Interview Drill::Go::G1 Language basics	idrill-3000	<p>Go'da array va slice farqi?</p>	<p><b>Array — qat'iy uzunlikli qiymat, slice — array ustidagi &quot;oyna&quot;.</b></p><ul><li>Array: uzunlik tipning qismi (<code>[3]int</code> ≠ <code>[4]int</code>), uzatilganda to'liq nusxalanadi.</li><li>Slice: <code>{ptr, len, cap}</code> — nusxalansa ham bir xil massivni ko'rsatadi.</li><li><code>append</code> cap yetmasa yangi massiv ochadi → bog'liqlik uziladi, shuning uchun doim <code>s = append(s, x)</code>.</li></ul>	lvl::Junior dom::go sec::g1 Basics
Interview Drill::Go::G1 Language basics	idrill-3001	<p>Bu kod nima chop etadi va nega?</p><pre>a := []int{1, 2, 3}<br>b := a[:2]<br>b = append(b, 99)<br>fmt.Println(a, b)</pre>	<p><b><code>[1 2 99] [1 2 99]</code></b></p><ul><li><code>b := a[:2]</code> → len=2, cap=3, <code>a</code> bilan bir massiv.</li><li><code>append</code> cap ichida joy topadi → yangi massiv ochmaydi, <code>a[2]</code> ni 99 ga yozadi.</li><li>Oldini olish: <code>a[:2:2]</code> (cap cheklash) yoki <code>slices.Clone</code>.</li></ul>	lvl::Junior dom::go sec::g1 Basics
Interview Drill::Go::G1 Language basics	idrill-3002	<p>&lt;code&gt;make&lt;/code&gt; va &lt;code&gt;new&lt;/code&gt; farqi?</p>	<p>**<code>make</code> — slice/map/chan ni ishga tayyor qiladi; <code>new(T)</code> — nol qiymatli T uchun joy ajratib <code>*T</code> qaytaradi.**</p><ul><li><code>new(map[string]int)</code> → nil map ga pointer: yozsangiz panic.</li><li><code>make(map[string]int)</code> → ishlaydigan map.</li><li>nil slice'ga esa <code>append</code> bemalol ishlaydi.</li></ul>	lvl::Junior dom::go sec::g1 Basics
Interview Drill::Go::G1 Language basics	idrill-3003	<p>Go 1.22+ da bu closure'lar nima chop etadi? Oldingi versiyalarda-chi?</p><pre>var fns []func()<br>for i := 0; i &lt; 3; i++ {<br>    fns = append(fns, func() { fmt.Print(i, &quot; &quot;) })<br>}<br>for _, f := range fns { f() }</pre>	<p><b>Go 1.22+: <code>0 1 2</code>. Go ≤1.21: <code>3 3 3</code>.</b></p><ul><li>1.22 dan har iteratsiyada yangi <code>i</code> yaratiladi — har closure o'z qiymatini ushlaydi.</li><li>Eskida bitta <code>i</code> bo'lgan, hammasi oxirgi qiymatni (3) ko'rgan; yechim <code>i := i</code> edi.</li><li>Xulq <code>go.mod</code> dagi <code>go</code> versiyasiga bog'liq.</li></ul>	lvl::Middle dom::go sec::g1 Basics
Interview Drill::Go::G1 Language basics	idrill-3004	<p>Nil pointer'ni <code>error</code> sifatida qaytarsak, <code>err != nil</code> nima bo'ladi?</p><pre>type MyErr struct{}<br>func (e *MyErr) Error() string { return &quot;boom&quot; }<br><br>func do() error {<br>    var p *MyErr = nil<br>    return p            // nil pointer, lekin error interfeysi ichida<br>}<br><br>func main() {<br>    if err := do(); err != nil {<br>        fmt.Println(&quot;xato bor:&quot;, err == nil)<br>    } else {<br>        fmt.Println(&quot;xato yo'q&quot;)<br>    }<br>}</pre>	<p><b><code>xato bor: false</code> — ya'ni <code>err != nil</code> true bo'ladi (typed nil).</b></p><ul><li>Interfeys = (tip, qiymat). Bu yerda tip=<code>*MyErr</code>, qiymat=nil → interfeys nil EMAS.</li><li>Tuzatish: xato bo'lmasa aniq <code>return nil</code> yozing, konkret pointer tipini qaytarmang.</li></ul>	lvl::Middle dom::go sec::g1 Errors
Interview Drill::Go::G1 Language basics	idrill-3005	<p><code>defer</code> qanday ishlaydi: argumentlar qachon hisoblanadi va tartib qanday?</p>	<p><b>Argumentlar <code>defer</code> yozilgan zahoti hisoblanadi; chaqiruvlar funksiya qaytishida LIFO tartibda bajariladi.</b></p><ul><li><code>i:=0; defer fmt.Println(i); i++</code> → 0 chiqadi.</li><li>Panic paytida ham ishlaydi (shuning uchun <code>recover</code> defer ichida).</li><li>Tuzoq: sikl ichida <code>defer f.Close()</code> — fayllar funksiya oxirigacha yopilmaydi.</li><li>Defer named return qiymatini o'zgartira oladi.</li></ul>	lvl::Middle dom::go sec::g1 Basics
Interview Drill::Go::G1 Language basics	idrill-3014	<p>Go'da xatolarni qanday boshqarasiz: wrapping, sentinel, custom tiplar?</p>	<p><b>Xato — oddiy qiymat: tekshiriladi, kontekst qo'shiladi va yuqoriga uzatiladi.</b></p><ul><li>Wrap: <code>fmt.Errorf(&quot;user yuklash: %w&quot;, err)</code> — zanjir saqlanadi (<code>%v</code> uzadi).</li><li>Tekshirish: <code>errors.Is</code> — sentinel (<code>ErrNotFound</code>), <code>errors.As</code> — maxsus tip.</li><li>Sentinel — API qismi, o'ylab e'lon qilinadi.</li><li>Xato matnini solishtirmang; bir marta, eng yuqori qatlamda log qiling.</li><li><code>panic</code> faqat dastur mantig'i buzilganda.</li></ul>	lvl::Senior dom::go sec::g1 Errors
Interview Drill::Go::G1 Language basics	idrill-3019	<p>Go'da interfeys qanday amalga oshiriladi (implement qilinadi)?</p>	<p><b>Implicit: tip interfeys metodlariga ega bo'lsa, avtomatik uni qanoatlantiradi — <code>implements</code> yo'q.</b></p><ul><li>Shuning uchun interfeys iste'molchi tomonda e'lon qilinadi.</li><li>Kichik interfeys afzal (<code>io.Reader</code> — 1 metod).</li><li>Nozik: metod pointer receiver bo'lsa, faqat <code>*T</code> qanoatlantiradi, <code>T</code> emas.</li></ul>	lvl::Middle dom::go sec::g1 Interfaces

Interview Drill::Go::G1 Language basics	idrill-11010	<p>Method value va method expression farqi?</p>	<p><b>Method value — <code>f := u.Describe</code>: receiver shu zahoti bog'lanadi. Interview Drill::System design::T3 System & infra gotchas	idrill-8018	<p>Redis'da natija: TTL qanday bo'ladi?</p><pre>SET session:1 &quot;data&quot; EX 600<br># 5 daqiqa o'tdi<br>SET session:1 &quot;yangi-data&quot;<br>TTL session:1</pre>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TTL <code>-1</code> bo'ladi — ya'ni kalit <b>abadiy</b> qoladi. Oddiy <code>SET key val</code> kalitni qayta yozadi va mavjud TTL'ni butunlay olib tashlaydi. Tuzoq: siz &quot;faqat qiymatni yangiladim&quot; deb o'ylaysiz, aslida muddatni ham o'chirdingiz.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Sessiya yoki lock kalitiga <code>SET</code> bilan qiymat yangilanadi — TTL yo'qoladi, kalit cheksiz yashaydi. Natija: xotira sekin to'ladi, yoki lock hech qachon bo'shamaydi (deadlock).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SET k v EX 60      -&gt; TTL 60<br>... 30s o'tdi (TTL 30) ...<br>SET k v2           -&gt; TTL -1 (olib tashlandi!)  &lt;- tuzoq<br>SET k v2 KEEPTTL   -&gt; TTL ~30 (saqlanadi)<br>EXPIRE k 60        -&gt; yoki qo'lda qayta qo'yish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>redis-cli SET k v EX 60<br>redis-cli TTL k            # 60<br>redis-cli SET k v2         # TTL ni o'chiradi<br>redis-cli TTL k            # -1  (abadiy!)<br>redis-cli SET k v2 KEEPTTL # TTL saqlanadi</pre><p><code>TTL</code> javoblari: <code>-1</code> = abadiy, <code>-2</code> = kalit yo'q, <code>&gt;0</code> = qolgan soniya.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sessiya/lock'ni <code>SET</code> bilan yangilash — TTL yo'qoladi, xotira to'ladi.</li><li><code>GETSET</code>, <code>SET</code> barchasi TTL'ni tiklaydi; faqat <code>KEEPTTL</code> yoki <code>EXPIRE</code> saqlaydi.</li><li><code>INCR</code>, <code>APPEND</code>, <code>HSET</code> kabi modifikatsiyalar TTL'ni o'zgartirmaydi — faqat <code>SET</code> oilasi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Lock uchun <code>SET key token NX EX 30</code> + Lua bilan egasini tekshirib o'chirish (Redlock pattern). Sessiya yangilashda har doim <code>KEEPTTL</code> yoki qayta <code>EX</code>. Xotira monitoring'ida <code>maxmemory</code> + eviction policy ham oxirgi himoya.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sys sec::t3 System_gotcha
Interview Drill::System design::T3 System & infra gotchas	idrill-8019	<p>Cache invalidatsiyasi: DB'ga yozganda cache'ni qachon o'chirish kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cache'ni tranzaksiya <b>COMMIT'dan keyin</b> o'chirish kerak (invalidate), oldin emas. Oldin o'chirsangiz, boshqa so'rov hali commit bo'lmagan eski qiymatni DB'dan o'qib keshga qayta yozadi — natijada kesh yana eski (stale) bo'lib qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Yozishdan oldin keshni tozalayman&quot; — klassik xato. Commit va o'chirish orasidagi oynada parallel o'qish eski qiymat bilan keshni qayta to'ldiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>YOMON (oldin o'chirish):<br>  DELETE cache -&gt; boshqa so'rov MISS -&gt; DB'dan ESKI o'qiydi -&gt; keshga ESKI yozadi<br>  -&gt; COMMIT  -&gt; kesh endi ESKI (stale)  X<br><br>YAXSHI (keyin o'chirish):<br>  BEGIN ... UPDATE ... COMMIT -&gt; DELETE cache<br>  -&gt; keyingi so'rov MISS -&gt; DB'dan YANGI -&gt; keshga YANGI</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>BEGIN;<br>UPDATE users SET name='Ali' WHERE id=42;<br>COMMIT;<br>-- COMMIT muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgandan keyin:</pre><pre>redis-cli DEL user:42       # update emas, DELETE — keyingi o'qish qayta to'ldiradi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cache'ni <b>update</b> qilish (yangi qiymat yozish) — race'ga moyil; <b>delete</b> + lazy reload xavfsizroq.</li><li>COMMIT va DELETE orasida ham kichik oyna bor — qisqa TTL ikkinchi himoya.</li><li>Commit fail bo'lsa cache'ni o'chirma (aks holda keraksiz miss).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yuqori izchillik kerak bo'lsa: delayed double-delete (commit'dan keyin DEL, qisqa kechikishdan keyin yana DEL) yoki CDC/binlog orqali invalidatsiya (Debezium) — ilova kodiga bog'liq emas. Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31203	<p>Unix nima va Unix-like (Unix-based) OS deganda nima tushuniladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Unix — 1969-yilda AT&amp;T Bell Labs'da (Ken Thompson, Dennis Ritchie) yaratilgan ko'p foydalanuvchili OS; 1973-da C tilida qayta yozilib, birinchi &quot;ko'chma&quot; (portable) OS bo'ldi. <b>Unix-like</b> — Unix kodini yoki sertifikatini olmagan, lekin Unix kabi ishlaydigan OS (Linux, FreeBSD).</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> DevOps'da ishlatadigan deyarli hamma narsa — Linux server, macOS laptop, konteyner — Unix g'oyalariga qurilgan. <code>ls</code>, <code>ps</code>, pipe, ruxsatlar bir xil ishlashining sababi shu umumiy ildiz.</p><p><b>Oila daraxti:</b></p><pre>            Unix (AT&amp;T, 1969)<br>           /                 \<br>   BSD (Berkeley)         System V (AT&amp;T)<br>    |      \                 |        \<br> FreeBSD  macOS (Darwin)   Solaris   AIX, HP-UX<br> OpenBSD<br>              Linux (1991) -- kod olmagan, qayta yozilgan, &quot;Unix-like&quot;</pre><p><b>Ikki toifa:</b> | Toifa | Ma'nosi | Misollar | |---|---|---| | Sertifikatlangan UNIX | Open Group'ning Single UNIX Specification testidan o'tgan, &quot;UNIX&quot; brendini ishlatadi | macOS, AIX, HP-UX, Solaris | | Unix-like | Kodi boshqa, sertifikati yo'q, lekin API va xulq bir xil | Linux, FreeBSD, OpenBSD |</p><p><b>Umumiy belgilar (Unix-likeni tanish usuli):</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Hamma narsa fayl&quot;: disk <code>/dev/sda</code>, jarayon <code>/proc/1234</code>.</li><li>Bitta ildizli ierarxik fayl tizimi (<code>/</code>).</li><li>Jarayon <code>fork()</code> + <code>exec()</code> bilan tug'iladi.</li><li>Pipe (<code>|</code>) bilan dasturlarni ulash.</li><li>Ko'p user, uid/gid, <code>rwx</code> ruxsatlar.</li><li>Shell — foydalanuvchi va kernel orasidagi interfeys.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>uname -s      # Linux / Darwin / FreeBSD<br>uname -a      # to'liq: kernel, versiya, arxitektura</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Linux = Unix&quot; deyish — huquqiy jihatdan noto'g'ri; Linux Unix-like.</li><li>macOS sertifikatlangan UNIX, lekin userland BSD — GNU buyruqlar flaglari farq qiladi.</li><li>Windows Unix-like emas (WSL ichida esa haqiqiy Linux kernel ishlaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amalda &quot;sertifikat bor-yo'q&quot; Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31204	<p>Unix falsafasi nima? Asosiy tamoyillari.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Unix falsafasi (Doug McIlroy): har dastur <b>bitta ishni yaxshi</b> bajarsin, dasturlar <b>birga ishlasin</b> (biri chiqishi — boshqasi kirishi), universal interfeys — <b>matn oqimi</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hamma narsani qiladigan bitta katta dastur — o'zgartirish qiyin, xato ko'p, qayta ishlatib bo'lmaydi. Kichik vositalar esa Lego kabi: har yangi masalaga yangi dastur yozmasdan, mavjudlarini ulaysan.</p><p><b>Asosiy tamoyillar:</b></p><ol><li><b>Bitta ish</b> — <code>sort</code> faqat saralaydi, <code>uniq</code> faqat takrorni yig'adi.</li><li><b>Kompozitsiya</b> — <code>|</code> orqali zanjir.</li><li><b>Matn — umumiy til</b> — har vosita stdin'dan o'qiydi, stdout'ga yozadi.</li><li><b>Hamma narsa fayl</b> — <code>/dev</code>, <code>/proc</code>, <code>/sys</code> bir xil <code>read/write</code> bilan.</li><li><b>Jim bo'l</b> — muvaffaqiyatda hech narsa chiqarma; xato stderr'ga, exit code bilan.</li><li><b>Tez prototip</b> — avval skript, keyin kerak bo'lsa optimallashtir.</li></ol><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>access.log -&gt; awk (1-ustun) -&gt; sort -&gt; uniq -c -&gt; sort -rn -&gt; head<br>   matn         IP'lar        tartib   sanoq      kamayish   top 10</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head<br>#   4521 10.0.0.15<br>#   1203 192.168.1.7</pre><p>Besh kichik vosita — bitta analitik so'rov, yangi kod yozilmadi.</p><pre>grep -q ERROR app.log &amp;&amp; echo &quot;xato bor&quot;   # jim, faqat exit code</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Keraksiz <code>cat file | grep</code> — <code>grep x file</code> yetarli (&quot;useless use of cat&quot;).</li><li>Matn oqimi strukturasi yo'q — bo'shliqli maydonlar <code>awk</code>'ni buzadi; JSON uchun <code>jq</code> ishlat.</li><li>Skript o'z chiqishiga ortiqcha bezak qo'shsa, keyingi vosita uni parse qila olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu falsafa mikroservis va CLI dizaynida ham ishlaydi: kichik, kompozitsiyalanadigan, aniq kontraktli komponentlar. Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31205	<p>Linux — OS'mi yoki kernel? GNU/Linux nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux — bu <b>kernel</b> (1991, Linus Torvalds). To'liq OS bo'lishi uchun ustiga <b>userland</b> kerak: shell, coreutils, libc, init, paket menejer. FSF bu kombinatsiyani &quot;GNU/Linux&quot; deb ataydi, chunki userland'ning katta qismi GNU loyihasidan.</p><p><b>Muammo / nega muhim:</b> &quot;Linux&quot; deganda nimani nazarda tutayotganingni bilish debug'da muhim: <code>ls</code> xatosi — coreutils muammosi, OOM — kernel muammosi, DNS — libc muammosi bo'lishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qatlamlar:</b></p><pre>+-------------------------------------------+<br>| Ilovalar (nginx, postgres, python)        |<br>+-------------------------------------------+<br>| Userland: bash, coreutils, systemd, apt   |<br>| libc: glibc (GNU) yoki musl (Alpine)      |<br>+-------------------------------------------+<br>| Linux kernel: process, memory, FS, net,   |<br>| driver, syscall                           |<br>+-------------------------------------------+<br>| Hardware                                  |<br>+-------------------------------------------+</pre><p><b>Kernel nima qiladi:</b> jarayonlar rejasi, xotira, drayverlar, fayl tizimlari, tarmoq stek, cgroups/namespaces. <b>Userland nima beradi:</b> <code>ls</code>, <code>cp</code>, <code>grep</code>, bash, <code>systemd</code>, <code>glibc</code>, <code>apt</code>/<code>dnf</code>.</p><p><b>Distributiv</b> = kernel + userland + paketlar + installer + release va support siyosati (Ubuntu, RHEL, Debian).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>uname -r                 # kernel: 6.8.0-45-generic<br>ldd --version | head -1  # libc: ldd (Ubuntu GLIBC 2.39) ...<br>ls --version | head -1   # coreutils: ls (GNU coreutils) 9.4<br>cat /etc/os-release      # distributiv</pre><p><b>Alpine misoli:</b> musl libc + BusyBox — GNU yo'q, lekin kernel Linux. Demak &quot;GNU/Linux&quot; har doim to'g'ri emas; Android ham Linux kernel, lekin GNU emas.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konteyner o'z kernel'iga ega deb o'ylash — yo'q, host kernel'ini ishlatadi; image faqat userland.</li><li><code>uname -r</code> va <code>/etc/os-release</code> ni aralashtirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konteyner davrida bu farq juda amaliy: image (userland) va host (kernel) alohida yangilanadi. Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31206	<p>POSIX nima va nega muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> POSIX (IEEE 1003, &quot;Portable Operating System Interface&quot;) — Unix-like OS'lar uchun umumiy standart: C API (<code>fork</code>, <code>open</code>, <code>pthread</code>), <code>sh</code> shell tili va asosiy utilitlar (<code>grep</code>, <code>sed</code>, <code>awk</code>). Muhimligi — <b>portability</b>: bir marta yozilgan skript/kod har joyda ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 1980-larda har Unix (BSD, System V, AIX) o'zicha edi — bir tizimda ishlagan dastur boshqasida buzilardi. POSIX &quot;minimal umumiy kontrakt&quot;ni belgiladi.</p><p><b>Nimani qamraydi:</b> | Qism | Misol | |---|---| | System API | <code>fork</code>, <code>exec</code>, <code>open</code>, <code>read</code>, <code>signal</code>, <code>pthread_create</code> | | Shell tili | <code>sh</code>: <code>if</code>, <code>case</code>, <code>for</code>, <code>$(...)</code>, <code>[ ]</code> | | Utilitlar | <code>ls</code>, <code>grep</code>, <code>sed</code>, <code>awk</code>, <code>find</code>, <code>tar</code> (pax) | | Muhit | <code>PATH</code>, <code>HOME</code>, exit code semantikasi |</p><p><b>Amalda — DevOps'da eng ko'p uchraydigan holat:</b></p><pre>#!/bin/sh<br># POSIX: Alpine (ash), Debian (dash), macOS, BusyBox'da ishlaydi<br>if [ &quot;$ENV&quot; = &quot;prod&quot; ]; then<br>  echo &quot;prod&quot;<br>fi</pre><pre>#!/bin/bash<br># Bash-ism: sh'da sinadi<br>if [[ $ENV == prod* ]]; then arr=(a b c); echo &quot;${arr[1]}&quot;; fi</pre><p>Tekshirish:</p><pre>shellcheck --shell=sh script.sh   # POSIX bo'lmagan sintaksisni topadi<br>dash -n script.sh                 # sintaksis tekshiruvi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ubuntu'da <code>/bin/sh</code> = dash. <code>#!/bin/sh</code> yozib <code>[[ ]]</code> ishlatsang — <code>[[: not found</code>.</li><li>Alpine image'da bash yo'q — <code>#!/bin/bash</code> skript ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>echo -e</code>, <code>sed -i</code>, <code>grep -P</code> — POSIX emas, platformaga qarab farqlanadi; <code>printf</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Linux rasmiy POSIX sertifikatiga ega emas, lekin amalda deyarli mos. Qoida: konteyner entrypoint va CI skriptlari — POSIX <code>sh</code>; murakkab mantiq — bash'ni aniq talab qil yoki Python/Go'ga o't.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v5 Unix_distros

Production uchun qaysi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Point/LTS release</b> (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, RHEL 9, Debian 12) — versiya muzlatiladi, faqat xavfsizlik/bugfix keladi. <b>Rolling</b> (Arch, Tumbleweed) — versiya yo'q, paketlar doim eng yangi. Production uchun — <b>LTS</b>: o'zgarish oldindan aytib bo'ladi va uzoq support bor.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Serverda <code>apt upgrade</code> qilding — PostgreSQL major versiyasi o'zgarib, ilova sindi. Rolling'da bu odatiy; LTS'da esa major versiyalar butun lifecycle davomida o'zgarmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>LTS:      24.04 ----- security patch ----- patch ----- ... (5 yil + ESM)<br>                (paket versiyalari muzlatilgan, fix backport qilinadi)<br>Rolling:  paket v1 -&gt; v2 -&gt; v3 (har kuni yangilanadi, &quot;versiya&quot; yo'q)<br>Fast:     Fedora 40 -&gt; 41 -&gt; 42 (~6 oy, ~13 oy support)</pre><p>| Tur | Misol | Support | Kimga | |---|---|---|---| | LTS / enterprise | RHEL 9 (10 yil), Ubuntu LTS (5 + 5 ESM), Debian (~5 yil LTS bilan) | uzun | production | | Fast release | Fedora, Ubuntu interim (9 oy) | qisqa | sinov, yangi feature | | Rolling | Arch, Tumbleweed | - | dev workstation |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /etc/os-release | grep VERSION<br>ubuntu-advantage status        # ESM holati (pro status)<br>apt list --upgradable          # LTS'da asosan security</pre><p>EOL'ni tekshirish: endoflife.date sayti.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>LTS'da Go/Node/Python eski — runtime'ni konteynerda yoki rasmiy vendor repo'dan ol, OS paketini emas.</li><li>&quot;Backport&quot; tufayli versiya raqami eski, lekin CVE yopilgan bo'lishi mumkin — skaner false positive beradi.</li><li>EOL'ga yetgan LTS (masalan, Ubuntu 20.04 standart support 2025-may tugadi) — patch kelmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> LTS tanlash — yarim yechim; asosiysi upgrade jarayoni. Major upgrade'ni har 2-3 yilda rejalashtir, aks holda EOL arafasida shoshilinch migratsiya bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v5 Unix_distros
Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31209	<p>Alpine (musl) vs Debian/Ubuntu (glibc) bazaviy image: qanday farq va gotcha?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Alpine — <b>musl libc + BusyBox</b>, ~5 MB. Debian/Ubuntu — <b>glibc</b> + GNU coreutils, slim ~30-80 MB. Farq kichik hajmda emas, <b>libc</b>'da: glibc uchun build qilingan binary, DNS xulqi, malloc tezligi va Python wheel'lar Alpine'da muammo beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Image kichraysin deb <code>FROM alpine</code> qilding — ilova <code>not found</code> bilan yiqildi yoki K8s'da DNS ba'zan ishlamaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>binary (glibc bilan link)  --needs--&gt;  /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2<br>Alpine'da bu fayl yo'q (musl: /lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1)<br>  =&gt; &quot;exec: not found&quot; (fayl bor, lekin loader yo'q)</pre><p><b>Asosiy gotcha'lar:</b> | Muammo | Sabab | |---|---| | <code>not found</code> | glibc dynamic loader yo'q | | DNS g'alati | musl resolver <code>search</code>/<code>ndots</code> va parallel so'rov xulqi farqli; eski musl TCP fallback'siz edi (1.2.4 dan beri bor) | | Ko'p thread'da sekin | musl malloc oddiyroq | | Python sekin build | manylinux wheel ishlamaydi (musllinux wheel kam), C extension compile qilinadi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>file ./app                         # dynamically linked, interpreter /lib64/ld-linux...<br>ldd ./app                          # qaysi lib'lar kerak<br>CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o app .    # Go: static, libc kerak emas</pre><pre>FROM golang:1.23 AS build<br>RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app .<br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12<br>COPY --from=build /app /app<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tanlov:</b></p><ul><li>Go static binary -&gt; <code>scratch</code> / <code>distroless/static</code>.</li><li>glibc kerak (Python, Java, Node native) -&gt; <code>debian:bookworm-slim</code> yoki distroless.</li><li>Alpine -&gt; shell kerak va hamma narsa musl'ga mos bo'lsa.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>apk add libc6-compat</code> — yamoq, kafolat emas.</li><li>Alpine'da bash yo'q — entrypoint <code>sh</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Image hajmi pull vaqtiga ta'sir qiladi, lekin layer cache bilan farq kichik. Debug va runtime barqarorligi bir necha MB'dan qimmat — default <code>debian-slim</code>/distroless, Alpine — ongli istisno.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v5 Unix_distros
Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31210	<p>Qaysi distributiv ekanini qanday aniqlaysan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng ishonchli usul — <code>/etc/os-release</code> (systemd standarti, deyarli hamma distroda bor): <code>ID</code>, <code>VERSION_ID</code>, <code>ID_LIKE</code>. Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31211	<p>Linux, BSD va macOS farqi (DevOps nuqtai nazaridan)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Linux</b> — faqat kernel, userland distributivdan (ko'pincha GNU); konteynerlar (cgroups, namespaces) faqat shu yerda native. <b>FreeBSD</b> — kernel va userland bitta repo'da, jails/ZFS/pf. <b>macOS</b> — XNU kernel + BSD userland; Docker u yerda Linux VM ichida ishlaydi. Sabab: GNU va BSD utilitlari bir xil nomli, lekin flaglari farqli.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | Linux | FreeBSD | macOS | |---|---|---|---| | Kernel | Linux (monolit, modulli) | FreeBSD | XNU (Mach + BSD) | | Userland | GNU (odatda) | BSD | BSD (+ eski GNU bash 3.2) | | Konteyner | cgroups + namespaces | jails | yo'q (Docker Desktop = Linux VM) | | Init | systemd | rc.d | launchd | | Litsenziya | GPLv2 | BSD | proprietary + BSD qism |</p><p><b>Klassik gotcha'lar:</b></p><pre>sed -i 's/a/b/' f          # GNU<br>sed -i '' 's/a/b/' f       # BSD/macOS (bo'sh backup suffiks majburiy)<br><br>date -d '1 day ago' +%F    # GNU<br>date -v-1d +%F             # BSD<br><br>stat -c %s file            # GNU<br>stat -f %z file            # BSD</pre><p><b>Yechimlar:</b></p><pre>brew install gnu-sed coreutils   # gsed, gdate<br>docker run --rm -v &quot;$PWD&quot;:/w -w /w ubuntu:24.04 ./script.sh   # CI bilan bir xil muhit</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>macOS default bash 3.2 (GPLv3 sabab) — <code>declare -A</code> yo'q; default shell zsh.</li><li>Mac'da Docker volume IO sekin (VM chegarasi) — benchmark'ni Linux'da qil.</li><li>Apple Silicon <code>arm64</code>, server <code>amd64</code> — <code>--platform</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Dev muhitini CI bilan tenglashtir: devcontainer yoki Nix. &quot;Mening Mac'imda ishlaydi&quot; — platforma farqi signali; skriptlarni POSIX yoki konteyner ichida yur.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v5 Unix_distros
Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31212	<p>Production uchun distributiv tanlashda qaysi mezonlarga qaraysan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy mezonlar: <b>lifecycle</b> (EOL, patch oynasi), <b>xavfsizlik</b> (CVE fix tezligi, SELinux/AppArmor, FIPS), <b>ekotizim</b> (vendor sertifikati, cloud image, driver), <b>kernel imkoniyatlari</b> (cgroup v2, eBPF), <b>jamoa bilimi</b> va <b>fleet bir xilligi</b>. Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31213	<p>Immutable/minimal host OS (Flatcar, Bottlerocket, Talos) nima va nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Immutable/minimal host OS (Flatcar, Bottlerocket, Talos) — faqat container runtime va kubelet uchun mo'ljallangan, <b>root FS read-only</b>, paket menejeri yo'q, yangilanish <b>A/B partition</b> bilan atomik. Interview Drill::Linux::V5 Unix & distributions	idrill-31214	<p>Kernel versiyasi va distributiv versiyasi nega alohida? <code>uname -r</code> nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kernel va distributiv — alohida mahsulot: distro (Ubuntu 24.04) o'z kernel'ini tanlaydi va yamaydi, lekin uni alohida yangilash mumkin. <code>uname -r</code> <b>hozir ishlayotgan</b> kernel versiyasini beradi: masalan <code>6.8.0-45-generic</code> (Ubuntu) yoki <code>5.14.0-427.el9.x86_64</code> (RHEL 9).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CVE skaner &quot;kernel 5.14 — zaif&quot; dedi, lekin RHEL 9 bu fixni allaqachon backport qilgan. Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-30557	<p><code>&gt;</code> , <code>&gt;&gt;</code> va <code>2&gt;&amp;1</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>&gt;</code> — stdout'ni faylga yozadi (fayl bor bo'lsa <b>ustidan yozadi</b>), <code>&gt;&gt;</code> — faylning <b>oxiriga qo'shadi</b>, <code>2&gt;&amp;1</code> — stderr (2) ni hozir stdout (1) qayerga ketayotgan bo'lsa o'sha yerga yo'naltiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cron skript ishlamadi, log fayl bo'sh. Sabab: xato xabarlari stderr'ga ketgan, faylga esa faqat stdout yozilgan. Yoki <code>&gt;</code> bilan kecha'gi log o'chib ketdi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Har jarayonda fayl deskriptorlari:<br>  0 = stdin   1 = stdout   2 = stderr<br>cmd &gt; out.log 2&gt;&amp;1<br>  1-qadam: 1 -&gt; out.log<br>  2-qadam: 2 -&gt; 1 hozir ko'rsatayotgan joy = out.log<br>cmd 2&gt;&amp;1 &gt; out.log<br>  1-qadam: 2 -&gt; 1 hozir = terminal<br>  2-qadam: 1 -&gt; out.log        (2 terminalda qoldi!)</pre><p>Redirect'lar <b>chapdan o'ngga</b> bajariladi — tartib muhim.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo &quot;salom&quot; &gt; a.txt          # a.txt = &quot;salom&quot; (eskisi o'chdi)<br>echo &quot;yana&quot; &gt;&gt; a.txt          # qo'shildi<br>ls /yoq &gt; out.log             # xato ekranda, out.log bo'sh<br>ls /yoq &gt; out.log 2&gt;&amp;1        # xato ham faylda<br>ls /yoq 2&gt; err.log            # faqat stderr<br>cmd &gt; out.log 2&gt; err.log      # alohida<br>cmd &amp;&gt; all.log                # bash: ikkalasi (= &gt; all.log 2&gt;&amp;1)<br>cmd &gt;&gt; app.log 2&gt;&amp;1           # cron uchun odatiy<br>cmd &gt; /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1          # hammasini tashlash<br>cmd 2&gt;&amp;1 | tee run.log        # ekranda ham, faylda ham</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>cmd 2&gt;&amp;1 &gt; file</code> — stderr faylga tushmaydi.</li><li><code>sort f &gt; f</code> — shell avval <code>f</code>ni bo'shatadi, keyin sort o'qiydi: fayl bo'sh qoladi. <code>sort -o f f</code> yoki <code>sponge</code>.</li><li><code>set -o noclobber</code> bilan <code>&gt;</code> mavjud faylni yozmaydi; majburlash — <code>&gt;|</code>.</li><li><code>&amp;&gt;</code> POSIX emas (<code>sh</code>/dash'da boshqacha ishlaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Servislarda loglarni faylga redirect qilish o'rniga stdout/stderr'ga yoz — systemd journald yoki konteyner runtime yig'adi (12-factor). Fayl redirect kerak bo'lsa, rotatsiya (logrotate) ham rejalashtirilsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v6 Shell
Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-30671	<p>sh, bash, zsh, fish farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>sh</b> — POSIX shell standarti (Debian/Ubuntu'da <code>dash</code>, Alpine'da BusyBox <code>ash</code>). <b>bash</b> — sh bilan mos + kengaytmalar (array, <code>[[ ]]</code>, <code>$(( ))</code>, <code>{1..10}</code>). <b>zsh</b> — bash'ga o'xshash, kuchli interaktiv qulayliklar (macOS default). <b>fish</b> — eng qulay interaktiv, lekin POSIX'ga <b>mos emas</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript developer'ning zsh'ida ishladi, Ubuntu'dagi <code>#!/bin/sh</code> yoki Alpine konteynerida sindi: <code>[[: not found</code>, <code>Syntax error: &quot;(&quot; unexpected</code>.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | Shell | POSIX | Kuchli tomoni | Qayerda default | |---|---|---|---| | sh (dash/ash) | ha | tez, kichik, portable | Debian <code>/bin/sh</code>, Alpine | | bash | ha + kengaytma | skriptlar, keng tarqalgan | ko'p Linux login shell | | zsh | deyarli | plugin, autocomplete, globbing | macOS | | fish | yo'q | autosuggestion, rangli, oson | - |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo $0                 # joriy shell<br>echo $SHELL             # login shell (default)<br>ls -l /bin/sh           # /bin/sh -&gt; dash<br>cat /etc/shells         # ruxsat etilganlar<br>chsh -s /bin/zsh        # default shell'ni o'zgartirish<br><br># Bash-ism'lar (sh'da ishlamaydi)<br>[[ $a == x* ]]; arr=(1 2 3); echo {1..5}; source f; function f { :; }<br># POSIX ekvivalentlari<br>[ &quot;$a&quot; = x ] ; set -- 1 2 3 ; seq 1 5 ; . f ; f() { :; }</pre><p>Tekshirish: <code>shellcheck -s sh script.sh</code>, <code>checkbashisms script.sh</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sh script.sh</code> bilan ishga tushirish shebang'ni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi — bash skript dash'da ishlaydi.</li><li>macOS bash 3.2 — <code>declare -A</code>, <code>mapfile</code> yo'q.</li><li>fish'da <code>export X=1</code> emas, <code>set -x X 1</code>; bash skriptlarni fish'da <code>source</code> qilib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Interaktiv uchun istalgan shell; avtomatlashtirish uchun aniq tanlov: entrypoint/CI — POSIX <code>sh</code>, murakkab skript — aniq <code>#!/usr/bin/env bash</code>. Skript qaysi shell'ga yozilganini shebang aytsin, taxmin emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v6 Shell

Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31215	<p>Shell nima? Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31217	<p>Shebang (<code>#!</code>) nima? <code>#!/bin/bash</code> va <code>#!/usr/bin/env bash</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shebang — skriptning birinchi qatoridagi <code>#!&lt;interpretator&gt;</code>. <code>./script.sh</code> bajarilganda kernel (<code>execve</code>) uni o'qib, interpretatorni chaqiradi: <code>/bin/bash ./script.sh</code>. <code>#!/bin/bash</code> — aniq yo'l; <code>#!/usr/bin/env bash</code> — <code>bash</code>ni <code>PATH</code>dan topadi (portable, masalan macOS'da brew bash).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript Linux'da ishladi, FreeBSD'da <code>bad interpreter: /bin/bash: No such file</code> — u yerda bash <code>/usr/local/bin/bash</code>da. Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31218	<p>Quoting: bitta qo'shtirnoq, qo'sh qo'shtirnoq va qo'shtirnoqsiz farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Bitta qo'shtirnoq</b> <code>'...'</code> — ichida hech narsa kengaymaydi (literal). <b>Qo'sh qo'shtirnoq</b> <code>&quot;...&quot;</code> — <code>$var</code>, <code>$(cmd)</code>, `<code> </code>cmd<code> </code><code> kengayadi, lekin <b>word splitting va glob bo'lmaydi</b>. <b>Qo'shtirnoqsiz</b> — kengayadi, keyin bo'shliqlar bo'yicha bo'linadi va </code>*` glob sifatida fayllarga aylanadi — xavfli.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>rm $f</code> — <code>f=&quot;my file.txt&quot;</code> bo'lsa ikki faylni (<code>my</code>, <code>file.txt</code>) o'chirishga urinadi. Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31219	<p>Glob (wildcard) va regex farqi? <code>*</code>, <code>?</code>, <code>[abc]</code>, <code>**</code>.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Glob</b> — shell'ning <b>fayl nomlari</b> bo'yicha naqshi: <code>*</code> istalgan belgilar, <code>?</code> bitta belgi, <code>[abc]</code>/<code>[a-z]</code> to'plam, <code><b></code> rekursiv (<code>shopt -s globstar</code>). </b>Regex<b> — <code>grep</code>/<code>sed</code>/<code>awk</code> ichida </b>matn** naqshi: <code>.</code> bitta belgi, <code>*</code> oldingisini 0+ marta, <code>^</code> <code>$</code> boshi/oxiri. Bir xil belgilar, boshqa ma'no.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>grep *.go -r .</code> — shell avval <code>*.go</code>ni joriy katalogdagi fayllarga kengaytiradi, grep noto'g'ri naqsh oladi. Yoki <code>ls *.tmp</code> fayl yo'q bo'lsa literal <code>*.tmp</code> ga xato beradi.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | Ma'no | Glob | Regex | |---|---|---| | istalgan belgilar | <code>*</code> | <code>.*</code> | | bitta belgi | <code>?</code> | <code>.</code> | | to'plam | <code>[a-c]</code> | <code>[a-c]</code> | | inkor | <code>[!a]</code> (yoki <code>[^a]</code>) | <code>[^a]</code> | | boshi/oxiri | butun nom avtomatik | <code>^</code> <code>$</code> | | kim ishlatadi | shell (fayl nomlari) | grep, sed, awk, <code>[[ =~ ]]</code> |</p><p><code>{a,b}</code> va <code>{1..5}</code> — <b>brace expansion</b>, glob emas: fayl bor-yo'qligidan qat'i nazar kengayadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls *.log                 # glob<br>ls file?.txt             # file1.txt, fileA.txt<br>ls [0-9]*.csv<br>shopt -s globstar; ls **/*.go     # rekursiv (bash 4+)<br>echo {dev,prod}.yaml     # dev.yaml prod.yaml<br>mkdir -p app/{src,test,docs}<br><br>grep -E '^ERROR.*timeout$' app.log   # regex — qo'shtirnoqda!<br>grep -r --include='*.go' &quot;TODO&quot; .     # glob grep'ga qo'shtirnoqda uzatiladi<br><br>shopt -s nullglob        # moslik yo'q -&gt; bo'sh ro'yxat<br>for f in *.tmp; do rm &quot;$f&quot;; done<br>shopt -s dotglob         # * yashirin fayllarni ham olsin</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Moslik bo'lmasa bash naqshni literal qoldiradi -&gt; <code>for f in *.tmp</code> bitta <code>*.tmp</code> iteratsiya. <code>nullglob</code> yoki <code>[ -e &quot;$f&quot; ] || continue</code>.</li><li><code>*</code> yashirin (<code>.env</code>) fayllarni olmaydi.</li><li>Regex'ni qo'shtirnoqsiz yozish — shell uni glob sifatida buzadi.</li><li>Juda ko'p fayl — <code>Argument list too long</code>; <code>find</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Glob — shell darajasida, buyruq ishga tushishidan <b>oldin</b> kengayadi; buni tushunish ko'p &quot;sirli&quot; xatolarni tushuntiradi. Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31257	<p><code>if</code> sharti: <code>[ ]</code>, <code>[[ ]]</code>, <code>test</code> va <code>(( ))</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>[ ]</code> va <code>test</code> — bir xil, POSIX (aslida buyruq). <code>[[ ]]</code> — bash/zsh kalit so'zi: word splitting yo'q, <code>&amp;&amp;</code>/<code>||</code> ichida, glob (<code>==</code>) va regex (<code>=~</code>) qo'llaydi. <code>(( ))</code> — arifmetik shart: <code>(( n &gt; Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31220	<p><code>set -euo pipefail</code> nima qiladi va qanday tuzoqlari bor?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>set -e</code> — buyruq 0 dan farqli kod qaytarsa skript to'xtaydi; <code>set -u</code> — aniqlanmagan o'zgaruvchiga murojaat xato; <code>set -o pipefail</code> — pipe'dagi har qanday buyruq xatosi butun pipe xatosi bo'ladi. Mantiq murakkablashsa — tilni almashtirish vaqti.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v6 Shell
Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31221	<p><code>$@</code>, <code>$*</code>, <code>$#</code>, <code>$0</code>, <code>$1</code>, <code>$$</code>, <code>$!</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Maxsus parametrlar: <code>$0</code> — skript nomi, <code>$1..$9</code>, <code>${10}</code> — pozitsion argumentlar, <code>$#</code> — argumentlar soni, <code>&quot;$@&quot;</code> — har argument <b>alohida</b> so'z (to'g'ri uzatish uchun), <code>&quot;$*&quot;</code> — hammasi <b>bitta</b> satr (<code>IFS</code>ning birinchi belgisi bilan), <code>$$</code> — joriy shell PID, <code>$!</code> — oxirgi fon (<code>&amp;</code>) jarayon PID, <code>$?</code> — oxirgi exit kod.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Wrapper skript <code>app $*</code> deb argument uzatadi — <code>--name &quot;Ali Vali&quot;</code> ikki argumentga bo'linadi va ilova xato oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>./s.sh &quot;a b&quot; Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31222	<p>Subshell nima? <code>( )</code>, <code>$( )</code>, pipe va <code>{ }</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Subshell</b> — joriy shell'ning nusxasi (fork), ichidagi o'zgarishlar (o'zgaruvchi, <code>cd</code>) tashqariga chiqmaydi. <code>( ... )</code>, <code>$( ... )</code> va pipe'ning har bir qismi (bash'da) — subshell. <code>{ ...; }</code> — <b>guruh</b>, joriy shell'da bajariladi, o'zgarishlar qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>cat f | while read l; do count=$((count+1)); done; echo $count</code> — <code>0</code>. Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31224	<p>Shell signal'lar va <code>trap</code>: skriptda cleanup qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>trap 'buyruq' SIGNAL</code> — skript signal yoki hodisa olganda bajariladigan handler. Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31259	<p>Bash funksiyalari: argument, return qiymat va <code>local</code>?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Funksiya <code>name() { ...; }</code> bilan e'lon qilinadi, argumentlar <code>$1</code>, <code>$2</code>, <code>&quot;$@&quot;</code> orqali keladi. <code>return N</code> — faqat <b>exit status</b> (0-255) qaytaradi, qiymat emas; natija <code>echo</code> qilinib <code>$(func)</code> bilan olinadi. <code>local</code> — o'zgaruvchini funksiya ichida cheklaydi; usiz hamma narsa global.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Funksiya <code>return &quot;$result&quot;</code> deb satr qaytarishga urinadi -&gt; <code>numeric argument required</code>. Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31260	<p>Bash array va associative array qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Indeksli array: <code>arr=(a b c)</code>, element <code>&quot;${arr[0]}&quot;</code>, hammasi <code>&quot;${arr[@]}&quot;</code>, soni <code>${#arr[@]}</code>, qo'shish <code>arr+=(d)</code>. Associative array (bash 4+): <code>declare -A m=([k]=v)</code>, kalitlar <code>&quot;${!m[@]}&quot;</code>, qiymat <code>&quot;${m[$k]}&quot;</code>. Faylni array'ga: <code>mapfile -t lines &lt; file</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Host ro'yxatini satrda saqlab <code>for h in $HOSTS</code> qilish — bo'shliqli nomlar va glob'da buziladi. Array har elementni chegarasi bilan saqlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>hosts=(web1 web2 &quot;db 1&quot;)<br>  [0]=web1  [1]=web2  [2]=&quot;db 1&quot;<br>&quot;${hosts[@]}&quot; -&gt; [web1] [web2] [db 1]   (har biri alohida so'z)<br>&quot;${hosts[*]}&quot; -&gt; [web1 web2 db 1]       (bitta satr)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>hosts=(web1 web2 &quot;db 1&quot;)<br>hosts+=(cache1)<br>echo &quot;${#hosts[@]}&quot;            # 4<br>echo &quot;${hosts[0]}&quot; &quot;${hosts[-1]}&quot;   # web1 cache1<br>for h in &quot;${hosts[@]}&quot;; do echo &quot;[$h]&quot;; done<br>echo &quot;${hosts[@]:1:2}&quot;         # slice: web2 db 1<br>unset 'hosts[1]'               # element o'chirish (indekslar siljimaydi!)<br><br>declare -A port=([web]=80 [db]=5432)<br>port[redis]=6379<br>for k in &quot;${!port[@]}&quot;; do echo &quot;$k=${port[$k]}&quot;; done<br>[[ -v port[db] ]] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;db bor&quot;<br><br>mapfile -t lines &lt; hosts.txt   # har qator — element<br>readarray -t ips &lt; &lt;(dig +short example.com)<br><br># Buyruqqa argumentlarni xavfsiz yig'ish<br>args=(--name &quot;Ali Vali&quot; --verbose)<br>[[ $dry == 1 ]] &amp;&amp; args+=(--dry-run)<br>./tool &quot;${args[@]}&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>macOS bash 3.2 — <code>declare -A</code>, <code>mapfile</code> yo'q.</li><li>Associative array tartibi kafolatlanmagan — kerak bo'lsa kalitlarni sort qil.</li><li><code>arr=$(ls)</code> — array emas, bitta satr; <code>arr=( $(ls) )</code> — splitting/glob xavfi.</li><li><code>sh</code>/dash'da array yo'q — POSIX'da faqat <code>set --</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Array'ning eng foydali qo'llanishi — buyruq argumentlarini xavfsiz yig'ish (<code>&quot;${args[@]}&quot;</code>), satr ichida emas. Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31263	<p>Arifmetika shell'da qanday? <code>$(( ))</code>, <code>let</code>, <code>expr</code>, <code>bc</code>.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bash'da butun son arifmetikasi — <b><code>$(( ))</code></b> (natija qaytaradi) va <b><code>(( ))</code></b> (shart/o'zgartirish). <code>let</code> — eski sinonim, <code>expr</code> — eskirgan tashqi buyruq. Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-30677	<p>Pipe (<code>|</code>) qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>a | b</code> — shell ikki jarayonni <b>bir vaqtda</b> ishga tushiradi va kernel <b>pipe</b> (bir tomonlama bufer, Linux'da default 64 KiB) orqali <code>a</code>ning stdout'ini <code>b</code>ning stdin'iga ulaydi. Bufer to'lsa yozuvchi <b>bloklanadi</b> (backpressure), bufer bo'sh bo'lsa o'quvchi kutadi; o'quvchi yopilsa yozuvchi <b>SIGPIPE</b> oladi va o'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>yes | head -1</code> nega cheksiz ishlamaydi? Pipe mexanikasini bilish bularni tushuntiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>shell: pipe() -&gt; [fd_read, fd_write]<br>       fork -&gt; a: stdout = fd_write  -&gt; exec a<br>       fork -&gt; b: stdin  = fd_read   -&gt; exec b<br>a --write--&gt; [ kernel bufer 64 KiB ] --read--&gt; b<br>   bufer to'la   -&gt; a uxlaydi (backpressure)<br>   a tugadi (EOF)-&gt; b read() 0 qaytaradi -&gt; tugaydi<br>   b yopildi     -&gt; a write() -&gt; SIGPIPE (exit 141) yoki EPIPE</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>yes | head -1              # head 1 qator o'qib chiqadi -&gt; yes SIGPIPE oladi<br>echo &quot;${PIPESTATUS[@]}&quot;    # 141 0  (128 + 13 SIGPIPE)<br><br>false | true; echo $?                 # 0 — faqat oxirgisi<br>set -o pipefail; false | true; echo $?   # 1<br><br>cat /proc/sys/fs/pipe-max-size        # maksimal bufer (1 MiB default)<br>ls -l /proc/$$/fd                     # pipe:[12345] ko'rinadi<br><br>mkfifo /tmp/p                         # nomli pipe (FIFO)<br>cat /tmp/p &amp; echo hello &gt; /tmp/p<br><br># Pipe ichidagi while subshell'da — o'zgaruvchi yo'qoladi<br>n=0; printf 'a\nb\n' | while read -r l; do n=$((n+1)); done; echo $n   # 0<br>n=0; while read -r l; do n=$((n+1)); done &lt; &lt;(printf 'a\nb\n'); echo $n # 2</pre><p><b>Buferlash:</b> ko'p dasturlar stdout terminal bo'lmasa blok-buferlaydi (4-8 KiB) — <code>tail -f log | grep x | awk ...</code> kechikib chiqadi. Xuddi shu tushunchalar Kafka consumer lag, gRPC flow control va TCP oynasida qaytadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v6 Shell
Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31225	<p>Konteyner ENTRYPOINT'da shell form va exec form farqi; nega <code>exec</code> muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Shell form</b> (<code>CMD node server.js</code>) — Docker uni <code>/bin/sh -c &quot;node server.js&quot;</code> sifatida ishga tushiradi, PID 1 = <code>sh</code>. <b>Exec form</b> (<code>CMD [&quot;node&quot;, &quot;server.js&quot;]</code>) — PID 1 = <code>node</code>. Shell PID 1 bo'lsa SIGTERM'ni bola jarayonga uzatmaydi — graceful shutdown buziladi. Wrapper skriptda oxirgi qator <b><code>exec ./app &quot;$@&quot;</code></b> — shell o'rnini ilova egallaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> K8s rollout'da pod 30 soniya &quot;Terminating&quot; turadi, keyin SIGKILL — ochiq so'rovlar uziladi, DB tranzaksiyalar yarim qoladi. Sabab: SIGTERM <code>sh</code>ga keldi, <code>node</code> uni hech qachon olmadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Shell form, exec'siz:<br>  PID 1: sh -c &quot;node server.js&quot;<br>           PID 7: node            &lt;- SIGTERM bu yerga yetmaydi<br>  docker stop -&gt; SIGTERM -&gt; sh (PID 1, handler yo'q, kernel PID 1 uchun default'ni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi)<br>  -&gt; 10 s (K8s: terminationGracePeriodSeconds) -&gt; SIGKILL -&gt; hamma o'ladi<br><br>Exec form yoki exec:<br>  PID 1: node  &lt;- SIGTERM to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, ilova o'zi yopiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Yomon<br>CMD node server.js<br># Yaxshi<br>CMD [&quot;node&quot;, &quot;server.js&quot;]<br><br># Wrapper bilan<br>COPY entrypoint.sh /entrypoint.sh<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/entrypoint.sh&quot;]<br>CMD [&quot;--port&quot;, &quot;8080&quot;]</pre><pre>#!/bin/sh<br>set -e<br>./migrate                     # tayyorgarlik<br>exec ./app &quot;$@&quot;               # shell almashtiriladi, CMD argumentlari uzatiladi</pre><p>Tekshirish:</p><pre>docker exec c ps -o pid,comm  # PID 1 kim?<br>time docker stop c            # ~10 s bo'lsa — signal yetmayapti</pre><p>Zombie yig'ish va signal uzatish uchun:</p><pre>docker run --init image       # tini PID 1</pre><pre>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/usr/bin/tini&quot;, &quot;--&quot;, &quot;/entrypoint.sh&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Exec form'da <code>$VAR</code> kengaymaydi (shell yo'q) — kerak bo'lsa wrapper skript.</li><li>Ilova SIGTERM'ni ushlamasa — <code>exec</code> ham yordam bermaydi; kodda handler kerak.</li><li>Ko'p jarayonli konteyner (supervisord) — har birini to'g'ri to'xtatish murakkab.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Graceful shutdown zanjiri: PID 1 signal oladi -&gt; readiness o'chadi -&gt; yangi so'rov olmaydi -&gt; mavjudlarini tugatadi -&gt; chiqadi, hammasi grace period ichida. K8s'da <code>preStop</code> sleep endpoint'lar yangilanishini kutish uchun ham kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v6 Shell
Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31226	<p>Production bash skript uchun qanday standartlar qo'llaysan? Qachon bash emas?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Production bash standarti: <code>#!/usr/bin/env bash</code> + <code>set -euo pipefail</code>, har o'zgaruvchi qo'shtirnoqda, <b>shellcheck CI'da</b>, <code>trap cleanup EXIT</code> + <code>mktemp</code>, <code>flock</code> bilan parallel ishga tushishdan himoya, <b>idempotentlik</b>, aniq exit kodlar, log stderr'ga, xavfli amallar uchun <code>--dry-run</code> va <code>${var:?}</code>. &amp;&amp; pwd)&quot;<br>log()  { printf '%s [%s] %s\n' &quot;$(date -Is)&quot; &quot;${2:-INFO}&quot; &quot;$1&quot; &gt;&amp;2; }<br>die()  { log &quot;$1&quot; ERROR; exit &quot;${2:-1}&quot;; }<br>usage(){ echo &quot;usage: $0 [--dry-run] &lt;env&gt;&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 2; }<br><br>DRY=0<br>[[ ${1:-} == --dry-run ]] &amp;&amp; { DRY=1; shift; }<br>ENV=${1:-}; [[ -n $ENV ]] || usage<br>run() { if (( DRY )); then log &quot;DRY: $*&quot;; else &quot;$@&quot;; fi; }<br><br>exec 9&gt;/var/lock/deploy.lock<br>flock -n 9 || die &quot;boshqa deploy ishlayapti&quot; 0<br><br>tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf &quot;$tmp&quot;' EXIT<br><br>command -v kubectl &gt;/dev/null || die &quot;kubectl yo'q&quot;<br>run kubectl apply -f &quot;$SCRIPT_DIR/manifests/$ENV&quot;</pre><p>| Standart | Nega | |---|---| | strict mode | xatoda davom etmaslik | | shellcheck CI | quoting, <code>cd</code> tekshiruvi | | idempotent | qayta ishga tushirish xavfsiz (retry) | | flock | cron overlap'dan himoya | | dry-run | xavfsiz sinov | | <code>bats</code> testlar | regressiya |</p><p><b>Qachon bash emas:</b></p><ul><li>150-200+ qator yoki murakkab boshqaruv oqimi.</li><li>JSON/YAML bilan jiddiy ishlash (<code>jq</code>dan oshsa).</li><li>Concurrency, retry/backoff, timeout'lar.</li><li>Unit test, tiplar, refaktoring kerak.</li><li>Windows'da ham ishlashi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>set -x</code> CI logda sirlarni chiqaradi.</li><li><code>IFS=$'\n\t'</code> — ataylab bo'shliq bo'yicha bo'lishga tayangan kodni buzadi.</li><li>Skriptni &quot;faqat bir marta ishlataman&quot; Qoida: glue — bash, logika — Go/Python; va har ikkisi ham kod review, test va versiyalash talab qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v6 Shell
Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31227	<p>Buyruq qanday topiladi va bajariladi: alias, function, builtin, PATH — tartib?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bash buyruq nomini quyidagi tartibda qidiradi: <b>alias</b> -&gt; <b>keyword</b> (<code>if</code>, <code>[[</code>) -&gt; <b>function</b> -&gt; <b>builtin</b> (<code>cd</code>, <code>echo</code>, <code>read</code>) -&gt; <b><code>PATH</code></b> kataloglari chapdan o'ngga (natija <code>hash</code> keshida). Nomda <code>/</code> bo'lsa (<code>./app</code>, <code>/usr/bin/ls</code>) — qidiruv yo'q, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'sha fayl. Topilgach: builtin/function — joriy shell'da; tashqi dastur — <code>fork</code> + <code>execve</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>ls</code> kutilmagan natija beryapti — alias. <code>cd</code> nega alohida binary emas? Chunki jarayon faqat o'zining joriy katalogini o'zgartira oladi; tashqi <code>cd</code> child'da ishlab, shell'ga ta'sir qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>&quot;ll&quot; kiritildi<br>  alias? ll='ls -alF' -&gt; almashtirish, qaytadan tahlil<br>  keyword? function? builtin?<br>  hash keshida? -&gt; to'g'ridan yo'l<br>  PATH: /usr/local/bin -&gt; /usr/bin -&gt; /bin ... birinchi bajariladigan<br>  topilmadi -&gt; command_not_found_handle -&gt; 127<br>tashqi: fork() -&gt; child: execve(&quot;/usr/bin/ls&quot;, argv, env) -&gt; parent wait()</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>type -a echo        # echo is a shell builtin / echo is /usr/bin/echo<br>type ll cd if       # alias / builtin / keyword<br>command ls          # alias va function'ni chetlab o'tish<br>\ls                 # faqat alias'ni chetlab o'tish<br>builtin cd /tmp     # aynan builtin<br>env ls              # faqat PATH'dagi dastur<br>hash; hash -r       # keshni ko'rish/tozalash (binary ko'chgandan keyin)<br>enable -n echo      # builtin'ni o'chirish (kamdan-kam)</pre><p><b>Security — PATH hijacking:</b></p><pre>PATH=.:/usr/bin   va  /tmp/ls (hujumchi skripti)<br>root: cd /tmp &amp;&amp; ls   -&gt; ./ls ishlaydi -&gt; root huquqida</pre><p>Himoya: PATH'da <code>.</code> va hammaga yoziladigan katalog yo'q; sudo <code>secure_path</code>; root skriptlarda to'liq yo'llar.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Funksiya nomi buyruq bilan bir xil (<code>ls() { ... }</code>) — rekursiya; ichida <code>command ls</code> ishlat.</li><li>Alias non-interactive skriptlarda default o'chiq (<code>expand_aliases</code>).</li><li>Binary yangi joyga ko'chgach eski hash yo'li — <code>No such file or directory</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Buyruqni topish tartibi xavfsizlik chegarasi hamdir: privileged kontekstda (sudo, cron, systemd) qaysi binary ishlashi taxminga emas, aniq yo'l va boshqariladigan PATH'ga asoslansin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v6 Shell

Interview Drill::Linux::V6 Shell	idrill-31265	<p>Parallel ish va concurrency shell'da: <code>&amp;</code>, <code>wait</code>, <code>xargs -P</code>, <code>flock</code>?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>cmd &amp;</code> — fon jarayon; <code>wait</code> — fondagilarni kutish (<code>wait $pid</code> — aniq jarayon va uning exit kodi). Cheklangan parallelizm — <code>xargs -P N</code> yoki <code>wait -n</code> bilan &quot;slot&quot; boshqaruvi. Bir vaqtda faqat bitta nusxa ishlashi uchun — <b><code>flock</code></b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 500 host'ga <code>for h in ...; do ssh &quot;$h&quot; ... &amp; done; wait</code> — 500 SSH birdan: fd limit, CPU, maqsad tizimga bosim; xatolar esa yo'qoladi, chunki oddiy <code>wait</code> doim 0 qaytaradi. Cron backup skripti oldingisi tugamay qayta ishga tushadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>cmd1 &amp;  cmd2 &amp;  cmd3 &amp;      -&gt; 3 parallel child, $! = oxirgi PID<br>wait            -&gt; hammasi tugaguncha, rc = 0 (xatolar yo'qoladi)<br>wait $pid       -&gt; o'sha jarayon rc<br>wait -n         -&gt; istalgan bittasi tugashini kutadi (bash 4.3+)<br>flock -n fd     -&gt; lock olinmasa darhol chiqish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Xatolarni yig'ish<br>pids=()<br>for h in web1 web2 web3; do ssh -n &quot;$h&quot; uptime &gt; &quot;out.$h&quot; 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp; pids+=($!); done<br>rc=0; for p in &quot;${pids[@]}&quot;; do wait &quot;$p&quot; || rc=1; done<br>exit $rc<br><br># Cheklangan parallel (8 tadan)<br>xargs -P 8 -I{} sh -c 'ssh -n {} uptime &gt; out.{} 2&gt;&amp;1' &lt; hosts.txt<br><br># wait -n bilan slot<br>max=8<br>while read -r h; do<br>  while (( $(jobs -rp | wc -l) &gt;= max )); do wait -n; done<br>  work &quot;$h&quot; &amp;<br>done &lt; hosts.txt<br>wait<br><br># GNU parallel: progress, retry, natija<br>parallel -j 8 --joblog jobs.log --retries 2 ssh {} uptime :::: hosts.txt<br><br># Bitta nusxa (cron overlap)<br>exec 9&gt;/var/lock/backup.lock<br>flock -n 9 || { echo &quot;allaqachon ishlayapti&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 0; }<br># yoki crontab'da: flock -n /var/lock/backup.lock /opt/backup.sh</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cheklovsiz <code>&amp;</code> — resurslar tugaydi, maqsad servis yiqiladi.</li><li>Parallel chiqishlar terminalda aralashadi — har birini o'z faylga.</li><li>Fon jarayonlar skript o'lganda yetim qoladi — <code>trap 'kill $(jobs -p)' EXIT</code>.</li><li>Lock fayl <code>/tmp</code>da va hammaga yoziladigan — boshqa user bloklashi mumkin; <code>/var/lock</code> yoki <code>/run</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Concurrency'ning asosiy savollari bash'da ham bir xil: parallelizm chegarasi, xatolarni yig'ish, timeout, bekor qilish va bir xil ishning takrorlanmasligi. Bularning hammasi kerak bo'lsa — bash chegarasi; Ansible (<code>forks</code>), GNU parallel yoki Go'dagi worker pool to'g'riroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v6 Shell

Tipik misollar.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>sed</b> — oqim muharriri: qatorlarda <b>matn almashtirish</b>, o'chirish, qator oralig'ini chiqarish. <b>awk</b> — ustunli matn uchun kichik til: <b>maydonlar bo'yicha filtr, hisoblash, guruhlash</b>. Access log'dan 5xx sonini va har IP bo'yicha trafikni hisoblash kerak (awk).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>sed: har qator -&gt; buyruq (s/// , d, p) -&gt; chiqish<br>awk: har qator -&gt; $1 $2 ... $NF ustunlarga bo'linadi -&gt; &quot;shart { amal }&quot; -&gt; END { yakun }</pre><p><b>Amalda — sed:</b></p><pre>sed 's/old/new/g' app.conf               # natija ekranga (fayl o'zgarmaydi)<br>sed -i.bak 's/old/new/g' app.conf        # joyida + .bak zaxira<br>sed -n '10,20p' file                     # 10-20 qatorlar<br>sed '/^#/d; /^$/d' nginx.conf            # izoh va bo'sh qatorlarni olib tashlash<br>sed -i 's|/opt/old|/opt/new|g' *.conf    # / ko'p bo'lsa boshqa ajratuvchi<br>sed -i '/^PermitRootLogin/s/yes/no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config</pre><p><b>Amalda — awk:</b></p><pre>awk '{print $1}' access.log                       # 1-ustun<br>awk '$9 &gt;= 500 {c++} END {print c+0}' access.log  # 5xx soni<br>awk -F, '{s+=$3} END {print s/NR}' data.csv       # o'rtacha<br>awk '{a[$1]+=$10} END {for (k in a) print a[k], k}' access.log | sort -rn | head<br>awk -F: '$3 &gt;= 1000 {print $1}' /etc/passwd       # oddiy user'lar<br>df -h | awk 'NR&gt;1 &amp;&amp; $5+0 &gt; 80 {print $6, $5}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sed -i</code> macOS'da <code>sed -i ''</code> — skriptlar platformalar orasida sinadi.</li><li>sed regex'da <code>.</code> istalgan belgi — domen/IP'da <code>\.</code>.</li><li>awk'da <code>$9 &gt;= 500</code> — ustun matn bo'lsa noto'g'ri solishtiradi; <code>$9+0</code>.</li><li>JSON/YAML'ni sed bilan tahrirlash — struktura buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bir martalik tahlil uchun awk juda kuchli; lekin 3-4 qatordan uzun awk dasturi — kodni Python'ga ko'chirish vaqti, chunki uni o'qish va test qilish qiyinlashadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v9 Commands_editors

Octal: r=4, w=2, x=1, uchta raqam — <b>user, group, others</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova <code>Permission denied</code> bilan config'ni o'qiy olmaydi. &quot;Tez yechim&quot; <code>chmod -R 777</code> — har kim o'qiy va yoza oladi, bu xavfsizlik teshigi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>-rw-r----- = 640<br>  rw-  (6 = 4+2)  user (egasi)<br>  r--  (4)        group<br>  ---  (0)        others<br>katalogda: r = ro'yxat, w = fayl yaratish/o'chirish, x = ichiga kirish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>chmod 640 app.conf                 # rw- r-- ---<br>chmod 755 deploy.sh                # rwx r-x r-x<br>chmod u+x,g-w script.sh            # symbolic<br>chmod -R u=rwX,g=rX,o= /srv/app    # X (katta): faqat katalog va allaqachon bajariladiganlarga x<br>chown app:app /var/lib/app<br>chown -R www-data: /var/www        # &quot;:&quot; — user'ning asosiy guruhi<br>chgrp devs shared.txt<br>stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' app.conf     # 640 app:app app.conf<br><br># Fayl va katalogga alohida<br>find /srv -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +<br>find /srv -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +</pre><p>| Octal | Ma'nosi | Tipik | |---|---|---| | 600 | faqat egasi o'qish/yozish | SSH kalit, sir | | 644 | hamma o'qiydi | oddiy fayl | | 640 | guruh o'qiydi | config | | 755 | hamma bajaradi | binary, katalog | | 700 | faqat egasi | <code>~/.ssh</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>chmod -R 777</code> — muammoni yashiradi va teshik ochadi; to'g'ri egalik/guruh ber.</li><li><code>chmod -R 644 dir</code> — kataloglardan <code>x</code> olinadi, ichiga kirib bo'lmaydi; <code>X</code> yoki <code>find -type</code>.</li><li><code>chown -R user /</code> kabi xato — tizimni buzadi; <code>--preserve-root</code> default, lekin <code>/*</code> himoyalanmagan.</li><li><code>chown</code> faqat root (oddiy user faylni boshqaga bera olmaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Least privilege: servis o'z user'i bilan, config <code>640 root:app</code>, sirlar <code>600</code>. Interview Drill::Linux::V9 Shell commands & text editors	idrill-33360	<p><code>tee</code> va pipe'dagi exit code: <code>cmd | tee log</code> da <code>cmd</code> xato bersa skript buni biladimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yo'q, default'da bilmaydi: pipe'ning exit kodi <b>oxirgi buyruqniki</b> — ya'ni <code>tee</code> (deyarli doim 0). <code>cmd</code> yiqilsa ham <code>cmd | tee log</code> muvaffaqiyatli ko'rinadi. Interview Drill::Linux::V9 Shell commands & text editors	idrill-33362	<p><code>tee</code> bufferlash va real-time log: nega <code>python app.py | tee log</code> da chiqish kechikadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Sabab — <b>stdout buferlash</b>: C stdio va Python stdout <b>terminal (TTY)</b> bo'lsa qatorlab (line-buffered), <b>pipe yoki fayl</b> bo'lsa katta bloklar bilan (4-8 KiB) buferlaydi. <code>python app.py | tee log</code> — Python pipe'ga yozyapti, shuning uchun chiqish to'planib keladi. Interview Drill::Linux::V9 Shell commands & text editors	idrill-33371	<p>stdin, stdout, stderr nima? File descriptor 0, 1, 2 va <code>/dev/null</code>?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har jarayon uchta standart oqim bilan boshlanadi: <b>stdin (fd 0)</b> — kirish, <b>stdout (fd 1)</b> — oddiy chiqish, <b>stderr (fd 2)</b> — xato va diagnostika. Bu ataylab: xatolar ma'lumot oqimini buzmasin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            +---------+<br> 0 stdin --&gt;|   cmd   |--&gt; 1 stdout --&gt; (ekran / fayl / pipe)<br>            |         |--&gt; 2 stderr --&gt; (ekran)<br>            +---------+<br>fd 3, 4, ... -&gt; dastur ochgan boshqa fayllar, socket'lar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cmd &lt; input.txt          # stdin fayldan<br>cmd &gt; out.txt            # stdout faylga (ustidan yozish)<br>cmd &gt;&gt; out.txt           # stdout qo'shish<br>cmd 2&gt; err.txt           # faqat stderr<br>cmd &gt; all.txt 2&gt;&amp;1       # ikkalasi bitta faylga<br>cmd &amp;&gt; all.txt           # bash qisqa yozuvi<br>cmd 2&gt;/dev/null          # xatolarni yashirish<br>cmd &gt; /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1     # hammasini jim qilish<br>echo &quot;xato&quot; &gt;&amp;2          # skriptdan stderr'ga yozish<br><br>ls -l /proc/$$/fd        # joriy shell'ning fd'lari<br># 0 -&gt; /dev/pts/0  1 -&gt; /dev/pts/0  2 -&gt; /dev/pts/0<br>ls -l /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/fd | wc -l   # jarayon nechta fd ochgan<br>ulimit -n                # fd limiti</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Skriptda log/progress'ni stdout'ga yozish — <code>$(script)</code> natijasi yoki pipe ma'lumoti buziladi; diagnostika <code>&gt;&amp;2</code>.</li><li><code>2&gt;/dev/null</code> hamma joyda — haqiqiy xatolar ham yo'qoladi, debug qiyinlashadi.</li><li>&quot;Too many open files&quot; — fd limiti tugagan (<code>ulimit -n</code>, systemd <code>LimitNOFILE=</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> stdout = ma'lumot, stderr = diagnostika — bu kontrakt CLI vositalarini kompozitsiya qilinadigan qiladi. Yoki o'zgarishni 10 serverga bir xil qo'llash kerak.</p><p><b>Unified diff'ni o'qish:</b></p><pre>--- nginx.conf.orig<br>+++ nginx.conf<br>@@ -10,3 +10,3 @@          &lt;- eski: 10-qatordan 3 qator; yangi: 10-qatordan 3 qator<br>     server_name example.com;<br>-    listen 80;              &lt;- o'chirilgan<br>+    listen 443 ssl;         &lt;- qo'shilgan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>diff -u nginx.conf.orig nginx.conf &gt; nginx.patch<br>patch --dry-run -p0 &lt; nginx.patch      # avval sinash<br>patch -p0 &lt; nginx.patch                # qo'llash<br>patch -R -p0 &lt; nginx.patch             # bekor qilish<br><br>diff -rq /etc/nginx/ /backup/nginx/    # qaysi fayllar farq qiladi<br>diff -ru dir1/ dir2/                   # to'liq farq<br>diff &lt;(ssh web1 cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf) &lt;(ssh web2 cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf)<br>diff &lt;(sort a.txt) &lt;(sort b.txt)       # tartibsiz ro'yxatlar<br>diff -u &lt;(grep -Ev '^\s*(#|$)' a.conf) &lt;(grep -Ev '^\s*(#|$)' b.conf)   # izohlarsiz<br>diff -w a b                            # bo'shliqlarni e'tiborsiz<br>vimdiff a b                            # interaktiv (do / dp — o'tkazish)<br>cmp -s a b &amp;&amp; echo bir-xil             # binary, jim<br>git diff --no-index a.conf b.conf      # git rangli diff, git repo'siz</pre><p><code>diff</code> exit kodi: <b>0</b> — bir xil, <b>1</b> — farq bor, <b>2</b> — xato.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>set -e</code> skriptda <code>diff</code> farq topsa (1) to'xtaydi — <code>diff ... || true</code> yoki kodni tekshir.</li><li><code>patch -p</code> darajasi noto'g'ri bo'lsa fayl topilmaydi; <code>git diff</code> patch'lari uchun odatda <code>-p1</code>.</li><li>CRLF farqlari butun faylni &quot;o'zgargan&quot; qilib ko'rsatadi — <code>--strip-trailing-cr</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Serverlar orasidagi config farqi — drift belgisi. Bir martalik diff incident'da yordam beradi; doimiy yechim — config'ni Git'da saqlash va IaC (Ansible <code>--check --diff</code>) bilan haqiqiy holatni muntazam solishtirish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v9 Commands_editors
Interview Drill::Linux::V9 Shell commands & text editors	idrill-33382	<p>Fayl yaxlitligini tekshirish: <code>md5sum</code>, <code>sha256sum</code> va qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>sha256sum</code> faylning kriptografik xeshini hisoblaydi — bir bayt o'zgarsa ham xesh butunlay boshqacha. Interview Drill::Linux::V9 Shell commands & text editors	idrill-33410	<p>Faylni bo'laklarga bo'lish va birlashtirish (<code>split</code>, <code>cat</code>), random string va base64?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>split</code> faylni qatorlar (<code>-l</code>) yoki hajm (<code>-b</code>) bo'yicha bo'laklarga bo'ladi, <code>cat</code> ularni qayta birlashtiradi (keyin checksum bilan tekshiriladi). Tasodifiy satr — <code>openssl rand</code> yoki <code>/dev/urandom</code>. <code>base64</code> — binary'ni matnga <b>kodlash</b> (shifrlash emas!): <code>base64</code> / <code>base64 -d</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 20 GB backup'ni 5 GB cheklovli joyga (email, eski FAT32, ba'zi upload limitlari) yuborish; Interview Drill::Linux::V10 Find, xargs & archives	idrill-31277	<p><code>find -exec ... \;</code>, <code>-exec ... +</code> va <code>-delete</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>-exec cmd {} \;</code> — har fayl uchun buyruqni <b>bir marta</b> ishga tushiradi (sekin). <code>-exec cmd {} +</code> — fayllarni <b>to'plab</b>, imkon qadar kam chaqiradi (xargs kabi, tez). <code>-delete</code> — find'ning o'zi o'chiradi, tashqi jarayonsiz (eng tez), lekin <b>ifodaning oxirida</b> bo'lishi shart.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 100 000 ta <code>.tmp</code> faylni o'chirish. <code>\;</code> bilan — 100 000 ta <code>rm</code> jarayoni, daqiqalar. <code>+</code> yoki <code>-delete</code> bilan — soniyalar.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>-exec rm {} \;   -&gt;  rm a ; rm b ; rm c ; ...        (N jarayon)<br>-exec rm {} +    -&gt;  rm a b c ... (ARG_MAX gacha)    (bir necha jarayon)<br>-delete          -&gt;  find o'zi unlink() chaqiradi    (0 qo'shimcha jarayon)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>find . -name &quot;*.tmp&quot; -exec rm {} \;                   # sekin<br>find . -name &quot;*.tmp&quot; -exec rm {} +                    # tez<br>find . -name &quot;*.tmp&quot; -delete                          # eng tez<br>find /var/log -name &quot;*.log&quot; -mtime +7 -exec gzip {} +<br>find . -name &quot;*.sh&quot; -exec chmod +x {} +<br>find . -type f -exec grep -l &quot;TODO&quot; {} +              # fayl nomlari bilan grep<br><br># Har faylga murakkab amal<br>find . -name &quot;*.jpg&quot; -exec sh -c 'convert &quot;$1&quot; &quot;${1%.jpg}.png&quot;' _ {} \;<br><br># Xavfsiz ishlash tartibi<br>find /data -name &quot;*.bak&quot; -mtime +30 -print            # 1. avval ko'r<br>find /data -name &quot;*.bak&quot; -mtime +30 -delete           # 2. keyin o'chir<br>find . -name &quot;*.tmp&quot; -ok rm {} \;                     # har biri uchun tasdiq</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><b><code>-delete</code> joyi:</b> <code>find . -delete -name &quot;*.tmp&quot;</code> — <code>-delete</code> birinchi bajariladi, <b>hamma narsani</b> o'chiradi!</li><li><code>-delete</code> avtomatik <code>-depth</code> yoqadi — <code>-prune</code> bilan birga ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>{} +</code> faqat oxirida bo'lishi kerak: <code>-exec cp {} /dst +</code> ishlamaydi; <code>-exec cp -t /dst {} +</code> ishlaydi.</li><li><code>-exec</code> fayl nomlarini xavfsiz uzatadi (bo'shliq, qator ko'chishi muammo emas) — <code>| xargs</code> dan farqli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avtomatik tozalash skriptlarida har doim: aniq boshlang'ich yo'l (o'zgaruvchi bo'sh bo'lsa <code>/</code> emas — <code>${DIR:?}</code>), <code>-xdev</code>, <code>-type f</code>, avval dry-run log, keyin <code>-delete</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v10 Find_archives
Interview Drill::Linux::V10 Find, xargs & archives	idrill-31278	<p><code>xargs</code> nima va nega kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>xargs</code> — stdin'dan kelgan qatorlarni/so'zlarni <b>buyruq argumentlariga</b> aylantiradi. Kerakligi: ko'p vositalar (<code>rm</code>, <code>gzip</code>, <code>ssh</code>) stdin'dan emas, argumentdan o'qiydi; shuningdek <code>Argument list too long</code> (ARG_MAX) chegarasini to'plab-bo'lib aylanib o'tadi va <code>-P</code> bilan parallel ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>rm /data/cache/*</code> — 2 million fayl: <code>bash: /bin/rm: Argument list too long</code>. Har holda parallelizmni cheklash (<code>-P</code>) — maqsadli tizimni bosib qo'ymaslik uchun.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v10 Find_archives
Interview Drill::Linux::V10 Find, xargs & archives	idrill-31279	<p><code>find | xargs</code> da bo'shliqli fayl nomi muammosi va <code>-print0 | xargs -0</code> yechimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>xargs</code> default'da bo'shliq, tab va qator ko'chishini ajratuvchi deb biladi — <code>my file.txt</code> ikki argumentga (<code>my</code>, <code>file.txt</code>) bo'linadi. NUL — fayl nomida bo'lishi mumkin bo'lmagan yagona belgi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>find . -name &quot;*.txt&quot; | xargs rm</code> — <code>my report.txt</code> o'rniga <code>my</code> va <code>report.txt</code> ni o'chirishga urinadi. Agar <code>my</code> nomli boshqa fayl bo'lsa — noto'g'ri fayl o'chadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy:   &quot;my report.txt\nb.txt&quot;  -&gt; xargs -&gt; [my] [report.txt] [b.txt]   XATO<br>-print0: &quot;my report.txt\0b.txt\0&quot; -&gt; xargs -0 -&gt; [my report.txt] [b.txt]  TO'G'RI</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>touch &quot;my report.txt&quot; b.txt<br>find . -name &quot;*.txt&quot; | xargs ls              # ls: cannot access './my': No such file<br>find . -name &quot;*.txt&quot; -print0 | xargs -0 ls   # to'g'ri<br><br>find . -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -P4 -n50 sha256sum<br>grep -rlZ &quot;password&quot; /etc | xargs -0 ls -l   # grep -Z: NUL bilan<br>git ls-files -z '*.go' | xargs -0 gofmt -l<br>find . -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 ...      # sort ham NUL bilan</pre><p>Alternativa — <code>xargs</code>siz:</p><pre>find . -name &quot;*.txt&quot; -exec rm {} +</pre><p>Bash'da tsikl:</p><pre>while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do echo &quot;fayl: $f&quot;; done &lt; &lt;(find . -print0)</pre><p><b>Xavfsizlik:</b> Hujumchi <code>/tmp</code> da <code>&quot;x\n/etc/passwd&quot;</code> nomli fayl yaratsa, root cron'dagi <code>find /tmp ... | xargs rm</code> uni ikki qatorga bo'lib, <code>/etc/passwd</code>ni o'chirishi mumkin. <code>-print0 | xargs -0</code> bu hujumni yopadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-print0</code> faqat <code>find</code>da; boshqa manbalardan kelsa — <code>tr '\n' '\0'</code> (lekin qator ko'chishli nomlar baribir buziladi).</li><li><code>xargs -d '\n'</code> (GNU) — faqat qator bo'yicha bo'ladi, bo'shliqni hal qiladi, lekin <code>\n</code>ni emas.</li><li><code>-0</code> ni bir tomonda unutish — butun ro'yxat bitta argument bo'lib qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: fayl nomlari ro'yxatini pipe orqali uzatadigan har qanday skriptda NUL-ajratish standart bo'lsin; ShellCheck (SC2038) bu xatoni avtomatik topadi — CI'ga qo'sh.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v10 Find_archives
Interview Drill::Linux::V10 Find, xargs & archives	idrill-31280	<p><code>tar</code> bilan arxiv yaratish, ko'rish, ochish. <code>c</code>, <code>x</code>, <code>t</code>, <code>z</code>, <code>J</code>, <code>f</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>tar</code> ko'p fayl va kataloglarni bitta arxivga to'playdi (ruxsatlar, egalik bilan), siqishni esa gzip/xz/zstd qiladi. Interview Drill::Linux::V10 Find, xargs & archives	idrill-31281	<p>gzip, bzip2, xz, zstd, zip — farqi va qachon qaysi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>gzip</b> — universal, tez, o'rta siqish. <b>bzip2</b> — eskirgan (sekin, xz/zstd'dan yomon). <b>xz</b> — eng kichik natija, juda sekin siqish (release tarball). <b>zstd</b> — yaxshi siqish va juda tez, ko'p yadroli (backup, log, konteyner layer uchun zamonaviy default). <b>zip</b> — Windows bilan almashish, har faylga random access.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 200 GB DB dump'ni siqish: xz bilan soatlar, gzip bilan uzoq va bitta yadro. zstd <code>-T0</code> bilan bir necha daqiqa.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash (taxminiy, matn/log uchun):</b> | Format | Siqish nisbati | Siqish tezligi | Ochish tezligi | Qachon | |---|---|---|---|---| | gzip | o'rta | tez (1 yadro) | tez | log rotatsiya, HTTP, universal moslik | | bzip2 | yaxshi | sekin | sekin | faqat eski tizimlar bilan moslik | | xz | eng yaxshi | juda sekin | o'rta | bir marta siqib, ko'p yuklanadigan release | | zstd | yaxshi (level 19 ~ xz) | juda tez, <code>-T0</code> parallel | juda tez | backup, log, Docker/OCI layer, DB dump | | zip | o'rta | tez | tez | Windows, ichidan bitta faylni olish |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gzip -9 app.log                       # app.log.gz<br>pigz -p 8 big.log                     # parallel gzip (gzip-mos natija)<br>xz -T0 -9 release.tar                 # xz ham ko'p thread qo'llaydi<br>zstd -T0 -3 big.sql                   # tez, default level 3<br>zstd -T0 -19 --long=31 big.sql        # maksimal (sekin)<br>zstd -d big.sql.zst<br>zip -r site.zip site/ &amp;&amp;
