Qayerda vaqt ketyapti — ochishdami yoki grep'dami?</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>zcat (1 yadro, ochish) --&gt; grep (regex, UTF-8) --&gt; natija<br>  tezlatish:  pigz (o'qish/CRC parallel thread'lar) | LC_ALL=C grep -F<br>  ko'p fayl:  fayl1 \<br>              fayl2  -- xargs -P 8 --&gt; har biri alohida yadro --&gt; yig'indi<br>              fayl3 /</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># 1. Qaysi qism sekin?<br>time zcat big.log.gz &gt; /dev/null            # faqat ochish<br>time zcat big.log.gz | grep -c ERROR        # ochish + qidirish<br><br># 2. Tezroq ochish va qidirish<br>time pigz -dc big.log.gz | LC_ALL=C grep -c ERROR<br>zgrep -F &quot;order_id=42&quot; app.log.*.gz         # -F: regex emas<br><br># 3. Ko'p fayl parallel<br>ls access.log.*.gz | xargs -P 8 -I{} sh -c 'zcat {} | grep -c &quot; 500 &quot;' \<br>  | paste -sd+ | bc<br><br># 4. Kerakli qismgacha o'qib to'xtash<br>zcat big.log.gz | grep -m 1 &quot;first_error&quot;   # -m: birinchi topilganda to'xtaydi<br><br># 5. Formatni almashtirish (logrotate)<br># /etc/logrotate.d/app<br># compress<br># compresscmd /usr/bin/zstd<br># compressext .zst<br># compressoptions -T0 -3<br># uncompresscmd /usr/bin/unzstd<br>zstdgrep -F ERROR app.log.*.zst</pre><p><b>Natijani o'qish:</b> agar <code>zcat &gt; /dev/null</code> vaqti umumiy vaqtga yaqin bo'lsa — muammo ochishda (zstd/parallel); agar grep qo'shilganda keskin oshsa — regex/locale.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>gzip formati tabiatan ketma-ket — <code>pigz -d</code> ochishni to'liq parallel qila olmaydi (faqat yordamchi thread'lar); haqiqiy tezlik zstd yoki ko'p fayl parallelida.</li><li><code>xargs -P</code> bilan disk IO cheklovchi bo'lsa — parallel foyda bermaydi.</li><li><code>LC_ALL=C</code> UTF-8 belgilarni bayt sifatida qaraydi — ko'p tilli qidiruvda ehtiyot.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Agar bir xil loglardan tez-tez qidirish kerak bo'lsa — grep'ni optimallashtirish noto'g'ri darajadagi yechim. Loglarni indekslaydigan tizimga (Loki, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse) yubor, strukturali (JSON) log yoz va saqlash muddatini xarajat bilan muvozanatla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v10 Find_archives
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30708	<p>LVM'ning uch qatlami — PV, VG, LV — nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LVM uch qatlamdan iborat: <b>PV</b> (Physical Volume) — LVM uchun belgilangan disk yoki partition; <b>VG</b> (Volume Group) — bir nechta PV'dan yig'ilgan umumiy joy hovuzi; <b>LV</b> (Logical Volume) — VG'dan kesib olingan &quot;virtual partition&quot;, uning ustiga fayl tizimi qo'yiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Oddiy partition diskka qattiq bog'langan: <code>/var</code> to'lsa, uni boshqa diskka &quot;cho'zib&quot; bo'lmaydi. LVM disklarni bitta hovuzga qo'shadi, hajmni esa keyin moslashuvchan taqsimlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre> /dev/sdb   /dev/sdc        &lt;- fizik disklar<br>    |          |<br>   PV         PV            &lt;- pvcreate (LVM metadata yoziladi)<br>    \        /<br>     VG &quot;data&quot; (sdb+sdc)    &lt;- vgcreate (umumiy hovuz)<br>     /        \<br>  LV &quot;pg&quot;   LV &quot;logs&quot;       &lt;- lvcreate (kesilgan bo'laklar)<br>    |          |<br>  xfs        ext4           &lt;- mkfs + mount</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pvcreate /dev/sdb /dev/sdc<br>vgcreate data /dev/sdb /dev/sdc<br>lvcreate -n pg -L 50G data<br>mkfs.xfs /dev/data/pg<br>pvs; vgs; lvs; lsblk</pre><p><code>vgs</code> chiqishida <code>VSize</code> — hovuz hajmi, <code>VFree</code> — hali LV'larga berilmagan joy.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PV — bu disk emas, diskka yozilgan LVM belgisi; <code>pvcreate</code> diskdagi eski ma'lumotni ishlatib bo'lmaydigan qiladi.</li><li>LV yaratish fayl tizimi yaratish emas — <code>mkfs</code> alohida qadam.</li><li>Linear VG ikki diskda bo'lsa, bitta disk o'lishi butun LV'ni buzadi — LVM o'zi redundancy bermaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> LVM'ning asosiy qiymati — hajmni keyin qaror qilish imkoni. Shuning uchun VG'ni 100% ajratib yuborma: 10-20% bo'sh joy shoshilinch kengaytirish va snapshot uchun zaxira.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30711	<p>LVM qaysi kernel mexanizmi ustida ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LVM kernel'dagi <b>device-mapper</b> (dm) mexanizmi ustida ishlaydi. LVM — userspace tool'lar (<code>lvcreate</code> va h.k.), haqiqiy blok xaritalashni esa kernel'dagi device-mapper bajaradi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> device-mapper — umumiy &quot;virtual blok qurilma&quot; freymvorki. Uning ustida faqat LVM emas, LUKS (<code>dm-crypt</code>), multipath (<code>dm-multipath</code>), Docker'ning eski <code>devicemapper</code> driveri, <code>dm-verity</code> ham ishlaydi. LVM shunchaki dm'ga &quot;bu LV — falon diskning falon sektorlari&quot; degan jadval beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>lvcreate (userspace)<br>   |<br>   v  ioctl, mapping table<br>device-mapper (kernel)<br>   |<br>   v<br>/dev/dm-0  &lt;- haqiqiy blok qurilma<br>   ^<br>   | symlink<br>/dev/mapper/vg0-root , /dev/vg0/root</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dmsetup ls                 # barcha dm qurilmalar<br>dmsetup table vg0-root     # xaritalash jadvali<br># 0 41934848 linear 8:3 2048<br>ls -l /dev/mapper/<br>lsblk                      # TYPE ustunida &quot;lvm&quot;</pre><p><code>dmsetup table</code> chiqishi: <code>boshlang'ich_sektor uzunlik target_turi qurilma offset</code> — ya'ni LV qaysi diskning qaysi joyiga map qilinganini ko'rasan.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>dmsetup remove</code> bilan LV'ni qo'lda olib tashlash LVM metadata'sini yangilamaydi — odatda <code>lvchange -an</code> ishlat.</li><li>LUKS ustida LVM yoki LVM ustida LUKS — ikkalasi ham dm qatlami; tartibni <code>lsblk</code> dan ko'r.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Disk muammosini debug qilganda <code>dmsetup</code> va <code>lsblk</code> stack'ni (disk -&gt; crypt -&gt; lvm -&gt; fs) ko'rsatadi. Har qatlam o'z latency va failure mode'iga ega.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30713	<p>PE (physical extent) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>PE</b> (Physical Extent) — VG ichidagi eng kichik ajratish birligi, default <b>4 MiB</b>. LV hajmi doim PE'lar soniga karrali; LV tomonidagi bo'lak <b>LE</b> (Logical Extent) deyiladi va har biri bitta PE'ga map qilinadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> LVM har baytni kuzatmaydi — bu metadata'ni ulkan qiladi. Diskni bir xil bo'laklarga bo'lib, &quot;LV'ning 10-LE'si sdb'ning 512-PE'sida&quot; kabi oddiy jadval saqlaydi. Shuning uchun <code>pvmove</code> va kengaytirish extent bo'yicha ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PV /dev/sdb:  [PE0][PE1][PE2][PE3]...   har biri 4 MiB<br>                 |    |<br>LV &quot;data&quot;:    [LE0][LE1]...</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>vgdisplay vg0 | grep -E 'PE Size|Total PE|Free  PE'<br>#  PE Size        4.00 MiB<br>#  Total PE       25599<br>#  Free  PE / Size 5120 / 20.00 GiB<br>lvcreate -n tmp -l 100 vg0          # 100 PE = 400 MiB<br>lvextend -l +100%FREE vg0/data      # barcha bo'sh PE<br>vgcreate -s 32M bigvg /dev/sdd      # PE hajmini o'zgartirish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-L 10G</code> berib, PE'ga karrali bo'lmasa LVM yaxlitlaydi (&quot;Rounding up size&quot;) — kutilgandan biroz katta chiqadi.</li><li>PE hajmi VG yaratilganda tanlanadi; keyin o'zgartirish noqulay.</li><li>Eski LVM1 da PE soni cheklangan edi; LVM2 da muammo emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default 4 MiB deyarli har doim yetarli. <code>-l</code> (extent/foiz) skriptlarda xavfsizroq: <code>100%FREE</code> &quot;qancha bo'lsa hammasini&quot; degan ma'noni aniq beradi va yaxlitlash xatosiz.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30714	<p>VG'ga yangi disk qo'shish buyrug'i?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval diskni PV qilasan, keyin VG'ga qo'shasan: <code>pvcreate /dev/sdc</code> -&gt; <code>vgextend vg0 /dev/sdc</code>. Shundan keyin VG'da yangi bo'sh joy (<code>VFree</code>) paydo bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> <code>/data</code> to'lyapti, VG'da bo'sh joy qolmagan. Serverga yangi disk ulandi — uni mavjud hovuzga qo'shib, keyin LV'ni kengaytirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>yangi disk /dev/sdc<br>   | pvcreate<br>   v<br>PV sdc  --vgextend--&gt;  VG vg0 (VFree oshadi)<br>                          | lvextend -r<br>                          v<br>                       LV data (FS ham kattalashadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lsblk                         # yangi disk ko'rindimi (sdc, bo'sh)<br>pvcreate /dev/sdc<br>vgextend vg0 /dev/sdc<br>vgs vg0<br>#  VG  #PV #LV  VSize   VFree<br>#  vg0   2   3  199.99g 100.00g<br>lvextend -r -l +100%FREE vg0/data<br>df -h /data</pre><p>Hot-plug disk ko'rinmasa: <code>echo &quot;- - -&quot; &gt; /sys/class/scsi_host/host0/scan</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Noto'g'ri diskni <code>pvcreate</code> qilish — undagi ma'lumot yo'qoladi. <code>lsblk -f</code> bilan bo'sh ekanini tekshir.</li><li><code>vgextend</code> LV'ni kattalashtirmaydi — faqat hovuzni. <code>lvextend</code> alohida.</li><li>Linear LV ikki diskka yoyilsa, endi istalgan disk o'lishi LV'ni buzadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bulutda yangi disk qo'shishdan ko'ra mavjud diskni kattalashtirish (<code>growpart</code> + <code>pvresize</code>) ko'pincha soddaroq va failure domain'ni oshirmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30720	<p><code>lvs</code> katta hajm ko'rsatadi, <code>df</code> esa eski. Sabab?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LV kattalashtirilgan, lekin <b>fayl tizimi</b> kattalashtirilmagan. <code>lvs</code> blok qurilma hajmini ko'rsatadi, <code>df</code> esa fayl tizimi bilgan hajmni. FS'ni alohida grow qilish kerak (<code>resize2fs</code> / <code>xfs_growfs</code>) yoki boshidanoq <code>lvextend -r</code>.</p><p><b>Nega shunday:</b> Bu ikki alohida qatlam. LV — &quot;konteyner&quot;, FS — uning ichidagi tuzilma. Konteyner kattalashsa ham, FS o'z superblock'ida eski hajmni yozib turgan bo'ladi.</p><pre>lvs:  [=========== LV 100G ===========]<br>df:   [==== FS 50G ====][ ishlatilmagan ]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lvs vg0/data        # LSize 100.00g<br>df -h /data         # Size 50G<br>lsblk -f            # FSTYPE ni bil<br><br># ext4 (online ishlaydi):<br>resize2fs /dev/vg0/data<br># XFS (mount nuqtasini beriladi):<br>xfs_growfs /data<br><br># Keyingi safar bir qadamda:<br>lvextend -r -L +20G vg0/data</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>xfs_growfs</code> ga qurilma emas, <b>mount point</b> beriladi (yangi versiyalar ikkalasini qabul qiladi, lekin odat shu).</li><li><code>resize2fs</code> XFS ustida ishlamaydi va aksincha — FS turini avval tekshir.</li><li>Bulutda yana bir qatlam bor: disk -&gt; partition -&gt; PV. Partition kengaymagan bo'lsa <code>growpart</code> ham kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Doim <code>-r</code> ishlat — u FS turini o'zi aniqlab to'g'ri tool'ni chaqiradi va &quot;LV katta, df eski&quot; xatosini butunlay yo'q qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30781	<p>PV, VG, LV ni noldan yaratish ketma-ketligi (ikki disk: /dev/sdb, /dev/sdc)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tartib: <code>pvcreate</code> -&gt; <code>vgcreate</code> -&gt; <code>lvcreate</code> -&gt; <code>mkfs</code> -&gt; <code>mount</code> -&gt; <code>/etc/fstab</code>. Har qadam bitta qatlamni yaratadi.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> Yangi DB server, ikki bo'sh disk. PostgreSQL uchun bitta katta volume kerak, keyinroq kengaytirish imkoni bilan.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lsblk -f                                  # 1. disklar bo'shmi?<br>pvcreate /dev/sdb /dev/sdc                # 2. PV<br>vgcreate data /dev/sdb /dev/sdc           # 3. VG<br>lvcreate -n pg -L 100G data               # 4. LV (yoki -l 100%FREE)<br>mkfs.xfs /dev/data/pg                     # 5. FS<br>mkdir -p /var/lib/postgresql<br>mount /dev/data/pg /var/lib/postgresql    # 6. mount<br>blkid /dev/data/pg                        # UUID ni ol<br>echo 'UUID=&lt;uuid&gt; /var/lib/postgresql xfs defaults,noatime 0 0' &gt;&gt; /etc/fstab<br>mount -a &amp;&amp; findmnt /var/lib/postgresql   # 7. fstab'ni sinab ko'r</pre><p><b>Chiqishni o'qish:</b></p><pre>pvs:  PV        VG    Fmt  PSize   PFree<br>      /dev/sdb  data  lvm2 100.00g 0<br>lvs:  LV  VG    LSize<br>      pg  data  100.00g</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fstab</code> ga yozib, <code>mount -a</code> bilan sinamaslik — xato bo'lsa server reboot'da emergency mode'ga tushadi. Muhim bo'lmagan disklar uchun <code>nofail</code> qo'sh.</li><li><code>/dev/sdb</code> nomi reboot'da o'zgarishi mumkin — fstab'da UUID yoki <code>/dev/mapper/data-pg</code>.</li><li>Hamma joyni darhol <code>100%FREE</code> qilib yuborish — keyin snapshot uchun joy qolmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu qadamlarni qo'lda emas, Ansible (<code>community.general.lvg</code>, <code>lvol</code>, <code>filesystem</code>, <code>mount</code>) bilan idempotent qil — server qayta qurilganda bir xil chiqadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30782	<p><code>pvs</code>, <code>vgs</code>, <code>lvs</code> va <code>pvdisplay/vgdisplay/lvdisplay</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>pvs</code>/<code>vgs</code>/<code>lvs</code> — har obyekt bir qator, ustunli qisqa jadval (skript va tez ko'rish uchun). <code>pvdisplay</code>/<code>vgdisplay</code>/<code>lvdisplay</code> — har obyekt uchun ko'p qatorli batafsil blok (UUID, PE soni, holat).</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b> Kundalik tekshiruv va monitoring skriptlari — <code>*s</code> buyruqlar, chunki ustunlarni tanlash va formatlash mumkin. Bitta obyektni chuqur o'rganish — <code>*display</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>vgs<br>#  VG  #PV #LV #SN Attr   VSize   VFree<br>#  vg0   2   3   0 wz--n- 199.99g 40.00g<br><br>lvs -o +devices                  # LV qaysi PV'larda<br>#  LV   VG  Attr       LSize  Devices<br>#  data vg0 -wi-ao---- 150g   /dev/sdb(0),/dev/sdc(0)<br><br>pvs -o +pv_used                  # PV qancha band<br>lvs -o lv_name,lv_size,data_percent --units g --noheadings   # skript uchun<br>vgs --reportformat json          # JSON chiqish<br><br>lvdisplay vg0/data               # UUID, LV Status, # open, segments</pre><p><code>lvs</code> dagi <code>Attr</code> ustuni: 1-belgi tur (<code>-</code> oddiy, <code>s</code> snapshot, <code>t</code> thin pool, <code>V</code> thin volume), 5-belgi <code>a</code> = active, 6-belgi <code>o</code> = open (mount qilingan).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>*display</code> chiqishini <code>grep</code> bilan parse qilish mo'rt — skriptda <code>lvs -o ... --noheadings</code> yoki <code>--reportformat json</code>.</li><li><code>VFree</code> 0 bo'lsa, kengaytirish uchun yangi PV kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monitoring uchun <code>vgs -o vg_name,vg_free --units b --noheadings</code> va thin pool'lar uchun <code>data_percent,metadata_percent</code> ni node_exporter textfile collector orqali eksport qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30783	<p><code>/dev/vg0/root</code> va <code>/dev/mapper/vg0-root</code> — farqi bormi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Farq yo'q — ikkalasi ham bitta <code>/dev/dm-N</code> qurilmaga ishora qiluvchi symlink. <code>/dev/vg0/root</code> — LVM yaratgan qulay nom, <code>/dev/mapper/vg0-root</code> — device-mapper nomi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/dev/vg0/root          -&gt; ../dm-0<br>/dev/mapper/vg0-root   -&gt; ../dm-0<br>                            |<br>                       /dev/dm-0 (haqiqiy blok qurilma)</pre><p>Ikkala symlink'ni udev yaratadi. Device-mapper nomi <code>VG-LV</code> formatida bo'lgani uchun, nomdagi <code>-</code> belgisi <code>--</code> ga aylanadi: VG <code>vg0</code>, LV <code>my-lv</code> -&gt; <code>/dev/mapper/vg0-my--lv</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls -l /dev/vg0/root /dev/mapper/vg0-root<br># lrwxrwxrwx ... /dev/vg0/root -&gt; ../dm-0<br># lrwxrwxrwx ... /dev/mapper/vg0-root -&gt; ../dm-0<br>blkid /dev/mapper/vg0-root     # UUID<br>lsblk -o NAME,KNAME,TYPE       # KNAME = dm-0</pre><p><b>fstab'da qaysi biri:</b> | Usul | Afzallik | Kamchilik | |---|---|---| | <code>UUID=...</code> | FS qayta nomlansa ham ishlaydi | mkfs qilinsa o'zgaradi | | <code>/dev/mapper/vg0-root</code> | o'qish oson, LV nomiga bog'liq | LV rename qilinsa buziladi | | <code>/dev/dm-0</code> | — | raqam reboot'da o'zgarishi mumkin, ishlatma |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>/dev/dm-N</code> ni hech qachon config'da ishlatma — tartib barqaror emas.</li><li>Nomida tire bor LV'larda <code>/dev/mapper</code> nomini qo'lda yozganda <code>--</code> ni unutish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Snapshot olinganda FS UUID'i nusxalanadi — XFS'da ikkita bir xil UUID mount qilinmaydi (<code>-o nouuid</code> kerak). Shunday holatlarda LV yo'li UUID'dan aniqroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30685	<p>LVM nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LVM fizik disklar ustida moslashuvchan qatlam beradi: <b>onlayn kengaytirish</b>, bir nechta diskni <b>bitta hovuzga birlashtirish</b>, <b>snapshot</b>, diskni <b>downtime'siz almashtirish</b> (<code>pvmove</code>), thin provisioning va RAID.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy partition'da <code>/var</code> to'lsa: yangi disk qo'shasan, ma'lumotni ko'chirasan, mount'ni o'zgartirasan — downtime. Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30710	<p>LVM snapshot qanday ishlaydi va uning xavfi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LVM snapshot <b>copy-on-write</b> (CoW): yaratilganda faqat metadata yoziladi; keyin asl LV'da biror blok birinchi marta o'zgarsa, eski versiya avval snapshot hududiga ko'chiriladi. Xavflar: snapshot hududi <b>to'lsa snapshot yaroqsiz</b> (invalid) bo'ladi, aktiv snapshot'lar <b>yozishni sekinlashtiradi</b>, va u <b>backup emas</b>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>origin LV:  [A][B][C][D]<br>snapshot:   (bo'sh, faqat jadval)<br><br>app B ni B' ga yozadi:<br>  1. eski B -&gt; snapshot hududiga nusxa<br>  2. B' -&gt; origin'ga<br>origin:   [A][B'][C][D]<br>snapshot: [B]      -&gt; snapshot ko'rinishi: A B C D (eski holat)</pre><p>Har birinchi yozuv = 1 o'qish + 2 yozish. Klassik snapshot'ni faqat qisqa oyna uchun ishlat: upgrade oldidan yoki backup olish vaqtida; <code>snapshot_autoextend_threshold</code> ni yoqib qo'y.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v1 LVM

Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30718	<p>Linear LV ikki diskka yoyilgan. Bitta disk o'ldi. Natija?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Butun LV yo'qoladi yoki buziladi. Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30719	<p>LVM metadata backup'i qayerda va qanday tiklanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LVM metadata har PV boshida saqlanadi, nusxasi esa <b><code>/etc/lvm/backup/&lt;vg&gt;</code></b> (oxirgi holat) va <b><code>/etc/lvm/archive/</code></b> (oldingi o'zgarishlar tarixi) da. Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30784	<p>LV'ni kichraytirish (shrink) — qanday va qanday xavf bor?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kichraytirishda tartib teskari: <b>avval FS, keyin LV</b>. Teskari qilsang (LV'ni avval kesib) — FS oxiridagi ma'lumot yo'qoladi. ext4 faqat <b>offline</b> kichrayadi; <b>XFS umuman kichraymaydi</b>.</p><p><b>Nega xavfli:</b></p><pre>to'g'ri:   FS 100G -&gt; 50G, keyin LV 100G -&gt; 50G   (FS ichkarida qoladi)<br>xato:      LV 100G -&gt; 50G, FS hali 100G deb o'ylaydi<br>           -&gt; FS'ning 50-100G qismi endi yo'q -&gt; buzilish</pre><p><b>Amalda (ext4):</b></p><pre># 0. Backup! (rsync/snapshot)<br>umount /data<br>e2fsck -f /dev/vg0/data             # majburiy tekshiruv<br>lvreduce -r -L 50G /dev/vg0/data    # -r: avval resize2fs, keyin LV<br>#   resize2fs ... to 13107200 (4k) blocks.<br>#   Size of logical volume vg0/data changed from 100.00 GiB to 50.00 GiB.<br>mount /data &amp;&amp; df -h /data</pre><p><code>-r</code> LVM'ning o'zi to'g'ri tartibni bajaradi — qo'lda <code>resize2fs</code> + <code>lvreduce</code> qilganda hajmlarni adashtirish xavfi bor.</p><p><b>XFS bo'lsa:</b></p><pre>xfsdump -f /backup/data.dump /data     # yoki rsync/tar<br>umount /data &amp;&amp; lvremove vg0/data<br>lvcreate -n data -L 50G vg0 &amp;&amp; mkfs.xfs /dev/vg0/data<br>mount /data &amp;&amp; xfsrestore -f /backup/data.dump /data</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kichraytiriladigan hajm ishlatilayotgan joydan kam bo'lishi mumkin emas — <code>df</code> ni oldin tekshir.</li><li>Root FS'ni kichraytirish — rescue rejimda.</li><li>Qo'lda <code>lvreduce</code> (<code>-r</code> siz) — eng ko'p uchraydigan ma'lumot yo'qotish sababi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shrink kerak bo'lib qolishi — rejalashtirish xatosi belgisi. Shuning uchun LV'larni kichik boshlab, kerak bo'lganda kengaytir: kengaytirish online va xavfsiz, kichraytirish emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30785	<p><code>lvextend -l +100%FREE</code> va <code>-L +10G</code> farqi? <code>-r</code> flagi nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>-L</code> — aniq hajm birliklarda (<code>-L +10G</code> = 10 GiB qo'sh, <code>-L 50G</code> = jami 50G). <code>-l</code> — <b>extent</b> soni yoki <b>foiz</b> (<code>-l +100%FREE</code>, <code>-l 50%VG</code>). <code>-r</code> (<code>--resizefs</code>) — LV'dan keyin fayl tizimini ham kattalashtiradi.</p><p><b>Farq jadvalda:</b> | Variant | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>-L +10G</code> | hozirgi hajmga 10G qo'sh | | <code>-L 10G</code> | jami hajm 10G bo'lsin | | <code>-l +100%FREE</code> | VG'dagi barcha bo'sh joyni qo'sh | | <code>-l 50%VG</code> | VG hajmining yarmi | | <code>-l +256</code> | 256 extent (4 MiB x 256 = 1 GiB) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lvextend -r -L +10G vg0/data        # 10G qo'sh, FS bilan<br>lvextend -r -l +100%FREE vg0/data   # bor bo'sh joyning hammasi<br>lvextend -L +10G vg0/data           # -r siz: FS eski qoladi<br>resize2fs /dev/vg0/data             #   ext4 uchun qo'lda<br>xfs_growfs /data                    #   XFS uchun qo'lda (mount point)</pre><p>ext4 va XFS <b>mount qilingan holda</b> kengayadi — downtime yo'q.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>+</code> belgisini unutish: <code>-L 10G</code> hozir 50G bo'lgan LV'ga — LVM uni kichraytirmoqchi bo'ladi (lvextend xato beradi, lekin <code>lvresize</code> kichraytiradi!).</li><li><code>100%FREE</code> VG'ni nolga tushiradi — snapshot uchun joy qolmaydi.</li><li><code>-r</code> siz ishlatish — &quot;lvs katta, df kichik&quot; muammosi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Skript va runbook'larda doim <code>lvextend</code> (faqat o'stiradi) ishlat, <code>lvresize</code> emas — xato hajm bilan tasodifan kichraytirish imkonsiz bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30786	<p>Diskni VG'dan chiqarish kerak (eskirgan disk). Downtime'siz qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>vgextend</code> (yangi disk) -&gt; <code>pvmove /dev/old</code> (extent'larni online ko'chirish) -&gt; <code>vgreduce vg0 /dev/old</code> -&gt; <code>pvremove /dev/old</code>. LV'lar butun jarayon davomida mount qilingan va ishlab turadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> <code>pvmove</code> vaqtinchalik mirror yaratadi: eski extent'larni yangi joyga nusxalaydi, nusxa sinxron bo'lgach xaritani almashtiradi. Ilova buni sezmaydi (faqat I/O yuklanishi).</p><pre>oldin:  LV data -&gt; [sdb extents]<br>pvmove: LV data -&gt; [sdb] &lt;=mirror=&gt; [sdd]<br>keyin:  LV data -&gt; [sdd extents]     sdb bo'sh</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pvcreate /dev/sdd<br>vgextend vg0 /dev/sdd<br>pvs                        # sdd PFree &gt;= sdb PUsed bo'lishi shart<br>pvmove -i 10 /dev/sdb      # -i: progress har 10s<br>#  /dev/sdb: Moved: 37.50%<br>pvs                        # sdb PUsed = 0<br>vgreduce vg0 /dev/sdb<br>pvremove /dev/sdb</pre><p>Faqat bitta LV'ni ko'chirish: <code>pvmove -n data /dev/sdb /dev/sdd</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>VG'da yetarli bo'sh extent bo'lmasa <code>pvmove</code> boshlanmaydi.</li><li>Uzilsa (reboot) — <code>pvmove</code> ni argumentsiz qayta ishga tushir, davom etadi; <code>pvmove --abort</code> bilan bekor qilinadi.</li><li>Katta disklarda soatlab I/O — DB'da latency oshadi; past trafik vaqtida qil.</li><li>O'layotgan diskdan o'qish xatolari pvmove'ni to'xtatishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu LVM'ning eng kuchli production imkoniyatlaridan biri: storage migratsiyasi (eski SAN -&gt; yangi NVMe) downtime'siz. Lekin oldin backup — mirror jarayonidagi xato kam, ammo nol emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30787	<p>Thin provisioning (thin pool) nima va xavfi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Thin pool — umumiy joy hovuzi, undan yaratilgan thin LV'larga <b>e'lon qilingan hajm</b>dan kam real joy beriladi; blok faqat haqiqatan yozilganda ajratiladi. Xavf: <b>overcommit</b> qilingan pool 100% to'lsa yozuvlar to'xtaydi va FS buzilishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 10 ta VM/konteyner har biri &quot;100G kerak&quot; deydi, lekin amalda 15G ishlatadi. Oddiy LV bilan 1T band bo'ladi; thin bilan 150G yetadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>thin pool 100G (real)<br> +-- thin LV &quot;a&quot;  -V 500G (e'lon) -&gt; yozilgan 30G<br> +-- thin LV &quot;b&quot;  -V 500G (e'lon) -&gt; yozilgan 40G<br>     jami e'lon 1000G, real ishlatilgan 70G / 100G</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lvcreate -L 100G -T vg0/pool               # pool<br>lvcreate -V 500G -T vg0/pool -n big        # thin LV<br>lvcreate -s vg0/big -n big_snap            # thin snapshot (hajm berilmaydi)<br>lvs vg0<br>#  LV   Attr       LSize   Pool Data%  Meta%<br>#  pool twi-aotz-- 100.00g      70.12  12.40<br>#  big  Vwi-aotz-- 500.00g pool 14.02</pre><p><code>/etc/lvm/lvm.conf</code>:</p><pre>thin_pool_autoextend_threshold = 80<br>thin_pool_autoextend_percent = 20</pre><p>(<code>dmeventd</code> monitoring yoqilgan bo'lishi kerak.)</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Meta%</code> ham to'ladi — metadata to'lishi data'dan ham xavfliroq.</li><li>Autoextend VG'da bo'sh joy bo'lsagina ishlaydi.</li><li>FS'da <code>discard</code>/<code>fstrim</code> bo'lmasa o'chirilgan fayllar joyi pool'ga qaytmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Thin — samaradorlik va tez snapshot uchun ajoyib, lekin overcommit = kredit. <code>Data%</code> va <code>Meta%</code> ga 80% alert, autoextend va muntazam <code>fstrim.timer</code> bo'lmasa, prod'da ishlatma.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30788	<p>Linear, striped va mirror (raid1) LV farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Linear</b> — PV'lar ketma-ket ulanadi (oddiy, tezlik bitta disk darajasida). <b>Striped</b> (<code>-i 2 -I 64k</code>) — bloklar disklarga navbatma-navbat yoziladi, I/O parallel va tezroq. <b>raid1</b> (<code>--type raid1 -m1</code>) — har blok ikki nusxada, bitta disk o'lsa ham ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>linear:   [A B C D] sdb  -&gt;  [E F G H] sdc<br>striped:  sdb: A C E G   sdc: B D F H     (chunk -I 64k)<br>raid1:    sdb: A B C D   sdc: A B C D</pre><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | Tur | Tezlik | Sig'im | Bitta disk o'lsa | |---|---|---|---| | linear | 1 disk | N disk yig'indisi | LV buziladi | | striped | ~N x | N disk yig'indisi | deyarli hammasi yo'qoladi | | raid1 | o'qish yaxshi, yozish 1x | yarmi | ishlaydi | | raid10 | yuqori | yarmi | ishlaydi (har juftdan 1) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lvcreate -n fast -i 2 -I 64k -L 200G vg0            # striped<br>lvcreate --type raid1 -m1 -n safe -L 100G vg0        # mirror<br>lvcreate --type raid10 -i 2 -m1 -n db -L 200G vg0    # raid10<br>lvs -a -o name,segtype,devices,copy_percent vg0</pre><p><code>copy_percent</code> (Cpy%Sync) — raid sinxronizatsiyasi qanchaga yetgani.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Striped'ni &quot;tezroq&quot; deb redundancy'siz prod DB'ga qo'yish.</li><li>Stripe'lar soni = PV soni bo'lishi kerak; bitta PV'da striped ma'nosiz.</li><li>raid1 backup emas — <code>rm -rf</code> ikkala nusxaga yoziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bulutda bitta katta disk + linear ko'pincha yetadi (redundancy provider'da). Bitta disk IOPS limitiga yetganda bir nechta disk + striping — lekin unda multi-disk snapshot izchilligini ham hal qilish kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30789	<p>LVM snapshot bilan izchil (consistent) DB backup qanday olinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LVM snapshot bir lahzadagi blok nusxasi — u <b>crash-consistent</b> (xuddi elektr o'chgandagi holat). PostgreSQL uni WAL orqali tiklay oladi, agar data va WAL <b>bir snapshot'da</b> bo'lsa yoki <code>pg_backup_start/stop</code> ishlatilsa.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ishlayotgan DB'dan <code>cp</code> qilish — fayllar har xil vaqtdagi holatda nusxalanadi, natija buzilgan. Snapshot butun volume'ni bir zumda &quot;muzlatadi&quot;, nusxa esa sekin olinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CHECKPOINT -&gt; snapshot (soniyalar) -&gt; mount ro -&gt; rsync (soatlar) -&gt; lvremove<br>                 ^ DB davom etadi, faqat CoW overhead</pre><p><b>Amalda (data va WAL bitta LV'da):</b></p><pre>psql -c &quot;CHECKPOINT&quot;                       # tiklash vaqtini qisqartiradi<br>lvcreate -s -L 20G -n pgsnap vg0/pg<br>mount -o ro,nouuid /dev/vg0/pgsnap /mnt/snap   # nouuid — XFS<br>rsync -a /mnt/snap/ backup:/pg/$(date +%F)/<br>umount /mnt/snap &amp;&amp; lvremove -y vg0/pgsnap</pre><p><b>WAL alohida LV'da bo'lsa:</b></p><pre>SELECT pg_backup_start('lvm', true);  -- shu sessiya ochiq qolsin<br>-- snapshot'lar olinadi, nusxa olinadi<br>SELECT * FROM pg_backup_stop();       -- backup_label'ni saqla</pre><p>(PG 15+ da eski <code>pg_start_backup</code> nomi o'zgargan.)</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Snapshot hajmi (<code>-L 20G</code>) backup davomidagi yozuvlarga yetmasa — invalid bo'ladi, backup chiqindi.</li><li>Backup'ni sinab tiklamaslik — ishlashini bilmaysan.</li><li>WAL arxivsiz faqat snapshot — PITR yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Snapshot backup tez restore uchun yaxshi, lekin asosiy strategiya <code>pgBackRest</code>/WAL arxiv + offsite bo'lsin. Snapshot'ni faqat &quot;nusxa olish oynasi&quot; sifatida ishlat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30790	<p>Snapshot'dan LV'ni orqaga qaytarish (rollback) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>lvconvert --merge vg0/snap</code> — origin LV snapshot olingan paytdagi holatga qaytadi va snapshot o'chadi. Origin mount qilingan bo'lsa, merge <b>keyingi aktivatsiyada</b> (reboot yoki <code>lvchange -an/-ay</code>) bajariladi.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> OS upgrade oldidan root'dan snapshot olding. Upgrade'dan keyin servis ishlamay qoldi — tez orqaga qaytish kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Upgrade oldidan:<br>lvcreate -s -L 10G -n pre_upgrade vg0/root<br>apt full-upgrade   # yoki dnf upgrade<br># ... xato chiqdi:<br>lvconvert --merge vg0/pre_upgrade<br>#  Delaying merge since origin is open.<br>#  Merging of snapshot vg0/pre_upgrade will occur on next activation of vg0/root.<br>reboot<br>lvs   # pre_upgrade endi yo'q, root eski holatda</pre><p>Root bo'lmagan LV uchun:</p><pre>umount /data<br>lvconvert --merge vg0/data_snap<br>lvchange -an vg0/data &amp;&amp; lvchange -ay vg0/data<br>mount /data</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Snapshot'dan keyingi <b>barcha</b> o'zgarishlar yo'qoladi — loglar, yangi yozilgan ma'lumot ham.</li><li><code>/boot</code> odatda alohida, LVM'dan tashqarida — kernel upgrade'ni snapshot qaytarmaydi; <code>/boot</code> ni ham alohida backup qil.</li><li>Snapshot invalid (100% to'lgan) bo'lsa merge mumkin emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu yondashuv Fedora/RHEL'dagi <code>snapm</code>/boom kabi tool'larga asos. Lekin ko'p servisli prod'da immutable image va qayta deploy rollback'ga nisbatan aniqroq va sinaladigan.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30791	<p>Bulutda (AWS EBS, GCP PD) LVM kerakmi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ko'p hollarda <b>shart emas</b>: bulut diski online kattalashadi va o'z snapshot'i bor, <code>growpart</code> + <code>resize2fs</code>/<code>xfs_growfs</code> yetadi. LVM foydali bo'ladi: bir disk limitidan katta hajm yoki IOPS kerak bo'lsa (striping), diskni online almashtirish (<code>pvmove</code>), bitta hovuzdan ko'p LV.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | Ehtiyoj | LVM'siz | LVM bilan | |---|---|---| | Hajmni oshirish | console + growpart + growfs | + pvresize + lvextend | | Snapshot | EBS/PD snapshot (izchil, bitta disk) | LVM snapshot (o'sha diskda) | | 64 TiB+ yoki ko'p disk IOPS | mumkin emas | striped LV | | Disk turini almashtirish (gp2-&gt;gp3) | provider modify | pvmove ham mumkin | | Murakkablik | past | yuqoriroq |</p><p><b>Amalda (LVM'siz kengaytirish):</b></p><pre>aws ec2 modify-volume --volume-id vol-xxx --size 100<br>lsblk<br>growpart /dev/nvme1n1 1<br>xfs_growfs /data</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p diskli striped VG'ning cloud snapshot'i: har disk boshqa vaqtda olinadi -&gt; izchil emas. Oddiylik — reliability: kerak bo'lgan aniq sabab bo'lmasa, bitta disk, partition'siz FS, provider snapshot.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30792	<p>Server reboot'dan keyin VG ko'rinmayapti (<code>vgs</code> bo'sh). Disk qatlamida har &quot;tuzatish&quot; qadami qaytarib bo'lmas bo'lishi mumkin — oldin diskning dd/snapshot nusxasini ol.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30793	<p>Prod DB serverlar uchun disk qatlamini qanday dizayn qilasan: LVM, RAID, FS, snapshot?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Printsip: <b>qatlamlarni ajrat, kengaytirishni oson qil, tiklashni sinab ko'r</b>. OS, data, WAL — alohida LV yoki disk; VG'da 10-20% zaxira; pastda redundancy (RAID yoki provider); FS — XFS yoki ext4; snapshot — faqat qisqa oyna, asosiy backup — WAL arxiv + offsite.</p><p><b>Dizayn:</b></p><pre>bare-metal:                       bulut:<br> NVMe x4                          disk1 (OS)  disk2 (data)  disk3 (WAL)<br>   | mdadm RAID10                   |             |             |<br> PV -&gt; VG &quot;pg&quot;                     ext4         XFS          XFS<br>   +-- LV os    ext4                         (provider replikatsiya)<br>   +-- LV data  XFS<br>   +-- LV wal   XFS<br>   +-- 15% bo'sh (snapshot, shoshilinch)</pre><p><b>Qarorlar va sababi:</b> | Qaror | Nega | |---|---| | data va WAL ajratilgan | WAL ketma-ket, data random I/O; bir-birini to'ldirmaydi | | XFS data uchun | katta fayl, parallel I/O yaxshi; lekin shrink yo'q | | RAID10 (bare-metal) | yozish tezligi + 1 disk/juft o'lishiga chidaydi | | mount: <code>noatime</code> | keraksiz metadata yozuvi yo'q | | <code>pgBackRest</code> + WAL arxiv | PITR, offsite, sinaladigan restore |</p><p><b>Monitoring va runbook:</b></p><pre>df -h; vgs -o vg_name,vg_free; lvs -o name,data_percent,metadata_percent<br>cat /proc/mdstat; smartctl -a /dev/nvme0</pre><p>Alert: FS 80%, thin pool 80%, RAID degraded, SMART ogohlantirish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Snapshot'ni backup deb hisoblash.</li><li>Kengaytirish va disk almashtirish runbook'ini hech qachon sinamaslik — kerak bo'lganda kechasi 3 da birinchi marta qilish.</li><li>Ko'p diskli VG snapshot'ini izchil deb o'ylash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Disk dizayni — RPO/RTO'dan boshlanadi. &quot;Qancha ma'lumot yo'qotishga chidaymiz va qancha tez tiklaymiz?&quot; degan savolga javob berib, keyin RAID, backup va restore drill'larni tanla; restore choraklik sinalmasa, backup yo'q deb hisobla.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30715	<p>Diskni downtime'siz almashtirish (extent'larni ko'chirish) buyrug'i?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>pvmove /dev/old</code> — eski PV'dagi barcha extent'larni VG ichidagi boshqa PV'larga <b>online</b> ko'chiradi. To'liq tartib: <code>vgextend</code> (yangi disk) -&gt; <code>pvmove</code> -&gt; <code>vgreduce</code> -&gt; <code>pvremove</code>.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> SMART eski disk o'layotganini ko'rsatyapti yoki eski SAN LUN'dan yangisiga o'tish kerak. Servisni to'xtatib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. vgextend: VG = [old][new(bo'sh)]<br>2. pvmove:   old extent -&gt; mirror -&gt; new  (ilova ishlab turadi)<br>3. vgreduce: VG = [new]<br>4. pvremove: old diskdan LVM belgisi o'chadi -&gt; fizik olib tashla</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pvcreate /dev/sdd &amp;&amp; vgextend vg0 /dev/sdd<br>pvs -o pv_name,pv_size,pv_used,pv_free<br>pvmove -i 30 /dev/sdb          # progress har 30s<br>#  /dev/sdb: Moved: 64.20%<br>pvs                            # sdb Used = 0<br>vgreduce vg0 /dev/sdb &amp;&amp; pvremove /dev/sdb</pre><p>Tanlab: <code>pvmove /dev/sdb /dev/sdd</code> (aniq manzil), <code>pvmove -n data /dev/sdb</code> (faqat bitta LV).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Manzilda yetarli bo'sh joy yo'q — <code>pvmove</code> rad etadi.</li><li>Jarayon uzilsa <code>pvmove</code> (argumentsiz) davom ettiradi; <code>--abort</code> bekor qiladi.</li><li>I/O yuklanishi sezilarli — kunduzi DB latency oshadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> O'layotgan diskda <code>pvmove</code> o'qish xatolariga tushishi mumkin — avval <code>ddrescue</code> yoki backup. Planned migratsiyada esa pvmove downtime'siz storage almashtirishning eng oddiy yo'li.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30717	<p>Thin pool 100% to'lsa nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Thin pool 100% to'lsa, yangi blok ajratib bo'lmaydi: yozuvlar <b>to'xtaydi</b> (queue yoki error), ilovalar osilib qoladi va fayl tizimi <b>buzilishi</b> mumkin. Interview Drill::Linux::V1 LVM: PV, VG, LV	idrill-30721	<p>Snapshot'dan asl LV'ni qaytarish buyrug'i?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>lvconvert --merge vg0/snap</code> — origin LV'ni snapshot paytidagi holatga qaytaradi va snapshot'ni o'chiradi. Origin hozir ishlatilayotgan (mount) bo'lsa, merge <b>keyingi aktivatsiyada</b> — reboot yoki <code>lvchange -an/-ay</code> dan keyin bajariladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> Snapshot'da o'zgargan bloklarning eski nusxalari bor. Faqat bir nechta faylni qaytarish kerak bo'lsa, snapshot'ni <code>ro</code> mount qilib, kerakli fayllarni nusxala — qolgan o'zgarishlar saqlanadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v1 LVM
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31228	<p>Swap nima va qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swap — diskdagi (yoki siqilgan RAM'dagi) maydon, kernel RAM tanqisligida kam ishlatiladigan <b>anonymous</b> page'larni (heap, stack) shu yerga chiqaradi. Bu RAM kengaytmasi emas, <b>bosim klapani</b>: RAM'ni aktiv jarayonlar va page cache uchun bo'shatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Swap bo'lmasa va RAM tugasa, kernel tashlab yuborib bo'lmaydigan anonymous xotirani hech qayerga qo'ya olmaydi — darhol OOM killer jarayonni o'ldiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>RAM page turlari:<br>  file-backed (binary, mmap fayl, page cache) -&gt; shunchaki tashlanadi,<br>                                                 kerak bo'lsa fayldan qayta o'qiladi<br>  anonymous (heap, stack, tmpfs)              -&gt; fayli yo'q, faqat swap'ga yoziladi<br><br>RAM to'ldi -&gt; kswapd reclaim -&gt; sovuq anon page -&gt; swap (so: swap out)<br>jarayon o'sha page'ga murojaat -&gt; page fault -&gt; diskdan qaytadi (si: swap in)</pre><p><b>Turlari:</b> swap partition, swap file, zram (RAM'dagi siqilgan swap).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>swapon --show<br># NAME      TYPE SIZE USED PRIO<br># /swapfile file   4G 120M   -2<br>free -h<br>#        total  used  free  shared  buff/cache  available<br># Mem:    15Gi  9Gi   1Gi   ...     5Gi         6Gi<br># Swap:    4Gi  120Mi 3.9Gi<br>vmstat 1 5     # si/so ustunlari: sekundiga swap in/out</pre><p><code>available</code> — haqiqatda ishlatsa bo'ladigan xotira (cache'ni hisobga olib); <code>free</code> ga qarab vahima qilma.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Swap ishlatilyapti = muammo&quot; — yo'q; <code>si/so</code> nolga yaqin bo'lsa, bu shunchaki sovuq sahifalar.</li><li>Swap disk RAM'dan ~1000x sekin — aktiv ma'lumot swap'da bo'lsa latency keskin oshadi.</li><li>Swap'da sir (parol, kalit) qolishi mumkin — shifrlanmagan diskda xavf.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Swap'ning asl qiymati — sovuq sahifalarni chiqarib page cache uchun joy ochish va OOM'dan oldin bufer berish. Lekin u capacity muammosini yashirmasligi kerak: <code>si/so</code> va PSI'ni monitoring qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31229	<p>Swap file qanday yaratiladi va doimiy qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>fallocate</code> (yoki <code>dd</code>) bilan fayl yarat, <code>chmod 600</code>, <code>mkswap</code>, <code>swapon</code>, keyin doimiy bo'lishi uchun <code>/etc/fstab</code>ga qator qo'sh.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Cloud VM'lar ko'pincha swap'siz keladi. Kichik VM'da build yoki migratsiya paytida RAM keskin oshsa — swap OOM'dan himoya qiladi. Partition qayta bo'lish shart emas.</p><p><b>Amalda (bosqichma-bosqich):</b></p><pre># 1. Fayl yaratish (4 GiB)<br>sudo fallocate -l 4G /swapfile<br>#    fallocate ishlamasa (ba'zi FS):<br># sudo dd if=/dev/zero of=/swapfile bs=1M count=4096 status=progress<br><br># 2. Faqat root o'qisin (swap'da xotira sirlari bo'ladi)<br>sudo chmod 600 /swapfile<br><br># 3. Swap formatini yozish<br>sudo mkswap /swapfile<br># Setting up swapspace version 1, size = 4 GiB<br><br># 4. Yoqish<br>sudo swapon /swapfile<br><br># 5. Doimiy qilish<br>echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab<br><br># 6. Tekshirish<br>swapon --show<br>free -h</pre><p>Reboot'siz fstab'ni tekshirish: <code>sudo swapoff /swapfile &amp;&amp; sudo swapon -a &amp;&amp; swapon --show</code>.</p><p><b>Btrfs'da:</b></p><pre>sudo btrfs filesystem mkswapfile --size 4G /swap/swapfile   # btrfs-progs 6.1+</pre><p>(NOCOW, siqishsiz, snapshot qilinmaydigan subvolume kerak.)</p><p><b>O'chirish:</b></p><pre>sudo swapoff /swapfile      # sahifalar RAM'ga qaytadi<br>sudo rm /swapfile           # va fstab qatorini o'chir</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>chmod 600</code> unutilsa — <code>swapon: insecure permissions</code> ogohlantirishi va xavf.</li><li><code>swapoff</code> RAM yetmasa OOM chaqiradi — avval <code>free</code> bilan tekshir.</li><li>fstab'da xato — boot emergency mode'ga tushishi mumkin; har doim <code>swapon -a</code> bilan sina.</li><li><code>tee -a</code> o'rniga <code>sudo echo &gt;&gt;</code> ishlamaydi (redirect root emas).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Swap'ni qo'lda emas, IaC/cloud-init orqali qo'y (masalan, Ansible role) — aks holda node'lar orasida drift. Hajm odatda 1-4 GiB yetadi; katta swap muammoni sekinlashtirib yashiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31230	<p>Swap partition va swap file farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swap partition — alohida disk bo'limi; swap file — mavjud FS ichidagi fayl. Zamonaviy kernel (2.6+) swap file bloklarini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri map qiladi, shuning uchun <b>tezlik deyarli bir xil</b>. Farq — boshqaruv qulayligida: file'ni o'lchamini o'zgartirish oson.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilgari &quot;partition tezroq&quot; degan qoida bor edi. Bugun asosiy savol — moslashuvchanlik, hibernate va FS cheklovlari.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | Partition | File | LVM LV | |---|---|---|---| | Yaratish | partitsiyalash (<code>fdisk</code>) | <code>fallocate</code> + <code>mkswap</code> | <code>lvcreate</code> | | O'lcham o'zgartirish | qiyin | oson (yangi fayl) | <code>lvresize</code> | | Tezlik | ~bir xil | ~bir xil | ~bir xil | | Hibernate | oson (<code>resume=</code>) | <code>resume_offset</code> kerak | oson | | FS cheklovi | yo'q | btrfs/NFS'da maxsus shart | yo'q | | Cloud VM | disk o'zgartirish kerak | eng qulay | - |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>swap file: swapon paytida kernel fayl extent'larini bir marta o'qiydi<br>           -&gt; keyin FS'ni chetlab, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri disk bloklariga yozadi<br>           shuning uchun fayl &quot;teshikli&quot; (sparse) bo'lmasligi kerak</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Partition<br>sudo mkswap /dev/sdb2 &amp;&amp; sudo swapon /dev/sdb2<br># fstab: UUID=xxxx none swap sw 0 0<br><br># LVM<br>sudo lvcreate -L 4G -n swap vg0 &amp;&amp; sudo mkswap /dev/vg0/swap<br><br># Hibernate uchun file offset<br>sudo filefrag -v /swapfile | head -4    # physical_offset -&gt; resume_offset=</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sparse fayl (<code>truncate</code>) bilan swap — <code>swapon: skipping - it appears to have holes</code>.</li><li>NFS ustida swap file — tavsiya qilinmaydi.</li><li>Bir nechta swap bo'lsa <code>pri=</code> ustuvorlik bilan boshqariladi (yuqori pri birinchi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Server va cloud uchun default — swap file (yoki zram); partition faqat hibernate kerak bo'lgan laptop yoki maxsus layout uchun. Swap disk sifatida tez SSD/NVMe, tarmoqli diskda emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31231	<p><code>vm.swappiness</code> nima? 0, 10, 60, 100 qiymatlari nimani bildiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>vm.swappiness</code> (0-200, default 60) — xotira qaytarib olinayotganda kernel <b>anonymous page'ni swap'ga chiqarish</b> va <b>file cache'ni tashlash</b> orasida qaysi birini afzal ko'rishini belgilaydi. Past qiymat — cache'ni tashla, heap'ni RAM'da saqla; yuqori — swap'ga erkinroq chiqar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> PostgreSQL serveri: kernel DB jarayonining heap'ini swap'ga chiqaryapti, page cache'ni esa saqlayapti — so'rovlar to'satdan sekin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>reclaim kerak -&gt;  anon (swap) &lt;---- swappiness ----&gt; file cache (drop)<br>   0    : swap faqat oxirgi chora (deyarli faqat cache tashlanadi)<br>   10   : anon'ni kamroq tegish<br>   60   : muvozanat (default)<br>   100  : anon va file teng narx<br>   200  : swap'ni afzal (zram uchun ma'noli)</pre><p>| Qiymat | Kimga | |---|---| | 0 | swap ishlatmaslik istagi, lekin OOM xavfi oshadi | | 1-10 | DB, Elasticsearch, Kafka, JVM — heap swap'ga tushmasin | | 60 | umumiy server/desktop | | 100-180 | zram (swap arzon, RAM ichida) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl vm.swappiness                 # hozirgi<br>sudo sysctl -w vm.swappiness=10      # darhol, reboot'gacha<br>echo 'vm.swappiness=10' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-swap.conf<br>sudo sysctl --system                 # fayllarni qayta o'qish</pre><p>cgroup v1'da har cgroup'da <code>memory.swappiness</code> bor edi; cgroup v2'da yo'q — o'rniga <code>memory.swap.max</code> bilan limit.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mif: <code>swappiness=0</code> swap'ni o'chiradi — yo'q, faqat imkon qadar kechiktiradi. O'chirish: <code>swapoff -a</code>.</li><li>Qiymatni o'zgartirib natijani o'lchamaslik — <code>vmstat</code> si/so va PSI'ga qara.</li><li>K8s/konteynerda host sysctl hammaga ta'sir qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> swappiness — nozik tuning, arxitektura yechimi emas. Avval xotira budjeti (JVM <code>-Xmx</code>, <code>shared_buffers</code>) to'g'ri bo'lsin; keyin swappiness 1-10 bilan &quot;sovuq&quot; sahifalar bufferi qoladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31232	<p>Server swap ishlatayotganini qanday ko'rasan va qaysi jarayon swap'da?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>free -h</code> umumiy swap ishlatilishini, <code>vmstat 1</code> dagi <code>si/so</code> <b>hozirgi</b> swap faolligini, <code>/proc/&lt;pid&gt;/status</code> dagi <code>VmSwap</code> (yoki <code>smem</code>) qaysi jarayon swap'da ekanini ko'rsatadi. Muhim: <b>katta &quot;used&quot; emas, doimiy <code>si/so</code></b> muammo belgisi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Monitoring &quot;swap 80% used&quot; deb alert berdi. Panika kerakmi? Bu eski, sovuq page'lar bo'lishi mumkin — yoki thrashing. Farqlash kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>free -h<br># Swap:  4.0Gi  3.1Gi  0.9Gi<br><br>vmstat 1 5<br># procs ---memory--- --swap-- ---io--- -cpu-<br>#  r  b  swpd  free   si   so   bi  bo  us sy id wa<br>#  1  0  3.1G  900M    0    0   12  40   5  2 92  1   &lt;- tinch: si/so=0<br>#  3  4  3.2G  100M  850  920  900 1000  3 10 20 67  &lt;- thrashing<br><br># Qaysi jarayon swap'da (KB)<br>grep VmSwap /proc/[0-9]*/status 2&gt;/dev/null | sort -k2 -n | tail -5<br>for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do<br>  printf &quot;%s %s\n&quot; &quot;$(awk '/VmSwap/{print $2}' $p/status 2&gt;/dev/null)&quot; &quot;$(cat $p/comm 2&gt;/dev/null)&quot;<br>done | sort -n | tail<br><br>smem -s swap -r | head      # smem o'rnatilgan bo'lsa (PSS bilan aniqroq)<br><br>cat /proc/pressure/memory<br># some avg10=0.00 avg60=0.00 avg300=0.00 total=...<br># full avg10=12.50 ...   &lt;- vaqtning 12.5% jarayonlar xotira kutib to'xtagan</pre><p><b>O'qish:</b> | Belgi | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | swap used katta, si/so ~0 | normal, sovuq page'lar | | si/so doimiy &gt; 0, wa yuqori | thrashing, latency oshgan | | PSI <code>full avg10</code> &gt; 5-10% | jiddiy xotira bosimi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>top</code>dagi SWAP ustuni ba'zan default o'chiq — <code>f</code> bilan yoqish kerak.</li><li>Konteynerda: cgroup v2 <code>memory.swap.current</code> faylini ko'r.</li><li>Swap'dan qaytgan page'lar &quot;swap cache&quot;da qoladi — <code>used</code> darhol kamaymaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alert <code>swap used %</code> ga emas, <b><code>si/so</code> tezligi</b> va <b>PSI memory</b>'ga qo'yilsin — ular foydalanuvchi sezadigan sekinlik bilan bog'liq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31233	<p>Thrashing nima va qanday aniqlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Thrashing — tizim RAM yetishmagani uchun vaqtining ko'p qismini sahifalarni swap'ga chiqarib-qaytarishga sarflaydi, foydali ish deyarli to'xtaydi. Belgilar: <code>vmstat</code>da doimiy yuqori <code>si/so</code>, yuqori <code>wa</code>, PSI memory <code>full</code>, javob bermaydigan SSH.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Server &quot;tirik&quot;: ping ishlaydi, health check ba'zan o'tadi, lekin so'rov 30 soniya kutadi. OOM killer ishga tushmaydi, chunki texnik jihatdan xotira &quot;bor&quot; (swap'da).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>working set &gt; RAM<br>  -&gt; page A swap'ga chiqadi -&gt; darhol kerak bo'ladi -&gt; qaytadi<br>  -&gt; buning uchun page B chiqadi -&gt; u ham kerak -&gt; ...<br>  CPU: page fault kutadi (wa), user% past, load average baland</pre><p><b>Aniqlash:</b></p><pre>vmstat 1<br>#  r  b   si    so   wa<br>#  2 12  2400  3100  70     &lt;- b (bloklangan) va si/so juda yuqori<br><br>cat /proc/pressure/memory<br># full avg10=35.20         &lt;- 35% vaqt hamma kutmoqda<br><br>sar -B 1 5                 # majflt/s (major page fault) yuqori<br>ps -eo pid,comm,rss,maj_flt --sort=-maj_flt | head<br>dmesg -T | grep -i oom</pre><p><b>Hal qilish (tartib bilan):</b></p><ol><li>Iste'molchini top: <code>ps aux --sort=-rss | head</code>, <code>smem</code>.</li><li>Darhol yengillatish: keraksiz jarayonni to'xtat yoki restart.</li><li>Limit qo'y: systemd <code>MemoryMax=</code>, cgroup <code>memory.max</code>, K8s <code>limits.memory</code>.</li><li>Uzoq muddat: RAM qo'shish yoki workload'ni bo'lish, xotira leak'ni tuzatish.</li></ol><p><b>Oldini olish:</b></p><pre>systemctl enable --now systemd-oomd   # PSI asosida erta kill<br># yoki earlyoom</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Katta swap qo'shamiz&quot; — thrashing'ni uzaytiradi, hal qilmaydi.</li><li>Load average baland -&gt; &quot;CPU kam&quot; deb o'ylash; aslida D-state (IO kutish).</li><li>Thrashing paytida SSH ham sekin — oldindan konsol/out-of-band kirish rejasi bo'lsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tez o'lib qayta tug'ilish ko'pincha sekin &quot;zombie&quot; holatdan yaxshi: PSI asosidagi kill (systemd-oomd) va cgroup limitlar bilan nosozlikni bitta servis ichida saqla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31234	<p>zram va zswap nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>zram</b> — RAM ichida siqilgan block device (<code>/dev/zram0</code>), unga swap yoziladi — disk IO yo'q. <b>zswap</b> — kernel'dagi kesh: page diskdagi swap'ga yozilishidan oldin siqilib RAM pool'da saqlanadi, pool to'lsa diskka tushadi. Ikkalasi CPU evaziga RAM'ni &quot;ko'paytiradi&quot; (siqish ~2-3x).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2 GB RAM'li edge qurilma yoki kichik VM — disk sekin (yoki SD karta, yozish resursi cheklangan). Disk swap foydasiz yoki zararli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>zram:   page -&gt; siqish (zstd/lz4) -&gt; /dev/zram0 (RAM) . disk yo'q<br>zswap:  page -&gt; siqish -&gt; RAM pool --(to'lsa)--&gt; disk swap</pre><p>| | zram | zswap | |---|---|---| | Disk swap kerakmi | yo'q | ha | | Qayerda | alohida device | swap oldidagi kesh | | Default | Fedora, ChromeOS, Android | ba'zi distrolarda yoqilgan | | Afzal | disk yo'q / sekin | disk swap bor, IO kamaysin |</p><p><b>Amalda — zram:</b></p><pre># Qo'lda<br>sudo modprobe zram<br>echo zstd | sudo tee /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm<br>echo 4G   | sudo tee /sys/block/zram0/disksize<br>sudo mkswap /dev/zram0 &amp;&amp; sudo swapon -p 100 /dev/zram0<br>zramctl<br># NAME       ALGORITHM DISKSIZE DATA COMPR TOTAL<br># /dev/zram0 zstd            4G 1.2G  400M  420M   &lt;- ~3x siqish<br><br># Doimiy: zram-generator (/etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf)<br># [zram0]<br># zram-size = ram / 2<br># compression-algorithm = zstd</pre><p><b>zswap:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/module/zswap/parameters/enabled<br># kernel cmdline: zswap.enabled=1 zswap.compressor=zstd zswap.max_pool_percent=20<br>grep -r . /sys/kernel/debug/zswap/ 2&gt;/dev/null   # statistika</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>zram'ni zswap bilan birga ishlatish — ikki marta siqish, odatda ma'nosiz.</li><li>zram uchun <code>swappiness</code> 100+ mantiqli (swap arzon).</li><li>Siqilmaydigan ma'lumot (shifrlangan) — foyda kam, CPU sarfi bor.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kam RAM'li node'larda zram — arzon xavfsizlik bufer. Lekin bu ham capacity rejasini almashtirmaydi; production server'da CPU-sezgir workload uchun siqish narxini o'lcha.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31235	<p>Kubernetes node'da swap: nega tarixan o'chirilgan va hozir holat qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tarixan kubelet swap yoqilgan node'da ishga tushmasdi (<code>--fail-swap-on=true</code>), chunki swap pod memory limit'ini, scheduling va eviction hisob-kitobini buzardi. Hozir <b>NodeSwap</b> feature bor (1.28 beta, <b>1.34 da GA</b>), cgroup v2 talab qiladi; <code>swapBehavior: LimitedSwap</code> rejimida faqat <b>Burstable</b> pod'lar limitga proporsional swap oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo (tarixiy):</b> Pod limiti 1 GiB. Swap bo'lsa, pod 1 GiB'dan oshganda OOM bo'lmaydi — swap'ga tushib sekinlashadi. Scheduler esa node'da &quot;RAM bor&quot; deb yangi pod qo'yadi. Natija — noaniq latency, eviction kech ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (LimitedSwap):</b></p><pre>Guaranteed pod   -&gt; swap = 0<br>BestEffort pod   -&gt; swap = 0<br>Burstable pod    -&gt; swap limit = (pod memory request / node RAM) * node swap<br>system daemons   -&gt; alohida sozlash</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># KubeletConfiguration<br>failSwapOn: false<br>memorySwap:<br>  swapBehavior: LimitedSwap    # yoki NoSwap (default)</pre><pre>kubectl get --raw &quot;/api/v1/nodes/&lt;node&gt;/proxy/configz&quot; | jq .kubeletconfig.memorySwap<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/kubepods.slice/.../memory.swap.max   # pod cgroup limiti</pre><p>Node'larni ajratish:</p><pre>nodeSelector: { swap: &quot;enabled&quot; }   # swap kerak bo'lgan workload'lar uchun alohida pool</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>cgroup v1 node'da NodeSwap ishlamaydi.</li><li>Swap shifrlanmagan bo'lsa — Secret'lar diskka tushishi mumkin; swap'ni shifrlash tavsiya qilinadi.</li><li>Eviction signal'lari hali asosan RAM'ga qaraydi — swap'li node'da <code>memory.available</code> boshqacha harakat qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Latency-sezgir workload'li node'larda swap o'chiq qolsin; swap kerak bo'lsa (Java/batch, xotira cho'qqilari) — alohida node pool, LimitedSwap va PSI monitoring bilan. Bu default emas, ongli istisno.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31236	<p>Production DB serverda swap: yoqasanmi? Argumentlar.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Odatda <b>kichik swap (1-4 GiB) + <code>vm.swappiness=1..10</code></b> — to'liq o'chirish ham, katta swap ham emas. Asosiy yechim swap emas, DB xotirasini RAM'ga to'g'ri o'lchash; swap faqat sovuq sahifalar va kutilmagan cho'qqi uchun bufer.</p><p><b>Ikki ekstremum:</b> | Variant | Nima bo'ladi | |---|---| | Swap yo'q | Bosimda OOM killer eng katta RSS'ni — ko'pincha DB'ni — o'ldiradi. Keskin, lekin aniq; failover ishga tushadi | | Katta swap | DB heap/buffer swap'ga tushadi, p99 soniyalarga chiqadi. Health check o'tadi, failover ishlamaydi — &quot;tirik, lekin o'lik&quot; |</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikkinchi holat ko'pincha yomonroq: replika lider bo'lib qoladi, lekin foydalanuvchilar timeout oladi.</p><p><b>Odatdagi kompromiss:</b></p><pre># Kichik swap, past swappiness<br>echo 'vm.swappiness=1' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-db.conf &amp;&amp; sudo sysctl --system<br><br># PostgreSQL: buffer'ni RAM'ga mos<br># shared_buffers = 25% RAM, effective_cache_size = 50-75% RAM<br># huge pages<br># huge_pages = try   +   vm.nr_hugepages=...</pre><pre># Elasticsearch: swap'ga tushmasin<br>bootstrap.memory_lock: true     # mlockall; LimitMEMLOCK=infinity kerak</pre><p>Java: <code>-Xms = -Xmx</code>, heap RAM'ning ~50%idan oshmasin (qolgani page cache).</p><p><b>Monitoring:</b></p><ul><li><code>si/so &gt; 0</code> 5 daqiqadan ortiq -&gt; alert.</li><li>PSI <code>memory full avg60</code> &gt; 5%.</li><li>DB p99 latency bilan korrelyatsiya.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PostgreSQL <code>shared_buffers</code>ni RAM'ning 70%iga qo'yish — OS cache va work_mem uchun joy qolmaydi.</li><li><code>memory_lock</code> qo'yib, systemd limitini oshirmaslik — ES ishga tushmaydi.</li><li>OOM'dan qochish uchun <code>oom_score_adj=-1000</code> — boshqa muhim jarayonlar o'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Swap capacity muammosini yashiradi. Principal javob: &quot;swap siyosati ikkinchi darajali; birinchi — xotira budjeti, limitlar va failover'ni sekin node'da ham ishlaydigan qilish (latency asosidagi health check)&quot;.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31237	<p>Disk quota nima va nega kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Disk quota — fayl tizimi darajasida user, group yoki <b>project</b> (katalog) uchun limit: <b>blocks</b> (hajm) va <b>inodes</b> (fayllar soni). Kernel yozishni limitdan oshganda <code>EDQUOT: Disk quota exceeded</code> bilan rad etadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Umumiy serverda bitta user (yoki loop'ga tushgan log) butun <code>/home</code> yoki <code>/</code> ni to'ldiradi — boshqalar ham yoza olmaydi, servislar yiqiladi. Quota bitta &quot;yomon qo'shni&quot;ni butun tizimdan ajratadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>write() -&gt; FS -&gt; quota tekshiruv:<br>   user ali: ishlatilgan 9.8G + yangi 300M &gt; hard 10G ?<br>      ha  -&gt; EDQUOT, yozish rad<br>      yo'q -&gt; yozish, hisobni yangila</pre><p><b>Nimani cheklaydi:</b> | Limit | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | blocks | egallangan hajm | | inodes | fayllar/kataloglar soni (millionta mayda fayl hujumi) |</p><p><b>Kimga:</b> user (<code>usrquota</code>), group (<code>grpquota</code>), project (katalog daraxti — XFS, ext4).</p><p><b>Qayerda ishlatiladi:</b> shared hosting, universitet <code>/home</code>, CI runner workspace, multi-tenant NFS, Docker overlay2 <code>--storage-opt size=</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda (ko'rish):</b></p><pre>quota -us                  # o'z limitim<br>sudo repquota -as          # hamma user (ext4)<br>sudo xfs_quota -x -c 'report -h' /data   # XFS</pre><p>Chiqish:</p><pre>User   used   soft   hard  grace<br>ali    9.2G   9G     10G   6days    &lt;- soft oshgan, grace ketyapti</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Root quota bilan cheklanmaydi (root ba'zan cheklovsiz yozadi).</li><li>Ilovalar <code>EDQUOT</code>ni <code>ENOSPC</code> kabi qayta ishlamasa — sirli xatolar.</li><li>Konteynerlar bir xil UID bilan ishlasa — user quota ularni ajrata olmaydi; project quota kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Quota — bitta FS ichida izolyatsiya; kuchliroq ajratish — alohida volume/PVC. Har holda limitga 80% yetganda alert bo'lsin, aks holda quota faqat &quot;boshqa joyda yiqilish&quot;ga aylanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31238	<p>Soft limit, hard limit va grace period farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Hard limit</b> — absolyut chegara, undan oshib yozib bo'lmaydi (<code>EDQUOT</code>). <b>Soft limit</b> — ogohlantirish chegarasi: undan oshish mumkin, lekin <b>grace period</b> (default 7 kun) boshlanadi. Grace tugasa, soft limit amalda hard'ga aylanadi — user soft'dan pastga tushmaguncha yozolmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Faqat hard limit bo'lsa, user ish o'rtasida to'satdan yozolmay qoladi (masalan, katta build). Soft + grace foydalanuvchiga tozalash uchun vaqt beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>0 ........ soft (9G) ........ hard (10G)<br>              |                    |<br>     oshdi -&gt; grace taymer (7 kun) |<br>     grace ichida: 10G gacha yozish mumkin<br>     grace tugadi: yangi yozish rad, toki &lt; 9G bo'lmaguncha<br>     hard: har doim, darhol rad</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># setquota -u user  bsoft bhard isoft ihard  FS<br>sudo setquota -u ali 9G 10G 100000 120000 /home<br><br># Grace period (soniya): bloklar va inode uchun, FS bo'yicha<br>sudo setquota -t 604800 604800 /home     # 7 kun<br><br># Interaktiv<br>sudo edquota -u ali<br>sudo edquota -t<br><br># Holat<br>sudo repquota -s /home<br># User   Block used  soft   hard   grace    File used soft hard grace<br># ali  +-   9.4G     9G     10G    6days    ...</pre><p><code>+-</code> — birinchi belgi bloklar soft limitdan oshganini bildiradi.</p><p><b>XFS'da:</b></p><pre>sudo xfs_quota -x -c 'limit -u bsoft=9g bhard=10g ali' /home<br>sudo xfs_quota -x -c 'timer -u -b 7d' /home</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Soft = hard qo'yish — grace ma'nosiz.</li><li>Grace tugaganini user bilmaydi — xabar/alert tizimi bo'lmasa to'satdan &quot;disk to'la&quot;.</li><li><code>0</code> qiymat = limit yo'q (cheksiz), nol emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Soft limit monitoring signali sifatida eng foydali: soft oshganda avtomatik ogohlantirish yuborilsin, hard esa xavfsizlik chegarasi bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31239	<p>ext4'da user quota qanday yoqiladi va tekshiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> fstab'da <code>usrquota,grpquota</code> mount opsiyasini qo'sh, remount, <code>quotacheck -cugm</code> bilan hisob fayllarini yarat, <code>quotaon</code> bilan yoq, <code>setquota</code>/<code>edquota</code> bilan limit ber, <code>quota</code>/<code>repquota</code> bilan tekshir. Zamonaviy usul — <code>tune2fs -O quota</code> (journaled quota, <code>quotacheck</code> kerak emas).</p><p><b>Nega:</b> <code>/home</code> umumiy bo'lgan serverda har user'ga hajm limiti qo'yish.</p><p><b>Amalda (klassik usul):</b></p><pre>sudo apt install quota          # yoki dnf install quota<br><br># 1. /etc/fstab<br># UUID=...  /home  ext4  defaults,usrquota,grpquota  0 2<br>sudo mount -o remount /home<br>mount | grep /home              # opsiyalar ko'rinsin<br><br># 2. Hisob fayllari (aquota.user, aquota.group)<br>sudo quotacheck -cugm /home     # c: yarat, u/g: user/group, m: remount ro qilmasdan<br><br># 3. Yoqish<br>sudo quotaon -v /home<br># /dev/sdb1 [/home]: group quotas turned on<br># /dev/sdb1 [/home]: user quotas turned on<br><br># 4. Limit<br>sudo setquota -u ali 9G 10G 100000 120000 /home<br>sudo edquota -p ali vali        # ali limitlarini vali'ga nusxa<br><br># 5. Tekshirish<br>quota -us ali<br>sudo repquota -as</pre><p><b>Zamonaviy usul (ext4 journaled quota):</b></p><pre>sudo umount /home<br>sudo tune2fs -O quota /dev/sdb1          # quota inode'lari FS ichida<br>sudo mount /home<br>sudo quotaon -v /home</pre><p>Afzalligi: crash'dan keyin <code>quotacheck</code> (uzoq skan) kerak emas.</p><p><b>Sinash:</b></p><pre>sudo -u ali dd if=/dev/zero of=/home/ali/big bs=1M count=11000<br># dd: error writing: Disk quota exceeded</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mount opsiyasisiz <code>quotaon</code> — <code>Mountpoint not found or quotas not enabled</code>.</li><li>Root FS (<code>/</code>) uchun remount yetmasligi mumkin — reboot.</li><li><code>quotacheck</code> katta FS'da sekin va aktiv yozishlarda noto'g'ri hisoblashi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Quota konfiguratsiyasini IaC'da saqla va <code>repquota</code> natijasini monitoringga eksport qil (node_exporter textfile collector) — limitga yaqinlashish oldindan ko'rinsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31240	<p>XFS quota va project quota nima? ext4'dan farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> XFS'da quota FS metadata'sining bir qismi — mount opsiyasi (<code>uquota</code>, <code>gquota</code>, <code>pquota</code>) bilan yoqiladi va <code>quotacheck</code> kerak emas. <b>Project quota</b> — katalog daraxtiga (user'ga emas) limit: masalan <code>/data/tenantA</code> 50 GB. ext4 ham project quota'ni qo'llaydi (4.5+ kernel), lekin XFS'da bu klassik va keng ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Barcha konteynerlar yoki tenant'lar bir xil UID bilan yozadi — user quota ularni ajrata olmaydi. Kerak — &quot;bu papka 50 GB'dan oshmasin&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/data/tenantA  -&gt; project id 42  (har fayl inode'ida projid=42 belgisi)<br>/data/tenantB  -&gt; project id 43<br>yozish -&gt; inode projid -&gt; o'sha project limiti tekshiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda (XFS):</b></p><pre># 1. fstab: remount yetmaydi, umount/mount kerak<br># /dev/sdc1  /data  xfs  defaults,uquota,pquota  0 0<br>sudo umount /data &amp;&amp; sudo mount /data<br><br># 2. Project'ni ro'yxatga olish<br>echo '42:/data/tenantA' | sudo tee -a /etc/projects<br>echo 'tenantA:42'       | sudo tee -a /etc/projid<br><br># 3. Katalogni belgilash va limit<br>sudo xfs_quota -x -c 'project -s tenantA' /data<br>sudo xfs_quota -x -c 'limit -p bhard=50g ihard=1000000 tenantA' /data<br><br># 4. Hisobot<br>sudo xfs_quota -x -c 'report -pbih' /data<br># Project ID   Used   Soft   Hard  Warn/Grace<br># tenantA      12G    0      50G   00 [------]</pre><p><b>ext4'da project quota:</b></p><pre>sudo tune2fs -O quota,project /dev/sdb1    # unmount holatda<br># mount opsiyasi: prjquota<br>sudo chattr -R +P -p 42 /data/tenantA<br>sudo setquota -P 42 0 50G 0 0 /data</pre><p><b>Root FS'da XFS quota:</b> kernel cmdline <code>rootflags=uquota,pquota</code> (fstab yetmaydi).</p><p><b>Qayerda ishlatiladi:</b> Docker overlay2 <code>--storage-opt size=10G</code> — backing FS XFS + <code>pquota</code> bo'lishi shart.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>mount -o remount</code> bilan XFS quota yoqilmaydi.</li><li>Hardlink/<code>mv</code> boshqa project'ga — projid inode'da qoladi (<code>EXDEV</code> yoki noto'g'ri hisob).</li><li>Project id'lar to'qnashuvi — markaziy ro'yxat yurit.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Project quota — bitta katta FS'ni tenant'lar orasida bo'lishning arzon usuli; qattiq izolyatsiya (IO, xavfsizlik) kerak bo'lsa — alohida volume.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-31241	<p>Multi-tenant platformada diskni qanday cheklaysan: quota, LVM, cgroup, K8s?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bitta usul yetmaydi — qatlamlar bilan: FS ichida <b>user/project quota</b>, kuchli ajratish uchun <b>alohida LV/PVC</b>, konteyner darajasida <b>K8s <code>ephemeral-storage</code></b> limit, IO tezligi uchun <b>cgroup <code>io.max</code></b>. &gt; /sys/fs/cgroup/tenant.slice/io.max   # 50 MB/s yozish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kubelet ephemeral-storage'ni davriy skanerlaydi — qisqa vaqt limitdan oshish mumkin (XFS pquota bilan aniqroq).</li><li><code>EDQUOT</code> ni ilova <code>ENOSPC</code> kabi qayta ishlamasa — noaniq xatolar.</li><li>Log rotatsiya bo'lmasa, limitlar faqat evict tsikliga olib keladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Limit — xavfsizlik chegarasi, monitoring esa birinchi himoya: 80% da alert, tenant'ga o'z iste'molini ko'rsatish (showback). Kuchli izolyatsiya talab qilinsa — alohida volume/node pool, ehtimol alohida klaster.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v7 Swap_quotas
Interview Drill::Linux::V7 Swap & disk quotas	idrill-30567	<p>Swap production serverda: yoqish kerakmi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kontekstga bog'liq. Latency-sezgir servis va K8s node'lari uchun — swap odatda o'chiq yoki qat'iy cheklangan, chunki swap &quot;o'lik emas, lekin foydasiz&quot; holat yaratadi.</p><p><b>Muammo / dilemma:</b></p><pre>Swap YO'Q:   RAM tugadi -&gt; OOM kill -&gt; servis restart -&gt; 10 s uzilish, aniq signal<br>Swap KATTA:  RAM tugadi -&gt; swap -&gt; latency 50 ms -&gt; 5 s, health check o'tadi<br>             -&gt; failover yo'q, foydalanuvchi uzoq kutadi</pre><p><b>Qaror jadvali:</b> | Muhit | Tavsiya | Sabab | |---|---|---| | Kichik VM, build server | 1-4 GiB swap yoki zram | vaqtinchalik cho'qqilar | | DB (PG, ES, Kafka) | kichik swap, <code>swappiness=1</code> yoki o'chiq + <code>memory_lock</code> | heap swap'ga tushmasin | | Latency API (stateless) | o'chiq yoki juda kichik | tez o'lib qayta tug'ilish yaxshi | | K8s node | default o'chiq; NodeSwap LimitedSwap — alohida pool | scheduling/eviction aniqligi | | Laptop/desktop | yoqiq (hibernate) | qulaylik |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>swapon --show; cat /proc/sys/vm/swappiness<br>sudo sysctl -w vm.swappiness=10<br>vmstat 1          # si/so ni kuzat<br>cat /proc/pressure/memory</pre><p>Erta kill:</p><pre>systemctl enable --now systemd-oomd</pre><p>systemd unit darajasida: <code>MemoryMax=2G</code>, <code>MemorySwapMax=0</code> — bitta servisga swap taqiqlash.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Swap yo'q = tezroq&quot; — yo'q, sovuq page'lar uchun joy yo'qligi page cache'ni kamaytiradi.</li><li>Swap'ni o'chirib, limitlarni qo'ymaslik — OOM killer noto'g'ri jarayonni tanlaydi.</li><li>Swap alert'ini <code>used %</code>ga qo'yish — <code>si/so</code> muhim.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Savol &quot;swap kerakmi&quot; emas, &quot;xotira tugaganda tizim qanday fail bo'lishini xohlaymiz&quot;.
