Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31076	<p>/etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /etc/group fayllarida nima saqlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/etc/passwd</code> — user'lar ro'yxati (nom, UID, GID, home, shell), hammaga o'qiladi. <code>/etc/shadow</code> — parol <b>hash</b>'lari va muddat sozlamalari, faqat root o'qiydi. <code>/etc/group</code> — guruhlar va a'zolar.</p><p><b>Nega uchta fayl:</b> Ko'p dastur (<code>ls</code>, <code>ps</code>) UID'ni nomga aylantirish uchun <code>passwd</code> ni o'qishi kerak — shuning uchun u hammaga ochiq. Hash'larni u yerda saqlash offline brute-force'ga yo'l ochardi, shuning uchun ular alohida, yopiq <code>shadow</code> ga ko'chirilgan.</p><p><b>Format:</b></p><pre>/etc/passwd:  alice:x:1001:1001:Alice Smith:/home/alice:/bin/bash<br>              nom  :pw:UID :GID :GECOS      :home       :shell<br>/etc/shadow:  alice:$y$j9T$...:19980:0:99999:7:::<br>              nom  :hash      :oxirgi_o'zgarish(kun):min:max:ogohlantirish<br>/etc/group:   docker:x:998:alice,bob<br>              nom   :pw:GID:a'zolar (supplementary)</pre><p><code>x</code> — &quot;parol shadow'da&quot; degani. Hash prefiksi: <code>$6$</code> SHA-512, <code>$y$</code> yescrypt (Debian 11+, Fedora, RHEL 9 default), <code>!</code> yoki <code>*</code> — parol bilan kirish yopiq.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>getent passwd alice      # NSS orqali: fayl + LDAP/SSSD<br>getent group docker<br>sudo getent shadow alice<br>ls -l /etc/shadow        # -rw-r----- root shadow (yoki 000 RHEL'da)<br>chage -l alice           # parol muddati, o'qilishi oson</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Fayllarni qo'lda tahrirlash — sintaksis buzilsa hech kim kira olmaydi. <code>vipw</code>, <code>vigr</code> yoki <code>useradd/usermod</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>cat /etc/passwd</code> LDAP user'larini ko'rsatmaydi — <code>getent</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>/etc/gshadow</code> — guruh parollari uchun to'rtinchi fayl, kam ishlatiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Audit uchun: <code>awk -F: '$3==0' /etc/passwd</code> — UID 0 faqat root bo'lishi kerak; <code>awk -F: '$2==&quot;&quot;' /etc/shadow</code> — parolsiz account'lar bo'lmasligi kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31077	<p>UID 0, system user (UID &lt; 1000) va oddiy user farqi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kernel nomni emas, <b>UID raqamini</b> ko'radi. <b>UID 0</b> = root, barcha ruxsat tekshiruvlarini aylanib o'tadi. <b>1-999</b> — system/service user'lar (<code>nginx</code>, <code>postgres</code>), odatda login qila olmaydi. <b>1000+</b> — oddiy odam user'lar.</p><p><b>Nega bu bo'linish:</b> Servisni root sifatida ishlatsang, undagi har bug butun serverni beradi. Har servis o'z unprivileged user'i ostida ishlasa — buzilganda faqat o'z fayllariga zarar yetkazadi.</p><pre>UID 0        root          hamma narsa mumkin<br>UID 1-999    nginx, app    faqat o'z fayllari, nologin<br>UID 1000+    alice, bob    odamlar, shell bilan<br>UID 65534    nobody        &quot;hech kim&quot;, NFS squash</pre><p>Diapazonlar <code>/etc/login.defs</code> da: <code>UID_MIN 1000</code>, <code>SYS_UID_MAX 999</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>useradd -r -s /usr/sbin/nologin -d /var/lib/app app   # system user<br>id app            # uid=998(app) gid=998(app)<br>awk -F: '$3==0 {print $1}' /etc/passwd   # faqat &quot;root&quot; chiqishi kerak<br>ps -eo user,uid,cmd | grep nginx         # worker'lar nginx/www-data ostida</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Root'dan boshqa UID 0 user yaratish (<code>toor</code>) — backdoor belgisi.</li><li>Nom boshqa, UID bir xil bo'lgan ikki user — kernel uchun bitta user.</li><li>Container'larda UID host bilan bir xil ma'noda (userns'siz) — container'dagi UID 1000 host'dagi UID 1000 fayllariga tegadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> systemd'da <code>DynamicUser=yes</code> servisga user'ni umuman yaratmasdan vaqtinchalik UID beradi — eng kam imtiyoz va tozalash muammosiz.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31078	<p>useradd, usermod, userdel, passwd buyruqlari nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> User hayot sikli: <code>useradd</code> (yaratish), <code>passwd</code> (parol), <code>usermod</code> (o'zgartirish, guruh qo'shish), <code>userdel</code> (o'chirish). Eng katta gotcha: <code>usermod -G</code> <b><code>-a</code> siz</b> user'ning boshqa supplementary guruhlarini o'chirib yuboradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>useradd -m -s /bin/bash -c &quot;Alice&quot; alice   # -m: /home/alice + /etc/skel<br>passwd alice                               # parol o'rnatish<br>usermod -aG docker,wheel alice             # guruhga QO'SHISH<br>id alice<br># uid=1001(alice) gid=1001(alice) groups=1001(alice),998(docker),10(wheel)<br>usermod -L alice                           # account'ni qulflash<br>chage -E 2026-12-31 alice                  # muddat<br>userdel -r alice                           # -r: home va mail ham</pre><p>Debian'da <code>adduser</code> — interaktiv wrapper (savollar beradi); skriptda <code>useradd</code> aniqroq.</p><p><b>Nega <code>-a</code> muhim:</b></p><pre>oldin:  alice -&gt; docker, wheel<br>usermod -G sudo alice     -&gt; faqat sudo (docker, wheel O'CHDI)<br>usermod -aG sudo alice    -&gt; docker, wheel, sudo</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Guruh qo'shilgandan keyin joriy session'da ko'rinmaydi — qayta login yoki <code>newgrp docker</code> (yangi shell).</li><li><code>userdel</code> user'ning boshqa joylardagi fayllarini o'chirmaydi — ular &quot;egasiz&quot; UID bilan qoladi: <code>find / -nouser</code>.</li><li><code>usermod -L</code> SSH kalit bilan kirishni to'xtatmaydi — <code>usermod -s /usr/sbin/nologin</code> yoki <code>chage -E 0</code> ham kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Offboarding'da user'ni o'chirishdan oldin qulfla va fayllarini arxivla; o'chirilgan UID qayta ishlatilsa, yangi user eski fayllarning egasiga aylanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31079	<p>rwx ruxsatlari va 755 / 644 raqamlari nimani bildiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ruxsatlar uch guruhga bo'linadi: <b>owner / group / others</b>, har birida <code>r</code>(4) <code>w</code>(2) <code>x</code>(1). Raqam — har guruh uchun yig'indi: <code>755</code> = <code>rwxr-xr-x</code> (owner hammasi, qolganlar o'qish+bajarish), <code>644</code> = <code>rw-r--r--</code> (owner yozadi, qolganlar faqat o'qiydi).</p><p><b>Hisoblash:</b></p><pre> 7 = 4+2+1 = rwx<br> 5 = 4+0+1 = r-x<br> 4 = 4+0+0 = r--<br> 6 = 4+2+0 = rw-<br> 0 =         ---<br>755 -&gt; owner rwx | group r-x | others r-x</pre><p><b>Fayl va direktoriyada ma'nosi farq qiladi:</b> | Bit | Fayl | Direktoriya | |---|---|---| | r | mazmunni o'qish | ichidagi nomlarni ko'rish (<code>ls</code>) | | w | o'zgartirish | fayl yaratish, o'chirish, rename | | x | dastur sifatida bajarish | ichiga kirish (<code>cd</code>, yo'ldan o'tish) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls -l deploy.sh          # -rw-r--r-- 1 alice dev ... deploy.sh<br>chmod 755 deploy.sh      # rwxr-xr-x<br>chmod u+x,g-w file       # simvolik usul<br>chmod 640 secret.conf    # owner rw, group r, others hech narsa<br>chown app:app /srv/app -R<br>stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' secret.conf   # 640 app:app secret.conf</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faylni o'chirish huquqi faylning emas, <b>direktoriyaning</b> <code>w</code> bitidan.</li><li>Direktoriyaga <code>r</code> berib <code>x</code> bermaslik — nomlar ko'rinadi, lekin fayllarni ochib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>&quot;Ishlamayapti — 777 qil&quot; — xavfsizlik teshigi, muammoni yashiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatiy standart: fayllar <code>644</code>, script'lar <code>755</code>, maxfiy config'lar <code>600/640</code>, direktoriyalar <code>755</code>. <code>chmod -R 755</code> fayllarga ham <code>x</code> beradi — <code>find -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +</code> bilan ajrat.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31080	<p>umask nima va 022 qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>umask</b> — yangi yaratilgan fayl/direktoriyadan <b>olib tashlanadigan</b> ruxsat bitlari. Bazaviy ruxsat: fayl uchun <code>666</code>, direktoriya uchun <code>777</code>. <code>umask 022</code> bilan fayl <code>644</code>, direktoriya <code>755</code> bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday hisoblanadi:</b> Bu ayirish emas, bit mask: <code>natija = baza &amp; ~umask</code>.</p><pre>fayl:  666 = rw-rw-rw-<br>umask: 022 = ----w--w-   (o'chiriladigan)<br>       644 = rw-r--r--<br><br>dir:   777 &amp; ~022 = 755<br>umask 077: fayl 600, dir 700   (faqat owner)<br>umask 027: fayl 640, dir 750   (guruh o'qiydi, others hech narsa)</pre><p>Fayl bazasi 666 — shuning uchun umask hech qachon yangi faylga <code>x</code> bermaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>umask                 # 0022<br>umask -S              # u=rwx,g=rx,o=rx<br>umask 077; touch s; ls -l s    # -rw-------<br># doimiy: ~/.bashrc yoki /etc/login.defs (UMASK), /etc/profile</pre><p>systemd servis:</p><pre>[Service]<br>UMask=0027</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Ayirish&quot; deb o'ylash: umask <code>033</code> bilan fayl <code>666 &amp; ~033 = 644</code>, lekin oddiy ayirish <code>633</code> beradi — noto'g'ri.</li><li>Shell'dagi umask servisga ta'sir qilmaydi — systemd unit'da alohida.</li><li>Dastur o'zi <code>open(..., 0600)</code> bilan aniq ruxsat bersa, umask faqat undan ham kesadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maxfiy ma'lumot yozadigan servislarda (<code>UMask=0077</code> yoki <code>0027</code>) default qilib qo'y — keyin har faylni alohida <code>chmod</code> qilishni unutish xavfi yo'qoladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31081	<p>setuid, setgid va sticky bit nima? Misol.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uch maxsus bit (to'rtinchi oktal raqam): <b>setuid (4)</b> — fayl bajarilganda <b>egasi</b> huquqi bilan ishlaydi (<code>passwd</code>); <b>setgid (2)</b> — direktoriyada yangi fayllar direktoriya <b>guruhini</b> oladi; <b>sticky (1)</b> — direktoriyada faylni faqat <b>egasi</b> o'chira oladi (<code>/tmp</code>).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b></p><ul><li><code>passwd</code> oddiy user tomonidan ishga tushiriladi, lekin root'ga tegishli <code>/etc/shadow</code> ga yozishi kerak -&gt; setuid root.</li><li>Jamoa papkasi: hamma yaratgan fayl <code>dev</code> guruhida bo'lishi kerak -&gt; setgid dir.</li><li><code>/tmp</code> hammaga yoziladi, lekin bir user boshqasining faylini o'chirmasin -&gt; sticky.</li></ul><p><b>Ko'rinishi:</b></p><pre>-rwsr-xr-x  /usr/bin/passwd   s owner x o'rnida = setuid<br>drwxrwsr-x  /srv/shared       s group x o'rnida = setgid<br>drwxrwxrwt  /tmp              t others x o'rnida = sticky<br>(katta S yoki T = bit bor, lekin x yo'q — odatda xato)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>chmod 2775 /srv/shared &amp;&amp; chgrp dev /srv/shared<br>chmod 1777 /scratch<br>chmod u+s /usr/local/bin/tool        # setuid (ehtiyot!)<br>find / -xdev -perm -4000 -type f 2&gt;/dev/null   # setuid audit<br>find / -xdev -perm -2000 -type f 2&gt;/dev/null   # setgid audit</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Setuid binar'dagi har bug = privilege escalation. Shell script'larga setuid kernel tomonidan e'tiborsiz qoldiriladi.</li><li><code>nosuid</code> mount opsiyasi (<code>/tmp</code>, <code>/home</code>) setuid'ni o'chiradi.</li><li>setgid dir eski fayllarga ta'sir qilmaydi — faqat yangilariga.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Setuid binar'lar ro'yxatini baseline qilib saqla va o'zgarishlarni monitoring qil (AIDE, auditd). Yangi setuid o'rniga capability yoki sudo qoidasi deyarli doim yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31082	<p>sudo qanday ishlaydi va sudoers'ni qanday xavfsiz tahrirlash kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>sudo</b> <code>/etc/sudoers</code> qoidalariga ko'ra ruxsat bergan user'ga buyruqni boshqa UID (odatda root) sifatida bajarishga imkon beradi va har chaqiruvni log qiladi. Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31083	<p>su, su - va sudo -i farqi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>-</code> (yoki <code>-l</code>) — <b>login shell</b>: HOME, PATH, profile fayllari target user uchun qayta yuklanadi. <code>su alice</code> — alice parolini so'raydi, env eskiligicha qoladi. <code>su -</code> — root'ning login shell'i, <b>root paroli</b> bilan. <code>sudo -i</code> — <b>o'z parolingiz</b> bilan root login shell, audit log bilan.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | Buyruq | Kimning paroli | Env | Audit | |---|---|---|---| | <code>su alice</code> | alice | joriy (PATH eski) | kam | | <code>su - alice</code> | alice | alice'ning login env | kam | | <code>su -</code> | root | root login env | kam | | <code>sudo -i</code> | o'zingniki | root login env | sudo log | | <code>sudo -s</code> | o'zingniki | joriy env, root shell | sudo log | | <code>sudo -u postgres psql</code> | o'zingniki | bitta buyruq | sudo log |</p><p><b>Nega env muhim:</b></p><pre>su            # PATH sizniki — /usr/sbin bo'lmasligi mumkin,<br>              # &quot;command not found: ip&quot;<br>su -          # root PATH, cd /root</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo -i                   # admin ishi<br>sudo -u postgres psql     # boshqa user nomidan bitta buyruq<br>sudo -iu app              # app user'ining login shell'i<br>sudo -u app -- env | grep HOME</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Root parolini jamoaga tarqatish (<code>su -</code> uchun) — kim nima qilgani noma'lum. Root parolini qulfla, <code>sudo</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>sudo su -</code> — ishlaydi, lekin keyingi buyruqlar sudo log'iga tushmaydi.</li><li>nologin shell'li user uchun <code>su - app</code> ishlamaydi — <code>sudo -u app cmd</code> yoki <code>su -s /bin/bash app</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da interaktiv root shell kamroq bo'lsin: aniq buyruqlar <code>sudo</code> bilan, session'lar esa <code>tlog</code>/auditd yozib olsin — incident'da kim nima qilganini tiklay olasan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31084	<p>Primary va supplementary group farqi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Primary group</b> (<code>/etc/passwd</code> dagi GID) — user yangi fayl yaratganda faylning guruhi bo'ladi. <b>Supplementary groups</b> (<code>/etc/group</code> dagi a'zolik) — qo'shimcha guruhlar, ruxsat tekshiruvida ishlatiladi. Kernel process'ning <b>barcha</b> guruhlarini tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>alice: primary=alice(1001), supplementary=docker(998), dev(1002)<br>touch x       -&gt; x guruhi = alice (primary)<br>open /srv/dev/file (group=dev, 640) -&gt; ruxsat bor (dev supplementary)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>id alice<br># uid=1001(alice) gid=1001(alice) groups=1001(alice),998(docker),1002(dev)<br>groups                    # joriy session guruhlari<br>usermod -g dev alice      # primary'ni almashtirish (doimiy)<br>usermod -aG dev alice     # supplementary qo'shish<br>newgrp dev                # joriy shell'da primary vaqtincha dev<br>cat /proc/$$/status | grep Groups   # process haqiqatda qaysi guruhlarda</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Guruh qo'shilgandan keyin <code>id</code> yangi guruhni ko'rsatadi, lekin <b>eski session</b>'lar (va ishlab turgan process'lar) uni bilmaydi — qayta login kerak.</li><li><code>docker</code> guruhi = amalda root: <code>docker run -v /:/host</code> bilan host'ni o'zgartirish mumkin. Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31085	<p>ACL (setfacl/getfacl) qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ACL</b> (Access Control List) — oddiy owner/group/others'dan tashqari bitta fayl yoki direktoriyaga <b>bir nechta aniq user/guruh</b> uchun alohida ruxsat berish. Kerak bo'ladi: yangi guruh yaratmasdan bitta user'ga ruxsat berish, yoki direktoriyadagi yangi fayllarga avtomatik ruxsat (default ACL).</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> <code>report.csv</code> egasi alice, guruhi finance. Auditor bob ham o'qishi kerak, lekin uni finance'ga qo'shib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>setfacl -m u:bob:r report.csv            # bob'ga o'qish<br>setfacl -m g:audit:rx /srv/reports       # guruhga<br>setfacl -d -m g:dev:rwx /srv/proj        # default: yangi fayllarga meros<br>getfacl report.csv<br># user::rw-<br># user:bob:r--<br># group::r--<br># mask::r--<br># other::---<br>ls -l report.csv     # -rw-r-----+  ('+' = ACL bor)<br>setfacl -x u:bob report.csv   # olib tashlash<br>setfacl -b report.csv         # barcha ACL'ni tozalash</pre><p><b>Mask nima:</b> <code>mask</code> — named user'lar, named guruhlar va group-owner uchun <b>maksimal</b> chegara. <code>chmod g-w</code> mask'ni o'zgartiradi va ACL ruxsatlarini jimgina kesib qo'yishi mumkin:</p><pre>user:bob:rw-   #effective:r--   &lt;- mask r-- bo'lgani uchun</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>cp</code>, <code>tar</code>, <code>rsync</code> default ACL'ni saqlamaydi — <code>cp -a</code>, <code>tar --acls</code>, <code>rsync -A</code>.</li><li>Mask tufayli &quot;ACL bor, lekin ishlamayapti&quot;.</li><li>ACL ko'p bo'lsa ruxsatlarni tushunish qiyinlashadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ACL — istisno uchun, asosiy model emas. Ko'p istisno kerak bo'lsa, guruh tuzilmasini qayta loyihala; shared papkalar uchun setgid + default ACL kombinatsiyasi eng barqaror.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31086	<p>Real, effective va saved UID nima? Privilege drop qanday to'g'ri qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har process'da uchta UID bor: <b>real (ruid)</b> — process'ni kim ishga tushirgan; <b>effective (euid)</b> — kernel ruxsatni shu bo'yicha tekshiradi; <b>saved (suid)</b> — euid'ni keyin qaytarib olish uchun saqlangan nusxa. To'g'ri privilege drop tartibi: <b>supplementary guruhlarni tozala -&gt; setgid -&gt; setuid</b> (oxirida).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (setuid binar):</b></p><pre>alice (1001) /usr/bin/passwd (setuid root) ni ishga tushiradi:<br>  ruid=1001  euid=0  suid=0<br>  -&gt; /etc/shadow ga yoza oladi (euid=0)<br>seteuid(1001) -&gt; vaqtincha imtiyozsiz, suid=0 saqlanadi -&gt; qaytarish mumkin<br>setuid(1001)  (root bo'lganda) -&gt; uchalasi 1001, qaytib bo'lmaydi</pre><p><b>To'g'ri drop (root'da ishga tushgan daemon):</b></p><pre>if (setgroups(0, NULL) != 0) abort();   // 1. supplementary (root guruhi!)<br>if (setgid(app_gid) != 0)    abort();   // 2. avval guruh<br>if (setuid(app_uid) != 0)    abort();   // 3. oxirida user<br>if (setuid(0) == 0)          abort();   // 4. tekshir: qaytib bo'lmasin</pre><p>Nega tartib: avval <code>setuid</code> qilsang, endi root emassan — <code>setgid</code> ruxsat bermaydi va process root guruhida qolib ketadi.</p><p><b>Amalda tekshirish:</b></p><pre>ps -o pid,ruid,euid,suid,rgid,egid,cmd -p &lt;pid&gt;<br>grep -E 'Uid|Gid|Groups' /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/status<br># Uid: 998 998 998 998   (real effective saved fs)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>setgroups</code> ni unutish — process root (0) supplementary guruhida qoladi.</li><li>Qaytariladigan drop (<code>seteuid</code>) xavfsizlik uchun yetarli deb o'ylash — exploit euid'ni qayta 0 qila oladi.</li><li>Return qiymatini tekshirmaslik (RLIMIT_NPROC tufayli <code>setuid</code> muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lishi mumkin).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bugun bu ishni o'zing qilish shart emas: systemd <code>User=</code>/<code>Group=</code>, <code>NoNewPrivileges=yes</code> yoki container <code>USER</code> — to'g'ri drop'ni kafolatlaydi. Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-31090	<p>Container ichida root ishlatish xavfi va user namespaces qanday yordam beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> User namespace'siz container ichidagi <b>root host'da ham UID 0</b>. Kernel exploit, noto'g'ri mount (<code>-v /:/host</code>), <code>--privileged</code> yoki docker socket orqali qochish — host'da to'liq root beradi. <b>User namespaces</b> container'dagi UID 0 ni host'dagi imtiyozsiz UID'ga (masalan 100000) map qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>userns'siz:   container uid 0  ==  host uid 0   (xavfli)<br>userns bilan: container uid 0  -&gt;  host uid 100000<br>              container uid 1  -&gt;  host uid 100001<br>              (/etc/subuid: alice:100000:65536)</pre><p>Qochgan process host'da 100000 — hech kimning fayliga tegolmaydi.</p><p><b>Himoya qatlamlari:</b></p><pre>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static<br>USER 10001:10001</pre><pre># Kubernetes<br>securityContext:<br>  runAsNonRoot: true<br>  runAsUser: 10001<br>  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true<br>  capabilities: { drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;] }<br>  seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }</pre><pre>podman run --userns=auto app        # rootless / userns<br>docker info | grep -i userns<br>cat /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/uid_map             # 0 100000 65536</pre><p>K8s 1.33+ da <code>hostUsers: false</code> (user namespaces) pod darajasida ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>USER</code> qo'yilgan, lekin volume fayllari root'ga tegishli — ilova yoza olmaydi, odamlar <code>USER root</code> ga qaytadi. <code>fsGroup</code> yoki to'g'ri <code>chown</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>--privileged</code> va docker socket mount userns'ni ham ma'nosiz qiladi.</li><li>Userns bilan ba'zi narsalar ishlamaydi (host network, ba'zi volume turlari).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Defense in depth: non-root + drop ALL caps + seccomp + read-only rootfs + userns + Pod Security Admission <code>restricted</code>. Har biri boshqasi yiqilganda zarar radiusini kichraytiradi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V2 Linux users, groups, permissions	idrill-30555	<p><code>chmod 754 app.sh</code> qanday ruxsat beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>754</code> = owner <b>rwx</b> (o'qish, yozish, bajarish), group <b>r-x</b> (o'qish, bajarish), others <b>r--</b> (faqat o'qish). Ya'ni <code>rwxr-xr--</code>.</p><p><b>Hisoblash:</b></p><pre>7 = 4(r)+2(w)+1(x) = rwx   -&gt; owner<br>5 = 4(r)+0   +1(x) = r-x   -&gt; group<br>4 = 4(r)           = r--   -&gt; others</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>chmod 754 app.sh<br>ls -l app.sh<br># -rwxr-xr-- 1 alice dev 120 Oct  3 app.sh<br>sudo -u bob ./app.sh      # bob dev guruhida bo'lsa -&gt; ishlaydi<br>sudo -u eve ./app.sh      # eve others -&gt; &quot;Permission denied&quot;<br>sudo -u eve cat app.sh    # eve o'qiy oladi (r)<br>stat -c '%a %A' app.sh    # 754 -rwxr-xr--</pre><p><b>Kuzat:</b> others script'ni bajara olmaydi, lekin <b>o'qiy oladi</b> — <code>bash app.sh</code> deb interpreter orqali baribir ishga tushirishi mumkin. Ya'ni script uchun <code>x</code> olib tashlash xavfsizlik chorasi emas; maxfiy script bo'lsa <code>r</code> ni ham olib tashla (<code>750</code>).</p><p><b>Direktoriyada:</b> <code>x</code> — ichiga kirish, <code>r</code> — ro'yxatni ko'rish. <code>754</code> direktoriyada others ro'yxatni ko'radi, lekin ichiga kira olmaydi va fayllarni ocholmaydi — g'alati kombinatsiya, odatda <code>755</code> yoki <code>750</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Ishlamasa 777&quot; — hamma yozadi, ya'ni har kim script'ni o'zgartirib, keyingi ishga tushiruvchining nomidan kod bajaradi.</li><li>Owner, group va others tekshiruvi ketma-ket: agar siz owner bo'lsangiz, faqat owner bitlari ishlaydi (group ruxsati katta bo'lsa ham).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Deploy script'lari uchun odatiy tanlov <code>750</code> yoki <code>755</code>; yozish huquqi faqat owner'da va owner root yoki deploy user bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users

Kod root'ga, faqat data <code>app</code> ga.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>DynamicUser=yes</code> + <code>StateDirectory=</code> + <code>ProtectSystem=strict</code> — zamonaviy systemd'da servis izolyatsiyasining eng kam kuch talab qiladigan yo'li.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v2 Linux_users
Interview Drill::Linux::V3 Package management	idrill-31091	<p>apt va dnf/yum nima? Asosiy buyruqlar.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Paket menejer — dasturni repo'dan yuklaydi, <b>bog'liqliklarni</b> (dependency) o'zi hal qiladi, o'rnatadi, yangilaydi va o'chiradi. Debian/Ubuntu'da <b>apt</b>, RHEL/Fedora/Rocky'da <b>dnf</b> (<code>yum</code> — uning eski nomi, RHEL 8+ da <code>yum</code> = dnf'ga symlink).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Nginx'ni qo'lda o'rnatish — o'nlab kutubxona, to'g'ri versiyalar, config joylari, systemd unit. Paket menejer buni bitta buyruqda qiladi va keyin xavfsizlik yangilanishlarini ham yetkazadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>apt install nginx<br>  -&gt; repo index (qaysi versiya, qanday dependency)<br>  -&gt; resolver: nginx + libssl3 + libpcre2 ...<br>  -&gt; .deb fayllarni yuklash, GPG imzo tekshiruvi<br>  -&gt; dpkg o'rnatadi, postinst script (systemd unit yoqiladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Debian/Ubuntu<br>sudo apt update<br>sudo apt install -y nginx<br>apt search nginx; apt show nginx<br>sudo apt remove nginx        # config qoladi<br>sudo apt purge nginx         # config ham o'chadi<br><br># RHEL/Rocky/Fedora<br>sudo dnf install -y nginx<br>dnf search nginx; dnf info nginx<br>sudo dnf remove nginx<br>dnf history                  # nima qachon o'rnatilgan, undo mumkin</pre><p>Boshqalar: Alpine — <code>apk add</code>, Arch — <code>pacman -S</code>, openSUSE — <code>zypper in</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>apt update</code> qilmasdan <code>install</code> — eski index, &quot;404 Not Found&quot; yoki eski versiya.</li><li>Distro repo'dagi versiya eski bo'lishi mumkin (barqarorlik uchun) — yangisi kerak bo'lsa rasmiy upstream repo.</li><li>Turli manbadan (<code>.deb</code> qo'lda + repo) aralash o'rnatish — dependency to'qnashuvi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod serverga qo'lda <code>apt install</code> emas — Ansible yoki image build (Packer/Dockerfile) ichida, versiya qotirilgan holda. Shunda har server bir xil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v3 Package_management
Interview Drill::Linux::V3 Package management	idrill-31092	<p>apt update va apt upgrade farqi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>apt update</code> — repo'lardan <b>paketlar ro'yxatini</b> (index) yangilaydi, hech narsa o'rnatmaydi. <code>apt upgrade</code> — o'rnatilgan paketlarni shu ro'yxatdagi yangi versiyalarga <b>yangilaydi</b>. <code>apt full-upgrade</code> — kerak bo'lsa paket o'chiradi yoki yangi dependency qo'shadi.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | Buyruq | Nima qiladi | Paket o'chiradimi | |---|---|---| | <code>apt update</code> | index yuklaydi (<code>/var/lib/apt/lists</code>) | yo'q | | <code>apt upgrade</code> | yangilaydi, yangi paket qo'shishi mumkin | yo'q | | <code>apt full-upgrade</code> | to'liq yangilash, conflict'larni hal qiladi | ha | | <code>apt-get upgrade</code> | yangi paket ham qo'shmaydi (eski xulq) | yo'q |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo apt update<br>#  Hit:1 http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu noble InRelease<br>#  23 packages can be upgraded. Run 'apt list --upgradable' to see them.<br>apt list --upgradable<br>sudo apt upgrade<br>#  The following packages have been kept back: linux-generic<br>sudo apt full-upgrade       # kept back'larni ham</pre><p>&quot;kept back&quot; — yangilash yangi paket o'rnatish yoki o'chirishni talab qiladi, <code>upgrade</code> buni qilmaydi.</p><p>dnf'da: <code>dnf check-update</code> (faqat ko'rish), <code>dnf upgrade</code> — metadata avtomatik yangilanadi (<code>metadata_expire</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>update</code> ni unutish — upgrade &quot;hamma narsa yangi&quot; deydi, aslida index eski.</li><li>Prod'da ko'r-ko'rona <code>full-upgrade</code> — kernel, libc, DB yangilanib, servis to'xtashi mumkin.</li><li>Kernel/libc yangilanishi reboot yoki restart'siz to'liq kuchga kirmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da yangilash = o'zgarish: avval staging, keyin canary guruh, keyin qolgani. Va <code>needrestart</code> bilan qaysi servislar eski kutubxonani ishlatayotganini tekshir.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v3 Package_management
Interview Drill::Linux::V3 Package management	idrill-31093	<p>dpkg va apt farqi; rpm va dnf farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>dpkg</b> / <b>rpm</b> — past daraja: bitta lokal paket faylini o'rnatadi/so'raydi, dependency'ni <b>hal qilmaydi</b> (faqat yo'qligini aytadi). <b>apt</b> / <b>dnf</b> — ular ustidagi yuqori daraja: repo'dan yuklaydi, dependency daraxtini hal qiladi, keyin dpkg/rpm'ni chaqiradi.</p><p><b>Qatlamlar:</b></p><pre>apt  (repo, resolver, yuklash)       dnf  (repo, resolver)<br>  |                                     |<br>dpkg (o'rnatish, DB: /var/lib/dpkg)   rpm (o'rnatish, rpmdb)</pre><p><b>Amalda — so'rov buyruqlari:</b> | Savol | Debian | RHEL | |---|---|---| | o'rnatilganlar | <code>dpkg -l</code> | <code>rpm -qa</code> | | paket fayllari | <code>dpkg -L nginx</code> | <code>rpm -ql nginx</code> | | fayl qaysi paketdan | <code>dpkg -S /usr/sbin/nginx</code> | <code>rpm -qf /usr/sbin/nginx</code> | | paket fayli ichi | <code>dpkg -c x.deb</code> | <code>rpm -qlp x.rpm</code> | | fayllar o'zgarganmi | <code>dpkg --verify nginx</code> | <code>rpm -V nginx</code> |</p><pre>sudo dpkg -i pkg.deb            # dependency yo'q bo'lsa xato:<br>#  dpkg: dependency problems prevent configuration<br>sudo apt -f install             # yetishmayotganlarni tortib keladi<br>sudo apt install ./pkg.deb      # yaxshiroq: bir qadamda (./ shart)<br>sudo dnf install ./pkg.rpm</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>apt install pkg.deb</code> (<code>./</code> siz) — apt uni repo'dagi paket nomi deb qidiradi.</li><li><code>rpm -i --nodeps</code> — dependency'ni chetlab o'tadi, keyin sinish garantiya.</li><li><code>rpm -V</code> chiqishidagi <code>5</code> (checksum), <code>M</code> (mode) belgilari — fayl qo'lda o'zgartirilgan; Interview Drill::Linux::V3 Package management	idrill-31094	<p>Repository va GPG kalit qanday qo'shiladi? Nega imzo muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kalit alohida faylga (<code>/etc/apt/keyrings/</code>) saqlanadi va repo qatori <code>signed-by=</code> bilan <b>faqat shu kalitga</b> bog'lanadi. Imzo muhim, chunki u paket haqiqatan repo egasidan kelgani va yo'lda (mirror, proxy, MITM) <b>o'zgartirilmagani</b>ni kafolatlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>repo egasi: Release faylini private key bilan imzolaydi<br>  Release -&gt; har Packages faylining SHA256 -&gt; har .deb SHA256<br>apt: public key bilan Release imzosini tekshiradi -&gt; hash zanjiri<br>  -&gt; bitta bayt o'zgarsa: &quot;NO_PUBKEY&quot; / &quot;BADSIG&quot; / hash mismatch</pre><p><b>Amalda (Debian/Ubuntu):</b></p><pre>sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings<br>curl -fsSL https://example.com/key.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/ex.gpg<br>echo &quot;deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/ex.gpg] https://example.com/apt stable main&quot; \<br>  | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ex.list<br>sudo apt update</pre><p>Yangi deb822 format (<code>.sources</code>):</p><pre>Types: deb<br>URIs: https://example.com/apt<br>Suites: stable<br>Components: main<br>Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/ex.gpg</pre><p>RHEL:</p><pre># /etc/yum.repos.d/ex.repo<br>[ex]<br>baseurl=https://example.com/rpm<br>gpgcheck=1<br>gpgkey=https://example.com/key.asc</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>apt-key add</code> deprecated (Debian 12 / Ubuntu 22.04+ da ogohlantirish, keyinroq olib tashlangan): kalit <b>barcha</b> repo'larga ishonchli bo'lardi — bitta repo kaliti boshqa repo nomidan paket imzolay olardi.</li><li><code>[trusted=yes]</code> yoki <code>gpgcheck=0</code> — imzoni o'chirish, hech qachon prod'da.</li><li>Kalitni HTTP orqali yuklash — kalitning o'zi almashtirilishi mumkin; fingerprint'ni tekshir: <code>gpg --show-keys ex.gpg</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Uchinchi tomon repo — supply chain'ga yangi ishonch nuqtasi. Iloji bo'lsa internal mirror orqali o'tkaz va fingerprint'ni config management'da qotir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v3 Package_management
Interview Drill::Linux::V3 Package management	idrill-31095	<p>Paket versiyasini qanday qotirish (pin/hold) mumkin?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Aniq versiyani o'rnatib (<code>apt install pkg=ver</code>), keyin <b>hold</b> qilasan (<code>apt-mark hold pkg</code>) — <code>apt upgrade</code> uni tegmaydi. RHEL'da <code>dnf versionlock</code>. Yanada nozik nazorat uchun apt <b>pinning</b> (<code>/etc/apt/preferences.d/</code>).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Postgres 16.4 ishlayapti. Avtomatik upgrade 16.5 yoki boshqa repo'dan major versiya olib keldi — restart, mos kelmaslik, downtime. DB, kernel, container runtime kabi paketlarni ongli yangilash kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apt-cache policy postgresql-16          # mavjud versiyalar<br>sudo apt install postgresql-16=16.4-1.pgdg22.04+1<br>sudo apt-mark hold postgresql-16<br>apt-mark showhold<br>sudo apt-mark unhold postgresql-16      # yangilash vaqti kelganda</pre><p>Pinning (masalan, faqat security origin'dan):</p><pre># /etc/apt/preferences.d/pg<br>Package: postgresql-16<br>Pin: version 16.4*<br>Pin-Priority: 1001</pre><p>RHEL:</p><pre>sudo dnf install 'dnf-command(versionlock)'<br>sudo dnf versionlock add kernel-5.14.0-427*<br>dnf versionlock list</pre><p>Dockerfile:</p><pre>RUN apt-get update &amp;&amp; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl=8.5.0-2ubuntu10.4</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hold qilingan paket xavfsizlik yangilanishlarini ham olmaydi — unutilsa, CVE'li qoladi.</li><li>Distro repo eski versiyalarni o'chirib yuboradi — Dockerfile'dagi qotirilgan versiya bir oydan keyin &quot;not found&quot; bo'ladi. Snapshot mirror (<code>snapshot.debian.org</code>, internal repo) kerak.</li><li>Hold dependency'larni qotirmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pin — &quot;hech qachon yangilama&quot; emas, &quot;ongli yangila&quot;. Har hold'ga sabab va review sanasini yoz (config management'da izoh), aks holda u texnik qarzga aylanadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v3 Package_management
Interview Drill::Linux::V3 Package management	idrill-31096	<p>Dockerfile'da apt-get to'g'ri qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>update</code>, <code>install</code> va tozalashni <b>bitta <code>RUN</code></b> da qil, <code>--no-install-recommends</code> bilan, oxirida <code>/var/lib/apt/lists/*</code> ni o'chir. Skript/Dockerfile'da <code>apt</code> emas <code>apt-get</code> ishlat.</p><p><b>Nega bitta layer:</b> Docker har <code>RUN</code> ni alohida keshlaydi:</p><pre>RUN apt-get update          &lt;- keshlanadi (3 oy oldingi index)<br>RUN apt-get install curl    &lt;- keyin qo'shilgan paket eski index bilan<br>                               -&gt; 404 yoki eski, CVE'li versiya</pre><p>Bitta <code>RUN</code> da <code>install</code> qatori o'zgarsa, <code>update</code> ham qayta ishlaydi.</p><p><b>To'g'ri namuna:</b></p><pre>FROM debian:bookworm-slim<br>ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive<br>RUN apt-get update \<br> &amp;&amp; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \<br>      ca-certificates \<br>      curl \<br> &amp;&amp; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*</pre><p>BuildKit kesh bilan (tezroq rebuild, image'ga tushmaydi):</p><pre>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked \<br>    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt,sharing=locked \<br>    apt-get update &amp;&amp; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl</pre><p><b>Har qism nega:</b> | Qism | Sabab | |---|---| | <code>apt-get</code> | barqaror CLI; <code>apt</code> &quot;unstable interface&quot; ogohlantiradi | | <code>-y</code> | interaktiv savol yo'q | | <code>--no-install-recommends</code> | keraksiz paketlar yo'q — kichik image, kam CVE | | <code>DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive</code> (<code>ARG</code>) | tzdata kabi savollarda osilmaydi; <code>ENV</code> emas, runtime'ga qolmasin | | <code>rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*</code> | ~30-50 MB index image'da qolmaydi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tozalashni alohida <code>RUN rm ...</code> da qilish — oldingi layer'da fayllar baribir qoladi.</li><li><code>ca-certificates</code> ni unutish — <code>curl https://</code> ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>apt-get upgrade</code> ni Dockerfile'da ishlatish — reproducibility buziladi; base image'ni yangila.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi apt — umuman yo'q apt: multi-stage build, runtime stage distroless yoki <code>scratch</code>. Build tool'lar faqat builder stage'da qoladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v3 Package_management
Interview Drill::Linux::V3 Package management	idrill-31097	<p>Shared library bog'liqligi: ldd va 'cannot open shared object file' xatosi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dinamik linker (<code>ld.so</code>) dastur talab qilgan <code>.so</code> kutubxonani <b>topa olmayapti</b>: kutubxona o'rnatilmagan, boshqa versiyasi bor (soname mos emas) yoki standart bo'lmagan yo'lda va linker keshida yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>./app ishga tushadi<br>  -&gt; not found<br>ldconfig -p | grep libssl          # keshda nima bor (masalan faqat libssl.so.1.1)<br>apt-file search libssl.so.3        # Debian: qaysi paketda -&gt; libssl3<br>dnf provides '*/libssl.so.3'       # RHEL<br>readelf -d app | grep -E 'NEEDED|RUNPATH'</pre><p><b>Tuzatish:</b></p><pre>sudo apt install libssl3                         # yetishmagan paket<br>echo /opt/vendor/lib | sudo tee /etc/ld.so.conf.d/vendor.conf<br>sudo ldconfig                                    # custom yo'l<br>LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/vendor/lib ./app            # faqat sinov uchun</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ldd</code> ishonchsiz binar ustida xavfli — u dasturni qisman ishga tushirishi mumkin; shubhali faylga <code>readelf -d</code> / <code>objdump -p</code>.</li><li><code>libssl.so.1.1</code> ni <code>libssl.so.3</code> deb symlink qilish — ABI boshqa, crash yoki xavfsizlik muammosi.</li><li><code>LD_LIBRARY_PATH</code> ni global (<code>/etc/environment</code>) qilish — boshqa dasturlar noto'g'ri kutubxonani yuklaydi.</li><li>Alpine (musl) image'da glibc uchun build qilingan binar — xuddi shu xato, chunki <code>ld-linux</code> yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu muammo sinfini butunlay yo'q qilish: Go'da <code>CGO_ENABLED=0</code> static binar, yoki container'da build va runtime image bir xil distro/versiyada bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v3 Package_management
Interview Drill::Linux::V3 Package management	idrill-31098	<p>Snap, Flatpak, AppImage va distro paketlari farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy farq — <b>bundled vs shared</b>. Distro paketlari (.deb/.rpm) umumiy kutubxonalarni ishlatadi, patch bir joyda. <b>Snap</b>, <b>Flatpak</b>, <b>AppImage</b> dasturni bog'liqliklari bilan birga &quot;qadoqlaydi&quot; — har qanday distro'da ishlaydi, lekin har biri o'z kutubxona nusxasini olib yuradi.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | Distro paket | Snap | Flatpak | AppImage | |---|---|---|---|---| | Kim tarqatadi | distro maintainer | Canonical Store | Flathub (va boshqalar) | muallif, istalgan joy | | Kutubxonalar | shared | bundled + base snap | bundled + runtime | to'liq bundled | | Yangilanish | apt/dnf | avtomatik (majburiy) | <code>flatpak update</code> | qo'lda | | Sandbox | yo'q | AppArmor confinement | bubblewrap portallar | yo'q | | Asosiy joy | server + desktop | Ubuntu, server ham | desktop | desktop, portable |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>snap list; snap info lxd; sudo snap refresh --hold=24h lxd<br>flatpak install flathub org.gimp.GIMP<br>chmod +x App.AppImage &amp;&amp; ./App.AppImage<br>mount | grep squashfs        # har snap — loop squashfs mount</pre><p><b>Trade-off:</b></p><ul><li>Shared: OpenSSL'da CVE — bitta paket yangilanadi, hamma tuzaladi. Lekin versiya distro bilan bog'liq.</li><li>Bundled: yangi versiya tez keladi, lekin CVE patch'i har dastur muallifiga bog'liq; disk ko'proq ketadi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Snap avtomatik yangilanishi serverda kutilmagan restart (<code>snap refresh</code> oynasini sozla: <code>snap set system refresh.timer=...</code>).</li><li>Snap confinement fayllarga kirishni cheklaydi — <code>/srv</code> dagi faylni ochmasligi mumkin.</li><li>AppImage imzosiz yuklab olish — supply chain xavfi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Serverda: distro paket yoki container image. Bundled formatlar desktop uchun qulay; server'da ular ikkinchi paket menejer va ikkinchi yangilanish siyosatini olib keladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v3 Package_management
Interview Drill::Linux::V3 Package management	idrill-31099	<p>Semantic versioning va dependency hell — qanday yechiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Dependency hell</b> — ikki komponent bitta kutubxonaning <b>mos kelmaydigan</b> versiyalarini talab qiladi (A -&gt; lib v1, B -&gt; lib v2). Yechimlar: <b>SemVer</b> bilan mos versiyalarni aniqlash, <b>lock fayl</b> bilan qotirish, <b>izolyatsiya</b> (container, venv), distro'da <b>soname</b> orqali bir nechta major'ni parallel saqlash.</p><p><b>SemVer:</b> <code>MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH</code></p><pre>2.4.1 -&gt; 2.4.2   PATCH: bug fix, xavfsiz<br>2.4.1 -&gt; 2.5.0   MINOR: yangi funksiya, orqaga mos<br>2.4.1 -&gt; 3.0.0   MAJOR: buzuvchi o'zgarish<br>&quot;^2.4.1&quot; = &gt;=2.4.1 &lt;3.0.0</pre><p><b>Muammo misoli:</b></p><pre>app<br> +-- libA 1.x -&gt; libX ^1.2<br> +-- libB 3.x -&gt; libX ^2.0      -&gt; X ning bitta versiyasi ikkalasini qondirmaydi</pre><p><b>Yechimlar:</b> | Usul | Qanday | |---|---| | Lock fayl | <code>go.sum</code>, <code>package-lock.json</code>, <code>poetry.lock</code> — har build bir xil | | Izolyatsiya | container, <code>venv</code> — har ilova o'z versiyasi | | Soname | <code>libssl.so.1.1</code> va <code>libssl.so.3</code> yonma-yon o'rnatiladi | | Upgrade | eskirgan libA ni yangilash yoki almashtirish | | Go MVS | eng kichik talab qilingan versiya, major — boshqa import yo'li (<code>/v2</code>) |</p><pre>go mod graph | grep libX       # kim qaysi versiyani talab qiladi<br>npm ls libX<br>pipdeptree -r -p libX</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lock faylni commit qilmaslik — CI va prod boshqa versiya oladi.</li><li>SemVer — va'da, kafolat emas; MINOR ham sindirishi mumkin. Testlar shart.</li><li><code>--force</code>/<code>--legacy-peer-deps</code> bilan muammoni yashirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Dependency soni — risk. Har yangi kutubxona: maintenance, CVE, hell ehtimoli. Kichik foydali kod uchun kutubxona olib kirishdan oldin o'zing yozish narxini sol; Renovate/Dependabot bilan kichik, tez-tez yangilash katta sakrashlardan xavfsizroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v3 Package_management

Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31103	<p>Linux katalog ierarxiyasi (FHS): /etc, /var, /usr, /opt, /tmp nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>FHS</b> (Filesystem Hierarchy Standard) — har narsaning standart joyi: <code>/etc</code> — konfiguratsiya, <code>/var</code> — o'zgaruvchan ma'lumot (log, DB, kesh), <code>/usr</code> — o'rnatilgan dasturlar va kutubxonalar (read-only bo'lishi mumkin), <code>/opt</code> — uchinchi tomon to'plamlari, <code>/tmp</code> — vaqtinchalik fayllar.</p><p><b>Nega standart muhim:</b> Har qanday Linux serverga kirib, nginx config'ini <code>/etc/nginx</code> da, loglarini <code>/var/log/nginx</code> da, ma'lumotini <code>/var/lib/...</code> da topasan. Backup, monitoring va hardening qoidalari shu tuzilmaga tayanadi.</p><p><b>Xarita:</b></p><pre>/            ildiz<br>+-- etc      config (matn fayllar)        -&gt; backup<br>+-- var      log, lib (DB/state), cache, spool -&gt; backup /var/lib<br>+-- usr      bin, lib, share (paketlar)   -&gt; qayta o'rnatiladi<br>+-- opt      vendor paketlar (/opt/app)<br>+-- tmp      vaqtinchalik, tmpfs bo'lishi mumkin<br>+-- home     user'lar, root -&gt; /root<br>+-- boot     kernel, initramfs, GRUB<br>+-- dev      qurilma fayllar (devtmpfs)<br>+-- proc,sys kernel virtual FS (diskda yo'q)<br>+-- run      runtime: PID, socket (tmpfs)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>man hier                     # rasmiy tavsif<br>findmnt                      # nima qayerga mount<br>du -xh --max-depth=1 /var | sort -h<br>systemd-tmpfiles --cat-config | grep /tmp   # /tmp qachon tozalanadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ma'lumotni <code>/tmp</code> da saqlash — reboot'da yoki <code>systemd-tmpfiles</code> (10 kun) bilan o'chadi.</li><li>O'z ilovangni <code>/usr/bin</code> ga qo'lda tashlash — paket menejer bilan to'qnashadi; <code>/usr/local</code> yoki <code>/opt</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>/var</code> root bilan bitta bo'limda — log to'lsa butun tizim to'xtaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Immutable OS'lar (Fedora CoreOS, Bottlerocket) <code>/usr</code> ni read-only qiladi va faqat <code>/etc</code> + <code>/var</code> ni yoziladigan qoldiradi — FHS bo'linishi shunday dizaynni mumkin qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31104	<p>mount va /etc/fstab nima? Muhim bo'lmagan disklar uchun <code>nofail</code>.</li><li>Tarmoq FS'lari uchun <code>_netdev</code> — tarmoq ko'tarilmasdan mount qilishga urinmasin.</li><li>Snapshot'dan klonlangan disklarda UUID takrorlanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>mount -a</code> + <code>findmnt --verify</code> ni fstab o'zgarishidan keyin majburiy qil (Ansible handler). Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31105	<p>df va du farqi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b><code>df</code></b> — fayl tizimining o'zidan statistikani so'raydi (jami, band, bo'sh — superblock'dan). <b><code>du</code></b> — direktoriyalarni aylanib, fayllar hajmini <b>sanaydi</b>. Shuning uchun ular farq qilishi mumkin; eng ko'p sabab — <b>o'chirilgan, lekin hali ochiq</b> fayl.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>df:  statfs(&quot;/var&quot;) -&gt; FS: &quot;jami 50G, band 48G&quot;   (tez, aniq)<br>du:  /var ichidagi har faylni stat() qiladi -&gt; yig'indi 20G<br>     o'chirilgan fayl katalogda yo'q -&gt; du ko'rmaydi<br>     lekin process uni ochiq tutgan -&gt; df hisoblaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>df -h                    # FS'lar bo'yicha hajm<br>df -hT /var              # + FS turi<br>df -i                    # inode'lar (fayl soni limiti)<br>du -sh /var/*            # qaysi papka katta<br>du -xh --max-depth=1 / 2&gt;/dev/null | sort -h | tail   # -x: boshqa FS'ga o'tma<br>ncdu -x /                # interaktiv (o'rnatilgan bo'lsa)<br>lsof +L1                 # o'chirilgan, ochiq fayllar</pre><p><b>Farqlar sabablari:</b> | Sabab | Belgisi | |---|---| | O'chirilgan, ochiq fayl | <code>lsof +L1</code> da <code>(deleted)</code> | | Mount ostida yashiringan fayllar | mount nuqtasi tagida eski fayllar (unmount qilib <code>du</code>) | | ext4 reserved 5% | <code>df</code> dagi Avail &lt; Size - Used | | Sparse fayllar | <code>du</code> kichik, <code>ls -l</code> katta |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>du</code> ni <code>-x</code> siz <code>/</code> da — <code>/proc</code>, NFS'ni ham aylanadi, sekin va chalkash.</li><li><code>df</code> 100% emas, lekin &quot;No space&quot; — inode tugagan (<code>df -i</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Disk alert'ida birinchi qadam: <code>df -h</code> + <code>df -i</code> + <code>lsof +L1</code>. Shu uchta buyruq holatlarning ko'pchiligini 1 daqiqada tushuntiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31106	<p>ext4, XFS va Btrfs farqi; qachon qaysi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ext4</b> — eng barqaror umumiy tanlov, offline kichrayadi (Debian/Ubuntu default). <b>XFS</b> — katta FS va parallel yozish uchun kuchli, faqat kattalashadi (RHEL default). <b>Btrfs</b> — copy-on-write, snapshot, checksum, compression (Fedora, openSUSE default). <b>ZFS</b> — CoW + volume manager + RAID + checksum bitta tizimda (litsenziya tufayli kernel'dan tashqari modul).</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | ext4 | XFS | Btrfs | ZFS | |---|---|---|---|---| | Max FS | 1 EiB | 8 EiB | 16 EiB | juda katta | | Shrink | offline | yo'q | online | yo'q (pool) | | Snapshot | yo'q (LVM bilan) | yo'q | ha | ha | | Data checksum | yo'q | yo'q (metadata ha) | ha | ha | | Inode | mkfs'da qat'iy | dinamik | dinamik | dinamik | | Kuchli tomoni | oddiy, ishonchli | parallel I/O | snapshot, send/receive | data integrity |</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b></p><ul><li>Umumiy server, kichik VM: ext4.</li><li>DB, katta fayllar, ko'p thread yozish: XFS (yoki ext4).</li><li>Desktop, snapshot'li rollback: Btrfs.</li><li>Storage server, NAS, ma'lumot yaxlitligi muhim: ZFS.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>df -T; lsblk -f<br>mkfs.ext4 -L data /dev/vg0/data<br>mkfs.xfs -L data /dev/vg0/data<br>mkfs.btrfs -L data /dev/sdb &amp;&amp; btrfs subvolume create /mnt/@home</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>XFS'ni katta qilib berish — keyin kichraytirib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Btrfs RAID5/6 hali ham &quot;unstable&quot; deb belgilangan — prod'da ishlatma.</li><li>CoW FS'larda DB fayllari fragmentatsiyaga uchraydi (tuning kerak).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlovni benchmark hal qilsin, moda emas. Ko'p hollarda FS farqi ilova va disk tanlovi (NVMe vs network disk) farqidan ancha kichik; operatsion tanishlik va tiklash tool'lari muhimroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems

Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31108	<p>O'chirilgan fayl joyni bo'shatmayapti. Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31109	<p>Journaling nima va ext4 data=ordered rejimi nimani kafolatlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Journaling</b> — fayl tizimi o'zgarishlarni avval maxsus jurnalga (WAL kabi) yozadi, keyin asl joyga. Crash'dan keyin jurnal qayta o'ynaladi va FS tez <b>izchil</b> holatga keladi, to'liq <code>fsck</code> kerak emas. ext4 default <b><code>data=ordered</code></b>: jurnalga faqat metadata yoziladi, lekin <b>data bloklari metadata commit'dan oldin</b> diskka yoziladi — crash'dan keyin faylda eski &quot;axlat&quot; (boshqa faylning qoldiq ma'lumoti) ko'rinmaydi.</p><p><b>Rejimlar:</b> | Rejim | Jurnalga | Kafolat | Tezlik | |---|---|---|---| | <code>journal</code> | data + metadata | eng kuchli | sekin (ikki marta yozish) | | <code>ordered</code> (default) | metadata, data oldin diskka | axlat ko'rinmaydi | yaxshi | | <code>writeback</code> | faqat metadata, tartib yo'q | faylda eski axlat bo'lishi mumkin | tez |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (ordered):</b></p><pre>1. data bloklari -&gt; disk<br>2. metadata (inode, bitmap) -&gt; jurnal, commit<br>3. metadata -&gt; asl joy (checkpoint)<br>crash 2 dan oldin: fayl o'zgarishi yo'q, FS izchil<br>crash 2 dan keyin: replay -&gt; metadata tiklanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dumpe2fs -h /dev/sda1 | grep -i -E 'journal|features'<br>mount | grep ' / '                  # data= opsiyasi ko'rinmasa — ordered<br>cat /proc/fs/ext4/sda1/options | grep data</pre><p><b>Muhim:</b> Jurnal <b>FS'ning</b> izchilligini kafolatlaydi, <b>ilovangiz</b> ma'lumotini emas. <code>write()</code> qaytgan ma'lumot crash'da yo'qolishi mumkin — ilova <code>fsync()</code> qilishi kerak.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Journaling bor, demak ma'lumot xavfsiz&quot; — yo'q, fsync'siz page cache'dagi data yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>writeback</code> ni tezlik uchun yoqish — crash'dan keyin fayllarda boshqa fayllarning eski ma'lumoti (xavfsizlik muammosi).</li><li><code>nobarrier</code> — disk cache bilan jurnal tartibi buziladi (yangi kernel'larda olib tashlangan).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DB'lar o'z WAL'iga ega va fsync'ga tayanadi; FS jurnali faqat metadata uchun yetarli. Shuning uchun DB uchun <code>data=journal</code> deyarli hech qachon kerak emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31110	<p>tmpfs, procfs, sysfs nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bular <b>virtual fayl tizimlari</b> — diskda yo'q. <b>tmpfs</b> — RAM (va swap) dagi fayl tizimi, tez, reboot'da yo'qoladi. <b>procfs</b> (<code>/proc</code>) — process'lar va kernel holatini fayl sifatida ko'rsatadi. <b>sysfs</b> (<code>/sys</code>) — qurilmalar, driver'lar va kernel obyektlarini ko'rsatadi va sozlashga imkon beradi.</p><p><b>Nega fayl ko'rinishida:</b> &quot;Hamma narsa fayl&quot; — <code>cat</code>, <code>echo</code>, <code>grep</code> bilan kernel'dan ma'lumot olish va sozlash mumkin, maxsus API kerak emas.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># tmpfs<br>mount -t tmpfs -o size=1G,mode=1777 tmpfs /mnt/ram<br>df -h /dev/shm /run<br># procfs<br>cat /proc/meminfo | head -3<br>cat /proc/1234/status          # process holati, Uid, VmRSS<br>ls -l /proc/1234/fd            # ochiq fayllar<br>cat /proc/loadavg<br>sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward     # = cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward<br># sysfs<br>cat /sys/block/nvme0n1/queue/scheduler     # [none] mq-deadline<br>cat /sys/class/net/eth0/speed<br>echo 1 &gt; /sys/class/block/sda/device/rescan   # disk hajmini qayta o'qish</pre><p><b>Joylar:</b> | FS | Odatiy mount | Ishlatilishi | |---|---|---| | tmpfs | <code>/run</code>, <code>/dev/shm</code>, <code>/tmp</code> | PID, socket, shared memory | | proc | <code>/proc</code> | process info, <code>/proc/sys</code> (sysctl) | | sysfs | <code>/sys</code> | qurilmalar, cgroup (<code>/sys/fs/cgroup</code>) |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>tmpfs RAM'ni yeydi; <code>size=</code> bermasang default — RAM yarmi. Container'da tmpfs cgroup memory limitiga kiradi -&gt; OOM.</li><li><code>/proc</code> dagi fayl hajmi <code>0</code> ko'rinadi, lekin o'qisang ma'lumot bor — <code>ls -l</code> ga ishonma.</li><li><code>/sys</code> va <code>/proc/sys</code> ga yozish — darhol kernel o'zgarishi; doimiy qilish uchun <code>/etc/sysctl.d/</code>, udev qoidasi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monitoring agentlari (node_exporter) aynan <code>/proc</code> va <code>/sys</code> ni o'qiydi. Container'ga <code>/proc</code> yoki <code>/sys</code> ni yoziladigan qilib berish — host'ni boshqarish imkonini berish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31111	<p>Foydali mount opsiyalari: noatime, noexec, nosuid, nodev, ro.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b><code>noatime</code></b> — har o'qishda access time yozilmaydi (performance). <b><code>noexec</code></b> — bu FS'dagi binarlar ishga tushmaydi. <b><code>nosuid</code></b> — setuid/setgid bitlari e'tiborsiz. <b><code>nodev</code></b> — device fayllari ishlamaydi. <b><code>ro</code></b> — faqat o'qish. Oxirgi to'rttasi — hardening.</p><p><b>Nega:</b></p><ul><li><code>atime</code>: har <code>cat</code> metadata yozuvini keltirib chiqaradi. Default <code>relatime</code> buni ancha kamaytirgan (kuniga bir marta yoki mtime'dan eski bo'lsa). <code>noatime</code> — butunlay o'chiradi.</li><li>Hujumchi <code>/tmp</code> ga yozib, u yerdan binar ishga tushiradi yoki setuid fayl qo'yadi — <code>noexec,nosuid,nodev</code> bu yo'lni yopadi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># /etc/fstab<br>UUID=...  /data     xfs    defaults,noatime                 0 2<br>tmpfs     /tmp      tmpfs  defaults,size=2G,nodev,nosuid,noexec 0 0<br>UUID=...  /var/tmp  ext4   defaults,nodev,nosuid,noexec     0 2<br>tmpfs     /dev/shm  tmpfs  defaults,nodev,nosuid,noexec     0 0</pre><pre>mount -o remount,noexec /tmp      # darhol, reboot'siz<br>findmnt -o TARGET,OPTIONS /tmp<br>cp /bin/ls /tmp/ &amp;&amp; /tmp/ls       # &quot;Permission denied&quot; -&gt; noexec ishlayapti</pre><p><b>Qayerda nima:</b> | Mount | Tavsiya | |---|---| | <code>/tmp</code>, <code>/var/tmp</code>, <code>/dev/shm</code> | <code>nodev,nosuid,noexec</code> | | <code>/home</code> | <code>nodev,nosuid</code> | | data disklar | <code>noatime</code>, <code>nodev,nosuid</code> | | USB/olinadigan | <code>nodev,nosuid,noexec</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>noexec</code> to'liq himoya emas: <code>bash /tmp/x.sh</code> yoki <code>python /tmp/x.py</code> baribir ishlaydi (interpreter boshqa FS'da).</li><li><code>/tmp</code> ga <code>noexec</code> ba'zi installer'larni sindiradi (ular <code>/tmp</code> da binar ishga tushiradi) — <code>TMPDIR</code> boshqa joyga.</li><li><code>atime</code> ga tayanadigan dasturlar (eski mail client'lar) <code>noatime</code> bilan ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CIS benchmark aynan shu opsiyalarni tekshiradi. Ular arzon, lekin defense in depth'ning bir qatlami xolos — asosiy himoya baribir yangilanishlar va least privilege.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31112	<p>fsync, page cache va 'yozildi' degan nima? Ma'lumot qachon yo'qolishi mumkin?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>write()</code> qaytdi — bu ma'lumot <b>diskda</b> degani emas: u kernel <b>page cache</b>'da &quot;dirty&quot; sahifa bo'lib turadi, diskka keyinroq (sekundlar ichida) flush qilinadi. <b>Durable</b> bo'lishi uchun <code>fsync(fd)</code> kerak. Ma'lumot yo'qoladi: fsync'dan oldin crash/elektr uzilishi, disk'ning volatile write cache'i, fsync xatosini e'tiborsiz qoldirish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app write() -&gt; page cache (RAM, dirty)  &lt;- shu yerda return<br>                 | vm.dirty_expire_centisecs (30s) / dirty_ratio<br>                 v<br>             disk controller cache (volatile!)<br>                 | FLUSH / FUA<br>                 v<br>             doimiy media<br>fsync(fd): page cache -&gt; disk + disk cache flush -&gt; return</pre><p><b>Atomik fayl almashtirish (to'g'ri pattern):</b></p><pre>1. write(config.tmp)      ; to'liq yangi mazmun<br>2. fsync(config.tmp)      ; data diskda<br>3. rename(config.tmp, config)   ; atomik nom almashuvi<br>4. fsync(dir)             ; rename'ning o'zi ham durable bo'lsin</pre><p>Crash qayerda bo'lmasin — yo eski, yo yangi fayl, hech qachon yarim.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>grep -E 'Dirty|Writeback' /proc/meminfo<br>sysctl vm.dirty_ratio vm.dirty_background_ratio vm.dirty_expire_centisecs<br>sync                         # hamma dirty'ni flush<br>dd if=/dev/zero of=f bs=1M count=100 conv=fsync   # fsync bilan o'lchash<br>hdparm -W /dev/sda           # disk write cache holati</pre><p><b>fsyncgate (PostgreSQL, 2018):</b> Linux fsync xato qaytargandan keyin dirty sahifalarni &quot;toza&quot; deb belgilab tashlardi; keyingi fsync muvaffaqiyatli qaytardi — ma'lumot jimgina yo'qolgan. Postgres endi fsync xatosida PANIC qiladi va WAL'dan tiklanadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fdatasync</code> faqat kerakli metadata'ni yozadi (fayl hajmi) — tezroq, lekin rename'dan keyin dir fsync'ni almashtirmaydi.</li><li>RAID controller'da BBU/flash-backed cache bo'lmasa write-back cache — elektr uzilishida yo'qotish.</li><li>Docker overlay'da yoki ba'zi network disk'larda fsync semantikasi kutilganidan farq qiladi — sinab ko'r.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Durable&quot; — butun stack'ning va'dasi: ilova fsync, FS, disk cache, controller. Har qatlam yolg'on gapirishi mumkin; muhim tizimlarda (DB) <code>pg_test_fsync</code> kabi tool bilan o'lchab, haqiqiy kafolatni tekshir.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31113	<p>XFS'ni kichraytirish kerak bo'lsa nima qilasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> XFS'ni <b>kichraytirib bo'lmaydi</b> — faqat <code>xfs_growfs</code> bor. Yagona yo'l: yangi kichik volume yaratish, ma'lumotni ko'chirish (<code>xfsdump/xfsrestore</code> yoki <code>rsync -aHAX</code>), mount'ni almashtirish va eskisini o'chirish.</p><p><b>Reja:</b></p><pre>1. yangi LV (kichik) + mkfs.xfs<br>2. birinchi nusxa (servis ishlab turibdi)   -- uzoq<br>3. servisni to'xtat -&gt; oxirgi rsync (delta) -- qisqa downtime<br>4. fstab/mount almashtir -&gt; servisni yoq<br>5. tekshir -&gt; eski LV'ni o'chir</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lvcreate -n data_new -L 200G vg0<br>mkfs.xfs /dev/vg0/data_new<br>mkdir /mnt/new &amp;&amp; mount /dev/vg0/data_new /mnt/new<br>rsync -aHAX --numeric-ids /data/ /mnt/new/        # 1-o'tish (online)<br>systemctl stop app<br>rsync -aHAX --numeric-ids --delete /data/ /mnt/new/   # delta<br>umount /data /mnt/new<br>lvrename vg0 data data_old &amp;&amp; lvrename vg0 data_new data<br>mount /data &amp;&amp; systemctl start app<br># bir necha kun kuzat, keyin:<br>lvremove vg0/data_old</pre><p>Alternativa — <code>xfsdump -l 0 -f /backup/data.dump /data</code> va <code>xfsrestore -f ... /mnt/new</code> (XFS atributlarini aniq saqlaydi).</p><p><b>rsync flaglari:</b> <code>-a</code> (arxiv: ruxsat, vaqt, symlink), <code>-H</code> (hard link), <code>-A</code> (ACL), <code>-X</code> (xattr, SELinux context), <code>--numeric-ids</code> (UID'lar nomga emas).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-H</code>/<code>-A</code>/<code>-X</code> siz — hard link'lar nusxaga aylanadi, ACL va SELinux label'lar yo'qoladi.</li><li>VG'da yangi LV uchun joy yo'q bo'lsa — vaqtincha boshqa disk kerak.</li><li>DB'ni rsync bilan ishlab turgan holda nusxalab, oxirgi o'tishni qilmaslik — buzilgan nusxa.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu muammoning yechimi — oldini olish: LV'larni kichik boshlab kerak bo'lganda grow qil. Shrink mumkin bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan joylarda ext4 tanla.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31114	<p>Copy-on-write FS (Btrfs/ZFS) va DB: qanday muammo bor?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DB'lar ma'lumotni <b>joyida</b> (in-place) qayta yozadi; CoW FS esa har yozuvni <b>yangi joyga</b> ko'chiradi. Natija: DB fayllari kuchli <b>fragmentatsiyaga</b> uchraydi, sequential o'qish sekinlashadi, <b>write amplification</b> oshadi. Tuning bilan yumshatiladi: Btrfs'da <code>chattr +C</code> (nodatacow), ZFS'da <code>recordsize</code> ni DB sahifasiga moslash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>DB: 8 KiB sahifa #100 ni yangilaydi<br>ext4/XFS:  [....#100....]  &lt;- o'sha joyga yoziladi<br>CoW:       #100 yangi blokka -&gt; fayl endi diskning har yerida tarqoq<br>           + metadata daraxti yangilanadi (yana yozuv)<br>full table scan: ketma-ket bloklar diskda ketma-ket emas -&gt; sekin</pre><p><b>Btrfs:</b></p><pre>mkdir /var/lib/postgresql<br>chattr +C /var/lib/postgresql     # faqat YANGI fayllarga ta'sir qiladi<br>lsattr -d /var/lib/postgresql     # ---------------C--</pre><p>Minus: nodatacow fayllarda checksum va compression ham o'chadi.</p><p><b>ZFS:</b></p><pre>zfs create -o recordsize=8k  -o logbias=throughput -o compression=lz4 \<br>           -o atime=off tank/pg          # Postgres (8 KiB sahifa)<br>zfs create -o recordsize=16k tank/mysql  # InnoDB (16 KiB)</pre><p>ZFS'da compression ko'pincha tezlikni <b>oshiradi</b> (kam I/O), <code>full_page_writes=off</code> ham mumkin (ZFS torn page bermaydi).</p><p><b>CoW afzalliklari:</b> arzon, bir zumda snapshot; data checksum (silent corruption'ni topadi); send/receive replikatsiya.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>chattr +C</code> ni mavjud fayllarga qo'llash ishlamaydi — avval atribut, keyin fayllarni nusxala.</li><li>ZFS ARC va DB shared_buffers ikki marta keshlashi — RAM'ni bo'l (<code>zfs_arc_max</code>).</li><li>CoW FS to'lib qolganda (90%+) performance keskin tushadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ZFS + Postgres to'g'ri tuning bilan prod'da yaxshi ishlaydi (snapshot backup, compression). Lekin default va operatsion soddalik uchun XFS/ext4 hamon xavfsiz tanlov — CoW'ni aniq foyda uchun tanla.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31115	<p>FS buzilganda (fsck) qanday tiklash va xavfsizlik qoidalari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy qoida: <b>mount qilingan FS'da fsck ishlatma</b> — buzilishni kuchaytiradi. Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-31116	<p>Ko'p node bitta FS'ga yozishi kerak: NFS, CephFS, object storage — qanday tanlaysan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Birinchi savol: <b>POSIX fayl semantikasi haqiqatan kerakmi?</b> Ko'pincha yo'q — ilova faqat &quot;fayl saqla/o'qi&quot; qiladi va <b>object storage</b> (S3) eng arzon, cheksiz va ishonchli yechim. Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30556	<p>Hard link va symbolic link farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Hard link</b> — o'sha <b>inode</b>'ga ikkinchi nom: &quot;asl&quot; va &quot;nusxa&quot; yo'q, ikkalasi teng; biri o'chsa, ma'lumot qoladi. Faqat bitta FS ichida, direktoriyaga emas. <b>Symlink</b> — ichida <b>yo'l matni</b> saqlanadigan alohida kichik fayl; target o'chsa link &quot;osilib&quot; qoladi (dangling); boshqa FS'ga va direktoriyaga ham ishora qila oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>hard link:<br>  report.txt  --\<br>                 +--&gt; inode 1234 (data, links=2)<br>  backup.txt  --/<br><br>symlink:<br>  latest -&gt; &quot;/srv/report.txt&quot;  (inode 5678, ichida faqat yo'l)<br>                 |<br>                 v<br>  report.txt --&gt; inode 1234</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo hello &gt; a.txt<br>ln a.txt b.txt            # hard link<br>ln -s a.txt c.txt         # symlink<br>ls -li<br># 1234 -rw-r--r-- 2 alice alice 6 a.txt<br># 1234 -rw-r--r-- 2 alice alice 6 b.txt      &lt;- bir xil inode, links=2<br># 5678 lrwxrwxrwx 1 alice alice 5 c.txt -&gt; a.txt<br>rm a.txt<br>cat b.txt                 # hello (ma'lumot bor)<br>cat c.txt                 # No such file or directory (osilib qoldi)</pre><p><b>Farqlar:</b> | | Hard link | Symlink | |---|---|---| | Inode | o'sha | alohida | | Boshqa FS'ga | yo'q | ha | | Direktoriyaga | yo'q | ha | | Target o'chsa | ishlaydi | buziladi | | Ruxsatlar | target bilan bir xil | link'niki ahamiyatsiz |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hard link'ni &quot;backup&quot; deb o'ylash — bitta faylni o'zgartirsang, ikkala nom ham o'zgaradi (bir xil data).</li><li>Nisbiy symlink link joylashgan <b>katalogga</b> nisbatan hisoblanadi, joriy katalogga emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Symlink'ning kuchli qo'llanishi — atomik deploy: <code>ln -sfn releases/v42 current.tmp &amp;&amp; mv -T current.tmp current</code> — rollback bitta buyruq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30678	<p>Linux'da fayl turlari qanday va <code>ls -l</code> ning birinchi belgisi nimani bildiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ls -l</code> ning birinchi belgisi — <b>fayl turi</b>: <code>-</code> oddiy fayl, <code>d</code> direktoriya, <code>l</code> symlink, <code>c</code> character device, <code>b</code> block device, <code>p</code> named pipe (FIFO), <code>s</code> socket. Linux'da &quot;hamma narsa fayl&quot; — qurilmalar va IPC kanallari ham fayl tizimida ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Misollar:</b></p><pre>ls -l /etc/hosts /tmp /dev/sda /dev/null /run/docker.sock<br># -rw-r--r--  /etc/hosts          oddiy fayl<br># drwxrwxrwt  /tmp                direktoriya<br># brw-rw----  /dev/sda            block device (disk, blok-blok)<br># crw-rw-rw-  /dev/null           character device (oqim)<br># srw-rw----  /run/docker.sock    unix socket<br>ls -l /bin/sh<br># lrwxrwxrwx  /bin/sh -&gt; dash     symlink<br>mkfifo /tmp/q &amp;&amp; ls -l /tmp/q<br># prw-r--r--  /tmp/q              FIFO</pre><p><b>Har biri nima:</b> | Belgi | Tur | Misol | |---|---|---| | <code>-</code> | oddiy fayl | matn, binar, rasm | | <code>d</code> | direktoriya | <code>/etc</code> | | <code>l</code> | symlink | <code>/bin/sh</code> | | <code>b</code> | block device | <code>/dev/sda</code>, <code>/dev/nvme0n1</code> | | <code>c</code> | char device | <code>/dev/null</code>, <code>/dev/tty</code> | | <code>p</code> | FIFO | <code>mkfifo</code> — process'lar orasida oqim | | <code>s</code> | socket | <code>/run/docker.sock</code>, <code>/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock</code> |</p><p><b>Tur kengaytma bilan aniqlanmaydi:</b> <code>file</code> buyrug'i fayl ichidagi &quot;magic&quot; baytlarga qaraydi.</p><pre>file /bin/ls report.pdf photo.jpg<br># /bin/ls: ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable ...<br>stat -c '%F' /dev/sda      # block special file</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Device'larda hajm o'rnida <code>8, 0</code> kabi major/minor raqamlar turadi — bu baytlar emas.</li><li>Socket faylni <code>rm</code> qilish servisni to'xtatmaydi, lekin yangi ulanishlar uni topmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container'ga <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code> (<code>s</code>) yoki <code>/dev/sda</code> (<code>b</code>) ni mount qilish — host'ni boshqarish huquqini berish. Fayl turini bilish xavfsizlik review'da muhim.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30682	<p>Linux'dagi asosiy fayl tizimi turlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy disk fayl tizimlari: <b>ext4</b> (umumiy default, Debian/Ubuntu), <b>XFS</b> (katta fayllar va parallel I/O, RHEL default), <b>Btrfs</b> (snapshot, copy-on-write, checksum; Fedora/openSUSE default), <b>ZFS</b> (enterprise storage, CoW + RAID). Maxsus/virtual: <b>tmpfs</b> (RAM), <b>proc</b>, <b>sysfs</b>, <b>overlay</b> (container), <b>vfat</b> (EFI bo'limi), <b>nfs</b> (tarmoq).</p><p><b>Qisqa xarakteristika:</b> | FS | Qayerda | Eslab qol | |---|---|---| | ext4 | umumiy server, VM | offline shrink mumkin | | XFS | DB, katta data, RHEL | shrink yo'q | | Btrfs | desktop, snapshot | subvolume, compression | | ZFS | NAS, storage | checksum, pool, ARC kesh | | tmpfs | <code>/run</code>, <code>/dev/shm</code>, <code>/tmp</code> | RAM, reboot'da yo'qoladi | | vfat | <code>/boot/efi</code> | UEFI talab qiladi | | overlay | Docker/containerd | image qatlamlari |</p><p><b>Amalda (turini aniqlash):</b></p><pre>df -T<br># Filesystem     Type   Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on<br># /dev/nvme0n1p2 ext4    50G   12G   36G  25% /<br># tmpfs          tmpfs  3.9G     0  3.9G   0% /dev/shm<br>lsblk -f                 # disk bo'yicha FSTYPE, UUID<br>findmnt -t xfs           # faqat XFS mount'lar<br>cat /proc/filesystems    # kernel qo'llaydigan FS'lar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>XFS'ni katta qilib yaratish — keyin kichraytirib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>FS turiga qarab tool o'zgaradi: <code>resize2fs</code> faqat ext, <code>xfs_growfs</code> faqat XFS.</li><li>tmpfs'ga katta fayl yozish — RAM tugaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default'ni o'zgartirishga jiddiy sabab bo'lmasa, distro default'ida qol: tool'lar, hujjatlar va jamoa tajribasi shunga mos.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30683	<p>Journaling fayl tizimi nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Journaling'da o'zgarishlar avval <b>jurnalga</b> (alohida log hudud) yoziladi, keyin asl joyga. Elektr uzilsa yoki kernel crash bo'lsa, boot'da jurnal qayta o'ynaladi — FS <b>soniyalarda izchil</b> holatga qaytadi, soatlab <code>fsck</code> kerak emas.</p><p><b>Jurnalsiz muammo:</b> Fayl yaratish bir nechta yozuv: inode ajratish, bitmap, katalog yozuvi. Ular orasida crash bo'lsa — FS ziddiyatli holatda (inode band, lekin hech kimga tegishli emas). ext2'da bu butun diskni skanerlovchi uzoq fsck degani edi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. tranzaksiya: [inode, bitmap, dir entry] -&gt; jurnal<br>2. commit yozuvi -&gt; jurnal<br>3. checkpoint: o'zgarishlar asl joyga<br>crash 1-2 orasida -&gt; tranzaksiya tashlanadi (hech narsa o'zgarmagan)<br>crash 2 dan keyin -&gt; replay (hammasi qo'llaniladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dumpe2fs -h /dev/sda1 | grep -i journal     # ext4 jurnal hajmi<br>journalctl -k | grep -i 'recovery'          # crash'dan keyin replay izi<br># EXT4-fs (sda1): recovery complete</pre><p>ext4 default — <code>data=ordered</code> (faqat metadata jurnallanadi, data undan oldin yoziladi). Btrfs/ZFS jurnal o'rniga <b>copy-on-write</b> ishlatadi: yangi ma'lumot yangi joyga yoziladi, keyin ko'rsatkich atomik almashtiriladi.</p><p><b>Muhim chegara:</b> Jurnal <b>fayl tizimi tuzilmasini</b> himoya qiladi, ilova ma'lumotini emas. <code>write()</code> qilingan, lekin <code>fsync()</code> qilinmagan ma'lumot crash'da yo'qolishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Jurnal bor — backup kerak emas&quot; — jurnal o'chirilgan faylni yoki disk o'limini qaytarmaydi.</li><li>Ilova o'zi <code>fsync</code> qilmasa, crash'dan keyin fayl bo'sh yoki eski bo'lishi mumkin (ext4 delayed allocation).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> FS jurnali, DB WAL'i va ilova <code>fsync</code>'i — uch xil qatlam. Har biri faqat o'z darajasidagi izchillikni kafolatlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30684	<p>tmpfs nima va qayerda ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>tmpfs</b> — xotirada (RAM, kerak bo'lsa swap'da) yashovchi fayl tizimi: juda tez, lekin <b>reboot'da yo'qoladi</b>. Ishlatiladi: <code>/run</code> (PID, socket), <code>/dev/shm</code> (shared memory), ko'pincha <code>/tmp</code>, Kubernetes'da <code>emptyDir: {medium: Memory}</code>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Vaqtinchalik, tez-tez yoziladigan, saqlash shart bo'lmagan ma'lumot uchun diskka yozish — sekin va diskni yeydi. Socket va PID fayllar reboot'dan keyin baribir eskiradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>df -h -t tmpfs<br># tmpfs  3.9G  1.2M  3.9G  1% /run<br>mount -t tmpfs -o size=512M,mode=1777,nodev,nosuid tmpfs /mnt/fast<br># fstab:<br># tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,size=2G,nodev,nosuid,noexec 0 0<br>systemctl status tmp.mount       # ba'zi distro'larda /tmp shu unit</pre><p>Kubernetes:</p><pre>volumes:<br>  - name: cache<br>    emptyDir:<br>      medium: Memory<br>      sizeLimit: 256Mi</pre><p><b>Xotira qanday hisoblanadi:</b></p><pre>tmpfs fayllari = RAM (Shmem)<br>free -h -&gt; &quot;shared&quot; ustuni<br>container ichida -&gt; cgroup memory limitiga KIRADI</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>size=</code> bermasang default RAM'ning yarmi — to'ldirilsa tizim swap'ga tushadi yoki OOM.</li><li>Container'da tmpfs'ga yozilgan fayllar memory limitga kiradi — kutilmagan <b>OOMKilled</b> (log'lar yoki upload'lar tmpfs'ga tushsa).</li><li>Muhim ma'lumotni tmpfs'da saqlash — reboot yoki pod restart'da yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> tmpfs — maxfiy vaqtinchalik ma'lumot uchun ham yaxshi (secret'lar diskka tushmaydi; K8s secret volume'lari aynan tmpfs). Faqat swap yoqilgan bo'lsa, ular swap'ga tushishi mumkinligini unutma.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30686	<p><code>mount</code> va <code>/etc/fstab</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b><code>mount</code></b> — qurilmadagi (yoki tarmoqdagi) fayl tizimini katalog daraxtining bir nuqtasiga ulaydi: shundan keyin <code>/data</code> ichiga yozilgan narsa o'sha diskka tushadi. <b><code>/etc/fstab</code></b> — boot paytida avtomatik mount qilinadigan narsalar ro'yxati.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/ (root disk)<br>+-- data   &lt;- mount /dev/sdb1 /data<br>     |        endi /data = sdb1 dagi FS<br>     +-- (sdb1 ichidagi fayllar)</pre><p>Mount'dan oldin <code>/data</code> da bo'lgan fayllar yo'qolmaydi — shunchaki yashirinadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lsblk -f                           # disk va UUID<br>sudo mount /dev/sdb1 /data         # qo'lda<br>findmnt /data                      # tekshirish<br>sudo umount /data<br># doimiy — /etc/fstab:<br># UUID=3f1c...  /data  ext4  defaults,noatime,nofail  0 2<br># nfs.local:/exp /mnt/share nfs _netdev,nofail 0 0<br>sudo findmnt --verify<br>sudo mount -a                      # REBOOT'DAN OLDIN sinab ko'r</pre><p><b>Opsiyalar:</b> | Opsiya | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>defaults</code> | rw, suid, dev, exec, auto, async | | <code>nofail</code> | disk yo'q bo'lsa boot to'xtamaydi | | <code>_netdev</code> | tarmoq ko'tarilgandan keyin mount | | <code>noexec,nosuid,nodev</code> | hardening | | <code>noatime</code> | o'qishda metadata yozilmaydi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>/dev/sdb</code> nomi bilan yozish — disk tartibi o'zgarsa boshqa disk mount bo'ladi. UUID ishlat.</li><li>fstab xatosi + reboot = emergency mode.</li><li><code>umount: target is busy</code> — kimdir ichida: <code>lsof +D /data</code>, <code>fuser -vm /data</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> systemd fstab'ni <code>.mount</code> unit'larga aylantiradi — <code>systemctl list-units -t mount</code> va <code>x-systemd.automount</code> (birinchi murojaatda mount) kabi opsiyalar tarmoq disklari bilan boot'ni tezlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30687	<p>Overlay fayl tizimi (overlayfs) Docker'da qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>OverlayFS</b> bir nechta katalogni bitta ko'rinishga birlashtiradi. Docker'da image qatlamlari — <b>lowerdir</b> (faqat o'qish), container yozuvlari — <b>upperdir</b> (yoziladigan), ular birlashgan ko'rinish — <b>merged</b> (container'ning <code>/</code>). Pastki qatlamdagi faylni o'zgartirish — avval uni upperdir'ga <b>copy-up</b> qilish (CoW); o'chirish — <b>whiteout</b> fayl.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>merged (container /):   /etc/nginx.conf  /app/main  /tmp/x<br>                             ^              ^          ^<br>upperdir (rw, container):  nginx.conf'   (yo'q)     x  + whiteout: /old<br>lowerdir 2 (image layer):  (yo'q)        main<br>lowerdir 1 (base image):   nginx.conf    ...       old</pre><ul><li>O'qish: yuqoridan pastga birinchi topilgan.</li><li>Yozish: fayl upper'ga to'liq nusxalanadi, keyin o'zgartiriladi.</li><li>O'chirish: upper'da maxsus &quot;whiteout&quot; (char device 0/0) — pastki fayl yashiriladi, lekin layer'da qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker info | grep 'Storage Driver'     # overlay2<br>docker inspect -f '{{json .GraphDriver.Data}}' web | jq<br># LowerDir, UpperDir, MergedDir yo'llari<br>mount | grep overlay<br>docker diff web          # A added, C changed, D deleted</pre><p><b>Oqibatlar:</b></p><ul><li>1 GB faylning 1 baytini o'zgartirish — 1 GB copy-up (sekin, disk).</li><li><code>RUN rm big.tar</code> keyingi layer'da — image hajmi kichraymaydi (fayl pastki layer'da qoladi). Bitta <code>RUN</code> da yukla va o'chir yoki multi-stage.</li><li>Container upperdir'i container o'chirilganda yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DB yoki log'larni container FS'ida saqlash — sekin (CoW) va o'chganda yo'qoladi; volume ishlat.</li><li>Inode'lar overlay'da ko'p ishlatiladi — <code>/var/lib/docker</code> alohida FS bo'lsa yaxshi.</li><li>XFS ustida overlay uchun <code>ftype=1</code> shart.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Image hajmini va build tezligini optimallash overlay mexanikasini tushunishdan boshlanadi: kam o'zgaradigan qatlamlar pastda, tez o'zgaradigan (kod) yuqorida, katta vaqtinchalik fayllar bitta RUN ichida.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30693	<p>Inode nima, unda nima saqlanadi va nima saqlanmaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Inode</b> — fayl haqidagi metadata yozuvi: tur, ruxsatlar, UID/GID, hajm, vaqtlar (atime, mtime, ctime), link soni va <b>data bloklari ko'rsatkichlari</b>. Inode'da <b>fayl nomi yo'q</b> — nom katalog yozuvida saqlanadi (<code>nom -&gt; inode raqami</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>katalog /home/alice:              inode 1234:<br>  &quot;report.txt&quot; -&gt; 1234              type=file, mode=0644<br>  &quot;notes.md&quot;   -&gt; 5678              uid=1001 gid=1001 size=8192<br>                                    atime/mtime/ctime<br>                                    links=1<br>                                    blocks -&gt; [disk 9001, 9002]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls -i report.txt            # 1234 report.txt<br>stat report.txt<br>#   Size: 8192   Blocks: 16   IO Block: 4096  regular file<br># Inode: 1234   Links: 1<br># Access: (0644/-rw-r--r--)  Uid: (1001/alice)<br># Access: ... Modify: ... Change: ...
