Fayl tizimi muammolarini &quot;nom&quot; emas, &quot;inode&quot; darajasida o'yla.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v4 Filesystems
Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30679	<p>/dev/null, /dev/zero, /dev/urandom nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b><code>/dev/null</code></b> — &quot;qora tuynuk&quot;: yozilgan hamma narsa yo'qoladi, o'qilsa darhol bo'sh (EOF). <b><code>/dev/zero</code></b> — o'qilganda cheksiz nol baytlar beradi. <b><code>/dev/urandom</code></b> — kernel CSPRNG'dan kriptografik xavfsiz tasodifiy baytlar.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># /dev/null — chiqishni o'chirish<br>cron_job.sh &gt; Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30707	<p>Hard link va soft (symbolic) link'ni chuqur solishtiring: <code>ln</code> va <code>ln -s</code> qanday ishlaydi, qachon qaysi biri, va 'log faylni o'chirdim, lekin disk bo'shamadi' holati bunga qanday bog'liq?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Hard link</b> (<code>ln a b</code>) — o'sha inode'ga yangi nom: link soni +1, &quot;asl&quot; inode 77</pre><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | Hard | Symlink | |---|---|---| | FS chegarasi | o'tmaydi | o'tadi | | Direktoriya | mumkin emas | mumkin | | Target o'chsa | ishlaydi | dangling | | Nisbiy yo'l | — | link joylashgan katalogga nisbatan |</p><p><b>&quot;Log o'chirdim, disk bo'shamadi&quot;:</b></p><pre>rm /var/log/app/app.log<br>df -h /var                       # o'zgarmadi<br>lsof +L1 | grep app.log          # (deleted) - app hali fd'ni ochiq tutyapti<br>: &gt; /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/fd/&lt;fd&gt;          # darhol bo'shatish<br>systemctl kill -s HUP app        # yoki reload: app faylni qayta ochadi</pre><p>To'g'ri usul — o'chirmasdan bo'shatish: <code>truncate -s 0 app.log</code> yoki logrotate.</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b></p><ul><li>Symlink: <code>current -&gt; releases/v42</code> atomik deploy (<code>ln -sfn</code> + <code>mv -T</code>), <code>/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*</code>, versiya almashish (<code>python3 -&gt; python3.12</code>).</li><li>Hard link: backup dedup (<code>rsync --link-dest</code> — o'zgarmagan fayllar avvalgi snapshot'ga hard link), bir fayl ikki joyda joy egallamasin.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ln -s target link</code> argument tartibini adashtirish.</li><li>Nisbiy symlink'ni boshqa katalogdan yaratib, noto'g'ri yo'l hosil qilish (<code>ln -s ../x dir/link</code> — <code>dir</code> ga nisbatan).</li><li>Hard link backup'da fayl o'zgarsa — hamma &quot;nusxa&quot; o'zgaradi (ular nusxa emas).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Disk bo'shamadi&quot; — klassik incident. Interview Drill::Linux::V4 Linux filesystems	idrill-30716	<p>XFS'ni kichraytirish mumkinmi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Yo'q.</b> XFS faqat kattalashadi (<code>xfs_growfs</code>); kichraytirish funksiyasi yo'q (eksperimental ishlar bor, lekin prod'da yo'q). <code>gdisk</code>/<code>sgdisk</code> — GPT; <code>parted</code> — skript va resize uchun (lekin darhol yozadi).</p><p>| | MBR | GPT | |---|---|---| | Max disk | 2 TiB | ~9.4 ZB | | Bo'limlar | 4 primary (extended orqali ko'proq) | 128 | | Zaxira | yo'q | disk oxirida backup header | | Butunlik | yo'q | CRC32 | | Boot | BIOS | UEFI (BIOS'da <code>bios_grub</code> bilan) |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>MBR:  [sektor 0: boot kod + 4 yozuv][ ... bo'limlar ... ]<br>GPT:  [protective MBR][GPT header][128 yozuv][ ... bo'limlar ... ][backup yozuvlar][backup header]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo fdisk -l /dev/sdb              # Disklabel type: gpt<br>sudo fdisk /dev/sdb                 # g (GPT jadval), n (yangi), p, w (yozish), q (saqlamay chiqish)<br>sudo parted /dev/sdb print<br>sudo parted -s /dev/sdb mklabel gpt mkpart data ext4 1MiB 100%<br>sudo parted /dev/sdb resizepart 1 100%<br>sudo sgdisk -p /dev/sdb             # skript uchun<br>sudo partprobe /dev/sdb             # kernelga yangi jadvalni o'qit</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fdisk</code> <code>w</code> bosilmaguncha hech narsa yozmaydi (o'rganish uchun xavfsiz), <b><code>parted</code> esa har buyruqni darhol yozadi</b>.</li><li>Noto'g'ri diskni tanlash (<code>sdb</code> o'rniga <code>sda</code>) — ma'lumot yo'qotish; avval <code>lsblk</code> va model/hajmni tekshiring.</li><li>2 TiB dan katta diskka MBR — qolgan joy ko'rinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud'da disk kengaytirilgach (EBS resize) <code>growpart /dev/xvda 1</code> + <code>resize2fs</code>/<code>xfs_growfs</code> — reboot'siz. Data disklarida ko'pincha bo'lim kerak emas — butun diskni LVM PV yoki to'g'ridan-to'g'ri FS qilish soddaroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v16 Disks_RAID
Interview Drill::Linux::V16 Disks, partitions & RAID	idrill-31350	<p>Cloud'da disk (EBS/PD) kattalashtirildi. Interview Drill::Linux::V16 Disks, partitions & RAID	idrill-31351	<p><code>mkfs</code> va FS sozlamalari: ext4 vs XFS yaratishda kerakli flaglar, inode soni, reserved blocks.</p>	<pre>sudo mkfs.ext4 -L data -m 1 /dev/sdb1          # 1% rezerv<br>sudo mkfs.ext4 -i 4096 /dev/sdb1               # har 4KB'ga inode (mayda fayllar uchun)<br>sudo mkfs.ext4 -N 20000000 /dev/sdb1           # aniq inode soni<br>sudo mkfs.xfs -L data /dev/sdb1                # inode dinamik<br>sudo mkfs.xfs -f ...                           # mavjud FS ustidan (ehtiyot!)<br>sudo tune2fs -l /dev/sdb1 | egrep &quot;Inode count|Reserved block|Mount count&quot;<br>sudo tune2fs -m 1 /dev/sdb1                    # rezervni online kamaytir<br>sudo tune2fs -L newlabel /dev/sdb1<br>sudo xfs_info /data<br>sudo e2label / xfs_admin -L</pre><ul><li>ext4 <b>inode soni yaratishda qotadi</b> — keyin o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi; <code>df -i</code> 100% = &quot;No space left&quot; (joy bor bo'lsa ham).</li><li>5% rezerv 4 TB diskda = 200 GB — root daemonlar uchun, ma'lumot diskida keraksiz.</li><li><code>mkfs</code> qaytarib bo'lmaydi: <code>lsblk -f</code> bilan qurilma to'g'riligini 2 marta tekshir.</li></ul>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v16 Disks_RAID

Interview Drill::Linux::V16 Disks, partitions & RAID	idrill-31353	<p>RAID darajalari: 0, 1, 5, 6, 10 — farqi, sig'imi, nechta disk o'lishiga chidaydi?</p>	<p>| Daraja | Min disk | Sig'im (N disk, S hajm) | Chidaydi | Yozish | Qachon | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | RAID 0 | 2 | N*S | 0 | eng tez | vaqtinchalik/cache, scratch | | RAID 1 | 2 | S | N-1 | 1 disk tezligi | OS diski, kichik muhim ma'lumot | | RAID 5 | 3 | (N-1)*S | 1 | sekin (parity, write penalty 4) | o'qish ko'p arxiv | | RAID 6 | 4 | (N-2)*S | 2 | yanada sekin (penalty 6) | katta HDD massivlar | | RAID 10 | 4 | N*S/2 | har mirror juftdan 1 | tez | <b>DB</b> |</p><p>Senior nuqtalar:</p><ul><li>Katta HDD'larda RAID 5 rebuild soatlab/kunlab davom etadi; shu paytda ikkinchi disk o'lsa yoki URE (o'qib bo'lmaydigan sektor) chiqsa — massiv yo'qoladi. Interview Drill::Linux::V16 Disks, partitions & RAID	idrill-34020	<p><code>lsblk</code> va <code>blkid</code> nima ko'rsatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b><code>lsblk</code></b> — blok qurilmalar daraxti: disklar, bo'limlar, LVM, hajm va mount nuqtalari. <b><code>blkid</code></b> — har bir bo'limning fayl tizimi turi, <b>UUID</b> va LABEL'i. <code>lsblk</code> &quot;nima bor va qayerga ulangan&quot;, <code>blkid</code> &quot;u nima va uning doimiy identifikatori qanday&quot; degan savolga javob beradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lsblk<br># NAME   SIZE TYPE MOUNTPOINT<br># sda     50G disk<br># |-sda1   1G part /boot<br># `-sda2  49G part /<br># sdb    100G disk                 &lt;- yangi disk, mount yo'q<br>lsblk -f                           # FS turi va UUID ham<br>lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL,SERIAL<br>sudo blkid /dev/sda2<br># /dev/sda2: UUID=&quot;3f2a...&quot; TYPE=&quot;ext4&quot; PARTUUID=&quot;...&quot;<br>sudo blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/sda2   # faqat UUID (skript uchun)<br>findmnt /data                      # nima, qayerga, qanday opsiyalar bilan</pre><p><b>Nega UUID muhim:</b></p><pre>Bugun:   disk A = /dev/sdb, disk B = /dev/sdc<br>Reboot:  disk A = /dev/sdc   (kernel topish tartibi o'zgardi)<br>fstab'da /dev/sdb -&gt; NOTO'G'RI disk mount bo'ladi yoki boot to'xtaydi<br>fstab'da UUID=... -&gt; har doim to'g'ri disk</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sdX</code> nomlari doimiy emas — ayniqsa cloud va NVMe'da (<code>nvme1n1</code> ham almashishi mumkin).</li><li>Diskni klonlasangiz (<code>dd</code>) UUID ham nusxalanadi — ikki disk bir UUID bilan chalkashlik; <code>tune2fs -U random</code>.</li><li>Formatlanmagan diskda <code>blkid</code> hech narsa chiqarmaydi — bu normal.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Formatlashdan oldin doim <code>lsblk -f</code> bilan diskda FS borligini tekshiring — &quot;bo'sh&quot; deb o'ylagan disk boshqa ma'lumotli disk bo'lib chiqishi mumkin. Cloud'da <code>/dev/disk/by-id/</code> (volume ID bilan) eng ishonchli nom.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v16 Disks_RAID
Interview Drill::Linux::V16 Disks, partitions & RAID	idrill-34021	<p>Yangi diskni formatlab, doimiy mount qilish qadamlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Diskni topish (<code>lsblk</code>) -&gt; fayl tizimi yaratish (<code>mkfs.ext4</code>/<code>mkfs.xfs</code>) -&gt; Interview Drill::Linux::V16 Disks, partitions & RAID	idrill-34022	<p>MBR va GPT farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>MBR</b> (Master Boot Record) — 1983-yildan beri: 2 TiB gacha disk, 4 ta primary bo'lim, zaxirasi yo'q, BIOS bilan ishlaydi. <b>GPT</b> (GUID Partition Table) — UEFI standartining qismi: amalda cheksiz hajm, 128 bo'lim, zaxira nusxa va butunlik tekshiruvi. Yangi serverlar — GPT.</p><p>| | MBR | GPT | |---|---|---| | Disk hajmi | 2 TiB gacha | amalda cheksiz | | Bo'limlar | 4 primary (extended orqali ko'proq) | 128 (default) | | Boot | BIOS | UEFI | | Zaxira | yo'q | disk oxirida backup header | | Buzilishni aniqlash | yo'q | CRC32 |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>MBR: diskning 1-sektori (512 bayt) = boot kod + 4 bo'lim yozuvi<br>     sektor buzilsa -&gt; butun jadval yo'qoladi<br>GPT: boshida header + jadval, OXIRIDA nusxasi<br>     boshi buzilsa -&gt; oxiridagidan tiklanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo fdisk -l /dev/sda | grep 'Disklabel type'   # dos (=MBR) yoki gpt<br>sudo parted /dev/sda print | grep 'Partition Table'<br>ls /sys/firmware/efi &amp;&amp; echo UEFI || echo BIOS   # tizim qanday yuklangan</pre><p>Asboblar: <code>fdisk</code> (ikkalasi), <code>gdisk</code>/<code>sgdisk</code> va <code>parted</code> (GPT).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>3 TB diskni MBR bilan bo'lish — faqat 2 TiB ko'rinadi.</li><li>MBR'dan GPT'ga o'tkazish (<code>gdisk</code> qila oladi) — boot jarayonini ham o'zgartiradi; backup'siz qilmang.</li><li>UEFI tizimga GPT bilan birga <b>EFI System Partition</b> (FAT32, ~512MB) kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p cloud image'lar hali ham MBR bilan keladi — 2 TiB dan katta root disk kerak bo'lsa GPT'li image tanlang. Bu kichik farq migratsiya paytida kutilmagan cheklovga aylanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v16 Disks_RAID
Interview Drill::Linux::V16 Disks, partitions & RAID	idrill-34023	<p>RAID 0, 1, 5, 10 farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>RAID 0</b> — striping: tezlik, lekin bitta disk o'lsa hammasi yo'qoladi. <b>RAID 1</b> — mirroring: har ma'lumot ikki diskda. <b>RAID 5</b> — striping + parity: bitta disk o'lishiga chidaydi, yozish sekinroq. <b>RAID 10</b> — mirror juftliklar ustida striping: tez va ishonchli, lekin hajmning 50% i.</p><p>| RAID | Min disk | Foydali hajm | Chidaydi | Qachon | |---|---|---|---|---| | 0 | 2 | 100% | 0 disk | tezlik, vaqtinchalik data | | 1 | 2 | 50% | 1 disk | OS, kichik server | | 5 | 3 | (N-1)/N | 1 disk | arxiv, o'qish ko'p | | 6 | 4 | (N-2)/N | 2 disk | katta disklar | | 10 | 4 | 50% | har juftdan 1 | DB, yozish ko'p |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>RAID 0:  A1 | A2        RAID 1:  A | A<br>RAID 5:  A1 | A2 | Ap   (parity aylanadi: B1 | Bp | B2 ...)<br>RAID 10: (A | A) + (B | B)  -&gt; mirror juftlar ustida stripe</pre><p><b>Amalda (software RAID, mdadm):</b></p><pre>sudo mdadm --create /dev/md0 --level=1 --raid-devices=2 /dev/sdb /dev/sdc<br>cat /proc/mdstat                      # [UU] sog'lom, [U_] bitta disk yo'q<br>sudo mdadm --detail /dev/md0<br>sudo mdadm --detail --scan | sudo tee -a /etc/mdadm/mdadm.conf<br>sudo update-initramfs -u</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><b>RAID backup emas</b> — <code>rm -rf</code>, ransomware yoki buzilgan yozuv bir zumda hamma disklarga yoziladi.</li><li>RAID 5 katta disklarda: o'lgan diskni tiklash (rebuild) soatlab davom etadi va shu vaqtda ikkinchi disk o'lsa — hammasi yo'q (RAID 6 yoki 10 tanlang).</li><li>Degraded holatni kuzatmaslik — bitta disk oylab o'lik turadi va hech kim bilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>mdadm --monitor</code> yoki <code>node_md_disks</code> metrikasi bilan degraded holatga alert qo'ying. Cloud'da RAID odatda kerak emas — provider disklari allaqachon replikatsiyalangan; muhimi snapshot va boshqa joyda backup.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v16 Disks_RAID
Interview Drill::Linux::V16 Disks, partitions & RAID	idrill-34024	<p>Disk sog'ligini qanday tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Fizik disk uchun <b>SMART</b> (<code>smartctl -H</code> va <code>-a</code>), kernel log'idagi I/O xatolari (<code>dmesg</code>), NVMe uchun <code>nvme smart-log</code>, va ishlash ko'rsatkichlari (<code>iostat</code>). Cloud disklarida SMART odatda yo'q — provider metrikalari va status check'lariga qaraladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo smartctl -H /dev/sda        # SMART overall-health: PASSED / FAILED<br>sudo smartctl -a /dev/sda | grep -E 'Reallocated_Sector|Current_Pending|Offline_Uncorrectable|CRC_Error|Power_On_Hours'<br>sudo smartctl -t short /dev/sda  # qisqa test (2 daqiqa), keyin -a da natija<br>sudo nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0   # percentage_used, media_errors<br>dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'i/o error|ata[0-9]|nvme|medium error'<br>iostat -xz 1                     # await keskin oshganmi</pre><p><b>Ko'rsatkichlarni o'qish:</b> | Atribut | Xavf belgisi | |---|---| | <code>Reallocated_Sector_Ct</code> | o'sib bormoqda -&gt; disk o'lmoqda | | <code>Current_Pending_Sector</code> | &gt; 0 -&gt; o'qib bo'lmaydigan sektorlar | | <code>UDMA_CRC_Error_Count</code> | kabel/ulanish muammosi | | NVMe <code>percentage_used</code> | 100% ga yaqin -&gt; resurs tugayapti | | NVMe <code>media_errors</code> | &gt; 0 -&gt; jiddiy |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>PASSED</code> — disk sog'lom degani emas; ko'p disklar PASSED holatda o'ladi. Atributlar trendiga qarang.</li><li>RAID kontroller ortidagi disklar uchun maxsus flag kerak (<code>-d megaraid,0</code>).</li><li>SMART'ni faqat muammo bo'lganda tekshirish — kech; <code>smartd</code> bilan doimiy kuzating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>smartd</code> yoki <code>smartctl_exporter</code> bilan Prometheus'ga chiqarib, <code>Reallocated</code>/<code>Pending</code> o'sishiga alert qo'ying va diskni <b>oldindan</b> almashtiring. Har qanday holatda ham disk sog'ligi backup o'rnini bosmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v16 Disks_RAID
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31242	<p>Linux boot jarayoni bosqichlari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Boot zanjiri: <b>firmware</b> (BIOS/UEFI, POST) -&gt; <b>bootloader</b> (GRUB2 / systemd-boot) -&gt; <b>kernel + initramfs</b> -&gt; haqiqiy root FS mount va <b>systemd (PID 1)</b> -&gt; <b>default.target</b> bo'yicha servislar -&gt; login (getty/sshd).</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> Server boot bo'lmasa, birinchi savol — qaysi bosqichda to'xtadi? GRUB menyusi ko'rinmasa — firmware/bootloader; <code>dracut emergency shell</code> — initramfs; <code>emergency mode</code> — fstab/systemd. Bosqichni bilsang, tuzatish yo'li ham aniq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Firmware (BIOS/UEFI): POST, boot qurilmasini tanlash<br>   v<br>Bootloader (GRUB2): menyu, kernel + initramfs'ni RAM'ga yuklash, cmdline<br>   v<br>Kernel: hardware init, initramfs'ni vaqtinchalik root qilib ochish<br>   v<br>initramfs: drayverlar, LVM/RAID/LUKS, haqiqiy root'ni topish va mount<br>   v<br>switch_root -&gt; /sbin/init = systemd (PID 1)<br>   v<br>sysinit.target -&gt; basic.target -&gt; multi-user.target (yoki graphical)<br>   v<br>sshd, getty -&gt; login</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>systemd-analyze<br># Startup finished in 4.1s (firmware) + 2.0s (loader) + 1.8s (kernel)<br>#                  + 3.2s (initrd) + 12.5s (userspace) = 23.6s<br>systemd-analyze blame | head        # eng sekin unit'lar<br>systemd-analyze critical-chain      # kim kimni kutdi<br>journalctl -b                       # joriy boot log<br>journalctl -b -1 -p err             # oldingi boot xatolari<br>dmesg -T | head                     # kernel xabarlari</pre><p><b>Bosqich bo'yicha belgilar:</b> | Belgi | Bosqich | |---|---| | &quot;No bootable device&quot; | firmware / disk | | <code>grub rescue&gt;</code> | GRUB fayllari topilmadi | | <code>dracut-initqueue timeout</code>, emergency shell | initramfs, root topilmadi | | <code>You are in emergency mode</code> | fstab yoki systemd |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cloud VM'da ekran yo'q — serial console (<code>console=ttyS0</code>) log'ini yoq.</li><li><code>journalctl -b -1</code> uchun persistent journal kerak (<code>/var/log/journal</code> mavjud bo'lsin).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Boot muammosini tez tuzatish uchun oldindan tayyorgarlik: serial console, persistent journal, rescue image va root diskni boshqa VM'ga ulash runbook'i.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31243	<p>BIOS va UEFI farqi? MBR va GPT?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>BIOS</b> — eski firmware, diskning birinchi sektoridagi <b>MBR</b> (446 bayt boot kod) ni bajaradi; MBR jadvali 2 TiB va 4 primary partition bilan cheklangan. <b>UEFI</b> — zamonaviy firmware, <b>ESP</b> (FAT32 bo'lim)dagi <code>.efi</code> faylni ishga tushiradi, <b>GPT</b> jadvalini ishlatadi (128 partition, juda katta disk), <b>Secure Boot</b> bor.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 4 TB disk MBR bilan bo'lingan — 2 TB'dan keyingisi ko'rinmaydi. Yoki BIOS rejimida o'rnatilgan OS'ni UEFI serverga ko'chirding — boot bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>BIOS:  POST -&gt; disk sektor 0 (MBR) -&gt; 446 bayt kod -&gt; GRUB stage 1.5/2 -&gt; kernel<br>UEFI:  POST -&gt; NVRAM boot entry -&gt; ESP:/EFI/ubuntu/shimx64.efi -&gt; grubx64.efi -&gt; kernel</pre><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | BIOS + MBR | UEFI + GPT | |---|---|---| | Boot kodi | MBR 446 bayt | ESP'dagi <code>.efi</code> fayl | | Disk limit | 2 TiB | ~9.4 ZB | | Partition | 4 primary (yoki extended) | 128 default | | Zaxira jadval | yo'q | disk oxirida backup header | | Secure Boot | yo'q | bor | | Boot tartibi | firmware menyusi | NVRAM (<code>efibootmgr</code>) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>[ -d /sys/firmware/efi ] &amp;&amp; echo UEFI || echo BIOS<br>sudo efibootmgr -v                 # boot entry'lar<br>lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,FSTYPE,PARTTYPENAME,MOUNTPOINT<br>sudo fdisk -l /dev/sda | grep 'Disklabel type'   # gpt / dos<br>mount | grep /boot/efi             # ESP (vfat)</pre><p>GPT diskda BIOS boot qilish uchun 1 MiB &quot;BIOS boot partition&quot; kerak.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CSM (legacy) va UEFI aralash rejim — o'rnatish bir rejimda, boot boshqasida bo'ladi.</li><li>ESP to'lib qolsa (eski kernel/fayllar) — yangilash xatosi.</li><li><code>efibootmgr</code> entry'si o'chib ketsa — <code>grub-install</code> yoki fallback <code>EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi serverlar — faqat UEFI + GPT (Secure Boot va TPM measured boot uchun asos). Cloud image'larni ikkala rejim uchun (hybrid) qurish migratsiyani osonlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31244	<p>GRUB2 nima? Konfiguratsiyasi qayerda va qanday o'zgartiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GRUB2 — Linux'ning asosiy bootloader'i. Asosiy sozlama <b><code>/etc/default/grub</code></b>, generator skriptlar <b><code>/etc/grub.d/</code></b>, natija <b><code>grub.cfg</code></b> (<code>/boot/grub/</code> yoki <code>/boot/grub2/</code>) — u <b>generatsiya qilinadi</b>, qo'lda tahrirlanmaydi. O'zgarishdan keyin <code>update-grub</code> (Debian) yoki <code>grub2-mkconfig</code> (RHEL), RHEL'da kernel parametrlari uchun <code>grubby</code> ham bor.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>grub.cfg</code>ni qo'lda tahrirlading — keyingi kernel yangilanishida o'zgarish yo'qoldi. Yoki parametr qo'shding, lekin generatsiya qilmading — hech narsa o'zgarmadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/etc/default/grub  +  /etc/grub.d/10_linux, 30_os-prober, 40_custom<br>            \             /<br>        update-grub / grub2-mkconfig<br>                   v<br>           /boot/grub/grub.cfg   (GRUB boot'da o'qiydi)</pre><p><b>Muhim o'zgaruvchilar:</b> | Kalit | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>GRUB_DEFAULT</code> | qaysi entry default (<code>0</code>, <code>saved</code>, nom) | | <code>GRUB_TIMEOUT</code> | menyu kutish (s) | | <code>GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX</code> | barcha kernel'larga parametrlar | | <code>GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT</code> | faqat oddiy (recovery emas) entry |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudoedit /etc/default/grub<br># GRUB_TIMEOUT=5<br># GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=&quot;console=ttyS0,115200 console=tty0&quot;<br><br>sudo update-grub                                   # Debian/Ubuntu<br>sudo grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg        # RHEL (8/9, UEFI ham shu yo'l)<br><br># RHEL: BLS entry'lar bilan ishlash<br>sudo grubby --info=ALL | grep -E 'kernel|args'<br>sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=&quot;console=ttyS0&quot;<br>sudo grubby --set-default /boot/vmlinuz-5.14.0-427.el9.x86_64<br><br>cat /proc/cmdline    # reboot'dan keyin tekshirish</pre><p>Bir martalik boshqa kernel: <code>sudo grub-reboot 2</code> (yoki <code>grub2-reboot</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>RHEL 9'da UEFI'da ham <code>/boot/grub2/grub.cfg</code> — eski <code>/boot/efi/EFI/redhat/grub.cfg</code> yo'liga yozish boot'ni buzishi mumkin.</li><li><code>GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX</code> sintaksis xatosi (qo'shtirnoq) — barcha entry'lar buziladi.</li><li>RHEL BLS (<code>/boot/loader/entries/</code>) ishlatadi — <code>grub.cfg</code>da kernel ro'yxati ko'rinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kernel parametrlari fleet bo'yicha IaC orqali (Ansible <code>grubby</code> yoki image build'da) boshqarilsin; qo'lda o'zgarish — keyingi yangilanishda yo'qoladigan drift.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31245	<p>initramfs (initrd) nima va nega kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> initramfs — kernel bilan birga yuklanadigan kichik vaqtinchalik root FS (cpio arxiv). Unda haqiqiy root'ni topish uchun kerakli <b>drayverlar va vositalar</b> (storage modullari, LVM, mdadm, cryptsetup, udev) bor. U root'ni mount qiladi va <code>switch_root</code> bilan boshqaruvni haqiqiy <code>/sbin/init</code>ga beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo (tovuq-tuxum):</b> Kernel root FS'ni o'qish uchun NVMe/RAID/LVM drayveri kerak, lekin drayver modullari root FS ichida (<code>/lib/modules</code>). initramfs shu halqani uzadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GRUB -&gt; vmlinuz + initramfs.img RAM'ga<br>kernel -&gt; initramfs'ni / qilib ochadi -&gt; /init (systemd yoki dracut skript)<br>   -&gt; modullar (nvme, dm-mod, xfs), udev<br>   -&gt; LUKS: parol/TPM so'rash -&gt; LVM aktivlash<br>   -&gt; root=UUID=... ni /sysroot ga mount<br>   -&gt; switch_root /sysroot /sbin/init</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Qayta yaratish (yangi driver, LVM/LUKS o'zgarishi, fstab'dagi root o'zgarishi)<br>sudo update-initramfs -u -k all            # Debian/Ubuntu<br>sudo dracut -f --regenerate-all            # RHEL/Fedora<br><br># Ichini ko'rish<br>lsinitramfs /boot/initrd.img-$(uname -r) | grep -E 'nvme|lvm'   # Debian<br>sudo lsinitrd /boot/initramfs-$(uname -r).img | grep lvm        # RHEL<br><br># Qo'shimcha modul qo'shish (RHEL)<br>echo 'add_drivers+=&quot; virtio_scsi &quot;' | sudo tee /etc/dracut.conf.d/virtio.conf<br>sudo dracut -f</pre><p><b>Debug:</b> cmdline'ga <code>rd.break</code> (dracut, root mount'dan oldin to'xtash), <code>rd.debug</code>, <code>rd.shell</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Root'ni LVM yoki boshqa controller'ga ko'chirib (P2V, V2V migratsiya) initramfs'ni yangilamaslik -&gt; <code>dracut-initqueue timeout</code>, emergency shell.</li><li>RHEL <code>dracut</code> default &quot;host-only&quot; — faqat joriy hardware drayverlari; boshqa VM turiga ko'chirishdan oldin <code>dracut -f -N</code> (generic).</li><li><code>/boot</code> to'la -&gt; initramfs yozilmay qoladi, keyingi boot sinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Image build pipeline'da initramfs'ni maqsadli platforma (virtio, NVMe, ENA) uchun tekshir; migratsiya runbook'ida &quot;initramfs qayta yaratish&quot; — majburiy qadam.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31246	<p>Kernel command line nima? Foydali parametrlar.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kernel command line — bootloader kernel'ga beradigan parametrlar qatori (<code>/proc/cmdline</code>). U root qurilmasini, konsolni, systemd target'ni, xavfsizlik va cgroup sozlamalarini belgilaydi. Bir martalik o'zgartirish — GRUB menyusida <code>e</code>; doimiy — <code>GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX</code> yoki <code>grubby</code>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Boot muammosini tuzatish (rescue rejim), cloud'da serial console, cgroup v2 yoqish — hammasi cmdline orqali.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/cmdline<br># BOOT_IMAGE=/vmlinuz-6.8.0-45-generic root=UUID=3f1a... ro quiet splash</pre><p><b>Foydali parametrlar:</b> | Parametr | Vazifa | |---|---| | <code>root=UUID=...</code>, <code>ro</code>/<code>rw</code> | root FS va mount rejimi | | <code>systemd.unit=rescue.target</code> | rescue rejim | | <code>systemd.unit=emergency.target</code> | minimal, fstab ishlanmaydi | | <code>rd.break</code> | initramfs'da to'xtash (RHEL parol tiklash) | | <code>init=/bin/bash</code> | systemd'siz shell (favqulodda) | | <code>console=ttyS0,115200 console=tty0</code> | serial + ekran konsol (oxirgisi asosiy) | | <code>systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=1</code> | cgroup v2 (yangi distrolarda default) | | <code>nomodeset</code> | grafik drayver muammosi | | <code>crashkernel=256M</code> | kdump uchun xotira | | <code>mitigations=off</code> | Spectre/Meltdown himoyasini o'chirish — faqat izolyatsiyalangan benchmark |</p><p><b>Bir martalik (GRUB menyu):</b></p><pre>menyu -&gt; entry ustida &quot;e&quot; -&gt; &quot;linux ...&quot; qatori oxiriga parametr -&gt; Ctrl+X</pre><p><b>Doimiy:</b></p><pre>sudoedit /etc/default/grub   # GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=&quot;... crashkernel=256M&quot;<br>sudo update-grub             # yoki grub2-mkconfig<br>sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=&quot;crashkernel=256M&quot;   # RHEL<br>sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --remove-args=&quot;quiet&quot;</pre><p>Reboot, keyin <code>cat /proc/cmdline</code> bilan tasdiqla.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>init=/bin/bash</code> — root <code>ro</code>, systemd yo'q; <code>reboot</code> ishlamaydi (<code>echo b &gt; /proc/sysrq-trigger</code> yoki <code>exec /sbin/init</code>).</li><li>Noto'g'ri <code>root=</code> — kernel panic: &quot;VFS: Unable to mount root fs&quot;.</li><li><code>mitigations=off</code> productionda — xavfsizlik teshigi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Fleet bo'yicha cmdline bir xilligini tekshir (<code>/proc/cmdline</code> ni inventory'ga yig'), chunki cgroup versiyasi yoki mitigations farqi g'alati, node'ga xos xatolar beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31247	<p>Runlevel nima? 0–6 qiymatlari.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Runlevel — SysV init davridagi tizim holati raqami (0-6): 0 o'chirish, 1 single-user (rescue), 2-4 multi-user variantlari, 5 grafik, 6 reboot. systemd'da ular <b>target</b>'lar bilan almashtirilgan, lekin moslik uchun <code>runlevelN.target</code> alias'lari va <code>runlevel</code> buyrug'i hali bor.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> Eski hujjatlar, runbook'lar va intervyular runlevel tilida gapiradi (&quot;server 3-runlevel'da&quot;). systemd ekvivalentini bilish kerak.</p><p><b>Jadval:</b> | Runlevel | Ma'nosi | systemd target | |---|---|---| | 0 | o'chirish | <code>poweroff.target</code> | | 1 (S) | single-user, rescue, network yo'q | <code>rescue.target</code> | | 2 | multi-user, NFS'siz (Debian'da = 3-5 bir xil) | <code>multi-user.target</code> | | 3 | multi-user + network, matn rejimi | <code>multi-user.target</code> | | 4 | belgilanmagan (custom) | <code>multi-user.target</code> | | 5 | 3 + grafik login | <code>graphical.target</code> | | 6 | reboot | <code>reboot.target</code> |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>runlevel            # N 5   (oldingi=N yo'q, joriy=5)<br>who -r              # run-level 5  2026-10-03 09:12<br>systemctl get-default          # graphical.target<br>ls -l /usr/lib/systemd/system/runlevel3.target<br># runlevel3.target -&gt; multi-user.target</pre><p>Eski uslubda o'tish (hali ishlaydi):</p><pre>sudo init 3         # = systemctl isolate multi-user.target<br>sudo telinit 6      # reboot</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Debian'da tarixan 2-5 bir xil edi — &quot;runlevel 2 = network yo'q&quot; runlevel — faqat tarixiy tushuncha va moslik qatlami.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31248	<p>SysV init va systemd farqi? Runlevel'lar systemd'da qanday ifodalangan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>SysV init</b> — <code>/etc/inittab</code> va <code>/etc/rcN.d/</code> dagi <code>S##</code>/<code>K##</code> skriptlarni <b>ketma-ket</b>, raqam tartibida ishga tushiradi; bog'liqlik qo'lda. <b>systemd</b> — unit'lar (<code>.service</code>, <code>.socket</code>, <code>.mount</code>, <code>.target</code>) va <code>Requires=</code>/<code>Wants=</code>/<code>After=</code> bilan <b>dependency graph</b>, parallel start, har servis o'z cgroup'ida. Runlevel'lar systemd'da <code>runlevelN.target</code> -&gt; <code>multi-user.target</code> kabi symlink'lar.</p><p><b>Muammo (SysV):</b> Servis A, B'dan keyin kerak — skript nomini <code>S20</code> va <code>S30</code> qilib qo'yasan. Servis fork qilib ketsa, PID fayl noto'g'ri — <code>stop</code> ishlamaydi, zombie qoladi. Boot sekin, chunki hammasi navbat bilan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SysV:     S10network -&gt; S20syslog -&gt; S50db -&gt; S80app   (ketma-ket)<br><br>systemd:  network-online.target<br>             /          \<br>        postgresql   redis        (parallel)<br>             \          /<br>              app.service (After= + Requires=)</pre><p>| | SysV | systemd | |---|---|---| | Konfiguratsiya | shell skript | deklarativ unit fayl | | Tartib | raqam | <code>After=/Before=</code> | | Bog'liqlik | yo'q | <code>Requires=/Wants=/BindsTo=</code> | | Start | ketma-ket | parallel, socket activation | | Jarayon kuzatuvi | PID fayl | cgroup (hamma bolalar) | | Restart | qo'lda / monit | <code>Restart=on-failure</code> | | Log | fayllar | journald |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls /etc/rc3.d/                    # SysV: S20nginx -&gt; ../init.d/nginx<br>systemctl list-dependencies multi-user.target<br>systemctl cat nginx               # unit fayl<br>systemd-cgls                      # cgroup daraxti<br>ls -l /usr/lib/systemd/system/runlevel*.target</pre><p>Moslik: <code>service nginx restart</code> -&gt; <code>systemctl restart nginx</code> ga yo'naltiriladi; <code>/etc/init.d</code> skriptlari <code>systemd-sysv-generator</code> orqali unit'ga aylantiriladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>After=</code> bog'liqlik emas (faqat tartib); <code>Requires=</code> esa tartib bermaydi — odatda ikkalasi birga.</li><li><code>network.target</code> != tarmoq tayyor; kerak bo'lsa <code>network-online.target</code> + <code>Wants=</code>.</li><li>Eski init skriptini systemd'ga ko'chirganda <code>Type=forking</code> va <code>PIDFile=</code> ni to'g'ri qo'yish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> systemd'ning asosiy yutug'i — cgroup orqali jarayon hayot sikli va resurs nazorati (<code>MemoryMax=</code>, <code>CPUQuota=</code>), bu konteynerlardan oldingi &quot;mini-orchestrator&quot;.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31249	<p>Default target'ni qanday ko'rasan va o'zgartirasan? Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31250	<p>rescue.target va emergency.target farqi? Qachon qaysi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>rescue.target</b> (eski runlevel 1) — <code>sysinit.target</code> bajariladi: fstab'dagi FS'lar mount, swap yoqiladi, lekin network va servislar yo'q; servis/config tuzatish uchun. <b>emergency.target</b> — eng minimal: faqat root FS (<code>ro</code>), fstab ishlanmagan; buzilgan <code>fstab</code> yoki fsck muammosi uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> fstab'da noto'g'ri UUID -&gt; rescue ham yiqiladi, chunki u fstab'ni mount qilishga urinadi. Shunda faqat emergency kirish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>emergency.target:  kernel -&gt; root (ro) -&gt; shell        (hech narsa mount emas)<br>rescue.target:     kernel -&gt; sysinit (fstab, swap, udev) -&gt; shell<br>multi-user.target: ... -&gt; basic -&gt; network -&gt; servislar</pre><p>| | emergency | rescue | |---|---|---| | Root FS | <code>ro</code> | <code>rw</code> | | Boshqa fstab FS | yo'q | mount | | udev, swap | minimal / yo'q | bor | | Network | yo'q | yo'q | | Qachon | fstab, fsck, root FS muammo | buzilgan servis, config |</p><p><b>Amalda (fstab tuzatish):</b></p><pre>GRUB -&gt; e -&gt; &quot;linux&quot; qatori oxiriga: systemd.unit=emergency.target -&gt; Ctrl+X</pre><pre>mount -o remount,rw /<br>vi /etc/fstab                # xato qatorni tuzat yoki &quot;nofail&quot; qo'sh<br>findmnt --verify             # fstab'ni tekshir<br>systemctl daemon-reload<br>mount -a                     # sinab ko'r<br>exit                         # boot davom etadi (yoki reboot)</pre><p>Ishlayotgan tizimdan: <code>systemctl rescue</code>, <code>systemctl emergency</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Root paroli qulflangan (RHEL/Ubuntu default) — rescue/emergency kirmaydi: &quot;Cannot open access to console, the root account is locked&quot;. Unda <code>rd.break</code> yoki <code>init=/bin/bash</code>.</li><li>emergency'da <code>/usr</code> alohida bo'lsa — buyruqlar yo'q.</li><li><code>exit</code> qilishdan oldin <code>daemon-reload</code>ni unutish — eski fstab ishlatiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>findmnt --verify</code> ni fstab o'zgartiradigan har qanday avtomatlashtirishga qo'sh — emergency mode'ga tushishning eng ko'p sababi fstab xatosi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31251	<p>Root parolni unutding yoki fstab xatosi tufayli server boot bo'lmayapti. Qanday tiklaysan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GRUB'da kernel qatoriga <b><code>rd.break</code></b> (RHEL) yoki <b><code>init=/bin/bash</code></b> qo'shib boot qil, root'ni <code>rw</code> qilib remount, kerak bo'lsa <code>chroot</code>, keyin <code>passwd root</code> yoki <code>/etc/fstab</code>ni tuzat; SELinux tizimida <code>touch /.autorelabel</code>. Himoya: GRUB paroli, Secure Boot, disk shifrlash (LUKS + TPM), konsol kirishini audit qilish. Va har bir fstab o'zgarishi <code>nofail</code> + <code>findmnt --verify</code> bilan.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels
Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31252	<p>Secure Boot nima va boot zanjiri qanday tekshiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secure Boot — UEFI imkoniyati: firmware faqat ishonchli kalit bilan <b>imzolangan</b> bootloader'ni ishga tushiradi, har bosqich keyingisini tekshiradi. Linux'da zanjir: UEFI db (Microsoft CA) -&gt; <b>shim</b> -&gt; <b>GRUB</b> -&gt; <b>kernel</b> -&gt; <b>kernel modullar</b>. Imzosiz bo'g'in yuklanmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bootkit/rootkit bootloader yoki kernel'ni almashtirsa, OS ichidagi antivirus uni ko'rmaydi — u OS'dan oldin ishga tushadi. Secure Boot zanjirni boot boshidanoq himoya qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>UEFI firmware (db: Microsoft UEFI CA, dbx: bekor qilingan imzolar)<br>   v tekshiradi<br>shimx64.efi  (Microsoft imzolagan, ichida distro kaliti)<br>   v tekshiradi (distro kaliti yoki MOK)<br>grubx64.efi<br>   v tekshiradi<br>vmlinuz  (distro imzosi)<br>   v kernel lockdown + module signature tekshiruvi<br>nvidia.ko, zfs.ko ... (imzosiz -&gt; rad)</pre><p><b>MOK</b> (Machine Owner Key) — admin o'z kalitini qo'shadi (<code>mokutil</code>).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>mokutil --sb-state                     # SecureBoot enabled<br>cat /sys/kernel/security/lockdown      # none [integrity] confidentiality<br>dmesg | grep -i 'secure boot'<br><br># DKMS/custom modulni imzolash<br>sudo mokutil --import /var/lib/dkms/mok.pub   # reboot'da MOK Manager'da tasdiqlash<br>/usr/src/linux-headers-$(uname -r)/scripts/sign-file sha256 MOK.priv MOK.der mymod.ko<br>modinfo mymod.ko | grep signer</pre><p><b>Measured boot (kengaytma):</b> har bosqich xeshi <b>TPM PCR</b>'ga yoziladi; LUKS kalitini PCR'ga bog'lash mumkin:</p><pre>sudo systemd-cryptenroll --tpm2-device=auto --tpm2-pcrs=7 /dev/nvme0n1p3</pre><p>Zanjir o'zgarsa — disk avtomatik ochilmaydi. Remote attestation bilan server &quot;toza&quot; boot bo'lganini isbotlaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NVIDIA/ZFS DKMS modullari — imzolanmasa &quot;Key was rejected by service&quot;.</li><li>Lockdown rejimi <code>/dev/mem</code>, imzosiz kexec, ba'zi eBPF/debug vositalarini cheklaydi.</li><li>dbx yangilanishi (BootHole kabi) eski shim'ni bloklab, boot'ni sindirishi mumkin — avval shim yangilansin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Secure Boot — faqat &quot;boot kod imzolangan&quot; kafolati, runtime xavfsizlik emas. Kuchli model: Secure Boot + measured boot (TPM) + attestation + disk shifrlash; MOK kalitlarini boshqarish esa alohida kalit-boshqaruv jarayoni.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v8 Boot_runlevels

Interview Drill::Linux::V8 Boot loaders & runlevels	idrill-31254	<p>systemd target'lar va <code>WantedBy=multi-user.target</code> nima? <code>systemctl enable</code> aslida nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Target — unit'larni guruhlaydigan sinxronizatsiya nuqtasi (eski runlevel o'rnida). <code>[Install]</code> dagi <code>WantedBy=multi-user.target</code> — &quot;multi-user.target ishga tushganda meni ham ishga tushir&quot;. <code>systemctl enable</code> aslida faqat <b>symlink yaratadi</b>: <code>/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/nginx.service</code>. Hozir ishga tushirmaydi — buning uchun <code>start</code> yoki <code>enable --now</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>systemctl start myapp</code> qilding, reboot'dan keyin servis ishlamayapti — <code>enable</code> qilinmagan. Yoki <code>enable</code> qilding, lekin <code>[Install]</code> bo'limi yo'q — &quot;The unit files have no installation config&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>multi-user.target<br>   |-- .wants/ (katalog)<br>   |      nginx.service  -&gt; /usr/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service  (symlink)<br>   |      sshd.service   -&gt; ...<br>boot: multi-user.target faollashadi -&gt; .wants ichidagi hamma unit start</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>systemctl cat nginx | sed -n '/\[Install\]/,$p'<br># [Install]<br># WantedBy=multi-user.target<br><br>sudo systemctl enable nginx<br># Created symlink /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/nginx.service -&gt; /usr/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service<br>sudo systemctl enable --now nginx    # enable + start<br>systemctl is-enabled nginx           # enabled / disabled / masked / static<br>systemctl is-active nginx<br>sudo systemctl disable nginx         # symlink o'chadi<br>sudo systemctl mask nginx            # -&gt; /dev/null, umuman start bo'lmaydi<br>sudo systemctl unmask nginx</pre><p><b>Atamalar:</b> | Buyruq/kalit | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>start</code> | hozir ishga tushir (boot'da emas) | | <code>enable</code> | boot'da ishga tushir (hozir emas) | | <code>mask</code> | hech qachon (qo'lda ham) | | <code>static</code> | <code>[Install]</code> yo'q, boshqa unit tortadi | | <code>Wants=</code> | yumshoq bog'liqlik (u yiqilsa ham davom) | | <code>Requires=</code> | qattiq bog'liqlik | | <code>After=</code> | faqat tartib, bog'liqlik emas |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Unit faylni o'zgartirib <code>daemon-reload</code> qilmaslik — eski versiya ishlaydi.</li><li><code>WantedBy=</code> o'zgarsa, <code>disable</code> + <code>enable</code> qayta qilish kerak (symlink eski joyda qoladi).</li><li><code>/usr/lib/systemd/system</code> dagi faylni tahrirlash — paket yangilanishida yo'qoladi; <code>systemctl edit</code> (drop-in) ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> O'z servislaringda <code>Restart=on-failure</code>, <code>After=/Wants=network-online.target</code>, resurs limitlari va <code>enable --now</code>ni IaC'da (Ansible <code>systemd</code> moduli) bir joyda boshqar — &quot;enabled lekin active emas&quot; Interview Drill::Linux::V14 systemd, services & cron	idrill-31286	<p><code>systemctl start</code> va <code>systemctl enable</code> farqi? <code>--now</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>start</code> — servisni <b>hozir</b> ishga tushiradi, lekin reboot'dan keyin o'zi chiqmaydi. <code>enable</code> — servisni <b>boot'da</b> avtomatik ishga tushadigan qiladi, lekin hozir ishga tushirmaydi. <code>enable --now</code> — ikkalasini birdan qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ko'p junior'lar <code>systemctl start nginx</code> qiladi, hammasi ishlaydi — keyin server reboot bo'ladi va sayt ochilmaydi, chunki servis enable qilinmagan edi.</p><p>| Buyruq | Hozir | Reboot'dan keyin | |---|---|---| | <code>start</code> | ishlaydi | yo'q | | <code>enable</code> | o'zgarmaydi | ishga tushadi | | <code>enable --now</code> | ishlaydi | ishga tushadi | | <code>stop</code> | to'xtaydi | enable bo'lsa yana chiqadi | | <code>disable --now</code> | to'xtaydi | chiqmaydi | | <code>mask</code> | start qilib bo'lmaydi | chiqmaydi |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[Install]<br>WantedBy=multi-user.target<br>   v  systemctl enable nginx<br>/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/nginx.service -&gt; Interview Drill::Linux::V14 systemd, services & cron	idrill-31287	<p><code>restart</code> va <code>reload</code> farqi? <code>reload-or-restart</code> qachon?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>restart</code> = stop + start: jarayon o'ladi va yangisi chiqadi (PID o'zgaradi, aktiv ulanishlar uziladi). <code>reload</code> = unit'dagi <code>ExecReload=</code> ni bajaradi — odatda servisga signal (SIGHUP) yuborib, config'ni <b>to'xtamasdan</b> qayta o'qitadi. <code>reload-or-restart</code> — reload qo'llab-quvvatlansa reload, aks holda restart.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (nginx misolida):</b></p><pre>restart:  master PID 100 o'ladi -&gt; downtime yo'q, PID 100 o'zgarmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo nginx -t &amp;&amp; sudo systemctl reload nginx     # AVVAL sintaksis tekshiruvi<br>systemctl show nginx -p ExecReload               # reload nima qiladi<br>sudo systemctl reload-or-restart myapp<br>sudo systemctl try-restart myapp                 # faqat ishlab turgan bo'lsa<br>systemctl show nginx -p MainPID                  # reload'dan keyin o'zgarmagan</pre><p>Unit'da reload'ni qo'llash:</p><pre>[Service]<br>ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Xato config bilan <code>restart</code> — servis umuman ko'tarilmaydi (downtime). <code>reload</code> da nginx xato config'ni rad etib eskisi bilan ishlashda davom etadi — lekin buni ham <code>-t</code> bilan tekshirish kerak.</li><li>Hamma servis reload'ni qo'llamaydi — <code>ExecReload</code> yo'q bo'lsa xato beradi.</li><li><code>systemctl reload app</code> va <code>systemctl daemon-reload</code> — butunlay boshqa narsalar (biri ilova config'i, biri unit fayllar).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Config o'zgarishi pipeline'ida: validate (<code>nginx -t</code>, <code>haproxy -c</code>, <code>sshd -t</code>) -&gt; Interview Drill::Linux::V14 systemd, services & cron	idrill-31292	<p><code>Restart=</code> qiymatlari va <code>StartLimitBurst</code>/<code>StartLimitIntervalSec</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>Restart=</code> — servis to'xtaganda systemd uni qachon qayta ishga tushirishini belgilaydi (<code>no</code>, <code>on-failure</code>, <code>on-abnormal</code>, <code>always</code> va h.k.). <code>StartLimitIntervalSec</code> + <code>StartLimitBurst</code> — crash-loop himoyasi: belgilangan vaqtda N martadan ko'p start bo'lsa systemd taslim bo'ladi va unit <code>failed</code> holatga o'tadi.</p><p>| Qiymat | Exit != 0 | Signal/timeout/watchdog | Exit 0 | |---|---|---|---| | <code>no</code> (default) | - | - | - | | <code>on-failure</code> | ha | ha | - | | <code>on-abnormal</code> | - | ha | - | | <code>always</code> | ha | ha | ha |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>crash -&gt; RestartSec (2s) -&gt; start -&gt; crash -&gt; ...<br>   60s ichida 5 start? Interview Drill::Linux::V14 systemd, services & cron	idrill-31293	<p><code>Wants</code>, <code>Requires</code>, <code>After</code>, <code>Before</code>, <code>BindsTo</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikki xil savolni ajrating: <b>nima</b> birga ishga tushadi (<code>Wants</code>, <code>Requires</code>, <code>BindsTo</code>, <code>PartOf</code>) va <b>qaysi tartibda</b> (<code>After</code>, <code>Before</code>). Ular mustaqil — <code>Requires=</code> tartib bermaydi, <code>After=</code> esa bog'liqlik yaratmaydi.</p><p>| Direktiva | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>Wants=X</code> | X ni ham ishga tushir; X yiqilsa men davom etaman (yumshoq) | | <code>Requires=X</code> | X ishga tushmasa yoki stop qilinsa — men ham to'xtayman | | <code>BindsTo=X</code> | Requires'dan kuchli: X yo'qolsa (device uzildi) darhol to'xtayman | | <code>PartOf=X</code> | X restart/stop bo'lsa men ham (bir tomonlama) | | <code>Conflicts=X</code> | birga ishlay olmaydi | | <code>After=X</code> | X ishga tushib bo'lgach meni boshla | | <code>Before=X</code> | mendan keyin X |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Requires=postgresql.service   (After yo'q)<br>   -&gt; app va postgres PARALLEL start -&gt; app DB'ga ulana olmaydi -&gt; crash<br><br>Requires=postgresql.service<br>After=postgresql.service<br>   -&gt; postgres &quot;started&quot; -&gt; keyin app</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>[Unit]<br>Wants=network-online.target<br>After=network-online.target<br>Requires=postgresql.service<br>After=postgresql.service</pre><pre>systemctl list-dependencies app<br>systemctl list-dependencies --reverse postgresql<br>systemd-analyze critical-chain app.service<br>systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/app.service</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Requires=</code> bor, <code>After=</code> yo'q — klassik xato, ikkalasi parallel.</li><li><code>After=network.target</code> tarmoq &quot;tayyor&quot; ekanini anglatmaydi — <code>network-online.target</code> + <code>Wants=</code> kerak.</li><li>&quot;started&quot; — <code>Type=</code> ga bog'liq: <code>simple</code> darhol &quot;started&quot; hisoblanadi, DB hali ulanishga tayyor bo'lmasligi mumkin; <code>Type=notify</code> aniqroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> systemd tartibi faqat startup'ni hal qiladi; tarmoq bog'liqliklari runtime'da ham uziladi. Interview Drill::Linux::V14 systemd, services & cron	idrill-31301	<p>Graceful shutdown: <code>systemctl stop</code> paytida nima sodir bo'ladi?</p>	<p>Ketma-ketlik:</p><ol><li><code>ExecStop=</code> (bo'lsa).</li><li><code>KillSignal=</code> (default SIGTERM) — <code>KillMode=control-group</code> (default) bo'yicha cgroup'dagi <b>hamma</b> jarayonga.</li><li><code>TimeoutStopSec=</code> (default 90s) kutadi.</li><li>Hali tirik bo'lsa — <code>SIGKILL</code> (<code>FinalKillSignal</code>).</li></ol><p><code>KillMode</code>: <code>control-group</code> | <code>mixed</code> (SIGTERM faqat main, SIGKILL hammaga) | <code>process</code> (faqat main — child'lar yetim qoladi, xavfli) | <code>none</code>.</p><p>Ilova tomoni (Go): SIGTERM ushla -&gt; yangi so'rov qabul qilmaslik -&gt; in-flight tugat -&gt; DB/Kafka yop:</p><pre>ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM, os.Interrupt)<br>defer stop()<br>&lt;-ctx.Done()<br>shCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 25*time.Second)<br>defer cancel()<br>srv.Shutdown(shCtx)</pre><p>Qoida: ilova shutdown vaqti &lt; <code>TimeoutStopSec</code> (K8s'da &lt; <code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code>).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v14 systemd_services

Diskda hech narsa yo'q: faylni o'qiganingizda kernel ma'lumotni shu zahoti generatsiya qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kernel ichidagi holatni (jarayonlar, xotira, CPU, tarmoq) oddiy <code>cat</code> bilan o'qish imkonini beradi. <code>ps</code>, <code>top</code>, <code>free</code>, <code>uptime</code> aynan shu fayllarni o'qiydi.</p><p><b>Tuzilishi:</b></p><pre>/proc<br> +-- 1234/          har jarayon uchun papka (PID)<br> |    +-- cmdline   qanday buyruq bilan ishga tushgan<br> |    +-- status    holat, xotira, UID<br> |    +-- fd/       ochiq fayllar (symlink)<br> |    +-- limits    ulimit qiymatlari<br> |    +-- environ   environment (faqat egasi/root o'qiy oladi)<br> +-- meminfo        xotira<br> +-- cpuinfo        CPU<br> +-- loadavg        yuklama<br> +-- sys/           kernel parametrlari (sysctl)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/meminfo | head -5         # MemTotal, MemAvailable<br>cat /proc/loadavg                   # 0.52 0.40 0.31 2/350 12345<br>tr '\0' ' ' &lt; /proc/1234/cmdline     # argumentlar NUL bilan ajratilgan<br>ls -l /proc/1234/fd | wc -l         # nechta FD ochiq<br>cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward   # 0 yoki 1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>du -sh /proc</code> yoki backup'ga <code>/proc</code> ni qo'shish — ma'nosiz va xavfli (<code>kcore</code> ulkan ko'rinadi).</li><li><code>/proc/sys</code> ga <code>echo</code> bilan yozilgan qiymat reboot'da yo'qoladi — doimiy uchun <code>/etc/sysctl.d/*.conf</code>.</li><li><code>environ</code> da secret'lar ko'rinadi — shuning uchun env orqali parol berish ehtiyotkorlik talab qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konteynerda <code>/proc/meminfo</code> host xotirasini ko'rsatadi (LXCFS bo'lmasa) — limitni <code>/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max</code> dan o'qing. Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30663	<p>Linux kernel nima va user space'dan farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Kernel</b> — hardware bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlaydigan, jarayon, xotira, fayl tizimi va tarmoqni boshqaradigan dastur; CPU'ning imtiyozli rejimida (ring 0) ishlaydi. <b>User space</b> — oddiy ilovalar cheklangan rejimda (ring 3) ishlaydi va kernelga faqat <b>system call</b> orqali murojaat qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega bo'lingan:</b> Agar har dastur diskka yoki boshqa jarayon xotirasiga bevosita yoza olsa, bitta bug butun tizimni buzardi. Ajratish izolyatsiya va xavfsizlik beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>+-----------------------------+<br>| User space (ring 3)         |  bash, nginx, python<br>|   libc (printf, fopen)      |<br>+-------------+---------------+<br>              | syscall (open, read, write)<br>              v<br>+-----------------------------+<br>| Kernel space (ring 0)       |  scheduler, MM, VFS, TCP/IP, drayverlar<br>+-------------+---------------+<br>              v<br>          Hardware (CPU, RAM, disk, NIC)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>uname -r                 # kernel versiyasi: 6.8.0-45-generic<br>strace -c ls &gt; /dev/null # ls qaysi syscall'larni chaqirdi<br>dmesg -T | tail          # kernel xabarlari</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Linux&quot; so'zi aslida faqat kernelni bildiradi; Ubuntu, RHEL — distributiv (kernel + GNU tool'lar + paket menejeri).</li><li>Ilova xatosi faqat o'zini yiqitadi (segfault), kernel xatosi — butun tizimni (kernel panic).</li><li>Konteynerlar alohida kernel emas — hammasi host kernelini bo'lishadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konteyner = umumiy kernel, shuning uchun kernel zaifligi barcha konteynerlarga tegadi; kuchli izolyatsiya kerak bo'lsa gVisor yoki Kata/Firecracker (microVM) ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes

Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-31336	<p>Signal'lar: SIGTERM, SIGKILL, SIGHUP, SIGINT, SIGSTOP farqi? <code>kill</code>, <code>pkill</code>, <code>killall</code>.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Signal — kernel jarayonga yuboradigan asinxron xabar. <b>SIGTERM (15)</b> — &quot;iltimos, tugat&quot; (ushlanadi), <b>SIGKILL (9)</b> — majburiy o'lim (ushlanmaydi), <b>SIGHUP (1)</b> — terminal uzildi / config qayta o'qish, <b>SIGINT (2)</b> — Ctrl+C, <b>SIGSTOP (19)</b> — muzlatish (ushlanmaydi, <code>SIGCONT</code> bilan davom).</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> To'g'ri signal tanlash = ma'lumot yo'qotmaslik. SIGKILL cleanup'ga imkon bermaydi: lock fayl, temp fayl, yozilmagan log, yarim tranzaksiya qoladi.</p><p>| Signal | Raqam | Ushlanadimi | Odatiy ishlatilish | |---|---|---|---| | SIGHUP | 1 | Ha | nginx/sshd config reload | | SIGINT | 2 | Ha | Ctrl+C | | SIGKILL | 9 | Yo'q | oxirgi chora | | SIGTERM | 15 | Ha | graceful stop (default) | | SIGSTOP | 19 | Yo'q | pauza |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kill 1234                 # SIGTERM<br>kill -HUP $(pidof nginx)  # reload<br>pgrep -a -f &quot;worker.py&quot;   # AVVAL kimga tegishini ko'r<br>pkill -f &quot;worker.py&quot;      # buyruq qatori bo'yicha<br>killall nginx             # nom bo'yicha<br>kill -0 1234 &amp;&amp; echo tirik  # signal yubormaydi, mavjudlikni tekshiradi<br>kill -l                   # ro'yxat</pre><p>Exit kodi <code>128+N</code>: <code>137</code> = SIGKILL (ko'pincha OOM killer), <code>143</code> = SIGTERM, <code>130</code> = Ctrl+C.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>pkill -f java</code> kutilmagan jarayonlarni ham o'ldiradi — doim avval <code>pgrep -a</code>.</li><li>Solaris'da <code>killall</code> hamma jarayonni o'ldiradi — boshqa Unix'da ehtiyot bo'ling.</li><li><code>D</code> holatidagi (disk kutayotgan) jarayonga SIGKILL ham ta'sir qilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avtomatlashtirishda pattern: SIGTERM -&gt; timeout (masalan 30s) -&gt; SIGKILL. systemd (<code>TimeoutStopSec</code>) va Kubernetes (<code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code>) aynan shunday qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes

Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30561	<p>Zombie jarayon nima va uni qanday yo'qotasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Zombie</b> — tugagan, lekin ota-jarayon <code>wait()</code> bilan exit statusini hali olmagan jarayon. U xotira yoki CPU yemaydi, faqat process table'da PID'ni band qiladi. Zombie'ni o'ldirib bo'lmaydi (u allaqachon o'lik) — ota-jarayonni tuzatish yoki o'ldirish kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ota dastur bug tufayli <code>wait()</code> qilmasa zombie'lar yig'iladi; minglab bo'lsa <code>pid_max</code> yoki cgroup <code>pids.max</code> tugaydi va yangi jarayon yaratib bo'lmaydi (&quot;fork: Resource temporarily unavailable&quot;).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>parent --fork--&gt; child<br>child exit(0) -&gt; Z holat (exit kodini saqlaydi)<br>parent wait() -&gt; kernel yozuvni o'chiradi -&gt; zombie yo'q<br>parent o'lsa  -&gt; child PID 1 ga &quot;asrab olinadi&quot; -&gt; PID 1 wait() qiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,cmd | awk '$3 ~ /Z/'     # zombie'lar va ota PID<br>ps -o pid,cmd -p &lt;PPID&gt;                       # ota kim<br>kill -s SIGCHLD &lt;PPID&gt;                        # otaga &quot;wait qil&quot; eslatmasi<br>kill &lt;PPID&gt;                                   # oxirgi chora: ota o'lsa, init tozalaydi</pre><p>Konteyner:</p><pre>docker run --init myimage      # tini PID 1 bo'ladi va zombie'larni yig'adi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>kill -9 &lt;zombie_pid&gt;</code> — hech narsa bermaydi.</li><li>Konteynerda PID 1 bo'lgan ilova (masalan Node, shell skript) bola jarayonlarni <code>wait()</code> qilmaydi — tini/dumb-init kerak.</li><li>Orphan (otasi o'lgan, o'zi tirik) bilan zombie'ni adashtirmang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bir nechta zombie — muammo emas; o'sib boruvchi son — ota dasturda bug. <code>pids.max</code> limit qo'yish cheksiz yig'ilishni host darajasida to'xtatadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes
Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30562	<p><code>ps aux</code> dagi STAT ustunidagi <code>D</code> holati nimani bildiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>D</code> — <b>uninterruptible sleep</b>: jarayon kernel ichida I/O (odatda disk yoki NFS) tugashini kutyapti va bu vaqtda signal qabul qilmaydi — hatto SIGKILL ham.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>load average</code> 40, lekin CPU 95% bo'sh. Sabab: Linux load'ga <code>D</code> holatidagi jarayonlarni ham qo'shadi. Odatda disk sekinlashgan yoki NFS server javob bermayapti.</p><p><b>STAT harflari:</b> | Harf | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | R | ishlayapti / navbatda | | S | interruptible sleep (signal kutadi) | | D | uninterruptible sleep (I/O) | | T | to'xtatilgan (Ctrl+Z, SIGSTOP) | | Z | zombie | | <code>&lt;</code>, <code>N</code>, <code>s</code>, <code>+</code> | yuqori prioritet, past, session leader, foreground |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ps -eo pid,stat,wchan:30,cmd | awk '$2 ~ /D/'   # wchan: kernelda qayerda kutyapti<br>cat /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/stack                            # kernel stack (root)<br>iostat -x 1                                      # %util, await yuqorimi<br>vmstat 1                                         # 'b' ustuni = D jarayonlar soni<br>dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'nfs|blocked for more than'</pre><p><code>wchan</code> da <code>nfs_*</code> yoki <code>io_schedule</code> — sabab topildi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>kill -9</code> yordam bermaydi — I/O manbasini tuzating (disk, NFS, iSCSI).</li><li>NFS <code>hard</code> mount'da server o'lsa jarayonlar abadiy D'da qoladi; <code>soft</code>/<code>timeo</code> trade-off'ini biling.</li><li>Qisqa D holati normal — muammo faqat uzoq qolganda.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>hung_task_timeout_secs</code> (default 120s) kernel log'iga &quot;blocked for more than 120 seconds&quot; yozadi — buni alertga ulang. Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30563	<p><code>fork()</code> va <code>exec()</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>fork()</code> — joriy jarayonning nusxasini (yangi PID bilan) yaratadi; xotira <b>copy-on-write</b> bilan bo'lishiladi, shuning uchun arzon. <code>exec()</code> — joriy jarayonning xotirasini yangi dastur bilan almashtiradi; PID o'zgarmaydi. Shell har buyruqni <b>fork + exec</b> bilan ishga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Nega ikkiga bo'lingan:</b> fork va exec orasida bola jarayon o'z muhitini sozlay oladi: stdout'ni faylga yo'naltirish, env o'zgartirish, <code>cd</code>, privilege tushirish. Aynan shu sabab <code>cmd &gt; file</code> ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bash (PID 100)<br>  |-- fork() --&gt; bash nusxasi (PID 101), sahifalar umumiy (CoW)<br>  |                |-- dup2(fd, 1)          # &gt; out.txt<br>  |                |-- execve(&quot;/usr/bin/ls&quot;) -&gt; PID 101 endi ls<br>  |-- wait(101) &lt;-- ls exit(0)  -&gt; $? = 0</pre><p>CoW: bola yoki ota sahifaga <b>yozganda</b> kernel o'sha sahifani nusxalaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>strace -f -e trace=clone,execve,wait4 bash -c 'ls &gt; /dev/null'</pre><p>Redis <code>BGSAVE</code>: fork qiladi, bola snapshot'ni diskka yozadi, ota ishlashda davom etadi — CoW tufayli darhol.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta xotirali jarayon (Redis 50GB) fork paytida page table nusxalash latency spike beradi; yozuv ko'p bo'lsa CoW xotira 2x gacha o'sadi.</li><li><code>vm.overcommit_memory=2</code> bo'lsa katta jarayon fork qila olmaydi — Redis <code>overcommit_memory=1</code> tavsiya qiladi.</li><li>exec muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa undan keyingi kod hech qachon bajarilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy kod <code>posix_spawn</code>/<code>vfork</code> (Go <code>os/exec</code> ichida <code>clone(CLONE_VFORK)</code>) ishlatadi — katta jarayondan fork qilish narxidan qochish uchun.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes
Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30665	<p>Monolitik va mikrokernel farqi? Linux qaysi biri?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Monolitik kernel</b> — drayverlar, fayl tizimi, tarmoq, scheduler hammasi bitta kernel maydonida ishlaydi (tez, lekin bitta drayver xatosi butun tizimni yiqitadi). <b>Mikrokernel</b> — kernelda faqat minimal (IPC, scheduling, xotira), qolganlari user space servislar (barqarorroq, lekin IPC narxi). Linux — <b>monolitik, modulli</b>.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><pre>Monolitik (Linux)              Mikrokernel (QNX, seL4)<br>+--------------------+         +------+ +------+ +-----+<br>| VFS | TCP | drayver|         | FS   | | Net  | |drv  |   user space<br>| scheduler | MM     |         +--+---+ +--+---+ +--+--+<br>+--------------------+            |  IPC  |        |<br>  bitta adres maydoni           +-v-------v--------v-+<br>                                | IPC | sched | MM   |  kernel<br>                                +--------------------+</pre><p>| | Monolitik | Mikrokernel | |---|---|---| | Tezlik | Yuqori (funksiya chaqiruvi) | Past (IPC xabarlari) | | Drayver xatosi | Kernel panic | Servis restart | | Misol | Linux, FreeBSD | QNX, MINIX 3, seL4 | | Gibrid | | Windows NT, macOS XNU |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lsmod | head          # Linux modulli: drayverlar runtime'da yuklanadi<br>modprobe -r pcspkr</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Modul bor = mikrokernel&quot; degan xato: Linux modullari ham kernel huquqida ishlaydi.</li><li>Mikrokernel &quot;har doim sekin&quot; — zamonaviy L4 oilasida IPC juda optimallashgan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xavfsizlik-kritik tizimlarda (avtomobil, aviatsiya) QNX/seL4 tanlanadi — formal isbotlangan. Linux ham bu yo'nalishda harakat qilyapti: drayverlarni Rust'da yozish, FUSE va eBPF orqali logikani kernel tashqarisiga/sandboxga chiqarish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes
Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30666	<p>Kernel modul nima va qanday boshqariladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kernel moduli — kernelni qayta kompilyatsiya qilmasdan va reboot'siz yuklanadigan <code>.ko</code> kodi (drayver, fayl tizimi, netfilter). Boshqaruv: <code>lsmod</code>, <code>modprobe</code> (bog'liqliklar bilan), <code>modprobe -r</code>, <code>modinfo</code>; doimiy yuklash — <code>/etc/modules-load.d/</code>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Bitta generic kernel minglab hardware'ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi — faqat kerakli drayver yuklanadi. Yangi NIC qo'shildi — udev mos modulni avtomatik yuklaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/lib/modules/6.8.0-45/kernel/drivers/net/ixgbe.ko<br>   v  modprobe ixgbe<br>modules.dep -&gt; bog'liqliklar -&gt; init_module() syscall<br>   v<br>kernel signature tekshiradi (Secure Boot / module.sig_enforce)<br>   v<br>modul kernel adres maydonida ishlaydi (to'liq huquq)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lsmod | grep -i ixgbe<br>modinfo ixgbe | grep -E 'filename|version|signer|parm'<br>sudo modprobe ixgbe<br>sudo modprobe -r ixgbe<br>echo &quot;options ixgbe allow_unsupported_sfp=1&quot; | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/ixgbe.conf<br>cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted        # 0 dan farqli: imzosiz/proprietary modul bor</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Modul kernel versiyasiga bog'liq — kernel yangilansa out-of-tree modul (NVIDIA, ZFS) qayta yig'ilishi kerak (DKMS).</li><li>Imzosiz modul kernelni &quot;tainted&quot; qiladi va vendor support rad etishi mumkin.</li><li>Ishlatilayotgan modulni <code>-r</code> qilib bo'lmaydi (&quot;in use&quot;).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xavfsizlik: modul = kernel huquqi, ya'ni rootkit yo'li. Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30667	<p>Linux scheduler (CFS/EEVDF) va <code>nice</code> qiymati nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Scheduler — qaysi jarayon qachon CPU olishini hal qiladi. <b>CFS</b> (2.6.23–6.5) har jarayonga vazn bo'yicha adolatli ulush beradi (<code>vruntime</code> eng kichigi navbatdagi); <b>6.6+</b> da uning o'rnini <b>EEVDF</b> egalladi (latency'ni yaxshiroq hisobga oladi). <b>nice</b> (-20..19) — vazn: kichik qiymat = ko'proq CPU ulushi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Backup va web-servis bir serverda — backup CPU'ni yeb qo'ymasligi uchun unga past prioritet beriladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>nice  0  -&gt; weight 1024<br>nice  5  -&gt; weight ~335<br>nice 19  -&gt; weight 15<br>CPU raqobatda: ulush = weight / jami_weight<br> nice0 + nice19 ikkalasi 100% istasa -&gt; ~98.5% / ~1.5%</pre><p>Har nice qadami ~10% CPU farqi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>nice -n 10 ./batch.sh<br>renice -n 15 -p 1234<br>ps -eo pid,ni,pri,cls,cmd | head    # NI = nice, CLS = TS/FF/RR<br>chrt -f -p 50 1234                  # SCHED_FIFO real-time (ehtiyot!)<br>ionice -c3 -p 1234                  # disk uchun idle klass<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/myapp/cpu.weight # konteyner/servis ulushi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>nice faqat CPU raqobati bo'lganda ta'sir qiladi; CPU bo'sh bo'lsa nice 19 jarayon ham 100% oladi.</li><li>Oddiy foydalanuvchi nice'ni faqat oshira oladi (pasaytirish uchun root yoki <code>CAP_SYS_NICE</code>).</li><li><code>SCHED_FIFO</code> noto'g'ri ishlatilsa CPU'ni butunlay band qilib tizimni &quot;osib&quot; qo'yadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Servis darajasida nice emas, cgroup ishlating: <code>CPUWeight=</code>, <code>CPUQuota=</code> (systemd), K8s <code>requests</code>/<code>limits</code>. CPU limit (CFS quota) throttling latency spike'lar beradi — <code>cpu.stat</code> dagi <code>nr_throttled</code> ni kuzating.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes
Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30668	<p>Virtual xotira va page fault nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Virtual xotira</b>: har jarayon o'zining alohida manzil maydonini ko'radi; CPU'dagi MMU sahifa jadvali (page table) orqali virtual manzilni fizik RAM'ga moslaydi. <b>Page fault</b> — kerakli sahifa hozir xaritada yo'q: <b>minor</b> (RAM'da bor, faqat moslash kerak — tez) yoki <b>major</b> (diskdan/swap'dan o'qish kerak — sekin).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Izolyatsiya (bir jarayon boshqasining xotirasini ko'rmaydi), RAM'dan ko'p xotira va'da qilish (overcommit), fayllarni xotiraga map qilish (mmap), fork'da CoW.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CPU: 0x7f12...  -&gt; TLB (kesh) hit? -&gt; fizik manzil<br>                     | miss<br>                     v<br>                 page table walk -&gt; sahifa bor? -&gt; TLB ga yoz<br>                     | yo'q<br>                     v<br>                 PAGE FAULT -&gt; kernel:<br>                   - ruxsatli manzil, RAM'da bor -&gt; minor fault<br>                   - diskdan o'qish kerak       -&gt; major fault (ms)<br>                   - ruxsatsiz manzil          -&gt; SIGSEGV (segfault)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ps -o pid,min_flt,maj_flt,rss,vsz,cmd -p 1234<br>/usr/bin/time -v ./app 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -i fault<br>sar -B 1          # majflt/s<br>perf stat -e page-faults,dTLB-load-misses ./app<br>cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled</pre><p><code>VSZ</code> — virtual hajm (katta bo'lishi normal), <code>RSS</code> — haqiqiy RAM'dagi qism.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta VSZ'dan qo'rqish — Go/Java katta virtual maydon rezerv qiladi, muhimi RSS.</li><li>Ko'p major fault — xotira yetishmayapti yoki swap ishlayapti.</li><li>THP (Transparent Huge Pages) Redis/MongoDB'da latency spike beradi — ular <code>madvise</code>/<code>never</code> tavsiya qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Huge pages (2MB) TLB miss'ni kamaytiradi — DB va JVM uchun foydali, lekin explicit hugepages yoki <code>madvise</code> rejimida. Major fault/s ni dashboard'ga qo'ying: bu xotira bosimining eng erta signali.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes
Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30692	<p><code>ls -l /etc/passwd</code> buyrug'ini bajarganda nima sodir bo'ladi (shell'dan kernelgacha)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shell qatorni tahlil qiladi -&gt; <code>ls</code> ni PATH'dan topadi -&gt; <code>fork()</code> + <code>execve()</code> -&gt; <code>ls</code> <code>lstat()</code> syscall qiladi -&gt; kernel VFS yo'lni hal qilib ext4 inode'ni o'qiydi -&gt; UID/GID nomlari NSS orqali topiladi -&gt; <code>write()</code> bilan terminalga -&gt; <code>exit()</code> va shell <code>wait()</code> bilan exit kodini oladi.</p><p><b>Bosqichma-bosqich:</b></p><pre>1. bash: tokenlar [&quot;ls&quot;,&quot;-l&quot;,&quot;/etc/passwd&quot;], alias? builtin? -&gt; yo'q<br>2. PATH qidiruv (hash jadval) -&gt; /usr/bin/ls<br>3. clone()/fork() -&gt; bola bash<br>4. execve(&quot;/usr/bin/ls&quot;) -&gt; ld-linux.so libc'ni map qiladi<br>5. ls: statx(&quot;/etc/passwd&quot;)<br>      kernel VFS: &quot;/&quot; -&gt; &quot;etc&quot; -&gt; &quot;passwd&quot; (dentry cache)<br>      ext4: inode o'qish (page cache yoki disk)<br>      ruxsat tekshiruvi: /etc ga x huquqi bormi<br>6. getpwuid(0) -&gt; NSS (/etc/nsswitch.conf) -&gt; /etc/passwd -&gt; &quot;root&quot;<br>7. write(1, &quot;-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 2.1K ...&quot;)<br>      kernel -&gt; pty -&gt; terminal emulator<br>8. exit_group(0) -&gt; bash wait4() -&gt; $? = 0</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>strace -f -e trace=execve,statx,openat,write ls -l /etc/passwd<br>type ls          # alias bo'lishi mumkin: ls='ls --color=auto'<br>ltrace ls -l /etc/passwd 2&gt;&amp;1 | head     # libc chaqiruvlari</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ls</code> ko'pincha alias — <code>type ls</code> bilan tekshiring.</li><li><code>/etc/passwd</code> ni o'qish uchun <code>/etc</code> papkasida <code>x</code> (search) huquqi ham kerak.</li><li>NSS LDAP/SSSD'ga ulangan bo'lsa nom topish tarmoqqa chiqadi — <code>ls -l</code> sekinligining klassik sababi (<code>ls -ln</code> bilan tekshiring).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu savol sizning qatlamlarni (shell, libc, syscall, VFS, FS, NSS, tty) tushunishingizni tekshiradi. Real debug'da xuddi shu zanjir bo'ylab <code>strace -T</code> bilan qaysi qadam sekinligini topasiz.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes
Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-31338	<p>Jarayon prioritet: <code>nice</code>, <code>renice</code>, <code>ionice</code>, <code>taskset</code>/CPU affinity.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>nice</code>/<code>renice</code> — CPU prioritetini (vaznini) o'zgartiradi; <code>ionice</code> — disk I/O prioritetini; <code>taskset</code> — jarayonni muayyan CPU core'larga bog'laydi (affinity); <code>chrt</code> — real-time siyosat.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kechasi backup ishga tushganda API latency 3x oshadi. Backup'ni &quot;faqat bo'sh resursdan foydalan&quot; rejimiga o'tkazish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CPU:  nice -20 ...... 0 ...... 19     (ko'p ulush -&gt; kam ulush)<br>I/O:  ionice -c1 (realtime) | -c2 -n0..7 (best-effort) | -c3 (idle)<br>Core: taskset -c 0-3  -&gt; faqat 0,1,2,3 core'larda ishlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>nice -n 19 ionice -c3 tar czf /backup/data.tgz /data   # backup klassikasi<br>renice -n 10 -p 1234<br>ionice -c2 -n7 -p 1234<br>taskset -cp 0-3 1234           # mavjud jarayonni bog'lash<br>taskset -c 4-7 ./latency_app   # izolyatsiya qilingan core'larda<br>chrt -p 1234                   # joriy siyosat: SCHED_OTHER<br>ps -eo pid,ni,psr,cmd | head   # PSR = hozir qaysi core'da</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>nice faqat CPU *raqobat* bo'lganda ta'sir qiladi.</li><li><code>ionice</code> faqat BFQ/CFQ scheduler'da ishlaydi; NVMe'da default <code>none</code>/<code>mq-deadline</code> — <code>ionice -c3</code> deyarli ta'sirsiz (<code>cat /sys/block/nvme0n1/queue/scheduler</code>).</li><li><code>taskset</code> NUMA'ni hisobga olmaydi — <code>numactl --cpunodebind --membind</code> kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Servis/konteyner uchun to'g'ri vosita cgroup: <code>CPUWeight</code>, <code>CPUQuota</code>, <code>IOWeight</code>, <code>IOReadBandwidthMax</code> (systemd) yoki K8s requests/limits. Latency-kritik ilova uchun <code>isolcpus</code>/CPU Manager <code>static</code> policy bilan alohida core.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes

Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-33464	<p>Linux'da process va thread farqi? <code>fork()</code> va <code>exec()</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Process</b> — o'z xotira maydoni, FD jadvali va resurslariga ega izolyatsiyalangan dastur nusxasi. <b>Thread</b> — bitta process ichidagi bajarilish oqimi; xotira va FD'lar umumiy, faqat stack va registrlar alohida. Linux'da ikkalasi ham <code>task</code> (<code>clone()</code> flag'lari farqi). <code>fork()</code> — process nusxasi, <code>exec()</code> — yangi dastur yuklash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bash (PID 100)<br>  |-- fork() --&gt; PID 101 (CoW xotira)<br>                  |-- exec(&quot;/usr/bin/ls&quot;) --&gt; PID 101 endi ls<br>  |-- wait() &lt;--- exit code<br><br>java (PID 200)            &lt;- bitta process<br>  +-- TID 200 main<br>  +-- TID 201 GC          &lt;- thread'lar: umumiy heap<br>  +-- TID 202 http-1</pre><p>| | Process | Thread | |---|---|---| | Xotira | Alohida | Umumiy | | Yaratish narxi | Yuqoriroq | Past | | Biri crash | Boshqasiga ta'sir yo'q | Butun process o'ladi | | Aloqa | IPC (pipe, socket) | Umumiy o'zgaruvchi (lock kerak) | | Ko'rish | <code>ps aux</code> | <code>ps -eLf</code>, <code>top -H</code> |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>top -H -p 1234                      # qaysi thread CPU yeyapti<br>ps -o nlwp= -p 1234                 # thread soni<br>ls /proc/1234/task | wc -l<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/&lt;grp&gt;/pids.max   # thread'lar ham shu limitga kiradi</pre><p><code>top -H</code> dagi TID'ni hex'ga o'tkazib (<code>printf '%x' TID</code>) Java <code>jstack</code> dagi <code>nid=</code> bilan moslashtiring.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Thread'lar <code>pids.max</code> limitiga kiradi — ko'p thread'li ilova &quot;can't create thread&quot; bilan yiqiladi.</li><li>Thread'lar orasida umumiy holat = race condition; process'lar orasida bu xavf kamroq.</li><li>Ko'p thread'li process'dan <code>fork()</code> — faqat chaqirgan thread nusxalanadi (lock'lar qotishi mumkin).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Izolyatsiya kerak bo'lsa (xavfsizlik, crash chegarasi) — process (masalan Chrome, nginx worker'lar); umumiy holat va arzonlik kerak bo'lsa — thread/goroutine. Bu arxitektura trade-off'i.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes
Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30669	<p>Kernel panic va kernel oops farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Oops</b> — kernel ichida xato (masalan NULL pointer), kernel o'sha task'ni o'ldirib davom etadi, lekin tizim endi ishonchsiz. <b>Panic</b> — kernel davom eta olmaydigan fatal xato; tizim to'xtaydi yoki (<code>kernel.panic=N</code> bo'lsa) N soniyadan keyin reboot.</p><p><b>Nega farqi muhim:</b> Oops'dan keyin server &quot;ishlayotgandek&quot; ko'rinadi, lekin lock'lar osilib qolgan, ma'lumot buzilgan bo'lishi mumkin. Productionda bu yashirin buzilishdan ko'ra toza reboot yaxshiroq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kernel xato (bug, yomon drayver, hardware)<br>   v<br>Oops: stack trace dmesg'ga, task o'ldiriladi, kernel &quot;tainted&quot;<br>   |   panic_on_oops=1 ?<br>   |      ha -&gt; panic<br>   v<br>Panic: &quot;Kernel panic - not syncing: ...&quot;<br>   v<br>kdump yoqilgan? -&gt; crash kernel vmcore'ni /var/crash ga yozadi<br>   v<br>kernel.panic=10 -&gt; 10s dan keyin reboot</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'oops|BUG:|panic|Call Trace'<br>journalctl -k -b -1          # oldingi boot kernel log'i<br>sysctl kernel.panic kernel.panic_on_oops<br>cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted<br># /etc/sysctl.d/90-panic.conf<br>#   kernel.panic = 10<br>#   kernel.panic_on_oops = 1<br>systemctl status kdump; crash /usr/lib/debug/vmlinux /var/crash/*/vmcore</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oops'dan keyin serverni ishlashda qoldirish — keyinroq tushunarsiz xatolar.</li><li>kdump uchun <code>crashkernel=</code> xotira rezervi bo'lmasa vmcore yozilmaydi.</li><li>Panic konsolda qoladi — cloud'da serial console bo'lmasa sababni ko'rmaysiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production standarti: <code>panic_on_oops=1</code> + <code>kernel.panic=10</code> + kdump/netconsole. Fleet darajasida panic'larni kernel versiyasi bo'yicha guruhlab, regression'ni tez topasiz.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes
Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-30670	<p>eBPF nima va nega DevOps'da mashhur?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>eBPF</b> — kernel ichida kichik, xavfsiz dasturlarni kernelni qayta yig'masdan va modul yuklamasdan ishga tushirish texnologiyasi. <b>Verifier</b> dasturni yuklashdan oldin tekshiradi (cheksiz loop yo'q, xotiraga xavfsiz murojaat), JIT esa native kodga aylantiradi. Ishlatilishi: observability, tarmoq (Cilium, XDP), xavfsizlik (Falco, Tetragon).</p><p><b>Nega mashhur:</b> Ilgari kernel ichini ko'rish uchun modul yozish (xavfli) yoki <code>strace</code> (juda sekin) kerak edi. eBPF bilan prod serverda deyarli overhead'siz har bir syscall, TCP retransmit yoki disk latency'ni ko'rasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bpftrace/bcc dasturi (C/skript)<br>   v  bpf() syscall<br>Verifier -&gt; xavfsizmi? -&gt; JIT -&gt; native kod<br>   v<br>hook: kprobe / tracepoint / XDP / cgroup / LSM<br>   v<br>voqea -&gt; eBPF dastur -&gt; BPF map (hisoblagich, histogram)<br>   v<br>user space map'ni o'qiydi -&gt; chiqish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo execsnoop-bpfcc            # har yangi jarayon (qisqa umrlilar ham)<br>sudo biolatency-bpfcc 5 1       # disk latency histogram<br>sudo tcpretrans-bpfcc           # TCP qayta yuborishlar<br>sudo bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_openat { printf(&quot;%s %s\n&quot;, comm, str(args-&gt;filename)); }'<br>sudo bpftool prog list          # yuklangan eBPF dasturlar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski kernel (&lt; 4.x) yoki BTF'siz kernelda ko'p tool ishlamaydi; CO-RE uchun BTF (<code>/sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux</code>) kerak.</li><li>eBPF yuklash <code>CAP_BPF</code>/root talab qiladi — konteynerga bu capability'ni bermang.</li><li>Juda tez-tez chaqiriladigan hook'ga og'ir dastur ilish overhead beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> eBPF — zamonaviy platformaning asosi: Cilium kube-proxy'ni almashtiradi, Pixie/Parca kodga tegmasdan tracing/profiling beradi.
