Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-33510	<p><code>epoll</code>, <code>select</code>/<code>poll</code> va <code>io_uring</code> farqi? Nega Nginx/Go yuz minglab ulanishni ko'taradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>select</code>/<code>poll</code> har chaqiruvda barcha FD'larni skanerlaydi (O(n)); <code>epoll</code> kernelda tayyor FD'lar ro'yxatini saqlaydi va faqat tayyorlarini qaytaradi (O(tayyorlar)); <code>io_uring</code> — submission/completion ring buferlari orqali haqiqiy asinxron I/O (disk ham), syscall'larsiz batch. Nginx/Go bir nechta thread'da epoll event loop bilan yuz minglab ulanishni ushlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Har ulanishga bitta thread&quot; modelida 100k ulanish = 100k thread = GB'lab stack va context switch. C10K muammosi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>select/poll:  har safar [fd1..fd100000] kernelga -&gt; hammasini tekshir -&gt; qaytar<br>epoll:        epoll_ctl(ADD fd) bir marta<br>              epoll_wait() -&gt; faqat [fd17, fd9001] tayyor<br>io_uring:     user  --SQ ring--&gt; kernel (read/write/accept so'rovlari)<br>              user &lt;--CQ ring--  kernel (natijalar), syscall shart emas</pre><p>| | select/poll | epoll | io_uring | |---|---|---|---| | Masshtab | O(n) | O(tayyor) | batch | | FD limiti | select: 1024 | yo'q | yo'q | | Disk I/O | ma'nosiz | ma'nosiz (fayl doim &quot;tayyor&quot;) | haqiqiy async | | Kim | eski kod | Nginx, Go netpoller, libuv, Redis | yangi DB/proxy |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>strace -f -e trace=epoll_wait,epoll_ctl -p $(pidof nginx | cut -d' ' -f1)<br>ls -l /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/fd | grep anon_inode:\\[eventpoll\\]<br>sysctl kernel.io_uring_disabled     # 0/1/2 (6.6+)</pre><p>Go: goroutine &quot;bloklovchi&quot; <code>conn.Read()</code> yozadi, runtime netpoller esa epoll orqali goroutine'ni park qiladi va tayyor bo'lganda uyg'otadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>epoll disk fayllari uchun ishlamaydi — shuning uchun libuv/Go disk I/O'ni thread pool'da bajaradi.</li><li>Edge-triggered rejimda barcha ma'lumotni <code>EAGAIN</code> gacha o'qimasangiz voqeani yo'qotasiz.</li><li>io_uring ko'p kernel zaifliklari manbai bo'lgan — Docker default seccomp va Google prod uni o'chiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xavfsizlik nuqtai nazaridan: konteyner workload'larida <code>kernel.io_uring_disabled=2</code> yoki seccomp bilan io_uring'ni yoping, faqat aniq foyda o'lchangan servislar uchun oching.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes

Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-34081	<p>File descriptor nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>File descriptor</b> — jarayon ochgan har bir resursga kernel beradigan kichik butun son (0, 1, 2, 3...). Fayl, socket, pipe, terminal — hammasi FD orqali ishlanadi. 0 = stdin, 1 = stdout, 2 = stderr.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Dastur fayl bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlamaydi — kernel'dan &quot;raqam&quot; oladi va keyin <code>read(3, ...)</code>, <code>write(3, ...)</code> deb shu raqamni ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Jarayon FD jadvali         Kernel<br> 0 -&gt; /dev/pts/0  (stdin)<br> 1 -&gt; /dev/pts/0  (stdout)<br> 2 -&gt; /dev/pts/0  (stderr)<br> 3 -&gt; /var/log/app.log      &lt;- open() eng kichik bo'sh raqamni berdi<br> 4 -&gt; socket:[45678]        &lt;- TCP ulanish ham FD</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls -l /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/fd         # FD -&gt; nimaga ishora<br>lsof -p &lt;PID&gt;                # batafsil<br>ulimit -n                    # 1024 - bir jarayon uchun limit<br>cmd &gt; out.log 2&gt;&amp;1           # fd2 ni fd1 ga yo'naltir</pre><p><code>2&gt;&amp;1</code> aynan &quot;FD 2 ni FD 1 ko'rsatgan joyga yo'naltir&quot; degani.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Limit tugasa: &quot;Too many open files&quot; — ko'pincha yopilmagan ulanishlar (leak), limitni oshirish faqat yarim yechim.</li><li>Log faylni <code>rm</code> qildingiz, lekin disk bo'shamadi — jarayon hali FD'ni ushlab turibdi (<code>lsof +L1</code>).</li><li><code>ulimit -n</code> shell'da o'zgartirilsa systemd servisiga ta'sir qilmaydi — unit'da <code>LimitNOFILE=</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p ulanishli servis (proxy, DB) uchun <code>LimitNOFILE=65535+</code> va FD sonini monitoring qilish (<code>process_open_fds</code>) standart amaliyot.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v11 Kernel_processes
Interview Drill::Linux::V11 Kernel & processes	idrill-34082	<p>Zombie va orphan jarayon nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Zombie</b> (<code>STAT</code> = <code>Z</code>) — ishini tugatgan, lekin ota-jarayon hali uning exit kodini <code>wait()</code> bilan olmagan jarayon. Interview Drill::Linux::V12 Memory, disk & troubleshooting	idrill-30541	<p>Serverda disk to'lib qoldi. Birinchi qaysi buyruqlar?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval <code>df -h</code> — qaysi fayl tizimi to'lgan; keyin <code>du -xh --max-depth=1 &lt;mount&gt; | sort -h</code> — qaysi papka; parallel <code>df -i</code> — inode tugamaganmi; <code>lsof +L1</code> — o'chirilgan, lekin ochiq fayllar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Disk 100% bo'lsa DB yozolmaydi, log yozilmaydi, ba'zan SSH'ga ham kirib bo'lmaydi. Interview Drill::Linux::V12 Memory, disk & troubleshooting	idrill-30542	<p>Load average 16, CPU foydalanish esa 10%. Nima bo'lishi mumkin?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux load average'ga CPU navbatidagi jarayonlardan tashqari <b><code>D</code> holatidagi</b> (uninterruptible I/O kutayotgan) jarayonlar ham kiradi. CPU 10% va load 16 — deyarli har doim <b>disk yoki NFS sekin</b>: jarayonlar I/O kutib turibdi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>load = R (ishlayotgan/navbatda) + D (I/O kutayotgan)<br>  R = 1, D = 15  -&gt; load 16, CPU esa deyarli bo'sh</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>nproc                                   # load'ni yadrolar bilan solishtir<br>vmstat 1 5                              # r = navbat, b = D jarayonlar, wa = iowait<br>ps -eo stat,pid,wchan:30,cmd | awk '$1 ~ /^D/'<br>iostat -xz 1                            # r_await/w_await ms, %util<br>cat /proc/pressure/io                   # some avg10=45.00 -&gt; 45% vaqt kutish<br>mount | grep nfs; dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'nfs|blocked'</pre><p><b>O'qish:</b> <code>vmstat</code> da <code>b</code> ustuni 15, <code>wa</code> 60% — I/O; <code>iostat</code> da <code>await</code> 200ms va <code>%util</code> 100% — disk to'yingan; <code>wchan</code> da <code>nfs_*</code> — NFS server javob bermayapti.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Load'ni &quot;CPU foizi&quot; deb tushunish — Linux'da bu noto'g'ri.</li><li><code>%util</code> NVMe/RAID'da 100% bo'lsa ham disk to'yinmagan bo'lishi mumkin (parallel navbat) — <code>await</code> muhimroq.</li><li>Cloud disk IOPS kvotasi tugashi (gp2 burst credit) — metrikada tekis &quot;shift&quot; ko'rinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Load o'rniga PSI (<code>/proc/pressure/{cpu,io,memory}</code>) ishlating — u qaysi resurs tufayli kutish borligini aniq ko'rsatadi va alert uchun yaxshiroq signal.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v12 Troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Linux::V12 Memory, disk & troubleshooting	idrill-30565	<p><code>free -m</code> da <code>available</code> kam, <code>buff/cache</code> esa katta. Xotira yetishmayaptimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yo'q. Linux bo'sh RAM'ni disk keshi (<b>page cache</b>) uchun ishlatadi va ilovalarga kerak bo'lganda darhol qaytaradi. Muhim ko'rsatkich — <b><code>available</code></b>. Agar <code>available</code> haqiqatan kam bo'lsa — shundagina xotira bosimi bor.</p><p>*(Eslatma: savoldagi holatda <code>buff/cache</code> katta bo'lsa, odatda <code>available</code> ham katta bo'ladi — chunki <code>available</code> ≈ <code>free</code> + bo'shatsa bo'ladigan kesh.)*</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>RAM 16G<br> +-- used (ilovalar)        4G<br> +-- buff/cache            11G  &lt;- toza sahifalar darhol bo'shatiladi<br> +-- free                  0.3G<br>available ~ free + reclaimable cache = ~10G</pre><p>Kesh bo'shatilmaydigan hollar: <code>Shmem</code> (tmpfs, <code>/dev/shm</code>), dirty sahifalar (avval yozilishi kerak), mlock.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>free -h<br>grep -E 'MemAvailable|Shmem:|Dirty|SReclaimable' /proc/meminfo<br>vmstat 1          # si/so &gt; 0 doimiy -&gt; haqiqiy bosim<br>cat /proc/pressure/memory<br>dmesg -T | grep -i oom</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>echo 3 &gt; /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches</code> &quot;xotira tozalash&quot; uchun — foydasiz va keshni yo'qotib disk I/O'ni oshiradi.</li><li>Katta <code>Shmem</code> (tmpfs'ga log yozish) kesh emas — bo'shatilmaydi.</li><li>Monitoring <code>free</code> bo'yicha alert berib noto'g'ri trevoga.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy bosim signallari: swap in/out, major page fault, PSI memory <code>some</code>/<code>full</code>, OOM yozuvlari. Interview Drill::Linux::V12 Memory, disk & troubleshooting	idrill-30566	<p>OOM killer nima va qaysi jarayonni tanlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OOM killer — xotira (RAM + swap yoki cgroup limiti) tugaganda kernel tizimni saqlash uchun bitta jarayonni SIGKILL bilan o'ldiradi. Tanlash <code>oom_score</code> bo'yicha: asosan jarayonning xotira hajmi + <code>oom_score_adj</code> tuzatmasi. Iz <code>dmesg</code> / <code>journalctl -k</code> da qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>allocation -&gt; bo'sh sahifa yo'q -&gt; reclaim (kesh, swap) -&gt; baribir yo'q<br>   v<br>OOM killer: har jarayon uchun oom_score (0..1000)<br>   = RSS + swap + page table ulushi  + oom_score_adj (-1000..1000)<br>   v<br>eng yuqorisi -&gt; SIGKILL -&gt; exit 137<br>cgroup limiti bo'lsa -&gt; faqat o'sha cgroup ichidan tanlanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'out of memory|killed process'<br># Killed process 4321 (java) total-vm:..., anon-rss:7.8GB<br>cat /proc/4321/oom_score /proc/4321/oom_score_adj<br>echo -1000 | sudo tee /proc/$(pidof sshd)/oom_score_adj   # himoya<br># systemd: OOMScoreAdjust=-900<br>kubectl describe pod x | grep -A3 'Last State'   # Reason: OOMKilled</pre><p>Go uchun: <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> ni konteyner limitidan ~10% past qo'ying — GC limitga yaqinlashganda faolroq ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>oom_score_adj=-1000</code> hamma narsaga — OOM killer kimni o'ldirishni topa olmay butun tizim osiladi.</li><li>JVM heap = konteyner limiti — off-heap/metaspace bilan baribir OOMKilled; <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75</code>.</li><li><code>vm.overcommit_memory=2</code> noto'g'ri sozlanса oddiy fork ham xato beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> OOM — oqibat; sabab leak yoki noto'g'ri limit. systemd-oomd/<code>earlyoom</code> PSI bo'yicha oldinroq harakat qiladi. OOM hodisalarini metrikaga (<code>node_vmstat_oom_kill</code>) chiqarib alert qiling.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v12 Troubleshooting

Interview Drill::Linux::V12 Memory, disk & troubleshooting	idrill-30570	<p><code>fsync</code> nima uchun kerak va DB'lar uchun nega muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>write()</code> ma'lumotni faqat <b>page cache</b>'ga (RAM) yozadi va darhol qaytadi; diskka kernel keyinroq tushiradi. <code>fsync(fd)</code> — &quot;shu faylning barcha ma'lumoti diskka (va disk keshidan media'ga) yozilmaguncha qaytma&quot;. Busiz elektr uzilsa &quot;commit bo'ldi&quot; deb javob berilgan tranzaksiya yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>write()  -&gt; page cache (dirty)  -&gt; &quot;OK&quot;   (tez, lekin RAM'da)<br>                 | ~30s ichida flush (yoki dirty limit)<br>                 v<br>              disk<br>fsync()  -&gt; dirty sahifalar + metadata -&gt; disk -&gt; FLUSH/FUA -&gt; &quot;OK&quot;</pre><p>DB commit: WAL yozuvi -&gt; <code>fsync</code> -&gt; mijozga &quot;COMMIT OK&quot;. Postgres endi fsync xatosida PANIC qiladi va WAL'dan tiklaydi.</li><li><code>fsync=off</code> (Postgres) yoki <code>nobarrier</code> mount — tezlik, lekin crash'da buzilgan DB.</li><li>Batareyasiz RAID kesh yoki disk &quot;write cache&quot; fsync'ga yolg'on gapirishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> fsync narxi latency'ning asosiy qismi — group commit, <code>synchronous_commit=off</code> (ba'zi ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin, lekin buzilish yo'q) kabi trade-off'larni ongli tanlang. Odatda eng ko'p xotira yeyayotgan jarayon tanlanadi (<code>oom_score</code> eng yuqori). Interview Drill::Linux::V13 Linux networking & security	idrill-30571	<p>Serverda minglab <code>TIME_WAIT</code> ulanishlar. Muammomi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Odatda muammo emas. <code>TIME_WAIT</code> — ulanishni <b>birinchi yopgan</b> tomon 2xMSL (Linux'da 60s) kutadigan normal TCP holati: kechikkan paketlar yangi ulanishni buzmasligi uchun. Muammo faqat <b>client</b> tomonda ephemeral portlar tugasa yuzaga keladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Client                Server<br>  FIN  -------------&gt;<br>       &lt;------------- ACK<br>       &lt;------------- FIN<br>  ACK  -------------&gt;<br>  TIME_WAIT (60s)       CLOSED<br>  (src_ip, src_port, dst_ip, dst_port) 60s band</pre><p>Bir manzilga ulanish uchun ~28k port (<code>32768-60999</code>) / 60s = ~470 yangi ulanish/s. Undan ko'p bo'lsa: <code>connect: cannot assign requested address</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -s                                  # TCP: ... timewait 18000<br>ss -tan state time-wait | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -n | tail<br>sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse</pre><p>Yechim tartibi:</p><ol><li><b>Keep-alive / connection pool</b> (asosiy yechim — ulanishni qayta ishlatish).</li><li><code>net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 10240 65535</code>.</li><li><code>net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1</code> (faqat outgoing, timestamp bilan xavfsiz).</li></ol><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>tcp_tw_recycle</code> — NAT ortidagi mijozlarni uzardi, kernel 4.12 da olib tashlangan; eski maqolalardan ko'chirmang.</li><li>Server tomonda minglab TIME_WAIT — zararsiz (bitta listen port, ko'p mijoz).</li><li>Har so'rovga yangi HTTP client yaratish (Go'da <code>http.Client{}</code> loop ichida) — klassik sabab.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> TIME_WAIT simptom; ildiz sabab — ulanishlarni qayta ishlatmaslik. Pool sozlamasini (<code>MaxIdleConnsPerHost</code>) tuzatish kernel tuning'dan ko'ra to'g'ri yechim.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v13 Networking_security
Interview Drill::Linux::V13 Linux networking & security	idrill-30572	<p>DNS muammosini qanday tekshirasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ilova ko'radigan natijani <code>getent hosts domain</code> bilan, DNS serverning javobini <code>dig domain</code> bilan tekshirasiz; <code>dig @8.8.8.8 domain</code> bilan resolver'larni solishtirasiz; <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code>, <code>/etc/hosts</code>, <code>/etc/nsswitch.conf</code> ni ko'rasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (nom qanday hal qilinadi):</b></p><pre>ilova getaddrinfo(&quot;api.x.com&quot;)<br>   v<br>/etc/nsswitch.conf: hosts: files dns<br>   v<br>files -&gt; /etc/hosts       (topilsa shu)<br>dns   -&gt; /etc/resolv.conf -&gt; nameserver 127.0.0.53 (systemd-resolved)<br>                              -&gt; upstream DNS -&gt; authoritative</pre><p><code>dig</code> faqat DNS'ni so'raydi, <code>/etc/hosts</code> ni o'qimaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>getent hosts api.x.com            # ilova nimani ko'radi<br>dig +short api.x.com              # standart resolver<br>dig @1.1.1.1 api.x.com            # boshqa resolver bilan solishtirish<br>dig +trace api.x.com              # root -&gt; TLD -&gt; authoritative<br>cat /etc/resolv.conf ; resolvectl status<br>grep hosts /etc/nsswitch.conf</pre><p><b>O'qish:</b> <code>status: NXDOMAIN</code> — nom yo'q; <code>SERVFAIL</code> — resolver/DNSSEC muammo; javob yo'q (timeout) — tarmoq/firewall UDP 53.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>dig</code> ishlaydi, ilova ishlamaydi — <code>/etc/hosts</code> dagi eski yozuv yoki nsswitch farqi.</li><li>K8s'da <code>ndots:5</code> — <code>api.x.com</code> uchun avval 3-4 ta search domain so'raladi; FQDN oxiriga <code>.</code> qo'ying.</li><li>Java/Go o'z DNS keshiga ega — TTL o'tgan bo'lsa ham eski IP ishlatilishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS — &quot;har doim DNS&quot; incidentlarining manbai. Interview Drill::Linux::V13 Linux networking & security	idrill-30573	<p><code>curl</code> sekin — 5 soniya kutib keyin javob beradi. Qayerda yo'qolayotganini qanday aniqlaysan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>curl -w</code> bilan vaqtni bosqichlarga bo'lasiz: DNS (<code>time_namelookup</code>), TCP (<code>time_connect</code>), TLS (<code>time_appconnect</code>), server ishlash (<code>time_starttransfer</code>), jami (<code>time_total</code>). Qaysi bosqich 5s olganini ko'rasiz. Aniq <b>5 soniya</b> — ko'pincha DNS resolver timeout (default <code>timeout:5</code>).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>0 ----- namelookup ----- connect ----- appconnect ----- starttransfer ----- total<br>  DNS                TCP handshake   TLS handshake    server javob       body<br> 5.01s               5.03s           5.10s            5.30s              5.31s<br> ^ 5s shu yerda yo'qolgan -&gt; DNS</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -o /dev/null -s -w 'dns=%{time_namelookup} tcp=%{time_connect} tls=%{time_appconnect} ttfb=%{time_starttransfer} total=%{time_total}\n' https://api.x.com<br>curl -4 ...                        # faqat IPv4 — tezlashsa IPv6 muammo<br>getent ahosts api.x.com            # A va AAAA javoblari<br>sudo tcpdump -i any -nn port 53    # qaysi so'rov javobsiz qolyapti</pre><p><b>5s sabablari:</b> | Simptom | Sabab | Yechim | |---|---|---| | namelookup 5s | birinchi nameserver o'lik | resolv.conf tuzatish | | namelookup 5s | A/AAAA parallel so'rov, bitta javob yo'qoladi (conntrack race) | <code>options single-request-reopen</code> | | connect 5s+ | IPv6 route yo'q, fallback | IPv6'ni tuzatish / <code>-4</code> | | ttfb katta | server sekin | APM/trace |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Muammoni server'da qidirish — ko'pincha client tomonda DNS.</li><li>K8s'da <code>ndots:5</code> + search domain'lar har birida timeout ko'paytiradi.</li><li><code>curl</code> ishlasa ham ilova boshqa resolver/kesh ishlatishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Aniq raqamlar (5s, 3s, 1s) — timeout sozlamasining izi; &quot;dumaloq&quot; kechikish ko'rsangiz, qaysi komponentda shunday default borligini qidiring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v13 Networking_security
Interview Drill::Linux::V13 Linux networking & security	idrill-30574	<p><code>iptables</code>/<code>nftables</code> da DROP va REJECT farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>DROP</b> — paketni jim tashlaydi, jo'natuvchi hech qanday javob olmaydi va timeout'gacha (TCP'da ~2 daqiqagacha retry) kutadi. <b>REJECT</b> — darhol javob qaytaradi (TCP RST yoki ICMP &quot;port unreachable&quot;), mijoz shu zahoti xato oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Mijoz SYN -&gt; [firewall]<br>  DROP:   ...jimlik... SYN retry 1s, 3s, 7s ... -&gt; &quot;Connection timed out&quot;<br>  REJECT: &lt;- RST -&gt; darhol &quot;Connection refused&quot;</pre><p>| | DROP | REJECT | |---|---|---| | Mijoz tajribasi | sekin timeout | tez xato | | Diagnostika | qiyin | oson | | Skanerga ma'lumot | port &quot;filtered&quot; | port &quot;closed&quot; | | Qayerda | internetga qaragan perimetr | ichki tarmoq |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 3306 -s 10.0.0.0/8 -j ACCEPT<br>sudo iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 3306 -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset<br>sudo iptables -L INPUT -n -v --line-numbers   # pkts/bytes hisoblagichlari<br># nftables:<br>sudo nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport 3306 reject with tcp reset<br>sudo nft list ruleset<br>sudo conntrack -S                              # conntrack drop/insert_failed</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ichki servislar orasida DROP — ilovalar timeout'gacha osilib, kaskad sekinlashuv.</li><li><code>REJECT</code> ni ko'p ishlatish DoS'da javob trafigini oshiradi — rate limit bilan birga.</li><li><code>nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet</code> — firewall qoidasi emas, conntrack to'lgani (<code>nf_conntrack_max</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Himoya nuqtai nazaridan: tashqi perimetrda DROP (skanerga kam ma'lumot), ichkarida REJECT (tez fail, oson debug). Default policy DROP + aniq ACCEPT qoidalari — allow-list yondashuvi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v13 Networking_security

Interview Drill::Linux::V13 Linux networking & security	idrill-30578	<p>Konteynerda Go/Java ilova CPU limiti bilan sekin ishlayapti, CPU esa limitgacha yetmayapti. Nima bo'lishi mumkin?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>CFS throttling.</b> CPU limit 100ms davrga kvota sifatida ishlaydi (masalan <code>limit: 1</code> = 100ms/100ms). Ko'p thread'li ilova (runtime host'ning 64 core'ini ko'rib 64 thread ochgan) kvotani davrning dastlabki ~2ms ida tugatadi va qolgan ~98ms davomida <b>to'xtatiladi</b>. O'rtacha CPU limitdan past ko'rinadi, lekin latency keskin oshadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>limit = 1 CPU -&gt; cpu.max = 100000 100000 (100ms kvota / 100ms davr)<br>64 thread parallel:<br> |##|..............................................| 100ms<br>  2ms: 64 x ~1.5ms = kvota tugadi -&gt; THROTTLED 98ms<br>O'rtacha: 1 CPU ishlatilgan (limit), lekin har so'rov +98ms kutadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat<br># nr_periods 12000<br># nr_throttled 8400      &lt;- 70% davrlarda throttling!<br># throttled_usec 512000000</pre><p>Prometheus: <code>rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m]) / rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m])</code>.</p><p><b>Yechimlar:</b></p><ul><li>Go: <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> ni limitga moslash (Go 1.25+ cgroup limitini avtomatik hisobga oladi; eski versiyalarda <code>uber-go/automaxprocs</code>).</li><li>Java: JDK 10+ konteynerni biladi; <code>-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=N</code> bilan aniqlashtirish.</li><li>Limitni oshirish yoki latency-kritik servislarda CPU limit qo'ymay, faqat <code>requests</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Dashboard'da CPU 40% ko'rinib &quot;resurs yetarli&quot; degan xulosa — throttling o'rtachada ko'rinmaydi.</li><li>GC thread'lari ham kvotani yeydi — GC pauzalari uzayadi.</li><li>Limit kasr (0.5) bo'lsa GOMAXPROCS 1 bo'ladi, lekin kvota 50ms — latency yana oshadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoalar CPU limitlarni olib tashlab faqat requests qoldiradi (noisy neighbor'ni requests vazni bilan boshqarish). Xotira limiti esa doim bo'lsin — u siqib bo'lmaydigan resurs.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v13 Networking_security

Interview Drill::Linux::V13 Linux networking & security	idrill-31334	<p><code>ping</code> ishlaydi, lekin ulanish bo'lmaydi / sekin. <code>traceroute</code>, <code>mtr</code> va MTU muammosi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ping</code> (kichik ICMP paket) o'tishi kichik paketlar o'tishini bildiradi, katta paketlar haqida hech narsa demaydi. Klassik sabab — <b>MTU / PMTU black hole</b>: yo'lda MTU kichikroq (VPN, VXLAN), lekin &quot;fragmentation needed&quot; ICMP xabari bloklangan, katta paketlar jim yo'qoladi. <code>mtr</code> — har hop'dagi yo'qotish va latency, <code>traceroute -T</code> — TCP bilan marshrut.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Host MTU 1500 --&gt; router --&gt; VPN tunnel MTU 1400 --&gt; server<br> 1500 baytli paket (DF bit) -&gt; router: &quot;sig'maydi&quot; -&gt; ICMP frag-needed<br> ICMP firewall'da bloklangan -&gt; host bilmaydi -&gt; qayta yuboradi -&gt; yo'qoladi<br>Simptom: SSH ulanadi, `ls` ishlaydi, `cat big.log` yoki TLS handshake osiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>mtr -rwzc 100 host                 # Loss% va Avg har hop'da<br>traceroute -T -p 443 host          # ICMP bloklangan joyda TCP<br>ping -M do -s 1472 host            # 1472 + 28 = 1500, DF bilan<br>ping -M do -s 1372 host            # kichraytirib chegara topiladi<br>ip link show eth0 | grep mtu<br>tracepath host                     # PMTU'ni avtomatik topadi</pre><p><b>Yechim:</b></p><pre>sudo ip link set eth0 mtu 1400<br>sudo iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>mtr</code> da oraliq hop'da loss, oxirgi hop'da yo'q — router ICMP'ni rate-limit qilyapti, muammo emas.</li><li>ICMP'ni butunlay bloklash (&quot;xavfsizlik uchun&quot;) — PMTUD'ni buzadi; <code>fragmentation-needed</code> (type 3 code 4) ruxsat bo'lishi kerak.</li><li>K8s overlay (VXLAN 50 bayt overhead) — pod MTU host MTU'dan kichik bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Firewall siyosatida ICMP'ni &quot;hammasi yoki hech narsa&quot; emas, kerakli turlarini (echo, frag-needed, time-exceeded) ruxsat bering. Cloud'da jumbo frame (9001) va VPN gateway (1500 dan kam) aralashganda MTU muammolari ayniqsa ko'p.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v13 Networking_security

Interview Drill::Linux::V17 TCP/IP & network config	idrill-31358	<p>TCP va UDP farqi? Qaysi protokollar qaysi birini ishlatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP — ulanishga asoslangan, ishonchli, tartibli <b>byte stream</b> (yo'qolgan paketni qayta yuboradi). UDP — ulanishsiz, kafolatsiz, alohida <b>datagram</b>lar; tez va yengil, ishonchlilikni kerak bo'lsa ilova o'zi qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega ikkalasi kerak:</b> fayl, SQL so'rov, HTTP sahifa — bitta bayt ham yo'qolmasligi shart (TCP). Ovoz, video, DNS so'rovi — kech kelgan paketdan foyda yo'q, tezlik muhim (UDP).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>TCP:  SYN -&gt;  &lt;- SYN-ACK  ACK -&gt;   (3-way handshake, 1 RTT)<br>      data -&gt; &lt;- ACK   (yo'qolsa retransmit, window bilan flow control)<br>      FIN -&gt; &lt;- ACK ... (yopish)<br><br>UDP:  datagram -&gt;   (handshake yo'q, ACK yo'q, tartib yo'q)</pre><p>| | TCP | UDP | |---|---|---| | Ulanish | 3-way handshake | yo'q | | Yetkazish | kafolatli, retransmit | kafolat yo'q | | Tartib | saqlanadi | saqlanmaydi | | Birlik | byte stream | alohida datagram | | Header | 20-60 bayt | 8 bayt | | Nazorat | flow + congestion control | yo'q |</p><p><b>Kim nimani ishlatadi:</b></p><ul><li>TCP: HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, SSH, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kafka, Redis, SMTP.</li><li>UDP: DNS (javob katta bo'lsa yoki zone transfer — TCP), NTP, DHCP, syslog (klassik), WireGuard, QUIC/HTTP/3.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -tlnp          # TCP listen portlar<br>ss -ulnp          # UDP listen portlar<br>nc -vz host 5432  # TCP port tekshiruv<br>nc -vzu host 53   # UDP — &quot;open&quot; ishonchsiz: javob bo'lmasa ham ochiq deydi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>TCP &quot;xabar&quot; chegarasini bilmaydi: ikki <code>write()</code> bitta <code>read()</code>da kelishi mumkin — ilova framing qilishi kerak (length prefix, newline).</li><li>UDP port tekshiruvi aldaydi: javob yo'qligi &quot;ochiq&quot; ham, &quot;filtrlangan&quot; ham bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Firewall'da DNS uchun faqat UDP 53 ochish — katta javoblar (DNSSEC) TCP 53 ga o'tadi va sinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> TCP'ning head-of-line blocking'i (bitta yo'qolgan paket butun oqimni to'xtatadi) HTTP/3 ning QUIC (UDP ustida, user space'da ishonchlilik) ga o'tishining asosiy sababi. &quot;UDP tez&quot; — afsona emas, lekin ishonchlilikni o'zing yozsang, TCP'ni qayta ixtiro qilasan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v17 TCP_IP
Interview Drill::Linux::V17 TCP/IP & network config	idrill-31359	<p>TCP 3-way handshake va 4-way close. Holatlar: LISTEN, SYN_SENT, ESTABLISHED, FIN_WAIT, CLOSE_WAIT, TIME_WAIT.</p>	<pre>Client                         Server (LISTEN)<br> SYN_SENT   ---- SYN ----&gt;      SYN_RECEIVED<br> ESTABLISHED &lt;-- SYN+ACK --<br>            ---- ACK ----&gt;      ESTABLISHED<br><br> FIN_WAIT_1 ---- FIN ----&gt;      CLOSE_WAIT   (ilova close() qilishi kerak)<br> FIN_WAIT_2 &lt;--- ACK -----<br> TIME_WAIT  &lt;--- FIN -----      LAST_ACK<br>            ---- ACK ----&gt;      CLOSED<br> (2*MSL ~60s) -&gt; CLOSED</pre><pre>ss -tan | awk 'NR&gt;1{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn</pre><ul><li><b>Ko'p CLOSE_WAIT</b> — <b>bizning</b> bug: socket yopilmayapti (Go: <code>resp.Body.Close()</code>). FD tugaydi.</li><li><b>Ko'p TIME_WAIT</b> — odatda normal (ko'p qisqa ulanish). Yechim: keep-alive/connection pool; <code>net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1</code> (faqat outgoing). <code>tcp_tw_recycle</code> — o'chirilgan, NAT'ni buzardi.</li><li><b>SYN_RECV ko'p</b> — SYN flood yoki backlog to'lgan: <code>tcp_syncookies</code>, <code>somaxconn</code>.</li><li><b>SYN_SENT da qolish</b> — firewall DROP (javob yo'q).</li></ul>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v17 TCP_IP

Gratuitous ARP — host o'z IP'sini so'ralmasdan e'lon qilishi; IP konflikti — bir IP ikki MAC'da bo'lishi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ethernet freym MAC bo'yicha yuboriladi, ilova esa IP biladi. Har paketdan oldin &quot;10.0.1.1 kimda?&quot; degan savolga javob kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Host A (10.0.1.5)                         broadcast ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff<br>  &quot;Who has 10.0.1.1? Tell 10.0.1.5&quot;  ------------------&gt;  hamma oladi<br>                                    &lt;------------------  gateway: &quot;10.0.1.1 is at aa:bb:..&quot;<br>  cache'ga yoziladi: REACHABLE -&gt; (vaqt o'tib) STALE -&gt; qayta tekshiruv<br><br>Gratuitous ARP: &quot;10.0.1.100 is at cc:dd:..&quot; (so'rovsiz) -&gt; qo'shnilar cache'ni yangilaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip neigh show<br># 10.0.1.1 dev eth0 lladdr aa:bb:cc:00:11:22 REACHABLE<br># 10.0.1.9 dev eth0  FAILED          &lt;- javob kelmadi<br>sudo ip neigh flush dev eth0          # cache tozalash<br>sudo arping -I eth0 -c 3 10.0.1.50    # kim javob beradi<br>sudo arping -D -I eth0 10.0.1.50      # duplicate detection: javob bo'lsa IP band<br>sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -nn arp          # ARP trafikni jonli ko'rish<br>ip -6 neigh                            # IPv6: ARP o'rniga NDP</pre><p>O'qish: <code>arping</code> javobida <b>ikki xil MAC</b> chiqsa — IP konflikti. Belgilar: ulanish &quot;goh ishlaydi, goh yo'q&quot;, SSH tasodifan boshqa serverga tushadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Gateway uchun <code>FAILED</code> — bu L2 muammo (VLAN, kabel, switch port), DNS yoki firewall emas.</li><li>Keepalived/VRRP VIP ko'chganda gratuitous ARP yuboriladi; ba'zi switch/router uni e'tiborsiz qoldirsa trafik eski node'ga ketadi.</li><li>Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) VPC'da haqiqiy L2 yo'q: ARP'ni hypervisor javob beradi, gratuitous ARP bilan VIP ko'chmaydi — API (secondary IP, ENI) orqali ko'chiriladi.</li></ul><p><b>Xavfsizlik (himoya):</b> ARP autentifikatsiyasiz — LAN'da ARP spoofing mumkin. Interview Drill::Linux::V17 TCP/IP & network config	idrill-31366	<p>Ikki server orasida tarmoq sekin. OSI qatlamlari bo'yicha.</p>	<ol><li><b>URL parse, kesh</b>: HSTS -&gt; https majburiy.</li><li><b>DNS (L7 over UDP/TCP 53)</b>: brauzer kesh -&gt; OS (<code>/etc/hosts</code>, systemd-resolved) -&gt; resolver -&gt; root -&gt; .com -&gt; authoritative. Interview Drill::Linux::V17 TCP/IP & network config	idrill-34015	<p><code>/24</code> subnet nimani bildiradi va unda nechta host bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/24</code> — IP'ning birinchi 24 biti tarmoq qismi, qolgan 8 bit host uchun. Mask <code>255.255.255.0</code>, jami 256 manzil, ishlatsa bo'ladigan <b>254 host</b> (birinchisi — network, oxirgisi — broadcast).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> subnet qaysi manzillar &quot;o'z tarmog'im&quot; (to'g'ridan yuboriladi) va qaysilari gateway orqali ketishini belgilaydi. VPC, Docker, K8s tarmog'ini rejalashtirishda ham shu hisob.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>IP:    10.0.0.37   = 00001010.00000000.00000000.00100101<br>mask:  /24         = 11111111.11111111.11111111.00000000<br>                     |------ tarmoq (24) ------| host(8)<br>tarmoq: 10.0.0.0      broadcast: 10.0.0.255<br>hostlar: 10.0.0.1 ... 10.0.0.254</pre><p>Formula: manzillar = <code>2^(32 - prefix)</code>, hostlar = <code>2^(32 - prefix) - 2</code>.</p><p>| CIDR | Mask | Manzil | Host | |---|---|---|---| | /16 | 255.255.0.0 | 65536 | 65534 | | /24 | 255.255.255.0 | 256 | 254 | | /26 | 255.255.255.192 | 64 | 62 | | /28 | 255.255.255.240 | 16 | 14 | | /30 | 255.255.255.252 | 4 | 2 | | /32 | 255.255.255.255 | 1 | bitta host |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ipcalc 10.0.0.37/24       # Network, Broadcast, HostMin, HostMax<br>python3 -c &quot;import ipaddress as i; n=i.ip_network('10.0.0.0/24'); print(n.num_addresses, n[1], n[-2])&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>AWS subnet'da yana 3 manzil band (.1 router, .2 DNS, .3 zaxira) — <code>/24</code>da 251 host. Azure ham 5 ta oladi.</li><li>Prefiks kattaroq = tarmoq kichikroq: <code>/28</code> <code>/24</code>dan kichik.</li><li>Kubernetes'da har pod IP oladi — <code>/24</code> node subnet tez tugaydi (EKS VPC CNI'da ayniqsa).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> VPC CIDR'ni kelajak uchun keng ol va boshqa VPC/ofis/VPN bilan to'qnashmasin — keyin o'zgartirish deyarli qayta qurish demak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v17 TCP_IP
Interview Drill::Linux::V17 TCP/IP & network config	idrill-34016	<p>Private IP diapazonlari qaysilar?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> RFC 1918 private diapazonlari: <code>10.0.0.0/8</code>, <code>172.16.0.0/12</code> (172.16.0.0–172.31.255.255) va <code>192.168.0.0/16</code>. Ular internetda route qilinmaydi; tashqariga NAT orqali chiqiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> IPv4 manzillar yetishmaydi. Ichki tarmoqlar (ofis, VPC, Docker) bir xil private manzillarni qayta ishlatadi, internetga esa bitta public IP orqali NAT bilan chiqadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>10.0.1.5 (private) --&gt; NAT gateway / router --&gt; 203.0.113.7 (public) --&gt; internet<br>                     src'ni almashtiradi, javobni qaytarib yo'naltiradi</pre><p>| Diapazon | Hajm | Odatiy joy | |---|---|---| | <code>10.0.0.0/8</code> | 16.7 mln | VPC, korporativ tarmoq | | <code>172.16.0.0/12</code> | 1 mln | Docker (<code>172.17.0.0/16</code>) | | <code>192.168.0.0/16</code> | 65 ming | uy/ofis router |</p><p>Boshqa maxsus diapazonlar:</p><ul><li><code>127.0.0.0/8</code> — loopback.</li><li><code>169.254.0.0/16</code> — link-local; cloud metadata <code>169.254.169.254</code>.</li><li><code>100.64.0.0/10</code> — CGNAT (provayder NAT, Tailscale ham ishlatadi).</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip -br a                       # serverning private IP'si<br>curl -s ifconfig.me            # tashqaridan qaysi public IP bilan ko'rinadi<br>docker network inspect bridge | grep Subnet</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker default <code>172.17.0.0/16</code> ofis VPN tarmog'i bilan to'qnashsa, VPN orqali server ishlamay qoladi — <code>/etc/docker/daemon.json</code>da <code>bip</code> / <code>default-address-pools</code> o'zgartiriladi.</li><li>VPC peering ikki tarafi bir xil CIDR bo'lsa — ulab bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>172.32.x.x</code> private EMAS (diapazon 172.31 da tugaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Xavfsizlik (himoya):</b> metadata endpoint <code>169.254.169.254</code> SSRF hujumlari nishoni — AWS'da IMDSv2 (token bilan) majburiy qilinsin.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tashkilot bo'yicha IP rejasi (IPAM) bo'lsin: qaysi VPC/region/ofis qaysi blokni oladi. To'qnashuv odatda birinchi merger yoki VPN ulanishida chiqadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v17 TCP_IP
Interview Drill::Linux::V17 TCP/IP & network config	idrill-34017	<p>DNS so'rovi qanday ishlaydi va <code>dig</code> bilan qanday tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ilova nomni resolver'ga beradi; &quot;.com qayerda?&quot;       -&gt; NS a.gtld-servers.net<br>   .com      -&gt; &quot;example.com qayerda?&quot; -&gt; NS ns1.example.com<br>   ns1       -&gt; &quot;example.com A?&quot;       -&gt; 93.184.215.14 TTL 300</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig example.com              # to'liq javob<br>dig +short example.com       # faqat IP<br>dig example.com AAAA         # IPv6<br>dig example.com MX           # pochta serverlari<br>dig @8.8.8.8 example.com     # boshqa resolver orqali<br>dig +trace example.com       # root'dan boshlab har qadam</pre><p>O'qish:</p><pre>;; Query time: 24 msec</pre><p>Asosiy record'lar: <code>A</code> (IPv4), <code>AAAA</code> (IPv6), <code>CNAME</code> (alias), <code>MX</code> (pochta), <code>TXT</code> (SPF, tasdiqlash), <code>NS</code> (authoritative server).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>dig</code> <code>/etc/hosts</code>ni o'qimaydi; Interview Drill::Linux::V17 TCP/IP & network config	idrill-34019	<p>Default gateway nima va uni qanday ko'rasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Default gateway — o'z subnet'ingizdan tashqaridagi barcha manzillarga paket yuboriladigan router. <code>ip r</code> (<code>ip route</code>) chiqishidagi <code>default via ...</code> qatori shuni ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> host faqat o'z subnet'idagilarni to'g'ridan ko'radi. Internetga yoki boshqa tarmoqqa chiqish uchun &quot;eshik&quot; kerak — gateway.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dst = 10.0.0.20 (o'z /24)  -&gt; ARP -&gt; to'g'ridan yuboriladi<br>dst = 8.8.8.8 (begona)      -&gt; eng aniq route yo'q -&gt; default via 10.0.0.1<br>                               -&gt; gateway MAC'iga yuboriladi -&gt; u davom ettiradi</pre><p>Kernel eng uzun mos prefiksni tanlaydi (longest prefix match); <code>default</code> = <code>0.0.0.0/0</code> — eng oxirgi variant.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip r<br># default via 10.0.0.1 dev eth0 proto dhcp metric 100<br># 10.0.0.0/24 dev eth0 proto kernel scope link src 10.0.0.5<br>ip route get 8.8.8.8        # aynan shu manzil qaysi yo'ldan ketadi<br>ping -c 3 10.0.0.1          # gateway tirikmi<br>traceroute -n 8.8.8.8       # birinchi hop — gateway<br>sudo ip route add default via 10.0.0.1   # vaqtinchalik (reboot'da yo'qoladi)</pre><p><b>Belgilar:</b> | Simptom | Ehtimoliy sabab | |---|---| | lokal serverlar ishlaydi, internet yo'q | gateway yo'q/noto'g'ri | | <code>Network is unreachable</code> | mos route yo'q | | ikki <code>default</code> qatori | asimmetrik routing, tasodifiy uzilish |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ikkita NIC'da ikkita default route — javob boshqa interfeysdan chiqib ketadi (policy routing kerak).</li><li>Cloud'da gateway VPC router; internetga chiqmasa — route table'da IGW/NAT yo'qligini tekshir, serverni emas.</li><li><code>ip route add</code> doimiy emas — netplan/NetworkManager'da yoz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>ip route get &lt;dst&gt;</code> — eng tez diagnostika: kernel aynan qaysi interfeys, gateway va source IP'ni tanlashini ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v17 TCP_IP

Interview Drill::Linux::V17 TCP/IP & network config	idrill-34098	<p>ARP nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ARP IP manzilni (L3) shu lokal tarmoqdagi MAC manzilga (L2) aylantiradi. Ethernet freym faqat MAC bo'yicha yetkaziladi, shuning uchun ARP'siz IPv4 paketini qo'shni mashinaga yoki gateway'ga yuborib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Oddiy misol:</b> IP — xatdagi shahar va ko'cha (oxirgi manzil), MAC — hozir xatni qo'lga beradigan pochtachining ismi (keyingi qadam).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Host 10.0.0.5: &quot;10.0.0.1 kimda? 10.0.0.5 ga ayt&quot;   (broadcast, hammaga)<br>Gateway:       &quot;10.0.0.1 menda, MAC 52:54:00:aa:bb:cc&quot; (unicast javob)<br>Host:          ARP cache'ga yozadi, keyingi paketlarda so'ramaydi</pre><ul><li>Manzil o'z subnet'ida bo'lsa — o'sha host MAC'i so'raladi.</li><li>Boshqa subnet'da bo'lsa — <b>gateway</b> MAC'i so'raladi; paketning IP manzili o'zgarmaydi, faqat freym gateway'ga yuboriladi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip neigh<br># 10.0.0.1 dev eth0 lladdr 52:54:00:aa:bb:cc REACHABLE<br># 10.0.0.7 dev eth0 FAILED<br>sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -nn arp     # so'rov va javoblarni ko'rish<br>sudo arping -c 3 10.0.0.1        # ARP darajasida &quot;ping&quot;</pre><p>Holatlar: <code>REACHABLE</code> — yaqinda tasdiqlangan, <code>STALE</code> — eski, keyingi ishlatishda qayta tekshiriladi, <code>FAILED</code> — javob kelmadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Gateway <code>FAILED</code> — IP to'g'ri bo'lsa ham internet yo'q; muammo L2 (kabel, VLAN, switch).</li><li>Ikki server bir IP'ni olsa (konflikt) — ARP cache navbatma-navbat almashadi, ulanishlar tasodifan uziladi.</li><li>IPv6'da ARP yo'q — NDP (<code>ip -6 neigh</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ARP autentifikatsiyasiz, shuning uchun lokal tarmoqqa ishonib bo'lmaydi: switch darajasida Dynamic ARP Inspection va ichki trafikda ham TLS — &quot;ichki tarmoq xavfsiz&quot; degan taxminga tayanma.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v17 TCP_IP

Misol.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>~/.ssh/config</code> — SSH mijozining shaxsiy sozlama fayli: har host uchun taxallus, manzil, foydalanuvchi, kalit, port, bastion (ProxyJump), port forwarding va keep-alive'ni bir marta yozib qo'yasiz. Natijada uzun <code>ssh -i ... -p ... -J ...</code> o'rniga <code>ssh prod-db</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 30 ta server, har birida boshqa user, kalit va bastion. Buyruqlarni eslab qolish va har safar yozish — xato va vaqt yo'qotish.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># ~/.ssh/config   (chmod 600)<br>Host bastion<br>    HostName 203.0.113.10<br>    User mansur<br>    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519<br><br>Host prod-*<br>    User deploy<br>    ProxyJump bastion<br>    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519<br>    IdentitiesOnly yes<br><br>Host prod-db<br>    HostName 10.0.1.20<br>    LocalForward 5432 localhost:5432<br><br>Host *<br>    ServerAliveInterval 30<br>    ServerAliveCountMax 3<br>    AddKeysToAgent yes<br>    HashKnownHosts yes</pre><pre>ssh prod-db            # bastion orqali kiradi + lokal 5432 ochiladi<br>ssh -G prod-db | grep -E '^(user|hostname|proxyjump)'   # yakuniy qiymatlar</pre><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ssh prod-db -&gt; fayl yuqoridan pastga o'qiladi<br>  &quot;prod-db&quot; mos  -&gt; HostName, LocalForward<br>  &quot;prod-*&quot;  mos  -&gt; User, ProxyJump, IdentityFile<br>  &quot;*&quot;       mos  -&gt; ServerAlive...<br>  Har parametr uchun BIRINCHI topilgan qiymat g'olib</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Host *</code> ni boshiga qo'yish — uning qiymatlari keyingi aniq host'larni bosib ketadi; umumiy blok oxirida.</li><li><code>IdentitiesOnly yes</code> siz agent'dagi barcha kalitlar sinaladi -&gt; &quot;Too many authentication failures&quot;.</li><li>Fayl huquqi keng bo'lsa (<code>644</code> boshqa yozishi mumkin) SSH &quot;Bad owner or permissions&quot; bilan rad etadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>ssh -G host</code> — yakuniy konfiguratsiyani ko'rishning eng tez yo'li. Jamoa uchun umumiy config'ni <code>Include ~/.ssh/config.d/*</code> bilan alohida faylda versiyalang; secret (kalit) hech qachon repozitoriyga tushmasin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v15 SSH
Interview Drill::Linux::V15 SSH & remote access	idrill-31307	<p>SSH tunnel: <code>-L</code>, <code>-R</code>, <code>-D</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>-L</code> (local forward) — lokal portni SSH orqali uzoqdagi manzilga ulaydi (private DB'ga lokaldan kirish). <code>-R</code> (remote forward) — server tomondagi portni sizning lokal servisingizga ulaydi (NAT ortidagi servisni ko'rsatish). <code>-D</code> (dynamic) — lokal SOCKS5 proxy, istalgan manzilga SSH server orqali chiqish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>-L 5432:db.internal:5432 bastion<br>  [siz] localhost:5432 ==ssh==&gt; bastion ---&gt; db.internal:5432<br><br>-R 9000:localhost:3000 vps<br>  internet -&gt; vps:9000 ==ssh==&gt; [siz] localhost:3000<br><br>-D 1080 bastion<br>  brauzer (SOCKS localhost:1080) ==ssh==&gt; bastion ---&gt; istalgan host:port</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ssh -N -f -L 5432:db.internal:5432 bastion   # -N buyruqsiz, -f fonga<br>psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U app<br>ssh -N -R 9000:localhost:3000 vps            # tashqaridan ochiq bo'lishi uchun sshd: GatewayPorts<br>ssh -N -D 1080 bastion<br>curl --socks5-hostname localhost:1080 http://intranet.local<br>ss -tlnp | grep 5432                         # tunnel tinglayaptimi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-L 0.0.0.0:5432:...</code> — tunnelni tarmoqdagi boshqa mashinalarga ham ochadi; default <code>127.0.0.1</code> qoldiring.</li><li><code>-R</code> bilan ichki servisni internetga chiqarish — firewall va xavfsizlik siyosatini chetlab o'tish.</li><li>Uzoq yashovchi tunnel uziladi — <code>autossh</code> yoki <code>ServerAliveInterval</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta (himoya):</b> Tunnel'lar perimetr nazoratini chetlab o'tadi. Server tomonda: <code>AllowTcpForwarding no</code> (default) va faqat bastion'da <code>yes</code>, <code>PermitOpen db.internal:5432</code> bilan manzillarni cheklash, <code>GatewayPorts no</code>, <code>PermitTunnel no</code>. Ma'lumotlar bazasiga doimiy kirish uchun esa audit qilinadigan yechim (SSM port forwarding, Teleport) yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v15 SSH
Interview Drill::Linux::V15 SSH & remote access	idrill-31308	<p>Bastion (jump host) orqali kirish: <code>ProxyJump</code> va agent forwarding farqi, xavfi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ProxyJump</b> (<code>-J</code>) — mijoz bastion orqali TCP tunnel ochadi va uning ichida target bilan <b>to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, end-to-end</b> SSH sessiya quradi; kalit va autentifikatsiya mijozda qoladi. <b>Agent forwarding</b> (<code>-A</code>) — bastion'da sizning SSH agent'ingizga ulanadigan socket paydo bo'ladi; bastion'dagi root (yoki hujumchi) shu socket orqali <b>sizning nomingizdan</b> boshqa serverlarga kira oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ProxyJump:<br> [laptop: kalit] ==SSH(bastion)==&gt; bastion --TCP--&gt; target<br> [laptop] ======== shifrlangan SSH (end-to-end) =======&gt; target<br> bastion faqat baytlarni uzatadi, ichini ko'rmaydi<br><br>Agent forwarding:<br> [laptop: agent] &lt;==socket== bastion:$SSH_AUTH_SOCK<br> bastion root: SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/tmp/ssh-xxx/agent.123 ssh prod-db  -&gt; SIZ sifatida kiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ssh -J mansur@bastion deploy@10.0.1.20<br>ssh -J b1,b2 target                  # zanjir<br># ~/.ssh/config<br># Host prod-*<br>#     ProxyJump bastion<br>#     ForwardAgent no</pre><p>Agent forwarding'dan qochib bo'lmasa:</p><pre>ssh-add -c ~/.ssh/id_ed25519   # har ishlatishda tasdiq so'raydi<br>ssh-add -t 1h ~/.ssh/id_ed25519   # vaqt cheklovi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bastion'da <code>git pull</code> uchun <code>-A</code> ishlatish — keng tarqalgan, lekin xavfli odat; deploy key yoki ProxyJump bilan almashtiring.</li><li>ProxyJump uchun bastion'da <code>AllowTcpForwarding yes</code> kerak (faqat bastion'da).</li><li>Eski <code>ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:%p bastion</code> ham ishlaydi, lekin <code>ProxyJump</code> soddaroq (OpenSSH 7.3+).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta (himoya):</b> Qoida: <code>-J</code> ishlat, <code>-A</code> dan qoch. Bastion'da <code>AllowAgentForwarding no</code> bilan server tomonda ham yoping, bastion'ni minimal (shell'siz, faqat forwarding) qiling va barcha sessiyalarni audit log'ga yozing.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v15 SSH

Interview Drill::Linux::V15 SSH & remote access	idrill-31311	<p>scp, rsync va sftp farqi? Kerakli flaglar.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>scp</b> — oddiy nusxalash (bir martalik fayl). <b>rsync</b> — faqat farqni yuboradi, uzilsa davom etadi, huquq/vaqtni saqlaydi, <code>--delete</code> bilan sinxronlaydi (katta yoki takroriy ko'chirish). <b>sftp</b> — interaktiv fayl sessiyasi (<code>ls</code>, <code>get</code>, <code>put</code>), ko'pincha cheklangan foydalanuvchilar uchun.</p><p>| | scp | rsync | sftp | |---|---|---|---| | Delta (faqat farq) | yo'q | ha | yo'q | | Uzilsa davom | yo'q | <code>-P</code> | <code>reget</code> | | Sinxronlash | yo'q | <code>--delete</code> | yo'q | | Interaktiv | yo'q | yo'q | ha |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>scp file.tar.gz deploy@host:/tmp/<br>scp -r -P 2222 dir/ host:/opt/              # -P katta harf = port (ssh'da -p!)<br>rsync -avzP --delete -n ./site/ host:/var/www/site/   # AVVAL dry-run<br>rsync -avzP --delete ./site/ host:/var/www/site/<br>#  -a arxiv (rekursiv, perms, owner, time, symlink)  -z siqish<br>#  -P progress + partial                             --delete manbada yo'qni o'chir<br>rsync -e &quot;ssh -p 2222&quot; --bwlimit=10m ...<br>sftp deploy@host   # sftp&gt; put file ; get file ; ls</pre><p><b>Trailing slash tuzog'i:</b></p><pre>rsync src/ dst/   -&gt; src ICHIDAGILAR dst/ ga<br>rsync src  dst/   -&gt; dst/src/ papkasi yaratiladi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--delete</code> + noto'g'ri yo'l (yoki slash) = manzildagi ma'lumot o'chadi; doim <code>-n</code> bilan boshlang.</li><li><code>scp -p</code> (kichik) — vaqtni saqlash, port emas.</li><li>OpenSSH 9.0+ da <code>scp</code> ichkarida SFTP protokolini ishlatadi; eski serverlarda <code>-O</code> kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Faqat fayl almashish kerak bo'lgan hamkorlar uchun <code>ForceCommand internal-sftp</code> + <code>ChrootDirectory</code> — shell'siz, papkaga qamalgan sftp; bu shell kirishni berishdan ancha xavfsiz.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v15 SSH

Keyingi safar kalit boshqacha bo'lsa — mijoz to'xtaydi: bu <b>MITM hujumi</b> bo'lishi mumkin yoki server qayta o'rnatilgan / IP boshqa serverga berilgan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1-ulanish: server kaliti SHA256:abc -&gt; &quot;yes&quot; -&gt; known_hosts:42 ga yoziladi<br>keyingi:   server kaliti SHA256:xyz != abc -&gt; WARNING, ulanish to'xtatiladi<br>Sabablar:  - server qayta o'rnatildi / image'dan qayta yaratildi (normal)<br>           - IP boshqa VM'ga berildi (cloud'da tez-tez)<br>           - kimdir trafikni ushlab turibdi (MITM) - xavfli!</pre><p><b>To'g'ri harakat:</b></p><pre># 1) Kalit haqiqatan o'zgarganini ISHONCHLI kanal orqali tasdiqlang:<br>#    cloud konsol / serial output / admin<br>sudo ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub   # server tomonda fingerprint<br># 2) Mos kelsa, eski yozuvni o'chiring:<br>ssh-keygen -R web1.example.com<br>ssh-keygen -R 10.0.1.20<br># 3) Qayta ulanib, ko'rsatilgan fingerprint'ni solishtiring<br>ssh web1.example.com</pre><p>AWS'da fingerprint'ni konsol chiqishidan olish mumkin: <code>aws ec2 get-console-output --instance-id i-xxx</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>StrictHostKeyChecking=no</code> yoki <code>UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null</code> ni doimiy ishlatish — MITM himoyasini butunlay o'chiradi.</li><li>Fingerprint'ni solishtirmasdan <code>ssh-keygen -R</code> qilish — himoya ma'nosi yo'qoladi.</li><li>Auto Scaling'da har yangi instance yangi kalit — shuning uchun jamoalar tekshiruvni o'chirishga moyil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta (himoya):</b> Avtomatlashtirishda tekshiruvni o'chirish o'rniga: <b>SSH host sertifikatlari</b> (CA imzolagan host key; mijozda bitta <code>@cert-authority *.example.com ...</code> qatori) yoki known_hosts'ni IaC orqali (DNS SSHFP yozuvlari, provisioning chiqishidan) to'ldiring.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v15 SSH
Interview Drill::Linux::V15 SSH & remote access	idrill-34095	<p>SSH key bilan login ostida qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SSH key login — <b>asimmetrik kriptografiya</b>: serverda sizning public key'ingiz (<code>authorized_keys</code>) bor, private key esa faqat sizda. Interview Drill::Linux::V18 TLS, certificates & Nginx	idrill-31367	<p>TLS handshake qanday ishlaydi va sertifikat nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TLS handshake'da client va server protokol versiyasi va cipher'ni kelishadi, server sertifikat bilan o'zini isbotlaydi, ikki taraf (ECDHE) orqali umumiy kalit hosil qiladi. Sertifikat &quot;bu public key haqiqatan <code>api.x.com</code>ga tegishli&quot; ekanini ishonchli CA imzosi bilan tasdiqlaydi — busiz shifrlash bor, lekin kim bilan gaplashayotganing noma'lum (MITM).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> shifrlashning o'zi yetmaydi. Hujumchi o'rtada turib o'z kalitini bersa, sen u bilan shifrlangan kanal ochasan. Sertifikat — identity isboti.</p><p><b>TLS 1.3 handshake (1 RTT):</b></p><pre>Client                                         Server<br>  ClientHello: TLS1.3, cipher'lar, SNI=api.x.com,<br>               key_share (ECDHE public) -------&gt;<br>            &lt;------- ServerHello: key_share<br>                     {Certificate}          (endi shifrlangan)<br>                     {CertificateVerify}    (private key egasi ekanini isbotlaydi)<br>                     {Finished}<br>  {Finished} --------&gt;<br>  ======== shifrlangan HTTP ========</pre><p><b>Client nimani tekshiradi:</b></p><ol><li>Zanjir: leaf -&gt; intermediate -&gt; trust store'dagi root CA (<code>/etc/ssl/certs</code>).</li><li>Domen SAN ro'yxatida bormi (CN tekshiruvi eskirgan).</li><li>Muddat: <code>notBefore</code> / <code>notAfter</code>.</li><li>Imzolar to'g'riligi; revocation (OCSP/CRL — amalda brauzerlar CRLite kabi mexanizmlar ishlatadi).</li></ol><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl s_client -connect api.x.com:443 -servername api.x.com &lt;/dev/null<br># Verify return code: 0 (ok)        &lt;- 0 bo'lmasa zanjir/domen xato<br># Protocol: TLSv1.3, Cipher: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256<br>echo | openssl s_client -connect api.x.com:443 -servername api.x.com 2&gt;/dev/null \<br>  | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -ext subjectAltName<br>curl -vI https://api.x.com</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Server intermediate sertifikatni yubormaydi — brauzer ishlaydi (cache), <code>curl</code>/Java xato beradi. <code>fullchain.pem</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>-servername</code> (SNI) berilmasa — boshqa (default) sertifikat qaytadi.</li><li>Server soati noto'g'ri — &quot;certificate not yet valid&quot;.</li><li>Ilovada <code>InsecureSkipVerify</code> / <code>verify=False</code> — himoyani butunlay o'chiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> TLS 1.0/1.1 o'chiriladi, 1.2 + 1.3 qoldiriladi; forward secrecy (ECDHE) majburiy. Servislar orasida mTLS (client ham sertifikat ko'rsatadi) — service mesh yoki SPIFFE bilan qisqa muddatli sertifikatlar, rotation avtomatik.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v18 TLS_Nginx

Ilova internetga to'g'ridan ochilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client 1.2.3.4 --HTTPS--&gt; nginx :443 --HTTP--&gt; app 127.0.0.1:8080<br>                          + X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4<br>                          + X-Forwarded-Proto: https<br>                          + Host: api.example.com</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>upstream app { server 127.0.0.1:8080; keepalive 16; }<br><br>server {<br>    listen 80;<br>    server_name api.example.com;<br><br>    location / {<br>        proxy_pass http://app;<br>        proxy_http_version 1.1;<br>        proxy_set_header Connection        &quot;&quot;;<br>        proxy_set_header Host              $host;<br>        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;<br>        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;<br>        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;<br>        proxy_connect_timeout 5s;<br>        proxy_read_timeout    60s;<br>    }<br>}</pre><pre>sudo nginx -t &amp;&amp; sudo systemctl reload nginx<br>curl -I http://api.example.com</pre><p><b><code>proxy_pass</code> slash nozikligi:</b> | Konfig | <code>/api/users</code> so'rovi backend'ga | |---|---| | <code>location /api/ { proxy_pass http://app; }</code> | <code>/api/users</code> | | <code>location /api/ { proxy_pass http://app/; }</code> | <code>/users</code> (prefiks kesiladi) |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Header'larsiz backend hamma so'rovni <code>127.0.0.1</code>dan deb ko'radi, redirect'lar <code>http://</code> va noto'g'ri host bilan chiqadi.</li><li><code>X-Forwarded-For</code>ni client o'zi soxtalashtira oladi — ilova unga faqat ishonchli proxy IP'lardan kelganda ishonsin.</li><li><code>proxy_pass</code>da hostname bo'lsa, nginx DNS'ni faqat start'da resolve qiladi — IP o'zgarsa eski joyga ketadi (<code>resolver</code> + o'zgaruvchi yoki upstream <code>resolve</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Timeout'lar zanjiri izchil bo'lsin: LB &gt; nginx &gt; ilova &gt; DB. Aks holda tashqi qatlam ichkidan oldin uzib, &quot;yetim&quot; so'rovlar ishlashda davom etadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v18 TLS_Nginx
Interview Drill::Linux::V18 TLS, certificates & Nginx	idrill-33215	<p>Nginx konfiguratsiyasini tekshirish va qayta yuklash: <code>nginx -t</code>, reload va restart farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>nginx -t</code> — konfiguratsiyani sintaksis va mantiq bo'yicha tekshiradi, hech narsani o'zgartirmaydi. <code>reload</code> — master yangi config'ni o'qib yangi worker'lar ochadi, eskilari joriy so'rovlarni tugatib chiqadi (uzilishsiz). <code>restart</code> — jarayonni to'liq to'xtatib qayta ishga tushiradi (ulanishlar uziladi).</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> xato config bilan <code>restart</code> nginx'ni umuman o'chirib qo'yadi — barcha saytlar yotadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>reload (SIGHUP):<br>  master: yangi config o'qiydi -- xato? --&gt; eski config'da qoladi, error.log'ga yozadi<br>            | ok<br>            v<br>  yangi worker'lar start -&gt; eski worker'lar &quot;graceful&quot;: joriy so'rovni tugatib chiqadi<br><br>restart:<br>  stop (hamma ulanish uziladi) -&gt; start (xato bo'lsa: nginx o'chiq qoladi!)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo nginx -t<br># nginx: the configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax is ok<br># nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful<br>sudo nginx -t &amp;&amp; sudo systemctl reload nginx     # xavfsiz odat<br>sudo nginx -T | less          # include'lar bilan yig'ilgan to'liq config<br>sudo systemctl status nginx<br>sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log</pre><p>Fayllar: <code>/etc/nginx/nginx.conf</code>, <code>/etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf</code>, Debian'da <code>sites-available/</code> + <code>sites-enabled/</code> (symlink).</p><p>| Holat | Nima ishlatish | |---|---| | config o'zgardi | <code>reload</code> | | nginx binary yangilandi | <code>restart</code> (yoki binary upgrade USR2) | | sertifikat yangilandi | <code>reload</code> | | <code>listen</code> / worker soni o'zgardi | odatda <code>reload</code> yetadi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>nginx -t</code> fayl tizimini tekshirmaydi: <code>proxy_pass</code> qilingan backend tirikmi — bilmaydi.</li><li><code>sites-available</code>da yangi fayl bor, lekin <code>sites-enabled</code>ga symlink unutilgan — config &quot;ishlamaydi&quot;.</li><li><code>nginx -t</code> boshqa foydalanuvchi bilan ishlatilsa sertifikat kalitini o'qiy olmay xato beradi — <code>sudo</code> bilan.</li><li>Uzoq WebSocket ulanishlari reload'dan keyin eski worker'larni uzoq ushlaydi — <code>worker_shutdown_timeout</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Config'ni git'da saqla, CI'da <code>nginx -t</code> (docker image ichida) ishlat, deploy'da <code>-t &amp;&amp; reload</code>. Interview Drill::Linux::V18 TLS, certificates & Nginx	idrill-33216	<p><code>server</code> va <code>location</code> bloklari qanday tanlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval <b>server</b> tanlanadi: <code>listen</code> (IP:port) mos kelganlar ichidan <code>Host</code> header <code>server_name</code>ga solishtiriladi; topilmasa <code>default_server</code> (yoki shu port'dagi birinchi server). Keyin <b>location</b>: <code>=</code> aniq moslik -&gt; eng uzun prefiks (agar <code>^~</code> bo'lsa shu yerda to'xtaydi) -&gt; regex'lar fayldagi tartibda (<code>~</code>, <code>~*</code>) -&gt; topilmasa eslab qolingan eng uzun prefiks.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> noto'g'ri tartib sababli <code>/api/</code> so'rovi statik location'ga tushadi yoki begona domen sizning saytingizni ochadi.</p><p><b>Location tanlash algoritmi:</b></p><pre>URI keldi<br>  |<br>  +-- &quot;= /uri&quot; aniq mos?  --&gt; ha: shu, tamom<br>  |<br>  +-- barcha prefiks location'lar ichidan eng uzunini eslab qol<br>  |      bu &quot;^~&quot; bilanmi? --&gt; ha: shu, regex tekshirilmaydi<br>  |<br>  +-- regex'lar (~ / ~*) fayldagi tartibda: birinchi mos --&gt; shu<br>  |<br>  +-- regex yo'q --&gt; eslab qolingan eng uzun prefiks</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>server {<br>    listen 80;<br>    server_name example.com www.example.com;<br><br>    location = /healthz        { return 200 &quot;ok\n&quot;; }          # 1. aniq<br>    location ^~ /static/       { root /var/www; }               # 2. prefiks, regex'siz<br>    location ~* \.(png|jpg)$   { expires 30d; }                 # 3. regex<br>    location /api/             { proxy_pass http://api; }       # 4. eng uzun prefiks<br>    location /                 { proxy_pass http://web; }       # 5. qolgan hammasi<br>}</pre><p>| So'rov | Tushadigan location | |---|---| | <code>/healthz</code> | <code>= /healthz</code> | | <code>/static/a.png</code> | <code>^~ /static/</code> (regex emas) | | <code>/img/a.png</code> | <code>~* \.(png|jpg)$</code> | | <code>/api/a.png</code> | regex! (<code>/api/</code> <code>^~</code> emas) | | <code>/about</code> | <code>/</code> |</p><p><b>Default server (himoya):</b></p><pre>server {<br>    listen 80 default_server;<br>    listen 443 ssl default_server;<br>    ssl_reject_handshake on;    # noma'lum SNI'ga sertifikat ham bermaydi<br>    return 444;                 # javobsiz ulanishni yopadi<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>default_server</code>siz noma'lum Host (yoki to'g'ridan IP) bilan kelgan so'rov birinchi server'ga tushadi — boshqa saytingiz ochilib qoladi, Host header injection'ga yo'l.</li><li>Regex location prefiks'dan ustun — <code>/api/x.png</code> kutilmaganda statik qoidaga tushadi.</li><li><code>root</code> vs <code>alias</code> farqi: <code>alias</code> location prefiksini almashtiradi, <code>root</code> qo'shadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Murakkab config'da <code>nginx -T</code> va <code>curl -H 'Host: ...'</code> bilan har muhim yo'lni test qil; regex'ni kam ishlat — tartibga bog'liqlik xatolarning asosiy manbai.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v18 TLS_Nginx

Interview Drill::Linux::V18 TLS, certificates & Nginx	idrill-33219	<p>Nginx bilan load balancing: <code>upstream</code>, algoritmlar, health check?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>upstream</code> blokida backend serverlar ro'yxati beriladi, <code>proxy_pass http://&lt;upstream&gt;</code> ular orasida yuklamani taqsimlaydi. Algoritmlar: default round-robin, <code>least_conn</code>, <code>ip_hash</code>, <code>hash &lt;key&gt;</code>, <code>weight</code>. Open source nginx'da <b>passive</b> health check (<code>max_fails</code>/<code>fail_timeout</code>); active health check — NGINX Plus yoki tashqi vosita.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> bitta backend — SPOF va o'tkazish chegarasi. Bir nechta instansiya ortida LB bilan biri o'lsa ham xizmat ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            +--&gt; 10.0.1.10  (ok)<br>client -&gt; nginx --&gt; 10.0.1.11  (3 marta xato -&gt; 10s chiqariladi)<br>            +--&gt; 10.0.1.12  backup (faqat hammasi yiqilsa)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>upstream api {<br>    least_conn;                                       # eng kam aktiv ulanishli server<br>    server 10.0.1.10:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;<br>    server 10.0.1.11:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s weight=2;<br>    server 10.0.1.12:8080 backup;<br>    keepalive 32;                                     # backend ulanishlarini qayta ishlatish<br>}<br>server {<br>    location / {<br>        proxy_pass http://api;<br>        proxy_http_version 1.1;<br>        proxy_set_header Connection &quot;&quot;;               # keepalive uchun shart<br>        proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502;<br>        proxy_next_upstream_tries 2;<br>    }<br>}</pre><p>| Algoritm | Qachon | |---|---| | round-robin | so'rovlar bir xil, oddiy holat | | <code>least_conn</code> | so'rov davomiyligi har xil, uzun so'rovlar | | <code>ip_hash</code> | oddiy sticky session (NAT ortida notekis) | | <code>hash $key consistent</code> | cache serverlar, shard bo'yicha |</p><p>Access log'ga <code>$upstream_addr $upstream_status $upstream_response_time</code> qo'shib qaysi backend sekinligini ko'r.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Passive health check faqat real so'rov xato berganda ishlaydi — ba'zi foydalanuvchilar baribir xato ko'radi.</li><li><code>proxy_next_upstream</code> POST'ni ham qayta yuborishi mumkin (<code>non_idempotent</code> qo'shilsa) — to'lovni ikki marta yechish xavfi. Default'da non-idempotent qayta yuborilmaydi — shunday qoldir.</li><li><code>keepalive</code> bor, lekin <code>Connection &quot;&quot;</code> va HTTP/1.1 yo'q — ulanishlar qayta ishlatilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sticky session'ga tayanish — ilova stateful degani; session'ni Redis/DB'ga chiqarib stateless qil. Cloud'da managed LB (ALB/NLB) active health check bilan odatda nginx'ning o'z balansidan ishonchliroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v18 TLS_Nginx
Interview Drill::Linux::V18 TLS, certificates & Nginx	idrill-33220	<p>502 Bad Gateway va 504 Gateway Timeout — farqi va qanday debug qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>502 Bad Gateway</b> — nginx backend'dan umuman yaroqli javob ololmadi (ulanish rad etildi, uzildi, noto'g'ri javob). <b>504 Gateway Timeout</b> — backend'ga ulandi, lekin belgilangan vaqtda (<code>proxy_read_timeout</code>, default 60s) javob kelmadi. Interview Drill::Linux::V18 TLS, certificates & Nginx	idrill-33221	<p>Nginx'da rate limiting va asosiy himoya sozlamalari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Nginx'da <code>limit_req</code> (so'rov tezligi, leaky bucket) va <code>limit_conn</code> (bir vaqtdagi ulanishlar) bilan IP bo'yicha cheklov qo'yiladi; qo'shimcha himoya: <code>server_tokens off</code>, <code>client_max_body_size</code>, timeout'lar, xavfsizlik header'lari, faqat TLS 1.2/1.3. Maqsad — brute force, scraping va oddiy DoS'dan backend'ni himoya qilish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> login endpoint'ga sekundiga minglab parol urinishi yoki bitta bot hamma worker'larni band qilishi — ilova o'zi buni arzon to'xtata olmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (leaky bucket):</b></p><pre>so'rovlar --&gt; [ chelak: burst=20 ] --&gt; 10 r/s tezlikda o'tadi<br>              to'lsa --&gt; 429 (limit_req_status)<br>nodelay: burst ichidagilar kutmasdan o'tadi, ortig'i darhol rad</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>http {<br>    limit_req_zone  $binary_remote_addr zone=login:10m rate=5r/m;<br>    limit_req_zone  $binary_remote_addr zone=api:10m   rate=10r/s;<br>    limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=conn:10m;<br><br>    server_tokens off;                # versiyani yashirish<br>    client_max_body_size 10m;<br>    client_body_timeout 10s;<br>    client_header_timeout 10s;<br><br>    server {<br>        add_header Strict-Transport-Security &quot;max-age=31536000&quot; always;<br>        add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;<br><br>        location = /api/login {<br>            limit_req zone=login burst=5 nodelay;<br>            limit_req_status 429;<br>            proxy_pass http://api;<br>        }<br>        location /api/ {<br>            limit_req zone=api burst=20 nodelay;<br>            limit_conn conn 20;<br>            proxy_pass http://api;<br>        }<br>    }<br>}</pre><pre>sudo nginx -t &amp;&amp; sudo systemctl reload nginx<br>for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} ' https://site/api/x; done<br># 200 200 ... 429 429   &lt;- limit ishlayapti<br>grep 'limiting requests' /var/log/nginx/error.log</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Nginx LB/CDN ortida bo'lsa <code>$remote_addr</code> = LB IP — hamma foydalanuvchi bitta limitga tushadi. Tuzatish: <code>set_real_ip_from &lt;LB CIDR&gt;; real_ip_header X-Forwarded-For; real_ip_recursive on;</code> — faqat ishonchli manbadan.</li><li>Korporativ NAT ortidagi yuzlab foydalanuvchi bitta IP — limitni juda past qo'yma; autentifikatsiyalangan API uchun API key/user bo'yicha limit yaxshiroq.</li><li><code>add_header</code> ichki blokda yozilsa tashqi bloklardagi <code>add_header</code>lar meros olinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Nginx limit — birinchi qatlam, bitta node xotirasida. Haqiqiy DDoS'ga qarshi CDN/WAF (Cloudflare, AWS Shield/WAF) kerak; ko'p node'da global limit Redis asosida ilova/gateway darajasida. Interview Drill::Linux::V18 TLS, certificates & Nginx	idrill-33223	<p>Nginx'da WebSocket va gRPC proxy qilishning o'ziga xosligi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>WebSocket</b> HTTP/1.1 <code>Upgrade</code> mexanizmi bilan boshlanadi — nginx <code>Upgrade</code> va <code>Connection</code> header'larini backend'ga ochiq uzatishi va uzoq jim ulanishlar uchun <code>proxy_read_timeout</code>ni oshirishi kerak. <b>gRPC</b> HTTP/2 ustida ishlaydi — <code>http2 on</code> va <code>proxy_pass</code> o'rniga <code>grpc_pass</code> ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> default nginx hop-by-hop header'larni (<code>Upgrade</code>, <code>Connection</code>) uzatmaydi va backend'ga HTTP/1.0 bilan boradi — WebSocket ulanmaydi. 60s jimlikdan keyin ulanish uziladi. gRPC'ni oddiy <code>proxy_pass</code> bilan proxy qilib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>WebSocket:<br>client: GET /ws  Upgrade: websocket, Connection: Upgrade<br>nginx  -&gt;                       # nginx 1.25.1+ sintaksisi<br>    server_name app.example.com;<br><br>    location /ws/ {<br>        proxy_pass http://ws_backend;<br>        proxy_http_version 1.1;<br>        proxy_set_header Upgrade    $http_upgrade;<br>        proxy_set_header Connection $connection_upgrade;<br>        proxy_set_header Host       $host;<br>        proxy_read_timeout 1h;      # default 60s: jim ulanish uziladi<br>    }<br><br>    location /payments.v1.PaymentService/ {<br>        grpc_pass grpc://10.0.1.20:9090;      # TLS backend uchun grpcs://<br>        grpc_read_timeout 300s;               # streaming RPC uchun<br>        grpc_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;<br>    }<br>}</pre><pre>websocat wss://app.example.com/ws/<br>grpcurl app.example.com:443 list</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>proxy_read_timeout</code>ni oshirmay, ilovada ping/pong (heartbeat) ham yo'q — ulanishlar har 60s'da uziladi.</li><li>Reload'da eski worker WebSocket ulanishlari tugaguncha yashaydi (xotira o'sadi) — <code>worker_shutdown_timeout 30s</code> va client'da reconnect + backoff.</li><li>Ko'p WebSocket — har biri fd; <code>worker_connections</code> va <code>LimitNOFILE</code>ni oshir.</li><li>Eski <code>listen 443 ssl http2;</code> sintaksisi deprecated — yangi versiyada <code>http2 on;</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Uzoq yashovchi ulanishlar deploy va load balancing'ni murakkablashtiradi: yangi instansiyaga yuk o'tmaydi, drain uzoq.  hajm + mtime farqli fayllar<br>                               v<br>               faqat o'zgargan bloklar (checksum) --&gt; yig'ib yoziladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>rsync -avz --progress /var/www/ user@backup:/srv/www/   # SSH orqali<br>rsync -avzn --delete src/ dst/     # -n: dry-run, nima bo'lishini ko'rsatadi<br>rsync -avz --delete src/ dst/      # dst'dagi ortiqcha fayllarni o'chiradi (mirror)<br>rsync -avP big.iso host:/tmp/      # -P = --partial --progress (uzilsa davom etadi)<br>rsync -avz --exclude 'node_modules' --exclude '*.log' app/ host:/opt/app/</pre><p>| Flag | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>-a</code> | archive: rekursiv + huquq, egasi, vaqt, symlink | | <code>-v</code> | nima ko'chirilayotganini ko'rsatadi | | <code>-z</code> | tarmoqda siqish | | <code>-n</code> | dry-run | | <code>--delete</code> | manbada yo'q fayllarni nishondan o'chiradi |</p><p><b>Slash qoidasi:</b> | Buyruq | Natija | |---|---| | <code>rsync -a src/ dst/</code> | <code>src</code> ichidagilar <code>dst/</code> ichiga | | <code>rsync -a src dst/</code> | <code>dst/src/</code> papka yaratiladi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--delete</code> + yo'lni adashtirish (<code>src</code> vs <code>src/</code>, yoki manba bo'sh) = nishonni tozalab yuborish. Avval har doim <code>-n</code>.</li><li>Egasi (<code>-o</code>, <code>-g</code>) saqlanishi uchun nishonda root huquqi kerak.</li><li><code>rsync</code> backup emas: manbada fayl o'chsa yoki shifrlansa (ransomware), keyingi <code>--delete</code> uni backup'dan ham o'chiradi — versiyali backup (restic, borg) ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Deploy uchun <code>rsync</code> qulay, lekin atomik emas — ko'chirish yarmida ilova aralash versiya ko'radi. Interview Drill::Linux::V20 Server bilan ishlash	idrill-31436	<p>Service'ni boshqarish: ishga tushirish, to'xtatish, qayta yuklash, log ko'rish.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zamonaviy Linux'da servislar systemd orqali boshqariladi: <code>systemctl start|stop|restart|reload|status &lt;servis&gt;</code>, boot'da ishga tushishi uchun <code>enable</code>, log'lar uchun <code>journalctl -u &lt;servis&gt;</code>.</p><p><b>Nega systemd:</b> u servisni kuzatadi (yiqilsa qayta ko'taradi), log'larni yig'adi, bog'liqliklar tartibini boshqaradi — qo'lda <code>nohup</code> bilan ishga tushirishdan ishonchli.</p><p><b>Buyruqlar:</b></p><pre>start    -&gt; Keng tarqalgan xatolar: minimal PATH, <code>%</code> belgisini ekranlamaslik, chiqishni log'ga yo'naltirmaslik, timezone va job'ning ikki marta parallel ishlashi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># m   h  dom mon dow  command<br>*/5   *  *   *   *    /opt/app/bin/cleanup &gt;&gt; /var/log/cleanup.log 2&gt;&amp;1<br>0     3  *   *   *    /usr/local/bin/backup.sh<br>0     9  *   *   1-5  /opt/app/report.sh                # ish kunlari 09:00<br>0     0  1   *   *    /opt/app/monthly.sh               # har oy 1-sanasi</pre><pre>crontab -e            # o'z jadvali<br>crontab -l<br>ls /etc/cron.d/       # tizim/paket job'lari (user maydoni bilan)<br>grep CRON /var/log/syslog | tail</pre><p><b>Xatolar va yechimlar:</b> | Xato | Belgisi | Yechim | |---|---|---| | Minimal PATH | qo'lda ishlaydi, cron'da <code>command not found</code> | to'liq yo'l yoki <code>PATH=</code> qatori | | <code>%</code> maxsus belgi | buyruq kesilib qoladi | <code>date +\%F</code> | | Chiqish yo'q | xato ko'rinmaydi | <code>&gt;&gt; log 2&gt;&amp;1</code> | | Parallel ishlash | oldingi tugamay keyingisi boshlanadi | <code>flock -n /run/lock/x.lock cmd</code> | | Timezone | &quot;noto'g'ri vaqtda&quot; ishlaydi | <code>timedatectl</code>, UTC hisobla | | Env yo'q | <code>.bashrc</code> o'qilmaydi | skript ichida o'zgaruvchilarni o'rnat |</p><p>Overlap himoyasi:</p><pre>*/5 * * * * flock -n /run/lock/cleanup.lock /opt/app/bin/cleanup &gt;&gt; /var/log/cleanup.log 2&gt;&amp;1</pre><p><b>Alternativ — systemd timer:</b></p><pre># /etc/systemd/system/backup.timer<br>[Timer]<br>OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:00:00<br>Persistent=true          # server o'chiq bo'lgan vaqtdagini keyin bajaradi<br>[Install]<br>WantedBy=timers.target</pre><p><code>systemctl enable --now backup.timer</code>, <code>systemctl list-timers</code>. Log journald'da, job o'zi parallel ishlamaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p server (HA)da bir xil crontab — job har serverda ishlaydi (ikki marta email, ikki marta to'lov). Interview Drill::Linux::V20 Server bilan ishlash	idrill-31438	<p>Server'da fayl va papka huquqlari: ilova 'Permission denied' bermoqda. Qanday tuzatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval ilova qaysi user bilan ishlashini aniqla, keyin fayl va <b>yo'ldagi har bir papka</b> huquqini tekshir (<code>namei -l</code>), egasini/huquqini minimal kerakli darajada to'g'rila (<code>chown</code>, <code>chmod</code>). Huquq to'g'ri bo'lsa ham rad etilsa — SELinux/AppArmor. <code>chmod 777</code> — yechim emas.</p><p><b>Qanday tekshiriladi:</b></p><pre>process user (app) --&gt; /var/lib/app/data.db ni ochmoqchi<br>  /        x kerak (kirish)<br>  /var     x<br>  /var/lib x<br>  /var/lib/app  x (+ yangi fayl yaratish uchun w)<br>  data.db  r yoki rw<br>  bitta &quot;x&quot; yo'q -&gt; Permission denied<br>  hammasi ok, baribir rad -&gt; SELinux/AppArmor, ACL, ro mount, chattr +i</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ps -o user,pid,cmd -C myapp          # process qaysi user<br>systemctl show myapp -p User         # systemd servis user'i<br>namei -l /var/lib/app/data.db        # yo'ldagi har papka huquqi<br># f: /var/lib/app/data.db<br># drwxr-xr-x root root /<br># drwx------ root root app      &lt;- app user kira olmaydi<br>sudo -u app cat /var/lib/app/data.db # aynan shu user nomidan sinash<br><br>sudo chown -R app:app /var/lib/app<br>sudo chmod 750 /var/lib/app          # egasi to'liq, guruh o'qiydi<br>sudo chmod 640 /etc/app/env          # secret: boshqalar o'qimasin<br><br># huquq to'g'ri, baribir rad:<br>sudo ausearch -m avc -ts recent      # SELinux rad etishlari<br>sudo restorecon -Rv /var/lib/app     # SELinux kontekstini tiklash<br>getfacl /var/lib/app                 # ACL<br>lsattr /var/lib/app/data.db          # chattr +i (immutable)?<br>findmnt /var/lib/app                 # ro mount emasmi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>chmod -R 777</code> — har qanday user (shu jumladan buzilgan boshqa servis) yozishi va kod joylashi mumkin; to'g'ri kontekst/boolean qo'y.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Least privilege: ilova o'z user'ida, faqat kerakli papkaga yozish huquqi bilan. systemd'da <code>StateDirectory=app</code> va <code>ProtectSystem=strict</code> + <code>ReadWritePaths=</code> — huquqlarni systemd o'zi to'g'ri yaratadi va qolgan tizimni faqat o'qish uchun qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v20 Server_operations
Interview Drill::Linux::V20 Server bilan ishlash	idrill-33000	<p>Process'ni to'xtatish: <code>kill</code>, <code>kill -9</code>, <code>pkill</code>. SIGTERM va SIGKILL farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>kill PID</code> default <b>SIGTERM</b> (15) yuboradi — process'dan muloyim to'xtashni so'raydi: u joriy ishni tugatib, fayllarni yopib chiqa oladi. <code>kill -9</code> — <b>SIGKILL</b>: kernel process'ni darhol o'ldiradi, ushlab bo'lmaydi, tozalash bo'lmaydi. <code>pkill</code>/<code>killall</code> — nom bo'yicha signal yuboradi. Avval SIGTERM, kutish, faqat keyin SIGKILL.</p><p><b>Nega <code>-9</code> oxirgi chora:</b> buffer flush bo'lmaydi, lock va temp fayllar qoladi, DB yozuvi yoki fayl yarim qolishi, child process'lar yetim qolishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SIGTERM -&gt; process handler: so'rovlarni tugat, ulanishlarni yop, exit 0<br>           (handler yo'q bo'lsa default — darhol chiqadi)<br>SIGKILL -&gt; kernel: process'ni darhol olib tashlaydi (handler yo'q)<br>SIGHUP  -&gt; ko'p daemon'da: config'ni qayta o'qish<br>SIGINT  -&gt; Ctrl-C</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pgrep -a myapp                 # PID va to'liq buyruq<br>kill 1234                      # SIGTERM<br>sleep 10; kill -0 1234 &amp;&amp; echo &quot;hali tirik&quot;   # -0: faqat mavjudligini tekshiradi<br>kill -9 1234                   # oxirgi chora<br>pkill -f 'python worker.py'    # to'liq buyruq satri bo'yicha<br>kill -HUP $(pidof nginx)       # nginx: config qayta o'qish<br>kill -l                        # signallar ro'yxati</pre><p>systemd servisi bo'lsa — <code>systemctl stop app</code> ishlat: u SIGTERM yuboradi, <code>TimeoutStopSec</code> kutadi, keyin SIGKILL, butun cgroup'ni (child'lar bilan) to'xtatadi.</p><p><b><code>kill -9</code> ham o'ldirmasa:</b> | Holat | <code>ps</code> STAT | Sabab | |---|---|---| | D | <code>D</code> | uninterruptible I/O (NFS, disk) — I/O tugashini kutadi | | Zombie | <code>Z</code> | allaqachon o'lgan; ota-process <code>wait()</code> qilmagan — otasini tuzat/restart |</p><pre>ps -o pid,ppid,stat,cmd -p 1234</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>pkill -f python</code> — serverdagi barcha python process'larni o'ldiradi. Avval <code>pgrep -af</code> bilan ro'yxatni ko'r.</li><li>Container'da PID 1 bo'lgan ilova SIGTERM handler'siz — signal e'tiborsiz qoladi, 10s'dan keyin SIGKILL. <code>tini</code>/<code>--init</code> yoki handler.</li><li>Restart skriptlarida darhol <code>kill -9</code> — har deploy'da ma'lumot buzilish xavfi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Graceful shutdown ilova dizaynining qismi: SIGTERM'da yangi so'rov qabul qilishni to'xtat, readiness'ni false qil, joriylarini tugat, keyin chiq. Deploy paytidagi 502'lar ko'pincha shu yo'qligidan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::linux sec::v20 Server_operations
