Interview Drill::Linux::V20 Server bilan ishlash	idrill-31424	<p><code>ulimit</code>, <code>nofile</code>, <code>Too many open files</code> — sabab va to'g'ri sozlash.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux'da har process ochadigan fayl deskriptorlari (fayl, socket, pipe) soni cheklangan: process limiti <code>RLIMIT_NOFILE</code> (<code>ulimit -n</code>, ko'pincha default 1024) va tizim limiti <code>fs.file-max</code>. Limitga yetsa <code>EMFILE: Too many open files</code>. To'g'ri sozlash: systemd servisida <code>LimitNOFILE=</code>, login sessiyalar uchun <code>/etc/security/limits.conf</code>. Lekin avval — bu haqiqiy ehtiyojmi yoki fd leak?</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2000 ta WebSocket client'li ilova 1024 limitga yetadi — yangi ulanishlar rad etiladi, log fayl ham ochilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>process fd jadvali: 0 stdin, 1 stdout, 2 stderr, 3 log, 4.. socket'lar<br>       soft limit (ulimit -n)  &lt;=  hard limit  &lt;=  fs.nr_open<br>       tizim bo'yicha jami      &lt;=  fs.file-max<br>limitlar qayerdan:<br>  login shell    &lt;- PAM pam_limits &lt;- /etc/security/limits.conf<br>  systemd servis &lt;- unit faylidagi LimitNOFILE (limits.conf ta'sir QILMAYDI)<br>  container      &lt;- runtime (--ulimit nofile=)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/limits | grep 'open files'   # process'ning HAQIQIY limiti<br>ls /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/fd | wc -l                     # hozir nechta ochiq<br>lsof -p &lt;pid&gt; | awk '{print $5}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn   # turi: IPv4, REG, FIFO<br>ss -tanp | grep 'pid=&lt;pid&gt;' | awk '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c # CLOSE_WAIT ko'pmi<br>sysctl fs.file-nr                             # tizim: ishlatilgan / max</pre><p>systemd servis uchun:</p><pre>sudo systemctl edit app<br># [Service]<br># LimitNOFILE=65536<br>sudo systemctl daemon-reload &amp;&amp; sudo systemctl restart app<br>cat /proc/$(pidof app)/limits | grep 'open files'   # tasdiqlash</pre><p><b>Leak yoki ehtiyoj:</b></p><pre>watch -n 60 'ls /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/fd | wc -l'</pre><p>Son yuk bilan birga o'sib-tushsa — ehtiyoj, limitni oshir. Yuk tushganda ham to'xtovsiz o'ssa — <b>leak</b>: yopilmagan HTTP response body (Go'da <code>resp.Body.Close()</code>), fayl, DB connection. Ko'p <code>CLOSE_WAIT</code> — ilova socket'ni yopmayapti.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>limits.conf</code>ni o'zgartirib systemd servisini restart qilish — hech narsa o'zgarmaydi.</li><li><code>ulimit -n</code> joriy shell'ni ko'rsatadi, ishlab turgan process'nikini emas — <code>/proc/&lt;pid&gt;/limits</code>ga qara.</li><li>Limitni 1 mln ga ko'tarib leak'ni &quot;tuzatish&quot; — faqat kechiktiradi, keyin xotira yoki ephemeral portlar tugaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> fd sonini metrikaga chiqar (<code>process_open_fds</code> / <code>process_max_fds</code>) va 80% da alert qo'y. Himoya: ilovalarga xotira limiti (<code>MemoryMax</code>, container limit), muhim process'larga <code>OOMScoreAdjust</code>, kichik swap, xotira monitoringi — va asosiysi, nega xotira o'sayotganini topish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> cheklanmagan cache bilan ilova o'sib bordi, OOM killer PostgreSQL'ni o'ldirdi (eng katta process) — butun tizim yiqildi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>xotira bosimi<br>  1. page cache bo'shatiladi (arzon)<br>  2. anonim sahifalar -&gt; swap (sekinlashadi, si/so &gt; 0)<br>  3. swap ham tugadi / yo'q -&gt; OOM killer<br>       oom_score = xotira ulushi + oom_score_adj (-1000..1000)<br>       eng yuqorisi SIGKILL<br>cgroup limiti (MemoryMax) bo'lsa: OOM faqat shu cgroup ichida -&gt; qo'shnilar omon</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dmesg -T | grep -iE 'killed process|out of memory'<br># Out of memory: Killed process 2211 (postgres) total-vm:..., anon-rss:6.1GB<br>journalctl -k | grep -i oom<br>free -h<br>vmstat 1 5                        # si/so doimiy &gt; 0 = swap thrashing<br>cat /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/oom_score<br>ps aux --sort=-rss | head         # eng ko'p RSS</pre><pre># app.service — ilova o'z limitida o'lsin, server emas<br>[Service]<br>MemoryMax=2G<br>MemoryHigh=1.8G                    # bu yerda kernel sekinlashtira boshlaydi<br># DB servisi — oxirgi navbatda o'ldirilsin<br>OOMScoreAdjust=-500</pre><p>Kichik swap (VPS):</p><pre>sudo fallocate -l 2G /swapfile &amp;&amp; sudo chmod 600 /swapfile<br>sudo mkswap /swapfile &amp;&amp; sudo swapon /swapfile<br>echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab<br>sudo sysctl vm.swappiness=10       # doimiy: /etc/sysctl.d/</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>OOMScoreAdjust=-1000</code> hamma narsaga — OOM killer o'ldiradigan process topolmay, tizim butunlay osilib qoladi.</li><li>Katta swap — OOM o'rniga soatlab thrashing: server &quot;tirik&quot;, lekin javob bermaydi. Swap kichik bo'lsin.</li><li>Konteynerda limit yo'q — bitta container butun node'ni OOM qiladi.</li><li>Go/Java'da runtime limitni bilmaydi: Go'da <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code>, Java'da <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> OOM — simptom. Qaysi bosqich sekin bo'lsa, o'sha qatlamni chuqur tekshir: DNS — resolver; TCP — yo'l, packet loss (<code>mtr</code>), firewall/conntrack, ephemeral port; TLS — handshake, OCSP; TTFB — tashqi API o'zi sekin. Uzilishlar uchun <code>tcpdump</code> bilan haqiqiy paketlarni ko'r.</p><p><b>Qanday fikrlash:</b></p><pre>curl -w:  dns  -&gt; tcp  -&gt; tls  -&gt; ttfb  -&gt; total<br>          |       |       |       |<br>       resolver  yo'l/   handshake  server tomoni<br>       timeout   SYN drop  CPU/OCSP   (bizniki emas, timeout qo'y)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -o /dev/null -s -w 'dns=%{time_namelookup} tcp=%{time_connect} tls=%{time_appconnect} ttfb=%{time_starttransfer} total=%{time_total}\n' https://api.example.com<br># dns=5.012 tcp=5.040 ...   &lt;- DNS 5s: resolver timeout (birinchi nameserver o'lik)<br><br>mtr -rwc 50 api.example.com            # loss qaysi hop'dan boshlanadi<br>ss -tan state syn-sent                 # javobsiz ulanish urinishlari<br>ss -s                                  # TIME-WAIT soni<br>sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range    # ephemeral port diapazoni<br>conntrack -S 2&gt;/dev/null | grep -i drop; dmesg | grep -i 'nf_conntrack: table full'<br>sudo tcpdump -i any -nn host 1.2.3.4 and port 443 -w cap.pcap   # keyin Wireshark<br>getent ahosts api.example.com          # IPv4 va IPv6 manzillar<br>curl -4 -v https://api.example.com     # faqat IPv4 bilan solishtir</pre><p><b>Tipik sabablar:</b> | Belgi | Sabab | |---|---| | <code>dns</code> ~5s | <code>resolv.conf</code>dagi birinchi DNS javob bermaydi | | <code>tcp</code> sekin, ba'zan timeout | packet loss, SYN drop, conntrack to'lgan | | ko'p TIME-WAIT, <code>cannot assign requested address</code> | connection reuse yo'q, ephemeral port tugagan | | birinchi urinish sekin, <code>-4</code> tez | AAAA bor, IPv6 marshrut yo'q | | <code>ttfb</code> katta | tashqi servis sekin | | cloud'da kunduzi uzilish | NAT gateway port/ulanish limiti |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>HTTP client'da timeout yo'q — tashqi API osilsa goroutine/thread'lar to'planib ilova o'ladi.</li><li>Har so'rovga yangi ulanish (keepalive yo'q) — TLS handshake narxi va port tugashi.</li><li>Retry'lar backoff'siz — sekin servisni yanada bosib qo'yadi (retry storm).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tashqi bog'liqlik uchun: connect/read timeout, connection pool, jitter'li exponential backoff, circuit breaker va per-dependency metrika (latency p99, xato ulushi). Shunda &quot;tarmoq sekin&quot; degan taxmin o'rniga dashboard qaysi qatlam ekanini ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::v20 Server_operations

Interview Drill::Linux::V20 Server bilan ishlash	idrill-33015	<p><code>strace</code>, <code>lsof</code>, <code>tcpdump</code>: process 'osilib qoldi'. Ichida nima bo'layotganini qanday ko'rasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval process holatini aniqla (<code>/proc/&lt;pid&gt;/status</code>, <code>wchan</code>): CPU yeyaptimi, uxlayaptimi, D state'dami. <code>strace</code> — process qaysi syscall'da turganini ko'rsatadi (masalan <code>connect</code> yoki <code>futex</code>), <code>lsof</code> — qaysi fayl va socket'lar ochiq, <code>tcpdump</code> — tarmoqda haqiqatan nima bo'layapti. Interview Drill::Linux::V20 Server bilan ishlash	idrill-33020	<p>Capacity planning: server qachon kichik bo'lib qoladi? Qanday o'lchab, bashorat qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Capacity planning — bitta server (yoki tizim) qancha yukni SLO ichida ko'tarishini <b>o'lchash</b> (load test, sinish nuqtasi va bottleneck), o'sish trendini prod metrikalardan <b>bashorat qilish</b> va yetarli zahira (headroom, N+1) bilan oldindan kengaytirish. Server &quot;kichik bo'lib qoladi&quot; — p99 latency yoki xato ulushi SLO'dan chiqqanda, CPU 100% bo'lganda emas.</p><p><b>Jarayon:</b></p><pre>1. SLO:          p99 &lt; 300ms, xato &lt; 0.1%<br>2. load test:    RPS'ni bosqichma-bosqich oshir -&gt; p99 qaysi RPS'da SLO'dan chiqadi?<br>                 nima birinchi to'yinadi: CPU? DB connection? lock? tarmoq?<br>3. trend:        prod RPS, disk, DB hajmi oyiga necha % o'syapti<br>4. hisob:        kerakli server = peak RPS x (1 + headroom) / bitta server RPS, + 1 (N+1)<br>5. qaror:        qachon va qanday kengaytirish (vertical / horizontal / bottleneck'ni tuzatish)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s --latency https://staging.example.com/api/items<br># Latency Distribution  50% 45ms  99% 410ms   &lt;- SLO buzildi<br># Requests/sec: 1850<br>k6 run --vus 300 --duration 10m load.js      # stsenariy bo'yicha, bosqichli</pre><p>Misol hisob: peak 3000 RPS, bitta server SLO ichida 1000 RPS, headroom 30% -&gt; 3000 x 1.3 / 1000 = 3.9 -&gt; 4 server + 1 (N+1) = 5.</p><p>Bashorat (Prometheus):</p><pre>predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint=&quot;/&quot;}[7d], 30*24*3600) &lt; 0   # 30 kunda disk tugaydi</pre><p>USE metodi har resurs uchun: Utilization, Saturation (navbat), Errors.</p><p><b>Vertical vs horizontal:</b> | | Vertical (kattaroq server) | Horizontal (ko'proq server) | |---|---|---| | Soddalik | oddiy, kod o'zgarmaydi | stateless bo'lishi shart | | Chegara | eng katta instansiya | deyarli cheksiz | | Mavjudlik | SPOF qoladi | biri o'lsa ham ishlaydi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Load test real bo'lmagan ma'lumot bilan (bo'sh DB, bitta endpoint, cache issiq) — prod'da natija boshqacha.</li><li>O'rtacha CPU'ga qarash — peak va p99 muhim.</li><li>Bottleneck DB yoki tashqi API bo'lsa, app server qo'shish yordam bermaydi, hatto DB connection'larni ko'paytirib yomonlashtiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Capacity — iqtisodiy qaror ham: headroom narxini incident narxi bilan solishtir. Har chorakda sinish nuqtasini qayta o'lcha — kod o'zgarishi bilan bitta serverning sig'imi ham o'zgaradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::v20 Server_operations

SSH faqat favqulodda (break-glass). Ko'p server, tez-tez deploy, drift muammosi va compliance bo'lsa to'g'ri; 1-2 server va kichik jamoa uchun ko'pincha ortiqcha murakkablik.</p><p><b>Mutable vs immutable:</b></p><pre>mutable:    server --ssh/ansible--&gt; o'zgartir --&gt; o'zgartir --&gt; (drift, snowflake)<br>immutable:  kod -&gt; build image v42 -&gt; test -&gt; deploy (yangi serverlar) -&gt; eskilarini o'chir<br>            rollback = v41 image'dan qayta ko'tarish</pre><p><b>Yetuklik bosqichlari:</b></p><ol><li>Qo'lda SSH (pet) — 1 server, MVP.</li><li>Ansible bilan mutable config — bir necha server, takrorlanadigan.</li><li>Golden image (Packer) + autoscaling group yoki container — SSH faqat break-glass.</li><li>Kubernetes / serverless — server abstraksiya qilingan.</li></ol><p><b>Amalda (namuna):</b></p><pre># packer: image yasash<br>source &quot;amazon-ebs&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  source_ami_filter { filters = { name = &quot;ubuntu/images/*24.04*&quot; } owners = [&quot;099720477109&quot;] most_recent = true }<br>  instance_type = &quot;t3.small&quot;<br>  ami_name      = &quot;app-{{timestamp}}&quot;<br>}<br>build {<br>  sources = [&quot;source.amazon-ebs.app&quot;]<br>  provisioner &quot;ansible&quot; { playbook_file = &quot;site.yml&quot; }<br>}</pre><pre>packer build app.pkr.hcl<br># Terraform launch template'da yangi AMI -&gt; ASG instance refresh (rolling)<br>aws autoscaling start-instance-refresh --auto-scaling-group-name app-asg</pre><p><b>Qachon to'g'ri:</b> serverlar soni o'smoqda, drift sababli incident'lar bor, audit/compliance talabi, tez autoscaling, xavfsizlik (SSH yo'q = hujum yuzasi kichik). <b>Qachon ortiqcha:</b> 1-2 server, oyda bir deploy, image pipeline'ni yuritadigan odam yo'q.</p><p><b>Shartlar (bularsiz immutable og'riqli):</b></p><ul><li>Log, metrika, trace server tashqarisida — server o'lsa ham ma'lumot qoladi.</li><li>Holat (DB, fayl) alohida — server ichida hech narsa saqlanmaydi.</li><li>Debug SSH'siz mumkin: pprof endpoint, tracing, SSM ephemeral sessiya.</li><li>Image build tez va avtomatik; xavfsizlik patch'i = yangi image, soatlar ichida.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Immutable&quot;, lekin har kuni break-glass SSH bilan tuzatish — aslida mutable, faqat yomonroq.</li><li>Image eskiradi: muntazam qayta qurish va CVE scan bo'lmasa, eski paketlar bilan yashaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Principal savoli: &quot;Bu complexity qaysi muammoni hal qiladi va uni qanday o'lchaymiz?&quot; — drift incident'lari soni, MTTR, deploy chastotasi. Muammo yo'q joyda pattern qo'llash — xarajat.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::v20 Server_operations

Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41451	<p>Linux boot jarayonini quvvat yoqilishidan login'gacha tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Firmware (BIOS/UEFI) → bootloader (GRUB) → kernel + initramfs → root fayl tizimini mount → PID 1 (systemd) → target'lar va servislar → login (getty / display manager / sshd).</p><p><b>Bosqichma-bosqich:</b></p><pre>[Quvvat]<br>   v<br>1. GRUB2       /boot/grub2/grub.cfg o'qiydi, menyu, kernel tanlanadi<br>   v           vmlinuz + initramfs ni RAM'ga yuklaydi, kernel cmdline beradi<br>3. Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41452	<p><code>systemd</code> nima va unit, target, timer nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> systemd — zamonaviy Linux'ning <b>init tizimi (PID 1)</b> va servis menejeri. <b>Unit</b> — u boshqaradigan har bir obyekt (servis, mount, socket, timer). <b>Target</b> — unit'lar guruhi / tizim holati (runlevel o'rnida). <b>Timer</b> — cron o'rnini bosuvchi rejali ishga tushirish.</p><p><b>Unit turlari:</b></p><pre>.service   jarayon (nginx.service)<br>.socket    socket activation (so'rov kelganda servisni ishga tushiradi)<br>.timer     reja bo'yicha .service ni ishga tushiradi<br>.mount     mount nuqtasi<br>.target    guruh: multi-user.target, graphical.target<br>.path      fayl o'zgarganda trigger<br>.slice     cgroup resurs guruhi</pre><p><b>Servis unit misoli:</b></p><pre># /etc/systemd/system/myapp.service<br>[Unit]<br>Description=My App<br>After=network-online.target<br>Wants=network-online.target<br><br>[Service]<br>User=myapp<br>ExecStart=/opt/myapp/bin/server<br>Restart=on-failure<br>RestartSec=5<br>MemoryMax=512M<br>Environment=PORT=8080<br><br>[Install]<br>WantedBy=multi-user.target</pre><pre>systemctl daemon-reload<br>systemctl enable --now myapp</pre><p><b>Timer misoli:</b></p><pre># backup.timer<br>[Timer]<br>OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00<br>Persistent=true          # o'chiq bo'lgan vaqtda o'tkazib yuborilganini keyin bajaradi<br>[Install]<br>WantedBy=timers.target</pre><pre>systemctl list-timers</pre><p><b>Target'lar (eski runlevel'lar):</b></p><pre>rescue.target      ~ runlevel 1<br>multi-user.target  ~ runlevel 3 (server)<br>graphical.target   ~ runlevel 5<br>systemctl get-default / set-default multi-user.target</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>/lib/systemd/system</code> dagi faylni tahrirlash — paket yangilanganda yo'qoladi. <code>systemctl edit nginx</code> (drop-in override) ishlat.</li><li><code>After=</code> tartib beradi, bog'liqlik emas; Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41453	<p>Linux process holatlari (<code>R</code>, <code>S</code>, <code>D</code>, <code>Z</code>, <code>T</code>) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har process ma'lum vaqtda bitta holatda: <b>R</b> — ishlayapti/navbatda, <b>S</b> — uxlayapti (to'xtatib bo'ladigan kutish), <b>D</b> — to'xtatib bo'lmaydigan kutish (odatda disk/NFS I/O), <b>Z</b> — zombie (tugagan, lekin ota-ona hali o'qimagan), <b>T</b> — to'xtatilgan (SIGSTOP / debugger).</p><p><b>Holat diagrammasi:</b></p><pre>         fork<br>          v<br>   +--&gt;  [R] running/runnable  &lt;------+<br>   |      |  I/O yoki event kutadi    |<br>   |      v                           | event keldi<br>   |    [S] interruptible sleep ------+   (signal bilan uyg'onadi)<br>   |    [D] uninterruptible sleep ----+   (signal TA'SIR QILMAYDI, hatto kill -9)<br>   |      |<br>   | SIGCONT    SIGSTOP / Ctrl+Z<br>   +---- [T] stopped<br>          |<br>        exit()<br>          v<br>         [Z] zombie --&gt; ota-ona wait() qiladi --&gt; yo'qoladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ps -eo pid,stat,wchan:20,cmd | head<br>ps -eo stat | sort | uniq -c          # holatlar bo'yicha son<br>ps -eo pid,stat,cmd | awk '$2 ~ /^D/'  # D holatdagilar<br>top                                    # S ustuni</pre><p><code>STAT</code> qo'shimcha belgilari: <code>s</code> session leader, <code>l</code> multi-thread, <code>+</code> foreground, <code>&lt;</code> yuqori prioritet, <code>N</code> past prioritet.</p><p><b>Nima uchun muhim:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p <b>D</b> — disk yoki NFS osilib qolgan. Load average yuqori bo'ladi, lekin CPU bo'sh. <code>wchan</code> qaysi kernel funksiyasida kutayotganini ko'rsatadi.</li><li>Ko'p <b>Z</b> — ota-ona process'da bug (<code>wait()</code> qilmaydi).</li><li><b>R</b> soni CPU soniga nisbatan ko'p — CPU yetishmayapti.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoq:</b> D holatdagi process'ni <code>kill -9</code> o'ldirmaydi — sababini (disk, NFS server, storage) tuzatish kerak. Yangi kernel'larda <code>TASK_KILLABLE</code> ba'zi holatlarda yordam beradi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Load 40, CPU 5%&quot; — klassik D-state belgisi. <code>cat /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/stack</code> va <code>echo w &gt; /proc/sysrq-trigger</code> (blocked task dump) bilan qayerda tiqilganini ko'r.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41454	<p>Zombie process nima va qanday hal qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zombie — <b>ishini tugatgan</b>, lekin ota-ona process uning exit statusini <code>wait()</code> bilan <b>hali o'qimagan</b> process. U xotira va CPU ishlatmaydi, faqat process jadvalida PID egallab turadi.</p><p><b>Qanday paydo bo'ladi:</b></p><pre>parent ---fork---&gt; child<br>                     | exit(0)<br>                     v<br>                 [Z] zombie: &quot;mening exit kodimni kimdir o'qishi kerak&quot;<br>parent wait()  --&gt; zombie yo'qoladi (reaped)<br>parent wait() qilmasa --&gt; zombie qoladi<br>parent o'lsa  --&gt; child'ni init (PID 1) &quot;asrab oladi&quot; va reap qiladi</pre><p><b>Topish:</b></p><pre>ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,cmd | awk '$3 ~ /Z/'<br>#  PID  PPID STAT CMD<br># 4321  1200 Z    [worker] &lt;defunct&gt;<br>top   # &quot;zombie&quot; soni yuqori qatorda</pre><p><b>Hal qilish:</b></p><ol><li>Zombie'ni o'zini <b>o'ldirib bo'lmaydi</b> — u allaqachon o'lgan. <code>kill -9 4321</code> hech narsa qilmaydi.</li><li>Ota-onaga signal: <code>kill -SIGCHLD 1200</code> — u <code>wait()</code> qilishi mumkin (agar handler to'g'ri yozilgan bo'lsa).</li><li>Ota-onani qayta ishga tushir/o'ldir: <code>kill 1200</code> — zombie'lar PID 1 ga o'tadi va tozalanadi.</li><li>Asosiy yechim — <b>kodni tuzat</b>: SIGCHLD handler'da <code>waitpid(-1, ..., WNOHANG)</code> sikl bilan.</li></ol><p><b>Konteynerda tipik muammo:</b> Ilova PID 1 sifatida ishlaydi va zombie'larni reap qilmaydi (shell skript ichidan child'lar). Yechim:</p><pre>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;tini&quot;, &quot;--&quot;, &quot;/app/start.sh&quot;]</pre><p>yoki <code>docker run --init</code>, K8s'da <code>shareProcessNamespace</code>.</p><p><b>Xavf:</b> Bir nechta zombie — zararsiz. Minglab — PID limitiga (<code>pid_max</code>, cgroup <code>pids.max</code>) yetadi va yangi process yaratib bo'lmaydi: <code>fork: Resource temporarily unavailable</code>.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zombie — simptom, root cause ota-ona kodida. Konteynerda doim init (tini/dumb-init) ishlat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41455	<p>Linux load average (1, 5, 15 daqiqa) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Load average — oxirgi 1, 5, 15 daqiqada <b>CPU'da ishlayotgan yoki navbatda kutayotgan (R)</b> va <b>to'xtatib bo'lmaydigan kutishdagi (D)</b> process'larning o'rtacha soni. Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41456	<p><code>top</code>, <code>htop</code> va <code>atop</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uchalasi ham real vaqtda process va resurslarni ko'rsatadi. <b>top</b> — hamma joyda bor, oddiy. <b>htop</b> — rangli, interaktiv, qulay (sichqoncha, daraxt, filtr). <b>atop</b> — tarixni <b>diskka yozadi</b>: &quot;kecha soat 3:00 da nima bo'lgan edi?&quot; degan savolga javob beradi.</p><p><b>Solishtirish:</b> | | top | htop | atop | |---|---|---|---| | O'rnatilgan | har doim | ko'pincha yo'q | yo'q | | Interfeys | matn | rangli, qulay | zich, ko'p ma'lumot | | Disk/tarmoq per-process | yo'q | qisman | ha | | Tarix | yo'q | yo'q | ha (<code>/var/log/atop/</code>) | | Tugagan process'lar | ko'rmaydi | ko'rmaydi | ko'rsatadi |</p><p><b>top asosiy tugmalar:</b></p><pre>1  har core alohida      M  xotira bo'yicha sort   P  CPU bo'yicha<br>c  to'liq buyruq          k  kill                    H  thread'lar</pre><p>Yuqori qatorni o'qish: <code>us</code> user CPU, <code>sy</code> kernel, <code>wa</code> I/O wait, <code>st</code> steal (VM: gipervizor CPU'ni boshqasiga berdi).</p><p><b>htop:</b></p><pre>F4 filtr  F5 daraxt  F6 sort  F9 kill  Space belgilash</pre><p><b>atop — tarix:</b></p><pre>atop -r /var/log/atop/atop_20261003   # o'sha kun log'i<br># t / T - oldinga/orqaga 10 daqiqa<br>atop -r ... -b 03:00                  # 03:00 dan boshla</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>top</code> dagi <code>%CPU</code> 100% dan oshishi mumkin (multi-thread, har core 100%).</li><li><code>RES</code> xotira shared kutubxonalarni ham o'z ichiga oladi — yig'indisi RAM'dan oshishi mumkin.</li><li><code>st</code> yuqori — sening muammo emas, &quot;noisy neighbor&quot; Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41457	<p>Virtual xotira nima va paging qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Virtual xotira — har bir process <b>o'zining alohida, katta manzil fazosini</b> ko'radi, go'yo butun xotira faqat uniki. Kernel va CPU'dagi MMU bu virtual manzillarni <b>page</b> (odatda 4 KB) birliklarida haqiqiy RAM'ga moslaydi. Paging — shu page'larni kerak bo'lganda RAM'ga yuklash va kerak bo'lmaganini chiqarish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Process A virtual          Page table A          Fizik RAM<br>0x7f00_1000  ------------&gt;  page 12  ----------&gt; [frame 503]<br>0x7f00_2000  ------------&gt;  (yo'q)   -&gt; page fault -&gt; kernel yuklaydi<br>Process B virtual<br>0x7f00_1000  ------------&gt;  page 12  ----------&gt; [frame 911]   &lt;- boshqa joy!</pre><ul><li>Bir xil virtual manzil turli process'larda turli fizik joyga ishora qiladi — <b>izolyatsiya</b>.</li><li>TLB — manzil tarjimalari keshi (tez).</li></ul><p><b>Nega kerak:</b></p><ol><li><b>Izolyatsiya</b> — bir process boshqasining xotirasini o'qiy olmaydi.</li><li><b>Lazy allocation</b> — <code>malloc(1GB)</code> darhol 1GB RAM olmaydi; page'ga birinchi yozilganda ajratiladi.</li><li><b>Sharing</b> — <code>libc</code> kodi RAM'da bitta nusxa, hamma process'larga map qilingan.</li><li><b>Copy-on-write</b> — <code>fork()</code> xotirani nusxalamaydi, faqat yozilganda.</li><li><b>Swap / file mapping</b> — disk xotira kengaytmasi sifatida.</li></ol><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/status | grep -E 'VmSize|VmRSS'   # VSZ (virtual) vs RSS (real RAM)<br>pmap -x &lt;pid&gt;                                      # xotira xaritasi<br>free -h<br>getconf PAGESIZE                                   # 4096</pre><p><b>VSZ vs RSS:</b> Go/Java process VSZ = 20 GB, RSS = 300 MB — normal. Haqiqiy RAM iste'moli — RSS (aniqrog'i PSS, shared'ni bo'lishtiradi).</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Overcommit tufayli kernel RAM'dan ko'p &quot;va'da&quot; beradi — real ishlatilganda yetmasa OOM Killer. Katta DB'lar uchun Huge Pages (2MB) TLB miss'ni kamaytiradi; THP esa ba'zan latency spike beradi (Redis, MongoDB uni o'chirishni tavsiya qiladi).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41458	<p>Minor va major page fault farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Page fault — process RAM'da hozir map qilinmagan page'ga murojaat qilganda bo'ladigan hodisa. <b>Minor</b> — kerakli ma'lumot <b>allaqachon RAM'da</b> (masalan, page cache'da yoki yangi bo'sh page), faqat page table yangilanadi — mikrosekundlar. <b>Major</b> — ma'lumotni <b>diskdan o'qish</b> kerak (swap yoki fayl) — millisekundlar, ~1000 marta sekinroq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Process -&gt; virtual manzil -&gt; page table'da yo'q -&gt; PAGE FAULT -&gt; kernel:<br>   ma'lumot RAM'da bormi? (page cache, shared lib, yangi anonim page)<br>      ha  -&gt; MINOR fault: page table'ga yozadi, davom etadi (~1 us)<br>      yo'q -&gt; MAJOR fault: diskdan o'qiydi (swap/fayl), process D holatda kutadi (~1-10 ms)</pre><p><b>Misollar:</b></p><ul><li>Minor: <code>malloc</code> qilingan xotiraga birinchi yozish; boshqa process yuklagan <code>libc</code> ni ishlatish.</li><li>Major: swap'ga chiqarilgan page'ni qayta o'qish; mmap qilingan fayl birinchi marta o'qilishi (cache'da yo'q).</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ps -o pid,min_flt,maj_flt,cmd -p &lt;pid&gt;<br>/usr/bin/time -v ./app        # &quot;Major (requiring I/O) page faults&quot;<br>sar -B 1                       # majflt/s - tizim bo'yicha<br>perf stat -e page-faults,major-faults ./app</pre><p><b>Diagnostika:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p minor fault — odatda normal (ishga tushish, katta allokatsiya).</li><li>Major fault doimiy yuqori — <b>RAM yetishmayapti</b> (swap thrashing) yoki working set page cache'ga sig'mayapti — latency keskin oshadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Latency-sezgir servisda major fault'ni metrika qilib kuzat. Yechim: ko'proq RAM, swap'ni cheklash, <code>mlock</code>/huge pages (DB), yoki cache'ni oldindan isitish (warmup).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41459	<p>Swap nima va <code>vm.swappiness</code> qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swap — RAM to'lganda kam ishlatiladigan xotira page'larini <b>diskka chiqarib</b> joy bo'shatadigan maydon (bo'lim yoki fayl). <code>vm.swappiness</code> (0–200, default 60) — kernel bosim ostida <b>anonim xotirani swap'ga chiqarish</b> va <b>page cache'ni tashlash</b> orasida qanchalik swap tomonga moyil ekanini belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>RAM bosim ostida -&gt; kernel qaysi page'ni bo'shatadi?<br>   (a) page cache (fayl nusxasi)  -&gt; tashlab yuboradi, kerak bo'lsa diskdan qayta o'qiydi<br>   (b) anonim xotira (heap)       -&gt; swap'ga yozadi<br>swappiness yuqori -&gt; (b) ko'proq<br>swappiness past   -&gt; (a) ko'proq, swap oxirgi chora<br>swappiness 0      -&gt; swap deyarli faqat OOM oldidan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>swapon --show<br>free -h<br>cat /proc/sys/vm/swappiness<br>sysctl vm.swappiness=10                         # vaqtinchalik<br>echo 'vm.swappiness=10' &gt; /etc/sysctl.d/99-swap.conf   # doimiy<br>vmstat 1        # si/so - swap in/out (doimiy &gt; 0 bo'lsa - muammo)<br><br># swap fayl yaratish<br>fallocate -l 4G /swapfile &amp;&amp; chmod 600 /swapfile<br>mkswap /swapfile &amp;&amp; swapon /swapfile<br>echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' &gt;&gt; /etc/fstab</pre><p><b>Tipik qiymatlar:</b></p><ul><li>DB serverlari (PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch): <code>1</code>–<code>10</code> yoki swap o'chiq.</li><li>Desktop: 60.</li><li>Kubernetes node: an'anaviy ravishda swap o'chiq (yangi versiyalarda <code>NodeSwap</code> beta, LimitedSwap bilan).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Swap'ni butunlay o'chirish — xotira tugaganda sekinlashish o'rniga darhol OOM kill.</li><li>Thrashing: doimiy <code>si</code>/<code>so</code> — tizim deyarli to'xtaydi; swap muammoni yashiradi.</li><li><code>swappiness=0</code> yangi kernel'larda &quot;swap yo'q&quot; degani emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Swap — xavfsizlik yostig'i, xotira o'rnini bosuvchi emas. <code>si/so</code> va major fault'larni monitor qil. zram (siqilgan RAM swap) — disksiz yumshoq yechim.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41460	<p>Linux OOM Killer nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OOM (Out Of Memory) Killer — kernel xotira <b>butunlay tugaganda</b> (RAM + swap, bo'shatib bo'ladigan cache ham qolmaganda) tizimni qutqarish uchun <b>bitta process'ni tanlab o'ldiradigan</b> mexanizm. Odatda eng ko'p xotira ishlatayotganini tanlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday tanlaydi:</b></p><pre>har process uchun oom_score (0..1000) ~ ishlatgan xotira ulushi<br>  + oom_score_adj (-1000..+1000) bilan sozlanadi<br>eng yuqori score -&gt; SIGKILL<br>oom_score_adj = -1000 -&gt; hech qachon o'ldirilmaydi</pre><p><b>Belgilar:</b></p><pre>dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'killed process|out of memory'<br># Out of memory: Killed process 2345 (java) total-vm:8123456kB, anon-rss:6012345kB<br>journalctl -k | grep -i oom<br>cat /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/oom_score</pre><p>Ilova &quot;sababsiz&quot; yo'qoldi, log'da hech narsa yo'q (SIGKILL — handler ishlamaydi), exit code <b>137</b> (128+9).</p><p><b>Konteyner/K8s'da:</b> cgroup limit (<code>memory.max</code>) oshsa — global emas, <b>cgroup OOM</b>: faqat shu konteyner o'ldiriladi.</p><pre>kubectl describe pod x   # Last State: Terminated, Reason: OOMKilled, Exit Code: 137</pre><p><b>Sozlash:</b></p><pre>echo -1000 &gt; /proc/$(pidof sshd)/oom_score_adj   # sshd'ni himoya<br># systemd unit:<br>[Service]<br>OOMScoreAdjust=-500<br>MemoryMax=2G         # cgroup limit: servis o'zi chegarada qoladi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Muhim DB o'ldirilishi — chunki u eng katta. DB'ni himoya qil, keraksiz process'larni chekla.</li><li>JVM heap = konteyner limiti — off-heap (metaspace, thread stack) tufayli OOMKilled. <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75</code>.</li><li>Go: <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> ni limitdan biroz past qo'y.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> OOM kill — xotira hisobini noto'g'ri qilganing belgisi. RSS trendini, <code>memory.events</code> (cgroup) va PSI memory ni kuzat; erta ogohlantirish uchun systemd-oomd yoki earlyoom.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41461	<p><code>/proc</code> fayl tizimi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/proc</code> — diskda mavjud bo'lmagan <b>virtual fayl tizimi</b>: kernel uni xotirada ochiq qiladi. Fayllarni o'qish = kernel'dan process'lar va tizim haqida joriy ma'lumot olish; ba'zilariga yozish = kernel sozlamasini o'zgartirish.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>/proc/<br>  &lt;PID&gt;/              har process uchun papka<br>     cmdline          qanday buyruq bilan ishga tushgan<br>     status           holat, xotira (VmRSS), thread'lar<br>     fd/              ochiq fayl deskriptorlar (symlink)<br>     environ          muhit o'zgaruvchilari<br>     limits           ulimit'lar<br>     maps             xotira xaritasi<br>     cwd, exe         joriy papka, binary<br>  cpuinfo, meminfo    CPU va xotira<br>  loadavg, uptime<br>  mounts              mount'lar<br>  sys/                kernel parametrlari (sysctl)<br>  net/                tarmoq statistikasi<br>  pressure/           PSI (cpu, memory, io)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/meminfo | head -5<br>cat /proc/1234/cmdline | tr '\0' ' '<br>ls -l /proc/1234/fd | wc -l                  # nechta fayl ochiq (fd leak?)<br>cat /proc/1234/limits | grep 'open files'<br>tr '\0' '\n' &lt; /proc/1234/environ            # env (secret'lar ko'rinishi mumkin!)<br>cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward<br>echo 1 &gt; /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward       # = sysctl -w<br>ls -l /proc/1234/exe                         # binary o'chirilgan bo'lsa &quot;(deleted)&quot;</pre><p><b>Foydali hiylalar:</b></p><ul><li>O'chirilgan, lekin hali ochiq faylni tiklash: <code>cp /proc/1234/fd/5 /tmp/recovered</code>.</li><li><code>ps</code>, <code>top</code>, <code>free</code> — hammasi aslida <code>/proc</code> ni o'qiydi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>/proc/&lt;pid&gt;/environ</code> va <code>cmdline</code> da secret'lar ko'rinishi mumkin — parolni CLI argument qilma.</li><li><code>hidepid=2</code> mount opsiyasi — boshqa userlarning process'larini yashiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>/proc</code> — kernel'ning API'si. Har bir monitoring agent (node_exporter) shu yerdan o'qiydi. Konteyner ichida <code>/proc/meminfo</code> host'nikini ko'rsatadi — limitni cgroup (<code>/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max</code>) dan o'qi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41462	<p><code>/sys</code> (sysfs) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/sys</code> (sysfs) — kernel'ning <b>qurilmalar, driver'lar va kernel obyektlari</b> modelini fayl ko'rinishida ochadigan virtual fayl tizimi. <code>/proc</code> — asosan process'lar va eski aralash ma'lumot; <code>/sys</code> — tartibli, &quot;bitta fayl = bitta qiymat&quot; qoidasi bilan qurilmalar ierarxiyasi.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>/sys/<br>  block/        disklar (sda, nvme0n1) -&gt; queue/scheduler, stat<br>  class/        turi bo'yicha: net/, block/, power_supply/, thermal/<br>  devices/      fizik ierarxiya (PCI, USB)<br>  bus/          bus'lar va ularning driver'lari<br>  module/       yuklangan kernel modullari va parametrlari<br>  fs/cgroup/    cgroup v2 ierarxiyasi (konteyner limitlari!)<br>  kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/class/net/eth0/speed                 # 10000 (Mbit/s)<br>cat /sys/class/net/eth0/statistics/rx_dropped<br>cat /sys/block/nvme0n1/queue/scheduler        # [none] mq-deadline<br>echo mq-deadline &gt; /sys/block/sda/queue/scheduler<br>cat /sys/block/sda/queue/rotational           # 1 = HDD, 0 = SSD<br>cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled<br>echo never &gt; /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max                 # konteyner ichida xotira limiti<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max                    # &quot;200000 100000&quot; = 2 CPU</pre><p><b>Muhim:</b> <code>/sys</code> ga yozilgan o'zgarishlar <b>reboot'da yo'qoladi</b>. Doimiy qilish: udev rule, <code>tmpfiles.d</code>, systemd unit yoki kernel cmdline.</p><pre># /etc/udev/rules.d/60-scheduler.rules<br>ACTION==&quot;add|change&quot;, KERNEL==&quot;sd[a-z]&quot;, ATTR{queue/scheduler}=&quot;mq-deadline&quot;</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konteyner ichida ilova CPU/xotira limitini <code>/sys/fs/cgroup</code> dan o'qishi kerak (Go 1.25+ GOMAXPROCS'ni avtomatik shunday sozlaydi, JVM ham). Host darajasidagi tuning (THP, scheduler) — <code>/sys</code> orqali.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41463	<p><code>systemctl</code> bilan servis lifecycle'i qanday boshqariladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>systemctl</code> — systemd bilan gaplashadigan asosiy buyruq: servisni ishga tushirish/to'xtatish (<b>hozir</b>) va boot'da avtomatik ishga tushishini yoqish/o'chirish (<b>kelajakda</b>) — bu ikkalasi <b>alohida</b> narsalar.</p><p><b>Ikki o'lchov:</b></p><pre>          hozir ishlayaptimi?      boot'da ishga tushadimi?<br>start/stop   &lt;-- active/inactive<br>enable/disable                     --&gt; enabled/disabled<br>enable --now = ikkalasi birdan</pre><p><b>Asosiy buyruqlar:</b></p><pre>systemctl start nginx          # hozir ishga tushir<br>systemctl stop nginx<br>systemctl restart nginx        # to'xtatib qayta (ulanishlar uziladi)<br>systemctl reload nginx         # konfigni qayta o'qi (uzilishsiz, servis qo'llasa)<br>systemctl reload-or-restart nginx<br>systemctl enable --now nginx   # boot'da + hozir<br>systemctl disable nginx<br>systemctl mask nginx           # hech qanday yo'l bilan ishga tushmasin (/dev/null ga link)<br>systemctl status nginx         # holat + oxirgi log qatorlari<br>systemctl is-active nginx      # skriptlar uchun<br>systemctl --failed             # fail bo'lgan unit'lar<br>systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running<br>systemctl cat nginx            # unit fayl + drop-in'lar<br>systemctl edit nginx           # override yaratish<br>systemctl daemon-reload        # unit fayl o'zgargandan keyin</pre><p><b><code>status</code> chiqishini o'qish:</b></p><pre>● nginx.service - A high performance web server<br>   Loaded: loaded (/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service; enabled; preset: enabled)<br>   Active: active (running) since Fri 2026-10-03 09:00:01 UTC; 2h ago<br> Main PID: 1234 (nginx)<br>   Memory: 12.3M</pre><p><code>Loaded ... enabled</code> — boot'da ishga tushadi; <code>Active</code> — hozirgi holat.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>start</code> qilib <code>enable</code> ni unutish — reboot'dan keyin servis yo'q.</li><li>Unit faylni tahrirlab <code>daemon-reload</code> qilmaslik — eski versiya ishlaydi.</li><li><code>restart</code> loop: <code>Restart=always</code> + tez fail → <code>start-limit-hit</code>. <code>systemctl reset-failed</code> va sababni journal'da qidir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konfig o'zgarishida avval tekshir (<code>nginx -t</code>), keyin <code>reload</code>. Deploy skriptlarida <code>systemctl is-active --quiet</code> bilan health tekshir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41464	<p><code>journalctl</code> bilan log'lar qanday so'raladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>journalctl</code> — systemd-journald yig'gan <b>binary, indekslangan</b> log'larni so'rash tool'i. Grep o'rniga servis, vaqt, priority, boot bo'yicha filtrlaydi.</p><p><b>Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan filtrlar:</b></p><pre>journalctl -u nginx                     # bitta servis<br>journalctl -u nginx -f                  # real vaqtda (tail -f)<br>journalctl -u nginx --since &quot;1 hour ago&quot;<br>journalctl --since &quot;2026-10-03 09:00&quot; --until &quot;2026-10-03 09:30&quot;<br>journalctl -p err -b                    # joriy boot'dagi xato va undan yuqori<br>journalctl -b -1                        # oldingi boot (crash'dan keyin!)<br>journalctl --list-boots<br>journalctl -k                           # faqat kernel (dmesg)<br>journalctl _PID=1234<br>journalctl -u nginx -n 50 --no-pager    # oxirgi 50 qator<br>journalctl -u myapp -o json-pretty      # strukturali maydonlar bilan<br>journalctl -u a -u b                    # bir nechta servis birga</pre><p><b>Priority darajalari:</b> <code>0 emerg, 1 alert, 2 crit, 3 err, 4 warning, 5 notice, 6 info, 7 debug</code>. <code>-p warning</code> = 4 va undan muhimroqlar.</p><p><b>Joy boshqaruvi:</b></p><pre>journalctl --disk-usage<br>journalctl --vacuum-size=500M<br>journalctl --vacuum-time=7d</pre><p>Doimiy sozlama: <code>/etc/systemd/journald.conf</code> -&gt; <code>SystemMaxUse=1G</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>/var/log/journal</code> papkasi yo'q bo'lsa log'lar faqat RAM'da (<code>/run/log/journal</code>) — reboot'da yo'qoladi. <code>Storage=persistent</code> yoki papkani yarat.</li><li>Oddiy user faqat o'z log'larini ko'radi — <code>systemd-journal</code> guruhiga qo'sh yoki <code>sudo</code>.</li><li>Rate limit: juda ko'p log yozuvchi servis log'lari tashlab yuboriladi (<code>RateLimitBurst</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Crash tahlili: <code>journalctl -b -1 -p err</code> — birinchi buyruq. Production'da journal'ni lokal tarix uchun saqla, lekin markaziy tizimga (Loki, ELK) yubor — server o'lsa log ham o'lmasin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41465	<p>Fayl ruxsatlari va octal yozuv (<code>chmod</code>) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har faylda uch guruh uchun (owner / group / others) uchtadan ruxsat bor: <b>r</b> (o'qish = 4), <b>w</b> (yozish = 2), <b>x</b> (bajarish = 1). Octal yozuvda har guruh uchun shu raqamlar qo'shiladi: <code>rwx = 7</code>, <code>rw- = 6</code>, <code>r-x = 5</code>, <code>r-- = 4</code>.</p><p><b>O'qish:</b></p><pre>-rwxr-x---  1 ali dev  app.sh<br> |\_/\_/\_/<br> | |  |  +-- others: ---  = 0<br> | |  +----- group:  r-x  = 5<br> | +-------- owner:  rwx  = 7     -&gt; 750<br> +---------- tur: - fayl, d papka, l symlink</pre><p><b>Fayl va papkada ma'nosi farq qiladi:</b> | | Fayl | Papka | |---|---|---| | r | ichini o'qish | fayllar ro'yxatini ko'rish (<code>ls</code>) | | w | o'zgartirish | ichida fayl yaratish/o'chirish/rename | | x | ishga tushirish | ichiga kirish (<code>cd</code>) va fayllarga murojaat |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>chmod 640 config.yml          # owner rw, group r, others yo'q<br>chmod 755 /opt/app/bin/run    # skript<br>chmod 700 ~/.ssh ; chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519<br>chmod u+x,g-w,o= file         # simvolik usul<br>chmod -R g+rX dir/            # X: faqat papkalarga va allaqachon x bo'lganlarga<br>chown ali:dev file<br>stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' file    # 640 ali:dev file</pre><p><b>Tipik qiymatlar:</b> <code>644</code> oddiy fayl, <code>755</code> skript/papka, <code>600</code> secret/kalit, <code>700</code> shaxsiy papka.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>chmod -R 777</code> — &quot;ishlamayapti, hammasiga ruxsat beraman&quot; — xavfsizlik teshigi.</li><li>Faylni o'chirish uchun faylning emas, <b>papkaning</b> <code>w</code> ruxsati kerak.</li><li>SSH kalitida <code>644</code> — ssh uni rad etadi (&quot;UNPROTECTED PRIVATE KEY FILE&quot;).</li><li><code>-R</code> bilan fayllarga ham <code>x</code> berib yuborish — <code>X</code> (katta) ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Least privilege: servis o'z useri ostida, faqat kerakli fayllarga. Yangi fayl default ruxsatini <code>umask</code> belgilaydi (022 → 644/755).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41466	<p>SUID, SGID va sticky bit (octal bilan) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy rwx'dan tashqari uchta <b>maxsus bit</b> bor (octal'da to'rtinchi, eng chap raqam):</p><ul><li><b>SUID (4)</b> — fayl <b>egasining</b> huquqi bilan ishga tushadi.</li><li><b>SGID (2)</b> — faylda: guruh huquqi bilan ishga tushadi; <b>papkada</b>: ichida yaratilgan fayllar papka guruhini meros oladi.</li><li><b>Sticky (1)</b> — papkada: faylni faqat <b>uning egasi</b> (yoki root) o'chira oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Ko'rinishi:</b></p><pre>-rwsr-xr-x  /usr/bin/passwd   s owner x o'rnida  -&gt; SUID   (4755)<br>drwxrwsr-x  /srv/shared       s group x o'rnida  -&gt; SGID   (2775)<br>drwxrwxrwt  /tmp              t others x o'rnida -&gt; sticky (1777)<br>Katta harf (S, T) = bit bor, lekin x yo'q (odatda xato)</pre><p><b>Nega kerak — misollar:</b></p><ul><li><code>passwd</code>: oddiy user <code>/etc/shadow</code> ga yoza olmaydi. <code>passwd</code> SUID root — u ishga tushganda root huquqi bilan parolni yozadi.</li><li>Jamoa papkasi: SGID bilan hamma yaratgan fayllar <code>dev</code> guruhida, jamoa bir-birining fayllarini tahrirlay oladi.</li><li><code>/tmp</code>: hamma yoza oladi, lekin sticky bit tufayli boshqaning faylini o'chira olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>chmod 4755 /usr/local/bin/tool    # SUID<br>chmod u+s file<br>chmod 2775 /srv/shared            # SGID papka<br>chmod g+s /srv/shared<br>chmod 1777 /scratch               # sticky<br>chmod +t /scratch<br>find / -perm -4000 -type f 2&gt;/dev/null   # barcha SUID fayllar (audit!)</pre><p><b>Xavfsizlik:</b></p><ul><li>SUID root binary'dagi har bug = <b>privilege escalation</b>. GTFOBins'da qaysi binary'lar SUID bo'lsa root beradi — ro'yxat bor.</li><li>Shell skriptlarda SUID Linux'da e'tiborsiz qoldiriladi (xavfsizlik uchun).</li><li><code>nosuid</code> mount opsiyasi (<code>/tmp</code>, <code>/home</code>, USB) — SUID'ni u yerda o'chiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi SUID binary — oxirgi chora. Afzalroq: Linux <b>capabilities</b> (<code>setcap cap_net_bind_service=+ep app</code> — 80 portni root'siz ochish) yoki sudo qoidasi. SUID fayllar ro'yxatini muntazam audit qil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41467	<p>Hard link va soft link (symlink) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Hard link</b> — bir xil <b>inode</b>ga (ya'ni bir xil ma'lumotga) ikkinchi <b>nom</b>. <b>Soft link (symlink)</b> — boshqa faylning <b>yo'lini</b> saqlaydigan alohida kichik fayl (yorliq).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Hard link:<br>  /data/a.txt ---\<br>                  +--&gt; inode 1234 --&gt; disk bloklari<br>  /data/b.txt ---/      (link count = 2)<br><br>Symlink:<br>  /data/c.txt (inode 5678, ichida: &quot;/data/a.txt&quot;) --&gt; /data/a.txt --&gt; inode 1234</pre><p><b>Farqlar:</b> | | Hard link | Symlink | |---|---|---| | Asl faylni o'chirsa | ma'lumot qoladi (link count &gt; 0) | <b>buziladi</b> (dangling) | | Papkaga | yo'q | ha | | Boshqa fayl tizimiga | yo'q (inode lokal) | ha | | inode | bir xil | alohida | | Ruxsatlar | bir xil (bitta inode) | target'niki ishlatiladi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ln a.txt b.txt              # hard link<br>ln -s /data/a.txt c.txt     # symlink<br>ls -li                      # 1-ustun inode, 3-ustun link count<br># 1234 -rw-r--r-- 2 ali ali 10 a.txt<br># 1234 -rw-r--r-- 2 ali ali 10 b.txt<br># 5678 lrwxrwxrwx 1 ali ali 11 c.txt -&gt; /data/a.txt<br>readlink -f c.txt           # oxirgi target<br>find . -xtype l             # buzilgan symlink'lar<br>find / -samefile a.txt      # bir inode'ning barcha hard link'lari</pre><p><b>Real foydalanish:</b></p><ul><li>Symlink: <code>/usr/bin/python -&gt; python3.12</code>, <code>current -&gt; releases/2026-10-03</code> (atomik deploy: <code>ln -sfn</code> bilan almashtirish), <code>/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/</code>.</li><li>Hard link: backup tool'lari (rsync <code>--link-dest</code>, Time Machine) — o'zgarmagan fayllar joy egallamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Nisbiy symlink ko'chirilganda buziladi.</li><li>Hard link'li faylni &quot;o'chirdim&quot; deb o'ylash — joy bo'shamaydi, chunki boshqa nom bor.</li><li>Symlink orqali hujum: <code>/tmp</code> da root yozadigan faylga symlink (<code>fs.protected_symlinks=1</code> himoya qiladi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>rm</code> aslida faylni emas, <b>nomni</b> (directory entry) o'chiradi. Ma'lumot link count 0 <b>va</b> hech kim ochiq tutmagan bo'lsagina o'chadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41468	<p>Linux'da inode nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Inode — fayl haqidagi <b>metadata strukturasi</b>: ruxsatlar, egasi, hajmi, vaqtlar, link soni va ma'lumot bloklarining diskdagi joylashuvi. Faqat <b>fayl nomi inode'da yo'q</b> — nom papka (directory) ichida &quot;nom → inode raqami&quot; juftligi sifatida saqlanadi.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>Papka /home/ali (o'zi ham fayl):<br>   &quot;notes.txt&quot;  -&gt; inode 1234<br>   &quot;photo.jpg&quot;  -&gt; inode 1290<br><br>inode 1234:<br>   type: regular file   mode: 0644   uid: 1000  gid: 1000<br>   size: 4096           links: 1<br>   atime/mtime/ctime<br>   block pointers / extents  --&gt; [disk bloklari: ma'lumot]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls -i notes.txt           # 1234 notes.txt<br>stat notes.txt            # to'liq inode ma'lumoti<br>df -i                     # inode'lar: jami / ishlatilgan / bo'sh<br># Filesystem  Inodes  IUsed   IFree IUse% Mounted on<br># /dev/sda1   6.5M    6.5M    0     100%  /         &lt;- inode tugagan!</pre><p><b>Nega muhim — inode tugashi:</b> ext4'da inode soni fayl tizimi yaratilganda <b>qotiriladi</b>. Millionlab mayda fayl (sessiya fayllari, cache, mail queue) inode'larni tugatadi — diskda GB joy bo'lsa ham <code>No space left on device</code>.</p><pre># qaysi papkada eng ko'p fayl<br>for d in /var/*; do echo &quot;$(find &quot;$d&quot; -xdev | wc -l) $d&quot;; done | sort -n | tail</pre><p>Yechim: keraksiz fayllarni o'chirish; kelajakda <code>mkfs.ext4 -i 4096</code> (ko'proq inode) yoki XFS (inode'larni dinamik ajratadi).</p><p><b>Inode bilan bog'liq faktlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>mv</code> bir fayl tizimi ichida — faqat nomni ko'chiradi, inode o'zgarmaydi (shuning uchun tez va atomik).</li><li>Hard link = bir inode'ga ikki nom.</li><li>inode raqami faqat bitta fayl tizimi ichida unikal.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monitoring'da <code>df -h</code> bilan birga <code>df -i</code> ham bo'lishi shart (node_exporter: <code>node_filesystem_files_free</code>). Mayda fayllar ko'p ishlatiladigan tizimlarda (cache, queue) fayl tizimini shunga mos tanla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41469	<p><code>df -h</code> da joy bor, lekin &quot;No space left on device&quot; — qanday troubleshoot qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>df -h</code> joy bor deb ko'rsatsa-yu, yozib bo'lmasa — uchta asosiy sabab: (1) <b>inode'lar tugagan</b>, (2) <b>o'chirilgan, lekin hali ochiq turgan</b> katta fayl, (3) <b>reserved bloklar</b> / boshqa fayl tizimi / kvota.</p><p><b>Diagnostika tartibi:</b></p><pre># 1. Qaysi mount? Haqiqatan qaysi fayl tizimiga yozilyapti?<br>df -h /var/log/app<br># 2. Inode'lar<br>df -i /var<br>#  IUse% 100%  -&gt; inode muammo<br># 3. O'chirilgan, lekin ochiq fayllar<br>lsof -nP +L1 | sort -k7 -n | tail<br>#  java 2345 app 12w REG ... 21474836480 0 /var/log/app.log (deleted)<br># 4. Kvota<br>quota -u appuser ; repquota -a<br># 5. Reserved bloklar (ext4, odatda 5% root uchun)<br>tune2fs -l /dev/sda1 | grep -i 'reserved block'<br># 6. Fayl tizimi read-only bo'lib qolganmi?<br>mount | grep ' / ' ; dmesg | grep -i 'remount.*read-only'</pre><p><b>Har bir holat yechimi:</b> | Sabab | Belgisi | Yechim | |---|---|---| | Inode tugagan | <code>df -i</code> 100% | mayda fayllarni o'chir (session, cache) | | Deleted-but-open | <code>lsof +L1</code> katta fayl | process'ni restart yoki <code>: &gt; /proc/PID/fd/N</code> | | Reserved 5% | oddiy user yoza olmaydi, root yoza oladi | <code>tune2fs -m 1</code> (ehtiyot bilan) | | Kvota | faqat bitta user | kvotani oshir | | Mount ustiga yozilgan | <code>du</code> va <code>df</code> farq qiladi | mount ostidagi fayllar — unmount qilib tekshir |</p><p><b>Deleted-but-open misoli:</b> Kimdir <code>rm app.log</code> qildi, lekin ilova faylni hali ochiq tutib yozyapti. Disk joyi bo'shamaydi, <code>du</code> uni ko'rmaydi, <code>df</code> esa band deb ko'rsatadi.</p><pre>: &gt; /proc/2345/fd/12       # faylni nolga qisqartirish (process'ni o'ldirmasdan)</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Log'ni hech qachon <code>rm</code> qilma — <code>truncate -s 0</code> yoki logrotate <code>copytruncate</code>/signal. Alert'ni ham <code>df</code> foizi, ham inode foizi bo'yicha qo'y, va disk to'lish <b>tezligini</b> (<code>predict_linear</code>) kuzat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41470	<p><code>atime</code>, <code>mtime</code> va <code>ctime</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b></p><ul><li><b>atime</b> (access) — fayl <b>oxirgi o'qilgan</b> vaqt.</li><li><b>mtime</b> (modify) — fayl <b>mazmuni</b> oxirgi o'zgargan vaqt.</li><li><b>ctime</b> (change) — fayl <b>inode metadata</b>si (ruxsat, egasi, link, nom) <b>yoki</b> mazmuni oxirgi o'zgargan vaqt. Bu &quot;creation time&quot; <b>emas</b>!</li></ul><p><b>Qaysi amal nimani o'zgartiradi:</b> | Amal | atime | mtime | ctime | |---|---|---|---| | <code>cat file</code> | ✓ (relatime qoidasi bilan) | | | | <code>echo x &gt;&gt; file</code> | | ✓ | ✓ | | <code>chmod 600 file</code> | | | ✓ | | <code>chown</code>, <code>mv</code>, <code>ln</code> | | | ✓ | | <code>touch file</code> | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stat app.log<br>#   Access: 2026-10-03 09:10:01<br>#   Modify: 2026-10-03 08:55:12<br>#   Change: 2026-10-03 08:55:12<br>#    Birth: 2026-09-01 10:00:00     &lt;- yaratilish vaqti (ext4/XFS qo'llasa)<br>ls -l   # mtime<br>ls -lu  # atime<br>ls -lc  # ctime<br>find /var/log -mtime +7          # 7 kundan oldin o'zgargan<br>find /etc -cmin -60              # oxirgi soatda metadata o'zgargan (forensics)<br>touch -d '2026-01-01' file       # mtime/atime ni qo'lda o'rnatish</pre><p><b>Muhim nozikliklar:</b></p><ul><li><b>ctime'ni qo'lda o'rnatib bo'lmaydi</b> (<code>touch</code> faqat atime/mtime) — shuning uchun forensics'da ishonchliroq: hujumchi mtime'ni soxtalashtirsa ham ctime &quot;hozir&quot; bo'lib qoladi.</li><li><b>atime</b> har o'qishda yozish = disk I/O. Default <code>relatime</code>: atime faqat mtime'dan eski bo'lsa yoki 24 soatdan keyin yangilanadi. <code>noatime</code> — umuman yangilamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Build tool'lar (make), backup (rsync) mtime'ga tayanadi. Incident tahlilida <code>find -cmin</code> bilan &quot;kim nimani o'zgartirdi&quot; — lekin jiddiy audit uchun <code>auditd</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41471	<p>Linux Filesystem Hierarchy Standard (FHS) ni tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> FHS (Filesystem Hierarchy Standard) — Linux'da qaysi fayl <b>qaysi papkada</b> turishi kerakligi haqidagi standart. Shu tufayli istalgan distro'da konfiguratsiya <code>/etc</code> da, log'lar <code>/var/log</code> da, binary'lar <code>/usr/bin</code> da bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Asosiy papkalar:</b></p><pre>/            root<br>/bin, /sbin  asosiy buyruqlar (zamonaviy distro'larda /usr/bin ga symlink — &quot;usrmerge&quot;)<br>/boot        kernel (vmlinuz), initramfs, GRUB<br>/dev         qurilma fayllari (sda, null, tty) — udev boshqaradi<br>/etc         TIZIM KONFIGURATSIYASI (matn fayllar): fstab, passwd, ssh/, nginx/<br>/home        oddiy user'lar papkalari<br>/root        root user papkasi<br>/lib, /lib64 kutubxonalar va kernel modullari (/lib/modules)<br>/media, /mnt olinadigan qurilmalar / vaqtinchalik mount<br>/opt         uchinchi tomon to'liq paketlari (/opt/google/chrome)<br>/proc, /sys  virtual: kernel ma'lumotlari<br>/run         joriy boot'gacha bo'lgan runtime ma'lumot (PID fayl, socket) — tmpfs<br>/srv         servis ma'lumotlari (web sayt, ftp)<br>/tmp         vaqtinchalik (reboot'da tozalanishi mumkin)<br>/usr         o'qish uchun dasturlar: /usr/bin, /usr/lib, /usr/share<br>/usr/local   lokal o'rnatilgan (paket menejeridan tashqari) dasturlar<br>/var         O'ZGARUVCHAN ma'lumot:<br>   /var/log    log'lar<br>   /var/lib    ilova holati (DB: /var/lib/postgresql, docker: /var/lib/docker)<br>   /var/cache  qayta yaratiladigan kesh<br>   /var/spool  navbatlar (mail, print, cron)</pre><p><b>Nega muhim (amaliy ma'no):</b></p><ul><li><code>/usr</code> faqat o'qiladigan bo'lishi mumkin; <code>/var</code> o'sadi — <b>alohida bo'limga</b> qo'y (log to'lib, <code>/</code> ni to'xtatmasin).</li><li>Backup: asosan <code>/etc</code>, <code>/var/lib</code>, <code>/home</code>, <code>/srv</code>.</li><li><code>/tmp</code> va <code>/var/tmp</code> farqi: <code>/var/tmp</code> reboot'dan keyin saqlanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>man hier                  # FHS qisqa hujjati<br>du -xsh /var/* | sort -h  # qaysi papka joy egallayapti</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> O'z ilovangni FHS bo'yicha joylashtir: binary <code>/usr/local/bin</code> yoki <code>/opt/app</code>, konfig <code>/etc/app</code>, holat <code>/var/lib/app</code>, log <code>/var/log/app</code>. Systemd: <code>StateDirectory=</code>, <code>LogsDirectory=</code>, <code>ConfigurationDirectory=</code> buni avtomatik qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41472	<p>LVM nima va PV, VG, LV nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LVM (Logical Volume Manager) — fizik disklar ustida <b>moslashuvchan abstraksiya qatlami</b>: bir nechta diskni bitta pul (pool) qilib, undan istalgan hajmdagi &quot;virtual disk&quot;lar ajratish va ularni keyinchalik <b>onlayn kengaytirish</b>, snapshot olish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Uch qatlam:</b></p><pre> PV (Physical Volume)   /dev/sdb   /dev/sdc   /dev/sdd    &lt;- fizik disk/bo'lim<br>            \             |           /<br> VG (Volume Group)       vg_data (300 GB pool)             &lt;- PV'lar birlashmasi<br>            /             |           \<br> LV (Logical Volume)   lv_db 100G   lv_logs 50G   (bo'sh 150G)<br>            |              |<br>       mkfs.xfs        mkfs.ext4   -&gt; mount /var/lib/pgsql, /var/log</pre><ul><li><b>PE (Physical Extent)</b> — VG ichidagi kichik bo'lak (default 4 MB); LV = PE'lar to'plami.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pvcreate /dev/sdb /dev/sdc<br>vgcreate vg_data /dev/sdb /dev/sdc<br>lvcreate -n lv_db -L 100G vg_data<br>mkfs.xfs /dev/vg_data/lv_db<br>mount /dev/vg_data/lv_db /var/lib/pgsql<br><br>pvs ; vgs ; lvs          # qisqa holat<br>pvdisplay ; vgdisplay ; lvdisplay   # batafsil</pre><p><b>Nega kerak:</b></p><ul><li>Disk to'lsa — yangi disk qo'shib (<code>vgextend</code>), LV'ni kengaytirish — downtime'siz.</li><li>Snapshot — backup oldidan muzlatilgan nusxa.</li><li>Ma'lumotni ishlab turgan holda boshqa diskka ko'chirish (<code>pvmove</code>).</li><li>Thin provisioning, RAID, cache (SSD) qatlamlari.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>LVM — RAID emas: bir nechta PV'dan VG'da bitta disk o'lsa, unga tushgan LV'lar yo'qoladi (<code>lvcreate --type raid1</code> kerak).</li><li>Snapshot'lar to'lib qolsa yaroqsiz bo'ladi; uzoq saqlama (yozish sekinlashadi).</li><li>Hammasini VG'ga ajratib qo'ymaslik — bo'sh joy qoldir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud'da EBS volume'ni o'zi kengaytirish mumkin, shuning uchun LVM kamroq kerak; lekin bare-metal va on-prem'da asosiy vosita. Ko'p diskni striping qilish (<code>-i 2</code>) bilan IOPS'ni birlashtirish mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41473	<p>LVM bilan ext4 va XFS'ni onlayn qanday kengaytirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tartib: <b>(1)</b> VG'da bo'sh joy borligini ta'minla (kerak bo'lsa yangi disk qo'sh) → <b>(2)</b> LV'ni kengaytir → <b>(3)</b> fayl tizimini kengaytir. ext4 ham, XFS ham <b>mount qilingan holda</b> kengaya oladi. Muhim farq: XFS'ni <b>kichraytirib bo'lmaydi</b>.</p><p><b>Qadamlar:</b></p><pre># 0. Holatni ko'r<br>df -h /var/lib/pgsql<br>lvs ; vgs                      # VFree bormi?<br><br># 1. VG'da joy yo'q bo'lsa - yangi disk qo'sh<br>lsblk                          # yangi disk: /dev/sdd<br>pvcreate /dev/sdd<br>vgextend vg_data /dev/sdd<br><br># 2+3. LV + fayl tizimini bitta buyruqda (-r = resizefs)<br>lvextend -r -L +50G /dev/vg_data/lv_db<br>lvextend -r -l +100%FREE /dev/vg_data/lv_db   # barcha bo'sh joy</pre><p><b><code>-r</code> siz, alohida qadamlar:</b></p><pre>lvextend -L +50G /dev/vg_data/lv_db<br># ext4:<br>resize2fs /dev/vg_data/lv_db          # qurilma yo'li bilan<br># XFS:<br>xfs_growfs /var/lib/pgsql             # MOUNT NUQTASI bilan<br>df -h /var/lib/pgsql                  # tekshir</pre><p><b>Cloud diskni kengaytirgan bo'lsang (EBS 100G -&gt; 200G):</b></p><pre>growpart /dev/nvme1n1 1      # bo'lim jadvalini kengaytir (bo'lim bo'lsa)<br>pvresize /dev/nvme1n1p1      # PV yangi hajmni ko'rsin<br>lvextend -r -l +100%FREE /dev/vg_data/lv_db</pre><p><b>ext4 vs XFS:</b> | | ext4 | XFS | |---|---|---| | Onlayn kengaytirish | ha | ha | | Kichraytirish | faqat unmount qilib | <b>mumkin emas</b> | | Buyruq | <code>resize2fs &lt;device&gt;</code> | <code>xfs_growfs &lt;mountpoint&gt;</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>LV'ni kengaytirib fayl tizimini unutish — <code>df</code> eski hajmni ko'rsatadi.</li><li>ext4'ni kichraytirishda tartib teskari (avval FS, keyin LV) — xato tartib = ma'lumot yo'qolishi. Har doim backup.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avtomatlashtirilgan runbook: disk 85% alert → yangi hajm → <code>growpart</code> + <code>pvresize</code> + <code>lvextend -r</code>. Kichraytirish kerak bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan joyda XFS'ni tanlama.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41474	<p>ext4, XFS va Btrfs farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b></p><ul><li><b>ext4</b> — eng keng tarqalgan, ishonchli, universal; Debian/Ubuntu default.</li><li><b>XFS</b> — katta fayllar va yuqori parallel I/O uchun kuchli; RHEL/Rocky default; kichraytirib bo'lmaydi.</li><li><b>Btrfs</b> — copy-on-write: snapshot, siqish, checksum, subvolume'lar o'rnatilgan; openSUSE/Fedora default.</li></ul><p><b>Solishtirish:</b> | | ext4 | XFS | Btrfs | |---|---|---|---| | Model | journaling | journaling | copy-on-write | | Max hajm | 1 EiB | 8 EiB | 16 EiB | | Onlayn kengaytirish | ha | ha | ha | | Kichraytirish | offline | yo'q | onlayn | | Snapshot | yo'q (LVM bilan) | yo'q (LVM bilan) | o'rnatilgan, arzon | | Data checksum | yo'q (faqat metadata) | metadata | ma'lumot + metadata | | Siqish | yo'q | yo'q | zstd/lzo | | Inode'lar | yaratishda qotiriladi | dinamik | dinamik | | Kuchli joyi | universal, fsck tez | katta fayl, ko'p thread | snapshot, rollback, NAS |</p><p><b>Qayerda nima:</b></p><ul><li>Umumiy server, VM root — <b>ext4</b>.</li><li>DB (PostgreSQL, MongoDB tavsiyasi), log, media, katta disklar — <b>XFS</b>.</li><li>Desktop rollback (snapper), konteyner build, NAS — <b>Btrfs</b>.</li><li>(ZFS — Btrfs'ga o'xshash, lekin yanada yetuk; litsenziya tufayli kernel'dan tashqarida.)</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>mkfs.ext4 -L data /dev/sdb1<br>mkfs.xfs  -L data /dev/sdb1<br>mkfs.btrfs -L data /dev/sdb1<br>lsblk -f                         # qaysi FS qayerda<br>btrfs subvolume snapshot / /.snapshots/pre-upgrade</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Btrfs RAID5/6 — hali ishonchsiz deb hisoblanadi.</li><li>Btrfs'da DB fayllari CoW tufayli fragmentatsiya — <code>chattr +C</code> (nodatacow).</li><li>XFS'ga katta hajm ajratib qo'yib, keyin kichraytira olmaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov — workload bo'yicha: I/O pattern, snapshot ehtiyoji, operatsion tajriba. Benchmark (<code>fio</code>) real yuklama bilan qil, internet tavsiyasi bilan emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41475	<p><code>/etc/fstab</code> nima va uning 6 maydoni?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/etc/fstab</code> — boot vaqtida <b>qaysi qurilma qayerga va qanday opsiyalar bilan avtomatik mount</b> qilinishini belgilaydigan jadval. Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41478	<p><code>strace</code> nima va ishlab turgan process'ni qanday trace qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>strace</code> — process'ning <b>kernel bilan qiladigan barcha system call'larini</b> (open, read, write, connect, futex...) real vaqtda ko'rsatadigan tool. Ilova &quot;osilib qoldi&quot; yoki &quot;nima uchundir ishlamayapti&quot; bo'lsa — u nimaga urinayotganini va qayerda xato olayotganini ko'rasan.</p><p><b>Ishlab turgan process'ga ulanish:</b></p><pre>strace -p 1234                          # bitta PID<br>strace -fp 1234                         # barcha thread/child'lar bilan<br>strace -fp 1234 -e trace=network        # faqat tarmoq syscall'lari<br>strace -fp 1234 -e trace=file           # faqat fayl operatsiyalari<br>strace -fp 1234 -tt -T                  # vaqt belgisi + har syscall davomiyligi<br>strace -c -fp 1234                      # Ctrl+C dan keyin statistik xulosa<br>strace -f -o /tmp/trace.txt ./app       # yangi process'ni ishga tushirib, faylga</pre><p><b>Chiqishni o'qish:</b></p><pre>openat(AT_FDCWD, &quot;/etc/app/config.yml&quot;, O_RDONLY) = -1 ENOENT (No such file or directory)<br>   -&gt;                 -&gt; socket'dan javob kutib osilib qolgan<br>futex(0x7f..., FUTEX_WAIT, ...)          -&gt; lock kutyapti (deadlock?)</pre><p><b>Tipik foydalanish:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Config qayerdan o'qiladi?&quot; Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41479	<p><code>lsof</code> bilan ochiq fayl va socket'larni qanday topasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>lsof</code> (list open files) — qaysi process <b>qaysi fayl, papka, socket, pipe yoki qurilmani ochiq tutganini</b> ko'rsatadi. Avval <code>-v</code> bilan ko'r, keyin <code>-TERM</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41481	<p><code>vmstat</code> va undagi <code>bi</code>, <code>bo</code>, <code>wa</code>, <code>si</code>, <code>so</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>vmstat</code> — CPU, xotira, swap va disk I/O holatini bir qatorda ko'rsatadigan tez diagnostika tool. <code>bi</code>/<code>bo</code> — diskdan o'qilgan/yozilgan block'lar, <code>wa</code> — CPU I/O kutishda turgan vaqt foizi, <code>si</code>/<code>so</code> — swap-in/swap-out.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Server &quot;sekin&quot; bo'lsa birinchi savol: CPU'mi, RAM'mi yoki disk'mi? <code>vmstat 1</code> 5 soniyada shu savolga javob beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday o'qiladi:</b></p><pre>procs  memory              swap     io       system   cpu<br> r  b  swpd free buff cache si so   bi  bo   in  cs   us sy id wa st<br> 8  3  ...                 0  0   120 4500  ...      20  5 40 35  0<br> ^  ^                      ^  ^    ^   ^             ^          ^<br> |  bloklangan (D state)   swap    disk I/O          user       I/O wait<br> run queue (CPU kutyapti)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>vmstat 1 5        # har 1 s, 5 marta. BIRINCHI qator boot'dan beri o'rtacha - e'tibor berma<br>vmstat -w 1       # keng format<br>vmstat -s         # xotira statistikasi umumiy</pre><p>O'qish qoidasi:</p><ul><li><code>r</code> &gt; CPU yadrolari soni doimiy — CPU bottleneck.</li><li><code>b</code> &gt; 0 va <code>wa</code> yuqori — disk sekin (keyin <code>iostat -x</code>).</li><li><code>si</code>/<code>so</code> doimiy &gt; 0 — RAM yetmayapti, thrashing.</li><li><code>st</code> &gt; 0 (VM'da) — hypervisor CPU'ni o'g'irlayapti (noisy neighbour).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Birinchi qatorni joriy holat deb o'qish — u boot'dan beri o'rtacha.</li><li><code>swpd</code> katta, lekin <code>si/so</code> = 0 — bu muammo emas, faqat eski sahifalar swap'da yotibdi.</li><li><code>free</code> kichikligidan qo'rqish — Linux bo'sh RAM'ni <code>cache</code> ga ishlatadi; <code>available</code> muhim (<code>free -h</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>vmstat</code> triage tool — &quot;qaysi resurs?&quot; degan savolga javob beradi, keyin aniq tool'ga o'tasiz (<code>iostat</code>, <code>pidstat</code>, <code>perf</code>). <code>wa</code> yolg'on ko'rsatkich bo'lishi mumkin: CPU bo'sh bo'lsa ko'tariladi, band bo'lsa I/O kutish bo'lsa ham 0 ko'rinadi — PSI (<code>/proc/pressure/io</code>) aniqroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41482	<p><code>iostat</code> va <code>%util</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>iostat</code> (sysstat paketi) har bir disk qurilma bo'yicha I/O yuklamasini ko'rsatadi. <code>%util</code> — qurilma kamida bitta so'rovga xizmat qilib band bo'lgan vaqt foizi. HDD uchun 100% = to'yingan; SSD/NVMe uchun bu chalg'ituvchi, chunki ular parallel ko'p so'rovni bajaradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> <code>vmstat</code> da <code>wa</code> yuqori — qaysi disk aybdor va u haqiqatan to'yinganmi, buni <code>iostat -x</code> aytadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>iostat -xz 1      # -x kengaytirilgan, -z faol bo'lmaganlarni yashir</pre><pre>Device  r/s   w/s   rkB/s  wkB/s  r_await w_await aqu-sz %util<br>nvme0n1 850  2300   34000  92000    0.4    12.5    28.7   99.8</pre><p>O'qish:</p><ul><li><code>r/s</code>, <code>w/s</code> — IOPS; <code>rkB/s</code>, <code>wkB/s</code> — throughput.</li><li><code>r_await</code>/<code>w_await</code> — o'rtacha kutish+xizmat vaqti (ms). Doimiy katta — so'rovlar navbatda turibdi.</li><li><code>%util</code> — faqat &quot;band bo'ldimi&quot; ni o'lchaydi, sig'imni emas.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NVMe'da <code>%util</code> 100% ni &quot;disk to'ldi&quot; deb xulosa qilish — u hali 5x ko'proq so'rovni ko'tarishi mumkin. <code>await</code> o'sishiga qarang.</li><li><code>iostat</code> ni argumentsiz ishlatish — boot'dan beri o'rtachani beradi.</li><li><code>svctm</code> ustuniga ishonish — u deprecated va noto'g'ri, yangi versiyalarda olib tashlangan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Disk muammosini bitta formula bilan baholang: latency (<code>await</code>) SLO'dan oshyaptimi va navbat (<code>aqu-sz</code>) o'syaptimi. Cloud diskda (EBS gp3) IOPS/throughput limiti bor — <code>%util</code> past bo'lsa ham throttle bo'lishi mumkin, CloudWatch'dagi <code>VolumeQueueLength</code> ni ham tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41483	<p><code>netstat</code> va <code>ss</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham socket'larni ko'rsatadi. <code>netstat</code> (net-tools) eski va deprecated — <code>/proc/net/*</code> matn fayllarini parse qiladi, minglab ulanishda sekin. <code>ss</code> (iproute2) ma'lumotni kernel'dan <code>netlink</code>/<code>sock_diag</code> orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oladi — tez va ko'proq detal (TCP ichki holati) beradi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> 100k ulanishli load balancer'da <code>netstat -an</code> soniyalab osilib qoladi, <code>ss</code> darhol javob beradi. Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41486	<p><code>nice</code> va <code>renice</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham process'ning CPU prioritetini (niceness) boshqaradi: <code>-20</code> (eng yuqori) dan <code>19</code> (eng past) gacha, default <code>0</code>. <code>nice</code> — <b>yangi</b> process'ni berilgan niceness bilan ishga tushiradi; <code>renice</code> — <b>ishlab turgan</b> process'ning qiymatini o'zgartiradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Prod serverda backup yoki log siqish ishlayapti va API latency oshdi. Raqobat bo'lmasa, nice 19 process ham butun bo'sh CPU'ni oladi — bu limit emas, ustunlik.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>nice -n 19 tar czf /backup/data.tgz /data      # past prioritet<br>renice -n 10 -p 12345                          # mavjud process<br>renice -n 5 -u deploy                          # user'ning hammasi<br>ps -o pid,ni,comm -p 12345                     # NI ustuni<br>ionice -c3 -p 12345                            # disk I/O ni ham &quot;idle&quot; qilish<br># systemd servisida:<br># [Service]<br># Nice=10<br># IOSchedulingClass=idle</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oddiy user faqat niceness'ni oshira oladi (prioritetni tushira oladi); manfiy qiymat yoki kamaytirish uchun root/<code>CAP_SYS_NICE</code> kerak.</li><li><code>nice</code> faqat CPU'ga ta'sir qiladi — disk'ni bosayotgan backup uchun <code>ionice</code> ham kerak.</li><li>Container'da <code>nice</code> cgroup CPU limitlarini chetlab o'tmaydi — cgroup'lar orasida <code>cpu.weight</code> ishlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qattiq izolyatsiya kerak bo'lsa niceness emas, cgroup (<code>CPUQuota=</code>, <code>CPUWeight=</code>, K8s <code>requests/limits</code>) ishlating. <code>nice</code> — bitta host ichidagi yengil tuning vositasi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41487	<p><code>kill</code>, <code>pkill</code> va <code>killall</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uchalasi ham signal yuboradi (default <code>SIGTERM</code>), farqi — nishonni qanday tanlashida: <code>kill</code> — aniq <b>PID</b> bo'yicha; <code>pkill</code> — process nomi/atributlari <b>pattern</b> bo'yicha; <code>killall</code> — aniq <b>nom</b> bo'yicha hamma nusxaga.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Noto'g'ri pattern prod'da kerakli process'larni ham o'ldirishi mumkin. Avval kim ta'sirlanishini ko'rish odati kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kill 1234               # SIGTERM<br>kill -9 1234            # SIGKILL (oxirgi chora)<br>kill -HUP $(cat /run/nginx.pid)   # config reload<br><br>pgrep -a python         # avval kimlar mos kelishini ko'r!<br>pkill -f &quot;worker.py --queue=email&quot;   # -f: to'liq buyruq qatori bo'yicha<br>pkill -u deploy node    # faqat deploy user'ning node process'lari<br><br>killall nginx           # aynan &quot;nginx&quot; nomli hammasi<br>killall -w myapp        # o'lishini kutadi</pre><p>| Tool | Nishon | Xavf | |---|---|---| | <code>kill</code> | PID | eng xavfsiz | | <code>pkill</code> | regex (nom yoki <code>-f</code> bilan cmdline) | keng pattern ortiqcha urishi mumkin | | <code>killall</code> | aniq nom | Solaris'da <code>killall</code> HAMMA process'ni o'ldiradi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>pkill python</code> — nomi ichida &quot;python&quot; bor hamma narsani (python3, ipython) o'ldiradi.</li><li><code>pkill -f</code> o'zini chaqirgan shell skriptga ham mos kelishi mumkin.</li><li>Darhol <code>kill -9</code> — app graceful shutdown (connection yopish, flush) qila olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> systemd servislarini <code>kill</code> bilan emas, <code>systemctl stop/reload</code> bilan boshqaring — aks holda <code>Restart=</code> uni qayta ko'taradi va holat chalkashadi. Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41488	<p>Asosiy Linux signal'lari (<code>SIGTERM</code>, <code>SIGKILL</code>, <code>SIGHUP</code>, <code>SIGINT</code>, <code>SIGQUIT</code>) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Signal — kernel'ning process'ga asinxron xabari. <code>SIGTERM</code>(15) — &quot;iltimos to'xta&quot;, ushlanadi; <code>SIGKILL</code>(9) — kernel darhol o'ldiradi, ushlab bo'lmaydi; <code>SIGHUP</code>(1) — terminal uzildi, daemon'larda config reload; <code>SIGINT</code>(2) — Ctrl+C; <code>SIGQUIT</code>(3) — Ctrl+\, core dump bilan chiqish.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Graceful shutdown butunlay signal'larga bog'liq: K8s pod o'chganda avval SIGTERM yuboradi, <code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code> (default 30 s) tugasa SIGKILL.</p><pre>kubectl delete pod / docker stop<br>      |<br>      v<br>  SIGTERM -&gt; app: yangi so'rov qabul qilma, borlarini tugat, DB yop, exit 0<br>      |<br>  (30 s kutish)<br>      v<br>  SIGKILL -&gt; majburan o'ldirish (exit 137)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kill -l                    # barcha signal ro'yxati<br>kill -TERM 1234<br>kill -HUP 1234             # nginx/sshd: config reload<br>trap 'echo cleanup; exit 0' TERM INT   # bash'da ushlash</pre><p>Go'da:</p><pre>ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM, syscall.SIGINT)<br>defer stop()<br>&lt;-ctx.Done()<br>srv.Shutdown(context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second))</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Container'da app PID 1 bo'lib, shell orqali (<code>CMD sh -c &quot;app&quot;</code>) ishga tushirilsa SIGTERM app'ga yetmaydi — exec form yoki <code>tini</code> ishlating.</li><li>PID 1 default handler'siz SIGTERM'ni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.</li><li><code>SIGKILL</code> dan keyin cleanup yo'q: lock fayl, yarim yozilgan fayl qoladi.</li><li><code>SIGSTOP</code> ham ushlanmaydi (SIGKILL kabi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Exit code 137 = 128+9 (SIGKILL, ko'pincha OOM killer), 143 = 128+15 (SIGTERM). Graceful shutdown'ni test qiling: readiness'ni darhol false qiling, in-flight so'rovlarni tugating va grace period'dan oldin chiqing.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41489	<p>Core dump nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Core dump — process crash bo'lgan paytdagi (SIGSEGV, SIGABRT, SIGQUIT) xotirasi, registrlari va thread stack'larining diskdagi nusxasi. Uni <code>gdb</code> bilan ochib, crash qaysi qatorda va qanday holatda bo'lganini post-mortem tahlil qilasiz.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Prod'da kamdan-kam, qayta hosil qilib bo'lmaydigan segfault — log'da faqat &quot;Segmentation fault&quot;. Core dump — yagona dalil.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>process -&gt; SIGSEGV -&gt; kernel: ulimit -c &gt; 0 ?<br>                           |<br>              /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern<br>                 |                       |<br>         &quot;core&quot; -&gt; joriy papkaga   &quot;|/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-coredump&quot;<br>                                         -&gt; /var/lib/systemd/coredump/ (siqilgan)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ulimit -c unlimited                 # shu shell uchun yoqish<br>cat /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern   # qayerga yoziladi<br>coredumpctl list                    # systemd-coredump yig'ganlari<br>coredumpctl info 4321               # signal, stack qisqacha<br>coredumpctl gdb 4321                # to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gdb'da ochish<br># gdb ichida:<br>(gdb) bt            # backtrace<br>(gdb) thread apply all bt</pre><p>Go uchun: <code>GOTRACEBACK=crash</code> bilan panic'da core dump hosil bo'ladi, <code>dlv core ./app core</code> bilan ochiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Debug symbol'siz binary — <code>bt</code> faqat adreslar (<code>??</code>) ko'rsatadi; symbol'larni alohida saqlang (<code>debuginfod</code>).</li><li>Core dump xotiradagi parol, token, PII'ni o'z ichiga oladi — xavfsizlik riski.</li><li>Katta process (20 GB heap) diskni to'ldirishi mumkin; <code>systemd-coredump</code> limitlari (<code>/etc/systemd/coredump.conf</code>).</li><li>Container'da <code>core_pattern</code> host'niki — dump host'ga ketadi yoki yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da core dump'ni default o'chirib, faqat kerakli servis uchun nazorat bilan yoqing (<code>LimitCORE=infinity</code>), shifrlangan joyda va qisqa muddat saqlang. Release'da binary bilan birga symbol fayl'ni artifact sifatida arxivlash — post-mortem'ning asosi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41490	<p><code>gdb</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>gdb</code> (GNU Debugger) — ishlab turgan process'ga ulanish yoki core dump'ni ochib, call stack, o'zgaruvchilar, registrlar va thread'larni tekshirish, breakpoint qo'yish va qadam-baqadam bajarish imkonini beradigan interaktiv debugger.
