PREROUTING(raw,mangle,nat:DNAT) -&gt; routing qarori<br>                                  |                         |<br>                         host'ga mo'ljallangan        boshqaga<br>                                  v                         v<br>                        INPUT(filter) -&gt; process     FORWARD(filter)<br>                                           |                |<br>                        process -&gt; OUTPUT(nat,filter)       |<br>                                           \                v<br>                                            -&gt;  POSTROUTING(nat:SNAT/MASQ) -&gt; tarmoqqa</pre><p>Qoidalar yuqoridan pastga tekshiriladi; birinchi terminal target yutadi; hech biri mos kelmasa chain <b>policy</b> ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>iptables -L -n -v --line-numbers        # filter table, hisoblagichlar bilan<br>iptables -t nat -L -n -v<br>iptables -A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT<br>iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -s 10.0.0.0/8 -j ACCEPT<br>iptables -P INPUT DROP                  # default policy<br>iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE<br>iptables-save &gt; tcpdump SYN ketdi-yu SYN-ACK kelmadimi, yoki RST qaytdimi — aniq ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>tcpdump -i eth0 -nn -s0 -w /tmp/cap.pcap port 443<br>#  -i any     barcha interfeyslar<br>#  -nn        DNS va port nomlarini resolve qilmaslik (tez, xolis)<br>#  -s0        to'liq paket (zamonaviy versiyada default)<br>#  -w         faylga yozish<br>#  -c 1000    1000 paketdan keyin to'xtash<br>tcpdump -i eth0 -nn 'host 10.0.0.5 and tcp port 5432'<br>tcpdump -i eth0 -nn 'tcp[tcpflags] &amp; (tcp-syn|tcp-rst) != 0'   # faqat SYN/RST<br>tcpdump -i eth0 -nn -A 'port 80'                               # payload ASCII<br>tcpdump -r /tmp/cap.pcap -nn | head<br>tcpdump -i eth0 -w cap-%H%M.pcap -G 300 -W 12                  # rotatsiya: 5 daq x 12</pre><p>O'qish:</p><pre>10:01:02 IP 10.0.0.2.51234 &gt; 10.0.0.5.5432: Flags [S]   &lt;- SYN<br>10:01:02 IP 10.0.0.5.5432 &gt; 10.0.0.2.51234: Flags [R.]  &lt;- RST: port yopiq/hech kim tinglamaydi</pre><p>SYN qayta-qayta, javobsiz — firewall DROP qilmoqda.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Filtrsiz band serverda ushlash — disk to'ladi va paketlar <code>dropped by kernel</code>.</li><li><code>-nn</code> siz — tcpdump o'zi DNS so'rovlari yuboradi, natija chalkashadi.</li><li>TLS trafigi shifrlangan — payload ko'rinmaydi; handshake/SNI va vaqtlarni tahlil qiling.</li><li>K8s pod trafigi uchun pod network namespace'ga kiring (<code>nsenter -t &lt;pid&gt; -n tcpdump ...</code>) yoki <code>kubectl debug</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ikki tomonda bir vaqtda ushlang (client va server) — paket qayerda yo'qolganini (oraliqdagi firewall, NAT, MTU) aniqlashning yagona ishonchli usuli. pcap'da sezgir ma'lumot bo'ladi — ehtiyot bilan ulashing.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41499	<p><code>iperf3</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>iperf3</code> — ikki host orasidagi tarmoqning maksimal throughput'i (TCP), shuningdek UDP'da jitter va paket yo'qotishini o'lchaydigan tool. Bir tomonda server, ikkinchisida client ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;Fayl ko'chirish sekin&quot; — disk'mi, ilova'mi, tarmoqmi? iperf3 xotiradan xotiraga sof tarmoq sig'imini o'lchaydi — tarmoqni boshqa omillardan ajratadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># server tomonda<br>iperf3 -s                    # default port 5201<br># client tomonda<br>iperf3 -c 10.0.0.5           # 10 s TCP test, client -&gt; server<br>iperf3 -c 10.0.0.5 -R        # teskari yo'nalish (server -&gt; client)<br>iperf3 -c 10.0.0.5 -P 8      # 8 parallel oqim<br>iperf3 -c 10.0.0.5 -u -b 500M   # UDP 500 Mbit/s: jitter va loss<br>iperf3 -c 10.0.0.5 -t 60 -J &gt; result.json</pre><p>O'qish:</p><pre>[ ID] Interval       Transfer     Bitrate         Retr<br>[  5] 0.00-10.00 sec 10.9 GBytes  9.38 Gbits/sec   12   sender</pre><ul><li><code>Bitrate</code> 10G link'da ~9.4 Gbit/s — normal (header overhead).</li><li><code>Retr</code> ko'p — paket yo'qotish/tirbandlik.</li><li>Bitta oqim past, <code>-P 8</code> yuqori — bitta TCP oqim (RTT x window) chegarasi yoki bitta CPU yadrosi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Server porti firewall'da yopiq — &quot;unable to connect&quot;.</li><li>Prod link'da uzoq test boshqa trafikni bosib qo'yadi.</li><li>Cloud'da instance turi bandwidth limiti va burst kreditlari natijani o'zgartiradi — qisqa test burst'ni o'lchaydi.</li><li><code>iperf</code> (v2) va <code>iperf3</code> protokollari mos emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yuqori RTT (cross-region) da bitta oqim sekin bo'lsa, bu TCP window/BDP muammosi — <code>-P</code> bilan solishtirib ko'ring. Natijani faqat bitta raqam sifatida emas, retransmit va CPU yuklamasi bilan birga baholang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41500	<p><code>traceroute</code> va <code>mtr</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>traceroute</code> — paketlarni TTL=1,2,3... bilan yuborib, har routerdan kelgan &quot;TTL exceeded&quot; javobi orqali marshrutdagi hop'larni <b>bir marta</b> ko'rsatadi. <code>mtr</code> — traceroute + ping: har hop'ga uzluksiz so'rov yuborib, <b>loss% va latency statistikasini</b> jonli ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>TTL=1 -&gt; router1 TTL=0 qiladi -&gt; &quot;ICMP time exceeded&quot; -&gt; hop 1 = router1<br>TTL=2 -&gt; router1 -&gt; router2 -&gt; time exceeded         -&gt; hop 2 = router2<br>...  manzilga yetguncha</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>traceroute -n 8.8.8.8          # UDP (Linux default)<br>traceroute -T -p 443 api.example.com   # TCP SYN - firewall'lardan yaxshiroq o'tadi<br>mtr -n api.example.com         # interaktiv<br>mtr -rwzbc 100 api.example.com # report: 100 paket, ASN bilan</pre><p>mtr chiqishi:</p><pre>Host            Loss%  Snt  Avg  Best  Wrst StDev<br>1. 10.0.0.1      0.0%  100  0.5  0.3   1.2   0.1<br>4. 72.14.x.x    40.0%  100 12.1 11.0  15.0   0.8   &lt;- faqat shu hop'da loss<br>9. 8.8.8.8       0.0%  100 12.5 11.8  14.1   0.4   &lt;- oxirgi hop toza =&gt; muammo YO'Q</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oraliq hop'dagi loss'ni muammo deb hisoblash — routerlar ICMP javobini rate-limit qiladi. Loss <b>oxirgi hop'gacha davom etsa</b> haqiqiy muammo.</li><li><code>* * *</code> — router javob bermaydi, bu albatta uzilish emas.</li><li>Qaytish yo'li boshqa bo'lishi mumkin (asimmetrik routing) — teskari tomondan ham mtr kerak.</li><li>Cloud ichida (VPC) ko'p hop'lar ko'rinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provayderga shikoyat qilishda <code>mtr -rwzbc 200</code> report'ini ikki yo'nalishda biriktiring — bu standart dalil. Latency hop N dan boshlab doimiy oshsa — o'sha bo'g'in (ko'pincha okean osti kabel yoki peering) aybdor.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41501	<p><code>/etc/security/limits.conf</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/etc/security/limits.conf</code> (va <code>/etc/security/limits.d/*.conf</code>) — <code>pam_limits</code> modulu orqali <b>login sessiyasi</b> (ssh, su, login) process'lariga resurs limitlari (ulimit): ochiq fayllar <code>nofile</code>, process'lar <code>nproc</code>, <code>core</code>, <code>memlock</code>, <code>stack</code>. systemd servislariga ta'sir qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Klassik incident: &quot;Too many open files&quot; — Nginx/DB 1024 fayl limiti bilan ishlayapti. Admin limits.conf'ni o'zgartiradi, lekin servis systemd orqali ishga tushgani uchun hech narsa o'zgarmaydi.</p><p><b>Format:</b></p><pre># domain   type  item    value<br>appuser    soft  nofile  65536<br>appuser    hard  nofile  131072<br>@devs      hard  nproc   4096<br>*          soft  core    0</pre><p><code>soft</code> — joriy limit (user <code>ulimit</code> bilan hard'gacha oshira oladi); <code>hard</code> — shift.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ulimit -n                          # joriy soft nofile<br>ulimit -Hn                         # hard<br>cat /proc/$(pgrep -o nginx)/limits # ishlab turgan process'ning HAQIQIY limiti</pre><p>systemd servisi uchun to'g'ri yo'l:</p><pre>systemctl edit nginx<br># [Service]<br># LimitNOFILE=65536<br>systemctl daemon-reload &amp;&amp; systemctl restart nginx</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Servis uchun limits.conf'ni tahrirlash — ta'sir yo'q, unit'da <code>LimitNOFILE=</code>.</li><li>O'zgarish faqat yangi login sessiyalarida kuchga kiradi.</li><li>Container limitlari runtime'dan (<code>--ulimit</code>, containerd default) keladi.</li><li>Tizim bo'yicha umumiy chegara <code>fs.file-max</code>/<code>fs.nr_open</code> (sysctl) ham bor.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har doim <code>/proc/&lt;pid&gt;/limits</code> bilan tekshiring — config emas, haqiqiy holat muhim. Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41502	<p><code>chroot</code> jail nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>chroot</code> — process (va bolalari) uchun root papkani (<code>/</code>) boshqa papkaga almashtiradigan syscall/buyruq. Process faqat shu daraxt ichidagi fayllarni &quot;ko'radi&quot;. Bu faqat <b>fayl tizimi ko'rinishini</b> cheklaydi — process, tarmoq, user izolyatsiyasi yo'q, shuning uchun xavfsizlik chegarasi emas.</p><p><b>Qayerda ishlatiladi:</b> Buzilgan tizimni live USB'dan tiklash (<code>chroot /mnt</code> + <code>grub-install</code>), SFTP user'larni papkaga qamash, paket build muhitlari (debootstrap, mock).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>host /                       chroot /srv/jail ichida<br> |- etc                       /  (aslida /srv/jail)<br> |- srv/jail   &lt;- bu           |- bin/bash  (nusxa kerak)<br>     |- bin, lib, etc          |- lib/... Izolyatsiya kerak bo'lsa chroot emas, shu vositalar (yoki systemd <code>RootDirectory=</code> + <code>ProtectSystem=</code>) ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41503	<p><code>systemd-cgls</code> va <code>systemd-cgtop</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham systemd'ning cgroup kuzatuv tool'lari. <code>systemd-cgls</code> — cgroup ierarxiyasini (slice -&gt; Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41504	<p><code>sysctl</code> va <code>/etc/sysctl.conf</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>sysctl</code> — <code>/proc/sys/</code> ostidagi kernel runtime parametrlarini (tarmoq, xotira, fayl tizimi) ko'rish va o'zgartirish tool'i. <code>sysctl -w</code> o'zgarishi reboot'da yo'qoladi; doimiy qilish uchun <code>/etc/sysctl.d/*.conf</code> fayliga yozib <code>sysctl --system</code> qilinadi (<code>/etc/sysctl.conf</code> eski, lekin hali o'qiladi).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Yuqori yuklamali servis default kernel sozlamalariga sig'maydi: masalan accept navbati (<code>somaxconn</code>), port diapazoni, IP forwarding (K8s node'ida majburiy), swappiness.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.core.somaxconn                 # o'qish<br>cat /proc/sys/net/core/somaxconn          # xuddi shu<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1           # vaqtincha<br>sysctl -a | grep tcp_keepalive            # hammasi</pre><p>Doimiy:</p><pre># /etc/sysctl.d/90-app.conf<br>net.core.somaxconn = 4096<br>net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 10240 65535<br>vm.swappiness = 10<br>fs.inotify.max_user_watches = 524288</pre><pre>sysctl --system       # barcha sysctl.d fayllarni qo'llash<br>sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/90-app.conf</pre><p>Fayllar alfavit tartibida o'qiladi — keyingi fayl oldingisini bosadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Internetdan &quot;tuning&quot; ro'yxatini ko'r-ko'rona ko'chirish (<code>tcp_tw_recycle</code> — NAT ortida buzadi, kernel 4.12'da olib tashlangan).</li><li><code>somaxconn</code> ni oshirib, ilovada <code>listen(backlog)</code> ni oshirmaslik — kichigi ishlaydi.</li><li>Container ichida ko'p sysctl'lar host'niki yoki namespace'langan; K8s'da faqat &quot;safe&quot; sysctl'lar pod'da ruxsat etilgan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har sysctl o'zgarishi o'lchovga asoslansin (oldin/keyin metrika) va izoh bilan versiyalangan konfigda tursin. Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41505	<p><code>journalctl -k</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>journalctl -k</code> (<code>--dmesg</code>) — systemd journal'idan faqat <b>kernel xabarlarini</b> chiqaradi. <code>dmesg</code> dan farqi: u faqat joriy ring buffer'ni ko'rsatadi (to'lsa eskilari o'chadi, reboot'da yo'qoladi), <code>journalctl -k</code> esa journal saqlangan bo'lsa <b>oldingi boot'lar</b>ni ham, vaqt filtrlari bilan ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Server tunda reboot bo'ldi. Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41506	<p><code>logrotate</code> (Linux admin) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>logrotate</code> — log fayllarni muntazam (kunlik/haftalik yoki hajm bo'yicha) aylantiradi: joriy faylni qayta nomlaydi, eskilarini siqadi, belgilangan sondan ortig'ini o'chiradi va ilovaga yangi faylga yozishni boshlashini bildiradi. systemd timer (<code>logrotate.timer</code>) yoki cron orqali ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Rotatsiyasiz <code>app.log</code> 200 GB'ga o'sadi va disk to'lib, butun server (DB ham) to'xtaydi — eng ko'p uchraydigan sabablardan biri.</p><p><b>Konfig:</b></p><pre># /etc/logrotate.d/myapp<br>/var/log/myapp/*.log {<br>    daily<br>    rotate 14<br>    maxsize 500M        # kunni kutmasdan hajm oshsa ham aylantir<br>    compress<br>    delaycompress       # oxirgi aylantirilganni hali siqma<br>    missingok<br>    notifempty<br>    create 0640 myapp adm<br>    sharedscripts<br>    postrotate<br>        systemctl kill -s HUP myapp.service<br>    endscript<br>}</pre><p>Ikki usul:</p><pre>create + postrotate(HUP)  : fayl qayta nomlanadi, app signal olib yangi fayl ochadi (to'g'ri)<br>copytruncate              : nusxa olib, asl faylni 0 ga qisqartiradi (app'ni bilmaydi;<br>                            nusxa va truncate orasida qatorlar yo'qolishi mumkin)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>logrotate -d /etc/logrotate.d/myapp      # VM'larda ham log'larni tez markaziy tizimga yuborib, lokalda qisqa muddat saqlash — disk incident'larining oldini oladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41507	<p><code>rsyslog</code> va <code>systemd-journald</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>systemd-journald</code> — systemd'ning log yig'uvchisi: stdout/stderr, syslog va kernel xabarlarini <b>binary, indekslangan, strukturali</b> formatda (metadata: unit, PID, UID, boot ID) saqlaydi, <code>journalctl</code> bilan so'raladi. <code>rsyslog</code> — an'anaviy syslog daemon: log'larni <b>matn fayllarga</b> yozadi va qoidalar bo'yicha filtrlash, masofaviy serverga (TCP/TLS, RELP) yo'naltirishda kuchli.</p><p><b>Odatiy zanjir:</b></p><pre>app stdout/stderr --+<br>syslog() ----------+--&gt; journald --(imjournal / ForwardToSyslog)--&gt; rsyslog<br>kernel ------------+        |                                        |    |<br>                    journalctl                            /var/log/syslog  remote SIEM</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>journalctl -u nginx --since today -p warning<br>journalctl -u nginx -o json-pretty | head        # strukturali maydonlar<br>journalctl --disk-usage<br>journalctl --vacuum-time=7d</pre><p>rsyslog bilan markaziy serverga yuborish:</p><pre># /etc/rsyslog.d/50-remote.conf<br>*.* action(type=&quot;omfwd&quot; target=&quot;logs.internal&quot; port=&quot;514&quot; protocol=&quot;tcp&quot;<br>           queue.type=&quot;LinkedList&quot; queue.filename=&quot;fwd&quot; queue.saveOnShutdown=&quot;on&quot;)</pre><p>| | journald | rsyslog | |---|---|---| | Format | binary, strukturali | matn | | So'rov | <code>journalctl</code> filtrlar | <code>grep</code>, <code>awk</code> | | Masofaga yuborish | cheklangan (<code>systemd-journal-upload</code>) | kuchli, disk queue bilan | | Saqlash | default ko'pincha <code>/run</code> (vaqtinchalik) | <code>/var/log</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Journal persistent emas — reboot'da log'lar yo'qoladi (<code>Storage=persistent</code>).</li><li>journald rate limit (<code>RateLimitBurst</code>) shovqinli app log'larini jimgina tashlaydi.</li><li>Ikkalasi ham to'liq saqlansa — log ikki marta disk egallaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy stack'da ko'pincha journald + log agent (Fluent Bit, Vector, Alloy — <code>systemd</code> input bilan) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri markaziy tizimga yuboradi; rsyslog compliance (syslog formatda SIEM) talab qilingan joyda qoladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory

Qoidalar bo'yicha xavfsizlik hodisalarini (fayl o'qish/o'zgartirish, syscall'lar, login, sudo, ruxsat o'zgarishi) kim (asl <code>auid</code>), qachon, qaysi process bilan qilganini <code>/var/log/audit/audit.log</code> ga yozadi. Interview Drill::Linux::H23 Linux internals, processes & memory	idrill-41509	<p><code>cron</code> va systemd timer farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham ishni jadval bo'yicha ishga tushiradi. <code>cron</code> — sodda, universal, bir qatorli sintaksis. systemd timer — <code>.timer</code> + <code>.service</code> juftligi: journald'da log, dependency'lar, resurs limitlari (cgroup), monotonic timer'lar (boot'dan keyin), <code>Persistent=true</code> (server o'chiq paytda o'tkazib yuborilgan run'ni bajaradi), <code>RandomizedDelaySec</code>, parallel ishga tushishdan himoya.</p><p><b>Amalda — cron:</b></p><pre># crontab -e<br>0 3 * * * /opt/backup.sh &gt;&gt;   # ifodani tekshirish</pre><p>| | cron | systemd timer | |---|---|---| | Log | o'zingiz yo'naltirasiz / mail | journald avtomatik | | O'tkazib yuborilgan run | yo'q (anacron alohida) | <code>Persistent=true</code> | | Overlap | ikkinchi nusxa ham ishga tushadi | servis allaqachon ishlasa qayta boshlamaydi | | Resurs limit | yo'q | cgroup |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>cron'da <code>PATH</code> minimal — skript qo'lda ishlaydi, cron'da &quot;command not found&quot;.</li><li>cron'da <code>%</code> belgisi maxsus — escape qilinmasa buyruq kesiladi.</li><li>Timer yaratilib <code>enable</code> qilinmagan — hech qachon ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p serverda bir vaqtda ishlaydigan job'lar (backup) uchun <code>RandomizedDelaySec</code> — &quot;thundering herd&quot;ni oldini oladi. Job muvaffaqiyatini kuzatish uchun exit status'ni monitoringga yuboring (dead man's switch) — jim fail bo'lgan backup eng xavfli.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
