usiz eski muhit qoladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sudoers</code>'ni oddiy editor bilan tahrirlash — sintaksis xatosi butun sudo'ni o'chirib qo'yadi; doim <code>visudo</code>.</li><li><code>NOPASSWD: ALL</code> yoki <code>sudo vim</code>/<code>sudo less</code> ruxsati — ichidan <code>:!sh</code> bilan to'liq root shell (GTFOBins).</li><li>Ruxsat berilgan skriptni oddiy user yoza oladi — privilege escalation.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da root login va <code>su</code> ni o'chirib, sudo'ni markaziy (LDAP/SSSD, <code>sudo</code> log'i SIEM'ga) boshqaring; yana yaxshirog'i — doimiy huquq o'rniga just-in-time access (Teleport, SSM Session Manager) va har sessiya yozib olinadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::linux sec::h23 Linux_internals_processes_memory
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41511	<p>100k parallel ulanishli web server uchun kernel'ni qanday tuning qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Asosiy g'oya:</b> 100k ulanish = 100k ochiq socket = 100k file descriptor (fd) + kernel buferlari + navbatlar. Default Linux ~1–10k ga mo'ljallangan. Tuning — qaysi limit birinchi to'lishini topib, o'shani ko'tarish. Ko'r-ko'rona konfig ko'chirish emas.</p><h4>0-qadam. Avval o'lcha (baseline)</h4><p>Load test (<code>wrk</code>, <code>k6</code>) yurgizib, nima sinishini ko'r:</p><pre>ss -s                          # jami socket, TIME-WAIT soni<br>ss -ltn                        # LISTEN: Recv-Q (navbatda) / Send-Q (backlog limiti)<br>nstat -az | grep -i -E 'ListenOverflows|ListenDrops|SyncookiesSent'<br>dmesg | grep -i -E 'too many open files|SYN flooding|nf_conntrack: table full'</pre><p>Simptom -&gt; sabab:</p><ul><li><code>accept: too many open files</code> -&gt; fd limit (1-qadam)</li><li><code>ListenOverflows</code> o'syapti, client'da connect timeout -&gt; accept queue to'lgan (2-qadam)</li><li>client tomonda <code>EADDRNOTAVAIL</code> / &quot;Cannot assign requested address&quot; -&gt; ephemeral port tugadi (3-qadam)</li><li><code>nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet</code> -&gt; conntrack (5-qadam)</li></ul><h4>1-qadam. File descriptor limitlari (eng ko'p uchraydigan)</h4><p>Har socket = 1 fd. Ikki daraja bor:</p><ul><li><b>Process limiti</b> (<code>ulimit -n</code>, default 1024) — odatda shu birinchi sinadi.</li><li><b>Tizim limiti</b> <code>fs.file-max</code> / <code>fs.nr_open</code>.</li></ul><pre>cat /proc/$(pidof nginx | cut -d' ' -f1)/limits | grep 'open files'   # haqiqiy limit</pre><p>systemd servisda <code>ulimit</code> va <code>limits.conf</code> <b>ishlamaydi</b> — unit'da berish kerak:</p><pre># systemctl edit nginx<br>[Service]<br>LimitNOFILE=1048576</pre><pre># /etc/sysctl.d/90-web.conf<br>fs.file-max = 2097152<br>fs.nr_open  = 1048576</pre><p>Nginx bo'lsa yana: <code>worker_rlimit_nofile 1048576;</code> va <code>worker_connections 65535;</code>.</p><h4>2-qadam. Listen navbatlari (burst'da ulanish yo'qolmasin)</h4><p>Handshake kernel'da: SYN keladi -&gt; <b>SYN queue</b> (<code>tcp_max_syn_backlog</code>), ACK kelgach -&gt; <b>accept queue</b>, ilova <code>accept()</code> bilan oladi. Ilova sekin <code>accept()</code> qilsa accept queue to'ladi va yangi ulanishlar tashlanadi.</p><p>Accept queue hajmi = <code>min(listen(backlog), net.core.somaxconn)</code>. Ya'ni <b>ikkalasini</b> ko'tarish kerak:</p><pre>net.core.somaxconn = 65535<br>net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog = 65535<br>net.core.netdev_max_backlog = 16384   # NIC -&gt; kernel paket navbati</pre><p>Ilovada: nginx <code>listen 80 backlog=65535;</code>, Go'da backlog <code>somaxconn</code>dan olinadi. Tekshiruv: <code>ss -ltn</code> da <code>Send-Q</code> = 65535 bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><code>tcp_syncookies = 1</code> qoldiring — SYN flood'da himoya.</p><h4>3-qadam. Ephemeral portlar va TIME-WAIT (proxy/client tomoni)</h4><p>Kiruvchi ulanishlar uchun port muammo emas (hammasi :443 ga keladi). Muammo <b>server o'zi chiquvchi ulanish ochganda</b>: nginx -&gt; upstream, app -&gt; DB/Redis. Har chiquvchi ulanish <code>(src_ip, src_port, dst_ip, dst_port)</code> — bitta upstream uchun ~28k port (default <code>32768–60999</code>).</p><p>Yopilgan ulanish 60s <code>TIME_WAIT</code>da portni band qiladi. Shuning uchun:</p><pre>net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 1024 65535   # ~64k port<br>net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1                   # TIME_WAIT portni yangi CHIQUVCHI ulanishga qayta ishlatish</pre><ul><li><code>tcp_tw_reuse</code> faqat chiquvchiga ta'sir qiladi, timestamps kerak — xavfsiz.</li><li><code>tcp_tw_recycle</code> — <b>ishlatmang</b>, NAT ortidagi client'larni buzardi, kernel 4.12 da o'chirilgan.</li><li>Eng to'g'ri yechim — sysctl emas, <b>keepalive / connection pool</b> (nginx <code>upstream { keepalive 256; }</code>). Ulanish qayta ishlatilsa, port ham, TIME_WAIT ham tugamaydi.</li><li><code>1024</code> dan boshlasangiz, o'sha diapazonda listen qiladigan servis porti band bo'lib qolishi mumkin — <code>ip_local_reserved_ports</code> bilan himoyalang.</li></ul><h4>4-qadam. Xotira va buferlar</h4><p>Har TCP socket'ning receive/send buferi bor. 100k × bir necha KB = GB'lar.</p><pre>net.core.rmem_max = 16777216              # setsockopt bilan berish mumkin bo'lgan max<br>net.core.wmem_max = 16777216<br>net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 87380 16777216   # min default max (auto-tuning)<br>net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 65536 16777216</pre><p>Diqqat: ko'p <b>kichik</b> ulanishda (chat, websocket) katta buferlar xotirani yeydi — <code>max</code>ni emas, <code>default</code>ni kichik saqlang. <code>16MB max</code> uzoq-masofali katta transfer uchun foydali. Umumiy TCP xotira limiti — <code>net.ipv4.tcp_mem</code> (sahifalarda); <code>/proc/net/sockstat</code> da <code>mem</code> ni kuzating.</p><h4>5-qadam. Conntrack (iptables/NAT/Docker/K8s bo'lsa)</h4><p>Har ulanish conntrack jadvalida yozuv. Default ~65k-262k — 100k ulanish + TIME_WAIT'da to'ladi va kernel <b>paketlarni jimgina tashlaydi</b>.</p><pre>net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = 1048576</pre><p>Tekshiruv: <code>conntrack -C</code> vs <code>sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max</code>.</p><h4>6-qadam. Throughput: qdisc + BBR</h4><pre>net.core.default_qdisc = fq<br>net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control = bbr</pre><p>BBR packet loss emas, o'lchangan bandwidth/RTT bo'yicha tezlikni boshqaradi — mobil/uzoq client'larda latency yaxshilanadi. <code>fq</code> BBR pacing'i uchun kerak. Bu ulanish <b>sonini</b> emas, <b>sifatini</b> oshiradi. Kernel ≥ 4.9.</p><h4>7-qadam. Qo'llash va saqlash</h4><pre>sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/90-web.conf &lt; tayyor_fayl<br>sudo sysctl --system               # qayta yuklash<br>sysctl net.core.somaxconn          # tekshirish<br>sudo systemctl daemon-reload &amp;&amp; sudo systemctl restart nginx</pre><p><code>/etc/sysctl.conf</code> emas, alohida <code>sysctl.d/</code> fayl — kim nima o'zgartirgani ko'rinadi, Ansible bilan boshqarish oson. Container'da ko'p <code>net.*</code> sysctl namespace'ga tegishli — pod/container darajasida beriladi (<code>securityContext.sysctls</code>).</p><h4>8-qadam. Qayta o'lcha</h4><p>Yana load test: <code>ListenOverflows</code> 0, fd ishlatilishi limitdan uzoq, p99 latency yaxshi. Har o'zgarishni alohida qo'llab ta'sirini ko'ring.</p><h4>Senior nuqtalar</h4><ul><li>Kernel tuning — oxirgi qatlam. Ko'pincha bottleneck <b>ilova</b>: thread-per-connection (100k thread = o'lim). Event-loop (<code>epoll</code>: nginx, Go netpoller, Node) kerak.</li><li>Bitta mashinada 100k — real; 1M (C1M) ham mumkin, lekin CPU core bo'yicha taqsimot (<code>SO_REUSEPORT</code>, RSS/RPS IRQ) kerak bo'ladi.</li><li>Keepalive timeout'larni o'ylang: bo'sh ulanishlar fd va xotira egallaydi.</li><li>Intervyuda javob tartibi: <b>o'lchash -&gt; fd -&gt; backlog -&gt; port/TIME_WAIT -&gt; buffer -&gt; conntrack -&gt; BBR -&gt; qayta o'lchash</b>. Konfigni yodlab aytish emas, har qatorni &quot;qaysi muammoni yechadi&quot; bilan aytish kuchli javob.</li></ul>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41512	<p>TCP 3-way handshake'ni socket darajasida (<code>listen()</code>, <code>accept()</code>, <code>connect()</code>) tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP ulanishni ilova emas, <b>kernel</b> o'rnatadi. Ilova faqat tayyor (<code>ESTABLISHED</code>) ulanishni <code>accept()</code> bilan oladi. Kernel buning uchun ikkita navbat ishlatadi: <b>SYN queue</b> va <b>accept queue</b>.</p><h4>Qadam-baqadam</h4><pre> Client                         Server kernel                    Server ilova<br>   |                                 |  socket(), bind(), listen()   |<br>   |                                 |  &lt;-- navbatlar yaratiladi ----|<br>   |--- SYN ------------------------&gt;|  SYN queue (SYN_RECV)         |<br>   |&lt;-- SYN-ACK ---------------------|                               |<br>   |--- ACK ------------------------&gt;|  accept queue (ESTABLISHED)   |<br>   |  connect() qaytdi               |                               |<br>   |                                 |------ accept() --------------&gt;| yangi fd</pre><ol><li><b><code>socket()</code></b> — fd yaratadi. <b><code>bind()</code></b> — IP:port biriktiradi. <b><code>listen(fd, backlog)</code></b> — socketni LISTEN holatiga o'tkazadi va navbatlarni ochadi.</li><li>Client <b><code>connect()</code></b> chaqiradi — kernel <code>SYN</code> yuboradi, client <code>SYN_SENT</code> holatida.</li><li>Server kernel ulanishni <b>SYN queue</b>'ga <code>SYN_RECV</code> holatida qo'yadi va <code>SYN-ACK</code> qaytaradi. Hajmi: <code>net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog</code>.</li><li>Client <code>ACK</code> yuboradi — client tomonda <code>connect()</code> shu yerda <b>qaytadi</b>.</li><li>Server kernel ulanishni <b>accept queue</b>'ga ko'chiradi. Hajmi: <code>min(listen backlog, net.core.somaxconn)</code>.</li><li>Ilova <b><code>accept()</code></b> chaqiradi — navbatdan bitta ulanishni olib, unga yangi fd beradi. Endi <code>read()</code>/<code>write()</code>.</li></ol><h4>Nega bilish kerak</h4><ul><li>Ilova band bo'lsa ham client ulanib bo'lgan — u accept queue'da kutyapti. Ilova sekin <code>accept()</code> qilsa navbat to'ladi va yangi ulanishlar <b>tashlanadi</b> (accept queue overflow).</li><li>SYN flood hujumi SYN queue'ni to'ldiradi. Himoya: <code>net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1</code> — kernel navbatsiz ishlaydi, holatni cookie ichida saqlaydi.</li></ul><h4>Tekshirish</h4><pre>ss -ltn                     # LISTEN: Recv-Q = navbatdagi, Send-Q = backlog limiti<br>ss -tan state syn-recv | wc -l   # SYN queue'dagi ulanishlar</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>connect()</code> muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishi server ilovasi ulanishni ko'rganini anglatmaydi. Shuning uchun health check TCP connect emas, application-level (HTTP <code>/healthz</code>) bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41513	<p>TCP accept queue overflow nima va qanday aniqlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Accept queue — handshake tugagan, lekin ilova hali <code>accept()</code> qilmagan ulanishlar navbati. U to'lsa, kernel yangi ulanishlarni qabul qilmaydi: client'ning yakuniy <code>ACK</code>ini jimgina tashlaydi. Client retry qiladi, timeout oladi, foydalanuvchi &quot;sayt qotdi&quot; deydi. Server log'larida esa hech narsa yo'q.</p><h4>Nega to'ladi</h4><p>Navbat hajmi <code>min(listen(backlog), net.core.somaxconn)</code>. To'lish sabablari:</p><ul><li>Ilova sekin <code>accept()</code> qiladi: event loop band (bloklovchi kod, GC pause, CPU 100%).</li><li>Backlog juda kichik: eski kernel'da <code>somaxconn</code> default 128 edi (5.4+ da 4096).</li><li>Trafik keskin oshdi (burst).</li></ul><h4>Qanday aniqlanadi</h4><ol><li><b>Navbat holati:</b></li></ol><pre>ss -ltn<br># State  Recv-Q Send-Q  Local Address:Port<br># LISTEN 4097   4096    0.0.0.0:8080      &lt;- Recv-Q &gt; Send-Q = navbat to'lgan</pre><p>LISTEN socket uchun <code>Recv-Q</code> — navbatdagi ulanishlar soni, <code>Send-Q</code> — limit.</p><ol><li><b>Kernel hisoblagichlari</b> (o'syaptimi?):</li></ol><pre>nstat -az | grep -E 'ListenOverflows|ListenDrops'<br>netstat -s | grep -i 'listen'   # &quot;times the listen queue of a socket overflowed&quot;</pre><ol><li><b>Client tomonda:</b> connect timeout, SYN retransmit (<code>tcpdump</code> da bir xil SYN qayta kelishi).</li></ol><h4>Qanday tuzatiladi</h4><ol><li>Avval <b>sababni</b> toping — ilova nega sekin <code>accept()</code> qilyapti (CPU, lock, bloklovchi I/O). Bu asosiy fix.</li><li>Burst uchun navbatni kattalashtiring — <b>ikkala</b> joyda:</li></ol><pre># /etc/sysctl.d/90-net.conf<br>net.core.somaxconn = 65535</pre><p>va ilovada: nginx <code>listen 80 backlog=65535;</code>.</p><ol><li>Ko'proq worker yoki <code>SO_REUSEPORT</code> — bir nechta process bir portni tinglaydi, har birining o'z navbati.</li></ol><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>tcp_abort_on_overflow = 1</code> qilsangiz kernel ACK'ni tashlash o'rniga <code>RST</code> yuboradi — client darhol xato oladi. Bu muammoni tez ko'rsatadi, lekin qisqa burst'larda ham ulanishlarni uzadi. Default (0) odatda to'g'ri.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41514	<p><code>epoll</code>, <code>select</code> va <code>poll</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uchalasi ham &quot;qaysi socket'da ma'lumot tayyor?&quot; degan savolga javob beradi (I/O multiplexing). Farq — <b>qancha ish</b> qilishida. <code>select</code>/<code>poll</code> har safar hamma fd'larni tekshiradi (O(N)). <code>epoll</code> faqat tayyorlarini qaytaradi (O(tayyorlar soni)).</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>10 000 ulanishli server. Har biriga alohida thread ochish qimmat (xotira, context switch). Bitta thread hammasini kuzatishi kerak — buning uchun kernel'dan &quot;qaysilari tayyor?&quot; deb so'raladi.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><ul><li><b><code>select</code></b>: fd'lar bitmask'da. Har chaqiruvda butun ro'yxat kernel'ga <b>nusxalanadi</b>, kernel hammasini aylanib chiqadi, qaytgach ilova ham qaytadan hammasini tekshiradi. Limit: <code>FD_SETSIZE</code> = <b>1024</b> fd.</li><li><b><code>poll</code></b>: <code>select</code> bilan bir xil g'oya, lekin massiv — 1024 limiti yo'q. Baribir har chaqiruvda O(N) nusxa + tekshiruv.</li><li><b><code>epoll</code></b>: holat <b>kernel ichida</b> saqlanadi.</li><li><code>epoll_create()</code> — kuzatish obyekti.</li><li><code>epoll_ctl(ADD, fd)</code> — fd'ni bir marta ro'yxatga qo'shish.</li><li><code>epoll_wait()</code> — faqat <b>tayyor</b> fd'lar ro'yxatini qaytaradi. Kernel paket kelganda callback orqali fd'ni &quot;ready list&quot;ga qo'yadi.</li></ul><h4>Raqamda</h4><p>10 000 ulanish, shundan 10 tasi faol:</p><ul><li><code>select</code>/<code>poll</code>: har chaqiruvda 10 000 ta tekshiruv.</li><li><code>epoll</code>: 10 ta natija.</li></ul><h4>Edge vs Level triggered</h4><ul><li><b>Level-triggered</b> (default): ma'lumot o'qilmaguncha har <code>epoll_wait</code>da qayta xabar beradi. Oddiy, xavfsiz.</li><li><b>Edge-triggered</b> (<code>EPOLLET</code>): faqat holat o'zgarganda bir marta. Tezroq, lekin socket'ni <code>EAGAIN</code>gacha to'liq o'qish shart — aks holda ma'lumot &quot;unutiladi&quot;.</li></ul><h4>Qayerda ishlatiladi</h4><p>nginx, Redis, Node.js (libuv), Go netpoller — hammasi epoll ustida. macOS/BSD analogi — <code>kqueue</code>, yangi Linux'da — <code>io_uring</code>.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ozgina fd (o'nlab) bo'lsa <code>poll</code> ham yetarli va portable. epoll ustunligi minglab, asosan bo'sh turgan ulanishlarda ko'rinadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41515	<p>Linux'da zero-copy (<code>sendfile()</code> / <code>splice()</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zero-copy — ma'lumotni kernel'dan user space'ga va qaytib nusxalamasdan, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kernel ichida uzatish. <code>sendfile()</code> faylni socket'ga, <code>splice()</code> ikki fd orasida pipe orqali uzatadi.</p><h4>Oddiy yo'l (zero-copy'siz)</h4><p>Faylni tarmoqqa yuborish uchun:</p><pre>read(file_fd, buf, n);   // disk -&gt; page cache -&gt; user buffer   (nusxa 1)<br>write(sock_fd, buf, n);  // user buffer -&gt; socket buffer        (nusxa 2)</pre><pre>disk -&gt; [page cache] --copy--&gt; [user buf] --copy--&gt; [socket buf] -&gt; NIC<br>          kernel                  user                 kernel</pre><p>Muammo: 2 ta CPU nusxa + 4 ta user/kernel o'tishi. Ma'lumot ilovaga umuman kerak emas — u shunchaki o'tkazib yuboryapti.</p><h4>sendfile bilan</h4><pre>sendfile(sock_fd, file_fd, &amp;offset, n);</pre><pre>disk -&gt; [page cache] ----------------------&gt; [socket buf] -&gt; NIC<br>                 (hammasi kernel ichida)</pre><p>NIC scatter-gather DMA qo'llasa, socket buffer'ga ham nusxa yo'q — NIC page cache'dan to'g'ri o'qiydi.</p><h4>Kim ishlatadi</h4><ul><li><b>nginx</b>: <code>sendfile on;</code> — statik fayllar.</li><li><b>Kafka</b>: consumer'ga log segmentlarni <code>sendfile</code> bilan beradi — Kafka tezligining asosiy sababi.</li><li><b><code>splice()</code></b>: proxy'lar (socket -&gt; pipe -&gt; socket), HAProxy.</li></ul><h4>Cheklovlar</h4><ul><li>Ma'lumotni <b>o'zgartirib</b> bo'lmaydi (siqish, shifrlash user space'da bo'ladi). TLS bilan klassik <code>sendfile</code> ishlamaydi — buning uchun <b>kTLS</b> (kernel TLS) kerak.</li><li>Kichik javoblarda foyda sezilmaydi — katta fayllarda samarali.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Zero-copy&quot; CPU nusxalari yo'qligini anglatadi, DMA nusxalari baribir bor. Foydasi — CPU va memory bandwidth tejash, natijada bir server ko'proq throughput beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41516	<p>Transparent Huge Pages (THP) nima va nega Redis/MongoDB uchun o'chiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> THP — kernel avtomatik ravishda 4KB sahifalar o'rniga 2MB &quot;katta&quot; sahifalar beradi. Bu odatda tezlashtiradi, lekin Redis/MongoDB kabi DB'larda <b>latency sakrashlari</b> va <b>xotira ortishi</b>ga olib keladi, shuning uchun o'chiriladi.</p><h4>Nega huge page kerak</h4><p>CPU virtual adresni fizikga <b>TLB</b> kesh orqali tarjima qiladi. TLB kichik (~1-2k yozuv).</p><ul><li>4KB sahifa: 1500 yozuv x 4KB = ~6MB xotirani qamraydi.</li><li>2MB sahifa: 1500 x 2MB = ~3GB.</li></ul><p>Katta xotira bilan ishlovchi ilovada TLB miss kamayadi — tezroq.</p><h4>Nega DB'larga zarar</h4><ol><li><b>Compaction latency:</b> 2MB uzluksiz fizik xotira topish uchun kernel xotirani &quot;yig'adi&quot; (<code>khugepaged</code>, direct compaction). Bu so'rov paytida ham bo'lishi mumkin — p99 latency millisekundlab sakraydi.</li><li><b>fork() + Copy-on-Write:</b> Redis snapshot (<code>BGSAVE</code>) uchun <code>fork()</code> qiladi. Parent 1 baytni o'zgartirsa, kernel butun sahifani nusxalaydi: 4KB o'rniga <b>2MB</b>. Natija — RDB paytida xotira keskin oshib, OOM.</li><li><b>Tasodifiy kichik kirish:</b> DB ko'p kichik obyektlarga sochilib kiradi — huge page foydasi kam, zarari ko'p.</li></ol><p>Redis o'zi ogohlantiradi: <code>WARNING you have Transparent Huge Pages (THP) support enabled</code>.</p><h4>Qanday o'chiriladi</h4><pre>cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled   # [always] madvise never<br>echo never | sudo tee /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled<br>echo never | sudo tee /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/defrag</pre><p>Doimiy qilish: kernel parametri <code>transparent_hugepage=never</code> (GRUB) yoki systemd unit. <code>echo</code> reboot'dan keyin yo'qoladi.</p><h4>Variantlar</h4><ul><li><code>always</code> — hamma joyda.</li><li><code>madvise</code> — faqat <code>madvise(MADV_HUGEPAGE)</code> so'ragan ilovalarga. <b>Ko'p hollarda eng yaxshi kompromiss.</b></li><li><code>never</code> — o'chiq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> THP (avtomatik) va <b>static HugePages</b> (<code>vm.nr_hugepages</code>, oldindan ajratilgan) farqli. Oracle, PostgreSQL (<code>huge_pages=on</code>), JVM kabi katta shared memory ilovalari static HugePages'dan foyda oladi — compaction muammosi yo'q.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41517	<p>Dirty memory (<code>vm.dirty_ratio</code> va <code>vm.dirty_background_ratio</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dirty memory — ilova yozgan, page cache'da turgan, lekin hali diskka tushmagan ma'lumot. Ikki sozlama flush qachon boshlanishini belgilaydi: <code>dirty_background_ratio</code> — fonda yozishni boshlash, <code>dirty_ratio</code> — ilovani <b>to'xtatib</b> yozdirish.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><p><code>write()</code> diskka emas, RAM'ga (page cache) yozadi va darhol qaytadi — shuning uchun tez. Kernel keyinroq diskka yozadi (writeback).</p><pre>dirty %:  0 ........ 10% ................ 20% ......<br>                     |                    |<br>     background flush boshlanadi    ilova write() BLOKLANADI<br>     (ilova sezmaydi)               (latency sakraydi)</pre><ul><li><b><code>vm.dirty_background_ratio</code></b> (default 10): RAM'ning shuncha foizi dirty bo'lsa, kernel thread'lari fonda yoza boshlaydi.</li><li><b><code>vm.dirty_ratio</code></b> (default 20): bu chegaraga yetsa, yozayotgan process o'zi flush qilishga majbur — <code>write()</code> sekinlashadi.</li><li><b><code>vm.dirty_expire_centisecs</code></b> (default 3000 = 30s): bundan eski dirty sahifa baribir yoziladi.</li></ul><h4>Muammo: katta RAM</h4><p>256GB RAM'da 20% = <b>51GB</b> dirty. Disk 500MB/s bo'lsa uni yozish ~100s. Natija:</p><ul><li>Uzoq jimlikdan keyin I/O &quot;bo'roni&quot;, hamma narsa qotadi.</li><li>Kutilmagan o'chishda ko'p ma'lumot yo'qoladi (fsync qilinmagan).</li></ul><h4>Yechim — foiz emas, bayt</h4><pre># /etc/sysctl.d/90-dirty.conf<br>vm.dirty_background_bytes = 268435456   # 256MB<br>vm.dirty_bytes            = 1073741824  # 1GB</pre><p><code>_bytes</code> berilsa <code>_ratio</code> e'tiborsiz qoladi. Kichikroq chegara = tez-tez, kichik flush = barqaror latency.</p><h4>Kuzatish</h4><pre>grep -E 'Dirty|Writeback' /proc/meminfo<br>vmstat 1          # bo bo'limi</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DB'lar (PostgreSQL, MySQL) o'zi <code>fsync</code> qiladi — page cache'ga ishonmaydi. Lekin katta dirty to'plami checkpoint paytida <code>fsync</code>ni juda sekinlashtiradi. Shuning uchun DB serverlarda kichik <code>dirty_background_bytes</code> standart tavsiya.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41518	<p>Kernel ring buffer (<code>dmesg</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kernel ring buffer — kernel o'z xabarlarini yozadigan xotiradagi aylanma (circular) buffer. <code>dmesg</code> uni o'qiydi. U to'lsa eng eski xabarlar ustidan yoziladi.</p><h4>Nima yoziladi</h4><ul><li>Boot: hardware topilishi, driver'lar yuklanishi.</li><li>Disk xatolari: <code>I/O error, dev sda, sector ...</code></li><li><b>OOM killer:</b> <code>Out of memory: Killed process 1234 (java)</code>.</li><li>Segfault: <code>app[123]: segfault at 0 ip ...</code></li><li>Tarmoq: <code>nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet</code>, link up/down.</li><li>USB qurilma ulanishi, kernel warning/BUG.</li></ul><h4>Ishlatish</h4><pre>dmesg -T                  # odam o'qiydigan vaqt bilan<br>dmesg -T -l err,warn      # faqat xato va ogohlantirish<br>dmesg -w                  # real vaqtda kuzatish (tail -f kabi)<br>journalctl -k             # systemd tizimida kernel log'lari<br>journalctl -k -b -1       # OLDINGI boot'ning kernel log'lari</pre><h4>Qachon birinchi qaraladi</h4><ul><li>Process sababsiz o'ldi — <code>dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'killed|oom'</code>.</li><li>Disk sekin yoki read-only bo'ldi — <code>dmesg | grep -i error</code>.</li><li>Tarmoq paketlari yo'qolmoqda — conntrack/driver xabarlari.</li></ul><h4>Nozik joylar</h4><ul><li>Buffer hajmi chegaralangan (<code>log_buf_len</code>) — uzoq ishlagan serverda eski xabarlar yo'q bo'ladi. Shuning uchun journald yoki rsyslog ularni diskka saqlaydi.</li><li><code>kernel.dmesg_restrict = 1</code> — oddiy user o'qiy olmaydi (xavfsizlik: kernel adreslari oshkor bo'lmasin).</li><li>Ring buffer reboot'da yo'qoladi — panic sababini ko'rish uchun persistent journal yoki kdump kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Incident paytida ilova log'lari &quot;hech narsa yo'q&quot; desa, birinchi <code>dmesg</code> — OOM, disk va tarmoq muammolari ko'pincha faqat shu yerda ko'rinadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41519	<p>Linux tizimlarida eBPF nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> eBPF — kernel ichida xavfsiz kichik dasturlarni ishga tushirish mexanizmi. Kernel kodini o'zgartirmasdan va modul yuklamasdan, kernel hodisalariga (syscall, tarmoq paketi, funksiya chaqiruvi) &quot;ilmoq&quot; qo'yib, ma'lumot yig'ish yoki xatti-harakatni o'zgartirish mumkin.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Avval kernel ichini ko'rish uchun ikki yo'l bor edi:</p><ul><li>Kernel modul yozish — bitta xato butun serverni yiqitadi.</li><li>Kernel'ni o'zgartirib qayta compile — oylar.</li></ul><p>eBPF uchinchi yo'l: dastur yuklanishdan oldin <b>verifier</b> tekshiradi (cheksiz loop yo'q, xotiraga noto'g'ri kirish yo'q). O'tsa — JIT bilan native kodga compile bo'lib, deyarli bepul ishlaydi.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><pre> user space:  bpftrace / bcc / Cilium<br>                  |  (bytecode yuklaydi)<br> kernel:      verifier -&gt; JIT -&gt; hook'ga biriktiriladi<br>                  hook'lar: kprobe, tracepoint, XDP, tc, cgroup, LSM<br>                  |<br>              BPF map'lar  &lt;-- natijani user space o'qiydi</pre><h4>Amaliy misollar</h4><pre># Qaysi process qaysi faylni ochyapti<br>sudo bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_openat { printf(&quot;%s %s\n&quot;, comm, str(args-&gt;filename)); }'<br><br># Disk I/O latency histogrammasi (bcc)<br>sudo biolatency<br><br># Yangi ishga tushgan process'lar<br>sudo execsnoop</pre><h4>Qayerda ishlatiladi</h4><ul><li><b>Observability:</b> bpftrace, bcc tools, Pixie, Parca (continuous profiling).</li><li><b>Networking:</b> Cilium (K8s CNI, iptables o'rniga), XDP bilan DDoS himoyasi (paketni driver darajasida tashlash).</li><li><b>Security:</b> Falco, Tetragon — runtime'da shubhali syscall'larni aniqlash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> eBPF production'da xavfsiz, chunki verifier kafolat beradi va overhead kichik — shuning uchun &quot;debug uchun restart qilaylik&quot; o'rniga jonli serverda tracing qilish mumkin. Cheklov: yangi kernel kerak (5.x+, BTF/CO-RE bilan), va root/<code>CAP_BPF</code> huquqi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41520	<p><code>perf</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>perf</code> — Linux'ning rasmiy profiler'i. CPU vaqti <b>qaysi funksiyada</b> ketayotganini, cache miss, branch miss kabi hardware hodisalarni va kernel tracepoint'larni o'lchaydi. &quot;CPU 100% — lekin nima qilyapti?&quot; savoliga javob.</p><h4>Asosiy buyruqlar</h4><pre>perf top                          # jonli: eng ko'p CPU yeyayotgan funksiyalar<br>perf stat -p &lt;PID&gt; sleep 10       # umumiy hisoblagichlar: cycles, instructions, IPC, cache-misses<br>perf record -F 99 -g -p &lt;PID&gt; -- sleep 30   # 30s namuna olish, call stack bilan<br>perf report                       # natijani ko'rish</pre><ul><li><code>-F 99</code> — sekundiga 99 marta namuna (sampling). Overhead kichik, production'da xavfsiz.</li><li><code>-g</code> — call graph (kim kimni chaqirgan).</li></ul><h4>Flame graph</h4><pre>perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl | flamegraph.pl &gt; cpu.svg</pre><p>Kenglik = CPU vaqti ulushi. Eng keng &quot;plato&quot; — optimallashtirish joyi.</p><h4><code>perf stat</code> natijasini o'qish</h4><ul><li><b>IPC</b> (instructions per cycle) &lt; 1 — CPU ko'p vaqt <b>xotirani kutyapti</b> (cache miss). Algoritm emas, data layout muammosi.</li><li>IPC &gt; 2 — CPU samarali, haqiqatan ko'p hisoblayapti.</li></ul><h4>Tez-tez uchraydigan muammolar</h4><ul><li>Funksiya nomlari o'rniga hex adreslar — symbol yo'q. Debug symbol paketini o'rnating yoki binary'ni strip qilmang.</li><li>JVM/Node (JIT) — <code>perf-&lt;pid&gt;.map</code> kerak (<code>-XX:+PreserveFramePointer</code>, <code>--perf-basic-prof</code>).</li><li>Container ichida — <code>perf_event_paranoid</code> va capability'lar cheklaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>perf</code> faqat <b>on-CPU</b> vaqtni ko'rsatadi. Process kutayotgan bo'lsa (lock, disk, tarmoq), u flame graph'da ko'rinmaydi — buning uchun <b>off-CPU</b> analiz (<code>offcputime</code> eBPF tool) kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41521	<p>Ssenariy: 8 yadroli serverda load average 45.0, lekin CPU 15%. Bottleneck nima va qanday tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CPU bo'sh, lekin load yuqori — demak process'lar CPU'ni emas, <b>I/O'ni kutyapti</b>. Linux load average'ga <code>D</code> holatidagi (uninterruptible sleep — odatda disk yoki NFS kutayotgan) process'larni ham qo'shadi.</p><h4>Load average nimani sanaydi</h4><p>Load = CPU'da ishlayotgan (<code>R</code>) + navbatda turgan (<code>R</code>) + <b><code>D</code> holatidagilar</b>. Shuning uchun Linux'da load &quot;CPU yuklanishi&quot; emas, &quot;tizim yuklanishi&quot;.</p><ul><li>8 yadro, load 8 — to'liq band, normal.</li><li>8 yadro, load 45, CPU 15% — 30+ process biror narsani kutib qotib turibdi.</li></ul><h4>Tekshirish tartibi</h4><ol><li><b>CPU nimani kutyapti:</b></li></ol><pre>top            # %wa (iowait) yuqori bo'lsa — disk<br>vmstat 1       # b ustuni = D holatdagi process'lar soni, wa = iowait</pre><ol><li><b>Qaysi disk:</b></li></ol><pre>iostat -xz 1 5<br># %util ~100, await (ms) katta = disk to'yingan</pre><ol><li><b>Qaysi process'lar <code>D</code> holatida:</b></li></ol><pre>ps -eo pid,stat,wchan:30,cmd | awk '$2 ~ /D/'</pre><p><code>wchan</code> — kernel'ning qaysi funksiyasida kutyapti (masalan <code>nfs_wait_bit_killable</code> = NFS).</p><ol><li><b>Aniq qayerda:</b></li></ol><pre>sudo cat /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/stack</pre><ol><li><b>Kim diskni yeyapti:</b> <code>iotop -o</code>, <code>pidstat -d 1</code>.</li></ol><h4>Odatiy sabablar va yechim</h4><ul><li><b>Osilgan NFS mount</b> (server javob bermayapti) — <code>D</code> process'larni <code>kill -9</code> ham o'ldirmaydi. NFS serverni tiklash yoki <code>umount -f -l</code>. Oldini olish: <code>soft,timeo=</code> opsiyalari (ehtiyot bilan).</li><li><b>Sekin/o'layotgan disk</b> — <code>dmesg</code> da I/O error, <code>smartctl -a</code>.</li><li><b>Cloud disk IOPS limiti</b> (EBS burst tugagan) — CloudWatch'da <code>BurstBalance</code>.</li><li><b>Swap thrashing</b> — <code>vmstat</code> da <code>si/so</code> yuqori, RAM yetmayapti.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Load average yolg'iz metrika sifatida yomon — u CPU va I/O'ni aralashtiradi. Aniqroq signal — <b>PSI</b> (<code>/proc/pressure/io</code>, <code>/proc/pressure/cpu</code>): qaysi resurs tanqisligi tufayli vaqt yo'qolayotganini alohida ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41522	<p>Ssenariy: kritik process &quot;Too many open files&quot; (<code>EMFILE</code>) bilan yiqildi. Butunlay qanday tuzatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>EMFILE</code> — process o'z <b>file descriptor limitiga</b> yetdi. Linux'da socket, fayl, pipe — hammasi fd. Limit 1024 bo'lsa, 1024-ulanishda server yangi ulanish ocha olmaydi. Yechim ikki qism: <b>leak yo'qligini tekshirish</b> va <b>limitni to'g'ri joyda ko'tarish</b>.</p><h4>1. Hozirgi holat</h4><pre>cat /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/limits | grep 'open files'   # haqiqiy limit (soft / hard)<br>ls /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/fd | wc -l                    # hozir ochiq fd soni<br>cat /proc/sys/fs/file-nr                     # tizim: ochiq / - / max</pre><h4>2. Leak'mi yoki haqiqiy yuk?</h4><pre>ls -l /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/fd | awk '{print $NF}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head<br>lsof -p &lt;PID&gt; | awk '{print $5}' | sort | uniq -c   # turi bo'yicha: IPv4, REG, FIFO</pre><ul><li>fd soni vaqt o'tib, yuk o'zgarmasa ham <b>o'syapti</b> — leak (yopilmagan fayl, HTTP response body yopilmagan, DB connection qaytarilmagan). Limitni ko'tarish faqat yiqilishni kechiktiradi — kodni tuzating.</li><li>Yuk bilan birga o'sib-tushyapti — haqiqiy ehtiyoj, limitni ko'taring.</li></ul><h4>3. Limitni ko'tarish — qayerda?</h4><p>Bu eng ko'p xato qilinadigan joy: limit <b>process qanday ishga tushganiga</b> bog'liq.</p><p><b>systemd servis</b> (ko'p hollarda shu) — <code>limits.conf</code> unga <b>ta'sir qilmaydi</b>:</p><pre>sudo systemctl edit myapp</pre><pre>[Service]<br>LimitNOFILE=65535</pre><pre>sudo systemctl daemon-reload &amp;&amp; sudo systemctl restart myapp<br>cat /proc/$(pidof myapp)/limits | grep 'open files'   # tekshirish!</pre><p><b>SSH orqali kirgan user / qo'lda ishga tushirilgan</b> — PAM orqali:</p><pre># /etc/security/limits.d/90-nofile.conf<br>*  soft  nofile  65535<br>*  hard  nofile  65535</pre><p>Qayta login kerak.</p><p><b>Docker:</b> <code>docker run --ulimit nofile=65535:65535</code>. <b>K8s:</b> node/container runtime sozlamasi.</p><p><b>Tizim limiti</b> (kamdan-kam kerak): <code>fs.file-max</code> sysctl.</p><h4>4. Kuzatuv</h4><p>fd ishlatilishini monitoring qiling: <code>process_open_fds / process_max_fds</code> (Prometheus) &gt; 80% — alert.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> soft — joriy limit, hard — process o'zi ko'tara oladigan maksimum. Ko'p ilovalar (Go 1.19+, nginx <code>worker_rlimit_nofile</code>) soft'ni avtomatik hard'gacha ko'taradi. Shuning uchun ba'zan faqat hard'ni oshirish yetarli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41523	<p>Ssenariy: o'chirilgan log fayl <code>df -h</code> da hali ham 100GB joy egallayapti. Nega va joyni darhol qanday qaytarasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux'da <code>rm</code> faylni emas, uning <b>nomini</b> o'chiradi. Fayl ma'lumoti (inode) uni ochib turgan process bor ekan, diskda qoladi. Log yozayotgan servis faylni ochiq ushlab turibdi — shuning uchun joy bo'shamaydi.</p><h4>Mexanizm</h4><p>Inode ikki hisoblagichga ega: <b>link count</b> (nechta nom) va <b>ochiq fd'lar</b>. Joy faqat ikkalasi 0 bo'lganda bo'shaydi.</p><pre>rm app.log:   link count 1 -&gt; 0    (nom yo'q, ls ko'rmaydi)<br>nginx fd 7:   hali ochiq            -&gt; block'lar band, df hisoblaydi</pre><p>Shuning uchun <code>du</code> (nomlarni sanaydi) va <code>df</code> (block'larni sanaydi) farq qiladi — bu klassik belgi.</p><h4>Topish</h4><pre>sudo lsof +L1                    # link count 0, lekin ochiq fayllar<br>sudo lsof | grep '(deleted)'<br># nginx  1234  www  7w  REG  8,1  107374182400  ...  /var/log/app.log (deleted)</pre><p>PID = 1234, FD = 7.</p><h4>Bo'shatish — 3 yo'l</h4><ol><li><b>Restart'siz, darhol</b> — fd orqali faylni nolga qisqartirish:</li></ol><pre>sudo truncate -s 0 /proc/1234/fd/7<br># yoki: : &gt; /proc/1234/fd/7</pre><ol><li><b>Servisga faylni qayta ochishni aytish</b> — nginx: <code>nginx -s reopen</code> (yoki <code>kill -USR1</code>). Eski fd yopiladi.</li><li><b>Restart</b> — eng oddiy, lekin downtime.</li></ol><h4>Oldini olish</h4><ul><li><b>logrotate</b> to'g'ri sozlansin:</li><li><code>postrotate</code> da servisga reopen signali (eng to'g'ri), yoki</li><li><code>copytruncate</code> — faylni nusxalab, aslini qisqartiradi (ilova signalni qo'llamasa; nusxa paytida bir oz log yo'qolishi mumkin).</li><li>Log'ni faylga emas, stdout/journald'ga yozish (container'larda standart).</li><li>Hech qachon ishlab turgan log'ni <code>rm</code> qilmang — <code>truncate -s 0 file</code> ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xuddi shu mexanizm deploy'da ham bor: eski binary yoki kutubxona o'chirilib yangisi qo'yilsa, ishlab turgan process eskisini ushlab turadi. <code>lsof | grep deleted</code> da <code>.so</code> fayllar ko'rinsa — servis restart qilinmagan, xavfsizlik patch'i hali qo'llanmagan.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41524	<p>Ssenariy: ko'p thread'li ilovada xotira fragmentatsiyasi va allokatsiya latency'si. glibc malloc'ni <code>jemalloc</code>/<code>tcmalloc</code> bilan qanday almashtirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> glibc'ning standart <code>malloc</code>i ko'p thread'li yuklamada xotirani <b>fragmentatsiya</b> qiladi (RSS o'sib boradi, qaytmaydi) va arena lock'larida <b>kutadi</b>. Yechim — <code>jemalloc</code> yoki <code>tcmalloc</code> allocator'iga o'tish, yoki glibc arenalarini cheklash. Kodni o'zgartirish shart emas — <code>LD_PRELOAD</code> bilan almashtiriladi.</p><h4>Simptomlar</h4><ul><li>Ilova xotirasi (RSS) vaqt o'tib o'sadi, lekin heap profiler leak ko'rsatmaydi.</li><li>Yuk tushsa ham RSS kamaymaydi.</li><li>Ko'p yadroli serverda p99 latency <code>malloc</code>/<code>free</code> ichida (perf'da <code>_int_malloc</code>, <code>__lll_lock_wait</code>).</li></ul><h4>Nega bo'ladi</h4><p>glibc har thread guruhiga alohida <b>arena</b> beradi (default: yadro x 8 tagacha). Har arena o'z bo'sh joylarini ushlaydi va OS'ga qaytarishni istamaydi. 64 yadro = 512 arena — har birida &quot;teshik&quot;lar. Natija: ishlatilmagan, lekin band xotira.</p><h4>Yechim 1 — jemalloc</h4><pre>sudo apt install libjemalloc2<br>LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libjemalloc.so.2 ./my_application</pre><p>systemd'da:</p><pre>[Service]<br>Environment=LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libjemalloc.so.2</pre><p>jemalloc: thread-local cache, o'lcham sinflari bo'yicha ajratish — fragmentatsiya kam, lock kam, bo'sh xotirani OS'ga qaytaradi. Redis default holatda jemalloc bilan keladi.</p><h4>Yechim 2 — glibc'ni sozlash (kutubxona almashtirmasdan)</h4><pre>MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 ./my_application</pre><p>Arena soni kamayadi — fragmentatsiya keskin kamayadi (lock contention biroz oshishi mumkin). Java servislarda RSS muammosi uchun klassik fix.</p><h4>Tekshirish</h4><p>Oldin/keyin: RSS (<code>ps -o rss</code>), p99 latency, throughput — load test bilan. Har yuklamada natija har xil, o'lchamasdan qaror qilmang.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval haqiqiy leak emasligini isbotlang (heap profiler: <code>jemalloc prof</code>, <code>heaptrack</code>, Go'da <code>pprof</code>). Allocator almashtirish fragmentatsiyani davolaydi, leak'ni emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41525	<p>Ssenariy: xotira tugab server SSH'da javob bermayapti. Magic SysRq'ni qanday ishlatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Magic SysRq — klaviatura yoki <code>/proc/sysrq-trigger</code> orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri <b>kernel'ga</b> buyruq berish. Userspace (SSH, shell) qotib qolganda ham kernel javob beradi. Eng muhimi: OOM'da <code>f</code> — OOM killer'ni qo'lda chaqirish; qayta yuklash kerak bo'lsa <code>R-E-I-S-U-B</code> — fayl tizimini buzmasdan reboot.</p><h4>Qachon kerak</h4><p>Xotira tugadi, tizim swap'da &quot;thrashing&quot; — SSH ulanmaydi, <code>kill</code> yoza olmaysiz. Hard reset (quvvatni o'chirish) — fayl tizimi va DB buzilishi xavfi.</p><h4>Qanday kirish</h4><ul><li>Fizik/IPMI/iLO konsol: <code>Alt + SysRq + &lt;harf&gt;</code>.</li><li>Cloud serial console (AWS EC2 Serial Console, GCP serial port): break signali + harf.</li><li>Shell hali ishlasa: <code>echo &lt;harf&gt; | sudo tee /proc/sysrq-trigger</code>.</li></ul><p>Yoqilganmi: <code>cat /proc/sys/kernel/sysrq</code> (1 = hammasi). Oldindan yoqing: <code>kernel.sysrq = 1</code>.</p><h4>Birinchi urinish — tizimni saqlab qolish</h4><ul><li><b><code>f</code></b> — OOM killer'ni chaqiradi: eng ko'p xotira yeyayotgan process o'ldiriladi, tizim tiklanadi. Reboot yo'q.</li><li><b><code>m</code></b> — xotira holatini <code>dmesg</code>ga chiqaradi (diagnostika uchun).</li></ul><h4>Oxirgi chora — xavfsiz reboot: R-E-I-S-U-B</h4><p>Har harf orasida bir necha soniya kuting: | Harf | Nima qiladi | |---|---| | <code>r</code> | klaviaturani X server'dan qaytarib oladi (raw) | | <code>e</code> | hamma process'larga <code>SIGTERM</code> — chiroyli yopilish imkoni | | <code>i</code> | qolganlariga <code>SIGKILL</code> | | <code>s</code> | dirty ma'lumotni diskka <b>sync</b> | | <code>u</code> | fayl tizimlarini <b>read-only</b> remount | | <code>b</code> | darhol reboot | Eslab qolish: &quot;<b>R</b>eboot <b>E</b>ven <b>I</b>f <b>S</b>ystem <b>U</b>tterly <b>B</b>roken&quot;.</p><h4>Keyin</h4><p>Sababni toping: <code>journalctl -k -b -1 | grep -i oom</code> — oldingi boot'dagi OOM log'lari. Kelajakda: memory limit (cgroup <code>MemoryMax=</code>), <code>earlyoom</code>/<code>systemd-oomd</code> — tizim qotishidan oldin process o'ldiradi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud VM'da konsolga kirish ham qiyin bo'lishi mumkin — shuning uchun swap'ni kichik saqlash, <code>vm.panic_on_oom</code>/watchdog va avtomatik qayta tiklash (auto-recovery) oldindan rejalashtiriladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41526	<p>NUMA va NUMA balancing nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) — ko'p protsessorli serverda har CPU socket'ning <b>o'z yaqin xotirasi</b> bor. O'z xotirasiga kirish tez, qo'shni socket xotirasiga kirish <b>sekinroq</b> (~1.5-2x). Process bitta node'da, xotirasi boshqa node'da bo'lsa — yashirin sekinlashuv.</p><h4>Tuzilishi</h4><pre>   Node 0                          Node 1<br> [CPU 0-15] -- tez -- [RAM 128G]   [CPU 16-31] -- tez -- [RAM 128G]<br>      \___________ sekin interconnect (UPI/Infinity Fabric) ________/</pre><pre>numactl --hardware     # nechta node, har birida qancha xotira, masofa jadvali<br>lscpu | grep NUMA<br>numastat -p &lt;PID&gt;      # process xotirasi qaysi node'larda</pre><h4>Qachon muammo</h4><ul><li>Katta DB (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch) — process bir node'da ishlaydi, xotirasining yarmi boshqasida.</li><li>Bitta node xotirasi to'ladi — kernel boshqa node'da bo'sh joy bo'lsa ham <b>swap</b> qilishi yoki reclaim qilishi mumkin (<code>vm.zone_reclaim_mode=1</code> bo'lsa). Klassik &quot;MySQL swap insanity&quot; muammosi.</li></ul><h4>Yechimlar</h4><ol><li><b>Pinning</b> — process va xotirani bitta node'ga bog'lash (latency-kritik, bir node'ga sig'adigan ilova):</li></ol><pre>numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0 ./app</pre><ol><li><b>Interleave</b> — xotirani node'lar bo'ylab teng taqsimlash (bitta node'ga sig'maydigan katta DB):</li></ol><pre>numactl --interleave=all mysqld</pre><ol><li><b><code>vm.zone_reclaim_mode = 0</code></b> — kernel lokal node'ni reclaim qilish o'rniga uzoq xotiradan foydalansin (DB serverlar uchun tavsiya).</li></ol><h4>NUMA balancing</h4><p><code>kernel.numa_balancing = 1</code> — kernel avtomatik ravishda sahifalarni ularni ishlatayotgan CPU node'iga ko'chiradi. Umumiy yuklamada foydali, lekin qo'lda pinning qilingan yoki latency'ga sezgir tizimda sahifa ko'chirish overhead beradi — o'chiriladi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kubernetes'da bu <b>Topology Manager</b> (<code>single-numa-node</code> policy) va CPU Manager <code>static</code> orqali boshqariladi — Guaranteed pod'larga bitta NUMA node'dan CPU va xotira beriladi. Bitta socket'li serverlar (ko'p cloud VM'lar) uchun bu mavzu ahamiyatsiz.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41527	<p>cgroup v2 unified hierarchy (<code>/sys/fs/cgroup</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> cgroup — process'lar guruhiga resurs (CPU, xotira, I/O, process soni) limiti qo'yish mexanizmi. Container'lar shunga qurilgan. <b>v2</b> — barcha controller'lar uchun <b>yagona daraxt</b> (<code>/sys/fs/cgroup</code>). v1'da har controller'ning alohida daraxti bor edi va ular bir-biri bilan kelishmasdi.</p><h4>v1 muammosi</h4><pre>v1:  /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/app/   /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/app/   /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/app/<br>     (har biri alohida daraxt — process har birida boshqa joyda bo'lishi mumkin)</pre><p>Natija: masalan buffered yozuv (writeback) qaysi cgroup'ga tegishli ekanini aniqlab bo'lmasdi — I/O limiti page cache orqali yozuvda ishlamasdi.</p><h4>v2 tuzilishi</h4><pre>/sys/fs/cgroup/<br>  system.slice/<br>    nginx.service/<br>       cgroup.procs     &lt;- shu guruhdagi PID'lar<br>       memory.max       &lt;- xotira limiti (OOM chegarasi)<br>       memory.high      &lt;- yumshoq chegara (throttle)<br>       cpu.max          &lt;- &quot;50000 100000&quot; = 0.5 CPU<br>       io.max           &lt;- disk limiti<br>       pids.max         &lt;- fork bomb himoyasi</pre><p>Bitta process — bitta joy, hamma controller'lar birga.</p><h4>v2 nima qo'shdi</h4><ul><li><b>To'g'ri writeback hisobi</b> — buffered I/O ham limitlanadi.</li><li><b>PSI</b> — har cgroup uchun pressure metrikasi (<code>memory.pressure</code>).</li><li><b><code>memory.high</code></b> — o'ldirmasdan sekinlashtirish (v1'da faqat qattiq limit).</li><li><b>Xavfsiz delegatsiya</b> — rootless container'lar (Podman) o'z sub-daraxtini boshqara oladi.</li></ul><h4>Amalda</h4><pre>stat -fc %T /sys/fs/cgroup     # cgroup2fs = v2<br>systemd-cgls                   # daraxt<br>systemd-cgtop                  # resurs ishlatilishi<br>systemctl set-property nginx.service MemoryMax=1G CPUQuota=50%</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy distro'lar (RHEL 9, Ubuntu 22.04+) va K8s 1.25+ v2'ni default ishlatadi. Eski JVM (8u372 dan oldin) va Go (runtime cgroup v2'ni bilmasa) container limitini ko'rmay, host xotira/CPU'siga moslashib OOM bo'lishi mumkin — versiyani tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41528	<p>Pressure Stall Information (PSI) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PSI — &quot;task'lar resurs <b>yetishmagani uchun</b> qancha vaqt kutib qoldi&quot; degan metrika. CPU, xotira va I/O uchun alohida. Utilization (CPU 90%) resurs bandligini ko'rsatadi, PSI esa bu bandlik <b>ishni sekinlashtirayaptimi</b> — shuni ko'rsatadi.</p><h4>Nega utilization yetarli emas</h4><ul><li>CPU 100%, lekin hech kim kutmayapti — normal, resurs samarali ishlatilmoqda.</li><li>Xotira 95% band — page cache bo'lishi mumkin, muammo yo'q. Yoki reclaim tufayli process'lar to'xtab turibdi — muammo. Utilization buni ajratmaydi, PSI ajratadi.</li></ul><h4>O'qish</h4><pre>cat /proc/pressure/memory<br># some avg10=12.50 avg60=8.20 avg300=3.10 total=123456789<br># full avg10=4.00  avg60=2.10 avg300=0.80 total=45678901</pre><ul><li><b><code>some</code></b> — vaqtning necha foizida <b>kamida bitta</b> task shu resursni kutgan. Sekinlashuv belgisi.</li><li><b><code>full</code></b> — necha foizida <b>hamma</b> (idle bo'lmagan) task'lar kutgan — tizim umuman ish qilmagan. Jiddiy.</li><li><code>avg10/60/300</code> — 10s, 1min, 5min o'rtacha. <code>total</code> — mikrosekundlarda jami.</li></ul><p>Misol: <code>memory full avg10=4.00</code> — oxirgi 10 sekundning 4%ida tizim xotira tufayli butunlay to'xtagan.</p><h4>Fayllar</h4><ul><li><code>/proc/pressure/cpu</code>, <code>/proc/pressure/memory</code>, <code>/proc/pressure/io</code> — butun tizim.</li><li><code>/sys/fs/cgroup/&lt;grup&gt;/memory.pressure</code> — alohida container/servis uchun (cgroup v2).</li></ul><h4>Ishlatilishi</h4><ul><li><b>systemd-oomd</b>, Facebook <b>oomd</b> — PSI oshsa, tizim qotishidan <b>oldin</b> process'ni o'ldiradi (kernel OOM killer juda kech ishga tushadi).</li><li>Alert: <code>memory some avg60 &gt; 10</code> — xotira tanqisligi boshlandi.</li><li>Prometheus node_exporter: <code>node_pressure_*</code> metrikalari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PSI &quot;saturation&quot; signalining eng to'g'ri o'lchovi (USE metodida U-S-E'ning S qismi). Load average'dan farqli, CPU va I/O'ni aralashtirmaydi. Kernel 4.20+ kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41529	<p>Linux capabilities (<code>getpcaps</code>, <code>setcap</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Capabilities — root huquqini <b>mayda bo'laklarga</b> bo'lish. Process'ga to'liq root bermasdan, faqat kerakli bitta huquqni berish mumkin. Masalan, 80-portni ochish uchun butun root emas, faqat <code>CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE</code>.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>An'anaviy Linux'da ikki daraja: root (hamma narsa mumkin) va oddiy user. Web server 80-portni ochishi uchun root'da ishlashi kerak edi — buzilsa, hujumchi butun tizimni oladi.</p><h4>Asosiy capability'lar</h4><p>| Capability | Nima beradi | |---|---| | <code>CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE</code> | 1024'dan kichik portlarni ochish | | <code>CAP_NET_ADMIN</code> | interfeys, routing, iptables sozlash | | <code>CAP_NET_RAW</code> | raw socket (<code>ping</code>) | | <code>CAP_SYS_ADMIN</code> | mount va boshqa ko'p narsa — &quot;yangi root&quot;, bermang | | <code>CAP_SYS_PTRACE</code> | boshqa process'larni debug qilish | | <code>CAP_CHOWN</code>, <code>CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE</code> | fayl ruxsatlarini chetlab o'tish |</p><h4>Faylga berish</h4><pre>sudo setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' /usr/local/bin/myserver<br>getcap /usr/local/bin/myserver<br># /usr/local/bin/myserver cap_net_bind_service=ep</pre><p><code>e</code> = effective (darhol faol), <code>p</code> = permitted (ruxsat etilgan). Endi oddiy user ishga tushirsa ham 80-portni ocha oladi.</p><h4>Process'nikini ko'rish</h4><pre>getpcaps &lt;PID&gt;<br>grep Cap /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/status     # hex; capsh --decode=&lt;hex&gt; bilan o'qish</pre><h4>systemd'da (eng to'g'ri usul)</h4><pre>[Service]<br>User=www<br>AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE<br>CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE</pre><h4>Container'larda</h4><p>Docker default'da kichik to'plam beradi. Best practice:</p><pre>securityContext:<br>  capabilities:<br>    drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;]<br>    add: [&quot;NET_BIND_SERVICE&quot;]</pre><p><code>--privileged</code> = hamma capability — deyarli host root.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>setcap</code> binary yangilanganda (paket upgrade) yo'qoladi. <code>CAP_SYS_ADMIN</code> berish amalda root berish bilan teng — undan qochish kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41530	<p>SELinux permissive va enforcing farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SELinux uch rejimda ishlaydi. <b>Enforcing</b> — policy buzilsa kirishni <b>bloklaydi</b> va log qiladi. <b>Permissive</b> — <b>ruxsat beradi</b>, faqat log qiladi (nima bloklanishi kerakligini ko'rish uchun). <b>Disabled</b> — umuman o'chiq.</p><h4>Nega permissive kerak</h4><p>Yangi ilova SELinux bilan ishlamayapti. Enforcing'da u qadam-baqadam yiqiladi — har safar bitta xatoni ko'rasiz. Permissive'da ilova ishlaydi va <b>barcha</b> buzilishlar bir vaqtda log'ga tushadi — ularni yig'ib, bitta to'g'ri policy yoziladi.</p><h4>Buyruqlar</h4><pre>getenforce                     # Enforcing / Permissive / Disabled<br>sestatus                       # batafsil<br>sudo setenforce 0              # vaqtincha permissive (reboot'gacha)<br>sudo setenforce 1              # qaytadan enforcing</pre><p>Doimiy: <code>/etc/selinux/config</code> da <code>SELINUX=enforcing</code>.</p><h4>Muammoni to'g'ri hal qilish</h4><ol><li>Rad etishlarni topish:</li></ol><pre>sudo ausearch -m AVC -ts recent<br>sudo sealert -a /var/log/audit/audit.log    # tushuntirish + taklif</pre><ol><li>Ko'pincha sabab — <b>noto'g'ri label</b> (fayl boshqa joydan ko'chirilgan):</li></ol><pre>ls -Z /var/www/html<br>sudo restorecon -Rv /var/www/html</pre><ol><li>Nostandart port yoki papka — boolean yoki context qo'shish:</li></ol><pre>sudo setsebool -P httpd_can_network_connect on<br>sudo semanage port -a -t http_port_t -p tcp 8081<br>sudo semanage fcontext -a -t httpd_sys_content_t '/data/web(/.*)?' &amp;&amp; sudo restorecon -Rv /data/web</pre><ol><li>Oxirgi chora — maxsus modul: <code>audit2allow -M mymod &lt; denials &amp;&amp; semodule -i mymod.pp</code>.</li></ol><h4>Faqat bitta domenni permissive qilish</h4><pre>sudo semanage permissive -a httpd_t</pre><p>Butun tizim himoyasini o'chirmasdan, faqat bitta servisni debug qilish.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>setenforce 0</code> ni &quot;fix&quot; sifatida qoldirish — keng tarqalgan xato, butun MAC himoyasini o'chiradi. Enforcing'dan Disabled'ga va qaytib o'tish butun fayl tizimini qayta label qilishni talab qiladi (<code>/.autorelabel</code>).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41531	<p>Network interface bonding (LACP / mode 4) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bonding — bir nechta fizik tarmoq kartasini (NIC) bitta mantiqiy interfeysga (<code>bond0</code>) birlashtirish. Ikki maqsad: <b>failover</b> (bitta kabel/switch port o'lsa, aloqa uzilmaydi) va <b>bandwidth</b> (bir nechta link yig'indisi). <b>Mode 4 (802.3ad / LACP)</b> — switch bilan kelishib ishlaydigan standart rejim.</p><h4>Asosiy rejimlar</h4><p>| Mode | Nomi | Switch sozlamasi | Ishlatilishi | |---|---|---|---| | 0 | balance-rr | kerak | kam ishlatiladi (paket tartibi buziladi) | | 1 | active-backup | <b>kerak emas</b> | oddiy failover, eng xavfsiz | | 4 | 802.3ad (LACP) | <b>LACP kerak</b> | failover + bandwidth, data center standarti | | 6 | balance-alb | kerak emas | switch'siz yuk taqsimlash |</p><h4>LACP qanday ishlaydi</h4><p>Server va switch LACP paketlari bilan link'larni kelishadi. Trafik <b>oqim bo'yicha</b> taqsimlanadi (hash: IP/port). Muhim: bitta TCP ulanish baribir <b>bitta</b> link orqali ketadi — 2x10G bond bitta ulanishga 20G bermaydi, ko'p ulanishga beradi.</p><h4>Sozlash (netplan misoli)</h4><pre>network:<br>  version: 2<br>  ethernets:<br>    eno1: {}<br>    eno2: {}<br>  bonds:<br>    bond0:<br>      interfaces: [eno1, eno2]<br>      parameters:<br>        mode: 802.3ad<br>        lacp-rate: fast<br>        mii-monitor-interval: 100<br>        transmit-hash-policy: layer3+4<br>      addresses: [10.0.0.10/24]</pre><h4>Tekshirish</h4><pre>cat /proc/net/bonding/bond0     # rejim, har link holati, LACP partner<br>ip -d link show bond0</pre><p><code>transmit-hash-policy: layer3+4</code> — IP va port bo'yicha hash, ko'p ulanishda yaxshi taqsimot (default <code>layer2</code> faqat MAC — bitta gateway orqasida hamma trafik bitta link'ga tushadi).</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy redundancy uchun ikki link <b>ikki xil switch</b>ga ulanishi kerak — bu MLAG/vPC (switch'lar juftligi) talab qiladi. Bitta switch'ga ikki kabel faqat kabel/port nosozligidan himoya qiladi. Cloud VM'larda bonding odatda yo'q — redundancy provider tomonida.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41532	<p>VLAN tagging (802.1Q) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VLAN — bitta fizik tarmoqni bir nechta <b>mantiqiy</b> (izolyatsiyalangan) tarmoqqa bo'lish. 802.1Q standarti Ethernet frame ichiga 4 baytli <b>tag</b> qo'shadi, unda 12-bitli VLAN ID (1-4094) bor. Shu ID bo'yicha switch frame qaysi tarmoqqa tegishli ekanini biladi.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Bitta switch, bitta kabel — lekin buxgalteriya, server'lar va mehmon Wi-Fi bir-birini ko'rmasligi kerak. Har biriga alohida switch o'rniga VLAN: <code>VLAN 10</code> — server'lar, <code>VLAN 20</code> — ofis, <code>VLAN 30</code> — mehmonlar. Ular orasida trafik faqat router/firewall orqali.</p><h4>Frame tuzilishi</h4><pre>| Dest MAC | Src MAC | 802.1Q tag (4B): TPID 0x8100 + PRI + VLAN ID(12 bit) | EtherType | Payload |</pre><h4>Access va trunk port</h4><ul><li><b>Access port</b> — bitta VLAN, tag'siz. Oddiy kompyuter ulanadi, VLAN haqida bilmaydi.</li><li><b>Trunk port</b> — ko'p VLAN, frame'lar tag bilan. Switch-switch yoki switch-server (server bir nechta VLAN'da bo'lsa).</li></ul><h4>Linux'da sub-interfeys</h4><pre>sudo ip link add link eth0 name eth0.100 type vlan id 100<br>sudo ip addr add 192.168.100.10/24 dev eth0.100<br>sudo ip link set eth0.100 up</pre><p>Endi <code>eth0.100</code> dan chiqqan frame'lar <code>VLAN 100</code> tag'i bilan ketadi. Switch port'i <b>trunk</b> bo'lishi va VLAN 100'ga ruxsat berishi kerak.</p><p>Doimiy (netplan):</p><pre>vlans:<br>  vlan100:<br>    id: 100<br>    link: eth0<br>    addresses: [192.168.100.10/24]</pre><h4>Tekshirish</h4><pre>ip -d link show eth0.100          # vlan protocol 802.1Q id 100<br>sudo tcpdump -e -i eth0 vlan      # tag'li frame'lar</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 4094 VLAN limiti katta data center/cloud uchun kam — shuning uchun overlay tarmoqlar (<b>VXLAN</b>, 24-bit = 16M segment) ishlatiladi; K8s CNI'lar (Flannel, Calico VXLAN rejimi) shu asosda. VLAN tag 4 bayt qo'shadi — MTU muammolariga e'tibor.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41533	<p>Generic Segmentation Offload (GSO) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GSO — katta ma'lumotni MTU (1500 bayt) o'lchamidagi paketlarga <b>bo'lishni imkon qadar kechroq</b> qilish. Kernel tarmoq stack'idan bitta katta &quot;super-paket&quot; (masalan 64KB) o'tkazadi va faqat oxirida — driver oldida — bo'ladi. NIC qo'llasa (<b>TSO</b>), bo'lishni umuman hardware bajaradi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>64KB yuborish = ~45 ta 1500-baytli paket. Har paket TCP/IP stack'dan alohida o'tsa — 45 marta header hisoblash, routing, netfilter (iptables), qdisc. CPU ko'p ish qiladi.</p><h4>Yechim</h4><pre>GSO'siz:  [64KB] -&gt; bo'lish -&gt; 45 paket -&gt; TCP/IP -&gt; netfilter -&gt; qdisc -&gt; driver   (45x)<br>GSO bilan: [64KB] -&gt; TCP/IP -&gt; netfilter -&gt; qdisc -&gt; bo'lish -&gt; driver             (1x)<br>TSO bilan: [64KB] -&gt; TCP/IP -&gt; netfilter -&gt; qdisc -&gt; driver -&gt; NIC o'zi bo'ladi    (0 CPU)</pre><h4>Atamalar</h4><ul><li><b>TSO</b> (TCP Segmentation Offload) — hardware, faqat TCP.</li><li><b>GSO</b> — software umumlashmasi, NIC TSO qo'llamasa ham ishlaydi, boshqa protokollar uchun ham.</li><li><b>GRO/LRO</b> — teskari tomon (qabul qilish), alohida savol.</li></ul><h4>Ko'rish va boshqarish</h4><pre>ethtool -k eth0 | grep -E 'segmentation|generic'<br># tcp-segmentation-offload: on<br># generic-segmentation-offload: on<br>sudo ethtool -K eth0 tso off gso off     # vaqtincha o'chirish (debug)</pre><h4>Qachon muammo beradi</h4><ul><li><b>tcpdump</b> 64KB &quot;paket&quot;larni ko'rsatadi — bu xato emas, offload tufayli (capture bo'lishdan oldin bo'ladi).</li><li>Ba'zi virtual NIC/tunnel driver'larida bug — paket yo'qolishi; debug uchun offload o'chiriladi.</li><li>Overlay (VXLAN) + noto'g'ri MTU kombinatsiyasi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Offload'larni &quot;ehtiyot uchun&quot; o'chirmang — CPU sarfi keskin oshadi va throughput tushadi. Faqat aniq muammo isbotlanganda, alohida va o'lchab o'chiriladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41534	<p>LRO / GRO nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LRO va GRO — qabul qilish tomonidagi optimizatsiya: ketma-ket kelgan bir xil TCP oqimining kichik paketlarini stack'ka uzatishdan oldin <b>bitta katta paketga birlashtirish</b>. Stack 45 ta paket o'rniga 1 ta paketni qayta ishlaydi — CPU tejaladi. <b>LRO</b> — hardware, qo'pol; <b>GRO</b> — software, xavfsiz.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>10 Gbit/s = sekundiga ~800 000 ta 1500-baytli paket. Har biri uchun interrupt, TCP/IP qayta ishlash, ACK — CPU bunga yetmaydi. Birlashtirish paket sonini o'n barobar kamaytiradi.</p><h4>LRO va GRO farqi</h4><p>| | LRO (Large Receive Offload) | GRO (Generic Receive Offload) | |---|---|---| | Qayerda | NIC hardware | kernel (NAPI), software | | Qanday | header'larni &quot;yo'qotib&quot; birlashtiradi | header'larni saqlaydi, qayta bo'lish mumkin | | Forwarding | <b>buzadi</b> | xavfsiz |</p><h4>Nega LRO forwarding'ni buzadi</h4><p>Server router, bridge yoki K8s node sifatida paketni <b>boshqa joyga uzatsa</b>, LRO birlashtirgan paketni asl holiga qaytarib bo'lmaydi — MTU'dan katta paket chiqadi yoki tashlanadi. GRO esa chiqishda GSO bilan qayta to'g'ri bo'ladi. Shuning uchun kernel ip_forward yoqilganda LRO'ni o'zi o'chiradi; router/hypervisor/container host'da LRO o'chiq bo'lishi kerak.</p><h4>Boshqarish</h4><pre>ethtool -k eth0 | grep -E 'receive-offload'<br># generic-receive-offload: on<br># large-receive-offload: off<br>sudo ethtool -K eth0 lro off</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default holat (GRO on, LRO off) ko'p hollarda to'g'ri. tcpdump'da 1500'dan katta qabul qilingan paketlar ko'rinsa — bu GRO, xato emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41535	<p>Kernel modulni blacklist qilish nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Blacklist — ma'lum kernel modulini (driver) boot'da yoki qurilma ulanganda <b>avtomatik yuklanmasligi</b> uchun belgilash. Sabablar: driver konflikti (<code>nouveau</code> vs NVIDIA proprietary), xavfsizlik (ishlatilmaydigan USB storage, eski fayl tizimlari), yoki bug'li driver.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><p>Qurilma topilganda <code>udev</code> mos modulni <code>modprobe</code> orqali yuklaydi. <code>blacklist</code> qatori shu <b>avtomatik</b> yuklashni to'xtatadi.</p><h4>Sozlash</h4><pre># /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-nouveau.conf<br>blacklist nouveau<br>options nouveau modeset=0</pre><p>Muhim: <code>blacklist</code> qo'lda <code>modprobe nouveau</code> yoki boshqa modul dependency sifatida yuklashni <b>to'xtatmaydi</b>. To'liq bloklash uchun:</p><pre># /etc/modprobe.d/disable-usb-storage.conf<br>install usb-storage /bin/false</pre><p>Endi har qanday yuklash urinishi muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ladi. CIS hardening shu usulni talab qiladi (<code>cramfs</code>, <code>udf</code>, <code>usb-storage</code>, <code>dccp</code>, <code>sctp</code>).</p><h4>initramfs'ni yangilash</h4><p>Modul boot'ning eng boshida (initramfs ichida) yuklanishi mumkin — u yerda <code>/etc/modprobe.d</code> ning eski nusxasi bor. Shuning uchun:</p><pre>sudo update-initramfs -u           # Debian/Ubuntu<br>sudo dracut -f                     # RHEL/Fedora</pre><h4>Boot paytida vaqtinchalik</h4><p>GRUB'da kernel qatoriga: <code>modprobe.blacklist=nouveau</code> — tizim boot bo'lmayotganda qutqarish uchun.</p><h4>Tekshirish</h4><pre>lsmod | grep nouveau           # bo'sh bo'lishi kerak<br>modprobe -n -v usb-storage     # &quot;install /bin/false&quot; ko'rinishi kerak</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Agar modul allaqachon yuklangan bo'lsa, blacklist uni chiqarmaydi — <code>modprobe -r</code> yoki reboot kerak. Kernel ichiga compile qilingan (built-in, <code>=y</code>) driver'ni blacklist bilan o'chirib bo'lmaydi — faqat kernel parametri bilan.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41536	<p><code>lsmod</code> va <code>modprobe</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kernel modul — kernel'ga <b>ishlab turganda</b> yuklanadigan kod bo'lagi (driver, fayl tizimi, tarmoq funksiyasi). <code>lsmod</code> — hozir yuklangan modullar ro'yxati. <code>modprobe</code> — modulni uning <b>bog'liqliklari bilan</b> birga yuklash yoki olib tashlash.</p><h4>Nega modul</h4><p>Kernel ichiga hamma driver'ni qo'shish — katta va sekin kernel. Modullar faqat kerak bo'lganda yuklanadi: USB disk ulandi — <code>usb-storage</code> yuklandi.</p><h4>lsmod</h4><pre>lsmod<br># Module         Size  Used by<br># overlay      151552  12<br># br_netfilter  32768  0<br># bridge       307200  1 br_netfilter</pre><p><code>Used by</code> — nechta narsa ishlatyapti va qaysi modullar unga bog'liq. 0 bo'lmasa — olib tashlab bo'lmaydi.</p><h4>modprobe</h4><pre>sudo modprobe br_netfilter          # yuklash (bog'liqliklari bilan)<br>sudo modprobe -r br_netfilter       # olib tashlash<br>modinfo br_netfilter                # tavsif, versiya, parametrlar, bog'liqliklar<br>sudo modprobe bonding mode=4        # parametr bilan yuklash</pre><p><b><code>insmod</code></b> dan farqi: <code>insmod</code> faqat bitta <code>.ko</code> faylni yuklaydi, bog'liqliklarni hal qilmaydi. <code>modprobe</code> <code>modules.dep</code> (<code>depmod</code> yaratgan) bo'yicha hammasini tartib bilan yuklaydi — doim <code>modprobe</code> ishlating.</p><h4>Boot'da avtomatik yuklash</h4><pre># /etc/modules-load.d/k8s.conf<br>overlay<br>br_netfilter</pre><p>Doimiy parametrlar: <code>/etc/modprobe.d/*.conf</code> da <code>options bonding mode=4</code>.</p><h4>Amaliy misol — Kubernetes node tayyorlash</h4><pre>sudo modprobe overlay<br>sudo modprobe br_netfilter<br>lsmod | grep -E 'overlay|br_netfilter'</pre><p><code>br_netfilter</code> siz bridge trafigi iptables'dan o'tmaydi — K8s Service'lar ishlamaydi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Modul kernel versiyasiga bog'langan (<code>/lib/modules/$(uname -r)/</code>). Kernel yangilangan, lekin reboot qilinmagan bo'lsa yangi modul yuklanmasligi mumkin. Secure Boot yoqilganda imzosiz modullar yuklanmaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41537	<p><code>dkms</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DKMS (Dynamic Kernel Module Support) — kernel bilan birga kelmaydigan (third-party) modullarni <b>har yangi kernel uchun avtomatik qayta compile</b> qiluvchi tizim. NVIDIA, ZFS, VirtualBox, ba'zi Wi-Fi driver'lari shu orqali o'rnatiladi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>Kernel modul aniq bir kernel versiyasi uchun compile qilinadi. <code>apt upgrade</code> yangi kernel o'rnatdi — eski NVIDIA moduli yangi kernel'ga mos emas. DKMS'siz: reboot'dan keyin ekran ishlamaydi, ZFS pool mount bo'lmaydi.</p><h4>DKMS qanday hal qiladi</h4><p>Modul <b>source kodi</b> saqlanadi (<code>/usr/src/&lt;modul&gt;-&lt;versiya&gt;/</code>). Yangi kernel o'rnatilganda paket menejer hook'i DKMS'ni chaqiradi — u modulni yangi kernel header'lari bilan compile qilib o'rnatadi.</p><pre>yangi kernel o'rnatildi -&gt; DKMS hook -&gt; /usr/src/zfs-2.2/ dan build -&gt; /lib/modules/&lt;yangi&gt;/updates/dkms/zfs.ko</pre><h4>Buyruqlar</h4><pre>dkms status<br># zfs/2.2.2, 6.5.0-15-generic, x86_64: installed<br># nvidia/550.54, 6.5.0-15-generic, x86_64: installed<br><br>sudo dkms autoinstall                     # joriy kernel uchun hammasini build<br>sudo dkms install zfs/2.2.2 -k 6.8.0-20-generic</pre><h4>Kerakli shartlar</h4><ul><li>Kernel header'lar: <code>linux-headers-$(uname -r)</code> (yoki <code>kernel-devel</code>).</li><li>Compiler: <code>gcc</code>, <code>make</code>.</li></ul><h4>Tez-tez muammolar</h4><ul><li>Yangi kernel versiyasi modul source'i bilan mos emas (API o'zgargan) — build yiqiladi. <code>dkms status</code> va <code>/var/lib/dkms/&lt;modul&gt;/.../make.log</code> ni ko'ring.</li><li><b>Secure Boot</b> — o'zingiz compile qilgan modul imzolanmagan, yuklanmaydi. MOK kalitini ro'yxatdan o'tkazish kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production'da kernel upgrade'dan keyin reboot qilishdan <b>oldin</b> <code>dkms status</code> tekshiring — aks holda storage (ZFS) yoki GPU node reboot'dan keyin ishlamay qoladi. Immutable/golden image yondashuvida modul image build vaqtida compile qilinadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41538	<p>Kernel panic va kdump nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Kernel panic</b> — kernel tiklab bo'lmaydigan xatoga duch kelib, butun tizimni to'xtatishi (Windows'dagi &quot;blue screen&quot;). <b>kdump</b> — panic paytida kernel xotirasini (<code>vmcore</code>) diskka saqlash mexanizmi, keyin <code>crash</code> tool bilan <b>sababini</b> topish uchun.</p><h4>Panic sabablari</h4><ul><li>Bug'li driver yoki kernel modul (NULL pointer dereference).</li><li>Hardware xatosi (RAM, CPU — MCE).</li><li>Root fayl tizimi mount bo'lmadi, <code>init</code> o'ldi.</li><li><code>vm.panic_on_oom=1</code> bo'lsa OOM.</li></ul><h4>Nega oddiy log yetmaydi</h4><p>Panic paytida kernel o'zi buzilgan — u diskka ishonchli yoza olmaydi. Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41540	<p>Inode tugashini qanday bartaraf qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Inode — fayl haqidagi ma'lumot (egasi, ruxsat, block'lar) saqlanadigan yozuv. Sababni tuzatish (asosiy qism)</h4><p>Fayllarni yaratayotgan ilova/cron'ni toping: tozalash cron'i ishlamay qolgan, session GC o'chiq, ilova temp fayllarni o'chirmaydi. Aks holda bir haftadan keyin yana to'ladi.</p><h4>4. Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41541	<p><code>taskset</code> bilan CPU pinning (affinity) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CPU affinity (pinning) — process'ni faqat <b>belgilangan CPU yadrolarida</b> ishlashga majburlash. <code>taskset</code> shuni qiladi. Maqsad: yadrolar orasida sakrash tufayli cache yo'qotilishini kamaytirish va muhim process'ni &quot;shovqinli qo'shnilar&quot;dan ajratish.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Default'da scheduler process'ni istalgan bo'sh yadroga ko'chiradi. Har ko'chishda:</p><ul><li>L1/L2 cache &quot;sovuq&quot; — ma'lumot qaytadan RAM'dan o'qiladi.</li><li>NUMA serverda — boshqa node'ga o'tib, xotiraga sekin kirish.</li></ul><p>Latency'ga sezgir ilovada (trading, real-time audio, DPDK, DB) bu p99'ni buzadi.</p><h4>Ishlatish</h4><pre>taskset -c 2,3 ./app                 # 2 va 3-yadroda ishga tushirish<br>taskset -cp 4-7 &lt;PID&gt;                # ishlab turgan process'ni 4-7 ga ko'chirish<br>taskset -cp &lt;PID&gt;                    # joriy affinity'ni ko'rish<br>ps -o pid,psr,comm -p &lt;PID&gt;          # hozir qaysi yadroda (PSR)</pre><p>Thread'lar uchun: <code>taskset -a -cp 4-7 &lt;PID&gt;</code> (<code>-a</code> — hamma thread'lar).</p><h4>systemd'da (doimiy)</h4><pre>[Service]<br>CPUAffinity=2 3</pre><h4>To'liq izolyatsiya</h4><p>Pinning boshqa process'larning shu yadroga kelishini to'xtatmaydi. Yadroni butunlay ajratish:</p><ul><li>Kernel parametri: <code>isolcpus=2,3 nohz_full=2,3</code> — scheduler bu yadrolarga hech narsa qo'ymaydi.</li><li>IRQ'larni boshqa yadrolarga: <code>/proc/irq/*/smp_affinity</code>.</li><li>cgroup v2 <code>cpuset</code>: <code>systemctl set-property myapp.service AllowedCPUs=2-3</code>.</li></ul><h4>Kubernetes</h4><p>CPU Manager <code>static</code> policy + Guaranteed pod (butun sonli CPU request = limit) — pod'ga eksklyuziv yadrolar beriladi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pinning kamdan-kam kerak — zamonaviy scheduler yaxshi. Noto'g'ri pinning (hamma narsani bir yadroga) unumdorlikni tushiradi. Faqat profiling (<code>perf</code>, cache miss, migration hisoblagichlari) foydasini ko'rsatganda qo'llang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41542	<p><code>chrt</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>chrt</code> — process'ning <b>scheduling policy</b>sini va real-time prioritetini ko'rish va o'zgartirish. Real-time policy (<code>SCHED_FIFO</code>, <code>SCHED_RR</code>) bilan process oddiy process'lardan <b>doim oldin</b> CPU oladi — latency kafolatlanadi. Xavfi: noto'g'ri ishlatilsa tizimni muzlatadi.</p><h4>Policy'lar</h4><p>| Policy | Turi | Xatti-harakat | |---|---|---| | <code>SCHED_OTHER</code> | oddiy (CFS/EEVDF) | default, adolatli taqsimot, <code>nice</code> bilan boshqariladi | | <code>SCHED_BATCH</code> | oddiy | fon ishlari, kamroq uyg'otish | | <code>SCHED_IDLE</code> | oddiy | faqat CPU butunlay bo'sh bo'lganda | | <code>SCHED_FIFO</code> | real-time | o'zi bo'shatmaguncha yoki yuqoriroq prioritet kelmaguncha ishlaydi | | <code>SCHED_RR</code> | real-time | FIFO + bir xil prioritetlilar orasida vaqt bo'lagi (round-robin) |</p><p>RT prioritet 1-99; har qanday RT process har qanday oddiy process'dan ustun.</p><h4>Ishlatish</h4><pre>chrt -p &lt;PID&gt;                      # joriy policy va prioritet<br>sudo chrt -f 50 ./audio_engine     # SCHED_FIFO, prioritet 50 bilan ishga tushirish<br>sudo chrt -r -p 30 &lt;PID&gt;           # mavjud process'ni SCHED_RR 30 ga<br>chrt -m                            # har policy uchun min/max</pre><h4>Xavf</h4><p><code>SCHED_FIFO</code> process cheksiz loop'ga tushsa — o'sha yadroda boshqa hech narsa (hatto shell) ishlamaydi. Himoya: kernel default'da RT task'larga har sekundning faqat 95%ini beradi:</p><pre>cat /proc/sys/kernel/sched_rt_runtime_us   # 950000 (1000000 dan)</pre><p>Bu 5% — tizimni qutqarish uchun. Uni <code>-1</code> qilmang.</p><h4>Qachon ishlatiladi</h4><p>Audio/video ishlash, sanoat boshqaruvi, telekom, past latency trading. Odatiy web servis uchun <b>kerak emas</b> — <code>nice</code> yoki cgroup <code>cpu.weight</code> yetarli.</p><p>systemd'da: <code>CPUSchedulingPolicy=fifo</code>, <code>CPUSchedulingPriority=50</code>.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy real-time kafolat uchun <code>PREEMPT_RT</code> kernel (6.12'dan mainline'da) va <code>isolcpus</code> bilan birga ishlatiladi. Oddiy kernel'da <code>chrt</code> faqat &quot;eng yuqori ustuvorlik&quot; beradi, qat'iy deadline emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41543	<p>CFS bandwidth control (<code>cpu.cfs_quota_us</code> / v2'da <code>cpu.max</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CFS bandwidth control — cgroup'ga <b>qat'iy CPU limiti</b> qo'yish: &quot;har <b>period</b> (default 100ms) ichida ko'pi bilan <b>quota</b> mikrosekund CPU ishlat&quot;. Docker <code>--cpus</code> va Kubernetes <code>resources.limits.cpu</code> aynan shu mexanizm. Limit tugasa — process period oxirigacha <b>to'xtatiladi</b> (throttle).</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><pre>cpu.max = &quot;50000 100000&quot;  -&gt; har 100ms da 50ms CPU = 0.5 yadro<br><br>vaqt:   |---- 100ms ----|---- 100ms ----|<br>ishlash: ##### ........   ##### ........<br>         50ms  throttled  50ms  throttled</pre><p>Ko'p thread'li ilova: 4 thread parallel ishlasa, 50ms kvota <b>12.5ms</b> da tugaydi — qolgan 87.5ms davomida hammasi to'xtaydi. Natija: latency 80+ ms sakraydi, garchi o'rtacha CPU kam bo'lsa ham.</p><h4>Fayllar</h4><ul><li>cgroup v1: <code>cpu.cfs_quota_us</code> (50000) va <code>cpu.cfs_period_us</code> (100000).</li><li>cgroup v2: bitta fayl <code>cpu.max</code> = <code>&quot;50000 100000&quot;</code> (<code>max</code> = cheklovsiz).</li></ul><pre>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/myapp.service/cpu.max<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/.../cpu.stat<br># nr_periods 12000<br># nr_throttled 3400      &lt;- necha period'da throttle bo'ldi<br># throttled_usec 98000000</pre><h4>Throttling'ni aniqlash</h4><ul><li><code>nr_throttled / nr_periods</code> yuqori = muammo.</li><li>Prometheus: <code>rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m]) / rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m])</code>.</li><li>Simptom: CPU grafigi limitdan past, lekin p99 latency yomon.</li></ul><h4>Limit va request (weight) farqi</h4><ul><li><b>Quota (limit)</b> — qat'iy shift, bo'sh CPU bo'lsa ham undan oshib bo'lmaydi.</li><li><b><code>cpu.weight</code></b> (K8s <code>requests</code>) — faqat raqobat paytida ulush; bo'sh CPU'ni ishlatishga ruxsat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Latency'ga sezgir servislarda ko'p jamoalar K8s CPU <b>limit</b>ni olib tashlab, faqat <b>request</b> qo'yadi — throttling yo'qoladi. Yana: runtime yadro sonini to'g'ri bilishi kerak (Go'da <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> ni limitga moslash — <code>automaxprocs</code> yoki Go 1.25+), aks holda 64 thread 2 CPU kvotasini darhol yeydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41544	<p>VM'larda memory ballooning nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Memory ballooning — hypervisor'ga VM'dan RAM'ni <b>qaytarib olish</b> imkonini beruvchi mexanizm. VM ichida maxsus driver (&quot;balloon&quot;) xotira ajratib &quot;shishiradi&quot; — guest OS bu xotirani ishlata olmaydi va hypervisor uning fizik sahifalarini boshqa VM'larga beradi.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Hypervisor overcommit qiladi: 64GB fizik RAM'da 10 ta 8GB VM (jami 80GB). Hammasi bir vaqtda to'liq ishlatmaydi. Bir VM'ga ko'proq xotira kerak bo'lsa, hypervisor bo'sh turgan boshqa VM'lardan qaytarib olishi kerak.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><pre>1. Hypervisor: &quot;VM-A, 2GB qaytar&quot;<br>2. VM-A ichidagi balloon driver 2GB ajratadi (guest'ning oddiy allokatsiyasi kabi)<br>3. Guest OS bu 2GB'ni band deb biladi — kerak bo'lsa page cache'ni bo'shatadi yoki swap qiladi<br>4. Driver o'sha sahifalar ro'yxatini hypervisor'ga beradi<br>5. Hypervisor fizik sahifalarni VM-B ga beradi<br>&quot;Deflate&quot; — teskarisi: balloon kichrayadi, xotira guest'ga qaytadi.</pre><p>Guest OS'ning o'zi qaysi sahifani bo'shatishni hal qiladi — u qaysi xotira kam muhim ekanini hypervisor'dan yaxshiroq biladi. Bu hypervisor-darajasidagi swap'dan ancha samarali.</p><h4>Qayerda</h4><ul><li>KVM: <code>virtio_balloon</code> driver.</li><li>VMware: <code>vmmemctl</code> (VMware Tools).</li><li>Hyper-V: Dynamic Memory.</li></ul><pre>lsmod | grep balloon</pre><h4>Muammolar</h4><ul><li>Guest ichida &quot;sababsiz&quot; xotira bosimi, swap, hatto OOM — VM ichidan qaraganda xotira yetarli ko'rinadi, lekin balloon uni yegan.</li><li>DB'lar (katta buffer pool) uchun yomon — latency sakraydi. Muhim VM'larda <b>memory reservation</b> qilinadi (balloon o'chiriladi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> VM ichida tushunarsiz unumdorlik tushishi bo'lsa — hypervisor metrikalarini ham tekshiring (VMware'da &quot;ballooned memory&quot;, &quot;swapped&quot;). Muammo guest'da emas, overcommit qilingan host'da bo'lishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41545	<p><code>blkdiscard</code> / <code>fstrim</code> (SSD TRIM) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TRIM — fayl tizimi SSD'ga &quot;<b>bu block'lar endi bo'sh</b>&quot; deb xabar berishi. SSD buni o'zi bilmaydi. TRIM'siz SSD bo'sh block'larni ham &quot;band&quot; deb ko'chirib yuradi — vaqt o'tib yozish sekinlashadi va disk tezroq eskiradi. <code>fstrim</code> — bo'sh joyni SSD'ga xabar qilish; <code>blkdiscard</code> — butun qurilmani tozalash (<b>ma'lumot yo'qoladi</b>).</p><h4>Nega SSD'ga kerak</h4><p>SSD'da ustiga yozib bo'lmaydi: avval katta blokni (erase block, ~MB) o'chirish, keyin yozish kerak. Fayl o'chirilganda FS faqat metadata'ni o'zgartiradi — SSD bu sahifalarni hali &quot;ma'lumot bor&quot; deb biladi va garbage collection paytida keraksiz ma'lumotni ko'chiradi (write amplification).</p><h4>fstrim — muntazam (to'g'ri usul)</h4><pre>sudo fstrim -av                       # hamma mount qilingan FS'lar, natijani ko'rsatadi<br># /: 12.4 GiB (13312983040 bytes) trimmed<br>systemctl status fstrim.timer         # haftalik avtomatik<br>sudo systemctl enable --now fstrim.timer</pre><h4><code>discard</code> mount opsiyasi — muqobil</h4><p><code>/etc/fstab</code> da <code>discard</code> — har o'chirishda darhol TRIM.
