Har qatlam <code>discard</code>ni o'tkazishi kerak — <code>lsblk --discard</code> har qatlamni ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41546	<p>Linux'da RAID 0, 1, 5, 10 (<code>mdadm</code>) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> RAID — bir nechta diskni bittadek ishlatish. Har daraja tezlik, sig'im va ishonchlilik o'rtasida boshqacha tanlov qiladi. <b>0</b> — tez, himoya yo'q. <b>1</b> — nusxa, ishonchli. <b>5</b> — parity bilan tejamli, lekin rebuild xavfli. <b>10</b> — tez va ishonchli, eng qimmat. <b>RAID backup emas.</b></p><h4>Taqqoslash (4 x 4TB disk)</h4><p>| Daraja | Qanday | Foydali sig'im | Chidaydi | Yozish tezligi | |---|---|---|---|---| | RAID 0 | striping — ma'lumot disklarga bo'linadi | 16TB (100%) | <b>0 disk</b> | eng tez | | RAID 1 | mirroring — har disk to'liq nusxa | 4TB (har juftlik 50%) | n-1 disk | bitta disk kabi | | RAID 5 | striping + taqsimlangan parity | 12TB (n-1) | <b>1 disk</b> | sekin (har yozuvda parity hisoblash) | | RAID 6 | ikki parity | 8TB (n-2) | 2 disk | yanada sekin | | RAID 10 | mirror'lar ustida stripe | 8TB (50%) | har juftlikdan 1 | tez |</p><h4>Diagramma</h4><pre>RAID 0:  disk1[A1 A3]  disk2[A2 A4]           — biri o'lsa, hammasi yo'q<br>RAID 1:  disk1[A1 A2]  disk2[A1 A2]           — aynan nusxa<br>RAID 5:  disk1[A1 B2 Cp] disk2[A2 Bp C1] disk3[Ap B1 C2]   — p = parity<br>RAID 10: (disk1=disk2) + (disk3=disk4), ular ustida stripe</pre><h4>Nega RAID 5 katta disklarda xavfli</h4><p>Bitta disk o'ldi — rebuild uchun qolgan <b>hamma</b> disklar to'liq o'qiladi (soatlab, hatto kunlab). Bu paytda: ikkinchi disk o'lishi (bir partiyadan, bir xil yoshda) yoki o'qib bo'lmaydigan sektor (URE) — butun massiv yo'qoladi. Katta disklar uchun RAID 6 yoki RAID 10.</p><h4>mdadm misoli</h4><pre>sudo mdadm --create /dev/md0 --level=10 --raid-devices=4 /dev/sd[b-e]<br>cat /proc/mdstat                         # holat, rebuild jarayoni<br>sudo mdadm --detail /dev/md0<br>sudo mdadm --detail --scan | sudo tee -a /etc/mdadm/mdadm.conf</pre><p>Disk almashtirish:</p><pre>sudo mdadm /dev/md0 --fail /dev/sdc --remove /dev/sdc<br>sudo mdadm /dev/md0 --add /dev/sdf</pre><h4>Tanlov</h4><ul><li>DB, yuqori yozish — <b>RAID 10</b>.</li><li>Ko'p o'qiladigan arxiv — RAID 6.</li><li>Vaqtinchalik/scratch ma'lumot — RAID 0.</li><li>OS diski — RAID 1.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> RAID disk nosozligidan himoya qiladi, lekin <code>rm -rf</code>, ransomware, FS buzilishi yoki ilova xatosidan <b>himoya qilmaydi</b> — ular hamma nusxaga darhol yoziladi. Backup alohida. Monitoring (<code>mdadm --monitor</code>, SMART) bo'lmasa, birinchi disk o'lganini sezmay qolasiz.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41547	<p>ZFS zpool va dataset farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ZFS'da ikki qatlam bor. <b>Zpool</b> — fizik disklardan yig'ilgan <b>xotira hovuzi</b> (RAID shu yerda: mirror, RAID-Z). <b>Dataset</b> — pool ichidagi <b>fayl tizimi</b>; har birining o'z sozlamalari (siqish, quota, snapshot). Barcha dataset'lar pool'ning umumiy joyini bo'lishadi — oldindan o'lcham ajratish shart emas.</p><h4>Tuzilishi</h4><pre>zpool &quot;tank&quot;   (disklar: RAID-Z2, 4 x 8TB)<br>  |- tank/db        compression=lz4, recordsize=16K, quota=2T<br>  |- tank/logs      compression=zstd<br>  |- tank/backups   snapshot har kecha</pre><p>An'anaviy: disk -&gt; RAID -&gt; LVM -&gt; fayl tizimi (alohida qatlamlar). ZFS'da hammasi bitta tizim.</p><h4>Pool yaratish</h4><pre>sudo zpool create tank raidz2 /dev/sdb /dev/sdc /dev/sdd /dev/sde<br>sudo zpool status tank          # disklar holati, xatolar<br>sudo zpool list<br>sudo zpool scrub tank           # hamma ma'lumotni checksum bo'yicha tekshirish</pre><p>Pool turlari: <code>mirror</code> (RAID 1 kabi), <code>raidz1/2/3</code> (1/2/3 parity disk).</p><h4>Dataset</h4><pre>sudo zfs create tank/db<br>sudo zfs set compression=lz4 tank/db<br>sudo zfs set quota=500G tank/db<br>sudo zfs set recordsize=16K tank/db       # DB sahifa o'lchamiga moslash<br>zfs list</pre><p>Sozlamalar ota dataset'dan meros o'tadi.</p><h4>Snapshot va replikatsiya</h4><pre>sudo zfs snapshot tank/db@2026-10-03        # bir zumda, CoW tufayli joy olmaydi<br>sudo zfs rollback tank/db@2026-10-03<br>sudo zfs send tank/db@snap | ssh backup zfs receive pool/db   # boshqa serverga</pre><h4>Boshqa xususiyatlar</h4><ul><li><b>Checksum</b> har block'da — &quot;jim&quot; ma'lumot buzilishini (bit rot) aniqlaydi va mirror'dan tuzatadi.</li><li><b>Zvol</b> — dataset o'rniga block device (VM disklari uchun).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ZFS'ga ko'p RAM kerak (ARC kesh) va pool'ni kengaytirish cheklangan — mavjud RAID-Z vdev'ga disk qo'shish faqat yangi versiyalarda (OpenZFS 2.3+). Pool dizaynini oldindan rejalashtiring. Litsenziya tufayli Linux kernel'ga kirmagan — DKMS orqali o'rnatiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41548	<p>Epoll starvation nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Epoll starvation — event loop bitta &quot;og'ir&quot; socket'ga (katta ma'lumot oqimi) shuncha vaqt sarflaydiki, boshqa tayyor socket'lar navbatini kutib <b>&quot;och&quot; qoladi</b> — ularning latency'si keskin oshadi. Yechim: har socket'ga bir iteratsiyada <b>cheklangan</b> ish berish (fairness).</p><h4>Qanday paydo bo'ladi</h4><p>Edge-triggered epoll'da qoida: socket'ni <code>EAGAIN</code>gacha to'liq o'qish kerak. Naiv kod:</p><pre>for each ready fd:<br>    while (read(fd, buf, N) &gt; 0)   // tez client uzluksiz yuborsa — bu loop tugamaydi<br>        process(buf);</pre><p>Bitta client 1GB yuklayapti — loop u bilan band, qolgan 999 ta client'ning kichik so'rovlari kutadi.</p><h4>Yechim — ish byudjeti</h4><pre>for each ready fd:<br>    for (i = 0; i &lt; 16; i++) {         // har socket'ga ko'pi bilan 16 ta read<br>        n = read(fd, buf, N);<br>        if (n &lt;= 0) break;             // EAGAIN — hammasi o'qildi<br>        process(buf);<br>    }<br>    if (hali ma'lumot bor) pending_list ga qo'sh   // keyingi aylanishda davom</pre><p><code>pending_list</code>dagi fd'lar keyingi iteratsiyada epoll'ni kutmasdan qayta ishlanadi — ma'lumot yo'qolmaydi, lekin hamma navbat bilan oladi.</p><h4>Boshqa yondashuvlar</h4><ul><li><b>Level-triggered</b> rejim + bir martalik cheklangan read — kernel &quot;hali ma'lumot bor&quot; deb qayta xabar beradi.</li><li><code>epoll_wait</code>'ning <code>maxevents</code> parametri — bir aylanishda qayta ishlanadigan hodisalar soni.</li><li>Og'ir ishni (CPU-intensive) event loop'dan <b>worker pool</b>ga chiqarish — event loop faqat I/O qiladi.</li><li>Ko'p event loop + <code>SO_REUSEPORT</code> — ulanishlar thread'lar bo'ylab taqsimlanadi.</li></ul><h4>Real misollar</h4><ul><li>nginx: har ulanish uchun buffer va limitlar.</li><li>Node.js: bitta sync og'ir funksiya butun event loop'ni to'xtatadi — xuddi shu muammoning ilova darajasidagi ko'rinishi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Simptom — o'rtacha latency yaxshi, lekin p99 yomon va bir nechta &quot;og'ir&quot; client bilan bog'liq. Event loop lag metrikasi (Node'da <code>eventLoopUtilization</code>) va har ulanish bo'yicha throughput buni ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41549	<p>Socket buffer autotuning nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Socket buffer autotuning — kernel har TCP ulanishning receive/send buferini <b>avtomatik</b> o'lchaydi: tez va uzoq (katta RTT) ulanishga katta bufer, sekin ulanishga kichik. Maqsad — <b>BDP</b> (Bandwidth-Delay Product) qadar ma'lumot &quot;yo'lda&quot; bo'la olsin, aks holda link to'liq ishlatilmaydi.</p><h4>Nega bufer o'lchami tezlikni belgilaydi</h4><p>TCP ACK kelishini kutmasdan ko'pi bilan <b>window</b> (taxminan bufer) qadar yuboradi.</p><pre>BDP = bandwidth x RTT<br>1 Gbit/s x 100ms (Toshkent - Frankfurt) = 125 MB/s x 0.1 s = 12.5 MB</pre><p>Bufer 256KB bo'lsa: max tezlik = 256KB / 0.1s = <b>2.5 MB/s</b> — 1 Gbit kanalning 2%i. Bufer 12.5MB bo'lsa — to'liq tezlik.</p><h4>Autotuning qanday ishlaydi</h4><p>Kernel har ulanishning haqiqiy tezligi va RTT'sini kuzatib, buferni <code>tcp_rmem</code>/<code>tcp_wmem</code> chegaralari ichida oshiradi yoki kamaytiradi.</p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_rmem<br># net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 131072 6291456<br>#                     min  default  max<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_moderate_rcvbuf    # 1 = receive autotuning yoqilgan</pre><p>Uzoq masofali katta transfer (backup, replikatsiya) uchun <code>max</code>ni oshirish:</p><pre>net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 131072 33554432<br>net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 16384  33554432<br>net.core.rmem_max = 33554432<br>net.core.wmem_max = 33554432</pre><h4>Muhim tuzoq</h4><p>Ilova <code>setsockopt(SO_RCVBUF)</code> bilan buferni <b>qo'lda</b> o'rnatsa — o'sha socket uchun <b>autotuning o'chadi</b>. Ko'p &quot;tuning&quot; maslahatlari aslida unumdorlikni yomonlashtiradi. Qo'lda o'rnatilgan qiymat <code>net.core.rmem_max</code> bilan cheklanadi.</p><h4>Kuzatish</h4><pre>ss -tmi dst 10.0.0.5<br># rtt:98.5/2.1 ... rcv_space:... skmem:(r0,rb6291456,...)  &lt;- rb = joriy receive bufer</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p kichik ulanishli serverda (100k websocket) katta <code>default</code> qiymat xotirani yeydi — <code>max</code>ni oshiring, <code>default</code>ni emas. Bufer yetarli bo'lib, tezlik baribir past bo'lsa — muammo packet loss'da, u holda congestion control (BBR) yordam beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41550	<p>Enterprise Linux hardening checklist qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Hardening — hujum yuzasini kamaytirish: kerak bo'lmagan hamma narsani o'chirish, qolganiga minimal huquq berish, hamma narsani log qilish va yangilab turish. Qo'lda emas — <b>standart</b> (CIS Benchmark, DISA STIG) asosida va <b>avtomatlashtirilgan</b> (Ansible) holda qilinadi.</p><h4>1. Kirish (SSH)</h4><pre># /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-hardening.conf<br>PermitRootLogin no<br>PasswordAuthentication no<br>KbdInteractiveAuthentication no<br>MaxAuthTries 3<br>AllowGroups ssh-users</pre><p>Faqat kalit (yaxshisi — SSH CA sertifikatlari yoki bastion/SSM). <code>fail2ban</code> brute-force uchun. O'zgartirishdan oldin <b>ikkinchi sessiyani ochiq qoldiring</b> — o'zingizni qulflab qo'ymang.</p><h4>2. Yangilanishlar</h4><pre>sudo apt install unattended-upgrades     # Debian/Ubuntu: avtomatik security patch<br>sudo dnf install dnf-automatic           # RHEL</pre><p>Kernel patch'lari reboot talab qiladi — rejali reboot oynasi yoki livepatch.</p><h4>3. Foydalanuvchi va huquqlar</h4><ul><li>Har kishiga alohida akkaunt, umumiy akkaunt yo'q.</li><li><code>sudo</code> faqat guruh orqali, <code>NOPASSWD</code> faqat avtomatlashtirish uchun.</li><li>Parol siyosati (<code>pam_pwquality</code>), ishlatilmaydigan akkauntlarni bloklash.</li></ul><h4>4. Tarmoq</h4><pre>ss -tulpn                  # nima tinglayapti? — kerakmaslarini o'chiring<br>sudo ufw default deny incoming &amp;&amp; sudo ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/8 to any port 22</pre><p>sysctl:</p><pre>net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 1<br>net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0<br>net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0<br>net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1<br>kernel.kptr_restrict = 2<br>kernel.dmesg_restrict = 1</pre><h4>5. MAC — SELinux / AppArmor</h4><p>Enforcing rejimida. <code>setenforce 0</code> doimiy yechim emas.</p><h4>6. Keraksiz narsalarni o'chirish</h4><ul><li>Servislar: <code>systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled</code> — keraksizlarini <code>disable</code>.</li><li>Kernel modullari: <code>install cramfs /bin/false</code>, <code>usb-storage</code> va h.k.</li><li>Paketlar: kompilyator, telnet, ftp production'da kerak emas.</li><li><code>/tmp</code>, <code>/var/tmp</code>: <code>nodev,nosuid,noexec</code> bilan mount.</li></ul><h4>7. Audit va log</h4><ul><li><code>auditd</code>: <code>/etc/passwd</code>, <code>/etc/sudoers</code>, privileged buyruqlar o'zgarishini kuzatish.</li><li>Log'larni <b>markaziy</b> serverga yuborish — hujumchi lokal log'ni o'chira oladi.</li><li>Fayl yaxlitligi: AIDE.</li></ul><h4>8. Tekshirish va avtomatlashtirish</h4><pre>sudo lynis audit system                           # ball va tavsiyalar<br>sudo oscap xccdf eval --profile cis ...           # CIS bo'yicha avtomatik tekshiruv</pre><p>Hammasi Ansible role sifatida — har yangi server bir xil holatda, drift CI'da aniqlanadi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hardening bir martalik ish emas — golden image + konfiguratsiya boshqaruvi + doimiy compliance skaneri. Har qoidani ko'r-ko'rona qo'llamang: CIS'ning ba'zi bandlari ilovani buzadi (masalan <code>/tmp noexec</code> ba'zi installer'larni) — test muhitida sinab, istisnolarni hujjatlashtiring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41551	<p><code>/etc/shadow</code> va <code>/etc/passwd</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/etc/passwd</code> — hamma o'qiy oladigan user ro'yxati (nom, UID, GID, home, shell). <code>/etc/shadow</code> — faqat root o'qiydigan parol hash'lari va parol muddati siyosati.</p><p><b>Nega ikkiga bo'lingan:</b> Eski Unix'da hash <code>/etc/passwd</code> ichida turardi. <code>ls -l</code>, <code>id</code>, <code>ps</code> kabi dasturlar UID -&gt; nom tarjimasi uchun bu faylni o'qishi kerak, shuning uchun u world-readable bo'lishi shart. Natijada har qanday user hash'larni olib offline brute-force qila olardi. Yechim: hash'ni alohida, <code>0640 root:shadow</code> (yoki <code>0000</code>) faylga ko'chirish.</p><p><b>Qanday ko'rinadi:</b></p><pre>/etc/passwd:<br>alice:x:1001:1001:Alice:/home/alice:/bin/bash<br>  |   |  |    |     |       |          +-- login shell<br>  |   |  |    |     |       +-- home<br>  |   |  |    |     +-- GECOS (izoh)<br>  |   |  |    +-- asosiy GID<br>  |   |  +-- UID<br>  |   +-- &quot;x&quot; = parol shadow'da<br>  +-- login nomi<br><br>/etc/shadow:<br>alice:$y$j9T$...:19800:0:90:7:14::<br>  hash  | oxirgi o'zgarish (kun) | min | max | warn | inactive | expire</pre><p>Hash prefiksi algoritmni bildiradi: <code>$6$</code> SHA-512, <code>$y$</code> yescrypt (Debian 11+, Fedora default), <code>!</code> yoki <code>*</code> — parol bilan login yopiq.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>getent passwd alice          # NSS orqali (LDAP/SSSD userlarni ham ko'rsatadi)<br>sudo getent shadow alice<br>sudo chage -l alice          # muddat siyosatini o'qiladigan formatda<br>sudo chage -M 90 -W 7 alice  # max 90 kun, 7 kun oldin ogohlantirish<br>sudo passwd -l alice         # lock: hash oldiga &quot;!&quot; qo'yadi<br>ls -l /etc/passwd /etc/shadow</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Fayllarni qo'lda <code>vi</code> bilan tahrirlash — lock yo'q, buzilsa hech kim kira olmaydi. <code>vipw</code> / <code>vipw -s</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>passwd -l</code> SSH key login'ni to'xtatmaydi — akkauntni to'liq yopish uchun <code>usermod -s /sbin/nologin</code> yoki <code>chage -E 0</code>.</li><li><code>cat /etc/passwd</code> LDAP/AD userlarni ko'rsatmaydi — <code>getent</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da lokal parol umuman bo'lmasligi kerak: SSH key + markaziy identity (SSSD/FreeIPA). <code>/etc/shadow</code> ruxsatlari va hash algoritmi CIS benchmark'da tekshiriladi; <code>pwck</code> bilan yaxlitlikni audit qil.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41552	<p><code>/etc/group</code> va <code>/etc/gshadow</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/etc/group</code> — guruhlar va ularning a'zolari (hamma o'qiy oladi). <code>/etc/gshadow</code> — guruh parollari va guruh administratorlari (faqat root).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ruxsatlar guruh orqali beriladi (masalan <code>docker</code>, <code>wheel</code>, <code>www-data</code>). Kim qaysi guruhda ekanini tizim bilishi kerak — bu <code>/etc/group</code>. Guruh paroli (<code>newgrp</code> bilan guruhga vaqtincha o'tish) va guruh admini esa maxfiy — <code>/etc/gshadow</code>.</p><p><b>Format:</b></p><pre>/etc/group:<br>docker:x:998:alice,bob<br>  |    |  |    +-- qo'shimcha (supplementary) a'zolar<br>  |    |  +-- GID<br>  |    +-- parol gshadow'da<br>  +-- guruh nomi<br><br>/etc/gshadow:<br>docker:!::alice,bob<br>       | | +-- a'zolar<br>       | +-- guruh adminlari (gpasswd -A)<br>       +-- parol hash (&quot;!&quot; = parolsiz, newgrp yopiq)</pre><p>Muhim: userning <b>asosiy</b> guruhi <code>/etc/group</code>dagi ro'yxatda emas, <code>/etc/passwd</code>ning 4-maydonida turadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>getent group docker<br>id alice                       # uid, gid va barcha guruhlar<br>sudo usermod -aG docker alice  # -a siz -G boshqa guruhlarni O'CHIRADI<br>sudo gpasswd -d alice docker   # guruhdan chiqarish<br>sudo vigr ; sudo vigr -s       # xavfsiz tahrir<br>grpck                          # yaxlitlik tekshiruvi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>usermod -G docker alice</code> (<code>-a</code> siz) — userni boshqa barcha qo'shimcha guruhlardan chiqarib yuboradi.</li><li>Guruhga qo'shilgandan keyin joriy sessiyada o'zgarish ko'rinmaydi — qayta login yoki <code>newgrp docker</code>.</li><li><code>docker</code> guruhi amalda root bilan teng — unga qo'shish = root berish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Guruh parollari deyarli ishlatilmaydi; zamonaviy amaliyot — guruhlarni LDAP/IdP'da boshqarish va sudo'ni guruhga bog'lash (<code>%wheel</code>). Auditda imtiyozli guruhlar (<code>wheel</code>, <code>sudo</code>, <code>docker</code>, <code>adm</code>) a'zoligini muntazam tekshir.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41553	<p>PAM (Pluggable Authentication Modules) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PAM — Linux'da autentifikatsiyani dasturlardan ajratadigan modulli qatlam. <code>sshd</code>, <code>sudo</code>, <code>login</code> o'zi parol tekshirmaydi, PAM'ga so'raydi; PAM esa <code>/etc/pam.d/&lt;servis&gt;</code> dagi modullar zanjirini bajaradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> PAM bo'lmasa har dastur LDAP, MFA, parol murakkabligi, akkaunt bloklashni o'zi qayta yozishi kerak edi. PAM bilan siyosat bir joyda o'zgaradi — dasturni qayta compile qilish shart emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>sshd ---&gt; libpam ---&gt; /etc/pam.d/sshd<br>                         |<br>       +-----------------+------------------+---------------+<br>       v                 v                  v               v<br>     auth             account            password        session<br>  (kimsan?)       (ruxsat bormi?      (parol almash-   (sessiya setup:<br>  pam_unix,        muddat, vaqt)       tirish qoidasi)  limits, mkhomedir)<br>  pam_sss,         pam_faillock       pam_pwquality     pam_limits<br>  pam_google_auth</pre><p>Control flag'lar: <code>required</code> (xato bo'lsa ham davom, oxirida rad), <code>requisite</code> (darhol rad), <code>sufficient</code> (muvaffaqiyat bo'lsa darhol OK), <code>optional</code>, <code>include</code>/<code>substack</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># /etc/pam.d/sshd (parcha) - TOTP MFA qo'shish<br>auth     required   pam_google_authenticator.so nullok<br>auth     include    password-auth<br>account  required   pam_nologin.so<br>session  required   pam_limits.so</pre><pre>ls /etc/pam.d/<br>authselect current                 # RHEL 8+: profillar bilan boshqarish<br>faillock --user alice              # bloklangan urinishlar<br>faillock --user alice --reset</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PAM'ni tahrirlab, ochiq root sessiyasini yopish — xato bo'lsa hech kim kira olmaydi. Doim ikkinchi terminalda test qil.</li><li>RHEL'da <code>system-auth</code>ni qo'lda o'zgartirish — <code>authselect</code> uni qayta yozadi.</li><li><code>sshd</code>da <code>UsePAM yes</code> bo'lmasa PAM modullari ishlamaydi; key login'da <code>auth</code> bosqichi chetlab o'tiladi (<code>account</code>/<code>session</code> ishlaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PAM — xavfsizlikning eng nozik joyi: noto'g'ri <code>sufficient</code> butun autentifikatsiyani ochib qo'yishi mumkin. O'zgarishlarni config management (Ansible) orqali, test VM'da sinab, tarqat.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41554	<p><code>nscd</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>nscd</code> (Name Service Cache Daemon) — <code>passwd</code>, <code>group</code>, <code>hosts</code> kabi NSS so'rovlari natijasini cache'laydigan daemon. LDAP/NIS serverga har <code>ls -l</code> uchun borishni oldini oladi. Bugun ko'pincha <code>sssd</code> (user/group) va <code>systemd-resolved</code> (DNS) bilan almashtirilgan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> User LDAP'da bo'lsa, <code>ls -l /home</code> har fayl egasi uchun UID -&gt; nom so'rovi qiladi. 1000 fayl = 1000 tarmoq so'rovi. LDAP sekinlashsa butun server &quot;qotadi&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ls -l --&gt; glibc getpwuid() --&gt; /etc/nsswitch.conf (passwd: files ldap)<br>                                   |<br>                         nscd ishlayaptimi? -- ha --&gt; socket /var/run/nscd/socket<br>                                   |                      | cache hit -&gt; javob<br>                                   | yo'q                 | miss -&gt; LDAP, keyin cache<br>                                   v<br>                         to'g'ridan-to'g'ri files / ldap</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /etc/nsswitch.conf<br>nscd -g                      # statistika: hit/miss<br>nscd -i passwd               # passwd cache'ni tozalash (user o'zgarganda)<br>nscd -i hosts<br># /etc/nscd.conf<br>#   positive-time-to-live passwd 600<br>#   enable-cache hosts no     # DNS uchun ko'pincha o'chiriladi<br>sss_cache -E                 # sssd ishlatilsa</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>hosts</code> cache'i DNS TTL'ni hurmat qilmaydi — failover'da eski IP'ga ulanish davom etadi.</li><li><code>nscd</code> va <code>sssd</code> birga <code>passwd</code>/<code>group</code> cache'lashi — ikki qavat cache, kutilmagan eski ma'lumot. sssd bilan nscd'da shu bazalarni o'chir.</li><li>Userni o'chirgandan keyin ham cache tufayli u &quot;bor&quot; ko'rinadi — invalidatsiya qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy stack: <code>sssd</code> (offline login, LDAP/AD/Kerberos cache) + <code>systemd-resolved</code> yoki lokal <code>dnsmasq</code>/<code>unbound</code>. Container image'larida nscd odatda yo'q — glibc so'rovlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qiladi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41555	<p><code>glibc</code> va <code>musl libc</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham standart C kutubxonasi (libc) — <code>printf</code>, <code>malloc</code>, <code>getaddrinfo</code> va syscall wrapper'lar. <code>glibc</code> — to'liq, eng mos (Debian/Ubuntu/RHEL). <code>musl</code> — kichik, sodda, static linking'ga qulay (Alpine). Farq: DNS, locale, malloc tezligi, thread stack hajmi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Deyarli har binary libc'ga bog'liq. glibc'da compile qilingan binary Alpine'da &quot;not found&quot; bilan ishlamaydi (aslida dynamic linker topilmaydi). Ko'p &quot;faqat Alpine'da&quot; bug'lar shu farqdan.</p><p>| Jihat | glibc | musl | |---|---|---| | Hajm | katta (~2 MB+) | kichik (~600 KB) | | DNS resolver | <code>search</code>/<code>ndots</code>, TCP fallback to'liq | tarixan TCP fallback yo'q edi (1.2.4 da qo'shildi), parallel so'rov | | Locale | to'liq | minimal (UTF-8) | | malloc | tez, ko'p thread'da yaxshi | sekinroq (ko'p thread'da sezilarli) | | Default thread stack | ~8 MB | 128 KB | | Static link | muammoli (NSS) | oson |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ldd --version                 # glibc versiyasi<br>ldd /usr/bin/curl             # qaysi libc'ga bog'langan<br>file ./app                    # &quot;dynamically linked, interpreter /lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1&quot;<br># Alpine'da glibc binary ishlatish kerak bo'lsa: gcompat (to'liq emas)<br>apk add gcompat</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Python/Node native wheel'lar Alpine'da source'dan build bo'ladi — image katta va build sekin bo'ladi (musllinux wheel bo'lmasa).</li><li>K8s'da <code>ndots:5</code> + musl DNS — sekin yoki xato resolve; katta DNS javob TCP talab qilsa eski musl ishlamaydi.</li><li>Kichik thread stack — chuqur rekursiya Alpine'da segfault.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Alpine kichik&quot; ko'pincha noto'g'ri tejash: Go static binary uchun <code>scratch</code>/distroless, boshqalar uchun <code>debian-slim</code> yoki distroless glibc — kamroq kutilmagan bug. libc tanlovi = runtime xulq tanlovi, uni test matritsangga kirit.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41556	<p>Dynamic linker (<code>ld.so</code> / <code>ld-linux.so</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dynamic linker (<code>ld-linux-x86-64.so.2</code>, musl'da <code>ld-musl-*.so.1</code>) — dynamic binary ishga tushganda kernel avval uni yuklaydi; u kerakli <code>.so</code> kutubxonalarni topib, xotiraga map qiladi, symbol'larni bog'laydi va keyin <code>main()</code>ga boshqaruv beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Har binary <code>libc</code>, <code>libssl</code> nusxasini o'zida saqlasa disk va RAM isrof bo'lardi, xavfsizlik patch'i uchun hammasini qayta build qilish kerak bo'lardi. Shared library bilan <code>libssl</code> bir marta yangilanadi — hamma dastur foydalanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>execve(&quot;./app&quot;)<br>   v<br>kernel ELF'dagi PT_INTERP ni o'qiydi -&gt; /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2<br>   v<br>ld.so: DT_NEEDED ro'yxati (libssl.so.3, libc.so.6)<br>   v  qidiruv tartibi:<br>   |  1. LD_LIBRARY_PATH<br>   |  3. /etc/ld.so.cache (ldconfig)<br>   |  4. /lib, /usr/lib<br>   v<br>mmap + relocation + (lazy yoki BIND_NOW) symbol binding<br>   v<br>main()</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ldd ./app                         # bog'liqliklar (ishonchsiz binary'da ishlatma - uni bajarishi mumkin)<br>readelf -d ./app | grep NEEDED    # xavfsiz alternativ<br>readelf -l ./app | grep interpreter<br>LD_DEBUG=libs ./app               # qaysi yo'ldan topilganini ko'rsatadi<br>LD_PRELOAD=./mymalloc.so ./app    # funksiyani almashtirish (jemalloc, debug)<br>/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 --list ./app</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;No such file or directory&quot; binary bor bo'lsa ham — interpreter yo'q (masalan glibc binary Alpine'da).</li><li><code>LD_LIBRARY_PATH</code>ni global export qilish — boshqa dasturlar noto'g'ri versiyani oladi.</li><li><code>ldd</code> ishonchsiz binary'da kod bajarishi mumkin — <code>readelf</code>/<code>objdump</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>LD_PRELOAD</code> — kuchli diagnostika va xavfli hujum vektori (<code>/etc/ld.so.preload</code> rootkit'larning sevimli joyi). setuid binary'lar <code>LD_*</code> o'zgaruvchilarini e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41557	<p><code>/etc/ld.so.conf</code> va <code>ldconfig</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/etc/ld.so.conf</code> (va <code>/etc/ld.so.conf.d/*.conf</code>) — dynamic linker qo'shimcha qidiradigan kutubxona papkalari ro'yxati. <code>ldconfig</code> shu papkalarni skanerlab <code>/etc/ld.so.cache</code> binary indeksini quradi va soname symlink'larini yangilaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Siz <code>/opt/myapp/lib</code> ga <code>libfoo.so.1</code> qo'ydingiz, dastur &quot;error while loading shared libraries: libfoo.so.1: cannot open shared object file&quot; deydi. Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41558	<p><code>chattr +i</code> (immutable bit) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>chattr +i fayl</code> — faylga immutable atribut qo'yadi: uni o'zgartirish, o'chirish, nomini o'zgartirish, hard link yaratish mumkin emas — hatto root ham. Avval <code>chattr -i</code> qilish kerak (buning uchun <code>CAP_LINUX_IMMUTABLE</code> kerak).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Oddiy rwx ruxsatlarini root chetlab o'tadi. Muhim fayllarni (masalan <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code>ni NetworkManager qayta yozishidan, yoki konfigni tasodifiy <code>rm</code>dan) himoyalash uchun qo'shimcha qavat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>rm /etc/resolv.conf<br>   v<br>VFS: inode flag'larini tekshiradi (ext4/xfs/btrfs saqlaydi)<br>   |-- IMMUTABLE bor -&gt; EPERM &quot;Operation not permitted&quot; (root uchun ham)<br>   v<br>oddiy DAC/rwx tekshiruvi</pre><p>Papkaga <code>+i</code> qo'yilsa, ichida fayl yaratish/o'chirish ham mumkin emas (mavjud fayllar tarkibi o'zgarishi mumkin).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo chattr +i /etc/resolv.conf<br>sudo rm /etc/resolv.conf     # rm: cannot remove: Operation not permitted<br>lsattr /etc/resolv.conf      # ----i---------e------- /etc/resolv.conf<br>sudo chattr -i /etc/resolv.conf<br>sudo chattr +a /var/log/audit.log   # append-only: faqat oxiriga yozish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Paket yangilanishi immutable faylni almashtira olmay xato beradi — sabab topish qiyin, chunki <code>ls -l</code> atributni ko'rsatmaydi.</li><li><code>+i</code> hamma fayl tizimida yo'q (tmpfs'da, NFS'da ishlamaydi).</li><li>Hujumchi root bo'lsa <code>chattr -i</code> qila oladi — bu xavfsizlik chegarasi emas, faqat &quot;tasodifiy xato&quot;dan himoya. Rootkit'lar ham o'z fayllarini <code>+i</code> qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Incident response'da &quot;faylni o'chira olmayapman&quot; bo'lsa birinchi <code>lsattr</code>. <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code> uchun <code>chattr +i</code> — eski hack; to'g'ri yo'l NetworkManager/systemd-resolved'ni sozlash.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41559	<p><code>lsattr</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>lsattr</code> — fayl va papkalarning kengaytirilgan fayl tizimi atributlarini (<code>chattr</code> bilan qo'yilgan) ko'rsatadi: <code>i</code> immutable, <code>a</code> append-only, <code>e</code> extents, <code>C</code> no-CoW, <code>A</code> no-atime va boshqalar.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> <code>ls -l</code> bu atributlarni ko'rsatmaydi. Root ham faylni o'chira olmasa yoki log'ga faqat yozish mumkin bo'lsa, sabab — atribut. Uni ko'rishning yagona yo'li <code>lsattr</code>.</p><p><b>Chiqishni o'qish:</b></p><pre>$ lsattr /etc/passwd /var/log/secure /var/lib/vm.img<br>----i---------e------- /etc/passwd<br>-----a--------e------- /var/log/secure<br>---------------C------ /var/lib/vm.img<br>    |   |      | |<br>    |   |      | +-- C: btrfs'da Copy-on-Write o'chirilgan<br>    |   |      +-- e: ext4 extents (oddiy, e'tibor berma)<br>    |   +-- a: append-only<br>    +-- i: immutable</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lsattr fayl<br>lsattr -d /etc              # papkaning o'zi (ichidagilar emas)<br>lsattr -R /etc 2&gt;/dev/null | grep -E '^....i'   # immutable fayllarni qidirish<br>sudo chattr +C /var/lib/libvirt/images   # btrfs'da VM disk uchun (bo'sh papkaga)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>e</code> flag'ni ko'rib xavotirlanish — bu ext4'ning odatiy extents formati.</li><li>tmpfs/NFS/overlay'da <code>lsattr</code> &quot;Inappropriate ioctl&quot; beradi — atribut qo'llanmaydi.</li><li><code>+C</code> btrfs'da faqat bo'sh faylga yoki papkaga qo'yilganda ta'sir qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rootkit va hujumchilar persistence uchun o'z fayllariga (<code>/etc/ld.so.preload</code>, cron fayllari) <code>+i</code> qo'yadi. Incident tekshiruvida <code>lsattr -R</code> bilan kutilmagan <code>i</code>/<code>a</code> flag'larni qidir.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41560	<p>Fayl tizimi quota (<code>edquota</code>, <code>repquota</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Disk quota — user yoki guruh ishlatishi mumkin bo'lgan disk hajmi (block) va fayl soni (inode)ni cheklash. Soft limit — grace period davomida oshish mumkin; hard limit — oshib bo'lmaydi. <code>edquota</code> limit qo'yadi, <code>repquota</code> hisobot beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Umumiy serverda (shared hosting, <code>/home</code>, build server) bitta user diskni to'ldirsa, hamma servis (DB, log) yiqiladi. Quota — &quot;noisy neighbor&quot;ga qarshi himoya.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>yozish --&gt; FS joriy foydalanishni tekshiradi<br>            |-- &lt; soft          -&gt; OK<br>            |-- soft..hard      -&gt; OK + ogohlantirish, grace (7 kun) boshlanadi<br>            |-- grace tugadi    -&gt; soft hard kabi ishlaydi -&gt; EDQUOT<br>            +-- &gt;= hard         -&gt; EDQUOT &quot;Disk quota exceeded&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda (ext4):</b></p><pre># /etc/fstab: UUID=... /home ext4 defaults,usrquota,grpquota 0 2<br>sudo mount -o remount /home<br>sudo quotacheck -cugm /home     # quota fayllarini yaratish<br>sudo quotaon /home<br>sudo edquota -u alice           # editor ochiladi: soft/hard block va inode<br>sudo setquota -u alice 5G 6G 0 0 /home   # skriptlash uchun<br>sudo repquota -s /home          # hamma userlar hisobot<br>quota -s                        # o'zimning holatim</pre><p>XFS'da: <code>uquota</code> mount opsiyasi va <code>xfs_quota -x -c 'limit bsoft=5g bhard=6g alice' /home</code>; XFS project quota — papka bo'yicha limit.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mount opsiyasini qo'shib, <code>quotaon</code>ni unutish — limit ishlamaydi.</li><li>Faqat block limit qo'yib, inode'ni unutish — millionlab kichik fayl FS'ni to'ldiradi.</li><li>Root uchun quota ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container davrida quota'ning o'rnini ko'pincha alohida volume, K8s <code>ephemeral-storage</code> limit yoki XFS project quota (overlay2 <code>--storage-opt size=</code>) egallaydi. Disk monitoringda inode foizini ham alert qil.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41561	<p><code>/dev/urandom</code> va <code>/dev/random</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zamonaviy kernel'da (5.6+) ikkalasi ham bir xil CSPRNG'dan o'qiydi; farq faqat boot'ning boshida: <code>/dev/random</code> CRNG init bo'lguncha bloklanadi, <code>/dev/urandom</code> bloklanmaydi. Golden image'dan klonlangan VM'larda SSH host key va seed fayllarini qayta generatsiya qil — aks holda hamma VM bir xil kalitga ega bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41562	<p>Kernel entropy pool nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Entropy pool — kernel tasodifiylik manbalarini (interrupt vaqtlari, klaviatura/disk timing, CPU <code>RDRAND</code>, TPM/virtio-rng) yig'adigan ichki bufer. Undan CSPRNG (ChaCha20 asosidagi CRNG) seed qilinadi va <code>/dev/urandom</code>, <code>getrandom()</code> shu orqali ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kompyuter deterministik — haqiqiy tasodifiylik faqat tashqi &quot;shovqin&quot;dan keladi. Kriptografik kalit, TLS nonce, ASLR, TCP sequence raqamlari oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>IRQ timing --+<br>disk timing -+<br>RDRAND ------+--&gt; input pool (BLAKE2s mixing) --&gt; CRNG seed --&gt; ChaCha20<br>virtio-rng --+                                       |            v<br>seed file ---+          (har ~60s qayta seed)       +--&gt; /dev/urandom, getrandom()</pre><p>Kernel 5.18+ da (Jason Donenfeld qayta yozuvi) &quot;entropiya hisoblash&quot; asosan olib tashlandi: CRNG bir marta 256 bit bilan seed bo'lgach, cheksiz xavfsiz deb hisoblanadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/entropy_avail<br>cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/poolsize<br>grep -o rdrand /proc/cpuinfo | head -1<br>ls /dev/hwrng &amp;&amp; cat /sys/class/misc/hw_random/rng_current<br>systemctl status systemd-random-seed   # reboot'lar orasida seed saqlash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski maslahat: <code>haveged</code> yoki <code>rngd</code> o'rnatish — zamonaviy kernel'da odatda kerak emas.</li><li>Headless VM'da klaviatura/disk shovqini kam — <code>virtio-rng</code> qo'shmasang eski kernel'da boot sekin bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li><code>entropy_avail</code> past degan monitoring alert'i yangi kernel'da ma'nosiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy xavf — entropiya &quot;tugashi&quot; emas, balki boot'ning eng boshidagi seed'siz holat va klonlangan VM'larda bir xil seed. Cloud image pipeline'da seed va host key'larni birinchi boot'da yangilash shart.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41563	<p><code>tune2fs</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>tune2fs</code> — ext2/3/4 fayl tizimining superblock parametrlarini o'qish va o'zgartirish tool'i: reserved block foizi, label, UUID, mount count bo'yicha fsck, journal va feature'lar.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> <code>mkfs</code> paytida qo'yilgan ba'zi default'lar prod'ga mos emas. Masalan, ext4 5% joyni root uchun zahirada saqlaydi — 4 TB data diskda bu 200 GB isrof.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo tune2fs -l /dev/sdb1 | less        # hamma parametrlar<br>sudo tune2fs -l /dev/sdb1 | grep -E 'Reserved block|Mount count|Maximum mount|Last checked|features'<br><br>sudo tune2fs -m 1 /dev/sdb1             # reserved 5% -&gt; 1% (data disk)<br>sudo tune2fs -L data01 /dev/sdb1        # label<br>sudo tune2fs -c 0 -i 0 /dev/sdb1        # mount/vaqt bo'yicha majburiy fsck'ni o'chirish<br>sudo tune2fs -O metadata_csum /dev/sdb1 # feature qo'shish (unmount holatda)<br>sudo tune2fs -U random /dev/sdb1        # yangi UUID (klonlangan disk uchun)<br>sudo tune2fs -e remount-ro /dev/sdb1    # xatoda read-only'ga o'tish</pre><p><b>Chiqishni o'qish:</b></p><pre>Reserved block count:  52428       &lt;- root uchun zahira<br>Mount count:           15<br>Maximum mount count:   -1          &lt;- -1 = mount soni bo'yicha fsck yo'q<br>Errors behavior:       Continue    &lt;- remount-ro yaxshiroq</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Root (<code>/</code>) bo'limida reserved'ni 0 qilish — disk to'lganda root ham kira olmaydi, syslog yozolmaydi.</li><li>Ba'zi feature o'zgarishlari faqat unmount holatda va keyin <code>e2fsck -f</code> talab qiladi.</li><li>Klonlangan disklarda bir xil UUID — fstab noto'g'ri diskni mount qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Data disklarida <code>-m 0..1</code>, OS diskida 5% qoldir. <code>Errors behavior: remount-ro</code> — buzilgan FS'ga yozishni davom ettirib ma'lumotni battar buzishdan yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41564	<p><code>dumpe2fs</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>dumpe2fs</code> — ext2/3/4 superblock'i va har block group metadata'sini (bo'sh block/inode, bitmap joylashuvi, backup superblock'lar) batafsil chiqaradi. Asosan diagnostika va recovery uchun.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Asosiy superblock buzilsa, FS mount bo'lmaydi. ext4 superblock nusxalarini bir nechta block group'larda saqlaydi — ularning joyini <code>dumpe2fs</code> ko'rsatadi, so'ng <code>e2fsck -b</code> bilan tiklanadi.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>ext4 disk:<br>+--------+-------------+-------------+-------------+----<br>| boot   | group 0     | group 1     | group 3     | ...<br>|        | superblock  | backup SB   | backup SB   |<br>|        | GDT, bitmap | bitmap      | bitmap      |<br>|        | inode table | inode table | inode table |<br>+--------+-------------+-------------+-------------+----<br>backup SB: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 25, 27, 49, 81... (sparse_super)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo dumpe2fs -h /dev/sdb1               # faqat superblock (qisqa)<br>sudo dumpe2fs /dev/sdb1 | grep -i superblock<br>#   Primary superblock at 0, Group descriptors at 1-1<br>#   Backup superblock at 32768, ...<br>sudo e2fsck -b 32768 /dev/sdb1           # backup SB bilan tiklash<br>sudo dumpe2fs -h /dev/sdb1 | grep -E 'Inode count|Free inodes|Block size|Filesystem state'</pre><p><code>Filesystem state: not clean with errors</code> — fsck kerak.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mount qilingan FS'da natija biroz eskirgan bo'lishi mumkin (o'qish xavfsiz, lekin aniq emas).</li><li><code>mke2fs -n</code> (dry-run) ham backup SB joylarini ko'rsatadi — lekin <code>-n</code>siz ishlatsang diskni FORMAT qiladi.</li><li>To'liq chiqish ulkan — doim <code>-h</code> yoki <code>grep</code> bilan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Recovery paytida birinchi qadam — diskning <code>dd</code>/<code>ddrescue</code> nusxasini olish, keyin nusxada <code>e2fsck</code> ishlatish. <code>dumpe2fs -h</code> inode tugashini (<code>Free inodes</code>) ham tez ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41565	<p><code>xfs_info</code> va <code>xfs_repair</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>xfs_info</code> — XFS geometriyasi (block size, allocation group soni, log hajmi, stripe sozlamalari). <code>xfs_repair</code> — buzilgan XFS'ni tekshirish va tuzatish tool'i (fsck o'rnida; FS <b>unmount</b> holatda bo'lishi shart).</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> RHEL 7+ default FS — XFS. <code>fsck.xfs</code> hech narsa qilmaydi (XFS boot'da journal'ni o'zi replay qiladi); haqiqiy tuzatish faqat <code>xfs_repair</code> bilan.</p><p><b>XFS tuzilmasi:</b></p><pre>XFS volume<br>+-------+-------+-------+-------+<br>| AG 0  | AG 1  | AG 2  | AG 3  |   &lt;- allocation group: mustaqil<br>+-------+-------+-------+-------+      metadata, parallel yozish<br>  + internal log (journal)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>xfs_info /data<br>#   agcount=4, agsize=...   bsize=4096   log=internal  sunit=0 swidth=0<br>sudo umount /data<br>sudo xfs_repair -n /dev/sdb1     # dry-run: faqat nima tuzatilishini ko'rsat<br>sudo xfs_repair /dev/sdb1<br># &quot;ERROR: The filesystem has valuable metadata changes in a log&quot; -&gt;<br>sudo mount /dev/sdb1 /data &amp;&amp; sudo umount /data   # log replay<br>sudo xfs_repair -L /dev/sdb1     # OXIRGI chora: log'ni o'chiradi, ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin<br>xfs_growfs /data                 # online kengaytirish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>XFS'ni <b>kichraytirib bo'lmaydi</b> — faqat kattalashtirish. LVM rejalashtirishda hisobga ol.</li><li><code>xfs_repair -L</code>ni birinchi qadam sifatida ishlatish — so'nggi tranzaksiyalar yo'qoladi.</li><li>Mount holatida <code>xfs_repair</code> ishlamaydi (va ishlatmaslik kerak).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> XFS katta fayllar va parallel yozishda kuchli (AG'lar tufayli), ext4 kichik FS va shrink kerak bo'lganda qulay. Recovery'dan oldin <code>xfs_metadump</code> bilan metadata nusxasini ol — tahlil va vendor support uchun.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41566	<p><code>fsck</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>fsck</code> — fayl tizimi yaxlitligini tekshirib, metadata xatolarini (noto'g'ri inode hisoblari, yetim block'lar, buzilgan papka yozuvlari) tuzatadigan frontend; FS turiga qarab <code>e2fsck</code>, <code>fsck.vfat</code> va h.k.ni chaqiradi. Faqat <b>unmount</b> qilingan (yoki read-only) FS'da ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b> Elektr o'chishi, kernel panic, disk xatosi, &quot;Structure needs cleaning&quot; xabari, FS read-only'ga o'tib qolishi, boot'da emergency mode.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (e2fsck bosqichlari):</b></p><pre>Pass 1: inode'lar, block'lar, hajmlar<br>Pass 2: papka strukturasi<br>Pass 3: papka bog'lanishi (yetimlar -&gt; lost+found)<br>Pass 4: link sonlari<br>Pass 5: group summary (bitmap'lar)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo umount /dev/sdb1<br>sudo fsck -n /dev/sdb1          # faqat tekshir, hech narsa o'zgartirma<br>sudo fsck -f /dev/sdb1          # &quot;clean&quot; bo'lsa ham majburan<br>sudo fsck -y /dev/sdb1          # hamma savolga &quot;yes&quot; (ehtiyot bilan)<br>echo $?                         # 0 OK, 1 tuzatildi, 4 tuzatilmagan xato qoldi<br># root FS uchun: keyingi boot'da tekshirish<br>sudo touch /forcefsck   # eski usul; systemd: kernel cmdline fsck.mode=force</pre><p>Tiklangan fayllar <code>lost+found/#&lt;inode&gt;</code> nomi bilan paydo bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mount qilingan FS'da <code>fsck</code> — FS'ni butunlay buzishi mumkin.</li><li>XFS uchun <code>fsck</code> hech narsa qilmaydi — <code>xfs_repair</code> kerak.</li><li>Fizik nosoz diskda takror fsck — diskni battar buzadi; avval <code>smartctl</code> va <code>ddrescue</code> bilan nusxa.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>/etc/fstab</code> 6-ustun (<code>fs_passno</code>): root uchun 1, boshqalar 2, tarmoq disklari 0. Cloud'da fsck kerak bo'lsa — diskni boshqa VM'ga ulab tuzatish konsolsiz eng tez yo'l.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41567	<p>Block qurilmaning major va minor raqamlari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har device fayl (<code>/dev/sda1</code>) ikkita raqamga ega: <b>major</b> — qaysi kernel driver xizmat qiladi; <b>minor</b> — o'sha driver ichida qaysi aniq qurilma/bo'lim. Kernel nomga emas, shu <code>(major, minor)</code> juftlikka qaraydi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> <code>/dev</code> dagi fayl — oddiy &quot;eshik&quot;. <code>open(&quot;/dev/sda1&quot;)</code> qilinganda kernel inode'dagi major raqam bo'yicha driver'ni topadi, minor'ni esa unga uzatadi. Container ichida device ruxsatlari (cgroup device controller) ham aynan shu raqamlar bilan beriladi.</p><p><b>Ko'rinishi:</b></p><pre>$ ls -l /dev/sda /dev/sda1 /dev/nvme0n1 /dev/null<br>brw-rw---- 1 root disk   8,  0 /dev/sda<br>brw-rw---- 1 root disk   8,  1 /dev/sda1<br>brw-rw---- 1 root disk 259,  0 /dev/nvme0n1<br>crw-rw-rw- 1 root root   1,  3 /dev/null<br>|                        |   +-- minor<br>|                        +-- major<br>+-- b = block device, c = character device</pre><p>SCSI disk major 8: <code>sda</code>=0, <code>sda1</code>=1 ... <code>sdb</code>=16 (har diskka 16 minor).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lsblk -o NAME,MAJ:MIN,SIZE,TYPE<br>cat /proc/devices                 # major -&gt; driver ro'yxati<br>stat -c '%t %T' /dev/sda1         # hex major/minor<br>ls -l /sys/dev/block/8:1          # sysfs'da qurilma<br>sudo mknod /tmp/mynull c 1 3      # qo'lda device node (odatda udev qiladi)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NVMe va device-mapper major raqamlari dinamik (259, 253) — skriptlarda qattiq yozma.</li><li>Container'ga <code>--device</code> bermasdan <code>mknod</code> qilish ishlamaydi — cgroup ruxsat bermaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> K8s/Docker <code>devices.allow</code> qoidalari <code>b 8:* rwm</code> ko'rinishida — major/minor tushunchasini bilish GPU, FUSE, loop device'larni container'ga xavfsiz berish uchun kerak.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41568	<p><code>udev</code> va <code>/etc/udev/rules.d/</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>udev</code> (<code>systemd-udevd</code>) — kernel'dan qurilma event'larini (uevent) olib, <code>/dev</code> da node'lar yaratadi, ruxsat qo'yadi, barqaror symlink'lar (<code>/dev/disk/by-uuid/...</code>) yasaydi va custom qoidalarni bajaradi. Qoidalar: <code>/usr/lib/udev/rules.d/</code> (paket) va <code>/etc/udev/rules.d/</code> (admin, ustun).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Disk nomlari (<code>sdb</code>, <code>sdc</code>) har boot'da o'zgarishi mumkin, USB qurilma ulanganda ruxsatlar kerak, NIC nomlari barqaror bo'lishi kerak. udev buni avtomatlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>disk ulandi -&gt; kernel driver -&gt; uevent (netlink) -&gt; systemd-udevd<br>                                                       v<br>                                  rules.d (raqam tartibida: 60-..., 99-...)<br>                                                       v<br>                  /dev/sdb yaratish + MODE/OWNER + SYMLINK + RUN+=&quot;skript&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># /etc/udev/rules.d/99-backup-disk.rules<br>SUBSYSTEM==&quot;block&quot;, ENV{ID_SERIAL}==&quot;WDC_WD40_ABC123&quot;, SYMLINK+=&quot;backupdisk&quot;, MODE=&quot;0660&quot;, GROUP=&quot;backup&quot;</pre><pre>udevadm info -a -n /dev/sdb | less      # match qilish uchun atributlar<br>udevadm info --query=property /dev/sdb<br>sudo udevadm control --reload<br>sudo udevadm trigger --subsystem-match=block<br>udevadm monitor --udev --property       # jonli event'lar<br>ls -l /dev/disk/by-id/ /dev/disk/by-uuid/</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>RUN+=</code> ichida uzoq ishlaydigan skript — udev uni o'ldiradi (timeout); uzoq ishlar uchun systemd unit trigger qil (<code>ENV{SYSTEMD_WANTS}</code>).</li><li>Qoida fayl nomi tartibi muhim — <code>10-</code> dagi qoida keyinroq <code>99-</code> tomonidan yozib yuborilishi mumkin.</li><li>Qoida o'zgargach <code>reload</code> + <code>trigger</code> qilmaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> fstab'da doim <code>UUID=</code> yoki <code>/dev/disk/by-id/</code> ishlat — <code>sdX</code> nomlari cloud'da (NVMe tartibi) ayniqsa ishonchsiz. AWS'da EBS volume ID <code>by-id</code> symlink orqali keladi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41569	<p><code>lsblk</code> va <code>blkid</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>lsblk</code> — block qurilmalarni daraxt ko'rinishida (disk -&gt; bo'lim -&gt; LVM/RAID/LUKS -&gt; mount nuqta) ko'rsatadi. <code>blkid</code> — qurilmalardagi FS turi, UUID, LABEL, PARTUUID ni o'qiydi. Birinchisi &quot;tuzilma&quot;, ikkinchisi &quot;identifikator&quot;.</p><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b> Yangi disk qo'shilganda uni topish, fstab'ga UUID yozish, LVM/LUKS qatlamlarini tushunish, &quot;disk qayerga mount qilingan?&quot; savoli.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lsblk<br># NAME          MAJ:MIN SIZE TYPE  MOUNTPOINTS<br># nvme0n1       259:0   100G disk<br># |-nvme0n1p1   259:1     1G part  /boot/efi<br># +-nvme0n1p2   259:2    99G part<br>#   +-vg-root   253:0    99G lvm   /<br># nvme1n1       259:3   500G disk              &lt;- yangi, bo'sh disk<br><br>lsblk -f                       # FS turi, UUID, bo'sh joy bilan<br>lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL,SERIAL<br>lsblk -J                       # JSON (skript uchun)<br><br>sudo blkid<br># /dev/nvme0n1p2: UUID=&quot;...&quot; TYPE=&quot;LVM2_member&quot;<br>sudo blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/nvme1n1p1   # faqat UUID<br>sudo blkid -p /dev/nvme1n1     # cache emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri probe</pre><p>fstab uchun:</p><pre>UUID=3f2a...  /data  xfs  defaults,nofail  0 2</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bo'sh (formatlanmagan) diskda <code>blkid</code> hech narsa chiqarmaydi — bu xato emas.</li><li><code>blkid</code> cache'i eskirgan bo'lishi mumkin — <code>-p</code> bilan probe qil.</li><li><code>lsblk</code>da ko'rinmayotgan yangi disk — SCSI rescan kerak: <code>echo &quot;- - -&quot; &gt; /sys/class/scsi_host/host0/scan</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>mkfs</code> qilishdan oldin doim <code>lsblk -f</code> bilan diskda FS/LVM yo'qligini tekshir — noto'g'ri diskni formatlash eng keng tarqalgan halokatli xato. Skriptlarda <code>lsblk -J</code> + <code>jq</code>.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41570	<p><code>hdparm</code> va <code>smartctl</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>hdparm</code> — SATA/ATA disk parametrlarini ko'rish va sozlash, o'qish tezligini taxminiy o'lchash. <code>smartctl</code> (smartmontools) — diskning S.M.A.R.T. sog'liq telemetriyasini o'qish va test o'tkazish: nosozlikni oldindan aniqlash.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Disklar ko'pincha birdaniga emas, asta-sekin o'ladi: reallocated sector'lar ko'payadi, CRC xatolari, harorat. SMART buni oldindan ko'rsatadi — disk o'lmasdan almashtirasan.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo smartctl -i /dev/sda            # model, serial, SMART yoqilganmi<br>sudo smartctl -H /dev/sda            # umumiy: PASSED / FAILED<br>sudo smartctl -A /dev/sda            # atributlar<br>sudo smartctl -t short /dev/sda      # 2 daqiqalik test; -t long - to'liq<br>sudo smartctl -l selftest /dev/sda   # test natijalari<br>sudo smartctl -a /dev/nvme0n1        # NVMe ham ishlaydi<br><br>sudo hdparm -I /dev/sda              # disk imkoniyatlari<br>sudo hdparm -tT /dev/sda             # cache va disk o'qish tezligi (taxminiy)<br>sudo hdparm -W /dev/sda              # write cache holati</pre><p><b>Muhim atributlar:</b> | ID | Nomi | Ma'nosi | |---|---|---| | 5 | Reallocated_Sector_Ct | almashtirilgan bad sector — o'sib borsa almashtir | | 197 | Current_Pending_Sector | o'qib bo'lmayotgan sector | | 198 | Offline_Uncorrectable | tuzatib bo'lmagan | | 199 | UDMA_CRC_Error_Count | kabel/ulagich muammosi | | 194 | Temperature | harorat |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-H PASSED</code> ga ishonish — ko'p disklar PASSED holida o'ladi; 5/197/198 o'sishini kuzat.</li><li><code>hdparm --security-erase</code> kabi buyruqlar ma'lumotni butunlay o'chiradi.</li><li>RAID controller ortidagi disk uchun <code>-d megaraid,N</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>smartd</code> daemon yoki <code>smartctl_exporter</code> -&gt; Prometheus bilan reallocated sector o'sishiga alert qo'y. Cloud VM'da SMART yo'q — u yerda provider metrikalari ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41571	<p><code>nvme-cli</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>nvme-cli</code> (<code>nvme</code> buyrug'i) — NVMe SSD'lar bilan ishlash uchun rasmiy tool: qurilmalarni ro'yxatlash, SMART/health log, xato log, firmware yangilash, namespace boshqaruvi, format va secure erase.</p><p><b>Nega alohida tool:</b> NVMe ATA/SCSI emas, o'z buyruq to'plamiga ega. <code>hdparm</code> u bilan ishlamaydi; <code>smartctl</code> asosiy narsani ko'rsatadi, lekin namespace, firmware slot, vendor log'lar uchun <code>nvme</code> kerak.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>NVMe controller (nvme0)<br>   |-- namespace 1 -&gt; /dev/nvme0n1 -&gt; bo'limlar nvme0n1p1...<br>   +-- namespace 2 -&gt; /dev/nvme0n2</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo nvme list                       # qurilmalar, model, hajm, firmware<br>sudo nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0<br>#   critical_warning   : 0          &lt;- 0 bo'lmasa jiddiy<br>#   temperature        : 41 C<br>#   percentage_used    : 7%         &lt;- yozish resursi qancha ishlatilgan<br>#   media_errors       : 0<br>#   unsafe_shutdowns   : 12<br>sudo nvme error-log /dev/nvme0<br>sudo nvme id-ctrl /dev/nvme0 | grep -E 'fr |mn '<br>sudo nvme fw-log /dev/nvme0<br>sudo nvme format /dev/nvme0n1 --ses=1   # crypto/user erase - HAMMA DATA O'CHADI</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>nvme format</code> / <code>sanitize</code> — qaytarib bo'lmaydi; qurilma nomini ikki marta tekshir.</li><li><code>percentage_used</code> 100% ga yetsa disk read-only bo'lishi mumkin — oldindan almashtir.</li><li>Cloud (AWS Nitro) NVMe'da ko'p buyruqlar cheklangan — EBS aslida tarmoq diski.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>percentage_used</code>, <code>media_errors</code>, <code>critical_warning</code>ni monitoring'ga chiqar.
