Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41572	<p>Linux I/O scheduler'lari (mq-deadline, kyber, bfq, none) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> I/O scheduler — block qurilmaga ketadigan so'rovlarni qanday tartibda va qanday birlashtirib yuborishni hal qiladi. blk-mq davrida 4 ta: <code>none</code> (NVMe), <code>mq-deadline</code> (SATA SSD/HDD, server default), <code>bfq</code> (desktop, adolat), <code>kyber</code> (tez qurilmada latency maqsadi). Eski <code>cfq</code>/<code>noop</code>/<code>deadline</code> olib tashlangan (5.0).</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> HDD'da seek qimmat — so'rovlarni tartiblash katta yutuq. NVMe'da esa ichki parallel navbatlar bor — kernel'dagi qo'shimcha tartiblash faqat CPU sarfi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app -&gt; page cache -&gt; block layer (blk-mq)<br>                        |<br>          per-CPU software queues<br>                        v<br>                 I/O scheduler   &lt;- none | mq-deadline | bfq | kyber<br>                        v<br>          hardware dispatch queues -&gt; disk</pre><p>| Scheduler | Qachon | |---|---| | none | NVMe, tez SSD, VM'dagi virtio disklar | | mq-deadline | HDD, SATA SSD, DB server'lar (read starvation'dan himoya) | | bfq | desktop, ko'p jarayon adolatli; <code>ionice</code> bilan ishlaydi; CPU sarfi yuqori | | kyber | tez qurilma, read/write latency target |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/block/nvme0n1/queue/scheduler     # [none] mq-deadline kyber bfq<br>echo mq-deadline | sudo tee /sys/block/sda/queue/scheduler<br>cat /sys/block/sda/queue/rotational        # 1 = HDD<br># doimiy: /etc/udev/rules.d/60-iosched.rules<br># ACTION==&quot;add|change&quot;, KERNEL==&quot;sd[a-z]&quot;, ATTR{queue/rotational}==&quot;1&quot;, ATTR{queue/scheduler}=&quot;mq-deadline&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>echo</code> bilan qo'yilgan qiymat reboot'da yo'qoladi — udev qoidasi kerak.</li><li>NVMe'da <code>bfq</code> — sezilarli CPU overhead.</li><li><code>ionice</code> priority faqat <code>bfq</code>da ta'sir qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Scheduler'ni o'zgartirishdan oldin <code>fio</code> bilan o'lcha — ko'pincha farq kichik, haqiqiy muammo queue depth yoki ilova pattern'ida.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41573	<p><code>ionice</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ionice</code> — process'ning I/O scheduling klassi va prioritetini o'rnatadi: <code>1</code> Real-time, <code>2</code> Best-effort (default, 0-7 daraja), <code>3</code> Idle (disk bo'sh bo'lganda). Masalan backup'ni prod DB'ga xalaqit bermaydigan qilish: <code>ionice -c3</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kechasi backup yoki <code>rsync</code> ishga tushganda disk to'yinadi va DB latency 10 baravar oshadi. CPU uchun <code>nice</code> bor; disk uchun — <code>ionice</code>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>klass:   RT (1)  &gt;  BE (2, daraja 0..7)  &gt;  Idle (3)<br>            \           |                    /<br>             +--&gt; I/O scheduler (bfq) navbat beradi<br>Idle: faqat boshqa I/O bo'lmaganda xizmat ko'rsatiladi</pre><p>Muhim: prioritetni faqat <b>BFQ</b> scheduler hurmat qiladi (eski CFQ olib tashlangan). <code>mq-deadline</code>/<code>none</code> da <code>ionice</code> deyarli ta'sirsiz.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ionice -c3 tar czf /backup/db.tgz /var/lib/data   # idle klass<br>ionice -c2 -n7 rsync -a src/ dst/                 # BE, eng past<br>ionice -p $(pgrep -f backup.sh)                   # joriy klass<br>sudo ionice -c3 -p 12345<br>nice -n19 ionice -c3 ./heavy.sh                   # CPU + I/O<br>cat /sys/block/sda/queue/scheduler                # bfq ekanini tekshir</pre><p>Ishonchliroq alternativ — cgroup v2 I/O limit:</p><pre>systemd-run --scope -p IOWeight=10 -p &quot;IOWriteBandwidthMax=/dev/sda 20M&quot; ./backup.sh</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NVMe (<code>none</code>) da <code>ionice -c3</code> qo'yib, &quot;ishlamayapti&quot; deb hayron bo'lish.</li><li>Buffered yozuvlar page cache orqali keyin <code>flush</code> thread'i tomonidan yoziladi — priority yo'qolishi mumkin; cgroup v2 writeback'ni to'g'ri hisoblaydi.</li><li>RT klassi boshqa hammani och qoldirishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da <code>ionice</code>dan ko'ra cgroup v2 <code>io.max</code>/<code>io.weight</code> (systemd <code>IOReadBandwidthMax=</code>) ishonchliroq va scheduler'dan mustaqil.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41574	<p>Direct I/O (<code>O_DIRECT</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>O_DIRECT</code> — fayl ochishda flag; o'qish/yozish page cache'ni chetlab, user buffer va disk orasida bevosita DMA bilan bajariladi. DB'lar (PostgreSQL emas, lekin MySQL InnoDB, Oracle, ScyllaDB) o'z buffer pool'iga ega bo'lgani uchun double caching'dan qochish uchun ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> InnoDB 64 GB buffer pool saqlaydi. Agar page cache ham shu ma'lumotni saqlasa — RAM ikki marta isrof, kernel esa DB'ning cache siyosatini bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy I/O:    app buffer &lt;-&gt; page cache &lt;-&gt; disk     (2 nusxa, kernel readahead)<br>O_DIRECT:     app buffer &lt;-------------&gt; disk        (1 nusxa, DMA)</pre><p>Talab: buffer manzili, offset va hajm block size'ga (odatda 512 B yoki 4 KiB) <b>aligned</b> bo'lishi kerak, aks holda <code>EINVAL</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>int fd = open(&quot;data.db&quot;, O_RDWR | O_DIRECT);<br>void *buf; posix_memalign(&amp;buf, 4096, 4096);<br>pread(fd, buf, 4096, 0);   // offset ham 4096 karrali</pre><pre>dd if=/dev/zero of=test bs=1M count=1024 oflag=direct    # cache'siz yozish tezligi<br>fio --name=t --rw=randread --bs=4k --direct=1 --size=1G --ioengine=io_uring<br># MySQL: innodb_flush_method = O_DIRECT</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>O_DIRECT</code> = durability emas: disk write cache'da qolishi mumkin; <code>fsync</code>/<code>O_DSYNC</code> baribir kerak.</li><li>Kichik, unaligned I/O'da sekinroq — readahead va birlashtirish yo'q.</li><li>Bir faylni bir vaqtda direct va buffered ishlatish — konsistentlik muammolari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Benchmark'da <code>--direct=1</code> siz natija RAM tezligini o'lchaydi, disk emas. PostgreSQL an'anaviy ravishda page cache'ga tayanadi (shared_buffers ~25% RAM) — PG 16+ da direct I/O faqat eksperimental <code>debug_io_direct</code>.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41575	<p>AIO va <code>io_uring</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux AIO (<code>io_submit</code>, libaio) — eski asinxron interfeys, amalda faqat <code>O_DIRECT</code> block I/O uchun to'g'ri ishlaydi. <code>io_uring</code> (5.1+) — userspace va kernel o'rtasida umumiy ring buffer'lar (submission/completion queue), istalgan I/O (fayl, socket, buffered) uchun, syscall soni minimal.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yuqori IOPS'da (NVMe, 1M+ IOPS) har <code>read()</code> syscall va context switch qimmat. Thread-per-I/O yondashuvi esa ko'p thread va xotira talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>AIO:      io_submit() syscall -&gt; kernel -&gt; io_getevents() syscall<br>          buffered I/O'da sinxron bloklanib qolishi mumkin<br><br>io_uring:<br> userspace                          kernel<br> [SQ ring] -- SQE yozish --&gt;   o'qiydi, bajaradi<br> [CQ ring] &lt;-- CQE natija --   yozadi<br> (mmap qilingan umumiy xotira; SQPOLL rejimida syscall umuman yo'q)</pre><p>| | AIO | io_uring | |---|---|---| | Buffered I/O | yo'q (bloklanadi) | ha | | Socket | yo'q | ha (accept, recv, send) | | Syscall | har batch'da 2 | 0-1 (batch, SQPOLL) | | Ishlatuvchilar | eski MySQL, QEMU | ScyllaDB, RocksDB, PG 18 (<code>io_method=io_uring</code>), Tokio-uring |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>fio --name=t --ioengine=io_uring --rw=randread --bs=4k --direct=1 --iodepth=64 --size=1G<br>fio --name=t --ioengine=libaio  --rw=randread --bs=4k --direct=1 --iodepth=64 --size=1G<br>cat /proc/sys/kernel/io_uring_disabled    # 6.6+: 0 ruxsat, 1 cheklangan, 2 o'chiq</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>io_uring ko'p kernel CVE'larga sabab bo'lgan — Google ChromeOS/prod'da, Docker default seccomp profilida bloklangan; container'da &quot;Operation not permitted&quot;.</li><li>Eski kernel'da (5.4) imkoniyatlar kam — feature probe kerak.</li><li>AIO'ni buffered fayl bilan ishlatish — jim sinxron bloklanish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> io_uring katta yutuq beradi, lekin xavfsizlik siyosatini hisobga ol: multi-tenant muhitda <code>io_uring_disabled=2</code> keng tarqalgan. Avval o'lcha — ko'p ilovalar uchun epoll + thread pool yetarli.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41576	<p><code>kswapd</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>kswapd</code> — har NUMA node uchun bitta fon kernel thread'i (<code>kswapd0</code>, <code>kswapd1</code>). Bo'sh xotira <code>low</code> watermark'dan tushganda uyg'onadi va <code>high</code> gacha xotirani qaytarib oladi: toza page cache'ni tashlaydi, dirty sahifalarni yozadi, anonim xotirani swap'ga chiqaradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Agar xotira faqat allokatsiya paytida bo'shatilsa, ilova <code>malloc</code>da to'xtab qolardi (direct reclaim). kswapd buni oldindan, fonda qiladi — ilovalar latency'ni sezmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bo'sh xotira<br>  ^<br>  | ---- high  &lt;- kswapd shu yerga yetganda uxlaydi<br>  |<br>  | ---- low   &lt;- kswapd uyg'onadi (fon reclaim)<br>  |<br>  | ---- min   &lt;- direct reclaim: ilova o'zi bo'shatadi (STALL!)<br>  |               undan ham past -&gt; OOM killer<br>  +----------------------------------------&gt; vaqt</pre><p>Watermark'lar <code>vm.min_free_kbytes</code> va <code>vm.watermark_scale_factor</code>dan hisoblanadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>top -p $(pgrep -d, kswapd)            # kswapd CPU yuqori = xotira bosimi<br>vmstat 1                              # si/so (swap in/out), free, cache<br>grep -E 'pgscan_kswapd|pgscan_direct|pgsteal' /proc/vmstat<br>cat /proc/zoneinfo | grep -E 'Node|min|low|high' | head<br>cat /proc/pressure/memory             # PSI: some/full stall foizi<br>sudo sysctl vm.watermark_scale_factor=200   # kswapd'ni ertaroq uyg'otish</pre><p><code>pgscan_direct</code> tez o'syapti — ilovalar reclaim'da kutmoqda, latency spike'lar shu.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;kswapd 100% CPU&quot; ni kernel bug deb o'ylash — odatda bu haqiqiy xotira yetishmovchiligi yoki noto'g'ri <code>min_free_kbytes</code>.</li><li><code>vm.min_free_kbytes</code>ni juda katta qilish — foydali xotira kamayadi, OOM ertaroq.</li><li>Swap'siz tizimda kswapd faqat cache'ni bo'shata oladi — cache tugasa thrashing (kod sahifalari qayta-qayta o'qiladi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xotira bosimini <code>free</code>dan emas, PSI (<code>/proc/pressure/memory</code>) va <code>pgscan_direct</code>dan o'lcha. Latency-sezgir servislarda <code>watermark_scale_factor</code> oshirish direct reclaim stall'larini kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41577	<p>Memory compaction nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Memory compaction — kernel band sahifalarni ko'chirib, fizik xotirada katta <b>uzluksiz</b> bo'sh bloklar hosil qilish jarayoni. Katta (high-order) allokatsiyalar uchun kerak: Transparent HugePages (2 MB), ba'zi driver DMA buferlari, kernel stack'lar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Umumiy bo'sh xotira 10 GB bo'lishi mumkin, lekin 4 KB'lik mayda bo'laklarga sochilgan. 2 MB uzluksiz blok so'ralganda — topilmaydi. Bu tashqi fragmentatsiya.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oldin:  [U][.][U][.][.][U][.][U]     U = band, . = bo'sh<br>             migrate scanner: band sahifalarni oxiriga ko'chiradi<br>             free scanner: bo'sh joylarni boshdan oladi<br>Keyin:  [.][.][.][.][U][U][U][U]  -&gt; 4 sahifalik uzluksiz blok</pre><p>Faqat ko'chirib bo'ladigan (movable) sahifalar siljiydi; kernel'ning pinned sahifalari to'siq bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/buddyinfo        # har order bo'yicha bo'sh blok soni<br># Node 0, zone Normal  1200  800  300  50  5  0  0 ...<br>#                       o0   o1   o2   o3 o4 o5 ...  &lt;- o'ngda 0 = fragmentatsiya<br>echo 1 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory     # qo'lda compaction<br>grep -E 'compact_(stall|fail|success)' /proc/vmstat<br>cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/defrag    # always/defer/madvise/never<br>sysctl vm.compaction_proactiveness                # 5.9+: fonda oldindan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>THP <code>defrag=always</code> — allokatsiya paytida sinxron compaction, DB'larda katta latency spike (Redis, MongoDB THP'ni o'chirishni tavsiya qiladi).</li><li><code>compact_stall</code> o'sishi — ilovalar compaction'da kutyapti.</li><li>Uzoq ishlagan serverda driver yuklash &quot;page allocation failure: order:4&quot; bilan yiqilishi — fragmentatsiya belgisi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Latency-sezgir tizimlarda THP <code>defrag=madvise</code> yoki <code>defer</code> qo'y. Kerakli HugePages'ni boot'da (<code>hugepages=</code> kernel param) ajrat — keyinroq fragmentatsiya sabab ololmaysan.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41578	<p>SLAB, SLUB va SLOB allocator'lari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Slab allocator — kernel'ning tez-tez yaratilib o'chiriladigan bir xil o'lchamli obyektlari (inode, dentry, <code>task_struct</code>, socket buferlari) uchun cache allocator. Uch implementatsiya bo'lgan: SLAB (eski), SLOB (embedded uchun minimal), SLUB (zamonaviy default). SLOB 6.4 da, SLAB 6.8 da olib tashlandi — bugun faqat SLUB.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Buddy allocator sahifa (4 KB) bilan ishlaydi. 200 baytlik <code>dentry</code> uchun butun sahifa berish isrof va sekin. Slab bir sahifani ko'p bir xil obyektga bo'ladi va bo'shatilganlarini qayta ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>buddy allocator (sahifalar)<br>        v<br>  kmem_cache &quot;dentry&quot; (192 B obyekt)<br>   +-- slab (1 sahifa): [obj][obj][obj]...[obj]<br>   +-- slab: ...<br>   per-CPU freelist -&gt; lock'siz tez allokatsiya</pre><p>SLUB afzalligi: sodda metadata, yaxshi debug imkoniyatlari (<code>slub_debug</code>), kam xotira overhead.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo slabtop -o | head -20<br>sudo cat /proc/slabinfo | head<br>ls /sys/kernel/slab/ | head          # SLUB cache'lari<br>grep -E 'Slab|SReclaimable|SUnreclaim' /proc/meminfo<br>#   SReclaimable: qaytarib olish mumkin (dentry, inode)<br>#   SUnreclaim:   qaytarilmaydigan - o'sishi leak belgisi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski hujjatlarda SLAB/SLOB tanlov sifatida tilga olinadi — yangi kernel'da mavjud emas.</li><li><code>Slab</code> katta ekanini leak deb o'ylash — ko'pincha bu <code>SReclaimable</code> dentry cache, bosim bo'lsa bo'shaydi.</li><li><code>SUnreclaim</code> doimiy o'sishi — driver yoki modul leak; <code>slabtop</code> bilan qaysi cache ekanini top.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;free ko'rsatmayapti, lekin RAM yo'q&quot; holatlarining katta qismi slab (masalan millionlab negative dentry). Monitoring'da <code>SUnreclaim</code>ni alohida grafik qil.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41579	<p><code>/proc/meminfo</code> dagi <code>MemAvailable</code>, <code>Buffers</code>, <code>Cached</code>, <code>Dirty</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>MemAvailable</code> — swap qilmasdan yangi ilovalarga berish mumkin bo'lgan xotira bahosi (bo'sh + qaytarib olinadigan cache). <code>Buffers</code> — block qurilma metadata'si uchun cache. <code>Cached</code> — fayl tarkibi page cache'i (tmpfs/shmem ham kiradi). <code>Dirty</code> — o'zgargan, lekin hali diskka yozilmagan sahifalar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi admin <code>MemFree: 300 MB</code> ko'rib &quot;xotira tugadi&quot; deydi. Aslida Linux bo'sh RAM'ni cache uchun ishlatadi — &quot;unused RAM is wasted RAM&quot;. Haqiqiy ko'rsatkich — <code>MemAvailable</code>.</p><p><b>O'qish:</b></p><pre>$ grep -E 'MemTotal|MemFree|MemAvailable|Buffers|^Cached|Dirty|Writeback|Shmem|AnonPages' /proc/meminfo<br>MemTotal:       32 GB<br>MemFree:         0.4 GB   &lt;- haqiqatan bo'sh (kichik bo'lishi normal)<br>MemAvailable:   18   GB   &lt;- SHUNGA QARA<br>Buffers:         0.2 GB<br>Cached:         17   GB   &lt;- page cache (bir qismi Shmem - bo'shatib bo'lmaydi!)<br>Shmem:           2   GB   &lt;- tmpfs, /dev/shm<br>AnonPages:      12   GB   &lt;- ilovalar heap/stack<br>Dirty:          150  MB   &lt;- yozilishi kutilmoqda<br>Writeback:       0</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>free -h                     # &quot;available&quot; ustuni = MemAvailable<br>watch -n1 &quot;grep -E 'Dirty|Writeback' /proc/meminfo&quot;<br>sysctl vm.dirty_ratio vm.dirty_background_ratio<br>sync                        # Dirty'ni majburan yozish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Cached</code>ni to'liq &quot;bo'shatiladigan&quot; deb hisoblash — <code>Shmem</code> (tmpfs, Postgres shared memory) bo'shatilmaydi.</li><li>Katta <code>Dirty</code> + sekin disk — <code>dirty_ratio</code>ga yetganda hamma yozuvchi process bloklanadi.</li><li>Container ichida <code>/proc/meminfo</code> host qiymatlarini ko'rsatadi (lxcfs bo'lmasa) — cgroup <code>memory.stat</code>ga qara.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alert'ni <code>MemAvailable / MemTotal &lt; 10%</code> ga qo'y, <code>MemFree</code>ga emas. Ko'p RAM'li serverlarda <code>dirty_ratio</code> foizda katta hajmni anglatadi — <code>vm.dirty_bytes</code>/<code>dirty_background_bytes</code> bilan absolyut limit qo'y.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41580	<p><code>/proc/slabinfo</code> va <code>slabtop</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/proc/slabinfo</code> — kernel slab cache'lari bo'yicha xom statistika (har cache'da nechta obyekt, hajmi). <code>slabtop</code> — uni <code>top</code> kabi real vaqtda, hajm bo'yicha tartiblab ko'rsatadi. Kernel xotirasi qayerga ketayotganini topish uchun.</p><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b> <code>free</code>da <code>used</code> katta, lekin process'lar RSS'i yig'indisi kichik. Yetishmayotgan xotira — kernel'da: slab, page table, driver.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>grep -E '^Slab|SReclaimable|SUnreclaim' /proc/meminfo<br>sudo slabtop -o -s c | head -15        # bir marta, hajm (cache size) bo'yicha</pre><pre> OBJS    ACTIVE  USE OBJ SIZE  SLABS  CACHE SIZE NAME<br> 12000000 11900000 99%   0.19K  571428  2285712K dentry      &lt;- 2.2 GB dentry!<br>   900000   880000 97%   1.06K   30000   960000K ext4_inode_cache<br>   400000   390000 97%   0.25K   12500   100000K kmalloc-256</pre><p>Tahlil:</p><pre>sudo cat /proc/slabinfo | awk 'NR&gt;2 {print $1, $3*$4/1024/1024 &quot; MB&quot;}' | sort -k2 -nr | head<br># dentry juda katta bo'lsa - ko'pincha millionlab yo'q fayllarga lookup (negative dentry)<br>echo 2 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches   # faqat diagnostika: dentry/inode bo'shatish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta <code>dentry</code>/<code>inode_cache</code> — odatda normal va reclaimable; bosim bo'lsa o'zi bo'shaydi.</li><li><code>kmalloc-*</code> cache'larining doimiy o'sishi — driver/modul leak belgisi, reboot'gacha qaytmaydi.</li><li><code>slabinfo</code> o'qish root talab qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Klassik holat: ilova har so'rovda mavjud bo'lmagan fayllarni <code>stat()</code> qiladi (masalan, NSS yoki health check) — negative dentry milliardga yetadi. Kernel 6.x da bu yaxshilangan, lekin <code>slabtop</code> birinchi tekshiruv bo'lib qoladi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41581	<p>Dentry cache nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dentry cache (dcache) — fayl yo'li komponentlari (<code>/var</code>, <code>log</code>, <code>nginx</code>) ni inode'larga bog'laydigan kernel cache. Har <code>open(&quot;/var/log/nginx/access.log&quot;)</code> da diskdan papkalarni o'qimasdan, xotiradan yo'lni tez topish imkonini beradi. Mavjud bo'lmagan yo'llar ham &quot;negative dentry&quot; sifatida cache'lanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yo'lni yechish (path walk) har komponent uchun papkani o'qishni talab qiladi. Millionlab <code>open</code>/<code>stat</code> chaqiruvlarida bu diskni o'ldirardi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>open(&quot;/var/log/nginx/access.log&quot;)<br>   v<br>&quot;/&quot; -&gt; dentry(var) -&gt; dentry(log) -&gt; dentry(nginx) -&gt; dentry(access.log) -&gt; inode<br>         | cache hit (RCU, lock'siz)      | miss -&gt; FS'dan o'qib dentry yaratish<br>negative dentry: &quot;/etc/foo.conf yo'q&quot; ham eslab qolinadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/sys/fs/dentry-state<br># 1250000  1100000  45  0  900000  0<br>#  jami    unused  age    negative(5.x+)<br>sudo slabtop -o | grep dentry<br>sudo perf stat -e 'syscalls:sys_enter_newstat' -a sleep 5   # stat chastotasi<br>sudo strace -f -e trace=openat,newfstatat -p &lt;PID&gt; 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep ENOENT | head</pre><p><code>ENOENT</code> ko'p bo'lsa — ilova mavjud bo'lmagan yo'llarni qidiryapti (PATH, Python import, PHP include_path).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>dcache katta bo'lishi xato emas — bosim bo'lganda kswapd bo'shatadi.</li><li>Negative dentry portlashi (millionlab unikal yo'q fayl nomlari) — slab o'sadi, ba'zi kernel'larda latency muammolari.</li><li>NFS'da dcache eskirgan bo'lishi mumkin — <code>lookupcache</code> mount opsiyasi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>vfs_cache_pressure</code> (default 100) — dentry/inode'ni page cache'ga nisbatan qanchalik agressiv bo'shatish. Millionlab fayl bilan ishlovchi (find, backup) serverlarda uni sozlash metadata I/O'ni sezilarli kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41582	<p><code>drop_caches</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/proc/sys/vm/drop_caches</code> — kernel'ni toza (clean) cache'larni darhol bo'shatishga majburlaydi: <code>1</code> page cache, <code>2</code> dentry va inode (slab), <code>3</code> hammasi. Faqat test va diagnostika uchun — prod'da muntazam ishlatish unumdorlikni tushiradi.</p><p><b>Qachon foydali:</b> &quot;Sovuq cache&quot; benchmark (diskning haqiqiy tezligi), xotira &quot;leak&quot;ini cache'dan ajratish, slab o'sishini tekshirish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>sync          -&gt; dirty sahifalarni diskka yozadi (drop_caches dirty'ga tegmaydi)<br>echo 3 &gt; ...  -&gt; clean page cache + reclaimable slab bo'shaydi<br>natija: keyingi o'qishlar diskdan (sekin), cache asta qayta to'ladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>free -h<br>sync; echo 3 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches<br>free -h                                 # buff/cache kamaydi<br># Benchmark:<br>sync; echo 1 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches<br>time cat bigfile &gt; /dev/null            # sovuq<br>time cat bigfile &gt; /dev/null            # issiq (cache'dan)<br># Bitta fayl uchun (yaxshiroq):<br>vmtouch -e bigfile                      # faqat shu faylni cache'dan chiqarish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cron'da &quot;har soatda drop_caches&quot; — klassik anti-pattern: DB va ilova keyin diskdan o'qiydi, latency sakraydi, hech narsa tuzalmaydi.</li><li><code>sync</code>siz ishlatish — dirty sahifalar qoladi, natija noto'liq.</li><li>Container ichidan ishlamaydi (read-only <code>/proc/sys</code>) va butun host'ga ta'sir qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Agar kimdir &quot;RAM to'ldi, drop_caches qilamiz&quot; desa — <code>MemAvailable</code>ni ko'rsat. Haqiqiy muammo bo'lsa (OOM), sabab cache emas, anonim xotira yoki <code>Shmem</code>/slab; drop_caches uni hal qilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41583	<p>HugePages (<code>vm.nr_hugepages</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HugePages — 4 KB o'rniga 2 MB yoki 1 GB'lik sahifalar. <code>vm.nr_hugepages</code> bilan oldindan ajratiladigan statik pul — swap qilinmaydi, fragmentatsiyaga uchramaydi. TLB miss'larni keskin kamaytiradi: Oracle, PostgreSQL (<code>huge_pages=on</code>), DPDK, JVM katta heap'lari uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 64 GB shared buffer 4 KB sahifalarda = 16 million sahifa. TLB atigi bir necha ming yozuvni sig'diradi — doimiy TLB miss va page table'lar o'zi gigabaytlab RAM yeydi (har process uchun!).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>4 KB:  64 GB / 4 KB  = 16 777 216 sahifa -&gt; katta page table, ko'p TLB miss<br>2 MB:  64 GB / 2 MB  = 32 768 sahifa     -&gt; page table kichik, TLB samarali<br>1 GB:  64 sahifa (boot paytida ajratish kerak)</pre><p>Statik HugePages (hugetlbfs) va THP (Transparent HugePages, avtomatik) — boshqa narsalar.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>grep -i huge /proc/meminfo<br># HugePages_Total: 0   HugePages_Free: 0   Hugepagesize: 2048 kB<br># PostgreSQL uchun kerakli sonni hisoblash (PG 15+):<br>postgres -D $PGDATA -C shared_memory_size_in_huge_pages<br>echo 'vm.nr_hugepages = 8500' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-hugepages.conf<br>sudo sysctl --system<br># 1 GB sahifalar - kernel cmdline: default_hugepagesz=1G hugepagesz=1G hugepages=32<br>cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled</pre><p><code>postgresql.conf</code>: <code>huge_pages = on</code> (try emas — ajratilmasa start bo'lmaydi va siz bilasiz).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ajratilgan HugePages boshqa maqsadga ishlatilmaydi — ortiqcha ajratish = RAM yo'qotish.</li><li>Uzoq ishlagan tizimda runtime'da ajratish fragmentatsiya tufayli kam chiqadi — boot'da qo'y.</li><li>THP va statik HugePages'ni chalkashtirish: ko'p DB'lar THP'ni o'chirishni, statikni yoqishni so'raydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> K8s'da HugePages alohida resurs (<code>hugepages-2Mi</code>), node'da oldindan ajratilgan bo'lishi kerak. PG'da <code>huge_pages=on</code> + to'g'ri hisoblangan <code>nr_hugepages</code> katta instance'larda 10-20% CPU tejaydi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41584	<p>POSIX shared memory (<code>shm_open</code>, <code>/dev/shm</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> POSIX shared memory — process'lar <code>shm_open()</code> bilan nomlangan xotira obyekti yaratib, uni <code>mmap</code> qiladi; natijada bir nechta process aynan bir xil fizik RAM sahifalarini ko'radi. Linux'da bu obyektlar <code>/dev/shm</code> (tmpfs) dagi fayllar.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Pipe yoki socket orqali ma'lumot almashish = kernel orqali nusxa ko'chirish. Shared memory'da nusxa yo'q — eng tez IPC (PostgreSQL shared buffers, Chrome renderer'lar, video pipeline'lar).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Process A                     Process B<br>virtual 0x7f00.. --+      +-- virtual 0x7e55..<br>                   v      v<br>              fizik sahifalar (tmpfs, /dev/shm/myseg)<br>sinxronizatsiya ALOHIDA kerak: semaphore, futex, atomic</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>int fd = shm_open(&quot;/myseg&quot;, O_CREAT | O_RDWR, 0600);<br>ftruncate(fd, 4096);<br>char *p = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0);<br>strcpy(p, &quot;salom&quot;);          // boshqa process darhol ko'radi<br>// tozalash: shm_unlink(&quot;/myseg&quot;);</pre><pre>ls -l /dev/shm<br>df -h /dev/shm               # default: RAM'ning 50%<br>ipcs -m                      # eski System V shm segmentlar (shmget)<br>docker run --shm-size=1g ... # Docker default /dev/shm = 64 MB!</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker'da 64 MB <code>/dev/shm</code> — PostgreSQL parallel query, Chrome/Puppeteer, PyTorch DataLoader &quot;No space left on device&quot; bilan yiqiladi. K8s'da <code>emptyDir: {medium: Memory}</code> ni <code>/dev/shm</code>ga mount qil.</li><li><code>shm_unlink</code> qilinmasa obyekt process o'lgandan keyin ham RAM'da qoladi.</li><li><code>/dev/shm</code>dagi ma'lumot <code>Shmem</code> sifatida hisoblanadi — cache kabi bo'shatilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shared memory'da xavfsizlik va to'g'rilik — sinxronizatsiyada: memory ordering, crash paytidagi yarim yozuv. Ko'pincha lock-free ring buffer + sequence counter pattern ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41585	<p>Memory-mapped fayllar (<code>mmap</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>mmap</code> faylni process'ning virtual manzil maydoniga map qiladi: faylni <code>read()</code> qilmasdan, oddiy xotira kabi o'qiysan. Sahifaga birinchi murojaatda page fault bo'ladi va kernel uni page cache orqali diskdan yuklaydi; <code>MAP_SHARED</code> yozuvlar keyinroq (lazy) diskka qaytadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> <code>read()</code> ma'lumotni page cache'dan user buffer'ga nusxalaydi. mmap'da nusxa yo'q — process to'g'ridan-to'g'ri page cache sahifalarini ko'radi. Shared library'lar, LMDB, MongoDB (eski MMAPv1), Kafka index fayllari, ripgrep shunday ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>p = mmap(fayl)          -&gt; faqat VMA yaratiladi, hech narsa o'qilmaydi<br>p[5000] ga murojaat     -&gt; page fault -&gt; page cache'da yo'q -&gt; disk I/O<br>                        -&gt; sahifa page table'ga ulanadi<br>p[5000] = 'x' (SHARED)  -&gt; sahifa dirty -&gt; writeback yoki msync() da diskka</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>int fd = open(&quot;data.bin&quot;, O_RDONLY);<br>struct stat st; fstat(fd, &amp;st);<br>const char *p = mmap(NULL, st.st_size, PROT_READ, MAP_PRIVATE, fd, 0);<br>madvise((void*)p, st.st_size, MADV_SEQUENTIAL);   // readahead maslahati</pre><pre>cat /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/maps | head          # map qilingan hududlar<br>pmap -x &lt;PID&gt;<br>sudo perf stat -e major-faults,minor-faults -p &lt;PID&gt; sleep 5</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>I/O xatosi <code>read()</code>dagi kabi xato kodi emas, <code>SIGBUS</code> signal bilan keladi (masalan fayl qisqartirilsa).</li><li>Durability uchun <code>msync(MS_SYNC)</code> kerak — aks holda crash'da yozuv yo'qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Katta random access'da page fault'lar latency'ni bashoratsiz qiladi; DB'lar uchun mmap ko'pincha yomon tanlov (&quot;Are You Sure You Want to Use MMAP in Your DBMS?&quot; maqolasi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> mmap qulay, lekin nazoratni kernel'ga beradi: eviction, I/O vaqti, xato ishlash. Read-heavy, katta, ko'p process o'qiydigan ma'lumot uchun zo'r; tranzaksion yozuvlar uchun — o'z buffer pool'ing yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41586	<p><code>fork()</code> dagi Copy-on-Write nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>fork()</code> paytida kernel parent xotirasini darhol nusxalamaydi: ikkala process bir xil fizik sahifalarni <b>read-only</b> deb bo'lishadi. Kimdir sahifaga yozganda page fault bo'ladi va kernel faqat o'sha sahifani nusxalaydi (Copy-on-Write). Shu tufayli 10 GB'lik process ham bir zumda fork bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Real misol — Redis BGSAVE:</b> Redis snapshot uchun fork qiladi; child xotirani diskka yozadi, parent esa yozuvlarni qabul qilishda davom etadi. Faqat o'zgargan sahifalar nusxalanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>fork() dan keyin:<br> parent PT --+<br>             +--&gt; fizik sahifa X (RO, refcount=2)<br> child  PT --+<br>parent X ga yozdi:<br> page fault -&gt; yangi sahifa X' nusxa -&gt; parent PT -&gt; X' (RW)<br> child  PT -&gt; X (refcount=1, endi RW mumkin)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>redis-cli INFO persistence | grep -E 'rdb_last_cow_size|current_fork_perc'<br>redis-cli INFO stats | grep latest_fork_usec      # fork vaqti (page table nusxasi)<br>cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled   # THP CoW'ni 2 MB'ga oshiradi<br>grep -E 'Private_Dirty|Shared_Clean' /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/smaps_rollup</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yozuv ko'p bo'lsa CoW deyarli butun xotirani nusxalaydi — 2x RAM kerak bo'lishi mumkin -&gt; OOM. Shu sababli Redis <code>vm.overcommit_memory=1</code> so'raydi.</li><li>THP yoqilgan bo'lsa 1 bayt yozish 2 MB nusxa chaqiradi — CoW xotirasi va latency portlaydi.</li><li>fork o'zi ham bepul emas: katta process'da page table'larni nusxalash yuzlab ms (Redis <code>latest_fork_usec</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta Redis/Python (multiprocessing) server'larda xotira rejasida CoW zahirasini hisobla.
