Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41587	<p><code>vfork()</code>, <code>fork()</code> va <code>clone()</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>fork()</code> — CoW xotira bilan to'liq alohida child process. <code>vfork()</code> — child parent xotirasini nusxasiz <b>qarzga oladi</b>, parent esa child <code>exec()</code> yoki <code>_exit()</code> qilguncha to'xtatiladi. <code>clone()</code> — asosiy syscall: flag'lar bilan nimani bo'lishishni (xotira, FD, namespace) tanlaysan; <code>fork</code>, thread'lar va container'lar shu ustiga qurilgan.</p><p><b>Nega uchtasi:</b> <code>fork</code> + darhol <code>exec</code> keng tarqalgan; katta process'da fork'ning page table nusxasi ham qimmat — <code>vfork</code> buni yo'q qiladi. <code>clone</code> esa umumlashgan mexanizm.</p><p>| | Xotira | Parent | Ishlatilishi | |---|---|---|---| | fork | CoW nusxa | davom etadi | oddiy child process | | vfork | umumiy (nusxasiz) | exec/_exit gacha bloklanadi | tez spawn (posix_spawn ichida) | | clone(CLONE_VM\|CLONE_FILES\|CLONE_THREAD...) | umumiy | davom etadi | pthread | | clone(CLONE_NEWPID\|CLONE_NEWNET...) | flag'ga qarab | davom etadi | container (runc) | | clone3 (5.3+) | struct bilan | | zamonaviy API |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>strace -f -e trace=clone,clone3,fork,vfork,execve bash -c 'ls' 2&gt;&amp;1 | head<br># clone(child_stack=NULL, flags=CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID|...|SIGCHLD) &lt;- glibc fork() aslida clone<br>unshare --pid --fork --mount-proc bash   # yangi PID namespace (clone/unshare flag'lari)<br>ps -eLf | head                           # LWP = thread'lar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>vfork</code> child'ida o'zgaruvchi o'zgartirish yoki <code>return</code> qilish — parent xotirasini buzadi; faqat <code>exec</code>/<code>_exit</code>.</li><li>Ko'p thread'li process'da <code>fork</code> — faqat chaqiruvchi thread nusxalanadi; boshqa thread ushlab turgan mutex abadiy qulflangan qoladi. fork'dan keyin faqat async-signal-safe funksiyalar.</li><li>Go'da <code>fork</code> mavjud emas — runtime <code>clone</code>+<code>exec</code> (syscall.ForkExec) ishlatadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi dastur ishga tushirish uchun <code>posix_spawn</code> ishlat — u vfork/<code>CLONE_VM|CLONE_VFORK</code> bilan tez va xavfsiz. Container runtime'larini tushunish = <code>clone</code> flag'lari + namespace'larni tushunish.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41588	<p>POSIX thread va Linux process farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux kernel uchun process ham, thread ham — bitta tur: <code>task_struct</code> (task). Farq — nimani bo'lishishida: thread'lar <code>clone(CLONE_VM | CLONE_FILES | CLONE_FS | CLONE_SIGHAND | CLONE_THREAD)</code> bilan yaratiladi va bir xil xotira, FD jadvali, signal handler'larni ko'radi. Process'lar alohida xotira maydoniga ega.</p><p><b>Amaliy oqibat:</b> Thread'lar arzon (xotira nusxasi yo'q) va tez ma'lumot almashadi, lekin bitta thread'dagi segfault butun process'ni o'ldiradi va data race xavfi bor. Process'lar izolyatsiyalangan, lekin IPC qimmatroq.</p><p><b>Qanday ko'rinadi:</b></p><pre>Process (TGID = 1000)<br> +-- task PID 1000 (main thread)    \<br> +-- task PID 1001                   &gt; umumiy: mm (xotira), files, sighand<br> +-- task PID 1002                  /<br>     har birida o'z: stack, registrlar, TID, TLS, scheduling<br>getpid() -&gt; 1000 (TGID), gettid() -&gt; 1001</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ps -eLf | grep nginx           # LWP ustuni = thread ID<br>ps -o pid,nlwp,cmd -p &lt;PID&gt;    # thread soni<br>ls /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/task/           # har thread uchun papka<br>top -H -p &lt;PID&gt;                # thread'lar bo'yicha CPU<br>cat /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/status | grep -E 'Tgid|Pid|Threads'</pre><p>| | Thread | Process | |---|---|---| | Xotira | umumiy | alohida (CoW) | | Crash ta'siri | butun process | faqat o'zi | | Yaratish narxi | arzon | qimmatroq | | Aloqa | to'g'ridan-to'g'ri xotira (+lock) | IPC |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>kill -9 &lt;TID&gt;</code> butun process'ni o'ldiradi (signal guruhga).</li><li><code>ulimit -u</code> (nproc) thread'larni ham sanaydi — Java ilovalari &quot;unable to create native thread&quot;.</li><li>Container <code>pids.max</code> ham thread'larni hisoblaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Arxitektura tanlovi: izolyatsiya (Postgres — process-per-connection, Chrome) vs samaradorlik (thread/goroutine). Go'da goroutine'lar M:N tarzda bir nechta OS thread'iga map qilinadi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41589	<p>Thread-Local Storage (TLS) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Thread-Local Storage — ko'p thread'li process'da global/statik o'zgaruvchining <b>har thread uchun alohida nusxasi</b>. Kodda bitta nom, lekin har thread o'z qiymatini ko'radi. Klassik misol: <code>errno</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>errno</code> global bo'lsa, thread A <code>open()</code> xatosini o'qishga ulgurmasidan thread B uni qayta yozib yuboradi. Lock qo'yish sekin. TLS bilan har thread'ning o'z <code>errno</code>si.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Thread 1: FS registr --&gt; TLS blok 1 [errno=2, req_id=A]<br>Thread 2: FS registr --&gt; TLS blok 2 [errno=0, req_id=B]<br>(x86-64'da %fs segment registri joriy thread TLS'iga ishora qiladi)<br>thread yaratilganda glibc TLS shablonidan yangi nusxa ajratadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>__thread int counter;               // GCC<br>_Thread_local int counter2;         // C11<br>thread_local std::string buf;       // C++11</pre><pre>private static final ThreadLocal&lt;SimpleDateFormat&gt; fmt =<br>    ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -&gt; new SimpleDateFormat(&quot;yyyy-MM-dd&quot;));</pre><pre>readelf -l ./app | grep TLS         # binary'dagi TLS segment</pre><p>Go'da TLS yo'q (goroutine'lar thread'lar orasida ko'chadi) — o'rniga <code>context.Context</code> ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Thread pool'da <code>ThreadLocal</code>ni tozalamaslik — keyingi so'rov oldingi user ma'lumotini ko'radi (security bug) yoki xotira leak (Tomcat classloader leak).</li><li>Async/coroutine kodda (Java virtual thread'lar, Python asyncio) TLS kutilgandek ishlamaydi — <code>ScopedValue</code>, <code>contextvars</code> ishlat.</li><li>Ko'p katta TLS obyektlari x thread soni = katta xotira.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> TLS — yashirin global holat; request-scoped ma'lumot (trace ID, user) uchun aniq context uzatish testlanadigan va async-xavfsiz. Thread pool'da <code>try/finally { tl.remove(); }</code> majburiy.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41590	<p>Voluntary va involuntary context switch farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Voluntary</b> context switch — task o'zi CPU'ni bo'shatadi, chunki biror narsani kutadi (I/O, lock, <code>sleep</code>). <b>Involuntary</b> — scheduler uni majburan to'xtatadi: time slice tugadi yoki yuqori prioritetli task uyg'ondi. Involuntary ko'p bo'lsa — CPU yetishmayapti (contention).</p><p><b>Nega farqlash kerak:</b> Ikkalasi ham &quot;context switch&quot;, lekin diagnozi teskari:</p><ul><li>ko'p voluntary -&gt; ilova kutyapti (disk, tarmoq, lock) — CPU emas, I/O/lock muammosi;</li><li>ko'p involuntary -&gt; CPU'ga navbat bor — throttling, juda ko'p thread, kam yadro.</li></ul><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Task A ishlayapti<br>  |-- read() -&gt; data yo'q -&gt; SLEEP          =&gt; voluntary  (nvcsw++)<br>  |-- timeslice tugadi / B uyg'ondi -&gt; preempt =&gt; involuntary (nivcsw++)<br>  v<br>scheduler (EEVDF/CFS) keyingi task'ni tanlaydi -&gt; registrlar, stack almashinuvi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pidstat -w -p &lt;PID&gt; 1<br>#  cswch/s  nvcswch/s  Command<br>#   1200.0      5.0    postgres   &lt;- I/O/lock kutish<br>#     10.0   3500.0    java       &lt;- CPU contention<br>grep ctxt /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/status<br># voluntary_ctxt_switches:   152000<br># nonvoluntary_ctxt_switches: 98000<br>vmstat 1                       # cs ustuni - tizim bo'yicha<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/&lt;pod&gt;/cpu.stat   # nr_throttled - container CPU limit</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Container'da involuntary ko'p, lekin host CPU bo'sh — sabab CFS quota throttling (<code>cpu.max</code>), CPU limitni tekshir.</li><li>Thread soni yadro sonidan ancha ko'p — switch overhead va cache sovishi.</li><li><code>vmstat cs</code> yuqoriligini o'zi muammo deb hisoblash — yuklamaga nisbatan baholash kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Latency muammosida birinchi <code>nvcswch</code> va <code>nr_throttled</code>ga qara. K8s'da CPU limit ko'pincha p99 latency'ni buzadi — ko'p jamoalar latency-sezgir servislarda CPU limitni olib tashlab, faqat request qo'yadi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41591	<p><code>/proc/cpuinfo</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/proc/cpuinfo</code> — har mantiqiy CPU bo'yicha protsessor ma'lumoti: model, chastota, cache hajmi, yadro/socket ID, CPU flag'lari (<code>avx2</code>, <code>avx512f</code>, <code>aes</code>, <code>vmx</code>) va <code>bugs</code> (Spectre/Meltdown kabi zaifliklar). <code>lscpu</code> — xuddi shu ma'lumotning qulay xulosasi.</p><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b> Binary yangi instruksiya talab qiladimi (AVX-512, &quot;Illegal instruction&quot;), virtualizatsiya yoqilganmi, nechta fizik yadro va HT bor, cloud instance qaysi CPU avlodida.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lscpu<br># Architecture: x86_64     CPU(s): 16<br># Thread(s) per core: 2    Core(s) per socket: 8   Socket(s): 1<br># Model name: AMD EPYC 7R13<br># NUMA node0 CPU(s): 0-15<br># Vulnerability Spectre v2: Mitigation; ...<br>nproc                                    # mavjud CPU (cgroup/affinity hisobga olinadi)<br>grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo         # mantiqiy CPU soni<br>grep -m1 -o -w -E 'avx2|avx512f|aes|vmx|svm' /proc/cpuinfo | sort -u<br>grep -m1 bugs /proc/cpuinfo<br>grep MHz /proc/cpuinfo                   # joriy chastota (o'zgarib turadi)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>processor</code> soni = mantiqiy CPU (hyper-thread'lar bilan), fizik yadro emas.</li><li>Container ichida <code>/proc/cpuinfo</code> host CPU'larini ko'rsatadi, cgroup limitini emas — ilova (JVM eski versiyalari, Node, Go <code>GOMAXPROCS</code>) noto'g'ri thread soni tanlaydi.</li><li><code>-march=native</code> bilan build qilingan binary boshqa CPU'li node'da <code>SIGILL</code> beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Go 1.25+ <code>GOMAXPROCS</code>ni cgroup CPU limitiga avtomatik moslaydi; eski versiyalarda <code>automaxprocs</code> kerak. Heterogen klasterda (turli CPU avlodlari) build'ni baseline <code>x86-64-v2/v3</code> darajasiga mo'ljalla.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41592	<p>CPU governor (<code>cpufreq</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CPU governor (<code>cpufreq</code> subsystem) — CPU chastotasini yuklamaga qarab qanday o'zgartirishni hal qiladigan siyosat: <code>performance</code> (doim maksimal), <code>powersave</code>, <code>ondemand</code>, <code>conservative</code>, <code>schedutil</code> (scheduler ma'lumotiga asoslangan, zamonaviy default). Intel <code>intel_pstate</code> drayveri o'z <code>performance</code>/<code>powersave</code> rejimlariga ega.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Quvvat tejash rejimida CPU past chastotada turadi; so'rov kelganda chastotani oshirish millisekundlar oladi — p99 latency oshadi. Latency-sezgir server'lar (trading, DB, real-time API) uchun bu sezilarli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>yuklama ^          performance: [=========== max ===========]<br>        |          schedutil:   [low]--spike--&gt;[max]---&gt;[low]<br>        |                              ^ ramp-up kechikishi<br>        +---------------------------------------&gt; vaqt</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cpupower frequency-info<br>cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_driver     # intel_pstate / acpi-cpufreq / amd-pstate<br>cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor | sort | uniq -c<br>sudo cpupower frequency-set -g performance<br># RHEL: tuned profillari<br>sudo tuned-adm profile latency-performance<br>tuned-adm active<br>watch -n1 &quot;grep MHz /proc/cpuinfo | head -4&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cloud VM'da ko'pincha <code>cpufreq</code> umuman yo'q — chastotani hypervisor boshqaradi; sozlash befoyda.</li><li><code>performance</code> quvvat va issiqlikni oshiradi — data center xarajati.</li><li><code>echo</code> bilan o'rnatilgan governor reboot'da qaytadi — <code>tuned</code> yoki systemd unit bilan doimiy qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bare-metal DB/latency server'larda <code>tuned</code> <code>latency-performance</code> + BIOS'da power profili &quot;performance&quot; standart amaliyot. Avval o'lcha: ko'p batch yuklamalarda <code>schedutil</code> farqsiz, lekin quvvatni tejaydi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41593	<p>CPU C-state va P-state farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>C-state</b> — CPU <b>bo'sh</b> turgandagi uyqu chuqurligi: C0 ishlayapti, C1 yengil to'xtash, C6 va undan chuqurroq — yadro deyarli o'chadi (tejash ko'p, uyg'onish sekin). <b>P-state</b> — CPU <b>ishlayotgan</b>dagi chastota/kuchlanish darajasi: P0 maksimal, kattaroq raqam = past chastota.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Chuqur C-state'dan uyg'onish o'nlab-yuzlab mikrosekund oladi. Har so'rov uxlab yotgan yadroni uyg'otsa, p99 latency o'sadi. P-state esa ishlash tezligini belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            ish bor (C0)                  ish yo'q<br>  P0 (3.5 GHz) .. P1 .. Pn (1.2 GHz)    C1 -&gt; C1E -&gt; C3 -&gt; C6<br>  &lt;-- governor/HWP boshqaradi --&gt;       &lt;-- cpuidle boshqaradi --&gt;<br>                                        chuqurroq = kam quvvat, uzoq uyg'onish</pre><p>| | C-state | P-state | |---|---|---| | Qachon | idle | aktiv | | Nima o'zgaradi | yadroning qismlari o'chadi | chastota/kuchlanish | | Latency ta'siri | uyg'onish kechikishi | ishlash tezligi | | Boshqaruv | <code>cpuidle</code>, <code>intel_idle</code> | <code>cpufreq</code>, HWP |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cpupower idle-info                      # mavjud C-state'lar va latency'lari<br>sudo turbostat --quiet sleep 5          # har yadro: Busy%, Bzy_MHz, C1%, C6%<br>cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpuidle/state*/name<br>cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpuidle/state*/latency   # mikrosekund<br># chuqur C-state'ni cheklash: kernel cmdline<br>#   intel_idle.max_cstate=1 processor.max_cstate=1<br># yoki dinamik: tuned latency-performance (/dev/cpu_dma_latency)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>C-state'larni butunlay o'chirish — Turbo Boost'ni kamaytirishi mumkin (issiqlik budjeti), quvvat ko'payadi.</li><li>VM ichidan C-state'ni nazorat qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>BIOS sozlamasi OS sozlamasini bekor qilishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ultra-past latency (HFT, telecom) uchun C1 dan chuqurga ruxsat berma; oddiy web servislar uchun bu quvvat isrofi. Qarorni <code>turbostat</code> va latency gistogrammasi bilan qabul qil.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41594	<p>IRQ va <code>/proc/interrupts</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> IRQ (interrupt request) — qurilma (NIC, disk, timer) CPU'ga &quot;menga e'tibor ber&quot; deb yuboradigan hardware signal. CPU joriy ishini to'xtatib, driver'ning interrupt handler'ini bajaradi. <code>/proc/interrupts</code> — har IRQ bo'yicha har CPU necha marta interrupt olganini ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Yuqori tarmoq trafikida soniyasiga yuz minglab interrupt bo'ladi. Ularning hammasi bitta CPU0 ga tushsa — o'sha yadro 100% (<code>%hi</code>/<code>%si</code>), qolganlari bo'sh, paketlar tushib qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>paket keldi -&gt; NIC -&gt; MSI-X interrupt -&gt; APIC -&gt; CPU 3<br>                                              v<br>                      hardirq handler (juda qisqa, interrupt'lar yopiq)<br>                                              v<br>                      softirq (NET_RX) -&gt; NAPI polling -&gt; TCP stack</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/interrupts | head -5<br>#            CPU0     CPU1     CPU2     CPU3<br>#  45:   9812345        0        0        0  IR-PCI-MSI  eth0-TxRx-0   &lt;- hammasi CPU0'da!<br>#  46:         0  8123456        0        0  IR-PCI-MSI  eth0-TxRx-1<br>watch -d -n1 'grep eth0 /proc/interrupts'   # qaysi biri o'syapti<br>mpstat -P ALL 1                             # %irq va %soft ustunlari<br>sar -I SUM 1                                # soniyasiga interrupt</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p navbatli NIC'da faqat bitta queue ishlayapti — RSS sozlanmagan (<code>ethtool -l</code>).</li><li><code>irqbalance</code> va qo'lda affinity bir-biriga zid ishlashi.</li><li>Bitta yadroda <code>%si</code> 100% — <code>top</code>da umumiy CPU 10% ko'rinadi, muammo yashirin qoladi; <code>mpstat -P ALL</code> bilan har yadroni ko'r.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yuqori PPS servislarida (LB, proxy, DNS) interrupt taqsimoti throughput'ning asosiy omili. Diagnostikani har yadro darajasida qil, o'rtacha CPU yolg'on gapiradi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41595	<p>SMP IRQ affinity nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SMP IRQ affinity — ma'lum IRQ'ni qaysi CPU yadro(lar)i qayta ishlashini belgilash: <code>/proc/irq/&lt;N&gt;/smp_affinity</code> (bitmask) yoki <code>smp_affinity_list</code> (<code>0-3</code>). Maqsad — interrupt yukini yadrolarga taqsimlash yoki, aksincha, ilova yadrolaridan uzoqlashtirish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 25/100 Gbit NIC'ning hamma queue interrupt'lari CPU0'ga tushsa, u to'yinadi va paketlar drop bo'ladi. Yoki latency-sezgir ilova yadrosi interrupt'lar bilan bezovta qilinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>NIC queue 0 -&gt; IRQ 45 -&gt; smp_affinity_list=0  -&gt; CPU0<br>NIC queue 1 -&gt; IRQ 46 -&gt; smp_affinity_list=1  -&gt; CPU1<br>NIC queue 2 -&gt; IRQ 47 -&gt; smp_affinity_list=2  -&gt; CPU2<br>ilova -&gt; taskset/cpuset -&gt; CPU 4-15 (interrupt'siz)</pre><p>NUMA: NIC qaysi socket'ga ulangan bo'lsa, IRQ'larni o'sha node yadrolariga bog'la.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>grep eth0 /proc/interrupts | awk '{print $1}'<br>cat /proc/irq/45/smp_affinity_list<br>echo 2 | sudo tee /proc/irq/45/smp_affinity_list   # IRQ 45 -&gt; CPU2<br>cat /sys/class/net/eth0/device/numa_node           # NIC NUMA node<br>systemctl status irqbalance<br># irqbalance'dan ba'zi CPU'larni chiqarish:<br># /etc/sysconfig/irqbalance: IRQBALANCE_BANNED_CPULIST=4-15<br># Mellanox/Intel skriptlari: set_irq_affinity.sh eth0</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qo'lda affinity qo'yib, <code>irqbalance</code>ni o'chirmaslik — u qayta yozib yuboradi.</li><li>Ba'zi managed IRQ'lar (NVMe) affinity'ni o'zgartirishga ruxsat bermaydi — &quot;Input/output error&quot;.</li><li>Boshqa NUMA node'ga bog'lash — cross-node xotira trafigi, unumdorlik pasayadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatiy server uchun <code>irqbalance</code> yetarli. Yuqori PPS yoki past latency'da: NIC queue = yadro soni, IRQ'larni NIC'ning NUMA node'iga pin, ilovani boshqa yadrolarga <code>isolcpus</code>/cpuset bilan ajrat; RPS/RFS — hardware queue kam bo'lsa.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41596	<p>SoftIRQ nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SoftIRQ — interrupt'ning &quot;og'ir&quot; ishini kechiktirib bajaradigan kernel mexanizmi. Hardware IRQ handler juda qisqa (paket keldi, deb belgilaydi), asosiy ish (TCP/IP stack, block I/O tugatish, timer'lar) softirq'da bajariladi — interrupt qaytgandan keyin yoki yuk ko'p bo'lsa <code>ksoftirqd/N</code> thread'ida.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Hardirq paytida boshqa interrupt'lar bloklanadi — u uzoq ishlasa tizim &quot;kar&quot; bo'ladi. Ishni ikkiga bo'lish: tez reaksiya + keyinroq qayta ishlash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>NIC IRQ --&gt; hardirq (mikrosekund): NAPI'ni rejalashtir, IRQ'ni yop<br>              v<br>         NET_RX softirq: driver'dan budget (300 paket) qadar poll -&gt; IP/TCP<br>              |-- budget tugadi va hali paket bor<br>              v<br>         ksoftirqd/N (oddiy thread, scheduler orqali) davom ettiradi</pre><p>Turlari: <code>NET_RX</code>, <code>NET_TX</code>, <code>BLOCK</code>, <code>TIMER</code>, <code>SCHED</code>, <code>RCU</code>, <code>TASKLET</code>, <code>HRTIMER</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>watch -d -n1 cat /proc/softirqs          # har CPU bo'yicha softirq soni<br>mpstat -P ALL 1                          # %soft<br>top                                      # ksoftirqd/3 yuqori CPU<br>cat /proc/net/softnet_stat               # 2-ustun: drop, 3-ustun: time_squeeze<br>sysctl net.core.netdev_budget net.core.netdev_budget_usecs<br>sudo sysctl -w net.core.netdev_budget=600</pre><p><code>time_squeeze</code> o'syapti — softirq budget yetmayapti, paketlar kechikmoqda.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ksoftirqd</code> CPU yuqori — bu kernel bug emas, tarmoq yuklamasi belgisi.</li><li>Bitta yadroda <code>%soft</code> 100% — RSS/RPS taqsimoti yo'q.</li><li>softirq vaqti ko'pincha process'ga emas, tasodifiy joriy process'ga hisoblanadi — <code>top</code>da chalg'itadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tarmoq drop'larini diagnostika: <code>ethtool -S</code> (NIC ring) -&gt; <code>softnet_stat</code> (backlog/squeeze) -&gt; <code>nstat</code> (socket buffer). Har qatlam o'z sababi va o'z yechimiga ega.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41597	<p>NIC RX/TX ring buffer (<code>ethtool -g</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> RX/TX ring buffer — NIC va driver o'rtasidagi aylanma navbat (descriptor ring). Kelgan paketlar DMA orqali RX ring'ga yoziladi va kernel ularni NAPI bilan oladi. Ring to'lsa, NIC yangi paketlarni tashlaydi. <code>ethtool -g</code> joriy/maksimal hajmni ko'rsatadi, <code>ethtool -G</code> o'zgartiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Trafik &quot;burst&quot; bilan kelganda (mikrosekundlarda minglab paket) kernel ulgurmaydi, kichik ring tez to'ladi -&gt; <code>rx_missed</code>/<code>rx_no_buffer</code> drop'lar, TCP retransmit, latency.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>   tarmoq --&gt; NIC --DMA--&gt; [RX ring: d0 d1 d2 ... d4095]<br>                                    ^ head      ^ tail<br>                       kernel NAPI poll -&gt; sk_buff -&gt; TCP stack<br>   ring to'la -&gt; NIC paketni tashlaydi (rx_missed_errors++)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ethtool -g eth0<br># Pre-set maximums:  RX: 4096  TX: 4096<br># Current hardware:  RX: 512   TX: 512<br>sudo ethtool -G eth0 rx 4096 tx 4096<br>ethtool -S eth0 | grep -iE 'drop|miss|no_buf|fifo'<br>ip -s link show eth0                # RX dropped<br># doimiy: NetworkManager<br>nmcli connection modify eth0 ethtool.ring-rx 4096 ethtool.ring-tx 4096</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ethtool -G</code> ba'zi driver'larda link'ni qisqa uzadi — SSH sessiya uziladi; maintenance oynasida qil.</li><li>Juda katta ring — bufferbloat va ko'proq cache miss; latency oshishi mumkin.</li><li>Ring'ni oshirish softirq sekinligini tuzatmaydi — drop sababi ring emas, CPU bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval o'lcha: <code>rx_missed</code> o'syaptimi? Ha bo'lsa — ring oshir + queue/IRQ taqsimotini tekshir. Cloud'da (ENA, virtio) ring cheklangan; AWS'da <code>ethtool -S</code> dagi <code>bw_in_allowance_exceeded</code>, <code>pps_allowance_exceeded</code> instance limitini ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41598	<p><code>ethtool</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ethtool</code> — NIC va uning driver'ini ko'rish/sozlash tool'i: link tezligi va duplex, auto-negotiation, driver/firmware versiyasi, offload'lar (TSO, GRO, checksum), ring buffer, queue (channel) soni, interrupt coalescing va batafsil statistika (<code>-S</code>).</p><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b> &quot;Tarmoq sekin&quot; — link 1 Gbit o'rniga 100 Mbit kelishuvga tushganmi? Paketlar qayerda drop bo'lyapti? Offload tcpdump'ni chalg'ityaptimi?</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ethtool eth0<br>#   Speed: 10000Mb/s   Duplex: Full   Link detected: yes<br>ethtool -i eth0              # driver: ixgbe, version, firmware-version<br>ethtool -S eth0 | grep -v ': 0$'   # nolga teng bo'lmagan hisoblagichlar<br>ethtool -k eth0              # offload holati<br>sudo ethtool -K eth0 gro off tso off   # vaqtincha (debug uchun)<br>ethtool -l eth0              # combined queue soni<br>sudo ethtool -L eth0 combined 8<br>ethtool -c eth0              # interrupt coalescing (rx-usecs)<br>sudo ethtool -C eth0 adaptive-rx on<br>sudo ethtool -s eth0 speed 1000 duplex full autoneg off   # qo'lda (ehtiyot!)</pre><p>| Flag | Vazifa | |---|---| | <code>-i</code> | driver/firmware | | <code>-S</code> | statistika | | <code>-k</code>/<code>-K</code> | offload ko'rish/sozlash | | <code>-g</code>/<code>-G</code> | ring buffer | | <code>-l</code>/<code>-L</code> | queue soni | | <code>-c</code>/<code>-C</code> | coalescing |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>tcpdump</code>da 64 KB &quot;paketlar&quot; yoki noto'g'ri checksum — bu TSO/GRO/checksum offload, xato emas.</li><li>Bir tomonda autoneg off, boshqasida on — duplex mismatch, juda ko'p xato va sekinlik.</li><li><code>ethtool</code> o'zgarishlari reboot'da yo'qoladi — NetworkManager/systemd-networkd <code>.link</code> fayli bilan doimiy qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tarmoq incident'ida <code>ethtool -S</code>ni ikki marta (oraliq bilan) olib farqini hisobla — mutlaq qiymat emas, o'sish sur'ati muhim. Bu ma'lumotni node_exporter <code>ethtool</code> collector bilan Prometheus'ga chiqar.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41599	<p>MTU mos kelmasligi va IP fragmentatsiya nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har link'ning MTU'si (odatda 1500, jumbo 9000, tunnel'larda kamroq) bor. Paket yo'ldagi MTU'dan katta va <code>DF</code> (Don't Fragment) bit qo'yilgan bo'lsa (TCP'da deyarli doim), router uni tashlab ICMP &quot;Fragmentation Needed&quot; yuboradi. Yuboruvchi Path MTU Discovery orqali kichraytiradi. ICMP firewall'da bloklangan bo'lsa — &quot;PMTU black hole&quot;: ulanish o'rnatiladi, kichik so'rovlar ishlaydi, katta javoblar osilib qoladi.</p><p><b>Real belgilar:</b> <code>ssh</code> ulanadi, lekin <code>ls</code> katta papkada qotadi; <code>curl</code> header oladi, body yo'q; VPN/VXLAN/IPsec ustida TLS handshake osiladi (sertifikat katta).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Host (MTU 1500) --1500B, DF--&gt; Router --&gt; tunnel (MTU 1450)<br>                                  |  sig'maydi, DF bor<br>                                  +--&gt; ICMP type 3 code 4 &quot;need frag, mtu=1450&quot; --&gt; Host<br>ICMP bloklangan:  host bilmaydi -&gt; qayta yuboradi -&gt; yana tushadi -&gt; osiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ping -M do -s 1472 10.0.0.5     # 1472 + 28 header = 1500, DF bilan<br>ping -M do -s 1422 10.0.0.5     # ishlasa - path MTU ~1450<br>tracepath 10.0.0.5              # pmtu ni ko'rsatadi<br>ip link show eth0 | grep mtu<br>ip route get 10.0.0.5           # cache'dagi mtu<br># Yechimlar:<br>sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1450<br>sudo iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu<br>sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1   # black hole'ni o'zi aniqlash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Xavfsizlik uchun&quot; barcha ICMP'ni bloklash — PMTUD buziladi. Kamida type 3 (IPv6'da Packet Too Big) ruxsat berilishi shart.</li><li>Overlay tarmoqlarda (VXLAN +50 bayt, WireGuard +60/80) pod MTU'ni kamaytirmaslik.</li><li>IPv6'da router fragmentatsiya qilmaydi — ICMPv6 bloklash yanada halokatli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> K8s CNI (Calico, Cilium) MTU'ni underlay'ga mos o'rnatish shart; AWS VPC ichida 9001, VPN/internet chiqishida 1500. MSS clamping — tunnel chegarasida eng ishonchli himoya.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41600	<p>Network namespace (<code>ip netns</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Network namespace — kernel'dagi tarmoq stack'ining izolyatsiyalangan nusxasi: o'z interfeyslari, IP manzillari, routing jadvali, iptables/nftables qoidalari, socket'lar va port maydoni. Har Docker container va K8s pod o'z netns'ida yashaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Ikki container ikkalasi ham <code>:80</code> portni tinglay olishi, bir-birining trafigini ko'rmasligi, alohida firewall qoidalariga ega bo'lishi uchun. VM'siz yengil tarmoq izolyatsiyasi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>host netns                          netns &quot;blue&quot;<br>+--------------------+              +-------------------+<br>| eth0 192.168.1.10  |              | lo                |<br>| br0  10.0.0.1 -----+--veth--------+ veth1 10.0.0.2    |<br>| iptables (host)    |              | o'z route, iptables|<br>+--------------------+              +-------------------+</pre><p>Yangi netns'da faqat <code>lo</code> bor (va u ham down) — tashqi dunyoga veth/macvlan orqali ulanadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo ip netns add blue<br>sudo ip link add veth0 type veth peer name veth1<br>sudo ip link set veth1 netns blue<br>sudo ip addr add 10.0.0.1/24 dev veth0 &amp;&amp; sudo ip link set veth0 up<br>sudo ip netns exec blue ip addr add 10.0.0.2/24 dev veth1<br>sudo ip netns exec blue ip link set veth1 up<br>sudo ip netns exec blue ip link set lo up<br>sudo ip netns exec blue ping -c1 10.0.0.1<br># container netns'iga kirish:<br>PID=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' web)<br>sudo nsenter -t $PID -n ss -tlnp<br>lsns -t net</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker netns'lari <code>ip netns list</code>da ko'rinmaydi (<code>/var/run/netns</code>da yo'q) — <code>nsenter</code> ishlat.</li><li>Yangi netns'da <code>lo</code> down — localhost ishlamaydi.</li><li>sysctl'larning bir qismi per-netns (<code>net.ipv4.ip_forward</code>), bir qismi global — container ichidagi sozlama hostga ta'sir qilmaydi yoki aksincha.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container tarmoq muammolarini host'dan <code>nsenter -n</code> bilan, container image'ida tool bo'lmasa ham diagnostika qil (<code>tcpdump</code>, <code>ss</code>). K8s'da pod ichidagi barcha container'lar bitta netns'ni bo'lishadi (pause container).</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41601	<p>Veth qurilma nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> veth (virtual Ethernet) — doim <b>juft</b> yaratiladigan virtual interfeyslar: bir uchiga kirgan paket ikkinchi uchidan chiqadi. Odatda bir uchi container netns'ida (<code>eth0</code>), ikkinchisi host'da bridge'ga ulangan (<code>vethXXXX</code>). Container tarmog'ining &quot;kabeli&quot;.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Network namespace izolyatsiyalangan — undan tashqariga chiqish uchun ikki namespace'ni bog'laydigan nimadir kerak. veth — eng oddiy yo'l.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>container netns            host netns<br>+--------------+           +---------------------------+<br>| eth0 (veth)  |&lt;=========&gt;| veth3a1f -- docker0/cni0  |-- eth0 -&gt; internet<br>| 172.17.0.2   |  juftlik  |  (bridge port)            |   (NAT/iptables)<br>+--------------+           +---------------------------+</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo ip link add vA type veth peer name vB<br>ip link show type veth<br># container eth0 qaysi host veth bilan juft?<br>docker exec web cat /sys/class/net/eth0/iflink    # masalan 27<br>ip -o link | grep '^27:'                          # 27: veth3a1f@if26 ...<br>ip -d link show veth3a1f                          # bridge master'ini ko'rsatadi<br>bridge link                                       # bridge portlari<br>sudo tcpdump -i veth3a1f -n                       # faqat shu container trafigi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir uchi o'chirilsa, ikkinchisi ham yo'qoladi — container o'lganda host veth avtomatik ketadi; &quot;yetim&quot; veth'lar odatda CNI bug.</li><li>veth MTU'si ikki tomonda bir xil bo'lishi kerak, overlay MTU'dan katta bo'lmasligi.</li><li><code>ip link</code> chiqishidagi <code>@ifNN</code> peer'ning <b>boshqa netns'dagi</b> indeksi — host'da shu raqamli interfeysni qidirma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> veth + bridge + iptables NAT oddiy, lekin har paket bir necha qatlamdan o'tadi. Yuqori throughput uchun Cilium eBPF (veth'da <code>bpf_redirect_peer</code>) yoki ipvlan rejimlari overhead'ni kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41602	<p>Linux bridge nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux bridge — kernel ichidagi dasturiy L2 switch. Unga ulangan interfeyslar (veth, tap, fizik NIC) o'rtasida Ethernet frame'larni MAC jadvali (FDB) bo'yicha uzatadi. <code>docker0</code>, <code>cni0</code>, <code>virbr0</code> (libvirt) — bularning hammasi Linux bridge.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Bir host'dagi ko'p container yoki VM bir-biri bilan bitta L2 segmentda gaplashishi va bitta gateway (bridge IP) orqali tashqariga chiqishi uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            +----------- br0 (10.0.0.1) -----------+<br>            |  FDB: MAC aa:.. -&gt; port veth1         |<br>            |       MAC bb:.. -&gt; port veth2         |<br>            +---+-------------+-------------+-------+<br>                |             |             |<br>             veth1         veth2          tap0<br>          (container A) (container B)    (VM)<br>noma'lum MAC -&gt; barcha portlarga flood; o'rganilgach -&gt; faqat kerakli portga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo ip link add br0 type bridge<br>sudo ip link set br0 up<br>sudo ip addr add 10.0.0.1/24 dev br0<br>sudo ip link set veth0 master br0<br>bridge link show                 # portlar<br>bridge fdb show br br0           # o'rganilgan MAC'lar<br>ip -d link show docker0<br>sysctl net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables   # K8s uchun 1 bo'lishi shart</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>br_netfilter</code> moduli yuklanmagan yoki <code>bridge-nf-call-iptables=0</code> — K8s Service (kube-proxy iptables) bir node ichidagi pod'lar o'rtasida ishlamaydi.</li><li>Fizik NIC'ni bridge'ga qo'shganda IP'ni NIC'dan bridge'ga ko'chirmaslik — host tarmoqdan uziladi (masofadan qilsang SSH yo'qoladi).</li><li>STP default o'chiq — bridge'lar halqa hosil qilsa broadcast storm.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bridge oddiy va ishonchli, lekin netfilter bilan birga katta overhead. Yuqori zichlikdagi K8s'da eBPF-asosli CNI'lar bridge'siz routing qiladi. Open vSwitch — SDN (OpenStack) uchun murakkabroq alternativ.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41603	<p>MACVLAN va IPVLAN farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham bitta fizik NIC ustida ko'p virtual interfeys yaratadi, bridge va NAT'siz. <b>MACVLAN</b> — har sub-interfeys o'z <b>MAC</b> va IP manziliga ega (tarmoqda alohida qurilmadek ko'rinadi). <b>IPVLAN</b> — hamma sub-interfeys ota NIC'ning <b>bitta MAC</b>ini bo'lishadi, faqat IP'lar farq qiladi (L2 yoki L3 rejim).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Container'ga fizik tarmoqdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri IP berish (legacy ilovalar, monitoring, DHCP), bridge/NAT overhead'isiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>MACVLAN:                          IPVLAN (L2):<br>eth0 (MAC M0)                     eth0 (MAC M0)<br> |-- mv1 MAC M1, IP .11            |-- ipv1 MAC M0, IP .11<br> |-- mv2 MAC M2, IP .12            |-- ipv2 MAC M0, IP .12<br>switch 3 ta MAC ko'radi           switch 1 ta MAC ko'radi</pre><p>| | MACVLAN | IPVLAN | |---|---|---| | MAC | har biriga alohida | umumiy | | DHCP | oson | qiyin (bir MAC) | | Switch port-security / MAC limit | muammo | muammo yo'q | | Cloud (AWS, Wi-Fi) | ko'pincha ishlamaydi (MAC filtrlash) | ishlaydi | | L3 rejim | yo'q | bor (routing, broadcast yo'q) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo ip link add mv1 link eth0 type macvlan mode bridge<br>sudo ip link add ipv1 link eth0 type ipvlan mode l2<br>docker network create -d macvlan --subnet=192.168.1.0/24 \<br>  --gateway=192.168.1.1 -o parent=eth0 lan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>MACVLAN/IPVLAN'da <b>host va o'z container'lari o'zaro gaplasha olmaydi</b> (ota interfeys orqali) — host'da qo'shimcha macvlan interfeys kerak.</li><li>Wi-Fi va ko'p cloud tarmoqlari noma'lum MAC'larni tashlaydi — MACVLAN ishlamaydi.</li><li>Promiscuous rejim kerak bo'lishi mumkin (VMware'da port group sozlamasi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud'da IPVLAN (AWS VPC CNI'ning ba'zi rejimlari, Cilium) yoki ENI-asosli yechimlar; on-prem'da legacy ilovalarga &quot;haqiqiy&quot; IP kerak bo'lsa MACVLAN. Ikkalasi ham firewall'ni host netfilter'dan chetlab o'tadi — xavfsizlik siyosatini qayta ko'rib chiq.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41604	<p>TUN va TAP qurilmalari farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TUN va TAP — userspace dasturi kernel'ga paket yuborish/olish uchun ochadigan virtual interfeyslar (<code>/dev/net/tun</code> orqali). <b>TUN</b> — L3: IP paketlar bilan ishlaydi. <b>TAP</b> — L2: to'liq Ethernet frame'lar (MAC bilan).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> VPN dasturi shifrlangan trafikni olib, ochib, kernel'ga &quot;tarmoqdan kelgan&quot; IP paket sifatida berishi kerak. VM emulyatori (QEMU) esa virtual NIC uchun to'liq Ethernet frame'larni almashtirishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ilova -&gt; kernel route: 10.8.0.0/24 dev tun0 -&gt; tun0<br>                                                v<br>                        OpenVPN process read(/dev/net/tun) -&gt; IP paket<br>                        shifrlaydi -&gt; UDP socket -&gt; internet<br>QEMU: VM NIC &lt;-&gt; tap0 (Ethernet frame) &lt;-&gt; br0 &lt;-&gt; fizik tarmoq</pre><p>| | TUN | TAP | |---|---|---| | Qatlam | L3 (IP) | L2 (Ethernet) | | Broadcast/ARP | yo'q | bor | | Ishlatuvchilar | OpenVPN (tun), tailscale userspace, wireguard-go | QEMU/KVM, OpenVPN (tap) | | Overhead | kam | ko'proq (frame header) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo ip tuntap add dev tun0 mode tun user $USER<br>sudo ip addr add 10.8.0.1/24 dev tun0 &amp;&amp; sudo ip link set tun0 up<br>sudo ip tuntap add dev tap0 mode tap<br>sudo ip link set tap0 master br0 &amp;&amp; sudo ip link set tap0 up<br>ip tuntap show<br>ls -l /dev/net/tun</pre><p>Container'da VPN uchun: <code>--cap-add=NET_ADMIN --device /dev/net/tun</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kernel WireGuard TUN ishlatmaydi — o'z <code>wireguard</code> interfeys turiga ega (userspace <code>wireguard-go</code> esa TUN ishlatadi).</li><li>TUN orqali har paket kernel &lt;-&gt; userspace nusxasi — yuqori throughput'da CPU sarfi katta.</li><li>K8s pod'da <code>/dev/net/tun</code> default yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Unumdorlik kerak bo'lsa kernel-ichidagi yechim (WireGuard modul, vhost-net KVM uchun) userspace TUN/TAP'dan ancha tez. TAP + bridge — VM'larni haqiqiy L2 tarmoqqa ulashning klassik usuli.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41605	<p>FRRouting (FRR) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> FRRouting (FRR) — Linux uchun ochiq dinamik routing to'plami (Quagga'ning davomchisi): BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RIP, PIM, BFD, EVPN daemon'lari. Linux serverni haqiqiy router'ga aylantiradi: marshrutlarni qo'shnilar bilan almashadi va kernel routing jadvaliga yozadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Statik route'lar katta yoki o'zgaruvchan tarmoqda boshqarib bo'lmaydi. Real holatlar: data center'da L3 leaf-spine (har server BGP gapiradi), anycast servis IP'larini e'lon qilish (DNS, LB), K8s'da pod/Service IP'larni fizik tarmoqqa reklama qilish (MetalLB, Calico, Cilium BGP rejimi ichida shunga o'xshash).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            vtysh (Cisco-ga o'xshash CLI)<br>                 |<br>  bgpd   ospfd   isisd   bfdd<br>     \     |      /<br>       zebra  (RIB: eng yaxshi route'ni tanlaydi)<br>         | netlink<br>         v<br>   kernel FIB (ip route)  ---&gt; paketlar uzatiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># /etc/frr/daemons:  bgpd=yes<br># /etc/frr/frr.conf<br>router bgp 65001<br> bgp router-id 10.0.0.11<br> neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 65000<br> address-family ipv4 unicast<br>  network 192.0.2.10/32          # anycast VIP e'lon qilish<br> exit-address-family</pre><pre>sudo systemctl enable --now frr<br>sudo vtysh -c 'show ip bgp summary'<br>sudo vtysh -c 'show ip route'<br>ip route | grep proto bgp</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kernel'da IP forwarding o'chiq (<code>net.ipv4.ip_forward=0</code>) — route bor, lekin uzatish yo'q.</li><li>Prefix filtr (route-map/prefix-list) qo'ymaslik — butun tarmoqqa noto'g'ri route'larni sizdirish (route leak).</li><li>Health check'siz anycast e'loni — servis o'lgan, lekin trafik baribir shu serverga keladi; BFD va health'ga bog'liq e'lon kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Routing on the host&quot; L2 domenini yo'q qiladi va ECMP orqali masshtablanadi, lekin tarmoq jamoasi bilan ASN rejasi va filtr siyosati kelishilishi shart. Konfigni Git'da saqla va <code>vtysh -C</code> bilan dry-run qil.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41606	<p>TCP SYN cookies algoritmi qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SYN cookies — SYN queue to'lganda kernel yarim ochiq ulanish uchun <b>holat saqlamaydi</b>. Buning o'rniga SYN-ACK'ning boshlang'ich sequence raqamini (ISN) maxfiy kalit, IP/portlar, vaqt hisoblagichi va kodlangan MSS'dan hisoblangan kriptografik hash qilib yuboradi. Client ACK qaytarganda (<code>ack - 1</code>) shu qiymat qayta tekshiriladi va ulanish faqat shunda yaratiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo — SYN flood:</b> Hujumchi soxta IP'lardan millionlab SYN yuboradi va handshake'ni tugatmaydi. Har biri SYN queue'da joy egallaydi; queue to'lgach, haqiqiy userlar ulana olmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy:     SYN -&gt; [SYN queue'da yozuv] -&gt; SYN-ACK -&gt; ACK -&gt; accept queue<br>SYN cookie:SYN -&gt; (queue to'la) -&gt; ISN = hash(secret, saddr, sport, daddr, dport, t) + MSS kodi<br>                  SYN-ACK(seq=ISN)  -- hech narsa saqlanmaydi<br>           ACK(ack=ISN+1) -&gt; hash qayta hisoblanadi -&gt; mos -&gt; ulanish yaratiladi<br>           soxta IP ACK yubormaydi -&gt; resurs sarflanmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies          # 1 = faqat queue to'lganda (default, tavsiya)<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog<br>nstat -az | grep -i -E 'SyncookiesSent|SyncookiesRecv|SyncookiesFailed|ListenDrops|ListenOverflows'<br>dmesg | grep -i &quot;possible SYN flooding&quot;<br>ss -ltn                                  # Recv-Q (accept queue) / Send-Q (backlog)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cookie'da faqat bir nechta MSS qiymati kodlanadi; eski kernel'larda window scaling/SACK yo'qolardi (TCP timestamp yoqilgan bo'lsa saqlanadi) — throughput pasayishi mumkin.</li><li><code>tcp_syncookies=2</code> (doim) — normal holatda ham opsiyalarni cheklaydi.</li><li>&quot;possible SYN flooding&quot; ko'pincha hujum emas, ilova <code>accept()</code>ni sekin chaqirishi yoki kichik <code>listen()</code> backlog'i (<code>somaxconn</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SYN cookies — oxirgi himoya chizig'i, katta DDoS'ni to'xtatmaydi; bandwidth darajasidagi hujumlarga upstream scrubbing (Cloudflare, AWS Shield) kerak. <code>ListenOverflows</code> o'sayotgan bo'lsa avval ilova va backlog'ni tekshir.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41607	<p>TCP Fast Open (<code>tcp_fastopen=3</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP Fast Open (TFO, RFC 7413) — oldin ulangan client serverdan olgan cookie bilan keyingi safar ma'lumotni birinchi <code>SYN</code> ichida yuboradi; server cookie'ni tekshirib, ma'lumotni handshake tugashidan oldin ilovaga beradi. Natija — qisqa ulanishlarda bitta RTT tejaladi. <code>net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen=3</code> — client va server tomonda yoqish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har yangi TCP ulanish so'rov yuborishdan oldin 1 RTT handshake talab qiladi. Uzoq masofali (200 ms RTT) mobil tarmoqlarda qisqa so'rovlar uchun bu sezilarli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1-ulanish:  SYN + &quot;cookie bering&quot; -&gt; SYN-ACK + cookie -&gt; ACK -&gt; data   (oddiy)<br>Keyingilar: SYN + cookie + DATA   -&gt; server darhol ilovaga DATA beradi<br>            SYN-ACK + javob DATA  -&gt; 1 RTT tejaldi</pre><p>Qiymatlar: <code>1</code> client, <code>2</code> server, <code>3</code> ikkalasi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen=3<br>nstat -az | grep -i fastopen         # TcpExtTCPFastOpenActive, ...Passive, ...Fail</pre><pre>listen 443 ssl fastopen=256;   # server tomonda TFO queue</pre><pre>setsockopt(fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_FASTOPEN, &amp;qlen, sizeof(qlen));  // server<br>sendto(fd, buf, len, MSG_FASTOPEN, addr, alen);                  // client</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SYN'dagi ma'lumot <b>qayta o'ynalishi (replay)</b> mumkin — faqat idempotent so'rovlar uchun xavfsiz (TLS 1.3 0-RTT bilan bir xil muammo).</li><li>Middlebox/firewall'lar data'li SYN'ni tashlaydi — kernel fallback qiladi, lekin vaqt yo'qoladi; amalda TFO internetda keng tarqalmadi.</li><li>Brauzerlar (Chrome) TFO'ni o'chirgan; zamonaviy alternativ — QUIC/HTTP/3 (0-RTT o'zida).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ichki data center trafigida foyda kichik (RTT &lt; 1 ms). Latency'ni kamaytirishning amaliy yo'li — connection pooling/keep-alive va HTTP/2/3; TFO esa niche optimizatsiya.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41608	<p>TCP SACK va D-SACK nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>SACK</b> (Selective ACK, RFC 2018) — qabul qiluvchi qaysi segment bloklari kelganini aniq aytadi (&quot;1-1000 va 3001-5000 bor&quot;), shuning uchun yuboruvchi faqat yo'qolgan qismni qayta yuboradi. <b>D-SACK</b> (RFC 2883) — qabul qiluvchi <b>dublikat</b> segment olganini bildiradi; yuboruvchi keraksiz retransmit qilganini tushunib, algoritmini moslaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy cumulative ACK faqat &quot;1000 gacha hammasi bor&quot; deydi. Bir oynada bir nechta paket yo'qolsa, yuboruvchi ularni birma-bir RTT bilan topadi yoki hammasini qayta yuboradi — yuqori latency va bandwidth isrofi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Yuborildi: [1][2][3][4][5]   3-chi yo'qoldi<br>ACK oddiy: ack=3, ack=3, ack=3 (dup ACK'lar)<br>ACK+SACK:  ack=3, SACK=4-5   -&gt; yuboruvchi faqat [3] ni qayta yuboradi<br>D-SACK:    [3] ikki marta keldi -&gt; SACK blok ack'dan oldingi diapazonni ko'rsatadi<br>           -&gt; &quot;qayta yuborish shart emas edi&quot; (reordering, kech ACK)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_sack net.ipv4.tcp_dsack     # default 1<br>nstat -az | grep -E 'TCPSACKRecovery|TCPDSACKRecv|TCPSACKReorder|TcpRetransSegs'<br>sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -nn 'tcp[tcpflags] &amp; tcp-ack != 0' -v | grep -i sack<br>ss -ti dst 10.0.0.5        # retrans, sacked, reordering</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>2019 &quot;SACK Panic&quot; (CVE-2019-11477) — vaqtinchalik <code>tcp_sack=0</code> qilingan; patch'langan kernel'da qayta yoqish kerak, aks holda yo'qotishli tarmoqda throughput tushadi.</li><li>Ba'zi eski firewall'lar sequence randomization qilib SACK bloklarini buzadi — g'alati retransmit'lar.</li><li>Ko'p D-SACK — tarmoqda reordering yoki juda agressiv RTO belgisi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SACK'ni o'chirish deyarli hech qachon to'g'ri emas. D-SACK va reordering hisoblagichlari — ECMP/bonding bilan bog'liq paket tartibsizligini topishning arzon usuli.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41609	<p>TCP CUBIC va BBR farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>CUBIC</b> — Linux default congestion control; paket yo'qotishini tiqilinch signali deb hisoblaydi va yo'qotishda oynani keskin qisqartiradi. <b>BBR</b> (Google) — yo'qotishga emas, o'lchangan bottleneck bandwidth va minimal RTT modeliga asoslanadi; yo'qotishli yoki uzun (yuqori BDP) tarmoqlarda ancha yuqori throughput va pastroq navbat kechikishi beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Uzoq masofali yoki Wi-Fi/mobil tarmoqlarda tasodifiy 1% paket yo'qotish tiqilinch emas, lekin CUBIC uni shunday talqin qilib tezlikni o'ldiradi. Bundan tashqari, CUBIC router buferlarini to'ldiradi (bufferbloat).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CUBIC:  cwnd ^    /\      /\      /\        yo'qotish -&gt; *0.7, keyin cubic o'sish<br>             |   /  \    /  \    /  \       buferlar to'ladi -&gt; RTT oshadi<br>             +------------------------&gt;<br><br>BBR:    pacing_rate = BtlBw * gain ; inflight ~ BtlBw * RTprop<br>        davriy ravishda bandwidth'ni &quot;probe&quot; qiladi, buferni to'ldirmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_available_congestion_control<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control       # cubic<br>sudo modprobe tcp_bbr<br>cat &lt;&lt;EOF | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/90-bbr.conf<br>net.core.default_qdisc = fq<br>net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control = bbr<br>EOF<br>sudo sysctl --system<br>ss -ti | grep -o 'bbr\|cubic' | sort | uniq -c</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>BBRv1 CUBIC oqimlari bilan bir linkda adolatsiz bo'lishi va yuqori yo'qotishda agressiv retransmit qilishi mumkin; BBRv3 buni yaxshilaydi, lekin hali mainline'da default emas.</li><li>Eski kernel'larda (&lt;4.13) BBR <code>fq</code> qdisc'siz pacing qilmaydi.</li><li>Congestion control faqat <b>yuboruvchi</b> tomonda ta'sir qiladi — download tezligini client'da BBR yoqib oshira olmaysan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CDN, video streaming, uzoq masofali replikatsiya (cross-region) uchun BBR katta yutuq; data center ichida (past RTT, kam yo'qotish) farq kichik — DCTCP kabi alternativlar ham bor. O'zgarishni A/B o'lchov bilan qil.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41610	<p><code>SO_BINDTODEVICE</code> socket opsiyasi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>SO_BINDTODEVICE</code> — socket'ni aniq tarmoq interfeysiga (<code>eth1</code>, <code>wg0</code>, VRF device) bog'laydi: socket faqat shu interfeys orqali yuboradi va qabul qiladi, umumiy routing qaroridan qat'i nazar. Root yoki <code>CAP_NET_RAW</code> kerak edi (5.7+ dan, interfeys allaqachon bog'lanmagan bo'lsa, yengillashtirilgan).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Multi-homed serverda (masalan, management va data tarmoqlari) DHCP server faqat ichki interfeysda javob berishi, monitoring agenti faqat management VLAN'dan chiqishi, yoki ilova VRF ichida ishlashi kerak bo'lganda. Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41611	<p><code>TCP_NODELAY</code> (Nagle algoritmini o'chirish) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>TCP_NODELAY</code> — socket opsiyasi bo'lib, Nagle algoritmini o'chiradi: kichik yozuvlar ACK kutilmasdan darhol paket sifatida yuboriladi. Past latency kerak bo'lgan RPC, interaktiv protokollar, o'yin, trading uchun zarur. Ko'p zamonaviy runtime'lar (Go <code>net</code>, Node.js 18+ HTTP) uni default yoqadi.</p><p><b>Muammo — Nagle + delayed ACK:</b> Nagle: &quot;oldingi kichik paket ACK'lanmaguncha yangisini yubormay, yig'aman&quot;. Qabul qiluvchi esa delayed ACK bilan 40 ms (Linux) gacha kutadi. Natijada &quot;write-write-read&quot; pattern'ida har so'rov ~40 ms &quot;jumboq&quot; kechikish oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Nagle yoqilgan:<br> client: write(header 50B) -&gt; yuborildi<br>         write(body 30B)   -&gt; KUTADI (unacked data bor)<br> server: delayed ACK ... 40 ms ... ACK<br> client: endi body yuboriladi   =&gt; +40 ms har so'rovda<br>TCP_NODELAY: ikkalasi darhol ketadi (lekin 2 ta kichik paket)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>int one = 1;<br>setsockopt(fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, &amp;one, sizeof(one));</pre><pre>conn.(*net.TCPConn).SetNoDelay(true)   // Go'da default allaqachon true</pre><pre>ss -tni | grep -i nodelay         # yo'q - strace bilan tekshir:<br>strace -e setsockopt -f -p &lt;PID&gt;</pre><p>nginx: <code>tcp_nodelay on;</code> (keep-alive ulanishlar uchun default).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NODELAY bilan ko'p mayda <code>write()</code> — har biri alohida paket, bandwidth va CPU isrofi. Yechim: yozuvlarni buferda yig'ib, bitta <code>write</code>/<code>writev</code> qil.</li><li>40 ms &quot;sirli&quot; latency'ni ilova kodida qidirish — aslida Nagle/delayed ACK o'zaro ta'siri.</li><li>Opsiya socket'ga bog'liq, global sysctl yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> To'g'ri pattern: NODELAY yoqilgan + ilova o'zi batch qiladi (buffered writer, <code>writev</code>). Shunda ham latency, ham samaradorlik bo'ladi. Latency spike'lar aniq 40/200 ms karrali bo'lsa — birinchi gumon Nagle.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41612	<p><code>TCP_CORK</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>TCP_CORK</code> — socket'ni &quot;tiqin&quot; bilan yopadi: yozilgan ma'lumot to'liq MSS hajmdagi segment yig'ilguncha (yoki tiqin olinguncha, yoki 200 ms o'tguncha) yuborilmaydi. Header + fayl tanasini bitta to'liq paketlarda yuborish uchun — throughput'ni maksimal qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Web server avval HTTP header'ni (300 B) yozadi, keyin <code>sendfile()</code> bilan faylni yuboradi. Corksiz header alohida kichik paket bo'lib ketadi — paket soni va overhead ortadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>setsockopt(CORK=1)<br>write(header 300B)      -&gt; kutadi<br>sendfile(file 1 MB)     -&gt; header + fayl boshi bitta to'liq MSS segmentga birlashadi<br>setsockopt(CORK=0)      -&gt; qolgan qisman segment darhol yuboriladi</pre><p>| | TCP_NODELAY | TCP_CORK | |---|---|---| | Maqsad | latency | throughput | | Kichik yozuvlar | darhol | yig'iladi | | Kim boshqaradi | kernel (darhol yubor) | ilova (tiqin qo'y/ol) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>int on = 1, off = 0;<br>setsockopt(fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_CORK, &amp;on, sizeof(on));<br>write(fd, hdr, hdr_len);<br>sendfile(fd, filefd, &amp;off_t_var, size);<br>setsockopt(fd, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_CORK, &amp;off, sizeof(off));   // flush</pre><p>nginx: <code>sendfile on; tcp_nopush on;</code> — <code>tcp_nopush</code> Linux'da aynan <code>TCP_CORK</code>. Ko'p &quot;tasodifiy timeout&quot; incident'lari shu ikki grafikdan bir daqiqada topiladi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage

Imzo kalitini HSM'da saqla va DKMS jarayonini avtomatlashtir, aks holda kernel update'dan keyin node'lar ishlamay qoladi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41616	<p>Kernel lockdown rejimi (<code>integrity</code> va <code>confidentiality</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kernel lockdown (5.4+ LSM) — root'ning ishlab turgan kernel'ni o'zgartirish imkoniyatlarini cheklaydi. <b>integrity</b> rejimi kernel kodini/xotirasini o'zgartiradigan narsalarni bloklaydi: <code>/dev/mem</code>, <code>/dev/kmem</code>, imzosiz modul, imzosiz <code>kexec</code>, MSR yozish, ba'zi ACPI/PCI BAR kirishlar, hibernation. <b>confidentiality</b> — qo'shimcha ravishda kernel xotirasini <b>o'qish</b>ni ham taqiqlaydi (<code>/proc/kcore</code>, ba'zi BPF/perf o'qishlari).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Secure Boot &quot;boot zanjiri ishonchli&quot; deb kafolat beradi. Lekin root boot'dan keyin kernel xotirasini o'zgartira olsa, bu kafolat ma'nosiz. Lockdown &quot;root != kernel&quot; chegarasini yaratadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>UEFI Secure Boot -&gt; imzolangan shim/GRUB -&gt; imzolangan kernel<br>                                                 v<br>                        lockdown=integrity (ko'p distro'larda SB bilan avtomatik)<br>root: insmod imzosiz.ko         -&gt; RAD<br>root: dd if=/dev/mem            -&gt; RAD<br>root: kexec imzosiz kernel      -&gt; RAD<br>root: bpf_probe_write_user      -&gt; RAD<br>confidentiality: /proc/kcore o'qish -&gt; RAD</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/kernel/security/lockdown<br># none [integrity] confidentiality<br>dmesg | grep -i lockdown<br># &quot;Lockdown: insmod: unsigned module loading is restricted; see man kernel_lockdown.7&quot;<br># yoqish: kernel cmdline  lockdown=integrity  (runtime'da faqat kuchaytirish mumkin)<br>echo confidentiality | sudo tee /sys/kernel/security/lockdown</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lockdown'ni runtime'da o'chirib bo'lmaydi — faqat reboot va cmdline.</li><li><code>confidentiality</code> ba'zi eBPF tracing va debug tool'larini (kprobe o'qishlari, <code>crash</code>) ishdan chiqaradi.</li><li>Ba'zi hardware tuning tool'lari (MSR yozish, <code>ioperm</code>) ishlamay qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p distro Secure Boot bilan <code>integrity</code>ni avtomatik yoqadi — hardware tuning yoki imzosiz modul ishlatayotgan bo'lsang oldindan test qil. <code>confidentiality</code> — yuqori xavfsizlik muhiti uchun, observability'dan voz kechish narxi bilan.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41617	<p>KASLR nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> KASLR (Kernel Address Space Layout Randomization) — har boot'da kernel kodi, modullar va ba'zi ma'lumot hududlari (direct map, vmalloc, vmemmap) virtual manzillarini tasodifiy siljitadi. Natijada exploit yozuvchi kerakli funksiya yoki gadget manzilini oldindan bila olmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kernel'da memory corruption bug topilsa ham, uni ishlatish uchun (ROP zanjiri, <code>commit_creds</code> manzili) aniq manzillar kerak. KASLRsiz ular har mashinada bir xil — exploit universal bo'lardi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>KASLRsiz:   _text = 0xffffffff81000000 (har doim)<br>KASLR bilan: boot1: 0xffffffff9a200000<br>             boot2: 0xffffffffb4600000<br>exploit avval manzil &quot;sizib chiqishi&quot; (info leak) ni topishi kerak</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /proc/cmdline | grep -o nokaslr      # bo'lsa - o'chirilgan<br>sudo grep ' _text$' /proc/kallsyms       # root haqiqiy manzilni ko'radi<br>grep ' _text$' /proc/kallsyms            # oddiy user: 0000000000000000<br>sysctl kernel.kptr_restrict              # 1 yoki 2 - manzillarni yashirish<br>sysctl kernel.dmesg_restrict             # 1 - dmesg'dan manzil sizishini oldini olish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>KASLR'ning himoyasi info leak'lar bilan osongina buziladi: <code>/proc/kallsyms</code>, dmesg'dagi pointer'lar, side-channel'lar (Meltdown/EntryBleed). Shuning uchun <code>kptr_restrict</code> va <code>dmesg_restrict</code> birga kerak.</li><li>Entropiya cheklangan (x86-64'da kernel matni uchun ~9 bit) — yagona himoya emas.</li><li>Debug yoki crash tahlilida <code>nokaslr</code> qo'yib, prod'da qoldirib ketish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> KASLR — defense-in-depth qatlami, o'zi yetarli emas. U bilan birga: SMEP/SMAP, KPTI, CFI, <code>kptr_restrict=1</code>, unprivileged BPF/userns'ni cheklash va eng muhimi — muntazam kernel patch.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41618	<p>Seccomp-BPF arxitekturasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Seccomp-BPF — process o'zi (yoki runtime uning nomidan) syscall filtrini o'rnatadi: classic BPF dasturi. Har syscall'da kernel shu dasturni syscall raqami, arxitektura va argumentlar (faqat registrdagi qiymatlar, pointer orqasidagi ma'lumot emas) bo'yicha bajaradi va qaror qaytaradi: <code>ALLOW</code>, <code>ERRNO</code>, <code>KILL_PROCESS</code>, <code>TRAP</code>, <code>LOG</code>, <code>USER_NOTIF</code>. Filtr meros qilinadi va olib tashlanmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kernel 400+ syscall taqdim etadi; oddiy web ilovaga ularning 50-60 tasi yetarli. Qolganlari (masalan <code>keyctl</code>, <code>bpf</code>, <code>unshare</code>, <code>ptrace</code>) — kernel exploit'lari uchun hujum yuzasi. Seccomp uni qisqartiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ilova -&gt; syscall(nr, args) -&gt; seccomp hook (syscall'dan OLDIN)<br>                                  v<br>                    BPF: arch tekshir -&gt; nr bo'yicha jadval -&gt; qaror<br>                       |-- ALLOW        -&gt; oddiy bajarish<br>                       |-- ERRNO(EPERM) -&gt; syscall bajarilmaydi<br>                       +-- KILL_PROCESS -&gt; SIGSYS bilan o'ldiriladi<br>o'rnatish: prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS) + seccomp(SECCOMP_SET_MODE_FILTER, prog)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>grep Seccomp /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/status          # 0 yo'q, 1 strict, 2 filter<br>docker run --security-opt seccomp=profile.json ...<br>docker info | grep -i seccomp</pre><pre># K8s pod<br>securityContext:<br>  seccompProfile:<br>    type: RuntimeDefault</pre><pre># systemd<br>SystemCallFilter=@system-service<br>SystemCallArchitectures=native</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Arch tekshiruvini unutish — 32-bit (<code>int 0x80</code>) syscall raqamlari boshqacha, filtr chetlab o'tiladi.</li><li>Pointer argumentlarni (fayl yo'li) tekshirib bo'lmaydi — TOCTOU; fayl siyosati uchun Landlock/LSM kerak.</li><li>Juda qattiq profil — glibc yangilanganda yangi syscall (<code>clone3</code>, <code>rseq</code>) <code>EPERM</code> bilan sinadi; <code>ERRNO(ENOSYS)</code> qaytarish fallback imkonini beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> K8s'da <code>RuntimeDefault</code>ni hamma joyda yoqish — eng arzon xavfsizlik yutug'i (Docker default profili ~44 xavfli syscall'ni bloklaydi). Maxsus profilni <code>strace -c</code>/<code>Security Profiles Operator</code> bilan yozib ol, qo'lda emas.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41619	<p>Landlock LSM nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Landlock (5.13+) — <b>imtiyozsiz</b> process o'zini sandbox qilishiga imkon beradigan stackable LSM. Ilova &quot;men faqat <code>/var/lib/app</code> ga yozaman, <code>/etc</code>dan o'qiyman, faqat 443 portga ulanaman&quot; deb qoidalar to'plamini (ruleset) yaratadi va o'ziga qo'llaydi; keyin bu cheklovni olib tashlab bo'lmaydi va child'larga meros o'tadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> SELinux/AppArmor siyosatlarini admin yozadi va root kerak. Landlock'da dasturchi o'z ilovasini ichidan cheklaydi — masalan, PDF parser buzilsa ham u SSH kalitlarini o'qiy olmaydi. Seccomp syscall'larni cheklaydi, lekin &quot;qaysi fayl&quot; degan savolga javob bera olmaydi — Landlock aynan shu bo'shliqni yopadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ruleset = landlock_create_ruleset(handled: READ_FILE, WRITE_FILE, ..., TCP_CONNECT)<br>landlock_add_rule(ruleset, PATH_BENEATH, &quot;/var/lib/app&quot;, READ|WRITE)<br>landlock_add_rule(ruleset, NET_PORT, 443, CONNECT_TCP)      # ABI 4+ (6.7)<br>prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS) ; landlock_restrict_self(ruleset)<br>-&gt; endi open(&quot;/home/user/.ssh/id_rsa&quot;) = EACCES</pre><p>Har yangi kernel ABI versiyasini oshiradi (fayl truncate, network, IPC scoping).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/kernel/security/lsm               # ro'yxatda &quot;landlock&quot; bormi<br>dmesg | grep -i landlock<br># Tayyor wrapper'lar:<br>landrun --rox /usr --rw /tmp -- ./app      # (community tool)</pre><pre># systemd o'zining shunga o'xshash direktivalari (mount namespace orqali):<br>ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/app</pre><p>Go: <code>github.com/landlock-lsm/go-landlock</code>; Rust: <code>landlock</code> crate.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski kernel'da ABI past — kod &quot;best effort&quot; rejimda ishlashi va qo'llab-quvvatlanmagan huquqlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirishi kerak.</li><li>Ba'zi distro'larda LSM ro'yxatida yoqilmagan (<code>lsm=</code> cmdline).</li><li>Qoidalar ochilgandan keyin — allaqachon ochiq FD'lar cheklanmaydi; sandbox'ni iloji boricha erta qo'lla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Untrusted ma'lumotni parse qiladigan komponentlar (fayl konvertor, image processing, plugin'lar) uchun Landlock + seccomp kombinatsiyasi — eng kam xarajatli &quot;least privilege&quot;. Bu defense-in-depth, LSM siyosatini almashtirmaydi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41620	<p>IMA (Integrity Measurement Architecture) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> IMA (Integrity Measurement Architecture) — kernel subsistemasi: fayl (executable, kutubxona, modul, firmware) bajarilish yoki o'qilishdan oldin uning hash'ini <b>o'lchaydi</b> (measure) va ro'yxatga yozadi (TPM PCR 10 ga extend), siyosat bo'yicha esa saqlangan imzo/hash bilan <b>tekshiradi</b> (appraise) — mos kelmasa bajarishni bloklaydi. EVM esa fayl metadata'sini (xattr) himoya qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Secure Boot boot zanjirini himoya qiladi, lekin boot'dan keyin <code>/usr/bin/sshd</code> almashtirilsa — u bilmaydi. IMA runtime'da fayl butunligini nazorat qiladi va masofaviy attestation uchun dalil beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>execve(&quot;/usr/bin/app&quot;)<br>   v<br>IMA policy: bu fayl tekshiriladimi?<br>   |-- measure  -&gt; sha256 -&gt; /sys/kernel/security/ima/ascii_runtime_measurements<br>   |               + TPM PCR10 extend (o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan jurnal)<br>   +-- appraise -&gt; security.ima xattr (hash yoki imzo) bilan solishtir<br>                   mos emas -&gt; EACCES, bajarilmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/kernel/security/ima/policy 2&gt;/dev/null<br>sudo head /sys/kernel/security/ima/ascii_runtime_measurements<br># 10 &lt;template-hash&gt; ima-ng sha256:&lt;file-hash&gt; /usr/bin/bash<br>getfattr -m security.ima -d /usr/bin/bash<br># kernel cmdline: ima_policy=tcb ima_appraise=enforce<br>evmctl ima_sign --key /etc/keys/ima.key /usr/local/bin/app</pre><p>RHEL 9 RPM'lari IMA imzolari bilan keladi (<code>rpm-plugin-ima</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ima_appraise=enforce</code>ni imzosiz fayllar bilan yoqish — tizim boot bo'lmaydi; avval <code>fix</code>/<code>log</code> rejimida sinab ko'r.</li><li>Measurement ro'yxati faqat yoziladi — uni hech kim tekshirmasa (remote attestation yo'q) foyda kam.</li><li>Har fayl uchun hash hisoblash — boot va exec'da qo'shimcha overhead.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> IMA + TPM + Keylime kabi attestation servisi — &quot;bu node haqiqatan ham biz bilgan software'ni ishlatyaptimi?&quot; savoliga kriptografik javob; telecom, edge va confidential computing'da talab qilinadi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41621	<p>TPM 2.0 va measured boot nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TPM 2.0 — anakart yoki CPU (fTPM) ichidagi xavfsizlik chipi: kalitlar yaratadi va saqlaydi, PCR (Platform Configuration Register)larga ega. <b>Measured boot</b> — har boot bosqichi (UEFI firmware, Secure Boot sozlamalari, shim/GRUB, kernel, initrd) keyingi bosqich hash'ini PCR'ga &quot;extend&quot; qiladi. Disk kalitini PCR qiymatlariga <b>seal</b> qilsang, TPM uni faqat aynan shu boot zanjirida beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Disk shifrlangan bo'lsa ham, har boot'da parol kiritish serverlar uchun amaliy emas. TPM parolsiz ochadi, lekin faqat ishonchli holatda: kimdir bootloader'ni almashtirsa yoki diskni boshqa mashinaga olib ketsa — kalit chiqmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PCR_new = SHA256(PCR_old || hash(keyingi komponent))   &lt;- faqat extend, reset yo'q<br>UEFI    -&gt; PCR0 (firmware), PCR7 (Secure Boot siyosati)<br>GRUB    -&gt; PCR4/8/9 (bootloader, cmdline, fayllar)<br>kernel  -&gt; PCR9/11 (UKI, systemd-stub)<br>unseal(LUKS key, policy: PCR7+PCR11 = kutilgan) -&gt; mos -&gt; kalit; aks holda rad</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls /dev/tpm0 /dev/tpmrm0<br>systemd-analyze has-tpm2<br>sudo tpm2_pcrread sha256:0,7,11<br># LUKS kalitini TPM'ga bog'lash (systemd 248+):<br>sudo systemd-cryptenroll --tpm2-device=auto --tpm2-pcrs=7 /dev/nvme0n1p3<br># /etc/crypttab:  root  UUID=...  none  tpm2-device=auto<br>sudo cryptsetup luksDump /dev/nvme0n1p3 | grep -A3 systemd-tpm2</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Firmware/kernel/GRUB yangilanishi PCR qiymatlarini o'zgartiradi -&gt; keyingi boot'da disk ochilmaydi. Recovery kalitini saqla, PCR7 (+ imzolangan PCR11 siyosati) kabi barqaror registrlarni tanla.</li><li>TPM'siz yoki faqat TPM bilan (PIN'siz) — o'g'irlangan noutbukda ham avtomatik ochiladi, agar boot zanjiri o'zgartirilmagan bo'lsa (cold boot/sniffing hujumlari mavjud).</li><li>TPM 1.2 va 2.0 API'lari mos emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Serverlar flotida TPM-seal + Tang (NBDE) yoki markaziy recovery key escrow birga ishlatiladi. Kernel update pipeline'ida PCR o'zgarishini hisobga olish (imzolangan PCR policy, <code>systemd-pcrlock</code>) — aks holda yangilanish butun flotni qotiradi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41622	<p>LUKS va <code>cryptsetup</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LUKS (Linux Unified Key Setup) — Linux'da blok qurilmani to'liq shifrlash standarti; <code>dm-crypt</code> ustida ishlaydi. Ma'lumot master key bilan (odatda AES-XTS 512-bit) shifrlanadi, master key esa header'dagi <b>key slot</b>larda parol/kalit fayl/TPM bilan o'ralgan holda saqlanadi. <code>cryptsetup</code> — boshqaruv tool'i. LUKS2 — zamonaviy format (Argon2id KDF, JSON metadata, token'lar).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Disk o'g'irlansa, utilizatsiya qilinsa yoki cloud snapshot sizib chiqsa — ma'lumot o'qib bo'lmaydigan bo'lishi kerak (GDPR, PCI DSS, HIPAA). Bir nechta key slot — parolni master key'ni o'zgartirmasdan, ya'ni diskni qayta shifrlamasdan almashtirish imkoni.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>+--------------------------- LUKS2 header ---------------------------+<br>| slot 0: Argon2id(parol)  -&gt; o'ralgan master key                     |<br>| slot 1: keyfile          -&gt; o'ralgan master key                     |<br>| token : systemd-tpm2 / clevis                                       |<br>+---------------------------------------------------------------------+<br>| shifrlangan ma'lumot (AES-XTS, master key bilan)                    |<br>+---------------------------------------------------------------------+<br>ochish -&gt; /dev/mapper/data (oddiy blok qurilma) -&gt; mkfs / mount</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 /dev/sdb      # BARCHA DATA O'CHADI<br>sudo cryptsetup open /dev/sdb data<br>sudo mkfs.xfs /dev/mapper/data &amp;&amp; sudo mount /dev/mapper/data /data<br>sudo cryptsetup luksDump /dev/sdb                     # slot'lar, cipher, KDF<br>sudo cryptsetup luksAddKey /dev/sdb                   # yangi parol<br>sudo cryptsetup luksKillSlot /dev/sdb 1<br>sudo cryptsetup luksHeaderBackup /dev/sdb --header-backup-file sdb-hdr.img<br>sudo cryptsetup close data<br># /etc/crypttab:  data  UUID=...  /etc/keys/data.key  luks</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Header buzilsa — ma'lumot butunlay yo'qoladi. <code>luksHeaderBackup</code> ni xavfsiz joyda saqla.</li><li>Ochilgan (mount qilingan) disk ishlab turgan tizimda himoyalanmagan — LUKS &quot;at rest&quot; himoyasi, root kompromisiga qarshi emas.</li><li>Parolni o'zgartirish master key'ni o'zgartirmaydi; master key sizgan bo'lsa <code>cryptsetup reencrypt</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SSD'da <code>discard</code> yoqish TRIM tufayli qaysi blok bo'shligini sizdiradi — odatda qabul qilinadigan trade-off. Cloud'da ko'pincha provider KMS shifrlash yetarli; LUKS esa &quot;provider kalitga ega bo'lmasin&quot; talabi bo'lganda.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41623	<p>Clevis va Tang (NBDE) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> NBDE (Network-Bound Disk Encryption): <b>Clevis</b> — client tomondagi framework, LUKS kalitini &quot;pin&quot;larga bog'laydi (<code>tang</code>, <code>tpm2</code>, <code>sss</code>). <b>Tang</b> — kichik, holatsiz server. Boot'da Clevis Tang bilan McCallum-Relyea (ECDH asosidagi) almashinuvini qilib kalitni tiklaydi — parol so'ramaydi. Tang hech qachon client kalitini ko'rmaydi va saqlamaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Data center'dagi yuzlab shifrlangan server reboot bo'lganda kimdir har biriga konsoldan parol kiritishi kerak. NBDE: server ishonchli ichki tarmoqda bo'lsa — avtomatik ochiladi; disk yoki server o'g'irlansa (Tang'ga yetib bo'lmaydi) — ochilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>boot -&gt; initramfs -&gt; clevis: LUKS token'dan tang URL + metadata<br>           |  network up (rd.neednet=1)<br>           v<br>       Tang server (ichki tarmoq) &lt;-- blinded ECDH so'rov<br>           |  javob (kalitni bilmasdan)<br>           v<br>       clevis kalitni tiklaydi -&gt; LUKS ochiladi -&gt; boot davom etadi<br>sss pin: &quot;2 dan 1&quot;: tang1 YOKI tang2 ; yoki &quot;tang VA tpm2&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Tang server<br>sudo dnf install tang &amp;&amp; sudo systemctl enable --now tangd.socket<br># Client<br>sudo dnf install clevis clevis-luks clevis-dracut<br>sudo clevis luks bind -d /dev/sda3 tang '{&quot;url&quot;:&quot;http://tang.internal&quot;}'<br>sudo clevis luks bind -d /dev/sda3 sss \<br>  '{&quot;t&quot;:1,&quot;pins&quot;:{&quot;tang&quot;:[{&quot;url&quot;:&quot;http://tang1&quot;},{&quot;url&quot;:&quot;http://tang2&quot;}]}}'<br>sudo clevis luks list -d /dev/sda3<br>sudo dracut -fv --regenerate-all          # initramfs'ga tarmoq + clevis</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tang server(lar) o'chsa hech bir server boot bo'lmaydi — kamida 2 ta Tang (<code>sss</code>) va parol slot'ini zahirada saqla.</li><li>Initramfs'da tarmoq sozlanmagan (statik IP, VLAN, bond) — Clevis Tang'ga yeta olmaydi.</li><li>Tang kalitlarini rotatsiya qilgach clientlarni <code>clevis luks regen</code> qilmaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tang + TPM kombinatsiyasi (<code>sss</code> t=2) — disk ham, server ham, tarmoq ham to'g'ri bo'lgandagina ochiladi. Tang'ni cheklangan segmentda, monitoring bilan joylashtir — u ham kritik infratuzilma.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41624	<p>systemd servis sandboxing direktivalari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> systemd unit faylida <code>[Service]</code> bo'limidagi direktivalar servisni namespace, capability, seccomp va cgroup orqali izolyatsiya qiladi — kodni o'zgartirmasdan. <code>systemd-analyze security &lt;unit&gt;</code> 0 dan 10 gacha &quot;exposure&quot; bahosi beradi (past = yaxshi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Default servis root sifatida butun fayl tizimini ko'radi va yoza oladi. Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41625	<p>systemd socket activation nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Socket activation — systemd <code>.socket</code> unit orqali portni (yoki unix socket'ni) o'zi ochib tinglaydi. Birinchi ulanish kelganda mos <code>.service</code>ni ishga tushiradi va tayyor, allaqachon tinglayotgan socket FD'sini unga beradi (<code>LISTEN_FDS</code>, <code>sd_listen_fds()</code>). Servis restart bo'lsa ham socket ochiq qoladi — yangi ulanishlar kernel navbatida kutadi, yo'qolmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b></p><ul><li>On-demand: kam ishlatiladigan servis (cups, sshd ba'zi distro'larda) xotira sarflamaydi.</li><li>Parallel boot: servislar bir-biri tayyor bo'lishini kutmaydi — socket mavjud, so'rov navbatda.</li><li>Zero-downtime restart: socket systemd'da, servis almashinuvi paytida <code>connection refused</code> yo'q.</li><li>Imtiyoz: 80/443 portni systemd ochadi, servis root'siz ishlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>boot: systemd -&gt; socket(), bind(:8080), listen()   [myapp.socket]<br>client ulanadi -&gt; kernel accept queue -&gt; systemd ko'radi<br>       -&gt; myapp.service start, env: LISTEN_FDS=1, FD 3 = tinglovchi socket<br>       -&gt; servis accept(3) qiladi<br>restart: servis o'ladi, FD 3 systemd'da ochiq -&gt; yangi ulanishlar navbatda</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># /etc/systemd/system/myapp.socket<br>[Socket]<br>ListenStream=8080<br>[Install]<br>WantedBy=sockets.target<br><br># /etc/systemd/system/myapp.service<br>[Service]<br>ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/myapp<br>User=app</pre><pre>sudo systemctl enable --now myapp.socket<br>systemctl list-sockets<br>systemd-socket-activate -l 8080 ./myapp    # lokal test</pre><p>Go: <code>github.com/coreos/go-systemd/activation</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova o'zi <code>listen()</code> qilishga harakat qilsa — &quot;address already in use&quot;; FD 3'dan olishni qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak.</li><li><code>Accept=yes</code> — har ulanishga yangi process (inetd uslubi); yuqori yuklamada halokatli, default <code>no</code> ishlat.</li><li>Uzoq start bo'ladigan servisda birinchi so'rov timeout bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container/K8s davrida kamroq ishlatiladi (u yerda rolling update va LB bor), lekin bare-metal'da yagona instance servislar uchun eng oddiy zero-downtime restart usuli.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage

Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41631	<p><code>net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range</code> — kernel chiquvchi ulanishlar uchun avtomatik tanlaydigan ephemeral (source) portlar diapazoni. Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41633	<p><code>vm.overcommit_memory</code> (0, 1, 2) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>vm.overcommit_memory</code> — kernel process'larga fizik RAM + swap'dan ko'proq virtual xotira va'da berishiga qanday munosabatda bo'lishi:</p><ul><li><code>0</code> (default) — heuristik: aniq imkonsiz katta allokatsiyalarni rad etadi, qolganiga ruxsat.</li><li><code>1</code> — doim ruxsat: hech qachon rad etmaydi (haqiqiy tanqislikda OOM killer ishlaydi).</li><li><code>2</code> — qat'iy: jami commit <code>CommitLimit = swap + RAM * overcommit_ratio/100</code> (yoki <code>overcommit_kbytes</code>) dan oshmaydi; oshsa <code>malloc</code> <code>NULL</code> qaytaradi.</li></ul><p><b>Nega overcommit bor:</b> Ko'p dasturlar katta virtual xotira so'raydi, lekin uning kichik qismini ishlatadi (sparse array, thread stack, <code>fork()</code> CoW).
