Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41634	<p><code>vm.panic_on_oom</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>vm.panic_on_oom</code> — xotira butunlay tugaganda nima qilish:</p><ul><li><code>0</code> (default) — OOM killer &quot;eng yomon&quot; process'ni (oom_score bo'yicha) o'ldiradi, tizim ishlashda davom etadi.</li><li><code>1</code> — kernel panic, lekin cgroup/cpuset/mempolicy bilan cheklangan OOM'da emas (faqat tizim bo'yicha OOM'da).</li><li><code>2</code> — har qanday OOM'da, hatto cgroup darajasidagisida ham, panic.</li></ul><p><code>kernel.panic=10</code> bilan birga panic'dan keyin 10 s da avtomatik reboot.</p><p><b>Nega panic kerak bo'lishi mumkin:</b> HA klasterda OOM killer tasodifiy muhim process'ni (masalan, klaster heartbeat agentini emas, DB'ni) o'ldirsa, node &quot;yarim tirik&quot; holatga tushadi — split-brain xavfi. To'liq panic + reboot esa aniq xato signali: fencing tez ishlaydi va failover toza bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>xotira tugadi<br>   |-- panic_on_oom=0 -&gt; OOM killer -&gt; process o'ladi -&gt; tizim davom etadi<br>   +-- panic_on_oom=1/2 -&gt; kernel panic -&gt; (kernel.panic=N) -&gt; reboot<br>                               |-- kdump bo'lsa -&gt; vmcore saqlanadi (tahlil uchun)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl vm.panic_on_oom kernel.panic<br>cat &lt;&lt;EOF | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-oom.conf<br>vm.panic_on_oom = 1<br>kernel.panic = 10<br>EOF<br>sudo sysctl --system<br>dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'out of memory|oom-kill|Killed process'<br>cat /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/oom_score<br>echo -1000 | sudo tee /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/oom_score_adj   # bu process'ni hech qachon o'ldirma</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>K8s node'da <code>2</code> — har bir pod limitiga yetganda butun node reboot bo'ladi.</li><li><code>kernel.panic=0</code> bilan panic — node abadiy osilib qoladi, konsolda qo'lda reset kerak.</li><li>Panic yoqib, <code>kdump</code>siz qoldirish — sababni tahlil qilish uchun ma'lumot yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Umumiy serverlar uchun <code>0</code> + <code>oom_score_adj</code> bilan muhim process'larni himoya qilish + systemd-oomd/PSI asosida erta choralar ko'rish. <code>1</code> — faqat aniq fencing va avtomatik failover bor klasterlarda ongli qaror.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41635	<p><code>kernel.hung_task_timeout_secs</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>kernel.hung_task_timeout_secs</code> (default 120) — task shu vaqtdan ko'proq <b><code>D</code> holatda</b> (uninterruptible sleep — odatda I/O kutish) qolib ketsa, kernel <code>khungtaskd</code> dmesg'ga &quot;INFO: task X blocked for more than 120 seconds&quot; va stack trace yozadi. <code>kernel.hung_task_panic=1</code> bo'lsa — panic.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> <code>D</code> holatdagi process'ni <code>kill -9</code> ham o'ldira olmaydi — u kernel ichida I/O tugashini kutyapti. Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41636	<p><code>fs.file-nr</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/proc/sys/fs/file-nr</code> — tizim bo'yicha uchta raqam: <b>ajratilgan</b> file handle'lar (<code>struct file</code>), <b>ajratilgan, lekin ishlatilmayotgan</b> (zamonaviy kernel'larda doim 0) va <b>maksimal</b> (<code>fs.file-max</code>). Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41637	<p>File descriptor leak nima va qanday aniqlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> FD leak — ilova fayl, socket yoki pipe ochadi, lekin har doim <code>close()</code> qilmaydi (ayniqsa xato yo'llarida). Ochiq deskriptorlar soni vaqt o'tishi bilan o'sadi va <code>RLIMIT_NOFILE</code>ga yetganda yangi ulanish/fayl ochilmaydi: &quot;Too many open files&quot; (<code>EMFILE</code>). Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41639	<p>Memory leak va memory fragmentation farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Memory leak</b> — xotira ajratiladi, lekin hech qachon bo'shatilmaydi (havola yo'qolgan yoki keraksiz havola saqlanib qolgan) — ishlatilayotgan (live) xotira cheksiz o'sadi. <b>Fragmentatsiya</b> — live ma'lumot o'smaydi, lekin bo'sh xotira mayda, uzluksiz bo'lmagan bo'laklarga bo'lingan: allocator uni OS'ga qaytara olmaydi yoki katta blok topa olmaydi — RSS yuqori qoladi.</p><p><b>Nega farqlash muhim:</b> Ikkalasida ham RSS katta. Leak'ni kodda tuzatish kerak; fragmentatsiyani allocator tanlovi, ob'ekt o'lchamlari yoki sozlamalar bilan.</p><p><b>Qanday farqlanadi:</b></p><pre>Leak:           live heap ^  ________/       RSS ham shu bilan o'sadi<br>                          +------------&gt;<br>Fragmentatsiya: live heap ^ /\/\/\/\/\       barqaror<br>                RSS       ^ /‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾      yuqorida qolib ketgan<br>heap:  [U][.][U][.][.][U][.][U]   bo'sh joy bor, lekin sahifalar qisman band -&gt; qaytarilmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># RSS trendi<br>ps -o pid,rss,vsz,cmd -p &lt;PID&gt;<br>grep -E 'VmRSS|RssAnon' /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/status<br># glibc malloc holati (gdb bilan yoki ilova ichidan malloc_stats())<br># jemalloc: MALLOC_CONF=stats_print:true<br># Go: live vs OS'dan olingan<br>curl -s localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap &gt; heap.pb.gz<br>go tool pprof -inuse_space heap.pb.gz       # live obyektlar (leak qidirish)<br># HeapInuse vs HeapIdle/HeapReleased farqi -&gt; fragmentatsiya/qaytarilmagan<br># Redis: INFO memory -&gt; mem_fragmentation_ratio (&gt;1.5 shubhali)<br>redis-cli INFO memory | grep -E 'used_memory_human|used_memory_rss_human|fragmentation'</pre><p><b>Yechimlar:</b> | Muammo | Yechim | |---|---| | Leak | profiler bilan allokatsiya joyini top, havolani uzish, cache'ga limit/TTL | | Fragmentatsiya | jemalloc/tcmalloc, <code>MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2</code> (glibc ko'p arena), Redis <code>activedefrag yes</code>, obyekt pool |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>glibc ko'p thread'li ilovada (Java native, Python) har thread uchun arena -&gt; RSS katta, leak'ga o'xshaydi; <code>MALLOC_ARENA_MAX</code>.</li><li>GC tillarida &quot;leak&quot; ko'pincha global map/cache'da cheksiz o'sish — GC uni bo'shata olmaydi, chunki havola bor.</li><li>Bitta o'lchov bilan xulosa — vaqt bo'yicha trend kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval o'lcha: live heap o'syaptimi (leak) yoki faqat RSS (fragmentatsiya/allocator)? Bu bitta savol diagnostika yo'nalishini to'liq o'zgartiradi. Uzoq ishlaydigan native servislarda jemalloc ko'pincha eng arzon yutuq.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41640	<p><code>valgrind</code> (Memcheck) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Valgrind — dinamik binary instrumentatsiya framework'i; uning default tool'i <b>Memcheck</b> dasturni sintetik CPU'da bajarib, har xotira murojaatini tekshiradi: leak'lar, buffer overflow (heap), use-after-free, double free, init qilinmagan qiymatdan foydalanish. Qayta compile shart emas (lekin <code>-g</code> bilan qatorlar ko'rinadi). Narxi — 20-50x sekinlik.</p><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b> C/C++ kodda tasodifiy segfault, xotira buzilishi, sekin o'sayotgan leak — ayniqsa source'ni o'zgartirib bo'lmagan yoki sanitizer bilan build qilib bo'lmagan holda.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcc -g -O0 app.c -o app<br>valgrind --leak-check=full --show-leak-kinds=all --track-origins=yes ./app</pre><p><b>Chiqishni o'qish:</b></p><pre>==1234== Invalid write of size 4<br>==1234==    at 0x10916B: main (app.c:12)          &lt;- qayerda<br>==1234==  Address 0x4a4b068 is 0 bytes after a block of size 40 alloc'd<br>==1234==    at 0x483B7F3: malloc<br>==1234==    by 0x109156: main (app.c:10)          &lt;- qayerda ajratilgan<br>...<br>==1234== LEAK SUMMARY:<br>==1234==    definitely lost: 120 bytes in 3 blocks    &lt;- haqiqiy leak, tuzat<br>==1234==    indirectly lost: 0 bytes<br>==1234==      possibly lost: 0 bytes<br>==1234==    still reachable: 72,704 bytes             &lt;- odatda OK (global, exit'da bo'shatilmagan)</pre><p>Boshqa tool'lar: <code>--tool=massif</code> (heap profil vaqt bo'yicha, <code>ms_print</code>), <code>--tool=helgrind</code>/<code>drd</code> (data race), <code>--tool=callgrind</code> (CPU profil).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prod'da ishlatib bo'lmaydi — juda sekin; real yuklamani takrorlash qiyin.</li><li>Optimizatsiya (<code>-O2</code>) bilan qator raqamlari va &quot;uninitialized&quot; xabarlari chalkash.</li><li>Go/Java/JIT dasturlari uchun deyarli foydasiz (o'z runtime va GC'si bor).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy amaliyotda birinchi tanlov — AddressSanitizer/LeakSanitizer (<code>-fsanitize=address</code>, ~2x sekinlik) CI testlarida; Valgrind — sanitizer imkonsiz bo'lganda yoki init qilinmagan xotira (MemorySanitizer o'rnida) uchun. Prod'dagi leak uchun esa heaptrack, jemalloc profiling yoki eBPF (<code>memleak</code> bcc).</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage
Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41641	<p><code>bpftrace</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>bpftrace</code> — eBPF uchun yuqori darajali tracing tili (awk/DTrace uslubida). Bir qatorli skript bilan ishlab turgan prod kernel va ilovalarga xavfsiz &quot;zond&quot; qo'yasan: syscall'lar, kernel funksiyalari (kprobe/fentry), tracepoint'lar, user funksiyalar (uprobe), USDT — va hisob, gistogramma, latency'ni kernel ichida yig'asan. Qayta ishga tushirish va kod o'zgartirish shart emas.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> <code>strace</code> har syscall'da process'ni to'xtatadi (10-100x sekinlik) — prod'da xavfli. bpftrace ma'lumotni kernel ichida agregatlaydi, overhead past; savol tug'ilganda darhol javob olasan (&quot;qaysi process eng ko'p fayl ochyapti?&quot;, &quot;disk latency taqsimoti qanday?&quot;).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bpftrace skript -&gt; LLVM -&gt; eBPF bytecode -&gt; verifier (xavfsizlik tekshiruvi)<br>      -&gt; probe'larga ulanadi (kprobe, tracepoint, uprobe)<br>      -&gt; event'lar kernel'da BPF map'larga yig'iladi -&gt; Ctrl-C -&gt; natija</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># qaysi process qaysi faylni ochyapti<br>sudo bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_openat { printf(&quot;%s %s\n&quot;, comm, str(args.filename)); }'<br># syscall soni process bo'yicha<br>sudo bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:raw_syscalls:sys_enter { @[comm] = count(); }'<br># read() latency gistogrammasi (mikrosekund)<br>sudo bpftrace -e 'kprobe:vfs_read { @s[tid] = nsecs; }<br>  kretprobe:vfs_read /@s[tid]/ { @us = hist((nsecs - @s[tid]) / 1000); delete(@s[tid]); }'<br># blok I/O hajmlari<br>sudo bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:block:block_rq_issue { @bytes = hist(args.bytes); }'<br>sudo bpftrace -l 'tracepoint:syscalls:*open*'      # mavjud probe'lar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Juda tez-tez chaqiriladigan funksiyaga (<code>kprobe:kmalloc</code>) murakkab mantiq qo'yish — sezilarli overhead.</li><li>kprobe'lar kernel versiyasiga bog'liq (funksiya nomlari o'zgaradi, inline qilinadi) — iloji bo'lsa tracepoint ishlat.</li><li>Root/<code>CAP_BPF</code>+<code>CAP_PERFMON</code> kerak; lockdown <code>confidentiality</code> ba'zi probe'larni bloklaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Brendan Gregg'ning tool'lari va kitobi — standart manba. bpftrace — ad-hoc savollar uchun; doimiy kuzatuv uchun esa eBPF asosidagi agentlar (Parca, Pixie, Cilium Hubble) ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage

Interview Drill::Linux::H25 Advanced Linux internals & storage	idrill-41648	<p>Kernel livepatching (kpatch / Canonical Livepatch) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kernel livepatching — ishlab turgan kernel'ga xavfsizlik tuzatishlarini <b>reboot qilmasdan</b> qo'llash. Patch modul sifatida yuklanadi va ftrace orqali eski funksiya chaqiruvlarini yangi versiyaga yo'naltiradi. Implementatsiyalar: kernel <code>livepatch</code> infratuzilmasi ustida — RHEL <code>kpatch</code>, Canonical Livepatch, SUSE <code>kGraft</code>/SLE Live Patching, Oracle Ksplice.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kritik kernel CVE chiqdi. Yuzlab DB, stateful servis, uzoq hisob-kitob ishlayotgan serverni darhol reboot qilish — downtime va xavf. Livepatch xavfsizlik oynasini yopadi, reboot'ni rejali oynaga qoldiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>eski funksiya:  tcp_foo() { ...zaif kod... }<br>livepatch modul yuklanadi -&gt; ftrace hook tcp_foo() boshiga<br>chaqiruv -&gt; tcp_foo() -&gt; ftrace -&gt; tcp_foo_patched() (yangi kod)<br>consistency model: har task &quot;xavfsiz nuqtada&quot; (stack'ida eski funksiya yo'q) bo'lganda yangi versiyaga o'tadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/kernel/livepatch/*/enabled 2&gt;/dev/null<br>ls /sys/kernel/livepatch/<br># RHEL<br>sudo dnf install kpatch kpatch-patch<br>kpatch list<br># Ubuntu Pro<br>sudo pro enable livepatch<br>canonical-livepatch status --verbose<br>uname -r                         # o'zgarmaydi - versiya eski ko'rinadi<br>cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted     # livepatch &quot;K&quot; taint flag'i qo'yadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma tuzatishni livepatch qilib bo'lmaydi — ma'lumot strukturasi o'zgarishlari, inline/assembly kod; vendor faqat tanlangan kritik CVE'lar uchun patch beradi.</li><li><code>uname -r</code> eski versiyani ko'rsatadi — vulnerability scanner'lar noto'g'ri &quot;zaif&quot; deydi yoki aksincha; livepatch holatini alohida tekshir.</li><li>Livepatch'lar faqat ma'lum vaqt (masalan, kernel versiyasi chiqqandan ~1 yil) qo'llab-quvvatlanadi — baribir rejali reboot kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Livepatch — vaqtinchalik ko'prik, yangilanish strategiyasining o'rnini bosmaydi. Yaxshi amaliyot: livepatch bilan darhol himoya + keyingi maintenance oynasida rolling reboot; immutable/cattle infratuzilmada esa node'larni yangi image bilan almashtirish ko'pincha soddaroq.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage

Zamonaviy himoya — profilaktik: Secure Boot + module signing, IMA, AIDE/fayl yaxlitligi, Falco/auditd runtime detection va immutable infratuzilma.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::linux sec::h25 Advanced_Linux_internals_storage

Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33152	<p>Git'da working directory, staging area (index) va repository farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git'da fayl uch joyda yashaydi: <b>working tree</b> (diskdagi tahrirlanayotgan fayllar), <b>index/staging</b> (keyingi commit'ning tayyorlanayotgan snapshot'i) va <b>repository</b> (<code>.git/objects</code> ichidagi doimiy commit'lar).</p><p><b>Nega uchta joy:</b> Bir faylda ikki xil ish qildingiz — bug fix va debug <code>print</code>. Index bo'lmasa hammasi bitta commit'ga tushardi. Index orqali faqat kerakli qismni tanlab commit qilasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>working tree --git add--&gt; index --git commit--&gt; repository (HEAD)<br>     ^                                                |<br>     +----------- git restore / git switch -----------+</pre><p>| Joy | Nima | Buyruq | |---|---|---| | Working tree | Diskdagi hozirgi fayllar | tahrirlash | | Index | Keyingi commit snapshot'i | <code>git add</code>, <code>git restore --staged</code> | | Repository | commit, tree, blob obyektlar | <code>git commit</code> |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git status            # uchala joy orasidagi farq<br>git diff              # working tree vs index (hali add qilinmagan)<br>git diff --staged     # index vs HEAD (commit'ga kiradigan)<br>git add -p app.go     # faqat kerakli bo'laklarni index'ga<br>git restore --staged app.go   # index'dan qaytarish, disk o'zgarmaydi</pre><p><code>git status</code> da &quot;Changes to be committed&quot; = index, &quot;Changes not staged&quot; = working tree.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git diff</code> bo'sh chiqdi deb &quot;o'zgarish yo'q&quot; deyish — hammasi allaqachon staged bo'lishi mumkin, <code>--staged</code> ni ham ko'ring.</li><li><code>git add</code> dan keyin faylni yana tahrirlasangiz, commit'ga <b>add paytidagi</b> versiya kiradi.</li><li><code>git commit -a</code> faqat tracked fayllarni oladi, yangi fayllar kirmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Index — &quot;atomik, mantiqiy commit&quot; vositasi. Kichik commit'lar review, <code>git bisect</code> va <code>revert</code> ni osonlashtiradi; <code>git add -p</code> odati shuni ta'minlaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33153	<p><code>git clone</code>, <code>git fetch</code>, <code>git pull</code>, <code>git push</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>clone</code> — repo'ni birinchi marta to'liq ko'chiradi; <code>fetch</code> — remote'dagi yangiliklarni yuklaydi, lekin sizning branch'ingizga tegmaydi; <code>pull</code> = <code>fetch</code> + <code>merge</code> (yoki rebase); <code>push</code> — local commit'larni remote'ga yuboradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>git pull</code> ni ko'r-ko'rona bosish kutilmagan merge commit va konfliktga olib keladi. Avval <code>fetch</code> qilib nima kelayotganini ko'rish xavfsizroq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>remote (origin/main)<br>   |  fetch: origin/main ref yangilanadi<br>   v<br>local origin/main --merge/rebase--&gt; local main   (pull = fetch + shu qadam)<br>local main --push--&gt; remote main  (faqat fast-forward bo'lsa)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git clone git@github.com:org/app.git   # repo + origin remote + default branch<br>git fetch origin                       # faqat yuklash<br>git log --oneline HEAD..origin/main    # nima kelyapti<br>git pull --rebase                      # o'z commit'larimni ustiga qo'yish<br>git push                               # yuborish</pre><p>Push rad etilsa: <code>! [rejected] main -&gt; main (non-fast-forward)</code> — remote oldinda, avval pull qiling.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>pull</code> default holatda merge commit yaratadi — tarix &quot;Merge branch 'main' of ...&quot; bilan to'ladi. <code>git config --global pull.rebase true</code> qo'ying.</li><li><code>fetch</code> qilmasdan <code>origin/main</code> ga qarash — u eskirgan bo'ladi.</li><li>Rad etilgan push'ni <code>--force</code> bilan &quot;tuzatish&quot; — boshqalarning ishini o'chiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>fetch</code> hech qachon lokal ishni buzmaydi — shubha bo'lsa avval fetch, keyin ko'rib chiqib integratsiya. CI'da ham <code>fetch</code> + aniq SHA checkout ishonchliroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33154	<p>Branch nima va <code>git switch</code>/<code>git checkout</code> bilan qanday ishlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Branch — bitta commit'ga ko'rsatkich (<code>.git/refs/heads/&lt;nom&gt;</code> faylidagi hash). Yangi commit qilsangiz, ko'rsatkich avtomatik oldinga siljiydi. <code>git switch</code> branch'lar orasida o'tish uchun zamonaviy buyruq (<code>checkout</code> ning branch qismi).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Har feature/bug'ni alohida izolyatsiyada ishlab, <code>main</code> ni barqaror saqlash. Branch arzon — 41 baytlik fayl.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>A---B---C  &lt;- main<br>         \<br>          D---E  &lt;- feature/login  &lt;- HEAD</pre><p><code>HEAD</code> qaysi branch'da turganingizni bildiradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git branch                       # lokal branch'lar, * = joriy<br>git switch -c feature/login      # yaratish + o'tish (eski: checkout -b)<br>git switch main                  # o'tish<br>git push -u origin feature/login # remote'ga + upstream bog'lash<br>git branch -d feature/login      # merge bo'lgan bo'lsa o'chirish<br>git branch -D feature/login      # majburan<br>cat .git/refs/heads/main         # ko'rsatkich ichida shunchaki hash</pre><p><b>Detached HEAD:</b> <code>git switch --detach v1.0</code> yoki <code>git checkout &lt;sha&gt;</code> — branch'da emas, to'g'ridan commit'dasiz. U yerda commit qilsangiz, <code>git switch -c fix</code> bilan saqlang, aks holda yo'qoladi (reflog'da qoladi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Commit qilinmagan o'zgarish bilan switch — Git konflikt bo'lsa rad etadi; stash yoki commit qiling.</li><li><code>-D</code> merge qilinmagan ishni o'chiradi.</li><li>Uzoq yashaydigan branch — katta konfliktlar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Branch umrini qisqa tuting (soatlar-kunlar). Uzun branch — integratsiya xavfini kechiktirish, yo'q qilish emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33155	<p>Merge conflict qanday paydo bo'ladi va qanday hal qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Konflikt ikki branch <b>bir faylning bir qatorini</b> turlicha o'zgartirganda paydo bo'ladi va Git qaysi biri to'g'riligini bilmaydi. Hal qilish: markerlarni ko'rib, to'g'ri natijani qo'lda yozish, <code>git add</code>, keyin merge/rebase'ni davom ettirish.</p><p><b>Qanday paydo bo'ladi:</b></p><pre>base:     port: 8000<br>main:     port: 8080   (siz)<br>feature:  port: 9090   (hamkasb)<br>-&gt; ikkalasi bir qatorni o'zgartirdi -&gt; CONFLICT</pre><p><b>Markerlarni o'qish:</b></p><pre>&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt; HEAD<br>port: 8080           &lt;- joriy branch (siz turgan)<br>=======<br>port: 9090           &lt;- kirib kelayotgan branch<br>&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt; feature</pre><p>Rebase paytida teskari: <code>HEAD</code> = upstream (main), pastki = sizning commit.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git merge feature<br>git status                      # &quot;both modified: config.yaml&quot;<br># faylni tahrirlang, markerlarni o'chiring<br>git add config.yaml<br>git commit                      # merge; rebase'da: git rebase --continue<br>git merge --abort               # boshidan qaytish<br>git config --global merge.conflictstyle zdiff3   # base versiyani ham ko'rsatadi</pre><p><code>zdiff3</code> bilan <code>|||||||</code> ostida asl (base) qiymat ko'rinadi — qaror qilish ancha oson.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Markerlarni qoldirib commit qilish — CI'da <code>git diff --check</code> yoki linter ushlaydi.</li><li>&quot;Mening variantim&quot; ni tanlab hamkasbning mantiqini o'chirib yuborish — ikkalasini birlashtirish kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Konfliktdan keyin testni ishga tushirmaslik — sintaktik to'g'ri, semantik xato.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konfliktni kamaytirish — jarayon masalasi: kichik PR, tez-tez main'dan yangilash, avtomatik formatter. Takrorlanuvchi konfliktlar uchun <code>git rerere</code> yoqing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33156	<p><code>.gitignore</code> nima uchun kerak va allaqachon commit qilingan faylni qanday ignore qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.gitignore</code> — Git kuzatmasligi kerak bo'lgan fayllar ro'yxati (build, log, <code>.env</code>, <code>node_modules</code>). Lekin u faqat <b>untracked</b> fayllarga ta'sir qiladi: allaqachon commit qilingan faylni <code>git rm --cached</code> bilan index'dan chiqarish kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>.env</code> commit bo'lib ketdi, keyin <code>.gitignore</code> ga qo'shdingiz — Git hali ham uni kuzatadi, chunki u tracked.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>.env<br>*.log<br>/bin/            # faqat root'dagi bin<br>node_modules/<br>!keep.log        # istisno</pre><p>Commit qilingan faylni to'xtatish:</p><pre>git rm --cached .env          # index'dan olib tashlash, diskda qoladi<br>echo &quot;.env&quot; &gt;&gt; .gitignore<br>git commit -m &quot;stop tracking .env&quot;<br>git check-ignore -v build/app # qaysi qoida ishlagani: .gitignore:3:/bin/</pre><p><b>Qatlamlar:</b> repo <code>.gitignore</code> (jamoa uchun), <code>.git/info/exclude</code> (faqat sizda), <code>core.excludesFile</code> (global: <code>.DS_Store</code>, <code>.idea/</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.env</code> tarixda qoladi — secret bo'lsa <b>rotate qiling</b>, tarixni tozalash yetarli emas.</li><li><code>git rm --cached</code> boshqalar pull qilganda ularning diskidan faylni <b>o'chiradi</b>.</li><li>Papkani ignore qilsangiz (<code>logs/</code>), ichidagi <code>!logs/keep</code> istisnosi ishlamaydi — avval <code>logs/*</code> yozing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shaxsiy IDE fayllarini repo <code>.gitignore</code> ga emas, global excludes'ga qo'ying. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33157	<p><code>git log</code>, <code>git diff</code>, <code>git show</code>, <code>git blame</code> nima uchun ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>log</code> — commit tarixi, <code>diff</code> — ikki holat orasidagi farq, <code>show</code> — bitta commit (meta + diff), <code>blame</code> — har qatorni oxirgi o'zgartirgan commit. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33158	<p>Yaxshi commit message qanday yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yaxshi commit message: qisqa sarlavha (~50 belgi, buyruq maylida, nima qilindi) + bo'sh qator + tana (<b>nega</b> qilindi, qanday yondashuv, ta'sir). Conventional Commits prefiksi (<code>feat:</code>, <code>fix:</code>) avtomatik versiya va changelog beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 6 oydan keyin <code>git log</code> da &quot;fix&quot;, &quot;update&quot;, &quot;wip&quot; — hech narsa aytmaydi. Bug tekshirayotganda nega bu qator o'zgarganini bilish imkonsiz.</p><p><b>Namuna:</b></p><pre>fix(auth): refresh token muddati chegarasini tuzatish<br><br>Token expiry '&lt;' bilan solishtirilgan, aynan muddat tugagan<br>soniyadagi token qabul qilinardi. '&lt;=' ga o'zgartirildi,<br>chegaraviy test qo'shildi.<br><br>Refs: #142</pre><p><b>Qoidalar:</b> | Qism | Qoida | |---|---| | Sarlavha | &lt;=50-72 belgi, nuqtasiz, &quot;add/fix&quot; buyruq shakli | | Prefiks | <code>feat</code> -&gt; minor, <code>fix</code> -&gt; patch, <code>feat!</code>/<code>BREAKING CHANGE:</code> -&gt; major | | Tana | nega, qanday muqobillar rad etildi | | Footer | <code>Refs: #142</code>, <code>Co-authored-by:</code> |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git commit                 # editor ochiladi, -m emas<br>git log --format='%s' | head   # sarlavhalar o'qiladimi?<br>npx commitlint --from origin/main   # CI'da format tekshiruvi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta commit'da bir nechta mantiqiy o'zgarish — message yozish qiyinlashadi; bu signal: commit'ni bo'ling.</li><li>Diff'ni takrorlash (&quot;x ni y ga o'zgartirdim&quot;) — diff buni ko'rsatadi, nega'ni yozing.</li><li>Squash merge'da PR sarlavhasi commit message bo'ladi — PR sarlavhasiga ham shu qoidalar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Commit message — kelajakdagi on-call injener uchun yozilgan hujjat. Format'ni CI (commitlint) bilan majburlash insonlar xotirasiga tayanishdan ishonchli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33406	<p><code>git clean</code> va <code>git restore</code> bilan working tree'ni qanday tozalaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git restore</code> — tracked fayldagi o'zgarishni bekor qiladi yoki unstage qiladi; <code>git clean</code> — <b>untracked</b> fayllarni o'chiradi. Ikkalasi ham qaytarib bo'lmaydigan amal: commit qilinmagan narsa reflog'da yo'q.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> Eksperimentdan keyin repo iflos: o'zgargan fayllar, yangi temp fayllar, build artefaktlar. Toza holatga qaytish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>tracked + o'zgargan  --git restore--&gt;   HEAD/index holatiga<br>staged               --git restore --staged--&gt; unstage<br>untracked            --git clean--&gt;     o'chiriladi<br>ignored (.gitignore) --git clean -x--&gt;  o'chiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git restore main.go               # o'zgarishni tashlash (eski: checkout -- main.go)<br>git restore --staged main.go      # unstage (eski: reset HEAD main.go)<br>git restore --source=HEAD~2 main.go   # eski versiyani olish<br>git clean -n                      # DRY RUN: nima o'chishini ko'rish<br>git clean -fd                     # untracked fayl + papkalar<br>git clean -fdx                    # + ignored (build/, node_modules, .env!)<br>git clean -i                      # interaktiv tanlash</pre><p><code>-n</code> chiqishi: <code>Would remove tmp/debug.log</code> — ro'yxatni o'qib, keyin <code>-f</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-x</code> lokal <code>.env</code>, IDE sozlamalarini ham o'chiradi.</li><li><code>restore</code> dan keyin &quot;orqaga&quot; yo'q — ikkilansangiz <code>git stash -u</code> qiling (qaytsa bo'ladi).</li><li><code>clean</code> submodule ichiga kirmaydi, <code>-ff</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xavfli tozalashdan oldin har doim <code>git stash -u</code> — bu bepul sug'urta. CI'da toza checkout uchun <code>git clean -ffdx</code> standart.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33407	<p>Semantic versioning (SemVer) nima: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SemVer — <code>MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH</code> versiyalash kelishuvi: MAJOR — orqaga mos kelmaydigan (breaking) o'zgarish, MINOR — mos keladigan yangi funksiya, PATCH — mos keladigan bug fix. Versiya raqami foydalanuvchiga &quot;yangilash xavflimi&quot; degan signal beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kutubxona <code>1.4</code> dan <code>1.5</code> ga o'tdi va kodingiz buzildi — demak muallif breaking change'ni minor qilib chiqargan. SemVer shu kelishuvni rasmiylashtiradi.</p><p><b>Misollar:</b></p><pre>1.4.2 -&gt; 1.4.3   bug fix<br>1.4.3 -&gt; 1.5.0   yangi endpoint, eskilari ishlaydi<br>1.5.0 -&gt; 2.0.0   API'dan maydon olib tashlandi<br>2.0.0-rc.1       pre-release (2.0.0 dan past)<br>0.x.y            boshlang'ich: har minor breaking bo'lishi mumkin</pre><p><b>Constraint'lar:</b> | Yozuv | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>^1.4.0</code> (npm) | &gt;=1.4.0 &lt;2.0.0 | | <code>~1.4.0</code> (npm) | &gt;=1.4.0 &lt;1.5.0 | | <code>~&gt; 5.60</code> (Terraform) | &gt;=5.60, &lt;6.0 | | <code>~&gt; 5.60.1</code> (Terraform) | &gt;=5.60.1, &lt;5.61 |</p><p><b>Amalda (avtomatlashtirish):</b></p><pre># Conventional Commits -&gt; versiya<br>feat: ...           -&gt; minor<br>fix: ...            -&gt; patch<br>feat!: ... / BREAKING CHANGE: -&gt; major<br>npx semantic-release   # yoki release-please GitHub Action: tag + CHANGELOG</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Go modullarida v2+ import yo'lida <code>/v2</code> bo'lishi shart (<code>module example.com/lib/v2</code>).</li><li>Lock fayl bo'lmasa <code>^</code> diapazon har build'da boshqa versiya olishi mumkin.</li><li>&quot;Breaking&quot; faqat API emas — default qiymat yoki xatti-harakat o'zgarishi ham.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SemVer — va'da, kafolat emas. Lock fayl + avtomatik dependency PR (Renovate/Dependabot) + test — haqiqiy himoya.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33159	<p><code>git merge</code> va <code>git rebase</code> farqi? Qachon qaysi biri?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>merge</code> ikki tarixni birlashtiruvchi yangi merge commit yaratadi va tarixni o'zgartirmaydi; <code>rebase</code> commit'laringizni boshqa asos ustiga <b>qayta yozadi</b> (yangi hash'lar) va chiziqli tarix beradi. Qoida: o'z lokal branch'ingizni rebase qiling, umumiy branch'ni faqat merge.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>merge:   A-B-C-------M  (main)       rebase:  A-B-C-D'-E'  (feature)<br>              \     /<br>               D---E</pre><p>| | merge | rebase | |---|---|---| | Tarix | haqiqiy, tarmoqli | chiziqli | | Hash | o'zgarmaydi | yangi commit'lar | | Konflikt | bir marta | har commit uchun | | Xavf | yo'q | boshqalar ishlatgan branch'ni buzadi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># feature'ni yangi main ustiga ko'chirish<br>git fetch origin<br>git rebase origin/main<br># konflikt: tuzatib -&gt; git add -&gt; git rebase --continue<br>git push --force-with-lease      # tarix qayta yozildi<br># commit'larni tartiblash<br>git rebase -i origin/main        # squash/fixup/reword<br># main'ga qo'shish<br>git switch main &amp;&amp; git merge --no-ff feature</pre><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b></p><ul><li>Lokal feature, PR'dan oldin tozalash — rebase.</li><li><code>main</code>, <code>release/*</code>, boshqalar pull qilgan branch — merge.</li><li>Long-running branch'ga main'dan yangilik olish — merge (yoki tez-tez rebase, agar faqat sizniki bo'lsa).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Umumiy branch'ni rebase + force push — hamkasblarda dublikat commit'lar va hayron qolish.</li><li>Oddiy <code>--force</code> — boshqaning push'ini o'chiradi; <code>--force-with-lease</code> ishlating.</li><li>Rebase'da har commit konflikti — <code>git rerere</code> yoqing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov — jamoa kelishuvi: ko'p jamoalar &quot;PR ichida rebase, main'ga squash merge&quot; modelini oladi. Muhimi bir xillik va tarixni o'qish oson bo'lishi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33160	<p><code>git reset --soft</code>, <code>--mixed</code>, <code>--hard</code> va <code>git revert</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>reset</code> branch ko'rsatkichini orqaga suradi (tarixni qayta yozadi): <code>--soft</code> faqat HEAD, <code>--mixed</code> HEAD + index, <code>--hard</code> hammasini, jumladan diskni ham. <code>revert</code> esa tarixga tegmaydi — o'zgarishni teskarisiga qiluvchi <b>yangi commit</b> qo'shadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Buyruq | HEAD | Index | Working tree | |---|---|---|---| | <code>reset --soft X</code> | X | o'zgarmaydi | o'zgarmaydi | | <code>reset --mixed X</code> (default) | X | X | o'zgarmaydi | | <code>reset --hard X</code> | X | X | X — o'zgarishlar yo'qoladi | | <code>revert X</code> | yangi commit | yangi | yangi |</p><pre>reset:   A-B-C  -&gt;  A-B          (C &quot;yo'qoladi&quot;, reflog'da qoladi)<br>revert:  A-B-C  -&gt;  A-B-C-C'     (C' = C ning teskarisi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git reset --soft HEAD~1    # oxirgi commit'ni ochish, o'zgarish staged qoladi<br>git reset HEAD~3           # 3 commit'ni unstaged o'zgarishga aylantirish<br>git reset --hard origin/main   # lokalni remote bilan bir xil qilish<br>git revert 9f8e7d6         # prod'dagi bug commit'ni bekor qilish<br>git revert -m 1 &lt;merge-sha&gt;    # merge commit'ni revert (1 = asosiy ota)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Push qilingan tarixda <code>reset</code> + force push — boshqalarning tarixini buzadi. Umumiy branch'da faqat <code>revert</code>.</li><li><code>reset --hard</code> commit qilinmagan o'zgarishni butunlay o'chiradi — reflog ham qaytarmaydi.</li><li>Merge commit'ni revert qilgandan keyin o'sha branch'ni qayta merge qilsangiz, o'zgarishlar kelmaydi — &quot;revert of revert&quot; kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod incident'da revert — eng tez va xavfsiz rollback yo'li: audit izi qoladi, CI qayta ishlaydi. <code>reset --hard</code> dan oldin <code>git stash -u</code> yoki branch yaratib qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33161	<p><code>git stash</code> nima va qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git stash</code> — commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlarni vaqtincha &quot;cho'ntakka&quot; saqlab, working tree'ni toza holatga qaytaradi. Keyin <code>pop</code>/<code>apply</code> bilan qaytarasiz. Qisqa muddatli kontekst almashtirish uchun.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> Feature ustida yarim ishsiz, prod'da shoshilinch bug. Commit qilish erta, lekin branch almashtirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>working tree (iflos) --stash push--&gt; stash@{0} (maxsus commit'lar)<br>                                         |<br>toza working tree  &lt;---- stash pop ------+</pre><p>Stash aslida <code>refs/stash</code> dagi commit'lar stack'i.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git stash push -m &quot;wip login&quot;   # saqlash<br>git stash -u                    # untracked fayllar bilan<br>git stash push -p               # faqat tanlangan bo'laklar<br>git stash list                  # stash@{0}: On feature: wip login<br>git stash show -p stash@{0}     # ichini ko'rish<br>git stash pop                   # qaytarish + o'chirish<br>git stash apply stash@{1}       # qaytarish, ro'yxatda qoladi<br>git stash branch fix-x stash@{0}   # stash'dan yangi branch (konflikt bo'lsa qulay)<br>git stash drop stash@{0}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>pop</code> konflikt bersa stash o'chirilmaydi — hal qilib, keyin <code>drop</code>.</li><li>Untracked fayllar default stash'ga kirmaydi — <code>-u</code> unutilsa ular qoladi.</li><li>Uzoq yashagan stash unutiladi va main o'zgargach konflikt beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stash — daqiqalar uchun. Soatlar/kunlar uchun WIP commit (keyin squash) yoki <code>git worktree</code> — ikkinchi papkada parallel ish, hech narsa yashirilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33162	<p><code>git cherry-pick</code> nima va qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>cherry-pick</code> — boshqa branch'dagi tanlangan commit(lar)ni joriy branch'ga nusxalaydi (yangi hash bilan). Odatiy holat: main'dagi bug fix'ni release branch'ga olib o'tish (backport).</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> <code>release/1.4</code> prod'da, fix <code>main</code> ga merge bo'ldi. Strategiya: fix avval main'ga, keyin release'ga — aksincha emas, aks holda keyingi relizda regression.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33163	<p><code>git reflog</code> nima va yo'qolgan commit'ni qanday tiklaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>reflog</code> — lokal repo'da HEAD va branch'lar qayerga ko'rsatganining tarixi (commit, reset, rebase, checkout). Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33164	<p>Trunk-based development va GitFlow farqi? CI/CD uchun qaysi biri?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitFlow — ko'p uzoq yashovchi branch (main, develop, release, hotfix) va rejali relizlar; trunk-based — hamma kichik, qisqa umrli branch'lar orqali bitta <code>main</code> ga tez-tez merge qiladi, tugallanmagan kod feature flag ortida. CI/CD uchun trunk-based standart.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> GitFlow'da feature branch haftalar yashaydi, release paytida katta konfliktlar va &quot;integratsiya do'zaxi&quot;. CD (kuniga ko'p deploy) uchun bu juda sekin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Trunk-based:<br>main: --o--o--o--o--o--o--&gt;  (har biri deploy qilinadi)<br>         \/   \/   \/<br>       qisqa PR (soatlar-1 kun)<br><br>GitFlow:<br>main:    o-----------o (v1.0)------o (v1.1)<br>develop:  \-o-o-o-o-/-o-o-o-o-----/<br>feature:     \-o-o-o/ (haftalar)</pre><p>| | GitFlow | Trunk-based | |---|---|---| | Branch'lar | main, develop, feature, release, hotfix | main + qisqa feature | | Branch umri | kunlar-haftalar | soatlar-1-2 kun | | Reliz | rejali | doimiy (CD) | | Tugallanmagan kod | branch'da | main'da, flag ortida |</p><p><b>Amalda (trunk-based talablari):</b></p><pre># har PR uchun majburiy CI<br>on: pull_request<br>jobs: { test: { runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [ ... ] } }</pre><pre>if flags.Enabled(ctx, &quot;new-checkout&quot;) { newCheckout() } else { oldCheckout() }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kuchli test'siz trunk-based — main doim buzuq.</li><li>Feature flag'larni tozalamaslik — texnik qarz.</li><li>GitFlow'ni SaaS'ga majburlash — keraksiz byurokratiya.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitFlow hali ham o'rinli: bir vaqtda bir necha versiya qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan on-prem yoki mobil mahsulotlarda. DORA tadqiqotlari trunk-based'ni yuqori delivery samaradorligi bilan bog'laydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33165	<p>Tasodifan secret (API key) commit qilinib push bo'ldi. To'g'ri tartib?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tartib: 1) darhol kalitni <b>rotate/revoke</b> qilish, 2) kalit bilan nima qilinganini audit, 3) tarixdan tozalash (<code>git filter-repo</code>), 4) jamoa re-clone, 5) qayta takrorlanmasligi uchun scanner'lar. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33166	<p><code>git bisect</code> bilan bug kiritgan commit'ni qanday topasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git bisect</code> — binary search orqali bug kiritgan commit'ni topadi: bitta &quot;yaxshi&quot; va bitta &quot;yomon&quot; nuqtani berasiz, Git o'rtadagi commit'larni navbat bilan checkout qiladi. 1000 commit ~10 qadamda tekshiriladi; <code>bisect run</code> bilan to'liq avtomatik.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> v1.3.0 da refund ishlagan, hozir buzuq, orada 400 commit. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33480	<p><code>git push --force</code> va <code>--force-with-lease</code> farqi? Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33481	<p><code>git worktree</code> nima va qachon foydali?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git worktree</code> — bitta repo'dan bir nechta ishchi papka: har biri o'z branch'ida, lekin umumiy <code>.git</code> obyektlari bilan. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33170	<p>Monorepo va polyrepo trade-off'lari? Katta monorepo'da Git'ni tezlashtirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Monorepo — atomik cross-cutting o'zgarish va yagona tooling beradi, lekin CI (affected-only build) va Git hajmi muammo bo'ladi. Polyrepo — mustaqil ownership va oddiy CI, lekin ko'p repo bo'ylab o'zgarish va versiya muvofiqlashtirish og'ir. Katta monorepo'ni partial clone, sparse-checkout va <code>git maintenance</code> tezlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Trade-off:</b> | | Monorepo | Polyrepo | |---|---|---| | Cross-cutting o'zgarish | bitta PR | ko'p PR, versiya bump | | CI | affected-only kerak | oddiy | | Ownership | CODEOWNERS | repo darajasida | | Dependency | bitta versiya | diamond/drift | | Git hajmi | katta | kichik |</p><p><b>Tezlashtirish:</b></p><pre>to'liq clone:   barcha tarix + barcha blob + barcha papka<br>partial clone:  tarix bor, blob'lar kerak bo'lganda yuklanadi<br>sparse:         faqat services/api papkasi diskda<br>shallow:        faqat oxirgi commit (CI)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git clone --filter=blob:none URL         # partial clone (dasturchi uchun eng yaxshi)<br>git clone --depth 1 URL                  # CI uchun shallow<br>git sparse-checkout init --cone<br>git sparse-checkout set services/api libs/common<br>git maintenance start                    # fon: commit-graph, prefetch, repack<br>git config core.fsmonitor true           # katta working tree'da status tez</pre><p>CI'da faqat o'zgargan qism:</p><pre>on:<br>  pull_request:<br>    paths: ['services/api/**', 'libs/common/**']</pre><p>Yoki Bazel/Nx/Turborepo dependency grafi bo'yicha affected target'lar.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Monorepo'ni tooling'siz boshlash — CI har PR'da hammasini build qiladi.</li><li><code>--depth 1</code> bilan <code>git describe</code> va tarix kerak bo'lgan ishlar buziladi.</li><li>Polyrepo'da shared library versiyalari drift qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov texnik emas, tashkiliy: Conway qonuni. Monorepo — kuchli platform jamoasi va build tooling'ga sarmoya talab qiladi; buning imkoni bo'lmasa polyrepo + yaxshi dependency avtomatlashtirish.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33171	<p>Git ichki modeli: blob, tree, commit obyektlari va SHA qanday bog'langan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git — content-addressable obyekt bazasi: <b>blob</b> (fayl mazmuni), <b>tree</b> (papka: nom -&gt; blob/tree), <b>commit</b> (root tree + parent + muallif + xabar). Har obyekt nomi — mazmunining hash'i (SHA-1, yangilari SHA-256). Commit hash parent hash'ni o'z ichiga oladi — shuning uchun tarix zanjiri o'zgarmas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>commit 9f8e --&gt; tree a1b2 --&gt; blob c3d4  (main.go)<br>   |                 \-----&gt; tree e5f6 (pkg/) --&gt; blob 77aa<br>   v parent<br>commit 7a6b --&gt; tree ...<br>branch main -&gt; 9f8e      HEAD -&gt; refs/heads/main</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git cat-file -t HEAD             # commit<br>git cat-file -p HEAD             # tree &lt;sha&gt;, parent &lt;sha&gt;, author, message<br>git cat-file -p HEAD^{tree}      # 100644 blob c3d4 main.go<br>git cat-file -p c3d4             # fayl mazmuni<br>echo 'hello' | git hash-object --stdin   # mazmun -&gt; hash<br>git count-objects -vH            # loose/pack hajmi</pre><p><b>Oqibatlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir xil mazmunli fayl bir marta saqlanadi (dedup).</li><li>Rebase/amend = yangi commit'lar: parent yoki mazmun o'zgardi -&gt; hash o'zgardi.</li><li>Branch/tag — faqat ko'rsatkich, shuning uchun arzon.</li><li>Obyektlar pack fayllarda delta-siqilgan holda saqlanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Git diff saqlaydi&quot; — yo'q, snapshot saqlaydi; delta faqat packfile siqish darajasida.</li><li>Tarixni &quot;o'zgartirish&quot; mumkin emas — faqat yangi zanjir yaratish va ref'ni ko'chirish.</li><li>SHA-1 collision (SHAttered) — Git hardened SHA-1 ishlatadi; SHA-256 repo'lar (<code>--object-format=sha256</code>) hali ekotizimda to'liq qo'llab-quvvatlanmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu model <code>filter-repo</code>, <code>bisect</code>, partial clone va imzolangan commit'lar qanday ishlashini tushuntiradi: commit hash'i butun tarixning kriptografik barmoq izi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33172	<p>Branch protection va code review jarayonini production repo uchun qanday sozlaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Production repo uchun: PR majburiy + 1-2 approval, CODEOWNERS review, required status checks (build/test/lint/security), branch up-to-date yoki merge queue, force push va o'chirish taqiqi (admin'larga ham), imzolangan commit (ixtiyoriy). Va bularning hammasi <b>kodda</b> (Terraform/rulesets) boshqariladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kimdir to'g'ridan <code>main</code> ga push qiladi yoki testsiz merge — prod buziladi, audit izi yo'q. Compliance (SOC 2) ham &quot;ikki kishi qoidasi&quot;ni talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PR -&gt; CI checks (required) -&gt; CODEOWNERS approval -&gt; merge queue -&gt; main<br>          |                          |<br>       qizil = blok          egasi yo'q = blok</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub rulesets, Terraform):</b></p><pre>resource &quot;github_repository_ruleset&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>  name        = &quot;main-protection&quot;<br>  repository  = &quot;payments&quot;<br>  target      = &quot;branch&quot;<br>  enforcement = &quot;active&quot;<br>  conditions { ref_name { include = [&quot;~DEFAULT_BRANCH&quot;] exclude = [] } }<br>  rules {<br>    deletion         = true<br>    non_fast_forward = true<br>    pull_request {<br>      required_approving_review_count   = 2<br>      require_code_owner_review         = true<br>      dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push     = true<br>      require_last_push_approval        = true<br>    }<br>    required_status_checks {<br>      required_check { context = &quot;ci/test&quot; }<br>      required_check { context = &quot;security/trivy&quot; }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre># .github/CODEOWNERS<br>/infra/        @org/platform<br>/payments/     @org/payments-leads</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Admin'lar uchun bypass ochiq — eng xavfli push'lar aynan shu yerdan keladi.</li><li>&quot;Require up to date&quot; katta jamoada doimiy rebase poygasi — merge queue ishlating.</li><li>Required check nomi o'zgarsa — PR'lar abadiy &quot;kutilmoqda&quot; holatida qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qo'lda bosilgan sozlama drift qiladi va audit qilinmaydi — rulesets'ni Terraform bilan org darajasida boshqaring. Favqulodda holat uchun break-glass jarayoni (loglangan) bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-33173	<p>Katta binary fayllar (dataset, model, video) Git'da nega muammo va yechim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git har versiyaning to'liq nusxasini saqlaydi va har clone butun tarixni yuklaydi — 500 MB model 10 marta o'zgarsa repo 5 GB bo'ladi. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34092	<p><code>git commit</code> ostida nima saqlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Commit — butun loyihaning <b>snapshot</b>'i, diff emas. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34094	<p><code>git push</code> va <code>git pull</code> ostida nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>fetch</code> remote'dan yangi obyektlarni yuklab, <code>origin/main</code> ko'rsatkichini yangilaydi — lokal <code>main</code> ga tegmaydi. <code>pull</code> = fetch + lokal branch'ga birlashtirish. <code>push</code> remote branch'ni sizning commit'ingizga siljitadi, lekin faqat <b>fast-forward</b> bo'lsa (remote'da siz bilmagan commit bo'lmasa).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>push:<br>  local main:  A-B-C-D<br>  remote main: A-B-C       -&gt; fast-forward OK, remote main = D<br>  remote main: A-B-C-X     -&gt; rejected (X sizda yo'q)<br><br>pull:<br>  fetch: origin/main = X<br>  merge/rebase: local main = A-B-C-X-D'</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git fetch<br>git log --oneline main..origin/main    # remote'da bor, menda yo'q<br>git log --oneline origin/main..main    # menda bor, remote'da yo'q<br>git pull --rebase                      # o'z commit'larimni ustiga qo'yish<br>git push<br># ! [rejected]  main -&gt; main (fetch first)  -&gt; avval pull</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rejected push'ni <code>--force</code> bilan yechish — hamkasbning commit X'i o'chadi. To'g'risi: pull, keyin push.</li><li><code>pull</code> merge commit yaratadi — <code>git config --global pull.rebase true</code>.</li><li>Push faqat joriy branch'ni (default <code>push.default=simple</code>) yuboradi; tag'lar alohida push qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Agar force kerak bo'lsa ham faqat <code>--force-with-lease</code> — u remote siz ko'rgan holatda bo'lsagina yozadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git

Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34104	<p><code>git remote -v</code> nima ko'rsatadi va <code>origin</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git remote -v</code> — repo bog'langan remote'lar ro'yxati va ularning fetch/push URL'larini ko'rsatadi. <code>origin</code> — <code>git clone</code> avtomatik bergan default remote nomi; maxsus ma'nosi yo'q, shunchaki kelishuv.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git remote -v<br># origin  git@github.com:org/app.git (fetch)<br># origin  git@github.com:org/app.git (push)<br><br>git remote add upstream https://github.com/orig/app.git<br>git remote set-url origin git@github.com:me/app.git   # HTTPS -&gt; SSH<br>git remote rename origin old<br>git remote remove old<br>git remote show origin        # tracking branch'lar, HEAD branch</pre><p><b>Fork bilan:</b></p><pre>upstream = asl repo (o'qish)   origin = sizning fork (yozish)<br>git fetch upstream -&gt; git rebase upstream/main -&gt; git push origin</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>URL'da token (<code>https://user:ghp_xxx@github.com/...</code>) — <code>.git/config</code> da ochiq turadi va loglarga tushadi. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34105	<p>Git'da SSH va HTTPS orqali ulanish farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SSH — kalit juftligi bilan autentifikatsiya (<code>git@github.com:org/app.git</code>, port 22); HTTPS — token bilan (<code>https://github.com/...</code>, port 443). Ikkalasi shifrlangan. Parol bilan HTTPS GitHub'da 2021 dan beri ishlamaydi — Personal Access Token yoki credential manager kerak.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | SSH | HTTPS | |---|---|---| | Auth | private key (<code>~/.ssh/id_ed25519</code>) | PAT / OAuth (credential helper) | | Port | 22 (yoki 443 <code>ssh.github.com</code>) | 443 | | Firewall | ba'zan bloklanadi | deyarli doim ochiq | | CI | deploy key | token (<code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code>) |</p><p><b>Amalda (SSH):</b></p><pre>ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C &quot;ali@example.com&quot;<br>cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub          # GitHub &gt; Settings &gt; SSH keys ga qo'shish<br>ssh -T git@github.com<br># Hi ali! Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34106	<p>Yangi branch yaratib, uni remote'ga birinchi marta qanday push qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git switch -c &lt;nom&gt;</code> bilan branch yaratasiz, commit qilasiz, keyin <code>git push -u origin &lt;nom&gt;</code> — remote'da branch yaratiladi va <code>-u</code> lokal branch'ni unga bog'laydi (upstream). Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34107	<p>Branch'ni lokal va remote'da qanday o'chirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Lokal: <code>git branch -d &lt;nom&gt;</code> (merge qilingan bo'lsa) yoki <code>-D</code> (majburan). Boshqalar o'chgan remote branch'larni <code>git fetch --prune</code> bilan tozalaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>lokal branch         -&gt; git branch -d<br>remote branch        -&gt; git push origin --delete<br>origin/&lt;nom&gt; (sizda) -&gt; git fetch --prune  (remote'da yo'q bo'lsa olib tashlanadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git branch -d feature/x          # merge bo'lmagan bo'lsa rad etadi<br># error: The branch 'feature/x' is not fully merged.<br>git branch -D feature/x          # baribir o'chirish<br>git push origin --delete feature/x<br>git fetch --prune<br>git config --global fetch.prune true<br># merge bo'lgan hamma lokal branch'larni tozalash<br>git branch --merged main | grep -v -E '^\*|main' | xargs git branch -d</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Squash merge'dan keyin <code>-d</code> &quot;not fully merged&quot; deydi — chunki commit'lar boshqa hash bilan main'da. Tekshirib <code>-D</code> ishlating.</li><li><code>-D</code> bilan merge bo'lmagan ishni o'chirish — tiklash faqat reflog orqali.</li><li>Protected branch'ni remote'dan o'chirib bo'lmaydi (bu yaxshi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitHub'da &quot;Automatically delete head branches&quot; ni yoqing — merge'dan keyin remote branch'lar o'zi tozalanadi, repo yuzlab eski branch bilan to'lmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34108	<p><code>git merge</code> va <code>git rebase</code> farqi (sodda)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham bir branch'dagi o'zgarishlarni boshqasiga qo'shadi. <b>Merge</b> — tarixni saqlab, yangi &quot;merge commit&quot; yaratadi. <b>Rebase</b> — commit'laringizni boshqa branch uchiga ko'chirib, qayta yozadi: tarix chiziqli, lekin hash'lar o'zgaradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Boshlang'ich:            merge:                  rebase:<br>A-B-C (main)             A-B-C------M            A-B-C-D'-E'<br>    \                        \     /<br>     D-E (feature)            D---E</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># merge<br>git switch main<br>git merge feature<br><br># rebase (o'z feature branch'ingizda)<br>git switch feature<br>git rebase main<br># konflikt: tuzatish -&gt; git add -&gt; git rebase --continue<br>git rebase --abort      # bekor qilish</pre><p><b>Qachon qaysi (sodda qoida):</b> | Vaziyat | Tanlov | |---|---| | O'z lokal branch'ingizni main bilan yangilash | rebase | | Boshqalar ham ishlatadigan branch | merge | | PR'ni main'ga qo'shish | jamoa kelishuvi (ko'pincha squash) |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Push qilingan umumiy branch'ni rebase qilish — boshqalarda tarix buziladi.</li><li>Rebase'dan keyin push rad etiladi — <code>git push --force-with-lease</code> kerak (oddiy <code>--force</code> emas).</li><li>Rebase'da bir xil konfliktni har commit uchun qayta hal qilish mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asosiy qoida: <b>umumiy (push qilingan) branch'ni rebase qilmang.</b> Qolgani — jamoa uslubi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34109	<p><code>git stash</code> nima uchun ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git stash</code> — commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlarni vaqtincha saqlab qo'yadi va working tree'ni tozalaydi. Branch almashtirish yoki <code>pull</code> qilish kerak bo'lganda, lekin ish hali commit'ga tayyor bo'lmaganda ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> Login sahifasi ustida ishlayapsiz, rahbar &quot;main'da bug bor, hozir tuzat&quot; dedi. Yarim ishni commit qilgingiz kelmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>o'zgarishlar --stash push--&gt; [stash@{0}, stash@{1}, ...] (stack)<br>toza papka  &lt;--stash pop---  (oxirgisi qaytadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git stash push -m &quot;wip login&quot;<br>git switch main<br># ... bug fix, commit, push<br>git switch feature/login<br>git stash list<br># stash@{0}: On feature/login: wip login<br>git stash pop               # qaytarib, stash'dan o'chiradi<br>git stash apply stash@{1}   # qaytaradi, lekin ro'yxatda qoladi<br>git stash -u                # yangi (untracked) fayllar bilan<br>git stash show -p           # ichida nima bor</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yangi fayllar default'da stash'ga kirmaydi — <code>-u</code> unutilsa ular joyida qoladi.</li><li><code>pop</code> konflikt bersa stash o'chmaydi — hal qilib, <code>git stash drop</code>.</li><li>Stash uzoq qolsa nima ekani unutiladi; <code>-m</code> bilan nom bering.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stash — qisqa muddatli vosita. Uzoqroq parallel ish uchun <code>git worktree</code> yoki WIP commit (keyin squash) ishonchliroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34110	<p><code>git reset --soft</code>, <code>--mixed</code>, <code>--hard</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uchala rejim ham branch'ni (HEAD) ko'rsatilgan commit'ga suradi. Farqi — o'zgarishlar qayerda qoladi: <code>--soft</code> — staging'da, <code>--mixed</code> (default) — faqat diskda (unstaged), <code>--hard</code> — <b>butunlay o'chadi</b>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Rejim | HEAD | Staging | Working dir | |---|---|---|---| | <code>--soft</code> | siljiydi | saqlanadi | saqlanadi | | <code>--mixed</code> | siljiydi | tozalanadi | saqlanadi | | <code>--hard</code> | siljiydi | tozalanadi | <b>o'chadi</b> |</p><pre>A - B - C (HEAD)   git reset HEAD~1   -&gt;   A - B (HEAD), C ning o'zgarishlari:<br>  --soft  -&gt; staged<br>  --mixed -&gt; unstaged<br>  --hard  -&gt; yo'q</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git reset --soft HEAD~1    # oxirgi commit'ni &quot;ochish&quot;, qayta commit qilish uchun<br>git reset HEAD~3           # 3 commit'ni bitta qilish uchun: keyin git add + commit<br>git reset --hard HEAD      # hamma commit qilinmagan o'zgarishni tashlash<br>git reset --hard origin/main   # lokalni remote bilan tenglash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--hard</code> commit qilinmagan o'zgarishni qaytarib bo'lmaydigan qilib o'chiradi — reflog ham yordam bermaydi.</li><li>Push qilingan commit'ni reset qilish — keyingi push rad etiladi va force kerak bo'ladi; umumiy branch'da <code>revert</code> ishlating.</li><li><code>git reset file</code> (fayl bilan) — faqat unstage qiladi, HEAD'ni siljitmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>--hard</code> dan oldin <code>git stash -u</code> yoki <code>git branch backup</code> — bir soniyalik sug'urta. Commit qilingan narsa yo'qolsa <code>git reflog</code> bilan qaytadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34112	<p>Yo'qolgan commit'ni qanday tiklaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git reflog</code> — HEAD qayerlarda bo'lganining lokal jurnali. Commit &quot;yo'qolsa&quot; (reset, o'chirilgan branch, noto'g'ri rebase), reflog'dan uning hash'ini topib, <code>git branch</code> bilan qayta tiklaysiz.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> <code>git reset --hard HEAD~2</code> qildingiz va kerakli &quot;login form&quot; commit'i ketdi. U aslida o'chmagan — shunchaki hech qaysi branch unga ko'rsatmayapti.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git reflog<br># 7c1d2e3 HEAD@{0}: reset: moving to HEAD~2<br># a1b2c3d HEAD@{1}: commit: login form       &lt;- kerakli<br># 9f8e7d6 HEAD@{2}: commit: add validation<br><br>git branch recover a1b2c3d      # xavfsiz: yangi branch<br># yoki joriy branch'ni qaytarish:<br>git reset --hard a1b2c3d<br><br># o'chirilgan branch: reflog'da &quot;checkout: moving from feature/x&quot; ni qidiring<br>git reflog | grep feature/x</pre><p><b>Saqlanish muddati:</b> reflog yozuvlari default ~90 kun (unreachable uchun 30 kun), keyin <code>git gc</code> tozalaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlar reflog'da yo'q — <code>reset --hard</code> ularni butunlay o'chiradi.</li><li>Reflog faqat <b>sizning</b> kompyuteringizda — boshqa clone'da yoki GitHub'da yo'q.</li><li>Tiklashni <code>reset --hard</code> bilan qilish joriy commit qilinmagan ishni o'chiradi — <code>git branch</code> xavfsizroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shuning uchun &quot;tez-tez commit qiling&quot; — commit qilingan narsa deyarli yo'qolmaydi. Keyin <code>rebase -i</code> bilan tartiblash mumkin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34113	<p><code>git cherry-pick</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git cherry-pick</code> — boshqa branch'dagi bitta (yoki bir nechta) commit'ni olib, uni joriy branch'ga yangi commit sifatida qo'llaydi. Odatda hotfix'ni release branch'ga o'tkazish uchun.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> Bug fix <code>main</code> ga tushdi, lekin prod <code>release/1.2</code> dan ishlaydi. Butun main'ni emas, faqat shu fix'ni olish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>main:        A - B - F(fix) - C<br>release/1.2: A - R1<br>cherry-pick F -&gt; release/1.2: A - R1 - F'   (F' yangi hash, bir xil o'zgarish)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git log --oneline main | grep &quot;fix&quot;      # 4f9e2a1 fix(pay): rounding<br>git switch release/1.2<br>git cherry-pick -x 4f9e2a1<br>git cherry-pick A..B           # A dan keyingi B gacha (A kirmaydi)<br>git cherry-pick A^..B          # A ham kiradi<br># konflikt:<br>git status; # tuzatish<br>git add . &amp;&amp; git cherry-pick --continue<br>git cherry-pick --abort</pre><p><code>-x</code> commit message'ga &quot;(cherry picked from commit 4f9e2a1)&quot; qo'shadi — kuzatish oson.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Fix boshqa commit'ga bog'liq bo'lsa (yangi funksiya ishlatsa) — build buziladi.</li><li>Bir xil o'zgarish ikki branch'da turli hash bilan — keyinchalik merge'da chalkashlik.</li><li>Ko'p cherry-pick qilish — branch strategiyasi muammosi belgisi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Fix har doim avval <code>main</code> ga, keyin release'ga cherry-pick — teskarisi keyingi relizda bug qaytishiga olib keladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34114	<p>Tag nima va lightweight va annotated tag farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tag — aniq commit'ga qo'yilgan doimiy nom (masalan, <code>v1.2.0</code>). <b>Lightweight</b> tag — faqat ko'rsatkich. <b>Annotated</b> tag — muallif, sana, xabar (va imzo) saqlanadigan alohida obyekt. Relizlar uchun annotated tavsiya etiladi.</p><p><b>Branch'dan farqi:</b> branch yangi commit bilan siljiydi, tag esa joyida qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>lightweight: v1.2.0-rc1 -&gt; commit<br>annotated:   v1.2.0 -&gt; tag obyekt (kim, qachon, xabar) -&gt; commit</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git tag -a v1.2.0 -m &quot;Release 1.2.0&quot;   # annotated (tavsiya)<br>git tag v1.2.0-rc1                      # lightweight<br>git tag                                 # ro'yxat<br>git show v1.2.0                         # tagger, sana, xabar + commit<br>git push origin v1.2.0                  # bitta tag<br>git push --tags                         # hammasi (ehtiyot)<br>git tag -d v1.2.0-rc1                   # lokal o'chirish<br>git push origin --delete v1.2.0-rc1     # remote o'chirish<br>git checkout v1.2.0                     # detached HEAD holatida ko'rish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git push</code> tag'larni avtomatik yubormaydi — alohida push kerak.</li><li>Chiqarilgan tag'ni ko'chirish yoki o'chirib qayta yaratish — boshqalarda eski versiya qoladi. Yangi versiya chiqaring (<code>v1.2.1</code>).</li><li><code>git describe</code> default holatda faqat annotated tag'larni ko'radi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI ko'pincha <code>v*</code> tag push'da release build va Docker image (<code>app:1.2.0</code>) yaratadi — shuning uchun tag yaratish huquqini cheklash (tag protection) kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34115	<p>Pull request (merge request) nima va nega kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pull request (GitLab'da merge request) — &quot;mening branch'imdagi o'zgarishlarni main'ga qo'shing&quot; degan so'rov. Unda kod review, avtomatik CI tekshiruvlari va muhokama bo'ladi; branch protection bilan birga u main'ga kirishning yagona yo'li bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b></p><ul><li>Ikkinchi ko'z — xato, xavfsizlik muammosi, noaniq kod ushlanadi.</li><li>Bilim almashish — jamoa kodni biladi.</li><li>CI — test/lint avtomatik ishlaydi.</li><li>Audit — kim, nima, nega qo'shgani yozib qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>branch -&gt; push -&gt; PR ochish -&gt; CI (test, lint) -&gt; review -&gt; approve -&gt; merge -&gt; deploy<br>                      ^                              |<br>                      +------ o'zgartirish so'raldi -+</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git switch -c fix/login-timeout<br>git commit -am &quot;fix(auth): login timeout 30s&quot;<br>git push -u origin fix/login-timeout<br>gh pr create --title &quot;fix(auth): login timeout&quot; --body &quot;Nega: ... Qanday test qilindi: ...&quot;<br>gh pr checks              # CI holati<br>gh pr merge --squash</pre><p><b>Merge usullari:</b> | Usul | Natija | |---|---| | Merge commit | barcha commit'lar + merge commit | | Squash | PR = bitta commit | | Rebase | commit'lar chiziqli ko'chiriladi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>2000 qatorli PR — review sifatsiz bo'ladi (&quot;LGTM&quot;). 200-400 qatorgacha saqlang.</li><li>Tavsifsiz PR — reviewer kontekstni taxmin qiladi.</li><li>CI qizil holatda review so'rash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PR hajmi va review tezligi delivery tezligiga to'g'ridan ta'sir qiladi. Kichik PR + tez review (bir necha soat ichida) jamoa madaniyati bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34116	<p>Squash merge nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Squash merge — PR'dagi barcha commit'larni <b>bitta</b> commit'ga birlashtirib main'ga qo'shish. Natijada main tarixi toza (har PR = 1 commit), revert oson; lekin PR ichidagi batafsil qadamlar main'da ko'rinmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>feature: A - wip - fix typo - review fix - tests<br>squash merge -&gt; main: ... - S  (&quot;feat(auth): login form (#142)&quot;)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># GitHub/GitLab'da &quot;Squash and merge&quot; tugmasi yoki:<br>gh pr merge 142 --squash<br><br># lokal<br>git switch main<br>git merge --squash feature/login<br>git commit -m &quot;feat(auth): login form&quot;<br><br># PR ichida o'zingiz tartiblash<br>git rebase -i origin/main     # pick / squash / fixup</pre><p>| | Afzallik | Kamchilik | |---|---|---| | Squash | toza main, oson revert/bisect | PR ichidagi tarix yo'qoladi | | Merge commit | to'liq tarix | &quot;wip&quot;, &quot;fix typo&quot; main'da | | Rebase merge | chiziqli, commit'lar saqlanadi | har commit sifatli bo'lishi kerak |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Squash'dan keyin lokal branch'ni <code>git branch -d</code> o'chirmaydi (&quot;not fully merged&quot;) — hash'lar boshqa, <code>-D</code> kerak.</li><li>Squash qilingan branch'da ishni davom ettirib yana PR — eski commit'lar qayta keladi, konflikt.</li><li>Commit message PR sarlavhasidan olinadi — sarlavhani Conventional Commits formatida yozing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Squash katta PR'larda yaxshi ma'lumotni yo'qotadi; yechim — PR'larni kichik saqlash, shunda &quot;bitta PR = bitta mantiqiy o'zgarish&quot; tabiiy bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34117	<p><code>git diff</code> ning turlari: working, staged, branch'lar orasida?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git diff</code> turlari nimani nima bilan solishtirishga bog'liq: <code>git diff</code> — disk vs staging, <code>git diff --staged</code> — staging vs oxirgi commit, <code>git diff A..B</code> — ikki commit/branch, <code>-- path</code> bilan faqat bitta fayl.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>working tree  &lt;--git diff--&gt;  index  &lt;--git diff --staged--&gt;  HEAD<br>                     &lt;--------- git diff HEAD ---------&gt;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git diff                       # hali add qilinmagan o'zgarishlar<br>git diff --staged              # commit'ga kiradigan o'zgarishlar<br>git diff HEAD                  # ikkalasi birga<br>git diff main..feature         # main uchidan feature uchigacha<br>git diff main...feature        # feature main'dan ajralgandan beri (PR ko'rinishi)<br>git diff HEAD~3 -- src/app.go  # bitta fayl, 3 commit oldin bilan<br>git diff --stat                # faqat fayllar va qator soni<br>git diff --name-only main      # o'zgargan fayllar ro'yxati (CI'da qulay)<br>git diff --word-diff           # so'z darajasida (matn uchun)</pre><p>Chiqishni o'qish: <code>-</code> bilan boshlangan qator o'chirilgan, <code>+</code> qo'shilgan, <code>@@ -10,6 +10,8 @@</code> — eski faylda 10-qatordan 6 qator, yangisida 10-qatordan 8 qator.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git diff</code> bo'sh — lekin o'zgarishlar staged bo'lishi mumkin, <code>--staged</code> ni tekshiring.</li><li><code>..</code> va <code>...</code> farqi: PR'da ko'rinadigan narsa — <code>...</code> (uch nuqta).</li><li>Untracked (yangi) fayllar <code>git diff</code> da ko'rinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'da <code>git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD</code> bilan faqat o'zgargan servislarni build/test qilish — monorepo'da asosiy tezlashtirish usuli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34118	<p><code>git log</code> ni qulay ko'rish uchun qaysi flag'lar?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng foydali to'plam: <code>--oneline --graph --all --decorate</code> (daraxt ko'rinishi), <code>-p -- file</code> (fayl tarixi), <code>--author</code>/<code>--since</code> (filtr), <code>-S</code>/<code>-G</code> (kod ichidan qidirish). Ularni alias qilib qo'yish vaqtni tejaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git log --oneline --graph --all --decorate<br># * 9f8e7d6 (HEAD -&gt; main, origin/main) fix: rounding<br># | * 1a2b3c4 (feature/x) wip<br># |/<br># * 7a6b5c4 (tag: v1.2.0) release<br><br>git log -p -- internal/pay/fee.go          # fayl tarixi diff bilan<br>git log --follow -- new_name.go            # rename'dan oldingi tarix ham<br>git log --author=ali --since=&quot;2 weeks ago&quot;<br>git log -S &quot;password&quot;                       # shu matn qo'shilgan/o'chirilgan commit'lar<br>git log -G &quot;retry\(.*\)&quot;                    # regex bo'yicha diff'da<br>git log main..feature                       # feature'da bor, main'da yo'q<br>git log --format='%h %an %ar %s'            # o'z formatingiz<br>git log --stat -5                           # oxirgi 5 ta, fayl statistikasi bilan</pre><p>Alias:</p><pre>git config --global alias.lg &quot;log --oneline --graph --all --decorate&quot;<br>git lg</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--follow</code> bitta fayl bilangina ishlaydi; rename'dan keyin tarix ko'rinmasa shuni qo'shing.</li><li><code>--all</code> siz faqat joriy branch tarixi ko'rinadi.</li><li>Juda katta repo'da <code>-S</code> sekin — <code>-- path</code> bilan cheklang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>git log -S</code> — &quot;bu funksiya qachon va nega paydo bo'ldi/yo'qoldi&quot; degan savolning eng tez javobi; debug va code archaeology'da kuchli vosita.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34119	<p>Git'ga secret (parol, kalit) commit qilib qo'ysangiz nima qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng birinchi — kalitni <b>bekor qiling va yangisini yarating (rotate)</b>. Keyin uni kim ishlatganini tekshiring, tarixdan o'chiring (<code>git filter-repo</code>), va kelajakda takrorlanmasligi uchun scanner qo'ying. <code>git rm</code> yetarli emas — fayl tarixda qoladi.</p><p><b>Nega rotate birinchi:</b> Push qilingan secret'ni bot'lar soniyalarda topadi. Tarixni tozalaguningizcha kimdir uni nusxalab bo'lgan.</p><p><b>Tartib:</b></p><pre>1. revoke/rotate (daqiqalar ichida)<br>2. audit: kalit bilan nima qilindi<br>3. tarixdan o'chirish + force push<br>4. jamoa qayta clone qiladi<br>5. oldini olish: pre-commit + CI scan + push protection</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># 3. tarixdan o'chirish<br>pip install git-filter-repo<br>git filter-repo --path .env --invert-paths<br>git push --force --all<br><br># 5. oldini olish<br>echo &quot;.env&quot; &gt;&gt; .gitignore<br>gitleaks git --staged            # pre-commit'da<br>gitleaks git -v                  # butun tarixni tekshirish</pre><p>GitHub: Settings &gt; Code security &gt; <b>Secret scanning</b> va <b>Push protection</b> ni yoqing — secret'li push'ni o'zi rad etadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat <code>git rm .env</code> + commit — kalit eski commit'da hali bor.</li><li>Faqat tarixni tozalash, rotate qilmaslik — fork va clone'larda nusxa qoladi.</li><li>Bir xil parol boshqa joylarda ham ishlatilgan bo'lsa — hammasini almashtiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Secret'lar umuman repo'da bo'lmasligi kerak: Vault/secret manager va CI'da qisqa muddatli credential (OIDC) — shunda &quot;tasodifan commit&quot; xavfi o'zi kamayadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34120	<p>Detached HEAD nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Detached HEAD — HEAD branch'ga emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aniq commit'ga ko'rsatib turgan holat (tag yoki SHA checkout qilinganda). Ko'rish uchun xavfsiz, lekin bu yerda commit qilsangiz va branch yaratmay chiqib ketsangiz, commit'lar &quot;yo'qoladi&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy:      HEAD -&gt; main -&gt; C<br>Detached:   HEAD -&gt; C   (hech qaysi branch yo'q)<br>commit:     HEAD -&gt; D -&gt; C     (D ga hech qaysi branch ko'rsatmaydi)<br>switch main: D &quot;osilib&quot; qoladi, gc keyin o'chiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git switch --detach v1.0.0       # yoki: git checkout v1.0.0<br># You are in 'detached HEAD' state...<br>git status                       # HEAD detached at v1.0.0<br><br># eksperiment qilib, saqlamoqchi bo'lsangiz:<br>git switch -c fix-from-v1        # yangi branch, commit'lar saqlanadi<br><br># allaqachon chiqib ketgan bo'lsangiz:<br>git reflog                       # D hash'ini toping<br>git branch rescue &lt;D-hash&gt;</pre><p><b>Qachon uchraydi:</b></p><ul><li><code>git checkout &lt;tag&gt;</code> yoki <code>&lt;sha&gt;</code>.</li><li>Rebase/bisect jarayoni o'rtasida.</li><li>Submodule ichida (har doim detached).</li><li>CI checkout (aniq SHA).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Detached holatda ishlab, <code>switch main</code> qilish — Git ogohlantiradi, lekin e'tibor bermasangiz commit'lar ko'rinmaydi.</li><li>Submodule ichida commit qilib push qilmaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Detached HEAD — xato emas, normal holat (CI deyarli doim shunda). Faqat u yerda yangi ish boshlasangiz, darhol branch yarating.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git

Clone'dan keyin papka yo'q — ilova xato beradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>mkdir logs &amp;&amp; touch logs/.gitkeep<br>git add logs/.gitkeep<br>git commit -m &quot;keep logs dir&quot;</pre><p>Yaxshiroq variant — papka ichidagi narsalar ignore qilinsin, lekin papka qolsin:</p><pre># logs/.gitignore<br>*<br>!.gitignore</pre><p>Bu holatda papka saqlanadi va ichiga tushgan log fayllar tasodifan commit bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Root <code>.gitignore</code> da <code>logs/</code> yozilgan bo'lsa, <code>logs/.gitkeep</code> ham ignore bo'ladi — <code>git add -f</code> yoki <code>logs/*</code> + <code>!logs/.gitkeep</code> kerak.</li><li><code>.gitkeep</code> nomi maxsus emas — <code>.keep</code> yoki istalgan nom ham ishlaydi; jamoada bir xil bo'lsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'pincha eng toza yechim — ilovaning o'zi kerakli papkani yaratishi (<code>os.MkdirAll(&quot;logs&quot;, 0o755)</code>).
