Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34122	<p>Merge conflict belgilarini qanday o'qiysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Konflikt belgilari faylda ikki variantni ko'rsatadi: <code>&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt; HEAD</code> dan <code>=======</code> gacha — joriy branch (siz), <code>=======</code> dan <code>&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;</code> gacha — kirib kelayotgan branch. Siz to'g'ri natijani qoldirib, barcha belgilarni o'chirasiz, keyin <code>git add</code>.</p><p><b>O'qish:</b></p><pre>&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt; HEAD<br>port: 8080              &lt;- siz turgan branch (main)<br>=======<br>port: 9090              &lt;- qo'shilayotgan branch<br>&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt; feature/port</pre><p>Base (asl) qiymatni ham ko'rish uchun:</p><pre>git config --global merge.conflictstyle zdiff3</pre><pre>&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt; HEAD<br>port: 8080<br>||||||| base<br>port: 8000              &lt;- ikkalasi o'zgartirishdan oldin<br>=======<br>port: 9090<br>&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt; feature/port</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git merge feature/port<br>git status                         # both modified: config.yaml<br># faylni tahrirlash: port: 9090 (yoki ikkalasini birlashtirish)<br>git add config.yaml<br>git merge --continue               # yoki: git commit<br>git merge --abort                  # hammasini bekor qilish<br>git checkout --theirs config.yaml  # butunlay ularning versiyasi<br>git checkout --ours config.yaml    # butunlay sizning versiyangiz</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rebase paytida <code>HEAD</code> = main (upstream), pastki qism = sizning commit — ours/theirs teskari.</li><li>Belgilarni qoldirib commit qilish — kod kompilyatsiya bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Bir variantni ko'r-ko'rona tanlash — ikkala o'zgarish ham kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konfliktdan keyin har doim test ishga tushiring — Git faqat matnni birlashtiradi, mantiqni emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34123	<p>Git Flow va trunk-based development farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Git Flow</b> — ko'p uzun branch'li model (main, develop, feature, release, hotfix), relizlar rejali. <b>Trunk-based</b> — hamma qisqa branch'lar (soatlar-1 kun) orqali bitta <code>main</code> ga tez-tez merge qiladi, tugallanmagan ish feature flag ortida. SaaS va CI/CD uchun trunk-based standart.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Trunk-based:<br>main:  --o---o---o---o---o--&gt;   (har merge -&gt; deploy)<br>          \_/ \_/ \_/<br>         kichik PR'lar<br><br>Git Flow:<br>main:     o--------------o (v1.0)<br>develop:  -o-o-o-o-o-o-o/-o-o<br>feature:     \-o-o-o-o/   (haftalar)</pre><p>| | Git Flow | Trunk-based | |---|---|---| | Branch'lar | main, develop, feature, release, hotfix | main + qisqa feature | | Reliz | rejalashtirilgan | tez-tez, uzluksiz | | Merge conflict | ko'p, katta | kam, kichik | | Mos | versiyalangan dastur (mobil, on-prem) | SaaS, CI/CD |</p><p><b>Amalda (trunk-based):</b></p><pre>// tugallanmagan feature main'da, lekin o'chiq<br>if flags.Enabled(&quot;new-checkout&quot;) {<br>    newCheckout()<br>} else {<br>    oldCheckout()<br>}</pre><p>Talablar: har PR'da avtomatik test, kichik PR, tez review.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Testlarsiz trunk-based — main tez-tez buziladi.</li><li>Eski feature flag'larni olib tashlamaslik — kod chalkashadi.</li><li>Git Flow'ni har kuni deploy qilinadigan servisga qo'llash — ortiqcha murakkablik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Model tanlash mahsulot turiga bog'liq: bir vaqtda bir nechta versiyani qo'llab-quvvatlash kerak bo'lsa — release branch'lar; bo'lmasa — trunk-based.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34124	<p>Fork va clone farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Clone</b> — repo'ni o'z kompyuteringizga ko'chirish (Git buyrug'i). <b>Fork</b> — repo'ning server tomonidagi (GitHub/GitLab) sizga tegishli nusxasi (platforma funksiyasi). Yozish huquqi bo'lmagan loyihaga hissa qo'shish uchun avval fork, keyin o'z fork'ingizni clone qilasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>github.com/org/app  --fork--&gt;  github.com/siz/app  --clone--&gt; laptop<br>     (upstream)                      (origin)<br>         ^                                                     |<br>         +-------- Pull Request &lt;------ push (origin) &lt;--------+</pre><p><b>Amalda (open source'ga hissa):</b></p><pre>gh repo fork org/app --clone       # fork + clone + upstream remote<br># yoki qo'lda:<br>git clone git@github.com:siz/app.git &amp;&amp; cd app<br>git remote add upstream https://github.com/org/app.git<br><br>git switch -c fix/typo<br>git commit -am &quot;docs: fix typo&quot;<br>git push -u origin fix/typo<br>gh pr create --repo org/app<br><br># fork'ni yangilash<br>git fetch upstream<br>git switch main &amp;&amp; git rebase upstream/main<br>git push origin main</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Fork'ning <code>main</code> ida ishlash — keyingi PR'lar aralashib ketadi. Har PR uchun alohida branch.</li><li>Fork'ni yangilamaslik — PR eski kod ustida, konfliktlar.</li><li>Fork'dan kelgan PR'da CI secret'lari yo'q (xavfsizlik uchun) — testlar shunga moslashishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kompaniya ichida fork kamdan-kam kerak — bitta repo, branch'lar va branch protection oddiyroq. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34125	<p><code>git fetch --prune</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git fetch --prune</code> — remote'dan yangiliklarni yuklash bilan birga, remote'da allaqachon o'chirilgan branch'larning lokal nusxalarini (<code>origin/feature-x</code>) ham olib tashlaydi. Aks holda <code>git branch -r</code> da mavjud bo'lmagan branch'lar ko'rinib turaveradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GitHub: feature-x merge bo'ldi va o'chirildi<br>Sizda:  origin/feature-x hali bor (eskirgan ref)<br>git fetch --prune -&gt; origin/feature-x o'chiriladi</pre><p>Eslatma: bu faqat <code>origin/...</code> ref'larini tozalaydi, sizning <b>lokal</b> <code>feature-x</code> branch'ingizga tegmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git branch -r                    # remote-tracking branch'lar<br>git fetch --prune<br># - [deleted]  (none) -&gt; origin/feature-x<br>git config --global fetch.prune true    # har fetch'da avtomatik<br><br># remote'i yo'qolgan lokal branch'larni topish<br>git branch -vv | grep ': gone]'<br>git branch -vv | grep ': gone]' | awk '{print $1}' | xargs git branch -d<br>git remote prune origin --dry-run       # nima o'chishini ko'rish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prune lokal branch'larni o'chirmaydi — ular alohida tozalanadi.</li><li><code>git fetch --prune --prune-tags</code> lokal tag'larni ham o'chiradi — o'zingiz yaratgan tag'lar ketishi mumkin.</li><li>Prune'siz avtomatik skriptlar (masalan, branch ro'yxatiga qarab deploy) eskirgan ma'lumot bilan ishlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>fetch.prune true</code> — sozlab qo'yish va unutish kerak bo'lgan sozlamalardan biri; GitHub'dagi &quot;auto-delete head branches&quot; bilan birga repo toza turadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34126	<p>Faylni Git'dan o'chirib, lekin diskda qoldirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git rm --cached &lt;fayl&gt;</code> — faylni Git kuzatuvidan (index'dan) chiqaradi, lekin diskda qoldiradi. Keyin <code>.gitignore</code> ga qo'shib, commit qilasiz. Fayl eski commit'larda baribir qoladi.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> <code>.env</code> yoki <code>config.local.yaml</code> tasodifan commit bo'lgan. Uni repo'dan chiqarish kerak, lekin o'zingizning lokal nusxangiz kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git rm --cached .env<br>echo &quot;.env&quot; &gt;&gt; .gitignore<br>git add .gitignore<br>git commit -m &quot;stop tracking .env&quot;<br>git status          # .env endi ko'rinmaydi (ignored)<br><br># butun papka<br>git rm -r --cached node_modules/</pre><p>Farq: | Buyruq | Index | Disk | |---|---|---| | <code>git rm file</code> | o'chiriladi | o'chiriladi | | <code>git rm --cached file</code> | o'chiriladi | qoladi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Boshqalar <code>git pull</code> qilganda fayl <b>ularning diskidan o'chadi</b> (Git uni &quot;o'chirilgan&quot; deb ko'radi). Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34127	<p><code>HEAD~1</code> va <code>HEAD^</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham commit'ning ota-onasiga ishora qiladi. <code>HEAD~n</code> — birinchi ota bo'ylab n qadam orqaga (bobosi, katta bobosi). <code>HEAD^n</code> — merge commit'ning n-ota-onasi (<code>^1</code> birinchi, <code>^2</code> ikkinchi). Oddiy commit'da <code>HEAD~1</code> = <code>HEAD^</code> = <code>HEAD^1</code>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>      D---E (feature)<br>     /     \<br>A---B---C---M  &lt;- HEAD (merge commit)<br><br>HEAD~1 = HEAD^1 = C   (birinchi ota, main tomoni)<br>HEAD^2           = E   (ikkinchi ota, feature tomoni)<br>HEAD~2           = B   (birinchi ota bo'ylab 2 qadam)<br>HEAD^2~1         = D</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git show HEAD~1              # oldingi commit<br>git diff HEAD~3 HEAD         # oxirgi 3 commit o'zgarishlari<br>git reset --soft HEAD~2      # oxirgi 2 commit'ni ochish<br>git log HEAD^2 --oneline     # merge'da kelgan branch tarixi<br>git show HEAD@{2}            # reflog bo'yicha (boshqa narsa!)<br>git rev-parse HEAD~1         # to'liq hash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>HEAD@{n}</code> (reflog: HEAD qayerda bo'lgan) bilan <code>HEAD~n</code> (ota-onalar) ni adashtirish.</li><li>zsh'da <code>HEAD^</code> maxsus belgi — <code>HEAD\^</code> yoki <code>'HEAD^'</code> deb yozing, yoki <code>HEAD~1</code> ishlating.</li><li>Merge commit'ni revert qilishda <code>-m 1</code> qaysi ota &quot;asosiy&quot; ekanini bildiradi — xuddi <code>^1</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>~</code> va <code>^</code> ni tushunish merge tarixida navigatsiya, <code>revert -m</code> va <code>rebase --onto</code> kabi aniq operatsiyalar uchun zarur.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34128	<p>Git LFS nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git LFS (Large File Storage) — katta binar fayllar (rasm, video, dizayn, model) uchun kengaytma: repo'da faqat kichik <b>pointer</b> fayl saqlanadi, haqiqiy mazmun alohida LFS serverda. Natijada clone tez, repo shishmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy Git har versiyani to'liq saqlaydi va har clone butun tarixni yuklaydi. 200 MB <code>.psd</code> 20 marta o'zgarsa — 4 GB repo, har dasturchi uni yuklaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>commit ichida:  design.psd -&gt;  version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1<br>                               oid sha256:4d7a...<br>                               size 209715200<br>LFS server:     sha256:4d7a... -&gt; haqiqiy 200 MB<br>checkout:       faqat joriy versiya yuklanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git lfs install                    # bir marta<br>git lfs track &quot;*.psd&quot;              # .gitattributes ga yoziladi<br>git add .gitattributes design.psd<br>git commit -m &quot;add design&quot;<br>git push<br>git lfs ls-files                   # LFS'dagi fayllar<br>cat .gitattributes<br># *.psd filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.gitattributes</code> ni commit qilmaslik — boshqalar faylni oddiy Git'ga qo'shadi.</li><li>LFS'ni keyin yoqish eski tarixni tozalamaydi — <code>git lfs migrate import</code> (tarix qayta yoziladi).</li><li>GitHub'da LFS storage va bandwidth limiti bor — CI har safar yuklasa kvota tugaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> LFS — dizayn/asset fayllar uchun. Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34129	<p>Branch protection rules nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Branch protection rules — muhim branch'lar (<code>main</code>, <code>release/*</code>) uchun platforma (GitHub/GitLab) qoidalari: to'g'ridan push yo'q, PR + review majburiy, CI yashil bo'lishi shart, force push va o'chirish taqiqlangan. Ular &quot;kimdir tasodifan main'ni buzishi&quot;ni texnik jihatdan imkonsiz qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git push origin main     -&gt; rad etiladi (protected)<br>PR -&gt; CI qizil           -&gt; merge tugmasi bloklangan<br>PR -&gt; approval yo'q      -&gt; merge tugmasi bloklangan<br>PR -&gt; CI yashil + 1 approve -&gt; merge mumkin</pre><p><b>Odatiy sozlamalar:</b> | Qoida | Nega | |---|---| | Require pull request | to'g'ridan push yo'q | | 1-2 approval | ikkinchi ko'z | | Dismiss stale approvals | approve'dan keyingi push qayta review | | Require status checks | test/lint o'tmasa merge yo'q | | CODEOWNERS review | muhim papkaga egasi tasdig'i | | Block force push / deletion | tarix himoyasi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># GitHub CLI bilan holatni ko'rish<br>gh api repos/org/app/branches/main/protection<br># yangi usul: Rulesets (Settings &gt; Rules &gt; Rulesets)</pre><p>To'g'ridan push urinishida:</p><pre>remote: error: GH006: Protected branch update failed for refs/heads/main.</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Admin'larga bypass ruxsat berish — qoidalar amalda ishlamaydi.</li><li>Required check nomi o'zgarsa PR'lar &quot;Expected — Waiting&quot; holatida qotib qoladi.</li><li>Qoidalarni qo'lda sozlash — repo'lar orasida farq va audit yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p repo'li tashkilotda qoidalarni org darajasidagi rulesets va Terraform orqali boshqaring — bir joyda, versiyalangan, audit qilinadigan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34131	<p>Git hook nima? pre-commit misoli.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git hook — Git hodisasi (commit, push va h.k.) paytida avtomatik ishga tushadigan skript, <code>.git/hooks/</code> papkasida yashaydi. <code>pre-commit</code> hook commit yaratilishidan oldin ishlaydi; u nolga teng bo'lmagan kod bilan chiqsa, commit bekor bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git commit -&gt; .git/hooks/pre-commit<br>                 exit 0 -&gt; commit yaratiladi<br>                 exit 1 -&gt; commit bekor, xabar ko'rsatiladi</pre><p>Boshqa hook'lar: <code>commit-msg</code> (xabar formati), <code>pre-push</code> (push'dan oldin test), serverda <code>pre-receive</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat &gt; .git/hooks/pre-commit &lt;&lt;'EOF'<br>#!/bin/sh<br>terraform fmt -check -recursive || { echo &quot;terraform fmt kerak&quot;; exit 1; }<br>gitleaks git --staged || exit 1<br>EOF<br>chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit</pre><p>Jamoa uchun — <code>pre-commit</code> framework:</p><pre># .pre-commit-config.yaml<br>repos:<br>  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks<br>    rev: v5.0.0<br>    hooks:<br>      - id: trailing-whitespace<br>      - id: check-yaml</pre><pre>pip install pre-commit &amp;&amp; pre-commit install</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.git/hooks</code> repo bilan tarqalmaydi — har kim o'zi o'rnatishi kerak (framework/husky shuni hal qiladi).</li><li><code>chmod +x</code> unutilsa hook jimgina ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>git commit --no-verify</code> hook'ni chetlab o'tadi — shuning uchun xuddi shu tekshiruvlar CI'da ham bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hook — tez feedback uchun qulaylik, CI — majburiy nazorat. Hook'ni sekin qilsangiz, dasturchilar <code>--no-verify</code> ga o'rganadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34132	<p><code>git blame</code> qachon foydali?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git blame</code> — faylning har bir qatorini oxirgi marta qaysi commit, kim va qachon o'zgartirganini ko'rsatadi. Foydali payt: g'alati kodni ko'rib &quot;nega shunday yozilgan?&quot; deganingizda — commit va PR'dan kontekst topasiz.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> <code>timeout := 47 * time.Second</code> — nega 47? <code>blame</code> commit'ni ko'rsatadi, <code>show</code> dan PR havolasi, PR'da esa &quot;upstream LB 50s'da uzadi&quot; degan tushuntirish.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git blame -L 40,60 app.go<br># 9f8e7d6a (Ali Valiyev 2026-03-02 14:10:22 +0500 42)  timeout := 47 * time.Second<br>git show 9f8e7d6a                 # commit message va diff<br>git blame -w -C -C app.go         # bo'shliq va boshqa fayldan ko'chirishni o'tkazib yuborish<br>git blame 9f8e7d6a^ -- app.go     # o'sha o'zgarishdan oldingi holat</pre><p>Formatlash commit'larini e'tiborsiz qoldirish:</p><pre>echo &quot;&lt;format-commit-sha&gt;&quot; &gt;&gt; .git-blame-ignore-revs<br>git config blame.ignoreRevsFile .git-blame-ignore-revs</pre><p>GitHub ham <code>.git-blame-ignore-revs</code> faylini avtomatik hisobga oladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta formatlash/refactor commit'i hamma qatorni &quot;egallaydi&quot; — ignore-revs ishlating.</li><li>Qator boshqa fayldan ko'chirilgan bo'lsa, blame ko'chirgan odamni ko'rsatadi — <code>-C</code>.</li><li>Blame'ni &quot;aybdor topish&quot; uchun ishlatish — jamoa madaniyatini buzadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maqsad — aybdor emas, <b>kontekst</b>.
