Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34134	<p><code>git bisect</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git bisect</code> — bug kiritgan commit'ni ikkiga bo'lib qidirish (binary search) usuli bilan topadi. Siz &quot;bu yerda ishlagan&quot; va &quot;bu yerda buzuq&quot; nuqtalarni berasiz, Git o'rtadagi commit'larni navbat bilan ochadi, siz har birini good/bad deb belgilaysiz. 1000 commit — taxminan 10 qadam.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>v1.4.0 (good) .......................... HEAD (bad)<br>                  ^ o'rta: test -&gt; good<br>                          ^ test -&gt; bad<br>                      ^ test -&gt; ... -&gt; &quot;birinchi buzuq commit&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git bisect start<br>git bisect bad              # hozirgi holat buzuq<br>git bisect good v1.4.0      # bu versiyada ishlagan<br># Git o'rtadagi commit'ga o'tadi -&gt; testlang<br>go test ./...<br>git bisect good             # yoki: git bisect bad<br># ... bir necha qadam<br># a1b2c3d is the first bad commit<br>git bisect reset            # asl branch'ga qaytish</pre><p>Avtomatik:</p><pre>git bisect start HEAD v1.4.0<br>git bisect run ./test.sh    # exit 0 = good, 1 = bad, 125 = skip</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git bisect reset</code> ni unutish — detached HEAD holatida qolasiz.</li><li>Ba'zi commit'lar build bo'lmaydi — ularni <code>git bisect skip</code> bilan o'tkazing.</li><li>Test natijasi beqaror (flaky) bo'lsa, noto'g'ri commit topiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kichik, har biri build bo'ladigan commit'lar bisect'ni kuchli qiladi; ulkan commit'lar uni deyarli foydasiz qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34135	<p><code>git switch</code> va <code>git restore</code> nima uchun <code>checkout</code> o'rniga paydo bo'ldi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git checkout</code> juda ko'p ishni qilardi: branch almashtirish, branch yaratish, fayl o'zgarishini tashlash, eski versiyani tiklash. Bu chalkashlik va xatolarga olib kelardi. Git 2.23 (2019) uni ikkiga bo'ldi: <code>git switch</code> — branch'lar uchun, <code>git restore</code> — fayllar uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo (checkout bilan):</b></p><pre>git checkout main      # branch'ga o'tish<br>git checkout main.go   # faylni tashlash!  (main nomli fayl bo'lsa nima bo'ladi?)</pre><p>Bir xil buyruq — butunlay boshqa (va xavfli) natija.</p><p><b>Moslik jadvali:</b> | Eski | Yangi | |---|---| | <code>git checkout main</code> | <code>git switch main</code> | | <code>git checkout -b new</code> | <code>git switch -c new</code> | | <code>git checkout &lt;tag&gt;</code> | <code>git switch --detach &lt;tag&gt;</code> | | <code>git checkout -- file.go</code> | <code>git restore file.go</code> | | <code>git reset HEAD file.go</code> | <code>git restore --staged file.go</code> | | <code>git checkout HEAD~2 -- f</code> | <code>git restore --source=HEAD~2 f</code> |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git switch main<br>git switch -c feature/login<br>git switch -                 # oldingi branch'ga qaytish<br>git restore app.go           # o'zgarishni bekor qilish<br>git restore --staged app.go  # unstage<br>git restore --staged --worktree app.go   # ikkalasi birga</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git restore file</code> commit qilinmagan o'zgarishni qaytarib bo'lmaydigan qilib o'chiradi.</li><li><code>switch</code> tag yoki SHA'ga <code>--detach</code> siz o'tmaydi — bu atayin xavfsizlik.</li><li>Eski qo'llanmalar <code>checkout</code> ishlatadi — ikkalasi ham ishlaydi, lekin yangilari aniqroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi dasturchilarga <code>switch</code>/<code>restore</code> ni o'rgating — ma'nosi aniq buyruqlar xatolar sonini kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34136	<p>Submodule nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Submodule — bir Git repo ichiga boshqa Git repo'ni ulash usuli. Ota repo faqat ichki repo'ning URL'ini (<code>.gitmodules</code>) va <b>aniq commit hash</b>'ini saqlaydi. Ichki kod ota repo'ga nusxalanmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app/<br>  .gitmodules:  vendor/lib -&gt; https://github.com/org/lib<br>  vendor/lib  = commit 7a6b5c4 ga &quot;qadalgan&quot;<br>lib yangilansa, app avtomatik o'zgarmaydi -&gt; qo'lda bump</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git submodule add https://github.com/org/lib vendor/lib<br>git commit -m &quot;add lib submodule&quot;<br><br># boshqa odam clone qilganda<br>git clone --recurse-submodules URL<br># yoki unutgan bo'lsa:<br>git submodule update --init --recursive<br><br># lib'ning yangi versiyasiga o'tish<br>git submodule update --remote vendor/lib<br>git add vendor/lib &amp;&amp; git commit -m &quot;bump lib&quot;<br><br>git submodule status          # qaysi commit'da turibdi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Clone'dan keyin <code>update --init</code> unutiladi — papka bo'sh, build xato beradi.</li><li><code>git pull</code> submodule'ni avtomatik yangilamaydi (<code>submodule.recurse true</code> sozlamasi yordam beradi).</li><li>Submodule ichida commit qilib, uni push qilmasdan ota repo'ni push qilish — boshqalar mavjud bo'lmagan commit'ni oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p hollarda package manager (Go modules, npm) yoki monorepo oddiyroq. Submodule — package manager bo'lmagan narsalar (proto fayllar, C kutubxonalar) uchun.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34137	<p><code>git shortlog</code> va <code>git describe</code> nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git shortlog</code> — commit'larni muallif bo'yicha guruhlab ko'rsatadi (kim qancha commit qilgan, release notes uchun). <code>git describe</code> — joriy commit'ni eng yaqin tag'ga nisbatan nomlaydi (<code>v1.2.0-5-g3a4b5c6</code>), bu build versiyasi uchun qulay.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git shortlog -sn                    # muallif bo'yicha commit soni<br>#    142  Ali Valiyev<br>#     87  Bob Smith<br>git shortlog v1.1.0..v1.2.0         # ikki reliz orasidagi o'zgarishlar, muallif bo'yicha<br><br>git describe --tags<br># v1.2.0-5-g3a4b5c6<br>#  |      |  |<br>#  tag    |  g + qisqa hash<br>#         tag'dan keyin 5 commit<br>git describe --tags --dirty         # commit qilinmagan o'zgarish bo'lsa &quot;-dirty&quot;<br>git describe --tags --abbrev=0      # faqat oxirgi tag: v1.2.0</pre><p><b>CI'da build versiyasi:</b></p><pre>VERSION=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty)<br>go build -ldflags &quot;-X main.version=$VERSION&quot; -o app .<br>./app --version     # v1.2.0-5-g3a4b5c6</pre><p>Shunda prod'dagi binary'dan aniq qaysi commit ekanini bilasiz.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CI'da shallow clone (<code>--depth 1</code>) bo'lsa tag'lar yo'q va <code>describe</code> xato beradi — <code>fetch-depth: 0</code> yoki <code>git fetch --tags</code>.</li><li><code>--tags</code> siz faqat annotated tag'lar hisobga olinadi.</li><li><code>shortlog</code> ga <code>.mailmap</code> bo'lmasa bir odam ikki xil email bilan ikki marta chiqadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har artefaktga <code>git describe</code> versiyasini kiritish — incident paytida &quot;prod'da qaysi kod?&quot; savoliga darhol javob beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::W1 Git	idrill-34138	<p>Katta repo'ni tez clone qilish usullari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uch asosiy usul: <b>shallow clone</b> (<code>--depth 1</code> — faqat oxirgi commit'lar), <b>partial clone</b> (<code>--filter=blob:none</code> — tarix bor, fayl mazmuni kerak bo'lganda yuklanadi) va <b>sparse-checkout</b> (faqat kerakli papkalar diskka chiqadi). CI uchun odatda shallow, dasturchi uchun partial.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>to'liq clone:   barcha commit + barcha fayl versiyalari<br>--depth 1:      faqat oxirgi commit (tarix yo'q)<br>--filter=blob:none: barcha commit/tree, fayllar talab bo'yicha<br>sparse:         diskda faqat tanlangan papkalar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git clone --depth 1 URL                         # CI: tez, kam trafik<br>git clone --filter=blob:none URL                # dasturchi: tarix bor, tez<br>git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse URL<br>cd repo &amp;&amp; git sparse-checkout set services/api # faqat bitta servis<br>git fetch --unshallow                           # keyin to'liq tarix kerak bo'lsa</pre><p>GitHub Actions:</p><pre>- uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>  with:<br>    fetch-depth: 1      # default; tag/tarix kerak bo'lsa 0</pre><p>| Usul | Kim uchun | Kamchilik | |---|---|---| | <code>--depth 1</code> | CI | <code>log</code>, <code>blame</code>, <code>describe</code> ishlamaydi | | <code>--filter=blob:none</code> | dasturchi | eski fayl ochilganda tarmoq kerak | | sparse-checkout | monorepo | tooling papkalarni ko'rmasligi mumkin |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--depth 1</code> bilan <code>git describe</code> tag'ni topa olmaydi — versiya noto'g'ri.</li><li>Shallow repo'dan push yoki merge ba'zan muammo beradi.</li><li>Partial clone'da offline ishlash qiyin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta repo'da CI clone vaqti umumiy pipeline vaqtining sezilarli qismi bo'lishi mumkin — clone strategiyasini o'lchab tanlang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::git sec::w1 Git
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42051	<p>Git nima va uning DAG arxitekturasi qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git — taqsimlangan versiya boshqaruv tizimi; ichida u content-addressable obyekt bazasi. Har commit — loyihaning to'liq snapshot'iga (tree) ishora va ota commit(lar)ga havola. Commit'lar ota-bola havolalari orqali DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph — yo'naltirilgan, tsiklsiz graf) hosil qiladi; branch esa shu grafdagi bitta commit'ga ko'rsatkich xolos.</p><p><b>Nega DAG:</b> Merge commit'ning ikki (yoki undan ko'p) otasi bor — shuning uchun tarix chiziq emas, graf. Tsikl bo'lishi mumkin emas: commit hash'i ota hash'ini o'z ichiga oladi, demak bola otadan oldin mavjud bo'lolmaydi.</p><pre>        C---D  feature<br>       /     \<br>A---B---E-----F  main  &lt;- HEAD<br>A &lt;- B &lt;- E &lt;- F    (havolalar bolaning ichida, otaga qaraydi)<br>F ning ikki otasi: E va D (merge commit)</pre><p><b>Muhim xususiyatlar:</b></p><ul><li><b>Snapshot, diff emas:</b> har commit to'liq tree; o'zgarmagan fayllar bir xil blob hash'iga ishora qiladi (takrorlanmaydi).</li><li><b>Content-addressable:</b> obyekt nomi = mazmun hash'i (SHA-1, yangi repo'larda SHA-256 ixtiyoriy). Mazmun o'zgarsa hash o'zgaradi — tarixni sezdirmasdan o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.</li><li><b>Distributed:</b> har clone — to'liq tarix va obyektlar.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git log --graph --oneline --all       # DAG'ni ko'rish<br>git cat-file -p HEAD                  # tree, parent(lar), author<br>git rev-list --parents -n1 HEAD       # commit va otalari<br>git log --merges --oneline | head     # ko'p otali commit'lar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Branch'ni &quot;commit'lar to'plami&quot; deb tushunish — u faqat ko'rsatkich; branch o'chirilsa commit'lar (reflog/gc'gacha) qoladi.</li><li>&quot;Git diff saqlaydi&quot; — yo'q, packfile'da delta siqish bor, lekin mantiqiy model snapshot.</li><li>Tarixni qayta yozish (rebase, amend) yangi hash'li commit'lar yaratadi — eski commit'lar o'zgarmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DAG modelini tushunish rebase, merge-base, cherry-pick, bisect kabi barcha &quot;murakkab&quot; buyruqlarni oddiy graf operatsiyalariga aylantiradi. SHA-1 collision xavfi sabab Git SHA-256 repo formatini qo'llaydi (<code>git init --object-format=sha256</code>), lekin hosting qo'llovi hali cheklangan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42052	<p><code>.git/objects/</code> dagi to'rt asosiy obyekt turini tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git obyekt bazasida to'rt tur bor: <b>blob</b> — fayl mazmuni (nomsiz), <b>tree</b> — katalog (nom, ruxsat va blob/tree hash'lari ro'yxati), <b>commit</b> — root tree, ota commit(lar), muallif, sana va xabar, <b>tag</b> (annotated) — boshqa obyektga imzolanadigan nomli havola va xabar.</p><pre>commit a1b2c3<br>  tree    9f8e7d  ------------&gt; tree 9f8e7d (root)<br>  parent  77aa11                 100644 blob 3c4d5e  README.md<br>  author  Ali &lt;...&gt; 1767...      040000 tree 5a6b7c  src<br>  message &quot;fix login&quot;                                  |<br>                                                       v<br>tag v1.0 -&gt; object a1b2c3          tree 5a6b7c: 100644 blob 8d9e0f  main.go<br>           tagger, message, (GPG)</pre><p>Blob'da fayl nomi yo'q — shuning uchun bir xil mazmunli ikki fayl bitta blob'ni bo'lishadi; nom tree'da.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git cat-file -t HEAD                 # commit<br>git cat-file -p HEAD                 # commit mazmuni<br>git cat-file -p HEAD^{tree}          # root tree<br>git cat-file -p HEAD:README.md       # blob mazmuni<br>git cat-file -p v1.0                 # annotated tag<br>find .git/objects -type f | head     # loose obyektlar: .git/objects/3c/4d5e...</pre><p>Loose obyekt fayli — <code>&quot;&lt;tur&gt; &lt;hajm&gt;\0&lt;mazmun&gt;&quot;</code> ning zlib bilan siqilgani; nomi uning SHA-1 hash'i (birinchi 2 belgi — katalog).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lightweight tag obyekt emas — faqat ref; <code>git cat-file -t v1.0</code> <code>commit</code> qaytaradi.</li><li>Bo'sh katalog Git'da saqlanmaydi — tree faqat ichida narsa bo'lsa; <code>.gitkeep</code> odati shundan.</li><li>Fayl ruxsatlaridan faqat bajariluvchanlik (<code>100755</code>) saqlanadi, egasi/boshqa bitlar yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu model nima uchun Git'da fayl ko'chirish &quot;kuzatilmasligi&quot; (rename heuristik ravishda aniqlanadi), nega katta binary fayllar repo'ni shishiradi (har versiya — yangi blob) va nega LFS kerakligini tushuntiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42053	<p>Git'ning &quot;uch daraxti&quot; (uch hudud) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git uch hudud bilan ishlaydi: <b>Working Directory</b> (diskdagi tahrirlanayotgan fayllar), <b>Index / Staging area</b> (<code>.git/index</code> — keyingi commit'ning loyihasi) va <b>HEAD / Repository</b> (oxirgi commit snapshot'i). Har asosiy buyruq fayllarni shu hududlar orasida ko'chiradi.</p><p><b>Nega index kerak:</b> Bir faylda ikki xil o'zgarish qilding — birini hozir commit qilmoqchisan. Index commit'ni ataylab &quot;yig'ish&quot; imkonini beradi (<code>git add -p</code>).</p><pre>Working Dir        Index (staging)        HEAD (repo)<br>     |  -- git add --&gt;  |                      |<br>     |                  |  -- git commit --&gt;   |<br>     |  &lt;-- git restore (index'dan) --         |<br>     |                  | &lt;-- git restore --staged (HEAD'dan)<br>     |  &lt;------------ git checkout / switch ---|<br>git diff          : Working vs Index<br>git diff --staged : Index vs HEAD<br>git diff HEAD     : Working vs HEAD</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo &quot;x&quot; &gt;&gt; app.go<br>git status -s            # &quot; M app.go&quot;  -&gt; o'ng ustun: working o'zgargan, stage qilinmagan<br>git add app.go<br>git status -s            # &quot;M  app.go&quot;  -&gt; chap ustun: stage qilingan<br>echo &quot;y&quot; &gt;&gt; app.go<br>git status -s            # &quot;MM app.go&quot;  -&gt; ikkalasi ham: index va working farq qiladi<br>git add -p app.go        # bo'lak-bo'lak stage<br>git ls-files -s          # index mazmuni: mode, blob hash, stage, path</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git add</code> dan keyin faylni yana tahrirlab, commit qilish — commit'ga <b>add paytidagi</b> versiya kiradi.</li><li><code>git commit -a</code> yangi (untracked) fayllarni qo'shmaydi.</li><li><code>git reset --hard</code> working directory'dagi commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlarni qaytarib bo'lmaydigan qilib o'chiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Uch daraxt modeli <code>reset</code> ning uch rejimini (<code>--soft</code> faqat HEAD, <code>--mixed</code> + index, <code>--hard</code> + working) va <code>restore</code>/<code>switch</code> farqini mexanik ravishda tushuntiradi. Toza, atomar commit'lar code review va <code>bisect</code> uchun asos.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42054	<p><code>git add</code> ichkarida qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git add</code> fayl mazmunini o'qiydi, uni <code>blob</code> obyekt sifatida hash'lab <code>.git/objects/</code> ga yozadi (agar hali yo'q bo'lsa), keyin <code>.git/index</code> faylida shu yo'l uchun yozuvni yangilaydi: mode, blob hash va fayl metadata'si (mtime, hajm, inode). Commit hali yaratilmaydi — faqat obyekt va index o'zgaradi.</p><pre>git add src/main.go<br>  1. mazmun o'qiladi (+ .gitattributes filtrlar: CRLF, LFS clean filter)<br>  2. header &quot;blob &lt;hajm&gt;\0&quot; + mazmun -&gt; SHA-1 -&gt; 8d9e0f...<br>  3. zlib siqib .git/objects/8d/9e0f... ga yoziladi<br>  4. .git/index: &quot;100644 8d9e0f... 0  src/main.go&quot; + stat ma'lumoti</pre><p>Shu sababli <code>add</code> dan keyin faylni o'chirib yuborsang ham, mazmuni obyekt bazasida qoladi (<code>git fsck --lost-found</code> bilan topiladi).</p><p><b>Amalda (plumbing bilan bir xil natija):</b></p><pre>echo 'hello' &gt; a.txt<br>git hash-object -w a.txt                  # ce0136...  blob yozildi<br>git update-index --add --cacheinfo 100644,ce0136250e...,a.txt<br>git ls-files -s                           # 100644 ce0136... 0  a.txt<br># Bu ikki qadam = git add a.txt</pre><p>Index'dagi stat ma'lumoti <code>git status</code> ni tez qiladi: mtime/hajm o'zgarmagan fayl qayta hash'lanmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta binary'ni <code>add</code> qilib, keyin o'chirib commit qilish — blob baribir commit tarixida (agar commit qilingan bo'lsa) yoki gc'gacha diskda.</li><li><code>git add .</code> bilan <code>.env</code> va build artefaktlarni stage qilish — <code>.gitignore</code> va <code>git status</code> ni tekshir.</li><li><code>.gitattributes</code> dagi <code>text=auto</code> — Windows'da CRLF normalizatsiyasi tufayli &quot;hamma fayl o'zgardi&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Index — oddiy &quot;ro'yxat&quot; emas, performance kesh ham: katta monorepo'larda <code>git status</code> tezligi index va <code>core.fsmonitor</code>/<code>untrackedCache</code> ga bog'liq. Merge konfliktida index har fayl uchun 1/2/3 stage yozuvlarini saqlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42055	<p><code>git commit</code> ichkarida qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git commit</code> index'dan tree obyektlarini yaratadi (<code>write-tree</code>), keyin root tree hash'i, ota commit (joriy HEAD), muallif/committer va xabardan commit obyektini yozadi (<code>commit-tree</code>) va nihoyat joriy branch ref'ini yangi commit'ga suradi (<code>update-ref</code>). Reflog'ga yozuv qo'shiladi.</p><pre>1. index -&gt; write-tree   -&gt; tree 9f8e7d (ichki katalog tree'lari ham)<br>2. commit-tree 9f8e7d -p &lt;HEAD&gt; -m &quot;msg&quot; -&gt; commit a1b2c3<br>3. HEAD -&gt; refs/heads/main  ; update-ref refs/heads/main a1b2c3<br>4. .git/logs/HEAD va logs/refs/heads/main ga reflog yozuvi<br>(+ hook'lar: pre-commit, prepare-commit-msg, commit-msg, post-commit)</pre><p><b>Amalda (plumbing bilan qo'lda commit):</b></p><pre>TREE=$(git write-tree)<br>COMMIT=$(echo &quot;manual commit&quot; | git commit-tree $TREE -p HEAD)<br>git update-ref refs/heads/main $COMMIT<br>git log --oneline -1          # porcelain commit bilan bir xil natija<br>git cat-file -p HEAD          # tree, parent, author, committer</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Commit &quot;o'zgarishlarni&quot; emas, butun index snapshot'ini saqlaydi — stage qilinmagan o'zgarishlar kirmaydi.</li><li><code>user.email</code> noto'g'ri sozlangan — commit'lar boshqa (yoki noma'lum) akkauntga bog'lanadi; tarixni tuzatish og'riqli.</li><li>Detached HEAD'da commit qilish — hech qaysi branch surilmaydi, keyin commit &quot;yo'qoladi&quot; (reflog'da bor).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Commit hash'i muallif vaqtini ham o'z ichiga oladi — shuning uchun bir xil mazmunni ikki marta commit qilish turli hash beradi. Imzolangan commit'lar (<code>commit.gpgsign</code>, SSH signing) supply-chain talablarida (branch protection: &quot;require signed commits&quot;) ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42056	<p>Git'da <code>HEAD</code> va &quot;detached HEAD&quot; nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>HEAD</code> — &quot;hozir qayerdaman&quot; ko'rsatkichi: odatda branch'ga simvolik havola (<code>.git/HEAD</code> ichida <code>ref: refs/heads/main</code>). Detached HEAD — HEAD branch'ga emas, to'g'ridan commit hash'iga ishora qilgan holat (tag, eski commit yoki remote branch'ni checkout qilganda). Bu holatda yangi commit'lar hech qaysi branch'ga tegishli emas.</p><pre>Oddiy:                        Detached:<br>HEAD -&gt; main -&gt; C3            HEAD -&gt; C1 (to'g'ridan)<br>A---B---C3                    A---B(C1)---C3  &lt;- main<br>                                   \<br>                                    X  &lt;- yangi commit, branch yo'q!<br>switch main qilsang X ga hech narsa ishora qilmaydi -&gt; reflog/gc</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat .git/HEAD                    # ref: refs/heads/main<br>git switch --detach v1.2.0       # yoki git checkout v1.2.0<br>cat .git/HEAD                    # 4f2a9c... (hash)<br>git status                       # &quot;HEAD detached at v1.2.0&quot;<br># Ishni saqlab qolish:<br>git switch -c hotfix-1.2         # joriy holatdan branch yarat<br># Unutib qo'ygan bo'lsang:<br>git reflog | head                # yo'qolgan commit hash'ini top<br>git branch rescue &lt;hash&gt;</pre><p><b>Qachon foydali:</b> eski versiyani tekshirish/build qilish, <code>git bisect</code> (avtomatik detached), CI checkout'lari (ko'p CI aynan commit SHA'ni detached holatda oladi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Detached holatda commit qilib, boshqa branch'ga o'tish — commit'lar &quot;yo'qoladi&quot; (gc.reflogExpireUnreachable, default 30 kun).</li><li>CI'da <code>git push</code> yoki <code>git describe</code> detached HEAD'da kutilmagan natija beradi — branch nomini env'dan ol.</li><li><code>HEAD~1</code> va <code>HEAD^2</code> farqi: <code>~</code> birinchi ota bo'ylab orqaga, <code>^2</code> merge'ning ikkinchi otasi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Detached HEAD — xato emas, oddiy holat. Muhimi reflog mavjudligini bilish: Git'da commit qilingan narsa amalda deyarli hech qachon darhol yo'qolmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42058	<p>Fast-forward va three-way merge (<code>--no-ff</code>) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Fast-forward — maqsad branch ajralgan nuqtadan beri o'zgarmagan bo'lsa, Git shunchaki branch ko'rsatkichini oldinga suradi; yangi commit yaratilmaydi. Three-way merge — ikki branch ham o'zgargan bo'lsa (yoki <code>--no-ff</code> majburlansa), Git merge-base va ikki uchni solishtirib, ikki otali yangi merge commit yaratadi.</p><pre>Fast-forward mumkin:<br>A---B  main<br>     \<br>      C---D  feature<br>git merge feature  -&gt;  A---B---C---D  main, feature  (ko'rsatkich surildi)<br><br>--no-ff (yoki ajralgan bo'lsa three-way):<br>A---B-----------M  main      M otalari: B va D<br>     \         /<br>      C-------D  feature<br>Three-way: base=B, ours=main uchi, theirs=feature uchi</pre><p><b>Nega <code>--no-ff</code>:</b> Fast-forward'dan keyin tarixda &quot;bu commit'lar bitta feature edi&quot; degan iz qolmaydi. Merge commit feature'ni guruhlaydi va uni bitta <code>git revert -m 1 M</code> bilan qaytarish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git merge --ff-only feature     # faqat FF mumkin bo'lsa, aks holda xato (CI/release'da xavfsiz)<br>git merge --no-ff feature       # har doim merge commit<br>git log --graph --oneline -5<br>git config merge.ff only        # yoki false — jamoa siyosati</pre><p>GitHub/GitLab: &quot;Create a merge commit&quot; = <code>--no-ff</code>; &quot;Rebase and merge&quot; = rebase + FF; &quot;Squash and merge&quot; = bitta yangi commit.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git pull</code> default holatda ajralgan branch'da keraksiz merge commit'lar yaratadi — <code>pull.ff only</code> yoki <code>pull.rebase true</code>.</li><li>Merge commit'ni revert qilganda <code>-m 1</code> ni unutish; va keyin o'sha branch'ni qayta merge qilganda o'zgarishlar kirmaydi (revert'ni revert qilish kerak).</li><li>Three-way merge semantik konfliktni topmaydi — matn bo'yicha toza merge kodni buzishi mumkin; CI merge natijasida ishlasin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov tarix &quot;nima uchun&quot; kerakligiga bog'liq: release branch'lar uchun <code>--ff-only</code> (aniqlik), feature'lar uchun <code>--no-ff</code> yoki squash. Merge queue (GitHub) — main'ni har doim yashil saqlashning zamonaviy usuli.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42059	<p><code>git cherry-pick</code> nima va qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git cherry-pick &lt;commit&gt;</code> bitta (yoki bir nechta) commit kiritgan o'zgarishni (diff'ni) joriy branch ustiga yangi commit sifatida qo'llaydi. Asl commit o'zgarmaydi, yangisi boshqa hash'ga ega.</p><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b> main'dagi bug fix'ni <code>release/2.3</code> ga ko'chirish (backport); noto'g'ri branch'ga qilingan commit'ni to'g'risiga o'tkazish.</p><pre>main:        A---B---F(fix)---G<br>release/2.3: A---R1---R2<br>git switch release/2.3 &amp;&amp; git cherry-pick F<br>release/2.3: A---R1---R2---F'   (F' = F ning diff'i, yangi hash)<br>Ichkarida: F ning otasi (B) base, F = theirs, HEAD = ours -&gt; three-way merge</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git cherry-pick a1b2c3<br>git cherry-pick -x a1b2c3            # xabarga &quot;(cherry picked from commit a1b2c3)&quot; qo'shadi — kuzatish uchun<br>git cherry-pick A^..C                # A dan C gacha (A ham kiradi)<br>git cherry-pick -n a1b2c3            # commit qilmasdan, faqat working/index'ga<br>git cherry-pick -m 1 &lt;merge-commit&gt;  # merge commit'ni (1-ota nisbatan)<br># konflikt: tuzat -&gt; git add -&gt; git cherry-pick --continue | --abort | --skip</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir xil o'zgarish ikki branch'da turli hash bilan — keyin merge qilinganda ba'zan takroriy konflikt; <code>-x</code> bilan iz qoldir.</li><li>Bog'liq commit'larsiz cherry-pick — fix oldingi refactor'ga tayanadi va build buziladi.</li><li>Cherry-pick'ni asosiy integratsiya usuliga aylantirish — branch'lar orasidagi farqni kuzatish imkonsiz bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Backport siyosati: fix avval main'ga, keyin release branch'larga <code>-x</code> bilan (avtomatlashtirilgan backport bot'lari ham shunday ishlaydi). Aksincha yo'nalish (release'dan main'ga) fix'ning main'da unutilishiga olib keladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42060	<p><code>git revert</code> va <code>git reset</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git revert &lt;commit&gt;</code> — berilgan commit o'zgarishini bekor qiluvchi <b>yangi</b> commit yaratadi; tarix o'zgarmaydi, push qilingan umumiy branch'lar uchun xavfsiz. <code>git reset &lt;commit&gt;</code> — branch ko'rsatkichini orqaga suradi (tarixni &quot;o'chiradi&quot;) va rejimga qarab index/working'ni ham o'zgartiradi; faqat hali push qilinmagan lokal ish uchun.</p><pre>Boshlanish: A---B---C (main, C yomon)<br><br>git revert C:   A---B---C---C'   (C' = C ning teskarisi)  &lt;- hamma uchun xavfsiz<br>git reset B:    A---B            (C ga hech narsa ishora qilmaydi; reflog'da)<br>                                  push qilingan bo'lsa -&gt; force push kerak -&gt; hamkasblar tarixi buziladi</pre><p>| | revert | reset | |---|---|---| | Tarix | qo'shadi | qayta yozadi | | Push qilingan branch | to'g'ri yo'l | xavfli (force push) | | Audit izi | bor | yo'q | | O'rta commit'ni bekor qilish | ha | yo'q (keyingilari ham ketadi) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git revert a1b2c3                    # muharrir ochiladi, xabar tasdiqla<br>git revert --no-edit HEAD~3..HEAD    # oxirgi 3 commit'ni<br>git revert -m 1 &lt;merge-commit&gt;       # merge'ni bekor qilish (1-ota saqlanadi)<br>git reset --soft HEAD~1              # lokal: oxirgi commit'ni bekor, o'zgarishlar staged qoladi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prod'da avariya — main'ni <code>reset</code> + <code>push --force</code> qilish; to'g'risi <code>revert</code> va oddiy push (CI orqali deploy).</li><li>Revert qilingan merge'ni keyin qayta merge qilish — Git &quot;allaqachon merge qilingan&quot; deb o'zgarishlarni kiritmaydi; avval revert'ni revert qil.</li><li>Revert ham konflikt berishi mumkin — keyingi commit'lar o'sha qatorlarni o'zgartirgan bo'lsa.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Incident paytida &quot;roll forward with revert&quot; — eng tez va izlanadigan rollback. Branch protection (force push taqiqi) umumiy branch'larda reset'ni amalda imkonsiz qiladi — bu to'g'ri default.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42061	<p><code>git reset --soft</code>, <code>--mixed</code> va <code>--hard</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uchalasi ham joriy branch'ni (HEAD) ko'rsatilgan commit'ga suradi; farq — qolgan ikki hududga (index va working directory) nima qilishida. <code>--soft</code> faqat HEAD'ni suradi; <code>--mixed</code> (default) HEAD + index'ni; <code>--hard</code> HEAD + index + working directory'ni — commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlar yo'qoladi.</p><p>| Rejim | HEAD/branch | Index | Working dir | Natija | |---|---|---|---|---| | <code>--soft</code> | suriladi | o'zgarmaydi | o'zgarmaydi | o'zgarishlar staged | | <code>--mixed</code> | suriladi | tiklanadi | o'zgarmaydi | o'zgarishlar unstaged | | <code>--hard</code> | suriladi | tiklanadi | tiklanadi | o'zgarishlar yo'q |</p><pre>A---B---C  (HEAD, C da &quot;x.go&quot; o'zgargan)<br>git reset --soft  B : HEAD=B, x.go staged     -&gt; qayta commit qilishga tayyor<br>git reset --mixed B : HEAD=B, x.go o'zgargan, stage qilinmagan<br>git reset --hard  B : HEAD=B, x.go B dagidek  -&gt; C dagi o'zgarish faqat reflog orqali</pre><p><b>Amalda (tipik vaziyatlar):</b></p><pre>git reset --soft HEAD~3 &amp;&amp; git commit -m &quot;feat: login&quot;   # oxirgi 3 commit'ni bittaga<br>git reset HEAD~1                    # oxirgi commit'ni bekor, fayllar qoladi (mixed)<br>git reset                           # hamma narsani unstage (= git restore --staged .)<br>git reset --hard origin/main        # lokal branch'ni remote holatiga keltirish<br># xato qilding:<br>git reflog                          # HEAD@{1}: commit: ...<br>git reset --hard HEAD@{1}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--hard</code> dan oldin stage qilinmagan/commit qilinmagan ish — reflog'da yo'q, qaytarib bo'lmaydi (faqat <code>git add</code> qilingan bo'lsa <code>fsck --lost-found</code> bilan blob'lar).</li><li>Untracked fayllarga <code>reset --hard</code> tegmaydi — ular uchun <code>git clean</code>.</li><li>Push qilingan commit'larni reset qilish — force push va jamoa muammolari; umumiy branch'da <code>revert</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xavfli operatsiyadan oldin arzon sug'urta: <code>git branch backup-$(date +%s)</code> yoki <code>git stash</code>. <code>reset &lt;fayl&gt;</code> (yo'l bilan) faqat index'ni o'zgartiradi — HEAD surilmaydi; Git 2.23+ da buning uchun aniqroq <code>git restore --staged</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42062	<p><code>git reflog</code> nima va avariyadan tiklashda qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git reflog</code> — HEAD va har branch qayerga ishora qilganining lokal jurnali (commit, reset, rebase, checkout, merge...). &quot;Yo'qolgan&quot; commit'lar — reset, noto'g'ri rebase yoki o'chirilgan branch'dan keyin — reflog orqali topiladi va tiklanadi. Reflog lokal, push qilinmaydi va vaqt o'tib tozalanadi.</p><p><b>Real vaziyat:</b> <code>git reset --hard HEAD~5</code> qilding yoki rebase'da konfliktni noto'g'ri hal qilib ishni buzding. Commit'lar hali obyekt bazasida — faqat ularga hech narsa ishora qilmayapti.</p><pre>git reflog<br>a1b2c3 HEAD@{0}: reset: moving to HEAD~5<br>f9e8d7 HEAD@{1}: commit: add payment retry     &lt;- shu kerak<br>77aa11 HEAD@{2}: rebase (finish): returning to refs/heads/feature<br>...<br>git reset --hard HEAD@{1}   -&gt;  ish qaytdi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git reflog                          # HEAD harakatlari<br>git reflog show feature             # aniq branch jurnali<br>git reflog --date=iso               # vaqt bilan<br>git branch rescue HEAD@{3}          # xavfsizroq: avval branch yarat, keyin ko'r<br>git reset --hard ORIG_HEAD          # rebase/merge/reset'dan oldingi holat (bitta qadam)<br>git checkout HEAD@{2.hours.ago} -- file.go   # faylning 2 soat oldingi versiyasi<br># reflog'da ham yo'q bo'lsa (masalan stash drop):<br>git fsck --lost-found --unreachable | grep commit</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Reflog muddati: erishib bo'ladigan yozuvlar 90 kun (<code>gc.reflogExpire</code>), erishib bo'lmaydiganlar 30 kun (<code>gc.reflogExpireUnreachable</code>) — keyin <code>gc</code> obyektlarni o'chiradi.</li><li>Reflog faqat shu clone'da — yangi clone qilsang yoki boshqa mashinada bo'lsa yordam bermaydi.</li><li>Commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlar reflog'da yo'q — hech qachon commit/stash qilinmagan ish qaytmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Server tomonda (GitHub) force push bilan yo'qolgan commit'lar uchun reflog yo'q, lekin GitHub Events API va &quot;Activity&quot; sahifasi eski SHA'ni ko'rsatadi. Jamoaga &quot;commit tez-tez qil — commit qilingan narsa yo'qolmaydi&quot; madaniyati shu mexanizmga tayanadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42063	<p><code>git stash</code> nima va <code>stash pop</code> bilan <code>stash apply</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git stash</code> commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlarni (working + index) vaqtinchalik &quot;javon&quot;ga olib qo'yadi va working directory'ni toza HEAD holatiga qaytaradi. <code>stash apply</code> o'zgarishlarni qayta qo'llaydi va stash'ni ro'yxatda <b>qoldiradi</b>; <code>stash pop</code> qo'llaydi va muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa stash'ni <b>o'chiradi</b>.</p><p><b>Real vaziyat:</b> Feature ustida yarim ish, prod'da urgent bug. Commit qilishga erta — stash, branch almashtir, fix, qayt, pop.</p><pre>stash stack (refs/stash + reflog):<br>stash@{0}: WIP on feature: a1b2c3 add form    &lt;- eng yangisi<br>stash@{1}: On main: experiment<br>Ichida: stash — maxsus commit (otalari: HEAD va index commit'i; -u bilan untracked commit'i ham)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git stash push -m &quot;yarim forma&quot;        # nom bilan<br>git stash -u                           # untracked fayllar ham (default'da kirmaydi!)<br>git stash list<br>git stash show -p stash@{1}            # ichini ko'rish<br>git stash apply stash@{1}              # qo'lla, stash qolsin<br>git stash pop                          # qo'lla va o'chir (konflikt bo'lsa o'chirilmaydi)<br>git stash branch fix-form stash@{0}    # stash'dan yangi branch (konfliktsiz)<br>git stash push -p                      # faqat tanlangan bo'laklar<br>git stash drop stash@{1}; git stash clear</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Untracked yangi fayllar stash'ga tushmaydi (<code>-u</code> kerak) — branch almashganda ular &quot;ergashib&quot; yuradi.</li><li><code>pop</code> konflikt bersa, stash o'chirilmaydi — tuzatgandan keyin qo'lda <code>drop</code> qil; aks holda dublikat qoladi.</li><li>Stash'ni uzoq muddatli saqlash joyi sifatida ishlatish — kontekst unutiladi; <code>stash clear</code> bilan yo'qolgan stash faqat <code>fsck</code> bilan topiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoalar stash o'rniga <code>git worktree add ../hotfix main</code> ishlatadi — ikkinchi ishchi katalog, hech narsa yashirilmaydi. Shuningdek WIP commit (keyin <code>reset --soft</code> yoki <code>commit --amend</code>) — tarixda iz qoladi va xavfsizroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42064	<p><code>git bisect</code> nima va debug'ni qanday avtomatlashtiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git bisect</code> — &quot;qaysi commit bug'ni olib kirdi?&quot; savoliga binary search bilan javob beradi: bitta &quot;yaxshi&quot; va bitta &quot;yomon&quot; commit beriladi, Git o'rtadagisini checkout qiladi, sen (yoki skript) uni good/bad deb belgilaysan. 1000 commit orasidan ~10 qadamda topiladi (log2 N).</p><pre>good                                         bad<br> A----o----o----o----o----o----o----o----o----Z     (1024 commit)<br>                     ^ test -&gt; good<br>                               ^ test -&gt; bad<br>                         ^ ...<br>Natija: &quot;c3d4e5 is the first bad commit&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda (qo'lda):</b></p><pre>git bisect start<br>git bisect bad                 # joriy (HEAD) yomon<br>git bisect good v2.3.0         # bu versiya yaxshi edi<br># Git checkout qiladi -&gt; sinab ko'r<br>git bisect good   # yoki: git bisect bad / git bisect skip (build bo'lmasa)<br>...<br>git bisect reset               # boshlang'ich branch'ga qaytish</pre><p><b>Avtomatlashtirish:</b></p><pre>git bisect start HEAD v2.3.0<br>git bisect run ./scripts/repro.sh<br># repro.sh: exit 0 = good, 1-124/126-127 = bad, 125 = skip<br># misol: go test ./payment -run TestRefund<br>git bisect log &gt; bisect.log    # natijani jamoa bilan bo'lishish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tarixda ko'p &quot;build qilinmaydigan&quot; commit'lar — bisect <code>skip</code> bilan aniqlik yo'qotadi; har commit build qilinadigan va atomar bo'lsin.</li><li>Test flaky bo'lsa — noto'g'ri commit topiladi; skriptda bir necha marta takrorla.</li><li>Merge commit'li murakkab tarixda natija merge commit bo'lishi mumkin — <code>--first-parent</code> (Git 2.29+) bilan faqat main tarixi bo'ylab.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>bisect run</code> + regression test skripti — &quot;qachondan beri sekin?&quot; kabi performance regressiyalari uchun ham (benchmark threshold bilan). Kichik, yashil commit'lar madaniyati bisect'ni kuchli vositaga aylantiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42065	<p><code>git clean</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git clean</code> working directory'dan <b>untracked</b> (Git kuzatmaydigan) fayllarni o'chiradi: build artefaktlar, vaqtinchalik fayllar, yangi yaratilgan lekin <code>add</code> qilinmagan fayllar. Qaytarib bo'lmaydi — Git ularni hech qachon saqlamagan.</p><pre>Fayl turlari:<br>tracked (index/HEAD'da) -&gt; clean tegmaydi (buning uchun reset/restore)<br>untracked               -&gt; git clean -f<br>ignored (.gitignore)    -&gt; faqat -x yoki -X bilan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git clean -n            # dry run: NIMA o'chirilishini ko'rsat (doim avval shu!)<br>git clean -f            # untracked fayllarni o'chir<br>git clean -fd           # + untracked kataloglar<br>git clean -fdx          # + ignored fayllar ham (node_modules, build/, .env!) — to'liq tozalash<br>git clean -fdX          # FAQAT ignored fayllar (artefaktlarni tozalab, yangi fayllarni saqlash)<br>git clean -i            # interaktiv tanlash<br>git clean -fd -e '.env*'   # istisno bilan</pre><p>&quot;Repo'ni yangi clone kabi holatga keltirish&quot;: <code>git reset --hard &amp;&amp; git clean -fdx</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-x</code> bilan <code>.env</code>, lokal config, IDE sozlamalarini o'chirib yuborish — ular <code>.gitignore</code> da, demak Git'da backup yo'q.</li><li><code>git stash -u</code> o'rniga <code>clean</code> qilish — keyin kerak bo'lib qoladi.</li><li><code>clean.requireForce=true</code> (default) — <code>-f</code> siz ishlamaydi; bu himoyani o'chirma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI runner'larda (self-hosted) build'lar orasida <code>git clean -ffdx</code> — &quot;mening mashinamda ishlaydi&quot; holatlarini kamaytiradi (ikki <code>f</code> ichki git repo'larni ham o'chiradi). Lokalda doim <code>-n</code> bilan boshla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42066	<p><code>.gitignore</code> nima va nega allaqachon kuzatilayotgan faylni e'tiborsiz qoldirmaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.gitignore</code> — Git qaysi <b>untracked</b> fayllarni e'tiborsiz qoldirishini belgilovchi pattern'lar fayli (<code>git status</code> da ko'rinmaydi, <code>git add .</code> qo'shmaydi). U faqat hali kuzatilmayotgan fayllarga ta'sir qiladi: fayl allaqachon index'da bo'lsa, Git uni kuzatishda davom etadi — ignore qoidasi tekshirilmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega shunday:</b> Index — &quot;nimani kuzataman&quot; ro'yxati. <code>.gitignore</code> faqat bu ro'yxatga <b>yangi</b> narsa qo'shilishini filtrlaydi; mavjud yozuvni o'chirmaydi. Aks holda ignore qatori qo'shish fayllarni jimgina tarixdan &quot;yo'qotib&quot; qo'yardi.</p><pre>.env commit qilingan -&gt; index'da bor<br>.gitignore ga &quot;.env&quot; qo'shildi -&gt; hech narsa o'zgarmaydi, .env o'zgarishlari hali ko'rinadi<br>Yechim:<br>git rm --cached .env  -&gt; index'dan chiqariladi (diskda qoladi)<br>commit -&gt; endi untracked + ignored</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># .gitignore<br>*.log<br>/build/            # faqat root'dagi build katalogi<br>node_modules/<br>.env<br>.env.*<br>!.env.example      # istisno: buni kuzat<br>**/tmp/            # istalgan chuqurlikda</pre><pre>git rm --cached .env &amp;&amp; git commit -m &quot;stop tracking .env&quot;<br>git rm -r --cached . &amp;&amp; git add .     # butun repo'ni yangi .gitignore bo'yicha qayta indekslash<br>git check-ignore -v build/app.bin     # qaysi fayl va qator ignore qilyapti<br>git status --ignored</pre><p>Boshqa joylar: <code>.git/info/exclude</code> (lokal, commit qilinmaydi), <code>core.excludesFile</code> (global, masalan <code>.DS_Store</code>, <code>.idea/</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret'ni <code>git rm --cached</code> bilan olib tashlash tarixdan o'chirmaydi — secret allaqachon oshkor, <b>rotate</b> qil.</li><li><code>!</code> istisno ota katalog ignore qilingan bo'lsa ishlamaydi (<code>build/</code> keyin <code>!build/keep.txt</code> — ishlamaydi; <code>build/*</code> yoz).</li><li><code>git update-index --assume-unchanged</code> ni &quot;lokal ignore&quot; deb ishlatish — bu performance flag, <code>--skip-worktree</code> aniqroq, lekin ikkalasi ham mo'rt.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Template repo'larda yaxshi <code>.gitignore</code> + pre-commit secret scan — birinchi kundan. Lokal o'zgaradigan config uchun to'g'ri pattern: <code>config.example.yaml</code> commit, haqiqiysi ignore.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42067	<p><code>git submodule</code> va <code>git subtree</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham boshqa repo'ni o'z repo'ng ichiga joylash usuli. <b>Submodule</b> — tashqi repo'ning aniq commit'iga ko'rsatkich (<code>.gitmodules</code> + &quot;gitlink&quot; yozuvi); kod ota repo'da saqlanmaydi, alohida clone qilinadi. <b>Subtree</b> — tashqi repo kodi (tarixi bilan yoki squash qilib) ota repo'ning oddiy katalogiga ko'chiriladi; clone qilganlar uchun maxsus qadam yo'q.</p><pre>Submodule:                               Subtree:<br>app/                                     app/<br>  .gitmodules -&gt; url, path                 vendor/lib/  &lt;- oddiy fayllar, app tarixida<br>  vendor/lib  -&gt; gitlink: commit 4f2a9c    yangilash: git subtree pull<br>  (mazmun alohida .git/modules/ da)</pre><p>| | Submodule | Subtree | |---|---|---| | Ota repo'da kod | yo'q, faqat SHA | bor | | Clone | <code>--recurse-submodules</code> kerak | oddiy clone | | Versiya pin | aniq commit | merge orqali | | Upstream'ga hissa | oson (ichida alohida repo) | <code>subtree push</code> (noqulayroq) | | Xato qilish ehtimoli | yuqori (detached HEAD, unutilgan update) | past |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Submodule<br>git submodule add https://github.com/org/lib vendor/lib<br>git clone --recurse-submodules &lt;url&gt;<br>git submodule update --init --recursive<br>git submodule update --remote vendor/lib &amp;&amp; git add vendor/lib &amp;&amp; git commit -m &quot;bump lib&quot;<br># Subtree<br>git subtree add --prefix=vendor/lib https://github.com/org/lib main --squash<br>git subtree pull --prefix=vendor/lib https://github.com/org/lib main --squash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CI'da submodule'lar yuklanmagan — checkout'da <code>submodules: recursive</code> va private repo uchun token.</li><li>Submodule ichida commit qilib, ota repo'da gitlink'ni yangilamaslik (yoki submodule'ni push qilmaslik) — boshqalar mavjud bo'lmagan commit'ga ishora oladi.</li><li>Subtree'da ota repo tarixi tashqi tarix bilan shishadi — <code>--squash</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p hollarda ikkalasidan ham yaxshiroq — paket menejeri (Go modules, npm, Helm dependency) yoki monorepo. Submodule/subtree'ni faqat paketlab bo'lmaydigan narsalar uchun (proto fayllar, umumiy Terraform modullari, vendor'langan C kutubxona) tanla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42068	<p><code>git commit --amend</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git commit --amend</code> oxirgi commit'ni <b>yangisiga almashtiradi</b>: joriy index mazmuni va (ixtiyoriy) yangi xabar bilan yangi commit yaratiladi, branch unga suriladi. Eski commit o'zgarmaydi — u shunchaki tarixdan chiqadi (reflog'da qoladi), hash yangi bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qachon:</b> commit xabarida xato, faylni qo'shishni unutding, kichik tuzatish — alohida &quot;fix typo&quot; commit'i o'rniga.</p><pre>Oldin:  A---B---C   (C: xabar &quot;fx login&quot;, test.go unutilgan)<br>git add test.go &amp;&amp; git commit --amend -m &quot;fix: login redirect&quot;<br>Keyin:  A---B---C'  (C' yangi hash; C faqat reflog'da)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git commit --amend -m &quot;fix: login redirect&quot;   # faqat xabarni o'zgartirish<br>git add forgotten.go &amp;&amp; git commit --amend --no-edit   # faylni qo'shish, xabar o'sha<br>git commit --amend --author=&quot;Ali &lt;ali@corp.com&gt;&quot; --no-edit<br>git commit --amend --reset-author --no-edit   # yangi user.email bilan<br># Allaqachon push qilingan bo'lsa (faqat o'z branch'ingda!):<br>git push --force-with-lease</pre><p>Eski commit'larni tuzatish uchun: <code>git commit --fixup=&lt;sha&gt;</code> keyin <code>git rebase -i --autosquash &lt;sha&gt;~1</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Push qilingan umumiy branch'da amend — tarix qayta yoziladi, hamkasblarda divergence.</li><li><code>git add .</code> bilan amend — kutilmagan fayllar (debug log, <code>.env</code>) oxirgi commit'ga qo'shiladi; avval <code>git status</code>.</li><li>Amend faqat oxirgi commit'ni o'zgartiradi — chuqurroq uchun interaktiv rebase.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PR ichida amend/fixup bilan toza commit'lar yaratish — review va bisect uchun foydali; lekin review boshlangandan keyin force push reviewer'lar uchun &quot;nima o'zgardi&quot; ni yo'qotadi — jamoa kelishuviga amal qil (masalan, review paytida yangi commit'lar, merge'da squash).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42069	<p><code>git pull</code> va <code>git fetch</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git fetch</code> remote'dan yangi commit va ref'larni yuklab oladi va faqat remote-tracking branch'larni (<code>origin/main</code>) yangilaydi — sening lokal branch'ing va working directory'ga tegmaydi. <code>git pull</code> = <code>git fetch</code> + joriy branch'ni upstream bilan birlashtirish (default merge, yoki sozlamaga ko'ra rebase / fast-forward).</p><pre>Remote (origin):  A---B---C---D<br><br>git fetch:<br>lokal main:       A---B           &lt;- o'zgarmadi<br>origin/main:      A---B---C---D   &lt;- yangilandi<br><br>git pull (= fetch + merge origin/main):<br>lokal main:       A---B---C---D   (FF) yoki merge commit (agar lokal commit'lar bo'lsa)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git fetch origin                      # xavfsiz, hech narsa o'zgarmaydi<br>git log --oneline main..origin/main   # remote'da yangi nima bor<br>git diff main origin/main             # farqni ko'r, keyin qaror qil<br>git merge --ff-only origin/main       # yoki git rebase origin/main<br>git fetch --prune                     # remote'da o'chirilgan branch'larning ref'larini ham o'chir<br>git pull --rebase                     # lokal commit'larni ustiga qayta qo'yadi<br>git config --global pull.ff only      # ajralgan bo'lsa pull xato bersin — ongli qaror</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ajralgan branch'da <code>git pull</code> — keraksiz &quot;Merge branch 'main' of ...&quot; commit'lar tarixni ifloslantiradi.</li><li>Commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlar bilan pull — konflikt yoki pull rad etiladi; avval commit/stash (<code>git pull --autostash</code>).</li><li><code>fetch</code> qildim, lekin <code>main</code> eski — fetch faqat <code>origin/main</code> ni yangilaydi, lokal branch'ni emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI va skriptlarda <code>fetch</code> + aniq SHA bilan ishla (<code>git fetch --depth=1 origin &lt;sha&gt;</code>) — pull'ning implicit merge xatti-harakati avtomatlashtirishda kutilmagan natija beradi. Lokalda <code>fetch</code> dan keyin ko'rib qaror qilish — yaxshi odat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42070	<p><code>git blame</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git blame &lt;fayl&gt;</code> faylning har qatori uchun uni oxirgi marta o'zgartirgan commit, muallif va sanani ko'rsatadi. Maqsad — ayblash emas, kontekst: &quot;bu qator nega shunday?&quot; savoliga commit xabari, PR va issue orqali javob topish.</p><pre>git blame -L 40,44 payment/retry.go<br>a1b2c3d4 (Ali   2025-03-02 41) for i := 0; i &lt; maxRetries; i++ {<br>a1b2c3d4 (Ali   2025-03-02 42)     err = charge(ctx, req)<br>f9e8d7c6 (Vali  2025-06-11 43)     if errors.Is(err, ErrIdempotent) { break }<br>a1b2c3d4 (Ali   2025-03-02 44)     time.Sleep(backoff(i))<br>-&gt; git show f9e8d7c6  -&gt; xabar: &quot;fix double charge on retry (INC-482)&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git blame -L 40,60 file.go           # qator oralig'i<br>git blame -w -C -C -M file.go        # whitespace'ni e'tiborsiz, ko'chirilgan/nusxalangan kodni asl muallifga<br>git blame &lt;sha&gt;^ -- file.go          # o'sha o'zgarishdan oldingi holat (qatlam-qatlam orqaga)<br>git log -L 40,44:file.go             # shu qatorlarning to'liq evolyutsiyasi<br>git log -S 'maxRetries' --oneline    # &quot;pickaxe&quot;: satr qachon qo'shilgan/olib tashlangan</pre><p>Formatlash commit'larini chetlab o'tish:</p><pre>echo &quot;&lt;format-commit-sha&gt;&quot; &gt;&gt; .git-blame-ignore-revs<br>git config blame.ignoreRevsFile .git-blame-ignore-revs   # GitHub UI ham buni hurmat qiladi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta reformat/rename commit'i blame'ni &quot;egallab oladi&quot; — <code>ignoreRevsFile</code> ishlat.</li><li>Blame ko'rsatgan odam qatorni faqat ko'chirgan bo'lishi mumkin — <code>-C -M</code> bilan asl manbani top.</li><li>O'chirilgan kod blame'da ko'rinmaydi — <code>git log -S</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Blame'ning qiymati commit xabarlari sifatiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'liq: &quot;fix&quot; emas, &quot;nega&quot; yozilgan xabar va ticket ID. Postmortem'da blameless madaniyat — blame tool'i odamni emas, qaror kontekstini topish uchun.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42071	<p><code>git log --graph --oneline --decorate --all</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bu buyruq repo tarixini ixcham grafik ko'rinishda chiqaradi: <code>--graph</code> commit'lar DAG'ini ASCII chiziqlar bilan chizadi, <code>--oneline</code> har commit'ni qisqa hash + sarlavha qilib bitta qatorga sig'diradi, <code>--decorate</code> branch/tag/HEAD nomlarini ko'rsatadi, <code>--all</code> faqat joriy branch emas, barcha ref'larni (lokal, remote, tag'lar) qamraydi.</p><pre>* f3a1c2e (HEAD -&gt; feature/login, origin/feature/login) add OAuth callback<br>* 9b8d7e6 login form<br>| * 4c5d6e7 (origin/main, main) fix: health check<br>|/<br>*   7a8b9c0 Merge pull request #41 from feature/api<br>|\<br>| * 1d2e3f4 api: pagination<br>|/<br>* 0a1b2c3 (tag: v1.2.0) release 1.2.0</pre><p>O'qish: <code>*</code> — commit, <code>|</code> — branch chizig'i, <code>/</code> va <code>\</code> — ajralish va birlashish nuqtalari; qavs ichida — shu commit'ga ishora qiluvchi ref'lar.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git log --graph --oneline --decorate --all<br>git config --global alias.lg &quot;log --graph --oneline --decorate --all&quot;<br>git lg -20                                 # oxirgi 20 tasi<br>git log --graph --oneline main..feature    # faqat feature'da bor commit'lar<br>git log --graph --format='%h %an %ar %s' --date-order<br>git log --oneline --first-parent main      # faqat main'ning &quot;asosiy&quot; chizig'i</pre><p>Git 2.x da <code>--decorate</code> terminalda default (<code>log.decorate=auto</code>), lekin skriptlarda aniq yozgan ma'qul.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--all</code> siz faqat joriy branch tarixi — boshqa branch'dagi commit'lar &quot;yo'q&quot; deb o'ylash.</li><li>Katta repo'da <code>--all</code> sekin va o'qib bo'lmaydigan &quot;spagetti&quot; — oraliq (<code>A..B</code>) yoki <code>--simplify-by-decoration</code> bilan chekla.</li><li><code>fetch</code> qilinmagan — remote branch'lar eski holatda ko'rinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rebase/merge oldidan va keyin shu buyruq bilan grafni ko'rish — xatolarni (keraksiz merge commit, noto'g'ri asos) darhol ko'rsatadi. Squash-merge siyosatli repo'larda <code>--first-parent</code> tarixi release notes uchun toza manba.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42072	<p><code>git diff</code> va <code>git diff --staged</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git diff</code> (argumentsiz) — working directory va index farqi, ya'ni <b>hali stage qilinmagan</b> o'zgarishlar. <code>git diff --staged</code> (sinonimi <code>--cached</code>) — index va HEAD farqi, ya'ni <b>keyingi commit'ga kiradigan</b> o'zgarishlar. <code>git diff HEAD</code> — working va HEAD (ikkalasi birga).</p><pre>Working Dir  --[git diff]--&gt;  Index  --[git diff --staged]--&gt;  HEAD<br>     \--------------------[git diff HEAD]--------------------/</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo &quot;a&quot; &gt;&gt; x.go &amp;&amp; git add x.go     # staged<br>echo &quot;b&quot; &gt;&gt; x.go                      # yana o'zgarish, stage qilinmagan<br>git diff              # faqat &quot;+b&quot;<br>git diff --staged     # faqat &quot;+a&quot;   &lt;- commit'ga aynan shu kiradi<br>git diff HEAD         # &quot;+a&quot; va &quot;+b&quot;<br>git diff --stat       # fayllar bo'yicha qisqacha<br>git diff --name-only main...feature   # feature main'dan ajralgandan beri o'zgargan fayllar<br>git diff --word-diff                  # so'z darajasida</pre><p>Commit oldidan odat: <code>git diff --staged</code> ni o'qib chiqish — tasodifiy debug kod va secret'larni ushlaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git add</code> dan keyin <code>git diff</code> bo'sh — &quot;o'zgarish yo'qoldi&quot; deb qo'rqish; ular staged, <code>--staged</code> bilan ko'r.</li><li>Untracked yangi fayllar <code>git diff</code> da ko'rinmaydi — <code>git add -N file</code> (intent-to-add) yoki <code>git status</code>.</li><li><code>A..B</code> va <code>A...B</code> farqi: ikki nuqta — B va A uchlari orasidagi diff; uch nuqta — merge-base'dan B gacha (PR diff'i aynan shu).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'da &quot;o'zgargan fayllarga qarab job ishga tushirish&quot; uchun <code>git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD</code> — monorepo pipeline optimizatsiyasining asosi; shallow clone'da merge-base topilmasligi mumkin, fetch chuqurligini hisobga ol.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42073	<p>Git plumbing va porcelain buyruqlari farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Porcelain — foydalanuvchi uchun qulay, yuqori darajali buyruqlar (<code>add</code>, <code>commit</code>, <code>log</code>, <code>merge</code>, <code>status</code>); chiqishi odam uchun va versiyalar orasida o'zgarishi mumkin. Plumbing — Git ichki obyekt va ref'lari bilan bevosita ishlaydigan past darajali buyruqlar (<code>hash-object</code>, <code>cat-file</code>, <code>update-index</code>, <code>write-tree</code>, <code>commit-tree</code>, <code>update-ref</code>, <code>rev-parse</code>); chiqishi barqaror va skriptlar uchun mo'ljallangan.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> Porcelain'ni skriptda parse qilish mo'rt (lokalizatsiya, rang, format o'zgarishi). Plumbing esa avtomatlashtirish va Git qanday ishlashini tushunish uchun.</p><pre>Porcelain          ~=  Plumbing ketma-ketligi<br>git add f          -&gt;  hash-object -w f ; update-index --add --cacheinfo ...<br>git commit -m m    -&gt;  write-tree ; commit-tree &lt;tree&gt; -p HEAD ; update-ref refs/heads/x &lt;c&gt;<br>git branch b       -&gt;  update-ref refs/heads/b HEAD<br>git status         -&gt;  diff-index / diff-files / ls-files --others</pre><p><b>Amalda (skript uchun to'g'ri tanlov):</b></p><pre># Mo'rt:<br>git branch | grep '*' | cut -d' ' -f2<br># Barqaror:<br>git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD<br>git symbolic-ref --short HEAD<br># Mo'rt: git status | grep modified<br># Barqaror (porcelain format — nomiga qaramay, mashina uchun barqaror):<br>git status --porcelain=v2<br>git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short) %(objectname:short)' refs/heads/</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git status --porcelain</code> — &quot;porcelain&quot; nomiga qaramay mashina uchun barqaror format; oddiy <code>git status</code> esa emas.</li><li>Plumbing bilan ref'larni qo'lda o'zgartirish — reflog va hook'larni chetlab o'tishi mumkin; ehtiyot bo'l.</li><li>Porcelain chiqishini <code>LANG</code> ga bog'liq holda parse qilish — boshqa tilda skript buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI/CD skriptlari, release tool'lar va pre-commit hook'larida plumbing yoki <code>--porcelain</code>/<code>--format</code> variantlarini ishlat. Plumbing'ni bilish Git avariyalarini (buzilgan ref, yo'qolgan obyekt) qo'lda tuzatishga imkon beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42074	<p><code>git cat-file</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git cat-file</code> — Git obyekt bazasidagi istalgan obyektni (blob, tree, commit, tag) hash bo'yicha ko'rsatadigan plumbing buyrug'i: turini (<code>-t</code>), hajmini (<code>-s</code>), chiroyli formatlangan mazmunini (<code>-p</code>) yoki mavjudligini (<code>-e</code>) tekshiradi.</p><pre>git cat-file -p HEAD<br>tree 9f8e7d6c...<br>parent 77aa1122...<br>author Ali &lt;ali@corp.com&gt; 1767225600 +0500<br>committer Ali &lt;ali@corp.com&gt; 1767225600 +0500<br><br>fix: login redirect<br><br>git cat-file -p 9f8e7d6c       (tree)<br>100644 blob 3c4d5e...    README.md<br>040000 tree 5a6b7c...    src</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git cat-file -t a1b2c3            # commit | tree | blob | tag<br>git cat-file -s a1b2c3            # bayt hajmi<br>git cat-file -p HEAD^{tree}       # root tree<br>git cat-file -p HEAD:src/main.go  # faylning HEAD'dagi mazmuni (= git show HEAD:src/main.go)<br>git cat-file -e &lt;sha&gt; &amp;&amp; echo bor # mavjudlik (exit code)<br># Ko'p obyektni tez o'qish (skriptlar):<br>git rev-list --objects --all | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectname) %(objectsize) %(rest)' \<br>  | sort -k3 -n | tail -5         # repo'dagi eng katta 5 obyekt</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qisqa hash noaniq bo'lsa (<code>ambiguous</code>) — uzunroq prefiks ber.</li><li><code>-p</code> blob uchun xom mazmun, binary bo'lsa terminalni buzadi — <code>-s</code> yoki <code>| xxd | head</code>.</li><li>Shallow/partial clone'da obyekt lokal bo'lmasligi mumkin — <code>-e</code> false qaytaradi (promisor remote'dan yuklanishi mumkin).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>--batch-check</code> bilan katta blob'larni topish — repo hajmi muammolarini tahlil qilishning standart usuli (keyin <code>git filter-repo</code> yoki LFS'ga ko'chirish). Imzolangan commit/tag'ni ham <code>cat-file -p</code> bilan xom ko'rib, <code>gpgsig</code> maydonini tekshirish mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42075	<p><code>git hash-object</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git hash-object &lt;fayl&gt;</code> fayl mazmunidan Git obyekt ID'sini (SHA-1, SHA-256 repo'da SHA-256) hisoblaydi: <code>&quot;blob &lt;hajm&gt;\0&quot; + mazmun</code> ning hash'i. <code>-w</code> flag'i bilan obyektni <code>.git/objects/</code> ga ham yozadi — <code>git add</code> ning birinchi yarmi aynan shu.</p><p><b>Nega bu muhim:</b> Content-addressing'ni ko'rsatadi — bir xil mazmun har qanday mashinada, har qanday nom bilan bir xil hash beradi. Shuning uchun Git dublikatlarni saqlamaydi va o'zgarishlarni tez aniqlaydi.</p><pre>mazmun &quot;hello\n&quot; (6 bayt)<br>  -&gt; &quot;blob 6\0hello\n&quot;<br>  -&gt; SHA-1 = ce013625030ba8dba906f756967f9e9ca394464a<br>  -&gt; -w: zlib siqib .git/objects/ce/013625030ba8dba906f756967f9e9ca394464a</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo 'hello' | git hash-object --stdin           # ce013625030ba8dba906f756967f9e9ca394464a<br>printf 'blob 6\0hello\n' | sha1sum               # xuddi shu hash — formula isboti<br>git hash-object -w config.yaml                   # obyektni yozish<br>git hash-object --no-filters file.txt            # .gitattributes filtrlarisiz (CRLF, LFS)<br># Fayl Git'dagi versiyaga tengmi? (hash solishtirish)<br>[ &quot;$(git hash-object app.go)&quot; = &quot;$(git rev-parse HEAD:app.go)&quot; ] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;o'zgarmagan&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Git blob hash'i oddiy <code>sha1sum fayl</code> bilan bir xil emas — header (<code>blob &lt;hajm&gt;\0</code>) qo'shiladi.</li><li><code>.gitattributes</code> filtrlari (eol, LFS) sabab diskdagi fayl hash'i commit'dagidan farq qilishi mumkin — <code>--path</code> yoki <code>--no-filters</code> ni tushunib ishlat.</li><li><code>-w</code> bilan yozilgan, lekin hech narsaga bog'lanmagan obyektlar keyin <code>gc</code> tomonidan o'chiriladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Skriptlarda &quot;fayl o'zgarganmi?&quot; ni tez tekshirish, deployment artefaktlarini Git obyekt ID bilan identifikatsiya qilish va repo integrity'ni tushunish uchun foydali. SHA-1 hash'lar Git'da collision-detection (SHA-1DC) bilan himoyalangan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42076	<p>Git reference (<code>ref</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ref — commit SHA'ga <b>nom</b> beradigan oddiy ko'rsatkich. Branch, tag, remote-tracking branch — hammasi ref. Fizik jihatdan <code>.git/refs/</code> ostidagi 41 baytli matn fayl (SHA + newline) yoki <code>.git/packed-refs</code> dagi bir qator.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Odam <code>a3f9c1e...</code> ni eslab qololmaydi. Ref — o'zgaruvchi nom: <code>main</code> bugun bir commit'ni, ertaga boshqasini ko'rsatadi. Commit obyekti o'zgarmas, ref esa siljiydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>.git/<br> +-- HEAD                      -&gt; &quot;ref: refs/heads/main&quot;<br> +-- refs/heads/main           -&gt; a3f9c1e...   (local branch)<br> +-- refs/tags/v1.0            -&gt; 7b2d...      (tag)<br> +-- refs/remotes/origin/main  -&gt; 9e1f...      (remote-tracking)<br> +-- packed-refs               -&gt; ko'p ref bitta faylda (gc dan keyin)</pre><p>Yangi commit qilganda Git faqat <code>refs/heads/main</code> faylidagi SHA'ni almashtiradi — branch &quot;ko'chishi&quot; shu.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat .git/refs/heads/main          # a3f9c1e5...<br>git show-ref                      # barcha ref'lar: SHA + to'liq nom<br>git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short) %(objectname:short)' refs/heads<br>git rev-parse main                # nomdan SHA</pre><p>Fayl yo'q bo'lsa — ref <code>packed-refs</code> da:</p><pre>grep main .git/packed-refs</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ref fayllarini qo'lda tahrirlash — reflog yozilmaydi va xato bo'lsa repo buziladi. <code>git update-ref</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>ls .git/refs/heads</code> bilan branch'larni sanash noto'g'ri — packed ref'lar ko'rinmaydi.</li><li>Katta-kichik harf: macOS'da <code>Feature</code> va <code>feature</code> branch'lari fayl tizimida to'qnashadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Git 2.45+ da yangi <code>reftable</code> backend bor (<code>git init --ref-format=reftable</code>) — minglab ref'li monorepo'larda tezroq va atomik. Shuning uchun skriptlar fayl yo'liga emas, plumbing buyruqlarga (<code>for-each-ref</code>, <code>update-ref</code>) tayanishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42077	<p>Simvolik reference (<code>symref</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Symbolic ref (symref) — SHA emas, <b>boshqa ref nomiga</b> ishora qiluvchi ref. Eng mashhuri <code>HEAD</code>: <code>.git/HEAD</code> ichida <code>ref: refs/heads/main</code> yoziladi, ya'ni &quot;hozirgi branch main&quot;.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Commit qilganda Git qaysi branch'ni siljitishni bilishi kerak. HEAD to'g'ridan SHA saqlasa, branch bilan aloqa yo'qoladi. Symref orqali: HEAD -&gt; main -&gt; SHA.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy holat:                     Detached HEAD:<br>HEAD --&gt; refs/heads/main --&gt; C3  HEAD --&gt; C2 (to'g'ridan SHA)<br>commit -&gt; main C4 ga siljiydi    commit -&gt; faqat HEAD siljiydi,<br>                                 branch yo'q -&gt; commit &quot;yetim&quot; bo'lishi mumkin</pre><p>Boshqa symref: <code>refs/remotes/origin/HEAD</code> -&gt; <code>refs/remotes/origin/main</code> (remote'ning default branch'i).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat .git/HEAD                       # ref: refs/heads/main<br>git symbolic-ref HEAD               # refs/heads/main<br>git symbolic-ref --short HEAD       # main<br>git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/dev   # HEAD'ni qo'lda boshqa branch'ga (switch'siz)<br>git remote set-head origin --auto   # origin/HEAD ni serverdagi default'ga moslash</pre><p>Detached holatni aniqlash (skriptlarda):</p><pre>git symbolic-ref -q HEAD || echo &quot;detached&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Detached HEAD'da commit qilib keyin <code>switch</code> qilish — commit'lar faqat reflog'da qoladi, <code>gc</code> keyin o'chiradi. <code>git switch -c fix</code> bilan saqla.</li><li>CI'da (checkout SHA bo'yicha) HEAD odatda detached — <code>git branch --show-current</code> bo'sh qaytaradi.</li><li><code>symbolic-ref HEAD</code> ni qo'lda o'zgartirish working tree'ni yangilamaydi — fayllar eski branch'niki bo'lib qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI skriptlarida branch nomini Git'dan emas, CI o'zgaruvchisidan (<code>GITHUB_REF_NAME</code>, <code>CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME</code>) ol — chunki u yerda HEAD deyarli doim detached.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42078	<p>Remote-tracking branch (<code>refs/remotes/origin/main</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Remote-tracking branch (<code>refs/remotes/origin/main</code>) — remote'dagi branch oxirgi <code>fetch</code>/<code>pull</code> paytida <b>qayerda bo'lganini</b> eslab qoluvchi lokal ref. Uni o'zing commit bilan siljita olmaysan — faqat <code>fetch</code> yangilaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Git offline ishlaydi. <code>origin/main</code> — serverning &quot;rasmi&quot;. Shu bilan <code>git log main..origin/main</code> kabi solishtirishlarni tarmoqsiz qilasan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Server:   main --&gt; C5<br>Lokal:    origin/main --&gt; C3   (oxirgi fetch)<br>          main        --&gt; C4   (sening commit'ing)<br><br>git fetch -&gt; origin/main --&gt; C5 (lokal main tegilmaydi)<br>git status -&gt; &quot;Your branch and 'origin/main' have diverged, 1 and 2 different commits&quot;</pre><p>Bog'lanish refspec bilan: <code>+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*</code> (<code>.git/config</code> da).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git fetch origin<br>git branch -r                         # remote-tracking ro'yxati<br>git branch -vv                        # qaysi lokal branch qaysi upstream'ni kuzatadi<br># * main a1b2 [origin/main: ahead 1, behind 2] fix<br>git log --oneline main..origin/main   # serverda bor, menda yo'q<br>git switch -c feat origin/feat        # tracking bilan yangi lokal branch<br>git branch -u origin/main             # upstream o'rnatish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git status</code> &quot;up to date&quot; deydi — lekin bu faqat oxirgi fetch'ga nisbatan. Avval <code>fetch</code>.</li><li><code>git checkout origin/main</code> — detached HEAD bo'ladi, unda ishlamaslik kerak.</li><li>Serverda o'chirilgan branch'lar lokal <code>origin/*</code> da qolib ketadi — <code>git fetch --prune</code> yoki <code>git config --global fetch.prune true</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>git push --force-with-lease</code> aynan remote-tracking ref'ga tayanadi: &quot;server hali men oxirgi ko'rgan joydami?&quot;. Shuning uchun force-push'dan oldin avtomatik fetch qiladigan IDE'lar bu himoyani bekor qilishi mumkin — <code>--force-with-lease=main:&lt;sha&gt;</code> aniqroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42079	<p>Git konfiguratsiya ierarxiyasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git konfiguratsiyasi bir nechta qatlamdan o'qiladi, <b>pastroq (aniqroq) qatlam ustun</b>: system &lt; global &lt; local &lt; worktree &lt; buyruq qatoridagi <code>-c</code>. Bir xil kalit bir necha joyda bo'lsa, oxirgi o'qilgani yutadi.</p><p><b>Qatlamlar:</b> | Daraja | Fayl | Kimga | Flag | |---|---|---|---| | system | <code>/etc/gitconfig</code> (yoki <code>$(prefix)/etc/gitconfig</code>) | mashinadagi hamma | <code>--system</code> | | global | <code>~/.gitconfig</code> yoki <code>~/.config/git/config</code> | joriy user | <code>--global</code> | | local | <code>.git/config</code> | shu repo | <code>--local</code> (default) | | worktree | <code>.git/worktrees/&lt;n&gt;/config.worktree</code> | shu worktree | <code>--worktree</code> | | buyruq | <code>git -c key=val ...</code> / <code>GIT_CONFIG_*</code> env | shu chaqiruv | — |</p><p><b>Real vaziyat:</b> Ish va shaxsiy loyihalarda turli email kerak. Global'da shaxsiy email, ish repo'larida local override — yoki shartli include.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git config --list --show-origin --show-scope   # har qiymat qayerdan kelgani<br>git config --show-origin user.email<br>git config --global user.email me@personal.dev<br>git config user.email me@company.com           # faqat shu repo<br>git -c core.pager=cat log -1                   # bir martalik</pre><p>Papka bo'yicha shartli config:</p><pre># ~/.gitconfig<br>[user]<br>    email = me@personal.dev<br>[includeIf &quot;gitdir:~/work/&quot;]<br>    path = ~/.gitconfig-work</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git config --global</code> deb o'ylab <code>--global</code> siz yozish — faqat shu repo'ga yoziladi.</li><li><code>.git/config</code> repo bilan push qilinmaydi — jamoa sozlamasini u orqali tarqatib bo'lmaydi (hook'lar uchun <code>core.hooksPath</code> + repo ichidagi papka).</li><li><code>includeIf &quot;gitdir:&quot;</code> oxirida <code>/</code> bo'lmasa mos kelmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Muammo bo'lganda birinchi buyruq — <code>git config --list --show-origin</code>. CI'da global config'ga tayanma: kerakli qiymatni <code>-c</code> yoki <code>GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_0/VALUE_0</code> env bilan aniq ber.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42080	<p><code>git remote</code> bilan remote'larni qanday boshqarasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git remote</code> — lokal repo biladigan uzoq repo'larning <b>nom -&gt; URL</b> ro'yxatini boshqaradi. <code>origin</code> shunchaki odatiy nom; bir nechta remote bo'lishi mumkin (fork workflow'da <code>origin</code> = sening fork'ing, <code>upstream</code> = asl repo).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> Remote <code>.git/config</code> dagi bo'lim:</p><pre>[remote &quot;upstream&quot;]<br>    url = https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes.git<br>    fetch = +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/upstream/*</pre><pre>upstream (asl repo) --fetch--&gt; lokal --push--&gt; origin (fork) --PR--&gt; upstream</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git remote -v                                   # nom, fetch/push URL<br>git remote add upstream https://github.com/org/proj.git<br>git fetch upstream<br>git rebase upstream/main                        # fork'ni yangilash<br>git remote set-url origin git@github.com:me/proj.git   # HTTPS -&gt; SSH<br>git remote rename origin old<br>git remote remove old<br>git remote show origin                          # tracking, stale branch'lar<br>git remote prune origin                         # serverda o'chgan origin/* ni tozalash</pre><p>Push'ni xavfsizlantirish (upstream'ga tasodifan push bo'lmasin):</p><pre>git remote set-url --push upstream DISABLED</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>prune</code> faqat <b>remote-tracking</b> ref'larni o'chiradi, lokal branch'larni emas. Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42081	<p>Lightweight va annotated tag farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Lightweight</b> tag — commit SHA'ga shunchaki nom (branch kabi, lekin siljimaydi), alohida obyekt yaratilmaydi. <b>Annotated</b> tag — Git bazasida alohida <code>tag</code> obyekti: tagger, sana, xabar va ixtiyoriy GPG/SSH imzo saqlaydi. Reliz uchun annotated ishlat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Lightweight:  refs/tags/tmp  --&gt;  commit C7<br><br>Annotated:    refs/tags/v1.0 --&gt;  tag obyekt (tagger, sana, msg, imzo)<br>                                       |<br>                                       v<br>                                   commit C7</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git tag tmp-test                          # lightweight<br>git tag -a v1.4.0 -m &quot;Release 1.4.0&quot;      # annotated<br>git tag -s v1.4.0 -m &quot;Release 1.4.0&quot;      # imzolangan (gpg yoki gpg.format=ssh)<br>git cat-file -t v1.4.0                    # tag   (annotated)<br>git cat-file -t tmp-test                  # commit (lightweight)<br>git show v1.4.0                           # tagger + xabar + commit<br>git tag -v v1.4.0                         # imzoni tekshirish<br>git push origin v1.4.0                    # tag'lar avtomatik push bo'lmaydi<br>git push --follow-tags                    # faqat annotated tag'larni birga</pre><p><b>Farq jadvali:</b> | | Lightweight | Annotated | |---|---|---| | Obyekt | yo'q | <code>tag</code> obyekt | | Muallif/sana | yo'q | bor | | Imzo | yo'q | mumkin | | <code>git describe</code> default | e'tiborsiz | ishlatiladi | | Maqsad | lokal belgi | reliz |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git describe</code> lightweight tag'ni ko'rmaydi (<code>--tags</code> kerak) — versiya <code>v1.3.0-45-g...</code> bo'lib chiqadi.</li><li>Push qilingan tag'ni ko'chirish (<code>-f</code>) — boshqalarda eski tag qoladi; yangi versiya chiqar.</li><li><code>git push --tags</code> hamma lokal tag'larni (shu jumladan &quot;tmp&quot;) push qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Reliz tag'i imzolangan bo'lsin va serverda himoyalansin (GitHub tag protection / rulesets) — shunda supply chain'da &quot;v1.4.0 aynan shu commit&quot; kafolati bor.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42082	<p><code>git checkout</code>, <code>git switch</code> va <code>git restore</code> farqi (Git 2.23+).</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git checkout</code> ikki xil ish qilardi — branch almashtirish va fayllarni tiklash — bu chalkashlik va xatolarga olib kelardi. Git 2.23 da u ikkiga bo'lindi: <b><code>git switch</code></b> — faqat branch'lar bilan, <b><code>git restore</code></b> — faqat fayllar bilan. <code>checkout</code> hali ishlaydi, lekin yangi buyruqlar aniqroq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>git checkout foo</code> — <code>foo</code> branch bo'lsa almashtiradi, fayl bo'lsa uning o'zgarishlarini <b>so'roqsiz o'chiradi</b>. Bir nomdagi branch va fayl bo'lsa — kutilmagan natija.</p><p><b>Mos keluvchi buyruqlar:</b> | Eski | Yangi | |---|---| | <code>git checkout dev</code> | <code>git switch dev</code> | | <code>git checkout -b feat</code> | <code>git switch -c feat</code> | | <code>git checkout &lt;sha&gt;</code> | <code>git switch --detach &lt;sha&gt;</code> | | <code>git checkout -- app.go</code> | <code>git restore app.go</code> | | <code>git reset HEAD app.go</code> | <code>git restore --staged app.go</code> | | <code>git checkout main -- app.go</code> | <code>git restore --source=main app.go</code> |</p><p><b>Qayerga ta'sir qiladi:</b></p><pre>            restore --staged          restore<br> HEAD/commit -------------&gt; index -------------&gt; working tree<br>                 (unstage)          (o'zgarishni bekor)<br> restore --source=X --staged --worktree : ikkalasini X dan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git switch -                         # oldingi branch<br>git switch -c hotfix origin/main<br>git restore --staged .               # hammasini unstage, fayllar joyida<br>git restore -p app.go                # bo'laklab bekor qilish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git restore file</code> working tree'dagi commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlarni <b>qaytarib bo'lmas</b> o'chiradi (reflog'da ham yo'q).</li><li><code>switch</code> detached HEAD'ga faqat <code>--detach</code> bilan o'tadi — tasodifan detached bo'lish xatosi kamayadi (bu afzallik).</li><li>Eski qo'llanmalar va skriptlar <code>checkout</code> ishlatadi — ikkalasini ham bilish kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Skriptlarda va jamoaga o'rgatishda <code>switch</code>/<code>restore</code> ishlat — buyruq niyati aniq. Uncommitted ishni yo'qotishdan himoya uchun avval <code>git stash</code> odatini shakllantir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42083	<p><code>git shortlog</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git shortlog</code> — <code>git log</code> natijasini <b>muallif bo'yicha guruhlab</b> chiqaradi: har muallif ostida uning commit sarlavhalari. <code>-sn</code> bilan faqat commit soni bo'yicha reyting.
