Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42084	<p><code>git show</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git show &lt;obyekt&gt;</code> — istalgan Git obyektini o'qiladigan ko'rinishda chiqaradi. Commit uchun: muallif, sana, xabar va <b>kiritgan diff</b> (parent'ga nisbatan). Tag uchun: tag ma'lumoti + commit. Fayl uchun: aniq versiyadagi mazmuni.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git show                         # HEAD commit va diff<br>git show a3f9c1e                 # aniq commit<br>git show v1.4.0                  # annotated tag: tagger, xabar, keyin commit<br>git show HEAD~2:config/app.yaml  # 2 commit oldingi fayl mazmuni (checkout'siz)<br>git show main:go.mod &gt; /tmp/old-go.mod<br>git show --stat HEAD             # faqat qaysi fayllar, nechta qator<br>git show --name-only HEAD<br>git show -s --format='%H %an %s' HEAD   # diff'siz, faqat metadata<br>git show HEAD^{tree}             # commit'ning tree'si</pre><p>Merge commit uchun:</p><pre>git show &lt;merge&gt;                 # combined diff (faqat konflikt hal qilingan joylar)<br>git show -m --first-parent &lt;merge&gt;   # birinchi parent'ga nisbatan to'liq diff</pre><p><b>Chiqishni o'qish:</b></p><pre>commit a3f9c1e...<br>Author: Alice &lt;alice@corp.com&gt;<br>Date:   Tue Oct 1 10:12 2026 +0500<br>    fix: nil map in config loader<br>diff --git a/config/load.go b/config/load.go<br>@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@   &lt;- eski qator 12dan 6 ta, yangi 12dan 7 ta<br>+    cfg.Extra = map[string]string{}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Merge commit'da <code>git show</code> bo'sh diff ko'rsatishi mumkin — bu &quot;o'zgarish yo'q&quot; emas, combined diff xususiyati.</li><li><code>git show branch:path</code> da yo'l repo ildiziga nisbatan; joriy papkaga nisbatan uchun <code>./path</code>.</li><li>Binary fayllarda diff o'rniga &quot;Binary files differ&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Incident paytida &quot;bu konfig prod relizda qanday edi?&quot; savoliga eng tez javob — <code>git show v1.4.0:deploy/values.yaml</code>. Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42085	<p><code>git status -s</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git status -s</code> (short) — holatni ixcham ikki ustunli formatda ko'rsatadi: <b>chap ustun = index (staged)</b>, <b>o'ng ustun = working tree (unstaged)</b>. Har fayl bitta qator.</p><p><b>Belgilar:</b> | Kod | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>M </code> | o'zgargan va stage qilingan | | <code> M</code> | o'zgargan, stage qilinmagan | | <code>MM</code> | stage qilingan, keyin yana o'zgartirilgan | | <code>A </code> | yangi fayl, stage qilingan | | <code>D </code> / <code> D</code> | o'chirilgan (staged / unstaged) | | <code>R </code> | rename (staged) | | <code>??</code> | untracked | | <code>!!</code> | ignored (<code>--ignored</code> bilan) | | <code>UU</code> | merge konflikti, ikkala tomon o'zgartirgan |</p><p><b>Misol:</b></p><pre>git status -sb<br>## main...origin/main [ahead 1]<br>M  api/handler.go        # tayyor commit uchun<br> M api/router.go         # o'zgargan, add qilinmagan<br>MM go.mod                # bir qismi staged, keyin yana o'zgardi<br>A  api/retry.go<br>?? tmp.log<br>UU db/migrate.go         # konflikt</pre><p><code>-b</code> branch va ahead/behind'ni qo'shadi.</p><p><b>Skriptlar uchun — porcelain:</b></p><pre>git status --porcelain=v1        # format versiyalar orasida o'zgarmaydi<br>test -z &quot;$(git status --porcelain)&quot; || { echo &quot;dirty tree&quot;; exit 1; }<br>git status --porcelain=v2 --branch   # batafsil, mashina uchun</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-s</code> formatini skriptda parse qilma — u rang va config'ga bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin; <code>--porcelain</code> barqaror kontrakt.</li><li><code>MM</code> holatida <code>git commit</code> faqat staged qismni oladi — &quot;o'zgarishim commit'ga kirmadi&quot; degan chalkashlik.</li><li>Untracked fayllar ko'p bo'lsa status sekin — <code>-uno</code> yoki <code>core.untrackedCache=true</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'da build yoki code generation'dan keyin <code>git status --porcelain</code> bo'sh ekanini tekshirish — &quot;generated fayllar commit qilinmagan&quot; xatosini ushlaydigan arzon gate.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42086	<p><code>git archive</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git archive</code> — aniq commit/tag'dagi fayllar daraxtini <code>.git</code> papkasisiz <b>tar yoki zip</b> arxivga eksport qiladi. Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42087	<p><code>git bundle</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git bundle</code> — commit'lar, ref'lar va kerakli obyektlarni <b>bitta faylga</b> jamlaydi. Bu fayl to'liq Git remote kabi ishlaydi: undan <code>clone</code>, <code>fetch</code>, <code>pull</code> qilish mumkin. Tarmoq bo'lmagan (air-gapped) muhitga repo'ni USB orqali olib o'tish uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Internetli mashina                     Yopiq tarmoq<br>git bundle create repo.bundle --all<br>        |  (USB / fayl)<br>        v<br>                                 git clone repo.bundle app<br>                                 ... keyinroq faqat yangi commit'lar:<br>git bundle create delta.bundle v1.4.0..main<br>                                 git fetch ../delta.bundle main:main</pre><p>Bundle ichida: header (ref'lar + prerequisite commit'lar) + packfile.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git bundle create full.bundle --all               # hamma branch va tag<br>git bundle create rel.bundle main --tags<br>git bundle create inc.bundle v1.4.0..main         # inkremental<br>git bundle verify inc.bundle                      # qabul qiluvchida kerakli commit'lar bormi<br># The bundle requires this ref: 7b2d... v1.4.0<br>git bundle list-heads full.bundle<br>git clone full.bundle myrepo<br>git remote add usb /media/usb/inc.bundle &amp;&amp; git fetch usb</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Inkremental bundle'da prerequisite commit qabul qiluvchida yo'q bo'lsa — <code>verify</code> xato beradi, fetch ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>HEAD</code> ni kiritmasang, <code>clone</code> qilinganda checkout bo'lmaydi (&quot;remote HEAD refers to nonexistent ref&quot;).</li><li>Bundle imzolanmagan — xavfsiz muhitga olib o'tishda checksum/imzoni alohida tekshir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bundle'ning yana bir qo'llanilishi — backup va katta CI clone'larni tezlashtirish (<code>git clone --bundle-uri</code>, Git 2.38+): CDN'dan tayyor bundle olib, faqat qolgan delta'ni serverdan fetch qilish server yukini kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42088	<p><code>git update-ref</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git update-ref</code> — ref'ni (branch, tag, istalgan <code>refs/...</code>) aniq SHA'ga <b>xavfsiz</b> o'rnatadigan, yaratadigan yoki o'chiradigan plumbing buyruq. Ref faylini qo'lda yozishdan farqli: lock oladi, reflog yozadi, va &quot;eski qiymat shu bo'lsa&quot; sharti bilan atomik ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Avtomatlashtirish (bot, migration skript, CI) branch'ni checkout qilmasdan siljitishi kerak. <code>echo SHA &gt; .git/refs/heads/main</code> packed ref'lar va reftable bilan ishlamaydi, race'dan himoyasiz.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git update-ref refs/heads/release a3f9c1e                 # yaratish/siljitish<br>git update-ref refs/heads/release NEW OLD                 # faqat hozir OLD bo'lsa (CAS)<br>git update-ref -d refs/heads/tmp                          # o'chirish<br>git update-ref -m &quot;bot: fast-forward&quot; refs/heads/main NEW # reflog xabari</pre><p>Bir nechta ref'ni atomik (hammasi yoki hech biri):</p><pre>git update-ref --stdin &lt;&lt;'EOF'<br>start<br>update refs/heads/main 9e1f... a3f9...<br>create refs/tags/v1.5.0 9e1f...<br>prepare<br>commit<br>EOF</pre><p>Natijani tekshirish:</p><pre>git reflog show release</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>update-ref</code> working tree va index'ga tegmaydi. Joriy branch'ni (HEAD ko'rsatgan) siljitsang, <code>git status</code> bir talay &quot;o'zgarish&quot; ko'rsatadi — fayllar eski commit'niki.</li><li>Fast-forward tekshiruvi yo'q: istalgan commit'ga, tarixni &quot;yo'qotib&quot; o'rnata oladi.</li><li><code>HEAD</code> ga ishlatganda symref orqali branch siljiydi; <code>--no-deref</code> bilan HEAD'ning o'zi detached bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eski qiymat bilan CAS (<code>NEW OLD</code>) — konkurent botlar uchun optimistic locking; serverdagi atomik push (<code>git push --atomic</code>) ham shu printsipda.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42089	<p><code>git rev-parse</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git rev-parse</code> — revision ifodalarini (branch, tag, <code>HEAD~3</code>, <code>main^2</code>, <code>v1.0^{commit}</code>, <code>@{u}</code>) <b>to'liq SHA</b>ga aylantiradi va repo haqida ma'lumot beradi (ildiz papka, <code>.git</code> joyi, joriy branch). Skriptlarning asosiy &quot;Git so'rovchi&quot; buyrug'i.</p><p><b>Revision sintaksisi:</b></p><pre>HEAD~3     birinchi parent bo'yicha 3 qadam orqaga<br>HEAD^2     merge commit'ning ikkinchi parent'i<br>main@{1}   reflog: main'ning oldingi qiymati<br>@{u}       joriy branch upstream'i (origin/main)<br>v1.0^{}    tag'ni commit'gacha &quot;ochish&quot;<br>HEAD:path  fayl blob'i</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git rev-parse HEAD                  # 40 belgili SHA<br>git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD       # build tag uchun<br>git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD     # main (detached bo'lsa &quot;HEAD&quot;)<br>git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{u}     # origin/main<br>git rev-parse --show-toplevel       # repo ildizi<br>git rev-parse --git-dir             # .git yo'li (worktree'da boshqacha)<br>git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree # true/false<br>git rev-parse --verify -q &quot;v9.9^{commit}&quot; || echo &quot;bunday tag yo'q&quot;</pre><p>Skriptda:</p><pre>ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)<br>IMAGE_TAG=$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git rev-parse foo</code> mavjud bo'lmagan nomni ham (ba'zan) qaytaradi yoki chalkash xato beradi — tekshiruv uchun <code>--verify</code>.</li><li>Qisqa SHA uzunligi repo kattalashgan sari o'zgaradi — tag'larda doim aniq <code>--short=N</code>.</li><li><code>--abbrev-ref HEAD</code> detached holatda <code>HEAD</code> qaytaradi — CI'da branch nomi uchun ishonchsiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Annotated tag SHA'si commit SHA'si emas — <code>git rev-parse v1.0</code> tag obyektini, <code>git rev-parse v1.0^{commit}</code> commit'ni beradi. Deploy'da solishtirishda shu farq tufayli &quot;mos emas&quot; xatolari chiqadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42090	<p><code>git merge-base</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git merge-base A B</code> — ikki commit'ning <b>eng yaxshi umumiy ajdodi</b>ni (ikkalasidan erishiladigan eng yangi commit) topadi. 3-way merge aynan shu commit'ni &quot;asos&quot; sifatida ishlatadi: nima A'da, nima B'da o'zgarganini shu nuqtaga nisbatan aniqlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>          C4---C5   feature<br>         /<br>C1---C2---C3---C6   main<br><br>git merge-base main feature  -&gt;  C3<br>3-way merge: base=C3, ours=C6, theirs=C5</pre><p>Base bo'lmasa Git har farqni konflikt deb hisoblardi; base bilan &quot;faqat bir tomon o'zgartirgan&quot; joylar avtomatik hal bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git merge-base main feature<br>git diff $(git merge-base main feature) feature   # = git diff main...feature<br>git log --oneline $(git merge-base main HEAD)..HEAD   # PR'dagi commit'lar<br>git merge-base --is-ancestor v1.4.0 HEAD &amp;&amp; echo &quot;v1.4.0 bu relizga kirgan&quot;<br>git merge-base --fork-point origin/main feature   # upstream rebase bo'lgan bo'lsa ham<br>git merge-base --all A B                           # criss-cross: bir nechta base</pre><p>CI'da &quot;faqat o'zgargan servislarni test qil&quot;:</p><pre>BASE=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)<br>git diff --name-only &quot;$BASE&quot; HEAD | cut -d/ -f1-2 | sort -u</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Shallow clone (<code>--depth=1</code>) da merge-base topilmaydi — CI'da <code>fetch-depth: 0</code> yoki yetarli chuqurlik kerak.</li><li>Criss-cross merge'larda bir nechta base bo'ladi — <code>ort</code> strategy ularni virtual base'ga birlashtiradi, natija kutilmagan konflikt bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li><code>A..B</code> va <code>A...B</code> farqi: <code>diff</code> da <code>...</code> merge-base'dan, <code>log</code> da <code>...</code> simmetrik farq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>--is-ancestor</code> — &quot;bu fix qaysi relizlarga kirgan?&quot; savoliga deterministik javob; reliz va hotfix kuzatuvini avtomatlashtirishda juda qo'l keladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42091	<p><code>git describe</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git describe</code> — commit'dan orqaga qarab eng yaqin <b>annotated</b> tag'ni topadi va inson o'qiy oladigan versiya qaytaradi: <code>v1.4.0-12-g2a1b3c4</code> = &quot;v1.4.0 dan keyin 12 commit, commit 2a1b3c4&quot;. Commit aynan tag'da bo'lsa — faqat <code>v1.4.0</code>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Build artifact'ga versiya yozish: SHA'dan ko'ra tushunarli, lekin aniq commit'ga bog'liq. Kodda versiya faylini qo'lda yangilash shart emas.</p><p><b>Formatni o'qish:</b></p><pre>v1.4.0-12-g2a1b3c4-dirty<br>  |     |  |         +-- working tree'da commit qilinmagan o'zgarish (--dirty)<br>  |     |  +-- &quot;g&quot; = git, keyin qisqa SHA<br>  |     +-- tag'dan keyingi commit soni<br>  +-- eng yaqin tag</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git describe                         # faqat annotated tag'lar<br>git describe --tags                  # lightweight ham<br>git describe --tags --dirty --always # tag bo'lmasa SHA qaytaradi, xato emas<br>git describe --abbrev=0              # faqat oxirgi tag nomi: v1.4.0<br>git describe --match 'v[0-9]*'       # boshqa tag'larni (deploy-*) e'tiborsiz<br>git describe --exact-match HEAD      # aynan tag'dami? reliz pipeline'da tekshiruv</pre><p>Go build'da:</p><pre>go build -ldflags &quot;-X main.version=$(git describe --tags --dirty --always)&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CI shallow clone'da tag'lar yo'q — <code>fatal: No names found</code>. <code>fetch-depth: 0</code> va <code>fetch-tags</code>.</li><li>Lightweight tag'lar default'da ko'rinmaydi — kutilgan tag o'rniga eskisi chiqadi.</li><li><code>-12-</code> &quot;12-patch&quot; degani emas; SemVer bilan aralashtirib, <code>v1.4.12</code> deb talqin qilma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>--exact-match</code> bilan reliz job'ini faqat tag'langan commit'da ishlashga majburla; boshqa build'larda <code>describe</code> natijasi pre-release versiya sifatida (<code>1.4.0-dev.12+g2a1b3c4</code>) ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42092	<p><code>git rm</code> va <code>git rm --cached</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git rm &lt;file&gt;</code> — faylni <b>diskdan ham, index'dan ham</b> o'chiradi (keyingi commit'da o'chirilgan bo'ladi). <code>git rm --cached &lt;file&gt;</code> — faqat index'dan olib tashlaydi: fayl diskda qoladi, lekin Git uni kuzatishni to'xtatadi (untracked bo'ladi).</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b></p><pre>git rm app.log            disk: yo'q     index: yo'q    -&gt; fayl kerak emas<br>git rm --cached .env      disk: bor      index: yo'q    -&gt; Git'da bo'lmasligi kerak edi</pre><p><b>Real vaziyat:</b> <code>.env</code> yoki <code>node_modules</code> tasodifan commit qilindi. <code>.gitignore</code> ga qo'shish yetmaydi — allaqachon tracked fayllarga ignore ta'sir qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo &quot;.env&quot; &gt;&gt; .gitignore<br>git rm --cached .env<br>git commit -m &quot;stop tracking .env&quot;<br>git rm -r --cached node_modules/       # papka<br>git rm --cached -r . &amp;&amp; git add .      # .gitignore o'zgargandan keyin hammasini qayta baholash<br>git rm -n '*.log'                      # dry-run: nima o'chishini ko'rsat<br>git rm -f file                         # o'zgargan faylni majburan o'chirish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git rm --cached</code> <b>tarixdan</b> o'chirmaydi. Secret commit qilingan bo'lsa u eski commit'larda qoladi — kalitni rotate qil, kerak bo'lsa <code>git filter-repo</code> bilan tarixni tozala.</li><li>Boshqa dasturchilar <code>pull</code> qilganda, <code>--cached</code> bilan olib tashlangan fayl <b>ularning diskidan o'chadi</b> (Git uchun bu o'chirish). Lokal <code>.env</code> larni oldindan zaxirala.</li><li><code>git rm</code> o'zgargan faylni rad etadi — <code>-f</code> bilan ishni yo'qotish mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Secret leak'da tartib: 1) kalitni darhol revoke/rotate, 2) keyin tarixni tozalash. Tarixni tozalash hech qachon birinchi qadam emas — kalit allaqachon clone'larda va fork'larda.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42093	<p><code>git mv</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git mv old new</code> — faylni qayta nomlaydi/ko'chiradi va natijani stage qiladi; bu <code>mv old new &amp;&amp; git rm old &amp;&amp; git add new</code> ga teng qisqa yo'l. Git rename'ni <b>saqlamaydi</b> — u diff/log paytida mazmun o'xshashligi bo'yicha aniqlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Commit A: tree { util.go -&gt; blob X }<br>Commit B: tree { helpers.go -&gt; blob X' }   (X' X ga 50%+ o'xshash)<br>git diff A B -&gt; &quot;rename util.go -&gt; helpers.go (92%)&quot;</pre><p>Rename metadata yo'q; Git har safar hisoblaydi (default o'xshashlik chegarasi 50%).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git mv src/util.go src/helpers.go<br>git status -s<br># R  src/util.go -&gt; src/helpers.go<br>git mv -n old new                    # dry-run<br>git mv File.go file.go               # case-insensitive FS'da (macOS) faqat shu ishlaydi<br>git log --follow -- src/helpers.go   # rename orqali tarix<br>git diff -M50% --stat HEAD~1         # rename aniqlash chegarasi<br>git blame -C -C src/helpers.go       # ko'chirilgan qatorlarning asl muallifi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta commit'da ham rename, ham katta o'zgartirish — o'xshashlik 50% dan tushib, Git uni &quot;delete + add&quot; deb ko'radi; tarix uziladi. Rename'ni alohida commit qil.</li><li><code>git log -- newpath</code> <code>--follow</code> siz rename'dan oldingi tarixni ko'rsatmaydi.</li><li>macOS/Windows'da <code>mv File.go file.go</code> Git'ga ko'rinmaydi — <code>git mv</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta refactoring'da (papkalarni ko'chirish) avval &quot;faqat ko'chirish&quot; PR, keyin &quot;o'zgartirish&quot; PR — review oson, <code>blame</code> va <code>--follow</code> tarixni saqlaydi. Merge'da ham rename detection konfliktlarni kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42094	<p><code>git ls-files</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git ls-files</code> — <b>index</b>dagi (Git kuzatayotgan) fayllar ro'yxatini chiqaradi. Opsiyalar bilan untracked, ignored, o'chirilgan, o'zgargan yoki konfliktli fayllarni ham ko'rsatadi. Skriptlar uchun <code>find</code> dan ishonchliroq: <code>.gitignore</code> ni hurmat qiladi va tez.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git ls-files                          # tracked fayllar<br>git ls-files -s                       # mode, blob SHA, stage raqami, yo'l<br># 100644 e69de29... 0  README.md<br>git ls-files --others --exclude-standard   # untracked, ignore qilinmaganlar<br>git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard  # ignore qilingan fayllar<br>git ls-files -m                       # o'zgargan (modified)<br>git ls-files -d                       # diskdan o'chirilgan<br>git ls-files -u                       # merge konflikt (stage 1/2/3)<br>git ls-files '*.go' | xargs gofmt -l  # faqat tracked Go fayllar<br>git ls-files -z | xargs -0 wc -l      # bo'shliqli nomlar uchun xavfsiz</pre><p><code>-s</code> dagi stage: 0 = normal; konfliktda 1 = base, 2 = ours, 3 = theirs.</p><p><b>Real foydalanish:</b></p><ul><li>Linter/formatter'ni faqat tracked fayllarga (vendor, build artefakt emas).</li><li>&quot;Nega bu fayl ignore qilinmayapti?&quot; — u tracked bo'lsa ignore ta'sir qilmaydi: <code>git ls-files --error-unmatch path</code>.</li><li>Qaysi ignore qoidasi ishladi: <code>git check-ignore -v path</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git ls-files</code> diskni emas, index'ni ko'rsatadi — <code>git add</code> qilinmagan yangi fayl ro'yxatda yo'q.</li><li><code>-z</code> siz bo'shliq yoki unicode nomli fayllar <code>xargs</code> da sinadi (<code>core.quotePath</code> ham ta'sir qiladi).</li><li>Submodule ichidagi fayllar ko'rinmaydi (<code>--recurse-submodules</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pre-commit hook va CI skriptlarda <code>find .</code> o'rniga <code>git ls-files</code> — <code>node_modules</code>, <code>.git</code>, build papkalarini avtomatik chetlab o'tadi va natija har mashinada bir xil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42095	<p><code>git ls-tree</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git ls-tree &lt;tree-ish&gt;</code> — tree obyekt mazmunini, ya'ni bitta commit'dagi papka &quot;ro'yxati&quot;ni chiqaradi: har yozuv uchun <b>mode, turi (blob/tree/commit), SHA, nomi</b>. Checkout qilmasdan istalgan versiyadagi fayl tuzilishini ko'rish uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>commit --&gt; tree (root)<br>             +-- 100644 blob 8ab6... README.md<br>             +-- 040000 tree 3c1f... src<br>             |               +-- 100644 blob ... main.go<br>             +-- 160000 commit 9d2e... vendor/lib   (submodule)</pre><p>Mode'lar: <code>100644</code> oddiy fayl, <code>100755</code> executable, <code>120000</code> symlink, <code>040000</code> papka, <code>160000</code> submodule (gitlink).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git ls-tree HEAD<br># 100644 blob 8ab686eafeb1f44702738c8b0f24f2567c36da6d    README.md<br># 040000 tree 3c1f2a...                                     src<br>git ls-tree -r HEAD                     # rekursiv, faqat blob'lar<br>git ls-tree -r -l v1.4.0 | sort -k4 -n | tail   # eng katta fayllar (-l = hajm)<br>git ls-tree --name-only -r main -- deploy/<br>git ls-tree HEAD src/                   # papka ichini<br>git ls-tree -d HEAD                     # faqat papkalar</pre><p>Executable bit tekshiruvi (CI'da skript ishga tushmayotgan bo'lsa):</p><pre>git ls-tree HEAD scripts/deploy.sh      # 100644 bo'lsa -&gt; chmod yo'qolgan<br>git update-index --chmod=+x scripts/deploy.sh</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ls-tree</code> index yoki diskni emas, <b>commit</b>dagi holatni ko'rsatadi (<code>ls-files</code> bilan adashtirma).</li><li><code>-r</code> siz faqat bir daraja — papkalar <code>tree</code> sifatida chiqadi.</li><li>Windows/<code>core.fileMode=false</code> muhitlarda executable bit Git'ga tushmay qoladi — Linux CI'da &quot;Permission denied&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>ls-tree -r -l</code> bilan repo'ga tasodifan qo'shilgan katta binary'larni topish oson; bunday fayllarni pre-receive hook yoki CI hajm limiti bilan bloklash repo shishishini oldini oladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42096	<p><code>git write-tree</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git write-tree</code> — <b>index</b>ning joriy holatidan tree obyekt(lar) yaratib <code>.git/objects</code> ga yozadi va root tree SHA'sini qaytaradi. Bu <code>git commit</code> ning ichki birinchi qadami: commit aslida &quot;index -&gt; tree -&gt; commit obyekt -&gt; ref siljitish&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git add            git write-tree        git commit-tree      git update-ref<br>working tree --&gt; index --(tree SHA)--&gt; commit obyekt --&gt; refs/heads/main<br>                           ^-- shu qadam</pre><p>Har papka uchun alohida tree obyekt yoziladi; mazmun o'zgarmagan papkalar uchun avvalgi tree SHA'si qayta ishlatiladi (content-addressed).</p><p><b>Amalda (commit'ni qo'lda qurish):</b></p><pre>echo &quot;hello&quot; &gt; a.txt<br>git add a.txt<br>TREE=$(git write-tree)<br>echo $TREE                       # 2e81171...<br>git cat-file -p $TREE<br># 100644 blob ce01362...    a.txt</pre><p>Konfliktli index bilan:</p><pre>git write-tree<br># error: a.txt: unmerged (...)  fatal: git-write-tree: error building trees</pre><p>Ya'ni hamma konflikt hal qilinmaguncha tree (va commit) yaratib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>write-tree</code> working tree'ni emas, index'ni oladi — <code>add</code> qilinmagan o'zgarishlar kirmaydi.</li><li>U hech qanday ref'ni o'zgartirmaydi; tree &quot;yetim&quot; obyekt bo'lib qoladi, commit qilinmasa <code>gc</code> o'chiradi.</li><li><code>--missing-ok</code> siz index'da mavjud bo'lmagan blob'ga havola bo'lsa xato beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Plumbing buyruqlarni bilish &quot;Git qanday ishlaydi&quot;ni tushunishning eng qisqa yo'li. Amaliy foydasi — boshqa branch'ga checkout qilmasdan commit yaratadigan botlar (temporary <code>GIT_INDEX_FILE</code> + <code>write-tree</code> + <code>commit-tree</code>), masalan generated docs'ni <code>gh-pages</code> ga yozish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42097	<p><code>git commit-tree</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git commit-tree &lt;tree&gt; [-p &lt;parent&gt;...] -m &quot;msg&quot;</code> — berilgan tree va parent(lar)dan <b>commit obyekt</b> yaratadi va uning SHA'sini chiqaradi. Hech qaysi branch'ni siljitmaydi, HEAD'ga tegmaydi — buni keyin <code>update-ref</code> bilan qilasan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>commit obyekt = tree &lt;SHA&gt;<br>                parent &lt;SHA&gt;       (0 = root, 1 = oddiy, 2+ = merge)<br>                author / committer + sana<br>                (ixtiyoriy gpgsig)<br>                &lt;bo'sh qator&gt;<br>                xabar</pre><p><b>Amalda (commit'ni to'liq qo'lda):</b></p><pre>TREE=$(git write-tree)<br>PARENT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)<br>NEW=$(git commit-tree &quot;$TREE&quot; -p &quot;$PARENT&quot; -m &quot;chore: regenerate docs&quot;)<br>git cat-file -p $NEW<br>git update-ref refs/heads/main &quot;$NEW&quot; &quot;$PARENT&quot;   # CAS bilan siljitish</pre><p>Boshqa branch'ga checkout'siz commit (masalan <code>gh-pages</code>):</p><pre>export GIT_INDEX_FILE=$(mktemp)<br>git read-tree --empty<br>git add -f site/*                     # yoki: git update-index --add ...<br>TREE=$(git write-tree)<br>NEW=$(git commit-tree $TREE -p gh-pages -m &quot;deploy docs $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)&quot;)<br>git update-ref refs/heads/gh-pages $NEW</pre><p>Tarixsiz &quot;squash&quot; (hamma tarixni bitta commit'ga):</p><pre>git reset $(git commit-tree HEAD^{tree} -m &quot;initial import&quot;)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>update-ref</code> qilinmasa commit yetim qoladi va <code>gc</code> uni o'chiradi.</li><li>Muallif/sana env'dan olinadi (<code>GIT_AUTHOR_NAME</code>, <code>GIT_AUTHOR_DATE</code>) — CI'da sozlanmasa &quot;unknown&quot; yoki xato.</li><li>Hook'lar (<code>pre-commit</code>, <code>commit-msg</code>) ishlamaydi — plumbing ularni chetlab o'tadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bir xil tree, parent, muallif, sana va xabar = bir xil commit SHA. Reproducible avtomatik commit'lar uchun <code>GIT_AUTHOR_DATE</code>/<code>GIT_COMMITTER_DATE</code> ni qotirish — shu xossaga tayanadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42098	<p><code>git pack-objects</code> va packfile (<code>.pack</code> / <code>.idx</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Packfile — Git obyektlarini bitta <code>.pack</code> faylga <b>delta compression</b> bilan siqib saqlash formati; yonidagi <code>.idx</code> — SHA bo'yicha obyekt offset'ini tez (binary search) topish uchun indeks. <code>git pack-objects</code> packfile yaratadigan plumbing buyruq; <code>gc</code>, <code>repack</code>, <code>push</code>, <code>fetch</code> uni ichkarida ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Loose obyekt = har biri alohida zlib fayl. 1 MB faylning 100 versiyasi = ~100 MB. Pack ichida esa bitta to'liq versiya + kichik delta'lar.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>loose: .git/objects/ab/cdef...   (har obyekt alohida fayl)<br>             |  git gc / git repack<br>             v<br>.git/objects/pack/pack-1a2b.pack   obyektlar: to'liq yoki delta (base'ga nisbatan)<br>.git/objects/pack/pack-1a2b.idx    SHA -&gt; offset (fanout jadval + sorted SHA)<br>(+ .rev, multi-pack-index, bitmap - katta repo'larda tezlik uchun)</pre><p>Delta tanlash: o'xshash nom va hajmdagi obyektlar <code>--window</code> ichida solishtiriladi; delta zanjiri <code>--depth</code> bilan cheklanadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git count-objects -vH                     # loose vs packed hajm<br>git gc                                    # loose -&gt; pack, keraksizlarni tozalash<br>git repack -a -d --window=250 --depth=50  # agressiv qayta packlash<br>git verify-pack -v .git/objects/pack/pack-*.idx | sort -k3 -n | tail -5   # eng katta obyektlar<br>git rev-list --objects --all | git pack-objects --stdout &gt; all.pack   # qo'lda</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Allaqachon siqilgan binary'lar (zip, jpg, mp4) deltalanmaydi — repo shishadi. Git LFS ishlat.</li><li><code>gc --aggressive</code> katta repo'da soatlab CPU va xotira yeydi; muntazam emas, kamdan-kam.</li><li>Tarixdan katta faylni o'chirganda pack'da qolaveradi — <code>reflog expire</code> + <code>gc --prune=now</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta repo'larda <code>git maintenance start</code> (fon incremental repack, commit-graph, multi-pack-index) qo'lda <code>gc</code> dan yaxshiroq. Server tomonida reachability bitmap'lar clone/fetch'ni bir necha barobar tezlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42099	<p><code>git unpack-objects</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git unpack-objects</code> — packfile'ni stdin'dan o'qib, ichidagi obyektlarni alohida <b>loose obyekt</b> fayllariga (<code>.git/objects/xx/...</code>) yozadi. <code>pack-objects</code> ning teskarisi. Kundalik ishda kamdan-kam kerak bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qachon ishlatiladi:</b></p><ul><li>Git o'zi: kichik <code>fetch</code>/<code>push</code> da kelgan pack obyektlari soni <code>transfer.unpackLimit</code> (default 100) dan kam bo'lsa — unpack qilinadi; ko'p bo'lsa pack holida saqlanadi (<code>index-pack</code>).</li><li>Buzilgan packfile'dan nima bo'lsa ham obyektlarni qutqarish.</li><li>Pack'dagi obyektni boshqa repo'ga ko'chirish yoki tekshirish.</li></ul><p><b>Muhim xususiyat:</b> Agar obyekt repo'da allaqachon mavjud bo'lsa, <code>unpack-objects</code> uni yozmaydi. Shuning uchun o'z pack'ingni o'sha repo'ga unpack qilsang, hech narsa bo'lmaydi — pack'ni avval boshqa joyga ko'chirish kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda (buzilgan pack'dan qutqarish):</b></p><pre>mv .git/objects/pack/pack-1a2b.pack /tmp/<br>rm .git/objects/pack/pack-1a2b.idx<br>git unpack-objects -r &lt; /tmp/pack-1a2b.pack   # -r: xatoli obyektlarni o'tkazib, davom etish<br>git fsck --full                               # nima yetishmayotganini ko'rish</pre><p>Oddiy:</p><pre>git unpack-objects -n &lt; some.pack    # dry-run, faqat tekshirish<br>git count-objects -v                 # loose soni oshganini ko'r</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta pack'ni unpack qilish — millionlab mayda fayl, disk va inode'larni to'ldiradi; ish ham sekinlashadi.</li><li><code>.idx</code> ni o'chirmasdan pack'ni joyida qoldirsang — obyektlar &quot;mavjud&quot; deb hisoblanadi va unpack hech narsa qilmaydi.</li><li>Qutqarishdan oldin butun <code>.git</code> papkasining nusxasini ol.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatda maqsad aksincha — loose'larni pack qilish (<code>gc</code>/<code>maintenance</code>). <code>unpack-objects</code> asosan disaster recovery va Git ichki mexanizmini o'rganish asbobi; bunday holatda eng yaxshi &quot;qutqarish&quot; — boshqa clone'dan (CI cache, hamkasb) yetishmayotgan obyektlarni fetch qilish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H32 Git internals	idrill-42100	<p><code>git count-objects</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git count-objects</code> — repo'dagi obyektlar sonini va egallagan joyni ko'rsatadi: loose obyektlar, packfile'lar, pack hajmi, &quot;garbage&quot; fayllar. <code>-vH</code> bilan batafsil va o'qiladigan birliklarda (KiB/MiB).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git count-objects -vH<br># count: 1834                 &lt;- loose obyektlar soni<br># size: 7.20 MiB              &lt;- loose hajmi<br># in-pack: 254310             &lt;- pack ichidagi obyektlar<br># packs: 3                    &lt;- packfile'lar soni<br># size-pack: 412.55 MiB       &lt;- pack hajmi (repo'ning asosiy og'irligi)<br># prune-packable: 120         &lt;- ham loose, ham pack'da bor (keraksiz nusxa)<br># garbage: 0                  &lt;- tanilmagan fayllar<br># size-garbage: 0 bytes</pre><p><b>O'qish:</b></p><ul><li><code>count</code> bir necha mingdan oshsa — <code>git gc</code> vaqti (Git o'zi ~6700 da <code>gc --auto</code> ishlatadi).</li><li><code>packs</code> ko'p (o'nlab) — fetch/qidiruv sekinlashadi, <code>git repack -ad</code>.</li><li><code>size-pack</code> kutilganidan katta — tarixda katta fayllar bor.</li></ul><p><b>Katta obyektlarni topish:</b></p><pre>git rev-list --objects --all \<br> | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectname) %(objectsize) %(rest)' \<br> | awk '$1==&quot;blob&quot;' | sort -k3 -n | tail -10</pre><p>Tozalash:</p><pre>git gc --prune=now<br>git filter-repo --strip-blobs-bigger-than 10M   # tarixni qayta yozadi - jamoa bilan kelishib</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>count-objects</code> faqat <code>.git/objects</code> ni hisoblaydi — LFS cache (<code>.git/lfs</code>) va worktree hajmi kirmaydi; <code>du -sh .git</code> bilan solishtir.</li><li>Faylni o'chirib commit qilish repo hajmini kamaytirmaydi — u tarixda qoladi.</li><li><code>filter-repo</code> dan keyin hamma qayta clone qilishi kerak, aks holda eski obyektlar push bilan qaytib keladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Repo hajmini CI'da kuzat (masalan <code>size-pack</code> metrikasi) va katta fayllarni pre-receive hook / pre-commit bilan oldindan to'xtat — keyin tarixni tozalashdan ko'ra arzon.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::git sec::h32 Git_internals
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42101	<p>Interaktiv rebase (<code>git rebase -i</code>) qanday bajariladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git rebase -i &lt;base&gt;</code> oxirgi commit'larni editor'da ro'yxat qilib ochadi; har qatordagi buyruqni (<code>pick</code>, <code>reword</code>, <code>edit</code>, <code>squash</code>, <code>fixup</code>, <code>drop</code>) o'zgartirib, tartibini almashtirib, tarixni PR'dan oldin tozalaysiz.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Feature branch'da &quot;wip&quot;, &quot;fix typo&quot;, &quot;fix again&quot; kabi 6 ta commit bor. Review qiluvchiga 2 ta mantiqiy commit kerak: &quot;feat: add API&quot; va &quot;test: add API tests&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> Git tanlangan commit'larni vaqtincha olib qo'yadi, <code>HEAD</code> ni base'ga qaytaradi va ro'yxatdagi buyruqlarni yuqoridan pastga qayta qo'llaydi. Har qayta qo'llangan commit — <b>yangi SHA</b>.</p><pre>base -- A -- B -- C -- D      (eski)<br>base -- A' -- (B+C)' -- D'    (rebase -i dan keyin)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git rebase -i HEAD~4          # yoki: git rebase -i origin/main</pre><p>Editor:</p><pre>pick   a1b2c3 feat: add user API<br>fixup  d4e5f6 fix typo<br>reword 0a9b8c test: add tests<br>drop   7f6e5d debug print</pre><p>| Buyruq | Nima qiladi | |---|---| | <code>pick</code> | o'zgarishsiz qoldiradi | | <code>reword</code> | faqat xabarni o'zgartiradi | | <code>edit</code> | shu commit'da to'xtaydi (<code>git commit --amend</code>, keyin <code>git rebase --continue</code>) | | <code>squash</code> | oldingisiga qo'shadi, xabarlarni birlashtiradi | | <code>fixup</code> | oldingisiga qo'shadi, xabarini tashlaydi | | <code>drop</code> | commit'ni olib tashlaydi | | <code>exec</code> | qatordan keyin buyruq ishlatadi (<code>exec make test</code>) |</p><p>Konflikt chiqsa: tuzat → <code>git add</code> → <code>git rebase --continue</code>; vahima bo'lsa <code>git rebase --abort</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Allaqachon push qilingan va boshqalar ishlatayotgan branch'ni rebase qilish — ularning tarixi buziladi.</li><li>Rebase'dan keyin oddiy <code>git push</code> rad etiladi — <code>--force-with-lease</code> kerak, <code>--force</code> emas.</li><li>Qatorni o'chirib qo'yish = <code>drop</code>. Adashsangiz <code>git reflog</code> orqali qaytasiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>git rebase -i --exec &quot;make test&quot; origin/main</code> har commit build bo'lishini tekshiradi — <code>bisect</code> uchun toza tarix. Jamoada <code>--autosquash</code> va <code>fixup!</code> commit'lar bilan ishlash qo'lda tahrirdan tezroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42102	<p>Murakkab merge conflict'ni qanday hal qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Murakkab konfliktni &quot;o'zimnikini&quot; yoki &quot;ularnikini&quot; tanlab emas, <b>ikkala tomon niyatini</b> tushunib hal qilasiz: base versiyani ko'rasiz (<code>zdiff3</code>), har tomon tarixini o'qiysiz, qo'lda birlashtirasiz, so'ng test bilan tasdiqlaysiz.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Siz <code>calculateTax()</code> ga parametr qo'shdingiz, hamkasb esa shu funksiyani boshqa faylga ko'chirib, nomini o'zgartirdi. Git faqat matn qatorlarini ko'radi — mantiqni emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> 3-way merge: base (umumiy ajdod), ours, theirs. Ikkalasi ham bir qatorni o'zgartirgan bo'lsa — konflikt.</p><pre>        base<br>       /    \<br>    ours    theirs<br>       \    /<br>     merge (konflikt shu yerda)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git config --global merge.conflictStyle zdiff3   # base ham ko'rinadi<br>git merge feature<br>git status                       # &quot;both modified&quot; fayllar<br>git log --merge -p -- src/tax.go # konfliktga sabab commit'lar<br>git diff                         # combined diff<br>git checkout --conflict=zdiff3 src/tax.go   # markerlarni qayta yaratish</pre><p>Fayl ichida:</p><pre>&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt;&lt; HEAD<br>total := calculateTax(price, region)<br>||||||| base<br>total := calculateTax(price)<br>=======<br>total := tax.Calculate(price)<br>&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt; feature</pre><p>To'g'ri yechim — ikkalasini qo'shish: <code>tax.Calculate(price, region)</code>. Keyin:</p><pre>git add src/tax.go<br>go test ./...                    # MAJBURIY<br>git merge --continue</pre><p>Butun faylni bir tomondan olish: <code>git checkout --ours file</code> / <code>--theirs file</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Marker qolgan holda commit — <code>git diff --check</code> yoki pre-commit hook ushlaydi.</li><li>Rebase paytida <code>ours</code>/<code>theirs</code> ma'nosi teskari: <code>ours</code> = upstream, <code>theirs</code> = sizning commit.</li><li>Konfliktsiz merge ham semantik buzilishi mumkin (bir tomon funksiyani o'chirdi, boshqasi chaqiruv qo'shdi) — testsiz merge xavfli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta konfliktlar — jarayon muammosi belgisi: uzoq yashovchi branch'lar. Yechim — kichik PR, tez-tez <code>main</code> dan rebase, refactor'larni alohida tez merge qilish. <code>rerere</code> takroriy konfliktlarni tejaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42103	<p><code>git rerere</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>rerere</code> (reuse recorded resolution) — siz bir marta hal qilgan konfliktni yozib oladi va xuddi shu konflikt yana chiqsa, yechimni avtomatik qo'llaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Uzoq yashovchi branch'ni har kuni <code>main</code> ustiga rebase qilasiz va har safar bir xil 5 ta konfliktni qayta hal qilasiz. Yoki test uchun merge qilib, keyin bekor qilasiz — keyingi haqiqiy merge'da yana o'sha ish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>konflikt chiqdi -&gt; rerere &quot;preimage&quot; (konflikt shakli) saqlaydi<br>siz hal qildingiz -&gt; commit paytida &quot;postimage&quot; saqlaydi<br>                     (.git/rr-cache/&lt;hash&gt;/)<br>keyingi safar xuddi shu preimage -&gt; postimage avtomatik qo'llanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git config --global rerere.enabled true<br>git config --global rerere.autoUpdate true   # hal qilinganni avtomatik stage<br>git rebase main<br># &quot;Resolved 'src/app.go' using previous resolution.&quot;<br>git rerere status        # rerere kuzatayotgan fayllar<br>git rerere diff          # joriy yechim farqi<br>git rerere forget src/app.go   # noto'g'ri yozilgan yechimni unutish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Noto'g'ri hal qilgan bo'lsangiz, rerere xatoni ham takrorlaydi — <code>forget</code> bilan tozalang.</li><li><code>autoUpdate</code> siz natijani ko'rmasdan stage qiladi — baribir test ishga tushiring.</li><li>Kesh lokal (<code>.git/rr-cache</code>) — jamoa bilan ulashilmaydi; eski yozuvlar <code>gc.rerereResolved</code> (default 60 kun) dan keyin o'chadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> rerere integration branch'larida (Linux kernel uslubi: topic branch'larni har kuni qayta merge qilish) juda foydali. Lekin u alomatni yengillashtiradi — asosiy davo baribir qisqa umrli branch'lar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42104	<p>Trunk-based va GitFlow (version control kontekstida) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Trunk-based</b> — hamma kichik o'zgarishlarni kuniga kamida bir marta <code>main</code> ga birlashtiradi, tugallanmagan ish feature flag ortida. <b>GitFlow</b> — <code>develop</code>, <code>feature/*</code>, <code>release/*</code>, <code>hotfix/*</code> kabi uzoq yashovchi branch'lar bilan rejalashtirilgan relizlar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki hafta alohida branch'da yashagan feature merge paytida 40 ta konfliktga uchraydi (&quot;merge hell&quot;). Integratsiya qanchalik kech bo'lsa, shuncha qimmat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Trunk-based:<br>main  --o--o--o--o--o--o--o--&gt;   (har biri CI'dan o'tgan)<br>         \_/   \_/              (&lt; 1 kunlik branch)<br><br>GitFlow:<br>main    --o-----------------o------&gt;  (faqat reliz tag'lari)<br>release        \--o--o--/<br>develop --o--o--o--o--o--o--o------&gt;<br>feature    \--o--o--o--/   (haftalab)</pre><p>| | Trunk-based | GitFlow | |---|---|---| | Branch umri | soatlar | kunlar/haftalar | | Deploy chastotasi | kuniga ko'p marta | rejali relizlar | | Tugallanmagan ish | feature flag | branch'da yashirin | | Konflikt | kichik, tez-tez | katta, kam | | Mos keladi | SaaS, CD | bir nechta versiya qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan mahsulot (on-prem, mobile) |</p><p><b>Amalda (trunk-based):</b></p><pre>git switch -c feat/login-button origin/main<br># ... kichik o'zgarish, flag ortida<br>git push -u origin feat/login-button   # PR, CI, review, shu kuni merge</pre><pre>if flags.Enabled(ctx, &quot;new-login&quot;) { renderNewLogin() } else { renderOld() }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trunk-based kuchli CI va testsiz ishlamaydi — buzilgan <code>main</code> hammani to'xtatadi.</li><li>Feature flag'lar to'planib &quot;flag qarzi&quot;ga aylanadi — o'chirish muddati qo'ying.</li><li>GitFlow muallifi (Vincent Driessen) o'zi ham doimiy deploy qilinadigan web ilovalar uchun uni tavsiya qilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DORA tadqiqotlari trunk-based'ni yuqori deploy chastotasi va past change failure rate bilan bog'laydi. GitFlow'ni faqat bir vaqtda bir nechta reliz versiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlash kerak bo'lganda tanlang — u holda ham <code>release/x.y</code> branch'lari yetarli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42105	<p><code>git push --force-with-lease</code> va <code>--force</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--force</code> remote branch'ni shartsiz sizning lokal holatingiz bilan almashtiradi. <code>--force-with-lease</code> esa faqat remote siz oxirgi ko'rgan holatda bo'lsa yozadi — aks holda rad etadi va hamkasbning commit'ini saqlab qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Siz rebase qildingiz va force push qilmoqchisiz. Shu orada hamkasb o'sha branch'ga commit push qildi. <code>--force</code> uning ishini jimgina o'chirib yuboradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>siz fetch qildingiz: origin/feat = X<br>hamkasb push qildi:  remote feat = Y<br>siz: push --force-with-lease<br>  git tekshiradi: remote == X ?  yo'q (Y)  -&gt; &quot;stale info&quot;, rad</pre><p>Lease qiymati — sizning <code>refs/remotes/origin/feat</code> (oxirgi fetch).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git rebase origin/main<br>git push --force-with-lease                       # xavfsiz<br>git push --force-with-lease=feat:abc1234          # aniq kutilgan SHA bilan<br>git push --force-with-lease --force-if-includes   # Git 2.30+<br>git config --global alias.pushf &quot;push --force-with-lease --force-if-includes&quot;</pre><p><b><code>--force-if-includes</code> nega kerak:</b> IDE yoki fon <code>git fetch</code> tracking ref'ni yangilab qo'ysa, lease &quot;yangi&quot; bo'lib ko'rinadi va hamkasb ishi baribir o'chishi mumkin. <code>--force-if-includes</code> remote uchidagi commit sizning lokal reflog'ingizda bor-yo'qligini (ya'ni uni ko'rib integratsiya qilganingizni) tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Push'dan oldin <code>git fetch</code> qilib, so'ng darhol <code>--force-with-lease</code> — lease foydasiz bo'ladi (yangi holatni ko'rmay &quot;tasdiqlaysiz&quot;).</li><li><code>main</code>/<code>release</code> branch'larga force push'ni branch protection bilan butunlay taqiqlang.</li><li>O'chirilgan commit'larni server reflog'i yoki hamkasb lokal nusxasidan tiklash mumkin, lekin og'riqli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jamoaviy qoida: <code>--force</code> hech qachon, faqat alias orqali <code>--force-with-lease --force-if-includes</code>. Shaxsiy feature branch'da ham shu odat — xavfsizlik odatiy holga aylansin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42106	<p><code>git gc</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git gc</code> (garbage collection) repo'ni ixchamlaydi: loose obyektlarni packfile'larga siqadi, delta-siqish qiladi, eskirgan reflog yozuvlarini va hech qayerdan erishib bo'lmaydigan eski obyektlarni o'chiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har <code>git add</code>/<code>commit</code> alohida zlib-siqilgan fayl (loose object) yaratadi. Minglab bunday fayl diskni va operatsiyalarni sekinlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>.git/objects/ab/cdef...  (loose, minglab)<br>        |<br>        v  git gc<br>.git/objects/pack/pack-xxx.pack  (delta-siqilgan)<br>              pack-xxx.idx   (indeks)<br>+ refs -&gt; packed-refs<br>+ reflog &gt; 90 kun (unreachable uchun 30 kun) -&gt; o'chadi<br>+ unreachable obyekt &gt; 2 hafta (gc.pruneExpire) -&gt; o'chadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git count-objects -vH          # oldin: count, size-pack<br>git gc                         # oddiy<br>git gc --aggressive            # chuqurroq delta, juda sekin, kam kerak<br>git gc --auto                  # faqat chegara oshsa (gc.auto=6700 loose)<br>git count-objects -vH          # keyin</pre><p>Chiqish:</p><pre>count: 0<br>size-pack: 142.30 MiB</pre><p>Git o'zi ko'p buyruqlardan keyin <code>gc --auto</code> ni fonda ishga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>gc</code> darhol hamma narsani o'chirmaydi — 2 haftalik prune muddati xavfsizlik to'ri. Shuning uchun &quot;secret'ni o'chirdim&quot; deb faqat <code>gc</code> ga ishonmang.</li><li><code>--aggressive</code> ni muntazam ishlatish behuda — CPU'ni yeydi, foydasi kam.</li><li>Katta repo'da <code>gc</code> uzoq bloklaydi — zamonaviy yo'l <code>git maintenance</code> (inkremental).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Server tomonida (GitHub, GitLab) gc platformaning ishi. Lokal katta monorepo'larda <code>git maintenance start</code> qo'ying — commit-graph, prefetch va inkremental repack fon rejasida ishlaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42107	<p><code>git fsck</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git fsck</code> (file system check) obyekt bazasini tekshiradi: har obyekt hash'i to'g'rimi, buzilmaganmi, havolalar (commit -&gt; tree -&gt; blob) to'liqmi; shuningdek hech qayerdan erishib bo'lmaydigan &quot;dangling&quot; obyektlarni ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Disk xatosi yoki to'satdan o'chgan kompyuterdan keyin <code>git log</code> &quot;bad object&quot; deydi. Yoki <code>reset --hard</code> qilib yo'qotgan ishingizni qidiryapsiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>refs + reflog -&gt; commit -&gt; tree -&gt; blob<br>fsck har bir bog'lanishni yuradi:<br>  - SHA mazmunga mosmi?      -&gt; yo'q: &quot;corrupt&quot;<br>  - havola qilingan obyekt bormi? -&gt; yo'q: &quot;missing&quot;<br>  - obyektga hech kim havola qilmaydimi? -&gt; &quot;dangling&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git fsck --full                 # to'liq tekshiruv<br>git fsck --lost-found           # dangling'larni .git/lost-found/ ga yozadi<br>git fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs | grep commit</pre><p>Chiqish:</p><pre>dangling commit 3f9a1c2...<br>dangling blob   8b7e4d1...</pre><p>Tiklash:</p><pre>git show 3f9a1c2                 # ko'rib chiqish<br>git switch -c recovered 3f9a1c2<br>git cat-file -p 8b7e4d1 &gt; restored.go   # blob = fayl mazmuni</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;dangling&quot; xato emas — odatiy hol (amend, rebase qoldiqlari). Faqat &quot;missing/corrupt&quot; xavotirli.</li><li><code>gc --prune=now</code> dan keyin dangling'lar yo'q bo'ladi — tiklash uchun avval fsck.</li><li>Buzilgan repo'ni &quot;tuzatishga&quot; urinmasdan avval <code>.git</code> ni nusxalang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Korrupsiyada eng tez yo'l — sog'lom remote'dan yangi clone va lokal o'zgarishlarni ko'chirish. Serverlarda <code>transfer.fsckObjects=true</code> kiruvchi push'larni tekshiradi — buzilgan yoki zararli obyektlar bazaga tushmaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts

Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42109	<p>Git hook'lari (<code>pre-commit</code>, <code>commit-msg</code>, <code>pre-push</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git hook'lar — ma'lum hodisalarda (commit oldidan, xabar yozilgach, push oldidan) Git avtomatik ishga tushiradigan skriptlar. Nol bo'lmagan exit kod operatsiyani to'xtatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dasturchilar lint xatoli kod, <code>console.log</code> yoki API kalit commit qiladi; CI 10 daqiqadan keyin aytadi. Xavfsizlik nazorati faqat hook'da bo'lsa — nazorat yo'q.</li><li>Sekin hook (butun test suite <code>pre-commit</code> da) odamlarni <code>--no-verify</code> ga undaydi. Tezlarini commit'ga, og'irlarini <code>pre-push</code>/CI ga.</li><li>Hook butun repo'ni emas, faqat staged fayllarni tekshirsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: lokal hook — tez feedback (qulaylik), CI va server tomoni (<code>pre-receive</code>, push protection, required checks) — majburiy nazorat. Ikkalasida bir xil tool va versiya.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42110	<p>Git'da imzolangan commit'lar (version control kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Imzolangan commit — commit obyektiga GPG, SSH yoki X.509 kalit bilan kriptografik imzo qo'shilgan. Git <code>user.name/email</code> ni hech kim tekshirmaydi, imzo esa commit haqiqatan shu kalit egasidan kelganini isbotlaydi; GitHub/GitLab &quot;Verified&quot; ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har kim <code>git config user.email ceo@company.com</code> qilib, boshqa nomidan commit qila oladi. Supply-chain hujumida zararli commit ishonchli muallifdek ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>commit mazmuni (tree, parent, author, msg)<br>   -&gt; private key bilan imzo -&gt; &quot;gpgsig&quot; header commit ichida<br>platforma: imzo + yuklangan public key + email mosligi -&gt; Verified</pre><p><b>Amalda (zamonaviy SSH usuli):</b></p><pre>git config --global gpg.format ssh<br>git config --global user.signingkey ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub<br>git config --global commit.gpgsign true<br>git config --global tag.gpgsign true<br>git commit -m &quot;feat: x&quot;              # avtomatik imzolanadi<br>git log --show-signature -1</pre><p>Lokal tekshirish uchun:</p><pre>echo &quot;me@co.com $(cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub)&quot; &gt;&gt; ~/.ssh/allowed_signers<br>git config --global gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile ~/.ssh/allowed_signers</pre><p>GitHub'da kalitni <b>Signing key</b> turi sifatida qo'shing (auth kalitidan alohida).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Imzo muallif kim ekanini emas, <b>qaysi kalit</b> imzolaganini isbotlaydi — kalit o'g'irlansa, imzo ham soxta ishonch beradi.</li><li>Rebase/squash commit'larni qayta yaratadi — imzo ham qayta qo'yilishi kerak (<code>commit.gpgsign</code> bo'lsa avtomatik).</li><li>GitHub web UI'da merge qilingan commit'larni GitHub o'z kaliti bilan imzolaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Branch protection'da &quot;Require signed commits&quot; yoqing va kalitlarni hardware (YubiKey, <code>ed25519-sk</code>) da saqlang. Sigstore/gitsign — kalitsiz, OIDC asosidagi qisqa muddatli sertifikat bilan imzolash — kalit boshqaruvi muammosini yo'qotadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42111	<p><code>git rebase --onto</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git rebase --onto &lt;yangi-baza&gt; &lt;eski-baza&gt; &lt;branch&gt;</code> — <code>&lt;eski-baza&gt;</code> dan keyingi commit'larni (faqat ularni) olib, <code>&lt;yangi-baza&gt;</code> ustiga ko'chiradi. Oddiy rebase &quot;qayerdan kesish&quot;ni o'zi aniqlaydi; <code>--onto</code> bilan siz aniq ko'rsatasiz.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>client</code> branch'ini <code>server</code> branch'idan ochgansiz. <code>server</code> hali tayyor emas, lekin <code>client</code> ni <code>main</code> ga alohida chiqarish kerak — <code>server</code> commit'larisiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>oldin:<br>main   A--B<br>           \<br>server      C--D<br>                \<br>client           E--F<br><br>git rebase --onto main server client<br><br>keyin:<br>main   A--B--E'--F'   (client)<br>           \<br>server      C--D</pre><p>Ya'ni: &quot;<code>server</code> da yo'q, <code>client</code> da bor commit'larni (<code>server..client</code>) <code>main</code> ustiga qo'y&quot;.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git log --oneline server..client       # ko'chadigan commit'lar: E, F<br>git rebase --onto main server client<br>git log --oneline --graph main..client</pre><p>Boshqa foydali holatlar:</p><pre>git rebase --onto HEAD~5 HEAD~3 HEAD   # o'rtadagi 2 commit'ni olib tashlash<br>git rebase --onto origin/main old-base # squash-merge qilingan baza ustidan qayta ko'chirish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Argumentlar tartibi: avval <b>yangi</b> baza, keyin <b>eski</b> (eksklyuziv) chegara. Adashsangiz — <code>git rebase --abort</code> yoki <code>reflog</code>.</li><li>Ota branch squash-merge qilingan bo'lsa, oddiy rebase eski commit'larni qayta qo'llab konflikt beradi — aynan <code>--onto</code> yechim.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stacked PR'larda (PR2 PR1 ustida) PR1 squash-merge qilingach, <code>git rebase --onto origin/main &lt;PR1-eski-uchi&gt; pr2</code> standart amal. <code>git rebase --update-refs</code> (Git 2.38+) stack'dagi barcha branch'larni birdaniga yangilaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42112	<p><code>git cherry-pick -n</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git cherry-pick -n</code> (<code>--no-commit</code>) commit o'zgarishlarini working tree va index'ga qo'llaydi, lekin yangi commit yaratmaydi. Bir nechta commit'ni bitta commit qilib olish yoki qo'llashdan oldin tahrirlash uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>main</code> dagi 3 ta bugfix commit'ini <code>release/1.4</code> ga olib o'tish kerak, lekin reliz branch'ida ular bitta &quot;backport: fix login issues&quot; commit bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>cherry-pick A        -&gt; A' commit<br>cherry-pick -n A B C -&gt; index'da A+B+C o'zgarishlari, commit yo'q<br>                        -&gt; siz o'zingiz bitta commit qilasiz</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git switch release/1.4<br>git cherry-pick -n a1b2c3 d4e5f6 0a9b8c<br>git status                  # staged o'zgarishlar<br>git diff --cached           # tekshirish, kerak bo'lsa tahrir<br>git commit -m &quot;fix: backport login fixes (a1b2c3, d4e5f6, 0a9b8c)&quot;</pre><p>Foydali qo'shimchalar:</p><pre>git cherry-pick -x a1b2c3   # xabarga &quot;(cherry picked from commit ...)&quot; qo'shadi<br>git cherry-pick main~3..main   # diapazon<br>git cherry-pick --abort     # bekor qilish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-n</code> bilan asl commit muallifi va xabari yo'qoladi — kelib chiqishni xabarda yozing.</li><li>Working tree toza bo'lmasa, qo'llangan o'zgarishlar sizning o'zgarishlaringiz bilan aralashadi.</li><li>Cherry-pick yangi SHA yaratadi — keyinchalik branch'larni merge qilsangiz, Git ba'zan ularni dublikat deb tanimaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Backport'larda <code>-x</code> ni afzal ko'ring — audit uchun asl commit'ga havola qoladi. Ko'p backport kerak bo'lsa, fix'ni avval eng eski qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan branch'ga qilib, yuqoriga merge qilish (&quot;merge forward&quot;) tarixni toza saqlaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42113	<p><code>git merge --squash</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git merge --squash feature</code> feature branch'idagi barcha o'zgarishlarni bitta to'plam qilib index'ga qo'yadi, lekin merge commit ham, commit ham yaratmaydi — siz bitta oddiy commit qilasiz. Natijada branch &quot;merge qilingan&quot; deb belgilanmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Feature branch'da 23 ta &quot;wip&quot; commit. <code>main</code> tarixida bitta toza &quot;feat: payment retry&quot; kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>main     A--B---------S        (S = barcha o'zgarishlar, bitta ota-ona)<br>             \<br>feature       c1--c2--...--c23 (bog'lanmagan holda qoladi)</pre><p>Oddiy merge'dan farqi: S'ning faqat bitta ota-onasi bor — Git <code>feature</code> ni <code>main</code> ga kirgan deb bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git switch main<br>git merge --squash feature<br>git status                 # hammasi staged<br>git commit -m &quot;feat: payment retry with backoff (#412)&quot;<br>git branch -D feature      # -d ishlamaydi: &quot;not fully merged&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Branch o'chirishda <code>-d</code> rad etadi, <code>git branch --merged</code> uni ko'rsatmaydi — chalkashlik.</li><li>Squash qilingan branch'da ishni davom ettirib, qayta squash-merge qilsangiz, eski o'zgarishlar konflikt beradi. Squash'dan keyin branch'ni tashlab, yangisini <code>main</code> dan oching.</li><li>Tarixda individual commit'lar yo'qoladi — <code>bisect</code> aniqligi pasayadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitHub'ning &quot;Squash and merge&quot; tugmasi xuddi shu. Kichik PR'lar uchun yaxshi default (1 PR = 1 commit = oson revert). Katta, mantiqiy bo'lingan PR'larda rebase-merge yoki merge commit afzal — foydali tarixni yo'qotmang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42114	<p><code>git diff</code> da uch nuqta (<code>...</code>) va ikki nuqta (<code>..</code>) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git diff A..B</code> — ikki commit uchi orasidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri farq (<code>git diff A B</code> bilan bir xil). <code>git diff A...B</code> — B'ning A bilan umumiy ajdodidan (merge-base) beri B'da nima o'zgargani; aynan PR diff'i shunday.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>git diff main..feature</code> qilasiz va o'zingiz tegmagan yuzlab o'zgarishlarni ko'rasiz — chunki <code>main</code> ham oldinga ketgan. Sizga faqat feature'da qilingan ish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>        o--o--M   main     (M: boshqalarning ishi)<br>       /<br>base--X<br>       \<br>        f1--f2   feature<br><br>diff main..feature  = M  vs f2   (main'dagi yangi ishlar &quot;teskari&quot; ko'rinadi)<br>diff main...feature = X  vs f2   (faqat f1+f2)</pre><p><code>A...B</code> = <code>git diff $(git merge-base A B) B</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git fetch origin<br>git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat     # PR'da nima o'zgaradi<br>git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/    # faqat papka<br>git merge-base origin/main HEAD        # umumiy ajdod SHA</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>diff</code> da <code>..</code> va <code>log</code> da <code>..</code> ma'nosi har xil — diff'da <code>..</code> shunchaki ikki nuqta orasidagi farq, log'da esa to'plam ayirmasi. Bu Git'ning eng chalkash nomlashlaridan biri.</li><li>Lokal <code>main</code> eskirgan bo'lsa, natija noto'g'ri — <code>origin/main</code> bilan solishtiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Code review va CI'da &quot;o'zgargan fayllar&quot;ni aniqlash (affected tests, monorepo build) uchun doim <code>origin/main...HEAD</code> ishlating — ikki nuqtali variant boshqalarning ishini sizniki deb hisoblaydi va keraksiz build'lar ishga tushadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42115	<p><code>git log</code> da uch nuqta (<code>...</code>) va ikki nuqta (<code>..</code>) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git log A..B</code> — B'dan erishiladigan, lekin A'dan erishib bo'lmaydigan commit'lar (&quot;B'da bor, A'da yo'q&quot;). <code>git log A...B</code> — ikkisidan faqat bittasida bor commit'lar (simmetrik farq); <code>--left-right</code> bilan qaysi tomonga tegishli ekani ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Mening branch'imda <code>main</code> ga hali kirmagan qaysi commit'lar bor?&quot; yoki &quot;pull qilsam nima keladi?&quot; savollari.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>base--X--m1--m2        main<br>       \<br>        f1--f2         feature<br><br>log main..feature   -&gt; f1, f2<br>log feature..main   -&gt; m1, m2<br>log main...feature  -&gt; Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42126	<p><code>git branch -d</code> va <code>-D</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git branch -d &lt;branch&gt;</code> — xavfsiz o'chirish: branch to'liq merge qilingan bo'lsagina (upstream'ga yoki <code>HEAD</code> ga) o'chiradi. <code>git branch -D</code> (<code>--delete --force</code>) — merge holatidan qat'i nazar o'chiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Eski branch'larni tozalayapsiz. Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42127	<p><code>git remote prune origin</code> (branch tozalash kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git remote prune origin</code> serverda allaqachon o'chirilgan branch'larning lokal nusxalarini (<code>refs/remotes/origin/*</code>) tozalaydi. Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42134	<p><code>core.autocrlf</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>core.autocrlf</code> qator oxirlarini avtomatik o'zgartiradi: <code>true</code> — checkout'da LF -&gt; CRLF, commit'da CRLF -&gt; LF (Windows); <code>input</code> — faqat commit'da CRLF -&gt; LF (Linux/macOS); <code>false</code> — o'zgartirmaydi. Yoki Linux container'da <code>bash: ./run.sh: /bin/bash^M: bad interpreter</code> xatosi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>repo (object DB):  LF<br>  checkout -&gt; autocrlf=true -&gt; CRLF diskda (Windows)<br>  commit   -&gt; CRLF -&gt; LF qaytadi<br>input: checkout'da tegmaydi, commit'da LF ga normallashtiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git config --global core.autocrlf true     # Windows<br>git config --global core.autocrlf input    # Linux/macOS<br>git ls-files --eol | head                  # har fayl holati</pre><p>Chiqish:</p><pre>i/lf    w/crlf  attr/text=auto  src/app.go<br>i/crlf  w/crlf  attr/           scripts/run.sh   &lt;- repo ichida CRLF: muammo</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sozlama har kompyuterda har xil — kimdir o'rnatmasa, CRLF baribir repo'ga kiradi.</li><li>Binary faylni noto'g'ri &quot;text&quot; deb tanisa, faylni buzadi.</li><li>Sozlamani o'zgartirgach eski fayllar avtomatik normallashmaydi — <code>git add --renormalize .</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jamoaviy yechim — repo'da <code>.gitattributes</code> (<code>* text=auto eol=lf</code>) — u hamma uchun bir xil va commit qilinadi. <code>core.autocrlf</code> ni esa shaxsiy fallback sifatida qoldiring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts
Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42135	<p><code>.gitattributes</code> va <code>eol=lf</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.gitattributes</code> — repo'ga commit qilinadigan fayl bo'lib, yo'l pattern'lari uchun Git xatti-harakatini belgilaydi: qator oxiri (<code>eol</code>), text/binary, diff/merge driver, LFS. <code>* text=auto eol=lf</code> — Git text deb tanigan barcha fayllar repo'da va diskda LF bo'ladi, OS'dan qat'i nazar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>core.autocrlf</code> har dasturchining shaxsiy sozlamasi — jamoa aralash bo'lsa, CRLF/LF janjali tugamaydi. Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42136	<p><code>.gitattributes</code> da generatsiya qilingan fayllar uchun diff'ni qanday o'chirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.gitattributes</code> da generatsiya qilingan fayllarni <code>-diff</code> (diff'ni &quot;Binary files differ&quot; qiladi) yoki <code>linguist-generated</code> (GitHub PR'da avtomatik yig'iladi va til statistikasidan chiqadi) deb belgilaysiz. Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42137	<p><code>git stash branch &lt;branch&gt;</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git stash branch &lt;yangi-branch&gt; [stash@{N}]</code> — stash yaratilgan commit'dan yangi branch ochadi, stash'ni unga qo'llaydi va muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa stash'ni o'chiradi. Interview Drill::Git::H33 Branching, rebase & conflicts	idrill-42145	<p><code>git rebase --abort</code> va <code>--skip</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git rebase --abort</code> butun rebase'ni bekor qiladi va branch'ni rebase'dan oldingi holatga qaytaradi. <code>git rebase --skip</code> faqat joriy (konfliktli) commit'ni tashlab yuborib, qolganlari bilan davom etadi — o'sha commit o'zgarishlari yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Rebase o'rtasida konflikt. Faqat commit haqiqatan keraksiz bo'lsa.</li><li>Rebase tugagach <code>--abort</code> endi ishlamaydi — u holda <code>git reset --hard ORIG_HEAD</code> yoki <code>reflog</code>.</li><li>Git o'zi bir xil patch'li commit'larni avtomatik o'tkazib yuboradi — skip kerak bo'lgan holatlar kamroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta rebase'dan oldin <code>git branch backup/feat</code> qo'ying — arzon sug'urta. Rebase'dan keyin <code>git range-diff old...new</code> bilan nima o'zgarganini tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h33 Branching_rebase_conflicts

Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42154	<p><code>git clone --depth 1</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git clone --depth 1</code> faqat oxirgi commit va uning fayllarini yuklaydi, tarixsiz (shallow clone). CI build'lari uchun tezkor checkout; lekin <code>git describe</code>, <code>log</code>, <code>blame</code>, <code>merge-base</code> ishlamaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI'da har job 2 GB'lik repo'ni to'liq clone qiladi — 3 daqiqa, 50 ta parallel job = tarmoq va vaqt isrofi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>to'liq:    A--B--C--...--Z    (barcha obyektlar)<br>depth 1:                 Z    (.git/shallow = Z; ota-ona &quot;kesilgan&quot;)<br>--single-branch default yoqiladi (faqat bitta branch)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>time git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/org/app.git<br>git clone --depth 1 --branch v1.4.0 https://github.com/org/app.git  # aniq tag<br>git log --oneline          # faqat 1 ta commit<br>git fetch --unshallow      # keyinchalik to'liq tarixga</pre><p>GitHub Actions:</p><pre>- uses: actions/checkout@v4      # default fetch-depth: 1<br>- uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>  with: { fetch-depth: 0 }       # semver/changelog/diff kerak bo'lsa</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Versiya hisoblovchi tool'lar (semantic-release, GitVersion, <code>git describe</code>) tarixsiz noto'g'ri versiya chiqaradi yoki yiqiladi.</li><li>PR'da &quot;o'zgargan fayllar&quot; (<code>git diff origin/main...HEAD</code>) merge-base topolmaydi.</li><li><code>--depth</code> bilan <code>--branch</code> dan tashqari boshqa branch'lar yo'q — <code>git checkout other</code> ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> O'lchab tanlang: kichik repo'da shallow foyda kam; katta repo'da <code>--depth 1</code> build job'lari uchun, <code>--filter=tree:0</code>/<code>blob:none</code> tarix kerak bo'lgan job'lar uchun. Self-hosted runner'larda clone o'rniga kesh qilingan mirror'dan <code>git fetch</code> eng tez.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42155	<p>Git worktree (enterprise kontekstida) qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Enterprise muhitda <code>git worktree</code> bitta clone'dan bir nechta branch'ni parallel ish papkalarida ochish uchun ishlatiladi: hotfix va feature bir vaqtda, PR review alohida papkada, bir nechta reliz branch'ini parallel build qilish — har biri uchun qayta clone (gigabaytlar) kerak emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Monorepo clone'i 30 GB va 20 daqiqa. Har parallel vazifa uchun yangi clone — imkonsiz; stash/switch esa build kesh'ini va IDE holatini buzadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>~/mono/.git  (bitta obyekt bazasi, ref'lar)<br>  |-- ~/mono             main  (asosiy ish)<br>  |-- ~/wt/hotfix-1.9    release/1.9<br>  |-- ~/wt/review-812    pr-812 (review uchun)<br>yangi worktree = faqat working tree fayllari (obyektlar ulashiladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git fetch origin release/1.9<br>git worktree add ~/wt/hotfix-1.9 -b hotfix/1.9.3 origin/release/1.9<br>git fetch origin pull/812/head:pr-812<br>git worktree add ~/wt/review-812 pr-812<br>git worktree list<br>git worktree lock ~/wt/hotfix-1.9 --reason &quot;USB diskda&quot;<br>git worktree remove ~/wt/review-812<br>git worktree prune</pre><p>CI/runner'da: bitta mirror kesh, har job uchun <code>worktree add</code> — sekundlarda tayyor ish joyi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta branch faqat bitta worktree'da checkout qilinadi.</li><li><code>git gc</code> va hook'lar umumiy — bir worktree'dagi hook boshqasiga ham ta'sir qiladi.</li><li>Sparse-checkout va submodule sozlamalari har worktree uchun alohida.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Worktree — &quot;kontekst almashtirish narxi&quot;ni kamaytirish vositasi. Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42156	<p>Git LFS nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git LFS (Large File Storage) katta binary fayllarni Git tarixida kichik pointer (matn) fayl bilan almashtiradi; haqiqiy mazmun alohida LFS serverda saqlanadi va faqat checkout qilinayotgan versiya yuklanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Git har versiyaning to'liq nusxasini saqlaydi. 200 MB'lik ML model 30 marta yangilangan = repo 6 GB; har clone hammasini yuklaydi. Binary'lar delta-siqilmaydi, diff/merge ham yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git add model.bin<br>   -&gt; clean filter: mazmun -&gt; .git/lfs/objects/ (lokal) ; repo'ga pointer:<br>      version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1<br>      oid sha256:4d7a2...<br>      size 209715200<br>git push -&gt; pointer Git server'ga, mazmun LFS server'ga<br>checkout -&gt; smudge filter: pointer -&gt; LFS'dan yuklash -&gt; haqiqiy fayl</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git lfs install<br>git lfs track &quot;*.bin&quot; &quot;*.psd&quot; &quot;models/**&quot;<br>cat .gitattributes      # *.bin filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text<br>git add .gitattributes models/v3.bin &amp;&amp; git commit -m &quot;add model&quot;<br>git lfs ls-files<br>git lfs migrate import --include=&quot;*.bin&quot; --everything   # eski tarixni ko'chirish<br>GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone ...                       # LFS'siz tez clone<br>git lfs pull --include=&quot;models/v3.bin&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.gitattributes</code> ni commit qilishni unutish — fayl oddiy Git obyektiga tushadi.</li><li><code>migrate import</code> tarixni qayta yozadi (SHA'lar o'zgaradi).</li><li>GitHub LFS'da saqlash va bandwidth kvotasi pullik; CI har job'da yuklasa — xarajat oshadi (kesh qiling).</li><li>LFS fayllar uchun merge yo'q — <code>git lfs lock</code> bilan qulflash ishlatiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> LFS — &quot;Git'da binary saqlash&quot; uchun yamoq. Build artefaktlari va ML modellari uchun ko'pincha artefakt registry (S3, Artifactory, model registry) + Git'da versiya havolasi to'g'riroq. LFS'ni dizayn asset'lari kabi kod bilan birga versiyalanishi kerak bo'lgan binary'lar uchun qoldiring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42157	<p>Git merge strategiyalari (ort, recursive, resolve, octopus) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Merge strategiyasi Git ikki yoki undan ortiq tarixni qanday birlashtirishini belgilaydi. <b>ort</b> — Git 2.34+ dan default (recursive'ning tez va to'g'ri qayta yozilgani); <b>recursive</b> — eski default; <b>resolve</b> — oddiy 3-way; <b>octopus</b> — 2 dan ortiq branch'ni konfliktsiz birlashtirish; <b>ours</b> — boshqa tomon o'zgarishlarini butunlay tashlash; <b>subtree</b> — boshqa repo'ni subpapka sifatida.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ko'pchilik default'dan foydalanadi, lekin <code>-s ours</code> va <code>-X ours</code> farqini bilmaslik prod'da o'zgarishlarni jimgina yo'qotishga olib keladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Strategiya | Qachon | Izoh | |---|---|---| | <code>ort</code> | default | rename'larni yaxshi aniqlaydi, katta repo'da ko'p barobar tez | | <code>recursive</code> | eski Git | bir nechta merge-base bo'lsa, ularni avval birlashtiradi | | <code>resolve</code> | kam | bitta merge-base, oddiy | | <code>octopus</code> | 3+ branch | konflikt bo'lsa rad etadi | | <code>ours</code> | eski branch'ni &quot;yopish&quot; | boshqa tomon <b>butunlay</b> e'tiborsiz | | <code>subtree</code> | vendoring | yo'llarni moslaydi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git merge feature                          # ort<br>git merge topic1 topic2 topic3             # avtomatik octopus<br>git merge -s ours legacy-branch            # tarixda &quot;merge qilingan&quot;, mazmun o'zgarmaydi<br>git merge -X ours feature                  # FARQLI: faqat konfliktli bo'laklarda bizniki<br>git merge -X theirs feature                # konfliktlarda ularniki<br>git merge -X ignore-space-change feature<br>git merge -X find-renames=40% feature</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-s ours</code> (strategiya) va <code>-X ours</code> (ort/recursive opsiyasi) mutlaqo boshqa: birinchisi hamma o'zgarishni tashlaydi, ikkinchisi faqat konflikt bo'laklarida tanlaydi.</li><li><code>-X theirs</code>/<code>ours</code> konfliktni &quot;hal qiladi&quot;, lekin semantik xatolarni yashiradi — test majburiy.</li><li><code>-s theirs</code> strategiyasi mavjud emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default ort deyarli har doim to'g'ri. Strategiya bilan &quot;o'ynash&quot; ko'pincha jarayon muammosini (uzoq branch'lar) yashirishga urinish. <code>git merge-tree --write-tree</code> ham ort'ni ishlatadi — server tomonidagi &quot;mergeable&quot; tekshiruvlari aynan shu.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42158	<p>Bare repository (<code>git init --bare</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bare repository (<code>git init --bare</code>) — working directory'siz repo: papkaning o'zi <code>.git</code> mazmunidan (objects, refs, HEAD, hooks) iborat. Unga push qilinadi, unda kod tahrirlanmaydi — markaziy server repo'lari (GitHub ham ichkarida) shunday.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy (non-bare) repo'ga checkout qilingan branch'ni push qilsangiz, Git rad etadi: &quot;refusing to update checked out branch&quot; — chunki working tree index bilan nomuvofiq bo'lib qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>non-bare:  project/            bare:  project.git/<br>             src/ ...                   HEAD<br>             .git/                      objects/<br>                objects/ refs/          refs/<br>                                        hooks/   (post-receive, pre-receive)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ssh git@server 'git init --bare /srv/git/app.git'<br>git remote add origin git@server:/srv/git/app.git<br>git push -u origin main<br>git clone --bare https://github.com/org/app.git     # mavjud repo'dan<br>git clone --mirror https://github.com/org/app.git   # bare + barcha ref'lar, backup uchun<br>git rev-parse --is-bare-repository                   # true</pre><p>Oddiy deploy: bare repo'ning <code>hooks/post-receive</code> i working tree'ga checkout qiladi:</p><pre>#!/bin/sh<br>git --work-tree=/var/www/app --git-dir=/srv/git/app.git checkout -f main</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bare repo'da <code>git status</code>, <code>git add</code> ma'nosiz — working tree yo'q.</li><li>Ruxsatlar: ko'p foydalanuvchi push qilsa, <code>--shared=group</code> bilan yarating, aks holda obyekt fayllari ruxsat xatosi beradi.</li><li><code>--bare</code> va <code>--mirror</code> farqi: mirror barcha ref'larni (notes, PR ref'lar) va <code>fetch</code> da prune'ni ham saqlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>git clone --mirror</code> + vaqti-vaqti bilan <code>git remote update</code> — platformadan mustaqil Git backup strategiyasining eng sodda shakli. Post-receive orqali deploy esa zamonaviy CI/CD va GitOps bilan almashtirilgan.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42159	<p><code>git format-patch</code> va <code>git am</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git format-patch</code> commit'larni muallif, sana, xabar va diff bilan email formatidagi patch fayllarga aylantiradi; <code>git am</code> (apply mailbox) bu patch'larni qabul qiluvchi repo'da asl muallif va xabar saqlangan holda commit sifatida qo'llaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki repo o'rtasida tarmoq yo'q (air-gapped), yoki loyiha mailing list orqali ishlaydi (Linux kernel, Git o'zi). <code>git apply</code> faqat diff qo'llaydi va muallif ma'lumoti yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>yuboruvchi:                         qabul qiluvchi:<br>commits -&gt; Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42160	<p>Enterprise GitOps repo arxitekturasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Odatiy enterprise GitOps arxitekturasi ikki turdagi repo'ga bo'linadi: <b>app repo</b> (kod, Dockerfile, test; CI image build qiladi) va <b>config (environment) repo</b> (Helm/Kustomize manifestlari, muhitlar bo'yicha; ArgoCD/Flux kuzatadi).
