Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42161	<p>Server tomonidagi <code>pre-receive</code> va <code>post-receive</code> hook'lari farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>pre-receive</code> — server push'ni qabul qilib, ref'larni yangilashdan <b>oldin</b> ishlaydi; nol bo'lmagan exit butun push'ni rad etadi (siyosat majburlash). <code>post-receive</code> — ref'lar yangilangandan <b>keyin</b> ishlaydi; push'ni bekor qila olmaydi, bildirishnoma va trigger'lar uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Client hook'larini <code>--no-verify</code> bilan chetlab o'tish mumkin. Majburiy qoida (imzosiz commit yo'q, 100 MB dan katta fayl yo'q, secret yo'q) faqat server tomonida ishonchli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git push<br>  -&gt; server: obyektlar qabul qilinadi (karantinda)<br>  -&gt; pre-receive (stdin: &lt;old&gt; &lt;new&gt; &lt;ref&gt;)  -- exit 1 -&gt; hammasi rad<br>  -&gt; update (har ref uchun alohida)          -- exit 1 -&gt; shu ref rad<br>  -&gt; ref'lar yangilanadi<br>  -&gt; post-receive (stdin bir xil)            -- CI webhook, chat, deploy</pre><p><b>Amalda (<code>hooks/pre-receive</code>):</b></p><pre>#!/bin/bash<br>zero=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000<br>while read old new ref; do<br>  [ &quot;$new&quot; = &quot;$zero&quot; ] &amp;&amp; continue                 # o'chirish<br>  range=$([ &quot;$old&quot; = &quot;$zero&quot; ] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;$new --not --all&quot; || echo &quot;$old..$new&quot;)<br>  for c in $(git rev-list $range); do<br>    git verify-commit &quot;$c&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null || { echo &quot;REJECT: $c imzolanmagan&quot;; exit 1; }<br>  done<br>done</pre><p><code>post-receive</code>:</p><pre>#!/bin/sh<br>while read old new ref; do<br>  curl -fsS -X POST &quot;https://ci.internal/hook?ref=$ref&amp;sha=$new&quot;<br>done</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sekin <code>pre-receive</code> har push'ni bloklaydi — tez va deterministik bo'lsin.</li><li>GitHub.com'da custom server hook yo'q; GitHub Enterprise Server'da pre-receive bor; GitHub.com'da push rulesets/protection, GitLab'da server hooks/push rules.</li><li><code>post-receive</code> dagi xato push'ni muvaffaqiyatsiz qilmaydi — monitoring kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Server hook'lari — siyosat nuqtasi, ular tushuntirib beradigan xabarlar bilan rad etsin (&quot;REJECT: ... qanday tuzatish: ...&quot;). Zamonaviy platformalarda imkon qadar deklarativ rulesets ishlating — custom skriptni qo'llab-quvvatlash qimmat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42162	<p><code>commit-msg</code> hook nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>commit-msg</code> — commit xabari yozilgandan keyin, commit yaratilishidan oldin ishlaydigan client hook. U xabar faylini argument sifatida oladi va qoidaga (masalan Conventional Commits: <code>feat:</code>, <code>fix:</code>) mos kelmasa, commit'ni rad etadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Avtomatik versiyalash va changelog (semantic-release) commit xabarlariga bog'liq. &quot;fixed stuff&quot; kabi xabar — reliz noto'g'ri versiya oladi, changelog bo'sh.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git commit -m &quot;...&quot;<br>  pre-commit -&gt; prepare-commit-msg -&gt; commit-msg .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG<br>                                         exit 0 -&gt; commit yaratiladi<br>                                         exit 1 -&gt; rad</pre><p><b>Amalda (oddiy skript, <code>.githooks/commit-msg</code>):</b></p><pre>#!/bin/sh<br>msg=$(head -1 &quot;$1&quot;)<br>echo &quot;$msg&quot; | grep -Eq '^(feat|fix|docs|refactor|test|chore|perf|ci|build)(\([a-z0-9-]+\))?!?: .{1,72}$' &amp;&amp; exit 0<br>echo &quot;Xato: Conventional Commits formati kerak, masalan: feat(api): add pagination&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>exit 1</pre><pre>git config core.hooksPath .githooks</pre><p>commitlint + husky (Node loyihalar):</p><pre>npm i -D @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional husky<br>echo &quot;export default { extends: ['@commitlint/config-conventional'] };&quot; &gt; commitlint.config.js<br>npx husky init &amp;&amp; echo 'npx --no -- commitlint --edit &quot;$1&quot;' &gt; .husky/commit-msg</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lokal hook chetlab o'tiladi (<code>--no-verify</code>) — CI'da PR commit'larini (yoki squash bo'lsa PR sarlavhasini) ham tekshiring.</li><li>Squash-merge ishlatilsa, <code>main</code> dagi xabar PR sarlavhasidan olinadi — PR title lint muhimroq.</li><li><code>prepare-commit-msg</code> ham Jira ID kabi narsalarni avtomatik qo'shish uchun qulay.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xabar formati — avtomatlashtirish uchun kontrakt. Uni majburlashda xato xabari qanday tuzatishni aniq ko'rsatsin; aks holda odamlar hook'ni o'chirib qo'yadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42163	<p><code>git maintenance</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git maintenance</code> katta repo'larni tez saqlash uchun fon vazifalarini rejalashtiradi: <code>prefetch</code> (har soat remote'dan yuklash), <code>commit-graph</code> yozish, <code>loose-objects</code> ni pack qilish, <code>incremental-repack</code>. <code>git maintenance start</code> ularni OS scheduler'iga (cron/launchd/Task Scheduler) qo'shadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Katta repo'da <code>git fetch</code> ertalab 2 daqiqa, <code>git log --graph</code> sekin, oddiy <code>git gc</code> esa uzoq vaqt bloklaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Vazifa | Chastota | Nima qiladi | |---|---|---| | <code>prefetch</code> | har soat | <code>refs/prefetch/</code> ga fon fetch (sizning ref'lar tegmaydi) | | <code>commit-graph</code> | har soat | commit DAG keshini yangilaydi | | <code>loose-objects</code> | har kuni | loose obyektlarni pack'ga | | <code>incremental-repack</code> | har kuni | kichik pack'larni MIDX bilan birlashtiradi | | <code>pack-refs</code> | har hafta | ref'larni <code>packed-refs</code> ga |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git maintenance start                    # repo'ni ro'yxatga oladi + scheduler<br>git config --global --get-all maintenance.repo<br>git maintenance run --task=commit-graph  # qo'lda bitta vazifa<br>git maintenance run --auto<br>git maintenance stop<br>git maintenance unregister</pre><p>Natijada <code>git fetch</code> deyarli darhol (ma'lumot allaqachon olingan).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Laptop'da prefetch tarmoq va batareyani ishlatadi — kichik repo'lar uchun keraksiz.</li><li>Container/CI'da <code>start</code> ma'nosiz (scheduler yo'q, muhit qisqa umrli).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>scalar clone</code> maintenance'ni avtomatik yoqadi. Monorepo dasturchilari uchun buni onboarding skriptiga qo'shish — kundalik Git tezligini sezilarli oshiradigan arzon chora.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42164	<p>Git commit-graph nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Commit-graph — commit'lar DAG tuzilishining (ota-onalar, tree, sana, generation number) binary keshi, <code>.git/objects/info/commit-graph</code> faylida. Git har commit obyektini ochib parse qilish o'rniga shu fayldan o'qiydi — <code>log --graph</code>, <code>merge-base</code>, ahead/behind hisoblash katta repo'da ko'p barobar tezlashadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 1 mln commit'li repo'da <code>git log --graph --oneline | head</code> yoki <code>git branch --contains</code> o'nlab soniya — har commit zlib bilan ochiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>oddiy: commit SHA -&gt; obyektni topish -&gt; zlib -&gt; parse -&gt; ota-onalar<br>commit-graph: SHA -&gt; indeks -&gt; ota-onalar, sana, generation (tayyor)<br>generation number: &quot;bu commit ildizdan qancha uzoqda&quot; -&gt;<br>   &quot;X Y ning ajdodimi?&quot; savoliga ko'p commit'ni o'qimasdan javob</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git commit-graph write --reachable --changed-paths   # changed-paths: Bloom filter<br>git commit-graph verify<br>git config --global fetch.writeCommitGraph true<br>git config core.commitGraph true                     # default yoqilgan<br>time git log --oneline -- src/payment/ | wc -l       # Bloom filter tufayli tez</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Keshni yangilamasangiz, yangi commit'lar uchun foyda yo'q — <code>git maintenance</code> yoki <code>fetch.writeCommitGraph</code> avtomatlashtiradi.</li><li><code>--changed-paths</code> (Bloom filter) qo'shimcha disk oladi, lekin <code>git log -- path</code> ni keskin tezlashtiradi.</li><li>Shallow repo'larda commit-graph cheklangan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitHub va GitLab server tomonida commit-graph'dan foydalanadi — &quot;N commits ahead&quot; va mergeability hisoblari shu tufayli tez. Lokal katta repo'larda u eng katta &quot;bepul&quot; tezlashtirishlardan biri.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42165	<p>Git multi-pack index (MIDX) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multi-pack index (MIDX) — bir nechta <code>.pack</code> fayl uchun bitta umumiy indeks (<code>.git/objects/pack/multi-pack-index</code>). Git obyekt qidirganda har pack'ning <code>.idx</code> faylini ketma-ket tekshirmaydi — bitta indeksdan darhol topadi; to'liq repack qilmasdan inkremental ishlash imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ko'p fetch'lardan keyin repo'da 200 ta pack fayl. Har obyekt qidiruvi 200 ta indeksni tekshiradi. To'liq <code>git gc</code> (barchasini bitta pack'ga) esa 30 GB repo'da soatlab davom etadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pack-1.pack + .idx<br>pack-2.pack + .idx    -&gt;  multi-pack-index (barcha obyektlar -&gt; qaysi pack, offset)<br>...<br>pack-200.pack + .idx<br>incremental-repack: kichik pack'larni yig'ib, kattaroq pack'ga, MIDX'ni yangilash</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls .git/objects/pack/*.pack | wc -l<br>git multi-pack-index write<br>git multi-pack-index verify<br>git multi-pack-index repack --batch-size=2g   # kichik pack'larni birlashtirish<br>git multi-pack-index expire                   # ishlatilmay qolgan pack'larni o'chirish<br>git maintenance run --task=incremental-repack # yuqoridagilarni avtomatik<br>git config core.multiPackIndex true           # default yoqilgan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>MIDX'ni qo'lda boshqarish kerak emas — <code>git maintenance</code> buni qiladi.</li><li>MIDX bitmap'lar (Git 2.34+) clone/fetch'ni serverda tezlashtiradi, lekin yaratish xotira talab qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> MIDX va commit-graph — &quot;repo kattalashgani sari Git sekinlashadi&quot; muammosiga Git jamoasi (asosan GitHub va Microsoft muhandislari) javobi. Kundalik dasturchi ularni bevosita boshqarmaydi, lekin monorepo platformasini boshqaruvchi bilishi shart.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42166	<p>Server tomonida fayl hajmi kvotasi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Server tomonidagi fayl hajmi kvotasi — belgilangan chegaradan (masalan 50-100 MB) katta fayl yoki katta push'ni rad etadigan platforma qoidasi yoki <code>pre-receive</code> hook. Maqsad — repo'ni binary'lar bilan &quot;zaharlanishdan&quot; saqlash; katta fayllar LFS yoki artefakt registry'ga yo'naltiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kimdir 2 GB'lik DB dump'ni commit qildi. Keyingi commit'da o'chirsa ham, tarixda abadiy qoladi — har clone 2 GB ko'proq yuklaydi; tozalash uchun butun tarixni qayta yozish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>push -&gt; server: yangi obyektlar ro'yxati<br>     -&gt; har blob hajmi &gt; limit ?  -&gt; rad: &quot;file X is 2.1 GB; max 100 MB&quot;<br>GitHub: &gt;50 MB ogohlantirish, &gt;100 MB rad; push hajmi 2 GB gacha<br>GitLab: &quot;Maximum file size&quot; push rule / instance limit</pre><p><b>Amalda (custom <code>pre-receive</code>):</b></p><pre>#!/bin/bash<br>max=$((50*1024*1024)); zero=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000<br>while read old new ref; do<br>  [ &quot;$new&quot; = &quot;$zero&quot; ] &amp;&amp; continue<br>  range=$([ &quot;$old&quot; = &quot;$zero&quot; ] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;$new --not --all&quot; || echo &quot;$old..$new&quot;)<br>  git rev-list --objects $range | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectsize) %(rest)' |<br>  awk -v m=$max '$1==&quot;blob&quot; &amp;&amp; $2&gt;m {print &quot;REJECT: &quot;$3&quot; (&quot;$2&quot; bytes) - Git LFS ishlating&quot;; bad=1} END{exit bad}' || exit 1<br>done</pre><p>Lokal oldini olish:</p><pre>git rev-list --objects --all | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objectsize) %(rest)' | sort -n | tail -5</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Limit faqat yangi push'larga ta'sir qiladi — eski tarixdagi katta fayllar qoladi (<code>filter-repo --strip-blobs-bigger-than</code>).</li><li>Lokal <code>pre-commit</code> (<code>check-added-large-files</code>) foydali, lekin majburiy emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kvota — guardrail; asosiy yechim — artefaktlar uchun to'g'ri saqlash joyi (registry, S3, LFS) va buni onboarding'da aniq aytish. Rad xabari aniq yo'l ko'rsatsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42167	<p>GitHub merge queue (version control kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitHub merge queue — PR'larni bevosita <code>main</code> ga emas, navbatga qo'yadigan mexanizm: har PR navbatdagi oldingi PR'lar bilan birlashtirilgan holatda (<code>main</code> + oldingilar + shu PR) vaqtinchalik branch'da CI'dan o'tkaziladi va faqat yashil bo'lsa merge qilinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> PR A va PR B alohida-alohida yashil. Ikkalasi merge qilingach, <code>main</code> buziladi — chunki A funksiyani o'zgartirdi, B esa eski signature'ni chaqirdi (&quot;semantic conflict&quot;). Har PR'ni merge'dan oldin <code>main</code> ga rebase qilish talabi esa katta jamoada navbat va qayta-qayta CI.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>main --o<br>queue: [A] [B] [C]<br>  gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-A  = main + A          -&gt; CI<br>  gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-B  = main + A + B      -&gt; CI (parallel)<br>  gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-C  = main + A + B + C  -&gt; CI<br>B yiqilsa -&gt; B navbatdan chiqariladi, C qayta qurildi (main + A + C)<br>yashil -&gt; fast-forward main</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><ol><li>Repo -&gt; Settings -&gt; Rules (ruleset) -&gt; &quot;Require merge queue&quot;: merge usuli, build concurrency, minimal/maksimal guruh hajmi.</li><li>Workflow'ga trigger qo'shing — aks holda navbat abadiy kutadi:</li></ol><pre>on:<br>  pull_request:<br>  merge_group:          # MAJBURIY<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps: [ { uses: actions/checkout@v4 }, { run: make test } ]</pre><ol><li>PR'da &quot;Merge when ready&quot; / <code>gh pr merge --auto</code>.</li></ol><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>merge_group</code> trigger'ini unutish — eng keng tarqalgan xato.</li><li>Flaky testlar navbatni tez-tez qayta qurishga majbur qiladi — throughput tushadi.</li><li>Required check nomlari <code>pull_request</code> va <code>merge_group</code> job'larida bir xil bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Merge queue &quot;main doim yashil&quot; kafolatini kuniga yuzlab PR bilan ham saqlaydi. Uning narxi — CI quvvati; uzoq testlarni tez &quot;gate&quot; va keyinroq ishlaydigan qismlarga bo'lish kerak bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42168	<p>Branch protection'da required reviewers nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Branch protection (yoki ruleset) dagi &quot;required reviewers&quot; — PR merge qilinishidan oldin kamida N ta tasdiq (approve) talab qiladi; &quot;Require review from Code Owners&quot; yoqilsa, o'zgargan fayllar egalari (CODEOWNERS) dan ham tasdiq majburiy.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta dasturchi o'z kodini review'siz prod'ga chiqarishi — sifat va xavfsizlik riski, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 auditida &quot;segregation of duties&quot; talabiga zid.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PR ochildi -&gt; CODEOWNERS bo'yicha reviewer'lar avtomatik so'raladi<br>  shartlar: approvals &gt;= N ; code owner approve ; required checks yashil ;<br>            conversations resolved ; yangi push -&gt; eski approve'lar bekor (ixtiyoriy)<br>hammasi ok -&gt; Merge tugmasi faol</pre><p><b>Amalda (sozlamalar):</b></p><ul><li>Require a pull request before merging -&gt; Required approvals: 2</li><li>Dismiss stale pull request approvals when new commits are pushed</li><li>Require review from Code Owners</li><li>Require approval of the most recent reviewable push (o'zi push qilib o'zi tasdiqlashni to'xtatadi)</li><li>Do not allow bypassing (adminlar uchun ham)</li></ul><p>CLI bilan ruleset ko'rish:</p><pre>gh api repos/org/app/rulesets | jq '.[].name'<br>gh pr view 812 --json reviewDecision,reviews</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Adminlar uchun bypass ochiq qolsa — nazorat qog'ozda qoladi.</li><li>&quot;Stale approvals&quot;ni bekor qilmaslik: tasdiqdan keyin har qanday kod qo'shish mumkin.</li><li>Juda ko'p majburiy reviewer — PR'lar kunlab kutadi, odamlar &quot;rubber-stamp&quot; qila boshlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Review soni emas, to'g'ri odam muhim: 1 ta code owner tasdig'i ko'pincha 2 ta tasodifiy approve'dan foydaliroq. Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42171	<p>Renovate konfiguratsiyasi (<code>renovate.json</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Renovate — ochiq kodli dependency yangilash bot'i (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps'da). <code>renovate.json</code> deklarativ konfiguratsiya: qaysi paketlar, qanday guruhlash, jadval, auto-merge qoidalari va regex manager'lar orqali istalgan faylda (Dockerfile ARG, Helm values, Terraform) versiyalarni yangilash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dependabot qo'llab-quvvatlamaydigan joylar (masalan Makefile'dagi <code>KUBECTL_VERSION=1.30.2</code>) va murakkab siyosatlar (&quot;barcha AWS SDK paketlari bitta PR'da, faqat dam olish kunlari, patch'lar avtomatik merge&quot;).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Renovate (App yoki self-hosted cron)<br>  -&gt; },<br>    { &quot;matchUpdateTypes&quot;: [&quot;major&quot;], &quot;labels&quot;: [&quot;major-upgrade&quot;], &quot;automerge&quot;: false }<br>  ],<br>  &quot;customManagers&quot;: [{<br>    &quot;customType&quot;: &quot;regex&quot;,<br>    &quot;managerFilePatterns&quot;: [&quot;/Makefile$/&quot;],<br>    &quot;matchStrings&quot;: [&quot;KUBECTL_VERSION=(?&lt;currentValue&gt;\\S+)&quot;],<br>    &quot;depNameTemplate&quot;: &quot;kubernetes/kubernetes&quot;,<br>    &quot;datasourceTemplate&quot;: &quot;github-releases&quot;<br>  }]<br>}</pre><p>Tekshirish: <code>npx --package renovate renovate-config-validator</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konfiguratsiya juda kuchli — natijada murakkab; Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42172	<p>Semantic Release bilan avtomatik versiyalash qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> semantic-release CI'da oxirgi reliz tag'idan beri commit xabarlarini (Conventional Commits) tahlil qiladi: <code>fix:</code> -&gt; PATCH, <code>feat:</code> -&gt; MINOR, <code>BREAKING CHANGE:</code> footer yoki <code>feat!:</code> -&gt; MAJOR. Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42174	<p>GPG kalit muddatini qanday yangilaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>gpg --edit-key &lt;KEY_ID&gt;</code> -&gt; <code>expire</code> buyrug'i bilan asosiy kalit (va <code>key N</code> bilan tanlab, subkey'lar) muddatini uzaytirasiz, <code>save</code> qilasiz, keyin yangilangan public kalitni GitHub/GitLab'ga va keyserver'ga qayta yuklaysiz. Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42177	<p><code>git add -p</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git add -p</code> (<code>--patch</code>) o'zgargan fayllarni bo'laklarga (hunk) bo'lib, har birini alohida stage qilish-qilmaslikni so'raydi. Bitta faylda aralash o'zgarishlar bo'lsa ham, ularni mantiqiy, atomik commit'larga ajratish mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bug tuzatayotganda bir yo'la formatlash va kichik refactor ham qildingiz. Bu o'z-o'zini review qilishning eng arzon shakli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42178	<p><code>git restore -p</code> / <code>git reset -p</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git restore -p &lt;fayl&gt;</code> working tree'dagi o'zgarishlarni hunk-hunk bo'yicha bekor qiladi (tashlaydi). <code>git reset -p</code> (yoki <code>git restore --staged -p</code>) esa stage qilingan hunk'larni index'dan chiqaradi (unstage), working tree'ga tegmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Faylda 5 ta o'zgarish bor; ulardan 2 tasi vaqtinchalik debug kod. Butun faylni <code>restore</code> qilsangiz, foydali o'zgarishlar ham yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            working tree  &lt;--restore -p--  index  &lt;--reset -p / restore --staged -p--  HEAD<br>&quot;tashlash&quot;: working tree hunk'ini index holatiga qaytarish (QAYTARIB BO'LMAYDI)<br>&quot;unstage&quot;:  index hunk'ini HEAD holatiga qaytarish (working tree'da qoladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git restore -p src/order.go          # har hunk: &quot;Discard this hunk from worktree [y,n,q,a,d,s,e,?]?&quot;<br>git reset -p src/order.go            # &quot;Unstage this hunk [y,n,...]?&quot;<br>git restore --staged -p src/order.go # zamonaviy ekvivalent<br>git checkout -p HEAD~1 -- src/order.go   # eski versiyadan tanlab olish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>restore -p</code> da tashlangan hunk hech qayerda saqlanmaydi (agar avval stage qilinmagan bo'lsa) — ehtiyot bo'ling; shubha bo'lsa avval <code>git stash</code> yoki <code>git diff &gt; backup.patch</code>.</li><li><code>reset -p</code> va <code>reset --hard</code> ni adashtirmang — birinchisi xavfsiz, ikkinchisi hammasini tashlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>add -p</code>, <code>reset -p</code>, <code>restore -p</code> — birgalikda commit'larni &quot;jarrohlik aniqligida&quot; yasash to'plami. Katta o'zgarishni review'dan oldin shu vositalar bilan mantiqiy qismlarga bo'lish PR sifatini sezilarli oshiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42179	<p><code>git commit --no-verify</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git commit --no-verify</code> (<code>-n</code>) lokal <code>pre-commit</code> va <code>commit-msg</code> hook'larini ishga tushirmasdan commit qiladi. Shuning uchun lokal hook'lar hech qachon yagona nazorat bo'lmasligi kerak — xuddi shu tekshiruvlar CI'da va server tomonida takrorlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Shoshilinch hotfix paytida sekin yoki noto'g'ri ishlayotgan hook commit'ni bloklaydi. Ba'zan chetlab o'tish asosli — lekin odatga aylansa, lint xatolari va secret'lar repo'ga tushadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git commit            -&gt; pre-commit -&gt; commit-msg -&gt; commit<br>git commit --no-verify -&gt; --------- o'tkazib -----&gt; commit<br>(prepare-commit-msg va post-commit baribir ishlaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git commit --no-verify -m &quot;fix: hotfix prod outage&quot;<br>SKIP=eslint git commit -m &quot;...&quot;      # pre-commit framework'da faqat bitta hook'ni o'tkazish</pre><p>CI'da xuddi shu tekshiruv:</p><pre>- uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>- uses: actions/setup-python@v5<br>- run: pip install pre-commit &amp;&amp; pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Hook ishlamay qoldi, <code>-n</code> qildim&quot; — ko'pincha hook sekin; ildiz sababni tuzating (faqat staged fayllar, kesh).</li><li><code>-n</code> — <code>--no-verify</code> ning qisqasi, lekin <code>git commit -n</code> boshqa buyruqlardagi &quot;dry run&quot; bilan adashtiriladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hook'ni chetlab o'tish imkoniyati — dizayn xususiyati, xato emas: lokal hook — dasturchi uchun qulaylik. Majburiy nazorat (secret scan, required checks, push protection) faqat siz nazorat qiladigan joyda — CI va serverda.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42180	<p><code>git push --no-verify</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git push --no-verify</code> lokal <code>pre-push</code> hook'ini (odatda testlar yoki branch nomi tekshiruvi) o'tkazib push qiladi. Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42181	<p>Git refspec (<code>refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Refspec — <code>[+]&lt;manba&gt;:&lt;manzil&gt;</code> formatidagi qoida bo'lib, fetch/push paytida qaysi ref qayerga yozilishini belgilaydi. Default <code>+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*</code> — &quot;serverdagi barcha branch'larni lokal <code>origin/...</code> tracking ref'lariga ko'chir&quot;; <code>+</code> esa non-fast-forward yangilanishga (force) ruxsat beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Siz serverdagi PR ref'larini (<code>refs/pull/*</code>), notes'ni yoki faqat bitta branch'ni olishni xohlaysiz; yoki branch'ni boshqa nom bilan push qilish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>.git/config:<br>[remote &quot;origin&quot;]<br>  url = git@github.com:org/app.git<br>  fetch = +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*<br>server refs/heads/feat/x  -&gt;  lokal refs/remotes/origin/feat/x<br>'+' bo'lmasa: server branch'i force-push qilinganda fetch rad etadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git config --get-all remote.origin.fetch<br># PR'larni ham olish:<br>git config --add remote.origin.fetch '+refs/pull/*/head:refs/remotes/origin/pr/*'<br>git fetch origin &amp;&amp; git switch --detach origin/pr/812<br># bir martalik refspec:<br>git fetch origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main<br>git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/release/1.9      # lokal HEAD ni boshqa nomga<br>git push origin feat/x:feat/y<br>git push origin :old-branch                      # bo'sh manba = o'chirish<br># faqat bitta branch'ni kuzatish (katta repo):<br>git config remote.origin.fetch '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Fetch refspec'ni o'zgartirib, <code>refs/heads/*</code> ga to'g'ridan yozsangiz, lokal branch'laringiz ustidan yoziladi.</li><li>Push'da <code>+</code> = force: <code>git push origin +main</code> — <code>--force</code> bilan bir xil xavfli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Refspec'ni tushunish mirror, migratsiya, CI checkout optimizatsiyasi (faqat kerakli ref'ni fetch) va PR'larni lokal tekshirish uchun zarur. Git'ning &quot;sehrli&quot; ko'rinadigan xatti-harakatlarining katta qismi shu oddiy qoidalardan kelib chiqadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42182	<p><code>--force-with-lease</code> &quot;stale info&quot; xatosi nimani bildiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>! [rejected] main -&gt; main (stale info)</code> — <code>--force-with-lease</code> ishlayapti: remote branch siz oxirgi ko'rgan (fetch qilgan) holatdan farq qiladi, ya'ni kimdir yangi commit push qilgan. Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42183	<p>Dangling blob va unreachable commit farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Dangling blob</b> — <code>git add</code> bilan obyekt bazasiga yozilgan, lekin hech qaysi commit'ning tree'siga kirmagan fayl mazmuni. <b>Unreachable commit</b> — hech qaysi branch, tag (va ixtiyoriy ravishda reflog) dan erishib bo'lmaydigan commit, masalan <code>reset --hard</code>, rebase yoki amend'dan keyin qolgan eski commit.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yo'qolgan ishni tiklashda qaysi turdagi obyektni qidirishni va qancha vaqtingiz borligini bilish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>refs (branch/tag) -&gt; Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42197	<p><code>GIT_SSH_COMMAND</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>GIT_SSH_COMMAND</code> Git SSH ulanishda ishlatadigan buyruqni to'liq parametrlar bilan almashtiradi — masalan aniq kalit faylini (<code>-i</code>), faqat shu kalitni (<code>IdentitiesOnly=yes</code>) yoki boshqa portni ko'rsatish.
