Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42198	<p>Git protocol v2 nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git wire protocol v2 — client va server o'rtasidagi zamonaviy protokol: server darhol barcha ref'larni yubormaydi, client faqat kerakli ref'larni (<code>ls-refs</code> filtri bilan) so'raydi; buyruqlar (<code>ls-refs</code>, <code>fetch</code>) alohida va kengaytiriladigan. Git 2.26 dan beri default.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> v0/v1'da har <code>git fetch</code> boshida server <b>barcha</b> ref'larni e'lon qiladi. Millionlab ref'li repo'da (har PR, har tag) faqat <code>main</code> ni olish uchun ham megabaytlab ref ro'yxati yuklanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>v0:  client -&gt; connect ; server -&gt; 2,000,000 ref e'loni ; client -&gt; want main<br>v2:  client -&gt; command=ls-refs, ref-prefix refs/heads/main<br>     server -&gt; 1 ref<br>     client -&gt; command=fetch, want &lt;sha&gt;</pre><p>Qo'shimcha: partial clone filtrlari, server tomonidagi imkoniyatlarni (capabilities) aniq kelishish.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git config --global protocol.version 2      # Git &gt;= 2.26 da default<br>GIT_TRACE_PACKET=1 git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -E &quot;version|ls-refs&quot; | head<br>git -c protocol.version=0 fetch            # taqqoslash uchun eski protokol<br>time git fetch origin main</pre><p>Chiqish (trace): <code>packet: git&lt; version 2</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Juda eski server yoki proxy v2 ni qo'llab-quvvatlamasa, Git avtomatik v0 ga tushadi — ishlaydi, lekin sekin.</li><li>SSH orqali v2 server tomonida <code>AcceptEnv GIT_PROTOCOL</code> sozlamasini talab qiladi (o'z serveringizda).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Protokol v2 — ko'rinmas, lekin katta tezlashtirish: ayniqsa CI'da ko'p repo'ni tez-tez fetch qilganda. Ichki Git server yoki proxy (masalan korporativ mirror) v2 ni qo'llab-quvvatlashini tekshirish — arzon optimizatsiya.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42199	<p><code>core.hooksPath</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>core.hooksPath</code> Git'ga hook'larni <code>.git/hooks/</code> o'rniga boshqa papkadan olishni aytadi. Uni repo ichidagi versiyalanadigan papkaga (<code>.githooks/</code>, Husky uchun <code>.husky/</code>) yo'naltirsangiz, hook'lar commit qilinadi va butun jamoa bir xil hook'lardan foydalanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>.git/hooks/</code> Git tomonidan kuzatilmaydi — u yerga yozilgan hook hamkasblarga yetib bormaydi va yangi clone'da yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git commit -&gt; hooks papkasi = core.hooksPath ?? .git/hooks<br>repo/<br>  .githooks/pre-commit   (commit qilingan, chmod +x)<br>  .githooks/commit-msg</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>mkdir -p .githooks<br>cp scripts/pre-commit .githooks/ &amp;&amp; chmod +x .githooks/*<br>git add .githooks &amp;&amp; git commit -m &quot;chore: shared git hooks&quot;<br>git config core.hooksPath .githooks       # har dasturchi bir marta (Makefile/setup skriptiga qo'ying)</pre><pre>setup:<br>    git config core.hooksPath .githooks</pre><p>Husky (Node) <code>prepare</code> script orqali shuni avtomatik qiladi: <code>npx husky init</code>. Global (barcha repo'lar uchun shaxsiy hook'lar):</p><pre>git config --global core.hooksPath ~/.config/git/hooks</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Git xavfsizlik sababli clone paytida hook'larni avtomatik yoqmaydi — har kim <code>core.hooksPath</code> ni o'zi sozlashi kerak (setup skript).</li><li>Global <code>core.hooksPath</code> qo'ysangiz, repo'larning <code>.git/hooks/</code> va Husky hook'lari e'tiborsiz qoladi.</li><li>Executable bit Windows'da yo'qolishi mumkin — <code>git update-index --chmod=+x</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ulashilgan hook'lar — qulaylik va tez feedback; ular &quot;ixtiyoriy&quot; bo'lib qolaveradi. Shuning uchun har hook'dagi tekshiruvning CI'dagi juftini saqlang va hook'larni tez (&lt;2-3 soniya) qiling.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Git::H34 GitOps & enterprise Git	idrill-42200	<p>Enterprise version control branching va reliz strategiyasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zamonaviy enterprise strategiya: (1) <b>trunk-based</b> — qisqa umrli branch'lar, PR, majburiy CI va review bilan <code>main</code> ga; (2) <b>merge queue</b> — <code>main</code> doim yashil; (3) <b>avtomatik semantik reliz</b> — Conventional Commits'dan SemVer tag va changelog; (4) <b>imzolangan commit'lar</b> va rulesets; (5) <b>GitOps promotion</b> — alohida config repo orqali ArgoCD/Flux bilan muhitlar bo'ylab deploy.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 50 ta jamoa, 300 ta repo. Har jamoa o'z branching modeli, qo'lda relizlar, prod'ga kim nima chiqarganini bilib bo'lmaydi; audit (SOC 2) dalil talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>feature branch (&lt;1 kun) -&gt; PR -&gt; CI (test, lint, SAST, secret scan)<br>   -&gt; CODEOWNERS review -&gt; merge queue -&gt; main (signed, linear)<br>main -&gt; release-please/semantic-release -&gt; tag vX.Y.Z -&gt; image build + sign (cosign) + SBOM<br>     -&gt; PR to config repo (dev overlay) -&gt; ArgoCD sync dev<br>     -&gt; promotion PR staging -&gt; prod (approval, change window)<br>rollback = config repo'da git revert</pre><p><b>Amalda (org ruleset — asosiy qoidalar):</b></p><pre>Target: default branch, release/*<br>- Require pull request: 1-2 approvals, code owners, dismiss stale<br>- Require status checks: build, test, security-scan (strict)<br>- Require merge queue<br>- Require signed commits<br>- Require linear history<br>- Block force pushes and deletions<br>- Bypass: faqat release bot (GitHub App)</pre><pre>gh api orgs/org/rulesets --jq '.[].name'</pre><p>Faqat bir nechta versiyani qo'llab-quvvatlash kerak bo'lsa: <code>release/x.y</code> branch'lari, fix avval <code>main</code> da, keyin cherry-pick <code>-x</code> bilan backport.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trunk-based'ni feature flag va kuchli test madaniyatisiz joriy qilish — <code>main</code> tez-tez buziladi.</li><li>Har repo'da qo'lda sozlash — drift; siyosatni org darajasidagi rulesets va Terraform (<code>github</code> provider) bilan kod sifatida boshqaring.</li><li>Reliz va deploy'ni bir-biriga bog'lab qo'yish: reliz (versiya) va prod'ga chiqarish (GitOps promotion) — alohida qarorlar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Strategiyaning maqsadi — DORA metrikalari (deploy chastotasi, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR) bo'yicha yaxshilanish, &quot;chiroyli tarix&quot; emas. Har qoidani qanday risk'ni kamaytirishi bilan asoslang va o'lchang; ortiqcha nazorat lead time'ni oshirib, odamlarni chetlab o'tishga undaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::git sec::h34 GitOps_enterprise_Git
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-2006	<p>Konteyner va virtual mashina farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Konteyner — host kernel'ini bo'lishib ishlaydigan, namespace va cgroup bilan izolyatsiya qilingan oddiy jarayon. VM — hypervisor ustida o'z kernel'i va to'liq OS'i bilan ishlaydigan alohida &quot;kompyuter&quot;. Konteyner yengil va tez, VM esa izolyatsiyada kuchliroq.</p><p><b>Nega bu farq muhim:</b> Serverda 50 ta servis bor. Har biriga VM bersangiz — 50 ta kernel, 50 ta OS, har biri 1-2 GB RAM va daqiqalab boot. Konteyner bilan — bitta kernel, har servis bir necha MB va soniyadan kam start. Lekin bitta kernel umumiy bo'lgani uchun kernel zaifligi hamma konteynerga xavf.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>   VM                          Konteyner<br>+--------+ +--------+       +------+ +------+<br>| App    | | App    |       | App  | | App  |<br>| Libs   | | Libs   |       | Libs | | Libs |<br>| Kernel | | Kernel |       +------+ +------+<br>+--------+ +--------+       | Docker/runc     |<br>|   Hypervisor      |       | Host Kernel     |<br>|   Hardware        |       | Hardware        |<br>+-------------------+       +-----------------+</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d --name web nginx<br>ps aux | grep nginx        # hostda nginx oddiy jarayon sifatida ko'rinadi<br>uname -r                   # host kernel<br>docker exec web uname -r   # aynan shu kernel versiyasi</pre><p>Ikkala <code>uname -r</code> bir xil chiqadi — konteynerda o'z kernel yo'qligining isboti.</p><p>| | Konteyner | VM | |---|---|---| | Kernel | host bilan umumiy | o'ziniki | | Start | &lt; 1 s | 10 s - daqiqalar | | Hajm | MB | GB | | Izolyatsiya | namespace, cgroup | hypervisor (hardware) |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konteynerni &quot;kichik VM&quot; deb o'ylash — unga SSH, systemd, cron qo'yish anti-pattern.</li><li>Linux konteyner Windows/macOS kernel'ida ishlamaydi — Docker Desktop yashirin Linux VM ishlatadi.</li><li>Konteyner ichidagi root host kernel uchun ham UID 0 (userns bo'lmasa).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p tenant (begona kod) muhitida oddiy konteyner yetarli emas — gVisor, Kata Containers yoki Firecracker microVM ishlatiladi: konteyner tezligi + VM izolyatsiyasi. Real hayotda ko'pincha ikkalasi birga: VM (cloud instance) ichida konteynerlar.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-2007	<p>Nega har kod o'zgarishida build 5 daqiqa ketadi? Tuzatish?</p><pre>FROM node:20<br>WORKDIR /app<br>COPY . .<br>RUN npm ci<br>RUN npm run build<br>CMD [&quot;node&quot;, &quot;dist/main.js&quot;]</pre>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dockerfile'da <code>COPY . .</code> dependency o'rnatishdan <b>oldin</b> turgan. Har kod o'zgarishida bu layer cache'dan tushadi va undan keyingi barcha layer'lar (masalan <code>npm ci</code>) qaytadan bajariladi. Yechim — avval faqat dependency fayllarini ko'chirish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta qatorni o'zgartirdingiz — Docker 5 daqiqa davomida 1000 ta npm paketni qayta yuklaydi. Sababi: Docker layer cache zanjir — bitta layer o'zgarsa, keyingilari hammasi qayta quriladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Yomon:                       Yaxshi:<br>COPY . .        &lt;- o'zgardi  COPY package*.json ./  &lt;- o'zgarmadi (cache)<br>RUN npm ci      &lt;- qayta     RUN npm ci             &lt;- cache<br>RUN npm build   &lt;- qayta     COPY . .               &lt;- o'zgardi<br>                             RUN npm run build      &lt;- faqat shu qayta</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM node:22-slim<br>WORKDIR /app<br>COPY package.json package-lock.json ./<br>RUN npm ci<br>COPY . .<br>RUN npm run build</pre><pre>docker build -t app .<br># chiqishda:  =&gt; CACHED [3/5] RUN npm ci</pre><p><code>CACHED</code> yozuvi ko'rinsa — tartib to'g'ri ishlayapti.</p><p><b>Qo'shimcha tezlatish:</b></p><ul><li><code>.dockerignore</code> — <code>.git</code>, <code>node_modules</code>, <code>dist</code> context'ga kirmasin.</li><li>BuildKit cache mount: <code>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm ci</code>.</li><li>Multi-stage — runtime image kichik bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.git</code> context'da qolsa har commit <code>COPY . .</code> cache'ni buzadi.</li><li><code>RUN apt-get update</code> alohida qatorda — eski cache bilan eskirgan paket ro'yxati.</li><li>CI runner har safar toza — lokal cache yo'q, remote cache (<code>--cache-from</code>) kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: kam o'zgaradigan narsa yuqorida, tez-tez o'zgaradigan pastda. Build vaqtini o'lchang (<code>docker build --progress=plain</code>) — qaysi qadam sekinligini bilmay optimizatsiya qilmang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31386	<p>Image va container farqi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Image</b> — o'zgarmas shablon: read-only layer'lar + metadata (CMD, ENV, EXPOSE). <b>Container</b> — shu image'dan ishga tushgan jarayon, ustiga yupqa yoziladigan (writable) layer qo'shilgan. Image — klass, container — uning obyekti.</p><p><b>Nega farq muhim:</b> Bitta <code>nginx:1.27</code> image'dan 10 ta container ishga tushirish mumkin — ular diskdagi image layer'larini ulashadi, faqat har birining o'z writable layer'i bor. Container o'chirilsa uning o'zgarishlari ham yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>container A (RW)   container B (RW)   &lt;- har biriga alohida<br>        \               /<br>     +--------------------+<br>     | image layer 3 (RO) |<br>     | image layer 2 (RO) |  &lt;- umumiy, diskda bir marta<br>     | image layer 1 (RO) |<br>     +--------------------+</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker pull nginx:1.27                  # image yuklash<br>docker images                           # image'lar ro'yxati<br>docker run -d --name web nginx:1.27     # container yaratish va ishga tushirish<br>docker ps -a                            # container'lar (to'xtaganlari bilan)<br>docker exec web touch /tmp/x<br>docker diff web                         # A /tmp/x - writable layer'dagi o'zgarish<br>docker rm -f web                        # container va uning RW layer'i yo'q</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Container ichida <code>apt install</code> qilib, keyin &quot;image'da yo'q&quot; deb hayron bo'lish — o'zgarish faqat o'sha container'da.</li><li>DB ma'lumotini container layer'ida saqlash — <code>docker rm</code> bilan yo'qoladi. Volume ishlating.</li><li><code>docker commit</code> bilan image yasash — takrorlanmaydigan &quot;qora quti&quot;. Dockerfile ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Image'ni immutable artefakt deb qarang: bir marta build, tag/digest bilan dev -&gt; staging -&gt; prod. Container esa disposable — istalgan payt o'ldirib, qayta yaratsa bo'ladigan bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31387	<p>Dockerfile'dagi asosiy instruksiyalar: FROM, RUN, COPY, CMD, ENTRYPOINT, EXPOSE, ENV — har biri nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dockerfile — image yasash retsepti. <code>FROM</code> asosni tanlaydi, <code>RUN</code> build paytida buyruq bajaradi, <code>COPY</code> fayl ko'chiradi, <code>ENV</code> o'zgaruvchi beradi, <code>EXPOSE</code> portni hujjatlaydi, <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> va <code>CMD</code> container start bo'lganda nima ishlashini belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> Instruksiyalarning bir qismi <b>build</b> paytida ishlaydi (layer yoki metadata yaratadi), <code>CMD</code>/<code>ENTRYPOINT</code> esa faqat <b>run</b> paytida bajariladi.</p><p>| Instruksiya | Qachon | Nima qiladi | |---|---|---| | <code>FROM</code> | build | asos image; multi-stage'da bir necha marta | | <code>RUN</code> | build | buyruq bajaradi, yangi layer yaratadi | | <code>COPY</code> | build | context'dan fayl ko'chiradi | | <code>ENV</code> | build + run | o'zgaruvchi, container'da ham qoladi | | <code>WORKDIR</code> | build + run | ishchi papka | | <code>EXPOSE</code> | - | faqat hujjat; portni <code>-p</code> ochadi | | <code>USER</code> | build + run | qaysi user bilan ishlash | | <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> | run | doimiy dastur | | <code>CMD</code> | run | default argument; <code>docker run img X</code> bilan almashadi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM python:3.12-slim<br>WORKDIR /app<br>ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1<br>COPY requirements.txt .<br>RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt<br>COPY . .<br>EXPOSE 8000<br>USER 10001<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;python&quot;, &quot;-m&quot;, &quot;uvicorn&quot;]<br>CMD [&quot;main:app&quot;, &quot;--host&quot;, &quot;0.0.0.0&quot;, &quot;--port&quot;, &quot;8000&quot;]</pre><pre>docker build -t api .<br>docker run -p 8000:8000 api              # CMD ishlaydi<br>docker run api main:app --port 9000      # CMD almashtirildi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>EXPOSE</code> portni ochadi deb o'ylash — yo'q, <code>-p</code> kerak.</li><li><code>ADD</code> ni <code>COPY</code> o'rniga ishlatish — URL/tar avtomatik ochilishi kutilmagan natija beradi.</li><li>Shell form <code>CMD python app.py</code> — SIGTERM ilovaga yetmaydi; exec form <code>[&quot;...&quot;]</code> ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har <code>RUN</code> layer qo'shadi — bog'liq buyruqlarni <code>&amp;&amp;</code> bilan bitta <code>RUN</code> ga birlashtiring va keshni o'sha qatorda tozalang. <code>USER</code> ni oxirida qo'ying — production'da root bilan ishlash shart emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31388	<p><code>docker run -p 8080:80</code>, <code>-v</code>, <code>-e</code>, <code>--rm</code>, <code>-d</code> flaglari nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>-p 8080:80</code> — hostning 8080 portini container'ning 80 portiga ulaydi. <code>-v</code> — volume yoki host papkasini mount qiladi. <code>-e</code> — environment variable beradi. <code>--rm</code> — container to'xtagach avtomatik o'chiradi. <code>-d</code> — fonda (detached) ishga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Container izolyatsiyalangan: o'z tarmog'i, o'z fayl tizimi. Tashqaridan kirish, ma'lumot saqlash va konfig berish uchun aynan shu flaglar kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>brauzer -&gt; host:8080 --(-p)--&gt; container:80<br>host /srv/conf  --(-v)--&gt; container /etc/app (ro)<br>LOG_LEVEL=debug --(-e)--&gt; container env</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d --rm --name api \<br>  -p 127.0.0.1:8080:80 \<br>  -v appdata:/var/lib/app \<br>  -v &quot;$PWD/conf:/etc/app:ro&quot; \<br>  -e LOG_LEVEL=debug \<br>  myapp:1.2<br>docker ps                 # PORTS: 127.0.0.1:8080-&gt;80/tcp<br>docker port api           # 80/tcp -&gt; 127.0.0.1:8080</pre><p>| Flag | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>-d</code> | detached, terminal bo'shaydi | | <code>-it</code> | interaktiv terminal (shell uchun) | | <code>--rm</code> | exit'dan keyin container o'chadi | | <code>-p H:C</code> | port mapping | | <code>-v name:/path</code> | named volume | | <code>-v /host:/path:ro</code> | bind mount, faqat o'qish | | <code>-e K=V</code> / <code>--env-file</code> | o'zgaruvchilar | | <code>--restart unless-stopped</code> | avtomatik qayta ishga tushish |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-p 8080:80</code> default <code>0.0.0.0</code> — hamma interfeysda ochiq, va Docker iptables qoidalari <code>ufw</code> ni chetlab o'tadi.</li><li><code>--rm</code> va <code>--restart</code> birga ishlatilmaydi.</li><li><code>-v ./conf:/etc/app</code> — eski versiyalarda nisbiy yo'l named volume deb tushuniladi; <code>$PWD</code> ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Faqat lokal kerak bo'lgan portni <code>127.0.0.1:</code> bilan bog'lang. Production'da uzun <code>docker run</code> qatorlari o'rniga Compose fayl yoki orchestrator manifest — konfig versiyalanadi va qayta tiklanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31389	<p>Volume, bind mount va tmpfs farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Named volume</b> — Docker boshqaradigan saqlash joyi, production ma'lumoti uchun. <b>Bind mount</b> — hostdagi aniq papkani container'ga ulash, asosan dev uchun. <b>tmpfs</b> — RAM'dagi vaqtinchalik fayl tizimi, container to'xtasa yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Container layer'i vaqtinchalik — <code>docker rm</code> qilsangiz Postgres ma'lumoti ketadi. Ma'lumotni container hayotidan ajratish uchun mount kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>named volume: /var/lib/docker/volumes/pgdata/_data --&gt; /var/lib/postgresql/data<br>bind mount:   /home/me/project                     --&gt; /app<br>tmpfs:        RAM                                   --&gt; /tmp</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker volume create pgdata<br>docker run -d -v pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=x postgres:17<br>docker run -it -v &quot;$PWD&quot;:/app -w /app node:22 npm test       # dev: kod jonli<br>docker run --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=64m myapp                    # RAM<br>docker volume inspect pgdata    # Mountpoint ni ko'rsatadi</pre><p>| | Named volume | Bind mount | tmpfs | |---|---|---|---| | Kim boshqaradi | Docker | siz (host yo'li) | kernel (RAM) | | Container o'chsa | qoladi | qoladi | yo'qoladi | | Asosiy ishlatish | DB, prod data | dev, konfig | secret, temp | | Portativlik | yuqori | hostga bog'liq | - |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bo'sh named volume image'dagi papka mazmuni bilan to'ldiriladi; bind mount esa image papkasini <b>yashiradi</b> (masalan <code>node_modules</code> yo'qoladi).</li><li>Bind mount'da UID/permission mos kelmasligi: container 10001 user'i host faylini yoza olmaydi.</li><li><code>docker system prune --volumes</code> — named volume'lar ham o'chishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Volume — backup strategiyasi emas. DB uchun <code>pg_dump</code>/snapshot alohida bo'lsin. Docker Desktop (macOS) da bind mount sekin — og'ir I/O uchun named volume tanlang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33068	<p>Docker registry bilan ishlash: login, tag, push, pull. Private registry?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Registry — image'lar saqlanadigan server (Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR, Harbor). Ish tartibi: <code>docker login</code> -&gt; image'ga registry nomi bilan <code>tag</code> -&gt; <code>push</code>; boshqa mashinada <code>pull</code>. Private registry uchun login yoki o'z registry'ingiz kerak.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Image laptop'da build qilindi, lekin serverga yetkazish kerak. Registry — image'larni versiya bilan tarqatadigan markaziy ombor.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ghcr.io / acme / api : 1.4.0<br>registry   namespace  repo  tag<br>(registry ko'rsatilmasa -&gt; docker.io/library/...)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo &quot;$GHCR_TOKEN&quot; | docker login ghcr.io -u myuser --password-stdin<br>docker build -t api:dev .<br>docker tag api:dev ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0<br>docker push ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0<br># chiqish: 1.4.0: digest: sha256:3f2a... size: 1789<br>docker pull ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0<br><br># o'z registry (test uchun)<br>docker run -d -p 5000:5000 --name registry registry:2<br>docker tag api:dev localhost:5000/api:dev &amp;&amp; docker push localhost:5000/api:dev</pre><p><code>push</code> chiqishidagi <code>digest</code> — image'ning o'zgarmas identifikatori, deploy'da shuni yozib qo'ying.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Parolni <code>-p</code> bilan berish — shell history'da qoladi; <code>--password-stdin</code> ishlating.</li><li>Credential <code>~/.docker/config.json</code> da base64 (shifrlanmagan) — credential helper (<code>osxkeychain</code>, <code>pass</code>, <code>ecr-login</code>) sozlang.</li><li>Docker Hub anonim pull limiti — CI'da <code>toomanyrequests</code>; login yoki mirror kerak.</li><li>TLS'siz registry'ga push — <code>insecure-registries</code> talab qiladi, prod'da qilmang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production uchun Harbor/ECR/Artifact Registry: auth, vulnerability scan, retention policy, replication. Image'ni registry'ga digest bilan pin qilib deploy qiling va imzolang (cosign).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33069	<p><code>docker ps</code>, <code>images</code>, <code>logs</code>, <code>exec</code>, <code>rm</code>, <code>rmi</code>, <code>system prune</code> — asosiy buyruqlar nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ps</code> — container'lar ro'yxati, <code>images</code> — image'lar, <code>logs</code> — stdout/stderr, <code>exec</code> — ishlayotgan container ichida buyruq, <code>rm</code> — container o'chirish, <code>rmi</code> — image o'chirish, <code>system prune</code> — ishlatilmayotgan resurslarni tozalash.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> Har kungi debug va tozalash shu buyruqlar bilan. Ayniqsa <code>prune</code> ni noto'g'ri ishlatish ma'lumot yo'qotishiga olib keladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker ps                      # ishlayotganlar<br>docker ps -a                   # to'xtaganlari bilan<br>docker images                  # image'lar, hajmi bilan<br>docker logs -f --since 10m api # oxirgi 10 daqiqa, oqim<br>docker exec -it api sh         # ichiga kirish<br>docker stop api &amp;&amp; docker rm api<br>docker rm -f api               # majburan (SIGKILL)<br>docker rmi myapp:old<br>docker system df               # nima qancha joy egallagan<br>docker system prune            # to'xtagan container, dangling image, tarmoq</pre><p><code>docker ps</code> chiqishi:</p><pre>CONTAINER ID  IMAGE      STATUS                    PORTS                 NAMES<br>a1b2c3d4e5f6  nginx:1.27 Up 3 hours (healthy)      0.0.0.0:8080-&gt;80/tcp  web</pre><p>STATUS ustuni: <code>Up</code>, <code>Exited (137)</code>, <code>Restarting</code> — muammoni birinchi shu yerda ko'rasiz.</p><p>| Buyruq | Ehtiyot darajasi | |---|---| | <code>system prune</code> | xavfsiz (dangling) | | <code>system prune -a</code> | ishlatilmayotgan <b>hamma</b> image ketadi | | <code>system prune -a --volumes</code> | ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>rmi</code> ishlatilayotgan image'ni o'chirmaydi — avval container'ni o'chiring.</li><li><code>prune -a</code> dan keyin keyingi deploy hamma image'ni qayta pull qiladi — sekin.</li><li><code>logs</code> bo'sh — ilova faylga yozyapti, stdout'ga emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod host'larda <code>--volumes</code> ni hech qachon avtomatik cron'da ishlatmang. Tozalashni filtr bilan qiling: <code>docker image prune -a --filter &quot;until=168h&quot;</code>.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33070	<p>Multi-stage build nima va nega kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multi-stage build — bitta Dockerfile'da bir necha <code>FROM</code> bosqichi. Birinchi bosqichda kompilyator va asboblar bilan build qilinadi, yakuniy bosqichga faqat tayyor artefakt ko'chiriladi. Natija: kichik, xavfsiz runtime image.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>golang:1.23</code> image'i ~900 MB: kompilyator, git, shell, yuzlab paket. Production'da bularning hech biri kerak emas — faqat 15 MB binary. Ortiqcha narsa = sekin pull, ko'p CVE, hujum yuzasi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Stage &quot;build&quot; (golang, 900MB)        Stage final (distroless, ~2MB)<br>  go mod download                      <br>  go build -&gt; /app  ---COPY --from---&gt;  /app<br>  (tashlab yuboriladi)                  ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM golang:1.25 AS build<br>WORKDIR /src<br>COPY go.mod go.sum ./<br>RUN go mod download<br>COPY . .<br>RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags=&quot;-s -w&quot; -o /app ./cmd/api<br><br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot<br>COPY --from=build /app /app<br>USER nonroot<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><pre>docker build -t api .<br>docker images api               # ~15 MB<br>docker build --target build -t api:builder .   # faqat build bosqichi (test uchun)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CGO yoqilgan binary distroless/static yoki scratch'da ishlamaydi — <code>CGO_ENABLED=0</code> yoki <code>distroless/base</code>.</li><li>Runtime'da kerakli fayllarni unutish: CA sertifikatlar, tzdata.</li><li>Bosqich nomi o'rniga indeks (<code>--from=0</code>) — Dockerfile o'zgarsa buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Multi-stage'da test bosqichi ham qo'shish mumkin (<code>--target test</code> CI'da). BuildKit ishlatilmaydigan bosqichlarni o'tkazib yuboradi va mustaqillarini parallel quradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33363	<p><code>ARG</code> va <code>ENV</code> farqi? Secret'ni <code>ARG</code> bilan berish nega xavfli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ARG</code> — faqat build paytida mavjud o'zgaruvchi, <code>ENV</code> — build'da ham, ishlayotgan container'da ham. Secret'ni <code>ARG</code> bilan berish xavfli, chunki qiymat image metadata'sida (<code>docker history</code>) va uni ishlatgan layer'da qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Private npm registry tokenini <code>ARG NPM_TOKEN</code> bilan berdingiz. Image public registry'ga chiqdi — har kim <code>docker history --no-trunc</code> bilan tokenni o'qiydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ARG GO_VERSION=1.25<br>FROM golang:${GO_VERSION} AS build<br>ARG VERSION=dev                       # build-time<br>ENV CGO_ENABLED=0                     # build + runtime<br>RUN go build -ldflags &quot;-X main.version=${VERSION}&quot; -o /app .</pre><pre>docker build --build-arg VERSION=1.4.0 -t api .<br>docker history --no-trunc api | grep VERSION   # ARG qiymati ko'rinadi!</pre><p>| | ARG | ENV | |---|---|---| | Build vaqtida | bor | bor | | Container ishlayotganda | yo'q | bor | | Qanday beriladi | <code>--build-arg</code> | Dockerfile, <code>-e</code>, compose | | <code>docker history</code>da | ishlatilgan RUN bilan ko'rinadi | ko'rinadi |</p><p><b>To'g'ri yo'l — BuildKit secret:</b></p><pre># syntax=docker/dockerfile:1<br>RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci</pre><pre>docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=$HOME/.npmrc .</pre><p>Secret faqat shu <code>RUN</code> davomida fayl sifatida mount qilinadi, hech qaysi layer'ga yozilmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>FROM</code> dan oldingi <code>ARG</code> keyingi bosqichda ko'rinmaydi — bosqich ichida qayta <code>ARG NAME</code> yozing.</li><li><code>ENV PASSWORD=...</code> — runtime'da <code>docker inspect</code> bilan ham ko'rinadi.</li><li><code>ARG</code> o'zgarsa — undan keyingi layer cache'i buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Runtime secret'lar image'ga umuman kirmasligi kerak — orchestrator secret (K8s Secret + External Secrets, Vault) orqali beriladi. CI'da gitleaks/trivy secret scan qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33364	<p><code>COPY</code> va <code>ADD</code> farqi? Qaysi birini ishlatish kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>COPY</code> — context'dan fayllarni oddiy ko'chiradi. <code>ADD</code> — qo'shimcha ravishda lokal tar arxivni avtomatik ochadi va URL'dan yuklay oladi. Deyarli doim <code>COPY</code> ishlating; <code>ADD</code> faqat lokal tar'ni ochish kerak bo'lganda.</p><p><b>Nega:</b> <code>ADD</code> &quot;sehrli&quot; — <code>app.tar.gz</code> ni ko'chirmoqchi bo'lsangiz, u ochib yuboradi. URL'dan yuklashda checksum va cache nazorati yo'q. Aniq xatti-harakat uchun <code>COPY</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>COPY go.mod go.sum ./                  # oddiy<br>COPY --chown=10001:10001 . .           # egasini belgilash<br>COPY --from=build /app /app            # multi-stage<br>ADD rootfs.tar.gz /                    # tar avtomatik ochiladi - ADD o'rinli</pre><p>URL'dan yuklash — <code>RUN</code> bilan, checksum tekshirib:</p><pre>RUN curl -fsSL -o /tmp/tool.tgz https://example.com/tool-1.2.tgz \<br> &amp;&amp; echo &quot;ab12...ef  /tmp/tool.tgz&quot; | sha256sum -c - \<br> &amp;&amp; tar -xzf /tmp/tool.tgz -C /usr/local/bin &amp;&amp; rm /tmp/tool.tgz</pre><p>Yangi Dockerfile sintaksisida <code>ADD --checksum=sha256:... &lt;url&gt; /dst</code> ham bor.</p><p>| | COPY | ADD | |---|---|---| | Lokal fayl | ha | ha | | Tar avto-ochish | yo'q | ha | | URL | yo'q | ha | | Bashorat qilish | oson | kutilmagan |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ADD https://...</code> — har build'da qayta yuklanmasligi yoki aksincha, kutilmaganda o'zgarishi mumkin.</li><li><code>COPY ../shared .</code> — context'dan tashqariga chiqib bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>--chown</code> siz ko'chirilgan fayllar root'ga tegishli — non-root user yoza olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> hadolint qoidasi DL3020: &quot;fayl/papka uchun ADD emas COPY&quot;. Linter'ni CI'ga qo'ying — bunday mayda xatolarni code review'ga qoldirmang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33421	<p>OverlayFS va Copy-on-Write: image layer'lari container'da qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Image layer'lari OverlayFS'da read-only <code>lowerdir</code> sifatida ustma-ust qo'yiladi, container'ga esa yozish uchun <code>upperdir</code> beriladi. Container faylni o'zgartirsa, fayl avval upper layer'ga to'liq nusxalanadi (copy-on-write), keyin o'zgartiriladi.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> Image hajmi, disk tejash, I/O tezligi va &quot;nega rm qilsam ham image kichraymadi&quot; kabi savollarning javobi shu mexanizmda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre> merged (container ko'radigan /)<br>   ^<br> upperdir  container layer (RW)   &lt;- yozish va whiteout shu yerga<br> ---------------------------------<br> layer 3: COPY app        (RO)<br> layer 2: RUN apk add     (RO)    lowerdir<br> layer 1: alpine base     (RO)</pre><p>Fayl o'chirilsa — pastki layer'dan o'chmaydi, upper'da &quot;whiteout&quot; belgisi yoziladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d --name t alpine sleep 1d<br>docker exec t sh -c 'echo hi &gt; /root/x; rm /etc/motd'<br>docker diff t<br># A /root/x     (added)<br># D /etc/motd   (deleted - whiteout)<br>docker inspect t --format '{{json .GraphDriver.Data}}' | jq<br># LowerDir, UpperDir, MergedDir yo'llari</pre><p><b>Oqibatlar:</b></p><ul><li>10 container bitta image'dan — layer'lar diskda bir marta.</li><li>1 GB faylga 1 bayt yozish — avval 1 GB nusxalanadi (sekin).</li><li><code>RUN rm big.tar</code> keyingi layer'da — image kichraymaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DB ma'lumotini container layer'ida saqlash — CoW sekin va <code>rm</code> da yo'qoladi. Volume ishlating.</li><li><code>RUN wget x.tar &amp;&amp; ...</code> va <code>RUN rm x.tar</code> ni alohida qatorda yozish.</li><li>Secret'ni COPY qilib keyin o'chirish — oldingi layer'da qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yozish ko'p bo'lgan papkalar (log, cache, data) har doim volume yoki tmpfs'da bo'lsin — bu ham tezlik, ham <code>--read-only</code> rootfs'ga yo'l ochadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-2008	<p>Production image hajmini kamaytirishning eng samarali yo'li?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng samarali yo'l — multi-stage build: kompilyator va build asboblari builder bosqichida qoladi, yakuniy image'ga faqat artefakt ko'chiriladi. Keyin minimal base (distroless, slim, scratch), <code>.dockerignore</code> va bir <code>RUN</code> ichida keshni tozalash.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> 1.2 GB image — har deploy va autoscaling'da sekin pull, registry xarajati, yuzlab CVE. 20 MB image — soniyalarda start, kam hujum yuzasi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (ta'sir tartibi):</b></p><pre>1. multi-stage           1.2GB -&gt; 80MB   (eng katta yutuq)<br>2. minimal base          80MB  -&gt; 20MB   (distroless/slim)<br>3. .dockerignore         context kichik, keraksiz fayl yo'q<br>4. bitta RUN + tozalash  bir necha 10MB</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM node:22 AS build<br>WORKDIR /app<br>COPY package*.json ./<br>RUN npm ci<br>COPY . .<br>RUN npm run build &amp;&amp; npm prune --omit=dev<br><br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22-debian12<br>WORKDIR /app<br>COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist<br>COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules<br>CMD [&quot;dist/server.js&quot;]</pre><pre>docker images myapp        # hajmni solishtir<br>dive myapp:latest          # qaysi layer'da ortiqcha joy borligini ko'rsatadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Alpine (musl) ba'zi native modullar va DNS bilan muammo beradi — slim/distroless ko'pincha xavfsizroq tanlov.</li><li>Dev dependency'larni production image'ga olib o'tish.</li><li>Hajmni kamaytiraman deb debug imkonini butunlay yo'qotish — debug image variantini saqlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hajm o'z-o'zidan maqsad emas — asosiy foyda: kam CVE va tez cold start. Avval <code>dive</code> bilan o'lchang, keyin eng katta layer'dan boshlang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31390	<p>Docker layer cache qanday ishlaydi va Dockerfile tartibi nega muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har Dockerfile instruksiyasi layer yaratadi va cache kaliti — instruksiya matni + oldingi layer + (COPY/ADD uchun) fayllar checksum'i. Bitta layer o'zgarsa, undan keyingi <b>barcha</b> layer'lar qayta quriladi. Shuning uchun kam o'zgaradigan qadamlar yuqorida bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kod 1 qator o'zgardi, lekin dependency'lar ham qayta yuklanyapti — chunki <code>COPY . .</code> dependency o'rnatishdan oldin turibdi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>FROM golang         [cache]<br>COPY go.mod go.sum  [cache]  &lt;- checksum o'zgarmadi<br>RUN go mod download [cache]<br>COPY . .            [MISS]   &lt;- main.go o'zgardi<br>RUN go build        [qayta]  &lt;- zanjir shu yerdan buziladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># syntax=docker/dockerfile:1<br>FROM golang:1.25 AS build<br>WORKDIR /src<br>COPY go.mod go.sum ./<br>RUN go mod download<br>COPY . .<br>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \<br>    CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app ./cmd/api</pre><pre>docker build --progress=plain -t api . 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -E 'CACHED|DONE'</pre><p><code>CACHED</code> — layer qayta ishlatildi; vaqt ko'rsatilgan qadamlar qayta bajarilgan.</p><p><b>Cache'ni buzadigan narsalar:</b></p><ul><li><code>COPY</code> qilingan har qanday fayl o'zgarishi (<code>.git</code>, log'lar ham!).</li><li><code>ARG</code> qiymati o'zgarishi.</li><li>Base image yangilanishi (<code>--pull</code>).</li><li><code>RUN</code> matni o'zgarishi (lekin tashqi natija emas — <code>apt-get update</code> eski qoladi).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>RUN apt-get update</code> alohida layer — cache'da eskirib qoladi; <code>update &amp;&amp; install</code> bitta qatorda.</li><li><code>.dockerignore</code> yo'q — <code>.git</code> har commit'da cache'ni buzadi.</li><li><code>--no-cache</code> ni CI'da doim yoqish — build sekin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> BuildKit <code>--mount=type=cache</code> paket menejer keshini layer'dan tashqarida saqlaydi — dependency o'zgarsa ham hammasi qayta yuklanmaydi. CI'da <code>--cache-from/--cache-to</code> bilan remote cache.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31391	<p>CMD va ENTRYPOINT farqi; shell form va exec form?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> — container'ning doimiy dasturi, <code>CMD</code> — unga default argumentlar (yoki ENTRYPOINT yo'q bo'lsa default buyruq). <code>docker run img X</code> faqat <code>CMD</code> ni almashtiradi. <b>Exec form</b> (<code>[&quot;/app&quot;]</code>) dastur PID 1 bo'ladi va signal oladi; <b>shell form</b> (<code>/app</code>) <code>/bin/sh -c</code> orqali ishlaydi va signal ilovaga yetmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>docker stop</code> har safar 10 soniya kutib, keyin container'ni o'ldiradi (exit 137). Sabab — shell form: PID 1 <code>sh</code>, u SIGTERM'ni ilovaga uzatmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Exec form:   PID 1 = /app            &lt;- SIGTERM -&gt; graceful shutdown<br>Shell form:  PID 1 = /bin/sh -c /app<br>                     `- /app          &lt;- SIGTERM yetmaydi -&gt; 10s -&gt; SIGKILL</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]<br>CMD [&quot;--port=8080&quot;]</pre><pre>docker run img                   # /app --port=8080<br>docker run img --port=9000       # /app --port=9000<br>docker run --entrypoint sh -it img   # ENTRYPOINT'ni almashtirish<br>docker exec &lt;id&gt; ps -o pid,args  # PID 1 kimligini tekshirish</pre><p>Wrapper script kerak bo'lsa:</p><pre>#!/bin/sh<br>set -e<br>envsubst &lt; /etc/app.tpl &gt; /etc/app.conf<br>exec &quot;$@&quot;        # sh o'rniga dastur PID 1 bo'ladi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Shell form'da <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> — <code>CMD</code> argumentlari umuman uzatilmaydi.</li><li>Entrypoint script oxirida <code>exec</code> yo'q — signal muammosi qaytadi.</li><li>PID 1 zombie'larni yig'maydi — child process ochadigan ilovada <code>--init</code> (tini).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ilova SIGTERM'ni ushlab, yangi so'rov qabul qilishni to'xtatishi va joriylarini tugatishi kerak; <code>stop_grace_period</code>/<code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code> ni ilovaning haqiqiy shutdown vaqtiga moslang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31392	<p>Docker network turlari: bridge, host, none, overlay. Container'lar bir-birini qanday topadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>bridge</b> — default, har container o'z private IP'si, tashqariga NAT. <b>host</b> — container host tarmog'ini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatadi. <b>none</b> — faqat loopback. <b>overlay</b> — bir necha host'dagi container'larni bitta virtual tarmoqqa ulaydi (Swarm). Container'lar bir-birini <b>user-defined</b> tarmoqda nom bo'yicha (Docker DNS) topadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>host<br> +-- docker0 / br-xxxx (bridge, 172.18.0.1)<br> |     +-- veth -- api (172.18.0.2)<br> |     +-- veth -- db  (172.18.0.3)<br> +-- eth0 ---- tashqi tarmoq (NAT/MASQUERADE)<br>Docker DNS 127.0.0.11: &quot;db&quot; -&gt; 172.18.0.3</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker network create app<br>docker run -d --network app --name db -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=x postgres:17<br>docker run --rm --network app alpine ping -c1 db     # nom ishlaydi<br>docker run --rm alpine ping -c1 db                   # default bridge: bad address<br>docker network inspect app --format '{{range .Containers}}{{.Name}} {{.IPv4Address}}{{&quot;\n&quot;}}{{end}}'</pre><p>| Tur | Izolyatsiya | Ishlatish | |---|---|---| | bridge (default) | bor, DNS yo'q | tez sinov | | user-defined bridge | bor, DNS bor | bir host'dagi servislar | | host | yo'q | maksimal tarmoq tezligi (faqat Linux) | | none | to'liq | batch, xavfsiz ishlov | | overlay | VXLAN | Swarm, ko'p host | | macvlan | fizik tarmoqda MAC | eski tizimlar, L2 kerak |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default <code>bridge</code> da nom bo'yicha topish yo'q — eski <code>--link</code> deprecated.</li><li><code>--network host</code> da <code>-p</code> e'tiborsiz qoldiriladi; port to'qnashuvi bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Docker subnet'i ofis/VPN tarmog'i bilan kesishishi (172.17.0.0/16).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Compose avtomatik user-defined tarmoq yaratadi — servis nomi = DNS nomi. Ko'p host uchun bugun overlay o'rniga odatda Kubernetes CNI (Cilium, Calico) ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31393	<p><code>docker stop</code> va <code>docker kill</code> farqi? Restart policy'lar?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker stop</code> — avval SIGTERM yuboradi, belgilangan vaqt (default 10s) kutadi, keyin SIGKILL. <code>docker kill</code> — darhol SIGKILL (exit 137). Restart policy (<code>no</code>, <code>on-failure</code>, <code>always</code>, <code>unless-stopped</code>) container o'lganda Docker uni qayta ishga tushiradimi-yo'qligini belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> <code>stop</code> ilovaga graceful shutdown imkonini beradi: DB ulanishlarini yopish, joriy so'rovlarni tugatish. <code>kill</code> — elektrni o'chirganday: yozilayotgan ma'lumot buzilishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker stop -t 30:  SIGTERM ---(30s kutadi)---&gt; SIGKILL (agar hali tirik)<br>docker kill:        SIGKILL (darhol, ushlab bo'lmaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker stop -t 30 api           # 30s grace<br>docker kill api                 # darhol<br>docker kill -s SIGHUP nginx     # boshqa signal (konfig reload)<br>docker run -d --restart on-failure:5 api<br>docker update --restart unless-stopped api<br>docker inspect api --format '{{.RestartCount}} {{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}'</pre><p>Dockerfile'da: <code>STOPSIGNAL SIGQUIT</code> (masalan nginx graceful uchun).</p><p>| Policy | Qachon qayta ishga tushadi | |---|---| | <code>no</code> | hech qachon (default) | | <code>on-failure[:N]</code> | exit code != 0 bo'lsa, N martagacha | | <code>always</code> | har doim; qo'lda stop qilinsa ham daemon restart'dan keyin ko'tariladi | | <code>unless-stopped</code> | always kabi, lekin qo'lda to'xtatilgani to'xtagan holda qoladi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova SIGTERM'ni ushlamasa — <code>stop</code> ham baribir 10s kutib SIGKILL bilan tugaydi.</li><li><code>always</code> bilan crash-loop container — log va CPU'ni to'ldiradi; Docker backoff qiladi, lekin muammoni yashiradi.</li><li><code>on-failure</code> exit 0 bilan tugaganda qayta ishga tushirmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Server'dagi standalone servislar uchun <code>unless-stopped</code> amaliy default. <code>RestartCount</code> o'syotgan bo'lsa alert qo'ying — restart policy muammoni hal qilmaydi, faqat yashiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31394	<p>Container ichida nima bo'layotganini qanday debug qilasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tartib: <code>docker ps -a</code> (holat va exit code) -&gt; <code>docker logs</code> -&gt; <code>docker inspect</code> (exit code, OOMKilled, health) -&gt; <code>docker stats</code>/<code>events</code> -&gt; <code>docker exec</code> bilan ichiga kirish. Shell yo'q bo'lsa — <code>docker debug</code> yoki boshqa container'ni bir xil namespace'larga ulash (netshoot).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Container ishlamayapti&quot; — juda keng. Avval holatni aniqlang: umuman start bo'lmaydimi, o'lib qolyaptimi, yoki ishlayapti lekin noto'g'ri javob beryaptimi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (qaror daraxti):</b></p><pre>docker ps -a<br> +-- Exited(N)  -&gt; logs + inspect ExitCode/OOMKilled<br> +-- Restarting -&gt; logs --previous emas, events: die<br> +-- Up         -&gt; exec / stats / netshoot</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker ps -a --filter name=api<br>docker logs --tail 100 -f api<br>docker inspect api --format 'exit={{.State.ExitCode}} oom={{.State.OOMKilled}} err={{.State.Error}}'<br>docker stats --no-stream api<br>docker events --since 30m --filter container=api<br>docker exec -it api sh<br>docker cp api:/etc/app.yaml ./app.yaml<br># shell yo'q (distroless):<br>docker run -it --rm --pid=container:api --network=container:api nicolaka/netshoot<br>docker debug api            # Docker Desktop / Pro</pre><p>| Exit code | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | 0 | normal tugadi (jarayon tugab qolgan) | | 1 | ilova xatosi | | 137 | SIGKILL (ko'pincha OOM) | | 139 | segfault | | 143 | SIGTERM |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konfig muammosini <code>exec</code> ichida qo'lda tuzatish — keyingi restart'da yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>logs</code> bo'sh — ilova faylga yozyapti.</li><li>Container o'lgani uchun <code>exec</code> ishlamaydi — <code>docker run --entrypoint sh -it &lt;image&gt;</code> bilan image'ni tekshiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Debug imkonini oldindan loyihalang: strukturali log'lar stdout'ga, <code>/healthz</code>, metrics endpoint. Production'da container ichiga kirish — oxirgi chora, asosiy ma'lumot observability'dan kelishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33071	<p>Docker HEALTHCHECK qanday ishlaydi va nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>HEALTHCHECK</code> — Docker container ichida vaqti-vaqti bilan buyruq bajarib, ilova haqiqatan ishlayotganini tekshiradi. Natija: <code>starting</code> -&gt; <code>healthy</code> / <code>unhealthy</code>. Bu &quot;jarayon tirik&quot; bilan &quot;ilova so'rovga javob beryapti&quot; orasidagi farqni ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Jarayon ishlayapti, lekin deadlock yoki DB ulanishi uzilgan — <code>docker ps</code> &quot;Up&quot; deydi, foydalanuvchi esa 502 oladi. Healthcheck buni aniqlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>start --start-period(20s)--&gt; har 10s: CMD<br>   exit 0 -&gt; healthy<br>   exit 1 x retries(3) -&gt; unhealthy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --start-period=20s --retries=3 \<br>  CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/healthz || exit 1</pre><pre>docker ps                      # STATUS: Up 2 min (healthy)<br>docker inspect --format '{{json .State.Health}}' api | jq<br># Status, FailingStreak, Log[] (oxirgi tekshiruvlar chiqishi)</pre><p>Compose'da:</p><pre>depends_on:<br>  db:<br>    condition: service_healthy</pre><p><b>Kim nima qiladi:</b> | Muhit | unhealthy bo'lsa | |---|---| | Standalone Docker | faqat status, restart <b>yo'q</b> | | Compose | <code>depends_on</code> kutadi | | Swarm | container almashtiriladi | | Kubernetes | HEALTHCHECK e'tiborsiz — liveness/readiness probe |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Distroless'da <code>curl</code>/<code>wget</code> yo'q — ilovaga <code>-healthcheck</code> flag qo'shing yoki statik binary.</li><li>Healthcheck DB'ni ham tekshiradi — DB sekinlashsa hamma container unhealthy (kaskad).</li><li><code>start-period</code> qisqa — sekin start qiladigan ilova doim unhealthy.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Liveness — &quot;o'zim ishlayapmanmi&quot; (dependency tekshirmaydi), readiness — &quot;trafik qabul qila olamanmi&quot;. Bu ikkisini aralashtirish production'da kaskad restart'larga olib keladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33072	<p>Container resurs limitlari: <code>--memory</code>, <code>--cpus</code>, <code>--pids-limit</code>. Limit oshsa nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--memory</code> — RAM chegarasi (oshsa kernel OOM killer jarayonni o'ldiradi, exit 137). <code>--cpus</code> — CPU vaqti kvotasi (oshsa throttling — sekinlashadi, o'lmaydi). <code>--pids-limit</code> — jarayon/thread soni chegarasi (oshsa <code>fork</code> xato qaytaradi). Hammasi cgroup orqali ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Limitsiz container memory leak bilan host'ning butun RAM'ini yeydi va qo'shni servislar (yoki dockerd o'zi) o'ladi. Fork bomb bitta container'dan butun host'ni qotiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>--memory=512m  -&gt; memory.max     -&gt; oshsa: OOM kill (137)<br>--cpus=1.5     -&gt; cpu.max 150000/100000 -&gt; oshsa: throttle (kutadi)<br>--pids-limit   -&gt; pids.max       -&gt; oshsa: fork EAGAIN</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d --name api \<br>  --memory=512m --memory-swap=512m \<br>  --cpus=1.5 --pids-limit=200 \<br>  -e GOMEMLIMIT=460MiB myapi<br>docker stats --no-stream api<br>docker inspect api --format '{{.State.OOMKilled}}'<br>docker exec api cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat     # nr_throttled</pre><p><code>--memory-swap</code> = <code>--memory</code> — swap'ga chiqishni taqiqlaydi (bashorat qilinadigan xatti-harakat).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Runtime limitni bilmaydi: Go'da <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> (limitdan ~10% past), JVM'da <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75</code>.</li><li>CPU throttling p99 latency'ni buzadi, o'rtacha CPU esa past ko'rinadi.</li><li><code>/dev/shm</code> va tmpfs ham memory limitiga hisoblanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Memory limit — majburiy (himoya). CPU limit — munozarali: latency-sensitive servisda ko'pincha faqat reservation qo'yiladi. Limitni taxmin bilan emas, yuk ostidagi peak o'lchovi asosida qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33073	<p>Docker logging: log qayerga yoziladi, disk to'lib qolishining oldini qanday olasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Default <code>json-file</code> driver har container log'ini <code>/var/lib/docker/containers/&lt;id&gt;/&lt;id&gt;-json.log</code> ga yozadi va <b>cheklovsiz</b> o'sadi. Oldini olish: <code>daemon.json</code> da <code>max-size</code>/<code>max-file</code> bilan rotatsiya yoki <code>local</code> driver; markaziy log tizimiga yuborish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Debug log yoqilgan servis bir hafta ichida 40 GB log yozdi, disk 100% — Docker yangi container yarata olmaydi, DB yozolmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app stdout/stderr -&gt; dockerd -&gt; log driver<br>                                 +-- json-file / local  (diskda, docker logs ishlaydi)<br>                                 +-- journald, fluentd, gelf, awslogs</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;log-driver&quot;: &quot;local&quot;,<br>  &quot;log-opts&quot;: { &quot;max-size&quot;: &quot;10m&quot;, &quot;max-file&quot;: &quot;3&quot; }<br>}</pre><pre>sudo vi /etc/docker/daemon.json<br>sudo systemctl restart docker<br>docker inspect api --format '{{.HostConfig.LogConfig}}'<br>du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log | sort -h | tail<br>docker run --log-opt max-size=50m --log-opt max-file=5 api   # bitta container uchun</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>daemon.json</code> o'zgarishi faqat <b>yangi</b> container'larga ta'sir qiladi — eskilarini qayta yaratish kerak.</li><li>Ilova faylga yozsa (<code>/var/log/app.log</code>) — container layer'i o'sadi va <code>docker logs</code> bo'sh.</li><li>Log faylini <code>rm</code> qilish — dockerd fayl deskriptorini ushlab turadi, joy bo'shamaydi; <code>truncate -s 0</code> ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 12-factor: ilova faqat stdout'ga, strukturali (JSON) log yozadi. Agent (Fluent Bit, Vector, Alloy) log'larni Loki/Elastic'ga yuboradi; lokal rotatsiya — faqat bufer. Disk 80% bo'lganda alert bo'lishi shart.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33074	<p><code>docker system df</code> 80 GB ko'rsatyapti. Disk nima bilan to'ladi va qanday tozalaysan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Odatda disk to'ladiganlar: ishlatilmayotgan image'lar, build cache, to'xtagan container'lar, rotatsiyasiz log'lar va yetim (dangling) volume'lar. Avval <code>docker system df -v</code> bilan aniqlang, keyin turi bo'yicha xavfsizdan xavfliga qarab tozalang.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI runner yoki server'da <code>/var/lib/docker</code> 80 GB. Ko'r-ko'rona <code>prune -a --volumes</code> qilish — DB ma'lumotini o'chirib yuborish xavfi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (tozalash tartibi):</b></p><pre>1. tahlil      docker system df -v<br>2. xavfsiz     container prune, image prune (dangling), builder prune<br>3. o'rta       image prune -a --filter until=...<br>4. xavfli      volume prune  (avval ko'rib chiqing!)<br>5. log         json-log truncate + rotatsiya sozlash</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker system df<br># TYPE           TOTAL  ACTIVE  SIZE     RECLAIMABLE<br># Images         84     12      41.2GB   35.0GB (84%)<br># Build Cache    310    0       22.5GB   22.5GB<br>docker system df -v<br>docker container prune -f<br>docker image prune -f                          # &lt;none&gt; image'lar<br>docker image prune -a --filter &quot;until=168h&quot;    # 7 kundan eski, ishlatilmayotgan<br>docker builder prune --keep-storage 10GB<br>docker volume ls -f dangling=true              # avval ro'yxat!<br>du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log | sort -h | tail</pre><p><code>RECLAIMABLE</code> ustuni — qancha joy bo'shatish mumkinligini ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>volume prune</code> — to'xtatilgan DB container'ining volume'i ham &quot;dangling&quot; bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li><code>/var/lib/docker</code> ichidan qo'lda <code>rm -rf</code> — Docker metadata buziladi.</li><li>Log <code>du</code> da ko'rinmasa — o'chirilgan lekin ochiq fayl (<code>lsof +L1</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI runner'larda cron/systemd timer bilan <code>builder prune --keep-storage</code> va <code>image prune --filter until=</code> ni avtomatlashtiring. <code>/var/lib/docker</code> ni alohida disk/partition'ga qo'ying — to'lsa OS buzilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33075	<p><code>docker build</code> context nima, <code>.dockerignore</code> nega kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Build context — <code>docker build</code> ga berilgan papka (odatda <code>.</code>); uning butun mazmuni BuildKit'ga yuboriladi va <code>COPY</code> faqat shu ichidan fayl ola oladi. <code>.dockerignore</code> keraksiz va maxfiy fayllarni context'dan chiqaradi: build tezlashadi, cache barqaror bo'ladi, secret image'ga tushmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>docker build .</code> &quot;Sending build context 2.3GB&quot; deb 1 daqiqa turadi — <code>node_modules</code>, <code>.git</code>, dataset'lar yuborilyapti. Bundan yomoni: <code>COPY . .</code> <code>.env</code> faylni image'ga qo'shib yuboradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker build -f docker/Dockerfile .<br>                                  ^ context (papka)<br>context - .dockerignore --&gt; BuildKit --&gt; COPY shu ichidan oladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># .dockerignore<br>.git<br>node_modules<br>dist<br>*.log<br>.env<br>.env.*<br>**/*.pem<br>Dockerfile*<br>docker-compose*.yml</pre><pre>docker build -t app .<br>docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.prod -t app:prod .   # Dockerfile boshqa joyda<br>docker build -t app https://github.com/acme/app.git#main  # git context</pre><p>Context'da nima borligini tekshirish:</p><pre>FROM busybox<br>COPY . /ctx<br>RUN find /ctx -maxdepth 2 | head -50</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.git</code> context'da — har commit <code>COPY . .</code> cache'ni buzadi.</li><li><code>COPY ../shared .</code> — context'dan tashqari, ishlamaydi; context'ni yuqoriroq papkaga ko'taring.</li><li><code>.dockerignore</code> faqat context ildizida o'qiladi (yoki <code>Dockerfile.dockerignore</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Allowlist yondashuvi xavfsizroq: <code>*</code> bilan hammasini chiqarib, <code>!src</code>, <code>!go.mod</code> bilan keraklisini qo'shing — yangi maxfiy fayl tasodifan image'ga kirmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33365	<p>Container ishga tushib darhol to'xtaydi (<code>Exited (0)</code> yoki <code>Exited (1)</code>). Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33366	<p>Container ichidagi app <code>localhost:5432</code> dagi DB'ga ulana olmayapti, host'da esa ishlaydi. Nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container o'z network namespace'ida ishlaydi, shuning uchun uning ichidagi <code>localhost</code> — container'ning o'zi, host emas. DB host'da <code>127.0.0.1:5432</code> da tinglayapti — container undan &quot;connection refused&quot; oladi. Yechim: DB'ga Docker DNS nomi yoki <code>host.docker.internal</code> orqali ulanish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>host netns:       postgres 127.0.0.1:5432<br>                     ^<br>                     x  (bu boshqa localhost)<br>container netns:  app -&gt; localhost:5432 -&gt; container o'zi -&gt; refused</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># 1. Host'dagi servisga container'dan ulanish odatda vaqtinchalik holat; uzoq muddatda DB'ni managed servis yoki alohida host'ga chiqaring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33367	<p>Image'dagi zaifliklarni qanday topasiz va CI'da qanday to'xtatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Image'ni Trivy, Grype yoki Docker Scout bilan skanerlaysiz — ular OS paketlari va ilova dependency'larini CVE bazasi bilan solishtiradi. CI'da skaner <code>--exit-code 1</code> bilan HIGH/CRITICAL topilganda pipeline'ni yiqitadi, shunda zaif image registry'ga chiqmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Base image'dagi eski <code>openssl</code> yoki <code>log4j</code> kritik zaiflik bilan prod'ga chiqib ketadi va buni hech kim bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build -&gt; image -&gt; trivy (paketlar ro'yxati + CVE DB)<br>                    +-- CRITICAL/HIGH (fix bor) -&gt; exit 1 -&gt; pipeline to'xtaydi<br>                    +-- qolganlari -&gt; report</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 registry/api:1.4.0</pre><p>Chiqish:</p><pre>registry/api:1.4.0 (debian 12.5)<br>Total: 2 (HIGH: 1, CRITICAL: 1)<br>| Library | Vulnerability  | Severity | Installed | Fixed   |<br>| libssl3 | CVE-2024-XXXX  | CRITICAL | 3.0.11-1  | 3.0.13-1|</pre><p><code>Fixed</code> ustuni — qaysi versiyaga yangilash kerakligini aytadi.</p><pre># GitHub Actions<br>- uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0<br>  with:<br>    image-ref: registry/api:${{ github.sha }}<br>    severity: HIGH,CRITICAL<br>    ignore-unfixed: true<br>    exit-code: &quot;1&quot;</pre><p>Istisno <code>.trivyignore</code> da sabab bilan:</p><pre># CVE-2024-XXXX: kod yo'li ishlatilmaydi, 2026-12-01 gacha<br>CVE-2024-XXXX</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--ignore-unfixed</code> siz — tuzatib bo'lmaydigan CVE'lar pipeline'ni doim bloklaydi va jamoa skanerni o'chiradi.</li><li>Faqat build paytida skanerlash — ertaga yangi CVE chiqadi, prod image'lar qayta skanerlanmaydi.</li><li>Base image yangilandi, lekin sizning image avtomatik rebuild bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Gate + muntazamlik: CI'da blok, registry'da kunlik qayta skan, haftalik avtomatik rebuild (Renovate/Dependabot base image digest'ini yangilaydi). Minimal base (distroless) CVE sonini keskin kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33418	<p>Zombie process nima va container'da nega <code>tini</code> / <code>--init</code> kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zombie — tugagan, lekin ota-jarayoni <code>wait()</code> qilib exit status'ini yig'magan jarayon (<code>&lt;defunct&gt;</code>). Container'da ilova PID 1 bo'ladi, PID 1 esa orphan jarayonlarni &quot;asrab oladi&quot; va ularni yig'ishi kerak. Oddiy ilova buni qilmaydi — zombie'lar to'planadi. <code>tini</code> / <code>docker run --init</code> — kichik init: zombie'larni yig'adi va signallarni ilovaga uzatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><ul><li>PID 1 uchun kernel default signal handler qo'ymaydi — ilova SIGTERM'ni o'zi ushlamasa, <code>docker stop</code> 10s kutib SIGKILL beradi.</li><li>Shell script, Node/Python child process, headless Chrome — orphan'lar PID 1'ga o'tadi; yig'ilmasa PID limit tugaydi: <code>fork: Resource temporarily unavailable</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>tini'siz:   PID1 app -- child (tugadi) -&gt; &lt;defunct&gt; qoladi<br>tini bilan: PID1 tini -- PID2 app -- child (tugadi) -&gt; tini wait() qiladi<br>            SIGTERM -&gt; tini -&gt; app</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run --init myimage                   # Docker o'zi docker-init (tini) qo'shadi<br>docker exec &lt;id&gt; ps -ef | grep defunct      # zombie bormi</pre><pre>RUN apk add --no-cache tini<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/sbin/tini&quot;, &quot;--&quot;]<br>CMD [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><p>Compose: <code>init: true</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;sh&quot;,&quot;-c&quot;,&quot;/app&quot;]</code> — sh PID 1, signal ham, zombie ham muammo.</li><li>tini qo'shib, ilovada SIGTERM handler yozmaslik — signal yetadi, lekin graceful shutdown baribir yo'q.</li><li>Kubernetes'da <code>shareProcessNamespace: true</code> bo'lsa pause container PID 1 bo'lib zombie'larni yig'adi; aks holda muammo o'sha.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Child ochmaydigan va SIGTERM'ni ushlaydigan Go binary'ga tini shart emas. Lekin entrypoint script yoki subprocess ishlatadigan har qanday image'da <code>--init</code> arzon sug'urta.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33419	<p><code>/var/run/docker.sock</code>'ni container'ga mount qilish va <code>--privileged</code> nega xavfli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code> — Docker API. Unga kirishi bor container istalgan container'ni istalgan parametr bilan yarata oladi, masalan host'ning <code>/</code> papkasini mount qilib — bu amalda host root. <code>--privileged</code> esa barcha capability'larni beradi, <code>/dev</code> ni ochadi va seccomp/AppArmor'ni o'chiradi — container'dan host'ga chiqish bir necha buyruq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI agent yoki monitoring tool &quot;qulaylik uchun&quot; docker.sock bilan ishga tushirilgan. Undagi zaiflik yoki zararli dependency butun host'ni egallaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>container (docker.sock mount) -&gt; docker API -&gt; yangi container:<br>   -v /:/host --privileged -&gt; chroot /host -&gt; host root shell</pre><p><b>Amalda (hujum ko'rinishi, faqat test muhitda):</b></p><pre>docker run -it -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock docker:cli sh<br># ichida:<br>docker run -it --rm -v /:/host alpine chroot /host sh    # host root</pre><p>Tekshirish:</p><pre>docker ps -q | xargs docker inspect --format '{{.Name}} priv={{.HostConfig.Privileged}} {{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} {{end}}' | grep -E 'priv=true|docker.sock'</pre><p>| Narsa | Nima beradi | Alternativa | |---|---|---| | <code>docker.sock</code> mount | host root | CI: BuildKit rootless / Buildah; monitoring: read-only socket proxy | | <code>--privileged</code> | barcha capability, <code>/dev</code> | <code>--cap-add NET_ADMIN</code> (faqat kerakli) | | <code>--pid=host</code>, <code>--network=host</code> | host jarayon/tarmoq | kerak bo'lsa alohida node | | <code>hostPath: /</code> (K8s) | host FS | PVC, ConfigMap |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Socket'ni <code>:ro</code> mount qilish himoya qilmaydi — API so'rovlari baribir ishlaydi.</li><li><code>docker</code> guruhiga user qo'shish ham = root huquqi.</li><li>&quot;Faqat ichki tool&quot; deb privileged qoldirish — supply chain hujumi aynan shu yerga tushadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kubernetes'da Pod Security Admission <code>baseline</code>/<code>restricted</code> privileged va hostPath'ni bloklaydi; Kyverno/Gatekeeper bilan qo'shimcha siyosat. Socket kerak bo'lsa — <code>tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy</code> kabi faqat kerakli endpoint'larni ochadigan proxy.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33420	<p>Docker'ni ishlatmasdan CI'da (Kubernetes runner'da) image qanday build qilinadi? Kaniko, BuildKit, Buildah?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes runner'da Docker daemon yo'q (va DinD privileged talab qiladi). Daemon'siz builder'lar ishlatiladi: <b>BuildKit</b> (rootless rejimda), <b>Buildah</b>/Podman, ilgari <b>Kaniko</b>. Ular Dockerfile'ni o'qib, image'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri registry'ga push qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI pod'ida <code>docker build</code> — &quot;Cannot connect to the Docker daemon&quot;. DinD (<code>docker:dind</code>) ishlatish uchun <code>privileged: true</code> kerak — bu node'ni xavf ostiga qo'yadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CI pod (privileged yo'q)<br>  buildkitd/buildah (rootless, user namespace)<br>     Dockerfile -&gt; layer'lar -&gt; registry push<br>     cache &lt;-&gt; registry (type=registry)</pre><p><b>Amalda (BuildKit rootless):</b></p><pre># GitLab CI<br>build:<br>  image: moby/buildkit:rootless<br>  variables:<br>    BUILDKITD_FLAGS: --oci-worker-no-process-sandbox<br>  script:<br>    - buildctl-daemonless.sh build<br>        --frontend dockerfile.v0<br>        --local context=. --local dockerfile=.<br>        --output type=image,name=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA,push=true<br>        --export-cache type=registry,ref=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:cache<br>        --import-cache type=registry,ref=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:cache</pre><p>Buildah:</p><pre>buildah bud -t registry/app:$SHA . &amp;&amp; buildah push registry/app:$SHA</pre><p>| Vosita | Xususiyat | |---|---| | DinD | oddiy, lekin privileged | | Kaniko | daemon'siz; 2025 da upstream arxivlangan (Chainguard fork bor) | | BuildKit rootless | tez, cache mount, multi-arch | | Buildah / Podman | daemon'siz, rootless, Red Hat ekotizimi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rootless BuildKit ham ba'zi kernel sozlamalarini talab qiladi (user namespace, seccomp/AppArmor unconfined).</li><li>Remote cache'siz har build noldan — juda sekin.</li><li>Registry credential'ni image'ga yoki log'ga chiqarib yuborish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi loyihada Kaniko emas, BuildKit (yoki boshqariladigan builder: Docker Build Cloud, GitHub hosted runner). Build pod'larini alohida node pool'da izolyatsiya qiling.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-33461	<p>Container'ni read-only rejimda qanday ishga tushirasiz va nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker run --read-only</code> container'ning root fayl tizimini faqat o'qish uchun qiladi; yozish kerak bo'lgan papkalarga (<code>/tmp</code>, cache) tmpfs yoki volume beriladi. Nega: hujumchi container'ga kirsa ham binary'larni almashtira, backdoor yoki skript yozib qo'ya olmaydi, va container doim image'dagi holatda qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> RCE zaifligi orqali hujumchi <code>/app</code> ga web-shell yozdi. Read-only rootfs'da bu <code>Read-only file system</code> xatosi bilan tugaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/            RO (image)<br>/tmp         tmpfs RW (RAM, 64MB)<br>/var/lib/app volume RW<br>qolgan har qanday yozish -&gt; EROFS</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d --read-only \<br>  --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=64m \<br>  -v app-data:/var/lib/app \<br>  --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges \<br>  --user 10001 myapp:1.4.0<br>docker exec &lt;id&gt; touch /x     # touch: /x: Read-only file system</pre><pre># Kubernetes<br>securityContext:<br>  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true<br>  runAsNonRoot: true<br>  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>volumeMounts: [{ name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp }]<br>volumes: [{ name: tmp, emptyDir: { medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 64Mi } }]</pre><p><b>Qanday joriy qilish:</b> container'ni oddiy ishga tushiring, <code>docker diff &lt;id&gt;</code> bilan qaysi papkalarga yozayotganini ko'ring, faqat o'shalarga tmpfs/volume bering.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova <code>/tmp</code>, <code>~/.cache</code>, PID fayl yoki nginx <code>/var/cache/nginx</code> ga yozadi — start'da yiqiladi.</li><li>Memory tmpfs container memory limitiga kiradi.</li><li>Ilova runtime'da konfig yozsa (<code>envsubst &gt; /etc/...</code>) — uni init bosqichiga yoki emptyDir'ga ko'chiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>--read-only</code> + non-root + <code>--cap-drop ALL</code> + <code>no-new-privileges</code> — arzon va kuchli baseline. Policy (PSA restricted, Kyverno) bilan majburiy qiling, istisnolarni hujjatlashtiring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-30029	<p>Go servis uchun production Docker image qanday qurilishi kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> To'g'ri qurilish: multi-stage. Build bosqichida <code>CGO_ENABLED=0</code>, <code>-trimpath</code>, <code>-ldflags &quot;-s -w -X main.version=...&quot;</code>, dependency'lar alohida layer'da. Runtime bosqichi — <code>distroless/static:nonroot</code> yoki <code>scratch</code> (CA sertifikat va tzdata bilan), non-root user, read-only rootfs.</p><p><b>Nega:</b> <code>golang</code> image'i bilan deploy — 1 GB, shell, kompilyator, yuzlab CVE. Statik Go binary hech narsaga muhtoj emas — runtime image bir necha MB bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>golang:1.25 (build)                  distroless/static:nonroot<br> go mod download (cache)               /app (statik binary)<br> go build CGO=0 -trimpath  --COPY--&gt;   CA certs, tzdata, nonroot user</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># syntax=docker/dockerfile:1<br>FROM golang:1.25 AS build<br>WORKDIR /src<br>COPY go.mod go.sum ./<br>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod go mod download<br>COPY . .<br>ARG VERSION=dev<br>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \<br>    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \<br>    CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath \<br>    -ldflags=&quot;-s -w -X main.version=${VERSION}&quot; -o /out/app ./cmd/api<br><br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot<br>COPY --from=build /out/app /app<br>USER nonroot:nonroot<br>EXPOSE 8080<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><pre>docker build --build-arg VERSION=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) -t api .<br>docker run --read-only --cap-drop ALL -p 8080:8080 api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>scratch</code> da CA sertifikat yo'q — <code>x509: certificate signed by unknown authority</code>; tzdata yo'q — <code>time.LoadLocation</code> xato (yoki <code>import _ &quot;time/tzdata&quot;</code>).</li><li>CGO yoqilgan binary scratch'da &quot;no such file or directory&quot; (dinamik linker yo'q).</li><li><code>GOMEMLIMIT</code>/<code>GOMAXPROCS</code> ni container limitiga moslamaslik (Go 1.25+ GOMAXPROCS'ni avtomatik sozlaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Distroless scratch'dan yaxshiroq default: sertifikat, tzdata va nonroot user tayyor. Debug uchun <code>:debug</code> tag yoki ephemeral container. Image'ni digest bilan imzolab (cosign) SBOM qo'shing.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31395	<p>Docker container izolyatsiyasi qanday qurilgan va u VM'dek xavfsizmi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container izolyatsiyasi kernel mexanizmlaridan yig'ilgan: <b>namespace</b> (nimani ko'radi), <b>cgroups</b> (qancha resurs ishlatadi), <b>capabilities</b> (root huquqining qaysi qismi), <b>seccomp</b> (qaysi syscall'lar), <b>AppArmor/SELinux</b> (MAC). U VM darajasida xavfsiz emas: kernel umumiy, kernel zaifligi = container escape.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>container jarayoni<br>  | namespace: pid, net, mnt, uts, ipc, user, cgroup<br>  | cgroups:   memory, cpu, pids<br>  | caps:      ~14 ta default (CAP_SYS_ADMIN yo'q)<br>  | seccomp:   ~44 syscall bloklangan<br>  | LSM:       docker-default AppArmor profili<br>  v<br> HOST KERNEL (umumiy)  &lt;- VM'da bu qatlam alohida</pre><p><b>Amalda (hardening):</b></p><pre>docker run -d \<br>  --user 10001 --read-only --tmpfs /tmp \<br>  --cap-drop ALL --cap-add NET_BIND_SERVICE \<br>  --security-opt no-new-privileges \<br>  --pids-limit 200 --memory 512m \<br>  myapp@sha256:...<br>docker inspect &lt;id&gt; --format '{{.HostConfig.CapAdd}} {{.HostConfig.SecurityOpt}}'<br>grep Cap /proc/$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' &lt;id&gt;)/status</pre><p><b>Izolyatsiyani buzadigan narsalar:</b> | Flag | Xavf | |---|---| | <code>--privileged</code> | hamma himoya o'chadi | | <code>-v /var/run/docker.sock</code> | host root | | <code>--pid=host</code>, <code>--network=host</code> | host jarayon/tarmoq | | <code>--cap-add SYS_ADMIN</code> | deyarli privileged |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Container ichida root = host kernel uchun UID 0 (userns bo'lmasa).</li><li>Kernel yangilanmagan host — Dirty Pipe kabi CVE'lar bilan escape.</li><li>Seccomp'ni <code>unconfined</code> qilish &quot;ishlamayapti&quot; muammosini tuzatish uchun.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Begona kod (multi-tenant, CI, serverless) uchun kuchliroq chegara: gVisor (user-space kernel), Kata/Firecracker (microVM). O'z kodingiz uchun hardening + rootless/userns + tez kernel patching yetarli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-31396	<p>Docker arxitekturasi: docker CLI, dockerd, containerd, runc qanday bog'langan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker</code> CLI — faqat klient, Unix socket orqali REST API bilan <b>dockerd</b> ga murojaat qiladi. dockerd image build, tarmoq, volume'ni boshqaradi va container ishga tushirishni gRPC orqali <b>containerd</b> ga topshiradi. containerd har container uchun <b>containerd-shim</b> ochadi, shim esa <b>runc</b> ni chaqiradi; containerd-shim-runc-v2 --&gt; runc --&gt; process<br>                                       ^ jarayonning otasi bo'lib qoladi</pre><p><b>Nega shunday bo'lingan:</b></p><ul><li>runc OCI standartiga mos, kichik va qisqa yashaydi.</li><li>shim jarayonning otasi — dockerd yoki containerd restart bo'lsa ham container yashaydi (<code>live-restore</code>).</li><li>containerd mustaqil — Kubernetes uni Docker'siz ishlatadi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker info | grep -iE 'runtime|containerd|runc'<br>ps -ef --forest | grep -A2 containerd-shim<br>sudo ctr -n moby containers ls        # Docker container'lari containerd'da<br>sudo crictl ps                        # K8s node'da (CRI)</pre><p><b>OCI:</b> image spec + runtime spec + distribution spec — shuning uchun Docker'da build qilingan image Podman, containerd, CRI-O'da ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Kubernetes Docker'ni qo'llamaydi, image'larimni qayta qurishim kerak&quot;
