Server: Docker Engine ...<br>systemctl status docker   # daemon holati<br>ls -l /var/run/docker.sock<br># srw-rw---- 1 root docker ... /var/run/docker.sock<br>curl --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock http://localhost/containers/json   # API to'g'ridan-to'g'ri<br>DOCKER_HOST=ssh://deploy@server docker ps<br>docker context create prod --docker host=ssh://deploy@server &amp;&amp; docker context use prod</pre><p><code>Cannot connect to the Docker daemon</code> — daemon ishlamayapti yoki socket'ga ruxsat yo'q.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>docker</code> guruhiga user qo'shish = amalda root huquqi (istalgan host papkani mount qila oladi).</li><li>Socket'ni konteynerga mount qilish — o'sha konteyner host root.</li><li>Daemon'ni TCP'da TLS'siz ochish (<code>-H tcp://0.0.0.0:2375</code>) — internetdan to'liq boshqaruv.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Masofaviy boshqaruv uchun <code>docker context</code> + SSH. Daemon root bo'lishi xavf manbai — kerak bo'lsa rootless Docker yoki Podman.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34158	<p>Rootless Docker va Podman nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Rootless Docker</b> — dockerd ham, konteynerlar ham oddiy (root bo'lmagan) user nomidan ishlaydi. <b>Podman</b> — Docker'ga mos CLI, lekin daemon'siz va default'da rootless. Ikkalasining maqsadi: konteyner escape bo'lsa ham hujumchi host'da root bo'lmasin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy Docker:  dockerd (root) -&gt; konteyner root = host root<br>Rootless:      dockerd (user 1000) -&gt; konteyner root = host'da 100000 (huquqsiz)<br>Podman:        podman (user) -&gt; fork/exec -&gt; konteyner (daemon yo'q)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Rootless Docker<br>dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install<br>export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/docker.sock<br>docker info | grep -i rootless<br><br># Podman<br>podman run -d -p 8080:80 nginx<br>podman ps<br>alias docker=podman            # ko'p buyruqlar bir xil<br>podman generate systemd --name web    # (yangi versiyada Quadlet)</pre><p>| | Docker (root) | Rootless Docker | Podman | |---|---|---|---| | Daemon | root | user | yo'q | | Escape xavfi | host root | huquqsiz user | huquqsiz user | | Compose | bor | bor | <code>podman compose</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>1024 dan past portlar ochilmaydi (sysctl <code>ip_unprivileged_port_start</code> kerak).</li><li>Tarmoq (slirp4netns/pasta) sekinroq, ba'zi rejimlar (macvlan) ishlamaydi.</li><li>Bind mount'larda UID mapping tufayli fayl egalari kutilmagan ko'rinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI runner va ko'p foydalanuvchili serverlar uchun rootless yaxshi default. Podman RHEL/Fedora'da standart va Kubernetes YAML bilan ishlay oladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34159	<p>Docker volume'ni qanday backup qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy usul: vaqtinchalik konteynerga volume'ni va host papkasini ulab, <code>tar</code> bilan arxivlash. Lekin DB volume'i uchun fayl nusxasi emas, DB'ning o'z vositasi (<code>pg_dump</code>, <code>mysqldump</code>) to'g'ri — ishlab turgan DB fayllarining nusxasi buzilgan (inconsistent) bo'lishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>alpine konteyner<br>  /data   &lt;- volume pgdata (o'qish)<br>  /backup &lt;- host papka<br>  tar czf /backup/pgdata.tgz -C /data .</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Backup<br>docker run --rm -v pgdata:/data:ro -v &quot;$PWD&quot;:/backup alpine \<br>  tar czf /backup/pgdata-$(date +%F).tgz -C /data .<br><br># Restore (yangi volume'ga)<br>docker volume create pgdata_new<br>docker run --rm -v pgdata_new:/data -v &quot;$PWD&quot;:/backup alpine \<br>  tar xzf /backup/pgdata-2026-10-03.tgz -C /data<br><br># DB uchun to'g'ri yo'l<br>docker exec db pg_dump -U postgres -Fc mydb &gt; mydb-$(date +%F).dump<br>docker exec -i db pg_restore -U postgres -d mydb &lt; mydb-2026-10-03.dump</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DB ishlab turganda <code>tar</code> — nomuvofiq nusxa; yoki DB'ni to'xtating, yoki <code>pg_dump</code>/snapshot.</li><li>Backup bir xil diskda — disk o'lsa backup ham ketadi; boshqa joyga (S3) ko'chiring.</li><li>Restore hech qachon sinalmagan backup — backup emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Backup strategiyasi: avtomatik jadval, offsite nusxa, retention, va muntazam restore testi. Katta DB uchun PITR (WAL arxivi) — pg_dump yetmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34160	<p>Dockerfile'da <code>WORKDIR</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>WORKDIR /app</code> — keyingi <code>RUN</code>, <code>COPY</code>, <code>CMD</code>, <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> instruksiyalari uchun ishchi papkani belgilaydi; papka yo'q bo'lsa yaratadi. Konteyner ishga tushganda ham shu papkada bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>RUN cd /app</code> yozdingiz, lekin keyingi <code>RUN make</code> ildiz papkada ishladi. Sabab: har <code>RUN</code> alohida shell'da bajariladi, <code>cd</code> keyingi qatorga o'tmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>WORKDIR /app        -&gt; keyingi hamma qadam /app da<br>RUN cd /src &amp;&amp; make -&gt; faqat shu qatorda /src<br>RUN ls              -&gt; yana /app da</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM golang:1.25<br>WORKDIR /src<br>COPY go.mod go.sum ./        # /src/go.mod<br>RUN go mod download<br>COPY . .<br>RUN go build -o /out/server .<br>WORKDIR /app                 # yangi ishchi papka<br>CMD [&quot;/out/server&quot;]</pre><pre>docker run --rm img pwd       # /app<br>docker run --rm -w /tmp img pwd   # runtime'da almashtirish: /tmp</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Nisbiy <code>WORKDIR</code> (<code>WORKDIR app</code>) — oldingi WORKDIR'ga nisbatan; doim absolyut yo'l yozing.</li><li><code>WORKDIR</code> root egaligida yaratiladi — non-root user u yerga yoza olmaydi; <code>chown</code> qiling.</li><li><code>RUN mkdir -p /app &amp;&amp; cd /app</code> — keraksiz, <code>WORKDIR</code> yetarli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>WORKDIR</code> ni aniq va absolyut yozish Dockerfile'ni o'qilishi oson qiladi va <code>COPY . .</code> qayerga tushishini noaniqlikdan qutqaradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34161	<p><code>EXPOSE</code> portni ochadimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yo'q. <code>EXPOSE</code> portni <b>ochmaydi</b> — u faqat hujjat/metadata: &quot;bu konteyner shu portda tinglaydi&quot; deb belgilaydi. Haqiqiy ochish <code>docker run -p</code> bilan bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi boshlovchi <code>EXPOSE 8080</code> yozadi va &quot;nega tashqaridan ulana olmayapman?&quot; deb hayron bo'ladi. Chunki EXPOSE host bilan konteyner portini bog'lamaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>EXPOSE 8080         -&gt; faqat metadata (docker inspect'da ko'rinadi)<br>docker run -p 8080:8080 img   -&gt; host:8080 -&gt; konteyner:8080 (haqiqiy bog'lanish)<br>docker run -P img             -&gt; EXPOSE'dagi hamma portni TASODIFIY host portga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -p 8080:8080 img       # aniq: host 8080 -&gt; konteyner 8080<br>docker run -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 img  # faqat localhost (xavfsizroq)<br>docker run -P img                 # EXPOSE'dagilarni auto port'ga<br>docker port &lt;container&gt;           # qaysi port qayerga bog'langanini ko'r</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>EXPOSE</code> yozib <code>-p</code> unutish — port ochilmaydi.</li><li><code>-p 8080</code> (bitta raqam) <code>-p 8080:8080</code> degani emas; to'liq yoz.</li><li><code>docker-compose</code> da <code>expose:</code> ham faqat konteynerlararo, <code>ports:</code> tashqariga ochadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> EXPOSE'ning foydasi — <code>-P</code> va boshqa tool'lar uchun hujjat; prod'da aniq <code>-p host_ip:port:port</code> yoz, <code>0.0.0.0</code> ga ochishdan ehtiyot bo'l.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34162	<p>Dockerfile'da layer cache qachon buziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Layer cache bitta RUN/COPY/ADD qatori o'zgarsa yoki undan <b>oldingi</b> qatorlardan biri o'zgarsa buziladi — va o'zgargan qatordan keyingi hamma qatorlar qayta ishlaydi. Shuning uchun tez-tez o'zgaradigan narsa Dockerfile oxirida bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har kod o'zgarishida <code>go mod download</code> (yoki <code>npm install</code>) qayta ishlasa — build 5 daqiqa. To'g'ri tartib bilan — 10 soniya.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>COPY go.mod go.sum ./   &lt;- kamdan-kam o'zgaradi -&gt; cache saqlanadi<br>RUN go mod download     &lt;- go.mod o'zgarmasa cache'dan<br>COPY . .                &lt;- har kod o'zgarishida buziladi<br>RUN go build ./...      &lt;- shundan keyin qayta ishlaydi (faqat shu)</pre><p>Agar <code>COPY . .</code> yuqorida bo'lsa — har kod o'zgarishi <code>go mod download</code> ni ham buzadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>COPY go.mod go.sum ./<br>RUN go mod download<br>COPY . .<br>RUN go build -o /app ./...</pre><pre>DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build .    # BuildKit cache'ni yaxshiroq boshqaradi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>COPY . .</code> ni yuqoriga qo'yish — eng ko'p uchraydigan sekin build sababi.</li><li><code>.dockerignore</code> yo'q bo'lsa <code>.git</code>, <code>node_modules</code> COPY'ga kiradi va cache'ni buzadi.</li><li><code>RUN apt-get update</code> ni alohida qatorga qo'yish — eski paket cache'lanadi (install bilan birlashtir).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> BuildKit cache mount (<code>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod</code>) dependency'larni layer'dan tashqarida keshlaydi — CI'da eng tez. Bog'liqlik manifesti (go.mod, package.json) va manbani ajratish — asosiy qoida.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34163	<p>Docker Hub rate limit nima va qanday yechiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Docker Hub anonim (login'siz) pull'larni IP bo'yicha cheklaydi; limitdan oshsa <code>toomanyrequests: You have reached your pull rate limit</code> xatosi. Yechim: <code>docker login</code> qilish, yoki registry mirror / pull-through cache ishlatish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI runner'lar bitta IP'dan yuzlab pull qiladi (NAT ortida jamoa ham) — limit tez tugaydi va build to'xtaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Anonim pull  -&gt; past limit (IP bo'yicha)<br>Autentifikatsiyalangan -&gt; yuqoriroq limit (akkaunt bo'yicha)<br>Mirror/cache -&gt; image bir marta tortiladi, keyin lokaldan -&gt; Hub'ga tegmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker login                       # limitni oshiradi<br># yoki image'ni boshqa registry'dan ol:<br>docker pull public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:latest   # AWS public ECR (limitsiz)</pre><pre>// /etc/docker/daemon.json — registry mirror<br>{ &quot;registry-mirrors&quot;: [&quot;https://mirror.gcr.io&quot;] }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CI'da har job login qilmasa — anonim limit; secret bilan login qadamini qo'sh.</li><li><code>latest</code> ni qayta-qayta pull qilish limitni yeydi; aniq tag + lokal cache.</li><li>Mirror faqat anonim public image'larga ishlaydi, private'ga emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jamoa/CI uchun to'g'ri yechim — ichki pull-through cache (Harbor, ECR pull-through, Artifactory): image bir marta tortiladi, barcha runner lokaldan oladi, Hub limiti va tashqi bog'liqlik kamayadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34164	<p>Image'dagi zaifliklarni qanday tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Image'dagi zaifliklarni (CVE) skaner bilan tekshiramiz: <code>trivy image myapp:1.0</code> yoki <code>docker scout cves myapp:1.0</code>. Ular image ichidagi OS paketlari va til kutubxonalarini ma'lum CVE bazasi bilan solishtiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Base image (masalan eski <code>node:18</code>) o'nlab ma'lum CVE bilan kelishi mumkin — bilmasdan prod'ga chiqarasiz. Skan buni reliz'dan oldin ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>image -&gt; paketlar ro'yxati (apk/apt/go.mod/package.json)<br>      -&gt; CVE bazasi bilan solishtir (NVD, distro advisory)<br>      -&gt; jadval: paket, versiya, CVE, severity, tuzatilgan versiya</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL myapp:1.0<br>docker scout cves myapp:1.0<br>trivy image --exit-code 1 --severity CRITICAL myapp:1.0   # CI gate (fail)</pre><p>Chiqishda <code>Total: 12 (HIGH: 10, CRITICAL: 2)</code> va har CVE uchun &quot;Fixed Version&quot;.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat skanlash yetarli emas — base image'ni yangilab qayta build qilmasa CVE qolaveradi.</li><li>Katta base (ubuntu, node full) = ko'p paket = ko'p CVE; slim/alpine/distroless kam.</li><li>&quot;0 CVE&quot; degan narsa yo'q — severity bo'yicha filtr qil (CRITICAL/HIGH ga e'tibor).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Skanni CI gate qil (<code>--exit-code 1</code>) va muntazam base image yangilash (Renovate/Dependabot). Distroless/minimal base + multi-stage build hujum yuzasini va CVE sonini keskin kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34165	<p><code>docker stop</code> va <code>docker kill</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker stop</code> konteynerga <b>SIGTERM</b> yuboradi va graceful shutdown uchun kutadi (default 10s), keyin SIGKILL. <code>docker kill</code> esa darhol <b>SIGKILL</b> (yoki belgilangan signal) yuboradi — kutish yo'q, ilova tozalashga ulgurmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy paytida <code>docker kill</code> ishlatsa — yarim bajarilgan so'rovlar uziladi, ochiq ulanishlar/fayllar to'g'ri yopilmaydi. <code>stop</code> ilovaga tozalanish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker stop -t 30 web:<br>   SIGTERM --&gt; ilova: yangi so'rov qabul qilma, joriysini tugat, DB yop<br>   30s kutadi<br>   hali tirik bo'lsa --&gt; SIGKILL (majburiy)<br>docker kill web:  SIGKILL darhol (tozalash yo'q)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker stop -t 30 web      # 30s graceful muddat<br>docker kill web            # darhol o'ldirish<br>docker kill -s SIGUSR1 web # maxsus signal yuborish (reload va h.k.)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova SIGTERM'ni ushlamasa — stop ham oxirida SIGKILL qiladi; kodda signal handler yoz.</li><li>PID 1 muammosi: shell-form <code>CMD</code> da signal ilovaga yetmaydi (exec-form ishlat yoki tini).</li><li><code>-t</code> muddat ilova tozalanishiga yetarli bo'lsin; K8s'da <code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code> mos kelsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Graceful shutdown dizayn qismi: SIGTERM'da readiness'ni o'chir, joriy ishlarni tugat, resurslarni yop. <code>kill</code> faqat osilib qolgan konteyner uchun. Deploy'da har doim <code>stop</code> yo'lidan bor.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34166	<p>Konteyner nega darhol to'xtab qoladi (<code>Exited (0)</code>)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>Exited (0)</code> — konteynerning asosiy jarayoni (PID 1) tabiiy tugadi. Docker konteynerni emas, bitta <b>foreground jarayonni</b> boshqaradi — u tugasa konteyner ham to'xtaydi. Ko'pincha sabab: xizmat daemon (fon) rejimida ishga tushib, PID 1 darhol qaytgan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>nginx</code> yoki <code>postgres</code> ni odatdagidek ishga tushirasiz, konteyner darhol <code>Exited (0)</code>. Chunki ular default'da fonga o'tadi va PID 1 bo'sh qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Konteyner tirik = PID 1 tirik<br>nginx (fon rejim)  -&gt; PID 1 darhol qaytadi -&gt; konteyner to'xtaydi (Exited 0)<br>nginx -g 'daemon off;' -&gt; PID 1 oldinda qoladi -&gt; konteyner ishlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker ps -a                  # Exited (kod) ni ko'r<br>docker logs &lt;container&gt;       # nega to'xtaganini o'qi<br>docker run nginx -g 'daemon off;'   # nginx'ni oldinda ushlash</pre><p>Dockerfile: <code>CMD [&quot;nginx&quot;, &quot;-g&quot;, &quot;daemon off;&quot;]</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Daemon rejim eng ko'p sabab — xizmatni foreground'da ishga tushir.</li><li>CMD shunchaki skript bo'lib tugasa ham <code>Exited (0)</code>; uzoq ishlaydigan jarayon kerak.</li><li><code>Exited (0)</code> normal tugash, <code>Exited (137)</code> = SIGKILL/OOM, <code>Exited (1)</code> = xato — kodga qarab tashxis.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Exit kod tashxis vositasi: 0 normal, 1-125 ilova xatosi, 137 OOM/kill, 139 segfault. <code>docker logs</code> + exit kod birinchi qadam. Prod'da foreground + to'g'ri signal + healthcheck.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34167	<p>Docker'da <code>--rm</code> qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--rm</code> — konteyner to'xtagach <b>avtomatik o'chiradi</b> (fayl tizimi, anonim volume'lar bilan). Bir martalik buyruqlar va test uchun — to'xtagan konteynerlar yig'ilib disk/<code>docker ps -a</code> ni to'ldirmasligi uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har <code>docker run</code> to'xtagan konteynerni qoldiradi; vaqt o'tib yuzlab &quot;dead&quot; konteyner yig'iladi va disk/ro'yxatni ifloslaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker run alpine echo hi      -&gt; to'xtaydi, lekin QOLADI (docker ps -a da)<br>docker run --rm alpine echo hi -&gt; to'xtaydi va AVTOMATIK o'chadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run --rm alpine nslookup google.com    # bir martalik diagnostika<br>docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/src -w /src golang go test ./...   # bir martalik test<br>docker run --rm -it ubuntu bash               # vaqtincha shell</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--rm</code> bilan ishga tushgan konteyner logini keyin ko'rib bo'lmaydi (o'chib ketadi) — debug kerak bo'lsa <code>--rm</code>siz ishlat.</li><li>Uzoq ishlaydigan servisga <code>--rm</code> qo'yma — qayta ishga tushirishda holat yo'qoladi.</li><li>Named volume <code>--rm</code> bilan o'chmaydi (faqat anonim), lekin ehtiyot bo'l.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>--rm</code> interaktiv/bir martalik ish uchun ideal. Yig'ilib qolganlarni <code>docker container prune</code> tozalaydi. Prod servisi uchun <code>--rm</code> emas — orkestrator (Compose/K8s) hayot siklini boshqaradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34168	<p>Bitta konteynerda bir nechta jarayon (nginx + app) ishlatish yaxshimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Odatda yomon. Docker falsafasi — konteyner bitta asosiy jarayon. Bitta konteynerda nginx + app bo'lsa: biri yiqilsa Docker bilmaydi (PID 1 tirik), log aralashadi, alohida scale/update qilib bo'lmaydi. To'g'ri yo'l — alohida konteynerlar (Compose/K8s pod).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> nginx + PHP-FPM ni bitta konteynerga qo'yadilar; FPM yiqilsa konteyner tirikdek ko'rinadi, healthcheck aldanadi, restart ishlamaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Bitta jarayon / konteyner:<br>  app crash -&gt; PID 1 o'ladi -&gt; Docker restart qiladi, alert<br>Ko'p jarayon (supervisord):<br>  app crash -&gt; supervisord tirik -&gt; Docker bilmaydi -&gt; &quot;zombi&quot; holat<br>To'g'ri: nginx konteyner + app konteyner, bitta network / pod</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># docker-compose.yml — alohida servis<br>services:<br>  app: { build: . }<br>  nginx: { image: nginx, depends_on: [app], ports: [&quot;80:80&quot;] }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>supervisord/<code>&amp;</code> bilan ko'p jarayon — crash ko'rinmaydi, restart/healthcheck buziladi.</li><li>Istisno: asosiy jarayon + yordamchi (log shipper) — sidecar sifatida, lekin alohida konteyner afzal.</li><li>Har jarayon alohida log/metrik berishi kerak — bitta konteynerda aralashadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Bir konteyner — bir mas'uliyat&quot;. Bir nechta jarayon kerak bo'lsa (masalan init reaper) — <code>tini</code>/<code>--init</code> ishlat, lekin biznes jarayonlarni ajrat. K8s pod bir nechta konteynerni bitta birlik sifatida boshqarish uchun aynan shu uchun bor.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34169	<p>Docker log driver'lari va log rotate?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Log driver — konteyner stdout/stderr'ini qayerga yozishni belgilaydi (default <code>json-file</code>). Log rotate bo'lmasa bu fayllar cheksiz o'sib diskni to'ldiradi. <code>daemon.json</code> da <code>max-size</code>/<code>max-file</code> bilan rotatsiya sozlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Serda konteyner haftalab ishlaydi, <code>/var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log</code> o'nlab GB bo'lib disk 100% to'ladi — hamma servis yiqiladi. Klassik &quot;disk full&quot; hodisasi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app stdout -&gt; log driver -&gt; fayl (json-file)<br>rotate yo'q -&gt; bitta fayl cheksiz o'sadi<br>max-size=10m, max-file=3 -&gt; 10MB x 3 = 30MB cheklov, eskisi o'chadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// /etc/docker/daemon.json (faqat YANGI konteynerlarga ta'sir qiladi)<br>{ &quot;log-driver&quot;: &quot;json-file&quot;, &quot;log-opts&quot;: { &quot;max-size&quot;: &quot;10m&quot;, &quot;max-file&quot;: &quot;3&quot; } }</pre><pre>systemctl restart docker          # o'zgarishdan keyin<br>du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log | sort -h | tail   # kim katta</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>daemon.json</code> o'zgarishi faqat yangi konteynerlarga — mavjudlarni qayta yaratish kerak.</li><li>Log faylni <code>rm</code> qilma — dockerd descriptor'ni ochiq ushlaydi, disk bo'shamaydi; <code>truncate -s 0</code> yoki konteyner qayta yaratish.</li><li>Juda ko'p log = debug darajasi prod'da yoqilgan yoki error loop — root cause'ni ham top.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da markaziy log (Loki/ELK, <code>local</code> yoki <code>journald</code>/<code>fluentd</code> driver) + lokal rotatsiya ikkalasi ham kerak. Log hajmi monitoring'ga ulansin — disk to'lishi oldindan alert bersin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-34170	<p>Docker ma'lumotlari hostda qayerda saqlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Docker ma'lumotlari default'da <code>/var/lib/docker</code> da saqlanadi: image layer'lar, konteyner yozuv qatlamlari, volume'lar, log'lar. Disk to'lsa ko'pincha aybdor shu papka — lekin qo'lda o'chirma, <code>docker system prune</code> ishlat.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Root disk to'ldi; <code>du</code> qilsang <code>/var/lib/docker</code> o'nlab GB. Ichiga qo'lda kirib fayl o'chirsa — Docker metadata buziladi va konteynerlar ishlamay qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/var/lib/docker/<br>  overlay2/   &lt;- image va konteyner fayl tizimi qatlamlari (eng katta)<br>  volumes/    &lt;- named/anonim volume ma'lumotlari<br>  containers/ &lt;- konteyner log'lari<br>  image/      &lt;- metadata</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker info | grep 'Docker Root Dir'      # qayerda ekanini tasdiqla<br>docker system df                          # nima qancha joy olgan<br>docker system prune -a --volumes          # ishlatilmayotganlarni tozalash (EHTIYOT)<br>du -sh /var/lib/docker/* 2&gt;/dev/null | sort -h</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qo'lda <code>rm -rf</code> qilma — metadata va haqiqiy fayllar nomuvofiq bo'ladi; <code>docker</code> buyruqlari orqali tozala.</li><li><code>prune -a --volumes</code> ishlatilmayotgan <b>volume</b>'larni ham o'chiradi — kerakli ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin; avval <code>docker system df -v</code> bilan ko'r.</li><li>Anonim volume'lar (har <code>docker run -v /path</code>) yig'iladi — asosiy &quot;yashirin&quot; disk yeyuvchi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da <code>/var/lib/docker</code> ni alohida disk/partition'ga qo'y (root to'lishi butun tizimni yiqitmasin), <code>docker system df</code> ni monitoring'ga ula, va muntazam <code>prune</code> ni cron/CI'ga qo'y — qo'lda favqulodda tozalash o'rniga.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41001	<p>Container nima va virtual mashinadan tubdan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container — host kernel'ni bo'lishadigan <b>oddiy Linux process</b>, faqat namespace'lar bilan izolyatsiyalangan (o'z PID, tarmoq, fayl tizimi ko'rinishi) va cgroup'lar bilan cheklangan. VM esa hypervisor ustida <b>o'z kernel'i bilan to'liq guest OS</b> ishlatadi. Tub farq — kernel umumiymi yoki alohidami.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta serverda 50 ta servisni izolyatsiyalash kerak. 50 VM = 50 kernel, har biri GB RAM va daqiqalab boot. 50 container = 50 process, MB va millisekundlar.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>VM:                               Container:<br>+-------+-------+                 +------+------+------+<br>| app   | app   |                 | app  | app  | app  |<br>| libs  | libs  |                 | libs | libs | libs |<br>| kernel| kernel|  &lt;- har VM'da   +------+------+------+<br>+-------+-------+                 | container runtime  |<br>|  hypervisor   |                 | HOST KERNEL (bitta)|<br>|  hardware     |                 | hardware           |</pre><p>| | Container | VM | |---|---|---| | Izolyatsiya | namespace/cgroup (kernel umumiy) | hardware virtualizatsiya | | Start | ms | soniya-daqiqa | | Overhead | MB | GB | | Boshqa OS kernel | yo'q (Linux'da Linux) | ha | | Xavfsizlik chegarasi | zaifroq | kuchli |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d --name web nginx<br>ps -ef | grep nginx             # host'da oddiy process sifatida ko'rinadi<br>docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' web<br>ls -l /proc/&lt;PID&gt;/ns            # uning namespace'lari<br>uname -r; docker run --rm alpine uname -r   # bir xil kernel</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Container ichida root = xavfsiz&quot; — kernel umumiy, kernel exploit host'ni buzadi.</li><li>macOS/Windows'dagi Docker aslida yashirin Linux VM ichida ishlaydi.</li><li>Container'ni VM kabi ishlatish (ichida systemd, SSH, ko'p servis).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ishonchsiz kod yoki multi-tenant yuklama uchun container yetarli chegara emas — gVisor, Kata yoki Firecracker kabi sandbox/microVM. Ko'p cloud'lar ikkalasini birlashtiradi: microVM ichida container.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41002	<p>Container izolyatsiyasini ta'minlovchi Linux namespace'larini tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Namespace — kernel resursining <b>ko'rinishini</b> process uchun ajratadi. Linux'da 8 tur: <b>PID</b> (process daraxti), <b>NET</b> (tarmoq stack), <b>MNT</b> (mount'lar), <b>UTS</b> (hostname), <b>IPC</b> (shared memory, MQ), <b>USER</b> (UID/GID map), <b>CGROUP</b> (cgroup ko'rinishi), <b>TIME</b> (monotonic/boot vaqt ofseti).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki container ikkalasi ham 80-portni tinglashi, o'z <code>/</code> va o'z PID 1 ga ega bo'lishi, bir-birining process'larini ko'rmasligi kerak — bitta kernel'da.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>host:  PID 1 systemd ... PID 4312 nginx<br>           |<br>   container PID ns:  PID 1 nginx  (host'da 4312)<br>   NET ns: eth0 10.0.0.5  &lt;-veth-&gt; host docker0<br>   MNT ns: / = overlay merged dir<br>   UTS ns: hostname=web-1<br>   USER ns: container UID 0 -&gt; host UID 100000</pre><p>Process <code>clone()</code>/<code>unshare()</code> bilan yangi namespace oladi, <code>setns()</code> bilan mavjudiga qo'shiladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># docker'siz o'zingiz namespace yarating<br>sudo unshare --pid --fork --mount-proc --uts --net bash<br>hostname test; ps aux     # faqat bash va ps; PID 1 = bash<br>ip a                      # faqat lo (DOWN)<br><br># ishlab turgan container namespace'iga kirish<br>PID=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' web)<br>sudo nsenter -t $PID -n ss -tlnp      # container tarmog'ini host tool bilan ko'rish<br>lsns -p $PID</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker default'da USER namespace'ni yoqmaydi — container root = host root UID 0.</li><li><code>--pid=host</code>, <code>--net=host</code> izolyatsiyani butunlay olib tashlaydi.</li><li>Namespace resursni <b>cheklamaydi</b> — bu cgroup ishi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>nsenter</code> — distroless container'ni debug qilishning eng kuchli usuli: host tool'larini container namespace'ida ishlatasiz. User namespace (rootless, K8s <code>hostUsers: false</code>) — container escape oqibatini keskin kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41003	<p>cgroups nima va v1 bilan v2 farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> cgroups (control groups) — process guruhlari uchun CPU, xotira, I/O va PID <b>resurslarini cheklash va hisoblash</b> kernel mexanizmi. <b>v1</b> — har controller alohida ierarxiya; <b>v2</b> — yagona ierarxiya, to'g'ri page cache/writeback hisobi, PSI (pressure) metrikalari, xavfsiz delegatsiya. 2025-2026 da asosiy distrolar va K8s v2 ni default ishlatadi, v1 deprecated.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta container xotira oqishi bilan butun host'ni OOM'ga olib kirmasligi, CPU'ni yolg'iz egallamasligi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>v1: /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/docker/&lt;id&gt;/   /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/docker/&lt;id&gt;/  (alohida daraxtlar)<br>v2: /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-&lt;id&gt;.scope/<br>       memory.max   cpu.max   io.max   pids.max   memory.pressure<br>cpu.max = &quot;50000 100000&quot;  -&gt; har 100ms da 50ms = 0.5 CPU<br>memory.max oshsa -&gt; cgroup ichida OOM kill</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stat -fc %T /sys/fs/cgroup        # cgroup2fs = v2, tmpfs = v1<br>docker run -d --name app --memory 256m --cpus 0.5 --pids-limit 200 nginx<br>CG=/sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' app).scope<br>cat $CG/memory.max $CG/cpu.max $CG/pids.max<br>cat $CG/memory.current $CG/memory.pressure<br>cat $CG/cpu.stat        # nr_throttled, throttled_usec</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Runtime limitni bilmasa host resursini ko'radi: eski JVM v2'ni o'qimaydi (JDK 15+ o'qiydi); Go 1.25+ faqat CPU limitidan GOMAXPROCS oladi, xotira uchun <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> ni o'zingiz qo'ying.</li><li><code>memory.current</code> page cache'ni ham o'z ichiga oladi — &quot;xotira to'lib boryapti&quot; degan noto'g'ri xulosa.</li><li>K8s 1.35 dan kubelet cgroup v1 node'da default ishga tushmaydi — eski node OS'larni yangilang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> v2 ning PSI (<code>memory.pressure</code>, <code>cpu.pressure</code>) — &quot;ilova resurs kutib qolyapti&quot; ning eng aniq signali, utilization'dan foydaliroq. <code>memory.high</code> (soft throttle) OOM'dan oldin yumshoq bosim beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41004	<p>Container runtime ierarxiyasi (high-level va low-level) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikki qatlam: <b>high-level runtime</b> (containerd, CRI-O) — image pull/unpack, snapshot, tarmoq, lifecycle va API (CRI) ni boshqaradi; <b>low-level OCI runtime</b> (runc, crun, youki, gVisor <code>runsc</code>, Kata) — <code>config.json</code> ni olib, kernel bilan namespace/cgroup yaratadi va process'ni ishga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Docker&quot; bitta narsa emas. K8s debug qilganda qaysi qatlam xato berayotganini bilish kerak: image pull xatosi (containerd) yoki <code>exec format error</code>/seccomp (runc).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker CLI --&gt; dockerd --+<br>kubelet --CRI gRPC-------+--&gt; containerd --&gt; containerd-shim-runc-v2 --&gt; runc --&gt; process<br>                              (image, snapshot)    (har container)       (chiqib ketadi)<br>kubelet --CRI gRPC--&gt; CRI-O --&gt; conmon --&gt; runc/crun --&gt; process</pre><p>| Qatlam | Misollar | Vazifa | |---|---|---| | CLI/orkestrator | docker, nerdctl, kubelet, podman | foydalanuvchi interfeysi | | High-level | containerd, CRI-O | image, storage, lifecycle | | Low-level (OCI) | runc, crun, youki, runsc, kata | namespace + cgroup + exec |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker info | grep -iE 'runtime|cgroup'<br>crictl info | jq '.config.containerd.runtimes'     # K8s node'da<br>ctr -n k8s.io containers ls                         # containerd darajasida<br>pstree -p $(pgrep -f containerd-shim | head -1)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>K8s node'da <code>docker ps</code> bo'sh — kubelet containerd'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatadi (<code>crictl</code> kerak).</li><li><code>ctr</code> namespace'larini (<code>k8s.io</code>, <code>moby</code>) bilmaslik — &quot;image yo'q&quot; deb o'ylash.</li><li>Low-level runtime'ni almashtirish (crun) seccomp/cgroup xatti-harakatida farq berishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> RuntimeClass bilan bitta klasterda turli low-level runtime'lar (runc oddiy, gVisor ishonchsiz yuklama uchun) ishlatish mumkin. Bu qatlamlarni bilish incident paytida to'g'ri log'ga (kubelet, containerd, shim) tez borishga yordam beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41005	<p>OCI (Open Container Initiative) qaysi spetsifikatsiyalarni belgilaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OCI (Linux Foundation) uchta spec belgilaydi: <b>Image Spec</b> (manifest, config, layer formati), <b>Runtime Spec</b> (<code>config.json</code> + bundle va lifecycle: create/start/kill/delete), <b>Distribution Spec</b> (registry push/pull HTTP API). Shu tufayli Docker'da build qilingan image Podman, containerd, CRI-O'da ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2015 gacha Docker formati yagona vendor'ga bog'liq edi. Har tool o'z formatini o'ylab topsa — image'lar ko'chmas bo'lardi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Build (BuildKit/Buildah) --Image Spec--&gt; manifest + config + layer tar.gz (digest bilan)<br>     --Distribution Spec--&gt; registry (/v2/&lt;name&gt;/manifests/&lt;ref&gt;, /blobs/&lt;digest&gt;)<br>     --pull, unpack--&gt; rootfs + config.json  (Runtime bundle)<br>     --Runtime Spec--&gt; runc create / start</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># image'ni OCI layout sifatida ko'rish<br>skopeo copy docker://nginx:1.27 oci:./nginx-oci:1.27<br>cat nginx-oci/index.json | jq<br># registry API bevosita<br>TOKEN=$(curl -s &quot;https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&amp;scope=repository:library/nginx:pull&quot; | jq -r .token)<br>curl -s -H &quot;Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN&quot; \<br>  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json' \<br>  https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/library/nginx/manifests/1.27 | jq '.manifests[].platform'<br># runtime bundle<br>runc spec     # namuna config.json</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker v2 schema 2 va OCI media type'lari aralash — eski registry'lar OCI index'ni qabul qilmasligi.</li><li>&quot;OCI-compatible&quot; deyilgan tool hamma spec'ni (masalan artifacts/referrers) qo'llashi shart emas.</li><li>Image Spec v1.1 (2024) referrers API'sini registry qo'llamasa imzo/SBOM bog'lanmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> OCI standart bo'lgani uchun registry endi umumiy artifact storage: Helm chart, SBOM, imzo (cosign), Wasm. Tool tanlashda &quot;OCI 1.1 + referrers&quot; qo'llovi supply chain uchun muhim mezon.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41006	<p><code>runc</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>runc</code> — OCI Runtime Spec'ning reference implementatsiyasi, Go'da yozilgan CLI. <code>config.json</code> va rootfs'ni olib namespace, cgroup, mount, capability, seccomp'ni sozlaydi, process'ni <code>exec</code> qiladi va <b>o'zi chiqib ketadi</b> — container'ni shim kuzatib turadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kernel primitivlarini (clone, pivot_root, setns, cgroup yozish) to'g'ri tartibda va xavfsiz chaqirish murakkab; runc bu ishni hamma high-level runtime uchun bajaradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>runc create &lt;id&gt;  --&gt; runc init (yangi namespace'larda), cgroup'ga qo'shiladi,<br>                      mount, pivot_root, capability/seccomp, kutadi<br>runc start &lt;id&gt;   --&gt; foydalanuvchi process'i exec (PID 1)<br>runc state/kill/delete</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> Docker'siz container:</p><pre>mkdir -p mycont/rootfs &amp;&amp; cd mycont<br>docker export $(docker create alpine) | tar -C rootfs -xf -<br>runc spec                        # config.json yaratadi (args: &quot;sh&quot;)<br>sudo runc run demo               # ichida: ps, hostname<br>sudo runc list</pre><p><code>config.json</code> ichida <code>linux.namespaces</code>, <code>process.capabilities</code>, <code>linux.resources</code> ni ko'ring.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>runc CVE'lari (2019 CVE-2019-5736, 2024 &quot;Leaky Vessels&quot; CVE-2024-21626, 2025 mount race'lar) — host'ga escape; runc'ni yangilab turing.</li><li>runc ko'pincha containerd paketi bilan keladi — containerd yangilansa ham runc eski qolishi mumkin.</li><li><code>crun</code> (C) tezroq va kam xotira, lekin xatti-harakat farqlari bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Node patch siyosatida runc alohida kuzatiladigan komponent bo'lsin (<code>runc --version</code>). Low-level runtime — host va container o'rtasidagi eng nozik nuqta; ishonchsiz yuklama uchun gVisor/Kata.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41007	<p><code>containerd</code> va <code>containerd-shim</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>containerd</code> — CNCF graduated high-level runtime: image pull, content store, snapshotter (overlayfs), container metadata va CRI plugin. <code>containerd-shim</code> (hozir <code>containerd-shim-runc-v2</code>) — har container (yoki pod) uchun kichik process: runc'ni chaqiradi, stdio va exit code'ni ushlaydi, container'ning parent'i bo'ladi. Shu tufayli containerd restart/upgrade bo'lsa ham container'lar ishlashda davom etadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Agar container'lar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri daemon'ning child'i bo'lsa, daemon upgrade = hamma container o'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>containerd (daemon) --ttrpc--&gt; shim (PID 1501) --&gt; runc create/start --&gt; exit<br>                                    |<br>                                    +-- child: app process (PID 1502)<br>containerd o'lsa: shim + app yashaydi; qayta start'da shim'ga qayta ulanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>systemctl status containerd<br>ps -ef --forest | grep -A2 containerd-shim<br>ctr -n k8s.io images ls | head<br>ctr -n k8s.io tasks ls<br>crictl ps; crictl logs &lt;id&gt;<br>cat /etc/containerd/config.toml | grep -E 'SystemdCgroup|snapshotter'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>SystemdCgroup = false</code> va kubelet <code>cgroupDriver: systemd</code> mos kelmasligi — node beqaror.</li><li>containerd 2.x da config versiyasi va eski CRI sozlamalari o'zgargan — upgrade'dan oldin migrate qiling.</li><li>Disk to'lishi: <code>/var/lib/containerd</code> dagi eski snapshot'lar; kubelet image GC chegaralarini sozlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shim modeli — &quot;daemonless runtime&quot; g'oyasiga yaqin: control plane (containerd) va data plane (container) ajratilgan. Bu node agent'larini to'xtovsiz upgrade qilish imkonini beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41008	<p>CRI-O nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CRI-O — <b>faqat Kubernetes</b> uchun yozilgan yengil CRI runtime (Red Hat/CNCF). Versiyasi K8s versiyasiga mos keladi (1.33 &lt;-&gt; 1.33), Docker'siz OCI image'larni pull qilib, <code>conmon</code> + runc/crun orqali ishga tushiradi. OpenShift'da default.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> containerd umumiy maqsadli (Docker, nerdctl, buildkit ham ishlatadi). Faqat K8s node'i uchun minimal, K8s bilan qadamma-qadam versiyalanadigan runtime ham kerak edi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubelet --CRI gRPC (unix:///var/run/crio/crio.sock)--&gt; CRI-O<br>    image: containers/image (Podman, Skopeo bilan bir xil kutubxona)<br>    storage: containers/storage (overlay)<br>    tarmoq: CNI<br>    --&gt; conmon (monitor) --&gt; crun/runc --&gt; container</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>systemctl status crio<br>crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///var/run/crio/crio.sock ps<br>crictl images; crictl inspect &lt;id&gt; | jq .info.runtimeSpec.linux.namespaces<br>cat /etc/crio/crio.conf.d/*.conf<br>journalctl -u crio -f</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CRI-O minor versiyasini K8s'dan farqli qoldirish — CRI xususiyatlari mos kelmaydi.</li><li><code>docker</code>, <code>ctr</code> buyruqlari ishlamaydi — faqat <code>crictl</code>/<code>podman</code>.</li><li>Registry sozlamalari <code>/etc/containers/registries.conf</code> da — mirror'larni u yerda qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> containerd va CRI-O orasida K8s uchun funksional farq kam; tanlov odatda distro/platformaga (OpenShift -&gt; CRI-O, EKS/GKE/AKS -&gt; containerd) bog'liq. Muhimi — node image'ni standartlashtirish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41009	<p>Sandboxed runtime'lar (gVisor, Kata Containers) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Sandboxed runtime'lar container va host kernel orasiga qo'shimcha chegara qo'yadi. <b>gVisor</b> (<code>runsc</code>) — userspace'da Go'da yozilgan &quot;application kernel&quot; (Sentry) syscall'larni ushlab o'zi bajaradi. <b>Kata Containers</b> — har pod'ni o'z guest kernel'li yengil microVM'da (QEMU, Cloud Hypervisor, Firecracker) ishlatadi. Ikkalasi ham OCI runtime sifatida ulanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> SaaS platforma mijozlarning ixtiyoriy kodini ishlatadi. Oddiy container'da bitta kernel CVE = boshqa mijozlar va host buziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>runc:   app --syscall--&gt; HOST kernel<br>gVisor: app --syscall--&gt; Sentry (userspace kernel) --cheklangan syscall--&gt; host kernel<br>Kata:   app --syscall--&gt; guest kernel (VM ichida) --virtio--&gt; hypervisor --&gt; host</pre><p>| | runc | gVisor | Kata | |---|---|---|---| | Izolyatsiya | namespace | syscall interception | VM | | Overhead | ~0 | syscall/I-O og'ir ishlarda sezilarli | ~ boot + xotira | | Moslik | to'liq | ba'zi syscall'lar yo'q | yuqori |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b> K8s RuntimeClass:</p><pre>apiVersion: node.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: RuntimeClass<br>metadata: {name: gvisor}<br>handler: runsc<br>---<br>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Pod<br>metadata: {name: untrusted}<br>spec:<br>  runtimeClassName: gvisor<br>  containers: [{name: app, image: python:3.13-slim, command: [&quot;python&quot;,&quot;-c&quot;,&quot;print(1)&quot;]}]</pre><pre>docker run --rm --runtime=runsc alpine dmesg   # gVisor'ning o'z &quot;kernel&quot; xabarlari</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>gVisor'da I/O va tarmoq og'ir ilovalar sekinlashadi — benchmark qiling.</li><li>Kata nested virtualization talab qiladi — ko'p cloud VM'larida yo'q yoki sekin.</li><li>Sandbox = xavfsizlikning hammasi emas; tarmoq siyosati va IAM baribir kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GKE Sandbox (gVisor), AWS Lambda/Fargate (Firecracker) shu g'oyani ishlatadi. Faqat ishonchsiz yuklamani RuntimeClass bilan sandbox'ga yuboring — hamma narsani emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41010	<p>Overlay fayl tizimi (overlay2) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> overlay2 — Docker/containerd'ning default storage driver'i, Linux <b>OverlayFS</b> union mount'iga asoslangan. Bir nechta read-only image layer'lari (<b>lowerdir</b>) ustiga container'ning yoziladigan qatlami (<b>upperdir</b>) qo'yiladi va container birlashgan ko'rinishni (<b>merged</b>) ko'radi; <b>workdir</b> — atomik operatsiyalar uchun ichki joy.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 100 ta container bitta 500 MB image'dan ishlasa — 50 GB nusxa emas, bitta nusxa + har biriga kichik yozish qatlami kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>merged/  (container ko'radi:  /etc/nginx.conf, /app/log.txt ...)<br>   ^<br>upperdir/  (RW: container yozgan va o'zgartirgan fayllar, whiteout'lar)<br>lowerdir/  layer3 (RO)  COPY app<br>           layer2 (RO)  RUN apt install<br>           layer1 (RO)  debian base<br>Fayl o'chirilsa -&gt; upperdir'da &quot;whiteout&quot; (char device 0/0) yaratiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d --name w nginx<br>docker inspect -f '{{json .GraphDriver.Data}}' w | jq<br># LowerDir, UpperDir, MergedDir, WorkDir yo'llari<br>mount | grep overlay | head -1<br>docker exec w sh -c 'echo hi &gt; /tmp/x'<br>sudo ls $(docker inspect -f '{{.GraphDriver.Data.UpperDir}}' w)/tmp<br>docker system df -v</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Container ichida katta yoziladigan ma'lumot (DB) upperdir'da — sekin va container o'chsa yo'qoladi; volume ishlating.</li><li>Inode tugashi: ko'p kichik faylli image'lar <code>/var/lib/docker</code> da inode'ni yeydi.</li><li>XFS'da <code>ftype=1</code> bo'lmasa overlay ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> overlay — read-mostly ish uchun optimallashgan. Yozish intensiv ish har doim volume'ga. containerd'da snapshotter'lar (overlayfs, stargz/SOCI lazy pull) image start vaqtini keskin qisqartirishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41011	<p>Docker'da Copy-on-Write (CoW) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Copy-on-Write: image layer'lari barcha container'lar orasida <b>bo'lishiladi</b> va o'zgarmaydi. Container faylni birinchi marta o'zgartirganda, storage driver uni read-only qatlamdan container'ning RW qatlamiga <b>to'liq nusxalaydi (copy-up)</b>, keyin o'zgartiradi. O'qish uchun nusxa olinmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Disk va page cache tejash, container'ni ms'da yaratish — buning uchun fayllarni oldindan nusxalamaslik kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>container A  RW: (bo'sh)          container B  RW: /etc/app.conf (copy-up qilingan)<br>                \                           /<br>              RO image: /etc/app.conf, /usr/bin/app (bitta nusxa)<br>B &quot;echo x &gt;&gt; /etc/app.conf&quot; -&gt; butun fayl upper'ga ko'chiriladi -&gt; keyin append</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d --name a ubuntu sleep inf<br>docker exec a sh -c 'dd if=/dev/zero of=/big bs=1M count=500'   # yangi fayl<br>docker diff a          # A /big, C /etc ... (A=added, C=changed, D=deleted)<br>docker ps -s           # SIZE: yozish qatlami hajmi (virtual = + image)<br># 1 GB fayldagi 1 baytni o'zgartirish ham 1 GB copy-up!</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta faylga (DB fayli, log) birinchi yozish sekin va disk ikki baravar sarflanadi.</li><li><code>RUN chmod -R</code> yoki <code>chown -R</code> Dockerfile'da — barcha fayllar yangi layer'ga nusxalanadi, image ikki baravar kattalashadi (<code>COPY --chown</code> ishlating).</li><li>Image'dagi faylni o'chirish image hajmini kamaytirmaydi — faqat whiteout qo'shadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CoW tufayli &quot;bitta RUN ichida o'rnat va tozala&quot; qoidasi bor. Ish vaqtida yoziladigan hamma narsa (cache, upload, DB) — volume yoki tmpfs; root fayl tizimini <code>--read-only</code> qilish xavfsizlik va performans uchun yaxshi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41012	<p>Multi-stage Dockerfile nima va nega production uchun muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multi-stage Dockerfile — bir nechta <code>FROM</code> bosqichli Dockerfile: og'ir build stage'da compiler, SDK va dependency'lar bilan yig'asiz, oxirgi stage'ga faqat tayyor artefaktni <code>COPY --from=</code> bilan olasiz. Natija — kichik, kam CVE'li, build tool'larsiz production image.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>FROM golang:1.25</code> + <code>go build</code> = 1 GB image ichida compiler, git, source kod va ehtimol <code>.netrc</code> secret. Pull sekin, hujum yuzasi katta.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>stage &quot;build&quot; (golang:1.25)  --&gt; /out/app (statik binary)<br>                                     |  COPY --from=build<br>stage final (distroless/static)  &lt;---+   ~15 MB<br>Build stage layer'lari yakuniy image'ga kirmaydi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># syntax=docker/dockerfile:1<br>FROM golang:1.25 AS build<br>WORKDIR /src<br>COPY go.mod go.sum ./<br>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod go mod download<br>COPY . .<br>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \<br>    CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags=&quot;-s -w&quot; -o /out/app ./cmd/api<br><br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot<br>COPY --from=build /out/app /app<br>USER nonroot<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><pre>docker build -t api:1 . &amp;&amp; docker images api<br>docker build --target build -t api:debug .   # faqat build stage</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CGO yoqiq binary'ni <code>static</code> image'ga ko'chirish — <code>no such file or directory</code> (libc yo'q).</li><li>Oxirgi stage'da CA sertifikat va timezone yo'qligi — TLS/vaqt xatolari.</li><li><code>COPY . .</code> ni dependency yuklashdan oldin qo'yish — cache har safar buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Multi-stage + BuildKit cache mount'lar = kichik image va tez CI. Test va lint'ni ham alohida stage qilib (<code>--target test</code>) bitta Dockerfile'da reproducible pipeline qurish mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41013	<p>Distroless image'lar nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Distroless image'lar (Google <code>gcr.io/distroless</code>, Chainguard) — faqat ilova va uning runtime bog'liqliklari (libc, CA sertifikatlar, tzdata) bor; <b>shell, package manager va OS utilitalari yo'q</b>. Natija: kichik hajm, kam CVE, hujumchi uchun foydali tool yo'q.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>debian</code> base'da 100+ paket — skaner o'nlab CVE ko'rsatadi (ilova ularni ishlatmasa ham), hujumchi RCE topsa <code>sh</code>, <code>curl</code>, <code>apt</code> tayyor turibdi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>debian:12          ~120 MB, bash, apt, coreutils, ~100 paket<br>distroless/base    ~20 MB, glibc, ssl, tzdata, /etc/passwd (nonroot)<br>distroless/static  ~2 MB, faqat CA, tzdata (statik Go/Rust uchun)<br>Variantlar: :nonroot (UID 65532), :debug (busybox shell bilan)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM gcr.io/distroless/java21-debian12:nonroot<br>COPY app.jar /app.jar<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;java&quot;,&quot;-jar&quot;,&quot;/app.jar&quot;]</pre><p>Debug (shell yo'q):</p><pre>docker exec -it app sh          # ishlamaydi: executable file not found<br>kubectl debug -it pod/app --image=busybox:1.37 --target=app   # ephemeral container<br>docker run --rm -it --pid=container:app --network=container:app nicolaka/netshoot</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>RUN</code> buyrug'i shell form'da final stage'da ishlamaydi — hamma narsani build stage'da qiling.</li><li><code>ENTRYPOINT</code> shell form (<code>ENTRYPOINT java -jar</code>) — <code>/bin/sh</code> yo'q, start bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Distroless &quot;zaifliksiz&quot; degani emas — glibc/openssl CVE'lari baribir bo'ladi; muntazam rebuild.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Distroless'ning eng katta qiymati — skaner shovqini kamayib, haqiqiy CVE'lar ko'rinadi. Debug amaliyotini (ephemeral container, nsenter) jamoaga oldindan o'rgating, aks holda &quot;shell qo'shib qo'yamiz&quot; bosimi paydo bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41014	<p>Dockerfile'da <code>CMD</code> va <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> — container'ning <b>asosiy executable'i</b> (doim ishlaydi). <code>CMD</code> — unga beriladigan <b>default argumentlar</b> (yoki ENTRYPOINT bo'lmasa — default buyruq). <code>docker run image ARGS</code> faqat <code>CMD</code> ni almashtiradi; <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> ni faqat <code>--entrypoint</code> bilan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Image &quot;tool&quot; kabi ishlashi kerak: <code>docker run mycli --help</code>, <code>docker run mycli migrate</code>. Agar hammasi <code>CMD</code> da bo'lsa, foydalanuvchi butun buyruqni qayta yozishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]   CMD [&quot;serve&quot;,&quot;--port&quot;,&quot;8080&quot;]<br>docker run img                 --&gt; /app serve --port 8080<br>docker run img migrate up      --&gt; /app migrate up        (CMD almashdi)<br>docker run --entrypoint sh img --&gt; sh                      (ENTRYPOINT almashdi)<br>K8s: command = ENTRYPOINT, args = CMD</pre><p>| Dockerfile | <code>docker run img</code> | <code>docker run img x</code> | |---|---|---| | faqat CMD [&quot;a&quot;] | a | x | | faqat ENTRYPOINT [&quot;e&quot;] | e | e x | | ENTRYPOINT [&quot;e&quot;] + CMD [&quot;a&quot;] | e a | e x |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM alpine:3.22<br>COPY entrypoint.sh /entrypoint.sh<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/entrypoint.sh&quot;]<br>CMD [&quot;serve&quot;]</pre><pre>#!/bin/sh<br>set -e<br>[ &quot;$1&quot; = &quot;serve&quot; ] &amp;&amp; ./wait-for-db.sh<br>exec /app &quot;$@&quot;        # exec — signal'lar /app'ga yetsin</pre><pre>docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Entrypoint}} {{.Config.Cmd}}' img</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Wrapper skriptda <code>exec</code> yo'q — shell PID 1 bo'lib SIGTERM'ni yutadi.</li><li>ENTRYPOINT shell form'da bo'lsa CMD umuman e'tiborga olinmaydi.</li><li>K8s'da <code>command:</code> yozib, ENTRYPOINT'ni bilmasdan almashtirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: ENTRYPOINT = &quot;nima&quot;, CMD = &quot;default qanday&quot;. Ikkalasini exec (JSON) formda yozing va K8s manifest'ida <code>args</code> dan foydalaning — image xulqi bashorat qilinadigan bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41015	<p><code>CMD [&quot;node&quot;, &quot;server.js&quot;]</code> (exec form) va <code>CMD node server.js</code> (shell form) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Exec form</b> (<code>CMD [&quot;node&quot;,&quot;server.js&quot;]</code>) — <code>node</code> to'g'ridan-to'g'ri <b>PID 1</b> bo'ladi va <code>SIGTERM</code> ni o'zi oladi. <b>Shell form</b> (<code>CMD node server.js</code>) — aslida <code>/bin/sh -c &quot;node server.js&quot;</code>; PID 1 = <code>sh</code>, u odatda signalni child'ga uzatmaydi, ilova graceful shutdown qila olmaydi va grace period'dan keyin <code>SIGKILL</code> bilan o'ldiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy paytida har pod 30 soniya &quot;Terminating&quot; da qotadi va keyin so'rovlar uzilib, 502 lar chiqadi — sabab ko'pincha shell form.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>shell form:  PID 1 /bin/sh -c &quot;node server.js&quot;<br>                  +-- PID 7 node   &lt;-- SIGTERM yetib bormaydi<br>             docker stop -&gt; SIGTERM -&gt; sh (e'tiborsiz) -&gt; 10s -&gt; SIGKILL -&gt; hammasi o'ladi<br>exec form:   PID 1 node  &lt;-- SIGTERM -&gt; process.on('SIGTERM') -&gt; drain -&gt; exit 0</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker exec app ps -o pid,args     # PID 1 kim?<br>time docker stop app               # ~10s = signal ishlanmadi; &lt;1s = to'g'ri</pre><pre>process.on('SIGTERM', () =&gt; {<br>  server.close(() =&gt; process.exit(0));   // yangi ulanish qabul qilmaydi, mavjudlarini tugatadi<br>});</pre><p>Shell kerak bo'lsa (env kengaytirish): <code>CMD [&quot;sh&quot;,&quot;-c&quot;,&quot;exec node server.js --port $PORT&quot;]</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PID 1 bo'lgan process uchun kernel default signal handler'larni qo'llamaydi — ilova SIGTERM'ni o'zi tutmasa, exec form'da ham to'xtamaydi.</li><li><code>npm start</code> orqali ishga tushirish — npm signal'ni ishonchli uzatmaydi; <code>node</code> ni bevosita chaqiring.</li><li>Exec form'da <code>$VAR</code> kengaytirilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Graceful shutdown zanjiri: exec form -&gt; ilovada SIGTERM handler -&gt; readiness <code>false</code> -&gt; drain -&gt; exit; K8s'da <code>preStop</code> sleep va <code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code> bilan muvofiqlashtiring. Zombie va signal uchun <code>tini</code>/<code>--init</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41016	<p>Rootless Docker / Rootless Podman nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Rootless rejim — container daemon'i (dockerd/podman) va container'lar host'da <b>oddiy foydalanuvchi</b> sifatida, user namespace ichida ishlaydi. Container ichida UID 0 bo'lsa ham host'da u imtiyozsiz UID (masalan 100000) ga map qilingan. Container escape bo'lsa hujumchi faqat shu user huquqini oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy Docker'da <code>dockerd</code> root bo'lib ishlaydi; docker guruhidagi har kim amalda host root, va runc/kernel escape'i to'g'ridan-to'g'ri root beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>host user alice (UID 1000), /etc/subuid: alice:100000:65536<br>  podman (UID 1000) --user ns--&gt; container UID 0  = host UID 1000<br>                                 container UID 1  = host UID 100000<br>tarmoq: slirp4netns / pasta (userspace), portlar &lt; 1024 cheklangan<br>storage: fuse-overlayfs yoki native overlay (kernel 5.11+)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Podman — default rootless<br>podman run --rm alpine id            # uid=0(root)<br>podman unshare cat /proc/self/uid_map<br>ps -o user,pid,cmd -C sleep          # host'da alice ko'rinadi<br><br># Docker rootless<br>dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install<br>export DOCKER_HOST=unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock<br>docker info | grep -i rootless</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>80/443 portlar: <code>net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start=80</code> yoki yuqori port + LB.</li><li>Tarmoq performansi (slirp4netns) sekinroq; <code>pasta</code> yaxshiroq.</li><li>Bind-mount qilingan host fayllarda UID mapping tufayli ruxsat xatolari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rootless (daemon darajasi) va &quot;container ichida root bo'lmaslik&quot; (<code>USER 10001</code>) — ikki alohida himoya; ikkalasini ham qo'llang. K8s'da ekvivalenti — user namespaces (<code>hostUsers: false</code>, 1.33+ beta default yoqilgan).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41017	<p>Docker capabilities (<code>CAP_SYS_ADMIN</code>, <code>CAP_NET_ADMIN</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux capabilities — root huquqini ~40 ta mayda bo'lakka ajratish: <code>CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE</code> (1024 dan past port), <code>CAP_NET_ADMIN</code> (tarmoq sozlash, iptables), <code>CAP_SYS_ADMIN</code> (mount, namespace va boshqa ko'p narsa — &quot;yangi root&quot;). Docker default'da ~14 ta capability qoldiradi; best practice — <code>--cap-drop=ALL</code> va faqat keraklisini qo'shish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova faqat 443-portni tinglashi kerak, lekin buning uchun to'liq root berish — butun kernel API'ni ochadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>process -&gt; bind(:443) -&gt; kernel: CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE bormi? -&gt; ha -&gt; OK<br>Docker default: CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, FOWNER, FSETID, KILL, SETGID, SETUID,<br>                SETPCAP, NET_BIND_SERVICE, NET_RAW, SYS_CHROOT, MKNOD, AUDIT_WRITE, SETFCAP<br>Default'da YO'Q: SYS_ADMIN, NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE, SYS_MODULE ...</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run --rm --cap-drop=ALL --cap-add=NET_BIND_SERVICE -p 443:443 myapp<br>docker exec app grep Cap /proc/1/status<br>capsh --decode=00000000a80425fb        # bitmask'ni o'qish</pre><p>K8s:</p><pre>securityContext:<br>  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>  capabilities: {drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;], add: [&quot;NET_BIND_SERVICE&quot;]}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Non-root user bilan capability qo'shish — ambient capability'siz ishlamaydi (K8s'da drop ALL + add kombinatsiyasi buni hal qiladi).</li><li><code>NET_RAW</code> default'da bor — ARP/ICMP spoofing; keraksiz bo'lsa olib tashlang.</li><li>&quot;Ishlamayapti — SYS_ADMIN qo'shamiz&quot; — amalda privileged ga yaqin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pod Security Standards &quot;restricted&quot; profili <code>drop: ALL</code> ni talab qiladi — buni namespace darajasida majburlang. Capability so'rovi bo'lsa — aniq syscall/funksiya bilan asoslansin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41018	<p>Nega <code>--privileged</code> bilan container ishlatish xavfli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--privileged</code> container'ga <b>barcha capability'lar</b>, host'ning barcha <code>/dev</code> qurilmalari, seccomp/AppArmor/SELinux o'chirilgan va <code>/sys</code> yozish huquqi beradi. Amalda bu host root: diskni mount qilish, kernel modul yuklash yoki cgroup orqali host'da buyruq bajarish bilan bir necha soniyada escape qilinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Docker-in-Docker ishlamayapti&quot; yoki &quot;qurilmaga kirish kerak&quot; degan sabab bilan <code>--privileged</code> qo'yiladi va unutiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (escape misoli):</b></p><pre>privileged container ichida:<br>  fdisk -l                      -&gt; host diski /dev/nvme0n1p1 ko'rinadi<br>  mount /dev/nvme0n1p1 /mnt     -&gt; host fayl tizimi<br>  chroot /mnt                   -&gt; host'da root shell<br>  (yoki: echo ... &gt; /mnt/etc/cron.d/x, ssh kalit qo'shish)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> tekshirish va alternativa:</p><pre>docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.Privileged}}' app<br>kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged==true) | .metadata.namespace+&quot;/&quot;+.metadata.name'<br># o'rniga: faqat kerakli qurilma va capability<br>docker run --device /dev/fuse --cap-add SYS_ADMIN --security-opt apparmor=unconfined ...</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CI runner'larda DinD uchun privileged — har pipeline host'ni egallashi mumkin; Kaniko/BuildKit rootless ishlating.</li><li>Monitoring agent'lariga &quot;qulay&quot; deb privileged berish.</li><li><code>privileged: false</code>, lekin <code>hostPath: /</code> mount — xuddi shunday xavfli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Privileged'ni Pod Security Admission (<code>baseline</code>/<code>restricted</code>) yoki Kyverno/OPA bilan bloklang, istisnolarni alohida namespace'da, ro'yxat va egasi bilan saqlang. CNI, CSI kabi tizim agent'lari ham ko'pincha capability ro'yxati bilan ishlay oladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41019	<p>Container'da zombie (defunct) process nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zombie (defunct) — ishini tugatgan, lekin parent'i <code>wait()</code> bilan exit status'ini <b>o'qimagan</b> process; u faqat process jadvalida PID egallab turadi. Container'da PID 1 odatda oddiy ilova bo'lib, yetim (orphan) process'larni reap qilmaydi — zombie'lar to'planib PID limitini tugatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova har so'rovda <code>sh -c</code> yoki healthcheck skript chaqiradi. Bir hafta o'tib <code>fork: Resource temporarily unavailable</code> — PID'lar tugagan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PID 1 app (wait() chaqirmaydi)<br>  +-- PID 20 sh -c &quot;curl ...&quot;   --&gt; tugadi --&gt; &lt;defunct&gt;<br>  +-- PID 35 worker --&gt; uning child'i 36 yetim qoldi --&gt; PID 1 ga &quot;meros&quot; o'tadi<br>Linux'da yetim process namespace'ning PID 1 iga beriladi; u reap qilmasa -&gt; zombie</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker exec app ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,cmd | awk '$3 ~ /Z/'<br># STAT &quot;Z&quot; = zombie<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/.../pids.current<br># Yechim:<br>docker run --init myapp          # tini PID 1 bo'ladi</pre><p>Dockerfile'da:</p><pre>RUN apk add --no-cache tini<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/sbin/tini&quot;,&quot;--&quot;,&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Zombie'ni <code>kill -9</code> bilan o'ldirib bo'lmaydi — u allaqachon o'lgan; parent'ni tuzatish yoki o'ldirish kerak.</li><li>K8s'da <code>shareProcessNamespace: true</code> bo'lsa pause container PID 1 bo'lib reap qiladi — boshqa xulq.</li><li>Zombie'lar xotira yemaydi, lekin PID va kernel task strukturasi egallaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p process ishga tushiradigan har container'ga init (tini, <code>--init</code>) standart bo'lsin. Yaxshiroq — bitta container'da bitta asosiy process va shell'ga chiqmaslik.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41020	<p><code>tini</code> / <code>dumb-init</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>tini</code> va <code>dumb-init</code> — container'da <b>PID 1</b> bo'lib ishlaydigan minimal init: ilovani child sifatida ishga tushiradi, kelgan signallarni (<code>SIGTERM</code>, <code>SIGINT</code>) unga <b>uzatadi</b> va yetim/zombie process'larni <b>reap</b> qiladi. <code>docker run --init</code> Docker'ga o'rnatilgan tini'ni qo'shadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> PID 1 kernel uchun maxsus: default signal handler'lar qo'llanmaydi va yetim process'lar unga tushadi. Oddiy ilova bu vazifalarga mo'ljallanmagan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PID 1 tini<br>  +-- PID 7 app<br>        +-- child'lar ...<br>SIGTERM --&gt; tini --&gt; app'ga uzatadi (dumb-init: butun process group'ga)<br>yetim tugadi --&gt; tini waitpid() --&gt; zombie yo'q<br>app exit code --&gt; tini shu kod bilan chiqadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM python:3.13-slim<br>RUN apt-get update &amp;&amp; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends tini &amp;&amp; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/usr/bin/tini&quot;,&quot;--&quot;]<br>CMD [&quot;gunicorn&quot;,&quot;app:app&quot;,&quot;-b&quot;,&quot;0.0.0.0:8000&quot;]</pre><pre>docker run --init --rm alpine sh -c 'sleep 100 &amp; sleep 100 &amp; wait' &amp;<br>docker exec &lt;id&gt; ps -o pid,cmd     # PID 1 = /sbin/docker-init (tini)</pre><p>K8s'da <code>--init</code> flag yo'q — tini'ni image'ga qo'shing.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova o'zi SIGTERM'ni ishlamasa tini ham yordam bermaydi — u faqat uzatadi.</li><li>Shell wrapper + tini: tini -&gt; sh -&gt; app; sh signalni yutadi — skriptda <code>exec</code> kerak.</li><li><code>dumb-init</code> signalni process group'ga yuboradi — ba'zi ilovalar ikki marta signal oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Go/Rust bitta binary, shell chaqirmaydi va SIGTERM'ni ishlaydi — init shart emas. Node, Python, shell skript va subprocess ishlatadigan har qanday image'da tini — arzon sug'urta.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41021	<p>Docker BuildKit nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> BuildKit — Docker'ning zamonaviy (23.0+ dan default) build engine'i: Dockerfile'ni dependency grafiga aylantirib mustaqil stage'larni <b>parallel</b> bajaradi, keraksiz stage'larni o'tkazib yuboradi, <b>cache mount</b>, <b>secret mount</b>, <b>SSH forwarding</b>, remote/registry cache va multi-platform build'ni qo'llaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Eski builder ketma-ket ishlardi, har build'da dependency'larni qayta yuklardi, secret'lar layer'ga tushib qolardi va CI'da cache yo'q edi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Dockerfile --&gt; LLB graf<br>  stage test ----\<br>  stage lint -----+--&gt; parallel<br>  stage build ---/ --&gt; final<br>cache: lokal / --cache-to type=registry / type=gha<br>RUN --mount=type=cache   -&gt; build'lar orasida saqlanadigan papka (layer'ga kirmaydi)<br>RUN --mount=type=secret  -&gt; faqat shu RUN vaqtida /run/secrets/...<br>RUN --mount=type=ssh     -&gt; host SSH agent (private git)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># syntax=docker/dockerfile:1<br>FROM node:22 AS deps<br>WORKDIR /app<br>COPY package*.json ./<br>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm ci<br>RUN --mount=type=ssh git clone git@github.com:corp/private.git</pre><pre>docker buildx build --ssh default \<br>  --cache-from type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/corp/api:cache \<br>  --cache-to type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/corp/api:cache,mode=max \<br>  -t ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 --push .<br>docker buildx du        # build cache hajmi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code># syntax=</code> qatorisiz yangi frontend xususiyatlari ishlamasligi mumkin.</li><li>CI'da ephemeral runner — cache export qilinmasa har build noldan.</li><li><code>mode=min</code> (default) faqat final stage cache'ini saqlaydi — multi-stage uchun <code>mode=max</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI build vaqtini qisqartirishning eng katta yutuqlari: to'g'ri layer tartibi + cache mount + registry cache. <code>docker buildx bake</code> bilan ko'p image'ni bitta deklarativ faylda parallel build qilish mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41022	<p>Multi-arch build (<code>docker buildx</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker buildx</code> bitta buyruq bilan bir nechta platforma (<code>linux/amd64</code>, <code>linux/arm64</code>, ...) uchun image yasab, ularni bitta tag ostida <b>multi-arch manifest list (OCI index)</b> ga yig'adi. Yasash QEMU emulyatsiyasi (binfmt_misc), native builder node'lar yoki cross-compilation orqali.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Jamoa Apple Silicon (arm64) da ishlaydi, prod esa Graviton (arm64) va x86 aralash. <code>amd64</code> image arm64 node'da <code>exec format error</code> beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t api:1 --push .<br>   amd64 builder --&gt; manifest A (digest a1)<br>   arm64 builder --&gt; manifest B (digest b2)<br>   index api:1 --&gt; [{amd64: a1}, {arm64: b2}]<br>pull'da client o'z arxitekturasiga mos manifest'ni tanlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run --privileged --rm tonistiigi/binfmt --install all   # QEMU<br>docker buildx create --name multi --use --bootstrap<br>docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 --push .<br>docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4</pre><p>Go'da emulyatsiyasiz tez cross-compile:</p><pre>FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.25 AS build<br>ARG TARGETOS TARGETARCH<br>RUN GOOS=$TARGETOS GOARCH=$TARGETARCH CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app .</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>QEMU orqali kompilyatsiya 5-20 baravar sekin — CI vaqti portlaydi.</li><li>Multi-platform natijani <code>--load</code> bilan lokal docker'ga yuklab bo'lmaydi (containerd image store'siz) — <code>--push</code> kerak.</li><li>Base image barcha platformani qo'llamasa build yiqiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng tez yo'l — <code>$BUILDPLATFORM</code> + cross-compile yoki har arxitektura uchun native runner (GitHub arm64 runner'lar) va keyin <code>imagetools create</code> bilan birlashtirish. arm64 (Graviton) ko'pincha 20-40% arzonroq — multi-arch'ga investitsiya o'zini oqlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41023	<p>OCI image manifest va manifest list nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Image manifest</b> — bitta platformadagi image'ni ta'riflaydigan JSON: config blob digest'i va layer'lar ro'yxati (digest, hajm, media type). <b>Manifest list / OCI image index</b> — bitta tag ostida bir nechta manifest'ni platforma (<code>os/arch/variant</code>) bo'yicha ko'rsatadigan yuqori darajali JSON.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>docker pull nginx</code> Mac M3 va x86 server'da turli binary olishi kerak, lekin tag bitta. Shuningdek layer'larni qayta yuklamaslik uchun ularni digest bo'yicha aniqlash kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>tag nginx:1.27 --&gt; index (sha256:aaa)<br>     +-- linux/amd64 --&gt; manifest (sha256:bbb)<br>     |       config: sha256:ccc (env, cmd, history)<br>     |       layers: sha256:d1, sha256:d2, sha256:d3<br>     +-- linux/arm64 --&gt; manifest (sha256:eee) --&gt; ...<br>     +-- (attestation manifest: SBOM/provenance)<br>Hammasi content-addressable: digest = sha256(JSON yoki blob)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker buildx imagetools inspect nginx:1.27 --raw | jq '.manifests[] | {platform, digest}'<br>skopeo inspect --raw docker://nginx:1.27 | jq .mediaType<br>skopeo inspect --raw --override-arch arm64 docker://nginx:1.27 | jq .   # bitta platforma<br>crane manifest nginx:1.27 | jq</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Index digest va platforma manifest digest'ini chalkashtirish — imzo/pin noto'g'ri narsaga.</li><li>BuildKit attestation'lari index'ga <code>unknown/unknown</code> platforma sifatida qo'shiladi — eski tool'lar chalkashadi.</li><li>Docker v2 (<code>application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json</code>) va OCI media type'lari farqi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Deploy'da index digest bilan pin qiling (<code>image@sha256:...</code>) — barcha arxitektura uchun o'zgarmas ma'lumot. Imzo va SBOM ham shu digest'ga referrers orqali bog'lanadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41024	<p>Docker bridge, host va none tarmoq rejimlari farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>bridge</b> (default) — container o'z NET namespace'ida private IP oladi, host'dagi Linux bridge (<code>docker0</code>) ga veth orqali ulanadi; tashqariga NAT, kirish <code>-p</code> port publish orqali. <b>host</b> — container host'ning tarmoq stack'ini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatadi (izolyatsiya yo'q, NAT yo'q). <b>none</b> — faqat loopback.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki container 8080 da tinglashi va bir-birini nom bilan topishi kerak (bridge); yoki maksimal tarmoq performansi kerak (host); yoki batch tarmoqsiz ishlashi kerak (none).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bridge:<br> container eth0 172.18.0.2 &lt;--veth--&gt; br-xxx (172.18.0.1) --iptables NAT--&gt; host eth0<br> -p 8080:80  --&gt; DNAT host:8080 -&gt; 172.18.0.2:80<br> user-defined bridge: ichki DNS (127.0.0.11) container nomini resolve qiladi<br>host:<br> container == host tarmog'i; app :80 = host :80<br>none:<br> faqat lo</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker network create appnet<br>docker run -d --name db --network appnet postgres:17<br>docker run --rm --network appnet alpine ping -c1 db      # nom bilan topadi<br>docker run -d --network host nginx                       # host:80 band<br>docker run --rm --network none alpine ip a               # faqat lo<br>docker network inspect appnet | jq '.[0].Containers'<br>sudo iptables -t nat -L DOCKER -n</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default <code>bridge</code> tarmog'ida nom bilan DNS ishlamaydi — user-defined network yarating.</li><li><code>-p 5432:5432</code> barcha interfeysda (0.0.0.0) ochadi — <code>-p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432</code> yozing.</li><li>Docker Desktop (Mac/Windows) da <code>--network host</code> boshqacha ishlaydi (VM ichida).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da DB portlarini publish qilmang — faqat ichki network. Host networking'ni faqat o'lchangan zarurat (yuqori PPS, multicast) bo'lsa ishlating — port to'qnashuvi va izolyatsiya yo'qligi narxi bor.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41025	<p>Docker Swarm va Kubernetes farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Docker Swarm</b> — Docker Engine'ga o'rnatilgan oddiy klasterlash: <code>docker swarm init</code>, Compose fayl bilan <code>stack deploy</code>, routing mesh, secret'lar; o'rganish oson, lekin ekotizim kichik va rivojlanishi sekin (Mirantis qo'llab-quvvatlaydi). <b>Kubernetes</b> — sanoat standarti: deklarativ API + controller'lar, HPA/autoscaling, kengaytiriladigan CRD/operator, boy storage/network ekotizimi, lekin ancha murakkab.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 3 ta server, 10 ta servis va kichik jamoa — K8s ortiqchami? Yoki 200 servis, multi-tenant — Swarm yetmaydimi?</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Swarm: manager x3 (Raft) --&gt; worker'lar; service = replicas + image; ingress routing mesh<br>K8s:   API server + etcd + scheduler + controllers --&gt; kubelet'lar<br>       Deployment, Service, Ingress, HPA, CRD/Operator, RBAC, NetworkPolicy</pre><p>| | Swarm | Kubernetes | |---|---|---| | O'rganish | soatlar | haftalar-oylar | | Autoscaling | yo'q (tashqi) | HPA, VPA, Karpenter | | Ekotizim | kichik | ulkan (Helm, operator, mesh) | | Managed | deyarli yo'q | EKS, GKE, AKS | | Kengaytirish | cheklangan | CRD + controller |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker swarm init<br>docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml shop<br>docker service ls; docker service scale shop_api=5<br><br>kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml<br>kubectl autoscale deployment api --cpu-percent=60 --min=2 --max=20</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Swarm'da stateful yuklama va volume boshqaruvi zaif.</li><li>K8s'ni &quot;rezyume uchun&quot; tanlash — kichik jamoada operatsion yuk mahsulotdan ko'p.</li><li>Swarm'ni tanlab, keyin K8s'ga ko'chish narxini hisobga olmaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 2026 da yangi loyiha uchun real tanlov odatda Swarm vs K8s emas, balki &quot;managed PaaS (ECS/Fargate, Cloud Run) vs managed K8s&quot;. Swarm faqat juda kichik, on-prem va Docker'ni yaxshi biladigan jamoa uchun mantiqli.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41026	<p>Container healthcheck (<code>HEALTHCHECK</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>HEALTHCHECK</code> — Dockerfile instruktsiyasi: Docker Engine container ichida berilgan buyruqni muntazam bajaradi, exit 0 = healthy, 1 = unhealthy. Holat <code>docker ps</code> da ko'rinadi va Swarm/Compose <code>depends_on: condition: service_healthy</code> uchun ishlatadi. <b>Kubernetes uni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi</b> — o'z liveness/readiness/startup probe'larini ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Process tirik (container &quot;Up&quot;), lekin ilova deadlock'da yoki DB'ga ulana olmayapti. Orkestrator buni bilishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>start --&gt; start-period (60s: xatolar hisoblanmaydi)<br>har interval (30s): CMD timeout(3s) ichida<br>   exit 0 --&gt; healthy<br>   exit 1 x retries(3) --&gt; unhealthy<br>Docker o'zi restart QILMAYDI; Swarm qayta yaratadi, Compose depends_on kutadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=60s --retries=3 \<br>  CMD [&quot;/app&quot;,&quot;healthcheck&quot;]</pre><p>(distroless'da <code>curl</code> yo'q — ilovaning o'zida <code>healthcheck</code> subcommand yaxshi.)</p><pre>docker ps   # STATUS: Up 2 minutes (healthy)<br>docker inspect -f '{{json .State.Health}}' app | jq '.Log[-1]'</pre><p>K8s ekvivalenti:</p><pre>readinessProbe: {httpGet: {path: /readyz, port: 8080}, periodSeconds: 5}<br>livenessProbe:  {httpGet: {path: /livez,  port: 8080}, failureThreshold: 3}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Health check tashqi bog'liqlikni (DB) tekshirsa — DB yiqilganda hamma container restart siklida (cascade).</li><li><code>curl</code> ni faqat healthcheck uchun image'ga qo'shish — hujum yuzasi.</li><li>start-period yo'q — sekin start bo'ladigan JVM ilovasi doim unhealthy.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Liveness = &quot;process tuzalmas holatdami&quot; (faqat ichki), readiness = &quot;trafik qabul qila oladimi&quot; (bog'liqliklar bilan). Bu ikkalasini aralashtirish production'dagi eng ko'p uchraydigan o'z-o'zini DDoS qilish sababi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41027	<p>Docker volume, bind mount va tmpfs farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Volume</b> — Docker boshqaradigan storage (<code>/var/lib/docker/volumes/</code>), nom bilan, container'dan mustaqil yashaydi, driver'lar (NFS, cloud) qo'llanadi. <b>Bind mount</b> — host'dagi aniq yo'lni container'ga ulash (dev'da kod uchun qulay). <b>tmpfs</b> — faqat RAM'da, diskka yozilmaydi, container to'xtasa yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Container o'chirilsa uning yozish qatlami ham yo'qoladi.
