Postgres ma'lumoti, dev'da jonli kod o'zgarishi va vaqtinchalik secret fayllari uchun turli yechim kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>volume:  pgdata (Docker) --&gt; /var/lib/docker/volumes/pgdata/_data --&gt; container:/var/lib/postgresql/data<br>bind:    /home/me/project --&gt; container:/app        (host yo'li, host UID/ruxsatlari)<br>tmpfs:   RAM --&gt; container:/run/secrets  (size cheklovi bilan)</pre><p>| | Volume | Bind mount | tmpfs | |---|---|---|---| | Boshqaruv | Docker | siz (host yo'li) | kernel RAM | | Saqlanadi | ha | ha (host'da) | yo'q | | Portativ | ha | yo'q (host'ga bog'liq) | - | | Ishlatish | DB, prod data | dev kod, config | cache, secret |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker volume create pgdata<br>docker run -d -v pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:17<br>docker run --rm -v &quot;$PWD&quot;:/app:ro -w /app node:22 node test.js<br>docker run --rm --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=64m,noexec alpine df -h /tmp<br>docker volume ls; docker volume inspect pgdata<br># backup<br>docker run --rm -v pgdata:/data -v &quot;$PWD&quot;:/bk alpine tar czf /bk/pg.tgz -C /data .</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bind mount bo'sh bo'lmagan papka ustiga — image ichidagi fayllar yashirinadi.</li><li><code>docker compose down -v</code> / <code>docker system prune --volumes</code> — ma'lumot butunlay o'chadi.</li><li>Bind mount'da UID mos kelmasligi — <code>Permission denied</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da DB'ni bitta host volume'ida ishlatish — o'sha host = SPOF; managed DB yoki replikatsiyali storage afzal. Read-only (<code>:ro</code>) va <code>noexec</code> opsiyalari arzon xavfsizlik qatlami.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41028	<p>Docker Compose nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Docker Compose — ko'p container'li ilovani (servislar, tarmoqlar, volume'lar, env, healthcheck, bog'liqliklar) bitta deklarativ <b><code>compose.yaml</code></b> da ta'riflab, <code>docker compose up</code> bilan ko'tarish vositasi. Compose v2 — <code>docker</code> CLI plagini (eski <code>docker-compose</code> v1 Python'da, deprecated). <code>version:</code> kaliti endi kerak emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Lokal muhitda API + Postgres + Redis + worker kerak. Har birini uzun <code>docker run</code> bilan ishga tushirish, tarmoq va tartibni qo'lda boshqarish — xatoga moyil.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>compose.yaml --&gt; docker compose up<br>   project tarmog'i &lt;proj&gt;_default yaratiladi (servis nomi = DNS)<br>   depends_on + healthcheck bo'yicha tartib<br>   volume'lar &lt;proj&gt;_pgdata</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    build: .<br>    ports: [&quot;127.0.0.1:8080:8080&quot;]<br>    environment:<br>      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:app@db:5432/app<br>    depends_on:<br>      db: {condition: service_healthy}<br>    develop:<br>      watch: [{action: sync, path: ./src, target: /app/src}]<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:17<br>    environment: {POSTGRES_USER: app, POSTGRES_PASSWORD: app}<br>    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]<br>    healthcheck:<br>      test: [&quot;CMD-SHELL&quot;,&quot;pg_isready -U app&quot;]<br>      interval: 5s<br>volumes: {pgdata: {}}</pre><pre>docker compose up -d --build<br>docker compose ps; docker compose logs -f api<br>docker compose watch          # kod o'zgarsa avtomatik sync/rebuild<br>docker compose down           # -v qo'shsangiz data ham o'chadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>depends_on</code> healthcheck'siz faqat start tartibini kafolatlaydi, tayyorlikni emas.</li><li>Secret'larni <code>environment</code> ga yozib git'ga commit qilish — <code>.env</code> + <code>.gitignore</code> yoki <code>secrets:</code>.</li><li>Compose'ni ko'p server'li prod orkestrator deb ishlatish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Compose — lokal dev va integration test'lar (CI'da) uchun ideal; <code>profiles</code> va override fayllar bilan muhitlarni ajrating. Prod'ga yaqinlik uchun bir xil image'ni ishlating, faqat config farq qilsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes

Har instruktsiyani userspace'da bajarib, fayl tizimi snapshot'idan layer yasaydi va registry'ga push qiladi. Diqqat: Google 2025 da loyihani arxivladi; Chainguard fork'i davom etmoqda, ko'p jamoa BuildKit rootless yoki Buildah'ga o'tmoqda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> K8s'dagi CI runner'da image build qilish kerak. Asosiy printsip o'zgarmaydi: CI'da daemon socket va privileged yo'q.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41030	<p>Buildah, Podman va Skopeo farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Red Hat'ning daemonsiz uchligi: <b>Buildah</b> — OCI image <b>build</b> qilish (Dockerfile yoki skript bilan); <b>Podman</b> — container va <b>pod</b>'larni ishga tushirish, Docker CLI bilan mos (<code>alias docker=podman</code>); <b>Skopeo</b> — image'larni lokal yuklamasdan registry'lar orasida <b>inspect, copy, sync, sign/delete</b> qilish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Docker monolit daemon (root) — build, run va registry ishlarining hammasini bitta privilegiyali process orqali. Podman + Quadlet esa bitta server'dagi container servislar uchun K8s'siz yengil, systemd-native yechim.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41031	<p>Docker build'ga secret'ni image tarixida ko'rinmaydigan qilib qanday uzatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> BuildKit <b>secret mount</b>: <code>RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci</code> va build'da <code>docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=$HOME/.npmrc .</code>. Secret faqat shu <code>RUN</code> davomida tmpfs'ga mount qilinadi va <b>hech qaysi layer'ga yozilmaydi</b>. <code>ARG</code>/<code>ENV</code>/<code>COPY</code> bilan secret berish — <code>docker history</code> va layer'larda qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Private npm/pip registry tokeni yoki git kaliti build vaqtida kerak. <code>ARG NPM_TOKEN</code> bilan bersangiz, image'ni olgan har kim tokenni ko'radi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ARG TOKEN  --&gt; image config/history'da ochiq      (YOMON)<br>COPY .npmrc + RUN rm --&gt; oldingi layer'da qoladi  (YOMON)<br>RUN --mount=type=secret --&gt; /run/secrets/&lt;id&gt; faqat shu RUN vaqtida, layer'da yo'q (YAXSHI)<br>RUN --mount=type=ssh --&gt; host SSH agent socket'i forward (kalit image'ga kirmaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># syntax=docker/dockerfile:1<br>FROM node:22 AS deps<br>WORKDIR /app<br>COPY package*.json ./<br>RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci<br># env sifatida ham mumkin:<br>RUN --mount=type=secret,id=gh_token,env=GH_TOKEN ./fetch-private.sh</pre><pre>docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=$HOME/.npmrc --secret id=gh_token,env=GH_TOKEN -t api .<br>docker history --no-trunc api | grep -i token     # hech narsa chiqmasligi kerak</pre><p>GitHub Actions: <code>docker/build-push-action</code> ning <code>secrets:</code> maydoni.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret qiymatini <code>RUN echo $X &gt; file</code> bilan faylga yozish — u holda layer'ga tushadi.</li><li>Multi-stage'da ham <code>ARG</code> final stage'ga o'tmasa ham build cache/registry cache'da qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Secret o'zgarsa BuildKit cache'ni bekor qilmaydi — kutilmagan eski natija.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Image'ni secret skaner (trivy <code>--scanners secret</code>, gitleaks) bilan CI'da tekshiring. Eng yaxshisi — build vaqtida umuman uzoq muddatli secret kerak bo'lmasin: OIDC bilan qisqa muddatli registry token.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41032	<p>Docker'da layer caching qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har Dockerfile instruktsiyasi layer va cache kalitiga ega. Builder har qadamda: oldingi layer bir xilmi <b>va</b> instruktsiya matni bir xilmi (<code>COPY</code>/<code>ADD</code> uchun fayllar checksum'i ham) — ha bo'lsa cache'dan oladi. Bitta qadam o'zgarsa, <b>undan keyingi hammasi</b> qayta bajariladi. Shuning uchun kam o'zgaradigan narsa yuqorida, tez o'zgaradigan pastda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har kod o'zgarishida <code>npm ci</code> 3 daqiqa qayta ishlaydi — chunki <code>COPY . .</code> dependency o'rnatishdan oldin turibdi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>YOMON:                         YAXSHI:<br>FROM node:22                   FROM node:22<br>COPY . .          &lt;- har safar COPY package*.json ./   &lt;- kamdan-kam o'zgaradi<br>RUN npm ci        &lt;- qayta!    RUN npm ci                &lt;- CACHED<br>                               COPY . .                  &lt;- faqat shu va keyingilar</pre><p><code>RUN</code> uchun faqat buyruq matni tekshiriladi: <code>RUN apt-get update</code> tashqi o'zgarishni sezmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker build --progress=plain -t api . 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -E 'CACHED|RUN'<br>docker build --no-cache -t api .                # hammasini qayta<br>docker build --no-cache-filter deps -t api .    # faqat bitta stage</pre><p>CI'da cache saqlash:</p><pre>docker buildx build --cache-from type=gha --cache-to type=gha,mode=max -t api .</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>RUN apt-get update</code> alohida qatorda — eski indeks cache'da qoladi; <code>update &amp;&amp; install</code> bitta RUN'da.</li><li><code>.dockerignore</code> yo'q — <code>.git</code> o'zgarishi <code>COPY . .</code> cache'ini har safar buzadi.</li><li><code>ARG BUILD_DATE</code> ni boshida e'lon qilib ishlatish — har build'da hamma narsa invalid.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cache — reproducibility'ga ham ta'sir qiladi: base image'ni digest bilan pin qiling va rejalashtirilgan <code>--pull --no-cache</code> rebuild'lar bilan xavfsizlik patch'larini oling. Cache mount'lar (<code>--mount=type=cache</code>) layer cache buzilganda ham paket yuklashni tejaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41033	<p><code>.dockerignore</code> nima va nega muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.dockerignore</code> — build context'dan (builder'ga yuboriladigan papkadan) chiqarib tashlanadigan fayllar ro'yxati, <code>.gitignore</code> sintaksisiga o'xshash. Natija: tezroq build, barqaror cache va <code>.env</code>, kalitlar, <code>.git</code> kabi narsalar image'ga tasodifan tushmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>COPY . .</code> bilan 2 GB <code>node_modules</code>, <code>.git</code> tarixi va <code>.env</code> (prod parollari) image'ga kirdi; image public registry'ga push qilindi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker build .  --&gt; context (butun papka) --&gt; BuildKit<br>   .dockerignore filtri context yuborilishidan OLDIN qo'llanadi<br>   COPY . .  faqat filtrdan o'tganlarni ko'radi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># .dockerignore<br>.git<br>.github<br>node_modules<br>dist<br>coverage<br>*.log<br>.env<br>.env.*<br>!.env.example<br>**/*.pem<br>Dockerfile*<br>compose*.yaml</pre><pre># context hajmini ko'rish<br>docker build --progress=plain . 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep 'transferring context'<br># image ichida nima borligini tekshirish<br>docker run --rm --entrypoint sh api -c 'ls -la /app; ls -la /app/.env 2&gt;/dev/null'</pre><p>Har Dockerfile uchun alohida: <code>api.Dockerfile</code> + <code>api.Dockerfile.dockerignore</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.dockerignore</code> faqat context ildizida ishlaydi — subpapkadagi fayl e'tiborsiz.</li><li>Allowlist uslubi (<code>*</code> keyin <code>!src</code>) kuchli, lekin kerakli faylni unutish oson.</li><li><code>node_modules</code> ni ignore qilib, keyin host'dagi native modullarni kutish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Allowlist yondashuvi (<code>*</code> + <code>!kerakli</code>) secret oqishiga eng chidamli. Bundan tashqari CI'da image'ni secret skaner bilan tekshirish — <code>.dockerignore</code> xato qilinsa ham ikkinchi himoya.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41034	<p>CSI (Container Storage Interface) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CSI (Container Storage Interface) — orkestrator (K8s, Nomad) va storage provayderi o'rtasidagi <b>standart gRPC interfeysi</b>. Storage vendor (EBS, EFS, Ceph, Portworx, NetApp) K8s kodiga tegmasdan driver yozadi; K8s <code>PersistentVolumeClaim</code> orqali disklarni yaratadi, ulaydi, kengaytiradi va snapshot oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilgari storage driver'lar K8s ichida (in-tree) edi — har bugfix uchun K8s release kutilardi va kod bazasi shishardi. In-tree driver'lar endi olib tashlangan/CSI'ga ko'chirilgan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PVC (10Gi, sc=gp3) --&gt; external-provisioner --CSI CreateVolume--&gt; controller plugin --&gt; AWS API<br>Pod schedule --&gt; external-attacher --ControllerPublish--&gt; diskni node'ga ulash<br>kubelet --NodeStage/NodePublish--&gt; node plugin (DaemonSet) --&gt; format + mount --&gt; pod<br>Qo'shimcha: resizer (ExpandVolume), snapshotter (CreateSnapshot)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: StorageClass<br>metadata: {name: gp3}<br>provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com<br>parameters: {type: gp3, encrypted: &quot;true&quot;}<br>volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer<br>allowVolumeExpansion: true<br>reclaimPolicy: Delete</pre><pre>kubectl get csidrivers<br>kubectl get pvc,pv<br>kubectl describe pvc data-db-0     # Events: provisioning xatolari<br>kubectl get volumeattachments</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>volumeBindingMode: Immediate</code> — disk boshqa AZ'da yaratiladi, pod schedule bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>reclaimPolicy: Delete</code> prod DB uchun — PVC o'chsa disk ham ketadi.</li><li>CSI driver IAM ruxsati (IRSA/Pod Identity) yo'q — PVC <code>Pending</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stateful K8s'da muammolar ko'pincha CSI darajasida (attach timeout, AZ mos kelmasligi, multi-attach). StorageClass'larni platforma jamoasi standartlashtirib, VolumeSnapshot bilan backup'ni avtomatlashtirsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41035	<p>CNI (Container Network Interface) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CNI (Container Network Interface) — container/pod uchun tarmoq interfeysi yaratish, IP berish (IPAM) va routing sozlashning standart spetsifikatsiyasi. Runtime pod yaratganda CNI plugin binary'sini <code>ADD</code>/<code>DEL</code>/<code>CHECK</code> buyruqlari bilan chaqiradi. Implementatsiyalar: Calico, Cilium (eBPF), Flannel, AWS VPC CNI, Azure CNI.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> K8s modeli: har pod o'z IP'iga ega, barcha pod'lar NAT'siz bir-biriga yetadi. Buni turli muhitlarda (bare metal, AWS, overlay) qanday qilishni K8s o'zi hal qilmaydi — CNI'ga topshiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubelet --&gt; containerd --&gt; pod sandbox (NET ns) yaratildi<br>   --&gt; CNI plugin ADD (stdin: config JSON, env: CNI_NETNS, CNI_IFNAME)<br>       --&gt; veth juftligi / ENI, IP (IPAM), route, (overlay VXLAN yoki BGP yoki VPC routing)<br>   &lt;-- natija: IP 10.244.1.23<br>NetworkPolicy ijrosi ham CNI'da (Calico, Cilium); Flannel qo'llamaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls /etc/cni/net.d/ /opt/cni/bin/<br>cat /etc/cni/net.d/10-*.conflist | jq<br>kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=cilium<br>cilium status; cilium connectivity test<br>kubectl get pod -o wide        # pod IP'lari</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>AWS VPC CNI'da pod IP'lari subnet'dan — subnet kichik bo'lsa pod'lar <code>Pending</code> (IP yo'q).</li><li>CNI'ni ishlab turgan klasterda almashtirish — deyarli har doim downtime va qayta yaratish.</li><li>NetworkPolicy yozildi, lekin CNI uni qo'llamaydi — hech narsa bloklanmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CNI tanlovi klaster hayoti davomidagi eng qiyin o'zgartiriladigan qarorlardan biri: NetworkPolicy, observability (Hubble), kube-proxy almashtirish (eBPF), IP rejasi. 2026 da Cilium amalda default tanlovga aylangan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41036	<p>CRI (Container Runtime Interface) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CRI (Container Runtime Interface) — <code>kubelet</code> va container runtime o'rtasidagi <b>gRPC API</b> (RuntimeService: pod sandbox va container lifecycle; ImageService: pull/list/remove). Hammasi namespace/cgroup kabi kernel primitivlarini ishlatadi, lekin maqsad va ekotizim boshqa.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;GIMP'ni Docker'da ishlataymi?&quot; yoki &quot;API'ni Snap qilib deploy qilaymi?&quot; — noto'g'ri tool tanlash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><p>| | Flatpak | Snap | Docker/OCI | |---|---|---|---| | Maqsad | desktop GUI | desktop + CLI + IoT/server daemon | server servislar | | Sandbox | bubblewrap + portal'lar | AppArmor + seccomp | namespace + seccomp/LSM | | Tarqatish | Flathub | Snap Store (Canonical, markaziy) | istalgan OCI registry | | Runtime | umumiy runtime'lar (GNOME, KDE) | squashfs, core snap | base image | | Yangilanish | foydalanuvchi/avtomatik | avtomatik (majburiy) | deploy orqali | | Orkestratsiya | yo'q | yo'q | K8s, Swarm, Nomad |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>flatpak install flathub org.gimp.GIMP<br>flatpak info --show-permissions org.gimp.GIMP<br>snap install lxd; snap connections lxd<br>docker run -d -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Snap'ning majburiy avtomatik yangilanishi — server'da kutilmagan restart (<code>snap refresh --hold</code>).</li><li>GUI ilovani Docker'da ishlatish — X11/Wayland socket mount = sandbox teshigi.</li><li>Flatpak &quot;sandbox&quot;i ko'p ilovada <code>--filesystem=host</code> bilan amalda ochiq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov — iste'molchi kim: oxirgi foydalanuvchi kompyuteri (Flatpak/Snap) yoki infra/orkestrator (OCI). Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41045	<p>Container'da fork bomb nima va qanday oldi olinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Fork bomb — o'zini cheksiz ko'paytiradigan process (<code>:(){ :|:&amp; };:</code>) — bir necha soniyada kernel PID/task jadvalini to'ldiradi va host'da yangi process (hatto SSH) ishga tushmay qoladi. Container'da oldi cgroup <b>PID limiti</b> bilan olinadi: <code>docker run --pids-limit</code>, K8s'da kubelet <code>podPidsLimit</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> PID'lar butun host uchun umumiy resurs (<code>kernel.pid_max</code>). Bitta buzuq yoki zararli container butun node'ni ishlamay qoldirishi mumkin — CPU/RAM limiti bunga yordam bermaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>:(){ :|:&amp; };:<br> f -&gt; f|f -&gt; 4 -&gt; 8 -&gt; 16 ... 2^n<br>pids.max=200 bo'lgan cgroup:<br> 201-chi fork() --&gt; EAGAIN (&quot;Resource temporarily unavailable&quot;)<br> faqat shu container zarar ko'radi, host va boshqa pod'lar ishlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run --rm -it --pids-limit 100 alpine sh -c ':(){ :|:&amp; };:'<br># sh: can't fork: Resource temporarily unavailable — host xavfsiz<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-&lt;id&gt;.scope/pids.max<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-&lt;id&gt;.scope/pids.events   # max N — necha marta urildi</pre><p>K8s kubelet config:</p><pre>apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1<br>kind: KubeletConfiguration<br>podPidsLimit: 4096<br>systemReserved: {pid: &quot;1000&quot;}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Limit juda past — Java/Go ilovalar thread'lar uchun ham PID ishlatadi (har thread = task).</li><li>Docker'da default PID limit yo'q.</li><li><code>ulimit -u</code> (nproc) user bo'yicha, container'lar orasida bir xil UID bo'lsa chalkashadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Node darajasida <code>podPidsLimit</code> va <code>pid</code> eviction chegaralarini standart qiling — bu bitta pod'ning butun node'ni &quot;o'ldirishi&quot; ga qarshi arzon himoya. <code>pids.events</code> metrikasiga alert qo'ying: limitga urilish ko'pincha thread oqishining belgisi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41046	<p>Container'da memory swappiness nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--memory-swappiness</code> (0-100) — xotira bosimi paytida kernel shu container'ning <b>anonymous</b> sahifalarini (heap) swap'ga chiqarishga qanchalik moyilligini belgilaydi: 0 — iloji boricha swap qilma (page cache'ni avval bo'shat), 100 — agressiv swap. Bu cgroup <b>v1</b> sozlamasi; cgroup v2'da per-cgroup swappiness yo'q — o'rniga <code>memory.swap.max</code> (<code>--memory-swap</code>) ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Latency'ga sezgir servis heap'i swap'ga chiqib, javob vaqti 10 ms dan soniyalarga sakraydi. Boshqa tomondan, swap'ni butunlay o'chirish OOM kill'ni tezlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>xotira bosimi --&gt; kernel reclaim:<br>   page cache (fayl sahifalari) --&gt; diskdan qayta o'qilishi mumkin, bo'shatish arzon<br>   anonymous (heap) --&gt; faqat swap'ga yozib bo'shatiladi<br>swappiness past --&gt; page cache avval qurbon; yuqori --&gt; heap ham swap'ga<br>v2: memory.swap.max=0 --&gt; bu cgroup umuman swap ishlatmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># cgroup v1<br>docker run -d --memory 512m --memory-swappiness 0 myapp<br># cgroup v2: swap limiti bilan boshqarish<br>docker run -d --memory 512m --memory-swap 512m myapp     # swap = 0 qo'shimcha<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/.../memory.swap.max /sys/fs/cgroup/.../memory.swap.current<br>vmstat 1          # si/so ustunlari — swap in/out</pre><p>K8s: 1.34 da <code>NodeSwap</code> GA — <code>LimitedSwap</code> rejimida faqat Burstable pod'lar swap oladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>cgroup v2 host'da <code>--memory-swappiness</code> e'tiborsiz qoldiriladi (ogohlantirish bilan).</li><li><code>--memory-swap</code> = <code>--memory</code> ning ikki baravari default — kutilmagan swap.</li><li>Swap bilan &quot;OOM yo'q, lekin servis amalda o'lik&quot; holati — thrashing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Latency servislar uchun swap'siz + to'g'ri memory limit + <code>memory.high</code>; batch/kam muhim yuklama uchun cheklangan swap zichlikni oshiradi. Qaror PSI <code>memory.pressure</code> metrikasi bilan o'lchab qabul qilinsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41047	<p>OOMKilled (exit code 137) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OOMKilled — container cgroup xotira limitidan (<code>--memory</code> / K8s <code>limits.memory</code>) oshganda kernel <b>OOM killer</b> process'ni <code>SIGKILL</code> bilan o'ldiradi; exit code <b>137</b> = 128 + 9. K8s'da <code>Last State: Terminated, Reason: OOMKilled</code> ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Pod har 2 soatda restart bo'ladi, log'da hech qanday xato yo'q (SIGKILL — ilova hech narsa yozishga ulgurmaydi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>memory.current yaqinlashadi memory.max (512Mi)<br>  --&gt; kernel reclaim (page cache bo'shatish)<br>  --&gt; yetmasa --&gt; cgroup OOM --&gt; eng katta oom_score process --&gt; SIGKILL<br>exit 137 --&gt; kubelet restart (CrashLoopBackOff bo'lishi mumkin)<br>Node OOM (limit yo'q pod'lar) --&gt; boshqa, sizniki bo'lmagan pod'lar ham o'lishi mumkin</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl describe pod api-7f9 | grep -A5 'Last State'<br>#   Reason: OOMKilled   Exit Code: 137<br>kubectl top pod api-7f9 --containers<br>docker inspect -f '{{.State.OOMKilled}} {{.State.ExitCode}}' app<br>dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process'<br># Prometheus<br># container_memory_working_set_bytes / container_spec_memory_limit_bytes</pre><p>Ilova tomonda: JVM <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75</code>, Go <code>GOMEMLIMIT=400MiB</code>, Node <code>--max-old-space-size</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Exit 137 har doim OOM emas — <code>docker stop</code> timeout'dagi SIGKILL ham 137; <code>OOMKilled</code> maydonini tekshiring.</li><li>Runtime heap limitini container limitiga moslamaslik — GC &quot;xotira ko'p&quot; deb yig'maydi.</li><li>Limitni shunchaki oshirish — oqish (leak) bo'lsa faqat kechiktiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>requests.memory = limits.memory</code> (Guaranteed QoS) xotira uchun eng bashorat qilinadigan rejim. OOM'ni metrika bilan oldindan ko'ring: working set'ning limitga nisbati &gt;90% — alert; keyin heap profiling (pprof, heap dump) bilan sababni toping.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41048	<p>CPU CFS throttling nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CFS throttling — CPU <b>limit</b> <code>cpu.max</code> (kvota/davr) bilan majburlanadi: davr odatda 100 ms. Container o'z kvotasini (masalan 1 CPU = 100 ms CPU vaqti, lekin 4 thread bilan 25 ms real vaqtda) davr oxirigacha tugatsa, qolgan vaqt <b>muzlatiladi</b> — so'rovlar kutib qoladi va p99 latency sakraydi, hatto o'rtacha CPU past bo'lsa ham.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dashboard'da CPU 30%, lekin p99 latency 200 ms. Sabab — ko'p thread'li ilova har davr boshida kvotani yeb, qolgan qismida throttled.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>limit 1 CPU: cpu.max = &quot;100000 100000&quot;<br>davr 100ms:  [4 thread x 25ms = 100ms kvota tugadi][----- 75ms THROTTLED -----]<br>             so'rov shu 75ms ichida kelsa -&gt; kutadi<br>nr_throttled / nr_periods yuqori = muammo</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/.../cpu.stat<br># nr_periods 12000  nr_throttled 3400  throttled_usec 98000000</pre><p>PromQL:</p><pre>rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m])<br>  / rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m]) &gt; 0.25</pre><p>Yechimlar: limitni olib tashlash yoki oshirish (requests'ni to'g'ri qo'yib); runtime thread sonini limitga moslash (Go 1.25+ GOMAXPROCS'ni avtomatik moslaydi, eski versiyalarda <code>automaxprocs</code>; JVM <code>-XX:ActiveProcessorCount</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>O'rtacha CPU utilization throttling'ni yashiradi — throttle nisbatini kuzating.</li><li>GOMAXPROCS = node yadrolari soni (64), limit 2 CPU — og'ir throttling.</li><li>Limitlarni olib tashlab, requests'ni ham noto'g'ri qoldirish — noisy neighbor.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoalar latency servislar uchun CPU <b>limit qo'ymaydi</b>, faqat to'g'ri <b>requests</b> (CPU — siqiladigan resurs, CFS shares adolatli taqsimlaydi); xotira limiti esa doim bo'lsin. Qaror throttle metrikasi va load test bilan qabul qilinsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41049	<p><code>seccomp</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> seccomp (secure computing mode) — kernel mexanizmi: process qaysi <b>syscall</b>'larni (va qaysi argumentlar bilan) chaqira olishini BPF filtr bilan cheklaydi. Docker default profili ~44 ta xavfli syscall'ni bloklaydi (<code>reboot</code>, <code>kexec_load</code>, <code>mount</code>, <code>keyctl</code>, <code>bpf</code>, ...). K8s'da <code>seccompProfile: RuntimeDefault</code> — runtime default profili (K8s'da u avtomatik yoqilmaydi, siz belgilashingiz kerak).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kernel ~400 ta syscall taqdim etadi; ilovaga odatda 50-100 tasi kerak. Har ortiqcha syscall — kernel zaifligidan foydalanish uchun eshik.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>process --syscall(unshare)--&gt; seccomp BPF filtr<br>   allow  --&gt; kernel bajaradi<br>   errno  --&gt; EPERM qaytaradi (Docker default xulqi)<br>   kill   --&gt; process o'ldiriladi<br>   log    --&gt; audit log, ruxsat beriladi (profil yozishda foydali)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run --rm alpine unshare -r id          # default profil: Operation not permitted<br>docker run --rm --security-opt seccomp=unconfined alpine unshare -r id   # ishlaydi (xavfli)<br>grep Seccomp /proc/$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' app)/status   # 2 = filtr faol</pre><p>K8s:</p><pre>securityContext:<br>  seccompProfile:<br>    type: RuntimeDefault        # yoki Localhost + localhostProfile: profiles/api.json</pre><p>Kubelet <code>--seccomp-default</code> bilan barcha pod'lar uchun RuntimeDefault default qilish mumkin.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>K8s'da seccomp default'da <b>Unconfined</b> (kubelet flag'isiz) — ko'pchilik buni bilmaydi.</li><li><code>seccomp=unconfined</code> ni &quot;tez yechim&quot; sifatida qo'yish.</li><li>Custom profil yozib, runtime/libc yangilanishida yangi syscall (masalan <code>clone3</code>) bloklanib qolishi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Minimal qadam — hamma joyda RuntimeDefault (PSS <code>restricted</code> buni talab qiladi). Yuqori xavfli servislar uchun Security Profiles Operator bilan <code>log</code> rejimida haqiqiy syscall'larni yozib, aniq profil yarating.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41050	<p>Container'lar uchun AppArmor / SELinux nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AppArmor va SELinux — Linux <b>Mandatory Access Control (MAC)</b> modullari (LSM): process root bo'lsa ham, profil/policy ruxsat bermagan fayl, capability va tarmoq operatsiyalarini kernel bloklaydi. <b>AppArmor</b> — yo'l (path) asosidagi profillar (Ubuntu/Debian/SUSE); <b>SELinux</b> — label (type, MCS category) asosida (RHEL/Fedora/OpenShift). Docker/Podman container'larga default profil (<code>docker-default</code>, <code>container_t</code>) qo'yadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Container escape'dan keyin hujumchi host fayllariga (<code>/etc/shadow</code>, boshqa container volume'lari) yetishi kerak — MAC aynan shu qadamni to'xtatadi. SELinux MCS har container'ni boshqasidan ham ajratadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SELinux: process label  system_u:system_r:container_t:s0:c12,c87<br>         fayl label     system_u:object_r:container_file_t:s0:c12,c87<br>         policy: container_t faqat o'z MCS (c12,c87) faylini o'qiy oladi<br>AppArmor: profil docker-default: deny mount, deny /proc/sys/** w, deny /sys/firmware/** ...</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># SELinux<br>getenforce                                 # Enforcing<br>ps -eZ | grep container_t<br>podman run -v /data:/data:Z alpine ls /data   # :Z — volume'ni qayta label'lash<br>ausearch -m avc -ts recent                 # bloklangan urinishlar<br><br># AppArmor<br>aa-status | grep docker<br>docker run --security-opt apparmor=my-profile nginx</pre><p>K8s: <code>securityContext.appArmorProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}</code> (1.30+ GA), <code>seLinuxOptions</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Muammo chiqsa <code>setenforce 0</code> qilib qoldirish — butun himoya o'chadi.</li><li>Volume'da <code>:z</code>/<code>:Z</code> siz — <code>Permission denied</code>, root bo'lsa ham.</li><li><code>/</code> yoki <code>/home</code> ga <code>:Z</code> — host fayllar label'i o'zgarib, tizim buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> MAC — container escape'ga qarshi oxirgi qatlamlardan biri; uni o'chirib emas, AVC log'larini o'qib to'g'rilang (<code>audit2allow</code> faqat tahlil uchun). SELinux'li node'lar (RHEL/OpenShift) bir qancha runc CVE'larining ta'sirini bloklagan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41051	<p><code>docker system prune</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker system prune</code> — ishlatilmayotgan Docker resurslarini o'chiradi: <b>to'xtagan container'lar</b>, <b>hech qaysi container ishlatmaydigan tarmoqlar</b>, <b>dangling image'lar</b> (tag'siz) va <b>build cache</b>. <code>-a</code> — ishlab turgan container ishlatmaydigan <b>barcha</b> image'lar; <code>--volumes</code> — ishlatilmayotgan (anonim) volume'lar ham. Prune — favqulodda tool, rejali tozalash emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41052	<p>Docker plugin nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Docker plugin — <code>dockerd</code> imkoniyatlarini kengaytiruvchi tashqi process (odatda maxsus container sifatida ishlaydi): <b>volume</b> driver (NFS, cloud disk), <b>network</b> driver, <b>logging</b> driver (Loki, Datadog), <b>authorization</b> plugin (API so'rovlarini ruxsat/rad). Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41053	<p>Docker'da <code>iptables</code> roli qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Docker <b>iptables</b> (yoki nftables) qoidalarini avtomatik boshqaradi: container'larning tashqariga chiqishi uchun <b>MASQUERADE</b> (SNAT), <code>-p</code> publish qilingan portlar uchun <b>DNAT</b>, tarmoqlar orasidagi izolyatsiya uchun <code>FORWARD</code> filtrlari. Muhim: publish qilingan portlar <code>nat</code> jadvalining <code>PREROUTING</code> da DNAT qilinadi, shuning uchun <b>UFW/firewalld <code>INPUT</code> qoidalarini chetlab o'tadi</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Server'da UFW bilan faqat 22/443 ochiq, lekin <code>docker run -p 5432:5432 postgres</code> — Postgres butun internetga ochiq bo'lib qoldi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>internet --&gt; eth0:5432 --&gt; PREROUTING (nat) DOCKER zanjiri: DNAT -&gt; 172.17.0.2:5432<br>         --&gt; FORWARD (filter) DOCKER-USER -&gt; DOCKER -&gt; container<br>         (INPUT zanjiri — UFW shu yerda — umuman ko'rilmaydi!)<br>container --&gt; tashqariga --&gt; POSTROUTING MASQUERADE -&gt; host IP</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo iptables -t nat -L DOCKER -n --line-numbers<br>sudo iptables -L DOCKER-USER -n<br># faqat ma'lum tarmoqqa ruxsat (DOCKER-USER — sizning qoidalaringiz uchun)<br>sudo iptables -I DOCKER-USER -i eth0 ! -s 10.0.0.0/8 -p tcp -m conntrack --ctorigdstport 5432 -j DROP<br># eng oddiy: faqat localhost'ga publish<br>docker run -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 postgres:17</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>&quot;iptables&quot;: false</code> daemon.json'da — container'lar tarmog'i buziladi, qo'lda hammasini yozish kerak.</li><li>Firewall qayta yuklanganda (<code>firewall-cmd --reload</code>) Docker qoidalari o'chib ketishi.</li><li>DOCKER-USER qoidalarida DNAT'dan keyingi port (container porti) ko'rinadi — <code>conntrack --ctorigdstport</code> ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: hech qachon UFW'ga ishonib <code>-p</code> qilmang; ichki servislarni faqat <code>127.0.0.1</code> yoki ichki tarmoqqa bog'lang, tashqi filtrni DOCKER-USER yoki cloud security group darajasida qiling. Docker 28+ nftables backend'ini ham qo'llaydi — firewall tool'ingiz bilan mosligini tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes

Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41055	<p>Image digest nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Image digest — image <b>manifest'ining SHA-256 hash'i</b> (<code>nginx@sha256:4c0f...</code>). Content-addressable: tarkib bir bit o'zgarsa digest o'zgaradi, shuning uchun digest <b>o'zgarmas</b> va aynan bir xil image'ni kafolatlaydi. Tag (<code>:1.27</code>, <code>:latest</code>) esa o'zgaruvchan ko'rsatkich — istalgan payt boshqa image'ga qayta ko'chirilishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Staging'da <code>api:1.4</code> test qilindi; kimdir shu tag'ni qayta push qildi va prod boshqa kodni oldi. Yoki base image <code>python:3.13</code> ertaga boshqa paketlar bilan keladi va build reproducible emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>tag api:1.4 ---(o'zgaruvchan)---&gt; sha256:aaa (bugun)<br>                              \--&gt; sha256:bbb (ertaga, qayta push)<br>api@sha256:aaa --&gt; HAR DOIM bir xil manifest --&gt; bir xil layer digest'lari<br>Multi-arch: index digest (hamma platforma) va platforma manifest digest'i farq qiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 --format '{{json .Manifest.Digest}}'<br>crane digest ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4<br>docker images --digests<br>docker pull ghcr.io/corp/api@sha256:aaa...</pre><pre>FROM python:3.13-slim@sha256:3f1c...   # tag o'qish uchun, digest haqiqat uchun</pre><pre>image: ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4@sha256:aaa...</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>docker images</code> dagi IMAGE ID (config digest) ni manifest digest bilan adashtirish.</li><li>Digest'ga pin qilib, keyin yangilamaslik — xavfsizlik patch'lari kelmaydi (Renovate/Dependabot ishlating).</li><li>Registry'lar orasida ko'chirishda (<code>docker save/load</code>) manifest qayta yaratilib digest o'zgarishi; <code>skopeo copy</code> digest'ni saqlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod deploy va imzo tekshiruvi digest asosida bo'lsin; tag'lar faqat odamlar uchun. Registry'da tag immutability yoqing (ECR, Harbor) — ikki himoya birga.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41056	<p>Dockerfile'da layer invalidation nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Layer invalidation — Dockerfile'dagi biror instruktsiyaning cache kaliti o'zgarsa (buyruq matni, <code>COPY</code> qilingan fayllar tarkibi, <code>ARG</code> qiymati, base image), o'sha qadam <b>va undan keyingi barcha qadamlar</b> cache'dan foydalanmay qayta bajariladi. Oldingi qadamlar cache'da qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta README o'zgarishi 15 daqiqalik to'liq rebuild'ga olib keladi — chunki <code>COPY . .</code> erta turibdi va keyingi barcha og'ir <code>RUN</code>'lar invalid bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1 FROM node:22          cached<br>2 COPY package*.json    cached (fayllar o'zgarmagan)<br>3 RUN npm ci            cached<br>4 COPY . .              INVALID (src/a.js o'zgardi)<br>5 RUN npm run build     qayta  (4 dan keyin)<br>6 ... hammasi qayta<br>Invalidatsiya manbalari: fayl checksum (COPY/ADD), buyruq matni, ARG/ENV qiymati,<br>FROM image yangilanishi (--pull), --no-cache</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker build --progress=plain . 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -E '^#[0-9]+ (\[|CACHED)'</pre><p>Yaxshi tuzilma:</p><pre>FROM node:22-slim<br>WORKDIR /app<br>COPY package.json package-lock.json ./<br>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm ci<br>COPY tsconfig.json ./<br>COPY src ./src                 # faqat kerakli papka, butun repo emas<br>RUN npm run build<br>ARG GIT_SHA                    # o'zgaruvchan ARG — oxirida<br>LABEL org.opencontainers.image.revision=$GIT_SHA</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ARG</code> ni boshida e'lon qilib, <code>RUN</code> da ishlatish — har yangi qiymat keyingi hammasini invalid qiladi.</li><li><code>ADD https://...</code> — har safar yuklab, checksum o'zgarsa invalid; <code>--checksum</code> bilan pin qiling.</li><li><code>.dockerignore</code> siz <code>.git</code> o'zgarishi <code>COPY . .</code> ni invalid qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Dockerfile'ni &quot;o'zgarish chastotasi&quot; bo'yicha tartiblang: base -&gt; tizim paketlari -&gt; dependency manifest -&gt; dependency o'rnatish -&gt; kod -&gt; metadata. CI build vaqti dashboard'i bilan cache hit ratio'ni kuzating.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41057	<p>Docker socket (<code>/var/run/docker.sock</code>) nima va nega xavfli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code> — Docker CLI <code>dockerd</code> API'si bilan gaplashadigan UNIX socket. Unga yoza oladigan har kim daemon'ga istalgan buyruq bera oladi — masalan host <code>/</code> ni mount qilgan privileged container ishga tushirish. Shuning uchun socket'ni container'ga mount qilish = shu container'ga <b>host root</b> berish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI agent, Portainer yoki &quot;auto-update&quot; container uchun qulaylik sifatida <code>-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock</code> qo'shiladi; ilovada RCE topilsa hujumchi butun host'ni oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (hujum):</b></p><pre>container ichida (socket mount qilingan):<br>  docker -H unix:///var/run/docker.sock run -it --privileged --pid=host \<br>     -v /:/host alpine chroot /host sh<br>  --&gt; host'da root shell<br>Docker CLI ham shart emas: curl --unix-socket ... POST /containers/create</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> topish va alternativalar:</p><pre>docker ps -q | xargs docker inspect -f '{{.Name}} {{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} {{end}}' | grep docker.sock<br>kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.volumes[]?.hostPath.path==&quot;/var/run/docker.sock&quot;) | .metadata.name'<br>ls -l /var/run/docker.sock     # srw-rw---- root docker  -&gt; docker guruhi = root</pre><p>Alternativalar: CI build uchun BuildKit rootless/Kaniko/Buildah; monitoring uchun read-only API proxy (masalan faqat <code>GET /containers</code> ga ruxsat beradigan socket proxy); rootless Docker.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>:ro</code> bilan mount qilish himoya qilmaydi — socket'ga yozish baribir ishlaydi.</li><li><code>docker</code> guruhiga user qo'shish — unga root berish bilan teng.</li><li>K8s'da <code>hostPath</code> orqali <code>containerd.sock</code> mount qilish — xuddi shunday xavf.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Socket mount'ni policy (Kyverno/OPA, PSS) bilan bloklang va istisnolarni hujjatlashtiring. Agar daemon API'si haqiqatan kerak bo'lsa — endpoint'lar allowlist'i bilan proxy, alohida izolyatsiyalangan host'da.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41058	<p>Container attestation nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container attestation — image digest'iga bog'langan, <b>kriptografik imzolangan bayonot</b> (in-toto format): bu image qanday, qayerda, qaysi manbadan build qilingan (<b>SLSA provenance</b>), ichida nima bor (<b>SBOM</b>), qaysi test/skan o'tgan (vulnerability, test natijasi). Registry'da OCI artifact sifatida saqlanadi va deploy'da policy bilan tekshiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Imzo faqat &quot;kim imzoladi&quot; ni aytadi. &quot;Bu image rasmiy CI'da, <code>main</code> branch'dan, review qilingan commit'dan build qilinganmi va CVE skandan o'tganmi?&quot; imzo -&gt; SLSA provenance (Level 3: izolyatsiyalangan, buzib bo'lmaydigan builder) -&gt; admission'da majburiy tekshiruv. Asosiy qiymat — incident paytida &quot;qaysi prod image'larda shu paket bor va ular qayerdan kelgan&quot; ga daqiqalarda javob.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes

Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41060	<p>Firecracker microVM nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Firecracker — AWS'ning ochiq kodli (Rust), KVM asosidagi <b>microVM</b> monitori (VMM): minimal virtual qurilmalar (virtio-net, virtio-block, serial), ~125 ms dan kam start va har microVM uchun ~5 MiB overhead. Container (umumiy kernel) — izolyatsiya zaif; oddiy VM (QEMU) — sekin start va katta overhead.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>host Linux + KVM<br>  +-- firecracker process (har microVM uchun bitta, jailer: chroot + seccomp + cgroup)<br>        +-- guest kernel + rootfs --&gt; mijoz kodi<br>  +-- firecracker process --&gt; boshqa mijoz<br>Minimal qurilma modeli = kichik hujum yuzasi; REST API (unix socket) bilan boshqariladi<br>Snapshot/restore --&gt; Lambda SnapStart</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>firecracker --api-sock /tmp/fc.sock &amp;<br>curl --unix-socket /tmp/fc.sock -X PUT http://localhost/boot-source \<br>  -d '{&quot;kernel_image_path&quot;:&quot;vmlinux&quot;,&quot;boot_args&quot;:&quot;console=ttyS0 reboot=k panic=1&quot;}'<br>curl --unix-socket /tmp/fc.sock -X PUT http://localhost/drives/rootfs \<br>  -d '{&quot;drive_id&quot;:&quot;rootfs&quot;,&quot;path_on_host&quot;:&quot;rootfs.ext4&quot;,&quot;is_root_device&quot;:true,&quot;is_read_only&quot;:false}'<br>curl --unix-socket /tmp/fc.sock -X PUT http://localhost/machine-config -d '{&quot;vcpu_count&quot;:1,&quot;mem_size_mib&quot;:128}'<br>curl --unix-socket /tmp/fc.sock -X PUT http://localhost/actions -d '{&quot;action_type&quot;:&quot;InstanceStart&quot;}'</pre><p>Container dunyosiga ulash: <b>Kata Containers</b> (Firecracker backend) yoki firecracker-containerd.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>KVM kerak — ko'p cloud VM'larida nested virtualization yo'q (bare metal instance yoki qo'llaydigan tur kerak).</li><li>GPU va ko'p qurilma passthrough cheklangan — umumiy maqsadli VM o'rnini bosmaydi.</li><li>Snapshot'dan tiklashda random seed, vaqt va unique ID'lar takrorlanishi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Firecracker — &quot;container ergonomikasi + VM izolyatsiyasi&quot; yo'nalishining namunasi (Fly.io, Lambda, Fargate, ba'zi CI sandbox'lar). Interview Drill::Docker::T14 Docker gotchas	idrill-17014	<p>Konteynerdagi Go ilova SIGTERM'ga javob bermayapti, Kubernetes 30s kutib SIGKILL beryapti. Sabab?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ilova PID 1 emas. Dockerfile'da shell-form <code>CMD /app</code> buyrug'i <code>/bin/sh -c /app</code> orqali ishga tushadi — PID 1 shell bo'ladi, shell esa SIGTERM'ni bola jarayonga uzatmaydi. Ilova signalni ko'rmaydi, Kubernetes 30s kutib SIGKILL beradi. Yechim: exec-form <code>CMD [&quot;/app&quot;]</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy/scale paytida graceful shutdown ishlamaydi — har pod SIGKILL bilan uziladi, joriy so'rovlar yo'qoladi, shutdown kodi umuman chaqirilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CMD /app          -&gt; sh -c &quot;/app&quot;  -&gt; PID 1 = sh, /app = bola<br>   SIGTERM -&gt; sh (uzatmaydi) -&gt; /app ko'rmaydi -&gt; 30s -&gt; SIGKILL<br>CMD [&quot;/app&quot;]      -&gt; PID 1 = /app  -&gt; SIGTERM to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ilovaga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>CMD [&quot;/app&quot;]          # exec form (to'g'ri)<br># yoki init reaper kerak bo'lsa:<br># docker run --init ...   yoki ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/sbin/tini&quot;,&quot;--&quot;]</pre><pre>ctx, _ := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM, syscall.SIGINT)<br>&lt;-ctx.Done()<br>srv.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)</pre><pre>docker exec &lt;c&gt; ps -o pid,cmd    # PID 1 ilova bo'lishi kerak</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Shell-form (<code>CMD app arg</code>) — eng ko'p &quot;SIGTERM ishlamaydi&quot; sababi; exec-form (<code>[&quot;app&quot;,&quot;arg&quot;]</code>) ishlat.</li><li>Exec-form'da <code>$VAR</code> kengaymaydi — kerak bo'lsa <code>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;sh&quot;,&quot;-c&quot;,&quot;exec app&quot;]</code> (exec bilan).</li><li>Avval readiness=false + preStop sleep — signal to'g'ri yetsa ham LB drain kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PID 1 signal va zombie reaping mas'uliyatini oladi — oddiy dastur buni bilmasligi mumkin. Exec-form + <code>--init</code>/tini. K8s'da to'liq zero-downtime = exec-form signal + preStop drain + grace period.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::t14 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker::T14 Docker gotchas	idrill-17016	<p>Docker image 900 MB. Eng katta ta'sir qiladigan o'zgarish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng katta ta'sir — <b>multi-stage build</b>: kompilyatsiyani to'liq <code>golang</code> image'da qil, natija (statik binar, <code>CGO_ENABLED=0</code>) ni <code>distroless</code> yoki <code>scratch</code> ga ko'chir. 900MB → o'nlab MB. Build tool'lar, kompilyator, manba kodi final image'da qolmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>golang:1.23</code> image ~800MB (kompilyator, git, hamma narsa). Agar shu image'da deploy qilsangiz — hujum yuzasi katta, pull sekin, CVE ko'p. Final image'ga faqat binar kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Stage 1 (builder): golang image -&gt; go build -&gt; binar<br>Stage 2 (final):   scratch/distroless + binar + CA + (tzdata)<br>   -&gt; build tool'lar, manba, kompilyator TASHLANADI</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM golang:1.23 AS build<br>WORKDIR /src<br>COPY go.mod go.sum ./<br>RUN go mod download<br>COPY . .<br>RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags=&quot;-s -w&quot; -o /app ./cmd/server<br><br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12<br>COPY --from=build /app /app<br>USER nonroot<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Alpine (musl) — cgo/DNS xulqi glibc'dan farq qiladi; <code>CGO_ENABLED=0</code> bilan sof Go resolver.</li><li><code>scratch</code> da CA sertifikat yo'q — HTTPS yiqiladi; distroless yoki <code>ca-certificates</code> COPY qil.</li><li>Layer tartibi: avval <code>go.mod/go.sum</code> → <code>mod download</code>, keyin manba (cache).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> distroless/<code>scratch</code> + nonroot user + statik binar = minimal hujum yuzasi, tez pull, kam CVE. tzdata/CA kerak bo'lsa aniq qo'sh. Image hajmi monitoring va skan (trivy) CI gate — &quot;katta image = ko'p xavf&quot; avtomatik ushlanadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::t14 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker::T14 Docker gotchas	idrill-30482	<p>Dockerfile'da <code>COPY . .</code> birinchi qatorlarda turibdi. Nima yomon?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>COPY . .</code> yuqorida bo'lsa, har qanday kod o'zgarishi shu layer'ni va <b>undan keyingi hamma layer'ni</b> cache'dan tushiradi — shu jumladan <code>go mod download</code> qayta ishlaydi. Kerak bo'lsa <code>TZ=Asia/Tashkent</code> + <code>tzdata</code> paketi.</p><p><b>2) Clock (haqiqiy muammo):</b> container'da alohida soat yo'q (time namespace faqat monotonic/boottime offset beradi). &quot;Not yet valid&quot; = <b>host</b> soati orqada. NTP/chrony ishlamayapti — VM snapshot'dan tiklangan, yoki suspend'dan qaytgan.</p><pre>timedatectl; chronyc tracking</pre><p><b>Senior/Staff nuqtalar</b></p><ul><li>Clock skew distributed tizimda: JWT <code>nbf/exp</code>, TOTP, Kafka timestamp, lease/lock — hammasi buziladi. Skew'ni metrika qil va alert qo'y.</li><li>Container image'ga <code>tzdata</code> qo'shib &quot;tuzatish&quot; — soat muammosini yashiradi, tuzatmaydi.</li></ul>	lvl::Staff dom::docker sec::t14 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker::T14 Docker gotchas	idrill-42260	<p>Production'da bitta host'dagi <code>dockerd</code> qayta ishga tushirildi (upgrade) va barcha container'lar o'chdi. Tizim darajasida bunday blast radius'ni qanday kamaytirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Bevosita:</b> <code>/etc/docker/daemon.json</code> da <code>&quot;live-restore&quot;: true</code> — dockerd restart bo'lganda containerd-shim container'larni ushlab turadi. Cheklov: major versiya upgrade'da ishonma; Swarm mode bilan mos emas.</p><p><b>Tizim darajasi (asosiy javob):</b></p><ol><li><b>Host = failure domain.</b> Har servisning replikasi kamida 2 host / 2 AZ da.</li><li><b>Node upgrade = drain → upgrade → uncordon</b>, bir vaqtda N% node, PodDisruptionBudget bilan.</li><li><b>Immutable node'lar:</b> in-place upgrade emas — yangi image'li node qo'sh, eskisini o'chir. Rollback = eski template.</li><li><b>Canary node pool:</b> yangi runtime avval kichik pool'da.</li><li><b>Detection:</b> node darajasidagi SLI (container restart soni, runtime xatolari) + deploy marker.</li></ol><p><b>Principal insight:</b> &quot;dockerd restart container'larni o'ldirmasin&quot; — bu lokal optimizatsiya. To'g'ri savol: &quot;bitta host o'lsa foydalanuvchi sezadimi?&quot; Agar sezsa — muammo daemon'da emas, arxitekturada.</p>	lvl::Principal dom::docker sec::t14 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-31400	<p>Docker Compose nima va qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Docker Compose — bir nechta container'dan iborat ilovani (api + db + redis) <b>bitta YAML faylda</b> tasvirlab, bitta buyruq bilan ko'taradigan tool. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-31401	<p>Compose'da service'lar bir-biriga qanday ulanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Compose har loyiha uchun <code>&lt;project&gt;_default</code> nomli bridge network yaratadi va barcha service'larni unga ulaydi. Service'lar bir-birini <b>service nomi</b> bo'yicha (Docker ichki DNS) va <b>container port</b> orqali topadi: <code>db:5432</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi boshlovchi <code>api</code> ichida <code>localhost:5432</code> yozadi va <code>connection refused</code> oladi. Sabab: har container o'z network namespace'iga ega — <code>localhost</code> = container'ning o'zi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>host:8080 --(ports)--&gt; api container :8080<br>                          |<br>                          | DNS &quot;db&quot; -&gt; 172.18.0.3 (127.0.0.11 resolver)<br>                          v<br>                       db container :5432   (host'ga ochilmagan)<br>     [ network: shop_default ]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    environment:<br>      DB_URL: postgres://app:pw@db:5432/app   # to'g'ri<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16<br>    # ports yo'q - faqat ichkaridan</pre><p>Tekshirish:</p><pre>docker compose exec api getent hosts db     # 172.18.0.3  db<br>docker network inspect shop_default         # ulangan container'lar</pre><p>Izolyatsiya uchun bir nechta network:</p><pre>services:<br>  proxy: { networks: [front] }<br>  api:   { networks: [front, back] }<br>  db:    { networks: [back] }<br>networks: { front: {}, back: {} }</pre><p>Endi <code>proxy</code> <code>db</code> ni ko'ra olmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>localhost</code> yoki host IP ishlatish — container ichidan noto'g'ri.</li><li><code>ports: &quot;5433:5432&quot;</code> bo'lsa ham ichkarida <code>db:5432</code> (container port), <code>5433</code> emas.</li><li>Service nomini o'zgartirsang — connection string'lar ham o'zgarishi kerak; barqaror nom uchun <code>aliases</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>ports</code> faqat host'dan kirish uchun; ichki service'larni (db, redis) publish qilmaslik — attack surface'ni kamaytirishning eng arzon yo'li.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-31402	<p><code>docker compose down</code> va <code>down -v</code> farqi? Ma'lumot qachon yo'qoladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose down</code> container va network'larni o'chiradi, <b>named volume'lar qoladi</b>. <code>down -v</code> volume'larni ham o'chiradi — DB ma'lumoti shu paytda yo'qoladi. <code>stop</code> esa faqat to'xtatadi, hech narsa o'chmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Toza boshlash&quot; uchun kimdir <code>down -v</code> yozadi va prod/staging Postgres ma'lumoti butunlay ketadi. Docker'da &quot;korzina&quot; yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Buyruq | Container | Network | Volume | Image | |---|---|---|---|---| | <code>stop</code> | to'xtaydi | qoladi | qoladi | qoladi | | <code>down</code> | o'chadi | o'chadi | qoladi | qoladi | | <code>down -v</code> | o'chadi | o'chadi | <b>o'chadi</b> | qoladi | | <code>down --rmi all</code> | o'chadi | o'chadi | qoladi | o'chadi |</p><p>Ma'lumot qachon yo'qoladi:</p><ol><li><code>down -v</code> (named + anonymous volume'lar).</li><li><code>volumes:</code> umuman berilmagan bo'lsa — data container'ning writable layer'ida, container o'chishi bilan ketadi.</li><li>Project name o'zgarsa — yangi bo'sh volume yaratiladi (eski &quot;yo'qolgandek&quot; ko'rinadi).</li></ol><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose stop              # vaqtincha to'xtatish<br>docker compose down              # tozalash, data qoladi<br>docker volume ls | grep shop     # shop_pgdata hali bor<br>docker compose down -v           # FAQAT dev'da, data o'chadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prod'da <code>-v</code> ni odatga aylantirish.</li><li>Bind mount (<code>./data:/var/lib/...</code>) <code>down -v</code> bilan o'chmaydi — lekin host papkasi qo'lda o'chirilishi mumkin.</li><li>Volume qoldi deb backup'siz yashash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Muhim volume'larni <code>external: true</code> qil — Compose ularni yaratmaydi va o'chirmaydi. Prod buyruqlarini Makefile/skriptga o'ra, <code>-v</code> umuman bo'lmasin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-31403	<p><code>depends_on</code> service tayyor bo'lishini kafolatlaydimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy <code>depends_on: [db]</code> faqat <b>start tartibini</b> kafolatlaydi (db container avval start bo'ladi), DB tayyorligini emas. Tayyorlikni kutish uchun <code>condition: service_healthy</code> + healthcheck kerak. Lekin bu ham faqat startup uchun — ilovada retry baribir shart.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Postgres container start bo'ldi, lekin init 3-5 soniya davom etadi. API darhol ulanadi -&gt; <code>connection refused</code> -&gt; crash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>depends_on: [db]                 db started --&gt; api start (db tayyor emas!)<br>condition: service_healthy       db healthy --&gt; api start<br>condition: service_completed_successfully<br>                                 migrate exit 0 --&gt; api start</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16<br>    healthcheck:<br>      test: [&quot;CMD-SHELL&quot;, &quot;pg_isready -U app&quot;]<br>      interval: 5s<br>      retries: 10<br>  migrate:<br>    image: myapp<br>    command: [&quot;./migrate&quot;, &quot;up&quot;]<br>    depends_on:<br>      db: { condition: service_healthy }<br>  api:<br>    image: myapp<br>    depends_on:<br>      migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully }</pre><pre>docker compose up -d<br>docker compose ps    # db: Up (healthy), migrate: Exited (0)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Healthcheck'siz <code>service_healthy</code> — xato beradi.</li><li>DB keyinroq restart bo'lsa <code>depends_on</code> hech narsa qilmaydi — api ulanishni yo'qotadi.</li><li>Server reboot'da Docker daemon container'larni restart policy bo'yicha ko'taradi, <code>depends_on</code> tartibini hisobga olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>depends_on</code> — dev qulayligi, reliability mexanizmi emas. Ilovada exponential backoff bilan reconnect va readiness endpoint bo'lsin — K8s'ga o'tganda ham xuddi shu kod ishlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-31404	<p>Compose'da environment: <code>.env</code>, <code>env_file</code>, <code>environment</code> va o'zgaruvchi interpolatsiyasi farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.env</code> fayl — <b>Compose faylining o'zidagi</b> <code>${VAR}</code> larni to'ldiradi (container'ga avtomatik bormaydi). <code>env_file:</code> — fayldagi o'zgaruvchilarni <b>container</b> env'iga beradi. <code>environment:</code> — inline, <code>env_file</code> dan ustun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki xil &quot;env&quot; aralashadi: biri YAML'ni shablon qiladi, ikkinchisi process'ga yetib boradi. Chalkashlik -&gt; &quot;<code>.env</code> ga yozdim, ilova ko'rmayapti&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>shell env + .env ---&gt; interpolation ---&gt; ${TAG} -&gt; 1.4.2 (YAML ichida)<br>env_file: api.env --+<br>environment:  -----+--&gt; container process env</pre><p>Interpolatsiya ustunligi: shell env &gt; <code>--env-file</code>/<code>.env</code>. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-31405	<p>Dev va prod uchun turli Compose konfiguratsiya: override, profiles, bir nechta -f?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uch mexanizm: (1) <b>override fayllar</b> — <code>compose.override.yaml</code> avtomatik qo'shiladi yoki <code>-f</code> bilan bir nechta fayl birlashtiriladi; (2) <b>profiles</b> — ba'zi service'lar faqat <code>--profile</code> bilan yoqiladi; (3) <b>include</b> — boshqa compose fayllarni modul sifatida qo'shish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dev'da bind mount, debug port, hot reload kerak; prod'da esa <code>restart</code>, limitlar, aniq image tag. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-31407	<p>Bir service'ni scale qilish: <code>docker compose up --scale api=3</code> — qanday muammolar chiqadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose up -d --scale api=3</code> bitta service'dan 3 ta container ko'taradi. Muammolar: qat'iy host port (<code>8080:8080</code>) to'qnashadi, <code>container_name</code> scale'ni bloklaydi, load balancing yo'q (faqat DNS round-robin), state/volume ulashish muammosi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yuk oshdi, &quot;3 ta qilib qo'yaman&quot; deysan — ikkinchi container <code>port is already allocated</code> bilan yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>proxy (nginx :80) --&gt; DNS &quot;api&quot; --&gt; 172.18.0.4 (api-1)<br>                                    172.18.0.5 (api-2)<br>                                    172.18.0.6 (api-3)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: myapi<br>    expose: [&quot;8080&quot;]          # host'ga publish yo'q<br>  proxy:<br>    image: nginx<br>    ports: [&quot;80:80&quot;]</pre><pre>docker compose up -d --scale api=3<br>docker compose ps                          # api-1, api-2, api-3<br>docker compose exec proxy getent hosts api # 3 ta IP</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ports: [&quot;8080:8080&quot;]</code> + scale -&gt; port band. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-31408	<p>Compose'ni production'da (single host) ishlatish mumkinmi? Nimalarni hal qilish kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ha, kichik loyiha va bitta server uchun mumkin va keng tarqalgan. Lekin o'zing hal qilishing kerak: restart policy, healthcheck, resurs limit, log rotation, aniq image tag, backup, zero-downtime deploy va monitoring. HA yo'q — host o'lsa hammasi o'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dev'dagi compose faylni prod'ga ko'chirasan: 2 haftadan keyin disk loglar bilan to'ladi, reboot'dan keyin servislar ko'tarilmaydi, memory leak butun serverni qotiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (checklist):</b></p><pre>TLS proxy (Traefik/Caddy) -&gt; api (restart, healthcheck, limits, logs)<br>                          -&gt; db  (volume + kunlik backup, port yopiq)<br>monitoring: node_exporter + cAdvisor -&gt; Prometheus/alert</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2@sha256:...   # aniq versiya<br>    restart: unless-stopped<br>    healthcheck:<br>      test: [&quot;CMD&quot;, &quot;/app/api&quot;, &quot;-health&quot;]<br>      interval: 10s<br>    deploy:<br>      resources: { limits: { cpus: &quot;1.0&quot;, memory: 512M } }<br>    logging:<br>      driver: json-file<br>      options: { max-size: 10m, max-file: &quot;3&quot; }</pre><pre>systemctl enable docker<br>docker compose pull &amp;&amp; docker compose up -d</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>pull &amp;&amp; up -d</code> recreate paytida qisqa downtime beradi — zero-downtime uchun proxy + blue/green kerak.</li><li><code>latest</code> tag — rollback qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Backup bor, lekin restore hech qachon sinalmagan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Trade-off: soddalik vs HA. 1 server, kichik trafik, past SLA — Compose ideal va arzon. Bir nechta node, 99.9%+ SLA, tez-tez deploy — K8s/Swarm yoki managed platforma. Murakkablikni talab paydo bo'lgandagina qo'sh.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-31409	<p>Compose <code>deploy:</code> bloki va <code>docker stack deploy</code> qanday bog'langan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Compose Specification bitta format: <code>docker compose</code> uni single host'da ishlatadi, <code>docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml app</code> esa Swarm cluster'da. <code>deploy:</code> bloki (replicas, update_config, placement) asosan Swarm uchun; <code>docker compose</code> undan faqat <code>resources</code> (va <code>replicas</code>) qismini qo'llaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta fayl ikki joyda ishlaydi deb o'ylaysan, lekin stack'da <code>build:</code> e'tiborsiz qoladi va deploy &quot;image not found&quot; bilan yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Maydon | <code>docker compose</code> | <code>docker stack deploy</code> | |---|---|---| | <code>build:</code> | ishlaydi | e'tiborsiz (image registry'da bo'lsin) | | <code>depends_on</code> | ishlaydi | e'tiborsiz | | <code>container_name</code> | ishlaydi | qo'llanmaydi | | <code>deploy.resources</code> | ishlaydi | ishlaydi | | <code>deploy.update_config</code>, <code>placement</code> | e'tiborsiz | ishlaydi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: registry.acme.io/api:1.4.2<br>    deploy:<br>      replicas: 3<br>      update_config: { parallelism: 1, order: start-first }<br>      placement: { constraints: [&quot;node.role==worker&quot;] }<br>      restart_policy: { condition: on-failure }</pre><pre>docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml shop<br>docker service ls<br>docker service ps shop_api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Stack'da <code>.env</code> avtomatik o'qilmaydi — <code>docker stack config</code> yoki oldindan <code>docker compose config</code> bilan yakuniy fayl yarat.</li><li>Kompose (compose -&gt; K8s manifest) — faqat boshlang'ich nuqta; probe, resources, secrets qo'lda tozalanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Swarm 2025-2026 da hali qo'llab-quvvatlanadi (Mirantis), lekin ekotizim K8s tomonda. Compose -&gt; Swarm migratsiya arzon, lekin uzoq muddatli platforma tanlovida jamoa ko'nikmasi va ekotizimni hisobga ol.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-33081	<p>Compose asosiy buyruqlari: up, down, ps, logs, exec, run, build, pull, restart.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy buyruqlar: <code>up</code> (yaratish va start), <code>down</code> (o'chirish), <code>ps</code> (holat), <code>logs</code> (loglar), <code>exec</code> (ishlab turgan container'da buyruq), <code>run</code> (yangi bir martalik container), <code>build</code> (image yig'ish), <code>pull</code> (image yuklash), <code>restart</code> (qayta ishga tushirish, config'ni olmaydi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Boshlovchilar <code>restart</code> bilan yangi env/image'ni &quot;qo'llayman&quot; deb o'ylaydi — o'zgarish kirmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build/pull -&gt; image tayyor<br>up -d      -&gt; container yaratadi/recreate qiladi (config o'zgargan bo'lsa)<br>restart    -&gt; o'sha container'ni stop+start (eski config)<br>down       -&gt; container + network o'chadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose up -d                       # ko'tarish<br>docker compose ps                          # NAME, STATUS (healthy?), PORTS<br>docker compose logs -f --tail=50 api       # oxirgi 50 qator + kuzatish<br>docker compose exec db psql -U app         # mavjud container ichida<br>docker compose run --rm api go test ./...  # bir martalik, keyin o'chadi<br>docker compose build --pull api            # base image'ni ham yangilab build<br>docker compose pull                        # registry'dan yangi image<br>docker compose restart api                 # compose.yaml o'zgarishini OLMAYDI<br>docker compose up -d api                   # o'zgarishni oladi (recreate)<br>docker compose config                      # yakuniy YAML<br>docker compose down</pre><p><code>ps</code> chiqishida <code>Up 2 minutes (healthy)</code> — healthcheck o'tgan; <code>Restarting</code> — crash loop, <code>logs</code> ga qara.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>run</code> ni <code>--rm</code> siz ishlatish — <code>api-run-xxxx</code> container'lar to'planadi.</li><li><code>exec</code> faqat ishlab turgan container'da ishlaydi; crash bo'lganda <code>run</code> yoki <code>logs</code> kerak.</li><li>Boshqa papkada buyruq bersang — boshqa project; <code>-f</code> yoki <code>-p</code> bilan aniqla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da qo'lda buyruq o'rniga <code>make deploy</code> kabi skript ishlat — buyruqlar ketma-ketligi (pull -&gt; up -d -&gt; prune) takrorlanuvchi va audit qilinadigan bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-33082	<p>Compose'da <code>ports</code> va <code>expose</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ports</code> — container portini <b>host'ga publish</b> qiladi (tashqaridan kirish mumkin). <code>expose</code> — faqat hujjat/metadata: port ichki network'da baribir ochiq, host'ga chiqmaydi. Ichki service'lar (db, redis) uchun <code>ports</code> kerak emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hamma service'ga <code>ports</code> qo'yiladi — Postgres <code>0.0.0.0:5432</code> da internetga ochiladi, botlar parol tanlashni boshlaydi. Docker iptables qoidalari UFW'ni ham chetlab o'tadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>internet -&gt; host:8080 --(ports)--&gt; web:80<br>                                   web --(ichki network)--&gt; api:9000 (expose/hech narsa)</pre><p>Bir network'dagi container'lar bir-birining istalgan portiga <code>expose</code>siz ham ulana oladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    ports: [&quot;127.0.0.1:8080:80&quot;]   # faqat localhost'dan (reverse proxy orqali)<br>  api:<br>    expose: [&quot;9000&quot;]               # faqat ichki, hujjat sifatida<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16             # ports yo'q</pre><pre>docker compose ps        # PORTS: 127.0.0.1:8080-&gt;80/tcp<br>ss -tlnp | grep 8080     # host'da kim tinglayapti</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>&quot;8080:80&quot;</code> ni qo'shtirnoqsiz yozma — YAML 1.1 <code>22:22</code> ni 60-lik son (1342) deb o'qishi mumkin.</li><li>IP ko'rsatilmasa <code>0.0.0.0</code> — barcha interfeys, UFW'ga qaramay ochiq.</li><li><code>expose</code> ni xavfsizlik deb o'ylash — u hech narsani yopmaydi, izolyatsiya uchun network ajrat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default qoida: faqat edge proxy publish qiladi, qolgan hamma narsa ichki. Debug uchun DB kerak bo'lsa <code>127.0.0.1:5432:5432</code> yoki SSH tunnel.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-33083	<p>Compose'da <code>build:</code> va <code>image:</code> birga ishlatilsa nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>build:</code> va <code>image:</code> birga bo'lsa Compose image'ni lokal build qiladi va <b>natijani <code>image:</code> dagi nom bilan tag qiladi</b>. Keyin <code>docker compose push</code> shu nom bilan registry'ga yuboradi. Image lokal bo'lsa <code>up</code> qayta build qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Faqat <code>build:</code> bo'lsa image <code>shop-api</code> kabi avtomatik nom oladi — uni push qilib, prod'da ishlatib bo'lmaydi. Faqat <code>image:</code> bo'lsa dev'da lokal build qilolmaysan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build: context + Dockerfile --&gt; image tag: ghcr.io/acme/api:dev<br>                                  |<br>                       docker compose push --&gt; registry<br>prod: image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2 (build yo'q) --&gt; pull</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    build:<br>      context: .<br>      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile<br>      args: { GO_VERSION: &quot;1.23&quot; }<br>      target: prod                 # multi-stage'dan qaysi stage<br>    image: ghcr.io/acme/api:${TAG:-dev}</pre><pre>TAG=1.4.2 docker compose build api<br>TAG=1.4.2 docker compose push api<br>docker image ls ghcr.io/acme/api       # 1.4.2 tag ko'rinadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>pull_policy</code> default'da image bor bo'lsa <code>up</code> eski lokal image bilan ishlaydi — kod yangilanmaydi; <code>--build</code> ber.</li><li><code>docker compose pull</code> build'li service uchun registry'dan tortishga urinadi — <code>--ignore-buildable</code> foydali.</li><li><code>TAG</code> bo'sh qolsa hamma narsa <code>dev</code> bo'ladi — CI'da <code>${TAG:?}</code> qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'da build+push, prod'da faqat pull — &quot;build once, deploy many&quot;. Prod serverda build qilish reproducible emas va server resursini yeydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-33084	<p>Compose'da resurs limitlari va log rotation qanday beriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Resurslar <code>deploy.resources.limits</code> (cpus, memory) va <code>reservations</code> bilan beriladi — Compose v2 ularni oddiy <code>up</code> da ham qo'llaydi. Log rotation <code>logging.options</code> (<code>max-size</code>, <code>max-file</code>) bilan sozlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta service memory leak qiladi — host OOM killer tasodifiy process'ni (balki sshd) o'ldiradi. Loglar cheklanmagan json-file'da yillar davomida yig'ilib diskni to'ldiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>limits.memory 512M --&gt; cgroup memory.max --&gt; oshsa: faqat shu container OOMKilled (137)<br>limits.cpus 1.0    --&gt; cgroup cpu.max    --&gt; throttle (o'ldirmaydi, sekinlashtiradi)<br>logging max-size   --&gt; 10m dan keyin yangi fayl, 3 tadan ortig'i o'chadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    deploy:<br>      resources:<br>        limits: { cpus: &quot;1.0&quot;, memory: 512M }<br>        reservations: { memory: 256M }<br>    logging:<br>      driver: json-file<br>      options: { max-size: &quot;10m&quot;, max-file: &quot;3&quot; }<br>    restart: unless-stopped</pre><pre>docker stats --no-stream            # MEM USAGE / LIMIT ustuni<br>docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.Memory}}' shop-api-1   # 536870912<br>docker inspect -f '{{.State.OOMKilled}}' shop-api-1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mavjud loyihaga logging qo'shsang — faqat recreate qilingan container'larga ta'sir qiladi.</li><li>Global default uchun <code>/etc/docker/daemon.json</code> da <code>log-opts</code> — har faylga yozishdan yaxshiroq.</li><li>JVM/Node limitni bilmasligi mumkin — heap'ni limitga moslab sozla (<code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Limitni taxmin bilan emas, <code>docker stats</code>/cAdvisor bilan o'lchab qo'y. <code>local</code> log driver json-file'dan ixchamroq va default rotation'ga ega.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-33085	<p>Compose'da bir nechta network bilan izolyatsiya: frontend/backend.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bir nechta network e'lon qilib, har service'ni faqat kerakli network'ga ulaysan: proxy <code>front</code>da, api <code>front</code>+<code>back</code>da, db faqat <code>back</code>da. <code>internal: true</code> network tashqi internetga chiqishni ham yopadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hamma bitta default network'da bo'lsa, proxy (internetga eng yaqin, eng ko'p hujumga uchraydigan) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri DB'ga ulana oladi. Proxy buzilsa — DB ham qo'lda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>internet -&gt; proxy --[front]--&gt; api --[back]--&gt; db<br>            proxy -X-&gt; db   (umumiy network yo'q)<br>            db    -X-&gt; internet (back: internal)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  proxy: { image: traefik, ports: [&quot;443:443&quot;], networks: [front] }<br>  api:   { image: api, networks: [front, back] }<br>  db:    { image: postgres:16, networks: [back] }<br>networks:<br>  front: {}<br>  back:<br>    internal: true        # tashqariga chiqish yo'q<br>  shared:<br>    external: true        # boshqa compose loyiha yaratgan network<br>    name: monitoring</pre><p>Tekshirish:</p><pre>docker compose exec proxy getent hosts db   # bo'sh -&gt; izolyatsiya ishlaydi<br>docker compose exec api getent hosts db     # IP chiqadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>networks:</code> yozsang default network'ga avtomatik ulanmaydi — kerakli hammasini ro'yxatga ol.</li><li><code>internal: true</code> network'dagi service'ga <code>ports</code> publish ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>external: true</code> network oldindan mavjud bo'lishi kerak (<code>docker network create monitoring</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Network segmentatsiya — defense in depth'ning arzon qatlami. <code>aliases</code> bilan service'ga barqaror DNS nom ber, shunda refactor paytida connection string'lar buzilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-33086	<p>Compose secrets qanday ishlatiladi va env'dan nimasi yaxshi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>secrets:</code> faylni container ichida <code>/run/secrets/&lt;nom&gt;</code> ga mount qiladi; ilova parolni fayldan o'qiydi (<code>*_FILE</code> konvensiyasi). Env'dan yaxshi tomoni: <code>docker inspect</code>, <code>/proc/&lt;pid&gt;/environ</code>, crash dump va child process'larda ko'rinmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>environment: DB_PASS: secret</code> — <code>docker inspect</code> qila oladigan har kim parolni ko'radi, xato logida env dump bo'lib chiqishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>./secrets/db_pass.txt (host, gitignore)<br>       |  bind mount (read-only)<br>       v<br>/run/secrets/db_pass (container) &lt;- app: os.ReadFile(DB_PASS_FILE)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16<br>    environment:<br>      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/db_pass<br>    secrets: [db_pass]<br>  api:<br>    secrets: [db_pass]<br>    environment:<br>      DB_PASS_FILE: /run/secrets/db_pass<br>secrets:<br>  db_pass:<br>    file: ./secrets/db_pass.txt</pre><pre>printf 's3cr3t' &gt; secrets/db_pass.txt &amp;&amp; chmod 600 secrets/db_pass.txt<br>echo &quot;secrets/&quot; &gt;&gt; .gitignore<br>docker compose exec api cat /run/secrets/db_pass<br>docker inspect shop-api-1 | grep -i pass    # faqat fayl yo'li ko'rinadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oddiy Compose'da (Swarm emas) secret shunchaki bind mount — diskda shifrlanmagan.</li><li><code>printf</code> o'rniga <code>echo</code> — oxirida newline qo'shiladi, parol mos kelmaydi.</li><li>Ilova <code>_FILE</code> ni qo'llamasa — entrypoint skriptda faylni o'qib env'ga o'tkazasan (kamroq xavfsiz).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Compose secrets — eng kam darajadagi gigiena. Jiddiy prod'da secret manba Vault / cloud secret manager bo'lsin, rotation va audit bilan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-33087	<p>Compose bilan CI'da integration test qanday yuritiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CI'da Compose bilan haqiqiy DB/Redis ko'tarib, test container'ni ichida ishga tushirasan: <code>up -d --wait</code> (healthy kutadi) -&gt; <code>run --rm tests</code> -&gt; exit code'ni saqla -&gt; <code>down -v</code> (har doim tozalash). Unikal project name parallel job'larni ajratadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Mock'lar bilan o'tgan test prod'da real Postgres bilan yiqiladi (SQL dialekt, constraint, transaction). Integration test real dependency talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CI job -&gt; project ci_1234 -&gt; network + db + redis (healthy)<br>                                  |<br>                       tests container -&gt; exit code<br>                                  |<br>                       down -v (har holda) -&gt; exit $rc</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -u<br>export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=ci_${CI_JOB_ID}<br>F=&quot;-f compose.test.yaml&quot;<br>trap 'docker compose $F down -v --remove-orphans' EXIT<br>docker compose $F up -d --wait --wait-timeout 120 db redis<br>docker compose $F run --rm tests</pre><p><code>trap</code> exit code'ni saqlaydi va test yiqilsa ham tozalaydi. Yiqilsa debug uchun: <code>docker compose $F logs db</code> ni artifact'ga yoz.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Project nomi bir xil bo'lsa parallel job'lar bir-birining container/volume'larini o'chiradi.</li><li>Healthcheck'siz <code>--wait</code> faqat &quot;running&quot; ni kutadi — testlar baribir erta boshlanadi.</li><li><code>ports</code> publish qilinsa parallel job'larda port to'qnashadi — testni compose network ichida ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alternativa — Testcontainers (test kodining o'zi container boshqaradi): dev mashinada ham bir xil. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-33088	<p>Compose loyihasi nomi (project name) nima va u nimaga ta'sir qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Project name — Compose resurslarini guruhlovchi nom: container (<code>shop-api-1</code>), network (<code>shop_default</code>), volume (<code>shop_pgdata</code>) shu prefiks bilan nomlanadi va <code>com.docker.compose.project</code> label oladi. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-33089	<p>Compose bilan zero-downtime deploy qanday qilasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Compose'da o'rnatilgan rolling update yo'q, shuning uchun: reverse proxy (Traefik/nginx) + yangi nusxani eskisi yonida ko'tarish -&gt; healthy bo'lgach trafikni o'tkazish -&gt; eskisini o'chirish. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42208	<p>Server reboot bo'ldi — Compose bilan ishlagan servislar ko'tarilmadi. Nega va qanday tuzatasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikki sabab: (1) container'larda <code>restart</code> policy yo'q (default <code>no</code>), (2) Docker daemon o'zi boot'da yoqilmagan (<code>systemctl enable docker</code> qilinmagan).
