Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42210	<p>Compose'da <code>db</code> healthy, lekin <code>api</code> start bo'lishi bilan <code>connection refused</code> beradi va yiqiladi. Bu Compose, K8s va DB failover'da bir xil ishlaydi; healthcheck faqat qo'shimcha.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::compose sec::k2 Compose

Nima qilasan va keyin qanday oldini olasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>down -v</code> bilan o'chgan named volume Docker'dan qaytmaydi — faqat backup'dan restore. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42261	<p>Compose'da volume e'lon qilish: named volume va bind mount yozilishi qanday farq qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Named volume — <code>nom:/container/yol</code> (Docker boshqaradi, <code>/var/lib/docker/volumes/</code> da); bind mount — <code>./host/yol:/container/yol</code> (host'dagi aniq papka). Qoida: yo'l <code>./</code>, <code>../</code> yoki <code>/</code> bilan boshlansa — bind mount, oddiy nom bo'lsa — named volume (va pastdagi <code>volumes:</code> da e'lon qilinadi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB ma'lumotini bind mount'da saqlab, UID/permission xatolariga uchraysan; yoki kodni named volume'ga qo'yib, o'zgarishlar ko'rinmayapti deb hayron qolasan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>named:  db-data ----&gt; /var/lib/docker/volumes/shop_db-data/_data<br>bind:   ./src   ----&gt; /home/me/project/src (host'dagi haqiqiy papka)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16<br>    volumes:<br>      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data   # named volume<br>  api:<br>    build: .<br>    volumes:<br>      - ./src:/app/src:ro                   # bind mount, read-only<br>volumes:<br>  db-data: {}</pre><pre>docker volume ls                     # shop_db-data<br>docker volume inspect shop_db-data   # Mountpoint</pre><p>| | Named volume | Bind mount | |---|---|---| | Qayerda | <code>/var/lib/docker/volumes/</code> | host'dagi istalgan papka | | Kim boshqaradi | Docker | siz | | Ishlatish | DB ma'lumoti | dev'da kod, config fayl | | <code>down -v</code> | o'chadi | o'chmaydi | | Image'dagi fayllar | birinchi marta ko'chiriladi | yopib qo'yadi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>volumes:</code> bo'limida e'lon qilinmagan nom — xato beradi.</li><li>Bind mount'da container UID (masalan 999) host papkaga yoza olmaydi — <code>permission denied</code>.</li><li>Mavjud bo'lmagan bind yo'l Docker tomonidan root egaligida papka sifatida yaratiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Data uchun named volume (portativ, tez), config va dev kod uchun bind mount (<code>:ro</code> bilan). Prod'da kod bind mount qilinmasin — image o'zgarmas artefakt bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42262	<p><code>docker compose run</code> va <code>docker compose exec</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>exec</code> — <b>mavjud, ishlab turgan</b> container ichida buyruq bajaradi. <code>run</code> — service konfiguratsiyasidan <b>yangi</b> container yaratib, bir martalik buyruq bajaradi (migratsiya, test, skript). <code>run</code> default'da portlarni publish qilmaydi va <code>--rm</code> bo'lmasa container qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> API crash loop'da — <code>exec</code> ishlamaydi (&quot;container is restarting&quot;). Yoki migratsiyani <code>exec</code> bilan ishlayotgan api ichida qilib, uni sekinlashtirasan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>exec: shop-api-1 (Up) --&gt; ichida yangi process (psql, sh)<br>run:  service &quot;api&quot; config --&gt; yangi container shop-api-run-a1b2 --&gt; buyruq --&gt; exit</pre><p>| | <code>exec</code> | <code>run</code> | |---|---|---| | Container | mavjud, ishlab turgan | yangi | | Ports | — | default ochilmaydi (<code>--service-ports</code>) | | depends_on | — | bog'liqlarni ko'taradi (<code>--no-deps</code>) | | Tozalash | — | <code>--rm</code> bo'lmasa qoladi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose exec db psql -U app          # ishlab turgan DB'ga kirish<br>docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U app app &gt; dump.sql   # pipe uchun -T<br>docker compose run --rm api ./migrate up    # bir martalik migratsiya<br>docker compose run --rm --entrypoint sh api # image ichini tekshirish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>run</code> ni <code>--rm</code> siz ko'p ishlatish — <code>api-run-xxx</code> container'lar to'planadi (<code>docker ps -a</code>).</li><li><code>exec</code> dagi o'zgarishlar (o'rnatilgan paket) container recreate'da yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>run</code> yangi container — ishlab turgan api'ning xotirasi/holatini ko'rmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Debug uchun <code>exec</code>, operatsion vazifalar (migrate, backfill) uchun <code>run --rm</code> — shunda vazifa ilova process'idan izolyatsiyalangan va o'z exit code'iga ega, CI/skriptda tekshirish oson.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42263	<p>Compose fayl nomi: <code>docker-compose.yml</code> va <code>compose.yaml</code>, <code>docker-compose</code> va <code>docker compose</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker-compose</code> — eski v1 (Python), 2023 iyulda to'xtatilgan. <code>docker compose</code> — v2 (Go, Docker CLI plugin), hozirgi standart. Fayl nomi: tavsiya <code>compose.yaml</code>; <code>docker-compose.yml</code> ham ishlaydi (orqaga moslik). <code>version:</code> maydoni endi kerak emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Eski tutorial'dagi <code>docker-compose up</code> yangi serverda <code>command not found</code>; eski skriptlar container nomini <code>project_service_1</code> deb kutadi, v2 esa <code>project-service-1</code> beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>v1: docker-compose (pip) -&gt; docker-compose.yml, version: &quot;3.8&quot;<br>v2: docker compose (plugin) -&gt; compose.yaml, Compose Specification (versiyasiz)</pre><p>Fayl qidirish tartibi: <code>compose.yaml</code>, <code>compose.yml</code>, <code>docker-compose.yaml</code>, <code>docker-compose.yml</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose version          # Docker Compose version v2.x<br>git mv docker-compose.yml compose.yaml<br>sed -i '/^version:/d' compose.yaml<br>docker compose config --quiet &amp;&amp; echo OK</pre><p>Eski skriptlar uchun vaqtinchalik alias: <code>alias docker-compose='docker compose'</code>.</p><p>| | v1 | v2 | |---|---|---| | Til | Python | Go | | Buyruq | <code>docker-compose</code> | <code>docker compose</code> | | Container nomi | <code>shop_api_1</code> | <code>shop-api-1</code> | | Holat | EOL | faol |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>version:</code> qoldirilsa — &quot;obsolete&quot; ogohlantirish (zarari yo'q, lekin chalg'itadi).</li><li>Monitoring/skriptlar container nomini <code>_</code> bilan grep qilsa — buziladi; label bo'yicha filtr qil.</li><li>Ikkala fayl (<code>compose.yaml</code> va <code>docker-compose.yml</code>) bo'lsa — birinchisi tanlanadi, ogohlantirish chiqadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container'ni nom bo'yicha emas, label (<code>com.docker.compose.service=api</code>) bo'yicha topadigan skriptlar versiya o'zgarishlariga chidamli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42264	<p>Compose'da <code>restart</code> policy'lari va <code>healthcheck</code> qanday ishlaydi? Unhealthy container qayta ishga tushadimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>restart</code> policy container <b>exit</b> bo'lganda dockerd nima qilishini belgilaydi: <code>no</code>, <code>on-failure[:N]</code>, <code>always</code>, <code>unless-stopped</code>. <code>healthcheck</code> esa container ichida vaqti-vaqti bilan test buyrug'ini bajarib, holatni <code>healthy/unhealthy</code> qiladi. Muhim: oddiy Docker/Compose'da <b>unhealthy container avtomatik restart bo'lmaydi</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> App deadlock'ga tushdi — process tirik, lekin javob bermaydi. Healthcheck &quot;unhealthy&quot; ko'rsatadi, lekin hech kim restart qilmaydi; K8s liveness probe kabi ishlaydi deb o'ylagan edik.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>process exit -&gt; restart policy -&gt; qayta start (backoff bilan)<br>healthcheck fail x retries -&gt; status: unhealthy -&gt; (hech narsa, faqat belgi)<br>                                  |-&gt; depends_on: service_healthy shuni kutadi<br>                                  |-&gt; Swarm/autoheal bo'lsa -&gt; replace</pre><p>| Policy | Qachon restart | |---|---| | <code>no</code> | hech qachon | | <code>on-failure[:N]</code> | exit code != 0 | | <code>always</code> | har doim, daemon restart'da ham | | <code>unless-stopped</code> | qo'lda to'xtatilmagan bo'lsa |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    restart: unless-stopped<br>    healthcheck:<br>      test: [&quot;CMD&quot;, &quot;wget&quot;, &quot;-qO-&quot;, &quot;http://localhost:8080/healthz&quot;]<br>      interval: 10s<br>      timeout: 3s<br>      retries: 3<br>      start_period: 20s</pre><pre>docker compose ps                     # Up 1 min (unhealthy)<br>docker inspect -f '{{json .State.Health.Log}}' shop-api-1 | jq '.[-1]'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Test buyrug'i (<code>curl</code>/<code>wget</code>) image'da bo'lishi kerak — distroless'da yo'q; app'ga <code>-health</code> flag qo'sh.</li><li><code>start_period</code> siz sekin start bo'ladigan app darhol unhealthy.</li><li>Unhealthy'ni restart qilish kerak bo'lsa — <code>willfarrell/autoheal</code> yoki Swarm.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Healthcheck — liveness emas, readiness'ga yaqin signal. Uni dependency'larga (DB) bog'lama: DB tushsa hamma api unhealthy bo'lib cascade beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42265	<p>Compose'da <code>extends</code>, YAML anchor (<code>x-</code> extension) va <code>include</code> — takrorni qanday kamaytirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uch vosita: <b>YAML anchor + <code>x-</code> extension</b> — bitta fayl ichida umumiy blokni qayta ishlatish; <b><code>extends</code></b> — boshqa service'dan (yoki fayldan) meros olish; <b><code>include</code></b> — butun compose fayllarni modul sifatida qo'shish (Compose 2.20+).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 10 ta service'da bir xil <code>restart</code>, <code>logging</code>, <code>networks</code> — birini o'zgartirsang, qolganlarini unutasan, konfiguratsiya &quot;drift&quot; qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>x-common: &amp;common  --(&lt;&lt;: *common)--&gt; api, worker  (YAML darajasida)<br>extends: base      --&gt; web = base + o'z maydonlari (Compose darajasida)<br>include: db.yaml   --&gt; }<br><br>services:<br>  api:<br>    &lt;&lt;: *common<br>    image: app/api<br>  worker:<br>    &lt;&lt;: *common<br>    image: app/worker</pre><pre>include:<br>  - ./infra/compose.db.yaml      # boshqa jamoa egalik qiladigan qism<br>services:<br>  web:<br>    extends: { file: common.yaml, service: base }</pre><pre>docker compose config    # anchor/extends ochilgan yakuniy natija</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>&lt;&lt;:</code> merge sayoz: ichki map (<code>logging</code>) to'liq almashtiriladi, birlashtirilmaydi.</li><li><code>x-</code> bo'lmagan noma'lum top-level kalit — validatsiya xatosi.</li><li><code>include</code> qilingan fayldagi nisbiy yo'llar o'sha faylning papkasiga nisbatan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qachon nima: anchor — bitta fayl ichida; <code>extends</code> — service shablon; <code>include</code> — jamoalar bo'yicha bo'lingan katta stack. Ortiqcha abstraksiya o'qishni qiyinlashtiradi — biroz takror ko'pincha sehrli merge'dan yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42266	<p><code>docker compose config</code> nima uchun kerak va CI'da qanday foydalanasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose config</code> barcha fayllarni (<code>-f</code>, override, include), <code>.env</code> interpolatsiyasi, anchor va <code>extends</code>ni birlashtirib <b>yakuniy, normallashtirilgan YAML</b>ni chiqaradi va validatsiya qiladi. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42267	<p>Compose'da <code>env_file</code> va <code>--env-file</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--env-file</code> (va default <code>.env</code>) — <b>Compose'ning o'ziga</b>: YAML'dagi <code>${TAG}</code> larni almashtiradi. <code>env_file:</code> (service ichida) — fayldagi o'zgaruvchilarni <b>container process'iga</b> beradi. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42268	<p>Compose'da GPU va device'larni container'ga qanday berasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GPU — <code>deploy.resources.reservations.devices</code> (<code>driver: nvidia</code>, <code>count</code> yoki <code>device_ids</code>, <code>capabilities: [gpu]</code>) bilan beriladi; host'da NVIDIA driver va <code>nvidia-container-toolkit</code> kerak. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-42271	<p>Compose loyihasida service'lar sonini va resurslarni qanday cheklaysiz, bitta servis butun host'ni o'ldirmasligi uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har service'ga cgroup chegaralari qo'yasan: <code>deploy.resources.limits</code> (cpus, memory), <code>pids_limit</code> (fork bomb), <code>ulimits</code> (file descriptor), log rotation (disk). Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34171	<p>Oddiy <code>compose.yaml</code> ning asosiy tuzilishi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>compose.yaml</code> asosan uchta top-level bo'limdan iborat: <code>services</code> (container'lar), <code>volumes</code> (doimiy ma'lumot), <code>networks</code> (ixtiyoriy, default bittasi avtomatik). Har service'da eng ko'p ishlatiladigan maydonlar: <code>image</code>/<code>build</code>, <code>ports</code>, <code>environment</code>, <code>volumes</code>, <code>depends_on</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi boshlovchi har bir maydon nima qilishini bilmasdan tutorial'dan nusxa oladi va keyin xato topa olmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>compose.yaml<br> +- name: (ixtiyoriy, project nomi)<br> +- services:<br> |    +- web: build, ports, environment, depends_on<br> |    +- db:  image, environment, volumes<br> +- volumes:   pgdata<br> +- networks:  (bo'lmasa default)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    build: .                      # shu papkadagi Dockerfile'dan<br>    ports: [&quot;8080:8080&quot;]          # host:container<br>    environment:<br>      DB_HOST: db                 # service nomi = DNS nom<br>    depends_on: [db]              # db avval start bo'lsin<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16            # tayyor image<br>    environment:<br>      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: secret<br>    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]<br>volumes:<br>  pgdata:                         # named volume e'loni</pre><pre>docker compose config --quiet &amp;&amp; echo &quot;fayl to'g'ri&quot;<br>docker compose up -d<br>docker compose ps</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>YAML'da indentatsiya — faqat bo'sh joy (tab emas); xato joydagi indent butun ma'noni o'zgartiradi.</li><li><code>version:</code> yozish shart emas (eskirgan).</li><li>Parolni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri faylda saqlab, Git'ga commit qilish — <code>.env</code> yoki <code>secrets:</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Faylni minimal tut va har maydonni ongli qo'sh. <code>docker compose config</code> — har o'zgarishdan keyin birinchi tekshiruv.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34172	<p><code>docker compose up -d</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose up -d</code> compose fayldagi barcha resurslarni (network, volume, container) yaratadi va container'larni <b>fonda</b> (detached) ishga tushiradi. Agar container allaqachon bo'lsa va config o'zgarmagan bo'lsa — tegmaydi; o'zgargan bo'lsa — qayta yaratadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>-d</code> siz ishga tushirsang, terminal loglarga band bo'ladi va Ctrl+C hamma narsani to'xtatadi; SSH uzilsa servislar ham to'xtashi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>up -d<br> +- image yo'q?    -&gt; pull yoki build<br> +- network yo'q?  -&gt; yaratish<br> +- container yo'q -&gt; yaratish + start<br> +- config o'zgardi -&gt; recreate<br> +- o'zgarmagan    -&gt; &quot;Running&quot; (tegmaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose up -d<br># [+] Running 3/3<br>#  Network shop_default  Created<br>#  Container shop-db-1   Started<br>#  Container shop-web-1  Started<br>docker compose up -d web       # faqat web (+ uning dependency'lari)<br>docker compose up -d --build   # image'ni qayta build qilib<br>docker compose up -d --wait    # healthy bo'lishini kutib qaytadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kod o'zgardi, lekin <code>--build</code> siz <code>up -d</code> — eski image ishlatiladi.</li><li><code>up -d</code> image tag <code>latest</code> bo'lsa ham yangi versiyani o'zi tortmaydi — avval <code>pull</code>.</li><li>Xato bo'lsa <code>-d</code> bilan ko'rinmaydi — <code>docker compose logs</code> ga qara.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>up -d</code> idempotent: necha marta ishlatsang ham natija bir xil — shuning uchun deploy skriptida xavfsiz. <code>--wait</code> CI va deploy skriptlarida &quot;haqiqatan ko'tarildi&quot; tekshiruvini beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34173	<p><code>depends_on</code> nima kafolatlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy <code>depends_on: [db]</code> faqat <b>tartibni</b> kafolatlaydi: db container avval start qilinadi. DB ulanishga tayyorligini kafolatlamaydi. Tayyorlikni kutish uchun <code>condition: service_healthy</code> + db'da <code>healthcheck</code> kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Postgres container &quot;Started&quot;, lekin ichida server hali ishga tushmoqda. API darhol ulanadi va <code>connection refused</code> bilan yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>depends_on: [db]              db start --&gt; darhol api start<br>condition: service_healthy    db start --&gt; healthcheck ok --&gt; api start</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    build: .<br>    depends_on:<br>      db:<br>        condition: service_healthy<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16<br>    environment: { POSTGRES_PASSWORD: secret }<br>    healthcheck:<br>      test: [&quot;CMD-SHELL&quot;, &quot;pg_isready -U postgres&quot;]<br>      interval: 5s<br>      retries: 10</pre><pre>docker compose up -d<br>docker compose ps     # db: Up (healthy) -&gt; keyin api start bo'ladi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Healthcheck'siz <code>service_healthy</code> — xato.</li><li>DB keyinroq qayta ishga tushsa, <code>depends_on</code> hech narsa qilmaydi.</li><li>Server reboot'da Docker container'larni tartibsiz ko'taradi — <code>depends_on</code> hisobga olinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ilova baribir ulanishni retry/backoff bilan qilishi kerak. <code>depends_on</code> — dev qulayligi, ishonchlilik kafolati emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34174	<p>Compose'da environment o'zgaruvchilarini berish usullari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uch usul: <code>environment:</code> (faylda inline), <code>env_file:</code> (alohida fayldan container'ga) va <code>.env</code> (Compose faylidagi <code>${VAR}</code> larni to'ldirish uchun — container'ga o'zi bormaydi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bir xil compose fayl dev, staging va prod'da ishlashi kerak, faqat qiymatlar (tag, URL, log darajasi) farq qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>.env (TAG=1.4.2)    --&gt; image: myapi:${TAG}  (Compose fayl ichida)<br>.env.api            --&gt; env_file --&gt; container env<br>environment: ...    --&gt; container env (env_file'dan ustun)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: myapi:${TAG:-latest}       # TAG bo'lmasa latest<br>    env_file: [.env.api]<br>    environment:<br>      LOG_LEVEL: info</pre><pre>cat .env            # TAG=1.4.2<br>cat .env.api        # DATABASE_URL=postgres://app:pw@db:5432/app<br>docker compose config | grep image    # image: myapi:1.4.2<br>docker compose exec api env | grep -E 'LOG|DATABASE'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.env</code> dagi o'zgaruvchi container ichida yo'q — kerak bo'lsa <code>environment: X: ${X}</code> bilan uzat.</li><li>Parolda <code>$</code> bo'lsa — <code>$$</code> bilan yoz.</li><li><code>.env</code> faylni Git'ga commit qilish — <code>.env.example</code> qo'y.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>${VAR:?xabar}</code> bilan majburiy o'zgaruvchini tekshir — bo'sh qiymat bilan jimgina start bo'lishdan ko'ra darhol yiqilish yaxshi. Parollar uchun <code>secrets:</code> ishlat.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34175	<p><code>docker compose config</code> nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose config</code> barcha compose fayllar, <code>.env</code> qiymatlari, anchor va override'larni birlashtirib, <b>yakuniy natijani</b> ko'rsatadi va xatolarni tekshiradi. Debug va CI'da validatsiya uchun ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>${TAG}</code> nimaga aylandi? Override fayl qaysi maydonni almashtirdi? Ko'z bilan bilish qiyin — <code>config</code> aniq javob beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>compose.yaml + compose.prod.yaml + .env<br>       |  merge + ${VAR} almashtirish + tekshiruv<br>       v<br>yakuniy YAML yoki xato xabari</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose config                              # yakuniy YAML<br>docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml config<br>docker compose config --quiet &amp;&amp; echo OK           # faqat tekshiruv (CI uchun)<br>docker compose config --services                   # service nomlari</pre><p>Xato misoli:</p><pre>service &quot;api&quot; refers to undefined volume pgdata: invalid compose project</pre><p>CI'da:</p><pre>- run: docker compose config --quiet</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Chiqishda parollar ochiq ko'rinadi — CI loglariga to'liq chiqarma.</li><li>CI'da <code>.env</code> yo'q bo'lsa qiymatlar bo'sh bo'lib qoladi — test uchun <code>--env-file ci.env</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har compose o'zgarishidan keyin birinchi qadam — <code>config</code>. Yakuniy natijani artifact qilib saqlash &quot;prod'da aslida nima ishlayapti&quot; savoliga javob beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34176	<p>Bir nechta compose faylni birlashtirish (override)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bir nechta faylni <code>-f</code> bilan berasan: <code>docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml up -d</code>. Keyingi fayl oldingisining ustiga yoziladi (override). <code>-f</code> berilmasa <code>compose.yaml</code> + <code>compose.override.yaml</code> avtomatik birlashadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dev va prod deyarli bir xil, faqat bir nechta farq bor (bind mount, debug port, limitlar). Ikki to'liq fayl saqlasang — ular vaqt o'tib farqlanib ketadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>compose.yaml          (umumiy: services, image, network)<br>  + compose.override.yaml  (dev: bind mount, debug port)  &lt;- avtomatik<br>  + compose.prod.yaml      (prod: restart, limitlar)      &lt;- -f bilan<br>Skalyar maydon: almashtiriladi. Ro'yxat (ports, volumes): qo'shiladi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># compose.prod.yaml<br>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2<br>    restart: unless-stopped<br>    deploy:<br>      resources: { limits: { memory: 512M } }</pre><pre>docker compose up -d                                   # dev<br>docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml up -d   # prod<br>docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml config  # natijani tekshir</pre><p>Har safar <code>-f</code> yozmaslik uchun: <code>export COMPOSE_FILE=compose.yaml:compose.prod.yaml</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-f</code> berilganda override fayl avtomatik qo'shilmaydi.</li><li>Ro'yxatlar birlashadi — base'dagi portni prod'da &quot;o'chirib&quot; bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Fayllar tartibi muhim: oxirgisi ustun.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Base'ga faqat umumiy narsalarni yoz, muhitga xosini override'ga. Yakuniy natijani har doim <code>config</code> bilan tekshir.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34177	<p>Compose'da service'ni scale qilish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose up -d --scale worker=4</code> bitta service'dan 4 ta container ishga tushiradi. Port publish qilinmagan service'lar (worker, queue consumer) uchun oson; host port publish qilingan bo'lsa ikkinchi nusxa &quot;port is already allocated&quot; bilan yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Navbatda vazifalar to'planib qoldi — ko'proq worker kerak. Yoki web service'ni scale qilmoqchi bo'lasan va port xatosi chiqadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>worker x4: shop-worker-1 ... shop-worker-4  (port yo'q, muammo yo'q)<br>web x2:    host:80 -&gt; web-1 OK, web-2 XATO (port band)<br>yechim:    proxy:80 -&gt; DNS &quot;web&quot; -&gt; web-1, web-2</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose up -d --scale worker=4<br>docker compose ps worker</pre><p>Web uchun:</p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    expose: [&quot;80&quot;]            # host'ga publish yo'q<br>  proxy:<br>    image: traefik:v3<br>    ports: [&quot;80:80&quot;]</pre><p>Doimiy qilish uchun faylda: <code>deploy: { replicas: 4 }</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>container_name:</code> bo'lsa scale ishlamaydi.</li><li>Barcha nusxa bitta host'da — server o'lsa hammasi o'ladi.</li><li>Keyingi oddiy <code>up -d</code> da <code>--scale</code> berilmasa nusxalar soni <code>replicas</code> (default 1) ga qaytadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bitta host'da scale CPU yadrolardan foydalanish uchun yaxshi, lekin HA bermaydi. Ko'p server kerak bo'lsa Swarm yoki Kubernetes.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34178	<p>Compose loyiha nomi (project name) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Project name — Compose loyihasining nomi; container, network va volume nomlari shu prefiks bilan yaratiladi (<code>shop-web-1</code>, <code>shop_default</code>, <code>shop_pgdata</code>). Default — papka nomi; <code>-p</code>, <code>COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME</code> yoki faylda <code>name:</code> bilan o'zgartiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bir server'da bir xil compose faylni ikki marta (staging va test) ishga tushirmoqchisan — nom bir xil bo'lsa, ikkinchisi birinchisini ustiga yozadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>-p shop          -p shop-test<br>shop-web-1       shop-test-web-1<br>shop_default     shop-test_default<br>shop_pgdata      shop-test_pgdata    &lt;- alohida ma'lumot</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose -p shop up -d<br>docker compose -p shop-test up -d<br>docker compose ls          # ikkala project ko'rinadi<br>docker compose -p shop-test down</pre><p>Faylda qat'iy nom:</p><pre>name: shop<br>services: ...</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Papkani boshqa nomga ko'chirsang — yangi project, yangi bo'sh volume (&quot;ma'lumot yo'qoldi&quot;).</li><li>Keyingi buyruqlarda <code>-p</code> ni unutish — boshqa project bilan ishlaysan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod fayllarida har doim <code>name:</code> yoz — nom joylashuvga bog'liq bo'lmasin. Parallel CI job'larda unikal nom (<code>ci_$JOB_ID</code>) majburiy.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34179	<p>Compose default network qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Compose har loyiha uchun bitta <code>&lt;project&gt;_default</code> bridge network yaratadi va barcha service'larni unga ulaydi. Service'lar bir-birini <b>service nomi</b> bo'yicha topadi (Docker ichki DNS). Container ichida <code>localhost</code> — faqat o'sha container'ning o'zi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> API'ga <code>DB_HOST=localhost</code> yozilgan — dev mashinada ishlagan, container ichida ishlamaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[ network: shop_default ]<br>  api (172.18.0.2) --- &quot;db&quot; DNS ---&gt; db (172.18.0.3):5432<br>  api ichida localhost = 127.0.0.1 = api o'zi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    environment:<br>      DB_URL: postgres://app:pw@db:5432/app   # 'db' - service nomi<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16</pre><pre>docker network ls | grep shop                # shop_default<br>docker compose exec api getent hosts db      # 172.18.0.3  db<br>docker compose exec api nc -zv db 5432       # ulanish bor-yo'qligi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>localhost</code> yoki host IP ishlatish.</li><li>Host port (<code>5433:5432</code>) ishlatish — ichkarida doim container port (<code>5432</code>).</li><li>Boshqa compose loyihadagi service default network'da ko'rinmaydi — umumiy <code>external</code> network kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Service nomi — barqaror interfeys. Connection string'larni env orqali ber, shunda bir xil image Compose'da ham, K8s'da ham (Service nomi bilan) ishlaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34180	<p>Compose'da <code>restart:</code> qiymatlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>restart:</code> container to'xtaganda Docker uni qayta ishga tushirish-tushirmasligini belgilaydi: <code>no</code> (default), <code>always</code>, <code>on-failure</code>, <code>unless-stopped</code>. Prod uchun odatda <code>unless-stopped</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova xato bilan yiqildi yoki server reboot bo'ldi — <code>restart</code> bo'lmasa, servis o'chiq qoladi va kimdir qo'lda ko'tarishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Qiymat | Xato bilan chiqdi | Server reboot | Qo'lda stop'dan keyin reboot | |---|---|---|---| | <code>no</code> | yo'q | yo'q | yo'q | | <code>on-failure</code> | ha | ha* | yo'q | | <code>always</code> | ha | ha | <b>ha</b> | | <code>unless-stopped</code> | ha | ha | yo'q |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    restart: unless-stopped</pre><pre>sudo systemctl enable docker      # daemon boot'da yoqilsin - shart!<br>docker compose up -d              # policy recreate'da qo'llanadi<br>docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}' shop-api-1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker daemon <code>enable</code> qilinmagan bo'lsa — hech qanday policy reboot'da ishlamaydi.</li><li>YAML'ni o'zgartirib <code>up -d</code> qilmaslik — eski container eski policy bilan qoladi.</li><li><code>restart</code> crash loop'ni yashiradi — <code>docker compose ps</code> da <code>Restarting</code> va restart sonini kuzat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>unless-stopped</code> — qo'lda to'xtatilgan servisni reboot'dan keyin &quot;tiriltirib&quot; yubormaydi, shuning uchun maintenance paytida xavfsizroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34181	<p>Compose'da loglarni qanday ko'rasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose logs</code> barcha service'larning stdout/stderr loglarini ko'rsatadi; <code>-f</code> — jonli kuzatish, <code>--tail N</code> — oxirgi N qator, service nomi bilan — faqat bittasi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Container yiqilib qayta ishga tushyapti — sababini bilish uchun loglar kerak. Ilova faylga emas, stdout'ga yozishi kerak, aks holda <code>logs</code> bo'sh.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app stdout/stderr -&gt; dockerd log driver (json-file/local) -&gt; docker compose logs</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose logs -f                      # hammasi, jonli<br>docker compose logs -f --tail 50 api        # faqat api, oxirgi 50 qator<br>docker compose logs --since 10m api         # oxirgi 10 daqiqa<br>docker compose logs -t api | grep -i error  # vaqt belgisi bilan<br>docker compose logs --no-log-prefix api &gt; api.log</pre><p>Chiqish: <code>api-1  | 2026-10-03 listening on :8080</code> — chapda container nomi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-f</code> ni <code>--tail</code> siz katta logda ishlatish — minglab qator oqib chiqadi.</li><li>Log driver <code>syslog</code>/<code>gelf</code> bo'lsa <code>logs</code> ishlamasligi mumkin (Docker 20.10+ dual logging yordam beradi).</li><li>Rotation sozlanmagan — loglar diskni to'ldiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>logs</code> — tez debug uchun. Prod'da loglarni markaziy tizimga (Loki, ELK) yig' — container o'chirilsa uning loglari ham yo'qoladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34182	<p><code>docker compose stop</code>, <code>down</code>, <code>rm</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>stop</code> — container'larni to'xtatadi (o'chirmaydi). <code>rm</code> — to'xtagan container'larni o'chiradi. <code>down</code> — container'larni to'xtatib o'chiradi va network'ni ham o'chiradi; volume'lar qoladi. <code>down -v</code> — volume'larni ham o'chiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Noto'g'ri buyruq tanlash — yo ma'lumot yo'qoladi (<code>down -v</code>), yo eski container'lar qolib port band qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Buyruq | Konteyner | Network | Volume | |---|---|---|---| | <code>stop</code> | to'xtaydi | qoladi | qoladi | | <code>rm</code> | o'chadi (to'xtagan bo'lsa) | qoladi | qoladi | | <code>down</code> | o'chadi | o'chadi | qoladi | | <code>down -v</code> | o'chadi | o'chadi | <b>o'chadi</b> |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose stop            # vaqtincha to'xtatish<br>docker compose start           # qayta yoqish (o'sha container)<br>docker compose rm -f worker    # bitta service container'ini o'chirish<br>docker compose down            # tozalash, ma'lumot qoladi<br>docker compose down -v         # faqat dev'da - DB ham o'chadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prod'da <code>down -v</code> — ma'lumot yo'qolishi, qaytarib bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>stop</code> dan keyin config o'zgarishi <code>start</code> bilan qo'llanmaydi — <code>up -d</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kundalik ishda <code>stop</code>/<code>up -d</code>, tozalashda <code>down</code>. <code>-v</code> ni faqat ataylab, dev muhitida ishlat; prod'da muhim volume'larni <code>external: true</code> qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34183	<p>Compose'da image'larni qanday yangilaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose pull</code> yangi image'larni yuklaydi, keyin <code>docker compose up -d</code> faqat image'i o'zgargan container'larni qayta yaratadi. Eski image'larni <code>docker image prune</code> bilan tozalaysan. O'zing build qilgan image'lar uchun <code>docker compose build --pull</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>up -d</code> o'zi registry'dan yangi versiyani tortmaydi — lokal image bo'lsa o'shani ishlatadi. Natijada &quot;yangiladim&quot; deysan, lekin eski versiya ishlayapti.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pull   -&gt; registry'dan yangi digest -&gt; lokal image yangilandi<br>up -d  -&gt; container image digest != yangi -&gt; recreate<br>prune  -&gt; hech kim ishlatmaydigan eski image'lar o'chadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose pull<br>docker compose up -d<br>docker compose ps                    # yangi container'lar &quot;Up X seconds&quot;<br>docker image prune -f                # dangling image'larni tozalash<br>docker compose build --pull          # o'z build: base image'ni ham yangilab</pre><p>Versiyani aniq boshqarish:</p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: ghcr.io/acme/api:${TAG}   # TAG=1.4.3 docker compose up -d</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>latest</code> tag — qaysi versiya ishlayotganini bilmaysan, rollback qiyin.</li><li>Recreate paytida qisqa downtime bo'ladi.</li><li><code>prune -a</code> — ishlatilmayotgan barcha image'larni o'chiradi, rollback image'ini ham.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Aniq tag (yoki digest) bilan deploy qil — rollback = oldingi TAG bilan <code>up -d</code>. Yangilashni avval staging'da sina.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34184	<p>Compose'da healthcheck qanday yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>healthcheck:</code> container ichida vaqti-vaqti bilan buyruq bajaradi; exit 0 — healthy, aks holda <code>retries</code> marta ketma-ket xatodan keyin unhealthy. Parametrlar: <code>test</code>, <code>interval</code>, <code>timeout</code>, <code>retries</code>, <code>start_period</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Container &quot;Up&quot;, lekin ilova ichida osilib qolgan yoki hali tayyor emas. Healthcheck haqiqiy holatni ko'rsatadi va <code>depends_on: service_healthy</code> uchun kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>start -&gt; start_period (20s, xatolar hisobga olinmaydi)<br>      -&gt; har interval (10s): test (timeout 3s)<br>           ok      -&gt; healthy<br>           3x fail -&gt; unhealthy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    healthcheck:<br>      test: [&quot;CMD&quot;, &quot;curl&quot;, &quot;-f&quot;, &quot;http://localhost:8080/health&quot;]<br>      interval: 10s<br>      timeout: 3s<br>      retries: 3<br>      start_period: 20s</pre><pre>docker compose ps        # STATUS: Up 1 minute (healthy)<br>docker inspect -f '{{json .State.Health}}' shop-api-1   # oxirgi natijalar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>curl</code> image'da yo'q (alpine, distroless) — healthcheck doim yiqiladi; <code>wget</code> yoki ilovaning o'z buyrug'i.</li><li><code>CMD-SHELL</code> va <code>CMD</code> farqi: shell sintaksisi (<code>||</code>, <code>$VAR</code>) faqat <code>CMD-SHELL</code> da.</li><li>Unhealthy container oddiy Compose'da avtomatik restart bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Health endpoint yengil bo'lsin va tashqi servislarni (DB) tekshirmasin — aks holda DB sekinlashsa hamma servislar unhealthy bo'lib ketadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34185	<p>Compose'da resurs limitlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>deploy.resources.limits</code> bilan CPU (<code>cpus</code>) va xotira (<code>memory</code>) chegarasi beriladi; <code>reservations</code> — minimal kafolat. Compose v2 bularni oddiy <code>docker compose up</code> da ham qo'llaydi (eski v1 da faqat Swarm'da ishlardi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta service xotirani yeb tugatadi va butun serverni qotiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>memory: 512M -&gt; oshsa container OOMKilled (exit 137), boshqalar omon<br>cpus: &quot;1.0&quot;  -&gt; 1 yadrodan ko'p ishlata olmaydi (sekinlashadi, o'lmaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    deploy:<br>      resources:<br>        limits:<br>          cpus: &quot;1.0&quot;<br>          memory: 512M<br>        reservations:<br>          memory: 256M</pre><pre>docker compose up -d<br>docker stats --no-stream     # MEM USAGE / LIMIT: 120MiB / 512MiB<br>docker inspect -f '{{.State.OOMKilled}}' shop-api-1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Limit juda past — ilova tez-tez OOMKilled bo'lib restart bo'ladi.</li><li>Eski <code>mem_limit</code>, <code>cpus</code> (service darajasida) ham ishlaydi, lekin <code>deploy.resources</code> bilan aralashtirma.</li><li>Java/Node limitni o'zi bilmasligi mumkin — heap sozlamasini moslashtir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Limitni taxmin bilan emas, <code>docker stats</code> bilan haqiqiy foydalanishni o'lchab, zaxira qo'shib qo'y.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34186	<p>Dev muhitda kodni konteynerga jonli ulash?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bind mount bilan host'dagi kod papkasini container ichiga ulaysan (<code>./src:/app/src</code>) va dev server (hot reload) o'zgarishni darhol ko'radi. Zamonaviy variant — <code>develop.watch</code> + <code>docker compose watch</code>: fayllarni avtomatik sync yoki kerak bo'lsa rebuild qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har kichik o'zgarishdan keyin <code>docker compose up --build</code> — 30 s-1 daqiqa kutish, dev sekinlashadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bind mount: host ./src  &lt;==&gt; container /app/src  (bir xil fayllar)<br>watch:      host ./src --(o'zgarish)--&gt; nusxa container'ga (sync)<br>            package.json o'zgardi --&gt; rebuild</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    build: .<br>    command: npm run dev<br>    volumes:<br>      - ./src:/app/src<br>      - /app/node_modules          # image'dagi node_modules saqlansin</pre><p>Watch varianti:</p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    build: .<br>    develop:<br>      watch:<br>        - action: sync<br>          path: ./src<br>          target: /app/src<br>        - action: rebuild<br>          path: package.json</pre><pre>docker compose watch</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bind mount image ichidagi <code>node_modules</code>ni yopib qo'yadi — anonymous volume bilan ajrat.</li><li>macOS/Windows'da bind mount sekin; watch tezroq.</li><li>Linux'da fayl egasi (UID) muammolari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu faqat dev uchun. Prod'da kod image ichida bo'lishi kerak — bind mount kod reproducible emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34187	<p>Compose'da secret'lar qanday beriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>secrets:</code> bo'limida secret e'lon qilinadi (fayldan) va service'ga ulanadi; container ichida u <code>/run/secrets/&lt;nom&gt;</code> fayli bo'lib ko'rinadi. Ilova parolni shu fayldan o'qiydi (masalan <code>POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE</code>).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Parolni <code>environment:</code> ga yozsang — <code>docker inspect</code>, loglar va process ro'yxatida ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>./db_pass.txt (host) --mount--&gt; /run/secrets/db_pass (container, read-only)<br>postgres: POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE -&gt; fayldan o'qiydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16<br>    environment:<br>      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/db_pass<br>    secrets: [db_pass]<br>secrets:<br>  db_pass:<br>    file: ./db_pass.txt</pre><pre>printf 'S3cret!' &gt; db_pass.txt &amp;&amp; chmod 600 db_pass.txt<br>echo db_pass.txt &gt;&gt; .gitignore<br>docker compose up -d<br>docker compose exec db ls -l /run/secrets/</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret faylni Git'ga commit qilish.</li><li><code>echo</code> oxirida newline qo'shadi — parol mos kelmaydi; <code>printf</code> ishlat.</li><li>Oddiy Compose'da secret shifrlanmaydi — shunchaki fayl mount.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Env'dan yaxshi, lekin to'liq yechim emas: prod'da secret'lar Vault yoki cloud secret manager'dan, rotation bilan kelishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34188	<p><code>docker compose ps</code> nima ko'rsatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose ps</code> joriy loyihaning container'larini ko'rsatadi: nomi, image, buyruq, service, holati (<code>Up</code>, <code>Exited</code>, <code>Restarting</code>, <code>(healthy)</code>) va publish qilingan portlar. Default faqat ishlayotganlar; <code>-a</code> — to'xtaganlar ham.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Sayt ochilmayapti&quot; — birinchi savol: container'lar ishlayaptimi, healthy'mi, port to'g'ri ochilganmi? <code>ps</code> bunga bir qarashda javob beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker compose ps -&gt; label project=shop bo'yicha container'lar -&gt; jadval</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose ps<br># NAME        IMAGE        SERVICE  STATUS                  PORTS<br># shop-api-1  shop-api     api      Up 5 minutes (healthy)  0.0.0.0:8080-&gt;8080/tcp<br># shop-db-1   postgres:16  db       Up 5 minutes (healthy)  5432/tcp<br>docker compose ps -a                         # Exited (1) ham ko'rinadi<br>docker compose ps --status exited<br>docker compose ps -q api                     # faqat ID (skript uchun)<br>docker compose ps --format json | jq '.[].Health'</pre><p>O'qish: <code>Exited (1)</code> — xato bilan chiqqan, <code>logs</code> ga qara; <code>Restarting</code> — crash loop; <code>5432/tcp</code> (strelkasiz) — faqat ichki, host'ga ochilmagan.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Boshqa papkada ishga tushirish — boshqa project, bo'sh ro'yxat.</li><li><code>-a</code> siz yiqilgan container ko'rinmaydi va &quot;yo'q&quot; deb o'ylaysan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Skriptlarda <code>--format json</code> ishlat — matn ustunlarini parse qilish versiya o'zgarganda buziladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34189	<p>Compose'da <code>command</code> va <code>entrypoint</code> ni almashtirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>command:</code> image'dagi <code>CMD</code> ni almashtiradi (argumentlar), <code>entrypoint:</code> esa <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> ni (asosiy dastur). Shu bilan bitta image'dan turli rollar — web, worker, scheduler — yasash mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Web va worker uchun ikki xil image build qilish — ikki marta build, ikki versiya, sinxronlash muammosi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>yakuniy buyruq = ENTRYPOINT + CMD<br>image: ENTRYPOINT [&quot;python&quot;]  CMD [&quot;app.py&quot;]<br>command: [&quot;worker.py&quot;]      -&gt; python worker.py<br>entrypoint: [&quot;sh&quot;,&quot;-c&quot;]     -&gt; CMD ham bekor qilinadi (o'zi ham bermasang bo'sh)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    image: myapp:1.4.2<br>    command: [&quot;gunicorn&quot;, &quot;app:wsgi&quot;, &quot;-b&quot;, &quot;0.0.0.0:8000&quot;]<br>  worker:<br>    image: myapp:1.4.2<br>    command: [&quot;python&quot;, &quot;worker.py&quot;, &quot;--queue&quot;, &quot;emails&quot;]<br>  debug:<br>    image: myapp:1.4.2<br>    entrypoint: [&quot;sleep&quot;, &quot;infinity&quot;]</pre><pre>docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Entrypoint}} {{.Config.Cmd}}' shop-worker-1<br>docker compose run --rm --entrypoint sh web     # bir martalik almashtirish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>String shakli (<code>command: python worker.py</code>) shell orqali emas, so'zlarga bo'linadi; <code>&amp;&amp;</code>, <code>$VAR</code> kerak bo'lsa <code>[&quot;sh&quot;,&quot;-c&quot;,&quot;...&quot;]</code>.</li><li><code>entrypoint</code> o'zgartirilsa image'dagi CMD ham bekor bo'ladi.</li><li>Shell orqali ishga tushgan process PID 1 bo'lmaydi — SIGTERM yetib bormaydi (<code>exec</code> ishlat).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Bitta image, ko'p rol&quot; — versiyalar har doim mos: web va worker bir xil kod bilan deploy bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34190	<p>Compose'da profillar (<code>profiles</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>profiles:</code> — service'ni faqat kerakli profil yoqilganda ishga tushirish. Profilsiz service'lar har doim ko'tariladi; <code>profiles: [debug]</code> bo'lgan service esa faqat <code>--profile debug</code> (yoki <code>COMPOSE_PROFILES=debug</code>) bilan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Adminer, mailhog, test seed, monitoring kabi yordamchi servislar har kuni kerak emas, lekin alohida faylda saqlash noqulay.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>up                  -&gt; api, db<br>up --profile debug  -&gt; api, db, adminer<br>up --profile debug --profile tools -&gt; + seed</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api: { build: . }<br>  db:  { image: postgres:16 }<br>  adminer:<br>    image: adminer<br>    ports: [&quot;127.0.0.1:8081:8080&quot;]<br>    profiles: [debug]<br>  seed:<br>    image: myapp<br>    command: [&quot;./seed&quot;]<br>    profiles: [tools]</pre><pre>docker compose --profile debug up -d<br>COMPOSE_PROFILES=debug,tools docker compose up -d<br>docker compose run --rm seed       # nom bilan chaqirilsa profil avtomatik yoqiladi<br>docker compose --profile debug down</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Profilli service'ni o'chirish uchun <code>down</code> ga ham <code>--profile</code> kerak, aks holda qolib ketadi.</li><li>Profilsiz service profilli service'ga <code>depends_on</code> qilsa — xato yoki kutilmagan yoqilish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Profillar bitta faylni dev/debug/tools uchun moslashuvchan qiladi va override fayllar sonini kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34191	<p>Compose'da <code>.env</code> fayli qayerdan o'qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Default'da <code>.env</code> <b>project papkasidan</b> (compose fayl joylashgan papka yoki <code>--project-directory</code>) o'qiladi. Boshqa faylni <code>--env-file .env.prod</code> bilan berasan. U compose fayldagi <code>${VAR}</code> larni to'ldiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Boshqa papkadan <code>-f ../app/compose.yaml</code> bilan ishga tushirsang, kutilgan <code>.env</code> topilmay qolishi va qiymatlar bo'sh bo'lishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ustunlik (interpolatsiya):<br>  shell env  &gt;  --env-file / .env  &gt;  ${VAR:-default}</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls -a        # compose.yaml  .env  .env.prod  .env.example<br>docker compose up -d                          # .env<br>docker compose --env-file .env.prod up -d     # .env.prod<br>docker compose --env-file .env.prod config | grep image   # tekshirish</pre><p><code>.env</code> misol:</p><pre>TAG=1.4.2<br>COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=shop</pre><p><code>.gitignore</code>:</p><pre>.env<br>.env.*<br>!.env.example</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.env</code> ni Git'ga commit qilish — parollar oshkor bo'ladi.</li><li>Shell'da eksport qilingan o'zgaruvchi <code>.env</code> dagi qiymatni jimgina bosadi.</li><li><code>.env</code> container ichiga avtomatik bormaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>.env.example</code> repo'da — yangi dasturchi qaysi o'zgaruvchilar kerakligini biladi. Muhit bo'yicha <code>--env-file</code> — sodda va tushunarli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34192	<p>Compose'da named volume va bind mount qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Named volume</b> — Docker boshqaradigan doimiy ma'lumot uchun (DB, upload'lar). <b>Bind mount</b> — host'dagi aniq fayl/papkani ulash uchun (config fayl, dev'da kod). Qoida: ma'lumot — named volume, config va kod — bind mount.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Postgres data'ni bind mount qilsang — UID/permission xatolari; config'ni named volume'ga qo'ysang — tahrirlash noqulay.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data  -&gt; /var/lib/docker/volumes/shop_pgdata (Docker)<br>./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro -&gt; host fayl, container faqat o'qiydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16<br>    volumes:<br>      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data          # named<br>  nginx:<br>    image: nginx<br>    volumes:<br>      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro    # bind, read-only<br>volumes:<br>  pgdata:</pre><pre>docker volume ls<br>ls -ln ./data      # bind mount'da egasi UID 999 bo'lishi mumkin</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bind mount'da container ichidagi user (masalan UID 999) host papkaga yoza olmaydi.</li><li>Mavjud bo'lmagan bind yo'l — Docker root egaligida papka yaratadi (fayl kutgan joyda papka).</li><li>Bitta faylni bind qilib, uni editor bilan tahrirlash — inode almashadi, container eski versiyani ko'radi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>:ro</code> ni default qil — container o'zgartirishi kerak bo'lmagan hamma narsa read-only bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34193	<p><code>docker compose exec db psql -U postgres</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bu buyruq ishlab turgan <code>db</code> service container'i ichida <code>psql</code> klientini <code>postgres</code> user'i bilan ishga tushiradi — interaktiv SQL konsol ochiladi. Host'ga psql o'rnatish yoki portni ochish shart emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB'ni tekshirish kerak, lekin port xavfsizlik uchun ochilmagan va host'da psql yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker compose exec db psql -U postgres<br>   -&gt; shop-db-1 container ichida yangi process: psql<br>   -&gt; unix socket orqali postgres serverga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose exec db psql -U postgres<br># postgres=# \l          bazalar ro'yxati<br># postgres=# \c app      bazaga o'tish<br># app=# \dt              jadvallar<br># app=# \q               chiqish<br>docker compose exec db psql -U postgres -d app -c 'select count(*) from users;'<br>docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U postgres app &gt; dump.sql     # backup<br>docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres app &lt; dump.sql        # restore</pre><p><code>-T</code> — TTY ajratmaydi; pipe yoki redirect bilan ishlatganda shart, aks holda chiqishda ortiqcha belgilar yoki &quot;input device is not a TTY&quot; xatosi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Container ishlamayotgan bo'lsa <code>exec</code> ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>-U postgres</code> user mavjud bo'lmasa (masalan <code>POSTGRES_USER=app</code>) — &quot;role does not exist&quot;.</li><li>Prod DB'da qo'lda SQL — audit va transaction'ni unutma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>exec -T</code> + pg_dump — oddiy backup skriptining asosi. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34194	<p>Compose'da port faqat localhost'ga qanday ochiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Portda host IP'ni ko'rsatasan: <code>&quot;127.0.0.1:5432:5432&quot;</code> — port faqat server'ning o'zidan (localhost) ochiq bo'ladi. <code>&quot;5432:5432&quot;</code> esa <code>0.0.0.0</code> — barcha interfeyslarda, ya'ni internetdan ochiq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB <code>5432:5432</code> bilan publish qilingan, UFW yoqilgan — baribir internetdan ochiq.
