Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34195	<p>Compose'da <code>build</code> bo'limi parametrlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>build:</code> bo'limi image qanday yig'ilishini belgilaydi: <code>context</code> (build papkasi), <code>dockerfile</code> (fayl yo'li), <code>target</code> (multi-stage'dan qaysi stage), <code>args</code> (build argumentlari). <code>image:</code> bilan birga natija shu nom bilan tag qilinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Monorepo'da Dockerfile ildizda emas, dev va prod uchun turli stage kerak, Go versiyasini parametr qilish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>context ./api (shu papka fayllari daemon'ga yuboriladi, .dockerignore hisobga)<br>  + dockerfile Dockerfile<br>  + args GO_VERSION=1.23 -&gt; ARG<br>  + target dev -&gt; faqat &quot;dev&quot; stage'gacha<br>  = image myorg/api:dev</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    build:<br>      context: ./api<br>      dockerfile: Dockerfile<br>      target: dev<br>      args:<br>        GO_VERSION: &quot;1.23&quot;<br>      cache_from: [myorg/api:cache]<br>    image: myorg/api:dev</pre><pre>ARG GO_VERSION=1.22<br>FROM golang:${GO_VERSION} AS dev<br>...<br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static AS prod</pre><pre>docker compose build api<br>docker compose build --no-cache api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>dockerfile</code> yo'li <code>context</code> ga nisbatan.</li><li>Katta context (<code>.git</code>, <code>node_modules</code>) — sekin build; <code>.dockerignore</code> qo'sh.</li><li><code>args</code> ga secret berish — image history'da qoladi; <code>build.secrets</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Multi-stage + <code>target</code> — bitta Dockerfile dev va prod'ga xizmat qiladi, prod image kichik va xavfsiz.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34196	<p>Compose bilan bir martalik vazifa (migratsiya) ishga tushirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose run --rm api ./migrate up</code> — <code>api</code> service konfiguratsiyasidan yangi vaqtinchalik container yaratadi, migratsiyani bajaradi va tugagach o'chiradi (<code>--rm</code>). Dependency'lar (<code>depends_on</code>) ham avtomatik ko'tariladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Migratsiya, seed, backfill — bir martalik vazifalar. Ularni ishlayotgan api ichida (<code>exec</code>) qilish noqulay, yoki api hali ishlamayapti.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>run --rm api ./migrate up<br>  -&gt; db ko'tarilganmi? (depends_on) -&gt; yo'q bo'lsa start<br>  -&gt; yangi container shop-api-run-xxxx -&gt; ./migrate up -&gt; exit code<br>  -&gt; --rm: container o'chiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose run --rm api ./migrate up<br>echo $?                                     # 0 - muvaffaqiyatli<br>docker compose run --rm --no-deps api ./migrate status   # db'ni ko'tarmasdan<br>docker compose run --rm -e LOG_LEVEL=debug api ./seed</pre><p>Yoki doimiy yechim — alohida service:</p><pre>services:<br>  migrate:<br>    image: myapp<br>    command: [&quot;./migrate&quot;, &quot;up&quot;]<br>    depends_on: { db: { condition: service_healthy } }<br>  api:<br>    depends_on: { migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--rm</code> siz — container'lar to'planadi.</li><li><code>run</code> default'da portlarni publish qilmaydi (<code>--service-ports</code> kerak).</li><li>Bir nechta replika start'da migratsiya qilsa — to'qnashuv; migratsiya bitta joydan bo'lsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Deploy ketma-ketligi: migratsiya (backward-compatible) -&gt; yangi versiya. Exit code'ni tekshir — migratsiya yiqilsa deploy to'xtasin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34197	<p>Compose qachon yetarli va qachon Kubernetes/Swarm kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Compose — <b>bitta server</b>, oddiy stack, kichik/o'rta trafik, past SLA uchun yetarli. Ko'p node, avtomatik failover, rolling update, autoscaling kerak bo'lsa — Swarm (oddiyroq) yoki Kubernetes (kuchliroq, murakkabroq).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kichik loyiha uchun K8s — ortiqcha murakkablik va xarajat. Katta loyiha uchun Compose — server o'lsa hammasi to'xtaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | | Compose | Swarm | Kubernetes | |---|---|---|---| | Node | 1 | ko'p | ko'p | | Failover | yo'q | ha | ha | | Rolling update | qo'lda | o'rnatilgan | o'rnatilgan | | Autoscaling | yo'q | yo'q | HPA | | Murakkablik | past | o'rta | yuqori | | Ekotizim | dev | kichik | juda katta |</p><p><b>Amalda (qaror savollari):</b></p><pre>Server o'lsa qancha downtime qabul qilinadi?   -&gt; soatlar: Compose<br>Kuniga necha deploy?                           -&gt; ko'p: rolling kerak<br>Jamoada K8s tajribasi bormi?                   -&gt; yo'q: managed (EKS/GKE) yoki PaaS<br>Trafik o'zgaruvchanmi?                         -&gt; ha: autoscaling</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Hamma K8s ishlatadi&quot; deb kichik loyihaga olib kirish — ops yuki rivojlanishni sekinlashtiradi.</li><li>Compose'da qolib, HA'ni qo'lda skriptlar bilan &quot;yasash&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng sodda yetarli yechimni tanla va migratsiya yo'lini ochiq qoldir: 12-factor ilova, env bilan config, healthcheck — keyin K8s'ga o'tish oson bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34198	<p><code>docker compose top</code> va <code>stats</code> nima ko'rsatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose top</code> — har container ichidagi <b>process'lar</b> ro'yxatini (PID, user, buyruq) ko'rsatadi. <code>docker stats</code> — container'larning jonli <b>resurs</b> foydalanishini (CPU %, xotira, network, disk I/O) ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Server sekin — qaysi container CPU/RAM yeyapti? Yoki container ichida kutilmagan process (zombie, crypto-miner) ishlayaptimi?</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>top   -&gt; har container cgroup'idagi process'lar (ps kabi)<br>stats -&gt; cgroup hisoblagichlari, har soniyada yangilanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose top<br># shop-api-1<br># UID  PID   PPID  CMD<br># 1000 2345  2320  /app/api<br>docker stats $(docker compose ps -q)<br># NAME        CPU %   MEM USAGE / LIMIT   NET I/O       PIDS<br># shop-api-1  2.5%    120MiB / 512MiB     1.2MB / 3MB   12<br>docker stats --no-stream --format 'table {{.Name}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}'</pre><p>O'qish: <code>MEM USAGE</code> limitga yaqin — OOM xavfi; <code>PIDS</code> doimiy o'sib boryapti — process/goroutine leak.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>stats</code> faqat lahzalik holat, tarix yo'q — trend uchun cAdvisor + Prometheus.</li><li>CPU % ko'p yadroli host'da 100% dan oshishi mumkin (200% = 2 yadro).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>stats</code> — tezkor diagnostika. Limitlarni qo'yish va alert uchun metrikalarni doimiy yig'.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34199	<p>Compose'da <code>networks</code> bilan service'larni ajratish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>networks:</code> bo'limida bir nechta network e'lon qilib, har service'ni faqat kerakli network'ga ulaysan. Bir xil network'da bo'lmagan service'lar bir-birini ko'rmaydi — masalan, proxy DB'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulana olmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hamma bitta network'da bo'lsa, internetga ochiq proxy buzilganda hujumchi DB'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yetib boradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[front]  proxy ---- api<br>[back]              api ---- db<br>proxy -X-&gt; db (umumiy network yo'q)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  proxy: { image: nginx, ports: [&quot;80:80&quot;], networks: [front] }<br>  api:   { image: api, networks: [front, back] }<br>  db:    { image: postgres:16, networks: [back] }<br>networks:<br>  front: {}<br>  back:<br>    internal: true      # tashqi internetga chiqish ham yo'q</pre><pre>docker compose exec proxy getent hosts db   # bo'sh -&gt; izolyatsiya ishlaydi<br>docker compose exec api getent hosts db     # IP bor</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>networks:</code> yozilgan service default network'ga ulanmaydi — kerakli hammasini sanab chiq.</li><li><code>internal: true</code> network'da <code>ports</code> publish ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Network ajratish — eng arzon xavfsizlik qatlami (defense in depth). Faqat kerakli yo'llarni och.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34200	<p>Compose'da <code>extends</code> yoki YAML anchor nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Takrorlanuvchi konfiguratsiyani bir joyga yig'ish uchun. YAML anchor (<code>&amp;common</code>) bilan blok belgilanadi va <code>&lt;&lt;: *common</code> bilan qo'shiladi; <code>x-</code> bilan boshlanadigan top-level kalitlarni Compose e'tiborsiz qoldiradi — shuning uchun shablonlar shu yerda saqlanadi. <code>extends</code> — boshqa service yoki fayldan meros.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 8 ta service'da bir xil <code>restart</code> va <code>logging</code> — bittasini o'zgartirishni unutasan va konfiguratsiya farqlanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>x-common: &amp;common  (shablon, Compose uni service deb o'qimaydi)<br>api:    &lt;&lt;: *common  -&gt; restart + logging + o'z maydonlari<br>worker: &lt;&lt;: *common</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>x-common: &amp;common<br>  restart: unless-stopped<br>  logging:<br>    options: { max-size: &quot;10m&quot; }<br>services:<br>  api:<br>    &lt;&lt;: *common<br>    image: api<br>  worker:<br>    &lt;&lt;: *common<br>    image: worker<br>    restart: on-failure      # shablondagi qiymatni bosib ketadi</pre><pre>docker compose config    # anchor'lar ochilgan holda ko'rinadi</pre><p><code>extends</code> varianti:</p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    extends: { file: common.yaml, service: base }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>&lt;&lt;:</code> sayoz birlashtiradi — ichki map (<code>logging</code>) to'liq almashtiriladi.</li><li>Anchor faqat bitta fayl ichida ishlaydi; fayllar orasida <code>extends</code>/<code>include</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Abstraksiyani me'yorida ishlat — o'qish oson bo'lsin. Yakuniy natijani doim <code>config</code> bilan tekshir.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34201	<p>Compose'da log rotate qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>logging:</code> bo'limida log driver va opsiyalar beriladi: <code>json-file</code> driver bilan <code>max-size</code> (bitta fayl hajmi) va <code>max-file</code> (nechta fayl saqlanadi). Shunda loglar cheksiz o'sib diskni to'ldirmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Default <code>json-file</code> cheklanmagan — oylar davomida <code>/var/lib/docker/containers/*/..-json.log</code> o'nlab GB bo'ladi, disk to'ladi, DB yozolmay qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app stdout -&gt; api-json.log (10m bo'lsa) -&gt; .log.1 -&gt; .log.2<br>              max-file 3 -&gt; eng eskisi o'chiriladi<br>maksimal hajm = 10m x 3 = 30m har container</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    logging:<br>      driver: json-file<br>      options:<br>        max-size: &quot;10m&quot;<br>        max-file: &quot;3&quot;</pre><p>Global default — <code>/etc/docker/daemon.json</code>:</p><pre>{ &quot;log-driver&quot;: &quot;local&quot;, &quot;log-opts&quot;: { &quot;max-size&quot;: &quot;10m&quot;, &quot;max-file&quot;: &quot;3&quot; } }</pre><pre>sudo systemctl restart docker<br>du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log | sort -h | tail</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sozlama faqat <b>yangi yaratilgan</b> container'larga ta'sir qiladi — <code>up -d --force-recreate</code>.</li><li><code>max-file</code> qo'shtirnoqda bo'lishi kerak (string).</li><li>Ilova faylga yozsa (<code>/app/logs</code>) — bu sozlama unga ta'sir qilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>local</code> driver siqilgan va default rotation'li — json-file'dan samaraliroq. Uzoq saqlash kerak bo'lsa loglarni markaziy tizimga (Loki/ELK) yubor.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34202	<p><code>docker compose restart</code> va <code>up -d --force-recreate</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose restart</code> — o'sha container'ni to'xtatib qayta yoqadi, <b>compose fayl o'zgarishlarini (env, image, port) olmaydi</b>. <code>up -d</code> — o'zgargan service'ni qayta yaratadi. <code>up -d --force-recreate</code> — hech narsa o'zgarmagan bo'lsa ham container'ni qaytadan yaratadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>environment:</code> ga yangi o'zgaruvchi qo'shib <code>restart</code> qilding — ilova uni ko'rmayapti. Chunki container eski konfiguratsiya bilan qayta ishga tushdi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>restart:                 stop -&gt; start (o'sha container, eski config)<br>up -d:                   config o'zgardimi? ha -&gt; o'chir + yangi yarat<br>up -d --force-recreate:  har doim o'chir + yangi yarat</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose restart api                 # ilova holatini tozalash uchun<br>docker compose up -d                       # compose.yaml o'zgarishini qo'llash<br>docker compose up -d --force-recreate api  # bind mount'dagi config fayl o'zgarganda<br>docker compose exec api env | grep NEW_VAR # natijani tekshir</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Config o'zgarishi uchun <code>restart</code> ishlatish — eng keng tarqalgan xato.</li><li><code>--force-recreate</code> container writable layer'idagi ma'lumotni o'chiradi (volume'dagi qoladi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: compose fayl o'zgardi — <code>up -d</code>; faqat ilovani &quot;silkitish&quot; kerak — <code>restart</code>. Deploy skriptlarida doim <code>up -d</code>.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34203	<p>Compose bilan prod'ga deploy qilishda nimalarga e'tibor?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Minimal checklist: aniq image tag, <code>restart: unless-stopped</code>, healthcheck, log rotation, resurs limitlari, DB port tashqariga yopiq, secret'lar Git'da emas, volume backup (va restore sinovi), TLS'li reverse proxy, Docker daemon enable qilingan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dev compose faylini o'zgarishsiz prod'ga qo'yish — disk to'lishi, reboot'dan keyin tushish, ochiq DB va backup'siz ma'lumot.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>internet -&gt; Caddy/Traefik (TLS, 443) -&gt; api (limit, healthcheck, restart)<br>                                         -&gt; db (port yopiq, volume -&gt; backup -&gt; S3)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: ghcr.io/acme/app:1.4.2          # latest emas<br>    restart: unless-stopped<br>    healthcheck:<br>      test: [&quot;CMD&quot;, &quot;/app/app&quot;, &quot;-health&quot;]<br>      interval: 10s<br>    deploy: { resources: { limits: { memory: 512M } } }<br>    logging: { driver: local, options: { max-size: &quot;10m&quot; } }<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16<br>    restart: unless-stopped<br>    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]<br>    # ports yo'q</pre><pre>sudo systemctl enable docker<br>docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml config --quiet</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>latest</code> — rollback qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Backup bor, restore sinalmagan.</li><li>Monitoring yo'q — muammoni foydalanuvchi xabar qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Checklist'ni skript/CI tekshiruviga aylantir (masalan, <code>config</code> chiqishida <code>latest</code> yoki <code>0.0.0.0:5432</code> bor-yo'qligini grep qilish) — inson xotirasiga tayanma.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34204	<p>Compose'da ishlayotgan konteynerda o'zgaruvchini tekshirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose exec api env</code> ishlab turgan container ichidagi barcha environment o'zgaruvchilarini chiqaradi; <code>grep</code> bilan keraklisini filtrlaysan. Container ishlamasa — <code>docker inspect</code> bilan config'dagi env'ni ko'rasan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova &quot;DB_HOST topilmadi&quot; deydi. O'zgaruvchi container'ga yetib bordimi yoki <code>.env</code>/<code>env_file</code> chalkashligimi — tekshirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>compose: environment + env_file + image ENV -&gt; container env<br>exec api env -&gt; process ichidagi haqiqiy qiymatlar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose exec api env | grep DB_<br># DB_HOST=db<br># DB_PORT=5432<br>docker compose exec api printenv DB_HOST<br>docker inspect -f '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' shop-api-1   # to'xtagan bo'lsa ham<br>docker compose config | grep -A5 environment    # Compose nima berishni rejalashtirgan</pre><p>Solishtir: <code>config</code> da bor, <code>exec env</code> da yo'q -&gt; container recreate qilinmagan (<code>up -d</code> kerak).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Distroless image'da <code>env</code>/shell yo'q — <code>docker inspect</code> ishlat.</li><li>Chiqishda parollar ko'rinadi — screen share/log'da ehtiyot bo'l.</li><li>Ilova env'ni startda o'qiydi — o'zgarish uchun recreate kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Kutilgan&quot; (<code>config</code>) va &quot;haqiqiy&quot; (<code>exec env</code>) qiymatlarni solishtirish — config muammolarini tez topishning eng ishonchli yo'li.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34205	<p>Compose'da <code>init: true</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>init: true</code> container ichida PID 1 sifatida kichik init jarayonini (<code>tini</code>) ishga tushiradi. U signallarni (SIGTERM) ilovangizga to'g'ri uzatadi va zombie process'larni tozalaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova PID 1 bo'lganda Linux unga default signal handler bermaydi — SIGTERM e'tiborsiz qolishi mumkin, <code>docker compose stop</code> 10 s kutib SIGKILL beradi (graceful shutdown yo'q). Child process'lar o'lsa zombie bo'lib qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>init: false   PID 1 = app (SIGTERM e'tiborsiz? zombie'lar yig'iladi)<br>init: true    PID 1 = docker-init (tini)<br>                 +-- PID 7 = app  &lt;- SIGTERM uzatiladi, zombie'lar reap qilinadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  app:<br>    image: myapp<br>    init: true</pre><pre>docker compose exec app ps -ef<br># PID 1  /sbin/docker-init -- node server.js<br># PID 7  node server.js<br>time docker compose stop app     # ~1 s bo'lsa signal to'g'ri ishlayapti, 10 s - yo'q</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Image'da allaqachon <code>tini</code>/<code>dumb-init</code> ENTRYPOINT bo'lsa — ikki marta qo'shish shart emas.</li><li><code>init</code> ilova o'zi SIGTERM'ni ushlamasa graceful shutdown qilmaydi — faqat signalni yetkazadi.</li><li>Shell form <code>CMD npm start</code> — sh PID 1, signal node'ga yetmaydi; exec form ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Child process ochadigan ilovalar (Node, Python skriptlar, shell wrapper) uchun <code>init: true</code> arzon va foydali; Go statik binary odatda signalni o'zi to'g'ri ushlaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34206	<p>Compose'da <code>stop_grace_period</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>stop_grace_period</code> — <code>docker compose stop/down</code> SIGTERM yuborgandan keyin container'ga o'zini to'xtatish uchun beriladigan vaqt. Muddat tugasa SIGKILL bilan majburan o'chiriladi. Default — 10 soniya.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Worker 40 soniyalik vazifani bajaryapti, deploy paytida 10 s dan keyin o'ldiriladi — vazifa yarim qoladi, ma'lumot nomuvofiq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>stop -&gt; SIGTERM -&gt; app: yangi ish olmaydi, joriyni tugatadi<br>        |--------- stop_grace_period (60s) ---------|<br>        tugatdi -&gt; exit 0          vaqt tugadi -&gt; SIGKILL (exit 137)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  worker:<br>    image: myworker<br>    stop_grace_period: 60s<br>    stop_signal: SIGTERM       # ba'zi ilovalar SIGQUIT/SIGINT kutadi</pre><pre>docker compose stop worker<br>docker inspect -f '{{.State.ExitCode}}' shop-worker-1    # 0 - graceful, 137 - o'ldirilgan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova SIGTERM'ni ushlamasa grace period foydasiz — shunchaki 60 s kutish.</li><li>Shell form CMD — signal ilovaga yetib bormaydi (<code>init: true</code> yoki exec form).</li><li>Juda katta qiymat deploy'ni sekinlashtiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Grace period ilovaning eng uzun normal vazifasidan biroz katta bo'lsin. Uzun vazifalar uchun idempotent qayta ishlash kerak — har holda SIGKILL bo'lishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34207	<p>Compose'da <code>tmpfs</code> qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>tmpfs:</code> container ichidagi papkani <b>xotirada</b> (RAM) vaqtinchalik fayl tizimi qilib mount qiladi; container to'xtasa ma'lumot o'chadi. <code>read_only: true</code> bilan birga ishlatiladi: root FS faqat o'qish uchun, yozish faqat <code>/tmp</code> kabi tmpfs'ga.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hujumchi container ichiga zararli fayl yozib ishga tushirishi mumkin; yoki vaqtinchalik fayllar writable layer'ni to'ldiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/       -&gt; read_only (yozib bo'lmaydi)<br>/tmp    -&gt; tmpfs (RAM, yozsa bo'ladi, restart'da tozalanadi)<br>/data   -&gt; volume (doimiy)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  app:<br>    image: myapp<br>    read_only: true<br>    tmpfs:<br>      - /tmp:size=64m,mode=1777<br>      - /run</pre><pre>docker compose exec app touch /etc/x    # Read-only file system<br>docker compose exec app touch /tmp/x    # ishlaydi<br>docker compose exec app df -h /tmp      # tmpfs 64M</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>size</code> bermasang tmpfs RAM'ni yeyishi mumkin (container memory limitiga kiradi).</li><li><code>read_only</code> dan keyin ilova yozadigan joylarni (cache, pid fayl, nginx <code>/var/cache/nginx</code>) topib tmpfs/volume qilish kerak.</li><li>tmpfs'dagi ma'lumot restart'da yo'qoladi — doimiy narsani u yerga yozma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>read_only</code> + tmpfs + non-root user — container hardening'ning arzon va samarali uchligi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34208	<p>Compose'da <code>docker compose events</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose events</code> loyihadagi container hodisalarini real vaqtda chiqaradi: <code>create</code>, <code>start</code>, <code>die</code>, <code>kill</code>, <code>health_status</code>, <code>oom</code> va boshqalar. <code>--json</code> — skript/monitoring uchun mashina o'qiydigan format.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Container qayta-qayta restart bo'lyapti, lekin nima sababdan va qachon — <code>logs</code> da ko'rinmaydi (OOM kill ilova logiga yozilmaydi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dockerd hodisalar -&gt; filtr: project=shop -&gt; stdout (jonli oqim)<br>die (exitCode=137) + oom -&gt; xotira limiti<br>health_status: unhealthy -&gt; healthcheck yiqilyapti</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose events<br># 2026-10-03 ... container die shop-api-1 (exitCode=137)<br># 2026-10-03 ... container oom shop-api-1<br>docker compose events --json | jq -c 'select(.action==&quot;die&quot;) | {service, attributes}'<br>docker events --filter event=oom --since 1h        # umumiy docker darajasida</pre><p>O'qish: <code>exitCode=137</code> + <code>oom</code> — memory limit; <code>exitCode=1</code> — ilova xatosi (<code>logs</code> ga qara); <code>exitCode=143</code> — SIGTERM bilan to'xtatilgan.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>events</code> faqat ishga tushgandan keyingi hodisalarni ko'rsatadi — tarix uchun <code>docker events --since</code>.</li><li>Uzoq kuzatuv uchun terminal oynasi emas, monitoring tizimi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>events</code> — &quot;nima bo'ldi&quot; savoliga javob, <code>logs</code> — &quot;nega&quot;. Restart loop'ni debug qilishda ikkalasini birga ishlat.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34209	<p>Compose'da image'ni registry'ga push qilish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval <code>docker compose build</code> image'ni <code>image:</code> maydonidagi nom bilan yig'adi, keyin <code>docker compose push</code> uni registry'ga yuboradi. Buning uchun service'da ham <code>build:</code>, ham to'liq registry nomli <code>image:</code> bo'lishi va registry'ga login qilingan bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dev'da build qilingan image boshqa serverda yo'q — prod uni registry'dan olishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build: .  +  image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2<br>  docker compose build -&gt; lokal image ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2<br>  docker compose push  -&gt; registry<br>  prod: docker compose pull -&gt; up -d</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    build: .<br>    image: ghcr.io/acme/api:${TAG:?TAG kerak}</pre><pre>echo &quot;$GHCR_TOKEN&quot; | docker login ghcr.io -u acme --password-stdin<br>TAG=1.4.2 docker compose build api<br>TAG=1.4.2 docker compose push api<br># multi-arch kerak bo'lsa:<br>docker buildx bake --push</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>image:</code> da registry yo'q (<code>api:1.4.2</code>) — Docker Hub'ga yuborishga urinadi va rad etiladi.</li><li><code>latest</code> ni push qilish — qaysi versiya ekanini bilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Login qilinmagan — <code>denied: requested access to the resource is denied</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Push CI'da bo'lsin, git commit SHA yoki semver tag bilan — har image qaysi koddan ekani kuzatiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34210	<p>Compose'da <code>ports</code> qisqa va uzun sintaksisi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Qisqa sintaksis — bitta string: <code>&quot;[host_ip:]host_port:container_port[/protocol]&quot;</code>, masalan <code>&quot;127.0.0.1:8080:80&quot;</code>. Uzun sintaksis — maydonlar alohida: <code>target</code>, <code>published</code>, <code>host_ip</code>, <code>protocol</code>, <code>mode</code>. Uzun variant o'qish oson va xato kamroq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Qisqa sintaksisda tartibni adashtirish (<code>80:8080</code> yoki <code>8080:80</code>?), IP ni unutish yoki qo'shtirnoqsiz yozib YAML parse xatosiga uchrash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>&quot;127.0.0.1:8080:80/tcp&quot;<br>  host_ip  published target protocol<br>host 127.0.0.1:8080 --&gt; container :80</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    ports:<br>      - &quot;127.0.0.1:8080:80&quot;          # qisqa<br>      - target: 80                   # uzun - xuddi shu narsa<br>        published: &quot;8080&quot;<br>        host_ip: 127.0.0.1<br>        protocol: tcp<br>      - &quot;53:53/udp&quot;                  # UDP</pre><pre>docker compose port web 80      # 127.0.0.1:8080<br>docker compose ps               # PORTS ustuni</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tartib doim <code>HOST:CONTAINER</code>.</li><li>Qo'shtirnoqsiz <code>22:22</code> — YAML 1.1 uni 60-lik son deb o'qishi mumkin; har doim qo'shtirnoq.</li><li><code>host_ip</code> yozilmasa — <code>0.0.0.0</code> (barcha interfeys).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Murakkab konfiguratsiyada uzun sintaksis — review'da aniq ko'rinadi va xatoga kamroq moyil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34211	<p>Compose'da <code>docker compose ls</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker compose ls</code> host'dagi barcha ishlayotgan Compose <b>loyihalarini</b> ko'rsatadi: nomi, holati (nechta container ishlayapti) va qaysi compose fayl(lar)dan ko'tarilgani. <code>-a</code> — to'xtaganlar ham.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Serverga kirding — qaysi loyihalar ishlayapti, ularning fayllari qayerda? Bilmasang, noto'g'ri papkada buyruq berasan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dockerd -&gt; container label'lari (com.docker.compose.project, config_files)<br>        -&gt; project bo'yicha guruhlash -&gt; jadval</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose ls<br># NAME   STATUS      CONFIG FILES<br># shop   running(3)  /srv/shop/compose.yaml,/srv/shop/compose.prod.yaml<br># blog   exited(1)   /srv/blog/compose.yaml<br>docker compose ls -a<br>docker compose -p shop ps      # aniq loyiha bilan ishlash<br>cd /srv/shop &amp;&amp; docker compose logs -f</pre><p>O'qish: <code>running(3)</code> — 3 container ishlayapti; <code>exited(1)</code> — to'xtagan; CONFIG FILES — loyihani boshqarish uchun qaysi fayllar va qaysi papka kerakligi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Compose'siz <code>docker run</code> bilan ko'tarilgan container'lar bu ro'yxatda yo'q.</li><li>Fayl ko'chirilgan/o'chirilgan bo'lsa ham eski yo'l ko'rinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Notanish serverda birinchi buyruqlardan biri — qaysi stack'lar ishlayotganini va ularning manba fayllarini aniqlash.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::K2 Docker Compose	idrill-34212	<p>Compose faylida versiya (<code>version: &quot;3.8&quot;</code>) kerakmi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yo'q. Compose v2 <b>Compose Specification</b> bo'yicha ishlaydi va <code>version:</code> maydonini e'tiborsiz qoldiradi — faqat &quot;obsolete&quot; ogohlantirishini chiqaradi. Yangi fayllarda yozmang, eskilaridan olib tashlang.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Eski tutorial'larda <code>version: &quot;3.8&quot;</code> bor; odamlar uni &quot;qaysi funksiyalar ishlashini belgilaydi&quot; deb o'ylaydi. Aslida v2 hamma maydonni versiyadan qat'i nazar qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>v1 (eski):  version: &quot;2.x&quot;/&quot;3.x&quot; -&gt; qaysi maydonlar ruxsat etilishi<br>v2 (hozir): Compose Specification -&gt; version e'tiborsiz<br>            WARN: the attribute `version` is obsolete</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># eski<br>version: &quot;3.8&quot;<br>services: ...<br><br># hozirgi<br>name: shop<br>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: app:1.4.2</pre><pre>sed -i '/^version:/d' compose.yaml<br>docker compose config --quiet &amp;&amp; echo OK</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>version: &quot;2.4&quot;</code> dagi <code>mem_limit</code> va <code>version: &quot;3&quot;</code> dagi <code>deploy.resources</code> farqi endi yo'q — ikkalasi ham ishlaydi, lekin bittasini tanla.</li><li>Eski <code>docker-compose</code> v1 bilan ham ishlashi kerak bo'lgan fayllarda version qolishi mumkin (lekin v1 EOL).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eskirgan maydonlarni tozalash — kichik, lekin jamoaga zamonaviy standartni ko'rsatadi va ogohlantirish &quot;shovqini&quot;ni yo'qotadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::compose sec::k2 Compose
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::T15 Docker Compose gotchas	idrill-33090	<p><code>.env</code> faylidagi o'zgaruvchi container ichida yo'q. Nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.env</code> fayli faqat <code>docker compose</code> ning <b>o'zini</b> sozlaydi (<code>${VAR}</code> substitutsiyasi compose.yaml ichida) — u avtomatik konteyner <b>ichiga</b> o'zgaruvchi qo'ymaydi. Konteynerga yetib borishi uchun <code>env_file:</code> yoki <code>environment:</code> kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dasturchi <code>.env</code> yaratadi, <code>DB_URL=...</code> yozadi, lekin ilova <code>os.Getenv(&quot;DB_URL&quot;)</code> bo'sh qaytaradi. Chunki <code>.env</code> faqat compose'ning interpolyatsiyasi uchun, konteyner muhiti uchun emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>.env + compose.yaml ${DB_URL}  -&gt; compose o'zi uchun o'rin bosadi (host tomonda)<br>env_file: [.env]               -&gt; .env mazmuni konteyner ENV'iga uzatiladi<br>environment: {DB_URL: ${DB_URL}} -&gt; interpolyatsiya + konteynerga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    env_file: [.env]          # .env'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri konteynerga<br>    # yoki aniq:<br>    environment:<br>      DB_URL: ${DB_URL}        # .env'dan interpolyatsiya qilib uzatish</pre><pre>docker compose config                 # interpolyatsiya natijasini ko'r<br>docker compose exec api env | grep DB # konteyner ichida bormi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.env</code> bor deb o'ylash yetarli emas — <code>env_file</code> yoki <code>environment</code> ham kerak.</li><li><code>.env</code> default faqat compose.yaml yonidan o'qiladi; boshqa joyda bo'lsa <code>--env-file path</code>.</li><li>Sirni <code>.env</code> da saqlash — repo'ga tushmasin (<code>.gitignore</code>); prod'da secret manager.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>.env</code> (compose interpolyatsiyasi) va <code>env_file</code> (konteyner ENV) ikki xil narsa — bu farqni bilmaslik eng ko'p uchraydigan Compose tuzog'i. Sirlar uchun <code>.env</code> emas, Docker secrets / external secret manager (prod). <code>docker compose config</code> har doim haqiqatni ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::compose sec::t15 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker Compose::T15 Docker Compose gotchas	idrill-33091	<p>compose.yaml o'zgartirildi, <code>docker compose restart api</code> qilindi — o'zgarish ishlamadi. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::T15 Docker Compose gotchas	idrill-33093	<p>Compose'da <code>ports: - 22:22</code> yoki <code>- 5432:5432</code> qo'shtirnoqsiz yozildi, kutilmagan port ochildi. Nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> YAML'da <code>- 22:22</code> qo'shtirnoqsiz yozilsa, YAML uni <b>base-60 (sexagesimal) son</b> sifatida talqin qiladi: <code>22:22</code> = 22*60+22 = 1342. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::T15 Docker Compose gotchas	idrill-42274	<p><code>docker compose up -d</code> ikkinchi marta ishga tushirilganda o'zgarmagan service'lar ham qayta yaratildi. Ikkinchi ishga tushirishda hash farq qilsa — garchi siz &quot;hech narsa o'zgartirmadim&quot; deb o'ylasangiz ham — recreate bo'ladi. Interview Drill::Docker Compose::T15 Docker Compose gotchas	idrill-42275	<p>Compose'da ikkita loyiha bir xil papka nomidan ishga tushirildi va bir-birining container/volume'larini o'chirib yubordi. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31410	<p>Docker Swarm nima? Manager va worker node farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Docker Swarm — Docker Engine ichiga o'rnatilgan orchestrator: bir nechta Docker host'ni bitta klasterga birlashtiradi va container'larni &quot;service&quot; sifatida boshqaradi. <b>Manager</b> klaster holatini (Raft) saqlaydi va qaror qabul qiladi, <b>worker</b> faqat berilgan task'larni bajaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 5 ta serverda qo'lda <code>docker run</code> qilish — server o'lsa container'lar yo'qoladi, kim qayerda ishlayotganini hech kim bilmaydi. Swarm &quot;menga 3 ta nginx kerak&quot; degan <b>desired state</b>ni saqlaydi va uni o'zi ushlab turadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            +-----------+   Raft   +-----------+<br>  CLI ----&gt; | manager-1 | &lt;------&gt; | manager-2 |  (holat, scheduler, API)<br>            +-----------+          +-----------+<br>                  |   task'larni tarqatadi<br>        +---------+---------+<br>        v                   v<br>   +---------+         +---------+<br>   | worker1 |         | worker2 |   (faqat container ishlatadi)<br>   +---------+         +---------+</pre><ul><li>Manager'lar o'zaro Raft orqali kelishadi; bittasi <b>Leader</b>.</li><li>Default'da manager ham task ishlatadi (o'zi ham worker).</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker swarm init --advertise-addr 10.0.0.1      # birinchi manager<br>docker swarm join-token worker                   # worker uchun buyruqni chiqaradi<br># worker'da:<br>docker swarm join --token SWMTKN-1-... 10.0.0.1:2377<br>docker node ls</pre><p><code>docker node ls</code> da <code>MANAGER STATUS</code> ustuni: <code>Leader</code>, <code>Reachable</code> (manager) yoki bo'sh (worker).</p><p>Kerakli portlar: 2377/tcp (management), 7946/tcp+udp (gossip), 4789/udp (VXLAN overlay).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta manager = single point of failure: u o'lsa yangi deploy qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>--advertise-addr</code> bermaslik — bir nechta NIC bo'lsa noto'g'ri IP tanlanadi.</li><li>Firewall 4789/udp ni yopsa node qo'shiladi, lekin service'lar gaplashmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production'da 3 (yoki 5) manager, turli AZ'da, <code>drain</code> qilingan — faqat boshqaruv bilan band. Swarm 2025-2026 da hamon qo'llab-quvvatlanadi (Mirantis), lekin ekotizim kichik — kichik jamoalar uchun oddiylik afzalligi bor.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31411	<p>Swarm'da service, task va stack nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Service</b> — &quot;nima ishlashi kerak&quot; degan ta'rif (image, replika soni, portlar). <b>Task</b> — service'ning bitta nusxasi (bitta container + uning scheduling yozuvi). <b>Stack</b> — compose faylidan birga deploy qilingan service'lar, network'lar, secret'lar guruhi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova bir nechta komponentdan iborat (api, worker, redis). Ularni alohida-alohida boshqarish o'rniga bitta fayl va bitta nom bilan boshqarish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>stack &quot;shop&quot;<br>  +-- service shop_api  (replicas: 3)<br>  |      +-- task shop_api.1 -&gt; container (node1)<br>  |      +-- task shop_api.2 -&gt; container (node2)<br>  |      +-- task shop_api.3 -&gt; container (node3)<br>  +-- service shop_redis (replicas: 1)<br>         +-- task shop_redis.1 -&gt; container (node2)</pre><p>Task o'lsa, Swarm uni qayta tiklamaydi — <b>yangi task</b> yaratadi (balki boshqa node'da). Bu reconciliation loop: desired state vs actual state.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service create --name web --replicas 3 -p 80:80 nginx:1.27<br>docker service ls                 # REPLICAS 3/3<br>docker service ps web             # har task qaysi node'da<br>docker service scale web=5<br>docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml shop<br>docker stack services shop</pre><p>| Swarm | Kubernetes analogi | |---|---| | service | Deployment (+ Service) | | task | Pod | | stack | Helm release / namespace'dagi manifestlar |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>docker ps</code> faqat shu node'dagi container'larni ko'rsatadi — klaster ko'rinishi uchun <code>docker service ps</code>.</li><li>Stack ichidagi service nomi <code>&lt;stack&gt;_&lt;service&gt;</code> bo'ladi (<code>shop_api</code>), buyruqlarda shuni ishlat.</li><li>Stack'ni qo'lda <code>service update</code> bilan o'zgartirsang, keyingi <code>stack deploy</code> uni qaytarib yozadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Source of truth — git'dagi stack fayl. Qo'lda <code>scale</code>/<code>update</code> faqat favqulodda holatda, keyin faylga ham kirit.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31412	<p>Replicated va global service farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Replicated</b> (default) — klaster bo'ylab aniq N ta task. <b>Global</b> — har mos node'da bittadan task; yangi node qo'shilsa unga avtomatik task tushadi. Global — Kubernetes DaemonSet analogi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> API uchun &quot;3 ta nusxa bo'lsin, qayerda bo'lsa ham&quot; yetarli. Lekin monitoring agent (node-exporter) yoki log collector <b>har bir</b> node'da bo'lishi shart — replika sonini qo'lda node soniga tenglash noto'g'ri.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>replicated (replicas=3)        global<br>node1: [api]                   node1: [exporter]<br>node2: [api][api]              node2: [exporter]<br>node3: -                       node3: [exporter]<br>                               node4 (yangi): [exporter]  &lt;- avtomatik</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service create --name api --replicas 3 app/api:1.4<br>docker service create --name node-exporter --mode global \<br>  --mount type=bind,src=/proc,dst=/host/proc,ro prom/node-exporter<br>docker service ls<br># NAME           MODE        REPLICAS<br># api            replicated  3/3<br># node-exporter  global      4/4</pre><p>Stack faylda:</p><pre>deploy:<br>  mode: global<br>  placement:<br>    constraints: [node.platform.os == linux]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Global service'ni <code>scale</code> qilib bo'lmaydi — xato beradi.</li><li>Global + constraint: faqat mos node'larda ishlaydi; <code>REPLICAS</code> soni node sonidan kam bo'lishi normal.</li><li>Mode'ni mavjud service'da o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi — service'ni qayta yaratish kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Global odatda infra agentlar va edge proxy (<code>mode: host</code> port bilan Traefik) uchun. Biznes servislar uchun replicated + <code>max_replicas_per_node</code> aniqroq nazorat beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31413	<p>Swarm routing mesh va ingress network qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Routing mesh — <code>-p 80:80</code> bilan publish qilingan port <b>har bir node'da</b> ochiladi. Task bo'lmagan node ham so'rovni qabul qilib, <code>ingress</code> overlay network orqali task bor node'ga IPVS bilan yo'naltiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Tashqi LB qaysi node'da task borligini bilmaydi va task'lar ko'chib yuradi. Routing mesh tufayli LB shunchaki hamma node'larga yuboradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client -&gt; LB -&gt; node3:80 (task yo'q)<br>                  |  IPVS (ingress network, VIP)<br>                  +-----&gt; node1: web.1<br>                  +-----&gt; node2: web.2</pre><ul><li><code>ingress</code> — Swarm yaratadigan maxsus overlay network.</li><li>Har node'da IPVS (kernel L4 LB) service VIP'ini task'larga tarqatadi.</li><li>Node so'rovni forward qilganda <b>SNAT</b> qiladi — container client IP o'rniga ichki IP ko'radi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service create --name web --replicas 2 -p 8080:80 nginx<br>curl http://node3:8080        # node3'da task bo'lmasa ham javob<br>docker network inspect ingress<br># host mode — client IP saqlanadi:<br>docker service create --name edge --mode global \<br>  --publish mode=host,target=80,published=80 traefik:v3</pre><p>| | ingress (default) | host | |---|---|---| | Port ochiq | hamma node | faqat task bor node | | Client IP | yo'qoladi | saqlanadi | | Hop | +1 bo'lishi mumkin | yo'q |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Log'larda hamma so'rov <code>10.0.0.x</code> dan — bu SNAT; real IP kerak bo'lsa host mode yoki PROXY protocol.</li><li>Ingress subnet korporativ tarmoq bilan to'qnashsa — <code>ingress</code>ni qayta yaratish kerak.</li><li>4789/udp yopiq bo'lsa forward ishlamaydi, &quot;ba'zan ishlaydi&quot; effekti chiqadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production'da pattern: tashqi LB -&gt; har node'da <code>mode: global</code> + host port'li Traefik/nginx -&gt; overlay orqali servislar. Routing mesh ichki/oddiy holatlar uchun qulay.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31414	<p>Swarm'da rolling update va rollback qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Rolling update <code>deploy.update_config</code> bilan sozlanadi: nechta task bir vaqtda (<code>parallelism</code>), oraliq (<code>delay</code>), tartib (<code>order</code>), muvaffaqiyatsizlikda nima qilish (<code>failure_action</code>). Rollback — <code>docker service rollback</code> yoki avtomatik <code>failure_action: rollback</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hamma replika'ni birdan almashtirsang, yangi versiya buzuq bo'lsa butun servis o'chadi. Bosqichma-bosqich almashtirish va xatoda avtomatik qaytish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>replicas=4, parallelism=1, order=start-first<br>v1 v1 v1 v1<br>v2+ v1 v1 v1   -&gt; v2 healthy? monitor 30s -&gt; eski v1 o'chadi<br>v2 v1 v1 v1    -&gt; delay 10s -&gt; keyingi<br>...            -&gt; xato bo'lsa: rollback_config bilan v1 ga qaytish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>deploy:<br>  replicas: 4<br>  update_config:<br>    parallelism: 1<br>    delay: 10s<br>    order: start-first<br>    failure_action: rollback<br>    monitor: 30s<br>    max_failure_ratio: 0<br>  rollback_config:<br>    parallelism: 2<br>    order: stop-first</pre><pre>docker service update --image api:1.3 shop_api<br>docker service inspect --pretty shop_api | grep -A3 UpdateStatus<br>docker service rollback shop_api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><b>Healthcheck bo'lmasa</b> Swarm &quot;container running&quot; ni muvaffaqiyat deb hisoblaydi — crash qilmaydigan, lekin 500 qaytaradigan versiya ham &quot;muvaffaqiyatli&quot; deploy bo'ladi.</li><li><code>monitor</code> healthcheck <code>start_period</code> dan qisqa bo'lsa — xato aniqlanmay qoladi.</li><li><code>start-first</code> + host mode port — ikki task bitta portni olmoqchi, update osiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>failure_action: rollback</code> + to'g'ri healthcheck + <code>monitor</code> — bu Swarm'dagi eng arzon &quot;canary&quot;. CI'da <code>--detach=false</code> bilan update natijasini kutib, pipeline'ni fail qil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31415	<p>Swarm secrets va configs qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secret — Raft'da shifrlangan holda saqlanadigan maxfiy ma'lumot; faqat unga ruxsat berilgan service task'lariga <code>/run/secrets/&lt;nom&gt;</code> fayli sifatida (tmpfs, xotirada) beriladi. Config — xuddi shunday, lekin maxfiy bo'lmagan fayllar (nginx.conf) uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Parolni <code>-e DB_PASS=...</code> bilan bersang — <code>docker inspect</code>, <code>/proc/&lt;pid&gt;/environ</code>, log va crash dump'larda ko'rinadi. Image ichiga qo'ysang — registry'dagi hamma o'qiydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker secret create -&gt; manager (Raft log, shifrlangan)<br>        |  TLS (mTLS node'lar orasida)<br>        v  faqat shu secret'li task bor node'ga<br>worker: tmpfs /run/secrets/db_pass  (diskka yozilmaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>printf 's3cret' | docker secret create db_pass -<br>docker secret ls<br>docker service create --name api --secret db_pass \<br>  -e DB_PASS_FILE=/run/secrets/db_pass app/api:1.4<br>docker config create nginx_conf ./nginx.conf<br>docker service create --config source=nginx_conf,target=/etc/nginx/nginx.conf nginx</pre><p>Ilova <code>*_FILE</code> env'dan yo'lni o'qib, faylni o'qiydi (Postgres, MySQL image'lari buni qo'llaydi).</p><p><b>Rotation (secret immutable):</b></p><pre>printf 'new' | docker secret create db_pass_v2 -<br>docker service update --secret-rm db_pass \<br>  --secret-add source=db_pass_v2,target=db_pass api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>echo</code> bilan yaratish — shell history'da qoladi; <code>printf</code> + stdin yoki fayldan, keyin faylni o'chir.</li><li>Ishlatilayotgan secret'ni <code>rm</code> qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Ilova secret'ni o'qib env'ga eksport qilsa — himoya yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Swarm secrets oddiy holatlar uchun yetarli, lekin dynamic secret, audit, avtomatik rotation kerak bo'lsa — Vault. Hajm chegarasi 500 KB.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31416	<p>Placement constraints va node label'lar nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Node label — node'ga qo'yiladigan kalit=qiymat (masalan <code>disk=ssd</code>). <b>Placement constraint</b> service'ni faqat mos node'larga joylaydi (qat'iy), <b>placement preference</b> (<code>spread</code>) esa task'larni label qiymatlari bo'yicha teng taqsimlaydi (yumshoq).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Postgres faqat SSD'li node'da ishlashi kerak; GPU job faqat GPU node'da; replikalar bitta AZ'ga to'planmasligi kerak. Default scheduler buni bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>constraint node.labels.disk==ssd<br>node1 (disk=ssd)  &lt;- mos<br>node2 (disk=hdd)  x<br>node3 (disk=ssd)  &lt;- mos<br>mos node yo'q -&gt; task Pending (&quot;no suitable node&quot;)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node update --label-add disk=ssd node-3<br>docker node inspect node-3 --format '{{ .Spec.Labels }}'<br>docker service create --name pg \<br>  --constraint 'node.labels.disk==ssd' \<br>  --constraint 'node.role==worker' postgres:16<br>docker service create --placement-pref 'spread=node.labels.zone' --replicas 6 web<br># maintenance:<br>docker node update --availability drain node-2</pre><p>Boshqa atributlar: <code>node.hostname</code>, <code>node.id</code>, <code>node.role</code>, <code>node.platform.os</code>, <code>engine.labels.*</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>node.labels</code> (Swarm, manager'da saqlanadi) va <code>engine.labels</code> (daemon.json, node o'zi e'lon qiladi) farqli — xavfsizlik uchun <code>node.labels</code> ishlat, worker uni o'zgartira olmaydi.</li><li>Label xato yozilsa (<code>ssd</code> vs <code>SSD</code>) — task jim <code>Pending</code>.</li><li><code>drain</code> dan keyin <code>active</code> qilinsa task'lar o'zi qaytmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Constraint'larni minimal tut — har bir qat'iy cheklov failover imkoniyatini kamaytiradi. AZ bo'ylab tarqatish uchun <code>spread</code> + <code>max_replicas_per_node</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31417	<p>Swarm manager'lar soni nega toq bo'lishi kerak? Quorum yo'qolsa nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm manager'lar Raft konsensusidan foydalanadi: har yozuv uchun <b>ko'pchilik (quorum = N/2+1)</b> rozi bo'lishi kerak. Toq son bir xil xarajatda ko'proq nosozlikka chidaydi; juft son foyda bermaydi. Quorum yo'qolsa klaster <b>read-only</b> bo'ladi: ishlayotgan container'lar davom etadi, lekin hech qanday o'zgartirish qilib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2 manager bo'lsa, ular orasidagi tarmoq uzilsa — kim to'g'ri? Split-brain oldini olish uchun ko'pchilik shart.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><p>| Manager | Quorum | Chidaydi | |---|---|---| | 1 | 1 | 0 | | 3 | 2 | 1 | | 4 | 3 | 1 | | 5 | 3 | 2 | | 7 | 4 | 3 |</p><p>4 manager — 3 bilan bir xil chidamlilik, lekin bitta ko'proq node'ga yozish kerak (sekinroq).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node ls     # MANAGER STATUS: Leader / Reachable / Unreachable<br>docker node update --availability drain m1 m2 m3<br># quorum yo'qolsa, tirik manager'da:<br>docker swarm init --force-new-cluster --advertise-addr 10.0.0.11<br>docker swarm join-token manager   # yangi manager'lar qo'sh</pre><p>Backup: <code>/var/lib/docker/swarm</code> (docker to'xtatilgan holda).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>3 manager'ni bitta AZ/rack'ga qo'yish — bitta nosozlik hammasini oladi.</li><li>7 dan ko'p manager — Raft yozuv latency oshadi, foyda yo'q.</li><li><code>--force-new-cluster</code> ni ikki node'da qilish — ikkita alohida klaster (split-brain).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 3 manager uchta AZ'da — ko'p jamoalar uchun optimal. Manager'larga workload qo'yma: CPU/disk bosimi Raft heartbeat'larni kechiktirib, leader election &quot;flapping&quot; chiqaradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31418	<p>Swarm va Kubernetes: qachon qaysi birini tanlaysan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm — oddiy, tez o'rganiladigan, compose formatidagi orchestrator; kichik klaster va bitta jamoa uchun yaxshi. Kubernetes — murakkab, lekin autoscaling, stateful, RBAC, ekotizim va managed xizmatlar (EKS/GKE/AKS) bilan; ko'p jamoa va o'sish uchun standart.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Hamma K8s ishlatadi&quot; deb 3 node'li loyihaga K8s olib kelish — operatsion xarajat ilovadan katta bo'ladi. Teskarisi: o'sayotgan platformani Swarm'da qoldirish — keyinchalik og'ir migratsiya.</p><p><b>Solishtirish:</b></p><p>| | Swarm | Kubernetes | |---|---|---| | O'rganish | soatlar | hafta/oylar | | Konfiguratsiya | compose.yaml | ko'p manifest, Helm/Kustomize | | Autoscaling | yo'q | HPA/VPA/KEDA, Cluster Autoscaler/Karpenter | | Stateful | cheklangan (CSI beta) | StatefulSet, CSI, operatorlar | | RBAC/multi-tenant | yo'q (manager = hamma narsa) | Namespace, RBAC, NetworkPolicy | | Managed | deyarli yo'q | EKS/GKE/AKS | | Ekotizim | kichik | juda katta (CNCF) |</p><p><b>Qaror tartibi:</b></p><pre>Bitta jamoa, 3-10 node, stateless?  -&gt; Swarm yoki Compose + LB<br>Autoscaling / ko'p jamoa / operator kerak? -&gt; Kubernetes (managed)<br>Cloud'da? -&gt; ko'pincha ECS/Cloud Run ham variant</pre><p><b>Amalda (Swarm tezligi):</b></p><pre>docker swarm init &amp;&amp; docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml app</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Swarm'da RBAC yo'q — kimdir manager'ga kirsa, hamma narsaga ega.</li><li>Yollash: K8s mutaxassisi topish oson, Swarm bo'yicha tajriba kam.</li><li>Migratsiya: compose -&gt; K8s uchun Kompose bor, lekin healthcheck, secret, network farqlari qo'lda.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov — texnologiya emas, operatsion yuk masalasi. Jamoa K8s'ni boshqara olmasa, managed K8s yoki PaaS; Swarm esa kichik, barqaror tizimlar uchun hamon oqilona.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31419	<p>Swarm'da stateful service (DB) ishlatish muammolari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy muammo — storage: default <code>local</code> volume har node'da alohida, task boshqa node'ga ko'chsa <b>bo'sh volume</b> bilan ko'tariladi. Yechimlar: node'ga pin qilish, network storage, yoki (eng ko'p tavsiya) DB'ni Swarm'dan tashqarida (managed DB yoki alohida VM) ishlatish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Node o'ldi, Swarm Postgres task'ini node2'ga ko'chirdi — Postgres bo'sh katalogni ko'rib <code>initdb</code> qiladi va toza DB ochadi. App ishlayapti, lekin ma'lumot &quot;yo'q&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>node1: pgdata (haqiqiy ma'lumot)   &lt;- node o'ldi<br>node2: pgdata (yangi, BO'SH)       &lt;- task shu yerga ko'chdi</pre><p><b>Variantlar:</b></p><p>| Yondashuv | Plus | Minus | |---|---|---| | <code>node.hostname==db-1</code> constraint | oddiy, bo'sh DB ochilmaydi | node o'lsa failover yo'q | | NFS / CSI (Swarm 23+, cheklangan) | task ko'chishi mumkin | fsync/lock xavfi, sekin | | Managed DB (RDS, Cloud SQL) | HA, backup, PITR tayyor | narx, vendor | | Patroni klaster (alohida VM) | to'liq nazorat | murakkab |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  db:<br>    image: postgres:16<br>    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]<br>    deploy:<br>      replicas: 1<br>      placement:<br>        constraints: [node.labels.db == true]<br>volumes:<br>  pgdata:</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Postgres'ni NFS ustida — data corruption xavfi.</li><li><code>replicas: 2</code> bilan bitta volume'li DB — ikki Postgres bitta data'ga yozadi.</li><li>Swarm'da operator yo'q — replication failover'ni qo'lda boshqarish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Swarm stateless uchun kuchli. Stateful'ni orchestrator tashqarisiga chiqarish ko'pincha eng yaxshi arxitektura qarori: &quot;pin qilingan DB node'i o'lsa&quot; scenariy'sini va backup/restore'ni sinab ko'r.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-33095	<p>Swarm service'ni yaratish, ko'rish, scale, log, o'chirish buyruqlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Service hayot sikli: <code>docker service create</code> (yaratish), <code>ls</code>/<code>ps</code>/<code>inspect</code> (ko'rish), <code>scale</code> (replika soni), <code>logs</code> (log), <code>rm</code> (o'chirish). Stack uchun mos ravishda <code>docker stack deploy/services/rm</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>docker ps</code> faqat lokal node'ni ko'rsatadi. Klaster bo'yicha holat va xatolarni ko'rish uchun service buyruqlari kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># yaratish<br>docker service create --name api --replicas 3 -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4<br># ko'rish<br>docker service ls                   # REPLICAS 3/3<br>docker service ps api --no-trunc    # task'lar, node, xato sababi<br>docker service inspect --pretty api # o'qiladigan konfiguratsiya<br># scale<br>docker service scale api=5<br># log<br>docker service logs -f --tail 100 api<br># o'chirish<br>docker service rm api<br>docker stack rm shop</pre><p><b>Chiqishni o'qish:</b></p><pre>docker service ps api<br>NAME    NODE  DESIRED STATE  CURRENT STATE          ERROR<br>api.1   w1    Running        Running 5 minutes ago<br>api.2   w2    Running        Rejected 3 seconds ago &quot;No such image: ...&quot;<br> \_ api.2 w2  Shutdown       Failed 1 minute ago    &quot;task: non-zero exit (1)&quot;</pre><ul><li><code>\_</code> — o'sha slot'ning oldingi (o'lgan) task'lari tarixi.</li><li><code>--no-trunc</code> — ERROR to'liq ko'rinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>docker service logs</code> driver <code>json-file</code>/<code>journald</code> bo'lmasa ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>service rm</code> volume'larni o'chirmaydi — node'larda qoladi.</li><li>Stack'dagi service'ni <code>service rm</code> bilan o'chirsang, keyingi <code>stack deploy</code> qaytaradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kundalik debug zanjiri: <code>service ls</code> (nechta ishlayapti) -&gt; <code>service ps --no-trunc</code> (nega yo'q) -&gt; <code>service logs</code> (ilova nima deyapti) -&gt; <code>node inspect</code> (node holati).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-33096	<p>Overlay network nima va Swarm'da service'lar qanday gaplashadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Overlay network — bir nechta host ustida yoyilgan virtual L2 tarmoq (VXLAN, 4789/udp). Bir overlay'dagi service'lar bir-birini <b>nomi</b> bilan topadi: ichki DNS service nomini VIP'ga, VIP esa IPVS orqali task'larga yo'naltiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>api</code> node1'da, <code>db</code> node3'da. Host'lar orasida container IP'lari to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rinmaydi, task'lar IP'si o'zgarib turadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>api task (node1)<br>   | DNS 127.0.0.11: &quot;db&quot; -&gt; 10.0.1.5 (VIP)<br>   v<br>IPVS (node1) -&gt; 10.0.1.8 (db.1, node3)<br>   | VXLAN encapsulation, UDP 4789<br>   v<br>node3 -&gt; db container</pre><ul><li><code>db</code> -&gt; VIP (barqaror).</li><li><code>tasks.db</code> -&gt; har task IP'si (DNS round robin).</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker network create -d overlay --attachable backend<br>docker service create --network backend --name db postgres:16<br>docker service create --network backend --name api -e DB_HOST=db api:1.4<br>docker exec -it $(docker ps -qf name=api) getent hosts db<br>docker exec -it $(docker ps -qf name=api) getent hosts tasks.db</pre><p><code>--attachable</code> — oddiy <code>docker run --network backend</code> container ham ulana oladi (debug uchun qulay).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Service'lar turli overlay'da bo'lsa — nom resolve bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Cloud'da MTU: VXLAN 50 bayt qo'shadi; katta paketlar osiladi -&gt; <code>--opt com.docker.network.driver.mtu=1400</code>.</li><li>Default overlay shifrlanmagan — <code>--opt encrypted</code> (IPsec) kerak bo'lsa.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har stack uchun alohida overlay — tarmoq izolyatsiyasi; umumiy &quot;hamma bitta network&quot; — bitta buzilgan servis hammaga yetib boradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-33097	<p>Node maintenance: drain, pause, active farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>availability</code> node'ga yangi task tushishini boshqaradi: <b>active</b> — oddiy; <b>pause</b> — yangi task tushmaydi, mavjudlar qoladi; <b>drain</b> — yangi task tushmaydi va mavjudlar boshqa node'larga ko'chiriladi. Maintenance (patch, reboot) oldidan <code>drain</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Node'ni reboot qilsang, undagi task'lar to'satdan o'ladi va Swarm keyin tiklaydi — qisqa uzilish. Drain bilan oldindan, nazoratli ko'chirasan.</p><p>| Holat | Yangi task | Mavjud task | |---|---|---| | active | tushadi | qoladi | | pause | tushmaydi | qoladi | | drain | tushmaydi | ko'chiriladi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node update --availability drain node-2<br>docker node ps node-2                    # bo'shaganini kut<br>sudo apt upgrade &amp;&amp; sudo reboot<br>docker node update --availability active node-2<br>docker service update --force api        # qayta balanslash (ixtiyoriy)<br># rol o'zgartirish<br>docker node promote node-4    # worker -&gt; manager<br>docker node demote node-4<br>docker node rm node-5         # oldin node'da: docker swarm leave</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>active</code> qilgandan keyin task'lar o'zi qaytmaydi — Swarm ishlab turgan task'ni ko'chirmaydi. <code>--force</code> rolling restart qiladi.</li><li>Drain <code>mode: host</code> port'li global service'larga ham ta'sir qiladi.</li><li>Bir vaqtda ko'p node drain — qolganlariga resurs yetmay <code>Pending</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Patch jarayonini avtomatlashtir: drain -&gt; kut -&gt; patch -&gt; reboot -&gt; active, bir vaqtda bittadan node. Manager'larda doim <code>drain</code> turishi normal.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-33098	<p>Swarm'da healthcheck va restart_policy qanday birga ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Healthcheck</b> container ichidagi ilova sog'lommi deb tekshiradi; <code>unhealthy</code> bo'lsa Swarm task'ni o'ldirib yangisini ko'taradi. <b>restart_policy</b> container chiqib ketganda (yoki unhealthy deb o'ldirilganda) qayta ishga tushirish qoidasi. Rolling update esa yangi task <b>healthy</b> bo'lishini kutadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova deadlock'ga tushdi — process tirik, lekin so'rovlarga javob bermaydi. Healthcheck'siz Swarm uni &quot;Running&quot; deb biladi va trafik yuboraveradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>task start -&gt; start_period (xatolar hisoblanmaydi)<br>  -&gt; har interval: test<br>       ok    -&gt; healthy (trafik VIP'ga qo'shiladi)<br>       fail x retries -&gt; unhealthy -&gt; Swarm task'ni o'ldiradi<br>            -&gt; restart_policy: condition/delay/max_attempts -&gt; yangi task</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: app/api:1.4<br>    healthcheck:<br>      test: [&quot;CMD&quot;, &quot;/app&quot;, &quot;-healthcheck&quot;]<br>      interval: 10s<br>      timeout: 3s<br>      retries: 3<br>      start_period: 30s<br>    deploy:<br>      restart_policy:<br>        condition: on-failure<br>        delay: 5s<br>        max_attempts: 5<br>        window: 60s</pre><pre>docker inspect --format '{{json .State.Health}}' &lt;container&gt;<br>docker service ps api    # &quot;unhealthy container&quot; xatosi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>curl</code> image'da yo'q (distroless) — healthcheck doim fail; ilova ichida <code>-healthcheck</code> flag yoki statik binary.</li><li>Healthcheck DB'ni ham tekshirsa — DB sekinlashganda <b>hamma</b> replika birdan o'ldiriladi (kaskad).</li><li><code>max_attempts</code> limitga yetsa task boshqa qayta ko'tarilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Healthcheck liveness kabi bo'lsin — faqat process'ning o'zi; tashqi bog'liqliklarni tekshirma. <code>start_period</code> real cold start vaqtidan katta bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-33099	<p>Swarm service'da task <code>Pending</code> yoki <code>Rejected</code> holatda turibdi. Qanday debug qilasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval <code>docker service ps &lt;svc&gt; --no-trunc</code> dagi <b>ERROR</b> ustunini o'qi — u sababni aytadi. <code>Pending</code> odatda scheduling (constraint, resurs), <code>Rejected</code> odatda node'da ishga tushirib bo'lmadi (image pull, port, mount).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>docker service ls</code> da <code>1/3</code> — nima bo'lganini ko'rsatmaydi. Sabab task darajasida yoziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>New -&gt; Pending (scheduler mos node qidiradi)<br>    -&gt; Assigned -&gt; Preparing (image pull, mount)<br>    -&gt; Starting -&gt; Running<br>Pending'da qolsa: mos node yo'q<br>Rejected: node'da tayyorlash xatosi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service ps api --no-trunc \<br>  --format '{{.Name}} {{.Node}} {{.CurrentState}} {{.Error}}'<br>docker node ls                          # Ready/Active?<br>docker node inspect node-3 --pretty     # label, resurs<br>docker service inspect api --format '{{json .Spec.TaskTemplate.Placement}}'</pre><p>| ERROR | Sabab | Yechim | |---|---|---| | <code>no suitable node (scheduling constraints...)</code> | label/constraint | label qo'y yoki constraint'ni tuzat | | <code>no suitable node (insufficient resources...)</code> | reservation katta | reservation kamaytir / node qo'sh | | <code>No such image</code> | private registry auth | <code>--with-registry-auth</code> | | <code>port already in use</code> | <code>mode: host</code> to'qnashuvi | <code>max_replicas_per_node: 1</code> / boshqa port | | <code>invalid mount config</code> | bind path node'da yo'q | path yarat yoki volume ishlat |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma node <code>drain</code> yoki <code>Down</code> — task jim kutadi.</li><li>Global service'ning faqat bitta node'da <code>Rejected</code> bo'lishi — o'sha node muammosi (disk, image).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pending task'lar sonini metrika qilib alert qo'y — deploy'dan keyin &quot;jim&quot; turib qolgan replikalar SLO'ni sezilmasdan buzadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-33100	<p><code>docker stack deploy</code> bilan private registry'dan image pull bo'lmayapti. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-33101	<p>Swarm klasterini monitoring va log yig'ish qanday tashkil qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Metrikalar: har node'da <code>mode: global</code> bilan node-exporter (host) va cAdvisor (container) + Prometheus (Swarm service discovery <code>dockerswarm_sd_configs</code>) + Grafana. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-33102	<p>Swarm overlay trafigini shifrlash va Swarm xavfsizlik modeli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm control plane default'da xavfsiz: node'lar orasida <b>mTLS</b>, avtomatik sertifikat rotation, Raft log shifrlangan. Data plane (overlay) esa default shifrlanmagan — <code>--opt encrypted</code> IPsec yoqadi. Qo'shimcha: autolock, token rotation, CA rotation.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cloud'da yoki umumiy tarmoqda node'lar orasidagi trafik (DB parollari, API) ochiq ketadi. Manager disk'i o'g'irlansa — Raft kalitlari va secret'lar.</p><p><b>Xavfsizlik modeli:</b></p><pre>manager (CA) --mTLS--&gt; worker   (control: har doim shifr)<br>task A --VXLAN--&gt; task B        (data: default OCHIQ)<br>task A --VXLAN+IPsec--&gt; task B  (--opt encrypted)</pre><ul><li>Manager = klasterning to'liq egasi (RBAC yo'q).</li><li>Worker faqat o'ziga kerakli secret'larni oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker network create -d overlay --opt encrypted backend<br>docker swarm update --autolock=true      # unlock key chiqadi — saqla!<br>docker swarm unlock-key                  # ko'rish<br>docker swarm ca --rotate<br>docker swarm join-token --rotate worker<br>docker swarm update --cert-expiry 720h</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Encrypted overlay IP protokol 50 (ESP) ni talab qiladi — firewall yopsa trafik jim yo'qoladi; CPU xarajati ham bor.</li><li>Docker API'ni <code>tcp://0.0.0.0:2375</code> (TLS'siz) ochish — klasterni to'liq topshirish.</li><li>Autolock unlock key yo'qolsa — manager restart'dan keyin ochilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng katta risk — kim manager'ga kira oladi. Manager SSH/API'ni bastion orqali, deploy'ni faqat CI'dan; docker guruhi = root ekanini unutma.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-33103	<p>Swarm klasterini backup va disaster recovery qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm holati (service, secret, config, network, node ro'yxati) manager'dagi <code>/var/lib/docker/swarm</code> katalogida (Raft log). Backup — bitta manager'da docker'ni to'xtatib shu katalogni arxivlash. Tiklash — arxivni joyiga qo'yib <code>docker swarm init --force-new-cluster</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Barcha manager'lar yo'qoldi (masalan AZ o'chdi yoki xato <code>rm -rf</code>). Backup bo'lmasa — secret'lar, config'lar va service ta'riflari yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>backup:  manager-3 (quorum saqlanadi: 3 tadan 2 tasi tirik)<br>   stop docker -&gt; tar /var/lib/docker/swarm -&gt; start docker<br>restore: yangi host<br>   tar xzf -&gt; start docker -&gt; swarm init --force-new-cluster<br>   -&gt; yangi manager/worker'lar join</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># backup (leader bo'lmagan manager'da)<br>systemctl stop docker<br>tar czf swarm-$(date +%F).tgz -C /var/lib/docker swarm<br>systemctl start docker<br># tiklash<br>systemctl stop docker<br>rm -rf /var/lib/docker/swarm<br>tar xzf swarm-2026-10-01.tgz -C /var/lib/docker<br>systemctl start docker<br>docker swarm unlock          # autolock bo'lsa<br>docker swarm init --force-new-cluster --advertise-addr 10.0.0.21<br>docker service ls</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker ishlab turganda nusxa olish — Raft nomuvofiq holat.</li><li>1 manager'li klasterda backup = qisqa control plane uzilishi.</li><li>Autolock yoqilgan bo'lsa unlock key'siz backup foydasiz.</li><li>Volume ma'lumotlari (DB) bu backup'ga kirmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoalar uchun tezroq DR — GitOps: stack fayllar git'da, secret'lar Vault/secret manager'da; yangi klasterni noldan <code>stack deploy</code> qilish. Har ikki yo'lni yilda bir marta sinab ko'r.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42213	<p>Swarm'da service update qilindi, lekin replika'lar <code>Rejected</code>/<code>Pending</code>, update <code>paused</code>. Qanday debug qilasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Update <code>paused</code> — Swarm yangi task'lar ishlamaganini sezib to'xtadi (<code>failure_action: pause</code>). Avval yangi task'lar xatosini (<code>service ps --no-trunc</code>), update holatini (<code>inspect</code>) va log'ni ko'r; tezkor mitigatsiya — <code>docker service rollback</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Prod'da yarim replika yangi versiyada osilib qoldi, yarimi eski — sig'im kamaygan va aralash versiya.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>update: v1 v1 v1 -&gt; v2(Rejected) -&gt; failure -&gt; pause<br>                                         -&gt; yoki rollback (sozlangan bo'lsa)<br>UpdateStatus.State: updating | paused | completed | rollback_completed</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service ps api --no-trunc --filter desired-state=shutdown<br>docker service ps api --no-trunc --format '{{.Name}} {{.Node}} {{.CurrentState}} {{.Error}}'<br>docker service inspect api --format '{{json .UpdateStatus}}'<br>docker service logs api --tail 100<br>docker service rollback api        # tezkor qaytish</pre><p>| Xato | Sabab | |---|---| | <code>No such image</code> | registry auth — <code>--with-registry-auth</code> | | <code>insufficient resources</code> | <code>reservations</code> sig'maydi (start-first + to'la node) | | <code>no suitable node</code> | yangi constraint/label | | task Running -&gt; Failed (healthcheck) | yangi versiya bug yoki <code>start_period</code> kichik |</p><p><b>Oldini olish:</b></p><pre>deploy:<br>  update_config: { parallelism: 1, delay: 10s, order: start-first, failure_action: rollback, monitor: 30s }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Paused holatda <code>service update</code> qayta qilish xato sababini tuzatmaydi.</li><li><code>start-first</code> qo'shimcha resurs talab qiladi — to'la klasterda faqat shu sabab bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval mitigate (rollback), keyin root cause. CI'da <code>--detach=false</code> — muvaffaqiyatsiz update pipeline'ni qizil qilsin, inson kech bilmasin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42214	<p>Yangi node Swarm'ga join bo'ldi, lekin u yerdagi task'lar boshqa service'larga ulana olmayapti. Nima tekshirasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng ko'p sabab — <b>firewall</b>: 7946/tcp+udp (gossip) yoki 4789/udp (VXLAN) yangi node'ga yopiq. Ikkinchi sabab — <b>MTU</b>: cloud/VPN'da overlay paketlari katta bo'lib, kichik so'rov o'tadi-yu katta javob osiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>docker node ls</code> da node <code>Ready</code> — chunki join faqat 2377/tcp'dan foydalanadi. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42215	<p>3 manager'dan 2 tasi o'chdi (quorum yo'q). Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42216	<p>Node o'chdi, Swarm Postgres task'ini boshqa node'ga ko'chirdi — DB bo'sh holda ko'tarildi. Nima qilasan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Darhol token'ni rotate qil (<code>docker swarm join-token --rotate worker</code>), <code>docker node ls</code> bilan begona node bormi tekshir va bo'lsa <code>node rm --force</code>. Begona node qo'shilgan bo'lsa — unga tushgan service'larning secret'larini ham rotate qil.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Worker token bilan istalgan mashina klasterga worker sifatida qo'shiladi; scheduler unga task'lar tushiradi — container'lar, image'lar va <b>secret'lar</b> begona qo'lga o'tadi. Manager token esa butun klaster ustidan nazorat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SWMTKN-1-&lt;CA hash&gt;-&lt;secret&gt;<br>rotate -&gt; eski secret qismi bekor; mavjud node'lar ta'sirlanmaydi<br>(token faqat join paytida tekshiriladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker swarm join-token --rotate worker<br>docker swarm join-token --rotate manager    # u ham tarqalgan bo'lsa<br>docker node ls --format '{{.Hostname}} {{.Status}} {{.ManagerStatus}}'<br>docker node inspect &lt;id&gt; --format '{{.Status.Addr}}'<br>docker node update --availability drain &lt;id&gt;<br>docker node rm --force &lt;id&gt;<br>docker node ps &lt;id&gt;        # unga qaysi task'lar tushgan edi<br>docker swarm ca --rotate   # ehtiyotkor holatda</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat token rotate qilib, node ro'yxatini tekshirmaslik — begona node allaqachon ichkarida qoladi.</li><li>Secret rotation'ni unutish — o'g'irlangan parol hali ham ishlaydi.</li><li>2377/tcp internetga ochiq bo'lsa token yagona himoya.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Token'ni Slack/wiki'da emas, secret manager'da saqla; node join'ni IaC orqali avtomatlashtir. 2377 faqat ichki tarmoqda — token sizsa ham tashqaridan foydasi yo'q.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42276	<p>Swarm klasterini qanday yaratasiz va node qo'shasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Birinchi manager'da <code>docker swarm init --advertise-addr &lt;IP&gt;</code>, keyin <code>docker swarm join-token worker|manager</code> chiqargan buyruqni boshqa node'larda ishga tushirasan. Natijani <code>docker node ls</code> bilan tekshirasan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bir nechta server bor, ularni bitta klasterga birlashtirib, container'larni ular orasida taqsimlash kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>node1: swarm init -&gt; CA, Raft, token'lar yaratiladi (Leader)<br>node2: swarm join --token &lt;worker&gt; node1:2377 -&gt; sertifikat oladi<br>node3: swarm join --token &lt;manager&gt; node1:2377 -&gt; Raft a'zosi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># node1 (manager)<br>docker swarm init --advertise-addr 10.0.0.1<br>docker swarm join-token worker<br>docker swarm join-token manager<br># worker'da<br>docker swarm join --token SWMTKN-1-... 10.0.0.1:2377<br># tekshirish (manager'da)<br>docker node ls<br># ID      HOSTNAME  STATUS  AVAILABILITY  MANAGER STATUS<br># abc *   node1     Ready   Active        Leader<br># def     node2     Ready   Active</pre><p><b>Portlar:</b> 2377/tcp (boshqaruv), 7946/tcp+udp (node'lar aloqasi), 4789/udp (overlay VXLAN).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir nechta IP'li server'da <code>--advertise-addr</code> bermaslik — xato IP e'lon qilinadi.</li><li>Faqat 2377 ochiq — join ishlaydi, lekin service'lar bir-biri bilan gaplashmaydi.</li><li>Node'lar soati (NTP) farq qilsa — TLS sertifikat xatolari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Manager token = klasterga to'liq kirish; sizsa <code>docker swarm join-token --rotate manager</code>. Production'da join'ni qo'lda emas, IaC (Terraform + cloud-init/Ansible) bilan qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42277	<p><code>docker service ps</code> va <code>docker service ls</code> nimani ko'rsatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker service ls</code> — klasterdagi barcha service'lar va ularning <code>REPLICAS</code> holati (ishlayotgan/kerakli). <code>docker service ps &lt;svc&gt;</code> — bitta service'ning task'lari: qaysi node'da, qanday holatda va <b>nega</b> ishlamayapti (ERROR ustuni).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>2/3</code> ko'rding — qaysi task, qayerda va nima uchun o'lgani <code>ls</code> da yo'q. Buni <code>ps</code> ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service ls<br># ID  NAME  MODE        REPLICAS  IMAGE<br># x1  api   replicated  2/3       app/api:1.2<br><br>docker service ps api --no-trunc<br># NAME     NODE  DESIRED STATE  CURRENT STATE          ERROR<br># api.1    w1    Running        Running 2 hours ago<br># api.3    w2    Running        Rejected 5 seconds ago &quot;no suitable node (insufficient memory)&quot;<br>#  \_ api.3 w2   Shutdown       Rejected 1 minute ago  &quot;...&quot;</pre><p><b>O'qish:</b></p><ul><li><code>DESIRED STATE</code> — Swarm nima istaydi; <code>CURRENT STATE</code> — aslida nima.</li><li><code>\_</code> — o'sha slot'ning eski urinishlari (tarix, default 5 ta: <code>task-history-limit</code>).</li><li>ERROR to'liq ko'rinishi uchun <code>--no-trunc</code>.</li></ul><pre>docker service ps api --filter desired-state=running   # faqat joriylar<br>docker service logs -f api                             # barcha replika log'i</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ps</code> ni filtrsiz o'qib, eski <code>Failed</code> qatorlarni hozirgi muammo deb o'ylash.</li><li><code>REPLICAS 3/3</code> — ilova to'g'ri ishlayapti degani emas (healthcheck yo'q bo'lsa).</li><li>Global service'da <code>REPLICAS</code> node soniga bog'liq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>ps</code> ning <code>--format '{{.Name}} {{.Node}} {{.Error}}'</code> varianti skript va alert'lar uchun qulay; tarixdagi tez-tez <code>Failed</code> — restart loop belgisi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42278	<p>Swarm'da stack fayli (<code>docker stack deploy -c</code>) va oddiy Compose fayldan farqi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Format bir xil (Compose spec), lekin <code>docker stack deploy</code> Swarm uchun: <code>build:</code> ni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi, <code>deploy:</code> bo'limini to'liq ishlatadi, <code>depends_on</code> va <code>container_name</code> ni qo'llamaydi, default network — overlay.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Lokal <code>docker compose up</code> ishlagan faylni stack qilib deploy qilsang — build bo'lmaydi, start tartibi yo'qoladi, ba'zi maydonlar jim tashlab ketiladi.</p><p>| Maydon | <code>docker compose</code> | <code>docker stack deploy</code> | |---|---|---| | <code>build:</code> | ishlaydi | <b>e'tiborsiz</b> (image kerak) | | <code>deploy.replicas/update_config/placement</code> | qisman | to'liq | | <code>depends_on</code> | start tartibi | e'tiborsiz | | <code>container_name</code> | ishlaydi | yo'q (task nomlari) | | Network default | bridge | overlay | | <code>.env</code> interpolatsiya | avtomatik | faqat shell env (<code>export</code>) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker compose config &gt;
