ilovada retry bo'lishi shart.</li><li><code>.env</code> fayl o'qilmaydi — <code>${TAG}</code> bo'sh qoladi; <code>set -a; . ./.env; set +a</code> yoki <code>compose config</code>.</li><li><code>ports</code> default ingress mode — lokal compose'dan farqli xatti-harakat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bitta base fayl + override (<code>compose.yaml</code> dev uchun, <code>stack.yml</code> prod uchun) — yoki <code>docker compose config</code> bilan yakuniy faylni CI'da generatsiya qilib artefakt sifatida saqla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42279	<p>Swarm'da <code>update_config</code> parametrlari: <code>parallelism</code>, <code>delay</code>, <code>order</code>, <code>failure_action</code>, <code>monitor</code> — har biri nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>parallelism</code> — bir vaqtda nechta task yangilanadi; <code>delay</code> — guruhlar orasidagi kutish; <code>order</code> — <code>stop-first</code> (avval eskisini o'chir) yoki <code>start-first</code> (avval yangisini ko'tar); <code>failure_action</code> — xatoda <code>pause</code>/<code>continue</code>/<code>rollback</code>; <code>monitor</code> — yangi task'ni shuncha vaqt kuzatib, shu oraliqda yiqilsa failure deb sanash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Noto'g'ri sozlama: juda katta parallelism — buzuq versiya bir zumda hammasiga yoyiladi; monitor kichik — xato sezilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>replicas=6, parallelism=2, start-first<br>[v1 v1 v1 v1 v1 v1]<br>[v2 v2]+ -&gt; healthy -&gt; monitor 30s -&gt; eski 2 ta o'chadi -&gt; delay 10s<br>... failure ulushi &gt; max_failure_ratio -&gt; failure_action</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>deploy:<br>  replicas: 6<br>  update_config:<br>    parallelism: 2<br>    delay: 10s<br>    order: start-first<br>    failure_action: rollback<br>    monitor: 30s<br>    max_failure_ratio: 0.1<br>  rollback_config:<br>    parallelism: 0          # hammasini birdan qaytar<br>    order: start-first</pre><p>| Param | Default | |---|---| | parallelism | 1 | | delay | 0s | | order | stop-first | | failure_action | pause | | monitor | 5s |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>start-first</code> — vaqtincha +parallelism task: resurs va (host mode'da) port yetishi kerak.</li><li><code>monitor</code> healthcheck <code>start_period</code> + bir necha interval'dan kichik — xatolar o'tkazib yuboriladi.</li><li><code>parallelism: 0</code> update'da — hammasini birdan (downtime xavfi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod default: <code>parallelism: 1</code>, <code>start-first</code>, <code>failure_action: rollback</code>, <code>monitor</code> &gt;= healthcheck oynasi. <code>pause</code> faqat inson darhol aralashadigan muhitda.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42280	<p>Swarm'da <code>endpoint_mode: vip</code> va <code>dnsrr</code> farqi? Qachon dnsrr kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>vip</code> (default) — service nomi bitta virtual IP'ga resolve bo'ladi, IPVS (kernel L4) task'lar orasida tarqatadi. <code>dnsrr</code> — DNS barcha task IP'larini qaytaradi, balanslashni client qiladi. dnsrr tashqi LB, client-side balancing (gRPC) yoki peer discovery kerak bo'lganda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> gRPC client VIP'ga bitta uzun HTTP/2 ulanish ochadi — IPVS L4 bo'lgani uchun hamma so'rov bitta task'ga ketadi, qolgan replikalar bo'sh.</p><p>| | <code>vip</code> | <code>dnsrr</code> | |---|---|---| | DNS javobi | bitta VIP | barcha task IP | | Balancing | IPVS, ulanish darajasida | client / DNS round robin | | Ingress publish | ishlaydi | faqat <code>mode: host</code> | | Task almashganda | shaffof | DNS cache muammosi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  search:<br>    image: elasticsearch:8.15.0<br>    deploy:<br>      endpoint_mode: dnsrr</pre><pre>docker exec -it &lt;c&gt; getent hosts search        # bir nechta IP</pre><p>nginx bilan:</p><pre>resolver 127.0.0.11 valid=10s;<br>set $up http://search:9200;<br>proxy_pass $up;</pre><p><b>dnsrr qachon:</b> HAProxy/nginx backend'larni o'zi ko'rishi kerak; gRPC/long-lived ulanish; Cassandra/Elasticsearch peer discovery.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DNS cache (JVM default, nginx statik <code>proxy_pass</code>) — o'lgan task IP'siga urinish.</li><li>dnsrr + ingress port — deploy xatosi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> VIP bilan ham <code>tasks.&lt;svc&gt;</code> orqali barcha IP'ni olish mumkin — ko'pincha endpoint_mode'ni o'zgartirmasdan shu yetarli.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42281	<p>Swarm node'ida disk/memory to'ldi va task'lar boshqa node'larga ko'chdi. Resurs reservation va limit qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Reservation</b> — scheduler uchun: task joylanishidan oldin node'da shuncha bo'sh CPU/memory bo'lishi shart; yetmasa <code>Pending</code>. <b>Limit</b> — runtime chegara: memory oshsa OOMKill, CPU oshsa throttling. Swarm <b>diskni</b> umuman hisobga olmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Reservation qo'yilmagan — scheduler hamma task'ni &quot;0 resurs&quot; deb ko'radi va bitta node'ga to'playdi; node memory'si to'ladi, OOM, task'lar boshqa node'ga ko'chadi va u yerni ham to'ldiradi — kaskad.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>node: 4 GB<br>reservation 1 GB x 4 task = to'ldi -&gt; 5-task boshqa node / Pending<br>limit 512M: container 600M ishlatdi -&gt; kernel OOMKill -&gt; restart_policy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>deploy:<br>  resources:<br>    reservations: { cpus: &quot;0.5&quot;, memory: 256M }<br>    limits:       { cpus: &quot;1&quot;,   memory: 512M }</pre><pre>docker node inspect node-1 --format '{{.Description.Resources}}'<br>docker stats --no-stream<br>docker inspect &lt;c&gt; --format '{{.State.OOMKilled}}'<br>journalctl -k | grep -i oom</pre><p><b>Disk to'lsa:</b></p><pre>df -h /var/lib/docker<br>docker system df<br>docker system prune -af --filter until=72h</pre><p>Log rotation: <code>daemon.json</code> -&gt; <code>&quot;log-opts&quot;: {&quot;max-size&quot;: &quot;10m&quot;, &quot;max-file&quot;: &quot;3&quot;}</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Limit'siz container node'dagi barcha memory'ni yeb, dockerd'ni ham OOM qiladi.</li><li>Reservation real ishlatishdan ancha katta — resurs bekorga band, <code>Pending</code>.</li><li>JVM/Go limit'ni bilmasligi (eski JVM) — heap'ni limit'dan katta qo'yadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Reservation = real p50 iste'mol, limit = p99 + zaxira. Disk uchun alohida alert (80%) va image/log tozalash cron — Swarm buni qilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42282	<p>Swarm'da <code>mode: host</code> va <code>mode: ingress</code> port publish farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>mode: ingress</code> (default) — port hamma node'da ochiladi, routing mesh orqali istalgan task'ga yetkaziladi, client IP SNAT tufayli yo'qoladi. <code>mode: host</code> — port faqat task ishlayotgan node'da to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ochiladi, client IP saqlanadi, lekin bitta node'da shu port uchun bitta task.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Rate limiting yoki audit uchun real client IP kerak, ingress esa hamma so'rovni <code>10.0.0.x</code> dan keltiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ingress:  client -&gt; anynode:80 -&gt; IPVS -&gt; SNAT -&gt; task (har node'da)<br>host:     client -&gt; node1:80 -&gt; task (node1'da)   (iptables DNAT, SNAT yo'q)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  traefik:<br>    image: traefik:v3.1<br>    ports:<br>      - target: 80<br>        published: 80<br>        protocol: tcp<br>        mode: host<br>    deploy:<br>      mode: global<br>      placement:<br>        constraints: [node.labels.edge == true]</pre><p>| | ingress | host | |---|---|---| | Ochiq node | hammasi | faqat task bor | | Client IP | yo'qoladi | saqlanadi | | Node'da task soni | ko'p | port uchun bitta | | Ishlatish | ichki/oddiy | edge proxy |</p><p><b>Pattern:</b> Traefik <code>mode: global</code> + <code>ports mode: host</code> — har (edge) node'da bitta proxy, real client IP; ichkarida overlay orqali servislar. Tashqi LB faqat edge node'larga health check bilan yuboradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Host mode + replicated + <code>start-first</code> — yangi task portni ololmaydi, update osiladi.</li><li>Host mode'da task yo'q node'ga LB yuborsa — connection refused; LB health check shart.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Agar LB orasida bo'lsa, PROXY protocol yoki <code>X-Forwarded-For</code> bilan client IP'ni uzatish ham variant — lekin ishonchli proxy ro'yxatini (trusted proxies) sozlashni unutma.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42283	<p>Swarm'da node label'lar va <code>placement.preferences</code> (spread) bilan AZ bo'ylab taqsimlash qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Node'larga <code>zone=a|b|c</code> label qo'yiladi; <code>placement.preferences: spread: node.labels.zone</code> task'larni zonalar bo'yicha teng tarqatadi (yumshoq), <code>constraints</code> esa qat'iy filtr, <code>max_replicas_per_node</code> bitta node'dagi replikalarni cheklaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 6 replikadan 5 tasi tasodifan bitta AZ'da — o'sha AZ o'chsa servis deyarli to'liq yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>replicas=6, spread zone<br>zone=a: node1 node2   -&gt; 2 task<br>zone=b: node3         -&gt; 2 task<br>zone=c: node4 node5   -&gt; 2 task<br>(node soni emas, label qiymati bo'yicha teng)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node update --label-add zone=a node1<br>docker node update --label-add zone=b node3<br>docker node update --label-add zone=c node4</pre><pre>deploy:<br>  replicas: 6<br>  placement:<br>    constraints:<br>      - node.role == worker<br>      - node.labels.disk == ssd<br>    preferences:<br>      - spread: node.labels.zone<br>    max_replicas_per_node: 2</pre><pre>docker service ps web --format '{{.Node}}' | sort | uniq -c</pre><p>| | constraints | preferences/spread | |---|---|---| | Turi | qat'iy | yumshoq | | Mos kelmasa | Pending | baribir joylaydi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Label'i yo'q node'lar spread'da alohida &quot;bo'sh qiymat&quot; guruhi bo'ladi — replikalar kutilmagan joyga tushadi.</li><li>Zona o'lgach task'lar qolgan zonalarga o'tadi, zona qaytganda o'zi qaytmaydi — <code>service update --force</code>.</li><li><code>max_replicas_per_node</code> juda kichik va node kam — <code>Pending</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har zonada yetarli sig'im (N+1) rezerv qil — aks holda zona yiqilganda qolganlari sig'dira olmaydi va spread foydasiz bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42284	<p>Swarm'da Raft log va manager node'lar: manager'da workload ishlatish kerakmi? Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42286	<p>Swarm'da secret rotation qanday qilinadi, agar secret o'zgarmas (immutable) bo'lsa?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secret o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun rotation = <b>yangi nomli</b> secret yaratish va service'da eskisini <code>--secret-rm</code>, yangisini <code>--secret-add ...,target=&lt;eski nom&gt;</code> bilan almashtirish. <code>target</code> bir xil qolgani uchun container ichidagi yo'l (<code>/run/secrets/db_pass</code>) va ilova kodi o'zgarmaydi; Swarm rolling update qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB parolini yangilash kerak, lekin <code>docker secret update</code> yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42287	<p>Swarm klasterini upgrade qilish (Docker Engine versiyasi) qanday zero-downtime bajariladi?</p>	<p><b>Tartib:</b></p><ol><li>Backup: <code>/var/lib/docker/swarm</code> (manager'dan, unlock key bilan).</li><li><b>Worker'lar</b> (bittadan yoki kichik partiya):</li></ol><pre>docker node update --availability drain w1<br># task'lar boshqa node'larga ko'chishini kut: docker node ps w1<br>apt-get install docker-ce=&lt;yangi&gt;   # upgrade<br>docker node update --availability active w1</pre><ol><li><b>Manager'lar</b> — bittadan, har biridan keyin <code>docker node ls</code> da <code>Reachable</code> va quorum tekshiriladi. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42291	<p><code>docker service scale</code> va <code>docker service update --replicas</code> farqi? Replika sonini qanday o'zgartirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi replika sonini o'zgartiradi. <code>docker service scale</code> — qisqa, bir vaqtda bir nechta service'ni scale qila oladi. <code>docker service update --replicas</code> — bitta service, lekin boshqa o'zgarishlar (image, env) bilan birga bitta update'da.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Trafik oshdi, tezda replikalar kerak — va bu o'zgarish keyingi deploy'da yo'qolmasligi kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service scale api=5 worker=3             # bir nechta service<br>docker service update --replicas 5 api          # bitta<br>docker service update --replicas 5 --image api:1.5 api   # birga<br>docker service ls                               # 5/5 ?</pre><p>Stack faylda (doimiy):</p><pre>deploy:<br>  replicas: 5</pre><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>desired 3 -&gt; 5: scheduler 2 ta yangi task joylaydi<br>desired 5 -&gt; 2: 3 ta task to'xtatiladi (SIGTERM, stop_grace_period)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Stack bilan deploy qilingan service'ni qo'lda <code>scale</code> — vaqtinchalik; keyingi <code>docker stack deploy</code> fayldagi <code>replicas</code> ga qaytaradi.</li><li>Global service'ni scale qilib bo'lmaydi — u har node'da bittadan.</li><li>Scale down'da <code>stop_grace_period</code> kichik bo'lsa so'rovlar uziladi.</li><li>Resurs reservation yetmasa yangi replikalar <code>Pending</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Swarm'da autoscaling yo'q — scale qarori inson yoki tashqi skript (metrika asosida) ishi. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42292	<p>Swarm'da service discovery: servis nomi va <code>tasks.&lt;servis&gt;</code> DNS nomi farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm'ning ichki DNS'i (127.0.0.11) bir overlay'dagi nomlarni resolve qiladi: <code>api</code> -&gt; service <b>VIP</b> (bitta barqaror IP, IPVS balanslaydi), <code>tasks.api</code> -&gt; <b>barcha task IP'lari</b> ro'yxati.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy HTTP chaqiruv uchun bitta barqaror manzil kerak; Elasticsearch yoki RabbitMQ klasteri esa har bir peer'ning IP'sini bilishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>nslookup api       -&gt; 10.0.1.5 (VIP) -&gt; IPVS -&gt; .7 / .8 / .9<br>nslookup tasks.api -&gt; 10.0.1.7, 10.0.1.8, 10.0.1.9</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker exec -it &lt;c&gt; nslookup api<br>docker exec -it &lt;c&gt; nslookup tasks.api<br>docker exec -it &lt;c&gt; getent hosts tasks.api</pre><p>| Nom | Javob | Ishlatish | |---|---|---| | <code>api</code> | VIP | oddiy HTTP/DB chaqiruv | | <code>tasks.api</code> | barcha task IP | peer discovery, client-side LB, monitoring | | <code>&lt;stack&gt;_api</code> | VIP | stack nomi bilan to'liq nom |</p><p>Elasticsearch misoli: <code>discovery.seed_hosts=tasks.es</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ikki service <b>bir xil overlay</b>da bo'lishi shart, aks holda NXDOMAIN.</li><li>Stack ichida qisqa nom (<code>api</code>) ishlaydi; boshqa stack'dan — <code>shop_api</code> va umumiy network.</li><li><code>tasks.</code> ro'yxatiga unhealthy task'lar kirmaydi, lekin DNS cache eski IP'ni ushlab qolishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monitoring scrape uchun ham <code>tasks.&lt;svc&gt;</code> (yoki <code>dockerswarm_sd</code>) — VIP orqali har gal tasodifiy replikani o'lchaysan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42293	<p>Swarm'da job mode (<code>replicated-job</code>, <code>global-job</code>) nima? Qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Job mode — bir martalik vazifalar uchun: <code>replicated-job</code> N marta muvaffaqiyatli tugaguncha ishlaydi, <code>global-job</code> har node'da bir marta bajariladi. Tugagan task qayta ko'tarilmaydi. Docker 20.10+ da mavjud; K8s Job / DaemonSet-job analogi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB migration yoki har node'da tozalash — oddiy replicated service bilan qilsang, tugagan container'ni Swarm &quot;o'ldi&quot; deb qayta-qayta ishga tushiradi.</p><p>| Mode | Xatti-harakat | |---|---| | <code>replicated</code> | doim N task ishlab tursin | | <code>global</code> | har node'da doim bitta | | <code>replicated-job</code> | jami N marta muvaffaqiyatli tugasin | | <code>global-job</code> | har node'da bir marta tugasin |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service create --name migrate --mode replicated-job \<br>  --replicas 1 --max-concurrent 1 \<br>  --network app app/api:1.4 ./migrate up<br><br>docker service create --name cleanup --mode global-job \<br>  --mount type=bind,src=/tmp,dst=/host/tmp \<br>  alpine sh -c &quot;rm -rf /host/tmp/old-*&quot;<br><br>docker service ps migrate     # Complete?<br>docker service logs migrate</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Job tugagach o'zi o'chmaydi — <code>docker service rm</code>.</li><li>Qayta ishga tushirish: <code>docker service update --force migrate</code> yoki yangi service.</li><li>Stack faylda <code>mode: replicated-job</code> qo'llanadi, lekin deploy'ni migration tugashini kutadigan qilish uchun CI'da alohida qadam kerak.</li><li>Migration idempotent bo'lmasa, <code>--replicas 2</code> — ikki marta bajariladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Migration'ni deploy'dan oldingi alohida CI qadamida job sifatida ishga tushir va <code>Complete</code> holatini kutib, keyin app update qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42294	<p><code>docker service rollback</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker service rollback</code> service'ni oldingi spec'iga (<code>PreviousSpec</code>) qaytaradi — image, env, resurs va boshqa hamma sozlama. Faqat <b>bitta qadam</b> orqaga; ikkinchi rollback yana yangi versiyaga qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 1.5 deploy qilindi, error rate oshdi — tezda 1.4 ga qaytish kerak, CI'ni qayta ishga tushirmasdan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Spec = 1.5, PreviousSpec = 1.4<br>rollback -&gt; Spec = 1.4, PreviousSpec = 1.5<br>rollback (yana) -&gt; Spec = 1.5  (almashadi!)</pre><p>Rollback ham rolling: <code>rollback_config</code> (parallelism, order) ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service update --image app/api:1.5 api<br>docker service rollback api<br>docker service inspect api --format '{{.Spec.TaskTemplate.ContainerSpec.Image}}'<br>docker service inspect api --format '{{json .UpdateStatus}}'</pre><p>Avtomatik:</p><pre>deploy:<br>  update_config: { failure_action: rollback, monitor: 30s }<br>  rollback_config: { parallelism: 0, order: start-first }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rollback DB migration'ni qaytarmaydi — schema backward-compatible bo'lmasa eski versiya ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>latest</code> tag bilan rollback ma'nosiz — bir xil tag, boshqa image.</li><li>Stack deploy'dan keyin qo'lda rollback — keyingi deploy yana fayldagi versiyani qo'yadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Chuqur tarix uchun — git'dagi stack fayl va immutable tag'lar (git SHA): rollback = eski commit bilan <code>stack deploy</code>. Migration'larni expand/contract uslubida yoz, shunda rollback xavfsiz.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm

Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42297	<p>CI/CD'dan Swarm'ga deploy qanday qilinadi? Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42298	<p>Swarm'da log'lar: har service uchun log driver va markaziy yig'ish qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<pre>x-log: &amp;log<br>  logging:<br>    driver: local<br>    options: { max-size: &quot;20m&quot;, max-file: &quot;5&quot; }<br><br>services:<br>  api:<br>    &lt;&lt;: *log<br>  promtail:                 # har node'da log yig'uvchi<br>    image: grafana/promtail<br>    deploy: { mode: global }<br>    volumes:<br>      - /var/lib/docker/containers:/var/lib/docker/containers:ro</pre><p><b>Trade-off:</b> | Yondashuv | + | − | |---|---|---| | Driver to'g'ridan (gelf/fluentd) | agent kerak emas | endpoint o'chsa container bloklanishi mumkin (<code>mode: non-blocking</code> kerak) | | Fayl + global agent | ishonchli, <code>service logs</code> ishlaydi | agent'ni boshqarish |</p><p><b>Label'lar:</b> Swarm log'ga <code>com.docker.swarm.service.name</code>, <code>task.id</code> qo'shadi — Loki'da shu bo'yicha filtr.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm

Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42300	<p>Swarm configs: <code>docker config</code> bilan nginx.conf'ni qanday berasiz va yangilaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker config</code> faylni Raft'da saqlaydi va task ichida <code>target</code> yo'liga mount qiladi. Config immutable, shuning uchun yangilash = yangi nom (odatda kontent hash'i bilan) va stack deploy — Swarm rolling update bilan task'larni yangi fayl bilan almashtiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> nginx.conf'ni image'ga qo'shsang, har konfiguratsiya o'zgarishi uchun yangi build; bind mount esa har node'da faylni qo'lda tarqatishni talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>nginx.conf -&gt; sha256 -&gt; nginx_conf_ab12cd34 (yangi config obyekt)<br>stack deploy -&gt; service spec o'zgardi -&gt; rolling update<br>task: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf (0444)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>configs:<br>  nginx_conf:<br>    name: nginx_conf_${CONF_HASH}<br>    file: ./nginx.conf<br>services:<br>  web:<br>    image: nginx:1.27<br>    configs:<br>      - source: nginx_conf<br>        target: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf<br>        mode: 0444</pre><pre>nginx -t -c &quot;$PWD/nginx.conf&quot;                      # avval sintaksis<br>export CONF_HASH=$(sha256sum nginx.conf | cut -c1-8)<br>docker stack deploy -c stack.yml shop<br>docker config ls                                   # eski versiyalarni tozala</pre><p>| | config | secret | |---|---|---| | Raft'da | shifrlangan | shifrlangan | | Task'da | oddiy fayl (container fs) | tmpfs <code>/run/secrets</code> | | Maqsad | konfiguratsiya | parol, kalit | | Chegara | 500 KB | 500 KB |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir xil nom bilan o'zgargan faylni deploy — &quot;config already exists&quot; yoki o'zgarish qo'llanmaydi.</li><li>Eski config'lar to'planib qoladi — ishlatilmayotganlarni <code>docker config rm</code>.</li><li>Buzuq nginx.conf — healthcheck + <code>failure_action: rollback</code> bo'lmasa servis yiqiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hash'li nom — config'ni immutable artefakt qiladi va rollback'ni avtomatik to'g'ri ishlatadi (eski spec eski config'ga ishora qiladi).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42301	<p>Swarm'ning ichki arxitekturasi: orchestrator, allocator, scheduler, dispatcher qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<pre> docker service create<br>        |<br>        v<br> [API] --&gt; [Raft store: desired state]<br>        |<br>        v<br> [Orchestrator]  service spec -&gt; N ta task (desired)<br>        |<br>        v<br> [Allocator]     task'ga overlay IP, VIP<br>        |<br>        v<br> [Scheduler]     filter (constraint, resurs, platform) -&gt; node tanlash<br>        |<br>        v<br> [Dispatcher]    gRPC stream -&gt; worker agent<br>        |<br>        v<br> [Worker agent -&gt; executor -&gt; containerd/runc]   status qaytaradi</pre><p><b>Reconciliation loop:</b> actual != desired bo'lsa (task o'ldi, node Down) — orchestrator yangi task yaratadi. Bu K8s controller pattern'iga o'xshash, lekin bitta binary ichida (SwarmKit).</p><p><b>Senior nuqtalar</b></p><ul><li>Heartbeat yo'qolsa (default ~5s × ko'paytma) node <code>Down</code> — task'lar boshqa node'ga. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42311	<p>Siz tizim arxitektorisiz: nega Swarm, K8s va boshqa orchestrator'lar &quot;desired state + reconciliation loop&quot; modelini tanlagan? Endi holat noma'lum; buyruqni qayta yuborish = 5 ta?</p><p><b>Yechim — level-triggered reconciliation:</b></p><pre>loop:<br>  desired = read(store)        # replicas: 3<br>  actual  = observe(world)     # 2 ishlayapti<br>  diff    = desired - actual<br>  act(diff)                    # 1 ta qo'sh — idempotent</pre><p>Event yo'qolsa ham (edge-triggered emas), keyingi aylanishda tuzatiladi. Partial failure, node o'limi, controller restart — hammasi bir xil yo'l bilan hal bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Chegaralari (Principal darajasida bilish kerak):</b></p><ul><li><b>Eventual:</b> &quot;deploy tugadi&quot; degan aniq moment yo'q — CI'da kutish va tekshirish kerak (<code>--detach=false</code>, rollout status).</li><li><b>Tartib va bir martalik amallar:</b> migratsiya, &quot;avval A keyin B&quot; — reconciliation modeliga yaxshi tushmaydi (job, hook, operator kerak).</li><li><b>State:</b> &quot;replica = 3&quot; — stateless uchun yetarli; DB uchun failover, split-brain, backup — domen bilimi kerak (operator pattern).</li><li><b>Konflikt:</b> ikki manba (qo'lda <code>scale</code> va stack fayl / GitOps) bir-birini bosib turadi — bitta source of truth kerak.</li><li><b>Thundering reconcile:</b> kaskad nosozlikda hamma bir vaqtda qayta ishga tushadi — backoff, rate limit.</li></ul><p><b>Principal insight:</b> bu model faqat orchestrator'ga xos emas — GitOps, Terraform, DB schema migration tool'lar, hatto o'z backend'ingizdagi background worker'lar uchun ham kuchli pattern. Kalit: idempotent harakat + kuzatiladigan actual state.</p>	lvl::Principal dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
