Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34214	<p>Swarm'da manager'lar soni nega toq bo'lishi kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Manager'lar Raft orqali kelishadi: har o'zgarish uchun ko'pchilik (quorum = N/2+1) kerak. Toq son bilan bir xil manager sonida maksimal nosozlikka chidaydi; juft son (masalan 4) toq songa (3) nisbatan chidamlilikni oshirmaydi, faqat sekinlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2 manager o'rtasida tarmoq uzilsa, hech biri ko'pchilik emas — klaster qotadi. 2 manager 1 tadan ham yomonroq: ikkitadan birining o'limi quorum'ni yo'qotadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><p>| Manager | Quorum | Chidaydi | |---|---|---| | 1 | 1 | 0 | | 2 | 2 | 0 | | 3 | 2 | 1 | | 4 | 3 | 1 (3 bilan bir xil) | | 5 | 3 | 2 | | 7 | 4 | 3 |</p><pre>5 manager, 2 tasi o'chdi: 3 tirik &gt;= quorum 3 -&gt; ishlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node ls<br># m1  Ready  Active  Leader<br># m2  Ready  Active  Reachable<br># m3  Down   Active  Unreachable<br>docker node promote w4      # manager sonini toq saqla</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>7 dan ko'p manager — har yozuvni ko'p node tasdiqlashi kerak, sekinlashadi.</li><li>Manager'larni bitta rack/AZ'ga qo'yish — toq son foydasini yo'qotadi.</li><li>Quorum yo'qolsa ham ishlayotgan container'lar davom etadi — lekin deploy/scale yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatda 3 manager (3 AZ) yetarli; juda katta yoki muhim klasterda 5. Manager'larni <code>drain</code> qilib workload'dan ozod qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34215	<p><code>docker node ls</code> nima ko'rsatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker node ls</code> klasterdagi barcha node'larni ko'rsatadi: ID, hostname, <b>STATUS</b> (Ready/Down — tirikmi), <b>AVAILABILITY</b> (Active/Pause/Drain — task olsinmi), <b>MANAGER STATUS</b> (Leader/Reachable/Unreachable yoki bo'sh = worker), engine versiyasi. Faqat manager'da ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klaster sog'lommi, qaysi node yo'qolgan, kim leader — bularni bir qarashda bilish kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node ls<br># ID        HOSTNAME  STATUS  AVAILABILITY  MANAGER STATUS  ENGINE VERSION<br># abc *     m1        Ready   Active        Leader          27.3.1<br># def       m2        Ready   Drain         Reachable       27.3.1<br># ghi       w1        Down    Active                        27.3.1</pre><ul><li><code>*</code> — buyruq ishlatilgan joriy node.</li><li><code>Down</code> — manager node'dan heartbeat olmayapti.</li></ul><pre>docker node ls --filter role=manager<br>docker node ls --format '{{.Hostname}} {{.Status}} {{.ManagerStatus}}'<br>docker node inspect w1 --pretty<br>docker node ps w1          # node'dagi task'lar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Worker'da ishlatsang: &quot;This node is not a swarm manager&quot; — xato emas, kutilgan holat.</li><li><code>Ready</code> ilova sog'lomligini bildirmaydi — faqat dockerd va manager aloqasi.</li><li>Manager'larda versiya farqi — upgrade paytida vaqtincha normal, uzoq qolmasin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monitoring: <code>Unreachable</code> manager soni &gt; 0 — alert (quorum xavfi), <code>Down</code> worker — sig'im xavfi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34216	<p>Swarm'da node'ga label qo'yib, service'ni o'sha node'larga joylash?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker node update --label-add kalit=qiymat &lt;node&gt;</code> bilan node'ga label qo'yiladi, keyin service'ga <code>--constraint 'node.labels.kalit==qiymat'</code> beriladi — scheduler task'larni faqat mos node'larga joylaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Postgres faqat SSD diskli node'da, GPU ilova faqat GPU node'da ishlashi kerak. Default scheduler hamma node'ni bir xil ko'radi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>node1 disk=ssd  &lt;- db task<br>node2 disk=hdd  x<br>node3 (label yo'q) x<br>mos node yo'q -&gt; Pending</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node update --label-add disk=ssd node2<br>docker node inspect node2 --format '{{json .Spec.Labels}}'<br>docker service create --name db \<br>  --constraint 'node.labels.disk==ssd' postgres:16<br>docker service ps db<br>docker node update --label-rm disk node2     # olib tashlash</pre><p>Stack faylda:</p><pre>deploy:<br>  placement:<br>    constraints:<br>      - node.labels.disk == ssd<br>      - node.role == worker</pre><p>Boshqa constraint'lar: <code>node.role==worker</code>, <code>node.hostname==n1</code>, <code>node.platform.os==linux</code>, <code>!=</code> ham ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Label yozuvidagi xato (<code>SSD</code> vs <code>ssd</code>) — task jim <code>Pending</code>.</li><li>Label'ni olib tashlash ishlayotgan task'ni ko'chirmaydi — keyingi update'da ko'chadi.</li><li><code>engine.labels</code> (daemon.json) bilan adashtirma — <code>node.labels</code> manager'da, xavfsizroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Label'larni IaC bilan qo'y (node yaratilganda), qo'lda emas — aks holda yangi node qo'shilganda &quot;nega task bormaydi&quot; muammosi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34217	<p>Swarm'da rolling update qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker service update</code> flaglari yoki stack fayldagi <code>deploy.update_config</code> bilan: <code>--update-parallelism</code> (nechta birdan), <code>--update-delay</code> (oraliq), <code>--update-order</code> (start-first/stop-first), <code>--update-failure-action rollback</code>. Healthcheck bo'lsa Swarm yangi task sog'lom bo'lishini kutadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi versiyani hamma replikaga birdan qo'yish — xato bo'lsa butun servis yiqiladi. Bosqichma-bosqich almashtirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>parallelism=1, delay=10s<br>[v1 v1 v1] -&gt; [v2 v1 v1] -&gt; 10s -&gt; [v2 v2 v1] -&gt; 10s -&gt; [v2 v2 v2]<br>xato -&gt; failure_action (rollback) -&gt; [v1 v1 v1]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service update \<br>  --image myapp:1.5 \<br>  --update-parallelism 1 \<br>  --update-delay 10s \<br>  --update-order start-first \<br>  --update-failure-action rollback \<br>  --update-monitor 30s \<br>  web<br>docker service ps web          # jarayonni kuzat</pre><p>Stack faylda:</p><pre>deploy:<br>  update_config: { parallelism: 1, delay: 10s, order: start-first, failure_action: rollback }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Healthcheck yo'q — &quot;Running&quot; yetarli hisoblanadi, buzuq versiya ham &quot;muvaffaqiyatli&quot;.</li><li>Default <code>failure_action: pause</code> — update yarim yo'lda to'xtab qoladi.</li><li><code>start-first</code> qo'shimcha resurs talab qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rolling update parametrlarini stack faylda saqla (git'da ko'rinadi), CLI flaglarda emas — keyingi <code>stack deploy</code> ularni qaytarib yozadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34218	<p>Swarm'da routing mesh nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Routing mesh — publish qilingan port (<code>-p 8080:80</code>) klasterning <b>har bir node'ida</b> ochiladi; qaysi node'ga so'rov kelsa ham, Swarm uni <code>ingress</code> network va IPVS orqali ishlayotgan task'lardan biriga yetkazadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Task'lar node'lar orasida ko'chib yuradi. Tashqi LB yoki DNS har safar &quot;hozir nginx qayerda&quot; deb bilishi kerak bo'lmasligi uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>3 node, 2 replica (node1, node2)<br>client -&gt; node3:8080<br>           | IPVS (ingress, VIP)<br>           +--&gt; node1: nginx.1<br>           +--&gt; node2: nginx.2</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service create --name web -p 8080:80 --replicas 2 nginx<br>curl http://node1:8080<br>curl http://node3:8080     # task yo'q, baribir ishlaydi<br>docker service inspect web --format '{{json .Endpoint.Ports}}'</pre><p>Odatiy arxitektura: tashqi LB (cloud LB, HAProxy) -&gt; barcha node'lar:8080.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Container ichida client IP o'rniga ichki IP — SNAT. Real IP kerak bo'lsa <code>mode=host</code>.</li><li>4789/udp yopiq bo'lsa — faqat task bor node'ga kelgan so'rovlar ishlaydi (&quot;ba'zan ishlaydi&quot;).</li><li>Bir xil published port'ni ikki service ishlata olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Routing mesh qo'shimcha hop va IPVS holatini beradi; yuqori yuk yoki real IP kerak bo'lsa edge proxy (<code>mode: global</code> + host port) afzal.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34219	<p>Swarm secret qanday yaratiladi va ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker secret create &lt;nom&gt; -</code> (stdin yoki fayldan) bilan yaratiladi, service'ga <code>--secret &lt;nom&gt;</code> bilan biriktiriladi; container ichida <code>/run/secrets/&lt;nom&gt;</code> fayli sifatida (xotirada, tmpfs) paydo bo'ladi. Ilova faylni o'qiydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Parolni env yoki image'da saqlash — <code>docker inspect</code>, log va registry orqali sizib chiqadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker secret create -&gt; manager Raft (shifrlangan)<br>service --secret db_pass -&gt; faqat shu task bor node'larga yuboriladi<br>container: /run/secrets/db_pass (tmpfs, faqat o'qish)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>printf 'S3cret' | docker secret create db_pass -<br>docker secret ls<br>docker service create --name db --secret db_pass \<br>  -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/db_pass postgres:16<br>docker exec -it $(docker ps -qf name=db) cat /run/secrets/db_pass</pre><p>Stack faylda:</p><pre>secrets:<br>  db_pass:<br>    external: true<br>services:<br>  db:<br>    secrets: [db_pass]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>echo 'parol' |</code> — shell history'da qoladi; fayldan yoki <code>read -s</code> bilan.</li><li>Secret o'zgarmaydi — yangi nom bilan yaratib service'ni update qilasiz.</li><li><code>docker secret inspect</code> qiymatni ko'rsatmaydi — bu xususiyat, xato emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ilovani <code>*_FILE</code> konvensiyasiga moslashtir: secret faylini o'qisin, env'ga ko'chirmasin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34220	<p>Swarm config va secret farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham Raft'da saqlanib, task ichiga fayl sifatida mount qilinadigan immutable obyektlar. <b>Secret</b> — maxfiy ma'lumot uchun: faqat tmpfs <code>/run/secrets/</code> ga beriladi, <code>inspect</code> qiymatni ko'rsatmaydi. <b>Config</b> — maxfiy bo'lmagan fayllar (nginx.conf) uchun: istalgan yo'lga mount qilinadi, kontentni <code>inspect</code> bilan ko'rish mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> nginx.conf yoki app.yaml'ni har node'ga qo'lda tarqatish yoki image'ga qo'shish noqulay.</p><p>| | config | secret | |---|---|---| | Maqsad | konfiguratsiya fayli | parol, kalit, sertifikat | | Task'dagi joy | istalgan <code>target</code> yo'l | <code>/run/secrets/&lt;nom&gt;</code> (tmpfs) | | <code>inspect</code> | kontent ko'rinadi (base64) | ko'rinmaydi | | Hajm chegarasi | 500 KB | 500 KB | | O'zgartirish | yangi nom + update | yangi nom + update |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker config create nginx_conf ./nginx.conf<br>docker service create --name web \<br>  --config source=nginx_conf,target=/etc/nginx/nginx.conf,mode=0444 \<br>  nginx:1.27<br>docker config inspect --pretty nginx_conf     # kontent ko'rinadi<br>printf 'pw' | docker secret create db_pass -</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Parolni config'ga qo'yish — <code>inspect</code> bilan istalgan manager foydalanuvchisi o'qiydi.</li><li>Config o'zgarmaydi: faylni tahrirlab qayta <code>create</code> — &quot;already exists&quot;.</li><li>Katta fayllar (500 KB+) — image yoki volume ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Config nomiga kontent hash qo'sh (<code>nginx_conf_ab12cd</code>) — har o'zgarish avtomatik rolling update va to'g'ri rollback beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34221	<p>Stack faylda <code>deploy:</code> bo'limi nimani belgilaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>deploy:</code> — Swarm'ga xos sozlamalar: nechta replika (<code>replicas</code>, <code>mode</code>), qanday yangilash (<code>update_config</code>, <code>rollback_config</code>), qachon qayta ishga tushirish (<code>restart_policy</code>), qayerga joylash (<code>placement</code>), qancha resurs (<code>resources</code>), labels va <code>endpoint_mode</code>. <code>docker compose up</code> ko'pini e'tiborsiz qoldiradi, <code>stack deploy</code> to'liq ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Image va portlar &quot;nima&quot; ishlashini aytadi; &quot;qanday, qayerda, nechta&quot; ishlashi uchun alohida bo'lim kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    image: myapp:1.4<br>    deploy:<br>      mode: replicated<br>      replicas: 3<br>      update_config: { parallelism: 1, delay: 10s, order: start-first, failure_action: rollback }<br>      rollback_config: { parallelism: 0 }<br>      restart_policy: { condition: on-failure, delay: 5s, max_attempts: 3 }<br>      placement:<br>        constraints: [node.role == worker]<br>        preferences: [{ spread: node.labels.zone }]<br>      resources:<br>        reservations: { cpus: &quot;0.25&quot;, memory: 128M }<br>        limits: { cpus: &quot;1&quot;, memory: 256M }<br>      labels:<br>        traefik.enable: &quot;true&quot;</pre><p>| Kalit | Nima uchun | |---|---| | replicas/mode | nechta va qanday tarqatish | | update_config | rolling update | | restart_policy | container chiqqanda | | placement | qaysi node'larga | | resources | scheduling va limit | | labels | service label'lari (Traefik) |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>deploy.labels</code> (service) va <code>labels</code> (container) farqli — Traefik Swarm'da <code>deploy.labels</code> ni o'qiydi.</li><li><code>resources</code> siz — task'lar bitta node'ga to'planadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>deploy:</code> bo'limi — servisning operatsion kontrakti; uni code review'da ilova kodi kabi tekshir.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34222	<p><code>docker stack deploy</code>, <code>stack ls</code>, <code>stack ps</code>, <code>stack rm</code>?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>stack deploy</code> — compose fayldan stack yaratadi yoki yangilaydi; <code>stack ls</code> — stack'lar ro'yxati; <code>stack services</code> — stack'dagi service'lar va replikalar; <code>stack ps</code> — stack'dagi barcha task'lar; <code>stack rm</code> — stack'ni (service, network, secret/config) o'chiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ko'p service'li ilovani bitta birlik sifatida boshqarish kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker stack deploy -c stack.yml --with-registry-auth shop<br>docker stack ls<br># NAME  SERVICES<br># shop  4<br>docker stack services shop<br># NAME        MODE        REPLICAS  IMAGE<br># shop_api    replicated  3/3       app/api:1.4<br>docker stack ps shop --no-trunc --filter desired-state=running<br>docker stack rm shop</pre><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>stack deploy (qayta) -&gt; fayl va joriy holat solishtiriladi<br>  o'zgargan service -&gt; rolling update<br>  o'zgarmagan -&gt; tegilmaydi<br>  fayldan olib tashlangan service -&gt; qoladi! (--prune bilan o'chadi)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Fayldan service'ni olib tashlash uni o'chirmaydi — <code>docker stack deploy --prune</code>.</li><li><code>stack rm</code> volume'larni o'chirmaydi (bu yaxshi), lekin network'lar o'chishi bir necha soniya oladi — darhol qayta deploy xato berishi mumkin.</li><li><code>stack rm</code> tasdiq so'ramaydi — prod'da ehtiyot.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'da <code>stack deploy --prune --with-registry-auth --detach=false</code> — fayl va klaster holati to'liq mos (GitOps uslubi).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34223	<p>Swarm'da <code>build:</code> ishlaydimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yo'q. <code>docker stack deploy</code> stack fayldagi <code>build:</code> ni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi — Swarm faqat tayyor image'dan ishlaydi, chunki task istalgan node'da ishlashi mumkin va image registry'dan pull qilinishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Lokal compose'da <code>build: .</code> ishlagan; stack deploy'da esa &quot;image not found&quot; yoki eski image ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CI: docker build -&gt; docker push registry/app:SHA<br>    -&gt; docker stack deploy (image: registry/app:SHA)<br>worker node'lar -&gt; registry'dan pull</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    build: .                                   # stack deploy uchun e'tiborsiz<br>    image: registry.example.com/api:${TAG}     # shu ishlatiladi</pre><pre>export TAG=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)<br>docker compose build api &amp;&amp; docker compose push api<br>docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml --with-registry-auth shop</pre><p>Private registry: <code>docker login</code> + <code>--with-registry-auth</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Image faqat bitta node'da lokal build qilingan — boshqa node'lar pull qila olmaydi (<code>No such image</code>).</li><li><code>latest</code> tag — node'larda turli versiyalar keshda qolishi mumkin; aniq tag yoki digest ishlat.</li><li>Registry auth unutilgan — task'lar <code>Rejected</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Build va deploy ajratilgan bo'lsin: bir marta build qilingan immutable image (SHA tag) barcha muhitlarga promote qilinadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34224	<p>Swarm'da node qanday chiqariladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> To'g'ri tartib: manager'da node'ni <code>drain</code> qil (task'lar boshqa node'larga ko'chadi) -&gt; node'ning o'zida <code>docker swarm leave</code> -&gt; manager'da <code>docker node rm</code>. Manager bo'lsa, avval <code>docker node demote</code> qilib worker'ga aylantir.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Node'ni shunchaki o'chirsang — task'lar to'satdan o'ladi, <code>docker node ls</code> da <code>Down</code> node abadiy qoladi; manager bo'lsa quorum hisobiga kiradi va xavf tug'diradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>drain -&gt; task'lar ko'chadi -&gt; leave (node klasterdan chiqadi, status Down)<br>     -&gt; node rm (ro'yxatdan o'chadi)<br>manager: demote -&gt; (Raft'dan chiqadi) -&gt; keyin yuqoridagi qadamlar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># manager'da<br>docker node update --availability drain node3<br>docker node ps node3            # bo'shaganini kut<br># node3'da<br>docker swarm leave<br># manager'da<br>docker node rm node3<br># manager node bo'lsa — avval:<br>docker node demote node3</pre><p>Node o'lib qaytmasa: <code>docker node rm --force node3</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Manager'ni demote qilmasdan <code>leave</code> — Raft'da &quot;Unreachable&quot; a'zo qoladi, quorum hisobini buzadi.</li><li>Oxirgi manager'dan <code>leave</code> — klaster yo'qoladi (<code>--force</code> talab qilinadi — bu signal).</li><li>Drain'dan keyin qolgan node'larga resurs yetmasa task'lar <code>Pending</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Manager'ni olib tashlashdan oldin yangisini qo'sh — manager soni hech qachon vaqtincha juftga yoki quorum chegarasiga tushmasin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34225	<p>Swarm task nega <code>Pending</code> holatda qoladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Task <code>Pending</code> — scheduler unga mos node topa olmadi. Asosiy sabablar: placement constraint/label mos emas, resurs reservation hech qaysi node'ga sig'maydi, barcha mos node'lar <code>drain</code>/<code>Down</code>, yoki <code>max_replicas_per_node</code> chegarasi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>docker service ls</code> da <code>1/3</code> — qolgan ikkitasi jim kutmoqda, log yo'q (container hali yaratilmagan).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>scheduler filtrlari:<br>  node Ready &amp; Active? -&gt; constraint mos? -&gt; resurs yetadimi?<br>  -&gt; max_replicas_per_node? -&gt; hammasi &quot;yo'q&quot; =&gt; Pending</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service ps --no-trunc web<br># ERROR: no suitable node (scheduling constraints not satisfied on 3 nodes)<br># ERROR: no suitable node (insufficient resources on 3 nodes)<br>docker node ls                                       # Active/Ready?<br>docker service inspect web --format '{{json .Spec.TaskTemplate.Placement}}'<br>docker service inspect web --format '{{json .Spec.TaskTemplate.Resources}}'<br>docker node inspect node2 --format '{{json .Spec.Labels}}'</pre><p>| ERROR | Tuzatish | |---|---| | constraints not satisfied | label qo'y / constraint'ni tuzat | | insufficient resources | reservation kamaytir yoki node qo'sh | | max replicas per node | node qo'sh yoki chegarani oshir |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Log'dan qidirish — Pending task'da container yo'q, log ham yo'q.</li><li>Reservation <code>--reserve-memory 4g</code>, node'da 4 GB jami — tizim o'zi ham band, sig'maydi.</li><li>Global service + constraint — ba'zi node'larda task yo'qligi normal, Pending emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pending — sig'im rejalashtirish signali. Uzoq Pending task'larga alert qo'y.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34226	<p>Service loglarini qanday ko'rasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker service logs &lt;svc&gt;</code> service'ning barcha task'lari (barcha node'lardagi) log'ini bitta oqimda ko'rsatadi; <code>-f</code> (follow), <code>--tail</code>, <code>--since</code>, <code>--timestamps</code> flaglari bilan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Replikalar turli node'larda — har node'ga SSH qilib <code>docker logs</code> qilish noqulay.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>docker service logs -&gt; manager -&gt; har task bor node'ning dockerd'idan<br>log oqimi (json-file/journald driver) -&gt; birlashtirib chiqaradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service logs -f --tail 100 web<br>docker service logs --since 10m --timestamps web<br>docker service logs --no-task-ids --raw web | grep ERROR<br>docker service logs web.2            # yoki task ID — bitta replika<br>docker stack ps shop                 # avval qaysi task muammoli</pre><p>Chiqish formati: <code>web.2.k3j4...@node2 | 2026-10-03T10:00:01 GET /health 200</code> — qaysi replika va node ekani ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Logging driver <code>fluentd</code>/<code>gelf</code>/<code>awslogs</code> bo'lsa <code>service logs</code> ishlamaydi (lokal o'qib bo'lmaydi), faqat <code>json-file</code>, <code>local</code>, <code>journald</code>.</li><li>Rotation (<code>max-size</code>) tufayli eski log'lar yo'q; node o'lsa uning log'lari ham ketadi.</li><li>Katta hajmli log'da <code>-f</code> sekin va manager'ni yuklaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>service logs</code> — tezkor debug uchun; production'da markaziy log tizimi (Loki/Elastic) va structured (JSON) log, trace ID bilan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34227	<p>Swarm'da service'ga resurs reservation va limit?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Reservation</b> (<code>--reserve-memory</code>, <code>--reserve-cpu</code>) — scheduler kafolati: task faqat shuncha bo'sh resursi bor node'ga joylanadi. <b>Limit</b> (<code>--limit-memory</code>, <code>--limit-cpu</code>) — container ishlayotganda oshib keta olmaydigan chegara: memory'da OOMKill, CPU'da throttling.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Resurssiz service'lar bitta node'ga to'planib, bittasi memory leak qilsa butun node va undagi boshqa servislarni yiqitadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>reservation 256m  -&gt; scheduling: &quot;node'da 256m bo'shmi?&quot;<br>limit 512m        -&gt; runtime: cgroup memory.max=512m<br>  ishlatish &gt; 512m -&gt; kernel OOMKill -&gt; restart_policy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service create --name myapp \<br>  --reserve-memory 256m --reserve-cpu 0.25 \<br>  --limit-memory 512m --limit-cpu 1 \<br>  myapp:1.4<br>docker service update --limit-memory 768m myapp<br>docker stats --no-stream<br>docker inspect &lt;c&gt; --format '{{.State.OOMKilled}}'</pre><p>Stack faylda:</p><pre>deploy:<br>  resources:<br>    reservations: { cpus: &quot;0.25&quot;, memory: 256M }<br>    limits: { cpus: &quot;1&quot;, memory: 512M }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat limit qo'yish — scheduler baribir hammasini bitta node'ga joylashi mumkin.</li><li>Reservation juda katta — task'lar <code>Pending</code>, resurs bo'sh turadi.</li><li>Ilova limitni bilmasligi (eski JVM, Node.js <code>--max-old-space-size</code>) — OOM tsikli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qiymatlarni taxmin emas, o'lchov asosida qo'y: <code>docker stats</code>/cAdvisor'dagi p50 -&gt; reservation, p99 + zaxira -&gt; limit.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34228	<p>Swarm overlay network'ni qanday yaratasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Manager'da <code>docker network create -d overlay &lt;nom&gt;</code> bilan; keyin service'larni <code>--network &lt;nom&gt;</code> bilan ulaysan. <code>--attachable</code> oddiy <code>docker run</code> container'larini ham ulashga ruxsat beradi, <code>--opt encrypted</code> node'lar orasidagi trafikni IPsec bilan shifrlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Turli node'lardagi container'lar bir-birini ko'rishi va nom bilan topishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>overlay &quot;backend&quot; (10.0.1.0/24)<br>node1: api.1 (10.0.1.7) ==VXLAN udp/4789== node2: db.1 (10.0.1.9)<br>DNS: &quot;db&quot; -&gt; VIP 10.0.1.5<br>Network faqat shu network'li task bor node'larda paydo bo'ladi (lazy)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker network create -d overlay --attachable backend<br>docker network create -d overlay --opt encrypted \<br>  --subnet 10.20.1.0/24 secure-backend<br>docker service create --network backend --name api myapi<br>docker service update --network-add secure-backend api<br>docker network ls --filter driver=overlay<br>docker run --rm -it --network backend nicolaka/netshoot   # debug</pre><p>Stack faylda:</p><pre>networks:<br>  backend:<br>    driver: overlay<br>    attachable: true</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Worker'da <code>docker network ls</code> — network ko'rinmasligi normal, unda task bo'lmasa.</li><li>Subnet VPC/VPN bilan to'qnashsa — g'alati routing; <code>--subnet</code> aniq ber.</li><li>Encrypted overlay — ESP (IP proto 50) firewall'da ochiq bo'lishi va CPU xarajati.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har stack uchun alohida network, umumiy faqat kerakli service'lar (masalan edge proxy) uchun — tarmoq segmentatsiyasi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34229	<p>Swarm uchun qaysi portlar ochiq bo'lishi kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Node'lar orasida ochiq bo'lishi kerak: <b>2377/tcp</b> — manager API va Raft (faqat manager'larga), <b>7946/tcp+udp</b> — node discovery/gossip, <b>4789/udp</b> — VXLAN overlay trafik. Encrypted overlay ishlatilsa — <b>IP protokol 50 (ESP)</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Firewall faqat 2377 ni ochsa — node qo'shiladi va <code>Ready</code> ko'rinadi, lekin service'lar bir-biri bilan gaplasha olmaydi va routing mesh ishlamaydi.</p><p>| Port | Vazifa | Kimga | |---|---|---| | 2377/tcp | manager API, Raft | manager'larga | | 7946/tcp,udp | gossip, discovery | barcha node'lar | | 4789/udp | overlay data (VXLAN) | barcha node'lar | | ESP (50) | encrypted overlay | barcha node'lar |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/24 to any port 2377 proto tcp<br>sudo ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/24 to any port 7946<br>sudo ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/24 to any port 4789 proto udp<br># tekshirish<br>nc -zv node2 2377<br>nc -zvu node2 7946<br>nc -zvu node2 4789<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 udp port 4789</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cloud security group'da UDP qoidasini unutish (faqat TCP ochilgan).</li><li>Bu portlarni internetga ochish — 2377 join token'ga, 4789 autentifikatsiyasiz VXLAN'ga hujum yuzasi.</li><li>Docker iptables qoidalarini o'zi qo'shadi; <code>ufw</code> bilan ziddiyat — publish qilingan portlar ufw'ni chetlab o'tadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Faqat klaster subnet'idan ruxsat; security group'larni IaC'da &quot;swarm-node&quot; guruhi sifatida aniqlab, hamma node'ga bir xil qo'lla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34230	<p>Swarm'da replica qachon boshqa node'ga ko'chadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Replika boshqa node'ga ko'chadi qachonki: node <code>Down</code> bo'lsa (heartbeat yo'q), node <code>drain</code> qilinsa, task yiqilib yangi task boshqa node'ga joylansa, yoki service update/<code>--force</code> qilinsa. Bu <b>desired state reconciliation</b>: Swarm doim &quot;kerakli N ta&quot;ni ushlab turadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Node qaytganda task'lar qaytib balanslanmaydi — bitta node yuklanib, yangisi bo'sh qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>desired 3: node1[a] node2[b] node3[c]<br>node3 Down -&gt; c yo'q -&gt; 2/3 -&gt; scheduler: c' -&gt; node1<br>node3 qaytdi -&gt; node1[a c'] node2[b] node3[] (o'zi qaytmaydi)<br>service update --force -&gt; rolling qayta joylash -&gt; teng taqsim</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node ls                     # node3 Down<br>docker service ps web              # yangi task qayerga tushdi<br>docker node update --availability drain node3   # rejali ko'chirish<br>docker service update --force web  # node qaytgach balanslash<br>docker service ps web --format '{{.Node}}' | sort | uniq -c</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Swarm ishlayotgan task'ni &quot;balans uchun&quot; o'zi ko'chirmaydi — ataylab, uzilish bo'lmasligi uchun.</li><li><code>--force</code> hamma task'ni qayta yaratadi — <code>update_config</code> sozlanmagan bo'lsa qisqa uzilish.</li><li>Stateful task (local volume) ko'chsa — bo'sh ma'lumot bilan ko'tariladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Node tiklangandan keyin <code>--force</code> ni rejalashtirilgan oynada, <code>parallelism: 1</code> bilan qil; yoki <code>max_replicas_per_node</code> bilan to'planishni oldindan chekla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34231	<p>Swarm'da <code>--mode global</code> qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--mode global</code> har bir (constraint'ga mos) node'da bittadan task kerak bo'lganda ishlatiladi: monitoring agent (node-exporter, cAdvisor), log collector (Fluent Bit, Promtail), edge proxy, security agent. Yangi node qo'shilsa unda avtomatik task paydo bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Monitoring agent har node'da bo'lishi shart. Replicated bilan <code>replicas = node soni</code> qilsang — ikkitasi bitta node'ga tushishi mumkin, yangi node qo'shilganda qo'lda yangilash kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>node1 [exporter]  node2 [exporter]  node3 [exporter]<br>+ node4 join -&gt; node4 [exporter] (avtomatik)<br>node drain -&gt; global task ham o'chadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service create --mode global --name node-exporter \<br>  --mount type=bind,src=/proc,dst=/host/proc,readonly \<br>  --mount type=bind,src=/sys,dst=/host/sys,readonly \<br>  prom/node-exporter --path.procfs=/host/proc --path.sysfs=/host/sys<br>docker service ls      # MODE global, REPLICAS 4/4</pre><p>Faqat ma'lum node'larda:</p><pre>deploy:<br>  mode: global<br>  placement:<br>    constraints: [node.labels.edge == true]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Global service'ga <code>scale</code> yoki <code>replicas</code> — xato.</li><li>Resurs reservation katta bo'lsa ba'zi node'larda <code>Pending</code> — global'da ham bo'ladi.</li><li>Manager'lar <code>drain</code> bo'lsa ularda agent yo'q — manager'lar monitoringsiz qoladi (ataylab constraint/availability'ni o'yla).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Agent'lar uchun kichik reservation va qat'iy limit qo'y — har node'da ishlaydigan narsa xato qilsa, butun klasterga ta'sir qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34232	<p>Swarm join token o'g'irlansa nima qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Darhol tegishli token'ni rotate qil: <code>docker swarm join-token --rotate worker</code> (va kerak bo'lsa <code>manager</code>). Keyin <code>docker node ls</code> bilan begona node bormi tekshir, bo'lsa <code>drain</code> + <code>node rm --force</code>, va unga tushgan secret'larni almashtir.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Token bilan istalgan mashina klasterga qo'shilib, task'lar va secret'larni olishi mumkin. Manager token — butun klasterni boshqarish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>rotate -&gt; yangi token, eski token bilan join rad etiladi<br>mavjud node'lar ta'sirlanmaydi (token faqat join'da ishlatiladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker swarm join-token --rotate worker<br>docker swarm join-token --rotate manager<br>docker node ls<br>docker node inspect &lt;shubhali&gt; --format '{{.Status.Addr}} {{.Description.Hostname}}'<br>docker node update --availability drain &lt;shubhali&gt;<br>docker node rm --force &lt;shubhali&gt;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat rotate — allaqachon qo'shilgan begona node ichkarida qoladi.</li><li>Manager token sizgan bo'lsa — begona manager Raft'ga kirgan bo'lishi mumkin; uni demote/rm, <code>docker swarm ca --rotate</code>.</li><li>2377 port internetda ochiq bo'lsa token yagona himoya qatlami.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Token'ni chat/wiki'da saqlama — secret manager; 2377 faqat ichki tarmoqda. Shunda token sizsa ham tashqaridan ishlatib bo'lmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34233	<p>Swarm vs Kubernetes — qisqacha?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm — Docker'ga o'rnatilgan, <code>swarm init</code> bilan bir daqiqada ishga tushadigan, compose formatidagi oddiy orchestrator. Kubernetes — murakkabroq, lekin autoscaling, RBAC, stateful workload'lar, katta ekotizim va managed xizmatlarga ega sanoat standarti.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kichik loyihaga ortiqcha murakkablik yoki katta platformaga yetarsiz vosita tanlash — ikkalasi ham qimmatga tushadi.</p><p>| | Swarm | Kubernetes | |---|---|---| | O'rnatish | <code>docker swarm init</code> | murakkab (yoki EKS/GKE/AKS) | | Fayl | compose formati | ko'p YAML obyektlar, Helm | | Autoscaling | yo'q | HPA, VPA, KEDA, node autoscaler | | RBAC | yo'q | bor | | Stateful | cheklangan | StatefulSet, operatorlar | | Ekotizim | kichik | juda katta | | O'rganish | soatlar | haftalar |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Swarm<br>docker swarm init<br>docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml app<br># Kubernetes analogi<br>kubectl apply -f k8s/</pre><p><b>Qachon nima:</b></p><pre>kichik jamoa, oz node, stateless -&gt; Swarm<br>ko'p jamoa, autoscaling, ekotizim -&gt; Kubernetes (managed)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Swarm o'ldi&quot; deb hisoblash — hali qo'llab-quvvatlanadi (Mirantis), lekin yangi feature kam.</li><li>K8s'ni self-managed o'rnatib, operatsion yukni kam baholash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov — jamoa sig'imi va kelgusi 2-3 yil talablariga bog'liq; texnologiya modasiga emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34234	<p><code>docker service inspect --pretty</code> nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker service inspect --pretty</code> service konfiguratsiyasini o'qishga qulay matn ko'rinishida beradi: image, replika/mode, update/rollback config, placement, resurslar, portlar, network'lar, mount'lar, secret/config'lar va oxirgi update holati. <code>--pretty</code> siz — to'liq JSON.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Prod'da aslida qaysi image va qaysi sozlama ishlayapti?&quot; — fayl emas, klaster haqiqatini ko'rish kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service inspect --pretty web<br># ID:             x1y2z3<br># Name:           web<br># Service Mode:   Replicated<br>#  Replicas:      3<br># UpdateStatus:<br>#  State:         completed<br># Placement:<br>#  Constraints:   [node.role==worker]<br># UpdateConfig:<br>#  Parallelism:   1<br>#  On failure:    rollback<br># ContainerSpec:<br>#  Image:         nginx:1.27@sha256:...<br># Resources:<br>#  Limits: Memory: 512MiB<br># Ports:<br>#  PublishedPort = 80, TargetPort = 80, PublishMode = ingress</pre><p>Aniq maydon (skript uchun):</p><pre>docker service inspect web --format '{{.Spec.TaskTemplate.ContainerSpec.Image}}'<br>docker service inspect web --format '{{json .UpdateStatus}}' | jq<br>docker service inspect web --format '{{json .PreviousSpec}}' | jq   # rollback nimaga qaytadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Image digest (<code>@sha256</code>) bilan ko'rinadi — tag bir xil bo'lsa ham digest qaysi build ekanini aytadi.</li><li><code>--pretty</code> ba'zi maydonlarni (healthcheck tafsiloti) ko'rsatmaydi — JSON'ga qara.</li><li>Spec &quot;kerakli&quot; holat; haqiqiy task holati uchun <code>service ps</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Drift tekshiruvi: inspect'dagi image/spec'ni git'dagi stack fayl bilan CI'da solishtir — qo'lda o'zgarishlarni topadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34235	<p>Swarm manager'da ham konteyner ishlaydimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ha, default'da manager ham worker kabi task ishlatadi. Production'da manager'larni <code>docker node update --availability drain</code> qilib faqat boshqaruvga qoldirish tavsiya etiladi — og'ir workload Raft'ni sekinlashtirib klasterni beqaror qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Manager'da CPU/memory/disk'ni yeydigan servis ishlasa — Raft heartbeat kechikadi, leader election takrorlanadi, deploy'lar osiladi; manager OOM bo'lsa quorum xavf ostida.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>manager (Active): Raft + scheduler + API + task'lar   &lt;- risk<br>manager (Drain):  Raft + scheduler + API              &lt;- barqaror<br>workers:          task'lar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node update --availability drain manager1<br>docker node update --availability drain manager2<br>docker node update --availability drain manager3<br>docker node ls<br>docker node ps manager1        # bo'sh bo'lishi kerak</pre><p>Yoki service darajasida:</p><pre>deploy:<br>  placement:<br>    constraints: [node.role == worker]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kichik klasterda (3 node, hammasi manager) drain qilsang — task'lar uchun joy qolmaydi; bunday holda resurs limit bilan ishlat.</li><li>Drain global service'larni ham manager'dan olib tashlaydi (monitoring agent).</li><li>Manager'ni katta qilish o'rniga workload'ni ajratish to'g'riroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Control plane va data plane ajratish — K8s'dagi control-plane taint bilan bir xil g'oya. Manager'lar kichik, barqaror, kuzatiladigan bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34236	<p>Swarm'da healthcheck nima o'zgartiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Healthcheck bilan Swarm task holatini &quot;Running&quot; emas, <b>healthy/unhealthy</b> bo'yicha baholaydi: unhealthy task o'ldirilib yangisi ko'tariladi, rolling update yangi task healthy bo'lishini kutadi, healthy bo'lmagan task VIP load balancing'ga kirmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova ishga tushdi, lekin DB'ga ulana olmay 500 qaytaryapti yoki deadlock'ga tushgan — healthcheck'siz Swarm buni &quot;ishlayapti&quot; deb trafik yuboradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>start -&gt; starting (start_period)<br>      -&gt; test ok -&gt; healthy -&gt; VIP'ga qo'shiladi, update davom etadi<br>      -&gt; test fail x retries -&gt; unhealthy -&gt; task o'ldiriladi -&gt; yangi task</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    image: myapp:1.4<br>    healthcheck:<br>      test: [&quot;CMD&quot;, &quot;wget&quot;, &quot;-qO-&quot;, &quot;http://localhost:8080/health&quot;]<br>      interval: 10s<br>      timeout: 3s<br>      retries: 3<br>      start_period: 20s</pre><pre>docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'      # (healthy)/(unhealthy)<br>docker inspect --format '{{json .State.Health}}' &lt;c&gt; | jq<br>docker service ps web --no-trunc                 # &quot;unhealthy container&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Image'da <code>wget</code>/<code>curl</code> yo'q (distroless) — healthcheck doim fail, task'lar loop'da o'ladi.</li><li><code>start_period</code> juda qisqa — sekin start qiluvchi ilova hech qachon healthy bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Healthcheck tashqi bog'liqlikni (DB) tekshirsa — DB sekinlashganda hamma replika o'ldiriladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Healthcheck arzon va lokal bo'lsin (process javob beryaptimi). U update xavfsizligi va avtomatik tiklanishning asosi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34237	<p>Swarm'da node promote va demote?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker node promote &lt;node&gt;</code> — worker'ni manager'ga aylantiradi (Raft a'zosi bo'ladi). <code>docker node demote &lt;node&gt;</code> — manager'ni worker'ga qaytaradi. Har o'zgarishdan keyin manager soni toq bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Manager o'ldi yoki serverni almashtirish kerak — quorum'ni saqlab, manager tarkibini o'zgartirish lozim.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>3 manager: m1 m2 m3   (chidaydi: 1)<br>m3 almashtirish:<br>  promote w4 -&gt; 4 manager (vaqtincha, chidaydi: 1)<br>  demote m3  -&gt; 3 manager (m1 m2 w4)<br>  m3: drain -&gt; leave -&gt; node rm</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node promote node2<br>docker node ls        # MANAGER STATUS: Reachable<br>docker node demote node2<br>docker node ls        # MANAGER STATUS bo'sh = worker</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oxirgi manager'ni demote qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>3 dan 2 ta manager'ga tushirish (demote) — chidamlilik 0 ga tushadi.</li><li>Unreachable manager'ni demote qilish quorum bo'lsagina ishlaydi; quorum yo'q bo'lsa <code>--force-new-cluster</code> kerak.</li><li>Yangi manager'ga 2377/tcp ochiq bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Almashtirishda avval qo'sh, keyin olib tashla — quorum hech qachon tushmasin. Manager rolini ishonchli, kichik, drain qilingan node'larga ber.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34238	<p>Swarm'da service'ni qayta ishga tushirish (image o'zgarmasa)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker service update --force &lt;svc&gt;</code> — spec o'zgarmagan bo'lsa ham barcha task'larni <code>update_config</code> bo'yicha rolling tarzda qayta yaratadi. Bu &quot;restart&quot; ning Swarm'dagi ekvivalenti.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova cache'ni qayta o'qishi kerak, node qaytgandan keyin task'larni qayta taqsimlash kerak, yoki memory leak bor — image yangi emas, lekin qayta ishga tushirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>--force -&gt; ForceUpdate hisoblagichi +1 -&gt; spec &quot;o'zgardi&quot;<br>-&gt; rolling update: parallelism, delay, order bo'yicha<br>-&gt; yangi task'lar scheduler orqali (balki boshqa node'larga)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service update --force web<br>docker service update --force --update-parallelism 1 --update-delay 10s web<br>docker service ps web                         # yangi task'lar<br># tag'ni qayta pull qilish (mutable tag bo'lsa):<br>docker service update --force --image myapp:1.4 --with-registry-auth web</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>update_config</code> sozlanmagan bo'lsa (<code>stop-first</code>, parallelism katta) — qisqa uzilish.</li><li><code>--force</code> mutable tag'ni avtomatik yangi digest'ga o'zgartirmaydi — Swarm digest'ni pin qiladi; <code>--image</code> qayta berish kerak.</li><li>Job mode service'ni qayta ishga tushirishning ham yo'li shu.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Doimiy <code>--force</code> ehtiyoji — ilova muammosining belgisi (leak, config reload yo'q); simptomni emas, sababni tuzat.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34239	<p>Swarm'da secret'ni almashtirish (rotate) tartibi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secret immutable, shuning uchun: (1) yangi qiymat bilan yangi nomli secret yarat, (2) service'da eskisini olib tashlab, yangisini <b>o'sha target nomi</b> bilan qo'sh — Swarm rolling update qiladi, (3) eski secret'ni o'chir. DB paroli bo'lsa, oldin DB ikki parolni ham qabul qilishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Parol sizdi yoki muddati tugadi — servisni to'xtatmasdan almashtirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>db_pass (eski)  --secret-rm--&gt;<br>db_pass_v2      --secret-add target=db_pass--&gt; /run/secrets/db_pass<br>ilova kodi bir xil yo'lni o'qiydi, faqat qiymat yangi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>printf '%s' &quot;$NEW&quot; | docker secret create db_pass_v2 -<br>docker service update \<br>  --secret-rm db_pass \<br>  --secret-add source=db_pass_v2,target=db_pass \<br>  web<br>docker service ps web            # rolling tugadimi<br>docker secret rm db_pass</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>target</code> bermasang fayl nomi <code>/run/secrets/db_pass_v2</code> bo'ladi — ilova eski yo'lni o'qib xato beradi.</li><li>Eski secret'ni boshqa service ishlatsa <code>rm</code> rad etiladi — hammasini yangila.</li><li>DB parolini avval o'zgartirish — update tugaguncha eski task'lar ulana olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rotation'ni skript/CI job qil va muntazam bajar — favqulodda holatda birinchi marta qilish xatoga olib keladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34240	<p>Swarm'da <code>restart_policy</code> va update <code>failure_action</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>restart_policy</code> — <b>bitta task</b> chiqib ketganda (crash, unhealthy) nima qilish: qayta ko'tarish sharti, kechikish, urinishlar soni. <code>update_config.failure_action</code> — <b>update jarayoni</b> muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lganda butun deploy bilan nima qilish: <code>pause</code>, <code>continue</code> yoki <code>rollback</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikkalasini aralashtirish: restart_policy'ni &quot;xatoda eski versiyaga qaytadi&quot; deb o'ylash — u faqat o'sha image'ni qayta ishga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>oddiy ishlash:  task crash -&gt; restart_policy -&gt; yangi task (o'sha versiya)<br>update paytida: v2 task'lar monitor oynasida yiqildi<br>                -&gt; failure_action: rollback -&gt; butun service v1 ga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>deploy:<br>  restart_policy:<br>    condition: on-failure     # none | on-failure | any (default)<br>    delay: 5s<br>    max_attempts: 3<br>    window: 60s<br>  update_config:<br>    failure_action: rollback  # pause (default) | continue | rollback<br>    monitor: 30s<br>    max_failure_ratio: 0</pre><p>| | restart_policy | failure_action | |---|---|---| | Qachon | task chiqqanda, istalgan vaqt | faqat update paytida | | Darajasi | bitta task | butun service | | Natija | o'sha versiya qayta | to'xtash/davom/orqaga |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>max_attempts</code> tugasa task qayta ko'tarilmaydi — replika soni jim kamayadi.</li><li><code>condition: none</code> — job'lar uchun; servisda ishlatsang crash'dan keyin tiklanmaydi.</li><li><code>monitor</code> qisqa bo'lsa crash restart_policy'ga tushadi-yu, update &quot;muvaffaqiyatli&quot; deb hisoblanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ikkalasi birga: restart_policy kundalik o'z-o'zini tiklash, failure_action + healthcheck esa buzuq release'dan himoya.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34241	<p>Swarm klasteri holatini qanday tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uch daraja tekshiriladi: klaster (<code>docker info</code> — Swarm active, manager'lar soni), node'lar (<code>docker node ls</code> — Ready/Active, Leader/Reachable) va service'lar (<code>docker service ls</code> — REPLICAS <code>3/3</code> mosmi). Mos kelmasa <code>docker service ps --no-trunc</code> bilan sababga tush.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Hammasi ishlayaptimi?&quot; savoliga tez va tizimli javob kerak — incident boshida yoki deploy'dan keyin.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker info --format '{{json .Swarm}}' | jq '{LocalNodeState, ControlAvailable, Managers, Nodes}'<br>docker info | grep -A8 Swarm<br>docker node ls<br>docker service ls<br># REPLICAS mos kelmaganlarni topish<br>docker service ls --format '{{.Name}} {{.Replicas}}' | awk '{split($2,a,&quot;/&quot;); if (a[1]!=a[2]) print}'<br>docker service ps api --no-trunc --filter desired-state=running</pre><p><b>O'qish:</b></p><pre>node ls:     Down / Unreachable   -&gt; node yoki manager muammosi<br>service ls:  2/3                  -&gt; biror task ishlamayapti<br>service ps:  ERROR ustuni         -&gt; sabab</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>3/3</code> ilova to'g'ri javob beryapti degani emas — healthcheck va real so'rov (smoke test) kerak.</li><li>Worker'da <code>docker node ls</code> ishlamaydi — manager'da tekshir.</li><li>Bitta <code>Unreachable</code> manager — hali ishlaydi, lekin chidamlilik zaxirasi yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu buyruqlarni monitoring'ga aylantir: desired != running, manager unreachable, Pending task'lar — Prometheus alert'lari, qo'lda tekshiruv emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34242	<p>Swarm Raft ma'lumotlari qayerda va qanday backup qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm holati (Raft log, sertifikatlar, secret/config, service va network ta'riflari) har manager'da <code>/var/lib/docker/swarm</code> katalogida. Backup: leader bo'lmagan manager'da docker'ni to'xtatib, shu katalogni arxivlash. Tiklash: arxivni qaytarib <code>docker swarm init --force-new-cluster</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Barcha manager'lar yo'qolsa — service ta'riflari, secret'lar va config'lar ham yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/var/lib/docker/swarm/<br>  raft/         &lt;- Raft log va snapshot (shifrlangan)<br>  certificates/ &lt;- node va CA sertifikatlari<br>  state.json, docker-state.json</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># backup (quorum saqlanishi uchun bitta manager'da)<br>systemctl stop docker<br>tar czf swarm-backup-$(date +%F).tgz -C /var/lib/docker swarm<br>systemctl start docker<br># tiklash<br>systemctl stop docker<br>rm -rf /var/lib/docker/swarm<br>tar xzf swarm-backup.tgz -C /var/lib/docker<br>systemctl start docker<br>docker swarm init --force-new-cluster --advertise-addr 10.0.0.10</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker ishlab turganda nusxa — nomuvofiq Raft holati.</li><li>Autolock yoqilgan bo'lsa unlock key'ni ham saqla, aks holda backup ochilmaydi.</li><li>Volume ma'lumotlari (DB) bu backup'ga kirmaydi — alohida.</li><li>Backup'da secret'lar bor — arxivni shifrlangan joyda saqla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Backup'ni muntazam (cron) va tiklashni staging'da sinab ko'r. Qo'shimcha: stack fayllar git'da — noldan qayta deploy ham DR yo'li.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34243	<p>Swarm'da kvorum yo'qolsa nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Quorum yo'qolsa (masalan 3 dan 2 manager o'chsa) klaster boshqaruvi to'xtaydi: deploy, scale, update, yangi node join ishlamaydi. Lekin <b>ishlab turgan container'lar davom etadi</b>. Tiklash: o'chgan manager'larni qaytarish, bo'lmasa tirik manager'da <code>docker swarm init --force-new-cluster</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Incident paytida rollback yoki scale kerak, lekin buyruqlar &quot;The swarm does not have a leader&quot; xatosini beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>3 manager, quorum=2<br>m1 OK, m2 X, m3 X -&gt; 1 &lt; 2 -&gt; leader yo'q<br>control plane: to'xtagan<br>data plane (task'lar, routing mesh): ishlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node ls          # Error: swarm does not have a leader<br># 1. eng yaxshi: m2/m3 ni tikla<br># 2. bo'lmasa, FAQAT bitta tirik manager'da:<br>docker swarm init --force-new-cluster --advertise-addr 10.0.0.11<br>docker node ls<br>docker node demote m2 m3 &amp;&amp; docker node rm m2 m3<br>docker swarm join-token manager     # yangi manager'lar qo'sh</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--force-new-cluster</code> ni bir nechta node'da — bir nechta klaster.</li><li>Eski manager'lar qaytsa — <code>docker swarm leave --force</code> bilan tozalab, qayta join.</li><li>Task'lar o'lsa quorum'siz qayta ko'tarilmaydi — vaqt cheklangan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Quorum yo'qolishi — dizayn xatosi belgisi (manager'lar bitta AZ'da, juft son). Runbook yozib, staging'da mashq qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34244	<p>Swarm'da service'ni o'chirish va bu konteynerlarga nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker service rm &lt;svc&gt;</code> service'ni o'chiradi: barcha node'lardagi uning task'lari (container'lari) to'xtatilib o'chiriladi, VIP va routing mesh port bo'shatiladi. <b>Volume'lar o'chmaydi</b> — node'larda qoladi; secret/config va network'lar ham alohida qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Service'ni o'chirish ma'lumotni ham o'chiradimi? Va qanday xavfsiz o'chirish kerak?</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>service rm -&gt; desired state: yo'q<br>  -&gt; har task: SIGTERM -&gt; stop_grace_period (default 10s) -&gt; SIGKILL<br>  -&gt; container'lar o'chiriladi<br>  qoladi: volume'lar, secret, config, network (stack'dan tashqari bo'lsa)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service rm web<br>docker service ls                  # yo'q<br>docker volume ls                   # har node'da volume'lar qoladi<br>docker volume rm web_data          # kerak bo'lsa qo'lda, har node'da<br>docker stack rm shop               # stack: service + network + secret/config</pre><p><code>stop_grace_period</code> ni stack faylda: <code>stop_grace_period: 30s</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tasdiq so'ralmaydi — noto'g'ri context/klasterda ishlatish xavfli (<code>docker context ls</code>).</li><li>Stack'dagi service'ni <code>service rm</code> qilsang — keyingi <code>stack deploy</code> qaytaradi.</li><li>Volume'lar har node'da tarqalib qoladi — disk to'ldiradi; vaqti-vaqti bilan <code>docker volume prune</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da o'chirish ham git orqali: fayldan olib tashla + <code>stack deploy --prune</code>. Volume tozalashdan oldin backup.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34245	<p>Swarm stack'da <code>endpoint_mode: dnsrr</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>endpoint_mode: dnsrr</code> — service nomi VIP o'rniga <b>barcha task IP'lari</b> ro'yxatiga resolve bo'ladi (DNS round robin), Swarm IPVS load balancing ishlatilmaydi. Default <code>vip</code> — bitta virtual IP va ichki LB. dnsrr bilan ingress routing mesh ishlamaydi — faqat <code>mode: host</code> port.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> O'z load balancer'ing (HAProxy/nginx) backend'larni alohida ko'rishi kerak, yoki gRPC kabi uzun ulanishlar VIP orqali bitta task'ga yopishib qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>vip:    &quot;api&quot; -&gt; 10.0.1.5 -&gt; IPVS -&gt; task'lar<br>dnsrr:  &quot;api&quot; -&gt; 10.0.1.7, 10.0.1.8, 10.0.1.9 -&gt; client o'zi tanlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    image: app/api:1.4<br>    deploy:<br>      endpoint_mode: dnsrr<br>      replicas: 3</pre><pre>docker exec -it &lt;c&gt; getent hosts api        # bir nechta IP</pre><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b></p><ul><li>Tashqi/ichki LB backend ro'yxatini DNS'dan oladi.</li><li>Client-side balancing (gRPC).</li><li>Peer discovery (Cassandra, Elasticsearch).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ports</code> (ingress) + dnsrr — deploy xatosi.</li><li>DNS cache (JVM, nginx statik upstream) — o'lgan task IP'siga so'rov.</li><li>Ko'p hollarda <code>tasks.&lt;svc&gt;</code> nomi yetarli — endpoint_mode'ni o'zgartirmasdan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> VIP oddiy va kutilgan default; dnsrr ga faqat aniq sabab bilan o't va client'larda DNS TTL/refresh xatti-harakatini tekshir.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34246	<p>Swarm'da <code>docker service create --name web --replicas 3 -p 80:80 nginx</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>web</code> nomli replicated service yaratadi: klaster bo'ylab <b>3 ta</b> nginx task'ini joylashtiradi va <b>80-port</b>ni routing mesh orqali <b>har bir node'da</b> ochadi — istalgan node'ning 80-portiga kelgan so'rov task'lardan biriga yetkaziladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bu buyruq Swarm'ning asosiy g'oyalarini birlashtiradi: desired state, scheduling, load balancing.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>--name web      -&gt; service nomi (DNS: web)<br>--replicas 3    -&gt; desired state: 3 task<br>-p 80:80        -&gt; ingress: published 80 -&gt; target 80, hamma node'da<br>nginx           -&gt; image (tag'siz = latest, tavsiya etilmaydi)<br><br>node1:80 \<br>node2:80  &gt; IPVS -&gt; web.1 | web.2 | web.3<br>node3:80 /</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service create --name web --replicas 3 -p 80:80 nginx:1.27<br>docker service ls<br># NAME  MODE        REPLICAS  IMAGE       PORTS<br># web   replicated  3/3       nginx:1.27  *:80-&gt;80/tcp<br>docker service ps web<br>curl http://&lt;istalgan-node&gt;/<br>docker service rm web</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tag'siz <code>nginx</code> — <code>latest</code>; node'lar turli vaqtda turli versiya olishi mumkin (Swarm digest'ni pin qiladi, lekin rebuild'da o'zgaradi).</li><li>80-port node'da band bo'lsa (masalan host'da nginx) — konflikt.</li><li>Healthcheck, resurs, update_config yo'q — prod uchun to'liq emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bir qatorli <code>service create</code> demo uchun yaxshi; prod'da hammasini stack faylda deklarativ yoz.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34247	<p>Swarm'da placement preference (spread) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Placement preference <code>spread</code> — task'larni berilgan label qiymatlari (masalan <code>zone</code>) bo'yicha <b>teng</b> taqsimlashga harakat qiladi. Bu yumshoq qoida: mos taqsim imkonsiz bo'lsa ham task baribir joylanadi (constraint'dan farqli).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 6 replika tasodifan bitta zonaga tushsa, zona o'chganda servis butunlay yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>--placement-pref spread=node.labels.zone, replicas=6<br>zone=a (3 node) -&gt; 2 task<br>zone=b (1 node) -&gt; 2 task<br>zone=c (2 node) -&gt; 2 task<br>(node soniga emas, zona soniga qarab teng)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker node update --label-add zone=a node1<br>docker node update --label-add zone=b node2<br>docker node update --label-add zone=c node3<br>docker service create --name web --replicas 6 \<br>  --placement-pref 'spread=node.labels.zone' nginx:1.27<br>docker service ps web --format '{{.Node}}' | sort | uniq -c</pre><p>Stack faylda:</p><pre>deploy:<br>  placement:<br>    preferences:<br>      - spread: node.labels.zone</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Label'siz node'lar &quot;bo'sh qiymat&quot; degan alohida guruh bo'lib, task oladi.</li><li>Zona qaytgach task'lar o'zi qayta tarqalmaydi — <code>service update --force</code>.</li><li>Zona ichidagi node'lar sig'imi teng emas — kichik zonadagi node'lar to'lib qolishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Spread'ni <code>max_replicas_per_node</code> va har zonada N+1 sig'im bilan birga ishlat — shunda bitta zona yiqilsa qolganlari yukni ko'taradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34248	<p>Swarm'da autolock nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Autolock — manager'lardagi Raft ma'lumotlarini (secret'lar, TLS kalitlari) shifrlaydigan kalitni diskda ochiq saqlamaslik. Yoqilgandan keyin manager docker restart bo'lsa, <code>docker swarm unlock</code> bilan unlock key kiritilmaguncha klasterga qo'shilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Default'da Raft shifrlash kaliti manager diskida turadi — disk yoki backup o'g'irlansa, secret'lar ham ochiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>autolock=false: Raft shifr kaliti diskda -&gt; restart avtomatik<br>autolock=true:  kalit unlock key bilan shifrlangan<br>   restart -&gt; manager &quot;locked&quot; -&gt; docker swarm unlock -&gt; ishlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker swarm update --autolock=true<br># To unlock a swarm manager after it restarts, run `docker swarm unlock`<br># and provide the following key: SWMKEY-1-...<br>docker swarm unlock-key                 # joriy kalitni ko'rish<br>docker swarm unlock-key --rotate        # kalitni almashtirish<br># restart'dan keyin:<br>docker swarm unlock</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Unlock key yo'qolsa — locked manager'ni tiklab bo'lmaydi; boshqa manager'lar ishlasa ularni qayta qo'shish, hammasi locked bo'lsa — klaster yo'q.</li><li>Har manager restart'i qo'lda aralashuv talab qiladi — avtomatik reboot (patch) jarayonlarini buzadi.</li><li>Kalit rotate qilingandan keyin eski kalit ham bir muddat saqlansin (o'sha paytda o'chgan manager uchun).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kalitni secret manager/parol seyfida saqla va unlock'ni runbook'ga kirit. Autolock xavfsizlik va avtomatlashtirish orasidagi trade-off — tahdid modeliga qarab tanla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-34249	<p>Swarm'da image'ni yangilab deploy qilishning eng oddiy yo'li?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng oddiy yo'l: yangi image'ni registry'ga push qilib, <code>docker service update --image myapp:1.5 --with-registry-auth web</code>. Swarm <code>update_config</code> bo'yicha rolling update qiladi; muammo bo'lsa <code>docker service rollback web</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi versiyani servisni to'xtatmasdan chiqarish va xato bo'lsa tez qaytish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>service update --image 1.5<br>  -&gt; spec o'zgardi -&gt; rolling: [1.4 1.4 1.4] -&gt; [1.5 1.4 1.4] -&gt; ... -&gt; [1.5 1.5 1.5]<br>  -&gt; PreviousSpec = 1.4 (rollback uchun saqlanadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker build -t registry.example.com/myapp:1.5 .<br>docker push registry.example.com/myapp:1.5<br>docker service update --image registry.example.com/myapp:1.5 \<br>  --with-registry-auth web<br>docker service ps web                    # yangi task'lar Running?<br>docker service inspect web --format '{{json .UpdateStatus}}'<br># muammo bo'lsa:<br>docker service rollback web</pre><p>Stack bilan deploy qilingan bo'lsa — fayldagi tag'ni o'zgartirib <code>docker stack deploy</code> qil, aks holda keyingi stack deploy eski tag'ga qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--with-registry-auth</code> unutilsa — private image node'larda pull bo'lmaydi (<code>Rejected</code>).</li><li>Bir xil tag'ni (<code>latest</code>) qayta push qilish — Swarm digest bo'yicha ishlaydi, o'zgarishni sezmasligi mumkin; har release'ga yangi tag.</li><li>Healthcheck va <code>failure_action: rollback</code> yo'q bo'lsa buzuq versiya ham &quot;muvaffaqiyatli&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tag = git SHA, update CI'dan <code>--detach=false</code> bilan — pipeline natijani kutsin. Rollback DB migration'ni qaytarmaydi: schema o'zgarishlarini backward-compatible qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::T16 Docker Swarm gotchas	idrill-33104	<p>Routing mesh orqali kelgan so'rovlarda ilova client IP o'rniga 10.0.0.x ko'radi. Nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm routing mesh (ingress) kelgan paketni overlay tarmoq orqali uzatadi va SNAT qiladi — shuning uchun ilova haqiqiy client IP o'rniga tarmoq gateway IP'sini (<code>10.0.0.x</code>) ko'radi. Haqiqiy client IP kerak bo'lsa <code>mode: host</code> (routing mesh'ni chetlab) ishlatish kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Rate limiting, geo-blocking yoki audit haqiqiy client IP'ga tayanadi — lekin hamma so'rovda bir xil <code>10.0.0.2</code> ko'rinadi. Routing mesh IP'ni yashirmoqda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Routing mesh (ingress): client -&gt; har node:80 -&gt; overlay (SNAT) -&gt; service task<br>   ilova ko'radi: ingress network gateway IP (client IP yo'qoladi)<br>mode: host: client -&gt; faqat task turgan node:80 -&gt; to'g'ridan-to'g'ri -&gt; real client IP<br>   (lekin load balancing yo'qoladi -&gt; global mode bilan har node'da task)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  web:<br>    ports:<br>      - target: 80<br>        published: 80<br>        mode: host          # routing mesh'ni chetlab, real IP<br>    deploy:<br>      mode: global          # har node'da bitta task (LB o'rnini bosadi)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>mode: host</code> LB routing mesh'ini chetlaydi — <code>mode: global</code> bilan birga ishlatmasa faqat bitta node ochiq qoladi.</li><li>HTTP uchun muqobil: tashqi LB/proxy <code>X-Forwarded-For</code> header qo'shsin, ilova uni o'qisin (ishonchli proxy'dan).</li><li><code>X-Forwarded-For</code> ni ko'r-ko'rona ishonmaslik — faqat ishonchli proxy qo'yganini qabul qil (spoofing).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> L7 (HTTP) da to'g'ri yo'l — reverse proxy (nginx/Traefik) <code>X-Forwarded-For</code>/<code>X-Real-IP</code> qo'yadi, ilova ishonchli proxy ro'yxatidan tekshiradi. L4 da <code>mode: host</code> + global. 2025 holatida Swarm &quot;maintenance&quot; rejimida — yangi loyihalar K8s'ga o'tmoqda.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::t16 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::T16 Docker Swarm gotchas	idrill-33105	<p>Stack yangilangandan keyin eski konfiguratsiya qoldi: <code>docker config</code>/<code>secret</code> o'zgarmadi. Nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm <code>config</code>/<code>secret</code> obyektlari <b>immutable</b> (o'zgarmas) — yaratilgach tahrirlab bo'lmaydi. Stack'ni yangilab fayl mazmunini o'zgartirsangiz ham, bir xil nomli config qayta yaratilmaydi, eski qoladi. Yechim: config nomiga mazmun hash'ini qo'shib, har o'zgarishda yangi nom hosil qilish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>nginx.conf</code> ni o'zgartirdingiz, <code>docker stack deploy</code> qildingiz — lekin konteyner hali eski konfig bilan. Chunki <code>nginx_conf</code> nomli config allaqachon mavjud, Swarm uni yangilamaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>config &quot;nginx_conf&quot; mavjud -&gt; deploy uni qayta yaratmaydi (immutable)<br>Yechim: nom = nginx_conf_&lt;hash&gt; -&gt; mazmun o'zgarsa hash o'zgaradi<br>   -&gt; yangi config obyekti -&gt; service yangi config bilan rolling update</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>configs:<br>  nginx_conf:<br>    name: nginx_conf_${CONF_HASH}<br>    file: ./nginx.conf</pre><pre>CONF_HASH=$(sha1sum nginx.conf | cut -c1-8) docker stack deploy -c stack.yml web</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir xil nomdagi config'ni &quot;yangilash&quot; ishlamaydi — immutable; nom o'zgarishi kerak.</li><li>Eski config obyektlari yig'iladi — vaqti-vaqti bilan <code>docker config ls</code> + <code>rm</code> (ishlatilmayotganini).</li><li>Secret uchun ham xuddi shu — parol o'zgarsa yangi nomli secret + service update.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Immutable config/secret — yaxshi dizayn (versiyalangan, kuzatiladigan), lekin nom-hash pattern bilan ishlatish kerak. Bu GitOps'dagi immutable artefakt g'oyasiga mos. 2025 holatida yangi loyihalar uchun K8s ConfigMap/Secret + checksum annotation ko'proq qo'llanadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::t16 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::T16 Docker Swarm gotchas	idrill-33106	<p>Stack'dagi <code>depends_on</code> ishlamayapti: api db'dan oldin ko'tarilib yiqiladi. Nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Swarm'da stack ichidagi <code>depends_on</code> <b>e'tiborsiz</b> qoldiriladi — service'lar bir-biridan mustaqil va ishga tushish tartibi kafolatlanmaydi. <code>api</code> <code>db</code>dan oldin ko'tarilib, ulanolmay yiqilishi mumkin. Yechim: ilovada ulanish retry + <code>restart_policy</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Compose'dagi <code>depends_on</code> ni Swarm'ga ko'chirasiz, lekin u ishlamaydi — api db tayyor bo'lishdan oldin start bo'lib crash qiladi. Tartibga tayangan dizayn Swarm'da buziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Compose (bitta host): depends_on tartibni boshqaradi<br>Swarm (distributed): service'lar mustaqil orkestratsiya -&gt; tartib YO'Q<br>   api db'dan oldin -&gt; ulanish fail -&gt; restart_policy qayta urinadi<br>   -&gt; oxir-oqibat db tayyor -&gt; api ulanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>services:<br>  api:<br>    deploy:<br>      restart_policy:<br>        condition: on-failure<br>        delay: 5s<br>        max_attempts: 10</pre><pre>// Ilovada: DB tayyor bo'lguncha retry (exponential backoff)<br>for i := 0; i &lt; 10; i++ {<br>    if err := db.Ping(); err == nil { break }<br>    time.Sleep(backoff(i))<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Swarm'da <code>depends_on</code> ni &quot;ishlaydi&quot; deb o'ylash — u jimgina e'tiborsiz.</li><li>Faqat <code>restart_policy</code> ga tayanish, retry'siz — har restart'da to'liq qayta boshlash (sekin).</li><li>Startup retry cheksiz bo'lmasin — max attempt + aniq xato log.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Distributed tizimda <b>har bog'liqlik vaqtincha yo'q bo'lishi mumkin</b> deb dizayn qil — startup tartibiga emas, retry/backoff'ga tayan. Bu umumiy prinsip (K8s'da ham initContainer yoki ilova retry). Ilova har doim bog'liqlik yo'qligiga chidamli bo'lsin — bu reliability asosi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::t16 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::T16 Docker Swarm gotchas	idrill-33107	<p>2 manager'li Swarm'da bitta manager o'chdi — klaster boshqarib bo'lmay qoldi. Nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> 2 manager'li Swarm <b>noto'g'ri konfiguratsiya</b>: Raft quorum uchun ko'pchilik (majority) kerak, 2 node'da quorum = 2. Bittasi o'chsa qolgan bitta node ko'pchilikni tashkil qilmaydi — klaster boshqaruvi (deploy/scale) to'xtaydi. Toq son (3, 5) manager kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Zaxira uchun 2 manager qo'ydim&quot; — aslida bu bitta node'dan ham yomon: bittasi o'chsa boshqaruv butunlay bloklanadi. Mavjud task'lar ishlaydi, lekin hech narsa o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Raft quorum = floor(N/2) + 1<br> 1 manager: quorum 1 -&gt; HA yo'q, lekin ishlaydi<br> 2 manager: quorum 2 -&gt; bittasi o'lsa 1 &lt; 2 -&gt; boshqaruv YO'Q<br> 3 manager: quorum 2 -&gt; bittasi o'lsa 2 &gt;= 2 -&gt; ishlaydi (1 fault toleransi)<br> 5 manager: 2 fault toleransi</pre><p><b>Amalda (tiklash):</b></p><pre># Tirik manager'da:<br>docker swarm init --force-new-cluster<br>docker node ls                    # holatni ko'r<br>docker swarm join-token manager   # yangi manager qo'shish uchun</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Juft son manager (2, 4) — fault toleransini oshirmaydi, faqat quorum xavfini ko'paytiradi; doim toq son.</li><li>Juda ko'p manager (7+) — Raft yozuv konsensusi sekinlashadi; 3 yoki 5 optimal.</li><li>Manager'lar bir xil rack/AZ'da bo'lsa — bitta nosozlik hammasini o'chiradi; tarqat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Quorum-ga asoslangan tizimlar (Raft, etcd, Zookeeper) uchun qoida: <b>toq son, 3 yoki 5</b>, alohida fault domain'larda. Bu Swarm, K8s etcd, Consul — hammasiga tegishli. 2 node HA emas — bu eng ko'p uchraydigan &quot;HA qildim deb o'ylash&quot; xatosi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::swarm sec::t16 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::T16 Docker Swarm gotchas	idrill-33108	<p>Node qayta ulangandan keyin task'lar notekis: bitta node'da hammasi, yangisida hech narsa. Nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Node qayta ulanganda Swarm mavjud task'larni avtomatik qayta taqsimlamaydi (rebalancing yo'q) — eski task'lar hali tirik node'da qoladi, yangi/qaytgan node bo'sh turadi. Balanslash uchun <code>docker service update --force</code> kerak (rolling qayta yaratish).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta node o'chib yoqildi; hamma task eski node'da to'planib qoldi, qaytgan node'da hech narsa yo'q. Yuk notekis — bitta node overloaded, boshqasi bo'sh.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Node o'chdi -&gt; task'lar boshqa node'larga ko'chdi<br>Node qaytdi -&gt; Swarm task'larni QAYTA taqsimlamaydi (ishlayotganini buzmaydi)<br>   -&gt; notekis holat davom etadi<br>update --force -&gt; task'lar rolling tarzda qayta yaratiladi -&gt; qaytadan taqsimlanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker service update --force api      # rolling recreate -&gt; qayta balanslash<br>docker service ps api                  # task'lar qaysi node'da ekanini ko'r</pre><p><code>update_config</code> (parallelism, delay) ga rioya qilib rolling bajariladi — downtime'siz.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--force</code> downtime bermasligi uchun <code>update_config</code> to'g'ri (parallelism 1, delay) bo'lsin.</li><li>Rebalancing avtomatik emas — buni bilmaslik notekis yukni &quot;normal&quot; deb qoldiradi.</li><li>Resurs reservation/constraint bo'lmasa taqsimlash baribir notekis bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Swarm avtomatik rebalance qilmaydi (ishlayotgan task'ni bejiz ko'chirmaslik — konservativ dizayn); balanslash ongli <code>update --force</code>. K8s'da ham default scheduler qayta ulangan node'ni avtomatik to'ldirmaydi — descheduler kerak. 2025 holatida Swarm yangi loyihalar uchun tavsiya etilmaydi — K8s standart.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::swarm sec::t16 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::T16 Docker Swarm gotchas	idrill-42289	<p>Swarm service'ni yangilagandan keyin image yangi tag bilan pull bo'lmadi — eski versiya ishlayapti. Sabab?</p>	<p><b>Mexanizm:</b> <code>docker service create app:1.2</code> → manager registry'dan digest so'raydi → task'lar <code>app:1.2@sha256:aaa</code> bilan ishlaydi. Keyin <code>app:1.2</code> qayta push qilindi (<code>sha256:bbb</code>), lekin service spec o'zgarmadi → yangilanish yo'q.</p><p><b>Yechimlar:</b></p><pre>docker service update --image app:1.2 --with-registry-auth api   # digest qayta resolve<br>docker service update --force api                                # majburan qayta yaratish</pre><p><b>To'g'ri amaliyot:</b> tag'ni hech qachon qayta ishlatma (immutable tag: <code>1.2.0</code>, <code>git-sha</code>). Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::T16 Docker Swarm gotchas	idrill-42290	<p>Swarm'da service <code>global</code> mode'da, lekin yangi qo'shilgan node'da task ishga tushmadi. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::T16 Docker Swarm gotchas	idrill-42312	<p>Swarm'da healthcheck'li service update qilinmoqda va har doim rollback bo'lyapti, lekin yangi versiya qo'lda ishga tushirilsa ishlaydi. Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::T16 Docker Swarm gotchas	idrill-42313	<p>Overlay network'da IP manzillar tugadi: yangi task'lar <code>Pending</code> (&quot;could not allocate IP&quot;).
