Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33109	<p>Kubernetes nima va qanday muammoni hal qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes (K8s) — konteynerlarni ko'p server (node) ustida avtomatik joylashtiradigan, o'lganini qayta ko'taradigan, skale qiladigan va tarmoqqa ulaydigan <b>container orchestrator</b>. Siz &quot;nima bo'lishi kerak&quot;ni YAML'da yozasiz, K8s uni doimiy ushlab turadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 3 ta serverda 20 ta servis bor. Server o'chsa konteynerlarni kim boshqa joyga ko'chiradi? Yangi versiyani uzilishsiz kim chiqaradi? Trafik ko'paysa kim nusxa qo'shadi? Qo'lda <code>docker run</code> + skriptlar bilan bu tez orada boshqarib bo'lmaydigan bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre> kubectl apply (desired state)<br>        v<br> +---------------- Control plane ----------------+<br> | kube-apiserver &lt;-&gt; etcd (holat bazasi)         |<br> | scheduler (pod qaysi node'ga)                  |<br> | controller-manager (desired == actual loop)    |<br> +------------------------------------------------+<br>        v<br> +--- Node 1 ---+  +--- Node 2 ---+<br> | kubelet      |  | kubelet      |<br> | containerd   |  | containerd   |<br> | kube-proxy   |  | kube-proxy   |<br> +--------------+  +--------------+</pre><p>Controller'lar doim solishtiradi: &quot;3 replika kerak, 2 ta bor&quot; -&gt; bittasini yaratadi. Bu <b>reconciliation loop</b>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl create deployment api --image=nginx --replicas=3<br>kubectl get pods -o wide        # qaysi node'da ishlayapti<br>kubectl delete pod &lt;birortasi&gt;  # o'chir -&gt; darhol yangisi paydo bo'ladi<br>kubectl scale deploy/api --replicas=5</pre><p><b>Hal qiladigan muammolar:</b> self-healing, rolling update/rollback, service discovery + load balancing, autoscaling, config/secret boshqaruvi, storage ulash.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>1-2 servisli kichik loyihaga K8s olib kirish — operatsion narx foydadan katta (Compose, PaaS, ECS yetarli).</li><li>&quot;K8s qo'ysak ilova o'zi ishonchli bo'ladi&quot; — yo'q, probe, resurs, graceful shutdown baribir sizning ishingiz.</li><li>Pod'ni qo'lda yaratish — controller'siz u qayta tug'ilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatda managed K8s (EKS/GKE/AKS) tanlanadi — control plane'ni o'zing boshqarish (etcd backup, upgrade) alohida kasb. K8s — platforma qurish uchun platforma; jamoa kichik bo'lsa uning murakkabligi asosiy xavf.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33110	<p>Pod, ReplicaSet, Deployment farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Pod</b> — bitta yoki bir nechta konteyner (umumiy IP va volume) — eng kichik birlik. <b>ReplicaSet</b> — &quot;N ta bir xil pod doim bo'lsin&quot;ni ta'minlaydi. <b>Deployment</b> — ReplicaSet'larni boshqaradi: rolling update va rollback beradi. Amalda faqat Deployment yoziladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Pod o'zi o'lsa qayta tug'ilmaydi. ReplicaSet uni tiklaydi, lekin yangi image'ga uzilishsiz o'tishni bilmaydi. Deployment yangi ReplicaSet yaratib, eskisini asta-sekin kamaytiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Deployment api (image 1.4)<br>   |<br>   +-- ReplicaSet api-6c8f (1.3)  replicas: 3 -&gt; 2 -&gt; 1 -&gt; 0<br>   +-- ReplicaSet api-7d9f (1.4)  replicas: 0 -&gt; 1 -&gt; 2 -&gt; 3<br>            |<br>            +-- Pod api-7d9f-x1, x2, x3</pre><p>Eski ReplicaSet 0 replika bilan saqlanadi — rollback shunda tez.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: apps/v1<br>kind: Deployment<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  replicas: 3<br>  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  template:<br>    metadata: { labels: { app: api } }<br>    spec:<br>      containers:<br>        - name: api<br>          image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4<br>          ports: [{ containerPort: 8080 }]</pre><pre>kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml<br>kubectl get deploy,rs,pods -l app=api   # uchala qatlamni ko'r<br>kubectl set image deploy/api api=ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5<br>kubectl rollout status deploy/api<br>kubectl rollout history deploy/api<br>kubectl rollout undo deploy/api         # oldingi ReplicaSet'ga qaytadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pod'ni yalang'och yaratish (<code>kind: Pod</code>) — node o'lsa yo'qoladi.</li><li>ReplicaSet'ni qo'lda tahrirlash — Deployment uni qaytadan o'zgartiradi.</li><li><code>selector</code> Deployment yaratilgandan keyin o'zgarmaydi (immutable).</li><li><code>:latest</code> tag — template o'zgarmagani uchun rollout bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>revisionHistoryLimit</code> (default 10) eski ReplicaSet'lar sonini cheklaydi. GitOps'da <code>rollout undo</code> o'rniga Git'dagi commit'ni revert qilish kerak, aks holda ArgoCD qaytarib yozadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33111	<p>Service turlari: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, Headless farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Service — o'zgaruvchan pod IP'lari oldida turgan barqaror nom va IP. <b>ClusterIP</b> — faqat klaster ichida (default). <b>NodePort</b> — har node'ning 30000-32767 portida ochiladi. <b>LoadBalancer</b> — cloud LB yaratadi (tashqi IP). <b>Headless</b> (<code>clusterIP: None</code>) — virtual IP yo'q, DNS to'g'ridan-to'g'ri pod IP'larini qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Pod qayta yaratilsa IP o'zgaradi. Mijoz qaysi IP'ga ulanishini bilmaydi. Service label selector orqali ready pod'larni topib, ularga trafikni taqsimlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Internet -&gt; Cloud LB (LoadBalancer)<br>              v<br>          NodeIP:31080 (NodePort)<br>              v<br>          ClusterIP 10.96.0.10:80<br>              v  (kube-proxy iptables/IPVS)<br>     pod-a:8080  pod-b:8080  pod-c:8080</pre><p>LoadBalancer ichida NodePort, NodePort ichida ClusterIP bor — ular qatlam.</p><p>| Tur | Kimga ochiq | Qachon | |---|---|---| | ClusterIP | klaster ichi | servislararo | | NodePort | node IP:port | test, bare-metal | | LoadBalancer | internet/VPC | TCP servis, Ingress controller'ning o'zi | | Headless | DNS -&gt; pod IP | StatefulSet (db-0.db), client-side LB | | ExternalName | CNAME | tashqi DB'ga ichki nom |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Service<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  type: ClusterIP<br>  selector: { app: api }<br>  ports: [{ port: 80, targetPort: 8080 }]</pre><pre>kubectl get svc api<br>kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api  # bo'sh bo'lsa selector xato<br>kubectl run t --rm -it --image=busybox -- wget -qO- api.prod.svc.cluster.local</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Selector label pod label'iga mos emas -&gt; endpoint bo'sh -&gt; &quot;connection refused&quot;.</li><li><code>port</code> va <code>targetPort</code> chalkashligi.</li><li>Har HTTP servisga alohida LoadBalancer — har biri pul turadi; bitta Ingress/Gateway yetarli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> gRPC kabi uzoq ulanishlarda ClusterIP L4 bo'lgani uchun yuk teng taqsimlanmaydi — headless + client-side LB yoki mesh kerak. <code>externalTrafficPolicy: Local</code> mijoz IP'sini saqlaydi, lekin node'lar orasida notekis yuk beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33112	<p>Asosiy kubectl buyruqlari: get, describe, logs, exec, apply, delete, port-forward?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>get</code> — ro'yxat, <code>describe</code> — batafsil holat va Events, <code>logs</code> — konteyner chiqishi, <code>exec</code> — konteyner ichida buyruq, <code>apply</code> — YAML'ni deklarativ qo'llash, <code>delete</code> — o'chirish, <code>port-forward</code> — lokal portni pod/servisga tunnel qilish.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Debug'ning 90%i shu yettita buyruq bilan qilinadi. Tartib odatda: <code>get</code> (nima noto'g'ri?) -&gt; <code>describe</code> (nega?) -&gt; <code>logs</code> (ilova nima deydi?) -&gt; <code>exec</code>/<code>port-forward</code> (ichidan tekshirish).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide             # STATUS, RESTARTS, NODE<br>kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase!=Running<br>kubectl describe pod api-7d9f -n prod        # pastdagi Events - sabab shu yerda<br>kubectl logs api-7d9f -c api -n prod --tail=100 -f<br>kubectl logs api-7d9f --previous             # crash bo'lgan OLDINGI konteyner<br>kubectl exec -it api-7d9f -- sh              # ichiga kirish<br>kubectl apply -f k8s/ --dry-run=server       # avval tekshir<br>kubectl diff -f k8s/                         # nima o'zgarishini ko'r<br>kubectl apply -f k8s/<br>kubectl delete -f k8s/old.yaml<br>kubectl port-forward svc/api 8080:80         # localhost:8080 -&gt; servis<br>kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp</pre><p><b>Chiqishni o'qish:</b> <code>get pods</code> da <code>RESTARTS</code> o'sayotgan bo'lsa — crash; <code>READY 0/1</code> — readiness o'tmayapti; <code>describe</code> Events'da <code>FailedScheduling</code>, <code>Back-off pulling image</code>, <code>Liveness probe failed</code> kabi aniq sabablar yoziladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>logs</code> crash'dan keyin yangi (bo'sh) konteynerni ko'rsatadi — <code>--previous</code> unutiladi.</li><li>Distroless image'da <code>sh</code> yo'q — <code>kubectl debug -it pod --image=busybox --target=api</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>kubectl create</code>/<code>edit</code> bilan prod'ni o'zgartirish — Git bilan drift paydo bo'ladi.</li><li><code>-n</code> unutilib noto'g'ri namespace'da qidirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da <code>exec</code> va <code>port-forward</code> RBAC bilan cheklanadi va audit qilinadi. Odatiy o'zgarishlar faqat GitOps orqali; <code>kubectl</code> — o'qish va favqulodda holat uchun.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33113	<p>ConfigMap va Secret nima? Secret haqiqatan maxfiymi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ConfigMap</b> — maxfiy bo'lmagan sozlamalar (URL, feature flag, config fayl). <b>Secret</b> — parol, token, sertifikat. Lekin Secret default holatda faqat <b>base64</b> (shifrlanmagan) — etcd yoki RBAC orqali kirgan har kim o'qiy oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Config'ni image ichiga tiqsak, har muhit (dev/prod) uchun alohida image kerak bo'ladi. ConfigMap/Secret config'ni image'dan ajratadi (12-factor).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ConfigMap/Secret (etcd'da)<br>     |<br>     +--&gt; env var (pod start paytida o'qiladi, keyin o'zgarmaydi)<br>     +--&gt; volume fayl (/etc/api/..., ~1 daqiqada yangilanadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl create configmap api-config --from-literal=LOG_LEVEL=info<br>kubectl create secret generic api-secret --from-literal=DB_PASS=s3cret<br>kubectl get secret api-secret -o jsonpath='{.data.DB_PASS}' | base64 -d   # ochiq ko'rinadi!</pre><pre>containers:<br>  - name: api<br>    envFrom:<br>      - configMapRef: { name: api-config }<br>      - secretRef:    { name: api-secret }<br>    volumeMounts:<br>      - { name: cfg, mountPath: /etc/api, readOnly: true }<br>volumes:<br>  - name: cfg<br>    configMap: { name: api-config }</pre><p><b>Secret'ni haqiqatan himoyalash:</b></p><ul><li>etcd'da encryption at rest: <code>EncryptionConfiguration</code> + KMS provider (managed K8s'da yoqiladi).</li><li>RBAC: <code>get/list secrets</code> huquqini minimal; <code>list</code> ham qiymatni qaytaradi.</li><li>Git'ga oddiy Secret YAML qo'yma — Sealed Secrets, SOPS yoki External Secrets Operator (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Env var o'zgarishi pod restart'siz ko'rinmaydi (<code>kubectl rollout restart</code>).</li><li><code>subPath</code> bilan mount qilingan fayl umuman yangilanmaydi.</li><li>Secret'ni log'ga yoki <code>describe</code> chiqishiga tushirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Config o'zgarishini avtomatik rollout qilish uchun pod template'ga config hash annotatsiyasi qo'yiladi (Helm'da <code>checksum/config</code>). Pod create huquqi bor odam namespace'dagi istalgan Secret'ni mount qila oladi — bu yashirin eskalatsiya yo'li.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33114	<p>Namespace nima va nima uchun ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Namespace — bitta klasterni mantiqiy bo'laklarga ajratish: nomlar to'qnashmaydi, RBAC, ResourceQuota va NetworkPolicy shu chegarada qo'llanadi. Lekin bu <b>xavfsizlik devori emas</b> — default holatda tarmoq ochiq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bir klasterda bir nechta jamoa yoki muhit (dev/staging) bor. Hamma <code>api</code> nomli Deployment yaratadi, bir-birining resursini yeb qo'yadi, bir-birining Secret'ini ko'radi. Namespace ularni ajratadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Klaster<br> +-- ns: team-a  (Role, Quota: 20 CPU, NetworkPolicy)<br> |     api, db-secret<br> +-- ns: team-b<br> |     api   &lt;- nom bir xil, to'qnashuv yo'q<br> +-- cluster-scoped: Node, PV, StorageClass, ClusterRole, Namespace</pre><p>DNS: <code>api.team-a.svc.cluster.local</code> va <code>api.team-b.svc.cluster.local</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl create ns staging<br>kubectl get pods -A                                   # hamma namespace<br>kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=staging<br>kubectl api-resources --namespaced=false              # namespace'siz resurslar</pre><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: ResourceQuota<br>metadata: { name: quota, namespace: staging }<br>spec:<br>  hard: { requests.cpu: &quot;10&quot;, requests.memory: 20Gi, pods: &quot;50&quot; }</pre><p>Standart namespace'lar: <code>default</code>, <code>kube-system</code> (tizim pod'lari), <code>kube-public</code>, <code>kube-node-lease</code> (node heartbeat).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hammasini <code>default</code> ga joylash — RBAC va quota qo'llab bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Namespace o'chirilsa ichidagi <b>hamma narsa</b> (PVC ham) o'chadi.</li><li>Namespace o'chirishda <code>Terminating</code> da qotib qolish — finalizer'li resurs qolgan.</li><li>&quot;Namespace ajratdik, endi xavfsiz&quot; — NetworkPolicy va Pod Security bo'lmasa yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy multi-tenancy (ishonchsiz ijarachilar) uchun namespace yetmaydi — alohida klaster yoki vCluster. Namespace'ga <code>pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted</code> label'i va default-deny NetworkPolicy'ni shablon sifatida qo'yish yaxshi amaliyot.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-2009	<p>Liveness va readiness probe farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Readiness</b> — &quot;pod hozir trafik qabul qila oladimi?&quot;; fail bo'lsa pod Service endpoint'idan chiqariladi, lekin o'ldirilmaydi. <b>Liveness</b> — &quot;jarayon qotib qolganmi?&quot;; fail bo'lsa kubelet konteynerni <b>restart</b> qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova ishga tushgan, lekin hali kesh yuklanmagan — trafik kelsa 5xx. Yoki ilova deadlock'ga tushdi — port ochiq, lekin javob bermaydi. Birinchisiga readiness, ikkinchisiga liveness yechim.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>startupProbe  --(o'tguncha boshqalar o'chiq)--&gt; <br>readiness fail  -&gt; EndpointSlice'dan chiqar (trafik yo'q), pod tirik<br>liveness fail x failureThreshold -&gt; konteyner kill + restart</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>startupProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }<br>  failureThreshold: 30<br>  periodSeconds: 2          # 60s gacha start uchun vaqt<br>readinessProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }<br>  periodSeconds: 5<br>livenessProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }<br>  periodSeconds: 10<br>  failureThreshold: 3<br>  timeoutSeconds: 2</pre><pre>kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -A3 -i probe   # &quot;Readiness probe failed: ...&quot;<br>kubectl get pods            # READY 0/1 = readiness o'tmayapti</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Liveness'da DB tekshirish — DB sekinlashsa hamma pod birdaniga restart, muammo kuchayadi.</li><li>Liveness va readiness'ni bir xil endpoint qilish — vaqtinchalik yuklamada pod o'ldiriladi.</li><li><code>timeoutSeconds</code> (default 1s) juda kichik — GC pauzasida soxta fail.</li><li>Sekin start'ni <code>initialDelaySeconds</code> bilan yechish — <code>startupProbe</code> to'g'riroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Liveness faqat lokal holatni tekshirsin (event loop tirikmi). Readiness'da tashqi bog'liqlikni tekshirish ham ehtiyotkorlik bilan: hamma pod not-ready bo'lsa Service bo'sh qoladi — degrade bo'lib javob berish ko'pincha yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-2010	<p>Pod tez-tez OOMKilled bo'lyapti va latency sakrayapti. Bu manifestda nima muammo?</p><pre>resources:<br>  requests:<br>    cpu: &quot;2&quot;<br>    memory: &quot;2Gi&quot;<br>  limits:<br>    cpu: &quot;2&quot;<br>    memory: &quot;256Mi&quot;</pre>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Manifestda <code>requests.memory: 2Gi</code>, <code>limits.memory: 256Mi</code> — limit request'dan kichik (API buni rad etadi yoki noto'g'ri qiymat yozilgan). Konteyner 256Mi'ga yetishi bilan kernel OOM killer uni o'ldiradi. Latency sakrashi — CPU limit tufayli throttling. Yechim: real o'lchovga ko'ra memory request = limit, CPU limit'ni ehtiyotkor qo'yish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Memory — <b>siqilmaydigan</b> resurs: limitdan oshsa jarayon o'ldiriladi (exit 137). CPU — <b>siqiladigan</b>: limitdan oshsa jarayon o'ldirilmaydi, balki sekinlashtiriladi (throttle) — bu latency sakrashi bo'lib ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>memory: ishlatish --&gt; 256Mi limit --&gt; cgroup OOM --&gt; kill (137) --&gt; restart<br>cpu:    100ms davrda kvota tugadi --&gt; qolgan vaqt kutadi --&gt; p99 latency</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -A5 &quot;Last State&quot;   # Reason: OOMKilled, Exit Code: 137<br>kubectl top pod api-x --containers                    # real ishlatish</pre><p>To'g'rilangan manifest:</p><pre>resources:<br>  requests: { cpu: &quot;500m&quot;, memory: &quot;1Gi&quot; }<br>  limits:   { memory: &quot;1Gi&quot; }     # memory: request = limit<br>  # cpu limit qo'yilmagan yoki request'dan ancha yuqori</pre><p>Qiymatlarni taxmin emas, o'lchov bilan: Prometheus <code>container_memory_working_set_bytes</code> p99 + 20-30% zaxira, yoki VPA recommendation rejimi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Limit &lt; request — mantiqsiz; kubectl validation xato beradi.</li><li>JVM/Go runtime limitni bilmasa heap o'sib ketadi (<code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage</code>, <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code>).</li><li>Restart sonini &quot;normal&quot; deb qabul qilish — har OOM'da so'rovlar yo'qoladi.</li><li>CPU limit juda past — o'rtacha ishlatish 30% bo'lsa ham throttle.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total</code> va OOM event'lariga alert qo'y. Memory request=limit pod'ni node bosimida evict'dan himoyalaydi va oldindan aytib bo'ladigan qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33115	<p>Ingress nima, Ingress Controller'siz ishlaydimi? Gateway API?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Ingress</b> — tashqi HTTP(S) trafikni host/path bo'yicha ichki Service'larga yo'naltirish <b>qoidalari</b> (L7). Qoidalarni bajaradigan narsa — <b>Ingress Controller</b> (ingress-nginx, Traefik, AWS LB Controller). Controller'siz Ingress obyekti hech narsa qilmaydi. <b>Gateway API</b> — Ingress'ning zamonaviy, rollarga bo'lingan vorisi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 10 ta HTTP servis uchun 10 ta LoadBalancer — qimmat va har birida TLS alohida. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33116	<p>PV, PVC, StorageClass qanday bog'langan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>PV</b> (PersistentVolume) — haqiqiy disk resursi. <b>PVC</b> (PersistentVolumeClaim) — pod'ning &quot;menga 20Gi RWO disk kerak&quot; degan so'rovi. <b>StorageClass</b> — PVC kelganda PV'ni <b>dinamik</b> yaratish retsepti (provisioner, disk turi, reclaim policy).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Konteyner fayl tizimi pod o'lganda yo'qoladi. Prod ma'lumot uchun <code>Retain</code>.</li><li><code>Immediate</code> binding — disk a-zonada, pod b-zonaga tushadi -&gt; pod Pending. <code>WaitForFirstConsumer</code> ishlat.</li><li>EBS'da RWX so'rash — hech qachon bind bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PV — backup emas. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33117	<p>Pod holatlari: Pending, CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, OOMKilled — har biri qanday debug qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har holatning o'z dalil manbai bor: <b>Pending</b> va <b>ImagePullBackOff</b> — <code>kubectl describe pod</code> Events; <b>CrashLoopBackOff</b> — <code>kubectl logs --previous</code>; <b>OOMKilled</b> — <code>describe</code> dagi <code>Last State</code> (exit 137) va memory metrikasi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Pod ishlamayapti&quot; — juda keng. Holat nomi qaysi bosqichda sinayotganini aytadi: scheduling, image yuklash, ilova start, yoki runtime resurs.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pending -&gt; (schedule) -&gt; ContainerCreating -&gt; (image pull) -&gt; Running<br>   |                         |                                 |<br> resurs/taint/PVC      ImagePullBackOff              crash -&gt; CrashLoopBackOff<br>                       CreateContainerConfigError    limit -&gt; OOMKilled</pre><p>CrashLoopBackOff — kubelet restart'lar orasidagi kutishni 10s, 20s, 40s... 5 daqiqagacha oshiradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get pods -n prod<br>kubectl describe pod api-x -n prod | sed -n '/Events/,$p'<br>kubectl logs api-x --previous --tail=50<br>kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState}'<br>kubectl get events -n prod --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail</pre><p>| Holat | Qarash | Odatiy sabab | |---|---|---| | Pending | Events: <code>FailedScheduling</code> | CPU/memory yetmaydi, taint, nodeSelector, PVC bind yo'q | | ImagePullBackOff | Events | tag xato, <code>imagePullSecrets</code> yo'q, registry rate limit | | CrashLoopBackOff | <code>logs --previous</code> | env/config xato, DB'ga ulanmadi, liveness juda qattiq | | OOMKilled (137) | <code>Last State</code> | limit kichik, memory leak | | CreateContainerConfigError | Events | ConfigMap/Secret yoki kalit yo'q |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>kubectl logs</code> crash'dan keyin bo'sh — <code>--previous</code> kerak.</li><li>Exit code 137 har doim OOM emas — liveness kill yoki <code>SIGKILL</code> ham bo'lishi mumkin (<code>Reason</code> ni o'qi).</li><li>Pending'da node qo'shish — sabab aslida taint yoki PVC zona bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu holatlarga alert (<code>kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason</code>) qo'y. Exit code 1 — ilova xatosi, 137 — SIGKILL, 143 — SIGTERM; raqamni o'qish birinchi gipotezani beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33118	<p>DaemonSet, Job, CronJob qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>DaemonSet</b> — har (yoki tanlangan) node'da bittadan pod (log agent, node-exporter, CNI). <b>Job</b> — bir marta tugaguncha ishlaydigan vazifa (migratsiya, batch). <b>CronJob</b> — jadval bo'yicha Job yaratadi (har kecha backup).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deployment pod'ni doim ishlab turishga harakat qiladi — tugagan skript qayta-qayta ishga tushadi. Har node'da agent kerak bo'lsa replika sonini qo'lda node soniga tenglab bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>DaemonSet:  node qo'shildi -&gt; unga avtomatik pod<br>Job:        pod -&gt; exit 0 -&gt; Complete (restart yo'q); fail -&gt; backoffLimit gacha qayta<br>CronJob:    &quot;0 3 * * *&quot; -&gt; har kuni 03:00 da yangi Job -&gt; Pod</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: CronJob<br>metadata: { name: backup }<br>spec:<br>  schedule: &quot;0 3 * * *&quot;<br>  timeZone: &quot;Asia/Tashkent&quot;<br>  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid          # oldingisi tugamasa yangisini boshlama<br>  startingDeadlineSeconds: 300<br>  jobTemplate:<br>    spec:<br>      backoffLimit: 3<br>      activeDeadlineSeconds: 600<br>      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400<br>      template:<br>        spec:<br>          restartPolicy: OnFailure<br>          containers:<br>            - name: backup<br>              image: acme/backup:1.0</pre><pre>kubectl get cronjob,job,pods -l job-name<br>kubectl create job --from=cronjob/backup backup-manual   # qo'lda sinash<br>kubectl get ds -A                                        # DESIRED = node soni</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CronJob ba'zan ikki marta ishlaydi yoki o'tkazib yuboriladi — job <b>idempotent</b> bo'lsin.</li><li><code>restartPolicy: Always</code> Job'da ruxsat yo'q.</li><li>Tugagan pod'lar to'planadi — <code>ttlSecondsAfterFinished</code> qo'y.</li><li>DaemonSet control-plane yoki taint'li node'ga tushmaydi — toleration kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Muhim CronJob'larga &quot;oxirgi muvaffaqiyatli ishga tushish&quot; bo'yicha alert qo'y (<code>kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time</code>) — jim fail bo'lgan backup eng xavfli. Katta batch uchun Indexed Job parallelizmni beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33119	<p>Labels, selectors, taints/tolerations va affinity farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Label</b> — obyektga yopishtirilgan <code>key=value</code>; <b>selector</b> — shu label bo'yicha tanlash (Service, Deployment). <b>Taint</b> — node'dagi &quot;begona kirmasin&quot; belgisi; <b>toleration</b> — pod'ning &quot;menga ruxsat&quot; deyishi. <b>Affinity</b> — pod'ni ma'lum node'ga yoki boshqa pod'lar yoniga (yoki uzoqroq) <b>tortish</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> GPU node'larga oddiy pod'lar tushib, joyni egallab olmasin; GPU pod esa aynan GPU node'ga borsin; bir servisning replikalari bitta zonaga to'planmasin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Taint (node: gpu=true:NoSchedule)   -&gt; itaradi (toleration'siz pod kelolmaydi)<br>Toleration (pod)                    -&gt; ruxsat beradi, LEKIN olib bormaydi<br>nodeAffinity (pod)                  -&gt; tortadi (shu label'li node'ga)<br>podAntiAffinity / topologySpread    -&gt; replikalarni tarqatadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl label node n1 gpu=a100<br>kubectl taint node n1 gpu=true:NoSchedule<br>kubectl get pods -l app=api,env=prod     # selector</pre><pre>tolerations:<br>  - { key: gpu, operator: Exists, effect: NoSchedule }<br>affinity:<br>  nodeAffinity:<br>    requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:<br>      nodeSelectorTerms:<br>        - matchExpressions: [{ key: gpu, operator: In, values: [&quot;a100&quot;] }]<br>topologySpreadConstraints:<br>  - maxSkew: 1<br>    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone<br>    whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule<br>    labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat toleration qo'yish — pod istalgan node'ga tushishi mumkin; affinity ham kerak.</li><li><code>required</code> affinity juda qattiq — node bo'lmasa pod abadiy Pending. <code>preferred</code> yumshoqroq.</li><li><code>NoExecute</code> taint mavjud pod'larni ham haydab chiqaradi.</li><li><code>IgnoredDuringExecution</code> — label keyin o'zgarsa ishlab turgan pod ko'chmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p replikali servislar uchun <code>topologySpreadConstraints</code> (zona + hostname) podAntiAffinity'dan arzonroq va bashoratliroq. Dedicated node pool = taint + affinity juftligi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33120	<p>HPA qanday ishlaydi va requests nega shart?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HPA (HorizontalPodAutoscaler) har ~15 soniyada metrikani o'qib, replika sonini formula bilan hisoblaydi: <code>kerakli = ceil(hozirgi * joriy_qiymat / maqsad)</code>. CPU utilization <b>request'ga nisbatan</b> foizda hisoblanadi — request bo'lmasa foiz hisoblanmaydi va HPA ishlamaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kunduzi 10 replika kerak, kechasi 2. Qo'lda skale qilish kech va qimmat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>metrics-server (kubelet'dan) --&gt; HPA controller<br>  4 pod, o'rtacha CPU = 140% (request'ga nisbatan), maqsad 70%<br>  kerakli = ceil(4 * 140/70) = 8<br>  --&gt; Deployment.spec.replicas = 8</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: autoscaling/v2<br>kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }<br>  minReplicas: 3<br>  maxReplicas: 20<br>  metrics:<br>    - type: Resource<br>      resource: { name: cpu, target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 70 } }<br>  behavior:<br>    scaleDown:<br>      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300</pre><pre>kubectl get hpa api          # TARGETS: 45%/70% ; &lt;unknown&gt; = metrika yo'q<br>kubectl describe hpa api     # nega skale qildi/qilmadi<br>kubectl top pods</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>TARGETS &lt;unknown&gt;</code> — metrics-server yo'q yoki container'da <code>requests.cpu</code> yo'q.</li><li>Deployment YAML'da <code>replicas:</code> va HPA birga — har <code>apply</code> HPA qiymatini qayta yozadi; GitOps'da <code>replicas</code> ni olib tashla.</li><li>HPA pod qo'shadi, lekin node yetmasa pod Pending — Cluster Autoscaler/Karpenter kerak.</li><li>I/O-bound servisda CPU signal emas — KEDA (queue lag, RPS).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi pod start vaqti (image pull + warmup) HPA reaksiyasini belgilaydi — sekin start'da maqsadni pastroq (60%) qo'yib zaxira qoldir. Scale-down'ni sekin, scale-up'ni tez qil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33121	<p>RBAC: Role, ClusterRole, RoleBinding, ServiceAccount qanday bog'langan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Role</b> — namespace ichidagi ruxsatlar ro'yxati (qaysi resursga qaysi verb). <b>ClusterRole</b> — klaster bo'yicha yoki qayta ishlatiladigan Role. <b>RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding</b> — Role'ni subject'ga (User, Group, <b>ServiceAccount</b>) bog'laydi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-33122	<p>NetworkPolicy nima? Default holatda pod'lar bir-biri bilan gaplasha oladimi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> NetworkPolicy — pod'lar orasidagi L3/L4 trafikni label bo'yicha cheklovchi firewall qoidasi. <b>Default holatda hamma pod hamma pod bilan gaplasha oladi</b> (namespace'lar orasida ham). Qoida faqat CNI qo'llab-quvvatlasa ishlaydi (Calico, Cilium; oddiy flannel — yo'q).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Frontend pod buzib kirilsa, u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri DB'ga ulanishi mumkin. Zero-trust: DB'ga faqat api pod'lari kira olsin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Policy tanlamagan pod   -&gt; hammasi ochiq<br>Policy tanlagan pod     -&gt; faqat ruxsat berilgan trafik (whitelist)<br>Bir nechta policy       -&gt; ruxsatlar qo'shiladi (OR)<br><br> web --X--&gt; db:5432<br> api ------&gt; db:5432   (ruxsat)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> avval default-deny, keyin ruxsatlar.</p><pre>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: default-deny, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: {}<br>  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]<br>---<br>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: db-allow-api, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: db } }<br>  policyTypes: [Ingress]<br>  ingress:<br>    - from: [{ podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } } }]<br>      ports: [{ port: 5432 }]<br>---<br># DNS ga ruxsat (egress deny bo'lsa shart)<br>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: allow-dns, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: {}<br>  policyTypes: [Egress]<br>  egress:<br>    - to: [{ namespaceSelector: {}, podSelector: { matchLabels: { k8s-app: kube-dns } } }]<br>      ports: [{ port: 53, protocol: UDP }, { port: 53, protocol: TCP }]</pre><pre>kubectl get netpol -n prod<br>kubectl exec -it web-x -- nc -zv db 5432   # timeout = bloklandi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CNI qo'llamasa policy jimgina e'tiborsiz qoladi.</li><li>Egress deny'da DNS unutiladi — hamma narsa &quot;ishlamay qoladi&quot;.</li><li><code>from</code> ichida <code>namespaceSelector</code> va <code>podSelector</code> bitta element (AND) vs ikki element (OR) — farqi katta.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Standart NetworkPolicy L7 (HTTP path) va FQDN bilmaydi — Cilium/Calico kengaytmalari kerak. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-2011	<p>Rolling update paytidagi qisqa uzilishlarni qanday mexanizmlar birgalikda yopadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kerakli to'plam: <b>readinessProbe</b> (yangi pod tayyor bo'lmaguncha trafik olmasin) + <b>preStop hook va graceful shutdown</b> (eski pod so'rovlarni tugatib keyin yopilsin) + <code>maxUnavailable: 0</code> (sig'im kamaymasin) + <b>PodDisruptionBudget</b> (drain'da hammasi birga ketmasin).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Rolling update ikki joyda uziladi: (1) yangi pod ishga tushdi, lekin hali tayyor emas — trafik oldi -&gt; Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-30026	<p>Go servisga <code>limits.memory: 512Mi</code> qo'yilgan, OOMKilled bo'lyapti. To'g'ri chora?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Go runtime konteyner memory limitini bilmaydi: GC heap'ni <code>GOGC=100</code> bo'yicha ikki baravar o'sishiga ruxsat beradi va 512Mi'dan oshib OOMKill bo'ladi. Chora: <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> ni limitdan ~10-20% past (masalan <code>450MiB</code>) qo'yish — GC limitga yaqinlashganda tez-tez ishlaydi. Parallel ravishda pprof heap profili bilan haqiqiy leak bormi tekshirish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Live heap 300Mi bo'lsa, GOGC=100 da keyingi GC 600Mi'da boshlanadi — limitdan oshdi. Yoki haqiqiy leak (goroutine, cheklanmagan kesh) — u holda GOMEMLIMIT faqat GC'ni &quot;o'ldiradi&quot; (CPU 100%) va muammoni yashiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>heap  ^<br>512Mi |---------------------------- cgroup limit (OOM)<br>450Mi |- - - - - - - - - - - - - - GOMEMLIMIT (GC shu yerda tezlashadi)<br>      |    /\    /\    /\<br>      |   /  \  /  \  /  \   &lt;- GC tsikllari<br>      +----------------------&gt; vaqt</pre><p>GOMEMLIMIT — soft limit: Go uni hurmat qiladi, lekin live heap undan katta bo'lsa baribir oshadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>env:<br>  - name: GOMEMLIMIT<br>    valueFrom:<br>      resourceFieldRef: { resource: limits.memory, divisor: &quot;1&quot; }  # yoki aniq &quot;450MiB&quot;<br>resources:<br>  requests: { memory: 512Mi }<br>  limits:   { memory: 512Mi }</pre><p>Kodda: <code>debug.SetMemoryLimit(int64(float64(limit) * 0.85))</code> yoki <code>KimMachineGun/automemlimit</code> kutubxonasi.</p><pre>kubectl port-forward pod/api-x 6060<br>go tool pprof -top http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap<br>curl -s localhost:6060/debug/pprof/goroutine?debug=1 | head   # goroutine leak?</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>GOMEMLIMIT'ni limitga teng qo'yish — goroutine stack, cgo, mmap heap'dan tashqarida; zaxira kerak.</li><li>Leak'ni GOMEMLIMIT bilan yashirish — GC death spiral, CPU throttle, latency.</li><li><code>container_memory_usage_bytes</code> page cache'ni ham sanaydi — <code>working_set</code> ga qara.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Go 1.25+ <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> ni cgroup CPU limitiga avtomatik moslaydi; eski versiyalarda <code>automaxprocs</code> kerak. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-30027	<p>CPU <code>limits</code> qo'yilgan podda p99 latency portlaydi, CPU ishlatish esa 40%. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-30261	<p><code>requests</code> va <code>limits</code> farqi va QoS klasslariga ta'siri?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>requests</code> — scheduler pod'ni joylashtirishda hisoblaydigan <b>kafolatlangan</b> miqdor. <code>limits</code> — yuqori chegara: CPU'da oshsa throttle, memory'da oshsa OOMKill. QoS klassi shulardan kelib chiqadi: <b>Guaranteed</b> (har konteynerda requests = limits, CPU va memory) — eng oxirida evict; <b>Burstable</b> (kamida bitta request) — o'rtada; <b>BestEffort</b> (hech narsa yo'q) — birinchi evict.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Node'da memory tugasa kubelet kimnidir chiqarib yuborishi kerak. QoS va &quot;request'dan qancha oshgan&quot; degan mezon kim birinchi ketishini belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Scheduling:  node allocatable - sum(requests) &gt;= pod requests ?  (limits hisobga olinmaydi)<br>Runtime:     cpu &gt; limit    -&gt; throttle<br>             mem &gt; limit    -&gt; OOMKill (konteyner)<br>Node bosimi: BestEffort -&gt; Burstable (request'dan ko'p oshgani) -&gt; Guaranteed</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resources:<br>  requests: { cpu: &quot;500m&quot;, memory: &quot;1Gi&quot; }<br>  limits:   { memory: &quot;1Gi&quot; }        # Burstable (cpu limit yo'q)</pre><pre>kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.qosClass}'<br>kubectl describe node n1 | sed -n '/Allocated resources/,/Events/p'   # overcommit ko'rinadi</pre><p>| QoS | Shart | Evict tartibi | |---|---|---| | Guaranteed | requests = limits (cpu+mem, hamma konteyner) | oxirgi | | Burstable | kamida bitta request/limit | o'rta | | BestEffort | hech narsa | birinchi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Request'siz pod — scheduler uni to'la node'ga ham joylaydi, HPA ishlamaydi.</li><li>Requests juda katta — node'lar bo'sh turadi, pul yonadi.</li><li>Memory limit request'dan ancha katta — node overcommit, bosimda ommaviy evict.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amaliy siyosat: memory request = limit (bashoratli), CPU request aniq, CPU limit yo'q yoki keng. Qiymatlarni VPA recommendation yoki Prometheus p95 bilan muntazam qayta ko'rib chiq — bu klaster xarajatining asosiy dastagi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes

Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-34089	<p>Kubernetes &quot;desired state&quot; va reconciliation loop nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Desired state</b> — siz YAML'da yozgan &quot;qanday bo'lishi kerak&quot; (masalan 3 ta replika). <b>Reconciliation loop</b> — controller'ning to'xtovsiz sikli: haqiqiy holatni kuzatadi, desired bilan solishtiradi va farqni yo'qotish uchun harakat qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Imperativ yondashuv (&quot;3 ta konteyner ishga tushir&quot;) bir martalik — biri o'lsa hech kim sezmaydi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::I1 Kubernetes	idrill-34091	<p>Liveness va readiness probe ostida nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubelet probe'ni belgilangan oraliqda bajaradi (HTTP GET, TCP ulanish, <code>exec</code> buyruq yoki gRPC). <b>Readiness</b> fail bo'lsa pod Service'dan chiqariladi (trafik kelmaydi, pod tirik). <b>Liveness</b> fail bo'lsa konteyner restart qilinadi. <b>Startup</b> probe o'tmaguncha qolgan ikkalasi ishlamaydi — sekin start'li ilovani himoya qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Konteyner jarayoni ishlayapti, lekin ilova (a) hali tayyor emas (kesh yuklanmoqda) yoki (b) qotib qolgan (deadlock). K8s buni o'zi bilmaydi — ilova aytishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubelet har periodSeconds'da:<br>  GET /ready  -&gt; 200..399 = OK, boshqa / timeout = fail<br>  fail ketma-ket failureThreshold marta:<br>    readiness -&gt; pod NotReady -&gt; EndpointSlice'dan chiqadi<br>    liveness  -&gt; konteyner kill -&gt; restartPolicy bo'yicha qayta start<br>  success successThreshold marta -&gt; yana Ready</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>startupProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /health, port: 8080 }<br>  periodSeconds: 2<br>  failureThreshold: 30       # 60s gacha start uchun<br>readinessProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }<br>  periodSeconds: 5<br>livenessProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /health, port: 8080 }<br>  periodSeconds: 10<br>  timeoutSeconds: 2<br>  failureThreshold: 3</pre><pre>kubectl get pods                       # READY 0/1 -&gt; readiness o'tmayapti<br>kubectl describe pod web-x | grep -i probe<br># Warning Unhealthy  Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 503</pre><p>Ilovada: <code>/health</code> — faqat &quot;jarayon javob beryapti&quot;; <code>/ready</code> — &quot;DB ulangan, kesh yuklangan&quot;.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Liveness'da DB tekshirish — DB tushsa hamma pod restart loop'ga tushadi.</li><li><code>timeoutSeconds</code> default 1s — yuklamada soxta fail.</li><li>Startup probe yo'q, ilova 60s'da ko'tariladi — liveness uni ko'tarilmasdan o'ldiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Probe'lar kubelet'dan keladi — tarmoq/LB yo'lini tekshirmaydi. Shutdown paytida <code>/ready</code> ni darhol 503 qilish trafikni tezroq olib tashlashga yordam beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::i1 Kubernetes
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33261	<p>Kubernetes arxitekturasi: control plane va worker node komponentlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes ikki qismdan iborat: <b>control plane</b> (qaror qabul qiladigan &quot;miya&quot;: kube-apiserver, etcd, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager, ixtiyoriy cloud-controller-manager) va <b>worker node</b>'lar (ish bajaradigan &quot;qo'l&quot;: kubelet, container runtime, kube-proxy yoki uning eBPF o'rnini bosuvchisi).</p><p><b>Nega shunday bo'lingan:</b> siz &quot;3 ta nginx ishlasin&quot; deb <b>desired state</b> yozasiz. Kimdir buni saqlashi (etcd), kimdir qaysi node'ga qo'yishni hal qilishi (scheduler), kimdir doim tekshirib turib farqni tuzatishi (controller) va kimdir node'da haqiqatan container'ni ishga tushirishi (kubelet) kerak. Har vazifa alohida komponent — biri yiqilsa, qolganlari ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubectl apply<br>     |<br>     v<br>+------------------- control plane -------------------+<br>|  kube-apiserver  &lt;----&gt;  etcd (yagona holat bazasi) |<br>|     ^       ^                                       |<br>|     |       +---- kube-scheduler (pod -&gt; node)      |<br>|     +------------ controller-manager (reconcile)    |<br>+-----|-----------------------------------------------+<br>      | watch / status<br>      v<br>+---- worker node (x N) ------------------------------+<br>| kubelet -&gt; containerd (CRI) -&gt; container'lar         |<br>| kube-proxy / Cilium -&gt; Service trafigi              |<br>+-----------------------------------------------------+</pre><p>Muhim qoida: <b>hamma faqat apiserver bilan gaplashadi</b>. etcd'ga to'g'ridan faqat apiserver yozadi. Scheduler va controller'lar apiserver'ni *watch* qilib, o'zgarishga reaksiya qiladi (reconcile loop).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get nodes -o wide                 # node'lar, runtime versiyasi<br>kubectl get pods -n kube-system           # control plane pod'lari (kubeadm'da)<br>kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'       # apiserver ichki tekshiruvlari<br>kubectl describe node worker-1 | grep -A5 Conditions</pre><p><code>/readyz</code> chiqishida har bir check <code>[+]ok</code> bo'lishi kerak; <code>[-]etcd failed</code> — apiserver etcd'ga ulana olmayapti.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>etcd'ni &quot;oddiy DB&quot; deb o'ylab zaxiralamaslik — u yo'qolsa cluster holati yo'qoladi.</li><li>Control plane'da workload ishlatish (taint olib tashlash) — resurs talashi apiserver'ni sekinlashtiradi.</li><li>Managed cluster (EKS/GKE/AKS)'da control plane ko'rinmaydi — bu &quot;yo'q&quot; degani emas, provider boshqaradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Arxitekturaning asosiy g'oyasi — level-triggered reconcile: controller &quot;nima o'zgardi&quot; emas, &quot;hozir qanday va qanday bo'lishi kerak&quot; deb qaraydi. Shu sabab tizim o'zini tiklaydi, lekin apiserver/etcd yagona tor joy — ularning sog'lig'i va latency'si (etcd fsync) butun cluster sog'lig'i.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33262	<p>Deployment manifestini qanday yozasiz? Asosiy maydonlar?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Deployment manifestida asosiylari: <code>apiVersion: apps/v1</code>, <code>kind</code>, <code>metadata</code>, <code>spec.replicas</code>, <code>spec.selector</code>, <code>spec.template</code> (pod shabloni: label'lar, container'lar, image, port, resurs, probe). <code>selector</code> bilan <code>template.metadata.labels</code> mos bo'lishi shart.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> pod'ni qo'lda yaratsangiz, u o'lsa hech kim qayta ko'tarmaydi. Deployment -&gt; ReplicaSet -&gt; Pod zanjiri replika sonini ushlab turadi va versiyalarni rolling update qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Deployment (api)          strategiya, tarix<br>   |<br>   v<br>ReplicaSet (api-7c9f)     aniq pod-template hash<br>   |<br>   v<br>Pod x3                    label app=api</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: apps/v1<br>kind: Deployment<br>metadata:<br>  name: api<br>  labels: { app: api }<br>spec:<br>  replicas: 3<br>  selector:<br>    matchLabels: { app: api }        # qaysi pod'lar &quot;meniki&quot;<br>  template:<br>    metadata:<br>      labels: { app: api }           # selector bilan bir xil!<br>    spec:<br>      containers:<br>      - name: api<br>        image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0   # aniq tag, latest emas<br>        ports: [{ containerPort: 8080 }]<br>        resources:<br>          requests: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }<br>          limits:   { memory: 256Mi }<br>        readinessProbe:<br>          httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }</pre><pre>kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f api.yaml   # schema + admission tekshiruvi<br>kubectl diff -f api.yaml                     # clusterdagidan farqi<br>kubectl apply -f api.yaml &amp;&amp; kubectl rollout status deploy/api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>spec.selector</code> immutable — keyin o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi, Deployment'ni qayta yaratish kerak.</li><li>Selector va template label mos kelmasa — apply xato beradi.</li><li><code>resources</code> yo'q — pod BestEffort bo'ladi, birinchi evict qilinadi.</li><li><code>readinessProbe</code> yo'q — tayyor bo'lmagan pod trafik oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Manifestni Helm/Kustomize bilan generatsiya qilsangiz ham, CI'da <code>kubeconform</code> + <code>--dry-run=server</code> bilan tekshiring: xato cluster'ga yetib bormasdan ushlansin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33263	<p><code>kubectl rollout</code> bilan deploy, status va rollback qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yangi image'ni <code>kubectl set image</code> yoki <code>kubectl apply</code> bilan berasiz, <code>kubectl rollout status</code> bilan kutasiz, muammo bo'lsa <code>kubectl rollout undo</code> bilan oldingi ReplicaSet'ga qaytasiz.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> deploy — bu bir lahzalik hodisa emas, jarayon: yangi pod'lar ko'tariladi, Ready bo'ladi, eski pod'lar o'chadi. Bu jarayonni kuzatish va yomon chiqsa tez qaytarish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> har template o'zgarishi yangi ReplicaSet yaratadi; eskilari <code>replicas: 0</code> bilan saqlanadi (<code>revisionHistoryLimit</code>, default 10). <code>undo</code> — oldingi ReplicaSet'ni qayta kattalashtirish.</p><pre>rev1 RS (0)   rev2 RS (0)   rev3 RS (3)  &lt;- hozirgi<br>                    ^<br>          rollout undo --to-revision=2</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl set image deploy/api api=ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0<br>kubectl annotate deploy/api kubernetes.io/change-cause=&quot;v1.5.0 release&quot;<br>kubectl rollout status deploy/api --timeout=5m   # exit code != 0 bo'lsa CI to'xtaydi<br>kubectl rollout history deploy/api<br>kubectl rollout undo deploy/api                  # oldingi revision<br>kubectl rollout undo deploy/api --to-revision=3<br>kubectl rollout restart deploy/api               # ConfigMap o'zgargach pod'larni yangilash<br>kubectl rollout pause deploy/api                 # bir nechta o'zgarishni yig'ish<br>kubectl rollout resume deploy/api</pre><p><code>rollout status</code> &quot;Waiting for deployment ... 1 of 3 updated replicas are available&quot; deb tursa — yangi pod Ready bo'lmayapti, <code>kubectl get pods</code> va <code>describe</code> ga qarang.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>progressDeadlineSeconds</code> (default 600) o'tsa Deployment <code>ProgressDeadlineExceeded</code> bo'ladi, lekin <b>avtomatik rollback qilmaydi</b>.</li><li>GitOps (Argo CD/Flux) ishlatilsa, <code>undo</code> vaqtinchalik — controller Git'dagi holatni qaytarib yozadi. Rollback = <code>git revert</code>.</li><li><code>--record</code> flag deprecated; change-cause'ni annotation bilan yozing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'da <code>rollout status</code> timeout'i bilan deploy'ni &quot;tugadi&quot; deb belgilang va xato bo'lsa avtomatik undo qiling; avtomatik metrikaga asoslangan rollback uchun Argo Rollouts/Flagger ishlating.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33264	<p>Helm nima: chart, release, values?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Helm — Kubernetes uchun paket menejer. <b>Chart</b> — shablonlangan manifestlar paketi, <b>values</b> — shablonga beriladigan sozlamalar, <b>release</b> — chart'ning cluster'ga o'rnatilgan aniq nusxasi (nomi va revision tarixi bilan).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> bitta ilova dev/stage/prod'da 90% bir xil, 10% farqli (replika, domen, resurs). 3 ta nusxa YAML saqlash o'rniga bitta shablon + 3 ta values fayli. Plus — install/upgrade/rollback bitta buyruq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>chart/ (templates + values.yaml)<br>       +  -f values-prod.yaml  +  --set image.tag=1.5.0<br>       |<br>       v<br>   helm template renderer (Go template)<br>       |<br>       v<br>   tayyor YAML -&gt; apiserver<br>       |<br>   release &quot;api&quot; rev N (Secret sifatida namespace'da saqlanadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami<br>helm show values bitnami/redis &gt; redis-values.yaml<br>helm upgrade --install api ./chart -n prod --create-namespace \<br>  -f values-prod.yaml --set image.tag=1.5.0 --atomic --timeout 5m<br>helm list -n prod<br>helm history api -n prod<br>helm rollback api 3 -n prod<br>helm template api ./chart -f values-prod.yaml | less   # nima chiqishini ko'rish</pre><p><code>--atomic</code> — upgrade muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa avtomatik rollback.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Helm 2 (Tiller) — eskirgan va xavfli edi; bugun faqat Helm 3.</li><li><code>--set</code> bilan ko'p qiymat berish — tarix yo'qoladi; values faylini Git'da saqlang.</li><li>Release holati namespace'dagi Secret'da (<code>sh.helm.release.v1.*</code>) — uni o'chirsangiz Helm release'ni &quot;unutadi&quot;.</li><li>Kimdir <code>kubectl edit</code> qilsa, Helm 3-way merge ba'zan kutilmagan natija beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Chart'larni OCI registry'da versiyalab saqlang (<code>helm push oci://...</code>), GitOps bilan birga ishlating: Helm render qiladi, Argo CD/Flux apply va drift'ni boshqaradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33265	<p>Kustomize nima va Helm'dan farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kustomize — shablonsiz, <b>overlay/patch</b> asosidagi vosita: oddiy YAML base + muhitga xos patch'lar. <code>kubectl apply -k</code> ichiga o'rnatilgan. Helm esa shablon (Go template) + paket menejer (versiya, release, rollback, hook).</p><p><b>Nega ikkalasi bor:</b> Helm kuchli, lekin shablon ichida <code>{{ if }}</code> lar ko'paysa YAML o'qib bo'lmaydigan holga keladi. Muhim — tanlov bitta bo'lsin va CI'da render natijasi tekshirilsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33266	<p>Init container va sidecar container nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Init container</b> asosiy container'dan oldin ketma-ket ishlaydi va muvaffaqiyatli tugashi shart (migratsiya, kutish, fayl tayyorlash). <b>Sidecar</b> asosiy container bilan parallel butun umr ishlaydi (log shipper, proxy, cert yangilovchi). K8s 1.29+ da native sidecar: <code>initContainers</code> ichida <code>restartPolicy: Always</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> ilova DB tayyor bo'lmasdan ko'tarilib crash qiladi, yoki har ilovaga log yuborish kodini yozish kerak. Init container tartibni kafolatlaydi, sidecar esa umumiy funksiyani ilovadan ajratadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod start:<br> init-1 (tugadi) -&gt; init-2 (tugadi) -&gt; [sidecar (native) start]<br>                                         |<br>                                         v<br>                                   app container start<br>Pod stop: app to'xtaydi -&gt; keyin sidecar to'xtaydi (native)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  initContainers:<br>  - name: wait-db<br>    image: busybox:1.36<br>    command: [&quot;sh&quot;,&quot;-c&quot;,&quot;until nc -z db 5432; do sleep 2; done&quot;]<br>  - name: log-shipper            # native sidecar (1.29+ beta, default on)<br>    image: fluent/fluent-bit:3.1<br>    restartPolicy: Always<br>    volumeMounts: [{ name: logs, mountPath: /logs }]<br>  containers:<br>  - name: app<br>    image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0<br>    volumeMounts: [{ name: logs, mountPath: /logs }]<br>  volumes:<br>  - name: logs<br>    emptyDir: {}</pre><pre>kubectl get pod api-x   # STATUS: Init:0/2 -&gt; init kutilyapti<br>kubectl logs api-x -c wait-db</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski usuldagi sidecar (oddiy <code>containers</code> ichida) Job'ni tugatmaydi — Job pod'i abadiy Running qoladi. Native sidecar buni hal qiladi.</li><li>Init container crash'da butun pod qayta boshlanadi; idempotent yozing.</li><li>Init'da migratsiya qilish — 10 replika = 10 parallel migratsiya. Migratsiyani alohida Job'da qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sidecar har pod'ga CPU/memory narx qo'shadi (1000 pod x 50Mi = 50Gi). Shu sabab service mesh'lar sidecar'siz (Istio Ambient) yo'lga o'tmoqda; sidecar'ni faqat haqiqatan pod'ga bog'liq vazifa uchun ishlating.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33306	<p>kubeconfig, context va namespace bilan qanday ishlaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> kubeconfig (<code>~/.kube/config</code>) — cluster'lar, user (credential)lar va ularni bog'lovchi <b>context</b>'lar ro'yxati. Context = cluster + user + default namespace. <code>kubectl config use-context</code> bilan almashtiriladi, namespace <code>-n</code> yoki context'ga yozib qo'yiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> dev, stage, prod cluster'lari bitta noutbukda. Noto'g'ri context'da <code>kubectl delete</code> — eng ko'p uchraydigan incident sababi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>clusters:  [dev-eks, prod-eks]        (server URL + CA)<br>users:     [dev-sso, prod-sso]        (token / exec plugin)<br>contexts:  dev  = dev-eks  + dev-sso  + ns=team-a<br>           prod = prod-eks + prod-sso + ns=default<br>current-context: dev</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl config get-contexts             # * hozirgisi<br>kubectl config current-context<br>kubectl config use-context prod<br>kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=payments<br>KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/dev:~/.kube/prod kubectl config view --flatten &gt; ~/.kube/config<br>aws eks update-kubeconfig --name prod --alias prod   # EKS<br># tezkor: kubectx / kubens (krew)<br>kubectx prod &amp;&amp; kubens payments</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prod context default bo'lib qolishi. Zamonaviy usul — <code>exec</code> plugin (aws, gke-gcloud-auth-plugin, kubelogin) qisqa muddatli token bilan.</li><li><code>chmod 600 ~/.kube/config</code> — boshqa userlar o'qimasin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'ga yozish huquqi odamlarda minimal bo'lsin: o'zgarish GitOps orqali, odam faqat read-only yoki vaqtinchalik (just-in-time) break-glass rolini oladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33307	<p>Imperative (<code>kubectl create/run</code>) va declarative (<code>kubectl apply -f</code>) farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Imperative</b> — &quot;buni qil&quot; buyruqlari (<code>kubectl create</code>, <code>run</code>, <code>scale</code>, <code>set image</code>): tez, lekin izi qolmaydi. <b>Declarative</b> — &quot;shunday bo'lsin&quot; (<code>kubectl apply -f</code>): holat faylda, Git'da, takrorlanadi va review qilinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> kimdir prod'da <code>kubectl scale --replicas=10</code> qildi, keyin boshqasi eski YAML'ni apply qildi — 3 ga qaytdi. Kim, nega, qachon — noma'lum.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Imperative:  odam --buyruq--&gt; apiserver   (holat faqat cluster'da)<br>Declarative: Git (YAML) --apply/GitOps--&gt; apiserver<br>             apply = diff(last-applied, fayl, live) -&gt; patch</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Imperative — o'rganish, debug, tez sinov<br>kubectl run tmp --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 -- sh<br>kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx:1.27<br><br># Imperative'dan YAML skeleti olish (eng foydali usul)<br>kubectl create deployment api --image=ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0 \<br>  --dry-run=client -o yaml &gt; deploy.yaml<br><br># Declarative<br>kubectl diff -f deploy.yaml<br>kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml<br>kubectl apply -f k8s/ --prune -l app=api   # ehtiyot bilan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>kubectl create -f</code> (imperative object config) va <code>apply -f</code> ni aralashtirish — <code>last-applied-configuration</code> annotation yo'q bo'lib, keyingi apply ogohlantirish beradi.</li><li><code>kubectl edit</code> prod'da — drift: Git va cluster farq qiladi.</li><li><code>--prune</code> noto'g'ri label bilan kerakli resurslarni o'chirib yuborishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: imperative — faqat o'qish va favqulodda holat; har qanday favqulodda o'zgarishdan keyin Git'ga ham yoziladi. GitOps controller drift'ni o'zi qaytaradi — bu imperative o'zgarishlarni &quot;yo'qotadi&quot;, shuning uchun jamoa buni bilishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33308	<p>Label va annotation farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Label</b> — tanlash (select) uchun qisqa key/value: Service, Deployment selector, <code>kubectl get -l</code> ular bo'yicha ishlaydi. <b>Annotation</b> — tanlanmaydigan metadata: tool'lar uchun konfiguratsiya, izoh, katta matn (Ingress sozlamalari, change-cause, Prometheus scrape).</p><p><b>Nega farqlanadi:</b> label'lar indekslanadi va filtrlashda ishlatiladi, shuning uchun qat'iy cheklangan (qiymat &lt;= 63 belgi). Annotation'ga esa JSON ham sig'adi (jami 256KB gacha), lekin u bo'yicha selector qila olmaysiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Service selector app=api  ----tanlaydi----&gt;  Pod labels {app: api, tier: backend}<br>Ingress controller        ----o'qiydi-----&gt;  annotations {nginx.ingress.../proxy-body-size: 20m}</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>metadata:<br>  labels:<br>    app.kubernetes.io/name: api<br>    app.kubernetes.io/version: &quot;1.5.0&quot;<br>    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: shop<br>    team: payments<br>  annotations:<br>    kubernetes.io/change-cause: &quot;v1.5.0: yangi checkout&quot;<br>    prometheus.io/scrape: &quot;true&quot;</pre><pre>kubectl get pods -l 'app.kubernetes.io/name=api,team in (payments)'<br>kubectl label pod api-x debug=true<br>kubectl label pod api-x debug-             # olib tashlash<br>kubectl annotate deploy api owner=team-payments<br>kubectl get pods -L team                   # label'ni ustun qilib ko'rsatish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Service selector'idagi label'ni pod'dan olib tashlasangiz — pod trafikdan chiqadi (debug uchun foydali hiyla ham).</li><li>Label qiymatiga commit SHA yoki tez o'zgaruvchi narsa yozish — Deployment selector'ga tushsa, immutable bo'lib qoladi.</li><li>Annotation'ga secret yozish — hamma ko'radi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tavsiya etilgan <code>app.kubernetes.io/*</code> label'larini standart qiling: monitoring, cost allocation (Kubecost), NetworkPolicy va policy engine'lar (Kyverno) shu label'larga tayanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33309	<p><code>kubectl get</code> natijasini qanday kengaytirib o'qiysiz: <code>-o wide</code>, <code>-o yaml</code>, <code>-w</code>, <code>explain</code>?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>-o wide</code> — qo'shimcha ustunlar (node, IP), <code>-o yaml</code> — to'liq obyekt (spec + status), <code>-w</code> — o'zgarishlarni jonli kuzatish, <code>kubectl explain</code> — maydon hujjati to'g'ridan cluster schema'sidan.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> oddiy <code>kubectl get</code> faqat yuzaki holatni beradi. &quot;Pod qaysi node'da?&quot;, &quot;nega Pending?&quot;, &quot;bu maydon nima degani?&quot; — chuqurroq ko'rish kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get pods -o wide                  # IP, NODE, NOMINATED NODE<br>kubectl get pod api-x -o yaml | less      # status.conditions, containerStatuses<br>kubectl get pods -w                       # Ctrl+C gacha o'zgarishlar<br>kubectl get pods --show-labels<br>kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.nodeName}'<br>kubectl get pods -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount<br>kubectl get pods --sort-by=.status.startTime<br>kubectl get pods --field-selector=status.phase!=Running -A<br>kubectl explain deployment.spec.strategy.rollingUpdate<br>kubectl explain pod.spec.containers --recursive | less<br>kubectl api-resources                     # qisqa nomlar (deploy, svc, cm)</pre><p><b>O'qish:</b> <code>-o yaml</code> da avval <code>status.conditions</code> (Ready/False va <code>reason</code>), keyin <code>containerStatuses[].state</code> / <code>lastState</code> (<code>terminated.reason: OOMKilled</code>, <code>exitCode</code>) ga qarang.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-o yaml</code> natijasini to'g'ridan qayta apply qilish — <code>status</code>, <code>resourceVersion</code>, <code>uid</code> kabi maydonlar aralashadi.</li><li><code>-w</code> faqat yangi event'larni ko'rsatadi; ulanish uzilsa qayta ishga tushirish kerak.</li><li><code>explain</code> cluster versiyasiga bog'liq — internetdagi hujjat boshqa versiya bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Skript va alert'larda chiroyli chiqish emas, <code>jsonpath</code>/<code>-o json | jq</code> ishlating; <code>kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod -l app=api --timeout=120s</code> sleep'li sikllardan ancha ishonchli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33310	<p>Deployment'ni qo'lda qanday scale qilasiz va bu GitOps bilan qanday to'qnashadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>kubectl scale deploy/api --replicas=5</code> — darhol ishlaydi. Lekin GitOps (Argo CD/Flux) yoki HPA bo'lsa, qo'lda qiymat tez orada qaytarib yoziladi: Git'dagi <code>replicas</code> yoki HPA hisobi g'olib chiqadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> tunda trafik oshdi, on-call qo'lda 10 ga ko'tardi. 3 daqiqadan keyin Argo CD &quot;OutOfSync&quot; deb 3 ga qaytardi — incident kuchaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>odam: replicas=10 --&gt; apiserver<br>                         ^<br>Argo CD (selfHeal) ------+  Git: replicas=3 -&gt; qaytaradi<br>HPA -------------------- +  metrika: kerakli=6 -&gt; o'zgartiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl scale deploy/api --replicas=5<br>kubectl scale deploy/api --replicas=5 --current-replicas=3   # optimistik shart<br>kubectl get hpa api                                          # HPA bormi?</pre><p>HPA ishlatilsa, Git'da <code>replicas</code> maydonini <b>olib tashlang</b>, aks holda har sync HPA bilan urushadi:</p><pre># Argo CD Application<br>spec:<br>  ignoreDifferences:<br>  - group: apps<br>    kind: Deployment<br>    jsonPointers: [/spec/replicas]</pre><p>Favqulodda holat: HPA'ning <code>minReplicas</code>'ini Git orqali (yoki tez PR) ko'taring.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>HPA + Git'dagi <code>replicas</code> — har deploy replikani 3 ga &quot;sakratib&quot; tushiradi.</li><li>Argo CD'da <code>selfHeal</code> o'chiq bo'lsa ham keyingi sync qaytaradi.</li><li>Scale 0 — pod'lar o'chadi, lekin PVC'lar qoladi (StatefulSet).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Replika sonining &quot;egasi&quot; bitta bo'lsin: yo Git, yo HPA. Incident runbook'da &quot;qo'lda scale qilinsa Argo'da auto-sync'ni vaqtincha o'chir va keyin Git'ga yoz&quot; qadamini aniq yozing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33311	<p>Service DNS nomlari qanday tuziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Service DNS: <code>&lt;service&gt;.&lt;namespace&gt;.svc.&lt;cluster-domain&gt;</code> (odatda <code>cluster.local</code>). Masalan <code>db.prod.svc.cluster.local</code>. Bir namespace ichida faqat <code>db</code> yetarli. Headless Service'da har pod: <code>&lt;pod&gt;.&lt;service&gt;.&lt;ns&gt;.svc.cluster.local</code>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> pod IP'lari doim o'zgaradi. Service barqaror nom va virtual IP (ClusterIP) beradi, CoreDNS esa nomni IP'ga aylantiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app pod: &quot;db&quot; ni resolve qil<br>   | /etc/resolv.conf: search prod.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local<br>   v<br>CoreDNS --&gt; db.prod.svc.cluster.local -&gt; 10.96.12.7 (ClusterIP)<br>   |<br>kube-proxy/eBPF: 10.96.12.7 -&gt; pod IP'lardan biri</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl run dns --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 -- sh<br>nslookup db                          # shu namespace<br>nslookup db.prod                     # boshqa namespace<br>nslookup db.prod.svc.cluster.local   # to'liq nom (FQDN)<br>cat /etc/resolv.conf                 # search domain'lar, ndots:5<br># headless (clusterIP: None) — pod IP'lar ro'yxati qaytadi<br>nslookup postgres-headless.prod.svc.cluster.local<br># SRV record: port nomi bilan<br>nslookup -type=SRV _http._tcp.api.prod.svc.cluster.local</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Boshqa namespace'dagi servisga faqat <code>db</code> deb murojaat qilish — <code>NXDOMAIN</code>.</li><li><code>ndots:5</code> sababli <code>api.example.com</code> kabi tashqi nomlar avval search domain'lar bilan sinab ko'riladi — keraksiz DNS so'rovlar. Tashqi nom oxiriga nuqta qo'ying yoki <code>ndots</code>ni kamaytiring.</li><li><code>ExternalName</code> Service — faqat CNAME, port xaritalashi yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta cluster'da DNS — yashirin bottleneck: NodeLocal DNSCache yoqing va CoreDNS metrikalari (<code>coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds</code>)ni kuzating.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33312	<p>ConfigMap'ni pod'ga env sifatida va fayl sifatida qanday berasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ConfigMap'ni ikki usulda berasiz: <b>env</b> (<code>env.valueFrom.configMapKeyRef</code> yoki <code>envFrom</code>) — pod start'da bir marta o'qiladi; <b>volume</b> — har key fayl bo'ladi va ConfigMap o'zgarsa fayl ~1 daqiqada avtomatik yangilanadi (subPath'dan tashqari).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> konfiguratsiyani image'ga qotirmaslik — bitta image dev va prod'da turli sozlama bilan ishlaydi (12-factor).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ConfigMap api-config<br>  |-- env:    LOG_LEVEL=info   (start'da muzlaydi)<br>  +-- volume: /etc/app/app.yaml (kubelet sync bilan yangilanadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: ConfigMap<br>metadata: { name: api-config }<br>data:<br>  LOG_LEVEL: info<br>  app.yaml: |<br>    timeout: 5s<br>---<br>spec:<br>  containers:<br>  - name: api<br>    env:<br>    - name: LOG_LEVEL<br>      valueFrom: { configMapKeyRef: { name: api-config, key: LOG_LEVEL } }<br>    envFrom:<br>    - configMapRef: { name: api-config }<br>    volumeMounts:<br>    - { name: cfg, mountPath: /etc/app, readOnly: true }<br>  volumes:<br>  - name: cfg<br>    configMap:<br>      name: api-config<br>      items: [{ key: app.yaml, path: app.yaml }]</pre><pre>kubectl create configmap api-config --from-file=app.yaml --from-literal=LOG_LEVEL=info \<br>  --dry-run=client -o yaml &gt; cm.yaml<br>kubectl exec deploy/api -- cat /etc/app/app.yaml<br>kubectl rollout restart deploy/api     # env o'zgarishini qo'llash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Env o'zgarishi pod restart'siz qo'llanmaydi.</li><li><code>subPath</code> bilan mount qilingan fayl hech qachon yangilanmaydi.</li><li>Fayl yangilansa ham ilova uni qayta o'qimasa foydasi yo'q (reload signal yoki watcher kerak).</li><li>Maxfiy ma'lumotni ConfigMap'ga yozish — Secret ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Yashirin&quot; config o'zgarishlaridan qochish uchun immutable ConfigMap + nomga hash (Kustomize <code>configMapGenerator</code>, Helm <code>checksum/config</code> annotation) ishlating: o'zgarish = yangi rollout = rollback qilinadigan revision.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33313	<p>Pod hayot sikli: Pending, ContainerCreating, Running, Succeeded, Failed, Terminating?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pod phase'lari: <b>Pending</b> (qabul qilindi, lekin hali joylanmagan yoki image yuklanmoqda), <b>Running</b> (kamida bitta container ishlayapti), <b>Succeeded</b> (hammasi 0 kod bilan tugadi), <b>Failed</b> (kamida bittasi xato bilan tugadi), <b>Unknown</b> (node bilan aloqa yo'q). <code>ContainerCreating</code>, <code>CrashLoopBackOff</code>, <code>Terminating</code> — bu phase emas, <code>kubectl</code> ko'rsatadigan container holati/sabab.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> debug har doim &quot;pod qaysi bosqichda qotdi?&quot; savolidan boshlanadi — har bosqichning sababi va tekshiruvi boshqa.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>create -&gt; Pending --(scheduler node tanladi)--&gt; ContainerCreating<br>            |                                      | image pull, volume mount<br>            | (joy yo'q: Unschedulable)            v<br>                                                Running --(Ready probe)--&gt; trafik<br>                                                   |<br>                    restartPolicy=Never/OnFailure  v<br>                                       Succeeded / Failed<br>delete -&gt; Terminating (preStop + SIGTERM + grace) -&gt; yo'qoladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get pod api-x                     # STATUS ustuni<br>kubectl describe pod api-x                # Events: FailedScheduling, Pulling, BackOff<br>kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'<br>kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions}'   # PodScheduled, Initialized, ContainersReady, Ready</pre><p>| Ko'rinish | Odatiy sabab | |---|---| | Pending uzoq | resurs yo'q, taint, PVC bog'lanmagan | | ContainerCreating uzoq | image katta, volume attach, CNI xato | | Terminating qotgan | finalizer, node yo'q |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Running</code> != tayyor. <code>READY 0/1</code> bo'lsa readiness o'tmagan, trafik yo'q.</li><li>Terminating'da qotgan pod'ni <code>--force --grace-period=0</code> bilan o'chirish StatefulSet'da ikki nusxa xavfini tug'diradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monitoring'da phase emas, <code>kube_pod_status_ready</code> va restart soni (<code>kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total</code>) bo'yicha alert qiling — Running lekin Ready emas pod'lar eng yashirin muammo.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33387	<p>Lokal Kubernetes: minikube, kind, k3s farqi va qachon qaysi biri?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>minikube</b> — VM yoki container ichida to'liq K8s, addon'lar ko'p, o'rganish uchun qulay. <b>kind</b> — Docker container'lari ichida node'lar, tez yaratiladi/o'chadi, CI testlari uchun ideal. <b>k3s</b> — yengil, bitta binary, production'ga ham yaraydi (edge, IoT, kichik server).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> har test uchun bulutda cluster ochish qimmat va sekin. Lokal cluster bilan manifest, Helm chart, operator'ni noutbukda tekshirasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>minikube:  host -&gt; VM/docker -&gt; bitta &quot;node&quot; (to'liq kubeadm)<br>kind:      host -&gt; docker -&gt; [control-plane container][worker container]...<br>k3s:       host -&gt; k3s binary (apiserver+kubelet+containerd+sqlite/etcd)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># kind — CI'da ko'p ishlatiladi<br>cat &lt;&lt;EOF &gt; kind.yaml<br>kind: Cluster<br>apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4<br>nodes: [{role: control-plane}, {role: worker}, {role: worker}]<br>EOF<br>kind create cluster --name dev --config kind.yaml<br>kind load docker-image api:dev --name dev    # lokal image'ni cluster'ga<br>kind delete cluster --name dev<br><br>minikube start --cpus 4 --memory 8g &amp;&amp; minikube addons enable ingress<br>curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | sh -           # k3s server</pre><p>| | minikube | kind | k3s | |---|---|---|---| | Asosiy maqsad | o'rganish | CI/test | yengil prod/edge | | Multi-node | bor | oson | bor | | LoadBalancer | <code>minikube tunnel</code> | MetalLB kerak | ServiceLB bor |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lokalda ishladi = prod'da ishlaydi emas: StorageClass, LoadBalancer, IAM, CNI farq qiladi.</li><li>kind'da <code>imagePullPolicy: Always</code> + lokal image — pull xatosi; <code>kind load</code> va <code>IfNotPresent</code> ishlating.</li><li>k3s default'da Traefik va flannel bilan keladi — prod konfiguratsiyangizdan farq qilishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'da kind bilan ephemeral cluster ochib Helm chart + integration test o'tkazish — &quot;YAML to'g'ri&quot; va &quot;ilova ishlaydi&quot; orasidagi bo'shliqni yopadi. Muhim — cluster versiyasini prod bilan bir xil pin qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33388	<p><code>imagePullPolicy</code> qanday ishlaydi va nega <code>latest</code> tag xavfli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>imagePullPolicy</code>: <b>Always</b> — har pod start'da registry'dan manifestni tekshiradi; <b>IfNotPresent</b> — node'da bo'lsa yuklamaydi; <b>Never</b> — faqat lokal. Tag <code>latest</code> bo'lsa (yoki tag yo'q bo'lsa) default <code>Always</code>, aks holda <code>IfNotPresent</code>. <code>latest</code> xavfli, chunki u <b>o'zgaruvchan</b> — qaysi kod ishlayotganini bilmaysiz.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 3 ta pod <code>api:latest</code>. Kimdir yangi <code>latest</code> push qildi. Bitta pod qayta tug'ildi va yangi kodni oldi, ikkitasi eski — bir Deployment ichida ikki versiya, rollback qiladigan joy yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>tag   (o'zgaruvchan ko'rsatkich):  api:latest -&gt; sha256:aaa (kecha)<br>                                    api:latest -&gt; sha256:bbb (bugun)<br>digest (o'zgarmas):                api@sha256:aaa  -&gt; doim bir xil</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>containers:<br>- name: api<br>  image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0@sha256:3f1c...   # tag o'qish uchun, digest aniqlik uchun<br>  imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent</pre><pre>crane digest ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0       # digest olish<br>kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].imageID}'   # haqiqatda ishlayotgan digest</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>latest</code> bilan <code>kubectl rollout undo</code> foydasiz — oldingi revision ham <code>latest</code>.</li><li>Pod spec o'zgarmagani uchun yangi <code>latest</code> push qilinsa deploy bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>Always</code> registry ishlamay qolsa yangi pod'larni ko'tarmaydi (rate limit — Docker Hub).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Immutable tag (git SHA yoki semver) + registry'da tag immutability yoqilgan + admission policy (Kyverno: <code>latest</code> taqiqlash, faqat imzolangan digest) — supply chain xavfsizligi va takrorlanuvchanlikning asosi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33389	<p><code>kubectl cordon</code>, <code>uncordon</code>, <code>drain</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>cordon</code> — node'ni &quot;unschedulable&quot; qiladi (yangi pod tushmaydi, eskilari qoladi). <code>drain</code> — cordon + mavjud pod'larni xavfsiz evict qiladi (PDB'ni hurmat qiladi). <code>uncordon</code> — node'ni yana ishga qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> kernel yangilash, node upgrade, hardware almashtirish oldidan node'ni bo'shatish kerak — servis to'xtamasdan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>cordon:  node.spec.unschedulable=true<br>drain:   cordon -&gt; har pod uchun Eviction API<br>                  -&gt; PDB ruxsat bersa pod o'chadi, boshqa node'da qayta tug'iladi<br>                  -&gt; PDB ruxsat bermasa kutadi/qayta urinadi<br>uncordon: unschedulable=false</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl cordon worker-3<br>kubectl get nodes          # STATUS: Ready,SchedulingDisabled<br>kubectl drain worker-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=10m<br># ... texnik ish, reboot ...<br>kubectl uncordon worker-3</pre><p>Flag'lar: <code>--ignore-daemonsets</code> (DaemonSet pod'lari baribir qayta tushadi), <code>--delete-emptydir-data</code> (emptyDir ma'lumoti yo'qolishiga rozilik), <code>--force</code> (controller'siz yalang'och pod'lar — ular qayta tug'ilmaydi!).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PDB <code>minAvailable</code> = replika soni bo'lsa drain abadiy qotadi (&quot;Cannot evict pod as it would violate the pod's disruption budget&quot;).</li><li>Bitta replika'li ilova — drain paytida downtime.</li><li><code>uncordon</code>ni unutish — node bo'sh turadi, cluster sig'imi kamayadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Managed node group'larda (EKS, GKE) upgrade drain'ni avtomatik qiladi, Karpenter esa node'larni o'zi almashtiradi — shuning uchun to'g'ri PDB, graceful shutdown va kamida 2 replika har bir servis uchun majburiy standart bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33390	<p>k9s, Lens, <code>kubectl</code> plugin'lari (krew) — kundalik ishni qanday tezlashtiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>k9s</b> — terminal UI: resurslar bo'ylab klaviatura bilan yurish, log, exec, delete bir tugma. <b>Lens/Freelens</b> — desktop GUI, ko'p cluster, grafiklar. <b>krew</b> — <code>kubectl</code> plugin menejeri: <code>ctx/ns</code>, <code>stern</code>, <code>neat</code>, <code>tree</code>, <code>who-can</code> kabi plugin'lar.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> <code>kubectl get pods -n x</code>, <code>describe</code>, <code>logs -f</code> ni kuniga yuzlab yozish vaqtni yeydi.
