Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33267	<p>Rolling update strategiyasi: <code>maxSurge</code>, <code>maxUnavailable</code>, <code>minReadySeconds</code>?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> RollingUpdate'da <code>maxSurge</code> — rejadan ortiq bir vaqtda nechta qo'shimcha pod yaratish mumkin; <code>maxUnavailable</code> — nechta pod bir vaqtda ishlamay turishi mumkin (default ikkalasi 25%). <code>minReadySeconds</code> — pod Ready bo'lgandan keyin necha soniya barqaror turishi kerak, shundan keyingina &quot;available&quot; hisoblanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 4 replika, yangi versiya start'da 30 soniya keyin crash qiladi. <code>minReadySeconds</code> yo'q bo'lsa rollout hammasini tez almashtirib yuboradi va hammasi yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (replicas=4, maxSurge=1, maxUnavailable=0):</b></p><pre>eski: 4   yangi: 0<br>eski: 4   yangi: 1 (Ready + minReadySeconds kutiladi)<br>eski: 3   yangi: 1 -&gt; yangi: 2<br>...<br>eski: 0   yangi: 4<br>Hech qachon &lt; 4 available pod bo'lmaydi, maksimum 5 pod.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  replicas: 4<br>  minReadySeconds: 15<br>  progressDeadlineSeconds: 300<br>  strategy:<br>    type: RollingUpdate<br>    rollingUpdate:<br>      maxSurge: 1          # yoki &quot;25%&quot;<br>      maxUnavailable: 0    # sig'im kamaymasin</pre><pre>kubectl rollout status deploy/api<br>kubectl get rs -l app=api -w      # eski va yangi RS replika soni jonli</pre><p>| Holat | Tanlov | |---|---| | Sig'im zich, kamaymasin | surge=1, unavailable=0 | | Resurs tanqis | surge=0, unavailable=1 | | Tez deploy, ko'p replika | surge=25%, unavailable=25% |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>maxSurge: 0</code> va <code>maxUnavailable: 0</code> — taqiqlangan kombinatsiya.</li><li>Readiness probe yo'q bo'lsa barcha parametrlar ma'nosiz — pod darhol &quot;Ready&quot;.</li><li><code>Recreate</code> strategiyasi hamma pod'ni o'chirib keyin yaratadi — downtime (lekin RWO volume yoki eski/yangi versiya mos kelmaganda kerak).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rolling update faqat &quot;pod ishlayaptimi&quot;ni tekshiradi, &quot;biznes metrika yaxshimi&quot;ni emas. Xavfli o'zgarishlar uchun canary + avtomatik tahlil (Argo Rollouts/Flagger) qo'shing.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33268	<p>Graceful shutdown: pod o'chirilganda nima bo'ladi va 5xx'siz qanday to'xtatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pod o'chirilganda bir vaqtda ikki narsa boshlanadi: endpoint'lardan chiqarish va container'ga <code>preStop</code> + <code>SIGTERM</code>. Ular <b>parallel</b> — shuning uchun proxy'lar hali eski pod'ga trafik yuborishi mumkin. 5xx'siz to'xtatish: <code>preStop</code> da qisqa kutish, ilova SIGTERM'da yangi so'rov qabul qilmay, borlarini tugatishi, yetarli <code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> har deploy paytida bir necha soniya 502/connection reset. Sabab — ilova SIGTERM'da darhol o'ladi, ingress esa hali uni endpoint deb biladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubectl delete / rollout<br>   |<br>   +--&gt; EndpointSlice'dan chiqarish -&gt; kube-proxy/ingress yangilanadi (1-5 s)<br>   |<br>   +--&gt; preStop (sleep 5) -&gt; SIGTERM -&gt; ilova drain -&gt; exit 0<br>                                   \<br>             terminationGracePeriodSeconds (default 30) o'tsa -&gt; SIGKILL (137)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45<br>  containers:<br>  - name: api<br>    lifecycle:<br>      preStop:<br>        sleep: { seconds: 5 }        # 1.30+ native; eski: exec [&quot;sleep&quot;,&quot;5&quot;]<br>    readinessProbe:<br>      httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }</pre><pre>// Go: SIGTERM'da graceful shutdown<br>ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM)<br>defer stop()<br>go srv.ListenAndServe()<br>&lt;-ctx.Done()<br>shCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)<br>defer cancel()<br>srv.Shutdown(shCtx) // yangi ulanish yo'q, mavjudlari tugaydi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Shell wrapper (<code>sh -c &quot;app&quot;</code>) SIGTERM'ni ilovaga uzatmaydi — <code>exec</code> yoki tini ishlating.</li><li>preStop + drain vaqti &gt; grace period bo'lsa SIGKILL.</li><li>Keep-alive ulanishlar: shutdown paytida <code>Connection: close</code> qaytaring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Graceful shutdown'ni test qiling: load test ostida <code>kubectl rollout restart</code> qilib 5xx sonini o'lchang — nol bo'lmaguncha &quot;tayyor&quot; demang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33269	<p>PodDisruptionBudget (PDB) nima va qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PodDisruptionBudget — <b>ixtiyoriy (voluntary) uzilishlar</b> paytida (drain, node upgrade, Karpenter consolidation) bir vaqtda nechta pod o'chishi mumkinligini cheklaydi: <code>minAvailable</code> yoki <code>maxUnavailable</code>. Node yiqilishi kabi majburiy uzilishlardan himoya qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> cluster upgrade'da 3 node bir vaqtda drain bo'ldi, 3 replika'li etcd/Kafka/API'ning hammasi bir vaqtda o'chdi — quorum yo'qoldi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>drain -&gt; Eviction API -&gt; PDB tekshiruvi:<br>   available(3) - 1 &gt;= minAvailable(2) ?  ha -&gt; evict<br>                                          yo'q -&gt; 429, keyinroq qayta urinish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: policy/v1<br>kind: PodDisruptionBudget<br>metadata: { name: api-pdb }<br>spec:<br>  maxUnavailable: 1            # replika soni o'zgarsa ham mos<br>  selector:<br>    matchLabels: { app: api }<br>  unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow   # crash'dagi pod'lar drain'ni to'smasin</pre><pre>kubectl get pdb -A<br># ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS = 0 bo'lsa hozir hech bir pod drain qilinmaydi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>minAvailable: 100%</code> yoki replika=1 + <code>minAvailable: 1</code> — drain abadiy qotadi, upgrade to'xtaydi.</li><li>PDB selector hech bir pod'ga mos kelmasa — himoya yo'q, lekin xato ham yo'q.</li><li><code>kubectl delete pod</code> PDB'ni chetlab o'tadi — faqat Eviction API hurmat qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Platforma standarti: har ko'p replika'li workload uchun <code>maxUnavailable: 1</code> PDB, va policy (Kyverno) bilan &quot;drain'ni to'sadigan PDB&quot;larni taqiqlash. Quorum'li tizimlar uchun <code>maxUnavailable: 1</code> aniq quorum'ni saqlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33270	<p>StatefulSet qanday kafolatlar beradi va headless Service bilan bog'liqligi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> StatefulSet kafolatlari: <b>barqaror nom</b> (<code>db-0</code>, <code>db-1</code>), <b>barqaror tarmoq identifikatori</b> (headless Service orqali <code>db-0.db.ns.svc</code>), <b>har pod'ga o'z PVC'si</b> (<code>volumeClaimTemplates</code>, pod qayta tug'ilsa shu disk qaytadi), <b>tartibli</b> yaratish/o'chirish/yangilash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> PostgreSQL replikasini Deployment bilan qo'ysangiz pod nomi va diski tasodifiy — replika qaysi primary ekanini, qaysi diskda o'z ma'lumoti borligini bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Headless Service &quot;db&quot; (clusterIP: None)<br>   db-0.db.prod.svc  -&gt; db-0  -&gt; PVC data-db-0<br>   db-1.db.prod.svc  -&gt; db-1  -&gt; PVC data-db-1<br>   db-2.db.prod.svc  -&gt; db-2  -&gt; PVC data-db-2<br>yaratish: 0 -&gt; 1 -&gt; 2 (oldingisi Ready bo'lganda)<br>o'chirish/update: 2 -&gt; 1 -&gt; 0</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Service<br>metadata: { name: db }<br>spec: { clusterIP: None, selector: { app: db }, ports: [{ port: 5432 }] }<br>---<br>apiVersion: apps/v1<br>kind: StatefulSet<br>metadata: { name: db }<br>spec:<br>  serviceName: db<br>  replicas: 3<br>  podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady   # yoki Parallel<br>  selector: { matchLabels: { app: db } }<br>  template:<br>    metadata: { labels: { app: db } }<br>    spec:<br>      containers:<br>      - name: pg<br>        image: postgres:17<br>        volumeMounts: [{ name: data, mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data }]<br>  volumeClaimTemplates:<br>  - metadata: { name: data }<br>    spec:<br>      accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]<br>      storageClassName: gp3<br>      resources: { requests: { storage: 50Gi } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>StatefulSet replikatsiya, failover, backup <b>qilmaydi</b> — bu ilova yoki operator ishi.</li><li>Scale down'da PVC o'chmaydi (default) — pul yeydi, lekin ma'lumotni saqlaydi.</li><li>Node yiqilsa pod avtomatik ko'chmaydi (ikki nusxa xavfi), qo'lda aralashuv yoki non-graceful node shutdown taint kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production DB uchun xom StatefulSet emas, operator (CloudNativePG, Strimzi) yoki managed servis tanlang — failover, backup, upgrade logikasi u yerda allaqachon sinovdan o'tgan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm

Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33272	<p>Job va CronJob'ni production'da to'g'ri sozlash: retry, parallelism, concurrencyPolicy?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Job — bir martalik vazifa: <code>backoffLimit</code> (qayta urinish soni), <code>activeDeadlineSeconds</code> (umumiy vaqt chegarasi), <code>completions</code>/<code>parallelism</code>, <code>ttlSecondsAfterFinished</code> (tozalash). CronJob — jadval bo'yicha Job yaratadi: <code>concurrencyPolicy</code> (Allow/Forbid/Replace), <code>startingDeadlineSeconds</code>, <code>timeZone</code>, history limit'lar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> tungi hisobot Job'i 2 soat davom etdi, keyingi jadval kelib ikkinchisi ham ishga tushdi — ikkalasi bir jadvalni yangilab, ma'lumot buzildi. Yoki Job abadiy qayta urinib, minglab tugagan pod qoldirdi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CronJob &quot;0 2 * * *&quot; --&gt; Job (har kuni) --&gt; Pod(lar)<br>   concurrencyPolicy: Forbid -&gt; oldingi tugamagan bo'lsa yangisi o'tkazib yuboriladi<br>Job: pod fail -&gt; backoff (10s, 20s, 40s ... 6 min max) -&gt; backoffLimit -&gt; Failed</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: CronJob<br>metadata: { name: report }<br>spec:<br>  schedule: &quot;0 2 * * *&quot;<br>  timeZone: &quot;Asia/Tashkent&quot;<br>  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid<br>  startingDeadlineSeconds: 600<br>  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3<br>  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 5<br>  jobTemplate:<br>    spec:<br>      backoffLimit: 3<br>      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600<br>      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400<br>      template:<br>        spec:<br>          restartPolicy: Never<br>          containers:<br>          - name: report<br>            image: ghcr.io/acme/report:2.1.0</pre><pre>kubectl create job --from=cronjob/report report-manual   # qo'lda ishga tushirish<br>kubectl get jobs; kubectl logs job/report-manual</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Job &quot;kamida bir marta&quot; ishlaydi, ba'zan ikki marta — vazifa <b>idempotent</b> bo'lishi shart.</li><li><code>restartPolicy: OnFailure</code> — pod ichida restart, log'lar yo'qolishi mumkin; <code>Never</code> debug uchun qulayroq.</li><li>CronJob controller 100 dan ortiq o'tkazib yuborilgan jadvalni ko'rsa Job yaratmaydi.</li><li>Indexed Job (<code>completionMode: Indexed</code>) bo'lak-bo'lak parallel ishlash uchun — <code>JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Job muvaffaqiyatsizligini kuzating (<code>kube_job_status_failed</code>) va &quot;oxirgi muvaffaqiyatli ishga tushish&quot; vaqti bo'yicha alert qo'ying — CronJob jimgina ishlamay qolishi eng ko'p kech aniqlanadigan muammo.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w6 Workloads_Helm
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33391	<p>Downward API nima va pod o'z nomi, namespace'i, resurs limitini qanday biladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Downward API — pod o'zi haqidagi ma'lumotni (nom, namespace, IP, node nomi, label/annotation, resurs request/limit) env yoki fayl orqali olishi. <code>fieldRef</code> va <code>resourceFieldRef</code> ishlatiladi; Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W6 K8s workloads & Helm	idrill-33427	<p>Ingress <code>pathType</code>: <code>Exact</code>, <code>Prefix</code>, <code>ImplementationSpecific</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>Exact</code> — yo'l aynan mos kelishi kerak (<code>/api</code> faqat <code>/api</code>). <code>Prefix</code> — <code>/</code> bilan bo'lingan element bo'yicha prefiks (<code>/api</code> -&gt; <code>/api</code>, <code>/api/users</code>, lekin <code>/apiv2</code> emas). <code>ImplementationSpecific</code> — ma'nosi Ingress controller'ga bog'liq (nginx'da regex ham bo'lishi mumkin).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>/api</code> Prefix qo'yildi, <code>/apidocs</code> frontend'ga ketishi kerak edi — controller'ga qarab har xil ishladi, chunki <code>ImplementationSpecific</code> ishlatilgan edi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>so'rov /api/users<br>  Exact /api            -&gt; mos emas<br>  Prefix /api           -&gt; mos (element: api)<br>  Prefix /ap            -&gt; mos emas (element butun bo'lishi kerak)<br>Bir nechta mos kelsa: eng uzun yo'l, teng bo'lsa Exact &gt; Prefix</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: Ingress<br>metadata: { name: shop }<br>spec:<br>  ingressClassName: nginx<br>  rules:<br>  - host: shop.example.com<br>    http:<br>      paths:<br>      - path: /healthz<br>        pathType: Exact<br>        backend: { service: { name: api, port: { number: 8080 } } }<br>      - path: /api<br>        pathType: Prefix<br>        backend: { service: { name: api, port: { number: 8080 } } }<br>      - path: /<br>        pathType: Prefix<br>        backend: { service: { name: web, port: { number: 80 } } }</pre><pre>curl -sI https://shop.example.com/api/users   # api<br>curl -sI https://shop.example.com/apix        # web (/ ga tushadi)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trailing slash: <code>Prefix /api/</code> va <code>/api</code> bir xil hisoblanadi, lekin <code>Exact</code>'da farq qiladi.</li><li>ingress-nginx'da <code>use-regex</code> + <code>rewrite-target</code> — <code>ImplementationSpecific</code> kerak; portativ emas.</li><li>2025-2026: ingress-nginx loyihasi rasmiy ravishda to'xtatilish (retirement) jarayonida — yangi loyihalar Gateway API (<code>HTTPRoute</code>)ga qarasin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Portativlik uchun faqat <code>Exact</code> va <code>Prefix</code> ishlating; Kichik qismda sinab ko'rish yoki darhol qaytarish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Blue-green:<br>  Service -&gt; selector version=blue  (100%)<br>  green deploy + smoke test<br>  Service -&gt; selector version=green (100%), blue zaxirada<br><br>Canary:<br>  Ingress/Gateway: stable 90% | canary 10%<br>     | Prometheus: error rate, p99<br>     v  yaxshi -&gt; 25% -&gt; 50% -&gt; 100% ; yomon -&gt; 0% (abort)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Argo Rollouts):</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: Rollout<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  replicas: 10<br>  strategy:<br>    canary:<br>      canaryService: api-canary<br>      stableService: api-stable<br>      trafficRouting:<br>        nginx: { stableIngress: api }<br>      steps:<br>      - setWeight: 10<br>      - analysis: { templates: [{ templateName: error-rate }] }<br>      - setWeight: 50<br>      - pause: { duration: 10m }</pre><pre>kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api --watch<br>kubectl argo rollouts abort api<br>kubectl argo rollouts promote api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Replika soni orqali canary (9 eski + 1 yangi) — trafik ulushi aniq emas, sticky session'da buziladi.</li><li>DB sxema o'zgarishi: ikki versiya bir vaqtda ishlaydi — migratsiya backward-compatible bo'lishi shart (expand/contract).</li><li>Blue-green 2x resurs talab qiladi.</li><li>Metrikasiz canary — shunchaki sekin rolling update.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Canary'ning qiymati avtomatik tahlilda: SLO metrikalari (error rate, p99) bo'yicha AnalysisTemplate va avtomatik abort. Balansni qayta tiklash uchun descheduler yoki Karpenter consolidation kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33278	<p>nodeSelector, node affinity va taint/toleration farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>nodeSelector</b> — oddiy majburiy label moslik (<code>disktype=ssd</code>). <b>Node affinity</b> — kengroq ifoda: majburiy (<code>required...</code>) yoki afzal (<code>preferred...</code>, vazn bilan), <code>In/NotIn/Exists</code> operatorlari. <b>Taint/toleration</b> — teskari yo'nalish: node &quot;meni ishlatma&quot; deydi, faqat tegishli toleration'li pod'lar tusha oladi.</p><p><b>Farqning mohiyati:</b> affinity pod'ni node'ga <b>tortadi</b>, taint pod'larni node'dan <b>itaradi</b>. GPU node'ni faqat ML pod'lari uchun ajratish uchun ikkalasi kerak: taint (boshqalar tushmasin) + affinity (ML pod'i aynan shu yerga borsin).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GPU node: label gpu=true, taint gpu=true:NoSchedule<br>  web pod (toleration yo'q)        -&gt; rad etiladi<br>  ml pod (toleration bor)          -&gt; tusha oladi, lekin boshqa joyga ham<br>  ml pod (toleration + affinity)   -&gt; faqat GPU node</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl label node gpu-1 gpu=true<br>kubectl taint node gpu-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule<br>kubectl taint node gpu-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule-     # olib tashlash</pre><pre>spec:<br>  tolerations:<br>  - { key: gpu, operator: Equal, value: &quot;true&quot;, effect: NoSchedule }<br>  affinity:<br>    nodeAffinity:<br>      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:<br>        nodeSelectorTerms:<br>        - matchExpressions:<br>          - { key: gpu, operator: In, values: [&quot;true&quot;] }<br>      preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:<br>      - weight: 50<br>        preference:<br>          matchExpressions:<br>          - { key: topology.kubernetes.io/zone, operator: In, values: [eu-west-1a] }</pre><p>Taint effektlari: <code>NoSchedule</code> (yangi tushmaydi), <code>PreferNoSchedule</code> (iloji bo'lsa), <code>NoExecute</code> (borlarini ham chiqaradi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Toleration &quot;ruxsat&quot; beradi, &quot;majburlamaydi&quot; — affinity'siz pod oddiy node'ga ham tushadi.</li><li><code>IgnoredDuringExecution</code> — label keyin o'zgarsa ishlab turgan pod qoladi.</li><li><code>NoExecute</code> taint qo'shish ishlab turgan pod'larni darhol chiqaradi — prod'da ehtiyot bo'ling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Node pool'larni maqsad bo'yicha ajratish (system, general, GPU, spot) taint + label standartiga asoslansin; Karpenter NodePool'larda aynan shu ifodalar ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33279	<p>Volume turlari: emptyDir, hostPath, configMap/secret, PVC?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>emptyDir</b> — pod umri davomidagi vaqtinchalik papka (pod o'chsa yo'qoladi). <b>hostPath</b> — node faylini pod'ga ochadi (xavfli, deyarli faqat tizim agentlari uchun). <b>configMap/secret</b> — konfiguratsiya va maxfiy ma'lumotni fayl qilib berish. <b>PVC</b> — doimiy disk, pod o'chsa ham saqlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> container fayl tizimi efemer — container restart bo'lsa yozilgan narsa yo'qoladi. Qaysi ma'lumot qancha yashashi kerakligiga qarab volume turi tanlanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Umr:  container &lt; emptyDir (pod) &lt; PVC (pod'dan mustaqil)<br>            container restart -&gt; emptyDir saqlanadi<br>            pod o'chdi        -&gt; emptyDir yo'q, PVC bor<br>hostPath: node diski -&gt; pod boshqa node'ga ko'chsa boshqa ma'lumot</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>volumes:<br>- name: cache<br>  emptyDir: { sizeLimit: 1Gi }          # medium: Memory -&gt; tmpfs (RAM'dan hisoblanadi)<br>- name: cfg<br>  configMap: { name: api-config }<br>- name: tls<br>  secret: { secretName: api-tls, defaultMode: 0400 }<br>- name: data<br>  persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: api-data }<br>- name: logs                             # faqat log agent DaemonSet uchun<br>  hostPath: { path: /var/log, type: Directory }</pre><pre>kubectl get pvc<br>kubectl exec api-x -- df -h /data</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>hostPath</code> — konteynerdan node'ga chiqish yo'li (masalan <code>/</code> yoki <code>/var/run/containerd.sock</code> mount qilinsa node to'liq egallanadi). Pod Security <code>baseline</code> uni taqiqlaydi.</li><li><code>sizeLimit</code>siz emptyDir node diskini to'ldirib eviction keltirib chiqaradi.</li><li><code>emptyDir.medium: Memory</code> pod memory limit'iga kiradi — OOM.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stateless servislar faqat emptyDir/configMap/secret ishlatsin; PVC — stateful komponentlar uchun ongli qaror. Har PVC — backup, zona bog'liqligi va pul degani.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33280	<p>PV access mode'lari: ReadWriteOnce, ReadOnlyMany, ReadWriteMany, ReadWriteOncePod?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ReadWriteOnce (RWO)</b> — bitta <b>node</b> o'qib-yoza oladi (o'sha node'dagi bir nechta pod ham). <b>ReadOnlyMany (ROX)</b> — ko'p node faqat o'qiydi. <b>ReadWriteMany (RWX)</b> — ko'p node o'qib-yozadi (NFS, EFS, CephFS, Azure Files). <b>ReadWriteOncePod (RWOP)</b> — faqat bitta <b>pod</b> (1.29+ GA).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deployment 3 replika, EBS RWO volume — 2- va 3-pod boshqa node'da &quot;Multi-Attach error&quot; bilan ContainerCreating'da qotadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Block disk (EBS, PD, Azure Disk) -&gt; odatda faqat RWO/RWOP<br>   node-a: pod1, pod2  OK (RWO)    node-b: pod3  Multi-Attach error<br>File storage (EFS, NFS, Filestore) -&gt; RWX<br>   node-a, node-b, node-c hammasi mount qiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: PersistentVolumeClaim<br>metadata: { name: shared-uploads }<br>spec:<br>  accessModes: [ReadWriteMany]<br>  storageClassName: efs-sc<br>  resources: { requests: { storage: 100Gi } }</pre><pre>kubectl get pv -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,MODES:.spec.accessModes,SC:.spec.storageClassName<br>kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -i attach</pre><p>| Mode | Misol backend | Ishlatish | |---|---|---| | RWO | EBS gp3 | DB, StatefulSet | | RWOP | EBS + CSI | qat'iy yagona yozuvchi | | RWX | EFS, NFS | umumiy fayllar |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>RWO &quot;bitta pod&quot; emas, &quot;bitta node&quot; — ikki pod bir node'da bir diskka yozib ma'lumotni buzishi mumkin; kerak bo'lsa RWOP.</li><li>Access mode — so'rov; backend qo'llamasa PVC Pending qoladi.</li><li>RWX tarmoq fayl tizimi sekinroq va DB uchun mos emas (lock, fsync semantikasi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> RWX'ga ehtiyoj ko'pincha arxitektura signali: umumiy fayllarni object storage (S3)ga ko'chirish odatda arzonroq, tezroq va masshtablanuvchan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33281	<p>Liveness, readiness va startup probe'lar qachon qaysi biri ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Liveness</b> — &quot;ilova tirikmi?&quot; yo'q bo'lsa kubelet container'ni <b>restart</b> qiladi. <b>Readiness</b> — &quot;trafik olishga tayyormi?&quot; yo'q bo'lsa pod Service endpoint'laridan <b>chiqariladi</b> (restart yo'q). <b>Startup</b> — sekin ishga tushadigan ilova uchun: u muvaffaqiyatli bo'lguncha liveness/readiness ishlamaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Java ilova 90 soniyada ko'tariladi, liveness 30 soniyadan keyin tekshiradi va uni o'ldiradi — abadiy CrashLoop. Yoki liveness DB'ni tekshiradi, DB sekinlashdi — hamma pod'lar bir vaqtda restart bo'ldi, to'liq outage.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>start -&gt; startupProbe (failureThreshold x period = max start vaqti)<br>            | OK<br>            v<br>     livenessProbe  -- fail N marta --&gt; restart container<br>     readinessProbe -- fail --&gt; endpoint'dan chiqarish, OK -&gt; qaytarish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>containers:<br>- name: api<br>  startupProbe:<br>    httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }<br>    periodSeconds: 5<br>    failureThreshold: 30          # 150 s gacha start<br>  livenessProbe:<br>    httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }   # faqat jarayon ichki holati<br>    periodSeconds: 10<br>    failureThreshold: 3<br>  readinessProbe:<br>    httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }     # bog'liqliklar, warmup<br>    periodSeconds: 5</pre><pre>kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -E &quot;Liveness|Readiness|Unhealthy&quot;<br>kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Liveness'da tashqi bog'liqlik (DB, Redis) tekshirish — kaskadli restart. Liveness faqat &quot;jarayon qotib qolmaganmi&quot;.</li><li>Readiness'ni ham juda qattiq qilish — DB sekinlashsa hamma pod chiqadi, 503.</li><li>Liveness va readiness bir xil endpoint, bir xil threshold — ma'nosi yo'qoladi.</li><li>Og'ir probe (har 1 s, DB query) — o'zi yuk yaratadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p servislar uchun liveness umuman kerak emas yoki juda yumshoq bo'lsin; deadlock'lar real bo'lsa qo'ying. Readiness esa graceful shutdown va rollout'ning asosi — uni har doim qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33282	<p>Pod'larni AZ va node bo'yicha tarqatish: topologySpreadConstraints va podAntiAffinity?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>topologySpreadConstraints</code> — pod'larni domenlar (zona, node) bo'yicha <b>teng taqsimlaydi</b>: <code>maxSkew</code> (eng ko'p va eng kam domen orasidagi farq), <code>topologyKey</code>, <code>whenUnsatisfiable</code>. <code>podAntiAffinity</code> — &quot;shu label'li pod bor joyga tushma&quot; qoidasi; qat'iy yoki afzal. Spread — zamonaviy va moslashuvchan, anti-affinity — oddiy &quot;bir node'ga bittadan&quot;.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 6 replika, hammasi bitta AZ'ga tushdi. AZ yiqildi — servis to'liq to'xtadi, garchi &quot;6 replika&quot; bo'lsa ham.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>maxSkew=1, topologyKey=zone<br>  zone-a: 2   zone-b: 2   zone-c: 2   -&gt; OK<br>  zone-a: 3   zone-b: 2   zone-c: 1   -&gt; skew 2, rad etiladi<br>anti-affinity (required, hostname): har node'da max 1 pod</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  topologySpreadConstraints:<br>  - maxSkew: 1<br>    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone<br>    whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule<br>    labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>    matchLabelKeys: [pod-template-hash]       # har revision alohida hisoblansin<br>  - maxSkew: 1<br>    topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname<br>    whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway<br>    labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  affinity:<br>    podAntiAffinity:<br>      preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:<br>      - weight: 100<br>        podAffinityTerm:<br>          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname<br>          labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }</pre><pre>kubectl get pods -l app=api -o wide<br>kubectl get nodes -L topology.kubernetes.io/zone</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>required</code> anti-affinity + replika &gt; node soni = Pending pod'lar.</li><li><code>DoNotSchedule</code> + bitta zonada sig'im tugasa — rollout qotadi.</li><li>Rolling update paytida eski/yangi pod'lar aralashib skew'ni buzadi — <code>matchLabelKeys</code> bilan hal qilinadi.</li><li>Spread faqat scheduling vaqtida; keyin muvozanat buzilsa descheduler kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zona bo'yicha spread — HA'ning asosi, lekin cross-AZ trafik pul turadi (AWS'da GB uchun). Topology-aware routing (<code>trafficDistribution: PreferClose</code>) bilan birga ishlating.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33283	<p>HPA, VPA va Cluster Autoscaler/Karpenter qanday birga ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>HPA</b> — pod sonini metrikaga (CPU, memory, custom) qarab o'zgartiradi. <b>VPA</b> — pod'ning request/limit hajmini o'zgartiradi. <b>Cluster Autoscaler / Karpenter</b> — Pending pod'lar uchun node qo'shadi, bo'sh node'larni olib tashlaydi. Zanjir: yuk oshdi -&gt; HPA pod qo'shdi -&gt; pod sig'madi (Pending) -&gt; Karpenter node qo'shdi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> HPA pod qo'shdi, lekin node yo'q — pod'lar Pending, yuk baribir eski pod'larda. Yoki HPA va VPA ikkalasi CPU'ga qarab bir-biriga qarshi ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>trafik ^ -&gt; CPU 80% -&gt; HPA: replicas 4 -&gt; 8<br>                          |<br>                          v<br>                 4 pod Pending (joy yo'q)<br>                          |<br>                          v<br>         Karpenter: mos instance turini tanlab node yaratadi (~1 daq)<br>                          |<br>                          v<br>                 pod'lar Running -&gt; CPU tushadi<br>VPA (alohida): tarixga qarab request'ni to'g'rilaydi (ko'pincha recommend rejimi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: autoscaling/v2<br>kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }<br>  minReplicas: 3<br>  maxReplicas: 30<br>  metrics:<br>  - type: Resource<br>    resource: { name: cpu, target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 70 } }<br>  behavior:<br>    scaleDown: { stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300 }</pre><pre>kubectl get hpa api -w          # TARGETS: 85%/70%<br>kubectl describe hpa api        # sabablar, &quot;unable to get metrics&quot;<br>kubectl get nodeclaims          # Karpenter yaratgan node'lar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>HPA CPU'si <b>request</b>ga nisbatan hisoblanadi — request yo'q bo'lsa HPA ishlamaydi.</li><li>HPA va VPA ikkalasi bir xil metrika (CPU) bo'yicha <code>Auto</code> rejimda — urush. VPA'ni <code>Off</code>/recommend rejimida ishlating yoki HPA custom metrikada bo'lsin.</li><li>metrics-server yo'q — <code>&lt;unknown&gt;/70%</code>.</li><li>Node qo'shish 1-3 daqiqa; keskin pik uchun overprovisioning (past prioritetli &quot;joy band qiluvchi&quot; pod'lar) kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Autoscaling — kaskad tizim, har bo'g'inning kechikishi qo'shiladi. Bashoratli yuk uchun jadval (KEDA cron), keskin yuk uchun headroom, va scaleDown'ni sekin qiling — tebranish (flapping) xarajat va latency'ni oshiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33284	<p>KEDA nima va qachon HPA'dan yaxshiroq?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> KEDA (Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling) — HPA ustiga qurilgan va tashqi event manbalari (Kafka lag, SQS/RabbitMQ navbat uzunligi, Prometheus query, cron) bo'yicha masshtablaydi, <b>0 gacha</b> tushirish va 0 dan ko'tarishni qo'llaydi. HPA'dan yaxshiroq: navbat/event asosidagi worker'lar va bo'sh vaqtda nolga tushirish kerak bo'lganda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kafka consumer CPU'si past, lekin lag 2 million xabar — CPU bo'yicha HPA hech narsa qilmaydi. Yoki tunda ishlamaydigan worker'lar 24/7 resurs yeydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>KEDA operator --so'raydi--&gt; Kafka (lag), SQS (uzunlik), Prometheus<br>     |<br>     +--&gt; 0 &lt;-&gt; 1 : KEDA o'zi (activation)<br>     +--&gt; 1 &lt;-&gt; N : KEDA yaratgan HPA (external metrics API orqali)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1<br>kind: ScaledObject<br>metadata: { name: orders-worker }<br>spec:<br>  scaleTargetRef: { name: orders-worker }<br>  minReplicaCount: 0<br>  maxReplicaCount: 50<br>  cooldownPeriod: 300<br>  triggers:<br>  - type: kafka<br>    metadata:<br>      bootstrapServers: kafka:9092<br>      consumerGroup: orders<br>      topic: orders<br>      lagThreshold: &quot;1000&quot;          # har replika uchun maqsad lag<br>    authenticationRef: { name: kafka-auth }</pre><pre>kubectl get scaledobject<br>kubectl get hpa                    # keda-hpa-orders-worker<br>kubectl describe scaledobject orders-worker</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kafka'da replika soni partition sonidan ko'p bo'lsa ortiqchalari bo'sh turadi.</li><li>0 dan ko'tarilish — cold start (image pull, warmup) kechikishi; latency-sezgir API uchun min 0 qo'ymang.</li><li>Bitta resurs uchun ham KEDA ScaledObject, ham qo'lda HPA — ikki HPA urushi.</li><li>Trigger autentifikatsiyasi uchun secret'lar — TriggerAuthentication + workload identity bilan bering.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asinxron worker'lar uchun to'g'ri signal — &quot;bajarilmagan ish hajmi&quot; (lag, navbat), CPU emas. KEDA shu signalni beradi; lekin downstream (DB) sig'imini ham hisobga olib <code>maxReplicaCount</code> ni cheklang, aks holda autoscaling DB'ni yiqitadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33285	<p>StorageClass, dynamic provisioning va reclaimPolicy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>StorageClass</b> — disk &quot;turi&quot; va uni qanday yaratish (provisioner, parametrlar: gp3, IOPS, shifrlash). <b>Dynamic provisioning</b> — PVC yaratilganda CSI driver avtomatik PV (haqiqiy disk) yaratadi. <b>reclaimPolicy</b> — PVC o'chirilganda disk bilan nima bo'ladi: <code>Delete</code> (disk o'chadi) yoki <code>Retain</code> (disk qoladi, qo'lda tozalash).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> kimdir test namespace'ni o'chirdi, unda prod DB'ning PVC'si bor edi va reclaimPolicy <code>Delete</code> — disk ham yo'qoldi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PVC (50Gi, sc=gp3-enc) --&gt; CSI provisioner --&gt; AWS'da EBS yaratadi<br>        |                                         |<br>        +---------- bind &lt;------- PV (avtomatik) -+<br>PVC o'chdi -&gt; reclaimPolicy:<br>   Delete -&gt; EBS o'chadi<br>   Retain -&gt; PV &quot;Released&quot;, EBS saqlanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: StorageClass<br>metadata:<br>  name: gp3-enc<br>  annotations: { storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: &quot;true&quot; }<br>provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com<br>parameters: { type: gp3, encrypted: &quot;true&quot;, iops: &quot;3000&quot; }<br>reclaimPolicy: Retain<br>allowVolumeExpansion: true<br>volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer</pre><pre>kubectl get sc<br>kubectl get pv,pvc -A<br>kubectl patch pv pvc-123 -p '{&quot;spec&quot;:{&quot;persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy&quot;:&quot;Retain&quot;}}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>volumeBindingMode: Immediate</code> — disk pod'dan oldin tasodifiy zonada yaratiladi, pod boshqa zonada bo'lsa joylanmaydi. <code>WaitForFirstConsumer</code> ishlating.</li><li>Default StorageClass ikkita bo'lsa — kutilmagan natija.</li><li>Disk hajmini kamaytirib bo'lmaydi, faqat kengaytirish (<code>allowVolumeExpansion</code>).</li><li><code>in-tree</code> provisioner'lar (<code>kubernetes.io/aws-ebs</code>) eskirgan — CSI driver ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Muhim ma'lumot uchun <code>Retain</code> + VolumeSnapshot asosidagi backup (Velero/CSI snapshot). reclaimPolicy — oxirgi himoya chizig'i, backup emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33286	<p>ResourceQuota va LimitRange nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ResourceQuota</b> — namespace bo'yicha jami cheklov (umumiy CPU/memory request/limit, pod soni, PVC, LoadBalancer soni). <b>LimitRange</b> — namespace ichidagi har bir container/pod uchun default va min/max qiymatlar (request yozilmasa avtomatik qo'yadi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> bitta jamoa xato bilan 500 replika yaratdi va butun cluster sig'imini egalladi; LimitRange default qo'shadi -&gt; Quota yig'indini tekshiradi<br>             -&gt; oshsa: 403 &quot;exceeded quota&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: ResourceQuota<br>metadata: { name: team-a, namespace: team-a }<br>spec:<br>  hard:<br>    requests.cpu: &quot;20&quot;<br>    requests.memory: 40Gi<br>    limits.memory: 80Gi<br>    pods: &quot;100&quot;<br>    services.loadbalancers: &quot;2&quot;<br>    persistentvolumeclaims: &quot;20&quot;<br>---<br>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: LimitRange<br>metadata: { name: defaults, namespace: team-a }<br>spec:<br>  limits:<br>  - type: Container<br>    defaultRequest: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }<br>    default: { memory: 256Mi }<br>    max: { memory: 4Gi }</pre><pre>kubectl describe quota -n team-a     # Used / Hard<br>kubectl describe limitrange -n team-a</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Quota <code>requests.cpu</code> bor, lekin LimitRange yo'q — request yozilmagan pod'lar rad etiladi (&quot;must specify requests.cpu&quot;).</li><li>Quota xatosi Deployment'da emas, ReplicaSet event'larida ko'rinadi — <code>kubectl describe rs</code>.</li><li>LimitRange faqat yangi pod'larga ta'sir qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Multi-tenant cluster'da har namespace yaratilganda quota + LimitRange + NetworkPolicy shablonini avtomatik qo'ying (Kyverno generate yoki namespace operator). Quota'lar — &quot;fair share&quot; va xarajat nazoratining birinchi qatlami.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33397	<p>PriorityClass va preemption qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PriorityClass pod'ga prioritet raqami beradi. Joy yetmasa scheduler <b>preemption</b> qiladi: past prioritetli pod'larni evict qilib, yuqori prioritetli pod'ni joylaydi. Tizim komponentlari uchun <code>system-cluster-critical</code> va <code>system-node-critical</code> tayyor.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> cluster to'la, to'lov servisining yangi pod'i Pending, holbuki node'larda batch hisobot pod'lari ishlayapti. Kim muhimroq ekanini scheduler bilishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>payments (priority 100000) Pending, joy yo'q<br>   |<br>   v<br>scheduler: qaysi node'da past prioritetli pod'larni chiqarsa sig'adi?<br>   node-b: batch (priority 100) x2 -&gt; evict (graceful)<br>   |<br>   v<br>payments -&gt; node-b (nominatedNodeName)<br>Eviction'da ham kubelet prioritetni hisobga oladi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: PriorityClass<br>metadata: { name: business-critical }<br>value: 100000<br>globalDefault: false<br>description: &quot;To'lov va checkout&quot;<br>---<br>apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: PriorityClass<br>metadata: { name: batch-low }<br>value: 100<br>preemptionPolicy: Never      # o'zi hech kimni chiqarmaydi<br>---<br>spec:<br>  priorityClassName: business-critical</pre><pre>kubectl get priorityclass<br>kubectl get pods -A -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,PRIO:.spec.priority<br>kubectl get events -A --field-selector reason=Preempted</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma jamoa o'zini &quot;critical&quot; qiladi — prioritet ma'nosiz bo'ladi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33287	<p>CPU limit va throttling: nega ko'p jamoalar CPU limit qo'ymaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CPU limit CFS quota orqali ishlaydi: har 100ms davrda container faqat <code>limit</code> qadar CPU vaqt oladi, tugasa davr oxirigacha <b>throttle</b> (to'xtatiladi) — hatto node'da bo'sh CPU bo'lsa ham. Shu sabab ko'p jamoalar CPU <b>request</b> qo'yadi (scheduling va adolatli taqsimot uchun), lekin CPU <b>limit</b> qo'ymaydi; memory limit esa qo'yiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> p99 latency 200ms, o'rtacha CPU 30%. Grafikda CPU past, lekin so'rovlar sekin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>limit = 1 CPU, 4 thread parallel ishlaydi<br>davr 100ms:<br> 0ms ----25ms [quota tugadi: 4 x 25 = 100ms CPU] ...... 100ms<br>          |&lt;----------- throttled 75ms ----------&gt;|<br>So'rov shu paytda kelsa +75ms kechikish.<br>CPU request esa cgroup cpu.weight -&gt; faqat raqobatda ulush, bo'sh CPU'ni olish mumkin.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># throttling bormi?<br>kubectl exec api-x -- cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat<br># nr_periods 12000  nr_throttled 3400  throttled_usec 98000000</pre><pre>rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{pod=~&quot;api.*&quot;}[5m])<br>/ rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{pod=~&quot;api.*&quot;}[5m])</pre><pre>resources:<br>  requests: { cpu: 500m, memory: 512Mi }<br>  limits:   { memory: 512Mi }          # CPU limit yo'q</pre><p>Go uchun: <code>GOMAXPROCS</code>ni CPU request/limit'ga moslang (Go 1.25+ cgroup limitini avtomatik hisobga oladi, eski versiyada <code>automaxprocs</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CPU limitsiz + request'siz = &quot;noisy neighbour&quot; — request majburiy.</li><li>Guaranteed QoS (request=limit) kerak bo'lsa (CPU pinning, <code>static</code> CPU manager) — limit qo'yiladi; bu ongli istisno.</li><li>Multi-tenant cluster'da limit'siz ishlash adolatni faqat request'larga tayantiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qaror o'lchovga asoslansin: throttling metrikasini kuzating. Tartib: avval request'dan ortiq ishlatayotganlar, ular ichida past prioritetlilar va eng ko'p &quot;ortiqcha&quot; ishlatganlar. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33494	<p>Kubernetes API Priority and Fairness (APF) nima? Bitta controller API server'ni bo'g'ib qo'ysa nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> API Priority and Fairness (APF) — kube-apiserver'ning so'rovlarni <b>navbatlar va prioritet darajalari</b> bo'yicha boshqarish mexanizmi: FlowSchema so'rovni tasniflaydi, PriorityLevelConfiguration har daraja uchun bir vaqtdagi so'rovlar ulushini beradi, ichida fair queuing. Bitta &quot;shovqinli&quot; controller API'ni bo'g'moqchi bo'lsa, u faqat o'z darajasi va navbatini to'ldiradi va 429 oladi; kubelet, leader election va tizim so'rovlari ishlashda davom etadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> xato yozilgan operator har soniyada barcha pod'larni LIST qiladi. FlowSchema (user/SA/verb/resource bo'yicha moslik)<br>            |<br>            v<br>   PriorityLevel: exempt | system | leader-election | workload-high | workload-low | global-default | catch-all<br>            |  (har biri concurrency ulushi)<br>            v<br>   shuffle-sharded navbatlar (flow = user+namespace)<br>            |  navbat to'lsa -&gt; 429 Too Many Requests<br>            v<br>   bajarish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get flowschemas<br>kubectl get prioritylevelconfigurations<br>kubectl get --raw /debug/api_priority_and_fairness/dump_priority_levels</pre><pre>sum by (priority_level, flow_schema) (rate(apiserver_flowcontrol_rejected_requests_total[5m]))<br>histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, priority_level) (rate(apiserver_flowcontrol_request_wait_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))</pre><pre>apiVersion: flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: FlowSchema<br>metadata: { name: noisy-operator }<br>spec:<br>  priorityLevelConfiguration: { name: workload-low }<br>  matchingPrecedence: 500<br>  distinguisherMethod: { type: ByUser }<br>  rules:<br>  - subjects: [{ kind: ServiceAccount, serviceAccount: { name: my-operator, namespace: ops } }]<br>    resourceRules: [{ verbs: [&quot;*&quot;], apiGroups: [&quot;*&quot;], resources: [&quot;*&quot;], namespaces: [&quot;*&quot;] }]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>APF himoya qiladi, lekin sababni tuzatmaydi: controller'ni informer/cache bilan yozish (LIST emas, WATCH), paginatsiya va backoff kerak.</li><li>O'z FlowSchema'ngizni <code>exempt</code>ga qo'yish — himoyani o'chirish.</li><li>Katta LIST so'rovlari &quot;og'ir&quot; Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33499	<p>etcd quorum va split-brain: nega 3 yoki 5 a'zo, 2 yoki 4 emas? Quorum yo'qolsa nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> etcd Raft quorum = <code>floor(n/2)+1</code>. 3 a'zo 1 ta, 5 a'zo 2 ta yo'qotishga chidaydi. 4 a'zo ham faqat 1 ta yo'qotishga chidaydi (quorum 3), lekin yozish uchun ko'proq tasdiq kerak — shuning uchun juft son foyda bermaydi. 2 a'zo esa 0 ta yo'qotishga chidaydi — bittadan ham yomonroq. Quorum yo'qolsa etcd <b>yozishni to'xtatadi</b> (split-brain'ning oldini oladi), cluster read-only/ishlamaydigan holatga tushadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2 DC'da 2+2 etcd. DC'lar orasidagi aloqa uzildi — hech bir tomonda ko'pchilik yo'q, butun control plane to'xtadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>n   quorum   chidaydi<br>1   1        0<br>2   2        0   &lt;- 1 dan ham yomon (ikki nuqtali xato)<br>3   2        1<br>4   3        1   &lt;- 3 bilan bir xil, sekinroq<br>5   3        2<br>Tarmoq bo'linishi (5 a'zo): [A,B,C] | [D,E]<br>  chap: 3 &gt;= 3 -&gt; leader, yozish davom etadi<br>  o'ng: 2 &lt; 3  -&gt; yozolmaydi (eski ma'lumot o'qilishi mumkin)<br>Ikki leader bo'lishi mumkin emas -&gt; split-brain yo'q</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>etcdctl endpoint status --cluster -w table    # IS LEADER, RAFT TERM<br>etcdctl member list -w table<br>etcdctl alarm list<br># Quorum butunlay yo'qolsa: bitta a'zodan snapshot -&gt; yangi cluster<br>etcdutl snapshot restore snap.db --name etcd-1 \<br>  --initial-cluster etcd-1=https://10.0.1.10:2380 --data-dir /var/lib/etcd-new</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>3 a'zoni bitta AZ'ga qo'yish — AZ yiqilsa quorum yo'qoladi. 3 AZ'ga tarqating.</li><li>7+ a'zo — yozish latency'si oshadi, foyda kam; 5 dan ortiq odatda kerak emas.</li><li>Yangi a'zo qo'shishda avval <code>member add</code> keyin start; bir vaqtda ikkita o'zgarish — quorum xavfi. Learner a'zo (<code>--learner</code>) xavfsizroq.</li><li><code>--force-new-cluster</code> — oxirgi chora, ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Quorum — consistency (CP) tanlovi: tarmoq bo'linishida mavjudlikdan voz kechib, to'g'rilikni saqlaydi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-33503	<p>Cluster API va vcluster nima? Ko'p klasterni qanday boshqarasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Cluster API (CAPI)</b> — Kubernetes cluster'larini Kubernetes uslubida (CRD + controller) yaratish, yangilash va o'chirish: <code>Cluster</code>, <code>MachineDeployment</code> obyektlari, provider'lar (AWS, Azure, vSphere). <b>vcluster</b> — mavjud cluster ichida virtual cluster: alohida apiserver/control plane, lekin pod'lar host cluster node'larida ishlaydi. Ko'p klaster boshqaruvi: CAPI/Terraform (yaratish) + GitOps (Argo CD ApplicationSet/Flux) (kontent) + markaziy policy, observability va identity.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 30 ta cluster, har biri qo'lda yaratilgan — versiyalar har xil, upgrade oylab davom etadi. Yoki har jamoaga to'liq cluster berish qimmat, namespace esa izolyatsiya uchun yetarli emas (CRD, cluster-scope resurslar).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Management cluster (CAPI controller'lari)<br>   Cluster &quot;prod-eu&quot; (CRD)  --provider--&gt; AWS: VPC, EC2/EKS, LB<br>   MachineDeployment v1.31 -&gt; v1.32: rolling node almashtirish<br><br>Host cluster<br>   namespace team-a: [vcluster apiserver + syncer]<br>        team-a o'z CRD/namespace'larini ko'radi<br>        syncer pod'larni host'ga ko'chirib ishlatadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>clusterctl init --infrastructure aws<br>clusterctl generate cluster prod-eu --kubernetes-version v1.31.2 &gt; prod-eu.yaml<br>kubectl apply -f prod-eu.yaml<br>clusterctl describe cluster prod-eu<br><br>vcluster create team-a -n team-a<br>vcluster connect team-a -n team-a</pre><pre># Argo CD ApplicationSet: har cluster'ga bir xil add-on'lar<br>spec:<br>  generators: [{ clusters: { selector: { matchLabels: { env: prod } } } }]<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      source: { repoURL: https://github.com/acme/platform, path: addons }<br>      destination: { server: &quot;{{server}}&quot;, namespace: platform }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Management cluster — yagona nosozlik nuqtasi va eng yuqori qiymatli nishon: uni alohida himoyalang va zaxiralang.</li><li>vcluster izolyatsiyasi node darajasida emas — pod'lar baribir bir kernel'da; qattiq izolyatsiya kerak bo'lsa alohida node pool yoki cluster.</li><li>Ko'p cluster = ko'p ko'chma qism; har cluster qo'shimcha xarajat (control plane narxi, add-on'lar).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Bitta katta cluster&quot; va &quot;ko'p kichik cluster&quot; — blast radius va operatsion xarajat orasidagi trade-off. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-34250	<p>Pod uchun <code>requests</code> va <code>limits</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>requests</b> — pod uchun kafolatlangan minimum; scheduler aynan shunga qarab node tanlaydi. <b>limits</b> — maksimum chegara: CPU limitdan oshsa <b>throttle</b> (sekinlashadi), memory limitdan oshsa container <b>OOMKilled</b> (o'ldiriladi, exit 137).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> request'siz scheduler pod qancha yeyishini bilmaydi va node'larni haddan ortiq to'ldiradi; limit'siz bitta xato ilova butun node xotirasini yeb, qo'shnilarni o'ldiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Node: 4 CPU, 16Gi (allocatable)<br> pod A request 1 CPU / 2Gi  -&gt; joy band qilindi<br> pod B request 1 CPU / 2Gi<br> qolgan: 2 CPU / 12Gi  (haqiqiy foydalanishdan qat'i nazar)<br><br>QoS klasslari:<br> Guaranteed: request = limit (CPU va memory)<br> Burstable:  request &lt; limit yoki faqat request<br> BestEffort: hech narsa yo'q -&gt; birinchi evict qilinadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resources:<br>  requests: { cpu: 250m, memory: 256Mi }   # 250m = 0.25 yadro<br>  limits:   { memory: 512Mi }</pre><pre>kubectl top pod api-x                         # haqiqiy foydalanish<br>kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -A4 -E &quot;Requests|Limits&quot;<br>kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.qosClass}'<br>kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -i oomkilled</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Memory request'ni juda past qo'yish — node to'lib, pod evict bo'ladi.</li><li>Birlik xatosi: <code>memory: 512M</code> (megabayt, 10^6) va <code>512Mi</code> (mebibayt, 2^20) farqli; <code>cpu: 1</code> = 1000m.</li><li>Java/Node.js heap hajmini limitga moslamaslik — OOMKilled.</li><li>CPU limitni juda past qo'yish — latency oshadi (throttling).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Request'larni taxmin bilan emas, o'lchov bilan qo'ying: <code>kubectl top</code>, Prometheus p95 foydalanish, VPA tavsiyasi. Memory: request = limit (oldindan aytib bo'ladigan), CPU: request bor, limit odatda yo'q.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-34251	<p>HPA (HorizontalPodAutoscaler) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HPA (HorizontalPodAutoscaler) — Deployment/StatefulSet'ning pod sonini metrikaga qarab avtomatik oshiradi yoki kamaytiradi. Odatda CPU foydalanishi (request'ga nisbatan %), memory yoki custom/external metrika (RPS, navbat uzunligi) bo'yicha.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> kunduzi trafik 10 barobar, tunda kam. Qo'lda replika o'zgartirish sekin va xatoga moyil; doim maksimal replika esa qimmat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>har 15 s: metrics-server -&gt; o'rtacha CPU = 90%<br>kerakli = ceil(hozirgi_replika x hozirgi / maqsad)<br>        = ceil(4 x 90 / 60) = 6<br>min/max chegarasida -&gt; Deployment.replicas = 6<br>scaleDown: 5 daqiqa barqarorlik oynasi (tebranmaslik uchun)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl autoscale deploy api --cpu-percent=60 --min=2 --max=10<br>kubectl get hpa                 # TARGETS 90%/60%, REPLICAS 6<br>kubectl describe hpa api        # Events: New size: 6; reason: cpu resource utilization above target<br>kubectl top pods -l app=api</pre><pre>apiVersion: autoscaling/v2<br>kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }<br>  minReplicas: 2<br>  maxReplicas: 10<br>  metrics:<br>  - type: Resource<br>    resource: { name: cpu, target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 60 } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>metrics-server o'rnatilmagan — TARGETS <code>&lt;unknown&gt;</code>.</li><li>Pod'da CPU <b>request</b> yo'q — foiz hisoblab bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Deployment YAML'ida <code>replicas</code> qoldirish — har deploy HPA qiymatini qayta yozadi.</li><li>Memory bo'yicha scale ko'p ilovada ishlamaydi: memory yuk tushgach ham bo'shamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HPA pod qo'shadi, lekin node yo'q bo'lsa pod'lar Pending — Cluster Autoscaler/Karpenter bilan birga ishlashi kerak. <code>minReplicas</code> kamida 2 (HA uchun), <code>maxReplicas</code> esa DB va downstream sig'imiga qarab.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-34252	<p>PVC (PersistentVolumeClaim) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PVC (PersistentVolumeClaim) — pod'ning &quot;menga 10Gi, shu turdagi disk kerak&quot; degan <b>so'rovi</b>. Kubernetes unga mos PV (PersistentVolume — haqiqiy disk) bog'laydi yoki StorageClass orqali avtomatik yaratadi. Pod diskni PVC nomi orqali ulaydi va pod o'lsa ham ma'lumot saqlanadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> container fayl tizimi vaqtinchalik — pod qayta yaratilsa ma'lumot yo'qoladi. Ma'lumotlar bazasi, yuklangan fayllar uchun doimiy disk kerak, va dasturchi AWS/GCP disk detallarini bilmasligi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Dasturchi:  PVC (10Gi, RWO, sc=gp3)<br>               |<br>Cluster:    StorageClass gp3 -&gt; CSI driver -&gt; bulutda disk yaratadi -&gt; PV<br>               |<br>            PVC &lt;-&gt; PV bog'lanadi (Bound)<br>               |<br>Pod:        volumes.persistentVolumeClaim.claimName -&gt; /data ga mount</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: PersistentVolumeClaim<br>metadata: { name: uploads }<br>spec:<br>  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]<br>  storageClassName: gp3<br>  resources: { requests: { storage: 10Gi } }<br>---<br>spec:<br>  containers:<br>  - name: app<br>    volumeMounts: [{ name: data, mountPath: /data }]<br>  volumes:<br>  - name: data<br>    persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: uploads }</pre><pre>kubectl get pvc           # STATUS: Bound / Pending<br>kubectl describe pvc uploads   # Pending sababi: &quot;waiting for first consumer&quot; yoki provisioner xatosi<br>kubectl get pv</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PVC <code>Pending</code> — StorageClass yo'q/noto'g'ri yoki <code>WaitForFirstConsumer</code> (pod yaratilmaguncha normal).</li><li>PVC'ni o'chirish, reclaimPolicy <code>Delete</code> bo'lsa disk ham o'chadi — ma'lumot yo'qoladi.</li><li>RWO disk boshqa zonadagi node'ga ulanmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PVC — ma'lumot saqlanadi, lekin backup emas. Muhim diskler uchun snapshot jadvali va tiklash testi bo'lsin; iloji bo'lsa holatni managed servisga (RDS, S3) chiqaring.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-34253	<p>StatefulSet va Deployment farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Deployment</b> — stateless ilovalar uchun: pod'lar bir xil va almashtiriladigan, nomlari tasodifiy, umumiy yoki hech qanday disk. <b>StatefulSet</b> — stateful ilovalar uchun: barqaror nom (<code>db-0</code>, <code>db-1</code>), har pod'ga alohida doimiy disk, tartibli start/stop.</p><p><b>Nega farqi muhim:</b> web server'ning qaysi nusxasi so'rovni olishi ahamiyatsiz. Lekin DB klasterida <code>db-0</code> primary, <code>db-1</code> replika — ular o'z ma'lumotiga va o'z nomiga ega bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Deployment:   api-7c9f-abcde, api-7c9f-xyz12  (tasodifiy, parallel)<br>              pod o'lsa -&gt; yangi nom bilan qayta tug'iladi<br><br>StatefulSet:  db-0 -&gt; db-1 -&gt; db-2 (tartib bilan)<br>              db-1 o'lsa -&gt; yana &quot;db-1&quot; nomi bilan, o'sha PVC data-db-1 bilan<br>              DNS: db-1.db.prod.svc.cluster.local</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get deploy,sts<br>kubectl get pods -l app=db         # db-0, db-1, db-2<br>kubectl get pvc                    # data-db-0, data-db-1, data-db-2<br>kubectl scale sts db --replicas=2  # db-2 o'chadi, PVC qoladi</pre><p>| | Deployment | StatefulSet | |---|---|---| | Pod nomi | tasodifiy | tartib raqamli | | Disk | umumiy/yo'q | har pod'ga o'zi | | Start tartibi | parallel | 0,1,2 | | Service | oddiy | headless kerak | | Misol | API, web | PostgreSQL, Kafka |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>StatefulSet replikatsiyani o'zi qilmaydi — bu DB'ning ishi.</li><li>Scale down'da PVC qoladi — keyin qo'lda o'chirish yoki <code>persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy</code>.</li><li>Stateless ilovani StatefulSet'ga qo'yish — sekin rollout, keraksiz murakkablik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stateful tizimni K8s'da ishlatishdan oldin so'rang: managed servis (RDS, Cloud SQL) arzonroq emasmi? Agar K8s bo'lsa — xom StatefulSet emas, operator tanlang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-34254	<p>DaemonSet nima va qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DaemonSet — har (yoki tanlangan) node'da aynan bitta pod ishlashini ta'minlaydi. Yangi node qo'shilsa unga ham avtomatik pod tushadi, node olib tashlansa pod ham yo'qoladi. Ishlatiladi: log yig'uvchilar (Fluent Bit), monitoring agentlari (node-exporter), CNI (Cilium), CSI driver, xavfsizlik agentlari.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> har node'dan log va metrika yig'ish kerak. Deployment bilan &quot;har node'ga bittadan&quot; qilish qiyin va node soni o'zgarsa buziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>node-1: [fluent-bit]   node-2: [fluent-bit]   node-3: [fluent-bit]<br>            yangi node-4 qo'shildi -&gt; DaemonSet controller -&gt; [fluent-bit]<br>nodeSelector/affinity bilan faqat ma'lum node'larga (masalan GPU)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: apps/v1<br>kind: DaemonSet<br>metadata: { name: node-exporter, namespace: monitoring }<br>spec:<br>  selector: { matchLabels: { app: node-exporter } }<br>  updateStrategy:<br>    type: RollingUpdate<br>    rollingUpdate: { maxUnavailable: 1 }<br>  template:<br>    metadata: { labels: { app: node-exporter } }<br>    spec:<br>      tolerations:<br>      - operator: Exists          # taint'li node'larda ham ishlasin<br>      containers:<br>      - name: node-exporter<br>        image: quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter:v1.8.2<br>        resources:<br>          requests: { cpu: 50m, memory: 64Mi }<br>          limits:   { memory: 128Mi }</pre><pre>kubectl get ds -A           # DESIRED = CURRENT = READY = node soni<br>kubectl rollout status ds/node-exporter -n monitoring</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Taint'li node'larda (control plane, GPU) toleration yo'q bo'lsa DaemonSet pod'i tushmaydi.</li><li>DaemonSet resurslari har node'da ko'payadi: 100 node x 200Mi = 20Gi.</li><li><code>hostPath</code>, <code>hostNetwork</code>, privileged — DaemonSet'lar ko'pincha keng huquqli; xavfsizlik nuqtai nazaridan minimal huquq bering.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DaemonSet'lar node'ning &quot;soliq&quot;i — ularni kam, yengil va yuqori PriorityClass bilan saqlang, chunki ular bo'lmasa node &quot;ko'r&quot; (log/metrika yo'q) yoki tarmoqsiz qoladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::w7 Scheduling_scaling
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W7 K8s scheduling, scaling & storage	idrill-34255	<p>Job va CronJob nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Job</b> — bir martalik vazifani bajaradi va muvaffaqiyatli tugaguncha (yoki <code>backoffLimit</code> tugaguncha) pod'ni qayta yaratadi. <b>CronJob</b> — Job'ni jadval bo'yicha (cron formatida) yaratadi: kunlik backup, hisobot, tozalash.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Deployment doim ishlab turadigan narsa uchun; tugaydigan vazifa (migratsiya, eksport) Deployment'da bo'lsa, tugagach qayta-qayta ishga tushadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CronJob &quot;0 3 * * *&quot;  --har kuni 03:00--&gt;  Job backup-28123  --&gt; Pod<br>                                            pod xato -&gt; qayta (backoffLimit)<br>                                            exit 0  -&gt; Completed</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: CronJob<br>metadata: { name: db-backup }<br>spec:<br>  schedule: &quot;0 3 * * *&quot;          # daqiqa soat kun oy hafta_kuni<br>  timeZone: &quot;Asia/Tashkent&quot;<br>  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid       # oldingisi tugamasa yangisini boshlama<br>  jobTemplate:<br>    spec:<br>      backoffLimit: 2<br>      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400<br>      template:<br>        spec:<br>          restartPolicy: OnFailure<br>          containers:<br>          - name: backup<br>            image: postgres:17<br>            command: [&quot;sh&quot;,&quot;-c&quot;,&quot;pg_dump \&quot;$DATABASE_URL\&quot; Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W8 K8s security & troubleshooting	idrill-33296	<p>Pod Security Standards: privileged, baseline, restricted va securityContext?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pod Security Standards (PSS) — uchta tayyor profil: <b>privileged</b> (cheklovsiz, tizim komponentlari uchun), <b>baseline</b> (ma'lum xavfli narsalarni taqiqlaydi: privileged, hostNetwork/hostPID, hostPath, xavfli capability), <b>restricted</b> (qattiq: root emas, <code>allowPrivilegeEscalation: false</code>, barcha capability drop, seccomp RuntimeDefault). Namespace label'lari orqali Pod Security Admission (PSA) qo'llaydi; PodSecurityPolicy 1.25 da olib tashlangan.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> container ichidagi root + privileged + hostPath = container'dan node'ga chiqish oson. Restricted profil zaiflik topilganda ham zararni container ichida ushlab qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>namespace label: pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted<br>pod yaratish -&gt; PSA tekshiradi<br>   enforce: buzsa rad etadi<br>   audit:   audit log'ga yozadi<br>   warn:    kubectl'ga ogohlantirish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl label ns prod \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version=latest \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn=restricted<br>kubectl label --dry-run=server --overwrite ns prod pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted<br># -&gt; mavjud qaysi pod'lar buzishini ko'rsatadi</pre><pre>spec:<br>  securityContext:<br>    runAsNonRoot: true<br>    runAsUser: 10001<br>    fsGroup: 10001<br>    seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }<br>  containers:<br>  - name: api<br>    securityContext:<br>      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true<br>      capabilities: { drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;] }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Darhol <code>enforce</code> — mavjud workload'lar yangi pod yarata olmay qoladi. Avval <code>warn</code>/<code>audit</code>, keyin enforce.</li><li><code>readOnlyRootFilesystem</code> — ilova <code>/tmp</code>ga yozsa, emptyDir mount qiling.</li><li>Image ichida USER root bo'lsa <code>runAsNonRoot</code> pod'ni ishga tushirmaydi — Dockerfile'da <code>USER 10001</code>.</li><li>PSA faqat pod spec'ni tekshiradi; image tarkibi yoki registry'ni emas — buning uchun Kyverno/Gatekeeper.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default — barcha ilova namespace'lari <code>restricted</code>, istisnolar (CNI, CSI, monitoring agent) alohida namespace'da <code>privileged</code> va hujjatlashtirilgan sabab bilan. Nozik qoidalar (registry, label, resource) uchun PSA + policy engine birga.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w8 Security_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W8 K8s security & troubleshooting	idrill-33297	<p>RBAC'ni least privilege bilan qanday loyihalaysiz va tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Least privilege RBAC: har ilova/odam uchun alohida identity, imkon qadar <b>Role + RoleBinding</b> (namespace darajasida), aniq <code>verbs</code> va <code>resources</code>, <code>*</code> yo'q, <code>cluster-admin</code> faqat break-glass. Tekshirish: <code>kubectl auth can-i</code>, <code>--as</code> bilan impersonation, <code>rbac-tool</code>/<code>kubectl who-can</code> va audit log.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> CI ServiceAccount'iga &quot;qulaylik uchun&quot; cluster-admin berilgan. CI token sizib chiqsa — butun cluster, barcha Secret'lar bilan, hujumchiga ochiq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Subject (User/Group/SA) --RoleBinding--&gt; Role (namespace) : verbs x resources<br>                        --ClusterRoleBinding--&gt; ClusterRole (butun cluster)<br>RBAC faqat ruxsat beradi (deny yo'q): huquqlar yig'indisi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: Role<br>metadata: { name: deployer, namespace: prod }<br>rules:<br>- apiGroups: [&quot;apps&quot;]<br>  resources: [&quot;deployments&quot;]<br>  verbs: [&quot;get&quot;,&quot;list&quot;,&quot;watch&quot;,&quot;patch&quot;,&quot;update&quot;]<br>- apiGroups: [&quot;&quot;]<br>  resources: [&quot;pods&quot;]<br>  verbs: [&quot;get&quot;,&quot;list&quot;,&quot;watch&quot;]<br>---<br>apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: RoleBinding<br>metadata: { name: ci-deployer, namespace: prod }<br>subjects: [{ kind: ServiceAccount, name: ci, namespace: ci }]<br>roleRef: { kind: Role, name: deployer, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io }</pre><pre>kubectl auth can-i delete secrets -n prod --as=system:serviceaccount:ci:ci   # no<br>kubectl auth can-i --list -n prod --as=system:serviceaccount:ci:ci<br>kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.roleRef.name==&quot;cluster-admin&quot;) | .subjects'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar (yashirin keng huquqlar):</b></p><ul><li><code>secrets</code> <code>list</code>/<code>watch</code> — barcha Secret qiymatlarini o'qish degani.</li><li><code>pods/exec</code>, <code>create pods</code> — pod yaratib istalgan SA bilan ishlatish orqali huquq oshirish.</li><li><code>escalate</code>, <code>bind</code>, <code>impersonate</code> verb'lari va RBAC obyektlarini tahrirlash — o'zi admin bo'lish yo'li.</li><li><code>nodes/proxy</code> — kubelet API orqali har pod'ga exec.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odamlar uchun SSO guruhlari (OIDC) + guruhga bog'langan rollar, shaxsiy statik credential yo'q. RBAC'ni Git'da saqlang, PR review qiling va davriy audit (kim cluster-admin, kim secrets o'qiy oladi) avtomatlashtiring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w8 Security_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W8 K8s security & troubleshooting	idrill-33298	<p>NetworkPolicy bilan default-deny va kerakli trafikni ruxsat berish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval namespace'ga <b>default-deny</b> (ingress va egress) NetworkPolicy qo'yasiz, keyin faqat kerakli oqimlarni aniq ruxsat berasiz: DNS'ga egress, frontend -&gt; api, api -&gt; db va hokazo. NetworkPolicy faqat CNI qo'llasa ishlaydi (Calico, Cilium; oddiy flannel — yo'q).</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> default holatda har pod har pod bilan gaplasha oladi. Bitta zaif frontend pod buzilsa, hujumchi to'g'ridan DB'ga yoki boshqa jamoaning servislariga ulanadi (lateral movement).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>default-deny: podSelector {} + policyTypes [Ingress, Egress], qoidalar yo'q<br>   -&gt; hamma narsa yopiq<br>allow qoidalari qo'shiladi (yig'indisi ruxsat):<br>   web --8080--&gt; api --5432--&gt; db<br>   hamma -&gt; kube-dns:53<br>NetworkPolicy additive: deny qoidasi yo'q, faqat &quot;tanlangan pod'lar uchun ruxsat ro'yxati&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: default-deny, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: {}<br>  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]<br>---<br>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: allow-dns, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: {}<br>  policyTypes: [Egress]<br>  egress:<br>  - to:<br>    - namespaceSelector: { matchLabels: { kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system } }<br>      podSelector: { matchLabels: { k8s-app: kube-dns } }<br>    ports: [{ port: 53, protocol: UDP }, { port: 53, protocol: TCP }]<br>---<br>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: api-to-db, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: db } }<br>  policyTypes: [Ingress]<br>  ingress:<br>  - from: [{ podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } } }]<br>    ports: [{ port: 5432 }]</pre><pre>kubectl get netpol -n prod<br>kubectl run t --rm -it -n prod --labels=app=web --image=nicolaka/netshoot -- nc -zv db 5432   # bloklanishi kerak</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DNS egress'ni unutish — hamma ilova &quot;ishlamay qoldi&quot;.</li><li><code>from</code> ichida <code>namespaceSelector</code> va <code>podSelector</code> bitta element (AND) yoki ikki element (OR) — bitta tire farqi butun ma'noni o'zgartiradi.</li><li>Ingress controller, monitoring (Prometheus scrape) uchun ruxsat unutiladi.</li><li>L7 (HTTP path) filtrlash standart NetworkPolicy'da yo'q — Cilium/mesh kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default-deny'ni bosqichma-bosqich joriy qiling: avval Hubble/flow log bilan haqiqiy oqimlarni yozib oling, keyin policy yarating va audit rejimida sinang. Policy'lar ilova chart'ining bir qismi bo'lsin — ilova egasi o'z oqimlarini biladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w8 Security_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W8 K8s security & troubleshooting	idrill-33299	<p>Kubernetes Secret'larni xavfsiz boshqarish: External Secrets, Sealed Secrets, SOPS?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> K8s Secret'lar default'da faqat base64 (shifrlanmagan) — ularni Git'da ochiq saqlab bo'lmaydi. Uch yondashuv: <b>External Secrets Operator</b> (haqiqiy qiymat Vault/AWS Secrets Manager/GCP SM'da, operator K8s Secret'ga sinxronlaydi), <b>Sealed Secrets</b> (cluster kaliti bilan shifrlangan SealedSecret Git'da, controller ochadi), <b>SOPS</b> (fayl ichidagi qiymatlar KMS/age bilan shifrlanadi, Flux/Argo plugin ochadi). Qo'shimcha: etcd encryption at rest, RBAC, rotatsiya.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> <code>secret.yaml</code> Git'ga commit qilindi — repo'ga kirishi bor har kim (va har fork, CI log) parolni ko'radi; Git tarixidan o'chirish deyarli imkonsiz, faqat rotatsiya.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ESO:     Vault/ASM (manba) &lt;--IAM/WI-- ESO --&gt; K8s Secret --&gt; pod<br>Sealed:  kubeseal (public key) -&gt; SealedSecret (Git) -&gt; controller (private key) -&gt; Secret<br>SOPS:    sops -e (KMS) -&gt; secret.enc.yaml (Git) -&gt; Flux decrypt -&gt; Secret</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1<br>kind: ExternalSecret<br>metadata: { name: db-creds, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  refreshInterval: 1h<br>  secretStoreRef: { name: aws-sm, kind: ClusterSecretStore }<br>  target: { name: db-creds }<br>  data:<br>  - secretKey: password<br>    remoteRef: { key: prod/db, property: password }</pre><pre>kubeseal --format yaml &lt; secret.yaml &gt; sealed.yaml        # Sealed Secrets<br>sops --encrypt --kms arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc --encrypted-regex '^(data|stringData)$' secret.yaml &gt; secret.enc.yaml<br>kubectl get externalsecret -n prod                        # STATUS SecretSynced</pre><p>| | ESO | Sealed Secrets | SOPS | |---|---|---|---| | Haqiqat manbai | tashqi vault | Git | Git | | Rotatsiya | markaziy, oson | qayta seal | qayta shifrlash | | Bog'liqlik | vault + IAM | controller kaliti | KMS/age |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sealed Secrets private key'ini zaxiralamaslik — cluster qayta qurilsa barcha secret'lar ochilmaydi.</li><li>Secret'ni env sifatida berish — crash dump, <code>/proc</code>, log'larda ko'rinishi mumkin; fayl mount afzal.</li><li><code>get/list secrets</code> RBAC huquqi keng berilsa barcha yondashuvlar foydasiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi secret — yo'q secret: bulut resurslari uchun workload identity (IRSA, Workload Identity), DB uchun IAM auth yoki Vault dynamic credentials (qisqa muddatli). Statik secret qolsa — markaziy vault, avtomatik rotatsiya va audit.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w8 Security_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W8 K8s security & troubleshooting	idrill-33300	<p>OOMKilled pod'ni qanday tahlil qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OOMKilled — container cgroup memory limitidan oshdi va kernel uni SIGKILL bilan o'ldirdi (exit code 137). Tahlil: <code>describe</code> da <code>Reason: OOMKilled</code> tasdiqlash -&gt; memory grafigi (sekin o'sish = leak, keskin pik = yuk/katta so'rov) -&gt; ilova runtime sozlamasi limitga mosmi (JVM heap, GOMEMLIMIT, Node.js <code>--max-old-space-size</code>) -&gt; limit yoki kodni tuzatish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>limits.memory: 512Mi  -&gt; cgroup memory.max = 512Mi<br>ilova RSS + page cache (qisman) -&gt; 512Mi ga yetdi<br>kernel OOM killer (cgroup ichida) -&gt; SIGKILL -&gt; exit 137<br>kubelet -&gt; restart (CrashLoopBackOff bo'lishi mumkin)<br>Node darajasidagi OOM (limitsiz pod'lar) — boshqa hodisa: istalgan jarayon o'ldirilishi mumkin.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -A5 &quot;Last State&quot;<br>#   Reason: OOMKilled  Exit Code: 137<br>kubectl top pod api-x --containers<br>kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].resources}'<br># node'da kernel log<br>kubectl debug node/worker-1 -it --image=ubuntu -- chroot /host dmesg -T | grep -i &quot;killed process&quot;</pre><pre>container_memory_working_set_bytes{pod=~&quot;api.*&quot;,container=&quot;api&quot;}<br>/ on(pod,container) kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource=&quot;memory&quot;}</pre><p>Grafik o'qish: arra tishli o'sish va restart -&gt; leak; trafik pikiga mos sakrash -&gt; yuk; start'da darhol -&gt; limit juda past.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>JVM: <code>-Xmx</code> limitga teng — heap'dan tashqari (metaspace, thread stack, direct buffer) joy qolmaydi. <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75</code> ishlating.</li><li>Go: <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> qo'yilmasa GC limitni bilmaydi.</li><li>Faqat limitni oshirish — leak bo'lsa keyinroq baribir o'ladi va node'larni ko'proq band qiladi.</li><li><code>kubectl top</code> working set ko'rsatadi; OOM ham working set'ga qarab — RSS bilan adashtirmang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Leak shubhasi bo'lsa — profil (Go <code>pprof</code> heap, JVM heap dump OOM'da: <code>-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError</code> PVC'ga) oling. Alert: memory/limit &gt; 90% 10 daqiqa — OOM'dan oldin ogohlantiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w8 Security_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W8 K8s security & troubleshooting	idrill-33301	<p>Ingress/LoadBalancer orqali 502/503 — qayerdan qidirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> 502/503 — yo'lning qaysi bo'g'inida xato tug'ilganini aniqlang: tashqi LB -&gt; ingress controller -&gt; Service/endpoint -&gt; pod. <b>503</b> odatda &quot;backend yo'q&quot; (endpoint bo'sh, pod'lar Ready emas, LB health check o'tmagan). <b>502</b> — backend bilan ulanish buzildi (pod o'ldi/restart, noto'g'ri port/protokol, keep-alive timeout nomuvofiqligi, graceful shutdown yo'q).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client -&gt; Cloud LB (target health) -&gt; ingress-nginx pod -&gt; Service -&gt; pod:8080<br>   503: LB'da sog'lom target yo'q   | nginx: upstream'da endpoint yo'q<br>   502: nginx pod'ga ulandi, lekin javob buzildi/uzildi (reset, noto'g'ri protokol)<br>   504: pod javobi timeout'dan uzun</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -sv https://shop.example.com/api/health      # javob kimdan? Server header, body<br>kubectl logs -n ingress-nginx deploy/ingress-nginx-controller --tail=200 | grep -E &quot; 50[234] &quot;<br>#  upstream: &quot;http://10.0.3.15:8080&quot; ... upstream prematurely closed connection<br>kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api<br>kubectl get pods -l app=api            # Ready? RESTARTS?<br>kubectl describe ingress shop          # backend service/port to'g'rimi<br>kubectl port-forward svc/api 8080:80 &amp;&amp; curl localhost:8080/health   # ingress'ni chetlab<br>aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn ...                # LB target holati</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat deploy paytida 502 — graceful shutdown/preStop yo'q (eski pod o'ldi, nginx hali yuboryapti).</li><li>Backend HTTPS kutadi, ingress HTTP yuboryapti (yoki aksincha) — <code>backend-protocol</code> annotation.</li><li>Ilovaning keep-alive timeout'i ingress/LB'nikidan qisqa — ulanish ishlatilayotganda yopiladi, tasodifiy 502.</li><li>LB health check yo'li ilovada yo'q (404) — barcha target unhealthy, 503.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har qatlamda access log + upstream status/latency maydonlari bo'lsin (nginx <code>$upstream_status</code>, <code>$upstream_response_time</code>). Shunda &quot;502 kim qaytardi&quot; savoliga log'ning o'zi javob beradi; SLO'ni esa foydalanuvchiga eng yaqin qatlamda (LB) o'lchang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w8 Security_troubleshooting

Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W8 K8s security & troubleshooting	idrill-33394	<p>Admission controller va webhook'lar (mutating/validating) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Admission controller'lar — so'rov autentifikatsiya va RBAC'dan o'tgandan keyin, lekin etcd'ga yozilishidan <b>oldin</b> ishlaydigan plugin'lar. <b>Mutating</b> — obyektni o'zgartiradi (sidecar qo'shish, default label/resource). <b>Validating</b> — faqat ruxsat beradi yoki rad etadi (policy). Admission policy shu bo'shliqni yopadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>so'rov -&gt; AuthN -&gt; AuthZ (RBAC) -&gt; Mutating admission (ketma-ket)<br>       -&gt; schema validatsiya -&gt; Validating admission (parallel) -&gt; etcd<br>Webhook: apiserver --HTTPS (AdmissionReview)--&gt; servis -&gt; allowed: true/false (+ JSON patch)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy<br>metadata: { name: no-latest-tag }<br>spec:<br>  failurePolicy: Fail<br>  matchConstraints:<br>    resourceRules:<br>    - { apiGroups: [&quot;apps&quot;], apiVersions: [&quot;v1&quot;], operations: [&quot;CREATE&quot;,&quot;UPDATE&quot;], resources: [&quot;deployments&quot;] }<br>  validations:<br>  - expression: &quot;object.spec.template.spec.containers.all(c, !c.image.endsWith(':latest'))&quot;<br>    message: &quot;latest tag taqiqlangan&quot;</pre><p>(+ <code>ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding</code> bilan namespace'larga bog'lanadi)</p><pre>kubectl get validatingwebhookconfigurations,mutatingwebhookconfigurations<br>kubectl get validatingadmissionpolicies</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Webhook servisi ishlamasa va <code>failurePolicy: Fail</code> — butun cluster'da pod yaratish to'xtaydi (kube-system ham!). <code>namespaceSelector</code> bilan tizim namespace'larini chiqarib tashlang, webhook'ni HA qiling.</li><li><code>failurePolicy: Ignore</code> — xavfsizlik policy'si jimgina o'chadi.</li><li>Webhook timeout (default 10s) — API so'rovlarini sekinlashtiradi.</li><li>Mutating webhook'lar tartibi kafolatlanmagan — bir-biriga bog'liq mutatsiyalardan qoching.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Policy-as-code: qoidalarni Git'da saqlang, avval <code>audit</code>/<code>warn</code> rejimida, keyin enforce. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W8 K8s security & troubleshooting	idrill-33423	<p>Pod <code>Exit Code 143</code> bilan tugadi. 137 dan farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Exit code 128+N = signal N bilan o'ldirilgan. <b>143</b> = 128+15 (<b>SIGTERM</b>) — jarayon to'xtatish so'rovi bilan tugadi (odatda normal: pod o'chirilishi, rollout, scale down, eviction). <b>137</b> = 128+9 (<b>SIGKILL</b>) — majburan o'ldirildi: OOMKilled, grace period tugadi, yoki liveness muvaffaqiyatsiz.</p><p><b>Nega farqi muhim:</b> 143 ko'pincha &quot;ilova SIGTERM'ni o'zi ushlamadi, default handler bilan chiqdi&quot;
