Completed / 0<br>   handler yo'q (default)              -&gt; 143<br>   grace period ichida chiqmadi        -&gt; SIGKILL -&gt; 137<br>memory limit oshdi -&gt; kernel SIGKILL   -&gt; 137 + reason OOMKilled</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated}'<br># {&quot;exitCode&quot;:137,&quot;reason&quot;:&quot;OOMKilled&quot;,...}  yoki {&quot;exitCode&quot;:143,&quot;reason&quot;:&quot;Error&quot;}<br>kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -E &quot;Reason|Exit Code|Liveness&quot;<br>kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=api-x</pre><p>| Kod | Signal | Tipik sabab | |---|---|---| | 0 | - | toza chiqish | | 1 | - | ilova xatosi | | 137 | SIGKILL | OOM, grace tugadi, liveness | | 139 | SIGSEGV | segfault (native kod) | | 143 | SIGTERM | to'xtatish |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>137 + reason <code>Error</code> (OOMKilled emas) — grace period yetmagan yoki liveness; event'larni qarang.</li><li>PID 1 muammosi: shell skript PID 1 bo'lsa SIGTERM'ni bolaga uzatmaydi — <code>exec</code> yoki <code>tini</code>.</li><li>Job'da 143 — <code>activeDeadlineSeconds</code> tugagani bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ilovalar SIGTERM'da 0 bilan chiqishi kerak — shunda 143/137 lar haqiqiy anomaliya signali bo'ladi va alert'lar shovqinsiz ishlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::w8 Security_troubleshooting

identity = github.com/acme/api workflow? digest? -&gt; ruxsat / rad</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0<br>syft ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0 -o spdx-json &gt; sbom.json<br>cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:3f1c...<br>cosign attest --yes --predicate sbom.json --type spdxjson ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:3f1c...<br>cosign verify ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:3f1c... \<br>  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/acme/api/.*' \<br>  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com</pre><pre>apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1<br>kind: ClusterPolicy<br>metadata: { name: verify-images }<br>spec:<br>  validationFailureAction: Enforce<br>  rules:<br>  - name: signed<br>    match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Pod] } }] }<br>    verifyImages:<br>    - imageReferences: [&quot;ghcr.io/acme/*&quot;]<br>      mutateDigest: true<br>      attestors:<br>      - entries:<br>        - keyless:<br>            subject: &quot;https://github.com/acme/*&quot;<br>            issuer: &quot;https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat skanerlash — deploy paytidagi image boshqa bo'lishi mumkin; imzo + digest kerak.</li><li>Skaner natijalari &quot;har deploy fail&quot; bo'lsa jamoalar uni o'chiradi — fix mavjud bo'lgan CRITICAL'larga fokus, istisno jarayoni bilan.</li><li>Base image'lar ham bog'liqlik — minimal (distroless, Chainguard/Wolfi) va muntazam yangilanadigan tanlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maqsad — tekshiriladigan zanjir: &quot;bu pod'dagi image aynan shu commit'dan, shu CI'da qurilgan&quot; degan dalil. app]      har pod'da proxy<br><br>Ambient:<br> [app] -&gt; ztunnel(node A) ==HBONE mTLS==&gt; ztunnel(node B) -&gt; [app]       L4<br> [app] -&gt; ztunnel -&gt; waypoint (L7 Envoy, ixtiyoriy) -&gt; ztunnel -&gt; [app]  L7</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>istioctl install --set profile=ambient<br>kubectl label ns prod istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient     # restart shart emas<br>istioctl waypoint apply -n prod --enroll-namespace        # L7 kerak bo'lsa<br>istioctl ztunnel-config workloads<br># Sidecar:<br>kubectl label ns prod istio-injection=enabled &amp;&amp; kubectl rollout restart deploy -n prod</pre><p>| | Sidecar | Ambient | |---|---|---| | Resurs | har pod'da | node + waypoint | | Joriy qilish | pod restart | label, restart yo'q | | L7 | doim | faqat waypoint bilan | | Izolyatsiya | pod darajasida proxy | node ztunnel umumiy | | Yetuklik | uzoq yillik | yangiroq (GA 2024) |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ambient'da L7 policy waypoint'siz ishlamaydi — &quot;AuthorizationPolicy qo'ydim, ta'sir yo'q&quot; Interview Drill::Kubernetes::W8 K8s security & troubleshooting	idrill-42224	<p>Senariy: deploy'dan keyin yangi pod'lar Ready bo'lmayapti, rollout osilib qoldi, eski pod'lar hali trafik olyapti. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::K4 Helm & ArgoCD	idrill-33430	<p>Helm hook'lar nima? DB migratsiyani <code>pre-upgrade</code> hook bilan qilish xavflari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Helm hook — chart'dagi resurs (odatda Job) ni release hayot siklining ma'lum nuqtasida (<code>pre-install</code>, <code>pre-upgrade</code>, <code>post-upgrade</code>) ishga tushirish. DB migratsiyani <code>pre-upgrade</code> hook bilan qilish xavfli, chunki <code>helm rollback</code> sxemani qaytarmaydi va migratsiya o'rtada yiqilsa release yarim holatda qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Yangi kod ishga tushishdan oldin migratsiya bo'lsin&quot; uchun <code>pre-upgrade</code> Job yoziladi. Lekin rollback paytida yangi ustunlar/jadvallar qoladi — eski kod ular bilan ishlamaydi yoki yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: Job<br>metadata:<br>  name: migrate-{{ .Release.Revision }}<br>  annotations:<br>    &quot;helm.sh/hook&quot;: pre-upgrade,pre-install<br>    &quot;helm.sh/hook-weight&quot;: &quot;0&quot;<br>    &quot;helm.sh/hook-delete-policy&quot;: before-hook-creation,hook-succeeded<br>spec:<br>  backoffLimit: 1<br>  activeDeadlineSeconds: 600</pre><p><b>Xavflar va qoidalar:</b></p><ul><li><code>helm rollback</code> sxemani qaytarmaydi — migratsiya <b>backward-compatible</b> (expand/contract) bo'lsin.</li><li><code>activeDeadlineSeconds</code> yo'q bo'lsa osilgan Job release'ni <code>pending-upgrade</code> holatida qoldiradi.</li><li>Hook resurslari release tarkibida kuzatilmaydi — <code>hook-delete-policy</code> bilan tozalash kerak.</li><li>ArgoCD Helm hook'larini o'z sync hook'lariga (<code>PreSync</code>) map qiladi — <code>helm install/upgrade</code> bajarmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Non-idempotent migratsiya qayta ishga tushsa (retry) ikki marta qo'llanadi.</li><li>Hook Job fail bo'lsa upgrade to'xtaydi, lekin yangi pod'lar allaqachon chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Migratsiyani Helm hook'ga bog'lamaslik yaxshiroq — alohida, idempotent, backward-compatible qadam sifatida (expand → deploy → contract). Hook ishlatilsa ham sxema har doim eski kod bilan mos bo'lsin, aks holda rollback imkonsiz.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::k4 Helm_GitOps
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::K4 Helm & ArgoCD	idrill-33431	<p>Helm chart dependency (<code>Chart.lock</code>) va <code>values.schema.json</code> nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>Chart.lock</code> — chart dependency'larining aniq versiyalarini qotiradi (reproducible build), <code>values.schema.json</code> esa <code>values</code> ni deploy'dan oldin JSON Schema bilan tekshiradi (noto'g'ri tur/yetishmagan maydon — xato).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>version: 20.x.x</code> har build'da boshqa minor versiyani olib kelishi mumkin — &quot;menda ishladi&quot; muammosi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::K4 Helm & ArgoCD	idrill-33444	<p>ArgoCD sync waves va sync hooks (<code>PreSync</code>, <code>PostSync</code>) nima? Qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Sync wave — ArgoCD resurslarni belgilangan tartibda qo'llashini ta'minlaydi (<code>argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: &quot;-1&quot;</code> avval). Wave/hook bu tartibni boshqaradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>metadata:<br>  annotations:<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: &quot;-1&quot;      # Secret, CRD avval<br>---<br>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: Job<br>metadata:<br>  name: db-migrate<br>  annotations:<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: BeforeHookCreation</pre><p>Tartib: <code>PreSync hooks → wave -1 → wave 0 → wave 1 … → PostSync</code>. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::K4 Helm & ArgoCD	idrill-33478	<p>ArgoCD va Flux farqi? Qaysi birini tanlaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ArgoCD va Flux — ikkalasi GitOps CD vositasi (Git = yagona haqiqat manbai, klaster Git'ga moslashtiriladi). ArgoCD — boy web UI, markaziy, <code>Application</code> CRD; Flux — UI'siz, to'liq deklarativ, Kubernetes-native kontrollerlar. Nega <code>kubectl rollout undo</code> yoki ArgoCD UI'dagi rollback yetarli emas?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitOps'da rollback = Git'da buzuq o'zgarishni <b><code>git revert</code></b> qilish va push — ArgoCD/Flux eski holatni avtomatik tiklaydi. <code>kubectl rollout undo</code> yoki UI rollback yetarli emas, chunki ular klasterni o'zgartiradi lekin Git o'zgarmaydi — natijada drift yuzaga keladi va selfHeal uni darhol qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Prod'da buzuq versiya; shoshib <code>kubectl rollout undo</code> qilasiz — bir daqiqada ArgoCD selfHeal yana buzuq versiyaga qaytaradi. Rollback ham o'zgarish sifatida Git orqali, audit/review bilan. Favqulodda break-glass yo'li bo'lsin, lekin har doim Git bilan reconcile qilib yopiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::k4 Helm_GitOps

Interview Drill::Kubernetes::K4 Helm & ArgoCD	idrill-34054	<p>Helm bilan upgrade va rollback qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>helm upgrade --install myapp ./chart</code> — mavjud release'ni yangilaydi (yoki yo'q bo'lsa o'rnatadi); <code>helm rollback myapp &lt;revision&gt;</code> — oldingi revision'ga qaytaradi. <code>helm history</code> barcha revision'larni ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi versiya deploy qilindi, lekin pod'lar yiqilyapti — tez orqaga qaytish kerak. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::K4 Helm & ArgoCD	idrill-34055	<p>Chart'ni o'rnatmasdan qanday tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> O'rnatmasdan tekshirish: <code>helm lint</code> (sintaksis/best practice), <code>helm template</code> (render qilingan YAML'ni ko'rish), <code>helm upgrade --dry-run</code> (klaster bilan birga tekshirish), <code>helm diff</code> (plugin — nima o'zgarishini ko'rsatadi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>helm install</code> darhol klasterni o'zgartiradi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::K4 Helm & ArgoCD	idrill-34056	<p>Helm repo bilan qanday ishlaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Helm repo — chart'lar saqlanadigan manba (HTTP yoki OCI registry). <code>helm repo add</code> bilan qo'shiladi, <code>helm search</code>/<code>show values</code> bilan ko'riladi, <code>helm install --version</code> bilan aniq versiya o'rnatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Umumiy chart'larni (Redis, Postgres, nginx-ingress) noldan yozmaslik kerak — tayyor, sinovdan o'tgan chart'lar repo'da bor. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::K4 Helm & ArgoCD	idrill-34058	<p>ArgoCD'da &quot;OutOfSync&quot; nima degani?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ArgoCD'da &quot;OutOfSync&quot; — klasterdagi haqiqiy holat Git'dagi kutilgan holatdan <b>farq qiladi</b> degani. Sabab: Git'ga yangi commit tushgan (hali sync bo'lmagan), kimdir <code>kubectl edit</code> qilgan (drift), yoki kontroller maydonlarni o'zgartirgan (HPA <code>replicas</code>).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> ArgoCD UI'da ilova sariq &quot;OutOfSync&quot; — bu xatomi yoki normalmi? Farqni ko'rmasdan sync bosish xavfli bo'lishi mumkin (masalan HPA scale qilgan replica'ni qaytarib qo'yish).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Git (kutilgan) vs klaster (haqiqiy) solishtiriladi<br> farq bor -&gt; OutOfSync<br>Sabablar:<br> - Git yangilandi, sync bo'lmagan     -&gt; sync kerak<br> - kubectl edit (drift)                -&gt; selfHeal qaytaradi<br> - HPA/kontroller replicas o'zgartirdi -&gt; kutilgan farq (ignore kerak)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>argocd app diff myapp          # aniq nima farq qilyapti<br>argocd app sync myapp          # Git holatini qo'llash</pre><pre># Kutilgan farqlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirish (HPA replicas):<br>spec:<br>  ignoreDifferences:<br>    - group: apps<br>      kind: Deployment<br>      jsonPointers: [/spec/replicas]<br>  syncPolicy:<br>    automated: { selfHeal: true, prune: true }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>HPA + Git'da <code>replicas</code> ikkalasi — doimiy OutOfSync; <code>ignoreDifferences</code> bilan <code>/spec/replicas</code> ni chiqar yoki Git'da replicas yozma.</li><li><code>prune: true</code> — Git'dan o'chirilgan resurs klasterdan ham o'chadi; ehtiyot bo'l.</li><li><code>kubectl edit</code> bilan drift — selfHeal yoqilgan bo'lsa darhol qaytariladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> OutOfSync o'zi xato emas — kontekst muhim. selfHeal + ignoreDifferences to'g'ri sozlansa, drift avtomatik tuzatiladi, kutilgan farqlar (HPA) esa shovqin qilmaydi. <code>argocd app diff</code> — har doim sync'dan oldin ko'r. GitOps'da klaster Git'dan oqadi, drift anomaliya.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::k8s sec::k4 Helm_GitOps
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41061	<p>Kubernetes control plane'ning asosiy komponentlari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Control plane — klasterning &quot;miyasi&quot;: <code>kube-apiserver</code> (yagona kirish nuqtasi), <code>etcd</code> (holat bazasi), <code>kube-scheduler</code> (pod'ni node'ga joylash), <code>kube-controller-manager</code> (reconcile loop'lar) va cloud'da <code>cloud-controller-manager</code>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kubernetes deklarativ: siz &quot;3 ta replika bo'lsin&quot; deysiz, control plane esa haqiqiy holatni doimiy shu istakka yaqinlashtiradi. Har komponent bitta vazifani bajaradi va ular faqat API server orqali gaplashadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubectl apply --&gt; kube-apiserver --(authn/authz/admission)--&gt; etcd<br>                     ^      ^       ^<br>                     |      |       |<br>             scheduler  controller-mgr  cloud-controller-mgr<br>             (watch)    (watch+update)  (LB, route, node)<br>                     ^<br>                  kubelet (har node'da, watch)</pre><ul><li><b>kube-apiserver</b> — REST API, validatsiya, admission. etcd'ga faqat u yozadi. Stateless, gorizontal scale qilinadi.</li><li><b>etcd</b> — Raft asosidagi consistent key-value store; butun klaster holati shu yerda.</li><li><b>kube-scheduler</b> — <code>nodeName</code> bo'sh pod'larni ko'radi, filter (resurs, taint, affinity) va score bosqichidan keyin node tanlaydi.</li><li><b>kube-controller-manager</b> — Deployment, ReplicaSet, Node, Job, EndpointSlice, ServiceAccount controller'lari bitta binary'da.</li><li><b>cloud-controller-manager</b> — <code>type: LoadBalancer</code> uchun LB yaratish, node'ning cloud'dagi holatini tekshirish.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get pods -n kube-system          # kubeadm'da static pod sifatida<br>kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'      # apiserver sog'ligi<br>kubectl get lease -n kube-system         # scheduler/controller leader kim</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Managed klasterda (EKS/GKE/AKS) control plane ko'rinmaydi — uni provider boshqaradi, siz faqat API'ni ko'rasiz.</li><li>Scheduler va controller-manager HA'da bir nechta replikada turadi, lekin faqat bittasi leader (Lease orqali).</li><li>etcd sekin disk'da tursa butun klaster sekinlashadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Control plane o'lsa ishlab turgan pod'lar to'xtamaydi — faqat o'zgarish (deploy, scale, self-healing) to'xtaydi. Shuning uchun self-managed'da 3 control plane node + alohida SSD'li etcd standart.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41062	<p>Worker node'ning asosiy komponentlari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Worker node'da uchta asosiy komponent bor: <code>kubelet</code> (node agenti), <code>kube-proxy</code> (Service trafigi qoidalari) va CRI container runtime (containerd yoki CRI-O). Ular ustida CNI plugin tarmoqni beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Control plane faqat &quot;nima bo'lishi kerak&quot;ni yozadi. Haqiqatda container'ni ishga tushiradigan, tarmoqni ulaydigan va holatni qayta xabar qiladigan narsa node'da turishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kube-apiserver<br>     | watch: nodeName=bu-node bo'lgan pod'lar<br>     v<br>  kubelet --CRI(gRPC)--&gt; containerd --&gt; runc --&gt; container<br>     |   --CNI--&gt; pod'ga IP va interfeys<br>     |   --CSI--&gt; volume mount<br>     +--&gt; status (Ready, pod phase) apiserver'ga<br>  kube-proxy --watch Service/EndpointSlice--&gt; iptables/IPVS/nftables qoidalari</pre><ul><li><b>kubelet</b> — PodSpec'ni bajaradi, probe'larni ishga tushiradi, eviction qiladi, node lease'ni yangilaydi (heartbeat).</li><li><b>kube-proxy</b> — ClusterIP'ga kelgan paketni haqiqiy pod IP'ga DNAT qiladi.</li><li><b>Runtime</b> — Docker (dockershim) 1.24'da olib tashlangan; bugun containerd yoki CRI-O.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>systemctl status kubelet<br>journalctl -u kubelet -f            # pod nega start bo'lmayapti<br>crictl ps; crictl logs &lt;id&gt;         # runtime darajasida<br>kubectl describe node &lt;node&gt;        # Conditions, Allocatable</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Node <code>NotReady</code> — ko'pincha kubelet o'lgan, CNI o'rnatilmagan yoki disk to'lgan.</li><li><code>docker ps</code> bilan debug qilish endi ishlamaydi — <code>crictl</code> ishlating.</li><li>Cilium kube-proxy replacement rejimida kube-proxy umuman bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> kubelet'ga <code>kubeReserved</code>/<code>systemReserved</code> ajrating, aks holda pod'lar node'ning o'z servislarini bo'g'ib qo'yadi va node butunlay qulaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41063	<p><code>etcd</code> ichki tuzilishi va consistency'ni qanday saqlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> etcd — <b>Raft</b> consensus asosidagi distributed key-value store. Har yozuv leader orqali o'tadi, WAL'ga yoziladi va <b>majority</b> (quorum) tasdiqlagandan keyin commit qilinadi. Ma'lumot MVCC bilan revision'lar ko'rinishida saqlanadi, o'qish default'da linearizable.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Klaster holati bitta &quot;haqiqat manbai&quot;da bo'lishi kerak va node yiqilganda ham yo'qolmasligi, ikki xil versiyaga bo'linmasligi (split-brain) shart.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client --&gt; leader<br>             | 1. WAL'ga yozadi<br>             | 2. AppendEntries --&gt; follower1, follower2<br>             | 3. majority ack (3 dan 2)<br>             v<br>          commit --&gt; bbolt (MVCC, revision++) --&gt; client'ga OK</pre><p>| Member | Quorum | Chidaydi | |---|---|---| | 1 | 1 | 0 | | 3 | 2 | 1 | | 5 | 3 | 2 | | 4 | 3 | 1 (3 dan yaxshi emas) |</p><p>Quorum = floor(N/2)+1. Shuning uchun toq son: 4 member 3 dan ko'proq yiqilishga chidamaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 \<br>  --cacert=ca.crt --cert=server.crt --key=server.key \<br>  endpoint status -w table      # leader, DB size, raft index<br>etcdctl member list -w table<br>etcdctl get /registry/pods/default --prefix --keys-only | head</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sekin disk (fsync latency &gt; 10ms) leader election'larga va timeout'larga olib keladi — SSD/NVMe shart.</li><li>Member'larni AZ'lar orasida juda uzoqqa qo'yish latency'ni oshiradi.</li><li>Quorum yo'qolsa klaster read-only ham emas — yozish butunlay to'xtaydi; tiklash snapshot'dan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>etcdctl snapshot save</code> bilan muntazam backup va restore'ni mashq qiling. Monitoring: <code>etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds</code> p99 va <code>etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41064	<p>Kubernetes Pod nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pod — Kubernetes'dagi eng kichik deploy birligi: bir yoki bir nechta container, ular bitta IP, port maydoni (network namespace), IPC va volume'larni bo'lishadi va doim bitta node'da birga joylashadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Ba'zan ikki process juda yaqin ishlashi kerak: masalan ilova va uning log yuboruvchi sidecar'i. Ularni alohida joylash noqulay — Pod ularni &quot;bitta mantiqiy host&quot; sifatida birlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod (IP 10.1.2.3)<br>+-------------------------------+<br>| pause (namespace egasi)       |<br>| app      :8080   &lt;- localhost |<br>| sidecar  :9090   -&gt; localhost |<br>| volume: /shared (emptyDir)    |<br>+-------------------------------+</pre><p>Container'lar bir-biriga <code>localhost</code> orqali murojaat qiladi, lekin bir xil portni ikki container ochishi mumkin emas.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Pod<br>metadata: { name: web }<br>spec:<br>  containers:<br>  - name: app<br>    image: nginx:1.27<br>    ports: [{ containerPort: 80 }]</pre><pre>kubectl apply -f pod.yaml<br>kubectl get pod web -o wide     # IP, NODE<br>kubectl describe pod web        # Events: pull, start, xatolar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pod'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yaratmang — u o'lsa hech kim qayta yaratmaydi. Deployment/StatefulSet ishlating.</li><li>Pod IP vaqtinchalik; unga emas, Service'ga murojaat qiling.</li><li>Bir pod'ga bog'liq bo'lmagan servislarni tiqmang — ular birga scale bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pod — &quot;cattle&quot;, qayta yaratiladigan birlik. Dizaynda har qanday pod istalgan payt o'lishi mumkinligini hisobga oling: state tashqarida, graceful shutdown bor.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41065	<p>Pause (infra) container nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pause (infra) container — har pod'da birinchi ishga tushadigan juda kichik container. U hech narsa qilmaydi (<code>pause()</code> chaqirib uxlaydi), faqat pod'ning network, IPC va UTS namespace'larini ushlab turadi; ilova container'lari shu namespace'larga qo'shiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Agar namespace ilova container'iga tegishli bo'lsa, u restart bo'lganda pod IP va tarmoq yo'qolar edi. Pause container barqaror &quot;egasi&quot; bo'lib, ilova qayta ishga tushsa ham IP o'zgarmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubelet -&gt; CRI RunPodSandbox<br>   v<br>pause container (netns + IP, CNI shu yerga ulanadi)<br>   v<br>app container   --join netns/ipc/uts--&gt; pause<br>sidecar         --join netns/ipc/uts--&gt; pause</pre><p>Shuningdek, PID namespace bo'lishilsa (<code>shareProcessNamespace: true</code>), pause PID 1 bo'lib zombie process'larni yig'adi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>crictl pods                        # sandbox'lar (har pod uchun bittadan)<br>crictl ps -a | grep pause          # containerd'da ko'rinmasligi mumkin<br>crictl inspectp &lt;pod-id&gt; | grep -i ip</pre><p>Image: <code>registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10</code> (versiya kubelet/containerd konfigida).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Air-gapped klasterda pause image mirror'da bo'lmasa hech qanday pod start bo'lmaydi (&quot;failed to create sandbox&quot;).</li><li><code>kubectl get pods</code> da pause ko'rinmaydi — bu normal.</li><li>containerd config'dagi <code>sandbox_image</code> va kubelet kutgan versiya mos kelmasligi ogohlantirishlar beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Sandbox&quot; tushunchasi Kata Containers/gVisor kabi runtime'larda muhim: u yerda pod sandbox — alohida VM yoki kernel, pause esa shu chegarani ifodalaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41066	<p>Deployment, ReplicaSet va Pod farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Pod</b> — ishlab turgan container'lar. <b>ReplicaSet</b> — selector bo'yicha aynan N ta pod borligini ta'minlaydi. <b>Deployment</b> — ReplicaSet'larni boshqarib rolling update, rollback va versiya tarixini beradi. Amalda siz faqat Deployment yozasiz.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Yangi versiyani chiqarishda eski va yangi pod'larni bosqichma-bosqich almashtirish kerak. Bitta ReplicaSet buni qila olmaydi — Deployment ikki ReplicaSet'ni parallel boshqaradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Deployment (image v2)<br>   |-- ReplicaSet v1 (hash abc)  replicas 3 -&gt; 2 -&gt; 1 -&gt; 0<br>   +-- ReplicaSet v2 (hash def)  replicas 0 -&gt; 1 -&gt; 2 -&gt; 3<br>                                     |<br>                                   Pod'lar (ownerReference -&gt; RS)</pre><p><code>pod-template-hash</code> label har RS'ni ajratadi. Eski RS 0 replikada saqlanadi — rollback uchun (<code>revisionHistoryLimit</code>, default 10).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx:1.26 --replicas=3<br>kubectl set image deploy/web nginx=nginx:1.27<br>kubectl rollout status deploy/web<br>kubectl get rs -l app=web           # ikki RS ko'rinadi<br>kubectl rollout history deploy/web<br>kubectl rollout undo deploy/web --to-revision=1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>ReplicaSet'ni qo'lda tahrirlash — Deployment uni qaytarib yozadi.</li><li><code>maxUnavailable: 0, maxSurge: 0</code> bo'lsa rollout hech qachon tugamaydi.</li><li>Readiness probe yo'q bo'lsa rollout &quot;muvaffaqiyatli&quot; ko'rinadi, lekin ilova ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>progressDeadlineSeconds</code> va readiness probe bilan buzuq rollout avtomatik to'xtaydi; canary/blue-green kerak bo'lsa Argo Rollouts yoki Flagger qo'shiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41067	<p>StatefulSet nima va Deployment'dan farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> StatefulSet — har pod'ga <b>barqaror identitet</b> beradigan controller: doimiy nom (<code>db-0</code>, <code>db-1</code>), headless Service orqali barqaror DNS, har pod'ga o'z PVC'si (<code>volumeClaimTemplates</code>) va tartibli start/update. Deployment esa pod'larni o'zaro almashtiriladigan deb hisoblaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> PostgreSQL, Kafka, ZooKeeper kabi tizimlarda har node o'z ma'lumotiga va o'z nomiga ega: <code>kafka-2</code> qayta tug'ilganda aynan o'z diskini va nomini olishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>StatefulSet db (replicas 3, serviceName db)<br>  db-0 --&gt; PVC data-db-0   DNS: db-0.db.ns.svc.cluster.local<br>  db-1 --&gt; PVC data-db-1   DNS: db-1.db.ns.svc.cluster.local<br>  db-2 --&gt; PVC data-db-2<br>Start: 0 -&gt; 1 -&gt; 2 (oldingisi Ready bo'lgach)<br>Update: 2 -&gt; 1 -&gt; 0 (teskari tartib)</pre><p>| | Deployment | StatefulSet | |---|---|---| | Pod nomi | tasodifiy hash | tartib raqami | | Storage | umumiy yoki yo'q | har pod'ga o'z PVC | | Tartib | parallel | ketma-ket (default) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  serviceName: db<br>  replicas: 3<br>  volumeClaimTemplates:<br>  - metadata: { name: data }<br>    spec:<br>      accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]<br>      resources: { requests: { storage: 20Gi } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>StatefulSet o'chirilsa PVC'lar qoladi (xavfsizlik uchun) — qo'lda tozalang yoki <code>persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy</code>.</li><li>Pod buzuq bo'lib Ready bo'lmasa, keyingi update to'xtab qoladi.</li><li>StatefulSet replikatsiya yoki failover qilmaydi — bu DB'ning yoki operator'ning ishi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production DB uchun xom StatefulSet emas, operator (CloudNativePG, Strimzi) yoki managed servis tanlang — backup, failover, upgrade logikasi asosiy murakkablik.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41068	<p>DaemonSet nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DaemonSet — har (yoki tanlangan) node'da aynan <b>bitta</b> pod ishlashini ta'minlaydi. Yangi node qo'shilsa pod avtomatik tushadi, node olib tashlansa pod ham ketadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Ba'zi agentlar har node'da bo'lishi shart: CNI (Cilium), log yig'uvchi (Fluent Bit), monitoring (<code>node_exporter</code>), CSI node plugin, security agentlari (Falco).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>DaemonSet fluent-bit<br>  node-a --&gt; fluent-bit-xxxx<br>  node-b --&gt; fluent-bit-yyyy<br>  node-c (yangi) --&gt; controller avtomatik pod yaratadi</pre><p>DaemonSet controller pod'ga node affinity qo'yadi va default scheduler joylaydi; tolerations orqali control plane yoki tainted node'larga ham tushishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: apps/v1<br>kind: DaemonSet<br>metadata: { name: node-exporter }<br>spec:<br>  selector: { matchLabels: { app: ne } }<br>  template:<br>    metadata: { labels: { app: ne } }<br>    spec:<br>      nodeSelector: { kubernetes.io/os: linux }<br>      tolerations: [{ operator: Exists }]<br>      hostNetwork: true<br>      containers:<br>      - name: ne<br>        image: quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter:v1.8.2</pre><pre>kubectl get ds -A      # DESIRED / CURRENT / READY / UP-TO-DATE</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>tolerations: Exists</code> hamma taint'ga chidaydi — keraksiz node'larga ham tushadi.</li><li>Resource request'siz DaemonSet har node'dan kutilmagan resurs yeydi; 100 node'da ko'paytirib hisoblang.</li><li><code>hostNetwork</code>/<code>hostPath</code> ishlatadigan DaemonSet — kuchli privilegiya, PSA bilan cheklang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DaemonSet'larga yuqori PriorityClass (<code>system-node-critical</code>) bering — aks holda node to'lganda ilova pod'lari agentni chiqarib yuboradi va monitoring &quot;ko'r&quot; bo'lib qoladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41069	<p>Job va CronJob farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Job</b> — pod'larni ishga tushirib, belgilangan sonda muvaffaqiyatli tugashini (run-to-completion) ta'minlaydi. <b>CronJob</b> — cron jadvali bo'yicha muntazam ravishda yangi Job yaratadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Migration, hisobot, backup kabi vazifalar doim ishlamaydi — bir marta bajarilib tugaydi. Deployment ularni qayta-qayta restart qilar edi; Job esa &quot;tugadi&quot;ni tushunadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CronJob (schedule &quot;0 2 * * *&quot;)<br>   | har kuni 02:00<br>   v<br>Job backup-28812345<br>   | completions, parallelism, backoffLimit<br>   v<br>Pod --&gt; exit 0 = Succeeded | exit !=0 = qayta urinish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: CronJob<br>metadata: { name: backup }<br>spec:<br>  schedule: &quot;0 2 * * *&quot;<br>  timeZone: &quot;Asia/Tashkent&quot;<br>  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid        # oldingisi ishlayotgan bo'lsa yangisini boshlama<br>  startingDeadlineSeconds: 300<br>  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3<br>  jobTemplate:<br>    spec:<br>      backoffLimit: 3<br>      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600<br>      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400<br>      template:<br>        spec:<br>          restartPolicy: OnFailure<br>          containers: [{ name: b, image: backup:1.0 }]</pre><pre>kubectl create job manual-1 --from=cronjob/backup   # qo'lda ishga tushirish<br>kubectl get jobs; kubectl logs job/manual-1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Job pod'larida <code>restartPolicy: Always</code> mumkin emas.</li><li>CronJob &quot;kamida bir marta&quot; kafolat beradi: ba'zan ikki marta yoki o'tkazib yuborilishi mumkin — vazifa idempotent bo'lsin.</li><li><code>ttlSecondsAfterFinished</code> yo'q bo'lsa tugagan Job'lar to'planib qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Og'ir batch uchun <code>podFailurePolicy</code> (masalan exit code 42 = retry qilma) va Indexed Job'dan foydalaning; murakkab DAG'lar uchun Argo Workflows yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41070	<p>Kubernetes Service turlari (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ClusterIP</b> (default) — faqat klaster ichida virtual IP. <b>NodePort</b> — har node'da <code>30000-32767</code> oralig'idagi port. <b>LoadBalancer</b> — cloud'da tashqi LB yaratadi (ichida NodePort + ClusterIP). <b>ExternalName</b> — proxy'siz DNS CNAME.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Pod IP'lari o'zgarib turadi. Service ularga barqaror nom va IP beradi, trafikni sog'lom pod'lar orasida taqsimlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Internet --&gt; Cloud LB --&gt; NodeIP:31080 --&gt; ClusterIP 10.96.0.10:80 --&gt; pod:8080<br>            (LoadBalancer)  (NodePort)       (ClusterIP)<br>ExternalName: my-db.ns.svc --CNAME--&gt; db.example.com (IP yo'q)</pre><p>Har tur oldingisi ustiga quriladi: LoadBalancer o'z ichida NodePort va ClusterIP'ni ham yaratadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Service<br>metadata: { name: web }<br>spec:<br>  type: ClusterIP<br>  selector: { app: web }<br>  ports: [{ port: 80, targetPort: 8080 }]</pre><pre>kubectl get svc web<br>kubectl get endpointslice -l kubernetes.io/service-name=web   # pod IP'lar<br>kubectl run t --rm -it --image=busybox -- wget -qO- web</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>EndpointSlice bo'sh bo'lsa — selector label'lari pod'ga mos emas yoki pod'lar Ready emas.</li><li>Har servisga LoadBalancer — har biri pullik LB. HTTP uchun bitta Ingress/Gateway ishlating.</li><li>ExternalName'da TLS SNI/Host header muammolari bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>externalTrafficPolicy: Local</code> client source IP'ni saqlaydi va qo'shimcha hop'ni olib tashlaydi, lekin pod'siz node'lar health check'dan yiqiladi va yuk notekis bo'ladi — trade-off.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41071	<p>Headless Service (<code>clusterIP: None</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Headless Service (<code>clusterIP: None</code>) virtual IP ajratmaydi va kube-proxy uni balans qilmaydi. CoreDNS servis nomiga barcha Ready pod IP'larini <code>A</code> yozuvlari sifatida qaytaradi, StatefulSet bilan esa har pod'ga alohida nom beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kafka, Cassandra, DB cluster'larida client aniq qaysi node'ga ulanishini bilishi kerak (masalan leader'ga). Load balancer bu yerda xalaqit beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy:    nslookup web      --&gt; 10.96.0.10 (bitta VIP)<br>Headless: nslookup kafka    --&gt; 10.1.0.5, 10.1.0.6, 10.1.0.7<br>          nslookup kafka-0.kafka.ns.svc.cluster.local --&gt; 10.1.0.5</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Service<br>metadata: { name: kafka }<br>spec:<br>  clusterIP: None<br>  selector: { app: kafka }<br>  ports: [{ port: 9092 }]</pre><pre>kubectl run d --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 -- nslookup kafka</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Client DNS natijasini cache'lab qo'ysa (masalan eski JVM), pod IP o'zgarganda eski IP'ga ulanadi.</li><li>Ready bo'lmagan pod'lar DNS'da ko'rinmaydi — cluster bootstrap uchun <code>publishNotReadyAddresses: true</code> kerak bo'ladi.</li><li>Headless'da load balancing yo'q — client o'zi tanlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> gRPC client-side balancing uchun ham headless Service qulay: ClusterIP bilan HTTP/2 uzun ulanish bitta pod'ga &quot;yopishib&quot; qoladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41072	<p>Ingress va Ingress Controller farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Ingress</b> — L7 (HTTP/HTTPS) routing qoidalarini yozadigan API resurs (host/path, TLS). <b>Ingress Controller</b> — shu qoidalarni o'qib haqiqatda trafikni yo'naltiradigan reverse proxy (ingress-nginx, Traefik, HAProxy, AWS LB Controller). Controller'siz Ingress obyekti hech narsa qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> 20 ta HTTP servisga 20 ta LoadBalancer qimmat. Bitta LB + Ingress Controller host va path bo'yicha hammasiga tarqatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Internet --&gt; LB --&gt; Ingress Controller pod (nginx)<br>                       | api.example.com/   --&gt; svc api:80<br>                       | shop.example.com/  --&gt; svc shop:80<br>                       +-- TLS (Secret tls-cert)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: Ingress<br>metadata: { name: web }<br>spec:<br>  ingressClassName: nginx<br>  tls: [{ hosts: [api.example.com], secretName: api-tls }]<br>  rules:<br>  - host: api.example.com<br>    http:<br>      paths:<br>      - path: /<br>        pathType: Prefix<br>        backend: { service: { name: api, port: { number: 80 } } }</pre><pre>kubectl get ingressclass<br>kubectl describe ingress web     # ADDRESS bo'sh bo'lsa controller ko'rmayapti</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ingressClassName</code> yo'q — controller resursni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.</li><li>Annotation'lar controller'ga xos: nginx annotation Traefik'da ishlamaydi.</li><li>Community <code>ingress-nginx</code> 2026-yil mart oyida retire qilinishi e'lon qilingan — yangi loyihalarda Gateway API yoki boshqa controller rejalashtiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ingress API &quot;muzlatilgan&quot; — yangi imkoniyatlar Gateway API'ga qo'shiladi. Uzoq muddatli platforma uchun Gateway API'ga migratsiyani rejalashtiring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41073	<p>Kubernetes Gateway API nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Gateway API — Ingress'ning zamonaviy vorisi (GA 2023, v1.0+). Resurslar rollarga bo'lingan: <code>GatewayClass</code> (infra provayder), <code>Gateway</code> (platforma jamoasi: listener, port, TLS), <code>HTTPRoute</code>/<code>GRPCRoute</code>/<code>TLSRoute</code> (dasturchi: routing qoidalari).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Ingress'da hamma narsa bitta obyektda va annotation'lar orqali — header routing, trafik bo'lish (canary), cross-namespace ruxsat yo'q edi va har controller o'z &quot;dialekt&quot;ini qilardi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GatewayClass (cilium / envoy / istio)   &lt;- infra admin<br>   v<br>Gateway  ns: infra, listener :443 TLS   &lt;- platforma jamoasi<br>   v  allowedRoutes: namespace'lar<br>HTTPRoute ns: team-a  /api -&gt; svc v1 90%, v2 10%   &lt;- dasturchi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: HTTPRoute<br>metadata: { name: api, namespace: team-a }<br>spec:<br>  parentRefs: [{ name: main-gw, namespace: infra }]<br>  hostnames: [api.example.com]<br>  rules:<br>  - matches: [{ path: { type: PathPrefix, value: / } }]<br>    backendRefs:<br>    - { name: api-v1, port: 80, weight: 90 }<br>    - { name: api-v2, port: 80, weight: 10 }</pre><pre>kubectl get gateway,httproute -A<br>kubectl describe httproute api    # status.parents: Accepted / ResolvedRefs</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CRD'lar klasterga alohida o'rnatiladi (standard yoki experimental channel).</li><li>Boshqa namespace'dagi Service'ga murojaat uchun <code>ReferenceGrant</code> kerak.</li><li>Har implementatsiya hamma xususiyatni qo'llamaydi — conformance jadvalini tekshiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Gateway API service mesh (GAMMA) uchun ham standart bo'lib bormoqda — bitta API bilan north-south va east-west trafik.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41074	<p>Namespace'lar va ularning izolyatsiya chegaralari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Namespace — bitta klaster ichidagi mantiqiy bo'linma: obyekt nomlari, RBAC, ResourceQuota, LimitRange va NetworkPolicy uchun doira. Lekin u <b>to'liq xavfsizlik chegarasi emas</b>: default'da tarmoq ochiq, node va kernel umumiy.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Bir klasterda bir nechta jamoa yoki muhit (dev/stage) ishlaganda nomlar to'qnashmasligi, ruxsat va resurslarni ajratish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Namespace team-a: RBAC (Role), ResourceQuota (cpu 20), NetworkPolicy<br>Namespace team-b: ...<br>Umumiy: Node, PV, StorageClass, CRD, ClusterRole (cluster-scoped)<br>Tarmoq: team-a pod --&gt; team-b pod  (NetworkPolicy yo'q bo'lsa OCHIQ)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl create ns team-a<br>kubectl api-resources --namespaced=false     # namespace'ga tegishli bo'lmaganlar<br>kubectl create quota q --hard=cpu=20,memory=64Gi,pods=100 -n team-a<br>kubectl label ns team-a pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted</pre><p>DNS: <code>svc.team-b.svc.cluster.local</code> — boshqa namespace'dagi servis nomi to'liq yozilsa ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Namespace o'chirilsa ichidagi hamma narsa o'chadi; finalizer'lar sabab <code>Terminating</code> da qotib qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Privileged pod boshqa namespace'dagi pod'lar bilan bitta node'da — kernel orqali chiqib ketishi mumkin.</li><li><code>default</code> namespace'da production ishlatish — tartibsizlik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Soft multi-tenancy (ishonchli jamoalar) uchun namespace + RBAC + NetworkPolicy + PSA yetadi. Hard multi-tenancy (begona mijozlar) uchun alohida klaster, vCluster yoki sandbox runtime kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41075	<p>ConfigMap va Secret farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ConfigMap</b> — maxfiy bo'lmagan konfiguratsiya. <b>Secret</b> — parol, token, kalit; base64 bilan <b>kodlangan, shifrlanmagan</b>. etcd'da shifrlash faqat <code>EncryptionConfiguration</code>/KMS yoqilganda bo'ladi; kirishni RBAC cheklaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Konfiguratsiyani image ichiga tiqmaslik kerak — bitta image har muhitda boshqa config bilan ishlaydi (12-factor).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ConfigMap / Secret --&gt; env var    (pod start'da bir marta o'qiladi)<br>                  --&gt; volume fayl (kubelet ~1 daqiqada yangilaydi)<br>Secret: kubelet tmpfs'da (RAM) saqlaydi, diskka yozmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl create configmap app --from-literal=LOG_LEVEL=info<br>kubectl create secret generic db --from-literal=password='S3cr3t'<br>kubectl get secret db -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' | base64 -d   # oson ochiladi!</pre><pre>envFrom:<br>- configMapRef: { name: app }<br>env:<br>- name: DB_PASS<br>  valueFrom: { secretKeyRef: { name: db, key: password } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret YAML'ni git'ga qo'yish = parolni ochiq qo'yish. Sealed Secrets, SOPS yoki External Secrets ishlating.</li><li>Env var'dagi qiymat yangilanganda pod restart bo'lmaguncha o'zgarmaydi.</li><li><code>list secrets</code> ruxsati namespace'dagi hamma sirni ochadi.</li><li>Hajm limiti ~1MiB.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> KMS v2 bilan envelope encryption yoqing, Secret'larni tashqi manbadan (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) sinxronlang va o'zgarmas config uchun <code>immutable: true</code> qo'ying — kube-apiserver yukini ham kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41076	<p>PersistentVolume (PV) va PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>PV (PersistentVolume)</b> — klasterdagi haqiqiy storage bo'lagi (EBS disk, NFS share), cluster-scoped. <b>PVC (PersistentVolumeClaim)</b> — foydalanuvchining &quot;menga 10Gi RWO disk kerak&quot; degan so'rovi, namespace'ga tegishli. Kubernetes PVC'ni mos PV bilan <b>bind</b> qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Dasturchi diskning qayerdan kelishini bilmasligi kerak; admin yoki StorageClass storage beradi. Bu storage'ni pod hayotidan ajratadi — pod o'lsa ham ma'lumot qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod --volumes.persistentVolumeClaim--&gt; PVC (10Gi, RWO, sc gp3)<br>                                         | bind (1:1)<br>                                         v<br>                                        PV (EBS vol-0abc, 10Gi)<br>                                         |<br>                                       CSI driver -&gt; node'ga attach + mount</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: PersistentVolumeClaim<br>metadata: { name: data }<br>spec:<br>  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]<br>  storageClassName: gp3<br>  resources: { requests: { storage: 10Gi } }</pre><pre>kubectl get pvc data          # STATUS: Pending / Bound<br>kubectl get pv                # RECLAIM POLICY, STATUS<br>kubectl describe pvc data     # Pending sababi Events'da</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Delete</code> — PVC o'chirilsa disk ham o'chadi. Muhim ma'lumot uchun <code>Retain</code>.</li><li>PVC <code>Pending</code> — StorageClass yo'q, hajm mos emas yoki AZ muammosi.</li><li>PV bir marta bind bo'lsa boshqa PVC'ga avtomatik o'tmaydi (<code>Released</code> holat).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PVC — backup emas. VolumeSnapshot yoki Velero bilan backup oling va restore'ni sinab ko'ring; disk kengaytirish uchun <code>allowVolumeExpansion: true</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41077	<p>Dynamic provisioning (StorageClass) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dynamic provisioning — PVC <code>storageClassName</code> ko'rsatsa, CSI driver haqiqiy diskni (masalan AWS gp3) <b>avtomatik yaratadi</b> va PV'ni bind qiladi. Admin oldindan PV tayyorlab qo'yishi shart emas.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Static provisioning'da admin yuzlab PV'ni qo'lda yaratishi kerak edi. StorageClass &quot;disk shabloni&quot;ni beradi, qolganini Kubernetes o'zi qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PVC (sc: gp3) --&gt; external-provisioner (CSI) --&gt; cloud API CreateVolume<br>                                               v<br>                                    PV yaratiladi --&gt; PVC bilan bind<br>WaitForFirstConsumer: pod schedule bo'lguncha kutadi -&gt; disk pod'ning AZ'ida yaratiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: StorageClass<br>metadata:<br>  name: gp3<br>  annotations: { storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: &quot;true&quot; }<br>provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com<br>parameters: { type: gp3, encrypted: &quot;true&quot; }<br>reclaimPolicy: Delete<br>volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer<br>allowVolumeExpansion: true</pre><pre>kubectl get sc                 # (default) belgisi<br>kubectl describe pvc data      # &quot;waiting for first consumer&quot; — normal</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Immediate</code> binding'da disk <code>us-east-1a</code> da, pod esa <code>1b</code> ga tushadi — pod abadiy Pending.</li><li>Ikki default StorageClass bo'lsa natija kutilmagan.</li><li>In-tree provisioner'lar (<code>kubernetes.io/aws-ebs</code>) olib tashlangan — CSI driver o'rnating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Turli SLA uchun alohida klasslar (<code>fast-ssd</code>, <code>standard</code>, <code>retain</code>) yarating va default'ni ehtiyotkor (shifrlangan, expansion yoqilgan) qiling.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41078	<p>Storage access mode'lari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Access mode — volume qanday ulanishi mumkinligi: <b>RWO</b> (bitta node read-write), <b>ROX</b> (ko'p node read-only), <b>RWX</b> (ko'p node read-write), <b>RWOP</b> (faqat bitta pod read-write, 1.29'dan GA).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Har storage turi har xil imkoniyatga ega: blok disk (EBS) bir vaqtda bitta mashinaga ulanadi, NFS/EFS esa ko'pchilikka. Noto'g'ri mode tanlash pod Pending yoki ma'lumot buzilishiga olib keladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Mode | Kim yozadi | Misol storage | |---|---|---| | RWO | bitta <b>node</b> (undagi bir nechta pod ham) | EBS, PD, Azure Disk | | ROX | ko'p node, faqat o'qish | NFS, snapshot'dan | | RWX | ko'p node, yozish | EFS, NFS, CephFS, Azure Files | | RWOP | aynan bitta <b>pod</b> | CSI disk'lar |</p><pre>RWO: node-a [pod1, pod2] OK   node-b [pod3] --&gt; Multi-Attach error</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get pvc -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,MODES:.spec.accessModes<br>kubectl describe pod web | grep -A3 Multi-Attach</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>RWO &quot;bitta pod&quot; degani emas — bir node'dagi bir nechta pod yozishi mumkin; aniq bitta pod uchun RWOP.</li><li>Deployment rolling update'da RWO disk: yangi pod boshqa node'ga tushsa eski pod disk'ni bo'shatmaguncha kutadi — <code>Recreate</code> strategiya yoki StatefulSet.</li><li>RWX (NFS) ustida DB ishlatish — locking va performance muammolari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> RWX'ga ehtiyoj ko'pincha arxitektura signali: umumiy fayllar uchun object storage (S3) odatda yaxshiroq va arzonroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41079	<p>ServiceAccount nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ServiceAccount — pod'ning (inson emas, ilovaning) Kubernetes API'dagi identiteti. Pod'ga qisqa muddatli, audience'ga bog'langan token projected volume orqali mount qilinadi (<code>/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token</code>); RBAC shu identitetga ruxsat beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Operator, CI agent yoki ilova API'ga murojaat qilsa, kimligini isbotlashi va faqat kerakli ruxsatga ega bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod (serviceAccountName: app)<br>  token (JWT, ~1 soat, kubelet avtomatik yangilaydi)<br>   v<br>kube-apiserver: sub=system:serviceaccount:ns:app<br>   v RBAC<br>RoleBinding app -&gt; Role (get configmaps)<br>Cloud: IRSA / EKS Pod Identity / GKE Workload Identity -&gt; IAM rol</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl create sa app -n prod<br>kubectl create token app -n prod --duration=10m     # qo'lda token<br>kubectl auth can-i list pods --as=system:serviceaccount:prod:app</pre><pre>spec:<br>  serviceAccountName: app<br>  automountServiceAccountToken: false   # API kerak bo'lmasa</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har namespace'da <code>default</code> SA bor va avtomatik mount qilinadi — buzilgan pod token bilan API'ga chiqadi.</li><li>1.24'dan uzoq muddatli Secret token'lar avtomatik yaratilmaydi; eski skriptlar buziladi.</li><li>Bitta SA'ni ko'p ilovaga berish — least privilege buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SA token'ni OIDC orqali cloud IAM'ga federatsiya qiling — statik cloud access key'larini butunlay yo'qotadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41080	<p>RBAC: Role, ClusterRole, RoleBinding, ClusterRoleBinding farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Role</b> — bitta namespace'dagi ruxsatlar. <b>ClusterRole</b> — klaster bo'yicha yoki cluster-scoped resurslar (Node, PV) uchun ruxsatlar. <b>RoleBinding</b> — Role yoki ClusterRole'ni namespace ichida subject'ga beradi. <b>ClusterRoleBinding</b> — ClusterRole'ni butun klasterda beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;Kim nima qila oladi&quot;ni least privilege bilan boshqarish: dasturchi o'z namespace'ida deploy qila olsin, lekin node yoki boshqa jamoaning Secret'iga tegmasin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Role/ClusterRole = NIMA (apiGroups, resources, verbs)<br>Binding          = KIMGA (User, Group, ServiceAccount) + QAYERDA<br><br>ClusterRole &quot;view&quot; + RoleBinding ns:team-a  --&gt; faqat team-a'da view<br>ClusterRole &quot;view&quot; + ClusterRoleBinding     --&gt; hamma namespace'da view</pre><p>RBAC faqat ruxsat beradi (allow); &quot;deny&quot; qoidasi yo'q.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: Role<br>metadata: { name: deployer, namespace: team-a }<br>rules:<br>- apiGroups: [apps]<br>  resources: [deployments]<br>  verbs: [get, list, watch, create, update, patch]<br>---<br>kind: RoleBinding<br>apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1<br>metadata: { name: deployer, namespace: team-a }<br>subjects: [{ kind: Group, name: team-a-devs, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io }]<br>roleRef: { kind: Role, name: deployer, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io }</pre><pre>kubectl auth can-i create deploy -n team-a --as=alice --as-group=team-a-devs<br>kubectl auth can-i --list -n team-a</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>*</code> verb/resource — keyinchalik qo'shilgan resurslarga ham ruxsat beradi.</li><li><code>create pods</code> yoki <code>escalate</code>/<code>bind</code>/<code>impersonate</code> — amalda admin'ga chiqish yo'li.</li><li><code>roleRef</code> o'zgartirilmaydi — binding'ni qayta yaratish kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qayta ishlatiladigan ClusterRole + namespace'li RoleBinding — eng toza pattern. RBAC'ni muntazam audit qiling (<code>rakkess</code>, <code>kubectl-who-can</code>).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41081	<p>Admission controller nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Admission controller — so'rov autentifikatsiya va avtorizatsiyadan o'tgandan keyin, lekin obyekt etcd'ga yozilishidan <b>oldin</b> uni ushlaydigan plugin. <b>Mutating</b> obyektni o'zgartiradi (default qo'shish, sidecar inject), <b>Validating</b> esa qabul yoki rad qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> RBAC faqat &quot;kim nima qila oladi&quot;ni tekshiradi, lekin &quot;privileged pod yaratmang&quot; yoki &quot;har pod'da limit bo'lsin&quot; kabi mazmun qoidalarini tekshira olmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubectl --&gt; authn --&gt; authz (RBAC) --&gt; Mutating admission --&gt; schema validation<br>                                           (webhook, built-in)        v<br>                                    Validating admission (VAP, webhook) --&gt; etcd</pre><p>Built-in misollar: <code>NamespaceLifecycle</code>, <code>LimitRanger</code>, <code>ResourceQuota</code>, <code>PodSecurity</code>, <code>DefaultStorageClass</code>.
