In-tree: <code>ValidatingAdmissionPolicy</code> (CEL, 1.30 GA) — webhook'siz.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy<br>metadata: { name: replicas-limit }<br>spec:<br>  matchConstraints:<br>    resourceRules: [{ apiGroups: [apps], apiVersions: [v1], operations: [CREATE, UPDATE], resources: [deployments] }]<br>  validations:<br>  - expression: &quot;object.spec.replicas &lt;= 20&quot;<br>    message: &quot;replicas 20 dan oshmasin&quot;</pre><pre>kubectl get validatingwebhookconfigurations,mutatingwebhookconfigurations</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Webhook servisi o'lsa va <code>failurePolicy: Fail</code> bo'lsa — butun klasterda deploy to'xtaydi.</li><li>Mutating webhook'lar tartibi kafolatlanmagan; bir-biriga bog'lanmang.</li><li>Webhook'ni <code>kube-system</code> ga ham qo'llash — o'zini o'zi bloklash xavfi; <code>namespaceSelector</code> bilan istisno qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Oddiy qoidalar uchun webhook emas, CEL asosidagi ValidatingAdmissionPolicy/MutatingAdmissionPolicy afzal — tarmoq hop'i va qo'shimcha failure point yo'q.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41082	<p>Liveness, readiness va startup probe farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Startup</b> — ilova ishga tushib bo'ldimi (o'tguncha qolgan probe'lar o'chiq). <b>Liveness</b> — process tirikmi; yiqilsa kubelet container'ni <b>restart</b> qiladi. <b>Readiness</b> — trafik qabul qilishga tayyormi; yiqilsa pod Service endpoint'laridan <b>chiqariladi</b>, restart bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Process tirik bo'lishi uning ishlayotganini anglatmaydi: deadlock'da qotgan ilovani faqat liveness restart qiladi; cache isitayotgan ilovaga trafik yubormaslikni readiness hal qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>start --&gt; startupProbe (failureThreshold*period gacha kutadi)<br>            | OK<br>            v<br>        livenessProbe  -- fail N marta --&gt; restart container<br>        readinessProbe -- fail --&gt; EndpointSlice'dan olib tashlash</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>startupProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }<br>  failureThreshold: 30<br>  periodSeconds: 5          # 150s gacha start'ga vaqt<br>livenessProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }<br>  periodSeconds: 10<br>  failureThreshold: 3<br>readinessProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }<br>  periodSeconds: 5</pre><pre>kubectl describe pod web | grep -A5 -i unhealthy<br>kubectl get pod web -w    # RESTARTS ortib borayaptimi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Liveness ichida DB'ni tekshirish: DB sekinlashsa hamma pod'lar birdan restart bo'ladi — kaskad nosozlik.</li><li><code>initialDelaySeconds</code> kichik, startup probe yo'q — sekin JVM ilovasi cheksiz restart loop'ga tushadi.</li><li>Liveness va readiness bir xil endpoint va bir xil threshold — ma'nosi yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Liveness faqat &quot;process o'zini tiklay olmaydigan holatda&quot;ni tekshirsin (arzon, lokal). Dependency holati — readiness yoki umuman circuit breaker'ning ishi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41083	<p>Init container nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Init container — asosiy container'lardan <b>oldin</b>, ketma-ket ishlab, muvaffaqiyatli tugashi shart bo'lgan container'lar. Biri yiqilsa pod <code>Init:Error</code>/<code>Init:CrashLoopBackOff</code> holatida qoladi va asosiy container start bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Tayyorgarlik ishlarini ilova image'idan ajratish: DB tayyor bo'lishini kutish, config yuklab olish, fayl ruxsatlarini to'g'rilash. Asboblar (curl, git) asosiy image'ga kirmaydi — attack surface kichik.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>init-1 (wait-db) --exit 0--&gt; init-2 (migrate) --exit 0--&gt; app + sidecar (parallel)<br>       | exit 1<br>       v restartPolicy bo'yicha qayta urinish</pre><p>1.29'dan beri <b>native sidecar</b>: <code>initContainers</code> ichida <code>restartPolicy: Always</code> — u init sifatida start bo'ladi, lekin pod umri bo'yi ishlaydi (Istio, log agent uchun).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>initContainers:<br>- name: wait-db<br>  image: busybox:1.36<br>  command: ['sh','-c','until nc -z db 5432; do echo kutyapman; sleep 2; done']<br>- name: log-agent            # native sidecar<br>  image: fluent-bit:3.1<br>  restartPolicy: Always<br>containers:<br>- name: app<br>  image: app:1.0</pre><pre>kubectl logs web -c wait-db<br>kubectl get pod web     # Init:0/2, PodInitializing</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Migration'ni init container'da qilish: 10 replika = 10 ta parallel migration. Alohida Job yoki lock kerak.</li><li>Init container'da probe yo'q (native sidecar'dan tashqari).</li><li>Init resource request'lari pod request hisobiga kiradi (max qoidasi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;DB'ni kutish&quot; o'rniga ilovaning o'zi retry bilan ulansin — bu restart va network blip'larda ham ishlaydi; init container faqat haqiqiy one-time tayyorgarlik uchun.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41084	<p>Ephemeral container nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ephemeral container — ishlab turgan pod'ga <b>restart qilmasdan</b> debug uchun vaqtincha qo'shiladigan container (<code>kubectl debug</code>). Pod spec'da <code>ephemeralContainers</code> ga yoziladi, port, probe va resurs kafolati yo'q, olib tashlab bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Production image'lar distroless yoki minimal — ichida <code>sh</code>, <code>curl</code>, <code>tcpdump</code> yo'q. Restart qilsak muammo (masalan xotira oqishi) yo'qoladi. Ephemeral container shu holatni o'zgartirmasdan ichiga kirishga imkon beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod web<br>  app (distroless, PID 1)<br>  debugger-x (busybox/netshoot)  --target=app --&gt; app'ning PID namespace'ini ko'radi<br>  umumiy: network namespace (localhost, IP)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Ishlayotgan pod'ga debug container<br>kubectl debug -it web --image=nicolaka/netshoot --target=app -- bash<br>  ps aux                 # app process'larini ko'rasiz<br>  ss -tlnp; curl localhost:8080/healthz<br>  ls /proc/1/root/app    # app'ning fayl tizimi<br><br># Pod nusxasi (original'ga tegmaslik uchun)<br>kubectl debug web -it --copy-to=web-dbg --image=busybox --share-processes<br><br># Node'ni debug qilish<br>kubectl debug node/node-a -it --image=ubuntu    # /host ga node root</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--target</code> bo'lmasa process'lar ko'rinmaydi (alohida PID namespace).</li><li>Restricted PSA <code>--profile</code> ga qarab bloklashi mumkin; <code>--profile=restricted|netadmin|sysadmin</code> tanlang.</li><li>Ephemeral container o'chirilmaydi — pod qayta yaratilguncha spec'da qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>pods/ephemeralcontainers</code> subresource'iga RBAC ruxsati — bu amalda pod ichiga kirish huquqi; uni <code>exec</code> kabi kuchli ruxsat sifatida cheklang va audit qiling.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41085	<p>Pod Disruption Budget (PDB) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PodDisruptionBudget (PDB) — <b>ixtiyoriy</b> uzilishlarda (node drain, cluster upgrade, Karpenter consolidation) bir vaqtda nechta pod o'chirilishi mumkinligini cheklaydi: <code>minAvailable</code> yoki <code>maxUnavailable</code>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Node upgrade paytida 3 replikali servisning hamma pod'lari bitta node'da bo'lsa, drain ularni birdan o'chiradi va servis yiqiladi. PDB Eviction API'ni &quot;kut&quot;ga majburlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubectl drain node-a<br>   v Eviction API (DELETE emas)<br>PDB tekshiradi: Ready pod'lar - 1 &gt;= minAvailable ?<br>   ha  --&gt; evict<br>   yo'q --&gt; 429 Too Many Requests, drain kutadi va qayta urinadi</pre><p>Majburiy uzilishlar (node crash, OOM) PDB'ni hurmat qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: policy/v1<br>kind: PodDisruptionBudget<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  maxUnavailable: 1<br>  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow</pre><pre>kubectl get pdb      # ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS ustuni</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>1 replika + <code>minAvailable: 1</code> = drain hech qachon tugamaydi, upgrade qotadi.</li><li><code>kubectl delete pod</code> PDB'ni chetlab o'tadi — faqat eviction hisobga olinadi.</li><li>Selector boshqa servis pod'larini ham ushlasa hisob noto'g'ri bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>maxUnavailable</code> foiz bilan (<code>25%</code>) scale bilan moslashadi; <code>unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow</code> buzuq pod'lar drain'ni bloklashining oldini oladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41086	<p>Resource requests va limits farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Requests</b> — pod uchun rezerv qilingan resurs; scheduler shunga qarab node tanlaydi. <b>Limits</b> — yuqori chegara: CPU oshsa <b>throttling</b> (sekinlashadi), memory oshsa <b>OOMKill</b> (container o'ldiriladi).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Request'siz scheduler node'ni haddan tashqari to'ldiradi; limit'siz bitta &quot;shovqinli qo'shni&quot; pod butun node xotirasini yeb qo'yishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Scheduler: sum(requests) &lt;= node allocatable ?  (haqiqiy ishlatish EMAS)<br>Runtime (cgroup v2):<br>  cpu.weight   &lt;- cpu request (raqobatda ulush)<br>  cpu.max      &lt;- cpu limit   (100ms davrda kvota -&gt; throttle)<br>  memory.max   &lt;- memory limit (oshsa OOM killer)</pre><p>Birlik: <code>500m</code> = 0.5 CPU; <code>512Mi</code> = 512 MiB.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resources:<br>  requests: { cpu: 250m, memory: 256Mi }<br>  limits:   { memory: 512Mi }        # CPU limit ko'pincha qo'yilmaydi</pre><pre>kubectl top pod --containers<br>kubectl describe node node-a | grep -A8 &quot;Allocated resources&quot;<br>kubectl get pod web -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState}'  # OOMKilled?</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CPU limit latency'ni buzadi: ko'p thread'li ilova 100ms kvotani 20ms'da tugatib, 80ms kutadi (p99 o'sadi).</li><li>Memory request &lt;&lt; limit — node overcommit, keyin eviction.</li><li>JVM/Go heap limit'ni bilmasa OOMKill; <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage</code> yoki <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amaliy qoida: memory request = limit (bashorat qilinadigan), CPU request bor, CPU limit yo'q (yoki keng). Request'larni VPA tavsiyasi yoki real p95 ishlatishdan oling.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41087	<p>Kubernetes QoS klasslari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> QoS klass resurs sozlamasidan avtomatik chiqadi: <b>Guaranteed</b> (har container'da CPU va memory request = limit), <b>Burstable</b> (kamida bitta request/limit bor, lekin Guaranteed emas), <b>BestEffort</b> (hech narsa yo'q). Xotira bosimida birinchi BestEffort, oxirida Guaranteed evict qilinadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Node xotirasi tugaganda kubelet kimni qurbon qilishni hal qilishi kerak — QoS shu tartibni belgilaydi va OOM score'ga ta'sir qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | QoS | Shart | oom_score_adj | Eviction | |---|---|---|---| | Guaranteed | request = limit (cpu+mem, hamma container) | -997 | oxirgi | | Burstable | qisman | 2..999 | o'rtada (request'dan oshganlar avval) | | BestEffort | yo'q | 1000 | birinchi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get pod web -o jsonpath='{.status.qosClass}'<br>kubectl get pods -A -o custom-columns=NS:.metadata.namespace,NAME:.metadata.name,QOS:.status.qosClass</pre><pre>resources:     # Guaranteed<br>  requests: { cpu: &quot;1&quot;, memory: 1Gi }<br>  limits:   { cpu: &quot;1&quot;, memory: 1Gi }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta sidecar'da limit yo'q — butun pod Burstable bo'lib qoladi.</li><li>Guaranteed + butun CPU son + <code>cpuManagerPolicy: static</code> — eksklyuziv core beradi; buni bilmasdan latency farqini tushunish qiyin.</li><li>QoS yaratilgandan keyin o'zgarmaydi (in-place resize ham QoS'ni saqlashi kerak).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kritik servislarni Guaranteed qiling, batch ishlarni Burstable/BestEffort — node'dan samarali foydalanish va himoya o'rtasidagi balans.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41088	<p>Node affinity va pod anti-affinity nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Node affinity</b> — pod qaysi node'larga tushishi mumkinligini node label'lari bo'yicha belgilaydi. <b>Pod anti-affinity</b> — pod'ni boshqa pod'lar (odatda o'z replikalari) bor joydan uzoqroq joylaydi. Ikkalasida <code>required...</code> (qat'iy) va <code>preferred...</code> (afzal, og'irlik bilan) bor.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> GPU ilovasi faqat GPU node'ga tushsin (affinity); 3 replika bitta node'da bo'lmasin, aks holda node o'lsa servis o'ladi (anti-affinity).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>nodeAffinity:      node label'lari  (zone=a, gpu=true)<br>podAffinity:       &quot;X pod'lar bor topology'ga tush&quot; (cache yonida)<br>podAntiAffinity:   &quot;X pod'lar bor topology'ga tushma&quot;<br>topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname | topology.kubernetes.io/zone<br>IgnoredDuringExecution: label keyin o'zgarsa pod ko'chirilmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>affinity:<br>  nodeAffinity:<br>    requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:<br>      nodeSelectorTerms:<br>      - matchExpressions: [{ key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type, operator: In, values: [m6i.large, m7i.large] }]<br>  podAntiAffinity:<br>    preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:<br>    - weight: 100<br>      podAffinityTerm:<br>        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname<br>        labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>required</code> anti-affinity + replika soni &gt; node soni = ortiqcha pod'lar abadiy Pending.</li><li>Pod (anti-)affinity katta klasterda scheduler'ni sezilarli sekinlashtiradi.</li><li>Oddiy holatda <code>nodeSelector</code> yetarli — murakkab sintaksis keraksiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Replikalarni tarqatish uchun anti-affinity o'rniga <b>topology spread constraints</b> aniqroq va arzonroq; anti-affinity'ni &quot;bir node'da ikkitasi bo'lmasin&quot; qat'iy holatlar uchun qoldiring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41089	<p>Taint va toleration nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Taint</b> node'ga qo'yiladi va pod'larni &quot;itaradi&quot; (<code>key=value:Effect</code>). <b>Toleration</b> pod'ga qo'yiladi va mos taint'li node'ga tushishga <b>ruxsat</b> beradi, lekin u yerga <b>majburlamaydi</b> — buning uchun affinity/nodeSelector ham kerak.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> GPU yoki maxsus node'larga oddiy pod'lar tushib, qimmat resursni egallamasligi uchun. Shuningdek muammoli node'dan pod'larni chiqarish (<code>NoExecute</code>).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Effect | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>NoSchedule</code> | toleration'siz yangi pod tushmaydi | | <code>PreferNoSchedule</code> | iloji bo'lsa tushirma | | <code>NoExecute</code> | mavjud toleration'siz pod'lar ham chiqariladi (<code>tolerationSeconds</code>) |</p><pre>node gpu-1 taint: gpu=true:NoSchedule<br>pod A (toleration yo'q)  --&gt; X<br>pod B (toleration + nodeSelector gpu=true) --&gt; gpu-1</pre><p>Avtomatik taint'lar: <code>node.kubernetes.io/not-ready</code>, <code>unreachable</code> (default 300s tolerate), <code>node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl taint nodes gpu-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule<br>kubectl taint nodes gpu-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule-     # olib tashlash<br>kubectl describe node gpu-1 | grep Taints</pre><pre>tolerations:<br>- { key: gpu, operator: Equal, value: &quot;true&quot;, effect: NoSchedule }<br>nodeSelector: { gpu: &quot;true&quot; }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat toleration qo'yib &quot;pod GPU node'ga tushadi&quot; deb kutish.</li><li><code>operator: Exists</code> kalit'siz — hamma taint'ga chidaydi.</li><li><code>NoExecute</code> taint'ni qo'shish darhol pod'larni o'ldiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Dedicated node pool pattern: taint (begonalarni itar) + label va affinity (o'zinikini jalb qil) — ikkalasi birga.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41090	<p>Topology spread constraints nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Topology spread constraints — pod'larni failure domain'lar (zone, node, rack) bo'ylab <b>teng</b> taqsimlash qoidasi. <code>maxSkew</code> — eng ko'p va eng kam pod bo'lgan domain orasidagi ruxsat etilgan farq.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> 6 replika bo'lsa ham hammasi bitta AZ'da bo'lsa, AZ o'chganda servis o'ladi. Anti-affinity &quot;bittadan ko'p bo'lmasin&quot; deydi, spread esa &quot;teng bo'lsin&quot; deydi — ko'p replikada ancha moslashuvchan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>maxSkew: 1, topologyKey: zone<br> zone-a: 2   zone-b: 2   zone-c: 1   -&gt; yangi pod zone-c ga (skew saqlanadi)<br> zone-a: 3   zone-b: 1               -&gt; skew 2 &gt; 1, ruxsat yo'q<br>whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule (qat'iy) | ScheduleAnyway (afzal)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>topologySpreadConstraints:<br>- maxSkew: 1<br>  topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone<br>  whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule<br>  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  matchLabelKeys: [pod-template-hash]     # faqat joriy versiya hisoblanadi<br>- maxSkew: 1<br>  topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname<br>  whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway<br>  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }</pre><pre>kubectl get pods -l app=api -o wide    # NODE ustunidan taqsimotni tekshiring</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Spread faqat <b>scheduling paytida</b> ishlaydi; keyin muvozanat buzilsa avtomatik tuzatilmaydi (descheduler kerak).</li><li><code>matchLabelKeys</code> siz rolling update'da eski versiya pod'lari ham hisoblanib, taqsimot qiyshayadi.</li><li>Node'siz zone (autoscaler hali yaratmagan) hisobga olinmaydi — <code>minDomains</code> bilan majburlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zone bo'yicha <code>DoNotSchedule</code> + host bo'yicha <code>ScheduleAnyway</code> — amaliy default; klaster darajasida <code>defaultConstraints</code> bilan hamma workload'ga qo'llash mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41091	<p>Kubelet eviction manager nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubelet eviction manager node resurslarini (memory, disk <code>nodefs</code>/<code>imagefs</code>, PID) kuzatadi va chegara oshganda node'ni qutqarish uchun pod'larni <b>evict</b> qiladi. Bu kernel OOM killer'dan oldin, &quot;nazorat ostidagi&quot; himoya.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Agar node xotirasi butunlay tugasa, kernel OOM killer tasodifiy process'ni (hatto kubelet'ni) o'ldirishi va node <code>NotReady</code> bo'lishi mumkin. Eviction manager buni oldindan, tartib bilan qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>signal: memory.available &lt; 100Mi (hard)  -&gt; darhol evict<br>        memory.available &lt; 500Mi 1m30s (soft + grace) -&gt; evict<br>tartib: 1) request'dan oshgan pod'lar  2) PriorityClass  3) request'ga nisbatan ishlatish<br>node condition: MemoryPressure / DiskPressure / PIDPressure -&gt; yangi pod'lar tushmaydi<br>disk: avval image va o'lik container'larni GC, keyin evict</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># KubeletConfiguration<br>evictionHard:<br>  memory.available: &quot;200Mi&quot;<br>  nodefs.available: &quot;10%&quot;<br>  imagefs.available: &quot;15%&quot;<br>evictionSoft: { memory.available: &quot;500Mi&quot; }<br>evictionSoftGracePeriod: { memory.available: &quot;1m30s&quot; }</pre><pre>kubectl describe node node-a | grep -A6 Conditions<br>kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Failed | grep Evicted<br>kubectl get events -A --field-selector reason=Evicted</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Evicted pod'lar <code>Failed</code> holatda to'planib qoladi — vaqti-vaqti bilan tozalang.</li><li>Eviction tezligi kubelet poll intervaliga bog'liq; tez o'sgan xotirada baribir kernel OOM ishlaydi.</li><li>Log fayllari <code>nodefs</code>ni to'ldirib, DiskPressure va ommaviy eviction'ga olib keladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>systemReserved</code>/<code>kubeReserved</code> + to'g'ri request'lar eviction'ning asosiy oldini olish; eviction — oxirgi himoya chizig'i, normal ish rejimi emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41092	<p>PriorityClass va preemption nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>PriorityClass</b> pod'ga nisbiy muhimlik raqamini beradi. Yuqori prioritetli pod resurs yo'qligi sababli joylasha olmasa, scheduler past prioritetli pod'larni <b>preempt</b> qiladi (o'chiradi) va joy bo'shatadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Klaster to'lganda to'lov servisi batch hisobot ortida navbatda turmasligi kerak. Shuningdek kube-system komponentlari doim joy topishi shart.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pending pod P (priority 1000000)<br>  scheduler: hech bir node mos emas<br>   v<br>  node-a'da past prioritetli pod'larni olib tashlasa P sig'adimi?<br>   ha -&gt; victim'larni graceful o'chiradi, P.status.nominatedNodeName=node-a<br>   v<br>  P node-a'ga joylanadi</pre><p>Built-in: <code>system-cluster-critical</code> (2000000000), <code>system-node-critical</code> (2000001000).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: PriorityClass<br>metadata: { name: business-critical }<br>value: 1000000<br>preemptionPolicy: PreemptLowerPriority   # yoki Never<br>globalDefault: false<br>description: &quot;To'lov va auth servislari&quot;</pre><pre>spec:<br>  priorityClassName: business-critical</pre><pre>kubectl get priorityclass<br>kubectl get events | grep -i preempt</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma jamoa o'z servisini &quot;eng muhim&quot; qilsa tizim ma'nosiz bo'ladi — ResourceQuota bilan PriorityClass ishlatishni cheklang.</li><li>Preemption PDB'ni &quot;imkon qadar&quot; hurmat qiladi, lekin kafolat bermaydi.</li><li><code>preemptionPolicy: Never</code> — navbatda oldinda turadi, lekin boshqalarni o'ldirmaydi (batch uchun yaxshi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Overprovisioning&quot; pattern: manfiy prioritetli bo'sh pause pod'lar joy egallab turadi; haqiqiy pod kelganda ular preempt bo'ladi va autoscaler yangi node'ni oldindan qo'shadi — scale-up latency yashiriladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41093	<p>Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) — metrikaga (CPU, memory, custom yoki external) qarab Deployment/StatefulSet <b>replika sonini</b> avtomatik o'zgartiradigan control loop. Default har 15 soniyada tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kunduzi 20 pod kerak, tunda 3 ta yetadi. Qo'lda scale qilish kech va qimmat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>desired = ceil( current * currentMetric / targetMetric )<br>misol: 4 pod, CPU 90%, target 60% -&gt; ceil(4*90/60) = 6<br>metrics.k8s.io (Metrics Server)  -&gt; cpu/memory<br>custom.metrics.k8s.io (Prometheus Adapter) -&gt; RPS, queue<br>external.metrics.k8s.io (KEDA) -&gt; SQS, Kafka lag</pre><p>CPU foizi <b>request</b>ga nisbatan hisoblanadi — request yo'q bo'lsa HPA ishlamaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: autoscaling/v2<br>kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }<br>  minReplicas: 3<br>  maxReplicas: 30<br>  metrics:<br>  - type: Resource<br>    resource: { name: cpu, target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 60 } }<br>  behavior:<br>    scaleDown: { stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300 }</pre><pre>kubectl get hpa api -w        # TARGETS: 45%/60%<br>kubectl describe hpa api      # &lt;unknown&gt; bo'lsa metrics kelmayapti</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Deployment manifest'ida <code>replicas</code> qoldirilsa, har <code>kubectl apply</code> HPA tanlagan sonni qaytarib yozadi.</li><li>Memory bo'yicha scale ko'pincha ishlamaydi — ko'p ilova xotirani qaytarmaydi.</li><li>Pod'lar sekin start bo'lsa HPA kech qoladi; minReplicas'ni zaxira bilan qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CPU proxy metrika; navbat yoki RPS bo'yicha scale ko'pincha aniqroq. HPA'ni cluster autoscaler bilan birga o'ylang — pod qo'shilsa ham node bo'lmasa ular Pending.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41094	<p>Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) — pod'larning tarixiy ishlatishiga qarab CPU/memory <b>request</b>larini (va proporsional limit'larni) tavsiya qiladi yoki avtomatik o'rnatadi. Replika sonini emas, har pod &quot;o'lchami&quot;ni o'zgartiradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Dasturchilar request'ni taxminan yozadi: ko'pincha 4 marta ortiq (pul isrofi) yoki kam (OOMKill). VPA real ma'lumotdan to'g'ri qiymat beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Recommender  --&gt; Metrics/Prometheus tarixi -&gt; target, lowerBound, upperBound<br>Updater      --&gt; request juda farq qilsa pod'ni evict qiladi (Auto/Recreate)<br>Admission    --&gt; yangi pod yaratilganda request'ni o'zgartiradi<br>updateMode: Off (faqat tavsiya) | Initial | Recreate | Auto | InPlaceOrRecreate (yangi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: autoscaling.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: VerticalPodAutoscaler<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  targetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }<br>  updatePolicy: { updateMode: &quot;Off&quot; }<br>  resourcePolicy:<br>    containerPolicies:<br>    - containerName: &quot;*&quot;<br>      minAllowed: { memory: 128Mi }<br>      maxAllowed: { cpu: &quot;2&quot;, memory: 4Gi }</pre><pre>kubectl describe vpa api    # Recommendation: Target cpu 320m memory 410Mi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>VPA va HPA bir xil metrika (CPU) bo'yicha birga — bir-biriga qarshi ishlaydi.</li><li><code>Auto</code> rejimda pod'lar evict bo'ladi; PDB bo'lmasa uzilish.</li><li>VPA alohida o'rnatiladi (klasterda default yo'q).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng xavfsiz yo'l — <code>Off</code> rejimda tavsiyani yig'ib, uni GitOps orqali manifest'ga kiritish. 1.33+ dagi in-place pod resize VPA'ni restart'siz qilishga yo'l ochmoqda.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41095	<p>KEDA nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> KEDA (Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling) — tashqi event manbalariga (Kafka lag, SQS navbat uzunligi, RabbitMQ, Prometheus query, cron) qarab workload'ni scale qiladi, shu jumladan <b>0 gacha</b> va 0 dan. CNCF graduated loyiha.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Navbat consumer'i uchun CPU yomon signal: navbatda 100 000 xabar turgan bo'lishi mumkin, CPU esa past. Bundan tashqari, bo'sh paytda 0 replika — pul tejaydi; oddiy HPA min 1.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ScaledObject --&gt; KEDA operator<br>                   | 0 &lt;-&gt; 1 (o'zi aktivatsiya qiladi)<br>                   | 1 &lt;-&gt; N (HPA yaratib, external metrics beradi)<br>                   v<br>             scaler: kafka / aws-sqs-queue / prometheus / cron ...</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1<br>kind: ScaledObject<br>metadata: { name: orders-consumer }<br>spec:<br>  scaleTargetRef: { name: orders-consumer }<br>  minReplicaCount: 0<br>  maxReplicaCount: 50<br>  cooldownPeriod: 300<br>  triggers:<br>  - type: kafka<br>    metadata:<br>      bootstrapServers: kafka:9092<br>      consumerGroup: orders<br>      topic: orders<br>      lagThreshold: &quot;1000&quot;</pre><pre>kubectl get scaledobject; kubectl get hpa     # keda-hpa-orders-consumer</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kafka'da replika soni partition sonidan oshsa ortiqcha pod'lar bekor turadi.</li><li>0 dan 1 ga o'tish — cold start; latency-sezgir HTTP uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.</li><li>Bir workload'ga ham KEDA, ham qo'lda yozilgan HPA — to'qnashuv.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Uzoq ishlaydigan vazifalar uchun <code>ScaledJob</code> — har xabar uchun Job; scale-down paytida ishni yarimda o'ldirmaslik uchun graceful shutdown muhim.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41096	<p>Karpenter nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Karpenter — ochiq kodli node autoscaler (AWS boshlagan, endi Kubernetes SIG Autoscaling ostida; Azure provider ham bor). U Pending pod'lar talablarini ko'rib, ASG/node group'larsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri mos instance'larni (EC2 Fleet API) soniyalar ichida yaratadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Cluster Autoscaler oldindan belgilangan node group'lar bilan ishlaydi: har instance turi uchun alohida ASG, sekin va moslashuvchan emas. Karpenter pod'ga qarab &quot;eng arzon mos&quot; instance'ni tanlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pending pod'lar (cpu, mem, arch, zone, spot/on-demand talablari)<br>   v batch<br>Karpenter: NodePool cheklovlari ichida instance tanlaydi (bin-packing, narx)<br>   v EC2 Fleet CreateFleet<br>NodeClaim -&gt; EC2 -&gt; kubelet join -&gt; pod'lar joylanadi</pre><p>v1 API (2024): <code>NodePool</code> (talablar, limitlar, disruption) va <code>EC2NodeClass</code> (AMI, subnet, SG, IAM).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1<br>kind: NodePool<br>metadata: { name: default }<br>spec:<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      nodeClassRef: { group: karpenter.k8s.aws, kind: EC2NodeClass, name: default }<br>      requirements:<br>      - { key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type, operator: In, values: [spot, on-demand] }<br>      - { key: kubernetes.io/arch, operator: In, values: [amd64, arm64] }<br>  limits: { cpu: &quot;1000&quot; }</pre><pre>kubectl get nodepool,nodeclaim<br>kubectl logs -n kube-system deploy/karpenter | grep -i launched</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>limits</code> yo'q — xato workload cheksiz node yaratib, katta hisob chiqaradi.</li><li>Karpenter controller'ining o'zi Karpenter yaratgan node'da tursa — o'zini o'chirib qo'yishi mumkin; uni Fargate yoki alohida managed node group'da ishlating.</li><li>Spot uchun interruption handling (SQS navbati) sozlanmasa pod'lar ogohlantirishsiz o'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Instance turlarini keng ochiq qoldiring (ko'p oila, ko'p arch) — Spot mavjudligi va narx optimallashuvi shundan keladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41097	<p>Karpenter consolidation nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Consolidation — Karpenter'ning node sonini va narxini kamaytirish mexanizmi: kam yuklangan node'lardagi pod'larni boshqa node'larga ko'chirib, bo'sh qolgan node'ni o'chiradi yoki uni arzonroq/kichikroq instance bilan almashtiradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Scale-up'dan keyin yuk tushganda node'lar 20% band holda qoladi — pul isrof. Consolidation klasterni doimiy &quot;zichlab&quot; turadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>disruption:<br>  consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized | WhenEmpty<br>  consolidateAfter: 1m<br>Karpenter simulyatsiya qiladi:<br>  node-x pod'lari boshqa node'larga sig'adimi? -&gt; ha -&gt; Delete<br>  yoki bitta arzonroq node'ga sig'adimi?      -&gt; Replace<br>  -&gt; node taint qilinadi -&gt; pod'lar eviction (PDB hurmat) -&gt; terminate</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  disruption:<br>    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized<br>    consolidateAfter: 5m<br>    budgets:<br>    - nodes: &quot;10%&quot;                                  # bir vaqtda maks 10%<br>    - nodes: &quot;0&quot;<br>      schedule: &quot;0 9 * * mon-fri&quot;                   # ish vaqtida to'xtat<br>      duration: 8h</pre><pre>metadata:<br>  annotations: { karpenter.sh/do-not-disrupt: &quot;true&quot; }   # muhim pod'ni himoya</pre><pre>kubectl get events -A | grep -i -E 'disrupt|consolidat'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PDB'siz servislar consolidation paytida uziladi.</li><li>Juda agressiv consolidation — doimiy pod &quot;churn&quot;, cold cache, uzun Job'lar o'ldiriladi.</li><li>Request'lar noto'g'ri bo'lsa Karpenter haqiqiy yukni bilmaydi — zich joylab, keyin throttling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Disruption budget'lar va <code>do-not-disrupt</code> bilan narx tejash va barqarorlik o'rtasida balans qiling; tejamni aniq request'lar bilan birga o'lchang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41098	<p>Cluster Autoscaler (CA) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cluster Autoscaler (CA) — an'anaviy node autoscaler: pod'lar resurs yo'qligidan <code>Pending</code> bo'lsa node group'ning (AWS ASG, GCP MIG, Azure VMSS) desired sonini oshiradi, node'lar uzoq vaqt kam band bo'lsa ularni olib tashlaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> HPA pod qo'shadi, lekin node'lar to'la bo'lsa pod'lar joylashmaydi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41099	<p>Kubernetes'da CoreDNS nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CoreDNS — klaster ichidagi DNS server (Deployment, <code>kube-dns</code> Service orqali). U servis nomlarini (<code>my-svc.my-ns.svc.cluster.local</code>) ClusterIP'ga, headless servislarda pod IP'larga resolve qiladi, tashqi domenlarni esa upstream DNS'ga forward qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Pod'lar bir-birini IP orqali emas, barqaror nom orqali topishi kerak — service discovery'ning asosi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pod /etc/resolv.conf:<br>  nameserver 10.96.0.10<br>  search ns.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local<br>  options ndots:5<br>&quot;api&quot; so'rovi -&gt; api.ns.svc.cluster.local -&gt; CoreDNS (kubernetes plugin, watch Service/EndpointSlice)<br>&quot;google.com&quot;  -&gt; avval search domain'lar bilan 3-4 marta NXDOMAIN, keyin forward -&gt; upstream</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl -n kube-system get cm coredns -o yaml        # Corefile<br>kubectl run d --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 -- nslookup kubernetes.default<br>kubectl -n kube-system logs -l k8s-app=kube-dns</pre><pre>.:53 {<br>    errors<br>    health<br>    kubernetes cluster.local in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa { pods insecure; fallthrough in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa }<br>    prometheus :9153<br>    forward . /etc/resolv.conf<br>    cache 30<br>    loop<br>    reload<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ndots:5</code> tashqi nomlar uchun 4-5 marta ortiqcha so'rov beradi — FQDN oxiriga nuqta (<code>api.example.com.</code>) yoki <code>dnsConfig</code> bilan <code>ndots: 2</code>.</li><li>CoreDNS replika kam — katta klasterda DNS timeout'lar (<code>cluster-proportional-autoscaler</code> ishlating).</li><li><code>loop</code> plugin node'ning resolv.conf'i 127.0.0.53 bo'lsa CoreDNS'ni CrashLoop'ga tushiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Ba'zan 5 soniya kechikish&quot; — klassik conntrack/UDP race muammosi; yechim NodeLocal DNSCache va DNS metrikalarini (<code>coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds</code>) kuzatish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41100	<p>NodeLocal DNSCache nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> NodeLocal DNSCache — har node'da DaemonSet sifatida ishlaydigan lokal DNS cache (link-local IP <code>169.254.20.10</code>). Pod'lar DNS so'rovini avval shu lokal agentga yuboradi; cache miss bo'lsa u CoreDNS'ga TCP orqali murojaat qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Katta klasterda har DNS so'rovi tarmoq orqali CoreDNS'ga boradi; UDP + conntrack race sabab paketlar yo'qoladi (5s timeout), <code>ndots:5</code> esa so'rovlar sonini ko'paytiradi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41101	<p>Endpoints va EndpointSlice API farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Endpoints</b> — Service ortidagi barcha pod IP'larini bitta obyektda saqlaydi. <b>EndpointSlice</b> — ularni bo'laklarga (default maks 100 endpoint) ajratadi. Endpoints API 1.33'da deprecated; kube-proxy, CoreDNS va ingress'lar EndpointSlice'dan foydalanadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> 5000 pod'li servisda bitta pod o'zgarsa, butun ulkan Endpoints obyekti qayta yoziladi va har node'dagi kube-proxy'ga to'liq yuboriladi — etcd, apiserver va tarmoqqa katta yuk.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Endpoints:      [ 5000 IP ] --1 pod o'zgardi--&gt; butun 5000 qayta yuboriladi<br>EndpointSlice:  slice-1 [100] slice-2 [100] ... slice-50 [100]<br>                --1 pod o'zgardi--&gt; faqat bitta slice (100) yangilanadi</pre><p>EndpointSlice qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi: <code>ready</code>/<code>serving</code>/<code>terminating</code> holatlari, <code>zone</code> va <code>nodeName</code> (topology-aware routing uchun), dual-stack (IPv4 va IPv6 alohida slice).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api<br>kubectl get endpointslice api-abc12 -o yaml | grep -A4 conditions</pre><p>Ilova o'z kodida servis a'zolarini kuzatsa — <code>discovery.k8s.io/v1</code> EndpointSlice'ga o'ting.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski operator/skriptlar <code>Endpoints</code> ni o'qiydi — 1000 dan ortiq endpoint'da u kesiladi (<code>endpoints.kubernetes.io/over-capacity</code>).</li><li>Bitta servisga bir nechta slice — ularni birlashtirib o'qish kerak, birinchisi emas.</li><li>Selector'siz Service uchun slice'larni qo'lda yaratganda <code>kubernetes.io/service-name</code> label'ini unutish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> EndpointSlice <code>terminating</code> holati graceful shutdown'ni yaxshilaydi: proxy yangi ulanishlarni yubormaydi, lekin mavjud ulanishlar tugashiga imkon beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41102	<p><code>kube-proxy</code> IPVS va iptables rejimi farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>iptables</b> rejimi har servis/endpoint uchun ketma-ket qoidalar zanjirini yaratadi — paket moslash O(N) va katta klasterda yangilash sekin. <b>IPVS</b> rejimi kernel'dagi hash jadvalli L4 load balancer'dan foydalanadi — O(1) qidiruv va ko'proq algoritm (rr, lc, sh). 1.31'dan <b>nftables</b> rejimi ham bor (1.33'da GA) va kelajakdagi tavsiya.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> 10 000 servisli klasterda iptables qoidalari yuz minglab bo'ladi: har o'zgarishda butun jadval qayta yoziladi (soniyalar), birinchi paket latency'si o'sadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>iptables: KUBE-SERVICES -&gt; KUBE-SVC-xxx -&gt; (random probability) -&gt; KUBE-SEP-yyy -&gt; DNAT<br>          N ta qoida ketma-ket tekshiriladi<br>IPVS:     virtual server 10.96.0.10:80 --hash--&gt; real server'lar (pod IP)<br>nftables: map/set'lar bilan O(1) ga yaqin, qisman (incremental) yangilash</pre><p>| | iptables | IPVS | nftables | |---|---|---|---| | Lookup | O(N) | O(1) | O(1) | | Yangilash | butun jadval | incremental | incremental | | Holat | default, eski | maintenance | yangi tavsiya |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl -n kube-system get cm kube-proxy -o yaml | grep mode<br>iptables-save | grep -c KUBE-SEP        # qoida soni<br>ipvsadm -Ln                              # IPVS rejimida<br>nft list table ip kube-proxy             # nftables rejimida</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>IPVS ham ba'zi ishlar uchun iptables'dan foydalanadi (masquerade, NodePort filter) — &quot;iptables'siz&quot; emas.</li><li>IPVS kernel modullari (<code>ip_vs</code>, <code>ip_vs_rr</code>) yuklanmagan bo'lsa iptables'ga qaytadi.</li><li>Rejim almashtirgandan keyin eski qoidalar qoladi — <code>kube-proxy --cleanup</code> yoki node reboot.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi klasterda yoki nftables, yoki eBPF (Cilium kube-proxy replacement) tanlang; IPVS loyihasi faol rivojlanmayapti.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41103	<p>Cilium eBPF CNI nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cilium — eBPF asosidagi CNI: pod tarmog'i, Service load balancing (kube-proxy o'rniga), NetworkPolicy (L3/L4 va L7), shaffof shifrlash (WireGuard/IPsec) va Hubble orqali tarmoq kuzatuvini kernel'ga yuklangan eBPF dasturlari bilan bajaradi. CNCF graduated.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> iptables minglab servisda sekinlashadi va IP asosida ishlaydi — pod IP'lari doim o'zgaradigan dunyoda IP qoidalari mo'rt. Cilium identitet (label) asosida va O(1) hash map'lar bilan ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pod --&gt; veth --&gt; eBPF (tc / XDP hook)<br>                  | service lookup (BPF map, O(1)) -&gt; backend tanlash<br>                  | policy: identity(label) ruxsat bormi?<br>                  | L7 kerak bo'lsa -&gt; Envoy proxy<br>                  v<br>             boshqa pod (shu node yoki tunnel/native routing)<br>Hubble: har oqimni ko'rish (kim, kimga, verdict)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cilium install --set kubeProxyReplacement=true<br>cilium status --wait<br>cilium connectivity test<br>hubble observe --namespace prod --verdict DROPPED     # nega paket tashlandi</pre><pre>apiVersion: cilium.io/v2<br>kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: api-l7 }<br>spec:<br>  endpointSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  ingress:<br>  - fromEndpoints: [{ matchLabels: { app: web } }]<br>    toPorts:<br>    - ports: [{ port: &quot;8080&quot;, protocol: TCP }]<br>      rules: { http: [{ method: GET, path: &quot;/v1/.*&quot; }] }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski kernel'larda ba'zi funksiyalar ishlamaydi — kernel versiya talablarini tekshiring.</li><li>kube-proxy replacement yoqilganda kube-proxy DaemonSet'ini olib tashlashni va qoidalarini tozalashni unutmang.</li><li>L7 policy Envoy orqali o'tadi — latency va resurs qo'shiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cilium ko'p hollarda alohida service mesh'ga ehtiyojni kamaytiradi (mTLS, L7 policy, observability); lekin murakkab trafik boshqaruvi uchun mesh hali ham kuchliroq — ehtiyojni aniq belgilang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41104	<p>NetworkPolicy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> NetworkPolicy — pod'lar orasidagi L3/L4 trafikni label selector'lar bilan boshqaradigan deklarativ firewall. Uni <b>CNI</b> (Calico, Cilium) amalga oshiradi; Flannel kabi qo'llamaydigan CNI'da policy jim e'tiborsiz qoladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Default'da Kubernetes'da har pod har pod bilan gaplashadi. Bitta pod buzilsa, hujumchi DB'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiqadi. NetworkPolicy lateral movement'ni cheklaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>podSelector: qaysi pod'larga qo'llanadi<br>policyTypes: Ingress / Egress<br>Pod hech bir policy tanlamasa -&gt; hammasi ochiq<br>Pod biror policy tanlasa      -&gt; faqat ruxsat berilgan oqimlar (allow-list, qo'shiluvchan)<br>from/to: podSelector | namespaceSelector | ipBlock</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: db-allow-api, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: postgres } }<br>  policyTypes: [Ingress]<br>  ingress:<br>  - from:<br>    - podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>    ports: [{ protocol: TCP, port: 5432 }]</pre><pre>kubectl get netpol -n prod<br>kubectl run t --rm -it -n prod --image=busybox -- nc -zv postgres 5432   # test</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>from</code> ichida bitta element (<code>podSelector</code> + <code>namespaceSelector</code> birga = AND) va ikki element (<code>- podSelector</code>, <code>- namespaceSelector</code> = OR) — bitta tire farqi butun ma'noni o'zgartiradi.</li><li><code>deny</code> qoidasi yo'q; faqat allow. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41105	<p>Default-deny NetworkPolicy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Default-deny NetworkPolicy — namespace'dagi barcha pod'larni (<code>podSelector: {}</code>) tanlab, hech qanday ruxsat qoidasi bermaydigan policy. Natijada hamma kiruvchi (va/yoki chiquvchi) trafik yopiladi, keyin kerakli oqimlar alohida policy'lar bilan aniq ochiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Zero-trust yondashuv: &quot;nima ruxsat etilganini bilamiz, qolgani yopiq&quot;. Yangi pod qo'shilsa ham u avtomatik himoyalangan bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1) default-deny (Ingress+Egress)    -&gt; hammasi yopiq<br>2) allow-dns (egress UDP/TCP 53 -&gt; kube-dns)<br>3) allow-web-to-api, allow-api-to-db ...<br>Policy'lar qo'shiluvchan: yakuniy ruxsat = hamma allow'lar yig'indisi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: default-deny, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: {}<br>  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]<br>---<br>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: allow-dns, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: {}<br>  policyTypes: [Egress]<br>  egress:<br>  - to:<br>    - namespaceSelector: { matchLabels: { kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system } }<br>      podSelector: { matchLabels: { k8s-app: kube-dns } }<br>    ports: [{ protocol: UDP, port: 53 }, { protocol: TCP, port: 53 }]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DNS egress'ni unutish — hamma ilova &quot;host topilmadi&quot; xatosi bilan yiqiladi.</li><li>Ingress controller, monitoring (Prometheus scrape) va webhook'lar uchun ruxsatni unutish.</li><li>Production'ga birdan qo'llash — avval audit/log rejimida (Cilium/Calico) yoki staging'da sinang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default-deny'ni namespace yaratish shabloniga (Kyverno <code>generate</code> qoidasi) kiriting — shunda hech qaysi jamoa uni unutmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41106	<p>Pod Security Admission (PSA) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pod Security Admission (PSA) — 1.25'da olib tashlangan PodSecurityPolicy o'rnini bosgan built-in admission controller. Namespace label'lari orqali uchta Pod Security Standard profilini (<b>privileged</b>, <b>baseline</b>, <b>restricted</b>) uch rejimda (<code>enforce</code>, <code>audit</code>, <code>warn</code>) qo'llaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Privileged container, <code>hostPath</code>, <code>hostNetwork</code> yoki root sifatida ishlash — node'ni egallashga yo'l. PSA bularni oddiy, standart profil bilan bloklaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Profil | Nima beradi | |---|---| | privileged | cheklovsiz (system komponentlar) | | baseline | ma'lum privilege escalation'larni yopadi (privileged, hostPath, hostNetwork) | | restricted | qattiq: non-root, <code>drop: [ALL]</code>, seccomp RuntimeDefault, <code>allowPrivilegeEscalation: false</code> |</p><pre>enforce -&gt; rad etadi; audit -&gt; audit log'ga yozadi; warn -&gt; kubectl'da ogohlantirish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl label ns prod \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version=latest \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn=restricted<br>kubectl label --dry-run=server --overwrite ns prod pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted<br># mavjud pod'lar qaysi biri buzishini ko'rsatadi</pre><pre>securityContext:<br>  runAsNonRoot: true<br>  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>  capabilities: { drop: [ALL] }<br>  seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PSA faqat pod'ni tekshiradi, lekin Deployment yaratilganda faqat <code>warn</code> chiqadi — pod'lar keyin ReplicaSet tomonidan yaratilmay qoladi. Events'ni tekshiring.</li><li>Moslashtirish imkoni kam (istisno faqat user/namespace/runtimeClass) — nozik qoidalar uchun Kyverno/Gatekeeper kerak.</li><li><code>kube-system</code> ga restricted qo'yish CNI/CSI'ni buzadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Strategiya: hamma namespace'da <code>warn</code>+<code>audit=restricted</code>, <code>enforce=baseline</code>; ilovalar tayyor bo'lgach <code>enforce=restricted</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41107	<p>OPA Gatekeeper nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OPA Gatekeeper — Open Policy Agent'ni Kubernetes'ga admission webhook sifatida ulaydigan loyiha. Siyosatlar <b>Rego</b> tilida <code>ConstraintTemplate</code> ga yoziladi, <code>Constraint</code> esa ularni parametrlar bilan qo'llaydi. Shuningdek mavjud resurslarni <b>audit</b> qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Tashkilot qoidalari: &quot;image faqat ichki registry'dan&quot;, &quot;har Deployment'da <code>owner</code> label bo'lsin&quot;, &quot;LoadBalancer faqat ma'lum namespace'larda&quot;. RBAC va PSA buni qila olmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ConstraintTemplate (Rego mantiq + CRD sxema)<br>   v generatsiya<br>CRD K8sRequiredLabels<br>   v<br>Constraint (match: Deployment, params: labels=[owner])<br>   v<br>admission webhook -&gt; violation -&gt; deny + xabar<br>audit controller -&gt; mavjud resurslardagi buzilishlar status'da</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1<br>kind: K8sRequiredLabels<br>metadata: { name: must-have-owner }<br>spec:<br>  enforcementAction: dryrun        # avval kuzat, keyin deny<br>  match:<br>    kinds: [{ apiGroups: [apps], kinds: [Deployment] }]<br>  parameters: { labels: [owner] }</pre><pre>kubectl get constrainttemplates<br>kubectl get k8srequiredlabels must-have-owner -o yaml | grep -A10 violations</pre><p>Tayyor siyosatlar: <code>gatekeeper-library</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rego o'rganish qiyin — jamoa uni yozish va test qilishni bilishi kerak (<code>gator test</code>).</li><li>Webhook <code>failurePolicy</code> va replika soni — HA bo'lmasa deploy'lar to'xtaydi yoki policy chetlab o'tiladi.</li><li>Policy'ni darhol <code>deny</code> bilan yoqish mavjud pipeline'larni sindiradi — <code>dryrun</code>/<code>warn</code> bilan boshlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Agar OPA allaqachon boshqa joylarda (API authz, Terraform <code>conftest</code>) ishlatilsa Gatekeeper mantiqiy; faqat Kubernetes uchun bo'lsa Kyverno yoki CEL asosidagi ValidatingAdmissionPolicy soddaroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41108	<p>Kyverno nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kyverno — Kubernetes-native policy engine: siyosatlar oddiy <b>YAML</b>da (yoki CEL bilan) yoziladi. U resurslarni <b>validate</b> (rad etish), <b>mutate</b> (o'zgartirish), <b>generate</b> (qo'shimcha resurs yaratish), image imzosini <b>verify</b> qiladi va <code>cleanup</code> siyosatlari bilan resurslarni tozalaydi. CNCF graduated.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Rego o'rganmasdan policy-as-code: Kubernetes YAML'ini biladigan har kim siyosat yoza oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ClusterPolicy<br>  rules:<br>   - validate  -&gt; pattern mos kelmasa deny / audit<br>   - mutate    -&gt; default label, securityContext qo'shish<br>   - generate  -&gt; yangi ns uchun default-deny NetworkPolicy<br>   - verifyImages -&gt; cosign imzo / attestation<br>Kyverno admission webhook + background scan -&gt; PolicyReport</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1<br>kind: ClusterPolicy<br>metadata: { name: disallow-latest-tag }<br>spec:<br>  validationFailureAction: Enforce<br>  rules:<br>  - name: no-latest<br>    match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Pod] } }] }<br>    validate:<br>      message: &quot;':latest' tag ishlatmang&quot;<br>      pattern:<br>        spec:<br>          containers:<br>          - image: &quot;!*:latest&quot;</pre><pre>kubectl get clusterpolicy<br>kubectl get policyreport -A<br>kyverno apply policy.yaml --resource deploy.yaml     # CI'da test</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pod uchun yozilgan qoida Kyverno autogen orqali Deployment'ga ham qo'llanadi — xabarlar shu yerdan kelishini bilish kerak.</li><li>Murakkab mantiq YAML'da noqulay (JMESPath) — ba'zan CEL yoki Rego aniqroq.</li><li>Kyverno pod'lari o'lsa va <code>failurePolicy: Fail</code> — klaster qotadi; HA va <code>kube-system</code> istisnosi shart.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Generate + mutate imkoniyati Kyverno'ni &quot;platform guardrail&quot; vositasiga aylantiradi: yangi namespace'ga avtomatik quota, NetworkPolicy, RBAC — self-service platformaning asosi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41109	<p>Helm va Helm hook'lari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Helm — Kubernetes paket menejeri: <b>chart</b> (shablonlar + <code>values.yaml</code>) dan manifest'lar render qilinadi va <b>release</b> sifatida o'rnatiladi, versiyalanadi, rollback qilinadi. <b>Hook</b>'lar — release lifecycle'ining ma'lum nuqtalarida (<code>pre-install</code>, <code>post-upgrade</code>, <code>pre-delete</code> va h.k.) bajariladigan resurslar (odatda Job).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Bitta ilova o'nlab YAML'dan iborat va har muhitda farq qiladi. Helm ularni parametrlaydi va bitta buyruq bilan o'rnatadi. Hook'lar esa &quot;deploy'dan oldin DB migration&quot; kabi tartibni beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>helm upgrade --install app ./chart -f prod.yaml<br>  1. render templates (values)<br>  2. pre-upgrade hook'lar (weight bo'yicha tartib) -&gt; tugashini kutadi<br>  3. asosiy resurslar apply<br>  4. post-upgrade hook'lar<br>  release tarixi: Secret sh.helm.release.v1.app.vN</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: Job<br>metadata:<br>  name: &quot;{{ .Release.Name }}-migrate&quot;<br>  annotations:<br>    &quot;helm.sh/hook&quot;: pre-upgrade,pre-install<br>    &quot;helm.sh/hook-weight&quot;: &quot;0&quot;<br>    &quot;helm.sh/hook-delete-policy&quot;: before-hook-creation,hook-succeeded<br>spec:<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      restartPolicy: Never<br>      containers: [{ name: m, image: &quot;app:{{ .Chart.AppVersion }}&quot;, args: [migrate] }]</pre><pre>helm template app ./chart -f prod.yaml | less      # nima chiqishini ko'rish<br>helm upgrade --install app ./chart -f prod.yaml --atomic --timeout 10m<br>helm history app; helm rollback app 3</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hook resurslari release'ning bir qismi sifatida boshqarilmaydi — <code>hook-delete-policy</code> siz eski Job'lar qoladi va keyingi deploy &quot;already exists&quot; bilan yiqiladi.</li><li><code>helm rollback</code> DB migration'ni orqaga qaytarmaydi — migration'lar backward-compatible bo'lsin.</li><li>Argo CD hook'larni o'z &quot;sync wave/hook&quot;lariga tarjima qiladi — xatti-harakat biroz farq qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Helm 3 Tiller'siz; chart'larni OCI registry'da saqlang. Migration'ni hook'da emas, alohida pipeline bosqichida qilish ko'pincha boshqarishga osonroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41110	<p>Helm dependency boshqaruvi (<code>Chart.lock</code>) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Subchart'lar <code>Chart.yaml</code> ning <code>dependencies</code> bo'limida (nom, versiya diapazoni, repository) e'lon qilinadi. <code>helm dependency update</code> ularni yuklab, aniq versiya va digest'larni <code>Chart.lock</code> ga yozadi; <code>helm dependency build</code> esa lock fayl bo'yicha aynan o'sha versiyalarni tiklaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Ilova chart'i PostgreSQL yoki Redis chart'iga bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin. Lock fayl bo'lmasa <code>~12.1</code> bugun bir versiya, ertaga boshqa versiya beradi — qayta tiklanmaydigan build.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Chart.yaml (diapazon ^15.0.0) --helm dep update--&gt; Chart.lock (15.5.2 + digest)<br>                                                    + charts/postgresql-15.5.2.tgz<br>CI: helm dep build  --&gt; Chart.lock bo'yicha aynan shu versiya</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Chart.yaml<br>apiVersion: v2<br>name: shop<br>version: 1.4.0<br>dependencies:<br>- name: postgresql<br>  version: &quot;~15.5.0&quot;<br>  repository: oci://registry-1.docker.io/bitnamicharts<br>  condition: postgresql.enabled<br>- name: common<br>  version: &quot;2.x.x&quot;<br>  repository: file://../common</pre><pre>helm dependency update ./shop      # lock'ni yangilaydi<br>helm dependency build ./shop       # lock bo'yicha tiklaydi (CI)<br>helm dependency list ./shop</pre><p>Subchart qiymatlari parent <code>values.yaml</code> da shu nom ostida: <code>postgresql.auth.database: shop</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Chart.lock</code> ni commit qilmaslik — reproducibility yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>charts/*.tgz</code> ni git'ga qo'shish yoki qo'shmaslik bo'yicha jamoa kelishuvi kerak (odatda qo'shilmaydi, CI build qiladi).</li><li>Uchinchi tomon chart'lari sabab registry o'zgarishlari (masalan, Bitnami katalog siyosati 2025) — muhim chart'larni o'z registry'ingizga mirror qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production'da DB'ni subchart sifatida ilova bilan birga o'rnatish anti-pattern bo'lishi mumkin — lifecycle'lari har xil; dependency'ni faqat dev/test uchun <code>condition</code> bilan yoqing.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41111	<p><code>values.schema.json</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>values.schema.json</code> — chart ildizidagi JSON Schema fayli. Helm <code>install</code>, <code>upgrade</code>, <code>lint</code> va <code>template</code> paytida foydalanuvchi bergan qiymatlarni shu sxema bo'yicha tekshiradi va xato bo'lsa render qilishdan <b>oldin</b> to'xtaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> <code>replicaCount: &quot;three&quot;</code> yoki <code>image.tag</code> unutilsa, odatda shablon jim noto'g'ri YAML chiqaradi yoki deploy'dan keyin yiqiladi. Schema xatoni erta va tushunarli xabar bilan ushlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>values.yaml + -f prod.yaml + --set ...  --&gt; birlashgan values<br>      v<br>values.schema.json tekshiruvi --xato--&gt; &quot;replicaCount: Invalid type. Expected: integer&quot;<br>      v OK<br>templates render --&gt; apply</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;$schema&quot;: &quot;https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#&quot;,<br>  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,<br>  &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;image&quot;],<br>  &quot;properties&quot;: {<br>    &quot;replicaCount&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;integer&quot;, &quot;minimum&quot;: 1 },<br>    &quot;image&quot;: {<br>      &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,<br>      &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;repository&quot;, &quot;tag&quot;],<br>      &quot;properties&quot;: {<br>        &quot;repository&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot; },<br>        &quot;tag&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;, &quot;pattern&quot;: &quot;^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$&quot; }<br>      }<br>    },<br>    &quot;service&quot;: { &quot;properties&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: { &quot;enum&quot;: [&quot;ClusterIP&quot;, &quot;LoadBalancer&quot;] } } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>helm lint ./chart -f prod.yaml<br>helm template ./chart --set replicaCount=abc     # schema xatosi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>additionalProperties: false</code> qo'ymasangiz <code>replcaCount</code> kabi xato nomlar jim o'tib ketadi.</li><li>Schema qo'lda yozilsa <code>values.yaml</code> bilan sinxronlikni yo'qotadi — generator plugin'lardan (<code>helm-schema</code>) foydalaning.</li><li>Subchart'larning o'z schema'si ham tekshiriladi — global qiymatlar to'qnashishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Schema — chart'ning &quot;API kontrakti&quot;.
