Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41112	<p>Kustomize nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kustomize — shablonsiz konfiguratsiya moslash vositasi: oddiy YAML <b>base</b> ustiga muhitga xos <b>overlay</b>'lar (patch, image tag, label, namespace, configMap generator) qo'llanadi. <code>kubectl apply -k</code> ga o'rnatilgan.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Helm'da YAML <code>{{ }}</code> shablonlarga aylanadi va o'qish qiyinlashadi. Kustomize'da base — haqiqiy, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlaydigan YAML, overlay faqat farqni yozadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>base/                 overlays/prod/<br>  deployment.yaml       kustomization.yaml<br>  service.yaml            resources: [../../base]<br>  kustomization.yaml      patches: [replicas.yaml]<br>                          images: [app -&gt; 1.4.2]<br>kustomize build overlays/prod --&gt; yakuniy YAML</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml<br>apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1<br>kind: Kustomization<br>namespace: prod<br>resources: [../../base]<br>labels:<br>- pairs: { env: prod }<br>images:<br>- { name: app, newTag: &quot;1.4.2&quot; }<br>patches:<br>- target: { kind: Deployment, name: app }<br>  patch: |-<br>    - op: replace<br>      path: /spec/replicas<br>      value: 5<br>configMapGenerator:<br>- { name: app-config, literals: [LOG_LEVEL=warn] }</pre><pre>kubectl kustomize overlays/prod | less<br>kubectl apply -k overlays/prod<br>kubectl diff -k overlays/prod</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>kubectl</code> ichidagi Kustomize versiyasi mustaqil <code>kustomize</code> binary'sidan eski bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li><code>configMapGenerator</code> nomga hash qo'shadi — bu yaxshi (config o'zgarsa rollout), lekin tashqaridan nom bo'yicha murojaat buziladi.</li><li>Juda chuqur overlay zanjiri — farqni kuzatish qiyin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amalda ko'p jamoa Helm (uchinchi tomon paketlar) + Kustomize (o'z ilovalari va post-render patch) kombinatsiyasidan foydalanadi; Argo CD ikkalasini ham qo'llaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41113	<p>Kustomize strategic merge patch nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Strategic merge patch — Kustomize (va <code>kubectl patch</code>) ning Kubernetes'ga xos birlashtirish usuli: patch qisman YAML sifatida yoziladi va list'lar <b>kalit bo'yicha</b> (masalan container <code>name</code>) birlashtiriladi, butunlay almashtirilmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Oddiy JSON merge'da <code>containers</code> list'ini patch qilsangiz butun ro'yxat yangi bilan almashadi va sidecar'lar yo'qoladi. Strategic merge faqat <code>name: app</code> container'ini topib, uning maydonlarini yangilaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>base containers:  [ {name: app, image: app:1}, {name: proxy, image: envoy} ]<br>patch containers: [ {name: app, resources: {limits: {memory: 1Gi}}} ]<br>natija:           [ {name: app, image: app:1, resources: ...}, {name: proxy, ...} ]<br>Merge kaliti Go struct tag'larida: patchMergeKey=name, patchStrategy=merge</pre><p>| Usul | List bilan nima bo'ladi | |---|---| | Strategic merge | kalit bo'yicha birlashtiriladi | | JSON merge (RFC 7386) | butunlay almashtiriladi | | JSON 6902 patch | aniq op/path (<code>add</code>, <code>replace</code>, <code>remove</code>) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># overlays/prod/memory.yaml<br>apiVersion: apps/v1<br>kind: Deployment<br>metadata: { name: app }<br>spec:<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      containers:<br>      - name: app<br>        resources: { limits: { memory: 1Gi } }</pre><pre>patches:<br>- path: memory.yaml</pre><p>O'chirish uchun direktiva: <code>$patch: delete</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CRD'larda strategic merge kalit ma'lumoti yo'q — list'lar almashtiriladi; JSON 6902 patch ishlating.</li><li>Patch'dagi <code>metadata.name</code> base'ga mos kelmasa — &quot;no matches&quot; xatosi.</li><li>Env var list'ida <code>name</code> kalit, lekin tartib o'zgarishi mumkin — natijani <code>kustomize build</code> bilan tekshiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Server-Side Apply ham shu merge semantikasidan (<code>x-kubernetes-list-type: map</code>) foydalanadi — CRD yozayotganda list'lar uchun list-type va map-keys belgilash yaxshi odat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41114	<p>CRD (Custom Resource Definition) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CRD (CustomResourceDefinition) — Kubernetes API'ni yangi resurs turi bilan kengaytirish mexanizmi. CRD yaratilgach <code>kubectl get kafkatopics</code> kabi buyruqlar ishlaydi, obyektlar etcd'da saqlanadi, RBAC va watch nativ resurslar kabi ishlaydi. Lekin CRD o'zi hech narsa <b>qilmaydi</b> — mantiqni controller beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Domen tushunchalarini (Certificate, KafkaTopic, Database) Kubernetes'ning deklarativ modeliga olib kirish — bitta tooling (kubectl, GitOps, RBAC) bilan boshqarish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CRD (group, versions, OpenAPI schema, scope)<br>   v apiserver yangi endpoint ochadi: /apis/example.com/v1/namespaces/*/backups<br>Custom Resource (kind: Backup) --&gt; etcd<br>   v watch<br>Controller/Operator --&gt; haqiqiy ish (S3'ga backup) --&gt; status yangilaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: CustomResourceDefinition<br>metadata: { name: backups.example.com }<br>spec:<br>  group: example.com<br>  scope: Namespaced<br>  names: { plural: backups, singular: backup, kind: Backup, shortNames: [bk] }<br>  versions:<br>  - name: v1<br>    served: true<br>    storage: true<br>    subresources: { status: {} }<br>    schema:<br>      openAPIV3Schema:<br>        type: object<br>        properties:<br>          spec:<br>            type: object<br>            required: [schedule]<br>            properties:<br>              schedule: { type: string }<br>              retentionDays: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }</pre><pre>kubectl get crd | grep example.com<br>kubectl explain backup.spec</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CRD o'chirilsa uning barcha obyektlari ham o'chadi — ehtiyot bo'ling (Helm uninstall CRD'ni o'chirmaydi aynan shu sababdan).</li><li>Versiyalar almashganda (v1beta1 -&gt; v1) conversion webhook kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Schema'siz yoki juda keng schema — noto'g'ri ma'lumot etcd'ga kiradi; CEL <code>x-kubernetes-validations</code> bilan qat'iylashtiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Juda ko'p CRD (yuzlab) apiserver xotirasini va discovery'ni og'irlashtiradi; o'rnatilgan CRD'lar sonini va ular egasini kuzatib boring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41115	<p>Operator pattern nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Operator pattern = CRD + custom controller: operator kerakli holatni (CR <code>spec</code>) kuzatadi va haqiqiy dunyoni unga moslashtiradi, odam operator qiladigan domen bilimini (failover, backup, upgrade, scaling) kodga aylantiradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> StatefulSet PostgreSQL pod'larini ishga tushiradi, lekin primary o'lsa replica'ni promote qilishni bilmaydi. Operator shu &quot;operatsion bilim&quot;ni avtomatlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            +---------- watch ----------+<br>            v                           |<br>   kind: PostgresCluster (spec)    Reconcile loop:<br>   replicas: 3, version: 16          1. haqiqiy holatni o'qi<br>            |                        2. spec bilan solishtir<br>            +--&gt; Operator ---------&gt; 3. farqni yop (StatefulSet, Service, backup Job)<br>                                     4. status'ni yangila, qayta navbatga qo'y</pre><p>Reconcile <b>idempotent</b> va <b>level-based</b>: &quot;nima o'zgardi&quot; emas, &quot;hozir qanday bo'lishi kerak&quot; asosida ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1<br>kind: Cluster<br>metadata: { name: pg }<br>spec:<br>  instances: 3<br>  storage: { size: 50Gi }<br>  backup:<br>    barmanObjectStore: { destinationPath: s3://backups/pg }</pre><pre>kubectl get cluster pg -o yaml | yq .status<br>kubectl logs -n cnpg-system deploy/cnpg-controller-manager</pre><p>Mashhur operator'lar: CloudNativePG, Strimzi (Kafka), Prometheus Operator, cert-manager, ECK.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Operator o'zi ham bug'li dastur — u xato qilsa production DB'ni buzishi mumkin; versiyalarni staging'da sinang.</li><li>Operator CRD versiyalarini yangilash murakkab — upgrade yo'riqnomasini o'qing.</li><li>Har oddiy ilova uchun operator yozish — ortiqcha murakkablik; Helm yetadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Operator tanlashda yetuklik darajasi (Operator Capability Levels 1-5), jamoa, release tezligi va backup/restore'ni sinab ko'rish asosiy mezonlar.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41116	<p>Operator Framework / Kubebuilder nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubebuilder va Operator SDK — Go'da operator yozish uchun scaffolding vositalari. Ikkalasi ham <code>controller-runtime</code> kutubxonasiga asoslanadi: loyiha tuzilmasi, CRD manifest'lari, RBAC, webhook va test muhitini (<code>envtest</code>) avtomatik generatsiya qiladi. Operator SDK qo'shimcha ravishda Helm/Ansible operator'lari va OLM integratsiyasini beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> client-go bilan informer, workqueue, leader election, cache'ni qo'lda yozish uzun va xatoga moyil. Bu vositalar faqat <code>Reconcile()</code> mantiqiga e'tibor berishga imkon beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubebuilder init --domain example.com<br>kubebuilder create api --group apps --version v1 --kind Backup<br>   -&gt; api/v1/backup_types.go   (Go struct + kubebuilder marker'lari)<br>   -&gt; internal/controller/backup_controller.go (Reconcile)<br>make manifests  -&gt; CRD YAML, RBAC (marker'lardan)<br>make test       -&gt; envtest (haqiqiy apiserver + etcd)<br>make run / make deploy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=apps.example.com,resources=backups,verbs=get;list;watch;update<br>func (r *BackupReconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, req ctrl.Request) (ctrl.Result, error) {<br>    var b appsv1.Backup<br>    if err := r.Get(ctx, req.NamespacedName, &amp;b); err != nil {<br>        return ctrl.Result{}, client.IgnoreNotFound(err)<br>    }<br>    // spec'ga qarab CronJob yaratish/yangilash (CreateOrUpdate)<br>    // status'ni yangilash<br>    return ctrl.Result{RequeueAfter: 10 * time.Minute}, nil<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Reconcile ichida uzoq bloklovchi ish — workqueue to'xtaydi; asinxron qiling yoki requeue.</li><li>Status'ni <code>r.Update</code> bilan yozish — <code>r.Status().Update</code> kerak, aks holda konflikt yoki yo'qolish.</li><li>Owner reference qo'yilmasa child resurslar CR o'chirilganda qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yaxshi operator: idempotent reconcile, <code>Conditions</code> bilan aniq status, finalizer orqali tashqi resurs tozalash, metrikalar va envtest bilan integratsiya testlari.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41117	<p>Controller'larda leader election nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Leader election — controller'ning bir nechta replikasi bo'lganda faqat <b>bittasi</b> faol reconcile qilishini ta'minlash. Kubernetes'da bu <code>coordination.k8s.io/v1</code> <b>Lease</b> obyekti orqali amalga oshiriladi: leader lease'ni muntazam yangilaydi, yangilanmay qolsa boshqa replika uni egallaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> HA uchun 2-3 replika kerak, lekin ikki replika bir vaqtda bitta resursni boshqarsa — ikki marta backup, to'qnashuvchi update'lar, race. Lease aktiv-passiv rejimni beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Lease kube-system/my-operator<br>  holderIdentity: pod-a<br>  leaseDurationSeconds: 15<br>  renewTime: 12:00:05<br>pod-a: har ~2s renew (renewDeadline 10s)<br>pod-b, pod-c: kutadi (retryPeriod 2s)<br>pod-a o'ldi -&gt; 15s renew yo'q -&gt; pod-b lease'ni oladi -&gt; reconcile boshlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>mgr, _ := ctrl.NewManager(cfg, ctrl.Options{<br>    LeaderElection:          true,<br>    LeaderElectionID:        &quot;backup-operator.example.com&quot;,<br>    LeaderElectionReleaseOnCancel: true,   // graceful shutdown'da tez topshirish<br>})</pre><pre>kubectl get lease -n kube-system<br>kubectl get lease kube-scheduler -n kube-system -o jsonpath='{.spec.holderIdentity}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lease vaqtga asoslangan: GC pause yoki tarmoq uzilishida eski leader o'zini hali leader deb o'ylashi mumkin — qisqa &quot;split-brain&quot; oynasi. Tashqi tizimlarga yozishda idempotentlik kerak.</li><li>Juda qisqa <code>leaseDuration</code> — apiserver sekinlashganda tez-tez leader almashadi.</li><li>Lease uchun RBAC (<code>leases</code> get/create/update) unutilsa, operator start bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Leader election throughput'ni oshirmaydi — faqat HA beradi. Masshtab kerak bo'lsa ishni sharding (namespace yoki hash bo'yicha) qiling.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41118	<p>etcd compaction va defragmentation nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Compaction</b> — etcd'dagi eski MVCC revision tarixini o'chiradi (mantiqan). <b>Defragmentation</b> — compaction'dan keyin bo'shagan joyni bbolt fayldan diskka <b>jismonan</b> qaytaradi. Ikkalasisiz DB hajmi kvotaga (default 2GiB, tavsiya maks 8GiB) yetadi va etcd <code>NOSPACE</code> alarm bilan read-only'ga o'tadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> etcd har o'zgarishni yangi revision sifatida saqlaydi. Tez o'zgaruvchi obyektlar (Lease, Event) ming-minglab revision qoldiradi — tozalanmasa DB shishadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>revision: 1 2 3 ... 100000<br>compact 95000 -&gt; 95000 gacha bo'lgan eski versiyalar o'chadi (fayl hajmi o'zgarmaydi!)<br>defrag        -&gt; fayl qayta yoziladi, bo'sh sahifalar OS'ga qaytadi<br>kube-apiserver har 5 daqiqada avtomatik compaction qiladi (--etcd-compaction-interval)<br>defrag esa qo'lda / cron bilan, har member alohida</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>etcdctl endpoint status -w table          # DB SIZE va &quot;IN USE&quot;<br>etcdctl alarm list                        # NOSPACE bormi<br>etcdctl defrag --endpoints=https://etcd-1:2379   # bittadan, leader'ni oxirida<br>etcdctl alarm disarm</pre><p>Kvota: <code>--quota-backend-bytes=8589934592</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Defrag paytida member bloklanadi — hamma member'larni birdan defrag qilish klasterni to'xtatadi.</li><li>Kvotani oshirish asosiy muammoni (masalan, Event spam yoki ulkan CRD'lar) hal qilmaydi.</li><li>Compaction'dan keyin <code>--rev</code> bilan eski revision'ni o'qish yoki watch qilish xato beradi — client'lar relist qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Managed klasterda bu provider ishi, self-managed'da esa monitoring shart: <code>etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes</code> va in-use nisbati; katta farq — defrag vaqti keldi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41119	<p>Kubernetes API versiyalari (<code>v1alpha1</code>, <code>v1beta1</code>, <code>v1</code>) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> API versiya yetuklikni bildiradi: <b>alpha</b> (<code>v1alpha1</code>) — eksperimental, default o'chiq, ogohlantirishsiz o'zgarishi/yo'qolishi mumkin; <b>beta</b> (<code>v1beta1</code>) — sinovdan o'tgan, 1.24'dan yangi beta API'lar default o'chiq; <b>GA</b> (<code>v1</code>) — barqaror, uzoq muddat qo'llanadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kubernetes tez rivojlanadi. Versiyalar foydalanuvchiga &quot;bu narsaga qanchalik tayanish mumkin&quot;ni aytadi va API'ni buzmasdan evolyutsiya qilish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Daraja | Default | Kafolat | Production | |---|---|---|---| | alpha | o'chiq (feature gate) | yo'q | yo'q | | beta | yangi API'lar o'chiq | deprecation siyosati bilan | ehtiyotkorlik bilan | | GA | yoqiq | olib tashlanmaydi (v1 ichida) | ha |</p><pre>Bitta obyekt bir nechta versiyada xizmat qilishi mumkin; etcd'da bitta &quot;storage version&quot;da saqlanadi,<br>apiserver so'ralgan versiyaga konvertatsiya qiladi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl api-versions | grep autoscaling<br>kubectl api-resources -o wide | grep -i hpa<br>kubectl explain hpa --api-version=autoscaling/v2</pre><p>Alpha'ni yoqish: apiserver'da <code>--feature-gates=Foo=true --runtime-config=foo.k8s.io/v1alpha1=true</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Beta API'larga tayangan manifest'lar upgrade'da yo'qoladi (masalan <code>policy/v1beta1</code> PodDisruptionBudget 1.25'da, <code>flowcontrol</code> beta'lari keyinroq).</li><li>Managed klasterlarda alpha feature'larni yoqib bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>kubectl get</code> ko'rsatgan versiya etcd'dagi storage versiyasi bilan bir xil emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Platforma uchun qoida: production manifest'larda faqat GA API'lar; beta faqat aniq sabab va chiqish rejasi bilan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41120	<p>Kubernetes deprecation policy qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes deprecation policy: GA API'lar major versiya ichida olib tashlanmaydi; beta API'lar deprecation e'lonidan keyin kamida <b>9 oy yoki 3 minor release</b> (qaysi uzoq bo'lsa) xizmat qiladi; alpha istalgan payt yo'qolishi mumkin. Deprecated API ishlatilsa apiserver ogohlantirish (<code>Warning:</code> header) qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Har yili ~3 minor release chiqadi. Deprecated API ishlatayotgan manifest yoki Helm chart upgrade'dan keyin &quot;no matches for kind&quot; xatosi bilan butunlay ishlamay qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1.x   : v1beta1 deprecated (ogohlantirish), v1 mavjud<br>1.x+3 : v1beta1 olib tashlandi --&gt; eski manifest apply qilinmaydi<br>etcd'dagi mavjud obyektlar yo'qolmaydi (yangi versiyada o'qiladi),<br>lekin CI/CD'dagi YAML va Helm release tarixi buziladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubent                                   # klasterdagi deprecated API'lar<br>pluto detect-files -d ./manifests<br>pluto detect-helm -o wide                # Helm release'lardagi<br>kubectl get --raw /metrics | grep apiserver_requested_deprecated_apis<br>kubectl convert -f old.yaml --output-version apps/v1   # kubectl-convert plugin</pre><p>Rasmiy &quot;Deprecated API Migration Guide&quot; har release uchun ro'yxat beradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Helm release Secret'ida eski API qolsa <code>helm upgrade</code> yiqiladi — <code>helm mapkubeapis</code> plugin bilan tuzatiladi.</li><li>Faqat repo'ni tekshirish yetarli emas — klasterga boshqa yo'llar bilan (operator'lar) qo'shilgan resurslar ham bor.</li><li>EKS/GKE &quot;upgrade insights&quot; ogohlantirishlarini e'tiborsiz qoldirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Deprecated API tekshiruvini CI'ga (pluto) va upgrade checklist'iga kiriting; <code>apiserver_requested_deprecated_apis</code> metrikasi kim hali eski API chaqirayotganini ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41121	<p>API Server aggregation layer nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Aggregation layer — kube-apiserver'ga mustaqil qo'shimcha API server'larni ulash mexanizmi. <code>APIService</code> obyekti ma'lum group/version'ga (masalan <code>metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1</code>) kelgan so'rovlarni ko'rsatilgan Service ortidagi server'ga proxy qiladi. Client uchun bu oddiy Kubernetes API bo'lib ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> CRD ma'lumotni etcd'da saqlaydi va faqat CRUD beradi. Agar ma'lumot etcd'da emas (real-time metrikalar) yoki maxsus mantiq (custom storage, subresource) kerak bo'lsa — alohida API server kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubectl top pods<br>   v GET /apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/x/pods<br>kube-apiserver (authn/authz)<br>   | APIService v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io -&gt; Service kube-system/metrics-server<br>   v proxy (front-proxy client cert bilan)<br>metrics-server --&gt; javob</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get apiservices<br>kubectl get apiservice v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io -o yaml | grep -A5 status<br># Available=False bo'lsa: FailedDiscoveryCheck, MissingEndpoints</pre><p>Misollar: Metrics Server, Prometheus Adapter (<code>custom.metrics.k8s.io</code>), KEDA (<code>external.metrics.k8s.io</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>APIService <code>Available=False</code> bo'lsa API discovery buziladi: <code>kubectl</code> ba'zi buyruqlarda xato beradi, namespace o'chirish <code>Terminating</code> da qotib qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Front-proxy sertifikatlari (<code>--requestheader-*</code>) noto'g'ri sozlansa aggregated server autentifikatsiyani tan olmaydi.</li><li>Ortiqcha yoki eskirgan APIService'lar (o'chirilgan add-on'dan qolgan) — tozalang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p holatda CRD + controller yetarli va operatsion jihatdan oson; aggregated API faqat etcd'ga mos kelmaydigan ma'lumot yoki maxsus semantika kerak bo'lganda.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41122	<p>Metrics Server nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Metrics Server — kubelet'lardan (Summary/resource API) CPU va memory ishlatishni yig'ib, xotirada saqlaydigan va <code>metrics.k8s.io</code> API orqali beradigan yengil komponent. Uni <code>kubectl top</code>, HPA va VPA ishlatadi. Bu monitoring tizimi <b>emas</b>: tarix yo'q, faqat oxirgi qiymat.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> HPA'ga &quot;hozir pod qancha CPU ishlatyapti&quot; degan tez, arzon javob kerak. To'liq Prometheus stack bunga majburiy emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubelet (har node, cAdvisor/CRI stats) &lt;-- scrape har 15s -- metrics-server<br>                                                             | xotirada<br>                                                             v<br>                       aggregation layer: metrics.k8s.io --&gt; kubectl top, HPA</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl apply -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/releases/latest/download/components.yaml<br>kubectl top nodes<br>kubectl top pods -A --sort-by=memory<br>kubectl get --raw /apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/nodes | jq .</pre><p>Lokal (kind/minikube) muhitda ba'zan <code>--kubelet-insecure-tls</code> kerak — production'da emas.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>error: Metrics API not available</code> — Metrics Server o'rnatilmagan yoki APIService <code>Available=False</code>.</li><li><code>kubectl top</code> qiymatlari Prometheus bilan bir xil emas (vaqt oynasi va manba farqi).</li><li>Bitta replika — o'lsa HPA ishlamay qoladi; katta klasterda HA rejim (2 replika) va resurs bering.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Metrics Server — autoscaling uchun &quot;nazorat signali&quot;, observability uchun Prometheus/OpenTelemetry. Ikkisini aralashtirmang va HPA uchun custom metrikalar kerak bo'lsa Prometheus Adapter yoki KEDA qo'shing.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41123	<p>Prometheus Operator nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Prometheus Operator — Prometheus, Alertmanager va ular konfiguratsiyasini Kubernetes CRD'lari orqali boshqaradigan operator: <code>Prometheus</code>, <code>Alertmanager</code>, <code>ServiceMonitor</code>, <code>PodMonitor</code>, <code>PrometheusRule</code>, <code>AlertmanagerConfig</code>. Odatda <code>kube-prometheus-stack</code> Helm chart'i orqali Grafana va exporter'lar bilan birga o'rnatiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Prometheus konfiguratsiyasi bitta katta <code>prometheus.yml</code> — har jamoa unga scrape target yoki alert qo'shishi kerak bo'lsa, markaziy fayl tor joy bo'ladi. Operator bilan har jamoa o'z namespace'ida CRD yaratadi, operator ularni yig'ib config'ni avtomatik qayta yuklaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ServiceMonitor / PodMonitor / PrometheusRule (jamoalar)<br>          v watch (label selector)<br>Prometheus Operator --&gt; generatsiya: prometheus.yml + rules --&gt; Secret<br>          v<br>StatefulSet prometheus-k8s (config-reloader sidecar hot reload)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts<br>helm upgrade --install kps prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack -n monitoring --create-namespace<br>kubectl get prometheus,servicemonitor,prometheusrule -A<br>kubectl -n monitoring port-forward svc/kps-kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus 9090<br># UI: Status -&gt; Targets (scrape holati), Status -&gt; Configuration</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Prometheus</code> CR'dagi <code>serviceMonitorSelector</code>/<code>ruleSelector</code> label'lariga mos kelmagan CRD'lar jim e'tiborsiz qoladi (kube-prometheus-stack'da <code>release: kps</code> label).</li><li>Yuqori cardinality'li metrikalar Prometheus xotirasini portlatadi — <code>metricRelabelings</code> bilan keraksizini tashlang.</li><li>CRD'lar Helm upgrade'da avtomatik yangilanmaydi — alohida qo'llang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bitta Prometheus uzoq muddatli saqlash va global ko'rinishni bermaydi — Thanos/Mimir yoki managed servisga remote_write; operator shu arxitekturani ham boshqaradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41124	<p><code>ServiceMonitor</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ServiceMonitor</code> — Prometheus Operator CRD'si: label selector bo'yicha Kubernetes Service'larni topadi va ularning EndpointSlice'laridagi pod'larni ko'rsatilgan port va path bo'yicha scrape target sifatida Prometheus'ga qo'shadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Pod IP'lari doim o'zgaradi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41125	<p>External Secrets Operator (Kubernetes kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> External Secrets Operator (ESO) — tashqi secret manager'lardan (AWS Secrets Manager, SSM, HashiCorp Vault, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault) qiymatlarni o'qib, ularni Kubernetes'ning nativ <code>Secret</code> obyektiga sinxronlaydigan va <code>refreshInterval</code> bo'yicha yangilab turadigan operator.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Secret'larni git'da saqlash xavfli, ularni qo'lda <code>kubectl create secret</code> qilish esa qayta tiklanmaydi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41126	<p>cert-manager nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> cert-manager — Kubernetes'da TLS sertifikatlarini avtomatik chiqaradigan va muddati tugashidan oldin yangilaydigan add-on. Manbalar: Let's Encrypt (ACME, HTTP-01/DNS-01), HashiCorp Vault, ichki CA, Venafi va boshqalar. Natija — <code>kubernetes.io/tls</code> turidagi Secret. CNCF graduated.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Qo'lda yangilanadigan sertifikat muddati albatta qachondir unutiladi va servis &quot;certificate expired&quot; bilan yiqiladi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41127	<p>Kubernetes garbage collection (cascading deletion) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes garbage collector egasi (<code>ownerReferences</code> dagi owner) o'chirilgan obyektlarni avtomatik o'chiradi — cascading deletion. Deployment o'chsa uning ReplicaSet'lari, ular orqali Pod'lar ham o'chadi. Uch rejim: <b>background</b> (default), <b>foreground</b>, <b>orphan</b>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Har child resursni qo'lda o'chirish kerak bo'lmasligi va &quot;yetim&quot; resurslar to'planmasligi uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Deployment web<br>  ^ ownerReferences (uid)<br>ReplicaSet web-abc<br>  ^ ownerReferences<br>Pod web-abc-xyz<br><br>background: Deployment darhol o'chadi, GC keyin child'larni o'chiradi<br>foreground: avval child'lar (blockOwnerDeletion), keyin owner (foregroundDeletion finalizer)<br>orphan:     faqat owner o'chadi, child'lar qoladi (ownerReference olib tashlanadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl delete deploy web                         # background<br>kubectl delete deploy web --cascade=foreground<br>kubectl delete deploy web --cascade=orphan        # pod'lar ishlashda davom etadi<br>kubectl get rs web-abc -o jsonpath='{.metadata.ownerReferences}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Owner va child boshqa namespace'da bo'la olmaydi (namespaced child cluster-scoped owner'ga ega bo'lishi mumkin, aksincha emas) — noto'g'ri ownerRef GC'ni chalkashtiradi.</li><li><code>--cascade=orphan</code> dan keyin yangi Deployment xuddi shu selector bilan yaratilsa, u yetim ReplicaSet'ni &quot;asrab oladi&quot;.</li><li>Operator child'larga ownerReference qo'ymasa, CR o'chganda resurslar qolib ketadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Orphan deletion — selector o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan maydonlarni (immutable) o'zgartirishning downtime'siz usuli: eski owner'ni orphan bilan o'chirib, yangisini yaratish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41128	<p>Kubernetes finalizer nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Finalizer — obyekt <code>metadata.finalizers</code> ro'yxatidagi kalit. Obyektni o'chirish so'ralganda u darhol o'chmaydi: <code>deletionTimestamp</code> qo'yiladi va controller tashqi tozalashni (cloud LB, disk, DNS yozuvi) tugatib, finalizer'ni olib tashlamaguncha etcd'da qoladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> <code>type: LoadBalancer</code> Service o'chsa, cloud'dagi LB ham o'chishi kerak. Agar obyekt darhol yo'qolsa, controller nimani tozalashni bilmay qoladi va pullik &quot;yetim&quot; resurslar qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubectl delete pvc data<br>   v<br>deletionTimestamp set, finalizers: [kubernetes.io/pvc-protection]<br>   v (obyekt &quot;Terminating&quot;)<br>controller: tozalash (pod hali ishlatayotgan bo'lsa kutadi)<br>   v<br>finalizer olib tashlanadi --&gt; ro'yxat bo'sh --&gt; etcd'dan o'chiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get ns stuck -o jsonpath='{.spec.finalizers}{.metadata.finalizers}'<br>kubectl get pvc data -o jsonpath='{.metadata.finalizers}'<br># Terminating'da qotgan namespace — qaysi resurs qolganini topish:<br>kubectl api-resources --verbs=list --namespaced -o name \<br>  | xargs -n1 kubectl get -n stuck --ignore-not-found --show-kind<br># Oxirgi chora (controller yo'q bo'lsa):<br>kubectl patch pvc data -p '{&quot;metadata&quot;:{&quot;finalizers&quot;:null}}' --type=merge</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Finalizer'ni majburan olib tashlash tashqi resursni yetim qoldiradi (pullik LB, disk) — avval sababni tushuning.</li><li>Controller o'chirilgan, lekin finalizer qolgan (masalan operator uninstall qilingan) — obyektlar abadiy Terminating.</li><li>Namespace Terminating ko'pincha <code>Available=False</code> APIService sabab — discovery ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Operator yozganda: finalizer'ni tashqi resurs yaratishdan <b>oldin</b> qo'shing, tozalash idempotent bo'lsin va tashqi resurs allaqachon yo'q bo'lsa ham muvaffaqiyat deb hisoblang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41129	<p>DaemonSet rolling update strategiyasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DaemonSet ikki update strategiyasiga ega: <code>RollingUpdate</code> (default) — pod'lar node'lar bo'ylab <code>maxUnavailable</code> (default 1) bo'yicha birma-bir almashtiriladi; <code>OnDelete</code> — yangi pod faqat eskisi qo'lda o'chirilganda yaratiladi. 1.25'dan <code>maxSurge</code> ham GA: yangi pod eskisi o'chishidan oldin ishga tushadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> DaemonSet ko'pincha CNI, log va monitoring agentlari. Hamma node'da birdan yangilash xavfli: yangi versiya buzuq bo'lsa butun klasterning tarmog'i yoki log'i yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>maxUnavailable: 1 (maxSurge: 0)<br>  node-a: eski o'chadi -&gt; yangi start -&gt; Ready -&gt; keyingi node<br>maxSurge: 1 (maxUnavailable: 0)<br>  node-a: yangi start (eski hali ishlaydi) -&gt; Ready -&gt; eski o'chadi   [uzilishsiz]<br>OnDelete: siz pod'ni o'chirgan node'dagina yangilanadi (qo'lda canary)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  updateStrategy:<br>    type: RollingUpdate<br>    rollingUpdate:<br>      maxUnavailable: 0<br>      maxSurge: &quot;10%&quot;<br>  minReadySeconds: 30</pre><pre>kubectl rollout status ds/fluent-bit -n logging<br>kubectl rollout undo ds/fluent-bit -n logging<br>kubectl get ds fluent-bit -n logging     # UP-TO-DATE ustuni</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>maxSurge</code> <code>hostPort</code> yoki eksklyuziv resurs ishlatadigan DaemonSet bilan ishlamaydi — ikkita pod bir portni ololmaydi.</li><li>Readiness probe va <code>minReadySeconds</code> yo'q bo'lsa buzuq versiya juda tez hamma node'ga tarqaladi.</li><li>500 node'da <code>maxUnavailable: 1</code> — rollout soatlab davom etadi; foiz bilan qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CNI kabi kritik agentlar uchun <code>OnDelete</code> yoki kichik canary node pool'da avval sinash — tarmoq agentining buzilishi butun klaster incident'i.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41130	<p>Node drain va cordon farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Cordon</b> — node'ni <code>unschedulable</code> qiladi: yangi pod'lar tushmaydi, mavjudlari ishlashda davom etadi. <b>Drain</b> — cordon qilib, keyin barcha pod'larni (DaemonSet'dan tashqari) Eviction API orqali PDB'ni hurmat qilib chiqaradi — reboot, kernel yangilash yoki node'ni o'chirish uchun.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Node'ni texnik xizmat uchun to'xtatishdan oldin undagi ish yuklarini boshqa node'larga xavfsiz ko'chirish kerak, aks holda servislar uziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>cordon:  node.spec.unschedulable=true (taint node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable)<br>drain:   cordon<br>         -&gt; har pod uchun Eviction (PDB tekshiruvi)<br>         -&gt; controller'lar pod'larni boshqa node'da qayta yaratadi<br>         -&gt; terminationGracePeriod kutiladi<br>uncordon: node yana schedulable</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl cordon node-a<br>kubectl drain node-a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=10m<br># ... reboot / upgrade ...<br>kubectl uncordon node-a<br>kubectl get nodes     # STATUS: Ready,SchedulingDisabled</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Controller'siz &quot;yalang'och&quot; pod'lar drain'ni bloklaydi; <code>--force</code> ularni butunlay yo'qotadi.</li><li><code>emptyDir</code> ma'lumotlari drain paytida yo'qoladi — shuning uchun alohida flag talab qilinadi.</li><li>PDB <code>ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS 0</code> bo'lsa drain abadiy kutadi — sababni (1 replika, buzuq pod'lar) tuzating, PDB'ni o'chirmang.</li><li>Uncordon'ni unutish — node bo'sh turadi va pul isrof bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Klaster upgrade'larini avtomatlashtiring (managed node group, Karpenter drift, kured) — ular drain'ni to'g'ri tartibda qiladi; sizning vazifangiz PDB, probe va graceful shutdown to'g'ri ekanini ta'minlash.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41131	<p><code>kubectl exec</code> va <code>kubectl attach</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>kubectl exec</code> container ichida <b>yangi</b> process ishga tushiradi (masalan <code>sh</code>). <code>kubectl attach</code> esa container'ning <b>mavjud</b> asosiy process'iga (PID 1) stdin/stdout/stderr orqali ulanadi — yangi process yaratilmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Debug uchun shell kerak bo'lsa — exec. Interaktiv ilovaning (masalan REPL yoki <code>-it</code> bilan start bo'lgan container) o'zi bilan gaplashish yoki uning jonli chiqishini ko'rish — attach.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>exec:   kubectl -&gt; apiserver -&gt; kubelet -&gt; CRI Exec -&gt; yangi process (PID N) container namespace'ida<br>attach: kubectl -&gt; apiserver -&gt; kubelet -&gt; CRI Attach -&gt; PID 1 ning stdio oqimlari</pre><p>| | exec | attach | |---|---|---| | Process | yangi | mavjud PID 1 | | Image'da shell kerakmi | ha | yo'q | | Chiqishda | process tugaydi | Ctrl+C PID 1'ga borishi mumkin |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl exec -it web -c app -- sh<br>kubectl exec web -- cat /etc/resolv.conf<br>kubectl run -it repl --image=python:3.12 -- python   # stdin bilan<br>kubectl attach -it repl                               # keyin qayta ulanish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Distroless image'da <code>exec ... sh</code> ishlamaydi (&quot;executable file not found&quot;) — <code>kubectl debug</code> ishlating.</li><li><code>attach</code> qilib Ctrl+C bosish asosiy process'ni o'ldirishi mumkin; chiqish uchun <code>Ctrl+P Ctrl+Q</code> (tty bo'lsa).</li><li><code>pods/exec</code> ruxsati amalda container ichidagi hamma narsaga (secret'lar, token) kirish — RBAC'da qattiq cheklang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production'da exec'ni istisno qiling: audit log'da kuzating, imkon bo'lsa faqat break-glass rol orqali bering. Kuzatuv uchun log/metric/trace yetishmasa — bu observability kamchiligi signali.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41132	<p><code>kubectl port-forward</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>kubectl port-forward</code> lokal mashinadagi portni klaster ichidagi pod (yoki Service/Deployment orqali tanlangan bitta pod) portiga API server va kubelet orqali <b>tunnel</b> qiladi. Service'ni tashqariga ochmasdan vaqtinchalik ulanish uchun.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Klaster ichidagi DB, admin panel yoki Prometheus UI'ni tez tekshirish uchun Ingress yoki LoadBalancer yaratish ortiqcha va xavfli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>localhost:5432 --&gt; kubectl --(HTTPS/WebSocket, SPDY)--&gt; kube-apiserver<br>                                                        v<br>                                                     kubelet --&gt; pod netns:5432</pre><p>Service ko'rsatilsa ham trafik <b>bitta</b> pod'ga boradi (load balancing yo'q); ulanish faqat TCP.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl port-forward svc/postgres 5432:5432 -n prod<br>psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U app<br><br>kubectl port-forward pod/web-abc 8080:80<br>kubectl port-forward deploy/grafana 3000 --address 0.0.0.0   # boshqa mashinadan (ehtiyot!)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pod restart bo'lsa yoki boshqa pod'ga almashsa tunnel uziladi — qayta ishga tushirish kerak.</li><li>UDP qo'llanmaydi; uzun va yuqori trafikli ishlar uchun sekin.</li><li><code>--address 0.0.0.0</code> ichki servisni butun lokal tarmoqqa ochadi.</li><li><code>pods/portforward</code> RBAC ruxsati NetworkPolicy'larni chetlab o'tishga imkon beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> port-forward — debug vositasi, doimiy kirish yo'li emas. Doimiy admin kirish uchun VPN, bastion yoki identity-aware proxy (Teleport, Tailscale) — audit va SSO bilan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41133	<p>Mutating webhook failure policy (<code>Ignore</code> va <code>Fail</code>) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Admission webhook'ning <code>failurePolicy</code> webhook javob bermasa (timeout, xato, TLS muammo) nima bo'lishini belgilaydi: <b><code>Ignore</code></b> — so'rov webhook'siz qabul qilinadi (fail-open); <b><code>Fail</code></b> — so'rov rad etiladi (fail-closed). <code>admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1</code> da default <code>Fail</code>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Bu xavfsizlik va mavjudlik o'rtasidagi tanlov: security policy chetlab o'tilmasligi kerak, lekin webhook o'lganda butun klaster deploy qila olmay qolishi ham falokat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>apiserver --&gt; webhook (timeoutSeconds: 10, max 30)<br>   javob yo'q:<br>     Ignore -&gt; obyekt yaratiladi (policy tekshirilmagan!)<br>     Fail   -&gt; &quot;failed calling webhook ...&quot; xatosi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>webhooks:<br>- name: policy.example.com<br>  failurePolicy: Fail<br>  timeoutSeconds: 5<br>  sideEffects: None<br>  namespaceSelector:<br>    matchExpressions:<br>    - { key: kubernetes.io/metadata.name, operator: NotIn, values: [kube-system, policy-system] }<br>  clientConfig: { service: { name: policy, namespace: policy-system, path: /validate } }</pre><pre>kubectl get validatingwebhookconfiguration,mutatingwebhookconfiguration<br>kubectl get events -A | grep -i 'failed calling webhook'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Fail</code> + webhook'ning o'z namespace'i ham tekshirilsa: webhook pod'i o'lsa, uni qayta yaratishni ham webhook bloklaydi — deadlock.</li><li>Bitta replika, PDB va anti-affinity yo'q — node drain webhook'ni o'chirib, klaster deploy'larini to'xtatadi.</li><li>Katta <code>timeoutSeconds</code> — sekin webhook har API so'rovni sekinlashtiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Security webhook'lari uchun <code>Fail</code> + HA (3 replika, PDB, yuqori PriorityClass) + tizim namespace'larini istisno qilish + latency/xato metrikalariga alert. Mumkin bo'lsa in-process CEL policy'lariga o'ting.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41134	<p><code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code> — pod o'chirilganda container'lar toza to'xtashi uchun beriladigan umumiy vaqt (default <b>30s</b>). Kubelet avval <code>preStop</code> hook'ini bajaradi, keyin <code>SIGTERM</code> yuboradi; vaqt tugaganda hali tirik process'larga <code>SIGKILL</code> yuboriladi. <code>preStop</code> vaqti ham shu davr ichiga kiradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Ilova yarim bajarilgan so'rovlarni tugatishi, ulanishlarni yopishi, navbatdagi xabarni commit qilishi kerak. Aks holda har deploy foydalanuvchilarga 502 xatolar beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>t=0   pod Terminating; endpoint'lardan olib tashlash boshlanadi (parallel!)<br>      preStop (masalan sleep 10)<br>t=10  SIGTERM -&gt; ilova yangi so'rov olmaydi, mavjudlarini tugatadi<br>t=30  hali tirik? -&gt; SIGKILL (exit 137)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60<br>  containers:<br>  - name: app<br>    lifecycle:<br>      preStop: { sleep: { seconds: 10 } }   # 1.30+ native sleep</pre><p>Go'da SIGTERM ishlovi:</p><pre>ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM)<br>defer stop()<br>&lt;-ctx.Done()<br>shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 40*time.Second)<br>defer cancel()<br>srv.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova shell orqali start bo'lsa (<code>sh -c &quot;java ...&quot;</code>), SIGTERM shell'ga boradi va ilovaga yetmaydi — <code>exec</code> yoki <code>tini</code> ishlating.</li><li>Ilovaning ichki shutdown timeout'i grace period'dan uzun bo'lsa baribir SIGKILL.</li><li>Juda katta grace period (masalan 3600) node drain va rollout'ni soatlab cho'zadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Grace period = preStop + ilovaning eng uzun so'rov/ish vaqti + zaxira. Uzun ishlovchi consumer'lar uchun ishni kichik bo'laklarga bo'ling — grace period'ni cheksiz oshirmang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41135	<p><code>preStop</code> lifecycle hook nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>preStop</code> — container to'xtatilishidan oldin, <code>SIGTERM</code> yuborilishidan <b>oldin</b> bajariladigan lifecycle hook (<code>exec</code> buyruq, <code>httpGet</code> yoki 1.30'dan native <code>sleep</code>). Kubelet u tugaguncha kutadi (grace period ichida).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Pod o'chirilganda ikki narsa <b>parallel</b> sodir bo'ladi: kubelet container'ni to'xtatadi va endpoint controller pod'ni Service'dan olib tashlaydi, kube-proxy/ingress esa buni biroz kechikib ko'radi. Agar ilova darhol to'xtasa, bu oraliqda kelgan so'rovlar &quot;connection refused&quot; oladi. <code>preStop: sleep</code> shu oraliqni yopadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>delete pod<br>  |-- EndpointSlice'dan chiqarish --&gt; kube-proxy / ingress yangilanishi (1-5s)<br>  |-- kubelet: preStop sleep 10  (ilova hali so'rovlarga javob beradi)<br>                  v<br>               SIGTERM -&gt; graceful shutdown -&gt; exit</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lifecycle:<br>  preStop:<br>    sleep: { seconds: 10 }          # image'da sleep binary kerak emas<br># eski usul:<br>#   exec: { command: [&quot;sh&quot;, &quot;-c&quot;, &quot;sleep 10&quot;] }<br># yoki ilovaga drain buyrug'i:<br>#   httpGet: { path: /drain, port: 8080 }</pre><pre>kubectl describe pod web | grep -A3 -i prestop<br>kubectl get events | grep FailedPreStopHook</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Distroless image'da <code>exec: sleep</code> ishlamaydi — native <code>sleep</code> (1.30+) ishlating.</li><li>preStop vaqti grace period'dan katta bo'lsa — ilova SIGTERM'ni umuman olmasdan SIGKILL bilan o'ladi.</li><li>preStop xatosi pod o'chishini to'xtatmaydi, faqat event yoziladi — muhim mantiqni unga ishonmang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rolling update'dagi 502/503 xatolarning eng keng tarqalgan sababi — shu endpoint propagatsiya oralig'i. preStop sleep + readiness + to'g'ri grace period — uchtasi birga zero-downtime deploy'ni beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41136	<p>Server-Side Apply (SSA) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Server-Side Apply (SSA) — apply mantiqini client'dan (<code>kubectl</code>) API server'ga ko'chiradi. Server har maydonga qaysi &quot;manager&quot; (kubectl, Helm, HPA, operator) egalik qilishini <code>metadata.managedFields</code> da kuzatadi; boshqa manager egalik qilgan maydonni o'zgartirmoqchi bo'lsangiz <b>konflikt</b> qaytariladi. 1.22'dan GA.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Client-side apply <code>last-applied-configuration</code> annotation'iga tayanadi va bir nechta vosita bitta obyektni boshqarganda bir-birining o'zgarishlarini jim ustidan yozadi (klassik: GitOps <code>replicas</code> ni qaytaradi, HPA esa uni o'zgartiradi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>managedFields:<br>  - manager: argocd      fields: spec.template, spec.selector<br>  - manager: hpa         fields: spec.replicas<br>argocd apply replicas: 3  --&gt; CONFLICT (egasi hpa)<br>  --force-conflicts       --&gt; egalik argocd'ga o'tadi<br>YAML'dan maydonni olib tashlash = egalikni bo'shatish (o'chirish emas, agar boshqa egasi bo'lsa)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl apply --server-side -f deploy.yaml --field-manager=ci<br>kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f deploy.yaml<br>kubectl get deploy web -o yaml --show-managed-fields | less</pre><p>Go'da: <code>client.Apply</code> patch turi yoki client-go <code>ApplyConfiguration</code> tiplari.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Manifest'da <code>replicas</code> ni qoldirib HPA bilan ishlatish — SSA konfliktni ko'rsatadi; yechim — maydonni manifest'dan olib tashlash.</li><li>Har deploy'da <code>--force-conflicts</code> ishlatish SSA'ning ma'nosini yo'qotadi.</li><li>Client-side'dan server-side'ga o'tishda egalik migratsiyasi ba'zan kutilmagan natija beradi — avval <code>kubectl diff --server-side</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Operator va GitOps vositalari uchun SSA standart bo'lib bormoqda (Argo CD <code>ServerSideApply=true</code>, Flux default) — bir nechta controller bitta obyektni xavfsiz bo'lishishining asosi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41137	<p>Kubernetes'da <code>subPath</code> volume mount nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>subPath</code> — butun volume'ni emas, uning ichidagi <b>bitta fayl yoki papkani</b> container'dagi aniq yo'lga mount qilish. Muhim cheklov: <code>subPath</code> bilan mount qilingan ConfigMap/Secret <b>avtomatik yangilanmaydi</b>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> ConfigMap'ni <code>/etc/nginx/</code> ga to'liq mount qilsangiz, papkadagi boshqa fayllar yashirinib qoladi. <code>subPath</code> faqat <code>nginx.conf</code> faylini qo'yib, qolganini saqlaydi. Shuningdek bitta PVC'ni bir necha container'ga turli papkalar bilan bo'lishish mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy mount:  volume (key'lar) --&gt; /etc/nginx/          (papka butunlay almashadi)<br>subPath:      volume/nginx.conf --&gt; /etc/nginx/nginx.conf (faqat bitta fayl)<br><br>Yangilanish: oddiy mount -&gt; symlink (..data) atomik almashtiriladi -&gt; fayl yangilanadi<br>             subPath     -&gt; bind mount aniq inode'ga -&gt; eski kontent qoladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>volumes:<br>- name: cfg<br>  configMap: { name: nginx-config }<br>- name: data<br>  persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: shared }<br>containers:<br>- name: nginx<br>  volumeMounts:<br>  - { name: cfg, mountPath: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf, subPath: nginx.conf }<br>  - { name: data, mountPath: /var/lib/app, subPathExpr: $(POD_NAME) }<br>  env:<br>  - name: POD_NAME<br>    valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.name } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Config yangilandi, lekin ilova eski qiymatni ko'radi — sabab subPath; pod'ni restart qiling yoki butun papkani mount qiling.</li><li><code>subPath</code> mavjud bo'lmasa papka sifatida yaratiladi — fayl kutgan ilova &quot;is a directory&quot; xatosini oladi.</li><li>Tarixan subPath bilan symlink zaifliklari (CVE'lar) bo'lgan — klasterni yangi saqlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Config o'zgarishini deploy bilan bog'lang: ConfigMap nomiga hash (Kustomize generator) yoki pod template'ga checksum annotation (Helm) — shunda config o'zgarishi kontrollik rollout bo'ladi, jim hot-reload emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::h18 K8s_architecture_control_plane
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41138	<p>Projected volume nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Projected volume — bir nechta manbani (<code>secret</code>, <code>configMap</code>, <code>downwardAPI</code>, <code>serviceAccountToken</code>, 1.29+'da <code>clusterTrustBundle</code>) <b>bitta papkaga</b> birlashtirib mount qiladigan volume turi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Ilova bitta konfiguratsiya papkasini kutadi (masalan <code>/etc/app/</code>), lekin ma'lumot turli joydan keladi: sertifikat Secret'da, sozlama ConfigMap'da, pod nomi metadata'da. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41139	<p>Downward API nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Downward API — pod va container haqidagi ma'lumotni (nom, namespace, pod IP, node nomi, label/annotation'lar, request/limit'lar) ilovaga <b>env var</b> yoki <b>fayl</b> sifatida, Kubernetes API'ga murojaat qilmasdan beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Ilova log'ga pod nomini yozishi, metrikaga node nomini qo'shishi yoki thread sonini CPU limit'iga moslashi kerak. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H18 K8s architecture & control plane	idrill-41140	<p>Kubernetes Event (<code>kubectl get events</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes Event — klasterda nima sodir bo'lganini yozadigan qisqa muddatli obyekt: scheduling qarorlari (<code>FailedScheduling</code>), image pull xatolari, probe yiqilishlari, OOM, eviction, scaling. Default'da faqat <b>~1 soat</b> saqlanadi (<code>--event-ttl</code>), shuning uchun uzoq tahlil uchun eksport qilinishi kerak.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;Pod nega Pending?&quot;, &quot;nega restart bo'ldi?&quot; degan savollarning birinchi javobi — Event'larda. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41141	<p>Ssenariy: pod <code>CrashLoopBackOff</code> da. Diagnostika qadamlaringiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>CrashLoopBackOff</code> — container ishga tushadi, yiqiladi, kubelet uni qayta ishga tushiradi va har safar kutish vaqtini oshiradi (10s, 20s, 40s ... 5 daqiqagacha). Bu sabab emas, oqibat: sababni exit code, event va <b>oldingi</b> log'dan topasiz.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy'dan keyin pod <code>Running</code> bo'lmaydi, restart soni o'sib boradi. Ko'pchilik <code>kubectl logs</code> ni ishlatib bo'sh ekran ko'radi — chunki yangi container hali ishga tushmagan, log oldingisida.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>start -&gt; crash (exit != 0) -&gt; kubelet restart<br>   ^                              |<br>   +---- backoff 10s,20s,40s...&lt;--+   (max 5m, 10 daqiqa barqaror ishlasa reset)</pre><p><b>Amalda (tartib bilan):</b></p><pre>kubectl get pod api-7d9f -o wide          # RESTARTS soni, qaysi node<br>kubectl describe pod api-7d9f             # Last State, Exit Code, Reason, Events<br>kubectl logs api-7d9f --previous          # yiqilgan container log'i<br>kubectl logs api-7d9f -c migrate --previous   # ko'p container bo'lsa<br>kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -20</pre><p><code>describe</code> da qarang:</p><pre>Last State:  Terminated<br>  Reason:    Error        &lt;- yoki OOMKilled<br>  Exit Code: 1            &lt;- ilova xatosi; 137 = SIGKILL; 127 = binary yo'q</pre><p><b>Exit code bo'yicha yo'naltirish:</b> | Kod | Ma'nosi | Qayerga qarash | |---|---|---| | 1 | ilova exception | <code>--previous</code> log | | 127/126 | binary yo'q / ruxsat yo'q | image, <code>command</code> | | 137 | OOMKilled yoki liveness kill | limit, probe | | 0 | process tugadi (server emas) | <code>command</code>, Job bo'lishi kerakmi |</p><p><b>Tipik sabablar:</b> env/Secret yo'q, DB'ga ulana olmaydi, noto'g'ri entrypoint, config fayl topilmaydi, liveness probe startup tugamasdan o'ldiradi, OOM.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--previous</code> siz log ko'rib &quot;log bo'sh&quot; deb xulosa qilish.</li><li>Agressiv liveness probe'ni sezmaslik — sekin startup'da <code>startupProbe</code> kerak.</li><li>Log hech narsa yozmasa — <code>kubectl debug</code> bilan image ichini ko'rish (41209).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval zararni to'xtating (<code>kubectl rollout undo</code>), keyin tekshiring. Ilova startup'da config'ni validate qilib aniq xato bilan yiqilishi (fail fast) — diagnostikani daqiqalarga qisqartiradi; <code>terminationMessagePolicy: FallbackToLogsOnError</code> ham yordam beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41142	<p>Ssenariy: pod <code>Exit Code 137</code> bilan tugadi. Nima bo'ldi va qanday tuzatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Exit code 137 = 128 + 9, ya'ni process <code>SIGKILL</code> oldi. Kubernetes'da eng ko'p sabab — container <code>limits.memory</code> dan oshib kernel OOM killer uni o'ldirgan (<code>Reason: OOMKilled</code>). Kamroq — grace period tugab majburan o'ldirilgan yoki liveness probe yiqilgan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Pod vaqti-vaqti bilan restart bo'ladi, log'da hech qanday xato yo'q — chunki SIGKILL'ni ushlab bo'lmaydi, ilova hech narsa yozib ulgurmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>container RSS o'sadi -&gt; cgroup memory.max ga yetadi<br>   -&gt; kernel OOM killer -&gt; SIGKILL -&gt; exit 137 -&gt; kubelet: OOMKilled</pre><p>CPU limit'dan oshish o'ldirmaydi (faqat throttle), memory esa o'ldiradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -A5 &quot;Last State&quot;<br>#   Reason: OOMKilled   Exit Code: 137<br>kubectl top pod api-x --containers        # joriy iste'mol<br>kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].resources}'<br>dmesg -T | grep -i oom                    # node'da (node OOM bo'lsa)</pre><p>Prometheus: <code>container_memory_working_set_bytes</code> vs <code>kube_pod_container_resource_limits</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzatish:</b></p><pre>resources:<br>  requests: { memory: 512Mi }<br>  limits:   { memory: 768Mi }<br>env:<br>- name: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS<br>  value: &quot;-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0&quot;   # JVM heap limit'ga moslanadi<br>- name: GOMEMLIMIT<br>  value: &quot;650MiB&quot;                      # Go GC limit'dan oldin agressivlashadi</pre><p>Leak bo'lsa — heap profiling (pprof, heap dump) bilan topish; limit'ni cheksiz oshirish yechim emas.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Reason: Error</code> + 137 — OOM emas, grace period'dan keyin SIGKILL yoki liveness kill bo'lishi mumkin; event'larni o'qing.</li><li>JVM eski versiyalari cgroup limitni ko'rmaydi — heap limit'dan katta bo'ladi.</li><li>Node darajasidagi OOM (node RAM tugadi) boshqa pod'larni ham o'ldiradi — eviction va reserved resurslarni tekshiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Memory uchun <code>requests == limits</code> (Guaranteed QoS) bashorat qilinadigan xulq beradi. Limit'ni p99 iste'mol + 20-30% zaxira bilan qo'ying va <code>OOMKilled</code> hodisasiga alert qo'ying — u jim ishlamay qolishning eng keng tarqalgan sababi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting

Uch vazifa: <b>traffic management</b> (canary, retry, timeout), <b>security</b> (avtomatik mTLS, authz) va <b>observability</b> (metrika, trace). Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41150	<p>Istio Ambient Mesh nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Istio Ambient Mesh — sidecar'siz rejim (2024'da GA). Mesh ikki qatlamga bo'linadi: har node'dagi <b>ztunnel</b> (L4: mTLS, identity, L4 authz) va kerak bo'lgandagina <b>waypoint proxy</b> (L7: HTTP routing, retry, L7 authz). Pod'lar restart qilinmasdan mesh'ga qo'shiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Sidecar modeli: 1000 pod = 1000 Envoy — RAM/CPU sarfi katta, sidecar upgrade uchun hamma pod restart, startup tartib muammolari.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[pod A]   [pod B]           node 1<br>    \       /<br>   ztunnel (DaemonSet, Rust, L4) ==HBONE mTLS==&gt; ztunnel (node 2) -&gt; [pod C]<br>                     |<br>         L7 kerak bo'lsa: waypoint (Envoy, namespace/servis uchun Deployment)</pre><p>HBONE — HTTP CONNECT ustidagi mTLS tunnel (port 15008).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>istioctl install --set profile=ambient<br>kubectl label ns shop istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient     # restart kerak emas<br>istioctl waypoint apply -n shop --enroll-namespace         # L7 kerak bo'lsa<br>istioctl ztunnel-config workloads</pre><p><b>Sidecar vs Ambient:</b> | | Sidecar | Ambient | |---|---|---| | Resurs | har pod'da Envoy | node'da ztunnel + kam waypoint | | Upgrade | pod restart | DaemonSet rollout | | L7 | har doim | faqat waypoint bilan | | Izolyatsiya | pod darajasida | ztunnel node'dagi pod'lar uchun umumiy |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Waypoint'siz VirtualService L7 qoidalari ishlamaydi — &quot;konfig qo'llanmayapti&quot; deb o'ylash.</li><li>Ba'zi CNI'lar bilan moslik va eBPF/iptables redirect cheklovlarini tekshiring.</li><li>Ztunnel buzilsa — butun node'dagi pod'lar ta'sirlanadi (blast radius kattaroq).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoalarga faqat mTLS va L4 policy kerak — Ambient bunda overhead'ni keskin kamaytiradi. L7 ni faqat haqiqatan kerak bo'lgan servislar uchun waypoint bilan yoqing.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41151	<p>Linkerd nima va Istio bilan solishtirganda?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linkerd — CNCF graduated, soddalikka yo'naltirilgan service mesh. Data plane — Rust'da yozilgan <code>linkerd2-proxy</code> (Envoy emas), control plane — Go. Default'da avtomatik mTLS, golden metrics (success rate, RPS, latency), retry/timeout beradi; resurs va latency Istio sidecar'dan sezilarli past.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Jamoaga mTLS va observability kerak, lekin Istio'ning yuzlab CRD va sozlamalari og'ir.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>control plane: destination, identity (CA), proxy-injector<br>        |<br>[app | linkerd2-proxy] --mTLS--&gt; [linkerd2-proxy | app]<br>   ~10-20MB RAM, sub-ms latency</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>linkerd check --pre<br>linkerd install --crds | kubectl apply -f -<br>linkerd install | kubectl apply -f -<br>kubectl annotate ns shop linkerd.io/inject=enabled<br>kubectl rollout restart deploy -n shop<br>linkerd viz install | kubectl apply -f -<br>linkerd viz stat deploy -n shop     # SUCCESS  RPS  LATENCY_P99</pre><p><b>Istio bilan solishtirish:</b> | | Linkerd | Istio | |---|---|---| | Proxy | Rust micro-proxy | Envoy (C++) | | Murakkablik | past | yuqori | | L7 imkoniyatlar | asosiy (HTTPRoute, retry, split) | juda boy (filter, Wasm) | | Sidecar'siz | yo'q | Ambient | | Litsenziya | stable build'lar Buoyant orqali (2024 dan) | to'liq open source |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>2024'dan open source loyihada faqat edge release'lar; production stable build'lar Buoyant Enterprise orqali — litsenziya shartini tekshiring.</li><li>Envoy filter'lari, Wasm plugin'lari yo'q — murakkab L7 kerak bo'lsa yetmaydi.</li><li>Sertifikat trust anchor muddatini kuzatmasangiz mesh to'xtaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Mesh tanlovi = talab: faqat mTLS + metrika -&gt; Linkerd yoki Istio Ambient; murakkab traffic shaping, multi-cluster, Wasm -&gt; Istio. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41152	<p>Cilium Service Mesh nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cilium Service Mesh — sidecar'siz mesh: L3/L4 ishlarini (load balancing, policy, shifrlash, observability) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kernel'da eBPF bilan, L7 ishlarini esa har node'dagi umumiy Envoy bilan bajaradi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41153	<p>Cilium Hubble nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Hubble — Cilium'ning observability qatlami. eBPF orqali har bir tarmoq flow'ini (kim kimga, qaysi port, ruxsat berildi/tashlandi, HTTP/DNS/Kafka L7 tafsilotlari) ilovani o'zgartirmasdan ko'rsatadi: CLI, UI (servis grafi) va Prometheus metrikalari.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Pod A pod B ga ulana olmayapti&quot; — NetworkPolicy blokladimi, DNS xatomi, servis javob bermayaptimi? Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41154	<p>Cilium Cluster Mesh nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cilium Cluster Mesh — bir nechta Kubernetes klasterini tarmoq darajasida birlashtiradi: pod'lar boshqa klaster pod'lariga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri IP orqali ulanadi, &quot;global service&quot; bir nechta klasterdagi endpoint'larga load balance qiladi, NetworkPolicy klasterlar bo'ylab ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DR yoki region-lokal klasterlar: bir klasterdagi servis yiqilsa trafik boshqasiga avtomatik o'tishi kerak; yoki servis boshqa klasterdagi DB'ni chaqiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>cluster-1 (pod CIDR 10.1.0.0/16)        cluster-2 (10.2.0.0/16)<br>  cilium-agent &lt;--- clustermesh-apiserver ---&gt; cilium-agent<br>     endpoint/identity/servis ma'lumotlarini almashadi<br>  pod -&gt; global service &quot;api&quot; -&gt; lokal yoki remote endpoint</pre><p>Shartlar: pod CIDR'lar kesishmasligi, unikal <code>cluster.id</code> va <code>cluster.name</code>, node'lar orasida IP bog'lanish.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cilium install --set cluster.name=eu1 --set cluster.id=1<br>cilium clustermesh enable --context eu1<br>cilium clustermesh connect --context eu1 --destination-context eu2<br>cilium clustermesh status --wait</pre><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Service<br>metadata:<br>  name: api<br>  annotations:<br>    service.cilium.io/global: &quot;true&quot;<br>    service.cilium.io/affinity: &quot;local&quot;   # avval lokal, yo'q bo'lsa remote</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CIDR kesishmasa ham, keyinchalik qo'shilgan klaster bilan konflikt — IP rejasini oldindan qiling.</li><li>Klasterlararo trafik cross-region narx va latency — <code>affinity: local</code> qo'ying.</li><li>Identity'lar klasterlar bo'ylab umumiy — policy xatosi boshqa klasterni ham ochadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cluster Mesh — tarmoq yechimi, DR strategiyasi emas: ma'lumotlar replikatsiyasi va state alohida masala.
