Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41155	<p>Control plane high availability qanday quriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Control plane HA: kamida 3 ta control plane node, har biri boshqa AZ'da; etcd 3 yoki 5 a'zoli quorum; kube-apiserver'lar oldida L4 load balancer; scheduler va controller-manager leader election bilan (bir vaqtda bittasi aktiv). Managed (EKS/GKE/AKS) bularni o'zi qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yagona control plane node yiqilsa: yangi pod schedule bo'lmaydi, scale/deploy to'xtaydi, kubectl ishlamaydi (ishlab turgan pod'lar ishlashda davom etadi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            kubectl / kubelet<br>                  |<br>           L4 LB (NLB, haproxy+keepalived) :6443<br>         /        |         \<br>   apiserver  apiserver  apiserver   (hammasi aktiv)<br>   sched*     sched      sched       (* = leader, Lease orqali)<br>   etcd  &lt;==Raft==&gt; etcd &lt;==&gt; etcd   (stacked yoki external)<br>   AZ-a        AZ-b        AZ-c</pre><p><b>Amalda (kubeadm):</b></p><pre>kubeadm init --control-plane-endpoint &quot;k8s-api.example.com:6443&quot; \<br>  --upload-certs<br>kubeadm join k8s-api.example.com:6443 --control-plane \<br>  --certificate-key &lt;key&gt; --token ... --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash ...<br>kubectl get lease -n kube-system kube-scheduler -o yaml   # kim leader</pre><p><b>Stacked vs external etcd:</b> | | Stacked | External | |---|---|---| | Node soni | 3 | 3 CP + 3 etcd | | Soddalik | yuqori | past | | Izolyatsiya | etcd va apiserver bitta nosozlikda | alohida |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>2 ta control plane — HA emas: bittasi yiqilsa etcd quorum yo'qoladi.</li><li>LB health check'i TCP emas, <code>/readyz</code> ga bo'lishi kerak.</li><li>Barcha CP bitta AZ'da — AZ yiqilsa hammasi ketadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoalar uchun managed control plane to'g'ri tanlov — o'zingiz boshqarish faqat on-prem yoki maxsus talabda oqlanadi. HA'ni muntazam sinang: bitta CP node'ni o'chirib kubectl va deploy ishlashini tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41156	<p>etcd split-brain nima va qanday oldi olinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Split-brain — tarmoq bo'linishidan keyin ikki guruh ham o'zini leader deb ma'lumot yozishi. etcd buni <b>Raft</b> konsensusi bilan oldini oladi: yozish faqat majority (quorum = floor(N/2)+1) tasdiqlasa commit bo'ladi, minority tomon leader saylay olmaydi va yozmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Agar ikkala tomon yozsa — ikki xil &quot;haqiqat&quot;, qayta ulanganda ma'lumotlar konflikti; Kubernetes uchun bu bir obyektning ikki xil versiyasi demak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>5 a'zo, quorum = 3<br>   [A B C] | [D E]   tarmoq bo'lindi<br>   A,B,C: majority -&gt; leader bor, yozish ishlaydi<br>   D,E:   2 &lt; 3 -&gt; leader yo'q, yozish rad etiladi (read ham default linearizable -&gt; xato)<br>qayta ulanganda D,E leader log'ini oladi</pre><p>| A'zolar | Quorum | Chidaydi | |---|---|---| | 1 | 1 | 0 | | 3 | 2 | 1 | | 4 | 3 | 1 (4 foydasiz) | | 5 | 3 | 2 |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>etcdctl --endpoints=$EPS endpoint status -w table   # IS LEADER, RAFT TERM<br>etcdctl --endpoints=$EPS endpoint health<br>etcdctl member list -w table</pre><p>Metrikalar: <code>etcd_server_has_leader</code>, <code>etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Juft son (2, 4) — qo'shimcha chidamlilik bermaydi, faqat quorum'ni og'irlashtiradi.</li><li>3 a'zoni 2 AZ'ga (2+1) joylash: 2 talik AZ yiqilsa quorum yo'q — 3 AZ kerak.</li><li>Ko'p a'zo (7+) — yozish sekinlashadi (har yozish ko'proq tasdiq kutadi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Split-brain'dan himoya bepul emas: minority tomon ishlamaydi (CAP'da etcd — CP). Quorum yo'qolsa tiklash snapshot restore yoki <code>--force-new-cluster</code> bilan — buni oldindan runbook qiling.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41157	<p>etcd snapshot va restore qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> etcd backup = <code>etcdctl snapshot save</code> bilan point-in-time snapshot. Restore = <code>etcdutl snapshot restore</code> bilan yangi data-dir yaratish va etcd'ni shu katalog bilan (yangi klaster sifatida) ishga tushirish. Backup'ni muntazam restore qilib sinamaguncha u backup emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> etcd — butun klaster holati (Deployment, Secret, RBAC). Disk buzilsa yoki kimdir hamma narsani o'chirsa — snapshot'siz klasterni noldan qurish kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda — snapshot:</b></p><pre>ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl \<br>  --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 \<br>  --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt \<br>  --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt \<br>  --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key \<br>  snapshot save /backup/etcd-$(date +%F-%H%M).db<br>etcdutl snapshot status /backup/etcd-2026-10-03-0200.db -w table<br># HASH  REVISION  TOTAL KEYS  TOTAL SIZE</pre><p><b>Restore (kubeadm, bitta node):</b></p><pre>mv /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml /tmp/   # apiserver'ni to'xtatish<br>etcdutl snapshot restore /backup/etcd-....db \<br>  --data-dir /var/lib/etcd-restored \<br>  --name cp1 --initial-cluster cp1=https://10.0.0.1:2380 \<br>  --initial-advertise-peer-urls https://10.0.0.1:2380<br># etcd.yaml da hostPath'ni /var/lib/etcd-restored ga o'zgartirish<br>mv /tmp/kube-apiserver.yaml /etc/kubernetes/manifests/</pre><p>Ko'p a'zoli klasterda — har a'zoda bir xil snapshot'dan restore, keyin hammasini birga ishga tushirish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>etcdctl snapshot restore</code> deprecated — etcd 3.5+ da <code>etcdutl</code> ishlating.</li><li>Snapshot'da Secret'lar bor (shifrlanmagan bo'lishi mumkin) — backup'ni shifrlang va ruxsatni cheklang.</li><li>Restore'dan keyin klaster &quot;o'tmishga qaytadi&quot;: shu orada yaratilgan PV, LB'lar yetim qoladi; controller'lar qayta reconcile qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> etcd backup — oxirgi chora; GitOps (manifest'lar Git'da) + Velero (PV) bilan ko'pincha klasterni qayta qurish tezroq. Managed K8s'da etcd'ga kira olmaysiz — u yerda Velero va GitOps asosiy DR.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41158	<p>API Priority and Fairness (APF) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> API Priority and Fairness (APF, GA 1.29) — kube-apiserver'ning so'rovlarni boshqarish mexanizmi. Har so'rov <code>FlowSchema</code> bo'yicha <code>PriorityLevelConfiguration</code> ga tushadi; har darajaning o'z concurrency ulushi va navbati bor. Bitta shovqinli client boshqalarni bo'g'a olmaydi — ortiqcha so'rovlar navbatga turadi yoki 429 oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Noto'g'ri yozilgan controller sekundiga minglab LIST yuboradi; apiserver to'lib qoladi va kubelet heartbeat'lari, scheduler ham javob ololmaydi — butun klaster &quot;osiladi&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>so'rov -&gt; FlowSchema (user, group, verb, resource bo'yicha mos keladi)<br>       -&gt; PriorityLevel: system | leader-election | workload-high | workload-low | global-default | catch-all<br>       -&gt; flow'lar bo'yicha fair queuing (shuffle sharding)<br>       -&gt; concurrency bor: bajar | navbat to'la: 429 + Retry-After</pre><p><code>exempt</code> darajasi (system:masters) cheklanmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get flowschemas<br>kubectl get prioritylevelconfigurations<br>kubectl get --raw /debug/api_priority_and_fairness/dump_priority_levels</pre><p>Metrikalar: <code>apiserver_flow_control_rejected_requests_total</code>, <code>apiserver_flow_control_request_wait_duration_seconds</code>, <code>apiserver_flow_control_current_inqueue_requests</code>.</p><p>Shovqinli servis account'ni past darajaga tushirish:</p><pre>apiVersion: flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: FlowSchema<br>metadata: { name: noisy-exporter }<br>spec:<br>  priorityLevelConfiguration: { name: workload-low }<br>  matchingPrecedence: 500<br>  rules:<br>  - subjects: [{ kind: ServiceAccount, serviceAccount: { name: exporter, namespace: mon } }]<br>    resourceRules: [{ verbs: [&quot;*&quot;], apiGroups: [&quot;*&quot;], resources: [&quot;*&quot;], clusterScope: true, namespaces: [&quot;*&quot;] }]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default PriorityLevel'larni o'zgartirish — upgrade'da qayta yoziladi (<code>apf.kubernetes.io/autoupdate-spec</code> annotatsiyasi).</li><li>429 ni client qayta urinish bilan yengishga harakat qilsa — muammo kuchayadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> APF simptomni yumshatadi; ildiz — client'lar polling o'rniga informer/watch ishlatishi kerak (41206). APF metrikalariga dashboard qo'ying — qaysi flow rad etilayotganini ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41159	<p>Kubelet sertifikat rotatsiyasi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubelet ikki xil sertifikat ishlatadi: <b>client</b> (apiserver'ga <code>system:node:&lt;name&gt;</code> sifatida kirish) va <b>serving</b> (apiserver kubelet'ning :10250 portiga ulanganda). Rotatsiya — muddati tugashidan oldin kubelet o'zi CSR yuborib yangisini oladi; client CSR avtomatik tasdiqlanadi, serving CSR'ni tasdiqlash uchun alohida mexanizm kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> kubeadm klasterlarda sertifikatlar 1 yillik. Rotatsiya yo'q bo'lsa — bir kuni hamma node bir vaqtda <code>NotReady</code>, <code>x509: certificate has expired</code>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubelet: cert muddatining ~70-90% o'tdi<br>  -&gt; yangi key + CertificateSigningRequest<br>  -&gt; client CSR: kube-controller-manager (csrapproving) avtomatik approve<br>  -&gt; serving CSR: qo'lda / kubelet-csr-approver bilan approve<br>  -&gt; kube-controller-manager imzolaydi -&gt; kubelet faylni almashtiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda (<code>kubelet-config.yaml</code>):</b></p><pre>rotateCertificates: true        # client cert (default kubeadm'da yoqilgan)<br>serverTLSBootstrap: true        # serving cert ham CSR orqali</pre><pre>kubectl get csr<br># NAME       SIGNERNAME                      REQUESTOR         CONDITION<br># csr-8x2k   kubernetes.io/kubelet-serving   system:node:w1    Pending<br>kubectl certificate approve csr-8x2k<br>openssl x509 -in /var/lib/kubelet/pki/kubelet-client-current.pem -noout -enddate</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>serverTLSBootstrap</code> yoqib serving CSR'larni tasdiqlamaslik — <code>kubectl logs/exec</code> ishlamay qoladi.</li><li>Serving CSR'ni ko'r-ko'rona avtomatik approve qilish xavfli (node boshqa nom uchun sertifikat so'rashi mumkin) — <code>kubelet-csr-approver</code> IP/nomni tekshiradi.</li><li>Control plane sertifikatlari (apiserver va h.k.) bu mexanizm bilan yangilanmaydi — <code>kubeadm certs renew</code> yoki upgrade (41210).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sertifikat muddati uchun alert qo'ying (<code>kubelet_certificate_manager_client_ttl_seconds</code>). Muntazam (yiliga kamida bir) klaster upgrade — sertifikatlarni ham yangilaydi va bu muammoni tabiiy hal qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41160	<p>Custom kubelet konfiguratsiyasi (<code>kubelet-config.yaml</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>KubeletConfiguration</code> (odatda <code>/var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml</code>) — kubelet'ning deklarativ sozlama fayli. CLI flag'lar o'rniga shu yerda: resurs rezervlari, eviction chegaralari, image GC, log rotation, max pods, cgroup driver va boshqalar. Ko'p flag'lar deprecated — config fayl tavsiya qilingan yo'l.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Default kubelet node'ning barcha resursini pod'larga beradi, log'larni 10Mi da aylantiradi, 110 pod limiti. Katta node'larda yoki og'ir yuklamada bu node'ni barqarorsiz qiladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1<br>kind: KubeletConfiguration<br>cgroupDriver: systemd<br>maxPods: 110<br>systemReserved: { cpu: 500m, memory: 1Gi }<br>kubeReserved:   { cpu: 500m, memory: 1Gi }<br>evictionHard:<br>  memory.available: &quot;500Mi&quot;<br>  nodefs.available: &quot;10%&quot;<br>  imagefs.available: &quot;15%&quot;<br>evictionSoft: { memory.available: &quot;1Gi&quot; }<br>evictionSoftGracePeriod: { memory.available: &quot;1m&quot; }<br>imageGCHighThresholdPercent: 80<br>imageGCLowThresholdPercent: 65<br>containerLogMaxSize: 50Mi<br>containerLogMaxFiles: 3<br>shutdownGracePeriod: 60s<br>shutdownGracePeriodCriticalPods: 10s</pre><pre>systemctl restart kubelet<br>kubectl get --raw &quot;/api/v1/nodes/w1/proxy/configz&quot; | jq   # amaldagi config</pre><p>kubeadm'da <code>kubeadm-config</code> ichidagi <code>KubeletConfiguration</code> orqali barcha node'larga; EKS'da launch template user-data / Karpenter <code>kubelet</code> bloki.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Fayldagi o'zgarish restart'siz qo'llanmaydi; noto'g'ri YAML — kubelet ishga tushmaydi, node <code>NotReady</code>.</li><li><code>cgroupDriver</code> container runtime bilan mos bo'lmasa pod'lar yaratilmaydi.</li><li>Bir node'ni qo'lda o'zgartirish — drift; config'ni IaC orqali boshqaring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Node konfiguratsiyasi immutable bo'lgani ma'qul: config'ni image/launch template'ga qo'ying va node'larni almashtiring, SSH bilan tahrirlamang. <code>configz</code> endpoint — haqiqiy holatni tekshirishning ishonchli usuli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41161	<p>System va Kube resurs rezervlari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Node resurslari uch qismga bo'linadi: <code>system-reserved</code> (OS: systemd, sshd, journald), <code>kube-reserved</code> (kubelet, containerd) va eviction threshold. Qolgani — <b>Allocatable</b>, scheduler faqat shuni pod'larga beradi. Rezerv bo'lmasa pod'lar kubelet'ni xotirasiz qoldirib node'ni yiqitishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Node 16Gi. Pod'lar 16Gi ni to'liq oladi, kubelet va containerd ga joy qolmaydi -&gt; kernel OOM tasodifiy process'ni (balki kubelet'ni) o'ldiradi -&gt; node <code>NotReady</code>, barcha pod'lar boshqa node'larga ko'chadi -&gt; kaskad.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Capacity (16Gi)<br> - kube-reserved     (1Gi)<br> - system-reserved   (1Gi)<br> - eviction-hard     (500Mi)<br> = Allocatable       (13.5Gi)  &lt;- scheduler shuni ko'radi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># KubeletConfiguration<br>systemReserved: { cpu: 500m, memory: 1Gi, ephemeral-storage: 5Gi }<br>kubeReserved:   { cpu: 500m, memory: 1Gi }<br>evictionHard:   { memory.available: 500Mi }<br>enforceNodeAllocatable: [&quot;pods&quot;]</pre><pre>kubectl describe node w1 | grep -A6 -E &quot;Capacity|Allocatable&quot;<br># Capacity:    memory: 16Gi<br># Allocatable: memory: 13.5Gi</pre><p>Cloud'lar (EKS AMI, GKE) node hajmiga qarab formula bilan rezerv qo'yadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>enforceNodeAllocatable</code> ga <code>system-reserved</code> ni qo'shish — OS daemon'larni cgroup'da cheklaydi; noto'g'ri hajmda sshd/systemd o'ldirilishi mumkin. Odatda faqat <code>pods</code> qoldiriladi.</li><li>Pod'larda limit'siz memory — Allocatable ham himoya qilmaydi, eviction kerak.</li><li>Kichik node'larda rezerv nisbatan katta — juda kichik instance'lar tejamli emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rezervni taxmin bilan emas, o'lchab qo'ying: node'da kubelet/containerd haqiqiy iste'molini (<code>systemd-cgtop</code>) kuzating. Ko'p pod'li node'larda kubelet xotirasi pod soniga qarab o'sadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41162	<p>Topology spread constraint va pod anti-affinity farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pod anti-affinity — &quot;bu pod shu label'li pod bor joyga tushmasin&quot; degan binar qoida. Topology spread constraint — pod'larni zona/node bo'ylab <b>teng</b> taqsimlash, ruxsat etilgan farqni <code>maxSkew</code> bilan beradi. Ko'p replikali servislar uchun topology spread yaxshiroq va scheduler uchun arzonroq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 3 AZ, 9 replika. Anti-affinity (required, zona bo'yicha) bilan har zonaga faqat 1 pod sig'adi — 4-replika <code>Pending</code>. Hech qanday qoida bo'lmasa hammasi bitta zonaga tushib AZ yiqilganda servis ketadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>topology spread, maxSkew=1, topologyKey=zone:<br>  zone-a: 3   zone-b: 3   zone-c: 3   -&gt; ok<br>  yangi pod: eng kam zonaga (farq &lt;= 1)<br>anti-affinity required: zone-a:1 zone-b:1 zone-c:1, 4-pod -&gt; Pending</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>topologySpreadConstraints:<br>- maxSkew: 1<br>  topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone<br>  whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule<br>  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  minDomains: 3<br>- maxSkew: 2<br>  topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname<br>  whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway<br>  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }</pre><p>Anti-affinity hali ham foydali joy: &quot;bu DB pod'i boshqa DB bilan bir node'da bo'lmasin&quot; (2-3 replika).</p><p>| | Anti-affinity | Topology spread | |---|---|---| | Mantiq | bor/yo'q | teng taqsimot | | Ko'p replika | Pending xavfi | yaxshi scale | | Scheduler narxi | katta klasterda qimmat | arzonroq |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Spread faqat scheduling paytida tekshiriladi — keyinchalik muvozanat buzilsa o'zi tuzalmaydi (Descheduler kerak, 41216).</li><li>Rolling update'da eski pod'lar ham hisobga olinadi — <code>matchLabelKeys: [pod-template-hash]</code> qo'shing.</li><li><code>DoNotSchedule</code> + autoscaler zonada node yarata olmasa — Pending.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default sifatida zona bo'yicha <code>maxSkew: 1</code> + node bo'yicha <code>ScheduleAnyway</code> yetarli; klaster darajasida default constraint'larni scheduler profilida berish mumkin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41163	<p>VolumeSnapshot (CSI snapshotter) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>VolumeSnapshot</code> — PVC'ning point-in-time snapshot'ini Kubernetes API orqali olish standarti. CSI driver snapshot'ni storage darajasida (EBS snapshot, Ceph RBD snapshot) bajaradi. Uch obyekt: <code>VolumeSnapshotClass</code> (qanday), <code>VolumeSnapshot</code> (so'rov), <code>VolumeSnapshotContent</code> (haqiqiy snapshot).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB migratsiyasidan oldin diskni tez saqlab qo'yish kerak; yoki staging'ga prod ma'lumot nusxasini berish. Cloud konsolida qo'lda snapshot olish avtomatlashtirilmaydi va K8s bilan bog'lanmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>VolumeSnapshot (ns) --&gt; snapshot-controller --&gt; VolumeSnapshotContent (cluster)<br>                              |<br>                       csi-snapshotter sidecar -&gt; CSI CreateSnapshot -&gt; storage<br>PVC (dataSource: VolumeSnapshot) -&gt; yangi volume snapshot'dan</pre><p>CRD va snapshot-controller alohida o'rnatiladi (ko'p managed klasterlarda add-on).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: snapshot.storage.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: VolumeSnapshotClass<br>metadata: { name: ebs-snap }<br>driver: ebs.csi.aws.com<br>deletionPolicy: Retain<br>---<br>apiVersion: snapshot.storage.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: VolumeSnapshot<br>metadata: { name: pg-before-migration }<br>spec:<br>  volumeSnapshotClassName: ebs-snap<br>  source: { persistentVolumeClaimName: data-pg-0 }<br>---<br>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: PersistentVolumeClaim<br>metadata: { name: pg-restore }<br>spec:<br>  dataSource: { name: pg-before-migration, kind: VolumeSnapshot, apiGroup: snapshot.storage.k8s.io }<br>  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]<br>  resources: { requests: { storage: 100Gi } }</pre><pre>kubectl get volumesnapshot   # READYTOUSE true bo'lishini kuting</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Snapshot crash-consistent: DB uchun avval flush/freeze (<code>fsfreeze</code>, <code>pg_backup_start</code>) yoki app-level backup.</li><li><code>deletionPolicy: Delete</code> — VolumeSnapshot o'chirilsa haqiqiy snapshot ham ketadi.</li><li>Snapshot ko'pincha shu AZ/region'da — DR uchun cross-region nusxa kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> VolumeSnapshot — backup'ning bir qismi, butun backup emas. Velero CSI snapshot'lar bilan integratsiya qilib manifest + volume'ni birga saqlaydi; restore'ni muntazam sinang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41164	<p>Kubernetes'da volume expansion nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Volume expansion — PVC'dagi <code>spec.resources.requests.storage</code> ni oshirib diskni kattalashtirish. Shart: StorageClass'da <code>allowVolumeExpansion: true</code> va CSI driver qo'llab-quvvatlashi. Ko'pchilik driver'lar online (pod ishlab turgan holda) kengaytiradi. Kamaytirib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB diski 95% to'ldi. Yangi disk yaratib ma'lumot ko'chirish — downtime va xavf; expansion bir buyruq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PVC 50Gi -&gt; 100Gi<br>  -&gt; external-resizer: CSI ControllerExpandVolume (EBS ModifyVolume)<br>  -&gt; kubelet: NodeExpandVolume (resize2fs / xfs_growfs)<br>  -&gt; PVC status.capacity = 100Gi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: StorageClass<br>metadata: { name: gp3 }<br>provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com<br>allowVolumeExpansion: true</pre><pre>kubectl patch pvc data-pg-0 -p '{&quot;spec&quot;:{&quot;resources&quot;:{&quot;requests&quot;:{&quot;storage&quot;:&quot;100Gi&quot;}}}}'<br>kubectl get pvc data-pg-0 -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions}'<br># FileSystemResizePending -&gt; filesystem kengaytirilishini kutyapti<br>kubectl exec pg-0 -- df -h /var/lib/postgresql</pre><p><b>StatefulSet uchun:</b> <code>volumeClaimTemplates</code> ni o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi. Yo'l: har PVC'ni alohida patch qilish, keyin StatefulSet'ni <code>kubectl delete sts pg --cascade=orphan</code> va yangi hajm bilan qayta yaratish (K8s 1.32+ da template o'zgartirish alpha).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>AWS EBS: bitta volume'ni har 6 soatda bir martagina modify qilish mumkin.</li><li>Kamaytirish yo'q — &quot;vaqtincha kattalashtiraman&quot; deb o'ylamang, xarajat qoladi.</li><li>Filesystem resize bo'lmasa (eski driver) pod restart talab qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Disk to'lishini 80% da alert qiling, 95% da emas. <code>kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes</code> bo'yicha prognoz (<code>predict_linear</code>) — bir necha kun oldin ogohlantiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41165	<p>Generic ephemeral volume nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Generic ephemeral volume — pod spec ichida <code>volumeClaimTemplate</code> yoziladi; pod yaratilganda Kubernetes avtomatik PVC yaratadi (StorageClass orqali haqiqiy disk), pod o'chganda PVC ham o'chadi. <code>emptyDir</code> kabi vaqtinchalik, lekin har qanday CSI storage'ning imkoniyatlari bilan (hajm, IOPS, snapshot).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilovaga katta vaqtinchalik joy kerak (100Gi cache, ML scratch). <code>emptyDir</code> node root diskini to'ldiradi va boshqa pod'larni evict qiladi; oddiy PVC esa pod tugagach qo'lda tozalash talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod &quot;worker-abc&quot; yaratildi<br>  -&gt; ephemeral controller: PVC &quot;worker-abc-scratch&quot; (ownerRef = pod)<br>  -&gt; provisioner disk yaratadi -&gt; pod'ga ulanadi<br>Pod o'chdi -&gt; GC PVC'ni o'chiradi -&gt; reclaimPolicy Delete -&gt; disk o'chadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Pod<br>metadata: { name: worker }<br>spec:<br>  containers:<br>  - name: app<br>    image: worker:1.2<br>    volumeMounts: [{ name: scratch, mountPath: /scratch }]<br>  volumes:<br>  - name: scratch<br>    ephemeral:<br>      volumeClaimTemplate:<br>        spec:<br>          accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]<br>          storageClassName: gp3<br>          resources: { requests: { storage: 100Gi } }</pre><pre>kubectl get pvc     # worker-scratch avtomatik paydo bo'ladi</pre><p><b>emptyDir bilan solishtirish:</b> | | emptyDir | generic ephemeral | |---|---|---| | Joy | node disk/RAM | alohida volume | | Hajm | node'ga bog'liq | istalgan | | Yaratish tezligi | darhol | provision vaqti (sekundlar) |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Provision vaqti pod startup'ni sekinlashtiradi; <code>WaitForFirstConsumer</code> StorageClass tavsiya.</li><li>PVC nomi <code>&lt;pod&gt;-&lt;volume&gt;</code> — shu nomli PVC oldindan bo'lsa pod ishga tushmaydi.</li><li>Ko'p qisqa pod'lar = ko'p disk yaratish/o'chirish, cloud API limitlari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kichik vaqtinchalik joy uchun <code>emptyDir</code> + <code>ephemeral-storage</code> limit yetarli; generic ephemeral'ni katta yoki tez (NVMe, IOPS) scratch kerak bo'lganda ishlating.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41166	<p>Secret'larni at-rest shifrlash qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Default holatda Secret'lar etcd'da faqat base64 — ya'ni ochiq matn. At-rest shifrlash: kube-apiserver'ga <code>EncryptionConfiguration</code> beriladi; Secret etcd'ga yozilishidan oldin shifrlanadi. Production'da <b>KMS v2</b> provider (AWS KMS, Vault, Azure Key Vault) — kalit etcd va node'dan tashqarida turadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> etcd snapshot yoki diski o'g'irlansa — barcha DB parollar, TLS kalitlar, tokenlar ochiq o'qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (KMS v2, envelope encryption):</b></p><pre>Secret -&gt; apiserver: DEK bilan AES-GCM shifrlash<br>       -&gt; DEK KMS'dagi KEK bilan shifrlangan (KEK KMS'dan chiqmaydi)<br>       -&gt; etcd: &quot;k8s:enc:kms:v2:...&quot; + shifrlangan DEK<br>o'qishda: DEK'ni KMS orqali ochish (keshlanadi) -&gt; Secret</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: EncryptionConfiguration<br>resources:<br>- resources: [secrets, configmaps]<br>  providers:<br>  - kms:<br>      apiVersion: v2<br>      name: aws-kms<br>      endpoint: unix:///var/run/kmsplugin/socket.sock<br>  - identity: {}          # eski shifrlanmagan ma'lumotni o'qish uchun</pre><pre># kube-apiserver flag: --encryption-provider-config=/etc/kubernetes/enc.yaml<br># mavjud secret'larni qayta yozish (shifrlash uchun):<br>kubectl get secrets -A -o json | kubectl replace -f -</pre><p>EKS: <code>aws eks associate-encryption-config</code>; GKE: Application-layer secrets encryption.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Config qo'shish eski secret'larni avtomatik shifrlamaydi — qayta yozish shart.</li><li><code>identity</code> ni birinchi qo'ysangiz — yangi yozuvlar shifrlanmaydi (birinchi provider yozish uchun ishlatiladi).</li><li><code>aescbc</code>/<code>secretbox</code> lokal kalit — kalit shu node'da diskda yotadi; KMS v1 deprecated.</li><li>KMS ishlamasa apiserver secret o'qiy olmaydi — KMS ham HA bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> At-rest shifrlash faqat etcd/backup o'g'irlanishidan himoya; <code>get secrets</code> RBAC'i bor odam baribir o'qiydi. Shuning uchun RBAC cheklovi va tashqi secret store (Secrets Store CSI, External Secrets) ham kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41167	<p>Kubernetes audit logging nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Audit logging — kube-apiserver har bir so'rov haqida yozuv qoldiradi: kim (user, group, SA), nima (verb, resource, ns, name), qachon, qayerdan (source IP, user-agent) va natija (status code). Nima va qanchalik batafsil yozilishini <b>audit policy</b> belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Kim prod'dagi Deployment'ni o'chirdi?&quot;, &quot;Kim Secret'ni o'qidi?&quot; — audit log'siz javob yo'q. Compliance (SOC2, PCI) ham talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>so'rov -&gt; stage: RequestReceived -&gt; ResponseStarted -&gt; ResponseComplete | Panic<br>policy: birinchi mos qoida darajani belgilaydi<br>  None | Metadata | Request | RequestResponse<br>backend: log fayl yoki webhook (SIEM)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: audit.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: Policy<br>omitStages: [RequestReceived]<br>rules:<br>- level: None                       # shovqinni o'chirish<br>  users: [&quot;system:kube-proxy&quot;]<br>  verbs: [watch]<br>- level: Metadata                   # Secret mazmunini YOZMANG<br>  resources: [{ group: &quot;&quot;, resources: [secrets, configmaps] }]<br>- level: RequestResponse<br>  verbs: [create, update, patch, delete]<br>- level: Metadata</pre><pre># kube-apiserver flaglari:<br>--audit-policy-file=/etc/kubernetes/audit-policy.yaml<br>--audit-log-path=/var/log/kubernetes/audit.log<br>--audit-log-maxage=30 --audit-log-maxbackup=10 --audit-log-maxsize=100<br>jq 'select(.verb==&quot;delete&quot; and .objectRef.resource==&quot;deployments&quot;)<br>    | {user:.user.username, ns:.objectRef.namespace, name:.objectRef.name}' audit.log</pre><p>Managed: EKS — CloudWatch'ga <code>audit</code> log turi; GKE — Cloud Audit Logs.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret'larga <code>Request</code>/<code>RequestResponse</code> darajasi — parollar audit log'ga yoziladi.</li><li>Hammasini <code>RequestResponse</code> — log hajmi va apiserver yuklamasi keskin oshadi.</li><li>Log faqat node diskida — control plane yiqilsa yo'qoladi; markaziy tizimga yuboring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Audit log o'zi himoya emas — undan alert yasang: <code>exec</code> prod pod'larga, <code>system:masters</code> ishlatilishi, ClusterRoleBinding yaratilishi, anonim so'rovlar. Saqlash muddatini compliance talabiga moslang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting

Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41170	<p><code>hostPath</code> mount orqali container escape qanday sodir bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>hostPath</code> node fayl tizimini pod ichiga mount qiladi. Agar keng yo'l (<code>/</code>, <code>/etc</code>, <code>/var/lib/kubelet</code>) yozish huquqi bilan mount qilinsa, container o'z izolyatsiyasini aylanib o'tib node fayllariga ta'sir qila oladi — amalda host ustidan nazorat. Pod Security Admission <code>baseline</code>/<code>restricted</code> darajasi hostPath'ni taqiqlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilovada zaiflik topilsa, hostPath mount bo'lgan pod'da hujumchi container doirasidan chiqib node'ga, u orqali node'dagi boshqa pod'larning secret'lari va kubelet credential'lariga yetib boradi — blast radius butun node.</p><p><b>Nega xavfli (konseptual):</b></p><pre>pod (hostPath / -&gt; /host, yozish mumkin)<br>  -&gt; node'ning tizim fayllari, kubelet secret katalogi, service token'lar ko'rinadi<br>  -&gt; container izolyatsiyasi aylanib o'tiladi -&gt; node darajasida ta'sir</pre><p><b>Himoya — amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl label ns apps pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted<br># hostPath'li pod rad etiladi:<br># violates PodSecurity &quot;baseline:latest&quot;: hostPath volumes (volume &quot;host&quot;)</pre><p>Agar haqiqatan kerak bo'lsa (log agent) — faqat aniq yo'l va <code>readOnly</code>:</p><pre>volumes:<br>- name: logs<br>  hostPath: { path: /var/log, type: Directory }<br>containers:<br>- volumeMounts: [{ name: logs, mountPath: /var/log, readOnly: true }]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>readOnly: true</code> ham sir o'qishni to'liq to'xtatmaydi (kubelet pod secret kataloglari).</li><li>Ruxsat etilgan yo'l ichidagi symlink node'ning boshqa joyiga olib borishi mumkin.</li><li><code>kube-system</code> DaemonSet'lari (CNI, log agent) hostPath ishlatadi — ular ham hujum yuzasi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> hostPath kerak bo'lgan workload'larni alohida namespace va node pool'ga ajrating, Kyverno/ValidatingAdmissionPolicy bilan yo'llarni whitelist qiling va Falco bilan node fayllariga yozishni kuzating.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41171	<p>Docker socket mount orqali container escape qanday sodir bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code> (yoki <code>containerd.sock</code>) — container runtime daemon'ining to'liq boshqaruv API'si. Uni pod ichiga mount qilish amalda node root huquqini berish bilan teng: shu socketdan foydalanib hujumchi yangi, keng huquqli container yaratib node'ni egallay oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI runner'lar (image build uchun) yoki monitoring agent'lar ko'pincha runtime socket mount qiladi. Shu pod'dagi istalgan zaiflik butun node'ga aylanib kirish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Nega xavfli (konseptual):</b></p><pre>pod -&gt; /var/run/docker.sock mount qilingan<br>  -&gt; daemon API orqali host fayl tizimini ko'radigan yangi container so'ralishi mumkin<br>  -&gt; container doirasidan node darajasiga ko'tarilish</pre><p><b>Himoya — amalda:</b></p><pre># Admission policy bilan runtime socket mountni bloklash (Kyverno misoli)<br>spec:<br>  rules:<br>  - name: no-sock<br>    validate:<br>      message: &quot;docker/containerd socket mount taqiqlangan&quot;<br>      pattern:<br>        spec:<br>          =(volumes):<br>          - =(hostPath):<br>              path: &quot;!/var/run/docker.sock &amp; !/run/containerd/containerd.sock&quot;</pre><p>Image build uchun socketsiz yechimlar: <b>Kaniko</b>, <b>Buildah</b>, <b>BuildKit (rootless)</b> — daemon kerak emas.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;faqat o'qish uchun kerak&quot; degan monitoring agent ham socket orqali yozishi mumkin — socket read/write ajratilmaydi.</li><li>Docker-in-Docker (<code>--privileged</code>) ham xuddi shunday xavfli alternativa.</li><li>PSA bu holatni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bloklamaydi (hostPath sifatida keladi) — aniq policy yozing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Runtime socketga ehtiyojni me'morchilik xatosi deb qarang: CI build'ni daemonsiz builder'ga, monitoring'ni read-only API/eBPF agent'ga o'tkazing. Socket mount qoladigan joylarni admission policy bilan whitelist qiling va alohida izolyatsiya qiling.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41172	<p>Workload identity federation (AWS IRSA / GCP Workload Identity / Azure) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Workload identity federation — pod'ga statik cloud access key berish o'rniga, Kubernetes ServiceAccount token'ini (OIDC bilan imzolangan) cloud IAM'ga ishontirish. Pod bu tokenni cloud STS'da qisqa muddatli credential'ga almashtiradi. AWS'da IRSA, GCP'da Workload Identity, Azure'da Workload Identity shu printsipda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Pod'ga S3/RDS kerak. AWS'da yangi klaster uchun IRSA o'rniga EKS Pod Identity (41173) ko'pincha soddaroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41173	<p>EKS Pod Identity nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> EKS Pod Identity (2023'dan) — IRSA'ning soddalashtirilgan muqobili: har klaster uchun OIDC provider trust sozlashsiz, EKS'da ishlaydigan agent orqali ServiceAccount'ni IAM role'ga <code>EKS Pod Identity Association</code> bilan bevosita bog'laydi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41174	<p>Kubernetes'da Crossplane nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Crossplane — Kubernetes'ni universal control plane'ga aylantiruvchi CNCF framework. Cloud resurslarini (S3, RDS, VPC) oddiy YAML CRD sifatida yaratasiz; Crossplane ularni provider orqali provision qiladi va <b>doimiy reconcile</b> qiladi (drift bo'lsa tuzatadi). Terraform'dan farqi — deklarativ, doimiy ishlaydigan controller, bir martalik apply emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova jamoasiga RDS kerak; har safar platform jamoasidan so'rash yoki Terraform PR kutish sekin. Crossplane bilan jamoa o'z namespace'ida CRD yaratadi, platform esa qaysi resurs ruxsat etilganini (Composition) belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Claim (ilova jamoasi) -&gt; Composite Resource (XR)<br>   -&gt; Composition (platform: qanday resurslar) -&gt; Managed Resources<br>   -&gt; provider-aws -&gt; cloud API -&gt; reconcile loop (drift tuzatadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: database.example.org/v1alpha1<br>kind: PostgreSQLInstance<br>metadata: { name: orders-db }<br>spec:<br>  parameters: { storageGB: 100, version: &quot;16&quot; }<br>  compositionRef: { name: rds-standard }</pre><p>Platform jamoa Composition'da instance class, backup, VPC'ni standartlashtiradi — ilova jamoasi faqat <code>storageGB</code> beradi.</p><p><b>Terraform bilan solishtirish:</b> | | Terraform | Crossplane | |---|---|---| | Model | imperativ apply | doimiy reconcile | | State | tfstate fayl | etcd (K8s obyektlari) | | Drift | <code>plan</code> da ko'rinadi | avtomatik tuzatiladi | | Self-service | PR orqali | CRD/Claim orqali |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Provider CRD'lari juda ko'p (minglab) — API bloat, etcd yuklamasi.</li><li>Reconcile drift'ni &quot;tuzatadi&quot; — kimdir qo'lda o'zgartirsa qaytaradi (xohlamagan bo'lsa muammo).</li><li>Composition yozish o'rganishni talab qiladi; kichik jamoada Terraform soddaroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Crossplane platform jamoasi ko'p jamoaga self-service infra bergisi kelganda kuchli — &quot;internal developer platform&quot; qurilishi. Oddiy infra uchun Terraform/OpenTofu yetarli; doimiy reconcile'ning qiymati drift'dan qo'rqadigan prod'da ko'rinadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41175	<p><code>vcluster</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>vcluster</code> (Loft) — host klaster namespace'i ichida ishlaydigan to'liq virtual Kubernetes klaster: o'z API server'i, scheduler'i va CRD'lari bor, lekin pod'lar aslida host klasterda ishlaydi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41176	<p>Cluster API (CAPI) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cluster API (CAPI) — Kubernetes'ning o'zini (klasterlarni) deklarativ CRD'lar bilan boshqarish sub-loyihasi: <code>Cluster</code>, <code>Machine</code>, <code>MachineDeployment</code> obyektlari orqali AWS/Azure/GCP/vSphere'da klaster yaratish, node'larni upgrade va scale qilish. &quot;Kubernetes bilan Kubernetes'ni boshqarish&quot;.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 30 ta klaster turli muhitda; har birini qo'lda yoki alohida skript bilan yaratish, upgrade qilish nomuvofiq va xatoga moyil. CAPI ularni bir management klasterdan bir xil GitOps bilan boshqaradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>management cluster (CAPI controllers)<br>  Cluster + ControlPlane + MachineDeployment (CRD)<br>    -&gt; infrastructure provider (CAPA=AWS, CAPZ=Azure...)<br>    -&gt; bootstrap provider (kubeadm) -&gt; workload cluster<br>  reconcile: desired node soni/versiya &lt;-&gt; haqiqiy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>clusterctl init --infrastructure aws<br>clusterctl generate cluster prod --kubernetes-version v1.31.0 \<br>  --control-plane-machine-count=3 --worker-machine-count=6 &gt; prod.yaml<br>kubectl apply -f prod.yaml<br>kubectl get machines<br># upgrade: MachineDeployment'da version'ni o'zgartirish -&gt; rolling node replace</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Management klasterning o'zi yagona nosozlik nuqtasi — uni HA va backup qiling (yoki boshqa management boshqaradi).</li><li>Provider versiyalari (CAPA/CAPZ) va K8s versiyalari o'rtasida moslik matritsasi.</li><li>O'rnatish egri chizig'i tik; kichik jamoaga eksctl/managed node group soddaroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CAPI ko'p klasterni standart va GitOps bilan boshqarish kerak bo'lganda oqlanadi (platform jamoa). Bir-ikki klaster uchun ortiqcha — managed service yoki Terraform yetarli. Har plugin so'rovni qayta ishlashning bir qismini bajaradi (<code>kubernetes</code> — Service/Pod yozuvlari, <code>forward</code> — tashqariga, <code>cache</code> — kesh, <code>errors</code>/<code>log</code> — kuzatuv). Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41178	<p>CoreDNS autoscaling qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CoreDNS yuklamasi node va pod soniga qarab o'sadi. <code>cluster-proportional-autoscaler</code> — CoreDNS replikalari sonini klaster o'lchamiga (node soni va/yoki CPU core) proporsional avtomatik sozlaydi. HPA'dan farqi — CPU metrikasiga emas, klaster hajmiga qarab scale qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klaster 10 node'dan 200 node'ga o'sdi, CoreDNS esa 2 replikada qoldi — DNS bo'g'ilib latency va timeout'lar. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41179	<p>Ingress pathType'lari (<code>Exact</code>, <code>Prefix</code>, <code>ImplementationSpecific</code>) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ingress qoidasida <code>pathType</code> yo'l mosligini qanday aniqlanishini belgilaydi: <code>Exact</code> — aynan teng, <code>Prefix</code> — <code>/</code> bilan ajratilgan element prefiksi, <code>ImplementationSpecific</code> — controller o'zi hal qiladi (ko'pincha regex). <code>pathType</code> majburiy maydon.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>/api</code> qoidasi <code>/api/users</code> ni qamrashi kerakmi yoki faqat aynan <code>/api</code> nimi? pathType'siz bu noaniq va controller'lar turlicha ishlagan — endi aniq belgilanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Prefix /api:   /api OK, /api/ OK, /api/users OK, /apix EMAS<br>Exact /api/v1: faqat /api/v1 (/api/v1/ ham emas)<br>ImplementationSpecific: controller'ga bog'liq (nginx regex, GCE'da boshqacha)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: Ingress<br>spec:<br>  rules:<br>  - host: shop.example.com<br>    http:<br>      paths:<br>      - path: /api<br>        pathType: Prefix<br>        backend: { service: { name: api, port: { number: 80 } } }<br>      - path: /healthz<br>        pathType: Exact<br>        backend: { service: { name: web, port: { number: 80 } } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Prefix</code> element bo'yicha: <code>/api</code> <code>/apix</code> ga mos EMAS, lekin ko'pchilik buni oddiy string prefiksi deb o'ylaydi.</li><li><code>ImplementationSpecific</code> portativ emas — nginx'da regex ishlaydi, GCE Ingress'da boshqacha; controller almashtirsangiz buziladi.</li><li>Bir nechta mos qoida bo'lsa aniqlik (longest match) controller'ga bog'liq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Portativlik uchun <code>Prefix</code>/<code>Exact</code> ishlating, <code>ImplementationSpecific</code> + nginx annotatsiyalariga bog'lanib qolmang. Yangi loyihalarda Ingress o'rniga Gateway API'ni ko'rib chiqing (41208) — path matching u yerda aniqroq va kengaytiriladigan.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41180	<p>Envoy filter chain nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Envoy'da har bir kiruvchi ulanish <b>filter chain</b> dan o'tadi: ketma-ket filtrlar (TLS inspector, HTTP connection manager, rate limit, RBAC, router). Har filter paketni ko'rib qaror qiladi: davom ettirish, o'zgartirish yoki to'xtatish. Istio/Gateway/mesh config oxir-oqibat shu filtrlarga aylanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;mTLS, keyin authz, keyin rate limit, keyin routing&quot; — bu bosqichlarni modulli va tartibli qilish kerak. Tez ko'tariladi/o'chiriladi, ko'p node va HA control plane'ni simulyatsiya qiladi. CI'da Kubernetes integratsiya testlari uchun de-fakto standart.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI'da &quot;bu Helm chart/operator/controller haqiqiy klasterda ishlaydimi?&quot; ni tekshirish kerak, lekin bulut klaster sekin va qimmat. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41194	<p>Karpenter node expiration nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Karpenter node expiration — node'larni belgilangan yoshdan keyin avtomatik almashtirish (yangi API: NodePool'da <code>spec.disruption.expireAfter</code>, masalan <code>720h</code> = 30 kun). Maqsad — node'lar &quot;immutable&quot; va yangi bo'lib qolishi: OS patch, kubelet va AMI yangilanishlari majburlanadi, uzoq yashagan &quot;pet&quot; node'lar bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Node 6 oy ishlaydi, OS'da yangilanmagan CVE'lar yig'iladi, kernel eski. Uni disruption budget va PDB bilan birga sozlang, aks holda avtomatik &quot;tuzatish&quot; o'zi incident bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41195	<p>Karpenter disruption budgets nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Karpenter disruption budgets — Karpenter ixtiyoriy disruption (consolidation, expiration, drift) paytida bir vaqtda qancha node'ni buzishi (o'chirishi/almashtirishi) mumkinligini cheklovchi siyosat. PDB pod darajasida himoya qilsa, disruption budget node darajasida — ikkalasi birga blast radius'ni ushlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Karpenter xarajatni optimallashtirmoqchi bo'lib bir vaqtda 20 node'ni consolidate qilsa — ko'p pod ko'chadi, servis qisqa muddatga degradatsiya bo'ladi. Budget buni sekinlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>budgets:<br>  - nodes: &quot;20%&quot;              # bir vaqtda ko'pi bilan 20% node<br>  - nodes: &quot;0&quot;               # muayyan vaqt oynasida umuman buzmaslik<br>    schedule: &quot;0 9 * * mon-fri&quot;<br>    duration: 8h             # ish soatlarida freeze<br>reasons: [Underutilized, Empty, Drifted]  # qaysi turdagi disruption'ga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1<br>kind: NodePool<br>spec:<br>  disruption:<br>    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized<br>    budgets:<br>    - nodes: &quot;10%&quot;<br>    - schedule: &quot;0 8 * * mon-fri&quot;<br>      duration: 10h<br>      nodes: &quot;0&quot;            # ish vaqtida optimizatsiyani to'xtatish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Budget faqat ixtiyoriy disruption'ga — majburiy (node o'ldi, spot interruption) baribir bo'ladi.</li><li>Juda qattiq budget (0) consolidation'ni to'xtatib xarajatni oshiradi — balans kerak.</li><li>PDB bilan birga: budget node'ni tanlaydi, PDB pod evict'ini bloklaydi — ikkalasi mos bo'lishi kerak, aks holda node drain osiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Disruption budget — avtomatik optimizatsiyaning &quot;tormozi&quot;. Prod'da ish soatlarida freeze (<code>nodes: 0</code>) + tunda agressiv consolidation yaxshi naqsh: tejamkorlik, lekin peak paytida barqarorlik.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41196	<p>Dual-stack networking nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dual-stack networking — pod va Service'lar bir vaqtda IPv4 va IPv6 manzilga ega bo'lishi. Klaster darajasida yoqiladi; har Service <code>ipFamilyPolicy</code> bilan single yoki dual stack bo'ladi. IPv6'ga bosqichma-bosqich o'tish yoki IPv4 manzil tanqisligini yengish uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Katta klasterda IPv4 pod CIDR tugaydi (RFC1918 cheklangan); yoki tashqi talab IPv6 bo'lsa. Dual-stack ikkalasini parallel beradi, keskin migratsiyasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>klaster: --pod-network-cidr=10.244.0.0/16,fd00::/48<br>  --service-cidr=10.96.0.0/12,fd00:1::/112<br>pod: eth0 da ham v4, ham v6 IP<br>Service ipFamilyPolicy:<br>  SingleStack | PreferDualStack | RequireDualStack</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Service<br>spec:<br>  ipFamilyPolicy: PreferDualStack<br>  ipFamilies: [IPv4, IPv6]<br>  selector: { app: web }<br>  ports: [{ port: 80 }]</pre><pre>kubectl get svc web -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIPs}'   # [&quot;10.96.1.2&quot;,&quot;fd00:1::ab&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CNI dual-stack'ni qo'llashi kerak (Cilium, Calico — ha; ba'zilari cheklangan).</li><li>NetworkPolicy ikkala oila uchun ham qoida talab qiladi — v4 bloklab v6 ochiq qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Cloud LB, ingress, DNS (A va AAAA) ham dual-stack'ga tayyor bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Dual-stack'ni butun yo'l bo'ylab (CNI, policy, LB, DNS, monitoring) tekshiring — bitta qatlam v6'ni qamramasa yashirin xavfsizlik teshigi yoki ulanmaslik. IPv4 tanqisligi real muammo bo'lgandagina kiriting; qo'shimcha murakkablik bejiz emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41197	<p>MetalLB nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> MetalLB — bare-metal (cloud LB'siz) klasterlar uchun <code>LoadBalancer</code> tipidagi Service implementatsiyasi. Cloud'da <code>LoadBalancer</code> Service cloud LB'ni yaratadi; on-prem'da hech kim yaratmaydi — MetalLB bu bo'shliqni to'ldiradi: pool'dan external IP beradi va uni L2 (ARP/NDP) yoki BGP bilan tarmoqqa e'lon qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> On-prem klasterda <code>type: LoadBalancer</code> Service abadiy <code>Pending</code> da qoladi (external IP yo'q). Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41198	<p>Cilium BGP control plane nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cilium BGP control plane — Cilium'ning o'zi BGP speaker bo'lib, pod va Service (LoadBalancer IP, externalIP) CIDR'larini data center ToR (top-of-rack) router'lariga BGP orqali e'lon qiladi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41199	<p>CSI volume cloning nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CSI volume cloning — mavjud PVC'ning ma'lumotini aynan nusxalab yangi PVC yaratish, <code>dataSource</code> ni PVC'ga qaratib. Snapshot'dan farqi — oraliq snapshot obyektisiz, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri PVC -&gt; PVC. Storage darajasida (CSI driver qo'llasa) tez va samarali.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Prod DB diskining nusxasini staging yoki test uchun olish; yoki template volume'dan ko'plab bir xil disk yaratish. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41200	<p>CSI ephemeral inline volume nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CSI ephemeral inline volume — pod spec'ida <code>volumes</code> ichida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri CSI driver'ni chaqirib vaqtinchalik storage ulash, alohida PVC obyektisiz. Pod bilan birga yaratiladi va o'chadi. Odatda driver'lar uchun (secret mount, lokal NVMe) ishlatiladi, hajm/holat kuzatishni talab qilmaydigan hollarda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Secrets Store CSI yoki lokal tez disk'ni pod'ga ulash kerak, lekin PVC lifecycle (bind, kuzatuv) ortiqcha. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41216	<p>Kubernetes Descheduler nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Descheduler — vaqt o'tishi bilan &quot;noto'g'ri joyda&quot; qolgan pod'larni topib <b>evict</b> qiladigan komponent (CronJob yoki Deployment). Pod'ning o'zi ko'chirilmaydi — evict'dan keyin uning controller'i yangi pod yaratadi va scheduler uni hozirgi holatga mos joylashtiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Scheduler faqat pod yaratilganda qaror qiladi. Keyin yangi node qo'shiladi (bo'sh qoladi), taint/affinity o'zgaradi yoki pod'lar bitta node'da to'planib qoladi — scheduler buni hech qachon qayta ko'rib chiqmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Descheduler (profile + plugins)<br>   +-- LowNodeUtilization / HighNodeUtilization  -&gt; yuklamani muvozanatlash / bin-packing<br>   +-- RemoveDuplicates                         -&gt; bir node'da bir xil ReplicaSet pod'lari<br>   +-- RemovePodsViolatingNodeAffinity / Taints / TopologySpreadConstraint<br>   +-- PodLifeTime                              -&gt; juda eski pod'lar<br>       |<br>       v<br>   Eviction API (PDB'ni hurmat qiladi) --&gt; controller yangi pod --&gt; scheduler</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: descheduler/v1alpha2<br>kind: DeschedulerPolicy<br>profiles:<br>- name: default<br>  pluginConfig:<br>  - name: LowNodeUtilization<br>    args:<br>      thresholds:       {cpu: 20, memory: 20, pods: 20}   # shundan past = kam yuklangan<br>      targetThresholds: {cpu: 60, memory: 60, pods: 60}   # shundan yuqori = ortiqcha<br>  - name: RemovePodsViolatingNodeAffinity<br>    args: {nodeAffinityType: [requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution]}<br>  plugins:<br>    balance:  {enabled: [LowNodeUtilization]}<br>    deschedule: {enabled: [RemovePodsViolatingNodeAffinity]}</pre><pre>helm install descheduler descheduler/descheduler -n kube-system --set kind=CronJob --set schedule=&quot;*/30 * * * *&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PDB'siz workload'lar evict'da bir vaqtda ko'p replika yo'qotishi mumkin.</li><li>Utilization hisoblash <b>request</b> bo'yicha, haqiqiy foydalanish bo'yicha emas (default'da).</li><li>Cluster-autoscaler/Karpenter consolidation bilan to'qnashib pod'larni &quot;ping-pong&quot; qilishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Karpenter ishlatilsa uning consolidation'i ko'p hollarda Descheduler'ni ortiqcha qiladi. Descheduler'ni avval dry-run (<code>--dry-run</code>) bilan ishga tushirib, nimani evict qilishini ko'ring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting

Resurs <b>foydalanishini</b> emas, <b>holatini</b> o'lchaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CPU/xotira metrikalari (cAdvisor, metrics-server) &quot;Deployment'da 3 dan 1 ta replika tayyor&quot; yoki &quot;CronJob 2 kundan beri muvaffaqiyatsiz&quot; kabi savollarga javob bermaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>API Server --watch--&gt; kube-state-metrics (in-memory) --/metrics--&gt; Prometheus<br>                                                                   |<br>cAdvisor/kubelet (usage) ----------------------------------------&gt;+--&gt; alert'lar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Deployment to'liq tayyor emas<br>kube_deployment_spec_replicas != kube_deployment_status_replicas_available<br># tez-tez restart<br>increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[1h]) &gt; 3<br># CrashLoopBackOff<br>kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason=&quot;CrashLoopBackOff&quot;} == 1<br># request vs haqiqiy foydalanish (KSM + cAdvisor)<br>sum by (namespace) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m]))<br>  / sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource=&quot;cpu&quot;})</pre><pre>kubectl -n monitoring port-forward svc/kube-state-metrics 8080 &amp;&amp; curl -s localhost:8080/metrics | head</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta klasterda KSM ko'p xotira oladi va juda ko'p series chiqaradi — <code>--metric-allowlist</code>/<code>--metric-denylist</code>, sharding.</li><li>Label'lar default chiqarilmaydi (<code>kube_pod_labels</code> bo'sh) — <code>--metric-labels-allowlist</code> bilan aniq tanlang (cardinality!).</li><li>KSM metrikalari &quot;snapshot&quot; — tarixiy ma'lumot Prometheus'da.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> kube-prometheus-stack KSM'ni tayyor alert'lar bilan beradi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41219	<p>Oddiy pod tarmog'i va <code>hostNetwork: true</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy pod o'z <b>network namespace</b>ini va CNI bergan alohida IP'ni oladi. <code>hostNetwork: true</code> bilan pod <b>node'ning network namespace'ini</b> ishlatadi: node IP'si, node interfeyslari, node portlari. Bu kuchli imkoniyat va jiddiy xavfsizlik/operatsion xavf.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>oddiy:                         hostNetwork: true:<br>node eth0 10.0.1.5             node eth0 10.0.1.5<br>   |                               |<br> CNI bridge/veth                pod process --&gt; to'g'ridan eth0, port 80 = node port 80<br>   |<br> pod eth0 10.244.3.17 (o'z netns)</pre><p>| | Oddiy pod | hostNetwork | |---|---|---| | IP | pod CIDR | node IP | | Port konflikt | yo'q | bir node'da bitta | | NetworkPolicy | qo'llanadi | odatda qo'llanmaydi | | Node interfeyslari | ko'rinmaydi | ko'rinadi (localhost servislari ham) |</p><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b> CNI agentlari, kube-proxy, node exporter, ba'zi ingress/LB agentlari — ya'ni node tarmog'ini boshqaradigan yoki kuzatadigan tizim komponentlari.</p><p><b>Amalda (aniqlash va cheklash):</b></p><pre>kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath='{range .items[?(@.spec.hostNetwork==true)]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}{&quot;\n&quot;}{end}'<br>kubectl label ns apps pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=baseline   # baseline hostNetwork'ni taqiqlaydi</pre><pre>spec:<br>  hostNetwork: true<br>  dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet     # aks holda cluster DNS ishlamaydi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>dnsPolicy</code> o'zgartirilmasa pod <code>*.svc.cluster.local</code> ni resolve qila olmaydi.</li><li>Pod node'ning <code>127.0.0.1</code> da tinglayotgan servislarga (masalan kubelet read-only port, metadata proxy) kira oladi — izolyatsiya yo'qoladi.</li><li>Bir node'ga ikkita replika tushsa port konflikti — pod <code>Pending</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ilova workload'lari uchun <code>hostNetwork</code> deyarli hech qachon kerak emas — <code>hostPort</code>, NodePort yoki LoadBalancer yetarli. Pod Security Admission <code>baseline</code>/<code>restricted</code> darajasi bilan uni faqat system namespace'larda ruxsat eting.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41220	<p>RuntimeClass nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> RuntimeClass — cluster darajasidagi obyekt bo'lib, pod qaysi <b>container runtime handler</b> bilan ishga tushishini tanlaydi (<code>spec.runtimeClassName</code>). Shu bilan bir klasterda oddiy workload'lar <code>runc</code>, ishonchsiz kod esa sandbox runtime (<code>gVisor/runsc</code>, <code>Kata Containers</code>) bilan ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy container'lar host kernel'ini bo'lishadi: kernel zaifligi orqali izolyatsiyadan chiqish xavfi bor. Foydalanuvchi yuklagan kodni (CI runner, multi-tenant SaaS, AI agent sandbox) ishga tushirishda qo'shimcha izolyatsiya qatlami kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod (runtimeClassName: gvisor)<br>   |<br>   v<br>kubelet --CRI--&gt; containerd --handler &quot;runsc&quot;--&gt; gVisor (user-space kernel, syscall'larni ushlaydi)<br>                            --handler &quot;kata&quot;---&gt; Kata (har pod uchun yengil VM, alohida kernel)<br>                            --default &quot;runc&quot;---&gt; oddiy namespace/cgroup</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: node.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: RuntimeClass<br>metadata: {name: gvisor}<br>handler: runsc                     # containerd config'dagi handler nomi<br>scheduling:<br>  nodeSelector: {sandbox: gvisor}  # faqat runsc o'rnatilgan node'larga<br>overhead:<br>  podFixed: {cpu: 100m, memory: 64Mi}   # sandbox xarajati scheduling'da hisobga olinadi<br>---<br>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Pod<br>metadata: {name: untrusted-job}<br>spec:<br>  runtimeClassName: gvisor<br>  containers: [{name: job, image: registry/job:1.0}]</pre><p>GKE Sandbox (gVisor) va AKS Pod Sandboxing (Kata) managed variantlar.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Handler node'da sozlanmagan bo'lsa pod <code>ContainerCreating</code> da qoladi — <code>scheduling.nodeSelector</code> muhim.</li><li>gVisor barcha syscall'larni qo'llamaydi va I/O-og'ir ishlarda sekinroq — mos kelishini test qiling.</li><li>RuntimeClass o'zi siyosat emas: ishonchsiz tenant'lar uni tanlashga majburlanishi kerak (Kyverno/Gatekeeper).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sandbox — defense in depth qatlami, <code>restricted</code> Pod Security, seccomp, non-root va NetworkPolicy o'rnini bosmaydi. Xavf modeli &quot;ishonchsiz kod&quot; bo'lsa, eng kuchli chegara — alohida node pool yoki alohida klaster.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41221	<p>Pod'larda sysctl nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pod <code>spec.securityContext.sysctls</code> orqali <b>namespaced</b> kernel parametrlarini (faqat o'z network/IPC namespace'i uchun) o'rnatishi mumkin, masalan <code>net.core.somaxconn</code>, <code>net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range</code>. &quot;Safe&quot; sysctl'lar default ruxsat etilgan; &quot;unsafe&quot; lari kubelet'da <code>--allowed-unsafe-sysctls</code> bilan aniq ruxsat talab qiladi. Node-wide (namespaced bo'lmagan) sysctl'larni pod orqali o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yuqori yuklamali proxy/DB pod'ga katta <code>somaxconn</code> kerak, lekin node'ning global sozlamasini o'zgartirish boshqa pod'larga ta'sir qiladi. Namespaced sysctl faqat shu pod'ga tegadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>safe (default ruxsat): kernel.shm_rmid_forced, net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range,<br>                       net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies, net.ipv4.ping_group_range,<br>                       net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start, net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_* (yangi versiyalar)...<br>unsafe (namespaced, lekin kubelet ruxsati kerak): net.core.somaxconn, kernel.msg*, ...<br>node-level (vm.*, fs.file-max): pod'dan TAQIQLANGAN -&gt; node tuning (DaemonSet/MachineConfig)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Pod<br>metadata: {name: haproxy}<br>spec:<br>  securityContext:<br>    sysctls:<br>    - {name: net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range, value: &quot;1024 65000&quot;}<br>    - {name: net.core.somaxconn, value: &quot;4096&quot;}     # unsafe<br>  nodeSelector: {sysctl-tuned: &quot;true&quot;}               # ruxsat berilgan node'lar<br>  containers: [{name: haproxy, image: haproxy:3.0}]</pre><pre># KubeletConfiguration (faqat maxsus node pool)<br>allowedUnsafeSysctls: [&quot;net.core.somaxconn&quot;]</pre><pre>kubectl exec haproxy -- sysctl net.core.somaxconn</pre><p>Ruxsat yo'q node'ga tushsa pod <code>SysctlForbidden</code> sababi bilan rad etiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Unsafe sysctl'larni hamma node'larda yoqish — bir tenant boshqalarga ta'sir qilishi mumkin; taint + alohida node pool.</li><li>Pod Security <code>baseline</code> faqat safe ro'yxatga ruxsat beradi.</li><li><code>hostNetwork: true</code> pod'da net.* sysctl node'ning o'ziga tegadi — shuning uchun bu kombinatsiya taqiqlangan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval sysctl haqiqatan kerakligini o'lchang (<code>ss -lnt</code> da Recv-Q to'lishi, <code>ListenOverflows</code>). Node darajasidagi tuning IaC orqali node image'da yoki privileged DaemonSet'da, pod'larda emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41222	<p>Volume binding mode (<code>Immediate</code> va <code>WaitForFirstConsumer</code>) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> StorageClass'dagi <code>volumeBindingMode</code>:</p><ul><li><code>Immediate</code> — PVC yaratilishi bilan PV darhol provision qilinadi, pod qayerga tushishi hali noma'lum;</li><li><code>WaitForFirstConsumer</code> — provisioning PVC'ni ishlatadigan pod <b>schedule qilingandan keyin</b>, aynan o'sha node'ning zonasida bajariladi.</li></ul><p><b>Muammo (Immediate):</b> EBS volume <code>us-east-1a</code> da yaratildi, scheduler esa pod'ni CPU yetarli bo'lgan <code>us-east-1b</code> node'ga qo'ymoqchi. Lekin u bir marta bind qilingandan keyin StatefulSet pod'i abadiy shu zonaga bog'lanadi — zona o'lsa pod ko'chmaydi; HA'ni ilova darajasida replikatsiya bilan hal qiling.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting

Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41228	<p>Informer / SharedInformer nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Informer — API Server'dan obyektlarni bir marta <b>LIST</b> qilib, keyin <b>WATCH</b> bilan o'zgarishlarni oladigan va ularni lokal <b>cache (indexer)</b>da saqlaydigan mexanizm; o'zgarishda <code>OnAdd/OnUpdate/OnDelete</code> handler'larni chaqiradi. <b>SharedInformer(Factory)</b> bitta resurs turi uchun bitta watch va bitta cache'ni bir process ichidagi barcha controller'larga ulashadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har controller har soniyada <code>LIST pods</code> qilsa API Server va etcd bo'g'iladi (429, sekinlik). Cache &quot;eventually consistent&quot;: o'z yozuvingizni darhol ko'rmasligingiz mumkin — mantiq buni hisobga olsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41229	<p>Controller'da workqueue nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Workqueue (client-go <code>workqueue</code>) — informer event'lari va reconcile worker'lari orasidagi navbat: <b>key'larni</b> (<code>namespace/name</code>) saqlaydi, bir key'ni <b>dedup</b> qiladi (navbatda bo'lsa qayta qo'shilmaydi), bitta key'ni bir vaqtda faqat <b>bitta worker</b> qayta ishlashini kafolatlaydi va xatoda <b>rate-limited retry</b> (exponential backoff) beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deployment'ning status'i 1 soniyada 20 marta yangilanadi. Har event uchun alohida reconcile — isrof va bir obyektni parallel o'zgartiruvchi worker'lar orasida conflict.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>event x20 (shop/api) --&gt; queue: [shop/api]  (bitta, dedup)<br>worker1 Get() --&gt; shop/api &quot;processing&quot; (boshqa worker olmaydi)<br>   reconcile xato --&gt; AddRateLimited(key)  --&gt; 5ms, 10ms, 20ms ... max backoff<br>   muvaffaqiyat   --&gt; Forget(key) (backoff hisobini tozalash)<br>   har holda      --&gt; Done(key)<br>processing paytida yangi event --&gt; &quot;dirty&quot;, Done'dan keyin qayta navbatga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>q := workqueue.NewTypedRateLimitingQueue(workqueue.DefaultTypedControllerRateLimiter[string]())<br>func processNext(ctx context.Context) bool {<br>    key, shutdown := q.Get()<br>    if shutdown { return false }<br>    defer q.Done(key)<br>    if err := reconcile(ctx, key); err != nil {<br>        if q.NumRequeues(key) &lt; 10 { q.AddRateLimited(key); return true }<br>        utilruntime.HandleError(err)          // taslim bo'lish, log<br>    }<br>    q.Forget(key)<br>    return true<br>}<br>for i := 0; i &lt; 4; i++ { go wait.UntilWithContext(ctx, func(ctx context.Context){ for processNext(ctx) {} }, time.Second) }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Done()</code> chaqirilmasa key abadiy &quot;processing&quot; da qoladi va boshqa hech qachon qayta ishlanmaydi.</li><li><code>Forget()</code> unutilsa keyingi xatoda backoff juda katta bo'lib qoladi.</li><li>Navbatga obyektni emas, key'ni qo'ying — reconcile paytida eng so'nggi holatni cache'dan oling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> controller-runtime bularning barchasini yashiradi (<code>MaxConcurrentReconciles</code>, <code>RateLimiter</code> sozlanadi). <code>workqueue_depth</code>, <code>workqueue_retries_total</code>, <code>workqueue_work_duration_seconds</code> metrikalari controller sog'lig'ining asosiy signallari.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41230	<p>Reconcile loop nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Reconcile loop — controller'ning yuragi: <code>Reconcile(ctx, Request{namespace/name}) (Result, error)</code> funksiyasi obyektning <b>desired state</b> (spec) ini <b>actual state</b> bilan solishtiradi va farqni yo'qotish uchun minimal o'zgarishni bajaradi. U <b>level-based</b> va <b>idempotent</b>: necha marta chaqirilsa ham bir xil natija beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Event'lar yo'qolishi, dublikat bo'lishi yoki tartibsiz kelishi mumkin. &quot;Qaysi event keldi?&quot; ga emas, &quot;hozir holat qanday va qanday bo'lishi kerak?&quot; ga qarab ishlash tizimni ishonchli qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Request(key) --&gt; obyektni cache'dan o'qish --&gt; yo'q? --&gt; (o'chirilgan) cleanup, return<br>      |<br>      v<br>DeletionTimestamp bor? --&gt; finalizer mantiqi (tashqi resursni o'chirish) --&gt; finalizer'ni olib tashlash<br>      |<br>      v<br>desired (spec) vs actual (child obyektlar, tashqi API)<br>      |<br>      v<br>create/update/delete --&gt; status yangilash (/status) --&gt; Result{RequeueAfter?} / error (backoff)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>func (r *AppReconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, req ctrl.Request) (ctrl.Result, error) {<br>    var app v1.App<br>    if err := r.Get(ctx, req.NamespacedName, &amp;app); err != nil {<br>        return ctrl.Result{}, client.IgnoreNotFound(err)<br>    }<br>    dep := &amp;appsv1.Deployment{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: app.Name, Namespace: app.Namespace}}<br>    _, err := controllerutil.CreateOrUpdate(ctx, r.Client, dep, func() error {<br>        dep.Spec.Replicas = &amp;app.Spec.Replicas<br>        // ... template<br>        return controllerutil.SetControllerReference(&amp;app, dep, r.Scheme)<br>    })<br>    if err != nil { return ctrl.Result{}, err }          // backoff bilan qayta<br>    app.Status.ReadyReplicas = dep.Status.ReadyReplicas<br>    if err := r.Status().Update(ctx, &amp;app); err != nil { return ctrl.Result{}, err }<br>    return ctrl.Result{RequeueAfter: 5 * time.Minute}, nil   // tashqi drift uchun<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har reconcile'da yangi tasodifiy nom/ID yaratish — idempotentlik buziladi, dublikatlar.</li><li>Status'ni <code>Update</code> bilan yangilab spec'ni ham yozish — conflict va keraksiz generation o'sishi; status subresource ishlating.</li><li>Ham <code>error</code>, ham <code>Requeue</code> qaytarish — error ustun bo'ladi; mantiqni aniq ajrating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>status.observedGeneration</code> va conditions (<code>Ready</code>, <code>Progressing</code>) bilan foydalanuvchiga controller spec'ning qaysi versiyasini ko'rganini ko'rsating. Reconcile tez va qisqa bo'lsin — uzoq tashqi operatsiyalar uchun holatni status'da saqlab, keyingi reconcile'da davom eting.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41231	<p>Optimistic concurrency control (<code>resourceVersion</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har K8s obyektida <code>metadata.resourceVersion</code> bor (etcd revision'ga asoslangan, client uchun &quot;opaque&quot; string). Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41232	<p>Control loop'larda eventual consistency nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes controller'lari <b>eventual consistency</b> modelida ishlaydi: o'zgarish darhol va atomik ravishda butun tizimga tarqalmaydi; har controller o'z cache'idan o'qiydi, kichik qadam qiladi va holat desired state'ga <b>vaqt o'tib</b> yaqinlashadi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41234	<p>OwnerReferences va BlockOwnerDeletion nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>metadata.ownerReferences</code> — child obyektni parent'ga bog'laydi (ReplicaSet -&gt; Pod). Parent o'chirilganda <b>garbage collector</b> child'larni avtomatik o'chiradi. <code>controller: true</code> — asosiy boshqaruvchi controller'ni bildiradi. <code>blockOwnerDeletion: true</code> — <b>foreground</b> o'chirishda parent child'lar o'chirilmaguncha yo'qolmasligini ta'minlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Deployment --owns--&gt; ReplicaSet --owns--&gt; Pod<br>kubectl delete deploy api --cascade=?<br>  background (default): parent darhol o'chadi, GC child'larni fonda o'chiradi<br>  foreground: parent'ga deletionTimestamp + &quot;foregroundDeletion&quot; finalizer,<br>              avval blockOwnerDeletion=true child'lar, keyin parent<br>  orphan:     parent o'chadi, child'lar qoladi (ownerReference olib tashlanadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>metadata:<br>  name: api-7d9f<br>  ownerReferences:<br>  - apiVersion: apps/v1<br>    kind: ReplicaSet<br>    name: api-7d9f<br>    uid: 3b1c...            # UID bo'yicha bog'lanadi, nom bo'yicha emas<br>    controller: true<br>    blockOwnerDeletion: true</pre><pre>kubectl delete deploy api --cascade=foreground<br>kubectl delete rs api-7d9f --cascade=orphan        # pod'lar qoladi (debug/migratsiya)<br>kubectl get pod api-7d9f-x -o jsonpath='{.metadata.ownerReferences[*].kind}'</pre><pre>controllerutil.SetControllerReference(&amp;app, dep, r.Scheme)  // operator'da</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cross-namespace owner reference ruxsat etilmaydi (namespaced child'ning owner'i boshqa namespace'da bo'lolmaydi) — GC buni noto'g'ri talqin qiladi.</li><li><code>blockOwnerDeletion: true</code> qo'yish uchun owner'ga <code>update</code> ruxsati kerak (OwnerReferencesPermissionEnforcement).</li><li>Owner reference — K8s ichidagi obyektlar uchun; tashqi resurslarni (cloud bucket) tozalash uchun finalizer kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Operator'da har yaratilgan child'ga controller reference qo'ying — tozalash bepul bo'ladi va <code>Owns()</code> watch'i child o'zgarganda parent'ni reconcile qiladi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41236	<p>Service session affinity (<code>ClientIP</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>sessionAffinity: ClientIP</code> — Service bir xil <b>client IP</b>dan kelgan so'rovlarni <code>timeoutSeconds</code> (default 10800 = 3 soat) davomida <b>bir xil pod</b>ga yo'naltiradi. kube-proxy (iptables <code>recent</code> moduli / IPVS persistence) yoki eBPF data plane darajasida ishlaydi; cookie yoki header'ni bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Eski ilova sessiyani pod xotirasida saqlaydi — so'rov boshqa pod'ga tushsa foydalanuvchi &quot;logout&quot; bo'ladi. Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41237	<p><code>externalTrafficPolicy</code> (<code>Cluster</code> va <code>Local</code>) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b></p><ul><li><code>Cluster</code> (default): NodePort/LoadBalancer trafigini olgan node uni <b>istalgan node'dagi</b> pod'ga yuboradi; buning uchun <b>SNAT</b> qiladi — client IP yo'qoladi, qo'shimcha hop bo'lishi mumkin, lekin yuklama teng taqsimlanadi.</li><li><code>Local</code>: trafik faqat <b>shu node'dagi</b> pod'larga boradi; <b>client IP saqlanadi</b>, ortiqcha hop yo'q; pod'i yo'q node'lar LB health check'idan (<code>healthCheckNodePort</code>) o'tmaydi va LB ularga yubormaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Cluster:  LB --&gt; node1 (pod yo'q) --SNAT--&gt; node2 pod     (client IP = node1 IP)<br>Local:    LB --&gt; node2 (pod bor)  -------&gt;  node2 pod     (client IP saqlanadi)<br>          LB -x  node1 (health check 503: lokal pod yo'q)</pre><p>| | Cluster | Local | |---|---|---| | Client IP | yo'qoladi | saqlanadi | | Hop | +1 bo'lishi mumkin | yo'q | | Taqsimot | teng (pod bo'yicha) | node bo'yicha (notekis bo'lishi mumkin) | | Rollout xavfi | past | pod ketayotgan node'ga trafik (drain'ni to'g'ri qilish kerak) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  type: LoadBalancer<br>  externalTrafficPolicy: Local<br>  selector: {app: ingress-nginx}</pre><pre>kubectl get svc ingress -o jsonpath='{.spec.healthCheckNodePort}'<br>curl -s http://&lt;node-ip&gt;:&lt;healthCheckNodePort&gt;/healthz     # localEndpoints soni</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Node1'da 1 pod, node2'da 5 pod bo'lsa LB node'lar bo'yicha teng bo'lsa node1'dagi pod 5 barobar ko'p yuk oladi — topologySpreadConstraints yoki DaemonSet bilan teng tarqating.</li><li>Pod terminating bo'lganda LB health check yangilanguncha so'rovlar tushishi mumkin — <code>preStop</code> delay, yangi versiyalarda terminating endpoint'lar mexanizmi yordam beradi.</li><li>AWS NLB IP target rejimi (pod'ga to'g'ridan) bu muammoni boshqacha hal qiladi — node darajasidagi policy ahamiyati kamayadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ingress/edge proxy uchun ko'pincha <code>Local</code> + DaemonSet/teng tarqatish: audit, rate limit va geo uchun haqiqiy client IP kerak. Muqobil — <code>Cluster</code> + PROXY protocol yoki <code>X-Forwarded-For</code>.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41238	<p>Traffic distribution (<code>PreferClose</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>spec.trafficDistribution: PreferClose</code> (K8s 1.31 da beta, 1.33 da GA) — kube-proxy/data plane'ga trafikni iloji bo'lsa <b>client bilan bir zonadagi</b> endpoint'larga yuborishni maslahat beradi; zonada sog'lom endpoint bo'lmasa boshqa zonalarga qaytadi. Cross-AZ trafik narxi va latency kamayadi. (Yangi versiyalarda aniqroq <code>PreferSameZone</code> / <code>PreferSameNode</code> qiymatlari ham qo'shilgan.)</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cloud'da AZ'lar orasidagi trafik pullik (AWS'da ~$0.01/GB har yo'nalishda). Chatty mikroservislar oyiga minglab dollarni faqat cross-AZ uchun to'laydi, har chaqiruvga ~1ms latency qo'shiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>EndpointSlice controller --&gt; har endpoint'ga hints.forZones (zona belgisi)<br>kube-proxy (zone=a) --&gt; faqat zone a endpoint'lariga yo'naltiradi<br>zone a da endpoint yo'q --&gt; barcha endpoint'lar (fallback)</pre><p>Eski mexanizm — <code>service.kubernetes.io/topology-mode: Auto</code> annotation (Topology Aware Routing), u endpoint'lar zona bo'yicha proporsional bo'lmasa o'zini o'chirardi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Service<br>metadata: {name: catalog}<br>spec:<br>  selector: {app: catalog}<br>  ports: [{port: 80, targetPort: 8080}]<br>  trafficDistribution: PreferClose</pre><pre>kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=catalog -o yaml | grep -A3 hints</pre><p>Pod'larni zonalarga teng tarqatish:</p><pre>topologySpreadConstraints:<br>- {maxSkew: 1, topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone, whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule, labelSelector: {matchLabels: {app: catalog}}}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Client'lar bir zonada ko'p, pod'lar teng bo'lsa — shu zona pod'lari ortiqcha yuklanadi (PreferClose sig'imni hisobga olmaydi).</li><li>Zona ichidagi barcha pod'lar sog'lom, lekin sekin bo'lsa ham trafik u yerda qoladi.</li><li>Service mesh (Istio locality LB) ham shu ishni qiladi — ikkalasini birga sozlashda xulqni tushuning.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval o'lchang: cross-AZ trafik hajmi (VPC Flow Logs, Kubecost). PreferClose + zonalar bo'yicha teng replika + zonaviy HPA — xarajat va latency'ni kamaytiradi, lekin bitta zonaning ortiqcha yuklanishiga alert qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41239	<p>Kubernetes IPAM nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes IPAM (IP Address Management) — pod va servis IP'larini <b>ajratish, kuzatish va qaytarish</b>.
