Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41244	<p>Node autoscaling'da overprovisioning nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Overprovisioning — klasterda <b>past prioritetli &quot;placeholder&quot; pod'lar</b> (pause container, <code>PriorityClass</code> value manfiy) ushlab turiladi. Haqiqiy pod kelganda scheduler placeholder'ni <b>preempt</b> qilib darhol joy oladi; ko'chirilgan placeholder <code>Pending</code> bo'lib qoladi va cluster-autoscaler/Karpenter fonda yangi node qo'shadi. Scale-up kechikishi (1-3 daqiqa) foydalanuvchidan yashiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Trafik spike'ida HPA yangi pod'lar yaratadi, lekin bo'sh node yo'q — yangi node ishga tushguncha (instance boot + image pull) pod'lar <code>Pending</code>, foydalanuvchilar xato oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[node1: app app placeholder] [node2: app placeholder placeholder]<br>spike --&gt; yangi app pod --&gt; preempt placeholder --&gt; app darhol Running<br>placeholder Pending --&gt; autoscaler --&gt; node3 --&gt; placeholder u yerga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: PriorityClass<br>metadata: {name: overprovisioning}<br>value: -10<br>preemptionPolicy: Never          # placeholder o'zi hech kimni siqib chiqarmaydi<br>globalDefault: false<br>---<br>apiVersion: apps/v1<br>kind: Deployment<br>metadata: {name: overprovisioning, namespace: kube-system}<br>spec:<br>  replicas: 3<br>  selector: {matchLabels: {app: overprovisioning}}<br>  template:<br>    metadata: {labels: {app: overprovisioning}}<br>    spec:<br>      priorityClassName: overprovisioning<br>      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0<br>      containers:<br>      - name: pause<br>        image: registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10<br>        resources: {requests: {cpu: &quot;1&quot;, memory: 2Gi}}   # zaxira hajmi</pre><p>Zaxirani klaster hajmiga proporsional qilish: <code>cluster-proportional-autoscaler</code> bilan replikalarni boshqarish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Zaxira — doimiy xarajat: 3 x (1 CPU, 2Gi) har doim to'lanadi.</li><li>Placeholder request'lari haqiqiy pod'lardan kichik bo'lsa, katta pod baribir joy topmaydi.</li><li>Ilova pod'larida default PriorityClass bo'lmasa (0) va placeholder ham 0 bo'lsa preemption ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Overprovisioning — &quot;sug'urta polisi&quot;: uning hajmini spike profili (qancha tez, qancha katta) va node ishga tushish vaqtiga qarab tanlang. Image pull vaqtini ham kamaytiring (kichik image, pre-pull, lazy loading) — bu ham scale-up'ning bir qismi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::h19 K8s_advanced_troubleshooting
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::H19 K8s advanced & troubleshooting	idrill-41245	<p>Karpenter'da mixed instance policy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Karpenter'da &quot;mixed instance policy&quot; alohida obyekt emas — <b>NodePool requirements</b> orqali keng instance turlari, o'lchamlari, avlodlari, arxitekturalari va <b>capacity type</b> (<code>spot</code>, <code>on-demand</code>) ruxsat etiladi. Turlarning xilma-xilligi — availability va narx.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pending pod'lar (CPU/mem/arch/zone talablari)<br>   |<br>   v<br>Karpenter: NodePool requirements ichidagi barcha mos instance turlari<br>   --&gt; EC2 Fleet (spot: price-capacity-optimized, bir nechta tur)<br>   --&gt; spot yo'q --&gt; on-demand<br>Consolidation: keyinroq arzonroq/kichikroq node'ga ko'chirish<br>Spot interruption (SQS) --&gt; cordon + drain 2 daqiqa ichida</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1<br>kind: NodePool<br>metadata: {name: general}<br>spec:<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      nodeClassRef: {group: karpenter.k8s.aws, kind: EC2NodeClass, name: default}<br>      requirements:<br>      - {key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type, operator: In, values: [spot, on-demand]}<br>      - {key: karpenter.k8s.aws/instance-category, operator: In, values: [c, m, r]}<br>      - {key: karpenter.k8s.aws/instance-generation, operator: Gt, values: [&quot;5&quot;]}<br>      - {key: kubernetes.io/arch, operator: In, values: [amd64, arm64]}<br>      - {key: karpenter.k8s.aws/instance-size, operator: NotIn, values: [nano, micro, small]}<br>  disruption:<br>    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized<br>    consolidateAfter: 1m<br>  limits: {cpu: &quot;1000&quot;}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Juda tor requirements (1-2 tur) — spot afzalligi yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>arm64</code> ruxsat etilsa image'lar multi-arch bo'lishi shart, aks holda &quot;exec format error&quot;.</li><li>Spot'da stateful yoki uzoq batch job'lar — <code>karpenter.sh/capacity-type: on-demand</code> nodeSelector va PDB bilan himoyalang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatiy tuzilma: kritik workload'lar uchun on-demand NodePool (yoki baseline reserved/Savings Plan), qolgan stateless'lar uchun keng spot NodePool. Bu bir nechta qatlamni birga talab qiladi: <b>control plane izolyatsiyasi</b> (vcluster yoki alohida klaster), <b>runtime izolyatsiyasi</b> (gVisor/Kata sandbox, alohida node pool), <b>tarmoq</b> (default-deny NetworkPolicy, Cilium L3-L7), <b>resurslar</b> (ResourceQuota, LimitRange, PriorityClass), <b>policy</b> (restricted PSA, Kyverno/Gatekeeper) va <b>identity</b> (tenant-scoped RBAC, cloud IAM). Eng kuchli chegara — tenant'ga alohida klaster.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Namespace — soft chegara: hamma tenant bitta API Server, bitta kernel (node'da), bitta CNI va cluster-scoped resurslarni (CRD, webhook, StorageClass) bo'lishadi. RuntimeClass gvisor               |  &lt;- kernel izolyatsiyasi<br>|   NetworkPolicy default-deny, egress cheklangan |  &lt;- tarmoq<br>|   ResourceQuota / LimitRange                    |  &lt;- resurslar<br>| node pool: taint tenant=a (ixtiyoriy)           |  &lt;- noisy neighbour, side-channel<br>+------------------------------------------------+<br>| tenant-b ns: ... xuddi shunday                  |<br>+------------------------------------------------+</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: {name: default-deny, namespace: tenant-a}<br>spec: {podSelector: {}, policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]}<br>---<br>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: ResourceQuota<br>metadata: {name: quota, namespace: tenant-a}<br>spec:<br>  hard: {requests.cpu: &quot;20&quot;, requests.memory: 64Gi, pods: &quot;200&quot;, services.loadbalancers: &quot;0&quot;}</pre><pre>kubectl label ns tenant-a pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted<br>vcluster create tenant-a -n tenant-a</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cluster-scoped resurslar (CRD, admission webhook, ClusterRole) tenant'larga berilsa izolyatsiya buziladi — vcluster aynan shuni hal qiladi.</li><li>Node'ni bo'lishish CPU/cache side-channel va kernel exploit xavfini qoldiradi — sandbox yoki alohida node'lar.</li><li>Cloud metadata endpoint'i (169.254.169.254) va node IAM role'iga pod'lardan kirishni bloklashni unutish — tenant cloud credential'larini olishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Izolyatsiya darajasini xavf modeli va narx bo'yicha tanlang: ishonchli ichki jamoalar uchun namespace + policy yetarli; Interview Drill::Kubernetes::T11 Kubernetes gotchas	idrill-17015	<p>CPU limit 1 core bo'lgan podda Go ilova sekin. Nima tekshiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng birinchi shubha — <b><code>GOMAXPROCS</code></b>. Eski Go versiyalari (1.25 dan oldin) container'ning CPU limitini ko'rmaydi va host'dagi yadrolar soniga (masalan 64) qarab 64 ta parallel thread ishga tushiradi. Ular 1 yadrolik kvotani millisekundlarda yeb qo'yadi va kernel container'ni <b>throttle</b> qiladi — ilova har 100ms davrning katta qismida to'xtab turadi.</p><h4>Mexanizm</h4><pre>CPU limit 1 core = cpu.max &quot;100000 100000&quot; (100ms davrda 100ms CPU)<br>GOMAXPROCS = 64 -&gt; 64 thread parallel ishlaydi (GC, goroutine'lar)<br>64 thread x ~1.5ms = 100ms kvota davr boshida ~1.5ms da tugadi<br>qolgan ~98ms -&gt; butun container TO'XTATILGAN (throttled)</pre><p>Natija: o'rtacha CPU ishlatilishi past ko'rinadi, lekin p99 latency 50–100ms sakraydi.</p><h4>Tekshirish</h4><pre>kubectl exec &lt;pod&gt; -- cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max          # limit<br>kubectl exec &lt;pod&gt; -- cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat         # nr_throttled, throttled_usec</pre><pre>rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{pod=&quot;api-x&quot;}[5m])<br>/ rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{pod=&quot;api-x&quot;}[5m])     # &gt; 0.2 — jiddiy</pre><p>Ilovada: <code>runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)</code> ni log'ga yozing — 64 ko'rinsa, sabab topildi.</p><h4>Tuzatish</h4><ul><li><b>Go 1.25+</b> — runtime cgroup CPU limitini o'zi hisobga oladi.</li><li>Eski versiyalar: <code>import _ &quot;go.uber.org/automaxprocs&quot;</code> yoki <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> env'ni limitga teng qilish:</li></ul><pre>env:<br>- name: GOMAXPROCS<br>  valueFrom: { resourceFieldRef: { resource: limits.cpu, divisor: &quot;1&quot; } }</pre><ul><li>Xotira uchun ham: <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> ni memory limitning ~90%iga — GC limitga yaqinlashganda faolroq ishlaydi, OOMKill kamayadi.</li></ul><h4>Boshqa tekshiriladigan narsalar</h4><ul><li>CPU limit juda kichikmi (GC uchun ham CPU kerak)?</li><li>GC bosimi (<code>GODEBUG=gctrace=1</code>, pprof) — ko'p allokatsiya.</li><li>Latency'ga sezgir servislarda CPU <b>limit</b>ni olib tashlab, faqat <b>request</b> qoldirish varianti.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xuddi shu muammo JVM, Node.js worker pool'lari va nginx <code>worker_processes auto</code>da ham bor — har runtime &quot;nechta yadro bor?&quot; savoliga qanday javob olishini tekshiring. Throttling metrikasi CPU dashboard'ida majburiy bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::k8s sec::t11 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::T11 Kubernetes gotchas	idrill-17017	<p>Liveness probe noto'g'ri sozlanganda eng xavfli stsenariy?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng xavflisi — liveness probe <b>tashqi bog'liqlikni</b> (DB, Redis, boshqa servis) tekshirishi. DB sekinlashsa, <b>barcha</b> pod'larning liveness'i bir vaqtda yiqiladi, kubelet ularni <b>restart</b> qiladi; restart paytida pod'lar ishlamaydi, qaytgach esa yana DB'ga ulanib yukni oshiradi — kaskadli avariya. Muammo DB'da edi, lekin Kubernetes uni butun servisning to'liq o'chishiga aylantirdi.</p><h4>Uch probe — uch xil savol</h4><p>| Probe | Savol | Muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa | |---|---|---| | <b>liveness</b> | process tirikmi yoki osilib qolganmi (deadlock)? | container <b>restart</b> | | <b>readiness</b> | hozir trafik qabul qila oladimi? | Service endpoint'laridan <b>chiqariladi</b> (restart yo'q) | | <b>startup</b> | ishga tushish tugadimi? | tugaguncha liveness/readiness tekshirilmaydi |</p><h4>To'g'ri sozlash</h4><pre>startupProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }<br>  periodSeconds: 5<br>  failureThreshold: 30            # 150s gacha ishga tushishga ruxsat<br>livenessProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }   # faqat &quot;process javob beradimi&quot;<br>  periodSeconds: 10<br>  timeoutSeconds: 2<br>  failureThreshold: 3             # bitta sekin javob — restart emas<br>readinessProbe:<br>  httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }     # bog'liqliklar, kesh isishi<br>  periodSeconds: 5<br>  failureThreshold: 2</pre><ul><li><code>/healthz</code> — hech qanday tashqi chaqiruvsiz, faqat ichki holat (event loop ishlayapti, deadlock yo'q).</li><li><code>/ready</code> — kerak bo'lsa DB ulanishini tekshiradi, lekin ehtiyot bilan: DB o'lsa <b>hamma</b> pod &quot;not ready&quot; bo'ladi va servis baribir yiqiladi. Ko'pincha yaxshisi: readiness faqat o'z holatini tekshiradi, DB xatolari so'rov darajasida (503 + circuit breaker) qaytariladi.</li></ul><h4>Boshqa xavfli xatolar</h4><ul><li>Liveness timeout juda qisqa (1s) — GC pauzasi yoki yuk ostida restart.</li><li><code>initialDelaySeconds</code> yetarli emas, startup probe yo'q — sekin start'li ilova (JVM) cheksiz restart loop'ida.</li><li>Liveness va readiness bir xil endpoint — readiness kerakli joyda restart sodir bo'ladi.</li><li>Probe og'ir ish qiladi (DB so'rovi) — o'zi yuk yaratadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Liveness probe — &quot;o'z-o'zini davolash&quot; emas, <b>qurol</b>: noto'g'ri ishlatilsa servisni o'zi o'ldiradi. Shubha bo'lsa, liveness'ni umuman qo'ymaslik (yoki juda yumshoq qilish) ko'pincha xavfsizroq — haqiqiy deadlock kam uchraydi, kaskadli restart esa ko'p.</p>	lvl::Principal dom::k8s sec::t11 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::T11 Kubernetes gotchas	idrill-30103	<p>Konteynerda Go jarayoni <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> 64 deb ko'rsatadi, lekin CPU limiti 2. Nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Go runtime <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> (bir vaqtda Go kodi bajaradigan OS thread'lar soni) ni node'dagi yadrolar soniga (64) teng qiladi, chunki eski versiyalar cgroup CPU kvotasini o'qimaydi. Container esa faqat 2 CPU olishi mumkin. Natija: 64 thread kvotani davr boshida tugatadi, kernel container'ni davr oxirigacha <b>throttle</b> qiladi — latency sakraydi, garchi o'rtacha CPU past bo'lsa ham.</p><h4>Nega aynan shunday</h4><ul><li>CFS bandwidth: <code>cpu.max = &quot;200000 100000&quot;</code> — har 100ms'da 200ms CPU vaqti (2 yadro).</li><li>64 thread parallel ishlasa: 200ms / 64 ≈ 3ms'da kvota tugaydi.</li><li>Qolgan ~97ms — hech bir thread ishlay olmaydi. So'rov shu payt kelsa — kutadi.</li><li>GC ham parallel ishlaydi (<code>GOMAXPROCS</code>ning 25%i) — ko'p GC worker'lar kvotani yanada tez yeydi.</li><li>Ko'p thread — ko'proq context switch va scheduler overhead.</li></ul><h4>Tekshirish</h4><pre>log.Printf(&quot;GOMAXPROCS=%d NumCPU=%d&quot;, runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0), runtime.NumCPU())</pre><pre>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat    # nr_throttled / nr_periods</pre><h4>Tuzatish</h4><ol><li><b>Go 1.25+</b> ga yangilash — runtime cgroup limitini hisobga oladi va limit o'zgarsa ham moslashadi.</li><li>Eski versiyalarda:</li></ol><pre>import _ &quot;go.uber.org/automaxprocs&quot;</pre><p>yoki env orqali <code>GOMAXPROCS=2</code>.</p><ol><li>Xotira uchun <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> (masalan limitning 90%i) — container OOMKill'dan oldin GC faollashadi.</li></ol><h4>Natija (odatiy)</h4><p>GOMAXPROCS to'g'ri qo'yilgandan keyin: throttling keskin kamayadi, p99 latency bir necha barobar yaxshilanadi, CPU ishlatilishi deyarli o'zgarmaydi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Fractional limit (masalan 1.5 CPU) bo'lsa — <code>automaxprocs</code> pastga yaxlitlaydi (1). Bu ataylab: biroz kam parallellik throttling'dan yaxshiroq. Umuman, Go servislari uchun butun sonli CPU limitlari yoki faqat request (limitsiz) eng oldindan aytib bo'ladigan natija beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::t11 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::T11 Kubernetes gotchas	idrill-30104	<p>Pod <code>Evicted</code> bo'ldi, log'da OOM yo'q. Ehtimolli sabab?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>Evicted</code> va <code>OOMKilled</code> — ikki xil mexanizm. <b>OOMKilled</b> — container o'z <b>memory limit</b>idan oshdi va kernel uni o'ldirdi (container restart bo'ladi). <b>Evicted</b> — <b>node</b> resurslari (xotira, disk, ephemeral storage, PID) tanqis bo'ldi va <b>kubelet</b> node'ni himoya qilish uchun ba'zi pod'larni chiqarib yubordi. Log'da OOM yo'q bo'lsa — node darajasidagi bosim, ko'pincha <b>disk</b>.</p><h4>Sababni topish</h4><pre>kubectl get pod &lt;pod&gt; -o jsonpath='{.status.reason}{&quot; — &quot;}{.status.message}'<br># Evicted — The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage. Container app was using 12Gi, request is 0.<br>kubectl describe node &lt;node&gt; | grep -A8 Conditions   # MemoryPressure / DiskPressure / PIDPressure<br>kubectl get events -A --field-selector reason=Evicted</pre><p>Xabar aniq aytadi: qaysi resurs va pod qancha ishlatgan.</p><h4>Odatiy sabablar</h4><ol><li><b>Ephemeral storage</b> — container log'lari, <code>emptyDir</code>, container ichiga yozilgan fayllar (temp, kesh) node diskini to'ldirdi.</li><li><b>Node xotirasi</b> — pod'lar request'dan ko'p ishlatmoqda (limit yo'q yoki request &lt;&lt; limit), node umumiy xotirasi <code>evictionHard</code> chegarasiga yetdi.</li><li><b>PID</b> — pod juda ko'p process/thread yaratdi.</li></ol><h4>Kim birinchi evict qilinadi</h4><ul><li>Resursni <b>request'idan ko'p</b> ishlatayotganlar birinchi.</li><li>QoS: <code>BestEffort</code> (request yo'q) -&gt; <code>Burstable</code> -&gt; <code>Guaranteed</code> (request = limit) eng oxirgi.</li><li>Ustuvorlik (PriorityClass) ham hisobga olinadi.</li></ul><h4>Tuzatish</h4><ul><li>Ephemeral storage'ni cheklash va so'rash:</li></ul><pre>resources:<br>  requests: { ephemeral-storage: 1Gi, memory: 512Mi }<br>  limits:   { ephemeral-storage: 2Gi, memory: 512Mi }<br>volumes:<br>- name: tmp<br>  emptyDir: { sizeLimit: 1Gi }</pre><ul><li>Log rotatsiyasi (<code>containerLogMaxSize</code>), log'larni stdout'ga, faylga emas.</li><li>Memory request'ni haqiqiy ishlatishga yaqin qilish; muhim pod'lar uchun <code>Guaranteed</code> QoS.</li><li>Node'larda kubelet uchun <code>systemReserved</code>/<code>kubeReserved</code> va mos <code>evictionHard</code>.</li></ul><h4>Evicted pod'lar qoldig'i</h4><p>Evicted pod obyektlari <code>Failed</code> holatida qoladi — Deployment yangi pod yaratadi, eski obyektlar tozalanmaydi (GC threshold'gacha):</p><pre>kubectl delete pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Failed</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eviction — node'ni qutqarish mexanizmi, xato emas. Takroriy eviction'lar request'lar noto'g'ri ekanining belgisi: scheduler node'ni bo'sh deb o'ylab pod'larni joylagan, haqiqatda esa ular ko'proq yeydi. Request'lar haqiqatga yaqin bo'lsa — eviction kamdan-kam bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::t11 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Kubernetes::T11 Kubernetes gotchas	idrill-30483	<p><code>kubectl apply</code> bilan deploy qilindi, lekin pod eski image bilan ishlayapti. Sabab?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes faqat <b>pod template o'zgarganda</b> yangi rollout qiladi. Image tag o'zgarmagan bo'lsa (<code>myapp:latest</code> -&gt; <code>myapp:latest</code>), manifest bir xil — <code>kubectl apply</code> &quot;unchanged&quot; deydi va hech narsa bo'lmaydi. Hatto pod qayta yaratilsa ham, node'da keshlangan eski image ishlatilishi mumkin (<code>imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent</code>). Yechim — <b>o'zgarmas tag'lar</b> (commit SHA yoki versiya) yoki <b>digest</b>.</p><h4>Nima bo'ladi</h4><pre>CI: docker build -t myapp:latest &amp;&amp; docker push   (registry'da yangi image)<br>CD: kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml  (image: myapp:latest — o'zgarmagan)<br>-&gt; &quot;deployment.apps/api unchanged&quot; -&gt; eski pod'lar ishlayveradi</pre><p>Qo'shimcha muammo: turli node'larda turli <code>latest</code> — bir pod yangi, boshqasi eski versiya (node keshi).</p><h4>To'g'ri yondashuv</h4><p><b>Har build uchun noyob tag:</b></p><pre>image: registry.example.com/myapp:1.4.2-3f9c2ab      # versiya + commit SHA</pre><p><b>Yoki digest (eng qat'iy):</b></p><pre>image: registry.example.com/myapp@sha256:9b1c...e4</pre><p>Digest — image tarkibining hash'i; o'zgarmaydi va kim nima ishlatayotgani aniq.</p><p>CI/CD'da:</p><pre>kubectl set image deploy/api app=registry.example.com/myapp:${GIT_SHA}<br>kubectl rollout status deploy/api --timeout=5m</pre><p>GitOps'da — Git'dagi manifest'da tag yangilanadi (Argo CD Image Updater, Renovate yoki CI commit qiladi).</p><h4><code>imagePullPolicy</code></h4><ul><li><code>Always</code> — har pod ishga tushishida registry'dan tekshiradi (<code>:latest</code> uchun default). Sekinroq, registry'ga bog'liqlik.</li><li><code>IfNotPresent</code> — node'da bo'lsa, yuklamaydi (aniq tag'lar uchun default va to'g'ri).</li></ul><p>Noyob tag'lar bilan <code>IfNotPresent</code> xavfsiz va tez.</p><h4>Majburlash</h4><ul><li>Kyverno/Gatekeeper policy: <code>:latest</code> yoki tag'siz image'larni rad etish.</li><li>Registry'da <b>tag immutability</b> (ECR, Harbor) — bir tag'ni qayta yozib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><h4>Favqulodda holatda</h4><pre>kubectl rollout restart deploy/api     # pod'larni qayta yaratadi (Always policy bilan yangi image tortiladi)</pre><p>Lekin bu — hack, jarayon emas: rollback qilish uchun &quot;oldingi versiya&quot; aniq emas.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>:latest</code> — &quot;qaysi versiya ishlayapti?&quot; savoliga javobni yo'qotadi: rollback, audit va incident tahlili imkonsiz bo'ladi. Production'da har bir ishlayotgan pod aniq commit'ga bog'lanishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::k8s sec::t11 Infra_gotcha

Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-2013	<p>Continuous Integration nimani anglatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Continuous Integration (CI) — har bir o'zgarish tez-tez (kamida kuniga bir marta) asosiy branch'ga qo'shiladi va har commit/PR <b>avtomatik build va test</b>dan o'tadi. Maqsad — integratsiya xatolarini kichik va yangi paytida topish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Uch dasturchi uch hafta alohida branch'da ishladi. Merge kuni — yuzlab konflikt, hech kim nima buzilganini bilmaydi (&quot;integration hell&quot;). CI buni kichik, tez-tez qo'shishlar bilan yo'qotadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dev: kichik o'zgarish -&gt; PR<br>        v<br>CI: checkout -&gt; build -&gt; lint -&gt; unit test -&gt; (tez, &lt; 10 daq)<br>        v<br>yashil -&gt; review -&gt; main'ga merge -&gt; main doim ishlaydigan holatda<br>qizil  -&gt; darhol tuzatiladi (main buzilgan holda qolmaydi)</pre><p>| Atama | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | Continuous Integration | har o'zgarish avtomatik tekshiriladi va tez qo'shiladi | | Continuous Delivery | har yashil build prod'ga <b>chiqishga tayyor</b> (tugma bilan) | | Continuous Deployment | har yashil build <b>avtomatik</b> prod'ga chiqadi |</p><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions):</b></p><pre>name: ci<br>on: [pull_request, push]<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: { go-version: &quot;1.25&quot; }<br>      - run: go vet ./...<br>      - run: go test -race ./...</pre><p>Branch protection: <code>main</code> ga faqat CI yashil bo'lsa merge.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CI server bor, lekin branch'lar haftalab yashaydi — bu CI emas, faqat &quot;avtomatik build&quot;.</li><li>Qizil main'ni kunlab qoldirish — hamma ishi bloklanadi.</li><li>Sekin CI (40+ daqiqa) — odamlar kamroq commit qiladi.</li><li>Testlar yo'q yoki flaky — yashil belgi hech narsani anglatmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI — vosita emas, amaliyot: kichik PR, tez feedback, tugallanmagan ish feature flag ortida. Asosiy o'lchov — main'ning qancha vaqt yashil turishi va PR'dan merge'gacha vaqt.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30546	<p><code>git merge</code> va <code>git rebase</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git merge</code> — ikki branch tarixini <b>merge commit</b> bilan birlashtiradi; mavjud commit'lar o'zgarmaydi. <code>git rebase</code> — branch'ingiz commit'larini yangi baza (masalan, yangi <code>main</code>) ustiga <b>qayta yozadi</b>: tarix chiziqli bo'ladi, lekin commit hash'lari o'zgaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Siz feature branch'da ishlayotganda <code>main</code> oldinga ketdi. Uni o'z branch'ingizga olib kirish kerak. Merge — tarix rost, lekin &quot;shovqinli&quot;; rebase — toza, lekin tarixni o'zgartiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Boshlang'ich:       A---B---C  main<br>                         \<br>                          D---E  feature<br><br>merge (feature'da git merge main):<br>                    A---B---C<br>                         \   \<br>                          D---E---M     (M = merge commit)<br><br>rebase (feature'da git rebase main):<br>                    A---B---C---D'---E'  (D', E' - yangi hash)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git switch feature<br>git fetch origin<br>git rebase origin/main          # konflikt bo'lsa: tuzat -&gt; git add -&gt; git rebase --continue<br>git rebase --abort              # bekor qilish<br>git push --force-with-lease     # rebase'dan keyin; birovning yangi commit'ini o'chirmaydi<br><br>git switch main<br>git merge --no-ff feature       # merge commit bilan<br>git log --oneline --graph       # tarixni ko'rish</pre><p><b>Oltin qoida:</b> boshqalar ham ishlatayotgan (push qilingan umumiy) branch'ni rebase qilmang — ularning tarixi sizniki bilan mos kelmay qoladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git push --force</code> (lease'siz) — hamkasbning commit'ini o'chirib yuborishi mumkin.</li><li>Uzoq branch'ni rebase qilish — har commit'da bir xil konflikt; <code>git rerere</code> yoki merge.</li><li>Rebase paytida konfliktni noto'g'ri yechish — commit'lar &quot;jim&quot; buziladi; har qadamda test.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jamoaviy kelishuv muhim: ko'pchilik &quot;lokal rebase, PR'ni squash merge&quot; ishlatadi — main tarixi toza, har PR bitta commit. <code>git pull --rebase</code> default qilish (<code>pull.rebase=true</code>) keraksiz merge commit'larni yo'qotadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i2 Git

Vault multi-cloud, on-prem va dynamic secret'lar haqiqatan kerak bo'lganda oqlanadi. (Litsenziya: Vault BSL ostida; ochiq fork — OpenBao.)</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i2 Secrets
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-33416	<p>CI'da matrix build va cache nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Matrix build</b> — bitta job'ni bir nechta parametrlar kombinatsiyasida (Go versiyalari x OS) avtomatik parallel ishga tushirish: moslikni bir PR'da tekshirasiz. <b>Cache</b> — dependency va build natijalarini ishga tushirishlar orasida saqlab, har safar noldan yuklamaslik: CI vaqtini bir necha baravar qisqartiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kutubxonangiz Go 1.24 va 1.25 da, Linux va macOS'da ishlashi kerak — 4 ta job'ni qo'lda yozish takror. Har job har safar 300 MB dependency yuklaydi — 5 daqiqa behuda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>matrix: go=[1.24,1.25] x os=[ubuntu,macos]  -&gt; 4 ta parallel job<br><br>cache:<br> kalit = os + hash(go.sum)<br>   topildi  -&gt; tiklash (soniyalar)<br>   topilmadi -&gt; yuklash -&gt; job oxirida saqlash<br> go.sum o'zgarsa -&gt; yangi kalit -&gt; yangi kesh</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    strategy:<br>      fail-fast: false<br>      matrix:<br>        go: [&quot;1.24&quot;, &quot;1.25&quot;]<br>        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]<br>    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: { go-version: &quot;${{ matrix.go }}&quot;, cache: true }   # go mod + build cache<br>      - run: go test -race ./...</pre><p>Docker layer kesh:</p><pre>- uses: docker/build-push-action@v6<br>  with:<br>    cache-from: type=gha<br>    cache-to: type=gha,mode=max</pre><p>Log'da <code>Cache restored from key: ...</code> yoki <code>Cache not found</code> — keshlash ishlayotganini tekshirish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fail-fast: true</code> (default) — bitta kombinatsiya yiqilsa qolganlari bekor; qaysilar ishlashini bilmaysiz.</li><li>Kesh kalitida lockfile hash yo'q — eski dependency'lar.</li><li>Keshga test natijalari yoki build artefaktlarini qo'yish — eskirgan &quot;yashil&quot; natija.</li><li>Matrix 3x3x3 = 27 job — runner limiti va pul.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PR'da kichik matrix (asosiy kombinatsiya), to'liq matrix — main yoki tungi build'da. Fork PR'lar keshga yozmasligi kerak — cache poisoning xavfi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-2014	<p>Blue-green va canary deploy farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Blue-green</b> — ikkita to'liq muhit: blue (joriy) va green (yangi). Green tayyor va tekshirilgandan keyin trafik <b>bir zumda</b> to'liq almashtiriladi; rollback — qayta almashtirish. <b>Canary</b> — yangi versiyaga trafikning <b>kichik qismi</b> (1-5%) beriladi, metrikalar yaxshi bo'lsa ulush asta oshiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi versiyadagi bug hamma foydalanuvchiga birdan tegsa — katta incident. Ikkala strategiya ham xavfni kamaytiradi, lekin turlicha: blue-green — tez qaytish, canary — kichik ta'sir doirasi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Blue-green:<br>  LB --100%--&gt; blue (v1)        green (v2) deploy + smoke test<br>  LB --100%--&gt; green (v2)       blue (v1) kutib turadi (rollback uchun)<br><br>Canary:<br>  LB --95%--&gt; v1<br>     --5%---&gt; v2   (xato %, p99, biznes metrika kuzatiladi)<br>  OK -&gt; 25% -&gt; 50% -&gt; 100%      yomon -&gt; 0% (abort)</pre><p>| | Blue-green | Canary | |---|---|---| | Xato ta'siri | hammaga birdan | kichik ulushga | | Rollback | bir zumda | bir zumda (ulush 0%) | | Resurs | 2x muhit | ozgina qo'shimcha | | Murakkablik | oddiy | metrika tahlili, trafik bo'lish kerak |</p><p><b>Amalda (Argo Rollouts canary):</b></p><pre>strategy:<br>  canary:<br>    steps:<br>      - setWeight: 5<br>      - pause: { duration: 10m }<br>      - setWeight: 25<br>      - pause: { duration: 10m }<br>      - setWeight: 100</pre><pre>kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api --watch<br>kubectl argo rollouts abort api      # canary'ni to'xtatish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ikkala versiya bir vaqtda ishlaydi — DB sxemasi ikkalasiga mos bo'lishi shart (expand-contract).</li><li>Blue-green'da sessiya/kesh holati — foydalanuvchilar sessiyasi yo'qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Canary'da trafik juda kam — metrika statistik ma'nosiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amalda canary ko'proq ishlatiladi — ko'p bug'lar faqat real trafikda ko'rinadi. Blue-green infra o'zgarishlari (masalan, klaster/DB versiya) va tez to'liq almashtirish kerak bo'lganda qulay.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i2 Deploy
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-2015	<p>Parol, API key va sertifikatlarni qanday boshqarasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Qoidalar: Git'da <b>hech qachon</b>; markazlashgan secret store (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager); <b>eng kam huquq</b> va har muhitga alohida kalit; muntazam <b>rotatsiya</b> (yaxshisi qisqa muddatli/dynamic credential); oqishni oldini olish (secret scanning); leak bo'lsa <b>revoke runbook</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Secret'lar kod, <code>.env</code>, CI sozlamalari, Slack'da tarqalib ketadi. Sertifikat muddati unutilsa — tunda uzilish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Yozish:  odam/terraform -&gt; Secret store (shifrlangan, audit)<br>O'qish:  ilova (identity: K8s SA / IAM role) -&gt; store -&gt; qisqa TTL secret<br>         K8s: External Secrets Operator -&gt; K8s Secret -&gt; env/volume<br>Himoya:  pre-commit gitleaks + GitHub push protection<br>Sertifikat: cert-manager / ACM -&gt; avtomatik yangilash</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># oqishni oldini olish<br>gitleaks git --redact -v .<br># AWS Secrets Manager<br>aws secretsmanager create-secret --name prod/api/db --secret-string '{&quot;password&quot;:&quot;...&quot;}'<br>aws secretsmanager rotate-secret --secret-id prod/api/db --rotation-lambda-arn arn:...</pre><pre>apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1<br>kind: ExternalSecret<br>metadata: { name: api-db }<br>spec:<br>  refreshInterval: 1h<br>  secretStoreRef: { name: aws-sm, kind: ClusterSecretStore }<br>  target: { name: api-db }<br>  data:<br>    - secretKey: password<br>      remoteRef: { key: prod/api/db, property: password }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>K8s Secret'ni xavfsiz deb hisoblash — u faqat base64; etcd encryption va RBAC kerak.</li><li>Secret'ni log yoki xato xabariga chiqarish.</li><li>Bitta kalit hamma muhitda — dev'dagi oqish prod'ni ochadi.</li><li>Git'ga tushgan secret'ni faqat tarixdan o'chirish — u allaqachon oshkor; avval revoke.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi secret — yo'q secret: workload identity (IRSA, GKE WI), OIDC federatsiya va dynamic DB credential'lar statik kalitlarni butunlay yo'qotadi. Har secret uchun ega, rotatsiya davri va &quot;oqsa nima qilamiz&quot; runbook'i bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i2 Secrets
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30547	<p>Tasodifan secret (API kalit) commit qilinib, push bo'ldi. To'g'ri harakat?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Birinchi — kalitni <b>darhol bekor qilish (revoke/rotate)</b>: push bo'lgan zahoti u oshkor hisoblanadi (botlar public repo'larni soniyalarda skanerlaydi). Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30548	<p>Qaysi commit bug keltirganini 500 ta commit ichidan tez topish?</p><pre>git bisect start<br>git bisect bad HEAD<br>git bisect good v1.4.0<br># har qadamda test qilib: git bisect good | bad<br># yoki avtomatik:<br>git bisect run ./test.sh</pre>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git bisect</code> — commit'lar ustida <b>ikkilik qidiruv</b>: bitta &quot;yaxshi&quot; va bitta &quot;yomon&quot; commit berasiz, Git o'rtadagi commit'ni tekshirishni so'raydi va har qadamda oraliqni ikkiga bo'ladi. 500 commit ichidan log2(500) = ~9 qadamda topiladi. <code>git bisect run</code> bilan to'liq avtomatik.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kecha ishlagan test bugun yiqilyapti, oradagi 500 commit. Har birini qo'lda tekshirish — kunlar. Bisect — bir necha daqiqa.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>good v1.4 ................................... bad HEAD   (500)<br>          test 250 -&gt; bad<br>good ................ bad 250                              (250)<br>          test 125 -&gt; good<br>          ......... <br>~9 qadamdan keyin: &quot;abc123 is the first bad commit&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git bisect start<br>git bisect bad HEAD<br>git bisect good v1.4.0<br># Git commit'ni checkout qildi -&gt; tekshir:<br>git bisect good    # yoki: git bisect bad / git bisect skip (build bo'lmasa)<br><br># Avtomatik:<br>git bisect run ./test.sh<br># test.sh exit kodi: 0 = good, 1..127 (125 dan tashqari) = bad, 125 = skip<br>git bisect log     # yozib qo'yish<br>git bisect reset   # boshlang'ich branch'ga qaytish</pre><p><code>test.sh</code> misoli:</p><pre>#!/bin/sh<br>go build ./... || exit 125<br>go test ./pkg/payment -run TestRefund -count=1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>git bisect reset</code> ni unutish — detached HEAD'da qolib ketish.</li><li>Flaky test bilan bisect — noto'g'ri natija; testni bir necha marta ishlat.</li><li>Katta &quot;aralash&quot; commit'lar — topilgan commit 2000 qatorli bo'lsa ham foydasi kam.</li><li>Merge commit'li tarixda <code>--first-parent</code> foydali (qaysi PR buzganini topish).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bisect'ning qiymati kichik, atomar va har biri build bo'ladigan commit'lardan keladi — bu squash/atomic commit madaniyatiga yana bir sabab. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30550	<p>GitOps nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitOps — infratuzilma va ilovalarning <b>kerakli holati Git'da</b> deklarativ saqlanadi; klaster ichidagi agent (<b>Argo CD</b>, <b>Flux</b>) Git'ni doim kuzatib, klasterni unga moslaydi (<b>pull model</b>). O'zgarish = Git'ga commit/PR; rollback = <code>git revert</code>; qo'lda o'zgarish (drift) avtomatik tuzatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI <code>kubectl apply</code> qiladi — CI'da prod klasterning admin kaliti saqlanadi (katta xavf), kim nimani qachon o'zgartirgani tarqoq, kimdir qo'lda <code>kubectl edit</code> qilsa hech kim bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dev PR -&gt; app repo -&gt; CI: test, image build (sha) -&gt; push registry<br>                        CI: config repo'da image.tag = sha (commit/PR)<br>                                     v<br>        Argo CD (klaster ichida) &lt;-- pull, har ~3 daq yoki webhook<br>            diff(Git, klaster) -&gt; sync -&gt; klaster = Git<br>            qo'lda o'zgarish -&gt; OutOfSync -&gt; selfHeal qaytaradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: Application<br>metadata: { name: api, namespace: argocd }<br>spec:<br>  project: default<br>  source:<br>    repoURL: https://github.com/acme/k8s-config<br>    path: apps/api/overlays/prod<br>    targetRevision: main<br>  destination: { server: https://kubernetes.default.svc, namespace: prod }<br>  syncPolicy:<br>    automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true }</pre><pre>argocd app get api        # Sync: Synced/OutOfSync, Health: Healthy/Degraded<br>argocd app diff api<br>git revert &lt;sha&gt; &amp;&amp; git push   # rollback</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret'larni Git'ga ochiq qo'yish — SOPS, Sealed Secrets yoki External Secrets.</li><li>HPA boshqaradigan <code>replicas</code> Git'da ham — doimiy OutOfSync; <code>ignoreDifferences</code> yoki maydonni olib tashla.</li><li><code>prune: true</code> noto'g'ri path bilan — resurslar o'chib ketishi mumkin.</li><li>Favqulodda <code>kubectl</code> bilan tuzatish — selfHeal qaytarib yozadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitOps'ning asosiy foydasi — xavfsizlik (CI'da klaster kaliti yo'q) va audit (git log = o'zgarishlar jurnali). App kodi va config'ni alohida repo'larda saqlash release jarayonini toza qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i2 GitOps

Ko'p jamoalar ikkalasini birga ishlatadi: Helm uchinchi tomon chart'lar uchun, Kustomize o'z ilovalari uchun; GitOps bilan muhit farqlari Git'da ko'rinadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i2 GitOps

Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-33417	<p>SAST, DAST, SCA va SonarQube quality gate — pipeline'da qayerda turadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>SAST</b> — manba kodni ishga tushirmasdan zaiflikka tahlil (PR'da). <b>SCA</b> — dependency'lardagi ma'lum CVE'lar va litsenziyalar (PR'da va muntazam). <b>DAST</b> — ishlab turgan ilovaga tashqaridan hujum simulyatsiyasi (staging'da). <b>SonarQube quality gate</b> — PR/branch uchun sifat chegaralari (yangi kodda coverage, bug, zaiflik) — o'tmasa merge bloklanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Xavfsizlikni release oldidan bir martalik &quot;audit&quot; bilan tekshirish — kech va qimmat. Har bosqichda tegishli tekshiruv bo'lsa, xato paydo bo'lgan joyda arzon tuzatiladi (&quot;shift left&quot;).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PR:      lint -&gt; unit -&gt; SAST (semgrep) -&gt; SCA (govulncheck/trivy) -&gt; secret scan<br>           -&gt; build image -&gt; image scan -&gt; quality gate (yangi kod: cov&gt;=80%, 0 critical)<br>staging: deploy -&gt; DAST (ZAP baseline) -&gt; e2e<br>prod:    faqat imzolangan image (admission policy)</pre><p>| Tur | Nimani ko'radi | Qayerda | Misol | |---|---|---|---| | SAST | kod (SQLi, hardcoded secret) | PR | Semgrep, CodeQL, gosec | | SCA | dependency CVE, litsenziya | PR + kunlik | govulncheck, Trivy, Snyk | | DAST | ishlayotgan ilova (header, XSS) | staging | OWASP ZAP | | Quality gate | sifat metrikalari | PR | SonarQube |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>govulncheck ./...                               # faqat haqiqatan chaqirilgan zaif funksiyalar<br>semgrep ci<br>trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 .<br>docker run -t ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-baseline.py -t https://staging.acme.uz</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma eski qarz bo'yicha gate — birinchi kuni hamma narsa qizil, jamoa skanerni o'chiradi. Faqat <b>yangi kod</b> bo'yicha.</li><li>False positive'larni boshqarish jarayoni yo'q — shovqin, ishonch yo'qoladi.</li><li>Har finding bloklaydi — critical bloklasin, qolgani ticket.</li><li>DAST'ni prod'da ruxsatsiz ishlatish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Skanerlar soni emas, signal sifati muhim: reachability tahlili (govulncheck), VEX va egalik (har finding kimga tegishli) bo'lmasa, xavfsizlik vositalari &quot;shovqin generatori&quot;ga aylanadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-33446	<p>Conventional Commits va semantic-release / release-please: versiya va changelog qanday avtomatlashadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Conventional Commits</b> — commit xabarlari uchun format (<code>type(scope): tavsif</code>): <code>fix</code> -&gt; patch, <code>feat</code> -&gt; minor, <code>!</code> yoki <code>BREAKING CHANGE:</code> -&gt; major. 1.4.0 -&gt; 1.4.1<br>feat(auth): OIDC login                   -&gt; 1.4.1 -&gt; 1.5.0<br>feat!: v1 endpoint'lar o'chirildi        -&gt; 1.5.0 -&gt; 2.0.0<br>chore/docs/test                          -&gt; versiya o'zgarmaydi<br><br>release-please:<br> merge'lar -&gt; bot &quot;Release PR&quot; ni yangilab boradi (CHANGELOG + versiya)<br> Release PR merge -&gt; tag v1.5.0 + GitHub Release</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># .github/workflows/release.yml<br>on: { push: { branches: [main] } }<br>permissions: { contents: write, pull-requests: write }<br>jobs:<br>  release:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4<br>        with: { release-type: go }</pre><p>Formatni majburlash:</p><pre>npm i -D @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional<br>echo &quot;export default { extends: ['@commitlint/config-conventional'] }&quot; &gt; commitlint.config.js<br>npx commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD</pre><p>| Vosita | Yondashuv | |---|---| | semantic-release | har merge = release (to'liq avtomat) | | release-please | Release PR — qachon chiqarishni odam hal qiladi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Squash merge'da commit xabari = PR sarlavhasi — PR sarlavhasini ham lint qil.</li><li><code>feat</code> ni noto'g'ri ishlatish — keraksiz minor versiyalar.</li><li>Monorepo'da paketlar alohida versiyalanmasa — hammasi birga ko'tariladi (release-please manifest rejimi bor).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avtomatik versiyalash faqat commit intizomi bilan ishlaydi; asl qiymati — foydalanuvchiga breaking change'ni ishonchli signal qilish. Ichki servislar uchun ko'pincha SemVer emas, commit SHA yetarli.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-33447	<p>Renovate / Dependabot nima va dependency yangilashni qanday xavfsiz avtomatlashtirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Renovate va Dependabot — repo'dagi dependency'larni kuzatib, yangi versiya chiqsa avtomatik <b>PR ochadigan botlar</b>. Xavfsiz avtomatlashtirish: yaxshi test qamrovi, <b>guruhlash</b> va <b>jadval</b> (PR shovqini kamayadi), patch/minor uchun <b>automerge</b> faqat CI yashil bo'lsa, major — qo'lda review, Docker image'larni <b>digest</b>'ga pin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dependency'lar yillab yangilanmaydi — keyin bir kunda 3 major versiya sakrash kerak bo'ladi va CVE patch'lari kechikadi. Qo'lda kuzatish imkonsiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bot (har kuni/hafta) -&gt; manifest'larni o'qiydi (go.mod, package.json, Dockerfile, Helm, Terraform)<br>   -&gt; yangi versiya -&gt; branch + PR (changelog, release notes bilan)<br>   -&gt; CI ishlaydi<br>   -&gt; patch/minor + yashil -&gt; automerge<br>   -&gt; major -&gt; label &quot;needs-review&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda (<code>renovate.json</code>):</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;extends&quot;: [&quot;config:recommended&quot;],<br>  &quot;schedule&quot;: [&quot;before 6am on monday&quot;],<br>  &quot;prConcurrentLimit&quot;: 5,<br>  &quot;packageRules&quot;: [<br>    { &quot;matchUpdateTypes&quot;: [&quot;patch&quot;, &quot;minor&quot;], &quot;matchCurrentVersion&quot;: &quot;!/^0/&quot;, &quot;automerge&quot;: true },<br>    { &quot;matchManagers&quot;: [&quot;dockerfile&quot;], &quot;pinDigests&quot;: true },<br>    { &quot;matchPackageNames&quot;: [&quot;/^@aws-sdk//&quot;], &quot;groupName&quot;: &quot;aws sdk&quot; },<br>    { &quot;matchUpdateTypes&quot;: [&quot;major&quot;], &quot;labels&quot;: [&quot;needs-review&quot;] }<br>  ],<br>  &quot;vulnerabilityAlerts&quot;: { &quot;labels&quot;: [&quot;security&quot;], &quot;schedule&quot;: [&quot;at any time&quot;] }<br>}</pre><p>Dependabot (<code>.github/dependabot.yml</code>) oddiyroq: <code>package-ecosystem</code>, <code>schedule</code>, <code>groups</code>.</p><p>| | Dependabot | Renovate | |---|---|---| | Ekotizimlar | asosiylar | juda keng (Helm, Terraform, K8s image'lar, regex) | | Guruhlash/jadval | bor (oddiyroq) | juda moslashuvchan | | Platforma | GitHub | GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, self-hosted |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Testlar zaif + automerge = avtomatik prod buzilishi.</li><li><code>0.x</code> versiyalarda minor ham breaking bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Har paketga alohida PR — jamoa e'tiborsiz qoldiradi (PR charchoq).</li><li>Yangi chiqqan versiyani darhol olish — <code>minimumReleaseAge</code> (masalan 3 kun) supply chain hujumlaridan himoya qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maqsad — &quot;kichik va tez-tez&quot; yangilash, shunda har biri xavfsiz. Xavfsizlik PR'lari jadvaldan tashqarida darhol ochilsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-33448	<p>Preview (ephemeral) environment nima va qanday quriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Preview (ephemeral) environment — har PR uchun avtomatik yaratiladigan <b>vaqtinchalik to'liq muhit</b> (o'z URL'i bilan), PR yopilganda avtomatik o'chiriladi. Har PR'ga alohida muhit bu navbatni yo'qotadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PR #123 ochildi<br>  -&gt; CI: image build (tag = commit sha)<br>  -&gt; helm upgrade --install pr-123 -n pr-123 --create-namespace<br>  -&gt; URL: pr-123.preview.acme.uz (wildcard DNS + wildcard cert)<br>  -&gt; PR'ga izoh: &quot;Preview: https://pr-123.preview.acme.uz&quot;<br>PR yopildi / TTL tugadi<br>  -&gt; helm uninstall + kubectl delete ns pr-123</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions):</b></p><pre>on:<br>  pull_request: { types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed] }<br>jobs:<br>  preview:<br>    if: github.event.action != 'closed'<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - run: |<br>          helm upgrade --install pr-${{ github.event.number }} ./chart \<br>            -n pr-${{ github.event.number }} --create-namespace \<br>            --set image.tag=${{ github.sha }} \<br>            --set ingress.host=pr-${{ github.event.number }}.preview.acme.uz<br>  cleanup:<br>    if: github.event.action == 'closed'<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - run: kubectl delete ns pr-${{ github.event.number }} --ignore-not-found</pre><p>Boshqa vositalar: Argo CD ApplicationSet (Pull Request generator), GitLab Review Apps, Vercel/Netlify (frontend).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tozalash yo'q — klaster unutilgan muhitlar bilan to'ladi; TTL va tungi &quot;garbage collector&quot; job.</li><li>DB: har PR'ga kichik seed'langan Postgres yoki umumiy DB'da alohida schema; prod ma'lumot emas.</li><li>Tashqi integratsiyalar (to'lov, SMS) — mock yoki sandbox.</li><li>Prod secret'lari preview'da — hech qachon.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Preview muhitlar narxini nazorat qil: spot node'lar, <code>requests</code> kichik, ishlatilmasa scale-to-zero. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-33470	<p>DORA metrikalari nima va DevOps samaradorligini qanday o'lchaysiz?</p>	<p>| Metrika | Nima | Qayerdan olinadi | |---|---|---| | Deployment frequency | Prod'ga qancha tez-tez deploy | CD tizimi | | Lead time for changes | Commit'dan prod'gacha vaqt | Git + CD | | Change failure rate | Deploy'larning necha foizi incident/rollback | Incident tracker + CD | | Time to restore | Incident'dan tiklanishgacha | Incident tracker |</p><p>Yangi versiyalarda beshinchi — reliability (SLO bajarilishi).</p><p><b>Middle nuqtalar:</b></p><ul><li>Metrika jamoani yaxshilash uchun, odamlarni solishtirish uchun emas — aks holda &quot;o'yin&quot; boshlanadi (mayda deploy'lar).</li><li>Lead time uzun bo'lsa — bottleneck'ni toping: review kutish, sekin CI, qo'lda approval.</li><li>Change failure rate yuqori — test, canary, feature flag.</li></ul>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-2016	<p>Build artefakti va muhitlar (dev/stage/prod) bo'yicha to'g'ri yondashuv qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> To'g'ri yondashuv — <b>build once, deploy many</b>: artefakt (Docker image) <b>bir marta</b> quriladi, o'zgarmas identifikator (<b>digest</b> <code>@sha256:...</code> yoki commit SHA tag) bilan belgilanadi va o'sha aynan artefakt dev -&gt; staging -&gt; prod bo'ylab o'tadi. Muhitlar orasidagi farq faqat <b>konfiguratsiya</b>da (env, secret, values).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har muhit uchun qayta build — staging'da tekshirilgan narsa prod'dagi bilan bir xil emas (boshqa dependency versiyasi, boshqa base image). <code>latest</code> tag — qaysi kod ishlayotganini hech kim bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>commit abc123 -&gt; CI build -&gt; ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:9f1... (tag: abc123)<br>                                   |<br>        +--------------------------+------------------------+<br>        v                          v                        v<br>      dev                       staging                    prod<br>   values-dev.yaml          values-staging.yaml       values-prod.yaml<br>   (bir xil image, farqli config)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker build -t ghcr.io/acme/api:$GIT_SHA .<br>docker push ghcr.io/acme/api:$GIT_SHA<br>DIGEST=$(docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/acme/api:$GIT_SHA --format '{{json .Manifest.Digest}}' | tr -d '&quot;')<br># promotion: faqat config repo'da tag/digest'ni yangilash<br>yq -i &quot;.image.digest = \&quot;$DIGEST\&quot;&quot; envs/prod/values.yaml</pre><p>Image ichida muhitga xos narsa yo'q: konfiguratsiya env var, ConfigMap, Secret orqali (12-factor).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ENV=prod</code> ni build vaqtida image'ga tikish — prod uchun alohida build kerak bo'ladi.</li><li>Tag'ni qayta ishlatish (mutable tag) — <code>v1.2</code> bugun va ertaga boshqa image.</li><li>Frontend'da API URL build vaqtida bundle'ga tushadi — runtime config (<code>/config.json</code>) kerak.</li><li>Prod'da faqat qayta build qilingan &quot;hotfix&quot; image — test qilinmagan artefakt.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Digest bo'yicha deploy + imzo (cosign) + admission policy = prod'da faqat CI qurgan va tekshirgan artefakt ishlaydi. Promotion — artefaktni ko'chirish emas, uning identifikatorini keyingi muhit config'iga yozish.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 Deploy
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-2017	<p>DB migratsiyasi deploy pipeline'ining qaysi qadamida bajarilishi kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Migratsiya <b>deploy'dan oldin</b> bajariladi va <b>orqaga mos (backward-compatible)</b> bo'lishi shart: rolling deploy paytida eski va yangi kod bir vaqtda ishlaydi, ikkalasi ham yangi sxema bilan ishlay olishi kerak. Buzuvchi o'zgarishlar <b>expand-contract</b> bilan bir necha relizga bo'linadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ustun nomi o'zgartirildi va kod bilan birga deploy qilindi. Rolling update davomida eski pod'lar eski nomni so'raydi -&gt; 500 xatolar. Yoki migratsiya katta jadvalni lock qildi -&gt; butun ilova to'xtadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CI/CD:<br> build -&gt; test -&gt; [migrate job: expand]  -&gt; rolling deploy (v1+v2 birga) -&gt; v2 100%<br>                    (faqat qo'shish)<br> keyingi reliz:   [migrate job: contract] (eski ustunni o'chirish)<br><br>Expand-contract (ustunni qayta nomlash):<br> R1: yangi ustun qo'sh, kod ikkalasiga yozadi<br> R2: backfill, kod yangidan o'qiydi<br> R3: eski ustunni o'chir</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Helm pre-upgrade hook yoki alohida K8s Job<br>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: Job<br>metadata:<br>  name: migrate-{{ .Values.image.tag }}<br>  annotations: { &quot;helm.sh/hook&quot;: pre-upgrade, &quot;helm.sh/hook-delete-policy&quot;: before-hook-creation }<br>spec:<br>  backoffLimit: 0<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      restartPolicy: Never<br>      containers:<br>        - name: migrate<br>          image: ghcr.io/acme/api:{{ .Values.image.tag }}<br>          command: [&quot;migrate&quot;, &quot;-path&quot;, &quot;/migrations&quot;, &quot;-database&quot;, &quot;$(DATABASE_URL)&quot;, &quot;up&quot;]</pre><pre>SET lock_timeout = '5s';<br>SET statement_timeout = '15min';<br>ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN status_v2 text;            -- tez, metadata<br>CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_status ON orders(status_v2);</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Migratsiyani ilova start'ida har pod'da ishlatish — 10 pod bir vaqtda migratsiya qiladi.</li><li><code>lock_timeout</code> yo'q — DDL lock navbatida qolib, butun jadvalni bloklaydi.</li><li>Katta backfill'ni bitta tranzaksiyada — WAL, lock, replication lag; batch + throttling.</li><li>O'chirishni (DROP) kod bilan bir relizda — rollback imkonsiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kod rollback'i oson, sxema rollback'i qiyin: shuning uchun &quot;down&quot; migratsiyaga emas, orqaga moslikka tayan. Destruktiv qadamlarni kechiktir — bir-ikki reliz kutib, keyin o'chir.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 Deploy
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30030	<p>Sxema o'zgarishi bo'lgan relizni zero-downtime chiqarish tartibi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Expand-contract</b> tartibi: (1) <b>expand</b> — faqat qo'shuvchi o'zgarish (nullable ustun, <code>CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY</code>); (2) ikki formatni ham tushunadigan kodni deploy qilish (ikkalasiga yozadi); (3) <b>backfill</b> — eski ma'lumotni batch'larda ko'chirish; (4) kodni yangi formatdan o'qishga o'tkazish; (5) keyingi relizda <b>contract</b> — eski ustun/kodni olib tashlash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Rolling deploy'da eski va yangi kod bir vaqtda ishlaydi va istalgan payt rollback bo'lishi mumkin. Har bir oraliq holatda sxema ikkala versiyaga ham mos bo'lishi shart.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (misol: <code>name</code> -&gt; <code>first_name</code> + <code>last_name</code>):</b></p><pre>Reliz 1 (expand):   ADD COLUMN first_name, last_name (NULL)<br>                    kod: name'ga VA yangi ustunlarga yozadi, name'dan o'qiydi<br>Backfill job:       UPDATE ... batch 5000, throttling<br>Reliz 2:            kod yangi ustunlardan o'qiydi, ikkalasiga yozadi<br>                    NOT NULL: CHECK NOT VALID -&gt; VALIDATE<br>Reliz 3 (contract): kod name'ni ishlatmaydi<br>Reliz 4:            DROP COLUMN name<br>Har bosqichda rollback mumkin.</pre><p><b>Amalda (PostgreSQL):</b></p><pre>SET lock_timeout = '3s';<br>ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN first_name text;            -- tez, lock qisqa<br>CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_first ON users(first_name);<br><br>-- backfill (batch)<br>UPDATE users SET first_name = split_part(name, ' ', 1)<br>WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE first_name IS NULL LIMIT 5000);<br><br>-- NOT NULL'ni uzoq lock'siz<br>ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT first_name_nn CHECK (first_name IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID;<br>ALTER TABLE users VALIDATE CONSTRAINT first_name_nn;     -- faqat SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE<br>ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN first_name SET NOT NULL;  -- PG12+: CHECK bor bo'lsa skan yo'q</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ALTER COLUMN TYPE</code> — butun jadvalni qayta yozadi va lock qiladi.</li><li><code>CREATE INDEX</code> (CONCURRENTLY'siz) — yozuvlarni bloklaydi; CONCURRENTLY tranzaksiya ichida ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>lock_timeout</code> yo'q — DDL lock kutib, orqasidagi hamma so'rovlarni bloklaydi.</li><li>Contract'ni shoshilib qilish — eski versiyaga rollback qilib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har migratsiyani CI'da prod hajmiga yaqin ma'lumotda sinab, lock turini tekshir (<code>pg_locks</code>). Bu jarayon sekin ko'rinadi, lekin zero-downtime va xavfsiz rollback'ning yagona ishonchli yo'li.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 Deploy
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30031	<p>Canary deploy qachon avtomatik rollback qilinishi kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Canary va <b>baseline</b> (bir vaqtda, bir xil sharoitda ishlayotgan eski versiya) <b>taqqoslanganda</b> SLO signallari — xato nisbati, p99 latency, saturation va asosiy biznes metrika (masalan, checkout konversiyasi) — oldindan belgilangan chegaradan yomonlashsa, <b>avtomatik abort</b> va trafik 0% ga qaytariladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Odam canary dashboard'ini 30 daqiqa kuzatolmaydi va qaror sub'ektiv. Mutlaq chegara (&quot;5xx &lt; 1%&quot;) ham chalg'itadi: tunda trafik kam, kunduzi umumiy fon xatolar ko'p — canary aybdormi yoki hamma joyda shundaymi?</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>trafik: 90% stable | 5% baseline (eski) | 5% canary (yangi)<br>har 1 daqiqa analysis:<br>   canary_err / baseline_err  &gt; 1.5 ?<br>   canary_p99 - baseline_p99  &gt; 100ms ?<br>   failureLimit: 2 ta ketma-ket fail -&gt; ABORT -&gt; canary 0%, alert<br>   hammasi OK n marta -&gt; keyingi qadam (25%, 50%, 100%)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Argo Rollouts AnalysisTemplate):</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: AnalysisTemplate<br>metadata: { name: error-rate }<br>spec:<br>  metrics:<br>    - name: error-rate<br>      interval: 1m<br>      failureLimit: 2<br>      successCondition: result[0] &lt; 0.01<br>      provider:<br>        prometheus:<br>          address: http://prometheus:9090<br>          query: |<br>            sum(rate(http_requests_total{app=&quot;api&quot;,version=&quot;{{args.version}}&quot;,code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[2m]))<br>            / sum(rate(http_requests_total{app=&quot;api&quot;,version=&quot;{{args.version}}&quot;}[2m]))</pre><p>Metrikalarda <code>version</code> (yoki <code>rollouts-pod-template-hash</code>) label'i bo'lishi shart — aks holda canary'ni ajratib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik juda kam — statistik ma'nosiz; minimal so'rov soni sharti qo'y.</li><li>Faqat texnik metrika — mantiqiy bug (noto'g'ri narx) 5xx bermaydi; biznes metrika ham kerak.</li><li>Avtomatik rollback, lekin migratsiya orqaga mos emas — rollback ham sindiradi.</li><li>Juda sezgir chegara — har deploy abort, jamoa avtomatikani o'chiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kayenta/Flagger kabi vositalar statistik testlar (Mann-Whitney) bilan baseline taqqoslaydi — mutlaq threshold'dan ishonchliroq. Abort sabablari postmortem'da tahlil qilinsin: false positive'lar ham, real ushlangan bug'lar ham.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30032	<p>Feature flag va deploy ajratilishi nimani beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Feature flag <b>deploy</b> (kodni prod'ga chiqarish) va <b>release</b> (funksiyani foydalanuvchiga yoqish)ni ajratadi. Natijada: soniyalarda rollback (flag'ni o'chirish, deploy'siz), progressiv yoyish (1% -&gt; 100%), A/B test, incident'da kill switch va tugallanmagan kodni main'ga xavfsiz qo'shish (trunk-based).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy = release bo'lsa, har xato uchun to'liq rollback deploy kerak (daqiqalar), tugallanmagan feature uzoq branch'da yashaydi va merge og'riqli bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kod v2 deploy (flag OFF) -&gt; hech kim yangi funksiyani ko'rmaydi<br>flag: ichki xodimlar -&gt; 1% -&gt; 10% -&gt; 50% -&gt; 100%<br>muammo? -&gt; flag OFF (soniyalar) -&gt; deploy kerak emas<br>barqaror -&gt; flag va eski kod yo'li o'chiriladi (tozalash)</pre><p><b>Amalda (OpenFeature, Go):</b></p><pre>client := openfeature.NewClient(&quot;checkout&quot;)<br>newFlow, _ := client.BooleanValue(ctx, &quot;new-checkout&quot;, false,   // xavfsiz default<br>    openfeature.NewEvaluationContext(userID, map[string]any{&quot;country&quot;: &quot;UZ&quot;}))<br>if newFlow {<br>    return newCheckout(ctx, cart)<br>}<br>return legacyCheckout(ctx, cart)</pre><p>Provider: LaunchDarkly, Unleash, Flagsmith, flagd. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30033	<p>Kubernetes'da sirlarni saqlashning eng mustahkam usuli qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng mustahkam variant: secret'lar <b>tashqi secret manager</b>da (Vault, AWS/GCP Secret Manager, KMS bilan shifrlangan), pod ularni <b>workload identity</b> orqali oladi, iloji bo'lsa <b>qisqa TTL dinamik credential</b> (masalan Vault DB engine) yoki <b>Secrets Store CSI</b> bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri volume'ga mount. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30264	<p>Blue-green va canary orasidagi tanlov nimaga bog'liq?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tanlov xavf profili, resurs va kuzatuv imkoniyatiga bog'liq. <b>Blue-green</b> — to'liq ikkinchi muhit, bir zumda almashtirish va tez rollback; lekin 2x resurs va xato birdan hammaga tegadi. <b>Canary</b> — kichik ulush bilan real trafik signalini yig'adi, ta'sir doirasi kichik; lekin metrika va trafikni bo'lish infratuzilmasi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Qaysi biri yaxshiroq?&quot; — umumiy javob yo'q. Ba'zi o'zgarishlar (infra, versiya almashuvi) to'liq almashtirishni talab qiladi, ba'zilarida (yangi algoritm) kichik foizda sinash xavfsizroq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (qaror):</b></p><pre>Real trafiksiz bug topish qiyinmi?        -&gt; canary<br>Ikki versiya bir vaqtda ishlay olmaydi?   -&gt; blue-green (yoki maintenance)<br>Metrika versiya bo'yicha ajratiladimi?    -&gt; yo'q -&gt; canary hali mumkin emas<br>Resurs 2x ga pul bormi?                    -&gt; yo'q -&gt; canary<br>Stateful/queue consumer?                   -&gt; feature flag (trafik bo'linmaydi)</pre><p>| Mezon | Blue-green | Canary | |---|---|---| | Ta'sir doirasi | 100% | 1-10% | | Rollback | bir zumda | bir zumda | | Resurs | 2x | +ozgina | | Kerakli infra | LB/DNS switch | L7 trafik bo'lish, metrika, analysis | | Qachon | infra almashuvi, tez to'liq switch | ko'pchilik ilova relizlari |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Argo Rollouts blue-green<br>strategy:<br>  blueGreen:<br>    activeService: api-active<br>    previewService: api-preview<br>    autoPromotionEnabled: false<br>    prePromotionAnalysis:<br>      templates: [{ templateName: smoke-tests }]</pre><pre>kubectl argo rollouts promote api   # preview -&gt; active<br>kubectl argo rollouts undo api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ikkalasida ham DB sxema ikki versiyaga mos bo'lishi shart (expand-contract).</li><li>Queue consumer'lar trafik ulushi bilan boshqarilmaydi — consumer'lar soni yoki flag.</li><li>Blue-green'da DNS bilan almashtirish — TTL va kesh tufayli &quot;bir zumda&quot; emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoalar gibrid ishlatadi: canary + feature flag. Tanlovdan oldin savol: &quot;metrika bo'yicha avtomatik qaror qila olamizmi?&quot; — yo'q bo'lsa canary faqat sekin blue-green bo'lib qoladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 Deploy
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30265	<p>CI pipeline'da sirlar bilan ishlashda nima majburiy?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Majburiy: <b>qisqa muddatli credential</b> (OIDC federatsiya — CI cloud'ga statik kalitsiz kiradi), secret faqat <b>kerakli job/step'da</b> va himoyalangan branch/environment'da, log'da <b>maskalash</b>, <b>fork PR'larga secret bermaslik</b> (<code>pull_request_target</code> tuzog'i), <b>secret scanning</b> va oldindan tayyor <b>rotatsiya</b> jarayoni.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI — hujumchi uchun eng qimmatli nishon: deploy kalitlari, registry, cloud admin. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30270	<p>Git'da productionga ketgan buzuq commit'ni orqaga qaytarish uchun nima ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git revert &lt;sha&gt;</code> — buzuq commit o'zgarishlarini <b>teskari qiluvchi yangi commit</b> yaratadi; tarix o'zgarmaydi, umumiy branch uchun xavfsiz. Merge commit uchun <code>git revert -m 1 &lt;merge-sha&gt;</code> (1 — asosiy branch ota-onasi). <code>reset --hard</code> + force push umumiy branch'da ishlatilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Buzuq commit <code>main</code> ga tushgan va prod'ga chiqqan; boshqalar allaqachon uning ustiga ishlagan. Tarixni qayta yozish (reset) hammaning lokal nusxasini buzadi va CI/GitOps izini yo'qotadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>main: A---B---X---C          (X buzuq)<br>git revert X:<br>main: A---B---X---C---X'     (X' = X ning teskarisi)<br>tarix saqlanadi, hamma oddiy pull qiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git log --oneline -10<br>git revert abc123                  # bitta commit<br>git revert --no-edit abc123 def456 # bir nechta<br>git revert -m 1 9f8e7d6            # PR merge commit'ini bekor qilish<br>git push origin main               # oddiy push, force yo'q</pre><p>GitOps'da: config repo'dagi image tag o'zgarishini revert qilish — Argo CD avtomatik oldingi versiyani qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Merge commit revert qilingandan keyin o'sha branch'ni qayta merge qilish — Git &quot;allaqachon merge qilingan&quot; deb o'zgarishlarni olib kirmaydi; avval revert'ning revert'i kerak.</li><li>Kod revert qilindi, lekin DB migratsiya allaqachon qo'llangan — eski kod yangi sxema bilan ishlay oladimi? Tekshir.</li><li><code>reset --hard</code> + <code>push --force</code> — hamkasblar ishini yo'qotadi, branch protection buni bloklashi kerak.</li><li>Revert'ni test qilmasdan push — konfliktli revert yangi xato kiritishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Incident paytida eng tez yo'l ko'pincha kod revert emas: feature flag o'chirish yoki oldingi artefaktni qayta deploy qilish. Revert esa main'ni toza holatga qaytarib, keyin tinch tuzatish imkonini beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30271	<p>Regressiya qaysi commit'da paydo bo'lganini topish uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>git bisect</code> — commit'lar oralig'ida ikkilik qidiruv: log2(N) qadamda (1000 commit — ~10 tekshiruv) regressiyani kiritgan birinchi commit'ni topadi. Regressiyani takrorlovchi test skripti bo'lsa, <code>git bisect run ./test.sh</code> uni to'liq avtomatik qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> p99 latency 2 hafta ichida 2x oshdi, oradagi 1000 commit. Kod review yoki <code>git blame</code> bilan qidirish — taxmin. Bisect — deterministik.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. Takrorlash: regressiyani aniq ko'rsatadigan test (exit code bilan)<br>2. Chegaralar: good = v2.3.0 (ishlagan), bad = HEAD<br>3. bisect run: har qadamda o'rtadagi commit'ni build + test<br>4. Natija: &quot;a1b2c3 is the first bad commit&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat &gt; /tmp/regress.sh &lt;&lt;'EOF'<br>#!/bin/sh<br>go build ./... || exit 125                   # build bo'lmasa - skip<br>go test ./internal/search -run XXX -bench BenchmarkQuery -benchtime=2s \<br>  | awk '/BenchmarkQuery/ { exit ($3 &gt; 800000) }'   # ns/op &gt; 0.8ms -&gt; bad<br>EOF<br>chmod +x /tmp/regress.sh<br>git bisect start HEAD v2.3.0<br>git bisect run /tmp/regress.sh<br>git bisect log &gt; bisect.log<br>git bisect reset</pre><p>Exit kodlar: <code>0</code> good, <code>125</code> skip, <code>1-127</code> (125 dan tashqari) bad, <code>128+</code> bisect'ni to'xtatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Test skripti repo ichida — eski commit'larda yo'q yoki boshqacha; uni repo'dan tashqariga (<code>/tmp</code>) qo'y.</li><li>Shovqinli metrika (benchmark) — bir necha marta ishlatib median ol, aks holda noto'g'ri yo'nalish.</li><li><code>git blame</code> — faqat qatorni oxirgi kim o'zgartirganini ko'rsatadi, regressiya sababini emas.</li><li>Merge-heavy tarixda <code>git bisect start --first-parent</code> qaysi PR'ni topish uchun qulayroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bisect'dan keyin topilgan testni regression suite'ga qo'sh — aks holda regressiya qaytadi. Performance regressiyalar uchun CI'da doimiy benchmark tarixi bo'lsa, bisect ko'pincha umuman kerak bo'lmaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30549	<p>Trunk-based development va GitFlow — CI/CD uchun qaysi biri va nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Trunk-based development</b> — hamma qisqa umrli (soatlar-1-2 kun) branch'lardan tez-tez <code>main</code> ga merge qiladi, tugallanmagan ish feature flag ortida; <code>main</code> doim deploy'ga tayyor. Continuous Delivery uchun aynan shu kerak. <b>GitFlow</b> — <code>develop</code>, <code>release/*</code>, <code>hotfix/*</code> kabi uzoq yashovchi branch'lar; rejalashtirilgan, versiyali relizli mahsulotlar (desktop, mobil, on-prem) uchun mos.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> GitFlow'da feature branch'lar haftalab yashaydi, merge og'riqli, <code>develop</code> va <code>main</code> farqlanib ketadi, hotfix'larni ikki joyga qo'shish kerak. Kuniga bir necha deploy qiladigan SaaS uchun bu ortiqcha jarayon.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Trunk-based:<br> main  ----o----o----o----o----o----o----&gt;  (har biri deploy'ga tayyor)<br>            \  /  \  /     \  /<br>          feat-a  fix-b   feat-c   (&lt; 1-2 kun)<br><br>GitFlow:<br> main     ----o-----------------o---------&gt; (release tag'lar)<br> develop  --o---o---o---o---o---o---o-----&gt;<br>              \       /   \<br>            feature/x    release/1.4 -&gt; main</pre><p>| | Trunk-based | GitFlow | |---|---|---| | Branch umri | soatlar-kun | hafta-oy | | Merge konflikti | kichik | katta | | Deploy chastotasi | kuniga ko'p | rejalashtirilgan | | Talab | kuchli testlar, flag | release boshqaruvi | | Mos | SaaS, mikroservis | versiyali mahsulot |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git switch -c feat/search-filter<br># ... kichik o'zgarish, flag ortida<br>git push -u origin feat/search-filter<br>gh pr create --fill<br># CI yashil + review -&gt; squash merge -&gt; main -&gt; CD</pre><p>Branch protection: required checks, kamida 1 review, linear history.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trunk-based'ni kuchli testlarsiz qilish — <code>main</code> doim buzilgan.</li><li>Flag'larsiz trunk-based — tugallanmagan ishni yashirib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>GitFlow'ni SaaS'da ishlatish — release branch'lar CD'ni sekinlashtiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DORA tadqiqotlari trunk-based amaliyotini yuqori samarali jamoalar bilan bog'laydi. Lekin bu natija emas, sabab — kichik partiyalar, tez feedback va avtomatik test; ularsiz faqat branch modelini almashtirish yordam bermaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 Git
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30552	<p>Noldan servis uchun CI/CD pipeline'ni loyihala: commit'dan production'gacha.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pipeline: <b>PR</b> (lint, unit, SAST/SCA, secret scan) -&gt; <b>merge</b> (bir marta build, tag = git SHA, SBOM + imzo, image scan, push) -&gt; <b>staging</b> (GitOps bilan deploy, migratsiya expand, integration/e2e) -&gt; <b>prod</b> (GitOps, canary SLO-analiz, avtomatik rollback) -&gt; <b>kuzatuv</b> (deploy marker'lari, DORA metrikalari). Asosiy tamoyillar: o'zgarmas artefakt, statik secret yo'q, tez rollback, o'lchov.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Qo'lda deploy, har muhitga qayta build, CI'da prod kalitlari, rollback — &quot;eski serverga SSH qilib...&quot; Bu sekin, xavfli va tekshirib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PR ----&gt; lint | unit | SAST | SCA | secret-scan        (&lt; 10 daq, merge gate)<br>merge -&gt; build image (sha) -&gt; SBOM -&gt; cosign sign -&gt; trivy -&gt; push registry<br>      -&gt; config repo: staging tag = sha (avtomatik commit)<br>staging (Argo CD) -&gt; migrate job (expand) -&gt; integration/e2e -&gt; DAST<br>      -&gt; config repo: prod tag = sha (PR / avtomatik promotion)<br>prod (Argo CD + Rollouts) -&gt; canary 5% -&gt; analysis -&gt; 25/50/100% | abort<br>observe -&gt; deploy annotation (Grafana), DORA, alerting</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions qismi):</b></p><pre>on: { push: { branches: [main] } }<br>permissions: { contents: read, packages: write, id-token: write }<br>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6<br>        id: img<br>        with:<br>          push: true<br>          tags: ghcr.io/acme/api:${{ github.sha }}<br>          cache-from: type=gha<br>          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max<br>          sbom: true<br>          provenance: mode=max<br>      - run: cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/acme/api@${{ steps.img.outputs.digest }}<br>      - run: trivy image --exit-code 1 --severity CRITICAL ghcr.io/acme/api@${{ steps.img.outputs.digest }}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har muhitga qayta build — staging'da tekshirilgan prod'ga bormaydi.</li><li>CI'dan <code>kubectl apply</code> prod'ga — klaster kaliti CI'da (GitOps pull afzal).</li><li>Migratsiya orqaga mos emas — canary/rollback ma'nosiz.</li><li>Pipeline sekin (40 daq) — jamoa aylanib o'tish yo'llarini topadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pipeline'ni ham mahsulot sifatida o'lcha: lead time, deploy chastotasi, change failure rate, MTTR. Eng katta qiymat odatda &quot;deploy qilish zerikarli va xavfsiz&quot; bo'lishidan keladi — kichik, tez-tez relizlar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 GitOps
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30553	<p>Docker image'ni <code>latest</code> tegi bilan deploy qilishning muammosi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>latest</code> — <b>o'zgaruvchan (mutable)</b> tag: bugun va ertaga boshqa image'ga ishora qilishi mumkin. Natijada qaysi kod ishlayotgani noma'lum, rollback qiyin (oldingi <code>latest</code> qaysi edi?), node'lar turli vaqtda turli image'ni yuklaydi, K8s pod template o'zgarmagani uchun rollout umuman bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Prod'da incident: &quot;qaysi versiya ishlayapti?&quot; — <code>api:latest</code>. Kecha 3 ta pod eski image bilan, bugun qo'shilgan 2 ta pod yangi image bilan — bir servisda ikki xil kod.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>09:00  push api:latest -&gt; sha256:aaa   (pod-1, pod-2 shu)<br>14:00  push api:latest -&gt; sha256:bbb<br>15:00  HPA pod-3 yaratdi -&gt; imagePullPolicy: Always -&gt; sha256:bbb<br>       =&gt; bitta Deployment'da ikki xil kod<br>Deployment YAML o'zgarmagan -&gt; 'kubectl apply' rollout qilmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda (to'g'ri yo'l):</b></p><pre>docker build -t ghcr.io/acme/api:${GIT_SHA} -t ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2 .<br>docker push ghcr.io/acme/api:${GIT_SHA}<br>crane digest ghcr.io/acme/api:${GIT_SHA}       # sha256:9f1...</pre><pre>containers:<br>  - name: api<br>    image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2@sha256:9f1c...   # o'qish uchun tag + aniqlik uchun digest</pre><p>Ishlayotgan image'ni tekshirish:</p><pre>kubectl get pods -l app=api -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.status.containerStatuses[0].imageID}{&quot;\n&quot;}{end}' | sort | uniq -c</pre><p>| Tag turi | O'zgaruvchanmi | Ishlatish | |---|---|---| | <code>latest</code> | ha | faqat lokal sinov | | semver <code>1.4.2</code> | odatda yo'q (lekin mumkin) | release | | git SHA | yo'q | CI artefakt | | digest <code>@sha256</code> | hech qachon | prod deploy |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Registry'da tag immutability yoqilmagan — <code>1.4.2</code> ham qayta yozilishi mumkin (ECR/Harbor'da yoq).</li><li>Base image'da ham <code>FROM golang:latest</code> — build reproducible emas.</li><li><code>imagePullPolicy: Always</code> + latest — har restart'da kutilmagan yangilanish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Admission policy (Kyverno: &quot;disallow latest tag&quot;, &quot;require digest&quot;) bilan buni majburla. Digest imzo (cosign) bilan birga supply chain zanjirini yopadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 GitOps

Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-33506	<p>SBOM nima? CycloneDX va SPDX, VEX nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>SBOM</b> (Software Bill of Materials) — artefakt ichidagi barcha komponentlar (paketlar, versiyalar, litsenziyalar, hash'lar) ro'yxati. <b>CycloneDX</b> (OWASP) va <b>SPDX</b> (Linux Foundation, ISO standart) — ikki asosiy SBOM formati. <b>VEX</b> (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) — &quot;bu CVE bizning mahsulotga ta'sir qiladimi?&quot; degan bayonot (<code>not_affected</code>, <code>affected</code>, <code>fixed</code>) — skaner shovqinini kamaytiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Log4Shell kabi yangi CVE chiqdi: &quot;qaysi servislarimizda log4j bor?&quot; — SBOM'siz har image'ni qo'lda tekshirish kerak. SBOM bo'lsa — bitta so'rov. Skaner esa 200 CVE ko'rsatadi, ko'pi ishlatilmaydigan kodda — VEX bularni belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build -&gt; image@sha256<br>   v<br>syft -&gt; sbom.json (CycloneDX/SPDX)<br>   v<br>cosign attest -&gt; SBOM image'ga imzolangan attestation sifatida biriktiriladi<br>   v<br>Dependency-Track (markaziy) &lt;- yangi CVE feed<br>   -&gt; &quot;CVE-2025-XXXX: api, billing, auth servislarida&quot; (avtomatik)<br>VEX: &quot;billing: not_affected (vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path)&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>syft ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0 -o cyclonedx-json &gt; sbom.json<br>grype sbom:sbom.json --fail-on high                 # SBOM bo'yicha CVE scan<br>cosign attest --yes --type cyclonedx --predicate sbom.json ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:...<br>cosign verify-attestation --type cyclonedx ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:... \<br>  --certificate-identity-regexp '.*' --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com<br># VEX bilan scan<br>trivy image --vex vex.openvex.json ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0</pre><p>| | CycloneDX | SPDX | |---|---|---| | Kelib chiqishi | OWASP, xavfsizlik fokus | Linux Foundation, litsenziya fokus | | VEX | ichki qo'llab-quvvatlash | alohida (OpenVEX/CSAF) | | Standart | ECMA-424 | ISO/IEC 5962 |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SBOM yaratib, hech qayerda saqlamaslik/tahlil qilmaslik — &quot;qog'oz uchun SBOM&quot;.</li><li>Manba kodi bo'yicha SBOM, lekin image'dagi OS paketlari hisobga olinmagan.</li><li>VEX'ni dalilsiz &quot;not_affected&quot; deb belgilash — xavfni yashirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Regulyatsiya (AQSh EO 14028, EU Cyber Resilience Act) SBOM'ni majburiyatga aylantirmoqda. Haqiqiy qiymat — inventarizatsiya: yangi CVE chiqqanda &quot;ta'sir qiladimi?&quot; savoliga daqiqalarda javob berish.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD

Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-33508	<p>Tekton nima va GitHub Actions/GitLab CI'dan farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tekton — Kubernetes-native CI/CD <b>framework</b>: pipeline'lar K8s CRD'lari (<code>Task</code>, <code>Pipeline</code>, <code>PipelineRun</code>) sifatida yoziladi va har step o'z klasteringizda alohida konteyner/pod'da ishlaydi. GitHub Actions/GitLab CI — tayyor <b>mahsulot</b> (UI, runner'lar, integratsiyalar); Tekton — undan platforma quriladigan qurilish bloklari.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Air-gapped yoki on-prem muhitda SaaS CI ishlatib bo'lmaydi; platforma jamoasi ko'p jamoaga yagona, K8s'da ishlaydigan, kengaytiriladigan CI bermoqchi. Tekton shu poydevorni beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Task      = qadamlar ketma-ketligi (har step = konteyner, bitta pod ichida)<br>Pipeline  = Task'lar grafi (runAfter, workspaces, params)<br>PipelineRun = Pipeline'ning bitta ishga tushishi<br>Triggers  = webhook -&gt; EventListener -&gt; PipelineRun yaratadi<br>Chains    = natijalarni imzolaydi, SLSA provenance</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1<br>kind: Task<br>metadata: { name: go-test }<br>spec:<br>  workspaces: [{ name: src }]<br>  steps:<br>    - name: test<br>      image: golang:1.23<br>      workingDir: $(workspaces.src.path)<br>      script: |<br>        go test ./...<br>---<br>apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1<br>kind: PipelineRun<br>metadata: { generateName: ci- }<br>spec:<br>  pipelineRef: { name: build-and-test }<br>  workspaces:<br>    - name: src<br>      volumeClaimTemplate:<br>        spec: { accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce], resources: { requests: { storage: 1Gi } } }</pre><pre>tkn pipelinerun list<br>tkn pipelinerun logs -f ci-x7k2p</pre><p>| | Tekton | GitHub Actions / GitLab CI | |---|---|---| | Ishlash joyi | o'z K8s klasteringiz | hosted yoki self-hosted runner | | UI | minimal (Dashboard) | boy | | Moslashuvchanlik | juda yuqori | mahsulot chegarasida | | Operatsiya | siz | asosan vendor | | Supply chain | Tekton Chains (SLSA) | artifact attestations |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>YAML hajmi katta — oddiy pipeline uchun ham ko'p boilerplate.</li><li>Workspace PVC'lar to'planadi — pruner sozla.</li><li>Dasturchi tajribasi (UI, log'lar) tayyor CI'dan ancha past — ustiga portal kerak bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tekton — CI qurish uchun, CI ishlatish uchun emas. Tayyor CI talablarni qoplasa, uni tanla. Tekton OpenShift Pipelines va boshqa platformalar ichida ishlatiladi; Tekton Chains SLSA L3 talab qilinadigan joylarda kuchli argument.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD

Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30034	<p>CI 40 daqiqa ketadi, jamoa relizdan qo'rqadi. Qanday tuzatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval <b>o'lchash</b> (qaysi qadam qancha vaqt oladi), keyin eng katta yutuqlardan boshlash: <b>kesh</b> (dependency, build, Docker layer), <b>parallellik va sharding</b>, <b>test piramidasini to'g'irlash</b> (ko'p unit, kam e2e), <b>affected-only</b> build, flaky testlarni karantin.
