Object storage — o'z versioning/replikatsiyasi bilan alohida. Har chorak: staging'ga to'liq tiklash va vaqtni o'lchash (RTO).</p><p><b>Upgrade:</b></p><ul><li>Required upgrade stops (masalan 16.3 -&gt; 16.7 -&gt; 16.11 -&gt; 17.x) — sakrab o'tib bo'lmaydi; <code>gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/blob/master/doc/update</code> dagi upgrade path tool.</li><li>Background migration'lar tugashini kut (Admin -&gt; Monitoring -&gt; Background migrations).</li><li>Avval staging, keyin prod; zero-downtime faqat multi-node'da.</li></ul><p><b>Runner tomoni:</b></p><ul><li>Autoscaling (kubernetes / docker-autoscaler), bir nechta AZ.</li><li>Ko'p runner GitLab API'ni poll qiladi — <code>check_interval</code> va runner soni muvozanati; Workhorse long polling yoqiq.</li><li>Runner versiyasi GitLab versiyasiga mos (major.minor).</li></ul><p><b>Monitoring:</b></p><pre>sum(sidekiq_queue_size)                         # fon ish navbati<br>histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(gitlab_runner_job_queue_duration_seconds_bucket[10m]))<br>rate(http_requests_total{status=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m])   # Puma 5xx</pre><p>Gitaly latency, PostgreSQL replikatsiya lag, disk bo'sh joyi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Artifact va registry lokal diskda — disk to'ladi, node yiqiladi.</li><li>Backup bor, lekin hech qachon tiklanmagan — <code>gitlab-secrets.json</code> yo'qligi tiklashda aniqlanadi.</li><li>Bir necha versiyani sakrab upgrade — migratsiya xatosi, DB buzilishi.</li><li>Gitaly NFS ustida — qo'llab-quvvatlanmaydi va sekin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Self-managed GitLab — kritik production servis (butun muhandislik to'xtaydi). Unga SLO, on-call va DR rejasi ber; ops yuki katta bo'lsa GitLab Dedicated/SaaS narxini halol solishtir.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i9 GitLab_CI
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32030	<p>Jenkins nima? Controller va agent arxitekturasi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Jenkins — open-source, self-hosted CI/CD server (Java). <b>Controller</b> — UI, job konfiguratsiyasi, navbat, plugin'lar va build'larni rejalashtirish. <b>Agent</b> — build'larni haqiqatda bajaradigan mashina/konteyner. Controller ish taqsimlaydi, agent ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hamma build controller'da ishlasa: bitta og'ir build UI'ni sekinlashtiradi, zararli <code>Jenkinsfile</code> controller'dagi barcha secret va konfiguratsiyaga kira oladi, turli muhitlar (Linux, Windows, GPU) kerak bo'lsa bitta mashina yetmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>+-------------------+   SSH (controller ulanadi)   +-----------+<br>| Controller        | ---------------------------&gt; | Agent 1   |<br>|  UI, queue, cron  |                              | linux     |<br>|  plugins, creds   |   inbound/WebSocket          +-----------+<br>|  executors = 0    | &lt;--------------------------- | Agent 2   |<br>+-------------------+   (agent ulanadi)            | K8s pod   |<br>        |                                          +-----------+<br>   JENKINS_HOME (job, build tarixi, config)</pre><p>Executor — agent'dagi parallel build slot'i.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d -p 8080:8080 -v jenkins_home:/var/jenkins_home jenkins/jenkins:lts-jdk21<br>docker exec &lt;id&gt; cat /var/jenkins_home/secrets/initialAdminPassword</pre><p>Inbound agent ulash:</p><pre>java -jar agent.jar -url https://ci.acme.uz/ -secret &lt;secret&gt; -name linux-1 -webSocket -workDir /home/jenkins</pre><p>Manage Jenkins -&gt; Nodes: controller'ning &quot;Number of executors&quot; = 0.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Controller'da build ishlatish — xavfsizlik teshigi va beqarorlik.</li><li>Qo'lda sozlangan &quot;snowflake&quot; agent'lar — tiklab bo'lmaydi; Docker/K8s agent ishlat.</li><li>Plugin'larni o'ylamasdan o'rnatish — ko'p CVE va upgrade muammolari shulardan.</li><li><code>JENKINS_HOME</code> backup qilinmagan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jenkins'ning kuchi (1800+ plugin, to'liq nazorat) ayni paytda uning operatsion yuki. OSS'da HA yo'q — tez tiklanish uchun controller'ni immutable image + JCasC + backup bilan qur.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32031	<p>Freestyle job va Pipeline farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Freestyle job</b> — UI'da formalar orqali sozlanadigan eski uslubdagi job: konfiguratsiya Jenkins ichida, Git'da emas. <b>Pipeline</b> — butun jarayon <code>Jenkinsfile</code> kodida, repo bilan birga versiyalanadi va review qilinadi. Yangi ishlar uchun faqat Pipeline.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Freestyle'da kimdir build qadamini UI'da o'zgartirdi — kim, qachon, nega? Tarix yo'q. Build -&gt; test -&gt; tasdiq -&gt; deploy oqimi, parallel qadamlar, qayta urinish — Freestyle'da qiyin yoki umuman mumkin emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | | Freestyle | Pipeline | |---|---|---| | Konfig | UI (XML, JENKINS_HOME'da) | <code>Jenkinsfile</code> repo'da | | Review/tarix | yo'q | PR, git log | | Oqim | ketma-ket qadamlar | stage, parallel, input, retry | | Restart'ga chidamlilik | yo'q | durable (davom ettira oladi) | | Branch/PR | qo'lda | Multibranch: avtomatik |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// Jenkinsfile (repo ildizida)<br>pipeline {<br>  agent any<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Build') { steps { sh 'make build' } }<br>    stage('Test')  { steps { sh 'make test' } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Jenkins'da: New Item -&gt; <b>Multibranch Pipeline</b> -&gt; Git repo URL. Jenkins har branch va PR uchun <code>Jenkinsfile</code> ni topib alohida job yaratadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pipeline'ni &quot;Pipeline script&quot; maydoniga UI'da yozish — Freestyle'ning muammosini qaytaradi; &quot;Pipeline script from SCM&quot; ishlat.</li><li>Hamma logikani Groovy'ga yozish — <code>sh 'make ...'</code> ga chiqarish yaxshiroq (lokal ham ishlaydi).</li><li>Eski Freestyle job'larni hech kim o'chirmaydi — inventarizatsiya qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pipeline-as-Code CI konfiguratsiyasini kod bilan bir xil sifat nazoratiga olib kiradi. Logikani Makefile/skriptlarga chiqarish keyinchalik boshqa CI'ga ko'chishni ham arzonlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32032	<p>Declarative Jenkinsfile tuzilmasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Declarative Jenkinsfile <code>pipeline { }</code> bloki ichida qat'iy tuzilmaga ega: <code>agent</code> (qayerda ishlaydi), <code>environment</code>, <code>options</code>, <code>parameters</code>, <code>triggers</code>, <code>stages { stage { steps } }</code> (nima qiladi) va <code>post</code> (natijaga qarab yakuniy amallar).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Erkin Groovy (Scripted) kodi har jamoada har xil yoziladi va o'qish qiyin. Declarative sintaksis tuzilmani majburlaydi, validatsiya qiladi va UI'da stage'larni chiroyli ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pipeline<br> +- agent        (global yoki stage darajasida)<br> +- environment  (env o'zgaruvchilar)<br> +- options      (timeout, buildDiscarder ...)<br> +- parameters / triggers<br> +- stages<br> |    +- stage('Build') { steps { ... } }<br> |    +- stage('Test')  { when {...}; steps { ... } }<br> +- post { always / success / failure / unstable / changed / cleanup }</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent { label 'linux' }<br>  environment { CGO_ENABLED = '0' }<br>  options { timeout(time: 20, unit: 'MINUTES'); timestamps() }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Build') { steps { sh 'go build ./...' } }<br>    stage('Test') {<br>      steps { sh 'gotestsum --junitfile report.xml ./...' }<br>    }<br>    stage('Deploy') {<br>      when { branch 'main' }<br>      steps { sh './deploy.sh' }<br>    }<br>  }<br>  post {<br>    always  { junit 'report.xml' }<br>    failure { echo &quot;Build ${env.BUILD_NUMBER} yiqildi&quot; }<br>    cleanup { cleanWs() }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Tekshirish: Jenkins'dagi &quot;Pipeline Syntax&quot; -&gt; Declarative Directive Generator, yoki lint:</p><pre>curl -X POST -F &quot;jenkinsfile=&lt;Jenkinsfile&quot; https://ci.acme.uz/pipeline-model-converter/validate</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>steps</code> ichida Groovy logika (if, loop) — <code>script { }</code> bloki kerak, ko'payib ketsa signal.</li><li><code>post { cleanup }</code> boshqa <code>post</code> shartlaridan keyin ishlaydi — tozalashni shu yerga qo'y.</li><li><code>environment</code> ichida secret'ni ochiq yozish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jenkinsfile — orkestratsiya, logika emas. Qadamlar <code>make</code>/skriptlarda bo'lsa, ularni lokal ham ishlatib bo'ladi va CI almashtirish arzon.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32033	<p>Jenkins'da credential qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secret'lar Jenkins <b>Credentials</b> store'ida (yoki tashqi Vault) saqlanadi va pipeline'ga ID orqali beriladi: <code>environment { X = credentials('id') }</code> yoki <code>withCredentials([...]) { }</code>. Jenkins log'da qiymatni <code>**<b></code> bilan maskalaydi. Shell'ga secret </b>bitta qo'shtirnoqli** Groovy satr bilan beriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Parolni <code>Jenkinsfile</code> ga yozish — u Git'da hammaga ko'rinadi. Credential store secret'ni koddan ajratadi va kim ishlatishini scope bilan cheklaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Credentials (Global / Folder scope)<br>  id: registry-creds  (username+password)<br>  id: api-token       (secret text)<br>     v<br>withCredentials -&gt; env var faqat blok ichida mavjud -&gt; log'da ****</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent any<br>  environment {<br>    REG = credentials('registry-creds')   // REG_USR va REG_PSW avtomatik<br>  }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Push') {<br>      steps {<br>        sh 'echo &quot;$REG_PSW&quot; | docker login -u &quot;$REG_USR&quot; --password-stdin ghcr.io'<br>        withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'api-token', variable: 'TOKEN')]) {<br>          sh 'curl -sf -H &quot;Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN&quot; https://api.acme.uz/deploy'<br>        }<br>      }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Fayl turidagi credential: <code>file(credentialsId: 'kubeconfig', variable: 'KUBECONFIG')</code>.</p><p><b>Eng muhim tuzoq — qo'shtirnoq:</b></p><pre>sh &quot;curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' ...&quot;   // YOMON: Groovy interpolation<br>sh 'curl -H &quot;Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN&quot; ...'     // TO'G'RI: shell o'zi o'qiydi</pre><p>Ikki qo'shtirnoqda secret Groovy tomonidan satrga qo'yiladi va jarayon argumentlariga (<code>ps</code>) tushadi; Jenkins ham bu haqda ogohlantiradi.</p><p><b>Boshqa tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>set -x</code> yoki <code>echo $TOKEN | base64</code> — maskalash ishlamaydi.</li><li>Global scope credential'ni har job ishlata oladi — folder scope ishlat.</li><li>Uzoq muddatli statik kalitlar — OIDC/Vault qisqa TTL token'larga o'tish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maskalash — xavfsizlik chegarasi emas: build'da kod ishlatish huquqi bor odam secret'ni chiqarib oladi. Shuning uchun prod credential'lar faqat himoyalangan branch job'lariga berilsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32034	<p>Build trigger turlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy trigger'lar: <b>webhook</b> (push/PR bo'lganda Git server Jenkins'ni chaqiradi — eng yaxshisi), <b>pollSCM</b> (Jenkins o'zi vaqti-vaqti bilan repo'ni tekshiradi), <b>cron</b> (jadval bo'yicha), <b>upstream</b> (boshqa job tugagach), <b>qo'lda</b> (parametrlar bilan &quot;Build with Parameters&quot;).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Build kodni o'zgartirgan zahoti boshlanishi kerak. Polling har 5 daqiqada yuzlab repo'ni tekshirib Git serverni yuklaydi va kechikish beradi; webhook darhol va arzon.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>push -&gt; GitHub webhook -&gt; Jenkins (/github-webhook/) -&gt; job start   (soniyalar)<br>pollSCM: har 5 daqiqa -&gt; git ls-remote -&gt; o'zgarish bormi? -&gt; start (kechikish)<br>cron:    'H 3 * * *' -&gt; har kecha ~03:xx -&gt; start</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent any<br>  triggers {<br>    cron('H 3 * * *')                       // tungi to'liq test<br>    upstream(upstreamProjects: 'lib-build', threshold: hudson.model.Result.SUCCESS)<br>  }<br>  parameters {<br>    choice(name: 'ENV', choices: ['stg', 'prod'], description: 'Qaysi muhit')<br>    booleanParam(name: 'DRY_RUN', defaultValue: true)<br>  }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Deploy') { steps { sh &quot;./deploy.sh ${params.ENV}&quot; } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Multibranch job'da webhook GitHub Branch Source plugin orqali avtomatik ishlaydi.</p><p><b><code>H</code> belgisi:</b> job nomidan hash olib vaqtni tarqatadi: <code>H 3 * * *</code> — 03:00-03:59 orasidagi barqaror daqiqa. Hamma job 00:00 da birdaniga yugurmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>0 0 * * *</code> hamma job'da — yarim tunda agent'lar uchun navbat bo'roni.</li><li>Parametrlar birinchi build'dan keyin ko'rinadi (Jenkinsfile o'qilgandan keyin).</li><li>Parametrni shell'ga tekshirmasdan qo'yish — injection (<code>${params.X}</code> ichida <code>; rm -rf</code>); qiymatni validatsiya qil.</li><li>Jenkins internetdan yopiq — webhook yetmaydi; relay yoki polling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Webhook + kam chastotali &quot;xavfsizlik&quot; polling (soatiga) — yo'qolgan webhook'larni ushlash uchun yaxshi kombinatsiya.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33053	<p>Declarative pipeline'da <code>agent any</code>, <code>agent none</code>, <code>label</code>, <code>docker</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>agent any</code> — istalgan bo'sh agent'da ishlaydi. <code>agent none</code> — global agent yo'q, har stage o'zinikini oladi. <code>agent { label 'x' }</code> — shu label'li agent'da. <code>agent { docker { image '...' } }</code> — agent ichida berilgan image'dan konteyner ochib, qadamlarni o'sha yerda bajaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Build uchun Go 1.23 kerak, deploy uchun kubectl va prod tarmoq'ga kirishli agent kerak. Bitta agent hammasini qilsa — u katta, xavfli va tiklash qiyin bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>agent none (global)<br>  stage Build  -&gt; docker golang:1.23   (toza, versiyasi aniq)<br>  stage Approve-&gt; agent yo'q           (input kutayotganda executor band emas)<br>  stage Deploy -&gt; label 'deploy'       (prod tarmoq'ga kirishi bor agent)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent none<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Build') {<br>      agent { docker { image 'golang:1.23'; args '-v go-cache:/root/.cache/go-build' } }<br>      steps { sh 'go build ./...' }<br>    }<br>    stage('Approve') {<br>      steps { input message: 'Prod ga deploy?' }<br>    }<br>    stage('Deploy') {<br>      agent { label 'deploy' }<br>      steps { sh './deploy.sh' }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><code>docker</code> agent uchun agent'da Docker va Docker Pipeline plugin kerak. K8s'da — <code>agent { kubernetes { ... } }</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Global <code>agent any</code> + <code>input</code> — tasdiq kutgan soatlar davomida executor band.</li><li>Stage'lar turli agent'da — workspace umumiy emas; fayllarni <code>stash/unstash</code> yoki artifact orqali o'tkazish kerak.</li><li><code>agent any</code> controller'ga ham tushishi mumkin (agar executor bo'lsa).</li><li><code>docker</code> agent'da image <code>:latest</code> — reproducible emas; tag yoki digest pin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Deploy agent'lari alohida label va cheklangan ruxsat bilan bo'lsin; har qanday PR build'i <code>label 'deploy'</code> so'rab prod'ga kirmasligi uchun Job Restrictions yoki K8s pod template'larini cheklash kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33054	<p>Workspace nima va uni qanday tozalaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Workspace — agent diskidagi job uchun ish papkasi: kod checkout qilinadi, build fayllari shu yerda paydo bo'ladi. Default holatda build'lar orasida <b>saqlanib qoladi</b>. Tozalash: <code>cleanWs()</code> (Workspace Cleanup plugin) <code>post { cleanup }</code> ichida, yoki <code>deleteDir()</code>, yoki ephemeral agent ishlatish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oldingi build'dan qolgan fayllar keyingisini buzadi (&quot;menda ishladi&quot;), va yuzlab job'ning workspace'lari agent diskini to'ldiradi — build'lar &quot;No space left on device&quot; bilan yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/home/jenkins/workspace/<br>   api_main/          &lt;- job workspace<br>   api_main@2/        &lt;- bir vaqtda ikkinchi build<br>   api_main@tmp/      &lt;- vaqtinchalik (secret fayllar, skriptlar)<br>   api_PR-42/</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent any<br>  options { skipDefaultCheckout(false) }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Build') { steps { sh 'make' } }<br>  }<br>  post {<br>    cleanup { cleanWs(deleteDirs: true, notFailBuild: true) }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Agent'da diskni tekshirish:</p><pre>du -sh /home/jenkins/workspace/* | sort -h | tail<br>df -h /home/jenkins</pre><p>Manage Jenkins -&gt; Nodes'da &quot;Free Disk Space&quot; monitor chegarasini sozla — disk kamaysa agent avtomatik offline bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>cleanWs()</code> ni <code>steps</code> oxiriga qo'yish — build fail bo'lsa ishlamaydi; <code>post { cleanup }</code> kerak.</li><li>Hamma narsani tozalash keshni ham o'chiradi (go mod cache, node_modules) — build sekinlashadi; keshni workspace'dan tashqarida saqla.</li><li><code>@tmp</code> papkalari ham to'planadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng toza yechim — har build uchun yangi K8s pod/konteyner agent: workspace pod bilan birga yo'qoladi, &quot;snowflake&quot; muammo yo'q. Tezlik uchun kesh alohida (PVC yoki remote cache) boshqariladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33055	<p><code>options</code> blokida nimalar sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>options</code> — pipeline'ning xulq sozlamalari: <code>timeout</code> (osilib qolishga qarshi), <code>buildDiscarder</code> (eski build'larni o'chirish), <code>disableConcurrentBuilds</code> (parallel ishlamasin), <code>timestamps</code>, <code>retry</code>, <code>skipDefaultCheckout</code>, <code>quietPeriod</code>, <code>durabilityHint</code>. Stage darajasida ham ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Osilgan test cheksiz executor egallaydi; har build'ning log va artifact'lari yillab to'planib <code>JENKINS_HOME</code> ni to'ldiradi; bitta branch'da ikki deploy bir vaqtda ishlab bir-birini buzadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent any<br>  options {<br>    timeout(time: 30, unit: 'MINUTES')               // butun pipeline<br>    buildDiscarder(logRotator(numToKeepStr: '20', artifactNumToKeepStr: '5'))<br>    disableConcurrentBuilds(abortPrevious: true)     // yangi push eskisini to'xtatadi<br>    timestamps()                                     // log qatorlarida vaqt<br>    skipStagesAfterUnstable()<br>  }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Flaky integration') {<br>      options { retry(2); timeout(time: 10, unit: 'MINUTES') }<br>      steps { sh 'make itest' }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>| Option | Nima uchun | |---|---| | timeout | osilgan build executor'ni bo'shatadi | | buildDiscarder | disk o'sishini cheklaydi | | disableConcurrentBuilds | deploy race'ga qarshi | | retry | flaky tashqi bog'liqlik | | durabilityHint('PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZED') | disk I/O kamayadi, crash'da resume yo'q |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>buildDiscarder</code> yo'q — controller diski asta-sekin to'ladi (eng keng tarqalgan muammo).</li><li><code>retry</code> bilan flaky testlarni yashirish — sababini tuzatmaslik.</li><li><code>abortPrevious: true</code> deploy job'da — yarim deploy qilingan holat qolishi mumkin; deploy uchun <code>lock</code> yaxshiroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu default'larni har jamoa o'zi yozmasin — Shared Library'dagi umumiy pipeline yoki global sozlama orqali majburlang (masalan, global timeout va discarder).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33056	<p><code>archiveArtifacts</code> va <code>junit</code> nima uchun ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>junit</code> — test natijalarini (JUnit XML) o'qib, Jenkins'da test trendlari, yiqilgan testlar ro'yxatini ko'rsatadi va fail bo'lsa build'ni <b>UNSTABLE</b> qiladi. <code>archiveArtifacts</code> — build mahsulotlarini (binary, hisobot) Jenkins'da saqlab, keyin yuklab olishga imkon beradi; <code>fingerprint: true</code> — fayl qaysi build'dan chiqqanini kuzatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Test yiqilganda 5000 qatorli log'dan qaysi test ekanini qidirish — vaqt isrofi. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32035	<p>Multibranch Pipeline va Organization Folder qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Multibranch Pipeline</b> — bitta repo'ni skanerlab, <code>Jenkinsfile</code> bor har branch va PR uchun avtomatik alohida job yaratadi; branch o'chsa job ham o'chadi. <b>Organization Folder</b> — bir daraja yuqori: butun GitHub org/GitLab group'ni skanerlab, har repo uchun Multibranch job yaratadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 50 ta repo, har birida o'nlab branch — har biriga qo'lda job yaratish imkonsiz. Organization Folder yangi repo'lar uchun &quot;standart CI&quot; ni bepul beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32036	<p>Shared Library nima va qanday versiyalanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shared Library — ko'p <code>Jenkinsfile</code> lar qayta ishlatadigan Groovy kodi alohida Git repo'da: <code>vars/</code> (global step'lar, masalan <code>goPipeline()</code>), <code>src/</code> (Groovy klasslar), <code>resources/</code> (shablon fayllar). Versiya <code>@Library('lib@v1.4.0')</code> bilan <b>tag'ga pin</b> qilinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 100 ta repo'da bir xil 80 qatorli Jenkinsfile. Bitta o'zgarish (masalan, yangi security scan) uchun 100 ta PR kerak. Library umumiy pipeline'ni bitta joyda saqlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>platform-lib (git, tag v1.4.0)<br>  vars/goPipeline.groovy        -&gt; goPipeline(service: 'billing')<br>  src/org/acme/Utils.groovy     -&gt; import org.acme.Utils<br>  resources/templates/helm.yaml -&gt; libraryResource('templates/helm.yaml')<br><br>billing/Jenkinsfile:<br>  @Library('platform-lib@v1.4.0') _<br>  goPipeline(service: 'billing')</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// vars/goPipeline.groovy<br>def call(Map cfg) {<br>  pipeline {<br>    agent { label 'linux' }<br>    options { timeout(time: 30, unit: 'MINUTES') }<br>    stages {<br>      stage('Test')  { steps { sh 'go test ./...' } }<br>      stage('Image') { steps { sh &quot;docker build -t ghcr.io/acme/${cfg.service}:${env.GIT_COMMIT} .&quot; } }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Manage Jenkins -&gt; System -&gt; Global Trusted Pipeline Libraries: nom, Git URL, default version.</p><p><b>Versiyalash:</b></p><ul><li>SemVer tag (<code>v1.4.0</code>), breaking change — major.</li><li>Jamoalar yangi versiyaga o'zi o'tadi (Renovate PR ochishi mumkin).</li><li>Library'ni test qilish: JenkinsPipelineUnit bilan unit test va test-repo'da integratsion run.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>@Library('lib@main')</code> — library'dagi bitta xato commit hamma pipeline'ni darhol sindiradi.</li><li><b>Global trusted</b> library sandbox'siz ishlaydi — u yerga yozish huquqi = controller'da kod ishlatish. Faqat platforma jamoasi yozsin.</li><li>Juda &quot;aqlli&quot; library — hech kim tushunmaydi va debug qilolmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Library'ni ichki mahsulot sifatida yurit: changelog, deprecation siklida, migration guide. Logikaning katta qismini Groovy emas, konteyner ichidagi CLI vositalariga qo'yish — test qilish oson va CI'dan mustaqil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32037	<p><code>parallel</code> va <code>stash/unstash</code> qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>parallel</code> — mustaqil stage'larni bir vaqtda (ko'pincha turli agent'larda) ishlatib pipeline vaqtini qisqartiradi. <code>stash/unstash</code> — kichik fayllarni (build natijasi) bir agent'dan boshqasiga <b>shu build ichida</b> o'tkazish: stash controller orqali saqlanadi, unstash boshqa agent'ga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Unit (5 daq), e2e (15 daq), lint (2 daq) ketma-ket — 22 daqiqa. Parallel — 15 daqiqa. Lekin parallel stage'lar boshqa agent'larda — build qilingan binary u yerda yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Build (agent A) -&gt; stash 'bin' --&gt; controller<br>                                      |<br>          +---------------------------+---------------+<br>          v                           v               v<br>   unit (agent B)              e2e (agent C)     lint (agent D)<br>   unstash 'bin'               unstash 'bin'</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stage('Build') {<br>  steps {<br>    sh 'make build'<br>    stash name: 'bin', includes: 'dist/**'<br>  }<br>}<br>stage('Tests') {<br>  failFast true<br>  parallel {<br>    stage('unit') { agent { label 'linux' }; steps { unstash 'bin'; sh 'make unit' } }<br>    stage('e2e')  { agent { label 'linux' }; steps { unstash 'bin'; sh 'make e2e' } }<br>    stage('lint') { agent { label 'linux' }; steps { sh 'make lint' } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><code>failFast true</code> — bittasi yiqilsa qolganlari to'xtatiladi (resurs tejaladi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta stash (yuzlab MB, <code>node_modules</code>) — controller orqali o'tadi, sekin va controller'ni yuklaydi. Katta narsalar uchun artifact repo (S3/Nexus) yoki konteyner image.</li><li>Stash faqat shu build ichida — build'lar orasida kesh emas.</li><li>Parallel stage'lar bitta agent'da bitta workspace'ni bo'lishsa — fayllar to'qnashadi.</li><li>Agent yetarli bo'lmasa parallel stage'lar navbatda kutadi — tezlik bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Parallelizmdan oldin eng sekin qadamni o'lcha (Stage View / Blue Ocean vaqtlari). Ko'pincha keshni to'g'irlash (dependency, Docker layer) parallelizmdan ko'proq tejaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32038	<p>Kubernetes plugin bilan dinamik agent'lar qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes plugin har build uchun K8s'da <b>vaqtinchalik pod</b> yaratadi: unda avtomatik qo'shiladigan <code>jnlp</code> konteyner (controller bilan aloqa) va siz ko'rsatgan tool konteynerlari (go, docker, kubectl) bo'ladi. Build tugagach pod o'chiriladi. <code>container('go') { sh ... }</code> qadamni kerakli konteynerda bajaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Doimiy VM agent'lar: qo'lda o'rnatilgan tool'lar, eski build qoldiqlari, bo'sh turganda ham pul. Dinamik agent'lar toza muhit va yuklamaga qarab skaleni beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build navbatda -&gt; plugin K8s API: pod yarat<br>  pod:<br>   +- jnlp   (jenkins/inbound-agent) -&gt; WebSocket -&gt; controller<br>   +- go     (golang:1.23, sleep infinity)<br>   +- kaniko (image build, privileged'siz)<br>  umumiy volume: /home/jenkins/agent (workspace)<br>build tugadi -&gt; pod o'chiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent {<br>    kubernetes {<br>      yaml '''<br>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Pod<br>spec:<br>  serviceAccountName: ci-build<br>  containers:<br>  - name: go<br>    image: golang:1.23<br>    command: [sleep]<br>    args: [infinity]<br>    resources: { requests: { cpu: &quot;1&quot;, memory: 2Gi } }<br>    volumeMounts: [{ name: gocache, mountPath: /root/.cache }]<br>  volumes:<br>  - name: gocache<br>    persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: go-cache }<br>'''<br>    }<br>  }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Test') { steps { container('go') { sh 'go test ./...' } } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>kubectl get pods -n ci -w      # build paytida pod paydo bo'ladi va yo'qoladi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konteynerda <code>command: sleep infinity</code> yo'q — konteyner darhol chiqadi.</li><li>Docker-in-Docker yoki <code>docker.sock</code> mount — klaster xavfsizligini buzadi; Kaniko/BuildKit rootless ishlat.</li><li>Pod start vaqti (image pull) — har build +20-60s; image'larni kichik va node'da keshlangan qil.</li><li>Kesh yo'q — har safar <code>go mod download</code>; PVC yoki proxy repo kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI pod'larini alohida namespace/node pool'da, cheklangan ServiceAccount va NetworkPolicy bilan ishlat — CI kodi ishonchsiz kod hisoblanadi. Resurs request'lari aniq bo'lsin, aks holda build'lar bir-birini bo'g'adi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32039	<p><code>input</code> step va manual approval'ning gotcha'si?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>input</code> — pipeline'ni to'xtatib, odamdan tasdiq (yoki parametr) kutadi; <code>submitter</code> kim tasdiqlay olishini cheklaydi. Asosiy gotcha'lar: (1) global agent bilan <code>input</code> kutish paytida <b>executor band</b> bo'ladi; (2) <code>timeout</code> bo'lmasa build kunlab osilib turadi; (3) tasdiqlanganda kod allaqachon eskirgan bo'lishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Prod deploy oldidan release manager tasdiqi kerak. Lekin tasdiq 3 soat kutsa va shu vaqt agent band tursa — boshqa build'lar navbatda qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Build -&gt; Test -&gt; [Approve: input kutadi]  -- agent yo'q, faqat controller'da yengil kutish<br>                       | tasdiq (release-managers) yoki timeout -&gt; ABORTED<br>                       v<br>                 Deploy (agent 'deploy')</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent none<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Build') { agent any; steps { sh 'make' } }<br>    stage('Approve') {<br>      options { timeout(time: 1, unit: 'HOURS') }<br>      input {<br>        message 'Prod ga deploy qilinsinmi?'<br>        ok 'Deploy'<br>        submitter 'release-managers'<br>        parameters { string(name: 'REASON', description: 'Sabab / ticket') }<br>      }<br>      steps { echo &quot;Tasdiqladi, sabab: ${REASON}&quot; }<br>    }<br>    stage('Deploy') {<br>      agent { label 'deploy' }<br>      steps { sh './deploy.sh prod' }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Stage darajasidagi <code>input</code> direktivasi agent ajratilishidan <b>oldin</b> ishlaydi — executor band bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>steps { input ... }</code> global <code>agent any</code> ichida — executor soatlab band.</li><li><code>timeout</code> yo'q — osilgan build'lar va <code>lock</code>lar to'planadi.</li><li><code>submitter</code> yo'q — job'ni ko'ra oladigan har kim tasdiqlaydi.</li><li>Uzoq kutishdan keyin eski build deploy bo'ladi — oldinroq yangi build o'tgan bo'lishi mumkin; <code>milestone</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qo'lda tasdiq — eng sekin va ko'pincha &quot;rubber stamp&quot; nazorat. Yaxshiroq: avtomatik gate'lar (testlar, SLO-asosli canary) va tasdiqni faqat haqiqiy xavfli o'zgarishlar uchun qoldirish; audit uchun kim tasdiqlaganini saqlash.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33057	<p><code>when</code> direktivasi bilan qanday shartlar yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>when</code> — stage qachon ishlashini belgilaydi. Shartlar: <code>branch</code>, <code>tag</code>, <code>changeRequest()</code> (PR), <code>changeset</code> (qaysi fayllar o'zgardi), <code>environment</code>, <code>expression { }</code> (Groovy), <code>buildingTag()</code>, va ularni birlashtiruvchi <code>allOf</code>, <code>anyOf</code>, <code>not</code>. <code>beforeAgent true</code> — shartni agent ajratishdan <b>oldin</b> tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Monorepo'da <code>billing</code> o'zgarmagan bo'lsa uni deploy qilish shart emas; PR'da deploy bo'lmasin; release faqat tag'da. Bularni <code>if</code> bilan yozish Declarative'da noqulay.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stage('Deploy billing') {<br>  when {<br>    beforeAgent true<br>    allOf {<br>      branch 'main'<br>      not { changeRequest() }<br>      changeset 'services/billing/**'<br>    }<br>  }<br>  agent { label 'deploy' }<br>  steps { sh './deploy.sh billing' }<br>}<br>stage('Release') {<br>  when { buildingTag() }                         // v1.2.3 tag build'ida<br>  steps { sh 'make release' }<br>}<br>stage('Nightly') {<br>  when { triggeredBy 'TimerTrigger' }<br>  steps { sh 'make e2e-full' }<br>}<br>stage('Param') {<br>  when { expression { params.ENV == 'prod' } }<br>  steps { echo 'prod' }<br>}</pre><p>| Shart | Misol | |---|---| | branch | <code>branch 'release/*'</code> | | tag | <code>tag pattern: 'v\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+', comparator: 'REGEXP'</code> | | changeset | <code>changeset '**/*.go'</code> | | environment | <code>environment name: 'DEPLOY', value: 'true'</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>beforeAgent true</code> yo'q — shart false bo'lsa ham agent/K8s pod ajratiladi (vaqt va resurs isrofi).</li><li><code>changeset</code> faqat oxirgi build'dan keyingi o'zgarishlarni ko'radi; birinchi build yoki force-push'da kutilmagan natija.</li><li><code>branch</code> sharti oddiy (Multibranch bo'lmagan) Pipeline job'da ishlamaydi — <code>env.BRANCH_NAME</code> yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monorepo'da <code>changeset</code> ga tayanish xavfli (dependency o'zgarganda ham build kerak) — build graph vositalari (Bazel, Nx, Turborepo) affected-target'ni aniqroq hisoblaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33058	<p><code>lock</code> (Lockable Resources) va <code>milestone</code> nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b><code>lock</code></b> (Lockable Resources plugin) — umumiy resursga (staging muhit, test qurilma) bir vaqtda faqat bitta build kirishini ta'minlaydi; boshqalari navbatda kutadi. <b><code>milestone</code></b> — build'lar tartibini kafolatlaydi: yangiroq build milestone'dan o'tsa, undan oldingi (eskiroq) build'lar shu milestone'ga yetganda <b>bekor qilinadi</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki build bir vaqtda staging'ga deploy qilsa — muhit aralash holatga tushadi. Yoki #11 build #12 dan sekinroq yurib, #12 deploy qilgandan keyin eski kodni ustidan yozib qo'yadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>#11 ---- test (sekin) --------------- milestone(1) -&gt; ABORT (#12 o'tib ketgan)<br>#12 ---- test --- milestone(1) -&gt; lock(staging) -&gt; deploy -&gt; unlock<br>#13 ---- test ------- milestone(1) -&gt; lock(staging) [kutadi] -&gt; deploy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stage('Deploy staging') {<br>  steps {<br>    milestone(1)<br>    lock(resource: 'staging-env', inversePrecedence: true) {<br>      milestone(2)<br>      sh './deploy.sh staging'<br>      sh './smoke.sh staging'<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><code>inversePrecedence: true</code> — lock bo'shaganda eng yangi build oladi. Resurslarni Manage Jenkins -&gt; Lockable Resources'da (yoki JCasC'da) ta'riflash mumkin; <code>label</code> bilan pul (pool) ham qilinadi: <code>lock(label: 'test-device', quantity: 1)</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>lock</code> ichida <code>input</code> — boshqalar soatlab kutadi; tasdiqni lock'dan tashqarida ol.</li><li><code>timeout</code> yo'q — osilgan build lock'ni abadiy ushlaydi.</li><li><code>disableConcurrentBuilds</code> faqat bitta job ichida; turli job'lar bitta muhitga deploy qilsa <code>lock</code> kerak.</li><li>milestone'siz faqat lock — tartib kafolatlanmaydi (eski build keyinroq lock olishi mumkin).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu muammolar GitOps'da tabiiy hal bo'ladi: muhit holati Git'da, Argo CD faqat oxirgi commit'ni qo'llaydi. Jenkins'da qolsangiz, deploy job'lari uchun lock + milestone standart shablon bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33059	<p>Jenkins'ni GitHub/GitLab bilan webhook orqali qanday ulaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git server push/PR hodisasida Jenkins URL'iga HTTP POST (webhook) yuboradi, Jenkins tegishli job'ni ishga tushiradi va natijani <b>commit status / check</b> sifatida PR'ga qaytaradi. Dasturchi PR'da natijani ko'rishi va yiqilgan build merge'ni bloklashi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dev push -&gt; GitHub --POST /github-webhook/ (HMAC imzo)--&gt; Jenkins<br>                                                            | branch indexing<br>                                                            v<br>                                                   job PR-42 build<br>Jenkins --Checks API (GitHub App token)--&gt; PR: &quot;ci/jenkins: passed&quot;<br>branch protection: required check -&gt; merge tugmasi faqat yashilda</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub):</b></p><ol><li>GitHub'da App yarat: permissions — Checks (RW), Contents (R), Pull requests (R), Commit statuses (RW); Settings -&gt; Branches: <code>main</code> uchun required status check.</li></ol><p>Tekshirish:</p><pre># GitHub: Settings -&gt; Webhooks -&gt; Recent Deliveries (javob kodi 200 bo'lishi kerak)<br>curl -I https://ci.acme.uz/github-webhook/</pre><p>GitLab: Settings -&gt; Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33060	<p><code>matrix</code> direktivasi Declarative pipeline'da qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>matrix</code> — bir xil stage'ni bir nechta o'q (axis) qiymatlari kombinatsiyalari uchun avtomatik parallel ishga tushiradi (masalan, Go versiyalari x OS). <code>excludes</code> keraksiz kombinatsiyalarni olib tashlaydi. Har kombinatsiyada axis qiymatlari env var sifatida mavjud.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kutubxona 2 ta Go versiyasi va 2 ta OS'da test qilinishi kerak — 4 ta deyarli bir xil stage'ni qo'lda yozish takror va xatoga moyil.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>axes: GO = [1.22, 1.23], OS = [linux, windows]<br>kombinatsiyalar:<br>  1.22/linux   1.22/windows (exclude)<br>  1.23/linux   1.23/windows<br>-&gt; 3 ta parallel branch, har biri o'z agent'ida</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stage('Test') {<br>  matrix {<br>    axes {<br>      axis { name 'GO'; values '1.22', '1.23' }<br>      axis { name 'OS'; values 'linux', 'windows' }<br>    }<br>    excludes {<br>      exclude {<br>        axis { name 'GO'; values '1.22' }<br>        axis { name 'OS'; values 'windows' }<br>      }<br>    }<br>    agent { label &quot;${OS}&quot; }<br>    stages {<br>      stage('test') {<br>        steps {<br>          echo &quot;Go ${GO} on ${OS}&quot;<br>          sh &quot;go${GO} test ./...&quot;    // windows'da bat kerak bo'ladi<br>        }<br>      }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Natija Blue Ocean / Stage View'da har kombinatsiya alohida ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kombinatsiyalar soni ko'paytmasi tez o'sadi (3x3x3 = 27) — agent'lar yetmaydi, navbat uzayadi.</li><li>Windows agent'da <code>sh</code> ishlamaydi — <code>bat</code>/<code>powershell</code> yoki <code>isUnix()</code> tekshiruvi.</li><li><code>failFast</code> matrix'da default yo'q — bitta yiqilsa ham hammasi tugaguncha kutiladi (<code>options { parallelsAlwaysFailFast() }</code>).</li><li>Axis qiymatlari faqat literal; dinamik ro'yxat uchun Scripted <code>parallel</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> To'liq matritsani faqat tungi yoki release build'da ishlat, PR'da esa asosiy kombinatsiya (fast feedback). Bu tezlik va qamrov orasidagi oqilona trade-off.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33061	<p>Scripted va Declarative pipeline qachon qaysi biri?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Declarative</b> — default tanlov: qat'iy tuzilma, validatsiya, <code>when</code>/<code>post</code>/<code>options</code> tayyor, o'qish va review oson. <b>Scripted</b> — erkin Groovy (<code>node { }</code>): dinamik stage'lar (masalan, papkalar soniga qarab parallel), murakkab boshqaruv oqimi kerak bo'lganda. Ikkalasi bir xil engine'da ishlaydi; Declarative ichida <code>script { }</code> bilan Scripted kod qo'shish mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Monorepo'da servislar soni o'zgaruvchan — har biriga parallel build kerak. Declarative'da stage'lar statik; Scripted'da ro'yxatni runtime'da yasash mumkin.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// Scripted: dinamik parallel<br>node('linux') {<br>  stage('Checkout') { checkout scm }<br>  stage('Build') {<br>    def svcs = sh(script: 'ls services', returnStdout: true).trim().split('\n')<br>    def branches = svcs.collectEntries { s -&gt;<br>      [(s): { sh &quot;make -C services/${s} build&quot; }]<br>    }<br>    parallel branches<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>// Declarative ichida kichik script bloki<br>pipeline {<br>  agent any<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Version') {<br>      steps {<br>        script { env.VERSION = sh(script: 'git describe --tags', returnStdout: true).trim() }<br>        echo &quot;v=${env.VERSION}&quot;<br>      }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>| | Declarative | Scripted | |---|---|---| | Tuzilma | qat'iy | erkin | | Validatsiya | ishlashdan oldin | faqat runtime | | <code>post</code>, <code>when</code>, <code>options</code> | tayyor | qo'lda try/finally | | Dinamik stage | cheklangan | to'liq | | Restart from stage | bor | yo'q |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Scripted'da <code>try/catch/finally</code> ni unutish — cleanup va xabarnomalar ishlamaydi.</li><li>Declarative ichida ulkan <code>script { }</code> bloklari — signal: logikani Shared Library yoki shell skriptga chiqar.</li><li>Groovy CPS cheklovlari ikkalasida ham amal qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jamoa uchun Declarative + Shared Library standarti, Scripted faqat library ichida dinamik qismlar uchun. Bu ko'p jamoada pipeline'larni bir xil va qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan saqlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32040	<p>Groovy CPS va sandbox: nega Jenkinsfile'da oddiy Groovy kutilganday ishlamaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Jenkinsfile oddiy Groovy kabi ishlamaydi, chunki (1) u <b>CPS</b> (Continuation Passing Style) bilan qayta yozilib, har qadamdan keyin holati diskka <b>serialize</b> qilinadi — controller restart'dan keyin davom etish uchun; (2) u <b>controller'da</b> ishlaydi (<code>sh</code> esa agent'da); (3) Script Security <b>sandbox</b> ichida — ruxsat berilmagan metodlar bloklanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dasturchi oddiy Groovy yozadi: <code>def m = (text =~ /v(\d+)/)</code> — va <code>NotSerializableException</code> oladi. Yoki <code>collect { }</code> kutilganidan boshqacha ishlaydi, yoki &quot;Scripts not permitted to use method ...&quot; xatosi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Jenkinsfile (Groovy)<br>   v  CPS transform<br>har step (sh, echo, stage) chegarasida:<br>   program state -&gt; serialize -&gt; JENKINS_HOME/jobs/.../program.dat<br>controller restart -&gt; deserialize -&gt; davom<br>   =&gt; o'zgaruvchilar Serializable bo'lishi shart<br>   =&gt; og'ir hisob controller CPU/heap'ida<br>sandbox: har metod chaqiruvi whitelist bo'yicha tekshiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// YOMON: Matcher serializable emas<br>def m = (env.TAG =~ /v(\d+)\.(\d+)/)<br>sh &quot;echo ${m[0][1]}&quot;        // NotSerializableException<br><br>// YAXSHI: natijani darhol oddiy turga aylantir<br>@NonCPS<br>def major(String tag) { (tag =~ /v(\d+)/)[0][1] }   // ichida step chaqirma!<br>def v = major(env.TAG)<br>sh &quot;echo ${v}&quot;<br><br>// ENG YAXSHI: logika shell'da<br>def v = sh(script: &quot;echo $TAG | cut -d. -f1 | tr -d v&quot;, returnStdout: true).trim()</pre><p>Katta JSON'ni Groovy'da parse qilish o'rniga: <code>sh 'jq .version package.json'</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>@NonCPS</code> metod ichida <code>sh</code>/<code>echo</code> chaqirish — kutilmagan xatti-harakat; NonCPS ichida faqat sof hisob.</li><li>Script Approval sahifasida <code>staticMethod java.lang.Runtime getRuntime</code> kabi narsalarni ko'r-ko'rona approve qilish — controller'da RCE.</li><li>Groovy'dagi katta loop'lar — controller'ni sekinlashtiradi (hamma job'lar uchun).</li><li>Groovy closure'lar ba'zi CPS-mos bo'lmagan metodlarda (<code>sort { }</code>, <code>each</code> eski versiyalarda) noto'g'ri ishlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: Jenkinsfile — faqat orkestratsiya (qaysi qadam, qaysi agent'da). Hamma logika konteyner ichidagi skript/CLI'da — test qilinadi, lokal ishlaydi va controller'ni yuklamaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32041	<p>Jenkins controller'ni production'da qanday xavfsiz va barqaror qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy tamoyillar: controller'da <b>build yo'q</b> (executors = 0), <b>minimal va yangilangan plugin'lar</b>, <b>SSO + matrix/RBAC</b> avtorizatsiya, Script Console va Script Approval faqat admin, credential'lar <b>folder scope</b>'da yoki Vault'da, butun konfiguratsiya <b>JCasC</b> bilan kodda, <code>JENKINS_HOME</code> backup va monitoring (heap, queue, executor).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Jenkins controller — tashkilotdagi eng ko'p secret saqlaydigan mashinalardan biri (deploy kalitlari, registry, cloud). Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32042	<p>Jenkins sekin va beqaror bo'lsa — qanday debug qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Taxmin bilan emas, dalil bilan: (1) metrikalar — heap, GC pause, queue uzunligi, executor bandligi; (2) <b>thread dump</b> — qaysi plugin/job osilgan; (3) <b>GC log</b> — heap yetmayaptimi yoki leak; (4) disk — <code>JENKINS_HOME</code> hajmi va I/O. Groovy?)<br> +- vaqti-vaqti bilan qotish -&gt; GC log: uzoq Full GC -&gt; heap/leak<br> +- build'lar navbatda       -&gt; executor yetmaydi? label noto'g'ri? agent offline?<br> +- hamma narsa sekin I/O    -&gt; disk: JENKINS_HOME katta, durability yozuvlari</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Thread dump (yoki UI: /threadDump)<br>jcmd $(pgrep -f jenkins.war) Thread.print &gt; td1.txt; sleep 10; jcmd $(pgrep -f jenkins.war) Thread.print &gt; td2.txt<br># GC<br>jcmd &lt;pid&gt; GC.heap_info<br># JVM flag'lar: -Xlog:gc*:file=/var/jenkins_home/gc.log -XX:+UseG1GC<br>du -sh /var/jenkins_home/jobs/* | sort -h | tail     # eng katta job'lar</pre><p>Script Console'da (admin) navbat sababini ko'rish: <code>Jenkins.instance.queue.items.each { println &quot;${it.task.name}: ${it.why}&quot; }</code>.</p><p><b>Tez yutuqlar:</b></p><pre>options {<br>  buildDiscarder(logRotator(numToKeepStr: '30'))<br>  durabilityHint('PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZED')   // I/O kamayadi; crash'da resume yo'q<br>}</pre><ul><li>Katta JSON/Groovy loop'lar -&gt; <code>sh 'jq ...'</code>.</li><li>stash/archive o'rniga S3/Nexus.</li><li>Har push'da Organization re-scan o'rniga webhook.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Root cause'siz heap oshirish — leak'ni yashiradi, GC pauzalari uzayadi.</li><li>Bir vaqtda ko'p o'zgarish — qaysi biri yordam berganini bilmaysan.</li><li>Plugin muammosini yangilash bilan &quot;tuzatish&quot; — yangi versiya boshqa muammo keltirishi mumkin; changelog o'qi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p holatda ildiz sabab — arxitektura: bitta controller'da yuzlab jamoa. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32043	<p>Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI — qachon qaysi birini tanlaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>GitHub Actions</b> — kod GitHub'da bo'lsa: eng kam ops, kuchli marketplace, OIDC. <b>GitLab CI</b> — GitLab ishlatilsa yoki SCM + CI + registry + security'ni bitta platformada xohlasangiz. <b>Jenkins</b> — on-prem/air-gapped, juda o'ziga xos integratsiyalar yoki katta mavjud investitsiya bo'lsa; narxi — yuqori operatsion yuk.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI tanlovi ko'p yilga qulf: pipeline'lar, plugin'lar, jamoa ko'nikmasi. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-32044	<p>Jenkins'da build reproducibility va supply chain xavfsizligini qanday ta'minlaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Reproducibility: <b>ephemeral, versiyalangan build muhiti</b> (Docker/K8s agent, image digest'ga pin), aniq commit SHA'dan build, lockfile va checksum'lar, proxy repo. Supply chain: <b>imzolash</b> (cosign), <b>SLSA provenance</b>, <b>SBOM</b> (syft), qisqa muddatli secret'lar (Vault/OIDC), va Jenkins'ning o'zi (plugin'lar) ham pin va yangilangan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Mening agent'imda ishlaydi&quot; — qo'lda o'rnatilgan Go 1.20 bir agent'da, 1.22 boshqasida. Hujumchi dependency yoki build agent'ni buzsa, imzolanmagan zararli artifact prod'ga yetib boradi (SolarWinds, Codecov holatlari).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>source (git SHA, signed tag)<br>  v<br>build env: golang:1.23@sha256:... (ephemeral pod)<br>  v  deps: go.sum checksum, proxy repo (Nexus/Artifactory)<br>artifact: image@sha256:...<br>  +- SBOM (syft)        -&gt; nima ichida<br>  +- provenance (SLSA)  -&gt; qayerda, qaysi commit'dan, qanday qurildi<br>  +- signature (cosign) -&gt; kim qurdi<br>  v<br>deploy: admission controller (Kyverno/Sigstore policy) imzoni tekshiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent { kubernetes { yaml '''<br>spec:<br>  containers:<br>  - name: build<br>    image: golang:1.23@sha256:&lt;digest&gt;<br>    command: [sleep, infinity]<br>''' } }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Build') {<br>      steps { container('build') { sh 'go build -trimpath -mod=readonly ./...' } }<br>    }<br>    stage('Sign') {<br>      steps {<br>        sh '''<br>          syft ghcr.io/acme/api@${DIGEST} -o spdx-json &gt; sbom.json<br>          cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/acme/api@${DIGEST}<br>          cosign attest --yes --type spdxjson --predicate sbom.json ghcr.io/acme/api@${DIGEST}<br>        '''<br>      }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Tekshirish: <code>cosign verify ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:... --certificate-identity=... --certificate-oidc-issuer=...</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Image'ni tag bilan imzolash/deploy qilish — tag o'zgaradi; faqat digest.</li><li>Release build'ni branch'dan qilish — tag/commit SHA'dan qil.</li><li>Uzoq muddatli imzolash kalitini Jenkins credential'ida saqlash — KMS yoki keyless (OIDC).</li><li>Plugin'larni pin qilmaslik — CI'ning o'zi supply chain'ning bir qismi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy kafolat deploy tomonida tekshiruvda: imzo va provenance'ni admission policy majburlamasa, imzolash faqat &quot;teatr&quot;. Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33062	<p>JCasC (Configuration as Code) va Job DSL bilan Jenkins'ni qanday kod sifatida boshqarasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>JCasC</b> (Configuration as Code plugin) — Jenkins tizim sozlamalarini (security, cloud'lar, credential'lar, tool'lar) YAML'da ta'riflaydi; Jenkins start'da shu YAML'ni qo'llaydi. <b>Job DSL</b> (seed job) — job'larni (Multibranch, folder) Groovy DSL bilan koddan yaratadi. Build tarixi uchun alohida <code>JENKINS_HOME</code> backup kerak (JCasC uni saqlamaydi).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33063	<p>Jenkins'dan GitHub Actions/GitLab CI'ga migratsiyani qanday rejalashtirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bosqichli reja: <b>inventarizatsiya</b> (qaysi job'lar ishlatiladi, qaysilari o'lik), <b>plugin -&gt; ekvivalent xaritasi</b>, logikani CI'dan mustaqil skriptlarga chiqarish, avtomatik konvertatsiya (<code>gh actions-importer</code>) boshlang'ich nuqta sifatida, <b>pilot</b> jamoalar, parallel ishlash davri, statik credential'lardan OIDC'ga o'tish, metrikalar bilan muvaffaqiyatni o'lchash va oxirida Jenkins'ni o'chirish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Big bang&quot; migratsiya — hamma pipeline bir hafta buziladi, release'lar to'xtaydi. 500 ta job'ning yarmi hech kimga kerak emas, lekin ko'chiriladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. Assess:   job'lar ro'yxati, oxirgi build sanasi, egasi, plugin'lar<br>2. Clean:    90+ kun ishlamagan job'larni o'chir<br>3. Decouple: logika -&gt; Makefile/skript (CI faqat chaqiradi)<br>4. Map:      plugin -&gt; action/component (yoki &quot;yo'q&quot; -&gt; yechim)<br>5. Pilot:    2-3 jamoa, feedback, shablonlar (reusable workflow)<br>6. Wave:     jamoalar to'lqinlar bilan; ikkala CI parallel<br>7. Cutover:  required check yangi CI'ga; Jenkins read-only<br>8. Decom:    arxiv, o'chirish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gh extension install github/gh-actions-importer<br>gh actions-importer audit jenkins --output-dir audit/          # nimalar bor, qancha konvertatsiya bo'ladi<br>gh actions-importer dry-run jenkins --source-url https://ci.acme.uz/job/api --output-dir out/<br>gh actions-importer migrate jenkins --source-url ... --target-url https://github.com/acme/api</pre><p>Audit hisobotida: qaysi qadamlar avtomatik o'tdi, qaysilari qo'lda ishlov talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Xavflar va yechimlar:</b> | Xavf | Yechim | |---|---| | on-prem hardware (HSM, Windows, GPU) | self-hosted runner | | ichki tarmoqqa deploy | runner ichki tarmoqda yoki GitOps (pull) | | statik credential'lar | OIDC -&gt; cloud IAM rollari | | Shared Library logikasi | reusable workflow / composite action |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konvertor natijasini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri prod'ga — u &quot;tarjima&quot; qiladi, yaxshilamaydi.</li><li>Eski Jenkins'ni o'chirmaslik — ikki tizim xarajati abadiy qoladi.</li><li>Deploy tarixini yo'qotish — audit uchun log/artifact'larni arxivla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Muvaffaqiyat metrikalari oldindan kelishilsin: pipeline vaqti, fail rate, lead time, ops soatlari. Migratsiya — CI'ni yaxshilash imkoniyati (kesh, OIDC, ephemeral runner), shunchaki ko'chirish emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33064	<p>Jenkins'da agent'lar orasida build cache'ni qanday hal qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ephemeral agent'larda kesh avtomatik saqlanmaydi, shuning uchun uni ataylab tashkil qilish kerak: (1) <b>pre-baked image</b> — kam o'zgaradigan dependency'lar image ichida; (2) <b>PVC</b> (K8s) — umumiy disk; (3) <b>proxy repo</b> (Nexus/Artifactory, Go proxy) — tarmoq orqali tez yuklash; (4) <b>remote build cache</b> (Bazel, Gradle, BuildKit registry cache) — eng yaxshi natija. PR build'lar keshga <b>yozmasligi</b> kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har build yangi pod — <code>go mod download</code>, <code>npm ci</code>, Docker layer'lar har safar noldan: 2 daqiqalik build 12 daqiqaga aylanadi. Statik agent'da kesh bor edi, lekin &quot;snowflake&quot; muammosi bilan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>             +---------------- kesh variantlari ----------------+<br>build pod -&gt; | image ichida (deps)  : tez, lekin image eskiradi |<br>             | PVC /cache           : oddiy, RWX parallel xavfi |<br>             | proxy repo (Nexus)   : tarmoq, ishonchli manba   |<br>             | remote cache (S3/registry): hermetik, eng tez    |<br>             +--------------------------------------------------+</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// Go: PVC read-only + GOPROXY<br>agent { kubernetes { yaml '''<br>spec:<br>  containers:<br>  - name: go<br>    image: golang:1.23<br>    command: [sleep, infinity]<br>    env:<br>    - { name: GOPROXY, value: &quot;https://nexus.acme.uz/repository/go-proxy/&quot; }<br>    - { name: GOMODCACHE, value: /cache/gomod }<br>    volumeMounts: [{ name: cache, mountPath: /cache, readOnly: true }]<br>  volumes:<br>  - name: cache<br>    persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: go-cache, readOnly: true }<br>''' } }</pre><pre># Docker image build: BuildKit registry cache<br>docker buildx build \<br>  --cache-from type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/api:buildcache \<br>  --cache-to   type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/api:buildcache,mode=max \<br>  -t ghcr.io/acme/api:$GIT_COMMIT --push .</pre><p>Keshni yangilash: faqat <code>main</code> branch'dagi alohida job keshga yozadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>RWX PVC'ga bir vaqtda ko'p build yozadi — kesh buziladi (corruption).</li><li>PR build keshga yozadi — <b>cache poisoning</b>: zararli PR main build'ga ta'sir qiladi.</li><li>Kesh kalitida lockfile hash yo'q — eski dependency'lar ishlatiladi.</li><li>Kesh hajmi cheksiz o'sadi — TTL/tozalash yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kesh — tezlik va hermetiklik/xavfsizlik orasidagi trade-off. Avval o'lcha (qaysi qadam vaqt yeydi), keyin eng arzon yechim: ko'pincha proxy repo + Docker layer cache 80% foydani beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33065	<p>Ko'p jamoali Jenkins'da RBAC va multi-tenancy qanday tashkil qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Jamoalarni <b>folder</b>'larga ajratish va <b>Role-based / Folder-based authorization</b> bilan har jamoaga faqat o'z folder'ida huquq berish; <b>credential'lar folder scope</b>'da; deploy agent'lariga kirishni cheklash (Job Restrictions, K8s pod template'lar, namespace); global trusted library faqat platforma jamoasida. Katta tashkilotda — bir nechta controller (har biznes bo'linmaga).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta Jenkins'da 20 jamoa: A jamoasining job'i B'ning prod credential'ini ishlata oladi, istalgan Jenkinsfile <code>label 'prod-deploy'</code> so'raydi, bitta jamoaning og'ir job'lari hammani sekinlashtiradi, bitta plugin upgrade hammani buzadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Controller<br> +- folder team-a/   (role: team-a-devs -&gt; Job/Build, Job/Read)<br> |     credentials: team-a-prod (faqat shu folder ichida ko'rinadi)<br> |     pod templates: ns ci-team-a, SA team-a-builder<br> +- folder team-b/<br> +- global: faqat platforma jamoasi (admin, trusted library, JCasC)</pre><p><b>Amalda (JCasC, Role Strategy plugin):</b></p><pre>jenkins:<br>  authorizationStrategy:<br>    roleBased:<br>      roles:<br>        global:<br>          - name: authenticated<br>            permissions: [Overall/Read]<br>            entries: [{ group: authenticated }]<br>        items:<br>          - name: team-a<br>            pattern: &quot;team-a/.*&quot;<br>            permissions: [Job/Build, Job/Read, Job/Cancel, Job/Workspace]<br>            entries: [{ group: team-a }]</pre><p>Credential folder'da: Folder -&gt; Credentials -&gt; &quot;Stores scoped to team-a&quot;. Agent cheklash: K8s cloud'da har jamoaga alohida namespace va cheklangan ServiceAccount.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Global credential'lar — har job ishlata oladi.</li><li>Folder huquqi berilgan, lekin <code>Job/Configure</code> — Jenkinsfile'ni o'zgartirib boshqa label/credential so'rash.</li><li>Agent'lar umumiy — bitta jamoa build'i boshqasining workspace/keshini ko'radi.</li><li>&quot;Hammaga admin&quot; — eng tez, eng xavfli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bitta controller = bitta failure domain va plugin konfliktlari. Jamoalar 10-15 dan oshsa, har bo'linmaga alohida controller (JCasC'dan bir xil shablon) yoki SaaS CI'ga o'tish operatsion jihatdan arzonroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33066	<p>Jenkins pipeline'da deployment strategiyasi (blue-green, canary, rollback) qanday quriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Jenkins strategiyani o'zi bilmaydi — u qadamlarni orkestratsiya qiladi: yangi versiyani chiqarish (Helm/kubectl), <b>avtomatik tekshirish</b> (SLO metrikalari, smoke test), muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa <b>oldingi artifact versiyasiga</b> qaytish. <b>Blue-green</b> — ikki muhit, trafikni birdan almashtirish; <b>canary</b> — kichik foiz trafik, metrikaga qarab oshirish. Yaxshiroq zamonaviy yondashuv: Jenkins faqat Git'dagi image tag'ni yangilaydi, deploy va canary'ni Argo CD / Argo Rollouts qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Deploy qildik, 20 daqiqadan keyin xatolar ko'paydi, rollback qanday?&quot; Rollback = qayta build bo'lsa — sekin va boshqa artifact chiqishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Canary:<br> v1 100% -&gt; v2 10% (10 daq SLO tekshir) -&gt; 50% -&gt; 100%<br>                  | SLO buzildi<br>                  v<br>             rollback: v1 100%<br>Blue-green:<br> LB -&gt; blue(v1)    green(v2) deploy + smoke<br> LB -&gt; green(v2)   blue saqlanadi (tez qaytish uchun)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stage('Canary') {<br>  steps {<br>    sh &quot;helm upgrade --install app ./chart --set image.tag=${GIT_COMMIT} --set canary.weight=10 --wait&quot;<br>    script {<br>      def ok = sh(script: './check-slo.sh --window 10m --max-error-rate 0.01', returnStatus: true) == 0<br>      if (!ok) {<br>        sh 'helm rollback app'<br>        error 'Canary SLO buzildi - rollback qilindi'<br>      }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}<br>stage('Promote') {<br>  steps { sh &quot;helm upgrade app ./chart --set image.tag=${GIT_COMMIT} --set canary.weight=100 --wait&quot; }<br>}</pre><p><code>check-slo.sh</code> Prometheus'dan so'raydi: <code>sum(rate(http_requests_total{version=&quot;canary&quot;,code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{version=&quot;canary&quot;}[5m]))</code>.</p><p>GitOps varianti: Jenkins <code>manifests</code> repo'da <code>image.tag</code> ni yangilab commit qiladi; Argo Rollouts <code>AnalysisTemplate</code> bilan canary va avtomatik abort qiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rollback = rebuild — doimo oldingi <b>imzolangan artifact</b>'ga qayt.</li><li>DB migratsiyasi orqaga mos emas — rollback ishlamaydi; expand-contract (avval qo'sh, keyin o'chir).</li><li>Canary trafigi juda kam — statistik ma'nosiz metrika.</li><li>Jenkins agent'i prod klasterga keng huquqli kubeconfig bilan — xavfsizlik riski (GitOps pull modeli buni yo'qotadi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avtomatik rollback mezonlari (error rate, latency p99) deploydan <b>oldin</b> belgilanadi. Feature flag'lar deploy va release'ni ajratadi — ko'p hollarda rollback o'rniga flag'ni o'chirish tezroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::I10 Jenkins	idrill-33067	<p>Jenkins plugin'larini qanday boshqarasiz va yangilaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Plugin'lar kod kabi boshqariladi: ro'yxat va versiyalar <code>plugins.txt</code> da pin qilinadi, <code>jenkins-plugin-cli</code> bilan <b>immutable Docker image</b>'ga o'rnatiladi, yangilash — rejalashtirilgan, staging'da sinalgan, LTS liniyasida. Minimal to'plam, tashlab ketilgan plugin'lar olib tashlanadi, kritik <b>Security Advisory</b>'da tezkor patch.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har plugin — attack surface, dependency daraxti va upgrade xavfi. UI'dan &quot;Update all&quot; bosilgan kuni yarim pipeline'lar sinadi; qaysi versiya ishlayotgani noma'lum, tiklab bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>plugins.txt (Git, PR review)<br>  kubernetes:4358.vcfd9c5a_0a_f51<br>  workflow-aggregator:608.v67378e9d3db_1<br>  configuration-as-code:1971.vf9280461ea_89<br>     v<br>Renovate/Dependabot PR -&gt; CI: image build -&gt; staging Jenkins -&gt; smoke pipeline'lar<br>     v<br>merge -&gt; prod image -&gt; rolling restart (yoki blue-green controller)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM jenkins/jenkins:2.516.2-lts-jdk21<br>COPY plugins.txt /usr/share/jenkins/ref/plugins.txt<br>RUN jenkins-plugin-cli --plugin-file /usr/share/jenkins/ref/plugins.txt --verbose</pre><pre># Mavjud controller'dagi plugin'larni ro'yxatlash (boshlang'ich plugins.txt uchun)<br>curl -s -u admin:$TOKEN &quot;https://ci.acme.uz/pluginManager/api/json?depth=1&quot; \<br>  | jq -r '.plugins[] | &quot;\(.shortName):\(.version)&quot;' | sort &gt; plugins.txt<br># Yangilanishlarni ko'rish<br>jenkins-plugin-cli --plugin-file plugins.txt --available-updates --output txt</pre><p>Manage Jenkins -&gt; Plugins sahifasida &quot;deprecated&quot; va &quot;security warning&quot; belgilarini kuzat.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prod'da UI orqali &quot;Update all&quot; — kutilmagan breaking change, rollback yo'q.</li><li>Transitive dependency'larni pin qilmaslik — image har build'da boshqa versiya oladi.</li><li>&quot;Bir marta kerak bo'lgan&quot; plugin'lar yillab qoladi — har biri CVE manbai.</li><li>Core'ni yangilamasdan faqat plugin'larni yangilash — minimal core versiya talabi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Plugin soni — Jenkins sog'lig'ining asosiy indikatori: kamroq plugin = kamroq CVE va oson upgrade. Har chorakda audit: ishlatilmayotgan va tashlab ketilgan plugin'larni olib tashlash, LTS bo'yicha rejalashtirilgan upgrade oynasi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::i10 Jenkins
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40551	<p>CI/CD nima va qaysi asosiy muammolarni hal qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CI/CD — kodni build qilish, test qilish va deploy qilishni avtomatlashtiruvchi amaliyot. CI (Continuous Integration) har o'zgarishni darhol tekshiradi, CD (Continuous Delivery/Deployment) tekshirilgan kodni xavfsiz va tez production'ga yetkazadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI/CD bo'lmagan jamoani tasavvur qil: 5 dasturchi 3 hafta alohida branch'da ishlaydi, keyin hammasini birlashtiradi — yuzlab conflict, &quot;mening kompyuterimda ishlardi&quot;, reliz kuni kechasi qo'lda <code>scp</code> va <code>ssh</code> bilan server yangilanadi, bitta qadam unutilsa prod yiqiladi.</p><p><b>CI/CD nimani hal qiladi:</b> | Muammo | Yechim | |---|---| | Kech topilgan integratsiya bug'i | Har push'da build + test | | Qo'lda deploy xatolari | Bir xil skript har safar | | Sekin reliz (oyiga 1) | Kuniga bir necha marta | | &quot;Kim nimani chiqardi?&quot; | Pipeline log = audit | | Qo'rqinchli rollback | Oldingi artifact'ni qayta deploy |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git push -&gt; CI: lint -&gt; build -&gt; test -&gt; artifact<br>                                          |<br>                                          v<br>                     CD: staging deploy -&gt; test -&gt; prod deploy</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions minimal):</b></p><pre>on: [push]<br>jobs:<br>  ci:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - run: make lint test build</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pipeline bor, lekin test yo'q — bu shunchaki &quot;avtomatik deploy&quot;, CI emas.</li><li>Pipeline 40 daqiqa — dasturchilar kutmaydi, natijaga qaramaydi.</li><li>Qizil <code>main</code> ni hech kim tuzatmaydi — CI ma'nosini yo'qotadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI/CD — tool emas, madaniyat. DORA metrikalari (deploy frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR) bilan o'lchanadi; maqsad — kichik, tez-tez, qaytariladigan o'zgarishlar.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40552	<p>Continuous Integration (CI) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Continuous Integration — dasturchilar kodni umumiy branch'ga tez-tez (kuniga kamida bir marta) birlashtiradi va har birlashtirish avtomatik build va test bilan tekshiriladi. Maqsad — integratsiya xatosini daqiqalarda topish.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Integratsiya qanchalik kam qilinsa, shunchalik og'riqli. Ikki kishi bir funksiyani 2 hafta mobaynida turlicha o'zgartirsa — conflict katta. Har kuni birlashtirsa — conflict kichik va darhol ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dev push/PR -&gt; webhook -&gt; CI server<br>   -&gt; checkout -&gt; deps -&gt; lint -&gt; build -&gt; unit test -&gt; integration test<br>   -&gt; natija: yashil/qizil + PR'da status</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name: ci<br>on:<br>  pull_request:<br>  push: { branches: [main] }<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: { go-version: '1.23' }<br>      - run: go vet ./...<br>      - run: go test -race ./...</pre><p>PR sahifasida <code>ci / test</code> yashil bo'lmasa — branch protection merge'ni bloklaydi.</p><p><b>CI amaliyoti qoidalari:</b></p><ul><li>Kichik commit'lar, tez-tez merge.</li><li>Build 10 daqiqadan kam.</li><li>Qizil build — eng yuqori prioritet, darhol tuzatiladi yoki revert.</li><li>Test'lar CI'da ishlaydigan va deterministik bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Uzoq yashovchi feature branch'da CI ishlatish — bu CI emas, chunki integratsiya bo'lmayapti.</li><li>Flaky test'lar — jamoa &quot;qayta ishga tushir&quot; ga o'rganadi, haqiqiy xatolar o'tib ketadi.</li><li>Faqat <code>main</code> da ishlatish — xato merge'dan keyin topiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'ning qiymati — feedback tezligi. 5 daqiqalik ishonchli pipeline 30 daqiqalik &quot;hamma narsani tekshiradigan&quot; pipeline'dan foydaliroq; og'ir test'larni nightly yoki merge queue'ga chiqar.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40553	<p>Continuous Delivery nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Continuous Delivery — har o'zgarish avtomatik build, test qilinib, istalgan payt production'ga chiqarishga tayyor holga keltiriladi. Prod'ga chiqarishning o'zi esa inson qarori (tugma bosish yoki approval).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Biznes ba'zan relizni o'zi tanlashni xohlaydi: marketing e'loni, regulyator talabi, yoki &quot;juma kechqurun chiqarmaymiz&quot; qoidasi. Continuous Delivery texnik tayyorlikni biznes qarordan ajratadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>commit -&gt; CI -&gt; artifact -&gt; staging (avto) -&gt; acceptance test (avto)<br>                                                  |<br>                                       [ Approve ] &lt;- inson<br>                                                  |<br>                                                  v<br>                                             production</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions environment approval):</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  deploy-staging:<br>    environment: staging<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps: [ { run: ./deploy.sh staging } ]<br>  deploy-prod:<br>    needs: deploy-staging<br>    environment: production   # required reviewers sozlangan<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps: [ { run: ./deploy.sh prod } ]</pre><p><code>production</code> environment'da &quot;Required reviewers&quot; yoqilgan bo'lsa, job &quot;Waiting for review&quot; holatida to'xtaydi.</p><p><b>Delivery vs Deployment:</b> | | Continuous Delivery | Continuous Deployment | |---|---|---| | Prod'ga chiqish | Qo'lda tasdiq | Avtomatik | | Talab | Yaxshi test | Juda yaxshi test + monitoring + avto-rollback |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tasdiq tugmasi bor, lekin staging prod'dan juda farq qiladi — &quot;tayyor&quot; degani yolg'on.</li><li>Approval rasmiyatchilikka aylanadi: reviewer nimani tasdiqlayotganini ko'rmaydi.</li><li>Deploy skripti faqat CD vaqtida ishlatiladi va kamdan-kam sinaladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asosiy talab — <code>main</code> doim deploy qilinadigan holatda. Qo'lda tasdiq bosqichi xavfni kamaytirmaydi, agar artifact va jarayon avtomatik ishonchli bo'lmasa; u faqat vaqtni boshqaradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40554	<p>Continuous Deployment nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Continuous Deployment — barcha avtomatik tekshiruvlardan o'tgan har commit inson aralashuvisiz production'ga chiqadi. Continuous Delivery'dan farqi — qo'lda &quot;Approve&quot; tugmasi yo'q.</p><p><b>Nega:</b> Inson approval sekin va ko'pincha samarasiz. Agar test, monitoring va rollback ishonchli bo'lsa, kichik o'zgarishlarni darhol chiqarish xavfni kamaytiradi — har reliz kichik, xato manbai aniq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>merge -&gt; CI (test) -&gt; artifact -&gt; staging -&gt; smoke test<br>     -&gt; prod canary 5% -&gt; metrikalar OK? -- yo'q --&gt; avto rollback<br>                              | ha<br>                              v<br>                          100% rollout</pre><p><b>Amalda (ArgoCD + Argo Rollouts misolida):</b></p><pre>strategy:<br>  canary:<br>    steps:<br>      - setWeight: 10<br>      - pause: { duration: 5m }<br>      - analysis: { templates: [ { templateName: error-rate } ] }<br>      - setWeight: 50<br>      - pause: { duration: 10m }</pre><p>CI image'ni build qilib Git'dagi tag'ni yangilaydi, ArgoCD sync qiladi, Rollouts canary'ni metrikaga qarab davom ettiradi yoki to'xtatadi.</p><p><b>Talablar (buni bo'lmasa qilma):</b></p><ul><li>Yuqori sifatli avtomatik test'lar.</li><li>Feature flag — tugallanmagan kod yashirin chiqadi.</li><li>Monitoring + alert + avtomatik rollback.</li><li>Backward-compatible DB migratsiyalar (expand/contract).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DB migratsiya kod bilan bir vaqtda buzuvchi o'zgarish qiladi — rollback imkonsiz.</li><li>Rollback faqat kodni qaytaradi, data'ni emas.</li><li>Metrikasiz canary — shunchaki sekin deploy.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Continuous Deployment — test strategiyasi va observability yetukligining natijasi, maqsad emas. Regulated sohalarda (bank, tibbiyot) odatda Delivery + audit qilinadigan approval tanlanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40555	<p>Production CI/CD pipeline'ning asosiy bosqichlari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Odatiy production pipeline: trigger -&gt; lint/statik tahlil -&gt; build -&gt; test -&gt; artifact (imzo, SBOM) -&gt; staging deploy + E2E/DAST -&gt; production progressive rollout -&gt; post-deploy tekshiruv.</p><p><b>Nega bosqichlar tartibi muhim:</b> Arzon va tez tekshiruvlar oldinda (lint 30 soniya), qimmatlari keyin (E2E 15 daqiqa). Xato qancha erta to'xtasa, shuncha arzon.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[1 Trigger] push/PR webhook<br>     v<br>[2 Static] lint, format, SAST, secret scan, SCA<br>     v<br>[3 Build] compile, docker build<br>     v<br>[4 Test] unit -&gt; integration (DB container bilan)<br>     v<br>[5 Package] image push, SBOM, cosign sign, provenance<br>     v<br>[6 Staging] deploy -&gt; smoke, E2E, DAST<br>     v<br>[7 Prod] canary/blue-green -&gt; metrika tahlili -&gt; 100%<br>     v<br>[8 Verify] SLO kuzatuv, avto rollback</pre><p><b>Amalda (skelet):</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  lint:   { runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [ ... ] }<br>  test:   { needs: lint, ... }<br>  build:<br>    needs: test<br>    steps:<br>      - run: docker build -t $IMG:$GITHUB_SHA .<br>      - run: docker push $IMG:$GITHUB_SHA<br>      - run: syft $IMG:$GITHUB_SHA -o cyclonedx-json &gt; sbom.json<br>      - run: cosign sign --yes $IMG@$DIGEST<br>  deploy-staging: { needs: build, environment: staging, ... }<br>  deploy-prod:    { needs: deploy-staging, environment: production, ... }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har muhit uchun qayta build — staging'da sinalgan narsa prod'dagi emas.</li><li>Xavfsizlik skanerlari faqat oxirida — tuzatish kechikadi.</li><li>Post-deploy tekshiruv yo'q — &quot;deploy yashil&quot; lekin foydalanuvchilar 500 olyapti.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pipeline dizaynida ikki metrika: lead time (commit -&gt; prod) va ishonch. Har bosqich &quot;qaysi xatoni ushlaydi?&quot; degan savolga javob berishi kerak; javob bo'lmasa — o'chir.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40556	<p>CI/CD'da artifact nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Artifact — build natijasida yaratilgan, o'zgarmas (immutable), versiyalangan deploy birligi: Docker image, JAR, binary, npm paket, Helm chart. Aynan shu artifact muhitlar bo'ylab (dev -&gt; staging -&gt; prod) ko'chiriladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Agar har deploy'da kod qaytadan build qilinsa, dependency yangilanishi yoki boshqa compiler versiyasi tufayli prod'ga sinalmagan narsa chiqishi mumkin. Artifact — &quot;aynan nima sinalgan&quot; degan savolga aniq javob.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>source@sha abc123 --build--&gt; app:abc123 (digest sha256:9f..)<br>                                 |<br>                   registry/artifact repo (ECR, Nexus, Artifactory)<br>                     |            |             |<br>                    dev        staging         prod</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker build -t registry.io/shop/api:1.4.2 .<br>docker push registry.io/shop/api:1.4.2<br># deploy'da tag emas, digest bilan:<br>docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' registry.io/shop/api:1.4.2<br># registry.io/shop/api@sha256:9f2c...</pre><p>GitHub Actions'da job'lar orasida: <code>actions/upload-artifact@v4</code> — bu CI artifact (test hisobotlari, binary), uzoq muddatli registry emas.</p><p><b>Yaxshi artifact xususiyatlari:</b></p><ul><li>Immutable: <code>1.4.2</code> bir marta push qilinadi, ustiga yozilmaydi.</li><li>Kuzatiladigan: commit SHA, build vaqti, SBOM, imzo.</li><li>Konfiguratsiyasiz: environment farqlari runtime'da beriladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>latest</code> tag bilan deploy — nima ishlayotgani noma'lum.</li><li>Secret'larni image ichiga build qilish.</li><li>Retention siyosati yo'q — registry terabaytlab o'sadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da tag emas, digest bilan deploy qil — tag ko'chirilishi mumkin, digest yo'q. Artifact repository'da immutable tag va retention siyosati yoq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40557	<p>&quot;Build once, deploy anywhere&quot; tamoyili nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> &quot;Build once, deploy anywhere&quot; — kod CI'da faqat bir marta artifact'ga yig'iladi va o'sha aynan artifact (bir xil digest) barcha muhitlarga deploy qilinadi. Muhitlar orasidagi farq faqat runtime konfiguratsiyada (env var, ConfigMap, secret).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Staging uchun bir build, prod uchun boshqa build qilsang — orada dependency yangilangan, base image o'zgargan bo'lishi mumkin. Staging'da test qilingan narsa prod'dagi narsa emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>        build (1 marta) -&gt; api@sha256:9f..<br>               |<br>   +-----------+-----------+<br>   v           v           v<br>  dev        staging      prod<br>DB_URL=dev  DB_URL=stg   DB_URL=prod   &lt;- faqat config farq</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Kustomize overlay: image bir xil, config farq<br># overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml<br>images:<br>  - name: api<br>    digest: sha256:9f2c...<br>configMapGenerator:<br>  - name: api-config<br>    literals: [ LOG_LEVEL=info, FEATURE_X=false ]</pre><p>Promotion = Git'da digest'ni keyingi muhit overlay'iga ko'chirish (PR orqali).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Frontend'da <code>API_URL</code> ni build vaqtida bundle'ga yozish (<code>REACT_APP_*</code>) — har muhit uchun alohida build kerak bo'lib qoladi. Yechim: runtime <code>config.json</code> yoki env injection.</li><li><code>if env == &quot;prod&quot;</code> kabi shartlar kodda — farq kodga ko'chadi.</li><li>Debug flag'lar bilan staging build'i.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu tamoyil 12-Factor App'ning &quot;config in environment&quot; qoidasi bilan birga ishlaydi. Promotion'ni artifact digest orqali qil va provenance (SLSA) bilan &quot;bu digest qaysi commit'dan&quot; ni isbotla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40558	<p>CI/CD'da build matrix nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Build matrix — bitta job ta'rifidan bir nechta parallel job yaratish: masalan OS (ubuntu, macos, windows) x til versiyasi (Node 20, 22, 24). Kod barcha qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan kombinatsiyalarda ishlashini tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kutubxona muallifi Node 20 va 22 ni qo'llab-quvvatlayman desa, ikkalasida ham test qilishi kerak. Qo'lda 9 ta job yozish — takror va xato manbai.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>matrix: os=[ubuntu, macos] x node=[20, 22]<br>  -&gt; job (ubuntu, 20)<br>  -&gt; job (ubuntu, 22)<br>  -&gt; job (macos, 20)<br>  -&gt; job (macos, 22)     hammasi parallel</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}<br>    strategy:<br>      fail-fast: false<br>      max-parallel: 4<br>      matrix:<br>        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]<br>        node: [20, 22]<br>        include:<br>          - os: ubuntu-latest<br>            node: 24<br>            experimental: true<br>        exclude:<br>          - os: macos-latest<br>            node: 20<br>    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4<br>        with: { node-version: '${{ matrix.node }}' }<br>      - run: npm ci &amp;&amp; npm test</pre><p>GitLab'da ekvivalent: <code>parallel: matrix:</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kombinatsiyalar portlashi: 3 OS x 4 versiya x 3 DB = 36 job — pul va vaqt.
