Faqat real qo'llab-quvvatlanadiganlarni qo'y.</li><li>macOS/Windows runner'lar Linux'dan bir necha barobar qimmat.</li><li>Branch protection'da matrix job nomlari (<code>test (ubuntu-latest, 20)</code>) — matrix o'zgarsa required check buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PR'da kichik matrix (asosiy kombinatsiya), nightly'da to'liq matrix — tezlik va qamrov o'rtasidagi muvozanat.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40559	<p>Pipeline caching va artifact storage farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cache — keyingi build'larni tezlashtirish uchun saqlanadigan vaqtinchalik fayllar (dependency'lar), yo'qolsa ham build to'g'ri ishlaydi. Artifact — build'ning natijasi (binary, hisobot), keyingi bosqich yoki odamlar uchun kerakli, kafolatlangan saqlanadi.</p><p><b>Farq:</b> | | Cache | Artifact | |---|---|---| | Maqsad | Tezlik | Natijani uzatish/saqlash | | Yo'qolsa | Build sekinlashadi, xolos | Pipeline buziladi | | Misol | <code>~/.npm</code>, <code>~/.m2</code>, Go mod cache | <code>app.jar</code>, <code>coverage.xml</code>, image | | Kalit | lockfile hash | job/run | | Muddat | LRU, 7 kun ishlatilmasa o'chadi (GHA) | retention (default 90 kun GHA) |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>run #1: cache miss -&gt; npm ci (2 min) -&gt; cache save (key=hash(lock))<br>run #2: cache hit  -&gt; npm ci (15 s)<br>build -&gt; dist/ -&gt; upload-artifact -&gt; deploy job download-artifact</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- uses: actions/cache@v4<br>  with:<br>    path: ~/.npm<br>    key: npm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}<br>    restore-keys: npm-${{ runner.os }}-<br>- run: npm ci &amp;&amp; npm run build<br>- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4<br>  with: { name: dist, path: dist/, retention-days: 7 }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cache'ga build natijasini qo'yib, keyingi job'da unga tayanish — cache evict bo'lsa pipeline buziladi.</li><li><code>node_modules</code> ni cache'lash (<code>~/.npm</code> o'rniga) — OS/Node versiyasi farq qilsa buzuq native modul.</li><li>Cache poisoning: PR'dan yozilgan cache <code>main</code> ga tushmasligi kerak (GHA branch scope buni boshqaradi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: cache — optimizatsiya, artifact — kontrakt. Uzoq muddatli deploy birliklarini CI artifact'da emas, registry/artifact repository'da saqla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40560	<p>Semantic Versioning (SemVer) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SemVer — <code>MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH</code> versiyalash qoidasi: MAJOR — orqaga mos kelmaydigan (breaking) o'zgarish, MINOR — mos keluvchi yangi funksiya, PATCH — mos keluvchi bug fix. Masalan <code>2.4.1 -&gt; 2.5.0</code> xavfsiz yangilanish, <code>-&gt; 3.0.0</code> — kodni tekshir.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Versiya raqami foydalanuvchiga &quot;yangilasam nima buziladi?&quot; degan savolga javob beradi. Package manager'lar (<code>^1.2.0</code>) shu kontraktga tayanadi.</p><p><b>Qoidalar:</b></p><pre>1.4.2  -&gt; 1.4.3   PATCH: bug fix<br>1.4.3  -&gt; 1.5.0   MINOR: yangi endpoint, eski ishlaydi (PATCH=0)<br>1.5.0  -&gt; 2.0.0   MAJOR: eski API o'chirildi (MINOR=PATCH=0)<br>2.0.0-rc.1        pre-release (2.0.0 dan kichik)<br>1.0.0+build.57    build metadata (tartibga ta'sir qilmaydi)<br>0.y.z             boshlang'ich rivojlanish: istalgan payt buzilishi mumkin</pre><p><b>Amalda (npm range'lari):</b></p><pre>&quot;lodash&quot;: &quot;^4.17.21&quot;   # &gt;=4.17.21 &lt;5.0.0<br>&quot;axios&quot;:  &quot;~1.6.2&quot;     # &gt;=1.6.2 &lt;1.7.0<br>npm version minor      # 1.4.2 -&gt; 1.5.0 + git tag v1.5.0<br>git tag -a v1.5.0 -m &quot;release 1.5.0&quot; &amp;&amp; git push --tags</pre><p>Go modullarida MAJOR &gt;= 2 import path'ga kiradi: <code>example.com/lib/v2</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Kichik&quot; breaking change'ni MINOR sifatida chiqarish — dependency'lar <code>^</code> bilan avtomatik oladi va buziladi.</li><li><code>0.x</code> da uzoq qolish — foydalanuvchilar uchun kafolat yo'q.</li><li>Breaking nima ekanini aniqlamaslik: default qiymat, xato formati, CLI flag ham public API.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SemVer — public API kontrakti. Ichki servislarda ko'pincha commit SHA yoki CalVer (<code>2026.10.03</code>) qulayroq; kutubxona va public API'larda SemVer shart.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40561	<p>Conventional Commits nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Conventional Commits — commit xabarining standart formati: <code>type(scope): tavsif</code>. <code>feat</code> MINOR, <code>fix</code> PATCH, <code>feat!</code> yoki <code>BREAKING CHANGE:</code> MAJOR versiyani oshiradi; tool'lar shundan avtomatik versiya va changelog yaratadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;fix stuff&quot;, &quot;wip&quot; kabi xabarlardan changelog yozib bo'lmaydi. Struktura bo'lsa — reliz avtomatlashadi va tarixni o'qish oson.</p><p><b>Format:</b></p><pre>&lt;type&gt;[(scope)][!]: &lt;qisqa tavsif&gt;<br><br>[body]<br><br>[footer: BREAKING CHANGE: ..., Refs: #123]</pre><p>| type | Ma'nosi | Versiya | |---|---|---| | feat | yangi funksiya | MINOR | | fix | bug fix | PATCH | | docs, chore, ci, refactor, test, perf, style | boshqalar | o'zgarmaydi (sozlanadi) | | <code>feat!</code> / <code>BREAKING CHANGE:</code> | buzuvchi | MAJOR |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>git commit -m &quot;feat(auth): add OIDC login&quot;<br>git commit -m &quot;fix(api): handle nil pointer in /orders&quot;<br>git commit -m &quot;feat(api)!: remove v1 endpoints<br><br>BREAKING CHANGE: /v1/* o'chirildi, /v2 ishlating&quot;</pre><p>Tekshirish (commitlint + husky yoki CI'da):</p><pre>npx commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD</pre><p>Reliz: <code>semantic-release</code> yoki <code>release-please</code> commit'larni o'qib <code>v2.0.0</code> tag, CHANGELOG.md va GitHub Release yaratadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Squash merge'da PR sarlavhasi commit xabariga aylanadi — PR title'ni ham lint qil.</li><li>Hamma narsani <code>chore:</code> deb yozish — reliz chiqmaydi.</li><li>Breaking change'ni belgilashni unutish — eng xavfli xato.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monorepo'da <code>scope</code> paket nomiga mos bo'lsin — release-please har paketni alohida versiyalaydi. Qoidani faqat CI'da emas, PR title check bilan majburla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40562	<p>Linter nima va nega erta ishlashi kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linter — kodni ishga tushirmasdan tekshiradigan statik tahlil tool'i: sintaksis, uslub, shubhali konstruksiyalar (ishlatilmagan o'zgaruvchi, e'tiborsiz error). Pipeline'da birinchi ishlashi kerak, chunki eng arzon va eng tez (soniyalar).</p><p><b>Nega erta:</b> Agar lint 10 daqiqalik build va test'dan keyin yiqilsa — 10 daqiqa behuda. &quot;Fail fast&quot;: arzon tekshiruv oldin, qimmati keyin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>source -&gt; parser -&gt; AST -&gt; qoidalar -&gt; diagnostika (fayl:qator: xabar)<br>pre-commit (lokal, 1s) -&gt; CI lint job (30s) -&gt; build/test (min)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> | Til | Linter | |---|---| | Go | <code>golangci-lint</code> | | JS/TS | ESLint, Biome | | Python | Ruff | | Shell | ShellCheck | | Dockerfile | Hadolint | | YAML/K8s | yamllint, kube-linter |</p><pre>golangci-lint run ./...<br># internal/order/svc.go:42:9: Error return value of `tx.Rollback` is not checked (errcheck)<br>ruff check . --output-format=github   # PR'da inline annotation</pre><pre>jobs:<br>  lint:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6<br>  test:<br>    needs: lint</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski kodga yangi linter yoqib 3000 ta xato — jamoa linter'ni o'chiradi. Yechim: faqat yangi kodga (<code>--new-from-rev=origin/main</code>).</li><li>Lokal va CI'da turli linter versiyasi — &quot;menda o'tadi&quot;. Versiyani qotir.</li><li>Har joyda <code>// nolint</code> — sababsiz suppress.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Formatlashni (gofmt, prettier) avtomatik qil, review'da muhokama qilinmasin. Linter qoidalari jamoa kelishuvi — konfiguratsiya repo'da, versiyalangan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40563	<p>CI/CD'da secret masking nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secret masking — CI tizimi ro'yxatdan o'tgan secret qiymatlarini log'da ko'rsa, ularni <code>***</code> ga almashtiradi. Bu tasodifiy oqishdan himoya, lekin to'liq kafolat emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Debug uchun <code>env</code> yoki <code>echo $TOKEN</code> yozildi — log'da token ochiq. Public repo log'ini istalgan kishi o'qiydi; ichki log'lar ham ko'p odamga ochiq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>secret DB_PASS=&quot;s3cr3t&quot; ro'yxatda<br>step stdout: &quot;connecting with s3cr3t&quot;<br>runner log filtri: string match -&gt; &quot;connecting with ***&quot;</pre><p>Bu oddiy matn almashtirish — qiymat o'zgarsa (base64, URL-encode, bo'laklangan) filtr tanimaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions):</b></p><pre>steps:<br>  - run: echo &quot;token=${{ secrets.API_TOKEN }}&quot;   # log'da: token=***<br>  - name: Dinamik qiymatni maskalash<br>    run: |<br>      TOKEN=$(vault read -field=token secret/ci)<br>      echo &quot;::add-mask::$TOKEN&quot;<br>      echo &quot;TOKEN=$TOKEN&quot; &gt;&gt; &quot;$GITHUB_ENV&quot;</pre><p>GitLab: variable'ni &quot;Masked&quot; (va &quot;Protected&quot;) qilib belgilash; qiymat talablari bor (minimal uzunlik, belgilar to'plami).</p><p><b>Maskalash ushlamaydigan holatlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>echo $TOKEN | base64</code> — boshqa satr.</li><li>Qiymatni harflab chop etish (<code>echo ${TOKEN:0:5}</code>).</li><li>Artifact faylga yozish — artifact'lar maskalanmaydi.</li><li>Juda qisqa secret (<code>abc</code>) — mask ishlamaydi yoki hamma joyni buzadi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>set -x</code> (bash xtrace) — buyruqlarni argument bilan chop etadi.</li><li>Fork PR'lardan workflow secret'larni o'qishi.</li><li>Maskalashga ishonib, qisqa muddatli bo'lmagan statik kalit ishlatish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Masking — oxirgi himoya qatlami. Asosiysi: OIDC bilan qisqa muddatli credential, minimal scope, oqish shubhasida darhol rotate.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40564	<p>CI/CD'da webhook nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Webhook — biror hodisa sodir bo'lganda (push, PR ochildi, tag yaratildi) Git platformasi boshqa tizimga yuboradigan HTTP POST so'rov. CI server shu so'rovni olib pipeline'ni darhol ishga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Muqobil — polling: CI har daqiqada &quot;yangi commit bormi?&quot; deb so'raydi. Bu kechikish va keraksiz yuk. Webhook — &quot;push&quot; model: hodisa bo'lishi bilan xabar keladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dev: git push<br>      v<br>GitHub ---- POST /github-webhook ----&gt; Jenkins/Atlantis/ArgoCD<br> headers: X-GitHub-Event: push<br>          X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=...<br> body:    {&quot;ref&quot;:&quot;refs/heads/main&quot;,&quot;after&quot;:&quot;abc123&quot;,...}<br>      v<br>CI: imzoni tekshiradi -&gt; pipeline trigger</pre><p><b>Amalda (imzo tekshiruvi):</b></p><pre>import hmac, hashlib<br>def verify(secret: bytes, body: bytes, header: str) -&gt; bool:<br>    expected = &quot;sha256=&quot; + hmac.new(secret, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()<br>    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, header)</pre><p>GitHub: Settings -&gt; Webhooks -&gt; Payload URL, Content type <code>application/json</code>, Secret, Events. &quot;Recent Deliveries&quot; bo'limida har so'rov va javob kodi ko'rinadi, &quot;Redeliver&quot; bilan qayta yuborish mumkin.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret'siz webhook — har kim soxta &quot;push&quot; yuborib build ishga tushiradi.</li><li>CI server internetdan ko'rinmaydi (private network) — webhook yetib bormaydi. Yechim: reverse proxy, smee/relay yoki pull-based runner (GitHub Actions self-hosted runner o'zi ulanadi).</li><li>Webhook yo'qolishi mumkin — muhim tizimlarda zaxira polling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Webhook — at-least-once va tartibsiz kelishi mumkin; qabul qiluvchi idempotent bo'lsin (delivery ID bo'yicha dedup) va tez 2xx qaytarib, ishni asinxron bajarsin (GitHub 10 soniyada timeout qiladi).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40565	<p>Ephemeral / preview environment nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ephemeral (preview) environment — PR ochilganda avtomatik yaratiladigan, o'sha branch kodi ishlaydigan izolyatsiyalangan muhit; PR merge yoki yopilganda avtomatik o'chiriladi. Reviewer, QA va PM o'zgarishni jonli URL'da ko'radi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta umumiy <code>staging</code> — 10 ta jamoa navbat kutadi, biri buzsa hammaning testi to'xtaydi, &quot;staging'da kimning kodi turibdi?&quot; noma'lum.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PR #42 opened  -&gt; CI: build image pr-42 -&gt; namespace pr-42 -&gt; deploy<br>               -&gt; URL: https://pr-42.preview.example.com -&gt; PR comment<br>PR #42 updated -&gt; qayta deploy<br>PR #42 closed  -&gt; namespace pr-42 delete</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions + Helm):</b></p><pre>on:<br>  pull_request:<br>    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]<br>jobs:<br>  preview:<br>    if: github.event.action != 'closed'<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - run: |<br>          helm upgrade --install app-pr-${{ github.event.number }} ./chart \<br>            -n pr-${{ github.event.number }} --create-namespace \<br>            --set image.tag=${{ github.sha }} \<br>            --set ingress.host=pr-${{ github.event.number }}.preview.example.com<br>  cleanup:<br>    if: github.event.action == 'closed'<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - run: kubectl delete ns pr-${{ github.event.number }} --wait=false</pre><p>Tayyor yechimlar: GitLab Review Apps, Vercel/Netlify previews, ArgoCD ApplicationSet PR generator.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cleanup ishlamay qoladi — yuzlab &quot;yetim&quot; namespace va pul. TTL controller qo'y.</li><li>Har preview uchun to'liq DB — qimmat; seed data bilan kichik DB yoki shared DB + schema.</li><li>Preview'lar internetga ochiq — auth yoki IP cheklov.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Preview environment'ning qiymati feedback tezligida; xarajatni namespace kvotasi, scale-to-zero va TTL bilan boshqar. Tashqi bog'liqliklar (to'lov, email) uchun sandbox yoki mock.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40567	<p>Canary deployment nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Canary deployment — yangi versiyani avval trafikning kichik qismiga (1-10%) chiqarish, error rate va latency'ni kuzatish, sog'lom bo'lsa bosqichma-bosqich 100% gacha oshirish; yomon bo'lsa — faqat oz foydalanuvchi ta'sirlanadi va darhol orqaga qaytariladi.</p><p><b>Nega nomi shunday:</b> Konchilar kanareyka qushini shaxtaga olib kirgan — gaz bo'lsa qush birinchi ta'sirlanadi. Canary versiya ham &quot;birinchi qurbon&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>       Ingress / Service Mesh<br>        |95%          |5%<br>        v             v<br>     [stable v1]   [canary v2]<br>                      |<br>          metrikalar: 5xx, p99, saturation<br>                      |<br>       OK -&gt; 25% -&gt; 50% -&gt; 100%      Yomon -&gt; 0%, rollback</pre><p><b>Amalda (Argo Rollouts):</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: Rollout<br>spec:<br>  strategy:<br>    canary:<br>      canaryService: api-canary<br>      stableService: api-stable<br>      trafficRouting:<br>        nginx: { stableIngress: api }<br>      steps:<br>        - setWeight: 5<br>        - pause: { duration: 10m }<br>        - analysis: { templates: [ { templateName: success-rate } ] }<br>        - setWeight: 50<br>        - pause: { duration: 10m }</pre><pre>kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api --watch<br>kubectl argo rollouts abort api     # qo'lda to'xtatish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik juda kam — 5% dan 10 so'rov, statistik xulosa yo'q.</li><li>Faqat replika soni bilan canary (1 pod / 10 pod) — aniq foiz va sticky routing yo'q.</li><li>Canary DB'ga buzuvchi migratsiya yozsa — trafik qaytarilsa ham data buzilgan.</li><li>Session sticky emas — foydalanuvchi v1 va v2 orasida sakraydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Canary'ning kuchi — avtomatik analiz (SLO asosidagi metrikalar). Ichki xodimlar yoki bitta region bilan boshlash (ring deployment) real xavfni yanada kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40568	<p>Dark launching nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dark launching — yangi funksiyani production'ga chiqarish, lekin foydalanuvchiga ko'rsatmaslik: kod real trafik bilan ishlaydi (yoki shadow trafik oladi), natija UI'ga chiqmaydi. Maqsad — unumdorlik va barqarorlikni real yuk ostida, xavfsiz tekshirish.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Staging'dagi load test hech qachon real trafikni to'liq takrorlamaydi. Yangi recommendation engine 10x yuk bersa — buni foydalanuvchilar ko'rmasidan oldin bilish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>user request -&gt; API<br>                 |-- eski yo'l -&gt; javob foydalanuvchiga<br>                 |<br>                 +-- (flag yoqilgan, async) yangi yo'l -&gt; natija faqat log/metrikaga<br>                                                          (solishtirish)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>func (h *Handler) Search(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {<br>    res := h.oldSearch(r.Context(), q)<br>    if h.flags.Enabled(&quot;search-v2-dark&quot;, user) {<br>        go func() {<br>            ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)<br>            defer cancel()<br>            v2, err := h.newSearch(ctx, q)<br>            metrics.Compare(res, v2, err) // mismatch rate, latency<br>        }()<br>    }<br>    json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(res)<br>}</pre><p>Infra darajasida: Istio <code>mirror</code> (traffic shadowing) — so'rov nusxasi yangi servisga yuboriladi, javobi tashlanadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Side effect'lar: dark kod email yuborsa yoki to'lov yozsa — foydalanuvchiga ta'sir qiladi. Write yo'llarini o'chir.</li><li>Ikki baravar yuk DB'ga — asosiy servisni sekinlashtirishi mumkin.</li><li>Goroutine'lar timeout'siz — resurs oqishi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Dark launch'ni &quot;parallel run&quot; bilan birga ishlat: eski va yangi natijalar farqini o'lcha (mismatch rate), shunda migratsiya to'g'riligi ham isbotlanadi (GitHub Scientist pattern).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40569	<p>Feature flag (toggle) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Feature flag — kodda shart (<code>if flag.enabled(&quot;x&quot;)</code>), uning qiymati deploy qilmasdan runtime'da o'zgartiriladi. U deploy'ni (kod serverga chiqdi) release'dan (foydalanuvchi ko'rdi) ajratadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Tugallanmagan funksiyani <code>main</code> ga merge qilish (trunk-based), xavfli funksiyani 1% foydalanuvchiga yoqish, muammo bo'lsa redeploy'siz bir zumda o'chirish (kill switch).</p><p><b>Turlari:</b> | Tur | Umri | Misol | |---|---|---| | Release toggle | kunlar-haftalar | yangi checkout | | Experiment (A/B) | haftalar | tugma rangi | | Ops / kill switch | uzoq | og'ir hisobotni o'chirish | | Permission | doimiy | premium funksiya |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app -&gt; flag SDK (lokal cache) &lt;- streaming/poll &lt;- flag server (LaunchDarkly,<br>                                                    Unleash, Flagsmith, flagd)<br>rule: country=UZ AND percentage(user_id) &lt; 10%</pre><p><b>Amalda (OpenFeature, vendor-neytral API):</b></p><pre>client := openfeature.NewClient(&quot;checkout&quot;)<br>on, _ := client.BooleanValue(ctx, &quot;new-checkout&quot;, false,<br>    openfeature.NewEvaluationContext(user.ID, map[string]any{&quot;country&quot;: user.Country}))<br>if on {<br>    return newCheckout(ctx, cart)<br>}<br>return oldCheckout(ctx, cart)</pre><p>Default qiymat (<code>false</code>) — flag server ishlamasa xavfsiz yo'l.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski flag'lar o'chirilmaydi — yuzlab <code>if</code>, test kombinatsiyalari portlaydi. Har flag'ga owner va muddat.</li><li>Flag server'ga sinxron so'rov har request'da — latency va yagona nuqta xatosi.</li><li>Test'lar faqat bitta holatni tekshiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Flag — texnik qarz, uni yaratish bilan birga o'chirish tiketini och. Flag o'zgarishlari ham audit log va alert bilan kuzatilsin — ko'p insidentlar &quot;kimdir flag'ni bosdi&quot; dan boshlanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40571	<p>GitFlow nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitFlow — uzoq yashovchi <code>develop</code> va <code>main</code>(master) hamda vaqtinchalik <code>feature/*</code>, <code>release/*</code>, <code>hotfix/*</code> branch'lariga asoslangan model. Rejali, versiyalangan relizlar uchun mo'ljallangan; web servislarda uzluksiz yetkazishni sekinlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>main     o-----------------o--------o-------&gt;  (faqat reliz tag'lari)<br>          \               / \      /<br>hotfix     \             /   o----o  hotfix/1.4.1<br>            \           /<br>release      \     o---o  release/1.4 (stabilizatsiya)<br>              \   /     \<br>develop  o-----o-o---o---o--------&gt;<br>              /       \<br>feature    o-o         o-o</pre><p><b>Amalda (oqim):</b></p><pre>git switch develop &amp;&amp; git switch -c feature/payments<br># ... ish ...<br>git switch develop &amp;&amp; git merge --no-ff feature/payments<br>git switch -c release/1.4 develop     # faqat bug fix<br>git switch main &amp;&amp; git merge --no-ff release/1.4 &amp;&amp; git tag v1.4.0<br>git switch develop &amp;&amp; git merge --no-ff release/1.4   # orqaga merge</pre><p><b>Qachon o'rinli:</b></p><ul><li>Bir vaqtda bir nechta versiya qo'llab-quvvatlanadi (desktop, mobil, on-prem mahsulot).</li><li>Reliz tashqi jarayon bilan bog'liq (App Store review, sertifikatsiya).</li></ul><p><b>Qachon emas:</b> SaaS/web servis — kuniga bir necha deploy; bu yerda trunk-based yoki GitHub Flow.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>develop</code> va <code>main</code> ajralib ketadi — hotfix'ni ikkala joyga merge qilish unutiladi.</li><li>Uzoq feature branch'lar — katta conflict'lar.</li><li>Ikki uzoq branch tufayli CI aslida integratsiyani kechiktiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitFlow muallifi (Vincent Driessen) 2020-yilda o'zi web ilovalar uchun soddaroq modelni tavsiya qilgan. Model tanlash reliz ritmiga bog'liq: nechta versiyani parallel qo'llab-quvvatlaysiz?</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40572	<p>SAST nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SAST (Static Application Security Testing) — source kodni (yoki bytecode'ni) ishga tushirmasdan zaifliklarga tekshirish: SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded secret, xavfli funksiyalar, zaif kriptografiya. &quot;Whitebox&quot; — kod ichini ko'radi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Zaiflikni kod yozilgan PR'da topish production'dagi pentest'da topishdan ko'p barobar arzon. Dasturchi qaysi qatorda xato borligini darhol ko'radi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>source -&gt; AST + data flow (taint analysis)<br>   source: r.URL.Query(&quot;id&quot;)  (ishonchsiz kirish)<br>      |  oqim kuzatiladi<br>   sink: db.Query(&quot;SELECT ... &quot; + id)   -&gt; topildi: SQL injection</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>semgrep scan --config p/owasp-top-ten --error .<br>gosec ./...<br># G201 (CWE-89): SQL string formatting (Confidence: HIGH)<br>#   internal/repo/user.go:31</pre><pre>- uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3<br>  with: { languages: go }<br>- uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3</pre><p>Tool'lar: CodeQL, Semgrep, SonarQube, gosec, Bandit (Python), Checkmarx/Fortify (tijorat).</p><p><b>SAST vs boshqalar:</b> | | SAST | DAST | SCA | |---|---|---|---| | Nimani | O'z kodi | Ishlab turgan ilova | Dependency'lar | | Qachon | PR/commit | Staging | PR/commit |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>False positive ko'p — jamoa e'tibor bermay qo'yadi. Qoidalarni sozla, triage qil.</li><li>Runtime konfiguratsiya xatolarini (CORS, header) ko'rmaydi — buning uchun DAST.</li><li>Hamma narsani bloklash — boshida faqat HIGH/CRITICAL bilan gate.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SAST natijasini SARIF formatida PR'ga inline annotation qilib chiqar — dasturchi kontekstda ko'radi. Faqat yangi topilmalarga gate qo'y (baseline), eski qarzni alohida rejalashtir.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40573	<p>DAST nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing) — ishlab turgan ilovaga tashqaridan, hujumchi kabi so'rovlar yuborib zaifliklarni topish: injection, XSS, auth bypass, noto'g'ri header'lar, ochiq admin endpoint'lar. &quot;Blackbox&quot; — kodni ko'rmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Ba'zi muammolar faqat runtime'da ko'rinadi: server konfiguratsiyasi, TLS, cookie flag'lari, reverse proxy xatolari, framework default'lari. SAST bularni ko'rmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>DAST scanner -&gt; crawl (sahifa/endpoint'larni topadi)<br>             -&gt; har parametrga payload: ' OR 1=1--, &lt;script&gt;, ../../etc/passwd<br>             -&gt; javobni tahlil: xato matni, aks etgan payload, status<br>             -&gt; hisobot<br>target: staging (prod emas!)</pre><p><b>Amalda (OWASP ZAP):</b></p><pre># passive baseline (tez, xavfsiz) - PR/staging uchun<br>docker run -t ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-baseline.py \<br>  -t https://staging.example.com -r zap.html<br># API scan OpenAPI bo'yicha<br>docker run -t ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-api-scan.py \<br>  -t https://staging.example.com/openapi.json -f openapi</pre><p>Chiqish: <code>WARN-NEW: Cookie Without Secure Flag [10011] x 3</code>, <code>FAIL-NEW: ...</code>. Boshqa tool'lar: Burp Suite, Nuclei (shablonli), StackHawk.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prod'ga active scan — ma'lumot yozadi/o'chiradi, DoS qilishi mumkin.</li><li>Auth sozlanmagan — scanner faqat login sahifasini ko'radi.</li><li>Juda sekin (soatlar) — har PR'da to'liq scan emas; baseline PR'da, full nightly.</li><li>Qaysi qatorda xato ekanini aytmaydi — tuzatish qiyinroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DAST + SAST + SCA birgalikda qatlamli himoya beradi. Topilmalarni regression test'ga aylantir — bir marta tuzatilgan xato qaytmasin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40574	<p>SCA (Software Composition Analysis) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SCA (Software Composition Analysis) — loyihadagi ochiq kodli dependency'larni (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va tranzitiv) aniqlab, ma'lum zaifliklar (CVE) bazalari (NVD, OSV, GitHub Advisory) va litsenziyalar bo'yicha tekshirish.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Zamonaviy ilova kodining 80-90% — boshqalarning kutubxonalari. Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) misoli: o'z kodingiz toza, lekin tranzitiv <code>log4j</code> tufayli remote code execution.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>lockfile (go.sum, package-lock.json, pom.xml)<br>   -&gt; dependency daraxti (tranzitiv bilan)<br>   -&gt; har paket@versiya -&gt; OSV/NVD bazasi<br>   -&gt; CVE-2024-xxxx  pkg 1.2.0  fixed in 1.2.5  severity HIGH</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>govulncheck ./...          # Go: faqat chaqiriladigan zaif funksiyalarni ko'rsatadi<br>npm audit --audit-level=high<br>osv-scanner scan -r .<br>trivy fs --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 .</pre><p>Avtomatik yangilash: Dependabot yoki Renovate — zaif versiya uchun PR ochadi.</p><pre># .github/dependabot.yml<br>version: 2<br>updates:<br>  - package-ecosystem: gomod<br>    directory: /<br>    schedule: { interval: weekly }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har CVE'ga panika — ko'pi zaif kod yo'lini umuman chaqirmaydi. Reachability analizi (govulncheck) shovqinni kamaytiradi.</li><li>Lockfile yo'q — skaner real versiyani bilmaydi.</li><li>Litsenziya (GPL/AGPL) xavfini e'tiborsiz qoldirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SCA'ni SBOM bilan bog'la: yangi CVE chiqqanda &quot;qaysi servislarimizda bu paket bor?&quot; degan savolga daqiqalarda javob ber. Dependency yangilashni muntazam qil — katta sakrash xavfliroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40575	<p>CI'da mutation testing nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Mutation testing — kodga avtomatik kichik o'zgarishlar (mutantlar) kiritiladi: <code>&gt;</code> ni <code>&gt;=</code> ga, <code>+</code> ni <code>-</code> ga, <code>return true</code> ni <code>return false</code> ga. Keyin test'lar ishga tushiriladi: test yiqilsa — mutant &quot;o'ldirildi&quot; (yaxshi), test o'tsa — mutant &quot;tirik qoldi&quot;, ya'ni test'lar bu xatoni ushlamaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Code coverage faqat &quot;qator bajarildimi&quot; ni o'lchaydi, &quot;natija tekshirildimi&quot; ni emas. Assertion'siz test 100% coverage berishi mumkin. Mutation score test sifatini o'lchaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>original:  if age &gt;= 18 { return true }<br>mutant 1:  if age &gt;  18 { return true }   -&gt; test(18) yiqildi -&gt; killed<br>mutant 2:  if age &gt;= 18 { return false }  -&gt; testlar o'tdi    -&gt; SURVIVED (!)<br>mutation score = killed / total = 1/2 = 50%</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> | Til | Tool | |---|---| | Java | PIT (pitest) | | JS/TS | Stryker | | Python | mutmut | | Go | go-mutesting, gremlins |</p><pre>npx stryker run<br># Mutation score: 78.5%  Killed: 314  Survived: 86  Timeout: 2<br># [Survived] ConditionalExpression src/discount.ts:14:9</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Juda sekin: har mutant uchun test suite qayta ishlaydi. Har PR'da butun repo emas — faqat o'zgargan fayllar (incremental) yoki nightly.</li><li>&quot;Ekvivalent mutantlar&quot; — xulq o'zgarmaydi, o'ldirib bo'lmaydi; 100% maqsad emas.</li><li>Mutation score'ni KPI qilish — o'yinga aylanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Mutation testing'ni kritik biznes mantiq (narx, to'lov, ruxsat) uchun ishlat — u yerda zaif test qimmatga tushadi. Tirik mutantlar ro'yxati — &quot;qaysi test yozish kerak&quot; ning aniq ro'yxati.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40576	<p>CI/CD'da concurrency control nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Concurrency control — bir xil pipeline'ning parallel ishga tushishini boshqarish: PR'ga yangi commit kelsa eskirgan run bekor qilinadi (resurs tejash), deploy'da esa bir muhitga bir vaqtda faqat bitta deploy ishlaydi (race'ning oldini olish).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dev 1 daqiqada 3 marta push qildi — 3 ta pipeline ishlaydi, ikkitasi keraksiz. Yomonrog'i: ikki deploy bir vaqtda prod'ga ketsa, eski versiya yangisidan keyin tugab, prod'ni orqaga qaytarishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>group = &quot;ci-refs/heads/feat-x&quot;<br>run#1 ishlayapti -&gt; run#2 keldi -&gt; cancel-in-progress: true -&gt; run#1 bekor<br>group = &quot;deploy-prod&quot;<br>deploy#1 ishlayapti -&gt; deploy#2 keldi -&gt; cancel-in-progress: false -&gt; navbatda kutadi<br>(navbatda faqat 1 ta pending; yangisi kelsa eski pending bekor bo'ladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions):</b></p><pre># CI: eskirganini bekor qil<br>concurrency:<br>  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}<br>  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}<br><br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    concurrency:<br>      group: deploy-production<br>      cancel-in-progress: false   # deploy'ni yarmida uzma!</pre><p>GitLab: <code>interruptible: true</code> (eski pipeline'ni bekor qilish) va <code>resource_group: production</code> (deploy'ni ketma-ket qilish). Jenkins: <code>disableConcurrentBuilds()</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Deploy job'ida <code>cancel-in-progress: true</code> — <code>terraform apply</code> yoki migratsiya yarmida uziladi, state lock va buzuq holat.</li><li><code>main</code> dagi run'larni bekor qilish — har commit uchun artifact/status yo'qoladi.</li><li>Group nomi juda keng (<code>ci</code>) — boshqa branch'lar bir-birini bekor qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: tekshiruv (CI) — bekor qilsa bo'ladi; holat o'zgartiruvchi (deploy, apply, migrate) — hech qachon, faqat navbat. Deploy tartibini kafolatlash uchun versiyani monoton tekshir.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40577	<p>GitHub'da merge queue nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Merge queue — PR'larni <code>main</code> ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, navbat orqali merge qiladi: har PR <code>main</code> + navbatdagi oldingi PR'lar bilan birga test qilinadi. Faqat shu birlashgan holat yashil bo'lsa merge bo'ladi, shuning uchun <code>main</code> buzilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo (&quot;semantic conflict&quot;):</b> PR A funksiya nomini o'zgartirdi, PR B eski nom bilan yangi chaqiruv qo'shdi. Ikkalasi alohida yashil, Git conflict yo'q. Ikkalasi merge bo'lgach — <code>main</code> compile bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>main: M<br>queue: [PR-A] [PR-B] [PR-C]<br>  test: M+A        -&gt; ok<br>  test: M+A+B      -&gt; FAIL -&gt; B navbatdan chiqariladi<br>  test: M+A+C      -&gt; ok<br>merge: A, C   (main doim yashil)</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub):</b></p><ol><li>Branch protection / ruleset: &quot;Require merge queue&quot; yoqiladi.</li><li>Workflow <code>merge_group</code> hodisasiga ham javob berishi kerak:</li></ol><pre>on:<br>  pull_request:<br>  merge_group:<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - run: make test</pre><ol><li>PR'da &quot;Merge when ready&quot; tugmasi — PR navbatga tushadi. Vaqtinchalik branch <code>gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-42-...</code> da test qilinadi.</li></ol><p>GitLab ekvivalenti — Merge Trains.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Workflow'da <code>merge_group</code> trigger yo'q — navbat abadiy kutadi.</li><li>Flaky test'lar — navbat tez-tez &quot;qayta boshlanadi&quot;, throughput tushadi.</li><li>Sekin CI (30 daqiqa) + ko'p PR — navbat soatlab cho'ziladi; batch hajmini sozla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Merge queue kuniga o'nlab PR merge qilinadigan katta repo'larda kerak; kichik jamoada &quot;branch up-to-date bo'lishi shart&quot; qoidasi yetarli. Navbat tezligi CI tezligi va ishonchliligiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'liq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40578	<p>Self-hosted runner va cloud-hosted runner farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cloud-hosted runner — CI provayder (GitHub, GitLab) boshqaradigan, har job uchun toza VM; sozlash shart emas. Self-hosted runner — o'zingizning serveringiz/klasteringizda ishlaydi: private tarmoqqa kirish, GPU, katta mashina, arzonroq yirik hajm — lekin xavfsizlik va yangilash sizning zimmangizda.</p><p><b>Farq:</b> | | Cloud-hosted | Self-hosted | |---|---|---| | Boshqarish | Provayder | Siz (OS patch, scaling) | | Toza muhit | Har job yangi VM | Default holatda qayta ishlatiladi (!) | | Private tarmoq | Yo'q (yoki qimmat private networking) | Bor | | Hardware | Standart (+ larger runners) | Istalgan (GPU, ARM, 64 CPU) | | Narx | Daqiqa bo'yicha | Infra narxi | | Xavf | Past | Yuqori, ayniqsa public repo'da |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>self-hosted runner agent --(outbound HTTPS long-poll)--&gt; GitHub<br>   job keldi -&gt; bajaradi -&gt; natijani yuboradi<br>(inbound port ochish shart emas)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>./config.sh --url https://github.com/acme/app --token XXXX \<br>  --labels linux,x64,gpu --ephemeral<br>./run.sh</pre><pre>jobs:<br>  train:<br>    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, gpu]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Public repo + self-hosted runner: fork'dan PR serveringizda ixtiyoriy kod bajaradi. GitHub buni qat'iy tavsiya qilmaydi.</li><li>Persistent runner'da oldingi job qoldiqlari (fayl, Docker image, credential) keyingi job'ga o'tadi — <code>--ephemeral</code> ishlat.</li><li>Runner'ga keng IAM rol — har workflow uni oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Self-hosted'ni ephemeral qilib (ARC, autoscaling VM) va runner group'lar bilan qaysi repo foydalanishini cheklab ishlat. Ko'p hollarda &quot;larger runners&quot; yoki private networking narx/xavf jihatdan yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40579	<p>Actions Runner Controller (ARC) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Actions Runner Controller (ARC) — GitHub rasmiy qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan Kubernetes operatori: GitHub Actions self-hosted runner'larini pod sifatida, talabga qarab (0 dan N gacha) avtomatik yaratadi va har job'dan keyin o'chiradi (ephemeral).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Doimiy self-hosted runner VM'lari: kechasi bo'sh turadi (pul), kunduz yetmaydi (navbat), job'lar orasida iflos holat qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (Runner Scale Sets modeli):</b></p><pre>GitHub job navbati<br>     ^  long-poll (listener pod)<br>     |<br>ARC controller -&gt; EphemeralRunnerSet -&gt; runner pod (1 job) -&gt; o'chadi<br>     |                        min: 0, max: 50<br>Kubernetes klaster (node autoscaler pod'lar uchun node qo'shadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>helm install arc -n arc-systems --create-namespace \<br>  oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set-controller<br><br>helm install arc-runner-set -n arc-runners --create-namespace \<br>  --set githubConfigUrl=&quot;https://github.com/acme&quot; \<br>  --set githubConfigSecret=gh-app-secret \<br>  --set minRunners=0 --set maxRunners=30 \<br>  oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set</pre><pre>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: arc-runner-set   # installation nomi = label</pre><p>Autentifikatsiya uchun PAT emas, GitHub App afzal.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker build kerak — <code>containerMode: dind</code> privileged talab qiladi; xavfsizroq: BuildKit rootless yoki <code>kubernetes</code> mode.</li><li><code>minRunners: 0</code> — birinchi job pod va image tortilishini kutadi (cold start); image'ni kichik va cache'langan qil.</li><li>Eski community ARC (<code>summerwind</code>, RunnerDeployment CRD) bilan yangi Scale Sets'ni aralashtirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ARC runner pod'larini alohida node pool'da, NetworkPolicy va minimal IAM (IRSA/Workload Identity) bilan izolyatsiya qil — CI kodi ishonchsiz kod deb hisoblanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40580	<p>CI/CD'da OIDC nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OIDC (OpenID Connect) — CI job'i provayderdan imzolangan qisqa muddatli JWT oladi va uni cloud'da (AWS, GCP, Azure) vaqtinchalik credential'ga almashtiradi. Natijada repo'da statik <code>AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY</code> saqlanmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Statik kalitlar oqadi (log, fork, sobiq xodim), hech qachon rotate qilinmaydi va keng huquqli bo'ladi. Oqsa — oylar davomida ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. job -&gt; GitHub OIDC provider: token ber (aud=sts.amazonaws.com)<br>2. JWT: iss=token.actions.githubusercontent.com<br>        sub=repo:acme/api:ref:refs/heads/main<br>3. job -&gt; AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity(JWT, role)<br>4. AWS: imzo + trust policy shartlari (sub, aud) tekshiriladi<br>5. STS -&gt; vaqtinchalik credential (1 soat)</pre><p><b>Amalda (AWS trust policy):</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;Effect&quot;: &quot;Allow&quot;,<br>  &quot;Principal&quot;: { &quot;Federated&quot;: &quot;arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com&quot; },<br>  &quot;Action&quot;: &quot;sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity&quot;,<br>  &quot;Condition&quot;: {<br>    &quot;StringEquals&quot;: {<br>      &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud&quot;: &quot;sts.amazonaws.com&quot;,<br>      &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub&quot;: &quot;repo:acme/api:environment:production&quot;<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>GCP'da Workload Identity Federation, Azure'da Federated credentials — xuddi shu g'oya.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sub</code> sharti yo'q yoki <code>repo:acme/*</code> wildcard — boshqa repo/branch (hatto PR) prod rolini oladi.</li><li><code>permissions: id-token: write</code> berilmagan — token olinmaydi.</li><li>Rolga <code>AdministratorAccess</code> — OIDC credential qisqa, lekin zarar baribir katta.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod rolini <code>environment:production</code> claim'iga bog'la — shunda environment protection (reviewer) ham majburiy bo'ladi. OIDC + least privilege + CloudTrail audit — CI xavfsizligining asosi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40581	<p>SBOM nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) — artifact (image, binary) ichidagi barcha komponentlar: paketlar, kutubxonalar, versiyalar, tranzitiv dependency'lar va litsenziyalarning mashina o'qiydigan ro'yxati. Standart formatlar: SPDX va CycloneDX.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Yangi CVE chiqdi (masalan xz-utils backdoor, 2024). Savol: &quot;bizning qaysi image'larimizda shu versiya bor?&quot; SBOM bo'lmasa — har image'ni qo'lda tekshirasan. SBOM bo'lsa — bitta so'rov. AQSh EO 14028 va EU Cyber Resilience Act SBOM'ni talab qila boshladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build -&gt; image -&gt; syft (generate) -&gt; sbom.cdx.json<br>                                        |<br>       attestation (cosign attest) -&gt; registry<br>                                        |<br>       grype/trivy (scan SBOM) &lt;- yangi CVE bazasi (har kuni)<br>       Dependency-Track (portfel bo'yicha monitoring)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>syft registry.io/shop/api:1.4.2 -o cyclonedx-json &gt; sbom.cdx.json<br>grype sbom:./sbom.cdx.json --fail-on high<br>trivy image --format spdx-json -o sbom.spdx.json registry.io/shop/api:1.4.2<br>cosign attest --yes --type cyclonedx --predicate sbom.cdx.json registry.io/shop/api@sha256:9f..</pre><p>Docker BuildKit: <code>docker buildx build --sbom=true --provenance=true ...</code></p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SBOM yaratildi, lekin hech kim ishlatmaydi — fayl saqlanadi, monitoring yo'q.</li><li>Source'dan SBOM (lockfile) va image'dan SBOM farq qiladi — OS paketlari faqat image'da.</li><li>Statik binary'lar (Go) ichidagi modullar: syft Go build info'ni o'qiydi, lekin C kutubxonalarini ko'rmasligi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SBOM'ni artifact bilan imzolab birga saqla (attestation) va markaziy bazaga (Dependency-Track, GUAC) yubor — asosiy qiymat insident vaqtidagi &quot;blast radius&quot; so'rovi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40582	<p>Sigstore Cosign nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cosign — Sigstore loyihasining tool'i: container image va boshqa OCI artifact'larni imzolaydi va tekshiradi. &quot;Keyless&quot; rejimda uzoq muddatli kalit kerak emas: CI'ning OIDC identity'si bilan qisqa muddatli sertifikat olinadi, imzo ochiq Rekor transparency log'ga yoziladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Registry buzilsa yoki kimdir bir xil tag bilan zararli image push qilsa — klaster buni bilmaydi. Imzo &quot;bu image aynan bizning CI pipeline'imizdan chiqqan&quot; ekanini isbotlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (keyless):</b></p><pre>CI job -&gt; OIDC token -&gt; Fulcio (CA): 10 daqiqalik sertifikat<br>                       identity = https://github.com/acme/api/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main<br>cosign: digest'ni imzolaydi -&gt; imzo registry'ga (OCI artifact)<br>                            -&gt; Rekor log'ga yozuv<br>deploy: cosign verify / Kyverno / policy-controller -&gt; identity mosmi?</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>permissions: { id-token: write, packages: write }<br>steps:<br>  - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3<br>  - run: cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/acme/api@${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}</pre><pre>cosign verify ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:9f.. \<br>  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/acme/api/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main$' \<br>  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com</pre><p>Kalitli rejim: <code>cosign generate-key-pair</code> yoki KMS (<code>--key awskms://...</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tag'ni imzolash — tag ko'chadi; doim digest.</li><li>Imzolash bor, tekshirish yo'q — admission controller (Kyverno, Sigstore policy-controller) bo'lmasa foydasiz.</li><li><code>verify</code> da identity tekshirmaslik — har qanday GitHub workflow imzosi o'tib ketadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Imzo + SBOM + SLSA provenance attestation'larni birga qo'lla va klaster kirishida policy bilan majburla — bu supply-chain zanjirining yopilgan halqasi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40583	<p>SLSA framework nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, &quot;salsa&quot;) — OpenSSF framework'i: artifact qanday build qilinganini isbotlash darajalarini belgilaydi. Asosiy tushuncha — provenance: &quot;bu artifact qaysi source commit'dan, qaysi build platformasida, qanday parametrlar bilan qurilgan&quot; degan imzolangan attestation.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> SolarWinds (2020) hujumida zararli kod build serverida qo'shilgan — source toza edi. Source review ham, image imzosi ham buni ushlamaydi, agar build jarayonining o'zi ishonchli bo'lmasa.</p><p><b>SLSA v1.0 Build track darajalari:</b> | Daraja | Talab | |---|---| | L0 | Hech narsa | | L1 | Provenance mavjud (build jarayoni hujjatlangan) | | L2 | Hosted build platformasi, provenance imzolangan | | L3 | Izolyatsiyalangan build, provenance'ni build skripti soxtalashtira olmaydi |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>source@sha -&gt; hosted builder (izolyatsiya) -&gt; artifact digest<br>                    |<br>                    +-&gt; provenance (in-toto): builder.id, source uri+sha,<br>                        buildType, parametrlar -&gt; imzo<br>deploy: slsa-verifier: &quot;digest mos, source acme/api, builder ishonchli&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># GitHub artifact attestations (L2+, reusable workflow bilan L3)<br>permissions: { id-token: write, attestations: write, contents: read }<br>steps:<br>  - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2<br>    with:<br>      subject-name: ghcr.io/acme/api<br>      subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}</pre><pre>gh attestation verify oci://ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:9f.. --owner acme</pre><p>Alternativ: <code>slsa-framework/slsa-github-generator</code> + <code>slsa-verifier</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Provenance yaratiladi, lekin deploy'da tekshirilmaydi.</li><li>Self-hosted persistent runner — izolyatsiya yo'q, L3 da'vo qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>SLSA'ni &quot;kod xavfsiz&quot; deb tushunish — u faqat build yaxlitligini kafolatlaydi, bug'larni emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amaliy maqsad ko'pincha L3: reusable trusted build workflow + verify on deploy. SLSA'ni Sigstore va SBOM bilan birlashtir — &quot;nima ichida&quot; (SBOM), &quot;kim qurgan&quot; (provenance), &quot;o'zgarmagan&quot; (imzo).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40584	<p>Hermetic build nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Hermetic build — build tashqi muhitga bog'liq bo'lmaydi: internetga chiqmaydi, barcha input'lar (source, dependency, tool'lar) oldindan e'lon qilingan va hash bilan qotirilgan. Natija — bir xil input'dan har doim bir xil output (reproducible build).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>npm install</code> build vaqtida internetdan oladi: bugun bir versiya, ertaga boshqa; npm registry ishlamasa build yiqiladi; zararli paket yangilanishi (left-pad, event-stream) sezilmasdan kiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>e'lon qilingan input'lar (hash bilan):<br>  source@sha + deps (lockfile, sha256) + toolchain (go 1.23.2, sha256)<br>          |<br>   sandbox (network=none, fixed env, fixed timestamp)<br>          |<br>   output: bit-for-bit bir xil -&gt; sha256 har safar bir xil</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Go: dependency'larni oldindan olib, tarmoqsiz build<br>go mod download &amp;&amp; go mod verify<br>GOFLAGS=-mod=mod GOPROXY=off CGO_ENABLED=0 \<br>  go build -trimpath -ldflags=&quot;-buildid=&quot; -o app ./cmd/app<br><br># Docker: tarmoqni o'chirish<br>docker buildx build --network=none ...<br># Bazel: sandbox + http_archive(sha256=...)</pre><p>Lockfile'lar: <code>go.sum</code>, <code>package-lock.json</code> + <code>npm ci</code>, <code>poetry.lock</code>, Nix flake.lock. <code>SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH</code> — fayl vaqt belgilarini qotirish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Dockerfile'da <code>apt-get update &amp;&amp; apt-get install</code> — har build boshqa natija. Base image'ni digest bilan pin qil.</li><li><code>FROM node:20</code> — tag ko'chadi.</li><li>Build ichida vaqt, hostname, random yozish — reproducibility buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hermeticity SLSA L3+ va xavfsizlik uchun asos: ikki mustaqil build bir xil digest bersa, build serveri buzilmaganini isbotlaydi. To'liq hermetiklik qimmat — Bazel/Nix; amalda lockfile + pinned image + private proxy ko'p foyda beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40585	<p>Docker BuildKit layer caching nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> BuildKit layer caching — Docker image build'ida o'zgarmagan layer'larni qayta build qilmaslik. Ephemeral CI runner'larda lokal cache yo'qoladi, shuning uchun cache registry'ga (<code>type=registry</code>) yoki GHA cache'ga (<code>type=gha</code>) eksport qilinib, keyingi build'da import qilinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har CI run toza VM — <code>npm ci</code> va <code>go mod download</code> har safar noldan, build 8 daqiqa. Cache bilan — 1 daqiqa.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Dockerfile qatorlari = layer'lar, har birining cache key'i (instruction + input hash)<br>FROM golang:1.23         cache hit<br>COPY go.mod go.sum ./    hit (lockfile o'zgarmagan)<br>RUN go mod download      hit  &lt;- eng qimmati tejaldi<br>COPY . .                 MISS (kod o'zgardi)<br>RUN go build             MISS<br>bir layer miss bo'lsa -&gt; keyingi hammasi miss</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3<br>- uses: docker/build-push-action@v6<br>  with:<br>    push: true<br>    tags: ghcr.io/acme/api:${{ github.sha }}<br>    cache-from: type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/api:buildcache<br>    cache-to: type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/api:buildcache,mode=max</pre><p><code>mode=max</code> — multi-stage'ning oraliq stage'larini ham saqlaydi. Muqobil: <code>type=gha</code> (GitHub cache, 10 GB limit). Dependency cache uchun: <code>RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build go build ...</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>COPY . .</code> dependency o'rnatishdan oldin — har kod o'zgarishida cache yo'qoladi. Avval lockfile, keyin kod.</li><li><code>.dockerignore</code> yo'q — <code>.git</code> o'zgarishi cache'ni buzadi.</li><li><code>RUN apt-get update</code> cache'dan kelib eskirgan paketlar — xavfsizlik yangilanishi kirmaydi; vaqti-vaqti bilan <code>--no-cache</code> rebuild.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Dockerfile tartibi = cache strategiyasi: kam o'zgaradigan narsalar tepada. Cache'ni ham supply-chain qismi deb qara — PR'lar <code>main</code> cache'iga yozmasin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40586	<p>SonarQube Quality Gate nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Quality Gate — SonarQube'da kod sifati shartlari to'plami (masalan: yangi kodda coverage &gt;= 80%, yangi bug/zaiflik = 0, duplication &lt; 3%). Tahlil natijasi shartlardan o'tmasa — gate &quot;Failed&quot;, CI va PR merge bloklanadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;Sifatli kod yozamiz&quot; — kelishuv; Quality Gate — uni avtomatik majburlovchi mexanizm. Review'da odam ko'rmaydigan narsalarni (coverage tushishi, takror kod) tool ushlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CI: test + coverage -&gt; sonar-scanner -&gt; SonarQube server (tahlil)<br>                                             |<br>                       Quality Gate shartlari &quot;New Code&quot; bo'yicha<br>                                             |<br>                    PASSED -&gt; merge mumkin | FAILED -&gt; PR'da qizil status</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> Default &quot;Sonar way&quot; gate (yangi kod uchun): 0 yangi issue, barcha security hotspot'lar ko'rib chiqilgan, coverage &gt;= 80%, duplication &lt;= 3%.</p><pre>sonar-scanner \<br>  -Dsonar.projectKey=acme-api \<br>  -Dsonar.go.coverage.reportPaths=coverage.out \<br>  -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true \<br>  -Dsonar.qualitygate.timeout=300<br># Quality Gate status: FAILED -&gt; exit code 1</pre><p><b>&quot;Clean as You Code&quot; g'oyasi:</b> shartlar butun kodga emas, faqat yangi kodga qo'llanadi — eski qarz merge'ni bloklamaydi, lekin yangisi qo'shilmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Butun kod bo'yicha coverage &gt;= 80% sharti eski loyihada — hamma PR qizil, gate o'chiriladi.</li><li>Coverage'ni ko'tarish uchun assertion'siz test yozish.</li><li><code>qualitygate.wait</code> yo'q — scanner yuklaydi, lekin pipeline natijani kutmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Gate shartlarini kam va ma'noli qil (zaiflik, bug, yangi kod coverage); qolganini ma'lumot sifatida ko'rsat. Gate bloklasa, uni chetlab o'tish jarayoni ham aniq bo'lsin (kim, qachon, nega).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40587	<p>Code coverage nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Code coverage — test'lar ishlaganda source kodning qancha qismi bajarilganini ko'rsatuvchi foiz: line, branch, function coverage. U &quot;qaysi kod umuman test qilinmagan&quot; ni ko'rsatadi, lekin test sifatini o'lchamaydi.</p><p><b>Muhim farq:</b></p><pre>func Discount(p int, vip bool) int {<br>    if vip {           // branch: true / false<br>        return p * 90 / 100<br>    }<br>    return p<br>}<br>test: Discount(100, true)  -&gt; line coverage 66%, branch 50%<br>assertion yo'q bo'lsa ham coverage bir xil!</pre><p><b>Turlari:</b> | Tur | Nimani o'lchaydi | |---|---| | Line/statement | Bajarilgan qatorlar | | Branch | <code>if</code>/<code>switch</code> har yo'nalishi | | Function | Chaqirilgan funksiyalar | | Condition (MC/DC) | Har shart alohida (aviatsiya standartlari) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>go test -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic ./...<br>go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1<br># total: (statements) 74.3%<br>go tool cover -html=coverage.out     # qizil qatorlar = test qilinmagan<br><br>pytest --cov=app --cov-branch --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under=70<br>npx jest --coverage</pre><p>CI'da <code>coverage.xml</code> ni Codecov/SonarQube'ga yuborib PR'da &quot;bu PR coverage'ni -2.1% tushirdi&quot; ko'rsatiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>100% maqsad — getter va trivial kod uchun test, muhim edge case'lar baribir yo'q.</li><li>Coverage KPI bo'lsa — assertion'siz test'lar (Goodhart qonuni).</li><li>Integration test coverage'ini hisobga olmaslik (Go 1.20+ <code>go build -cover</code> bilan binary coverage mumkin).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Coverage'ni pastki chegara sifatida emas, &quot;ko'rinmas joylar xaritasi&quot; sifatida ishlat. Kritik modullarda branch coverage va mutation testing; diff coverage (faqat yangi kod) global foizdan foydaliroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40588	<p>Pipeline as Code nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pipeline as Code — CI/CD pipeline UI'da qo'lda sozlanmaydi, balki repo ichidagi faylda kod sifatida yoziladi: <code>.github/workflows/*.yml</code>, <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code>, <code>Jenkinsfile</code>. Pipeline ham kod kabi versiyalanadi, review qilinadi va branch'ga qarab o'zgaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> UI'da sozlangan Jenkins job: kim o'zgartirgani noma'lum, orqaga qaytarib bo'lmaydi, server o'lsa — hammasi yo'qoladi, yangi branch uchun nusxa qo'lda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>repo/<br>  src/...<br>  .github/workflows/ci.yml   &lt;- pipeline ta'rifi kod bilan birga<br>push -&gt; CI shu commit'dagi pipeline faylini o'qiydi -&gt; bajaradi<br>feature branch pipeline'ni o'zgartirsa -&gt; faqat o'sha branch'da sinaladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># .github/workflows/ci.yml<br>name: ci<br>on: [pull_request]<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - run: make test</pre><pre>// Jenkinsfile<br>pipeline {<br>  agent { label 'linux' }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Test') { steps { sh 'make test' } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Afzalliklari:</b> Git tarixi = audit; PR review pipeline o'zgarishiga ham; rollback = <code>git revert</code>; takrorlanadigan qismlar reusable workflow / shared library / <code>include</code> bilan.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pipeline faylini istalgan kishi o'zgartira oladi — PR'dan secret o'g'irlash yoki deploy qadamini o'chirish. CODEOWNERS bilan <code>.github/workflows/</code> ni himoyala.</li><li>1000 qatorlik YAML ichida bash — test qilinmaydi. Mantiqni <code>Makefile</code>/skriptga chiqar, YAML faqat orkestratsiya.</li><li>Har repo'da nusxa — reusable shablonlarga o'tkaz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pipeline'ni lokal ishga tushiriladigan qil (<code>make ci</code>, <code>act</code>, <code>gitlab-ci-local</code>) — CI vendor'ga bog'liqlik kamayadi va debug tezlashadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40589	<p>Monorepo CI strategiyasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Monorepo'da har commit'da hamma narsani build/test qilish juda sekin. Strategiya: o'zgargan fayllarni aniqlash -&gt; dependency graph orqali ta'sirlangan paketlarni topish -&gt; faqat ularni build/test qilish, natijalarni cache'lash (Nx, Turborepo, Bazel, Pants).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 50 servisli monorepo, bitta README o'zgardi — 50 servis 40 daqiqa test qilinadi. Yoki aksincha: faqat <code>services/api</code> test qilinadi, lekin u ishlatadigan <code>libs/auth</code> o'zgargani e'tibordan chetda qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>o'zgargan: libs/auth/token.go<br>dependency graph:<br>  libs/auth &lt;- services/api<br>            &lt;- services/billing<br>  libs/log  &lt;- hammasi<br>affected = { libs/auth, services/api, services/billing } -&gt; faqat shular<br>remote cache: hash(input) mos -&gt; natijani yuklab ol, qayta ishlatma</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>npx nx affected -t test --base=origin/main --head=HEAD<br>npx turbo run test --filter='...[origin/main]'<br>bazel test $(bazel query 'rdeps(//..., set(//libs/auth:all))')</pre><p>Oddiy variant — GitHub Actions path filter:</p><pre>on:<br>  pull_request:<br>    paths: ['services/api/**', 'libs/auth/**']</pre><p>Yoki <code>dorny/paths-filter</code> bilan job darajasida shartlar.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Path filter'lar qo'lda — <code>libs/</code> dependency'si unutiladi, buzuq kod merge bo'ladi.</li><li>Required status check + path filter: job ishlamasa PR &quot;kutayotgan&quot; holatda qotadi (skip bo'lgan job required bo'lsa).</li><li>Shallow clone (<code>fetch-depth: 1</code>) — base commit yo'q, diff hisoblanmaydi.</li><li>Root config (<code>go.mod</code>, <code>package.json</code>) o'zgarsa — hamma narsa affected bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Graph-aware tool + remote cache monorepo CI'ni masshtablaydi; path filter faqat kichik repo uchun. Vaqti-vaqti bilan (nightly) to'liq build qil — graph xatolarini ushlash uchun.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40590	<p>Pull-through cache nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pull-through cache — tashkilot ichidagi registry (Harbor proxy cache, ECR pull through cache, Artifactory, Nexus) tashqi registry (Docker Hub, ghcr.io, quay.io) uchun proksi bo'ladi: image birinchi so'rovda tashqaridan olinib saqlanadi, keyingilari lokal cache'dan beriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Docker Hub anonymous pull limiti (IP bo'yicha soatiga cheklangan) — NAT ortidagi 100 ta CI runner limitga darhol uriladi: <code>toomanyrequests: You have reached your pull rate limit</code>. Docker Hub ishlamasa — build va deploy to'xtaydi. Har pull tashqi trafik (NAT gateway narxi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>runner/k8s node -&gt; harbor.internal/dockerhub-proxy/library/nginx:1.27<br>                       |<br>                cache'da bormi? -- ha --&gt; darhol qaytar<br>                       | yo'q<br>                       v<br>              registry-1.docker.io -&gt; olib, saqlab, qaytar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># AWS ECR pull through cache qoidasi<br>aws ecr create-pull-through-cache-rule \<br>  --ecr-repository-prefix dockerhub \<br>  --upstream-registry-url registry-1.docker.io \<br>  --credential-arn arn:aws:secretsmanager:...:secret:ecr-pullthroughcache/dockerhub<br><br>docker pull 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/dockerhub/library/nginx:1.27</pre><p>containerd darajasida mirror (<code>/etc/containerd/certs.d/docker.io/hosts.toml</code>) — image nomlarini o'zgartirmasdan:</p><pre>server = &quot;https://registry-1.docker.io&quot;<br>[host.&quot;https://harbor.internal/v2/dockerhub-proxy&quot;]<br>  capabilities = [&quot;pull&quot;, &quot;resolve&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cache'dagi image'lar eskiradi — <code>latest</code> kabi tag'lar upstream'da yangilangan bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Cache'ga zaif image kiradi — proksi'da ham skanerlash (Harbor + Trivy).</li><li>Upstream credential'siz proksi ham limitga uriladi — autentifikatsiyalangan hisob ber.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pull-through cache — ishonchlilik (tashqi bog'liqlik ajratiladi), tezlik va narx masalasi. Prod uchun undan ham qat'iyrog'i: kerakli image'larni ichki registry'ga mirror qilib, faqat tasdiqlangan (skanerlangan, imzolangan) image'larga ruxsat berish.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40591	<p>CI/CD'da Automated Canary Analysis (ACA) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Automated Canary Analysis — canary versiyaning metrikalarini (error rate, latency, CPU) bir vaqtda ishlayotgan baseline bilan statistik solishtiradigan avtomatik jarayon. Natija &quot;pass&quot; bo'lsa rollout davom etadi, &quot;fail&quot; bo'lsa avtomatik rollback.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Qo'lda canary: muhandis Grafana'ga 10 daqiqa qaraydi, &quot;yaxshiga o'xshaydi&quot; deydi. Subyektiv, sekin, tunda hech kim qaramaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>stable (v1, 90%)   baseline (v1, 5%, yangi pod'lar)   canary (v2, 5%)<br>                         |                              |<br>                     metrikalar ------- solishtirish ---+<br>                         (Mann-Whitney U yoki threshold)<br>                         score: 92/100 -&gt; pass (chegara 80)</pre><p>Baseline nega kerak: canary yangi pod (cold cache) — eski uzoq ishlagan pod'lar bilan solishtirish adolatsiz; baseline ham yangi pod'lar, faqat eski versiya.</p><p><b>Amalda (Argo Rollouts AnalysisTemplate):</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: AnalysisTemplate<br>metadata: { name: success-rate }<br>spec:<br>  metrics:<br>    - name: success-rate<br>      interval: 1m<br>      count: 5<br>      failureLimit: 1<br>      successCondition: result[0] &gt;= 0.99<br>      provider:<br>        prometheus:<br>          address: http://prometheus:9090<br>          query: |<br>            sum(rate(http_requests_total{app=&quot;api&quot;,role=&quot;canary&quot;,code!~&quot;5..&quot;}[2m]))<br>            / sum(rate(http_requests_total{app=&quot;api&quot;,role=&quot;canary&quot;}[2m]))</pre><p>Kayenta (Spinnaker/Netflix) — statistik baseline vs canary solishtirish uchun klassik vosita.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik kam — statistik ahamiyat yo'q; yolg'on pass yoki fail.</li><li>Faqat texnik metrikalar — biznes metrika (checkout conversion) tushishi ko'rinmaydi.</li><li>Metrika label'larida canary/stable ajratilmagan — solishtirib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Analiz metrikalari SLO bilan mos bo'lsin. Analizning o'zi xato qilsa (Prometheus ishlamasa) — &quot;inconclusive&quot; holatda to'xtash, avtomatik davom etmaslik kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40592	<p>Flagger nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flagger — CNCF (Flux oilasi) Kubernetes operatori: oddiy Deployment uchun progressive delivery (canary, A/B, blue-green) ni avtomatlashtiradi. Trafikni service mesh yoki ingress (Istio, Linkerd, NGINX, Contour, Gateway API) orqali bosqichma-bosqich o'tkazadi va Prometheus metrikalariga qarab davom etadi yoki rollback qiladi.</p><p><b>Argo Rollouts'dan farqi:</b> Flagger mavjud <code>Deployment</code> ni o'zgartirmasdan ishlaydi (alohida <code>Canary</code> CR), Flux GitOps bilan tabiiy juftlik. Argo Rollouts — <code>Deployment</code> o'rniga <code>Rollout</code> CR va ArgoCD bilan yaqin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Deployment api (image o'zgardi)<br>     v<br>Flagger: api-primary (stable) + api-canary<br>     v<br>trafik: 0% -&gt; 10% -&gt; 20% ... -&gt; 50% (har interval metrika tekshiruvi)<br>     v<br>OK -&gt; canary image primary'ga ko'chiriladi, canary 0 ga scale<br>FAIL (threshold marta) -&gt; rollback, trafik 100% primary</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: flagger.app/v1beta1<br>kind: Canary<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  targetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }<br>  service: { port: 8080 }<br>  analysis:<br>    interval: 1m<br>    threshold: 5<br>    maxWeight: 50<br>    stepWeight: 10<br>    metrics:<br>      - name: request-success-rate<br>        thresholdRange: { min: 99 }<br>        interval: 1m<br>      - name: request-duration<br>        thresholdRange: { max: 500 }<br>        interval: 1m<br>    webhooks:<br>      - name: load-test<br>        url: http://flagger-loadtester/<br>        metadata: { cmd: &quot;hey -z 1m -q 10 http://api-canary:8080/&quot; }</pre><pre>kubectl describe canary api   # Events: Advance api.prod canary weight 20</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik bo'lmasa metrika yo'q — load tester webhook qo'sh.</li><li>HPA bilan ishlatganda <code>autoscalerRef</code> ni ko'rsatish kerak.</li><li>Service nomlari Flagger tomonidan boshqariladi — o'zing <code>api-primary</code> Service yaratma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Flagger yoki Argo Rollouts tanlovi asosan GitOps tool'iga bog'liq (Flux vs ArgoCD). Muhimi — rollout qarorini metrikaga topshirish va rollback'ni tezkor sinab ko'rish.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40593	<p>Argo Rollouts nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Argo Rollouts — Kubernetes controller va <code>Rollout</code> CRD: standart Deployment'ning rolling update'i o'rniga canary, blue-green, trafik ulushini boshqarish, avtomatik metrika analizi (AnalysisTemplate) va pauza/promote/abort imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kubernetes Deployment faqat rolling update biladi: foiz bo'yicha trafik bo'lish, metrikaga qarab to'xtash, bir zumda rollback yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Rollout (spec Deployment'ga o'xshash + strategy)<br>  -&gt; ReplicaSet stable, ReplicaSet canary<br>  -&gt; trafik routing: Istio/NGINX/ALB/Gateway API (aniq foiz)<br>  -&gt; steps: setWeight -&gt; pause -&gt; analysis -&gt; ...<br>  -&gt; AnalysisRun (Prometheus/Datadog/Job) -&gt; Successful | Failed -&gt; abort</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: Rollout<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  replicas: 10<br>  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  template: { ... Deployment pod template bilan bir xil ... }<br>  strategy:<br>    blueGreen:<br>      activeService: api-active<br>      previewService: api-preview<br>      autoPromotionEnabled: false<br>      prePromotionAnalysis:<br>        templates: [ { templateName: smoke-test } ]</pre><pre>kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api -w<br>kubectl argo rollouts promote api<br>kubectl argo rollouts abort api<br>kubectl argo rollouts undo api</pre><p>Mavjud Deployment'ni ko'chirmasdan <code>workloadRef</code> bilan ulash mumkin.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik routing sozlanmagan canary — faqat replika nisbati (aniq emas).</li><li>ArgoCD'da Rollout pauza holatida &quot;Progressing/Suspended&quot; — buni xato deb o'ylash.</li><li>HPA va <code>setWeight</code> — canary replika soni HPA bilan to'qnashmasligi uchun <code>setCanaryScale</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Argo Rollouts'ning qiymati — rollout qarorini insondan metrikaga ko'chirish. Analizni avval &quot;dry-run&quot; rejimda ishlatib, threshold'larni real ma'lumotda sozla, keyin bloklovchi qil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40595	<p>ArgoCD nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ArgoCD — Kubernetes uchun GitOps CD tool'i (CNCF graduated): <code>Application</code> resursida Git repo/path va maqsad klaster ko'rsatiladi; ArgoCD Git'dagi desired state'ni klasterdagi live state bilan doimiy solishtiradi, farqni (OutOfSync) ko'rsatadi va sync qiladi. Kuchli Web UI'ga ega.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Git repo (Helm/Kustomize/YAML)<br>     v  (har 3 daqiqa yoki webhook)<br>repo-server: manifestlarni render qiladi<br>     v<br>application-controller: desired vs live diff<br>     |-- Synced / OutOfSync<br>     |-- Healthy / Progressing / Degraded<br>     v<br>sync (auto yoki qo'lda) -&gt; kube-apiserver</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: Application<br>metadata: { name: api-prod, namespace: argocd }<br>spec:<br>  project: prod<br>  source:<br>    repoURL: https://github.com/acme/gitops<br>    path: apps/api/overlays/prod<br>    targetRevision: main<br>  destination:<br>    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc<br>    namespace: api<br>  syncPolicy:<br>    automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true }<br>    syncOptions: [ CreateNamespace=true ]</pre><pre>argocd app get api-prod<br>argocd app diff api-prod<br>argocd app sync api-prod<br>argocd app history api-prod &amp;&amp; argocd app rollback api-prod 12</pre><p>Ko'p ilova/klaster uchun: App-of-Apps yoki <code>ApplicationSet</code> (git, cluster, PR generator'lar).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>prune: true</code> — Git'dan o'chirilgan resurs klasterdan ham o'chadi (PVC ham!). Kerak bo'lsa <code>Prune=false</code> annotation.</li><li><code>selfHeal</code> — HPA o'zgartirgan <code>replicas</code> bilan doimiy kurash; manifestdan <code>replicas</code> ni olib tashla yoki <code>ignoreDifferences</code>.</li><li><code>AppProject</code> cheklovlarisiz — har jamoa istalgan namespace'ga deploy qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ArgoCD'ni SSO + RBAC + AppProject bilan multi-tenant qil; o'zini ham GitOps bilan boshqar. Sync wave va hook'lar bilan tartibni (CRD -&gt; operator -&gt; app) boshqar.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40596	<p>FluxCD nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flux (FluxCD) — CNCF graduated GitOps toolkit: alohida controller'lar to'plami (source, kustomize, helm, notification, image automation). Git yoki OCI manbadan klaster holatini avtomatik sinxronlaydi. ArgoCD'dan farqi — UI'siz, to'liq Kubernetes-native (hammasi CRD va <code>kubectl</code>/<code>flux</code> CLI orqali).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GitRepository / OCIRepository / HelmRepository   (source-controller: artifact oladi)<br>        v<br>Kustomization  (kustomize-controller: apply, prune, health check)<br>HelmRelease    (helm-controller: helm install/upgrade)<br>        v<br>klaster<br>ImageRepository + ImagePolicy + ImageUpdateAutomation:<br>   registry'da yangi tag -&gt; Git'ga commit (avtomatik image yangilash)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>flux bootstrap github --owner=acme --repository=fleet \<br>  --branch=main --path=clusters/prod --personal=false</pre><pre>apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1<br>kind: Kustomization<br>metadata: { name: api, namespace: flux-system }<br>spec:<br>  interval: 5m<br>  path: ./apps/api/prod<br>  prune: true<br>  sourceRef: { kind: GitRepository, name: fleet }<br>  healthChecks:<br>    - { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api, namespace: api }</pre><pre>flux get kustomizations<br>flux reconcile kustomization api --with-source<br>flux logs --level=error</pre><p><b>ArgoCD vs Flux:</b> | | ArgoCD | Flux | |---|---|---| | UI | Bor, kuchli | Yo'q (Weave GitOps/Headlamp plugin) | | Model | Application CR | Modulli controller'lar | | Image auto-update | Image Updater (alohida) | Ichida | | Multi-tenancy | AppProject | Namespace + service account |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>prune: true</code> bilan noto'g'ri path — resurslar o'chiriladi.</li><li>Kustomization'lar orasidagi tartib — <code>dependsOn</code> qo'yilmasa CRD'dan oldin CR apply bo'ladi.</li><li>Bootstrap token'ini keng huquq bilan qoldirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Platforma jamoasi UI'ni kamroq ishlatsa va hammasi kod orqali bo'lsa — Flux; dasturchilarga vizual ko'rinish muhim bo'lsa — ArgoCD. Ikkalasi ham Flagger/Argo Rollouts bilan progressive delivery qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40597	<p>Tekton nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tekton — Kubernetes'da CI/CD pipeline qurish uchun ochiq kodli framework (CD Foundation): <code>Task</code>, <code>Pipeline</code>, <code>TaskRun</code>, <code>PipelineRun</code> CRD'lari orqali. Har Task — pod, har step — konteyner. Tayyor mahsulot emas, platforma qurish uchun &quot;qurilish bloki&quot; (OpenShift Pipelines asosi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pipeline: clone -&gt; test -&gt; build-image -&gt; deploy<br>   |         |        |          |<br>PipelineRun yaratiladi -&gt; har Task = alohida Pod<br>   Task pod: step1 (container) -&gt; step2 (container) ...<br>   Task'lar orasida ma'lumot: Workspace (PVC) va Results<br>Tekton Triggers: webhook -&gt; EventListener -&gt; PipelineRun<br>Tekton Chains: TaskRun natijalarini imzolab SLSA provenance yaratadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1<br>kind: Task<br>metadata: { name: go-test }<br>spec:<br>  workspaces: [ { name: source } ]<br>  steps:<br>    - name: test<br>      image: golang:1.23<br>      workingDir: $(workspaces.source.path)<br>      script: |<br>        go test ./...<br>---<br>apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1<br>kind: Pipeline<br>metadata: { name: ci }<br>spec:<br>  workspaces: [ { name: src } ]<br>  tasks:<br>    - name: clone<br>      taskRef: { resolver: hub, params: [ {name: name, value: git-clone} ] }<br>      workspaces: [ { name: output, workspace: src } ]<br>    - name: test<br>      runAfter: [clone]<br>      taskRef: { name: go-test }<br>      workspaces: [ { name: source, workspace: src } ]</pre><pre>tkn pipeline start ci -w name=src,volumeClaimTemplateFile=pvc.yaml --showlog<br>tkn pipelinerun logs -f</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p YAML va past darajali — kichik jamoa uchun GitHub Actions/GitLab ancha sodda.</li><li>Workspace PVC'lar — sekin (attach) va tozalanmasa to'planadi.</li><li>UI cheklangan (Tekton Dashboard) — dasturchi tajribasi zaif.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tekton — o'z ichki CI platformasini Kubernetes ustida qurayotgan platforma jamoalari uchun; Chains orqali supply-chain xavfsizligi kuchli. Oddiy ehtiyojga managed CI arzonroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals

Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40599	<p>Gitleaks nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Gitleaks — Git repo, commit tarixi va fayllarda oqib ketgan secret'larni (API kalit, token, private key, parol) regex va entropiya qoidalari bilan topuvchi ochiq kodli tez skaner. Pre-commit hook'da (oqishdan oldin) va CI'da (o'tib ketganini ushlash) ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dasturchi <code>.env</code> yoki <code>config.go</code> dagi AWS kalitni commit qildi.
