Bildirishnoma, test hisobotlarini yig'ish, workspace tozalash uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (tartib):</b></p><pre>stages tugadi (natija: SUCCESS / FAILURE / UNSTABLE / ABORTED)<br>   v<br>always -&gt; changed -&gt; fixed -&gt; regression -&gt; aborted -&gt; failure<br>       -&gt; success -&gt; unstable -&gt; unsuccessful -&gt; cleanup (eng oxiri)<br>mos kelgan shartlar bajariladi</pre><p>| Shart | Qachon | |---|---| | <code>always</code> | Har doim | | <code>failure</code> | Yiqildi | | <code>unstable</code> | Test'lar yiqilgan (junit), build o'zi muvaffaqiyatli | | <code>fixed</code> | Oldingi yiqilgan edi, endi o'tdi | | <code>regression</code> | Oldingi o'tgan edi, endi yiqildi | | <code>cleanup</code> | Boshqalardan keyin, har doim |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent any<br>  stages {<br>    stage('Test') {<br>      steps { sh 'make test' }<br>      post {<br>        always { junit 'reports/**/*.xml' }   // stage darajasi<br>      }<br>    }<br>  }<br>  post {<br>    failure {<br>      slackSend channel: '#ci', color: 'danger',<br>        message: &quot;FAILED: ${env.JOB_NAME} #${env.BUILD_NUMBER} ${env.BUILD_URL}&quot;<br>    }<br>    fixed { slackSend channel: '#ci', color: 'good', message: &quot;FIXED: ${env.JOB_NAME}&quot; }<br>    cleanup { cleanWs() }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>post</code> ichidagi step yiqilsa — build natijasi o'zgaradi; bildirishnoma xatosi build'ni qizil qilmasligi uchun <code>catchError</code> yoki <code>try</code>.</li><li><code>always</code> ichida <code>cleanWs()</code> va keyin hisobot o'qish — fayllar yo'q; tozalashni <code>cleanup</code> ga qo'y.</li><li>Har muvaffaqiyatli build'ga Slack xabar — shovqin; <code>failure</code> + <code>fixed</code> yetarli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>fixed</code>/<code>regression</code> alert shovqinini keskin kamaytiradi — odamlar holat o'zgarishi haqida xabar oladi, takror qizil haqida emas. Test hisobotini <code>always</code> da yig' — aks holda aynan kerak bo'lganda (failure) hisobot yo'q.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40634	<p>Jenkins agent va controller farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Controller (oldingi nomi &quot;master&quot;) — Jenkins'ning &quot;miyasi&quot;: web UI, konfiguratsiya, job'lar va build tarixi, plugin'lar, pipeline'ni parse va rejalashtirish. Agent (oldingi &quot;slave&quot;) — build step'larini haqiqatda bajaradigan worker (VM, konteyner, pod). Controller'da build ishlatmaslik kerak: <code>numExecutors: 0</code>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            +----------------------+<br>            | Controller           |  UI, queue, scheduler,<br>            | (JENKINS_HOME)       |  credential'lar, plugin'lar<br>            +----------------------+<br>               |  remoting (inbound TCP/WebSocket yoki SSH)<br>     +---------+----------+-------------+<br>     v                    v             v<br> agent linux-1      agent windows    k8s pod (ephemeral)<br> label: linux go    label: windows   label: docker</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline {<br>  agent { label 'linux &amp;&amp; go' }    // label bo'yicha agent tanlash<br>  stages { stage('Build') { steps { sh 'go build ./...' } } }<br>}</pre><pre># JCasC: controller'da executor yo'q<br>jenkins:<br>  numExecutors: 0<br>  nodes:<br>    - permanent:<br>        name: linux-1<br>        labelString: &quot;linux go&quot;<br>        remoteFS: /home/jenkins<br>        launcher:<br>          ssh: { host: 10.0.1.15, credentialsId: agent-ssh }</pre><p>Diagnostika: Manage Jenkins -&gt; Nodes (online/offline, disk, clock), <code>/computer/linux-1/log</code>.</p><p><b>Nega controller'da build yo'q:</b></p><ul><li>Build kodi controller fayl tizimiga (credential'lar, <code>secrets/</code>, konfiguratsiya) kira oladi — xavfsizlik.</li><li>Og'ir build controller'ni sekinlashtiradi — butun UI va scheduler ta'sirlanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Controller yagona nuqta (SPOF) — HA yo'q (open source'da), <code>JENKINS_HOME</code> backup shart.</li><li>Agent'lar doimiy va iflos — oldingi build qoldiqlari; ephemeral agent'lar afzal.</li><li>Agent va controller Java versiyalari mos kelmasligi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Controller'ni kichik va barqaror ushla (kam plugin, JCasC), hamma ishni ephemeral agent'larga ber. Juda katta Jenkins'ni bitta ulkan controller o'rniga bir nechta jamoa controller'lariga bo'lish ko'pincha osonroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40635	<p>Jenkins controller'ni zararli agent'lardan qanday himoyalaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Agent buzilgan deb faraz qilib himoya qil: Agent -&gt; Controller security (agent controller'da fayl o'qish/yozish va buyruq bajarishni cheklash) yoqiq bo'lsin (Jenkins 2.326+ da doim yoqiq), remoting orqali CLI o'chirilsin, agent'lar ephemeral va izolyatsiyalangan bo'lsin, controller'da build ishlamasin, credential'lar minimal scope bilan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Agent'da ishonchsiz kod ishlaydi (PR'lar, dependency skriptlari). Agar agent controller'ga erkin murojaat qila olsa — <code>JENKINS_HOME/secrets/</code> dan barcha credential'larni o'g'irlash yoki controller'da kod bajarish mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build kodi (ishonchsiz) -&gt; agent jarayoni<br>   | remoting kanali<br>   v<br>controller: Agent-&gt;Controller filtr: ruxsat etilmagan callable/fayl kirishi -&gt; rad<br>agent ko'radigan narsa: faqat o'z workspace'i va berilgan credential'lar</pre><p><b>Amalda (choralar ro'yxati):</b></p><pre>jenkins:<br>  numExecutors: 0                      # controller'da build yo'q<br>  remotingSecurity:<br>    enabled: true                      # agent -&gt; controller himoyasi<br>  slaveAgentPort: -1                   # TCP inbound port o'chiq, WebSocket ishlat<br>security:<br>  globalJobDslSecurityConfiguration:<br>    useScriptSecurity: true</pre><ul><li>Agent'lar: Kubernetes pod (ephemeral), alohida namespace, NetworkPolicy (faqat controller va kerakli manzillar), <code>privileged: false</code>, <code>runAsNonRoot</code>.</li><li>Credential'lar: folder darajasida, faqat kerakli job'lar ko'radi; prod credential'lari alohida agent pool'da.</li><li>Ishonch zonalari: PR build'lari alohida agent'larda, prod deploy agent'lariga ulanmaydi.</li><li>Plugin'larni yangilab turish — Jenkins security advisory'lari.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir agent'da ham PR build, ham prod deploy — PR kodi prod credential'larini oladi.</li><li>Script approval'da &quot;hammasini approve&quot; — sandbox chetlab o'tiladi.</li><li>Eski JNLP agent port ochiq va internetga ko'rinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jenkins xavfsizligi — ishonch zonalarini ajratish: kim kod yozadi, qayerda ishlaydi, qaysi credential'ni ko'radi. Controller'ni internetdan yashirib, SSO va RBAC bilan himoyala.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40636	<p>GitHub Actions <code>step-security/harden-runner</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>step-security/harden-runner</code> — GitHub Actions runner uchun EDR-ga o'xshash agent: job'ning tarmoq chiqishlarini (egress), DNS so'rovlarini, jarayonlar va fayl o'zgarishlarini kuzatadi; <code>audit</code> rejimida xulqni yozadi, <code>block</code> rejimida ruxsat etilmagan domenlarga chiqishni bloklaydi. Supply-chain hujumlarini (secret exfiltration) aniqlash uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2025-yil <code>tj-actions/changed-files</code> hodisasi: mashhur action buzilib, CI log'lariga secret'larni chiqardi. Harden-Runner aynan shunday g'ayritabiiy tarmoq chaqiruvini aniqlab bergan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job boshida harden-runner agent ishga tushadi<br>   step'lar -&gt; outbound ulanishlar -&gt; agent kuzatadi<br>   audit: hammasi yoziladi -&gt; insights sahifasi (qaysi step qaysi domenga)<br>   block: allowed-endpoints ro'yxatida yo'q -&gt; bloklanadi + alert</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@v2   # amalda commit SHA bilan pin qil<br>        with:<br>          egress-policy: block<br>          allowed-endpoints: &gt;<br>            github.com:443<br>            api.github.com:443<br>            proxy.golang.org:443<br>            sum.golang.org:443<br>            ghcr.io:443<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - run: go build ./...</pre><p>Jarayon: avval <code>egress-policy: audit</code> bilan bir necha run -&gt; insights'dan kerakli domenlar ro'yxati -&gt; <code>block</code> ga o'tish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Darhol <code>block</code> — build'lar sababsiz yiqiladi; avval audit.</li><li>Faqat GitHub-hosted Linux runner va ba'zi self-hosted sozlamalarda to'liq ishlaydi.</li><li>Ruxsat ro'yxatiga <code>*.amazonaws.com</code> kabi keng domenlar — hujumchi ham o'sha cloud'dan foydalanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Harden-Runner — qatlamlardan biri: action'larni SHA bilan pin qilish, <code>permissions</code> minimal, OIDC va Dependabot (actions ecosystem) bilan birga ishlat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40637	<p>Composite action'da <code>using: &quot;composite&quot;</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>runs.using: &quot;composite&quot;</code> — <code>action.yml</code> ichida action turini e'lon qiladi: bu action JavaScript (<code>node20</code>) yoki Docker (<code>docker</code>) emas, balki <code>runs.steps</code> ro'yxatidagi oddiy step'lardan (<code>run</code> va <code>uses</code>) iborat composite action.</p><p><b>Action turlari:</b> | <code>using</code> | Qanday ishlaydi | Qachon | |---|---|---| | <code>composite</code> | Step'lar ketma-ketligi, runner'da bevosita | Mavjud buyruq va action'larni birlashtirish | | <code>node20</code> (yangi <code>node24</code>) | JS fayl (<code>main: dist/index.js</code>) | Murakkab mantiq, GitHub API | | <code>docker</code> | Konteyner (<code>image: Dockerfile</code>) | Maxsus muhit; faqat Linux runner |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>uses: ./.github/actions/lint<br>  runner action.yml ni o'qiydi -&gt; using: composite<br>  -&gt; steps[0] run (shell: bash) -&gt; steps[1] uses: actions/setup-python ...<br>  hammasi chaqiruvchi job'ning runner va workspace'ida</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># .github/actions/lint/action.yml<br>name: Lint<br>description: Python lint (ruff) ishga tushiradi<br>inputs:<br>  path: { description: tekshiriladigan papka, default: '.' }<br>runs:<br>  using: &quot;composite&quot;<br>  steps:<br>    - uses: actions/setup-python@v5<br>      with: { python-version: '3.12' }<br>    - run: pip install ruff==0.6.9<br>      shell: bash<br>    - run: ruff check &quot;${{ inputs.path }}&quot; --output-format=github<br>      shell: bash<br>    - run: echo &quot;lint tugadi&quot; &gt;&gt; &quot;$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY&quot;<br>      shell: bash</pre><p>Action ichidagi fayllarga yo'l: <code>${{ github.action_path }}/script.sh</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>run</code> step'da <code>shell:</code> yozilmasa — <code>Required property is missing: shell</code>.</li><li><code>${{ inputs.x }}</code> ni <code>run</code> ichiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'yish — injection xavfi; <code>env:</code> orqali ber.</li><li>Composite ichida <code>if:</code> va <code>continue-on-error</code> qo'llab-quvvatlanadi, lekin <code>timeout-minutes</code> step darajasida cheklangan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Oddiy birlashtirish uchun composite, tashqi API va murakkab mantiq uchun JS action. Node 20 runtime ham eskirish jadvalida — JS action'larni yangilab tur.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40638	<p>GitLab CI <code>include</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>include</code> — GitLab CI'da tashqi YAML fayllarni pipeline'ga qo'shish: <code>local</code> (shu repo'dagi fayl), <code>project</code> + <code>file</code> (boshqa GitLab loyihasidan, <code>ref</code> bilan), <code>remote</code> (URL), <code>template</code> (GitLab tayyor shablonlari), <code>component</code> (CI/CD Catalog komponentlari). Pipeline'ni modullashtirish va markaziy shablonlarni qayta ishlatish uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>.gitlab-ci.yml<br>  include:<br>    - local: ci/test.yml<br>    - project: acme/ci-templates, ref: v3.1.0, file: go.yml<br>    - component: gitlab.com/acme/components/sast@2.0.0<br>  -&gt; barcha fayllar birlashtiriladi (merged YAML)<br>  -&gt; lokal ta'riflar include qilinganlarni ustidan yozadi (deep merge)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>include:<br>  - local: 'ci/lint.yml'<br>  - project: 'acme/ci-templates'<br>    ref: 'v3.1.0'                 # tag bilan pin<br>    file: ['/templates/go.yml', '/templates/docker.yml']<br>  - template: 'Jobs/Secret-Detection.gitlab-ci.yml'<br>  - component: '$CI_SERVER_FQDN/acme/components/deploy@1.4.0'<br>    inputs:<br>      environment: production<br><br># shablondagi job'ni moslashtirish<br>go-test:<br>  variables:<br>    GO_VERSION: &quot;1.23&quot;</pre><p>Shablonda <code>extends</code> va <code>!reference</code> bilan qayta ishlatish:</p><pre>.go-base:<br>  image: golang:$GO_VERSION<br>deploy:<br>  extends: .go-base<br>  script:<br>    - !reference [.setup, script]<br>    - ./deploy.sh</pre><p>Natijani ko'rish: Pipeline editor -&gt; &quot;Full configuration&quot; tab.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ref</code> siz <code>project</code> include — default branch; shablon o'zgarsa hamma loyiha buziladi.</li><li><code>remote</code> include — tashqi URL'dan kod bajarish (supply-chain xavfi), ishonchli manba bilan cheklang.</li><li>Merge qoidalari: ro'yxatlar (<code>script</code>) birlashtirilmaydi, butunlay almashtiriladi — kutilmagan natija.</li><li>Ichma-ich include chuqurligi va soni cheklangan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy usul — CI/CD Components: versiyalangan, typed <code>inputs</code> bilan, katalogda ko'rinadigan. Platforma jamoasi uchun bu ichki &quot;kutubxona&quot; — SemVer va changelog bilan boshqar.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40639	<p>GitHub Actions <code>runner.temp</code> va <code>runner.workspace</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>runner.temp</code> — har job uchun vaqtinchalik papka, job boshida bo'sh va tugagach tozalanadi (oraliq fayllar, kalit fayllari uchun). <code>runner.workspace</code> — workspace'ning ota papkasi (<code>/home/runner/work/&lt;repo&gt;</code>); repo odatda <code>github.workspace</code> ga (<code>/home/runner/work/&lt;repo&gt;/&lt;repo&gt;</code>) checkout qilinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (GitHub-hosted Linux):</b></p><pre>/home/runner/work/<br>  _temp/                 &lt;- runner.temp  (RUNNER_TEMP), job'dan keyin tozalanadi<br>  api/                   &lt;- runner.workspace<br>    api/                 &lt;- github.workspace (GITHUB_WORKSPACE), checkout shu yerga<br>/opt/hostedtoolcache     &lt;- runner.tool_cache (setup-* action'lar)</pre><p>| O'zgaruvchi | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>runner.temp</code> / <code>$RUNNER_TEMP</code> | Vaqtinchalik fayllar | | <code>github.workspace</code> / <code>$GITHUB_WORKSPACE</code> | Repo checkout joyi, step'lar default working dir | | <code>runner.workspace</code> | Workspace ota papkasi | | <code>runner.tool_cache</code> | O'rnatilgan tool'lar cache'i |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>steps:<br>  - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>  - name: Kubeconfig'ni vaqtinchalik faylga yozish<br>    run: |<br>      echo &quot;$KUBECONFIG_B64&quot; | base64 -d &gt; &quot;$RUNNER_TEMP/kubeconfig&quot;<br>      chmod 600 &quot;$RUNNER_TEMP/kubeconfig&quot;<br>      echo &quot;KUBECONFIG=$RUNNER_TEMP/kubeconfig&quot; &gt;&gt; &quot;$GITHUB_ENV&quot;<br>    env: { KUBECONFIG_B64: '${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_B64 }}' }<br>  - run: kubectl get ns<br>  - run: |<br>      echo &quot;temp=$RUNNER_TEMP workspace=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE&quot;<br>      ls &quot;${{ runner.workspace }}&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret fayllarni <code>github.workspace</code> ga yozish — keyingi <code>upload-artifact path: .</code> bilan artifact'ga tushib qoladi. <code>runner.temp</code> ishlat.</li><li>Self-hosted (persistent) runner'da workspace job'lar orasida saqlanadi — oldingi build qoldiqlari. <code>runner.temp</code> tozalanadi, workspace esa yo'q.</li><li>Yo'llarni hardcode qilish (<code>/home/runner/...</code>) — Windows/macOS va self-hosted'da buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yo'llarni doim kontekst o'zgaruvchilaridan ol. Ephemeral runner bo'lmasa, job oxirida workspace tozalash (<code>if: always()</code>) qadamini qo'sh.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40640	<p>GitLab CI'da Docker-in-Docker (dind)'ni qanday xavfsiz ishlatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Docker-in-Docker (dind) <code>privileged: true</code> talab qiladi — konteyner host kernel'iga deyarli to'liq kirish oladi, ya'ni CI job'i runner host'ni egallashi mumkin. Xavfsizlashtirish: imkon qadar dind'dan voz kechib daemon'siz/rootless build tool'lariga o'tish (BuildKit rootless, Buildah, Podman); dind majbur bo'lsa — TLS yoqish, alohida ephemeral runner, ishonchli loyihalar bilan cheklash.</p><p><b>Variantlar solishtirmasi:</b> | Usul | Privileged | Xavf | Izoh | |---|---|---|---| | dind + TLS | Ha | Yuqori | Izolyatsiyalangan runner'da | | Docker socket mount (<code>/var/run/docker.sock</code>) | Yo'q, lekin | Juda yuqori | Host daemon'ga to'liq root | | BuildKit rootless | Yo'q (seccomp/apparmor sozlash) | Past | Tavsiya | | Buildah / Podman | Yo'q | Past | OCI, daemon'siz | | Kaniko | Yo'q | Past | 2025 da arxivlangan |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (dind):</b></p><pre>job konteyner (docker CLI) --TLS:2376--&gt; service konteyner docker:dind (privileged)<br>                                             |<br>                                       host kernel</pre><p><b>Amalda (dind majbur bo'lsa):</b></p><pre>build:<br>  image: docker:27<br>  services:<br>    - name: docker:27-dind<br>  variables:<br>    DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2376<br>    DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: &quot;/certs&quot;<br>    DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: 1<br>    DOCKER_CERT_PATH: &quot;/certs/client&quot;<br>  tags: [ isolated-dind ]           # faqat shu maqsaddagi runner<br>  script:<br>    - docker build -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA .</pre><p>Afzal variant (BuildKit rootless):</p><pre>build:<br>  image: moby/buildkit:rootless<br>  variables:<br>    BUILDKITD_FLAGS: --oci-worker-no-process-sandbox<br>  script:<br>    - buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0<br>        --local context=. --local dockerfile=.<br>        --output type=image,name=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA,push=true</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: &quot;&quot;</code> (TLS o'chiq) — tarmoqdagi boshqa konteynerlar daemon'ga 2375 orqali ulanadi.</li><li>Umumiy (shared) runner'da privileged — bir loyiha boshqa loyiha job'lariga kira oladi.</li><li>Socket mount'ni &quot;privileged emas, demak xavfsiz&quot; deb o'ylash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI runner'ni ishonchsiz kod bajaradigan joy deb qara. Image build'ni rootless tool'ga o'tkazish ko'pincha bir kunlik ish, lekin butun bir hujum sinfini yo'q qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40641	<p>Kaniko nima va nega Kubernetes'da image build uchun afzal?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kaniko — Google'ning ochiq kodli tool'i: Dockerfile'dan container image'ni Docker daemon'siz va privileged rejimsiz, oddiy konteyner (masalan Kubernetes pod) ichida build qiladi. <b>Muhim:</b> Google 2025-yilda loyihani arxivladi (yangi rivojlanish va xavfsizlik tuzatishlari yo'q); yangi loyihalar uchun BuildKit (rootless) yoki Buildah tavsiya etiladi (Chainguard fork'ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi).</p><p><b>Nega afzal edi:</b> Kubernetes'da Docker daemon yo'q (containerd), dind esa privileged talab qiladi. Kaniko Dockerfile buyruqlarini userspace'da bajarib, fayl tizimi snapshot'laridan layer yasaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kaniko executor (konteyner ichida)<br>  1. base image'ni yuklab, o'z root fayl tizimiga ochadi<br>  2. har RUN/COPY -&gt; buyruqni bevosita bajaradi<br>  3. fayl tizimi snapshot -&gt; o'zgargan fayllar = yangi layer<br>  4. image'ni registry'ga push<br>(daemon yo'q, privileged yo'q, lekin konteyner ichida root)</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitLab):</b></p><pre>build:<br>  image:<br>    name: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:debug<br>    entrypoint: [&quot;&quot;]<br>  script:<br>    - /kaniko/executor<br>        --context &quot;$CI_PROJECT_DIR&quot;<br>        --dockerfile &quot;$CI_PROJECT_DIR/Dockerfile&quot;<br>        --destination &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA&quot;<br>        --cache=true --cache-repo &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE/cache&quot;</pre><p>Registry auth: <code>/kaniko/.docker/config.json</code>.</p><p><b>Alternativalar (2025-2026):</b> | Tool | Holat | |---|---| | BuildKit rootless (<code>buildctl</code>) | Faol, tez, keng qo'llab-quvvatlangan | | Buildah | Faol, Red Hat | | Kaniko (Chainguard fork) | Fork orqali qo'llab-quvvatlanadi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kaniko konteynerni root sifatida ishlatadi — &quot;rootless&quot; emas, faqat &quot;privileged'siz&quot;.</li><li>Multi-stage va katta build'larda sekin (snapshot'lash).</li><li>Arxivlangan tool — yangi CVE'lar tuzatilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tool tanlashda loyiha holati (maintenance, xavfsizlik tuzatishlari) funksiya kabi muhim. Kaniko'dan BuildKit'ga ko'chish odatda bir necha qator o'zgarish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40642	<p>Buildah nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Buildah — Red Hat (containers loyihasi) yaratgan CLI tool: OCI va Docker formatidagi image'larni daemon'siz va root'siz (rootless) build qiladi. Dockerfile/Containerfile'dan (<code>buildah build</code>) yoki skript orqali qadam-baqadam (<code>from</code>, <code>run</code>, <code>copy</code>, <code>commit</code>) image yasaydi. Podman ichida ham shu kutubxona ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Docker daemon root huquqida doimiy ishlaydi — hujum yuzasi. Buildah har buyruq uchun oddiy jarayon, user namespace orqali rootless — CI va Kubernetes'da xavfsizroq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>buildah (oddiy foydalanuvchi)<br>  -&gt; user namespace (uid 0 konteyner ichida = uid 100000 host'da)<br>  -&gt; storage driver (overlay/fuse-overlayfs, vfs)<br>  -&gt; layer'lar -&gt; OCI image -&gt; push<br>daemon yo'q: jarayon tugadi = hammasi tugadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Dockerfile bilan<br>buildah build -t ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2 -f Containerfile .<br>buildah push ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2<br><br># skript bilan (Dockerfile'siz)<br>ctr=$(buildah from gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12)<br>buildah copy $ctr ./bin/api /api<br>buildah config --entrypoint '[&quot;/api&quot;]' --user 65532 $ctr<br>buildah commit $ctr ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2</pre><p>GitLab/Kubernetes'da:</p><pre>build:<br>  image: quay.io/buildah/stable<br>  variables:<br>    STORAGE_DRIVER: vfs<br>    BUILDAH_ISOLATION: chroot<br>  script:<br>    - buildah login -u &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_USER&quot; -p &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD&quot; &quot;$CI_REGISTRY&quot;<br>    - buildah build -t &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA&quot; .<br>    - buildah push &quot;$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rootless konteyner ichida user namespace ruxsat etilmagan — <code>BUILDAH_ISOLATION=chroot</code> va <code>vfs</code> (sekinroq) kerak bo'ladi.</li><li><code>vfs</code> storage — har layer to'liq nusxa, disk va vaqt ko'p.</li><li>Docker'ga xos Dockerfile kengaytmalari (ba'zi BuildKit <code>--mount</code> sintaksislari) to'liq mos kelmasligi mumkin.</li><li><code>buildah login -p</code> — parol <code>ps</code> da; <code>--password-stdin</code> ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Buildah + Podman + Skopeo — Red Hat/OpenShift ekotizimida standart; BuildKit esa Docker ekotizimida. Tanlov jamoa ekotizimiga bog'liq — ikkalasi ham daemon'siz va rootless.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40643	<p><code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> — har workflow job'i uchun GitHub avtomatik yaratadigan installation access token (GitHub App token). Faqat shu repo'ga ta'sir qiladi, huquqlari <code>permissions:</code> bloki bilan cheklanadi va job tugashi bilan (maksimal 24 soat) bekor bo'ladi. Secret yaratish shart emas: <code>${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}</code> yoki <code>${{ github.token }}</code>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Workflow repo'ga komment yozishi, release yaratishi, package push qilishi, PR label qo'yishi kerak. Shaxsiy PAT ishlatish — uzoq muddatli, odamga bog'liq, keng huquqli. <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> qisqa muddatli va avtomatik.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job boshlandi -&gt; GitHub App token (repo scope, permissions bo'yicha)<br>   -&gt; steps: gh CLI, actions/checkout, API chaqiruvlar<br>job tugadi -&gt; token yaroqsiz</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>permissions:<br>  contents: read<br>jobs:<br>  comment:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    permissions:<br>      pull-requests: write          # job darajasida kengaytirish<br>    steps:<br>      - run: gh pr comment &quot;$PR&quot; --body &quot;Build OK&quot;<br>        env:<br>          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}<br>          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}</pre><p><b>Muhim xususiyatlar:</b> | Xususiyat | Tafsilot | |---|---| | Rekursiya himoyasi | <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> bilan qilingan push/PR yangi workflow'ni ishga tushirmaydi (<code>workflow_dispatch</code> va <code>repository_dispatch</code> bundan mustasno) | | Fork PR | Faqat read huquqi, secret'larsiz | | Default huquq | Org/repo sozlamasi: &quot;read&quot; (tavsiya) yoki &quot;read and write&quot; |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Release workflow <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> bilan tag push qiladi, lekin &quot;on: push tags&quot; workflow ishga tushmaydi — rekursiya himoyasi. GitHub App token kerak.</li><li>Boshqa repo'ga yozish — <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> bilan bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>pull_request_target</code> + PR kodini checkout — fork kodi write token bilan ishlaydi (klassik &quot;pwn request&quot;).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Org darajasida default'ni &quot;read&quot; qil va har workflow'da <code>permissions:</code> ni aniq yoz. Repo'lar orasidagi ish uchun PAT emas, GitHub App token.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40644	<p>GitHub Actions'da least-privilege permissions qanday qo'yiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Workflow boshida (top-level) <code>permissions:</code> ni minimal qilib yoz (masalan <code>contents: read</code>), keyin faqat kerak bo'lgan job'da kengaytir (<code>id-token: write</code>, <code>packages: write</code>). <code>permissions</code> e'lon qilinsa, ko'rsatilmagan barcha scope'lar <code>none</code> bo'ladi. Org/repo default'ini &quot;Read repository contents&quot; ga o'tkaz.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Eski repo'larda default <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> &quot;read and write&quot; — buzilgan third-party action kodni o'zgartira, release yarata, workflow'ni o'zgartira oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>org default (read) <br>   -&gt; workflow permissions: { contents: read }      (qolganlari none)<br>      -&gt; job build: meros oladi (contents: read)<br>      -&gt; job publish: permissions: { contents: read, packages: write, id-token: write }<br>job darajasidagi permissions workflow darajasini to'liq almashtiradi (birlashtirmaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name: release<br>on: { push: { tags: ['v*'] } }<br>permissions:<br>  contents: read<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps: [ { uses: actions/checkout@v4 }, { run: make test } ]<br>  publish:<br>    needs: test<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    permissions:<br>      contents: write        # GitHub Release yaratish<br>      packages: write        # ghcr.io push<br>      id-token: write        # OIDC / cosign keyless<br>      attestations: write    # build provenance<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - run: make release</pre><p>Asosiy scope'lar: <code>contents</code>, <code>pull-requests</code>, <code>issues</code>, <code>packages</code>, <code>id-token</code>, <code>actions</code>, <code>checks</code>, <code>deployments</code>, <code>security-events</code>, <code>attestations</code>. Qiymatlar: <code>read</code>, <code>write</code>, <code>none</code>. Tekshirish: job log'ining boshida &quot;GITHUB_TOKEN Permissions&quot; bo'limi beriladigan huquqlarni ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Job darajasida faqat <code>id-token: write</code> yozish — <code>contents</code> endi <code>none</code>, <code>actions/checkout</code> private repo'da yiqiladi.</li><li><code>permissions: write-all</code> — qulay, lekin maqsadga zid.</li><li><code>pull_request</code> fork'dan — yozish huquqi baribir berilmaydi; buni chetlab o'tish uchun <code>pull_request_target</code> ishlatish xavfli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Least privilege'ni avtomatik tekshir: OpenSSF Scorecard yoki <code>zizmor</code> workflow'larni keng permission, pin qilinmagan action va injection xavfi uchun skanerlaydi — CI'ga qo'sh.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40645	<p>GitHub Actions'da cron job qanday ishga tushiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>on: schedule</code> va POSIX cron ifodasi: <code>- cron: '0 2 * * *'</code> — har kuni 02:00 <b>UTC</b> da. Workflow faqat default branch'dagi fayl bo'yicha ishlaydi; vaqt aniq kafolatlanmaydi (yuklama paytida kechikadi yoki ba'zan tashlab ketiladi), eng kichik interval — 5 daqiqa.</p><p><b>Cron formati:</b></p><pre> +------------ daqiqa (0-59)<br> | +---------- soat (0-23, UTC!)<br> | | +-------- oy kuni (1-31)<br> | | | +------ oy (1-12)<br> | | | | +---- hafta kuni (0-6, 0=yakshanba)<br> | | | | |<br> 0 2 * * *      har kuni 02:00 UTC (Toshkent 07:00)<br> 30 4 * * 1-5   ish kunlari 04:30 UTC<br> */15 * * * *   har 15 daqiqa<br> 0 0 1 * *      har oy 1-sanasi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name: nightly<br>on:<br>  schedule:<br>    - cron: '17 2 * * *'       # &quot;toq&quot; daqiqa - :00 dagi tirbandlikdan qochish<br>  workflow_dispatch:           # qo'lda ham ishga tushirish uchun<br>jobs:<br>  e2e:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    timeout-minutes: 60<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - run: make e2e<br>      - if: failure()<br>        run: gh issue create --title &quot;Nightly failed $(date -u +%F)&quot; --body &quot;$RUN_URL&quot;<br>        env:<br>          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}<br>          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}</pre><p><code>github.event.schedule</code> — qaysi cron ifodasi ishga tushirganini bildiradi (bir nechta cron bo'lsa).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mahalliy vaqt deb o'ylash — hammasi UTC (Toshkent = UTC+5).</li><li>Public repo'da 60 kun faollik bo'lmasa scheduled workflow'lar avtomatik o'chiriladi.</li><li><code>0 * * * *</code> — butun dunyo shu vaqtni tanlaydi, kechikish ko'p; toq daqiqa tanla.</li><li>Aniq vaqt kerak bo'lgan biznes ish (to'lov, hisobot) uchun Actions cron'ga tayanish — Kubernetes CronJob yoki cloud scheduler ishonchliroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Scheduled job yiqilganini hech kim ko'rmaydi — failure'da issue/alert yarat. Bir xil ishning ikki marta bajarilishiga chidamli (idempotent) qil, chunki qayta ishga tushirish kerak bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40646	<p>GitLab CI o'zgaruvchilar ierarxiyasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab CI'da bir xil nomli o'zgaruvchi bir necha joyda e'lon qilinsa, ustunlik (yuqori yutadi) taxminan: pipeline execution policy / scan execution policy &gt; pipeline o'zgaruvchilari (manual run, trigger, schedule, API) &gt; project CI/CD variables &gt; group (ichki group ustun) &gt; instance &gt; <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code> job <code>variables</code> &gt; global <code>variables</code> &gt; deployment variables &gt; predefined variables. UI'da berilgan o'zgaruvchi YAML'dagini bosib ketadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>predefined: CI_COMMIT_SHA ...                (eng past)<br>YAML global:   LOG_LEVEL=info<br>YAML job:      LOG_LEVEL=debug               (global'ni yengadi)<br>instance -&gt; group -&gt; subgroup -&gt; project UI: LOG_LEVEL=warn  (YAML'ni yengadi)<br>manual run / API: LOG_LEVEL=trace            (deyarli eng yuqori)<br>job ichida natija: trace</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variables:<br>  LOG_LEVEL: info<br>  DEPLOY_ENV: staging<br><br>deploy:<br>  variables:<br>    LOG_LEVEL: debug<br>  script:<br>    - echo &quot;LOG_LEVEL=$LOG_LEVEL DEPLOY_ENV=$DEPLOY_ENV&quot;</pre><pre># API orqali pipeline o'zgaruvchisi bilan ishga tushirish (eng yuqori ustunlik)<br>glab ci run -b main --variables LOG_LEVEL:trace</pre><p>Project variable sozlamalari: Protected (faqat protected branch/tag), Masked / Masked and hidden, Expand variable reference, Environment scope (<code>production</code>, <code>review/*</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>YAML'da o'zgaruvchini o'zgartirib, lekin project UI'da shu nom borligini bilmaslik — o'zgarish ta'sir qilmaydi.</li><li>Protected variable unprotected branch'da bo'sh — job jim yiqiladi yoki noto'g'ri qiymat ishlatadi.</li><li>Pipeline o'zgaruvchilarini istalgan developer bera oladi — xavfsizlik uchun ularni cheklash mumkin (project sozlamasida faqat Maintainer'larga ruxsat).</li><li>Aniq tartib GitLab versiyalari bilan o'zgargan — rasmiy hujjatdagi &quot;CI/CD variable precedence&quot; ni tekshir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Secret'lar faqat UI/external secret manager'da (Vault, cloud) va environment scope bilan; YAML'da faqat sir bo'lmagan default'lar. Muhim deploy o'zgaruvchilarini pipeline darajasida o'zgartirishni rol bilan chekla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40647	<p>Jenkins Pipeline Syntax Generator nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pipeline Syntax Generator (Snippet Generator) — Jenkins ichidagi web sahifa (<code>&lt;jenkins-url&gt;/pipeline-syntax</code>, yoki job sahifasida &quot;Pipeline Syntax&quot; havolasi): ro'yxatdan step (masalan <code>checkout</code>, <code>withCredentials</code>, <code>junit</code>) tanlab, formani to'ldirasan va u to'g'ri Groovy snippet'ini yaratib beradi. Declarative Directive Generator — <code>options</code>, <code>when</code>, <code>agent</code> kabi direktivalar uchun.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Har plugin o'z step sintaksisiga ega va hujjatlari tarqoq. Generator aynan sizning Jenkins'ingizda o'rnatilgan plugin versiyalari bo'yicha snippet beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/pipeline-syntax<br>  Sample Step: [withCredentials: Bind credentials to variables]<br>  Bindings: Secret text -&gt; Variable: TOKEN, Credentials: npm-token<br>  [Generate Pipeline Script]<br>        v<br>withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'npm-token', variable: 'TOKEN')]) {<br>    // some block<br>}</pre><p><b>Amalda (foydali sahifalar):</b> | URL | Nima | |---|---| | <code>/pipeline-syntax</code> | Snippet Generator | | <code>/pipeline-syntax/html</code> | Barcha step'lar ma'lumotnomasi (o'rnatilgan plugin'lar bo'yicha) | | <code>/pipeline-syntax/globals</code> | Global o'zgaruvchilar: <code>env</code>, <code>params</code>, <code>currentBuild</code> | | Declarative Directive Generator | <code>options</code>, <code>triggers</code>, <code>when</code> va boshqalar |</p><p>Misol natija (checkout):</p><pre>checkout scmGit(<br>  branches: [[name: '*/main']],<br>  userRemoteConfigs: [[credentialsId: 'gh-app', url: 'https://github.com/acme/api.git']]<br>)</pre><p>Declarative'ni tekshirish (linter):</p><pre>curl -X POST -F &quot;jenkinsfile=&lt;Jenkinsfile&quot; https://jenkins.example.com/pipeline-model-converter/validate</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Generator ba'zan barcha default parametrlarni yozadi — snippet keraksiz uzun; ortiqchasini olib tashla.</li><li>Snippet o'rnatilgan plugin versiyasiga bog'liq — boshqa Jenkins'da ishlamasligi mumkin.</li><li>Generatorda credential tanlash — credential ID Jenkinsfile'ga yoziladi, qiymat emas (bu to'g'ri), lekin ID nomlanishi standart bo'lsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Generator — o'rganish va tez snippet uchun; takrorlanadigan qismlarni shared library'ga chiqar va Jenkinsfile'larni linter bilan CI'da tekshir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40648	<p>CI'da SonarQube Scanner nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SonarQube Scanner — CI'da ishlaydigan klient: loyiha kodini (va test/coverage hisobotlarini) tahlil qilib natijani SonarQube serverga (yoki SonarQube Cloud'ga) yuboradi, keyin (sozlansa) Quality Gate natijasini kutib, pipeline'ni o'tkazadi yoki yiqitadi. Turli variantlari bor: <code>sonar-scanner</code> CLI, Maven/Gradle plugin, .NET scanner, GitHub/GitLab integratsiyalari.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CI: test -&gt; coverage.out / lcov.info / jacoco.xml<br>   v<br>sonar-scanner: kodni lokal tahlil qiladi -&gt; hisobot -&gt; SonarQube server<br>   v<br>server: background task (Compute Engine) -&gt; issue'lar, coverage, duplication<br>   v<br>Quality Gate: PASSED/FAILED -&gt; scanner (qualitygate.wait=true) -&gt; exit code<br>   v<br>PR decoration: MR/PR'da izoh va status</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># sonar-project.properties<br>sonar.projectKey=acme_api<br>sonar.sources=.<br>sonar.exclusions=**/*_test.go,**/vendor/**<br>sonar.tests=.<br>sonar.test.inclusions=**/*_test.go<br>sonar.go.coverage.reportPaths=coverage.out</pre><pre># GitHub Actions<br>- uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>  with: { fetch-depth: 0 }            # blame va yangi kod aniqlash uchun<br>- run: go test -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...<br>- uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action@v5<br>  env:<br>    SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}<br>    SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ vars.SONAR_HOST_URL }}<br>  with:<br>    args: -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fetch-depth: 1</code> (shallow) — &quot;new code&quot; va blame noto'g'ri, ogohlantirish chiqadi.</li><li>Coverage hisobot yo'li noto'g'ri — SonarQube 0% ko'rsatadi, xato bermaydi.</li><li>Test fayllarini <code>sources</code> ga qo'shish — duplication va issue'lar sun'iy oshadi.</li><li>Token'ni log'ga chiqarish; Global Analysis Token o'rniga loyiha token'i ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Scanner natijasini PR'ga (decoration) chiqar — dasturchi kontekstda ko'radi. Tahlilni test job'idan keyin, lekin merge'ni bloklash faqat &quot;new code&quot; shartlari bo'yicha bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40649	<p>GitLab Review Apps nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Review Apps — GitLab funksiyasi: har branch yoki merge request uchun dinamik environment (masalan <code>review/feature-x</code>) avtomatik deploy qilinadi, MR sahifasida &quot;View app&quot; havolasi chiqadi; branch o'chirilganda yoki MR yopilganda <code>on_stop</code> job'i muhitni o'chiradi. GitLab'dagi ephemeral/preview environment ko'rinishi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>MR ochildi (branch feature-x)<br>  -&gt; deploy_review job: environment review/feature-x<br>     url: https://feature-x.review.example.com<br>  -&gt; MR sahifasida &quot;View app&quot; tugmasi<br>MR merge/yopildi yoki auto_stop_in muddati tugadi<br>  -&gt; stop_review job (on_stop) -&gt; namespace o'chiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>deploy_review:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  image: alpine/helm:3.16<br>  script:<br>    - helm upgrade --install &quot;review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG&quot; ./chart<br>        -n &quot;review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG&quot; --create-namespace<br>        --set image.tag=$CI_COMMIT_SHA<br>        --set ingress.host=$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.review.example.com<br>  environment:<br>    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG<br>    url: https://$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.review.example.com<br>    on_stop: stop_review<br>    auto_stop_in: 3 days<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;<br><br>stop_review:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  image: alpine/helm:3.16<br>  variables:<br>    GIT_STRATEGY: none          # branch o'chgan bo'lishi mumkin<br>  script:<br>    - helm uninstall &quot;review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG&quot; -n &quot;review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG&quot;<br>    - kubectl delete ns &quot;review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG&quot; --wait=false<br>  environment:<br>    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG<br>    action: stop<br>  rules:<br>    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == &quot;merge_request_event&quot;<br>      when: manual</pre><p>Operate -&gt; Environments sahifasida barcha review muhitlar va &quot;Stop&quot; tugmasi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>GIT_STRATEGY: none</code> yo'q — branch o'chirilgach stop job checkout qila olmay yiqiladi va muhit abadiy qoladi.</li><li><code>auto_stop_in</code> yo'q — unutilgan muhitlar pul yeydi.</li><li><code>CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG</code> 63 belgidan uzun bo'lishi mumkin — DNS/namespace chegarasi.</li><li>Review app'lar prod secret'lari bilan — alohida, cheklangan credential'lar ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Review App'ning qiymati — reviewer va PM o'zgarishni kod o'qimasdan ko'radi. Narxni boshqarish (TTL, kvota, kichik replika, umumiy DB) dizaynning bir qismi bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H12 GHA, GitLab & Jenkins deep dive	idrill-40650	<p>GitHub Actions <code>continue-on-error</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>continue-on-error: true</code> — step (yoki job) yiqilsa ham job/workflow muvaffaqiyatsiz deb belgilanmaydi va keyingi step'lar davom etadi. Muhim bo'lmagan qadamlar uchun: eksperimental linter, ixtiyoriy hisobot yuklash, yangi til versiyasidagi matrix job.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>step A: OK<br>step B (continue-on-error: true): exit 1<br>   -&gt; steps.B.outcome    = failure<br>   -&gt; steps.B.conclusion = success   (job uchun)<br>step C: ishlaydi<br>job natijasi: success (yashil, B'da ogohlantirish belgisi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    strategy:<br>      fail-fast: false<br>      matrix:<br>        go: ['1.22', '1.23']<br>        experimental: [false]<br>        include:<br>          - go: '1.24'<br>            experimental: true<br>    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}   # job darajasi<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - id: newlint<br>        continue-on-error: true                     # step darajasi<br>        run: golangci-lint run --enable-only=newcheck ./...<br>      - name: Lint natijasini xabar qilish<br>        if: steps.newlint.outcome == 'failure'<br>        run: echo &quot;::warning::Yangi lint qoidalari buzilgan, hozircha bloklamaydi&quot;<br>      - run: go test ./...</pre><p><code>outcome</code> — haqiqiy natija, <code>conclusion</code> — <code>continue-on-error</code> qo'llangandan keyingisi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Muhim step'ga (test, xavfsizlik skaneri) qo'yish — xatolar jim o'tib ketadi, pipeline doim yashil.</li><li><code>if: failure()</code> keyingi step'da ishlamaydi — chunki job &quot;failure&quot; emas; <code>steps.&lt;id&gt;.outcome</code> ni tekshir.</li><li>Vaqtinchalik qo'yilgan <code>continue-on-error</code> abadiy qoladi — TODO va muddat qo'y.</li><li>GitLab ekvivalenti <code>allow_failure: true</code> (pipeline sariq &quot;warning&quot; bilan).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>continue-on-error</code> — yangi qoidani &quot;audit rejimida&quot; joriy qilish vositasi: avval ogohlantirish, jamoa tuzatgach — bloklovchi qilish. Natijani ko'rinadigan qil (warning, summary), aks holda hech kim e'tibor bermaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cicd sec::h12 GHA_GitLab_Jenkins_deep_dive
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40651	<p>GitOps nima (CD kontekstida)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitOps — deploy modeli: klaster va infra'ning kerakli holati (desired state) Git'da deklarativ saqlanadi, klaster ichidagi agent (ArgoCD, Flux) Git'ni o'qib (pull), live holatni unga muttasil moslaydi (reconcile). Deploy = Git'ga merge.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klassik push-CD'da CI pipeline <code>kubectl apply</code> qiladi. Natija: CI'da prod kubeconfig/admin token saqlanadi (CI buzilsa — prod ham buziladi), kimdir qo'lda <code>kubectl edit</code> qilsa hech kim bilmaydi, &quot;prod'da hozir nima turibdi?&quot; savoliga javob yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dev --PR--&gt; Git (manifests) &lt;--pull-- ArgoCD/Flux (klaster ichida)<br>                 ^                         |<br>                 |                         v  apply + diff<br>   CI: test, build, image push        Kubernetes API<br>   + manifestda image tag'ini yangilash   (live state)</pre><p>CI faqat image yaratadi va config repo'ga commit/PR qiladi. Klasterga hech kim tashqaridan kirmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># deploy = tag'ni o'zgartirib merge qilish<br>yq -i '.images[0].newTag=&quot;1.4.2&quot;' apps/api/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml<br>git commit -am &quot;api: 1.4.2&quot; &amp;&amp; git push   # -&gt; PR -&gt; review -&gt; merge<br>argocd app get api-prod    # Sync: Synced, Health: Healthy<br># rollback = git revert<br>git revert &lt;sha&gt; &amp;&amp; git push</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>App kodi va manifest'larni bitta repo'da saqlash — har kod commit'i sync trigger qiladi, CI loop'lar paydo bo'ladi. Odatda alohida config repo.</li><li>Secret'larni ochiq YAML'da Git'ga qo'yish — Sealed Secrets/ESO kerak.</li><li>GitOps CI'ni almashtirmaydi: test, build, scan hali ham CI'da.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitOps'ning asosiy foydasi — audit (har o'zgarish = commit, review, author) va xavfsizlik (prod credential CI'dan chiqadi). Narxi — &quot;tez qo'lda fix&quot; imkoni yo'qoladi; incident'da ham o'zgarish Git orqali o'tishi kerak, shuning uchun tez merge jarayonini oldindan tayyorla.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40652	<p>GitOps'ning to'rt tamoyili (OpenGitOps) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OpenGitOps (CNCF) to'rt tamoyili: 1) <b>Declarative</b> — tizim holati deklarativ tasvirlanadi; 2) <b>Versioned and Immutable</b> — holat versiyalangan, o'zgarmas tarix bilan saqlanadi (odatda Git); 3) <b>Pulled Automatically</b> — agent desired state'ni o'zi tortib oladi; 4) <b>Continuously Reconciled</b> — agent doimiy actual va desired holatni solishtirib, farqni tuzatadi.</p><p><b>Nega aynan shu to'rttasi:</b> har biri bitta muammoni yopadi:</p><p>| Tamoyil | Yopadigan muammo | |---|---| | Declarative | &quot;Qanday qilish&quot; skriptlari emas, &quot;nima bo'lishi kerak&quot; — idempotent | | Versioned/Immutable | Audit, review, <code>git revert</code> bilan rollback | | Pulled | Klasterga tashqi credential kerak emas | | Reconciled | Drift (qo'lda o'zgarish) avtomatik aniqlanadi/tuzatiladi |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (reconcile loop):</b></p><pre>loop har N soniya / webhook:<br>  desired = render(Git@HEAD)<br>  actual  = kube-api.get()<br>  diff    = desired - actual<br>  if diff: apply(diff)   -&gt; status: Synced</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> tamoyillarni tekshirish:</p><pre>kubectl -n prod scale deploy api --replicas=10   # qo'lda drift<br>argocd app get api-prod   # OutOfSync -&gt; selfHeal yoqilgan bo'lsa 3 ga qaytadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pipeline'dan <code>kubectl apply</code> qilib &quot;GitOps qildik&quot; deyish — 3 va 4-tamoyil yo'q.</li><li><code>latest</code> tag ishlatish — Git o'zgarmagan, lekin holat o'zgaradi; 2-tamoyil buziladi. Immutable tag yoki digest ishlat.</li><li>&quot;Git&quot; shart emas — OCI registry yoki S3 ham versiyalangan manba bo'la oladi (Flux OCIRepository).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Intervyuda tamoyillarni yodlab aytish yetmaydi — har birini buzish nimaga olib kelishini ayt. Masalan HPA <code>replicas</code>ni o'zgartiradi: bu &quot;drift&quot; emas, shuning uchun <code>replicas</code>ni manifestdan olib tashlash yoki <code>ignoreDifferences</code> kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40653	<p>ArgoCD nima va qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ArgoCD — Kubernetes uchun CNCF graduated GitOps CD tool'i. Klaster ichida ishlaydi, Git (yoki Helm/OCI) repo'dagi manifest'larni render qiladi, live holat bilan solishtiradi va farqni sync qiladi; UI, CLI, RBAC, SSO beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> O'nlab servis va klasterni &quot;hozir nima deploy qilingan, Git bilan mos keladimi&quot; deb kuzatish qo'lda imkonsiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (komponentlar):</b></p><pre>Git/Helm/OCI --&gt; repo-server (helm template, kustomize build -&gt; YAML)<br>                      |<br>                      v<br>            application-controller --diff--&gt; kube-api (live)<br>                      |  sync (apply)            ^<br>                      v                          |<br>            argocd-server (UI/API/SSO) ----------+<br>            redis (cache), dex (SSO, ixtiyoriy)</pre><ul><li><b>repo-server</b> — manifest generatsiya (Helm, Kustomize, plain, plugin).</li><li><b>application-controller</b> — reconcile loop (default ~3 daqiqa polling yoki webhook).</li><li><b>argocd-server</b> — UI/API, RBAC.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl create ns argocd<br>kubectl apply -n argocd -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/stable/manifests/install.yaml<br>argocd app create api --repo https://github.com/org/deploy.git \<br>  --path apps/api/prod --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace api<br>argocd app sync api<br>argocd app get api      # Sync Status / Health Status</pre><p><code>Synced + Healthy</code> — Git bilan mos va resurslar sog'lom. <code>OutOfSync</code> — diff bor.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default <code>admin</code> parolini qoldirish va UI'ni internetga ochish.</li><li>Bitta ArgoCD'dan 100+ klasterni boshqarish — controller sharding kerak (<code>ARGOCD_CONTROLLER_REPLICAS</code>).</li><li>Katta monorepo'da repo-server CPU/memory tugaydi — <code>reposerver.parallelism.limit</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Topologiya qarori: markaziy ArgoCD (hub-spoke, bitta panel, lekin hamma klaster credential'i bir joyda) yoki har klasterda o'z ArgoCD'si (izolyatsiya, lekin ko'p instance). Blast radius va operatsion yukni solishtirib tanla.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40654	<p>ArgoCD Application CRD nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>Application</code> — ArgoCD'ning asosiy CRD'si: &quot;qaysi manbadan (repo, revision, path) qaysi joyga (klaster, namespace) qanday siyosat bilan (sync policy) deploy qilish&quot; ni deklarativ yozadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> UI'da qo'lda yaratilgan app'lar Git'da yo'q — ArgoCD o'zi ham GitOps bilan boshqarilishi kerak (&quot;app of apps&quot;).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: Application<br>metadata:<br>  name: api-prod<br>  namespace: argocd<br>  finalizers: [resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io]   # app o'chsa resurslar ham<br>spec:<br>  project: payments              # AppProject: ruxsat chegarasi<br>  source:<br>    repoURL: https://github.com/org/deploy.git<br>    targetRevision: main<br>    path: apps/api/overlays/prod<br>  destination:<br>    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc<br>    namespace: api<br>  syncPolicy:<br>    automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true }<br>    syncOptions: [CreateNamespace=true, ServerSideApply=true]<br>    retry: { limit: 5, backoff: { duration: 10s, factor: 2 } }<br>  ignoreDifferences:<br>    - group: apps<br>      kind: Deployment<br>      jsonPointers: [/spec/replicas]   # HPA boshqaradi</pre><pre>kubectl apply -f api-prod.yaml<br>argocd app diff api-prod</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>project: default</code> — hamma repo va hamma namespace'ga ruxsat; jamoalar uchun alohida <code>AppProject</code> (sourceRepos, destinations, clusterResourceWhitelist).</li><li>Finalizer'siz app'ni o'chirsang resurslar klasterda qoladi (yetim); finalizer bilan — hammasi o'chadi, ehtiyot bo'l.</li><li><code>targetRevision: HEAD</code> prod'da — har merge darhol prod'ga. Tag/branch strategiyasini aniq qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p source kerak bo'lsa (<code>sources:</code> — Helm chart bitta repo'da, values boshqasida) multi-source ishlat. Application'larni qo'lda yozish ko'paysa — ApplicationSet'ga o't.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40655	<p>ArgoCD ApplicationSet nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ApplicationSet — <code>Application</code>lar fabrikasi: generator (List, Cluster, Git directory/file, Matrix, Merge, SCM Provider, Pull Request) natijalarini template'ga qo'yib, ko'plab Application yaratadi va ularni sinxron ushlab turadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 30 servis x 4 klaster = 120 deyarli bir xil Application YAML. Yangi klaster qo'shilsa — 30 ta fayl qo'lda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>generator(lar) --&gt; parametrlar [{cluster: prod-eu, url: ...}, ...]<br>                         |<br>                         v<br>            template (Application) --&gt; N ta Application</pre><p><b>Amalda (Matrix: har klaster x har servis papkasi):</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: ApplicationSet<br>metadata: { name: services, namespace: argocd }<br>spec:<br>  goTemplate: true<br>  generators:<br>    - matrix:<br>        generators:<br>          - clusters: { selector: { matchLabels: { env: prod } } }<br>          - git:<br>              repoURL: https://github.com/org/deploy.git<br>              revision: main<br>              directories: [{ path: &quot;apps/*&quot; }]<br>  template:<br>    metadata: { name: &quot;{{.path.basename}}-{{.name}}&quot; }<br>    spec:<br>      project: default<br>      source: { repoURL: https://github.com/org/deploy.git, targetRevision: main, path: &quot;{{.path.path}}&quot; }<br>      destination: { server: &quot;{{.server}}&quot;, namespace: &quot;{{.path.basename}}&quot; }<br>      syncPolicy: { automated: { selfHeal: true } }</pre><p>Yangi klasterni <code>env=prod</code> label bilan ro'yxatdan o'tkazdingmi — barcha servis avtomatik deploy bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Generator natijasidan element yo'qolsa, Application (va uning resurslari) o'chadi. Himoya: <code>syncPolicy.preserveResourcesOnDeletion: true</code> yoki <code>applicationsSync: create-only</code>.</li><li>Hamma klasterga bir vaqtda chiqarish — <code>strategy: RollingSync</code> (progressive sync) bilan bosqichma-bosqich qil.</li><li>Pull Request generator — preview muhit uchun zo'r, lekin fork PR'lardan xavfsizlik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ApplicationSet — platform jamoaning &quot;self-service&quot; vositasi: dev papka qo'shadi, platform template'ni boshqaradi. Lekin template xatosi bir zarbada yuzlab app'ga tegadi — template o'zgarishlarini staging klaster to'plamida sina.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40656	<p>ArgoCD sync wave'lari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Sync wave — <code>argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: &quot;&lt;int&gt;&quot;</code> annotation. ArgoCD bitta sync ichida resurslarni wave raqami bo'yicha o'sish tartibida qo'llaydi (manfiy ham bo'ladi, default <code>0</code>); keyingi wave oldingi wave <b>healthy</b> bo'lgandan keyin boshlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CRD avval, keyin uni ishlatadigan CR; ConfigMap/Secret avval, keyin Deployment; DB avval, keyin app. Tartibsiz apply — &quot;no matches for kind&quot; yoki CrashLoop.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>phase: PreSync -&gt; Sync -&gt; PostSync<br> har phase ichida:<br>   wave -1: Namespace, CRD<br>   wave  0: ConfigMap, Secret          (default)<br>   wave  1: Database StatefulSet  -- healthy kutiladi<br>   wave  2: API Deployment<br>   wave  3: Ingress<br> bir wave ichida: kind bo'yicha tartib (Namespace, CRD, ... ), keyin nom</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: apps/v1<br>kind: StatefulSet<br>metadata:<br>  name: postgres<br>  annotations:<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: &quot;1&quot;<br>---<br>apiVersion: apps/v1<br>kind: Deployment<br>metadata:<br>  name: api<br>  annotations:<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: &quot;2&quot;</pre><pre>argocd app sync api --dry-run<br>argocd app get api --show-operation   # qaysi wave'da turibdi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Wave faqat bitta Application ichida ishlaydi; app'lar orasidagi tartib uchun app-of-apps'da Application resurslariga wave qo'y.</li><li>Custom resource uchun health check bo'lmasa ArgoCD uni darhol &quot;healthy&quot; deb oladi — keyingi wave erta boshlanadi. Lua health check yoz.</li><li>Wave'lar orasidagi pauza (<code>ARGOCD_SYNC_WAVE_DELAY</code>, default 2s) — ko'p wave sync'ni sekinlashtiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Wave'larni haddan tashqari ko'paytirma: ilova o'zi dependency'ni retry bilan kutadigan qilib yozilsa (eventual consistency), deploy tartibiga bog'liqlik kamayadi va tizim mustahkamroq bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40657	<p>ArgoCD sync phase'lari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ArgoCD sync bosqichlari: <b>PreSync</b> (asosiy resurslardan oldin), <b>Sync</b> (asosiy manifest'lar), <b>PostSync</b> (hammasi healthy bo'lgandan keyin), <b>SyncFail</b> (sync yiqilsa). Yana <code>Skip</code> va (yangi versiyalarda) <code>PreDelete</code>/<code>PostDelete</code> hook'lari bor. Hook — <code>argocd.argoproj.io/hook</code> annotation'li resurs (odatda Job).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy faqat &quot;YAML'ni apply qilish&quot; emas: oldin DB migration, keyin smoke test, yiqilsa — Slack xabari yoki tozalash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PreSync hooks --ok--&gt; Sync (wave'lar bo'yicha) --healthy--&gt; PostSync hooks<br>     |                      |<br>     +------- fail ---------+----&gt; SyncFail hooks</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: Job<br>metadata:<br>  name: db-migrate<br>  annotations:<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: BeforeHookCreation,HookSucceeded<br>spec:<br>  backoffLimit: 1<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      restartPolicy: Never<br>      containers:<br>        - name: migrate<br>          image: org/api:1.4.2<br>          command: [&quot;./migrate&quot;, &quot;up&quot;]</pre><p><code>hook-delete-policy</code>: <code>HookSucceeded</code> (muvaffaqiyatdan keyin o'chir), <code>HookFailed</code>, <code>BeforeHookCreation</code> (keyingi sync'dan oldin eskisini o'chir — nom to'qnashuvini oldini oladi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PreSync migration yangi kodga mos, lekin hali ishlab turgan eski pod'larga mos bo'lmasa — downtime. Migration backward-compatible (expand/contract) bo'lishi shart.</li><li>Delete policy'siz Job qoladi va keyingi sync'da &quot;already exists&quot; xatosi.</li><li>Helm hook'lari (<code>helm.sh/hook: pre-install</code>) ArgoCD'da tegishli ArgoCD hook'lariga map qilinadi, lekin to'liq bir xil emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Migration'ni deploy'ga bog'lash qulay, lekin uzoq migration sync'ni bloklaydi. Katta jadvallarda migration'ni alohida pipeline/Job sifatida, ilova relizidan ajratib boshqar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40658	<p>ArgoCD auto-sync va self-heal nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Auto-sync</b> (<code>syncPolicy.automated</code>) — Git'da yangi commit paydo bo'lsa ArgoCD o'zi sync qiladi (qo'lda &quot;Sync&quot; tugmasi shart emas). <b>Self-heal</b> (<code>selfHeal: true</code>) — Git o'zgarmagan bo'lsa ham, klasterdagi qo'lda o'zgarishni (drift) aniqlab Git holatiga qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Auto-sync'siz — merge qilindi, lekin kimdir sync bosishni unutdi. Self-heal'siz — kimdir <code>kubectl edit</code> qildi, app <code>OutOfSync</code> bo'lib qoladi va keyingi deploy'gacha shu holat yashaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            Git o'zgardi?  --ha--&gt; auto-sync --&gt; apply<br>            live != desired, Git o'zgarmagan?<br>                          --ha--&gt; selfHeal=true ? apply : faqat OutOfSync ko'rsat</pre><p>Self-heal default 5 soniya kutib qayta urinadi (<code>--self-heal-timeout-seconds</code>).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>syncPolicy:<br>  automated:<br>    prune: true<br>    selfHeal: true<br>    allowEmpty: false     # Git bo'sh bo'lsa hammasini o'chirma</pre><pre>kubectl -n api set image deploy/api api=org/api:hotfix   # qo'lda<br>kubectl -n api get deploy api -o jsonpath='{..image}'     # bir necha soniyadan keyin eski tag<br>argocd app history api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Incident paytida qo'lda fix qilding — self-heal uni darhol bekor qiladi. Vaqtincha o'chirish: <code>argocd app set api --self-heal=false</code> (va buni qaytarishni unutma).</li><li>HPA, VPA, mutating webhook o'zgartiradigan maydonlar doimiy &quot;drift&quot; — <code>ignoreDifferences</code> bilan chiqarib tashla, aks holda sync loop.</li><li>Prod'da auto-sync + <code>targetRevision: main</code> = har merge darhol prod. Gate kerak bo'lsa — PR approval yoki sync window.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Self-heal GitOps'ning &quot;Git — yagona haqiqat&quot; va'dasini amalga oshiradi. Uni o'chirib qo'yish — drift'ni qonuniylashtirish. To'g'ri yo'l: hotfix'ni ham Git'dan tez o'tkazadigan jarayon.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40659	<p>ArgoCD prune nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Prune — Git'dan o'chirilgan manifest'ga mos resursni klasterdan ham o'chirish. Auto-sync'da default <code>prune: false</code> (xavfsizlik uchun): ArgoCD resursni faqat <code>OutOfSync</code> (orphan &quot;requires pruning&quot;) deb belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>old-worker</code> Deployment'ni Git'dan o'chirding, lekin klasterda ishlashda davom etadi — resurs yeydi, eski kod queue'dan xabar o'qiydi. Yoki teskari: noto'g'ri path tufayli butun app &quot;o'chirilgan&quot; ko'rinadi va prune hammasini yo'q qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>live resurslar (app label/tracking annotation bilan)<br>   minus  Git'dagi resurslar<br>   =      prune nomzodlari --prune=true--&gt; delete</pre><p>ArgoCD resursni o'ziniki deb <code>app.kubernetes.io/instance</code> label yoki tracking annotation orqali taniydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>argocd app diff api                 # &quot;requires pruning&quot; ro'yxati<br>argocd app sync api --prune         # qo'lda bir martalik prune</pre><pre>syncPolicy:<br>  automated: { prune: true }<br>  syncOptions: [PruneLast=true]     # prune'ni oxirida, yangi resurslar healthy bo'lgach<br>---<br>metadata:<br>  annotations:<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: Prune=false   # shu resursni hech qachon prune qilma (PVC, CRD)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PVC, Namespace, CRD prune bo'lsa — ma'lumot yo'qoladi. Ularga <code>Prune=false</code> yoki <code>Delete=false</code> qo'y.</li><li><code>allowEmpty: false</code> qoldir — xato commit repo'ni bo'shatib qo'ysa hammasi o'chib ketmaydi.</li><li>Bir resurs ikki app tomonidan kuzatilsa — biri uni prune qilishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da <code>prune: true</code> + <code>PruneLast</code> + muhim stateful resurslarga <code>Prune=false</code> — muvozanatli sozlama. Prune'siz GitOps'da yetim resurslar to'planadi va &quot;Git = haqiqat&quot; yolg'onga aylanadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40660	<p>FluxCD tarkibi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flux v2 — GitOps Toolkit: alohida controller'lar to'plami. <b>Source Controller</b> (Git/Helm/OCI/Bucket'dan artifact), <b>Kustomize Controller</b> (manifest'larni apply), <b>Helm Controller</b> (HelmRelease), <b>Notification Controller</b> (alert va webhook receiver), <b>Image Reflector + Image Automation</b> (yangi image tag'ini topib Git'ga commit).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Monolit CD tool o'rniga — har vazifa alohida, kompozitsiya qilinadigan CRD/controller; UI yo'q, hammasi <code>kubectl</code>/<code>flux</code> CLI va CRD'lar orqali.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GitRepository/OCIRepository/HelmRepository  (source-controller)<br>        | artifact (tar.gz, revision)<br>        +--&gt; Kustomization  (kustomize-controller) --&gt; kube-api<br>        +--&gt; HelmRelease    (helm-controller)      --&gt; kube-api<br>ImageRepository -&gt; ImagePolicy -&gt; ImageUpdateAutomation --git push--&gt; repo<br>events --&gt; Alert/Provider (notification-controller) --&gt; Slack</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>flux bootstrap github --owner=org --repository=fleet --path=clusters/prod --personal=false<br>flux get sources git<br>flux get kustomizations -A<br>flux reconcile kustomization apps --with-source   # darhol sync<br>flux logs --level=error</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Flux'da o'rnatilgan UI yo'q (Weave GitOps/Headlamp plugin alohida). Vizual panel kerak bo'lsa ArgoCD qulayroq.</li><li>Image Automation Git'ga yozadi — deploy key'ga write ruxsat kerak, bu xavfsizlik qarori.</li><li><code>bootstrap</code> Flux'ning o'zini ham repo'ga yozadi — Flux upgrade ham GitOps orqali.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ArgoCD vs Flux: ArgoCD — UI, multi-tenancy/RBAC, ko'p klasterni markazdan boshqarish; Flux — yengil, Kubernetes-native, har klaster o'zini boshqaradi, OCI artifact va Helm'ni chuqurroq qo'llaydi. Ikkalasi ham CNCF graduated.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40661	<p>FluxCD Kustomization CRD nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flux <code>Kustomization</code> (<code>kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io</code>) — source artifact'idagi papkani <code>kustomize build</code> qilib klasterga apply qiladigan reconcile birligi: interval, prune, health check, <code>dependsOn</code>, <code>postBuild</code> substitution, decryption (SOPS) bilan.</p><p>Diqqat: bu <code>kustomize.config.k8s.io</code> dagi <code>kustomization.yaml</code> fayl emas — nomi bir xil, lekin Flux CRD.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;infra (cert-manager, ingress) avval, keyin app'lar&quot; tartibi va har qatlamni sog'liq bo'yicha tekshirish kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1<br>kind: Kustomization<br>metadata: { name: apps, namespace: flux-system }<br>spec:<br>  interval: 10m<br>  sourceRef: { kind: GitRepository, name: fleet }<br>  path: ./apps/prod<br>  prune: true<br>  wait: true                  # barcha resurslar ready bo'lishini kut<br>  timeout: 5m<br>  dependsOn:<br>    - name: infra-controllers # avval bu Ready bo'lsin<br>  postBuild:<br>    substitute: { CLUSTER: prod-eu }<br>  decryption: { provider: sops, secretRef: { name: sops-age } }</pre><pre>flux get kustomizations<br># NAME   REVISION        READY  MESSAGE<br># apps   main@sha1:ab12  True   Applied revision: main@sha1:ab12<br>flux diff kustomization apps --path ./apps/prod</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>prune: true</code> + noto'g'ri <code>path</code> = hamma resurs o'chadi.</li><li><code>dependsOn</code> faqat bir namespace/Kustomization darajasida; sikl bo'lsa ikkalasi ham kutib qoladi.</li><li><code>wait: true</code> CRD'siz custom resurslar uchun ready'ni bilmasa — <code>healthChecks</code> ni aniq yoz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatiy tuzilma: <code>clusters/&lt;name&gt;</code> -&gt; <code>infra-controllers</code> -&gt; <code>infra-configs</code> -&gt; <code>apps</code>, har biri <code>dependsOn</code> bilan. Bu klasterni noldan tiklashni (DR) bitta <code>flux bootstrap</code> ga aylantiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40662	<p>FluxCD HelmRelease nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>HelmRelease</code> — Flux Helm Controller CRD'si: qaysi chart (HelmRepository/OCI), qaysi versiya, qanday values bilan release bo'lishini deklarativ yozadi; controller <code>helm install/upgrade</code>ni o'zi bajaradi, drift'ni aniqlaydi, xatoda rollback/uninstall qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>helm upgrade</code> ni CI'dan qo'lda chaqirish — values qayerdan kelgani noaniq, yiqilgan release <code>pending-upgrade</code> holatida qoladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1<br>kind: HelmRepository<br>metadata: { name: bitnami, namespace: flux-system }<br>spec: { type: oci, url: oci://registry-1.docker.io/bitnamicharts, interval: 1h }<br>---<br>apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2<br>kind: HelmRelease<br>metadata: { name: redis, namespace: cache }<br>spec:<br>  interval: 15m<br>  chart:<br>    spec:<br>      chart: redis<br>      version: &quot;20.x&quot;          # semver range<br>      sourceRef: { kind: HelmRepository, name: bitnami, namespace: flux-system }<br>  values:<br>    architecture: replication<br>  valuesFrom:<br>    - kind: Secret<br>      name: redis-values<br>  install: { remediation: { retries: 3 } }<br>  upgrade:<br>    remediation: { retries: 3, remediateLastFailure: true, strategy: rollback }<br>  driftDetection: { mode: enabled }</pre><pre>flux get helmreleases -A<br>helm history redis -n cache</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>version: &quot;*&quot;</code> yoki keng range — upstream yangi major chiqarsa prod o'zi upgrade bo'ladi. Aniq versiya yoki Renovate bilan PR.</li><li><code>valuesFrom</code> dagi Secret o'zgarsa reconcile <code>interval</code> gacha kutadi.</li><li>Helm release secret'lari (<code>sh.helm.release.v1.*</code>) to'planadi — <code>maxHistory</code> qo'y.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HelmRelease drift detection Helm'ning eng katta zaif nuqtasini (release ichidagi qo'lda o'zgarishlar ko'rinmaydi) yopadi. Chart versiyasini Git'da pin qilib, yangilashni bot PR'lari orqali o'tkazish — reproducible va auditli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40663	<p>Progressive delivery nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Progressive delivery — yangi versiyani hammaga birdaniga emas, bosqichma-bosqich (canary, blue-green, feature flag) chiqarib, har bosqichda real metrikalarni avtomatik tahlil qilish va yomon bo'lsa avtomatik orqaga qaytarish. Maqsad — xato bo'lsa zararni (blast radius) kichik foydalanuvchi ulushida ushlash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Rolling update hamma pod'ni ketma-ket almashtiradi; xato faqat yuklama ostida chiqsa, sezganingda 100% foydalanuvchi jabrlanadi. Staging hech qachon prod'ni to'liq takrorlamaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>v2: 5% --analiz(5m)--&gt; 25% --analiz--&gt; 50% --analiz--&gt; 100%<br>          |                 |<br>          +-- error&gt;1% -----+--&gt; abort: 0% v2, 100% v1</pre><p>Komponentlar: trafik bo'luvchi (Istio, Linkerd, NGINX/Gateway API, ALB), metrika manbai (Prometheus, Datadog), controller (Argo Rollouts, Flagger), ixtiyoriy feature flag (LaunchDarkly, OpenFeature).</p><p><b>Amalda (Argo Rollouts):</b></p><pre>strategy:<br>  canary:<br>    steps:<br>      - setWeight: 5<br>      - analysis: { templates: [{ templateName: success-rate }] }<br>      - setWeight: 25<br>      - pause: { duration: 10m }<br>      - setWeight: 100</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik kam bo'lsa 5% canary statistik ahamiyatsiz — 10 so'rovdan xulosa qilinmaydi. Minimal so'rov sonini shart qil.</li><li>DB schema o'zgarishi canary'ni befoyda qiladi: ikkala versiya bir DB'ni ishlatadi, rollback DB'ni qaytarmaydi.</li><li>Faqat texnik metrika (5xx) — biznes metrikasi (checkout conversion) tushishini ko'rmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Progressive delivery deploy (kod serverga chiqdi) va release'ni (foydalanuvchi ko'rdi) ajratadi. Eng katta qiymat — avtomatik rollback; buning uchun avval yaxshi SLI va alert chegaralari kerak, aks holda analiz tasodifiy qaror beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40664	<p>Argo Rollouts qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Argo Rollouts — Kubernetes controller: <code>Deployment</code> o'rniga <code>Rollout</code> CRD ishlatiladi, u canary/blue-green strategiyani step'lar bilan bajaradi, trafikni mesh/ingress orqali bo'ladi va <code>AnalysisRun</code> natijasiga ko'ra promote yoki abort qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Native Deployment faqat <code>RollingUpdate</code>/<code>Recreate</code> biladi: trafik foizini boshqarib bo'lmaydi, pauza va metrika tahlili yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Rollout --&gt; stable ReplicaSet (v1)   &lt;--- 80% ---+<br>        \-&gt; canary ReplicaSet (v2)   &lt;--- 20% ---+-- Istio VirtualService / NGINX / Gateway API<br>              |<br>          AnalysisRun (Prometheus) -- fail --&gt; abort, canary 0</pre><p>Trafik router bo'lmasa, foiz replica nisbati bilan taxminlanadi (4 stable + 1 canary = ~20%).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: Rollout<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  replicas: 10<br>  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  template: { metadata: { labels: { app: api } }, spec: { containers: [{ name: api, image: org/api:1.5.0 }] } }<br>  strategy:<br>    canary:<br>      canaryService: api-canary<br>      stableService: api-stable<br>      trafficRouting: { nginx: { stableIngress: api } }<br>      steps:<br>        - setWeight: 10<br>        - pause: { duration: 5m }<br>        - setWeight: 50<br>        - pause: {}            # qo'lda promote kutadi</pre><pre>kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api --watch<br>kubectl argo rollouts promote api<br>kubectl argo rollouts abort api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mavjud Deployment'ni ko'chirish: <code>workloadRef</code> bilan Deployment'ga havola qilib bosqichma-bosqich o't, aks holda ikki controller bitta pod'larni boshqaradi.</li><li>ArgoCD'da Rollout health'i to'g'ri ko'rinishi uchun ArgoCD versiyasi uni qo'llashi kerak (built-in).</li><li><code>pause: {}</code> — cheksiz kutish; kimdir promote qilishni unutsa reliz osilib qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rollouts'ni ArgoCD bilan birga ishlatganda Git'da faqat image tag o'zgaradi, qolgan orkestratsiyani controller qiladi. Abort'dan keyin Git hali yangi tag'ni ko'rsatadi — Git'ni ham revert qilish kerak, aks holda keyingi sync qayta urinadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40665	<p>Argo Rollouts'da AnalysisTemplate nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>AnalysisTemplate</code> — Argo Rollouts'da &quot;canary sog'lommi?&quot; savolini deklarativ yozadigan shablon: metrika provider (Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, New Relic, Web, Job), so'rov, <code>successCondition</code>/<code>failureCondition</code>, interval va necha marta tekshirish. Undan <code>AnalysisRun</code> yaratiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Inson Grafana'ga qarab &quot;yaxshiga o'xshaydi&quot; deyishi — sekin va subyektiv. Qaror mezonini kodda yozish kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: AnalysisTemplate<br>metadata: { name: success-rate }<br>spec:<br>  args: [{ name: service }]<br>  metrics:<br>    - name: success-rate<br>      interval: 1m<br>      count: 5<br>      failureLimit: 1           # 1 tadan ko'p fail -&gt; abort<br>      successCondition: result[0] &gt;= 0.99<br>      provider:<br>        prometheus:<br>          address: http://prometheus.monitoring:9090<br>          query: |<br>            sum(rate(http_requests_total{service=&quot;{{args.service}}&quot;,code!~&quot;5..&quot;}[2m]))<br>            /<br>            sum(rate(http_requests_total{service=&quot;{{args.service}}&quot;}[2m]))</pre><p>Rollout'da: <code>- analysis: { templates: [{ templateName: success-rate }], args: [{ name: service, value: api-canary }] }</code>.</p><pre>kubectl get analysisrun<br>kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api   # AnalysisRun: Successful / Failed / Inconclusive</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik yo'q bo'lsa <code>0/0 = NaN</code> — natija Inconclusive yoki noto'g'ri success. <code>or vector(1)</code> yoki minimal so'rov sharti.</li><li>Butun servis bo'yicha metrika — canary va stable aralashadi; label bilan faqat canary pod'larini filtrla.</li><li>Prometheus ishlamay qolsa — analysis <code>Error</code>; <code>consecutiveErrorLimit</code> ni sozla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng ishonchli tahlil — canary'ni stable bilan solishtirish (nisbiy), absolyut chegara emas: sutkalik trafik o'zgarishi ikkalasiga bir xil ta'sir qiladi. <code>ClusterAnalysisTemplate</code> bilan standart tahlillarni platforma darajasida ulash mumkin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40666	<p>Flagger qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flagger (Flux loyihasi) — progressive delivery operatori: mavjud <code>Deployment</code>ga <code>Canary</code> CRD orqali havola qiladi, <code>-primary</code> nusxasini yaratadi, trafikni mesh/ingress (Istio, Linkerd, NGINX, Contour, Gateway API, App Mesh) orqali bosqichma-bosqich o'tkazadi va metrika tahlili bilan promote/rollback qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Argo Rollouts Deployment'ni <code>Rollout</code>ga almashtirishni talab qiladi; Flagger mavjud Deployment'ni o'zgartirmasdan o'raydi — Helm chart'larga invaziv emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>siz: Deployment &quot;api&quot; (image yangilandi)<br>Flagger: api-primary (stable, trafik oladi)  &lt;-- 90%<br>         api (canary, yangi image)           &lt;-- 10%  -&gt; metrikalar ok -&gt; 20..50%<br>         muvaffaqiyat: yangi spec api-primary'ga ko'chiriladi, api 0 ga scale</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: flagger.app/v1beta1<br>kind: Canary<br>metadata: { name: api, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  targetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }<br>  service: { port: 80 }<br>  analysis:<br>    interval: 1m<br>    threshold: 5          # 5 marta fail -&gt; rollback<br>    maxWeight: 50<br>    stepWeight: 10<br>    metrics:<br>      - name: request-success-rate<br>        thresholdRange: { min: 99 }<br>        interval: 1m<br>      - name: request-duration<br>        thresholdRange: { max: 500 }<br>    webhooks:<br>      - name: load-test<br>        url: http://flagger-loadtester.test/<br>        metadata: { cmd: &quot;hey -z 1m -q 10 http://api-canary.prod/&quot;
