}</pre><pre>kubectl -n prod get canary api -w   # Progressing -&gt; Succeeded / Failed</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik bo'lmasa analiz o'tmaydi — load-test webhook kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>HPA'ni ham <code>autoscalerRef</code> bilan bering, aks holda primary'da HPA yo'q.</li><li>Canary tugaguncha yangi deploy kelsa — Flagger analizni qayta boshlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Flux ekotizimida Flagger tabiiy tanlov, ArgoCD'da — Argo Rollouts. Asosiy farq: Flagger primary/canary nusxa usuli (resurs ikki baravar vaqtincha), Rollouts — bitta CRD'da ReplicaSet'lar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40667	<p>Software supply chain security nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Software supply chain security — kod yozilishidan production'da ishlashigacha bo'lgan butun zanjirni himoyalash: source (repo, review), dependency'lar, build tizimi, artifact (image), registry va deploy. Savol: &quot;prod'da ishlayotgan narsa haqiqatan biz review qilgan kodmi?&quot;</p><p><b>Muammo (real hodisalar):</b> SolarWinds (2020 — build server buzilib, imzolangan update'ga backdoor), Codecov (CI skripti o'zgartirilib env secret'lar o'g'irlangan), <code>xz-utils</code> (2024 — maintainer sifatida kirgan hujumchi backdoor), <code>tj-actions/changed-files</code> (2025 — action tag'lari zararli commit'ga qayta yo'naltirildi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (hujum nuqtalari va himoya):</b></p><pre>dev -&gt; source -&gt; deps -&gt; build -&gt; artifact -&gt; registry -&gt; deploy -&gt; runtime<br> |       |         |       |         |           |          |<br>MFA   branch    lockfile  ephemeral  SBOM,     imzo       admission<br>signed protect  pin, SCA  runner,    provenance (cosign)  policy (Kyverno)<br>commits review            SLSA</pre><p><b>Amalda (minimal zanjir):</b></p><pre>syft org/api:1.4.2 -o cyclonedx-json &gt; sbom.json      # nima ichida<br>grype sbom:sbom.json --fail-on high                    # zaifliklar<br>cosign sign --yes org/api@sha256:...                   # kim yaratdi<br>cosign attest --yes --type cyclonedx --predicate sbom.json org/api@sha256:...<br># klasterda: Kyverno faqat imzolangan image'ni qabul qiladi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat CVE skanerlash = supply chain security deb o'ylash. Build tizimi buzilsa toza kodga ham backdoor tushadi.</li><li>Tag bo'yicha deploy (<code>:1.4.2</code>) — tag qayta yozilishi mumkin; digest ishlat.</li><li>CI'da uzoq muddatli cloud kalitlar — OIDC federation bilan almashtir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Framework'lar: SLSA (build yaxlitligi darajalari), NIST SSDF, OpenSSF Scorecard. Hammasini birdan qilma: avval eng arzon yuqori foydali qadamlar — action pinning, branch protection, OIDC, imzolash + admission tekshiruv.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40668	<p>SLSA darajalari (1–3) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts) v1.0 Build track darajalari: <b>L1</b> — provenance mavjud (build qanday bo'lgani yozilgan, imzosiz bo'lishi mumkin); <b>L2</b> — hosted build platformasi imzolagan provenance; <b>L3</b> — mustahkamlangan (hardened) platforma: build'lar bir-biridan izolyatsiyalangan, imzo kaliti build kodi yeta olmaydigan joyda — provenance'ni soxtalashtirib bo'lmaydi. (L0 — hech narsa.)</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Bu image qaysi commit'dan, qaysi tizimda build bo'lgan?&quot; — buni isbotlay olmasang, buzilgan build'ni aniqlab bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><p>| Daraja | Talab | Nimadan himoya | |---|---|---| | L1 | Provenance yaratiladi | Xato/tasodifiy build, kuzatuv | | L2 | Hosted builder, imzolangan provenance | Build'dan keyin artifact almashtirish | | L3 | Izolyatsiya, kalitlar build'dan himoyalangan | Build ichidan provenance soxtalash, cache poisoning |</p><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions, L3 ga yaqin):</b></p><pre>permissions: { id-token: write, attestations: write, contents: read }<br>steps:<br>  - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2<br>    with: { subject-path: dist/app.tar.gz }</pre><p>yoki <code>slsa-framework/slsa-github-generator</code> reusable workflow. Tekshirish:</p><pre>gh attestation verify dist/app.tar.gz --owner org<br>slsa-verifier verify-artifact app.tar.gz --provenance-path app.intoto.jsonl \<br>  --source-uri github.com/org/app --source-tag v1.4.2</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Provenance yaratib, uni hech kim <b>tekshirmasa</b> — foyda nol. Deploy paytida verify majburiy bo'lsin.</li><li>SLSA v0.1 da L4 bor edi; v1.0 da Build track L3 gacha, L4 olib tashlangan (source track alohida ishlanmoqda).</li><li>Self-hosted persistent runner bilan L3 da'vo qilish — izolyatsiya talabi bajarilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p tashkilot uchun realistik maqsad L2-L3: GitHub Actions/GitLab hosted runner + attestation + admission'da tekshiruv. SLSA build yaxlitligini beradi, lekin manba kodning o'zi zararli bo'lsa (xz kabi) — himoya qilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40669	<p>Cosign bilan keyless signing qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Keyless signing — uzoq muddatli private key saqlamasdan imzolash: Cosign vaqtinchalik key pair yaratadi, OIDC token (GitHub Actions, Google, ...) bilan Fulcio'dan shu public key'ga identity bog'langan ~10 daqiqalik sertifikat oladi, artifact'ni imzolaydi, imzoni Rekor transparency log'ga yozadi va private key'ni tashlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klassik imzoda private key — eng qimmat secret: o'g'irlansa hujumchi hamma narsani imzolaydi, rotatsiya og'riqli. Keyless'da o'g'irlanadigan uzoq muddatli kalit yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CI job --OIDC token (repo, workflow, ref)--&gt; Fulcio<br>   |  ephemeral keypair                         | sertifikat (SAN = workflow identity, 10 min)<br>   v                                            v<br> sign(image digest) --&gt; imzo + cert --&gt; Rekor (log entry, timestamp)<br>                                   --&gt; registry (sha256-&lt;digest&gt;.sig)<br>verify: cert identity + issuer tekshiriladi, Rekor'da imzo sertifikat amal qilgan vaqtda qo'yilgani isbotlanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>permissions: { id-token: write, packages: write }<br>steps:<br>  - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3<br>  - run: cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/org/api@${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}</pre><pre>cosign verify ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc... \<br>  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/org/api/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v' \<br>  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Verify'da identity'ni tekshirmaslik (<code>--certificate-identity-regexp '.*'</code>) — har kim o'z GitHub akkauntidan imzolab o'tadi.</li><li>Tag'ni imzolash — imzo digest'ga bog'lanadi; tag'ga emas, digest bo'yicha imzola va deploy qil.</li><li>Public Rekor'ga yozish — repo nomi/identity ochiq bo'ladi; private loyihalar uchun xususiy Sigstore instance.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Keyless'da &quot;kalit&quot;ning o'rnini identity egallaydi: xavfsizlik endi CI workflow'ini kim o'zgartira olishiga bog'liq. Shuning uchun release workflow'ni branch protection va CODEOWNERS bilan himoyala.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40670	<p>Sigstore'da Rekor nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Rekor — Sigstore'ning transparency log'i: imzo metadata'sini (artifact hash, imzo, sertifikat, attestation) append-only, Merkle tree asosidagi o'zgarmas jurnalga yozadi. Har kim yozuvni tekshira oladi va log'dan yozuvni jim o'chirib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Keyless sertifikat 10 daqiqada eskiradi. Bir oydan keyin &quot;imzo sertifikat amal qilgan paytda qo'yilganmi?&quot; — buni ishonchli vaqt belgisi isbotlaydi. Yana: kimdir sening identity'ing bilan imzolasa, sen buni log'ni monitoring qilib bilib olasan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>cosign sign --&gt; Rekor: entry {hash, sig, cert} --&gt; Merkle tree'ga qo'shiladi<br>             &lt;-- SET / inclusion proof (signed timestamp, log index)<br>cosign verify --&gt; inclusion proof tekshiriladi (offline ham bo'ladi, bundle bilan)</pre><p>Certificate Transparency (TLS sertifikatlar uchun) bilan bir xil g'oya.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>rekor-cli search --sha sha256:abc123...<br>rekor-cli get --log-index 123456789 --format json | jq .<br># o'z identity'ingni kuzatish<br>rekor-cli search --email release@org.com</pre><p>Cosign verify yozuvni avtomatik tekshiradi; air-gapped muhitda <code>--offline</code> bilan bundle ichidagi proof ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Public Rekor'ga yozilgan ma'lumot ochiq va o'chirilmaydi — private repo nomlari, email'lar sizib chiqadi.</li><li><code>--tlog-upload=false</code> bilan imzolab, verify'da log'ni talab qilish — verify yiqiladi (yoki aksincha xavfsizlik zaiflashadi).</li><li>Log'ni yozish yetmaydi — anomaliyani bilish uchun o'z identity'ing bo'yicha monitoring (rekor-monitor) qo'y.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Transparency log'ning kuchi — oldini olishda emas, <b>aniqlashda</b>: kompromat yashirin qolmaydi. Enterprise'da o'z Rekor/Fulcio instance'ini (Sigstore scaffolding) yuritish — maxfiylik va mustaqillik, lekin operatsion yuk.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40671	<p>Sigstore'da Fulcio nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Fulcio — Sigstore'ning bepul code-signing Certificate Authority'si: OIDC identity'ni (email, GitHub Actions workflow, SPIFFE ID) tekshirib, shu identity'ni ephemeral public key'ga bog'laydigan qisqa muddatli (~10 daqiqa) X.509 sertifikat beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klassik code-signing sertifikat qimmat, yillab amal qiladi va kalit boshqaruvi og'ir. Developer/CI uchun &quot;men kimman&quot; ni allaqachon IdP isbotlaydi — Fulcio buni sertifikatga aylantiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client: keypair yaratadi<br>  --&gt; Fulcio: {public key, OIDC token, proof-of-possession}<br>Fulcio: tokenni issuer bo'yicha tekshiradi (GitHub, Google, Microsoft, ...)<br>  &lt;-- X.509 cert: SAN = identity, extension'larda issuer, repo, workflow, commit SHA<br>cert CT log'ga yoziladi; client imzolab, private key'ni o'chiradi</pre><p>GitHub Actions sertifikatida: <code>Build Signer URI</code>, <code>Source Repository Digest</code>, <code>Runner Environment</code> kabi OID extension'lar — verify'da ularni tekshirish mumkin.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cosign verify org/api@sha256:... \<br>  --certificate-identity https://github.com/org/api/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \<br>  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \<br>  --certificate-github-workflow-repository org/api<br># sertifikatni ko'rish<br>cosign download signature org/api@sha256:... | jq -r .Cert | base64 -d | openssl x509 -text -noout</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sertifikat qisqa yashaydi — verify Rekor timestamp'iga tayanadi; log'siz verify ishlamaydi.</li><li>Faqat issuer'ni tekshirish (GitHub) — har qanday GitHub repo o'tadi. Identity (repo + workflow + ref) aniq bo'lsin.</li><li>Shaxsiy email bilan interaktiv imzo CI'da emas — CI'da workload identity ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Fulcio + Rekor birga &quot;kalit egasi kim&quot; savolini &quot;qaysi workflow, qaysi commit&quot; savoliga almashtiradi — bu provenance policy yozishni ancha soddalashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40672	<p>Syft nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Syft (Anchore) — SBOM generator: container image, papka, arxiv yoki binary ichidagi paketlarni (OS: apk/deb/rpm; til: npm, pip, Go modules, Maven, Cargo ...) aniqlab, CycloneDX, SPDX yoki o'z JSON formatida SBOM chiqaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Log4Shell (2021) paytida savol: &quot;qaysi servislarimizda log4j bor?&quot; SBOM bo'lmasa — har image'ni qo'lda ochib qidirish, kunlar ketadi. Registry'da attestation sifatida yoki Dependency-Track'da saqla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SBOM'ning qiymati — markazlashtirilgan saqlashda: barcha SBOM'larni Dependency-Track (yoki shunga o'xshash) ga yuborsang, yangi CVE chiqqanda &quot;qayerda ta'sir bor&quot; degan savolga daqiqalarda javob olasan. Buildkit <code>--sbom=true</code> ham SBOM yaratadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40673	<p>Grype nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Grype (Anchore) — ochiq kodli vulnerability scanner: image, papka yoki tayyor SBOM'dagi paketlarni zaiflik bazalari (NVD, GitHub Advisories, distro security feed'lari) bilan solishtirib CVE ro'yxatini beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Image'da yuzlab paket bor; qaysi birida ma'lum zaiflik borligini va tuzatilgan versiya mavjudmi — buni avtomatik bilish kerak, ayniqsa CI gate sifatida.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>image/dir --(ichki syft)--&gt; paketlar ---+<br>SBOM fayl ------------------------------+--&gt; moslashtirish (purl, CPE, distro version)<br>                     grype DB (kunlik yangilanadi) --+<br>                                                     v<br>                         CVE, severity, fixed-in, EPSS/KEV</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>grype ghcr.io/org/api:1.4.2<br># NAME      INSTALLED  FIXED-IN  TYPE  VULNERABILITY   SEVERITY<br># openssl   3.0.11     3.0.13    apk   CVE-2024-0727   Medium<br>grype sbom:./sbom.cdx.json --only-fixed --fail-on high<br>grype db update &amp;&amp; grype db status</pre><p><code>.grype.yaml</code> da ignore (sabab bilan):</p><pre>ignore:<br>  - vulnerability: CVE-2023-XXXX<br>    reason: &quot;kod yo'li ishlatilmaydi, VEX bilan tasdiqlangan&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>FIXED-IN</code> bo'sh CVE'lar uchun gate qo'yish — tuzatish yo'q, pipeline abadiy qizil. <code>--only-fixed</code> ishlat.</li><li>Offline/air-gapped CI'da DB yangilanmasa — eski natija. Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40674	<p>In-toto nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> in-toto (CNCF graduated) — supply chain'ning har qadamini (checkout, test, build, package) kim bajargani va qanday input/output bilan bajarganini kriptografik attestation sifatida yozish va oxirida butun zanjir oldindan belgilangan <b>layout</b> (siyosat) ga mosligini tekshirish framework'i. Bugun uning <b>attestation formati</b> (Statement + Predicate) SLSA, Cosign, GitHub attestations'da standart.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har qadam alohida xavfsiz bo'lishi mumkin, lekin qadamlar orasida artifact almashtirilsa (build'dan keyin, packaging'dan oldin) — buni hech kim sezmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>layout (project owner imzolagan):<br>  step &quot;build&quot;: faqat ci-key imzolaydi, material = src/*, product = app.bin<br>  step &quot;package&quot;: material = app.bin (build product'iga teng bo'lishi shart)<br>har qadam --&gt; link metadata {materials hashes, products hashes, command} + imzo<br>verify: imzolar + hash zanjiri layout'ga mosmi?</pre><p>Attestation tuzilishi:</p><pre>{ &quot;_type&quot;: &quot;https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1&quot;,<br>  &quot;subject&quot;: [{ &quot;name&quot;: &quot;ghcr.io/org/api&quot;, &quot;digest&quot;: { &quot;sha256&quot;: &quot;abc...&quot; } }],<br>  &quot;predicateType&quot;: &quot;https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1&quot;,<br>  &quot;predicate&quot;: { &quot;buildDefinition&quot;: { }, &quot;runDetails&quot;: { } } }</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>in-toto-run --step-name build --key ci.key --materials src --products app.bin -- make build<br>in-toto-verify --layout root.layout --layout-keys owner.pub</pre><p>Amalda ko'pincha to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, Cosign/Witness/GitHub attestations orqali ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Attestation yig'ib, layout/policy bilan tekshirmaslik — hujjat bor, himoya yo'q.</li><li>Har qadam uchun alohida kalit boshqaruvi og'ir — keyless (Sigstore) bilan birga ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> in-toto — &quot;til&quot; (format), SLSA — &quot;nima yozilishi kerakligi&quot; (provenance predicate), Sigstore — &quot;qanday imzolanadi&quot;, Kyverno/OPA — &quot;qayerda tekshiriladi&quot;. Bu to'rttasini bir zanjir sifatida tushuntira olish — senior signal.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain

Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40677	<p>External Secrets Operator (ESO) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> External Secrets Operator (ESO) — tashqi secret store'dan (AWS Secrets Manager/Parameter Store, HashiCorp Vault, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault, 1Password ...) qiymatlarni o'qib, klasterda oddiy Kubernetes <code>Secret</code> yaratadigan va davriy yangilab turadigan operator. Secret'ni etcd'ga umuman tushirmaslik kerak bo'lsa — Secrets Store CSI Driver yoki Vault Agent (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fayl).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40678	<p>Vault Agent Sidecar Injector nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Vault Agent Injector — mutating admission webhook: pod'dagi annotation'larni ko'rib, unga <code>vault-agent-init</code> (init container) va <code>vault-agent</code> (sidecar) qo'shadi. Dinamik DB credential'lar kerak bo'lsa — Vault Agent eng to'liq yechim.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40679	<p>Terraform uchun Atlantis nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Atlantis — self-hosted server: Terraform/OpenTofu workflow'ini Pull Request ichiga ko'chiradi. PR ochilsa avtomatik <code>terraform plan</code> qiladi va natijani izoh sifatida yozadi; <code>atlantis apply</code> izohi bilan apply qilinadi. Bir directory/workspace'ni bir vaqtda faqat bitta PR lock qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har developer o'z noutbukidan <code>terraform apply</code> — kim, qachon, nima o'zgartirgani noma'lum; ikki kishi bir vaqtda apply; cloud admin kalitlari noutbuklarda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PR ochildi --webhook--&gt; Atlantis --&gt; terraform init/plan --&gt; PR izohi: plan output<br>reviewer approve --&gt; &quot;atlantis apply&quot; izohi --&gt; apply --&gt; natija izoh --&gt; merge<br>lock: dir+workspace PR'ga bog'lanadi (boshqa PR &quot;locked&quot; xabarini oladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda (<code>atlantis.yaml</code>):</b></p><pre>version: 3<br>projects:<br>  - name: prod-network<br>    dir: envs/prod/network<br>    workspace: default<br>    autoplan: { when_modified: [&quot;*.tf&quot;, &quot;../../modules/**/*.tf&quot;] }<br>    apply_requirements: [approved, mergeable]</pre><p>PR'da:</p><pre>atlantis plan -p prod-network<br>atlantis apply -p prod-network<br>atlantis unlock</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Atlantis server'da cloud admin credential'lari — u eng qimmat nishon. Uni tarmoqda izolyatsiyala, webhook secret'ni tekshir, <code>--repo-allowlist</code> qo'y.</li><li>Fork'dan PR — zararli <code>.tf</code> (<code>external</code> data source, provider) plan paytida kod bajarishi mumkin. Fork PR'larda autoplan'ni o'chir.</li><li>Apply merge'dan oldin bo'ladi — apply muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa main va infra holati farqlanadi; jarayonni aniq kelishib ol.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Atlantis — bepul va oddiy; lekin policy (OPA/conftest), drift detection, RBAC'ni o'zing yig'asan. Kattaroq tashkilotlar Spacelift/Terraform Cloud/env0 ni shu sababli tanlaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40680	<p>Spacelift nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Spacelift — IaC uchun boshqariladigan (SaaS yoki self-hosted) orkestratsiya platformasi: Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Ansible, Kubernetes &quot;stack&quot;larini boshqaradi; Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40681	<p>ARC (Actions Runner Controller) autoscaling qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ARC (Actions Runner Controller) — GitHub'ning rasmiy Kubernetes operatori: self-hosted GitHub Actions runner'larni pod sifatida yaratadi. Hozirgi &quot;runner scale set&quot; rejimida listener pod GitHub'dan navbatdagi job'lar sonini long-poll orqali oladi va <code>EphemeralRunnerSet</code>ni shunga mos scale qiladi (<code>minRunners</code>..<code>maxRunners</code>, 0 gacha).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Doimiy VM runner'lar — kechasi bo'sh turib pul yeydi, kunduzi navbat hosil bo'ladi; holat job'lar orasida ifloslanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>workflow: runs-on: arc-linux<br>GitHub job queue &lt;--long poll-- listener pod (scale set)<br>                                  | &quot;3 job kutyapti&quot;<br>                                  v<br>                 EphemeralRunnerSet: replicas=3 --&gt; 3 runner pod<br>                 har pod 1 job bajaradi -&gt; o'chadi</pre><p>Eski ARC (summerwind, <code>RunnerDeployment</code> + <code>HorizontalRunnerAutoscaler</code> webhook/pull metrikasi) — legacy, yangi o'rnatishda scale set ishlat.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>helm install arc oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set-controller -n arc-systems --create-namespace<br>helm install arc-linux oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set \<br>  -n arc-runners --create-namespace \<br>  --set githubConfigUrl=https://github.com/org \<br>  --set githubConfigSecret=gh-app-secret \<br>  --set minRunners=0 --set maxRunners=50<br>kubectl -n arc-runners get ephemeralrunners</pre><p>Workflow'da: <code>runs-on: arc-linux</code> (scale set nomi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>minRunners=0</code> — sovuq start: pod schedule + image pull + node autoscaler 1-3 daqiqa. Muhim repo'lar uchun 1-2 issiq runner.</li><li>Docker-in-Docker kerak bo'lsa <code>containerMode: dind</code> — privileged pod, xavfsizlik riski; iloji bo'lsa <code>kubernetes</code> mode yoki Kaniko/BuildKit rootless.</li><li>GitHub App o'rniga PAT bilan autentifikatsiya — keng ruxsat va bitta odamga bog'liq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Runner pool'larni ishonch darajasi bo'yicha ajrat: public/fork PR'lar uchun alohida namespace/node pool (yoki umuman GitHub-hosted), prod deploy runner'lari alohida. ARC narxni tejaydi, lekin runner'lar sizning klasteringizda — ularning xavfsizligi endi sizning javobgarligingiz.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40682	<p>Ephemeral runner xavfsizligi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ephemeral runner — bitta job uchun yaratilib, job tugashi bilan butunlay yo'q qilinadigan runner (pod/VM). Xavfsizlik foydasi: oldingi job qoldirgan fayl, credential, zararli jarayon yoki cache keyingi job'ga o'tmaydi; hujumchi doimiy o'rnashib (persistence) qololmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Doimiy self-hosted runner'da bitta zararli PR (yoki buzilgan dependency) <code>~/.docker/config.json</code>, <code>~/.aws/credentials</code>, Git token'larni o'g'irlashi, fon jarayoni qoldirib keyingi prod deploy job'ini kuzatishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>persistent:  job1(PR, zararli) -&gt; backdoor qoldi -&gt; job2(prod deploy) -&gt; secret o'g'irlandi<br>ephemeral:   job1 -&gt; runner o'chirildi<br>             job2 -&gt; toza runner (yangi pod/VM) -&gt; backdoor yo'q</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># klassik runner'ni ephemeral rejimda ro'yxatdan o'tkazish<br>./config.sh --url https://github.com/org --token $REG_TOKEN --ephemeral --unattended</pre><p>ARC scale set'larda runner'lar default ephemeral. Qo'shimcha qattiqlashtirish:</p><pre>permissions: { contents: read }      # GITHUB_TOKEN minimal<br># cloud'ga OIDC, uzoq muddatli kalit yo'q<br>- uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4<br>  with: { role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123:role/ci-deploy, aws-region: eu-central-1 }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ephemeral pod, lekin host Docker socket mount qilingan yoki privileged — konteynerdan node'ga chiqib, boshqa runner'larga ta'sir qilish mumkin.</li><li>Node'ning cloud metadata endpoint'i (IMDS) ochiq — pod node IAM role'ini oladi. IMDSv2 hop limit=1 yoki NetworkPolicy bilan yop.</li><li>Shared cache volume (npm, Docker layer) — cache poisoning orqali holat baribir o'tadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ephemeral — zarur, lekin yetarli emas. To'liq model: ephemeral + izolyatsiya (alohida node pool yoki microVM, masalan Firecracker) + egress cheklovi + qisqa muddatli OIDC credential'lar + ishonchsiz kod uchun alohida runner guruhi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain

Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40687	<p>tfsec nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> tfsec (Aqua Security) — Terraform uchun tez statik xavfsizlik skaneri edi. 2023 dan beri u <b>Trivy</b> ga birlashtirilgan va yangi funksiyalar faqat Trivy'da: <code>trivy config</code> Terraform, CloudFormation, K8s, Helm, Dockerfile misconfiguration'larini o'sha qoidalar bilan tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ochiq security group, shifrlanmagan disk, public RDS, <code>*:*</code> IAM policy — PR bosqichida ushlash kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>brew install trivy<br>trivy config ./terraform<br>trivy config --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 ./terraform<br>trivy config --tf-vars prod.tfvars ./terraform</pre><p>Chiqish:</p><pre>main.tf (terraform)<br>HIGH: Security group rule allows ingress from public internet.<br> AVD-AWS-0107<br>  12 |   cidr_blocks = [&quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;]</pre><p>Ignore (sabab bilan):</p><pre>#trivy:ignore:AVD-AWS-0107  # ALB public bo'lishi kerak<br>resource &quot;aws_security_group_rule&quot; &quot;alb_https&quot; { }</pre><p>Eski <code>#tfsec:ignore:aws-ec2-no-public-ingress-sgr</code> izohlari Trivy'da ham taniladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yangi loyihada tfsec o'rnatish — u faqat bakim (maintenance) rejimida; Trivy'ga o't.</li><li>Modullar <code>terraform init</code> qilinmagan bo'lsa remote modul ichi skanerlanmaydi.</li><li>Custom Rego qoidalarni tfsec formatidan Trivy formatiga ko'chirish kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Trivy'ning afzalligi — bitta binary image CVE, SBOM, secret va IaC'ni qamraydi, pipeline'da tool soni kamayadi. Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40688	<p>Infracost nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Infracost — Terraform/OpenTofu kodini (yoki plan JSON'ni) tahlil qilib, cloud narx API'lari asosida oylik xarajatni va PR qanchaga o'zgartirishini hisoblaydigan tool; natijani PR izohi sifatida yozadi va narx policy'larini qo'llay oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Developer <code>instance_type = &quot;m5.large&quot;</code> ni <code>&quot;m5.4xlarge&quot;</code> ga o'zgartiradi — review'da hech kim $500/oy farqni sezmaydi; xarajat oy oxirida hisob-fakturada ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>terraform plan JSON --&gt; Infracost resurs/atributlarni ajratadi<br>   --&gt; Cloud Pricing API (AWS/Azure/GCP narxlari)<br>   --&gt; base vs PR farqi --&gt; PR izohi: &quot;+$412/oy (+18%)&quot;<br>usage-based resurslar (S3, Lambda) --&gt; infracost-usage.yml dagi taxminlar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>infracost auth login<br>infracost breakdown --path ./envs/prod<br>infracost breakdown --path . --format json --out-file base.json   # main branch<br>infracost diff --path . --compare-to base.json                    # PR branch<br>infracost comment github --path diff.json --repo org/infra \<br>  --pull-request $PR --github-token $GH_TOKEN --behavior update</pre><p>Chiqish: resurs bo'yicha <code>Monthly Qty</code>, <code>Unit</code>, <code>Monthly Cost</code>, oxirida <code>OVERALL TOTAL</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Usage-based narxlar (egress, so'rovlar soni) default 0 — usage fayl bermasang haqiqiy xarajat kam ko'rinadi.</li><li>Chegirmalar (Savings Plans, RI, EDP) hisobga olinmaydi — bu ro'yxat narxi.</li><li>Har PR'ni narx bo'yicha bloklash — avval faqat ko'rsatish, keyin katta o'sishlar uchun approval.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> FinOps'ning &quot;shift-left&quot; qismi: xarajatni qaror qabul qilinayotgan joyda (PR) ko'rsatish.
