yangilash <code>nx migrate</code> bilan.</li><li><code>namedInputs</code> noto'g'ri — test fayl o'zgarishi production build cache'ini bekor qiladi yoki aksincha.</li><li>Remote cache (Nx Cloud) tijoriy; self-hosted variantlar shartlarini tekshir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Nx vs Turborepo: Nx — ko'proq imkoniyat (boundaries, generatorlar, distributed execution), ko'proq konvensiya; Turborepo — sodda va yengil. Tanlov jamoa hajmi va kerakli boshqaruv darajasiga bog'liq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40719	<p>Git pre-commit hook nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Git pre-commit hook — <code>.git/hooks/pre-commit</code> dagi skript: <code>git commit</code> paytida commit yaratilishidan <b>oldin</b> lokal ishga tushadi; nol bo'lmagan exit code commit'ni to'xtatadi. Odatda format, lint, secret skanerlash, katta fayl tekshiruvi. U majburiy emas: <code>git commit --no-verify</code> bilan o'tkazib yuboriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Formatlash xatosi yoki tasodifan commit qilingan <code>.env</code> CI'da 10 daqiqadan keyin topiladi (yoki secret allaqachon push qilingan). Lokal hook buni soniyalarda ushlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>git commit<br>  -&gt; pre-commit (staged fayllar)  -- exit 1 --&gt; commit bekor<br>  -&gt; prepare-commit-msg -&gt; commit-msg (xabar formati) -&gt; commit yaratildi<br>  -&gt; post-commit<br>git push -&gt; pre-push</pre><p><code>.git/hooks/</code> repo bilan <b>klonlanmaydi</b> — har developer o'zi o'rnatadi (shuning uchun <code>pre-commit</code>, husky, lefthook kabi tool'lar).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat &gt; .git/hooks/pre-commit &lt;&lt;'EOF'<br>#!/bin/sh<br>set -e<br>files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM -- '*.go')<br>[ -z &quot;$files&quot; ] || gofmt -l $files | (! grep .) || { echo &quot;gofmt kerak&quot;; exit 1; }<br>gitleaks protect --staged --redact<br>EOF<br>chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit<br>git config core.hooksPath .githooks     # repo ichidagi umumiy hook papkasi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hook'ga ishonib CI'da tekshirmaslik — <code>--no-verify</code> yoki hook o'rnatilmagan mashina. Har tekshiruv CI'da takrorlanishi shart.</li><li>Sekin hook (butun test suite) — developer'lar <code>--no-verify</code>ni odat qiladi. Faqat staged fayllar, soniyalar.</li><li>Staged va working tree farqi: hook working tree'dagi faylni tekshirsa, commit'ga boshqa versiya tushadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pre-commit — developer tajribasi uchun (tez feedback), xavfsizlik nazorati uchun emas. Server tomonda: push protection (GitHub secret scanning), branch protection va CI check'lar majburiy qatlam.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40720	<p><code>pre-commit</code> framework nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>pre-commit</code> (pre-commit.com) — Python'da yozilgan ko'p tilli hook menejeri: <code>.pre-commit-config.yaml</code> da hook'lar repo URL va <b>versiya (rev)</b> bilan e'lon qilinadi, tool o'zi ularni izolyatsiyalangan muhitga o'rnatadi va faqat staged fayllarga ishga tushiradi. Hook'lar repo bilan birga versiyalanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Qo'lda yozilgan <code>.git/hooks</code> skriptlari klonlanmaydi, har developer'da boshqa tool versiyasi, Python/Node/Go hook'larini o'rnatish og'riqli.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># .pre-commit-config.yaml<br>repos:<br>  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks<br>    rev: v5.0.0<br>    hooks:<br>      - id: trailing-whitespace<br>      - id: end-of-file-fixer<br>      - id: check-added-large-files<br>        args: [--maxkb=500]<br>      - id: check-yaml<br>  - repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks<br>    rev: v8.21.2<br>    hooks: [{ id: gitleaks }]<br>  - repo: https://github.com/antonbabenko/pre-commit-terraform<br>    rev: v1.96.2<br>    hooks: [{ id: terraform_fmt }, { id: terraform_validate }]</pre><pre>pipx install pre-commit<br>pre-commit install                    # .git/hooks/pre-commit ni o'rnatadi<br>pre-commit install --hook-type commit-msg<br>pre-commit run --all-files            # butun repo bo'yicha (CI'da ham shu)<br>pre-commit autoupdate                 # rev'larni yangilash</pre><p>CI'da: <code>pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure</code> yoki pre-commit.ci xizmati.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>rev</code> sifatida mutable tag — teoriyada qayta yozilishi mumkin; yuqori xavfsizlik talabida commit SHA (<code>autoupdate --freeze</code>).</li><li>Yangi hook qo'shib <code>--all-files</code> ishga tushirmaslik — eski fayllar keyingi tegilganda kutilmaganda &quot;yiqiladi&quot;.</li><li>Har developer <code>pre-commit install</code> qilishini unutadi — CI tekshiruvi baribir kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yagona <code>.pre-commit-config.yaml</code> ham lokal, ham CI uchun manba bo'lsa — &quot;menda o'tdi, CI'da yiqildi&quot; holatlari yo'qoladi. JS loyihalarda muqobil: husky + lint-staged; tez, ko'p tilli muqobil: lefthook.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40721	<p>Trunk-based'da feature flag lifecycle qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Trunk-based development'da feature flag lifecycle: 1) flag yaratiladi (nomi, egasi, tozalash muddati bilan), 2) yangi kod flag ortida (default OFF) kichik PR'lar bilan <code>main</code>ga merge qilinadi, 3) prod'ga deploy (kod bor, lekin o'chiq), 4) bosqichma-bosqich yoqiladi (ichki xodimlar -&gt; 5% -&gt; 100%), 5) barqaror bo'lgach flag va eski kod yo'li <b>o'chiriladi</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Trunk-based'da uzoq yashovchi branch yo'q — tugallanmagan feature ham main'ga tushadi. Flag uni foydalanuvchidan yashiradi. Lekin tozalanmagan flag'lar texnik qarzga aylanadi (Knight Capital 2012: eski flag qayta ishlatilib $440M yo'qotish).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>create flag (owner, expiry) -&gt; code behind flag -&gt; merge main -&gt; deploy (OFF)<br>   -&gt; enable: internal -&gt; 5% -&gt; 50% -&gt; 100%   (har qadamda metrika)<br>   -&gt; remove flag + old path (PR) -&gt; flag config'dan o'chirish</pre><p><b>Amalda (OpenFeature, Go):</b></p><pre>client := openfeature.NewClient(&quot;checkout&quot;)<br>ctx := openfeature.NewEvaluationContext(userID, map[string]any{&quot;country&quot;: &quot;UZ&quot;})<br>if ok, _ := client.BooleanValue(context.Background(), &quot;new-checkout-flow&quot;, false, ctx); ok {<br>    return newCheckout(req)<br>}<br>return oldCheckout(req)</pre><p>Tozalashni majburlash: flag'da <code>expires: 2026-12-01</code>, CI'da muddati o'tgan flag'lar uchun ogohlantirish (yoki LaunchDarkly/Unleash &quot;stale flag&quot; hisobotlari).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default qiymat noto'g'ri (<code>true</code>) — flag servisi ishlamasa tugallanmagan feature hammaga yoqiladi.</li><li>Flag'lar bir-biriga bog'liq (A yoqilgan va B o'chiq) — test kombinatsiyalari portlaydi.</li><li>Release flag va uzoq muddatli ops/permission flag'larini aralashtirish — har biri boshqa lifecycle'ga ega.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Flag turlarini ajrat: release (qisqa, kunlar-haftalar), experiment (A/B), ops/kill switch (uzoq), permission (doimiy). Faqat release flag'lar uchun qat'iy tozalash muddati — bu qarzni nazoratda ushlaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40722	<p>Dark launching va shadowing farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Dark launch</b> — yangi kodni prod'ga chiqarish, lekin foydalanuvchilar uni ko'rmaydi (flag ortida yoki faqat ichki chaqiruvlar, ba'zan real so'rovlar bilan &quot;fon&quot;da ishlaydi). <b>Shadowing (traffic mirroring)</b> — jonli kiruvchi so'rovlarni nusxalab yangi versiyaga ham yuborish; foydalanuvchiga faqat eski versiya javobi qaytadi, yangisining javobi tashlanadi (yoki solishtiriladi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi versiya real yuklama va real ma'lumot shakllarida qanday ishlashini foydalanuvchiga ta'sir qilmasdan bilish kerak (yangi DB, qayta yozilgan servis).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>shadowing:<br>client --&gt; proxy (Istio/Envoy/NGINX) --&gt; v1 --&gt; javob client'ga<br>                     \--copy (fire-and-forget)--&gt; v2 --&gt; javob tashlanadi, metrika/diff<br>dark launch:<br>client --&gt; app (flag OFF uchun user'lar) --&gt; eski yo'l<br>                 + fon: yangi yo'l ham chaqiriladi yoki faqat internal user'larga ON</pre><p><b>Amalda (Istio mirroring):</b></p><pre>apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1<br>kind: VirtualService<br>metadata: { name: search }<br>spec:<br>  hosts: [search]<br>  http:<br>    - route: [{ destination: { host: search, subset: v1 }, weight: 100 }]<br>      mirror: { host: search, subset: v2 }<br>      mirrorPercentage: { value: 10.0 }</pre><p>NGINX: <code>mirror /mirror;</code> direktivasi.</p><p>| | Dark launch | Shadowing | |---|---|---| | Qatlam | Ilova (flag) | Tarmoq (proxy) | | Real user ko'radimi | Tanlangan guruh ko'rishi mumkin | Hech qachon | | Asosiy maqsad | Kod prod'da, release keyin | Yangi versiyani real trafik bilan sinash |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mirror qilingan yozish so'rovlari (POST /payment) — yangi versiya ham to'lov qiladi yoki xat yuboradi! Shadow'da side effect'larni o'chir yoki faqat read so'rovlar.</li><li>Shadow trafik yuklamani oshiradi — umumiy DB/downstream'lar ikki baravar yuk oladi.</li><li>Mirror javoblari tashlanadi — xatolarni ko'rish uchun alohida metrika/diff (Diffy kabi) kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shadowing — qayta yozish (rewrite) va migratsiyalar uchun eng kuchli xavfsiz vosita: eski va yangi javoblarni solishtirib, farq foizini nolga tushirgandan keyingina canary'ga o't.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40723	<p>Artifact provenance hujjati nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Provenance — artifact (image, binary) qanday paydo bo'lgani haqidagi imzolangan, tekshiriladigan metadata: qaysi source repo va <b>commit SHA</b>dan, qaysi build platformasi va workflow'da, qanday parametrlar va dependency'lar bilan, qachon build qilingan. Standart format — SLSA Provenance (in-toto attestation).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Registry'da <code>api:1.5.0</code> turibdi. U haqiqatan bizning CI'da, review qilingan main branch'dan build qilinganmi yoki kimdir noutbukidan push qilganmi? Provenance'siz — bilib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build platformasi (GitHub Actions) --&gt; provenance:<br>  subject:  ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc<br>  builder:  https://github.com/actions/runner (github-hosted)<br>  source:   git+https://github.com/org/api@refs/tags/v1.5.0, commit 9f1e...<br>  workflow: .github/workflows/release.yml, inputs, start/finish vaqt<br>--&gt; imzo (Sigstore) --&gt; registry/Rekor<br>deploy/admission: provenance'ni tekshir -&gt; repo == org/api, ref == tag, builder ishonchli?</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>permissions: { id-token: write, attestations: write, packages: write, contents: read }<br>steps:<br>  - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6<br>    id: push<br>    with: { push: true, tags: ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 }<br>  - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2<br>    with: { subject-name: ghcr.io/org/api, subject-digest: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}, push-to-registry: true }</pre><pre>gh attestation verify oci://ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 --owner org</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Provenance'ni build skripti o'zi yozsa (platforma emas) — buzilgan build soxta provenance yozadi (SLSA L1). Platforma yaratgan va imzolagan bo'lsin (L2/L3).</li><li>Faqat yaratish, tekshirmaslik — hujjat bor, nazorat yo'q.</li><li>Provenance'dagi source'ga ishonish — source'ning o'zi review qilinganini (branch protection) alohida ta'minlash kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provenance incident response'da ham bebaho: &quot;zararli image qaysi commit, qaysi run'dan?&quot; savoliga darhol javob. Policy'da eng muhim tekshiruvlar — source repo, ref (tag/main) va builder identity.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40724	<p>CycloneDX nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CycloneDX — OWASP Foundation'ning BOM (Bill of Materials) standarti (ECMA-424): komponentlar (paketlar, purl, hash, litsenziya), dependency graph, servislar va zaifliklar haqidagi ma'lumotni JSON/XML/Protobuf'da ifodalaydi. } }] }<br>  ],<br>  &quot;dependencies&quot;: [{ &quot;ref&quot;: &quot;pkg:golang/org/api&quot;, &quot;dependsOn&quot;: [&quot;pkg:golang/golang.org/x/net@v0.30.0&quot;] }]<br>}</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>syft ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 -o cyclonedx-json &gt; \<br>  -F project=$UUID -F bom=@sbom.cdx.json</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>purl</code> bo'lmagan komponentlar — skanerlar ularni CVE bazasiga moslay olmaydi.</li><li>Spec versiyalari farqi (1.4/1.5/1.6) — iste'molchi tool qo'llamasligi mumkin.</li><li>SBOM build'dan keyin emas, artifact'ning o'zidan yaratilsin — aks holda &quot;nima reja qilingan&quot;ni ko'rsatadi, &quot;nima yetkazilgan&quot;ni emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CycloneDX vs SPDX: CycloneDX xavfsizlik use-case'lariga (VEX, zaifliklar, servislar) qulayroq, SPDX litsenziya/compliance va ISO standarti sifatida kuchli. Ko'p tool ikkalasini chiqaradi; mijoz/regulator talabiga qarab tanla.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40725	<p>SPDX nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SPDX (Software Package Data Exchange) — Linux Foundation standarti, <b>ISO/IEC 5962:2021</b>: dasturiy paketlar, fayllar, ular orasidagi munosabatlar, litsenziyalar va copyright haqidagi ma'lumotni almashish formati (tag-value, JSON, YAML, RDF). Litsenziya identifikatorlari (<code>Apache-2.0</code>, <code>MIT</code>) ham SPDX License List'dan keladi. SPDX 3.0 (2024) — profillarga (Security, Build, AI, Dataset) bo'lingan yangi model.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kompaniya mahsulotidagi barcha open source litsenziyalarini bilishi kerak (GPL kodi yopiq mahsulotda — huquqiy risk); AQSh EO 14028 kabi talablar SBOM'ni so'raydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (JSON fragment, SPDX 2.3):</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;spdxVersion&quot;: &quot;SPDX-2.3&quot;,<br>  &quot;dataLicense&quot;: &quot;CC0-1.0&quot;,<br>  &quot;SPDXID&quot;: &quot;SPDXRef-DOCUMENT&quot;,<br>  &quot;name&quot;: &quot;org-api-1.5.0&quot;,<br>  &quot;packages&quot;: [<br>    { &quot;SPDXID&quot;: &quot;SPDXRef-Package-net&quot;, &quot;name&quot;: &quot;golang.org/x/net&quot;, &quot;versionInfo&quot;: &quot;v0.30.0&quot;,<br>      &quot;licenseConcluded&quot;: &quot;BSD-3-Clause&quot;,<br>      &quot;externalRefs&quot;: [{ &quot;referenceCategory&quot;: &quot;PACKAGE-MANAGER&quot;, &quot;referenceType&quot;: &quot;purl&quot;,<br>                         &quot;referenceLocator&quot;: &quot;pkg:golang/golang.org/x/net@v0.30.0&quot; }] }<br>  ],<br>  &quot;relationships&quot;: [{ &quot;spdxElementId&quot;: &quot;SPDXRef-DOCUMENT&quot;, &quot;relationshipType&quot;: &quot;DESCRIBES&quot;,<br>                      &quot;relatedSpdxElement&quot;: &quot;SPDXRef-Package-net&quot; }]<br>}</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>syft ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 -o spdx-json &gt; sbom.spdx.json<br>docker buildx build --sbom=true -t org/api:1.5.0 --push .   # BuildKit SPDX attestation<br>jq -r '.packages[] | &quot;\(.name) \(.licenseConcluded)&quot;' sbom.spdx.json | sort -u</pre><p>Kod fayllarida: <code>// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>NOASSERTION</code> litsenziyalar — tool aniqlay olmagan; CycloneDX — xavfsizlik jamoalari tilida. Supply chain dasturida ko'pincha ikkalasini ham yaratib saqlash eng arzon yo'l.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40726	<p>VEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) — mashina o'qiy oladigan hujjat: ma'lum bir mahsulotga nisbatan aniq CVE'ning holatini bildiradi — <code>not_affected</code> (sabab bilan), <code>affected</code>, <code>fixed</code>, <code>under_investigation</code>. Maqsad: SBOM + scanner bergan yuzlab &quot;nazariy&quot; zaifliklardan haqiqatan muhimlarini ajratish. Formatlar: OpenVEX, CycloneDX VEX, CSAF VEX.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Scanner image'da 200 CVE ko'rsatadi. Ko'pchiligi ishlatilmaydigan funksiyada yoki kompilyatsiya qilinmagan kodda. Har mijoz/audit bir xil savolni beradi; jamoa har safar qo'lda tushuntiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SBOM (komponentlar) + scanner (CVE ro'yxati)<br>   + VEX (vendor bayonoti: CVE-X not_affected, vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path)<br>   --&gt; filtrlangan natija: faqat affected/under_investigation</pre><p><code>not_affected</code> asoslari (justification): <code>component_not_present</code>, <code>vulnerable_code_not_present</code>, <code>vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path</code>, <code>vulnerable_code_cannot_be_controlled_by_adversary</code>, <code>inline_mitigations_already_exist</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda (OpenVEX):</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;@context&quot;: &quot;https://openvex.dev/ns/v0.2.0&quot;,<br>  &quot;@id&quot;: &quot;https://org.com/vex/api-1.5.0&quot;,<br>  &quot;author&quot;: &quot;security@org.com&quot;,<br>  &quot;timestamp&quot;: &quot;2026-10-01T10:00:00Z&quot;,<br>  &quot;statements&quot;: [{<br>    &quot;vulnerability&quot;: { &quot;name&quot;: &quot;CVE-2024-45338&quot; },<br>    &quot;products&quot;: [{ &quot;@id&quot;: &quot;pkg:oci/api@sha256:abc...&quot; }],<br>    &quot;status&quot;: &quot;not_affected&quot;,<br>    &quot;justification&quot;: &quot;vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path&quot;,<br>    &quot;impact_statement&quot;: &quot;html tokenizer ishlatilmaydi&quot;<br>  }]<br>}</pre><pre>vexctl create --product pkg:oci/api@sha256:abc --vuln CVE-2024-45338 \<br>  --status not_affected --justification vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path &gt; api.vex.json<br>trivy image --vex api.vex.json ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0<br>grype ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 --vex api.vex.json</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>not_affected</code>ni asossiz qo'yish — bu xavfli yolg'on; har bayonotni texnik dalil (reachability tahlili) bilan qo'llab-quvvatla.</li><li>VEX ma'lum mahsulot versiyasiga bog'langan — kod o'zgarsa qayta baholash kerak.</li><li>Imzolanmagan VEX — har kim CVE'larni &quot;yopib&quot; qo'yishi mumkin; attestation sifatida imzola.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> VEX — triage natijasini qayta ishlatiladigan aktivga aylantiradi. <code>govulncheck</code> kabi reachability tool'lari VEX yaratishni avtomatlashtirishi mumkin. VEX bilan CVE shovqini kamayadi va jamoa haqiqiy riskka e'tibor beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40727	<p>SLSA provenance nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SLSA provenance — SLSA spec'idagi in-toto attestation predicate turi (<code>https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1</code>): artifact qaysi <b>build platformasi</b> (<code>builder.id</code>), qaysi <b>build ta'rifi</b> (buildType, externalParameters: repo, ref, workflow), qaysi <b>resolvedDependencies</b> (source commit, base image) bilan yaratilganini yozadi. Build platformasi yaratib imzolaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Provenance&quot; umumiy so'z; SLSA uni aniq sxema bilan standartlashtiradi — shunda verifier (slsa-verifier, Kyverno, <code>gh attestation</code>) har qanday platformaning provenance'ini bir xil qoidalar bilan tekshira oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;_type&quot;: &quot;https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1&quot;,<br>  &quot;subject&quot;: [{ &quot;name&quot;: &quot;ghcr.io/org/api&quot;, &quot;digest&quot;: { &quot;sha256&quot;: &quot;abc...&quot; } }],<br>  &quot;predicateType&quot;: &quot;https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1&quot;,<br>  &quot;predicate&quot;: {<br>    &quot;buildDefinition&quot;: {<br>      &quot;buildType&quot;: &quot;https://actions.github.io/buildtypes/workflow/v1&quot;,<br>      &quot;externalParameters&quot;: { &quot;workflow&quot;: { &quot;repository&quot;: &quot;https://github.com/org/api&quot;,<br>                                            &quot;ref&quot;: &quot;refs/tags/v1.5.0&quot;, &quot;path&quot;: &quot;.github/workflows/release.yml&quot; } },<br>      &quot;resolvedDependencies&quot;: [{ &quot;uri&quot;: &quot;git+https://github.com/org/api@refs/tags/v1.5.0&quot;,<br>                                 &quot;digest&quot;: { &quot;gitCommit&quot;: &quot;9f1e...&quot; } }]<br>    },<br>    &quot;runDetails&quot;: { &quot;builder&quot;: { &quot;id&quot;: &quot;https://github.com/actions/runner/github-hosted&quot; },<br>                    &quot;metadata&quot;: { &quot;invocationId&quot;: &quot;https://github.com/org/api/actions/runs/123&quot; } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>slsa-verifier verify-image ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc... \<br>  --source-uri github.com/org/api --source-tag v1.5.0<br>cosign verify-attestation --type slsaprovenance1 \<br>  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/org/' \<br>  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc...</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>v0.2 va v1 predicate formatlari farq qiladi (<code>predicateType</code> URI boshqa) — verifier qaysi birini kutishini bil.</li><li><code>externalParameters</code>ni tekshirmaslik — boshqa branch yoki fork'dan build ham o'tadi.</li><li>Provenance image digest'iga bog'langan; tag'ni qayta push qilsang eski provenance yangi image'ga tegishli emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provenance tekshiruvining kuchi — &quot;faqat shu repo, shu workflow, protected ref'dan, ishonchli builder'da build qilingan narsa prod'ga chiqadi&quot; degan bitta qoidada. Bu qoida bilan hatto registry credential'i o'g'irlansa ham soxta image deploy bo'lmaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40728	<p>Docker Content Trust (DCT) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Docker Content Trust (DCT) — Notary v1 / The Update Framework (TUF) asosidagi Docker imzo mexanizmi: <code>DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1</code> bo'lsa <code>docker push</code> tag'ni imzolaydi, <code>docker pull</code> esa faqat imzolangan tag'larni oladi. Bugun u <b>eskirgan</b> (Notary v1 deyarli rivojlanmaydi, Docker Hub'da qo'llov kamaymoqda); zamonaviy alternativalar — Sigstore Cosign va Notary Project <b>Notation</b> (Notary v2).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Registry yoki tarmoq buzilsa, <code>nginx:1.27</code> tag'i ostida boshqa image berilishi mumkin. Imzo publisher va yaxlitlikni isbotlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (DCT):</b></p><pre>docker push (DCT=1) --&gt; root key + repository (targets) key bilan tag-&gt;digest imzosi<br>                    --&gt; Notary server (TUF metadata: root, targets, snapshot, timestamp)<br>docker pull (DCT=1) --&gt; Notary'dan imzolangan tag-&gt;digest --&gt; faqat shu digest pull</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>export DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1<br>docker trust key generate alice<br>docker trust signer add --key alice.pub alice org/api<br>docker push org/api:1.5.0          # imzolaydi<br>docker trust inspect --pretty org/api:1.5.0</pre><p>Zamonaviy ekvivalent:</p><pre>cosign sign --yes org/api@sha256:...                        # Sigstore<br>notation sign --key mykey org/api@sha256:...                # Notation (X.509, KMS)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DCT faqat Docker CLI darajasida ishlaydi — Kubernetes (containerd) uni tekshirmaydi; klaster himoyasi uchun admission policy kerak.</li><li>Root key yo'qolsa repository imzosini tiklash juda og'ir; offline saqlash shart edi.</li><li>DCT imzosi registry'ga emas, alohida Notary serverga bog'langan — ko'p registry'lar (ECR, GHCR) uni qo'llamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi tizimda DCT'ni tanlama. Tanlov Cosign (keyless, Sigstore ekotizimi, OSS'da keng) va Notation (X.509 PKI, korporativ CA va Azure/AWS signer integratsiyasi) orasida; ikkalasi OCI referrers orqali imzoni registry'da saqlaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40729	<p>Pipeline deadlock nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pipeline deadlock — ikki yoki undan ko'p job/pipeline bir-birini kutib, hech biri oldinga siljiy olmaydigan holat: A resurs 1 ni (lock, runner, muhit) ushlab resurs 2 ni kutadi, B esa resurs 2 ni ushlab resurs 1 ni kutadi. Natija — pipeline'lar timeout'gacha (yoki abadiy) osilib turadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Real misollar: ikki deploy pipeline staging va prod lock'larini teskari tartibda oladi; parent job barcha runner'larni band qilib, child job'lar uchun runner qolmaydi; Terraform state lock'ini yiqilgan job qo'yib ketdi va hamma kutadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pipeline A: lock(staging) ... lock(prod)  &lt;- kutyapti<br>Pipeline B: lock(prod)    ... lock(staging) &lt;- kutyapti<br>                 ^ sikl = deadlock<br><br>Runner starvation:<br>4 runner: 4 ta parent job ishlab turibdi, har biri child job'ni kutadi -&gt; child'ga runner yo'q</pre><p><b>Amalda (oldini olish):</b></p><pre># GitHub Actions: muhit bo'yicha bitta concurrency group, timeout majburiy<br>concurrency: { group: deploy-${{ inputs.env }}, cancel-in-progress: false }<br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    timeout-minutes: 30</pre><pre># Terraform: osilib qolgan lock'ni tekshirib ochish (ehtiyot bilan)<br>terraform force-unlock &lt;LOCK_ID&gt;<br># GitLab: resource_group bir vaqtda bitta job<br># .gitlab-ci.yml -&gt; deploy_prod: { resource_group: production }</pre><p>Qoidalar: lock'larni doim bir xil global tartibda olish; trigger/child pipeline'lar uchun alohida runner pool; har job va lock'da timeout.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Timeout'siz job'lar — deadlock sezilmaydi, faqat &quot;CI sekin&quot; shikoyati.</li><li><code>cancel-in-progress: true</code> deploy'da — yarim qolgan deploy; deploy'larda navbat (false) yaxshiroq.</li><li>Lock'ni qo'lda majburan ochish, boshqa job hali ishlayotganda — state buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Deadlock'ni klassik shartlar (mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no preemption, circular wait) orqali tahlil qil va bittasini buz: odatda aylanma kutishni lock tartibi bilan, hold-and-wait'ni esa &quot;hamma lock'ni birdaniga ol yoki hech birini&quot; bilan.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40730	<p>CI/CD pipeline blast radius nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CI/CD blast radius — CI/CD tizimi (runner, pipeline, credential, plugin) buzilsa yoki xato ishlasa yetkazilishi mumkin bo'lgan maksimal zarar: qaysi muhitlar, akkauntlar, secret'lar va ma'lumotlarga yeta oladi. CI/CD odatda eng imtiyozli tizim, shuning uchun uning blast radius'ini ataylab kichraytirish kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta Jenkins serverida barcha prod cloud kalitlari, kubeconfig'lar va DB parollari. Zaif plugin yoki zararli PR -&gt; butun kompaniya infratuzilmasi (Codecov, CircleCI 2023 hodisalari).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (kamaytirish qatlamlari):</b></p><pre>katta:   CI (admin kalit hamma akkauntga) --push--&gt; prod<br>kichik:  CI: faqat build + image push (registry'ga yozish)<br>         prod klaster ichidagi ArgoCD/Flux --pull--&gt; Git   (prod credential CI'da yo'q)<br>         OIDC: job -&gt; 15 daqiqalik role, faqat shu repo/branch/environment uchun<br>         runner: ephemeral, alohida pool (untrusted PR vs release)<br>         environment protection: prod uchun approval + faqat main</pre><p><b>Amalda (AWS role trust, faqat main'dagi release workflow):</b></p><pre>&quot;Condition&quot;: {<br>  &quot;StringEquals&quot;: {<br>    &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud&quot;: &quot;sts.amazonaws.com&quot;,<br>    &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub&quot;: &quot;repo:org/api:environment:production&quot;<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    environment: production         # required reviewers, faqat protected branch<br>    permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta &quot;ci-admin&quot; IAM user hamma repo uchun — bitta repo buzilsa hammasi buziladi. Repo/muhit bo'yicha alohida role.</li><li><code>sub</code> claim'ni wildcard (<code>repo:org/*</code>) — har qanday repo, har qanday branch prod role'ni oladi.</li><li>Self-hosted runner'lar prod VPC ichida — runner buzilsa tarmoq ichidan hujum.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Savol: &quot;Eng kam ishonchli kod (fork PR, yangi dependency) qaysi eng qimmat secret'ga yeta oladi?&quot; Javob &quot;hech qaysi&quot; bo'lmaguncha arxitekturani o'zgartir. Pull-based GitOps + OIDC + ephemeral izolyatsiyalangan runner'lar — eng ta'sirli uchlik.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40731	<p>Argo Rollouts'da avtomatik rollback qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Argo Rollouts'da avtomatik rollback: canary bosqichidagi <code>AnalysisRun</code> muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa (failureLimit oshsa) Rollout <b>abort</b> qilinadi — trafik darhol 100% stable ReplicaSet'ga qaytariladi, canary ReplicaSet 0 ga scale qilinadi va Rollout <code>Degraded</code> holatiga o'tadi. Inson aralashuvi shart emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kechasi 3 da chiqqan reliz error rate'ni 8% ga oshirdi. Inson alert'ni ko'rib, tahlil qilib, rollback qilguncha 20-30 daqiqa. Avtomatik analiz buni 1-3 daqiqada qiladi va faqat canary ulushiga ta'sir qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>setWeight 20 -&gt; AnalysisRun (har 1m, 5 marta)<br>   success-rate: 0.995 ok, 0.97 FAIL, 0.96 FAIL  (failureLimit: 1 -&gt; oshdi)<br>   -&gt; AnalysisRun Failed -&gt; Rollout abort<br>   -&gt; trafik: stable 100%, canary 0 -&gt; status Degraded</pre><p>Background analysis (butun rollout davomida) yoki inline analysis step ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>strategy:<br>  canary:<br>    analysis:                      # background: 2-qadamdan boshlab doimiy<br>      templates: [{ templateName: success-rate }]<br>      startingStep: 1<br>      args: [{ name: service, value: api-canary }]<br>    steps:<br>      - setWeight: 10<br>      - pause: { duration: 5m }<br>      - setWeight: 30<br>      - pause: { duration: 10m }<br>      - setWeight: 100</pre><pre>kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api<br># Status: Degraded  Message: RolloutAborted: metric &quot;success-rate&quot; assessed Failed<br>kubectl argo rollouts retry rollout api      # tuzatgandan keyin qayta urinish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Abort'dan keyin Git'da hali yangi image tag turibdi — ArgoCD keyingi sync'da Rollout spec'ini o'zgartirmaydi, lekin keyingi o'zgarish qayta canary boshlaydi. Git'ni revert qil.</li><li>To'liq promote bo'lgandan (100%) keyin abort mexanizmi ishlamaydi — bu oddiy rollback (<code>undo</code>) talab qiladi.</li><li>DB migration allaqachon bajarilgan bo'lsa trafik rollback'i yetmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avtomatik rollback faqat metrikalar canary'ni stable'dan ajrata olsa ishonchli. Abort hodisasini notification bilan jamoaga yetkaz va postmortem'da analiz chegaralarini kalibrla — juda qattiq bo'lsa yaxshi relizlar ham abort qilinadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40732	<p>Canary step weight nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Canary step weight — progressive rollout'ning ma'lum bosqichida yangi (canary) versiyaga yo'naltiriladigan trafik foizi. Argo Rollouts'da <code>setWeight: 20</code>, Flagger'da <code>stepWeight</code> (har qadam qo'shiladigan foiz) va <code>maxWeight</code>. Weight'lar ketma-ketligi va har birida kutish vaqti risk va tezlik muvozanatini belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Juda katta birinchi qadam (50%) — xato bo'lsa yarim foydalanuvchi jabrlanadi. Juda kichik (1%) kam trafikli servisda — statistik ma'nosiz, analiz hech narsani ko'rmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>trafik router bilan (Istio/NGINX/Gateway API): aniq foiz<br>   steps: 5% -&gt; 20% -&gt; 50% -&gt; 100%<br>router'siz (faqat replica): weight = canary pod / jami pod<br>   replicas 10, setWeight 20 -&gt; 2 canary pod, 8 stable (taxminiy)<br>   setWeight 5 va 10 replica -&gt; 1 pod (aslida 10%)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>strategy:<br>  canary:<br>    trafficRouting:<br>      istio: { virtualService: { name: api, routes: [primary] } }<br>    steps:<br>      - setWeight: 5<br>      - pause: { duration: 10m }<br>      - setWeight: 25<br>      - pause: { duration: 10m }<br>      - setWeight: 50<br>      - pause: { duration: 10m }<br>    # 100% oxirgi qadamdan keyin avtomatik</pre><pre>kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api   # Step: 3/6, SetWeight: 25, ActualWeight: 25</pre><p>Header-based routing (<code>setHeaderRoute</code>) bilan avval faqat ichki xodimlarni canary'ga yo'naltirish ham mumkin.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Router'siz kichik weight — pod soni yaxlitlanadi; <code>ActualWeight</code> ni tekshir.</li><li>Sticky session yo'q — bitta foydalanuvchi so'rovlari v1 va v2 orasida sakraydi (UI/API mos kelmasligi).</li><li>Weight'ni oshirish bilan canary pod'lar yetarli scale qilinmasa — canary yuklamadan yiqiladi (bu versiya xatosi emas). <code>dynamicStableScale</code>, HPA'ni tekshir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Weight tanlash: birinchi qadam kutilgan xatoni ko'rish uchun yetarli so'rov beradigan eng kichik foiz bo'lsin (masalan &quot;10 daqiqada kamida 1000 so'rov&quot;). Qadamlar soni ko'p bo'lsa reliz uzayadi — ko'p deploy qiladigan jamoada 3-4 qadam odatda yetarli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40733	<p>Flagger MetricTemplate nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flagger <code>MetricTemplate</code> — custom metrika so'rovini (Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, New Relic, Graphite, InfluxDB, Stackdriver ...) qayta ishlatiladigan resurs sifatida belgilaydigan CRD. <code>Canary.spec.analysis.metrics[]</code> unga <code>templateRef</code> bilan havola qiladi va <code>thresholdRange</code> (min/max) beradi. O'rnatilgan <code>request-success-rate</code> va <code>request-duration</code> dan tashqari biznes yoki maxsus metrikalar uchun kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> O'rnatilgan metrikalar mesh/ingress'ga bog'liq va faqat HTTP; sizga esa &quot;queue consumer lag&quot;, &quot;checkout xatolari&quot; yoki gRPC status'lari kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>MetricTemplate (provider + query, {{ namespace }}, {{ target }}, {{ interval }} o'zgaruvchilar)<br>Canary.analysis.metrics: templateRef + thresholdRange<br>Flagger har interval: query -&gt; qiymat -&gt; range ichida? -&gt; yo'q: failedChecks++<br>failedChecks &gt;= threshold -&gt; rollback</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: flagger.app/v1beta1<br>kind: MetricTemplate<br>metadata: { name: error-rate, namespace: flagger-system }<br>spec:<br>  provider: { type: prometheus, address: http://prometheus.monitoring:9090 }<br>  query: |<br>    100 * sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace=&quot;{{ namespace }}&quot;,pod=~&quot;{{ target }}-[0-9a-zA-Z]+(-[0-9a-zA-Z]+)&quot;,status=~&quot;5..&quot;}[{{ interval }}]))<br>    /<br>    sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace=&quot;{{ namespace }}&quot;,pod=~&quot;{{ target }}-[0-9a-zA-Z]+(-[0-9a-zA-Z]+)&quot;}[{{ interval }}]))<br>---<br># Canary ichida<br>analysis:<br>  metrics:<br>    - name: error-rate<br>      templateRef: { name: error-rate, namespace: flagger-system }<br>      thresholdRange: { max: 1 }      # 1% dan oshmasin<br>      interval: 1m</pre><pre>kubectl -n prod describe canary api   # Events: &quot;Halt advancement error-rate 3.2 &gt; 1&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik yo'q bo'lsa so'rov bo'sh/NaN qaytaradi — Flagger buni xato deb hisoblaydi va canary to'xtaydi. Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40734	<p>Blue-green cutover latency nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Blue-green cutover latency — trafikni Blue (eski) muhitdan Green (yangi) muhitga o'tkazish buyrug'idan barcha <b>yangi</b> so'rovlar Green'ga borguncha ketgan vaqt. Mexanizmga bog'liq: Kubernetes Service selector yoki mesh — soniyalar (endpoint propagation), load balancer target group — soniyalar-daqiqalar (health check, deregistration delay), DNS — TTL va resolver cache'larga qarab daqiqalar-soatlar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cutover sekin yoki notekis bo'lsa bir vaqtda ikkala versiya trafik oladi (mos kelmaslik), rollback ham shuncha sekin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><p>| Mexanizm | Odatdagi kechikish | Nimaga bog'liq | |---|---|---| | K8s Service selector | 1-5 s | EndpointSlice -&gt; kube-proxy/iptables yangilanishi | | Istio/Gateway API weight | 1-5 s | xDS konfiguratsiya tarqalishi | | ALB target group almashtirish | 5-60 s | health check, listener rule | | DNS | TTL (60 s) ... soatlar | client/resolver cache, TTL'ni hurmat qilmaslik |</p><pre>mavjud ulanishlar: keep-alive/HTTP2/gRPC uzoq yashovchi ulanishlar Blue'da qoladi<br>   -&gt; Blue'ni darhol o'chirma: connection draining</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># K8s: Service selector'ni almashtirish<br>kubectl patch svc api -p '{&quot;spec&quot;:{&quot;selector&quot;:{&quot;app&quot;:&quot;api&quot;,&quot;version&quot;:&quot;green&quot;}}}'<br>kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api -w<br># Argo Rollouts blue-green<br>kubectl argo rollouts promote api      # activeService -&gt; green</pre><pre>strategy:<br>  blueGreen:<br>    activeService: api<br>    previewService: api-preview<br>    autoPromotionEnabled: false<br>    scaleDownDelaySeconds: 300     # Blue 5 daqiqa tirik — tez rollback va draining</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DNS cutover'dan oldin TTL'ni kamaytirishni unutish (bir kun oldin 60 s ga) — eski TTL (1 soat) davomida trafik Blue'ga boradi.</li><li>Uzoq yashovchi ulanishlar (gRPC, WebSocket) — selector o'zgarsa ham eski pod'ga yopishib qoladi; ulanish yoshini cheklash (max connection age).</li><li>Blue'ni darhol scale down — tez rollback imkoniyati yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cutover latency'ni o'lcha (sintetik so'rovlar versiya header'i bilan) — &quot;100% Green&quot; momenti taxmin emas, o'lchov bo'lsin. Rollback ham xuddi shu mexanizm, shuning uchun tez cutover = tez rollback.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40735	<p>Pipeline concurrency lock nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pipeline concurrency lock — bir target (muhit, Terraform state, klaster) uchun bir vaqtda faqat <b>bitta</b> deploy pipeline/job bajarilishini kafolatlaydigan mexanizm; qolganlari navbatda kutadi yoki bekor qilinadi. GitHub Actions'da <code>concurrency</code>, GitLab'da <code>resource_group</code>, Jenkins'da <code>lock()</code> (Lockable Resources) yoki <code>disableConcurrentBuilds()</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki merge ketma-ket bo'ldi, ikkita deploy parallel ishladi: eski commit'ning deploy'i kechroq tugab, yangisini ustidan yozdi — prod'da eski versiya. Yoki ikki <code>terraform apply</code> bir state'ga.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>merge #1 -&gt; deploy-prod (lock oldi) ---------&gt; tugadi (lock bo'shadi)<br>merge #2 -&gt; deploy-prod (kutyapti) ................&gt; boshlandi<br>merge #3 -&gt; (pending #2 ni almashtiradi — faqat eng oxirgisi kutadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># GitHub Actions<br>concurrency:<br>  group: deploy-production<br>  cancel-in-progress: false       # ishlayotgan deploy'ni o'ldirma, navbatga qo'y</pre><pre># GitLab CI<br>deploy_prod:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  resource_group: production<br>  script: ./deploy.sh</pre><pre>// Jenkins<br>pipeline {<br>  options { disableConcurrentBuilds() }<br>  stages { stage('Deploy') { steps { lock('prod-env') { sh './deploy.sh' } } } }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>cancel-in-progress: true</code> deploy'da — yarim apply qilingan migratsiya yoki Terraform. Deploy uchun false, PR testlar uchun true.</li><li>GitHub <code>concurrency</code>da bitta guruhda faqat bitta <b>pending</b> run turadi — oraliq run'lar bekor qilinadi (odatda kerakli xatti-harakat, lekin bilib qo'y).</li><li>Lock CI darajasida, lekin kimdir lokal <code>terraform apply</code> qilsa — state lock (DynamoDB/S3 lockfile) ham kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Concurrency lock'ni target bo'yicha granular qil (<code>deploy-${{ env }}-${{ service }}</code>) — butun kompaniya bitta global lock'da kutib qolmasin. GitOps'da reconcile controller'ning o'zi bitta yozuvchi bo'lgani uchun bu muammoning katta qismi yo'qoladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40736	<p>GitOps sync window nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Sync window — ArgoCD <code>AppProject</code>dagi vaqt jadvali (cron + davomiylik): <code>allow</code> oynasi faqat shu vaqtda sync'ga ruxsat beradi, <code>deny</code> oynasi shu vaqtda sync'ni taqiqlaydi. Applications, namespace'lar yoki klasterlar bo'yicha qo'llanadi; <code>manualSync: true</code> bilan deny paytida ham qo'lda sync'ga ruxsat berish mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Juma kechqurun yoki &quot;Black Friday&quot; paytida avtomatik sync prod'ga yangi o'zgarish chiqarmasligi kerak (change freeze), lekin hotfix imkoniyati qolishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>sync so'rovi (auto yoki manual) --&gt; project windows tekshiriladi<br>   deny oynasi faol?        -&gt; bloklanadi (manualSync: true bo'lsa qo'lda ruxsat)<br>   allow oynalari bor va hech biri faol emas? -&gt; bloklanadi<br>   aks holda -&gt; sync</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: AppProject<br>metadata: { name: payments, namespace: argocd }<br>spec:<br>  syncWindows:<br>    - kind: deny<br>      schedule: &quot;0 18 * * 5&quot;      # juma 18:00 dan<br>      duration: 62h               # dushanba 08:00 gacha<br>      applications: [&quot;*-prod&quot;]<br>      manualSync: true            # hotfix uchun qo'lda sync mumkin<br>      timeZone: &quot;Asia/Tashkent&quot;<br>    - kind: allow<br>      schedule: &quot;0 9 * * 1-4&quot;<br>      duration: 8h<br>      clusters: [prod-eu]</pre><pre>argocd proj windows list payments<br>argocd app get api-prod     # &quot;Sync windows: Denied&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>timeZone</code> ko'rsatmaslik — default UTC, oyna kutilgandan boshqa soatda ishlaydi.</li><li>Deny oynasida self-heal ham ishlamaydi — drift oyna tugaguncha tuzatilmaydi.</li><li>Allow oynasi qo'shilishi bilan qolgan barcha vaqt avtomatik &quot;taqiqlangan&quot;ga aylanadi — bu ko'pincha kutilmagan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Change freeze — risk boshqaruvi vositasi, lekin uzun freeze'lar o'zgarishlarni to'plab, freeze'dan keyingi relizni xavfliroq qiladi. Freeze'ni minimal va aniq maqsadli qil; Flux'da analog — Kustomization'ni <code>suspend</code> qilish yoki tashqi jadval.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40737	<p>ArgoCD SSO nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ArgoCD SSO — foydalanuvchilarni lokal akkauntlar o'rniga tashkilot IdP'si (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google, GitHub, Keycloak) orqali autentifikatsiya qilish: bevosita <b>OIDC</b> yoki ichki <b>Dex</b> orqali (SAML, LDAP, GitHub connector). IdP'dan kelgan group claim'lari <code>argocd-rbac-cm</code> dagi rollarga map qilinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Lokal <code>admin</code> va umumiy parollar — kim nima qilganini bilib bo'lmaydi, xodim ketganda kirishni olish unutiladi, MFA yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>user --&gt; ArgoCD UI/CLI --redirect--&gt; IdP (login + MFA)<br>     &lt;-- ID token (email, groups: [&quot;platform-admins&quot;, &quot;payments-dev&quot;])<br>ArgoCD RBAC: g, payments-dev, role:payments-deployer<br>             p, role:payments-deployer, applications, sync, payments/*, allow</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># argocd-cm<br>data:<br>  url: https://argocd.org.com<br>  admin.enabled: &quot;false&quot;<br>  oidc.config: |<br>    name: Entra ID<br>    issuer: https://login.microsoftonline.com/&lt;tenant-id&gt;/v2.0<br>    clientID: &lt;client-id&gt;<br>    clientSecret: $oidc.entra.clientSecret<br>    requestedScopes: [&quot;openid&quot;, &quot;profile&quot;, &quot;email&quot;]<br>    requestedIDTokenClaims: { groups: { essential: true } }<br>---<br># argocd-rbac-cm<br>data:<br>  policy.default: role:readonly<br>  scopes: &quot;[groups]&quot;<br>  policy.csv: |<br>    p, role:payments-deployer, applications, get, payments/*, allow<br>    p, role:payments-deployer, applications, sync, payments/*, allow<br>    g, payments-dev, role:payments-deployer<br>    g, platform-admins, role:admin</pre><pre>argocd login argocd.org.com --sso<br>argocd account get-user-info<br>argocd admin settings rbac can role:payments-deployer sync applications 'payments/api-prod' \<br>  --policy-file policy.csv</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>policy.default: role:admin</code> yoki <code>readonly</code> o'rniga keng default — har kirgan odam ko'p narsa qila oladi.</li><li>Entra ID 200+ guruhli foydalanuvchida groups claim'ni token'ga qo'ymaydi (overage) — guruh filtrlash yoki app role'lar.</li><li>SSO yoqib, <code>admin</code> lokal akkauntni o'chirmaslik — yon eshik qoladi (break-glass uchun saqlasang, parolini vault'da va audit bilan).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> RBAC'ni AppProject chegaralari bilan birga loyihala: jamoa faqat o'z project'ida sync qila oladi, <code>exec</code> va <code>override</code> huquqlari alohida. RBAC konfiguratsiyasining o'zi ham Git'da va review'dan o'tsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40738	<p>FluxCD Source Controller nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flux Source Controller — tashqi manbalarni kuzatib, ularni klaster ichidagi boshqa controller'lar uchun <b>artifact</b> (tar.gz + revision + checksum) ga aylantiradigan controller. CRD'lari: <code>GitRepository</code>, <code>OCIRepository</code>, <code>HelmRepository</code>, <code>HelmChart</code>, <code>Bucket</code> (S3/GCS/Azure Blob). Autentifikatsiya, imzo tekshiruvi (GPG, Cosign) va polling shu yerda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har controller (Kustomize, Helm) o'zi Git'ga borib klonlasa — takroriy yuklama, credential'lar har joyda.
