artifact: http://source-controller.flux-system.svc/gitrepository/flux-system/app/&lt;sha&gt;.tar.gz<br>  --&gt; status.artifact.revision = main@sha1:ab12...<br>Kustomization/HelmRelease --&gt; sourceRef orqali artifact'ni yuklab oladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1<br>kind: GitRepository<br>metadata: { name: app, namespace: flux-system }<br>spec:<br>  interval: 1m<br>  url: ssh://git@github.com/org/deploy.git<br>  ref: { branch: main }<br>  secretRef: { name: deploy-key }<br>  ignore: |<br>    /*<br>    !/apps/<br>---<br>apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2<br>kind: OCIRepository<br>metadata: { name: manifests, namespace: flux-system }<br>spec:<br>  interval: 5m<br>  url: oci://ghcr.io/org/manifests<br>  ref: { semver: &quot;&gt;=1.0.0&quot; }<br>  verify: { provider: cosign }        # imzolanmagan artifact qabul qilinmaydi</pre><pre>flux get sources all -A<br>flux reconcile source git app<br>kubectl -n flux-system describe gitrepository app    # auth/clone xatolari</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta monorepo'ni har daqiqada klonlash — CPU/tarmoq yuki; <code>ignore</code> va sparse checkout, yoki CI'da OCI artifact chiqarib <code>OCIRepository</code> ishlat.</li><li>Deploy key'ga write ruxsat kerak emas (image automation'dan tashqari) — read-only qil.</li><li>Juda kichik <code>interval</code> + ko'p repo — Git provider rate limit; webhook receiver bilan interval'ni kattalashtir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> OCI artifact yondashuvi (CI manifest'larni <code>flux push artifact</code> bilan registry'ga imzolab qo'yadi, klaster OCIRepository'dan Cosign verify bilan oladi) — Git'ga klaster ichidan kirishni yo'q qiladi va supply chain tekshiruvini deploy manbasiga ham qo'llaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40739	<p>FluxCD Kustomize Controller nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flux Kustomize Controller — <code>Kustomization</code> CRD'larini reconcile qiladi: Source Controller artifact'ini yuklab oladi, <code>kustomize build</code> qiladi (kustomization.yaml bo'lmasa avtomatik yaratadi), SOPS bilan shifrlangan secret'larni ochadi, <code>postBuild</code> o'zgaruvchilarini qo'yadi, server-side apply bilan klasterga qo'llaydi, prune va health check qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Manifest'larni to'g'ri tartibda, faqat o'zgarganini, garbage collection va sog'liq tekshiruvi bilan apply qilish — buni ishonchli avtomatlashtirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>artifact (rev ab12) --&gt; kustomize build --&gt; SOPS decrypt --&gt; substitute ${VAR}<br>   --&gt; server-side apply (dry-run diff, keyin apply) --&gt; inventory (qaysi obyektlar meniki)<br>   --&gt; prune: inventory'da bor, yangi build'da yo'q -&gt; delete<br>   --&gt; health check (wait/healthChecks) --&gt; status Ready=True, lastAppliedRevision</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1<br>kind: Kustomization<br>metadata: { name: api, namespace: flux-system }<br>spec:<br>  interval: 10m<br>  retryInterval: 1m<br>  sourceRef: { kind: GitRepository, name: app }<br>  path: ./apps/api/prod<br>  prune: true<br>  targetNamespace: api<br>  serviceAccountName: api-deployer     # multi-tenancy: cheklangan RBAC bilan apply<br>  healthChecks:<br>    - { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api, namespace: api }<br>  decryption: { provider: sops, secretRef: { name: sops-age } }</pre><pre>flux get kustomizations<br>flux events --for Kustomization/api<br>flux build kustomization api --path ./apps/api/prod   # lokal render</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>serviceAccountName</code>siz — controller cluster-admin huquqi bilan apply qiladi; multi-tenant klasterda jamoa boshqa namespace'ga yoza oladi.</li><li>Immutable maydon o'zgarsa (Job spec, Service clusterIP) apply yiqiladi — <code>force: true</code> qayta yaratadi, ehtiyot bo'l.</li><li>Health check timeout'i qisqa bo'lsa sekin start qiladigan ilovalar &quot;failed&quot; ko'rinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Server-side apply va inventory asosidagi prune — Flux'ni <code>kubectl apply --prune</code>dan ancha ishonchli qiladi. Multi-tenancy uchun har tenant Kustomization'i o'z ServiceAccount'i bilan — bu GitOps'ning RBAC chegarasi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40740	<p>FluxCD Notification Controller nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Flux Notification Controller ikki yo'nalishda ishlaydi: <b>chiquvchi</b> — Flux hodisalarini (<code>Alert</code> + <code>Provider</code>) Slack, Teams, Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, generic webhook'larga yuboradi va Git commit status'ini (GitHub/GitLab) yangilaydi; <b>kiruvchi</b> — <code>Receiver</code> orqali Git provider/registry webhook'larini qabul qilib, tegishli manbani darhol reconcile qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Reconcile yiqilsa (noto'g'ri manifest, health check) hech kim bilmaydi — GitOps &quot;jim&quot; ishlaydi. Polling interval (5-10 daqiqa) deploy'ni sekinlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>chiquvchi:  kustomize/helm controller event --&gt; Alert (filtr: severity, kind) --&gt; Provider (Slack)<br>kiruvchi:   GitHub push webhook --&gt; Receiver (/hook/&lt;token-hash&gt;) --&gt; GitRepository reconcile darhol</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta3<br>kind: Provider<br>metadata: { name: slack, namespace: flux-system }<br>spec: { type: slack, channel: deploys, secretRef: { name: slack-webhook } }<br>---<br>apiVersion: notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta3<br>kind: Alert<br>metadata: { name: prod-errors, namespace: flux-system }<br>spec:<br>  providerRef: { name: slack }<br>  eventSeverity: error<br>  eventSources: [{ kind: Kustomization, name: &quot;*&quot; }, { kind: HelmRelease, name: &quot;*&quot; }]<br>---<br>apiVersion: notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1<br>kind: Receiver<br>metadata: { name: github, namespace: flux-system }<br>spec:<br>  type: github<br>  events: [push]<br>  secretRef: { name: webhook-token }<br>  resources: [{ kind: GitRepository, name: app }]</pre><pre>kubectl -n flux-system get receiver github -o jsonpath='{.status.webhookPath}'<br>flux get alerts</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>eventSeverity: info</code> hamma narsa uchun — Slack kanal shovqinga to'ladi va jamoa uni o'chirib qo'yadi.</li><li>Receiver endpoint'ini Ingress orqali ochib, secret/HMAC tekshiruvini sozlamaslik.</li><li>Faqat Slack xabari — muhim yiqilishlar uchun Prometheus metrikasi (<code>gotk_reconcile_condition</code>) asosidagi alert ishonchliroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitHub commit status provider'i (<code>type: github</code>) Flux natijasini commit yoniga yozadi — developer PR/commit sahifasida &quot;prod'ga chiqdimi&quot; ni ko'radi. Bu GitOps'ning &quot;ko'rinmaslik&quot; muammosini yaxshi yopadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40741	<p>Tekton PipelineRun nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>PipelineRun</code> — Tekton <code>Pipeline</code>ining bitta bajarilishi: qaysi Pipeline (<code>pipelineRef</code> yoki inline <code>pipelineSpec</code>), qaysi parametrlar, qaysi workspace'lar (PVC, ConfigMap, Secret, emptyDir), ServiceAccount, timeout'lar. Controller undan har Task uchun <code>TaskRun</code> yaratadi va DAG bo'yicha boshqaradi; natijalar va status shu obyektda yoziladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Pipeline — shablon (nima qilish), PipelineRun — aniq ish (qaysi commit, qaysi image tag, qaysi muhit). Bu ajratish bitta Pipeline'ni ko'p marta turli kirishlar bilan ishlatish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PipelineRun (params, workspaces)<br>   --&gt; controller: tasks DAG<br>       clone (TaskRun -&gt; Pod) --&gt; test, lint (parallel TaskRun'lar) --&gt; build (TaskRun)<br>   --&gt; status: conditions (Succeeded True/False), childReferences, results</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1<br>kind: PipelineRun<br>metadata: { generateName: ci-run- }<br>spec:<br>  pipelineRef: { name: ci }<br>  params:<br>    - { name: repo-url, value: https://github.com/org/api }<br>    - { name: revision, value: 9f1e2c3 }<br>  workspaces:<br>    - name: src<br>      volumeClaimTemplate:<br>        spec: { accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce], resources: { requests: { storage: 1Gi } } }<br>    - name: docker-config<br>      secret: { secretName: registry-creds }<br>  taskRunTemplate: { serviceAccountName: ci-bot }<br>  timeouts: { pipeline: 30m, tasks: 20m, finally: 5m }</pre><pre>kubectl create -f pipelinerun.yaml     # generateName uchun create, apply emas<br>tkn pipelinerun logs -f --last<br>tkn pipelinerun describe ci-run-x8k2l</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>generateName</code> bilan <code>kubectl apply</code> ishlamaydi — <code>create</code> kerak.</li><li><code>volumeClaimTemplate</code> har run uchun yangi PVC yaratadi — tozalanmasa PVC'lar to'planadi (pruner yoki owner reference).</li><li>ServiceAccount'ga ortiqcha huquq — PipelineRun yaratishga ruxsati bor har kim uni ishlatadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PipelineRun'larni odatda inson emas, Tekton Triggers (EventListener) yaratadi. Tekton Chains PipelineRun/TaskRun natijalaridan avtomatik imzolangan SLSA provenance chiqaradi — bu Tekton'ni supply chain uchun kuchli qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40742	<p>Tekton TaskRun nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>TaskRun</code> — Tekton <code>Task</code>ining bitta bajarilishi: Task'ning har <code>step</code>i bitta <b>Pod</b> ichida ketma-ket container sifatida ishga tushiriladi; parametrlar, workspace'lar va natijalar (<code>results</code>) shu obyektga bog'lanadi. Mustaqil ham, PipelineRun ichida ham yaratiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Build qadamlari (checkout, compile, test) umumiy fayl tizimini ulashishi kerak — bir Pod ichidagi step'lar <code>/workspace</code> va volume'larni ulashadi, alohida pod'lar orasida esa PVC kerak bo'lardi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>TaskRun --&gt; Pod<br>   init: entrypoint binary'ni nusxalaydi<br>   step-1 (golang:1.23)  : go build   --&gt; tugashini /tekton/run fayl orqali bildiradi<br>   step-2 (golang:1.23)  : go test    --&gt; step-1 tugashini kutadi (entrypoint wrapper)<br>   step-3 (alpine)       : echo -n &quot;$(digest)&quot; &gt; $(results.digest.path)<br>   sidecar'lar (masalan dind, DB) step'lar davomida ishlaydi</pre><p>Barcha container'lar bir vaqtda start bo'ladi, lekin Tekton entrypoint ularni tartib bilan ishga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1<br>kind: Task<br>metadata: { name: go-test }<br>spec:<br>  params: [{ name: package, default: &quot;./...&quot; }]<br>  workspaces: [{ name: source }]<br>  results: [{ name: coverage }]<br>  steps:<br>    - name: test<br>      image: golang:1.23<br>      workingDir: $(workspaces.source.path)<br>      script: |<br>        go test -coverprofile=c.out $(params.package)<br>        go tool cover -func=c.out | tail -1 | awk '{print $3}' | tr -d '\n' &gt; $(results.coverage.path)<br>---<br>apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1<br>kind: TaskRun<br>metadata: { generateName: go-test-run- }<br>spec:<br>  taskRef: { name: go-test }<br>  workspaces: [{ name: source, persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: src-pvc } }]</pre><pre>tkn taskrun logs -f --last<br>kubectl get taskrun -o jsonpath='{.items[-1:].status.results}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pod resurs so'rovi — step'larning <b>maksimal</b> emas, Tekton ularni shunday hisoblaydi (ketma-ket ishlagani uchun); lekin LimitRange bilan kutilmagan natijalar bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Results hajmi cheklangan (default 4 KB atrofida termination message) — katta ma'lumotni workspace orqali uzat.</li><li>Step yiqilsa keyingilar ishlamaydi — tozalash uchun <code>finally</code> (Pipeline darajasida) yoki <code>onError: continue</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Task granularligi — trade-off: bitta Task'da ko'p step tezroq (bitta pod, umumiy fayl tizimi), alohida Task'lar esa parallellik va qayta ishlatishni beradi. Tekton Hub/Artifact Hub'dagi tayyor Task'larni versiya bilan pin qilib ishlat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40743	<p>GitLab CI'da matrix job nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitLab CI'da matrix job — <code>parallel: matrix:</code> bilan bitta job ta'rifidan o'zgaruvchilar kombinatsiyalari bo'yicha bir nechta parallel job yaratish. Har kombinatsiya alohida job bo'lib, o'zgaruvchilarni env sifatida oladi. Bitta job uchun maksimal 200 ta variant.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kodni Go 1.22/1.23 va amd64/arm64 da test qilish yoki 5 ta region'ga deploy — bir xil job'ni nusxa-ko'chirish YAML'ni shishiradi va xatoga moyil.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>test:<br>  parallel:<br>    matrix:<br>      - GO: [&quot;1.22&quot;, &quot;1.23&quot;]<br>        ARCH: [amd64, arm64]<br>--&gt; 4 job: test: [1.22, amd64], test: [1.22, arm64], test: [1.23, amd64], test: [1.23, arm64]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>test:<br>  stage: test<br>  image: golang:${GO}<br>  parallel:<br>    matrix:<br>      - GO: [&quot;1.22&quot;, &quot;1.23&quot;]<br>        ARCH: [amd64, arm64]<br>  tags: [$ARCH]                     # mos runner'ga yo'naltirish<br>  script:<br>    - go test ./...<br><br>deploy:<br>  stage: deploy<br>  parallel:<br>    matrix:<br>      - REGION: [eu-central-1, us-east-1]<br>  environment: prod/$REGION<br>  resource_group: prod-$REGION<br>  script: ./deploy.sh $REGION<br><br>report:<br>  needs:<br>    - job: test<br>      parallel:<br>        matrix:<br>          - GO: &quot;1.23&quot;<br>            ARCH: amd64            # faqat bitta matrix variantiga bog'lanish<br>  script: ./report.sh</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kombinatsiyalar tez ko'payadi (3x3x4 = 36 job) — runner navbati va xarajat; keraksiz kombinatsiyalarni ajratib alohida ro'yxat elementlari bilan yoz.</li><li><code>needs</code> matrix job'ga ishora qilganda variantni aniq ko'rsatmasang — hamma variantlarni kutadi.</li><li>Job nomi kombinatsiya bilan uzun bo'ladi; artifact nomlarida o'zgaruvchidan foydalan, aks holda bir-birini ustidan yozadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>parallel: N</code> (oddiy son) testlarni shard'larga bo'lish uchun (<code>CI_NODE_INDEX</code>/<code>CI_NODE_TOTAL</code>), <code>parallel: matrix</code> esa turli konfiguratsiyalar uchun — ularni adashtirma. GitHub Actions'dagi analog — <code>strategy.matrix</code> (include/exclude bilan).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40744	<p>Secrets Store CSI Driver nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secrets Store CSI Driver — Kubernetes CSI driver: <code>SecretProviderClass</code> bo'yicha tashqi secret store'dan (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager — provider plugin'lar orqali) secret'larni olib, pod'ga <b>tmpfs volume'dagi fayl</b> sifatida mount qiladi. Default'da Kubernetes <code>Secret</code> obyekti yaratilmaydi (ixtiyoriy <code>secretObjects</code> sync bor).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kubernetes <code>Secret</code> etcd'da saqlanadi va <code>get secrets</code> huquqi bor har kim o'qiydi. Ba'zi compliance talablari secret'ning klaster API'sida umuman bo'lmasligini talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pod start --&gt; kubelet --&gt; CSI driver (DaemonSet) --&gt; provider (aws/vault/azure)<br>   --&gt; pod ServiceAccount identity (IRSA / Workload Identity / Vault k8s auth) bilan secret oladi<br>   --&gt; /mnt/secrets/db-password (tmpfs, faqat shu pod'da)<br>rotation (ixtiyoriy): davriy qayta o'qish, fayl yangilanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: secrets-store.csi.x-k8s.io/v1<br>kind: SecretProviderClass<br>metadata: { name: api-secrets, namespace: api }<br>spec:<br>  provider: aws<br>  parameters:<br>    objects: |<br>      - objectName: &quot;prod/db&quot;<br>        objectType: &quot;secretsmanager&quot;<br>        jmesPath:<br>          - { path: password, objectAlias: db-password }<br>---<br># pod spec<br>volumes:<br>  - name: secrets<br>    csi:<br>      driver: secrets-store.csi.k8s.io<br>      readOnly: true<br>      volumeAttributes: { secretProviderClass: api-secrets }<br>containers:<br>  - name: api<br>    volumeMounts: [{ name: secrets, mountPath: /mnt/secrets, readOnly: true }]</pre><pre>kubectl exec deploy/api -- cat /mnt/secrets/db-password<br>kubectl -n kube-system logs ds/csi-secrets-store -c secrets-store</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret faqat pod start'da mount bo'ladi — store ishlamasa pod <code>ContainerCreating</code>da qoladi.</li><li>Env var kerak bo'lsa <code>secretObjects</code> bilan baribir K8s Secret yaratiladi — asosiy foyda yo'qoladi.</li><li>Rotation yoqilgan bo'lsa ham ilova faylni qayta o'qishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov: CSI Driver — secret etcd'ga tushmaydi, sidecar yo'q; ESO — eng oddiy integratsiya (oddiy Secret, env var); Vault Agent — dinamik secret va template. Threat model'ga qarab tanla: asosiy xavf etcd/RBAC'mi yoki secret rotatsiyasimi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40745	<p>CI/CD'da zero-downtime DB migration ketma-ketligi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zero-downtime migration — <b>expand/contract</b> (parallel change) pattern: 1) <b>expand</b> — eski kodga zarar qilmaydigan qo'shimcha o'zgarish (yangi nullable ustun/jadval); 2) ilova ikkala joyga yozadi (dual write), eskisidan o'qiydi; 3) <b>backfill</b> — eski ma'lumotni yangi ustunga ko'chirish (batch'larda); 4) ilova yangi ustundan o'qiydi; 5) eski ustunga yozishni to'xtatish; 6) <b>contract</b> — eski ustunni o'chirish. Har qadam alohida reliz va har birida rollback mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Rolling deploy paytida eski va yangi pod'lar bir vaqtda ishlaydi va bitta DB'ni ishlatadi. <code>ALTER TABLE RENAME COLUMN</code> qilinsa — eski pod'lar darhol sinadi; rollback qilsang — yangi schema eski kod bilan mos emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (<code>name</code> -&gt; <code>full_name</code> misolida):</b></p><pre>reliz 1: ADD COLUMN full_name NULL          kod: name'dan o'qiydi, ikkalasiga yozadi<br>reliz 2: backfill (batch 10k, throttle)      kod: o'zgarmaydi<br>reliz 3: kod full_name'dan o'qiydi (ikkalasiga yozishda davom) -&gt; tekshirish<br>reliz 4: kod faqat full_name'ga yozadi<br>reliz 5: DROP COLUMN name (+ NOT NULL constraint)</pre><p><b>Amalda (PostgreSQL):</b></p><pre>ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN full_name text;            -- tez, metadata o'zgarishi<br>-- backfill batch'lab (uzun lock va WAL portlashidan qochish)<br>UPDATE users SET full_name = name<br>WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE full_name IS NULL LIMIT 10000);<br>CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_full_name ON users(full_name);<br>ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT full_name_nn CHECK (full_name IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID;<br>ALTER TABLE users VALIDATE CONSTRAINT full_name_nn;     -- yengil lock bilan</pre><p><code>SET lock_timeout = '5s';</code> — migration uzoq lock kutib, butun trafikni bloklamasligi uchun.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir relizda hamma qadamlarni qilish — &quot;zero-downtime&quot; yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>CREATE INDEX</code> (CONCURRENTLY'siz) va <code>NOT NULL</code> ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'shish katta jadvalda uzoq <code>ACCESS EXCLUSIVE</code> lock.</li><li>Contract qadamini unutish — eski ustunlar yillab qoladi va chalkashlik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Migration'ni kod relizidan ajratilgan, alohida kuzatiladigan jarayon sifatida boshqar (va <code>lock_timeout</code> + retry bilan). Har qadam &quot;oldingi va keyingi kod versiyasi bilan mos&quot; bo'lishi kerak — bu qoidani PR review checklist'iga qo'sh.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40746	<p>In-tree va out-of-tree CI plugin farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>In-tree</b> plugin — CI engine'ning o'z kodi bilan birga yetkaziladigan, uning jamoasi tomonidan saqlanadigan va release qilinadigan funksiya (GitLab CI'ning o'rnatilgan keyword'lari, Tekton core). <b>Out-of-tree</b> — alohida loyihada yashaydigan, runtime'da yuklanadigan tashqi plugin/action (Jenkins plugin'lari, GitHub Marketplace action'lari, CircleCI orb'lari). Out-of-tree moslashuvchan, lekin supply chain xavfi va versiya muvofiqligi muammosi yuqoriroq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI ekotizimi tashqi kodga to'la: o'rtacha workflow 5-15 third-party action ishlatadi, har biri sizning secret'laringiz va kodingiz bilan bir xil muhitda ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><p>| | In-tree | Out-of-tree | |---|---|---| | Kim saqlaydi | CI vendor | Har kim (community, bitta maintainer) | | Yangilanish | CI versiyasi bilan | Mustaqil, tez-tez | | Ishonch/review | Vendor jarayoni | Noma'lum | | Xavf | Past | Tag qayta yozish, maintainer akkaunti buzilishi, typosquatting |</p><pre>tj-actions/changed-files (2025): hujumchi barcha tag'larni zararli commit'ga yo'naltirdi<br>  -&gt; @v35 ishlatgan minglab workflow log'ga secret'larni chiqardi</pre><p><b>Amalda (out-of-tree xavfini kamaytirish):</b></p><pre>steps:<br>  - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683   # v4.2.2 — SHA pin<br>    with: { persist-credentials: false }<br>permissions: { contents: read }</pre><p>GitHub org sozlamasi: &quot;Allow only actions created by GitHub / verified creators / ro'yxatdagilar&quot;; Jenkins'da plugin'lar soni minimal va Update Center'dan faqat kerakli.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Jenkins'da 100+ plugin — har biri yangilashda bir-biriga mos kelmasligi va zaiflik manbai.</li><li>Out-of-tree action'ni tag bilan ishlatish — kod sizdan so'ramay o'zgaradi.</li><li>&quot;Kichik&quot; action (masalan, Slack xabari) ga ham butun job secret'lari ochiq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Out-of-tree kodni &quot;dependency&quot; kabi boshqar: inventarizatsiya, pin, avtomatik yangilash PR'lari (Renovate), review va allowlist. Muhim pipeline'larda trivial action'lar o'rniga 5 qatorlik <code>run:</code> skript ko'pincha xavfsizroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40747	<p>GitHub Actions'da action pinning nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Action pinning — third-party GitHub Action'ni o'zgaruvchan tag (<code>@v4</code>) yoki branch (<code>@main</code>) bilan emas, <b>to'liq 40 belgili commit SHA</b> bilan chaqirish. Tag'ni egasi (yoki hujumchi) istalgan commit'ga ko'chirishi mumkin; commit SHA esa o'zgarmas — aynan review qilingan kod ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v45</code> — 2025-yil martida hujumchi tag'larni secret'larni log'ga chiqaradigan commit'ga yo'naltirdi; tag bilan ishlatgan barcha repo'lar avtomatik zararlandi, SHA bilan pin qilganlar zarar ko'rmadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>@v4          -&gt; tag (ko'chiriladi)    -&gt; bugun A, ertaga zararli B<br>@main        -&gt; branch (har push)     -&gt; eng xavfli<br>@&lt;sha40&gt;     -&gt; commit (o'zgarmas)    -&gt; faqat review qilingan kod</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>steps:<br>  - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2<br>  - uses: actions/setup-go@3041bf56c941b39c61721a86cd11f3bb1338122a # v5.2.0</pre><pre># tag -&gt; SHA aniqlash<br>git ls-remote https://github.com/actions/checkout refs/tags/v4.2.2<br># avtomatik pin qilish<br>npx pin-github-action .github/workflows/*.yml<br># yoki: renovate &quot;helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests&quot; preset (SHA + izohda versiya, yangilash PR'lari)</pre><p>GitHub org/repo sozlamasida &quot;Require actions to be pinned to a full-length commit SHA&quot; policy'sini yoqish mumkin.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qisqa SHA (<code>@11bd719</code>) — to'liq SHA emas; fork'dagi to'qnashuv riski va policy'lar uni qabul qilmaydi.</li><li>Pin qilib, hech qachon yangilamaslik — xavfsizlik tuzatishlari o'tib ketadi. Renovate/Dependabot bilan yangila.</li><li>Pin qilingan action ichida o'zi boshqa action'ni <code>@main</code> bilan chaqirsa yoki <code>curl | sh</code> qilsa (composite/Docker action) — pin to'liq himoya qilmaydi; Docker action image'i ham digest bilan bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SHA pinning + avtomatik yangilash PR'lari + review — o'zgarmaslik va yangilanishni birlashtiradi. Qo'shimcha: StepSecurity Harden-Runner kabi egress monitoring, <code>permissions</code> minimal va allowlist'dagi action'lar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40748	<p>Kaniko bilan hermetic container build nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kaniko — Dockerfile'dan image'ni <b>Docker daemon'siz va privileged huquqsiz</b> oddiy container (pod) ichida user-space'da build qilib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri registry'ga push qiladigan tool. Bu &quot;hermetic&quot;/izolyatsiyalangan build'ga yaqinlashtiradi: host Docker socket'i mount qilinmaydi. Diqqat: Google <code>GoogleContainerTools/kaniko</code>ni 2025-yilda <b>arxivladi</b>; yangi tizimlar uchun BuildKit rootless, Buildah yoki Chainguard fork'i ko'rib chiqiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI pod'ida <code>docker build</code> uchun <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code> mount qilish = node'ga root kirish: pod istalgan container'ni privileged ishga tushirib host'ni egallashi mumkin. Docker-in-Docker esa privileged pod talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kaniko executor (pod ichida):<br>  base image'ni registry'dan oladi -&gt; o'z fayl tizimiga ochadi<br>  har Dockerfile buyrug'ini bajaradi -&gt; fayl tizimi snapshot -&gt; layer<br>  --cache=true: layer'larni registry'dagi cache repo'dan qayta ishlatadi<br>  natija image'ni push qiladi (lokal daemon yo'q)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Kubernetes Job / Tekton step):</b></p><pre>containers:<br>  - name: build<br>    image: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:v1.23.2<br>    args:<br>      - --context=git://github.com/org/api.git#refs/tags/v1.5.0<br>      - --dockerfile=Dockerfile<br>      - --destination=ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0<br>      - --cache=true<br>      - --reproducible                # timestamp'larni olib tashlaydi<br>      - --digest-file=/workspace/digest<br>    volumeMounts: [{ name: docker-config, mountPath: /kaniko/.docker }]</pre><p>BuildKit rootless alternativasi:</p><pre>buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=. --local dockerfile=. \<br>  --output type=image,name=ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0,push=true</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kaniko container ichida root sifatida fayl tizimini o'zgartiradi — uni boshqa ish bilan bir pod'da ishlatma (u o'z container fayl tizimini &quot;buzadi&quot;).</li><li>Multi-stage va murakkab Dockerfile'larda BuildKit'dan sekinroq; ba'zi BuildKit sintaksisi (<code>RUN --mount</code>) qisman qo'llanadi.</li><li>Arxivlangan loyiha — yangi CVE tuzatishlari kelmaydi; migratsiya rejasini tuz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Hermetic&quot; so'zi bu yerda asosan izolyatsiyani anglatadi; to'liq hermetic build (tarmoqsiz, faqat e'lon qilingan input'lar) uchun pinned base digest, lockfile'lar va <code>--network=none</code> kabi qo'shimcha choralar kerak. Daemonless build + SLSA provenance — CI'dagi image build'ning zamonaviy standarti.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40749	<p>Pipeline flakiness rate nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pipeline flakiness rate — kod o'zgarmagan holda (masalan, xuddi shu commit'da retry qilinganda o'tadigan) yiqilgan run'lar ulushi. Sabablari: beqaror testlar (vaqt, tartib, race condition), tarmoq/registry timeout'lari, umumiy test muhiti, resurs yetishmasligi. Yuqori flakiness — CI'ga ishonchni yemiradi: developer'lar qizil natijani &quot;yana flaky&quot; deb e'tiborsiz qoldiradi va haqiqiy xatolar o'tib ketadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2% flaky test ehtimoli x 200 test = har run'ning katta qismi tasodifan yiqiladi. &quot;Re-run&quot; tugmasi odat bo'ladi, CI vaqti va xarajati oshadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (o'lchash):</b></p><pre>flaky run = fail -&gt; o'sha SHA'da retry -&gt; pass<br>flakiness rate = flaky run'lar / jami run'lar (masalan haftalik)<br>test darajasida: test_X 500 run'da 12 marta fail, keyin pass -&gt; 2.4% flaky</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Go: shubhali testni ko'p marta va race detector bilan<br>go test -run TestCheckout -count=200 -race ./checkout/<br># tartibga bog'liqlikni topish<br>go test -shuffle=on ./...<br># JUnit hisobotlarini yig'ib flaky'larni aniqlash (BuildPulse, Datadog CI Visibility, GitLab &quot;flaky tests&quot;, Trunk)</pre><p>Jarayon:</p><pre>1. aniqlash (avtomatik, retry natijalari bo'yicha)<br>2. karantin (alohida, bloklamaydigan suite; ticket va egasi bilan)<br>3. tuzatish: sleep -&gt; polling/condition, umumiy holat -&gt; izolyatsiya, vaqt -&gt; fake clock<br>4. qaytarish va kuzatish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Avtomatik retry'ni hamma joyga yoqish — flakiness yashirinadi, haqiqiy race condition'lar prod'ga chiqadi. Retry bo'lsa ham o'lchab qayd et.</li><li>Karantin &quot;qabriston&quot;ga aylanishi — karantindagi testlar uchun SLA (masalan 2 hafta) yoki o'chirish.</li><li>Infra flakiness (registry 429, DNS) ni test xatosi bilan aralashtirish — sababi bo'yicha klassifikatsiya qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Flakiness'ni platforma metrikasi sifatida kuzat (maqsad &lt; 1-2%) va egalarini belgila. Ko'pincha &quot;flaky test&quot; — ilovadagi haqiqiy concurrency xatosining yagona ko'rinadigan belgisi, shuning uchun uni o'chirishdan oldin sababini tushun.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::CI/CD::H13 GitOps & supply chain	idrill-40750	<p>Progressive delivery'da avtomatik metrika gating nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avtomatik metrika gating — canary/progressive rollout paytida real vaqt telemetriyasi (golden signals: latency, traffic, errors, saturation va biznes metrikalari) oldindan belgilangan chegaralar yoki baseline bilan avtomatik solishtiriladi; natijaga ko'ra reliz keyingi bosqichga <b>promote</b> qilinadi yoki <b>abort/rollback</b> qilinadi — inson qaror qabul qilishi shart emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Inson Grafana'ga qarab qaror qilsa: sekin, charchoqqa moyil, tunda ishlamaydi va subyektiv. Ko'p deploy qiladigan jamoada (kuniga o'nlab) qo'lda gating — bottleneck.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>canary 10% --&gt; har 1m: query metrikalar (faqat canary vs stable)<br>   error_rate(canary) &lt;= max(1%, stable * 1.2)?<br>   p99(canary) &lt;= stable_p99 * 1.25?<br>   min so'rovlar &gt;= 500?         (statistik yetarlilik)<br>   --&gt; hammasi ok N marta: promote -&gt; 30%<br>   --&gt; fail &gt;= limit: abort -&gt; 0%, alert<br>   --&gt; ma'lumot yetarli emas: inconclusive -&gt; pauza (inson)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Argo Rollouts, nisbiy solishtirish):</b></p><pre>metrics:<br>  - name: error-ratio-vs-stable<br>    interval: 1m<br>    count: 10<br>    failureLimit: 2<br>    successCondition: result[0] &lt;= 1.2<br>    provider:<br>      prometheus:<br>        address: http://prometheus:9090<br>        query: |<br>          (sum(rate(http_requests_total{rollouts_pod_template_hash=&quot;{{args.canary-hash}}&quot;,code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[2m]))<br>            / sum(rate(http_requests_total{rollouts_pod_template_hash=&quot;{{args.canary-hash}}&quot;}[2m])))<br>          /<br>          (sum(rate(http_requests_total{rollouts_pod_template_hash=&quot;{{args.stable-hash}}&quot;,code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[2m]))<br>            / sum(rate(http_requests_total{rollouts_pod_template_hash=&quot;{{args.stable-hash}}&quot;}[2m])) + 0.0001)</pre><p>Flagger'da — MetricTemplate + <code>thresholdRange</code>; Spinnaker'da — Kayenta.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat absolyut chegaralar — kunlik trafik o'zgarishida soxta abort yoki soxta success.</li><li>Ma'lumot yetarli bo'lmagan holatni &quot;success&quot; deb hisoblash — kam trafikli servisda gating hech narsani tekshirmaydi.</li><li>Faqat texnik metrikalar — checkout konversiyasi tushishi yoki noto'g'ri hisob-kitob 5xx bermaydi; biznes SLI qo'sh.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Gating sifati SLI sifatiga teng: avval servisning SLO va SLI'larini aniqla, keyin ularni gate qil. Abort'lar statistikasini kuzat — juda ko'p soxta abort jamoani gate'ni o'chirishga undaydi, juda kam bo'lsa — chegaralar bo'sh.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cicd sec::h13 GitOps_supply_chain
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33174	<p>Infrastructure as Code (IaC) nima va qanday muammoni hal qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> IaC — infratuzilmani (server, tarmoq, DB, IAM) konsolda qo'lda bosish o'rniga <b>kod</b> sifatida yozish va shu koddan avtomatik yaratish. U takrorlanuvchanlik, review, tarix/rollback va falokatdan keyin tez tiklanishni beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo (ClickOps):</b> Prod'ni kimdir konsolda sozlagan. Kim, qachon, nima o'zgartirgani noma'lum; staging prod'dan farq qiladi; region yiqilsa qayta qurish — haftalar va xotiraga tayanish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kod (Git) --PR/review--&gt; plan (diff: nima o'zgaradi) --approve--&gt; apply --&gt; cloud<br>    ^                                                                  |<br>    +-------------- drift detection (real holat != kod) ---------------+</pre><p><b>Turlari:</b> | Tur | Vosita | Nima qiladi | |---|---|---| | Provisioning | Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, CloudFormation | resurslarni yaratadi | | Configuration mgmt | Ansible, Chef, Puppet | server ichini sozlaydi | | Image building | Packer | tayyor AMI/image |</p><p>Declarative — &quot;oxirgi holat qanday bo'lsin&quot; (Terraform); imperative — &quot;qaysi qadamlar&quot; (bash skript).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;logs&quot; {<br>  bucket = &quot;acme-prod-logs&quot;<br>  tags   = { env = &quot;prod&quot;, owner = &quot;platform&quot; }<br>}</pre><pre>terraform plan    # + aws_s3_bucket.logs will be created<br>terraform apply</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>IaC bor, lekin konsoldan ham o'zgartirish davom etadi — drift va ishonch yo'qoladi.</li><li>Secret'larni kod ichida saqlash.</li><li>Bitta ulkan konfiguratsiya — har plan sekin, xato radiusi katta.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> IaC'ning haqiqiy qiymati — jarayon: hamma o'zgarish PR orqali, apply faqat CI'dan, konsolda prod write huquqi yo'q. Kodning o'zi yetarli emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33175	<p>Terraform asosiy tushunchalari: provider, resource, data source, variable, output?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Provider</b> — API bilan gaplashuvchi plagin (AWS, GCP, K8s); <b>resource</b> — Terraform yaratadigan/boshqaradigan obyekt; <b>data source</b> — mavjud narsani faqat o'qish; <b>variable</b> — kirish parametri; <b>output</b> — natijani tashqariga chiqarish. Resurslar orasidagi murojaatlardan Terraform dependency graph quradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>variable.region --&gt; provider &quot;aws&quot;<br>data.aws_ami.ubuntu ----+<br>                        v<br>             resource aws_instance.web --&gt; output.public_ip</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform {<br>  required_providers {<br>    aws = { source = &quot;hashicorp/aws&quot;, version = &quot;~&gt; 5.60&quot; }<br>  }<br>}<br><br>variable &quot;region&quot; {<br>  type    = string<br>  default = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;<br>}<br><br>provider &quot;aws&quot; { region = var.region }<br><br>data &quot;aws_ami&quot; &quot;ubuntu&quot; {<br>  most_recent = true<br>  owners      = [&quot;099720109477&quot;]   # Canonical<br>  filter {<br>    name   = &quot;name&quot;<br>    values = [&quot;ubuntu/images/hvm-ssd-gp3/ubuntu-noble-24.04-amd64-server-*&quot;]<br>  }<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  ami           = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id<br>  instance_type = &quot;t3.micro&quot;<br>  tags          = { Name = &quot;web&quot; }<br>}<br><br>output &quot;public_ip&quot; { value = aws_instance.web.public_ip }</pre><p>Manzil formati: <code>&lt;tur&gt;.&lt;nom&gt;.&lt;atribut&gt;</code> — <code>aws_instance.web.id</code>, <code>data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Provider versiyasini pin qilmaslik — yangi major versiya kodni buzadi.</li><li><code>most_recent = true</code> AMI — yangi AMI chiqqanda instance replace bo'ladi.</li><li>Resource nomini (<code>web</code>) o'zgartirish = Terraform uchun eski o'chiriladi, yangi yaratiladi (<code>moved</code> kerak).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Implicit dependency (atributga murojaat) har doim <code>depends_on</code> dan yaxshi — graph aniq va parallel bajariladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33176	<p><code>terraform init</code>, <code>plan</code>, <code>apply</code>, <code>destroy</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>init</code> — provider'larni yuklaydi va backend'ni ulaydi; <code>plan</code> — kod va real holat orasidagi farqni ko'rsatadi (hech narsa o'zgarmaydi); <code>apply</code> — o'sha o'zgarishlarni bajaradi; <code>destroy</code> — boshqariladigan hamma narsani o'chiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>init  -&gt; .terraform/ (provider'lar), .terraform.lock.hcl, backend ulanish<br>plan  -&gt; refresh (real holatni o'qish) -&gt; kod bilan solishtirish -&gt; diff<br>apply -&gt; plan'dagi amallarni dependency tartibida bajarish -&gt; state yangilash</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform init<br>terraform fmt -check &amp;&amp; terraform validate<br>terraform plan -out tf.plan<br>terraform show tf.plan              # qayta ko'rish<br>terraform apply tf.plan             # aynan ko'rilgan plan<br>terraform destroy                   # ehtiyot!</pre><p>Plan belgilari: | Belgi | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>+</code> | yaratiladi | | <code>~</code> | joyida o'zgaradi | | <code>-/+</code> | o'chirib qayta yaratiladi (replace) | | <code>-</code> | o'chiriladi | | <code>&lt;=</code> | data source o'qiladi |</p><p>Oxirgi qator: <code>Plan: 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.</code> — avval shu yerga qarang.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-/+</code> ni e'tiborsiz qoldirish — DB yoki disk qayta yaratilib ma'lumot yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>plan</code> siz <code>apply</code> — oradagi o'zgarish ko'rilmaydi; saqlangan plan'ni apply qiling.</li><li><code>destroy</code> noto'g'ri papka/workspace'da.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da oqim: PR'da plan (review uchun comment), merge'dan keyin CI aynan o'sha plan'ni apply qiladi. Odamlar lokal apply qilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33177	<p>Terraform state nima va nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> State — Terraform kodidagi resurs manzillarini (<code>aws_instance.web</code>) cloud'dagi haqiqiy obyektlar (<code>i-0abc123</code>) bilan bog'lovchi JSON fayl. State'siz Terraform nimani boshqarayotganini bilmaydi va har safar yangidan yaratishga harakat qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kod: aws_instance.web  &lt;--state--&gt;  AWS: i-0abc123 (atributlar, dependency)<br>plan = kod vs state (+ refresh orqali real holat)</pre><p>State'da: resurs ID'lari, barcha atributlar, dependency'lar va <b>ko'pincha secret'lar ochiq matnda</b> (DB parol, private key).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform state list<br># aws_instance.web<br># aws_s3_bucket.logs<br>terraform state show aws_instance.web     # id = &quot;i-0abc123&quot;, private_ip = ...<br>terraform state pull &gt; backup.tfstate     # nusxa</pre><p>Remote backend:</p><pre>terraform {<br>  backend &quot;s3&quot; {<br>    bucket       = &quot;acme-tfstate&quot;<br>    key          = &quot;prod/app.tfstate&quot;<br>    region       = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;<br>    encrypt      = true<br>    use_lockfile = true<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Qoidalar:</b></p><ul><li>Git'ga emas — remote backend (S3, GCS, HCP Terraform), versioning yoqilgan.</li><li>Shifrlangan va IAM bilan cheklangan.</li><li>Qo'lda tahrirlamang — <code>state mv/rm</code>, <code>moved {}</code>, <code>import {}</code> bor.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lokal state laptop'da — boshqalar ko'rmaydi, yo'qolsa Terraform &quot;hamma narsa yangi&quot; deb o'ylaydi.</li><li>State yo'qolsa resurslar cloud'da qoladi, lekin boshqarilmaydi (orphan) — har birini qayta import qilish kerak.</li><li>Bir state'da hamma narsa — plan sekin, xato radiusi katta.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> State'ni secret deb hisoblang. Uni kichik bo'laklarga (network/data/app) bo'lish blast radius va lock raqobatini kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33324	<p>Variable'larga qiymat berish usullari: <code>tfvars</code>, <code>-var</code>, <code>TF_VAR_</code>, default?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Variable qiymati bir nechta manbadan keladi: <code>default</code>, <code>TF_VAR_&lt;nom&gt;</code> env, <code>terraform.tfvars</code>, <code>*.auto.tfvars</code>, <code>-var-file</code> va <code>-var</code>. Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33325	<p><code>terraform fmt</code>, <code>validate</code> va <code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terraform fmt</code> — kodni kanonik formatga keltiradi (diff toza); <code>validate</code> — sintaksis va ichki mantiqni tekshiradi (cloud'ga ulanmasdan); <code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> — provider'larning aniq versiyasi va checksum'larini qotiradi, shunda hamma bir xil provider bilan ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Constraint <code>~&gt; 5.0</code>. Bugun sizda 5.60, ertaga CI'da 5.80 yuklandi va plan boshqacha. Lock fayl bunga yo'l qo'ymaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>required_providers (diapazon: ~&gt; 5.60)<br>          |<br>   terraform init --&gt; lock fayl (aniq: 5.62.0 + hash'lar)<br>          |<br>   keyingi init'lar --&gt; lock'dagi versiya (init -upgrade bo'lmaguncha)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform fmt -recursive            # formatlash<br>terraform fmt -recursive -check     # CI: formatlanmagan bo'lsa exit 3<br>terraform validate                  # Success! The configuration is valid.<br>terraform init -upgrade             # constraint ichida yangilash, lock yangilanadi<br>terraform providers lock \<br>  -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64   # hamma platforma hash'lari</pre><pre>required_providers {<br>  aws = { source = &quot;hashicorp/aws&quot;, version = &quot;~&gt; 5.60&quot; }   # &gt;=5.60, &lt;6.0<br>}</pre><p><code>.gitignore</code>: <code>.terraform/</code> — commit qilinmaydi; <code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> — <b>commit qilinadi</b>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lock faylni ignore qilish — reproducibility yo'qoladi.</li><li>Mac'da yaratilgan lock'da faqat <code>darwin_arm64</code> hash — Linux CI'da xato; <code>providers lock -platform</code> bilan hamma platformani qo'shing.</li><li><code>validate</code> variable qiymatlari va cloud holatini tekshirmaydi — <code>plan</code> o'rnini bosmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provider yangilanishini Renovate/Dependabot orqali alohida PR'da, plan bilan qiling — boshqa o'zgarishlar bilan aralashtirmang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33326	<p><code>locals</code>, <code>output</code> va <code>depends_on</code> qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>locals</code> — konfiguratsiya ichida qayta ishlatiladigan hisoblangan qiymatlar (nom prefiksi, umumiy tag'lar); <code>output</code> — natijani foydalanuvchiga yoki boshqa modul/state'ga chiqarish; <code>depends_on</code> — atribut murojaati bo'lmagan yashirin bog'liqlikni majburlash (kamdan-kam).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>locals {<br>  name = &quot;${var.project}-${var.env}&quot;<br>  tags = { project = var.project, env = var.env, managed_by = &quot;terraform&quot; }<br>}<br><br>provider &quot;aws&quot; {<br>  region = var.region<br>  default_tags { tags = local.tags }    # hamma resursga avtomatik<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;logs&quot; {<br>  bucket = &quot;${local.name}-logs&quot;<br>}<br><br>output &quot;bucket_name&quot; { value = aws_s3_bucket.logs.bucket }<br>output &quot;db_password&quot; {<br>  value     = random_password.db.result<br>  sensitive = true<br>}</pre><p><code>depends_on</code> misoli — Lambda IAM policy biriktirilmaguncha ishga tushmasligi kerak, lekin unga atribut orqali murojaat yo'q:</p><pre>resource &quot;aws_lambda_function&quot; &quot;fn&quot; {<br>  # ...<br>  depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.logs]<br>}</pre><pre>terraform output bucket_name<br>terraform output -json | jq -r .bucket_name.value</pre><p>| Vosita | Qachon | |---|---| | <code>variable</code> | tashqaridan kiruvchi qiymat | | <code>locals</code> | ichki hisob, takrorni yo'qotish | | <code>output</code> | modul &quot;API&quot;si |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>depends_on</code> ni ko'p ishlatish — graph noaniq, parallelizm kamayadi, ba'zan data source'lar plan'da &quot;known after apply&quot; bo'lib qoladi.</li><li><code>sensitive</code> output ham state'da ochiq turadi.</li><li><code>locals</code> ichida murakkab mantiq — o'qib bo'lmaydigan kod.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Output'lar — modulning ommaviy kontrakti: ularni o'zgartirish breaking change. Faqat iste'molchilarga kerakli narsani chiqaring.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33327	<p>Terraform plan'da <code>-/+</code> (replace) ko'rsangiz nima qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>-/+</code> — resurs o'chirilib, qayta yaratiladi (replace). DB, disk yoki bucket uchun bu ma'lumot yo'qolishi yoki downtime demak. Qaysi atribut &quot;forces replacement&quot; ekanini topib, sababini bartaraf qilasiz yoki xavfsiz rejalashtirasiz.</p><p><b>O'qish:</b></p><pre>  # aws_db_instance.main must be replaced<br>-/+ resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>      ~ identifier = &quot;prod-db&quot; -&gt; &quot;prod-main-db&quot; # forces replacement<br>        ...<br>    }<br>Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 1 to destroy.</pre><p><b>Tekshiruv tartibi:</b></p><pre>1. qaysi maydon &quot;# forces replacement&quot;?<br>2. ataylabmi? <br>   yo'q -&gt; kodni qaytaring / ignore_changes<br>   rename (resurs manzili) -&gt; moved {} blok<br>   ha, majburiy -&gt; 3<br>3. DB/disk: snapshot, prevent_destroy, maintenance oyna, create_before_destroy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform plan -out tf.plan<br>terraform show -json tf.plan | jq -r '.resource_changes[]<br>  | select(.change.actions | index(&quot;delete&quot;)) | .address'<br># CI'da: delete bo'lsa qo'shimcha approval</pre><pre>moved {<br>  from = aws_db_instance.db<br>  to   = aws_db_instance.main<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>  lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }<br>  deletion_protection = true<br>}</pre><p>Ataylab qayta yaratish: <code>terraform apply -replace=aws_instance.web</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Immutable atributlar (nom, AZ, engine, subnet group) — o'zgarishi har doim replace.</li><li>Data source (<code>most_recent</code> AMI) o'zgarishi yashirin replace chaqiradi.</li><li>Provider yangilanishidan keyingi kutilmagan replace — changelog o'qing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Plan'dagi har <code>destroy</code>/<code>replace</code> ni CI'da avtomatik aniqlab, alohida tasdiq talab qiling — inson ko'zi uzun plan'da uni o'tkazib yuborishi oson.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33328	<p>Data source va resource farqi? Qachon <code>data</code> ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Resource</b> — Terraform yaratadi, o'zgartiradi, o'chiradi (lifecycle'ga egalik qiladi). <b>Data source</b> — mavjud narsani faqat <b>o'qiydi</b> (boshqa jamoa yaratgan VPC, AMI, akkaunt ID). Narsa sizniki bo'lmasa — <code>data</code>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>data.aws_vpc.shared  (o'qish, plan paytida)  --&gt; id<br>          v<br>resource aws_instance.app (yaratish) uses data.*.id</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>data &quot;aws_caller_identity&quot; &quot;current&quot; {}<br>data &quot;aws_region&quot; &quot;current&quot; {}<br><br>data &quot;aws_vpc&quot; &quot;shared&quot; {<br>  tags = { Name = &quot;shared-prod&quot; }<br>}<br><br>data &quot;aws_subnets&quot; &quot;private&quot; {<br>  filter {<br>    name   = &quot;vpc-id&quot;<br>    values = [data.aws_vpc.shared.id]<br>  }<br>  tags = { tier = &quot;private&quot; }<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  ami           = var.ami_id<br>  instance_type = &quot;t3.small&quot;<br>  subnet_id     = data.aws_subnets.private.ids[0]<br>}<br><br>locals {<br>  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id<br>}</pre><p>| | resource | data | |---|---|---| | Yaratadi | ha | yo'q | | destroy'da | o'chadi | tegilmaydi | | Topilmasa | yaratadi | plan xato beradi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>most_recent = true</code> AMI — yangi AMI chiqqanda instance <b>replace</b>. Prod'da AMI ID'ni pin qiling yoki <code>ignore_changes = [ami]</code>.</li><li>Filtr bir nechta natija qaytarsa (<code>aws_vpc</code>) — xato; filtrni aniqlashtiring.</li><li>Data source boshqa resursga bog'liq bo'lsa, qiymat &quot;known after apply&quot; bo'lib, keraksiz replace chaqiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Data source — jamoalar orasidagi bo'shroq kontrakt (tag yoki nom bo'yicha). Tag'lar kontrakt ekanini hujjatlashtiring, aks holda kimdir tag'ni o'zgartirib, boshqaning plan'ini buzadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33398	<p><code>terraform console</code>, <code>graph</code>, <code>output</code>, <code>show</code> qanday yordam beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>console</code> — ifoda va funksiyalarni interaktiv sinash (REPL); <code>graph</code> — dependency grafini DOT formatda chiqarish; <code>output</code> — output qiymatlarini o'qish; <code>show</code> — state yoki saqlangan plan'ni o'qiladigan/JSON ko'rinishda ko'rsatish. Ular debug va CI avtomatizatsiyasi uchun.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform console<br>&gt; cidrsubnet(&quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;, 8, 3)<br>&quot;10.0.3.0/24&quot;<br>&gt; [for s in [&quot;a&quot;,&quot;b&quot;] : upper(s)]<br>[&quot;A&quot;, &quot;B&quot;]<br>&gt; aws_instance.web.private_ip<br>&quot;10.0.1.15&quot;<br>&gt; local.tags<br><br>terraform output                         # hamma output<br>terraform output -raw public_ip          # skript uchun xom qiymat<br>terraform output -json | jq .<br><br>terraform show                           # joriy state<br>terraform show tf.plan                   # saqlangan plan<br>terraform show -json tf.plan | jq -r '.resource_changes[]<br>  | select(.change.actions | index(&quot;delete&quot;)) | .address'<br><br>terraform graph | dot -Tsvg &gt; graph.svg  # Graphviz kerak</pre><p>| Buyruq | Asosiy foydasi | |---|---| | <code>console</code> | <code>for</code>, <code>cidrsubnet</code>, regex'ni apply'siz sinash | | <code>output -raw</code> | bash skript va CI'ga qiymat uzatish | | <code>show -json</code> | plan'ni policy/skript bilan tekshirish | | <code>graph</code> | sikl va ortiqcha <code>depends_on</code> ni topish |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>console</code> state'ni lock qiladi — CI apply paytida ishlatmang.</li><li><code>output -raw</code> faqat string/number uchun; murakkab tur uchun <code>-json</code>.</li><li>Katta loyihada <code>graph</code> o'qib bo'lmas darajada katta — <code>-type=plan</code> va filtrlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>show -json</code> — OPA/Conftest yoki oddiy <code>jq</code> bilan &quot;delete yo'q&quot;, &quot;public bucket yo'q&quot; kabi policy-as-code tekshiruvlarining asosi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33178	<p>Remote backend va state locking qanday sozlanadi? Ikki kishi bir vaqtda apply qilsa nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Remote backend state'ni umumiy, shifrlangan joyda (S3, GCS, HCP Terraform) saqlaydi; locking esa bir vaqtda faqat bitta operatsiya state'ni yozishiga kafolat beradi. Ikki kishi bir vaqtda apply qilsa, ikkinchisi <code>Error acquiring the state lock</code> oladi — state buzilmaydi.</p><p><b>Lock'siz nima bo'lardi:</b></p><pre>A: state o'qidi (v5) -&gt; apply -&gt; state yozdi (v6a)<br>B: state o'qidi (v5) -&gt; apply -&gt; state yozdi (v6b)  &lt;- A'ning o'zgarishi yo'qoldi<br>   natija: cloud'da resurslar bor, state'da yo'q (orphan) yoki dublikat</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform {<br>  backend &quot;s3&quot; {<br>    bucket       = &quot;acme-tfstate&quot;<br>    key          = &quot;prod/network/terraform.tfstate&quot;<br>    region       = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;<br>    encrypt      = true<br>    kms_key_id   = &quot;alias/tfstate&quot;<br>    use_lockfile = true      # S3 native lock (1.10+); eski: dynamodb_table (deprecated)<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Bucket sozlamalari: versioning (state tiklash), Block Public Access, KMS, faqat CI roli va adminlarga IAM ruxsat.</p><pre>terraform apply -lock-timeout=5m     # lock bo'shashini kutish<br>terraform force-unlock &lt;LOCK_ID&gt;     # faqat hech kim ishlamayotganiga ishonch bo'lsa</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>force-unlock</code> ni ishlayotgan apply ustidan qilish — state buziladi.</li><li>Bucket versioning'siz — buzilgan state'ni qaytarib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Hamma muhit bitta key'da — har apply hammani bloklaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi lock — tashkiliy: apply faqat CI'dan va har state uchun concurrency group (bitta job). Odamlar faqat plan ko'radi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33179	<p>Drift nima va qanday aniqlanadi/tuzatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Drift — cloud'dagi real holat Terraform kodidan/state'dan farq qilishi (kimdir konsolda o'zgartirgan, boshqa tool tegingan). Aniqlash: <code>terraform plan</code> (yoki <code>-refresh-only</code>) muntazam CI'da. Tuzatish: o'zgarish to'g'ri bo'lsa kodga qo'shish, noto'g'ri bo'lsa <code>apply</code> bilan qaytarish.</p><p><b>Qanday paydo bo'ladi:</b></p><pre>kod: SG faqat 443        state: 443<br>konsolda kimdir 22 ni 0.0.0.0/0 ga ochdi<br>real: 443 + 22   --&gt; plan: ~ ingress (22 o'chiriladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform plan -refresh-only          # faqat real holat vs state<br>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode     # 0 = farq yo'q, 1 = xato, 2 = farq bor<br>terraform apply -refresh-only         # real holatni state'ga qabul qilish (kodni emas!)</pre><p>Kunlik drift job:</p><pre>on: { schedule: [{ cron: &quot;0 6 * * *&quot; }] }<br>jobs:<br>  drift:<br>    steps:<br>      - run: terraform init -input=false<br>      - run: |<br>          set +e<br>          terraform plan -detailed-exitcode -input=false -lock=false<br>          [ $? -eq 2 ] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;DRIFT&quot; &amp;&amp; exit 1 || true</pre><p><b>Qaror:</b> | Holat | Harakat | |---|---| | Incident paytidagi to'g'ri fix | kodga qo'shish, PR | | Noto'g'ri/xavfli o'zgarish | <code>apply</code> bilan qaytarish | | Tashqi tizim ataylab o'zgartiradi | <code>ignore_changes</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>apply -refresh-only</code> drift'ni state'ga &quot;qonuniylashtiradi&quot;, lekin kod hali eski — keyingi apply yana qaytaradi.</li><li>Autoscaler boshqaradigan maydon (<code>desired_count</code>) — doimiy soxta drift; <code>ignore_changes</code> qo'ying.</li><li>Drift job'ni plan lock'i bilan ishlatib, haqiqiy apply'larni bloklash — <code>-lock=false</code> (faqat read uchun).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Drift'ni aniqlash simptom; asl sabab — konsolda write huquqi. Prod'da odamlarga read-only, break-glass rolini loglangan qiling.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33180	<p>Module nima va qanday yaxshi modul yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Modul — qayta ishlatiladigan Terraform kodi papkasi (input = variable, output = output). Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33181	<p><code>count</code> va <code>for_each</code> farqi? Nega <code>for_each</code> ko'pincha xavfsizroq?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>count</code> resurslarni <b>indeks</b> bo'yicha (<code>[0]</code>, <code>[1]</code>) aniqlaydi, <code>for_each</code> esa <b>kalit</b> bo'yicha (<code>[&quot;ali&quot;]</code>). Ro'yxat o'rtasidan element o'chsa, <code>count</code> keyingi hammasini siljitib qayta yaratadi; <code>for_each</code> faqat o'sha bittasini o'chiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>users = [&quot;a&quot;,&quot;b&quot;,&quot;c&quot;]<br>count:    u[0]=a  u[1]=b  u[2]=c<br>&quot;b&quot; o'chdi -&gt; [&quot;a&quot;,&quot;c&quot;]:  u[1]: b -&gt; c (replace!),  u[2]: destroy<br>for_each: u[&quot;a&quot;] u[&quot;b&quot;] u[&quot;c&quot;]<br>&quot;b&quot; o'chdi -&gt; faqat u[&quot;b&quot;] destroy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># xavfli<br>resource &quot;aws_iam_user&quot; &quot;u&quot; {<br>  count = length(var.users)<br>  name  = var.users[count.index]<br>}<br><br># barqaror<br>resource &quot;aws_iam_user&quot; &quot;u&quot; {<br>  for_each = toset(var.users)<br>  name     = each.key<br>}<br><br># map bilan<br>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;b&quot; {<br>  for_each = { logs = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;, backup = &quot;eu-west-1&quot; }<br>  bucket   = &quot;acme-${each.key}&quot;<br>}<br><br># count hali ham o'rinli: shartli resurs<br>resource &quot;aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm&quot; &quot;cpu&quot; {<br>  count = var.enable_alarms ? 1 : 0<br>}</pre><p>Migratsiya (count -&gt; for_each):</p><pre>moved {<br>  from = aws_iam_user.u[0]<br>  to   = aws_iam_user.u[&quot;a&quot;]<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>for_each</code> kaliti plan paytida ma'lum bo'lishi kerak — boshqa resursning ID'si (apply'dan keyin ma'lum) kalit bo'lolmaydi.</li><li><code>for_each</code> faqat <code>set(string)</code> yoki <code>map</code> qabul qiladi — ro'yxatni <code>toset()</code> qiling.</li><li>Shartli resursga murojaat: <code>aws_x.y[0]</code> — <code>count=0</code> bo'lsa xato; <code>one(aws_x.y[*].id)</code> ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kalit sifatida barqaror, ma'noli qiymat (nom) tanlang — kalitni o'zgartirish ham replace. Har refactor'dan keyin plan &quot;0 to destroy&quot; bo'lishini tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33182	<p><code>terraform import</code> va <code>moved</code> blok nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>import</code> — Terraform'dan tashqarida (konsolda) yaratilgan mavjud resursni state'ga olib, boshqaruvga o'tkazadi. <code>moved</code> — kodda resurs manzili o'zgarganda (rename, modulga ko'chirish) Terraform'ga &quot;bu o'sha resurs&quot; Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33183	<p>Terraform'da secret'lar bilan qanday ishlash kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Qoida: secret iloji boricha Terraform'dan umuman o'tmasin (managed password, IAM role, OIDC). O'tishi kerak bo'lsa — <code>sensitive = true</code> (faqat CLI chiqishini yashiradi), secret manager'dan data source orqali o'qish, state'ni esa shifrlangan va qattiq cheklangan backend'da saqlash.</p><p><b>Nega qiyin:</b> Terraform har atributni state'ga yozadi. <code>sensitive</code> faqat plan/output'da <code>(sensitive value)</code> ko'rsatadi — state JSON'da parol ochiq turadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Yomon:   tfvars (Git) -&gt; TF -&gt; state (ochiq) -&gt; RDS<br>O'rta:   Secrets Manager -&gt; data source -&gt; TF -&gt; state (ochiq) -&gt; RDS<br>Yaxshi:  TF &quot;manage_master_user_password=true&quot; -&gt; AWS o'zi yaratadi va saqlaydi<br>          (state'da parol yo'q, faqat secret ARN)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>  identifier                  = &quot;prod-db&quot;<br>  engine                      = &quot;postgres&quot;<br>  username                    = &quot;app&quot;<br>  manage_master_user_password = true    # Secrets Manager, rotation bilan<br>}<br><br>data &quot;aws_secretsmanager_secret_version&quot; &quot;api&quot; {<br>  secret_id = &quot;prod/api-key&quot;<br>}<br><br>variable &quot;api_key&quot; {<br>  type      = string<br>  sensitive = true     # TF_VAR_api_key env'dan<br>}<br><br>output &quot;db_secret_arn&quot; {<br>  value = aws_db_instance.main.master_user_secret[0].secret_arn<br>}</pre><p>Ilova secret'ni o'zi o'qiydi (IAM role orqali), Terraform faqat ARN'ni uzatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sensitive</code> = xavfsiz deb o'ylash — state'da ochiq.</li><li><code>.tfvars</code> da parol + Git.</li><li><code>random_password</code> resursi — natija state'da; state'ga kirish = parolga kirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi Terraform (1.10+) <code>ephemeral</code> resurs/variable'lari va 1.11+ write-only atributlari secret'ni state'ga yozmaslik imkonini beradi; OpenTofu'da esa state encryption bor. Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33329	<p>Terraform uchun CI/CD pipeline qanday quriladi?</p>	<pre># GitHub Actions (qisqartirilgan)<br>permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read, pull-requests: write }<br>jobs:<br>  plan:<br>    steps:<br>    - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4<br>      with: { role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123:role/tf-plan, aws-region: eu-central-1 }<br>    - run: terraform init -input=false<br>    - run: terraform fmt -check &amp;&amp; terraform validate<br>    - run: terraform plan -input=false -out=tf.plan<br>  apply:<br>    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'<br>    environment: production        # manual approval<br>    concurrency: tf-prod<br>    steps:<br>    - run: terraform apply -input=false tf.plan</pre><p>Plan role — faqat o'qish; apply role — yozish, faqat main branch'dan assume qilinadi. Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33399	<p><code>dynamic</code> blok nima va qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>dynamic</code> blok — resurs ichidagi <b>ichki blokni</b> (<code>ingress</code>, <code>setting</code>, <code>rule</code>) ro'yxat bo'yicha takroran yaratish usuli. Resursning o'zini emas, faqat uning ichidagi bloklarni ko'paytiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>var.ingress_ports = [80, 443]<br>dynamic &quot;ingress&quot; { for_each ... content {...} }<br>   -&gt; ingress { from_port = 80 ... }<br>   -&gt; ingress { from_port = 443 ... }</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variable &quot;ingress_ports&quot; {<br>  type    = list(number)<br>  default = [80, 443]<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  name   = &quot;web&quot;<br>  vpc_id = var.vpc_id<br><br>  dynamic &quot;ingress&quot; {<br>    for_each = var.ingress_ports<br>    content {<br>      from_port   = ingress.value     # iterator nomi = blok nomi<br>      to_port     = ingress.value<br>      protocol    = &quot;tcp&quot;<br>      cidr_blocks = [&quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;]<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Iterator nomini o'zgartirish: <code>iterator = port</code> -&gt; <code>port.value</code>. Map bo'lsa <code>.key</code> va <code>.value</code>.</p><p>Ko'pincha aniqroq muqobil — alohida resurs:</p><pre>resource &quot;aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  for_each          = toset([for p in var.ingress_ports : tostring(p)])<br>  security_group_id = aws_security_group.web.id<br>  from_port         = tonumber(each.key)<br>  to_port           = tonumber(each.key)<br>  ip_protocol       = &quot;tcp&quot;<br>  cidr_ipv4         = &quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ichma-ich <code>dynamic</code> — kodni o'qib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Inline blok ro'yxatidagi o'zgarish butun blokni qayta yozadi — diff katta va tushunarsiz.</li><li>Inline qoidalar va alohida rule resurslarini aralashtirish — ular bir-birini doimiy &quot;tuzatadi&quot; (drift).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>dynamic</code> — modulga moslashuvchanlik berish uchun, lekin oddiy konfiguratsiyada statik bloklar o'qilishi osonroq. Mumkin bo'lsa alohida resurs + <code>for_each</code>: har qoidaning o'z manzili bor.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33400	<p>Provisioner'lar (<code>local-exec</code>, <code>remote-exec</code>) va <code>terraform_data</code> — nega 'oxirgi chora'?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Provisioner'lar (<code>local-exec</code>, <code>remote-exec</code>, <code>file</code>) resurs yaratilgandan keyin ixtiyoriy skript ishga tushiradi. Ular &quot;oxirgi chora&quot;, chunki Terraform ularning natijasini bilmaydi va boshqarmaydi: idempotent emas, plan'da ko'rinmaydi, xato bo'lsa resurs &quot;tainted&quot; bo'ladi. <code>terraform_data</code> — ularni biriktirish uchun provider'siz &quot;bo'sh&quot; resurs (<code>null_resource</code> o'rnini bosuvchi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>plan: + aws_instance.web       (skript haqida hech narsa yo'q)<br>apply: instance OK -&gt; remote-exec (SSH) timeout -&gt; instance TAINTED<br>keyingi apply: instance qayta yaratiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;terraform_data&quot; &quot;migrate&quot; {<br>  triggers_replace = [var.app_version]   # versiya o'zgarsa qayta ishlaydi<br>  provisioner &quot;local-exec&quot; {<br>    command     = &quot;./scripts/migrate.sh ${var.app_version}&quot;<br>    environment = { DB_HOST = aws_db_instance.main.address }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Yaxshiroq muqobillar:</b> | Vazifa | Muqobil | |---|---| | Birinchi boot sozlash | <code>user_data</code> / cloud-init | | Dastur o'rnatish | Packer bilan tayyor AMI | | Server konfiguratsiyasi | Ansible (Terraform'dan keyin) | | DB migratsiya | CI/CD pipeline qadami yoki K8s Job | | API'da yo'q narsa | provider/resurs qidiring |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>remote-exec</code> SSH kalit, ochiq port va tarmoq kirishini talab qiladi — CI'da mo'rt, xavfsizlikka zid.</li><li>Skript idempotent bo'lmasa, qayta ishlaganda zarar.</li><li><code>when = destroy</code> provisioner'lar ishonchsiz — ko'p holatda ishlamay qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provisioner ko'rsangiz — vazifani to'g'ri qatlamga ko'chirish mumkinligini so'rang: image (Packer), boot (cloud-init), config (Ansible), deploy (CI/CD). Terraform infratuzilma holatini boshqarsin, protseduralarni emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33432	<p><code>terraform state mv</code>, <code>state rm</code>, <code>state list/show</code> qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> State buyruqlari state faylini to'g'ridan boshqaradi: <code>list</code> — boshqariladigan resurslar, <code>show</code> — bitta resurs atributlari, <code>mv</code> — manzilni o'zgartirish (resurs qayta yaratilmaydi), <code>rm</code> — resursni state'dan &quot;unutish&quot; (cloud'da qoladi). Odatiy refactor'lar kod bloklari orqali.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33433	<p><code>Error acquiring the state lock</code>. <code>terraform force-unlock</code> qachon xavfsiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bu xato boshqa operatsiya (CI job yoki hamkasb) state lock'ini ushlab turganini bildiradi. <code>force-unlock</code> faqat lock egasi <b>haqiqatan ishlamayotganiga</b> (job tugagan, crash bo'lgan) ishonch hosil qilgandan keyin xavfsiz; aks holda ikki apply bir state'ga yozib, uni buzadi.</p><p><b>O'qish:</b></p><pre>Error: Error acquiring the state lock<br>Lock Info:<br>  ID:        6f1c...e2<br>  Path:      acme-tfstate/prod/app.tfstate<br>  Operation: OperationTypeApply<br>  Who:       runner@ci-123<br>  Version:   1.10.3<br>  Created:   2026-10-02 09:14:03 UTC</pre><p><b>Tekshiruv tartibi:</b></p><pre>1. Who -&gt; ci-123: shu job hali ishlayaptimi? (CI UI)<br>   yoki odam -&gt; undan so'rang<br>2. Created -&gt; qancha vaqt o'tdi? apply odatda necha daqiqa?<br>3. Job crash/cancel bo'lgan -&gt; lock &quot;osilib&quot; qolgan<br>4. Ishonch bor -&gt; force-unlock, keyin plan bilan state'ni tekshirish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform force-unlock 6f1c...e2<br>terraform plan          # state izchilmi, kutilmagan o'zgarish yo'qmi<br>terraform apply -lock-timeout=5m    # qisqa navbat uchun kutish</pre><p>CI'da oldini olish:</p><pre>concurrency:<br>  group: tf-prod-app       # bir state'ga bitta job<br>  cancel-in-progress: false<br>timeout-minutes: 60</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Uzoq ishlayotgan (masalan, RDS yaratish 20 daqiqa) apply'ni &quot;osilgan&quot; deb unlock qilish.</li><li>CI job'ni bekor qilish (cancel) — Terraform lock'ni bo'shatmay qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Drift job yoki <code>console</code> ham lock oladi — read-only ishlar uchun <code>-lock=false</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tez-tez lock to'qnashuvi — arxitektura signali: state juda katta yoki ko'p yo'l bilan apply qilinadi. State'ni bo'ling va apply'ni bitta pipeline'ga to'plang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33434	<p><code>-target</code> flag nima va nega anti-pattern hisoblanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>-target</code> — plan/apply'ni faqat ko'rsatilgan resurs (va uning bog'liqliklari) bilan cheklaydi. Anti-pattern, chunki u to'liq rasmni yashiradi: boshqa o'zgarishlar va drift ko'rinmaydi, state kod bilan nomuvofiq qoladi. Terraform o'zi &quot;routine use not recommended&quot; deb ogohlantiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday xavf:</b></p><pre>kod: SG o'zgardi + LB o'zgardi + IAM o'zgardi<br>apply -target=SG  -&gt; faqat SG<br>natija: LB va IAM kod bilan mos emas, keyingi to'liq plan kutilmagan diff ko'rsatadi</pre><p><b>Amalda (o'rinli holatlar):</b></p><pre># incident: bitta SG qoidasini tez tuzatish<br>terraform plan -target=aws_security_group.api -out fix.plan<br>terraform apply fix.plan<br>terraform plan          # darhol keyin to'liq plan: nima qoldi?<br><br># bootstrap: avval provider'ga kerak bo'lgan resurs (masalan, EKS cluster)<br>terraform apply -target=module.eks<br>terraform apply</pre><pre>Warning: Resource targeting is in effect<br>... routine use of this option is not recommended</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har kuni <code>-target</code> — state'da kim nimani qachon qo'llagani noaniq.</li><li>Target bog'liq resurslarni ham oladi — kutganingizdan ko'p narsa o'zgaradi.</li><li>CI'da <code>-target</code> ishlatish — review qilingan plan to'liq bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Doim target kerak bo'lsa — state juda katta yoki bog'liqliklar noto'g'ri. Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33435	<p>Provider alias nima? Bitta konfiguratsiyada ikki region yoki ikki AWS akkauntga qanday resurs yaratasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Provider alias — bitta provider turining bir nechta konfiguratsiyasi (boshqa region, boshqa akkaunt/rol). Resursda <code>provider = aws.us</code>, modulda <code>providers = { aws = aws.us }</code> bilan qaysi biri ishlatilishini tanlaysiz.</p><p><b>Real holat:</b> CloudFront faqat <code>us-east-1</code> dagi ACM sertifikatini qabul qiladi, qolgan infratuzilma esa <code>eu-central-1</code> da.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>provider &quot;aws&quot;           -&gt; eu-central-1, akkaunt 111 (default)<br>provider &quot;aws&quot; alias=us  -&gt; us-east-1<br>provider &quot;aws&quot; alias=dr  -&gt; eu-west-1, akkaunt 222 (assume_role)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>provider &quot;aws&quot; &quot;cdn&quot; {<br>  provider          = aws.us<br>  domain_name       = &quot;example.com&quot;<br>  validation_method = &quot;DNS&quot;<br>}<br><br>module &quot;backup&quot; {<br>  source    = &quot;./modules/backup&quot;<br>  providers = { aws = aws.dr }<br>}</pre><p>Modul ichida alias qabul qilish:</p><pre>terraform {<br>  required_providers {<br>    aws = { source = &quot;hashicorp/aws&quot;, configuration_aliases = [aws.replica] }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Resursga <code>provider</code> ni unutish — default region'da yaratiladi, CloudFront xato beradi.</li><li>Modul ichida <code>provider</code> bloki e'lon qilish — <code>for_each</code>/<code>count</code> bilan ishlamaydi; Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33439	<p>Backend'ni o'zgartirish: lokal state'ni S3'ga qanday ko'chirasiz? <code>-migrate-state</code> va <code>-reconfigure</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Backend blokini qo'shib/o'zgartirib <code>terraform init -migrate-state</code> qilasiz — Terraform eski state'ni yangi backend'ga <b>ko'chiradi</b>. <code>-reconfigure</code> esa eski state'ni e'tiborsiz qoldirib, yangi backend'ni noldan ishlatadi (ko'chirmaydi). Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33440	<p><code>precondition</code>/<code>postcondition</code> va <code>check</code> bloklari nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>precondition</code> — resurs yaratilishidan <b>oldin</b> taxminni tekshiradi (kirish noto'g'ri bo'lsa plan to'xtaydi); <code>postcondition</code> — yaratilgandan <b>keyin</b> natija kutilganday ekanini tekshiradi; <code>check</code> bloki — infratuzilmaning umumiy sog'lig'ini tekshiradi, lekin xato bo'lsa faqat <b>ogohlantiradi</b>, apply'ni to'xtatmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Modulga x86 AMI berildi, lekin instance turi Graviton (arm64). Apply 5 daqiqadan keyin noaniq xato bilan yiqiladi. Precondition buni plan bosqichida tushunarli xabar bilan ushlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>plan:  variable validation -&gt; precondition -&gt; (xato = stop)<br>apply: resurs yaratiladi -&gt; postcondition -&gt; (xato = stop, keyingilar bajarilmaydi)<br>har plan/apply oxirida: check -&gt; (xato = warning)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;api&quot; {<br>  ami           = data.aws_ami.app.id<br>  instance_type = var.type<br><br>  lifecycle {<br>    precondition {<br>      condition     = data.aws_ami.app.architecture == &quot;arm64&quot;<br>      error_message = &quot;Graviton (t4g/m7g) uchun arm64 AMI kerak.&quot;<br>    }<br>    postcondition {<br>      condition     = self.private_ip != &quot;&quot;<br>      error_message = &quot;Private IP berilmadi.&quot;<br>    }<br>  }<br>}<br><br>check &quot;api_health&quot; {<br>  data &quot;http&quot; &quot;api&quot; { url = &quot;https://api.example.com/health&quot; }<br>  assert {<br>    condition     = data.http.api.status_code == 200<br>    error_message = &quot;API health 200 emas.&quot;<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>| | Qachon ishlaydi | Xato natijasi | Nimaga | |---|---|---|---| | <code>validation</code> | plan | stop | bitta variable | | <code>precondition</code> | plan | stop | bir nechta qiymat orasidagi bog'liqlik | | <code>postcondition</code> | apply | stop | natija kafolati | | <code>check</code> | har run | warning | doimiy sog'lik/drift |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Postcondition'da <code>self</code> ishlatilmasa — o'sha resursni emas, boshqasini tekshirasiz.</li><li><code>check</code> apply'ni to'xtatadi deb kutish — u faqat ogohlantiradi.</li><li>Juda ko'p shart — modul o'qilishi qiyinlashadi; muhimlarini qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shartlar — modul kontraktining bajariladigan hujjati: iste'molchi xatosi apply'da emas, plan'da, aniq xabar bilan chiqadi. <code>terraform test</code> bilan birga ular modul sifatini sezilarli oshiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform

Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33186	<p><code>lifecycle</code> bloki: <code>prevent_destroy</code>, <code>create_before_destroy</code>, <code>ignore_changes</code> qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>lifecycle</code> — Terraform'ning resursni qanday almashtirishi/o'chirishini boshqaradi. <code>prevent_destroy</code> — o'chirishga olib keladigan plan'ni xato bilan to'xtatadi (DB, bucket); <code>create_before_destroy</code> — replace'da avval yangisini yaratib, keyin eskisini o'chiradi (downtime yo'q); <code>ignore_changes</code> — tashqaridan boshqariladigan atributlarni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>default replace:          destroy old -&gt; create new     (oraliqda downtime)<br>create_before_destroy:    create new -&gt; switch -&gt; destroy old<br>prevent_destroy:          plan'da destroy bo'lsa -&gt; Error<br>ignore_changes:           atribut farqi plan'da ko'rinmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>  deletion_protection = true             # cloud darajasida ham<br>  lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_launch_template&quot; &quot;lt&quot; {<br>  name_prefix = &quot;api-&quot;                    # nom to'qnashmasligi uchun<br>  lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_ecs_service&quot; &quot;api&quot; {<br>  desired_count = 2<br>  lifecycle { ignore_changes = [desired_count] }   # autoscaler boshqaradi<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  lifecycle {<br>    replace_triggered_by = [terraform_data.app_version]   # versiya o'zgarsa replace<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>create_before_destroy</code> unique nomli resurslarda (bir xil <code>name</code>) to'qnashadi — <code>name_prefix</code> ishlating.</li><li><code>prevent_destroy</code> faqat Terraform ichida: resurs blokini koddan o'chirsangiz himoya ham ketadi. Shuning uchun cloud tomonidagi <code>deletion_protection</code> ham kerak.</li><li><code>ignore_changes = all</code> — drift'ni butunlay yashiradi; aniq atributlarni sanang.</li><li><code>create_before_destroy</code> bog'liq resurslarga ham tarqaladi — ular ham shu rejimga o'tadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stateful resurslar (DB, bucket, KMS key) uchun ikki qatlamli himoya standart: <code>prevent_destroy</code> + provider'ning deletion protection'i + CI'da destroy uchun alohida tasdiq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform

Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-33490	<p>OpenTofu state encryption nima va nega muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OpenTofu (1.7+) state va plan fayllarini <b>klient tomonida</b> shifrlay oladi (AES-GCM, kalit KMS/PBKDF2 orqali).
