Unga boshqa joydan <code>&lt;TUR&gt;.&lt;NOM&gt;.&lt;atribut&gt;</code> bilan murojaat qilinadi.</p><p><b>Tuzilishi:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;logs&quot; {<br>          ^ tur           ^ lokal nom (kodda)<br>  bucket = &quot;myco-logs-prod&quot;   &lt;- argument (cloud'dagi haqiqiy nom)<br>}<br>murojaat: aws_s3_bucket.logs.arn</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;logs&quot; {<br>  bucket = &quot;myco-logs-prod&quot;<br>  tags   = { env = &quot;prod&quot; }<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket_versioning&quot; &quot;logs&quot; {<br>  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.logs.id          # murojaat = avtomatik bog'liqlik<br>  versioning_configuration { status = &quot;Enabled&quot; }<br>}<br><br>output &quot;logs_arn&quot; { value = aws_s3_bucket.logs.arn }</pre><pre>terraform plan<br># + aws_s3_bucket.logs will be created<br>#   + arn    = (known after apply)<br>#   + bucket = &quot;myco-logs-prod&quot;</pre><p>&quot;known after apply&quot; — qiymat (ARN, ID) faqat cloud yaratgandan keyin ma'lum bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Meta-argumentlar</b> (har resursda bor): <code>count</code>, <code>for_each</code>, <code>depends_on</code>, <code>provider</code>, <code>lifecycle</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lokal nomni (<code>logs</code>) o'zgartirish — Terraform eski resursni o'chirib, yangisini yaratadi; <code>moved</code> blok kerak.</li><li>Resursga ikki joyda turli nom berib, bir xil <code>bucket</code> qiymati — &quot;already exists&quot; xatosi.</li><li>Argument nomini provider hujjatisiz taxmin qilish — <code>terraform validate</code> ushlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Lokal nomlarni ma'noli va barqaror tanlang (<code>main</code>, <code>logs</code>, <code>this</code>) — keyinchalik o'zgartirish state migratsiyasini talab qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34258	<p>Remote state nima va nega lokal state yomon?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Remote state — <code>terraform.tfstate</code> faylini laptop'da emas, umumiy va himoyalangan joyda (S3, GCS, Azure Blob, HCP Terraform) saqlash. Lokal state yomon: jamoa ko'rmaydi, lock yo'q, backup yo'q va unda secret'lar ochiq turadi.</p><p><b>Lokal state muammolari:</b></p><pre>Ali laptop: state (v10)       Vali laptop: state (v7, eski)<br>Vali apply -&gt; eski state bilan -&gt; resurslarni qayta yaratishga urinadi<br>Ali laptop buzildi -&gt; state yo'q -&gt; Terraform hech narsani tanimaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform {<br>  backend &quot;s3&quot; {<br>    bucket       = &quot;myco-tfstate&quot;<br>    key          = &quot;prod/network.tfstate&quot;<br>    region       = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;<br>    encrypt      = true<br>    use_lockfile = true      # S3 native lock (Terraform 1.10+)<br>    # eski usul: dynamodb_table = &quot;tf-lock&quot; (deprecated)<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>terraform init -migrate-state    # lokal state'ni S3 ga ko'chirish<br>terraform state list             # endi S3 dan o'qiladi</pre><p>Bucket uchun: versioning ON, Block Public Access, KMS shifrlash, faqat kerakli rollarga IAM ruxsat.</p><p>| | Lokal | Remote | |---|---|---| | Jamoa | ko'rmaydi | umumiy | | Lock | yo'q | bor | | Backup | yo'q | versioning | | Xavfsizlik | laptop'da ochiq | shifrlangan, IAM |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>State bucket'ni o'sha konfiguratsiya ichida yaratish — &quot;tovuq va tuxum&quot;; alohida bootstrap qiling.</li><li>Versioning'siz bucket — buzilgan state'ni qaytarib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Hamma muhit bitta key'da.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> State'ga kirish = infratuzilma secret'lariga kirish. IAM'da uni prod ma'lumot darajasida himoya qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34259	<p>State locking nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> State locking bir vaqtda faqat <b>bitta</b> Terraform operatsiyasi state'ni o'zgartirishiga kafolat beradi. Lock bo'lmasa, ikki kishi bir vaqtda apply qilib, bir-birining yozuvini ustiga yozadi — state buziladi va resurslar &quot;yo'qolib&quot; qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Ali:  plan/apply -&gt; lock oldi -&gt; ... ishlayapti ... -&gt; lock bo'shatdi<br>Vali: apply ----&gt; &quot;Error acquiring the state lock&quot; (kutadi yoki xato)</pre><p><b>Qayerda lock:</b> | Backend | Lock | |---|---| | S3 | <code>use_lockfile = true</code> (1.10+, <code>.tflock</code> fayl); eski: DynamoDB (deprecated) | | GCS, Azure Blob | avtomatik | | HCP Terraform | avtomatik | | local | faqat bitta mashinada |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform apply<br># Acquiring state lock. This may take a few moments...<br><br># boshqasi ishlayotgan bo'lsa:<br># Error: Error acquiring the state lock<br>#   Who: runner@ci-123   Operation: OperationTypeApply<br><br>terraform apply -lock-timeout=5m     # bo'shashini kutish<br>terraform force-unlock &lt;LOCK_ID&gt;     # faqat hech kim ishlamayotgan bo'lsa</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Uzoq davom etayotgan apply'ni &quot;qotib qoldi&quot; deb <code>force-unlock</code> qilish — ikki operatsiya bir state'ga yozadi.</li><li>CI job'ni bekor qilish — lock bo'shamay qolishi mumkin; <code>Who</code> va vaqtni tekshirib keyin unlock.</li><li><code>-lock=false</code> ni apply'da ishlatish — himoyani o'chirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Lock — texnik himoya; asosiy himoya — apply faqat bitta CI pipeline'dan va har state uchun bitta job (concurrency group).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34260	<p><code>terraform plan -out</code> va <code>apply plan</code> nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terraform plan -out=tfplan</code> rejani faylga saqlaydi; <code>terraform apply tfplan</code> <b>aynan o'sha</b> rejani, qayta hisoblamasdan bajaradi. Shunda review qilingan narsa bilan bajarilgan narsa bir xil bo'ladi — oradagi o'zgarishlar kutilmaganda kirib qolmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Siz plan'ni ko'rdingiz (&quot;1 to change&quot;), 10 daqiqadan keyin oddiy <code>apply</code> qildingiz. Bu orada kimdir boshqa narsani o'zgartirdi va apply boshqa (kattaroq) rejani bajardi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>plan -out=tfplan  -&gt;  [tfplan fayl: aniq amallar + state versiyasi]<br>review (show)<br>apply tfplan      -&gt;  state o'zgargan bo'lsa: &quot;Saved plan is stale&quot; -&gt; rad</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform plan -out=tfplan<br>terraform show tfplan                 # o'qiladigan ko'rinish<br>terraform show -json tfplan &gt; plan.json   # avtomatik tekshiruv uchun<br>terraform apply tfplan                # tasdiq so'ramaydi</pre><p>CI oqimi:</p><pre>PR ochildi  -&gt; plan -out -&gt; PR'ga comment (diff) -&gt; review<br>merge       -&gt; apply (o'sha plan yoki main'dan qayta plan + apply)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>tfplan</code> faylida secret'lar bor (shifrlanmagan) — CI artefaktini cheklangan va qisqa muddat saqlang.</li><li>Plan eskirgan bo'lsa (state o'zgargan) apply rad etiladi — qayta plan qiling.</li><li>Plan bir platforma/versiyada yaratilib, boshqasida apply qilinsa ishlamaydi — bir xil Terraform versiyasi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Saqlangan plan — &quot;nima tasdiqlangan bo'lsa, shu bajarilgan&quot; degan audit kafolati. Atlantis, HCP Terraform, Spacelift kabi tool'lar aynan shu oqimni avtomatlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34261	<p>Terraform module nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Module — birga ishlatiladigan Terraform resurslari to'plami (bitta papka), uni bir necha joyda parametrlar bilan qayta ishlatish mumkin. Har Terraform papkasi aslida modul; siz <code>terraform</code> ni ishga tushirgan papka — <b>root module</b>, u chaqiradiganlar — <b>child module</b>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>root (envs/prod)<br>  module &quot;vpc&quot; ---&gt; modules/vpc/ (variables.tf -&gt; main.tf -&gt; outputs.tf)<br>         inputs: cidr                          outputs: private_subnets</pre><p>Modul — funksiya kabi: variable = parametr, output = qaytariladigan qiymat.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>module &quot;vpc&quot; {<br>  source  = &quot;terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws&quot;   # public registry<br>  version = &quot;5.8.1&quot;<br>  name    = &quot;prod&quot;<br>  cidr    = &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;<br>  azs             = [&quot;eu-central-1a&quot;, &quot;eu-central-1b&quot;]<br>  private_subnets = [&quot;10.0.1.0/24&quot;, &quot;10.0.2.0/24&quot;]<br>}<br><br>module &quot;app&quot; {<br>  source     = &quot;./modules/app&quot;            # lokal papka<br>  subnet_ids = module.vpc.private_subnets # bir modul output'i -&gt; boshqasiga<br>}</pre><pre>terraform init      # modullarni .terraform/modules ga yuklaydi</pre><p>Source turlari: lokal (<code>./modules/x</code>), registry (<code>org/name/provider</code>), git (<code>git::https://...?ref=v1.2.0</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Versiyani yozmaslik yoki <code>ref=main</code> — modul egasining har o'zgarishi sizning infraga ta'sir qiladi.</li><li>Modulni o'zgartirgach <code>terraform init</code> unutiladi — &quot;Module not installed&quot;.</li><li>Juda katta, hamma narsani qiladigan modul — moslashuvchan emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval jamoat registry'dagi sinalgan modullarni ko'ring; o'zingiznikini yozsangiz — kichik, bitta maqsadli va SemVer bilan versiyalangan qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34262	<p>Terraform'da <code>count</code> va <code>for_each</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham bitta blokdan bir nechta resurs yaratadi. <code>count</code> — son bo'yicha, resurslar indeks bilan (<code>u[0]</code>, <code>u[1]</code>). <code>for_each</code> — set/map bo'yicha, resurslar kalit bilan (<code>u[&quot;ali&quot;]</code>). Ro'yxat o'rtasidan element o'chsa <code>count</code> keyingilarini qayta yaratadi, <code>for_each</code> esa faqat o'sha bittasini o'chiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>users = [&quot;ali&quot;, &quot;vali&quot;, &quot;soli&quot;]<br><br>count:     u[0]=ali  u[1]=vali  u[2]=soli<br>&quot;vali&quot; o'chirildi -&gt; u[1]=soli (o'zgaradi!), u[2] o'chiriladi<br><br>for_each:  u[&quot;ali&quot;]  u[&quot;vali&quot;]  u[&quot;soli&quot;]<br>&quot;vali&quot; o'chirildi -&gt; faqat u[&quot;vali&quot;] o'chiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># count: shartli yaratish uchun yaxshi<br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;bastion&quot; {<br>  count         = var.enable_bastion ? 1 : 0<br>  ami           = var.ami<br>  instance_type = &quot;t3.micro&quot;<br>}<br><br># for_each: nomli to'plam uchun<br>resource &quot;aws_iam_user&quot; &quot;u&quot; {<br>  for_each = toset([&quot;ali&quot;, &quot;vali&quot;])<br>  name     = each.key<br>}<br><br># map bilan<br>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;b&quot; {<br>  for_each = { logs = &quot;prod-logs&quot;, backup = &quot;prod-backup&quot; }<br>  bucket   = each.value<br>}</pre><p>Murojaat: <code>aws_iam_user.u[&quot;ali&quot;].arn</code>, <code>aws_instance.bastion[0].id</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>count</code> bilan ro'yxat — o'rtadan o'chirish qayta yaratish chaqiradi.</li><li><code>for_each</code> ga oddiy list berish — xato; <code>toset()</code> kerak.</li><li><code>for_each</code> kaliti apply'dan keyin ma'lum bo'ladigan qiymat bo'lolmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: &quot;yoq/o'chir&quot; uchun <code>count = var.x ? 1 : 0</code>, to'plam uchun doim <code>for_each</code>.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34263	<p>Terraform workspace nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Workspace — bitta Terraform kodi va backend uchun bir nechta <b>alohida state</b>. <code>default</code> workspace avtomatik bor; <code>dev</code>, <code>prod</code> kabi yangilarini yaratib, ular orasida almashasiz. Kod bir xil, faqat state (va <code>terraform.workspace</code> qiymati) farq qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bir xil kod<br>   |-- workspace default -&gt; s3://bucket/terraform.tfstate<br>   |-- workspace dev     -&gt; s3://bucket/env:/dev/terraform.tfstate<br>   +-- workspace prod    -&gt; s3://bucket/env:/prod/terraform.tfstate</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform workspace new dev<br>terraform workspace select prod<br>terraform workspace list<br>#   default<br>#   dev<br># * prod<br>terraform workspace show       # prod</pre><pre>locals {<br>  instance_type = terraform.workspace == &quot;prod&quot; ? &quot;t3.large&quot; : &quot;t3.micro&quot;<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  instance_type = local.instance_type<br>  tags          = { env = terraform.workspace }<br>}</pre><p>| | Workspace | Alohida papka | |---|---|---| | Kod | bir xil | farq qilishi mumkin | | State | alohida | alohida | | IAM/akkaunt | odatda bir xil | alohida bo'lishi mumkin | | Xato muhitga apply | oson | qiyin |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>terraform workspace select</code> ni unutib, prod'ga dev o'zgarishini apply qilish — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.</li><li>Workspace'lar bitta backend va bitta credential'dan foydalanadi — izolyatsiya zaif.</li><li>HCP Terraform'dagi &quot;workspace&quot; boshqa tushuncha (alohida konfiguratsiya + state) — adashtirmang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Workspace'lar PR preview yoki vaqtinchalik muhitlar uchun yaxshi. dev/stage/prod uchun alohida papka (va ideal holda alohida akkaunt) xavfsizroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34264	<p><code>terraform import</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terraform import</code> — Terraform'dan tashqarida (konsolda, skript bilan) yaratilgan mavjud resursni state'ga qo'shadi, shunda Terraform uni boshqara boshlaydi. Resurs qayta yaratilmaydi. Terraform 1.5+ da kodda yoziladigan <code>import {}</code> bloki tavsiya etiladi.</p><p><b>Vaziyat:</b> S3 bucket bir yil oldin konsolda qo'lda yaratilgan. Endi uni Terraform'ga olish kerak — o'chirib qayta yaratish mumkin emas (ichida ma'lumot).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>AWS: bucket &quot;myco-logs-prod&quot; (bor)<br>kod: resource aws_s3_bucket.logs + import { id = &quot;myco-logs-prod&quot; }<br>plan: 1 to import -&gt; apply -&gt; state'da bog'landi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import {<br>  to = aws_s3_bucket.logs<br>  id = &quot;myco-logs-prod&quot;<br>}</pre><pre>terraform plan -generate-config-out=gen.tf   # resurs kodini avtomatik yozadi<br># gen.tf ni ko'rib chiqing, keraksiz atributlarni tozalang, main.tf ga ko'chiring<br>terraform plan<br># Plan: 1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.<br>terraform apply</pre><p>Import tugagach <code>import {}</code> blokini o'chirish mumkin.</p><p>Eski usul (CLI):</p><pre>terraform import aws_s3_bucket.logs myco-logs-prod</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Import'dan keyin plan'da <code>~</code> yoki <code>-/+</code> bor — kod real holatga mos emas; mos qilmaguncha apply qilmang, aks holda resurs o'zgaradi yoki qayta yaratiladi.</li><li>Har resurs turi uchun <code>id</code> formati boshqacha — provider hujjatidagi &quot;Import&quot; bo'limini o'qing.</li><li>Bog'liq resurslarni (bucket policy, versioning) unutish — ular boshqarilmay qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Import muvaffaqiyati mezoni: plan &quot;0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy&quot;. Shu holatga yetmaguncha import tugamagan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34265	<p>Drift nima va Terraform uni qanday aniqlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Drift — cloud'dagi haqiqiy holat Terraform kodidan farq qilib qolishi (kimdir konsolda o'zgartirgan). Terraform har <code>plan</code> da real holatni o'qib (refresh), state va kod bilan solishtiradi va farqni ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Misol:</b></p><pre>kod:      instance_type = &quot;t3.micro&quot;<br>konsolda: kimdir t3.large ga o'zgartirdi<br>plan:     ~ instance_type = &quot;t3.large&quot; -&gt; &quot;t3.micro&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform plan                       # drift + kod o'zgarishlari birga<br>terraform plan -refresh-only         # faqat drift (kod o'zgarishisiz)<br># Note: Objects have changed outside of Terraform<br>#   ~ instance_type = &quot;t3.micro&quot; -&gt; &quot;t3.large&quot;<br>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode    # 0 = farq yo'q, 2 = farq bor (CI uchun)</pre><p><b>Nima qilish:</b> | O'zgarish | Harakat | |---|---| | To'g'ri (masalan, incident fix) | kodni yangilash, PR | | Noto'g'ri | <code>terraform apply</code> — kodga qaytaradi | | Tashqi tizim ataylab o'zgartiradi | <code>lifecycle { ignore_changes = [...] }</code> |</p><p><b>Oldini olish:</b></p><ul><li>Prod konsolda odamlarga faqat read-only huquq.</li><li>Har kuni CI'da <code>plan -detailed-exitcode</code>, farq bo'lsa alert.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Drift'ni ko'rib, o'ylamay <code>apply</code> qilish — incident paytidagi kerakli fix'ni bekor qilish mumkin.</li><li>Terraform boshqarmaydigan atributlar/resurslar drift'i ko'rinmaydi.</li><li><code>apply -refresh-only</code> faqat state'ni yangilaydi, kodni emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Drift — jarayon muammosi belgisi. Yechim texnik emas: hamma o'zgarish kod orqali o'tishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34266	<p>Sensitive qiymatlar (parol) Terraform'da qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Variable va output'ni <code>sensitive = true</code> deb belgilasangiz, Terraform ularni plan va konsol chiqishida <code>(sensitive value)</code> deb yashiradi. Lekin qiymat <b>state faylida ochiq</b> qoladi — shuning uchun parolni Git'ga qo'ymaslik, state'ni himoyalash va iloji bo'lsa parolni Terraform'dan umuman o'tkazmaslik kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>TF_VAR_db_password (env) -&gt; variable (sensitive) -&gt; RDS<br>plan chiqishi: password = (sensitive value)<br>state JSON:    &quot;password&quot;: &quot;SuperSecret123&quot;   &lt;- ochiq!</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variable &quot;db_password&quot; {<br>  type      = string<br>  sensitive = true<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>  username = &quot;app&quot;<br>  password = var.db_password<br>}</pre><pre>export TF_VAR_db_password=&quot;$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \<br>  --secret-id prod/db --query SecretString --output text)&quot;<br>terraform plan</pre><p>Yaxshiroq — AWS parolni o'zi yaratsin:</p><pre>resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>  username                    = &quot;app&quot;<br>  manage_master_user_password = true   # Secrets Manager'da, state'da parol yo'q<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>prod.tfvars</code> ichida parol va uni commit qilish — <code>*.tfvars</code> ni <code>.gitignore</code> ga qo'shing yoki secret'larni faqat env'dan bering.</li><li><code>sensitive</code> = shifrlangan deb o'ylash — yo'q, faqat ekranda yashirilgan.</li><li><code>terraform output -json</code> sensitive qiymatlarni ham ochiq chiqaradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> State'ga kirish huquqini parolga kirish huquqi deb hisoblang: shifrlangan backend, minimal IAM. Terraform 1.10+ dagi <code>ephemeral</code> qiymatlar secret'ni state'ga yozmaslik imkonini beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34267	<p><code>terraform destroy</code> xavfini qanday kamaytirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bir necha qatlamli himoya: kodda <code>lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }</code>, cloud'da <code>deletion_protection</code>, IAM'da destroy huquqini cheklash, CI'da plan'dagi har <code>destroy</code> uchun alohida tasdiq va muhim ma'lumot uchun backup/snapshot.</p><p><b>Xavf qayerdan keladi:</b></p><pre>terraform destroy (noto'g'ri papka/workspace)<br>resurs blokini koddan o'chirish -&gt; plan: destroy<br>immutable atribut o'zgarishi -&gt; plan: -/+ replace</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>  identifier              = &quot;prod-db&quot;<br>  deletion_protection     = true          # AWS o'zi o'chirishni rad etadi<br>  skip_final_snapshot     = false<br>  final_snapshot_identifier = &quot;prod-db-final&quot;<br>  backup_retention_period = 14<br>  lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }    # Terraform plan'ni to'xtatadi<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;data&quot; {<br>  bucket = &quot;acme-prod-data&quot;<br>  lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }<br>}</pre><p>Plan'da:</p><pre>Error: Instance cannot be destroyed<br>  Resource aws_db_instance.main has lifecycle.prevent_destroy set...</pre><p>CI'da destroy'ni ushlash:</p><pre>terraform show -json tf.plan | jq -e '[.resource_changes[]<br>  | select(.change.actions | index(&quot;delete&quot;))] | length == 0' || echo &quot;DESTROY bor - tasdiq kerak&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>prevent_destroy</code> resurs bloki bilan birga yo'qoladi — kimdir blokni o'chirsa himoya ham ketadi. Shuning uchun cloud'dagi <code>deletion_protection</code> ham kerak.</li><li><code>skip_final_snapshot = true</code> — DB o'chsa oxirgi nusxa yo'q.</li><li>Prod credential bilan lokal ishlash — noto'g'ri papkada destroy.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng kuchli himoya — odamlarning prod'ga lokal apply/destroy huquqi yo'qligi. Hammasi CI orqali, destroy esa ikki kishilik tasdiq bilan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34268	<p><code>.terraform</code> papkasi va <code>.gitignore</code>?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>.terraform/</code> — <code>terraform init</code> yuklab olgan provider binarlari va modullar keshi; u lokal, katta va qayta yaratiladi, shuning uchun Git'ga qo'shilmaydi. <code>.gitignore</code> ga state fayllari, secret'li <code>tfvars</code> va crash log'lar ham qo'shiladi. <code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> esa <b>commit qilinadi</b>.</p><p><b>Nima qayerda:</b> | Fayl | Git'ga? | Nega | |---|---|---| | <code>.terraform/</code> | yo'q | provider binarlari (yuzlab MB), qayta yuklanadi | | <code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> | <b>ha</b> | hamma bir xil provider versiyasi | | <code>*.tfstate</code>, <code>*.tfstate.*</code> | yo'q | secret'lar, remote backend'da bo'lishi kerak | | <code>*.tfvars</code> (secret'li) | yo'q | parollar | | <code>crash.log</code> | yo'q | debug fayl | | <code>*.tfplan</code> | yo'q | plan'da secret'lar |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>.terraform/<br>*.tfstate<br>*.tfstate.*<br>*.tfplan<br>crash.log<br>crash.*.log<br>override.tf<br>override.tf.json<br>*_override.tf<br>*.tfvars<br>!example.tfvars</pre><pre>git check-ignore -v .terraform/providers   # qaysi qoida ishlayapti<br>du -sh .terraform                           # odatda 100+ MB</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.terraform/</code> ni commit qilish — repo yuzlab MB ga shishadi va platformaga bog'liq binarlar keladi.</li><li>Lock faylni ignore qilish — CI va jamoada turli provider versiyalari.</li><li>Hamma <code>*.tfvars</code> ni ignore qilib, secret'siz muhit konfiguratsiyasini ham yo'qotish — <code>prod.tfvars</code> (secret'siz) ni commit qilish mumkin; secret'lar env'dan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pre-commit'da <code>terraform fmt</code>, <code>gitleaks</code> va &quot;state fayl commit qilinmasin&quot; tekshiruvini qo'ying — <code>.gitignore</code> faqat birinchi himoya chizig'i.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34269	<p>Terraform'da variable turlari va validatsiya?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Variable turlari: oddiy (<code>string</code>, <code>number</code>, <code>bool</code>) va murakkab (<code>list</code>, <code>set</code>, <code>map</code>, <code>object</code>, <code>tuple</code>). <code>type</code> noto'g'ri qiymatni ushlaydi, <code>validation</code> bloki esa biznes qoidasini (ruxsat etilgan qiymatlar, format) plan bosqichida tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variable &quot;env&quot; {<br>  type = string<br>  validation {<br>    condition     = contains([&quot;dev&quot;, &quot;stage&quot;, &quot;prod&quot;], var.env)<br>    error_message = &quot;env dev, stage yoki prod bo'lishi kerak.&quot;<br>  }<br>}<br><br>variable &quot;instance_count&quot; {<br>  type    = number<br>  default = 2<br>  validation {<br>    condition     = var.instance_count &gt;= 1 &amp;&amp; var.instance_count &lt;= 10<br>    error_message = &quot;1 dan 10 gacha.&quot;<br>  }<br>}<br><br>variable &quot;tags&quot; {<br>  type    = map(string)<br>  default = {}<br>}<br><br>variable &quot;db&quot; {<br>  type = object({<br>    engine  = string<br>    size_gb = number<br>    backup  = optional(bool, true)   # ixtiyoriy maydon, default bilan<br>  })<br>}</pre><p>Noto'g'ri qiymat:</p><pre>terraform plan -var env=production<br># Error: Invalid value for variable<br>#   env dev, stage yoki prod bo'lishi kerak.</pre><p><b>Turlar jadvali:</b> | Tur | Misol | |---|---| | <code>list(string)</code> | <code>[&quot;a&quot;, &quot;b&quot;]</code> (tartib bor, takror mumkin) | | <code>set(string)</code> | takrorsiz, <code>for_each</code> uchun | | <code>map(number)</code> | <code>{ a = 1 }</code> | | <code>object({...})</code> | aniq maydonli tuzilma |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>type = any</code> — xatolar plan'dan keyin, noaniq joyda chiqadi.</li><li>Validation'da boshqa variable'ga murojaat — faqat Terraform 1.9+ da ishlaydi.</li><li><code>description</code> yozmaslik — modul foydalanuvchisi nima berishni bilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Aniq turlar va validation — modulning &quot;kontrakti&quot;. Xato apply'da emas, plan'da tushunarli xabar bilan chiqsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W2 Terraform	idrill-34270	<p>Terraform va CloudFormation/Pulumi farqi qisqacha?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Terraform</b> — HCL tilida, ko'p cloud, state'ni o'zingiz boshqarasiz. <b>CloudFormation</b> — faqat AWS, YAML/JSON, state'ni AWS o'zi saqlaydi. <b>Pulumi</b> — ko'p cloud, oddiy dasturlash tillarida (TypeScript, Go, Python) yoziladi.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | Terraform | CloudFormation | Pulumi | |---|---|---|---| | Bulut | ko'p | faqat AWS | ko'p | | Til | HCL | YAML/JSON (CDK: TS/Python) | TS, Go, Python, C# | | State | o'zingiz (S3 va h.k.) | AWS boshqaradi | Pulumi Cloud yoki o'zingiz | | Rollback | yo'q (qayta apply) | avtomatik | yo'q | | Ekotizim | eng katta (modullar) | AWS'ning o'zi | o'sib bormoqda |</p><p><b>Bir xil narsa uch xil:</b></p><pre># Terraform<br>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;logs&quot; { bucket = &quot;acme-logs&quot; }</pre><pre># CloudFormation<br>Resources:<br>  Logs:<br>    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket<br>    Properties: { BucketName: acme-logs }</pre><pre>// Pulumi<br>new aws.s3.Bucket(&quot;logs&quot;, { bucket: &quot;acme-logs&quot; });</pre><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p cloud yoki SaaS provider'lar (GitHub, Datadog) ham kerak — Terraform/OpenTofu.</li><li>Faqat AWS, state boshqarishni istamaysiz — CloudFormation/CDK.</li><li>Jamoa dasturchilardan iborat, test va abstraksiya muhim — Pulumi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Terraform litsenziyasi 1.6+ da BSL — ochiq kod alternativasi OpenTofu.</li><li>CloudFormation'da stack xato holatda qotib qolishi (<code>UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED</code>).</li><li>Bir tashkilotda bir nechta IaC tool — bilim tarqalib ketadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tool tanlovi jamoa ko'nikmasi va ekotizimga bog'liq; eng muhimi — tanlangan tool bilan PR + plan + CI apply jarayonini yo'lga qo'yish.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w2 Terraform
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33188	<p>Ansible nima va Terraform'dan farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ansible — agentsiz configuration management va avtomatlashtirish vositasi: SSH orqali serverlarga ulanib, ular <b>ichini</b> sozlaydi (paket, fayl, servis, user). Terraform esa <b>resurslarni yaratadi</b> (VM, VPC, DB) va state saqlaydi. Odatiy oqim: Terraform VM yaratadi, Ansible uni sozlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Terraform:  kod -&gt; state -&gt; cloud API -&gt; VM, VPC, RDS paydo bo'ladi<br>Ansible:    playbook -&gt; SSH -&gt; VM ichida: apt install, config, systemctl</pre><p>| | Terraform | Ansible | |---|---|---| | Vazifa | resurs yaratish | server ichini sozlash | | Model | declarative + state | task'lar ketma-ketligi (idempotent modullar) | | State | bor | yo'q (har safar real holatni tekshiradi) | | Ulanish | cloud API | SSH / WinRM | | Agent | yo'q | yo'q (faqat Python target'da) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform apply                                   # 3 ta VM<br>ansible-playbook -i inventory/aws_ec2.yml site.yml   # ularni sozlash</pre><pre>- hosts: web<br>  become: true<br>  tasks:<br>    - ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ansible bilan cloud resurs yaratish (<code>amazon.aws.ec2_instance</code>) — mumkin, lekin state yo'q: o'chirish va drift'ni kuzatish qiyin.</li><li>Terraform <code>remote-exec</code> bilan server sozlash — mo'rt; bu Ansible'ning ishi.</li><li>Ikkalasi bir resursni boshqarsa — bir-birini &quot;tuzatadi&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konteyner davrida Ansible'ning roli kichraydi (sozlash image ichida), lekin VM, bare-metal, tarmoq qurilmalari, OS hardening va Kubernetes node'larini tayyorlashda hali keng ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33189	<p>Inventory, playbook, task, module, role nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Inventory</b> — qaysi serverlar (va guruhlar); <b>playbook</b> — YAML fayl, qaysi hostlarda nima qilish; <b>task</b> — bitta qadam; <b>module</b> — task bajaradigan kod birligi (<code>apt</code>, <code>copy</code>, <code>service</code>); <b>role</b> — task, template, handler, default'larni qayta ishlatiladigan paketga yig'ish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>inventory (web1, web2, db1)<br>   |<br>playbook site.yml<br>   +-- play: hosts: web<br>         +-- role: nginx<br>         +-- task: &quot;nginx o'rnatish&quot; -&gt; module: apt<br>         +-- task: &quot;nginx ishlasin&quot;  -&gt; module: service</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># inventory.ini<br>[web]<br>web1 ansible_host=10.0.1.10<br>web2 ansible_host=10.0.1.11<br>[db]<br>db1 ansible_host=10.0.2.10</pre><pre># site.yml<br>- hosts: web<br>  become: true<br>  roles:<br>    - nginx<br>  tasks:<br>    - name: nginx o'rnatish<br>      ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present, update_cache: true }<br>    - name: nginx ishlasin<br>      ansible.builtin.service: { name: nginx, state: started, enabled: true }</pre><pre>ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini site.yml<br>ansible web -i inventory.ini -m ping         # ad-hoc</pre><p>Chiqish oxirida <code>PLAY RECAP</code>: <code>web1 : ok=3 changed=1 failed=0</code> — nechta task o'zgartirdi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qisqa modul nomi (<code>apt</code>) o'rniga FQCN (<code>ansible.builtin.apt</code>) ishlatmaslik — ansible-lint ogohlantiradi, kolleksiyalar to'qnashuvi.</li><li>Task'ga <code>name</code> bermaslik — chiqishni o'qish qiyin.</li><li>Hamma narsani bitta ulkan playbook'ga yozish — role'larga bo'ling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Role — Ansible'dagi asosiy qayta ishlatish va test birligi; uni Molecule bilan test qilib, versiya bilan tarqating.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33190	<p>Idempotentlik Ansible'da nimani anglatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Idempotentlik — playbook'ni necha marta ishga tushirsangiz ham natija bir xil va ikkinchi ishga tushirishda hech narsa o'zgarmaydi (<code>changed=0</code>). Ansible modullari &quot;kerakli holat&quot; ni tekshiradi va faqat farq bo'lsa harakat qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Playbook'ni har kuni yoki har deploy'da xavfsiz qayta ishlatish; drift'ni tuzatish; yarim yo'lda yiqilgan run'ni shunchaki qayta boshlash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>apt: name=nginx state=present<br>  nginx bormi? -- ha --&gt; ok (changed=false)<br>               -- yo'q --&gt; o'rnatish (changed=true)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># idempotent: paket bor bo'lsa &quot;ok&quot;<br>- ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present }<br><br># idempotent EMAS: har safar qator qo'shiladi<br>- ansible.builtin.shell: echo &quot;x&quot; &gt;&gt; /etc/app.conf<br><br># to'g'rilangan<br>- ansible.builtin.lineinfile: { path: /etc/app.conf, line: &quot;x&quot; }<br><br># command'ni idempotent qilish<br>- ansible.builtin.command: /opt/app/init.sh<br>  args: { creates: /opt/app/.initialized }<br><br># faqat o'qiydigan command<br>- ansible.builtin.command: systemctl is-active app<br>  register: st<br>  changed_when: false<br>  failed_when: false</pre><p>Tekshiruv:</p><pre>ansible-playbook site.yml        # 1-marta: changed=5<br>ansible-playbook site.yml        # 2-marta: changed=0 bo'lishi kerak<br>ansible-playbook site.yml --check --diff</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>shell</code>/<code>command</code> default'da har doim <code>changed</code> — <code>creates</code>, <code>removes</code>, <code>changed_when</code> qo'ying.</li><li><code>state: latest</code> — har run'da yangi versiya o'rnatishi mumkin (idempotent, lekin deterministik emas).</li><li>Template ichida vaqt (<code>{{ ansible_date_time }}</code>) — har safar fayl o'zgaradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'da Molecule'ning idempotence bosqichi (ikkinchi converge <code>changed=0</code>) bu xususiyatni avtomatik majburlaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33241	<p><code>--check</code> va <code>--diff</code> nima uchun kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--check</code> — dry run: modullar nima o'zgartirishini aytadi, lekin hech narsa bajarmaydi. <code>--diff</code> — fayl va template'lardagi aniq farqni (eski vs yangi) ko'rsatadi. Birga ishlatiladi: prod'ga apply'dan oldin &quot;nima bo'ladi&quot; ni ko'rish.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ansible-playbook site.yml --check --diff --limit web1<br># TASK [nginx config] ***<br># --- before: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf<br># +++ after: /home/u/.ansible/tmp/.../nginx.conf.j2<br># @@ -3,7 +3,7 @@<br># -    worker_connections 1024;<br># +    worker_connections 4096;<br># changed: [web1]</pre><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>--check:  modul &quot;check mode&quot; ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydimi?<br>            ha  -&gt; holatni tekshiradi, changed/ok aytadi<br>            yo'q (command/shell) -&gt; task o'tkazib yuboriladi (skipped)</pre><p><b>Nozik joylar:</b></p><pre># check rejimida ham bajarilsin (faqat o'qiydigan task)<br>- ansible.builtin.command: cat /etc/app/version<br>  register: ver<br>  check_mode: false<br>  changed_when: false<br><br># secret diff'da chiqmasin<br>- ansible.builtin.template: { src: db.conf.j2, dest: /etc/app/db.conf }<br>  diff: false<br>  no_log: true</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oldingi task check'da bajarilmagan bo'lsa (paket o'rnatilmagan), keyingi task &quot;fayl topilmadi&quot; deb yiqiladi — natija noaniq.</li><li><code>command</code>/<code>shell</code> check'da o'tkazib yuboriladi — &quot;changed=0&quot; yolg'on xotirjamlik beradi.</li><li><code>--diff</code> parol va kalitlarni ekranga (va CI logiga) chiqaradi — <code>no_log</code>/<code>diff: false</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI'da prod'ga <code>--check --diff</code> natijasini PR'ga comment qilish — Terraform plan'ining Ansible ekvivalenti. Uni to'liq kafolat deb emas, review vositasi deb qabul qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33330	<p>Ansible ad-hoc buyruqlar nima va qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ad-hoc buyruq — playbook yozmasdan bitta modulni bir yoki ko'p hostda darhol bajarish (<code>ansible &lt;hostlar&gt; -m &lt;modul&gt; -a &lt;argumentlar&gt;</code>). Tezkor tekshiruv, ma'lumot yig'ish yoki bir martalik ish uchun; takrorlanadigan ish playbook'ga.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ansible web -m ansible.builtin.service -a &quot;name=nginx state=restarted&quot; --become<br>   |      |                   |                         |<br> hostlar  modul           argumentlar                  sudo</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ansible all -i inventory.ini -m ping               # ulanish bormi<br>ansible web -i inventory.ini -a &quot;uptime&quot;           # default modul: command<br>ansible web -a &quot;df -h /&quot; -o                        # bir qatorli chiqish<br>ansible web -m ansible.builtin.apt -a &quot;name=htop state=present&quot; --become<br>ansible db  -m ansible.builtin.service -a &quot;name=postgresql state=restarted&quot; --become<br>ansible web -m ansible.builtin.setup -a &quot;filter=ansible_distribution*&quot;   # facts<br>ansible all -m ping --limit web1<br>ansible web -m shell -a &quot;ss -tlnp | grep 443&quot; --become -f 20     # 20 parallel</pre><p>Chiqish: <code>web1 | CHANGED | rc=0 &gt;&gt;</code> yoki <code>web2 | UNREACHABLE!</code> — qaysi host muammoli darhol ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Qachon:</b> | Ad-hoc | Playbook | |---|---| | &quot;hamma serverda disk qancha?&quot; | doimiy konfiguratsiya | | incident'da servisni restart | deploy | | facts'ni ko'rish | review va tarix kerak bo'lgan ish |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ad-hoc bilan prod konfiguratsiyasini o'zgartirish — Git'da izi yo'q, keyingi playbook run uni qaytaradi.</li><li><code>-a</code> bilan <code>command</code> moduli pipe (<code>|</code>) va <code>&gt;</code> ni tushunmaydi — <code>-m shell</code> kerak.</li><li><code>all</code> ga xavfli buyruq — avval <code>--limit</code> va <code>--check</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Incident paytida ad-hoc qilingan har o'zgarishni keyin playbook'ga ko'chiring, aks holda u keyingi deploy'da jimgina bekor bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33331	<p><code>become</code>, SSH kalitlar va Ansible ulanishi qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ansible SSH bilan ulanadi: <code>ansible_user</code> (qaysi user), <code>ansible_ssh_private_key_file</code> (qaysi kalit), <code>ansible_host</code> (IP). Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33332	<p>Facts nima va <code>when</code> shartlari bilan qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Facts — Ansible play boshida har hostdan avtomatik yig'adigan ma'lumot (OS, versiya, IP, xotira, CPU, disklar). <code>when</code> shartlarida ulardan foydalanib, bitta playbook'ni turli OS va muhitlarga moslashtirasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>play boshlandi -&gt; }<br>      when: st.rc != 0</pre><pre>ansible web1 -m setup -a &quot;filter=ansible_distribution*&quot;</pre><p>Bir nechta shart: <code>when: [a, b]</code> (AND) yoki <code>when: a or b</code>.</p><p><b>Tezlik:</b></p><pre>- hosts: all<br>  gather_facts: false       # facts kerak bo'lmasa</pre><pre># ansible.cfg<br>gathering = smart<br>fact_caching = jsonfile<br>fact_caching_connection = /tmp/ansible_facts<br>fact_caching_timeout = 3600</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>when</code> ichida <code>{{ }}</code> yozish — kerak emas, ogohlantirish beradi.</li><li><code>gather_facts: false</code> dan keyin facts'ga murojaat — undefined xatosi.</li><li>Eski <code>ansible_os_family</code> (injected) va yangi <code>ansible_facts['os_family']</code> aralashtirish — yangisini ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yuzlab hostda facts yig'ish sezilarli vaqt oladi — fact cache yoki <code>gather_subset</code> bilan faqat keraklisini yig'ing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33457	<p><code>loop</code> va <code>with_items</code> farqi? Ansible'da sikl qanday yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>loop</code> — zamonaviy (2.5+) va tavsiya etiladigan sikl sintaksisi; <code>with_items</code> va boshqa <code>with_*</code> — eski lookup-asosli usul (hali ishlaydi, lekin yangi kodda <code>loop</code>). Siklda joriy element <code>{{ item }}</code> orqali olinadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- name: Paketlar<br>  ansible.builtin.apt: { name: &quot;{{ item }}&quot;, state: present }<br>  loop: [nginx, curl, htop]<br><br>- name: Foydalanuvchilar<br>  ansible.builtin.user:<br>    name: &quot;{{ item.name }}&quot;<br>    groups: &quot;{{ item.groups }}&quot;<br>  loop: &quot;{{ users }}&quot;<br>  loop_control:<br>    label: &quot;{{ item.name }}&quot;     # chiqishda faqat nom (secret chiqmasin)<br><br>- name: Map ustida sikl<br>  ansible.builtin.debug: { msg: &quot;{{ item.key }} = {{ item.value }}&quot; }<br>  loop: &quot;{{ ports | dict2items }}&quot;<br><br>- name: Ichma-ich (product)<br>  ansible.builtin.debug: { msg: &quot;{{ item.0 }} -&gt; {{ item.1 }}&quot; }<br>  loop: &quot;{{ envs | product(regions) | list }}&quot;</pre><p>| Eski | Yangi | |---|---| | <code>with_items: [...]</code> | <code>loop: [...]</code> | | <code>with_dict: &quot;{{ d }}&quot;</code> | <code>loop: &quot;{{ d \| dict2items }}&quot;</code> | | <code>with_nested</code> | <code>loop: &quot;{{ a \| product(b) \| list }}&quot;</code> | | <code>with_fileglob</code> | <code>loop: &quot;{{ query('fileglob', '*.conf') }}&quot;</code> |</p><p><b>Tezroq usul:</b> ko'p modul ro'yxatni o'zi qabul qiladi:</p><pre>- ansible.builtin.apt:<br>    name: [nginx, curl, htop]     # bitta apt tranzaksiyasi, siklsiz<br>    state: present</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>with_items</code> ro'yxatni avtomatik &quot;yassilaydi&quot; (flatten), <code>loop</code> — yo'q; ko'chirishda <code>| flatten(1)</code> kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Katta obyektlar siklida chiqish juda uzun va secret'lar ko'rinadi — <code>loop_control.label</code>.</li><li>Ichma-ich role/task siklida <code>item</code> nomi to'qnashadi — <code>loop_var: user</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 100 ta paket uchun sikl = 100 ta modul chaqiruvi; Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33191	<p>Handler nima va qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Handler — faqat boshqa task <b>o'zgarish qilganda</b> (<code>changed</code>) <code>notify</code> orqali chaqiriladigan maxsus task. Odatda servisni restart/reload qilish uchun: config o'zgarmasa, servis ham tegilmaydi. Play oxirida, necha marta notify qilinsa ham, <b>bir marta</b> ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har deploy'da nginx restart — bekorga uzilishlar. Config o'zgargandagina reload kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>task: template nginx.conf  -&gt; changed -&gt; notify &quot;reload nginx&quot;<br>task: template site.conf   -&gt; changed -&gt; notify &quot;reload nginx&quot;<br>task: apt nginx            -&gt; ok<br>play oxiri: handler &quot;reload nginx&quot; (bir marta)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>tasks:<br>  - name: nginx config<br>    ansible.builtin.template:<br>      src: nginx.conf.j2<br>      dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf<br>      validate: nginx -t -c %s        # buzuq config o'rnatilmaydi<br>    notify: reload nginx<br><br>  - name: Handler'larni hozir ishlatish (keyingi task'lar yangi config'ga muhtoj)<br>    ansible.builtin.meta: flush_handlers<br><br>handlers:<br>  - name: reload nginx<br>    ansible.builtin.service: { name: nginx, state: reloaded }<br>    listen: &quot;web config changed&quot;     # bir nechta handler'ni bitta mavzu bilan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Play o'rtasida yiqilsa, handler'lar ishlamaydi — config yangi, servis eski. <code>--force-handlers</code> yoki <code>force_handlers: true</code>.</li><li>Handler nomi notify'dagi bilan aynan mos bo'lishi kerak — imlo xatosi jimgina... aslida xato beradi, lekin role'lar orasida chalkashlik.</li><li><code>restarted</code> o'rniga <code>reloaded</code> mumkin bo'lsa — reload ishlating (ulanishlar uzilmaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>validate:</code> + handler juftligi — &quot;buzuq config prod'ni yiqitmasin&quot; kafolatining asosi. Rolling deploy'da <code>serial</code> bilan birga handler'lar har batch oxirida ishlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33192	<p>Variable'lar, <code>group_vars</code>/<code>host_vars</code> va precedence qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Variable'lar ko'p joyda aniqlanadi (role defaults, inventory, <code>group_vars</code>, <code>host_vars</code>, play, role vars, <code>-e</code>) va Ansible ularni qat'iy precedence bo'yicha birlashtiradi: aniqroq va keyinroq joy g'olib, <code>-e</code> (extra vars) hammasini bosadi. Amaliy qoida: default'lar role'da, muhit farqi <code>group_vars</code>'da, host xususiyati <code>host_vars</code>'da.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>inventory/<br>  hosts.ini<br>  group_vars/<br>    all.yml        # hamma host<br>    web.yml        # web guruhi<br>    prod/          # papka ham bo'lishi mumkin<br>      vars.yml<br>      vault.yml<br>  host_vars/<br>    web1.yml<br>roles/nginx/<br>  defaults/main.yml   # eng past: foydalanuvchi o'zgartirishi uchun<br>  vars/main.yml       # yuqori: ichki konstanta</pre><p><b>Precedence (soddalashtirilgan, pastdan yuqoriga):</b></p><pre>role defaults<br>inventory vars / group_vars/all<br>group_vars/&lt;guruh&gt;<br>host_vars/&lt;host&gt;<br>facts / register<br>play vars, vars_files<br>role vars (vars/main.yml)<br>task vars, include params<br>-e (extra vars)      &lt;- eng ustun</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># roles/nginx/defaults/main.yml<br>nginx_worker_connections: 1024<br># group_vars/web.yml<br>nginx_worker_connections: 4096</pre><pre>ansible-inventory -i inventory --host web1          # host'ning yakuniy o'zgaruvchilari<br>ansible web1 -m debug -a &quot;var=nginx_worker_connections&quot;<br>ansible-playbook site.yml -e nginx_worker_connections=8192   # bir martalik</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sozlanadigan qiymatni role <code>vars/</code> ga qo'yish — <code>group_vars</code> uni bosa olmaydi va &quot;nega o'zgarmayapti?&quot; degan savol.</li><li>Bir host bir necha guruhda va ikkalasida qiymat bor — natija guruhlar alifbo/ierarxiya tartibiga bog'liq.</li><li><code>-e</code> ni doimiy konfiguratsiya uchun ishlatish — Git'da izi yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Precedence'ning 20+ darajasini yodlash shart emas — o'zgaruvchini faqat 1-2 joyda aniqlash qoidasini o'rnating; ko'p joyda aniqlangan o'zgaruvchi — dizayn xatosi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible

Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33244	<p>Dynamic inventory nima? Cloud'da serverlar autoscaling bilan doimiy almashadi va IP o'zgaradi — statik fayl darhol eskiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>static inventory: web1=10.0.1.10, web2=10.0.1.11<br>ASG web1 ni almashtirdi -&gt; yangi IP 10.0.1.37<br>playbook: web1 UNREACHABLE, yangi server umuman sozlanmadi</pre><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ansible-playbook -i aws_ec2.yml<br>   -&gt; plugin: ec2:DescribeInstances (filtr: tag env=prod, running)<br>   -&gt; guruhlar tag'lardan: role_web, role_db<br>   -&gt; ansible_host = private IP</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># inventory/aws_ec2.yml  (fayl nomi *aws_ec2.yml bilan tugashi shart)<br>plugin: amazon.aws.aws_ec2<br>regions: [eu-central-1]<br>filters:<br>  tag:env: prod<br>  instance-state-name: running<br>keyed_groups:<br>  - { key: tags.role, prefix: role }      # role_web, role_db<br>hostnames: [private-ip-address]<br>compose:<br>  ansible_host: private_ip_address<br>cache: true<br>cache_timeout: 300</pre><pre>ansible-galaxy collection install amazon.aws<br>ansible-inventory -i inventory/aws_ec2.yml --graph<br># @all:<br>#   |--@role_web:<br>#   |  |--10.0.1.37<br>ansible-playbook -i inventory/aws_ec2.yml site.yml --limit role_web</pre><p>IAM: Ansible ishlaydigan rolga <code>ec2:DescribeInstances</code> (va kerak bo'lsa <code>ec2:DescribeTags</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tag'lar izchil emas (<code>Role</code> vs <code>role</code>) — host hech qaysi guruhga tushmaydi va jimgina sozlanmaydi.</li><li>Public IP bilan ulanish — bastion/SSM yoki private IP ishlating.</li><li>Cache'siz katta akkauntda har run'da sekin API chaqiruvlar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Dynamic inventory'da tag'lar &quot;haqiqat manbai&quot; bo'ladi — ularni Terraform'da majburiy qiling (<code>default_tags</code>, validation). Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33333	<p>Role tuzilmasi va Ansible kodini qanday test qilasiz (ansible-lint, Molecule)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Role — standart papka tuzilmali qayta ishlatiladigan birlik (<code>tasks</code>, <code>handlers</code>, <code>templates</code>, <code>defaults</code>, <code>vars</code>, <code>meta</code>). Test qatlamlari: <code>--syntax-check</code> va <code>ansible-lint</code> (statik), <code>--check --diff</code> (dry run), <b>Molecule</b> (role'ni konteyner/VM'da haqiqatan ishga tushirib, idempotentlik va natijani tekshirish).</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>roles/nginx/<br>  defaults/main.yml    # sozlanadigan default'lar<br>  vars/main.yml        # ichki konstantalar<br>  tasks/main.yml<br>  handlers/main.yml<br>  templates/nginx.conf.j2<br>  files/<br>  meta/main.yml        # dependency, platformalar<br>  molecule/default/    # testlar</pre><p><b>Molecule oqimi:</b></p><pre>create (docker/podman) -&gt; converge (role'ni qo'llash) -&gt; idempotence (yana qo'llash: changed=0?)<br>   -&gt; verify (testinfra / ansible assert) -&gt; destroy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ansible-galaxy role init roles/nginx<br>ansible-playbook site.yml --syntax-check<br>ansible-lint                                   # FQCN, no-changed-when, yaml xatolari<br>ansible-playbook site.yml --check --diff --limit staging<br>cd roles/nginx &amp;&amp; molecule init scenario &amp;&amp; molecule test</pre><pre># molecule/default/verify.yml<br>- hosts: all<br>  tasks:<br>    - ansible.builtin.uri: { url: http://localhost, status_code: 200 }<br>    - ansible.builtin.command: nginx -t<br>      changed_when: false</pre><pre># requirements.yml<br>collections:<br>  - { name: community.general, version: &quot;9.5.0&quot; }<br>roles:<br>  - { src: geerlingguy.docker, version: &quot;7.4.1&quot; }</pre><pre>ansible-galaxy install -r requirements.yml</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konteynerda systemd yo'q — servis task'lari Molecule'da yiqiladi; systemd'li image yoki VM driver.</li><li>Kolleksiya versiyasini pin qilmaslik — CI bir kun to'satdan buziladi.</li><li>Faqat lint — role haqiqatan ishlashini kafolatlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Minimal CI: lint + Molecule (idempotence bilan) har PR'da, staging'ga <code>--check --diff</code>. Bu Ansible kodini &quot;skriptlar to'plami&quot; dan dasturiy mahsulot darajasiga ko'taradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33409	<p><code>delegate_to</code>, <code>run_once</code> va <code>local_action</code> qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>delegate_to</code> — task'ni joriy host <b>nomidan</b>, lekin boshqa hostda bajarish (masalan, LB'da serverni o'chirish); <code>run_once</code> — task'ni guruh bo'yicha faqat bir marta bajarish (DB migratsiya); <code>local_action</code> / <code>delegate_to: localhost</code> — task'ni control node'da bajarish (API chaqiruv, Slack xabari).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (rolling deploy):</b></p><pre>for host in web (serial: 1):<br>  lb1: disable web1        &lt;- delegate_to: lb1<br>  web1: deploy, restart<br>  lb1: enable web1<br>bir marta: DB migration    &lt;- run_once<br>localhost: Slack &quot;deployed&quot; &lt;- delegate_to: localhost</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- hosts: web<br>  serial: 1<br>  tasks:<br>    - name: LB'dan chiqarish<br>      community.general.haproxy:<br>        state: disabled<br>        host: &quot;{{ inventory_hostname }}&quot;<br>        backend: app<br>      delegate_to: lb1<br><br>    - name: DB migration (bir marta)<br>      ansible.builtin.command: /opt/app/bin/migrate<br>      run_once: true<br><br>    - name: Slack'ga xabar<br>      ansible.builtin.uri:<br>        url: &quot;{{ slack_hook }}&quot;<br>        method: POST<br>        body_format: json<br>        body: { text: &quot;deploy {{ inventory_hostname }}&quot; }<br>      delegate_to: localhost<br>      become: false<br><br>    - name: LB'ga qaytarish<br>      community.general.haproxy: { state: enabled, host: &quot;{{ inventory_hostname }}&quot;, backend: app }<br>      delegate_to: lb1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>run_once</code> + <code>serial</code> — har batch'da bir marta ishlaydi, butun play'da emas. Migratsiyani alohida play'ga chiqaring.</li><li><code>delegate_to</code> da o'zgaruvchilar (<code>ansible_host</code>, facts) <b>asl</b> hostniki bo'ladi — chalkashlik; <code>delegate_facts: true</code> kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li><code>delegate_to: localhost</code> + <code>become: true</code> — laptopingizda sudo so'raladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rolling deploy'ning to'g'ri tartibi: drain (delegate) -&gt; deploy -&gt; health check -&gt; enable (delegate), <code>max_fail_percentage</code> bilan. Migratsiyalar backward-compatible bo'lishi kerak — eski va yangi kod bir vaqtda ishlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33441	<p>Ansible'da xatolarni boshqarish: <code>block</code>/<code>rescue</code>/<code>always</code>, <code>ignore_errors</code>, <code>failed_when</code>?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>block</code>/<code>rescue</code>/<code>always</code> — try/catch/finally: <code>block</code> dagi task yiqilsa <code>rescue</code> ishlaydi (masalan, rollback), <code>always</code> har doim (tozalash). <code>ignore_errors</code> — xatoni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi (kam ishlating); <code>failed_when</code>/<code>changed_when</code> — modulning muvaffaqiyat/o'zgarish mezonini o'zingiz belgilaysiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>block:  unarchive -&gt; restart -&gt; health check<br>           | xato<br>           v<br>rescue: symlink'ni prev'ga -&gt; restart -&gt; fail (play qizil bo'lsin)<br>always: tmp faylni o'chirish (har holda)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- block:<br>    - name: Yangi versiyani o'rnatish<br>      ansible.builtin.unarchive: { src: &quot;app-{{ ver }}.tgz&quot;, dest: &quot;/opt/app/releases/{{ ver }}&quot;, remote_src: true }<br>    - ansible.builtin.file: { src: &quot;/opt/app/releases/{{ ver }}&quot;, dest: /opt/app/current, state: link }<br>    - ansible.builtin.systemd: { name: app, state: restarted }<br>    - ansible.builtin.uri: { url: http://localhost:8080/health }<br>      register: h<br>      until: h.status == 200<br>      retries: 5<br>      delay: 3<br>  rescue:<br>    - name: Oldingi versiyaga qaytish<br>      ansible.builtin.file: { src: /opt/app/releases/prev, dest: /opt/app/current, state: link }<br>    - ansible.builtin.systemd: { name: app, state: restarted }<br>    - ansible.builtin.fail: { msg: &quot;Deploy fail, rollback qilindi: {{ ansible_failed_result.msg | default('') }}&quot; }<br>  always:<br>    - ansible.builtin.file: { path: /tmp/app.tgz, state: absent }<br><br>- name: grep &quot;topilmadi&quot; xato emas<br>  ansible.builtin.command: grep -q feature_x /etc/app.conf<br>  register: g<br>  failed_when: g.rc not in [0, 1]<br>  changed_when: false</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>rescue</code> ichida <code>fail</code> bo'lmasa — play &quot;muvaffaqiyatli&quot; tugaydi, CI yashil, lekin deploy aslida yiqilgan.</li><li><code>ignore_errors: true</code> — xatoni yashiradi, keyingi task'lar buzuq holat ustida ishlaydi.</li><li><code>rescue</code> faqat task xatolarini ushlaydi — host unreachable yoki sintaksis xatolarini emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rollback mantiqi <code>rescue</code> da bo'lsa ham, haqiqiy xavfsizlik — <code>serial</code> + <code>max_fail_percentage</code>: birinchi batch yiqilsa, qolgan serverlarga umuman tegilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33442	<p><code>tags</code>, <code>--start-at-task</code>, <code>--limit</code> bilan playbook'ning bir qismini qanday ishga tushirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--limit</code> — qaysi <b>hostlar</b>da ishlashni cheklaydi; <code>--tags</code>/<code>--skip-tags</code> — qaysi <b>task</b>lar ishlashini tanlaydi; <code>--start-at-task</code> — playbook'ni ma'lum task'dan boshlaydi (yiqilgan joydan davom ettirish). Birga ular katta playbook'ning kichik qismini xavfsiz ishlatish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- name: nginx config<br>  ansible.builtin.template: { src: nginx.conf.j2, dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf }<br>  notify: reload nginx<br>  tags: [nginx, config]<br><br>- name: facts kerak<br>  ansible.builtin.setup:<br>  tags: [always]        # har doim ishlaydi<br><br>- name: DB'ni tozalash<br>  ansible.builtin.command: /opt/app/bin/wipe<br>  tags: [never, wipe]   # faqat --tags wipe bilan</pre><pre>ansible-playbook site.yml --list-tasks --tags nginx     # avval nima ishlashini ko'ring<br>ansible-playbook site.yml --list-hosts --limit 'web:&amp;prod'<br>ansible-playbook site.yml --tags config --limit web1 --check --diff<br>ansible-playbook site.yml --skip-tags slow<br>ansible-playbook site.yml --start-at-task &quot;nginx config&quot;<br>ansible-playbook site.yml --limit @site.retry          # yiqilgan hostlar (retry_files_enabled bo'lsa)</pre><p>Limit naqshlari: <code>web1,web2</code>, <code>web:!web3</code> (istisno), <code>web:&amp;prod</code> (kesishma), <code>'web[0:4]'</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tag bilan ishlaganda o'tkazib yuborilgan task'dagi <code>register</code> yoki <code>set_fact</code> qiymati yo'q — keyingi task undefined xatosi bilan yiqiladi.</li><li><code>import_tasks</code> ga tag ichidagi hamma task'ga tarqaladi, <code>include_tasks</code> ga tag faqat include'ning o'ziga — ichidagi task'lar ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>--start-at-task</code> dan oldingi task'lar o'rnatgan o'zgaruvchilar yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da avval <code>--list-tasks</code>/<code>--list-hosts</code> bilan qamrovni tasdiqlash odati — &quot;faqat bitta serverda deb o'ylagan edim&quot; turidagi incidentlarni oldini oladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33443	<p>Uzoq ishlaydigan task (backup, katta yuklash) SSH timeout'ga tushyapti. <code>async</code> va <code>poll</code> qanday yordam beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>async: N</code> — task'ni hostda fon jarayon sifatida ishga tushiradi va maksimal N soniya yashashiga ruxsat beradi; <code>poll: 0</code> — Ansible kutmaydi, keyingi task'larga o'tadi (&quot;fire and forget&quot;); keyin <code>async_status</code> bilan natija tekshiriladi. SSH ulanishi butun vaqt ochiq turmaydi — timeout muammosi yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>command: backup.sh (40 daqiqa)<br>SSH sessiya -&gt; NAT/firewall idle timeout (15 daq) -&gt; uzildi -&gt; task &quot;failed&quot;, backup holati noma'lum</pre><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>poll: 0   -&gt; hostda fon jarayon (job id) -&gt; Ansible darhol davom etadi<br>...boshqa task'lar...<br>async_status (jid) -&gt; har 30s qisqa SSH tekshiruv -&gt; finished?</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- name: Katta backup<br>  ansible.builtin.command: /usr/local/bin/backup.sh<br>  async: 3600        # 1 soatgacha ishlashga ruxsat<br>  poll: 0            # kutmaydi<br>  register: job<br><br>- name: Boshqa ishlar parallel<br>  ansible.builtin.debug: { msg: &quot;parallel&quot; }<br><br>- name: Backup tugashini kutish<br>  ansible.builtin.async_status: { jid: &quot;{{ job.ansible_job_id }}&quot; }<br>  register: r<br>  until: r.finished<br>  retries: 120<br>  delay: 30</pre><p>Oddiy variant — <code>poll: 30</code>: Ansible kutadi, lekin har 30 soniyada yangi qisqa ulanish bilan tekshiradi.</p><p>| Rejim | Xatti-harakat | |---|---| | <code>async</code> yo'q | SSH butun vaqt ochiq | | <code>async: 3600, poll: 30</code> | kutadi, qisqa so'rovlar bilan | | <code>async: 3600, poll: 0</code> | kutmaydi, keyin <code>async_status</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>async</code> vaqti tugasa jarayon o'ldiriladi — zaxira bilan qo'ying.</li><li><code>poll: 0</code> va <code>async_status</code> siz — natija hech qachon tekshirilmaydi, xato yashirinadi.</li><li><code>async</code> ni <code>become</code> bilan ishlatganda <code>async_status</code> ham bir xil <code>become</code> bilan bo'lishi kerak (job fayli boshqa user'da).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>poll: 0</code> ko'p hostda uzoq ishni parallel boshlash uchun ham kuchli. Lekin juda uzoq ishlar (backup) uchun Ansible'dan ko'ra systemd timer/cron yoki job scheduler to'g'riroq joy bo'lishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33458	<p><code>import_tasks</code> va <code>include_tasks</code> farqi (statik vs dinamik)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>import_tasks</code> — <b>statik</b>: playbook o'qilayotganda (parse) faylni joyiga qo'yadi; <code>include_tasks</code> — <b>dinamik</b>: task bajarilayotgan paytda (runtime) faylni yuklaydi. Shuning uchun <code>loop</code> va o'zgaruvchili fayl nomi faqat <code>include</code> bilan ishlaydi, <code>--list-tasks</code> va tag'larning tarqalishi esa <code>import</code> da yaxshi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>import_tasks: install.yml  -&gt; parse paytida ichidagi task'lar playbook'ga &quot;ko'chiriladi&quot;<br>                              tag/when har bir ichki task'ga qo'llanadi<br>include_tasks: x.yml       -&gt; run paytida, shu task navbati kelganda yuklanadi<br>                              tag/when include'ning o'ziga qo'llanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- ansible.builtin.import_tasks: install.yml          # statik<br>  tags: install                                      # ichidagi hamma task'ga<br><br>- ansible.builtin.include_tasks: &quot;{{ ansible_facts['os_family'] | lower }}.yml&quot;   # debian.yml / redhat.yml<br><br>- ansible.builtin.include_tasks: user.yml<br>  loop: &quot;{{ users }}&quot;<br>  loop_control: { loop_var: u }                      # faqat include bilan<br><br>- ansible.builtin.include_tasks:<br>    file: config.yml<br>    apply:<br>      tags: [config]                                 # include ichidagilarga tag<br>  tags: [config]</pre><p>| | import | include | |---|---|---| | Qachon | parse vaqtida | run vaqtida | | <code>loop</code> | yo'q | bor | | <code>--list-tasks</code> da ko'rinadi | ha | yo'q | | O'zgaruvchili fayl nomi | cheklangan | ha | | Tag/when | ichki task'larga | include'ning o'ziga |</p><p>Role'lar uchun ham xuddi shu: <code>import_role</code> vs <code>include_role</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>include_tasks</code> ga <code>--tags config</code> — include o'zi tag'siz bo'lsa ichidagi task'lar umuman ishlamaydi; <code>apply: tags</code> kerak.</li><li><code>import_tasks</code> + <code>when</code> — shart har ichki task'da qayta baholanadi; birinchi task shart o'zgaruvchisini o'zgartirsa, qolganlari skip bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Handler'ni <code>include</code> qilingan task orqali notify qilish nozik — handler nomlari oldindan ma'lum bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default'da <code>import</code> (oldindan ma'lum, ko'rinadigan, tag'lar oson); faqat sikl yoki runtime'ga bog'liq fayl kerak bo'lsa <code>include</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33459	<p><code>strategy: linear</code> va <code>free</code>, <code>forks</code> nima? Ansible'ni qanday tezlashtirasiz?</p>	<pre># ansible.cfg<br>[defaults]<br>forks = 50<br>gathering = smart<br>fact_caching = jsonfile<br>fact_caching_connection = /tmp/facts<br>[ssh_connection]<br>pipelining = True<br>ssh_args = -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPersist=60s</pre><pre>- hosts: all<br>  strategy: free<br>  gather_facts: false</pre><p>| Usul | Ta'sir | |---|---| | <code>forks</code> | Parallel hostlar | | <code>pipelining</code> | Har task uchun kamroq SSH amali (sudoers'da <code>requiretty</code> o'chiq bo'lsin) | | ControlPersist | SSH ulanishni qayta ishlatish | | <code>gather_facts: false</code> / cache | Har play boshida setup yo'q | | <code>strategy: free</code> | Sekin host boshqalarni ushlab turmaydi |</p><p><code>free</code> bilan output aralash va rolling deploy tartibi kafolatlanmaydi — deploy uchun <code>linear</code> + <code>serial</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33460	<p>Push va pull rejim: <code>ansible-pull</code> qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Push</b> (odatiy) — control node SSH bilan serverlarga ulanib, playbook'ni &quot;itaradi&quot;. <b>Pull</b> (<code>ansible-pull</code>) — har server o'zi Git repo'dan playbook'ni tortib, o'ziga lokal qo'llaydi (cron/systemd timer orqali). Pull — markaziy SSH kirish bo'lmagan, autoscaling yoki juda katta flot uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Push:  control node --SSH--&gt; web1, web2, ... webN   (forks bilan cheklangan)<br>Pull:  web1: timer -&gt; git pull infra.git -&gt; ansible-playbook local.yml (localhost)<br>       web2: ... (har biri mustaqil)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ansible-pull -U https://git.example.com/infra.git -C main -i localhost, local.yml</pre><pre># /etc/systemd/system/ansible-pull.timer (cron muqobili)<br>[Timer]<br>OnBootSec=2min<br>OnUnitActiveSec=30min<br>RandomizedDelaySec=5min</pre><pre># cron: faqat repo o'zgarsa (-o)<br>*/30 * * * * ansible-pull -U https://git.example.com/infra.git -o local.yml &gt;&gt; /var/log/ansible-pull.log 2&gt;&amp;1</pre><p>Cloud-init (user-data) bilan birinchi boot'da:</p><pre>#cloud-config<br>packages: [ansible, git]<br>runcmd:<br>  - ansible-pull -U https://git.example.com/infra.git -C main local.yml</pre><p>| | Push | Pull | |---|---|---| | Boshqaruv | markaziy, darhol | har host o'zi, jadval bo'yicha | | Masshtab | forks bilan cheklangan | yaxshi | | SSH kirish | kerak | kerak emas | | Natijani ko'rish | bir joyda | har host logida — markaziy yig'ish kerak |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har serverda Git credential va Ansible o'rnatilgan bo'lishi kerak — supply chain va secret masalasi.</li><li>Hamma serverlar bir vaqtda pull qilsa — Git server'ga yuk; tasodifiy kechikish qo'shing.</li><li>Xato bo'lsa hech kim bilmaydi — loglarni markaziy tizimga yuboring va alert qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Autoscaling uchun eng ishonchli yo'l — oldindan &quot;pishirilgan&quot; image (Packer + Ansible), boot'da faqat minimal sozlash. <code>ansible-pull</code> — image va doimiy konfiguratsiya o'rtasidagi kompromiss.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-33195	<p>Ansible'ni katta flot (yuzlab server) uchun qanday tezlashtirasiz va xavfsiz rollout qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tezlik uchun: <code>forks</code> ni oshirish, SSH <code>pipelining</code> va <code>ControlPersist</code>, fact caching, keraksiz facts'ni o'chirish, kerak bo'lsa <code>strategy: free</code>. Xavfsiz rollout uchun: <code>serial</code> bilan bosqichma-bosqich (canary -&gt; 10% -&gt; 25%), <code>max_fail_percentage</code>, LB'dan drain, har batch'dan keyin health check.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>500 host, serial: [&quot;1&quot;, &quot;10%&quot;, &quot;25%&quot;]<br>batch 1:  1 host  (canary) -&gt; health OK?<br>batch 2:  50 host          -&gt; xatolar &gt; 5%? -&gt; STOP, qolganlarga tegilmaydi<br>batch 3+: 125 tadan ...</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># ansible.cfg<br>[defaults]<br>forks = 50<br>gathering = smart<br>fact_caching = jsonfile<br>fact_caching_connection = /tmp/facts<br>fact_caching_timeout = 7200<br>callbacks_enabled = profile_tasks      # qaysi task sekin<br>[ssh_connection]<br>pipelining = True<br>ssh_args = -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPersist=60s</pre><pre>- hosts: web<br>  serial: [&quot;1&quot;, &quot;10%&quot;, &quot;25%&quot;]<br>  max_fail_percentage: 5<br>  pre_tasks:<br>    - name: LB'dan chiqarish<br>      community.general.haproxy: { state: disabled, host: &quot;{{ inventory_hostname }}&quot;, backend: app }<br>      delegate_to: lb1<br>  roles: [app]<br>  post_tasks:<br>    - ansible.builtin.uri:<br>        url: &quot;http://{{ inventory_hostname }}/healthz&quot;<br>        status_code: 200<br>      register: h<br>      until: h.status == 200<br>      retries: 10<br>      delay: 3<br>    - community.general.haproxy: { state: enabled, host: &quot;{{ inventory_hostname }}&quot;, backend: app }<br>      delegate_to: lb1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>forks</code> juda katta — control node CPU/xotirasi va bastion SSH limiti (<code>MaxStartups</code>) tugaydi.</li><li><code>pipelining</code> sudoers'da <code>requiretty</code> bo'lsa ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>serial</code> siz katta deploy — xato hamma serverga bir vaqtda tarqaladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Masshtabda asosiy savol — &quot;bu ishni deploy paytida qilish kerakmi?&quot;. Image'ga pishirish va immutable infratuzilma Ansible run vaqtini va xavfini tubdan kamaytiradi; Ansible esa qolgan farqni boshqaradi. <code>profile_tasks</code> bilan avval o'lchang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34271	<p>Oddiy Ansible playbook misoli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Playbook — YAML fayl: qaysi hostlar (<code>hosts</code>), qaysi huquq bilan (<code>become</code>), qanday task'lar ketma-ketligi. Har task bitta modulni chaqiradi va &quot;kerakli holat&quot; ni tasvirlaydi (masalan, nginx o'rnatilgan va ishlab turgan bo'lsin).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># site.yml<br>- name: Web serverlarni sozlash<br>  hosts: web<br>  become: true                 # sudo bilan<br>  tasks:<br>    - name: nginx o'rnatish<br>      ansible.builtin.apt:<br>        name: nginx<br>        state: present<br>        update_cache: true<br><br>    - name: Bosh sahifa<br>      ansible.builtin.copy:<br>        content: &quot;Salom, {{ inventory_hostname }}\n&quot;<br>        dest: /var/www/html/index.html<br>        mode: &quot;0644&quot;<br><br>    - name: nginx ishga tushsin va boot'da yoqilsin<br>      ansible.builtin.service:<br>        name: nginx<br>        state: started<br>        enabled: true</pre><pre>ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini site.yml --syntax-check<br>ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini site.yml --check      # sinov<br>ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini site.yml</pre><p>Chiqishni o'qish:</p><pre>TASK [nginx o'rnatish] ******<br>changed: [web1]          &lt;- o'zgartirdi<br>ok: [web2]               &lt;- allaqachon shunday edi<br>PLAY RECAP<br>web1 : ok=4 changed=3 unreachable=0 failed=0</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>YAML chekinishi (indentation) xatosi — eng ko'p uchraydigan muammo; <code>--syntax-check</code> va editor plaginini ishlating.</li><li><code>become: true</code> ni unutish — &quot;Permission denied&quot;.</li><li><code>mode: 644</code> (qo'shtirnoqsiz) — sakkizlik emas, o'nlik son deb tushuniladi; <code>&quot;0644&quot;</code> yozing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ikkinchi marta ishga tushirganda <code>changed=0</code> bo'lishi kerak — bu playbook to'g'ri (idempotent) yozilganining belgisi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34272	<p>Inventory fayl qanday yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Inventory — Ansible boshqaradigan serverlar ro'yxati va ularning guruhlari. INI yoki YAML formatda yoziladi; har hostga ulanish o'zgaruvchilari (<code>ansible_host</code>, <code>ansible_user</code>) beriladi, guruhlarga esa umumiy o'zgaruvchilar.</p><p><b>Amalda (INI):</b></p><pre>[web]<br>web1 ansible_host=10.0.0.11<br>web2 ansible_host=10.0.0.12<br><br>[db]<br>db1 ansible_host=10.0.0.21<br><br>[prod:children]        # guruhlar guruhi<br>web<br>db<br><br>[all:vars]<br>ansible_user=deploy<br>ansible_ssh_private_key_file=~/.ssh/deploy_ed25519</pre><p>YAML ekvivalenti:</p><pre>all:<br>  vars:<br>    ansible_user: deploy<br>  children:<br>    web:<br>      hosts:<br>        web1: { ansible_host: 10.0.0.11 }<br>        web2: { ansible_host: 10.0.0.12 }<br>    db:<br>      hosts:<br>        db1: { ansible_host: 10.0.0.21 }</pre><pre>ansible-inventory -i inventory.ini --graph<br># @all:<br>#   |--@prod:<br>#   |  |--@web:<br>#   |  |  |--web1<br>#   |  |  |--web2<br>#   |  |--@db:<br>#   |  |  |--db1<br>ansible-inventory -i inventory.ini --host web1    # host o'zgaruvchilari<br>ansible web -i inventory.ini -m ping</pre><p>Diapazon: <code>web[01:20].example.com</code> — 20 ta host bir qatorda.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p o'zgaruvchini inventory qatoriga yozish — o'qib bo'lmaydi; <code>group_vars/</code> va <code>host_vars/</code> papkalariga chiqaring.</li><li>Cloud'da statik IP'lar tez eskiradi — dynamic inventory (aws_ec2 plugin).</li><li><code>ansible.cfg</code> da <code>inventory</code> ko'rsatilmasa, har safar <code>-i</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Inventory — &quot;qayerda&quot; savoli; o'zgaruvchilar <code>group_vars</code> da, mantiq playbook/role'da. Bu uchtasini aralashtirmaslik katta loyihani tartibli saqlaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34273	<p>Handler nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Handler — oddiy task kabi, lekin u faqat boshqa task <b>o'zgarish qilganda</b> (<code>changed</code>) va <code>notify</code> bilan chaqirilganda ishlaydi. Odatda servisni restart/reload qilish uchun. Play oxirida, necha marta chaqirilsa ham, faqat <b>bir marta</b> bajariladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Config o'zgarmagan bo'lsa nginx'ni restart qilish keraksiz uzilish. Handler &quot;faqat kerak bo'lganda restart&quot; ni ta'minlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>template nginx.conf -&gt; changed -&gt; notify: reload nginx<br>template site.conf  -&gt; ok      -&gt; (notify yo'q)<br>play oxiri          -&gt; handler &quot;reload nginx&quot; bir marta<br>config o'zgarmasa   -&gt; handler umuman ishlamaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- hosts: web<br>  become: true<br>  tasks:<br>    - name: nginx config<br>      ansible.builtin.template:<br>        src: nginx.conf.j2<br>        dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf<br>        validate: nginx -t -c %s      # xato config o'rnatilmaydi<br>      notify: reload nginx<br><br>  handlers:<br>    - name: reload nginx<br>      ansible.builtin.service:<br>        name: nginx<br>        state: reloaded</pre><p>Handler'ni darhol (play oxirini kutmay) ishlatish:</p><pre>- ansible.builtin.meta: flush_handlers</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Play o'rtasida xato bo'lsa handler'lar ishlamaydi — config yangi, servis eski holatda qoladi (<code>--force-handlers</code>).</li><li><code>notify</code> dagi nom handler nomi bilan aynan bir xil bo'lishi kerak.</li><li><code>restarted</code> o'rniga <code>reloaded</code> yetarli bo'lsa — reload ishlating, ulanishlar uzilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>validate</code> + handler juftligi buzuq config'ning servisni yiqitishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34274	<p>Ansible'da variable'lar qayerda yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Variable'lar bir necha joyda yoziladi: role <code>defaults/</code> (default qiymatlar), inventory'dagi <code>group_vars/</code> (guruh uchun) va <code>host_vars/</code> (bitta host uchun), playbook <code>vars:</code>, va buyruq qatorida <code>-e</code>. Bir xil nom bir necha joyda bo'lsa, aniqroq joy yutadi: <code>-e</code> eng kuchli, role <code>defaults</code> eng kuchsiz.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>inventory/<br>  hosts.ini<br>  group_vars/<br>    all.yml          # hamma serverlar<br>    web.yml          # web guruhi<br>  host_vars/<br>    web1.yml         # faqat web1<br>roles/nginx/defaults/main.yml</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># roles/nginx/defaults/main.yml<br>http_port: 80<br># group_vars/web.yml<br>http_port: 8080<br># host_vars/web1.yml<br>http_port: 9090</pre><p>Natija: web1 -&gt; 9090, web2 -&gt; 8080, web guruhidan tashqari -&gt; 80.</p><pre>ansible -i inventory -m debug -a 'var=http_port' web1<br># web1 | SUCCESS =&gt; { &quot;http_port&quot;: 9090 }<br>ansible -m debug -a 'var=hostvars[inventory_hostname]' web1   # hammasi<br>ansible-playbook site.yml -e http_port=7070                    # hammasini bosadi</pre><p><b>Ustunlik (soddalashtirilgan, pastdan yuqoriga):</b></p><pre>role defaults &lt; group_vars/all &lt; group_vars/&lt;guruh&gt; &lt; host_vars &lt; play vars &lt; role vars &lt; -e</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir o'zgaruvchini 4-5 joyda aniqlash — &quot;qaysi qiymat ishladi?&quot; ni topish qiyin.</li><li>Role <code>vars/main.yml</code> ga sozlanadigan qiymat qo'yish — <code>group_vars</code> uni o'zgartira olmaydi.</li><li>Secret'larni oddiy <code>group_vars</code> ga yozish — Ansible Vault ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: default'lar role'da, muhitlar orasidagi farq <code>group_vars</code> da, <code>-e</code> faqat bir martalik holatlar uchun.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34275	<p>Ansible Vault nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ansible Vault — parol, API kalit kabi secret'larni AES-256 bilan shifrlab, ularni Git'da xavfsiz saqlash imkonini beruvchi o'rnatilgan vosita. Playbook ishga tushganda vault paroli bilan fayl avtomatik ochiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>group_vars/prod.yml</code> da DB paroli ochiq turibdi va Git'ga commit qilingan — repo'ga kirgan har kim uni ko'radi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>vault.yml (ochiq) --ansible-vault encrypt--&gt; $ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.1;AES256 ...
