Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34276	<p><code>template</code> moduli va Jinja2?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>template</code> moduli Jinja2 shablonidan (<code>.j2</code> fayl) har bir server uchun o'zgaruvchilar qo'yilgan haqiqiy config fayl yaratadi va uni serverga yozadi. <code>{{ o'zgaruvchi }}</code> qiymat qo'yadi, <code>{% for %}</code>/<code>{% if %}</code> sikl va shart beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>nginx.conf.j2 + o'zgaruvchilar (http_port=8080, inventory_hostname=web1)<br>       | render<br>       v<br>web1:/etc/nginx/conf.d/app.conf:  listen 8080; server_name web1;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{# templates/nginx.conf.j2 #}<br># {{ ansible_managed }}<br>server {<br>  listen {{ http_port | default(80) }};<br>  server_name {{ inventory_hostname }};<br><br>{% for loc in locations %}<br>  location {{ loc.path }} {<br>    proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:{{ loc.port }};<br>  }<br>{% endfor %}<br><br>{% if enable_gzip %}<br>  gzip on;<br>{% endif %}<br>}</pre><pre>- name: nginx site config<br>  ansible.builtin.template:<br>    src: nginx.conf.j2<br>    dest: /etc/nginx/conf.d/app.conf<br>    mode: &quot;0644&quot;<br>  notify: reload nginx</pre><pre># group_vars/web.yml<br>http_port: 8080<br>enable_gzip: true<br>locations:<br>  - { path: /api, port: 3000 }</pre><p>| Modul | Qachon | |---|---| | <code>copy</code> | statik fayl, o'zgarishsiz | | <code>template</code> | o'zgaruvchili, hostga moslashgan fayl |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>O'zgaruvchi aniqlanmagan — &quot;undefined variable&quot; xatosi; <code>| default(...)</code> ishlating.</li><li>Template'da vaqt yoki tasodifiy qiymat — har run'da fayl &quot;o'zgaradi&quot; va servis bekorga reload bo'ladi.</li><li>Murakkab mantiqni template ichiga yozish — o'qish qiyin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>{{ ansible_managed }}</code> sarlavhasi serverda faylni qo'lda tahrirlamaslik kerakligini eslatadi — keyingi run baribir qayta yozadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34277	<p><code>copy</code>, <code>template</code>, <code>file</code>, <code>lineinfile</code> modullari farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>copy</code> — faylni o'zgarishsiz serverga ko'chiradi; <code>template</code> — Jinja2 shablonidan o'zgaruvchilar bilan fayl yaratadi; <code>file</code> — fayl/papka/symlink'ning holatini (mavjudlik, egasi, ruxsat) boshqaradi, mazmuniga tegmaydi; <code>lineinfile</code> — mavjud fayldagi <b>bitta qatorni</b> qo'shadi yoki almashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b> | Modul | Vazifa | Misol | |---|---|---| | <code>copy</code> | statik fayl | SSL sertifikat, skript | | <code>template</code> | o'zgaruvchili fayl | nginx.conf.j2 | | <code>file</code> | papka, ruxsat, symlink, o'chirish | <code>/opt/app</code> yaratish | | <code>lineinfile</code> | bitta qator | <code>PermitRootLogin no</code> | | <code>blockinfile</code> | bir nechta qatorli blok | <code>/etc/hosts</code> ga blok |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- name: Papka<br>  ansible.builtin.file: { path: /opt/app, state: directory, owner: app, group: app, mode: &quot;0755&quot; }<br><br>- name: Symlink<br>  ansible.builtin.file: { src: /opt/app/releases/1.2, dest: /opt/app/current, state: link }<br><br>- name: Faylni o'chirish<br>  ansible.builtin.file: { path: /tmp/old.log, state: absent }<br><br>- name: Statik skript<br>  ansible.builtin.copy: { src: files/backup.sh, dest: /usr/local/bin/backup.sh, mode: &quot;0755&quot; }<br><br>- name: Config shablondan<br>  ansible.builtin.template: { src: app.conf.j2, dest: /etc/app/app.conf }<br><br>- name: SSH root kirishni o'chirish<br>  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:<br>    path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config<br>    regexp: '^#?PermitRootLogin'<br>    line: 'PermitRootLogin no'<br>    validate: sshd -t -f %s<br>  notify: restart sshd</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>lineinfile</code> bilan butun config'ni boshqarish — mo'rt va chalkash; to'liq faylni <code>template</code> bilan boshqaring.</li><li><code>regexp</code> mos kelmasa <code>lineinfile</code> qatorni oxiriga qo'shadi — dublikat qatorlar.</li><li><code>mode: 755</code> (qo'shtirnoqsiz) noto'g'ri tushuniladi — <code>&quot;0755&quot;</code> yozing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Fayl to'liq sizniki bo'lsa — <code>template</code>; paket bilan kelgan faylda bitta sozlama — <code>lineinfile</code> (yoki <code>/etc/&lt;app&gt;.d/</code> drop-in fayl, bu eng toza variant).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34278	<p>Ansible role nima va tuzilishi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Role — bitta vazifaga (masalan, &quot;nginx o'rnatish va sozlash&quot;) tegishli task, handler, template, fayl va default o'zgaruvchilarni standart papka tuzilmasida birlashtirgan qayta ishlatiladigan paket. Playbook'da <code>roles: [nginx]</code> deb bir qatorda ulanadi.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>roles/nginx/<br>  tasks/main.yml        # asosiy task'lar<br>  handlers/main.yml     # reload/restart<br>  templates/            # .j2 shablonlar<br>  files/                # statik fayllar<br>  defaults/main.yml     # sozlanadigan default'lar (eng past ustunlik)<br>  vars/main.yml         # ichki konstantalar<br>  meta/main.yml         # dependency, platformalar</pre><p>Ansible bu papkalarni avtomatik taniydi: <code>template: src=nginx.conf.j2</code> — <code>templates/</code> dan qidiriladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ansible-galaxy role init roles/nginx</pre><pre># roles/nginx/defaults/main.yml<br>nginx_port: 80<br><br># roles/nginx/tasks/main.yml<br>- ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present }<br>- ansible.builtin.template: { src: site.conf.j2, dest: /etc/nginx/conf.d/site.conf }<br>  notify: reload nginx<br><br># roles/nginx/handlers/main.yml<br>- name: reload nginx<br>  ansible.builtin.service: { name: nginx, state: reloaded }</pre><pre># site.yml<br>- hosts: web<br>  become: true<br>  roles:<br>    - role: nginx<br>      vars: { nginx_port: 8080 }</pre><p>Tayyor role'lar: <code>ansible-galaxy role install geerlingguy.nginx</code> (versiyani <code>requirements.yml</code> da pin qiling).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sozlanadigan qiymatni <code>vars/</code> ga qo'yish — tashqaridan o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi; <code>defaults/</code> ishlating.</li><li>Role ichida hostga xos qiymatlarni qattiq yozish — role qayta ishlatilmaydigan bo'ladi.</li><li>Galaxy role'ni versiyasiz o'rnatish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yaxshi role — bitta maqsad, aniq <code>defaults</code> (uning &quot;API&quot;si) va Molecule testi. Role o'zgaruvchilariga role nomi prefiksini bering (<code>nginx_port</code>) — to'qnashuv bo'lmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34279	<p><code>command</code> va <code>shell</code> modullari qachon ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham serverda buyruq bajaradi. <code>command</code> — buyruqni to'g'ridan ishga tushiradi (shell'siz): pipe <code>|</code>, <code>&gt;</code>, <code>&amp;&amp;</code>, <code>$VAR</code> ishlamaydi, lekin xavfsizroq. <code>shell</code> — <code>/bin/sh</code> orqali, shuning uchun shell imkoniyatlari ishlaydi. Ikkalasi ham oxirgi chora: avval tayyor modul (<code>apt</code>, <code>user</code>, <code>service</code>, <code>copy</code>) qidiring.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>command: ls /tmp | grep x   -&gt; &quot;ls&quot; ga argumentlar: &quot;/tmp&quot;, &quot;|&quot;, &quot;grep&quot;, &quot;x&quot;  (xato)<br>shell:   ls /tmp | grep x   -&gt; /bin/sh -c &quot;ls /tmp | grep x&quot;                  (ishlaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- name: Migratsiya (bir marta)<br>  ansible.builtin.command: /opt/app/migrate<br>  args:<br>    creates: /opt/app/.migrated     # fayl bor bo'lsa task o'tkazib yuboriladi<br><br>- name: Pipe kerak<br>  ansible.builtin.shell: set -o pipefail &amp;&amp; journalctl -u app | tail -n 50<br>  args:<br>    executable: /bin/bash<br>  changed_when: false               # faqat o'qiydi<br><br>- name: Holatni tekshirish<br>  ansible.builtin.command: systemctl is-active app<br>  register: st<br>  changed_when: false<br>  failed_when: st.rc not in [0, 3]</pre><p><b>Modul bilan almashtiring:</b> | Buyruq | Modul | |---|---| | <code>apt-get install nginx</code> | <code>ansible.builtin.apt</code> | | <code>useradd ali</code> | <code>ansible.builtin.user</code> | | <code>systemctl restart app</code> | <code>ansible.builtin.systemd</code> | | <code>mkdir -p /opt/app</code> | <code>ansible.builtin.file</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>command</code>/<code>shell</code> doim <code>changed</code> deb hisoblanadi — <code>creates</code>, <code>removes</code> yoki <code>changed_when</code> qo'ying, aks holda idempotent emas.</li><li><code>shell</code> ga foydalanuvchi o'zgaruvchisini to'g'ridan qo'yish — shell injection; <code>| quote</code> filtri.</li><li>Pipe'da xato yashirinadi — <code>set -o pipefail</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Playbook'da <code>shell</code> ko'p bo'lsa — bu Ansible emas, SSH orqali bash skript. Modul ishlatish idempotentlik, <code>--check</code> va o'qiladigan diff beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34280	<p>Playbook'ni faqat ba'zi hostlarda yoki task'larda ishlatish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--limit</code> — playbook'ni faqat tanlangan <b>hostlarda</b> ishlatadi; <code>--tags</code> — faqat ma'lum tag'li <b>task'larni</b>; <code>--start-at-task</code> — playbook'ni ko'rsatilgan task'dan boshlaydi. Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34281	<p><code>ansible all -m ping</code> nima tekshiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ansible all -m ping</code> — ICMP ping <b>emas</b>. Interview Drill::IaC::W3 Ansible	idrill-34282	<p><code>register</code> va <code>debug</code> bilan natijani ko'rish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>register</code> — task natijasini (stdout, stderr, rc, changed va boshqalar) o'zgaruvchiga saqlaydi; <code>debug</code> — o'zgaruvchi yoki xabarni chiqishga chop etadi. Birga ular &quot;task nima qaytardi?&quot; ni ko'rish va keyingi task'larda shu natijaga qarab qaror qilish uchun ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>command: uptime  --register--&gt;  up = { stdout: &quot;...&quot;, rc: 0, changed: true, ... }<br>debug: var=up.stdout  -&gt; ekranga<br>when: up.rc != 0      -&gt; keyingi task'da shart</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- name: Uptime<br>  ansible.builtin.command: uptime<br>  register: up<br>  changed_when: false<br><br>- name: Natijani ko'rish<br>  ansible.builtin.debug:<br>    var: up.stdout<br><br>- name: Butun natija tuzilmasi<br>  ansible.builtin.debug:<br>    var: up<br><br>- name: O'z xabarim<br>  ansible.builtin.debug:<br>    msg: &quot;{{ inventory_hostname }}: {{ up.stdout }}&quot;<br><br>- name: Disk tekshiruvi<br>  ansible.builtin.shell: df --output=pcent / | tail -1 | tr -dc '0-9'<br>  register: disk<br>  changed_when: false<br><br>- name: Disk to'la bo'lsa ogohlantirish<br>  ansible.builtin.debug:<br>    msg: &quot;Diqqat: disk {{ disk.stdout }}%&quot;<br>  when: disk.stdout | int &gt; 85</pre><p>Natija maydonlari: <code>stdout</code>, <code>stdout_lines</code> (ro'yxat), <code>stderr</code>, <code>rc</code> (exit kod), <code>changed</code>, <code>failed</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>stdout</code> string — son bilan solishtirishdan oldin <code>| int</code>.</li><li>Secret qaytaradigan task'ni <code>debug</code> bilan chiqarish — loglarga tushadi; <code>no_log: true</code>.</li><li>Faqat o'qiydigan <code>command</code> task'ga <code>changed_when: false</code> qo'ymaslik — har run'da &quot;changed&quot; ko'rsatadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>debug</code> ga <code>verbosity: 1</code> qo'shsangiz, xabar faqat <code>-v</code> bilan chiqadi — oddiy run'larni toza, debug'ni esa kerak bo'lganda yoqiladigan qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w3 Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::W13 Chef, Puppet, SaltStack	idrill-33524	<p>Chef, Puppet, SaltStack va Ansible farqi: agent va push/pull modeli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Ansible</b> — agentsiz, <b>push</b> modeli: control node SSH/WinRM orqali buyruqlarni yuboradi; YAML playbook'lar. <b>Puppet</b> — agentli, <b>pull</b>: har node'dagi agent davriy (default 30 daq) Puppet server'dan catalog oladi va qo'llaydi; o'z deklarativ DSL'i. <b>Chef</b> — agentli, pull: chef-client Chef Infra Server'dan cookbook'larni oladi; Ruby DSL. <b>SaltStack</b> — asosan agentli (minion), master ZeroMQ orqali tez <b>push</b> (event bus) qiladi, lekin pull ham mumkin; <code>salt-ssh</code> agentsiz rejim ham bor; YAML + Jinja.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 500 serverda bir xil konfiguratsiyani (paket, fayl, servis, foydalanuvchi) saqlash va qo'lda o'zgarishlarni (drift) avtomatik tuzatish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Push (Ansible):   control --SSH--&gt; server1..N   (siz ishga tushirganda)<br>Pull (Puppet/Chef): agent (har 30 daq) --&gt; server: &quot;menga catalog/cookbook&quot; -&gt; qo'llaydi<br>Salt:             master --ZeroMQ event bus--&gt; minion'lar (sekundlarda minglab)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ansible-playbook -i inventory site.yml --check --diff      # push, quruq sinov<br>puppet agent -t --noop                                     # pull, nima o'zgarishini ko'rish<br>chef-client --why-run<br>salt '*' state.apply nginx test=True</pre><p>| | Ansible | Puppet | Chef | Salt | |---|---|---|---|---| | Agent | yo'q | bor | bor | bor (salt-ssh'siz) | | Model | push | pull | pull | push (+pull) | | Til | YAML | Puppet DSL | Ruby DSL | YAML+Jinja | | Drift tuzatish | ishga tushirilganda | doimiy | doimiy | jadval/reactor | | O'rganish | oson | o'rta | qiyinroq | o'rta |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar (himoya nuqtai nazaridan ham):</b></p><ul><li>Master/server (Puppet server, Chef server, Salt master) — barcha node'larda root huquqli buyruq bera oladigan markaz: eng qimmatli nishon. Uni izolyatsiya qiling, yangilab turing (Salt master'ning 2020 dagi CVE-2020-11651 zaifligi ommaviy buzilishlarga olib kelgan).</li><li>Ansible control node'dagi SSH kalitlari ham xuddi shunday kuchli — himoyalang, vault bilan secret'larni shifrlang.</li><li>2025-2026 holati: Puppet (Perforce) va Chef (Progress) tijoriy yo'nalishga o'tgan, ochiq kodli jamoa fork'lari paydo bo'lgan (masalan OpenVox); yangi loyihalarda Ansible eng keng tarqalgan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Immutable infratuzilma (image'ga pishirish, container, K8s) zamonida configuration management roli kichraydi: asosan base image qurish (Packer + Ansible) va qolgan &quot;uy hayvoni&quot; serverlar uchun. Tanlovni jamoa bilimi va mavjud ekotizimga qarab qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w13 Config_management
Interview Drill::IaC::W13 Chef, Puppet, SaltStack	idrill-33525	<p>Puppet'da manifest, module, catalog, Hiera va Facter nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Manifest</b> — Puppet DSL'dagi <code>.pp</code> fayl: resurslarning kerakli holati (<code>package</code>, <code>file</code>, <code>service</code>). <b>Module</b> — manifest, shablon, fayl va fact'larni qayta ishlatiladigan paketga yig'ish (<code>modules/nginx/manifests/init.pp</code>; Puppet Forge'dan olinadi). <b>Catalog</b> — server ma'lum node uchun manifest + ma'lumotlardan <b>kompilyatsiya</b> qilgan yakuniy resurslar grafi; agent shuni qo'llaydi. <b>Hiera</b> — kod va ma'lumotni ajratuvchi ierarxik key-value ombori (muhit/OS/node bo'yicha qiymatlar). <b>Facter</b> — node haqidagi fakt'larni (OS, IP, xotira, hostname) yig'adi va server'ga yuboradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>agent: Facter -&gt; facts {os: Ubuntu 24.04, ip: 10.0.1.5, role: web}<br>   -&gt; Puppet server: manifest/module + Hiera(facts bo'yicha qiymat) -&gt; catalog kompilyatsiya<br>   &lt;- catalog (faqat shu node uchun, bog'liqliklar grafi)<br>agent: catalog'ni qo'llaydi (faqat farq bo'lsa o'zgartiradi) -&gt; report<br>Hiera ierarxiyasi: nodes/web-1.yaml &gt; role/web.yaml &gt; os/Ubuntu.yaml &gt; common.yaml</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># modules/nginx/manifests/init.pp<br>class nginx (String $worker_processes = 'auto') {<br>  package { 'nginx': ensure =&gt; installed }<br>  file { '/etc/nginx/nginx.conf':<br>    ensure  =&gt; file,<br>    content =&gt; epp('nginx/nginx.conf.epp', { 'workers' =&gt; $worker_processes }),<br>    require =&gt; Package['nginx'],<br>    notify  =&gt; Service['nginx'],<br>  }<br>  service { 'nginx': ensure =&gt; running, enable =&gt; true }<br>}</pre><pre># data/role/web.yaml (Hiera)<br>nginx::worker_processes: '4'</pre><pre>facter os.release.full networking.ip<br>puppet parser validate init.pp<br>puppet agent -t --noop        # nima o'zgarishini ko'rish<br>puppet lookup nginx::worker_processes --node web-1 --explain   # qiymat qaysi qatlamdan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret'larni oddiy Hiera YAML'da saqlash — Git'da ochiq; <code>hiera-eyaml</code> yoki Vault backend bilan shifrlang.</li><li>Resurslar orasida bog'liqlik (<code>require</code>, <code>notify</code>) yozilmasa tartib kafolatlanmaydi.</li><li><code>exec</code> resursini ko'p ishlatish — idempotentlik yo'qoladi (<code>unless</code>/<code>onlyif</code>/<code>creates</code> qo'shing).</li><li>Fact'lar agentdan keladi — buzilgan node soxta fact yuborib boshqa rol konfiguratsiyasini (va secret'larini) olishi mumkin; maxfiy ma'lumotni ishonchli (sertifikat nomi <code>trusted.certname</code>) fact'larga bog'lang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Roles and profiles&quot; naqshi: module — texnologiya (nginx), profile — kompaniya konfiguratsiyasi, role — server vazifasi; ma'lumotlar Hiera'da. Bu kodni test qilinadigan (rspec-puppet, <code>--noop</code> CI'da) va qayta ishlatiladigan qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w13 Config_management
Interview Drill::IaC::W13 Chef, Puppet, SaltStack	idrill-33526	<p>Chef'da cookbook, recipe, resource, run-list va Test Kitchen nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Resource</b> — eng kichik birlik: tizimning bir qismi kerakli holatda (<code>package 'nginx'</code>, <code>template</code>, <code>service</code>). <b>Recipe</b> — resurslar ketma-ketligi yozilgan Ruby fayl (<code>recipes/default.rb</code>). <b>Cookbook</b> — recipe'lar, attribute'lar, template, fayl va test'lar paketi (versiyalanadi). <b>Run-list</b> — node'da qaysi recipe/role'lar qaysi tartibda bajarilishi ro'yxati. <b>Test Kitchen</b> — cookbook'ni vaqtinchalik VM/container'da (Vagrant, Docker, bulut) yaratib, qo'llab, InSpec bilan tekshiradigan test vositasi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>node (chef-client) -&gt; Chef Infra Server: &quot;run-list'im nima?&quot;<br>   run-list: role[web] -&gt; recipe[base], recipe[nginx]<br>   -&gt; cookbook'lar yuklanadi -&gt; compile bosqichi (Ruby) -&gt; converge (resurslar qo'llanadi)<br>   -&gt; report server'ga<br>Test Kitchen: create -&gt; converge -&gt; verify (InSpec) -&gt; destroy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># cookbooks/nginx/recipes/default.rb<br>package 'nginx'<br><br>template '/etc/nginx/nginx.conf' do<br>  source 'nginx.conf.erb'<br>  variables(workers: node['nginx']['workers'])<br>  notifies :reload, 'service[nginx]', :delayed<br>end<br><br>service 'nginx' do<br>  action [:enable, :start]<br>end</pre><pre># kitchen.yml<br>driver: { name: dokken }<br>provisioner: { name: dokken }<br>platforms: [{ name: ubuntu-24.04 }]<br>suites:<br>- name: default<br>  run_list: ['recipe[nginx::default]']<br>  verify: { inspec_tests: ['test/integration/default'] }</pre><pre>kitchen test                      # create + converge + verify + destroy<br>knife node run_list add web-1 'role[web]'<br>chef-client --why-run             # quruq sinov</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Compile va converge bosqichlarini tushunmaslik — Ruby kodi (masalan <code>File.read</code>) resurslardan <b>oldin</b> bajariladi va hali yaratilmagan faylni topa olmaydi; <code>lazy</code> yoki <code>ruby_block</code>.</li><li><code>execute</code> resursini guard'siz (<code>not_if</code>/<code>only_if</code>) ishlatish — har ishga tushishda qayta bajariladi.</li><li>Secret'lar oddiy attribute'larda — Chef Vault/encrypted data bag yoki tashqi secret manager.</li><li>Cookbook versiyalarini pin qilmaslik (Policyfile'siz) — bog'liqlik yangilanishi prod'ni buzadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Policyfile'lar bilan cookbook bog'liqliklarini qulflang, Test Kitchen + InSpec'ni CI'da majburiy qiling. Chef'ning qiymati — Ruby kuchi; xavfi — konfiguratsiya to'liq dasturga aylanib, murakkablashishi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::w13 Config_management
Interview Drill::IaC::W13 Chef, Puppet, SaltStack	idrill-33527	<p>SaltStack: master/minion, state, grain va pillar nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Master</b> — markaziy boshqaruv serveri; <b>minion</b> — boshqariladigan node'dagi agent (ZeroMQ orqali master'ga doimiy ulangan, buyruqlarni real vaqtda oladi). <b>State</b> (<code>.sls</code> fayl) — node'ning kerakli holati YAML + Jinja'da (paket, fayl, servis). <b>Grain</b> — minion'ning <b>o'zi</b> haqidagi statik ma'lumot (OS, CPU, IP, rol) — Puppet fact'iga o'xshash, nishonlash uchun. <b>Pillar</b> — master'da saqlanadigan va <b>faqat tegishli minion'ga</b> yuboriladigan maxfiy/konfiguratsion ma'lumot (parollar, kalitlar, muhit sozlamalari).</p><p><b>Muhim farq:</b> grain'lar minion'dan keladi (ishonchsiz — minion o'zgartira oladi), pillar'lar master'dan keladi (nazorat ostida). Interview Drill::IaC::W13 Chef, Puppet, SaltStack	idrill-34067	<p>Configuration management nima va nega kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Configuration management (CM) — serverlarning konfiguratsiyasini (paketlar, fayllar, servislar, foydalanuvchilar, sozlamalar) <b>kod sifatida</b> tavsiflash va uni avtomatik, takrorlanuvchan tarzda qo'llash. Kerak, chunki: qo'lda sozlash sekin va xatoga moyil, serverlar vaqt o'tib bir-biridan farqlanadi (configuration drift), o'zgarishlar tarixi yo'q, yangi serverni tez va bir xil ko'tarish mumkin emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 20 ta web server, kimdir 3 tasida nginx sozlamasini qo'lda o'zgartirdi. Zamonaviy yo'nalishda esa server'ni sozlash o'rniga tayyor image (Packer) yoki container ishlatiladi — CM asosan image qurish bosqichiga ko'chadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w13 Config_management

Interview Drill::IaC::W13 Chef, Puppet, SaltStack	idrill-34069	<p>Push va pull modeli farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Push</b> — markaziy tizim (control node) o'zgarishni serverlarga o'zi yuboradi va siz ishga tushirgan paytda qo'llanadi (Ansible, Salt odatiy rejimi). <b>Pull</b> — har serverdagi agent markaziy manbadan konfiguratsiyani davriy ravishda o'zi tortib oladi va qo'llaydi (Puppet, Chef; K8s'da GitOps — Argo CD/Flux ham pull).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> o'zgarishni qanchalik tez va qanchalik ishonchli yetkazish kerak? Push — darhol va nazoratli, lekin o'chiq serverlar o'tkazib yuboriladi. Pull — server qayta yonganda o'zi yangilanadi va drift'ni doimiy tuzatadi, lekin kechikish bor.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Push:  [control] --SSH--&gt; s1, s2, s3     (s4 o'chiq -&gt; o'tkazib yuborildi)<br>       credential control node'da, tarmoq control -&gt; serverlar yo'nalishida<br><br>Pull:  s1, s2, s3, s4 --(har 30 daq)--&gt; [server/Git]<br>       s4 yonganda o'zi tortib oladi; credential'lar har agentda (o'z sertifikati)<br>       tarmoq server -&gt; markaz yo'nalishida (kiruvchi port kerak emas)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ansible-playbook -i inventory site.yml --limit web       # push: hozir<br>puppet agent -t                                          # pull: darhol tortish<br>systemctl status puppet                                  # pull agent davriy ishlaydi<br># ansible-pull (Ansible'ni pull rejimida ishlatish)<br>ansible-pull -U https://github.com/acme/infra.git local.yml</pre><p>| | Push | Pull | |---|---|---| | Qachon qo'llanadi | siz ishga tushirganda | agent jadvali bo'yicha | | O'chiq serverlar | o'tkazib yuboriladi | keyin o'zi oladi | | Drift tuzatish | qayta ishga tushirsangiz | avtomatik, doimiy | | Masshtab | control node cheklaydi | yaxshi taqsimlanadi | | Xavfsizlik | kuchli kalit bitta joyda | serverlar faqat chiqadi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar (himoya nuqtai nazaridan ham):</b></p><ul><li>Push'da control node buzilsa — hamma serverga root kirish; MFA, cheklangan kirish, audit.</li><li>Pull'da markaziy manba (server yoki Git repo) buzilsa — barcha agentlar zararli konfiguratsiyani o'zi tortib oladi. Repo'ga yozishni himoyalang (branch protection, imzolangan commit'lar, review).</li><li>Pull kechikishi: shoshilinch xavfsizlik tuzatishini 30 daqiqa kutish — majburiy ishga tushirish mexanizmi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p tizimlar gibrid: pull — doimiy holatni ushlab turish va drift uchun, push — favqulodda o'zgarishlar uchun. K8s'dagi GitOps aynan pull modelining zamonaviy ko'rinishi: cluster credential'lari tashqi CI'da saqlanmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w13 Config_management
Interview Drill::IaC::W13 Chef, Puppet, SaltStack	idrill-34070	<p>Declarative va imperative yondashuv farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Declarative</b> — <b>nima</b> bo'lishi kerakligini tavsiflaysiz (&quot;nginx o'rnatilgan va ishlayotgan bo'lsin&quot;, &quot;3 ta replika&quot;), tizim joriy holatni tekshirib, qanday erishishni o'zi hal qiladi. <b>Imperative</b> — <b>qanday</b> qilishni ketma-ket buyruqlar bilan yozasiz (&quot;apt install nginx, keyin systemctl start nginx&quot;). Declarative tabiatan idempotent va drift'ni tuzatishga mos; imperative — oddiy, lekin har ishga tushishda nima bo'lishini siz nazorat qilishingiz kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> imperative skript ikkinchi marta ishga tushirildi — foydalanuvchi qayta yaratilmoqchi bo'lib xato berdi, config faylga bir xil qator ikki marta qo'shildi. Declarative tizim &quot;holat allaqachon to'g'ri&quot; deb hech narsa qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Imperative:  qadam1 -&gt; qadam2 -&gt; qadam3   (holatni tekshirish sizning vazifangiz)<br>Declarative: kerakli holat --&gt; [vosita: joriy holatni o'qi -&gt; farqni hisobla -&gt; faqat farqni qo'lla]<br>             2-marta: farq yo'q -&gt; changed=0</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Imperative (bash)<br>apt-get install -y nginx<br>echo &quot;worker_processes 4;&quot; &gt;&gt; /etc/nginx/nginx.conf   # har safar qo'shiladi!<br>systemctl start nginx</pre><pre># Declarative (Ansible)<br>- ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present }<br>- ansible.builtin.lineinfile: { path: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf, regexp: '^worker_processes', line: 'worker_processes 4;' }<br>- ansible.builtin.service: { name: nginx, state: started, enabled: true }</pre><pre># Declarative (Kubernetes)<br>spec:<br>  replicas: 3      # &quot;3 ta bo'lsin&quot; — qanday qilishni controller hal qiladi</pre><p>Misollar: declarative — Terraform, Kubernetes YAML, Puppet, Ansible modullarining ko'pi; imperative — bash skript, <code>kubectl create/scale</code>, Ansible <code>shell</code>/<code>command</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Declarative vositada ham imperative &quot;teshik&quot;lar (<code>shell</code>, <code>exec</code>, <code>local-exec</code>) — idempotentlikni o'zingiz ta'minlashingiz kerak (<code>creates</code>, <code>unless</code>).</li><li>Declarative tizim &quot;o'zi hal qiladi&quot; — ba'zan kutilmagan yo'l bilan (Terraform resursni qayta yaratish / replace); <code>plan</code>/<code>--check</code> natijasini doim o'qing.</li><li>O'chirish declarative'da ko'pincha aniq yozilishi kerak (<code>state: absent</code>) — fayldan olib tashlash resursni o'chirmaydi (Terraform bundan istisno).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production infratuzilma declarative bo'lsin — Git'dagi tavsif = haqiqat, review va drift aniqlash mumkin. Imperative — bir martalik operatsiyalar, debug va migratsiya qadamlari uchun; ular ham skript sifatida saqlanib, takrorlanuvchan bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::iac sec::w13 Config_management
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41251	<p>Infrastructure as Code nima va qaysi asosiy muammolarni hal qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — server, tarmoq, DB, DNS kabi infratuzilmani qo'lda konsolda bosib emas, <b>kod faylida tasvirlab</b>, uni Git'da saqlab, tool orqali avtomatik yaratish.</p><p><b>Qaysi muammoni hal qiladi:</b></p><ul><li><b>Qo'lda xato (ClickOps)</b> — konsolda 40 ta checkbox bosiladi, bittasi unutiladi. Shunda kod = haqiqat manbai bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41252	<p>Deklarativ va imperativ IaC'ni misollar bilan solishtiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Deklarativ</b> — &quot;oxirida nima bo'lishi kerak&quot;ni yozasan (desired state), tool o'zi qanday yetishni hisoblaydi. <b>Imperativ</b> — &quot;qadam-baqadam nima qilish kerak&quot;ni yozasan.</p><p><b>Misol bilan:</b> 3 ta server kerak, hozir 2 ta bor.</p><pre>Deklarativ (Terraform):  count = 3<br>  -&gt; tool: &quot;hozir 2, kerak 3 -&gt; 1 ta qo'shaman&quot;<br>  -&gt; qayta ishga tushirsang: &quot;3 = 3 -&gt; hech narsa&quot;<br><br>Imperativ (bash/AWS CLI):  aws ec2 run-instances --count 3<br>  -&gt; har ishga tushganda yana 3 ta yaratadi (2+3=5, keyin 8...)</pre><p><b>Deklarativ:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  count         = 3<br>  ami           = &quot;ami-123&quot;<br>  instance_type = &quot;t3.micro&quot;<br>}</pre><p>Toollar: Terraform/OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Kubernetes YAML, Crossplane.</p><p><b>Imperativ:</b></p><pre>for i in 1 2 3; do<br>  aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-123 --instance-type t3.micro<br>done</pre><p>Toollar: shell script, AWS CLI, Pulumi/CDK (imperativ *tilda* yoziladi, lekin natijada deklarativ graf hosil qiladi).</p><p><b>Solishtirish:</b> | | Deklarativ | Imperativ | |---|---|---| | Idempotent | o'z-o'zidan | qo'lda tekshirish kerak | | Drift aniqlash | bor (plan) | yo'q | | O'chirish | resursni kodan olib tashla | alohida delete script | | Murakkab logika | cheklangan | to'liq dasturlash tili |</p><p><b>Tuzoq:</b> Ansible &quot;deklarativ&quot; ko'rinadi, lekin task'lar tartib bilan bajariladi va <code>shell:</code> modul idempotent emas — gibrid.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Infratuzilma *holati* uchun deklarativ tanla (drift, plan, review). Imperativ — bir martalik operatsiyalar (migration, failover runbook) uchun. Pulumi/CDK'da ham oxirida engine desired-state solishtiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41253	<p>Terraform state nima va nega kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> State (<code>terraform.tfstate</code>) — Terraform'ning <b>xotirasi</b>: koddagi har bir resurs real dunyodagi qaysi obyektga (ID'ga) mos kelishini va uning oxirgi ma'lum atributlarini saqlaydigan JSON fayl.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kodda <code>aws_instance.web</code> yozilgan. Cloud'da <code>i-0abc123</code> bor. Terraform ular bir xil narsa ekanini qayerdan biladi? — state'dan.</p><pre>  Kod (.tf)          State                  Cloud<br>aws_instance.web --&gt; id = i-0abc123  &lt;--&gt;  i-0abc123 (real VM)</pre><ol><li><b>Mapping</b> — kod nomi va real ID bog'lanishi.</li><li><b>Diff hisoblash</b> — plan: kod vs state (refresh qilingan) farqi.</li><li><b>Dependency</b> — o'chirish tartibini biladi (avval EC2, keyin subnet).</li><li><b>Performance</b> — katta infra'da hamma narsani har safar API'dan qidirmaydi.</li><li><b>Output'lar</b> — boshqa modul/stack o'qishi mumkin.</li></ol><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform state list                    # nima boshqarilyapti<br>terraform state show aws_instance.web   # bitta resursning atributlari</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>State'da <b>secret'lar ochiq</b> saqlanadi (DB parol, private key) — shifrlangan backend + cheklangan access majburiy.</li><li>Local state + jamoa = ikki kishi bir vaqtda apply, state buziladi. Remote backend + locking kerak.</li><li>State'ni qo'lda tahrir qilma — <code>terraform state mv/rm/import</code> ishlat.</li><li>State yo'qolsa Terraform resurslarni &quot;yo'q&quot; deb o'ylab qayta yaratmoqchi bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> State = kritik artefakt. Versioning yoqilgan S3 (eski versiyaga qaytish), KMS shifrlash, IAM bilan faqat CI'ga write. State'ni kichik bo'laklarga bo'l (har servis/muhit alohida) — blast radius va lock contention kamayadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41254	<p>Asosiy Terraform CLI workflow buyruqlari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>init</code> → <code>validate</code>/<code>fmt</code> → <code>plan</code> → <code>apply</code> → (kerak bo'lsa) <code>destroy</code>.</p><p><b>Har biri nima qiladi:</b></p><pre>terraform init      provider plugin'larni yuklaydi, backend'ga ulanadi,<br>                    modullarni yuklaydi, .terraform.lock.hcl yaratadi<br>terraform fmt       kodni standart formatga keltiradi<br>terraform validate  sintaksis va tiplarni tekshiradi (cloud'ga bormaydi)<br>terraform plan      kod vs real holat -&gt; nima o'zgarishini ko'rsatadi<br>terraform apply     plan'ni bajaradi (tasdiq so'raydi)<br>terraform destroy   hamma boshqariladigan resursni o'chiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda — to'g'ri CI oqimi:</b></p><pre>terraform init -input=false<br>terraform fmt -check<br>terraform validate<br>terraform plan -out=tfplan        # plan faylga saqlanadi<br>terraform show tfplan             # review uchun<br>terraform apply tfplan            # aynan review qilingan plan bajariladi</pre><p><b>Plan chiqishini o'qish:</b></p><pre>  + create      yangi resurs<br>  ~ update      in-place o'zgaradi<br>  -/+ replace   o'chirib qayta yaratadi (DIQQAT: downtime/data yo'qolishi)<br>  - destroy     o'chadi<br>Plan: 2 to add, 1 to change, 1 to destroy.</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>apply</code> ni <code>-out</code> plan'siz ishlatish — review va apply orasida kod/infra o'zgarsa, boshqa narsa bajariladi.</li><li><code>-/+</code> belgisini e'tiborsiz qoldirish — DB qayta yaratilishi mumkin.</li><li><code>-auto-approve</code> ni lokalda prod'ga ishlatish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da: PR'da plan avtomatik comment bo'ladi, merge'dan keyin <b>saqlangan plan</b> apply qilinadi. <code>destroy</code> bor joyda qo'shimcha approval gate.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41255	<p>Terraform <code>count</code> va <code>for_each</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi bir resursdan ko'p nusxa yaratadi. <code>count</code> — <b>raqam index</b> (<code>[0]</code>, <code>[1]</code>), <code>for_each</code> — <b>kalit</b> (<code>[&quot;web&quot;]</code>, <code>[&quot;api&quot;]</code>). Farq ro'yxatdan element o'chirilganda ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo <code>count</code> bilan:</b></p><pre>variable &quot;users&quot; { default = [&quot;ali&quot;, &quot;vali&quot;, &quot;soli&quot;] }<br>resource &quot;aws_iam_user&quot; &quot;u&quot; {<br>  count = length(var.users)<br>  name  = var.users[count.index]<br>}</pre><pre>[0]=ali  [1]=vali  [2]=soli<br>&quot;vali&quot; ni o'chirsang:<br>[0]=ali  [1]=soli  &lt;- [1] nomi o'zgardi -&gt; soli qayta yaratiladi<br>         [2]       &lt;- o'chiriladi</pre><p>Bitta element o'chdi, lekin boshqasi ham buzildi!</p><p><b><code>for_each</code> bilan:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_iam_user&quot; &quot;u&quot; {<br>  for_each = toset(var.users)<br>  name     = each.key<br>}</pre><pre>[&quot;ali&quot;] [&quot;vali&quot;] [&quot;soli&quot;]  -&gt; &quot;vali&quot; o'chsa, faqat [&quot;vali&quot;] destroy</pre><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b></p><ul><li><code>count</code> — bir xil nusxalar (<code>count = 3</code>) yoki shartli resurs: <code>count = var.enabled ? 1 : 0</code>.</li><li><code>for_each</code> — har nusxa o'z identifikatoriga ega (user, bucket, subnet) — map yoki set.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>for_each</code> kaliti plan vaqtida ma'lum bo'lishi kerak (boshqa resursning ID'si bo'lmaydi) — &quot;Invalid for_each argument&quot;.</li><li><code>count</code> dan <code>for_each</code> ga o'tishda <code>moved</code> bloklari yoki <code>state mv</code> kerak, aks holda qayta yaratiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default <code>for_each</code> ishlat. <code>count</code> faqat on/off uchun. Ro'yxat tartibiga bog'liq resurs — kelajakdagi incident.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41256	<p>Terraform modul nima va DRY'ni qanday ta'minlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Modul — <code>.tf</code> fayllar papkasi, input (variables) qabul qilib, output qaytaradigan <b>qayta ishlatiladigan funksiya</b>. Bir marta yozilib, dev/stage/prod va ko'p servislarda chaqiriladi — kod takrorlanmaydi (DRY).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>modules/vpc/          &lt;- modul (bir marta yozilgan)<br>  main.tf  variables.tf  outputs.tf<br><br>envs/dev/main.tf   module &quot;vpc&quot; { source=&quot;../../modules/vpc&quot; cidr=&quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot; }<br>envs/prod/main.tf  module &quot;vpc&quot; { source=&quot;../../modules/vpc&quot; cidr=&quot;10.1.0.0/16&quot; }</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># modules/vpc/variables.tf<br>variable &quot;cidr&quot; { type = string }<br># modules/vpc/main.tf<br>resource &quot;aws_vpc&quot; &quot;this&quot; { cidr_block = var.cidr }<br># modules/vpc/outputs.tf<br>output &quot;vpc_id&quot; { value = aws_vpc.this.id }<br><br># chaqirish<br>module &quot;vpc&quot; {<br>  source = &quot;git::https://github.com/myco/tf-modules.git//vpc?ref=v1.4.0&quot;<br>  cidr   = &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_subnet&quot; &quot;a&quot; { vpc_id = module.vpc.vpc_id ... }</pre><p><b>Yaxshi modul belgilari:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta aniq mas'uliyat (vpc, eks, rds) — &quot;hamma narsa&quot; moduli emas.</li><li>Input'lar tipli, <code>validation</code> bilan, oqilona default'lar.</li><li>Versiyalangan (<code>?ref=v1.4.0</code>) — <code>main</code> ga bog'lanma.</li><li>README + misol.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Haddan tashqari abstraksiya: 80 ta variable li modul — oddiy resursdan qiyinroq.</li><li>Modulni versiyasiz chaqirish — kimdir <code>main</code> ni o'zgartirsa, hamma prod buziladi.</li><li>Modul ichida provider konfiguratsiyasi — modullarni o'chirishni qiyinlashtiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Modul — jamoalar orasidagi <b>kontrakt</b>. Platform jamoasi &quot;golden&quot; modullar beradi (xavfsizlik default'lari ichida), app jamoalari faqat kerakli input beradi. SemVer + changelog, breaking change = major versiya.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41257	<p>Terraform variables, locals va outputs farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b></p><ul><li><b>variables</b> — tashqaridan keladigan <b>input</b> (funksiya parametri).</li><li><b>locals</b> — modul ichida hisoblangan <b>ichki o'zgaruvchi</b> (takrorlanadigan ifodaga nom berish).</li><li><b>outputs</b> — modul tashqariga beradigan <b>natija</b> (return qiymati).</li></ul><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>  var.env, var.app  --&gt;  [ locals: name = &quot;${var.app}-${var.env}&quot; ]  --&gt;  output &quot;bucket_arn&quot;<br>     (input)                   (ichki hisob)                              (natija)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variable &quot;env&quot; {<br>  type = string<br>  validation {<br>    condition     = contains([&quot;dev&quot;,&quot;stage&quot;,&quot;prod&quot;], var.env)<br>    error_message = &quot;env dev/stage/prod bo'lishi kerak.&quot;<br>  }<br>}<br>locals {<br>  name = &quot;myapp-${var.env}&quot;<br>  tags = { env = var.env, managed_by = &quot;terraform&quot; }<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;b&quot; {<br>  bucket = local.name<br>  tags   = local.tags<br>}<br>output &quot;bucket_arn&quot; { value = aws_s3_bucket.b.arn }</pre><pre>terraform apply -var env=prod<br>terraform output bucket_arn</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>locals'ni tashqaridan override qilib bo'lmaydi — agar o'zgarishi kerak bo'lsa, variable qil.</li><li>Secret output'ga <code>sensitive = true</code> qo'ymasang, CLI'da ko'rinadi.</li><li>Hamma narsani variable qilish — modul API'si shishadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Variable = public API, minimal va validatsiyali. Locals = DRY va o'qilishi uchun. Output = boshqa modul/stack'lar uchun kontrakt — o'chirish breaking change.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41258	<p>Remote backend nima va nega state locking majburiy?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Remote backend — state faylni lokal diskda emas, umumiy joyda (S3, GCS, Azure Blob, HCP Terraform) saqlash. <b>Locking</b> — bir vaqtda faqat bitta <code>apply</code> state'ga yoza olishini kafolatlaydi.</p><p><b>Locking bo'lmasa nima bo'ladi:</b></p><pre>Ali:   plan (state v5) ---- apply ------&gt; state v6 yozadi<br>Vali:     plan (state v5) ---- apply ---&gt; state v6' yozadi (Ali'nikini ustidan!)<br>Natija: Ali yaratgan resurs state'da yo'q -&gt; &quot;yetim&quot; resurs, keyingi plan uni qayta yaratadi</pre><p>Locking bilan: Vali <code>Error acquiring the state lock</code> oladi va kutadi.</p><p><b>Amalda (S3):</b></p><pre>terraform {<br>  backend &quot;s3&quot; {<br>    bucket       = &quot;myco-tfstate&quot;<br>    key          = &quot;prod/network/terraform.tfstate&quot;<br>    region       = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;<br>    encrypt      = true<br>    use_lockfile = true      # TF 1.10+: S3 native lock<br>    # eski usul: dynamodb_table = &quot;tf-locks&quot;<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Remote backend afzalliklari:</b></p><ul><li>Jamoa bitta haqiqatni ko'radi.</li><li>Shifrlash + IAM bilan himoya.</li><li>Versioning — buzilgan state'ni oldingisiga qaytarish.</li><li>CI/CD runner'lari ham ishlata oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Backend bucket'ini o'sha Terraform bilan yaratish (tovuq-tuxum) — alohida bootstrap stack.</li><li>Crash'dan keyin lock qolib ketsa — <code>terraform force-unlock &lt;ID&gt;</code>, faqat hech kim apply qilmayotganiga ishonch hosil qilib.</li><li>Bucket versioning o'chirilgan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> State bucket — eng kritik resurs: versioning, MFA delete / object lock, alohida AWS account, faqat CI role write qiladi, odamlarda read-only.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41259	<p>OpenTofu nima va nega yaratilgan?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OpenTofu — Terraform'ning <b>ochiq kodli fork</b>i. 2023-yilda HashiCorp Terraform litsenziyasini MPL 2.0 (open source) dan <b>BSL</b> (Business Source License) ga o'zgartirdi; bunga javoban Linux Foundation ostida OpenTofu yaratildi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b></p><ul><li>BSL HashiCorp bilan raqobatlashadigan mahsulotlarda (Spacelift, env0 kabi) Terraform'ni ishlatishni cheklaydi.</li><li>Kompaniyalar vendor lock-in va kelajakdagi litsenziya xavfidan qo'rqdi.</li><li>OpenTofu MPL 2.0 da qoladi, jamoa boshqaruvi ostida.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>brew install opentofu<br>tofu init<br>tofu plan<br>tofu apply</pre><p>Mavjud Terraform kodi (1.5.x gacha) deyarli o'zgarishsiz ishlaydi, state formati mos.</p><p><b>OpenTofu'ning o'z xususiyatlari:</b></p><ul><li><b>State encryption</b> (client-side) — state fayl shifrlangan holda saqlanadi.</li><li>Provider-defined funksiyalar, <code>for_each</code> provider'larda, erta variable evaluation (backend'da variable).</li><li>Registry: <code>registry.opentofu.org</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Vaqt o'tishi bilan Terraform va OpenTofu bir-biridan uzoqlashmoqda — yangi Terraform feature'lari OpenTofu'da bo'lmasligi va aksincha.</li><li>HCP Terraform (Terraform Cloud) bilan OpenTofu ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov — litsenziya/strategik qaror: BSL sizning foydalanishingizga ta'sir qiladimi, HCP Terraform kerakmi, jamoa qaysi feature'larga tayanadi. Migratsiya oson, lekin ikkalasini aralash ishlatma — bitta tanla va CI'da versiyani qotir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41260	<p>IaC'da configuration drift nima va qanday hal qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Drift — real infratuzilma koddagidan <b>farq qilib qolishi</b>. Sabab: kimdir konsolda o'zgartirdi, skript tegdi, auto-scaling yoki cloud o'zi o'zgartirdi.</p><p><b>Misol:</b></p><pre>Kod:    security group 443 port ochiq<br>Real:   kimdir debug uchun 22 portni 0.0.0.0/0 ga ochdi va unutdi<br>-&gt; xavfsizlik teshigi, kodda ko'rinmaydi</pre><p><b>Qanday aniqlanadi:</b></p><pre>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode<br># exit 0 = farq yo'q, 1 = xato, 2 = drift/o'zgarish bor<br>terraform plan -refresh-only     # faqat real holat vs state</pre><p>Har kecha CI'da cron bilan ishga tushir, exit 2 bo'lsa Slack'ga alert.</p><p><b>Qanday hal qilinadi — ikki yo'l:</b></p><ol><li><b>Kod to'g'ri</b> — <code>terraform apply</code> drift'ni bekor qiladi (real holatni kodga qaytaradi).</li><li><b>O'zgarish to'g'ri edi</b> (hotfix) — kodni yangilab PR ochasan, keyin plan toza bo'ladi. <code>apply -refresh-only</code> faqat state'ni yangilaydi.</li></ol><p><b>Oldini olish:</b></p><ul><li>Prod konsolda odamlarga read-only IAM; o'zgarish faqat pipeline orqali.</li><li>AWS Config / CloudTrail bilan qo'lda o'zgarishlarni kuzatish.</li><li>Break-glass access — vaqtinchalik, audit bilan.</li><li>Auto-scaling kabi tabiiy o'zgarishlarga <code>ignore_changes</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Drift'ni ko'r-ko'rona <code>apply</code> bilan tozalash — kimdir incident paytida qilgan muhim hotfix'ni bekor qilishi mumkin.</li><li>Faqat apply paytida plan qilish — drift oylab bilinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Drift — texnik emas, <b>jarayon</b> muammosi. Uni o'lcha (drift soni haftasiga), sabablarni topib, odamlarning qo'lda o'zgartirish ehtiyojini yo'q qil (tez pipeline, self-service).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41261	<p>Terraform'da <code>moved</code> bloki nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>moved</code> bloki — resursni koddagi <b>manzilini o'zgartirganda</b> (rename, modulga ko'chirish, count→for_each) Terraform'ga &quot;bu o'sha resurs, faqat nomi o'zgardi&quot; deb aytish. Aks holda Terraform eskisini o'chirib, yangisini yaratadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;db&quot; {...}      # eski nom<br>resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {...}    # yangi nom</pre><p>plan: <code>- destroy aws_db_instance.db</code> + <code>+ create aws_db_instance.main</code> — <b>DB o'chadi!</b></p><p><b>Yechim:</b></p><pre>moved {<br>  from = aws_db_instance.db<br>  to   = aws_db_instance.main<br>}</pre><p>plan: <code>aws_db_instance.db has moved to aws_db_instance.main</code> — 0 to destroy.</p><p><b>Boshqa holatlar:</b></p><pre>moved { from = aws_s3_bucket.logs            to = module.logging.aws_s3_bucket.this }<br>moved { from = aws_iam_user.u[0]             to = aws_iam_user.u[&quot;ali&quot;] }</pre><p><b>Nega <code>state mv</code> dan yaxshi:</b> | <code>terraform state mv</code> | <code>moved {}</code> | |---|---| | qo'lda, har muhitda alohida | kodda, PR'da review | | CI'dan tashqari | plan'da ko'rinadi | | modul foydalanuvchilari o'zi qilishi kerak | modul ichida — hamma uchun avtomatik |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>moved</code> ni darhol o'chirma — barcha muhit/foydalanuvchilar apply qilmaguncha qoldir.</li><li>Har xil resurs tipiga ko'chirib bo'lmaydi (TF 1.8+ ba'zi provider'lar qo'llaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Refactoring PR'ida plan'da <b>0 to destroy</b> bo'lishi shart — CI'da tekshir. Modul mualliflari uchun <code>moved</code> — breaking change'siz refactor qilishning yagona to'g'ri yo'li.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41262	<p>Terraform 1.5+ dagi <code>import {}</code> bloki nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>import {}</code> bloki (TF 1.5+) — Terraform'dan <b>tashqarida yaratilgan</b> mavjud resursni state'ga kod orqali olib kirish. Eski <code>terraform import</code> CLI buyrug'ining deklarativ, review qilinadigan versiyasi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Konsolda qo'lda yaratilgan S3 bucket bor. Endi uni Terraform boshqarsin, lekin qayta yaratmasin.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import {<br>  to = aws_s3_bucket.legacy<br>  id = &quot;myco-legacy-bucket&quot;<br>}</pre><p>Kodni o'zing yozishing shart emas — generatsiya qildir:</p><pre>terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf</pre><p><code>generated.tf</code> ni ko'rib chiq, tozalab, asosiy faylga ko'chir. Keyin:</p><pre>terraform plan    # &quot;1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change&quot;<br>terraform apply</pre><p>Endi <code>import</code> blokini o'chirsa bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Eski usul bilan farq:</b> | <code>terraform import</code> (CLI) | <code>import {}</code> | |---|---| | darhol state'ga yozadi, plan yo'q | plan'da ko'rinadi | | har resursga alohida buyruq | ko'p resurs bir PR'da | | kod qo'lda yoziladi | <code>-generate-config-out</code> |</p><p>TF 1.7+: <code>import</code> bilan <code>for_each</code> ham ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Generatsiya qilingan kod ko'pincha keraksiz default atributlar bilan to'la — tozala.</li><li>Import'dan keyin plan'da <code>~ update</code> chiqsa — kod real holatga mos emas; apply qilishdan oldin moslashtir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ClickOps'dan IaC'ga migratsiyada: import → plan &quot;no changes&quot; bo'lguncha kodni moslashtir → shundan keyingina o'zgarish kirit. Bir PR = bir mantiqiy guruh.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41263	<p>Terraform precondition va postcondition nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>precondition</code> — resurs yaratilishidan <b>oldin</b> shart tekshiradi; <code>postcondition</code> — yaratilgandan <b>keyin</b> natijani tekshiradi. Precondition esa data source natijasi, bir nechta qiymat orasidagi munosabat kabi murakkab taxminlarni tekshiradi — xato prod'da emas, plan'da ushlanadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>data &quot;aws_ami&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  most_recent = true<br>  owners      = [&quot;self&quot;]<br>  filter { name = &quot;name&quot; values = [&quot;app-*&quot;] }<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  ami           = data.aws_ami.app.id<br>  instance_type = var.type<br><br>  lifecycle {<br>    precondition {<br>      condition     = data.aws_ami.app.architecture == &quot;x86_64&quot;<br>      error_message = &quot;AMI x86_64 bo'lishi kerak, t3 instance ARM AMI'ni ishlatolmaydi.&quot;<br>    }<br>    postcondition {<br>      condition     = self.public_ip == &quot;&quot;<br>      error_message = &quot;Web instance public IP olmasligi kerak.&quot;<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Qayerda ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>variable validation  -&gt; bitta input<br>precondition         -&gt; resurs/data/output dan oldin<br>postcondition        -&gt; resurs/data dan keyin (self.* bilan)<br>check {} (TF 1.5+)   -&gt; ogohlantiradi, lekin to'xtatmaydi (health check)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Postcondition apply'dan keyin ham fail bo'lishi mumkin — resurs allaqachon yaratilgan.</li><li>Juda ko'p shart — kod o'qilishi qiyinlashadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Modul mualliflari uchun — modul taxminlarini (assumption) <b>kodda hujjatlash</b> usuli. &quot;Bu modul faqat private subnet'da ishlaydi&quot; — README'da emas, precondition'da.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41264	<p>Terragrunt nima va qaysi muammolarni hal qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Terragrunt — Terraform/OpenTofu ustidagi <b>wrapper</b>: ko'p muhit va ko'p stack'li infratuzilmada backend, provider va variable konfiguratsiyasining takrorlanishini yo'qotadi va stack'lar orasidagi bog'liqlikni boshqaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo (sof Terraform):</b></p><pre>envs/dev/vpc/backend.tf     &lt;- deyarli bir xil<br>envs/dev/eks/backend.tf     &lt;- deyarli bir xil<br>envs/prod/vpc/backend.tf    &lt;- ... x50 ta papka</pre><p>Har biri backend bloki, provider, umumiy variable'ni copy-paste qiladi.</p><p><b>Terragrunt bilan:</b></p><pre>live/<br>  root.hcl                  &lt;- backend + provider BIR MARTA<br>  prod/<br>    env.hcl                 &lt;- env = &quot;prod&quot;<br>    vpc/terragrunt.hcl<br>    eks/terragrunt.hcl      &lt;- dependency &quot;vpc&quot;</pre><pre># live/prod/eks/terragrunt.hcl<br>include &quot;root&quot; { path = find_in_parent_folders(&quot;root.hcl&quot;) }<br>terraform { source = &quot;git::https://github.com/myco/modules.git//eks?ref=v2.1.0&quot; }<br>dependency &quot;vpc&quot; { config_path = &quot;../vpc&quot; }<br>inputs = {<br>  vpc_id     = dependency.vpc.outputs.vpc_id<br>  subnet_ids = dependency.vpc.outputs.private_subnets<br>}</pre><pre>cd live/prod &amp;&amp; terragrunt run-all plan   # dependency tartibida</pre><p><b>Hal qiladigan muammolar:</b></p><ul><li>DRY backend (har stack uchun state key avtomatik <code>path_relative_to_include()</code>).</li><li>Stack'lar orasida output uzatish.</li><li><code>run-all</code> — ko'p stack'ni tartib bilan.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qo'shimcha tool qatlami — debug qiyinroq.</li><li><code>run-all apply</code> prod'da xavfli — katta blast radius.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kichik loyihaga keraksiz. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41265	<p>Terraform dynamic block nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>dynamic</code> blok — resurs ichidagi <b>ichki bloklarni</b> (masalan, <code>ingress</code>, <code>setting</code>) ro'yxatdan sikl bilan generatsiya qilish. <code>for_each</code> resursni ko'paytiradi, <code>dynamic</code> resurs <b>ichidagi blokni</b> ko'paytiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  ingress { from_port = 80   to_port = 80   protocol = &quot;tcp&quot; cidr_blocks = [&quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;] }<br>  ingress { from_port = 443  to_port = 443  protocol = &quot;tcp&quot; cidr_blocks = [&quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;] }<br>  ingress { from_port = 8080 to_port = 8080 protocol = &quot;tcp&quot; cidr_blocks = [&quot;10.0.0.0/8&quot;] }<br>}</pre><p><b>Dynamic bilan:</b></p><pre>variable &quot;rules&quot; {<br>  default = [<br>    { port = 80,   cidr = &quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot; },<br>    { port = 443,  cidr = &quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot; },<br>    { port = 8080, cidr = &quot;10.0.0.0/8&quot; },<br>  ]<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  dynamic &quot;ingress&quot; {<br>    for_each = var.rules<br>    content {<br>      from_port   = ingress.value.port<br>      to_port     = ingress.value.port<br>      protocol    = &quot;tcp&quot;<br>      cidr_blocks = [ingress.value.cidr]<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><code>ingress.value</code> — iterator (nomi blok nomi bilan bir xil, <code>iterator = r</code> bilan o'zgartirsa bo'ladi).</p><p><b>Shartli blok:</b></p><pre>dynamic &quot;logging&quot; {<br>  for_each = var.enable_logging ? [1] : []<br>  content { target_bucket = var.log_bucket }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Haddan ortiq dynamic — kod o'qib bo'lmaydigan bo'ladi.</li><li>Ro'yxat tartibi o'zgarsa, ba'zi provider'larda keraksiz diff chiqadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HashiCorp tavsiyasi: dynamic'ni modul input'idan kelgan haqiqiy o'zgaruvchan ro'yxat uchun ishlat; statik 2-3 blok uchun oddiy yozish aniqroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41266	<p><code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> va <code>terraform.tfstate</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b></p><ul><li><code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> — <b>provider versiyalari va hash'lari</b> qotirilgan fayl. <b>Git'ga commit qilinadi.</b></li><li><code>terraform.tfstate</code> — <b>real infratuzilma holati</b> (resurs ID'lari, atributlari, secret'lar). <b>Git'ga hech qachon commit qilinmaydi</b>, remote backend'da turadi.</li></ul><p><b>Analogiya:</b></p><pre>.terraform.lock.hcl  ~  package-lock.json / go.sum   (tool'lar qaysi versiya)<br>terraform.tfstate    ~  ishlab turgan DB'ning snapshot'i (nima mavjud)</pre><p><b>Lock fayl ichida:</b></p><pre>provider &quot;registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws&quot; {<br>  version     = &quot;5.62.0&quot;<br>  constraints = &quot;~&gt; 5.0&quot;<br>  hashes = [&quot;h1:abc...&quot;, &quot;zh:def...&quot;]<br>}</pre><p>Nega kerak: <code>~&gt; 5.0</code> bugun 5.62, ertaga 5.70 ni yuklashi mumkin — har kim/CI har xil versiya bilan ishlaydi. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41267	<p>Terraform'da sezgir qiymatlarni qanday himoyalaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uch qatlamda himoya: (1) secret'ni <b>kodga yozma</b> — tashqi manbadan ol, (2) <code>sensitive = true</code> bilan CLI chiqishida yashir, (3) <b>state'ni</b> shifrla va accessni chekla — chunki secret baribir state'ga tushadi.</p><p><b>1. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41269	<p>Crossplane (IaC kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Crossplane — <b>Kubernetes ichida</b> ishlaydigan IaC: cloud resurslarini (RDS, S3, VPC) Kubernetes custom resource (YAML) sifatida e'lon qilasan, controller doimiy ravishda real holatni shu YAML'ga moslab turadi.</p><p><b>Terraform'dan farqi:</b></p><pre>Terraform:   odam/CI apply qiladi -&gt; bir martalik moslash -&gt; keyingi apply'gacha drift kuzatilmaydi<br>Crossplane:  controller reconcile loop -&gt; har necha daqiqada tekshiradi va drift'ni o'zi tuzatadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1<br>kind: Bucket<br>metadata:<br>  name: myco-logs<br>spec:<br>  forProvider:<br>    region: eu-central-1<br>  providerConfigRef:<br>    name: default</pre><pre>kubectl apply -f bucket.yaml<br>kubectl get bucket            # READY / SYNCED ustunlari<br>kubectl describe bucket myco-logs</pre><p><b>Kuchli tomoni — Composition:</b> platform jamoasi <code>PostgreSQLInstance</code> degan oddiy API yaratadi, ichida RDS + subnet group + secret + IAM. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41270	<p>Pulumi (IaC kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pulumi — infratuzilmani HCL emas, <b>oddiy dasturlash tillarida</b> (TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, Java) yozish imkonini beruvchi IaC tool. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41271	<p>Ansible nima va agentless arxitekturasi qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ansible — server <b>konfiguratsiyasini</b> (paket o'rnatish, fayl, servis, user) avtomatlashtiruvchi tool. <b>Agentless</b>: boshqariladigan serverlarga hech narsa o'rnatilmaydi — oddiy <b>SSH</b> (Windows'da WinRM) va Python orqali ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Control node (laptop/CI)<br>  | 1. inventory'dan hostlarni o'qiydi<br>  | 2. har task uchun Python modulini generatsiya qiladi<br>  | 3. SSH orqali hostga /tmp ga nusxalaydi<br>  v<br>Managed host:  python modul.py  -&gt; JSON natija qaytaradi -&gt; o'chiriladi<br>  (changed / ok / failed)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># inventory.ini<br>[web]<br>10.0.1.10<br>10.0.1.11</pre><pre># site.yml<br>- hosts: web<br>  become: true<br>  tasks:<br>    - name: nginx o'rnatish<br>      ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present, update_cache: true }<br>    - name: nginx ishlasin<br>      ansible.builtin.service: { name: nginx, state: started, enabled: true }</pre><pre>ansible web -i inventory.ini -m ping<br>ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini site.yml --check --diff   # dry-run<br>ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini site.yml</pre><p><b>Agentless afzalligi:</b> o'rnatish/yangilash kerak bo'lgan agent yo'q, ochiq port yo'q (faqat SSH), boshlash oson. <b>Kamchiligi:</b> push model — Ansible ishlamasa, drift tuzatilmaydi; ko'p hostda SSH sekinroq (<code>forks</code>, <code>pipelining</code>, <code>mitogen</code> bilan tezlatiladi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hostda Python yo'q bo'lsa — <code>raw</code> modul bilan avval o'rnat.</li><li><code>shell:</code>/<code>command:</code> ko'p ishlatish — idempotentlik yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Immutable infra davrida Ansible ko'proq <b>image qurish</b> (Packer bilan) va legacy/bare-metal serverlar uchun. Terraform yaratadi, Ansible sozlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41272	<p>Ansible idempotency nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Idempotency — playbook'ni <b>necha marta ishga tushirsang ham natija bir xil</b>. Birinchi ishga tushishda o'zgarish qiladi (<code>changed</code>), keyingilarida holat allaqachon to'g'ri bo'lgani uchun hech narsa qilmaydi (<code>ok</code>).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> Ansible modullari avval <b>joriy holatni tekshiradi</b>, keyin faqat kerak bo'lsa o'zgartiradi:</p><pre>apt: name=nginx state=present<br>  -&gt; nginx o'rnatilganmi? ha -&gt; ok (hech narsa qilmaydi)<br>                          yo'q -&gt; o'rnatadi -&gt; changed</pre><p><b>Idempotent emas misol:</b></p><pre>- shell: echo &quot;export PATH=$PATH:/opt/bin&quot; &gt;&gt; ~/.bashrc</pre><p>Har ishga tushganda yana bitta qator qo'shiladi!</p><p><b>To'g'ri:</b></p><pre>- ansible.builtin.lineinfile:<br>    path: ~/.bashrc<br>    line: 'export PATH=$PATH:/opt/bin'</pre><p><b><code>shell</code>/<code>command</code> majbur bo'lsa:</b></p><pre>- command: /opt/app/init-db.sh<br>  args:<br>    creates: /opt/app/.db-initialized   # fayl bo'lsa, ishga tushmaydi<br>- shell: grep -q foo /etc/x || echo foo &gt;&gt; /etc/x<br>  changed_when: false</pre><p><b>Tekshirish:</b></p><pre>ansible-playbook site.yml           # 1-marta: changed=5<br>ansible-playbook site.yml           # 2-marta: changed=0 bo'lishi KERAK</pre><p>CI'da ikkinchi run'da <code>changed=0</code> ni tekshir (Molecule <code>idempotence</code> test qadami shuni qiladi).</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Idempotency — xavfsiz qayta ishga tushirish va drift tuzatishning asosi. Yarim yo'lda fail bo'lgan playbook'ni shunchaki qayta ishga tushira olish — production'da eng katta foyda.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41274	<p><code>terraform refresh</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terraform refresh</code> — real infratuzilmani o'qib, <b>state'ni</b> unga moslab yangilaydi (kodga tegmaydi, resurslarni o'zgartirmaydi). Hozir <b>deprecated</b> — o'rniga <code>terraform plan/apply -refresh-only</code> ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Nega eski buyruq xavfli edi:</b></p><pre>terraform refresh  -&gt; state'ni DARHOL o'zgartiradi, nima o'zgarganini ko'rsatmaydi<br>Masalan: resurs vaqtincha API'da ko'rinmadi -&gt; state'dan o'chiriladi -&gt; keyingi plan uni qayta yaratmoqchi bo'ladi</pre><p><b>To'g'ri usul:</b></p><pre>terraform plan -refresh-only     # state qanday o'zgarishini ko'rsatadi<br>terraform apply -refresh-only    # tasdiqlasang, faqat state yangilanadi</pre><p>Chiqish:</p><pre>Note: Objects have changed outside of Terraform<br>  ~ resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>      ~ instance_type = &quot;t3.micro&quot; -&gt; &quot;t3.large&quot;</pre><p><b>Eslatma:</b> oddiy <code>terraform plan</code> ham default ravishda avval refresh qiladi (xotirada). Katta infra'da tezlatish uchun <code>-refresh=false</code> (ehtiyot bilan).</p><p><b>Qachon ishlatiladi:</b></p><ul><li>Drift'ni ko'rish va state'ni qabul qilish (o'zgarish to'g'ri bo'lsa).</li><li>Output qiymatlari eskirganda yangilash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>-refresh-only</code> drift <b>qabul qilish</b> uchun, <code>apply</code> drift <b>bekor qilish</b> uchun. Qaysi biri — qaror, avtomatika emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41275	<p>Terraform data source nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Data source (<code>data</code> bloki) — Terraform <b>boshqarmaydigan</b>, mavjud ma'lumotni <b>faqat o'qish</b>: boshqa jamoa yaratgan VPC, eng yangi AMI, joriy account ID, Secrets Manager qiymati.</p><p><b>resource vs data:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_vpc&quot; &quot;x&quot;  -&gt; yaratadi, o'zgartiradi, o'chiradi (state'da boshqariladi)<br>data     &quot;aws_vpc&quot; &quot;x&quot;  -&gt; faqat o'qiydi, hech qachon o'zgartirmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>data &quot;aws_vpc&quot; &quot;shared&quot; {<br>  tags = { Name = &quot;shared-vpc&quot; }<br>}<br>data &quot;aws_ami&quot; &quot;ubuntu&quot; {<br>  most_recent = true<br>  owners      = [&quot;099720109477&quot;]<br>  filter {<br>    name   = &quot;name&quot;<br>    values = [&quot;ubuntu/images/hvm-ssd/ubuntu-jammy-22.04-amd64-server-*&quot;]<br>  }<br>}<br>data &quot;aws_caller_identity&quot; &quot;me&quot; {}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  ami       = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id<br>  subnet_id = data.aws_subnet.private.id<br>  tags      = { account = data.aws_caller_identity.me.account_id }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>most_recent = true</code> AMI — har plan'da yangi AMI chiqqanda instance <b>replace</b> bo'ladi. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41276	<p><code>terraform taint</code> va <code>terraform apply -replace</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham resursni <b>majburan o'chirib qayta yaratish</b> uchun. <code>terraform taint</code> — eski, <b>deprecated</b>: state'ni darhol belgilaydi. <code>apply -replace=ADDR</code> — yangi usul: plan'da ko'rinadi, bitta qadamda.</p><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b> EC2 buzildi, <code>user_data</code> qayta ishlashi kerak, sertifikat qayta generatsiya — lekin kodda hech narsa o'zgarmagan, Terraform &quot;o'zgarish yo'q&quot; deydi.</p><p><b>Eski usul:</b></p><pre>terraform taint aws_instance.web    # state'ni darhol o'zgartiradi!<br>terraform plan                      # -/+ replace<br>terraform apply</pre><p>Muammo: taint va apply orasida boshqa odam apply qilsa, resurs kutilmaganda replace bo'ladi. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41277	<p>Terraform workspace'lari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Workspace — <b>bitta konfiguratsiya</b>dan bir nechta <b>alohida state</b> yaratish. Har workspace o'z state fayliga ega (<code>env:/dev/...</code>, <code>env:/prod/...</code>), kod esa bir xil.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform workspace new dev<br>terraform workspace new prod<br>terraform workspace select dev<br>terraform workspace list      # * dev<br>terraform apply               # dev state'ga yozadi</pre><pre>locals {<br>  size = terraform.workspace == &quot;prod&quot; ? &quot;m5.large&quot; : &quot;t3.micro&quot;<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  instance_type = local.size<br>  tags          = { env = terraform.workspace }<br>}</pre><p><b>Qanday saqlanadi (S3):</b></p><pre>s3://tfstate/env:/dev/app/terraform.tfstate<br>s3://tfstate/env:/prod/app/terraform.tfstate</pre><p><b>Muammolari (nega prod/dev uchun tavsiya qilinmaydi):</b></p><ul><li>Hamma muhit <b>bitta backend</b> va bir xil credential'larni bo'lishadi — dev uchun ruxsat prod state'ga ham beradi.</li><li>Qaysi workspace tanlanganini unutish — <code>prod</code> da <code>destroy</code> qilish oson.</li><li>Muhitlar orasidagi farqlar <code>terraform.workspace ==</code> shartlari bilan kodga tarqaladi.</li><li>Kodda ko'rinmaydi — fayl tuzilmasidan qaysi muhitlar borligini bilib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Qachon yaxshi:</b> vaqtinchalik bir xil muhitlar — PR uchun preview muhit, feature branch testlari.</p><p><b>Muhitlar uchun yaxshiroq:</b></p><pre>envs/dev/main.tf   -&gt; module &quot;app&quot; + dev backend + dev account<br>envs/prod/main.tf  -&gt; module &quot;app&quot; + prod backend + prod account</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HashiCorp o'zi ham: CLI workspace'lar — kuchli izolyatsiya kerak bo'lgan muhitlar uchun emas. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41278	<p><code>terraform fmt</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terraform fmt</code> — <code>.tf</code> fayllarni <b>standart uslubga</b> avtomatik formatlaydi (indent, <code>=</code> tekislash, bo'sh joylar). <code>gofmt</code> ning Terraform versiyasi.</p><p><b>Oldin:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;b&quot; {<br>bucket=&quot;logs&quot;<br>  tags = {env=&quot;prod&quot;<br>  owner = &quot;platform&quot;}<br>}</pre><p><b><code>terraform fmt</code> dan keyin:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;b&quot; {<br>  bucket = &quot;logs&quot;<br>  tags = {<br>    env   = &quot;prod&quot;<br>    owner = &quot;platform&quot;<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform fmt                # joriy papkani formatlaydi<br>terraform fmt -recursive     # hamma ichki papkalar<br>terraform fmt -check -diff   # CI uchun: o'zgartirmaydi, formatlanmagan bo'lsa exit 3</pre><p><b>CI'da:</b></p><pre>- run: terraform fmt -check -recursive</pre><p><b>Pre-commit hook:</b></p><pre>repos:<br>  - repo: https://github.com/antonbabenko/pre-commit-terraform<br>    hooks: [{ id: terraform_fmt }, { id: terraform_validate }, { id: terraform_tflint }]</pre><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> PR diff'ida faqat mazmunli o'zgarishlar ko'rinadi, uslub haqida bahs yo'q.</p><p><b>Eslatma:</b> <code>fmt</code> faqat formatlaydi — mantiqiy xatolarni topmaydi. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41283	<p>Atlantis (IaC kontekstida) qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Atlantis — self-hosted server: Terraform'ni <b>Pull Request ichida</b> boshqaradi. PR ochilsa avtomatik <code>plan</code> qiladi va natijani comment qiladi; review'dan keyin <code>atlantis apply</code> comment yozilsa apply qiladi va merge qiladi.</p><p><b>Oqim:</b></p><pre>1. PR merge</pre><p><b>Konfiguratsiya:</b></p><pre># atlantis.yaml<br>version: 3<br>projects:<br>  - name: prod-network<br>    dir: envs/prod/network<br>    autoplan: { when_modified: [&quot;*.tf&quot;, &quot;../../modules/**/*.tf&quot;] }<br>    apply_requirements: [approved, mergeable]</pre><p><b>Afzalliklari:</b></p><ul><li>Credential'lar faqat Atlantis server'da — dasturchilarning laptop'ida prod key yo'q.</li><li>Plan va apply bitta joyda, PR tarixi = audit log.</li><li>Directory/project lock — ikki PR bir stack'ni bir vaqtda o'zgartira olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Apply before merge&quot; — apply bo'ldi, lekin PR merge bo'lmasa main va real holat farq qiladi.</li><li>Atlantis server — juda kuchli credential'li target: tarmoqdan himoya, webhook secret, faqat ruxsat etilgan repo'lar.</li><li>Fork'dan PR — zararli kod plan vaqtida ishlashi mumkin (external data source). Fork PR'larni o'chir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Atlantis — oddiy va bepul GitOps for Terraform. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41286	<p>Terraform <code>ignore_changes</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>ignore_changes</code> — <code>lifecycle</code> ichidagi sozlama: ko'rsatilgan atributlarning <b>real dunyodagi o'zgarishini Terraform e'tiborsiz qoldiradi</b> va ularni qaytarishga urinmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> ASG <code>desired_capacity = 2</code>. Har biriga izoh yoz: kim boshqaradi va nega.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41287	<p><code>create_before_destroy</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>create_before_destroy = true</code> — resursni replace qilish kerak bo'lganda <b>avval yangisini yaratib</b>, keyin eskisini o'chiradi. Default tartib aksincha (avval o'chirish) — bu downtime beradi.</p><p><b>Farq:</b></p><pre>Default:                 destroy eski --&gt; (downtime) --&gt; create yangi<br>create_before_destroy:   create yangi --&gt; trafik o'tadi --&gt; destroy eski</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_launch_template&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  name_prefix   = &quot;web-&quot;         # nom unique bo'lishi kerak!<br>  image_id      = var.ami<br>  lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_acm_certificate&quot; &quot;cert&quot; {<br>  domain_name       = &quot;api.myco.com&quot;<br>  validation_method = &quot;DNS&quot;<br>  lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }<br>}</pre><p><b>Asosiy tuzoq — nom to'qnashuvi:</b> Agar <code>name = &quot;web&quot;</code> qat'iy bo'lsa, yangi resurs yaratilayotganda eski hali bor — <code>AlreadyExists</code> xatosi. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41288	<p><code>prevent_destroy</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>prevent_destroy = true</code> — Terraform'ga bu resursni <b>o'chirishga harakat qiladigan har qanday plan'ni xato bilan to'xtatishni</b> buyuradi. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41289	<p>Terraform provider alias nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Provider alias — <b>bir provider'ning bir nechta konfiguratsiyasi</b>: masalan, bitta kodda ikki region yoki ikki AWS account bilan ishlash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CloudFront uchun ACM sertifikat <b>faqat us-east-1</b> da bo'lishi kerak, qolgan infra esa eu-central-1 da.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>provider &quot;aws&quot; {<br>  region = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;            # default<br>}<br>provider &quot;aws&quot; {<br>  alias  = &quot;use1&quot;<br>  region = &quot;us-east-1&quot;<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;site&quot; { bucket = &quot;myco-site&quot; }   # default provider<br><br>resource &quot;aws_acm_certificate&quot; &quot;cdn&quot; {<br>  provider          = aws.use1                              # us-east-1<br>  domain_name       = &quot;myco.com&quot;<br>  validation_method = &quot;DNS&quot;<br>}</pre><p><b>Boshqa account:</b></p><pre>provider &quot;aws&quot; {<br>  alias = &quot;dns&quot;<br>  assume_role { role_arn = &quot;arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/dns-admin&quot; }<br>}</pre><p><b>Modulga uzatish:</b></p><pre>module &quot;dr&quot; {<br>  source    = &quot;./modules/app&quot;<br>  providers = { aws = aws.use1 }<br>}<br># modul ichida:<br>terraform {<br>  required_providers {<br>    aws = { source = &quot;hashicorp/aws&quot;, configuration_aliases = [aws.primary, aws.replica] }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Modul ichida <code>provider</code> blokini e'lon qilish — modulni <code>count</code>/<code>for_each</code> bilan ishlatib bo'lmaydi va o'chirish qiyinlashadi. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41290	<p>Terraform variable precedence qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bir variable bir necha joydan berilsa, <b>keyingisi oldingisini bosadi</b>. Pastdan yuqoriga (eng past ustuvorlikdan eng yuqoriga):</p><pre>1. variable bloki ichidagi default         (eng past)<br>2. TF_VAR_name muhit o'zgaruvchisi<br>3. terraform.tfvars<br>4. terraform.tfvars.json<br>5. *.auto.tfvars / *.auto.tfvars.json (alifbo tartibida)<br>6. -var-file=... va -var=...
