Kutilmagan qiymat ko'rinsa — debug'ni shu ro'yxatdan boshla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41291	<p><code>terraform state rm</code> va <code>terraform state mv</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b></p><ul><li><code>terraform state rm ADDR</code> — resursni <b>state'dan olib tashlaydi</b>, lekin real dunyoda <b>o'chirmaydi</b>. Terraform uni boshqarishni to'xtatadi.</li><li><code>terraform state mv A B</code> — resursning state'dagi <b>manzilini o'zgartiradi</b> (rename, modulga ko'chirish), qayta yaratmasdan.</li></ul><p><b><code>state rm</code> qachon:</b></p><pre>- Resursni boshqa stack/jamoaga topshirish (u yerda import qilinadi)<br>- Resurs Terraform'dan tashqarida qo'lda boshqarilishi kerak<br>- Provider bug: resurs o'chirilgan, lekin state'da qolib ketgan</pre><pre>terraform state rm aws_s3_bucket.legacy<br># TF 1.7+ deklarativ usul:<br>removed {<br>  from = aws_s3_bucket.legacy<br>  lifecycle { destroy = false }<br>}</pre><p><b><code>state mv</code> qachon:</b></p><pre>terraform state mv aws_instance.web aws_instance.app<br>terraform state mv aws_vpc.main module.network.aws_vpc.this<br>terraform state mv 'aws_iam_user.u[0]' 'aws_iam_user.u[&quot;ali&quot;]'</pre><p>Zamonaviy alternativa — kodda <code>moved {}</code> bloki (review qilinadi, hamma muhitda avtomatik).</p><p><b>Xavfsiz ishlash:</b></p><pre>terraform state pull &gt; backup-$(date +%F).tfstate    # avval backup<br>terraform state mv ... <br>terraform plan                                       # &quot;No changes&quot; bo'lishi kerak</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>state rm</code> dan keyin kodda resurs qolsa — keyingi plan uni <b>yangidan yaratmoqchi</b> bo'ladi (nom to'qnashuvi yoki dublikat).</li><li>State buyruqlari darhol yoziladi, plan/review yo'q.</li><li>Qo'shtirnoq: <code>'aws_iam_user.u[&quot;ali&quot;]'</code> — shell'da tirnoqlarni to'g'ri qo'y.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Imkon bo'lsa <code>moved</code>/<code>removed</code>/<code>import</code> bloklarini ishlat — ular PR'da ko'rinadi. CLI state buyruqlari — favqulodda holat uchun, backup bilan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41292	<p>Terraform provider mirroring nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Provider mirroring — Terraform provider binary'larini <b>ichki manbadan</b> (lokal papka yoki ichki HTTP server) yuklash: internetga chiqmasdan, <code>registry.terraform.io</code> ga bog'liq bo'lmasdan.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b></p><ul><li>Air-gapped (internetsiz) muhit — bank, davlat.</li><li>Supply chain nazorati — faqat tasdiqlangan versiyalar.</li><li>CI tezligi va ishonchliligi — registry down bo'lsa ham ishlaydi, har job'da yuz MB yuklanmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform providers mirror -platform=linux_amd64 /opt/tf-mirror</pre><pre># ~/.terraformrc yoki TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE<br>provider_installation {<br>  filesystem_mirror {<br>    path    = &quot;/opt/tf-mirror&quot;<br>    include = [&quot;registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/*&quot;]<br>  }<br>  direct {<br>    exclude = [&quot;registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/*&quot;]<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Yoki <code>network_mirror { url = &quot;https://tf-mirror.internal/&quot; }</code> (Artifactory/Nexus).</p><p><b>Oddiy kesh (mirror emas):</b></p><pre>export TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR=&quot;$HOME/.terraform.d/plugin-cache&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mirror'da kerakli platforma (darwin_arm64 / linux_amd64) bo'lmasa — init fail.</li><li><code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> hash'lari mirror'dagi fayllar bilan mos bo'lishi kerak.</li><li>Mirror'ni yangilashni unutish — provider yangi versiyasi yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Regulated muhitda: Artifactory remote repo (proxy + kesh) + faqat skanerdan o'tgan versiyalar + lock fayl hash'lari = to'liq supply chain nazorati.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41293	<p>Terraform blast radius nima va qanday kamaytiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Blast radius — bitta xato (noto'g'ri <code>apply</code>, buzilgan state, xato kod) <b>qancha infratuzilmaga zarar yetkazishi mumkinligi</b>. Terraform'da asosan bitta state'da qancha resurs borligi bilan aniqlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>Bitta ulkan state: VPC + EKS + 40 RDS + DNS + IAM (3000 resurs)<br> - plan 15 daqiqa<br> - kichik tag o'zgarishi DB'ga ham tegishi mumkin<br> - lock: bitta jamoa apply qilsa, hamma kutadi<br> - state buzilsa -&gt; hamma narsa xavf ostida</pre><p><b>Kamaytirish usullari:</b></p><ol><li><b>State'ni bo'lish</b> — qatlam va ownership bo'yicha:</li></ol><pre>prod/<br>  network/      (kam o'zgaradi)<br>  data/         (RDS, kritik)<br>  platform/     (EKS)<br>  apps/svc-a/   (tez-tez o'zgaradi)</pre><ol><li><b>Muhitlarni ajratish</b> — alohida account, alohida backend, alohida credential.</li><li><b>Least privilege</b> — app pipeline'i IAM/network'ni o'zgartira olmaydi.</li><li><b>Himoyalar</b> — <code>prevent_destroy</code>, deletion protection.</li><li><b>Policy gate</b> — plan'da <code>delete</code> bo'lsa yoki N dan ortiq resurs o'zgarsa qo'shimcha approval.</li><li><b>Progressive apply</b> — dev -&gt; stage -&gt; prod, region-by-region.</li><li><b><code>-target</code> emas</b> — u odatiy ish uchun emas, favqulodda holat uchun.</li></ol><p><b>Tuzoq:</b> Haddan ortiq bo'lish — 200 ta mayda state, ular orasida <code>remote_state</code> spagettisi. Muvozanat kerak.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> State chegarasi = <b>o'zgarish tezligi + ownership + xavf darajasi</b> bo'yicha. Bir xil tezlikda o'zgaradigan, bir jamoaga tegishli narsalar bitta state'da.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41294	<p>Ansible playbook, role va collection farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b></p><ul><li><b>Playbook</b> — YAML fayl: qaysi hostlarda qaysi task/role'lar bajarilishini belgilaydigan <b>ssenariy</b>.</li><li><b>Role</b> — qayta ishlatiladigan <b>standart tuzilmali paket</b> (task, handler, template, default'lar) — masalan <code>nginx</code> role.</li><li><b>Collection</b> — role, modul, plugin'larni birga <b>tarqatish formati</b> (Ansible Galaxy'da), namespace bilan: <code>community.postgresql</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Ierarxiya:</b></p><pre>Collection (amazon.aws)<br>   +-- modules (ec2_instance, s3_bucket)<br>   +-- roles<br>   +-- plugins (inventory, lookup, filter)<br><br>Playbook site.yml<br>   +-- play: hosts: web -&gt; roles: [common, nginx]<br>   +-- play: hosts: db  -&gt; roles: [common, postgres]</pre><p><b>Role tuzilmasi:</b></p><pre>roles/nginx/<br>  tasks/main.yml<br>  handlers/main.yml       # restart nginx<br>  templates/nginx.conf.j2<br>  defaults/main.yml       # override qilinadigan default'lar<br>  vars/main.yml           # ichki, kuchli ustuvorlikdagi<br>  meta/main.yml           # dependency'lar</pre><pre>ansible-galaxy role init roles/nginx<br>ansible-galaxy collection install community.postgresql</pre><p><b>Playbook:</b></p><pre>- hosts: web<br>  become: true<br>  roles:<br>    - role: nginx<br>      vars: { nginx_port: 8080 }</pre><p><b>requirements.yml (versiyalarni qotirish):</b></p><pre>collections:<br>  - name: community.general<br>    version: &quot;9.2.0&quot;</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Playbook'ni yupqa qil (faqat qaysi role qayerga), mantiq role'larda. (app jamoasi)</pre><p><b>Oqim:</b></p><pre>Claim (ns: team-a)  --&gt;  Composite Resource (XR, cluster-scoped)<br>                              |  Composition tanlanadi<br>                              v<br>               +--------------+---------------+<br>          RDS Instance   DBSubnetGroup   SecurityGroup  (managed resources)<br>                              |<br>                       connection secret --&gt; team-a namespace'ga</pre><p><b>Claim misoli:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: platform.myco.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: PostgreSQLInstance<br>metadata: { name: orders-db, namespace: team-a }<br>spec:<br>  parameters: { size: small, version: &quot;16&quot; }<br>  writeConnectionSecretToRef: { name: orders-db-conn }</pre><p>Dasturchi VPC, subnet, encryption haqida bilmaydi — bular Composition ichida, xavfsiz default'lar bilan.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>XRD sxemasini o'zgartirish = API versiyalash muammosi (v1alpha1 -&gt; v1).</li><li>Composition xatolari dasturchiga ko'rinmaydi — <code>kubectl describe</code> va condition'larni yaxshi ochib ber.</li><li>Crossplane v2 da Claim konsepsiyasi soddalashtirilgan (namespaced XR) — versiyani bil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu — platform engineering'ning asosi: infra'ni &quot;mahsulot API&quot;si sifatida berish. Terraform'da plan bilan apply <b>orasida</b> ishga tushadi va qoidaga zid o'zgarishni bloklaydi.</p><p><b>Oqim:</b></p><pre>plan --&gt; Sentinel policy check --&gt; (pass) --&gt; apply<br>                |<br>             (fail) --&gt; advisory: ogohlantirish<br>                        soft-mandatory: admin override qila oladi<br>                        hard-mandatory: hech kim o'tkaza olmaydi</pre><p><b>Misol policy:</b></p><pre>import &quot;tfplan/v2&quot; as tfplan<br><br>allowed_types = [&quot;t3.micro&quot;, &quot;t3.small&quot;, &quot;t3.medium&quot;]<br><br>ec2 = filter tfplan.resource_changes as _, rc {<br>  rc.type is &quot;aws_instance&quot; and rc.change.actions contains &quot;create&quot;<br>}<br><br>main = rule {<br>  all ec2 as _, i { i.change.after.instance_type in allowed_types }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tipik policy'lar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat ruxsat etilgan instance tiplari/region'lar.</li><li>Hamma resursda <code>owner</code>, <code>cost-center</code> tag'lari.</li><li>S3 public bo'lmasin, encryption majburiy.</li><li>Oylik xarajat o'sishi $X dan oshmasin (cost estimation bilan).</li></ul><p><b>Test:</b></p><pre>sentinel test     # test/&lt;policy&gt;/pass.hcl, fail.hcl mock'lar bilan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat HashiCorp tijorat mahsulotlarida — vendor lock-in.</li><li>Yangi til o'rganish kerak; OPA/Rego bilan bilim boshqa joyda (K8s) ham ishlatiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sentinel vs OPA: HCP Terraform'da ikkalasi ham qo'llanadi. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41302	<p>KubeVela nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> KubeVela — <b>OAM</b> (Open Application Model) asosidagi CNCF platformasi: dasturchi Kubernetes detallarisiz ilovani oddiy &quot;Application&quot; sifatida tasvirlaydi, platform jamoasi esa uni Deployment, Service, Ingress, HPA va hatto cloud resurslariga (Terraform/Crossplane orqali) aylantiradigan shablonlarni beradi.</p><p><b>Model:</b></p><pre>Application<br>  +-- components   (nima ishga tushadi: webservice, worker, cloud DB)<br>  +-- traits       (qanday ishlaydi: scaler, gateway, sidecar)<br>  +-- policies     (qayerga: topology, override)<br>  +-- workflow     (qadamlar: deploy dev -&gt; approval -&gt; deploy prod)</pre><p><b>Misol:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: core.oam.dev/v1beta1<br>kind: Application<br>metadata: { name: orders }<br>spec:<br>  components:<br>    - name: api<br>      type: webservice<br>      properties: { image: myco/orders:1.4.0, port: 8080 }<br>      traits:<br>        - type: scaler<br>          properties: { replicas: 3 }<br>        - type: gateway<br>          properties: { domain: orders.myco.com, http: { &quot;/&quot;: 8080 } }</pre><pre>vela up -f app.yaml<br>vela status orders</pre><p>Component/trait turlari <b>CUE</b> tilida yozilgan definition'lar — platform jamoasi yaratadi.</p><p><b>Qachon:</b> ko'p jamoaga yagona deploy abstraksiyasi kerak, multi-cluster, delivery workflow bitta joyda.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b> CUE o'rganish, kichik ekotizim, yana bir abstraksiya qatlami — muammo chiqsa ostidagi K8s'ni baribir bilish kerak.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> KubeVela, Crossplane, Backstage templates — hammasi bir maqsad: platform-as-a-product. Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41304	<p>Terraform <code>templatefile()</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>templatefile(path, vars)</code> — tashqi shablon faylni o'qib, ichidagi <code>${...}</code> va <code>%{ for }</code>/<code>%{ if }</code> direktivalarni berilgan o'zgaruvchilar bilan to'ldirib, <b>tayyor matn</b> qaytaradigan funksiya. Odatda <code>user_data</code>, config fayl, IAM policy generatsiyasi uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>user_data</code> ni HCL ichida heredoc bilan yozish — uzun, tirnoqlar chalkash, qayta ishlatib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># templates/init.sh.tftpl<br>#!/bin/bash<br>echo &quot;ENV=${env}&quot; &gt; /etc/app.env<br>%{ for p in ports ~}<br>ufw allow ${p}<br>%{ endfor ~}</pre><pre>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  user_data = templatefile(&quot;${path.module}/templates/init.sh.tftpl&quot;, {<br>    env   = var.env<br>    ports = [80, 443]<br>  })<br>}</pre><p>Natija:</p><pre>echo &quot;ENV=prod&quot; &gt; /etc/app.env<br>ufw allow 80<br>ufw allow 443</pre><p><b>JSON uchun yaxshi usul</b> (qo'lda vergul bilan kurashmaslik):</p><pre>${jsonencode({ bucket = bucket, actions = actions })}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bash'ning o'z <code>${VAR}</code> sintaksisi Terraform bilan to'qnashadi — bash o'zgaruvchisini <code>$${VAR}</code> deb escape qil.</li><li><code>path.module</code> siz nisbiy yo'l modul ichida noto'g'ri papkani ko'rsatadi.</li><li><code>~</code> — bo'sh joy/yangi qatorni olib tashlaydi (strip marker).</li><li>Eski <code>template_file</code> data source — deprecated, ishlatma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Fayl kengaytmasini <code>.tftpl</code> qil (IDE taniydi). Murakkab mantiq shablonda emas, <code>locals</code> da tayyorlanib shablonga beriladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41305	<p><code>null_resource</code> va <code>terraform_data</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham <b>hech qanday real infratuzilma yaratmaydigan</b> &quot;bo'sh&quot; resurs: provisioner'larni ishga tushirish yoki boshqa resurslarni qayta yaratishga trigger bo'lish uchun. <code>null_resource</code> — <code>hashicorp/null</code> provider'idan (alohida yuklash kerak). <code>terraform_data</code> (TF 1.4+) — Terraform'ga <b>o'rnatilgan</b>, provider kerak emas va qo'shimcha imkoniyatlari bor.</p><p><b>null_resource (eski):</b></p><pre>resource &quot;null_resource&quot; &quot;migrate&quot; {<br>  triggers = { version = var.app_version }   # faqat string map<br>  provisioner &quot;local-exec&quot; { command = &quot;./migrate.sh&quot; }<br>}</pre><p><b>terraform_data (yangi):</b></p><pre>resource &quot;terraform_data&quot; &quot;migrate&quot; {<br>  triggers_replace = [var.app_version]        # istalgan tip<br>  provisioner &quot;local-exec&quot; { command = &quot;./migrate.sh ${self.output}&quot; }<br>  input = var.app_version                     # qiymat saqlaydi -&gt; self.output<br>}</pre><p><b>Asosiy foydalanish — <code>replace_triggered_by</code>:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;terraform_data&quot; &quot;ami_version&quot; { input = var.ami_version }<br><br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  lifecycle {<br>    replace_triggered_by = [terraform_data.ami_version]<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><code>replace_triggered_by</code> faqat resurslarga havola qila oladi, variable'ga emas — <code>terraform_data</code> oraliq &quot;ko'prik&quot; bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Farqlar:</b> | | null_resource | terraform_data | |---|---|---| | Provider | <code>hashicorp/null</code> | built-in | | triggers | <code>map(string)</code> | istalgan qiymat | | Qiymat saqlash | yo'q | <code>input</code> / <code>output</code> |</p><p><b>Migratsiya:</b> TF 1.9+ <code>moved { from = null_resource.x  to = terraform_data.x }</code> qo'llaydi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provisioner'li bo'sh resurs — ko'pincha IaC'ga mos kelmaydigan ishni Terraform'ga tiqish belgisi. Migration, seed, script — odatda CI/CD qadami yoki K8s Job'da bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41306	<p><code>local-exec</code> va <code>remote-exec</code> provisioner farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b></p><ul><li><code>local-exec</code> — buyruqni <b>Terraform ishlayotgan mashinada</b> (laptop, CI runner) bajaradi.</li><li><code>remote-exec</code> — buyruqni <b>yaratilgan serverning ichida</b> (SSH/WinRM orqali) bajaradi.</li></ul><p><b>Qayerda ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CI runner (terraform apply)<br>   |-- local-exec:   ./notify.sh, aws cli, kubectl, ansible-playbook<br>   |<br>   +--SSH--&gt; yangi EC2<br>               |-- remote-exec: apt install, systemctl start</pre><p><b>Misollar:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  provisioner &quot;local-exec&quot; {<br>    command = &quot;echo ${self.private_ip} &gt;&gt; inventory.txt&quot;<br>  }<br>  provisioner &quot;remote-exec&quot; {<br>    inline = [&quot;sudo apt-get update&quot;, &quot;sudo apt-get install -y nginx&quot;]<br>    connection {<br>      type        = &quot;ssh&quot;<br>      user        = &quot;ubuntu&quot;<br>      private_key = file(&quot;~/.ssh/id_rsa&quot;)<br>      host        = self.public_ip<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><code>when = destroy</code> — o'chirish paytida ishlaydi; <code>on_failure = continue</code> — xato apply'ni to'xtatmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega HashiCorp &quot;oxirgi chora&quot; deydi:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat <b>yaratilishda</b> bir marta ishlaydi — keyin o'zgartirsang qayta ishlamaydi.</li><li>Plan'da nima qilishini ko'rsatmaydi, idempotent emas, drift kuzatilmaydi.</li><li>Fail bo'lsa resurs <b>tainted</b> — keyingi apply uni qayta yaratadi.</li><li><code>remote-exec</code> uchun SSH ochiq va kalit CI'da bo'lishi kerak — xavfsizlik muammosi.</li></ul><p><b>Yaxshiroq alternativalar:</b></p><ul><li>Server sozlash: <code>user_data</code> / cloud-init, yoki Packer bilan tayyor image.</li><li>Konfiguratsiya: Ansible (Terraform output -&gt; dinamik inventory).</li><li>Lokal hodisalar: CI pipeline qadami.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provisioner ishlatsang, bu vaqtinchalik yechim ekanini yoz. Immutable infra: image tayyor, server ichiga SSH bilan kirish kerak emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41307	<p>Provider dependency lock nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Provider dependency lock — <code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> fayli: har bir provider'ning <b>aniq tanlangan versiyasi va checksum'larini</b> qotiradi. Shunda har bir <code>terraform init</code> (laptop, CI, hamkasb) aynan bir xil provider binary'sini ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>required_providers {<br>  aws = { source = &quot;hashicorp/aws&quot;, version = &quot;~&gt; 5.0&quot; }<br>}</pre><p><code>~&gt; 5.0</code> = 5.x ning har qanday versiyasi. Bugun CI 5.60 ni yuklaydi, ertaga 5.70 chiqadi — u yangi default yoki bug bilan keladi. Kod o'zgarmagan, lekin plan o'zgardi.</p><p><b>Lock bilan:</b></p><pre>init (birinchi marta) -&gt; 5.62.0 tanlanadi -&gt; lock faylga yoziladi (versiya + hash)<br>init (keyingi)        -&gt; lock'dagi 5.62.0 aynan yuklanadi, hash tekshiriladi</pre><p>Hash mos kelmasa — <code>init</code> xato beradi (binary o'zgartirilgan bo'lishi mumkin — supply chain himoyasi).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform init                    # lock'ni hurmat qiladi<br>terraform init -upgrade           # constraint ichida yangi versiyaga o'tadi, lock'ni yangilaydi<br>terraform providers lock \<br>  -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64 -platform=darwin_amd64<br>git add .terraform.lock.hcl</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lock faylni commit qilmaslik.</li><li>Faqat bitta platforma hash'lari — boshqa OS'dagi CI'da &quot;doesn't match any of the checksums&quot;.</li><li>Lock faqat <b>provider</b>larni qotiradi — modullarni emas (modul uchun <code>?ref=</code> yoki <code>version =</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Reproducible build printsipi IaC'ga: kod + lock = deterministik plan. Provider upgrade — alohida, review qilinadigan o'zgarish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41308	<p>Terraform <code>self</code> reference nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>self</code> — resursning <b>o'z atributlariga</b> havola. Faqat resurs ichidagi <code>provisioner</code>, <code>connection</code> va <code>postcondition</code> bloklarida ishlaydi — u yerda resurs nomini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatib bo'lmaydi (o'ziga o'zi bog'liqlik sikli bo'ladi).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  provisioner &quot;local-exec&quot; {<br>    command = &quot;echo ${aws_instance.web.public_ip}&quot;   # XATO: Cycle / self-reference<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b>To'g'ri:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  ami           = var.ami<br>  instance_type = &quot;t3.micro&quot;<br><br>  connection {<br>    type = &quot;ssh&quot;<br>    host = self.public_ip<br>    user = &quot;ubuntu&quot;<br>  }<br>  provisioner &quot;local-exec&quot; {<br>    command = &quot;echo ${self.id} ${self.private_ip} &gt;&gt; hosts.txt&quot;<br>  }<br>  provisioner &quot;local-exec&quot; {<br>    when    = destroy<br>    command = &quot;./deregister.sh ${self.id}&quot;     # destroy'da faqat self ishlatiladi<br>  }<br>  lifecycle {<br>    postcondition {<br>      condition     = self.instance_state == &quot;running&quot;<br>      error_message = &quot;Instance running emas.&quot;<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><b><code>count</code>/<code>for_each</code> bilan:</b> <code>self</code> — joriy nusxani bildiradi (<code>self.id</code> aynan shu instance'niki).</p><p><b>Tuzoq:</b> <code>when = destroy</code> provisioner'larida boshqa resurs yoki variable'larga havola qilib bo'lmaydi — faqat <code>self</code>, <code>count.index</code>, <code>each.key</code>. Kerakli ma'lumotni oldindan resursning tag'iga yoki <code>terraform_data.input</code> ga saqla.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>self</code> kamdan-kam kerak bo'ladi — chunki provisioner'lar o'zi kam ishlatilishi kerak. Ko'p <code>self</code> ko'rsang — IaC'ga mos kelmaydigan ish Terraform'da qilinyapti.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41309	<p>Terraform Module Registry nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Terraform Module Registry — tayyor, versiyalangan modullar katalogi. <b>Public</b>: <code>registry.terraform.io</code> (masalan <code>terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws</code>). <b>Private</b>: HCP Terraform, GitLab, Artifactory yoki o'z registry'ing — kompaniya ichki modullari uchun.</p><p><b>Ishlatish:</b></p><pre>module &quot;vpc&quot; {<br>  source  = &quot;terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws&quot;<br>  version = &quot;~&gt; 5.13&quot;<br><br>  name            = &quot;prod&quot;<br>  cidr            = &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;<br>  azs             = [&quot;eu-central-1a&quot;, &quot;eu-central-1b&quot;]<br>  private_subnets = [&quot;10.0.1.0/24&quot;, &quot;10.0.2.0/24&quot;]<br>}</pre><p>Private registry:</p><pre>source  = &quot;app.terraform.io/myco/vpc/aws&quot;<br>version = &quot;2.1.0&quot;</pre><p><b>Registry vs Git source:</b> | Registry | Git (<code>git::...?ref=v1.2.0</code>) | |---|---| | <code>version</code> constraint (<code>~&gt; 5.0</code>) | faqat aniq ref | | hujjat, input/output avtomatik ko'rinadi | README qo'lda | | nom formati: <code>&lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;name&gt;/&lt;provider&gt;</code> | istalgan repo |</p><p><b>Public modul tanlashda tekshir:</b></p><ul><li>Yuklab olishlar soni, oxirgi release sanasi, issue'larga javob.</li><li>Verified/partner belgisi.</li><li>Kodni o'qi — u sening account'ingda resurs yaratadi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Versiyasiz chaqirish — har init'da eng yangi major (breaking change) kelishi mumkin.</li><li>Ulkan &quot;hamma narsani qiladigan&quot; public modul — 200 ta input, debug qiyin.</li><li>Supply chain: begona modul kodi plan vaqtida external data source orqali buyruq ishlatishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Public modullardan o'rgan, lekin kritik infra uchun ichki fork/wrapper qil: xavfsizlik default'lari, versiya nazorati, sening standartlaring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H20 Terraform & OpenTofu core	idrill-41310	<p><code>terraform force-unlock</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terraform force-unlock LOCK_ID</code> — state'dagi <b>qolib ketgan lock'ni qo'lda olib tashlaydi</b>. Lock odatda apply tugaganda avtomatik bo'shaydi, lekin jarayon o'ldirilsa (Ctrl+C ikki marta, CI runner crash, tarmoq uzilishi) — lock qoladi va hech kim apply qila olmaydi.</p><p><b>Belgisi:</b></p><pre>Error: Error acquiring the state lock<br>Lock Info:<br>  ID:        6b8a1c2e-...<br>  Path:      myco-tfstate/prod/network/terraform.tfstate<br>  Operation: OperationTypeApply<br>  Who:       runner@ci-7f9c<br>  Created:   2026-10-03 09:12:44 UTC</pre><p><b>To'g'ri tartib:</b></p><ol><li><b>Kim egalik qilayotganini tekshir</b> — <code>Who</code> va <code>Created</code>. CI job hali ishlayaptimi? Hamkasbing apply qilyaptimi?</li><li>Haqiqatan hech kim ishlamayotganiga ishonch hosil qil (CI dashboard, jamoaga yoz).</li><li>Unlock:</li></ol><pre>terraform force-unlock 6b8a1c2e-...</pre><ol><li><code>terraform plan</code> — avvalgi apply yarim yo'lda to'xtagan bo'lishi mumkin; state va real holatni tekshir.</li></ol><p><b>XAVF:</b> Boshqa apply hali ishlayotganda unlock qilsang — ikki jarayon bir vaqtda state'ga yozadi, state buziladi, &quot;yetim&quot; resurslar paydo bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Lock qayerda turadi:</b> S3 native lock (<code>.tflock</code> fayl), DynamoDB jadval (eski usul), GCS object, HCP Terraform workspace lock.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lock ID'ni xato xabaridan aynan ko'chir.</li><li>Har gal lock qolsa — sababini tuzat: CI'da <code>timeout</code> va graceful cancel, runner'lar o'ldirilmasin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> force-unlock — favqulodda vosita, runbook'da bo'lsin: kim qila oladi, avval nima tekshiriladi. Tez-tez kerak bo'lsa — pipeline'da concurrency nazorati yo'q (bitta stack = bitta navbat).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::iac sec::h20 Terraform_OpenTofu_core
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41311	<p><code>terraform plan</code> lifecycle'ini qadamma-qadam tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terraform plan</code> — &quot;kod nima bo'lishini xohlaydi&quot; va &quot;real dunyoda hozir nima bor&quot; ni solishtirib, ularni tenglashtirish uchun <b>qanday o'zgarishlar</b> kerakligini hisoblaydi. Hech narsani o'zgartirmaydi — faqat reja tuzadi.</p><h4>Qadam-baqadam</h4><pre> .tf fayllar --&gt; 1. parse + DAG<br> backend     --&gt; 2. state o'qish (+ lock)<br> cloud API   --&gt; 3. refresh (jonli holat)<br>                 4. diff: kerakli vs mavjud<br>                 5. reja chiqarish (+ -out fayl)</pre><ol><li><b>Konfiguratsiyani o'qish va graf qurish.</b> Barcha <code>.tf</code> fayllar parse qilinadi, <code>var</code>/<code>local</code>/<code>data</code> hisoblanadi. Resurslar orasidagi havolalar (<code>aws_subnet.x.vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id</code>) asosida <b>DAG</b> (yo'naltirilgan, aylanasiz graf) quriladi. Bu bajarish tartibini belgilaydi — bog'liq bo'lmaganlar parallel (default 10 ta).</li><li><b>State'ni o'qish.</b> Remote backend'dan (S3, GCS, TF Cloud) <code>terraform.tfstate</code> olinadi — Terraform oxirgi marta nima yaratganini eslab qoladigan xarita (<code>aws_instance.web</code> = <code>i-0abc123</code>). Backend qo'llasa <b>lock</b> qo'yiladi (S3 + DynamoDB yoki S3 native lock) — ikki kishi bir vaqtda ishlamasin.</li><li><b>Refresh.</b> Har resurs uchun provider cloud API'ni chaqiradi (<code>DescribeInstances</code>) va haqiqiy holatni oladi. Kimdir konsolda qo'lda o'zgartirgan bo'lsa (drift) — shu yerda ko'rinadi.</li><li><b>Diff hisoblash.</b> Har resurs uchun: kodda bor, state'da yo'q — <b>create</b> (<code>+</code>); ikkalasida bor, atribut farq — <b>update in-place</b> (<code>~</code>); o'zgarmas atribut farq (masalan AMI, subnet) — <b>replace</b> (<code>-/+</code>); state'da bor, kodda yo'q — <b>destroy</b> (<code>-</code>).</li><li><b>Natija.</b> <code>Plan: 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.</code></li></ol><h4><code>-out</code> — nega muhim</h4><pre>terraform plan -out=tfplan<br>terraform apply tfplan</pre><p><code>-out</code>siz <code>apply</code> rejani <b>qaytadan</b> hisoblaydi — orada kimdir nimanidir o'zgartirgan bo'lsa, siz ko'rib tasdiqlaganingizdan boshqa narsa bajariladi. CI'da: plan -&gt; review -&gt; aynan shu faylni apply.</p><h4>Foydali flag'lar</h4><ul><li><code>-refresh=false</code> — refresh'siz, tez (katta state'da), lekin drift ko'rinmaydi.</li><li><code>-refresh-only</code> — faqat drift'ni ko'rsatadi, kod o'zgarishisiz.</li><li><code>-target=aws_instance.web</code> — faqat bitta resurs (favqulodda holat uchun, odatiy ish uchun emas).</li><li><code>terraform show -json tfplan</code> — rejani JSON'da (policy tekshiruvlari uchun).</li></ul><h4>Tuzoq</h4><p><code>(known after apply)</code> — qiymat faqat yaratilgandan keyin ma'lum (masalan yangi ID). Bunday qiymatga bog'liq <code>for_each</code>/<code>count</code> xato beradi: <code>Invalid for_each argument</code>.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Plan'da eng xavfli belgi — <code>-/+</code> (<b>replace</b>): DB yoki disk o'chib qayta yaratiladi, ma'lumot yo'qoladi. Review'da avval shuni qidiring; kritik resurslarga <code>lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }</code> qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41312	<p>Terraform graph cycle nima va qanday hal qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cycle — resurslar <b>bir-biriga aylana</b> bo'lib bog'langan: A uchun B kerak, B uchun A. Terraform qaysi birini birinchi yaratishni bilmaydi va <code>Error: Cycle: aws_security_group.a, aws_security_group.b</code> beradi. Yechim — aylanani <b>buzish</b>: bog'lanishni alohida resursga chiqarish.</p><h4>Klassik misol</h4><p>App SG DB'ga, DB SG App'dan trafikka ruxsat beradi:</p><pre>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  egress { security_groups = [aws_security_group.db.id] }   # app -&gt; db<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;db&quot; {<br>  ingress { security_groups = [aws_security_group.app.id] } # db &lt;- app<br>}</pre><p><code>app</code> uchun <code>db.id</code> kerak, <code>db</code> uchun <code>app.id</code> kerak — cycle.</p><h4>Yechim: qoidalarni alohida resursga chiqarish</h4><pre>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;app&quot; { name = &quot;app&quot; }<br>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;db&quot;  { name = &quot;db&quot; }<br><br>resource &quot;aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule&quot; &quot;db_from_app&quot; {<br>  security_group_id            = aws_security_group.db.id<br>  referenced_security_group_id = aws_security_group.app.id<br>  from_port   = 5432<br>  to_port     = 5432<br>  ip_protocol = &quot;tcp&quot;<br>}</pre><p>Endi tartib: ikkala SG (bog'liqliksiz) -&gt; keyin qoida (ikkalasiga bog'liq). Aylana yo'q.</p><h4>Cycle'ni topish</h4><pre>terraform graph -type=plan | dot -Tsvg &gt; graph.svg</pre><p>Xato xabari aylanadagi resurslarni sanaydi — shu zanjirni grafda kuzating.</p><h4>Boshqa odatiy sabablar</h4><ul><li><b>Modullar orasida</b>: A modul output'i B ga, B output'i A ga kiradi. Yechim: umumiy qismni uchinchi modulga chiqarish.</li><li><b><code>depends_on</code> ortiqcha</b> — keraksiz qo'lda bog'liqlik aylana hosil qiladi.</li><li><b><code>create_before_destroy</code></b> bilan aralash lifecycle — bog'liq resurslarda ham kerak bo'ladi.</li><li>Provider konfiguratsiyasi shu konfiguratsiyada yaratilayotgan resursga bog'liq (masalan EKS klaster va uning <code>kubernetes</code> provider'i) — alohida state'ga ajratish yaxshiroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Inline blok (<code>ingress {}</code> SG ichida) va alohida qoida resurslarini <b>aralashtirmang</b> — ular bir-birini o'chirib tashlaydi va har plan'da farq chiqadi. Bitta usulni tanlang, afzali alohida resurslar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41313	<p>Terraform bilan ASG'da zero-downtime AMI yangilashni qanday qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yangi AMI bilan <b>yangi launch template versiyasi</b> yaratiladi, ASG esa <b>instance refresh</b> orqali eski server'larni bosqichma-bosqich (rolling) yangisiga almashtiradi — har doim yetarli sog'lom server ishlab turadi. Terraform faqat template va ASG sozlamasini yangilaydi, almashtirishni AWS bajaradi.</p><h4>Kod</h4><pre>resource &quot;aws_launch_template&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  name_prefix   = &quot;app-&quot;<br>  image_id      = var.ami_id           # yangi AMI = yangi versiya<br>  instance_type = &quot;t3.medium&quot;<br>  lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_autoscaling_group&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  min_size            = 3<br>  max_size            = 6<br>  vpc_zone_identifier = var.subnets<br>  target_group_arns   = [aws_lb_target_group.app.arn]<br>  health_check_type   = &quot;ELB&quot;           # EC2 emas — ilova haqiqatan javob beradimi<br>  health_check_grace_period = 120<br><br>  launch_template {<br>    id      = aws_launch_template.app.id<br>    version = aws_launch_template.app.latest_version<br>  }<br><br>  instance_refresh {<br>    strategy = &quot;Rolling&quot;<br>    preferences {<br>      min_healthy_percentage = 90       # har doim kamida 90% sog'lom<br>      instance_warmup        = 120      # yangi server tayyor bo'lishini kutish<br>      auto_rollback          = true     # yangi server'lar yiqilsa — qaytarish<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><h4>Nima bo'ladi</h4><ol><li><code>ami_id</code> o'zgaradi -&gt; <code>terraform apply</code> -&gt; launch template'ning yangi versiyasi.</li><li>ASG template versiyasi o'zgarganini ko'radi -&gt; instance refresh boshlanadi.</li><li>AWS eski server'larni partiyalab almashtiradi: yangi server ishga tushadi -&gt; ALB health check'dan o'tadi -&gt; warmup -&gt; eskisi to'xtatiladi (ALB <b>connection draining</b> bilan joriy so'rovlarni tugatadi).</li><li>Yangi server'lar health check'dan o'tmasa — refresh to'xtaydi va <code>auto_rollback</code> eski versiyaga qaytaradi.</li></ol><h4>Muhim tafsilotlar</h4><ul><li><code>health_check_type = &quot;ELB&quot;</code> — busiz ASG faqat &quot;VM ishlayaptimi&quot;ni tekshiradi, ilova buzuq bo'lsa ham &quot;sog'lom&quot; deydi.</li><li><code>deregistration_delay</code> (target group) — so'rovlar tugashi uchun vaqt (masalan 30s).</li><li>Terraform <code>apply</code> refresh <b>tugashini kutmaydi</b> — CI'da <code>aws autoscaling describe-instance-refreshes</code> bilan holatni tekshiring.</li><li>Muqobil: blue/green — ikkita ASG, ALB listener'ni almashtirish. Tezroq rollback, lekin vaqtincha 2x resurs.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy zero-downtime ilovaga ham bog'liq: graceful shutdown (<code>SIGTERM</code>da yangi so'rov qabul qilmay, joriylarni tugatish) va DB migratsiyalari eski va yangi versiya bilan bir vaqtda ishlashi (expand/contract). Infra to'g'ri, ilova esa <code>SIGTERM</code>da darhol o'lsa — baribir 5xx bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41314	<p>HCL'da <code>lookup()</code>, <code>try()</code> va <code>can()</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uchalasi ham &quot;qiymat bo'lmasa yoki xato bo'lsa nima qilish&quot; uchun. <b><code>lookup</code></b> — map'dan kalit bo'yicha olish, yo'q bo'lsa default. <b><code>try</code></b> — bir nechta ifodani sinab, <b>birinchi xatosizini</b> qaytaradi. <b><code>can</code></b> — ifoda xatosizmi yoki yo'qmi, <b><code>true/false</code></b> qaytaradi (validatsiya uchun).</p><h4>lookup — map'dan default bilan</h4><pre>variable &quot;instance_types&quot; {<br>  default = { dev = &quot;t3.small&quot;, prod = &quot;m5.large&quot; }<br>}<br>locals {<br>  type = lookup(var.instance_types, var.env, &quot;t3.micro&quot;)<br>}</pre><p><code>env = &quot;staging&quot;</code> bo'lsa — kalit yo'q, <code>&quot;t3.micro&quot;</code>. Faqat <b>bir darajali</b> map uchun. Zamonaviy Terraform'da ko'pincha <code>var.instance_types[var.env]</code> yoki <code>try</code> bilan almashtiriladi.</p><h4>try — xatoga chidamli o'qish</h4><p>Chuqur ichki tuzilma, ba'zi maydonlar bo'lmasligi mumkin:</p><pre>locals {<br>  # settings.network.cidr yo'q bo'lsa — default<br>  cidr = try(var.settings.network.cidr, &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;)<br><br>  # turli formatdagi input'ni normallashtirish: string yoki list<br>  subnets = try(tolist(var.subnets), [var.subnets])<br>}</pre><p><code>try</code> faqat <b>dinamik</b> xatolarni (yo'q atribut, tur o'zgartirish) ushlaydi. Sintaksis xatosi yoki noto'g'ri resurs nomi baribir xato beradi.</p><h4>can — validatsiya</h4><pre>variable &quot;cidr&quot; {<br>  type = string<br>  validation {<br>    condition     = can(cidrhost(var.cidr, 0))<br>    error_message = &quot;cidr to'g'ri CIDR bo'lishi kerak, masalan 10.0.0.0/16.&quot;<br>  }<br>}<br><br>variable &quot;name&quot; {<br>  validation {<br>    condition     = can(regex(&quot;^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,30}$&quot;, var.name))<br>    error_message = &quot;Faqat kichik harf, raqam va '-'.&quot;<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><code>cidrhost</code> xato bersa <code>can</code> <code>false</code> qaytaradi — validatsiya chiroyli xabar bilan to'xtaydi.</p><h4>Qisqa jadval</h4><p>| Funksiya | Qaytaradi | Qachon | |---|---|---| | <code>lookup(m, k, d)</code> | qiymat yoki default | oddiy map, kalit bo'lmasligi mumkin | | <code>try(a, b, ...)</code> | birinchi xatosiz qiymat | ichki tuzilma, tur farqi | | <code>can(expr)</code> | <code>bool</code> | <code>validation</code>, shart |</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>try</code>ni ortiqcha ishlatmang — u haqiqiy xatolarni (masalan nomni noto'g'ri yozish natijasida yo'q atribut) jimgina default'ga aylantiradi va bug yashirinadi. Kutilgan &quot;yo'qlik&quot; uchun <code>optional()</code> atributli <code>object</code> turi aniqroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41315	<p>OpenTofu'da variable'larni erta baholash (early evaluation) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Terraform'da <code>backend</code> va <code>module source</code> bloklari variable'larni qabul qilmaydi — ular <code>init</code> vaqtida, variable'lar hisoblanishidan <b>oldin</b> o'qiladi. Resurs atributlari va <code>data</code> source'lari — yo'q (ular apply vaqtida ma'lum). Qiymat <code>init</code>da berilishi kerak, aks holda xato.</p><h4>Qachon foydali</h4><ul><li>Ko'p muhit (dev/stage/prod) bitta kod bilan, faqat <code>tfvars</code> farqi.</li><li>Modul versiyasini markazdan boshqarish.</li><li>Terragrunt'siz soddaroq tuzilma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu OpenTofu'ga xos — Terraform bilan <b>mos emas</b>. Tanlovni jamoa darajasida qiling: litsenziya (OpenTofu MPL, Terraform BSL), xususiyatlar (OpenTofu: state shifrlash, early eval) va ekotizim (TF Cloud) bo'yicha.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt

Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41317	<p>Terragrunt <code>dependency</code> bloki nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>dependency</code> bloki — bir Terragrunt modulining boshqa modul <b>output'lariga</b> muhtojligini e'lon qiladi. Terragrunt o'sha modulning state'idan output'larni avtomatik o'qiydi va <code>run-all</code> paytida modullarni <b>to'g'ri tartibda</b> (avval VPC, keyin EKS) bajaradi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>VPC va EKS alohida state'larda (blast radius kichik bo'lsin). Ularni qo'lda ko'chirish — xato manbai; <code>terraform_remote_state</code> data source — har modulda backend tafsilotlarini takrorlash.</p><h4>Ishlatish</h4><pre># live/prod/eks/terragrunt.hcl<br>include &quot;root&quot; { path = find_in_parent_folders() }<br><br>terraform { source = &quot;git::git@github.com:org/modules.git//eks?ref=v2.3.0&quot; }<br><br>dependency &quot;vpc&quot; {<br>  config_path = &quot;../vpc&quot;<br>}<br><br>inputs = {<br>  vpc_id     = dependency.vpc.outputs.vpc_id<br>  subnet_ids = dependency.vpc.outputs.private_subnet_ids<br>}</pre><h4>Nima bo'ladi</h4><ol><li>Terragrunt <code>../vpc</code> modulida <code>terraform output -json</code> bajaradi.</li><li>Natija <code>dependency.vpc.outputs</code> sifatida mavjud.</li><li><code>terragrunt run-all apply</code> — modullar orasida graf quriladi: <code>vpc</code> -&gt; <code>eks</code> -&gt; <code>app</code>. Bog'liq bo'lmaganlar parallel.</li><li><code>run-all destroy</code> — <b>teskari</b> tartibda (avval app, keyin eks, keyin vpc).</li></ol><h4>Faqat tartib kerak bo'lsa</h4><p>Output kerak emas, faqat ketma-ketlik:</p><pre>dependencies {<br>  paths = [&quot;../vpc&quot;, &quot;../iam&quot;]<br>}</pre><h4>Tuzoqlar</h4><ul><li>Upstream hali apply qilinmagan — output yo'q, <code>plan</code> yiqiladi. Yechim: <code>mock_outputs</code>.</li><li>Har <code>dependency</code> — alohida <code>terraform output</code> chaqiruvi; ko'p modulda sekin. <code>dependency_fetch_output_from_state = true</code> (S3'dan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'qish) tezlashtiradi.</li><li><code>run-all apply</code> hamma narsani bir vaqtda o'zgartiradi — production'da xavfli. Ko'pincha CI'da faqat o'zgargan modullar apply qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bog'liqlik grafini sayoz saqlang. VPC kabi kam o'zgaradigan &quot;poydevor&quot; qatlami yuqorida; tez-tez o'zgaradigan ilova qatlamlari pastda. Chuqur zanjir = har kichik o'zgarishda uzoq va xavfli <code>run-all</code>.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41318	<p>Terragrunt <code>mock_outputs</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>mock_outputs</code> — <code>dependency</code> modul hali apply qilinmagan (output'lari yo'q) paytda ishlatiladigan <b>soxta qiymatlar</b>. Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41319	<p>CI/CD'da avtomatik Terraform drift detection'ni qanday qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Drift — real infratuzilma kodda yozilganidan <b>farq qilishi</b> (kimdir konsolda qo'lda o'zgartirgan, avtomatik jarayon yoki boshqa vosita tegingan). Aniqlash: jadval bo'yicha (masalan har kecha) CI'da <code>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode</code> ishga tushiriladi; exit code <code>2</code> bo'lsa — drift bor, alert yuboriladi.</p><h4>Exit code'lar</h4><pre>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode -lock=false -no-color -input=false</pre><p>| Kod | Ma'nosi | Harakat | |---|---|---| | 0 | farq yo'q | hech narsa | | 1 | <b>xato</b> (auth, API, sintaksis) | pipeline'ni yiqitish, tekshirish | | 2 | <b>farq bor</b> | Slack/Jira alert | <code>-lock=false</code> — faqat o'qiyapmiz, boshqa ishlayotgan apply'larni bloklamaylik.</p><h4>GitHub Actions misoli</h4><pre>on:<br>  schedule: [{ cron: &quot;0 3 * * *&quot; }]   # har kecha 03:00<br>jobs:<br>  drift:<br>    strategy:<br>      matrix: { stack: [network, eks, rds] }<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3<br>      - run: terraform -chdir=stacks/${{ matrix.stack }} init -input=false<br>      - id: plan<br>        run: |<br>          set +e<br>          terraform -chdir=stacks/${{ matrix.stack }} plan -detailed-exitcode -lock=false -no-color &gt; plan.txt<br>          echo &quot;code=$?&quot; &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT<br>      - if: steps.plan.outputs.code == '2'<br>        run: ./notify-slack.sh &quot;Drift: ${{ matrix.stack }}&quot; plan.txt<br>      - if: steps.plan.outputs.code == '1'<br>        run: exit 1</pre><p>Auth — OIDC orqali <b>faqat o'qish</b> huquqli rol.</p><h4>Drift topilgandan keyin</h4><p>Ikki yo'l:</p><ol><li><b>O'zgarish noto'g'ri</b> — <code>terraform apply</code> bilan kod holatiga qaytarish.</li><li><b>O'zgarish to'g'ri</b> (masalan favqulodda tuzatish) — kodga kiritish, keyin plan toza bo'ladi.</li></ol><p>Faqat refresh'ni ko'rish: <code>terraform plan -refresh-only</code>.</p><h4>Shovqin muammosi</h4><p>Ba'zi atributlar doim farq ko'rsatadi (AWS tag tartibi, avtomatik qo'shilgan qiymatlar). Yechim:</p><pre>lifecycle { ignore_changes = [tags[&quot;LastScanned&quot;]] }</pre><p>Shovqinli alert'ni hech kim o'qimaydi — avval tozalang.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Aniqlash — yarim yechim. Asosiysi — <b>oldini olish</b>: production'da konsol orqali yozish huquqini olib tashlash (faqat read-only + break-glass rol), barcha o'zgarishlar PR orqali. Spacelift, TF Cloud, env0 drift detection'ni tayyor xizmat sifatida beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41320	<p>Terratest bilan Terraform modulini Go'da qanday test qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Terratest — Go kutubxonasi: Terraform modulini <b>haqiqiy cloud'da</b> deploy qiladi, natijani tekshiradi (output, API, HTTP), keyin hammasini o'chiradi. Bu integration test — &quot;kod sintaktik to'g'ri&quot; emas, &quot;haqiqatan ishlaydigan infra yaratadimi&quot; degan savolga javob.</p><h4>Test</h4><pre>package test<br><br>import (<br>    &quot;testing&quot;<br><br>    &quot;github.com/gruntwork-io/terratest/modules/aws&quot;<br>    &quot;github.com/gruntwork-io/terratest/modules/random&quot;<br>    &quot;github.com/gruntwork-io/terratest/modules/terraform&quot;<br>    &quot;github.com/stretchr/testify/assert&quot;<br>)<br><br>func TestVpcModule(t *testing.T) {<br>    t.Parallel()<br>    region := &quot;eu-west-1&quot;<br>    name := &quot;test-vpc-&quot; + random.UniqueId()   // parallel testlar to'qnashmasin<br><br>    opts := terraform.WithDefaultRetryableErrors(t, &amp;terraform.Options{<br>        TerraformDir: &quot;../modules/vpc&quot;,<br>        Vars: map[string]interface{}{<br>            &quot;name&quot;:       name,<br>            &quot;cidr_block&quot;: &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;,<br>        },<br>        EnvVars: map[string]string{&quot;AWS_DEFAULT_REGION&quot;: region},<br>    })<br><br>    defer terraform.Destroy(t, opts)          // test yiqilsa ham tozalash<br>    terraform.InitAndApply(t, opts)<br><br>    vpcID := terraform.Output(t, opts, &quot;vpc_id&quot;)<br>    assert.NotEmpty(t, vpcID)<br><br>    subnets := aws.GetSubnetsForVpc(t, vpcID, region)<br>    assert.Equal(t, 3, len(subnets))          // haqiqiy AWS API orqali tekshirish<br>}</pre><pre>cd test &amp;&amp; go test -v -timeout 30m</pre><h4>Qismlar</h4><ul><li><b><code>WithDefaultRetryableErrors</code></b> — cloud'ning vaqtinchalik xatolarida (rate limit, eventual consistency) qayta urinish.</li><li><b><code>random.UniqueId()</code></b> — har test o'z nomi bilan; parallel ishlaganda konflikt yo'q.</li><li><b><code>defer terraform.Destroy</code></b> — <code>InitAndApply</code>dan <b>oldin</b> yoziladi, test yiqilsa ham resurslar o'chadi.</li><li><b><code>-timeout 30m</code></b> — Go default 10 daqiqa; Qoida buzilsa, pipeline apply'dan <b>oldin</b> to'xtaydi.</p><h4>Oqim</h4><pre>terraform plan -out=tfplan<br>terraform show -json tfplan &gt; tfplan.json<br>conftest test tfplan.json -p policy/<br>  -&gt; FAIL bo'lsa pipeline to'xtaydi, apply bo'lmaydi</pre><p>Nega plan, kod emas: plan'da <b>yakuniy hisoblangan</b> qiymatlar bor (variable, modul, <code>for_each</code>dan keyin). Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41322	<p>OpenTofu provider imzosini tekshirish nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>init</code> paytida OpenTofu provider binary'sini yuklab oladi va uni ishga tushirishdan oldin ikki narsani tekshiradi: <b>SHA256 checksum</b> (fayl buzilmagan, almashtirilmagan) va <b>GPG imzo</b> (fayl haqiqatan provider muallifidan). Bu <b>supply chain</b> hujumlaridan himoya — provider sizning cloud kalitlaringiz bilan ishlaydi, soxta provider hammasini o'g'irlashi mumkin.</p><h4>Nega muhim</h4><p>Provider — oddiy bajariluvchi dastur. <code>terraform apply</code> paytida u <code>AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY</code> ga to'liq kiradi. Registry yoki tarmoq buzilsa va soxta binary yetkazilsa — hujumchi infra'ga to'liq egalik qiladi.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><ol><li>Registry provider uchun: yuklash URL, <code>SHA256SUMS</code> fayli va uning <b>imzosi</b>, imzolovchining public key'ini beradi.</li><li>OpenTofu <code>SHA256SUMS</code> imzosini public key bilan tekshiradi.</li><li>Yuklangan zip hash'ini <code>SHA256SUMS</code>dagi qiymat bilan solishtiradi.</li><li>Mos kelmasa — <code>init</code> xato bilan to'xtaydi.</li></ol><h4>Lock fayl — ikkinchi himoya qatlami</h4><pre># .terraform.lock.hcl  (Git'ga commit qilinadi!)<br>provider &quot;registry.opentofu.org/hashicorp/aws&quot; {<br>  version     = &quot;5.70.0&quot;<br>  constraints = &quot;~&gt; 5.0&quot;<br>  hashes = [<br>    &quot;h1:abc...=&quot;,<br>    &quot;zh:def...&quot;,<br>  ]<br>}</pre><p>Birinchi <code>init</code> hash'larni yozadi. Keyingi har <code>init</code> (boshqa kompyuter, CI) aynan shu hash'ni talab qiladi — kimdir registry'da shu versiyani almashtirsa ham, yuklash rad etiladi.</p><p>Ko'p platforma uchun (dasturchi macOS, CI Linux):</p><pre>tofu providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64</pre><p>Aks holda CI'da <code>the current package doesn't match any of the checksums</code> xatosi.</p><h4>Qo'shimcha</h4><ul><li>Ichki/air-gapped muhit: provider <b>mirror</b> (<code>tofu providers mirror</code>) — internetsiz, oldindan tekshirilgan binary'lar.</li><li><code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code>ni <code>.gitignore</code>ga qo'shish — keng tarqalgan xato, himoyani yo'qqa chiqaradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Imzo &quot;kim chiqargan&quot;ni isbotlaydi, &quot;xavfsiz&quot;ligini emas — community provider'lar ham imzolanadi. Provider tanlashda manba, ta'minotchi va versiyani pin qilish (<code>~&gt;</code> bilan major qotirish) birga muhim.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41323	<p>Terraform modulini semantic versioning bilan qotirish nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Modulni <b>aniq versiyaga</b> bog'lash — kod har safar sinovdan o'tgan bir xil modul nusxasini ishlatadi. Busiz modul muallifi yangi o'zgarish chiqarganda, keyingi <code>init</code> uni avtomatik yuklaydi va production'da kutilmagan <code>destroy</code> paydo bo'lishi mumkin.</p><h4>Semantic versioning — <code>MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH</code></h4><ul><li><b>MAJOR</b> (<code>5.0.0</code> -&gt; <code>6.0.0</code>) — <b>breaking change</b>: input nomi o'zgardi, resurs qayta yaratiladi.</li><li><b>MINOR</b> (<code>5.1</code> -&gt; <code>5.2</code>) — yangi imkoniyat, orqaga mos.</li><li><b>PATCH</b> (<code>5.1.0</code> -&gt; <code>5.1.1</code>) — bug fix.</li></ul><h4>Pin qilish</h4><p>Registry moduli:</p><pre>module &quot;vpc&quot; {<br>  source  = &quot;terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws&quot;<br>  version = &quot;5.1.0&quot;        # aniq versiya<br>  # version = &quot;~&gt; 5.1&quot;     # 5.1.x va 5.x — lekin 6.0 emas<br>}</pre><p>Git moduli (<code>version</code> atributi ishlamaydi — <code>ref</code> ishlatiladi):</p><pre>module &quot;eks&quot; {<br>  source = &quot;git::https://github.com/org/tf-modules.git//eks?ref=v2.3.1&quot;<br>}</pre><p><code>ref=main</code> — pin <b>emas</b>: har init boshqa kod.</p><h4>Qaysi constraint qachon</h4><p>| Constraint | Ma'nosi | Qachon | |---|---|---| | <code>= 5.1.0</code> | aynan shu | production live konfiguratsiya | | <code>~&gt; 5.1.0</code> | 5.1.x (patch'lar) | xavfsiz avtomatik bug fix | | <code>~&gt; 5.1</code> | 5.x | modul ichidan boshqa modulga | | <code>&gt;= 5.0</code> | har qanday yangi | <b>ishlatmang</b> |</p><h4>Yangilash jarayoni</h4><ol><li>Changelog'ni o'qish (ayniqsa major).</li><li>Versiyani PR'da o'zgartirish.</li><li><code>terraform plan</code> — <code>-/+</code> (replace) va <code>destroy</code> yo'qligini tekshirish.</li><li>Avval dev/stage, keyin prod.</li></ol><p>Renovate/Dependabot yangi versiyalar uchun avtomatik PR ochadi.</p><h4>Modul muallifi sifatida</h4><ul><li>Har release'ga Git tag (<code>v2.3.1</code>).</li><li>Major'da <code>moved {}</code> bloklari — resurs nomi o'zgarsa, qayta yaratish o'rniga state'da ko'chirish.</li><li>CHANGELOG va migratsiya qo'llanmasi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provider'lar uchun ham xuddi shunday: <code>required_providers</code>da <code>~&gt; 5.0</code> + commit qilingan <code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code>. Pin qilinmagan modul va provider — &quot;kecha ishlagan, bugun ishlamayapti&quot; turidagi incidentlarning asosiy manbai.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41324	<p>HCL'da <code>merge()</code> va <code>concat()</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>merge()</code> — <b>map/object</b>larni birlashtiradi; bir xil kalit bo'lsa <b>oxirgisi yutadi</b>. <code>concat()</code> — <b>list</b>larni ketma-ket ulaydi; takrorlanishlar saqlanadi.</p><h4>merge — default + override</h4><pre>locals {<br>  common_tags = { Team = &quot;platform&quot;, ManagedBy = &quot;terraform&quot;, Env = &quot;dev&quot; }<br>  extra_tags  = { Env = &quot;prod&quot;, CostCenter = &quot;42&quot; }<br><br>  tags = merge(local.common_tags, local.extra_tags)<br>  # { Team = &quot;platform&quot;, ManagedBy = &quot;terraform&quot;, Env = &quot;prod&quot;, CostCenter = &quot;42&quot; }<br>}</pre><p><code>Env</code> ikkalasida — o'ngdagisi (<code>prod</code>) qoldi. Bu pattern: <b>default'lar chapda, maxsus qiymatlar o'ngda</b>.</p><p><b>Muhim:</b> <code>merge</code> <b>sayoz</b> (shallow). Ichki map'lar birlashtirilmaydi, butunlay almashtiriladi:</p><pre>merge({ a = { x = 1, y = 2 } }, { a = { y = 3 } })<br># = { a = { y = 3 } }   &lt;- x yo'qoldi!</pre><p>Chuqur birlashtirish uchun ichki darajani alohida <code>merge</code> qilish kerak.</p><h4>concat — list'larni ulash</h4><pre>locals {<br>  base_cidrs  = [&quot;10.0.0.0/8&quot;]<br>  office_cidr = [&quot;203.0.113.0/24&quot;]<br>  allowed     = concat(local.base_cidrs, local.office_cidr, var.extra_cidrs)<br>  # [&quot;10.0.0.0/8&quot;, &quot;203.0.113.0/24&quot;, ...]<br>}</pre><p>Takrorlanishni olib tashlash: <code>distinct(concat(a, b))</code>. Ichki list'larni tekislash: <code>flatten([a, [b, c]])</code>.</p><h4>Jadval</h4><p>| | <code>merge</code> | <code>concat</code> | |---|---|---| | Kirish | map / object | list / tuple | | Takror kalit | oxirgisi yutadi | ikkalasi qoladi | | Tartib | ahamiyatsiz (map) | saqlanadi | | Chuqurlik | sayoz | — |</p><h4>Odatiy tuzoq</h4><p><code>merge</code>ga list yoki <code>concat</code>ga map berish — tur xatosi. Ichki map'li sozlamalarni <code>merge</code> qilib, ichki kalitlar &quot;yo'qolishi&quot; — eng ko'p uchraydigan bug.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> AWS provider'da tag'lar uchun <code>merge</code> o'rniga provider darajasidagi <code>default_tags</code> blokini ishlating — har resursda <code>merge(local.tags, ...)</code> takrorlanmaydi va hech biri unutilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41325	<p>Terraform custom provider yaratish nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Custom provider — Terraform'ga <b>sizning API'ingizni</b> (ichki platforma, ichki DNS, SaaS) boshqarishni o'rgatadigan Go dasturi. Siz har resurs turi uchun <code>Create</code>, <code>Read</code>, <code>Update</code>, <code>Delete</code> funksiyalarini yozasiz; Terraform qolganini (state, plan, diff, graf) o'zi qiladi. Zamonaviy usul — <b>Terraform Plugin Framework</b>.</p><h4>Qachon kerak</h4><ul><li>Ichki API'ni (masalan &quot;kompaniya ichki load balancer'i&quot;) boshqa infra bilan bitta <code>plan</code>/<code>apply</code> ichida boshqarish.</li><li>Mavjud provider yo'q yoki imkoniyati yetarli emas.</li></ul><p>Avval tekshiring: <code>http</code> provider, <code>restapi</code> community provider yoki <code>terraform_data</code> + skript yetarli bo'lishi mumkin — provider yozish va qo'llab-quvvatlash qimmat.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><pre>terraform  &lt;--gRPC--&gt;  terraform-provider-myapi (Go binary)  --HTTP--&gt;  Sizning API<br>  plan/state/diff        CRUD funksiyalari</pre><h4>Resurs skeleti (Plugin Framework)</h4><pre>type serverResource struct{ client *api.Client }<br><br>type serverModel struct {<br>    ID   types.String `tfsdk:&quot;id&quot;`<br>    Name types.String `tfsdk:&quot;name&quot;`<br>    Size types.String `tfsdk:&quot;size&quot;`<br>}<br><br>func (r *serverResource) Schema(_ context.Context, _ resource.SchemaRequest, resp *resource.SchemaResponse) {<br>    resp.Schema = schema.Schema{Attributes: map[string]schema.Attribute{<br>        &quot;id&quot;:   schema.StringAttribute{Computed: true},<br>        &quot;name&quot;: schema.StringAttribute{Required: true,<br>            PlanModifiers: []planmodifier.String{stringplanmodifier.RequiresReplace()}},<br>        &quot;size&quot;: schema.StringAttribute{Required: true},<br>    }}<br>}<br><br>func (r *serverResource) Create(ctx context.Context, req resource.CreateRequest, resp *resource.CreateResponse) {<br>    var plan serverModel<br>    resp.Diagnostics.Append(req.Plan.Get(ctx, &amp;plan)...)<br>    if resp.Diagnostics.HasError() { return }<br><br>    srv, err := r.client.CreateServer(ctx, plan.Name.ValueString(), plan.Size.ValueString())<br>    if err != nil {<br>        resp.Diagnostics.AddError(&quot;server yaratilmadi&quot;, err.Error())<br>        return<br>    }<br>    plan.ID = types.StringValue(srv.ID)<br>    resp.Diagnostics.Append(resp.State.Set(ctx, plan)...)<br>}<br>// Read, Update, Delete — xuddi shunday</pre><h4>Har funksiya vazifasi</h4><ul><li><b>Schema</b> — atributlar: <code>Required</code>, <code>Optional</code>, <code>Computed</code> (API qaytaradi), <code>Sensitive</code>. <code>RequiresReplace</code> — o'zgarsa resurs qayta yaratiladi.</li><li><b>Create</b> — API'da yaratish, ID'ni state'ga yozish.</li><li><b>Read</b> — refresh paytida haqiqiy holatni olish. Resurs topilmasa <code>resp.State.RemoveResource()</code> — Terraform uni qayta yaratishni taklif qiladi. <b>Drift aniqlash shu funksiyaga bog'liq.</b></li><li><b>Update</b> — joyida o'zgartirish.</li><li><b>Delete</b> — o'chirish; allaqachon yo'q bo'lsa xato bermaslik (idempotent).</li><li><b>ImportState</b> — mavjud resurslarni <code>terraform import</code> bilan olish.</li></ul><h4>Test va tarqatish</h4><ul><li>Acceptance testlar: <code>resource.Test</code> bilan haqiqiy API'ga (<code>TF_ACC=1 go test</code>).</li><li>GoReleaser bilan build, GPG imzo, ichki yoki public registry.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng qiyin qism — API'ning o'zi: async operatsiyalar (yaratish 5 daqiqa — polling va timeout kerak), eventual consistency, idempotentlik. <code>Read</code> to'g'ri bo'lmasa — har <code>plan</code>da yolg'on farq yoki yashirin drift. Provider — mahsulot: versiyalash, changelog va egasi bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41326	<p>Ssenariy: muhandis staging'ga tasodifan <code>terraform destroy</code> ishga tushirib, o'rtasida to'xtatdi. Qanday tiklaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval zararni to'xtat va baholash qil: qolib ketgan lock'ni bo'shat, state'ni haqiqiy holat bilan sinxronla (<code>apply -refresh-only</code>), keyin <code>plan</code> bilan o'chirilgan resurslarni qayta yaratish rejasini ko'rib apply qil. Ma'lumotli resurslar (DB, bucket) Terraform bilan emas, snapshot/backup'dan tiklanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>destroy</code> o'rtasida Ctrl+C bosilganda Terraform bir qism resursni o'chirib ulgurgan, state esa yarim yangilangan bo'ladi. Lock ham ko'pincha bo'shatilmay qoladi. Shoshib yana <code>apply</code> qilish — noto'g'ri state bilan yangi xatolar keltiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday tiklanadi:</b></p><pre>[destroy to'xtatildi]<br>   v<br>1. Hamma apply'larni to'xtat (CI pipeline'ni pauza)<br>   v<br>2. State backup:  terraform state pull &gt; before-recovery.tfstate<br>   v<br>3. Lock:          terraform force-unlock &lt;LOCK_ID&gt;<br>   v<br>4. Sinxron:       terraform apply -refresh-only   (state = real dunyo)<br>   v<br>5. Ma'lumot:      RDS/EBS snapshot'dan tiklash (Terraform ma'lumotni qaytarmaydi)<br>   v<br>6. Reja:          terraform plan -out=recovery.plan  -&gt; &quot;N to add&quot;<br>   v<br>7. Apply:         terraform apply recovery.plan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform state pull &gt; backup-$(date +%s).tfstate<br>terraform force-unlock 6f1c2a3e-...        # ID xato xabarida chiqadi<br>terraform apply -refresh-only              # o'chganlar state'dan tushadi<br># DB uchun: snapshot'dan tiklab, so'ng import<br>aws rds restore-db-instance-from-db-snapshot \<br>  --db-instance-identifier staging-db --db-snapshot-identifier rds:staging-db-2026-10-02<br>terraform import aws_db_instance.main staging-db<br>terraform plan -out=recovery.plan<br>terraform apply recovery.plan</pre><p><code>plan</code> chiqishida faqat <code>+ create</code> bo'lishi kerak. <code>- destroy</code> yoki <code>-/+ replace</code> ko'rinsa — to'xta va sababini tushun.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lock'ni boshqa process hali ishlayotganda <code>force-unlock</code> qilish — ikki apply bir state'ni buzadi.</li><li>DB'ni Terraform bilan &quot;bo'sh&quot; qayta yaratish — keyin snapshot'dan tiklash uchun uni yana almashtirish kerak bo'ladi.</li><li>Refresh qilmasdan plan — Terraform mavjud bo'lmagan resursni o'zgartirmoqchi bo'lib API xatosi beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Profilaktika muhimroq: <code>prevent_destroy</code> muhim resurslarda, RDS <code>deletion_protection = true</code>, staging/prod alohida akkaunt va IAM'da <code>Delete*</code> faqat pipeline role'iga. Bir necha task bir handler'ni chaqirsa ham, u play oxirida <b>bir marta</b> ishlaydi. Klassik misol: config o'zgarganda servisni restart/reload qilish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har run'da nginx'ni restart qilish keraksiz uzilish beradi. Faqat konfiguratsiya haqiqatan o'zgarganda restart kerak — idempotentlik.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>task: template nginx.conf   -&gt; changed  --notify--&gt; [Reload nginx] (navbatga)<br>task: template site.conf    -&gt; changed  --notify--&gt; [Reload nginx] (allaqachon navbatda)<br>task: copy cert             -&gt; ok       (notify yo'q)<br>...<br>play oxiri: handler'lar  -&gt; Reload nginx  (1 marta)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- hosts: web<br>  become: true<br>  tasks:<br>    - name: nginx config<br>      ansible.builtin.template:<br>        src: nginx.conf.j2<br>        dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf<br>        validate: nginx -t -c %s<br>      notify: Reload nginx<br><br>    - name: Darhol qo'llash kerak bo'lsa<br>      ansible.builtin.meta: flush_handlers<br><br>  handlers:<br>    - name: Reload nginx<br>      ansible.builtin.systemd:<br>        name: nginx<br>        state: reloaded</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Task yiqilsa, play to'xtaydi va navbatdagi handler'lar ishlamaydi — config o'zgargan, servis eski. <code>--force-handlers</code> yoki <code>force_handlers: true</code> ishlat.</li><li>Handler nomi <code>notify</code> dagi bilan harfma-harf mos bo'lishi kerak (yoki <code>listen:</code> bilan topic).</li><li><code>validate:</code> siz config yozish — buzilgan config bilan reload servisni yiqitadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rolling deploy'da <code>flush_handlers</code> ni health check'dan oldin qo'y, shunda har batch'da restart va tekshiruv bir joyda bo'ladi. <code>reloaded</code> ni <code>restarted</code> dan afzal ko'r — ulanishlar uzilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41343	<p>Ansible <code>serial</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>serial</code> — play'ni host'larning hammasida birdan emas, batch'lar bilan bajaradi (<code>serial: 2</code>, <code>serial: &quot;20%&quot;</code> yoki <code>[1, 5, &quot;25%&quot;]</code>). <code>max_fail_percentage</code> bilan birga — xato ko'paysa to'xtaydi. Bu zero-downtime rolling update'ning asosi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Default'da Ansible task'ni barcha host'larda parallel bajaradi (forks bo'yicha). Yangi versiya buzuq bo'lsa — hamma serverlar birdan yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>10 server, serial: [1, &quot;30%&quot;, &quot;100%&quot;]<br><br>batch 1: web1            -&gt; deploy, health check   (canary)<br>batch 2: web2..web4      -&gt; deploy, health check<br>batch 3: web5..web10     -&gt; deploy<br>har batch: barcha task'lar tugaydi, keyin keyingi batch</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- hosts: web<br>  serial: [1, &quot;30%&quot;, &quot;100%&quot;]<br>  max_fail_percentage: 10<br>  pre_tasks:<br>    - name: LB'dan chiqarish<br>      community.aws.elb_target:<br>        target_group_arn: &quot;{{ tg_arn }}&quot;<br>        target_id: &quot;{{ ec2_id }}&quot;<br>        state: absent<br>      delegate_to: localhost<br>  roles:<br>    - app_deploy<br>  post_tasks:<br>    - name: Health check<br>      ansible.builtin.uri:<br>        url: &quot;http://{{ inventory_hostname }}:8080/healthz&quot;<br>      register: hc<br>      until: hc.status == 200<br>      retries: 20<br>      delay: 5<br>    - name: LB'ga qaytarish<br>      community.aws.elb_target:<br>        target_group_arn: &quot;{{ tg_arn }}&quot;<br>        target_id: &quot;{{ ec2_id }}&quot;<br>        state: present<br>      delegate_to: localhost</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>max_fail_percentage</code> har batch'ga nisbatan hisoblanadi, umumiy emas; <code>0</code> qo'ysang birinchi xatoda to'xtaydi.</li><li>Health check'siz serial — buzuq versiya baribir hamma joyga tarqaladi, faqat sekinroq.</li><li><code>run_once</code> task'lar har batch'da bir marta ishlaydi — kutilmagan takror.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Birinchi batch'ni 1 host (canary) qilish va keyin foiz bilan oshirish — riskni nazorat qiladi. Kubernetes'da bu vazifani Deployment strategiyasi bajaradi; Ansible serial VM-asosli tizimlar uchun.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible

Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41345	<p>Terraform <code>nonsensitive()</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>nonsensitive(value)</code> — <code>sensitive</code> deb belgilangan qiymatdan sezgirlik belgisini olib tashlaydi, natijada u plan/output'da ochiq ko'rinadi. Faqat qiymat aslida secret bo'lmagan holatlarda (masalan, secret'dan hosil qilingan, lekin o'zi zararsiz hash yoki uzunlik) ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Terraform sezgirlikni &quot;yuqumli&quot; qiladi: sezgir variable'dan hosil bo'lgan har qanday qiymat ham sezgir bo'ladi. Natijada <code>for_each</code> kalitlari yoki debug uchun kerakli zararsiz qiymatlar ham yashirinadi, ba'zan esa xato chiqadi (&quot;sensitive value cannot be used as for_each&quot;).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>var.db_config (sensitive)  --&gt;  keys(var.db_config)  (sensitive, chunki manbasi sezgir)<br>                                    |<br>                           nonsensitive(...)  --&gt;  oddiy qiymat, for_each'da ishlatsa bo'ladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variable &quot;users&quot; {<br>  type      = map(string)   # user =&gt; parol<br>  sensitive = true<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_iam_user&quot; &quot;u&quot; {<br>  # kalitlar (user nomlari) secret emas, parollar esa secret<br>  for_each = toset(nonsensitive(keys(var.users)))<br>  name     = each.key<br>}<br><br>output &quot;password_length_ok&quot; {<br>  value = nonsensitive(length(var.db_password) &gt;= 16)<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret'ning o'zini <code>nonsensitive</code> qilish — u CI log'ida ochiq chiqadi va saqlanib qoladi.</li><li>Unutma: <code>sensitive</code> faqat CLI chiqishini yashiradi; state'da qiymat baribir ochiq turadi.</li><li>Sezgir bo'lmagan qiymatga <code>nonsensitive</code> qo'llash eski versiyalarda xato berardi (1.x yangilarida xato emas, lekin keraksiz).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Code review'da har <code>nonsensitive()</code> chaqiruvi alohida tekshirilishi kerak — u xavfsizlik chegarasini ochiq ravishda bekor qiladi. Checkov/tflint qoidasi bilan uni flag qilish mumkin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41346	<p>Output'da <code>depends_on</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Output ichidagi <code>depends_on</code> — output qiymati faqat ko'rsatilgan resurslar to'liq yaratilgandan keyin hisoblanishini (va tashqariga, ya'ni parent modulga uzatilishini) ta'minlaydi. Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41347	<p>Terraform modul nesting bo'yicha best practice qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Modullarni sayoz qil: root modul -&gt; bir daraja child modullar, juda kamdan-kam ikkinchi daraja. Kompozitsiyani root'da qil (modullar bir-birining output'larini root orqali oladi), modul ichida boshqa modulni chaqirishdan qoch.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>module.platform -&gt; module.network -&gt; vpc_id<br>      +-- network             +-- module.eks       (vpc_id = module.network.vpc_id)<br>           +-- subnets        +-- module.rds       (subnet_ids = module.network.private)<br>                +-- routes</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>module &quot;network&quot; Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41350	<p>Policy as Code shift-left testing nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shift-left policy as code — xavfsizlik va compliance qoidalarini (shifrlash yoqilgan, public bucket yo'q, tag'lar bor) kod sifatida yozib, ularni deploy'dan keyin emas, <b>developer'ga eng yaqin bosqichda</b> — pre-commit va PR'da Checkov, Trivy, OPA/Conftest bilan avtomatik tekshirish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Audit uch oyda bir marta topadigan public S3 bucket allaqachon ma'lumot oqizgan bo'ladi. Semantika bir xil, faqat sintaksis JSON. Asosan boshqa dastur (skript, generator, CDK) konfiguratsiyani avtomatik yaratganda ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> HCL'ni dasturiy generatsiya qilish noqulay — string concatenation bilan qavs va qo'shtirnoqlarni to'g'ri qo'yish qiyin. Har qanday til esa JSON'ni ishonchli serializatsiya qila oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Python/Go generator --json.dumps--&gt; main.tf.json<br>                                        |<br>terraform plan  &lt;-- *.tf va *.tf.json birga o'qiladi (bitta modulda aralash bo'lishi mumkin)</pre><p>JSON'da ifoda (expression) string ichida <code>${...}</code> interpolatsiya bilan yoziladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;variable&quot;: {<br>    &quot;env&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;, &quot;default&quot;: &quot;dev&quot; }<br>  },<br>  &quot;resource&quot;: {<br>    &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot;: {<br>      &quot;logs&quot;: {<br>        &quot;bucket&quot;: &quot;acme-logs-${var.env}&quot;,<br>        &quot;tags&quot;: { &quot;Env&quot;: &quot;${var.env}&quot; }<br>      }<br>    }<br>  },<br>  &quot;output&quot;: {<br>    &quot;bucket_arn&quot;: { &quot;value&quot;: &quot;${aws_s3_bucket.logs.arn}&quot; }<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>python gen.py &gt; main.tf.json<br>terraform validate &amp;&amp; terraform plan</pre><p>Shu HCL ekvivalenti: <code>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;logs&quot; { bucket = &quot;acme-logs-${var.env}&quot; }</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Izoh yozib bo'lmaydi (JSON'da comment yo'q) — <code>&quot;//&quot;</code> kalitini Terraform izoh sifatida qabul qiladi.</li><li><code>&quot;${...}&quot;</code> siz yozilgan havola oddiy string bo'lib qoladi — xato jim o'tadi.</li><li>Inson tahrirlaydigan kod uchun JSON o'qish va review qilish qiyin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CDKTF ham ichida aynan <code>cdk.tf.json</code> generatsiya qiladi. Yozuv allaqachon bo'lsa — boshqa process ishlayapti, lock olinmaydi. Ish tugagach yozuv o'chiriladi. Alohida yozuvda state'ning MD5 digest'i ham saqlanadi (S3 eventual consistency'ni tekshirish uchun). Terraform 1.10+ da S3 native locking (<code>use_lockfile = true</code>) bor va DynamoDB lock <b>deprecated</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki muhandis yoki ikki CI job bir vaqtda apply qilsa, ikkalasi ham state'ni yozadi — biri ikkinchisining o'zgarishini yo'qotadi, resurslar dublikat bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job A: PutItem(LockID=&quot;bucket/prod/terraform.tfstate&quot;, cond: not exists) -&gt; OK  (lock)<br>job B: PutItem(... same ...)                                              -&gt; ConditionalCheckFailed<br>       -&gt; &quot;Error acquiring the state lock&quot;  (Who, Operation, Created ko'rsatiladi)<br>job A: tugadi -&gt; DeleteItem -&gt; lock bo'shadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Zamonaviy (1.10+): DynamoDB'siz<br>terraform {<br>  backend &quot;s3&quot; {<br>    bucket       = &quot;acme-tfstate&quot;<br>    key          = &quot;prod/network/terraform.tfstate&quot;<br>    region       = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;<br>    encrypt      = true<br>    use_lockfile = true      # S3'da .tflock obyekti (conditional write)<br>  }<br>}<br># Eski usul:  dynamodb_table = &quot;terraform-locks&quot;  (hash key: LockID, String)</pre><pre>terraform plan -lock-timeout=5m<br>terraform force-unlock &lt;LOCK_ID&gt;    # faqat process o'lganiga ishonch bo'lsa</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DynamoDB jadval hash key nomi aniq <code>LockID</code> bo'lishi shart.</li><li><code>-lock=false</code> bilan ishlash — lock'ni butunlay o'chiradi.</li><li>O'tish davrida ikkala lock'ni (<code>use_lockfile</code> + <code>dynamodb_table</code>) birga yoqib, keyin DynamoDB'ni olib tashlash xavfsiz yo'l.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Lock state'ni parallel yozishdan himoya qiladi, lekin noto'g'ri navbatdagi apply'dan emas. CI'da muhit bo'yicha concurrency group (bitta muhitga bir vaqtda bitta job) ham qo'y.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible

Jinja2'da <code>{{ var }}</code> ifoda, <code>{% for %}</code> / <code>{% if %}</code> boshqaruv va <code>| filter</code> lar ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 50 ta serverda nginx config bir xil, faqat server nomi, upstream ro'yxati va worker soni farq qiladi. Har biri uchun alohida fayl saqlash — imkonsiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>templates/nginx.conf.j2  +  vars (group_vars, host_vars, facts)<br>                 v  (control node'da render)<br>         /etc/nginx/nginx.conf (host'ga yoziladi; o'zgargan bo'lsa -&gt; changed)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{# templates/nginx.conf.j2 #}<br># {{ ansible_managed }}<br>worker_processes {{ ansible_facts['processor_vcpus'] }};<br>upstream app {<br>{% for host in groups['app'] %}<br>    server {{ hostvars[host]['ansible_host'] }}:{{ app_port | default(8080) }};<br>{% endfor %}<br>}<br>server {<br>    listen 80;<br>    server_name {{ server_name }};<br>{% if enable_gzip %}<br>    gzip on;<br>{% endif %}<br>}</pre><pre>- name: nginx config<br>  ansible.builtin.template:<br>    src: nginx.conf.j2<br>    dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf<br>    owner: root<br>    mode: &quot;0644&quot;<br>    validate: nginx -t -c %s<br>  notify: Reload nginx</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Undefined variable — render yiqiladi; <code>| default(...)</code> yoki <code>| mandatory</code> bilan aniq qil.</li><li>YAML'da qiymat <code>{{</code> bilan boshlansa qo'shtirnoq shart: <code>name: &quot;{{ app }}&quot;</code>.</li><li>Bo'sh joy va yangi qatorlar: <code>{%- ... -%}</code> bilan boshqar, aks holda config'da ortiqcha bo'sh qatorlar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shablonda mantiqni minimal ushla — murakkab hisob-kitoblarni <code>vars</code>/<code>set_fact</code> yoki custom filter'ga chiqar. <code>validate:</code> parametri buzilgan config'ni diskka yozilishidan oldin ushlaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41378	<p>Ansible <code>block</code> va <code>rescue</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>block</code> — task'larni guruhlaydi (umumiy <code>when</code>, <code>become</code>, tag qo'llash uchun ham); <code>rescue</code> — block ichidagi task yiqilsa bajariladi (try/catch'dagi catch); <code>always</code> — natijadan qat'i nazar har doim bajariladi (finally). Bu Ansible'da xatolarni boshqarish va rollback usuli.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy o'rtasida migratsiya yiqildi — servis yarim yangilangan holatda qoldi. Avtomatik eski versiyaga qaytish va LB'ga qayta qo'shish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>block:   task1 -&gt; task2 (FAILED) -&gt; task3 (o'tkazib yuboriladi)<br>            v<br>rescue:  rollback task'lari  (ansible_failed_task, ansible_failed_result mavjud)<br>            v<br>always:  LB'ga qaytarish / tozalash   (har doim)</pre><p>Rescue muvaffaqiyatli tugasa, host &quot;rescued&quot; hisoblanadi va play davom etadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- name: Ilovani yangilash<br>  block:<br>    - name: Yangi release'ni yuklash<br>      ansible.builtin.unarchive:<br>        src: &quot;https://artifacts.acme.io/app-{{ version }}.tgz&quot;<br>        dest: /opt/app/releases/{{ version }}<br>        remote_src: true<br>    - name: Symlink'ni almashtirish<br>      ansible.builtin.file:<br>        src: /opt/app/releases/{{ version }}<br>        dest: /opt/app/current<br>        state: link<br>    - name: Health check<br>      ansible.builtin.uri: { url: &quot;http://localhost:8080/healthz&quot; }<br>      register: hc<br>      until: hc.status == 200<br>      retries: 10<br>      delay: 3<br>  rescue:<br>    - name: Xato haqida<br>      ansible.builtin.debug:<br>        msg: &quot;{{ ansible_failed_task.name }} yiqildi&quot;<br>    - name: Eski versiyaga qaytish<br>      ansible.builtin.file:<br>        src: /opt/app/releases/{{ previous_version }}<br>        dest: /opt/app/current<br>        state: link<br>    - ansible.builtin.fail:<br>        msg: &quot;Deploy rollback qilindi&quot;<br>  always:<br>    - name: Servisni restart<br>      ansible.builtin.systemd: { name: app, state: restarted }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rescue'da xatoni &quot;yutib&quot; yuborish — pipeline yashil ko'rinadi; oxirida <code>fail</code> bilan aniq xato qaytar.</li><li>Sintaksis xatolari va undefined variable ba'zan rescue'ni chetlab o'tadi.</li><li><code>ignore_errors: true</code> ni rescue o'rniga ishlatish — xato yashirinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rollback mumkin bo'lishi uchun deploy'ni qaytariladigan qilib loyihala (release papkalari + symlink, oldingi versiya saqlanadi). Rescue faqat shunda ma'noli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible
