Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41384	<p>Terraform workspace izolyatsiyasi qachon anti-pattern?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Terraform CLI workspace'lari bitta backend va bitta credential to'plamini ulashadi, faqat state kaliti farq qiladi. Agar muhitlar turli AWS akkauntlarida, turli IAM role'lar, turli kirish nazorati yoki sezilarli farqli konfiguratsiya talab qilsa, workspace bilan ajratish anti-pattern: noto'g'ri tanlangan workspace'da <code>apply</code> prod'ni buzadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>terraform workspace select dev</code> ni unutib, prod workspace'da qolgan holda apply qilish. Yoki dev muhandisiga dev workspace uchun ruxsat berish — u avtomatik prod state'ga ham kirish oladi, chunki backend bir xil.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Workspace modeli:<br>  backend s3://tfstate/env:/dev/app.tfstate<br>           s3://tfstate/env:/prod/app.tfstate     &lt;- bitta bucket, bitta IAM<br>  kod: bir xil, farq faqat terraform.workspace bo'yicha shartlarda<br><br>Papka/akkaunt modeli:<br>  live/dev  -&gt; backend dev-akkaunt, role dev-deployer<br>  live/prod -&gt; backend prod-akkaunt, role prod-deployer (alohida approval)</pre><p><b>Amalda (anti-pattern belgisi):</b></p><pre>instance_type = terraform.workspace == &quot;prod&quot; ? &quot;m6i.xlarge&quot; : &quot;t3.small&quot;<br>count         = terraform.workspace == &quot;prod&quot; ? 3 : 1</pre><p>Yaxshiroq:</p><pre>live/<br>  dev/main.tf   -&gt; module &quot;app&quot; { source = &quot;../../modules/app&quot; size = &quot;small&quot; }<br>  prod/main.tf  -&gt; module &quot;app&quot; { source = &quot;../../modules/app&quot; size = &quot;large&quot; }</pre><p>Workspace qachon mos: bir xil muhitning vaqtinchalik nusxalari (feature branch preview, test stack'lar).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Joriy workspace terminalda ko'rinmaydi — <code>terraform workspace show</code> ni har safar tekshirish kerak.</li><li>Kod ichidagi <code>terraform.workspace</code> shartlari ko'payib, o'qib bo'lmaydigan bo'ladi.</li><li>HCP Terraform &quot;workspace&quot; atamasi boshqa narsa (alohida state + sozlamalar + ruxsatlar) — CLI workspace bilan aralashtirma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Izolyatsiya darajasi xavf darajasiga mos bo'lsin: prod uchun alohida akkaunt, backend va pipeline — bu nafaqat xatolardan, balki kompromat holatlarida blast radius'dan ham himoya qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41385	<p><code>-lock-timeout</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>-lock-timeout=DURATION</code> (masalan <code>5m</code>) — state lock band bo'lsa, Terraform darhol xato bermasdan ko'rsatilgan vaqt davomida qayta-qayta urinib kutadi. Vaqt tugasa ham lock bo'shamasa — xato bilan chiqadi. Default <code>0s</code> (darhol xato).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI'da bir nechta pipeline bir state bilan ishlaydi (masalan, birin-ketin merge qilingan PR'lar). Biri ishlayotganda ikkinchisi darhol &quot;Error acquiring the state lock&quot; bilan yiqiladi va qo'lda qayta ishga tushirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>job B: lock olishga urinadi -&gt; band (job A)<br>          v  -lock-timeout=10m<br>       qayta urinish ... qayta urinish ...<br>          v<br>   A tugadi -&gt; lock bo'shadi -&gt; B lock oladi va davom etadi<br>   yoki 10m o'tdi -&gt; Error acquiring the state lock</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform plan  -lock-timeout=5m -out=tfplan<br>terraform apply -lock-timeout=10m tfplan<br>export TF_CLI_ARGS_apply=&quot;-lock-timeout=10m&quot;   # CI uchun global</pre><p>Xato chiqishi:</p><pre>Error: Error acquiring the state lock<br>Lock Info:<br>  ID:        6f1c2a3e-...<br>  Path:      acme-tfstate/prod/network/terraform.tfstate<br>  Operation: OperationTypeApply<br>  Who:       runner@ci-1234<br>  Created:   2026-10-03 08:12:44 UTC</pre><p><code>Who</code> va <code>Created</code> lock kimniki va qachondan beri ekanini ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Juda uzun timeout — CI job vaqti tugaydi yoki runner'lar band bo'ladi.</li><li>Lock &quot;osilgan&quot; (process o'lgan) bo'lsa, timeout yordam bermaydi — <code>force-unlock</code> kerak, lekin faqat tekshirgandan keyin.</li><li>Lock'ni chetlab o'tish uchun <code>-lock=false</code> — hech qachon prod'da.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kutishdan ko'ra yaxshiroq — CI darajasida navbat: GitHub <code>concurrency</code> group yoki Atlantis/HCP Terraform run queue. <code>-lock-timeout</code> qisqa to'qnashuvlar uchun xavfsizlik to'ri.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible

O'chirishda tartib teskari.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Resurslarni to'g'ri tartibda yaratish kerak, lekin har birini qo'lda tartiblash imkonsiz. Terraform havolalardan tartibni o'zi chiqaradi va mustaqil resurslarni parallel yaratadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>aws_vpc.main<br>   |  .id<br>   v<br>aws_subnet.a  ----+<br>aws_subnet.b  ----+--&gt; aws_route_table_association<br>   |<br>   v  .id<br>aws_instance.web<br><br>Mustaqil resurslar (aws_s3_bucket.logs) -&gt; parallel (default -parallelism=10)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_vpc&quot; &quot;main&quot; { cidr_block = &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot; }<br><br>resource &quot;aws_subnet&quot; &quot;a&quot; {<br>  vpc_id     = aws_vpc.main.id          # implicit dependency<br>  cidr_block = cidrsubnet(aws_vpc.main.cidr_block, 8, 1)<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  subnet_id = aws_subnet.a.id           # zanjir: vpc -&gt; subnet -&gt; instance<br>  ami       = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id<br>}</pre><pre>terraform graph | dot -Tsvg &gt; graph.svg   # grafni ko'rish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Havola nomini string sifatida yozish (<code>vpc_id = &quot;vpc-123&quot;</code>) — bog'liqlik yo'qoladi.</li><li>Ko'rinmas bog'liqliklar (IAM policy biriktirilishi, eventual consistency) — havola yo'q bo'lsa, Terraform tartibni bilmaydi; <code>depends_on</code> kerak bo'ladi.</li><li>Sikl (A B ga, B A ga) — &quot;Cycle&quot; xatosi; ko'pincha security group qoidalarini alohida resursga chiqarib hal qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Implicit dependency — afzal usul: u aniq, o'zi hujjatlanadi va faqat kerakli tartibni o'rnatadi. <code>depends_on</code> ni faqat ma'lumot oqimi bo'lmagan haqiqiy yon ta'sirlar uchun qoldir.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible

    error_hook &quot;alert&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform {<br>  source = &quot;../../modules/lambda&quot;<br><br>  before_hook &quot;fmt_check&quot; {<br>    commands = [&quot;plan&quot;, &quot;apply&quot;]<br>    execute  = [&quot;terraform&quot;, &quot;fmt&quot;, &quot;-check&quot;, &quot;-recursive&quot;]<br>  }<br><br>  before_hook &quot;package&quot; Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41405	<p>Terraform <code>flatten()</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>flatten(list)</code> — ichma-ich list'larni (list of lists) bitta tekis list'ga aylantiradi: <code>flatten([[&quot;a&quot;,&quot;b&quot;],[&quot;c&quot;],[]])</code> -&gt; <code>[&quot;a&quot;,&quot;b&quot;,&quot;c&quot;]</code>. Eng ko'p ishlatilishi — ikki darajali ma'lumotni (masalan, har VPC uchun subnet'lar) <code>for_each</code> uchun yagona ro'yxatga keltirish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>for_each</code> faqat bir darajali map/set qabul qiladi. Ma'lumotingiz esa ierarxik: <code>networks = { app = { subnets = [...] }, db = { subnets = [...] } }</code>. Har subnet uchun alohida resurs kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>networks:<br>  app: [10.0.1.0/24, 10.0.2.0/24]<br>  db:  [10.0.10.0/24]<br>       v  for (ichma-ich) -&gt; list of lists<br>[[{net=app,cidr=..1}, {net=app,cidr=..2}], [{net=db,cidr=..10}]]<br>       v  flatten<br>[{app,..1}, {app,..2}, {db,..10}]<br>       v  for_each uchun map: key = &quot;app-10.0.1.0/24&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>variable &quot;networks&quot; {<br>  default = {<br>    app = { cidrs = [&quot;10.0.1.0/24&quot;, &quot;10.0.2.0/24&quot;] }<br>    db  = { cidrs = [&quot;10.0.10.0/24&quot;] }<br>  }<br>}<br><br>locals {<br>  subnets = flatten([<br>    for net_name, net in var.networks : [<br>      for cidr in net.cidrs : {<br>        key  = &quot;${net_name}-${cidr}&quot;<br>        net  = net_name<br>        cidr = cidr<br>      }<br>    ]<br>  ])<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_subnet&quot; &quot;this&quot; {<br>  for_each   = { for s in local.subnets : s.key =&gt; s }<br>  vpc_id     = aws_vpc.main.id<br>  cidr_block = each.value.cidr<br>  tags       = { Network = each.value.net }<br>}</pre><pre>terraform console<br>&gt; flatten([[&quot;a&quot;], [&quot;b&quot;, [&quot;c&quot;]]])    # rekursiv: [&quot;a&quot;,&quot;b&quot;,&quot;c&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>for_each</code> kaliti sifatida list indeksini ishlatish — element qo'shilganda/o'chirilganda boshqalari qayta yaratiladi; barqaror kalit (nom+cidr) ishlat.</li><li><code>flatten</code> rekursiv — ichida haqiqatan list bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan qiymatlar ham tekislanib ketadi.</li><li>Kalitlar takrorlansa — map yasashda &quot;Duplicate object key&quot; xatosi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>flatten</code> + <code>for</code> ifodasi — <code>for_each</code> bilan ishlashning standart pattern'i; uni local'ga chiqarib, <code>terraform console</code> da tekshirib ol — resurs blokida murakkab ifoda debug qilish qiyin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible
Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41406	<p>Terraform <code>element()</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>element(list, index)</code> — list'dan indeks bo'yicha element qaytaradi. Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41416	<p>Terraform modul uchun Git source sintaksisi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Terraform modulni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri git'dan yuklaydi: <code>source = &quot;git::https://github.com/org/repo.git?ref=v1.2.0&quot;</code>. <code>ref</code> — tag, branch yoki commit SHA. SSH uchun <code>git::ssh://git@github.com/org/repo.git?ref=v1.2.0</code> yoki <code>git@github.com:org/repo.git</code>. GitHub uchun qisqa forma <code>github.com/org/repo</code> ham bor.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ichki modullarni registry'siz tarqatish va aniq versiyaga qotirish kerak — aks holda <code>main</code> branch'dagi har o'zgarish barcha iste'molchilarni darhol buzadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>terraform init<br>   v<br>source git::...?ref=v1.2.0  -&gt; git clone --depth ... -&gt; checkout v1.2.0<br>   v<br>.terraform/modules/&lt;nom&gt;/   (modules.json da manba yoziladi)</pre><p><code>ref</code> o'zgarsa <code>terraform init</code> (yoki <code>init -upgrade</code>) qayta yuklaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>module &quot;vpc&quot; {<br>  source = &quot;git::https://github.com/acme/terraform-aws-vpc.git?ref=v1.2.0&quot;<br>  cidr   = &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;<br>}<br><br># Eng qat'iy: commit SHA (tag ko'chirilsa ham o'zgarmaydi)<br>module &quot;vpc_pinned&quot; {<br>  source = &quot;git::https://github.com/acme/terraform-aws-vpc.git?ref=8f3e2a1c4b5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f&quot;<br>}<br><br># Private repo, SSH<br>module &quot;iam&quot; {<br>  source = &quot;git::ssh://git@github.com/acme/terraform-aws-iam.git?ref=v3.0.1&quot;<br>}</pre><pre>terraform init -upgrade      # ref o'zgargach modullarni qayta yuklash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ref</code> siz — default branch olinadi, reproducibility yo'q.</li><li>Git manbalarida <code>version =</code> argumenti ishlamaydi — faqat registry modullari uchun.</li><li>CI'da private repo'ga kirish: SSH kalit yoki <code>git config url.&quot;https://x-access-token:${TOKEN}@github.com/&quot;.insteadOf</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tag'larni immutable deb hisobla (yoki SHA ishlat) va Renovate/Dependabot bilan modul versiyalarini avtomatik yangilovchi PR'lar ochtir — shunda versiyalar eskirmaydi va har yangilanish review'dan o'tadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible

Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41422	<p>Ansible <code>become: true</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>become: true</code> — task'ni (yoki play'ni) boshqa foydalanuvchi huquqi bilan, default'da <code>root</code> sifatida bajarish (privilege escalation). Usul default <code>sudo</code>; <code>become_user</code> (masalan <code>postgres</code>) va <code>become_method</code> (<code>su</code>, <code>doas</code>, <code>runas</code>...) bilan sozlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ansible SSH orqali oddiy foydalanuvchi (<code>deploy</code>, <code>ubuntu</code>) sifatida ulanadi — root SSH login o'chirilgan bo'lishi kerak. Lekin paket o'rnatish, <code>/etc</code> ni tahrirlash root huquqini talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SSH: ubuntu@web1<br>   v  become: true<br>sudo -H -S -n -u root /bin/sh -c 'python3 module.py'<br>   v<br>modul root sifatida bajariladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>- hosts: web<br>  remote_user: ubuntu<br>  become: true                  # butun play root sifatida<br>  tasks:<br>    - name: nginx o'rnatish<br>      ansible.builtin.apt: { name: nginx, state: present }<br><br>    - name: Faqat shu task - postgres user sifatida<br>      community.postgresql.postgresql_db: { name: app }<br>      become_user: postgres<br><br>    - name: root kerak bo'lmagan task<br>      ansible.builtin.command: whoami<br>      become: false</pre><pre>ansible-playbook site.yml -K          # --ask-become-pass: sudo parolini so'raydi<br>ansible web -b -m ansible.builtin.command -a 'id'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Butun play'ga <code>become: true</code> — hamma task root; least privilege uchun faqat kerakli task'larda yoq.</li><li>Root bo'lmagan <code>become_user</code> (postgres) bilan vaqtinchalik fayllar ruxsati muammosi — <code>allow_world_readable_tmpfiles</code> yoki ACL (<code>setfacl</code>) kerak.</li><li>sudo <code>requiretty</code> yoki parol talab qilsa, CI'da osilib qoladi — sudoers'da <code>NOPASSWD</code> (cheklangan) yoki <code>-K</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> sudoers'da Ansible user'iga cheksiz <code>NOPASSWD: ALL</code> berish keng tarqalgan, lekin audit uchun yomon; kamida session log (sudo I/O logging) va alohida deploy user ishlat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible

Abstrakt API va aniq cloud maydonlari orasida tarjima qatlami kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Claim spec.parameters.size = &quot;large&quot;<br>     v FromCompositeFieldPath + map transform<br>RDS spec.forProvider.instanceClass = &quot;db.r6g.xlarge&quot;<br><br>RDS status.atProvider.endpoint<br>     v ToCompositeFieldPath<br>XR status.endpoint  (developer ko'radi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>pipeline:<br>  - step: patch-and-transform<br>    functionRef: { name: function-patch-and-transform }<br>    input:<br>      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1<br>      kind: Resources<br>      resources:<br>        - name: rds<br>          base:<br>            apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta3<br>            kind: Instance<br>            spec:<br>              forProvider: { engine: postgres, region: eu-central-1 }<br>          patches:<br>            - type: FromCompositeFieldPath<br>              fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.size<br>              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass<br>              transforms:<br>                - type: map<br>                  map: { small: db.t4g.medium, large: db.r6g.xlarge }<br>            - type: FromCompositeFieldPath<br>              fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.storageGB<br>              toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage<br>            - type: ToCompositeFieldPath<br>              fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address<br>              toFieldPath: status.endpoint</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Manba maydon bo'sh bo'lsa patch jim o'tkazib yuboriladi (default <code>policy.fromFieldPath: Optional</code>) — muhim maydonlar uchun <code>Required</code>.</li><li>Map'da yo'q qiymat (<code>size: medium</code>) — xato; Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41449	<p>Pulumi policy enforcement level (<code>mandatory</code> va <code>advisory</code>) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CrossGuard policy'larida <code>enforcementLevel</code>: <code>advisory</code> — qoida buzilsa ogohlantirish chiqadi, lekin <code>pulumi up</code> davom etadi; <code>mandatory</code> — buzilish yangilanishni bloklaydi (preview/up yiqiladi); <code>remediate</code> — policy resurs xususiyatlarini avtomatik tuzatadi; <code>disabled</code> — o'chirilgan.   -&gt; davom<br>   mandatory -&gt; &quot;mandatory: [rds-encrypted] ...&quot; -&gt; error: preview failed     -&gt; to'xtaydi<br>   remediate -&gt; resurs props avtomatik o'zgartiriladi (masalan tag qo'shiladi) -&gt; davom</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>new PolicyPack(&quot;acme&quot;, {<br>  enforcementLevel: &quot;advisory&quot;,          // pack bo'yicha default<br>  policies: [<br>    {<br>      name: &quot;require-cost-center&quot;,<br>      description: &quot;CostCenter tag majburiy&quot;,<br>      enforcementLevel: &quot;advisory&quot;,      // yangi qoida - avval ogohlantirish<br>      validateResource: (args, report) =&gt; {<br>        if (args.props.tags &amp;&amp; !args.props.tags.CostCenter) report(&quot;CostCenter tag'i yo'q&quot;);<br>      },<br>    },<br>    {<br>      name: &quot;no-public-buckets&quot;,<br>      description: &quot;Public S3 taqiqlangan&quot;,<br>      enforcementLevel: &quot;mandatory&quot;,     // jiddiy xavf - bloklaydi<br>      validateResource: validateResourceOfType(aws.s3.BucketAclV2, (acl, _, report) =&gt; Interview Drill::IaC::H22 Crossplane, Pulumi, Ansible	idrill-41450	<p>Crossplane <code>Ready: True</code> holati nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Crossplane managed resurslarida ikki asosiy condition bor: <code>Synced: True</code> — controller oxirgi reconcile'ni xatosiz bajardi (cloud API'ga so'rov muvaffaqiyatli); <code>Ready: True</code> — tashqi cloud resurs haqiqatan yaratilgan va foydalanishga tayyor (masalan RDS <code>available</code>). Composite/Claim'larda <code>Ready</code> barcha tarkibiy resurslar tayyor bo'lganda <code>True</code> bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>kubectl apply</code> muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi, lekin DB hali yo'q. Ilovani qachon ishga tushirish mumkinligini va muammo qayerda ekanini bilish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Synced  Ready   ma'nosi<br>True    False   API so'rovi OK, resurs hali yaratilmoqda (RDS ~10 daqiqa)   -&gt; kut<br>True    True    hammasi tayyor<br>False   False   reconcile xatosi (IAM ruxsat, noto'g'ri parametr)             -&gt; describe/events<br>False   True    resurs bor, lekin oxirgi yangilash yiqildi (drift tuzatilmayapti)</pre><p>Ready reason'lari: <code>Creating</code>, <code>Available</code>, <code>Deleting</code>, <code>Unavailable</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get instance.rds.aws.upbound.io<br># NAME      SYNCED   READY   EXTERNAL-NAME   AGE<br># prod-db   True     False   prod-db         4m<br><br>kubectl describe instance.rds.aws.upbound.io prod-db | sed -n '/Conditions/,/Events/p'<br>kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=prod-db<br><br># Claim tayyor bo'lishini kutish (CI/skriptda)<br>kubectl wait postgresql/orders-db -n team-a --for=condition=Ready --timeout=20m<br><br># Composite ichidagi resurslar daraxti<br>crossplane beta trace postgresql orders-db -n team-a</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat <code>Ready</code> ga qarash — <code>Synced: False</code> bo'lsa, <code>Ready: True</code> eski holatni ko'rsatishi mumkin (o'zgarishlaring qo'llanmagan).</li><li>Composition'da readiness check'lar noto'g'ri sozlansa (<code>function-auto-ready</code> yo'q) — Claim hech qachon Ready bo'lmaydi.</li><li><code>kubectl wait</code> ni timeout'siz ishlatish — CI cheksiz osiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>crossplane beta trace</code> — ko'p darajali Composition'larni debug qilishning eng tez yo'li: qaysi tarkibiy resurs Ready emasligini va sababini daraxt shaklida ko'rsatadi. Bu condition'larni monitoring'ga (kube-state-metrics custom resource state) chiqarib alert qil.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h22 Crossplane_Pulumi_Ansible
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-2019	<p>Log, metrika va trace farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Log — alohida hodisa yozuvi (&quot;nima bo'ldi&quot;). Metrika — vaqt bo'yicha agregatlangan son (RPS, xato %, latency). Trace — bitta so'rovning servislar bo'ylab yo'li va har qadam qancha vaqt olgani.</p><p><b>Nega uchalasi kerak:</b> Kechasi &quot;checkout sekin&quot; degan shikoyat keldi. Metrika aytadi: p99 latency 2s ga chiqdi, 14:05 dan beri. Trace aytadi: vaqtning 1.8s i <code>payment-service -&gt; bank API</code> chaqiruvida. Log aytadi: <code>bank API timeout, retry 3/3</code>. Bittasi bilan javob topilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday bog'lanadi:</b></p><pre>Metrika (alert)  --&gt; &quot;muammo bor, qayerda?&quot;<br>      |<br>      v<br>Trace (trace_id) --&gt; &quot;qaysi servis / qadam sekin?&quot;<br>      |<br>      v<br>Log (trace_id)   --&gt; &quot;aniq nima bo'ldi, qaysi xato?&quot;</pre><p>| | Log | Metrika | Trace | |---|---|---|---| | Birlik | hodisa | son (time series) | span'lar daraxti | | Narx | qimmat (hajm) | arzon | o'rtacha (sampling) | | Savol | nima? nega? | qancha? qachondan? | qayerda sekin? | | Vosita | Loki, ELK | Prometheus | Jaeger, Tempo |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b> log qatoriga <code>trace_id</code> qo'shiladi:</p><pre>{&quot;ts&quot;:&quot;2026-10-03T14:05:12Z&quot;,&quot;level&quot;:&quot;error&quot;,&quot;service&quot;:&quot;payment&quot;,&quot;trace_id&quot;:&quot;4bf92f35...&quot;,&quot;msg&quot;:&quot;bank timeout&quot;}</pre><p>Grafana'da metrika grafigidan exemplar orqali trace'ga, trace'dan shu <code>trace_id</code> loglariga o'tasan.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma narsani logga yozib, metrikani logdan hisoblash — qimmat va sekin.</li><li><code>trace_id</code> logda yo'q — uchala signalni bog'lab bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Metrika label'iga <code>user_id</code> qo'yish — kardinallik portlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alert metrikadan, tahlil trace/logdan. Uchala signal bitta korrelyatsiya kaliti (<code>trace_id</code>) bilan bog'lanmasa, bu observability emas — uchta alohida monitoring.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Logging
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-33485	<p>MTTD, MTTR, MTBF nima va ularni qanday yaxshilaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> MTTD — nosozlik boshlanishidan aniqlanishigacha o'rtacha vaqt. MTTR — aniqlanishdan tiklanishgacha (ba'zan boshidan). MTBF — ikki nosozlik orasidagi o'rtacha vaqt. Birinchi ikkisi kichik, uchinchisi katta bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Vaqt chizig'i:</b></p><pre>nosozlik --MTTD--&gt; aniqlandi --(triage, fix)--&gt; tiklandi ....MTBF.... keyingi nosozlik<br>   |&lt;------------------- foydalanuvchi ta'siri -------&gt;|</pre><p>Foydalanuvchi zarari = MTTD + MTTR. Ko'p jamoa faqat MTTR ga qaraydi, holbuki 40 daqiqa &quot;hech kim bilmagan&quot; vaqt eng katta qism bo'lishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday yaxshilanadi:</b></p><p>| Metrika | Yaxshilash | |---|---| | MTTD | Simptom (SLO burn rate) alert'lari, synthetic monitoring, to'g'ri threshold va <code>for:</code> | | MTTR | Runbook, bir tugmali rollback, feature flag, dashboard + trace, on-call mashqi | | MTBF | Test, canary deploy, capacity planning, chaos testlar, postmortem action item'lar |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b> incident tracker'da (PagerDuty, incident.io, Jira) har incident uchun <code>started_at</code>, <code>detected_at</code>, <code>mitigated_at</code>, <code>resolved_at</code> maydonlarini majburiy qil. Keyin:</p><pre>SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY detected_at - started_at) AS mttd_p50,<br>       percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mitigated_at - detected_at) AS mttr_p90<br>FROM incidents WHERE created_at &gt; now() - interval '90 days';</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>O'rtacha chalg'itadi: bitta 10 soatlik incident 20 ta qisqasini yashiradi — median va p90 ko'r.</li><li>MTTR'ni &quot;resolved&quot; bo'yicha o'lchash: root cause fix haftalab cho'ziladi; foydalanuvchi uchun &quot;mitigated&quot; muhim.</li><li>Metrikani KPI qilib jamoaga bosim — incident'lar yashiriladi yoki SEV darajasi pasaytiriladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tez tiklash (rollback, flag) ko'pincha nosozlikni oldini olishdan arzonroq. DORA ham &quot;time to restore service&quot; ni asosiy metrika deb oladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Logging

Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-2021	<p>Trace servis chegarasida uzilib qolyapti (har servis alohida trace ko'rsatadi). Sabab?</p><pre>// A servis<br>span = tracer.start_span(&quot;call_b&quot;)<br>resp = http.get(&quot;http://b/api/items&quot;)   # header yo'q<br>span.end()</pre>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Trace konteksti (<code>traceparent</code> header) keyingi servisga uzatilmagan. Yechim — HTTP/gRPC client'ni instrumentatsiya qilish yoki propagator orqali <code>inject(ctx, headers)</code> chaqirish, qabul qiluvchida <code>extract</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo qanday ko'rinadi:</b> Jaeger'da <code>orders</code> trace'i 20ms da tugaydi, <code>payments</code> esa alohida, o'z root span'i bilan boshqa trace sifatida. Ular bitta so'rov ekanini bilib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (W3C Trace Context):</b></p><pre>orders (span A)                     payments<br>  ctx{trace=abc, span=A}<br>     |  inject  -&gt; header:<br>     |  traceparent: 00-abc...-A...-01<br>     +-----------------------------&gt;  extract -&gt; parent=A<br>                                      yangi span B (trace=abc)</pre><p>Format: <code>version-traceid(32 hex)-parentid(16 hex)-flags</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda (Go, OpenTelemetry):</b></p><pre>// client: instrumented transport<br>client := http.Client{Transport: otelhttp.NewTransport(http.DefaultTransport)}<br>req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, &quot;GET&quot;, url, nil) // ctx muhim!<br><br>// server<br>handler := otelhttp.NewHandler(mux, &quot;orders&quot;)<br><br>// global propagator<br>otel.SetTextMapPropagator(propagation.TraceContext{})</pre><p>Kafka uchun: producer'da <code>otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Inject(ctx, carrier)</code> — xabar header'iga; consumer'da <code>Extract</code>.</p><p><b>Tipik uzilish joylari:</b></p><ul><li><code>context.Background()</code> ishlatilgan — so'rov ctx'i uzatilmagan.</li><li>Qo'lda yozilgan HTTP client, instrumentatsiyasiz.</li><li>Message queue, cron, goroutine ichidagi async ish.</li><li>Proxy/gateway header'ni o'chirib tashlaydi yoki boshqa format (B3 vs W3C) — propagator mos emas.</li></ul><p><b>Tekshirish:</b> <code>curl -v</code> bilan keyingi servisga ketayotgan so'rovda <code>traceparent</code> header bormi; servisda kelgan header'ni logla.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Propagation — eng zaif bo'g'in. Uni platform kutubxonasida majburiy qil va &quot;orphan root span&quot; sonini metrika sifatida kuzat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::i3 Tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-33484	<p>Toil nima va uni qanday kamaytirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Toil — qo'lda, takroriy, avtomatlashtirsa bo'ladigan, uzoq muddatli qiymat bermaydigan va servis o'sishi bilan chiziqli o'sadigan operatsion ish. Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-2022	<p>Servis uchun qaysi to'plam asosiy metrika sifatida eng foydali (RED metodikasi)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> RED: <b>Rate</b> (so'rov/s), <b>Errors</b> (xato ulushi), <b>Duration</b> (latency taqsimoti — p50/p95/p99). Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-30035	<p>Distributed tracing joriy qilindi, lekin sekin so'rovlar trace'da ko'rinmaydi. Sabab?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Sabab, ehtimol, head-based sampling (masalan 1%): saqlash qarori so'rov boshida, natija noma'lum paytda qabul qilinadi, shuning uchun kam uchraydigan sekin so'rovlar deyarli tushmaydi. Yechim — tail-based sampling (OTel Collector) yoki xato/sekin trace'larni majburiy saqlash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Head-based:   so'rov keldi -&gt; tanga tashla (1%) -&gt; saqla/tashla<br>              (qaror erta, sekinligini hali bilmaymiz)<br><br>Tail-based:   barcha span'lar -&gt; Collector buffer (masalan 10s)<br>              -&gt; trace tugadi -&gt; qoida: xato? &gt;1s? -&gt; saqla<br>                                   aks holda 1% -&gt; saqla</pre><p><b>Amalda (OTel Collector tail_sampling):</b></p><pre>processors:<br>  tail_sampling:<br>    decision_wait: 10s<br>    policies:<br>      - name: errors<br>        type: status_code<br>        status_code: {status_codes: [ERROR]}<br>      - name: slow<br>        type: latency<br>        latency: {threshold_ms: 1000}<br>      - name: baseline<br>        type: probabilistic<br>        probabilistic: {sampling_percentage: 1}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tail sampling uchun bitta trace'ning barcha span'lari bitta Collector'ga kelishi kerak — oldiga <code>loadbalancing</code> exporter (trace_id bo'yicha) qo'y.</li><li><code>decision_wait</code> dan uzun trace'lar bo'linib qoladi.</li><li>Collector xotirasi: buffer RPS x wait vaqtiga proporsional.</li><li>Servislar orasida sampling qarori uzatilmasa (parent-based emas) — trace yarim bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Gibrid: SDK'da head sampling yuqori (masalan 10-20%) + Collector'da tail qoidalar. Metrikalarni sampling'dan oldin (spanmetrics connector) hisobla — aks holda RED statistikasi buziladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::i3 Tracing

Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-30266	<p>RED va USE metodikalari nimani anglatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> RED (servislar uchun): Rate, Errors, Duration — foydalanuvchi ko'rgan holat. Blameless postmortem &quot;kim?&quot; emas, &quot;qanday shart-sharoit bu xatoni mumkin qildi?&quot; deb so'raydi.</p><p><b>Nega bu texnik masala:</b> Muhandis <code>DROP TABLE</code> ni noto'g'ri DB'da bajardi. Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-30449	<p>OpenTelemetry'da span, trace va context propagation qanday bog'lanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Trace — bitta so'rov bo'ylab span'lar daraxti (umumiy <code>trace_id</code>). Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34036	<p>Monitoring va logging farqi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Monitoring — tizim holatini oldindan belgilangan metrikalar orqali kuzatish va alert berish (&quot;nima bo'lyapti?&quot;). Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34037	<p>Prometheus'da counter, gauge, histogram farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Counter — faqat o'sadigan son (restart'da 0 ga tushadi), masalan jami so'rovlar. Gauge — ixtiyoriy ko'tarilib-tushadigan joriy qiymat, masalan xotira. Histogram — qiymatlarni bucket'larga taqsimlaydi, latency persentillarini hisoblash uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday farqlanadi:</b></p><p>| Tur | Xususiyat | Misol | Odatiy so'rov | |---|---|---|---| | Counter | faqat o'sadi | <code>http_requests_total</code> | <code>rate(x[5m])</code> | | Gauge | yuqori-past | <code>node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes</code> | to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, <code>avg_over_time</code> | | Histogram | <code>_bucket</code>, <code>_sum</code>, <code>_count</code> | <code>http_request_duration_seconds</code> | <code>histogram_quantile(0.95, ...)</code> | | Summary | klientda quantile | eski kod | agregatsiya qilib bo'lmaydi |</p><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>reqs := prometheus.NewCounterVec(prometheus.CounterOpts{Name: &quot;http_requests_total&quot;}, []string{&quot;code&quot;})<br>inflight := prometheus.NewGauge(prometheus.GaugeOpts{Name: &quot;http_inflight_requests&quot;})<br>dur := prometheus.NewHistogram(prometheus.HistogramOpts{<br>    Name: &quot;http_request_duration_seconds&quot;, Buckets: prometheus.DefBuckets})<br><br>reqs.WithLabelValues(&quot;200&quot;).Inc()<br>inflight.Inc(); defer inflight.Dec()<br>dur.Observe(time.Since(start).Seconds())</pre><p>So'rovlar:</p><pre>rate(http_requests_total[5m])            # sekundiga so'rov<br>http_inflight_requests                   # hozirgi qiymat<br>histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Counter'ni xom grafikda ko'rsatish — doim o'sadigan chiziq, foydasiz; <code>rate()</code> ishlat.</li><li>Counter uchun <code>rate</code> emas <code>delta</code>, gauge uchun <code>rate</code> — noto'g'ri natija.</li><li>Counter nomi <code>_total</code> bilan tugasin; birlik nomda (<code>_seconds</code>, <code>_bytes</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>rate()</code> counter reset'ni (pod restart) avtomatik hisobga oladi — shuning uchun counter kamayishi muammo emas. Latency uchun har doim histogram tanla.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Metrics
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34038	<p>Yaxshi alert qanday bo'lishi kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yaxshi alert — actionable (kelsa, odam aniq ish qiladi), foydalanuvchiga ta'sir qiladigan simptom bo'yicha, qisqa sakrashlarda uyg'otmaydi (<code>for:</code>), to'g'ri severity'ga ega va runbook havolasi bilan keladi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Har shovqinli alert jamoaning ishonchini kamaytiradi. 50 ta bekor alertdan keyin 51-chi haqiqiysi ham e'tiborsiz qoladi (alert fatigue).</p><p><b>Yaxshi va yomon:</b></p><p>| Yomon | Yaxshi | |---|---| | CPU &gt; 80% | Xato ulushi &gt; 2% 5 daqiqa | | Pod restart bo'ldi | Checkout SLO budjeti tez yonmoqda | | Disk 85% | Disk 4 soatda to'ladi (bashorat) | | Runbook yo'q | <code>runbook_url</code> bor |</p><p><b>Amalda (Prometheus):</b></p><pre>- alert: HighErrorRate<br>  expr: |<br>    sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;,code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>    / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;}[5m])) &gt; 0.02<br>  for: 5m<br>  labels:<br>    severity: page<br>    team: payments<br>  annotations:<br>    summary: &quot;API xato ulushi {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}&quot;<br>    runbook_url: &quot;https://wiki/runbooks/api-high-errors&quot;</pre><p>Disk bashorati:</p><pre>predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes[6h], 4*3600) &lt; 0</pre><p><b>Tekshirish savollari:</b> Bu alert kelsa nima qilaman? Shoshilinchmi (tun 3 da)? Foydalanuvchi zarar ko'ryaptimi? Javob yo'q bo'lsa — page emas.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>for:</code> yo'q — 10 soniyalik sakrash uyg'otadi.</li><li>Bir muammo uchun 20 ta alert (har pod) — Alertmanager <code>group_by</code> ishlat.</li><li>Alert matni &quot;Something wrong&quot; — kontekst yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Severity ikki daraja yetarli: page (hozir, odam kerak) va ticket (ish vaqtida). Har alertni har oy review qil: necha marta keldi, necha marta harakat qilindi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Metrics
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34039	<p>Golden signals (4 ta asosiy signal) qaysilar?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Google SRE'ning 4 golden signal'i: <b>Latency</b> (so'rov qancha vaqt oladi), <b>Traffic</b> (yuklama, RPS), <b>Errors</b> (xato ulushi), <b>Saturation</b> (resurs qanchalik to'lgan). Faqat 4 ta narsani kuzatsang, shularni kuzat.</p><p><b>Nega aynan to'rtta:</b> Ular foydalanuvchi tajribasini (latency, errors) va tizim sig'imini (traffic, saturation) qamraydi. Ko'p incident shu to'rttadan birida birinchi ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Har biri:</b></p><pre>Latency    -&gt; p50/p95/p99 (o'rtacha emas!); xato so'rovlarini alohida<br>Traffic    -&gt; RPS, aktiv sessiya, xabar/s<br>Errors     -&gt; 5xx ulushi, noto'g'ri javob (200 lekin bo'sh)<br>Saturation -&gt; CPU, RAM, DB pool, queue uzunligi, disk I/O navbat</pre><p><b>Amalda (PromQL):</b></p><pre># Latency p95<br>histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))<br># Traffic<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br># Errors<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br># Saturation (CPU throttling)<br>rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m]) / rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m])</pre><p><b>Bog'liq metodikalar:</b></p><ul><li>RED (Rate, Errors, Duration) — servislar uchun, golden signals'ning qisqasi.</li><li>USE (Utilization, Saturation, Errors) — resurslar uchun.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tez xato javoblar latency'ni &quot;yaxshilaydi&quot; — muvaffaqiyatli va xato so'rovlarni alohida o'lcha.</li><li>Saturation'ni faqat CPU deb bilish — ko'pincha bo'g'iz connection pool yoki queue.</li><li>200 qaytib, ichida xato bor — bu ham error (application-level).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Saturation — yagona &quot;oldindan ogohlantiruvchi&quot; signal: latency va xato o'smasdan oldin navbat o'sadi. Uni alert'ga emas, capacity planning dashboard'iga qo'y.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Metrics
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34040	<p>Nega o'rtacha (average) latency yetarli emas, p95/p99 kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> O'rtacha qiymat sekin so'rovlarni (tail latency) yashiradi. p95/p99 &quot;eng yomon 5% / 1% foydalanuvchi qancha kutdi&quot; ni ko'rsatadi — aynan ular shikoyat qiladi.</p><p><b>Oddiy misol:</b></p><pre>99 so'rov x 50ms  +  1 so'rov x 5000ms<br>o'rtacha = (99*50 + 5000) / 100 = ~100ms   &lt;- &quot;yaxshi&quot;<br>p99      = 5000ms                          &lt;- haqiqat</pre><p><b>Persentillar:</b></p><ul><li><b>p50 (median)</b> — odatiy foydalanuvchi.</li><li><b>p95</b> — 20 ta so'rovdan 1 tasi shundan sekin.</li><li><b>p99</b> — 100 tadan 1 tasi; tail latency.</li></ul><p><b>Nega p99 ko'pchilikka ta'sir qiladi:</b> Bitta sahifa 30 ta backend so'rov qilsa, ulardan kamida bittasi p99'ga tushish ehtimoli: <code>1 - 0.99^30 = ~26%</code>. Ya'ni har 4-sahifa sekin yuklanadi.</p><p><b>Amalda (Prometheus):</b></p><pre>histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))<br>histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))</pre><p>Grafana'da p50, p95, p99 ni bitta grafikda chiz — ular orasidagi masofa kengaysa, muammo bor.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Persentillarni o'rtachalash (10 pod'ning p99'lari o'rtachasi) — matematik jihatdan noto'g'ri; bucket'larni qo'shib, keyin quantile ol.</li><li>Kam so'rovda p99 ma'nosiz (10 ta so'rovda p99 = eng sekin bittasi).</li><li>Faqat p99 ga qarab p50 ni unutish — ko'pchilik tajribasi ham muhim.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SLO odatda persentil bilan yoziladi (&quot;p95 &lt; 300ms&quot;) yoki ulush bilan (&quot;so'rovlarning 99% i 300ms dan tez&quot;) — ikkinchisi Prometheus'da aniqroq hisoblanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Metrics
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34041	<p>Dashboard'da nimani ko'rsatish kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dashboard bitta savolga tez javob berishi kerak: &quot;servis hozir yaxshimi?&quot;. Tepada — foydalanuvchi ko'rgan signallar (RPS, xato %, p95 latency), pastda — resurslar (CPU, RAM, pool, queue), grafiklarda deploy annotatsiyalari.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 50 panelli dashboard — incident paytida hech kim qaerga qarashni bilmaydi. Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34303	<p>Postmortem (incident review) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Postmortem — incident tugagandan keyin yoziladigan hujjat va uchrashuv: nima bo'ldi, qanday ta'sir qildi, nega bo'ldi, qanday tuzatildi va takrorlanmasligi uchun nima qilamiz. Maqsad — aybdor topish emas, tizimni yaxshilash (blameless).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Postmortem'siz incident — bekorga sarflangan og'riq. Xuddi shu sabab 2 oydan keyin qaytadi.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>1. Xulosa         -&gt; 2-3 jumla<br>2. Ta'sir         -&gt; kim, qancha vaqt, nechta so'rov/buyurtma<br>3. Timeline (UTC) -&gt; 14:02 deploy, 14:05 alert, 14:20 rollback, 14:25 tiklandi<br>4. Root cause     -&gt; va hissa qo'shgan omillar<br>5. Nima yaxshi ishladi / ishlamadi / omadimiz keldi<br>6. Action item'lar -&gt; egasi + muddat + ticket</pre><p><b>Amalda (misol):</b></p><pre>Xulosa: v2.3 deploy'dagi migratsiya orders jadvalini 15 daqiqa lock qildi.<br>Ta'sir: 15 daqiqa davomida 100% checkout xato, ~1200 buyurtma.<br>Root cause: ALTER TABLE ... NOT NULL default bilan katta jadvalda lock oldi.<br>Action:<br> - Migratsiyalar CI'da lock tekshiruvidan o'tsin (OPS-101, @dilshod, 20.10)<br> - Deploy'da avtomatik rollback SLO bo'yicha (OPS-102, @aziz, 30.10)</pre><p><b>Qachon yoziladi:</b> SEV1/SEV2 da har doim; error budget'ning katta qismi yonganda; &quot;near miss&quot; (deyarli bo'lgan) holatlarda ham foydali.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Human error&quot; ni root cause deb yozish — u boshlanish, sabab emas.</li><li>Action item egasiz va muddatsiz — hech qachon bajarilmaydi.</li><li>Postmortem 3 hafta keyin — tafsilotlar unutilgan; 2-5 kun ichida yoz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Postmortem'larni hammaga ochiq kutubxonada saqla va chorakda bir umumiy tahlil qil — takrorlanuvchi naqshlar (config, deploy, dependency) arxitektura investitsiyasini asoslaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Alerting
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34304	<p>Runbook nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Runbook — aniq alert yoki vaziyat uchun qadam-baqadam ko'rsatma: nimani tekshirish, qaysi buyruqni bajarish, qachon kimga eskalatsiya qilish. Tun 3 da uyg'ongan, bu servisni bilmaydigan on-call ham undan foydalana olishi kerak.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Bilim bitta odamning boshida bo'lsa — u ta'tilda bo'lganda MTTR soatlarga cho'ziladi. Runbook bilimni jamoaga tarqatadi va stress paytida xato kamayadi.</p><p><b>Yaxshi runbook tuzilmasi:</b></p><pre>## DiskAlmostFull<br>Ma'nosi: /var 90% dan oshdi, ~4 soatda to'ladi.<br>Ta'sir: to'lsa DB yozolmaydi -&gt; checkout xato.<br>Dashboard: https://grafana/d/node<br>Tekshirish:<br>  1. df -h; du -xh /var --max-depth=1 | sort -h | tail<br>Tuzatish:<br>  2. journalctl --vacuum-size=500M<br>  3. docker system prune -f          # konteyner hostlarda<br>  4. find /var/log/app -name '*.gz' -mtime +7 -delete<br>Tasdiqlash:<br>  5. df -h /var  -&gt; 80% dan past<br>Eskalatsiya: 15 daqiqada hal bo'lmasa -&gt; #sre, @storage-oncall</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> Alert'ga havola qo'shiladi:</p><pre>annotations:<br>  runbook_url: https://wiki.example.com/runbooks/DiskAlmostFull</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eskirgan runbook — buyruqlar ishlamaydi, ishonch yo'qoladi; GameDay'da sinab tur.</li><li>&quot;Logs'ni tekshiring&quot; kabi noaniq qadamlar — aniq buyruq yoz.</li><li>Xavfli buyruq (<code>rm -rf</code>, DB restart) ogohlantirishsiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Runbook — avtomatlashtirishning birinchi bosqichi: runbook -&gt; script -&gt; avtomatik remediation. Agar runbook har hafta bir xil bajarilsa — u toil, avtomatlashtir yoki ildizini tuzat.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Alerting
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34305	<p>Severity darajalari (SEV1, SEV2, ...) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Severity (SEV) — incident'ning jiddiylik darajasi. U kim qanchalik tez javob berishi, kim xabardor qilinishi va postmortem kerakmi — shuni belgilaydi. Odatda SEV1 eng jiddiy (asosiy funksiya ishlamaydi), SEV3-4 kichik muammolar.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Har muammo uchun hammani uyg'otish — charchoq. Darajalar oldindan yozilsa, incident paytida bahs bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Odatiy jadval:</b></p><p>| Daraja | Mezon | Misol | Javob | |---|---|---|---| | SEV1 | asosiy funksiya hamma uchun ishlamaydi, pul/ma'lumot yo'qolyapti | to'lov ishlamaydi, data leak | darhol, incident commander, status page | | SEV2 | muhim feature yiqilgan yoki ko'p foydalanuvchiga ta'sir | qidiruv ishlamaydi, bir region down | 15-30 daqiqada | | SEV3 | kichik ta'sir, workaround bor | sekinlik, bitta hisobot xato | ish vaqtida | | SEV4 | kosmetik | UI'da matn xato | backlog |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><ul><li>SEV1/SEV2: incident kanali (<code>#inc-2026-10-03-checkout</code>), rollar: Incident Commander, Communications, Ops.</li><li>Har 30 daqiqada stakeholder'larga holat.</li><li>SEV1/SEV2 dan keyin majburiy postmortem.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Darajani &quot;obro'&quot; uchun pasaytirish — postmortem va o'rganish yo'qoladi.</li><li>Mezon noaniq (&quot;katta ta'sir&quot;) — raqam bilan yoz (foydalanuvchi %, daromad).</li><li>Darajani o'zgartirmaslik — incident o'sib borsa SEV2 dan SEV1 ga ko'tarish mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Shubha bo'lsa — yuqoriroq daraja e'lon qil, keyin pasaytir. Ortiqcha javob arzon, kech javob qimmat.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Alerting
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34307	<p>Alert fatigue nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Alert fatigue — alertlar shunchalik ko'p va ko'pi foydasiz bo'lganki, jamoa ularga e'tibor bermay qo'yadi. Natijada haqiqiy, muhim alert ham o'tkazib yuboriladi.</p><p><b>Qanday paydo bo'ladi:</b></p><pre>ko'p alert -&gt; ko'pi &quot;o'zi o'tib ketdi&quot; -&gt; odamlar jim qiladi<br>   -&gt; haqiqiy DB down alerti ham e'tiborsiz -&gt; katta incident</pre><p>Belgilari: kuniga o'nlab page, on-call charchagan, alertlar Slack kanalida o'qilmasdan turadi.</p><p><b>Yechim:</b></p><ol><li><b>Actionable bo'lsin</b> — har alertga &quot;kelsa nima qilaman?&quot; javobi bo'lsin; bo'lmasa o'chir yoki dashboard'ga o'tkaz.</li><li><b>Simptom bo'yicha</b> — &quot;xato 5% dan oshdi&quot;, &quot;CPU 80%&quot; emas.</li><li><b><code>for:</code> davomiylik</b> — qisqa sakrashlarga uyg'otmasin.</li><li><b>Grouping</b> — bir muammo 30 ta alert bermasin.</li><li><b>Severity</b> — page (hozir) va ticket (ish vaqtida) ajratilsin.</li><li><b>Haftalik review</b> — eng shovqinli alertlarni tuzat yoki o'chir.</li></ol><p><b>Amalda (Alertmanager):</b></p><pre>route:<br>  group_by: [alertname, cluster, service]<br>  group_wait: 30s<br>  group_interval: 5m<br>  repeat_interval: 4h<br>inhibit_rules:<br>  - source_matchers: [alertname=&quot;ClusterDown&quot;]<br>    target_matchers: [severity=&quot;warning&quot;]<br>    equal: [cluster]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Threshold'ni shunchaki ko'tarish — haqiqiy muammoni ham yashiradi.</li><li>Hamma alertni bir kanalga — muhimi ko'milib ketadi.</li><li>&quot;Silence&quot; ni muddatsiz qo'yish — unutiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> O'lchab boshqar: har alert uchun &quot;keldi / harakat qilindi&quot; nisbati. Nisbati past alertlar — birinchi tozalash nomzodlari.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Alerting
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34308	<p>Health check endpoint'da nimani qaytarish kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikki xil endpoint bo'lishi kerak: <b>liveness</b> (<code>/healthz</code>) — jarayon tirikmi (faqat o'z holati, tashqi dependency'siz); <b>readiness</b> (<code>/ready</code>) — trafik qabul qilishga tayyormi (DB ulanishi, warm-up, kerakli dependency'lar). Javob — HTTP status kod (200/503) va qisqa JSON.</p><p><b>Nega ajratiladi:</b> Kubernetes liveness fail bo'lsa podni restart qiladi, readiness fail bo'lsa — faqat trafikdan chiqaradi. Agar liveness'da DB tekshirilsa: DB 1 daqiqa sekinlashdi -&gt; hamma pod restart -&gt; cold start -&gt; to'liq outage.</p><pre>liveness  fail -&gt; kubelet restart qiladi<br>readiness fail -&gt; Service endpoint'dan chiqariladi (restart yo'q)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>http.HandleFunc(&quot;/healthz&quot;, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {<br>    w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK) // jarayon javob beryapti<br>})<br>http.HandleFunc(&quot;/ready&quot;, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {<br>    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 500*time.Millisecond)<br>    defer cancel()<br>    if shuttingDown.Load() || db.PingContext(ctx) != nil {<br>        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)<br>        json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{&quot;status&quot;: &quot;not_ready&quot;})<br>        return<br>    }<br>    json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{&quot;status&quot;: &quot;ok&quot;, &quot;db&quot;: &quot;ok&quot;})<br>})</pre><pre>livenessProbe:  {httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: 8080}, periodSeconds: 10, failureThreshold: 3}<br>readinessProbe: {httpGet: {path: /ready, port: 8080}, periodSeconds: 5}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Liveness'ga DB/tashqi API qo'shish — dependency nosozligi cascade restart beradi.</li><li>Health endpoint'da versiya, hostname, ichki IP ochiq — tashqariga yopiq bo'lsin.</li><li>Readiness'da sekin tekshiruv timeout'siz — probe o'zi osilib qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Graceful shutdown'da SIGTERM kelgach avval readiness'ni 503 qil, bir necha soniya kut (endpoint'lar yangilansin), keyin ulanishlarni yop. Sekin start uchun <code>startupProbe</code> ishlat.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::i3 Alerting
Interview Drill::Observability::I3 Observability & SRE	idrill-34309	<p>APM nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> APM (Application Performance Monitoring) — ilova ichidan ishlashini kuzatish: har so'rov qancha vaqt oldi, vaqt qaysi funksiya/DB so'rovi/tashqi chaqiruvga ketdi, qanday xatolar bo'ldi. Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33196	<p>Prometheus qanday ishlaydi: pull model, exporter, scrape?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Prometheus <b>pull</b> modelida ishlaydi: har <code>scrape_interval</code> da target'lardagi HTTP <code>/metrics</code> endpoint'ini o'zi so'rab, matnli metrikalarni o'z TSDB'siga yozadi. Ilovada metrika bo'lmasa (OS, DB, nginx) — <b>exporter</b> ularni Prometheus formatiga o'giradi. Alert qoidalari Prometheus'da baholanadi, xabarni Alertmanager yuboradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[app :8080/metrics] &lt;---scrape (15s)--- [Prometheus TSDB] ---&gt; [Grafana]<br>[node_exporter :9100] &lt;---------------/        |<br>[postgres_exporter :9187] &lt;-----------/        v<br>                                         [Alertmanager] -&gt; Slack / PagerDuty</pre><p><code>/metrics</code> mazmuni:</p><pre># TYPE http_requests_total counter<br>http_requests_total{method=&quot;GET&quot;,code=&quot;200&quot;} 1543</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># prometheus.yml<br>global:<br>  scrape_interval: 15s<br>scrape_configs:<br>  - job_name: node<br>    static_configs:<br>      - targets: [&quot;10.0.1.10:9100&quot;, &quot;10.0.1.11:9100&quot;]<br>  - job_name: kubernetes-pods<br>    kubernetes_sd_configs: [{ role: pod }]</pre><pre>curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | head<br>promtool check config prometheus.yml</pre><p>UI: Status -&gt; Targets — har target <code>UP</code>/<code>DOWN</code> va oxirgi xato.</p><p><b>Pull vs push:</b> | | Pull | Push | |---|---|---| | Target o'lganini bilish | <code>up == 0</code> avtomatik | jimlik = noaniq | | Yuk nazorati | Prometheus o'zi | klientlar bosishi mumkin | | Qisqa umrli job | qiyin (Pushgateway) | tabiiy |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Batch job uchun Pushgateway'ni har narsaga ishlatish — oxirgi qiymat abadiy qoladi, <code>up</code> ma'nosiz.</li><li>NAT/firewall ortidagi target'lar — pull ishlamaydi; agent rejimi + <code>remote_write</code>.</li><li>Statik target ro'yxati cloud'da eskiradi — service discovery.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> K8s'da Prometheus Operator <code>ServiceMonitor</code>/<code>PodMonitor</code> bilan target'larni deklarativ boshqaradi — har jamoa o'z monitoringini o'z namespace'ida yozadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33197	<p>Prometheus metrika turlari: counter, gauge, histogram, summary?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Counter</b> — faqat o'sadigan hisoblagich (so'rovlar, xatolar), <code>rate()</code> bilan o'qiladi; <b>gauge</b> — ko'tarilib-tushadigan joriy qiymat (xotira, navbat uzunligi); <b>histogram</b> — qiymatlarni bucket'larga taqsimlaydi va serverda istalgan quantile'ni hisoblash imkonini beradi; <b>summary</b> — quantile'ni klientda hisoblaydi va uni instance'lar bo'yicha yig'ib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (histogram):</b></p><pre>http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=&quot;0.1&quot;}  950<br>http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=&quot;0.5&quot;}  990<br>http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=&quot;+Inf&quot;} 1000<br>http_request_duration_seconds_sum   87.3<br>http_request_duration_seconds_count 1000<br>-&gt; histogram_quantile(0.99, ...) bucket'lardan p99 ni taxmin qiladi</pre><p>| Tur | Misol | Qanday so'raladi | |---|---|---| | Counter | <code>http_requests_total</code> | <code>rate(x[5m])</code> — xom qiymat ma'nosiz | | Gauge | <code>node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes</code> | to'g'ridan, <code>avg_over_time</code> | | Histogram | <code>http_request_duration_seconds_bucket</code> | <code>histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(...)))</code> | | Summary | <code>go_gc_duration_seconds{quantile=&quot;0.99&quot;}</code> | tayyor, lekin agregatsiya qilinmaydi |</p><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>var reqDur = prometheus.NewHistogramVec(prometheus.HistogramOpts{<br>    Name:    &quot;http_request_duration_seconds&quot;,<br>    Buckets: []float64{.005, .01, .025, .05, .1, .25, .5, 1, 2.5, 5},<br>}, []string{&quot;route&quot;, &quot;method&quot;})</pre><pre>histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>10 pod summary p99'larining o'rtachasi — matematik jihatdan ma'nosiz. Latency uchun histogram.</li><li>Bucket'lar SLO chegarasiga mos kelmasa (SLO 300ms, bucket 250/500) — p99 noaniq.</li><li>Counter'ni gauge sifatida ishlatish (kamaytirish) — <code>rate()</code> uni &quot;reset&quot; deb tushunadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Native histogram'lar (Prometheus 2.40+ eksperimental, 3.x da barqarorlashmoqda) bucket'larni avtomatik tanlaydi va aniqroq, arzonroq — yangi loyihalarda ko'rib chiqing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33198	<p>Asosiy PromQL so'rovlar: rate, sum by, histogram_quantile?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy uchlik: <code>rate()</code> — counter'ni sekundiga tezlikka aylantiradi; <code>sum by (label)</code> — series'larni kerakli o'lcham bo'yicha yig'adi; <code>histogram_quantile()</code> — histogram bucket'laridan p95/p99 latency hisoblaydi. Shu uchtasi bilan RED (Rate, Errors, Duration) dashboard'ning asosi quriladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>http_requests_total (counter, 50 pod x 20 route)<br>  -&gt; rate([5m])         : har series uchun req/s<br>  -&gt; sum by (service)   : servis bo'yicha bitta qiymat</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># RPS servis bo'yicha<br>sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br><br># xatolar ulushi (0..1)<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>  / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br><br># p99 latency<br>histogram_quantile(0.99,<br>  sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))<br><br># eng ko'p trafik olgan 5 route<br>topk(5, sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total[5m])))<br><br># disk 4 soatda to'ladimi<br>predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes[6h], 4*3600) &lt; 0<br><br># ishlamayotgan target'lar<br>up == 0</pre><p><b>rate vs irate:</b> <code>irate</code> faqat oxirgi 2 nuqtaga qaraydi — keskin, dashboard'da qisqa sakrashlar uchun; alert uchun doim <code>rate</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>rate(sum(x))</code> — xato tartib; avval <code>rate</code>, keyin <code>sum</code>. Aks holda counter reset'lari buziladi.</li><li><code>histogram_quantile</code> da <code>le</code> label'ini <code>sum by</code> dan tushirib qoldirish — natija NaN.</li><li>Oraliq juda qisqa (<code>[30s]</code> va 15s scrape) — bo'sh natija yoki shovqin; kamida 4x scrape interval.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p ishlatiladigan og'ir ifodalarni recording rule'larga aylantiring — dashboard tez, alert va panel bir xil ta'rifdan foydalanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33246	<p><code>rate()</code> va <code>irate()</code> farqi, nega counter'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qaralmaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Counter'ning xom qiymati (<code>1 543 211</code>) — jarayon boshlanganidan beri yig'indi; u o'zi hech narsa demaydi va restart'da 0 ga tushadi. <code>rate()</code> butun oraliq bo'yicha o'rtacha sekundlik tezlikni beradi (reset'larni to'g'rilaydi) — silliq, alert uchun. <code>irate()</code> faqat oxirgi ikki nuqtadan hisoblaydi — tez reaksiya qiladi, lekin tikanli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>qiymat: 100 ... 400 ... 0 (restart) ... 150<br>rate:   reset'ni aniqlaydi -&gt; (400-100) + 150 ni oraliqqa bo'ladi<br>irate:  faqat oxirgi 2 sample: (150 - 0) / 15s</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>rate(http_requests_total[5m])       # 5 daqiqadagi o'rtacha req/s<br>irate(http_requests_total[5m])      # oxirgi 2 sample asosida<br>increase(http_requests_total[1h])   # 1 soatdagi o'sish (~ rate * 3600)<br>sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))   # avval rate, keyin sum</pre><p>| | rate | irate | |---|---|---| | Asos | butun oraliq | oxirgi 2 sample | | Grafik | silliq | tikanli | | Alert | ha | yo'q | | Zoom-out | barqaror | qisqa sakrashlarni yo'qotadi |</p><p><b>Qoidalar:</b></p><ul><li>Oraliq kamida 4 x <code>scrape_interval</code> (15s -&gt; <code>[1m]</code> va ko'proq). Grafana'da <code>$__rate_interval</code>.</li><li>Avval <code>rate</code>, keyin agregatsiya: <code>sum(rate(x[5m]))</code>, teskarisi xato.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Counter'ni grafikda to'g'ridan ko'rsatish — doim o'suvchi chiziq, foydasiz.</li><li><code>irate</code> bilan alert — bitta sakrash alert'ni yoqib-o'chiradi (flapping).</li><li><code>rate</code> ni gauge'ga qo'llash — ma'nosiz natija; gauge uchun <code>deriv()</code>/<code>delta()</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alert oynasini tanlash — signal va tezlik orasidagi trade-off: <code>[5m]</code> + <code>for: 10m</code> odatda yaxshi muvozanat; SLO burn-rate alert'lari esa bir nechta oynani birga ishlatadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33247	<p>Exporter nima? Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33449	<p>PromQL'da <code>increase()</code> va <code>rate()</code> farqi? Instant vector va range vector nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Instant vector</b> — har series'ning bitta (joriy) qiymati, grafik va alert shu bilan ishlaydi. <b>Range vector</b> — har series uchun oraliqdagi nuqtalar to'plami (<code>[5m]</code>), uni faqat funksiyaga (<code>rate</code>, <code>increase</code>) berish mumkin. <code>rate()</code> — sekundiga tezlik; <code>increase()</code> — oraliqdagi umumiy o'sish (<code>rate * oraliq soniyalari</code>).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>http_requests_total          -&gt; instant: {pod=a} 1500, {pod=b} 900<br>http_requests_total[5m]      -&gt; range:   {pod=a} [1420,1440,...,1500] (20 nuqta)<br>rate(...[5m])                -&gt; instant: {pod=a} 0.27 req/s<br>increase(...[1h])            -&gt; instant: {pod=a} 972 so'rov</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>http_requests_total                       # instant vector<br>http_requests_total[5m]                   # range vector (Table ko'rinishida)<br>rate(http_requests_total[5m])             # dashboard throughput<br>increase(http_requests_total{code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[24h])   # &quot;bugun nechta xato&quot;<br>sum(increase(orders_created_total[1d]))   # kunlik buyurtmalar</pre><p>| Savol | Funksiya | |---|---| | Hozir sekundiga nechta? | <code>rate</code> | | Oxirgi soatda nechta? | <code>increase</code> | | Gauge qanchaga o'zgardi? | <code>delta</code> | | Gauge o'sish tezligi? | <code>deriv</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Range vector'ni grafikka chizishga urinish — &quot;range vector must be wrapped&quot; xatosi.</li><li><code>increase</code> natijasi kasr (972.4) — oraliq chegaralarida ekstrapolyatsiya, bu normal; aniq hisob (billing) uchun metrika emas, log/DB.</li><li><code>increase</code> ni counter bo'lmagan metrikaga qo'llash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prometheus — taxminiy, operatsion signal uchun. Aniq biznes hisobi (to'lovlar soni) kerak bo'lsa, manba — ma'lumotlar bazasi, metrika esa trend va alert uchun.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33473	<p><code>up</code> metrikasi, <code>job</code> va <code>instance</code> label'lari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>up</code> — Prometheus har scrape'da o'zi yaratadigan sintetik metrika: target muvaffaqiyatli scrape qilinsa <code>1</code>, aks holda <code>0</code>. <code>job</code> — scrape konfiguratsiyasidagi <code>job_name</code> (qaysi turdagi target), <code>instance</code> — aniq target manzili (<code>host:port</code>). Bu label'lar avtomatik qo'shiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>scrape_configs: job_name: node, targets: [10.0.1.10:9100]<br>  scrape OK   -&gt; up{job=&quot;node&quot;, instance=&quot;10.0.1.10:9100&quot;} 1<br>  scrape FAIL -&gt; up{...} 0  (+ scrape_duration_seconds, scrape_samples_scraped)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>up == 0                                 # ishlamayotgan target'lar<br>count by (job) (up == 1)                # har job'da nechta tirik<br>avg_over_time(up[1h]) &lt; 0.9             # oxirgi soatda tez-tez uzilganlar<br>scrape_duration_seconds &gt; 10            # sekin target<br>scrape_samples_scraped &gt; 50000          # haddan ko'p series</pre><pre>- alert: TargetDown<br>  expr: up == 0<br>  for: 5m<br>  labels: { severity: warning }<br>  annotations:<br>    summary: &quot;{{ $labels.job }}/{{ $labels.instance }} scrape bo'lmayapti&quot;</pre><p>Scrape xato sabablari Status -&gt; Targets sahifasida: <code>connection refused</code>, <code>context deadline exceeded</code> (timeout), <code>401/403</code>, TLS, noto'g'ri port/path.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>up == 1</code> = servis sog'lom deb o'ylash — faqat <code>/metrics</code> javob berdi; biznes funksiyasi ishlamasligi mumkin.</li><li>Target service discovery'dan butunlay yo'qolsa, <code>up</code> series ham yo'qoladi — <code>up == 0</code> yonmaydi; <code>absent()</code> yoki kutilgan son bilan solishtirish kerak.</li><li><code>instance</code> label'ini relabel bilan o'zgartirib, takrorlanuvchi qiymat qilish — series'lar to'qnashadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>up</code> — monitoring qamrovining metrikasi. &quot;Har servisda kamida N ta target UP&quot; alert'i va <code>absent(up{job=&quot;payments&quot;})</code> — jim yo'qolib qolishni ushlaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33199	<p>Label'lar va kardinallik: nega <code>user_id</code>ni label qilish xavfli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har noyob label qiymatlari kombinatsiyasi — alohida time series (xotira, disk, so'rov vaqti). <code>user_id</code> kabi chegaralanmagan qiymat label bo'lsa, series soni millionlab o'sadi va Prometheus xotirasi tugab, OOM bilan yiqiladi. Label'lar faqat <b>cheklangan</b> qiymatlar uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday hisoblanadi:</b></p><pre>5 method x 20 route x 6 status x 50 pod = 30 000 series   (OK)<br>+ user_id (1 000 000)                   = 30 000 000 000   (o'lim)<br>har series ~ 3-4 KB xotira (head block)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># eng ko'p series'ga ega metrikalar<br>topk(10, count by (__name__) ({__name__=~&quot;.+&quot;}))<br># metrika ichida qaysi label portlayapti<br>count(count by (path) (http_requests_total))<br>prometheus_tsdb_head_series      # umumiy aktiv series</pre><pre>promtool tsdb analyze /prometheus     # eng yuqori kardinallik label'lari</pre><p>Himoya:</p><pre>scrape_configs:<br>  - job_name: app<br>    sample_limit: 50000                  # oshsa scrape fail<br>    metric_relabel_configs:<br>      - action: labeldrop<br>        regex: (request_id|user_id)<br>      - source_labels: [__name__]<br>        regex: debug_.*<br>        action: drop</pre><p>Kodda: route <b>shabloni</b> (<code>/users/:id</code>), haqiqiy URL (<code>/users/42</code>) emas; status class (<code>5xx</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Xato xabarini (<code>error=&quot;connection to 10.0.3.7 refused&quot;</code>) label qilish — har IP yangi series.</li><li>K8s'da pod nomi qisqa umrli — &quot;churn&quot; ham xotirani to'ldiradi.</li><li><code>labeldrop</code> dan keyin qolgan label'lar bir xil bo'lib qolsa — dublikat series xatosi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yuqori kardinallikli ma'lumot (user, request_id) — log va trace'ga; metrika va trace'ni exemplar orqali bog'lang. Ko'pincha &quot;Prometheus scale muammosi&quot; aslida bitta yomon label.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33200	<p>Alerting qoidasi va Alertmanager qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Alert qoidasi — Prometheus muntazam baholaydigan PromQL ifodasi: natija bo'sh bo'lmasa alert <code>pending</code>, <code>for</code> muddati davomida saqlansa <code>firing</code> bo'ladi va Alertmanager'ga yuboriladi. Alertmanager esa alert'larni guruhlaydi, takrorlanishini yo'qotadi, bostiradi (inhibit/silence) va to'g'ri kanalga (Slack, PagerDuty) yo'naltiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Prometheus: har evaluation_interval -&gt; expr &gt; 0.05 ?<br>   inactive -&gt; pending (for: 10m kutish) -&gt; firing -&gt; Alertmanager<br>Alertmanager: group_by -&gt; group_wait -&gt; route (team/severity) -&gt; receiver<br>              inhibit_rules / silences -&gt; repeat_interval</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># rules/api.yml<br>groups:<br>- name: api<br>  rules:<br>  - alert: HighErrorRate<br>    expr: |<br>      sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>        / sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m])) &gt; 0.05<br>    for: 10m<br>    labels: { severity: page, team: payments }<br>    annotations:<br>      summary: &quot;{{ $labels.service }}: 5xx {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}&quot;<br>      runbook_url: https://wiki/runbooks/high-error-rate</pre><pre># alertmanager.yml<br>route:<br>  receiver: default-slack<br>  group_by: [alertname, cluster, service]<br>  group_wait: 30s<br>  group_interval: 5m<br>  repeat_interval: 4h<br>  routes:<br>    - matchers: [severity=&quot;page&quot;]<br>      receiver: pagerduty<br>inhibit_rules:<br>  - source_matchers: [alertname=&quot;ClusterDown&quot;]<br>    target_matchers: [severity=&quot;warning&quot;]<br>    equal: [cluster]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>for</code> siz alert — bir lahzalik sakrash ham odamni uyg'otadi.</li><li>Sabab (CPU 80%) bo'yicha page — ko'pincha foydalanuvchi hech narsa sezmaydi; alert fatigue.</li><li>Runbook'siz alert — tungi on-call nima qilishni bilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Page faqat <b>simptom</b> (foydalanuvchi his qiladigan: xato, latency, SLO burn rate) va actionable bo'lsa. Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33202	<p>node_exporter bilan server monitoringi: qaysi metrikalarga qaraladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> node_exporter Linux host metrikalarini beradi. USE metodikasi bo'yicha qaraladi: har resurs (CPU, xotira, disk, tarmoq) uchun <b>Utilization</b> (bandlik), <b>Saturation</b> (navbat/kutish) va <b>Errors</b>. Asosiy metrikalar: CPU band %, <code>MemAvailable</code>, disk bo'sh joy va inode'lar, disk I/O bandligi, load, tarmoq xatolari.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># CPU band %<br>100 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=&quot;idle&quot;}[5m])) * 100<br><br># CPU saturation: load / yadrolar<br>node_load5 / count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=&quot;idle&quot;})<br><br># iowait ulushi<br>avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=&quot;iowait&quot;}[5m]))<br><br># mavjud xotira %<br>node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes * 100<br><br># disk bo'sh %<br>node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~&quot;tmpfs|overlay&quot;}<br>  / node_filesystem_size_bytes * 100<br><br># inode bo'sh %<br>node_filesystem_files_free / node_filesystem_files * 100<br><br># disk bandlik (saturation)<br>rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[5m])<br><br># tarmoq xatolari<br>rate(node_network_receive_errs_total[5m])</pre><p>| Resurs | Utilization | Saturation | Errors | |---|---|---|---| | CPU | busy % | load/cores, PSI | - | | Memory | used % | swap, OOM kill, PSI | - | | Disk | io_time | queue, await | I/O errors | | Network | bytes/s | drops | errs |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>MemFree</code> ga qarash — Linux bo'sh xotirani page cache'ga ishlatadi, <code>MemFree</code> doim kichik ko'rinadi; to'g'risi <code>MemAvailable</code>.</li><li>Inode tugashi ham &quot;No space left on device&quot; beradi, disk bo'sh ko'rinsa ham.</li><li>Konteynerlar ichidagi xotira cgroup limiti bilan cheklangan — node metrikasi buni ko'rsatmaydi (cAdvisor kerak).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pressure Stall Information (<code>node_pressure_*</code>) — saturation'ning eng aniq signali: &quot;jarayonlar resurs kutib qancha vaqt yo'qotdi&quot;. Disk uchun <code>predict_linear</code> bilan &quot;4 soatda to'ladi&quot; alert'i — statik 90% dan foydaliroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana

Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33472	<p>Recording rule va alerting rule farqi? Recording rule qachon kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Recording rule</b> — PromQL ifodasini muntazam hisoblab, natijani <b>yangi metrika</b> sifatida saqlaydi (oldindan hisoblangan). <b>Alerting rule</b> — ifodani baholab, shart bajarilsa alert yaratadi. Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33474	<p>Prometheus'ni HA (yuqori mavjud) qanday qilasiz? Retention va disk qanday hisoblanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HA uchun ikkita (yoki ko'proq) <b>bir xil</b> Prometheus bir xil target'larni mustaqil scrape qiladi; ular faqat <code>replica</code> external label bilan farqlanadi. So'rovda Thanos Querier (yoki Mimir) dublikatlarni olib tashlaydi, Alertmanager cluster (gossip) esa ikkala replikadan kelgan bir xil alert'ni bitta xabarga aylantiradi. Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33477	<p>Exemplar nima va metrikadan trace'ga qanday o'tiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Exemplar — metrika nuqtasiga biriktirilgan namuna <code>trace_id</code> (masalan, histogram bucket'iga tushgan aniq bitta so'rov). Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33203	<p>Prometheus'ni scale qilish va uzoq muddat saqlash: federation, remote_write, Thanos/Mimir?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bitta Prometheus vertikal o'sadi va lokal diskka bog'liq. Scale yo'llari: <b>HA juftlik</b> (ishonchlilik), <b>sharding</b> (target'larni bir nechta Prometheus'ga bo'lish), <b>recording rule va downsampling</b> (so'rov yuki), <b>remote_write -&gt; Mimir/Thanos/VictoriaMetrics</b> (global so'rov va obyekt storage'da uzoq saqlash). <b>Federation</b> — eski usul, faqat agregatlar uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>cluster A: Prometheus x2 (HA) --remote_write--\<br>cluster B: Prometheus x2      --remote_write---&gt; Mimir / Thanos (S3, GCS)<br>cluster C: Prometheus agent   --remote_write--/         ^<br>                                                    Grafana (global query)</pre><p>| Yondashuv | Nima beradi | Kamchilik | |---|---|---| | HA juftlik | bitta Prometheus o'lsa ham ishlaydi | dedup kerak | | Federation | yuqori darajadagi agregatlar | xom data yo'q, mo'rt | | Thanos sidecar | S3'da blok, global query | qo'shimcha komponentlar | | remote_write + Mimir | markaziy, multi-tenant, uzoq saqlash | tarmoq, operatsion murakkablik | | Agent mode | lokal so'rovsiz, faqat yuborish | lokal alert yo'q |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>remote_write:<br>  - url: https://mimir.example.com/api/v1/push<br>    queue_config: { max_samples_per_send: 5000, capacity: 20000 }<br>    write_relabel_configs:<br>      - source_labels: [__name__]<br>        regex: &quot;go_gc_.*|debug_.*&quot;<br>        action: drop                  # keraksizlarini markazga yubormaslik</pre><pre>rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total[5m])     # yuborish xatolari<br>prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds<br>  - ignoring(remote_name, url) group_right prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds  # lag</pre><p>Thanos compactor: eski ma'lumotni 5m va 1h rezolyutsiyaga downsampling qiladi — yillik so'rovlar tez.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Scale'ni kardinallikni tozalamasdan boshlash — muammoni qimmatroq joyga ko'chirish.</li><li>remote_write lag'ini monitoring qilmaslik — markazda ma'lumot soatlab kechikadi.</li><li>Hamma narsani markazga yuborish — narx; Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33476	<p>Prometheus'da staleness nima? Target yo'qolganda grafikda nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Staleness — series &quot;endi yo'q&quot; ekanini belgilash mexanizmi. Target scrape bo'lmasa yoki series keyingi scrape'da qaytmasa, Prometheus <b>stale marker</b> yozadi va instant so'rovlarda bu series darhol yo'qoladi (5 daqiqa &quot;osilib&quot; turmaydi). Grafikda chiziq uziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>scrape: 10:00 v=5   10:00:15 v=6   10:00:30 FAIL -&gt; stale marker<br>query 10:01: series qaytmaydi (yo'q)<br>marker bo'lmasa (masalan, remote/federation): lookback-delta (5m) davomida oxirgi qiymat qaytadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>up == 0                                  # target scrape bo'lmayapti<br>absent(up{job=&quot;payments&quot;})               # job umuman yo'q bo'lsa 1<br>absent_over_time(heartbeat_timestamp[10m])<br>time() - job_last_success_timestamp_seconds &gt; 3600   # batch job uchun</pre><pre>- alert: PaymentsMetricsAbsent<br>  expr: absent(up{job=&quot;payments&quot;} == 1)<br>  for: 5m</pre><p>Sozlama: <code>--query.lookback-delta=5m</code> (default).</p><p><b>Alert'larga ta'siri:</b></p><pre>alert: latency &gt; 1s (firing)<br>pod o'ldi -&gt; metrika stale -&gt; ifoda bo'sh -&gt; alert &quot;RESOLVED&quot;   &lt;- yolg'on tinchlik!</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Target yo'qolganda simptom alert'i o'z-o'zidan resolve bo'ladi — <code>up == 0</code> va <code>absent()</code> alert'lari majburiy.</li><li>Pushgateway metrikalari stale bo'lmaydi — o'lgan job'ning oxirgi qiymati abadiy qoladi; <code>push_time_seconds</code> bilan yangilikni tekshiring.</li><li><code>rate()</code> oraliq ichida kamida 2 nuqta talab qiladi — scrape uzilishlari grafikda bo'shliq beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har muhim alert uchun &quot;agar ma'lumot yo'qolsa nima bo'ladi?&quot; savolini bering. Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-33491	<p>Thanos arxitekturasi: Sidecar, Store Gateway, Querier, Compactor, Ruler nima qiladi?</p>	<pre>Prometheus+Sidecar (A, replica 0) --\<br>Prometheus+Sidecar (A, replica 1) ---+--&gt; Querier (dedupe) &lt;-- Grafana<br>Prometheus+Sidecar (B)            --/        ^<br>        |  (2h bloklar)                       |<br>        v                                     |<br>   Object storage (S3) &lt;--- Store Gateway ----+<br>        ^<br>     Compactor (compaction, 5m/1h downsampling, retention)  -- yagona instance!</pre><p><b>Staff nuqtalar:</b></p><ul><li>Compactor bucket'da faqat bitta bo'lishi kerak — ikkitasi blok'larni buzadi.</li><li>Downsampling uzoq oraliq so'rovlarini tezlashtiradi, lekin xom data'ni ham saqlaydi (disk kamaymaydi, aksincha).</li><li>Sidecar vs Receive: Sidecar — pull, Prometheus lokal; Receive — remote_write qabul qiladi (multi-tenant, ephemeral Prometheus).</li><li>Muqobil: Grafana Mimir (remote_write asosida, horizontal, multi-tenant) — yangi qurilmalarda ko'pincha soddaroq.</li></ul>	lvl::Staff dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-34283	<p>Prometheus konfiguratsiyasida scrape job qanday yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Scrape job — <code>prometheus.yml</code> dagi <code>scrape_configs</code> ro'yxatining elementi: <code>job_name</code> (nom, <code>job</code> label bo'ladi), <code>scrape_interval</code> (qanchalik tez-tez) va target'lar (statik ro'yxat yoki service discovery). Har serverga bittadan o'rnatiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/proc, /sys (kernel ma'lumotlari) -&gt; node_exporter (collector'lar) -&gt; :9100/metrics -&gt; Prometheus</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># o'rnatish (systemd servis sifatida yoki Docker)<br>docker run -d --net=host --pid=host -v /:/host:ro,rslave \<br>  quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter --path.rootfs=/host<br><br>curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep node_memory_MemAvailable<br># node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes 6.442450944e+09</pre><p><b>Mashhur metrikalar:</b> | Metrika | Ma'nosi | |---|---| | <code>node_cpu_seconds_total{mode}</code> | CPU vaqti rejimlar bo'yicha (idle, user, system, iowait) | | <code>node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes</code> | ishlatish mumkin bo'lgan xotira | | <code>node_filesystem_avail_bytes</code> | disk bo'sh joyi | | <code>node_filesystem_files_free</code> | bo'sh inode'lar | | <code>node_load1</code>, <code>node_load5</code> | o'rtacha yuk | | <code>node_network_receive_bytes_total</code> | tarmoq trafigi | | <code>node_disk_io_time_seconds_total</code> | disk bandligi |</p><pre>node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes * 100   # bo'sh xotira %</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Konteynerda <code>--path.rootfs</code> va host mount'larsiz ishlatish — konteynerning o'z fayl tizimini ko'rsatadi.</li><li><code>MemFree</code> ga qarab &quot;xotira tugayapti&quot; deyish — Linux cache'ni hisobga olmaydi; <code>MemAvailable</code> ishlating.</li><li>9100 portni internetga ochiq qoldirish — server haqida ma'lumot oqadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> node_exporter host darajasini ko'rsatadi; konteyner/pod darajasi uchun cAdvisor va kube-state-metrics ham kerak. Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-34285	<p>CPU ishlatilishi % ni PromQL bilan qanday hisoblaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> node_exporter CPU vaqtini rejimlar bo'yicha counter sifatida beradi (<code>node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=&quot;idle&quot;}</code>). Bo'sh (idle) vaqt ulushini <code>rate</code> bilan topib, 100 dan ayirsangiz — band CPU foizi chiqadi.</p><p><b>Qanday hisoblanadi:</b></p><pre>har yadro, har rejim: sekundlar yig'indisi (counter)<br>rate(idle[5m])           -&gt; yadro sekundiga necha soniya bo'sh (0..1)<br>avg by (instance)        -&gt; hamma yadrolar o'rtachasi<br>100 - (bo'sh * 100)      -&gt; band %</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># server bo'yicha CPU band %<br>100 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=&quot;idle&quot;}[5m])) * 100<br><br># rejimlar bo'yicha (nima band qilyapti?)<br>avg by (instance, mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!=&quot;idle&quot;}[5m])) * 100<br><br># iowait — disk kutish<br>avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=&quot;iowait&quot;}[5m])) * 100</pre><p>Alert:</p><pre>- alert: HighCPU<br>  expr: 100 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=&quot;idle&quot;}[5m])) * 100 &gt; 90<br>  for: 15m<br>  labels: { severity: warning }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>rate</code> siz <code>node_cpu_seconds_total</code> ga qarash — doim o'suvchi son, foydasiz.</li><li><code>avg by (instance)</code> ni unutish — har yadro alohida chiziq bo'lib chiqadi.</li><li>Yuqori <code>iowait</code> ni &quot;CPU band&quot; deb o'qish — aslida muammo disk'da.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CPU 90% o'zi muammo emas (resurs to'liq ishlatilmoqda).
