Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-34286	<p>Disk bo'sh joyi 10% dan kam bo'lsa alert qoidasi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Alert qoidasi <code>node_filesystem_avail_bytes / node_filesystem_size_bytes</code> nisbatini 0.10 bilan solishtiradi; <code>for: 10m</code> qisqa sakrashlarni filtrlaydi; <code>fstype</code> filtri tmpfs/overlay kabi virtual fayl tizimlarini chiqarib tashlaydi. Qoida <code>rule_files</code> da ulanadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># rules/disk.yml<br>groups:<br>- name: disk<br>  rules:<br>  - alert: DiskAlmostFull<br>    expr: |<br>      node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~&quot;tmpfs|overlay|squashfs&quot;}<br>        / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~&quot;tmpfs|overlay|squashfs&quot;} &lt; 0.10<br>    for: 10m<br>    labels: { severity: warning }<br>    annotations:<br>      summary: &quot;{{ $labels.instance }} {{ $labels.mountpoint }}: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} bo'sh&quot;<br>      runbook_url: https://wiki/runbooks/disk-full<br><br>  - alert: DiskWillFillIn4h<br>    expr: |<br>      predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~&quot;tmpfs|overlay&quot;}[6h], 4*3600) &lt; 0<br>    for: 30m<br>    labels: { severity: page }</pre><pre># prometheus.yml<br>rule_files: [&quot;rules/*.yml&quot;]</pre><pre>promtool check rules rules/disk.yml</pre><p>UI: Alerts sahifasida <code>inactive</code> -&gt; <code>pending</code> -&gt; <code>firing</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fstype</code> filtrsiz — har konteyner overlay'i va tmpfs uchun yolg'on alert'lar.</li><li>Faqat foiz — 10 TB diskda 10% = 1 TB bo'sh (shoshilinch emas), 20 GB diskda 2 GB (shoshilinch). <code>predict_linear</code> yaxshiroq.</li><li>Inode tugashini unutish: <code>node_filesystem_files_free / node_filesystem_files &lt; 0.10</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Qachon to'ladi?&quot; (predict_linear) — &quot;qancha to'ldi?&quot; dan muhimroq savol: u odamni faqat haqiqatan vaqt qolmaganda uyg'otadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-34287	<p>Alertmanager vazifasi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Alertmanager — Prometheus yuborgan alert'larni qabul qilib, ularni <b>guruhlaydi</b> (50 ta alert -&gt; 1 xabar), <b>takrorlanishini</b> yo'qotadi, <b>bostiradi</b> (inhibition, silence) va <b>yo'naltiradi</b> (severity/team bo'yicha Slack, PagerDuty, email). Prometheus &quot;nima yonmoqda&quot; ni aniqlaydi, Alertmanager &quot;kimga, qanday va qachon xabar berish&quot; ni.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Prometheus (alert firing) --&gt; Alertmanager<br>    grouping (alertname, cluster) -&gt; inhibition -&gt; silence -&gt; routing<br>       -&gt; severity=page   -&gt; PagerDuty<br>       -&gt; severity=warning -&gt; Slack #alerts</pre><p><b>Asosiy funksiyalar:</b> | Funksiya | Misol | |---|---| | Grouping | 50 pod'dan bir xil alert -&gt; bitta xabar | | Inhibition | node down bo'lsa, undagi servis alert'lari bostiriladi | | Silence | rejali texnik ish vaqtida vaqtincha jim | | Routing | severity/team label bo'yicha turli kanal | | Dedup | HA'dagi ikki Prometheus'dan kelgan bir xil alert -&gt; bitta |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>route:<br>  receiver: slack<br>  group_by: [alertname, cluster]<br>  group_wait: 30s<br>  repeat_interval: 4h<br>  routes:<br>    - matchers: [severity=&quot;page&quot;]<br>      receiver: pagerduty<br>receivers:<br>  - name: slack<br>    slack_configs: [{ channel: &quot;#alerts&quot;, api_url: &quot;https://hooks.slack.com/...&quot; }]<br>  - name: pagerduty<br>    pagerduty_configs: [{ routing_key: &quot;&lt;key&gt;&quot; }]</pre><pre>amtool check-config alertmanager.yml<br>amtool silence add alertname=DiskAlmostFull instance=db1 --duration=2h --comment=&quot;disk kengaytirilmoqda&quot;<br>amtool alert query</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>group_by</code> siz — har alert alohida xabar, kanal spam bo'ladi.</li><li>Muddatsiz yoki juda uzun silence — haqiqiy muammo ham jim qoladi.</li><li>Bitta Alertmanager — o'zi o'lsa hech qanday xabar kelmaydi (HA cluster + watchdog).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alertmanager — alert fatigue'ga qarshi asosiy vosita: to'g'ri guruhlash va inhibition bilan incident paytida on-call 200 emas, 2-3 ta mazmunli xabar oladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-34288	<p>Grafana'da data source va dashboard nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Data source</b> — Grafana ma'lumot oladigan manba ulanishi (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, PostgreSQL, CloudWatch). <b>Dashboard</b> — panellar (grafik, jadval, stat) to'plami, har panel data source'ga so'rov yuborib natijani vizuallashtiradi. Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-34289	<p>Label nima va high cardinality nega xavfli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Label — metrikaga qo'shilgan kalit=qiymat juftligi (<code>method=&quot;GET&quot;</code>), u bir metrikani o'lchamlar bo'yicha bo'lish va filtrlash imkonini beradi. Har noyob label kombinatsiyasi — alohida time series. Label qiymatlari juda ko'p bo'lsa (high cardinality), series soni portlaydi va Prometheus xotirasi tugaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>http_requests_total{method=&quot;GET&quot;,  status=&quot;200&quot;, path=&quot;/api&quot;}   -&gt; series 1<br>http_requests_total{method=&quot;POST&quot;, status=&quot;500&quot;, path=&quot;/api&quot;}   -&gt; series 2<br>...<br>3 method x 5 status x 10 path = 150 series   (yaxshi)<br>+ user_id (100 000 user)       = 15 000 000 series   (Prometheus yiqiladi)</pre><p><b>Yaxshi va yomon label'lar:</b> | Yaxshi (cheklangan) | Yomon (cheksiz) | |---|---| | <code>method</code> (GET, POST...) | <code>user_id</code> | | <code>status</code> / status class | <code>request_id</code>, <code>trace_id</code> | | <code>service</code>, <code>route</code> shabloni (<code>/users/:id</code>) | to'liq URL (<code>/users/42?x=1</code>) | | <code>region</code>, <code>env</code> | email, IP manzil, xato matni |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sum by (method, status) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))   # label bo'yicha guruhlash<br>count by (__name__) ({__name__=~&quot;.+&quot;})                    # qaysi metrikada series ko'p<br>prometheus_tsdb_head_series                               # umumiy series soni</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kodda <code>path</code> label'iga haqiqiy URL yozish — har ID yangi series.</li><li>Xato xabarini label qilish — har xil matn yangi series.</li><li>Kardinallikni monitoring qilmaslik — muammo Prometheus OOM bilan yiqilganda bilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Foydalanuvchi yoki so'rov darajasidagi ma'lumot metrikaga emas, log va trace'ga tegishli. Metrika — agregat signal.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-34290	<p>Blackbox exporter nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Blackbox exporter — servislarni <b>tashqaridan</b> (foydalanuvchi kabi) tekshiradi: HTTP(S), TCP, ICMP, DNS, gRPC so'rovlarini yuborib, javob bor-yo'qligi, status kodi, vaqt va TLS sertifikat muddati haqida metrika beradi. Ilova ichki metrikalari &quot;hammasi yaxshi&quot; desa ham, foydalanuvchi sayt ochilmasligini ko'rishi mumkin — blackbox shuni ushlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Prometheus --/probe?target=https://example.com&amp;module=http_2xx--&gt; blackbox exporter<br>                                                                      | HTTP GET<br>                                                                      v<br>                                                                 example.com<br>&lt;-- probe_success 1, probe_duration_seconds 0.23, probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry ...</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># blackbox.yml<br>modules:<br>  http_2xx:<br>    prober: http<br>    timeout: 5s<br>    http:<br>      valid_status_codes: [200]<br>      fail_if_ssl: false</pre><pre># prometheus.yml<br>scrape_configs:<br>  - job_name: blackbox<br>    metrics_path: /probe<br>    params: { module: [http_2xx] }<br>    static_configs:<br>      - targets: [&quot;https://example.com&quot;, &quot;https://api.example.com/health&quot;]<br>    relabel_configs:<br>      - source_labels: [__address__]<br>        target_label: __param_target<br>      - source_labels: [__param_target]<br>        target_label: instance<br>      - target_label: __address__<br>        replacement: blackbox-exporter:9115</pre><pre>probe_success{job=&quot;blackbox&quot;} == 0                             # sayt ishlamayapti<br>(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time()) / 86400 &lt; 14         # sertifikat 14 kunda tugaydi<br>probe_http_duration_seconds{phase=&quot;tls&quot;}                       # bosqichlar bo'yicha vaqt</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Relabel qismini noto'g'ri yozish — Prometheus saytni emas, exporter'ni scrape qiladi.</li><li>Probe'ni faqat ichki tarmoqdan ishlatish — tashqi DNS/CDN muammolarini ko'rmaydi.</li><li><code>probe_success</code> ga bir martalik xato uchun alert — <code>for: 2m</code> qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Blackbox — &quot;foydalanuvchi ko'zi&quot; bilan monitoring (synthetic). Ichki (whitebox) metrikalar bilan birga ishlating; sertifikat muddati alert'i ko'plab &quot;kutilmagan&quot; outage'larning oldini oladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-34291	<p>Prometheus metrikalarini ilovadan qanday chiqarasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ilovaga Prometheus client kutubxonasini qo'shib, metrikalar (Counter, Gauge, Histogram) yaratasiz, kod ichida ularni yangilaysiz va HTTP <code>/metrics</code> endpoint'ini ochasiz. Prometheus shu endpoint'ni scrape qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kod: REQ.labels(status=&quot;200&quot;).inc()  -&gt; xotiradagi counter<br>HTTP GET /metrics -&gt; matn formatida:<br>   app_requests_total{status=&quot;200&quot;} 42<br>Prometheus har 15s shu sahifani o'qiydi</pre><p><b>Amalda (Python):</b></p><pre>from prometheus_client import Counter, Histogram, start_http_server<br>import time, random<br><br>REQ = Counter(&quot;app_requests_total&quot;, &quot;So'rovlar soni&quot;, [&quot;status&quot;])<br>LAT = Histogram(&quot;app_request_duration_seconds&quot;, &quot;So'rov vaqti&quot;,<br>                buckets=[0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5])<br><br>start_http_server(8000)          # :8000/metrics<br><br>while True:<br>    with LAT.time():             # vaqtni avtomatik o'lchaydi<br>        time.sleep(random.random() / 5)<br>    REQ.labels(status=&quot;200&quot;).inc()</pre><p><b>Go:</b></p><pre>var reqs = promauto.NewCounterVec(prometheus.CounterOpts{<br>    Name: &quot;app_requests_total&quot;, Help: &quot;So'rovlar soni&quot;,<br>}, []string{&quot;status&quot;})<br><br>func main() {<br>    http.Handle(&quot;/metrics&quot;, promhttp.Handler())<br>    reqs.WithLabelValues(&quot;200&quot;).Inc()<br>    http.ListenAndServe(&quot;:8000&quot;, nil)<br>}</pre><pre>curl -s localhost:8000/metrics | grep app_requests_total<br># app_requests_total{status=&quot;200&quot;} 42.0</pre><p>Muqobil: OpenTelemetry SDK — metrika, trace va log'lar uchun bitta standart, Prometheus formatiga eksport qiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Metrika nomida birlik va <code>_total</code> qo'shimchasini unutish — nomlash kelishuvi: <code>_seconds</code>, <code>_bytes</code>, counter uchun <code>_total</code>.</li><li>Label'ga <code>user_id</code> yoki to'liq URL qo'yish — kardinallik portlashi.</li><li><code>/metrics</code> ni ommaviy portda ochiq qoldirish — ichki ma'lumot oqishi; alohida port yoki tarmoq cheklovi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har servisda minimal RED to'plami bo'lsin: so'rovlar soni (status bilan), xatolar va latency histogram'i. Bu to'plam standart dashboard va SLO alert'larini avtomatik qurish imkonini beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W4 Prometheus & Grafana	idrill-34292	<p>Prometheus ma'lumotni qancha saqlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Default'da Prometheus ma'lumotni <b>15 kun</b> saqlaydi. <code>--storage.tsdb.retention.time</code> (vaqt) yoki <code>--storage.tsdb.retention.size</code> (hajm) bilan o'zgartiriladi — qaysi limit oldin yetsa, eski bloklar o'chiriladi. Prometheus bitta node'li lokal storage — oylar/yillar va HA uchun mo'ljallanmagan; uzoq saqlash uchun <code>remote_write</code> orqali Thanos/Mimir/VictoriaMetrics.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>yangi sample -&gt; head block (xotira + WAL) -&gt; har 2 soatda diskka blok<br>bloklar compaction bilan kattalashadi -&gt; retention'dan eski bloklar o'chiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>prometheus \<br>  --storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus \<br>  --storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d \<br>  --storage.tsdb.retention.size=200GB</pre><pre>prometheus_tsdb_storage_blocks_bytes                       # bloklar hajmi<br>rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total[5m])      # sekundiga yangi sample<br>prometheus_tsdb_lowest_timestamp_seconds                   # eng eski ma'lumot vaqti</pre><p><b>Disk taxmini:</b></p><pre>sample/s x ~1.5 bayt x retention soniyalari<br>50 000 x 1.5 x (30 x 86 400) ~ 194 GB  (+ WAL va compaction uchun zaxira)</pre><p><b>Uzoq saqlash:</b></p><pre>remote_write:<br>  - url: https://mimir.example.com/api/v1/push</pre><p>| Variant | Qachon | |---|---| | Lokal 15-30 kun | operatsion monitoring, alert'lar | | Thanos / Mimir / VictoriaMetrics | oylar-yillar, global so'rov, HA |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat <code>retention.time</code> qo'yib, <code>retention.size</code> siz — kardinallik o'ssa disk to'lib, Prometheus yiqiladi.</li><li>Retention'ni yillab qilish — so'rovlar sekin, restart'da WAL replay uzoq, bitta disk = bitta failure point.</li><li>Disk monitoringini Prometheus'ning o'ziga qo'ymaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Lokal retention'ni qisqa ushlang (alert va yaqin debug uchun), tarixiy tahlil va capacity planning uchun ma'lumotni obyekt storage'ga downsampling bilan yuboring — arzon va ishonchli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w4 Prometheus_Grafana
Interview Drill::Observability::W9 Logs, tracing & SLO	idrill-33314	<p>Log level'lar (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR) qachon qaysi biri ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>DEBUG</b> — dasturchi uchun batafsil ichki holat (prod'da odatda o'chiq). <b>INFO</b> — normal muhim hodisalar (servis start, buyurtma yaratildi). <b>WARN</b> — g'ayrioddiy, lekin tizim o'zini tikladi (retry muvaffaqiyatli, deprecated API ishlatildi). <b>ERROR</b> — operatsiya muvaffaqiyatsiz, kimdir e'tibor berishi kerak bo'lishi mumkin. (FATAL — jarayon to'xtaydi.)</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> hamma narsa ERROR — on-call 10 000 &quot;xato&quot; ichidan haqiqiysini topa olmaydi. Hamma narsa DEBUG — log hajmi va narxi portlaydi, sekundiga megabaytlar.</p><p><b>Qanday tanlash:</b></p><pre>Bu hodisa uchun kimdir uyg'onishi kerakmi?          -&gt; ERROR (va alert metrikada)<br>Tizim o'zi hal qildi, lekin trend kuzatilsin?        -&gt; WARN<br>Biznes jarayoni normal o'tdi, audit/kontekst uchun? -&gt; INFO<br>Faqat debug paytida kerak?                           -&gt; DEBUG</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>logger := slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, &amp;slog.HandlerOptions{Level: slog.LevelInfo}))<br>logger.Info(&quot;order created&quot;, &quot;order_id&quot;, id, &quot;amount&quot;, amt)<br>logger.Warn(&quot;payment retry&quot;, &quot;attempt&quot;, 2, &quot;err&quot;, err)<br>logger.Error(&quot;payment failed&quot;, &quot;order_id&quot;, id, &quot;err&quot;, err)<br>logger.Debug(&quot;cache lookup&quot;, &quot;key&quot;, k)   // prod'da chiqmaydi</pre><pre>LOG_LEVEL=debug ./app                                  # vaqtincha batafsil<br>kubectl logs deploy/api | jq 'select(.level==&quot;ERROR&quot;)'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Klient xatosi (404, validatsiya) ni ERROR qilish — bu sizning xatongiz emas; INFO/WARN.</li><li>Bir xatoni har qatlamda qayta log qilish — bitta muammo 5 ta ERROR bo'ladi. Xatoni bir joyda (chegarada) log qiling, ichkarida kontekst bilan qaytaring.</li><li>Level'ni o'zgartirish uchun deploy kerak — runtime'da (env, signal, admin endpoint) o'zgartirish imkoni bo'lsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alert'lar log level'iga emas, metrikalarga (error rate, SLO) asoslansin. Log — &quot;nima bo'ldi&quot;ni tushuntirish uchun, metrika — &quot;muammo bormi&quot;ni aniqlash uchun.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w9 Logs_tracing_SLO
Interview Drill::Observability::W9 Logs, tracing & SLO	idrill-33315	<p>Strukturaviy (structured) log nima va nega oddiy matndan yaxshi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Strukturaviy log — har yozuv matn emas, maydonlarga ega obyekt (odatda JSON): <code>{&quot;ts&quot;:..., &quot;level&quot;:&quot;error&quot;, &quot;msg&quot;:&quot;payment failed&quot;, &quot;order_id&quot;:&quot;o-42&quot;, &quot;trace_id&quot;:&quot;...&quot;}</code>. Afzalligi: mashina aniq filtrlaydi, agregatsiya qiladi va maydon bo'yicha qidiradi — regex bilan taxmin qilish shart emas.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>Payment failed for order 42 after 3 tries</code> — &quot;3 dan ortiq urinishli xatolar soni&quot;ni topish uchun murakkab regex kerak, format o'zgarsa buziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Matn:    2026-10-03 10:00:01 ERROR Payment failed for order 42 after 3 tries<br>JSON:    {&quot;ts&quot;:&quot;2026-10-03T10:00:01Z&quot;,&quot;level&quot;:&quot;error&quot;,&quot;msg&quot;:&quot;payment failed&quot;,<br>          &quot;order_id&quot;:&quot;42&quot;,&quot;attempts&quot;:3,&quot;trace_id&quot;:&quot;4bf9...&quot;}<br>             |<br>             v<br>Loki/Elastic: level=&quot;error&quot; AND attempts&gt;=3 | count by order_id</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>slog.Error(&quot;payment failed&quot;, &quot;order_id&quot;, id, &quot;attempts&quot;, n, &quot;trace_id&quot;, tid, &quot;err&quot;, err)</pre><pre>kubectl logs deploy/api | jq -c 'select(.level==&quot;error&quot;) | {ts, order_id, err}'</pre><pre>{app=&quot;api&quot;} | json | level=&quot;error&quot; and attempts &gt;= 3<br>sum by (err) (count_over_time({app=&quot;api&quot;} | json | level=&quot;error&quot; [5m]))</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Maydon nomlari har servisda boshqacha (<code>userId</code>, <code>user_id</code>, <code>uid</code>) — umumiy sxema (OpenTelemetry semantic conventions yoki ichki standart) kerak.</li><li>Ko'p qatorli stack trace — bitta JSON maydonga yozing, aks holda log yig'uvchi bo'laklarga ajratadi.</li><li>Yuqori kardinallikli qiymatlarni (user_id) Loki <b>label</b>'iga aylantirish — indeks portlaydi; ular log tanasida qolsin.</li><li>Shaxsiy ma'lumotni maydon sifatida yozish — endi uni qidirish ham oson (xavf ham).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Strukturaviy log + <code>trace_id</code> — log, metrika va trace'ni bog'lovchi ip. Bitta trace_id bo'yicha butun so'rov yo'lini barcha servislarda topish incident vaqtini keskin qisqartiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w9 Logs_tracing_SLO
Interview Drill::Observability::W9 Logs, tracing & SLO	idrill-33316	<p>Konteyner va Kubernetes'da loglar qayerga yoziladi va qanday o'qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container ilovasi log'ni <b>stdout/stderr</b>ga yozadi. Container runtime ularni node'da <code>/var/log/pods/&lt;ns&gt;_&lt;pod&gt;_&lt;uid&gt;/&lt;container&gt;/*.log</code> fayllariga saqlaydi, kubelet rotation qiladi. <code>kubectl logs</code> shu fayllarni kubelet orqali o'qiydi. Markaziy log tizimi, saqlash muddati va kirish huquqi siyosati bo'lmasa incident tahlili va audit imkonsiz.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w9 Logs_tracing_SLO
Interview Drill::Observability::W9 Logs, tracing & SLO	idrill-33317	<p>Loki va ELK (Elasticsearch) farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ELK (Elasticsearch)</b> — log'ning <b>to'liq matnini indekslaydi</b>: har so'z bo'yicha tez qidiruv, murakkab agregatsiya, lekin xotira/disk/CPU qimmat. <b>Loki</b> — faqat <b>label</b>'larni (namespace, app, level) indekslaydi, log tanasini siqib object storage'ga (S3) saqlaydi va qidiruvda &quot;grep&quot;ga o'xshab skanerlaydi: arzon, oddiy, Grafana bilan integratsiya, lekin label'siz keng qidiruv sekinroq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> kuniga 2 TB log — Elasticsearch'da indeks hajmi va klaster narxi byudjetdan oshdi; yoki Loki'da &quot;butun cluster bo'yicha shu xato matnini top&quot; so'rovi daqiqalab ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Elasticsearch:  log -&gt; tokenlar -&gt; inverted index (har so'z -&gt; hujjatlar)<br>                qidiruv: indeksdan darhol; saqlash: indeks + manba (~1-1.5x)<br>Loki:           log -&gt; stream (label to'plami) -&gt; siqilgan chunk -&gt; S3<br>                indeks: faqat label'lar<br>                qidiruv: label bilan oqimni tanlash -&gt; [5m]))</pre><pre># Kibana KQL<br>kubernetes.namespace:&quot;prod&quot; and message:&quot;timeout&quot; and latency_ms &gt; 500</pre><p>| | ELK | Loki | |---|---|---| | Indeks | to'liq matn | faqat label | | Narx | yuqori | past (S3) | | Erkin qidiruv | tez | sekinroq | | Operatsiya | murakkab (shard, heap) | oddiyroq | | Yaxshi joyi | xavfsizlik tahlili, qidiruv | ops log, Grafana |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Loki'da yuqori kardinallikli label (user_id, request_id) — millionlab stream, ishlash yiqiladi.</li><li>Elasticsearch'da mapping portlashi (har xil maydon nomlari) va heap muammolari.</li><li>Ikkalasida ham saqlash muddati siyosatisiz xarajat cheksiz o'sadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov so'rov uslubiga bog'liq: &quot;aniq servis, aniq vaqt oralig'i&quot; (ops) — Loki; &quot;butun ma'lumot bo'ylab erkin qidiruv va tahlil&quot; (SIEM, biznes) — Elastic/OpenSearch. Ko'p kompaniyalar ikkalasini turli maqsadda ishlatadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w9 Logs_tracing_SLO
Interview Drill::Observability::W9 Logs, tracing & SLO	idrill-33318	<p>SLI, SLO va SLA farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>SLI</b> (indicator) — o'lchanadigan ko'rsatkich: &quot;muvaffaqiyatli so'rovlar ulushi&quot;, &quot;p99 latency &lt; 300ms bo'lgan so'rovlar ulushi&quot;. <b>SLO</b> (objective) — ichki maqsad: &quot;30 kunda SLI &gt;= 99.9%&quot;. <b>SLA</b> (agreement) — mijoz bilan yuridik/moliyaviy shartnoma: &quot;99.5% dan past bo'lsa pul qaytaramiz&quot;. SLA odatda SLO'dan yumshoqroq bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;tizim tez va ishonchli bo'lsin&quot; — o'lchab bo'lmaydi. Bitta jamoa &quot;100% uptime&quot; talab qiladi, boshqasi deploy qila olmaydi. SLO ishonchlilikni raqamli va kelishilgan qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SLI:  yaxshi so'rovlar / jami so'rovlar   (o'lchov)<br>SLO:  SLI &gt;= 99.9% / 30 kun               (ichki maqsad)<br>      error budget = 0.1% = ~43 daqiqa/oy<br>SLA:  &gt;= 99.5%, aks holda 10% kredit       (tashqi va'da)<br>99.9 (SLO) &gt; 99.5 (SLA) -&gt; SLA buzilishidan oldin ogohlanish zaxirasi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># SLI: 5xx bo'lmagan so'rovlar ulushi (30 kun)<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;,code!~&quot;5..&quot;}[30d]))<br>/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;}[30d]))</pre><p>| SLO | Oyiga ruxsat etilgan downtime | |---|---| | 99% | ~7.2 soat | | 99.9% | ~43 daqiqa | | 99.99% | ~4.3 daqiqa |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SLI'ni server CPU yoki &quot;pod Running&quot; bo'yicha tanlash — foydalanuvchi tajribasini aks ettirmaydi. Foydalanuvchiga yaqin joyda (LB, klient) o'lchang.</li><li>100% SLO — imkonsiz va o'zgarishlarni to'xtatadi.</li><li>Juda ko'p SLO — hech biri jiddiy qabul qilinmaydi. Har servis uchun 2-4 ta.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SLO — texnik emas, biznes qarori: har qo'shimcha &quot;9&quot; narxi taxminan 10 barobar oshadi. Interview Drill::Observability::W9 Logs, tracing & SLO	idrill-33323	<p>SLO burn rate alert nima va oddiy threshold alertdan nega yaxshi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Burn rate — error budget qanchalik tez yonayotgani: <code>burn rate = hozirgi xato ulushi / ruxsat etilgan xato ulushi</code>. Interview Drill::Observability::W9 Logs, tracing & SLO	idrill-34293	<p><code>journalctl</code> bilan loglarni filtrlash?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>journalctl</code> — systemd jurnalini o'qish. Asosiy filtrlar: <code>-u &lt;servis&gt;</code> (unit), <code>-p err</code> (prioritet), <code>--since/--until</code> (vaqt), <code>-b</code> (joriy boot), <code>-f</code> (jonli kuzatish), <code>-k</code> (kernel), <code>-o json</code> (strukturaviy chiqish), <code>_PID=</code>, <code>_COMM=</code> kabi maydonlar.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> zamonaviy Linux'da servis log'lari alohida fayllarda emas, journald'da (binar, indekslangan). <code>cat /var/log/...</code> bilan topilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>servis stdout/stderr, syslog(), kernel -&gt; systemd-journald<br>   -&gt; /run/log/journal (vaqtincha) yoki /var/log/journal (doimiy, Storage=persistent)<br>   -&gt; maydonlar: _SYSTEMD_UNIT, PRIORITY, _PID, _HOSTNAME, MESSAGE ...</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>journalctl -u nginx -n 100 --no-pager          # oxirgi 100 qator<br>journalctl -u nginx -f                         # tail -f kabi<br>journalctl -u api --since &quot;2026-10-03 09:00&quot; --until &quot;10:00&quot;<br>journalctl -u api --since &quot;-1h&quot; -p warning     # oxirgi soat, warning va yuqori<br>journalctl -p err -b                           # joriy boot'dagi barcha xatolar<br>journalctl -b -1 -p err                        # oldingi boot (crash sababi)<br>journalctl -k | grep -i oom                    # kernel: OOM killer<br>journalctl -u api -o json-pretty -n 1          # barcha maydonlar<br>journalctl --disk-usage<br>sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=7d               # 7 kundan eskilarini o'chirish</pre><p>Prioritetlar: <code>emerg(0) alert crit err(3) warning notice info debug(7)</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>/var/log/journal</code> papkasi yo'q — log reboot'da yo'qoladi; <code>Storage=persistent</code>.</li><li>Oddiy user boshqa servislar log'ini ko'rmaydi — <code>adm</code>/<code>systemd-journal</code> guruhi yoki sudo.</li><li><code>-u</code> nomi to'liq bo'lmasa ham ishlaydi, lekin noto'g'ri unit nomi xato bermay bo'sh chiqadi.</li><li>Journal hajmi cheksiz o'sishi mumkin — <code>SystemMaxUse=</code> bilan cheklang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Server log'larini faqat lokal journald'da saqlash — node yo'qolsa dalil ham yo'qoladi. Markaziy tizimga (Loki, Elastic, bulut) yuboring; lokal jurnal — tezkor debug uchun.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::obs sec::w9 Logs_tracing_SLO

Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41651	<p>Monitoring va observability o'rtasidagi tub farq nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Monitoring — oldindan ma'lum savollarga javob: belgilangan metrikalarni chegaralar bilan kuzatadi (&quot;CPU &gt; 90%mi? sayt ishlayaptimi?&quot;). Observability — tizimning xususiyati: chiqaradigan telemetriyasi (metrika, log, trace, profil) yetarlicha boy bo'lsa, <b>oldindan ko'zda tutilmagan</b> savolga ham kodni o'zgartirmasdan javob topish mumkin (&quot;nega aynan Android 14'dagi, EU region'idagi premium user'larda checkout sekin?&quot;).</p><p><b>Nega farq muhim:</b> Monolitda nosozliklar soni cheklangan — dashboard'lar yetadi. 50 mikroservisli tizimda nosozlik kombinatsiyalari cheksiz; har biriga oldindan dashboard qurib bo'lmaydi. &quot;Unknown unknowns&quot; ni tekshirish uchun yuqori cardinality'li, bog'langan ma'lumot kerak.</p><pre>Monitoring:    bilingan savol --&gt; dashboard/alert --&gt; &quot;ha/yo'q&quot;<br>                                       (known unknowns)<br>Observability: yangi savol --&gt; metrika -&gt; trace -&gt; log -&gt; profil (bog'langan)<br>                                       (unknown unknowns)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><ul><li>Monitoring: <code>up == 0</code> alert, CPU dashboard, blackbox HTTP check.</li><li>Observability: har so'rovga <code>trace_id</code>, strukturali log'lar (<code>user_tier</code>, <code>region</code>, <code>app_version</code> maydonlari), exemplar'lar orqali metrikadan trace'ga o'tish, ad-hoc so'rov (<code>{service=&quot;checkout&quot;} | json | region=&quot;eu&quot; and duration_ms &gt; 2000</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Observability tool sotib oldik — observability bor&quot; — u tool emas, instrumentatsiya sifati.</li><li>Uchala signalni alohida silo'larda yig'ish, lekin <code>trace_id</code> bilan bog'lamaslik.</li><li>Monitoring'dan voz kechish — alert'lar baribir monitoring (SLO) asosida bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Monitoring &quot;biror narsa buzildi&quot; deydi (symptom alert), observability &quot;nega&quot; ni topishga yordam beradi. Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41652	<p>Observability'ning uch ustuni va ular incident paytida qanday bog'lanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Metrics</b> — arzon agregat sonlar (alert va trend uchun), <b>Logs</b> — har hodisaning batafsil yozuvi (nima aynan bo'ldi), <b>Traces</b> — bitta request'ning servislar bo'ylab yo'li va har bosqich vaqti (qayerda sekin/xato). Incident'da ular zanjir bo'lib ishlaydi: metrika alert beradi -&gt; trace qaysi servis/span aybdorligini ko'rsatadi -&gt; log aniq sababni (exception, SQL) aytadi.</p><p><b>Incident oqimi:</b></p><pre>1. TRACE: checkout -&gt; payment -&gt; postgres span 1.8s   (Tempo/Jaeger)<br>        |  span'dagi trace_id bo'yicha<br>        v<br>3. Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41653	<p>Google SRE'ning to'rt Golden Signal'ini tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Google SRE kitobidagi foydalanuvchiga yo'naltirilgan servisni kuzatishning minimal to'plami: <b>Latency</b> (javob vaqti, muvaffaqiyatli va xatolilar alohida), <b>Traffic</b> (talab: req/s), <b>Errors</b> (muvaffaqiyatsiz so'rovlar ulushi — aniq 5xx va yashirin: noto'g'ri kontent, SLO'dan sekin), <b>Saturation</b> (resurs qanchalik &quot;to'la&quot;: CPU, xotira, navbat, connection pool).</p><p><b>Nega aynan bular:</b> Ular foydalanuvchi his qiladigan narsani o'lchaydi. CPU 95% — foydalanuvchi sezmasa muammo emas; latency 3 s — CPU 20% bo'lsa ham muammo.</p><p><b>PromQL misollari:</b></p><pre># Latency p99<br>histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=&quot;api&quot;}[5m])))<br># Traffic<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;}[5m]))<br># Errors ulushi<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;,code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>  / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;}[5m]))<br># Saturation (masalan DB pool)<br>db_pool_in_use / db_pool_max</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Xatoli so'rovlar latency'si: tez qaytgan 500'lar o'rtacha latency'ni &quot;yaxshi&quot; ko'rsatadi — ajratib o'lchang.</li><li>O'rtacha latency — tail'ni yashiradi; p95/p99 ishlating.</li><li>Saturation'ni faqat CPU deb bilish — ko'pincha bottleneck navbat, thread pool yoki connection pool.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alert'larni latency va error (symptom) bo'yicha, ideal holda SLO burn rate orqali qo'ying; saturation esa bashorat (capacity planning) va diagnostika uchun. Saturation ko'pincha muammoning oldingi signali — latency oshishidan oldin navbat o'sadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41654	<p>RED va USE metodlarini solishtiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>RED</b> (Tom Wilkie) — request bilan ishlaydigan <b>servislar</b> uchun: Rate (req/s), Errors (xato soni/ulushi), Duration (latency taqsimoti). <b>USE</b> (Brendan Gregg) — <b>resurslar</b> (CPU, disk, tarmoq, xotira, pool) uchun: Utilization (band vaqt %), Saturation (navbatdagi ortiqcha ish), Errors (resurs xatolari). Ular raqobatchi emas: RED &quot;foydalanuvchi qanday his qilyapti&quot;, USE &quot;nega&quot;.</p><pre>          foydalanuvchi<br>               |<br>      [ servis: RED ]   Rate / Errors / Duration<br>               |<br>   +-----------+-----------+<br> [CPU: USE] [Disk: USE] [DB pool: USE]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> | Resurs | Utilization | Saturation | Errors | |---|---|---|---| | CPU | <code>1 - rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=&quot;idle&quot;}[5m])</code> | load avg / yadro, PSI, cgroup throttling | — | | Disk | <code>rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[5m])</code> | <code>node_disk_io_time_weighted_seconds_total</code> (navbat) | I/O xatolari | | Tarmoq | bayt / link sig'imi | drop, retransmit | <code>node_network_receive_errs_total</code> |</p><p>RED dashboard: har servis uchun 3 panel (rate, error %, p50/p95/p99).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>USE'ni servis darajasida, RED'ni infra'da qo'llashga urinish — ma'nosiz.</li><li>Utilization past, lekin saturation yuqori bo'lishi mumkin (qisqa burst'lar, bitta yadro band).</li><li>Errors'ni faqat HTTP 5xx deb hisoblash — timeout'lar va client tomonda bekor qilinganlar ham.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Debug tartibi: RED bilan qaysi servis buzilganini top, keyin uning resurslarini USE checklist bo'yicha tekshir. Har yangi servis standart RED dashboard + alert bilan chiqsin — bu platformaning &quot;default&quot; i bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41655	<p>Prometheus nima va pull arxitekturasi qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Prometheus — CNCF'ning ochiq monitoring tizimi va time-series DB'si. <b>Pull</b> modelida ishlaydi: service discovery (Kubernetes, Consul, EC2, fayl) orqali target'larni topadi, har <code>scrape_interval</code> da ularning HTTP <code>/metrics</code> endpoint'idan matn formatdagi metrikalarni o'zi tortib oladi, lokal TSDB'ga yozadi, PromQL bilan so'raladi va rule'lar asosida Alertmanager'ga alert yuboradi.</p><p><b>Arxitektura:</b></p><pre> [K8s API] --SD--&gt; +-------------------+ --alerts--&gt; [Alertmanager] -&gt; Slack/PD<br>                   |    Prometheus     |<br> [app /metrics] &lt;--| scrape -&gt; TSDB    | &lt;--PromQL-- [Grafana]<br> [node_exporter] &lt;-| rules (record/alert)<br>                   +-------------------+ --remote_write--&gt; [Mimir/Thanos]<br> [batch job] -&gt; [Pushgateway] &lt;--scrape</pre><p><b>Pull nega yaxshi:</b></p><ul><li><code>up</code> metrikasi bepul: target scrape qilinmasa darhol bilinadi (push'da &quot;jim&quot; va &quot;o'lik&quot; farqlanmaydi).</li><li>Target'lar monitoring manzilini bilishi shart emas; <code>/metrics</code> ni brauzerda ochib debug qilish oson.</li><li>Prometheus o'z tezligini nazorat qiladi — push &quot;bo'roni&quot; yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>scrape_configs:<br>  - job_name: api<br>    kubernetes_sd_configs: [{ role: pod }]<br>    relabel_configs:<br>      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]<br>        action: keep<br>        regex: &quot;true&quot;</pre><pre>curl -s localhost:8080/metrics | head<br># http_requests_total{method=&quot;GET&quot;,code=&quot;200&quot;} 10234</pre><p>UI: Status -&gt; Targets (scrape xatolari).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta Prometheus = bitta node: HA yo'q, cheklangan retention — uzoq muddat uchun Thanos/Mimir.</li><li>Qisqa yashovchi job'lar scrape'gacha tugaydi — Pushgateway yoki boshqa yondashuv.</li><li>NAT/firewall ortidagi target'larni pull qilish qiyin — agent mode + remote_write.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prometheus aniqlikdan ko'ra ishonchlilikni tanlaydi: billing kabi 100% aniq hisob uchun emas, operatsion monitoring uchun. Zamonaviy setup'da ko'pincha Prometheus Operator (<code>ServiceMonitor</code>/<code>PodMonitor</code> CRD'lari) ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41656	<p>Prometheus'ning to'rt metrika turini tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Counter</b> — faqat o'sadi (restart'da 0 ga qaytadi), har doim <code>rate()</code>/<code>increase()</code> bilan o'qiladi. <b>Gauge</b> — ixtiyoriy ko'tariladi-tushadi (joriy qiymat). <b>Histogram</b> — kuzatuvlarni oldindan berilgan bucket'larga sanaydi, quantile server tomonda hisoblanadi va instance'lar bo'ylab agregatsiya qilinadi. <b>Summary</b> — quantile'ni client'da hisoblaydi, agregatsiya qilib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b></p><pre>&quot;Nechta bo'ldi?&quot; (so'rov, xato, bayt)    -&gt; Counter   *_total<br>&quot;Hozir qancha?&quot; (xotira, navbat, ulanish) -&gt; Gauge<br>&quot;Qancha davom etdi / qanchalik katta?&quot;    -&gt; Histogram (default tanlov)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>reqs := promauto.NewCounterVec(prometheus.CounterOpts{<br>    Name: &quot;http_requests_total&quot;}, []string{&quot;method&quot;, &quot;code&quot;})<br>inflight := promauto.NewGauge(prometheus.GaugeOpts{Name: &quot;http_inflight_requests&quot;})<br>dur := promauto.NewHistogramVec(prometheus.HistogramOpts{<br>    Name:    &quot;http_request_duration_seconds&quot;,<br>    Buckets: []float64{.01, .05, .1, .25, .5, 1, 2.5, 5}}, []string{&quot;route&quot;})</pre><p>Histogram aslida 3 series beradi: <code>_bucket{le=&quot;...&quot;}</code> (kumulyativ), <code>_sum</code>, <code>_count</code>.</p><pre>rate(http_requests_total[5m])                         # counter<br>histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le)(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))<br>rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum[5m]) / rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count[5m])  # o'rtacha</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Counter'ni xom grafikda ko'rsatish yoki <code>rate()</code> siz alert — restart'larda noto'g'ri.</li><li>Gauge'ga <code>rate()</code> qo'llash — ma'nosiz (<code>deriv()</code> bor).</li><li>Summary quantile'larini o'rtachalash (<code>avg</code> p99) — matematik jihatdan noto'g'ri.</li><li>Bucket'lar SLO chegarasiga mos tanlanmagan — p99 aniqligi yomon.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi kodda summary deyarli kerak emas — histogram, imkon bo'lsa <b>native histogram</b> (Prometheus 2.40+ eksperimental, 3.x da barqarorlashmoqda): bucket'lar avtomatik eksponensial, aniqroq va har bucket alohida series emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41657	<p>Prometheus exporter nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Exporter — o'zi Prometheus formatida metrika bermaydigan tizimdan (Linux kernel, MySQL, Redis, hardware, tashqi endpoint) ma'lumot o'qib, uni Prometheus formatiga tarjima qilib <code>/metrics</code> endpoint'ida beradigan kichik servis.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> PostgreSQL yoki Linux kernel'ga Prometheus kutubxonasini qo'shib bo'lmaydi. Exporter &quot;tarjimon&quot; bo'lib turadi; o'z kodingiz uchun esa exporter emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri client library ishlatiladi.</p><pre>[PostgreSQL] &lt;--SQL (pg_stat_*)-- [postgres_exporter :9187/metrics] &lt;--scrape-- [Prometheus]<br>[Linux /proc,/sys] &lt;--- [node_exporter :9100/metrics] &lt;--scrape--<br>[https://site] &lt;--probe-- [blackbox_exporter :9115/probe?target=...] &lt;--scrape--</pre><p><b>Mashhur exporter'lar:</b> | Exporter | Nima uchun | |---|---| | <code>node_exporter</code> | Linux host: CPU, RAM, disk, tarmoq | | <code>postgres_exporter</code>, <code>mysqld_exporter</code> | DB statistikasi | | <code>redis_exporter</code>, <code>kafka_exporter</code> | cache/MQ | | <code>blackbox_exporter</code> | tashqi tekshiruv (HTTP, TCP, ICMP, DNS) | | <code>kube-state-metrics</code> | K8s obyekt holati | | <code>cAdvisor</code> (kubelet ichida) | container resurs sarfi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run -d -p 9187:9187 \<br>  -e DATA_SOURCE_NAME=&quot;postgresql://exporter:pw@db:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable&quot; \<br>  quay.io/prometheuscommunity/postgres-exporter<br>curl -s localhost:9187/metrics | grep pg_up</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Exporter'ga superuser DB huquqi berish — faqat monitoring roli (<code>pg_monitor</code>).</li><li>Qimmat custom query'lar har scrape'da DB'ni yuklaydi.</li><li>Exporter o'zi tirik, lekin manbaga ulana olmaydi — <code>up=1</code>, lekin <code>pg_up=0</code>; ikkalasiga alert kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Exporter'ni iloji boricha manba yonida (sidecar yoki shu host'da) ishlating, uning o'z resurs sarfi va scrape vaqtini (<code>scrape_duration_seconds</code>) kuzating. Ko'p zamonaviy tizimlar (etcd, CoreDNS, Envoy) nativ <code>/metrics</code> beradi — exporter shart emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41658	<p>PromQL'da <code>rate()</code> va <code>irate()</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham counter'ning soniyalik o'sish tezligini hisoblaydi va counter reset'larni to'g'rilaydi. <code>rate()</code> — oynadagi <b>barcha</b> nuqtalar bo'yicha o'rtacha tezlik (silliq, barqaror) — alert, recording rule va SLO uchun. <code>irate()</code> — oynadagi faqat <b>oxirgi ikki</b> nuqta bo'yicha oniy tezlik (sakrashlarni ko'rsatadi, lekin shovqinli) — tez o'zgaruvchan grafiklar uchun.</p><p><b>Farq vizual:</b></p><pre>counter o'sishi:  qisqa burst 10:00:30 da<br>rate([5m]):   ____/‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾\____   burst 5 daq davomida &quot;yoyilgan&quot;, past cho'qqi<br>irate([5m]):  ______|\_________     o'tkir cho'qqi, scrape'lar orasiga tushsa ko'rinmay qolishi ham mumkin</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Alert / SLO: barqaror<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) &gt; 0.01<br># Dashboard'da oniy sakrashlar<br>irate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device=&quot;eth0&quot;}[1m])<br># Oyna davomida jami o'sish<br>increase(http_requests_total[1h])</pre><p>Oyna qoidasi: <code>range &gt;= 4 x scrape_interval</code> (15s scrape -&gt; kamida <code>[1m]</code>). Grafana'da <code>$__rate_interval</code> o'zgaruvchisini ishlating — avtomatik to'g'ri oyna.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>irate</code> bilan alert — <code>for:</code> bo'lsa ham flapping qiladi.</li><li>Oyna juda kichik (<code>[15s]</code> da 15s scrape) — faqat bitta nuqta, natija bo'sh.</li><li><code>sum</code> ni <code>rate</code> dan oldin qo'llash: <code>rate(sum(...))</code> — noto'g'ri, reset'lar buziladi; doim avval <code>rate</code>, keyin <code>sum</code>.</li><li>Dashboard'da zoom out qilinganda <code>irate</code> ko'p nuqtalarni tashlab yuboradi (step &gt; oyna).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amalda <code>irate</code> kamdan-kam kerak; <code>rate</code> + mos oyna standart. <code>increase()</code> ham ekstrapolyatsiya qiladi, shuning uchun butun bo'lmagan qiymat qaytarishi normal — hisob-kitob (billing) uchun Prometheus ishlatmang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41659	<p>PromQL'da <code>histogram_quantile()</code> p99 latency'ni qanday hisoblaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>histogram_quantile(0.99, ...)</code> kumulyativ bucket hisoblagichlaridan (<code>le</code>) 99-persentil tushadigan bucket'ni topadi va uning chegaralari orasida <b>chiziqli interpolatsiya</b> qilib <b>taxminiy</b> p99 qaytaradi. Aniqlik bucket chegaralariga bog'liq; agregatsiya <code>le</code> label'ini saqlab qilinishi shart.</p><p><b>Hisob misoli:</b> 5 daqiqada 1000 so'rov, bucket'lar (kumulyativ):</p><pre>le=&quot;0.1&quot;  -&gt; 900<br>le=&quot;0.25&quot; -&gt; 985<br>le=&quot;0.5&quot;  -&gt; 996     &lt;- 990-chi so'rov (99%) shu bucket ichida<br>le=&quot;1&quot;    -&gt; 1000<br>p99: 0.25 + (0.5-0.25) * (990-985)/(996-985) = 0.25 + 0.25*0.4545 ~= 0.364 s</pre><p>Haqiqiy p99 0.26 ham, 0.49 ham bo'lishi mumkin edi — natija faqat bucket ichidagi bir tekis taqsimot farazi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>histogram_quantile(0.99,<br>  sum by (le, service) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))</pre><p>To'g'ri tartib: <code>rate</code> -&gt; <code>sum by (le, ...)</code> -&gt; <code>histogram_quantile</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sum</code> da <code>le</code> ni tashlab yuborish — natija <code>NaN</code> yoki bo'sh.</li><li>Oxirgi bucket'dan (<code>+Inf</code>) katta qiymat — natija eng katta chekli chegaraga &quot;qisiladi&quot; (masalan doim 5 s).</li><li>Default bucket'lar (<code>.005 ... 10</code>) sizning SLO chegarangizga (masalan 300 ms) mos emas — aynan SLO atrofida bucket qo'ying.</li><li>p99'larni servislar bo'yicha o'rtachalash — noto'g'ri; bucket'larni yig'ib keyin quantile.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SLO uchun quantile emas, <b>&quot;chegaradan tez bo'lgan so'rovlar ulushi&quot;</b> ni aniq hisoblang: <code>rate(..._bucket{le=&quot;0.3&quot;}[5m]) / rate(..._count[5m])</code> — interpolatsiyasiz va aniq. Native histogram'lar xatolikni sezilarli kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41660	<p>Metrikalarda high cardinality nima va nega Prometheus'ni yiqitadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cardinality — metrika uchun label qiymatlari kombinatsiyalaridan hosil bo'lgan <b>unikal time series soni</b>. Har series Prometheus head block'ida xotira (~bir necha KB), indeks yozuvi va disk egallaydi. <code>user_id</code>, <code>order_id</code>, <code>email</code>, to'liq URL path kabi cheksiz qiymatli label'lar series sonini millionlarga chiqarib, xotira tugashiga (OOM), sekin so'rovlarga va restart'da uzoq WAL replay'ga olib keladi.</p><p><b>Hisob:</b></p><pre>http_requests_total{method, code, route}<br>   5 method x 10 code x 50 route         = 2 500 series   (OK)<br> + user_id (1 000 000 user)              = 2.5 mlrd series (o'lim)<br> x pod (har deploy'da yangi pod nomlari)  -&gt; &quot;churn&quot; ham o'sadi</pre><p><b>Amalda — aniqlash:</b></p><pre>topk(10, count by (__name__) ({__name__=~&quot;.+&quot;}))      # eng ko'p series'li metrikalar<br>count by (route) (http_requests_total)                # label qiymatlari soni<br>prometheus_tsdb_head_series                            # jami faol series</pre><pre>promtool tsdb analyze /prometheus      # label cardinality hisobotи</pre><p>UI: Status -&gt; TSDB Status.</p><p><b>Himoya:</b></p><pre>metric_relabel_configs:<br>  - source_labels: [__name__]<br>    regex: &quot;http_request_duration_seconds_bucket&quot;<br>    action: keep<br>  - regex: &quot;user_id|session_id&quot;<br>    action: labeldrop<br>sample_limit: 50000          # scrape_config darajasida</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Route o'rniga xom path (<code>/users/123</code>) — har ID yangi series; template'ni ishlating (<code>/users/{id}</code>).</li><li>Histogram x ko'p label — bucket'lar soniga ko'payadi (12 bucket = 12 barobar).</li><li>Xato xabarini label qilish (<code>error=&quot;timeout after 3021ms&quot;</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: label qiymatlari chegaralangan va kichik bo'lsin; individual identifikatorlar log, trace va exemplar'larga tegishli. Platforma darajasida <code>sample_limit</code>, <code>label_limit</code> va har team uchun series kvotasi qo'ying (Mimir'da tenant limitlari).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41661	<p>Prometheus exemplar nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Exemplar — metrika sample'iga biriktirilgan namunaviy hodisa havolasi, odatda <code>trace_id</code> (va qiymat, vaqt). Histogram bucket'iga &quot;shu bucket'ga tushgan aniq bir so'rov — mana bu trace&quot; degan ma'lumot qo'shadi. Grafana'da latency grafigidagi nuqtani bosib, aynan shu sekin so'rov trace'ini Tempo/Jaeger'da ochasiz.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Metrika &quot;p99 = 2.4 s&quot; deydi, lekin qaysi so'rov? Exemplar'siz trace'lar orasidan qidirish kerak; exemplar bilan bir bosish.</p><pre>p99 grafik  .  .  .  *(exemplar: trace_id=4bf92f...)  .  .<br>                      |<br>                      v  bosish<br>              Tempo: checkout -&gt; payment -&gt; db.query 2.1s</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> Go'da yozish:</p><pre>hist.(prometheus.ExemplarObserver).ObserveWithExemplar(<br>    dur.Seconds(), prometheus.Labels{&quot;trace_id&quot;: span.SpanContext().TraceID().String()})</pre><p>Prometheus'ni yoqish va OpenMetrics formatda scrape:</p><pre>prometheus --enable-feature=exemplar-storage</pre><p><code>/metrics</code> chiqishi (OpenMetrics):</p><pre>http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=&quot;2.5&quot;} 120 # {trace_id=&quot;4bf92f3577b34da6&quot;} 2.31 1727950000.000</pre><p>Grafana: Prometheus data source -&gt; Exemplars -&gt; <code>trace_id</code> -&gt; Tempo data source; panelda &quot;Exemplars&quot; ni yoqish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Scrape OpenMetrics formatida bo'lmasa exemplar'lar tashlanadi.</li><li>Exemplar havola qilgan trace sampling'da tashlangan — bosganda &quot;trace topilmadi&quot;; tail sampling yoki sampled trace'larnigina exemplar qilish.</li><li>Exemplar storage xotirada cheklangan (<code>max_exemplars</code>) — uzoq tarix yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Exemplar — yuqori cardinality'li identifikatorni (trace_id) metrikaga label qilmasdan bog'lashning to'g'ri yo'li. OTel SDK'lar sampled span konteksti bo'lsa exemplar'ni avtomatik qo'shadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41662	<p>Grafana nima va zamonaviy observability'dagi roli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Grafana — ochiq kodli vizualizatsiya va observability platformasi: ko'plab data source'larga (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Elasticsearch, CloudWatch, PostgreSQL...) ulanib, dashboard'lar, ad-hoc tahlil (Explore), alerting va signallar orasida bog'langan navigatsiyani (metrika -&gt; trace -&gt; log -&gt; profil) bir UI'da beradi. U ma'lumot saqlamaydi — so'rovni manbaga yuboradi.</p><p><b>LGTM stack'dagi o'rni:</b></p><pre>            +------------- Grafana (UI, alerting, korrelyatsiya) -------------+<br>            |                |                 |                  |<br>         Mimir/Prom        Loki             Tempo             Pyroscope<br>         (Metrics)         (Logs)           (Traces)          (Profiles)<br>            ^                ^                 ^                  ^<br>            +--------- Alloy / OTel Collector (yig'ish) ----------+</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><ul><li>Explore: dashboard'siz ad-hoc PromQL/LogQL/TraceQL, split view'da metrika va log yonma-yon.</li><li>Dashboard'lar: variables (<code>$namespace</code>), <code>$__rate_interval</code>, annotation'lar (deploy vaqtlari).</li><li>Provisioning (kod sifatida):</li></ul><pre># /etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources/prom.yaml<br>apiVersion: 1<br>datasources:<br>  - name: Prometheus<br>    type: prometheus<br>    url: http://prometheus:9090<br>    jsonData:<br>      exemplarTraceIdDestinations: [{ name: trace_id, datasourceUid: tempo }]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>UI'da qo'lda yasalgan dashboard'lar — versiyasiz, yo'qoladi, drift; provisioning yoki dashboard-as-code.</li><li>Og'ir panellar (uzoq oyna, recording rule'siz) — har ochilishda Prometheus'ni yuklaydi.</li><li>50 panelli &quot;hamma narsa&quot; dashboard — incident'da hech narsa topilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Dashboard ierarxiyasini qur: yuqori darajada SLO/RED overview, undan drill-down servis va infra dashboard'lariga. Grafana — &quot;yagona oyna&quot;, lekin signallarning sifati instrumentatsiyaga bog'liq; Grafana'ni HA (tashqi DB, bir nechta replika) bilan ishga tushiring, chunki incident paytida u ham kritik.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41663	<p>Alertmanager nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Alertmanager — Prometheus (yoki Mimir/Loki ruler) yuborgan alert'larni qabul qilib, ularni <b>dedup</b> qiladi, <b>group</b>laydi, <b>route</b> bo'yicha kerakli <b>receiver</b>ga (Slack, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, email, webhook) yuboradi, <b>inhibition</b> va <b>silence</b> bilan keraksizlarini o'chiradi va qayta eslatish (<code>repeat_interval</code>) ni boshqaradi. Prometheus faqat &quot;alert firing&quot; deydi; xabarnoma mantiqi Alertmanager'da.</p><p><b>Oqim:</b></p><pre>Prometheus HA (x2) --alerts--&gt; Alertmanager klaster (gossip)<br>                                  |<br>                       dedup (fingerprint) -&gt; inhibit -&gt; silence<br>                                  |<br>                          route tree (label'lar)<br>                         /            |          \<br>                 PagerDuty       Slack #alerts   webhook</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>route:<br>  receiver: slack-default<br>  group_by: [alertname, cluster, service]<br>  group_wait: 30s        # birinchi xabardan oldin guruh yig'ilishini kutish<br>  group_interval: 5m     # guruhga yangi alert qo'shilsa<br>  repeat_interval: 4h    # hal bo'lmasa qayta eslatish<br>  routes:<br>    - matchers: [severity=&quot;critical&quot;]<br>      receiver: pagerduty<br>receivers:<br>  - name: pagerduty<br>    pagerduty_configs: [{ routing_key: &lt;secret&gt; }]<br>  - name: slack-default<br>    slack_configs: [{ channel: &quot;#alerts&quot;, send_resolved: true }]</pre><pre>amtool check-config alertmanager.yml<br>amtool alert query<br>amtool config routes test severity=critical service=api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Alertmanager'ni bitta nusxada ishlatish — u yiqilsa hech kim bilmaydi (klaster + Watchdog).</li><li><code>group_by</code> juda tor — bir hodisa 200 ta alohida xabar.</li><li>Secret'larni (webhook URL, routing key) konfigda ochiq saqlash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alertmanager — shovqin boshqaruvining markazi: har page actionable va runbook havolasi bilan bo'lsin, qolgani ticket/Slack. Alert'lar sonini va &quot;ack qilinmasdan yopilgan&quot;larni hafta sayin ko'rib chiqish — alert fatigue'ga qarshi asosiy jarayon.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41664	<p>Alertmanager inhibition va grouping nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Grouping</b> — bir xil <code>group_by</code> label qiymatlariga ega alert'larni bitta xabarnomaga jamlaydi (node yiqildi — 50 ta pod alert'i bitta xabar). <b>Inhibition</b> — &quot;manba&quot; alert faol bo'lganda unga bog'liq &quot;nishon&quot; alert'larni o'chiradi (<code>NodeDown</code> firing bo'lsa, o'sha node'dagi <code>PodNotReady</code> xabar bermaydi), chunki ular bir sababning oqibati.</p><p><b>Grouping vizual:</b></p><pre>group_by: [alertname, cluster]<br> KubePodCrashLooping{pod=a, cluster=prod}  \<br> KubePodCrashLooping{pod=b, cluster=prod}   &gt;--&gt; 1 ta xabar: &quot;3 alerts: KubePodCrashLooping prod&quot;<br> KubePodCrashLooping{pod=c, cluster=prod}  /</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>route:<br>  group_by: [alertname, cluster, namespace]<br>  group_wait: 30s<br>  group_interval: 5m<br><br>inhibit_rules:<br>  - source_matchers: [alertname=&quot;NodeDown&quot;]<br>    target_matchers: [severity=~&quot;warning|critical&quot;]<br>    equal: [node]                # faqat AYNAN o'sha node'dagilar<br>  - source_matchers: [severity=&quot;critical&quot;]<br>    target_matchers: [severity=&quot;warning&quot;]<br>    equal: [alertname, service]  # critical bor bo'lsa shu servis warning'i jim</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>equal</code> ni yozmaslik — bitta node yiqilsa butun klasterdagi alert'lar o'chadi; haqiqiy muammo yashirinadi.</li><li>Manba alert'ning o'zi xabar bermaydigan route'da bo'lsa — hamma jim.</li><li><code>group_by: ['...']</code> (maxsus &quot;hamma label&quot;) — amalda grouping'ni o'chiradi.</li><li>Juda uzun <code>group_wait</code> — kritik page kechikadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Inhibition — sabab-oqibat bog'lanishini kodlash; uni ehtiyotkorlik bilan, test qilib (<code>amtool</code>) qo'ying. Yaxshiroq asos — symptom-based alerting (SLO): u holda kaskad alert'lar kamroq bo'ladi va inhibition qoidalari soni kichik qoladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41665	<p>Loki nima va Elasticsearch'dan farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Elasticsearch</b> har log qatorining to'liq matnini inverted index'da indekslaydi — ixtiyoriy so'z bo'yicha qidiruv juda tez, lekin ingest CPU, RAM va storage qimmat. <b>Loki</b> faqat <b>label'lar</b>ni (<code>app</code>, <code>namespace</code>, <code>level</code>) indekslaydi, log matnini siqilgan chunk'larda arzon object storage'da (S3, GCS) saqlaydi; so'rovda avval label'lar bilan stream'larni toraytirib, keyin matnni brute-force (parallel) skanerlaydi.</p><pre>Elasticsearch:  &quot;error timeout user=42&quot; -&gt; [error] [timeout] [user] [42] -&gt; inverted index<br>Loki:           {app=&quot;api&quot;, env=&quot;prod&quot;} -&gt; index (kichik)<br>                &quot;error timeout user=42&quot; -&gt; siqilgan chunk -&gt; S3</pre><p>| | Elasticsearch / OpenSearch | Loki | |---|---|---| | Indeks | to'liq matn | faqat label'lar | | Narx | yuqori (index 1-2x ma'lumot hajmi) | past (S3 + kichik index) | | Ixtiyoriy matn qidiruv | juda tez | label'lar bilan toraytirilsa yaxshi, aks holda sekin | | Analitika / agregatsiya | kuchli | LogQL metrikalari, cheklanganroq | | Ops murakkabligi | shard, heap, mapping | object storage, kamroq tuning |</p><p><b>Amalda (LogQL):</b></p><pre>{namespace=&quot;prod&quot;, app=&quot;api&quot;} |= &quot;timeout&quot; | json | status &gt;= 500</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Loki'da yuqori cardinality'li label (<code>user_id</code>, <code>trace_id</code>) — stream'lar portlaydi, ingest buziladi. Ular log ichida qolsin (yoki structured metadata).</li><li>Loki'da label'siz keng so'rov (<code>{env=&quot;prod&quot;} |= &quot;x&quot;</code> 30 kun) — terabaytlarni skanerlaydi.</li><li>Elasticsearch'da dynamic mapping portlashi va heap muammolari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov ish yukiga bog'liq: debug va operatsion log'lar (asosan &quot;shu servisning shu vaqtdagi log'i&quot;) — Loki arzon va yetarli; xavfsizlik analitikasi, ixtiyoriy matn qidiruv, murakkab agregatsiya (SIEM) — Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. Ko'p kompaniyalar ikkalasini turli maqsadda ishlatadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41666	<p>LogQL nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LogQL — Loki'ning so'rov tili, PromQL'dan ilhomlangan. Ikki turi bor: <b>log query</b> — stream selector (<code>{label=&quot;...&quot;}</code>) + pipeline (filtr, parser, formatlash) bilan log qatorlarini qaytaradi; <b>metric query</b> — log'larni <code>rate</code>, <code>count_over_time</code>, <code>sum_over_time</code> kabi funksiyalar bilan time series'ga aylantiradi (dashboard va alert uchun).</p><p><b>Pipeline tartibi:</b></p><pre>{app=&quot;payment&quot;, env=&quot;prod&quot;}      &lt;- stream selector (indeks, majburiy)<br>  |= &quot;failed&quot;                    &lt;- line filter (tez, chunk skanerlash)<br>  != &quot;healthcheck&quot;<br>  | json                         &lt;- parser (logfmt, regexp, pattern ham bor)<br>  | status_code &gt;= 500           &lt;- label filter (parse qilingan maydon)<br>  | line_format &quot;{{.user}} {{.msg}}&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Log'lar<br>{app=&quot;payment&quot;} |= &quot;timeout&quot; | json | duration_ms &gt; 2000<br><br># Regex filter<br>{app=&quot;nginx&quot;} |~ &quot;HTTP/1.1\&quot; 5\\d\\d&quot;<br><br># Metrika: soniyalik xato soni region bo'yicha<br>sum by (region) (rate({app=&quot;payment&quot;} |= &quot;ERROR&quot; [5m]))<br><br># Xatolar ulushi<br>sum(count_over_time({app=&quot;api&quot;} | json | level=&quot;error&quot; [5m]))<br>  / sum(count_over_time({app=&quot;api&quot;} [5m]))</pre><p>Alert (Loki ruler):</p><pre>- alert: PaymentErrorsHigh<br>  expr: sum(rate({app=&quot;payment&quot;} |= &quot;ERROR&quot; Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41668	<p>Uzoq muddatli Prometheus storage uchun Thanos va Mimir farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham Prometheus'ni uzoq muddatli, global va HA qiladi, ma'lumotni object storage'da saqlaydi. <b>Thanos</b> — mavjud Prometheus'lar yoniga <b>sidecar</b> qo'shadi: 2 soatlik TSDB block'larni S3'ga yuklaydi, Querier ko'p Prometheus + S3 ustidan global so'rov va dedup qiladi (alternativ: Receive komponenti remote_write qabul qiladi). <b>Mimir</b> (Grafana Labs, Cortex vorisi) — <b>remote_write</b> qabul qiladigan, gorizontal scale qiladigan, multi-tenant markaziy TSDB servisi.</p><p><b>Arxitektura farqi:</b></p><pre>Thanos (sidecar model):<br> [Prom+sidecar] [Prom+sidecar] --block'lar--&gt; Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41669	<p>OpenTelemetry (OTel) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OpenTelemetry (OTel) — CNCF loyihasi: telemetriya (trace, metrika, log, eksperimental profil) yaratish va uzatish uchun <b>vendor-neytral standart</b>: API (instrumentatsiya interfeysi), tillar bo'yicha SDK'lar, auto-instrumentation, OTLP protokoli, semantic conventions va Collector. Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41670	<p>OTel Collector arxitekturasi (receiver, processor, exporter) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OTel Collector — telemetriyani qabul qilib, qayta ishlab, yuboradigan alohida process. U <b>pipeline</b>lardan iborat (har signal uchun: traces, metrics, logs): <b>receiver</b> — ma'lumotni qabul qiladi (OTLP, Prometheus scrape, Jaeger, filelog, kafka); <b>processor</b> — o'zgartiradi (memory_limiter, batch, attributes/PII olib tashlash, k8sattributes, tail_sampling, filter); <b>exporter</b> — backend'larga yuboradi (otlp, prometheusremotewrite, loki, kafka, vendor). Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41671	<p>Distributed tracing'da span va trace farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Trace</b> — bitta request (yoki operatsiya)ning butun tizim bo'ylab to'liq yo'li; barcha span'lari bitta <code>trace_id</code> ga ega. <b>Span</b> — trace ichidagi bitta ish birligi (HTTP handler, DB so'rov, Kafka publish): nomi, boshlanish/tugash vaqti, <code>span_id</code>, ota span (<code>parent_span_id</code>), atributlar, event'lar, status va kind (SERVER, CLIENT, PRODUCER, CONSUMER, INTERNAL).</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>trace_id = 4bf92f...<br>[GET /checkout          SERVER  0 ms ---------------------------- 820 ms]  (root span)<br>   [auth.verify         CLIENT  5 ---- 40]<br>   [payment.charge      CLIENT       45 ------------------- 700]<br>        [POST /charge   SERVER       50 ----------------- 690]   (payment servisida)<br>             [SELECT orders  CLIENT   60 -------------- 650]     &lt;- asosiy vaqt shu yerda<br>   [kafka.publish       PRODUCER                          705 -- 720]</pre><p>Span'lar daraxtni ota-bola bog'lanishi orqali hosil qiladi; Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41672	<p>W3C TraceContext nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> W3C Trace Context — trace kontekstini servislar orasida HTTP header'larda uzatish uchun W3C standarti. <code>traceparent</code> — majburiy: versiya, 16-baytli <code>trace-id</code>, 8-baytli <code>parent-id</code> (chaqiruvchi span), flag'lar (<code>01</code> = sampled). <code>tracestate</code> — ixtiyoriy, vendorlarga xos key=value ro'yxati. Standartgacha har vendor o'z header'ini (<code>X-B3-TraceId</code>, <code>uber-trace-id</code>) ishlatgan — turli tool'lar orasida trace uzilardi.</p><p><b>Format:</b></p><pre>traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01<br>             |  |                                |                |<br>          versiya     trace-id (32 hex)         parent-id (16 hex)  flags (01=sampled)<br>tracestate:  congo=t61rcWkgMzE,rojo=00f067aa0ba902b7</pre><p><b>Oqim:</b></p><pre>Service A (span X)  --HTTP traceparent: 00-&lt;T&gt;-&lt;X&gt;-01--&gt;  Service B<br>                                                          yangi span Y, parent = X, trace = T</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>otel.SetTextMapPropagator(propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(<br>    propagation.TraceContext{}, propagation.Baggage{}))<br>client := http.Client{Transport: otelhttp.NewTransport(http.DefaultTransport)} // inject<br>handler := otelhttp.NewHandler(mux, &quot;server&quot;)                                   // extract</pre><pre>curl -H 'traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01' https://api/x</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Proxy/gateway (eski nginx, API gateway) header'ni tashlab yuboradi — trace ikkiga bo'linadi.</li><li>Turli servislarda turli propagator (B3 va W3C) — konfigda ikkalasini composite qiling migratsiya paytida.</li><li>Tashqi (ishonchsiz) client'dan kelgan <code>traceparent</code> ga ko'r-ko'rona ishonish — sampling qarorini tashqaridan boshqarishga yo'l beradi; chekkada (edge) yangi trace boshlash yoki siyosat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Message queue'larda ham kontekstni xabar header'iga (Kafka record headers) qo'ying — aks holda async yo'l trace'dan tushib qoladi. Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41673	<p>Tail-based va head-based sampling farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Head-based</b> sampling — qaror trace <b>boshida</b> (birinchi span'da) qabul qilinadi va <code>traceparent</code> flag'i orqali hamma servislarga uzatiladi (masalan 5% tasodifiy). Arzon va oddiy, lekin qaysi trace xato yoki sekin bo'lishini oldindan bilmaydi. <b>Tail-based</b> sampling — Collector butun trace span'larini yig'ib, trace <b>tugagandan keyin</b> qaror qiladi: barcha xatoli va sekinlarni 100%, normal'larning kichik qismini saqlaydi.</p><pre>Head:  request kelishi -&gt; tanga tashlash (5%) -&gt; sampled=1/0 butun zanjirga<br>       + arzon, past overhead<br>       - kamyob xatolarning 95% i yo'qoladi<br><br>Tail:  hamma span -&gt; [Collector buffer: decision_wait 10s] -&gt; siyosat:<br>                      status=ERROR -&gt; saqla<br>                      duration&gt;2s  -&gt; saqla<br>                      qolgani      -&gt; 5% saqla<br>       + qiziqarli trace'lar saqlanadi<br>       - xotira, bitta trace'ning barcha span'lari BITTA collector'ga kelishi shart</pre><p><b>Amalda (Collector gateway):</b></p><pre>processors:<br>  tail_sampling:<br>    decision_wait: 10s<br>    num_traces: 100000<br>    policies:<br>      - { name: errors, type: status_code, status_code: { status_codes: [ERROR] } }<br>      - { name: slow,   type: latency,     latency: { threshold_ms: 2000 } }<br>      - { name: rest,   type: probabilistic, probabilistic: { sampling_percentage: 5 } }</pre><p>Agent qatlami trace_id bo'yicha yo'naltiradi:</p><pre>exporters:<br>  loadbalancing:<br>    routing_key: traceID<br>    resolver: { k8s: { service: otel-gateway-headless } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Loadbalancing exporter'siz bir nechta gateway — trace span'lari bo'linadi, qaror noto'g'ri.</li><li><code>decision_wait</code> dan uzoq davom etadigan trace'lar — kech span'lar alohida qarorga tushadi.</li><li>Head sampling 5% + tail — tail faqat head o'tkazgan 5% ichidan tanlaydi.</li><li>Sampled ma'lumotdan hisoblangan RED metrikalar noto'g'ri — metrikani sampling'dan oldin hisoblang (spanmetrics connector).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatiy kompromiss: SDK'da <code>parentbased_always_on</code> (hamma narsa Collector'ga), gateway'da tail sampling. Hajm juda katta bo'lsa — head sampling'ni yuqori darajada qoldirib, xatolar uchun log/metrika exemplar'lariga tayanish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus

Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41675	<p>Cilium Hubble tarmoq observability'sida nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Hubble — Cilium CNI ustidagi tarmoq observability qatlami. eBPF orqali kernel'da har tarmoq oqimini (flow) ko'radi va ilova kodiga tegmasdan beradi: servislararo bog'liqlik xaritasi, L3/L4 flow'lar (kim kimga, qaysi port, forwarded/dropped va sababi), L7 ma'lumot (HTTP metod/status/latency, DNS so'rovlari, Kafka) va Prometheus metrikalari.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;Pod A pod B ga ulana olmayapti&quot; — NetworkPolicy blokladimi, DNS xatomi, yoki B o'zi javob bermayaptimi? Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41676	<p>SLO multi-window multi-burn-rate alerting (monitoring) qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SLO alerting'da xato <b>ulushi</b> emas, <b>error budget'ning yonish tezligi</b> (burn rate) kuzatiladi: burn rate 1 = budget aynan SLO davri (30 kun) oxirida tugaydi; 14.4 = 30 kunlik budget'ning 2% i 1 soatda yonadi (budget ~2 kunda tugaydi). <b>Multi-window</b>: alert faqat uzun oyna (1h) VA qisqa oyna (5m) ikkalasida chegara oshsa yonadi — uzun oyna shovqinni yo'qotadi, qisqa oyna muammo tugaganda alert tez o'chishini ta'minlaydi. <b>Multi-burn-rate</b>: tez yonish -&gt; page, sekin yonish -&gt; ticket.</p><p><b>Google SRE Workbook jadvali (SLO 99.9%, 30 kun):</b> | Burn rate | Uzun oyna | Qisqa oyna | Budget sarfi | Harakat | |---|---|---|---|---| | 14.4 | 1h | 5m | 2% | page | | 6 | 6h | 30m | 5% | page | | 1 | 3d | 6h | 10% | ticket |</p><p>Hisob: <code>14.4 x (1 - 0.999) = 0.0144</code> -&gt; xato ulushi 1.44% dan oshsa.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># recording rule<br>- record: slo:error_ratio:rate1h<br>  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;,code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[1h])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;}[1h]))<br># (rate5m, rate6h, rate30m ham xuddi shunday)<br>- alert: ApiErrorBudgetFastBurn<br>  expr: slo:error_ratio:rate1h &gt; (14.4 * 0.001) and slo:error_ratio:rate5m &gt; (14.4 * 0.001)<br>  for: 2m<br>  labels: { severity: critical }</pre><p>Bunday qoidalarni qo'lda yozmaslik uchun generator'lar: <b>Sloth</b>, <b>Pyrra</b>, OpenSLO.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oddiy &quot;xato &gt; Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41677	<p>Prometheus remote write va WAL nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>WAL</b> (Write-Ahead Log) — Prometheus kelgan sample'larni xotiradagi head block'ga qo'shishdan oldin diskdagi <code>wal/</code> papkasiga ketma-ket yozadi; crash/restart'dan keyin WAL qayta o'qilib (replay) xotiradagi ma'lumot tiklanadi. <b>Remote write</b> — Prometheus WAL'ni &quot;tail&quot; qilib, sample'larni snappy-siqilgan protobuf'da HTTP orqali tashqi storage'ga (Mimir, Thanos Receive, VictoriaMetrics, Cortex) stream qiladi; har endpoint uchun shard'lar va navbat bilan.</p><pre>scrape -&gt; WAL (disk) -&gt; head block (RAM) -&gt; 2h block (disk)<br>            |<br>            +--&gt; remote_write reader -&gt; queue (shards) -&gt; HTTP POST -&gt; Mimir<br>                     endpoint ishlamasa: retry/backoff, WAL'da (~2 soatgacha) kutadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>remote_write:<br>  - url: https://mimir.example.com/api/v1/push<br>    headers: { X-Scope-OrgID: team-a }<br>    queue_config:<br>      capacity: 10000<br>      max_shards: 50<br>      max_samples_per_send: 2000<br>    write_relabel_configs:<br>      - source_labels: [__name__]<br>        regex: &quot;go_gc_.*&quot;<br>        action: drop       # keraksizini yubormaslik (narx)</pre><p>Kuzatish:</p><pre>prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds - ignoring(remote_name, url) group_right prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds   # lag<br>rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total[5m])<br>prometheus_remote_storage_shards</pre><p>Faqat yuborish kerak bo'lsa: <code>--agent</code> rejimi (lokal so'rov/TSDB yo'q, kam resurs).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Endpoint uzoq ishlamasa WAL truncation (head compaction ~2h) — ma'lumot yo'qoladi.</li><li>Restart'da katta WAL replay daqiqalab davom etadi — bu vaqtda scrape yo'q.</li><li>Remote write'da 4xx (masalan tenant limiti, out-of-order) — retry qilinmaydi, sample'lar tashlanadi.</li><li><code>max_shards</code> kichik — lag doimiy o'sadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Remote write lag'ini alert qiling — u global dashboard va SLO'larning &quot;ko'rinmas&quot; Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41680	<p>PromQL'da <code>predict_linear()</code> bilan diskni proaktiv alert qilish qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>predict_linear(v[range], t)</code> — gauge'ning <code>range</code> oynadagi qiymatlariga oddiy chiziqli regressiya qo'llab, <code>t</code> soniyadan keyingi qiymatini bashorat qiladi. Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41685	<p>Strukturali (JSON) logging nima va nega majburiy?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Strukturali logging — har log yozuvini erkin matn qatori emas, maydonlari aniq nomlangan obyekt (odatda JSON yoki logfmt) sifatida chiqarish: <code>{&quot;ts&quot;:&quot;...&quot;,&quot;level&quot;:&quot;error&quot;,&quot;msg&quot;:&quot;charge failed&quot;,&quot;order_id&quot;:&quot;o-91&quot;,&quot;trace_id&quot;:&quot;4bf9...&quot;,&quot;duration_ms&quot;:812}</code>. Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41686	<p>OpenTelemetry baggage nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Baggage — OTel'da trace konteksti bilan birga servis chegaralari orqali (HTTP <code>baggage</code> header, W3C Baggage standarti) uzatiladigan ixtiyoriy key=value juftliklar: masalan <code>tenant.id=enterprise_456</code>, <code>feature_flag=new_checkout</code>. Span atributlaridan farqi: atribut faqat o'sha span'da, baggage esa <b>keyingi barcha</b> servislarga ketadi.</p><pre>API gateway (tenant=ent_456 ni biladi)<br>   | baggage: tenant.id=ent_456<br>   v<br>order-service ---&gt; payment-service ---&gt; ledger-service<br>                   (tenant.id ni span atributiga qo'shadi; &quot;har tenant bo'yicha latency&quot;)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>m, _ := baggage.NewMember(&quot;tenant.id&quot;, &quot;ent_456&quot;)<br>b, _ := baggage.New(m)<br>ctx = baggage.ContextWithBaggage(ctx, b)        // propagator uni header'ga qo'yadi<br><br>// downstream'da<br>tenant := baggage.FromContext(ctx).Member(&quot;tenant.id&quot;).Value()<br>span.SetAttributes(attribute.String(&quot;tenant.id&quot;, tenant))</pre><p>Header: <code>baggage: tenant.id=ent_456,feature_flag=new_checkout</code>. Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41687	<p>Prometheus'da alert dedup va fingerprint nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Fingerprint — alert'ning barcha label'laridan (alertname + qolgan label'lar, annotation'lar emas) hisoblangan hash; u alert'ning <b>identifikatori</b>. Alertmanager bir xil fingerprint'li alert'larni bitta alert deb hisoblaydi: HA juftligidagi ikkita Prometheus bir xil target'larni scrape qilib bir xil alert yuborsa, xabarnoma bir marta ketadi. Alertmanager klaster nusxalari ham gossip orqali &quot;kim nima yubordi&quot; va silence'larni ulashib, takroriy xabarni oldini oladi.</p><pre>Prometheus-A --alert{alertname=HighLatency, service=api, severity=critical}--+<br>Prometheus-B --alert{alertname=HighLatency, service=api, severity=critical}--+--&gt; AM klaster<br>                         fingerprint bir xil  -&gt;  1 ta alert  -&gt;  1 ta page</pre><p><b>Amalda — muhim sozlama:</b></p><pre># Prometheus-A<br>global:<br>  external_labels: { cluster: prod, replica: A }<br>alerting:<br>  alert_relabel_configs:<br>    - regex: replica<br>      action: labeldrop        # replica label'ini alert'dan olib tashlash!<br>  alertmanagers:<br>    - static_configs: [{ targets: [am-0:9093, am-1:9093, am-2:9093] }]</pre><p>Prometheus alert'ni <b>barcha</b> Alertmanager nusxalariga yuboradi (load balancer orqali emas).</p><pre>amtool alert query -o extended      # fingerprint va label'larni ko'rish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>replica</code> external label'i alert'da qolsa — fingerprint'lar farq qiladi, har alert ikki marta keladi.</li><li>Alert label'ida o'zgaruvchan qiymat (<code>value=&quot;{{ $value }}&quot;</code> label sifatida) — har baholashda yangi fingerprint, alert &quot;flap&quot; qiladi va qayta-qayta yuboriladi. Qiymatni annotation'ga qo'ying.</li><li>Alertmanager'lar orasida gossip porti (9094) yopiq — klaster bo'linib, takroriy xabarlar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Label = identifikator, annotation = tavsif. Bu qoidani buzish dedup, silence va inhibition'ni bir vaqtda buzadi. HA'ni test qiling: bitta Prometheus va bitta AM nusxasini o'chirib, xabar bir marta kelishini tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
