Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41689	<p><code>scrape_interval</code> va <code>evaluation_interval</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>scrape_interval</code> — Prometheus target'lardan metrikani <b>qanchalik tez-tez yig'ishi</b> (default 1m, amalda ko'pincha 15s-30s). <code>evaluation_interval</code> — recording va alerting rule'larni <b>qanchalik tez-tez hisoblashi</b> (default 1m). Ikkalasi <code>global</code> da beriladi va mos ravishda job yoki rule group darajasida qayta belgilanadi.</p><pre>scrape   |----15s----|----15s----|----15s----|     (ma'lumot kelishi)<br>evaluate |---------30s---------|---------30s--|    (rule'lar hisobi)<br>alert:   expr true -&gt; pending --(for: 5m)--&gt; firing -&gt; Alertmanager</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>global:<br>  scrape_interval: 15s<br>  scrape_timeout: 10s          # scrape_interval dan katta bo'lmasligi kerak<br>  evaluation_interval: 30s<br>scrape_configs:<br>  - job_name: heavy-exporter<br>    scrape_interval: 60s        # qimmat exporter uchun kamroq<br>rule_files: [/etc/prometheus/rules/*.yml]</pre><pre>groups:<br>  - name: slo<br>    interval: 15s              # shu guruh uchun evaluation_interval<br>    rules: [...]</pre><p><b>Alert kechikishi hisobi:</b> muammo boshlanishi -&gt; keyingi scrape (&lt;=15s) -&gt; keyingi evaluation (&lt;=30s) -&gt; <code>for: 5m</code> -&gt; <code>group_wait</code> (30s) -&gt; xabar. Ya'ni minimal <code>for</code> + bir daqiqacha qo'shimcha.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>rate(x[30s])</code> 15s scrape bilan — oynada 2 ta nuqta, ishonchsiz; oyna &gt;= 4 x scrape_interval.</li><li>Juda qisqa scrape (1-5s) hamma joyda — series hajmi va xarajat bir necha barobar.</li><li>Har job'da turli scrape interval — bir dashboard'da <code>rate</code> oynalarini moslashtirish qiyin; Grafana'da <code>$__rate_interval</code> va data source'da to'g'ri &quot;scrape interval&quot; sozlamasi.</li><li><code>scrape_timeout</code> &gt; <code>scrape_interval</code> — konfig xatosi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Standart: butun tashkilotda bitta scrape interval (15s yoki 30s), istisnolar sababli. <code>evaluation_interval</code> ni scrape interval'idan juda kichik qilish foyda bermaydi — yangi ma'lumot kelmaydi, faqat CPU sarfi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41690	<p>Prometheus recording rule nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Recording rule — PromQL ifodasini har <code>evaluation_interval</code> da oldindan hisoblab, natijani <b>yangi time series</b> sifatida saqlaydigan qoida. Dashboard va alert'lar qimmat so'rovni har safar qayta hisoblash o'rniga tayyor series'ni o'qiydi — tez va arzon; Mimir/Thanos'ga yuboriladigan hajmni ham kamaytirish mumkin.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> 10 000 pod bo'yicha <code>histogram_quantile(... sum by (le) (rate(..._bucket[5m])))</code> har dashboard ochilishida millionlab sample'ni skanerlaydi; 20 kishi bir vaqtda ochsa Prometheus bo'g'iladi. Recording rule bilan bu bitta series'ni o'qish.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>groups:<br>  - name: api_rules<br>    interval: 30s<br>    rules:<br>      - record: job:http_requests:rate5m<br>        expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br>      - record: job:http_request_errors:ratio_rate5m<br>        expr: |<br>          sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total{code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>          / sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br>      - record: job:http_request_duration_seconds:p99_5m<br>        expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))</pre><pre>promtool check rules rules.yml<br>promtool test rules tests.yml        # unit test: kirish series -&gt; kutilgan natija</pre><p>Nomlash konvensiyasi <code>level:metric:operations</code>: <code>level</code> — qaysi label'lar qoldi (<code>job</code>, <code>instance</code>), <code>metric</code> — asl nom, <code>operations</code> — qo'llangan amallar (<code>rate5m</code>, <code>ratio_rate5m</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Recording rule natijasi faqat yaratilgan paytdan boshlab mavjud — tarix yo'q (backfill uchun <code>promtool tsdb create-blocks-from rules</code>).</li><li>Rule'lar orasida bog'liqlik: bir guruh ichida ketma-ket baholanadi, guruhlar parallel — boshqa guruh natijasiga tayanish kechikish beradi.</li><li>Har narsani recording qilish — series soni o'sadi, foyda yo'q.</li><li><code>rate</code> ni recording qilib keyin uni yana <code>rate</code> qilish — noto'g'ri; counter'ni emas, natijani saqlayapsiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SLO alerting (burn rate oynalari) va katta agregatsiyalar recording rule'larsiz amalda ishlamaydi. Rule'larni kod sifatida test bilan saqlang (<code>promtool test rules</code>) — noto'g'ri recording rule jim va uzoq vaqt noto'g'ri ma'lumot beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41691	<p>Prometheus TSDB block compaction nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Compaction — Prometheus TSDB'ning fon jarayoni: head'dan chiqqan 2 soatlik block'larni kattaroq block'larga (2h -&gt; 6h -&gt; 18h -&gt; ... maksimal retention'ning ~10% i yoki 31 kun, qaysi kichik bo'lsa) birlashtiradi. Bunda index'lar birlashtiriladi, chunk'lar qayta yoziladi, tombstone (o'chirilgan deb belgilangan) series'lar haqiqatan olib tashlanadi va retention'dan eskirgan block'lar o'chiriladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Har 2 soatda yangi block — 30 kunda 360 ta block. So'rov har block'ning index'ini ochishi kerak bo'lardi (sekin, ko'p fayl). Kam va katta block'lar — tez so'rov va kamroq disk (takroriy index ma'lumoti yo'q).</p><pre>head (RAM, ~2-3h) --cut--&gt; [2h][2h][2h] --compact--&gt; [6h] ... [6h][6h][6h] --&gt; [18h] ...<br>                                                                       retention -&gt; o'chirish<br>har block: chunks/  index  meta.json  tombstones</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls /prometheus                       # 01HXYZ... (ULID nomli block papkalari), wal/, chunks_head/<br>cat /prometheus/01HXYZ.../meta.json  # minTime, maxTime, compaction.level, sources<br>promtool tsdb list /prometheus       # block'lar va hajmlari</pre><p>Kuzatish:</p><pre>rate(prometheus_tsdb_compactions_failed_total[1h]) &gt; 0<br>prometheus_tsdb_compaction_duration_seconds_sum</pre><p>Thanos/Mimir sidecar bilan ishlaganda lokal compaction o'chiriladi (<code>--storage.tsdb.min-block-duration=2h --storage.tsdb.max-block-duration=2h</code>), compaction object storage'da (Thanos Compactor / Mimir compactor) qilinadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Compaction vaqtida vaqtinchalik qo'shimcha disk kerak — disk deyarli to'la bo'lsa compaction fail bo'ladi va block'lar to'planadi.</li><li>Admin API bilan series o'chirish (<code>delete_series</code>) darhol joy bo'shatmaydi — faqat tombstone; <code>clean_tombstones</code> yoki compaction kerak.</li><li>Sidecar bilan lokal compaction'ni o'chirmaslik — Thanos block'larni noto'g'ri yuklaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Disk hajmini rejalashtirishda formula: <code>retention_soniya x sample/s x ~1-2 bayt</code> + compaction uchun ~zaxira. <code>prometheus_tsdb_compactions_failed_total</code> va disk bo'sh joyiga alert — jim buzilgan compaction oxir-oqibat Prometheus'ni to'xtatadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41692	<p>Prometheus head block va persistent block farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Head block</b> — Prometheus'ning xotiradagi faol qismi: oxirgi ~2-3 soatlik sample'lar shu yerga yoziladi, yozish mumkin, WAL bilan himoyalangan (crash'da replay) va to'ldirilgan chunk'lar <code>chunks_head/</code> ga mmap qilinadi. <b>Persistent block</b> — head'dan &quot;kesilgan&quot; 2 soatlik (keyin compaction bilan kattalashgan) diskdagi <b>o'zgarmas</b> (immutable) block: <code>chunks/</code>, <code>index</code>, <code>meta.json</code>, <code>tombstones</code>.</p><pre>              YOZISH                               O'QISH<br>scrape -&gt; [WAL] -&gt; [HEAD block: RAM + chunks_head mmap]  &lt;- so'nggi ma'lumot<br>                          | har ~2h (head 3h bo'lganda eng eski 2h kesiladi)<br>                          v<br>               [block 2h] [block 2h] ... [block 18h]     &lt;- disk, immutable, compaction</pre><p>| | Head block | Persistent block | |---|---|---| | Joy | RAM (+ mmap chunk'lar) | disk | | O'zgaruvchanlik | yoziladi | o'zgarmas | | Himoya | WAL | o'zi faylda | | Xotira sarfi | faol series soniga proporsional | asosan page cache |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>prometheus_tsdb_head_series          # faol series (RAM'ning asosiy omili)<br>prometheus_tsdb_head_chunks<br>rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total[5m])<br>prometheus_tsdb_head_min_time / prometheus_tsdb_head_max_time</pre><p>UI: Status -&gt; TSDB Status — head statistikasi va eng ko'p series'li metrikalar.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prometheus RAM'i &quot;ma'lumot hajmi&quot; emas, head series soni bilan o'sadi — cardinality portlashi = OOM.</li><li>Pod churn (har deploy'da yangi pod label'i) — eski series'lar head'dan 2-3 soatgacha chiqmaydi, xotira vaqtincha ikki baravar.</li><li>Out-of-order sample'lar head vaqt oynasidan tashqarida rad etiladi (<code>out_of_order_time_window</code> sozlamasi yoqilmagan bo'lsa).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xotira rejalashtirish uchun qo'pol qoida: faol series boshiga bir necha KB (label uzunligiga bog'liq). Restart vaqti WAL replay'ga bog'liq — head snapshot (<code>--enable-feature=memory-snapshot-on-shutdown</code>) restart'ni tezlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41693	<p>Alertmanager silence nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Silence — Alertmanager'da label matcher'lar bilan berilgan vaqt oralig'ida mos keluvchi alert'larning <b>xabarnomalarini</b> o'chirish. Alert'lar baholanishda va UI'da ko'rinishda davom etadi, faqat receiver'larga yuborilmaydi. Rejali texnik ish (maintenance), ma'lum va ustida ishlanayotgan muammo yoki shovqinli alert vaqtincha tuzatilguncha ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>amtool silence add alertname=HighLatency service=payment \<br>  --duration=2h --author=&quot;ali&quot; --comment=&quot;DB migratsiyasi, JIRA OPS-123&quot;<br>amtool silence query<br>amtool silence query -o extended service=payment<br>amtool silence expire &lt;silence-id&gt;        # muddatidan oldin tugatish</pre><p>UI: Alertmanager -&gt; Silences -&gt; New Silence (yoki Grafana'dan). Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41700	<p>Observability'da eBPF kernel probing nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> eBPF — kernel ichida xavfsiz (verifier tekshirgan, sandbox) kichik dasturlarni hodisalarga biriktirib ishga tushirish texnologiyasi: <b>kprobe/kretprobe</b> (ixtiyoriy kernel funksiyasi kirish/chiqishi), <b>tracepoint</b> (barqaror kernel hook'lari), <b>uprobe</b> (user-space funksiyalar), <b>fentry/fexit</b>, socket/XDP/TC hook'lari. Observability'da kodni o'zgartirmasdan, kernel modul yozmasdan va past overhead bilan syscall latency, TCP retransmit, paket drop, disk I/O, CPU profil, HTTP/gRPC so'rovlarini kuzatish uchun ishlatiladi.</p><pre>user: bpftrace / Cilium / Pyroscope / Pixie / Beyla<br>         | eBPF bytecode yuklash (bpf syscall)<br>kernel:  verifier -&gt; JIT -&gt; hook'larga biriktirish (tracepoint, kprobe, uprobe)<br>         hodisa -&gt; eBPF dastur -&gt; BPF map / ring buffer -&gt; user-space agent -&gt; metrika/trace</pre><p><b>Amalda (bpftrace):</b></p><pre># Qaysi process qaysi fayllarni ochmoqda<br>bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_openat { printf(&quot;%s %s\n&quot;, comm, str(args-&gt;filename)); }'<br># Block I/O latency gistogrammasi<br>bpftrace -e 'kprobe:blk_account_io_start { @s[arg0]=nsecs; }<br>  kprobe:blk_account_io_done /@s[arg0]/ { @us=hist((nsecs-@s[arg0])/1000); delete(@s[arg0]); }'<br># Tayyor tool'lar (bcc / libbpf-tools)<br>tcpretrans          # TCP retransmit'lar<br>biolatency          # disk latency<br>execsnoop           # yangi process'lar</pre><p>Production tool'lar: Cilium/Hubble (tarmoq), Pyroscope/Parca (profil), Grafana Beyla / OTel eBPF (HTTP/gRPC auto-instrumentation), Falco/Tetragon (xavfsizlik).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>kprobe'lar kernel ichki funksiyalariga bog'liq — kernel versiyasi o'zgarsa buziladi; tracepoint va CO-RE (BTF) barqarorroq.</li><li>Juda issiq yo'lga (har paket, har syscall) og'ir dastur — overhead sezilarli bo'ladi.</li><li>eBPF yuklash uchun yuqori huquq (<code>CAP_BPF</code>, <code>CAP_PERFMON</code>, ko'pincha privileged) — agent'lar xavfsizlik nuqtai nazaridan kritik.</li><li>TLS ichidagi ma'lumot faqat kutubxona uprobe'lari (OpenSSL) orqali — har til/kutubxona uchun alohida.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> eBPF &quot;instrumentatsiya qilinmagan&quot; tizimlarga darhol ko'rinish beradi, lekin biznes kontekstini (tenant, order) bilmaydi — u SDK instrumentatsiyasini to'ldiradi, almashtirmaydi. Kernel versiyasi va BTF mavjudligi platforma talablari ro'yxatida bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus

U Alertmanager orqali tashqi &quot;heartbeat&quot; servisiga (Dead Man's Snitch, Healthchecks.io, PagerDuty/Opsgenie heartbeat, Grafana OnCall) har bir necha daqiqada yuboriladi. Xabar kelmay qolsa, tashqi servis page qiladi: demak Prometheus, rule evaluation, Alertmanager yoki tarmoq zanjiridagi biror bo'g'in o'lgan — boshqa hech qanday alert ham kelmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Monitoring o'zi yiqilsa — sukunat. Sukunatni &quot;hammasi yaxshi&quot; deb tushunish eng xavfli holat.</p><pre>Prometheus (Watchdog vector(1)) -&gt; Alertmanager -&gt; heartbeat servis (har 1 daq ping)<br>     X yiqildi                                           |<br>                                         5 daq ping yo'q -&gt; PAGE: &quot;monitoring o'lik&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Prometheus rule<br>- alert: Watchdog<br>  expr: vector(1)<br>  labels: { severity: none }<br>  annotations:<br>    summary: &quot;Alerting pipeline ishlayotganini tasdiqlovchi alert&quot;<br># Alertmanager<br>route:<br>  routes:<br>    - matchers: [alertname=&quot;Watchdog&quot;]<br>      receiver: heartbeat<br>      group_wait: 0s<br>      group_interval: 1m<br>      repeat_interval: 1m        # tez-tez qayta yuborish kerak<br>receivers:<br>  - name: heartbeat<br>    webhook_configs: [{ url: &quot;https://hc-ping.com/&lt;uuid&gt;&quot; }]</pre><p>kube-prometheus-stack bu alert'ni default bilan beradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Heartbeat servisini monitoring bilan bir xil klaster/region'da joylashtirish — birga o'ladi; tashqi bo'lsin.</li><li><code>repeat_interval</code> default (4h) — o'lim faqat soatlar o'tib bilinadi.</li><li>Watchdog'ni Slack kanaliga yuborish — shovqin; maxsus receiver'ga.</li><li>Inhibition qoidasi Watchdog'ni tasodifan o'chirib qo'yadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Kim kuzatuvchini kuzatadi?&quot; — har monitoring qatlami (Prometheus, Alertmanager, log pipeline, synthetic) uchun mustaqil heartbeat bo'lsin. Har chorakda alert zanjirini end-to-end test (sinov alert -&gt; page) qilish ham shu tamoyildan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41702	<p>Grafana Agent / Grafana Alloy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Grafana Agent — Grafana Labs'ning metrika, log va trace yig'uvchi agenti edi; 2024-yilda <b>deprecated</b> bo'ldi va EOL (2025-yil noyabr) e'lon qilindi. Uning vorisi <b>Grafana Alloy</b> — OpenTelemetry Collector'ning Grafana distributsiyasi bo'lib, Prometheus komponentlarini ham o'z ichiga oladi: metrika, log, trace va profillarni bitta binary'da yig'adi, qayta ishlaydi va yuboradi. Konfiguratsiya tili — komponentlarni bir-biriga ulaydigan deklarativ &quot;Alloy syntax&quot; (avvalgi River).</p><pre>[discovery.kubernetes] -&gt; [prometheus.scrape] -&gt; [prometheus.remote_write] -&gt; Mimir<br>[loki.source.kubernetes] -&gt; [loki.process] -&gt; [loki.write] -&gt; Loki<br>[otelcol.receiver.otlp] -&gt; [otelcol.processor.batch] -&gt; [otelcol.exporter.otlp] -&gt; Tempo<br>[pyroscope.ebpf] -&gt; [pyroscope.write] -&gt; Pyroscope</pre><p><b>Amalda (<code>config.alloy</code>):</b></p><pre>discovery.kubernetes &quot;pods&quot; { role = &quot;pod&quot; }<br><br>prometheus.scrape &quot;pods&quot; {<br>  targets    = discovery.kubernetes.pods.targets<br>  forward_to = [prometheus.remote_write.mimir.receiver]<br>}<br><br>prometheus.remote_write &quot;mimir&quot; {<br>  endpoint { url = &quot;http://mimir/api/v1/push&quot; }<br>}</pre><pre>alloy convert --source-format=static --output=config.alloy agent.yaml   # Agent'dan migratsiya<br>alloy run config.alloy        # UI :12345 da komponent grafi va holati</pre><p>Helm: <code>grafana/alloy</code> chart yoki <code>k8s-monitoring</code> chart.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yangi o'rnatishda Grafana Agent (static/flow) tanlash — qo'llab-quvvatlanmaydi.</li><li>Uch alohida agent (Promtail, node_exporter, OTel Collector) o'rniga Alloy'ni tanlab, lekin bitta DaemonSet'ga hamma yuklamani yuklash — resurs limitlarini o'lchang.</li><li>Promtail ham deprecated (Alloy'ga o'tish tavsiya qilinadi).</li><li>Alloy syntax YAML emas — CI'da <code>alloy fmt</code> bilan tekshiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Alloy vs sof OTel Collector: Grafana stack (LGTM) bo'lsa Alloy qulay va Prometheus-native; vendor-neytrallik muhim bo'lsa upstream OTel Collector. Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41703	<p>Span context nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Span context — span'ning process chegaralari orqali uzatiladigan <b>o'zgarmas identifikatsiya qismi</b>: <code>TraceID</code> (16 bayt), <code>SpanID</code> (8 bayt), <code>TraceFlags</code> (masalan sampled bit), <code>TraceState</code> (vendor ma'lumoti) va <code>IsRemote</code> belgisi. Span'ning qolgan qismi (nom, atributlar, event'lar, vaqtlar) process ichida qoladi va eksport qilinadi; tarmoq bo'ylab faqat context ketadi — u keyingi servisda yangi span'ning <b>parent</b>i bo'ladi.</p><pre>Service A:  Span{ name, attrs, events, start/end }   &lt;- eksport -&gt; backend<br>              |<br>              SpanContext{TraceID=T, SpanID=S1, Flags=01}<br>              |  inject -&gt; traceparent: 00-T-S1-01<br>              v<br>Service B:  extract -&gt; remote parent SpanContext{T, S1}<br>            yangi Span{TraceID=T, SpanID=S2, parent=S1}</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>sc := trace.SpanContextFromContext(ctx)<br>if sc.IsValid() {<br>    logger.Info(&quot;charge&quot;, &quot;trace_id&quot;, sc.TraceID().String(), &quot;span_id&quot;, sc.SpanID().String())<br>}<br>sampled := sc.IsSampled()<br><br>// Manual propagation (masalan Kafka header)<br>carrier := propagation.MapCarrier{}<br>otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Inject(ctx, carrier)        // carrier -&gt; xabar header'lari<br>ctx = otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Extract(ctx, carrier) // consumer tomonda</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Context'ni <code>context.Background()</code> bilan almashtirib yuborish (goroutine, worker pool) — bog'lanish uziladi.</li><li>Span context o'zgarmas — atribut qo'shish uchun span'ning o'zi kerak, context emas.</li><li>Sampled flag'ga qaramasdan log'ga trace_id yozish ham foydali — lekin trace backend'da bo'lmasligi mumkinligini bilish kerak.</li><li>Async xabarlarda context'ni header'ga inject qilmaslik — consumer'da yangi trace.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Span context — signallarni bog'lovchi &quot;kalit&quot;: log'larga trace_id/span_id, metrikalarga exemplar sifatida qo'shilganda butun observability bitta grafga aylanadi. Propagation'ni kutubxona/middleware darajasida standartlashtiring, har dasturchi qo'lda qilmasin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41704	<p>Loki log stream nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Loki log stream — <b>aynan bir xil label to'plamiga</b> ega log qatorlarining vaqt bo'yicha tartiblangan ketma-ketligi. <code>{app=&quot;api&quot;, namespace=&quot;prod&quot;, pod=&quot;api-7f9&quot;}</code> bitta stream; bitta label qiymati farq qilsa — boshqa stream. Loki indeksida faqat stream'lar (label to'plamlari) saqlanadi; har stream qatorlari siqilgan <b>chunk</b>'larga yig'ilib object storage'ga yoziladi.</p><pre>{app=&quot;api&quot;,ns=&quot;prod&quot;,level=&quot;info&quot;}  -&gt; chunk1 -&gt; chunk2 -&gt; ...   (S3)<br>{app=&quot;api&quot;,ns=&quot;prod&quot;,level=&quot;error&quot;} -&gt; chunk1 -&gt; ...<br>{app=&quot;web&quot;,ns=&quot;prod&quot;,level=&quot;info&quot;}  -&gt; chunk1 -&gt; ...<br>index: label to'plami -&gt; chunk'lar ro'yxati (kichik)<br>stream soni = label qiymatlari kombinatsiyasi = cardinality</pre><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Har faol stream ingester xotirasida o'z chunk'ini ushlaydi. Ko'p mayda stream'lar = ko'p kichik chunk'lar, katta index, sekin so'rov va ingester OOM. Kam, lekin &quot;qalin&quot; stream'lar Loki uchun ideal.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{namespace=&quot;prod&quot;, app=&quot;api&quot;} |= &quot;error&quot;          # stream selector -&gt; keyin filter</pre><p>Stream statistikasini ko'rish:</p><pre>logcli series '{namespace=&quot;prod&quot;}' --analyze-labels   # qaysi label nechta qiymat yaratmoqda</pre><p>Yaxshi label'lar: <code>namespace</code>, <code>app</code>/<code>service</code>, <code>env</code>, <code>cluster</code>, (ehtimol) <code>level</code>. Yomon: <code>user_id</code>, <code>trace_id</code>, <code>request_id</code>, <code>ip</code> — ular log matnida yoki <b>structured metadata</b> (Loki 3.x) da qolsin.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yuqori cardinality label — <code>stream limit exceeded</code>, <code>per_stream_rate_limit</code> xatolari va ingest rad etilishi.</li><li>Bitta stream'ga juda katta hajm — per-stream rate limit; ba'zan stream'ni tabiiy label bilan bo'lish kerak.</li><li>Bir stream ichida vaqt tartibi buzilishi (eski versiyalarda out-of-order rad etilgan; hozir cheklangan oyna ruxsat).</li><li>Dinamik label'lar (pod nomi) — har deploy'da yangi stream'lar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Loki dizaynining asosiy qoidasi: label'lar — &quot;qayerdan keldi&quot; (topologiya), matn — &quot;nima bo'ldi&quot;. Shu qoidaga amal qilish Loki narxi va tezligini Elasticsearch'dan ham yaxshiroq qiladi; buzish esa uni ishlamaydigan holatga keltiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41705	<p>OTel auto-instrumentation va manual instrumentation farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Auto-instrumentation</b> — kodni o'zgartirmasdan telemetriya qo'shish: Java agent (bytecode manipulation, <code>-javaagent</code>), Python/Node.js monkey-patching, .NET profiler API, eBPF asosidagi (Go, kompilyatsiya qilingan tillar uchun — Grafana Beyla, OTel Go auto-instrumentation) va K8s OTel Operator annotation'lari. U HTTP server/client, DB driver, gRPC, Kafka kabi mashhur kutubxonalarni avtomatik span va metrikalar bilan qoplaydi. <b>Manual instrumentation</b> — dasturchi OTel API bilan o'zi span ochadi, biznes atributlari (<code>order.id</code>, <code>tenant.id</code>), custom metrikalar va event'lar qo'shadi.</p><p>| | Auto | Manual | |---|---|---| | Boshlash tezligi | daqiqalar | vaqt talab qiladi | | Qamrov | framework/kutubxona chegaralari | biznes mantiqi | | Kontekst | texnik (HTTP, SQL) | biznes (tenant, order, plan) | | Nazorat | kam, ba'zan ortiqcha span | to'liq | | Overhead | ba'zan yuqoriroq (agent) | boshqariladi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># K8s: OTel Operator bilan auto-instrumentation<br>metadata:<br>  annotations:<br>    instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/inject-java: &quot;true&quot;</pre><pre># Python<br>opentelemetry-instrument --service_name checkout python app.py</pre><p>Manual (Go) — auto span ichiga biznes span:</p><pre>ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, &quot;apply_discount&quot;)<br>span.SetAttributes(attribute.String(&quot;app.promo_code&quot;, code), attribute.Int(&quot;app.items&quot;, n))<br>defer span.End()</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat auto — trace'da &quot;POST /checkout 2s&quot; bor, lekin ichida nima sekinligi va qaysi mijoz ekani yo'q.</li><li>Auto + manual bir kutubxonani ikki marta instrumentatsiya qiladi — dublikat span'lar.</li><li>Java agent versiyasi va framework versiyasi mos emas — startup sekinlashadi yoki span'lar yo'q.</li><li>Go'da monkey-patching yo'q — kutubxona wrapper'lari (<code>otelhttp</code>, <code>otelsql</code>) yoki eBPF kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Strategiya: auto bilan tez keng qamrov (baseline), keyin kritik biznes oqimlariga (to'lov, checkout) manual span va atributlar. Platforma jamoasi auto-instrumentation'ni standart qiladi, mahsulot jamoalari esa biznes kontekstiga mas'ul.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus

Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41708	<p>Prometheus Pushgateway nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pushgateway — Prometheus pull modelini qo'llab-quvvatlay olmaydigan <b>qisqa yashovchi batch job</b>lar (cron, backup, ETL, CI job) uchun oraliq metrika ombori: job tugashidan oldin metrikalarini HTTP orqali Pushgateway'ga <b>push</b> qiladi, Prometheus esa Pushgateway'ni oddiy target kabi scrape qiladi. Pushgateway metrikalarni o'zi o'chirmaguningizcha <b>abadiy</b> saqlaydi.</p><pre>cron backup (30 s ishlaydi, scrape'gacha tugaydi)<br>     | POST /metrics/job/backup/instance/db01<br>     v<br>[Pushgateway] &lt;--scrape (honor_labels: true)-- [Prometheus]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat &lt;&lt;EOF | curl --data-binary @- http://pushgateway:9091/metrics/job/db_backup/instance/db01<br># TYPE backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds gauge<br>backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds $(date +%s)<br># TYPE backup_duration_seconds gauge<br>backup_duration_seconds 312<br>EOF<br>curl -X DELETE http://pushgateway:9091/metrics/job/db_backup/instance/db01   # tozalash</pre><pre>scrape_configs:<br>  - job_name: pushgateway<br>    honor_labels: true          # push qilingan job/instance label'larini saqlash<br>    static_configs: [{ targets: [pushgateway:9091] }]</pre><p>To'g'ri alert — &quot;oxirgi muvaffaqiyat qachon edi&quot;:</p><pre>time() - backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds &gt; 26 * 3600</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Doimiy servislarni Pushgateway orqali monitoring qilish — servis o'lsa ham oxirgi qiymat abadiy turadi, <code>up</code> signali yo'qoladi.</li><li>Har job'ni unikal <code>instance</code> (masalan pod nomi) bilan push qilish — eski guruhlar to'planib qoladi (cardinality, eskirgan ma'lumot).</li><li><code>honor_labels: true</code> siz — job label'i <code>pushgateway</code> bo'lib qoladi.</li><li>Pushgateway — single point of failure va HA'siz; uni counter yig'uvchi (agregator) deb o'ylash noto'g'ri — u har push'da guruhni almashtiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pushgateway'ni faqat &quot;service-level batch job&quot; uchun ishlating. Alternativalar: node_exporter textfile collector (host'dagi cron uchun), Prometheus agent/OTel orqali remote write, yoki job'ni uzoq yashovchi worker'ga aylantirish. Batch job'larda eng muhim metrika — oxirgi muvaffaqiyat vaqti.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41709	<p>Grafana variables (template so'rovlar) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Grafana variables (template variables) — dashboard tepasidagi dropdown/maydonlar: qiymati so'rovlarga <code>$var</code> sifatida qo'yiladi. Bitta dashboard'ni turli klaster, namespace, servis, pod yoki region uchun qayta ishlatish imkonini beradi — har servisga alohida dashboard nusxasi kerak emas. Turlari: <b>query</b> (data source'dan dinamik ro'yxat), custom, constant, interval, data source, text box, ad hoc filters.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b> Query variable'lar (Prometheus), zanjir bo'lib:</p><pre>cluster    = label_values(up, cluster)<br>namespace  = label_values(kube_pod_info{cluster=&quot;$cluster&quot;}, namespace)<br>pod        = label_values(kube_pod_info{cluster=&quot;$cluster&quot;, namespace=&quot;$namespace&quot;}, pod)</pre><p>Panel so'rovi:</p><pre>sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=&quot;$cluster&quot;, namespace=&quot;$namespace&quot;, pod=~&quot;$pod&quot;}[$__rate_interval]))</pre><p>Multi-value / &quot;All&quot; tanlanganda <code>$pod</code> regex sifatida (<code>a|b|c</code>) qo'yiladi — shuning uchun <code>=~</code> ishlatiladi. Foydali o'rnatilgan o'zgaruvchilar: <code>$__rate_interval</code>, <code>$__interval</code>, <code>$__range</code>. Data source variable (<code>$datasource</code>) bilan bir dashboard turli Prometheus'larda ishlaydi. URL'da <code>?var-namespace=prod</code> — tayyor havola (alert'dan dashboard'ga).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Multi-value variable bilan <code>=</code> operatori — &quot;All&quot; tanlanganda so'rov bo'sh.</li><li><code>label_values(metric_name, label)</code> ni filtrsiz katta metrika ustida — dashboard ochilishi sekin (har yuklanishda qayta so'raladi; &quot;Refresh: on time range change&quot; ni o'ylab tanlang).</li><li>Juda ko'p qiymatli (minglab pod) &quot;All&quot; — so'rov regex'i ulkan bo'lib, Prometheus'ni yuklaydi.</li><li>Repeat panel/row'lar &quot;All&quot; bilan — yuzlab panel generatsiya qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yaxshi dashboard dizayni: yuqorida <code>datasource -&gt; cluster -&gt; namespace -&gt; service</code> zanjiri, panellar shu o'zgaruvchilarga bog'liq; alert annotation'larida esa shu parametrlar bilan dashboard havolasi. Bu on-call'ni alert'dan kerakli kontekstga bir bosishda olib boradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::obs sec::h26 Observability_Prometheus
Interview Drill::Observability::H26 Observability & Prometheus	idrill-41710	<p>OTel Collector memory_limiter processor nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>memory_limiter</code> — OTel Collector processor'i: Collector xotirasini muntazam (<code>check_interval</code>) tekshiradi; <b>soft limit</b>dan oshsa yangi ma'lumotni rad etadi (receiver'ga xato qaytaradi — yuboruvchi retry/backpressure qiladi), <b>hard limit</b>dan oshsa qo'shimcha ravishda GC'ni majburlaydi. Maqsad — trafik portlashida Collector OOM bo'lib, butun buffer'dagi ma'lumot bilan birga o'lmasligi. Pipeline'da <b>birinchi</b> processor bo'lishi kerak — qolgan processor'lar xotira sarflashidan oldin cheklash uchun.</p><pre>receiver -&gt; [memory_limiter] -&gt; k8sattributes -&gt; tail_sampling -&gt; batch -&gt; exporter<br>                 |<br>     xotira &gt; soft (limit - spike):  yangi ma'lumot RAD (receiver 503/ResourceExhausted)<br>     xotira &gt; hard (limit):          + majburiy GC<br>     yuboruvchi SDK/agent: retry with backoff, o'z queue'sida ushlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>processors:<br>  memory_limiter:<br>    check_interval: 1s<br>    limit_percentage: 80          # container memory limit'ining 80% i (hard)<br>    spike_limit_percentage: 20    # soft = 80% - 20% = 60%<br>service:<br>  pipelines:<br>    traces:<br>      receivers: [otlp]<br>      processors: [memory_limiter, batch]<br>      exporters: [otlp]</pre><p>K8s'da <code>resources.limits.memory</code> ni bering (foiz shundan hisoblanadi) va Go runtime'ga mos <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> (masalan limit'ning ~80%) qo'ying. Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41711	<p>PromQL'da error rate foizini qanday hisoblaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Error rate = <b>xatoli so'rovlar tezligi / barcha so'rovlar tezligi</b>. Ikkalasi ham counter, shuning uchun avval <code>rate()</code> bilan &quot;sekundiga nechta&quot; ga aylantiriladi, keyin bo'linadi.</p><h4>So'rov</h4><pre>sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>/<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br>* 100</pre><h4>Qatorma-qator</h4><ol><li><code>http_requests_total</code> — <b>counter</b>: faqat o'sadi (restart'da 0 ga tushadi). Uning xom qiymati (masalan 1 234 567) foydasiz — bizga o'zgarish tezligi kerak.</li><li><code>rate(...[5m])</code> — oxirgi 5 daqiqada sekundiga o'rtacha nechta so'rov. Counter reset'ni o'zi to'g'ri hisoblaydi.</li><li><code>{status=~&quot;5..&quot;}</code> — regex: 500-599 kodlar. 4xx odatda <b>client xatosi</b> — servis aybi emas, SLO'ga qo'shilmaydi.</li><li><code>sum(...)</code> — barcha pod/instance'lar bo'yicha yig'ish. <code>sum</code>siz har pod alohida chiqadi va bo'linishda label'lar mos kelmasa natija bo'sh bo'ladi.</li><li>Bo'lish va <code>* 100</code> — foiz.</li></ol><h4>Servis bo'yicha</h4><pre>sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>/<br>sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))</pre><p>Ikkala tomonda <b>bir xil</b> <code>by (...)</code> bo'lishi shart — aks holda label'lar mos kelmaydi.</p><h4>Alert misoli</h4><pre>- alert: HighErrorRate<br>  expr: |<br>    sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>    / sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m])) &gt; 0.05<br>  for: 10m</pre><p><code>for: 10m</code> — qisqa sakrashda alert chiqmasin.</p><h4>Tuzoqlar</h4><ul><li>Trafik juda kam (kechasi 2 so'rov, 1 tasi xato) — 50% error rate, yolg'on alert. Yechim: minimal trafik sharti qo'shish (<code>and sum(rate(...)) &gt; 1</code>).</li><li>Trafik 0 bo'lsa — 0/0 = <code>NaN</code>, alert ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>rate()</code> oynasi scrape interval'dan kamida 4x katta bo'lsin (15s scrape — <code>[1m]</code>+).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production'da bu so'rov <b>recording rule</b> sifatida oldindan hisoblanadi (<code>job:http_errors:ratio_rate5m</code>) va SLO uchun bir nechta oynada (5m, 1h, 6h) <b>multi-window burn-rate</b> alert'lari quriladi — oddiy threshold'dan ancha kam shovqin beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41712	<p>Kubernetes'da container CPU foizini (limit'ga nisbatan) PromQL bilan qanday hisoblaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container ishlatgan CPU tezligini uning <b>CPU limiti</b>ga bo'lamiz. Ishlatish — cAdvisor metrikasi (<code>container_cpu_usage_seconds_total</code>), limit — kube-state-metrics metrikasi (<code>kube_pod_container_resource_limits</code>).</p><h4>So'rov</h4><pre>sum by (namespace, pod) (<br>  rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!=&quot;&quot;, container!=&quot;POD&quot;}[5m])<br>)<br>/<br>sum by (namespace, pod) (<br>  kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource=&quot;cpu&quot;}<br>)<br>* 100</pre><h4>Qatorma-qator</h4><ol><li><code>container_cpu_usage_seconds_total</code> — container ishlatgan <b>CPU-sekundlar</b> counter'i. <code>rate()</code> dan keyin u &quot;<b>nechta yadro</b> ishlatilyapti&quot; degan son bo'ladi: <code>0.5</code> = yarim yadro.</li><li><code>container!=&quot;&quot;</code> — pod darajasidagi umumiy (agregat) qatorni chiqarib tashlaydi, aks holda ikki marta sanaladi.</li><li><code>container!=&quot;POD&quot;</code> — &quot;pause&quot; container (pod'ning tarmoq namespace'ini ushlab turuvchi) — keraksiz.</li><li><code>kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource=&quot;cpu&quot;}</code> — limit <b>yadrolarda</b> (<code>500m</code> = <code>0.5</code>).</li><li>Ikkala tomon <code>by (namespace, pod)</code> — label'lar mos kelishi uchun. Ikki xil manba (cAdvisor va kube-state-metrics) bo'lgani uchun boshqa label'lar (<code>instance</code>, <code>job</code>) farq qiladi — <code>sum by</code> ularni olib tashlaydi.</li></ol><p>Natija 100% ga yaqin — container limitga urilyapti, <b>throttling</b> boshlanadi.</p><h4>Limit yo'q bo'lsa</h4><p>Limitsiz pod'larda o'ng tomon bo'sh — natijada ular umuman ko'rinmaydi. Request'ga nisbatan hisoblash:</p><pre>... / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource=&quot;cpu&quot;}) * 100</pre><p>Request'ga nisbatan 100% dan oshishi normal (limit yo'q, bo'sh CPU'ni ishlatyapti).</p><h4>Throttling'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'lchash</h4><p>O'rtacha CPU 60% bo'lsa ham throttling bo'lishi mumkin (qisqa burst'lar). Aniqroq:</p><pre>sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m]))<br>/ sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m]))</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CPU % o'zi yolg'iz kam ma'no beradi — latency'ga ta'sir qiladigan narsa <b>throttling</b>. Dashboard'da ikkalasini yonma-yon qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41713	<p>PromQL'da <code>increase()</code> va <code>rate()</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham counter'ning oyna ichidagi o'sishini hisoblaydi. <code>rate()</code> — <b>sekundiga</b> o'rtacha o'sish (tezlik). <code>increase()</code> — oyna davomida <b>jami</b> o'sish. Aslida <code>increase(x[1h]) = rate(x[1h]) * 3600</code>.</p><h4>Misol</h4><p><code>http_requests_total</code> 1 soat ichida 36 000 ga o'sdi:</p><ul><li><code>rate(http_requests_total[1h])</code> = <b>10</b> (sekundiga 10 so'rov)</li><li><code>increase(http_requests_total[1h])</code> = <b>36 000</b> (soatda jami)</li></ul><h4>Qachon qaysi</h4><ul><li><b><code>rate()</code></b> — grafiklar, alert'lar, nisbatlar (error rate, RPS). Oyna o'lchami o'zgarsa ham qiymat bir xil ma'noda — taqqoslash oson.</li><li><b><code>increase()</code></b> — odam o'qiydigan &quot;jami&quot; son: &quot;oxirgi 24 soatda nechta buyurtma&quot;, &quot;bugun nechta xato&quot;.</li></ul><h4>Nega <code>increase()</code> butun son bermaydi</h4><p>Counter butun son bo'lsa ham, <code>increase()</code> <code>10.5</code> kabi qaytarishi mumkin. Sabab — <b>ekstrapolyatsiya</b>: scrape'lar oyna chegarasiga aniq to'g'ri kelmaydi (masalan 1 soatlik oynada birinchi namuna 14s kech). Prometheus mavjud namunalar orasidagi o'sishni butun oynaga cho'zadi. Bu xato emas — statistik baho.</p><h4>Counter reset</h4><p>Ikkalasi ham restart'ni (counter 0 ga tushishi) to'g'ri qayta ishlaydi: kamayishni &quot;reset&quot; deb tushunadi va qo'shib hisoblaydi. Shuning uchun counter'ga hech qachon oddiy ayirish (<code>x - x offset 1h</code>) ishlatmang.</p><h4><code>irate()</code> — uchinchisi</h4><p><code>irate()</code> faqat oxirgi <b>ikki</b> namuna bo'yicha — juda &quot;asabiy&quot;, tez o'zgarishlarni ko'rsatadi. Alert va recording rule uchun emas, faqat zoom qilingan grafik uchun.</p><h4>Muhim qoida</h4><p>Avval <code>rate</code>, keyin <code>sum</code>:</p><pre>sum(rate(x[5m]))     # TO'G'RI<br>rate(sum(x)[5m])     # NOTO'G'RI — sum reset'larni yashiradi</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Oyna kamida 4 ta scrape'ni qamrab olishi kerak (15s scrape = <code>[1m]</code> minimum). Juda kichik oynada namuna yetmaydi va grafik &quot;teshik&quot; bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41714	<p>PromQL vector matching (<code>on()</code>, <code>ignoring()</code>, <code>group_left()</code>, <code>group_right()</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PromQL'da ikki vektor ustida arifmetika (<code>/</code>, <code>*</code>, <code>+</code>) qilinganda Prometheus qatorlarni <b>label'lari bir xil</b> bo'yicha juftlaydi. Label'lar to'liq mos kelmasa natija bo'sh. Vector matching kalit so'zlari qaysi label'lar bo'yicha moslashni va &quot;bittaga ko'p&quot; munosabatni boshqaradi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><pre>container_memory_usage_bytes / kube_pod_container_resource_limits</pre><p>Natija bo'sh — chunki chapda <code>instance=&quot;node1:10250&quot;, job=&quot;kubelet&quot;</code>, o'ngda <code>instance=&quot;ksm:8080&quot;, job=&quot;kube-state-metrics&quot;</code>. Label to'plamlari farq qiladi.</p><h4><code>on()</code> va <code>ignoring()</code> — qaysi label'lar bo'yicha</h4><pre>a / on(namespace, pod) b          # FAQAT shu label'lar bo'yicha juftla<br>a / ignoring(instance, job) b     # shu label'lardan TASHQARI hammasi bo'yicha</pre><h4><code>group_left</code> / <code>group_right</code> — bittaga ko'p</h4><p>Default — <b>bittaga bitta</b>. Bir tomonda bir xil kalit uchun bir nechta qator bo'lsa xato: <code>many-to-many matching not allowed</code>.</p><ul><li><code>group_left</code> — <b>chap</b> tomonda ko'p qator, o'ngda bitta.</li><li><code>group_right</code> — teskari.</li></ul><h4>Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan holat — label qo'shish</h4><p>Metrikada <code>node</code> label'i yo'q, lekin uni ko'rsatish kerak. <code>kube_pod_info</code> da bor (qiymati doim <code>1</code>):</p><pre>sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m]))<br>* on(namespace, pod) group_left(node)<br>kube_pod_info</pre><ul><li><code>on(namespace, pod)</code> — pod bo'yicha juftlash.</li><li><code>group_left(node)</code> — chapdagi har qatorga o'ngdan <code>node</code> label'ini <b>ko'chirib</b> qo'yish.</li><li><code>* 1</code> — qiymat o'zgarmaydi, faqat label qo'shiladi.</li></ul><p>Bu &quot;info metric&quot; pattern: deploy versiyasi (<code>app_build_info</code>), node rollari va h.k. shu usulda qo'shiladi.</p><h4>Tez-tez xatolar</h4><ul><li><code>group_left</code> qo'yilgan, lekin o'ng tomonda ham bir kalitga ikki qator (pod restart'da eski va yangi <code>kube_pod_info</code>) — <code>duplicate series</code> xatosi. Yechim: o'ng tomonni <code>max by (...)</code> bilan bir qatorga tushirish.</li><li><code>on()</code> ga label'ni unutish — noto'g'ri juftlash yoki bo'sh natija.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bo'sh natija PromQL'da eng ko'p uchraydigan &quot;bug&quot;. Avval har ikki tomonni alohida ishga tushirib, label'larini solishtiring — sabab deyarli doim mos kelmagan label.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41715	<p>OTel Collector'da xatolarni ushlash uchun tail-based sampling qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tail-based sampling — trace <b>tugagandan keyin</b>, uning to'liq tarkibini ko'rib, saqlash yoki tashlashni hal qilish. Shuning uchun &quot;xatoli yoki sekin trace'larni 100%, qolganlarini 5% saqla&quot; degan qoida mumkin. Head-based sampling buni qila olmaydi — u trace boshida, natija noma'lum paytda qaror qiladi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>Sekundiga 50 000 span — hammasini saqlash juda qimmat. 1% random sampling qilsangiz, eng qiziq trace'lar (xatolar, sekinlar — juda kam) asosan <b>tashlanadi</b>.</p><h4>Sozlama</h4><pre>processors:<br>  tail_sampling:<br>    decision_wait: 10s              # trace'ning barcha span'larini shuncha kutish<br>    num_traces: 100000              # xotirada bir vaqtda ushlanadigan trace'lar<br>    expected_new_traces_per_sec: 2000<br>    policies:<br>      - name: errors<br>        type: status_code<br>        status_code: { status_codes: [ERROR] }<br>      - name: slow<br>        type: latency<br>        latency: { threshold_ms: 2000 }<br>      - name: baseline<br>        type: probabilistic<br>        probabilistic: { sampling_percentage: 5 }<br><br>service:<br>  pipelines:<br>    traces:<br>      receivers: [otlp]<br>      processors: [tail_sampling, batch]<br>      exporters: [otlp/tempo]</pre><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><ol><li>Span'lar keladi, Collector ularni trace ID bo'yicha xotirada guruhlaydi.</li><li>Birinchi span'dan <code>decision_wait</code> (10s) o'tgach — trace &quot;tugagan&quot; hisoblanadi.</li><li>Policy'lar tekshiriladi. <b>Birortasi</b> &quot;saqla&quot; desa — saqlanadi (OR mantiq).</li><li>Natija: hamma xatolar + hamma 2s+ trace'lar + qolganlardan 5%.</li></ol><h4>Muhim arxitektura talabi</h4><p>Bitta trace'ning <b>barcha</b> span'lari <b>bitta</b> Collector instance'ga kelishi shart — aks holda har instance trace'ning bir qismini ko'radi va noto'g'ri qaror qiladi. Yechim — ikki qatlam:</p><pre>servislar -&gt; Collector (1-qatlam, loadbalancing exporter, routing_key: traceID)<br>          -&gt; Collector (2-qatlam, tail_sampling) -&gt; Tempo/Jaeger</pre><h4>Narxi</h4><ul><li>Xotira: <code>decision_wait</code> x trace oqimi. 10s x 2000 trace/s = 20 000 trace xotirada.</li><li><code>decision_wait</code>dan kech kelgan span'lar yo'qoladi — uzoq async ishlar uchun oynani kattalashtiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'pincha ikkalasi birga: SDK'da yengil head sampling (masalan 50%) yukni kamaytiradi, Collector'da tail sampling qiymatli trace'larni tanlaydi. Saqlanmagan trace'lar uchun RED metrikalarni <b>sampling'dan oldin</b> (spanmetrics connector) hisoblang — aks holda metrikalar ham noto'g'ri bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41716	<p>OTel TraceIdRatioBased sampler nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>TraceIdRatioBased</code> — OpenTelemetry SDK'dagi <b>head-based</b> sampler: trace boshlanayotganda trace ID'ga qarab belgilangan foizni (masalan 10%) saqlaydi. Qaror <b>deterministik</b> — bir xil trace ID uchun har servis bir xil natija oladi. Odatda <code>ParentBased</code> bilan birga ishlatiladi.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><p>Trace ID — tasodifiy 128-bit son. Sampler uning bir qismini chegaraviy qiymat bilan solishtiradi:</p><pre>ratio = 0.1  -&gt; threshold = 0.1 x MAX<br>trace_id(past 8 bayt) &lt; threshold ? SAQLA : TASHLA</pre><p>Tasodifiy ID bo'lgani uchun ~10% saqlanadi. Lekin random son emas, ID'ning o'zi ishlatiladi — shuning uchun qayta hisoblansa ham natija o'zgarmaydi.</p><h4>Nega ParentBased kerak</h4><p>Trace 5 ta servisdan o'tadi. Har servis o'zi mustaqil 10% tanlasa — trace &quot;teshik&quot; bo'ladi (A saqladi, B tashladi). <code>ParentBased</code> qoidasi:</p><ul><li><b>Root span</b> (trace boshi) — <code>TraceIdRatioBased</code> qaror qiladi.</li><li><b>Child span</b> — ota span'ning qarorini oladi (<code>traceparent</code> header'idagi <code>sampled</code> flag).</li></ul><p>Natija: butun trace yo saqlanadi, yo tashlanadi.</p><h4>Sozlash</h4><p>Environment orqali (kod o'zgarmaydi):</p><pre>OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio<br>OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.1</pre><p>Go'da:</p><pre>sdktrace.WithSampler(sdktrace.ParentBased(sdktrace.TraceIDRatioBased(0.1)))</pre><h4>Afzalligi va kamchiligi</h4><ul><li><b>+</b> Arzon: tashlangan span'lar umuman yaratilmaydi/yuborilmaydi — SDK, tarmoq, Collector yuki kamayadi.</li><li><b>−</b> Ko'r qaror: trace boshida xato bo'lishi noma'lum. 0.1% xatolik bo'lsa, 10% sampling ularning 90%ini tashlaydi.</li></ul><p>Shuning uchun xatolarni ushlash uchun Collector'da <b>tail-based sampling</b> qo'shiladi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sampling metrikalarni buzadi: trace'lardan hisoblangan RPS 10x kam chiqadi. Metrikalarni trace'dan emas, alohida (Prometheus yoki sampling'dan oldingi spanmetrics) yig'ing.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41717	<p>Tempo'da trace-to-logs va logs-to-trace korrelyatsiyasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Korrelyatsiya — trace'dan bir bosishda shu so'rovning <b>log'lariga</b>, log'dan esa shu so'rovning <b>trace'iga</b> o'tish. Kalit — <b><code>traceId</code></b>: ilova uni har log qatoriga yozadi, Grafana esa data source'larni shu maydon orqali bog'laydi.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Incident: trace'da 3s kechikkan span ko'rindi — lekin <b>nega</b>? Sabab log'da (<code>retry 3/3</code>, <code>connection refused</code>). traceId'siz log'larni vaqt bo'yicha qidirasiz — ming qator ichidan.</p><h4>1-qadam: ilova log'iga traceId yozish (eng muhim)</h4><pre>{&quot;level&quot;:&quot;error&quot;,&quot;msg&quot;:&quot;db timeout&quot;,&quot;trace_id&quot;:&quot;4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736&quot;,&quot;span_id&quot;:&quot;00f067aa0ba902b7&quot;}</pre><p>OTel SDK log bridge yoki logger'ga context'dan trace ID olib qo'shish (Go: <code>trace.SpanFromContext(ctx).SpanContext().TraceID()</code>). Bu bo'lmasa, qolgan sozlamalar ishlamaydi.</p><h4>2-qadam: Logs -&gt; Trace (Loki data source)</h4><p>Grafana -&gt; Loki data source -&gt; <b>Derived fields</b>:</p><ul><li>Name: <code>TraceID</code></li><li>Regex: <code>&quot;trace_id&quot;:&quot;(\w+)&quot;</code></li><li>Internal link: Tempo data source, so'rov <code>${__value.raw}</code></li></ul><p>Natija: log qatori yonida &quot;Tempo&quot; tugmasi — bosilsa trace ochiladi.</p><h4>3-qadam: Trace -&gt; Logs (Tempo data source)</h4><p>Grafana -&gt; Tempo data source -&gt; <b>Trace to logs</b>:</p><ul><li>Data source: Loki</li><li>Tags: <code>service.name</code> -&gt; <code>app</code> (span atributini Loki label'iga moslash)</li><li>Filter by trace ID: yoqilgan</li><li>Vaqt oynasi: span vaqti ± bir necha soniya</li></ul><p>Natija: har span'da &quot;Logs for this span&quot; tugmasi.</p><h4>Bonus: metrics -&gt; trace (exemplars)</h4><p>Prometheus histogramma'ga namuna trace ID'sini biriktiradi. Latency grafigidagi nuqtani bossangiz — o'sha sekin so'rovning trace'i ochiladi. To'liq zanjir: <b>alert -&gt; metrika -&gt; exemplar -&gt; trace -&gt; log</b>.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Loki'da <code>trace_id</code>ni <b>label</b> qilmang — har so'rov yangi stream yaratadi (cardinality portlashi). U log matni ichida qolsin, qidiruv <code>|= &quot;trace_id&quot;</code> yoki structured metadata orqali.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41718	<p>Thanos Querier va Thanos Store Gateway farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Thanos — Prometheus'ni uzoq muddatli saqlash va global ko'rinishga kengaytiradi. <b>Querier</b> — foydalanuvchi so'rovini qabul qilib, hamma manbalardan ma'lumot yig'adigan <b>so'rov dvigateli</b>. <b>Store Gateway</b> — object storage'dagi (S3) <b>eski block'larni</b> o'qib beradigan manba. Querier &quot;so'raydi&quot;, Store Gateway — u so'raydigan manbalardan biri.</p><h4>Arxitektura</h4><pre>                    Grafana<br>                       |<br>                 Thanos Querier  (PromQL, dedup)<br>          _____________|______________<br>         |             |              |<br>   Sidecar(Prom A)  Sidecar(Prom B)  Store Gateway<br>   (oxirgi ~2 soat)  (HA juftlik)        |<br>         |                              S3 (oylar/yillar)<br>         +---- block'larni S3'ga yuklaydi ----^</pre><h4>Querier</h4><ul><li><b>Stateless</b> — ma'lumot saqlamaydi, gorizontal ko'paytiriladi.</li><li>Prometheus'ga o'xshash API beradi — Grafana uni oddiy Prometheus deb biladi.</li><li>So'rovni barcha <b>StoreAPI</b> manbalariga yuboradi: Sidecar, Store Gateway, Receive, Ruler.</li><li><b>Deduplikatsiya</b>: ikki Prometheus bir xil target'larni scrape qiladi (HA). <code>replica</code> label bo'yicha (<code>--query.replica-label=replica</code>) ikki nusxani bitta qatorga birlashtiradi — biri o'chsa grafikda teshik yo'q.</li></ul><h4>Store Gateway</h4><ul><li>S3/GCS'dagi block'lar uchun StoreAPI.</li><li>Block indekslarini (kichik qismini) lokal diskda/xotirada keshlaydi, ma'lumotni kerak bo'lganda S3'dan o'qiydi.</li><li>Deyarli stateless — lokal kesh o'chsa qayta yuklaydi.</li><li>Katta yuklamada sharding (<code>--selector.relabel-config</code>) bilan bo'linadi.</li></ul><h4>So'rov qanday bajariladi</h4><p>&quot;Oxirgi 30 kun&quot; so'rovi: oxirgi 2 soat Sidecar'lardan (Prometheus'ning lokal TSDB'si), qolgani Store Gateway orqali S3'dan. Querier natijalarni birlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Uzoq oynali so'rovlar Store Gateway'ni og'ir yuklaydi — <b>Query Frontend</b> (kesh + so'rovni vaqt bo'yicha bo'lish) va Compactor'ning downsampling'i shart. Aks holda &quot;1 yillik grafik&quot; Store Gateway'ni OOM qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41719	<p>Thanos Compactor nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Thanos Compactor — object storage'dagi (S3) block'lar ustida <b>xizmat ko'rsatuvchi fon jarayoni</b>. Uch ish qiladi: kichik block'larni kattaroqqa <b>birlashtiradi</b> (compaction), eski ma'lumot uchun past rezolyutsiyali nusxa yaratadi (<b>downsampling</b>), va muddati o'tgan ma'lumotni <b>o'chiradi</b> (retention). Butun bucket uchun <b>faqat bitta</b> instance ishlashi shart.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Prometheus har 2 soatda bitta block yuklaydi: yiliga <b>4 380</b> block, har Prometheus'dan. Bir yillik so'rov minglab kichik block indeksini o'qishi kerak — juda sekin.</p><h4>1. Compaction</h4><p>2 soatlik block'lar -&gt; 8 soatlik -&gt; 2 kunlik -&gt; 14 kunlik. Kamroq, kattaroq block = tezroq so'rov, kichikroq indeks. HA juftlik block'larini ham birlashtira oladi (vertical compaction).</p><h4>2. Downsampling</h4><p>| Ma'lumot yoshi | Rezolyutsiya | |---|---| | har qanday | raw (15s) | | 40 soatdan keyin | 5 daqiqa | | 10 kundan keyin | 1 soat | Bir yillik grafikda 15s nuqtalar (2 million nuqta) kerak emas — 1 soatlik (8 760 nuqta) yetarli va yuzlab marta tez. Querier oynaga qarab mos rezolyutsiyani avtomatik tanlaydi.</p><p><b>Muhim:</b> downsampling joyni <b>tejamaydi</b> — u qo'shimcha nusxalar yaratadi. Joy retention orqali tejaladi.</p><h4>3. Retention</h4><pre>thanos compact \<br>  --data-dir=/var/thanos/compact \<br>  --objstore.config-file=bucket.yml \<br>  --retention.resolution-raw=30d \<br>  --retention.resolution-5m=180d \<br>  --retention.resolution-1h=2y \<br>  --wait</pre><p>Ma'nosi: aniq ma'lumot 30 kun, o'rtacha 6 oy, trend 2 yil.</p><h4>Nega singleton</h4><p>Ikki Compactor bir vaqtda bir block'ni birlashtirsa — dublikat yoki buzilgan block. Shuning uchun <code>replicas: 1</code> (StatefulSet). U so'rov yo'lida emas — vaqtincha to'xtasa so'rovlar ishlayveradi, faqat sekinlashadi.</p><h4>Operatsion muammolar</h4><ul><li>Katta lokal disk kerak (block'larni yuklab birlashtiradi) — yuzlab GB.</li><li>Ko'p kun ishlamay qolsa — &quot;orqada qolish&quot; (backlog), compaction hech tugamaydi. Metrikasini (<code>thanos_compact_halted</code>) kuzating.</li><li>Bucket'da buzilgan block bo'lsa Compactor <b>to'xtaydi</b> (halt) — qo'lda <code>thanos tools bucket</code> bilan tuzatish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Raw retention'ni juda qisqa qilmang — <code>rate()[5m]</code> kabi so'rovlar downsampled ma'lumotda noto'g'ri natija beradi. Alert va SLO hisobi raw ma'lumot muddati ichida bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41720	<p>Mimir arxitekturasi (distributor, ingester, querier, compactor) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Grafana Mimir — Prometheus metrikalarini ko'p tenant'li, gorizontal kengayadigan, uzoq muddatli saqlovchi tizim. Yozish va o'qish yo'llari alohida komponentlarga bo'lingan: <b>Distributor</b> (qabul qiladi), <b>Ingester</b> (xotirada ushlab, S3'ga yozadi), <b>Querier</b> (so'rovga javob beradi), <b>Compactor</b> (S3'dagi block'larni tartiblaydi). Ma'lumot oxir-oqibat object storage'da yashaydi.</p><h4>Arxitektura</h4><pre>YOZISH:  Prometheus/Agent --remote_write--&gt; Distributor --(hash, x3 replika)--&gt; Ingester'lar<br>                                                                                    |<br>                                                                         (2 soatda block)<br>                                                                                    v<br>O'QISH:  Grafana -&gt; Query Frontend -&gt; Querier --(yangi)--&gt; Ingester'lar          S3<br>                                              --(eski)---&gt; Store Gateway -------^<br>                                                           Compactor ----------^</pre><h4>Distributor — kirish eshigi</h4><ul><li><b>Stateless</b>. <code>remote_write</code> so'rovlarini qabul qiladi.</li><li><b>Validatsiya</b>: label limiti, sample vaqti, tenant limitlari (sekundiga sample, series soni) — oshsa rad etadi (429).</li><li>Har series'ni label'lari <b>hash</b>i bo'yicha hash ring'dan aniqlangan <b>3 ta</b> ingester'ga yuboradi (replication factor 3). Ko'pchilik (2/3) tasdiqlasa — muvaffaqiyat.</li></ul><h4>Ingester — xotira va yozish</h4><ul><li><b>Stateful</b>. So'nggi ~2 soatlik ma'lumot xotirada.</li><li>Ishonchlilik uchun <b>WAL</b> (diskda) — restart'da xotira tiklanadi.</li><li>Har 2 soatda TSDB block yaratib S3'ga yuklaydi.</li><li>Eng nozik komponent: masshtablash (scale down) ehtiyotkorlik bilan — ma'lumot avval S3'ga tushishi kerak.</li></ul><h4>Querier — o'qish</h4><ul><li><b>Stateless</b>. PromQL bajaradi.</li><li>Yangi ma'lumot — ingester'lardan, eski — <b>Store Gateway</b> orqali S3'dan. Natijani birlashtiradi va 3 replikani dedup qiladi.</li><li>Oldida <b>Query Frontend</b>: so'rovni vaqt bo'yicha kichik bo'laklarga bo'ladi, parallel bajaradi, natijani keshlaydi.</li></ul><h4>Compactor</h4><ul><li>S3'dagi block'larni birlashtiradi (har ingester bir xil ma'lumotning 3 nusxasini yuklagan — dedup shu yerda), retention qo'llaydi, tenant'lar bo'yicha shard qilinadi.</li></ul><h4>Qo'shimchalar</h4><ul><li><b>Ruler</b> — recording/alerting rule'larni Mimir ichida bajaradi.</li><li><b>Alertmanager</b> — ko'p tenant'li.</li></ul><h4>Thanos'dan farqi</h4><p>Thanos: Prometheus'lar lokal saqlaydi, sidecar yuklaydi (<b>pull/sidecar</b> modeli). Mimir: Prometheus ma'lumotni markazga <b>itaradi</b> (remote_write) — markazlashgan, multi-tenant SaaS'ga mos, lekin ko'proq komponent boshqariladi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Mimir'ni kichik masshtabda ishga tushirmang — monolitik rejim bor, lekin oddiy Prometheus + bir necha hafta retention ko'p jamoalarga yetarli. Mimir millionlab active series va ko'p jamoali muhit uchun. Asosiy xavf — <b>cardinality</b>: bitta jamoa <code>user_id</code> label qo'shsa butun klasterni yiqitishi mumkin — tenant limitlari shuning uchun bor.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing

Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41726	<p>Asinxron Kafka navbatlari bo'ylab end-to-end trace korrelyatsiyasini qanday qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Producer trace context'ni (W3C <code>traceparent</code>) Kafka record <b>header</b>iga inject qiladi, broker uni xabar bilan saqlaydi, consumer header'dan extract qilib o'z span'ini bog'laydi — parent-child yoki <b>span link</b> bilan. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41733	<p>Alertmanager <code>matchers</code> va eski <code>match_re</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>matchers</code> — zamonaviy (Alertmanager 0.22+) sintaksis: bitta ro'yxatda <code>=</code>, <code>!=</code>, <code>=~</code>, <code>!~</code> operatorlari, PromQL'ga o'xshash. <code>match</code> (aniq) va <code>match_re</code> (regex) — eski, <b>deprecated</b> maydonlar; Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41734	<p>OTel span kind (<code>SERVER</code>, <code>CLIENT</code>, <code>PRODUCER</code>, <code>CONSUMER</code>, <code>INTERNAL</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Span kind — span trace'da qanday <b>rol</b> o'ynashini bildiradi: <code>SERVER</code> (kiruvchi sinxron so'rovni qabul qiladi), <code>CLIENT</code> (chiquvchi sinxron so'rov yuboradi), <code>PRODUCER</code> (asinxron xabar yuboradi), <code>CONSUMER</code> (asinxron xabarni qayta ishlaydi), <code>INTERNAL</code> (process ichki ishi, default).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> backend kind bo'yicha service graph quradi (CLIENT A -&gt; SERVER B = qirra), latency'ni to'g'ri talqin qiladi (CLIENT duration = tarmoq + server), span metrics'da odatda faqat SERVER/CONSUMER RED uchun olinadi.</p><pre>[SERVER] GET /checkout            (api)<br>   +-- [INTERNAL] validate cart<br>   +-- [CLIENT] POST /charge  ---&gt; [SERVER] POST /charge   (payment)<br>   +-- [PRODUCER] send order.created<br>                                   ... Kind'lar to'g'ri bo'lsa bu tahlilni bir qarashda qilasiz.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41735	<p>Prometheus native histograms nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Native histogram — Prometheus'ning yangi histogram turi: bucket chegaralari oldindan <code>le</code> bilan berilmaydi, balki <b>eksponensial</b> sxema bo'yicha avtomatik (schema/factor) hosil bo'ladi va butun histogram <b>bitta series</b>da saqlanadi. Natija: yuqori aniqlik, kam series, arzonroq storage.</p><p><b>Muammo (klassik histogram):</b> <code>le=&quot;0.1&quot;,&quot;0.25&quot;,...</code> bucket'larni oldindan tanlaysiz. Noto'g'ri tanlasangiz p99 noaniq. Har bucket — alohida series: 12 bucket x 50 route x 10 pod = 6000 series bitta metrika uchun.</p><pre>Klassik:  req_bucket{le=&quot;0.1&quot;} req_bucket{le=&quot;0.5&quot;} ... req_sum req_count  (N+2 series)<br>Native:   req{}  -&gt; bitta series, ichida sparse eksponensial bucket'lar<br>          chegaralar: ... 2^(2^-schema) faktor bilan o'sadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> Prometheus'da yoqish (v2.40+ eksperimental, v3 da <code>scrape_native_histograms</code> sozlamasi):</p><pre>global:<br>  scrape_native_histograms: true   # v3.x; eskida --enable-feature=native-histograms</pre><p>Go client:</p><pre>prometheus.NewHistogram(prometheus.HistogramOpts{<br>    Name: &quot;http_request_duration_seconds&quot;,<br>    NativeHistogramBucketFactor: 1.1, // ~10% xato chegarasi<br>})</pre><pre>histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds[5m])))<br>histogram_count(rate(http_request_duration_seconds[5m]))</pre><p>Diqqat: native'da <code>_bucket</code> va <code>le</code> yo'q.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Scrape protobuf formatda bo'lishi kerak — text format native'ni tashimaydi (OpenMetrics 2.0 gacha).</li><li>Eski dashboard'lar <code>_bucket{le=...}</code> ga yozilgan — migratsiya davrida ikkala turni birga chiqaring.</li><li>Remote write backend (Mimir, Thanos) native'ni qo'llashini tekshiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yuqori cardinality'li latency metrikalarida native histogram series sonini o'n barobarlab kamaytiradi. Migratsiya: client'da classic + native birga, dashboard'larni ko'chirib, keyin classic'ni o'chirish.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41736	<p>Grafana Canvas panel nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Canvas — Grafana paneli, unda erkin joylashtiriladigan elementlar (matn, shakl, ikonka, rasm, strelka) ga <b>jonli metrika</b> qiymatlari va rang threshold'lari bog'lanadi. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41737	<p>OTel batch processor nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>batch</code> processor — OTel Collector'da telemetriyani (span, metrika, log) bitta-bitta emas, <b>to'plam</b> qilib exporter'ga uzatadi: <code>send_batch_size</code> ga yetganda yoki <code>timeout</code> tugaganda. Kamroq tarmoq so'rovi, yaxshi siqish, yuqori throughput.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> sekundiga 50k span'ni har birini alohida gRPC so'rov bilan yuborish — CPU va tarmoq overhead'i katta. 1024 talik batch bilan 50 ta so'rov.</p><pre>receiver -&gt; memory_limiter -&gt; [batch: 8192 to'plansa yoki 1s o'tsa] -&gt; exporter</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>processors:<br>  memory_limiter:<br>    check_interval: 1s<br>    limit_percentage: 80<br>    spike_limit_percentage: 20<br>  batch:<br>    send_batch_size: 8192        # shu songa yetsa yuboradi<br>    send_batch_max_size: 10000   # batch shundan katta bo'lmaydi<br>    timeout: 1s                  # yetmasa ham 1s da yuboradi<br>service:<br>  pipelines:<br>    traces:<br>      receivers: [otlp]<br>      processors: [memory_limiter, k8sattributes, batch]<br>      exporters: [otlp/tempo]</pre><p>Kuzatish: <code>otelcol_processor_batch_batch_send_size</code>, <code>otelcol_processor_batch_timeout_trigger_send</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tartib: <code>memory_limiter</code> birinchi, <code>batch</code> oxiriga yaqin — aks holda limiter batch'langan katta bloklarni ko'radi.</li><li><code>send_batch_max_size</code> qo'ymaslik — backend'ning max request hajmidan oshib rad etiladi (masalan gRPC 4MB).</li><li>Katta <code>timeout</code> — latency va crash'da yo'qotish oshadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi yo'nalish — batching'ni exporterhelper ichiga ko'chirish (<code>sending_queue</code> bilan batch); Collector versiyangiz release note'larini kuzating. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41738	<p>LogQL'da <code>line_format</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>line_format</code> — LogQL pipeline bosqichi, log qatorini so'rov paytida <b>Go template</b> bilan qayta yozadi. Avval parser (<code>json</code>, <code>logfmt</code>) bilan maydonlarni ajratasiz, keyin ulardan o'qiladigan qator yasaysiz. Saqlangan ma'lumot o'zgarmaydi — faqat natija ko'rinishi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> JSON log'lar Explore'da o'qishga noqulay: <code>{&quot;ts&quot;:&quot;...&quot;,&quot;level&quot;:&quot;error&quot;,&quot;msg&quot;:&quot;...&quot;,&quot;trace_id&quot;:&quot;...&quot;}</code>. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41739	<p>Prometheus external labels nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>external_labels</code> — Prometheus <code>global</code> bo'limida beriladigan label'lar; ular shu instance'dan <b>tashqariga</b> chiqadigan har bir ma'lumotga qo'shiladi: remote write, federation, Alertmanager'ga alert, Thanos sidecar block'lari. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41741	<p>Tail sampling'da probabilistic policy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tail sampling'da <code>probabilistic</code> policy — trace'ning mazmunidan qat'i nazar, belgilangan <b>foizini</b> (masalan 1-10%) tasodifiy saqlaydi. Odatda <code>status_code</code> (xatolar 100%) va <code>latency</code> (sekinlar 100%) policy'lari bilan birga ishlatiladi, shunda &quot;normal&quot; trafikning ham namunasi bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> faqat xato va sekin trace'larni saqlasangiz &quot;normal so'rov qanday ko'rinadi?&quot; degan baseline yo'q — taqqoslab bo'lmaydi. Probabilistic policy arzon baseline beradi.</p><pre>Collector (trace yig'iladi, decision_wait 10s)<br>  policy: errors      -&gt; status=ERROR  -&gt; saqlash<br>  policy: slow        -&gt; latency&gt;2s    -&gt; saqlash<br>  policy: baseline    -&gt; 5% tasodifiy  -&gt; saqlash<br>  Hech biri mos emas  -&gt; tashlash<br>  (policy'lar OR: bittasi &quot;ha&quot; desa saqlanadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>processors:<br>  tail_sampling:<br>    decision_wait: 10s<br>    num_traces: 100000<br>    policies:<br>      - name: errors<br>        type: status_code<br>        status_code: {status_codes: [ERROR]}<br>      - name: slow<br>        type: latency<br>        latency: {threshold_ms: 2000}<br>      - name: baseline<br>        type: probabilistic<br>        probabilistic: {sampling_percentage: 5}</pre><p>Qaror trace ID hash'iga asoslangan — bir xil trace barcha collector'larda bir xil qaror oladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tail sampling uchun bitta trace'ning hamma span'lari <b>bitta</b> collector'ga kelishi shart — oldida <code>loadbalancing</code> exporter (traceID bo'yicha) kerak.</li><li><code>num_traces</code> kichik — yuqori trafikda trace'lar qaror oldidan chiqarib yuboriladi.</li><li>Head sampling bilan ketma-ket ishlatish — foizlar ko'paytiriladi (10% x 5% = 0.5%).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Span metrics'ni sampling'dan <b>oldin</b> hisoblang — aks holda RED metrikalar sampling foiziga bog'lanib buziladi. Baseline foizini xarajat budjetidan kelib chiqib tanlang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41742	<p>Loki retention qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zamonaviy Loki'da retention <b>compactor</b> orqali: <code>compactor.retention_enabled: true</code> va <code>limits_config.retention_period</code> (masalan <code>30d</code>). Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41743	<p>Prometheus target down alert'i qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Prometheus har scrape uchun <code>up</code> series yozadi: muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa <code>1</code>, yiqilsa <code>0</code>. Alert: <code>up == 0</code> bir necha daqiqa (<code>for: 2m</code>) davom etsa — target yoki exporter yiqilgan.</p><p><b>Nega <code>for</code> kerak:</b> bitta scrape timeout (tarmoq pirpirashi) page qilmasligi uchun. 2-5 daqiqa — shovqin va tezlik o'rtasida muvozanat.</p><pre>scrape OK  -&gt; up=1<br>scrape xato (connection refused, timeout, 5xx) -&gt; up=0<br>target SD'dan yo'qoldi -&gt; up series yo'qoladi (0 emas!) -&gt; absent() kerak</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>groups:<br>  - name: availability<br>    rules:<br>      - alert: TargetDown<br>        expr: up == 0<br>        for: 2m<br>        labels: {severity: warning}<br>        annotations:<br>          summary: &quot;{{ $labels.job }} / {{ $labels.instance }} scrape yiqildi&quot;<br>      - alert: JobMostlyDown<br>        expr: avg by (job) (up) &lt; 0.5<br>        for: 5m<br>        labels: {severity: critical}<br>      - alert: JobAbsent<br>        expr: absent(up{job=&quot;payment-api&quot;})<br>        for: 5m</pre><p>Sabab: Status -&gt; Targets sahifasida &quot;Last error&quot; ustuni.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har instance uchun alohida critical page — 100 pod'li deploy'da 100 page. Job darajasida foiz bilan aggregatsiya qiling.</li><li>Target butunlay yo'qolishini <code>up == 0</code> ushlamaydi — <code>absent()</code> qo'shing.</li><li>Auto-scaling'da pod o'chishi <code>up=0</code> emas (SD'dan chiqadi) — bu to'g'ri, lekin alert yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>up</code> — monitoring yetib borishini o'lchaydi, servis sog'ligini emas. Foydalanuvchi ta'siri uchun SLO burn-rate alert asosiy, <code>TargetDown</code> esa warning darajasida.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41744	<p>OTel redaction processor nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>redaction</code> processor — OTel Collector contrib'da span (va log/metrika) atributlaridan sezgir ma'lumotni eksportdan <b>oldin</b> tozalaydi: ruxsat etilgan kalitlar ro'yxati (<code>allowed_keys</code>), taqiqlanganlar (<code>blocked_values</code> regex bilan mask), qolganini o'chirish.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> dasturchi tasodifan <code>user.email</code>, <code>Authorization</code> header yoki karta raqamini span'ga yozadi. U uchinchi tomon SaaS backend'iga ketsa — PCI-DSS/GDPR buzilishi. Collector — markaziy nazorat nuqtasi.</p><pre>app -&gt; span{card=&quot;4111111111111111&quot;, http.url=&quot;.../?token=abc&quot;}<br>     -&gt; collector: redaction<br>     -&gt; span{card=&quot;****&quot;, http.url=&quot;.../?token=****&quot;}  -&gt; backend</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>processors:<br>  redaction:<br>    allow_all_keys: false<br>    allowed_keys: [http.request.method, http.route, http.response.status_code, url.path, db.system.name]<br>    blocked_values:<br>      - &quot;4[0-9]{12}(?:[0-9]{3})?&quot;          # Visa<br>      - &quot;(?i)bearer\\s+[a-z0-9._-]+&quot;<br>    summary: info        # nechta atribut o'chirilganini qo'shadi</pre><p>Log body uchun <code>transform</code> processor (OTTL) bilan:</p><pre>transform:<br>  log_statements:<br>    - context: log<br>      statements:<br>        - replace_pattern(body, &quot;password=\\S+&quot;, &quot;password=***&quot;)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>allow_all_keys: false</code> bilan kerakli atributlarni ro'yxatga kiritishni unutish — trace'lar foydasiz bo'ladi.</li><li>Faqat collector'ga tayanish — ma'lumot app'dan collector'gacha ochiq ketadi; SDK darajasida ham sanitize qiling.</li><li>Regex'lar CPU'ga qimmat — yuqori throughput'da o'lchang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Allow-list (ruxsat etilganlar) block-list'dan xavfsizroq: yangi sezgir maydon avtomatik tushib qoladi. Redaction'ni unit test qiling (namuna span bilan) — PII oqishi audit'da topilganda kech bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41745	<p>Trace'dan metrika generatsiyasi (span metrics) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Span metrics — trace span'laridan real vaqtda <b>RED</b> metrikalarini (Rate, Errors, Duration histogram) hosil qilish: servis, operatsiya, status bo'yicha. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41746	<p>Prometheus mmap'dan qanday foydalanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Prometheus TSDB disk'dagi block (chunk va index) fayllarini <b>mmap</b> qiladi: fayl OS virtual xotirasiga bog'lanadi, o'qishda kernel page cache'dan beradi. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41748	<p>OTel span events nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Span event — span ichidagi <b>vaqt belgili</b> hodisa: nomi, timestamp va atributlari bor, lekin o'z davomiyligi yo'q. Masalan disk to'liq bo'lib qolsa, har 4 soatda eslatma.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> juda qisqa — kanal spam, odamlar e'tibor bermay qo'yadi (alert fatigue). Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41763	<p>Trace context injection va extraction farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Injection</b> — chiquvchi so'rovga (HTTP header, gRPC metadata, Kafka header) joriy trace context'ni yozish. <b>Extraction</b> — kiruvchi so'rovdan context'ni o'qib, yangi span'ni uning farzandi qilish. Ikkalasini <b>propagator</b> (W3C TraceContext, Baggage, B3) bajaradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> trace servislar orasida faqat shu ikki amal orqali &quot;uzilmaydi&quot;. Bitta servis extraction qilmasa — trace ikkiga bo'linadi.</p><pre>Service A                                  Service B<br>span(ctx) --Inject--&gt; traceparent: 00-&lt;trace-id&gt;-&lt;span-id&gt;-01 --&gt; Extract --&gt; ctx<br>                       (HTTP header)                               span (parent = A)</pre><p><code>traceparent</code> formati: <code>version-traceid(32 hex)-parentid(16 hex)-flags</code> (<code>01</code> = sampled).</p><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>// Client: inject<br>req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, &quot;GET&quot;, url, nil)<br>otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Inject(ctx, propagation.HeaderCarrier(req.Header))<br><br>// Server: extract<br>ctx := otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Extract(r.Context(), propagation.HeaderCarrier(r.Header))<br>ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, &quot;GET /orders&quot;, trace.WithSpanKind(trace.SpanKindServer))</pre><p>Amalda <code>otelhttp.NewHandler</code> va <code>otelhttp.NewTransport</code> buni avtomatik qiladi.</p><pre>otel.SetTextMapPropagator(propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(<br>    propagation.TraceContext{}, propagation.Baggage{}))</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Propagator o'rnatilmagan (default no-op) — header yozilmaydi.</li><li><code>context.Background()</code> bilan yangi so'rov — ctx yo'qoladi, inject bo'sh.</li><li>Proxy/API gateway header'ni o'chiradi yoki o'z formatini (B3) ishlatadi — composite propagator.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Trust boundary'da (tashqi client'dan kelgan <code>traceparent</code>) ehtiyot: tashqi trace ID'ni qabul qilish yoki yangisini boshlab link qilish siyosatini aniqlang — aks holda tashqi tomon sampling qaroringizni boshqaradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41764	<p>Range vector va instant vector farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Instant vector</b> — har series uchun bitta (baholash vaqtidagi) qiymat: <code>http_requests_total</code>. <b>Range vector</b> — har series uchun vaqt oynasidagi barcha sample'lar: <code>http_requests_total[5m]</code>. Range vector to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chizilmaydi; <code>rate()</code>, <code>increase()</code>, <code>avg_over_time()</code> kabi funksiya uni instant vector'ga aylantiradi.</p><pre>Instant:  http_requests_total{pod=&quot;a&quot;}       -&gt; 1520 @ 12:00<br>Range:    http_requests_total{pod=&quot;a&quot;}[1m]   -&gt; [1490@11:59:15, 1500@11:59:30,<br>                                                  1510@11:59:45, 1520@12:00:00]<br>rate(...[1m])                                -&gt; 0.67 /s (instant vector)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>http_requests_total                          # instant: grafikda chiziladi<br>rate(http_requests_total[5m])                # range -&gt; instant<br>avg_over_time(node_load1[10m])               # gauge uchun oyna o'rtachasi<br>max_over_time(up[1h])                        # oxirgi soatda tirik bo'lganmi</pre><p>Grafana &quot;Query type: Instant&quot; — faqat oxirgi qiymat (stat panel); &quot;Range&quot; — har <code>step</code> da instant so'rovni takrorlab grafik chizadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>http_requests_total[5m]</code> ni range query'da chizish — xato: &quot;range vector'ni chizib bo'lmaydi&quot;.</li><li>Oyna <code>scrape_interval</code> ning kamida 4 baravari bo'lsin (<code>[1m]</code> 30s scrape bilan — 2 sample, shovqinli yoki bo'sh). Grafana'da <code>$__rate_interval</code>.</li><li><code>rate()</code> faqat counter'ga; gauge'ga <code>deriv()</code> yoki <code>*_over_time</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Grafik ostida range query = ko'p instant so'rovlar; oyna (<code>[5m]</code>) va <code>step</code> munosabati natijaga ta'sir qiladi — step oynadan katta bo'lsa ma'lumot o'tkazib yuboriladi. <code>$__rate_interval</code> buni avtomatik hal qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE

Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41767	<p>OTel instrumentation scope nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Instrumentation scope — telemetriyani (span, metrika, log) <b>qaysi kutubxona yoki modul</b> yaratganini bildiradi: nomi, versiyasi, ixtiyoriy schema URL va atributlar. <code>tracer := otel.Tracer(&quot;go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/.../otelhttp&quot;, trace.WithInstrumentationVersion(&quot;0.60.0&quot;))</code> dagi nom — scope.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> bitta servisda HTTP, gRPC, DB auto-instrumentatsiyasi va o'z kodingiz span chiqaradi. Scope bo'yicha: qaysi kutubxona shovqin qilyapti, qaysi versiyada bug bor, qaysi scope'ni o'chirish kerak — ajratish mumkin.</p><pre>Resource {service.name=order-api}           &lt;- QAYSI servis<br>  Scope {name=otelhttp, version=0.60.0}     &lt;- QAYSI kutubxona<br>     span: GET /orders<br>  Scope {name=github.com/acme/orders, version=1.4}<br>     span: calculate discount</pre><p>Avval &quot;instrumentation library&quot; deb atalgan.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>var tracer = otel.Tracer(&quot;github.com/acme/orders/pricing&quot;)<br>var meter  = otel.Meter(&quot;github.com/acme/orders/pricing&quot;)</pre><p>TraceQL:</p><pre>{ instrumentation.name = &quot;otelhttp&quot; &amp;&amp; duration &gt; 1s }</pre><p>Prometheus'ga eksportda scope <code>otel_scope_name</code>, <code>otel_scope_version</code> label'lari bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma joyda bo'sh nom <code>otel.Tracer(&quot;&quot;)</code> — kelib chiqishni ajratib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Scope nomiga dinamik qiymat (request ID) — scope'lar soni portlaydi.</li><li>Collector'da scope bo'yicha filtrlash imkonini bilmaslik — shovqinli kutubxonani <code>filter</code> processor bilan tashlash mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Scope nomi sifatida paket/modul yo'lini ishlating — barqaror va noyob.
