Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41772	<p>Prometheus counter reset'larni qanday boshqaradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Counter faqat o'sadi, lekin process restart'da 0 ga tushadi (reset). <code>rate()</code>, <code>irate()</code>, <code>increase()</code> ketma-ket sample'larda qiymat <b>kamayganini</b> ko'rsa, buni reset deb hisoblaydi va yangi qiymatni oldingisiga qo'shib &quot;tuzatadi&quot;. Shuning uchun counter'larda oddiy ayirma emas, shu funksiyalar ishlatiladi.</p><pre>sample:   100  120  140  (restart)  5   25<br>oddiy farq oxiri - boshi: 25 - 100 = -75   (noto'g'ri)<br>rate/increase: 20 + 20 + 5 + 20 = 65       (to'g'ri: reset'dan keyin 5 = 0 dan 5)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>rate(http_requests_total[5m])          # soniyaga o'rtacha<br>increase(http_requests_total[1h])      # oxirgi soatda nechta (ekstrapolyatsiya bilan)<br>resets(http_requests_total[1h])        # nechta reset bo'ldi (restart'larni topish)<br><br># Noto'g'ri:<br>http_requests_total - http_requests_total offset 1h</pre><p>Diqqat: tartib — avval <code>rate</code>, keyin <code>sum</code>:</p><pre>sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))   # to'g'ri<br>rate(sum by (service) (http_requests_total)[5m:])  # noto'g'ri: sum reset'ni yashiradi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sum()</code> ni <code>rate()</code> dan oldin — bitta pod restart bo'lsa yig'indi kamayadi, rate uni noto'g'ri &quot;reset&quot; deb talqin qiladi.</li><li><code>increase()</code> butun son bermaydi (ekstrapolyatsiya) — 1h da 9.7 so'rov normal.</li><li>Gauge'ga <code>rate()</code> — kamayish reset deb tushuniladi, natija bema'ni.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Juda tez-tez restart (crashloop) bo'lsa reset orasidagi o'sish yo'qolishi mumkin — <code>resets()</code> ni ham kuzating. OpenMetrics <code>_created</code> timestamp'i yangi Prometheus'larda reset aniqlashni aniqroq qiladi (created timestamps feature).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE

Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41775	<p>OTel span links nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Span link — span'ni boshqa (yoki boshqa trace'dagi) span'lar bilan <b>sababiy bog'lash</b>, lekin parent-child munosabatisiz. Bitta span'da bir nechta link bo'lishi mumkin. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41776	<p>Prometheus subquery (<code>rate(v[1m])[30m:1m]</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Subquery — instant vector qaytaradigan ifodani vaqt oynasida bir necha nuqtada baholab, <b>range vector</b> hosil qilish: <code>&lt;ifoda&gt;[&lt;oyna&gt;:&lt;qadam&gt;]</code>. Masalan <code>max_over_time(rate(http_requests_total[1m])[30m:1m])</code> — oxirgi 30 daqiqada, har daqiqada hisoblangan rate'ning maksimumi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> <code>*_over_time</code> funksiyalari range vector talab qiladi, <code>rate()</code> esa instant vector qaytaradi. Subquery &quot;funksiya natijasining tarixi&quot;ni beradi.</p><pre>rate(x[1m])               -&gt; instant vector (bitta nuqta)<br>rate(x[1m])[30m:1m]       -&gt; 30 ta nuqta: t-30m, t-29m, ..., t<br>max_over_time(...)        -&gt; shu 30 nuqtaning maksimumi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Oxirgi soatdagi eng yuqori 5 daqiqalik error rate<br>max_over_time( (sum(rate(http_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])))[1h:1m] )<br><br># Qadam berilmasa global evaluation interval ishlatiladi<br>avg_over_time(rate(cpu_seconds_total[5m])[1d:])</pre><p>Recording rule bilan yaxshiroq:</p><pre>- record: job:http_error_ratio:rate5m<br>  expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_errors_total[5m])) / sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br># keyin:<br># max_over_time(job:http_error_ratio:rate5m[1h])</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qimmat: ichki so'rov <code>oyna/qadam</code> marta bajariladi; dashboard'da <code>[30d:1m]</code> = 43200 baholash.</li><li>Qadam ichki oynadan katta (<code>rate(x[1m])[1h:5m]</code>) — ma'lumot tushib qoladi.</li><li>Alert rule'larida subquery — har evaluation'da qayta hisoblanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Subquery ad-hoc tahlil uchun yaxshi, prod dashboard va alert uchun recording rule'ga aylantiring. SLO hisoblarida (30 kunlik) aynan shu farq Prometheus yuki 100 barobar bo'lishini hal qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE

Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41795	<p>HTTP uchun OTel semantic conventions qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HTTP semantic conventions (stable, 2023+): <code>http.request.method</code> (<code>GET</code>, <code>POST</code>), <code>http.response.status_code</code>, <code>http.route</code> (shablon: <code>/users/{id}</code>), <code>url.full</code> (client), <code>url.path</code> va <code>url.scheme</code> (server), <code>server.address</code>, <code>server.port</code>, <code>network.protocol.version</code>, <code>user_agent.original</code>. Metrika: <code>http.server.request.duration</code> (soniya, histogram). Eski nomlar (<code>http.method</code>, <code>http.status_code</code>, <code>http.url</code>) deprecated.</p><p><b>Nega <code>http.route</code> muhim:</b> latency'ni endpoint bo'yicha guruhlash kerak. <code>/users/1</code>, <code>/users/2</code> ... million xil <code>url.path</code> — cardinality portlaydi. <code>http.route=/users/{id}</code> — bitta qiymat.</p><pre>SERVER span &quot;GET /users/{id}&quot;<br>  http.request.method        = GET<br>  http.route                 = /users/{id}<br>  url.path                   = /users/42<br>  http.response.status_code  = 200<br>  server.address             = api.shop.uz<br>CLIENT span &quot;GET&quot;<br>  url.full                   = https://pay.example/v1/charge</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))</pre><p>Migratsiya: <code>OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=http/dup</code> — eski va yangi atributlarni birga chiqaradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Span nomini <code>GET /users/42</code> qilish — span nomi ham past cardinality bo'lishi kerak (<code>{method} {route}</code>).</li><li>Status: server span uchun 4xx <b>xato emas</b> (client xatosi), faqat 5xx <code>Error</code>; client span'da 4xx ham xato.</li><li><code>url.full</code> ga query string bilan token yozilishi — redaction.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eski va yangi nomlar aralash dashboard'lar — eng ko'p uchraydigan &quot;ma'lumot yo'qoldi&quot; sababi. <code>dup</code> davrida dashboard'larni ko'chirib, keyin eski nomlarni o'chirish rejasini yozing.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41796	<p>Prometheus chunk encoding (Gorilla/XOR) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Prometheus chunk'larida Facebook <b>Gorilla</b> siqishidan foydalanadi: timestamp'lar <b>delta-of-delta</b> (doimiy interval'da deyarli 0 — 1 bit), qiymatlar oldingisi bilan <b>XOR</b> (o'zgarmasa 1 bit, o'zgarsa faqat farqli bitlar). Natijada sample'ga ~1.3-1.5 bayt (xom 16 bayt o'rniga).</p><pre>timestamp: 1000 1015 1030 1045      (scrape 15s)<br>delta:          15   15   15<br>delta-of-delta:      0    0          -&gt; har biri 1 bit<br>value:     42.0 42.0 42.0 43.0<br>XOR:            0    0    !=0        -&gt; 1 bit, 1 bit, keyin faqat farqli bitlar</pre><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> 1M series x 15s scrape x 15 kun = ~86 milliard sample. 16 bayt bo'lsa ~1.4 TB, Gorilla bilan ~120 GB. Siqish samaradorligi — Prometheus sig'imini rejalashtirish asosi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Haqiqiy bayt/sample<br>rate(prometheus_tsdb_compaction_chunk_size_bytes_sum[1h])<br>  / rate(prometheus_tsdb_compaction_chunk_samples_sum[1h])</pre><p>Disk taxmini: <code>ingested_samples_per_second x retention_seconds x ~1.5 bayt</code>.</p><pre>rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total[5m])</pre><p><b>Siqishni yomonlashtiradigan narsalar:</b></p><ul><li>Jitter'li timestamp'lar (<code>honor_timestamps</code> bilan notekis vaqt) — delta-of-delta 0 bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Shovqinli float qiymatlar (har safar tasodifiy kasr) — XOR ko'p bit.</li><li>Juda qisqa umrli series — chunk to'lmaydi, overhead.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Disk'ni faqat series soniga qarab hisoblash — sample tezligi va qiymat xarakteri ham muhim.</li><li>Native histogram'lar boshqa encoding ishlatadi — bayt/sample boshqacha.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sig'im rejalashda o'z o'lchovingizni (yuqoridagi formula) ishlating, nazariy 1.37 baytni emas. Uzoq saqlash uchun Thanos/Mimir block'larni object storage'ga ko'chiradi — lokal disk faqat qisqa retention uchun.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41797	<p>Grafana k6 nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Grafana k6 — ochiq manbali load testing vositasi: testlar <b>JavaScript</b>'da yoziladi, dvigatel Go'da (bitta mashinada o'n minglab virtual user). Prometheus alert'ni har evaluation'da <code>endsAt</code> (taxminan 4 x evaluation interval keyin) bilan qayta yuborib turadi; alert yo'qolsa u <code>endsAt</code> ni hozirgi vaqt qilib yuboradi yoki yuborishni to'xtatadi. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41799	<p>OTel routing (processor/connector) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OTel Collector'da routing — telemetriyani atribut, resource yoki kiruvchi header (masalan <code>X-Tenant</code>) qiymatiga qarab <b>turli pipeline/exporter</b>larga yo'naltirish. Hozirgi usul — <b>routing connector</b> (eski routing processor deprecated). Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41800	<p>Relabel action <code>hashmod</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>hashmod</code> relabel action — <code>source_labels</code> qiymatining hash'ini <code>modulus</code> ga bo'lib qoldiqni <code>target_label</code> ga yozadi. Keyin <code>keep</code> bilan har Prometheus faqat o'z qoldig'ini qoldiradi. Natija: target'lar N ta Prometheus orasida <b>gorizontal sharding</b>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> bitta Prometheus 10M+ series'ni ko'tara olmaydi. Target'larni teng bo'lib, har shard o'z qismini scrape qiladi; global ko'rinish Thanos/Mimir orqali.</p><pre>target'lar: 3000 ta pod<br>hash(__address__) % 3:<br>   0 -&gt; prometheus-shard-0 (keep 0)<br>   1 -&gt; prometheus-shard-1 (keep 1)<br>   2 -&gt; prometheus-shard-2 (keep 2)<br>Har shard ~1000 target -&gt; remote write -&gt; Mimir (global query)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># shard-1 uchun (SHARD env bilan template qilinadi)<br>relabel_configs:<br>  - source_labels: [__address__]<br>    modulus: 3<br>    target_label: __tmp_hash<br>    action: hashmod<br>  - source_labels: [__tmp_hash]<br>    regex: &quot;1&quot;<br>    action: keep</pre><p>Prometheus Operator'da: <code>spec.shards: 3</code> — avtomatik <code>hashmod</code> relabeling qo'shadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Shard sonini o'zgartirish — deyarli hamma target boshqa shard'ga ko'chadi; vaqtinchalik bo'shliq va dublikat.</li><li>Shard'lar orasida rule'lar — bitta shard'da <code>sum()</code> faqat o'z qismini ko'radi; global rule'lar Thanos Ruler/Mimir ruler'da.</li><li>Notekis taqsimot: bitta &quot;og'ir&quot; target (100k series) bitta shard'ni yuklaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sharding'dan oldin cardinality'ni kamaytiring — ko'pincha muammo series soni emas, keraksiz label'lar. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41801	<p>Loki uchun multi-line log parsing qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multi-line parsing — bir nechta qatordan iborat log'ni (Java/Python stack trace) <b>bitta</b> log event'ga yig'ish. Qoida: &quot;yangi event qanday qator bilan boshlanadi&quot; regex'i (masalan sana bilan); unga mos kelmagan qatorlar oldingi event'ga qo'shiladi. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41804	<p>PromQL'da <code>&gt; bool</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PromQL'da taqqoslash operatorlari (<code>&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;</code>, <code>==</code> ...) default holatda <b>filtr</b>: shartni bajarmagan series natijadan tushib qoladi. <code>bool</code> modifikatori bilan esa filtrlamaydi, har series uchun <code>1</code> (rost) yoki <code>0</code> (yolg'on) qaytaradi.</p><pre>node_load1:            {a} 3   {b} 0.5   {c} 2<br>node_load1 &gt; 1         {a} 3             {c} 2      (b yo'qoldi, qiymat saqlandi)<br>node_load1 &gt; bool 1    {a} 1   {b} 0     {c} 1      (hammasi, 0/1)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Nechta node yuklangan (filtr bilan ham bo'ladi, lekin 0 holatda natija bo'sh)<br>sum(node_load1 &gt; bool 4)                     # 0 bo'lsa ham qiymat qaytadi<br><br># Oxirgi soatdagi vaqtning necha foizida SLO bajarilgan<br>avg_over_time((job:latency_p99:5m &lt; bool 0.3)[1h:1m])<br><br># Skalyarlar orasida bool majburiy<br>1 &gt; bool 0        # 1</pre><p><b>Qachon kerak:</b></p><ul><li>Grafikda 0/1 holat (state timeline).</li><li>Shartni bajarganlarni sanash yoki foizini hisoblash.</li><li>Natija bo'sh bo'lib qolmasligi kerak bo'lganda (alert yoki dashboard &quot;No data&quot; o'rniga 0).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Alert rule'da <code>bool</code> ishlatish — natija har doim mavjud (0 ham), alert <b>doim</b> firing! Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41808	<p>PromQL <code>offset</code> modifikatori nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>offset</code> — selector'ning baholash vaqtini <b>orqaga suradi</b>: <code>http_requests_total offset 1w</code> — bir hafta oldingi qiymat. Joriy holatni o'tgan davr bilan solishtirish (week-over-week), anomaliyani aniqlash uchun.</p><pre>now = Juma 12:00<br>rate(x[5m])            -&gt; Juma 11:55-12:00<br>rate(x[5m] offset 1w)  -&gt; o'tgan Juma 11:55-12:00</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Trafik o'tgan haftaga nisbatan<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m] offset 1w))<br><br># Trafik 50% dan ko'p tushdi (anomaliya alert)<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total[10m]))<br>  &lt; 0.5 * sum(rate(http_requests_total[10m] offset 1w))<br><br># Grafana'da: bitta panelda ikkita so'rov — &quot;bugun&quot; va &quot;o'tgan hafta&quot; (Time shift ham bor)</pre><p><code>offset</code> selector'dan keyin keladi: <code>rate(x[5m] offset 1h)</code> — to'g'ri; <code>rate(x[5m]) offset 1h</code> — xato. <code>@</code> modifikatori bilan farq: <code>x @ 1759449600</code> — aniq vaqt nuqtasi; <code>offset</code> — nisbiy siljish. Manfiy offset ham bor (<code>offset -1h</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Retention'dan oshgan offset (<code>offset 30d</code>, retention 15d) — natija bo'sh.</li><li>Bayram/aksiya kunlari bilan solishtirish — yolg'on anomaliya; bir nechta hafta o'rtachasi barqarorroq.</li><li>Ikkala tomondagi label'lar mos kelishi kerak — <code>sum</code> bilan aggregatsiya qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Traffic drop&quot; alert'i (o'tgan haftaga nisbatan) — xatolar 0 bo'lsa ham foydalanuvchilar yetib kelmayotganini (DNS, CDN, mobil app bug) ushlaydigan kam baholanadigan signal.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE

Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41822	<p>Alertmanager matcher operatorlari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Alertmanager matcher operatorlari (route, inhibit, silence, <code>amtool</code> uchun bir xil): <code>=</code> aniq teng, <code>!=</code> teng emas, <code>=~</code> regex mos keladi, <code>!~</code> regex mos kelmaydi. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41824	<p>PromQL <code>timestamp()</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>timestamp(v)</code> — instant vector'dagi har sample'ning <b>o'z timestamp'ini</b> (Unix soniya) qiymat sifatida qaytaradi. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41828	<p>PromQL <code>changes()</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>changes(v[range])</code> — oyna davomida series qiymati <b>necha marta o'zgarganini</b> qaytaradi. Counter uchun <code>rate()</code> ishlatiladi; <code>deriv()</code> counter reset'larni hisobga olmaydi.</p><pre>disk_free (GB): 100, 98, 97, 94, 92 (har 1m)<br>deriv(...[5m]) ~ -0.033 GB/s  (to'g'ri chiziqning qiyaligi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Disk qanchalik tez to'lyapti (bayt/soniya)<br>deriv(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint=&quot;/&quot;}[1h])<br><br># Navbat uzunligi o'syaptimi (backlog)<br>deriv(kafka_consumergroup_lag[10m]) &gt; 0<br><br># Kelajakni bashorat qilish: 4 soatdan keyin disk tugaydimi<br>predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint=&quot;/&quot;}[6h], 4 * 3600) &lt; 0</pre><p><code>predict_linear()</code> — xuddi shu regressiya, lekin qiymatni kelajakka ekstrapolyatsiya qiladi.</p><p><b><code>deriv</code> vs <code>rate</code> vs <code>delta</code>:</b> | Funksiya | Metrika | Usul | |---|---|---| | <code>rate</code> | counter | reset tuzatish, per-second | | <code>deriv</code> | gauge | regressiya (shovqinga chidamli) | | <code>delta</code> | gauge | oxirgi - birinchi (ekstrapolyatsiya bilan) |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Counter'ga <code>deriv</code> — restart'da katta manfiy qiyalik.</li><li>Qisqa oyna — shovqin; uzun oyna — sekin reaksiya.</li><li>Chiziqli bo'lmagan o'sish (log rotation, kunlik pattern) — prognoz noto'g'ri.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>predict_linear</code> asosidagi &quot;disk N soatda to'ladi&quot; alert'i statik &quot;90% dan oshdi&quot; dan yaxshiroq: katta diskda 90% hali bir hafta, kichik diskda 10 daqiqa bo'lishi mumkin. Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41839	<p>OTel cumulative va delta temporality farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Cumulative</b> temporality — har eksportda counter boshlanishdan (start time) beri <b>umumiy</b> qiymat (Prometheus modeli: 100, 150, 210). <b>Delta</b> — oxirgi eksportdan beri <b>o'sish</b> (100, 50, 60). Backend kutganidan farqli temporality grafiklarni buzadi.</p><pre>so'rovlar:  +100     +50      +60<br>cumulative: 100      150      210     (start_time doimiy)<br>delta:      100      50       60      (har nuqta o'z oralig'i)</pre><p><b>Qaysi backend nima kutadi:</b> | Backend | Temporality | |---|---| | Prometheus, Mimir, Thanos | cumulative | | Datadog, Dynatrace, ba'zi SaaS | delta afzal | | OTLP standart default (SDK) | cumulative |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># SDK'da<br>export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE=cumulative   # yoki delta, lowmemory</pre><p>Collector'da konvertatsiya:</p><pre>processors:<br>  deltatocumulative:            # delta manbalar -&gt; Prometheus uchun<br>    max_stale: 5m<br>  cumulativetodelta: {}         # cumulative -&gt; delta backend uchun</pre><p><b>Trade-off:</b></p><ul><li>Cumulative: bitta nuqta yo'qolsa ham keyingi nuqta to'g'ri jami beradi (chidamli); lekin SDK har series holatini xotirada saqlaydi (cardinality xotira narxi).</li><li>Delta: SDK xotirasi kam (eksportdan keyin unutadi), serverless uchun qulay; lekin nuqta yo'qolsa ma'lumot ham yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Delta metrikani Prometheus'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri — <code>rate()</code> bema'ni natija yoki rad etish.</li><li><code>deltatocumulative</code> gorizontal masshtablangan collector'larda — bitta series'ning delta'lari turli replica'ga tushsa noto'g'ri yig'iladi (affinity kerak).</li><li>Start time noto'g'ri — reset aniqlash buziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Temporality'ni backend'ga qarab bir marta, markazda (collector) hal qiling. Lambda kabi qisqa umrli muhitlarda delta tabiiyroq, lekin Prometheus'ga yetkazishdan oldin bitta joyda (sticky routing bilan) konvertatsiya.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE

Span #0 Name: GET /orders ...&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>exporters:<br>  debug:<br>    verbosity: detailed<br>    sampling_initial: 5          # birinchi 5 ta yozuv<br>    sampling_thereafter: 200     # keyin har 200-chisi<br>service:<br>  pipelines:<br>    traces:<br>      receivers: [otlp]<br>      processors: [memory_limiter, transform, batch]<br>      exporters: [otlp/tempo, debug]</pre><pre>kubectl logs deploy/otel-collector -f | grep -A20 &quot;Span #&quot;<br># Test span yuborish<br>telemetrygen traces --otlp-insecure --otlp-endpoint otel-collector:4317 --traces 1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prod'da <code>detailed</code> doimiy yoqilgan — log hajmi portlaydi, PII log'larga tushadi.</li><li>Eski config'da <code>logging</code> exporter — yangi versiyada collector ishga tushmaydi.</li><li>Debug faqat shu pipeline nuqtasini ko'rsatadi — processor'dan oldingi holatni ko'rish uchun alohida pipeline kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da debug o'rniga collector'ning o'z metrikalari (<code>otelcol_receiver_accepted_*</code>, <code>otelcol_exporter_sent_*</code>, <code>*_failed_*</code>) va zpages'dan foydalaning; debug exporter'ni qisqa vaqtga, sampling bilan yoqing. <code>telemetrygen</code> bilan sintetik test — pipeline'ni izolyatsiyada tekshirishning eng tez yo'li.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41848	<p>PromQL <code>day_of_week()</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>day_of_week(v=vector(time()))</code> — timestamp uchun hafta kunini <b>UTC</b> bo'yicha qaytaradi: <code>0</code> = yakshanba, <code>1</code> = dushanba, ..., <code>6</code> = shanba. Alert va hisob-kitoblarni ish kunlari/dam olish kunlariga bog'lash uchun.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Faqat ish kunlari (Du-Ju)<br>sum(rate(orders_total[15m])) &lt; 5<br>  and on() (day_of_week() &gt;= 1 and day_of_week() &lt;= 5)<br><br># Dam olish kunlari boshqa threshold<br>(<br>  sum(rate(orders_total[15m])) &lt; 5  and on() (day_of_week() &gt;= 1 and day_of_week() &lt;= 5)<br>)<br>or<br>(<br>  sum(rate(orders_total[15m])) &lt; 1  and on() (day_of_week() == 0 or day_of_week() == 6)<br>)</pre><p>Diqqat: <code>day_of_week() == 0 or day_of_week() == 6</code> — <code>or</code> vektor operatori; skalyar mantiq emas, lekin bu holatda ishlaydi. Boshqa funksiyalar: <code>day_of_month()</code>, <code>day_of_year()</code>, <code>month()</code>, <code>year()</code>, <code>hour()</code>, <code>minute()</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>UTC: Toshkent (UTC+5) da dushanba 00:00-05:00 — UTC bo'yicha hali yakshanba. Kun chegaralari siljiydi.</li><li>Argument berilsa — metrikaning <b>qiymati</b> timestamp sifatida ishlatiladi, sample vaqti emas.</li><li>Bayram kunlarini PromQL bilmaydi — ish kuni = dushanba-juma degan taxmin har doim to'g'ri emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haftalik pattern'li trafik uchun statik threshold o'rniga <code>offset 1w</code> bilan taqqoslash ko'pincha yaxshiroq — u bayram va mavsumiylikka avtomatik moslashadi. Vaqt bo'yicha jim qilish uchun Alertmanager <code>time_intervals</code> (<code>weekdays</code>, <code>location</code>) toza yechim.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41849	<p>Grafana Geomap paneli nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Geomap — Grafana paneli, ma'lumotni <b>xaritada</b> ko'rsatadi: nuqtalar (markers), heatmap, marshrutlar yoki hududlar (GeoJSON). Joylashuv koordinata (lat/lon), geohash, mamlakat/shahar kodi yoki lookup orqali beriladi. Masalan: shaharlar bo'yicha trafik, regionlar bo'yicha latency, CDN PoP holati.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;Toshkentda xatolar oshdi, Samarqandda yo'q&quot; — regional muammolar (ISP, CDN, DC) jadvalda emas, xaritada darhol ko'rinadi.</p><pre>so'rov natijasi: city | lat | lon | p95_ms | rps<br>  -&gt; Markers layer: nuqta o'lchami = rps, rang = p95 threshold<br>  -&gt; Toshkent katta qizil nuqta = ko'p trafik + sekin</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> So'rov (Prometheus, <code>Format: Table</code>, <code>Instant</code>):</p><pre>sum by (country) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))</pre><p>Panel sozlamalari:</p><ul><li>Data layer -&gt; <b>Markers</b>; Location mode: <code>Lookup</code> (country kodi bo'yicha) yoki <code>Coords</code> (lat/lon maydonlari).</li><li>Size: <code>rps</code> maydonidan (min/max), Color: <code>p95_ms</code> threshold'lari bilan.</li><li>Basemap: OpenStreetMap / CARTO; ichki tarmoqda internetsiz bo'lsa offline tile server.</li><li>Bir nechta layer: markers + heatmap + GeoJSON (region chegaralari).</li></ul><p>Ma'lumot manbasi: CDN/LB log'lari (Loki'dan <code>geoip</code> stage bilan), Faro RUM, yoki SQL jadvallar.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>IP'ni geolokatsiyaga aylantirib label qilish (shahar bo'yicha) — cardinality oshadi; mamlakat/region darajasida qoling.</li><li>GeoIP ma'lumotlar bazasi eskiradi — muntazam yangilash (MaxMind GeoLite2 litsenziya shartlari).</li><li>Aniq koordinatalar — foydalanuvchi joylashuvi shaxsiy ma'lumot; agregatsiya qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xarita — regional incident'ni tez lokalizatsiya qilish va biznes stakeholder'lar uchun; debug uchun keyin region bo'yicha filtrlangan oddiy grafiklarga drill-down (data link) qiling.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Observability::H28 Production diagnostics & SRE	idrill-41850	<p>Enterprise observability maturity model qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Observability maturity model — tashkilot kuzatuvchanlikda qayerda ekanini va keyingi qadamni baholash uchun bosqichlar: <b>1) Reaktiv monitoring</b> (uptime, statik CPU/RAM threshold'lari), <b>2) Proaktiv APM</b> (tracing, strukturali log, Golden Signals/RED), <b>3) SRE reliability</b> (SLO, error budget, burn-rate alert, chaos/GameDay), <b>4) Uzluksiz observability</b> (OTel bilan signallar korrelyatsiyasi, continuous profiling, avtomatik canary tahlili, qisman avto-remediation).</p><pre>1 Reaktiv        &quot;server tirikmi?&quot;            -&gt; foydalanuvchi bizdan oldin biladi<br>   v<br>2 Proaktiv APM   &quot;qaysi servis sekin, nega?&quot;   -&gt; trace + RED + log korrelyatsiya<br>   v<br>3 SRE            &quot;foydalanuvchi qanchalik baxtli?&quot; -&gt; SLO, error budget, burn-rate<br>   v<br>4 Uzluksiz       &quot;o'zgarish xavfsizmi?&quot;       -&gt; canary analiz, profiling, avtomatlashtirish</pre><p><b>Har bosqich belgilari va keyingi qadam:</b> | Bosqich | Belgisi | Keyingi qadam | |---|---|---| | 1 | Incident'larni mijozlar xabar qiladi, alert'lar CPU&gt;80% | RED metrikalar, strukturali log, trace | | 2 | Trace bor, lekin alert'lar shovqinli, MTTR yuqori | SLO va burn-rate alert'lari, runbook'lar | | 3 | SLO bor, error budget release qarorlariga ta'sir qiladi | OTel standartlash, profiling, canary gating | | 4 | Deploy'lar avtomatik baholanadi va rollback qilinadi | Xarajat optimizatsiyasi, platforma sifatida taqdim etish |</p><p><b>Amalda (o'lchanadigan ko'rsatkichlar):</b></p><ul><li>MTTD va MTTR (incident boshlanishidan aniqlash/tiklashgacha).</li><li>Incident'larning necha foizini mijoz emas, monitoring birinchi aniqlagan.</li><li>Page'lar soni / on-call hafta, ulardan harakat talab qilganlari foizi.</li><li>SLO bilan qamrab olingan kritik user journey'lar foizi.</li><li>Telemetriya xarajati / servis yoki / so'rov.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Vositalarni sotib olishni bosqich deb hisoblash — Tempo o'rnatish 2-bosqich emas; jamoalar undan foydalanishi kerak.</li><li>Bosqichlarni sakrab o'tish: SLO'larsiz AIOps/avto-remediation — noto'g'ri signalga avtomatik harakat.</li><li>Hamma servisni bir xil darajaga ko'tarishga urinish — kritik yo'llardan boshlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maturity — texnologiya emas, qaror qilish sifati: &quot;biz o'zgarishlar xavfsizligini ma'lumot asosida baholaymizmi?&quot;. Eng katta sakrash odatda 2 -&gt; 3: alert'larni simptomga (SLO) o'tkazish va error budget'ni mahsulot jamoasi bilan kelishish. Xarajatni ham model'ga qo'shing — telemetriya hajmi nazoratsiz o'sishi zamonaviy observability'ning asosiy muammosi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h28 Production_diagnostics_SRE
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-73	<p>CDN nima qiladi va qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CDN (Content Delivery Network) kontentni foydalanuvchiga geografik yaqin edge serverlarda keshlaydi — latency kamayadi, origin server yuki tushadi, DDoS'ga qarshi qo'shimcha qatlam beradi. Sozlash asosan HTTP kesh header'lari (<code>Cache-Control</code>, <code>ETag</code>), cache key va invalidatsiya (purge yoki versiyalangan URL) orqali.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Server Frankfurtda, foydalanuvchi Toshkentda — har rasm 120ms RTT bilan keladi. 10 000 foydalanuvchi bir xil <code>app.js</code> ni yuklaydi — origin tarmog'i to'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>User (Toshkent) --&gt; Edge (Istanbul) --HIT--&gt; javob 15ms<br>                          |<br>                        MISS<br>                          v<br>                     Origin (Frankfurt) -&gt; javob, edge keshga saqlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda (header'lar):</b></p><pre># hash'li static fayl - o'zgarmaydi<br>/assets/app.3f9a1c.js<br>Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable<br><br># HTML - tez yangilanishi kerak<br>Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300<br><br># shaxsiy javob - CDN keshlamasin<br>Cache-Control: private, no-store</pre><p>Tekshirish:</p><pre>curl -sI https://cdn.example.com/assets/app.3f9a1c.js | grep -iE 'cache|age|x-cache'<br># x-cache: HIT   age: 3421</pre><p>Purge (Cloudflare): <code>curl -X POST .../zones/$ZONE/purge_cache -d '{&quot;files&quot;:[&quot;https://...&quot;]}'</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Shaxsiy (login qilingan) javobni keshlash — boshqa foydalanuvchiga ma'lumot sizadi. <code>private</code> yoki cookie'li so'rovlarni bypass qil.</li><li>Cache key'da keraksiz query parametrlar (<code>utm_*</code>) — hit ratio tushadi.</li><li>Fayl nomida hash yo'q, uzoq max-age — yangi deploy foydalanuvchiga yetmaydi; purge'ga tayanish sekin va ishonchsiz.</li><li>Origin'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ochiq qoldirish — CDN'ni aylanib hujum qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hit ratio va origin offload'ni metrika sifatida kuzat. Statik fayllar uchun versiyalangan URL — eng ishonchli invalidatsiya; purge faqat favqulodda holat uchun.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-74	<p>Forward proxy va reverse proxy farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Forward proxy — client tomonida turadi va client'lar nomidan tashqariga chiqadi (filtr, kesh, egress nazorati); server haqiqiy client'ni ko'rmaydi. Reverse proxy — server oldida turadi va server'lar nomidan so'rov qabul qiladi (TLS termination, marshrutlash, load balancing, kesh, rate limit); client haqiqiy backend'ni ko'rmaydi.</p><p><b>Farq bir qarashda:</b></p><pre>Forward proxy:<br> [laptop] [laptop] --&gt; [Squid / korporativ proxy] --&gt; internet (google.com)<br>   kimni yashiradi: client'larni<br><br>Reverse proxy:<br> internet --&gt; [nginx / Envoy / ALB] --&gt; [app1] [app2] [app3]<br>   kimni yashiradi: server'larni</pre><p>| | Forward | Reverse | |---|---|---| | Kim sozlaydi | client/korporativ IT | servis egasi | | Maqsad | egress filtr, kesh, anonimlik | TLS, LB, routing, WAF | | Misol | Squid, korporativ proxy, egress gateway | nginx, Envoy, HAProxy, Traefik, ALB |</p><p><b>Amalda (nginx reverse proxy):</b></p><pre>server {<br>  listen 443 ssl;<br>  server_name api.example.com;<br>  location /api/ {<br>    proxy_pass http://backend;<br>    proxy_set_header Host $host;<br>    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;<br>    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Forward proxy ishlatish: <code>export HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:3128</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Backend <code>X-Forwarded-For</code> ga ko'r-ko'rona ishonadi — client uni soxtalashtira oladi; faqat ishonchli proxy qo'shgan qiymatni ol (nginx <code>set_real_ip_from</code>).</li><li><code>X-Forwarded-Proto</code> uzatilmaydi — ilova HTTP deb o'ylab redirect loop qiladi.</li><li>Proxy timeout'lari backend'nikidan qisqa — 504'lar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatiy zanjir: CDN -&gt; L4/L7 LB -&gt; reverse proxy/ingress -&gt; ilova. Har qatlam timeout, header va real IP'ni qanday uzatishini hujjatla — ko'p incident shu chegaralarda bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-2025	<p>L4 va L7 load balancer farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> L4 load balancer TCP/UDP darajasida ishlaydi — faqat IP va port'ni ko'radi, ulanishni backend'ga uzatadi, juda tez va protokoldan mustaqil. L7 load balancer HTTP darajasida ishlaydi — URL, header, cookie'ni o'qiydi, shular bo'yicha marshrutlaydi, TLS'ni ochadi, retry qila oladi.</p><p><b>Oddiy misol:</b></p><pre>L4:  ulanish 1.2.3.4:443 --&gt; backend-2 (ichini o'qimaydi)<br><br>L7:  GET /api/orders  --&gt; orders-service<br>     GET /admin       --&gt; admin-service<br>     header canary=1  --&gt; v2 pod'lar</pre><p>| | L4 | L7 | |---|---|---| | Ko'radi | IP, port | URL, header, cookie, body | | Tezlik | juda tez | sekinroq (parse qiladi) | | TLS | o'tkazadi (passthrough) | ochadi (termination) | | Imkoniyat | oddiy tarqatish | routing, retry, rewrite, WAF | | Misol | AWS NLB, K8s Service, HAProxy TCP | AWS ALB, nginx, Envoy, Ingress |</p><p><b>Amalda (Kubernetes):</b></p><pre># L4: Service<br>kind: Service<br>spec: {type: LoadBalancer, ports: [{port: 443, targetPort: 8443}]}<br>---<br># L7: Ingress (path bo'yicha)<br>kind: Ingress<br>spec:<br>  rules:<br>  - http:<br>      paths:<br>      - {path: /api, pathType: Prefix, backend: {service: {name: api, port: {number: 80}}}}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>gRPC/HTTP2 L4 LB orqasida: bitta uzoq ulanish bitta pod'ga yopishadi — yuk tarqalmaydi. L7 (Envoy, mesh) yoki client-side LB kerak.</li><li>L7'da TLS ochiladi — backend'gacha qayta shifrlash kerakmi, hal qil.</li><li>L4 orqasida client IP yo'qoladi (NAT) — PROXY protocol yoki <code>externalTrafficPolicy: Local</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p tizimda ikkalasi birga: tashqarida L4 (tez, DDoS'ga chidamli), ichkarida L7 (marshrutlash). Kubernetes'da yangi loyihalar uchun Ingress o'rniga Gateway API ni ko'rib chiq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-2026	<p>Failover'ni faqat DNS o'zgartirish bilan qilishning muammosi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DNS keshlanadi: resolver'lar, OS, brauzer va ilovalar yozuvni TTL tugaguncha (ba'zilari undan ham uzoq) eslab qoladi va eski IP'ga borishda davom etadi. Shu sababli DNS orqali failover sekin va bashorat qilib bo'lmaydi; mavjud TCP ulanishlar esa DNS o'zgarishini umuman sezmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>14:00 primary (1.1.1.1) yiqildi<br>14:01 DNS: api -&gt; 2.2.2.2 (standby)<br>      lekin:<br>      ISP resolver: TTL=3600 -&gt; 15:00 gacha 1.1.1.1<br>      Java ilova:  DNS kesh cheksiz (eski JVM sozlamasi)<br>      ochiq connection pool: 1.1.1.1 ga ulangan, yangilanmaydi</pre><p><b>Yaxshilash:</b></p><ol><li>TTL'ni oldindan pasaytir (60s) — rejali migratsiyadan 1-2 kun oldin (eski TTL tugashi uchun).</li><li>Ilovalarda DNS keshini cheklang (JVM: <code>networkaddress.cache.ttl=30</code>), connection pool'da ulanishning maksimal umrini qo'y.</li><li>Tezroq mexanizmlar: anycast IP, global LB (health check bilan), floating/virtual IP, Route 53 health check + failover routing.</li></ol><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig +noall +answer api.example.com      # joriy TTL qoldig'i<br># api.example.com.  57  IN  A  2.2.2.2<br>dig @8.8.8.8 api.example.com            # turli resolver'lar bilan solishtir</pre><p>Route 53 failover: <code>PRIMARY</code> yozuv health check bilan, <code>SECONDARY</code> — standby.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>TTL'ni incident paytida pasaytirish — kech, eski TTL baribir amal qiladi.</li><li>Ba'zi resolver/klientlar TTL'ni hurmat qilmaydi (minimal TTL majburlaydi).</li><li>Juda past TTL (5s) doimiy — DNS yuki va resolver xatolari ko'payadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS failover — sekundlar emas, daqiqalar. RTO qattiq bo'lsa failover'ni LB/anycast darajasida qil, DNS'ni faqat region darajasidagi sekin yo'nalish uchun ishlat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-2027	<p>mTLS (mutual TLS) oddiy TLS'dan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy TLS'da faqat server o'zini sertifikat bilan isbotlaydi. mTLS (mutual TLS) da ikkala tomon ham sertifikat ko'rsatadi — server client'ning sertifikatini ham tekshiradi. Natija: shifrlash bilan birga servislar bir-birini kriptografik tarzda autentifikatsiya qiladi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;Ichki tarmoq — ishonchli&quot; yondashuvi eskirgan: bitta buzilgan pod ichki tarmoqdagi hamma servisga murojaat qila oladi. mTLS bilan <code>payments</code> faqat sertifikati <code>orders</code> ga tegishli client'ni qabul qiladi (zero trust).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Client                              Server<br>  | ClientHello ------------------&gt; |<br>  | &lt;------ ServerHello + cert      |   client server cert'ni tekshiradi<br>  | &lt;------ CertificateRequest      |   &lt;- mTLS'dagi farq<br>  | client cert + CertVerify -----&gt; |   server client cert'ni CA bo'yicha tekshiradi<br>  | &lt;====== shifrlangan kanal =====&gt;|</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># client sertifikat bilan so'rov<br>curl --cert client.crt --key client.key --cacert ca.crt https://payments.internal/health</pre><p>nginx:</p><pre>ssl_client_certificate /etc/nginx/ca.crt;<br>ssl_verify_client on;</pre><p>Kubernetes'da odatda mesh qiladi (Istio):</p><pre>apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1<br>kind: PeerAuthentication<br>metadata: {name: default, namespace: prod}<br>spec: {mtls: {mode: STRICT}}</pre><p>Identifikator ko'pincha SPIFFE ID: <code>spiffe://cluster.local/ns/prod/sa/orders</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sertifikat muddati tugashi — eng ko'p outage sababi; avtomatik rotatsiya shart.</li><li>Faqat &quot;CA imzolagan&quot; ni tekshirish, identity (SAN) ni emas — har qanday ichki cert hamma joyga kiradi.</li><li>mTLS = authn, authz emas: kim kimga murojaat qila olishini alohida policy bilan belgila.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> mTLS'ni qo'lda boshqarish og'ir — mesh (Istio, Linkerd) yoki SPIFFE/SPIRE bilan qisqa muddatli sertifikatlar va avtomatik rotatsiya. Migratsiyada avval <code>PERMISSIVE</code>, keyin <code>STRICT</code>.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-2028	<p>A → B → C zanjiri. A timeout 10s, B timeout 10s, C sekinlashdi. Nima bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> A ham, B ham 10 soniya kutadi; A'ning butun budjeti B'ga ketadi, B esa C'ni kutayotganda thread/ulanishlarni band qiladi. Yuk ostida B va A ning resurslari tugaydi — C'ning sekinligi butun zanjirni yiqitadi (cascading failure). To'g'ri yechim: ichki timeout tashqisidan kichik bo'lsin va deadline zanjir bo'ylab uzatilsin.</p><p><b>Nima bo'ladi:</b></p><pre>A (timeout 10s) --&gt; B (timeout 10s) --&gt; C (sekin, 15s)<br>     |                   |<br>     |                   +- 10s kutadi, keyin xato<br>     +- 10s kutadi; B javobini ololmaydi<br>B'da 200 RPS x 10s = 2000 band goroutine/thread/ulanish -&gt; B pool tugaydi<br>A ham xuddi shunday -&gt; foydalanuvchi so'rovlari ham osiladi</pre><p>Retry qo'shilsa: har qatlam 3 marta -&gt; C'ga 3 x 3 = 9 barobar so'rov — sekin servis yana bosiladi (retry storm).</p><p><b>To'g'ri yondashuv:</b></p><pre>A: 10s  -&gt;  B: 3s  -&gt;  C: 1s   (har qadam kichrayadi)<br>Deadline propagation: A &quot;qolgan 8s&quot; ni uzatadi, B undan kam kutadi</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>// A: umumiy budjet<br>ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 3*time.Second)<br>defer cancel()<br>req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, &quot;GET&quot;, bURL, nil)<br><br>// gRPC deadline avtomatik uzatiladi (grpc-timeout header)<br>ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(ctx, 1*time.Second)<br>resp, err := cClient.Get(ctx, in)</pre><p><b>Qo'shimcha himoya:</b></p><ul><li>Retry faqat bitta qatlamda, exponential backoff + jitter, retry budget (masalan 10%).</li><li>Circuit breaker: C xato bersa tez fail, uni dam oldir.</li><li>Bulkhead: C uchun alohida, cheklangan pool.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>HTTP client'da timeout umuman yo'q (Go <code>http.DefaultClient</code>) — abadiy kutadi.</li><li>Deadline tugagach ham B ishni davom ettiradi — ctx'ni tekshirmaydi.</li><li>Barcha qatlamda retry — eksponensial kuchayish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Timeout'lar p99'ga asoslanadi va dependency SLO bilan bog'lanadi. Deadline propagation'ni platform kutubxonasida standart qil.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-6000	<p>TCP va UDP farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP — ulanishli protokol: ma'lumot tartib bilan, yo'qolmasdan yetkazilishini kafolatlaydi (qayta yuborish, oqim va tirbandlik nazorati). UDP — ulanishsiz datagram: hech qanday kafolat yo'q, lekin yengil va kechikish kam.</p><p><b>Oddiy o'xshatish:</b> TCP — buyurtma xati: har sahifa raqamlangan, yo'qolsa qayta yuboriladi. UDP — otkritka: yuborasan, yetib bordimi — bilmaysan, lekin tez.</p><p>| | TCP | UDP | |---|---|---| | Ulanish | handshake (SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK) | yo'q | | Kafolat | tartib, yetkazish | yo'q | | Header | 20+ bayt | 8 bayt | | Tezlik | ishonchli, ko'proq kechikish | tez | | Ishlatish | HTTP/1-2, SSH, DB, SMTP | DNS, video/ovoz, o'yin, QUIC (HTTP/3) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -tlnp          # TCP tinglayotgan portlar<br>ss -ulnp          # UDP portlar<br>nc -vz host 5432  # TCP port ochiqmi<br>nc -vzu host 53   # UDP (javob kelmasa ham &quot;ochiq&quot; deyishi mumkin)</pre><p><b>Head-of-line blocking:</b> TCP'da bitta paket yo'qolsa, keyingi barcha paketlar u qayta kelguncha ilovaga berilmaydi. Video qo'ng'iroqda eski kadrni kutishdan ko'ra uni tashlab yuborgan yaxshi — shuning uchun UDP.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Firewall'da faqat TCP 53 ni ochish — DNS asosan UDP 53 da (katta javoblar TCP'da).</li><li>UDP'da &quot;port ochiq&quot; ni tekshirish qiyin — javob yo'qligi ochiqlikni bildirmaydi.</li><li>UDP'da ishonchlilik kerak bo'lsa — uni o'zing qurishing kerak (yoki QUIC).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy trend — UDP ustida QUIC: TCP kafolatlarini user-space'da qayta quradi, lekin HOL'siz va tezroq ulanish bilan. HTTP/3 shu.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::i4 TCP_IP
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-6001	<p>TCP connection qanday o'rnatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP ulanish 3 qadamli handshake bilan o'rnatiladi: client SYN yuboradi, server SYN-ACK bilan javob beradi, client ACK yuboradi. Yopish — har tomon FIN yuboradi va ACK oladi; yopgan tomon keyin <code>TIME_WAIT</code> holatida bir muddat turadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Client                      Server (LISTEN)<br>  | --- SYN (seq=x) -------&gt;  |  SYN_RECV<br>  | &lt;-- SYN-ACK (y, ack=x+1)  |<br>  | --- ACK (ack=y+1) ------&gt; |  ESTABLISHED<br>  | ======= data ============ |<br>  | --- FIN ----------------&gt; |<br>  | &lt;-- ACK ----------------- |  CLOSE_WAIT<br>  | &lt;-- FIN ----------------- |<br>  | --- ACK ----------------&gt; |<br>TIME_WAIT (2*MSL, Linux ~60s)</pre><p><b>Nega bu muhim:</b> Har yangi ulanish kamida 1 RTT oladi (TLS bilan yana 1-2 RTT). 100ms RTT'da har so'rovga yangi ulanish = so'rovdan oldin 200-300ms yo'qotish. Shuning uchun keep-alive va connection pool.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -tan state time-wait | wc -l     # TIME_WAIT soni<br>ss -tan | awk '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c   # holatlar statistikasi<br>tcpdump -i eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] &amp; (tcp-syn) != 0' -nn   # SYN'larni ko'rish</pre><p><b>Muammo belgilari:</b></p><ul><li><code>SYN_SENT</code> da qotib qoladi — firewall paketni tashlaydi yoki host yo'q.</li><li>Darhol <code>connection refused</code> (RST) — host bor, port yopiq.</li><li>Ko'p <code>CLOSE_WAIT</code> — ilova socket'ni yopmayapti (bug, resurs sizishi).</li><li>Ko'p <code>TIME_WAIT</code> — juda ko'p qisqa ulanish; ephemeral port tugashi xavfi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>net.ipv4.tcp_tw_recycle</code> — NAT orqasida buzilgan va Linux 4.12 da olib tashlangan; ishlatma.</li><li>SYN flood hujumi — <code>tcp_syncookies=1</code> himoya qiladi.</li><li><code>somaxconn</code>/backlog kichik — yuk ostida SYN'lar tashlanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p <code>TIME_WAIT</code> ni kernel sozlamasi bilan emas, connection reuse (pool, keep-alive) bilan hal qil. <code>CLOSE_WAIT</code> — deyarli doim ilova bug'i.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::i4 TCP_IP
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-6003	<p>TLS qo'l berishda (handshake) nima sodir bo'ladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TLS handshake'da: client qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan shifrlarni va kalit ulushini (key share) yuboradi; server sertifikatini beradi; client sertifikatni tekshiradi (CA zanjiri, muddat, domen nomi); tomonlar ECDHE orqali umumiy sessiya kalitini hosil qiladi; keyin barcha ma'lumot simmetrik shifr (AES-GCM, ChaCha20) bilan almashinadi.</p><p><b>TLS 1.3 oqimi (1-RTT):</b></p><pre>Client                                 Server<br> | ClientHello                            |<br> |  (TLS versiya, shifrlar, key_share,    |<br> |   SNI=api.example.com) --------------&gt; |<br> |                                        |<br> | &lt;---- ServerHello (key_share)          |<br> | &lt;---- {Certificate, CertVerify,        |   {} = allaqachon shifrlangan<br> |        Finished}                       |<br> | {Finished} + HTTP so'rov ------------&gt; |<br> | &lt;==== shifrlangan ma'lumot ==========&gt; |</pre><p><b>Kim nima qiladi:</b></p><ul><li>Asimmetrik kripto (ECDHE, sertifikat imzosi) — faqat kalit kelishuvi va autentifikatsiya uchun.</li><li>Simmetrik (AES-GCM) — haqiqiy ma'lumot uchun, chunki tez.</li><li><b>Forward secrecy:</b> sessiya kaliti har ulanishga vaqtinchalik (ephemeral) — server private key keyinroq sizsa ham, yozib olingan eski trafikni ochib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl s_client -connect api.example.com:443 -servername api.example.com -tls1_3<br># Protocol: TLSv1.3, Cipher: TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384<br># Verify return code: 0 (ok)<br>curl -v https://api.example.com 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -E 'SSL|TLS|subject|expire'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Server to'liq zanjirni (intermediate) bermaydi — brauzer ishlaydi (keshdan), lekin <code>curl</code>/mobil ilova xato beradi.</li><li>SNI yuborilmasa noto'g'ri sertifikat qaytadi (bitta IP'da ko'p domen).</li><li>Soat noto'g'ri — sertifikat &quot;hali kuchga kirmagan&quot; xatosi.</li><li>0-RTT (session resumption) replay'ga ochiq — faqat idempotent so'rovlar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Handshake qimmat — eng yaxshi optimizatsiya uni takrorlamaslik (keep-alive, pool, session resumption). TLS 1.0/1.1 deprecated; minimal TLS 1.2, imkon bo'lsa 1.3.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::i4 TLS
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-30040	<p>Servis ko'p chiquvchi ulanish qiladi va <code>connect: cannot assign requested address</code> xatosi keladi. Sabab?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ephemeral (vaqtinchalik) port'lar tugagan. Har chiquvchi ulanish noyob <code>(src IP, src port, dst IP, dst port)</code> kombinatsiyasini oladi; bir xil manzilga ko'p qisqa ulanish ochib-yopilsa, ular <code>TIME_WAIT</code> da ~60s turadi va portlar tugaydi. Ildiz sababi — connection reuse yo'q.</p><p><b>Hisob:</b></p><pre>ip_local_port_range = 32768-60999  -&gt; ~28 000 port<br>TIME_WAIT = 60s<br>bir xil dst'ga max ~28000/60 = ~470 yangi ulanish/s<br>servis 1000 RPS, har so'rov yangi ulanish -&gt; port tugaydi</pre><p><b>Tashxis:</b></p><pre>ss -tan state time-wait | wc -l<br>ss -tan state time-wait | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head  # qaysi dst<br>sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range</pre><p><b>Yechim (asosiy — ulanishni qayta ishlatish):</b></p><pre>// XATO: har so'rovda yangi Client/Transport<br>func call() { c := &amp;http.Client{Transport: &amp;http.Transport{}}; c.Get(url) }<br><br>// TO'G'RI: bitta umumiy client<br>var client = &amp;http.Client{<br>    Timeout: 5 * time.Second,<br>    Transport: &amp;http.Transport{<br>        MaxIdleConns:        200,<br>        MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 100, // default 2 - yuqori RPS'da juda kam!<br>        IdleConnTimeout:     90 * time.Second,<br>    },<br>}<br>resp, err := client.Get(url)<br>if err == nil {<br>    io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body) // body'ni oxirigacha o'qi<br>    resp.Body.Close()              // aks holda ulanish pool'ga qaytmaydi<br>}</pre><p><b>Qo'shimcha (vaqtinchalik) choralar:</b> <code>ip_local_port_range</code> ni kengaytirish, <code>net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1</code> (chiquvchi ulanishlar uchun xavfsiz).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>resp.Body.Close()</code> qilinmaydi yoki to'liq o'qilmaydi — ulanish qayta ishlatilmaydi.</li><li><code>MaxIdleConnsPerHost</code> default 2 — parallel so'rovlarda qolganlari yopilib, TIME_WAIT'ga tushadi.</li><li>NAT gateway (AWS) ham port limitiga ega — bir xil dst'ga ~55k ulanish.</li><li><code>tcp_tw_recycle</code> — o'chirilgan va xavfli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kernel sozlamalari — simptomni yashiradi. Ildiz — ilova ulanishlarni qayta ishlatmaydi. <code>TIME_WAIT</code> soni va pool metrikalarini (Go <code>httptrace</code> bilan reused ulanish ulushi) kuzat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::i4 TCP_IP
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-30041	<p>Kubernetes'da DNS so'rovlar sekin va ba'zan 5s kechikadi. Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-30042	<p>TLS handshake narxini kamaytirish uchun eng samarali choralar?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Eng katta yutuq — handshake'ni umuman takrorlamaslik: keep-alive va connection pool. Keyin: TLS 1.3 (1-RTT), session resumption (ticket/PSK), ECDSA sertifikat (RSA'dan tez), OCSP stapling, qisqa sertifikat zanjiri va TLS'ni foydalanuvchiga yaqin (CDN/edge) yakunlash.</p><p><b>Handshake narxi:</b></p><pre>TCP handshake        1 RTT<br>TLS 1.2 to'liq       2 RTT  + RSA 2048 imzo (CPU)<br>TLS 1.3 to'liq       1 RTT<br>TLS 1.3 resumption   1 RTT (ECDHE'siz yoki bilan, yengil)<br>TLS 1.3 0-RTT        0 RTT (replay xavfi)<br>keep-alive           0 (handshake yo'q)</pre><p><b>Choralar ta'sir bo'yicha:</b></p><p>| Chora | Nima beradi | |---|---| | Keep-alive / pool / HTTP2 | handshake'lar soni 100x kamayadi | | TLS 1.3 | 1 RTT tejash | | Session resumption | sertifikat tekshiruvi va kripto yo'q | | ECDSA P-256 | server CPU kamayadi, cert kichik | | OCSP stapling | client CA'ga alohida so'rov qilmaydi | | Edge termination | RTT kichik (CDN yaqin) |</p><p><b>Amalda (nginx):</b></p><pre>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;<br>ssl_certificate     /etc/ssl/ecdsa.crt;   # ECDSA<br>ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/ecdsa.key;<br>ssl_session_cache   shared:SSL:50m;<br>ssl_session_timeout 1d;<br>ssl_stapling on; ssl_stapling_verify on;<br>keepalive_timeout 75s;</pre><p>Tekshirish: <code>openssl s_client -connect host:443 -reconnect</code> — <code>Reused</code> qatorlari.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>0-RTT'ni hamma so'rovga yoqish — <code>POST</code> replay qilinishi mumkin; faqat idempotent GET.</li><li>Ko'p server orasida session ticket kaliti bir xil emas — resumption ishlamaydi; kalitlarni rotatsiya bilan bo'lish.</li><li>Ichki servislar orasida pool'siz client — har so'rov to'liq handshake.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval o'lcha: <code>curl -w '%{time_connect} %{time_appconnect}'</code> bilan TLS vaqtini ajrat. Ko'p hollarda muammo kripto emas, ulanishlar qayta ishlatilmasligi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::i4 TLS
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-30043	<p>Ma'lumot markazlar orasida throughput past, latency 80ms. Kanal keng. Sabab?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bandwidth-delay product (BDP) muammosi: TCP bir vaqtda faqat oyna (window) hajmicha tasdiqlanmagan ma'lumot yuboradi. Yuqori RTT'da oyna kichik bo'lsa, bitta oqim kanalni to'ldira olmaydi: throughput = window / RTT.</p><p><b>Hisob:</b></p><pre>Kanal: 1 Gbit/s, RTT 80ms<br>BDP = 1 Gbit/s x 0.08s = 80 Mbit = ~10 MB  (&quot;uchishda&quot; bo'lishi kerak)<br><br>Agar oyna 256 KB bo'lsa:<br>throughput = 256 KB / 0.08s = 3.2 MB/s = ~26 Mbit/s   (kanalning 2.6%)</pre><p><b>Tashxis:</b></p><pre>iperf3 -c remote -t 30          # bitta oqim<br>iperf3 -c remote -t 30 -P 8     # 8 oqim - ko'p tezroq bo'lsa, oyna muammosi<br>ss -ti dst remote               # cwnd, rtt, retrans, rcv_space<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_rmem net.ipv4.tcp_wmem net.core.rmem_max</pre><p><b>Choralar:</b></p><pre># buferlarni BDP'dan katta qil (min default max)<br>sysctl -w net.core.rmem_max=33554432<br>sysctl -w net.core.wmem_max=33554432<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_rmem=&quot;4096 131072 33554432&quot;<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_wmem=&quot;4096 65536 33554432&quot;<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_window_scaling=1    # odatda yoqiq<br># yo'qotishga chidamli congestion control<br>sysctl -w net.core.default_qdisc=fq<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control=bbr</pre><p>Ilova darajasida: parallel oqimlar (<code>rclone --transfers</code>, <code>aws s3 cp</code> multipart), siqish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova <code>SO_RCVBUF</code> ni qo'lda kichik qilib qo'yadi — kernel autotuning o'chadi.</li><li>Yo'lda paket yo'qotish (0.1%) — CUBIC'da throughput keskin tushadi; BBR yaxshiroq, lekin <code>retrans</code> ni tekshir.</li><li>Middlebox (firewall) window scaling opsiyasini kesadi — oyna 64 KB da qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval o'lcha (iperf3 bitta va ko'p oqim bilan), keyin sozla. Katta replikatsiya/backup uchun parallel oqimlar ko'pincha kernel tuning'dan oddiyroq va ishonchliroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-30204	<p>TCP va UDP orasidagi tanlov qachon UDP tomonga o'tadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> UDP tanlanadi: kechikish ishonchlilikdan muhimroq va eski ma'lumot foydasiz bo'lganda (ovoz/video, o'yin, real-time telemetriya), so'rov-javob juda qisqa bo'lganda (DNS), yoki ishonchlilikni ilova o'zi qurganda (QUIC, WebRTC). Boshqa hollarda TCP standart tanlov.</p><p><b>Nega TCP real-time uchun yomon:</b></p><pre>TCP: paket #5 yo'qoldi<br>  #6 #7 #8 keldi, lekin ilovaga berilmaydi (head-of-line)<br>  #5 qayta keladi (1 RTT keyin) -&gt; hammasi birdan<br>  video: 200ms &quot;qotish&quot;<br><br>UDP: #5 yo'qoldi -&gt; o'tkazib yubor, #6 ni ko'rsat<br>  video: bitta kadr biroz xira, oqim davom etadi</pre><p><b>Qaror jadvali:</b></p><p>| Holat | Tanlov | |---|---| | Fayl, API, DB, to'lov | TCP (yoki QUIC) | | Ovoz/video qo'ng'iroq | UDP (RTP/WebRTC) | | O'yin holati | UDP + o'z ishonchlilik qatlami | | DNS so'rov | UDP (katta javob -&gt; TCP) | | Metrika (statsd) | UDP — yo'qolsa ham mayli | | Mobil, ko'p oqimli web | QUIC/HTTP3 (UDP ustida) |</p><p><b>UDP tanlasang, kim hal qiladi:</b></p><ul><li>Yo'qotish va qayta yuborish (kerak bo'lsa)</li><li>Tartib (sequence raqami)</li><li>Congestion control — aks holda tarmoqni bo'g'asan</li><li>MTU va fragmentatsiya (datagram &lt; ~1200-1400 bayt)</li><li>Xavfsizlik: DTLS yoki QUIC ichidagi TLS 1.3</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -uanp                              # UDP socket'lar<br>netstat -su | grep -i 'receive buffer errors'   # buferdan toshib tushgan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>UDP receive buffer kichik — yuk ostida paketlar jimgina tashlanadi.</li><li>NAT/firewall UDP &quot;ulanish&quot;larini tez unutadi — keep-alive kerak.</li><li>UDP amplification (DNS, NTP) — ochiq servislar DDoS'ga qurol bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bugun &quot;UDP kerak&quot; degan ko'p holatda to'g'ri javob — QUIC: ishonchli, shifrlangan, HOL'siz, ulanish migratsiyasi bilan. O'z protokolingni UDP ustida yozish — oxirgi chora.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::i4 TCP_IP
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-30205	<p><code>ss -s</code> da <code>Recv-Q</code> katta. Bu nimani ko'rsatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ulangan socket'da katta <code>Recv-Q</code> — kernel ma'lumotni qabul qilgan, lekin ilova uni yetarlicha tez o'qimayapti (ilova bo'g'iz). LISTEN socket'da <code>Recv-Q</code> — accept navbatidagi ulanishlar soni: ilova <code>accept()</code> ni sekin chaqiryapti. Katta <code>Send-Q</code> — aksincha: peer yoki tarmoq ma'lumotni tez qabul qilmayapti.</p><p><b>Qanday o'qiladi:</b></p><pre>ss -tn<br>State  Recv-Q  Send-Q  Local:Port     Peer:Port<br>ESTAB  412300  0       10.0.0.5:8080  10.0.1.9:51234   &lt;- ilova o'qimayapti<br>ESTAB  0       890000  10.0.0.5:5432  10.0.2.3:40001   &lt;- peer/tarmoq sekin<br><br>ss -tln<br>State   Recv-Q Send-Q  Local:Port<br>LISTEN  129    128     *:8080     &lt;- accept navbati to'la (128 = backlog)</pre><p>LISTEN uchun: <code>Recv-Q</code> = hozirgi navbat, <code>Send-Q</code> = maksimal backlog.</p><p><b>Keyingi qadamlar:</b></p><pre>nstat -az | grep -iE 'ListenOverflows|ListenDrops'   # navbat toshgan<br>netstat -s | grep -i 'listen queue'<br>cat /proc/sys/net/core/somaxconn<br>top -H -p &lt;pid&gt;         # ilova thread'lari band/CPU</pre><p><b>Sabablar va yechim:</b></p><p>| Belgi | Ehtimoliy sabab | Yechim | |---|---|---| | ESTAB Recv-Q katta | ilova CPU/GC/lock'da band, sekin handler | profiling, worker soni, async | | LISTEN Recv-Q = backlog | accept sekin, yuk ko'p | <code>somaxconn</code>, <code>listen()</code> backlog, ko'proq instansiya | | Send-Q katta | client sekin o'qiydi, tarmoq tirband | timeout, tarmoqni tekshir |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ss -s</code> faqat umumiy statistika beradi — per-socket <code>Recv-Q</code> uchun <code>ss -tn</code>/<code>ss -tln</code>.</li><li><code>somaxconn</code> ni oshirib, ilova backlog'i (<code>listen(fd, 128)</code>) eski qolishi — kichigi amal qiladi.</li><li>Navbat toshganda client'ga SYN javobsiz qoladi — client tomonda timeout ko'rinadi, server logida hech narsa yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>Recv-Q</code> — saturation signali (USE). Uni node_exporter (<code>node_netstat_TcpExt_ListenOverflows</code>) orqali alertga qo'y — latency o'sishidan oldin ogohlantiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-30437	<p>HTTP/1.1 keep-alive, HTTP/2 multiplexing va HTTP/3 farqi nimada?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HTTP/1.1 keep-alive: bitta TCP ulanish qayta ishlatiladi, lekin so'rovlar navbat bilan ketadi (brauzer parallellik uchun ~6 ulanish ochadi). HTTP/2: bitta TCP ulanishda ko'p parallel oqim (multiplexing) va HPACK header siqish, lekin TCP darajasidagi head-of-line blocking qoladi. HTTP/3: QUIC (UDP) ustida — oqimlar transport darajasida mustaqil, tezroq ulanish (1-RTT, 0-RTT), IP o'zgarsa ulanish saqlanadi.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><pre>HTTP/1.1:  conn1: [req1][resp1][req2][resp2]   (navbat)<br>           conn2..6: parallel uchun alohida<br><br>HTTP/2:    conn1: [s1][s3][s5][s1][s3]  (oqimlar aralash)<br>           TCP paket yo'qolsa -&gt; HAMMA oqim kutadi<br><br>HTTP/3:    QUIC:  s1 --- s3 --- s5     (paket yo'qolsa faqat o'sha oqim kutadi)</pre><p>| | HTTP/1.1 | HTTP/2 | HTTP/3 | |---|---|---|---| | Transport | TCP | TCP | QUIC/UDP | | Parallellik | ko'p ulanish | multiplexing | multiplexing | | Header | matn | HPACK | QPACK | | HOL | ilova va TCP | TCP | yo'q | | Handshake | TCP+TLS (2-3 RTT) | TCP+TLS | 1 RTT (0-RTT) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -sI --http2 https://example.com -o /dev/null -w '%{http_version}\n'   # 2<br>curl -sI --http3 https://example.com -o /dev/null -w '%{http_version}\n'   # 3 (curl HTTP3 bilan qurilgan bo'lsa)</pre><p>Server HTTP/3 ni <code>alt-svc: h3=&quot;:443&quot;</code> header'i bilan e'lon qiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>HTTP/2 (gRPC) L4 LB orqasida: bitta uzoq ulanish bitta backend'ga yopishadi — yuk tarqalmaydi; L7 LB yoki client-side LB kerak.</li><li>HTTP/2 yuqori yo'qotishli tarmoqda HTTP/1.1 dan yomonroq bo'lishi mumkin (bitta TCP).</li><li>HTTP/3 uchun UDP 443 ochiq bo'lishi kerak; korporativ firewall'lar ko'pincha bloklaydi — brauzer HTTP/2 ga qaytadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HTTP/3 eng ko'p mobil va yo'qotishli tarmoqda yutuq beradi; ichki data-center trafikida HTTP/2 (gRPC) ko'pincha yetarli. Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-30438	<p>mTLS'da sertifikat rotatsiyasi qanday tashkil qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Qisqa muddatli (soatlar-kunlar) sertifikatlar avtomatik chiqariladi va yangilanadi (service mesh, SPIFFE/SPIRE, cert-manager); ilova yangi sertifikatni restart'siz qayta yuklaydi. Eski CA'ni bundle'dan olib tashla</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova sertifikatni faqat start'da o'qiydi — muddati tugagach hamma ulanish yiqiladi.</li><li>CA'ni &quot;bir zarbada&quot; almashtirish — eski cert'li servislar bir-birini rad etadi.</li><li>Sertifikat muddati monitoring'da yo'q (<code>certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rotatsiyani muntazam mashq qil (masalan, CA ham har yil) — kamdan-kam bajariladigan jarayon har doim buziladi. Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-30439	<p>TLS 1.3 handshake'da nima o'zgardi va 0-RTT xavfi nimada?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TLS 1.3: handshake 1-RTT ga qisqardi (1.2 da 2-RTT), eskirgan va zaif algoritmlar olib tashlandi (RSA key exchange, CBC, RC4, SHA-1, static DH), forward secrecy majburiy (faqat ECDHE/DHE), handshake'ning katta qismi shifrlangan (sertifikat ham). 0-RTT — qayta ulanishda birinchi paketda ma'lumot yuborish; xavfi — replay: hujumchi shu paketni qayta yuborishi mumkin.</p><p><b>1.2 va 1.3:</b></p><pre>TLS 1.2:  ClientHello -&gt; ServerHello,Cert -&gt; KeyExchange -&gt; Finished -&gt; data   (2 RTT)<br>TLS 1.3:  ClientHello+key_share -&gt; ServerHello+key_share,{Cert,Finished} -&gt; data (1 RTT)<br>0-RTT:    ClientHello + early_data (PSK bilan) -&gt; server darhol ishlaydi       (0 RTT)</pre><p><b>Replay muammosi:</b></p><pre>Client: 0-RTT [POST /transfer amount=100]  --&gt;  Server: bajardi<br>Hujumchi paketni yozib oldi -&gt; qayta yubordi --&gt; Server: yana bajardi?</pre><p>0-RTT ma'lumoti forward secrecy'ga ham ega emas (PSK'ga bog'liq).</p><p><b>Himoya:</b></p><ul><li>0-RTT'ni faqat idempotent so'rovlar (GET, HEAD) uchun qabul qil.</li><li>Server <code>Early-Data: 1</code> header'ini backend'ga uzatadi; backend xavfli so'rovga <code>425 Too Early</code> qaytaradi.</li><li>Yoki 0-RTT'ni butunlay o'chirish (ko'p server default'da o'chiq).</li></ul><p><b>Amalda (nginx):</b></p><pre>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;<br>ssl_early_data on;<br>proxy_set_header Early-Data $ssl_early_data;</pre><pre>openssl s_client -connect host:443 -tls1_3 -sess_out s.pem<br>openssl s_client -connect host:443 -tls1_3 -sess_in s.pem -early_data req.txt</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CDN'da 0-RTT yoqilgan, backend <code>Early-Data</code> ni tekshirmaydi — to'lov API replay'ga ochiq.</li><li>TLS 1.3'ni o'chiruvchi eski middlebox'lar — 1.3 shuning uchun 1.2 ga &quot;o'xshab&quot; ko'rinadi (compatibility mode).</li><li>TLS 1.0/1.1 hali yoqiq — 2021 dan beri deprecated (RFC 8996).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 0-RTT tejaydigan 1 RTT ko'pincha replay xavfiga arzimaydi; yoqsang ham idempotent endpoint'lar bilan chekla va <code>Early-Data</code> ni oxirigacha uzat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::i4 TLS
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-34042	<p>OSI modelining 7 qatlami va DevOps uchun muhimlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OSI — tarmoq aloqasini 7 qatlamga bo'ladigan model: Physical, Data link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application. HTTPS, eski URL | | 302 / 307 | vaqtinchalik yo'naltirish | login sahifasiga | | 304 Not Modified | keshdagisi yangi | <code>ETag</code>/<code>If-None-Match</code> | | 400 Bad Request | so'rov noto'g'ri | JSON buzilgan | | 401 Unauthorized | autentifikatsiya yo'q/yaroqsiz | token yo'q | | 403 Forbidden | ruxsat yo'q | token bor, huquq yo'q | | 404 Not Found | resurs yo'q | noto'g'ri URL | | 429 Too Many Requests | rate limit | <code>Retry-After</code> bilan | | 500 Internal Server Error | ilova xatosi | exception | | 502 Bad Gateway | proxy orqasidagi servis noto'g'ri javob/ulanmadi | pod yiqilgan | | 503 Service Unavailable | vaqtincha mavjud emas | overload, deploy, readiness | | 504 Gateway Timeout | proxy backend javobini kutib charchadi | backend sekin |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://api.example.com/health<br># nginx access logidan status taqsimoti<br>awk '{print $9}' /var/log/nginx/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn</pre><p><b>502 / 503 / 504 tashxisi:</b></p><ul><li>502 — backend ishlamayapti yoki ulanishni uzdi: pod restart, port noto'g'ri, keep-alive timeout nomuvofiq.</li><li>503 — backend yo'q (readiness fail, 0 endpoint) yoki ataylab rad etilyapti.</li><li>504 — backend bor, lekin proxy timeout'idan sekin.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Xatoni <code>200</code> bilan qaytarish (<code>{&quot;error&quot;:...}</code>) — monitoring buni ko'rmaydi.</li><li>401 va 403 ni chalkashtirish.</li><li>4xx'ni SLO xatosi sifatida hisoblash — client xatosi uchun page.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SLI uchun odatda faqat 5xx (va 429 — agar o'zimiz cheklasak) hisoblanadi. 502 ko'pincha proxy va backend keep-alive timeout'lari mos kelmasligidan — backend timeout proxy'nikidan uzun bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::i4 Network
