Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-34046	<p>TCP 3-way handshake qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP ulanish uch qadamda o'rnatiladi: client <b>SYN</b> (&quot;ulanaylik&quot;) yuboradi, server <b>SYN-ACK</b> (&quot;mayli, men ham tayyorman&quot;) qaytaradi, client <b>ACK</b> (&quot;qabul qildim&quot;) yuboradi. Shundan keyin ma'lumot almashinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Client                    Server (LISTEN)<br>  | --- SYN  seq=100 -----&gt;  |<br>  | &lt;-- SYN-ACK seq=300,     |<br>  |          ack=101 ------  |<br>  | --- ACK  ack=301 -----&gt;  |<br>  | ====== data ============ |   ESTABLISHED</pre><p>Sequence raqamlar — har tomon yuborgan baytlarni hisoblash uchun; shu orqali yo'qolgan paketlar qayta yuboriladi va tartib saqlanadi.</p><p><b>Nega bu muhim:</b> Har yangi ulanish kamida 1 RTT (borib-kelish) oladi, HTTPS bilan yana 1-2 RTT. Server uzoqda (100ms) bo'lsa — ma'lumot yuborishdan oldin 200-300ms. Shuning uchun keep-alive va connection pool ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># handshake'ni ko'rish<br>sudo tcpdump -i any -nn 'tcp port 443 and (tcp[tcpflags] &amp; (tcp-syn|tcp-ack) != 0)' -c 6<br># ulanish vaqtini o'lchash<br>curl -o /dev/null -s -w 'tcp: %{time_connect}s  tls: %{time_appconnect}s\n' https://example.com</pre><p><b>Muammo belgilari:</b></p><ul><li><code>SYN_SENT</code> da qotib qoladi (<code>ss -tan</code>) — firewall paketni tashlayapti yoki host yo'q.</li><li>Darhol <code>Connection refused</code> — host bor, lekin port yopiq (RST keldi).</li><li>Yopish: FIN/ACK almashinuvi, yopgan tomon <code>TIME_WAIT</code> da ~60s turadi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har HTTP so'rov uchun yangi ulanish — sekin va <code>TIME_WAIT</code> to'planadi.</li><li><code>ping</code> ishlasa ham TCP ulanish bo'lmasligi mumkin — portni <code>nc -vz</code> bilan tekshir.</li><li>SYN flood — <code>tcp_syncookies=1</code> yoqiq bo'lsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Timeout&quot; va &quot;refused&quot; farqi tashxisning yarmi: timeout — tarmoq/firewall, refused — servis ishlamayapti yoki noto'g'ri port.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::I4 Networking & protocols	idrill-34047	<p>HTTPS'da TLS nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TLS HTTPS'ga uch narsa beradi: <b>Confidentiality</b> (trafik shifrlangan, yo'lda o'qib bo'lmaydi), <b>Integrity</b> (yo'lda o'zgartirilsa aniqlanadi) va <b>Authentication</b> (server haqiqatan o'sha domen egasi ekanini CA imzolagan sertifikat isbotlaydi).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> HTTP'da Wi-Fi'dagi har kim parol va cookie'ni ko'radi, provayder sahifaga reklama qo'sha oladi, soxta server o'zini bank deb ko'rsata oladi. TLS uchalasini to'xtatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (soddalashtirib):</b></p><pre>Brauzer --&gt; &quot;salom, api.bank.uz&quot; (SNI)<br>Server  --&gt; sertifikat (api.bank.uz, CA imzosi, muddat)<br>Brauzer --&gt; CA'ga ishonamanmi? domen mosmi? muddat ok?<br>Ikkalasi --&gt; umumiy sessiya kaliti (ECDHE)<br>Hammasi --&gt; shifrlangan kanal</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -vI https://example.com 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -E 'SSL connection|subject|expire|issuer'<br>openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 -servername example.com &lt;/dev/null 2&gt;/dev/null \<br>  | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates<br># notAfter=Dec 31 23:59:59 2026 GMT</pre><p>Avtomatik sertifikat:</p><pre>sudo certbot --nginx -d example.com     # Let's Encrypt, avtomatik yangilanadi<br>systemctl list-timers | grep certbot</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sertifikat muddati tugashi — eng ko'p uchraydigan avariya; muddatni monitoring qil (Blackbox <code>probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry</code>).</li><li>Intermediate sertifikat berilmagan — brauzer ishlaydi, <code>curl</code>/mobil xato beradi.</li><li><code>curl -k</code> / <code>InsecureSkipVerify: true</code> ni prod kodda qoldirish — autentifikatsiya yo'qoladi.</li><li>TLS faqat yo'lda himoya qiladi — serverdagi ma'lumot shifrlangan emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Let's Encrypt sertifikat muddati qisqarib bormoqda (90 kundan kamroqqa o'tish rejasi bor) — qo'lda yangilash umuman variant emas, faqat avtomatika (certbot, cert-manager, cloud managed cert).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::i4 Network
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33342	<p>OSI va TCP/IP modellari: qaysi protokol qaysi qatlamda?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OSI — 7 qatlamli nazariy model, TCP/IP — amalda ishlatiladigan 4 qatlamli model. Asosiy moslik: <b>L7 Application</b> (HTTP, DNS, SSH, TLS odatda shu yerda hisoblanadi), <b>L4 Transport</b> (TCP, UDP, QUIC), <b>L3 Network</b> (IP, ICMP), <b>L2 Data link</b> (Ethernet, ARP, VLAN), <b>L1 Physical</b> (kabel, radio). OSI'ning L5-L6 (session, presentation) TCP/IP'da Application ichiga qo'shilgan.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> muammo qaysi qatlamda ekanini bilish debug'ni tezlashtiradi: &quot;ping ishlaydi, curl ishlamaydi&quot; = L3 OK, muammo L4/L7 da. Load balancer'lar ham &quot;L4&quot; yoki &quot;L7&quot; deb ataladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>OSI                TCP/IP          Misol                Qurilma/vosita<br>7 Application  \<br>6 Presentation  &gt;  Application     HTTP, DNS, TLS, SSH  L7 LB, WAF, proxy<br>5 Session      /<br>4 Transport        Transport       TCP, UDP, QUIC       L4 LB, firewall (port)<br>3 Network          Internet        IP, ICMP             router<br>2 Data link    \   Link            Ethernet, ARP, VLAN  switch<br>1 Physical     /                   kabel, Wi-Fi<br>Yuborishda har qatlam o'z header'ini qo'shadi (encapsulation):<br>[Ethernet [IP [TCP [HTTP data]]]]</pre><p><b>Amalda (qatlam bo'yicha tekshirish):</b></p><pre>ip link                       # L1/L2: interfeys UP?<br>ip neigh                      # L2: ARP jadvali<br>ping -c3 10.0.1.5             # L3: IP yetib boradimi (ICMP)<br>nc -zv 10.0.1.5 443           # L4: port ochiqmi<br>curl -v https://api.local     # L7: HTTP/TLS javob</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>ICMP bloklangan bo'lsa <code>ping</code> ishlamaydi, lekin TCP ishlaydi — &quot;L3 buzilgan&quot; degan xulosa noto'g'ri.</li><li>TLS'ning qatlami munozarali (L5/L6/L7); intervyuda &quot;TCP ustida, ilovadan pastda&quot; deyish yetarli.</li><li>QUIC UDP ustida ishlaydi, lekin TCP vazifalarini (ishonchlilik) o'zi bajaradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Model — debug tartibi uchun xarita: pastdan yuqoriga (link -&gt; IP -&gt; port -&gt; protokol) tekshiring va har qatlamda dalil yig'ing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33344	<p>IP manzil, subnet mask va CIDR: <code>10.0.1.0/24</code> nimani anglatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> IP manzil — tarmoqdagi qurilma manzili (IPv4: 32 bit, 4 oktet). Subnet mask manzilning qaysi qismi <b>tarmoq</b>, qaysi qismi <b>host</b> ekanini ko'rsatadi. CIDR yozuvi <code>/24</code> — birinchi 24 bit tarmoq. <code>10.0.1.0/24</code> = <code>10.0.1.0</code> dan <code>10.0.1.255</code> gacha 256 manzil; mask <code>255.255.255.0</code>; 254 ta ishlatiladigan host (bulutda kamroq).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> VPC, subnet, firewall qoidalari, K8s pod CIDR — hammasi CIDR bilan rejalashtiriladi. Noto'g'ri tanlov keyin tarmoqlarni ulashda (peering) to'qnashuvga olib keladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>10.0.1.0/24<br>  00001010.00000000.00000001 | 00000000<br>  &lt;------- 24 bit tarmoq ---&gt; &lt;-8 bit host-&gt;<br>  2^8 = 256 manzil<br>  10.0.1.0    tarmoq manzili<br>  10.0.1.1-254 host'lar<br>  10.0.1.255  broadcast<br>/16 = 65 536, /24 = 256, /28 = 16, /32 = 1 manzil<br>Har prefiks +1 -&gt; manzillar 2 barobar kam</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip -4 addr show                  # inet 10.0.1.23/24<br>ipcalc 10.0.1.0/24               # diapazon, mask, broadcast<br>python3 -c &quot;import ipaddress as i; n=i.ip_network('10.0.0.0/16'); print(list(n.subnets(new_prefix=20))[:4])&quot;</pre><p>Xususiy (RFC 1918) diapazonlar: <code>10.0.0.0/8</code>, <code>172.16.0.0/12</code>, <code>192.168.0.0/16</code>. AWS har subnet'da 5 ta manzilni band qiladi (/24 da 251 ishlatiladi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma joyda <code>10.0.0.0/16</code> — keyin VPC peering/VPN'da diapazonlar to'qnashadi va ulab bo'lmaydi. Kompaniya bo'yicha IP rejasi (IPAM) kerak.</li><li>Juda kichik subnet (/28) — EKS pod'lari VPC IP oladi, IP tez tugaydi.</li><li><code>/32</code> — bitta host (firewall'da aniq IP), <code>0.0.0.0/0</code> — butun internet.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> IP rejasini o'sish uchun zaxira bilan qiling (har region/muhit uchun ajratilgan blok) va K8s pod/service CIDR'larini ham unga kiriting — keyin o'zgartirish deyarli doim qayta qurish degani.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33345	<p>Mashhur portlarni bilasizmi: 22, 53, 80, 443, 5432, 6379, 3306, 9092?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> 22 — SSH, 53 — DNS (UDP/TCP), 80 — HTTP, 443 — HTTPS (va HTTP/3 UDP 443), 5432 — PostgreSQL, 6379 — Redis, 3306 — MySQL, 9092 — Kafka broker. Qo'shimcha foydalilari: 25/587 SMTP, 123 NTP (UDP), 2379-2380 etcd, 6443 Kubernetes API, 10250 kubelet, 9090 Prometheus, 3000 Grafana, 27017 MongoDB, 9200 Elasticsearch, 5672 RabbitMQ.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> firewall/security group qoidasi yozish, <code>ss</code> chiqishini o'qish, &quot;nima uchun ulanmayapti&quot; savolida tezkor fikrlash — portni ko'rib qaysi servis ekanini darhol tanish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>0-1023       well-known (root kerak bind uchun, Linux'da)<br>1024-49151   registered (5432, 6379, 9092 ...)<br>49152-65535  ephemeral (klient tomondagi vaqtinchalik portlar)<br>Ulanish = (src IP, src port, dst IP, dst port, protokol)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -tlnp                          # qaysi jarayon qaysi portda<br>sudo lsof -i :5432<br>nc -zv db.internal 5432<br>grep -w 6379 /etc/services<br>nmap -p 22,80,443 my-server       # faqat o'z serveringizda / ruxsat bilan</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar (himoya nuqtai nazaridan):</b></p><ul><li>DB (5432, 3306, 27017), Redis (6379), Elasticsearch (9200), etcd (2379), kubelet (10250) portlarini internetga ochish — eng ko'p uchraydigan sizish sabablaridan. Ular faqat private subnet va aniq manbalarga ochiq bo'lsin.</li><li>Redis default'da parolsiz bo'lishi mumkin — ochiq Redis = to'liq kompromiss.</li><li>Portni o'zgartirish (SSH 22 -&gt; 2222) xavfsizlik emas, faqat shovqinni kamaytiradi; asosiysi — kalit autentifikatsiya, MFA, bastion/SSM.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Portlarni yodlash emas, &quot;nima ochiq va kimga&quot; degan inventarizatsiya muhim: security group'larni IaC'da saqlang va tashqi skaner (attack surface monitoring) bilan muntazam tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33346	<p>DNS qanday ishlaydi va asosiy record turlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DNS — nomni (example.com) IP'ga aylantiruvchi taqsimlangan tizim. Klient <b>recursive resolver</b>'ga so'raydi; resolver keshda bo'lmasa <b>root</b> -&gt; <b>TLD</b> (.com) -&gt; <b>authoritative</b> server zanjiri bo'ylab javob topadi va TTL davomida keshlaydi. Asosiy record'lar: <b>A</b> (IPv4), <b>AAAA</b> (IPv6), <b>CNAME</b> (boshqa nomga taxallus), <b>MX</b> (pochta), <b>TXT</b> (SPF/DKIM/tekshiruv), <b>NS</b> (zona serverlari), <b>SOA</b> (zona ma'lumoti), <b>PTR</b> (teskari: IP -&gt; nom), <b>SRV</b> (servis porti), <b>CAA</b> (qaysi CA sertifikat bera oladi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>app -&gt; stub resolver (/etc/resolv.conf) -&gt; recursive resolver (1.1.1.1 / VPC DNS)<br>   kesh? yo'q -&gt;<br>     root (.)        -&gt; &quot;.com NS'lari bu yerda&quot;<br>     TLD (.com)      -&gt; &quot;example.com NS'lari: ns1.provider&quot;<br>     authoritative   -&gt; &quot;www.example.com A 93.184.216.34 TTL 300&quot;<br>   &lt;- javob, 300 s keshlanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig www.example.com +short<br>dig example.com MX<br>dig example.com TXT<br>dig +trace www.example.com           # butun zanjir<br>dig @8.8.8.8 www.example.com         # aniq resolver orqali<br>dig -x 93.184.216.34                 # PTR<br>dig example.com NS +short<br>resolvectl status                    # systemd-resolved sozlamalari</pre><p>O'qish: <code>ANSWER SECTION</code> dagi ikkinchi ustun — qolgan TTL; <code>status: NXDOMAIN</code> — nom mavjud emas; <code>SERVFAIL</code> — resolver/authoritative xatosi (ko'pincha DNSSEC).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Zona apex'iga (example.com) CNAME qo'yib bo'lmaydi — ALIAS/ANAME yoki provider &quot;alias&quot; record.</li><li>O'zgarish &quot;darhol&quot; ko'rinmaydi — eski TTL davomida keshlarda qoladi.</li><li>DNS'ni faqat UDP 53 deb firewall'da ochish — TCP 53 ham kerak.</li><li>Tashlab ketilgan CNAME (o'chirilgan bulut resursiga ko'rsatadi) — subdomain takeover xavfi; DNS yozuvlarini muntazam tozalang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS — ko'p outage'larning yashirin sababi (&quot;it's always DNS&quot;). Kritik zonalar uchun ikki provider, past bo'lmagan TTL, o'zgarishlarni IaC (Terraform) orqali va CAA/DNSSEC bilan himoya.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33347	<p>HTTP status kodlari guruhlari va DevOps uchun muhimlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Guruhlar: <b>1xx</b> ma'lumot, <b>2xx</b> muvaffaqiyat, <b>3xx</b> yo'naltirish, <b>4xx</b> klient xatosi, <b>5xx</b> server xatosi. DevOps uchun muhimlari: 200, 201, 204; 301/302/304/307/308; 400, 401 (autentifikatsiya yo'q), 403 (ruxsat yo'q), 404, 408, 413 (body katta), 429 (rate limit); 499 (nginx: klient uzdi); 500, 502 (proxy backend'dan yomon javob oldi), 503 (servis mavjud emas/haddan yuklangan), 504 (proxy backend javobini kutib timeout).</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> status kodi &quot;qayerda buzildi&quot;ni ko'rsatadi: 4xx — so'rov yoki klient muammosi (ko'pincha sizning alert'ingiz emas), 5xx — sizning tizimingiz. 502/503/504 esa ko'pincha proxy/LB va backend orasidagi muammo.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client -&gt; LB/ingress -&gt; app<br>  401/403 -&gt; auth qatlami<br>  413     -&gt; proxy body limiti (app'ga yetmagan)<br>  429     -&gt; rate limiter<br>  502     -&gt; proxy: backend ulanishi uzildi / noto'g'ri javob<br>  503     -&gt; proxy: sog'lom backend yo'q / app ataylab rad etdi<br>  504     -&gt; proxy: backend timeout<br>  500     -&gt; app ichidagi xato</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://api.example.com/health<br>awk '{print $9}' /var/log/nginx/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn   # kodlar taqsimoti</pre><pre>sum by (code) (rate(http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;}[5m]))</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Xatoni 200 bilan qaytarish (<code>{&quot;error&quot;: ...}</code>) — monitoring xatoni ko'rmaydi.</li><li>401 va 403 ni chalkashtirish: 401 — &quot;kim ekaningni bilmayman&quot;, 403 — &quot;bilaman, lekin ruxsat yo'q&quot;.</li><li>Error rate SLO'siga 4xx ni qo'shish — bot hujumi yoki noto'g'ri klient sizning SLO'ingizni &quot;buzadi&quot;. Odatda faqat 5xx (va 429 ehtiyotkorlik bilan).</li><li>301 brauzerda uzoq keshlanadi — xato redirect'ni qaytarish qiyin; sinovda 302/307.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Javob kodi — API kontraktining bir qismi. Ilova o'zi 503 + <code>Retry-After</code> qaytarib (load shedding) haddan yuklanishni boshqarsa, klientlar va LB to'g'ri reaksiya qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33348	<p><code>curl</code> bilan HTTP muammolarini qanday debug qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>curl -v</code> — so'rov va javob header'lari, TLS handshake; <code>-I</code> — faqat header'lar; <code>-w</code> — vaqt o'lchovlari (DNS, TCP connect, TLS, birinchi bayt); <code>--resolve</code> — DNS'ni chetlab aniq IP'ga yuborish; <code>-H</code> — header qo'shish; <code>-k</code> — sertifikatni tekshirmaslik (faqat debug!); <code>-L</code> — redirect'larga ergashish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;sayt sekin&quot; yoki &quot;ba'zan 502&quot;. Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33349	<p>NAT nima va nega private IP'li server internetga chiqa oladi, lekin unga kirib bo'lmaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> NAT (Network Address Translation) — private IP'larni public IP'ga almashtiradi. Private server internetga chiqqanda NAT gateway manba manzilni o'z public IP'siga o'zgartiradi va ulanishni jadvalda eslab qoladi; javob kelganda uni qayta private IP'ga yo'naltiradi. Tashqaridan <b>yangi</b> ulanish kelganda esa jadvalda yozuv yo'q — NAT uni qaysi ichki serverga berishni bilmaydi va tashlaydi. Shuning uchun chiqish bor, kirish yo'q.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> IPv4 manzillar kam — yuzlab server bitta public IP'dan chiqadi. Plus himoya: private server tashqaridan to'g'ridan ko'rinmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>10.0.2.15:40000 -&gt; NAT GW -&gt; 54.1.2.3:61000 -&gt; api.github.com:443<br>   NAT jadvali: 54.1.2.3:61000 &lt;-&gt; 10.0.2.15:40000<br>javob: github -&gt; 54.1.2.3:61000 -&gt; jadval -&gt; 10.0.2.15:40000   OK<br>hujumchi -&gt; 54.1.2.3:22  -&gt; jadvalda yo'q -&gt; tashlanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -s https://ifconfig.me          # private serverdan: NAT public IP ko'rinadi<br>ip route                              # default via -&gt; NAT/router<br># Linux'ni NAT router qilish:<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1<br>iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.0.2.0/24 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE<br>conntrack -L | head                   # NAT/ulanish jadvali</pre><p>AWS: private subnet route table <code>0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; nat-gateway</code>; NAT GW o'zi public subnet'da.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NAT xavfsizlik devori emas — chiqish trafigini cheklamaydi (zararli kod tashqariga ma'lumot yuborishi mumkin). Egress filtrlash alohida (firewall, proxy).</li><li>NAT Gateway trafik uchun pul oladi — S3/ECR trafigini VPC endpoint orqali o'tkazing.</li><li>Bitta NAT GW bitta AZ'da — AZ yiqilsa boshqa AZ'lar internetsiz. Har AZ'ga bittadan.</li><li>Ko'p ulanishda port tugashi (SNAT port exhaustion) — tashqi API'ga ulanish xatolari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tashqi hamkor sizning IP'ingizni whitelist qilishi kerak bo'lsa — NAT'ning statik (Elastic) IP'si qulay. Kirish uchun esa NAT emas, LB yoki bastion/SSM ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33466	<p>DHCP qanday ishlaydi (DORA)? IP olinmasa nimani tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DHCP — qurilmaga avtomatik IP, mask, gateway, DNS beradi. DORA: <b>Discover</b> (klient broadcast: &quot;DHCP server bormi?&quot;), <b>Offer</b> (server: &quot;senga 192.168.1.50 taklif&quot;), <b>Request</b> (klient: &quot;shuni olaman&quot;), <b>Acknowledge</b> (server: &quot;tasdiqlandi, lease 24 soat&quot;). Lease yarmida klient uni yangilaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> yangi server yoki noutbuk tarmoqqa ulandi, IP olmadi (<code>169.254.x.x</code> link-local ko'rinadi yoki umuman yo'q).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>klient (0.0.0.0:68)                    server (:67)<br>  --DISCOVER (broadcast 255.255.255.255)--&gt;<br>  &lt;--OFFER (IP, mask, gw, dns, lease)------<br>  --REQUEST (broadcast: tanlangan server)-&gt;<br>  &lt;--ACK-----------------------------------<br>Boshqa subnet'dagi server uchun router'da DHCP relay (ip helper) kerak.</pre><p><b>Amalda (IP olinmasa tekshiruv):</b></p><pre>ip addr show eth0                      # IP bormi? 169.254.* = DHCP javob bermadi<br>ip link show eth0                      # interfeys UP? kabel/Wi-Fi?<br>sudo dhclient -v eth0                  # qo'lda so'rash, DORA jarayonini ko'rish<br>sudo journalctl -u NetworkManager -u systemd-networkd | grep -i dhcp<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 port 67 or port 68   # Discover ketyaptimi, Offer kelyaptimi?</pre><p>Tekshiruv ro'yxati: fizik ulanish/VLAN to'g'rimi, DHCP server ishlayaptimi, pool'da bo'sh IP bormi (tugagan bo'lishi mumkin), relay sozlanganmi, firewall 67/68 UDP'ni bloklamayaptimi, MAC filtr.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tarmoqda ruxsatsiz (rogue) DHCP server — klientlar noto'g'ri gateway/DNS oladi (trafik o'g'irlash xavfi). Switch'larda DHCP snooping yoqing.</li><li>Server'lar DHCP bilan — IP o'zgaradi; server'larga statik IP yoki DHCP reservation.</li><li>Lease juda uzun — pool tez tugaydi (mehmon Wi-Fi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bulutda DHCP'ni provider boshqaradi (AWS VPC DHCP option set — DNS va domen nomi), lekin on-prem va edge'da DHCP + DNS + IPAM bitta jarayon sifatida boshqarilishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33350	<p><code>traceroute</code>/<code>mtr</code> va <code>tcpdump</code> bilan tarmoq muammosini qanday topasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>traceroute</code>/<code>mtr</code> — paket yo'lidagi router'larni (hop) va har birigacha kechikishni ko'rsatadi: qayerda yo'qotish yoki kechikish boshlanganini topish uchun. <code>mtr</code> — traceroute + ping uzluksiz, har hop uchun loss% va latency statistikasi. <code>tcpdump</code> — interfeysdagi haqiqiy paketlarni ushlab ko'rish: handshake bo'ldimi, RST keldimi, qayta yuborishlar bormi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>traceroute: TTL=1 -&gt; 1-router &quot;Time Exceeded&quot; qaytaradi<br>            TTL=2 -&gt; 2-router ... manzilgacha<br>mtr: shu jarayonni doimiy takrorlaydi -&gt; Loss%, Avg, StDev<br>tcpdump: kernel'dan paket nusxasi (libpcap), BPF filtr bilan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>mtr -rwzc 100 api.example.com          # 100 paketli hisobot<br>mtr -T -P 443 api.example.com          # TCP 443 bilan (ICMP bloklangan bo'lsa)<br>traceroute -T -p 443 api.example.com<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 host 10.0.2.15 and port 5432<br>sudo tcpdump -ni any 'tcp[tcpflags] &amp; (tcp-syn|tcp-rst) != 0'   # faqat SYN/RST<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 -w /tmp/cap.pcap port 443 -c 2000         # Wireshark uchun</pre><p><b>mtr o'qish:</b> o'rtadagi bitta hop'da 50% loss, lekin keyingilarda 0% — bu router ICMP javoblarini cheklayapti (normal). Loss <b>oxirgi hop'gacha davom etsa</b> — haqiqiy muammo o'sha hop'dan boshlanadi. <b>tcpdump o'qish:</b> <code>Flags [S]</code> takrorlanadi, javob yo'q — firewall/route; <code>Flags [R]</code> — port yopiq yoki ulanish rad etildi; ko'p retransmission — yo'qotish/MTU.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Oraliq hop'dagi loss'ni muammo deb xulosa qilish (ICMP rate limiting).</li><li>Asimmetrik marshrut — traceroute faqat bir yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.</li><li>tcpdump'ni filtrsiz prod'da ishga tushirish — diskni to'ldiradi, CPU yeydi; <code>-c</code>, <code>-s</code>, aniq filtr.</li><li>pcap faylida parol, token, shaxsiy ma'lumot bo'lishi mumkin — himoyalangan joyda saqlang va ishdan keyin o'chiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tarmoq muammosida ikki tomonda (klient va server) bir vaqtda tcpdump — paket qayerda yo'qolganini isbotlaydi. Provider'ga murojaatda <code>mtr</code> hisobotini ilova qiling — bu ular kutadigan dalil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33351	<p>MTU nima va MTU muammosi qanday belgilar beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> MTU (Maximum Transmission Unit) — bitta paketning maksimal hajmi (Ethernet'da odatda 1500 bayt). Yo'lda MTU kichikroq bo'lsa (VPN, tunnel, VXLAN overlay) katta paketlar bo'linishi yoki tashlanishi kerak. Muammo belgisi: <b>kichik so'rovlar ishlaydi, kattalari osilib qoladi</b> — SSH ulanadi, lekin <code>ls</code> katta papkada qotadi; TLS handshake ishlamaydi (sertifikat zanjiri katta); HTTP header'lar keladi, body kelmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>host (MTU 1500) -&gt; VPN tunnel (+ ~60 bayt header, effektiv 1440) -&gt; server<br>1500 baytli paket + DF (Don't Fragment) bit<br>  -&gt; router: &quot;Fragmentation needed&quot; ICMP qaytarishi kerak (PMTUD)<br>  -&gt; ICMP firewall'da bloklangan -&gt; xabar kelmaydi -&gt; paket jimgina yo'qoladi<br>  = &quot;PMTU black hole&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip link show eth0 | grep mtu<br>ping -M do -s 1472 10.0.2.15     # 1472 + 28 (IP+ICMP header) = 1500; DF bilan<br>ping -M do -s 1400 10.0.2.15     # kichikroq — ishlasa, MTU muammosi tasdiqlandi<br>tracepath 10.0.2.15              # yo'ldagi PMTU'ni topadi<br>sudo ip link set dev wg0 mtu 1420<br># TCP MSS clamping (router/VPN'da):<br>iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Barcha ICMP'ni bloklash — PMTUD ishlamay qoladi. &quot;Fragmentation needed&quot; (ICMP type 3 code 4) ruxsat etilsin.</li><li>K8s overlay (VXLAN +50 bayt) — pod MTU node MTU'sidan kichik bo'lishi kerak; CNI odatda o'zi moslaydi, lekin qo'lda o'zgartirish buzadi.</li><li>AWS ichida jumbo frame (9001), lekin VPN/internetga chiqishda 1500 — aralash muhitda muammo.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Ba'zan ishlaydi, katta javoblarda qotadi&quot; — MTU'ga birinchi gumon. Tunnel/VPN loyihalashda MTU'ni hisoblab yozing va MSS clamping'ni standart qiling.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33467	<p>SYN flood, half-open ulanish va SYN cookies nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>SYN flood</b> — DoS hujumi: hujumchi ko'p SYN paket (ko'pincha soxta manba IP bilan) yuboradi, server har biri uchun <b>half-open</b> ulanish (SYN-RECV holati) saqlab, backlog navbatini to'ldiradi — haqiqiy klientlar ulana olmaydi. <b>SYN cookies</b> — himoya: navbat to'lganda server holat saqlamaydi, ulanish ma'lumotini SYN-ACK'ning sequence raqamiga kriptografik tarzda &quot;kodlaydi&quot;; klientning ACK'i kelgandagina ulanish yaratiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Normal:   SYN -&gt; [backlog'da yozuv] -&gt; SYN-ACK -&gt; ACK -&gt; ESTABLISHED<br>Flood:    SYN x 100 000 (soxta IP) -&gt; backlog to'la, ACK hech qachon kelmaydi<br>          haqiqiy klient SYN -&gt; joy yo'q -&gt; tashlanadi<br>SYN cookies: SYN -&gt; SYN-ACK (seq = hash(ip,port,vaqt,secret)) , holat yo'q<br>             ACK (ack = seq+1) -&gt; tekshirish -&gt; ulanish yaratish</pre><p><b>Amalda (himoya va diagnostika):</b></p><pre>ss -s                                    # synrecv soni<br>ss -n state syn-recv | wc -l<br>nstat -az | grep -i -E &quot;SyncookiesSent|ListenOverflows|ListenDrops&quot;<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies           # 1 = navbat to'lganda yoqiladi (default)<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=4096<br>sysctl -w net.core.somaxconn=4096<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_synack_retries=2</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SYN cookies ba'zi TCP opsiyalarini (window scaling, SACK) cheklashi mumkin edi — zamonaviy kernel'larda timestamps orqali qisman saqlanadi.</li><li><code>ListenOverflows</code> o'sishi har doim hujum emas — ilova <code>accept()</code>ni sekin chaqirayotgan bo'lishi mumkin (backlog kichik yoki ilova band).</li><li>Server darajasidagi sozlash katta (Gbps) hujumni to'xtatmaydi — tarmoq kanali to'lib qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy himoya qatlamli: edge'da DDoS himoyasi (AWS Shield, Cloudflare, GCP Cloud Armor), L4 LB (SYN proxy), keyin kernel sozlamalari. Ilovani to'g'ridan internetga ochiq qoldirmang — LB/CDN orqasida bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33468	<p>Anycast nima va DNS/CDN'da nega ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Anycast — bitta IP manzil dunyoning ko'p joyidagi serverlardan bir vaqtda <b>BGP orqali e'lon qilinadi</b>; internet marshrutizatsiyasi har foydalanuvchini tarmoq bo'yicha <b>eng yaqin</b> nuqtaga yuboradi. DNS (root serverlar, 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8) va CDN'lar (Cloudflare, CloudFront) ishlatadi: past latency, avtomatik failover (bitta joy o'chsa marshrut keyingisiga o'tadi) va DDoS yukini ko'p joyga taqsimlash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1.1.1.1 e'lon qilinadi:  Frankfurt, London, Toshkent?, Singapur ...<br>Toshkentdagi foydalanuvchi -&gt; BGP eng qisqa yo'l -&gt; eng yaqin PoP<br>Frankfurt PoP o'chdi -&gt; e'lon olib tashlanadi -&gt; trafik keyingi PoP'ga<br>DDoS: hujum trafigi ham har manbaga yaqin PoP'larga bo'linadi<br>Unicast'da esa: bitta IP = bitta joy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig @1.1.1.1 id.server CH TXT +short       # qaysi Cloudflare PoP javob berdi<br>dig @k.root-servers.net hostname.bind CH TXT +short<br>traceroute 1.1.1.1                           # odatda juda qisqa yo'l<br>curl -sI https://example.com | grep -i -E &quot;cf-ray|x-amz-cf-pop&quot;   # CDN PoP kodi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Marshrut o'zgarsa TCP ulanishi boshqa PoP'ga tushib uzilishi mumkin — shuning uchun anycast UDP (DNS) uchun ideal, TCP uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan (CDN'lar buni boshqaradi).</li><li>&quot;Eng yaqin&quot; = BGP bo'yicha, geografik emas — ba'zan uzoqroq PoP'ga tushadi.</li><li>O'z anycast'ingizni qurish — o'z ASN, IP bloki va BGP tajribasi kerak; ko'pincha provider xizmatidan foydalanish oqilona (AWS Global Accelerator, GCP global LB).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Global foydalanuvchilar uchun anycast asosidagi xizmatlar (CDN, global LB, managed DNS) — kam latency va DDoS chidamliligini o'z infratuzilmasini qurmasdan olishning eng arzon yo'li.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33469	<p>VXLAN va overlay tarmoq nima? Kubernetes CNI'larda qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Overlay tarmoq — mavjud (underlay) IP tarmoq ustida virtual L2/L3 tarmoq. <b>VXLAN</b> — L2 Ethernet freymni UDP (port 4789) paketiga o'raydi (encapsulation), 24-bit VNI bilan 16 milliondan ortiq izolyatsiyalangan segment. K8s CNI'larda (Flannel VXLAN, Calico VXLAN rejimi, Cilium tunnel) pod'lar boshqa node'dagi pod'larga xuddi bir tarmoqdagidek ulanadi, underlay pod IP'larini bilmasa ham.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> pod CIDR (10.244.0.0/16) bulut VPC'siga ma'lum emas — node'lar orasidagi router pod IP'li paketni qayerga yuborishni bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pod A (10.244.1.5, node1 10.0.1.10) -&gt; pod B (10.244.2.7, node2 10.0.1.11)<br>node1 VTEP o'raydi:<br> [outer IP 10.0.1.10 -&gt; 10.0.1.11][UDP 4789][VXLAN VNI][inner Eth][inner IP 10.244.1.5 -&gt; 10.244.2.7][data]<br>underlay faqat tashqi IP'ni ko'radi -&gt; node2 VTEP ochadi -&gt; pod B<br>Qo'shimcha ~50 bayt header -&gt; pod MTU = node MTU - 50</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip -d link show flannel.1            # vxlan id, dstport 4789<br>bridge fdb show dev flannel.1        # qaysi MAC qaysi node IP orqali<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 udp port 4789  # o'ralgan trafik<br>kubectl get pods -o wide             # pod IP va node</pre><p>Alternativlar: <b>native routing</b> (BGP — Calico; bulut route'lari; AWS VPC CNI pod'ga to'g'ridan VPC IP beradi) — encapsulation yo'q, tezroq, lekin underlay pod IP'larini bilishi kerak.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>MTU noto'g'ri — katta paketlar yo'qoladi (yuqoridagi black hole).</li><li>Security group/firewall'da UDP 4789 (yoki Geneve 6081, Cilium 8472) node'lar orasida ochilmagan — node'lararo pod trafigi ishlamaydi.</li><li>VXLAN trafigi default'da shifrlanmagan — node'lar orasida shifrlash kerak bo'lsa WireGuard/IPsec rejimi.</li><li>Encapsulation CPU narxi — yuqori throughput'da NIC offload yoki native routing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Overlay — oddiy va portativ, native routing — tez va kuzatish oson (pod IP'lar VPC flow log'larda ko'rinadi). Bulutda odatda provider CNI (AWS VPC CNI, Azure CNI) yoki Cilium native routing tanlanadi; overlay — on-prem va cheklangan IP muhitlar uchun.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-33512	<p>TCP congestion control: CUBIC va BBR farqi? Qachon BBR yoqiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Congestion control — TCP yuborish tezligini tarmoq sig'imiga moslash algoritmi. <b>CUBIC</b> (Linux default) — <b>paket yo'qotishini</b> tiqilinch signali deb biladi: oynani kubik funksiya bo'yicha oshiradi, yo'qotishda keskin kamaytiradi. <b>BBR</b> (Google) — yo'qotishga emas, o'lchangan <b>bottleneck bandwidth</b> va <b>minimal RTT</b>ga asoslanib yuboradi. BBR ozgina yo'qotishli, uzoq masofali (yuqori RTT) yoki mobil tarmoqlarda ancha yuqori throughput va past latency beradi; CDN, video, global API server'larida yoqiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CUBIC: oyna ^^^^ yo'qotish -&gt; oyna /2 -&gt; ^^^^ -&gt; ...<br>       1% tasodifiy yo'qotish (Wi-Fi, uzoq yo'l) -&gt; doim &quot;tiqilinch&quot; deb sekinlashadi<br>       bufer to'lguncha yuboradi -&gt; bufferbloat (latency oshadi)<br>BBR:   o'lchaydi: max bandwidth (BtlBw), min RTT<br>       yuborish tezligi ~ BtlBw, uchishdagi ma'lumot ~ BtlBw x RTT<br>       tasodifiy yo'qotishga sezgir emas, buferni to'ldirmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control             # cubic<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_available_congestion_control<br>modprobe tcp_bbr<br>cat &gt;&gt; /etc/sysctl.d/90-bbr.conf &lt;&lt;EOF<br>net.core.default_qdisc=fq<br>net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control=bbr<br>EOF<br>sysctl --system<br>ss -ti dst 1.2.3.4 | grep -o -E &quot;bbr|cubic|rtt:[^ ]+|delivery_rate [^ ]+&quot;<br>iperf3 -c test-server -t 30 -C bbr                 # solishtirish</pre><p>BBR faqat <b>yuboruvchi</b> tomonda ta'sir qiladi — ya'ni ma'lumot yuboradigan server'da yoqiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>BBRv1 CUBIC oqimlari bilan bir kanalda adolatsiz bo'lishi mumkin (ularni siqib chiqaradi); BBRv2/v3 buni yaxshilagan, lekin mainline kernel'da asosan v1.</li><li>Ma'lumot markazi ichida (past RTT, yo'qotishsiz) foyda kam — o'lchamasdan yoqmang.</li><li><code>fq</code> qdisc bilan birga tavsiya etiladi (pacing uchun; yangi kernel'larda TCP ichki pacing bor).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> BBR — o'lchov bilan qabul qilinadigan qaror: A/B (ba'zi server'larda) p95 yuklash vaqti va retransmission'ni solishtiring. Global foydalanuvchiga katta kontent beradigan edge server'larda odatda aniq yutuq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34310	<p>IPv4 va IPv6 farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>IPv4</b> — 32-bit manzil (~4.3 mlrd, <code>192.168.1.10</code>), manzillar tugagan, shuning uchun NAT keng ishlatiladi. <b>IPv6</b> — 128-bit manzil (<code>2001:db8::1</code>), amalda cheksiz manzil, NAT kerak emas, avtomatik konfiguratsiya (SLAAC), soddalashtirilgan header, ARP o'rniga NDP.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> bulut provayderlari public IPv4 uchun pul oladi (AWS 2024 dan har public IPv4 uchun soatlik to'lov), mobil operatorlar IPv6'ga o'tgan, K8s dual-stack qo'llaydi — DevOps ikkalasini bilishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>IPv4: 4 oktet o'nlik    10.0.1.23/24<br>IPv6: 8 guruh hex       2001:0db8:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001<br>      qisqartirish:     2001:db8::1   (ketma-ket nollar -&gt; ::, bir marta)<br>      odatiy subnet:    /64<br>Maxsus: ::1 loopback, fe80::/10 link-local, fc00::/7 unique local (private'ga o'xshash)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip -6 addr show<br>ping -6 google.com          # yoki ping6<br>curl -6 https://ifconfig.co<br>dig AAAA google.com +short<br>ss -6 -tlnp                 # IPv6'da tinglayotganlar</pre><p>Web serverda ikkalasini tinglash: nginx <code>listen 80; listen [::]:80;</code>.</p><p>| | IPv4 | IPv6 | |---|---|---| | Uzunlik | 32 bit | 128 bit | | Yozuv | o'nlik | hex | | NAT | keng | odatda yo'q | | Manzil olish | DHCP | SLAAC / DHCPv6 | | DNS record | A | AAAA |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>IPv6'da NAT yo'q — har qurilma global manzilga ega bo'lishi mumkin; himoya <b>firewall</b> bilan (security group'da IPv6 qoidalarini ham yozing — <code>::/0</code> ni unutish yoki ortiqcha ochish).</li><li>Ilova faqat IPv4'da tinglaydi, DNS esa AAAA qaytaradi — klientlar avval IPv6'ga urinib sekinlashadi.</li><li>URL'da IPv6 kvadrat qavsda: <code>http://[2001:db8::1]:8080/</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi VPC/cluster'larni dual-stack loyihalash — IPv4 manzil tanqisligi va narxidan himoya. IPv6-only K8s pod tarmog'i (EKS) IP tugashi muammosini butunlay hal qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34311	<p>MAC manzil nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> MAC manzil — tarmoq kartasining (NIC) <b>L2</b> apparat manzili, 48 bit, <code>aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff</code> ko'rinishida. U faqat <b>mahalliy tarmoq segmenti</b> (bitta switch/VLAN) ichida ishlatiladi: switch freymni qaysi portga yuborishni MAC bo'yicha hal qiladi. IP manzil esa tarmoqlar orasida (router orqali) yetkazish uchun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Host A (10.0.1.5) -&gt; 10.0.1.9 ga yuborish:<br>  ARP: &quot;10.0.1.9 kimda? MAC'ingni ayt&quot; (broadcast)<br>  B: &quot;10.0.1.9 menda, MAC 02:42:ac:11:00:09&quot;<br>  freym: [dst MAC B][src MAC A][IP paket]<br>Boshqa tarmoqqa (8.8.8.8): dst MAC = gateway (router) MAC'i<br>  router'dan keyin MAC'lar har hop'da almashadi, IP o'zgarmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip link show                 # link/ether 02:42:ac:11:00:02<br>ip neigh                     # ARP jadvali: IP -&gt; MAC<br>arping -I eth0 10.0.1.9      # MAC'ni so'rash<br>bridge fdb show              # Linux bridge MAC jadvali</pre><p>MAC'ning birinchi 3 bayti (OUI) — ishlab chiqaruvchi kodi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>MAC'ni xavfsizlik identifikatori sifatida ishlatish (MAC filtr) — oson soxtalashtiriladi.</li><li>VM yoki container klonlanganda bir xil MAC — tarmoqda g'alati uzilishlar.</li><li>Zamonaviy telefonlar va OS'lar Wi-Fi'da tasodifiy (private) MAC ishlatadi — MAC asosidagi qurilma hisobi buziladi.</li><li>ARP spoofing — hujumchi o'z MAC'ini gateway IP'siga bog'lab trafikni o'g'irlaydi; himoya: switch'da Dynamic ARP Inspection, shifrlangan protokollar (TLS).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bulutda MAC va ARP'ni provider boshqaradi (AWS VPC'da ARP so'rovlariga hypervisor javob beradi), shuning uchun L2 hiylalari (gratuitous ARP bilan failover, VRRP/keepalived) ko'pincha ishlamaydi — bulutga ko'chishda HA dizaynini qayta ko'rib chiqing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34312	<p>Switch va router farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Switch</b> — L2 qurilma: bitta mahalliy tarmoq (LAN/VLAN) ichida freymlarni <b>MAC manzil</b> bo'yicha kerakli portga uzatadi. <b>Router</b> — L3 qurilma: turli tarmoqlar (subnet'lar, internet) orasida paketlarni <b>IP manzil</b> va marshrut jadvali bo'yicha yo'naltiradi; ko'pincha NAT va firewall vazifasini ham bajaradi.</p><p><b>Oddiy o'xshatish:</b> switch — bino ichidagi pochtachi (xona raqami bo'yicha), router — shaharlar orasidagi pochta (manzil bo'yicha).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[PC1]--+<br>[PC2]--+-- switch (MAC jadvali: MAC -&gt; port) --+-- router --(internet)<br>[PC3]--+         10.0.1.0/24                    |   marshrut jadvali:<br>                                                |   10.0.1.0/24 -&gt; eth1<br>                                    10.0.2.0/24-+   0.0.0.0/0  -&gt; ISP<br>Bir subnet ichida: switch yetarli.<br>Boshqa subnet'ga: paket default gateway (router)ga ketadi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip route                     # default via 10.0.1.1 -&gt; router (gateway)<br>ip neigh                     # bir subnet'dagi qo'shnilar (switch orqali)<br>traceroute 8.8.8.8           # har hop — router<br># Linux'ning o'zi router bo'lishi mumkin:<br>sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward</pre><p>Bulutda: VPC ichidagi &quot;implicit router&quot; va route table'lar — router vazifasi; subnet — switch segmentiga o'xshash.</p><p>| | Switch | Router | |---|---|---| | Qatlam | L2 | L3 | | Manzil | MAC | IP | | Doira | bitta LAN/VLAN | tarmoqlar orasida | | Broadcast | uzatadi | to'xtatadi |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;L3 switch&quot; — marshrutlashni ham qiladi; chegara qurilma turida emas, vazifada.</li><li>Ikki subnet'dagi kompyuterlar switch orqali ulangan, lekin gateway yo'q — bir-birini ko'rmaydi.</li><li>Switch'da loop (ikki kabel) — broadcast storm; STP himoya qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bulut va K8s'da bu tushunchalar virtual (route table, CNI), lekin debug mantiqi bir xil: &quot;manzil o'z subnet'imdami (L2) yoki gateway orqali (L3)?&quot; — <code>ip route get &lt;IP&gt;</code> bitta buyruqda javob beradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34313	<p>Port nima va nechta port bor?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Port — bitta IP manzildagi turli servislarni ajratuvchi 16-bit raqam: 0 dan 65535 gacha (jami 65 536 ta), TCP va UDP uchun alohida. IP — &quot;qaysi kompyuter&quot;, port — &quot;shu kompyuterdagi qaysi dastur&quot;.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> bitta serverda nginx (443), PostgreSQL (5432), SSH (22) bir vaqtda ishlaydi. OS kelgan paketni port raqamiga qarab to'g'ri dasturga beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>0-1023        well-known (22 SSH, 80 HTTP, 443 HTTPS) — Linux'da bind uchun root/CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE<br>1024-49151    registered (3306 MySQL, 5432 PostgreSQL, 6379 Redis)<br>49152-65535   dynamic/ephemeral — klient chiquvchi ulanishlari uchun<br>Linux ephemeral diapazoni: /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range (32768-60999)<br>Ulanish noyobligi: (protokol, src IP, src port, dst IP, dst port)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -tlnp                         # tinglayotgan TCP portlar va jarayonlar<br>ss -tnp state established        # faol ulanishlar<br>sudo lsof -i :8080               # 8080 ni kim egallagan<br>cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range<br>nc -zv example.com 443</pre><p><code>ss -tlnp</code> chiqishi: <code>LISTEN 0 4096 0.0.0.0:443 ... users:((&quot;nginx&quot;,pid=812))</code> — 0.0.0.0 = barcha interfeys.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Address already in use&quot; — port boshqa jarayonda band (yoki eski ulanish TIME_WAIT'da; server'da <code>SO_REUSEADDR</code>).</li><li>1024 dan kichik portni oddiy user ochmoqchi — ruxsat yo'q; capability yoki reverse proxy.</li><li>Faqat kerakli portlarni oching — har ochiq port hujum yuzasi.</li><li>Juda ko'p chiquvchi ulanish — ephemeral portlar tugaydi (bir manzilga ~28 000).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container dunyosida port to'qnashuvi kam (har pod o'z IP'siga ega), lekin node darajasida (hostPort, NodePort 30000-32767) va NAT'da port tugashi hali ham real production muammo.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34314	<p>Socket nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Socket — dastur uchun tarmoq aloqasining &quot;uchi&quot;: OS bergan ob'ekt (Linux'da file descriptor), u orqali ma'lumot yuboriladi va qabul qilinadi. TCP socket'i IP + port + protokol bilan aniqlanadi; ulanish ikki socket orasida. Bundan tashqari <b>Unix domain socket</b> — bitta mashina ichidagi jarayonlar orasidagi aloqa (fayl yo'li orqali, masalan <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code>).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Server:  socket() -&gt; bind(0.0.0.0:8080) -&gt; listen() -&gt; accept() -&gt; yangi socket har klient uchun<br>Klient:  socket() -&gt; connect(server:8080) -&gt; send()/recv()<br>ss chiqishida har qator = socket:<br>  LISTEN      0.0.0.0:8080                 (tinglovchi)<br>  ESTAB       10.0.1.5:8080 &lt;-&gt; 10.0.2.7:51234   (ulanish)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -tanp                          # barcha TCP socket'lar holati bilan<br>ss -xlp                           # Unix domain socket'lar<br>ls -l /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/fd | grep socket   # jarayon ochgan socket'lar<br>ulimit -n                         # bitta jarayonga ruxsat etilgan fd soni<br>python3 -c &quot;import socket; s=socket.create_connection(('example.com',80)); print(s.getsockname())&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har socket — file descriptor; ko'p ulanishli server <code>ulimit -n</code> (default 1024) ga urilib &quot;too many open files&quot; beradi.</li><li>Socket yopilmasa (leak) — fd va ulanishlar to'planadi; <code>ss</code> da CLOSE_WAIT ko'payishi — ilova socket'ni yopmayapti.</li><li>Unix socket fayl huquqlari — <code>docker.sock</code> ga yozish huquqi = host'da root huquqi. Uni container'ga mount qilmang va guruhini cheklang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Socket holatlari (<code>ss -s</code>, CLOSE_WAIT, TIME_WAIT soni) — ilovaning ulanishni qanday boshqarishini ko'rsatadigan bepul diagnostika; ulanish pool'lari va keep-alive sozlamalari to'g'riligini shu bilan tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34315	<p><code>curl</code> va <code>wget</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>curl</b> — ko'p protokolli (HTTP/1-3, FTP, SMTP...) uzatish vositasi va kutubxona (libcurl): API so'rovlari, header'lar, metodlar, TLS va vaqtni debug qilish uchun; default natijani stdout'ga chiqaradi. <b>wget</b> — fayl <b>yuklab olish</b>ga yo'naltirilgan: default faylga saqlaydi, uzilgan yuklashni davom ettiradi (<code>-c</code>), rekursiv yuklash/sayt nusxasi (<code>-r</code>, <code>--mirror</code>).</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b> API test, HTTP debug, skriptdagi so'rov — curl. Katta fayl yoki ko'p fayl yuklash, sekin tarmoqda qayta urinish — wget. Ko'p minimal container image'larda faqat bittasi (yoki BusyBox varianti) bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -sS https://api.example.com/v1/users -H &quot;Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN&quot; | jq .<br>curl -X POST -d '{&quot;a&quot;:1}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://api.example.com/x<br>curl -fL -o app.tar.gz https://example.com/app.tar.gz       # -f: HTTP xatoda exit != 0<br>curl -C - -O https://example.com/big.iso                     # davom ettirish<br><br>wget https://example.com/app.tar.gz<br>wget -c https://example.com/big.iso                          # uzilgan joydan<br>wget -q -O - https://example.com | head                      # stdout'ga<br>wget --tries=5 --timeout=10 https://example.com/file</pre><p>| | curl | wget | |---|---|---| | Default chiqish | stdout | fayl | | API/metod/header | kuchli | cheklangan | | Rekursiv yuklash | yo'q | bor | | Davom ettirish | <code>-C -</code> | <code>-c</code> |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>curl</code> default'da HTTP 404/500'da ham exit 0 qaytaradi — skriptda <code>-f</code> (yoki <code>--fail-with-body</code>) ishlating.</li><li><code>curl ... | sh</code> — tekshirilmagan skriptni bajarish xavfli; avval yuklab, ko'rib, checksum/imzoni tekshiring.</li><li><code>-k</code> / <code>--no-check-certificate</code> — TLS tekshiruvini o'chiradi, faqat lokal debug uchun.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container health check va CI skriptlarda curl <code>-fsS --retry 3 --max-time 10</code> kabi qat'iy flag'lar bilan ishlatilsin — aks holda xatolar jimgina o'tib ketadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34316	<p><code>traceroute</code> / <code>mtr</code> nima ko'rsatadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>traceroute</code> — manzilgacha bo'lgan yo'ldagi har bir router (hop) va unga yetish vaqtini ko'rsatadi. <code>mtr</code> — traceroute va ping'ning birikmasi: yo'lni uzluksiz tekshirib, har hop uchun paket yo'qotish (Loss%) va kechikish statistikasini (o'rtacha, eng yomon, tebranish) beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;server sekin&quot; — muammo bizning tarmoqdami, provider'dami yoki manzil serverdami? Yo'lning qaysi qismida kechikish yoki yo'qotish boshlanganini ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>TTL=1 paket -&gt; 1-router TTL'ni 0 qiladi -&gt; &quot;Time Exceeded&quot; qaytaradi -&gt; hop 1<br>TTL=2 ...                                                          -&gt; hop 2<br>... manzilgacha<br>* * * = shu hop javob bermadi (ICMP bloklangan) — har doim muammo emas</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>traceroute example.com<br>traceroute -T -p 443 example.com     # TCP bilan (firewall ICMP/UDP'ni bloklasa)<br>mtr example.com                      # interaktiv<br>mtr -rwc 100 example.com             # 100 paketli hisobot</pre><p>Hisobotni o'qish:</p><pre>HOST                Loss%  Snt  Avg   Wrst<br>1. 10.0.0.1          0.0%  100  0.5   1.2<br>2. isp-gw            0.0%  100  3.1   8.0<br>3. core-router      40.0%  100  9.8   12.0   &lt;- faqat shu hop'da loss<br>4. example.com       0.0%  100  10.2  14.0   &lt;- oxirida 0% -&gt; muammo yo'q</pre><p>Agar loss 3-hop'dan <b>oxirigacha</b> davom etsa — muammo o'sha joydan boshlanadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>O'rtadagi hop'dagi yo'qotish — ko'pincha router ICMP javoblarini cheklayotgani (normal).</li><li>Qaytish yo'li boshqa bo'lishi mumkin — traceroute faqat bir tomonni ko'rsatadi.</li><li>Bulut ichida ko'p hop'lar yashirin (<code>* * *</code>) — bu normal.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provider'ga shikoyat qilishda <code>mtr -rwc 200</code> natijasini ikkala yo'nalishda (siz -&gt; ular, ular -&gt; siz) ilova qiling; bu tarmoq muhandislari tushunadigan va jiddiy qabul qiladigan dalil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34317	<p>Latency va bandwidth farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Latency</b> — bitta ma'lumot birligining manzilga yetish vaqti (ms), &quot;qancha tez boshlanadi&quot;. <b>Bandwidth</b> — vaqt birligida o'tkazish mumkin bo'lgan maksimal hajm (Mbps/Gbps), &quot;quvur qanchalik keng&quot;. <b>Throughput</b> — amalda erishilgan tezlik. Ular mustaqil: sun'iy yo'ldosh internet — keng (yuqori bandwidth), lekin sekin javob (600ms latency).</p><p><b>Nega farq muhim:</b> ko'p kichik so'rovli ilova (API chaqiruvlari, DB query'lar) latency'ga sezgir — bandwidth'ni oshirish yordam bermaydi. Katta fayl ko'chirish (backup) bandwidth'ga sezgir.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>O'xshatish: avtomagistral<br>  bandwidth = qatorlar soni<br>  latency   = A dan B gacha yurish vaqti<br>1 KB javob, 100 Mbps, RTT 150ms  -&gt; ~150ms (latency hukmron)<br>10 GB fayl, 100 Mbps, RTT 1ms    -&gt; ~14 daqiqa (bandwidth hukmron)<br>TCP: bitta oqim throughput &lt;= oyna / RTT  (yuqori RTT -&gt; pastroq tezlik)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ping -c 10 api.example.com                     # RTT (latency)<br>mtr -rwc 50 api.example.com<br>iperf3 -c iperf-server -t 20                   # bandwidth/throughput<br>iperf3 -c iperf-server -P 8                    # parallel oqimlar<br>curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_connect} %{time_starttransfer} %{speed_download}\n' https://example.com/big</pre><p>Yo'naltiruvchi raqamlar: bitta AZ ichida &lt;1ms, region ichida AZ'lar orasida ~1-2ms, Yevropa-AQSh ~80-100ms.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Sekin&quot; deyilganda faqat bandwidth'ni oshirish — muammo latency'da bo'lsa foydasiz.</li><li>Chatty protokol: bitta sahifa uchun 50 ketma-ket DB so'rovi x 2ms = 100ms; region'lararo bo'lsa 50 x 80ms = 4s.</li><li>O'rtacha latency'ga qarash — p99'ni ko'ring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Latency'ni kamaytirish yo'llari: yaqinlik (ilova va DB bir AZ/region'da, CDN), so'rovlar sonini kamaytirish (batch, kesh), ulanishni qayta ishlatish (keep-alive, pool). Arxitekturada region'lararo sinxron chaqiruvlardan qoching.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34318	<p>HTTP va HTTPS farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>HTTP</b> — ochiq matn: trafikni yo'ldagi har kim (Wi-Fi, provider, proxy) o'qiy va o'zgartira oladi. <b>HTTPS</b> — HTTP + <b>TLS</b>: shifrlash (maxfiylik), yaxlitlik (o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi) va server autentifikatsiyasi (sertifikat orqali &quot;bu haqiqatan bank.uz&quot;). Default portlar: 80 va 443.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> HTTP orqali login — parol ochiq ketadi; umumiy Wi-Fi'dagi hujumchi sessiya cookie'sini o'g'irlaydi yoki sahifaga zararli skript qo'shadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (TLS 1.3, soddalashtirilgan):</b></p><pre>client -&gt; ClientHello (qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan shifrlar, key share)<br>server -&gt; ServerHello + sertifikat + imzo (key share)<br>client: sertifikat zanjirini tekshiradi (ishonchli CA? domen mos? muddati?)<br>ikkala tomon umumiy kalit hisoblaydi -&gt; shifrlangan HTTP<br>TLS 1.3: 1 RTT (qayta ulanishda 0-RTT mumkin)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -vI https://example.com 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -E &quot;SSL connection|subject|expire|issuer&quot;<br>openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 -servername example.com &lt;/dev/null 2&gt;/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates -subject</pre><pre>server { listen 80; server_name example.com; return 301 https://$host$request_uri; }<br>server {<br>  listen 443 ssl;<br>  http2 on;<br>  ssl_certificate     /etc/letsencrypt/live/example.com/fullchain.pem;<br>  ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/example.com/privkey.pem;<br>  ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;<br>  add_header Strict-Transport-Security &quot;max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains&quot; always;<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat login sahifasi HTTPS — boshqa sahifalarda cookie ochiq ketadi; butun sayt HTTPS bo'lsin, cookie'lar <code>Secure</code>.</li><li>HSTS'siz birinchi HTTP so'rovni hujumchi ushlab qolishi mumkin (SSL stripping).</li><li>Eski TLS 1.0/1.1 va zaif shifrlar — o'chiring.</li><li>Sertifikat muddati tugashi — avtomatlashtirilgan yangilash va monitoring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bugun HTTPS — standart, hatto ichki trafik uchun ham (zero trust, mTLS). TLS'ni qayerda tugatish (LB, ingress, pod) va ichki qism shifrlanadimi — ongli arxitektura qarori bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34319	<p>HTTP methodlari: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>GET</b> — resursni o'qish (body yo'q, xavfsiz, idempotent, keshlanadi). <b>POST</b> — yangi resurs yaratish yoki amal (idempotent emas: ikki marta = ikki buyurtma). <b>PUT</b> — resursni to'liq almashtirish (idempotent). <b>PATCH</b> — qisman o'zgartirish (odatda idempotent emas deb hisoblanadi). <b>DELETE</b> — o'chirish (idempotent). Qo'shimcha: HEAD (faqat header'lar), OPTIONS (CORS preflight, ruxsat etilgan metodlar).</p><p><b>Nega idempotentlik muhim:</b> tarmoq uzildi, javob kelmadi — klient yoki proxy qayta yuboradimi? GET/PUT/DELETE'ni xavfsiz qayta yuborish mumkin; POST'ni qayta yuborish ikki marta to'lovga olib kelishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GET    /orders/42           -&gt; 200 + buyurtma<br>POST   /orders   {..}       -&gt; 201 Created + Location: /orders/43<br>PUT    /orders/42 {to'liq}  -&gt; 200/204 (hammasi almashtiriladi)<br>PATCH  /orders/42 {status}  -&gt; 200 (faqat status)<br>DELETE /orders/42           -&gt; 204 ; qayta DELETE -&gt; 404 yoki 204 (holat bir xil)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -s https://api.example.com/orders/42<br>curl -s -X POST https://api.example.com/orders -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \<br>  -H 'Idempotency-Key: 7c1e-...' -d '{&quot;item&quot;:&quot;book&quot;,&quot;qty&quot;:1}'<br>curl -s -X PATCH https://api.example.com/orders/42 -d '{&quot;status&quot;:&quot;paid&quot;}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'<br>curl -s -X DELETE https://api.example.com/orders/42 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n'<br>curl -sI https://api.example.com/orders/42          # HEAD</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>GET bilan holat o'zgartirish (<code>GET /delete?id=5</code>) — crawler, prefetch yoki CSRF bilan tasodifan o'chiriladi.</li><li>POST'ni retry qilish (LB, klient kutubxonasi) — dublikat; <code>Idempotency-Key</code> header'i va server tomonda tekshiruv.</li><li>PUT'ni PATCH sifatida ishlatish — yuborilmagan maydonlar o'chib ketadi.</li><li>Maxfiy ma'lumotni GET query'da yuborish — URL log'larga tushadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Retry siyosati metod semantikasiga bog'liq bo'lsin: proxy/mesh'da avtomatik retry faqat idempotent metodlar uchun; to'lov kabi POST'lar uchun idempotency key — majburiy dizayn elementi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34320	<p>HTTP header'lariga misollar?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Header — so'rov/javobning metadata qismi (<code>Nom: qiymat</code>). So'rov misollari: <code>Host</code>, <code>User-Agent</code>, <code>Accept</code>, <code>Content-Type</code>, <code>Authorization</code>, <code>Cookie</code>, <code>X-Forwarded-For</code>, <code>traceparent</code>. Javob misollari: <code>Content-Type</code>, <code>Cache-Control</code>, <code>Set-Cookie</code>, <code>Location</code>, <code>Retry-After</code>, <code>Strict-Transport-Security</code>, <code>Content-Security-Policy</code>, <code>X-Content-Type-Options</code>.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> keshlash, autentifikatsiya, proxy orqasidagi klient IP, CORS, xavfsizlik — hammasi header'lar orqali. Ko'p &quot;g'alati&quot; xatolar (CORS, redirect sikli, kesh) header'ni ko'rib hal qilinadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -sI https://example.com                       # javob header'lari<br>curl -sv https://example.com -o /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep '^&gt;'   # yuborilgan so'rov header'lari<br>curl -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.example.com/me</pre><pre>HTTP/2 200<br>content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8<br>cache-control: no-store<br>strict-transport-security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains<br>x-content-type-options: nosniff<br>content-security-policy: default-src 'self'<br>x-request-id: 7f3a...</pre><p>| Header | Vazifa | |---|---| | <code>Host</code> | qaysi sayt (virtual host, ingress) | | <code>Cache-Control</code> | kesh qoidasi | | <code>X-Forwarded-For/Proto</code> | proxy orqasidagi klient IP/protokol | | <code>Retry-After</code> | 429/503 dan keyin qachon qayta urinish | | <code>HSTS</code>, <code>CSP</code> | brauzer xavfsizlik siyosati |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Server: nginx/1.18.0</code> yoki <code>X-Powered-By</code> — versiyani oshkor qiladi; yashiring (<code>server_tokens off</code>).</li><li><code>X-Forwarded-For</code>ni tashqi klientdan qabul qilib ishonish — IP soxtalashtiriladi; faqat ishonchli proxy'dan.</li><li>Header'lardagi <code>Authorization</code>/<code>Cookie</code>ni log'larga yozish.</li><li>Header nomlari katta-kichik harfga sezgir emas; HTTP/2 da hammasi kichik harf.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xavfsizlik header'larini (HSTS, CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors) ilova kodida emas, edge'da (ingress/CDN) markaziy qo'llang va skaner (securityheaders.com, ZAP) bilan muntazam tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34321	<p>Reverse proxy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Reverse proxy — klientlar va backend serverlar orasida turadigan server: klient proxy'ga ulanadi, proxy so'rovni ichki backend'ga uzatadi va javobni qaytaradi. Vazifalari: TLS tugatish, load balancing, marshrutlash (domen/path bo'yicha), keshlash, siqish, rate limiting, xavfsizlik header'lari, backend'larni tashqaridan yashirish. Misollar: nginx, HAProxy, Envoy, Traefik, Caddy, K8s ingress controller'lar.</p><p><b>Farq:</b> forward proxy — klient tomonida (foydalanuvchilar internetga chiqishi uchun); reverse proxy — server tomonida (internet sizning servislaringizga kirishi uchun).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client --HTTPS--&gt; [reverse proxy :443]<br>                     | TLS tugatish, rate limit, header'lar<br>                     +--/api--&gt; api-1:8080, api-2:8080 (LB)<br>                     +--/   --&gt; web:3000<br>                     +--/static -&gt; kesh<br>Backend'lar private tarmoqda, faqat proxy ularga ulanadi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>upstream api { server 10.0.2.11:8080; server 10.0.2.12:8080; keepalive 32; }<br>server {<br>  listen 443 ssl;<br>  server_name shop.example.com;<br>  location /api/ {<br>    proxy_pass http://api;<br>    proxy_http_version 1.1;<br>    proxy_set_header Connection &quot;&quot;;<br>    proxy_set_header Host $host;<br>    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;<br>    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>nginx -t &amp;&amp; systemctl reload nginx</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>X-Forwarded-*</code> header'larsiz backend klient IP'si va HTTPS ekanini bilmaydi (redirect sikllari, noto'g'ri log).</li><li>Proxy va backend timeout'lari mos emas — 502/504.</li><li>Proxy — yagona nosozlik nuqtasi; kamida ikki nusxa yoki managed LB.</li><li>Backend'larga tashqaridan to'g'ridan kirish ham ochiq qolgan — proxy'ni chetlab o'tib himoya qatlamlarini aylanib o'tish mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Reverse proxy — kesishuvchi vazifalar (TLS, auth, rate limit, observability) uchun tabiiy joy; lekin ko'p biznes mantiqini u yerga qo'ymang — konfiguratsiya kodga aylanib, test qilish qiyinlashadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34322	<p>Load balancer nima va algoritmlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Load balancer (LB) — kiruvchi trafikni bir nechta backend server orasida taqsimlaydi, sog'lom bo'lmaganlarini health check orqali chiqaradi va masshtablash hamda yuqori mavjudlikni ta'minlaydi. Algoritmlar: <b>round robin</b>, <b>weighted round robin</b>, <b>least connections</b>, <b>least response time</b>, <b>IP hash / consistent hashing</b> (sticky), <b>random (power of two choices)</b>. L4 LB (TCP/UDP darajasida) va L7 LB (HTTP: path, header bo'yicha) bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>                 +--&gt; app-1 (healthy)<br>client --&gt; LB ---+--&gt; app-2 (healthy)<br>                 +--x app-3 (health check fail -&gt; chiqarilgan)<br>Round robin:       1,2,3,1,2,3 ...<br>Least connections: eng kam faol ulanishlisiga<br>IP hash:           hash(client IP) -&gt; doim bir server (sessiya)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>upstream api {<br>  least_conn;<br>  server 10.0.2.11:8080 weight=2 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;<br>  server 10.0.2.12:8080;<br>  server 10.0.2.13:8080 backup;<br>}</pre><pre>aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn $TG    # target'lar holati<br>for i in $(seq 1 6); do curl -s https://api.example.com/whoami; done   # taqsimotni ko'rish</pre><p>| Algoritm | Qachon | |---|---| | Round robin | bir xil server'lar, qisqa so'rovlar | | Least connections | uzoq/notekis so'rovlar (WebSocket) | | Consistent hash | kesh lokalligi, sessiya | | Weighted | turli quvvatli server'lar, canary |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sticky session — bitta server haddan yuklanadi va o'lsa sessiyalar yo'qoladi; holatni Redis'ga chiqaring.</li><li>Health check juda yengil (faqat port) yoki juda og'ir (DB'ga so'rov) — noto'g'ri qaror.</li><li>LB'ning o'zi bitta nusxa — managed LB yoki HA juftlik.</li><li>Uzoq ulanishlar (gRPC, HTTP/2) L4 LB'da bitta backend'ga &quot;yopishib&quot; qoladi — L7 LB kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta tizimlarda &quot;power of two choices&quot; (ikki tasodifiy backend'dan kamroq yuklanganini tanlash) oddiy va samarali; muhimi — LB qarorlari backend sog'lig'ini (latency, xato) hisobga olsin va health check ilovaning haqiqiy tayyorligini aks ettirsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34323	<p>DNS'da A va CNAME record farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>A record</b> — domen nomini to'g'ridan <b>IPv4 manzil</b>ga bog'laydi (<code>api.example.com -&gt; 93.184.216.34</code>). <b>CNAME</b> — nomni <b>boshqa nom</b>ga taxallus qiladi (<code>www.example.com -&gt; example.netlify.app</code>); resolver keyin o'sha nomning A/AAAA'sini topadi. Asosiy cheklov: CNAME zona apex'ida (example.com) va boshqa record'lar bilan bir nomda turolmaydi.</p><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b> IP barqaror va sizniki bo'lsa — A. Manzil provider tomonidan boshqarilsa va IP o'zgarishi mumkin bo'lsa (CDN, LB, SaaS) — CNAME (yoki provider ALIAS).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>dig www.example.com<br>  www.example.com.   300 IN CNAME  shop.cdn-provider.net.<br>  shop.cdn-provider.net. 60 IN A   151.101.1.1<br>dig api.example.com<br>  api.example.com.   300 IN A      93.184.216.34</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig www.example.com +short          # CNAME zanjiri, keyin IP<br>dig api.example.com A +short<br>dig example.com CNAME +short</pre><pre>resource &quot;aws_route53_record&quot; &quot;www&quot; {<br>  zone_id = var.zone_id<br>  name    = &quot;www.example.com&quot;<br>  type    = &quot;CNAME&quot;<br>  ttl     = 300<br>  records = [&quot;shop.cdn-provider.net&quot;]<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_route53_record&quot; &quot;apex&quot; {   # apex uchun ALIAS<br>  zone_id = var.zone_id<br>  name    = &quot;example.com&quot;<br>  type    = &quot;A&quot;<br>  alias { name = aws_lb.main.dns_name, zone_id = aws_lb.main.zone_id, evaluate_target_health = true }<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Apex'da CNAME — standart buzilishi, MX/NS bilan to'qnashadi; ALIAS/ANAME yoki CNAME flattening ishlating.</li><li>Uzun CNAME zanjirlari — har biri qo'shimcha DNS so'rovi va nosozlik nuqtasi.</li><li>Provider'dagi resurs o'chirildi, CNAME qoldi (&quot;dangling&quot;) — boshqa odam o'sha nomni o'zi uchun ro'yxatdan o'tkazib subdomeningizni egallashi mumkin (subdomain takeover). Resurs o'chirilganda DNS'ni ham tozalang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bulut LB'lari IP'ni o'zgartiradi — ularga hech qachon A record bilan IP yozmang; ALIAS/CNAME ishlating. DNS yozuvlarini IaC'da saqlab, egasiz yozuvlarni davriy audit qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34324	<p>DNS TTL nima va migratsiyada nega muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TTL (Time To Live) — DNS javobi resolver va klientlarda <b>qancha soniya keshlanishi</b>. Migratsiyada muhim, chunki IP'ni o'zgartirganingizdan keyin ham eski javob TTL tugaguncha keshlarda yashaydi — foydalanuvchilarning bir qismi eski serverga boradi. Shuning uchun migratsiyadan <b>oldin</b> TTL'ni kamaytirasiz (masalan 3600 -&gt; 60), eski TTL o'tishini kutasiz, keyin record'ni o'zgartirasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>T-48h: TTL 3600 -&gt; 60 ga tushirildi (eski 3600 keshlar 1 soatda tugaydi)<br>T-0:   A record: 1.1.1.1 -&gt; 2.2.2.2<br>T+60s: deyarli barcha resolver'lar yangi IP'ni oladi<br>T+1d:  hammasi joyida -&gt; TTL yana 3600 ga<br>Eski server ba'zi &quot;TTL'ni hurmat qilmaydigan&quot; klientlar uchun bir muddat ishlab tursin.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig api.example.com +noall +answer          # 2-ustun = qolgan TTL<br>dig @ns1.provider.com api.example.com       # authoritative'dan (asl TTL)<br>dig @8.8.8.8 api.example.com; dig @1.1.1.1 api.example.com   # turli resolver'lardagi holat</pre><p>Odatiy qiymatlar: barqaror yozuvlar 3600-86400, tez o'zgaruvchan/failover 30-300.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>TTL'ni o'zgarish bilan <b>bir vaqtda</b> kamaytirish — foydasiz, chunki keshlarda eski (uzun) TTL bilan yozuv bor.</li><li>Juda past TTL doimiy — DNS so'rovlari va xarajati oshadi, DNS provider muammosida chidamlilik kamayadi.</li><li>Ba'zi klientlar (JVM default kesh, eski kutubxonalar, ilova ichidagi kesh) TTL'ni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi — eski server'ni darhol o'chirmang, trafikni kuzating.</li><li>Negativ javob (NXDOMAIN) ham keshlanadi (SOA minimum) — yangi yozuv qo'shishdan oldin so'ralgan bo'lsa kechikadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS asosidagi migratsiya — &quot;sekin rubilnik&quot;: rejalashtiring, eski tomonni kuzatib, trafik nolga tushgach o'chiring. Tez va aniq almashtirish kerak bo'lsa DNS emas, LB darajasida (weighted target group) qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34325	<p>MX, TXT, NS record'lari nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>MX</b> — domen uchun pochta qabul qiluvchi serverlar (prioritet bilan: kichik raqam = yuqori prioritet). <b>TXT</b> — erkin matn: SPF (kim domen nomidan xat yubora oladi), DKIM (xat imzosi public kaliti), DMARC (tekshiruv muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa nima qilish), domen egaligini tasdiqlash (Google, ACME DNS-01). <b>NS</b> — zona qaysi authoritative DNS serverlarda ekanligi (delegatsiya).</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> SPF/DKIM/DMARC yo'q — hujumchi <code>ceo@company.uz</code> nomidan phishing xat yuboradi va u qabul qilinadi; yoki kompaniya xatlari spam'ga tushadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>xat yuborish: kimgadir@company.uz -&gt; dig MX company.uz -&gt; 10 mx1.mail.provider<br>qabul qiluvchi tekshiradi:<br>   SPF:   yuboruvchi IP TXT &quot;v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com -all&quot; ichidami?<br>   DKIM:  imzo selector._domainkey.company.uz TXT kaliti bilan mosmi?<br>   DMARC: _dmarc.company.uz &quot;p=reject&quot; -&gt; mos kelmasa rad et<br>NS: .uz TLD -&gt; &quot;company.uz NS: ns1.provider, ns2.provider&quot; -&gt; zona shu yerda</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig company.uz MX +short          # 10 mx1.example.net.<br>dig company.uz TXT +short         # &quot;v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com -all&quot;<br>dig _dmarc.company.uz TXT +short  # &quot;v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@company.uz&quot;<br>dig google._domainkey.company.uz TXT +short<br>dig company.uz NS +short</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir nechta SPF record — ikkalasi ham bekor bo'ladi; bitta TXT'da birlashtiring. SPF 10 ta DNS lookup limitiga ega.</li><li>DMARC'ni darhol <code>p=reject</code> — legitim xatlar (marketing servis) yo'qoladi; <code>p=none</code> + hisobotlar bilan boshlang.</li><li>NS'ni registrar'da o'zgartirish — TLD darajasidagi TTL uzun (kunlab); oldindan rejalashtiring.</li><li>Ishlatilmaydigan domenlar ham himoyalansin: <code>v=spf1 -all</code> va <code>p=reject</code> — soxtalashtirishga qarshi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pochta autentifikatsiyasi (SPF + DKIM + DMARC enforcement) — 2024 dan beri Google/Yahoo katta yuboruvchilar uchun majburiy; DMARC hisobotlarini kuzatish domeningiz nomidan kim xat yuborayotganini ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34326	<p>Firewall nima va stateful firewall nima degani?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Firewall — trafikni qoidalar asosida (manba/manzil IP, port, protokol, holat) o'tkazadigan yoki bloklaydigan tizim. <b>Stateful</b> firewall ulanishlar holatini eslaydi (connection tracking): ichkaridan boshlangan ulanishning <b>javob</b> paketlarini avtomatik o'tkazadi, shuning uchun har yo'nalishga alohida qoida yozish shart emas. <b>Stateless</b> firewall har paketni alohida baholaydi — javob trafigi uchun ham aniq qoida kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Stateful (iptables conntrack, AWS Security Group):<br>  server -&gt; 1.2.3.4:443  (chiquvchi ruxsat) -&gt; conntrack: ESTABLISHED<br>  1.2.3.4:443 -&gt; server:51234 javob -&gt; holat mos -&gt; o'tadi (alohida qoidasiz)<br>Stateless (AWS Network ACL):<br>  javob ephemeral portga (1024-65535) keladi -&gt; inbound qoida bo'lmasa tashlanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># nftables/iptables (stateful asosiy shablon)<br>iptables -A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT<br>iptables -A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT<br>iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT<br>iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT<br>iptables -P INPUT DROP<br># ufw (oddiyroq)<br>ufw default deny incoming &amp;&amp; ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/16 to any port 22 &amp;&amp; ufw allow 443/tcp &amp;&amp; ufw enable<br>conntrack -L | head</pre><p>| | Security Group (AWS) | Network ACL (AWS) | |---|---|---| | Holat | stateful | stateless | | Qoidalar | faqat allow | allow + deny | | Daraja | instance/ENI | subnet |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Masofadagi serverda <code>DROP</code> siyosatini SSH ruxsatidan oldin qo'llash — o'zingizni qulflab qo'yasiz.</li><li>NACL'da ephemeral portlarni unutish — chiquvchi ulanishlar javobsiz qoladi.</li><li>Faqat kirishni cheklab, chiqishni ochiq qoldirish — buzilgan server ma'lumotni tashqariga bemalol yuboradi.</li><li>Conntrack jadvali to'lishi (<code>nf_conntrack: table full</code>) — yuqori yukda paketlar tashlanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Default deny&quot; va eng kam ruxsat — ham kirish, ham chiqish uchun. Qoidalarni IaC'da saqlang, sabab/egasi bilan izohlang va ishlatilmayotgan qoidalarni flow log'lar asosida tozalang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34327	<p>VPN nima va nega ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VPN (Virtual Private Network) — ochiq tarmoq (internet) ustida <b>shifrlangan tunnel</b> yaratib, masofadagi qurilma yoki ofisni xususiy tarmoqqa xuddi ichida turgandek ulaydi. Ishlatiladi: xodimlarning ichki resurslarga xavfsiz kirishi (remote access), ofis/DC va bulut VPC'ni ulash (site-to-site), umumiy Wi-Fi'da trafikni himoyalash. Protokollar: WireGuard, IPsec, OpenVPN.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> ichki DB, admin panel, kubelet yoki Grafana internetga ochiq bo'lmasligi kerak, lekin muhandislar uydan ishlashi kerak. VPN ularni faqat autentifikatsiyalangan foydalanuvchilarga ochadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Remote access:<br>  noutbuk --[WireGuard shifrlangan UDP 51820]--&gt; VPN gateway --&gt; 10.0.0.0/16 (private)<br>Site-to-site:<br>  ofis router &lt;==IPsec tunnel==&gt; AWS VPN Gateway &lt;-&gt; VPC<br>Tunnel ichidagi paketlar o'ralgan va shifrlangan; tashqaridan faqat gateway IP'lari ko'rinadi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf (klient)<br>[Interface]<br>PrivateKey = &lt;klient-private&gt;<br>Address = 10.8.0.2/32<br>[Peer]<br>PublicKey = &lt;server-public&gt;<br>Endpoint = vpn.example.com:51820<br>AllowedIPs = 10.0.0.0/16          # faqat ichki tarmoq tunnel orqali (split tunnel)<br>PersistentKeepalive = 25</pre><pre>wg-quick up wg0 &amp;&amp; wg show<br>ip route get 10.0.2.15            # tunnel orqali ketyaptimi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>VPN'ga kirgan har kim butun tarmoqqa kiradi (&quot;flat network&quot;) — buzilgan noutbuk = butun ichki tarmoq. Segmentatsiya va qo'shimcha autentifikatsiya kerak.</li><li>Parol bilan VPN, MFA'siz — credential o'g'irlash bilan kirish; MFA va SSO majburiy.</li><li>VPN qurilmalari (Fortinet, Ivanti, Pulse va h.k.)ning zaifliklari ko'p ekspluatatsiya qilingan — tez yangilash.</li><li>MTU muammolari (tunnel header) — katta paketlar qotadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy yondashuv — &quot;VPN = tarmoqqa ishonch&quot; o'rniga zero trust/identity-aware access (Tailscale, Cloudflare Access, AWS Verified Access, IAP): har ilovaga kirish foydalanuvchi va qurilma holatiga qarab alohida tekshiriladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34328	<p>Bastion host (jump host) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bastion host (jump host) — public tarmoqdan kirish mumkin bo'lgan <b>yagona</b>, qattiq himoyalangan server; private subnet'dagi serverlarga SSH faqat u orqali qilinadi. Shunda yuzlab server o'rniga faqat bitta kirish nuqtasini himoyalash, kuzatish va audit qilish kerak bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> har serverda 22-port internetga ochiq — har biri brute force va zaiflik skanerlarining nishoni, kim qayerga kirgani noma'lum.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>admin --SSH (MFA, kalit)--&gt; bastion (public subnet, SG: faqat ofis IP/VPN)<br>                              |<br>                              +--SSH--&gt; app-1 (private, SG: faqat bastion SG'dan)<br>                              +--SSH--&gt; db-1  (private)<br>Barcha sessiyalar bastion'da log qilinadi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ssh -J admin@bastion.example.com admin@10.0.2.15          # ProxyJump<br># ~/.ssh/config<br>Host bastion<br>  HostName bastion.example.com<br>  User admin<br>Host 10.0.2.*<br>  ProxyJump bastion<br>  User admin<br>ssh 10.0.2.15</pre><p>Bastion'ni qattiqlashtirish: faqat kalit autentifikatsiya (<code>PasswordAuthentication no</code>), root login yo'q, MFA, minimal paketlar, avtomatik yangilanish, SG'da faqat ma'lum IP'lar, sessiya yozuvi, qisqa muddatli SSH sertifikatlar.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Agent forwarding (<code>ssh -A</code>) — bastion root'i sizning SSH agentingizdan foydalanib boshqa serverlarga kirishi mumkin; <code>ProxyJump</code> ishlating.</li><li>Private kalitlarni bastion'da saqlash — u buzilsa hamma serverlar ochiq.</li><li>Bastion'ni &quot;barcha uchun 0.0.0.0/0 22&quot; bilan qoldirish.</li><li>Bastion'ning o'zi monitoring va yangilashsiz unutilgan server bo'lib qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bulutda bastion'ning zamonaviy o'rnini bosuvchilar: AWS SSM Session Manager, GCP IAP TCP forwarding, Azure Bastion, Teleport — ochiq port yo'q, IAM bilan kirish va to'liq audit. Imkon bo'lsa SSH'ni umuman kamaytiring (immutable infra, avtomatlashtirish).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34329	<p>Ichki tarmoqdan internetga chiqish va internetdan kirish farqi (NAT gateway)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Chiqish (egress)</b> — ichkaridagi server o'zi ulanish boshlaydi (paket yangilash, tashqi API). Private subnet'da bu <b>NAT Gateway</b> orqali: manba IP NAT'ning public IP'siga almashtiriladi. <b>Kirish (ingress)</b> — tashqaridan kimdir sizning serveringizga ulanadi; NAT bunga ruxsat bermaydi, kirish uchun <b>public LB</b> (yoki Internet Gateway + public IP) kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> private serverni yangilash kerak (internetga chiqish), lekin u tashqaridan ko'rinmasligi kerak. NAT GW aynan shu bir tomonlama yo'lni beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>             Internet<br>                ^  |<br>   chiqish      |  |  kirish<br>                |  v<br>  [NAT GW]  [Internet GW] &lt;- [ALB public subnet'da]<br>     ^ (public subnet)            |<br>     |                            v<br>  [app private subnet] &lt;---- ALB -&gt; app:8080<br> route: 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; NAT GW (chiqish uchun)<br> public subnet route: 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; IGW</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># private serverdan<br>curl -s https://ifconfig.me          # NAT GW public IP chiqadi<br>ip route                             # default via VPC router -&gt; route table -&gt; NAT<br>aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-abc \<br>  --query 'RouteTables[].Routes'</pre><pre>resource &quot;aws_route&quot; &quot;private_out&quot; {<br>  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.private.id<br>  destination_cidr_block = &quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;<br>  nat_gateway_id         = aws_nat_gateway.az_a.id<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NAT GW narxi: soatlik + har GB uchun — S3/ECR/DynamoDB trafigini VPC endpoint'larga o'tkazing.</li><li>Bitta NAT GW — AZ nosozligida boshqa AZ'lar chiqa olmaydi; har AZ'ga bittadan.</li><li>Chiqish nazoratsiz — buzilgan server ma'lumotni istalgan joyga yuboradi; egress filtrlash (AWS Network Firewall, proxy allowlist, DNS firewall).</li><li>IPv6'da NAT o'rniga &quot;egress-only internet gateway&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Egress — xavfsizlik va xarajat chegarasi: qaysi servis qaysi tashqi manzilga chiqishi kerakligini ro'yxatlang va faqat shuni oching; NAT'ning statik IP'si tashqi hamkorlar whitelist'i uchun ham qulay.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34330	<p><code>nc</code> (netcat) bilan port tekshirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>nc</code> (netcat) — TCP/UDP ulanishlarni qo'lda ochish uchun oddiy vosita. Port tekshirish: <code>nc -zv host port</code> — <code>-z</code> ma'lumot yubormasdan faqat ulanib ko'radi, <code>-v</code> natijani batafsil chiqaradi.
