Bundan tashqari: oddiy server tinglash (<code>-l</code>), fayl uzatish, protokolni qo'lda sinash.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;ilova DB'ga ulana olmayapti&quot; — muammo tarmoq/firewall'dami yoki ilova konfiguratsiyasidami? <code>nc</code> bir buyruqda L4 darajasida javob beradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>nc -zv db.internal 5432<br># Connection to db.internal 5432 port [tcp/postgresql] succeeded!   -&gt; port ochiq<br># nc: connect to db.internal port 5432 (tcp) failed: Connection refused  -&gt; host bor, port yopiq<br># (osilib qolib timeout)                                             -&gt; firewall/route<br>nc -zv -w 3 db.internal 5432         # 3 s timeout<br>nc -zv host 20-25                    # port diapazoni<br>nc -zvu 10.0.0.2 53                  # UDP (natija ishonchsiz)<br>nc -l 8080                           # boshqa tomonda: test server<br>echo -e &quot;GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.com\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n&quot; | nc example.com 80<br># Bash'da nc yo'q bo'lsa:<br>timeout 3 bash -c '&lt;/dev/tcp/db.internal/5432' &amp;&amp; echo open || echo closed</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Turli versiyalar (OpenBSD nc, ncat, BusyBox) flag'lari farq qiladi — <code>-z</code> yo'q bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>UDP uchun &quot;succeeded&quot; — javob yo'qligi ham shunday ko'rinishi mumkin; UDP'ni ilova protokoli bilan tekshiring (<code>dig</code> DNS uchun).</li><li>Port ochiq = ilova sog'lom emas: TCP ulanadi, lekin ilova xato qaytarishi mumkin.</li><li>Ruxsatsiz boshqa tarmoqlarni skanerlash — xavfsizlik siyosatini buzadi; faqat o'z infratuzilmangizda.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container'larda <code>nc</code> ko'pincha yo'q — <code>kubectl debug</code> bilan <code>nicolaka/netshoot</code> ephemeral container'i yoki <code>/dev/tcp</code> hiylasi. Tekshiruvni ilova turgan joydan (o'sha pod/subnet'dan) qiling — boshqa joydan natija boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34331	<p>&quot;Connection refused&quot; va &quot;Connection timed out&quot; farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Connection refused</b> — paket manzilga yetdi, lekin o'sha portda hech kim tinglamayapti (yoki firewall REJECT qildi) va darhol TCP RST qaytdi: xato bir zumda keladi. <b>Connection timed out</b> — javob umuman kelmadi: paket yo'lda tashlandi (firewall DROP, security group, noto'g'ri route, host o'chiq) va klient timeout'gacha kutdi.</p><p><b>Nega farq muhim:</b> diagnostika yo'nalishini darhol beradi. Refused -&gt; servis ishlayaptimi, to'g'ri port/interfeysdami? Timeout -&gt; tarmoq yo'li, firewall, security group, route.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Refused:   client --SYN--&gt; host<br>           client &lt;--RST-- host        (port yopiq)        ~ms ichida xato<br>Timeout:   client --SYN--&gt; [firewall DROP] / [host yo'q]<br>           client --SYN (qayta)--&gt;  ...  hech narsa  -&gt; 20-130 s keyin xato</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>nc -zv -w 5 10.0.2.15 8080<br>curl -v --connect-timeout 5 http://10.0.2.15:8080/<br># Refused bo'lsa (server'da):<br>ss -tlnp | grep 8080          # tinglayaptimi? 127.0.0.1:8080 bo'lsa tashqaridan yopiq<br>systemctl status app<br># Timeout bo'lsa:<br>ip route get 10.0.2.15        # yo'l<br>sudo tcpdump -ni any host 10.0.2.15 and port 8080   # SYN ketyaptimi, javob bormi<br>aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-123  # inbound qoidalar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova <code>127.0.0.1</code> da tinglaydi — tashqaridan &quot;refused&quot;.</li><li>K8s'da Service bor, lekin endpoint yo'q — kube-proxy'ga qarab refused yoki timeout bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Timeout har doim firewall emas — server haddan yuklangan, SYN backlog to'lgan bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Ilovadagi ulanish timeout'i default'da juda uzun (masalan 2 daqiqa) — foydalanuvchi so'rovlari osilib qoladi; aniq connect timeout qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ilovalarda connect timeout'ni qisqa (1-3 s), read timeout'ni so'rov turiga mos qo'ying; aks holda tarmoq &quot;qora tuynugi&quot; thread/ulanish pool'larini to'ldirib, kaskadli outage keltiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34332	<p>Nginx'da oddiy reverse proxy konfiguratsiyasi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy reverse proxy: <code>server</code> blokida <code>listen</code> va <code>server_name</code>, <code>location /</code> ichida <code>proxy_pass http://backend;</code> va to'g'ri header'lar (<code>Host</code>, <code>X-Real-IP</code>, <code>X-Forwarded-For</code>, <code>X-Forwarded-Proto</code>). Keyin <code>nginx -t</code> bilan tekshirish va <code>reload</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> ilova 127.0.0.1:3000 da ishlaydi, uni 80/443 portda domen orqali ochish, TLS va bir nechta ilovani bitta serverda xizmat qilish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client -&gt; nginx :80/:443 (server_name bo'yicha tanlaydi)<br>            location /     -&gt; proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000<br>            location /api/ -&gt; proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># /etc/nginx/conf.d/app.conf<br>upstream app_backend {<br>    server 127.0.0.1:3000;<br>    keepalive 16;<br>}<br>server {<br>    listen 80;<br>    server_name app.example.com;<br><br>    client_max_body_size 10m;<br><br>    location / {<br>        proxy_pass http://app_backend;<br>        proxy_http_version 1.1;<br>        proxy_set_header Connection &quot;&quot;;<br>        proxy_set_header Host $host;<br>        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;<br>        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;<br>        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;<br>        proxy_connect_timeout 5s;<br>        proxy_read_timeout 60s;<br>    }<br>}</pre><pre>sudo nginx -t                    # sintaksis tekshiruvi<br>sudo systemctl reload nginx      # uzilishsiz qayta yuklash<br>curl -H 'Host: app.example.com' http://127.0.0.1/<br>tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>proxy_pass http://backend/;</code> (oxirida <code>/</code> bilan) va <code>/</code> siz farqli: birinchisi <code>location</code> prefiksini olib tashlaydi. <code>/api/</code> uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.</li><li>WebSocket uchun <code>Upgrade</code> va <code>Connection &quot;upgrade&quot;</code> header'lari kerak.</li><li>SELinux yoqilgan tizimda nginx tarmoqqa ulana olmaydi — <code>setsebool -P httpd_can_network_connect 1</code>.</li><li><code>restart</code> o'rniga <code>reload</code> — faol ulanishlar uzilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konfiguratsiyani Git'da saqlang va CI'da <code>nginx -t</code> (container ichida) bilan tekshiring. Ko'p servis bo'lsa — K8s ingress yoki Caddy/Traefik avtomatik TLS bilan qo'lda boshqaruvni kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34333	<p>Let's Encrypt bilan bepul TLS sertifikat olish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Let's Encrypt — bepul, avtomatlashtirilgan CA. Sertifikat ACME protokoli orqali olinadi: <code>certbot</code> (yoki acme.sh, Caddy, cert-manager) domen sizniki ekanini <b>challenge</b> bilan isbotlaydi — HTTP-01 (<code>/.well-known/acme-challenge/</code> fayl) yoki DNS-01 (TXT record) — keyin sertifikat beriladi. Muddati 90 kun (qisqarib bormoqda), shuning uchun avtomatik yangilash majburiy.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>certbot -&gt; Let's Encrypt: &quot;app.example.com uchun sertifikat&quot;<br>LE -&gt; &quot;http://app.example.com/.well-known/acme-challenge/&lt;token&gt; da shu kalitni ko'rsat&quot;<br>certbot nginx orqali faylni joylaydi -&gt; LE tekshiradi -&gt; sertifikat beradi<br>/etc/letsencrypt/live/app.example.com/{fullchain.pem, privkey.pem}<br>systemd timer: kuniga 2 marta tekshiradi, 30 kun qolganda yangilaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo apt install certbot python3-certbot-nginx<br>sudo certbot --nginx -d app.example.com -d www.app.example.com -m ops@example.com --agree-tos<br>sudo certbot certificates                # mavjud sertifikatlar va muddati<br>sudo certbot renew --dry-run             # yangilashni sinash<br>systemctl list-timers | grep certbot<br># Wildcard (DNS-01, DNS plugin bilan)<br>sudo certbot certonly --dns-route53 -d '*.example.com'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>80-port yopiq yoki DNS boshqa serverga ko'rsatadi — HTTP-01 ishlamaydi.</li><li>Test paytida ko'p urinish — rate limit (domen bo'yicha haftalik limit); <code>--staging</code> bilan sinang.</li><li>Yangilangan sertifikatni nginx ko'rmaydi — reload hook kerak (<code>--deploy-hook &quot;systemctl reload nginx&quot;</code>).</li><li><code>privkey.pem</code> ruxsatlari — faqat root o'qisin; backup'larda ham himoyalang.</li><li>DNS-01 uchun DNS API kaliti — faqat kerakli zona va TXT yozuvlariga cheklangan huquq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sertifikat muddati qisqarmoqda (CA/B Forum qarori bilan bosqichma-bosqich 47 kungacha) — qo'lda yangilash amalda imkonsiz bo'ladi. To'liq avtomatlashtirish + muddat bo'yicha mustaqil monitoring standart bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34334	<p>Sertifikat muddati qachon tugashini qanday tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>openssl s_client</code> bilan serverdan sertifikatni olib, <code>openssl x509 -noout -enddate</code> bilan <code>notAfter</code> sanasini o'qiysiz. Fayl uchun to'g'ridan <code>openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -enddate</code>. Avtomatik nazorat: Prometheus blackbox_exporter (<code>probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry</code>), cert-manager metrikalari yoki monitoring servisi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> sertifikat tunda tugadi, sayt va API ishlamay qoldi; mobil ilova va integratsiyalar sertifikat xatosi bilan to'xtadi. Bu oldindan ma'lum bo'lgan sana — uni o'tkazib yuborish to'liq oldini olsa bo'ladigan outage.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo | openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 -servername example.com 2&gt;/dev/null \<br>  | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -enddate<br># notAfter=Dec 31 23:59:59 2026 GMT<br>openssl x509 -in /etc/ssl/certs/app.pem -noout -enddate<br># 30 kun ichida tugaydimi? (exit code 1 = ha)<br>openssl x509 -in app.pem -noout -checkend $((30*86400)) &amp;&amp; echo OK || echo &quot;30 kundan kam!&quot;<br>curl -vI https://example.com 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -i &quot;expire date&quot;<br>kubectl get certificate -A          # cert-manager: READY va muddat</pre><pre>(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=&quot;blackbox&quot;} - time()) / 86400 &lt; 14</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-servername</code> (SNI) berilmasa server default sertifikatni qaytaradi — boshqa domen sertifikatini tekshirib qo'yasiz.</li><li>Faqat leaf sertifikatni tekshirish — oraliq (intermediate) sertifikat ham tugashi mumkin; zanjirni ko'ring (<code>-showcerts</code>).</li><li>Faqat bitta endpoint — LB orqasidagi har node yoki har region alohida sertifikatga ega bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Ichki mTLS/servis sertifikatlari va kubeadm sertifikatlari (<code>kubeadm certs check-expiration</code>) ham unutiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Inventarizatsiya + avtomatik yangilash + mustaqil tashqi monitoring (yangilash mexanizmidan alohida) — uchalasi birga. Alert'ni 14-21 kun oldin bering, toki jarayon buzilgan bo'lsa ham tuzatishga vaqt qolsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34336	<p>WebSocket va oddiy HTTP farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy HTTP — so'rov/javob modeli: klient so'raydi, server javob beradi; server o'z tashabbusi bilan xabar yubora olmaydi. <b>WebSocket</b> — HTTP'dan <code>Upgrade</code> orqali boshlanadigan, keyin <b>doimiy, ikki tomonlama</b> (full-duplex) ulanish: server ham, klient ham istalgan vaqtda xabar yuboradi. Chat, jonli bildirishnomalar, o'yinlar, birja kotirovkalari uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> chat'da yangi xabarni bilish uchun har sekund so'rov (polling) — keraksiz yuk va kechikish. WebSocket bir marta ulanib, xabarni darhol yetkazadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client: GET /ws  Upgrade: websocket, Connection: Upgrade, Sec-WebSocket-Key: ...<br>server: 101 Switching Protocols<br>=&gt; endi xom TCP ustida freymlar: client &lt;==&gt; server (soatlab ochiq)<br>HTTP: so'rov -&gt; javob -&gt; (keep-alive bo'lsa ham) faqat klient boshlaydi<br>Alternativa: SSE (faqat server -&gt; klient, oddiy HTTP)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>websocat wss://echo.websocket.org      # interaktiv test<br>curl -i -N -H &quot;Connection: Upgrade&quot; -H &quot;Upgrade: websocket&quot; \<br>  -H &quot;Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13&quot; -H &quot;Sec-WebSocket-Key: SGVsbG8=&quot; https://example.com/ws</pre><pre>location /ws/ {<br>    proxy_pass http://ws_backend;<br>    proxy_http_version 1.1;<br>    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;<br>    proxy_set_header Connection &quot;upgrade&quot;;<br>    proxy_read_timeout 3600s;           # default 60s uzilishga olib keladi<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Proxy/LB idle timeout'i qisqa — ulanishlar har 60 s'da uziladi; ping/pong heartbeat va timeout'larni moslang.</li><li>Deploy paytida minglab ulanish bir vaqtda uzilib qayta ulanadi (thundering herd) — klientda tasodifiy kechikishli reconnect.</li><li>Har ulanish server resursi (fd, xotira) — ko'p ulanishli server uchun <code>ulimit</code> va L7 LB.</li><li>Autentifikatsiya va <code>Origin</code> tekshiruvi — aks holda boshqa sayt foydalanuvchi nomidan ulanadi (cross-site WebSocket hijacking).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> WebSocket — stateful: horizontal masshtablashda xabarlarni pod'lar orasida tarqatish uchun pub/sub (Redis, NATS) va graceful drain kerak. Faqat server -&gt; klient oqim bo'lsa SSE odatda soddaroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34337	<p>MTU nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> MTU (Maximum Transmission Unit) — tarmoq interfeysi bir paketda yubora oladigan maksimal hajm (bayt). Ethernet'da standart 1500 bayt; AWS VPC ichida jumbo frame 9001; VPN/tunnel'larda header qo'shilgani uchun kichikroq (WireGuard odatda 1420). Paket MTU'dan katta bo'lsa bo'linadi (fragmentatsiya) yoki, DF bit qo'yilgan bo'lsa, tashlanadi.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> noto'g'ri MTU — eng chalkash tarmoq muammolaridan biri: kichik so'rovlar ishlaydi, katta javoblar (fayl, katta JSON, TLS sertifikat zanjiri) osilib qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1500 bayt Ethernet MTU ichida:<br>  20 IP header + 20 TCP header + 1460 ma'lumot (MSS)<br>Tunnel (+60 bayt) -&gt; ichki MTU 1440 bo'lishi kerak<br>Katta paket + DF -&gt; router &quot;Fragmentation needed&quot; ICMP -&gt; yuboruvchi kichraytiradi (PMTUD)<br>ICMP bloklangan -&gt; paket jimgina yo'qoladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip link show eth0                 # ... mtu 1500 ...<br>ping -M do -s 1472 8.8.8.8        # 1472+28 = 1500, bo'linmasin<br>ping -M do -s 1473 8.8.8.8        # &quot;message too long&quot; -&gt; MTU 1500<br>tracepath example.com             # yo'ldagi pmtu<br>sudo ip link set eth0 mtu 1450    # vaqtincha o'zgartirish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Barcha ICMP'ni firewall'da bloklash — PMTUD buziladi.</li><li>Docker/K8s overlay'da container MTU'si host'nikidan katta qolishi.</li><li>MTU'ni o'zgartirishni doimiy saqlamaslik (netplan/NetworkManager) — reboot'da qaytadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;SSH ulanadi, lekin katta chiqishda qotadi&quot; yoki &quot;TLS handshake vaqti-vaqti bilan osiladi&quot; — MTU'ni birinchi tekshiring. Tunnel'larda MSS clamping'ni standart sozlama qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34338	<p>Proxy orqasida mijozning haqiqiy IP'sini qanday bilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Proxy/LB orqasida ilova TCP ulanishida faqat proxy IP'sini ko'radi. Haqiqiy klient IP'si header'da uzatiladi: <code>X-Forwarded-For</code> (zanjir: <code>klient, proxy1, proxy2</code>), <code>X-Real-IP</code>, standart <code>Forwarded: for=...</code>, yoki L4 darajasida <b>PROXY protocol</b> (NLB, HAProxy). Ilova/nginx faqat <b>ishonchli proxy</b>'lardan kelgan header'ga ishonishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> ilova <code>X-Forwarded-For</code>ning birinchi qiymatini oladi. Hujumchi o'zi <code>X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4</code> yuborib IP asosidagi rate limit, ban va admin IP whitelist'ini chetlab o'tadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>klient 203.0.113.7 -&gt; CDN 198.51.100.1 -&gt; ALB 10.0.0.5 -&gt; nginx -&gt; app<br>X-Forwarded-For: &lt;klient yuborgan soxta?&gt;, 203.0.113.7, 198.51.100.1<br>To'g'ri usul: o'ngdan chapga yurib, ishonchli proxy'larni tashlab,<br>              birinchi ishonchsiz IP = haqiqiy klient (203.0.113.7)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># nginx realip: faqat ishonchli manbalardan<br>set_real_ip_from 10.0.0.0/16;          # ALB subnet'i<br>set_real_ip_from 198.51.100.0/24;      # CDN diapazonlari<br>real_ip_header X-Forwarded-For;<br>real_ip_recursive on;<br>log_format main '$remote_addr - &quot;$http_x_forwarded_for&quot; &quot;$request&quot; $status';</pre><pre>curl -H 'X-Forwarded-For: 1.1.1.1' https://example.com/whoami   # soxta header e'tiborsiz qolishini tekshirish</pre><p>K8s ingress-nginx: <code>use-forwarded-headers</code>, Service <code>externalTrafficPolicy: Local</code> (L4 LB'da manba IP saqlansin), yoki PROXY protocol.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>real_ip_recursive off</code> va ko'p proxy — noto'g'ri IP.</li><li><code>externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster</code> — kube-proxy SNAT qiladi, klient IP yo'qoladi.</li><li>PROXY protocol bir tomonda yoqilgan, ikkinchisida yo'q — barcha ulanishlar buziladi.</li><li>Klient IP — shaxsiy ma'lumot (GDPR): log'larda saqlash muddati va maqsadi aniqlansin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Ishonchli proxy&quot; ro'yxatini (CDN IP diapazonlari) avtomatik yangilab turing va klient IP'sini edge'da bir marta to'g'ri aniqlab, ichki servislarga standart header orqali uzating — har servis o'zicha parse qilmasin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34339	<p>Loopback interfeys va <code>0.0.0.0</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Loopback</b> (<code>lo</code>, <code>127.0.0.1</code>, IPv6 <code>::1</code>) — faqat <b>shu mashina ichida</b> ishlaydigan virtual interfeys: <code>127.0.0.1</code> da tinglagan servisga tashqaridan ulanib bo'lmaydi. <b><code>0.0.0.0</code></b> — tinglashda &quot;barcha interfeyslarda&quot; degani: servis loopback, LAN va public interfeyslar orqali kirishga ochiq (IPv6'da <code>::</code>).</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> servisni qayerda tinglatish — ham ishlash, ham xavfsizlik masalasi. Container'da ilova <code>127.0.0.1</code> da tinglasa, port forward/Service orqali kirib bo'lmaydi; DB <code>0.0.0.0</code> da tinglab, firewall yo'q bo'lsa — internetga ochiq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ss -tlnp:<br>  127.0.0.1:5432  -&gt; faqat lokal jarayonlar<br>  0.0.0.0:5432    -&gt; barcha IPv4 interfeyslar (10.0.1.5, public IP ...)<br>  10.0.1.5:5432   -&gt; faqat shu aniq interfeys<br>Container ichidagi 127.0.0.1 = container'ning o'z loopback'i (host'niki emas!)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -tlnp | grep -E '5432|6379|8080'<br># PostgreSQL: postgresql.conf  listen_addresses = 'localhost'   (yoki '10.0.1.5')<br># Redis:      bind 127.0.0.1 -::1 ; protected-mode yes<br># Docker: port'ni faqat lokalga ochish<br>docker run -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 postgres:17<br># Ilova container'da: 0.0.0.0 da tinglashi kerak<br>./app --listen 0.0.0.0:8080</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>docker run -p 5432:5432</code> — default <code>0.0.0.0</code> ga bog'laydi va Docker iptables qoidalari ufw'ni chetlab o'tishi mumkin — DB internetga ochiq qoladi.</li><li>Container ichida <code>localhost</code> ga ulanish boshqa container'ga yetmaydi — servis nomi ishlating.</li><li>Debug/admin endpoint'lar (pprof, actuator) <code>0.0.0.0</code> da — tashqaridan ichki ma'lumot olish mumkin; ularni loopback yoki alohida ichki portga bog'lang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: &quot;eng tor interfeys + firewall + autentifikatsiya&quot; — uchalasi birga. Faqat bitta qatlamga (masalan, faqat security group) tayanish — bitta xato konfiguratsiyada butun himoya yo'qoladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34340	<p><code>ss -s</code> yoki <code>netstat</code> bilan TIME_WAIT ko'p bo'lsa nima degani?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TIME_WAIT — TCP ulanishini <b>birinchi bo'lib yopgan</b> tomon ulanishni yopgandan keyin ~60 soniya (Linux'da 2xMSL) shu holatda saqlaydi: kech kelgan paketlar yangi ulanishga aralashmasligi uchun. Ko'p TIME_WAIT odatda <b>ko'p qisqa ulanishlar</b> ochilib-yopilayotganini bildiradi (keep-alive/pool yo'q). O'zi xato emas, lekin klient tomonda ephemeral portlar tugashiga olib kelishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> servis tashqi API'ga har so'rovda yangi ulanish ochadi: sekundiga 1000 so'rov x 60 s = 60 000 TIME_WAIT — bitta manzil uchun ~28 000 ephemeral port tugaydi, &quot;cannot assign requested address&quot; xatolari.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Faol yopuvchi: ESTABLISHED -&gt; FIN_WAIT_1 -&gt; FIN_WAIT_2 -&gt; TIME_WAIT (60 s) -&gt; CLOSED<br>Passiv tomon:  ESTABLISHED -&gt; CLOSE_WAIT -&gt; LAST_ACK -&gt; CLOSED<br>CLOSE_WAIT ko'p = ilova socket'ni yopmayapti (bug!)<br>TIME_WAIT ko'p  = ko'p qisqa ulanish (dizayn masalasi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -s                                   # TCP: ... timewait 41000 ...<br>ss -tan state time-wait | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head   # qaysi manzilga<br>ss -tan state close-wait | wc -l<br>cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse            # 1/2: chiquvchi ulanishlarda qayta ishlatish</pre><p>Yechimlar: HTTP keep-alive va ulanish pool (eng to'g'ri), nginx upstream <code>keepalive</code>, DB pool; kerak bo'lsa <code>tcp_tw_reuse=1</code>, <code>ip_local_port_range</code> ni kengaytirish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>tcp_tw_recycle</code> — NAT ortidagi klientlarni buzgan, Linux 4.12 da olib tashlangan; maslahat sifatida eslatmang.</li><li>TIME_WAIT'ni &quot;kamaytirish&quot; uchun <code>SO_LINGER 0</code> (RST bilan yopish) — ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin.</li><li>CLOSE_WAIT'ni TIME_WAIT bilan adashtirish — CLOSE_WAIT ilova kodidagi leak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> TIME_WAIT soni — ulanishni qayta ishlatish sifatining ko'rsatkichi. Servislararo trafikda keep-alive/HTTP2/gRPC bilan ulanishlarni qayta ishlatish ham latency'ni (handshake, TLS), ham port tugashini hal qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34341	<p>Network segmentation nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Network segmentation — tarmoqni maqsad va ishonch darajasiga qarab alohida zonalarga bo'lish (public/DMZ, ilova, ma'lumotlar bazasi, boshqaruv, ofis, PCI zonasi) va ular orasidagi trafikni faqat kerakli yo'nalish va portlarga ruxsat berish. Maqsad: buzilish bir joyda qolsin (blast radius kichik), hujumchi tarmoq bo'ylab erkin yura olmasin (lateral movement), compliance doirasi tor bo'lsin.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> &quot;tekis&quot; tarmoqda bitta zaif web server buzilsa, hujumchi undan DB, backup server va domen kontrollerga to'g'ridan ulanadi — ransomware butun kompaniyaga tarqaladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Internet -&gt; [public: LB, WAF]<br>               | 443<br>               v<br>            [app subnet]  --5432--&gt; [db subnet]   (faqat app SG'dan)<br>               ^<br>     [mgmt: bastion/SSM] --22--&gt; app (faqat mgmt'dan)<br>db subnet: internetga chiqish yo'q, kirish faqat app'dan<br>K8s ichida: namespace + NetworkPolicy default-deny (mikrosegmentatsiya)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_security_group_rule&quot; &quot;db_from_app&quot; {<br>  type                     = &quot;ingress&quot;<br>  from_port                = 5432<br>  to_port                  = 5432<br>  protocol                 = &quot;tcp&quot;<br>  security_group_id        = aws_security_group.db.id<br>  source_security_group_id = aws_security_group.app.id   # IP emas, SG identity<br>}</pre><pre>aws ec2 describe-security-groups --query &quot;SecurityGroups[?IpPermissions[?IpRanges[?CidrIp=='0.0.0.0/0']]].GroupId&quot;<br>kubectl get netpol -A</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Segmentlar bor, lekin qoidalar <code>10.0.0.0/8 -&gt; hammasi</code> — amalda tekis tarmoq.</li><li>Boshqaruv trafigi (SSH, RDP, admin panel) ilova trafigi bilan bir zonada.</li><li>Faqat perimetr (tashqi) himoya, ichkarida ishonch — zamonaviy hujumlar ichkaridan yuradi.</li><li>Segmentatsiya hujjatsiz — keyin hech kim qoidani o'chirishga jur'at qilmaydi va &quot;vaqtinchalik&quot; ochiq qoidalar to'planadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Segmentatsiya zero trust bilan to'ldirilsin: tarmoq zonasi + servis identity (mTLS, IAM) + har so'rovda avtorizatsiya. Flow log'lar (VPC Flow Logs, Hubble) bilan haqiqiy oqimlarni ko'rib, qoidalarni ma'lumotga asoslang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34342	<p><code>/etc/services</code> fayli nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/etc/services</code> — port raqamlarini servis nomlariga bog'lovchi oddiy matn fayl (<code>ssh 22/tcp</code>, <code>https 443/tcp</code>, <code>postgresql 5432/tcp</code>). U <code>ss</code>, <code>netstat</code>, <code>tcpdump</code>, <code>getent services</code> kabi vositalarda raqam o'rniga nom ko'rsatish va dasturlarda <code>getservbyname()</code> orqali nomdan portni topish uchun ishlatiladi. U portni <b>ochmaydi va bloklamaydi</b> — faqat ma'lumotnoma.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> <code>ss -t</code> chiqishida <code>:postgresql</code> yoki <code>:https</code> ko'rsatilsa — bu shu fayldan. Notanish port raqamini tez aniqlash uchun ham qulay.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/etc/services qator formati:<br>  &lt;nom&gt;   &lt;port&gt;/&lt;protokol&gt;   [taxalluslar]   # izoh<br>  ssh     22/tcp<br>  domain  53/udp<br>  postgresql 5432/tcp  postgres<br>ss (flag -n siz) -&gt; getservbyport(5432) -&gt; &quot;postgresql&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>grep -w 5432 /etc/services<br>getent services https            # https 443/tcp<br>getent services 6379             # nom bo'lsa ko'rsatadi<br>ss -tl                           # nomlar bilan (:ssh, :https)<br>ss -tln                          # -n: raqamlar bilan (skriptlar uchun ishonchli)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faylga qator qo'shish servisni ishga tushirmaydi va firewall'ni ochmaydi.</li><li>Skript va monitoring'da nom bilan parse qilish — turli tizimlarda fayl farq qilishi mumkin; har doim <code>-n</code> bilan raqam ishlating.</li><li>Port nomi servisni kafolatlamaydi: 443'da istalgan dastur tinglashi mumkin — <code>ss -p</code> bilan haqiqiy jarayonni ko'ring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu kichik fayl — &quot;nom faqat ko'rinish, haqiqat raqam va jarayon&quot; qoidasining yaxshi misoli. Xavfsizlik auditida portni nomidan emas, tinglayotgan jarayon va uning egasidan baholang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::W10 Networking basics	idrill-34343	<p><code>tcpdump</code> bilan trafikni qanday ko'rasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>tcpdump</code> — tarmoq interfeysidagi paketlarni ushlab ko'rsatadi yoki faylga (pcap) yozadi. Asosiy flag'lar: <code>-i</code> (interfeys, <code>any</code> — hammasi), <code>-n</code> (DNS/port nomlarisiz), <code>-c</code> (paket soni), <code>-w</code>/<code>-r</code> (faylga yozish/o'qish), <code>-A</code>/<code>-X</code> (tarkibini ko'rsatish), oxirida BPF filtr (<code>host</code>, <code>port</code>, <code>net</code>, <code>tcp</code>, <code>udp</code>).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;ilova so'rov yuboryapti deydi, server olmadim deydi&quot; — tcpdump haqiqatda nima o'tganini ko'rsatadigan yakuniy dalil.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 port 443 -c 20<br>sudo tcpdump -ni any host 10.0.2.15 and port 5432<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 'udp port 53'                          # DNS so'rov/javoblar<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] &amp; (tcp-syn|tcp-rst) != 0'   # ulanish urinishlari va rad etishlar<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 -A -s 0 'tcp port 80'                  # HTTP matnini ko'rish<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 -w /tmp/cap.pcap -c 5000 port 8080     # keyin Wireshark'da<br>tcpdump -nr /tmp/cap.pcap | head<br># K8s pod ichida:<br>kubectl debug -it api-x --image=nicolaka/netshoot --target=api -- tcpdump -ni any port 8080</pre><p>O'qish: <code>Flags [S]</code> — SYN, <code>[S.]</code> — SYN-ACK, <code>[.]</code> — ACK, <code>[P.]</code> — ma'lumot, <code>[F.]</code> — FIN, <code>[R]</code> — RST. SYN takrorlanib javob yo'q — firewall/route; darhol RST — port yopiq.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Filtrsiz va <code>-c</code>siz prod'da — disk to'ladi, CPU yeydi, ko'p paket &quot;dropped by kernel&quot;.</li><li>HTTPS trafik shifrlangan — tarkibini ko'rmaysiz, faqat ulanish va TLS handshake.</li><li>pcap fayllarida parol, cookie, shaxsiy ma'lumot bo'lishi mumkin — himoyalangan joyda saqlang, kirishni cheklang, ishdan keyin o'chiring; boshqa odamlar trafigini ruxsatsiz yozmang.</li><li><code>-i eth0</code> noto'g'ri interfeys (container, bridge, VPN) — hech narsa ko'rinmaydi; <code>-i any</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Muammoni ikki uchdan (klient va server) bir vaqtda yozib solishtirish — paket qayerda yo'qolganini isbotlaydi. Ko'p hollarda to'liq paket o'rniga header'lar yetarli (<code>-s 128</code>) — maxfiylik va hajm uchun yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::net sec::w10 Networking_basics
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41851	<p>7 qatlamli OSI modeli va DevOps muhandisi har kuni ishlaydigan qatlamlarni tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OSI — tarmoq aloqasini 7 qatlamga bo'luvchi mental model. Real internet TCP/IP (4 qatlam) bilan ishlaydi, lekin debug paytida &quot;muammo qaysi qatlamda?&quot; deb o'ylash uchun OSI juda qulay. DevOps asosan L3 (IP, routing), L4 (TCP/UDP, port) va L7 (HTTP, DNS, gRPC) da ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;Sayt ochilmayapti&quot; — bu DNS (L7)mi, firewall port (L4)mi, routing (L3)mi yoki TLS sertifikat (L6)mi? Qatlamlar bo'yicha pastdan yuqoriga tekshirish taxminni yo'qotadi.</p><pre>L7 Application   HTTP, DNS, gRPC, SSH      -&gt; Ingress, API Gateway, ALB<br>L6 Presentation  TLS, JSON/Protobuf        -&gt; sertifikat, serializatsiya<br>L5 Session       sessiya boshqaruvi        -&gt; (amalda L7 ichida)<br>L4 Transport     TCP, UDP, QUIC, port      -&gt; NLB, Security Group, kube-proxy<br>L3 Network       IP, ICMP, BGP, IPsec      -&gt; VPC, subnet, route table<br>L2 Data Link     Ethernet, MAC, ARP, VLAN  -&gt; switch, CNI bridge (cni0)<br>L1 Physical      kabel, optika, radio      -&gt; data center / cloud provider</pre><p><b>Amalda (qatlam bo'yicha debug):</b></p><pre>ip link show                     # L2: interfeys UP mi<br>ip neigh                         # L2: ARP jadvali<br>ping -c3 10.0.1.5                # L3: IP erishiluvchanlik<br>ip route get 10.0.1.5            # L3: qaysi route ishlaydi<br>nc -zv 10.0.1.5 5432             # L4: port ochiqmi<br>openssl s_client -connect api.example.com:443   # L6: TLS<br>curl -v https://api.example.com/health          # L7: HTTP javob</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ping</code> ishlamasa host o'lik deb o'ylash — ICMP ko'pincha bloklangan; <code>nc</code>/<code>curl</code> bilan L4/L7 ni tekshir.</li><li>ALB (L7) va NLB (L4) farqini bilmaslik: NLB HTTP path bo'yicha marshrutlay olmaydi.</li><li>TLS'ni L4 deb hisoblash — u TCP ustida, ilovadan pastda.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Load balancer, firewall, NetworkPolicy tanlashda &quot;qaysi qatlamda qaror qabul qilinadi?&quot; savoli asosiy: L4 tez va arzon, L7 aqlli (path, header, retry) lekin qimmatroq va TLS termination talab qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41852	<p>TCP va UDP'ni ulanish holati, ishonchlilik, header va qo'llanilish bo'yicha solishtiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP — ulanishli, ishonchli, tartibli oqim (handshake, ACK, retransmission). UDP — ulanishsiz, &quot;yubor va unut&quot; datagram, yengil va tez. Tanlov: yo'qotish qabul qilinmasa TCP, latency muhim va yo'qotishga chidamli bo'lsa UDP.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> DB ulanishi bitta bayt yo'qotishni ko'tarolmaydi (TCP). VoIP'da 200 ms kechikkan paket foydasiz — qayta yuborishdan ko'ra tashlab yuborish yaxshi (UDP).</p><pre>TCP 3-way handshake:          UDP:<br>Client          Server        Client          Server<br>  | --- SYN ----&gt; |             | --- data ---&gt; |<br>  | &lt;-- SYN-ACK - |             | --- data ---&gt; |   (ACK yo'q,<br>  | --- ACK ----&gt; |             |               |    tartib yo'q)<br>  | === data ===&gt; |</pre><p>| Xususiyat | TCP | UDP | |---|---|---| | Ulanish | handshake (1 RTT) | yo'q | | Ishonchlilik | ACK + retransmission | yo'q | | Tartib | sequence number bilan | kafolat yo'q | | Flow/congestion control | bor | yo'q | | Header | 20-60 bayt | 8 bayt | | Misol | HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, SSH, PostgreSQL | DNS, VoIP, o'yin, QUIC (HTTP/3) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -tan state established | head   # TCP ulanishlar<br>ss -uan                            # UDP socket'lar<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] &amp; tcp-syn != 0'   # SYN'larni ko'rish<br>dig @8.8.8.8 example.com +tcp      # DNS'ni TCP orqali majburlash</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DNS faqat UDP deb o'ylash — katta javoblar (DNSSEC, &gt;512/1232 bayt) TCP 53 ga o'tadi; firewall'da TCP 53 ni ham och.</li><li>UDP &quot;tezroq&quot; deb o'z protokolingni yozish — ishonchlilikni qayta ixtiro qilasan; QUIC aynan shu ishni to'g'ri qilgan.</li><li>Security Group'da UDP qoidasi yo'qligi uchun DNS/NTP timeout.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> QUIC UDP ustida TCP xususiyatlarini (ishonchlilik, congestion control) user-space'da beradi — shuning uchun &quot;UDP = ishonchsiz&quot; endi transport haqida, ilova haqida emas. Korporativ firewall'lar UDP 443 ni bloklasa HTTP/3 jimgina HTTP/2 ga tushadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41853	<p><code>api.stripe.com</code> ga kirishda DNS resolution'ning to'liq yo'lini tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval lokal cache'lar (brauzer, OS, <code>/etc/hosts</code>), keyin recursive resolver; u root -&gt; <code>.com</code> TLD -&gt; <code>stripe.com</code> authoritative server zanjiri bo'ylab iterativ so'raydi va javobni TTL bo'yicha cache'laydi.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> &quot;DNS muammosi&quot; deyilganda u qaysi bo'g'inda — lokal cache, resolver, yoki authoritative zona? Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41854	<p>Public IP, private IP (RFC 1918) va NAT farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Public IP internetda global noyob va marshrutlanadi. Private IP (RFC 1918: <code>10.0.0.0/8</code>, <code>172.16.0.0/12</code>, <code>192.168.0.0/16</code>) faqat ichki tarmoqda. Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41855	<p>CIDR yozuvi va subnet hajmini hisoblashni tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CIDR <code>10.0.1.0/24</code> — bazaviy manzil va prefiks: birinchi 24 bit tarmoq, qolgan 32-24=8 bit host. Manzillar soni = 2^(32 - prefiks). <code>/24</code>=256, <code>/20</code>=4096, <code>/16</code>=65536.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> VPC/subnet o'lchamini noto'g'ri tanlasang, keyin kengaytirish og'riqli (EKS'da har pod VPC IP oladi — <code>/24</code> tez tugaydi).</p><pre>10.0.1.0/24<br>00001010.00000000.00000001 | 00000000<br>&lt;------ 24 bit tarmoq ----&gt; | &lt;8 bit host&gt;<br>Diapazon: 10.0.1.0 - 10.0.1.255  (256 manzil)<br><br>Bo'lish: /24 ni ikkiga -&gt; /25 + /25<br>10.0.1.0/25   (0-127)<br>10.0.1.128/25 (128-255)</pre><p>| Prefiks | Manzil | AWS'da foydalanish mumkin | |---|---|---| | /28 | 16 | 11 | | /24 | 256 | 251 | | /20 | 4096 | 4091 | | /16 | 65536 | 65531 |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ipcalc 10.0.1.0/24          # network, broadcast, host diapazoni<br>python3 -c &quot;import ipaddress as i; n=i.ip_network('10.0.0.0/16'); print([str(s) for s in n.subnets(new_prefix=20)][:4])&quot;</pre><p>Klassik tarmoqda foydalanish mumkin = 2^n - 2 (network va broadcast). AWS esa har subnet'da 5 ta band qiladi: <code>.0</code> network, <code>.1</code> VPC router, <code>.2</code> DNS, <code>.3</code> zaxira, oxirgi — broadcast.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Prefiks kattalashsa subnet kichrayadi (<code>/28</code> &lt; <code>/24</code>) — yangi boshlovchilar teskari tushunadi.</li><li>EKS VPC CNI bilan har node o'nlab IP band qiladi (warm pool) — subnet IP tugaydi, pod <code>Pending</code>.</li><li>Kelajakdagi peering/VPN uchun boshqa VPC'lar bilan ustma-ust CIDR tanlash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta prefiksli VPC (<code>/16</code>) ol, subnet'larni AZ va qatlam bo'yicha (public/private/data) teng bo'l, zaxira joy qoldir. EKS uchun prefix delegation yoki secondary CIDR (<code>100.64.0.0/16</code>) — IP tanqisligining standart yechimi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41856	<p>TLS 1.3 handshake'ini tushuntiring va TLS 1.2 bilan solishtiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TLS 1.3 handshake 1 RTT (qayta ulanishda 0-RTT), TLS 1.2 esa 2 RTT. 1.3 key share'ni birinchi xabarda yuboradi, sertifikatni shifrlaydi, faqat forward-secret (ECDHE) kalit almashinuvi va AEAD cipher'larni qoldiradi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Har RTT — mobil tarmoqda 50-200 ms. Handshake'ni qisqartirish birinchi bayt vaqtini sezilarli kamaytiradi; zaif algoritmlarni olib tashlash butun hujum sinflarini (POODLE, ROBOT, RSA key exchange) yo'qotdi.</p><pre>TLS 1.2 (2-RTT)                      TLS 1.3 (1-RTT)<br>C: ClientHello          -&gt;           C: ClientHello + key_share   -&gt;<br>S: ServerHello, Cert,   &lt;-           S: ServerHello + key_share,<br>   ServerKeyExchange, Done              {EncryptedExtensions, Cert,<br>C: ClientKeyExchange,   -&gt;               CertVerify, Finished}   &lt;-<br>   ChangeCipherSpec, Finished        C: {Finished} + HTTP so'rov  -&gt;<br>S: ChangeCipherSpec, Finished &lt;-<br>C: HTTP so'rov          -&gt;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 -tls1_3 &lt;/dev/null 2&gt;/dev/null | grep -E 'Protocol|Cipher'<br>curl -sv --tlsv1.3 https://example.com -o /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -i 'SSL connection'<br>nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers -p 443 example.com    # qaysi versiya/cipher yoqilgan</pre><p>Nginx: <code>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;</code> (1.0/1.1 RFC 8996 bilan deprecated).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>0-RTT ma'lumoti replay qilinishi mumkin — faqat idempotent GET uchun; nginx'da <code>ssl_early_data</code> yoqsang backend <code>Early-Data</code> header'ini tekshirsin.</li><li>TLS 1.3'da sertifikat shifrlangan — eski &quot;passiv&quot; IDS/DPI SNI'dan boshqa narsani ko'rmaydi.</li><li>Eski client'lar (Java 8 eski update'lar) uchun 1.2 ni darhol o'chirib qo'yish avariya keltiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 2025-2026 holatida TLS 1.2 + 1.3 standart, 1.0/1.1 o'chiq. Post-quantum gibrid key exchange (<code>X25519MLKEM768</code>) Chrome/Cloudflare'da allaqachon default — LB/proxy'lar katta ClientHello'ni to'g'ri qabul qilishini tekshir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41857	<p>Simmetrik va asimmetrik shifrlash farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Simmetrik shifrlashda bitta umumiy kalit bilan shifrlanadi va ochiladi (AES-GCM, ChaCha20) — juda tez. Asimmetrik shifrlashda public/private juftlik (RSA, ECDSA, X25519) — sekin, lekin kalitni oldindan bo'lishmasdan xavfsiz almashish va imzo qo'yish imkonini beradi. Amalda ikkalasi birga ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Simmetrik tez, lekin kalitni internet orqali qanday xavfsiz yetkazasan? Asimmetrik buni hal qiladi, lekin GB'lab ma'lumotni RSA bilan shifrlash 1000 marta sekin.</p><pre>TLS / envelope encryption gibrid sxemasi:<br>1. Asimmetrik (ECDHE / RSA)  -&gt; tomonlar umumiy session key kelishadi<br>2. Simmetrik (AES-256-GCM)   -&gt; barcha ma'lumot shu kalit bilan<br>3. Imzo (ECDSA/RSA)          -&gt; server identity'si sertifikat orqali tasdiqlanadi</pre><p>| | Simmetrik | Asimmetrik | |---|---|---| | Kalit | 1 umumiy | public + private | | Tezlik | juda tez (AES-NI) | sekin | | Ishlatilishi | bulk data, disk, DB | kalit almashish, imzo, SSH auth | | Misol | AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305 | RSA-3072, ECDSA P-256, Ed25519 |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Simmetrik<br>openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -in data.txt -out data.enc<br># Asimmetrik kalit jufti va imzo<br>openssl genpkey -algorithm ed25519 -out key.pem<br>openssl pkey -in key.pem -pubout -out pub.pem<br>openssl pkeyutl -sign -inkey key.pem -rawin -in data.txt -out sig.bin</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>ECB rejimi yoki autentifikatsiyasiz CBC — ma'lumot o'zgartirilishi mumkin; AEAD (GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305) ishlat.</li><li>GCM'da bir kalit bilan nonce'ni qayta ishlatish — kalit buziladi.</li><li>O'z kriptografiyangni yozish; tayyor kutubxona (libsodium, Go <code>crypto</code>, Tink) ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy muammo algoritm emas, kalit boshqaruvi: saqlash (KMS/HSM), rotatsiya, kirish auditi. Post-quantum davrga tayyorgarlik — asimmetrik qism (RSA/ECC) xavf ostida, AES-256 esa yetarli qoladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41858	<p>Reverse proxy va forward proxy farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Forward proxy client'lar tomonida turadi va ularning chiquvchi so'rovlarini nazorat qiladi (server client'ni bilmaydi). Reverse proxy server'lar oldida turadi va kiruvchi so'rovlarni backend'larga taqsimlaydi (client backend'ni bilmaydi).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Forward — korporativ internet filtri, egress nazorati, cache. Reverse — bitta kirish nuqtasi: TLS termination, load balancing, rate limit, cache, WAF.</p><pre>Forward proxy:<br>[Laptop] -&gt; [Squid/egress proxy] -&gt; internet (github.com)<br>             filtr, log, allowlist<br><br>Reverse proxy:<br>internet -&gt; [Nginx/Envoy/ALB] -&gt; [app-1]<br>                               -&gt; [app-2]<br>             TLS, LB, cache, rate limit</pre><p><b>Amalda (Nginx reverse proxy):</b></p><pre>upstream app { server 10.0.1.10:8080; server 10.0.1.11:8080; }<br>server {<br>  listen 443 ssl;<br>  server_name api.example.com;<br>  location / {<br>    proxy_pass http://app;<br>    proxy_set_header Host $host;<br>    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;<br>    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Forward proxy client tomonda: <code>export HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:3128 NO_PROXY=.svc,.cluster.local,169.254.169.254</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>X-Forwarded-For</code> ni ishonchsiz manbadan qabul qilish — client IP soxtalashtiriladi; faqat ishonchli proxy'lar zanjiridan ol.</li><li><code>NO_PROXY</code> da metadata (<code>169.254.169.254</code>) va ichki domenlarni unutish — pod'lar ichki servislarni proxy orqali qidiradi.</li><li>Reverse proxy timeout'lari backend'nikidan qisqa — 504 lar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kubernetes Ingress controller, API Gateway, service mesh sidecar — barchasi reverse proxy. Egress uchun forward proxy (yoki egress gateway) — data exfiltration va supply-chain nazoratining arzon usuli.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41859	<p>Web Application Firewall (WAF) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> WAF — HTTP(S) so'rovlarini L7 da tekshiruvchi filtr: SQLi, XSS, path traversal, yomon bot, rate flood kabi pattern'larni qoidalar bo'yicha bloklaydi. U virtual patch, lekin xavfsiz kod o'rnini bosmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Kodda zaiflik topildi, fix 2 hafta. WAF qoidasi bilan exploit'ni bugun bloklaysan. Shuningdek PCI-DSS kabi standartlar WAF talab qiladi.</p><pre>Client -&gt; [CDN/edge] -&gt; [WAF: qoidalar] -&gt; [ALB] -&gt; app<br>                         | managed rules (OWASP CRS)<br>                         | rate-based rule (IP/5 min)<br>                         | geo / IP reputation<br>                         | bot control<br>                         v<br>                     BLOCK / COUNT / CAPTCHA / ALLOW</pre><p><b>Amalda (AWS WAF, Terraform):</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_wafv2_web_acl&quot; &quot;api&quot; {<br>  name  = &quot;api-acl&quot;<br>  scope = &quot;REGIONAL&quot;<br>  default_action { allow {} }<br>  rule {<br>    name     = &quot;common&quot;<br>    priority = 1<br>    override_action { count {} }   # avval COUNT rejimda kuzat<br>    statement {<br>      managed_rule_group_statement {<br>        vendor_name = &quot;AWS&quot;<br>        name        = &quot;AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet&quot;<br>      }<br>    }<br>    visibility_config { cloudwatch_metrics_enabled = true; metric_name = &quot;common&quot;; sampled_requests_enabled = true }<br>  }<br>  visibility_config { cloudwatch_metrics_enabled = true; metric_name = &quot;api&quot;; sampled_requests_enabled = true }<br>}</pre><p>Muqobillar: Cloudflare WAF, ModSecurity/Coraza + OWASP CRS.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>To'g'ridan BLOCK rejimda yoqish — false positive'lar legitim to'lovlarni bloklaydi; avval COUNT, log'ni tahlil qil.</li><li>Origin to'g'ridan internetga ochiq — hujumchi WAF'ni chetlab o'tadi; origin'ni faqat CDN IP'lariga yoki secret header'ga chekla.</li><li>Body inspection limiti (masalan 8-64 KB) — katta payload ichidagi hujum ko'rinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> WAF — defense in depth'ning bir qatlami. Uning qiymati tuning va kuzatuvda: blocked/counted metrikalariga alert, qoida o'zgarishlari IaC orqali va staging'da test.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41860	<p>Zero Trust arxitekturasi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zero Trust — &quot;hech qachon ishonma, doim tekshir&quot;: tarmoq joylashuvi (VPN ichida, VPC ichida) ishonch bermaydi. Har so'rov identity (user + device + workload), kontekst va siyosat asosida autentifikatsiya va avtorizatsiya qilinadi, trafik shifrlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klassik &quot;qal'a va xandaq&quot; modelida perimetr ichiga kirgan hujumchi (phishing, buzilgan pod) lateral movement bilan hamma narsaga yetadi. Bulut, remote ish va SaaS bilan perimetr yo'qoldi.</p><pre>Perimetr modeli:           Zero Trust:<br>[VPN] -&gt; ichkarida hamma   har so'rov -&gt; [Policy Decision Point]<br>         narsaga ruxsat                    | kim? (SSO, MFA)<br>                                           | qaysi device? (posture)<br>                                           | qaysi workload? (mTLS/SPIFFE)<br>                                           | nimaga? (least privilege)<br>                                           v<br>                                      ruxsat / rad, log</pre><p><b>Amalda (komponentlar):</b></p><ul><li>User kirish: VPN o'rniga identity-aware proxy (Google IAP, Cloudflare Access, Tailscale ACL) + SSO + MFA.</li><li>Servis-servis: service mesh mTLS (Istio/Linkerd) + AuthorizationPolicy.</li><li>Tarmoq: default-deny NetworkPolicy, mikrosegmentatsiya.</li><li>Infra kirish: SSM Session Manager / Teleport, qisqa muddatli credential.</li></ul><pre>apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1<br>kind: AuthorizationPolicy<br>metadata: { name: payment-allow, namespace: prod }<br>spec:<br>  selector: { matchLabels: { app: payment } }<br>  rules:<br>  - from:<br>    - source: { principals: [&quot;cluster.local/ns/prod/sa/checkout&quot;] }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Zero Trust'ni bitta mahsulot deb sotib olish — bu arxitektura tamoyili (NIST SP 800-207).</li><li>mTLS'ni yoqib, avtorizatsiya siyosatini yozmaslik — shifrlangan, lekin hamma hammaga gapira oladi.</li><li>Break-glass kirish rejasi yo'q — IdP tushsa hech kim kira olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bosqichma-bosqich jori qil: avval inventar va identity, keyin observe (kim kimga gapiradi), keyin enforce. Maqsad — buzilish bo'lganda blast radius'ni kichik qilish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41861	<p>Mutual TLS (mTLS) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy TLS'da faqat server sertifikat ko'rsatadi. mTLS'da client ham o'z X.509 sertifikatini ko'rsatadi — ikki tomon bir-birining identity'sini kriptografik tasdiqlaydi va trafik shifrlanadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Servislar orasida &quot;bu so'rov haqiqatan checkout servisidan keldimi?&quot; savoliga IP manzil ishonchli javob emas (pod IP'lar o'zgaradi, soxtalashtiriladi). Sertifikatdagi identity — ishonchli.</p><pre>Client                                  Server<br>  | -- ClientHello -------------------&gt; |<br>  | &lt;- ServerHello, Cert(server),       |<br>  |    CertificateRequest ------------- |   &lt;- server client sertifikat so'raydi<br>  | -- Cert(client), CertVerify,        |<br>  |    Finished ----------------------&gt; |   &lt;- client private key egaligini isbotlaydi<br>  | &lt;==== shifrlangan, ikki tomon tasdiqlangan ====&gt; |</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Test: client sertifikati bilan so'rov<br>curl --cert client.crt --key client.key --cacert ca.crt https://internal.api:8443/health<br>openssl s_client -connect internal.api:8443 -cert client.crt -key client.key -CAfile ca.crt</pre><p>Nginx:</p><pre>ssl_client_certificate /etc/nginx/ca.crt;<br>ssl_verify_client on;</pre><p>Istio'da qo'lda sertifikat kerak emas:</p><pre>apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1<br>kind: PeerAuthentication<br>metadata: { name: default, namespace: istio-system }<br>spec: { mtls: { mode: STRICT } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sertifikat muddati tugashi — eng ko'p uchraydigan mTLS avariyasi; avtomatik rotatsiya (cert-manager, mesh) va expiry alert.</li><li><code>PERMISSIVE</code> rejimni abadiy qoldirish — plaintext ham qabul qilinadi.</li><li>mTLS = autentifikatsiya; avtorizatsiya (kim nimaga) alohida siyosat talab qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qo'lda mTLS boshqaruvi miqyosda ishlamaydi — service mesh yoki SPIFFE/SPIRE bilan qisqa muddatli (soatlar) sertifikat va avtomatik rotatsiya. Revocation (CRL/OCSP) o'rniga qisqa TTL — amaliy yondashuv.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41862	<p>DevSecOps va &quot;Shift-Left&quot; falsafasi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DevSecOps — xavfsizlikni alohida jamoa va relizdan oldingi yakuniy &quot;darvoza&quot; emas, butun SDLC'ning avtomatik qismiga aylantirish. Shift-Left — xavfsizlik tekshiruvlarini iloji boricha erta (IDE, pre-commit, PR) bosqichga surish, chunki u yerda tuzatish eng arzon.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Pentest relizdan 1 hafta oldin 40 ta zaiflik topadi — reliz to'xtaydi yoki xavf bilan chiqadi. Avval report, keyin faqat yangi CRITICAL'larda fail.</li><li>Shift-left = shift-right'ni tashlash emas — runtime monitoring baribir kerak.</li><li>Xavfsizlik jamoasi tool'larni o'rnatib, natijalar egasini belgilamaydi — topilmalar backlog'da chiriydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DevSecOps madaniyat va platforma masalasi: &quot;paved road&quot; (xavfsiz default'li template, base image, pipeline) dasturchiga xavfsizlikni bepul beradi. Metrikalar: MTTR zaiflik bo'yicha, CRITICAL ochiq yoshi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41863	<p>SAST, DAST, IAST va SCA farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SAST — source kodni ishga tushirmasdan tahlil (white-box). DAST — ishlab turgan ilovaga tashqaridan hujum qilib tekshirish (black-box). IAST — test paytida ilova ichidan agent bilan kuzatish (grey-box). SCA — third-party dependency'larda ma'lum CVE va litsenziya muammolarini topish.</p><p><b>Nega to'rttasi:</b> Har biri boshqa narsani ko'radi. SAST SQL injection pattern'ini kodda topadi, lekin konfiguratsiya xatosini emas; DAST noto'g'ri header'ni topadi, lekin qaysi qatorda ekanini aytmaydi; SCA esa sening koding emas, kutubxonadagi Log4Shell'ni topadi.</p><p>| | SAST | DAST | IAST | SCA | |---|---|---|---|---| | Nima tekshiriladi | source kod | ishlab turgan app | runtime ichidan | dependency'lar | | Qachon | PR/CI | staging | integration test | CI, doimiy | | Kuchli | aniq qator, erta | real exploit, konfiguratsiya | kam false positive | tez, keng qamrov | | Zaif | false positive | sekin, qator yo'q | agent, til bog'liq | faqat ma'lum CVE | | Tool | Semgrep, CodeQL, SonarQube | OWASP ZAP, Burp | Contrast | Trivy, Grype, Snyk, Dependabot |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>semgrep scan --config p/owasp-top-ten .           # SAST<br>trivy fs --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL . # SCA (lock fayllar)<br>docker run -t ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-baseline.py -t https://staging.example.com   # DAST</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SCA natijasida CVE bor, lekin zaif funksiya hech chaqirilmaydi — reachability tahlilisiz shovqin ko'p.</li><li>DAST'ni production'ga qarshi ishga tushirish — ma'lumot buziladi, rate limit/WAF ishlaydi.</li><li>Lock fayl commit qilinmagan — SCA haqiqiy versiyalarni ko'rmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pipeline'da SAST + SCA + secret scan har PR'da (tez), DAST nightly staging'da. Natijalarni bitta joyga (DefectDojo, GitHub Security) yig'ib, dedup va egasi bilan boshqar.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41864	<p>HashiCorp Vault va uning asosiy imkoniyatlari nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HashiCorp Vault — identity asosidagi secret boshqaruv tizimi: secret'larni shifrlab saqlaydi (KV), talab bo'yicha qisqa muddatli dynamic credential yaratadi (DB, AWS), &quot;encryption as a service&quot; &quot;card-1234&quot;)</pre><p>Policy:</p><pre>path &quot;secret/data/app/*&quot; { capabilities = [&quot;read&quot;] }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Unseal kalitlarini qo'lda boshqarish — restart'da Vault sealed qoladi; Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41865	<p>CVE va CVSS ball nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CVE — ommaga ma'lum zaiflikning noyob identifikatori (<code>CVE-2021-44228</code> = Log4Shell). CVSS — uning texnik og'irlik bahosi 0.0-10.0: Low 0.1-3.9, Medium 4.0-6.9, High 7.0-8.9, Critical 9.0-10.0.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> Skaner 800 ta CVE ko'rsatdi — qaysi birini birinchi tuzatasan? CVSS yolg'iz yetmaydi: 9.8 lik CVE ichki, ishlatilmaydigan kutubxonada bo'lishi mumkin, 7.5 lik esa internetda faol exploit qilinayotgan bo'lishi mumkin.</p><pre>CVSS v3.1 vector misoli:<br>CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H  = 10.0<br>AV:N  tarmoqdan     AC:L oson     PR:N auth kerak emas<br>UI:N  user harakati kerak emas     C/I/A:H to'liq ta'sir<br><br>Prioritet = CVSS + EPSS (exploit ehtimoli) + CISA KEV (faol exploit)<br>          + kontekst (internetga ochiqmi? reachable'mi?)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>trivy image --severity CRITICAL,HIGH --ignore-unfixed myapp:1.4<br>grype myapp:1.4 -o table<br>curl -s &quot;https://api.first.org/data/v1/epss?cve=CVE-2021-44228&quot; | jq '.data[0].epss'</pre><p><code>--ignore-unfixed</code> — hali patch'i yo'q CVE'larni yashiradi (tuzatib bo'lmaydiganlar shovqini).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat CVSS bo'yicha &quot;hamma 7+ ni tuzat&quot; siyosati — jamoa shovqinga botadi.</li><li><code>.trivyignore</code> ga muddatsiz va sababsiz qo'shish — unutilgan xavf.</li><li>Base image'ni yangilamay faqat ilova dependency'larini tuzatish — CVE'larning ko'pi OS paketlarida.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CVSS v4.0 (2023) chiqdi, lekin ko'p tool'lar hali v3.1 ishlatadi. Risk asosidagi prioritetlash (KEV + EPSS + reachability) va SLA (Critical 7 kun, High 30 kun) — samarali zaiflik boshqaruvining asosi; VEX bilan &quot;bizga ta'sir qilmaydi&quot; ni hujjatlashtir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41866	<p>Kubernetes RBAC'ni (xavfsizlik kontekstida) tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes RBAC'da <code>Role</code> (namespace) / <code>ClusterRole</code> (klaster) — qaysi resurs ustida qaysi fe'l (<code>get</code>, <code>list</code>, <code>create</code>...) ruxsat ekanini belgilaydi; <code>RoleBinding</code> / <code>ClusterRoleBinding</code> bu ruxsatni subject'ga (User, Group, ServiceAccount) bog'laydi. Default — hamma narsa taqiqlangan, faqat ruxsat qo'shiladi.</p><p><b>Xavfsizlik nuqtai nazaridan:</b> Ba'zi ruxsatlar amalda klaster-admin'ga teng: <code>secrets</code> ni <code>list</code> qilish (barcha token'lar), <code>pods/exec</code>, pod yaratish (privileged pod -&gt; node), <code>escalate</code>, <code>bind</code>, <code>impersonate</code>, wildcard <code>*</code>.</p><pre>Subject (SA: ci-deployer)<br>   |<br>RoleBinding (ns: prod) ---&gt; Role: deployments [get,list,patch]<br>                                  pods        [get,list]<br>   kube-apiserver: &quot;ci-deployer prod'da deployment patch qila oladimi?&quot; -&gt; ha</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: Role<br>metadata: { name: deployer, namespace: prod }<br>rules:<br>- apiGroups: [&quot;apps&quot;]<br>  resources: [&quot;deployments&quot;]<br>  verbs: [&quot;get&quot;, &quot;list&quot;, &quot;patch&quot;]<br>---<br>apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: RoleBinding<br>metadata: { name: deployer, namespace: prod }<br>subjects: [{ kind: ServiceAccount, name: ci-deployer, namespace: prod }]<br>roleRef: { kind: Role, name: deployer, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io }</pre><pre>kubectl auth can-i list secrets -n prod --as=system:serviceaccount:prod:ci-deployer<br>kubectl auth can-i --list --as=system:serviceaccount:prod:ci-deployer -n prod</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ClusterRoleBinding</code> bilan <code>cluster-admin</code> ni CI'ga berish — &quot;tezroq ishlashi uchun&quot;.</li><li><code>pods/create</code> ruxsati xavfsiz deb o'ylash — u har qanday SA bilan pod ishga tushirib, uning secret'larini o'qishga imkon beradi.</li><li>Default SA token'i har pod'ga mount — <code>automountServiceAccountToken: false</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> RBAC'ni muntazam audit qil (<code>rbac-tool</code>, <code>kubectl-who-can</code>), odamlarga OIDC group orqali ber, ServiceAccount'larga minimal huquq. Escalation yo'llarini (create pod, bind, escalate) alohida kuzat.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41867	<p>Bastion host va SSM Session Manager farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bastion host — public subnet'dagi &quot;sakrash&quot; serveri: 22-port ochiq, SSH kalitlar bilan ichki serverlarga o'tiladi. Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41868	<p>DDoS nima va edge'da qanday kamaytiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DDoS — ko'plab manbadan (botnet) servisni trafik yoki so'rovlar bilan to'ldirib ishdan chiqarish. Edge'da kamaytiriladi: Anycast CDN/scrubbing (Cloudflare, AWS Shield, CloudFront) trafikni taqsimlab yutadi, WAF va rate limiting L7 hujumlarini filtrlaydi, cache origin'ni himoya qiladi.</p><p><b>Hujum turlari:</b> | Qatlam | Misol | Himoya | |---|---|---| | L3/L4 volumetric | UDP/DNS amplification, SYN flood | Anycast, provider scrubbing, SYN cookies | | L4 protokol | SYN flood, ACK flood | Shield, NLB, SYN cookies | | L7 | HTTP flood, qimmat endpoint'larga so'rov | WAF rate rule, bot challenge, cache |</p><pre>Botnet (100k IP) -&gt; [Anycast edge: 300+ PoP]   &lt;- hujum bir nechta PoP'ga taqsimlanadi<br>                         | L3/L4 scrubbing<br>                         | WAF + rate limit + bot check<br>                         | cache HIT -&gt; origin'ga bormaydi<br>                         v<br>                  [Origin: faqat CDN IP'laridan qabul qiladi]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># AWS WAF rate-based rule: 5 daqiqada bitta IP'dan 2000 dan ortiq so'rov -&gt; block<br>rule {<br>  name = &quot;rate-limit&quot;<br>  priority = 0<br>  action { block {} }<br>  statement { rate_based_statement { limit = 2000, aggregate_key_type = &quot;IP&quot; } }<br>  visibility_config { cloudwatch_metrics_enabled = true, metric_name = &quot;rate&quot;, sampled_requests_enabled = true }<br>}</pre><p>Nginx darajasida: <code>limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api:10m rate=10r/s;</code></p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Origin IP oshkor (eski DNS yozuvi, email header) — hujumchi CDN'ni chetlab o'tadi.</li><li>Autoscaling'ni DDoS himoyasi deb o'ylash — hisobni portlatadi (&quot;economic DoS&quot;).</li><li>Login/qidiruv kabi qimmat endpoint'lar uchun alohida, qattiqroq limit yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Runbook oldindan tayyor bo'lsin: &quot;Under attack&quot; rejimi, provider support kontakti, qaysi metrikalar (edge RPS, origin 5xx). Shield Advanced kabi xizmatlar hujum paytidagi scaling xarajatini ham qoplaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41869	<p>Container escape (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container escape — container ichidagi hujumchi izolyatsiyadan (namespace, cgroup) chiqib host ustidan nazorat olishi. Sabablari: <code>--privileged</code>, root sifatida ishlash, host path mount (<code>/</code>, <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code>), ortiqcha capabilities, <code>hostPID</code>/<code>hostNetwork</code>, yoki kernel zaifligi.</p><p><b>Nega xavfli:</b> Container — VM emas, kernel umumiy. Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41870	<p>Git'da secret scanning va CI'da secret masking nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secret scanning — commit/push'larda AWS kalit, private key, token kabi pattern va yuqori entropiyali qatorlarni topib bloklaydi (Gitleaks, Trufflehog, GitHub push protection). Secret masking — CI log'larida ma'lum secret qiymatlarini <code>***</code> bilan almashtiradi, toki ular build chiqishida ko'rinmasin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Git tarixi abadiy: faylni o'chirib commit qilish secret'ni yo'q qilmaydi. Public repo'ga tushgan AWS kaliti daqiqalar ichida botlar tomonidan topiladi.</p><pre>Developer -&gt; pre-commit (gitleaks) -&gt; push -&gt; server push protection<br>                                               -&gt; CI scan (to'liq tarix)<br>CI job: echo $TOKEN -&gt; runner log'da &quot;***&quot;   &lt;- masking</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gitleaks git -v .                  # tarixni skanerlash (v8.19+ sintaksis)<br>gitleaks protect --staged          # eski versiyalarda staged fayllar<br>trufflehog git file://. --only-verified</pre><p>GitHub Actions'da dinamik qiymatni mask qilish:</p><pre>echo &quot;::add-mask::$GENERATED_TOKEN&quot;</pre><p><b>Topilsa nima qilish (tartib muhim):</b></p><ol><li>Secret'ni <b>darhol revoke/rotate</b> qil — bu asosiy qadam.</li><li>Ishlatilganini audit qil (CloudTrail va h.k.).</li><li>Keyin tarixdan tozalash (<code>git filter-repo</code>) — ixtiyoriy, chunki clone'lar allaqachon bor.</li></ol><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Masking'ga ishonish — base64 qilingan yoki bo'laklarga bo'lingan secret mask'lanmaydi; <code>set -x</code> xavfli.</li><li>Faqat tarixni tozalab, kalitni rotate qilmaslik.</li><li>Fork qilingan PR'larga secret berish (<code>pull_request_target</code> xatolari).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi secret — yo'q secret: OIDC federation (GitHub -&gt; AWS role) bilan CI'da uzoq muddatli kalitga ehtiyoj qolmaydi. Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41871	<p>Kubernetes default-deny NetworkPolicy yozing va whitelisting qanday ishlashini tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Default-deny NetworkPolicy namespace'dagi barcha pod'larni tanlaydi (<code>podSelector: {}</code>) va hech qanday ruxsat qoidasi bermaydi — natijada barcha ingress va egress bloklanadi. Keyin alohida policy'lar kerakli oqimlarni ochadi; policy'lar additiv (OR), ya'ni ruxsatlar birlashadi, deny qoidasi yo'q.</p><p><b>Nega:</b> Default holatda K8s'da har pod har pod'ga gapira oladi. Buzilgan frontend pod'i to'g'ridan DB'ga ulanishi mumkin. Default-deny + whitelist = mikrosegmentatsiya.</p><pre>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: default-deny-all, namespace: production }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: {}          # namespace'dagi hamma pod<br>  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]<br>---<br># DNS'ga ruxsat (egress)<br>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: allow-dns, namespace: production }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: {}<br>  policyTypes: [Egress]<br>  egress:<br>  - to:<br>    - namespaceSelector: { matchLabels: { kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system } }<br>      podSelector: { matchLabels: { k8s-app: kube-dns } }<br>    ports: [{ port: 53, protocol: UDP }, { port: 53, protocol: TCP }]<br>---<br># frontend -&gt; api:8080<br>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: api-from-frontend, namespace: production }<br>spec:<br>  podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  policyTypes: [Ingress]<br>  ingress:<br>  - from: [{ podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: frontend } } }]<br>    ports: [{ port: 8080, protocol: TCP }]</pre><pre>frontend --8080--&gt; api      (ruxsat)<br>frontend --5432--&gt; db       (bloklangan)<br>api -&gt; egress kerak bo'lsa (db:5432) -&gt; alohida egress policy ham kerak!</pre><p><b>Tekshirish:</b></p><pre>kubectl -n production exec deploy/frontend -- nc -zv -w2 api 8080<br>kubectl -n production exec deploy/frontend -- nc -zv -w2 db 5432   # timeout kutiladi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CNI NetworkPolicy'ni qo'llamaydi (masalan, oddiy Flannel) — policy yaratiladi, lekin hech narsa bloklanmaydi.</li><li>Egress default-deny'da ruxsat ikki tomondan kerak: manba pod'ning egress'i va manzil pod'ning ingress'i.</li><li><code>from</code> ichida <code>namespaceSelector</code> va <code>podSelector</code> bitta element (AND) yoki ikki element (OR) — YAML tirei farqi katta.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval observe (Cilium Hubble, flow log) bilan haqiqiy oqimlarni yig', keyin policy yoz. FQDN asosidagi egress (masalan <code>api.stripe.com</code>) uchun standart NetworkPolicy yetmaydi — Cilium/Calico CRD kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals

Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41873	<p>SPIFFE/SPIRE va workload identity attestation qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SPIFFE — workload identity standarti: har servis <code>spiffe://trust-domain/path</code> ko'rinishidagi ID va uni isbotlovchi qisqa muddatli SVID (X.509 yoki JWT) oladi. SPIRE — uning implementatsiyasi: agent workload'ni attestation qiladi (kernel/kubelet orqali uning kimligini tekshiradi) va secret'siz, avtomatik yangilanadigan sertifikat beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo (&quot;secret zero&quot;):</b> Servis Vault'ga yoki boshqa servisga o'zini qanday isbotlaydi? Agar token kerak bo'lsa, o'sha token'ni qayerda saqlaysan? Attestation bu muammoni yo'q qiladi — identity platformadan kelgan faktlarga asoslanadi.</p><pre>1. Node attestation: SPIRE agent -&gt; SPIRE server (AWS IID / K8s PSAT bilan isbot)<br>2. Workload attestation:<br>   pod process -&gt; Workload API (unix socket) -&gt; SPIRE agent<br>        agent: PID -&gt; kernel (/proc) -&gt; cgroup -&gt; container ID<br>               kubelet -&gt; pod: ns=finance, sa=payment-service, image hash<br>        selector'lar mos keldi -&gt; registration entry topildi<br>3. SVID: spiffe://prod.example.com/ns/finance/sa/payment-service<br>   X.509, TTL ~1 soat, xotirada, avtomatik rotatsiya<br>4. mTLS: boshqa servis SVID'ni trust bundle bilan tekshiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spire-server entry create \<br>  -spiffeID spiffe://prod.example.com/ns/finance/sa/payment-service \<br>  -parentID spiffe://prod.example.com/k8s-node \<br>  -selector k8s:ns:finance -selector k8s:sa:payment-service<br>spire-agent api fetch x509 -socketPath /run/spire/sockets/agent.sock</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Selector'lar juda keng (faqat <code>k8s:ns:finance</code>) — namespace'dagi har pod bir xil identity oladi.</li><li>SPIRE server HA va CA kalit backup'i yo'q — server tushsa SVID'lar yangilanmay muddati tugaydi.</li><li>Ilova SVID rotatsiyasini qayta yuklamaydi (sertifikatni bir marta o'qiydi) — 1 soatdan keyin mTLS uziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Istio identity ham SPIFFE formatida. SPIFFE ko'p klaster/ko'p cloud federatsiyada, Vault/AWS'ga JWT-SVID bilan secret'siz autentifikatsiyada kuchli — &quot;secret zero&quot; muammosining eng toza yechimi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41874	<p>Vault dynamic secrets statik DB credential'larini qanday yo'qotadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Vault database secrets engine har ilova instance'i uchun so'rov bo'yicha alohida, qisqa muddatli (masalan 1 soat) DB user yaratadi va lease tugaganda o'zi o'chiradi. VALID UNTIL '...';<br>       GRANT app_rw TO &quot;v-k8s-app-x7Kd&quot;;<br>3. Vault -&gt; Pod: username/password + lease_id (TTL 1h, max 24h)<br>4. Pod lease'ni renew qiladi ... yoki to'xtaydi<br>5. Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41876	<p>Admission control uchun OPA Gatekeeper va Kyverno solishtiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham Kubernetes admission webhook sifatida resurslarni yaratishdan oldin siyosat bo'yicha tekshiradi. Kyverno — siyosatlar <b>YAML</b> da: K8s'ga nativ, validate + mutate + generate + image verify bir joyda.</p><pre>kubectl apply -&gt; kube-apiserver -&gt; authn/authz -&gt; Mutating webhooks -&gt; Validating webhooks -&gt; etcd<br>                                                   (Kyverno mutate)    (Gatekeeper/Kyverno validate)</pre><p>| | Gatekeeper | Kyverno | |---|---|---| | Til | Rego (ConstraintTemplate + Constraint) | YAML (CEL ham) | | Mutation | bor (Assign, keyinroq qo'shilgan) | nativ, kuchli | | Generate resurs | yo'q | bor (masalan, har yangi ns'ga NetworkPolicy) | | Image imzo tekshiruvi | tashqi (Ratify) | nativ <code>verifyImages</code> | | K8s'dan tashqarida | OPA: Terraform, API, Envoy | asosan K8s (kyverno CLI CI'da) |</p><p><b>Amalda (bir xil qoida — <code>team</code> label majburiy):</b></p><pre># Kyverno<br>apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1<br>kind: ClusterPolicy<br>metadata: { name: require-team-label }<br>spec:<br>  validationFailureAction: Enforce<br>  rules:<br>  - name: check-team<br>    match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Deployment] } }] }<br>    validate:<br>      message: &quot;team label majburiy&quot;<br>      pattern: { metadata: { labels: { team: &quot;?*&quot; } } }</pre><p>Gatekeeper'da shu uchun Rego'li <code>ConstraintTemplate</code> + <code>K8sRequiredLabels</code> Constraint kerak.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Webhook <code>failurePolicy: Fail</code> va controller tushgan — klasterda hech narsa deploy bo'lmaydi; HA va <code>kube-system</code> ni istisno qil.</li><li>Darhol Enforce — mavjud workload'lar keyingi deploy'da yiqiladi; avval Audit rejimi.</li><li>Policy'larni test qilmaslik — <code>kyverno test</code> / <code>gator verify</code> CI'da.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Endi K8s'ning o'zida <code>ValidatingAdmissionPolicy</code> (CEL, 1.30 GA) bor — oddiy qoidalar uchun webhook'siz. Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41877	<p>CycloneDX va SPDX SBOM formatlari farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham SBOM (Software Bill of Materials — dasturdagi komponentlar ro'yxati) standarti. CycloneDX (OWASP) — xavfsizlikka yo'naltirilgan, yengil, VEX, servis va ML-BOM qo'llaydi. Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41878	<p>Cosign va keyless image imzolash (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cosign (Sigstore) container image'larni imzolaydi va tekshiradi.
