Intervyuda &quot;ECDHE forward secrecy beradi, HKDF ajratadi, transcript bog'laydi&quot; — uch qism.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42024	<p>ESNI / Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ECH (Encrypted Client Hello) — <code>ClientHello</code> ni ikkiga bo'ladi: ochiq &quot;outer&quot; (umumiy <code>public_name</code>, masalan CDN domeni) va shifrlangan &quot;inner&quot; (haqiqiy SNI, ALPN va h.k.). Kalit DNS <code>HTTPS</code> yozuvidan olinadi. ESNI — uning eski, faqat SNI'ni shifrlaydigan va bekor qilingan versiyasi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> TLS 1.3 sertifikatni shifrlaydi, lekin SNI (qaysi domenga kirilayotgani) ochiq ketadi. ISP, korporativ proxy yoki senzura tizimi <code>sni=example.com</code> ni ko'rib bloklaydi yoki profil yig'adi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. DNS: example.com HTTPS RR -&gt; ech=&lt;ECHConfig: public key, public_name=cdn.net&gt;<br>2. Client:<br>   ClientHelloOuter (ochiq): SNI=cdn.net<br>      +-- encrypted_client_hello: HPKE( ClientHelloInner: SNI=example.com )<br>3. Client-facing server (CDN) kalit bilan ochadi -&gt; backend'ga inner bilan davom<br>4. Ocholmasa -&gt; outer bilan handshake + &quot;retry_configs&quot; (yangi kalit)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>dig +short HTTPS crypto.cloudflare.com     # ech=... maydonini ko'r<br># Firefox/Chrome: ECH DoH bilan birga yoqiladi<br>curl --ech hard https://crypto.cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/trace   # curl 8.8+ ECH bilan build qilingan bo'lsa</pre><p><code>/cdn-cgi/trace</code> chiqishida <code>sni=encrypted</code> ko'rinsa — ECH ishladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DNS shifrlanmagan bo'lsa (DoH/DoT yo'q) domen baribir DNS so'rovida ko'rinadi — ECH faqat DoH bilan ma'noli.</li><li>Korporativ TLS inspection/IDS SNI'ga tayanadi — ECH ularni ko'r qiladi; ba'zi tarmoqlar ECH'ni bloklaydi.</li><li>Standart RFC sifatida 2025 da yakunlangan, lekin server tomonda qo'llab-quvvatlash hali asosan CDN'larda (Cloudflare).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ECH &quot;ko'plab domen bitta public_name ortida&quot; bo'lgandagina maxfiylik beradi — kichik o'z serveringizda foydasi kam. Himoya jamoasi uchun: SNI-ga asoslangan egress filtrlash kelajakda ishonchsiz, DNS/endpoint darajasidagi nazoratga o'tish kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42025	<p>HTTP/2 HPACK nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HPACK — HTTP/2 header siqish formati: <b>statik jadval</b> (61 ta keng tarqalgan header), ulanish bo'yicha <b>dinamik jadval</b> (oldin yuborilganlar indeksi) va <b>Huffman</b> kodlash. Takroriy header (cookie, user-agent) ikkinchi marta 1-2 bayt indeks sifatida ketadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> HTTP/1.1 da har so'rovda 500-2000 bayt bir xil header matn holida qayta yuboriladi. Sahifa 100 ta resurs so'rasa — o'nlab KB faqat header. Mobil tarmoqda bu sezilarli kechikish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1-so'rov:  :method GET        -&gt; statik idx 2           (1 bayt)<br>           user-agent: Mozilla... -&gt; literal + dinamik jadvalga qo'sh (idx 62)<br>2-so'rov:  user-agent        -&gt; idx 62                  (1 bayt)<br>Encoder va decoder bir xil dinamik jadvalni sinxron saqlaydi (TCP tartibi kafolatlaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>nghttp -nv https://example.com     # HEADERS frame hajmi va jadval ishini ko'r<br>h2load -n 1000 -c 10 https://example.com   # &quot;space savings&quot; ko'rsatkichi</pre><p>Chiqishda <code>header table size</code> va <code>space savings: 85%</code> kabi qatorlar — siqish samarasi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Nega gzip emas? HTTP/1 da TLS+siqish <b>CRIME</b> hujumiga olib kelgan (siqilgan hajmdan sirni taxminlash). HPACK sezgir header'lar uchun <code>never-indexed</code> literal'ni qo'llaydi — <code>Authorization</code>, <code>Cookie</code> qismlarini jadvalga qo'ymaslik mumkin.</li><li>Katta dinamik jadval = server xotirasi; <code>SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE</code> bilan cheklanadi. &quot;HPACK bomb&quot; (kichik indeks — katta header) ga qarshi <code>max header list size</code> qo'y.</li><li>Dinamik jadval tartibga bog'liq — shuning uchun QUIC'da ishlamaydi (QPACK kerak bo'ldi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Proxy (nginx, Envoy) da <code>large_client_header_buffers</code>/<code>max_request_headers_kb</code> va HTTP/2 limitlarini sozlash — HPACK asosidagi DoS'ga qarshi asosiy himoya.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42026	<p>HTTP/3 QPACK nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> QPACK — HTTP/3 (QUIC) uchun HPACK'ning moslashgan varianti. Dinamik jadval yangilanishlari alohida bir yo'nalishli <b>encoder/decoder stream</b>'larda yuboriladi, so'rov stream'lari esa jadvalga havola qiladi — shu tufayli bitta stream'dagi paket yo'qolishi qolgan so'rovlarni to'xtatib qo'ymaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> QUIC'da stream'lar mustaqil va tartibsiz yetib keladi. Agar HPACK ishlatilsa, B so'rovi A'dagi jadval qo'shimchasiga tayanadi — A paketi yo'qolsa B ham kutadi. Bu TCP'dagi head-of-line blocking'ni qaytarib olib keladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>encoder stream  (client -&gt; server): &quot;jadvalga user-agent qo'sh&quot;   [unidirectional]<br>decoder stream  (server -&gt; client): &quot;qo'shimchani oldim (ack)&quot;<br>request stream 4:  Required Insert Count = 5, idx ref ...<br>     ^ decoder bu count'gacha jadval tayyor bo'lmasa -&gt; stream &quot;blocked&quot;<br>SETTINGS_QPACK_BLOCKED_STREAMS = 0 bo'lsa encoder faqat ack'langan<br>yozuvlarga havola qiladi -&gt; hech qachon blok bo'lmaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl --http3 -v https://cloudflare.com 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -i 'HTTP/3'<br># nginx 1.25+: listen 443 quic reuseport; add_header Alt-Svc 'h3=&quot;:443&quot;; ma=86400';</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>QPACK_BLOCKED_STREAMS</code> katta = yaxshi siqish lekin blokirovka xavfi; 0 = xavfsiz, siqish kamroq. Trade-off.</li><li>UDP/443 firewall'da yopiq bo'lsa brauzer jimgina HTTP/2 ga qaytadi — &quot;HTTP/3 ishlamayapti&quot; deb xato debug qilinadi.</li><li>Header limitlari (<code>max_field_section_size</code>) yo'q bo'lsa DoS xavfi HPACK'dagidek.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> QPACK — &quot;transport mustaqilligi uchun siqish samarasidan biroz voz kechish&quot; namunasi. HTTP/3 yutug'i asosan yo'qotishli mobil tarmoqlarda; datacenter ichida HTTP/2 yetarli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42027	<p>DNS rebinding hujumi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DNS rebinding — hujumchi o'z domenini juda qisqa TTL bilan avval o'z serveriga, keyin <b>ichki IP</b>ga (<code>127.0.0.1</code>, <code>192.168.1.1</code>, <code>169.254.169.254</code>) resolve qildiradi. Brauzer uchun origin o'zgarmagan (<code>evil.com</code>), shuning uchun same-origin policy JS'ga ichki servis javobini o'qishga ruxsat beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dasturchi noutbukida autentifikatsiyasiz <code>localhost:8080</code> admin panel, router web UI yoki Kubernetes dashboard — &quot;tashqaridan ochiq emas, demak xavfsiz&quot; deb o'ylanadi. Rebinding bu chegarani brauzer orqali kesib o'tadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. Qurbon evil.com ochadi   DNS: evil.com -&gt; 1.2.3.4 (TTL=1)<br>2. JS yuklanadi, kutadi<br>3. JS fetch(&quot;http://evil.com:8080/api&quot;)  DNS qayta: evil.com -&gt; 127.0.0.1<br>4. Brauzer: origin evil.com = evil.com  -&gt; javobni JS o'qiy oladi<br>5. JS natijani hujumchiga yuboradi</pre><p><b>Himoya (amalda):</b></p><pre># Ichki servis faqat kutilgan Host'ni qabul qilsin<br>server {<br>  listen 127.0.0.1:8080 default_server;<br>  return 421;                          # noma'lum Host<br>}<br>server { listen 127.0.0.1:8080; server_name localhost admin.internal; ... }</pre><pre># dnsmasq / Pi-hole: tashqi domenlar uchun private IP javoblarini blokla<br>stop-dns-rebind<br>rebind-localhost-ok</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Localhost'da, demak xavfsiz&quot; — eng katta noto'g'ri tushuncha; har ichki servis autentifikatsiya talab qilsin.</li><li>Faqat IP allowlist yetmaydi — <code>Host</code> header tekshiruvi kerak (dev server'lar: Vite, webpack <code>allowedHosts</code>).</li><li>SSRF filtri DNS'ni bir marta tekshirib, keyin qayta resolve qilsa — xuddi shu rebinding (TOCTOU).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Chrome Private Network Access (PNA) preflight'larni joriy qilmoqda, lekin unga tayanma. Mudofaa: Host validatsiyasi + autentifikatsiya + DNS rebind filtri — uch qatlam.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42028	<p>CSRF nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) — foydalanuvchi bank.com'ga login bo'lgan holda evil.com'ni ochadi, u yerdagi forma bank.com'ga so'rov yuboradi va brauzer <b>cookie'ni avtomatik qo'shadi</b> — server uni foydalanuvchining haqiqiy harakati deb qabul qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Server faqat cookie bo'yicha autentifikatsiya qilsa, so'rov qaysi saytdan boshlanganini bilmaydi. Natija: pul o'tkazish, email/parol o'zgartirish foydalanuvchi bilmagan holda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>evil.com sahifasi:<br>  &lt;form action=&quot;https://bank.com/transfer&quot; method=&quot;POST&quot;&gt;<br>    &lt;input name=&quot;to&quot; value=&quot;attacker&quot;&gt; &lt;input name=&quot;amount&quot; value=&quot;1000&quot;&gt;<br>  &lt;/form&gt;  &lt;script&gt;form.submit()&lt;/script&gt;<br>Brauzer -&gt; bank.com  Cookie: session=abc   (avtomatik!)<br>bank.com: sessiya to'g'ri -&gt; o'tkazma bajarildi</pre><p><b>Himoya (amalda):</b></p><pre>Set-Cookie: session=abc; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/</pre><pre>// Go 1.25+: net/http.CrossOriginProtection — Sec-Fetch-Site/Origin tekshiradi<br>h := http.NewCrossOriginProtection()<br>http.ListenAndServe(&quot;:8080&quot;, h.Handler(mux))</pre><p>Klassik variant — synchronizer token: server sessiyaga bog'liq token beradi, forma <code>&lt;input type=hidden name=csrf&gt;</code> bilan qaytaradi, server solishtiradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>SameSite=Lax</code> GET'ni himoya qilmaydi — holat o'zgartiruvchi GET endpoint (<code>/delete?id=5</code>) bo'lmasin.</li><li>Subdomen (<code>evil.bank.com</code>) &quot;same-site&quot; hisoblanadi — SameSite yordam bermaydi, token kerak.</li><li>Token'ni <code>Authorization</code> header'da yuboradigan SPA (cookie emas) CSRF'ga deyarli chidamli; lekin CORS'ni <code>*</code> + credentials bilan ochsangiz himoya yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy stack: <code>SameSite=Lax</code> default + <code>Sec-Fetch-Site</code>/<code>Origin</code> tekshiruvi + muhim amallarda qayta tasdiqlash (parol, 2FA). Qatlamlarni birlashtir, bittasiga tayanma.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42029	<p>SSRF nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) — ilova foydalanuvchi bergan URL'ga <b>server o'zi</b> so'rov yuboradi (webhook, rasm yuklash, PDF render) va hujumchi uni ichki manzillarga yo'naltiradi: cloud metadata (<code>169.254.169.254</code>), ichki admin API, Redis.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Server ichki tarmoqda, firewall ichida turadi. &quot;URL'dan avatar yuklash&quot; Ilova kodidagi filtr — ikkinchi qatlam.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42030	<p>Command injection nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Command injection — ilova foydalanuvchi input'ini shell buyrug'i satriga qo'shadi (<code>sh -c &quot;ping &quot; + host</code>), va <code>;</code>, <code>&amp;&amp;</code>, <code>|</code>, <code>$( )</code> kabi shell metabelgilar orqali hujumchi o'z buyrug'ini bajartiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Diagnostika&quot; sahifasi: host kiriting -&gt; ping. Iloji bo'lmasa: allowlist validatsiya + argv + <code>--</code> + minimal huquqli, seccomp'li konteyner. Kod review'da <code>sh -c</code> va <code>shell=True</code> — avtomatik qizil bayroq (Semgrep qoidasi).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42031	<p>Path traversal nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Path traversal — foydalanuvchi bergan fayl nomidagi <code>../</code> (yoki uning kodlangan shakllari) orqali ilova ruxsat bergan papkadan tashqaridagi fayllarga kirish: <code>/download?file=../../app/.env</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova <code>filepath.Join(&quot;/srv/uploads&quot;, name)</code> qilib faylni qaytaradi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42032	<p>Insecure deserialization nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Insecure deserialization — ishonchsiz baytlarni til-native format bilan (Python <code>pickle</code>, Java serialization, PHP <code>unserialize</code>, .NET <code>BinaryFormatter</code>) obyektga aylantirish. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42033	<p>XXE injection nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> XXE (XML External Entity) — XML parser DTD'dagi tashqi entity'larni qayta ishlasa, server lokal fayllarni o'qib qaytarishi, ichki URL'larga so'rov yuborishi (SSRF) yoki ichma-ich entity'lar bilan xotirani tugatishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> SAML, SOAP, SVG/DOCX/XLSX yuklash, RSS import — hammasi XML. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42034	<p>Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) hujumi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> MitM — hujumchi ikki tomon orasiga kirib, trafikni o'qiydi yoki o'zgartiradi. Asosiy himoya — <b>autentifikatsiyali shifrlash</b>: TLS + sertifikat zanjiri va hostname'ni to'g'ri tekshirish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ochiq Wi-Fi, soxta DNS/DHCP yoki buzilgan router. Ilova <code>InsecureSkipVerify: true</code> bilan ishlasa — shifrlash bor, lekin kim bilan gaplashayotganini tekshirmaydi, ya'ni himoya yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Client ---TLS---&gt; [oraliq] ---TLS---&gt; Server<br>Oraliq o'z sertifikatini beradi:<br>  client tekshirsa   -&gt; ishonchli CA emas / hostname mos emas -&gt; ulanish uziladi<br>  client tekshirmasa -&gt; trafik ochiq</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>openssl s_client -connect api.example.com:443 -servername api.example.com -verify_return_error<br>curl -v https://api.example.com 2&gt;&amp;1 | grep -E 'subject|issuer|verify'</pre><pre>pool := x509.NewCertPool(); pool.AppendCertsFromPEM(caPEM)<br>cfg := &amp;tls.Config{RootCAs: pool, MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12}   // InsecureSkipVerify yo'q</pre><p>Servislararo: mTLS (Istio/Linkerd, SPIFFE).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>curl -k</code>, <code>verify=False</code> dev'dan prod'ga o'tib qoladi — SAST bilan qidir.</li><li>Qisman HTTPS: cookie <code>Secure</code> bo'lmasa HTTP'da sizadi — HSTS + <code>Secure</code>.</li><li>Pinning: mobil'da foydali, lekin sertifikat almashsa ilova ishlamaydi — SPKI pin + zaxira kalit.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ichki tarmoq ham ishonchli emas (Zero Trust). Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42035	<p>Downgrade hujumi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Downgrade hujumi — oraliqdagi hujumchi tomonlarni <b>zaifroq</b> variantga majburlaydi: eski TLS/SSL versiyasi, zaif cipher yoki HTTPS o'rniga HTTP (SSL stripping). Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42036	<p>Buffer overflow (memory corruption) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Buffer overflow (memory corruption) — dastur buffer'ga ajratilganidan ko'p ma'lumot yozib, qo'shni xotirani buzadi. Natija: crash, ma'lumot buzilishi yoki eng yomon holatda boshqaruv oqimining egallanishi. C/C++ chegarani avtomatik tekshirmagani uchun yuzaga keladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Microsoft va Google ma'lumotlariga ko'ra og'ir xavfsizlik xatolarining ~70% i memory safety bilan bog'liq. Bitta <code>strcpy</code> — butun servis xavfi.</p><p><b>Qanday himoyalanadi (qatlamlar):</b></p><pre>1. Til:        memory-safe (Go, Rust, Java) -&gt; chegara avtomatik tekshiriladi<br>2. Kod:        chegarali API (snprintf, strlcpy), uzunlikni doim tekshir<br>3. Kompilyator: stack canary, FORTIFY_SOURCE, PIE<br>4. OS/CPU:     ASLR, NX (W^X), RELRO<br>5. Runtime:    sandbox (seccomp, minimal huquq) -&gt; zarar chegaralanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcc -O2 -fstack-protector-strong -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3 -fPIE -pie \<br>    -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now app.c -o app<br>checksec --file=./app            # Canary / NX / PIE / RELRO holati<br>gcc -fsanitize=address -g app.c &amp;&amp; ./a.out   # test paytida aniq qatorni ko'rsatadi</pre><pre>snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, &quot;%s&quot;, in);   // strcpy o'rniga</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Mitigatsiyalar xatoni yo'qotmaydi, faqat ekspluatatsiyani qiyinlashtiradi — xatoni baribir tuzatish kerak.</li><li>Integer overflow (<code>len * size</code>) ko'pincha kichik ajratish va keyin overflow'ga olib keladi.</li><li>Go/Rust'da <code>unsafe</code>/cgo qismlari xavfni saqlaydi — review'da alohida e'tibor.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi kod uchun memory-safe til (CISA/NSA tavsiyasi). Mavjud C/C++ uchun: OSS-Fuzz/libFuzzer + sanitizer'lar CI'da + hardening flag'lar + sandbox. Distro paketlarini yangilab turish — eng arzon himoya.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42037	<p>ASLR nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ASLR (Address Space Layout Randomization) — har ishga tushishda stack, heap, mmap va kutubxonalar (PIE bo'lsa dastur kodi ham) bazaviy manzillarini tasodifiylashtiradi. Natija: xotira xatosidan foydalanmoqchi bo'lgan hujumchi kerakli manzillarni oldindan bilmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Manzillar doimiy bo'lsa, bitta xotira xatosi deyarli kafolatli ekspluatatsiyaga aylanadi. ASLR uni ehtimollik o'yiniga aylantiradi va boshqa mitigatsiyalar bilan birga ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Ishga tushirish 1:  libc @ 0x7f3a1c200000<br>Ishga tushirish 2:  libc @ 0x7f9b44a00000<br>PIE bo'lmagan binar: kodi har doim bir manzilda -&gt; ASLR qisman</pre><p><b>Amalda (tekshiruv):</b></p><pre>cat /proc/sys/kernel/randomize_va_space   # 2 = to'liq (kerakli qiymat)<br>grep libc /proc/self/maps                 # ikki marta ishga tushirib solishtir<br>checksec --file=/usr/bin/nginx            # PIE enabled?<br>cat /proc/cmdline | grep -o nokaslr       # kernel KASLR o'chirilmaganini tekshir</pre><p>Hardening: <code>sysctl -w kernel.randomize_va_space=2</code> va <code>/etc/sysctl.d/</code> da doimiy qilish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ma'lumot oqishi (info leak) bitta manzilni oshkor qilsa ASLR samarasi tushadi — shuning uchun yakka himoya emas.</li><li>32-bit tizimlarda entropiya kam.</li><li>Debug uchun ASLR o'chirilgan image yoki <code>nokaslr</code> prod'ga o'tib qolishi — CIS benchmark bilan tekshir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ASLR + NX + canary + RELRO + CFI — birgalikda ma'noli. Audit'da <code>randomize_va_space</code> va binar'larning PIE holati standart tekshiruv bandi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42038	<p>NX / DEP nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> NX (No-eXecute, Intel'da XD) / DEP (Windows nomi) — CPU sahifa jadvalidagi bit: ma'lumot sahifalari (stack, heap) <b>bajarib bo'lmaydi</b>. Prinsip W^X: sahifa yo yoziladigan, yo bajariladigan. Buffer'ga yozilgan ma'lumot kod sifatida ishga tushmaydi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Xotira xatolarining eng oddiy ekspluatatsiya yo'lini yopadi. Hujumchilar mavjud kod parchalarini qayta ishlatishga majbur bo'ladi — bunga qarshi ASLR va CFI ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>/proc/PID/maps ruxsatlari:<br> r-xp  /app       &lt;- kod: o'qish + bajarish<br> rw-p  /app       &lt;- data: yozish, bajarish yo'q<br> rw-p  [stack]    &lt;- bajarish yo'q<br>JIT (V8, JVM) bundan istisno -&gt; ular W^X ni o'zi boshqaradi</pre><p><b>Amalda (tekshiruv):</b></p><pre>grep -o ' nx ' /proc/cpuinfo | head -1     # CPU NX qo'llaydi<br>checksec --file=./app                      # NX enabled<br>readelf -lW ./app | grep GNU_STACK         # RW (RWE bo'lmasin)<br>grep -E 'rwxp' /proc/$(pidof app)/maps     # bajariladigan+yoziladigan sahifa bormi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski kutubxona <code>execstack</code> bilan link qilingan bo'lsa butun process stack'i bajariladigan bo'lib qoladi — <code>readelf</code> bilan tekshir.</li><li><code>rwx</code> sahifalar (JIT'dan tashqari) — shubhali, EDR/audit signal.</li><li>NX kod qayta ishlatish texnikalarini to'xtatmaydi — CFI (Intel CET shadow stack, <code>-fcf-protection</code>) keyingi qatlam.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy toolchain'lar NX'ni default yoqadi; senior'ning ishi — istisnolarni topish (eski vendor binar'lari, <code>execstack</code>) va CET kabi yangi himoyalarni yoqish.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::net sec::h31 DevSecOps_cryptography
Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42039	<p>LKM rootkit nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> LKM rootkit — kernel moduli sifatida yuklanib, kernel darajasida ishlaydigan zararli dastur: process, fayl va ulanishlarni userland tool'lardan (<code>ps</code>, <code>ls</code>, <code>ss</code>) yashiradi. Interview Drill::Networking::H31 DevSecOps & cryptography	idrill-42043	<p>Git'da imzolangan commit'lar (GPG / SSH / S/MIME) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Imzolangan commit — commit'ni private kalit (GPG, SSH yoki S/MIME) bilan imzolash. Interview Drill::Networking::T13 Network & latency gotchas	idrill-17022	<p>TCP connection 'tirik' ko'rinadi, lekin qarshi tomon allaqachon o'lgan. Nega va nima qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TCP'da ulanish &quot;tirik&quot; degani — faqat ikki tomonda holat (state) saqlanganini anglatadi. Agar qarshi tomon <b>to'satdan</b> yo'qolsa (server o'chdi, kabel uzildi, NAT/load balancer ulanishni jimgina unutdi), hech qanday <code>FIN</code>/<code>RST</code> kelmaydi va trafik bo'lmagani uchun sizning tomon buni <b>sezmaydi</b> — bu <b>half-open</b> ulanish. Birinchi yozish urinishida yoki uzoq kutishdan keyin xato chiqadi. Yechim — <b>timeout'lar</b> va <b>keepalive/heartbeat</b>.</p><h4>Qanday paydo bo'ladi</h4><pre>Client &lt;---- ulanish ----&gt; Server<br>            server elektr o'chdi (FIN yuborilmadi)<br>Client: ulanish ESTABLISHED, read() kutyapti... abadiy</pre><p>Bulutdagi klassik holat: AWS NAT Gateway (350s), ALB (60s default), Azure LB (4 daqiqa) — <b>idle</b> ulanishni o'z jadvalidan jimgina o'chiradi. Ikkala tomon ulanishni tirik deb biladi; keyingi so'rov yuborilganda — <code>connection reset</code> yoki timeout. &quot;Uzoq tanaffusdan keyingi birinchi so'rov doim xato&quot; — shu.</p><h4>Himoya qatlamlari</h4><p><b>1. Ilova timeout'lari (eng muhim)</b></p><pre>conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second))<br>client := &amp;http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}</pre><p>Hech qachon cheksiz kutmang.</p><p><b>2. TCP keepalive</b> — trafik yo'q paytda kichik tekshiruv paketlari:</p><pre>dialer := &amp;net.Dialer{KeepAlive: 30 * time.Second}</pre><p>Linux sozlamalari (default juda uzoq — 2 soat):</p><pre>net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time = 60<br>net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl = 10<br>net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes = 6</pre><p>Keepalive interval NAT/LB idle timeout'dan <b>qisqa</b> bo'lishi kerak — shunda ulanish jadvalda &quot;tirik&quot; qoladi.</p><p><b>3. Ilova darajasidagi heartbeat</b> — WebSocket ping/pong, gRPC keepalive, DB pool'larda validatsiya so'rovi. TCP keepalive'dan ishonchliroq (ilova haqiqatan javob berayotganini ham tekshiradi).</p><p><b>4. Pool'larda idle limit</b> — ulanishni LB timeout'idan oldin o'zi yopish:</p><pre>transport := &amp;http.Transport{IdleConnTimeout: 50 * time.Second}  // ALB 60s dan kam<br>db.SetConnMaxIdleTime(4 * time.Minute)</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Server keep-alive timeout &gt; load balancer idle timeout&quot; qoidasi: aks holda server ulanishni yopadi, LB esa uni tirik deb so'rov yuboradi — 502. Client tomonda esa teskari: client idle timeout &lt; LB/NAT idle timeout. Bu ikki qoida tasodifiy &quot;birinchi so'rov xatosi&quot;ning ko'pini yo'qotadi.</p>	lvl::Principal dom::net sec::t13 Network_gotcha
Interview Drill::Networking::T13 Network & latency gotchas	idrill-17023	<p>Yuk ostida 'connection reset by peer' va TIME_WAIT ko'payyapti. Sabab?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bu simptomlar odatda <b>ulanishlar qayta ishlatilmayotgani</b>ni ko'rsatadi: har so'rov uchun yangi TCP (va TLS) ulanish ochiladi va yopiladi. Har yopilgan ulanish yopgan tomonda <b>TIME_WAIT</b> holatida 60s qoladi, portlar tugaydi, server esa yuk ostida ulanishlarni <code>RST</code> bilan rad etadi. Go'da klassik sabablar: har so'rovga yangi <code>http.Client</code>, response body yopilmagan/oxirigacha o'qilmagan, yoki <code>MaxIdleConnsPerHost</code> juda kichik (default 2).</p><h4>Tekshirish</h4><pre>ss -s                                          # TIME-WAIT soni<br>ss -tan state time-wait | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head   # kimga<br>netstat -s | grep -i reset</pre><p>Yangi ulanishlar sekundiga ~RPS ga teng bo'lsa — keep-alive ishlamayapti.</p><h4>Go'dagi tipik xatolar va to'g'ri kod</h4><pre>// XATO: har chaqiruvda yangi client/transport — pool yo'q<br>func call() { c := &amp;http.Client{}; c.Get(url) }<br><br>// XATO: body yopilmagan yoki o'qilmagan — ulanish pool'ga qaytmaydi<br>resp, _ := client.Get(url)<br>// resp.Body.Close() yo'q</pre><pre>// TO'G'RI: bitta umumiy client, sozlangan transport<br>var client = &amp;http.Client{<br>    Timeout: 10 * time.Second,<br>    Transport: &amp;http.Transport{<br>        MaxIdleConns:        200,<br>        MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 100,          // default 2 — bitta upstream'ga ko'p so'rovda yetmaydi<br>        IdleConnTimeout:     90 * time.Second,<br>    },<br>}<br><br>resp, err := client.Do(req)<br>if err != nil { return err }<br>defer resp.Body.Close()<br>io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)            // oxirigacha o'qish — ulanish qayta ishlatiladi</pre><h4>TIME_WAIT haqida</h4><ul><li>U ulanishni <b>faol yopgan</b> tomonda paydo bo'ladi (2 x MSL, Linux'da 60s).</li><li>Bu xato emas — kechikkan paketlar yangi ulanishga aralashmasligi uchun.</li><li>Muammo — uning <b>soni</b>: bitta manzilga ~28 000 port (default diapazon) / 60s ≈ sekundiga ~470 yangi ulanish chegarasi.</li><li><code>tcp_tw_reuse=1</code> (chiquvchi ulanishlar uchun) yordam beradi, lekin asosiy yechim — <b>keep-alive</b>.</li></ul><h4>&quot;connection reset by peer&quot;</h4><p>Server tomonda: accept queue to'lgan, ulanish limiti, yoki server keep-alive timeout'i tugab, ulanishni yopgan paytda client so'rov yuborgan. Server idle timeout &gt; client idle timeout bo'lsin.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ulanishni qayta ishlatish — eng arzon unumdorlik optimizatsiyasi: TLS handshake har so'rovda 1–2 RTT va CPU. Monitoringda &quot;sekundiga yangi ulanishlar&quot; metrikasi RPS ga yaqin bo'lsa — pool ishlamayapti, boshqa optimizatsiyalardan oldin shuni tuzating.</p>	lvl::Principal dom::net sec::t13 Network_gotcha
Interview Drill::Networking::T13 Network & latency gotchas	idrill-17024	<p>Bir service DNS orqali boshqasini chaqiradi. Deploy paytida eski podlarga trafik ketyapti. Nega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DNS faqat <b>yangi ulanish</b> ochilganda hal qilinadi. Client keep-alive bilan ulanishni ochiq ushlab tursa, u <b>eski pod IP</b>siga yopishib qoladi — DNS yangilangani unga ta'sir qilmaydi. Deploy paytida eski pod to'xtaguncha (yoki ulanish uzilguncha) trafik unga boradi; agar eski pod <code>SIGTERM</code>da ulanishlarni to'g'ri yopmasa — xatolar.</p><h4>Qachon bo'ladi</h4><ul><li><b>Headless Service</b> (<code>clusterIP: None</code>) — DNS pod IP'larini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qaytaradi; client ulanish ochib, unga yopishadi.</li><li><b>gRPC / HTTP/2</b> — bitta uzoq yashovchi ulanish orqali barcha so'rovlar; hatto ClusterIP Service bilan ham bitta pod'ga &quot;yopishadi&quot; (L4 balanslash faqat ulanish ochilishida).</li><li>Client DNS natijasini o'zi keshlaydi (JVM default TTL, ba'zi kutubxonalar).</li></ul><h4>Yechimlar</h4><p><b>1. Server tomonda ulanishlarni yopish:</b></p><ul><li>Graceful shutdown: <code>SIGTERM</code>da yangi so'rov olmay, joriylarini tugatib, ulanishlarni yopish. HTTP/2 va gRPC'da <code>GOAWAY</code> — client boshqa pod'ga qayta ulanadi.</li><li><code>preStop</code> kechikishi — pod endpoint'lardan chiqarilishini kutish.</li><li>gRPC server'da <code>MaxConnectionAge</code> — ulanishlarni davriy yangilash, shunda client'lar yangi pod'larni ham &quot;ko'radi&quot;:</li></ul><pre>grpc.NewServer(grpc.KeepaliveParams(keepalive.ServerParameters{<br>    MaxConnectionAge:      5 * time.Minute,<br>    MaxConnectionAgeGrace: 30 * time.Second,<br>}))</pre><p><b>3. Client tomonda L7 balanslash:</b></p><ul><li>gRPC client-side load balancing: <code>dns:///svc-headless:50051</code> + <code>round_robin</code> — barcha pod'larga ulanishlar, DNS davriy yangilanadi.</li><li>Yoki service mesh (Envoy) — har so'rov alohida balanslanadi.</li></ul><p><b>4. DNS keshini cheklash</b> — JVM: <code>networkaddress.cache.ttl=30</code>.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kubernetes Service — <b>L4</b> (ulanish) balanslovchi. Thread — process ichidagi bajarilish oqimi: xotirani boshqa thread'lar bilan bo'lishadi, shuning uchun aloqa arzon, lekin umumiy holat uchun sinxronizatsiya (mutex, atomic) kerak.</p><p><b>Backend uchun nega muhim:</b></p><pre>Process A [heap][stack][fd]      Process B [heap][stack][fd]<br>   bir-birini ko'rmaydi; crash faqat o'zini o'ldiradi<br><br>Process C<br>  [umumiy heap, fd]<br>   thread1 [stack]  thread2 [stack]  thread3 [stack]<br>   bitta thread crash (segfault) -&gt; butun process o'ladi</pre><p>| | Process | Thread | |---|---|---| | Xotira | alohida | umumiy | | Yaratish narxi | yuqori (fork, page table) | pastroq | | Context switch | qimmatroq (TLB flush) | arzonroq | | Izolyatsiya | kuchli | yo'q (data race xavfi) | | Aloqa | IPC | umumiy o'zgaruvchi |</p><p><b>Real misollar:</b></p><ul><li>PostgreSQL — har ulanishga alohida process: 1000 ulanish = 1000 process, har biri ~5-10 MB. Shuning uchun PgBouncer kabi pooler kerak.</li><li>nginx — bir nechta worker process, har biri event loop.</li><li>Go — bitta process, ichida goroutine'lar oz sonli OS thread'larga taqsimlanadi (M:N).</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ps -eLf | grep myapp | wc -l       # thread soni<br>cat /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/status | grep Threads<br>top -H -p &lt;pid&gt;                    # thread bo'yicha CPU</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Thread'lar orasida umumiy map'ni lock'siz yozish — data race (Go'da <code>-race</code> bilan tut).</li><li>cgroup limitlari (CPU, memory, <code>pids.max</code>) process darajasida — thread'lar ham PID sifatida sanaladi.</li><li>Har so'rovga yangi thread — 10k ulanishda xotira va scheduler bosimi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Izolyatsiya kerak bo'lsa (ishonchsiz kod, crash chegarasi) — process; tezlik va umumiy holat kerak bo'lsa — thread/goroutine. Konteyner ham aslida izolyatsiyalangan process.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::i5 OS
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-82	<p>UTF-8 qanday kodlash va &quot;satr uzunligi&quot; nega bir necha xil ma'noga ega?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> UTF-8 — o'zgaruvchan uzunlikli Unicode kodlashi: ASCII belgilar 1 bayt, lotin kengaytmalari va kirill 2 bayt, ko'p Osiyo belgilari 3 bayt, emoji 4 bayt. Shuning uchun &quot;string uzunligi&quot; uch xil narsa bo'lishi mumkin: baytlar soni, kod nuqtalari (rune) soni va ko'rinadigan belgilar (grafema) soni — ular teng emas.</p><p><b>Misol:</b></p><pre>&quot;o'zbek&quot;   -&gt; 6 bayt, 6 rune<br>&quot;Ўзбек&quot;    -&gt; 10 bayt, 5 rune<br>&quot;g'&quot;       -&gt; ba'zan &quot;g&quot; + U+02BB (2 rune, 3 bayt)<br>&quot;e&quot; + U+0301 (kombinatsiyalovchi urg'u) -&gt; 1 ko'rinadigan &quot;é&quot;, 2 rune</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>s := &quot;Ўзбек&quot;<br>len(s)                       // 10  (bayt)<br>utf8.RuneCountInString(s)    // 5   (rune)<br>[]rune(s)[0:2]               // &quot;Ўз&quot; (to'g'ri kesish)<br>s[0:3]                       // yaroqsiz UTF-8: yarim belgi!<br><br>for i, r := range s { _ = i; _ = r } // range rune bo'yicha yuradi</pre><p>Normalizatsiya (qidiruv/solishtirish uchun):</p><pre>import &quot;golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm&quot;<br>norm.NFC.String(input) // &quot;e&quot;+urg'u -&gt; bitta &quot;é&quot;</pre><p><b>Backend'da qayerda chiqadi:</b></p><ul><li>DB ustun limiti: PostgreSQL <code>varchar(10)</code> — belgilar, MySQL <code>utf8</code> (eski, 3 bayt) emoji'ni saqlamaydi — <code>utf8mb4</code> kerak.</li><li>Truncate (masalan, SMS 160 belgi) bayt bo'yicha kesilsa — buzilgan belgi.</li><li>O'zbek apostrofi: <code>'</code>, <code>ʻ</code> (U+02BB), <code>‘</code> — har xil kod nuqtalari; qidiruvda normalizatsiya kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>len()</code> ni &quot;belgilar soni&quot; deb ishlatish.</li><li>Bayt indeksi bilan kesish.</li><li>Emoji yoki bayroq bir nechta rune'dan iborat — rune bo'yicha kesish ham uni buzishi mumkin (grafema kutubxonasi kerak).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hamma joyda (DB, API, fayl) UTF-8 va <code>utf8mb4</code>; validatsiyani chegarada qil (<code>utf8.ValidString</code>) va limitlarni hujjatda aniq yoz: bayt yoki belgi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::i5 OS
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-1017	<p>Kubernetes'da servisni deploy qilganda query'lar yo'qolmasligi uchun graceful shutdown qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Graceful shutdown tartibi: SIGTERM keladi -&gt; ilova readiness'ni fail qiladi va yangi so'rov olishni to'xtatadi -&gt; Kubernetes endpoint'lardan podni chiqarishini kutadi (bir necha soniya) -&gt; joriy so'rovlarni deadline bilan tugatadi -&gt; DB/queue ulanishlarini yopadi -&gt; chiqadi. <code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code> bu jarayondan uzun bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kubernetes podni o'chirganda SIGTERM yuborish va endpoint'dan chiqarish <b>parallel</b> bo'ladi. Ilova darhol yopilsa, kube-proxy/Ingress hali bir necha soniya trafik yuboradi -&gt; 502/connection refused.</p><p><b>Vaqt chizig'i:</b></p><pre>t=0   pod Terminating<br>      |-- kubelet: preStop (sleep 5) -&gt; keyin SIGTERM<br>      |-- endpoint controller: podni Service'dan chiqaradi<br>      |   (kube-proxy, ingress yangilanishi 1-5s)<br>t=5   SIGTERM -&gt; ilova: server.Shutdown(ctx) - yangi ulanish yo'q, joriylar tugaydi<br>t=5..25 joriy so'rovlar tugaydi, DB/Kafka yopiladi<br>t=30  grace period tugadi -&gt; SIGKILL (agar hali tirik bo'lsa)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>srv := &amp;http.Server{Addr: &quot;:8080&quot;, Handler: mux}<br>go srv.ListenAndServe()<br><br>ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM, syscall.SIGINT)<br>&lt;-ctx.Done()<br>ready.Store(false)                       // /ready -&gt; 503<br><br>shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)<br>defer cancel()<br>_ = srv.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)            // joriy so'rovlarni kutadi<br>consumer.Close()                         // yangi xabar olmaydi, joriyni ack<br>db.Close()</pre><pre>spec:<br>  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30<br>  containers:<br>  - name: app<br>    lifecycle:<br>      preStop: {exec: {command: [&quot;sleep&quot;, &quot;5&quot;]}}   # yoki K8s 1.30+: sleep action</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova shell orqali ishga tushgan (<code>sh -c</code>) — SIGTERM ilovaga yetmaydi (PID 1 muammosi).</li><li><code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code> shutdown'dan qisqa — SIGKILL so'rovlarni uzadi.</li><li>Kafka consumer offset'ni commit qilmasdan chiqadi — xabar qayta ishlanadi (idempotentlik kerak).</li><li>Uzoq ulanishlar (WebSocket, gRPC stream) — alohida drain va client reconnect.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Deploy paytida xato sonini metrika bilan tekshir — &quot;zero-downtime&quot; ni da'vo qilish emas, o'lchash kerak. PodDisruptionBudget va <code>maxUnavailable</code> bilan birga ishlat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::i5 Ops

Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-5018	<p>SQS standard va FIFO queue farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SQS Standard — amalda cheksiz throughput, at-least-once yetkazish (dublikat bo'lishi mumkin), tartib kafolatlanmaydi. SQS FIFO — <code>MessageGroupId</code> ichida qat'iy tartib va 5 daqiqalik deduplikatsiya, lekin throughput cheklangan (high throughput rejimida ancha yuqori, lekin baribir limitli).</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><p>| | Standard | FIFO | |---|---|---| | Tartib | best-effort | guruh ichida qat'iy | | Yetkazish | at-least-once | exactly-once processing (dedup oynasi ichida) | | Throughput | deyarli cheksiz | 300 msg/s (batch bilan 3000), high-throughput rejimda ko'proq | | Nom | ixtiyoriy | <code>.fifo</code> bilan tugaydi |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (visibility timeout):</b></p><pre>Consumer ReceiveMessage -&gt; xabar 30s &quot;ko'rinmas&quot;<br>   ishlov ok -&gt; DeleteMessage<br>   crash yoki 30s o'tdi -&gt; xabar yana ko'rinadi (qayta yetkaziladi)<br>   maxReceiveCount (masalan 5) dan oshdi -&gt; DLQ</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws sqs create-queue --queue-name orders.fifo \<br>  --attributes FifoQueue=true,ContentBasedDeduplication=true<br>aws sqs send-message --queue-url $Q --message-body '{&quot;id&quot;:42}' \<br>  --message-group-id customer-42 --message-deduplication-id order-42</pre><p>Redrive:</p><pre>{&quot;deadLetterTargetArn&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:sqs:...:orders-dlq&quot;,&quot;maxReceiveCount&quot;:&quot;5&quot;}</pre><p><b>Qachon qaysi:</b></p><ul><li>Ko'pincha: Standard + idempotent consumer (masalan <code>order_id</code> bo'yicha unique constraint) — sodda va tez.</li><li>FIFO: bir obyekt bo'yicha tartib muhim (bitta hisob balansi, holat mashinasi). Guruhni mayda tanla (<code>customer_id</code>) — parallellik saqlansin.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Visibility timeout ishlov vaqtidan qisqa — xabar ikki consumer'da parallel ishlanadi. Uzoq ishlarda <code>ChangeMessageVisibility</code> bilan uzaytir.</li><li>FIFO'da bitta guruh xabari DLQ'ga tushmaguncha guruh bloklanadi.</li><li>FIFO &quot;exactly-once&quot; faqat 5 daqiqalik dedup oynasi ichida — consumer baribir idempotent bo'lsin.</li><li>Short polling — ko'p bo'sh so'rov va pul; <code>WaitTimeSeconds=20</code> (long polling).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tartib kafolati qimmat; ko'pincha biznes darajasida versiya/timestamp bilan tartibsizlikni hal qilish arzonroq. DLQ uchun alert va qayta yuborish (redrive) jarayoni bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::i5 AWS

Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-5020	<p>RDS'da Multi-AZ va read replica farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multi-AZ — boshqa AZ'dagi sinxron standby nusxa, faqat yuqori mavjudlik va avtomatik failover uchun (klassik Multi-AZ instance'da standby'dan o'qib bo'lmaydi). Read replica — asinxron nusxa, o'qish yukini taqsimlash uchun; lag bor, failover avtomatik emas (qo'lda promote).</p><p><b>Farq:</b></p><pre>Multi-AZ:   App -&gt; Primary (AZ-a) ==sinxron==&gt; Standby (AZ-b)<br>            primary o'lsa -&gt; DNS standby'ga (~60-120s)<br><br>Replica:    App(yozish) -&gt; Primary --asinxron--&gt; Replica1, Replica2<br>            App(o'qish) -&gt; Replica (lag: ms...sekundlar)</pre><p>| | Multi-AZ | Read replica | |---|---|---| | Maqsad | mavjudlik (HA) | o'qish masshtabi | | Replikatsiya | sinxron | asinxron | | O'qish mumkinmi | yo'q (instance) | ha | | Failover | avtomatik | qo'lda promote | | Region | bir region | cross-region ham mumkin |</p><p><b>Yangi variantlar:</b> Multi-AZ DB *cluster* (2 o'qiladigan standby, tezroq failover ~35s); Aurora — umumiy storage 3 AZ'da 6 nusxa, replica'lar ham failover target, failover ~30s.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws rds modify-db-instance --db-instance-identifier prod-db --multi-az --apply-immediately<br>aws rds create-db-instance-read-replica --db-instance-identifier prod-db-ro1 \<br>  --source-db-instance-identifier prod-db</pre><p>Lag monitoringi: CloudWatch <code>ReplicaLag</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Replica'ni HA deb hisoblash — avtomatik failover yo'q, asinxron bo'lgani uchun ma'lumot yo'qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Read-your-writes: foydalanuvchi yozib, darhol replica'dan o'qisa eski ma'lumotni ko'radi; yozishdan keyingi o'qishni primary'ga yo'naltir.</li><li>Ilova DNS'ni keshlaydi — failover'dan keyin eski IP'ga ulanib turadi; RDS Proxy yordam beradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatda ikkalasi birga: Multi-AZ — HA, replica — o'qish va hisobotlar. Failover'ni mashq qil (<code>reboot --force-failover</code>) va ilova qayta ulanishini o'lcha.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::i5 AWS

Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30200	<p>Jarayon va oqim (thread) farqi, va nega Go goroutine ikkisidan arzon?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Process — alohida xotira maydoni (yaratish va almashish qimmat). Thread — process xotirasini bo'lishadi, lekin OS kernel tomonidan rejalashtiriladi: katta stack (odatda 1-8 MB virtual), almashish kernel orqali (~1-2 mikrosekund). Goroutine — Go runtime tomonidan user-space'da rejalashtiriladi: 2 KB dan boshlanadigan o'suvchi stack, almashish ~100-200 ns, M:N modeli (ko'p goroutine oz sonli OS thread'da).</p><p><b>M:N (G-M-P) modeli:</b></p><pre>G (goroutine) x 100 000<br>      |<br>P (processor, GOMAXPROCS = CPU soni) - lokal navbatlar<br>      |<br>M (OS thread) x ~CPU soni (+ bloklangan syscall'lar uchun qo'shimcha)</pre><p>Goroutine kanal, mutex yoki tarmoq (netpoller, epoll) kutsa — runtime uni park qiladi va boshqasini ishga tushiradi, kernel switch'siz.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><p>| | Process | OS thread | Goroutine | |---|---|---|---| | Stack | alohida | ~1-8 MB | 2 KB, o'sadi | | Rejalashtiruvchi | kernel | kernel | Go runtime | | Switch narxi | yuqori | ~µs | ~100 ns | | 100 000 dona | yo'q | deyarli yo'q | normal |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>for i := 0; i &lt; 100_000; i++ {<br>    go func() { time.Sleep(time.Minute) }()<br>}<br>fmt.Println(runtime.NumGoroutine()) // ~100001, xotira ~200-400 MB emas, o'nlab MB</pre><pre>GODEBUG=schedtrace=1000 ./app      # scheduler holati<br>curl localhost:6060/debug/pprof/goroutine?debug=1 | head</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bloklovchi syscall yoki cgo chaqiruvi — goroutine thread'ni egallaydi, runtime yangi M ochadi; ko'p bo'lsa thread soni portlaydi.</li><li>&quot;Arzon&quot; — &quot;bepul&quot; emas: cheksiz goroutine (har so'rovga, chegarasiz) xotira va GC bosimi; bounded concurrency (worker pool, semafor) ishlat.</li><li>Goroutine leak — kanal hech qachon yopilmaydi; <code>goleak</code> bilan testla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konteynerda Go 1.25 dan oldin <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> cgroup CPU limitini hisobga olmasdi — <code>automaxprocs</code> kerak edi; Go 1.25 da bu default. CPU throttling'ni shu bilan tekshir.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::i5 OS
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30201	<p>Fayldan o'qishda <code>page cache</code> nimani o'zgartiradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Page cache — kernel diskdan o'qilgan bloklarni bo'sh RAM'da saqlaydi; takroriy o'qish diskka bormaydi (mikrosekundlar o'rniga nanosekund-mikrosekund). Yozuv ham avval page cache'ga tushadi (&quot;dirty&quot;), diskka keyinroq yoki <code>fsync</code> chaqirilganda yoziladi. Shuning uchun <code>free</code> da katta <code>buff/cache</code> — normal holat, xotira &quot;tugagani&quot; emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>read(fd) --&gt; page cache'da bormi?<br>              ha  -&gt; RAM'dan qaytar (tez)<br>              yo'q -&gt; diskdan o'qi -&gt; cache'ga qo'y -&gt; qaytar<br><br>write(fd) --&gt; page cache (dirty) --&gt; qaytdi (tez, lekin hali diskda emas!)<br>               flusher (dirty_expire ~30s) yoki fsync() --&gt; disk</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>free -h<br>#        total  used  free  shared  buff/cache  available<br># Mem:    31Gi  6Gi   1Gi   ...     24Gi        24Gi   &lt;- &quot;available&quot; ga qara<br>grep -E 'Dirty|Writeback' /proc/meminfo<br>vmtouch /var/lib/postgresql/data/base/16384/*   # fayl qancha cache'da<br>echo 3 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches       # faqat test uchun!</pre><p><b>Real ta'sirlar:</b></p><ul><li>PostgreSQL: <code>shared_buffers</code> (~25% RAM) + qolgani page cache orqali — ikki darajali kesh; <code>effective_cache_size</code> buni planner'ga aytadi.</li><li>Kafka page cache'ga to'liq tayanadi — consumer'lar &quot;issiq&quot; ma'lumotni diskka bormay o'qiydi.</li><li>Konteynerda page cache cgroup xotirasiga hisoblanadi: ko'p fayl o'qiydigan pod <code>memory.max</code> ga yaqinlashadi (kernel avval cache'ni bo'shatadi, lekin bosim bo'ladi).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>free</code> dagi kichik &quot;free&quot; ni ko'rib panika — <code>available</code> muhim.</li><li><code>fsync</code> siz &quot;yozdim&quot; deb hisoblash — elektr o'chsa oxirgi soniyalar yo'qoladi. DB'da <code>fsync=off</code> — tez, lekin crash'da ma'lumot buziladi.</li><li><code>drop_caches</code> ni prod'da &quot;tozalash&quot; uchun ishlatish — keyin hamma narsa sekin.</li><li>Benchmark'ni issiq cache bilan o'tkazish — real disk tezligini ko'rsatmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ma'lumot to'plami page cache'ga sig'adimi — performance'ning asosiy savoli. Sig'masa, disk IOPS hal qiluvchi bo'ladi; working set va cache hit'ni o'lcha.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::i5 OS
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30202	<p><code>fork</code> qilinganda xotira qanday nusxalanadi va bu nega muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>fork()</code> da bola jarayon ota xotirasini darhol nusxalamaydi — copy-on-write (CoW): sahifalar ikkala jarayonda umumiy va &quot;faqat o'qish&quot; deb belgilanadi; kimdir sahifaga yozsa, faqat o'sha sahifa (odatda 4 KB) nusxalanadi. Shuning uchun fork tez, lekin yozuv ko'p bo'lsa xotira asta-sekin ikki barobargacha o'sishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>fork() dan keyin:<br>  ota  --&gt; [sahifa A][sahifa B][sahifa C]  &lt;-- bola  (umumiy, read-only)<br>ota B ga yozdi:<br>  ota  --&gt; [A][B'][C]       bola --&gt; [A][B][C]   (faqat B nusxalandi)</pre><p><b>Nega muhim — Redis misoli:</b></p><pre>Redis 10 GB, BGSAVE/AOF rewrite -&gt; fork()<br>bola: snapshot'ni diskka yozadi (bir necha daqiqa)<br>ota: shu vaqt ichida yozuvlarni qabul qiladi -&gt; har o'zgargan sahifa nusxalanadi<br>yozuv ko'p -&gt; +8 GB -&gt; jami ~18 GB -&gt; konteyner limiti 12 GB -&gt; OOMKilled</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>redis-cli INFO persistence | grep -E 'rdb_last_cow_size|aof_last_cow_size'<br>redis-cli INFO stats | grep latest_fork_usec       # fork qancha vaqt oldi<br>sysctl vm.overcommit_memory                         # Redis tavsiyasi: 1<br>cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled     # Redis uchun: never</pre><p><b>Choralar:</b></p><ul><li>Xotira limitida zaxira qoldir (<code>maxmemory</code> ~ limitning 50-70%).</li><li><code>vm.overcommit_memory=1</code> — aks holda katta jarayonda fork &quot;Cannot allocate memory&quot; bilan yiqiladi.</li><li>Transparent Huge Pages o'chiq: aks holda bitta bayt yozuv 2 MB sahifani nusxalaydi va fork latency oshadi.</li><li>Snapshot'ni replica'da qil, primary'da emas.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Katta heap'li jarayonda fork o'zi ham sekin (page table nusxasi) — Redis'da <code>latest_fork_usec</code> yuzlab ms bo'lishi mumkin, shu vaqt so'rovlar to'xtaydi.</li><li>Python/Ruby pre-fork serverlarida reference count yozuvlari CoW'ni buzadi (Python'da <code>gc.freeze()</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Fork asosidagi persistence (Redis RDB, PostgreSQL emas) bilan ishlaganda xotira rejasini &quot;eng yomon holatda 2x&quot; deb tuz va CoW metrikasini kuzat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::i5 OS

Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30268	<p>Terraform'da state fayli nima uchun kritik va qanday boshqariladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> State fayli Terraform kodidagi resurslarni real infratuzilmadagi obyektlar (ID'lar) bilan bog'laydi va atributlarini saqlaydi. U yo'qolsa yoki buzilsa, Terraform nima mavjudligini bilmaydi — resurslarni qayta yaratishga urinadi (dublikat, konflikt) yoki boshqarib bo'lmaydi. State'da sirlar ham bo'lishi mumkin. Shuning uchun: remote backend, locking, versiyalash, shifrlash, cheklangan ruxsat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kod (aws_db_instance.main) &lt;--&gt; state {&quot;id&quot;:&quot;prod-db-1&quot;, &quot;endpoint&quot;:..., &quot;password&quot;:...}<br>                                         |<br>                                  real AWS resurs<br>plan = kod vs state vs real (refresh)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform {<br>  backend &quot;s3&quot; {<br>    bucket       = &quot;acme-tfstate&quot;<br>    key          = &quot;prod/data/terraform.tfstate&quot;<br>    region       = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;<br>    encrypt      = true<br>    kms_key_id   = &quot;alias/tfstate&quot;<br>    use_lockfile = true      # 1.10+; eski usul: dynamodb_table<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Bucket'da versioning yoqiq — buzilgan state'ni oldingi versiyadan tiklash.</p><p>State bilan xavfsiz ishlash:</p><pre>terraform state list<br>terraform state show aws_db_instance.main<br>terraform state mv aws_instance.a module.web.aws_instance.a   # refaktoring<br>terraform import aws_s3_bucket.logs acme-logs                 # mavjud resursni olish</pre><p>Terraform 1.5+ da kod ichida: <code>import {}</code>, <code>moved {}</code>, 1.7+ da <code>removed {}</code> bloklari — review qilinadigan, deklarativ.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>State'ni Git'ga commit qilish — sirlar ochiladi, konfliktlar.</li><li>Qo'lda JSON tahrirlash — buzilish xavfi.</li><li>Hamma narsa bitta state'da — sekin plan, katta blast radius.</li><li>State'ga o'qish huquqi = sirlarni o'qish huquqi; ruxsatni chekla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> State'ni muhit va komponent bo'yicha bo'l (prod/network, prod/data, prod/app), har biriga alohida IAM ruxsat.
