Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30269	<p>IAM'da eng kam huquq (least privilege) amalda qanday ta'minlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Amalda: har workload'ga alohida IAM role (EC2 instance profile, EKS Pod Identity/IRSA, Lambda execution role), statik access key yo'q; policy'larda aniq action va ARN, kerak bo'lsa <code>Condition</code>; ruxsatlar real foydalanishga qarab muntazam qisqartiriladi (IAM Access Analyzer, last accessed); tashkilot darajasida guardrail'lar (SCP, permission boundary).</p><p><b>Bosqichlar:</b></p><pre>1. Identity  -&gt; har servis/odam alohida; odamlar SSO (IAM Identity Center), user kalitlari yo'q<br>2. Policy    -&gt; minimal action + aniq resurs + condition<br>3. Guardrail -&gt; SCP: region cheklash, CloudTrail o'chirishni taqiqlash<br>4. Tekshir   -&gt; Access Analyzer: ishlatilmagan ruxsatlar, tashqi kirish<br>5. Qisqart   -&gt; 90 kun ishlatilmagan action'larni olib tashla</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> Yomon:</p><pre>{&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Allow&quot;,&quot;Action&quot;:&quot;s3:*&quot;,&quot;Resource&quot;:&quot;*&quot;}</pre><p>Yaxshi:</p><pre>{&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Allow&quot;,<br> &quot;Action&quot;:[&quot;s3:GetObject&quot;,&quot;s3:PutObject&quot;],<br> &quot;Resource&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:s3:::acme-invoices/prod/*&quot;,<br> &quot;Condition&quot;:{&quot;StringEquals&quot;:{&quot;aws:SourceVpce&quot;:&quot;vpce-0abc123&quot;}}}</pre><pre>aws accessanalyzer start-policy-generation ...    # CloudTrail'dan policy generatsiya<br>aws iam generate-service-last-accessed-details --arn arn:aws:iam::123:role/orders<br>aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket acme-invoices \<br>  --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>iam:PassRole</code> <code>Resource: &quot;*&quot;</code> bilan — foydalanuvchi o'zidan kuchliroq rolni Lambda/EC2'ga berib, privilege escalation qiladi.</li><li>Wildcard action'lar (<code>ec2:*</code>) &quot;vaqtincha&quot; qo'yilib, abadiy qoladi.</li><li>Bitta umumiy &quot;app-role&quot; hamma servis uchun — bitta buzilish hamma narsani ochadi.</li><li>Least privilege'ni bir marta qilib unutish — ruxsatlar vaqt o'tib kengayadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Least privilege — jarayon, bir martalik ish emas. Policy'larni IaC'da saqla, CI'da lint qil (Access Analyzer <code>validate-policy</code>, checkov) va break-glass kirishni audit bilan alohida tashkil qil.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::i5 AWS
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30457	<p>cgroup v2 memory limiti ilovaga qanday ta'sir qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> cgroup v2 da <code>memory.max</code> — qattiq chegara: unga yetilganda kernel avval xotirani qaytarib olishga (reclaim) urinadi — page cache, keyin swap (bo'lsa); bo'shatolmasa, cgroup ichida OOM killer jarayonni o'ldiradi (K8s'da <code>OOMKilled</code>, exit 137). <code>memory.high</code> — yumshoq chegara: oshganda jarayon throttle qilinadi (sekinlashadi) va agressiv reclaim boshlanadi. Page cache, tmpfs va kernel xotirasi ham hisobga kiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>usage &lt; memory.high   -&gt; normal<br>usage &gt; memory.high   -&gt; reclaim + throttle (latency oshadi)<br>usage = memory.max    -&gt; reclaim; bo'lmasa -&gt; OOM kill</pre><p>K8s'da: <code>resources.limits.memory</code> -&gt; <code>memory.max</code>; MemoryQoS (alpha/beta) yoqilsa <code>memory.high</code> ham qo'yiladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current<br>grep -E 'anon|file |shmem' /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.stat   # anon = heap, file = page cache<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events                       # high, max, oom, oom_kill hisoblagichlari<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.pressure                     # PSI<br>kubectl describe pod x | grep -A3 'Last State'          # Reason: OOMKilled</pre><p><b>Go misoli:</b></p><pre>resources:<br>  limits: {memory: 1Gi}<br>env:<br>  - name: GOMEMLIMIT<br>    value: &quot;900MiB&quot;   # limitdan ~10% kam</pre><p><code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> bilan Go GC heap shu chegaraga yaqinlashganda tez-tez ishlaydi — OOMKill o'rniga GC bosimi (CPU sarfi). Java'da: <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>memory.current</code> ga page cache kiradi — ko'p fayl o'qiydigan pod limitga yaqin ko'rinadi, lekin bu ko'pincha qaytarib olinadigan xotira; <code>working_set</code> (anon + aktiv file) ga qara.</li><li>tmpfs (<code>emptyDir: medium: Memory</code>) xotira limitiga kiradi.</li><li>Limit = request emas: limit katta, request kichik bo'lsa node overcommit -&gt; node darajasida eviction.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xotira uchun <code>requests = limits</code> (Guaranteed QoS) ko'pincha eng bashorat qilinadigan variant. <code>memory.events</code> dagi <code>high</code> hisoblagichi o'sishi — OOM'dan oldingi ogohlantirish signali.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::cloud sec::i5 OS
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30458	<p>Konteynerda <code>PID 1</code> muammosi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Konteynerda ilk jarayon PID 1 bo'ladi, Linux esa PID 1 ga maxsus muomala qiladi: unga signal handler o'rnatilmagan bo'lsa, <code>SIGTERM</code>/<code>SIGINT</code> default harakati (o'lish) qo'llanmaydi — signal e'tiborsiz qoladi. Bundan tashqari PID 1 yetim (orphan) jarayonlarni &quot;asrab oladi&quot; va ularni <code>wait()</code> qilishi kerak, aks holda zombi'lar yig'iladi. Ilova shell orqali ishga tushsa, shell PID 1 bo'ladi va signalni ilovaga uzatmaydi.</p><p><b>Belgilar:</b></p><pre>kubectl delete pod -&gt; pod 30s &quot;Terminating&quot; -&gt; SIGKILL (exit 137)<br>docker stop -&gt; 10s kutadi -&gt; SIGKILL<br>ps aux da &lt;defunct&gt; jarayonlar ko'payadi</pre><p><b>Sabab (shell form):</b></p><pre># YOMON: /bin/sh -c &quot;/app/server&quot; -&gt; sh PID 1, server bola<br>CMD /app/server --port 8080<br><br># YAXSHI: exec form -&gt; server o'zi PID 1<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/app/server&quot;]<br>CMD [&quot;--port&quot;, &quot;8080&quot;]</pre><p>Entrypoint script kerak bo'lsa — oxirida <code>exec</code>:</p><pre>#!/bin/sh<br>set -e<br>envsubst &lt; /tpl &gt; /etc/app.conf<br>exec /app/server &quot;$@&quot;     # sh o'rnini server egallaydi</pre><p><b>Zombi va signal uchun init:</b></p><pre>RUN apk add --no-cache tini<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/sbin/tini&quot;, &quot;--&quot;, &quot;/app/server&quot;]</pre><p>yoki <code>docker run --init</code>; Kubernetes'da <code>shareProcessNamespace: true</code> bo'lsa pause konteyner PID 1 bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Tekshirish:</b></p><pre>docker exec app ps -o pid,comm      # PID 1 kim?<br>docker exec app cat /proc/1/status | grep SigCgt   # qaysi signallar ushlanadi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ilova SIGTERM'ni ushlaydi, lekin graceful shutdown yozilmagan — baribir darhol uziladi.</li><li>Bola jarayonlar (<code>exec.Command</code>) ishga tushiradigan ilovada zombi'lar — init kerak.</li><li><code>STOPSIGNAL</code> ilova kutganidan farqli (nginx <code>SIGQUIT</code> bilan graceful).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Go'da <code>signal.NotifyContext</code> bilan SIGTERM'ni ushlash va exec form — minimal standart. Base image shablonida buni bir marta to'g'ri qil, har jamoa qayta kashf qilmasin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::i5 Ops
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30535	<p>Infrastructure as Code (IaC) nima beradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Infrastructure as Code — serverlar, tarmoq, DB, DNS kabi infratuzilmani qo'lda konsolda bosish o'rniga kod (fayl) bilan tasvirlash. Natija: infratuzilma Git'da versiyalanadi, o'zgarishlar PR orqali review qilinadi, istalgan muhit bir xil tarzda qayta yaratiladi va kim nima o'zgartirgani tarixda ko'rinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo (IaC'siz):</b> Prod serverni 2 yil oldin kimdir qo'lda sozlagan. U ketdi. Server yiqildi — hech kim uni qanday qayta qurishni bilmaydi (&quot;snowflake server&quot;). Staging prod'dan farq qiladi — &quot;staging'da ishlardi&quot;.</p><p><b>IaC nima beradi:</b></p><p>| Foyda | Qanday | |---|---| | Takrorlanuvchanlik | bir xil kod -&gt; bir xil dev/stage/prod | | Review | o'zgarish PR'da, <code>plan</code> natijasi bilan | | Tarix va audit | <code>git log</code> kim, qachon, nega | | Tez tiklash | falokatda kodni qayta apply | | Hujjat | kodning o'zi — eng yangi hujjat |</p><p><b>Ikki yondashuv:</b></p><ul><li>Deklarativ — &quot;qanday holat bo'lishi kerak&quot; (Terraform/OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Kubernetes YAML). Tool farqni o'zi hisoblaydi.</li><li>Imperativ — &quot;qanday qadamlar bajarilsin&quot; (bash, ba'zan Ansible, Pulumi'da dasturlash tili bilan, lekin natija deklarativ).</li></ul><p><b>Amalda (Terraform):</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;logs&quot; {<br>  bucket = &quot;acme-app-logs&quot;<br>  tags   = { team = &quot;platform&quot;, env = &quot;prod&quot; }<br>}</pre><pre>terraform init<br>terraform plan     # nima o'zgaradi?<br>terraform apply    # bajar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kod bor, lekin baribir konsolda qo'lda o'zgartirish — drift, kod yolg'on gapiradi.</li><li>Sirlarni (parol) kodga yozish.</li><li>State faylini lokal saqlash — jamoa ishlay olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> IaC'ning haqiqiy qiymati — jarayon: hamma o'zgarish PR + CI orqali, konsolga yozish huquqi cheklangan. Kod yozish oson qismi; intizom asosiy qismi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::i5 IaC
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30536	<p><code>terraform plan</code> va <code>terraform apply</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terraform plan</code> — kod, state va real infratuzilmani solishtirib, nima yaratilishi, o'zgarishi yoki o'chirilishini ko'rsatadi; hech narsani o'zgartirmaydi. <code>terraform apply</code> — shu o'zgarishlarni haqiqatan bajaradi. Plan — &quot;nima bo'ladi&quot;, apply — &quot;qil&quot;.</p><p><b>Plan chiqishini o'qish:</b></p><pre>  + create<br>  ~ update in-place<br>  - destroy<br>-/+ destroy and then create replacement   &lt;- XAVFLI (DB, disk!)<br><br>  # aws_db_instance.main must be replaced<br>-/+ resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>      ~ engine_version = &quot;15.4&quot; -&gt; &quot;16.2&quot;<br>      ~ identifier     = &quot;prod-db&quot; -&gt; &quot;prod-db-v2&quot;  # forces replacement<br>    }<br>Plan: 1 to add, 2 to change, 1 to destroy.</pre><p><code># forces replacement</code> — qaysi atribut almashtirishga sabab bo'layotganini aytadi.</p><p><b>Amalda (CI'da xavfsiz oqim):</b></p><pre># PR bosqichi<br>terraform plan -out=tfplan -input=false<br>terraform show -no-color tfplan &gt; plan.txt      # PR comment'ga<br><br># merge'dan keyin - AYNAN o'sha plan<br>terraform apply -input=false tfplan</pre><p>Saqlangan plan bilan apply — review qilingan narsa bajariladi; orada kimdir boshqa o'zgarish qilsa, plan &quot;stale&quot; bo'lib rad etiladi.</p><p><b>Himoya:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>  lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }<br>  deletion_protection = true<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>apply -auto-approve</code> ni plan'siz, lokaldan — review'siz prod o'zgarishi.</li><li><code>-/+</code> ni e'tiborsiz qoldirish — DB yoki disk o'chib, ma'lumot yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>plan</code> &quot;No changes&quot; — lekin <code>-refresh=false</code> bilan ishlatilgan bo'lsa drift ko'rinmaydi.</li><li>Plan va apply orasida ko'p vaqt — boshqa o'zgarishlar bilan to'qnashuv.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Plan'ni avtomatik tahlil qil: <code>terraform show -json tfplan</code> + OPA/Conftest bilan &quot;delete yoki replace bo'lsa — qo'shimcha approval&quot; qoidasi. Odamlar uzun plan'ni o'qishda xato qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::i5 IaC
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30537	<p>Ikki muhandis bir vaqtda <code>terraform apply</code> qilsa nima bo'ladi va qanday oldini olasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Locking bo'lmasa, ikki apply bir vaqtda bitta state'ni o'qib, har biri o'z versiyasini yozadi — biri ikkinchisining o'zgarishlarini yo'qotadi (state buziladi), resurslar ikki marta yaratilishi yoki &quot;yetim&quot; qolishi mumkin. Oldini olish: remote backend + state locking (ikkinchi apply lock'ni kutadi yoki xato beradi) va apply'ni faqat CI orqali, bitta navbatda bajarish.</p><p><b>Nima bo'ladi:</b></p><pre>Ali:    state v5 o'qidi -&gt; + aws_instance.a yaratdi -&gt; state v6a yozdi<br>Vali:   state v5 o'qidi -&gt; + aws_instance.b yaratdi -&gt; state v6b yozdi (v6a ustidan)<br>Natija: aws_instance.a AWS'da bor, state'da yo'q -&gt; keyingi plan uni yana yaratadi</pre><p><b>Locking qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>apply boshlandi -&gt; lock oldi (S3 .tflock fayl yoki DynamoDB yozuv)<br>ikkinchi apply  -&gt; &quot;Error acquiring the state lock ... Lock Info: ID, Who, Created&quot;<br>birinchisi tugadi -&gt; lock bo'shadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>terraform {<br>  backend &quot;s3&quot; {<br>    bucket       = &quot;acme-tfstate&quot;<br>    key          = &quot;prod/app/terraform.tfstate&quot;<br>    region       = &quot;eu-central-1&quot;<br>    use_lockfile = true    # Terraform 1.10+ S3 native lock<br>    # eski: dynamodb_table = &quot;tf-locks&quot;  (deprecated yo'nalishda)<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Lock kutish: <code>terraform apply -lock-timeout=5m</code>. Osilib qolgan lock (jarayon o'ldirilgan):</p><pre>terraform force-unlock &lt;LOCK_ID&gt;   # faqat apply aniq tugaganiga ishonch bo'lsa!</pre><p><b>Jarayon darajasida:</b></p><ul><li>Apply faqat CI pipeline'dan (Atlantis, Terraform Cloud/HCP, Spacelift, GitHub Actions <code>concurrency</code> group).</li><li>Odamlarda prod state'ga yozish huquqi yo'q.</li><li>State'ni komponentlarga bo'lish — bir jamoa network'ni, boshqasi app'ni bir vaqtda o'zgartira oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>force-unlock</code> ni boshqa apply ishlayotganda qilish — aynan oldini olmoqchi bo'lgan buzilish.</li><li><code>-lock=false</code> — hech qachon prod'da.</li><li>Lokal backend jamoada — lock faqat bitta kompyuterda.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Lock — texnik himoya; asosiy himoya — yagona yo'l (CI). Har apply'ni kim, qaysi commit'dan qilganini audit qil.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::i5 IaC
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30538	<p>Drift nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Drift — real infratuzilma Terraform kodi/state'dan farq qilib qolishi: kimdir konsolda security group qoidasini qo'shdi, auto-scaling o'zgartirdi, boshqa tool resursni yangiladi. Keyingi <code>plan</code> bu farqni ko'rsatadi va <code>apply</code> qo'lda qilingan o'zgarishni qaytarib yuboradi — ko'pincha kutilmaganda.</p><p><b>Qanday paydo bo'ladi:</b></p><pre>kod:  instance_type = &quot;t3.medium&quot;<br>incident paytida konsolda: t3.medium -&gt; t3.xlarge (tez fix)<br>2 hafta keyin boshqa PR apply qilindi -&gt; t3.xlarge -&gt; t3.medium<br>-&gt; yana incident</pre><p><b>Aniqlash:</b></p><pre>terraform plan -refresh-only           # faqat real holatni ko'rsatadi, o'zgartirmaydi<br>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode<br># exit 0 = farq yo'q, 1 = xato, 2 = farq bor -&gt; alert</pre><p>Rejali tekshiruv (har kecha CI'da):</p><pre>- run: terraform plan -detailed-exitcode -lock=false<br>  continue-on-error: true<br>  id: drift<br>- if: steps.drift.outcome == 'failure'<br>  run: ./notify-slack.sh &quot;Drift: prod/app&quot;</pre><p>Boshqa vositalar: HCP Terraform drift detection, Spacelift, driftctl (endi rivojlanmayapti), AWS Config.</p><p><b>Drift topilganda:</b></p><ol><li>Qo'lda o'zgarish to'g'rimi? -&gt; kodga ko'chir (PR), keyin plan toza.</li><li>Noto'g'rimi? -&gt; <code>apply</code> bilan koddagi holatga qaytar.</li><li>Resurs umuman koddan tashqarida yaratilganmi? -&gt; <code>import {}</code> bloki bilan kodga ol.</li><li>Atribut tashqi tizim tomonidan boshqariladimi (ASG <code>desired_capacity</code>)? -&gt; <code>lifecycle { ignore_changes = [...] }</code>.</li></ol><p><b>Oldini olish:</b> prod konsolda faqat o'qish huquqi; favqulodda yozish — break-glass rol, audit va keyin majburiy PR.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>ignore_changes</code> ni hamma narsaga qo'yib driftni &quot;yashirish&quot;.</li><li>Drift'ni ko'rmasdan apply — incident fix'i bekor bo'ladi.</li><li>Faqat Terraform boshqargan resurslar tekshiriladi — umuman koddan tashqaridagi resurslar (ClickOps) ko'rinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Drift — jarayon muammosining simptomi. Uning soni va manbasini kuzat; tez-tez qaytarilsa, ehtimol jamoalarga tez o'zgarish uchun qulay yo'l yetishmayapti.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::i5 IaC
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30539	<p>Terraform va Ansible farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Terraform — infratuzilmani yaratish va boshqarish (provisioning): VPC, VM, DB, DNS, IAM; deklarativ, state bilan farqni hisoblaydi. Ansible — mavjud serverlar ichini sozlash (configuration management): paket o'rnatish, fayl, servis; agentsiz SSH orqali, playbook'lar ketma-ket bajariladi, state fayli yo'q.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b></p><p>| | Terraform | Ansible | |---|---|---| | Asosiy ish | resurs yaratish (cloud API) | OS ichini sozlash | | Uslub | deklarativ | protsedural (task ketma-ketligi), modullar idempotent | | State | bor (state fayli) | yo'q (har safar tekshiradi) | | Ulanish | provider API | SSH / WinRM, agentsiz | | O'chirish | resurs koddan olinsa — o'chiradi | o'zi o'chirmaydi (<code>state: absent</code> yozish kerak) |</p><p><b>Odatiy birga ishlash:</b></p><pre>Terraform: VPC + 3 ta VM + LB yaratadi -&gt; IP'larni output<br>     |<br>     v<br>Ansible:  inventory (dinamik, aws_ec2 plugin) -&gt; nginx, agent, config o'rnatadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_instance&quot; &quot;web&quot; {<br>  count         = 3<br>  ami           = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id<br>  instance_type = &quot;t3.small&quot;<br>  tags          = { role = &quot;web&quot; }<br>}</pre><pre>- hosts: tag_role_web<br>  become: true<br>  tasks:<br>    - apt: {name: nginx, state: present, update_cache: true}<br>    - template: {src: nginx.conf.j2, dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf}<br>      notify: reload nginx<br>  handlers:<br>    - name: reload nginx<br>      service: {name: nginx, state: reloaded}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ansible bilan cloud resurs yaratish — state yo'q, o'chirish va drift qiyin.</li><li>Terraform <code>remote-exec</code>/<code>user_data</code> bilan murakkab konfiguratsiya — debug qiyin, idempotent emas.</li><li><code>shell</code>/<code>command</code> modullari bilan Ansible yozish — idempotentlik yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Immutable infratuzilma davrida (Packer image, konteyner, Kubernetes) Ansible'ning roli kamaydi: server ichi image build vaqtida sozlanadi, keyin o'zgartirilmaydi. Ansible hali ham bare-metal, tarmoq qurilmalari va eski VM parklari uchun kuchli.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::i5 IaC
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-30540	<p>Katta kompaniyada Terraform kodini qanday tashkil qilasan (modullar, muhitlar, state)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kichik, mustaqil state'lar va hamma o'zgarish PR orqali. Versiyalangan modullar alohida; har muhit alohida akkaunt va alohida state; state'lar komponentlar bo'yicha bo'lingan (network, data, app); remote backend + lock + shifrlash; CI'da lint/security/plan, merge'dan keyin apply, prod uchun approval; provider va modul versiyalari pin; drift tekshiruvi; sirlar tashqi tizimda.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>terraform-modules/        (alohida repo, semver tag'lar)<br>  vpc/  eks/  rds/  s3-bucket/<br>infra-live/<br>  accounts/<br>    dev/   network/ data/ app/<br>    stage/ network/ data/ app/<br>    prod/  network/ data/ app/<br>  global/  iam/ dns/</pre><p>Har papka — alohida state; komponentlar bir-biriga <code>terraform_remote_state</code> yoki (yaxshiroq) SSM parameter/data source orqali bog'lanadi.</p><p><b>Modul chaqirish:</b></p><pre>module &quot;vpc&quot; {<br>  source  = &quot;git::https://github.com/acme/terraform-modules.git//vpc?ref=v2.3.1&quot;<br>  cidr    = &quot;10.20.0.0/16&quot;<br>  azs     = 3<br>}</pre><p><b>CI pipeline:</b></p><pre>PR:    terraform fmt -check -&gt; validate -&gt; tflint -&gt; trivy config / checkov<br>       -&gt; plan (har o'zgargan papka) -&gt; PR comment (+ Infracost)<br>merge: apply saqlangan plan; prod -&gt; manual approval<br>cron:  drift detection -&gt; alert</pre><p>Vositalar: Atlantis, HCP Terraform, Spacelift, env0; ko'p muhitni DRY qilish uchun Terragrunt yoki Terraform Stacks.</p><p><b>Muhim qoidalar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code> commit qilinadi — provider versiyalari barqaror.</li><li><code>required_version</code> va <code>required_providers</code> aniq.</li><li>Sirlar Vault/Secrets Manager'da; state'ga tushmasligi uchun ephemeral resurslar (1.10+).</li><li>Modul o'zgarishi alohida release, muhitlar navbat bilan yangilanadi (dev -&gt; stage -&gt; prod).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Monolit state — plan 15 daqiqa, har kichik o'zgarish butun prod'ni xavf ostiga qo'yadi.</li><li><code>workspace</code> ni muhitlar uchun ishlatish — bir xil backend/ruxsat, prod va dev aralashadi.</li><li>Modulga <code>ref=main</code> — kimdir modulni o'zgartirsa, hamma joyda kutilmagan plan.</li><li>Juda mayda state'lar — bog'liqliklar labirinti.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> State chegarasi = blast radius va egalik chegarasi. Uni jamoalar va o'zgarish chastotasiga qarab chiz (network kam o'zgaradi, app tez-tez). OpenTofu (MPL litsenziya) — Terraform BSL'ga o'tgandan keyin muqobil; tanlovni litsenziya siyosatiga qarab qil.</p>	lvl::Staff dom::cloud sec::i5 IaC
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-34048	<p>IaaS, PaaS, SaaS farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bu cloud xizmat modellari — kim nimani boshqarishi bo'yicha farqlanadi. IaaS — provider &quot;temir&quot; va virtualizatsiyani beradi, OS va undan yuqorisi seniki (EC2). PaaS — provider OS va runtime'ni ham boshqaradi, sen faqat kod va ma'lumot berasan (Heroku, App Engine). SaaS — tayyor dastur, sen faqat foydalanasan (Gmail, Jira).</p><p><b>Pitsa o'xshatishi:</b></p><pre>On-prem : uyda o'zing pishirasan (hammasi seniki)<br>IaaS    : oshxona ijarada, masalliq va pishirish seniki<br>PaaS    : tayyor pitsa yetkaziladi, stol va ichimlik seniki<br>SaaS    : restoranda yeysan</pre><p><b>Kim nimani boshqaradi:</b></p><p>| Qatlam | On-prem | IaaS | PaaS | SaaS | |---|---|---|---|---| | Ilova | sen | sen | sen | provider | | Ma'lumot | sen | sen | sen | provider (ma'lumot egasi - sen) | | Runtime | sen | sen | provider | provider | | OS | sen | sen | provider | provider | | Virtualizatsiya, server, tarmoq | sen | provider | provider | provider |</p><p><b>Misollar:</b></p><ul><li>IaaS: AWS EC2, Azure VM, Google Compute Engine, DigitalOcean Droplet.</li><li>PaaS: Heroku, Google App Engine, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Azure App Service, Cloud Run (CaaS/serverless).</li><li>SaaS: Gmail, Slack, Jira, Salesforce, GitHub.</li></ul><p><b>Qanday tanlanadi:</b></p><ul><li>To'liq nazorat kerak (maxsus OS sozlamasi, eski dastur) -&gt; IaaS.</li><li>Tez ishga tushirish, kichik jamoa -&gt; PaaS / serverless.</li><li>Biznes funksiya (email, CRM), o'zingiz yozishga arzimaydi -&gt; SaaS.</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>IaaS'da OS patch, backup, xavfsizlik — seniki; ko'pchilik buni unutadi.</li><li>PaaS'da vendor lock-in va cheklovlar (runtime versiyasi, fayl tizimi).</li><li>SaaS'da ham ma'lumot va kirish huquqlari (kim admin) — sening javobgarliging.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yuqoriga chiqqan sari nazorat kamayadi, lekin operatsion yuk ham kamayadi. Default — eng yuqori darajadagi yetarli model; pastga faqat aniq sabab bilan tush.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::i5 Cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-34049	<p>Region va Availability Zone farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Region — geografik hudud (masalan, <code>eu-central-1</code> Frankfurt), bir-biridan uzoq va mustaqil. Availability Zone (AZ) — region ichidagi bir yoki bir nechta alohida data-center: o'z elektr, sovutish va tarmog'iga ega, lekin boshqa AZ'lar bilan past latency (~1-2 ms) bog'langan. AZ — alohida avariya chegarasi.</p><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>Region eu-central-1 (Frankfurt)<br>  +-- AZ eu-central-1a  [DC] [DC]<br>  +-- AZ eu-central-1b  [DC]<br>  +-- AZ eu-central-1c  [DC] [DC]<br>       (AZ'lar orasi ~1-2 ms, o'nlab km masofa)<br><br>Region us-east-1 (Virginia)  &lt;-- ~90 ms uzoqlikda, to'liq mustaqil</pre><p><b>Qachon nima uchun:</b></p><p>| Maqsad | Yechim | |---|---| | Bitta DC yong'in/elektr nosozligiga chidash (HA) | 2-3 AZ ga tarqatish | | Butun region nosozligi (DR) | boshqa regionda nusxa/backup | | Foydalanuvchiga yaqinlik | foydalanuvchilarga yaqin region | | Qonun (data residency, GDPR) | ma'lumot faqat ruxsat etilgan regionda |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 describe-availability-zones --region eu-central-1 \<br>  --query 'AvailabilityZones[].ZoneName'<br>kubectl get nodes -L topology.kubernetes.io/zone</pre><p>Odatiy HA: Auto Scaling Group 3 AZ'da subnet'lar bilan, RDS Multi-AZ, LB cross-zone.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma narsa bitta AZ'da (default subnet) — DC nosozligi = to'liq outage.</li><li>AZ'lar orasidagi trafik pullik (~$0.01/GB har yo'nalishda) — chatty servislar qimmatga tushadi.</li><li><code>eu-central-1a</code> nomi har AWS akkauntda boshqa fizik AZ bo'lishi mumkin — akkauntlararo solishtirish uchun AZ ID (<code>euc1-az2</code>) ishlat.</li><li>Ba'zi xizmatlar (EBS disk) AZ'ga bog'liq — boshqa AZ'dagi instansga ulanmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Multi-AZ — deyarli har prod uchun default; multi-region — qimmat va murakkab, faqat RTO/RPO yoki qonun talab qilsa.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::i5 Cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-34050	<p>Cloud'da shared responsibility model nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shared responsibility model — xavfsizlik javobgarligi provider va mijoz o'rtasida bo'linadi. Provider — &quot;security OF the cloud&quot;: fizik data-center, hardware, hypervisor, global tarmoq. Mijoz — &quot;security IN the cloud&quot;: IAM (kimga qanday ruxsat), ma'lumot shifrlash, tarmoq qoidalari (security group), OS yangilanishi (IaaS'da), ilova va konfiguratsiya.</p><p><b>Kim nimaga javobgar:</b></p><pre>            IaaS (EC2)      PaaS (RDS)      SaaS / serverless<br>Ma'lumot    MIJOZ           MIJOZ           MIJOZ<br>IAM/kirish  MIJOZ           MIJOZ           MIJOZ<br>Ilova       MIJOZ           MIJOZ           provider<br>OS patch    MIJOZ           provider        provider<br>Tarmoq SG   MIJOZ           MIJOZ           qisman<br>Hardware/DC provider        provider        provider</pre><p>Qoida: xizmat qanchalik managed bo'lsa, mijoz ulushi shuncha kam — lekin ma'lumot va kirish huquqlari <b>har doim</b> mijozda.</p><p><b>Real misollar (mijoz aybi):</b></p><ul><li>S3 bucket public qoldirilgan — millionlab yozuv sizgan.</li><li>Security group'da <code>0.0.0.0/0</code> ga 22 yoki 5432 port ochiq.</li><li>Access key GitHub'ga commit qilingan — bir soatda kripto-mayning.</li><li>EC2'da 2 yil OS yangilanmagan.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda (asosiy tekshiruvlar):</b></p><pre>aws s3control get-public-access-block --account-id 123456789012<br>aws ec2 describe-security-groups \<br>  --filters Name=ip-permission.cidr,Values=0.0.0.0/0 --query 'SecurityGroups[].GroupId'<br>aws iam get-account-summary | grep -i mfa</pre><p>Vositalar: AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config qoidalari, Prowler.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Cloud'da — demak xavfsiz&quot; degan taxmin.</li><li>Managed DB ham parolsiz/public endpoint bilan ochiq qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Backup — ko'pincha mijoz javobgarligi (provider durability beradi, lekin sen o'chirsang — o'chadi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Mijoz qismini avtomatik guardrail'lar bilan ta'minla (SCP, Block Public Access account darajasida, policy-as-code) — odamlarning ehtiyotkorligiga tayanma.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::i5 Cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-34051	<p>Scale up (vertical) va scale out (horizontal) farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Scale up (vertical) — mavjud mashinani kuchaytirish: ko'proq CPU/RAM. Scale out (horizontal) — bir xil mashinalar sonini ko'paytirish va yukni load balancer bilan taqsimlash. Vertical oddiy, lekin chegarasi va downtime'i bor; horizontal amalda cheksiz, lekin ilova stateless bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Oddiy misol:</b></p><pre>Vertical:   [4 CPU, 8 GB]  --&gt;  [16 CPU, 64 GB]   (bitta katta)<br><br>Horizontal:         +--&gt; [4 CPU]<br>            LB -----+--&gt; [4 CPU]                  (ko'p kichik)<br>                    +--&gt; [4 CPU]</pre><p>| | Vertical (up) | Horizontal (out) | |---|---|---| | Usul | CPU/RAM qo'shish | instance qo'shish | | Chegara | eng katta mashina turi | amalda cheksiz | | Downtime | ko'pincha restart kerak | yo'q (qo'shib boriladi) | | Talab | yo'q | stateless ilova, LB | | HA | bitta nuqta (SPOF) | biri o'lsa qolganlari ishlaydi | | Qayerda yaxshi | DB, eski monolit | web/API servislar |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Kubernetes - horizontal<br>kubectl scale deploy/api --replicas=6<br>kubectl autoscale deploy/api --cpu-percent=70 --min=3 --max=20<br># AWS - vertical (instance to'xtatiladi!)<br>aws ec2 modify-instance-attribute --instance-id i-0abc --instance-type m6i.2xlarge</pre><p><b>Horizontal uchun ilova talablari:</b></p><ul><li>Sessiya serverda emas — Redis yoki JWT'da.</li><li>Fayllar lokal diskda emas — S3'da.</li><li>Cron/job'lar bir necha nusxada ikki marta ishlamasin (leader election, lock).</li></ul><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>DB'ni horizontal masshtablash qiyin (sharding) — ko'pincha avval vertical + read replica.</li><li>Stateful ilovani nusxalash — sessiyalar yo'qoladi, foydalanuvchi &quot;logout&quot; bo'ladi.</li><li>Autoscaling juda sekin (yangi VM 3-5 daqiqa) — tez yuk sakrashiga ulgurmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud'da odatiy: stateless qatlam — horizontal (Auto Scaling Group / HPA), stateful (DB) — avval vertical, keyin replika, oxirgi chora sharding.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::i5 Cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::I5 Cloud, OS, operations	idrill-34052	<p>Cloud xarajatini nazorat qilishning oddiy usullari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Oddiy, lekin samarali usullar: budjet va alert qo'yish (oy oxirida syurpriz bo'lmasin), hamma resursga tag (<code>team</code>, <code>env</code>) berish, ishlatilmayotgan resurslarni tozalash, haddan katta mashinalarni kichraytirish (rightsizing), dev muhitni tunda o'chirish, doimiy yuk uchun Savings Plans/Reserved, uzilishga chidamli yuk uchun Spot.</p><p><b>Qayerdan pul ketadi (odatiy):</b></p><pre>Ishlatilmayotgan:  ulanmagan EBS disklar, eski snapshot'lar, bo'sh Elastic IP,<br>                   unutilgan LB/NAT Gateway, to'xtatilgan, lekin disk'li VM<br>Katta o'lcham:     5% CPU ishlatayotgan m5.4xlarge<br>Har doim yoniq:    dev/test kechasi va dam olishda<br>Trafik:            NAT Gateway, cross-AZ, internetga chiqish<br>Saqlash:           S3'da eski log'lar Standard class'da</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># budjet<br>aws budgets create-budget --account-id 123 --budget file://budget.json \<br>  --notifications-with-subscribers file://notify.json<br># ulanmagan disklar<br>aws ec2 describe-volumes --filters Name=status,Values=available \<br>  --query 'Volumes[].[VolumeId,Size,CreateTime]' --output table<br># bog'lanmagan Elastic IP<br>aws ec2 describe-addresses --query 'Addresses[?AssociationId==null].PublicIp'</pre><p>S3 lifecycle: 30 kundan keyin <code>STANDARD_IA</code>, 90 kundan keyin <code>GLACIER</code>, 365 kunda o'chirish. Vositalar: AWS Cost Explorer, Compute Optimizer (rightsizing tavsiyalari), Trusted Advisor; K8s uchun Kubecost/OpenCost.</p><p><b>Xarid modellari:</b></p><p>| Yuk turi | Model | Tejash | |---|---|---| | Doimiy 24/7 | Savings Plans / Reserved | ~30-70% | | Uzilishga chidamli (batch, CI) | Spot | ~60-90% | | Notekis | On-demand + autoscaling | — |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tag'siz resurslar — kim egasi, o'chirsa bo'ladimi — noma'lum. Tag'ni IaC va SCP/policy bilan majburla.</li><li>3 yillik Reserved'ni tez o'zgaradigan arxitektura uchun olish.</li><li>Spot'da stateful yoki uzoq ish — 2 daqiqalik ogohlantirish bilan o'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xarajat — muhandislik metrikasi: har jamoa o'z xarajatini ko'rsin (showback), PR'da Infracost bilan oldindan baholansin. Eng katta tejash odatda arxitekturada (trafik, saqlash klassi), chegirmalarda emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::i5 Cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33204	<p>Region, Availability Zone va edge location farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Region</b> — mustaqil geografik hudud (masalan, <code>eu-central-1</code> Frankfurt), ma'lumot qayerda yotishini belgilaydi. <b>Availability Zone</b> — region ichidagi alohida elektr, sovutish va tarmoqqa ega bir yoki bir nechta data center; AZ'lar past latency bilan bog'langan. <b>Edge location</b> — foydalanuvchiga yaqin nuqta: CloudFront CDN keshi va Route 53 DNS.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Region eu-central-1<br>  +-- AZ a (DC1, DC2)  &lt;-- ~1-2 ms --&gt;  AZ b  &lt;--&gt;  AZ c<br>Edge: Toshkent/Istanbul/... (CloudFront kesh, Route 53)</pre><p><b>Qaror mezonlari:</b> | Daraja | Nimadan himoya | Narx/murakkablik | |---|---|---| | Single-AZ | hech narsadan | arzon | | Multi-AZ | bitta DC yiqilishi (odatiy hodisa) | o'rtacha, standart prod | | Multi-region | region darajasidagi falokat | qimmat, murakkab |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 describe-availability-zones --region eu-central-1 \<br>  --query 'AvailabilityZones[].[ZoneName,ZoneId]' --output table</pre><p>Prod minimal: ALB + kamida 2 AZ'da instance/pod + RDS Multi-AZ.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>AZ nomi (<code>eu-central-1a</code>) har akkauntda boshqa jismoniy AZ'ga mos kelishi mumkin — akkauntlar aro moslash uchun <code>ZoneId</code> (<code>euc1-az2</code>) ishlating.</li><li>AZ'lar orasidagi trafik pullik (~$0.01/GB har yo'nalish) — chatty servislar uchun sezilarli.</li><li>Region tanlashda faqat narxga qarash — qonun (ma'lumot rezidentligi) va foydalanuvchiga latency muhimroq.</li><li>Hamma servis hamma region'da yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Multi-region'ni faqat aniq RTO/RPO talabi bo'lsa qiling — u ma'lumot replikatsiyasi, konsistentlik va ikki baravar operatsion yuk demak. Ko'p tizim uchun yaxshi qurilgan multi-AZ yetarli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33205	<p>EC2 nima va instance type'lar qanday tanlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> EC2 — AWS'dagi virtual server. Instance type oilasi (CPU/xotira nisbati), hajmi va avlodi yuk profiliga qarab tanlanadi; keyin narx modeli (On-Demand, Savings Plans, Spot) ishlatish xarakteriga qarab. Tanlov o'lchovga asoslanishi kerak, taxminga emas.</p><p><b>Nom o'qish:</b></p><pre>m7g.xlarge<br>| ||  +-- hajm (4 vCPU, 16 GiB)<br>| |+----- g = Graviton (ARM); i = Intel, a = AMD<br>| +------ avlod (7)<br>+-------- oila (m = umumiy)</pre><p>| Oila | Nisbat | Qachon | |---|---|---| | t3/t4g | burstable | kichik, notekis yuk (CPU credit) | | m7i/m7g | 1:4 | umumiy servislar | | c7i/c7g | 1:2 | CPU-bound (API, encoding) | | r7i/r7g | 1:8 | xotira (cache, DB) | | g/p | GPU | ML, render |</p><p><b>Narx modellari:</b> | Model | Tejash | Qachon | |---|---|---| | On-Demand | - | noaniq, qisqa yuk | | Savings Plans / RI | ~40-70% | 1-3 yillik barqaror baza | | Spot | 90% gacha | stateless, batch; 2 daqiqa ogohlantirish bilan olib qo'yiladi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-0abc... --instance-type t4g.small \<br>  --subnet-id subnet-123 --iam-instance-profile Name=app --user-data file://init.sh<br>aws ec2 describe-instance-types --instance-types m7g.large \<br>  --query 'InstanceTypes[].[VCpuInfo.DefaultVCpus,MemoryInfo.SizeInMiB]'</pre><p>Tushunchalar: <b>AMI</b> — image, <b>user data</b> — birinchi boot skripti, <b>EBS</b> — disk, <b>instance profile</b> — IAM role.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>t</code> instance'da CPU credit tugasa keskin sekinlashadi — doimiy yuk uchun <code>m</code>/<code>c</code>.</li><li>Graviton (ARM) uchun image <code>arm64</code> bo'lishi kerak.</li><li>&quot;Har ehtimolga qarshi&quot; katta instance — CloudWatch/Compute Optimizer bilan rightsizing qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval o'lchang (CPU, xotira, tarmoq), keyin oila tanlang; Graviton odatda ~20% arzon va tez. Bazaviy yukni Savings Plans bilan, cho'qqilarni On-Demand/Spot bilan qoplang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33206	<p>S3 nima, qanday asosiy xususiyatlari bor?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> S3 — cheksiz hajmli obyekt saqlash: fayllar (obyektlar) bucket'larda kalit bo'yicha HTTP API orqali saqlanadi. Juda yuqori chidamlilik (11 ta to'qqiz), strong read-after-write consistency, versioning, lifecycle, shifrlash va storage class'lar orqali narx nazorati.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>s3://acme-backups/2026/10/db.tar.gz<br>     |bucket      | kalit (prefiks + nom) -- papka yo'q, faqat &quot;/&quot; li kalit<br>PUT -&gt; region ichida bir nechta AZ'ga nusxa -&gt; 200 OK</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws s3 cp backup.tar.gz s3://acme-backups/2026/10/<br>aws s3 sync ./site s3://acme-site --delete<br>aws s3 presign s3://acme-files/video.mp4 --expires-in 3600   # vaqtinchalik havola<br>aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket acme-backups \<br>  --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled</pre><p>Lifecycle:</p><pre>{ &quot;Rules&quot;: [{ &quot;ID&quot;: &quot;archive&quot;, &quot;Status&quot;: &quot;Enabled&quot;, &quot;Filter&quot;: { &quot;Prefix&quot;: &quot;logs/&quot; },<br>  &quot;Transitions&quot;: [{ &quot;Days&quot;: 30, &quot;StorageClass&quot;: &quot;STANDARD_IA&quot; },<br>                  { &quot;Days&quot;: 90, &quot;StorageClass&quot;: &quot;GLACIER&quot; }],<br>  &quot;Expiration&quot;: { &quot;Days&quot;: 365 } }] }</pre><p>| Xususiyat | Nima uchun | |---|---| | Block Public Access | default yoqiq — shunday qolsin | | Versioning | tasodifiy o'chirish/ustidan yozishdan himoya | | SSE-S3 / SSE-KMS | shifrlash (SSE-S3 default), KMS — kalit nazorati va audit | | Presigned URL | klient to'g'ridan S3'ga yuklaydi, server orqali emas | | Object Lock | WORM, ransomware'dan himoya |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bucket'ni public qilib sayt berish — CloudFront + Origin Access Control ishlating.</li><li>Versioning yoqib lifecycle qo'ymaslik — eski versiyalar jimgina pul yeydi.</li><li>Ko'p kichik obyektlar va Glacier — har obyekt uchun overhead va retrieval narxi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> S3 xarajati ko'pincha saqlashda emas, so'rovlar va egress'da. Public ma'lumot uchun CDN, ichki trafik uchun VPC gateway endpoint (NAT'siz, bepul).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33207	<p>IAM: user, group, role, policy farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>User</b> — doimiy credential'li shaxs yoki dastur; <b>group</b> — user'larga policy biriktirish uchun to'plam; <b>role</b> — qisqa muddatli credential beradigan, &quot;kiyiladigan&quot; identifikator (EC2, Lambda, boshqa akkaunt, SSO); <b>policy</b> — nima ruxsat/taqiqligini belgilovchi JSON hujjat. IAM sozlamalarini Terraform'da saqlab, policy o'zgarishlarini review qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33208	<p>VPC, subnet (public/private), Internet Gateway va NAT Gateway nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>VPC</b> — AWS'dagi sizning izolyatsiyalangan virtual tarmog'ingiz (CIDR, masalan <code>10.0.0.0/16</code>). <b>Subnet</b> — VPC'ning bitta AZ'dagi bo'lagi. <b>Public</b> subnet — route table'da <code>0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; Internet Gateway</code> bor; <b>private</b> — internetga faqat <b>NAT Gateway</b> orqali chiqadi (kirish yo'q). IGW — VPC'ni internetga ulaydi; NAT GW — private resurslarga faqat chiquvchi ulanish beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>              Internet<br>                 |<br>         [Internet Gateway]<br>                 |<br>  VPC 10.0.0.0/16<br>  +-- public 10.0.1.0/24 (AZ a) : ALB, NAT GW<br>  |        route 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; IGW<br>  +-- private 10.0.11.0/24 (AZ a): app (EC2/EKS)<br>  |        route 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; NAT GW (AZ a)<br>  +-- private 10.0.21.0/24 (AZ a): RDS (internetga yo'l yo'q)<br>  (AZ b, c da ham xuddi shunday)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-123 \<br>  --query 'RouteTables[].Routes[].[DestinationCidrBlock,GatewayId,NatGatewayId]' --output table</pre><pre>module &quot;vpc&quot; {<br>  source             = &quot;terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws&quot;<br>  version            = &quot;5.8.1&quot;<br>  cidr               = &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;<br>  azs                = [&quot;eu-central-1a&quot;, &quot;eu-central-1b&quot;, &quot;eu-central-1c&quot;]<br>  public_subnets     = [&quot;10.0.1.0/24&quot;, &quot;10.0.2.0/24&quot;, &quot;10.0.3.0/24&quot;]<br>  private_subnets    = [&quot;10.0.11.0/24&quot;, &quot;10.0.12.0/24&quot;, &quot;10.0.13.0/24&quot;]<br>  enable_nat_gateway = true<br>  one_nat_gateway_per_az = true<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta NAT GW — u turgan AZ yiqilsa hamma private subnet'lar internetsiz qoladi; prod'da har AZ'ga bittadan.</li><li>NAT GW pullik (soat + har GB) — S3/DynamoDB uchun gateway VPC endpoint (bepul), ECR/STS uchun interface endpoint.</li><li>Kichik yoki boshqa tarmoqlar bilan kesishadigan CIDR — keyin peering/VPN qilib bo'lmaydi. EKS pod'lari ko'p IP yeydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CIDR rejasi — qaytarib bo'lmaydigan qaror: butun tashkilot uchun IPAM bilan, kelajakdagi VPC'lar, ofis va on-prem tarmoqlari bilan kesishmaydigan qilib reja tuzing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33209	<p>Security Group va Network ACL farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Security Group</b> — instance (ENI) darajasidagi <b>stateful</b> firewall: faqat allow qoidalari, javob trafigi avtomatik ruxsat, manba sifatida boshqa SG'ga murojaat qilish mumkin. <b>NACL</b> — subnet darajasidagi <b>stateless</b> filtr: allow va deny, raqam tartibida, javob trafigi (ephemeral portlar) uchun alohida qoida kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Internet -&gt; [NACL subnet chegarasi: kirish + chiqish alohida tekshiriladi]<br>              -&gt; [SG instance: kirish tekshiriladi, javob avtomatik o'tadi] -&gt; EC2</pre><p>| | Security Group | NACL | |---|---|---| | Daraja | ENI (instance) | subnet | | State | stateful | stateless | | Qoidalar | faqat allow | allow + deny, raqam tartibida | | Manba | CIDR yoki <b>boshqa SG</b> | faqat CIDR | | Default | kirish yopiq | default NACL hammasini ochadi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule&quot; &quot;db_from_app&quot; {<br>  security_group_id            = aws_security_group.db.id<br>  referenced_security_group_id = aws_security_group.app.id   # IP emas, SG<br>  from_port                    = 5432<br>  to_port                      = 5432<br>  ip_protocol                  = &quot;tcp&quot;<br>}</pre><pre>aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-123 \<br>  --query 'SecurityGroups[].IpPermissions'<br># SSH o'rniga:<br>aws ssm start-session --target i-0abc123</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>0.0.0.0/0</code> dan 22/3389-port — internetdan doimiy brute-force; SSM Session Manager ishlating.</li><li>NACL'da ephemeral portlarni (1024-65535) chiqishga ochishni unutish — ulanishlar &quot;osilib&quot; qoladi.</li><li>SG qoidasida IP manzil — autoscaling'da IP o'zgaradi, qoida eskiradi; SG reference ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asosiy himoya — SG'lar orasidagi &quot;kim kim bilan gaplashadi&quot; grafi (app -&gt; db). Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33334	<p>Shared responsibility model nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shared responsibility — xavfsizlik vazifalari AWS va mijoz o'rtasida bo'linadi: AWS <b>cloud'ning o'zi</b> uchun (hardware, data center, tarmoq, hypervisor) javob beradi, mijoz esa <b>cloud ichidagi</b> narsalar uchun (IAM, ma'lumot, konfiguratsiya, OS — servis turiga qarab). Managed servis qanchalik yuqori bo'lsa, sizning qismingiz shuncha kichik, lekin IAM va ma'lumot doim sizda.</p><p><b>Qanday bo'linadi:</b></p><pre>         EC2 (IaaS)      RDS (managed)     Lambda / S3<br>Siz:  [ma'lumot      ] [ma'lumot      ] [ma'lumot      ]<br>      [IAM, SG       ] [IAM, SG       ] [IAM, policy   ]<br>      [app, runtime  ] [backup sozlama] [kod           ]<br>      [OS patch      ] -----------------------------------<br>AWS:  [hypervisor, HW] [OS, DB patch  ] [runtime, OS   ]<br>      [data center, fizik xavfsizlik, global tarmoq    ]</pre><p>| Kim | EC2 | RDS | Lambda/S3 | |---|---|---|---| | AWS | hardware, tarmoq, hypervisor | + OS, DB engine patch | + runtime | | Siz | OS patch, SG, IAM, ma'lumot | SG, IAM, backup sozlamasi, ma'lumot | IAM, kod, bucket policy, ma'lumot |</p><p><b>Amalda (sizning tomoningiz):</b></p><pre>aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket acme-data      # bucket ochiq emasmi<br>aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=ip-permission.cidr,Values=0.0.0.0/0<br>aws iam list-access-keys --user-name ci                    # eski access key'lar<br>aws configservice describe-compliance-by-config-rule</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;AWS'da bo'lsa xavfsiz&quot; deb o'ylash — ko'p real incident'lar (public S3, ochiq SG, oqib ketgan key) mijoz tomonida.</li><li>EC2'da OS patch'ni unutish — bu AWS'ning ishi emas.</li><li>RDS &quot;managed&quot; deb backup retention va shifrlashni tekshirmaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Managed servislarni tanlash — xavfsizlik qarori ham: har bir qatlam AWS'ga o'tganda patch, HA va hardening yuki kamayadi. Qolgan qismni (IAM, ma'lumot) policy-as-code va avtomatik tekshiruvlar bilan boshqaring.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33335	<p>AWS CLI'ni qanday sozlaysiz: profile, credential, SSO?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS CLI credential'ni zanjir bo'yicha qidiradi: env o'zgaruvchilar -&gt; <code>~/.aws</code> profillar (SSO yoki access key) -&gt; container/instance role. Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33336	<p>EBS, EFS va S3 farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>EBS</b> — bitta instance'ga ulanadigan blok disk (bitta AZ'da), OS va DB uchun. <b>EFS</b> — ko'p instance bir vaqtda ulanadigan NFS fayl tizimi (multi-AZ). <b>S3</b> — HTTP API orqali obyekt saqlash, region darajasida, eng arzon va cheksiz. Tanlov: kim, qanday protokol bilan va qancha tez kirishi kerakligiga qarab.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>EBS: EC2 --(blok qurilma /dev/nvme1n1)--&gt; volume (AZ a)<br>EFS: EC2 a, EC2 b, pod'lar --(NFS mount)--&gt; /mnt/shared (multi-AZ)<br>S3:  har kim --(HTTPS GET/PUT)--&gt; s3://bucket/key</pre><p>| | EBS | EFS | S3 | |---|---|---|---| | Turi | blok | fayl (NFS) | obyekt | | Ulanish | 1 instance (odatda) | ko'p instance | HTTP API | | Doira | bitta AZ | multi-AZ | region | | Misol | OS disk, DB | umumiy fayllar, CMS | backup, rasm, log, static sayt | | Narx (GB) | o'rtacha | qimmat | arzon |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 create-volume --availability-zone eu-central-1a --size 100 --volume-type gp3 \<br>  --iops 6000 --throughput 250 --encrypted<br>aws ec2 create-snapshot --volume-id vol-123 --description &quot;pre-upgrade&quot;<br>sudo mount -t efs -o tls fs-123:/ /mnt/shared<br>aws s3 cp report.pdf s3://acme-reports/</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>EBS AZ'ga bog'liq: instance boshqa AZ'ga ko'chsa, snapshot'dan yangi volume kerak; K8s'da pod boshqa AZ'ga ko'cha olmaydi.</li><li>gp2 hali ham ishlatilmoqda — gp3 arzonroq va IOPS hajmdan mustaqil sozlanadi.</li><li>EFS'da DB ishlatish — latency va locking muammolari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default: holatsiz servislar + S3 (umumiy fayllar), DB uchun managed servis (RDS). EBS va EFS kerak bo'lgan joylar kamaysa, arxitektura AZ yiqilishlariga chidamliroq bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33337	<p>Route 53 asoslari: hosted zone, record turlari, alias?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Route 53 — AWS'ning DNS servisi. <b>Hosted zone</b> — bitta domen uchun yozuvlar konteyneri (public yoki VPC ichidagi private). Asosiy yozuvlar: A/AAAA (IP), CNAME (boshqa nom), MX (pochta), TXT (tasdiqlash, SPF). <b>Alias</b> — AWS'ga xos yozuv: domen apex'ini (<code>example.com</code>) ALB/CloudFront/S3'ga yo'naltiradi, bepul so'rovlar bilan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>brauzer -&gt; resolver -&gt; .com NS -&gt; Route 53 NS (hosted zone example.com)<br>   -&gt; example.com A (alias) -&gt; ALB IP'lari (AWS avtomatik yangilaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>example.com        A (alias)  -&gt; my-alb-123.eu-central-1.elb.amazonaws.com<br>www.example.com    CNAME      -&gt; example.com<br>example.com        MX         10 mail.example.com<br>_acme.example.com  TXT        &quot;verification=...&quot;</pre><pre>resource &quot;aws_route53_record&quot; &quot;apex&quot; {<br>  zone_id = aws_route53_zone.main.zone_id<br>  name    = &quot;example.com&quot;<br>  type    = &quot;A&quot;<br>  alias {<br>    name                   = aws_lb.web.dns_name<br>    zone_id                = aws_lb.web.zone_id<br>    evaluate_target_health = true<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>dig +short example.com<br>dig NS example.com            # registrar'dagi NS Route 53'nikimi<br>dig @8.8.8.8 www.example.com +trace</pre><p><b>Routing policy'lar:</b> simple, weighted (canary 10/90), latency, failover (health check bilan), geolocation.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Apex'da CNAME — DNS standarti ruxsat bermaydi; alias ishlating.</li><li>Migratsiyadan oldin TTL'ni pasaytirmaslik — eski IP soatlab keshda qoladi. Avval 300s ga tushiring, kuting, keyin o'zgartiring.</li><li>Registrar'dagi NS yozuvlari Route 53 zone NS'lariga mos emas — yozuvlar &quot;ishlamaydi&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS — eng ko'p &quot;hamma narsa ishlamay qoldi&quot; sababidan biri. Muhim zonalarni Terraform'da saqlang, DNSSEC va health-check failover'ni ko'rib chiqing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33338	<p>Auto Scaling Group nima va Launch Template bilan qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Auto Scaling Group (ASG) — bir xil EC2 instance'lar guruhini kerakli sonda (min/desired/max) bir nechta AZ'da ushlab turadi: yiqilganini almashtiradi, yuk bo'yicha ko'paytiradi/kamaytiradi. <b>Launch Template</b> — yangi instance qanday bo'lishini belgilaydi (AMI, type, SG, user_data, IAM role) va versiyalanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ALB -&gt; }<br>    target_value = 50<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>aws autoscaling start-instance-refresh --auto-scaling-group-name web<br>aws autoscaling describe-scaling-activities --auto-scaling-group-name web --max-items 5</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>health_check_type = &quot;EC2&quot;</code> — faqat VM holatini ko'radi; Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33210	<p>ALB va NLB farqi? Qachon qaysi biri?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ALB</b> — L7 (HTTP/HTTPS/gRPC) load balancer: host, path, header bo'yicha routing, TLS termination, WAF, Cognito/OIDC auth. <b>NLB</b> — L4 (TCP/UDP/TLS): juda past latency, millionlab ulanish, statik/Elastic IP, client IP'ni saqlash. HTTP API va veb uchun ALB; TCP protokollar, statik IP yoki ekstremal throughput uchun NLB.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ALB: client --HTTPS--&gt; ALB (TLS tugaydi, so'rov o'qiladi)<br>       /api/*  -&gt; TG api       host: admin.* -&gt; TG admin<br>NLB: client --TCP--&gt; NLB (paketni o'qimaydi) --&gt; TG (target'lar, client IP saqlanadi)</pre><p>| | ALB | NLB | |---|---|---| | Qatlam | L7 | L4 | | Routing | path, host, header, query | port | | TLS | termination, SNI | passthrough yoki termination | | IP | o'zgaruvchan (DNS orqali) | statik / Elastic IP | | WAF | bor | yo'q | | Misol | REST API, veb, gRPC | MQTT, DB proxy, o'yin serveri, PrivateLink |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_lb_target_group&quot; &quot;api&quot; {<br>  port                 = 8080<br>  protocol             = &quot;HTTP&quot;<br>  vpc_id               = module.vpc.vpc_id<br>  deregistration_delay = 30            # connection draining<br>  health_check {<br>    path                = &quot;/healthz&quot;<br>    matcher             = &quot;200&quot;<br>    interval            = 10<br>    healthy_threshold   = 2<br>    unhealthy_threshold = 3<br>  }<br>}</pre><pre>aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn $TG \<br>  --query 'TargetHealthDescriptions[].[Target.Id,TargetHealth.State,TargetHealth.Reason]'</pre><p>K8s'da: AWS Load Balancer Controller — Ingress -&gt; ALB, Service <code>type: LoadBalancer</code> -&gt; NLB.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Health check <code>/</code> ga va u DB'ni tekshiradi — DB sekinlashsa hamma target &quot;nosog'lom&quot; bo'lib, butun servis yiqiladi. Liveness'ni yengil qiling.</li><li>Deregistration delay juda katta — deploy sekin; juda kichik — so'rovlar uziladi.</li><li>ALB idle timeout (60s) va ilova keep-alive mos emas — tasodifiy 502'lar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 502/504 tahlilida ALB access log'lari (<code>target_processing_time</code>, <code>elb_status_code</code> vs <code>target_status_code</code>) muammo LB'dami yoki ilovadami — darhol ajratadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics

Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33340	<p>Lambda qachon mos va qachon mos emas?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Lambda — notekis, hodisaga asoslangan, qisqa (15 daqiqagacha) ishlar uchun mos: S3/SQS/EventBridge trigger'lari, kam trafikli API, cron, &quot;yelim&quot; kod. Doimiy yuqori yuk, uzoq jarayonlar, past va barqaror latency talabi, ko'p DB ulanishi yoki maxsus runtime kerak bo'lsa — ECS/EKS yaxshiroq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>event (API GW, S3, SQS) -&gt; Lambda service -&gt; issiq muhit bormi?<br>     yo'q -&gt; cold start (init: runtime + kod)  -&gt; handler<br>     ha   -&gt; handler (tez)<br>har parallel so'rov = alohida muhit (concurrency)</pre><p>| Mezon | Lambda | ECS/EKS | |---|---|---| | Davomiylik | &lt;= 15 daqiqa | cheksiz | | Yuk | notekis, kam | doimiy, yuqori | | Cold start | bor (Go'da ~100ms, JVM'da sezilarli) | yo'q | | Ops | minimal | ko'proq | | Narx | so'rov x vaqt x xotira | soat |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws lambda create-function --function-name thumb --runtime provided.al2023 --architectures arm64 \<br>  --handler bootstrap --zip-file fileb://fn.zip --role arn:aws:iam::111:role/thumb \<br>  --memory-size 512 --timeout 30<br>aws lambda put-function-concurrency --function-name thumb --reserved-concurrent-executions 50<br>aws lambda put-function-event-invoke-config --function-name thumb \<br>  --maximum-retry-attempts 1 --destination-config '{&quot;OnFailure&quot;:{&quot;Destination&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:sqs:...:thumb-dlq&quot;}}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har parallel invocation — alohida DB ulanishi; cho'qqida RDS ulanishlari tugaydi: RDS Proxy kerak.</li><li>Asinxron event'lar avtomatik qayta yuboriladi — handler idempotent bo'lsin, DLQ/destination sozlang.</li><li>Account concurrency limiti (default 1000) umumiy — bitta funksiya hammasini bo'g'ishi mumkin: reserved concurrency.</li><li>Doimiy yuqori trafikda Lambda narxi konteynerdan bir necha baravar qimmat bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qaror — narx va operatsion yuk egri chiziqlari kesishgan nuqtada: past/notekis trafikda Lambda arzon va oddiy, barqaror yuqori trafikda konteyner. Ikkalasini aralash ishlatish normal.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33341	<p>Secrets Manager va SSM Parameter Store farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham konfiguratsiya va secret'larni markazlashgan, KMS bilan shifrlangan holda saqlaydi. <b>Secrets Manager</b> — secret'lar uchun ixtisoslashgan: avtomatik rotation, cross-region replika, katta hajm, lekin har secret uchun to'lov. <b>Parameter Store</b> — umumiy konfiguratsiya, ierarxik path'lar, standard tier bepul, rotation yo'q.</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | Secrets Manager | Parameter Store | |---|---|---| | Rotation | o'rnatilgan (Lambda, RDS integratsiya) | yo'q | | Narx | ~$0.40/secret/oy + API | standard bepul | | Hajm | 64 KB | 4 KB (advanced 8 KB) | | Versiyalar | staging label'lar (AWSCURRENT/AWSPREVIOUS) | raqamli versiyalar | | Ierarxiya | nom | path (<code>/prod/api/...</code>) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id prod/db --query SecretString --output text<br>aws ssm get-parameter --name /prod/api/log_level --query Parameter.Value --output text<br>aws ssm get-parameters-by-path --path /prod/api --with-decryption</pre><p>Ilovada (Go) runtime'da o'qish va keshlash:</p><pre>out, err := sm.GetSecretValue(ctx, &amp;secretsmanager.GetSecretValueInput{SecretId: aws.String(&quot;prod/db&quot;)})<br>// natijani 5-15 daqiqa keshlash, auth xatosida qayta o'qish</pre><p>ECS: task definition'da <code>secrets: [{name: DB_PASSWORD, valueFrom: arn:...}]</code>; EKS: External Secrets Operator.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (rotation):</b></p><pre>AWSCURRENT (parol v1) -&gt; rotation Lambda: yangi parol v2 yaratadi -&gt; DB'da o'rnatadi<br>  -&gt; AWSPENDING -&gt; test -&gt; AWSCURRENT = v2, AWSPREVIOUS = v1<br>ilova: ulanish xatosida secret'ni qayta o'qiydi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret'ni build vaqtida image yoki env'ga &quot;pishirish&quot; — rotation'dan keyin yangilanmaydi va image'da oqadi.</li><li>Ilova secret'ni faqat startup'da o'qiydi — rotation'dan keyin ulanishlar yiqiladi.</li><li>Har so'rovda API chaqiruv — narx va throttling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rotation dizayni ilova bilan birga qilinadi: ikki parol bir vaqtda amal qiladigan oyna (alternating users strategiyasi) uzilishsiz rotation beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33403	<p>AWS Organizations va SCP nima? Multi-account strategiya nega kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>AWS Organizations</b> — ko'p AWS akkauntini markaziy boshqarish: OU (organizational unit) ierarxiyasi, umumiy billing, markaziy siyosatlar. <b>SCP (Service Control Policy)</b> — OU/akkauntdagi <b>maksimal</b> ruxsat chegarasi: hatto akkaunt admini ham undan oshib o'tolmaydi. Multi-account — eng kuchli izolyatsiya chegarasi: blast radius, xavfsizlik, xarajat va kvotalarni ajratadi.</p><p><b>Nega bitta akkaunt yomon:</b></p><pre>bitta akkaunt: dev'dagi xato IAM / skript -&gt; prod resurslarini o'chiradi<br>               dev API limitlari prod'ni bo'g'adi, xarajatni ajratib bo'lmaydi<br>multi-account: har muhit/jamoa alohida akkaunt -&gt; xato faqat o'z chegarasida</pre><p><b>Tuzilma:</b></p><pre>Root (management) -- faqat billing va org boshqaruvi, workload yo'q<br> +-- OU Security    : log-archive, audit<br> +-- OU Infra       : network, shared-services<br> +-- OU Workloads<br>      +-- prod      : payments-prod, api-prod<br>      +-- nonprod   : dev, staging<br> +-- OU Sandbox     : tajriba akkauntlari (budget bilan)</pre><p><b>Amalda (SCP):</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;Version&quot;: &quot;2012-10-17&quot;,<br>  &quot;Statement&quot;: [<br>    { &quot;Sid&quot;: &quot;DenyOtherRegions&quot;, &quot;Effect&quot;: &quot;Deny&quot;, &quot;NotAction&quot;: [&quot;iam:*&quot;,&quot;sts:*&quot;,&quot;organizations:*&quot;,&quot;support:*&quot;],<br>      &quot;Resource&quot;: &quot;*&quot;,<br>      &quot;Condition&quot;: { &quot;StringNotEquals&quot;: { &quot;aws:RequestedRegion&quot;: [&quot;eu-central-1&quot;] } } },<br>    { &quot;Sid&quot;: &quot;ProtectCloudTrail&quot;, &quot;Effect&quot;: &quot;Deny&quot;,<br>      &quot;Action&quot;: [&quot;cloudtrail:StopLogging&quot;,&quot;cloudtrail:DeleteTrail&quot;,&quot;guardduty:DeleteDetector&quot;],<br>      &quot;Resource&quot;: &quot;*&quot; }<br>  ]<br>}</pre><pre>aws organizations list-accounts --query 'Accounts[].[Name,Id,Status]' --output table</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Region deny SCP'da global servislarni (IAM, STS, CloudFront) istisno qilmaslik — ular ishlamay qoladi.</li><li>SCP ruxsat <b>bermaydi</b> — faqat cheklaydi; IAM policy baribir kerak.</li><li>Management akkauntda workload ishlatish — SCP u yerga ta'sir qilmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Control Tower / Landing Zone Accelerator bu tuzilmani avtomatik quradi (CloudTrail, Config, guardrail'lar). Odamlar IAM Identity Center orqali kerakli akkauntga rol bilan kiradi — har akkauntda IAM user yo'q.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33404	<p>CloudTrail, GuardDuty va AWS Config — har biri nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>CloudTrail</b> — &quot;kim, qachon, qayerdan, qaysi API'ni chaqirdi&quot; audit jurnali. <b>GuardDuty</b> — loglar (CloudTrail, VPC Flow, DNS) asosida tahdidlarni avtomatik aniqlaydi (kripto-mayning, kompromat credential, g'alati API faolligi). <b>AWS Config</b> — resurslar konfiguratsiyasi tarixi va qoidalarga mosligini (compliance) kuzatadi. <b>Security Hub</b> — barcha topilmalarni bir joyda yig'adi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>API chaqiruv --&gt; CloudTrail (log-archive S3) --&gt; &quot;SG'ni kim ochdi?&quot;<br>CloudTrail + VPC Flow + DNS --&gt; GuardDuty (ML, threat intel) --&gt; finding<br>resurs o'zgarishi --&gt; Config (holat tarixi + rule) --&gt; NON_COMPLIANT<br>hammasi --&gt; Security Hub --&gt; EventBridge --&gt; Slack / ticket / avtomatik tuzatish</pre><p>| Servis | Savol | Misol | |---|---|---| | CloudTrail | Kim nima qildi? | &quot;SG'ni kim 0.0.0.0/0 ga ochdi?&quot; | | GuardDuty | Hujum bormi? | EC2 mining pool'ga ulanmoqda | | Config | Holat qoidaga mosmi, qanday o'zgargan? | shifrlanmagan EBS ro'yxati | | Security Hub | Umumiy holat | CIS / FSBP benchmark ball |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress \<br>  --max-results 5 --query 'Events[].[EventTime,Username]'<br>aws guardduty list-findings --detector-id $D --finding-criteria '{&quot;Criterion&quot;:{&quot;severity&quot;:{&quot;Gte&quot;:7}}}'<br>aws configservice describe-compliance-by-config-rule --compliance-types NON_COMPLIANT</pre><p>EventBridge qoidasi — root login'da alert:</p><pre>{ &quot;detail-type&quot;: [&quot;AWS Console Sign In via CloudTrail&quot;],<br>  &quot;detail&quot;: { &quot;userIdentity&quot;: { &quot;type&quot;: [&quot;Root&quot;] } } }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CloudTrail faqat bitta region'da yoki o'sha akkauntdagi bucket'da — hujumchi izni o'chiradi. Organization trail, alohida log-archive akkaunt, Object Lock.</li><li>GuardDuty yoqilgan, lekin finding'larni hech kim ko'rmaydi — EventBridge orqali alert/ticket.</li><li>Config hamma resurs turlarini yozsa — xarajat; kerakli turlarni tanlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Minimum baseline: organization-wide CloudTrail + GuardDuty + Config, log-archive'da o'zgarmas saqlash, yuqori severity'ga avtomatik alert. Bularsiz incident'da &quot;nima bo'ldi?&quot; ga javob topib bo'lmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics
Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-33405	<p>VPC peering, Transit Gateway va PrivateLink farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>VPC peering</b> — ikki VPC'ni to'g'ridan 1:1 bog'laydi (tranzitiv emas). <b>Transit Gateway</b> — markaziy hub: ko'p VPC, VPN va Direct Connect'ni hub-and-spoke bilan bog'laydi, tranzitiv routing. <b>PrivateLink</b> — tarmoqlarni emas, bitta <b>servisni</b> boshqa VPC'ga xususiy endpoint sifatida ochadi (CIDR kesishsa ham ishlaydi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Peering:        VPC A &lt;----&gt; VPC B &lt;----&gt; VPC C   (A -&gt; C yo'q! to'r o'sib ketadi)<br>Transit GW:     VPC A --\<br>                VPC B ---[ TGW ]--- VPN / Direct Connect (ofis)<br>                VPC C --/<br>PrivateLink:    consumer VPC [interface endpoint ENI] --&gt; NLB --&gt; provider servisi</pre><p>| | VPC peering | Transit Gateway | PrivateLink | |---|---|---|---| | Topologiya | 1:1 | hub-and-spoke | servis -&gt; iste'molchi | | Tranzitiv | yo'q | ha | - | | CIDR kesishishi | mumkin emas | mumkin emas | mumkin | | Narx | faqat trafik | soat + GB | soat + GB | | Misol | 2-3 VPC | 10+ VPC, gibrid tarmoq | SaaS, boshqa jamoa API'si |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 create-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-id vpc-a --peer-vpc-id vpc-b<br># har ikki tomonda route table'ga yo'nalish qo'shish kerak!<br>aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-a --destination-cidr-block 10.1.0.0/16 \<br>  --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-123<br><br>aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-a --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.s3 \<br>  --route-table-ids rtb-a                                   # gateway endpoint (bepul)<br>aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-a --vpc-endpoint-type Interface \<br>  --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.ecr.dkr --subnet-ids subnet-1 subnet-2</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Peering'dan keyin route'larni va SG'larni unutish — ulanish &quot;ishlamaydi&quot;.</li><li>Peering to'ri: 10 VPC = 45 ta ulanish — boshqarib bo'lmaydi; TGW'ga o'ting.</li><li>TGW orqali katta trafik — GB to'lovi sezilarli; ma'lumot ko'p almashadigan juftliklar uchun peering arzonroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tarmoq topologiyasi tashkilot tuzilmasini aks ettiradi: platforma — TGW hub; jamoalar orasidagi servis kontraktlari — PrivateLink (minimal ochiqlik, tarmoq bog'lanishisiz). AWS servislariga esa doim VPC endpoint'lar.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics

Birinchi qadamlar va uzoq muddatli yechim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Avval <b>qon to'xtatish</b>: qaysi so'rovlar CPU'ni yeyotganini (<code>pg_stat_activity</code>, <code>pg_stat_statements</code>, Performance Insights) topib, kerak bo'lsa og'ir so'rovni bekor qilish yoki yangi deploy'ni rollback qilish. Interview Drill::Cloud::W5 AWS basics	idrill-42234	<p>Senariy: bitta AZ ishdan chiqdi. Arxitekturangiz omon qoldimi — nimalarni oldindan tekshirgan bo'lishingiz kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AZ yiqilishi — kutilishi kerak bo'lgan oddiy hodisa. Omon qolish uchun oldindan: compute bir nechta AZ'da va qolgan AZ'larda yukni ko'tarishga <b>yetarli zaxira</b>; har AZ'da o'z NAT GW'si; DB va cache avtomatik failover bilan; stateful komponentlar AZ'ga bog'lanmagan; va eng muhimi — bularning hammasi <b>sinovdan</b> o'tgan (FIS, zonal shift).</p><p><b>Qanday ko'rinadi:</b></p><pre>oldin:  AZ a [3 pod]  AZ b [3 pod]  AZ c [3 pod]   -&gt; 9 pod, 66% yuk<br>AZ a o'ldi:           AZ b [3]      AZ c [3]       -&gt; 6 pod, 100% yuk!  (zaxira kerak)<br>static stability: oldindan 4+4+4 = 12 pod -&gt; AZ yo'qolsa 8 pod, ~75% yuk</pre><p><b>Tekshiruv ro'yxati:</b> | Qatlam | Nima bo'lishi kerak | |---|---| | Compute | ASG/Karpenter 3 AZ subnet'ida, topology spread, N+1 zaxira sig'im | | LB | ALB barcha AZ'larda, cross-zone, health check | | NAT | har AZ'da o'z NAT GW va route table | | DB | RDS Multi-AZ (avtomatik failover ~1-2 daq) | | Cache | ElastiCache replica + automatic failover, multi-AZ | | Stateful pod | EBS AZ'ga bog'liq -&gt; replikatsiya ilova darajasida yoki EFS/S3 | | Bog'liqliklar | ilova DNS keshi, retry/timeout, failover'ga chidamli klient |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># K8s: pod'larni AZ'lar bo'yicha teng tarqatish<br>topologySpreadConstraints:<br>  - maxSkew: 1<br>    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone<br>    whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule<br>    labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }</pre><pre># AZ'ni sun'iy &quot;o'chirish&quot;: ARC zonal shift (ALB/NLB trafigini AZ'dan olib ketadi)<br>aws arc-zonal-shift start-zonal-shift --resource-identifier $ALB_ARN \<br>  --away-from euc1-az1 --expires-in 1h --comment &quot;game day&quot;<br># AWS FIS: AZ power interruption senariysi (EC2, EBS, RDS failover)<br>aws fis start-experiment --experiment-template-id EXT123</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta NAT GW — bitta AZ yiqilishi boshqa AZ'larni ham internetsiz qoldiradi.</li><li>Tiklanish uchun control plane'ga tayanish (AZ yiqilgach yangi instance ochish) — o'sha payt hamma ochadi, sig'im yetishmaydi.</li><li>PDB va <code>maxSkew</code> siz pod'lar bitta AZ'ga to'planib qolgan — nazariy multi-AZ, amalda single-AZ.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Static stability&quot; tamoyili: tizim AZ yiqilganda hech narsa yaratmasdan, mavjud sig'im bilan ishlashda davom etishi kerak. Game day'larda sinamagan HA — faqat umid.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::w5 AWS_basics

Interview Drill::Cloud::W11 Azure basics	idrill-33513	<p>Azure resurs ierarxiyasi: Management Group, Subscription, Resource Group, Resource. Interview Drill::Cloud::W11 Azure basics	idrill-33514	<p>Azure'da VNet, Subnet, NSG va Azure Firewall farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>VNet</b> — Azure'dagi xususiy tarmoq (AWS VPC). <b>Subnet</b> — VNet ichidagi IP diapazon bo'lagi. <b>NSG (Network Security Group)</b> — subnet yoki NIC'ga biriktiriladigan <b>stateful</b> L3/L4 allow/deny qoidalar ro'yxati (prioritet raqami bilan). <b>Azure Firewall</b> — markaziy, managed, stateful firewall servisi: L3-L7, FQDN filtrlash, threat intelligence, TLS inspection (Premium), odatda hub VNet'da va trafik UDR orqali unga yo'naltiriladi.</p><p><b>Nega ikkalasi:</b> NSG — arzon, har subnet'da mikrosegmentatsiya; Azure Firewall — markazlashgan egress nazorati (masalan &quot;faqat <code>*.github.com</code> ga chiqish&quot;) va log'lash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Hub VNet (10.0.0.0/16): Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, Bastion<br>   ^ peering                       ^ peering<br>Spoke VNet prod (10.1.0.0/16)     Spoke VNet dev<br>   subnet-app [NSG: 443 from AppGW]  -- UDR 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; Firewall private IP<br>   subnet-db  [NSG: 1433 from subnet-app]<br>NSG qoidalari: prioritet 100-4096, kichik raqam birinchi; default qoidalar oxirida</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>az network vnet create -g rg-net -n vnet-prod --address-prefixes 10.1.0.0/16 \<br>  --subnet-name snet-app --subnet-prefixes 10.1.1.0/24<br>az network nsg create -g rg-net -n nsg-app<br>az network nsg rule create -g rg-net --nsg-name nsg-app -n allow-https \<br>  --priority 100 --direction Inbound --access Allow --protocol Tcp \<br>  --source-address-prefixes 10.1.0.0/24 --destination-port-ranges 443<br>az network vnet subnet update -g rg-net --vnet-name vnet-prod -n snet-app --network-security-group nsg-app<br>az network watcher show-next-hop ...      # trafik qayerga ketadi<br>az network nic list-effective-nsg ...     # amaldagi qoidalar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default NSG qoidasi <code>AllowVnetInBound</code> — VNet (va peering) ichidagi hamma trafik ochiq; aniq deny qoidasi kerak.</li><li>NSG ham subnet'da, ham NIC'da — ikkalasidan o'tishi kerak; debug chalkashadi.</li><li>RDP/SSH (3389/22) ni <code>Internet</code>ga ochish — eng ko'p uchraydigan Azure hujum nuqtasi; Azure Bastion yoki JIT VM access ishlating.</li><li>Azure Firewall qimmat (soatlik + trafik) — kichik muhitlarga NAT Gateway + NSG yetarli bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hub-spoke topologiya + markaziy firewall + Private Endpoint'lar (PaaS'ni public endpoint'siz) — Azure'da standart xavfsiz tarmoq naqshi. NSG flow logs / VNet flow logs'ni yoqib, qoidalarni haqiqiy trafikka asoslang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w11 Azure
Interview Drill::Cloud::W11 Azure basics	idrill-33518	<p>Azure DevOps Pipelines va GitHub Actions: Azure'ga deploy qilishning zamonaviy usuli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zamonaviy usul — <b>OIDC workload identity federation</b>: GitHub Actions yoki Azure DevOps pipeline Azure'ga <b>secret'siz</b> kiradi. Entra ID'da app registration yoki user-assigned managed identity yaratib, unga &quot;federated credential&quot; qo'shasiz (masalan <code>repo:acme/api:environment:prod</code>), pipeline qisqa muddatli OIDC token'ni Azure access token'ga almashtiradi. Azure DevOps'da bu &quot;Workload identity federation&quot; turidagi service connection. Uzoq yashaydigan client secret yoki sertifikat — eskirgan amaliyot.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> service principal'ning client secret'i CI secret'larida saqlanadi, 2 yil muddatli, hech kim rotatsiya qilmaydi; sizib chiqsa (log, fork PR, buzilgan action) hujumchi subscription'ga kiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GitHub Actions job (environment: prod)<br>  -&gt; GitHub OIDC provider: JWT (sub=repo:acme/api:environment:prod, aud=api://AzureADTokenExchange)<br>  -&gt; Entra ID: federated credential sub mosmi? -&gt; qisqa access token (~1 soat)<br>  -&gt; az / terraform / deploy<br>Secret saqlanmaydi, token faqat shu repo+environment uchun.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>permissions:<br>  id-token: write<br>  contents: read<br>jobs:<br>  deploy:<br>    runs-on: ubuntu-latest<br>    environment: prod          # required reviewers bilan himoyalangan<br>    steps:<br>    - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>    - uses: azure/login@v2<br>      with:<br>        client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}<br>        tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}<br>        subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}<br>    - run: az aks get-credentials -g rg-shop-prod -n aks-prod</pre><pre>az identity federated-credential create -g rg-ci --identity-name id-gha-prod -n gha-prod \<br>  --issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \<br>  --subject repo:acme/api:environment:prod --audiences api://AzureADTokenExchange<br>az role assignment create --assignee &lt;principalId&gt; --role &quot;Contributor&quot; --scope /subscriptions/&lt;id&gt;/resourceGroups/rg-shop-prod</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>subject</code>ni keng qilish (<code>repo:acme/*</code>) — har qanday branch/PR prod'ga deploy qila oladi. Environment yoki aniq branch bilan cheklang.</li><li>Pipeline identity'siga subscription Owner — minimal rol, minimal scope (RG).</li><li>Azure DevOps Classic release'lar eskirgan yo'nalish — YAML pipeline'larga o'ting.</li><li>Prod environment'da required reviewers va branch protection yo'q — har push prod'ga ketadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GitHub Actions va Azure DevOps ikkalasi ham to'liq ishlaydi; tanlov kod qayerda turishiga va tashkilot standartiga bog'liq. Muhimi — secret'siz federatsiya, environment himoyasi va GitOps (AKS uchun Flux/Argo) bilan push huquqini kamaytirish.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w11 Azure
Interview Drill::Cloud::W11 Azure basics	idrill-33515	<p>Managed Identity nima? System-assigned va user-assigned farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Managed Identity — Azure resursiga (VM, App Service, Function, AKS pod) Entra ID'da avtomatik boshqariladigan identity beradi: kod secret saqlamasdan Key Vault, Storage, SQL kabi servislarga token bilan kiradi; kalit rotatsiyasini Azure o'zi qiladi. <b>System-assigned</b> — resurs bilan birga yaratiladi va birga o'chadi, faqat o'sha resursga tegishli (1:1). <b>User-assigned</b> — mustaqil Azure resursi, ko'p resursga biriktiriladi va umri ulardan alohida.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> connection string'dagi Storage key yoki SQL parol app sozlamalarida turibdi — sizib chiqsa muddatsiz kalit; Key Vault: token + RBAC tekshiruvi -&gt; secret<br>Kodda parol yo'q; DefaultAzureCredential buni avtomatik qiladi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>az webapp identity assign -g rg-shop -n app-shop                     # system-assigned<br>az identity create -g rg-shop -n id-shop-api                         # user-assigned<br>az vm identity assign -g rg-shop -n vm-1 --identities id-shop-api<br>az role assignment create --assignee &lt;principalId&gt; \<br>  --role &quot;Key Vault Secrets User&quot; --scope $(az keyvault show -n kv-shop --query id -o tsv)</pre><pre>from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential<br>from azure.keyvault.secrets import SecretClient<br>client = SecretClient(&quot;https://kv-shop.vault.azure.net&quot;, DefaultAzureCredential())<br>print(client.get_secret(&quot;db-password&quot;).value)</pre><p>| | System-assigned | User-assigned | |---|---|---| | Umr | resurs bilan | mustaqil | | Ulashish | yo'q (1:1) | ko'p resurs | | Qachon | oddiy, bitta resurs | ko'p instance, oldindan ruxsat, AKS workload identity |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Identity'ga subscription darajasida Contributor — RCE bo'lsa hujumchi butun subscription'ni boshqaradi; minimal rol va scope.</li><li>User-assigned identity'ni ko'p servisga ulashish — biri buzilsa hammasining huquqi ketadi.</li><li>VM ichidagi istalgan jarayon IMDS'dan token olishi mumkin — SSRF zaifligi identity'ni o'g'irlash yo'li;
