Interview Drill::Cloud::W11 Azure basics	idrill-33516	<p>Azure RBAC va Azure Policy farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Azure RBAC</b> — <b>kim</b> <b>nima qila oladi</b>: identity (user, group, managed identity) ga scope (MG, subscription, RG, resurs) bo'yicha rol (Reader, Contributor, Owner, Key Vault Secrets User...) beriladi. <b>Azure Policy</b> — <b>qanday resurs</b> yaratilishi mumkin: kimligidan qat'i nazar resurs xususiyatlariga qoida qo'yadi (faqat <code>westeurope</code>, Storage'da public access yo'q, tag majburiy) — <code>Deny</code>, <code>Audit</code>, <code>Modify</code>, <code>DeployIfNotExists</code> effektlari bilan.</p><p><b>Farqning mohiyati:</b> RBAC Owner ham Policy'ni buzib resurs yarata olmaydi. Masalan dasturchi RG'da Contributor (RBAC ruxsat beradi), lekin public IP'li VM yaratishga urinsa Policy rad etadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>so'rov: &quot;rg-shop'da Storage Account yarat (allowBlobPublicAccess=true)&quot;<br>  1. RBAC: foydalanuvchi Contributor? -&gt; ha<br>  2. Policy: &quot;Storage public access taqiqlangan&quot; (Deny) -&gt; RAD<br>  -&gt; 403 RequestDisallowedByPolicy<br>Policy mavjud resurslarni ham baholaydi -&gt; compliance hisobot</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>az role assignment create --assignee team-shop@acme.com --role Contributor \<br>  --scope /subscriptions/&lt;id&gt;/resourceGroups/rg-shop-prod<br>az role assignment list --scope /subscriptions/&lt;id&gt;/resourceGroups/rg-shop-prod -o table<br>az policy definition list --query &quot;[?displayName=='Allowed locations'].name&quot; -o tsv<br>az policy assignment create -n allowed-locations --policy &lt;defName&gt; \<br>  --scope /providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/landing-zones \<br>  --params '{&quot;listOfAllowedLocations&quot;:{&quot;value&quot;:[&quot;westeurope&quot;,&quot;northeurope&quot;]}}'<br>az policy state summarize --management-group landing-zones</pre><p>| | RBAC | Policy | |---|---|---| | Savol | kim nima qila oladi | resurs qanday bo'lishi kerak | | Ob'ekt | identity | resurs xususiyatlari | | Natija | ruxsat / yo'q | deny / audit / tuzatish |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Policy'ni darhol <code>Deny</code> bilan joriy qilish — mavjud pipeline'lar sinadi; avval <code>Audit</code>, compliance'ni ko'rib, keyin <code>Deny</code>.</li><li>Owner va &quot;User Access Administrator&quot; rollari o'ziga va boshqalarga huquq berishi mumkin — juda kam odamga, PIM (just-in-time) orqali.</li><li>Classic administrator rollari va kalit asosidagi kirish (Storage account key) RBAC'ni chetlab o'tadi — <code>allowSharedKeyAccess=false</code> Policy bilan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Guardrail'lar = Policy (MG darajasida, kod sifatida Git'da), huquqlar = RBAC (guruhlarga, minimal scope, PIM bilan). Ikkisi birga &quot;self-service, lekin xavfsiz&quot; platformani beradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w11 Azure
Interview Drill::Cloud::W11 Azure basics	idrill-33517	<p>AKS'ni production uchun qanday sozlaysiz (asosiy qarorlar)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Production AKS uchun asosiy qarorlar: <b>tarmoq</b> (Azure CNI Overlay yoki Cilium dataplane, private cluster yoki API server authorized IP'lar), <b>identity</b> (Entra ID integratsiyasi + Azure RBAC for K8s, local accounts o'chiq, Workload Identity), <b>node pool'lar</b> (alohida system va user pool, availability zones, autoscaler, spot pool kerak bo'lsa), <b>upgrade</b> (auto-upgrade channel, maintenance window, node image yangilanishi), <b>xavfsizlik</b> (Azure Policy/Gatekeeper, Defender for Containers, Key Vault CSI), <b>egress</b> (NAT Gateway yoki Azure Firewall UDR), <b>observability</b> (Container Insights / Managed Prometheus + Grafana), <b>SLA</b> (Standard tier — uptime SLA).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>AKS (Standard tier, AZ 1-2-3)<br>  control plane (managed, private endpoint)<br>  system pool: 3 x D4s (taint CriticalAddonsOnly) -&gt; Interview Drill::Cloud::W11 Azure basics	idrill-34059	<p>Azure'da Resource Group nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Resource Group (RG) — Azure'dagi bir-biriga bog'liq resurslarni (VM, disk, tarmoq, DB) birga saqlaydigan mantiqiy konteyner. Har resurs aynan bitta RG'da bo'ladi. RG darajasida ruxsatlar (RBAC), policy, tag, budget va lock beriladi; RG o'chirilsa ichidagi hamma resurs o'chadi.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> loyiha uchun 15 ta resurs yaratdingiz — ularni birga ko'rish, xarajatini hisoblash, jamoaga ruxsat berish va kerak bo'lmaganda bir buyruq bilan tozalash oson bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Subscription &quot;prod&quot;<br>  +-- rg-shop-prod (westeurope, tag: owner=team-shop)<br>  |     vm-api-1, disk, nic, vnet, sql-db, kv-shop<br>  +-- rg-shop-dev<br>RG'ning location'i faqat metadata uchun; ichidagi resurslar boshqa region'da bo'lishi mumkin.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>az group create -n rg-shop-dev -l westeurope --tags env=dev owner=team-shop<br>az group list -o table<br>az resource list -g rg-shop-dev -o table<br>az lock create -n no-delete -g rg-shop-prod --lock-type CanNotDelete<br>az group delete -n rg-shop-dev --yes      # ichidagi HAMMA narsa o'chadi</pre><p>Nomlash odati: <code>rg-&lt;ilova&gt;-&lt;muhit&gt;-&lt;region&gt;</code>, masalan <code>rg-shop-prod-weu</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Turli umrdagi resurslarni bitta RG'ga qo'yish — test VM'ni o'chirish uchun RG'ni o'chirsangiz umumiy tarmoq ham ketadi.</li><li>Prod RG'da lock yo'q — tasodifiy <code>az group delete</code>.</li><li>Resursni boshqa RG'ga ko'chirish har doim ham mumkin emas va resurs ID'sini o'zgartiradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> RG'ni &quot;birga yaratiladi, birga o'chiriladi&quot; printsipi bo'yicha loyihalang va IaC (Terraform) bilan boshqaring — shunda RG ichidagi holat kodda aniq va drift ko'rinadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w11 Azure
Interview Drill::Cloud::W11 Azure basics	idrill-34060	<p>Azure'ning asosiy servislari AWS'da nimaga to'g'ri keladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy mosliklar: <b>Virtual Machines</b> = EC2; <b>Blob Storage</b> = S3; <b>Managed Disks</b> = EBS; <b>Azure Files</b> = EFS; <b>VNet</b> = VPC; <b>NSG</b> = Security Group; <b>Load Balancer / Application Gateway</b> = NLB / ALB; <b>Front Door</b> = CloudFront + global LB; <b>Azure SQL / Database for PostgreSQL</b> = RDS; <b>Cosmos DB</b> = DynamoDB; <b>AKS</b> = EKS; <b>Container Apps</b> = App Runner / ECS Fargate; <b>Functions</b> = Lambda; <b>Entra ID</b> = IAM Identity Center + (qisman) IAM; <b>Key Vault</b> = KMS + Secrets Manager; <b>Monitor / Log Analytics</b> = CloudWatch; <b>Service Bus / Event Hubs</b> = SQS/SNS / Kinesis; <b>ACR</b> = ECR; <b>Azure DNS</b> = Route 53.</p><p><b>Nega bilish kerak:</b> multi-cloud yoki migratsiya loyihalarida bir bulutdagi bilimni ikkinchisiga ko'chirish. Lekin moslik — taxminiy: xulq, limitlar va narx modeli farq qiladi.</p><p>| Toifa | Azure | AWS | |---|---|---| | Hisob | Subscription | Account | | Kompyuter | VM, VMSS | EC2, ASG | | Konteyner | AKS, Container Apps | EKS, ECS/Fargate | | Serverless | Functions | Lambda | | Object storage | Blob Storage | S3 | | SQL DB | Azure SQL, PostgreSQL Flexible | RDS, Aurora | | NoSQL | Cosmos DB | DynamoDB | | Secret/kalit | Key Vault | Secrets Manager, KMS | | Identity | Entra ID, Managed Identity | IAM, IAM roles | | Monitoring | Azure Monitor | CloudWatch | | Registry | ACR | ECR |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>az vm list -o table                  # ~ aws ec2 describe-instances<br>az storage account list -o table     # ~ aws s3 ls (account darajasi)<br>az aks list -o table                 # ~ aws eks list-clusters</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Azure'da Storage Account — S3 bucket'dan bir daraja yuqori (account -&gt; container -&gt; blob).</li><li>Resource Group tushunchasi AWS'da yo'q — tag'lar bilan almashtirib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>IAM modellari farqli: Azure'da identity Entra ID'da (tenant), ruxsat RBAC rollari bilan; AWS'da policy hujjatlari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Servis nomlarini yodlashdan ko'ra har bulutning asosiy tushunchalarini (identity modeli, tarmoq, ierarxiya, narx) bilish muhim — migratsiyadagi xatolarning ko'pi shu farqlarda.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w11 Azure

Interview Drill::Cloud::W12 GCP basics	idrill-33519	<p>GCP resurs ierarxiyasi va asosiy servislar: Organization, Folder, Project. AWS bilan solishtirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GCP ierarxiyasi: <b>Organization</b> (kompaniya domeni, ildiz) -&gt; <b>Folder</b> (bo'lim/muhit bo'yicha guruhlash, ichma-ich) -&gt; <b>Project</b> (resurslar, billing, API'lar va IAM'ning asosiy chegarasi) -&gt; resurslar. IAM va Organization Policy yuqoridan pastga meros bo'ladi. AWS bilan: Organization ~ AWS Organization, Folder ~ OU, Project ~ Account. Asosiy servislar: Compute Engine (EC2), Cloud Storage (S3), GKE (EKS), Cloud Run (App Runner/Fargate), Cloud SQL (RDS), BigQuery (Redshift/Athena), Pub/Sub (SNS+SQS), Cloud Functions (Lambda), VPC (global!), Cloud IAM, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry.</p><p><b>Nega muhim:</b> ruxsat va policy qayerda berilsa, pastdagi hamma narsaga tegadi; project — izolyatsiya va billing birligi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Organization: acme.com  (Org Policy: faqat EU region, tashqi IP taqiq)<br>  +-- Folder: prod<br>  |     +-- Project: shop-prod  -&gt; GKE, Cloud SQL, GCS<br>  +-- Folder: nonprod<br>        +-- Project: shop-dev<br>Farq: GCP VPC — global resurs (subnet'lar region'da), AWS VPC — region'ga bog'liq.<br>Shared VPC: host project tarmog'ini service project'lar ishlatadi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcloud organizations list<br>gcloud resource-manager folders list --organization=123456789<br>gcloud projects list<br>gcloud projects create shop-dev-123 --folder=987654321<br>gcloud config set project shop-dev-123<br>gcloud services enable container.googleapis.com run.googleapis.com</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Project ID global noyob va o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi; nomlash standartini oldindan belgilang.</li><li>API'lar har project'da alohida yoqilishi kerak — &quot;API not enabled&quot; xatosi.</li><li>Org darajasida keng rol (Owner, Editor) — barcha project'larga meros.</li><li>Billing account'ga bog'lanmagan project'da resurs yaratilmaydi; budget alert'larini project/folder bo'yicha qo'ying.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> GCP'da project'lar arzon — har ilova va muhitga alohida project bering (blast radius, billing, IAM aniq), tarmoqni esa Shared VPC orqali markazlashtiring. Org Policy'lar bilan guardrail'larni ildizda qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w12 GCP
Interview Drill::Cloud::W12 GCP basics	idrill-33522	<p>Cloud Run nima va qachon Kubernetes o'rniga ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cloud Run — container'ni serverless tarzda ishga tushiradigan managed platforma: siz image berasiz, Google HTTP endpoint, TLS, autoscaling (0 gacha), yangilash va revision'lar bilan trafik bo'lishni o'zi boshqaradi; to'lov ishlatilgan vaqt uchun. Kubernetes (GKE) o'rniga ishlatiladi: stateless HTTP/gRPC servislar, event-driven ishlar (Cloud Run jobs, Pub/Sub/Eventarc), kichik jamoa va cluster boshqarishga resurs yo'q bo'lganda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 5 ta mikroservis uchun GKE cluster, node pool'lar, ingress, upgrade, monitoring — kichik jamoa uchun operatsion yuk mahsulotdan ko'p vaqt oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>gcloud run deploy -&gt; revision (o'zgarmas) -&gt; trafik: rev-5 90% / rev-6 10%<br>so'rovlar ^ -&gt; instance'lar 0 -&gt; N (concurrency: bitta instance'ga 80 so'rov)<br>so'rov yo'q -&gt; 0 instance (min-instances=0 bo'lsa) -&gt; cold start<br>Ostida: Knative API, gVisor/microVM sandbox</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcloud run deploy api --image=europe-docker.pkg.dev/shop/app/api:1.5.0 \<br>  --region=europe-west1 --service-account=api-sa@shop.iam.gserviceaccount.com \<br>  --min-instances=1 --max-instances=50 --concurrency=80 --cpu=1 --memory=512Mi \<br>  --no-allow-unauthenticated --set-secrets=DB_PASS=db-pass:latest<br>gcloud run services update-traffic api --region=europe-west1 --to-revisions=api-00006=10<br>gcloud run services describe api --region=europe-west1<br>gcloud run jobs deploy migrate --image=... &amp;&amp; gcloud run jobs execute migrate</pre><p>| | Cloud Run | GKE | |---|---|---| | Operatsiya | deyarli yo'q | cluster boshqaruvi | | Scale to zero | bor | yo'q (KEDA bilan qisman) | | Stateful, DaemonSet, maxsus tarmoq | cheklangan | to'liq | | Narx | ishlatilgan vaqt | node'lar doimiy |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cold start — latency-sezgir servislarga <code>min-instances</code> qo'ying.</li><li>Default service account (Compute Engine default) — keng Editor huquqi bo'lishi mumkin; har servisga alohida minimal SA.</li><li><code>--allow-unauthenticated</code> ichki servisga — internetga ochiq; ichki servislar uchun IAM invoker yoki ingress <code>internal</code>.</li><li>Instance so'rovsiz paytda CPU cheklanadi (default) — fon ishlari uchun &quot;CPU always allocated&quot; yoki Cloud Run jobs.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Standart yo'l: avval Cloud Run, aniq ehtiyoj (stateful, maxsus tarmoq, GPU sharing, sidecar ko'p, katta masshtabda narx) paydo bo'lganda GKE. Ko'p kompaniyalarda ikkalasi birga yashaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w12 GCP
Interview Drill::Cloud::W12 GCP basics	idrill-33520	<p>GCP'da service account va Workload Identity Federation: kalitsiz autentifikatsiya qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Service account (SA) — GCP'da ilova/mashina uchun identity. Eski usul — SA uchun JSON kalit fayl yaratish (muddatsiz secret, sizish xavfi). <b>Workload Identity Federation (WIF)</b> — tashqi identity provider (GitHub Actions OIDC, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, OIDC/SAML) token'ini GCP STS orqali qisqa muddatli GCP token'iga almashtiradi: kalit fayl umuman yo'q. GKE ichida esa <b>Workload Identity Federation for GKE</b> — K8s ServiceAccount to'g'ridan IAM principal sifatida.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> <code>sa-key.json</code> CI secret'ida, Git tarixida yoki noutbukda — sizsa muddatsiz kirish. Google ham kalit yaratishni Org Policy (<code>iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation</code>) bilan taqiqlashni tavsiya qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GitHub Actions job -&gt; OIDC JWT (repo, ref, environment)<br>  -&gt; GCP STS: Workload Identity Pool + Provider (attribute condition: repo == acme/api)<br>  -&gt; federated token<br>  -&gt; (ixtiyoriy) SA impersonation -&gt; qisqa access token (1 soat)<br>  -&gt; gcloud / terraform</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcloud iam workload-identity-pools create github --location=global<br>gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers create-oidc gh --location=global \<br>  --workload-identity-pool=github --issuer-uri=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \<br>  --attribute-mapping=&quot;google.subject=assertion.sub,attribute.repository=assertion.repository&quot; \<br>  --attribute-condition=&quot;assertion.repository=='acme/api' &amp;&amp; assertion.ref=='refs/heads/main'&quot;<br>gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding deployer@shop.iam.gserviceaccount.com \<br>  --role=roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser \<br>  --member=&quot;principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/123/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github/attribute.repository/acme/api&quot;</pre><pre>- uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2<br>  with:<br>    workload_identity_provider: projects/123/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github/providers/gh<br>    service_account: deployer@shop.iam.gserviceaccount.com</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>attribute-condition</code> yo'q yoki keng — boshqa repo/fork ham token olishi mumkin. Repo, branch, environment bilan cheklang.</li><li>Deployer SA'ga <code>roles/owner</code> yoki <code>editor</code> — minimal rol.</li><li>Mavjud SA kalitlarini o'chirmaslik — federatsiya qo'shildi, lekin eski kalit hali ishlaydi; <code>gcloud iam service-accounts keys list</code> bilan audit.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maqsad — &quot;SA kalitlari nolga&quot;: GCP ichida biriktirilgan SA, GKE'da Workload Identity, tashqarida WIF. Org Policy bilan kalit yaratishni taqiqlab, istisnolarni hujjatlang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w12 GCP
Interview Drill::Cloud::W12 GCP basics	idrill-33521	<p>GKE Autopilot va Standard farqi? Qachon qaysi biri?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>GKE Autopilot</b> — Google node'larni to'liq boshqaradi: siz faqat pod'larni deploy qilasiz va pod request'lari bo'yicha to'laysiz; xavfsizlik best practice'lari majburiy (privileged pod'lar cheklangan), node'larga SSH yo'q. <b>Standard</b> — node pool'larni o'zingiz boshqarasiz (mashina turi, OS, autoscaling, DaemonSet erkinligi), node uchun to'laysiz. Autopilot — ko'p hollarda default tanlov; Standard — node darajasida nazorat kerak bo'lganda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Autopilot:  pod (request: 500m, 1Gi) -&gt; Google mos node'ni o'zi tanlaydi/yaratadi<br>            to'lov = pod request'lari (vCPU, memory, ephemeral) yig'indisi<br>Standard:   siz: node pool e2-standard-4 x 3..10 -&gt; pod'lar joylanadi<br>            to'lov = node'lar (bo'sh joy ham), bin-packing sizning vazifangiz</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcloud container clusters create-auto shop-prod --region=europe-west1 \<br>  --release-channel=regular --enable-private-nodes<br>gcloud container clusters create shop-std --region=europe-west1 \<br>  --num-nodes=1 --machine-type=e2-standard-4 --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=1 --max-nodes=10 \<br>  --workload-pool=shop.svc.id.goog --release-channel=regular<br>kubectl get nodes        # Autopilot'da node'lar ko'rinadi, lekin boshqarib bo'lmaydi</pre><p>| | Autopilot | Standard | |---|---|---| | Node boshqaruvi | Google | siz | | To'lov | pod request | node | | Privileged/hostPath | cheklangan | ruxsat | | Moslashuvchanlik | kamroq | to'liq | | Operatsiya | kam | ko'proq |</p><p><b>Qachon Standard:</b> maxsus kernel/OS sozlamalari, privileged DaemonSet'lar (ba'zi xavfsizlik/monitoring agentlari), juda zich bin-packing bilan narx optimizatsiyasi, maxsus GPU/TPU konfiguratsiyalari, node darajasida debug.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Autopilot'da request'lar minimal qiymatga yaxlitlanadi va request'siz pod'larga default beriladi — kichik pod'lar kutilganidan qimmat bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>Ba'zi uchinchi tomon tool'lar (privileged agent'lar) Autopilot'da ishlamaydi — avval moslik ro'yxatini tekshiring.</li><li>Standard'da node auto-upgrade va PDB'larni sozlamaslik — upgrade'da downtime.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Autopilot &quot;platform jamoasi ishini&quot; Google'ga beradi — kichik/o'rta jamoalar uchun odatda arzonroq umumiy xarajat (odam vaqti hisobga olinsa). Standard'ni faqat aniq texnik yoki iqtisodiy sabab bilan tanlang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w12 GCP
Interview Drill::Cloud::W12 GCP basics	idrill-33523	<p>GCP IAM: basic, predefined va custom role'lar; nega <code>roles/editor</code> xavfli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GCP IAM rollari: <b>basic</b> (Owner, Editor, Viewer — eski, juda keng, minglab ruxsatni qamraydi), <b>predefined</b> (Google tayyorlagan servisga xos: <code>roles/storage.objectViewer</code>, <code>roles/run.developer</code>), <b>custom</b> (o'zingiz tanlagan ruxsatlar to'plami). <code>roles/editor</code> xavfli, chunki deyarli barcha servislarda resurs yaratish/o'zgartirish/o'chirish huquqini beradi — ko'plab sezgir ma'lumot va hisoblash resurslariga, va ba'zi yo'llar bilan huquqni oshirishga (masalan service account sifatida ishlaydigan VM/funksiya yaratish) imkon beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo (himoya):</b> &quot;ishlasin&quot; deb CI service account'iga yoki dasturchiga Editor berildi. Hisob buzilsa — hujumchi project'dagi deyarli hamma narsani o'zgartira yoki o'chira oladi, kripto-mayning VM'lari ishga tushiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Policy binding: member (user/group/SA) + role + (ixtiyoriy) condition<br>  scope: organization &gt; aniq ro'yxat, siz qo'llab-quvvatlaysiz</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcloud projects get-iam-policy shop-prod --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role==&quot;roles/editor&quot;)'<br>gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding shop-prod \<br>  --member=serviceAccount:api-sa@shop-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/storage.objectViewer \<br>  --condition='expression=resource.name.startsWith(&quot;projects/_/buckets/shop-assets&quot;),title=assets-only'<br>gcloud iam roles create deployLimited --project=shop-prod \<br>  --permissions=run.services.get,run.services.update,iam.serviceAccounts.actAs<br>gcloud recommender recommendations list --project=shop-prod --location=global \<br>  --recommender=google.iam.policy.Recommender      # ishlatilmagan ruxsatlarni olib tashlash tavsiyalari</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default Compute Engine SA ko'pincha Editor bilan yaratilgan — VM'lar va ilovalar shu bilan ishlaydi; o'chiring/almashtiring (Org Policy <code>iam.automaticIamGrantsForDefaultServiceAccounts</code>).</li><li><code>iam.serviceAccounts.actAs</code> va <code>iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator</code> — boshqa SA nomidan ishlash; kuchli huquq, ehtiyotkorlik bilan.</li><li>Shaxslarga to'g'ridan rol berish — guruhlarga bering, audit va ishdan ketishda oson.</li><li>Custom role'larni ko'paytirish — yangi ruxsatlar qo'shilganda yangilash kerak; avval predefined'ni qidiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> IAM Recommender va Policy Analyzer bilan &quot;berilgan, lekin ishlatilmagan&quot; ruxsatlarni muntazam qisqartiring; yuqori huquqlarni doimiy emas, PAM/just-in-time bilan bering. Basic rollar faqat sandbox project'larda.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::w12 GCP
Interview Drill::Cloud::W12 GCP basics	idrill-34063	<p>GCP'da Project nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Project — GCP'dagi asosiy tashkiliy birlik: barcha resurslar (VM, bucket, DB, cluster) biror project ichida yaratiladi. Project bilan bog'liq: billing (qaysi hisobga to'lov), yoqilgan API'lar, IAM ruxsatlari, kvotalar. Uch identifikatori bor: <b>project name</b> (o'zgaradi), <b>project ID</b> (global noyob, o'zgarmaydi, buyruqlarda ishlatiladi), <b>project number</b> (Google bergan raqam).</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> dev va prod'ni ajratish, xarajatni aniq hisoblash, jamoaga faqat o'z project'iga ruxsat berish. Bitta project'dagi xato boshqasiga tegmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Organization<br>  +-- Folder: prod<br>        +-- Project: shop-prod-4821 (billing: acme-main)<br>              APIs: compute, container, sqladmin<br>              IAM: team-shop@ -&gt; roles/run.developer<br>              Resurslar: GKE, Cloud SQL, GCS</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcloud projects list<br>gcloud projects create shop-dev-4821 --name=&quot;Shop Dev&quot;<br>gcloud billing projects link shop-dev-4821 --billing-account=0X0X0X-0X0X0X-0X0X0X<br>gcloud config set project shop-dev-4821<br>gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com<br>gcloud projects describe shop-dev-4821<br>gcloud projects delete shop-dev-4821      # 30 kun ichida tiklash mumkin</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>gcloud config</code> dagi joriy project'ni unutib, boshqa project'da buyruq bajarish — skriptlarda <code>--project</code> ni aniq bering.</li><li>Project ID'ni o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi va o'chirilgandan keyin ham qayta ishlatilmaydi.</li><li>Prod project'larda resurs o'chirishdan himoya yo'q — &quot;lien&quot; (<code>gcloud resource-manager liens create</code>) bilan project o'chirilishini bloklang.</li><li>Billing budget yo'q — kutilmagan xarajat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Project'lar avtomatik (Terraform &quot;project factory&quot;) yaratilsin: nom standarti, billing, kerakli API'lar, IAM guruhlari, budget va log eksporti bir marta to'g'ri sozlanadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w12 GCP
Interview Drill::Cloud::W12 GCP basics	idrill-34064	<p>GCP'ning asosiy servislari AWS'da nimaga to'g'ri keladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy mosliklar: <b>Compute Engine</b> = EC2; <b>Cloud Storage (GCS)</b> = S3; <b>Persistent Disk</b> = EBS; <b>Filestore</b> = EFS; <b>VPC</b> = VPC (lekin GCP'da global); <b>Firewall rules</b> = Security Groups; <b>Cloud Load Balancing</b> = ELB/ALB (global anycast); <b>Cloud CDN</b> = CloudFront; <b>Cloud SQL / AlloyDB</b> = RDS / Aurora; <b>Firestore / Bigtable</b> = DynamoDB; <b>BigQuery</b> = Redshift + Athena; <b>GKE</b> = EKS; <b>Cloud Run</b> = App Runner / Fargate; <b>Cloud Functions</b> = Lambda; <b>Pub/Sub</b> = SNS + SQS / Kinesis; <b>IAM</b> = IAM; <b>Secret Manager</b> = Secrets Manager; <b>Cloud KMS</b> = KMS; <b>Artifact Registry</b> = ECR; <b>Cloud Monitoring/Logging</b> = CloudWatch; <b>Cloud DNS</b> = Route 53.</p><p>| Toifa | GCP | AWS | |---|---|---| | Hisob | Project | Account | | VM | Compute Engine | EC2 | | Object storage | Cloud Storage | S3 | | Kubernetes | GKE | EKS | | Serverless container | Cloud Run | App Runner / Fargate | | Funksiya | Cloud Functions | Lambda | | SQL | Cloud SQL, AlloyDB | RDS, Aurora | | Analitik DB | BigQuery | Redshift / Athena | | Messaging | Pub/Sub | SNS/SQS/Kinesis | | Monitoring | Cloud Monitoring/Logging | CloudWatch |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcloud compute instances list          # ~ aws ec2 describe-instances<br>gcloud storage ls                      # ~ aws s3 ls<br>gcloud container clusters list         # ~ aws eks list-clusters<br>gcloud run services list</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>GCP VPC global, subnet'lar regional; AWS'da VPC regional — tarmoq dizayni farqli.</li><li>GCP firewall qoidalari VPC darajasida, network tag yoki SA bo'yicha nishonlanadi — instance'ga biriktiriladigan SG'dan farqli.</li><li>Pub/Sub — bitta servis ikkala naqshni (fan-out va queue) qamraydi.</li><li>Narx modeli farq qiladi (masalan GCP'da sustained use discount avtomatik).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Moslik jadvali — boshlanish nuqtasi. Arxitektura qarorlarida farqlarga e'tibor bering: global VPC va global LB GCP'da multi-region dizaynni soddalashtiradi, BigQuery esa serverless analitikada alohida kuchli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w12 GCP
Interview Drill::Cloud::W12 GCP basics	idrill-34065	<p><code>gcloud</code> bilan autentifikatsiya va VM ro'yxati?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Inson uchun: <code>gcloud auth login</code> (brauzer orqali CLI uchun), <code>gcloud auth application-default login</code> (lokal kod/SDK va Terraform uchun ADC). Interview Drill::Cloud::W12 GCP basics	idrill-34066	<p>GCP'da service account nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Service account (SA) — odam emas, ilova yoki VM uchun GCP identity'si (<code>name@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com</code>). Unga IAM rollari beriladi va resurs (VM, Cloud Run, GKE pod) shu SA nomidan Google API'larga murojaat qiladi. Token'ni platforma o'zi beradi — kodda parol kerak emas.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> ilova GCS'dan fayl o'qishi yoki Pub/Sub'ga xabar yozishi kerak. Shaxsiy hisob bilan ishlatish xavfli va xodim ketsa buziladi; SA esa aniq, minimal huquqli va audit qilinadigan identity.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Cloud Run &quot;api&quot; (SA: api-sa@shop.iam)<br>  -&gt; metadata server: token ber<br>  -&gt; GCS: api-sa'da roles/storage.objectViewer bormi? -&gt; ruxsat<br>Audit log: &quot;api-sa@... storage.objects.get shop-assets/logo.png&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>gcloud iam service-accounts create api-sa --display-name=&quot;API service&quot;<br>gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://shop-assets \<br>  --member=serviceAccount:api-sa@shop-dev-4821.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/storage.objectViewer<br>gcloud run deploy api --image=... --service-account=api-sa@shop-dev-4821.iam.gserviceaccount.com<br>gcloud iam service-accounts list<br>gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=api-sa@shop-dev-4821.iam.gserviceaccount.com   # kalit bo'lmasligi kerak</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default Compute Engine SA'dan foydalanish — u ko'pincha keng (Editor) huquqli va hamma VM'larda bir xil.</li><li>JSON kalit yaratib yuklab olish — muddatsiz secret; Git'ga yoki chatga tushishi oson. Faqat haqiqatan boshqa yo'l bo'lmasa, qisqa muddat bilan.</li><li>Bitta SA'ni ko'p ilovaga berish — biri buzilsa hammasi; har ilovaga alohida SA.</li><li>Ruxsatni bucket o'rniga butun project darajasida berish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Bitta workload — bitta SA — minimal rol — kalitsiz&quot; qoidasi GCP xavfsizligining asosi. SA'ga kim impersonation qila olishini (<code>serviceAccountUser</code>, <code>TokenCreator</code>) ham xuddi rollar kabi audit qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::w12 GCP
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40751	<p>Cloud computing nima va uchta asosiy servis modeli (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cloud computing — server, storage, tarmoq va tayyor servislarni internet orqali <b>talab bo'yicha</b> olib, faqat ishlatganingiz uchun to'lash (pay-as-you-go). Uchta model farqi — <b>kim nimani boshqaradi</b>: IaaS (siz OS'dan yuqorini), PaaS (siz faqat kod va data), SaaS (siz faqat foydalanasiz).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> O'z data center'ingiz bo'lsa — server sotib olish haftalar, quvvat oldindan rejalanadi, ishlatilmagan server ham pul yeydi. Cloud'da 2 daqiqada server olasiz, kerak bo'lmasa o'chirasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (kim boshqaradi):</b></p><pre>            On-prem   IaaS     PaaS     SaaS<br>Ilova        SIZ      SIZ      SIZ      provayder<br>Data         SIZ      SIZ      SIZ      SIZ (qisman)<br>Runtime      SIZ      SIZ      prov.    provayder<br>OS           SIZ      SIZ      prov.    provayder<br>Hypervisor   SIZ      prov.    prov.    provayder<br>Hardware     SIZ      prov.    prov.    provayder</pre><p>| Model | Misol | Siz boshqarasiz | |---|---|---| | IaaS | EC2, Azure VM, GCE | OS, patch, runtime, ilova | | PaaS | Elastic Beanstalk, App Service, App Engine, Cloud Run | kod, config, data | | SaaS | Google Workspace, GitHub, Slack | foydalanuvchilar, ruxsatlar |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># IaaS: VM olasiz, ichini o'zingiz sozlaysiz<br>aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-0abc --instance-type t3.micro<br>ssh ec2-user@IP 'sudo dnf update -y &amp;&amp; sudo dnf install -y nginx'<br><br># PaaS: faqat kodni berasiz<br>gcloud run deploy api --source .   # build, TLS, scaling — provayderda</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Cloud = arzon&quot; emas: doim yoqiq katta VM on-prem'dan qimmat bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li>PaaS'da vendor lock-in kuchliroq — runtime cheklovlari (timeout, disk) bor.</li><li>SaaS'da ham data va access sizning javobgarligingiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tanlov — nazorat va operatsion yuk o'rtasidagi trade-off. Kichik jamoa uchun PaaS/serverless default bo'lsin; IaaS'ga faqat aniq ehtiyoj (maxsus kernel, GPU, litsenziya) bo'lsa tushing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40752	<p>Shared Responsibility Model IaaS, PaaS va Serverless'da qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shared Responsibility Model: provayder <b>cloud'ning o'zi</b> (bino, hardware, hypervisor, global tarmoq) xavfsizligiga, mijoz <b>cloud ichidagi</b> narsalar (data, IAM, tarmoq qoidalari, kod) xavfsizligiga javob beradi. Chegara servis modeliga qarab siljiydi: IaaS'da mijozda ko'p, Serverless'da kam.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ko'p incident &quot;AWS himoya qiladi deb o'ylagandik&quot; dan: public S3 bucket, <code>0.0.0.0/0</code> ga ochiq SSH, patch qilinmagan AMI. Bularning hammasi mijoz tomonida.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>             IaaS (EC2)   PaaS (RDS)   Serverless (Lambda)<br>Data/IAM       MIJOZ        MIJOZ         MIJOZ<br>Ilova kodi     MIJOZ        MIJOZ         MIJOZ<br>Runtime        MIJOZ        provayder     provayder<br>OS patch       MIJOZ        provayder     provayder<br>Tarmoq (SG)    MIJOZ        MIJOZ         MIJOZ (VPC bo'lsa)<br>Hardware       provayder    provayder     provayder</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> mijoz qismini tekshirish:</p><pre># public bucket'lar bormi<br>aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket my-bucket<br># 22-port dunyoga ochiq SG'lar<br>aws ec2 describe-security-groups \<br>  --filters Name=ip-permission.from-port,Values=22 \<br>            Name=ip-permission.cidr,Values=0.0.0.0/0 \<br>  --query 'SecurityGroups[].GroupId'<br># Lambda'da sizning qismingiz: execution role<br>aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name fn --query Role</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>RDS'da OS patch provayderda, lekin <b>minor version upgrade</b> oynasini siz sozlaysiz.</li><li>Shifrlash imkoniyatini provayder beradi, yoqish — sizda.</li><li>Lambda'da OS yo'q, lekin kod dependency'laridagi CVE sizniki.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Javobgarlik chegarasini servis bo'yicha jadvalga yozib qo'ying va guardrail'larni (SCP, Config rule, Security Hub) mijoz qismiga qo'ying. Managed servis tanlash — javobgarlikni provayderga o'tkazishning eng arzon yo'li.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40753	<p>Region, Availability Zone (AZ), Local Zone va Edge Location farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Region</b> — geografik hudud (<code>us-east-1</code>), ichida 3+ <b>AZ</b>. <b>AZ</b> — mustaqil quvvat/tarmoqli bir yoki bir necha data center. <b>Local Zone</b> — region'ning katta shahar yaqinidagi kichik kengaytmasi (past latency). <b>Edge Location</b> — CloudFront/Route 53 kabi servislar uchun foydalanuvchiga yaqin PoP.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta data center yonsa yoki elektr o'chsa, ilova to'xtamasligi kerak (AZ). Butun hudud muammosi yoki qonun talabi (data mamlakat ichida) — region. Foydalanuvchi uzoqda — edge.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Region eu-central-1 (Frankfurt)<br>+-----------------------------------------+<br>|  AZ-a  &lt;--~1-2ms--&gt;  AZ-b  &lt;--&gt;  AZ-c   |<br>|  (DC1,DC2)          (DC3)      (DC4)    |<br>+-----------------------------------------+<br>        |                     \<br>   Local Zone (yaqin shahar)   Edge Location x 600+ (CDN cache, DNS)</pre><p>| Daraja | Maqsad | Misol | |---|---|---| | Region | data rezidentlik, DR | <code>us-east-1</code> | | AZ | HA (bitta DC nosozligi) | <code>us-east-1a</code> | | Local Zone | &lt;10ms latency (gaming, media) | <code>us-east-1-bos-1a</code> | | Edge | cache, DNS, WAF | CloudFront PoP |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 describe-availability-zones --region eu-central-1 \<br>  --query 'AvailabilityZones[].[ZoneName,ZoneId,ZoneType]' --output table</pre><p><code>ZoneId</code> (<code>euc1-az1</code>) muhim: <code>us-east-1a</code> nomi har akkauntda boshqa fizik AZ'ga map bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>AZ'lar orasidagi trafik pullik (~$0.01/GB har yo'nalish) — chatty servislar qimmatga tushadi.</li><li>Hamma servis hamma region'da yo'q; yangi region'lar opt-in.</li><li>Akkauntlar orasida AZ nomi bilan emas, <code>ZoneId</code> bilan solishtiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default — multi-AZ, single-region. Multi-region murakkablikni (data replikatsiya, consistency) 2-3 baravar oshiradi; faqat RTO/RPO yoki qonun talab qilsa qiling.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40754	<p>VPC / VNet nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VPC (AWS) / VNet (Azure) — cloud ichida sizga ajratilgan <b>mantiqan izolyatsiyalangan virtual tarmoq</b>. IP diapazoni (CIDR), subnet'lar, route table, gateway va firewall qoidalarini o'zingiz belgilaysiz.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cloud'da minglab mijoz bir xil fizik tarmoqda. Sizning DB'ingiz boshqa mijoz yoki internetdan ko'rinmasligi kerak — VPC shu chegarani beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>VPC 10.0.0.0/16<br>+---------------------------------------------+<br>| AZ-a                     AZ-b               |<br>| public 10.0.1.0/24       public 10.0.2.0/24 | --&gt; IGW --&gt; internet<br>| private 10.0.11.0/24     private 10.0.12.0/24| --&gt; NAT GW<br>| route tables, SG, NACL                      |<br>+---------------------------------------------+</pre><p>Subnet bitta AZ'da yashaydi; VPC esa region bo'yicha.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>resource &quot;aws_vpc&quot; &quot;main&quot; {<br>  cidr_block           = &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;<br>  enable_dns_hostnames = true<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_subnet&quot; &quot;app_a&quot; {<br>  vpc_id            = aws_vpc.main.id<br>  cidr_block        = &quot;10.0.11.0/24&quot;<br>  availability_zone = &quot;eu-central-1a&quot;<br>}</pre><pre>aws ec2 describe-vpcs --query 'Vpcs[].[VpcId,CidrBlock,IsDefault]'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CIDR'ni kichik tanlash (<code>/24</code>) — keyin EKS pod IP'lari yetmaydi.</li><li>Boshqa VPC/on-prem bilan <b>kesishadigan</b> CIDR — keyin peering/VPN qilib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Default VPC'da prod ishlatish (hamma subnet public).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CIDR'ni tashkilot darajasida IPAM bilan rejalang (masalan har akkauntga <code>/16</code>, kelajakdagi peering uchun kesishmasdan). Bu keyin o'zgartirish eng qimmat qarorlardan biri.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40755	<p>Public subnet va private subnet farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Farq <b>route table'da</b>: public subnet'da <code>0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; Internet Gateway</code>, private subnet'da <code>0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; NAT Gateway</code> (yoki umuman default route yo'q). Shuning uchun private'dagi resursga internetdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kirib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Load balancer internetdan ko'rinishi kerak, DB va app server'lar esa yo'q. Lekin app server <code>apt update</code> yoki tashqi API uchun chiqishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>internet<br>   ^ v<br>  IGW<br>   |<br>[public subnet]  ALB, NAT GW, (bastion)<br>   |  route: 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; igw-xxx<br>   v<br>[private subnet] app, DB<br>      route: 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; nat-xxx   (faqat chiquvchi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># subnet qaysi route table'ga bog'langan va default route qayerga<br>aws ec2 describe-route-tables \<br>  --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-0abc \<br>  --query 'RouteTables[].Routes[?DestinationCidrBlock==`0.0.0.0/0`]'</pre><p><code>GatewayId: igw-...</code> bo'lsa public, <code>NatGatewayId: nat-...</code> bo'lsa private.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Public subnet'dagi instance'ga public IP berilmasa, IGW bo'lsa ham internetga chiqolmaydi.</li><li>NAT Gateway public subnet'da turishi kerak, private'da emas.</li><li>&quot;Private&quot; — bu xavfsizlik kafolati emas; SG qoidalari baribir kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatiy 3 qatlam: public (faqat LB/NAT), private-app, isolated-data (default route yo'q). NAT xarajatini kamaytirish uchun S3/DynamoDB'ga gateway endpoint qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40756	<p>Internet Gateway (IGW) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Internet Gateway (IGW) — VPC'ni internetga ulaydigan, AWS boshqaradigan, gorizontal scale bo'ladigan va redundant komponent. Public IP'li resurslar uchun 1:1 NAT qiladi; bandwidth cheklovi va to'lovi yo'q (trafik o'zi pullik).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> VPC default'da yopiq. Veb-sayt internetdan kirilishi uchun chiqish/kirish nuqtasi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>EC2 (10.0.1.5, public 3.120.4.7)<br>   |  paket src=10.0.1.5<br>   v<br>route 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; igw<br>   v<br>IGW: src 10.0.1.5 -&gt; 3.120.4.7 (1:1 NAT)<br>   v<br>internet</pre><p>Bitta VPC'ga bitta IGW. Instance o'z OS'ida public IP'ni ko'rmaydi — tarjimani IGW qiladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>IGW=$(aws ec2 create-internet-gateway --query InternetGateway.InternetGatewayId --output text)<br>aws ec2 attach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IGW --vpc-id vpc-0abc<br>aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0pub \<br>  --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id $IGW</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>IGW ulangan, lekin route qo'shilmagan — trafik yurmaydi.</li><li>Instance'da public/Elastic IP yo'q — IGW tarjima qila olmaydi.</li><li>IPv6 uchun faqat chiquvchi kerak bo'lsa — <b>Egress-only IGW</b> ishlatiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> IGW o'zi xavfsizlik chegarasi emas, faqat yo'l. Kim ochiq bo'lishini SG/NACL va qaysi subnet'ga route berilganligi hal qiladi. 2024-dan beri public IPv4 manzil ham soatbay pullik — kerak bo'lmasa bermang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40757	<p>NAT Gateway va NAT Instance farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>NAT Gateway</b> — AWS boshqaradigan, 100 Gbps gacha avtomatik scale bo'ladigan, AZ ichida HA servis; soat + GB uchun to'lov. <b>NAT Instance</b> — iptables MASQUERADE qiladigan oddiy EC2: arzon, lekin patch, scaling va failover sizda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Private subnet'dagi server tashqi API'ga chiqishi kerak, lekin internetdan unga kirish bo'lmasligi kerak — buni NAT hal qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>private app 10.0.11.7 --&gt; NAT (public subnet, EIP 18.1.2.3) --&gt; IGW --&gt; internet<br>javob: internet --&gt; 18.1.2.3:port --&gt; NAT jadvali --&gt; 10.0.11.7</pre><p>| | NAT Gateway | NAT Instance | |---|---|---| | Boshqaruv | AWS | siz (AMI, patch) | | Bandwidth | 5 -&gt; 100 Gbps auto | instance turiga bog'liq | | HA | AZ ichida; har AZ'ga bittadan qo'ying | skript bilan failover | | SG | qo'llanmaydi | qo'llanadi | | Narx | ~$0.045/soat + $0.045/GB | instance narxi |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id subnet-pub-a --allocation-id eipalloc-0abc<br>aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-priv-a \<br>  --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0abc</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta NAT GW'ni hamma AZ ishlatsa: o'sha AZ yiqilsa hammasi uziladi + cross-AZ trafik to'lovi.</li><li>S3'ga trafik NAT orqali o'tib katta GB to'lovi — gateway endpoint qo'ying.</li><li>NAT Instance'da source/dest check'ni o'chirish esdan chiqadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod'da har AZ'ga NAT GW. Hisobda &quot;NatGateway-Bytes&quot; katta bo'lsa — VPC Flow Logs bilan kim ishlatayotganini toping; ko'pincha S3/ECR trafigi, endpoint bilan bepul qilinadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40758	<p>Security Group va Network ACL (NACL) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Security Group</b> — ENI/instance darajasida, <b>stateful</b>, faqat Allow qoidalari. <b>NACL</b> — subnet darajasida, <b>stateless</b>, Allow va Deny, raqam tartibida birinchi mos kelgan qoida ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Instance'ni himoyalash uchun SG yetarli; lekin butun subnet uchun ma'lum IP'ni <b>bloklash</b> kerak bo'lsa (SG'da Deny yo'q) — NACL.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>internet -&gt; [NACL subnet chegarasi: in qoidasi] -&gt; [SG instance: in qoidasi] -&gt; app<br>app -&gt; [SG: javob avtomatik ruxsat] -&gt; [NACL: OUT qoidasi kerak! 1024-65535] -&gt; internet</pre><p>Stateful = SG ulanishni eslaydi, javobga alohida qoida kerak emas. Stateless = NACL har paketni alohida tekshiradi.</p><p>| | SG | NACL | |---|---|---| | Daraja | ENI | subnet | | Holat | stateful | stateless | | Qoidalar | faqat Allow | Allow + Deny | | Baholash | hammasi birga | raqam bo'yicha, birinchi mos | | Manba | CIDR yoki boshqa SG | faqat CIDR |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># SG: faqat ALB SG'dan 8080<br>aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-app \<br>  --protocol tcp --port 8080 --source-group sg-alb<br># NACL: yomon IP'ni bloklash<br>aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0abc --ingress \<br>  --rule-number 50 --protocol -1 --cidr-block 203.0.113.9/32 --rule-action deny</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NACL'da ephemeral portlar (1024-65535) OUT ochilmasa — javoblar yo'qoladi.</li><li>SG'da Deny yo'q — &quot;bloklash&quot; uchun SG ishlamaydi.</li><li>NACL qoida raqamlari oralig'ini (10, 20...) qoldirmaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asosiy nazorat SG'da, SG-to-SG reference bilan (IP emas). NACL'ni default holatda qoldirib, faqat qo'pol subnet chegaralari uchun ishlating — murakkab NACL debug'ni og'irlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40759	<p>VPC peering nima va cheklovlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VPC peering — ikki VPC'ni AWS ichki tarmog'i orqali private IP bilan bog'lash (bir yoki boshqa akkaunt/region). Cheklovlar: <b>tranzitiv emas</b>, CIDR'lar <b>kesishmasligi</b> shart, N VPC uchun N(N-1)/2 ulanish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>shared-services</code> VPC'dagi monitoring <code>app</code> VPC'dagi server'larga private IP bilan yetishi kerak, internetga chiqmasdan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>VPC-A 10.0.0.0/16 &lt;==pcx==&gt; VPC-B 10.1.0.0/16 &lt;==pcx==&gt; VPC-C 10.2.0.0/16<br>A -&gt; C : YO'Q (B orqali o'tmaydi, tranzitiv emas)<br>Ikki tomonda ham route table'ga yozuv kerak.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 create-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-id vpc-A --peer-vpc-id vpc-B<br>aws ec2 accept-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc<br>aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-A --destination-cidr-block 10.1.0.0/16 \<br>  --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc<br>aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-B --destination-cidr-block 10.0.0.0/16 \<br>  --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc</pre><p>SG'larda ham peer CIDR'ga ruxsat bering.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat accept qilib, route qo'shmaslik — &quot;ulandi, lekin ping yo'q&quot;.</li><li>10 ta VPC = 45 peering — boshqarib bo'lmaydi.</li><li>Peering orqali boshqa VPC'ning IGW/NAT'idan foydalanib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 2-3 VPC uchun peering eng arzon va tez (bir AZ ichida trafik to'lovi yo'q). Ko'proq bo'lsa yoki markaziy firewall kerak bo'lsa — Transit Gateway; faqat bitta servisni ochish kerak bo'lsa — PrivateLink.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40760	<p>AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Transit Gateway (TGW) — region darajasidagi boshqariladigan <b>hub router</b>: yuzlab VPC, VPN va Direct Connect'ni bitta markazga ulaydi va ular orasida <b>tranzitiv</b> routing beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 30 ta VPC'ni peering bilan full mesh qilish = 435 ulanish. On-prem VPN'ni ham har VPC'ga alohida ulash kerak bo'lardi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>        VPC-A   VPC-B   VPC-C<br>           \      |      /<br>            [ Transit Gateway ] -- route tables (segmentatsiya)<br>           /      |       \<br>     VPN on-prem  DX GW   Inspection VPC (firewall)</pre><p>Har ulanish — attachment. TGW route table'lari bilan &quot;prod dev'ni ko'rmasin&quot; kabi segmentatsiya qilinadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 create-transit-gateway --description core \<br>  --options DefaultRouteTableAssociation=disable,DefaultRouteTablePropagation=disable<br>aws ec2 create-transit-gateway-vpc-attachment --transit-gateway-id tgw-0abc \<br>  --vpc-id vpc-A --subnet-ids subnet-a1 subnet-a2<br># VPC tomonida<br>aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-A --destination-cidr-block 10.0.0.0/8 \<br>  --transit-gateway-id tgw-0abc</pre><p>Organization bo'ylab ulashish — AWS RAM orqali.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Narx: har attachment soatbay + har GB uchun ($0.02/GB) — katta trafikda sezilarli.</li><li>Default route table hammani hamma bilan bog'laydi — segmentatsiya yo'qoladi.</li><li>Attachment subnet'ini har AZ'da bermaslik — o'sha AZ trafigi yetib bormaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> TGW — landing zone'ning markaziy qismi: markaziy egress va inspection VPC (Network Firewall) bilan. Yuqori hajmli ikki VPC orasida baribir to'g'ridan-to'g'ri peering qo'yish mumkin — arzonroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40761	<p>AWS PrivateLink nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PrivateLink — bitta <b>servisni</b> boshqa VPC'ga sizning subnet'ingizdagi <b>private IP'li ENI (interface endpoint)</b> orqali ochish. Trafik internetga chiqmaydi, ikki VPC tarmog'i umuman birlashmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> SaaS provayder yoki boshqa jamoa servisiga ulanish kerak, lekin butun VPC'ni peering qilish (va CIDR kesishmasligini ta'minlash) ortiqcha va xavfli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Consumer VPC (10.0.0.0/16)            Provider VPC (10.0.0.0/16 ham bo'lishi mumkin!)<br>app --&gt; ENI 10.0.11.50 (endpoint) ===PrivateLink===&gt; NLB --&gt; servis<br>     DNS: api.vendor.com -&gt; 10.0.11.50</pre><p>Bir tomonlama: consumer provider'ga ulanadi, teskarisi yo'q.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># AWS servisi uchun (masalan ECR, STS, SSM)<br>aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0abc --vpc-endpoint-type Interface \<br>  --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.ecr.api \<br>  --subnet-ids subnet-a subnet-b --security-group-ids sg-endpoint \<br>  --private-dns-enabled</pre><p>Provider tomoni: NLB oldiga <code>create-vpc-endpoint-service-configuration</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Endpoint SG'si 443'ni app SG'dan ochmasa — timeout.</li><li><code>private-dns-enabled</code> o'chiq — app hali public endpoint'ga boradi.</li><li>Har endpoint har AZ'da soatbay pullik — 20 servis x 3 AZ tez yig'iladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PrivateLink — &quot;servis darajasidagi&quot; ulanish, eng kam ruxsat printsipiga mos. Ko'p akkauntda interface endpoint'larni markaziy shared VPC'da qo'yib, Route 53 orqali ulashish xarajatni kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40762	<p>Gateway VPC Endpoint nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Gateway VPC Endpoint — <b>faqat S3 va DynamoDB</b> uchun, route table'ga qo'shiladigan <b>bepul</b> yozuv. Private subnet bu servislarga NAT yoki public IP'siz, AWS ichki tarmog'i orqali chiqadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Private subnet'dagi ETL kuniga 5 TB S3'ga yozadi. NAT GW orqali bo'lsa ~$0.045/GB = oyiga minglab dollar. Gateway endpoint bilan — $0.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>private app --&gt; route table:<br>   pl-6ea54007 (S3 prefix list) -&gt; vpce-0abc   &lt;-- gateway endpoint<br>   0.0.0.0/0                    -&gt; nat-0abc<br>S3 trafigi NAT'ga umuman bormaydi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0abc \<br>  --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.s3 \<br>  --route-table-ids rtb-priv-a rtb-priv-b</pre><p>Endpoint policy bilan faqat o'z bucket'laringizga ruxsat:</p><pre>{&quot;Statement&quot;:[{&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Allow&quot;,&quot;Principal&quot;:&quot;*&quot;,&quot;Action&quot;:&quot;s3:*&quot;,<br>  &quot;Resource&quot;:[&quot;arn:aws:s3:::corp-*&quot;,&quot;arn:aws:s3:::corp-*/*&quot;]}]}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat shu region'dagi S3 ishlaydi; boshqa region bucket'i hali NAT orqali.</li><li>On-prem yoki peered VPC gateway endpoint'dan foydalana olmaydi — ular uchun S3 <b>interface</b> endpoint (pullik).</li><li>Bucket policy'da <code>aws:SourceVpce</code> cheklovi qo'yilsa, konsol kirishi ham bloklanishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har yangi VPC shabloniga S3 va DynamoDB gateway endpoint'ini default qo'shing — bu cloud'dagi eng oson &quot;bepul&quot; tejash va data exfiltration'ni endpoint policy bilan cheklash vositasi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40763	<p>ALB, NLB va GWLB farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ALB</b> — L7 (HTTP/HTTPS/gRPC), host/path bo'yicha routing. <b>NLB</b> — L4 (TCP/UDP/TLS), juda past latency, statik IP, client IP saqlanadi. <b>GWLB</b> — L3, trafikni firewall/IDS appliance'lari orqali shaffof o'tkazadi (GENEVE).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta domen ostida <code>/api</code> va <code>/web</code> turli servisga borishi kerak (ALB). O'yin server UDP va statik IP kerak (NLB). Barcha trafik Palo Alto firewall'dan o'tishi kerak (GWLB).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ALB:  client --HTTPS--&gt; ALB (TLS tugaydi, header o'qiladi) --&gt; /api -&gt; TG-api<br>                                                           --&gt; host=admin -&gt; TG-admin<br>NLB:  client --TCP--&gt; NLB (paketni ochmaydi) --&gt; target (src IP = client)<br>GWLB: VPC trafik --&gt; GWLB endpoint --&gt; GWLB --GENEVE--&gt; firewall fleet --&gt; qaytadi</pre><p>| | ALB | NLB | GWLB | |---|---|---|---| | Qatlam | L7 | L4 | L3 | | Protokol | HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket | TCP, UDP, TLS | IP | | Statik IP | yo'q (DNS) | ha, har AZ | - | | WAF | ha | yo'q | - |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws elbv2 create-rule --listener-arn $LISTENER --priority 10 \<br>  --conditions Field=path-pattern,Values='/api/*' \<br>  --actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=$TG_API</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>ALB orqasida client IP faqat <code>X-Forwarded-For</code> da — log'da ALB IP'ni ko'rasiz.</li><li>NLB'da endi SG qo'llash mumkin (2023+), lekin default'da yo'q — target SG'ni to'g'ri ochish kerak.</li><li>Health check yo'li noto'g'ri — barcha target unhealthy.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HTTP servis uchun default — ALB (WAF, routing, auth). NLB — non-HTTP, juda yuqori RPS, PrivateLink provider yoki statik IP talab qilinganda. Ikkalasi zanjiri (NLB -&gt; ALB) statik IP + L7 uchun ishlatiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40764	<p>EBS, S3 va EFS farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>EBS</b> — bitta EC2'ga ulanadigan block disk (bitta AZ). <b>S3</b> — HTTP API orqali obyekt storage, cheksiz, 11 to'qqizlik durability. <b>EFS</b> — ko'p instance bir vaqtda mount qiladigan managed NFS (POSIX).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB uchun tez lokal disk kerak (EBS). Rasmlar va backup uchun arzon cheksiz joy (S3). 10 ta web server bitta umumiy papkani ko'rishi kerak (EFS).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>EBS:  EC2 --(block, /dev/nvme1n1)--&gt; volume (1 AZ, odatda 1 instance)<br>S3:   har kim --HTTPS PUT/GET--&gt; bucket/key (region, 3+ AZ)<br>EFS:  EC2 x N --NFSv4.1--&gt; mount target (har AZ) --&gt; fayl tizimi</pre><p>| | EBS | S3 | EFS | |---|---|---|---| | Turi | block | object | file (NFS) | | Kirish | 1 EC2 (io2 multi-attach istisno) | HTTP API | ko'p client | | Latency | sub-ms | ~10-100ms | ms | | Narx/GB | ~$0.08 (gp3) | ~$0.023 | ~$0.30 (Standard) | | K8s | ReadWriteOnce | - | ReadWriteMany |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 create-volume --size 100 --volume-type gp3 --availability-zone eu-central-1a<br>aws s3 cp backup.tar.gz s3://corp-backups/2026/<br>sudo mount -t efs fs-0abc:/ /mnt/shared   # amazon-efs-utils</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>EBS boshqa AZ'dagi instance'ga ulanmaydi — snapshot orqali ko'chirish kerak.</li><li>S3'ni fayl tizimi deb ishlatish (append, rename yo'q; Mountpoint ham to'liq POSIX emas).</li><li>EFS'da ko'p kichik faylli build — sekin va qimmat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default qoida: holat (state) — managed DB yoki S3'da, EBS faqat haqiqatan lokal disk kerak bo'lsa. Shared fayl tizimi (EFS) ko'pincha arxitektura hidi — S3 + obyekt API ko'proq scale bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40765	<p>EBS volume turlari (gp3, io2 Block Express, st1, sc1) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>gp3</b> — umumiy SSD (3000 IOPS / 125 MB/s bazaviy, alohida oshiriladi). <b>io2 Block Express</b> — kritik DB uchun 256K IOPS gacha, sub-ms latency, 99.999% durability. <b>st1</b> — ketma-ket katta o'qish uchun throughput HDD. <b>sc1</b> — eng arzon cold HDD.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Noto'g'ri tur — yo pul isrof (hamma joyda io2), yo sekin DB (gp2 kichik hajmda IOPS yetmaydi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><p>| Tur | Media | Maks IOPS | Maks MB/s | Ishlatish | |---|---|---|---|---| | gp3 | SSD | 16 000 (yangi: 80 000) | 1 000 (yangi: 2 000) | boot, app, ko'p DB | | io2 BE | SSD | 256 000 | 4 000 | Oracle, SAP, katta Postgres | | st1 | HDD | 500 | 500 | log, Kafka, big data | | sc1 | HDD | 250 | 250 | arxiv, kam kirish |</p><p>gp2'da IOPS hajmga bog'langan edi (3 IOPS/GB); gp3'da mustaqil va ~20% arzon.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># gp2 -&gt; gp3, downtime'siz<br>aws ec2 modify-volume --volume-id vol-0abc --volume-type gp3 --iops 6000 --throughput 250<br>aws ec2 describe-volumes-modifications --volume-id vol-0abc<br># ichida yuklamani ko'rish<br>iostat -x 1   # r/s + w/s ~ IOPS, %util, await</pre><p>CloudWatch: <code>VolumeQueueLength</code> doim yuqori bo'lsa — IOPS yetmayapti.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Instance turi ham EBS bandwidth limitiga ega — katta volume, kichik instance = baribir sekin.</li><li>st1/sc1 boot volume bo'la olmaydi.</li><li><code>modify-volume</code> dan keyin 6 soat qayta o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hamma gp2'ni gp3'ga o'tkazish — deyarli har audit'da birinchi tejash. io2'ga faqat o'lchangan IOPS/latency talab bilan o'ting; ko'p hollarda managed DB (Aurora) bu savolni yo'q qiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40766	<p>EC2 IMDSv2 nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> IMDSv2 — EC2 metadata servisi (<code>169.254.169.254</code>) ning session'li versiyasi: avval <code>PUT</code> bilan token olinadi, keyin har so'rov shu token header bilan. Bu <b>SSRF</b> orqali IAM credential o'g'irlashni deyarli imkonsiz qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 2019 Capital One incident: ilovadagi SSRF orqali hujumchi <code>http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/role</code> ni GET qilib role kalitlarini oldi. IMDSv1'da oddiy GET yetarli edi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1) PUT /latest/api/token<br>   X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600   --&gt; TOKEN<br>2) GET /latest/meta-data/...<br>   X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: TOKEN               --&gt; ma'lumot<br>SSRF odatda faqat GET, custom header qo'yolmaydi -&gt; bloklanadi.<br>Hop limit=1: paket bitta hop'dan o'tmaydi -&gt; container ichidan (qo'shimcha hop) kirib bo'lmaydi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>TOKEN=$(curl -sX PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token \<br>  -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300')<br>curl -s -H &quot;X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN&quot; \<br>  http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id<br><br># Majburiy qilish<br>aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-options --instance-id i-0abc \<br>  --http-tokens required --http-put-response-hop-limit 1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eski SDK/agent'lar faqat v1 ishlatadi — <code>required</code> qilishdan oldin CloudWatch <code>MetadataNoToken</code> metrikasini tekshiring.</li><li>EKS'da hop limit=1 pod'larni ham bloklaydi — bu yaxshi, pod'lar IRSA/Pod Identity ishlatsin.</li><li>Faqat launch template'da emas, account default'ida ham yoqing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Organization darajasida <code>ec2:MetadataHttpTokens=required</code> SCP sharti va akkaunt default'i bilan v1'ni butunlay taqiqlang. 2024+ yangi AMI'lar (AL2023) default'da v2.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40767	<p>AWS Auto Scaling va ASG nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> EC2 Auto Scaling — Auto Scaling Group (ASG) dagi instance sonini metrika yoki jadvalga qarab <code>min</code>/<code>max</code> oralig'ida avtomatik o'zgartiradi va nosoz instance'ni almashtiradi. Maqsad — yetarli quvvat, eng past narxda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kunduzi 20 server kerak, kechasi 3 ta. Qo'lda boshqarsangiz yo pul isrof, yo cho'qqida sayt yiqiladi. Bitta server o'lsa ham kimdir uni qayta yaratishi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Launch Template (AMI, tur, user-data, SG)<br>        v<br>ASG: min=2 desired=4 max=20, subnet'lar 3 AZ<br>        |  health check (EC2 yoki ELB) --&gt; unhealthy -&gt; terminate + yangi<br>        |  scaling policy (CPU 60%) --&gt; desired o'zgaradi<br>        v<br>Target Group (ALB) ga avtomatik register</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name web \<br>  --launch-template LaunchTemplateName=web,Version='$Latest' \<br>  --min-size 2 --max-size 20 --desired-capacity 4 \<br>  --vpc-zone-identifier &quot;subnet-a,subnet-b,subnet-c&quot; \<br>  --target-group-arns $TG --health-check-type ELB --health-check-grace-period 120<br>aws autoscaling describe-scaling-activities --auto-scaling-group-name web --max-items 5</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>health-check-type EC2</code> — ilova o'lgan, lekin VM tirik; ELB health check ishlating.</li><li>Instance'da state (lokal fayl, sessiya) — scale-in'da yo'qoladi.</li><li>Uzun boot (10 daqiqa) — cho'qqiga kech qoladi; warm pool yoki tezroq AMI.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ASG — &quot;cattle&quot; modeli: instance'lar bir xil va istalgan payt o'ladi. Yangilanish uchun Instance Refresh ishlating, qo'lda SSH emas. K8s'da shu rolni Karpenter/Cluster Autoscaler o'ynaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40768	<p>Auto Scaling policy turlari (Target Tracking, Step, Scheduled, Predictive) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Target Tracking</b> — metrikani maqsadda ushlaydi (CPU 60%). <b>Step</b> — alarm chegarasiga qarab qadam-qadam qo'shadi. <b>Scheduled</b> — vaqt jadvali bo'yicha. <b>Predictive</b> — ML bilan kunlik naqshni bashorat qilib oldindan scale qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Trafik turi har xil: silliq o'sish (target tracking), keskin portlash (step), ma'lum aksiya vaqti (scheduled), har kuni 9:00 dagi takroriy cho'qqi (predictive).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Target tracking: CPU 80% &gt; 60% maqsad --&gt; desired = ceil(cur * 80/60)<br>Step:  CPU 70-85% -&gt; +2;  85%+ -&gt; +5<br>Scheduled: 08:30 da min=10, 20:00 da min=2<br>Predictive: o'tgan 14 kun naqshi --&gt; 09:00 dan oldin oldindan ko'tarish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws autoscaling put-scaling-policy --auto-scaling-group-name web \<br>  --policy-name cpu60 --policy-type TargetTrackingScaling \<br>  --target-tracking-configuration '{<br>    &quot;PredefinedMetricSpecification&quot;:{&quot;PredefinedMetricType&quot;:&quot;ASGAverageCPUUtilization&quot;},<br>    &quot;TargetValue&quot;:60}'<br>aws autoscaling put-scheduled-update-group-action --auto-scaling-group-name web \<br>  --scheduled-action-name morning --recurrence &quot;30 8 * * MON-FRI&quot; --min-size 10</pre><p><code>ALBRequestCountPerTarget</code> ko'pincha CPU'dan yaxshiroq signal.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Scale-in juda agressiv — flapping (yoqildi-o'chdi). Cooldown/warmup to'g'ri bo'lsin.</li><li>Predictive'ni avval <code>ForecastOnly</code> rejimda sinamasdan yoqish.</li><li>Ilova bottleneck'i DB bo'lsa, app scale qilish yordam bermaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Odatiy kombinatsiya: Target Tracking (asos) + Scheduled/Predictive (ma'lum cho'qqilar). Metrika so'rov soni yoki queue chuqurligi bo'lsin — CPU kech signal.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40769	<p>Spot instance nima va Spot Fleet qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Spot — AWS'ning bo'sh quvvati, On-Demand'dan <b>90% gacha arzon</b>, lekin AWS uni <b>2 daqiqa ogohlantirish</b> bilan qaytarib olishi mumkin. Spot Fleet (va zamonaviy usul — ASG mixed instances / EC2 Fleet) ko'p turdagi instance va AZ'lardan sig'imni yig'ib, uzilish xavfini taqsimlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI runner'lar, batch, stateless web'ga On-Demand narxini to'lash isrof. Lekin bitta Spot turi qaytarilsa hamma birdan o'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Target: 20 vCPU<br>pool: m5.large/a, m5a.large/b, m6i.large/c, c5.xlarge/a ...<br>strategy: price-capacity-optimized --&gt; eng chuqur, arzon pool'lar<br>interrupt --&gt; 2 min notice (IMDS + EventBridge) --&gt; drain --&gt; yangi pool'dan almashtirish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># instance ichida uzilish xabarini kuzatish<br>TOKEN=$(curl -sX PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 60')<br>curl -s -H &quot;X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN&quot; \<br>  http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/spot/instance-action<br># 404 = hammasi joyida; JSON {&quot;action&quot;:&quot;terminate&quot;,&quot;time&quot;:...} = 2 daqiqa qoldi</pre><p>ASG: <code>MixedInstancesPolicy</code> — <code>OnDemandBaseCapacity=2</code>, qolgani Spot, 10+ instance turi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta instance turi — tez-tez <code>InsufficientInstanceCapacity</code>.</li><li>State'li ishni (DB) Spot'da ishlatish.</li><li><code>lowest-price</code> strategiyasi — eng ko'p uziladigan pool'lar; <code>price-capacity-optimized</code> ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Spot'ga mos workload: stateless, idempotent, checkpoint qila oladigan. K8s'da Karpenter + node termination handler bilan Spot'ni 60-80% gacha ishlatish odatiy; kritik qism On-Demand baza ustida turadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40770	<p>Savings Plans va Reserved Instances farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi — 1 yoki 3 yilga majburiyat evaziga chegirma. <b>Savings Plans</b> — soatlik $ sarf majburiyati; Compute SP EC2/Fargate/Lambda'ga, istalgan region/oila/OS'ga avtomatik qo'llanadi (~66% gacha). <b>Reserved Instances</b> — aniq instance oilasi/region'ga bog'langan; Standard RI chegirmasi biroz yuqoriroq (72% gacha), moslashuvchanlik kam.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Doim ishlaydigan baza yuklama (masalan 40 vCPU 24/7) uchun On-Demand to'lash — yiliga katta isrof.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Majburiyat: $10/soat Compute SP<br>Soatlik sarf $14 --&gt; birinchi $10 (On-Demand ekvivalenti) chegirma bilan, qolgan $4 On-Demand<br>Soatlik sarf $7  --&gt; baribir $10 to'laysiz (ishlatilmagan majburiyat kuyadi)</pre><p>| | Compute SP | EC2 Instance SP | Standard RI | Convertible RI | |---|---|---|---|---| | Chegirma | ~66% | ~72% | ~72% | ~54% | | Region o'zgartirish | ha | yo'q | yo'q | yo'q | | Fargate/Lambda | ha | yo'q | yo'q | yo'q | | RDS/ElastiCache | yo'q | yo'q | ha (o'z RI'si) | - |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ce get-savings-plans-purchase-recommendation \<br>  --savings-plans-type COMPUTE_SP --term-in-years ONE_YEAR \<br>  --payment-option NO_UPFRONT --lookback-period-in-days THIRTY_DAYS<br>aws ce get-savings-plans-utilization --time-period Start=2026-09-01,End=2026-10-01</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cho'qqi yuklamaga majburiyat olish — ishlatilmagan qism pul kuydiradi.</li><li>RDS, ElastiCache, OpenSearch uchun SP yo'q (Database Savings Plans 2025 dan cheklangan) — ular uchun RI.</li><li>Arxitektura o'zgarishi (Graviton'ga o'tish) EC2 Instance SP'ni foydasiz qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval rightsizing va Spot, keyin barqaror minimumning ~70-80% iga Compute SP. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40773	<p>AWS EKS nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Amazon EKS — AWS boshqaradigan sertifikatlangan Kubernetes. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40774	<p>AWS Lambda va uning execution modeli qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Lambda — event'ga (S3 upload, API Gateway, SQS xabari) javoban kodingizni ishga tushiradigan serverless compute. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40775	<p>Lambda cold start nima va qanday kamaytiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cold start — yangi execution environment yaratish kechikishi: microVM, runtime start, kodni yuklash, INIT kodi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40776	<p>Amazon Aurora nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Amazon Aurora — MySQL va PostgreSQL bilan mos, cloud uchun qayta yozilgan relational DB. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40777	<p>Aurora Serverless v2 nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Aurora Serverless v2 — Aurora instance'ining sig'imini <b>ACU</b> (1 ACU ~ 2 GB RAM + mos CPU) larda yuklamaga qarab soniyalar ichida, ulanishlarni uzmasdan oshirib-tushiradi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40778	<p>Amazon DynamoDB nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DynamoDB — AWS'ning to'liq boshqariladigan serverless key-value/document NoSQL bazasi: istalgan hajmda bir xonali ms latency, 3 AZ replikatsiya, PITR backup, Global Tables (multi-region active-active).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Sessiya, savatcha, IoT event kabi juda ko'p oddiy key bo'yicha o'qish/yozish — relational DB'ni bunga scale qilish qimmat va murakkab.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Item: PK (partition key) [+ SK (sort key)] + atributlar (&lt;=400KB)<br>hash(PK) --&gt; partition (har biri ~3000 RCU / 1000 WCU, 10GB)<br>Query: bitta PK ichida SK bo'yicha (tez)<br>Scan: butun jadval (qimmat, sekin)<br>GSI: boshqa kalit bo'yicha ko'rinish (eventual)</pre><p>Rejim: On-Demand (so'rov bo'yicha to'lov) yoki Provisioned (+auto scaling).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws dynamodb put-item --table-name Orders \<br>  --item '{&quot;PK&quot;:{&quot;S&quot;:&quot;USER#42&quot;},&quot;SK&quot;:{&quot;S&quot;:&quot;ORDER#2026-10-03#981&quot;},&quot;total&quot;:{&quot;N&quot;:&quot;120&quot;}}'<br>aws dynamodb query --table-name Orders \<br>  --key-condition-expression 'PK = :u AND begins_with(SK, :p)' \<br>  --expression-attribute-values '{&quot;:u&quot;:{&quot;S&quot;:&quot;USER#42&quot;},&quot;:p&quot;:{&quot;S&quot;:&quot;ORDER#2026-10&quot;}}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hot partition — bitta PK'ga ko'p trafik (masalan <code>status=ACTIVE</code>) throttle bo'ladi.</li><li>Scan'ni prod yo'lida ishlatish — sekin va qimmat.</li><li>Ad-hoc query, JOIN, agregatsiya yo'q — keyin analitika uchun export kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DynamoDB'ni access pattern'lardan boshlab loyihalang, jadval sxemasidan emas. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40779	<p>DynamoDB single-table design nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Single-table design — bir nechta entity'ni (user, order, item) <b>bitta</b> DynamoDB jadvalida umumiy <code>PK</code>/<code>SK</code> va GSI'lar bilan saqlash, shunda bog'liq ma'lumot bitta <code>Query</code> bilan olinadi. Shart: access pattern'lar oldindan aniq bo'lishi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DynamoDB'da JOIN yo'q. Har entity alohida jadvalda bo'lsa, &quot;user va uning oxirgi 10 buyurtmasi&quot; uchun bir necha so'rov kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PK          SK                    atributlar<br>USER#42     PROFILE               name, email<br>USER#42     ORDER#2026-10-01#7    total, status<br>USER#42     ORDER#2026-10-03#9    total, status<br>ORDER#9     ITEM#1                sku, qty<br>GSI1: GSI1PK=status#PENDING, GSI1SK=createdAt  --&gt; &quot;kutayotgan buyurtmalar&quot;<br>Query PK=USER#42 --&gt; profil + buyurtmalar bitta so'rovda</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> avval pattern ro'yxati:</p><pre>1. User profilini ol           -&gt; PK=USER#id, SK=PROFILE<br>2. User buyurtmalari (yangi)   -&gt; PK=USER#id, SK begins_with ORDER#, ScanIndexForward=false<br>3. Status bo'yicha buyurtmalar -&gt; GSI1</pre><pre>aws dynamodb query --table-name App --key-condition-expression 'PK=:p' \<br>  --expression-attribute-values '{&quot;:p&quot;:{&quot;S&quot;:&quot;USER#42&quot;}}' --no-scan-index-forward</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yangi access pattern — ko'pincha backfill va yangi GSI kerak.</li><li>Jadvalni o'qish va debug qilish qiyin; o'qiladigan tooling kerak.</li><li>Hamma narsani bitta jadvalga majburlash — har xil lifecycle/backup talabi bo'lsa ajrating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Single-table — performans optimizatsiyasi, dogma emas. AWS ham hozir &quot;bog'liq va birga o'qiladigan entity'lar uchun&quot; deb tavsiya qiladi; GraphQL/tez o'zgaradigan mahsulotda multi-table oddiyroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40780	<p>Route 53 nima va routing policy'lari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Route 53 — AWS'ning yuqori mavjud authoritative DNS servisi (100% SLA), domen ro'yxatdan o'tkazish va health check bilan. Routing policy'lar: <b>Simple, Weighted, Latency, Failover, Geolocation, Geoproximity, Multivalue, IP-based</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta domen trafigini region'lar orasida taqsimlash, yangi versiyaga 10% yuborish yoki region yiqilsa avtomatik zaxiraga o'tish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>client --&gt; resolver --&gt; Route 53: api.corp.com?<br>   Weighted:  90% -&gt; ALB-v1, 10% -&gt; ALB-v2<br>   Latency:   foydalanuvchiga eng yaqin region ALB<br>   Failover:  primary healthy? -&gt; primary : secondary<br>   Geo:       UZ -&gt; eu-central-1, US -&gt; us-east-1</pre><p>| Policy | Ishlatish | |---|---| | Simple | bitta resurs | | Weighted | canary, A/B | | Latency | multi-region tezlik | | Failover | active-passive DR | | Geolocation | qonun, kontent lokalizatsiyasi | | Multivalue | 8 tagacha sog'lom IP |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123 --change-batch '{<br> &quot;Changes&quot;:[{&quot;Action&quot;:&quot;UPSERT&quot;,&quot;ResourceRecordSet&quot;:{<br>   &quot;Name&quot;:&quot;api.corp.com&quot;,&quot;Type&quot;:&quot;A&quot;,&quot;SetIdentifier&quot;:&quot;v2&quot;,&quot;Weight&quot;:10,<br>   &quot;AliasTarget&quot;:{&quot;HostedZoneId&quot;:&quot;Z215JYRZR1TBD5&quot;,&quot;DNSName&quot;:&quot;alb-v2...elb.amazonaws.com&quot;,<br>   &quot;EvaluateTargetHealth&quot;:true}}}]}'<br>dig +short api.corp.com</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yuqori TTL — failover'da client'lar eski IP'da qoladi.</li><li>Geolocation'da &quot;Default&quot; yozuv yo'q — mos kelmagan mamlakat javob olmaydi.</li><li>Zone apex'da CNAME bo'lmaydi — Alias ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS failover — daqiqalar darajasida (TTL + resolver cache). Soniyalar kerak bo'lsa Global Accelerator. Health check'lar ilovaning haqiqiy bog'liqliklarini tekshirsin, faqat <code>200 OK</code> emas.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40781	<p>Amazon CloudFront nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CloudFront — AWS'ning global CDN'i: statik fayl, dinamik API va video'ni 600+ edge location orqali foydalanuvchiga yaqin joydan beradi. Cache, TLS, WAF, edge funksiyalar (CloudFront Functions, Lambda@Edge) bir joyda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> S3 bucket Frankfurt'da, foydalanuvchi Toshkent va Sidneyda. Har so'rov okean kesib o'tadi — sekin, va origin barcha yuklamani o'zi ko'taradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>user --&gt; eng yaqin edge (DNS orqali)<br>           | cache HIT --&gt; darhol javob<br>           | MISS --&gt; regional edge cache --&gt; origin (S3/ALB) --&gt; keshlaydi<br>Cache key = URL + tanlangan header/cookie/query (Cache Policy)<br>TTL: Cache-Control: max-age / s-maxage</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># kesh'ni tozalash (deploy'dan keyin)<br>aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1ABC --paths '/index.html' '/assets/*'<br># HIT yoki MISS?<br>curl -sI https://cdn.corp.com/app.js | grep -iE 'x-cache|age|cache-control'<br># x-cache: Hit from cloudfront</pre><p>S3 origin'ni faqat CloudFront o'qishi uchun <b>Origin Access Control (OAC)</b> ishlating (eski OAI emas).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cache key'ga barcha cookie/header qo'shish — hit ratio ~0%.</li><li>Fayl nomida versiya yo'q (<code>app.js</code>) — har deploy'da invalidation kerak; <code>app.3f9a.js</code> ishlating.</li><li>Dinamik shaxsiy javobni keshlab, boshqa foydalanuvchiga ko'rsatish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asosiy metrika — cache hit ratio va origin yuklamasi. Statik asset'lar uzoq TTL + immutable nom, HTML qisqa TTL. CloudFront'dan S3/AWS origin'ga data transfer bepul — internetga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri S3'dan berishdan ko'pincha arzon.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40782	<p>AWS Global Accelerator nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Global Accelerator — sizga <b>2 ta statik Anycast IP</b> beradi; trafik eng yaqin AWS edge'da qabul qilinib, AWS global backbone orqali sog'lom region'dagi ALB/NLB/EC2'ga yetkaziladi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40783	<p>AWS Direct Connect (DX) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Direct Connect (DX) — on-prem data center'ni AWS'ga <b>maxsus fizik optik liniya</b> (1/10/100 Gbps) orqali ulash. Internet chetlab o'tiladi: barqaror bandwidth, bashorat qilinadigan latency, arzonroq chiquvchi trafik. Default'da <b>shifrlanmagan</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bank on-prem DB'dan har kuni 20 TB AWS'ga sinxronlaydi. VPN internet orqali — tezlik va latency o'zgaruvchan, ~1.25 Gbps tunnel limiti.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>On-prem router --cross-connect--&gt; DX location (colo) --&gt; AWS backbone<br>        BGP sessiya, VIF (virtual interface):<br>          Private VIF  --&gt; VGW / DX Gateway --&gt; VPC'lar<br>          Transit VIF  --&gt; DX Gateway --&gt; Transit Gateway<br>          Public VIF   --&gt; AWS public servislar (S3 public endpoint)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws directconnect describe-connections --query 'connections[].[connectionName,bandwidth,connectionState]'<br>aws directconnect describe-virtual-interfaces --query 'virtualInterfaces[].[virtualInterfaceType,bgpPeers[0].bgpStatus]'</pre><p>Router tomonda BGP holati: <code>show bgp summary</code> — <code>Established</code> bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta DX liniya = bitta nuqtali nosozlik. Kamida 2 ta, turli location'da (yoki DX + VPN zaxira).</li><li>Provision qilish haftalar/oylar — oxirgi daqiqada rejalamang.</li><li>Shifrlash: 10/100G'da <b>MACsec</b>, yoki DX ustidan IPsec VPN.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DX — tarmoq loyihasi, bitta API chaqiriq emas: BGP, ASN, route summarization, failover testi kerak. AWS Resiliency Toolkit &quot;maximum resiliency&quot; modeli (4 ulanish, 2 location) kritik tizimlar uchun standart.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40784	<p>AWS Site-to-Site VPN nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Site-to-Site VPN — on-prem router (<b>Customer Gateway</b>) ni AWS'dagi <b>Virtual Private Gateway</b> yoki <b>Transit Gateway</b> bilan internet orqali <b>IPsec</b> shifrlangan tunnel bilan ulash. Har ulanish = 2 tunnel (2 xil AWS endpoint), har biri ~1.25 Gbps.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ofis yoki kichik data center'ni AWS VPC bilan tezda (soatlarda) va arzon xavfsiz bog'lash kerak; DX uchun vaqt/byudjet yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>on-prem CGW (public IP) ==IPsec tunnel 1==&gt; AWS endpoint A --+<br>                        ==IPsec tunnel 2==&gt; AWS endpoint B --+--&gt; VGW/TGW --&gt; VPC<br>routing: static yoki BGP (tavsiya: BGP, avtomatik failover)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 create-customer-gateway --type ipsec.1 --public-ip 198.51.100.10 --bgp-asn 65010<br>aws ec2 create-vpn-connection --type ipsec.1 --customer-gateway-id cgw-0abc \<br>  --transit-gateway-id tgw-0abc<br>aws ec2 describe-vpn-connections --query 'VpnConnections[].VgwTelemetry[].[OutsideIpAddress,Status]'</pre><p>AWS router uchun tayyor konfiguratsiya fayli beradi (Cisco, Juniper, strongSwan, pfSense).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat bitta tunnel sozlangan — AWS texnik ishida ulanish uziladi.</li><li>MTU/MSS: IPsec overhead tufayli katta paketlar tushadi — MSS clamp 1379.</li><li>Trafik bo'lmasa tunnel uxlaydi — DPD va doimiy keepalive.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> VPN — DX'ning zaxirasi yoki boshlang'ich yo'l.
