Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40785	<p>AWS IAM nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS IAM — AWS'da <b>kim</b> (autentifikatsiya) <b>nima qila olishini</b> (avtorizatsiya) boshqaradigan global, bepul servis: user, group, role, policy. Har bir AWS API chaqiriq IAM tomonidan tekshiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dasturchi, CI pipeline, Lambda va EC2 — har biri AWS'ga kirishi kerak, lekin faqat kerakli darajada. Hamma bitta admin kalit ishlatsa — bitta oqish hamma narsani yo'qotadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Principal (user / role session / servis)<br>   --&gt; so'rov: Action=s3:GetObject, Resource=arn:aws:s3:::b/k, Context(IP, MFA, tag)<br>   --&gt; IAM: identity policy + resource policy + SCP + boundary --&gt; Allow / Deny</pre><p>Asosiy obyektlar: <b>User</b> (odam/kalit), <b>Group</b> (user'lar to'plami), <b>Role</b> (vaqtinchalik assume qilinadigan identity), <b>Policy</b> (JSON ruxsat).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws sts get-caller-identity          # men kimman?<br>aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/app \<br>  --action-names s3:GetObject --resource-arns arn:aws:s3:::corp-data/x.csv<br>aws iam generate-service-last-accessed-details --arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/app</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Root user'ni kundalik ishlatish va MFA'siz qoldirish.</li><li><code>AdministratorAccess</code> ni &quot;keyin toraytiramiz&quot; deb berish — hech qachon torayilmaydi.</li><li>Access key'larni kodga yoki <code>.env</code> ga yozish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maqsad — odamlarda uzoq muddatli kalit nol (SSO), workload'larda faqat role. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40786	<p>IAM policy nima va asosiy JSON elementlari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> IAM policy — ruxsatlarni ta'riflovchi JSON hujjat. Asosiy elementlar: <code>Version</code>, <code>Statement[]</code>, ichida <code>Effect</code> (Allow/Deny), <code>Action</code> (<code>s3:GetObject</code>), <code>Resource</code> (ARN), ixtiyoriy <code>Condition</code> (IP, MFA, tag) va resource-based policy'da <code>Principal</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Bu Lambda faqat bitta bucket'ning <code>uploads/</code> papkasidan o'qisin va faqat shifrlangan ulanish orqali&quot; — buni aniq ifodalash kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Statement = Effect + Action + Resource [+ Condition] [+ Principal]<br>identity-based: user/role'ga biriktiriladi (Principal yo'q — u biriktirilgan identity)<br>resource-based: bucket/KMS key/SQS'ga biriktiriladi (Principal kerak)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{<br>  &quot;Version&quot;: &quot;2012-10-17&quot;,<br>  &quot;Statement&quot;: [<br>    {<br>      &quot;Sid&quot;: &quot;ReadUploads&quot;,<br>      &quot;Effect&quot;: &quot;Allow&quot;,<br>      &quot;Action&quot;: [&quot;s3:GetObject&quot;],<br>      &quot;Resource&quot;: &quot;arn:aws:s3:::corp-data/uploads/*&quot;,<br>      &quot;Condition&quot;: {&quot;Bool&quot;: {&quot;aws:SecureTransport&quot;: &quot;true&quot;}}<br>    },<br>    {<br>      &quot;Sid&quot;: &quot;ListOnlyPrefix&quot;,<br>      &quot;Effect&quot;: &quot;Allow&quot;,<br>      &quot;Action&quot;: &quot;s3:ListBucket&quot;,<br>      &quot;Resource&quot;: &quot;arn:aws:s3:::corp-data&quot;,<br>      &quot;Condition&quot;: {&quot;StringLike&quot;: {&quot;s3:prefix&quot;: &quot;uploads/*&quot;}}<br>    }<br>  ]<br>}</pre><p><code>ListBucket</code> bucket ARN'ga, <code>GetObject</code> obyekt ARN'ga (<code>/*</code>) — eng ko'p xato shu yerda.</p><pre>aws accessanalyzer validate-policy --policy-type IDENTITY_POLICY --policy-document file://p.json</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>&quot;Version&quot;: &quot;2012-10-17&quot;</code> ni tushirib qoldirish — policy variable'lar ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>&quot;Action&quot;: &quot;s3:*&quot;, &quot;Resource&quot;: &quot;*&quot;</code> — keng ruxsat.</li><li><code>NotAction</code>/<code>NotResource</code> ni Allow bilan ishlatish — kutilmagan keng ruxsat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Policy'larni IaC'da yozing, PR'da <code>validate-policy</code> va Access Analyzer &quot;unused access&quot; bilan tekshiring. Tag'ga asoslangan (ABAC) condition'lar ko'p jamoali muhitda policy sonini keskin kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40787	<p>IAM policy evaluation logikasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tartib: (1) default — <b>implicit deny</b>; (2) biror joyda <b>explicit Deny</b> bo'lsa — darhol rad; (3) aks holda barcha cheklovchi qatlamlar (SCP, RCP, permission boundary, session policy) ruxsat berishi <b>va</b> identity yoki resource policy'da <b>explicit Allow</b> bo'lishi kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Policy'da Allow bor, lekin AccessDenied&quot; — bu deyarli har doim boshqa qatlam (SCP, boundary, KMS key policy, bucket policy) sabab.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>so'rov<br>  v<br>explicit Deny bormi (har qanday policy'da)? --ha--&gt; DENY<br>  v yo'q<br>SCP / RCP ruxsat beradimi? --yo'q--&gt; DENY<br>  v<br>resource policy Allow beradimi (bir akkaunt ichida)? --ha--&gt; ALLOW<br>  v<br>permission boundary ruxsat beradimi? --yo'q--&gt; DENY<br>  v<br>session policy (assume vaqtida) ruxsat beradimi? --yo'q--&gt; DENY<br>  v<br>identity policy Allow? --ha--&gt; ALLOW, yo'q--&gt; DENY (implicit)<br>Cross-account: IKKALA tomonda (identity + resource) Allow kerak.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/app \<br>  --action-names kms:Decrypt --resource-arns arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:111:key/abc \<br>  --query 'EvaluationResults[].[EvalActionName,EvalDecision,MatchedStatements[].SourcePolicyId]'</pre><p>AccessDenied xabari endi qaysi turdagi policy rad etganini ko'rsatadi: <code>...with an explicit deny in a service control policy</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>KMS: key policy ruxsat bermasa, IAM Allow yetarli emas.</li><li>Permission boundary ruxsat <b>bermaydi</b>, faqat chegaralaydi.</li><li>Simulator SCP va resource policy'larni har doim to'liq hisobga olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Debug tartibi: xato matni -&gt; CloudTrail event (<code>errorCode</code>, <code>errorMessage</code>) -&gt; qatlam bo'yicha tekshirish. Guardrail'larni Deny (SCP) bilan, ruxsatlarni Allow bilan yozing — ikkalasini aralashtirmang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40788	<p>IAM Role va IAM User farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>IAM User</b> — uzoq muddatli credential'li doimiy identity (parol, access key). <b>IAM Role</b> — hech qanday doimiy credential'siz identity; ishonilgan entity (EC2, Lambda, pod, boshqa akkaunt, SSO foydalanuvchisi) uni <b>assume</b> qilib vaqtinchalik (15 daq - 12 soat) kalit oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> User access key'i GitHub'ga tushib qolsa — u o'chirilguncha ishlaydi. Role kaliti esa bir soatda o'zi tugaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Role = trust policy (KIM assume qila oladi) + permission policy (NIMA qila oladi)<br>EC2 --instance profile--&gt; sts:AssumeRole --&gt; AccessKeyId + SecretKey + SessionToken (1 soat)<br>GitHub Actions --OIDC token--&gt; sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity --&gt; vaqtinchalik kalit</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b> CI uchun kalitsiz role:</p><pre>{&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Allow&quot;,<br> &quot;Principal&quot;:{&quot;Federated&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:iam::111:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com&quot;},<br> &quot;Action&quot;:&quot;sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity&quot;,<br> &quot;Condition&quot;:{&quot;StringEquals&quot;:{<br>   &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud&quot;:&quot;sts.amazonaws.com&quot;,<br>   &quot;token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub&quot;:&quot;repo:corp/api:ref:refs/heads/main&quot;}}}</pre><pre>aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222:role/deploy --role-session-name me<br>aws iam list-access-keys --user-name legacy-bot   # eski kalitlarni toping</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>OIDC trust'da <code>sub</code> shartini qo'ymaslik — har qanday repo role'ni assume qiladi.</li><li>Ilovaga user kaliti berish o'rniga instance role ishlatmaslik.</li><li>Role session muddatini 12 soat qilib, qisqa muddat afzalligini yo'qotish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Zamonaviy standart: odamlar — Identity Center (SSO), workload'lar — role (instance profile, IRSA/Pod Identity, OIDC). IAM user faqat role ishlata olmaydigan eski tizim uchun istisno, kalit rotatsiyasi va alert bilan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40789	<p>AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> IAM Identity Center (sobiq AWS SSO) — korporativ IdP (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace) bilan ulanib, xodimlarga barcha AWS akkauntlariga <b>bitta login</b> bilan, vaqtinchalik credential orqali kirishni beruvchi markaziy servis. Ruxsatlar <b>Permission Set</b> larda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 40 ta akkaunt, 200 xodim. Har akkauntda IAM user yaratish, xodim ketganda hammasini o'chirish — xavfli va qo'lda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Okta/Entra (user, group) --SCIM sync--&gt; Identity Center<br>Permission Set &quot;ReadOnly&quot;, &quot;DevPowerUser&quot;<br>Assignment: group &quot;payments-dev&quot; + PS &quot;DevPowerUser&quot; + akkaunt &quot;payments-dev&quot;<br>     --&gt; har akkauntda avtomatik role: AWSReservedSSO_DevPowerUser_xxx<br>User login --&gt; portal --&gt; akkaunt+role tanlaydi --&gt; 1-12 soatlik kalit</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws configure sso          # profil: sso_start_url, sso_region, account, role<br>aws sso login --profile payments-dev<br>aws s3 ls --profile payments-dev</pre><p><code>~/.aws/config</code> da faqat profil — hech qanday doimiy secret yo'q.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>IdP'da group'lar to'g'ri SCIM sync qilinmasa — ketgan xodim hali kira oladi.</li><li>Hammaga <code>AdministratorAccess</code> permission set berish.</li><li>Identity Center o'zi bir region'da — o'sha region muammosiga break-glass rejasi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Xodim offboarding'i IdP'da bitta joyda bo'lishi — asosiy xavfsizlik yutug'i. Break-glass uchun MFA'li 1-2 favqulodda IAM user/root, CloudTrail alert bilan.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40790	<p>AWS Service Control Policy (SCP) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SCP (Service Control Policy) — AWS Organizations'da OU yoki akkauntga qo'yiladigan <b>maksimal ruxsat chegarasi</b>. U hech narsaga ruxsat <b>bermaydi</b>, faqat cheklaydi; SCP taqiqlagan narsani akkauntdagi admin, hatto root ham qila olmaydi (management account'dan tashqari).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 50 ta akkauntda kimdir CloudTrail'ni o'chirmasligi, ruxsat etilmagan region'da resurs yaratmasligi kerak — har akkaunt IAM'iga ishonib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Root OU (SCP: FullAWSAccess)<br>  +-- Prod OU (SCP: deny region != eu-*, deny cloudtrail:Stop*)<br>  |     +-- payments-prod akkaunt<br>  +-- Sandbox OU (SCP: deny ec2 katta instance turlari)<br>Samarali ruxsat = IAM Allow  KESISHMA  barcha yuqori SCP'lar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{&quot;Version&quot;:&quot;2012-10-17&quot;,&quot;Statement&quot;:[{<br>  &quot;Sid&quot;:&quot;DenyOutsideEU&quot;,&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Deny&quot;,&quot;NotAction&quot;:[&quot;iam:*&quot;,&quot;sts:*&quot;,&quot;route53:*&quot;,&quot;cloudfront:*&quot;,&quot;support:*&quot;],<br>  &quot;Resource&quot;:&quot;*&quot;,<br>  &quot;Condition&quot;:{&quot;StringNotEquals&quot;:{&quot;aws:RequestedRegion&quot;:[&quot;eu-central-1&quot;,&quot;eu-west-1&quot;]}}<br>}]}</pre><pre>aws organizations attach-policy --policy-id p-abc --target-id ou-xyz</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Global servislarni (IAM, CloudFront) region SCP'sidan istisno qilmaslik — ular <code>us-east-1</code> da.</li><li>SCP management (payer) akkauntga ta'sir qilmaydi — u yerda workload ishlatmang.</li><li>Allow-list SCP'lar keng ko'lamda boshqarib bo'lmaydi — deny-list ko'proq ishlatiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SCP — preventiv guardrail; uni avval sandbox OU'da sinang, keyin prod'ga. RCP (Resource Control Policy, 2024) bilan birga &quot;data perimeter&quot; quriladi: faqat o'z org'dagi identity'lar o'z resurslaringizga kira oladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40791	<p>AWS CloudTrail nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CloudTrail — AWS akkauntidagi <b>har bir API chaqiriqni</b> (kim, qachon, qaysi IP'dan, qaysi parametr bilan, natija) yozadigan audit servisi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40792	<p>Amazon CloudWatch nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CloudWatch — AWS'ning kuzatuv servisi: <b>Metrics</b> (CPU, latency, custom), <b>Logs</b> (jamlash, Logs Insights so'rovlari), <b>Alarms</b> (chegara -&gt; SNS/autoscaling), Dashboards, shuningdek Synthetics, Container Insights, Application Signals.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 30 servis, 200 instance. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40794	<p>AWS KMS nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS KMS — shifrlash kalitlarini yaratish, saqlash (FIPS HSM'larda), rotatsiya va ishlatishni IAM + key policy bilan boshqaradigan servis. Kalit KMS'dan hech qachon ochiq holda chiqmaydi; katta ma'lumot <b>envelope encryption</b> bilan shifrlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova o'zi kalit saqlasa — kalit kod/config'da oqadi, rotatsiya va kim ishlatganini kuzatish yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (envelope):</b></p><pre>1) GenerateDataKey(KMS key) --&gt; plaintext data key + encrypted data key<br>2) ilova data'ni plaintext key bilan AES-256-GCM shifrlaydi, plaintext key'ni xotiradan o'chiradi<br>3) saqlaydi: ciphertext + encrypted data key<br>O'qish: Decrypt(encrypted data key) --&gt; plaintext key --&gt; data'ni ochish<br>Har Decrypt CloudTrail'da.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws kms create-key --description &quot;app data&quot; --key-usage ENCRYPT_DECRYPT<br>aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/app-data --target-key-id &lt;key-id&gt;<br>aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id &lt;key-id&gt;          # yillik avtomatik<br>aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/app-data --plaintext fileb://secret.txt \<br>  --query CiphertextBlob --output text</pre><p>| Kalit turi | Kim boshqaradi | Policy | |---|---|---| | AWS owned | AWS | ko'rinmaydi | | AWS managed (<code>aws/s3</code>) | AWS | o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi | | Customer managed | siz | to'liq nazorat, $1/oy |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Key policy'da akkaunt root'ga ruxsat yo'q — kalit &quot;boshqarib bo'lmaydigan&quot; bo'lib qoladi.</li><li>Kalitni o'chirish (<code>ScheduleKeyDeletion</code>) — u bilan shifrlangan hamma narsa qaytmas yo'qoladi.</li><li>KMS API so'rov limiti — har obyektga Decrypt; S3 Bucket Key bilan kamaytiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Customer managed key — cross-account kirish va &quot;kalitni o'chirib ma'lumotni kriptografik yo'q qilish&quot; nazorati uchun. Key policy'ni least privilege va <code>kms:ViaService</code> sharti bilan yozing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40795	<p>Secrets Manager va Parameter Store farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Secrets Manager</b> — secret'lar uchun: avtomatik rotatsiya (RDS uchun tayyor), versiyalash, cross-account, replikatsiya; ~$0.40/secret/oy. <b>SSM Parameter Store</b> — ierarxik config key-value (<code>/app/prod/db_host</code>), <code>SecureString</code> (KMS) bilan; Standard tier bepul, rotatsiya yo'q.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB parolini env faylda saqlash — oqadi va hech qachon almashtirilmaydi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40796	<p>AWS WAF nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS WAF — CloudFront, ALB, API Gateway, AppSync, Cognito va App Runner oldida ishlaydigan <b>L7 web application firewall</b>: SQLi, XSS, yomon bot, rate flood va geo bo'yicha so'rovlarni bloklaydi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40797	<p>Shield Standard va Shield Advanced farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Shield Standard</b> — barcha AWS mijozlari uchun bepul va avtomatik L3/L4 DDoS himoyasi (SYN flood, UDP reflection). <b>Shield Advanced</b> (~$3000/oy + trafik, 1 yillik) — 24/7 Shield Response Team, DDoS sababli scaling xarajatidan moliyaviy himoya, L7 avtomatik mitigation, batafsil telemetriya.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Biznes uchun kritik sayt 500 Gbps hujum ostida. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40798	<p>Amazon GuardDuty nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GuardDuty — CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS log'lari (va ixtiyoriy S3, EKS audit, RDS login, Lambda, runtime monitoring) ni tahdid razvedkasi va ML bilan tahlil qilib, <b>buzilgan instance, o'g'irlangan credential, kripto-mayning</b> kabi tahdidlarni topadigan servis. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40799	<p>AWS Security Hub nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Security Hub — GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, IAM Access Analyzer, Config va third-party tool'lar topilmalarini <b>yagona formatda (ASFF/OCSF)</b> jamlaydigan va akkauntlarni CIS, AWS FSBP, PCI-DSS, NIST standartlariga qarshi avtomatik tekshiradigan markaziy security posture servisi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 5 ta security servis, 40 akkaunt, 10 region — har biri o'z konsolida. &quot;Umumiy holatimiz qanday va eng muhim 10 muammo qaysi?&quot; degan savolga javob yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GuardDuty   \<br>Inspector    \<br>Macie         ---&gt; Security Hub (aggregator region, delegated admin) --&gt; score, dashboard<br>Config rules /        |<br>3rd party   /         +--&gt; EventBridge --&gt; Jira / Slack / auto-remediation<br>Standartlar: FSBP &quot;S3.1 Block Public Access yoqilmagan&quot; -&gt; FAILED</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws securityhub enable-security-hub --enable-default-standards<br>aws securityhub get-findings --filters '{<br>  &quot;SeverityLabel&quot;:[{&quot;Value&quot;:&quot;CRITICAL&quot;,&quot;Comparison&quot;:&quot;EQUALS&quot;}],<br>  &quot;WorkflowStatus&quot;:[{&quot;Value&quot;:&quot;NEW&quot;,&quot;Comparison&quot;:&quot;EQUALS&quot;}]}' \<br>  --query 'Findings[].[Title,Resources[0].Id]' --max-items 10</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hamma standartni birdan yoqish — minglab finding, hech kim ko'rmaydi.</li><li>AWS Config yoqilmasa — control tekshiruvlari ishlamaydi.</li><li>Finding'larga egalik (owner) va SLA yo'q — dashboard faqat bezak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Security Hub — &quot;yagona navbat&quot;; qiymat triage jarayonidan keladi: severity bo'yicha egasi, muddati, avtomatik suppression qoidalari. Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40800	<p>Amazon Inspector nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Amazon Inspector — EC2 instance, ECR image'lari va Lambda funksiyalarini <b>dasturiy zaifliklar (CVE)</b> va EC2 uchun <b>tarmoqqa keraksiz ochiqlik</b> bo'yicha avtomatik va uzluksiz skanerlaydigan servis. Yangi CVE chiqsa, mavjud resurslarni qayta baholaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 300 ta container image va 100 instance. Log4Shell kabi CVE chiqqanda &quot;qaysi joyda zaif kutubxona bor?&quot; ga daqiqalarda javob kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>EC2: SSM Agent (yoki agentless EBS snapshot skan) --&gt; paket inventari<br>ECR: push'da + uzluksiz (image'lar) --&gt; OS + til paketlari (npm, pip, Maven, Go)<br>Lambda: funksiya kodi va layer'lar<br>   --&gt; CVE bazasi bilan solishtirish --&gt; finding + Inspector score (CVSS + ochiqlik)<br>   --&gt; Security Hub / EventBridge</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws inspector2 enable --resource-types EC2 ECR LAMBDA<br>aws inspector2 list-findings --filter-criteria '{<br>  &quot;severity&quot;:[{&quot;comparison&quot;:&quot;EQUALS&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:&quot;CRITICAL&quot;}],<br>  &quot;vulnerabilityId&quot;:[{&quot;comparison&quot;:&quot;EQUALS&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:&quot;CVE-2021-44228&quot;}]}' \<br>  --query 'findings[].resources[0].id'<br># SBOM eksport<br>aws inspector2 create-sbom-export --report-format CYCLONEDX_1_4 --s3-destination bucketName=corp-sbom</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SSM Agent ishlamayotgan instance'lar skanerlanmaydi (agentless rejimini yoqing).</li><li>Faqat skan — tuzatish yo'q; patch jarayoni bo'lmasa finding'lar to'planadi.</li><li>Eski ECR image'lar ham skanerlanib xarajat qo'shadi — lifecycle policy.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Inspector — runtime inventari; CI'da (Trivy/Grype) &quot;shift left&quot; skan bilan birga ishlating. Ustuvorlik: internetga ochiq + exploit mavjud + CRITICAL; qolganini rejali patch siklida.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40801	<p>S3 storage class'lari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> S3 storage class'lari saqlash narxi va o'qish narxi/tezligi orasidagi trade-off: <b>Standard</b> (tez-tez), <b>Intelligent-Tiering</b> (noma'lum naqsh, avtomatik), <b>Standard-IA / One Zone-IA</b> (oyda kam), <b>Glacier Instant Retrieval</b> (kam, lekin ms'da), <b>Glacier Flexible</b> (daqiqa-soat), <b>Deep Archive</b> (12-48 soat, eng arzon). Plus <b>Express One Zone</b> — bir xonali ms latency.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 500 TB log va backup Standard'da — oyiga ~$11 500. Ko'pi hech qachon o'qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><p>| Class | $/GB-oy (taxm.) | Min muddat | O'qish | |---|---|---|---| | Standard | 0.023 | - | ms, bepul | | Intelligent-Tiering | 0.023 -&gt; 0.004 | - | ms (arxiv tier'lar ixtiyoriy) | | Standard-IA | 0.0125 | 30 kun | ms, $/GB | | Glacier Instant | 0.004 | 90 kun | ms, qimmatroq $/GB | | Glacier Flexible | 0.0036 | 90 kun | 1 daq - 12 soat | | Deep Archive | 0.00099 | 180 kun | 12-48 soat |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b> lifecycle qoidasi:</p><pre>{&quot;Rules&quot;:[{&quot;ID&quot;:&quot;logs&quot;,&quot;Status&quot;:&quot;Enabled&quot;,&quot;Filter&quot;:{&quot;Prefix&quot;:&quot;logs/&quot;},<br>  &quot;Transitions&quot;:[{&quot;Days&quot;:30,&quot;StorageClass&quot;:&quot;STANDARD_IA&quot;},<br>                 {&quot;Days&quot;:180,&quot;StorageClass&quot;:&quot;DEEP_ARCHIVE&quot;}],<br>  &quot;Expiration&quot;:{&quot;Days&quot;:2555}}]}</pre><pre>aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket corp-logs --lifecycle-configuration file://lc.json</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kichik obyektlar (&lt;128 KB) IA'da 128 KB deb hisoblanadi — qimmatlashadi.</li><li>Minimum muddatdan oldin o'chirish — qolgan kunlar baribir to'lanadi.</li><li>Glacier'dan tiklash vaqtini DR rejasida hisobga olmaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Naqsh noma'lum bo'lsa — Intelligent-Tiering default. S3 Storage Lens va Storage Class Analysis bilan o'lchab, keyin lifecycle yozing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40802	<p>S3 versioning va MFA Delete nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Versioning</b> — bucket'dagi har obyektning barcha versiyalarini saqlaydi: ustidan yozish yangi versiya yaratadi, o'chirish faqat <b>delete marker</b> qo'yadi. <b>MFA Delete</b> — versiyani butunlay o'chirish yoki versioning'ni to'xtatish uchun root'ning MFA kodini talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript xato bilan <code>aws s3 rm --recursive</code> qildi yoki ransomware fayllarni shifrlangan nusxa bilan almashtirdi. Versioning bo'lmasa — ma'lumot yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PUT report.csv  --&gt; v1<br>PUT report.csv  --&gt; v2 (v1 saqlanadi)<br>DELETE report.csv --&gt; delete marker (v1, v2 hali bor)<br>GET report.csv  --&gt; 404, lekin GET ?versionId=v2 --&gt; ishlaydi<br>DELETE ?versionId=v1 --&gt; butunlay o'chadi (MFA Delete bo'lsa — MFA kerak)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket corp-data --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled<br>aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket corp-data --prefix report.csv<br># tiklash: delete marker'ni o'chirish<br>aws s3api delete-object --bucket corp-data --key report.csv --version-id &lt;marker-id&gt;</pre><p>Eski versiyalar uchun lifecycle: <code>NoncurrentVersionExpiration: {NoncurrentDays: 90}</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Versioning'ni bir marta yoqsangiz o'chirib bo'lmaydi, faqat <code>Suspended</code>.</li><li>Lifecycle'siz eski versiyalar cheksiz to'planadi — hisob ikki baravar.</li><li>MFA Delete faqat root + CLI orqali yoqiladi, avtomatlashtirish qiyin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amalda MFA Delete o'rniga ko'proq <b>Object Lock</b> va alohida akkauntga replikatsiya ishlatiladi — avtomatlashtirish va ransomware'ga qarshi kuchliroq.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40803	<p>S3 Object Lock va WORM nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> S3 Object Lock — <b>WORM</b> (Write Once Read Many): obyekt versiyasini belgilangan retention muddati davomida o'chirib yoki ustidan yozib bo'lmaydi. <b>Compliance</b> rejimida hech kim (root ham) qisqartira olmaydi; <b>Governance</b> rejimida maxsus ruxsatli user chetlab o'ta oladi. Alohida <b>Legal Hold</b> — muddatsiz qulf.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hujumchi admin kalitini o'g'irlab, backup'larni o'chirib, keyin to'lov talab qiladi. Yoki regulyator (SEC 17a-4) yozuvlarni 7 yil o'zgarmas saqlashni talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bucket: Object Lock enabled (versioning majburiy)<br>PUT backup.tar  + Retention: COMPLIANCE, RetainUntil=2027-10-03<br>DELETE ?versionId=...  --&gt; AccessDenied (2027 gacha)<br>DELETE (versiyasiz)    --&gt; faqat delete marker, versiya qoladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws s3api create-bucket --bucket corp-backup-lock --object-lock-enabled-for-bucket \<br>  --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=eu-central-1<br>aws s3api put-object-lock-configuration --bucket corp-backup-lock \<br>  --object-lock-configuration '{&quot;ObjectLockEnabled&quot;:&quot;Enabled&quot;,<br>   &quot;Rule&quot;:{&quot;DefaultRetention&quot;:{&quot;Mode&quot;:&quot;GOVERNANCE&quot;,&quot;Days&quot;:30}}}'<br>aws s3api get-object-retention --bucket corp-backup-lock --key db.dump --version-id v1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Compliance rejimida test uchun 10 yil qo'yish — bucket'ni ham, akkauntni ham yopa olmaysiz (faqat to'laysiz).</li><li>Governance'da <code>s3:BypassGovernanceRetention</code> ruxsati keng berilsa — himoya yo'q.</li><li>Object Lock faqat versiyani himoya qiladi, delete marker qo'yishni emas — o'qishda chalkashlik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Backup bucket'ni alohida, minimal kirishli akkauntda Object Lock bilan saqlang — bu ransomware'ga qarshi eng kuchli himoya. Avval Governance bilan sinab, keyin Compliance.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40804	<p>S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) — bucket'ga yozilgan yangi obyektlarni boshqa region'dagi (va ixtiyoriy boshqa akkauntdagi) bucket'ga <b>asinxron</b> avtomatik nusxalash. Ikkala bucket'da <b>versioning</b> yoqilgan bo'lishi shart. Bir region ichida — SRR.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DR talabi: region yo'qolsa ham ma'lumot boshqa joyda bo'lsin; yoki compliance nusxani boshqa akkauntda talab qiladi; yoki boshqa qit'adagi foydalanuvchilarga yaqin nusxa.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>eu-central-1 bucket (src) --PUT--&gt; replication rule (prefix/tag filtr)<br>     --&gt; IAM role --&gt; eu-west-1 bucket (dst), storage class / owner o'zgartirish mumkin<br>odatda soniya-daqiqalar; RTC bilan 99.99% 15 daqiqa ichida (SLA)<br>mavjud (eski) obyektlar --&gt; S3 Batch Replication bilan alohida</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws s3api put-bucket-replication --bucket src-bucket --replication-configuration '{<br>  &quot;Role&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:iam::111:role/s3-repl&quot;,<br>  &quot;Rules&quot;:[{&quot;ID&quot;:&quot;all&quot;,&quot;Status&quot;:&quot;Enabled&quot;,&quot;Priority&quot;:1,&quot;Filter&quot;:{},<br>    &quot;DeleteMarkerReplication&quot;:{&quot;Status&quot;:&quot;Disabled&quot;},<br>    &quot;Destination&quot;:{&quot;Bucket&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:s3:::dst-bucket&quot;,&quot;StorageClass&quot;:&quot;STANDARD_IA&quot;}}]}'<br>aws s3api head-object --bucket src-bucket --key a.txt --query ReplicationStatus<br># PENDING | COMPLETED | FAILED</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qoidani yoqishdan oldingi obyektlar replikatsiya qilinmaydi.</li><li>SSE-KMS obyektlar uchun manzil kaliti va ruxsat alohida sozlanadi.</li><li>Delete marker replikatsiyasi yoqilsa, tasodifiy o'chirish ham nusxalanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Replikatsiya — backup emas: buzilgan yoki shifrlangan fayl ham nusxalanadi. DR uchun CRR + boshqa akkaunt + Object Lock kombinatsiyasi; <code>ReplicationLatency</code> va FAILED hodisalariga alert qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40805	<p>S3 event notification nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> S3 Event Notification — bucket'da hodisa bo'lganda (<code>s3:ObjectCreated:*</code>, <code>s3:ObjectRemoved:*</code>, restore, replication) uni <b>SQS, SNS, Lambda</b> yoki <b>EventBridge</b> ga avtomatik yuborish. Prefix/suffix bo'yicha filtr qilish mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Foydalanuvchi rasm yuklagan zahoti thumbnail yasash kerak — bucket'ni har daqiqada ro'yxatlab tekshirish (polling) sekin va qimmat.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>PUT uploads/cat.jpg --&gt; S3 --&gt; notification config:<br>    prefix=uploads/ suffix=.jpg --&gt; SQS queue --&gt; worker<br>    yoki --&gt; EventBridge (ko'p qoida, ko'p target, filter boy)<br>Event JSON: Records[].s3.bucket.name, .object.key (URL-encoded!), .size<br>Yetkazish: at-least-once, tartib kafolatlanmagan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws s3api put-bucket-notification-configuration --bucket corp-uploads \<br>  --notification-configuration '{&quot;QueueConfigurations&quot;:[{<br>    &quot;QueueArn&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:sqs:eu-central-1:111:thumbs&quot;,<br>    &quot;Events&quot;:[&quot;s3:ObjectCreated:*&quot;],<br>    &quot;Filter&quot;:{&quot;Key&quot;:{&quot;FilterRules&quot;:[{&quot;Name&quot;:&quot;prefix&quot;,&quot;Value&quot;:&quot;uploads/&quot;},<br>                                     {&quot;Name&quot;:&quot;suffix&quot;,&quot;Value&quot;:&quot;.jpg&quot;}]}}}]}'<br># yoki EventBridge'ga<br>aws s3api put-bucket-notification-configuration --bucket corp-uploads \<br>  --notification-configuration '{&quot;EventBridgeConfiguration&quot;:{}}'</pre><p>SQS queue policy S3'ga <code>sqs:SendMessage</code> ruxsat berishi shart.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lambda natijani <b>o'sha</b> prefix'ga yozsa — cheksiz loop va katta hisob.</li><li>Key URL-encoded (<code>my+file.jpg</code>) — decode qilmasangiz <code>NoSuchKey</code>.</li><li>Dublikat event'lar — ishlov idempotent bo'lsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> To'g'ridan-to'g'ri Lambda o'rniga S3 -&gt; SQS -&gt; Lambda: buffer, retry, DLQ beradi. Ko'p iste'molchi yoki murakkab filtr kerak bo'lsa — EventBridge.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40806	<p>Amazon EventBridge nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Amazon EventBridge — serverless <b>event bus</b>: AWS servislari, o'z ilovalaringiz va SaaS hamkorlardan event qabul qiladi va JSON <b>pattern</b> qoidalari bilan 20+ turdagi target'ga (Lambda, SQS, Step Functions, API destination) yo'naltiradi. Qo'shimcha: Scheduler (cron), Pipes (source -&gt; target), Archive/Replay, Schema Registry.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>OrderPlaced</code> hodisasini 5 ta servis eshitishi kerak. Order servisi har birini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chaqirsa — qattiq bog'lanish va har yangi iste'molchi uchun deploy.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>producer --PutEvents--&gt; custom bus &quot;orders&quot;<br>   rule1: {&quot;detail-type&quot;:[&quot;OrderPlaced&quot;],&quot;detail&quot;:{&quot;total&quot;:[{&quot;numeric&quot;:[&quot;&gt;&quot;,1000]}]}} --&gt; fraud SQS<br>   rule2: {&quot;detail-type&quot;:[&quot;OrderPlaced&quot;]} --&gt; email Lambda<br>   rule3: {&quot;source&quot;:[&quot;aws.ec2&quot;],&quot;detail-type&quot;:[&quot;EC2 Instance State-change Notification&quot;]} --&gt; ops</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws events put-events --entries '[{&quot;EventBusName&quot;:&quot;orders&quot;,&quot;Source&quot;:&quot;com.corp.orders&quot;,<br>  &quot;DetailType&quot;:&quot;OrderPlaced&quot;,&quot;Detail&quot;:&quot;{\&quot;id\&quot;:\&quot;981\&quot;,\&quot;total\&quot;:1200}&quot;}]'<br>aws events put-rule --event-bus-name orders --name big-orders \<br>  --event-pattern '{&quot;detail-type&quot;:[&quot;OrderPlaced&quot;],&quot;detail&quot;:{&quot;total&quot;:[{&quot;numeric&quot;:[&quot;&gt;&quot;,1000]}]}}'<br>aws events put-targets --event-bus-name orders --rule big-orders \<br>  --targets Id=1,Arn=arn:aws:sqs:eu-central-1:111:fraud</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Target ishlamasa event yo'qoladi — target'ga DLQ va retry policy qo'ying.</li><li>Event 256 KB limit — katta payload'ni S3'da saqlab havola yuboring.</li><li>Tartib va exactly-once kafolati yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> EventBridge — domen hodisalari integratsiyasi uchun (past-o'rta throughput, boy filtr). Yuqori throughput va replay/tartib kerak bo'lsa — Kinesis yoki Kafka (MSK). Event schema'ni contract sifatida versiyalang.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40807	<p>SQS Standard va FIFO farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Standard</b> SQS — deyarli cheksiz throughput, <b>at-least-once</b> (ba'zan dublikat), tartib best-effort. <b>FIFO</b> — message group ichida qat'iy tartib, 5 daqiqalik deduplication oynasi bilan dublikatsiz yuborish; throughput cheklangan (300 msg/s, batch bilan 3000; high-throughput rejimida bir necha o'n ming).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Email yuborish navbati — tartib muhim emas, tezlik muhim (Standard). Bank hisobi bo'yicha operatsiyalar — tartib buzilsa balans noto'g'ri (FIFO, group = account_id).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Standard:  producer --&gt; [m3 m1 m2 m1'] --&gt; consumer (dublikat/aralash bo'lishi mumkin)<br>FIFO:      group A: a1 -&gt; a2 -&gt; a3 (qat'iy)<br>           group B: b1 -&gt; b2       (A bilan parallel)<br>Receive --&gt; visibility timeout (masalan 30s) --&gt; DeleteMessage<br>     o'chirilmasa --&gt; qayta ko'rinadi --&gt; maxReceiveCount --&gt; DLQ</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws sqs create-queue --queue-name payments.fifo \<br>  --attributes FifoQueue=true,ContentBasedDeduplication=false,VisibilityTimeout=60<br>aws sqs send-message --queue-url $Q --message-body '{&quot;op&quot;:&quot;debit&quot;,&quot;amt&quot;:50}' \<br>  --message-group-id acct-42 --message-deduplication-id tx-981<br>aws sqs receive-message --queue-url $Q --wait-time-seconds 20 --max-number-of-messages 10</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Visibility timeout ishlov vaqtidan qisqa — xabar ikki marta ishlanadi.</li><li>FIFO'da bitta group_id — butun navbat ketma-ket, parallel yo'q.</li><li>&quot;Exactly-once&quot; faqat yuborish tomonida; consumer baribir idempotent bo'lishi kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Default — Standard + idempotent consumer + DLQ. FIFO'ni faqat tartib biznes invarianti bo'lganda, group kalitini mayda (entity bo'yicha) tanlab ishlating.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40808	<p>Amazon SNS nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Amazon SNS — boshqariladigan <b>pub/sub</b>: bitta topic'ga yuborilgan xabar barcha subscriber'larga (SQS, Lambda, HTTP/S, email, SMS, mobile push, Firehose) <b>push</b> qilinadi. Eng mashhur naqsh — <b>SNS + SQS fan-out</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>UserSignedUp</code> hodisasini email servis, analitika va CRM qabul qilishi kerak; har biri o'z tezligida ishlasin va biri yiqilsa boshqalarga ta'sir qilmasin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>producer --Publish--&gt; SNS topic &quot;user-signed-up&quot;<br>              +--&gt; SQS email-queue    --&gt; email worker<br>              +--&gt; SQS analytics-queue --&gt; batch<br>              +--&gt; Lambda crm-sync<br>Subscription filter policy: faqat {&quot;plan&quot;:[&quot;pro&quot;]} bo'lgan xabarlar --&gt; sales-queue<br>SNS xabarni saqlamaydi; subscriber yetib bo'lmasa retry, keyin DLQ (sozlansa)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>T=$(aws sns create-topic --name user-signed-up --query TopicArn --output text)<br>aws sns subscribe --topic-arn $T --protocol sqs \<br>  --notification-endpoint arn:aws:sqs:eu-central-1:111:email-queue \<br>  --attributes '{&quot;RawMessageDelivery&quot;:&quot;true&quot;,&quot;FilterPolicy&quot;:&quot;{\&quot;plan\&quot;:[\&quot;pro\&quot;]}&quot;}'<br>aws sns publish --topic-arn $T --message '{&quot;id&quot;:42}' \<br>  --message-attributes '{&quot;plan&quot;:{&quot;DataType&quot;:&quot;String&quot;,&quot;StringValue&quot;:&quot;pro&quot;}}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SQS queue policy SNS'ga ruxsat bermasa — xabarlar jimgina yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>RawMessageDelivery</code> o'chiq — consumer SNS konvertini (envelope) kutmagan bo'ladi.</li><li>Tartib kerak bo'lsa oddiy topic yetmaydi — SNS FIFO + SQS FIFO.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SNS -&gt; SQS -&gt; consumer har iste'molchiga mustaqil buffer va retry beradi. Murakkab routing va ko'p manbali event'lar uchun EventBridge zamonaviyroq; SNS esa juda yuqori fan-out va past latency'da kuchli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40809	<p>AWS Step Functions nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Step Functions — Lambda, ECS, DynamoDB va 200+ AWS servisini <b>state machine</b> (Amazon States Language, JSON) sifatida muvofiqlashtiruvchi serverless workflow orkestratori: retry, catch, parallel, map, kutish va inson tasdig'i tayyor. <b>Standard</b> (1 yilgacha, exactly-once) va <b>Express</b> (5 daqiqa, yuqori hajm) turlari.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Buyurtma jarayoni: to'lov -&gt; ombor -&gt; yetkazish; har qadam muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lishi va kompensatsiya kerak. Buni Lambda ichida <code>if/try</code> zanjiri bilan yozish — mo'rt va kuzatib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Start --&gt; ChargeCard (Task, Retry 3x backoff)<br>             | Catch --&gt; RefundAndFail<br>             v<br>          ReserveStock (Task) --Catch--&gt; Refund --&gt; Fail<br>             v<br>          WaitForApproval (.waitForTaskToken)  -- inson tasdig'i<br>             v<br>          Ship --&gt; Success<br>Har qadam holati konsolda vizual ko'rinadi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{&quot;StartAt&quot;:&quot;Charge&quot;,&quot;States&quot;:{<br>  &quot;Charge&quot;:{&quot;Type&quot;:&quot;Task&quot;,&quot;Resource&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke&quot;,<br>    &quot;Parameters&quot;:{&quot;FunctionName&quot;:&quot;charge&quot;,&quot;Payload.$&quot;:&quot;$&quot;},<br>    &quot;Retry&quot;:[{&quot;ErrorEquals&quot;:[&quot;States.TaskFailed&quot;],&quot;MaxAttempts&quot;:3,&quot;BackoffRate&quot;:2}],<br>    &quot;Catch&quot;:[{&quot;ErrorEquals&quot;:[&quot;States.ALL&quot;],&quot;Next&quot;:&quot;Fail&quot;}],<br>    &quot;Next&quot;:&quot;Done&quot;},<br>  &quot;Done&quot;:{&quot;Type&quot;:&quot;Succeed&quot;},<br>  &quot;Fail&quot;:{&quot;Type&quot;:&quot;Fail&quot;}}}</pre><pre>aws stepfunctions start-execution --state-machine-arn $SM --input '{&quot;orderId&quot;:&quot;981&quot;}'<br>aws stepfunctions get-execution-history --execution-arn $EX --max-items 20</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Standard'da har state o'tishi pullik — juda ko'p kichik qadamli yuqori hajmda qimmat (Express ishlating).</li><li>Payload 256 KB limit — katta data S3 orqali.</li><li>Task idempotent bo'lmasa retry ikki marta to'lov olishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Step Functions — saga/orkestratsiya uchun: holat, retry va audit kodda emas, deklarativ. Ko'p hollarda Lambda'siz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri SDK integratsiyalari (DynamoDB, SQS) kod va xarajatni kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H14 Cloud fundamentals	idrill-40810	<p>CloudFormation va Terraform farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>CloudFormation</b> — AWS'ning o'z deklarativ IaC servisi: YAML/JSON stack, state'ni AWS server tomonda saqlaydi, rollback avtomatik, faqat AWS. <b>Terraform</b> — HashiCorp (BSL litsenziya; ochiq fork — <b>OpenTofu</b>), HCL tili, minglab provayder (multi-cloud, SaaS), state'ni o'zingiz (S3 + lock) boshqarasiz, <code>plan</code> bilan aniq diff.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Infra'ni qo'lda konsolda yaratish — takrorlab bo'lmaydi, review yo'q, drift. Qaysi IaC tool'ni tanlash jamoa va platformaga bog'liq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>CloudFormation: template --&gt; CreateStack/ChangeSet --&gt; AWS servis state --&gt; xatoda rollback<br>Terraform:      *.tf --&gt; terraform plan (state + real API) --&gt; apply --&gt; state.tfstate (S3)</pre><p>| | CloudFormation | Terraform / OpenTofu | |---|---|---| | Doira | faqat AWS | multi-cloud + SaaS | | State | AWS boshqaradi | siz (S3, lock) | | Diff | Change Set | <code>plan</code> (aniqroq) | | Rollback | avtomatik | yo'q, oldinga tuzatish | | Yangi AWS feature | ko'pincha birinchi kun | provayder yangilanishi kerak | | Abstraksiya | CDK (TypeScript/Python) | modullar, CDKTF |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws cloudformation deploy --template-file vpc.yaml --stack-name vpc --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM<br>aws cloudformation detect-stack-drift --stack-name vpc<br><br>terraform init &amp;&amp; terraform plan -out tf.plan &amp;&amp; terraform apply tf.plan<br>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode   # 2 = drift/o'zgarish bor</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Terraform state'ni lokal yoki lock'siz saqlash — ikki apply bir-birini buzadi; state'da secret'lar ochiq.</li><li>CloudFormation stack <code>UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED</code> da qotib qolishi.</li><li>Bir resursni ikki tool bilan boshqarish — doimiy drift.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Faqat AWS va CDK yoqadigan jamoa uchun CloudFormation/CDK yaxshi; multi-cloud, SaaS (Datadog, GitHub) va yagona workflow uchun Terraform/OpenTofu. Litsenziya xavotiri bo'lsa OpenTofu — muhimi bitta standart va state boshqaruvi intizomi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::cloud sec::h14 Cloud_fundamentals
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40811	<p>AWS, Azure va GCP asosiy tushunchalarini solishtiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uchala provayder ham bir xil asosiy qurilish bloklarini beradi (VM, tarmoq, storage, K8s, serverless, identity), lekin <b>nomlar</b> va eng muhimi <b>tashkiliy ierarxiya</b> va <b>tarmoq modeli</b> farq qiladi. Bir cloud'ni bilsangiz, boshqasiga o'tish — asosan atamalarni moslashtirish va bir nechta muhim farqni bilish.</p><h4>Taqqoslash jadvali</h4><p>| Tushuncha | AWS | Azure | GCP | |---|---|---|---| | Ierarxiya | Organization -&gt; OU -&gt; <b>Account</b> | Management Group -&gt; <b>Subscription</b> -&gt; Resource Group | Organization -&gt; Folder -&gt; <b>Project</b> | | Izolyatsiya/billing birligi | Account | Subscription | Project | | Virtual tarmoq | VPC (<b>regional</b>) | VNet (regional) | VPC (<b>global</b>), subnet regional | | VM | EC2 | Virtual Machines | Compute Engine | | Managed K8s | EKS | AKS | GKE | | Object storage | S3 | Blob Storage | Cloud Storage | | Serverless funksiya | Lambda | Functions | Cloud Run functions | | Serverless container | Fargate / App Runner | Container Apps | Cloud Run | | Relational DB | RDS / Aurora | Azure SQL / PostgreSQL Flexible | Cloud SQL / AlloyDB / Spanner | | Identity | IAM (user/role/policy) | Entra ID + Azure RBAC | Cloud IAM (principal + role) | | Workload identity | IAM Role (IRSA, Pod Identity) | Managed Identity | Service Account, Workload Identity | | IaC (native) | CloudFormation / CDK | ARM / Bicep | Infrastructure Manager |</p><h4>Muhim farqlar</h4><p><b>1. Ierarxiya va izolyatsiya</b></p><ul><li>AWS'da kuchli chegara — <b>account</b> (ko'p akkauntli strategiya: har muhit/jamoa alohida akkaunt).</li><li>Azure'da — <b>subscription</b>, ichida Resource Group'lar (birga yaratiladigan/o'chiriladigan resurslar).</li><li>GCP'da — <b>project</b>; folder'lar orqali policy meros.</li></ul><p><b>2. Tarmoq</b> GCP VPC global: turli regionlardagi VM'lar peering'siz private IP bilan gaplashadi. AWS va Azure'da VPC/VNet bitta region — regionlararo ulash uchun peering yoki transit kerak.</p><p><b>3. Identity modeli</b></p><ul><li>AWS: policy'lar JSON, identity va resursga biriktiriladi; role &quot;kiyiladi&quot; (<code>AssumeRole</code>).</li><li>Azure: identity Entra ID'da (Active Directory merosi), ruxsat — RBAC rol tayinlash (scope: management group/subscription/RG/resurs).</li><li>GCP: rol principal'ga resurs ierarxiyasining istalgan darajasida beriladi va pastga meros bo'ladi.</li></ul><p><b>4. Kuchli tomonlar (umumlashtirilgan)</b></p><ul><li>AWS — eng keng servis tanlovi va ekotizim.</li><li>Azure — Microsoft ekotizimi (Entra ID, Office 365, Windows, .NET) bilan integratsiya, enterprise.</li><li>GCP — tarmoq, data/analitika (BigQuery), Kubernetes (GKE).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud tanlovi texnik ro'yxatdan ko'ra ko'proq tashkilotning mavjud bilimi, shartnomalar va ekotizimga bog'liq. Intervyuda nomlarni yodlashdan ko'ra modellarni (ierarxiya, identity, tarmoq) tushuntira olish muhimroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40812	<p>GCP Global VPC arxitekturasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GCP'da VPC <b>global</b> resurs: bitta VPC dunyoning barcha regionlarini qamraydi, subnet'lar esa ma'lum regionga tegishli. Natijada turli regionlardagi VM'lar <b>peering, VPN yoki transit gateway'siz</b> private IP orqali Google'ning ichki tarmog'ida gaplashadi. AWS va Azure'da esa har region uchun alohida VPC/VNet va ularni ulash kerak.</p><h4>Tuzilishi</h4><pre>VPC &quot;prod&quot; (global)<br> |- subnet eu-west1  10.0.1.0/24   [vm-a]<br> |- subnet us-east1  10.0.2.0/24   [vm-b]<br> |- subnet asia-se1  10.0.3.0/24   [vm-c]<br> firewall qoidalari va marshrutlar — butun VPC uchun<br>vm-a -&gt; vm-b : private IP, Google backbone orqali, qo'shimcha sozlamasiz</pre><h4>Afzalliklari</h4><ul><li><b>Soddalik</b>: ko'p regionli ilova uchun bitta tarmoq, bitta firewall siyosati.</li><li><b>Global load balancing</b>: bitta Anycast IP, trafik eng yaqin regiondagi backend'ga.</li><li><b>Shared VPC</b>: markaziy &quot;host project&quot; tarmog'ini boshqa project'lar (jamoalar) ishlatadi — tarmoq jamoasi boshqaradi, jamoalar resurs yaratadi.</li></ul><h4>Muhim tafsilotlar</h4><ul><li><b>Firewall qoidalari</b> VPC darajasida, lekin network tag yoki service account bo'yicha qo'llanadi (masalan <code>target-tags: web</code>).</li><li><b>Regionlararo trafik bepul emas</b> — egress narxi baribir bor.</li><li>Default VPC (&quot;auto mode&quot;) har regionda avtomatik subnet yaratadi; production uchun <b>custom mode</b> (CIDR'larni o'zingiz rejalashtirasiz).</li><li>Cloud Router + Cloud NAT regional — har regionda alohida sozlanadi.</li><li>VPC'lar orasidagi ulanish (masalan boshqa project) — VPC Network Peering (transitiv emas) yoki Network Connectivity Center.</li></ul><h4>AWS bilan farq</h4><p>| | GCP | AWS | |---|---|---| | VPC qamrovi | global | regional | | Subnet qamrovi | regional | <b>zonal</b> (AZ) | | Regionlararo private ulanish | avtomatik | peering / Transit Gateway |</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Global VPC qulay, lekin <b>blast radius</b> ham global: noto'g'ri firewall qoidasi barcha regionlarga ta'sir qiladi. Katta tashkilotlarda Shared VPC + muhit bo'yicha alohida VPC'lar (prod/non-prod) va IaC orqali boshqarish standart.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40813	<p>GKE Autopilot nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GKE Autopilot — Kubernetes'ning shunday rejimiki, <b>node'larni Google boshqaradi</b>: yaratish, masshtablash, yangilash, xavfsizlik sozlamalari. Siz faqat pod'larni deploy qilasiz va <b>pod so'ragan resurslar</b> (CPU, xotira) uchun to'laysiz, node'lar uchun emas. Standard rejimda esa node pool'larni o'zingiz boshqarasiz va butun node uchun to'laysiz.</p><h4>Standard va Autopilot</h4><p>| | Standard | Autopilot | |---|---|---| | Node boshqaruvi | siz (pool, o'lcham, upgrade) | Google | | To'lov | node'lar (bo'sh joy ham) | pod <code>requests</code> | | Moslashuvchanlik | to'liq (DaemonSet, privileged, maxsus kernel) | cheklangan | | Xavfsizlik | o'zingiz sozlaysiz | qat'iy default'lar (privileged yo'q, hostPath cheklangan) | | SLA | control plane | control plane <b>va pod'lar</b> |</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><ol><li>Siz Deployment yaratasiz (<code>requests</code> bilan).</li><li>Autopilot mos node'ni avtomatik yaratadi (kerak bo'lsa GPU, Spot, ARM — <code>nodeSelector</code> orqali so'raladi).</li><li>Bo'sh node'lar avtomatik olib tashlanadi.</li><li>Node OS yangilanishlari, auto-repair — Google.</li></ol><p><code>requests</code> ko'rsatilmasa — default qiymatlar qo'yiladi; juda kichik yoki nisbatsiz so'rovlar minimal qiymatlarga yaxlitlanadi.</p><h4>Qachon mos</h4><ul><li>Kichik/o'rta platform jamoasi, node boshqaruviga vaqt yo'q.</li><li>Yuk o'zgaruvchan — bo'sh node'larga to'lamaslik.</li><li>Xavfsizlik default'lari foydali.</li></ul><h4>Qachon mos emas</h4><ul><li>Privileged DaemonSet'lar (ba'zi xavfsizlik/monitoring agentlari — garchi ko'p mashhurlari ruxsat ro'yxatida bo'lsa ham).</li><li>Maxsus kernel sozlamalari, node'ga SSH.</li><li>Juda zich, barqaror yuk — Standard + to'g'ri bin-packing arzonroq bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Autopilot'da xarajat to'g'ridan-to'g'ri <code>requests</code>ga bog'liq — over-request qilingan pod'lar endi &quot;bepul bo'sh joy&quot; emas, aniq pul. Bu jamoalarni rightsizing'ga majburlaydi — ko'pincha bu Autopilot'ning eng katta foydasi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40814	<p>Google Cloud Run nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cloud Run — <b>container image</b> beriladi, Google uni HTTP endpoint sifatida ishga tushiradi va so'rovlar soniga qarab <b>avtomatik masshtablaydi</b>, jumladan <b>0 gacha</b> (trafik yo'q — pul yo'q). Server, klaster, node yo'q. Shart: container <b>stateless</b> bo'lishi va <code>PORT</code> muhit o'zgaruvchisidagi portni tinglashi kerak.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><pre>gcloud run deploy orders \<br>  --image=europe-docker.pkg.dev/proj/app/orders:1.4.2 \<br>  --region=europe-west1 \<br>  --min-instances=0 --max-instances=50 \<br>  --concurrency=80 --cpu=1 --memory=512Mi</pre><ul><li>So'rov keladi -&gt; instance yo'q bo'lsa — ishga tushiriladi (<b>cold start</b>, image va ilovaga qarab ~0.5–5s).</li><li>Har instance bir vaqtda <code>concurrency</code> (default 80) so'rovga xizmat qiladi; oshsa — yangi instance.</li><li>Trafik yo'q -&gt; instance'lar 0 ga tushadi.</li></ul><h4>Asosiy xususiyatlar</h4><ul><li><b>Revision'lar</b> va trafik bo'lish: <code>--tag canary</code>, 10% yangi revision'ga.</li><li><b>Trigger'lar</b>: HTTP, Pub/Sub (push), Eventarc (Cloud Storage, audit log event'lari), Cloud Scheduler.</li><li><b>Jobs</b>: HTTP'siz, tugaydigan vazifalar (batch, migratsiya).</li><li><b>Xavfsizlik</b>: IAM bilan himoyalangan endpoint (<code>--no-allow-unauthenticated</code>), service account identity, VPC'ga ulanish (Direct VPC egress).</li><li>Narx: so'rov bajarilayotgan vaqt uchun CPU/xotira (yoki &quot;always-on CPU&quot; rejimi).</li></ul><h4>Cold start'ni kamaytirish</h4><ul><li><code>--min-instances=1</code> (doimiy to'lov evaziga).</li><li>Kichik image, tez ishga tushadigan til/runtime (Go yaxshi; JVM uchun CRaC/GraalVM).</li><li><b>Startup CPU boost</b>.</li></ul><h4>Qachon mos</h4><ul><li>HTTP API'lar, webhook'lar, notekis trafikli ichki servislar.</li><li>Kubernetes'siz tez deploy.</li></ul><h4>Qachon mos emas</h4><ul><li>Doimiy uzoq ulanishlar (ba'zi WebSocket/gRPC stream holatlari — cheklovlar bor), lokal holat saqlaydigan ilovalar.</li><li>Maxsus tarmoq/kernel ehtiyojlari.</li><li>Doimiy yuqori yuk — GKE arzonroq bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud Run Knative API'ga asoslangan — container'ingiz standart, vendor lock-in kam (xohlasangiz GKE'ga ko'chirasiz). Ilova <code>SIGTERM</code>ni qayta ishlashi va lokal diskka tayanmasligi kerak — instance istalgan paytda yo'qolishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40815	<p>Google Cloud Spanner nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Spanner — dunyo bo'ylab taqsimlangan, gorizontal masshtablanadigan <b>relational</b> DB: SQL, ACID tranzaksiyalar va <b>kuchli konsistentlik</b> global miqyosda. Odatda bu xususiyatlar bir-biriga zid (NoSQL masshtab beradi, lekin konsistentlikni yo'qotadi). Spanner buni <b>TrueTime</b> (aniq vaqt manbai) va Paxos replikatsiyasi bilan hal qiladi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>Oddiy PostgreSQL — bitta writer node; masshtab chegarasi bor. NoSQL (Cassandra) — masshtablanadi, lekin tranzaksiya va konsistentlik kafolatlari zaif. Bank yoki inventar tizimi ikkalasini xohlaydi.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><ul><li>Ma'lumot <b>split</b>'larga (kalit diapazonlari) bo'linadi; har split bir nechta replikaga ega (zonalar/regionlar bo'ylab), ular <b>Paxos</b> konsensusi bilan sinxron.</li><li>Yuk oshsa split'lar avtomatik bo'linadi va node'lar bo'ylab taqsimlanadi.</li><li><b>TrueTime</b>: atom soatlar va GPS asosidagi API, vaqtni noaniqlik oralig'i bilan qaytaradi (<code>[earliest, latest]</code>, odatda bir necha ms). Tranzaksiya commit'da shu noaniqlik o'tishini kutadi (&quot;commit wait&quot;) — natijada global <b>external consistency</b>: tranzaksiyalar tartibi haqiqiy vaqt tartibiga mos.</li></ul><h4>Imkoniyatlar</h4><ul><li>SQL (GoogleSQL va PostgreSQL dialekti), sekundary indekslar, tranzaksiyalar.</li><li>Regional (99.99%) yoki multi-region (99.999%) konfiguratsiya.</li><li>Qulfsiz konsistent o'qishlar eski vaqt nuqtasida (stale reads — tezroq).</li></ul><h4>Sxema dizayni — muhim</h4><ul><li><b>Hotspot</b>: monoton o'suvchi primary key (<code>AUTO_INCREMENT</code>, vaqt belgisi) — barcha yozuvlar bitta split'ga tushadi. UUIDv4 yoki bit-reversed sequence ishlating.</li><li><b>Interleaved tables</b>: bola jadval ota bilan bir joyda saqlanadi (<code>orders</code> -&gt; <code>order_items</code>) — join tez.</li></ul><h4>Trade-off'lar</h4><ul><li>Narx: kichik loyihalar uchun qimmat (garchi kichik &quot;processing units&quot; bor bo'lsa ham).</li><li>Multi-region yozuv latency'si — konsensus regionlararo RTT ga bog'liq.</li><li>Faqat GCP'da (CockroachDB, YugabyteDB — o'xshash g'oyali ochiq muqobillar).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CAP nuqtai nazaridan Spanner — <b>CP</b> tizim: tarmoq bo'linishida konsistentlikni tanlaydi. Lekin Google tarmog'ining ishonchliligi tufayli amalda juda yuqori mavjudlik beradi. Spanner'ni tanlash sababi — &quot;global konsistent yozuvlar kerak va sharding'ni o'zim boshqarishni xohlamayman&quot;.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40816	<p>Google BigQuery nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> BigQuery — serverless <b>data warehouse</b>: terabayt va petabayt hajmdagi ma'lumot ustida SQL so'rovlarni soniyalarda bajaradi, server yoki klaster boshqarmasdan. Tezligi ikki narsadan: <b>ustunli saqlash</b> (faqat kerakli ustunlar o'qiladi) va <b>massiv parallel bajarish</b> (so'rov minglab worker'larga bo'linadi).</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><ul><li><b>Storage</b> (Capacitor format, ustunli, siqilgan) va <b>compute</b> (Dremel) <b>ajratilgan</b> — ular mustaqil masshtablanadi.</li><li>So'rov daraxt shaklida bo'linadi, minglab &quot;slot&quot;lar (CPU birliklari) parallel skan qiladi va natijalarni birlashtiradi.</li><li>Ustunli saqlash: <code>SELECT user_id, amount FROM orders</code> — 100 ustunli jadvaldan faqat 2 ta ustun o'qiladi.</li></ul><h4>Narx modeli — muhim</h4><ul><li><b>On-demand</b>: <b>skan qilingan bayt</b> uchun to'lov (~$6.25/TB). <code>SELECT *</code> katta jadvalda — qimmat xato.</li><li><b>Capacity (editions)</b>: oldindan slot'lar sotib olish — barqaror yuk uchun.</li><li>Storage alohida (faol va uzoq muddatli — arzonroq).</li></ul><h4>Xarajat va tezlikni boshqarish</h4><ul><li><b>Partitioning</b> (odatda sana bo'yicha): <code>WHERE event_date = '2026-10-03'</code> — faqat bir kunlik ma'lumot skan qilinadi.</li><li><b>Clustering</b> (masalan <code>customer_id</code> bo'yicha) — partition ichida kerakli bloklarni o'tkazib yuborish.</li><li>Faqat kerakli ustunlar; <code>LIMIT</code> skanni <b>kamaytirmaydi</b>.</li><li>So'rovdan oldin &quot;dry run&quot; — necha bayt skan qilinishini ko'rsatadi.</li><li><code>require_partition_filter</code> — partition filtrisiz so'rov rad etiladi.</li></ul><h4>Ishlatilishi</h4><ul><li>Analitika, BI (Looker), hisobotlar.</li><li>Log va event tahlili (Cloud Logging -&gt; BigQuery eksport).</li><li>BigQuery ML — SQL bilan ML modellar.</li><li>Streaming insert va Storage Write API — real-vaqtga yaqin ma'lumot.</li></ul><h4>Qachon mos emas</h4><ul><li>OLTP (ko'p mayda yozuv/o'qish, past latency) — Cloud SQL/Spanner kerak.</li><li>Tez-tez bitta qatorni yangilash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> BigQuery'da eng katta xavf — nazoratsiz xarajat: bitta noto'g'ri dashboard har daqiqada 10TB skan qilsa, oyiga katta summa. Partition/cluster dizayni, kvotalar (foydalanuvchi bo'yicha kunlik skan limiti) va xarajat monitoringi — boshidan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud

Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40818	<p>Azure Resource Manager (ARM) va Bicep nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>ARM (Azure Resource Manager)</b> — Azure'ning boshqaruv qatlami: portal, CLI, SDK, Terraform — hammasi oxir-oqibat ARM API orqali resurs yaratadi; u autentifikatsiya, RBAC, policy va tag'larni bir joyda qo'llaydi. <b>Bicep</b> — Azure infrasini yozish uchun Microsoft'ning deklarativ tili; u <b>ARM template'ga (JSON)</b> compile bo'ladi, lekin o'qish va yozish ancha oson.</p><h4>ARM qatlami</h4><pre>Portal / az CLI / PowerShell / Terraform / Bicep<br>                  |<br>           Azure Resource Manager  (auth, RBAC, Policy, lock, tag)<br>                  |<br>       Resource provider'lar (Microsoft.Compute, Microsoft.Storage, ...)</pre><p>Resurslar <b>Resource Group</b> ichida — birga yaratiladigan va o'chiriladigan narsalar to'plami. Deploy idempotent: bir xil template'ni qayta qo'llash — o'zgarish faqat farq bo'lsa.</p><h4>ARM JSON vs Bicep</h4><p>ARM JSON — uzun va o'qish qiyin. Bir xil storage account Bicep'da:</p><pre>param location string = resourceGroup().location<br>param env string<br><br>resource sa 'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts@2023-05-01' = {<br>  name: 'stapp${env}${uniqueString(resourceGroup().id)}'<br>  location: location<br>  sku: { name: 'Standard_ZRS' }<br>  kind: 'StorageV2'<br>  properties: {<br>    minimumTlsVersion: 'TLS1_2'<br>    allowBlobPublicAccess: false<br>  }<br>}<br><br>output id string = sa.id</pre><pre>az deployment group what-if --resource-group rg-app --template-file main.bicep --parameters env=prod<br>az deployment group create  --resource-group rg-app --template-file main.bicep --parameters env=prod</pre><p><code>what-if</code> — Terraform <code>plan</code> analogi.</p><h4>Bicep afzalliklari</h4><ul><li><b>State fayli yo'q</b> — haqiqiy holat ARM'ning o'zida.</li><li>Yangi Azure xususiyatlari birinchi kundan qo'llanadi.</li><li>Modullar, tiplar, VS Code'da kuchli yordam.</li><li><b>Deployment stacks</b> — boshqariladigan resurslar to'plami, o'chirilganlarini tozalash.</li></ul><h4>Bicep vs Terraform</h4><p>| | Bicep | Terraform | |---|---|---| | Cloud | faqat Azure | ko'p cloud + SaaS | | State | yo'q (ARM) | state fayli | | Yangi xususiyatlar | darhol | provider yangilanishini kutadi | | Ekotizim | Azure | juda keng |</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Faqat Azure ishlatadigan jamoa uchun Bicep soddaroq (state boshqaruvi yo'q). Ko'p cloud yoki Azure'dan tashqari resurslar (DNS, monitoring SaaS) bo'lsa — Terraform. Ikkalasini bir resurs uchun aralashtirmang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud

Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40820	<p>Azure Virtual WAN nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Azure Virtual WAN — tarmoq ulanishlarini (filiallar VPN/SD-WAN orqali, data center ExpressRoute orqali, masofaviy foydalanuvchilar, turli regionlardagi VNet'lar) <b>bitta boshqariladigan &quot;hub-and-spoke&quot; tarmog'iga</b> birlashtiradigan servis. Hub'larni Microsoft boshqaradi va ular o'zaro Microsoft backbone orqali avtomatik ulanadi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>Ko'p region, o'nlab VNet, yuzlab filial. Qo'lda: har VNet uchun peering, har filial uchun VPN gateway, marshrut jadvallari — &quot;mesh&quot; murakkabligi o'sib boradi, xatolar ko'payadi.</p><h4>Tuzilishi</h4><pre>         Filiallar (SD-WAN/VPN)    Masofaviy userlar (P2S VPN)<br>                   \                    /<br>   Data center -- [Virtual Hub West Europe] ====== [Virtual Hub East US]<br>  (ExpressRoute)        |       |     (Microsoft backbone, avtomatik)  |<br>                     VNet-A   VNet-B                                 VNet-C</pre><ul><li><b>Virtual Hub</b> — har regionda Microsoft boshqaradigan tranzit tarmoq (gateway'lar, router).</li><li><b>Spoke</b> VNet'lar hub'ga ulanadi; hub'lar o'zaro <b>avtomatik</b> ulanadi — &quot;any-to-any&quot; ulanish.</li><li>Marshrutlar avtomatik tarqatiladi (BGP).</li></ul><h4>Imkoniyatlar</h4><ul><li>Site-to-site VPN, point-to-site VPN, ExpressRoute — bitta hub'da.</li><li><b>Secured hub</b>: Azure Firewall (yoki uchinchi tomon NVA) hub ichida, routing intent bilan barcha trafik firewall'dan o'tadi.</li><li>SD-WAN provayderlari bilan integratsiya.</li><li>Basic va Standard SKU (to'liq imkoniyatlar Standard'da).</li></ul><h4>Qachon mos</h4><ul><li>Ko'p region + ko'p filial + gibrid ulanish — global tarmoq.</li><li>Markazlashgan xavfsizlik nazorati kerak.</li></ul><h4>Qachon ortiqcha</h4><p>Bitta-ikki region, bir nechta VNet — oddiy hub-and-spoke (o'z hub VNet'i, peering, Azure Firewall) arzonroq va moslashuvchanroq.</p><h4>AWS analoglari</h4><p>Transit Gateway (regional hub) va Cloud WAN (global, policy asosida).</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Virtual WAN boshqaruvni soddalashtiradi, lekin nazoratni ham kamaytiradi: hub ichida maxsus marshrutlash va NVA joylashuvi cheklangan. Arxitektura tanlovida tarmoq jamoasining murakkab routing ehtiyojlari va narx (hub soatlik + ma'lumot qayta ishlash) hisobga olinadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40821	<p>Azure Front Door va Application Gateway farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham L7 (HTTP) load balancer va WAF beradi, farq — <b>qamrov</b>. <b>Front Door</b> — <b>global</b>: Microsoft'ning yuzlab edge nuqtalarida ishlaydi, foydalanuvchini eng yaqin edge'ga olib keladi va eng sog'lom/yaqin <b>regionga</b> yo'naltiradi (CDN ham). <b>Application Gateway</b> — <b>regional</b>: bitta region ichida, VNet'da joylashgan va shu regiondagi backend'lar orasida taqsimlaydi.</p><h4>Taqqoslash</h4><p>| | Front Door | Application Gateway | |---|---|---| | Qamrov | global (Anycast, edge) | regional (VNet ichida) | | Vazifa | regionlararo yo'naltirish, failover, CDN, edge'da TLS | region ichida backend'lar orasida | | Backend | internetdan ko'rinadigan (yoki Private Link — Premium) | VNet ichidagi private IP'lar ham | | Kesh | bor (CDN) | yo'q | | WAF | edge'da | region darajasida | | Ichki (private) LB | yo'q | bor (private frontend) |</p><h4>Odatiy kombinatsiya</h4><pre>Foydalanuvchi -&gt; Front Door (edge: TLS, WAF, kesh, global routing)<br>                   |                          |<br>       App Gateway (West Europe)     App Gateway (East US)<br>          |    (VNet ichida)                |<br>        AKS / VM'lar                     AKS / VM'lar</pre><ul><li>Front Door: region o'lsa — sog'lom regionga failover; statik kontent edge'da.</li><li>Application Gateway: region ichida path-based routing, AKS ingress (AGIC), private backend'lar.</li><li>Backend'larni faqat Front Door trafigi bilan cheklash: <code>X-Azure-FDID</code> header tekshiruvi yoki Private Link.</li></ul><h4>Qachon nima</h4><ul><li>Bitta region, ichki ilova — faqat Application Gateway.</li><li>Global foydalanuvchilar, ko'p region, CDN — Front Door.</li><li>Ikkalasi — ko'p regionli, private backend'li tizim.</li><li>L4 (TCP/UDP) kerak bo'lsa — Azure Load Balancer (regional) yoki cross-region Load Balancer.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;Ikki marta WAF&quot; va ikki qatlam TLS — latency va narxni oshiradi; har qatlamning aniq vazifasi bo'lsin. Health probe'lar ham ikki darajada — Front Door App Gateway'ni, App Gateway backend'ni tekshiradi; noto'g'ri sozlangan probe yolg'on failover'ga olib keladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40822	<p>Azure Cosmos DB va uning consistency modellari qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cosmos DB — Azure'ning global taqsimlangan NoSQL DB'si (bir nechta API: NoSQL/document, MongoDB, Cassandra, Gremlin, Table). Asosiy xususiyati — <b>beshta konsistentlik darajasi</b>: eng qat'iy (Strong) dan eng bo'sh (Eventual) gacha. Har daraja — <b>konsistentlik</b> va <b>latency/mavjudlik/narx</b> o'rtasidagi tanlov.</p><h4>Beshta daraja (kuchlidan kuchsizga)</h4><p>| Daraja | Kafolat | Misol | |---|---|---| | <b>Strong</b> | har o'qish oxirgi tasdiqlangan yozuvni ko'radi (linearizability) | bank balansi | | <b>Bounded Staleness</b> | ko'pi bilan K versiya yoki T vaqt orqada | narxlar, reyting — &quot;5 soniyadan eski emas&quot; | | <b>Session</b> (default) | o'z sessiyangiz ichida: o'z yozuvlaringizni ko'rasiz, tartib saqlanadi | foydalanuvchi profili, savat | | <b>Consistent Prefix</b> | tartib buzilmaydi (A, B, C — hech qachon A, C) lekin kechikishi mumkin | chat, ijtimoiy lenta | | <b>Eventual</b> | oxir-oqibat bir xil, tartib kafolati yo'q | layk soni, statistika |</p><h4>Nega muhim</h4><p>Global replikatsiyada (masalan Yevropa va AQSh):</p><ul><li><b>Strong</b> — yozuv barcha regionlarda tasdiqlanishi kerak: yuqori latency, multi-region yozuv bilan ishlatilmaydi.</li><li><b>Session</b> — eng ko'p holatlar uchun yetarli: foydalanuvchi o'zgarish qilsa, darhol ko'radi; boshqalar biroz kechikib.</li><li>Kuchsizroq darajalar — arzonroq (o'qish kamroq Request Unit oladi) va tezroq.</li></ul><h4>Boshqa asosiy tushunchalar</h4><ul><li><b>Request Units (RU)</b> — barcha operatsiyalar narxi RU'da; provisioned throughput yoki serverless.</li><li><b>Partition key</b> — eng muhim dizayn qarori: teng taqsimlanuvchi va so'rovlarda ishlatiladigan maydon (<code>tenantId</code>, <code>userId</code>). Noto'g'ri tanlov — hot partition va qimmat cross-partition so'rovlar.</li><li><b>Multi-region writes</b> — har regionda yozish (konflikt hal qilish siyosati bilan: last-writer-wins yoki maxsus).</li><li>99.999% SLA (multi-region).</li></ul><h4>Tanlash</h4><p>Ko'p hollarda <b>Session</b> — to'g'ri default. Strong faqat haqiqatan global linearizability kerak bo'lsa va latency qabul qilinsa. Darajani so'rov bo'yicha kuchsizlantirish mumkin (kuchaytirish emas).</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konsistentlik darajasini ilova talabidan kelib chiqib tanlang: &quot;foydalanuvchi o'z o'zgarishini darhol ko'rishi kerakmi?&quot; (Session), &quot;boshqa foydalanuvchi ham darhol ko'rishi shartmi?&quot; (Strong). Partition key xatosini keyin tuzatish qimmat — ma'lumotni yangi konteynerga ko'chirish talab qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40823	<p>GCP Pub/Sub nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pub/Sub — GCP'ning boshqariladigan <b>xabar almashish</b> servisi: producer'lar xabarni <b>topic</b>'ga yuboradi, har <b>subscription</b> xabarlar nusxasini oladi va consumer'larga yetkazadi. Server yoki partition boshqaruvi yo'q — avtomatik masshtablanadi. Servislarni bir-biridan ajratish (asinxron), event tarqatish va yukni buferlash uchun.</p><h4>Model</h4><pre>Producer -&gt; Topic &quot;orders&quot;<br>              |-- Subscription &quot;billing&quot;   -&gt; billing servis (pull)<br>              |-- Subscription &quot;analytics&quot; -&gt; BigQuery (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri)<br>              |-- Subscription &quot;email&quot;     -&gt; Cloud Run (push, HTTP)</pre><p>Har subscription mustaqil: har biri barcha xabarlarni oladi (fan-out).</p><h4>Asosiy tushunchalar</h4><ul><li><b>Pull</b>: consumer o'zi oladi (yuqori throughput, oqim boshqaruvi). <b>Push</b>: Pub/Sub HTTP endpoint'ga yuboradi (Cloud Run, Functions).</li><li><b>Ack</b>: consumer xabarni qayta ishlab tasdiqlaydi. <code>ackDeadline</code> ichida tasdiqlanmasa — qayta yetkaziladi.</li><li><b>At-least-once</b> (default) — dublikatlar bo'lishi mumkin; consumer <b>idempotent</b> bo'lishi kerak. <b>Exactly-once delivery</b> opsiyasi (pull, bitta region ichida) bor.</li><li><b>Ordering keys</b> — bir xil kalitli xabarlar tartibda (masalan <code>order_id</code> bo'yicha). Busiz tartib kafolatlanmaydi.</li><li><b>Dead-letter topic</b> — N marta muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lgan xabar alohida topic'ga, oqim to'xtamaydi.</li><li><b>Retention</b>: tasdiqlanmagan xabarlar 7 kungacha (31 gacha sozlanadi); <b>seek</b> — vaqt nuqtasiga qaytib qayta ishlash.</li><li><b>Filtrlash</b>: subscription faqat atributlari mos xabarlarni oladi.</li></ul><h4>Misol</h4><pre>gcloud pubsub topics create orders<br>gcloud pubsub subscriptions create billing --topic=orders \<br>  --ack-deadline=60 --dead-letter-topic=orders-dlq --max-delivery-attempts=5 \<br>  --enable-message-ordering</pre><h4>Kafka bilan farqi</h4><p>| | Pub/Sub | Kafka | |---|---|---| | Boshqaruv | to'liq managed, partition yo'q | partition, broker (yoki MSK/Confluent) | | Tartib | ordering key bilan | partition ichida | | Replay | seek (retention ichida) | offset bo'yicha, uzoq retention | | Consumer modeli | per-message ack | offset commit | | Stream processing | Dataflow bilan | Kafka Streams, Flink |</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pub/Sub'da eng ko'p uchraydigan muammolar — idempotentlik yo'qligi (dublikat qayta ishlash) va <code>ackDeadline</code>dan uzoq ishlov (xabar qayta yetkaziladi va ish ikki marta bajariladi). Uzoq vazifalarda deadline'ni uzaytirish (client kutubxonalari avtomatik qiladi) yoki ishni boshqa joyga topshirib tez ack qilish.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40824	<p>GCP Anthos (Google Distributed Cloud) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Anthos (hozir <b>GKE Enterprise</b> va <b>Google Distributed Cloud</b> nomlari ostida) — Kubernetes klasterlarini <b>qayerda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar</b> (GCP, on-prem, AWS, Azure, edge) bitta joydan boshqarish platformasi: umumiy konfiguratsiya, policy, service mesh va observability. Maqsad — gibrid va multi-cloud muhitda bir xil operatsion model.</p><h4>Tarkibiy qismlar</h4><ul><li><b>Fleet</b> — barcha klasterlar ro'yxati va guruhlanishi (qayerda bo'lishidan qat'i nazar).</li><li><b>Config Sync</b> — GitOps: Git'dagi konfiguratsiya barcha klasterlarga avtomatik qo'llanadi.</li><li><b>Policy Controller</b> (OPA Gatekeeper asosida) — xavfsizlik va compliance qoidalari hamma klasterda.</li><li><b>Cloud Service Mesh</b> (Istio asosida) — klasterlararo mTLS, trafik boshqaruvi.</li><li><b>Connect gateway</b> — boshqa joydagi klasterlarga Google Cloud konsol va IAM orqali kirish.</li><li>GDC: on-prem (VMware yoki bare metal) va hatto internetsiz (air-gapped) variantlar.</li></ul><h4>Qachon mos</h4><ul><li>Ma'lumot on-prem'da qolishi shart (regulyator), lekin bulutdagidek boshqaruv kerak.</li><li>Ko'p klaster va muhitlarda yagona policy/konfiguratsiya.</li><li>Bosqichma-bosqich on-prem'dan bulutga o'tish.</li></ul><h4>Trade-off'lar</h4><ul><li>Narx (vCPU bo'yicha litsenziya) va murakkablik.</li><li>Google ekotizimiga bog'liqlik.</li><li>Ochiq muqobillar: ArgoCD/Flux (GitOps), Kyverno/Gatekeeper, Istio, Rancher, Cluster API — o'zingiz yig'asiz, lekin vendor'dan mustaqil. Azure Arc va AWS EKS Anywhere — boshqa provayderlarning analoglari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Gibrid platformalarning asosiy qiymati — texnologiya emas, <b>bir xil operatsion model</b>: bitta GitOps oqimi, bitta policy to'plami, bitta kirish nazorati. Agar tashkilotda bu ehtiyoj bo'lmasa (bitta cloud, kam klaster), bunday platforma ortiqcha murakkablik.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40825	<p>Multi-cloud strategiyasi nima va trade-off'lari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multi-cloud — ish yuklarini <b>bir nechta</b> cloud provayderda yuritish. Sabablar: vendor lock-in xavfini kamaytirish, har provayderning eng yaxshi servisini olish, regulyator talablari, kompaniya qo'shilishlari. Ko'p tashkilotlar uchun <b>bitta cloud'da multi-region</b> yetarli.</p><h4>Multi-cloud turlari</h4><ol><li><b>Workload bo'yicha tanlov</b> (eng keng tarqalgan): analitika GCP BigQuery'da, asosiy ilovalar AWS'da, ofis Azure/M365'da. Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40826	<p>AWS Control Tower va Landing Zone nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Landing Zone</b> — xavfsiz, masshtablanadigan <b>ko'p akkauntli</b> AWS muhitining tayyor asosi: akkaunt tuzilmasi, markaziy identity (SSO), markaziy log'lar, xavfsizlik guardrail'lari va tarmoq. <b>Control Tower</b> — bunday landing zone'ni avtomatik quradigan va boshqaradigan AWS servisi. Maqsad: har yangi akkaunt birinchi kundan to'g'ri sozlangan holda tug'ilsin.</p><h4>Nega ko'p akkaunt</h4><p>Bitta akkauntda hamma narsa: dev xatosi prod'ni buzadi, huquqlarni ajratish qiyin, xarajatni taqsimlash qiyin, limitlar umumiy. Akkaunt — AWS'dagi eng kuchli izolyatsiya chegarasi.</p><h4>Control Tower nima yaratadi</h4><pre>Management account (faqat billing va boshqaruv)<br> |- Security OU<br> |    |- Log Archive account   (barcha CloudTrail, Config log'lari, o'zgarmas)<br> |    |- Audit account         (xavfsizlik jamoasi, Security Hub, GuardDuty delegated admin)<br> |- Sandbox OU<br> |- Workloads OU<br>      |- Prod OU  -&gt; app-prod akkauntlari<br>      |- NonProd OU -&gt; app-dev, app-staging</pre><ul><li><b>IAM Identity Center</b> — SSO, hamma akkauntlarga markaziy kirish (permission set'lar).</li><li><b>Guardrail'lar (controls)</b>:</li><li><b>Preventive</b> — SCP'lar: masalan &quot;CloudTrail'ni o'chirib bo'lmaydi&quot;, &quot;faqat ruxsat etilgan regionlar&quot;.</li><li><b>Detective</b> — AWS Config qoidalari: &quot;shifrlanmagan EBS bor&quot;.</li><li><b>Proactive</b> — CloudFormation hook'lari: yaratishdan oldin tekshirish.</li><li><b>Account Factory</b> — yangi akkauntni standart sozlamalar bilan yaratish (Service Catalog yoki <b>AFT</b> — Terraform orqali).</li></ul><h4>Control Tower'siz</h4><p>Landing zone'ni o'zingiz qurish mumkin (Terraform, Organizations, SCP) — ko'proq nazorat, ko'proq ish. Control Tower — tezroq boshlanish va AWS qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan standart.</p><h4>Amaliy maslahatlar</h4><ul><li>Management akkauntida <b>hech qanday</b> ish yuki yo'q.</li><li>Tarmoq uchun alohida akkaunt (Transit Gateway, egress, DNS).</li><li>Akkaunt yaratishni avtomatlashtirish (AFT) — har jamoa/servis/muhit uchun akkaunt &quot;arzon&quot; bo'lsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Landing zone — bir martalik loyiha emas, platforma mahsuloti: yangi guardrail'lar, akkaunt so'rovlari, istisnolar jarayoni. Uni boshidan to'g'ri qurish ko'p yil davomida xavfsizlik va xarajat nazoratini osonlashtiradi; keyin tuzatish esa ancha qiyin.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40827	<p>AWS Organizational Unit (OU) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OU (Organizational Unit) — AWS Organizations ichida akkauntlarni <b>guruhlash</b> uchun &quot;papka&quot;. Asosiy maqsadi — <b>policy'larni guruh bo'yicha qo'llash</b>: OU'ga biriktirilgan SCP (Service Control Policy) undagi barcha akkauntlarga va ichki OU'larga <b>meros</b> bo'lib o'tadi. Shunday qilib yuzlab akkauntni bir nechta qoida bilan boshqarish mumkin.</p><h4>Tuzilma misoli</h4><pre>Root<br> |- Security OU      (log archive, audit)<br> |- Infrastructure OU (network, shared services)<br> |- Workloads OU<br> |    |- Prod OU       &lt;- qat'iy SCP'lar<br> |    |- NonProd OU    &lt;- yumshoqroq<br> |- Sandbox OU        &lt;- byudjet limitlari, prod tarmog'iga ulanish yo'q<br> |- Suspended OU      &lt;- yopilayotgan akkauntlar, hamma narsa Deny</pre><h4>SCP qanday ishlaydi</h4><p>SCP — <b>ruxsat bermaydi</b>, faqat <b>chegara</b> qo'yadi: akkauntdagi hech kim (hatto root) SCP ruxsat bermagan amalni bajara olmaydi. Haqiqiy ruxsat IAM policy'dan keladi; SCP — uning ustidagi &quot;tom&quot;.</p><pre>{<br>  &quot;Version&quot;: &quot;2012-10-17&quot;,<br>  &quot;Statement&quot;: [{<br>    &quot;Sid&quot;: &quot;DenyOutsideAllowedRegions&quot;,<br>    &quot;Effect&quot;: &quot;Deny&quot;,<br>    &quot;NotAction&quot;: [&quot;iam:*&quot;, &quot;sts:*&quot;, &quot;organizations:*&quot;, &quot;support:*&quot;],<br>    &quot;Resource&quot;: &quot;*&quot;,<br>    &quot;Condition&quot;: { &quot;StringNotEquals&quot;: { &quot;aws:RequestedRegion&quot;: [&quot;eu-west-1&quot;, &quot;eu-central-1&quot;] } }<br>  }]<br>}</pre><p>Bu SCP OU'ga biriktirilsa — undagi barcha akkauntlarda boshqa regionlarda resurs yaratib bo'lmaydi (global servislar istisno).</p><h4>Odatiy SCP'lar</h4><ul><li>CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Config'ni o'chirishni taqiqlash.</li><li>Organizatsiyadan chiqishni taqiqlash.</li><li>Root foydalanuvchi amallarini cheklash.</li><li>Faqat ruxsat etilgan regionlar.</li><li>S3 public access block'ni o'chirishni taqiqlash.</li></ul><h4>Dizayn tamoyillari</h4><ul><li>OU'larni <b>policy ehtiyoji</b> bo'yicha tuzing (prod/non-prod/sandbox), <b>tashkiliy tuzilma</b> bo'yicha emas (jamoalar o'zgaradi, policy'lar kamroq).</li><li>Sayoz ierarxiya (2–3 daraja) — tushunish va debug oson.</li><li>SCP'larni avval test OU'da sinash — noto'g'ri <code>Deny</code> butun prod'ni to'xtatishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SCP'lar management akkauntiga ta'sir qilmaydi — shuning uchun u yerda hech qanday ish yuki bo'lmasligi kerak. Murakkab SCP'larni debug qilishda CloudTrail'dagi <code>AccessDenied</code> xabari &quot;explicit deny in a service control policy&quot; deb ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40828	<p>Cloud FinOps va FinOps lifecycle nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> FinOps — cloud xarajatini <b>muhandislik, moliya va biznes</b> birgalikda boshqaradigan amaliyot. Maqsad &quot;xarajatni kamaytirish&quot; emas, har sarflangan dollardan <b>maksimal biznes qiymati</b> olish. Uch takrorlanuvchi faza: <b>Inform</b> (ko'rish), <b>Optimize</b> (yaxshilash), <b>Operate</b> (doimiy boshqarish).</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Cloud'da har muhandis bir buyruq bilan pul sarflaydi. Optimize — yaxshilash</h4><ul><li><b>Foydalanish optimizatsiyasi</b> (kamroq ishlatish): rightsizing, ishlatilmayotgan resurslarni o'chirish, non-prod'ni kechasi o'chirish, storage lifecycle, arxitektura (serverless, Spot).</li><li><b>Narx optimizatsiyasi</b> (arzonroq to'lash): Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, Spot, Graviton, provayder bilan chegirmalar.</li><li>Tartib: avval foydalanishni, keyin narxni — aks holda isrofga uzoq muddatli majburiyat olasiz.</li></ul><h4>3.
