O'z xarajatini ko'rmagan jamoa uni optimallashtirmaydi. Shuningdek, xarajat har doim <b>qiymat</b> bilan solishtiriladi: xarajat 20% o'sdi, lekin daromad 50% o'sdi — bu yaxshi natija.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40829	<p>AWS Cost &amp; Usage Report (CUR) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CUR (Cost and Usage Report, hozir <b>CUR 2.0 / Data Exports</b>) — AWS xarajati va foydalanishi haqidagi <b>eng batafsil</b> ma'lumot: har resurs, har soat, har narx elementi bo'yicha qator. Cost Explorer — yuqori darajadagi ko'rinish; CUR — xom ma'lumot.</p><h4>Nimasi bor</h4><ul><li>Resurs ID'si (<code>i-0abc...</code>), servis, region, foydalanish turi (<code>BoxUsage:m5.large</code>), miqdor, narx.</li><li><b>Tag'lar</b> (cost allocation tag sifatida yoqilganlari) — jamoa/servis bo'yicha taqsimlash.</li><li>Chegirmalar: Savings Plans va RI qanday qo'llangani (amortizatsiya), kreditlar, soliqlar.</li><li>Ko'p akkaunt — butun organizatsiya bitta hisobotda.</li></ul><h4>Sozlash va so'rov</h4><ol><li>Billing -&gt; Data Exports -&gt; CUR 2.0, Parquet, S3 bucket.</li><li>Athena integratsiyasi (Glue jadvali avtomatik).</li></ol><pre>SELECT resource_tags['user_team'] AS team,<br>       line_item_product_code     AS service,<br>       round(sum(line_item_unblended_cost), 2) AS cost<br>FROM cur<br>WHERE billing_period = '2026-09'<br>GROUP BY 1, 2<br>ORDER BY cost DESC<br>LIMIT 20;</pre><h4>Qachon CUR kerak</h4><ul><li>Jamoa/servis bo'yicha aniq taqsimlash va chargeback.</li><li>Unit economics (biznes ma'lumotlari bilan birlashtirish).</li><li>Kubecost, CloudHealth, Vantage kabi FinOps vositalari uchun manba.</li><li>Anomaliyalarni chuqur tekshirish (&quot;qaysi resurs bu sakrashni berdi?&quot;).</li></ul><h4>Nozik joylar</h4><ul><li><b>Unblended vs amortized</b> xarajat: commitment'lar oldindan to'langan bo'lsa, amortized ko'rinish haqiqiy kundalik narxni ko'rsatadi.</li><li>Tag'lar faqat cost allocation tag sifatida <b>yoqilgandan keyin</b> paydo bo'ladi (orqaga emas).</li><li>Ma'lumot kechikadi (soatlar) va oy davomida yangilanadi.</li><li>Hajm katta — Parquet va partition'lar bilan ishlash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CUR — FinOps'ning &quot;haqiqat manbai&quot;. Ko'p tashkilotlar Cost Explorer bilan cheklanib, savollarga javob topa olmaydi. CUR'ni boshidan yoqing — tarixiy ma'lumotni keyin olish mumkin emas.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40830	<p>FinOps'da Infracost qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Infracost — Terraform o'zgarishining <b>oylik xarajatga ta'sirini</b> PR'ning o'zida ko'rsatadi: &quot;bu PR oyiga +$842 qo'shadi&quot;. Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40831	<p>Cloud optimizatsiyasida Kubernetes right-sizing nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Rightsizing — pod'larning <code>requests</code> va <code>limits</code> qiymatlarini <b>haqiqiy ishlatishga</b> moslash. Muammo: jamoalar &quot;ehtiyot uchun&quot; katta qiymatlar so'raydi; scheduler esa node'ni <b>request</b> bo'yicha band deb hisoblaydi. Natija — node'lar &quot;to'la&quot;, lekin haqiqiy CPU 10–20%. Rightsizing bu bo'sh joyni qaytaradi — odatda eng katta K8s tejash manbai.</p><h4>Nega request muhim</h4><pre>Node: 8 CPU<br>Pod A: request 2 CPU, ishlatadi 0.2<br>Pod B: request 2 CPU, ishlatadi 0.3<br>Pod C: request 2 CPU, ishlatadi 0.1<br>Pod D: request 2 CPU, ishlatadi 0.2<br>-&gt; scheduler: node TO'LA (8/8). Haqiqatda: 0.8/8 = 10%.</pre><p>Siz 8 CPU uchun to'laysiz, 0.8 ishlatiladi.</p><h4>Jarayon</h4><ol><li><b>O'lchash</b> — kamida 1–2 hafta (haftalik ritmni qamrash uchun) haqiqiy foydalanish:</li></ol><pre>quantile_over_time(0.95, rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!=&quot;&quot;}[5m])[7d:5m])<br>max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!=&quot;&quot;}[7d])</pre><ol><li><b>Tavsiya</b> — VPA (recommendation rejimi), Goldilocks, Kubecost:</li><li>CPU request ≈ p95 ishlatish + kichik zaxira.</li><li>Memory request ≈ maksimal ishlatish + 10–20%.</li><li><b>Qo'llash</b> — PR orqali, jamoa bilan; avval non-prod, keyin prod.</li><li><b>Kuzatish</b> — OOMKill, throttling, latency.</li></ol><h4>Limitlar bo'yicha qoidalar</h4><ul><li><b>Memory</b>: <code>limit = request</code> (yoki yaqin). Xotira &quot;siqib&quot; bo'lmaydi — limit oshsa OOMKill; request'dan ko'p ishlatish node bosimida evict xavfi.</li><li><b>CPU</b>: limit ko'pincha <b>qo'yilmaydi</b> — limit throttling'ga olib keladi (o'rtacha past bo'lsa ham). Request adolatli taqsimotni ta'minlaydi.</li></ul><h4>Avtomatlashtirish</h4><ul><li>VPA <code>Auto</code> rejimi — pod'larni qayta yaratib qiymatlarni o'zgartiradi (HPA bilan CPU bo'yicha birga ishlatilmaydi).</li><li>K8s 1.33+ in-place resize — restart'siz o'zgartirish.</li><li>Request'siz pod'larni rad etish (Kyverno) va LimitRange default'lari.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rightsizing — bir martalik emas: ilova o'zgaradi, yuk o'zgaradi. Doimiy jarayon kerak (oylik tavsiyalar, dashboard'da &quot;request vs usage&quot; farqi jamoa bo'yicha). Rightsizing'dan keyin Karpenter consolidation bo'shagan node'larni haqiqatan olib tashlaydi — ikkalasi birga ishlaganda tejash paydo bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40832	<p>Cloud egress xarajati nima va qanday kamaytiriladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Egress — ma'lumot cloud'dan <b>chiqqanda</b> olinadigan to'lov: internetga, boshqa regionga, ba'zan boshqa AZ'ga. Kiruvchi trafik odatda bepul, chiquvchi esa GB uchun to'lanadi (AWS internetga ~$0.09/GB). Katta hajmda bu hisobning sezilarli qismi bo'ladi. Kamaytirish: <b>CDN</b>, <b>trafikni chiqarmaslik</b> (VPC endpoint, bir AZ/region ichida saqlash), <b>siqish</b> va arxitektura.</p><h4>Egress turlari va narx (AWS, taxminiy)</h4><p>| Yo'nalish | Narx | |---|---| | Internetdan kirish | bepul | | Internetga chiqish | ~$0.05–0.09/GB (hajmga qarab) | | Regionlararo | ~$0.02/GB | | AZ'lararo (bir region) | ~$0.01/GB har yo'nalish | | NAT Gateway orqali | + $0.045/GB qayta ishlash | | CloudFront -&gt; internet | odatda S3/EC2'dan arzonroq, origin -&gt; CloudFront bepul |</p><h4>Kamaytirish usullari</h4><p><b>1. CDN</b> Statik kontent (rasmlar, JS, video) CloudFront/Cloudflare orqali: kesh hit'larda origin'dan chiqish yo'q, CDN narxi past. Origin -&gt; CloudFront trafigi AWS'da bepul.</p><p><b>2. VPC endpoint'lar</b> S3/DynamoDB gateway endpoint (bepul), boshqa servislar uchun interface endpoint — NAT Gateway qayta ishlash to'lovi yo'q.</p><p><b>3. Joylashuv</b></p><ul><li>Chatty servislar va ularning DB'si bir regionda.</li><li>Topology-aware routing — K8s'da trafik imkon qadar bir AZ ichida.</li><li>Replikatsiya va backup'larni rejalashtirish (regionlararo nusxa haqiqatan kerakmi?).</li></ul><p><b>4. Hajmni kamaytirish</b></p><ul><li>Siqish (gzip/brotli/zstd) — API javoblari, log'lar.</li><li>Keraksiz ma'lumotni yubormaslik (pagination, faqat kerakli maydonlar).</li><li>Delta sinxronizatsiya, to'liq nusxa emas.</li></ul><p><b>5. Monitoring</b> CUR'da <code>DataTransfer</code> qatorlari; VPC Flow Logs — kim qayerga qancha yuboryapti.</p><p><b>6. Shartnoma</b> Katta hajmda provayder bilan chegirma; ba'zi provayderlar (Cloudflare R2) egress to'lovisiz storage beradi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Egress — arxitektura qarorlarida ko'pincha e'tiborsiz qoladigan xarajat: multi-region, multi-cloud, va &quot;har narsani har joyga replikatsiya&quot; dizaynlari hisobni keskin oshiradi. Dizayn bosqichida ma'lumot oqimlarini va ularning hajmini hisoblang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud

Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40840	<p>CIEM (Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CIEM — cloud'dagi <b>identity va huquqlarni</b> boshqarish: kim (odam, service account, role) <b>nimaga</b> kira oladi, aslida <b>nimani ishlatadi</b> va farq qanchalik. Cloud'dagi buzilishlarning katta qismi ortiqcha huquqli identity'lar orqali kengayadi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><ul><li>Minglab IAM role, service account va policy; &quot;ishlashi uchun&quot; keng huquqlar (<code>*:*</code>, <code>AdministratorAccess</code>).</li><li>Huquqlar faqat qo'shiladi, deyarli hech qachon olib tashlanmaydi.</li><li>Murakkab zanjirlar: A role B'ni assume qiladi, B esa <code>iam:PassRole</code> bilan admin role'ni beradi — yashirin eskalatsiya yo'li.</li><li>Multi-cloud'da har provayderning o'z modeli.</li></ul><h4>CIEM nima qiladi</h4><ol><li><b>Effektiv huquqlarni hisoblash</b>: identity policy + resource policy + SCP + permission boundary + session policy — haqiqatda nima mumkin.</li><li><b>Foydalanish bilan solishtirish</b> (CloudTrail va boshqalar): &quot;bu role 50 servisga ruxsatga ega, 90 kunda 3 tasini ishlatgan&quot;.</li><li><b>Xavfli yo'llarni topish</b>: privilege escalation zanjirlari, tashqi akkauntlarga ishonch, ishlatilmagan admin'lar.</li><li><b>Tuzatish</b>: haqiqiy foydalanish asosida qisqartirilgan policy taklifi; ishlatilmagan identity'larni o'chirish.</li></ol><h4>Vositalar</h4><ul><li>Native: IAM Access Analyzer (unused access, policy generatsiya), GCP IAM Recommender, Microsoft Entra Permissions Management.</li><li>Tijorat: Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Sonrai, Ermetic (Tenable).</li><li>Ochiq: PMapper (AWS privilege escalation grafigi), Cloudsplaining.</li></ul><h4>Amaliy jarayon</h4><ul><li>Har identity'ning egasi (tag) — egasiz identity'lar ro'yxati.</li><li>Kvartal bo'yicha &quot;ishlatilmagan huquqlarni olib tashlash&quot; tsikli.</li><li>Yangi policy'lar CI'da tekshiruv (keng <code>*</code> taqiqlangan).</li><li>Odamlar uchun doimiy huquq o'rniga JIT.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Least privilege'ga &quot;boshidan to'g'ri yozish&quot; bilan erishib bo'lmaydi — kerakli huquqlarni oldindan bilish qiyin. Amaliy yo'l: boshlanishda kengroq, <b>kuzatish</b> asosida toraytirish — CIEM va Access Analyzer aynan shu siklni ma'lumot bilan ta'minlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud

*)<br><br>resources:<br>  Resources:<br>    OrdersTable:<br>      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table<br>      Properties:<br>        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.TABLE}<br>        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST<br>        AttributeDefinitions: [{ AttributeName: id, AttributeType: S }]<br>        KeySchema: [{ AttributeName: id, KeyType: HASH }]</pre><pre>serverless deploy --stage prod<br>serverless invoke -f create --data '{&quot;body&quot;:&quot;{}&quot;}'<br>serverless logs -f create --tail</pre><h4>Kuchli tomonlari</h4><ul><li>Juda tez boshlash, oddiy sintaksis.</li><li>Stage'lar (dev/prod) va o'zgaruvchilar tizimi.</li><li>Plugin'lar: <code>serverless-offline</code> (lokal), bundling, domen boshqaruvi va h.k.</li></ul><h4>E'tiborga olish kerak</h4><ul><li><b>v4 litsenziyasi</b>: katta kompaniyalar (yillik daromad chegarasidan yuqori) uchun pullik; v3 va ochiq fork'lar (masalan <b>oss-serverless</b>) mavjud.</li><li>&quot;Multi-cloud&quot; — nazariy jihatdan; amalda konfiguratsiya har provayder uchun boshqacha.</li><li>Murakkab infra uchun CloudFormation <code>resources</code> bo'limi tez kattalashadi — CDK/Terraform bilan birga ishlatiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Framework tanlovida uzoq muddatli boshqaruvni o'ylang: litsenziya, jamoaning mavjud IaC vositasi va plugin'lar ishonchliligi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40845	<p>AWS CDK nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS CDK — infratuzilmani <b>haqiqiy dasturlash tillarida</b> (TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, C#) yozish imkonini beradi. Kod <b>CloudFormation template</b>ga aylantiriladi (&quot;synthesize&quot;) va CloudFormation uni deploy qiladi. Asosiy afzallik — <b>abstraksiyalar</b> (constructs): bir necha qator kod to'g'ri sozlangan ko'plab resurslarni yaratadi, va til imkoniyatlari (sikl, funksiya, tip, test) ishlatiladi.</p><h4>Misol (TypeScript)</h4><pre>import * as cdk from 'aws-cdk-lib';<br>import * as ec2 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-ec2';<br>import * as ecs from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-ecs';<br>import * as patterns from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-ecs-patterns';<br><br>export class ApiStack extends cdk.Stack {<br>  constructor(scope: cdk.App, id: string, props?: cdk.StackProps) {<br>    super(scope, id, props);<br>    const vpc = new ec2.Vpc(this, 'Vpc', { maxAzs: 3 });<br>    const cluster = new ecs.Cluster(this, 'Cluster', { vpc });<br><br>    new patterns.ApplicationLoadBalancedFargateService(this, 'Api', {<br>      cluster,<br>      cpu: 512, memoryLimitMiB: 1024, desiredCount: 3,<br>      taskImageOptions: { image: ecs.ContainerImage.fromAsset('./app'), containerPort: 8080 },<br>    });<br>  }<br>}</pre><p>Bu ~15 qator: VPC (subnet'lar, NAT, route'lar), ECS klaster, ALB, target group, security group'lar, task definition, IAM role'lar, log group — yuzlab qator CloudFormation.</p><h4>Constructs darajalari</h4><ul><li><b>L1</b> (<code>CfnBucket</code>) — CloudFormation resursining aynan nusxasi.</li><li><b>L2</b> (<code>Bucket</code>) — xavfsiz default'lar va qulay metodlar (<code>bucket.grantRead(role)</code> — IAM policy avtomatik).</li><li><b>L3 / patterns</b> — butun arxitektura bloklari.</li></ul><p>Tashkilot o'z construct kutubxonasini yaratib, standartlarni kodga joylaydi.</p><h4>Ish oqimi</h4><pre>cdk synth          # CloudFormation template generatsiya<br>cdk diff           # plan analogi<br>cdk deploy</pre><p>Test: <code>aws-cdk-lib/assertions</code> bilan generatsiya qilingan template'ni unit test qilish.</p><h4>Trade-off'lar</h4><ul><li><b>+</b> Abstraksiya, qayta ishlatish, IDE yordami, tip xavfsizligi, testlar.</li><li><b>−</b> CloudFormation cheklovlari (sekin, stack limitlari, ba'zi xatolarda rollback muammolari).</li><li><b>−</b> Juda ko'p &quot;aqlli&quot; abstraksiya — nima yaratilayotgani yashirin; <code>cdk diff</code>ni diqqat bilan o'qish shart.</li><li>Faqat AWS (CDK for Terraform — CDKTF — ko'p cloud, lekin rivojlanishi to'xtatilgan).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CDK'da IaC &quot;oddiy kod&quot;ga aylanadi — demak kod sifati qoidalari (review, test, murakkablikni cheklash) ham amal qiladi. Deklarativ soddalik yo'qolmasin: infra kodi ichida murakkab biznes mantiq va tashqi API chaqiruvlari — anti-pattern.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud

plan<br>pulumi up          # apply<br>pulumi stack select prod</pre><h4>Asosiy tushunchalar</h4><ul><li><b>Stack</b> — muhit (dev/staging/prod), o'z konfiguratsiyasi va state'i.</li><li><b>State backend</b> — Pulumi Cloud (default) yoki o'zingizning S3/GCS/Azure Blob.</li><li><b>Secrets</b> — konfiguratsiyada shifrlangan qiymatlar (<code>pulumi config set --secret</code>).</li><li><b>Component resources</b> — qayta ishlatiladigan abstraksiyalar (CDK construct'lariga o'xshash).</li><li><b>Automation API</b> — Pulumi'ni kod ichidan boshqarish (o'z platformangizni qurish uchun).</li></ul><h4>Terraform bilan taqqoslash</h4><p>| | Pulumi | Terraform | |---|---|---| | Til | TS/Python/Go/... | HCL | | Mantiq | to'liq dasturlash tili | <code>for_each</code>, <code>count</code>, ifodalar | | Test | til test framework'lari | <code>terraform test</code>, Terratest | | Provider'lar | ko'p (ba'zilari Terraform provider'laridan) | eng katta ekotizim | | Jamoa bilimi | dasturchilarga tanish | ops jamoalarida standart |</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Til erkinligi ikki tomonlama: murakkab tuzilmalarni ifodalash oson, lekin infra kodi tushunarsiz &quot;dastur&quot;ga aylanishi ham oson. Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40847	<p>Crossplane Composite Resource Definition (XRD) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Crossplane — Kubernetes'ni cloud resurslarini boshqaradigan <b>control plane</b>ga aylantiradi. <b>XRD</b> (Composite Resource Definition) — platform jamoasi yaratadigan <b>o'z API</b>si (masalan <code>Database</code>), <b>Composition</b> esa shu API'ni haqiqiy resurslarga (RDS + subnet group + security group + secret) qanday &quot;yoyish&quot;ni belgilaydi. Dasturchi faqat oddiy <code>Database</code> obyektini yaratadi — qolgan hammasi standart va xavfsiz holda yaratiladi.</p><h4>Uch qatlam</h4><pre>Dasturchi:   Database (claim, namespace'da)       &lt;- oddiy, 5 qator<br>               |<br>Platforma:   XRD (API sxemasi) + Composition (qanday yasaladi)<br>               |<br>Provider:    RDSInstance, DBSubnetGroup, SecurityGroup, IAM ... (managed resources)<br>               |<br>AWS API</pre><h4>XRD — API sxemasi</h4><pre>apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1<br>kind: CompositeResourceDefinition<br>metadata: { name: xdatabases.platform.acme.io }<br>spec:<br>  group: platform.acme.io<br>  names: { kind: XDatabase, plural: xdatabases }<br>  claimNames: { kind: Database, plural: databases }<br>  versions:<br>  - name: v1<br>    served: true<br>    referenceable: true<br>    schema:<br>      openAPIV3Schema:<br>        type: object<br>        properties:<br>          spec:<br>            type: object<br>            properties:<br>              size: { type: string, enum: [small, medium, large] }<br>              engineVersion: { type: string, default: &quot;16&quot; }<br>            required: [size]</pre><h4>Dasturchi foydalanishi</h4><pre>apiVersion: platform.acme.io/v1<br>kind: Database<br>metadata: { name: orders-db, namespace: team-orders }<br>spec:<br>  size: small<br>  writeConnectionSecretToRef: { name: orders-db-conn }</pre><p>Composition <code>small</code>ni <code>db.t4g.medium</code>, 50GB, Multi-AZ, shifrlash, backup 7 kun, to'g'ri subnet va SG'ga aylantiradi. Ulanish ma'lumotlari Secret'ga yoziladi.</p><h4>Afzalliklari</h4><ul><li><b>Doimiy reconciliation</b>: kimdir konsolda o'zgartirsa — Crossplane qaytaradi (Terraform faqat <code>apply</code> paytida).</li><li>K8s vositalari bilan: RBAC, GitOps (ArgoCD), policy (Kyverno).</li><li>Platform jamoasi murakkablikni yashiradi, standartlarni majburlaydi.</li></ul><h4>Kamchiliklari</h4><ul><li>Debug qiyinroq (ko'p qatlam, CRD'lar, holatlar).</li><li>Kubernetes klasteri o'zi kritik bog'liqlik bo'ladi.</li><li>Ba'zi provider'lar Terraform'dek yetuk emas; ko'p CRD API serverni yuklaydi (provider family'lar bilan kamaytiriladi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> XRD — platformaning <b>interfeysi</b>; uni mahsulot API'si kabi loyihalash kerak: kichik, barqaror, versiyalangan. Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40848	<p>AWS VPC Lattice nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VPC Lattice — servislararo aloqa uchun <b>application darajasidagi</b> boshqariladigan tarmoq: turli VPC'lar va akkauntlardagi servislar (EKS, ECS, Lambda, EC2) bir-birini <b>nomi bo'yicha</b> topadi va ulanadi, VPC peering, Transit Gateway, load balancer yoki sidecar proxy'larsiz. So'rovlar SigV4 bilan imzolanadi.</li></ul><h4>Afzalliklari</h4><ul><li><b>IP kesishishi muammo emas</b> — VPC'lar CIDR'lari bir xil bo'lsa ham ishlaydi.</li><li>Turli compute turlari bitta modelda.</li><li>Sidecar yo'q — ilovaga ta'sir kam.</li><li>Access log'lar va CloudWatch metrikalari servis bo'yicha.</li><li>EKS uchun AWS Gateway API Controller — K8s <code>Gateway</code>/<code>HTTPRoute</code> resurslari Lattice'ni boshqaradi.</li></ul><h4>Cheklovlar</h4><ul><li>Faqat AWS ichida; multi-cloud uchun mos emas.</li><li>Narx: soatlik servis + GB + so'rovlar — yuqori trafikda hisoblang.</li><li>Service mesh'ning ba'zi imkoniyatlari (batafsil retry/circuit breaker siyosati, mTLS sertifikat identity) cheklangan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Lattice ko'p akkauntli AWS tashkilotida &quot;servislarni ulash&quot; muammosini tarmoq jamoasining ishidan <b>servis egalari</b> darajasiga ko'taradi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40849	<p>AWS Cloud WAN nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Cloud WAN — regionlar, VPC'lar, on-prem data center'lar va filiallarni <b>bitta global tarmoqqa</b> birlashtirish va uni <b>markaziy policy</b> (JSON hujjat) bilan boshqarish servisi. Transit Gateway'lar va ular orasidagi peering'larni qo'lda ulash o'rniga, siz &quot;segment&quot;lar va qoidalarni e'lon qilasiz — AWS global tarmoqni o'zi quradi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>Ko'p regionli tashkilot: har regionda Transit Gateway, ular orasida peering, har birida marshrut jadvallari, prod va dev'ni ajratish — qo'lda boshqarish murakkab va xatoga moyil.</p><h4>Tushunchalar</h4><ul><li><b>Core network</b> — global tarmoq, har regionda <b>Core Network Edge</b> (CNE).</li><li><b>Segment</b> — izolyatsiyalangan marshrutlash domeni (masalan <code>prod</code>, <code>dev</code>, <code>shared</code>) — global VRF kabi.</li><li><b>Attachment</b> — VPC, VPN, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway — tag'lar asosida avtomatik kerakli segmentga qo'shiladi.</li><li><b>Network policy</b> — hammasini belgilovchi JSON:</li></ul><pre>{<br>  &quot;version&quot;: &quot;2021.12&quot;,<br>  &quot;core-network-configuration&quot;: {<br>    &quot;asn-ranges&quot;: [&quot;64512-65534&quot;],<br>    &quot;edge-locations&quot;: [{ &quot;location&quot;: &quot;eu-west-1&quot; }, { &quot;location&quot;: &quot;us-east-1&quot; }]<br>  },<br>  &quot;segments&quot;: [<br>    { &quot;name&quot;: &quot;prod&quot;, &quot;require-attachment-acceptance&quot;: true },<br>    { &quot;name&quot;: &quot;dev&quot; },<br>    { &quot;name&quot;: &quot;shared&quot; }<br>  ],<br>  &quot;segment-actions&quot;: [<br>    { &quot;action&quot;: &quot;share&quot;, &quot;mode&quot;: &quot;attachment-route&quot;, &quot;segment&quot;: &quot;shared&quot;, &quot;share-with&quot;: [&quot;prod&quot;, &quot;dev&quot;] }<br>  ],<br>  &quot;attachment-policies&quot;: [<br>    { &quot;rule-number&quot;: 100, &quot;conditions&quot;: [{ &quot;type&quot;: &quot;tag-value&quot;, &quot;key&quot;: &quot;env&quot;, &quot;value&quot;: &quot;prod&quot; }],<br>      &quot;action&quot;: { &quot;association-method&quot;: &quot;constant&quot;, &quot;segment&quot;: &quot;prod&quot; } }<br>  ]<br>}</pre><p><code>env=prod</code> tag'li VPC avtomatik <code>prod</code> segmentga tushadi; <code>prod</code> va <code>dev</code> bir-birini ko'rmaydi, ikkalasi <code>shared</code>ni ko'radi.</p><h4>Transit Gateway bilan farqi</h4><p>| | Transit Gateway | Cloud WAN | |---|---|---| | Qamrov | regional | global | | Boshqaruv | har TGW alohida, qo'lda peering | bitta policy | | Segmentatsiya | route table'lar | segment'lar (global) | | Mos | 1–2 region | ko'p region, gibrid |</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cloud WAN'ning qiymati — tarmoqni <b>kod sifatida, policy orqali</b> boshqarish: yangi region yoki VPC qo'shish tag qo'yishdek oddiy bo'ladi. Lekin bitta policy o'zgarishi butun global tarmoqqa ta'sir qiladi — o'zgarishlarni review, bosqichli qo'llash va rollback rejasi bilan.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::cloud sec::h15 Azure_GCP_multi-cloud
Interview Drill::Cloud::H15 Azure, GCP & multi-cloud	idrill-40850	<p>AWS App Mesh nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> App Mesh — AWS'ning Envoy proxy asosidagi boshqariladigan <b>service mesh</b>i edi: ECS, EKS va EC2'dagi servislar orasida trafik boshqaruvi (canary, retry, timeout), mTLS va telemetriya. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40851	<p>Ssenariy: <code>us-east-1</code> va <code>eu-west-1</code> bo'ylab konfliktsiz replikatsiyali multi-region active-active web ilovani loyihalang.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har ikki region to'liq ishlaydi va foydalanuvchiga eng yaqini javob beradi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40863	<p>EBS Fast Snapshot Restore (FSR) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Snapshot'dan yaratilgan EBS volume odatda &quot;lazy&quot; — block'lar birinchi o'qilganda S3'dan tortiladi va sekin. <b>Fast Snapshot Restore (FSR)</b> yoqilgan snapshot'dan yaratilgan volume esa darhol to'liq unumdorlikda ishlaydi (initialization kerak emas).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DR yoki autoscaling paytida DB volume'ni snapshot'dan tiklaysiz — birinchi soatlarda har yangi block o'qish yuzlab ms. Ilova &quot;ishlayapti&quot;, lekin latency 10x — amalda RTO buzilgan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Oddiy:  snapshot (S3) --volume yaratish--&gt; volume (bo'sh &quot;pointer&quot;)<br>                                     birinchi o'qish -&gt; S3'dan fetch (sekin)<br>FSR:    snapshot + AZ'da FSR yoqilgan --&gt; volume to'liq tayyor (darhol tez)</pre><p>FSR AZ va snapshot juftligi uchun yoqiladi, soatbay to'lanadi (DSU-soat). Bir vaqtda yaratish credit'lari bor (bucket).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 enable-fast-snapshot-restores --availability-zones us-east-1a us-east-1b \<br>  --source-snapshot-ids snap-0abc<br>aws ec2 describe-fast-snapshot-restores --filters Name=state,Values=enabled</pre><p>FSR'siz alternativ — volume'ni &quot;isitish&quot;:</p><pre>sudo fio --filename=/dev/nvme1n1 --rw=read --bs=1M --iodepth=32 \<br>  --ioengine=libaio --direct=1 --name=volume-initialize</pre><p>2025'dan beri EBS'da <b>Provisioned Rate for Volume Initialization</b> ham bor — volume yaratishda hydration tezligini belgilash (FSR'dan arzonroq alternativ).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>FSR'ni hamma snapshot'ga doimiy yoqish — har AZ uchun soatbay qimmat.</li><li>Faqat bitta AZ'da yoqish, tiklash esa boshqa AZ'da.</li><li>&quot;Volume <code>available</code> bo'ldi = tayyor&quot; deb o'ylash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> FSR'ni faqat RTO-kritik &quot;golden&quot; snapshot'lar (DR DB, tez scale bo'ladigan AMI) uchun yoq. RTO'ni o'lchaganda tiklashdan keyingi warm-up vaqtini ham hisobga ol.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40864	<p>Aurora Global Database write forwarding nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Aurora Global Database'da secondary region read-only. <b>Write forwarding</b> yoqilsa, secondary'ga ulangan ilova <code>INSERT/UPDATE</code> yuborishi mumkin — Aurora uni avtomatik primary region writer'iga uzatadi va natijani qaytaradi. Aurora MySQL va PostgreSQL'da mavjud.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Multi-region ilovada eu-west'dagi servis ko'pincha o'qiydi, ba'zan yozadi. Ikki xil connection (o'qish lokal, yozish uzoq region) boshqarish ilova kodini murakkablashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>eu-west-1 app --SELECT--&gt; secondary (lokal, tez)<br>eu-west-1 app --UPDATE--&gt; secondary --forward--&gt; us-east-1 writer<br>                                                    | commit<br>              &lt;---- storage replikatsiya (&lt;1s) -----+</pre><p>Consistency darajasi sessiyada tanlanadi:</p><ul><li><code>eventual</code> — yozgandan keyin o'z yozuvingni darhol ko'rmasligingiz mumkin.</li><li><code>session</code> — o'z yozuvlaringizni ko'rasiz (read-your-writes).</li><li><code>global</code> — barcha region'lardagi commit'larni ko'rasiz (eng sekin).</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>-- Aurora PostgreSQL<br>SET apg_write_forward.consistency_mode = 'session';<br>-- Aurora MySQL<br>SET aurora_replica_read_consistency = 'session';</pre><pre>aws rds modify-db-cluster --db-cluster-identifier eu-secondary --enable-global-write-forwarding</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Har yozuvga region'lararo RTT (~70-100 ms) qo'shiladi — ko'p yozuvli tranzaksiya juda sekinlashadi.</li><li>Bu multi-writer emas: primary region yiqilsa yozuv ham to'xtaydi.</li><li>DDL va ba'zi operatsiyalar forward qilinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Write forwarding — &quot;kam yozuvli, ko'p o'qiladigan&quot; global ilova uchun qulaylik, haqiqiy active-active emas. Yozuv ko'p bo'lsa, yozuvchi servisni primary region'ga joylashtirish yaxshiroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40865	<p>DynamoDB Streams nima va Lambda bilan qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DynamoDB Streams — jadvaldagi har o'zgarishning (INSERT/MODIFY/REMOVE) <b>tartiblangan, 24 soat saqlanadigan</b> log'i. Lambda event source mapping orqali stream'ni batch'lab o'qiydi va o'zgarishga reaksiya qiladi (CDC).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Buyurtma yozilganda qidiruv index'ini yangilash, email yuborish, analitikaga uzatish kerak. Buni ilova kodida &quot;DB'ga yoz + boshqa tizimga yoz&quot; qilsangiz — dual-write: biri muvaffaqiyatli, ikkinchisi yo'q bo'lsa nomuvofiqlik.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>App -&gt; PutItem -&gt; DynamoDB table<br>                      | (har partition uchun shard, tartib saqlanadi)<br>                      v<br>                 Stream (24h)  --poll (Lambda servis)--&gt; Lambda (batch 100)<br>                                                          | xato?<br>                                                          v<br>                                    bisect / retry / on-failure destination (SQS)</pre><p><code>StreamViewType</code>: <code>KEYS_ONLY</code>, <code>NEW_IMAGE</code>, <code>OLD_IMAGE</code>, <code>NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES</code>.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws dynamodb update-table --table-name orders \<br>  --stream-specification StreamEnabled=true,StreamViewType=NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES<br>aws lambda create-event-source-mapping --function-name indexer \<br>  --event-source-arn arn:aws:dynamodb:...:table/orders/stream/... \<br>  --starting-position LATEST --batch-size 100 \<br>  --bisect-batch-on-function-error --maximum-retry-attempts 3 \<br>  --filter-criteria '{&quot;Filters&quot;:[{&quot;Pattern&quot;:&quot;{\&quot;eventName\&quot;:[\&quot;INSERT\&quot;]}&quot;}]}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Xato beruvchi &quot;zaharli&quot; yozuv shard'ni bloklaydi — retry chegarasi, bisect va DLQ qo'y.</li><li>Lambda handler idempotent emas — retry'da email ikki marta ketadi.</li><li>24 soatdan uzoq saqlash/ko'p consumer kerak bo'lsa — Kinesis Data Streams for DynamoDB.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Streams — transactional outbox'ning &quot;bepul&quot; versiyasi: yozuv va event atomik. Tartib faqat partition key ichida kafolatlangan, global emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40866	<p>DynamoDB Global Tables nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Global Tables — bitta DynamoDB jadvalini bir nechta region'da <b>multi-active</b> qiladi: har region'da o'qish va yozish mumkin, o'zgarishlar boshqa region'larga odatda ~1 soniyada asinxron replikatsiya qilinadi. Default'da konflikt <b>Last-Writer-Wins</b>; 2025'dan <b>multi-Region strong consistency (MRSC)</b> rejimi ham bor.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Global foydalanuvchilar uchun past latency va region avariyasiga chidamlilik kerak, lekin replikatsiyani o'zingiz (Streams + Lambda) qurish murakkab va xatoga moyil.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>us-east-1 replica  &lt;---- async (~1s) ----&gt;  eu-west-1 replica<br>     ^ write A (t=10)                           ^ write B (t=11)<br>            konflikt: bir xil item -&gt; t=11 yutadi (LWW), A yo'qoladi</pre><p>| Rejim | Replikatsiya | O'qish | RPO | |---|---|---|---| | MREC (default) | Asinxron | Eventual (lokal) | &gt; 0 | | MRSC | Sinxron (3 region) | Strong mumkin | 0 |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws dynamodb update-table --table-name sessions \<br>  --replica-updates '[{&quot;Create&quot;:{&quot;RegionName&quot;:&quot;ap-southeast-1&quot;}}]'<br>aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/DynamoDB \<br>  --metric-name ReplicationLatency --dimensions Name=TableName,Value=sessions \<br>  Name=ReceivingRegion,Value=ap-southeast-1 --statistics Average \<br>  --start-time ... --end-time ... --period 300</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Hisoblagichni ikki region'da <code>SET count = count + 1</code> — LWW yangilanishni yeydi.</li><li>Conditional write faqat lokal replikada tekshiriladi (MREC).</li><li>Write capacity har region'da to'lanadi (replicated WCU) — xarajat region soniga ko'payadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> LWW xavfsiz bo'lishi uchun har item'ni bitta region &quot;egallasin&quot; (user home region) yoki ma'lumot idempotent/append-only bo'lsin. Pul va inventar uchun MRSC yoki bitta writer.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40867	<p>ElastiCache Redis va Memcached farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Redis/Valkey</b> — boy data strukturalar, replikatsiya, avtomatik failover, persistence, Pub/Sub, Lua; cache'dan tashqari session, leaderboard, rate limiter, queue uchun. <b>Memcached</b> — oddiy, multi-threaded key-value cache, replikatsiya va persistence yo'q.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> DB'ga yukni kamaytirish uchun cache kerak. Memcached faqat juda oddiy, katta, ko'p yadroli sof cache kerak bo'lsa va yo'qotish arzon bo'lsa.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios

Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40893	<p>Amazon Redshift nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Amazon Redshift — boshqariladigan, petabayt hajmli <b>data warehouse</b>: columnar storage, MPP (massively parallel processing), siqish, natija cache. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40894	<p>Lambda Function URL nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Lambda Function URL — Lambda funksiyaga bevosita beriladigan HTTPS endpoint (<code>https://&lt;id&gt;.lambda-url.&lt;region&gt;.on.aws</code>). Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40895	<p>Lambda Extensions API nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Lambda Extensions API — Lambda execution environment ichida funksiya bilan birga ishlaydigan <b>qo'shimcha process'lar</b> (extension) yozish imkoni. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40897	<p>SQS long polling va short polling farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Short polling</b> (<code>WaitTimeSeconds=0</code>) — SQS serverlarining bir qismini so'raydi va darhol qaytadi, navbat bo'sh bo'lsa ham (bo'sh javob ham API chaqiruv sifatida to'lanadi). <b>Long polling</b> (<code>WaitTimeSeconds</code> 1-20) — xabar kelguncha yoki vaqt tugaguncha kutadi va barcha serverlarni so'raydi — bo'sh javoblar va xarajat keskin kamayadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Worker <code>while true: receive()</code> qiladi; navbat ko'pincha bo'sh. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40904	<p>AWS Batch nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Batch — container'lashgan <b>batch job</b>'larni navbatga qo'yib, kerakli compute'ni (EC2 On-Demand/Spot, Fargate yoki EKS) avtomatik ko'tarib, bajarib, keyin o'chiradigan boshqariladigan scheduler. Array job, dependency, retry, priority qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kechasi 10 000 ta video transkodlash yoki genom tahlili kerak. O'zingiz cluster ushlab tursangiz kunduzi bo'sh turadi; qo'lda scale qilish va Spot uzilishlarini boshqarish murakkab.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Job definition (image, vCPU, memory, retry, timeout)<br>   v submit<br>Job queue (priority) --&gt; Compute environment(lar)<br>                           - Spot (arzon, birinchi)<br>                           - On-Demand (fallback)<br>   v<br>Scheduler: pending job'lar uchun instance'lar ko'tariladi -&gt; job'lar ishlaydi -&gt; bo'shasa 0 ga<br>Array job: 1 submit = 10 000 child (AWS_BATCH_JOB_ARRAY_INDEX)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws batch submit-job --job-name transcode --job-queue spot-queue \<br>  --job-definition ffmpeg:3 --array-properties size=10000 \<br>  --retry-strategy '{&quot;attempts&quot;:3,&quot;evaluateOnExit&quot;:[{&quot;onStatusReason&quot;:&quot;Host EC2*&quot;,&quot;action&quot;:&quot;RETRY&quot;},{&quot;onReason&quot;:&quot;*&quot;,&quot;action&quot;:&quot;EXIT&quot;}]}'<br>aws batch list-jobs --job-queue spot-queue --job-status FAILED</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Job idempotent emas — Spot uzilishidan keyin retry natijani buzadi/dublikat qiladi.</li><li>Compute environment <code>maxvCpus</code> juda kichik — job'lar <code>RUNNABLE</code> holatida qotadi (yoki instance turi quota'si yetmaydi).</li><li>Juda qisqa (bir necha soniyalik) job'lar — scheduling overhead; ularni bitta job ichida guruhla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Batch vs Step Functions Distributed Map vs K8s Job: og'ir, uzoq, ko'p resursli hisoblash — Batch; ko'p qisqa serverless qadamlar — Step Functions; allaqachon K8s platforma bo'lsa — Kueue/Argo Workflows.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios

Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40909	<p>AWS Network Access Analyzer nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Network Access Analyzer — tarmoq <b>siyosatini</b> (Network Access Scope) e'lon qilib, butun VPC/akkaunt bo'ylab unga zid <b>mumkin bo'lgan</b> yo'llarni topadi. Aniq invariantlarni yoz.</li><li>Bir martalik audit — o'zgarishlardan keyin regulyar (jadval bilan) ishga tushir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu &quot;tarmoq uchun unit test&quot;: segmentatsiya invariantlarini kod sifatida yoz va har tarmoq o'zgarishidan keyin avtomatik tekshir.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40910	<p>Global Accelerator va CloudFront farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>CloudFront</b> — CDN: HTTP(S) kontentni edge'da <b>cache</b>'laydi, statik va dinamik web, video, API uchun. <b>Global Accelerator</b> — cache'siz: istalgan <b>TCP/UDP</b> trafikni 2 ta statik <b>anycast IP</b> orqali eng yaqin edge'ga olib, AWS private backbone bo'ylab region endpoint'iga yetkazadi; health check bilan soniyalarda region failover.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Global foydalanuvchilar uchun latency. Lekin hamma trafik cache'lanmaydi: o'yin serverlari (UDP), IoT (MQTT), VoIP yoki statik IP talab qiladigan B2B mijozlar (firewall allowlist).</p><p><b>Taqqoslash:</b> | | CloudFront | Global Accelerator | |---|---|---| | Protokol | HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, gRPC | TCP, UDP | | Cache | Bor | Yo'q | | IP | O'zgaruvchan (DNS) | 2 ta statik anycast IP | | Failover | Origin group (5xx'da) | Endpoint group, health check, traffic dial | | Xavfsizlik | WAF, Shield, Functions | Shield | | Narx | Data transfer + request | Soatlik + DT-Premium |</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>User --anycast--&gt; eng yaqin edge --AWS backbone--&gt; ALB/NLB/EC2 (us-east-1 yoki eu-west-1)<br>                       (internet &quot;yarim yo'li&quot; yo'q, kam jitter)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws globalaccelerator create-accelerator --name game --ip-address-type IPV4 --region us-west-2<br>aws globalaccelerator update-endpoint-group --endpoint-group-arn $EG \<br>  --traffic-dial-percentage 0 --region us-west-2    # region'ni trafikdan chiqarish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Statik web sayt uchun GA tanlash — cache yo'q, qimmatroq.</li><li>CloudFront'ga statik IP kerak deb kutish — yo'q.</li><li>Ikkalasini birga ishlatish odatda ma'nosiz (CloudFront allaqachon edge'da).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qaror: HTTP va cache'lanadigan — CloudFront; non-HTTP, statik IP yoki tez multi-region failover — Global Accelerator.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios

Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40912	<p>Amazon MQ nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Amazon MQ — <b>Apache ActiveMQ</b> va <b>RabbitMQ</b> uchun boshqariladigan message broker: standart protokollar (AMQP, MQTT, STOMP, OpenWire, JMS) qo'llab-quvvatlanadi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40913	<p>Kinesis Data Streams va SQS farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>SQS</b> — xabarlar <b>navbati</b>: har xabar bitta consumer tomonidan qayta ishlanadi va o'chiriladi; worker'lar mustaqil scale qiladi. <b>Kinesis Data Streams</b> — tartiblangan <b>stream (log)</b>: yozuvlar 24 soatdan 365 kungacha saqlanadi, bir nechta consumer ilova bir xil ma'lumotni mustaqil o'qiydi va <b>replay</b> qila oladi; tartib shard (partition key) ichida.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Noto'g'ri tanlov: task queue uchun Kinesis (shard boshqaruvi, bitta sekin yozuv shard'ni bloklaydi) yoki analitika/event sourcing uchun SQS (o'qilgan xabar yo'qoladi, ikkinchi consumer ko'rmaydi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SQS:     producer -&gt; [m1 m2 m3] -&gt; worker A oladi m1, worker B oladi m2 -&gt; delete<br>Kinesis: producer -&gt; shard-1: r1 r2 r3 r4 ...  (ofset/sequence number)<br>                       app X (analitika) o'qiydi o'z checkpoint'i bilan<br>                       app Y (arxiv) o'qiydi o'z checkpoint'i bilan</pre><p>| | SQS | Kinesis Data Streams | |---|---|---| | Model | Queue, competing consumers | Log, ko'p mustaqil consumer | | Tartib | Standard: yo'q; FIFO: group ichida | Shard ichida | | Saqlash | Max 14 kun, o'qib o'chiriladi | 24 soat - 365 kun, replay | | Scale | Avtomatik | Shard'lar yoki on-demand rejim | | Har xabar ack | Bor (visibility, DLQ) | Yo'q, checkpoint |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws kinesis put-record --stream-name clicks --partition-key user-42 --data &quot;$(echo '{&quot;p&quot;:&quot;/home&quot;}' | base64)&quot;<br>aws kinesis describe-stream-summary --stream-name clicks<br>aws sqs send-message --queue-url $Q --message-body '{&quot;jobId&quot;:1}'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kinesis'da partition key kam xilma-xil — hot shard, <code>ProvisionedThroughputExceeded</code>.</li><li>Kinesis'da bitta buzuq yozuv consumer'ni to'xtatadi (navbatdagi kabi alohida DLQ yo'q, bisect/on-failure destination sozlash kerak).</li><li>SQS'da tartib kutish (standard queue) — tartib kerak bo'lsa FIFO.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Savol: &quot;Xabar — bajariladigan ish (task)mi yoki sodir bo'lgan fakt (event)mi?&quot; Task — SQS; ko'p iste'molchili event stream — Kinesis yoki MSK (Kafka).</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios

SAML login'ni ta'minlaydi, SCIM esa &quot;kim bor&quot; ro'yxatini sinxronlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Faqat SAML bo'lsa, Identity Center'da foydalanuvchi va guruhlarni qo'lda yaratish kerak. Xodim ishdan ketdi — IdP'da o'chirildi, lekin AWS'da guruh a'zoligi qoldi. Xavfsizlik va audit muammosi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Okta / Entra ID (manba haqiqat)<br>   | SAML 2.0  -&gt; autentifikatsiya (login)<br>   | SCIM 2.0  -&gt; POST/PATCH/DELETE /Users, /Groups (bearer token bilan)<br>   v<br>IAM Identity Center<br>   guruh &quot;platform-admins&quot; -&gt; permission set &quot;AdministratorAccess&quot; -&gt; akkauntlar<br>Xodim ketdi -&gt; IdP'da disable -&gt; SCIM -&gt; Identity Center'da disable -&gt; kirish yo'q</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><ol><li>Identity Center: identity source = External IdP, <b>Automatic provisioning</b> yoqish -&gt; SCIM endpoint + access token olish.</li><li>IdP'da AWS ilovasida SCIM URL va token'ni kiritish, guruhlarni &quot;push&quot; qilish.</li></ol><pre>aws identitystore list-groups --identity-store-id d-123 --query 'Groups[].DisplayName'<br>aws identitystore list-users --identity-store-id d-123 --filters AttributePath=UserName,AttributeValue=ali@corp.com</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SCIM access token muddati (1 yil) tugaydi — sinxronlash jim to'xtaydi. Muddatni kuzat va rotatsiya qil.</li><li>Nested guruhlar Identity Center'da qo'llab-quvvatlanmaydi (Entra'dan tekis guruh push qilinadi).</li><li>IdP va Identity Center'da qo'lda o'zgartirish — konflikt; manba haqiqat faqat IdP.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Joiner-Mover-Leaver jarayoni avtomatlashtirilgan bo'lishi kerak: HR tizimi -&gt; IdP -&gt; SCIM -&gt; AWS. Shunda kirish huquqi lavozim bilan birga o'zgaradi va auditda isbotlanadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40920	<p>Cognito User Pools va Identity Pools farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>User Pools</b> — ilova foydalanuvchilari uchun <b>identity provider</b>: ro'yxatdan o'tish, login, MFA, parol tiklash, social/SAML/OIDC federatsiya; natijada JWT (ID, access, refresh token). <b>Identity Pools</b> (Federated Identities) — tasdiqlangan (yoki mehmon) foydalanuvchiga <b>vaqtinchalik AWS IAM credential</b> beradi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri S3/DynamoDB'ga murojaat qilish uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Mobil ilova foydalanuvchilarini autentifikatsiya qilish kerak (User Pool), va ba'zan foydalanuvchi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri S3'ga rasm yuklashi kerak — backend orqali emas (Identity Pool).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>User -&gt; User Pool login -&gt; JWT (id_token, access_token)<br>          |                        |<br>          | API GW/ALB JWT tekshiradi -&gt; backend<br>          v<br>   Identity Pool: JWT -&gt; STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity<br>          v<br>   Vaqtinchalik AWS credential (role: authenticated) -&gt; S3 PutObject (faqat o'z prefix'iga)</pre><p>| | User Pools | Identity Pools | |---|---|---| | Javob beradi | &quot;Kim bu?&quot; (authN) | &quot;AWS'da nima qila oladi?&quot; (AWS authZ) | | Natija | JWT token'lar | AWS access key + session token | | Manba | O'z directory'si + federatsiya | User Pool, Google, Apple, SAML, guest |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>{&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Allow&quot;,&quot;Action&quot;:[&quot;s3:PutObject&quot;],<br> &quot;Resource&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:s3:::uploads/${cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub}/*&quot;}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Guest (unauthenticated) access yoqilgan, role juda keng — har kim AWS resursingizga kiradi.</li><li>ID token'ni API authorization uchun ishlatish — access token mo'ljallangan.</li><li>Policy'da foydalanuvchi prefix'i yo'q — bir foydalanuvchi boshqasining fayllarini o'qiydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p ilovalarga faqat User Pool yetadi; S3'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yuklash uchun pre-signed URL ko'pincha Identity Pool'dan soddaroq va nazoratliroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40921	<p>AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) — fizik, virtual (VMware, Hyper-V) yoki boshqa cloud serverlarni <b>block darajasida uzluksiz replikatsiya</b> qilib, AWS'da arzon &quot;staging area&quot;da saqlaydi; avariyada daqiqalarda to'liq o'lchamli EC2 sifatida ishga tushiradi. RPO — soniyalar, RTO — daqiqalar. CloudEndure Disaster Recovery'ning vorisi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> On-prem DR site — ikkinchi data center, ikki hissa hardware va litsenziya, deyarli hech qachon ishlatilmaydi. Backup'dan tiklash esa soatlab yoki kunlab.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Source server (agent) --block-level CDC (TLS)--&gt; Staging subnet:<br>                                                 kichik replication server + arzon EBS<br>                                                 (point-in-time snapshot'lar)<br>Drill / avariya:<br>   Launch -&gt; konvertatsiya (driver, boot) -&gt; to'liq EC2 recovery instance (target subnet)<br>Failback: AWS -&gt; on-prem teskari replikatsiya</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Source serverda agent<br>sudo python3 aws-replication-installer-init --region eu-central-1 --no-prompt<br>aws drs describe-source-servers --query 'items[].[sourceServerID,dataReplicationInfo.dataReplicationState]'<br>aws drs start-recovery --is-drill --source-servers sourceServerID=s-123</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Drill hech qachon qilinmagan — launch template (subnet, SG, instance turi) noto'g'ri ekanini avariya paytida bilasiz.</li><li>Ilova bog'liqliklari (DNS, AD, litsenziya serveri) DR region'da yo'q — server ishga tushadi, ilova ishlamaydi.</li><li>Replikatsiya tarmoq kanali yetarli emas — lag o'sib, RPO buziladi; <code>lagDuration</code> ni kuzat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DRS server darajasidagi DR uchun; cloud-native ilovalarda esa DR'ni arxitekturada (multi-AZ, Aurora Global, IaC bilan region qayta yaratish) qurish arzonroq va ishonchliroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40922	<p>AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) — <b>lift-and-shift (rehost)</b> migratsiya uchun tavsiya etilgan asosiy servis: manba serverlardan block darajasida uzluksiz replikatsiya, test instance'larni ishga tushirish, so'ng minimal downtime bilan <b>cutover</b>. Avtomatik konvertatsiya (boot, driver) va post-launch action'lar (SSM).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 300 ta VM'ni AWS'ga ko'chirish kerak. Qo'lda image eksport/import — sekin, xatoga moyil, har biri uchun uzoq downtime.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>1. Agent o'rnatish (yoki agentless vCenter) -&gt; replikatsiya staging area'ga<br>2. Initial sync -&gt; &quot;Ready for testing&quot;<br>3. Launch test instance -&gt; ilova testi -&gt; &quot;Ready for cutover&quot;<br>4. Cutover: manbada yozuvni to'xtat -&gt; oxirgi sync (soniyalar) -&gt; cutover instance<br>5. DNS/LB'ni yangi instance'ga o'tkaz -&gt; &quot;Finalize&quot; -&gt; manbani o'chirish<br>Wave'lar: serverlar to'lqin-to'lqin, bog'liqliklar bo'yicha guruhlanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws mgn describe-source-servers --query 'items[].[sourceServerID,lifeCycle.state]'<br>aws mgn start-test --source-server-ids s-123<br>aws mgn start-cutover --source-server-ids s-123<br>aws mgn finalize-cutover --source-server-id s-123</pre><p><b>MGN vs DRS vs DMS:</b> | Servis | Maqsad | |---|---| | MGN | Server migratsiyasi (bir martalik ko'chirish) | | DRS | Doimiy DR replikatsiya | | DMS | Ma'lumotlar bazasi migratsiyasi/CDC |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Test bosqichini o'tkazib yuborish — cutover kuni litsenziya/IP hardcode muammolari chiqadi.</li><li>Lift-and-shift'dan keyin rightsizing qilmaslik — on-prem &quot;katta&quot; VM'lar AWS'da qimmat.</li><li>Ilova bog'liqliklarini (discovery) xaritalamasdan wave tuzish — yarim tizim AWS'da, yarmi on-prem, latency.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Rehost — tezlik uchun; keyin optimizatsiya (replatform: RDS, containerlar). &quot;Migrate then modernize&quot; rejasi va unga byudjet oldindan bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40923	<p>AWS Migration Hub nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Migration Hub — migratsiya portfelini <b>bitta joyda kuzatish va rejalash</b>: discovery ma'lumotlari (Application Discovery Service), serverlarni ilovalarga guruhlash, MGN/DMS va hamkor tool'lar bo'yicha statusni ko'rish, Strategy Recommendations va Orchestrator (migratsiya workflow shablonlari).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yirik migratsiyada yuzlab server, o'nlab jamoa, bir nechta tool. &quot;Qaysi ilova qaysi bosqichda?&quot; degan savolga Excel jadvalidan javob qidiriladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Discovery (agent / agentless / import CSV)<br>   -&gt; serverlar, CPU/RAM, tarmoq bog'liqliklari<br>   v<br>Ilovalarga guruhlash (app = web + db + cache)<br>   v<br>Strategy recommendations (rehost / replatform / refactor)<br>   v<br>Migratsiya: MGN, DMS, hamkor tool'lar -&gt; status Migration Hub'ga<br>   v<br>Dashboard: Not started / In progress / Completed (har ilova)</pre><p>Home region tanlanadi — barcha migratsiya ma'lumotlari shu yerda.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws discovery start-continuous-export<br>aws migrationhub list-migration-tasks --progress-update-stream MGN</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Discovery'ni qisqa muddat (1-2 kun) yig'ish — oy oxiri yukini va kam ishlatiladigan bog'liqliklarni ko'rmaysiz; kamida 2-4 hafta.</li><li>Tool'ni maqsad deb bilish — asosiy ish ilova egalari bilan muloqot va wave rejasi.</li><li>Home region'ni keyin o'zgartirish qiyin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Migratsiya — dastur boshqaruvi muammosi. 7R (retire, retain, rehost, relocate, repurchase, replatform, refactor) bo'yicha har ilovaga qaror va egasi belgilansa, tool'lar faqat kuzatishni yengillashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40924	<p>AWS Well-Architected Framework nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Well-Architected Framework — cloud workload'larni loyihalash va baholash uchun best practice'lar to'plami, <b>oltita ustun</b>: Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, Sustainability. Har ustun dizayn tamoyillari va savollar (masalan &quot;Workload'ingiz komponent nosozligiga qanday chidaydi?&quot;) dan iborat.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Jamoalar arxitekturani intuitsiya bilan quradi; zaif joylar (bitta AZ, backup sinalmagan, xarajat nazorati yo'q) faqat incident yoki katta hisobdan keyin ochiladi.</p><p><b>Ustunlar va asosiy savol:</b> | Ustun | Mohiyati | Misol amaliyot | |---|---|---| | Operational Excellence | Ishga tushirish va yaxshilash | IaC, runbook, postmortem | | Security | Ma'lumot va tizimni himoyalash | Least privilege, shifrlash, audit | | Reliability | Nosozlikdan tiklanish | Multi-AZ, backup sinovi, quota | | Performance Efficiency | Resursdan samarali foydalanish | To'g'ri instance, cache, o'lchash | | Cost Optimization | Keraksiz xarajatni yo'qotish | Rightsizing, Savings Plan, tag | | Sustainability | Ekologik ta'sirni kamaytirish | Utilization, Graviton, data lifecycle |</p><p>Qo'shimcha <b>Lens</b>'lar: Serverless, SaaS, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Financial Services va boshqalar.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b> review jarayoni:</p><pre>1. Workload'ni aniqla (chegara, egasi, biznes kritikligi)<br>2. Har ustun savollariga javob (ko'pincha WA Tool'da)<br>3. High/Medium risk'lar ro'yxati (HRI)<br>4. Ustuvorlik -&gt; backlog -&gt; 3-6 oyda qayta review</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Review'ni bir martalik &quot;auditor uchun hujjat&quot; qilish.</li><li>Barcha ustunlarni teng muhim deb bilish — trade-off bor (masalan reliability va cost).</li><li>Tavsiyalarni kontekstsiz qo'llash (har ichki tool uchun multi-region).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Framework — savollar ro'yxati, javob emas. Uning qiymati — jamoani muntazam ravishda xavf va trade-off haqida gapirishga majburlashda.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40925	<p>AWS Well-Architected Tool nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Well-Architected Tool — AWS konsolidagi <b>bepul</b> servis: workload'ni ro'yxatdan o'tkazib, Framework (va Lens) savollariga javob berasiz, u <b>High/Medium risk</b>'larni (HRI/MRI) ko'rsatadi, improvement plan tuzadi va milestone'lar bilan vaqt bo'yicha progressni kuzatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Well-Architected review Word hujjat yoki Excel'da qilinsa, natijalar yo'qoladi, keyingi review'da nima o'zgarganini ko'rib bo'lmaydi va ko'p workload bo'yicha umumiy rasm yo'q.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Workload &quot;payments-api&quot; (egasi, muhit, region'lar, akkauntlar)<br>   + Lens: WA Framework, Serverless Lens, custom lens (kompaniya standartlari)<br>   v<br>Savollar -&gt; javoblar -&gt; risk: HIGH / MEDIUM / NONE<br>   v<br>Improvement plan (har risk uchun yo'riqnoma havolasi)<br>   v<br>Milestone &quot;2026-Q3&quot; saqlanadi -&gt; keyingi review'da solishtirish<br>   v<br>Jira integratsiyasi / API orqali hisobot, Trusted Advisor tekshiruvlari bog'lanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws wellarchitected create-workload --workload-name payments-api --environment PRODUCTION \<br>  --aws-regions eu-central-1 --review-owner platform@corp.com \<br>  --lenses wellarchitected serverless --description &quot;Payments&quot;<br>aws wellarchitected list-lens-review-improvements --workload-id w-123 --lens-alias wellarchitected \<br>  --query 'ImprovementSummaries[?Risk==`HIGH`].QuestionTitle'<br>aws wellarchitected create-milestone --workload-id w-123 --milestone-name 2026-Q3</pre><p><b>Custom lens</b> — kompaniyaning o'z talablari (masalan &quot;har servisda SLO bor&quot;) JSON'da yoziladi va tashkilot bo'ylab ulashiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Savollarga &quot;ha&quot; deb belgilab qo'yish, dalilsiz — natija yolg'on xavfsizlik hissi.</li><li>Improvement plan backlog'ga tushmaydi — hech narsa o'zgarmaydi.</li><li>Juda katta &quot;workload&quot; (butun kompaniya) — natija umumiy va foydasiz.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tool'ni production readiness review'ga bog'la: yangi kritik servis HRI'larsiz prod'ga chiqmasin — bu jarayonni tekshiriladigan qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40926	<p>AWS Trusted Advisor nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Trusted Advisor — akkauntingizni avtomatik tekshirib, besh (endi olti) yo'nalishda tavsiya beradi: <b>Cost Optimization</b>, <b>Performance</b>, <b>Security</b>, <b>Fault Tolerance</b>, <b>Service Limits (quota)</b> va <b>Operational Excellence</b>. Basic/Developer support'da faqat asosiy tekshiruvlar; to'liq to'plam Business/Enterprise support bilan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bo'sh Elastic IP, ishlatilmayotgan EBS, MFA'siz root, ochiq S3, bitta AZ'dagi RDS, 80%ga yetgan quota — hammasini qo'lda topish mumkin emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Trusted Advisor checks (davriy yangilanadi)<br>  [qizil] Security: S3 bucket ochiq ruxsat, SG 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; 22<br>  [sariq] Cost: kam ishlatiladigan EC2 (CPU &lt; 10%, 14 kun)<br>  [sariq] Fault tolerance: RDS Multi-AZ o'chiq<br>  [qizil] Service limits: VPC per region 4/5<br>   v<br>Organizational view (barcha akkauntlar) / EventBridge / Support API</pre><p>Trusted Advisor Priority (Enterprise) — TAM tomonidan saralangan eng muhim tavsiyalar.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws support describe-trusted-advisor-checks --language en --region us-east-1 \<br>  --query 'checks[?category==`security`].[id,name]'<br>aws support describe-trusted-advisor-check-result --check-id Pfx0RwqBli --region us-east-1</pre><p>EventBridge: <code>source: aws.trustedadvisor</code>, <code>status: ERROR</code> -&gt; Slack.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tavsiyalarni hech kim ko'rmaydi — har kategoriya uchun egasi va alert bo'lsin.</li><li>&quot;Kam ishlatilgan&quot; degani doim isrof emas (DR standby, mavsumiy).</li><li>Security Hub mavjud bo'lsa, xavfsizlik tekshiruvlari takrorlanadi — bitta manba tanlang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Trusted Advisor — &quot;past osilgan meva&quot; topuvchi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40927	<p>AWS Service Quotas nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Service Quotas — har akkaunt va region bo'yicha AWS servis limitlarini (vCPU soni, VPC soni, Lambda concurrency, EIP va h.k.) <b>ko'rish, oshirishni so'rash va kuzatish</b> uchun markaziy servis. Ko'p quota'lar uchun CloudWatch'da usage metrikasi bor — alarm qo'yish mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Black Friday'da autoscaling 200 instance ko'tarmoqchi, lekin On-Demand vCPU quota'si 256 — <code>VcpuLimitExceeded</code>, servis yiqiladi. Yoki DR region'da quota'lar default (kichik) — failover paytida infra ko'tarilmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Quota: &quot;Running On-Demand Standard instances&quot; = 512 vCPU (eu-central-1)<br>Usage metrika (AWS/Usage): hozir 410<br>   v CloudWatch alarm: usage / quota &gt; 80%<br>   v<br>Quota increase request -&gt; (ko'pincha avtomatik tasdiq, ba'zan support case)<br>Organizations: quota request template - yangi akkauntlarga avtomatik</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A<br>aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 \<br>  --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 1024<br>aws service-quotas list-requested-service-quota-change-history --service-code ec2</pre><p>CloudWatch metric math: <code>SERVICE_QUOTA(m1)</code> funksiyasi bilan foiz alarm.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Quota'ni faqat prod region'da oshirib, DR region'ni unutish.</li><li>Hard limit'lar (o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan) — arxitektura shunga moslashishi kerak (masalan SG'dagi qoidalar soni).</li><li>Ba'zi limitlar Service Quotas'da emas, API throttling (rate limit) sifatida — ularni ham hisobga ol.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Quota — capacity planning'ning bir qismi. Har yirik launch yoki DR mashqidan oldin &quot;quota checklist&quot; bo'lsin; yangi akkauntlar uchun template bilan oldindan oshir.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40928	<p>AWS Budgets nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Budgets — xarajat, foydalanish (usage), RI/Savings Plans qamrovi va utilization bo'yicha <b>byudjet</b> o'rnatadi; <b>haqiqiy</b> yoki <b>prognoz</b> qilingan qiymat chegaradan oshsa email/SNS/Chatbot alert yuboradi va ixtiyoriy <b>Budget Actions</b> (IAM/SCP policy qo'llash, EC2/RDS'ni to'xtatish) bajaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Xarajat haqida faqat oy oxiridagi hisobdan bilish. Sandbox akkauntda kimdir GPU instance qoldirib ketdi — $15k.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Budget: team-a-prod, $10 000/oy, filter: tag CostCenter=team-a<br>  Alert 1: ACTUAL &gt; 80%      -&gt; Slack<br>  Alert 2: FORECASTED &gt; 100% -&gt; Slack + email menejer<br>  Action:  ACTUAL &gt; 120%     -&gt; SCP &quot;DenyEC2RunInstances&quot; (tasdiq bilan yoki avtomatik)<br>Ma'lumot kuniga bir necha marta yangilanadi (real-time emas)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws budgets create-budget --account-id 111 \<br>  --budget '{&quot;BudgetName&quot;:&quot;sandbox&quot;,&quot;BudgetLimit&quot;:{&quot;Amount&quot;:&quot;500&quot;,&quot;Unit&quot;:&quot;USD&quot;},&quot;TimeUnit&quot;:&quot;MONTHLY&quot;,&quot;BudgetType&quot;:&quot;COST&quot;}' \<br>  --notifications-with-subscribers '[{&quot;Notification&quot;:{&quot;NotificationType&quot;:&quot;FORECASTED&quot;,&quot;ComparisonOperator&quot;:&quot;GREATER_THAN&quot;,&quot;Threshold&quot;:100},&quot;Subscribers&quot;:[{&quot;SubscriptionType&quot;:&quot;SNS&quot;,&quot;Address&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111:budget&quot;}]}]'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat ACTUAL alert — kech bo'ladi; FORECASTED alert ham qo'y.</li><li>Budget ma'lumoti soatlab kechikadi — tez &quot;yonish&quot;ni ushlash uchun Cost Anomaly Detection va servis metrikalari kerak.</li><li>Prod'da avtomatik stop action — xarajat uchun outage; prod'da faqat alert.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Budget — har jamoa/akkaunt uchun egalik va javobgarlik vositasi. Sabab 6 ta joydan birida bo'lishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (yo'l):</b></p><pre>EC2 (private subnet)<br>  1 DNS: VPC resolver (enableDnsSupport) -&gt; github.com IP<br>  2 SG egress: 443/tcp -&gt; 0.0.0.0/0<br>  3 NACL out: 443 ; NACL in: 1024-65535 (javob)<br>  4 Route table: 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; nat-xxx<br>  5 NAT GW (public subnet, Available, Elastic IP bor)<br>  6 Public subnet route: 0.0.0.0/0 -&gt; igw-xxx<br>  -&gt; Internet -&gt; github.com</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Instance ichidan (SSM Session Manager orqali)<br>dig +short github.com                       # 1: DNS<br>curl -sv --max-time 5 https://github.com -o /dev/null   # timeout = tarmoq; 403 = proxy/policy<br># AWS tomondan<br>aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-priv \<br>  --query 'RouteTables[].Routes[]'<br>aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --nat-gateway-ids nat-xxx --query 'NatGateways[].[State,SubnetId]'<br>aws ec2 describe-network-acls --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-priv</pre><p>Belgilar: <code>Could not resolve host</code> -&gt; DNS; <code>Connection timed out</code> -&gt; route/NAT/NACL/SG; tez <code>Connection refused</code> yoki TLS xatosi -&gt; proxy/firewall.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>NAT Gateway private subnet'ga yaratilgan — o'zi internetga chiqa olmaydi.</li><li>NACL'da javob uchun ephemeral portlar ochilmagan (stateless!).</li><li>Network Firewall yoki egress proxy domain allowlist'da <code>github.com</code> bor, lekin <code>objects.githubusercontent.com</code> (release fayllari) yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bunday muammolarni oldini olish: tarmoqni IaC modul bilan standart qur va Network Access Analyzer/Reachability testlarini pipeline'ga qo'sh. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40961	<p>NACL'da ephemeral portlar nima uchun muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Client ulanish ochganda manba porti sifatida OS tasodifiy <b>ephemeral port</b> tanlaydi (Linux: <code>32768-60999</code>, ELB/NAT va boshqa OS'lar <code>1024-65535</code> ishlatishi mumkin). Javob shu portga qaytadi. <b>NACL stateless</b> — javob trafigini avtomatik ruxsat qilmaydi, shuning uchun kiruvchi (yoki chiquvchi) ephemeral port oralig'ini alohida ochish shart.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> NACL'da faqat &quot;outbound 443 allow&quot; va &quot;inbound 22 allow&quot; qo'yildi. SG'da bu muammo yo'q, chunki SG stateful.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>EC2 10.0.1.5:49152  ---- SYN dst:443 ----&gt;  github.com:443   (NACL OUT: 443 kerak)<br>EC2 10.0.1.5:49152  &lt;--- SYN-ACK src:443 --  github.com:443   (NACL IN: dst 49152 kerak!)<br><br>Server tomonida (ALB -&gt; app:8080):<br>  NACL IN: 8080 ruxsat,  NACL OUT: 1024-65535 (javob client'ning ephemeral portiga)</pre><p>| | Security Group | NACL | |---|---|---| | Holat | Stateful (javob avtomatik) | Stateless | | Daraja | ENI | Subnet | | Qoidalar | Faqat allow | Allow va deny, raqam tartibida |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0abc --ingress --rule-number 120 \<br>  --protocol tcp --port-range From=1024,To=65535 --cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --rule-action allow<br>cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range     # Linux: 32768 60999</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat Linux oralig'ini ochish — NAT Gateway yoki ELB <code>1024-65535</code> ishlatadi, ba'zi ulanishlar uziladi.</li><li>NACL qoidalari tartibi: past raqamli <code>deny</code> keyingi <code>allow</code>ni bekor qiladi.</li><li>Muammoni SG'da qidirish — Flow Logs'da <code>REJECT</code> va yo'nalishga qara.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> NACL'larni default (allow all) qoldirib, nazoratni SG'larda qilish ko'p jamoalar uchun soddaroq va xavfsiz. NACL — subnet darajasida qo'pol &quot;deny&quot; (masalan ma'lum CIDR'ni bloklash) uchun.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40962	<p>Direct Connect Public VIF, Private VIF va Transit VIF farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VIF (virtual interface) — Direct Connect ulanishi ustidagi mantiqiy kanal (VLAN + BGP sessiya):</p><ul><li><b>Public VIF</b> — AWS <b>public</b> endpoint'lariga (S3, DynamoDB, public API'lar) internetsiz, DX orqali.</li><li><b>Private VIF</b> — bitta VPC'ga (Virtual Private Gateway) yoki DX Gateway orqali bir nechta VGW'ga, private IP'lar bilan.</li><li><b>Transit VIF</b> — DX Gateway orqali <b>Transit Gateway</b>'ga — bitta VIF bilan yuzlab VPC.</li></ul><p><b>Muammo:</b> 50 VPC va on-prem bor. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40963	<p>Local Zones va Wavelength farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Local Zones</b> — AWS region'ining yirik shaharlarga yaqin joylashtirilgan kengaytmasi (EC2, EBS, ECS/EKS, ba'zi joyda RDS): shu shahardagi foydalanuvchilar va on-prem tizimlar uchun bir xonali ms latency. <b>Wavelength</b> — 5G operator tarmog'i ichidagi AWS compute: mobil qurilmalar uchun operator tarmog'idan chiqmasdan ultra past latency.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Media rendering studiyasi Los-Angeles'da, eng yaqin region esa Oregon (~20-30 ms). Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40965	<p>S3 uchun PrivateLink (Interface Endpoint) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> S3 Interface Endpoint (PrivateLink) — S3 uchun VPC subnet'ingizda <b>private IP'li ENI</b> yaratadi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40966	<p>IAM session policy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Session policy — <code>AssumeRole</code>, <code>AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity</code>, <code>GetFederationToken</code> chaqiruvida <b>inline</b> (<code>Policy</code>) yoki managed policy ARN'lari (<code>PolicyArns</code>) sifatida uzatiladigan qo'shimcha policy. Sessiyaning haqiqiy ruxsatlari = role ruxsatlari <b>va</b> session policy kesishmasi. U faqat <b>cheklaydi</b>, kengaytira olmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta umumiy role bor (masalan <code>data-processor</code>, butun bucket'ga ruxsat), lekin har bir tenant/job uchun vaqtinchalik credential faqat o'z prefix'iga kirishi kerak. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40967	<p>KMS envelope encryption'da DEK lifecycle qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Envelope encryption: ma'lumot <b>DEK</b> (data encryption key) bilan lokal shifrlanadi, DEK esa KMS'dagi <b>KEK</b> (KMS key) bilan shifrlanib, ciphertext yonida saqlanadi. KMS'ga faqat kichik DEK yuboriladi — katta ma'lumot hech qachon KMS'ga ketmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> KMS <code>Encrypt</code> faqat 4 KB gacha ma'lumot qabul qiladi, har chaqiruv tarmoq latency'si va narxi bor va throttling limitlari mavjud. 5 GB faylni KMS bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri shifrlab bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>DEK lifecycle:</b></p><pre>SHIFRLASH<br>1. GenerateDataKey(KeyId=CMK, KeySpec=AES_256)<br>      -&gt; Plaintext DEK (32 bayt) + CiphertextBlob (KMS bilan shifrlangan DEK)<br>2. AES-256-GCM(Plaintext DEK, data) -&gt; ciphertext  (lokal, xotirada)<br>3. Plaintext DEK'ni xotiradan o'chir (zeroize)<br>4. Saqla: {encrypted_dek, iv, ciphertext}<br><br>OCHISH<br>5. Decrypt(encrypted_dek) -&gt; Plaintext DEK   (KMS: IAM + key policy tekshiruvi, CloudTrail log)<br>6. AES-GCM decrypt(data) -&gt; plaintext<br>7. DEK'ni xotiradan o'chir</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/app --key-spec AES_256 \<br>  --query '{p:Plaintext,c:CiphertextBlob}'</pre><pre># AWS Encryption SDK buni to'g'ri qiladi (DEK cache, format, algoritm)<br>import aws_encryption_sdk<br>client = aws_encryption_sdk.EncryptionSDKClient()<br>ct, header = client.encrypt(source=data, keyring=kms_keyring)</pre><p>S3 SSE-KMS, EBS, RDS aynan shu modelni ichkarida ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Plaintext DEK'ni ciphertext yonida (yoki log'da) saqlash — butun himoya bekor.</li><li>Har obyekt uchun <code>GenerateDataKey</code> — katta hajmda KMS throttling va narx; data key caching (S3 Bucket Keys) ishlat.</li><li>Shifrlashni o'zingiz yozish (IV qayta ishlatish, ECB) — Encryption SDK yoki Tink ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Envelope encryption'ning kuchi — kalit boshqaruvi: CMK'ni o'chirish yoki policy'dan chiqarish bilan millionlab obyektni bir zumda &quot;o'qib bo'lmaydigan&quot; qilish (crypto-shredding), va har ochish CloudTrail'da audit qilinadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40968	<p>Secrets Manager rotation Lambda arxitekturasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Rotation Lambda — Secrets Manager tomonidan <b>to'rt bosqichda</b> (<code>Step</code> parametri bilan) ketma-ket chaqiriladi: <code>createSecret</code> -&gt; <code>setSecret</code> -&gt; <code>testSecret</code> -&gt; <code>finishSecret</code>. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40970	<p>RDS Multi-AZ va Multi-Region farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Multi-AZ</b> — bir region ichida boshqa AZ'da <b>sinxron</b> standby (yoki Multi-AZ DB cluster'da 2 ta o'qiladigan standby): yuqori availability, avtomatik failover (~1-2 daqiqa; DB cluster'da ~35 s gacha), RPO = 0. <b>Multi-Region</b> (cross-region read replica yoki Aurora Global Database) — boshqa region'ga <b>asinxron</b> replikatsiya: region avariyasidan DR va uzoq foydalanuvchilarga lokal o'qish, RPO &gt; 0.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> AZ uzilishi (yiliga bir necha marta bo'ladi) va region uzilishi (kam, lekin juda og'ir) — turli xavflar, turli yechimlar va narxlar.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Multi-AZ:      AZ-a primary ==sinxron==&gt; AZ-b standby<br>               failover: DNS endpoint standby'ga o'tadi (ilova reconnect qiladi)<br><br>Multi-Region:  us-east-1 primary --asinxron (soniyalar)--&gt; eu-west-1 replica<br>               DR: replica'ni promote (qo'lda/avtomatik), ilova endpoint'ni o'zgartiradi</pre><p>| | Multi-AZ | Multi-Region | |---|---|---| | Replikatsiya | Sinxron | Asinxron | | RPO | 0 | Soniyalar (lag) | | RTO | 1-2 daqiqa, avtomatik | Daqiqalar, odatda boshqariladigan | | Himoya | AZ, instance, storage nosozligi | Region avariyasi | | Write latency | Biroz oshadi | Ta'sir yo'q |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws rds modify-db-instance --db-instance-identifier prod --multi-az --apply-immediately<br>aws rds reboot-db-instance --db-instance-identifier prod --force-failover   # failover testi<br>aws rds create-db-instance-read-replica --db-instance-identifier prod-dr \<br>  --source-db-instance-identifier arn:aws:rds:us-east-1:111:db:prod --region eu-west-1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Multi-AZ standby (klassik instance'da) o'qish uchun ishlatilmaydi — read replica alohida.</li><li>Ilova DNS'ni uzoq cache'laydi (JVM default) — failover'dan keyin ham eski IP'ga uriladi; TTL'ni hurmat qil.</li><li>Multi-AZ'ni backup deb hisoblash — <code>DROP TABLE</code> standby'ga ham darhol ko'chadi; backup/PITR alohida kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Prod uchun Multi-AZ — default. Multi-Region — biznes RTO/RPO talabi region avariyasini qamrashi kerak bo'lganda; narxi va murakkabligi (ilova, DNS, secret, konfiguratsiya ham ikki region'da) bilan.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40971	<p>RDS read replica lag nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Replica lag — primary'da commit qilingan o'zgarishning read replica'da ko'rinishigacha bo'lgan <b>kechikish</b> (asinxron replikatsiya). RDS'da CloudWatch <code>ReplicaLag</code> (soniya), Aurora'da <code>AuroraReplicaLag</code> (ms, umumiy storage tufayli odatda &lt; 100 ms) metrikasi bilan o'lchanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Foydalanuvchi profilini yangiladi, sahifa qayta yuklandi — eski ma'lumot ko'rinadi (o'qish replica'dan). Yoki hisobot replica'dan &quot;kechagi&quot; sonlarni ko'rsatadi. Lag katta bo'lsa, failover'da ma'lumot yo'qotiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Primary: COMMIT (t=0) -&gt; WAL/binlog<br>   | tarmoq orqali uzatish<br>Replica: qabul -&gt; qayta qo'llash (replay)  (t=lag)<br>Lag sabablari:<br>  - primary'da katta yozuv yuki / uzun tranzaksiya (katta UPDATE)<br>  - replica instance kichik (CPU/IO yetmaydi)<br>  - replica'dagi uzun so'rov replay'ni bloklaydi (PostgreSQL: conflict)<br>  - MySQL: bitta thread'li replay (parallel replication o'chiq)<br>  - region'lararo tarmoq</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/RDS --metric-name ReplicaLag \<br>  --dimensions Name=DBInstanceIdentifier,Value=prod-replica-1 \<br>  --statistics Maximum --period 60 --start-time ... --end-time ...</pre><pre>-- PostgreSQL primary'da<br>SELECT client_addr, state, replay_lag FROM pg_stat_replication;<br>-- MySQL replica'da<br>SHOW REPLICA STATUS\G     -- Seconds_Behind_Source</pre><p><b>Yechimlar:</b> read-your-writes kerak bo'lgan so'rovlarni primary'ga yo'naltirish (yoki yozgandan keyin N soniya primary), replica'ni primary o'lchamida qilish, katta batch'larni bo'lish, MySQL'da parallel replication.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Barcha o'qishni replica'ga yo'naltirib, consistency talabini unutish.</li><li><code>ReplicaLag</code> alarm'siz — lag soatlab o'sib, failover'da ma'lumot yo'qoladi.</li><li>Lag'ni &quot;tarmoq muammosi&quot; deb, replica'dagi uzun so'rovni ko'rmaslik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Replica — eventual consistency. Arxitekturada qaysi o'qishlar &quot;eskirgan&quot; ma'lumotga chidaydi (katalog, hisobot) va qaysilari yo'q (to'lov holati) — aniq belgilang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40972	<p>ElastiCache cluster mode enabled va disabled farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>Cluster mode disabled</b> — bitta shard: 1 primary + 5 tagacha replica; barcha ma'lumot bitta node xotirasiga sig'ishi kerak, yozish bitta primary bilan cheklangan. <b>Cluster mode enabled</b> — ma'lumot 16 384 hash slot bo'yicha <b>500 tagacha shard</b>ga bo'linadi (har shard o'z primary + replica'lari): yozish va xotira gorizontal scale qiladi, online resharding mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cache 300 GB'ga yetdi yoki yozish 500k op/s — bitta node bunga yetmaydi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40979	<p>Route 53 Traffic Flow nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Route 53 Traffic Flow — murakkab DNS routing'ni (geolocation, latency, failover, weighted, geoproximity) <b>vizual editor</b>da daraxt (traffic policy) sifatida qurish va uni bir nechta domen/record'ga versiyalab qo'llash vositasi. Geoproximity (bias bilan) routing faqat Traffic Flow orqali (endi oddiy record'larda ham) mavjud.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Yevropa foydalanuvchilari -&gt; eu region (latency bo'yicha 2 ta region orasida), eu yiqilsa -&gt; us; Osiyo -&gt; 90% ap, 10% yangi region (canary)&quot; — buni oddiy record'lar bilan qurish o'nlab bog'langan alias record'lar va xatoga moyil.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Traffic policy v3 (JSON / vizual):<br>  Start: geolocation<br>    Europe ---&gt; latency rule<br>                  eu-central-1 (health check) --failover--&gt; us-east-1<br>                  eu-west-1    (health check)<br>    Asia   ---&gt; weighted: ap-southeast-1 90% | ap-south-1 10%<br>    Default --&gt; us-east-1<br>   v<br>Policy record: api.example.com -&gt; policy v3   (versiyalar, rollback)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws route53 create-traffic-policy --name api-global --document file://policy.json<br>aws route53 create-traffic-policy-instance --hosted-zone-id Z123 --name api.example.com \<br>  --ttl 60 --traffic-policy-id &lt;id&gt; --traffic-policy-version 3</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Narx: har policy record oyiga sezilarli to'lov (~$50) — oddiy holat uchun ortiqcha.</li><li>Health check'siz endpoint'lar — failover hech qachon ishlamaydi.</li><li>DNS TTL va client cache — routing o'zgarishi darhol emas; resolver'lar EDNS client subnet'ni har doim yubormaydi, geolocation noaniq bo'lishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS routing — qo'pol vosita (TTL, cache). Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40980	<p>Route 53 DNSSEC nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Route 53 DNSSEC signing — public hosted zone yozuvlariga <b>kriptografik imzo</b> (RRSIG) qo'shadi. Resolver imzoni zanjir bo'yicha (root -&gt; TLD -&gt; sizning zona) tekshiradi va soxta javobni rad etadi. Bu <b>DNS spoofing va cache poisoning</b>'dan himoya; shifrlash emas (maxfiylik bermaydi). Route 53 Resolver'da esa DNSSEC <b>validation</b> ham yoqiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hujumchi resolver cache'ini zaharlab <code>bank.example.com</code> ni o'z IP'siga yo'naltiradi.
