Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40036	<p>Python <code>asyncio</code> va Event Loop nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>asyncio</code> — Python'ning bitta thread'da kooperativ concurrency framework'i. Event loop coroutine'larni navbat bilan bajaradi: coroutine <code>await</code> da I/O kutayotganda boshqaruvni loop'ga qaytaradi va loop tayyor bo'lgan boshqa task'ni davom ettiradi. Bu I/O-bound ishlarda (HTTP, SSH, DB) minglab parallel operatsiyani bitta thread bilan beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 1000 ta endpoint'ni health-check qilish: ketma-ket 1000 x 0.5s = 8 daqiqa. 1000 thread — har biri ~8 MB stack, context switch qimmat. asyncio — 1000 coroutine, har biri bir necha KB.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>event loop (bitta thread)<br>  ready queue: [task A, task B, task C]<br>  A ishlaydi -&gt; await http.get() -&gt; socket'ni epoll'ga ro'yxat, A &quot;kutmoqda&quot;<br>  B ishlaydi -&gt; await ...         -&gt; kutmoqda<br>  epoll: A ning socket'i tayyor -&gt; A yana ready queue'ga -&gt; davom etadi<br>Kod faqat &quot;await&quot; nuqtalarida almashinadi (preemption yo'q).</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import asyncio, aiohttp<br><br>async def check(session, url, sem):<br>    async with sem:<br>        try:<br>            async with session.get(url, timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=5)) as r:<br>                return url, r.status<br>        except Exception as e:<br>            return url, repr(e)<br><br>async def main(urls):<br>    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(100)                       # bounded concurrency<br>    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as s:<br>        results = await asyncio.gather(*(check(s, u, sem) for u in urls))<br>    for url, status in results:<br>        print(status, url)<br><br>asyncio.run(main([f&quot;https://svc{i}.internal/health&quot; for i in range(1000)]))<br><br># Bloklovchi kodni loop'ni to'xtatmasdan ishlatish<br># data = await asyncio.to_thread(blocking_func, arg)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Coroutine ichida bloklovchi chaqiruv (<code>requests.get</code>, <code>time.sleep</code>, og'ir CPU hisob) — butun loop va barcha task'lar to'xtaydi. Async kutubxona (<code>aiohttp</code>, <code>httpx</code>, <code>asyncpg</code>) yoki <code>asyncio.to_thread</code>.</li><li><code>await</code> qilinmagan coroutine hech qachon bajarilmaydi (&quot;coroutine was never awaited&quot; warning).</li><li>CPU-bound ish uchun asyncio tezlik bermaydi (GIL, bitta thread).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> asyncio &quot;funksiya rangi&quot; muammosini olib keladi — async butun call stack bo'ylab tarqaladi. Oddiy ops skriptida 50-100 parallel I/O uchun <code>ThreadPoolExecutor</code> soddaroq; asyncio minglab ulanish yoki uzoq yashovchi servislar uchun o'zini oqlaydi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40037	<p>Python xotira sarfini <code>tracemalloc</code> bilan qanday profil qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>tracemalloc</code> — standart kutubxonadagi xotira trace'ri: Python obyekt allokatsiyalarini kod qatori bo'yicha kuzatadi. <code>start()</code> dan keyin <code>get_traced_memory()</code> joriy va peak hajmni beradi, <code>take_snapshot()</code> esa qaysi fayl/qator eng ko'p xotira ajratganini ko'rsatadi; ikki snapshot farqi leak'ni topadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Log tahlil skripti container'da OOMKilled bo'ladi yoki uzoq ishlaydigan daemon xotirasi soatma-soat o'sadi. Qaysi qator aybdor ekanini taxmin qilish o'rniga o'lchash kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>tracemalloc.start(25)          -&gt; har allokatsiyaga traceback (25 frame) yoziladi<br>... ish ...<br>snap1 = take_snapshot()<br>... yana ish ...<br>snap2 = take_snapshot()<br>snap2.compare_to(snap1, &quot;lineno&quot;) -&gt; qaysi qatorda xotira o'sdi<br>Overhead: sekinlashtiradi (~1.5-3x) va qo'shimcha xotira — prod'da doim yoqmang.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import tracemalloc<br><br>tracemalloc.start()<br>data = [line for line in open(&quot;big.log&quot;)]        # tekshirilayotgan workload<br>cur, peak = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()<br>print(f&quot;current={cur/1e6:.1f} MB  peak={peak/1e6:.1f} MB&quot;)<br><br>snap = tracemalloc.take_snapshot()<br>for stat in snap.statistics(&quot;lineno&quot;)[:5]:<br>    print(stat)          # big_job.py:4: size=812 MiB, count=9000000, average=90 B<br><br># Leak qidirish<br>s1 = tracemalloc.take_snapshot()<br>for _ in range(1000):<br>    handle_request()<br>s2 = tracemalloc.take_snapshot()<br>for d in s2.compare_to(s1, &quot;lineno&quot;)[:5]:<br>    print(d)             # +12 MiB o'sgan qator<br>tracemalloc.stop()</pre><pre>python -X tracemalloc=10 script.py      # kodni o'zgartirmasdan yoqish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Faqat Python allokatorini ko'radi; C kengaytmalar (numpy buferlari, lxml) xotirasi ko'rinmasligi mumkin — RSS (<code>ps</code>, <code>/proc/PID/status</code>) bilan solishtiring.</li><li><code>peak</code> <code>start()</code> dan keyin hisoblanadi; oldin yaratilgan obyektlar kirmaydi.</li><li>RSS kamaymasligi har doim leak emas — Python bo'shatilgan xotirani OS'ga darhol qaytarmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval o'lchang, keyin optimallashtiring: ko'pincha yechim — list o'rniga generator, <code>__slots__</code>, yoki ma'lumotni stream qilish. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40038	<p>Python'da <code>shutil</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>shutil</code> — standart kutubxonadagi yuqori darajali fayl operatsiyalari moduli: papkani rekursiv nusxalash (<code>copytree</code>), o'chirish (<code>rmtree</code>), ko'chirish (<code>move</code>), metadata bilan nusxalash (<code>copy2</code>), arxiv yaratish (<code>make_archive</code>), disk bo'sh joyi (<code>disk_usage</code>) va buyruqni PATH'dan topish (<code>which</code>).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>subprocess.run([&quot;cp&quot;, &quot;-r&quot;, ...])</code> yoki <code>os.system(&quot;rm -rf ...&quot;)</code> — platformaga bog'liq, injection xavfi va xatolarni parse qilish kerak. <code>shutil</code> sof Python, ko'chma va Python exception'lari bilan ishlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>os       : past darajali (bitta fayl, syscall'larga yaqin): os.remove, os.rename<br>shutil   : yuqori daraja (daraxtlar, metadata, arxiv): rmtree, copytree, move<br>pathlib  : yo'l bilan ishlash (obyekt), ichida os/shutil'ni chaqirish mumkin</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import shutil, sys<br>from pathlib import Path<br><br># Disk joyini tekshirish (deploy'dan oldin)<br>total, used, free = shutil.disk_usage(&quot;/var/lib/docker&quot;)<br>if free &lt; Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40039	<p>Python'da <code>pathlib</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>pathlib</code> — fayl yo'llarini <code>Path</code> obyekti sifatida ifodalaydigan standart modul (Python 3.4+). <code>/</code> operatori bilan yo'l birlashtiriladi, <code>.exists()</code>, <code>.read_text()</code>, <code>.glob()</code>, <code>.suffix</code>, <code>.parent</code> kabi metodlar bitta joyda — <code>os.path</code> + <code>open</code> + <code>glob</code> aralashmasini almashtiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), &quot;..&quot;, &quot;config&quot;, name + &quot;.yaml&quot;)</code> — o'qish qiyin, xato qilish oson, string bo'lgani uchun tip xatolar ko'rinmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Path(&quot;/var/log&quot;) / &quot;nginx&quot; Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40040	<p>Python <code>logging</code> modulida best practice qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har modulda <code>log = logging.getLogger(__name__)</code>, konfiguratsiya faqat bitta joyda (entrypoint'da) — handler, formatter, level. Darajalarni to'g'ri ishlating, argumentlarni <code>log.info(&quot;x=%s&quot;, x)</code> shaklida (lazy) bering, exception'ni <code>log.exception()</code> bilan traceback'i bilan yozing; konteynerda stdout'ga, iloji bo'lsa JSON formatda.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>print()</code> — darajasi yo'q, vaqt yo'q, qaysi moduldan ekani noma'lum, o'chirib bo'lmaydi. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40041	<p>Bash parameter expansion: <code>${VAR:-default}</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>${VAR:-default}</code> — <code>VAR</code> unset <b>yoki bo'sh</b> bo'lsa <code>default</code> qiymatni qaytaradi, lekin <code>VAR</code> ning o'zini o'zgartirmaydi. Ikki nuqtasiz <code>${VAR-default}</code> faqat unset holatda ishlaydi (bo'sh stringni qiymat deb qabul qiladi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript ixtiyoriy sozlamalarni env'dan oladi: <code>PORT</code> berilmasa 8080. <code>set -u</code> yoqilgan bo'lsa oddiy <code>$PORT</code> unset bo'lganda skriptni yiqitadi — <code>${PORT:-8080}</code> ham default beradi, ham <code>-u</code> bilan xavfsiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>                 VAR unset    VAR=&quot;&quot;     VAR=&quot;x&quot;<br>${VAR:-def}      def          def        x<br>${VAR-def}       def          &quot;&quot;         x<br>VAR o'zgaradimi? yo'q         yo'q       yo'q</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>PORT=&quot;${PORT:-8080}&quot;                         # natijani o'zi saqlash kerak<br>LOG_LEVEL=&quot;${LOG_LEVEL:-info}&quot;<br>TAG=&quot;${1:-latest}&quot;                           # positional argument default<br>echo &quot;port=$PORT level=$LOG_LEVEL tag=$TAG&quot;<br><br># Default boshqa o'zgaruvchidan yoki buyruqdan<br>OUT_DIR=&quot;${OUT_DIR:-$HOME/reports}&quot;<br>TODAY=&quot;${TODAY:-$(date +%F)}&quot;                # buyruq faqat kerak bo'lsa ishlaydi<br><br># set -u bilan ixtiyoriy o'zgaruvchini tekshirish<br>if [[ -n &quot;${DEBUG:-}&quot; ]]; then set -x; fi</pre><pre>PORT=9000 ./run.sh     # port=9000<br>./run.sh v1.2          # port=8080 tag=v1.2</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>${VAR:-default}</code> VAR ga saqlamaydi — keyingi qatorlarda <code>$VAR</code> hali bo'sh. Saqlash kerak bo'lsa <code>VAR=&quot;${VAR:-default}&quot;</code> yoki <code>:=</code>.</li><li>Bo'sh string ataylab berilgan holat (masalan <code>PREFIX=&quot;&quot;</code>) ham default'ga almashadi — buni xohlamasangiz <code>${VAR-default}</code>.</li><li>Default'da tirnoqsiz bo'shliq: <code>${DIR:-/my dir}</code> — tashqi tirnoq bilan o'rang: <code>&quot;${DIR:-/my dir}&quot;</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Barcha sozlamalarni skript boshida bitta blokda <code>VAR=&quot;${VAR:-default}&quot;</code> ko'rinishida e'lon qiling — bu skriptning konfiguratsiya &quot;kontrakti&quot; bo'lib xizmat qiladi va <code>--help</code> da ko'rsatish oson.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40042	<p>Bash parameter expansion: <code>${VAR:=default}</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>${VAR:=default}</code> — <code>VAR</code> unset yoki bo'sh bo'lsa <code>default</code> ni <b>VAR ga yozadi</b> va qiymatni qaytaradi. Ko'pincha <code>: &quot;${VAR:=default}&quot;</code> shaklida ishlatiladi (<code>:</code> — hech narsa qilmaydigan buyruq, faqat expansion bajarilsin).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>:-</code> faqat qiymatni qaytaradi, <code>VAR</code> bo'sh qoladi — keyingi qatorlarda yoki bola jarayonlarda (agar export qilingan bo'lsa) default ko'rinmaydi. <code>:=</code> default'ni bir marta o'rnatib, skript bo'ylab ishlatadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>                 VAR unset    VAR=&quot;&quot;     VAR=&quot;x&quot;<br>${VAR:=def}      def          def        x<br>VAR keyin        def          def        x        &lt;- :- dan farqi<br>${VAR=def}       faqat unset holatda yozadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br># Konfiguratsiya bloki<br>: &quot;${ENVIRONMENT:=dev}&quot;<br>: &quot;${REPLICAS:=2}&quot;<br>: &quot;${REGISTRY:=registry.example.com}&quot;<br>export ENVIRONMENT REPLICAS REGISTRY        # helm/envsubst ham ko'rsin<br><br>echo &quot;env=$ENVIRONMENT replicas=$REPLICAS&quot;<br>envsubst &lt; deployment.tpl.yaml | kubectl apply -f -<br><br># Solishtirish:<br>unset A B<br>echo &quot;${A:-x}&quot;; echo &quot;A='$A'&quot;   # x ; A=''   (set -u bo'lsa ikkinchisi xato)<br>echo &quot;${B:=y}&quot;; echo &quot;B='$B'&quot;   # y ; B='y'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Positional parametr va maxsus o'zgaruvchilarga assign qilib bo'lmaydi: <code>${1:=x}</code> -&gt; &quot;cannot assign in this way&quot;.</li><li><code>:</code> siz <code>${VAR:=x}</code> yolg'iz yozilsa, qiymat buyruq sifatida bajarilishga urinadi (<code>x: command not found</code>).</li><li><code>:=</code> faqat joriy shell'da o'rnatadi; bola jarayonga yetishi uchun <code>export</code> kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>: &quot;${X:=default}&quot;</code> + <code>export</code> — konfiguratsiya default'larini skript boshida idempotent o'rnatishning eng qisqa usuli. Majburiy qiymatlar uchun esa default bermang — <code>${X:?}</code> ishlating.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40043	<p>Bash parameter expansion: <code>${VAR:?error_msg}</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>${VAR:?xabar}</code> — <code>VAR</code> unset yoki bo'sh bo'lsa <code>xabar</code> ni stderr'ga chiqaradi va skriptni (non-interactive shell'da) non-zero exit code bilan to'xtatadi. Majburiy parametrlarni bir qatorda tekshirish uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>rm -rf &quot;${DEPLOY_DIR}/releases&quot;</code> — <code>DEPLOY_DIR</code> berilmagan bo'lsa <code>rm -rf /releases</code>. Yoki <code>aws s3 sync . &quot;s3://${BUCKET}/&quot;</code> noto'g'ri joyga yozadi. Majburiy qiymat bo'lmasa skript hech narsa qilmasdan darhol to'xtashi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>                 VAR unset         VAR=&quot;&quot;            VAR=&quot;x&quot;<br>${VAR:?msg}      &quot;VAR: msg&quot;, exit  &quot;VAR: msg&quot;, exit  x<br>${VAR?msg}       &quot;VAR: msg&quot;, exit  &quot;&quot;                x</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br># Skript boshida barcha majburiy qiymatlar<br>: &quot;${DEPLOY_DIR:?DEPLOY_DIR o'rnatilmagan}&quot;<br>: &quot;${BUCKET:?BUCKET kerak, masalan BUCKET=my-artifacts}&quot;<br>: &quot;${1:?Usage: $0 &lt;version&gt;}&quot;<br><br>VERSION=$1<br><br># Xavfli buyruq ichida himoya<br>rm -rf -- &quot;${DEPLOY_DIR:?}/releases/old&quot;</pre><pre>$ ./deploy.sh<br>./deploy.sh: line 5: DEPLOY_DIR: DEPLOY_DIR o'rnatilmagan<br>$ echo $?<br>1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Interactive shell'da (terminalda) skript emas, faqat buyruq bekor qilinadi — skriptlarda esa butun skript chiqadi.</li><li>Xabar matnida tirnoqsiz bo'shliq muammo emas, lekin <code>$</code>/<code>}</code> bo'lsa escape kerak.</li><li><code>set -u</code> faqat unset'ni ushlaydi, bo'sh stringni emas — <code>:?</code> ikkalasini ham ushlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>rm -rf</code>, <code>aws s3 rm --recursive</code>, <code>kubectl delete</code> kabi buyruqlarda yo'l qismi bo'lgan har bir o'zgaruvchini <code>${VAR:?}</code> bilan o'rang — bu Steam'ning mashhur <code>rm -rf &quot;$STEAMROOT/&quot;*</code> hodisasi kabi falokatlardan himoya.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40044	<p>Bash'da <code>${#VAR}</code> nima qaytaradi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>${#VAR}</code> — o'zgaruvchidagi string uzunligini belgilar soni bilan qaytaradi. Massiv uchun <code>${#ARR[@]}</code> — elementlar soni, <code>${#ARR[0]}</code> — birinchi element uzunligi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Input validatsiyasi: hostname 63 belgidan, K8s label qiymati 63 belgidan, parol kamida 12 belgidan bo'lishi kerak. Tashqi <code>wc -c</code> chaqirish sekin va newline'ni ham sanaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>name=&quot;web-01&quot;      ${#name}       -&gt; 6<br>arr=(a bb ccc)     ${#arr[@]}     -&gt; 3   (elementlar soni)<br>                   ${#arr[2]}     -&gt; 3   (ccc uzunligi)<br>UTF-8 locale'da    s=&quot;salom-o'zbek&quot;  belgilar soni (bayt emas)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>name=&quot;$1&quot;<br>if (( ${#name} == 0 || ${#name} &gt; 63 )); then<br>  echo &quot;Nom 1-63 belgi bo'lishi kerak (hozir ${#name})&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>  exit 2<br>fi<br><br>servers=(web1 web2 db1)<br>echo &quot;Server soni: ${#servers[@]}&quot;<br><br># Bayt soni kerak bo'lsa (UTF-8 da farq qiladi)<br>s=&quot;o'zbekcha: ш&quot;<br>echo &quot;belgi: ${#s}&quot;<br>LC_ALL=C; echo &quot;bayt: ${#s}&quot;           # C locale'da bayt sanaydi<br>printf '%s' &quot;$s&quot; | wc -c               # bayt, tashqi buyruq bilan<br><br># Uzunlikka moslab chiroyli chiqish<br>printf '%-20s|\n' &quot;$name&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>${#ARR}</code> (indekssiz) — massiv uzunligi emas, birinchi element uzunligi.</li><li><code>echo &quot;$s&quot; | wc -c</code> — newline'ni ham sanaydi (+1); <code>printf '%s'</code> ishlating.</li><li>Locale'ga bog'liqlik: bir xil skript C va UTF-8 muhitda turli natija berishi mumkin (cron'da locale boshqacha).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tashqi tizim cheklovlari ko'pincha <b>bayt</b>da (DNS label 63 bayt, DB VARCHAR ba'zan bayt) — Unicode input bo'lsa qaysi biri kerakligini aniqlang.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40045	<p>Bash'da <code>${VAR:offset:length}</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>${VAR:offset:length}</code> — <code>offset</code> pozitsiyadan (0 dan boshlab) <code>length</code> belgi substring qaytaradi. <code>length</code> berilmasa oxirigacha; manfiy offset oxiridan sanaydi, lekin oldidan bo'shliq kerak: <code>${VAR: -4}</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Git commit SHA'dan qisqa 7 belgilik tag, timestamp'dan sana qismi, fayl nomidan prefiks olish — <code>cut</code>/<code>awk</code> jarayonlarini chaqirmasdan, sof Bash'da.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>s=&quot;2026-10-03T14:05&quot;<br>   index: 0123456789...<br>${s:0:10}   -&gt; 2026-10-03<br>${s:11}     -&gt; 14:05<br>${s: -5}    -&gt; 14:05   (oxiridan 5)<br>${s:0:-6}   -&gt; 2026-10-03  (manfiy length: oxiridan shuncha olib tashla, bash 4.2+)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)<br>SHORT=${SHA:0:7}<br>IMAGE=&quot;registry/app:${SHORT}&quot;<br>echo &quot;$IMAGE&quot;                        # registry/app:3f9c2ab<br><br>TS=&quot;2026-10-03T14:05:22Z&quot;<br>DATE=${TS:0:10}; TIME=${TS:11:8}<br>echo &quot;$DATE $TIME&quot;<br><br># Oxirgi 4 belgi (masalan kartani maskalash)<br>CARD=&quot;8600123456789012&quot;<br>echo &quot;**** ${CARD: -4}&quot;<br><br># K8s nomlarini 63 belgiga qisqartirish<br>NAME=&quot;feature-very-long-branch-name-from-jira-ticket-ABC-12345-with-description&quot;<br>NAME=${NAME:0:63}<br>NAME=${NAME%-}                       # oxirida &quot;-&quot; qolmasin<br><br># Massivdan bo'lak (slice)<br>arr=(a b c d e)<br>echo &quot;${arr[@]:1:3}&quot;                 # b c d</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>${VAR:-4}</code> (bo'shliqsiz) — bu default qiymat sintaksisi (<code>:-</code>), substring emas! Manfiy offset uchun bo'shliq yoki qavs: <code>${VAR: -4}</code> / <code>${VAR:(-4)}</code>.</li><li>Bash'ga xos — POSIX <code>sh</code> da ishlamaydi.</li><li>Indeks belgilar bo'yicha (locale'ga bog'liq), bayt emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pozitsiyaga asoslangan kesish faqat qat'iy formatli ma'lumotda (SHA, ISO sana) ishonchli. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40046	<p>Bash'da <code>${VAR//pattern/replacement}</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>${VAR//pattern/replacement}</code> — <code>VAR</code> ichidagi <code>pattern</code> ning <b>barcha</b> uchrashuvlarini almashtiradi; <code>${VAR/pattern/replacement}</code> — faqat birinchisini. <code>${VAR/#p/r}</code> — faqat boshida, <code>${VAR/%p/r}</code> — faqat oxirida. Pattern — glob (regex emas).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Git branch nomi <code>feature/JIRA-123_new UI</code> dan Docker tag yoki K8s namespace yasash kerak — <code>/</code>, <code>_</code> va bo'shliqlar ruxsat etilmagan. <code>sed</code> chaqirish o'rniga sof Bash.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>s=&quot;a-b-c&quot;<br>${s/-/_}     -&gt; a_b-c   (birinchisi)<br>${s//-/_}    -&gt; a_b_c   (hammasi)<br>${s/#a/X}    -&gt; X-b-c   (boshida bo'lsa)<br>${s/%c/X}    -&gt; a-b-X   (oxirida bo'lsa)<br>${s//-}      -&gt; abc     (replacement bo'sh -&gt; o'chirish)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>BRANCH=&quot;feature/JIRA-123_new UI&quot;<br>SLUG=${BRANCH//\//-}          # / -&gt; -<br>SLUG=${SLUG//[_ ]/-}          # _ va bo'shliq -&gt; -   (glob character class)<br>SLUG=${SLUG,,}                # kichik harflarga (bash 4+)<br>echo &quot;$SLUG&quot;                  # feature-jira-123-new-ui<br><br># Yo'llarni almashtirish<br>CONF=&quot;/etc/app/prod.conf&quot;<br>echo &quot;${CONF/prod/staging}&quot;   # /etc/app/staging.conf<br><br># Ruxsat etilmagan belgilarni o'chirish<br>NAME='my@app#v1!'<br>echo &quot;${NAME//[^a-zA-Z0-9-]/}&quot;   # myappv1<br><br># Massivning har elementiga<br>files=(a.txt b.txt)<br>echo &quot;${files[@]/%.txt/.bak}&quot;    # a.bak b.bak</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pattern regex emas, glob: <code>.</code> — oddiy nuqta, <code>*</code> — har qanday ketma-ketlik. <code>${s//*-/}</code> kutilmagan ko'p qismni yutadi.</li><li><code>/</code> ni almashtirishda escape kerak: <code>${p//\//-}</code>.</li><li>Replacement'dagi <code>&amp;</code> bash 5.2+ da (<code>patsub_replacement</code>) mos kelgan matn ma'nosini olishi mumkin — literal kerak bo'lsa escape qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bitta-ikkita almashtirish uchun parameter expansion <code>sed</code> dan tez (jarayon yaratilmaydi) — sikl ichida farq sezilarli. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40047	<p>Bash subshell <code>( cd /tmp &amp;&amp; ls )</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>( ... )</code> ichidagi buyruqlar alohida <b>subshell</b> (forked bola jarayon) ichida bajariladi. U yerda <code>cd</code>, o'zgaruvchi, <code>set -x</code>, <code>trap</code> o'zgarishlari faqat ichkarida qoladi va tashqi shell'ga ta'sir qilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript bir nechta papkada build qiladi: <code>cd service-a &amp;&amp; make; cd service-b &amp;&amp; make</code> — birinchi <code>cd</code> dan keyin ikkinchisi noto'g'ri nisbiy yo'ldan qidiradi. Subshell har blokni toza kontekstda bajaradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>asosiy shell (cwd=/repo, X=1)<br>   |<br>   +-- fork --&gt; subshell ( cd /tmp; X=2; ls )   cwd=/tmp, X=2<br>   |                 '-- tugadi, exit code qaytdi<br>   v<br>asosiy shell: cwd hali /repo, X hali 1</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>for svc in api worker web; do<br>  ( cd &quot;services/$svc&quot; &amp;&amp; make build ) || echo &quot;$svc build xato&quot;<br>done<br>pwd     # hali repo ildizi<br><br># Vaqtinchalik muhit o'zgarishi<br>( export AWS_PROFILE=prod; aws s3 ls )   # tashqarida profile o'zgarmaydi<br><br># Subshell'ning chiqishini birlashtirish<br>( echo &quot;== disk&quot;; df -h /; echo &quot;== mem&quot;; free -m ) &gt; report.txt<br><br># Subshell'da set -e alohida — xato faqat blokni to'xtatadi<br>( set -e; step1; step2 ) || echo &quot;blok yiqildi, davom etamiz&quot;<br><br># DIQQAT: o'zgaruvchi tashqariga chiqmaydi<br>count=0<br>( count=5 )<br>echo &quot;$count&quot;   # 0</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Pipe'ning har bir qismi ham subshell: <code>cat f | while read l; do n=$((n+1)); done; echo $n</code> — 0. <code>done &lt; f</code> ishlating yoki <code>shopt -s lastpipe</code>.</li><li><code>$(...)</code> ham subshell — ichida o'zgaruvchi o'rnatish natija bermaydi.</li><li>Subshell ichidagi <code>exit</code> faqat subshell'ni yopadi, skriptni emas.</li><li>Har subshell <code>fork</code> — sikl ichida minglab marta qimmat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>cd</code> ni subshell yoki <code>pushd/popd</code> ichida qiling — skriptning ishchi papkasi hech qachon &quot;suzib&quot; ketmasin. Holat (state) tashqariga kerak bo'lsa <code>{ }</code> ishlating.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40048	<p>Bash'da command grouping <code>{ cd /tmp; ls; }</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>{ cmd1; cmd2; }</code> — buyruqlarni <b>joriy shell'da</b> (subshell'siz) guruhlaydi. Guruhga bitta redirect yoki <code>||</code>/<code>&amp;&amp;</code> qo'llash mumkin, ichidagi <code>cd</code> va o'zgaruvchi o'zgarishlari saqlanadi. Sintaksis qat'iy: <code>{</code> dan keyin bo'shliq, oxirgi buyruqdan keyin <code>;</code> (yoki newline).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bir nechta buyruq chiqishini bitta faylga yo'naltirish yoki xato bo'lganda bir necha amal (log + exit) bajarish kerak. <code>( )</code> bilan qilsangiz <code>exit</code> faqat subshell'ni yopadi va skript davom etadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>( ... )  -&gt; fork, alohida jarayon, o'zgarishlar yo'qoladi, exit = subshell'dan<br>{ ...; } -&gt; shu jarayon, o'zgarishlar qoladi, exit = butun skriptdan</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Xato bo'lsa: xabar + chiqish (subshell bo'lsa exit skriptni to'xtatmasdi)<br>cd /app || { echo &quot;[ERROR] /app yo'q&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 1; }<br><br># Bir nechta buyruq chiqishi bitta faylga (bitta open)<br>{<br>  echo &quot;# Hisobot $(date -Is)&quot;<br>  uname -a<br>  df -h /<br>} &gt; /tmp/report.txt<br><br># Guruh stderr'ini alohida<br>{ apt-get update; apt-get -y upgrade; } 2&gt;&gt; /var/log/upgrade.err<br><br># O'zgaruvchi saqlanadi<br>{ count=5; }<br>echo &quot;$count&quot;     # 5<br><br># Pipe bilan — DIQQAT: pipe'da guruh baribir subshell'da ishlaydi<br>{ echo a; echo b; } | sort</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>{cmd; }</code> (bo'shliqsiz) yoki <code>{ cmd }</code> (<code>;</code> siz) — sintaksis xato: <code>{</code> va <code>}</code> reserved word, alohida so'z bo'lishi kerak.</li><li>Pipe'ning qismi bo'lgan guruh subshell'da ishlaydi — o'zgaruvchilar yo'qoladi.</li><li><code>a &amp;&amp; b || c</code> — &quot;if-else&quot; emas: <code>b</code> yiqilsa ham <code>c</code> ishlaydi. Aniq mantiq uchun <code>if</code> yoki <code>a &amp;&amp; { b; } || { c; }</code> dan ham ehtiyot bo'ling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: kontekstni izolyatsiya qilish kerak bo'lsa <code>( )</code>, guruhlab redirect qilish yoki skriptdan chiqish kerak bo'lsa <code>{ ; }</code>. <code>cmd || { log; exit 1; }</code> — eng ko'p ishlatiladigan himoya naqshi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40049	<p>Process substitution <code>diff &lt;(cmd1) &lt;(cmd2)</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>&lt;(cmd)</code> — buyruq chiqishini fayl yo'li (<code>/dev/fd/63</code> kabi) sifatida beradi. Shunday qilib fayl argument kutadigan dastur (<code>diff</code>, <code>comm</code>, <code>paste</code>) vaqtinchalik faylsiz buyruq natijasini o'qiydi. <code>&gt;(cmd)</code> — teskarisi: unga yozilgan narsa buyruq stdin'iga boradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ikki serverdagi o'rnatilgan paketlarni solishtirish: odatda <code>ssh a ... &gt; /tmp/a; ssh b ... &gt; /tmp/b; diff /tmp/a /tmp/b; rm ...</code>. Vaqtinchalik fayllar, tozalash va nom to'qnashuvi. Process substitution bularni olib tashlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>diff &lt;(cmd1) &lt;(cmd2)<br>  bash: cmd1 -&gt; pipe -&gt; /dev/fd/63<br>        cmd2 -&gt; pipe -&gt; /dev/fd/62<br>  aslida bajariladi: diff /dev/fd/63 /dev/fd/62<br>  diff ularni oddiy fayl kabi ochib o'qiydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Ikki serverning paketlari<br>diff &lt;(ssh web1 'rpm -qa | sort') &lt;(ssh web2 'rpm -qa | sort')<br><br># K8s: ikki muhit konfiguratsiyasi<br>diff &lt;(kubectl --context staging get cm app -o yaml) \<br>     &lt;(kubectl --context prod    get cm app -o yaml)<br><br># Faqat birinchi ro'yxatda bor qatorlar<br>comm -23 &lt;(sort expected.txt) &lt;(sort actual.txt)<br><br># while sikliga o'zgaruvchi saqlanadigan qilib uzatish (pipe'dan farqli)<br>count=0<br>while read -r pod; do ((count++)); done &lt; &lt;(kubectl get pods -o name)<br>echo &quot;$count&quot;     # to'g'ri qiymat<br><br># Chiqishni bir vaqtda faylga va siqib arxivga<br>some_cmd | tee &gt;(gzip &gt; out.gz) &gt; out.txt<br><br>echo &lt;(true)      # /dev/fd/63 — qanday ko'rinishini ko'rish</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bash/zsh/ksh xususiyati — <code>#!/bin/sh</code> da &quot;syntax error near unexpected token `('&quot;.</li><li>Bu pipe, haqiqiy fayl emas — <code>seek</code> qila olmaydi; faylni ikki marta o'qiydigan yoki orqaga qaytadigan dasturlar ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>&lt;(cmd)</code> ichidagi xatoning exit code'i yo'qoladi (<code>pipefail</code> ta'sir qilmaydi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>&lt; &lt;(cmd)</code> naqshi — pipe'dagi &quot;o'zgaruvchi yo'qoldi&quot; muammosining standart yechimi. Muhitlar orasidagi drift'ni tez aniqlash (config, paket, IAM policy) uchun <code>diff &lt;(...) &lt;(...)</code> juda samarali.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40050	<p><code>2&gt;&amp;1</code> redirection nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>2&gt;&amp;1</code> — file descriptor 2 (stderr) ni hozir fd 1 (stdout) qayerga ishora qilayotgan bo'lsa, o'sha joyga yo'naltiradi. Redirect'lar chapdan o'ngga bajariladi, shuning uchun <code>cmd &gt; file 2&gt;&amp;1</code> ikkalasini faylga yozadi, <code>cmd 2&gt;&amp;1 &gt; file</code> esa stderr'ni ekranda qoldiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cron job <code>backup.sh &gt; backup.log</code> xato bersa — xato xabari (stderr) log'da yo'q, cron uni email'ga yuboradi yoki yo'qotadi. Debug uchun ikkala oqim ham kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Boshida:          fd1 -&gt; terminal   fd2 -&gt; terminal<br><br>cmd &gt; file 2&gt;&amp;1<br>  1) &gt; file      : fd1 -&gt; file<br>  2) 2&gt;&amp;1        : fd2 -&gt; (fd1 hozir qayerda) = file      =&gt; ikkalasi file<br><br>cmd 2&gt;&amp;1 &gt; file<br>  1) 2&gt;&amp;1        : fd2 -&gt; (fd1 hozir) = terminal<br>  2) &gt; file      : fd1 -&gt; file                            =&gt; stderr terminalda</pre><p><code>2&gt;&amp;1</code> — &quot;fd2 ni fd1 ning nusxasi qil&quot; (dup2), &quot;fd1 ga ulash&quot; emas.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>backup.sh &gt; /var/log/backup.log 2&gt;&amp;1        # ikkalasi faylga<br>backup.sh &gt;&gt; /var/log/backup.log 2&gt;&amp;1       # qo'shib yozish<br>backup.sh &amp;&gt; /var/log/backup.log            # bash qisqartmasi (sh da yo'q)<br><br># Ikkalasini pipe orqali<br>make 2&gt;&amp;1 | tee build.log<br>make |&amp; tee build.log                       # bash 4+ qisqartmasi<br><br># Faqat stderr'ni pipe'ga (stdout'ni tashlab)<br>cmd 2&gt;&amp;1 &gt;/dev/null | grep -i error<br><br># Skript ichida butun chiqishni log'ga<br>exec &gt; &gt;(tee -a /var/log/deploy.log) 2&gt;&amp;1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tartibni teskari yozish — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.</li><li><code>cmd &gt; file 2&gt; file</code> — ikki alohida open, bir-birining ustidan yozadi; <code>2&gt;&amp;1</code> ishlating.</li><li><code>&amp;&gt;</code> va <code>|&amp;</code> POSIX emas — <code>#!/bin/sh</code> da ishlamaydi (<code>&amp;&gt;</code> dash'da &quot;fon + redirect&quot; deb tushuniladi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Konteynerlarda ilova ikkala oqimni ham stdout/stderr'ga yozsin, faylga emas — runtime ularni yig'adi. stderr'ni stdout bilan aralashtirish JSON chiqishini parse qiladigan skriptlarni buzadi: ma'lumot stdout'ga, log stderr'ga.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40051	<p>Linux'da <code>/dev/null</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>/dev/null</code> — kernel taqdim etadigan maxsus character device: unga yozilgan hamma narsa tashlanadi (yozish doim muvaffaqiyatli), undan o'qish darhol EOF qaytaradi. Keraksiz chiqishni &quot;yutish&quot; va bo'sh input berish uchun ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cron job har daqiqada shovqinli chiqish beradi va har safar email yuboradi; yoki skript faqat buyruq <b>muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldimi</b> degan savolga javob kerak, chiqishi emas. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40056	<p>Python <code>contextlib.contextmanager</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>@contextlib.contextmanager</code> — bitta <code>yield</code> bilan generator funksiyani <code>with</code> operatorida ishlatiladigan context manager'ga aylantiradi. <code>yield</code> dan oldingi kod — kirish (setup), keyingisi — chiqish (cleanup); <code>try/finally</code> bilan o'ralsa cleanup xato bo'lganda ham bajariladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Maintenance rejimini yoqish, lock olish, vaqtinchalik papka yaratish, <code>cd</code> qilish — har birida &quot;keyin albatta qaytarish&quot; kerak. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40057	<p><code>cron</code> sintaksisi (<code>* * * * *</code>) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cron qatori 5 vaqt maydoni + buyruqdan iborat: <code>daqiqa(0-59) soat(0-23) oy_kuni(1-31) oy(1-12) hafta_kuni(0-7, 0 va 7 = yakshanba)</code>. <code>*</code> — har qanday, <code>,</code> — ro'yxat, <code>-</code> — oraliq, <code>/</code> — qadam.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Har ish kuni soat 02:30 da backup&quot; Zamonaviy tizimlarda systemd timer (<code>Persistent=true</code>, journal) yoki K8s CronJob afzal.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40058	<p>Vaqtinchalik timer uchun <code>systemd-run</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>systemd-run</code> — unit fayl yozmasdan buyruqni vaqtinchalik (transient) systemd service yoki timer sifatida ishga tushiradi. <code>--on-active=10m</code> kabi flag'lar bilan kechiktirib/rejali, <code>-p</code> bilan resurs limitlari bilan, log esa journal'ga yoziladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;Bu migratsiyani 30 daqiqadan keyin bir marta ishga tushir&quot; Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-40060	<p><code>rsync -avz</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>rsync -avz SRC DST</code> — fayllarni faqat o'zgargan qismlarini uzatib sinxronlaydi: <code>-a</code> (archive: rekursiv + ruxsatlar, vaqt, symlink, egasi, guruh saqlanadi), <code>-v</code> (verbose), <code>-z</code> (uzatishda siqish). Doim avval <code>-n</code> (dry-run).</li><li><code>-z</code> tez LAN'da yoki allaqachon siqilgan fayllarda (<code>.gz</code>, <code>.jpg</code>) CPU'ni bekorga yeydi.</li><li><code>-a</code> ACL (<code>-A</code>), xattr (<code>-X</code>) va hardlink (<code>-H</code>) ni o'z ichiga olmaydi — tizim backup'ida qo'shing.</li><li>Egasini saqlash uchun qabul qiluvchi tomonda root kerak, aks holda fayllar ulanuvchi foydalanuvchi nomiga yoziladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> rsync — sinxronlash, backup emas: source'dagi tasodifiy o'chirish <code>--delete</code> bilan backup'ga ham ko'chadi. Versiyali backup uchun <code>--link-dest</code> (snapshot naqshi) yoki restic/borg ishlating.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34071	<p>Bash skript boshida <code>set -euo pipefail</code> nima qiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>set -euo pipefail</code> uchta xavfsizlik rejimini yoqadi: <code>-e</code> — buyruq xato (non-zero) qaytarsa skript to'xtaydi; <code>-u</code> — e'lon qilinmagan o'zgaruvchi ishlatilsa xato; <code>-o pipefail</code> — pipe (<code>a | b</code>) ichida istalgan buyruq xato bersa butun pipe xato hisoblanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Oddiy Bash xatoga qaramay davom etadi. Misol: <code>cd /app/old</code> xato bo'ldi (papka yo'q), lekin keyingi <code>rm -rf *</code> baribir ishladi — boshqa papkadagi fayllar o'chdi. Yoki <code>$DIR</code> da typo — bo'sh string, <code>rm -rf &quot;$DIR/&quot;</code> -&gt; <code>rm -rf /</code>.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>set -e:        cmd1 OK -&gt; cmd2 XATO -&gt; STOP (cmd3 bajarilmaydi)<br>set -u:        echo $UNDEFINED -&gt; &quot;unbound variable&quot; -&gt; STOP<br>pipefail:      false | true  -&gt; pipefail'siz: 0 (OK deb hisoblanadi)<br>                             -&gt; pipefail bilan: 1 (xato)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>BACKUP_DIR=&quot;/backup&quot;<br>cd &quot;$BACKUP_DIR&quot;                        # yo'q bo'lsa — skript to'xtaydi<br>tar czf &quot;db-$(date +%F).tgz&quot; /var/lib/data<br>echo &quot;Backup tayyor&quot;<br><br># Xato bo'lishi normal holat bo'lsa:<br>grep -q &quot;pattern&quot; file.txt || echo &quot;topilmadi&quot;<br>OPTIONAL=&quot;${OPTIONAL:-}&quot;                # -u bilan ixtiyoriy o'zgaruvchi</pre><p>Debug uchun qo'shimcha: <code>set -x</code> — har bajarilgan buyruqni ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>grep</code> hech narsa topmasa 1 qaytaradi — <code>-e</code> skriptni to'xtatadi. <code>|| true</code> qo'shing.</li><li><code>if</code>, <code>&amp;&amp;</code>, <code>||</code> ichidagi buyruqlarda <code>-e</code> ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>-u</code> bilan ixtiyoriy env o'zgaruvchini <code>${VAR:-}</code> shaklida o'qing.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har yangi Bash skript shu qator bilan boshlansin — bu arzon sug'urta. Lekin u to'liq himoya emas: muhim buyruqlarni baribir aniq tekshiring va <code>shellcheck</code> dan o'tkazing.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34072	<p>Exit code nima va uni qanday tekshirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Exit code — har buyruq tugaganda qaytaradigan son: <code>0</code> — muvaffaqiyat, <code>1-255</code> — xato. Oxirgi buyruq kodi <code>$?</code> da saqlanadi. Skriptda odatda <code>if cmd; then</code>, <code>cmd &amp;&amp; ...</code>, <code>cmd || ...</code> bilan tekshiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript <code>apt-get install</code> dan keyin servisni ishga tushiradi, lekin o'rnatish xato bo'lgan bo'lsa ham davom etadi. Exit code'ni tekshirmasangiz, muammo keyinroq, tushunarsiz joyda chiqadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>cmd  -&gt;  tugadi  -&gt;  $? = 0      muvaffaqiyat<br>                 -&gt;  $? = 1..125 dastur xatosi<br>                 -&gt;  126  ruxsat yo'q (bajarib bo'lmaydi)<br>                 -&gt;  127  buyruq topilmadi<br>                 -&gt;  128+N signal: 130 Ctrl+C, 137 kill -9 / OOM, 143 SIGTERM</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>grep -q nginx /etc/passwd<br>echo $?                      # 0 = topildi, 1 = topilmadi, 2 = xato (fayl yo'q)<br><br># Eng toza usul — to'g'ridan if<br>if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then<br>  echo &quot;nginx ishlayapti&quot;<br>else<br>  echo &quot;nginx to'xtagan&quot;<br>fi<br><br># Xato bo'lsa chiqish<br>cp app.conf /etc/app/ || { echo &quot;nusxalab bo'lmadi&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 1; }<br><br># Kodni saqlab keyin ishlatish<br>curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/health<br>rc=$?<br>[[ $rc -ne 0 ]] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;health xato, rc=$rc&quot;<br><br># O'z skriptingiz kodi<br>exit 0</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>echo $?</code> dan oldin boshqa buyruq (hatto <code>echo</code>) — <code>$?</code> yangilanib ketadi. Darhol <code>rc=$?</code>.</li><li><code>cmd | tee log</code> — <code>$?</code> faqat <code>tee</code> niki; <code>pipefail</code> yoki <code>${PIPESTATUS[0]}</code>.</li><li><code>exit 256</code> -&gt; 0 bo'ladi (faqat 0-255).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI/CD, Kubernetes va monitoring faqat exit code'ga qaraydi — skriptingiz xato bo'lganda <b>albatta</b> 0 dan farqli kod bilan chiqsin, aks holda yiqilgan deploy &quot;yashil&quot; ko'rinadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34073	<p>Bash'da o'zgaruvchini nega qo'shtirnoq ichida ishlatish kerak?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tirnoqsiz <code>$var</code> ni Bash bo'shliqlar bo'yicha bir nechta so'zga bo'ladi (word splitting) va <code>*</code>, <code>?</code> kabi belgilarni fayl nomlariga ochadi (globbing). <code>&quot;$var&quot;</code> esa qiymatni aynan bitta argument sifatida uzatadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Fayl nomida bo'shliq bo'lsa yoki o'zgaruvchi bo'sh bo'lsa, tirnoqsiz buyruq butunlay boshqa narsani qiladi — noto'g'ri faylni o'chiradi yoki <code>[ ]</code> sintaksis xato beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>file=&quot;my report.txt&quot;<br>rm $file    -&gt;  rm my report.txt      (2 ta argument: &quot;my&quot;, &quot;report.txt&quot;)<br>rm &quot;$file&quot;  -&gt;  rm &quot;my report.txt&quot;    (1 ta argument)<br><br>p=&quot;*.log&quot;<br>echo $p     -&gt;  a.log b.log c.log     (glob ochildi)<br>echo &quot;$p&quot;   -&gt;  *.log</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>file=&quot;my report.txt&quot;<br>rm $file          # XATO: 'my' va 'report.txt' ni o'chirishga urinadi<br>rm &quot;$file&quot;        # to'g'ri<br><br>dir=&quot;&quot;<br>rm -rf $dir/*     # XATO: rm -rf /*  (!!)<br>rm -rf &quot;${dir:?}&quot;/*   # dir bo'sh bo'lsa to'xtaydi<br><br># Argumentlarni boshqa buyruqqa uzatish<br>for arg in &quot;$@&quot;; do echo &quot;[$arg]&quot;; done   # har argument butun saqlanadi<br><br># Buyruq natijasi ham<br>files=&quot;$(ls /tmp)&quot;<br>echo &quot;$files&quot;     # qatorlar saqlanadi<br><br>shellcheck deploy.sh    # SC2086: Double quote to prevent globbing and word splitting</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>&quot;$@&quot;</code> va <code>$@</code>/<code>$*</code> farqi: faqat <code>&quot;$@&quot;</code> har argumentni alohida va butun saqlaydi.</li><li><code>[ $var = x ]</code> — bo'sh <code>var</code> da &quot;unary operator expected&quot;; <code>[[ &quot;$var&quot; == x ]]</code>.</li><li>Ataylab bo'lish kerak bo'lsa (masalan flag'lar ro'yxati) — massiv ishlating: <code>&quot;${flags[@]}&quot;</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: har doim qo'shtirnoq, istisno kamdan-kam va ataylab. <code>shellcheck</code> ni CI'ga qo'shing — u tirnoqlash xatolarining deyarli hammasini avtomatik topadi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34074	<p>Bash'da <code>for</code> sikl va <code>if</code> sharti misoli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>for x in ro'yxat; do ...; done</code> — ro'yxat elementlari bo'yicha takrorlaydi. <code>if shart; then ...; elif ...; else ...; fi</code> — shart (aslida buyruqning exit code'i) bo'yicha tarmoqlanadi. 80 )); then<br>  echo &quot;OGOHLANTIRISH: ${disk}%&quot;<br>fi<br><br># Raqamlar oralig'i va fayllar bo'yicha sikl<br>for i in {1..5}; do echo &quot;urinish $i&quot;; done<br>for f in /var/log/*.log; Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34075	<p>stdout, stderr va redirect (<code>&gt;</code>, <code>&gt;&gt;</code>, <code>2&gt;&amp;1</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Har jarayonda uchta standart oqim bor: stdin (0), stdout (1 — oddiy natija), stderr (2 — xatolar). <code>&gt;</code> — stdout'ni faylga yozadi (ustidan), <code>&gt;&gt;</code> — oxiriga qo'shadi, <code>2&gt;</code> — stderr'ni yo'naltiradi, <code>2&gt;&amp;1</code> — stderr'ni stdout bilan bir joyga yuboradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cron'dagi backup xato beradi, lekin log faylda hech narsa yo'q — chunki faqat stdout yo'naltirilgan, xato xabarlari (stderr) yo'qolgan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>          +---------+<br>stdin 0 -&gt;| buyruq  |-&gt; stdout 1 -&gt; ekran (yoki &gt; fayl)<br>          |         |-&gt; stderr 2 -&gt; ekran (yoki 2&gt; fayl)<br>          +---------+<br>cmd &gt; all.log 2&gt;&amp;1 :<br>   1) stdout -&gt; all.log<br>   2) stderr -&gt; stdout qayerda bo'lsa (all.log)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>ls /etc &gt; out.log            # stdout faylga (ustidan yozadi)<br>ls /etc &gt;&gt; out.log           # oxiriga qo'shadi<br>ls /yoq 2&gt; err.log           # faqat xatolar<br>cmd &gt; all.log 2&gt;&amp;1           # ikkalasi bitta faylga<br>cmd &amp;&gt; all.log               # Bash qisqartmasi<br>cmd &gt; /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1         # hammasini tashlash<br>cmd 2&gt;/dev/null              # faqat xatolarni yashirish<br><br># Ham ekranda ko'rish, ham faylga yozish<br>./deploy.sh 2&gt;&amp;1 | tee deploy.log<br><br># O'z skriptingizda xatoni stderr'ga yozish<br>echo &quot;XATO: config topilmadi&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br><br># Cron misoli<br>0 2 * * * /opt/backup.sh &gt;&gt; /var/log/backup.log 2&gt;&amp;1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>cmd 2&gt;&amp;1 &gt; file</code> — tartib noto'g'ri: stderr baribir ekranga chiqadi. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34076	<p>Skriptga argument qanday uzatiladi (<code>$1</code>, <code>$#</code>, <code>$@</code>)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Skriptga berilgan argumentlar <code>$1</code>, <code>$2</code>, ... da; <code>$0</code> — skript nomi; <code>$#</code> — argumentlar soni; <code>&quot;$@&quot;</code> — hamma argumentlar, har biri alohida. <code>shift</code> birinchi argumentni olib tashlab qolganini chapga suradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta deploy skriptini dev, staging va prod uchun ishlatish kerak — muhit nomini argument sifatida berasiz. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34347	<p>Bash'da arifmetika qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bash butun sonlar arifmetikasini <code>$(( ifoda ))</code> (natija qaytaradi) va <code>(( ifoda ))</code> (hisoblaydi, shart sifatida exit code beradi) bilan bajaradi. Ichida <code>$</code> ixtiyoriy: <code>$((a + b))</code>. Kasr sonlar qo'llanmaydi — buning uchun <code>bc</code> yoki <code>awk</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Retry urinishlarini sanash, kutish vaqtini hisoblash, disk foizini limit bilan solishtirish — skriptlarda doim kerak. <code>expr</code> yoki tashqi buyruq ishlatish eski va sekin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>$((5 + 3))      -&gt; 8   (qiymat)<br>$((7 / 2))      -&gt; 3   (butun bo'linish, kasr tashlanadi)<br>$((7 % 2))      -&gt; 1   (qoldiq)<br>$((2 ** 10))    -&gt; 1024<br>(( a &gt; b ))     -&gt; rost bo'lsa exit 0, aks holda 1</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>a=5; b=3<br>echo $((a + b))              # 8<br>echo $((a * b))              # 15<br>sum=$(( a + b ))<br><br>count=0<br>((count++))                  # oshirish<br>((count += 5))<br>echo &quot;$count&quot;                # 6<br><br>if (( a &gt; b )); then echo &quot;a katta&quot;; fi<br><br># Retry'da kutish vaqti: 2, 4, 8 soniya<br>for i in 1 2 3; do<br>  sleep $(( 2 ** i ))<br>done<br><br># Kasr sonlar<br>echo &quot;scale=2; 10 / 3&quot; | bc        # 3.33<br>awk 'BEGIN { printf &quot;%.1f\n&quot;, 7/2 }'   # 3.5<br><br># Foiz hisoblash<br>used=37; total=120<br>echo &quot;$(( used * 100 / total ))%&quot;  # 30%  (avval ko'paytirish!)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>set -e</code> bilan <code>((count++))</code> count=0 bo'lganda exit 1 qaytaradi (natija 0 = &quot;false&quot;) va skript to'xtaydi. <code>((count+=1))</code> ham shunday; <code>count=$((count + 1))</code> xavfsiz.</li><li><code>08</code>, <code>09</code> — nol bilan boshlangan son sakkizlik deb o'qiladi: &quot;value too great for base&quot;. <code>$((10#$n))</code>.</li><li><code>$(( 7 / 2 * 100 ))</code> = 300, <code>$(( 7 * 100 / 2 ))</code> = 350 — butun bo'linish tartibi muhim.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pul, foiz yoki aniq hisob-kitob kerak bo'lgan joyda Bash arifmetikasiga tayanmang — <code>awk</code> yoki Python ishlating.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting

Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34349	<p>Bash funksiya qanday yoziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bash funksiya <code>nom() { buyruqlar; }</code> shaklida yoziladi va oddiy buyruq kabi chaqiriladi: <code>nom arg1 arg2</code>. Funksiya kodni bir joyga yig'adi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>log INFO &quot;Deploy boshlandi&quot;<br>  -&gt; $1 = INFO, $2 = &quot;Deploy boshlandi&quot;<br>  -&gt; shift -&gt; $* = &quot;Deploy boshlandi&quot;<br>qiymat:  result=$(get_version)   &lt;- funksiya echo qilgan narsa<br>status:  if check_health; then   &lt;- funksiya return kodi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>log() {<br>  local level=$1; shift<br>  echo &quot;$(date +%T) [$level] $*&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>}<br><br>die() { log ERROR &quot;$*&quot;; exit 1; }<br><br>get_version() {<br>  local file=${1:-VERSION}<br>  [[ -f &quot;$file&quot; ]] || return 1         # xato kodi<br>  cat &quot;$file&quot;                          # &quot;qaytarilgan&quot; qiymat<br>}<br><br>check_health() {<br>  curl -fsS --max-time 3 &quot;http://$1/health&quot; &gt; /dev/null<br>}                                      # oxirgi buyruq kodi = funksiya kodi<br><br>log INFO &quot;Deploy boshlandi&quot;<br>ver=$(get_version) || die &quot;VERSION fayl yo'q&quot;<br>check_health localhost:8080 &amp;&amp; log INFO &quot;sog'lom&quot; || log WARN &quot;javob yo'q&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>local</code> siz o'zgaruvchi global — boshqa funksiyadagi bir xil nomni buzadi.</li><li>Funksiya ichida <code>echo</code> bilan debug yozish — u <code>$(func)</code> natijasiga aralashadi. Log'ni <code>&gt;&amp;2</code> ga yozing.</li><li><code>return 300</code> — 255 dan katta bo'lsa 44 bo'lib qoladi (mod 256).</li><li>Funksiyani chaqirishdan <b>oldin</b> e'lon qilish kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Skriptni <code>main() { ... }; main &quot;$@&quot;</code> shaklida tuzing — barcha funksiyalar oldin e'lon qilinadi va mantiq yuqoridan pastga o'qiladi. <code>log</code>/<code>die</code> funksiyalari har skriptda bo'lsin.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34350	<p><code>$?</code>, <code>$$</code>, <code>$!</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>$?</code> — oxirgi bajarilgan buyruqning exit code'i (0 = OK). <code>$$</code> — joriy shell (skript) jarayonining PID'i. <code>$!</code> — fonda (<code>&amp;</code> bilan) ishga tushirilgan oxirgi jarayonning PID'i.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Fonda server ishga tushirib, keyin uni to'xtatish kerak — PID'ini bilmasangiz <code>kill</code> qila olmaysiz. Yoki buyruq muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldimi tekshirish kerak. Yoki skript o'z PID'ini lock faylga yozadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>skript (PID 4000)           $$ = 4000<br>  sleep 100 &amp;  -&gt; PID 4123  $! = 4123<br>  false        -&gt; exit 1    $? = 1<br>  true         -&gt; exit 0    $? = 0   (har buyruqdan keyin yangilanadi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br><br># $! — fon jarayonni boshqarish<br>python3 -m http.server 8000 &amp;<br>server_pid=$!<br>echo &quot;Server PID: $server_pid&quot;<br>sleep 2<br>curl -s localhost:8000 &gt; /dev/null &amp;&amp; echo &quot;server javob berdi&quot;<br>kill &quot;$server_pid&quot;<br>wait &quot;$server_pid&quot; 2&gt;/dev/null<br>echo &quot;server to'xtadi&quot;<br><br># $? — oxirgi buyruq kodi<br>grep -q root /etc/passwd<br>echo &quot;grep kodi: $?&quot;          # 0<br><br># $$ — joriy skript PID'i<br>echo &quot;Mening PID: $$&quot;<br>echo $$ &gt; /run/myjob.pid<br><br># Bir nechta fon jarayonni kutish va kodlarini tekshirish<br>pids=()<br>for h in web1 web2; do ssh &quot;$h&quot; uptime &amp; pids+=($!); done<br>for p in &quot;${pids[@]}&quot;; do wait &quot;$p&quot; || echo &quot;PID $p xato bilan tugadi&quot;; done</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>$?</code> faqat <b>oxirgi</b> buyruqniki — orada <code>echo</code> yoki <code>[[ ]]</code> bo'lsa yo'qoladi. Darhol <code>rc=$?</code> ga saqlang.</li><li>Subshell <code>( )</code> ichida <code>$$</code> baribir asosiy skript PID'ini ko'rsatadi; haqiqiy PID uchun <code>$BASHPID</code>.</li><li><code>$$</code> bilan vaqtinchalik fayl nomi (<code>/tmp/x.$$</code>) — oldindan taxmin qilinadi, xavfsiz emas; <code>mktemp</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Fon jarayonlarni har doim <code>wait &quot;$pid&quot;</code> bilan kuting va <code>trap</code> ichida o'ldiring — aks holda skript tugaganda yetim (orphan) jarayonlar qoladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34351	<p><code>&amp;&amp;</code> va <code>||</code> qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>a &amp;&amp; b</code> — <code>b</code> faqat <code>a</code> muvaffaqiyatli (exit 0) bo'lsa bajariladi. <code>a || b</code> — <code>b</code> faqat <code>a</code> xato bersa bajariladi. Bular qisqa shartli zanjirlar: &quot;shu bo'lsa — keyingisini qil&quot; va &quot;bo'lmasa — buni qil&quot;.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>mkdir /data; cd /data; rm -rf *</code> — agar <code>cd</code> xato bo'lsa, <code>rm</code> joriy (noto'g'ri) papkada ishlaydi. <code>&amp;&amp;</code> bilan zanjir xatoda to'xtaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>a &amp;&amp; b       a OK  -&gt; b bajariladi<br>             a XATO -&gt; b o'tkazib yuboriladi<br>a || b       a OK  -&gt; b o'tkazib yuboriladi<br>             a XATO -&gt; b bajariladi<br>a &amp;&amp; b || c  DIQQAT: b xato bersa ham c ishlaydi (if-else EMAS)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>mkdir -p /data &amp;&amp; cd /data &amp;&amp; echo &quot;tayyor&quot;<br><br>ping -c1 -W1 db &gt; /dev/null || echo &quot;db javob bermayapti&quot;<br><br>cd /app || exit 1                         # xato bo'lsa chiqish<br><br># Bir nechta amal: { } bilan guruhlash<br>cp app.conf /etc/app/ || { echo &quot;nusxalab bo'lmadi&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 1; }<br><br># Mavjud bo'lmasa yaratish<br>id app &amp;&gt;/dev/null || useradd --system app<br><br># Haqiqiy if-else kerak bo'lsa — if yozing<br>if systemctl restart nginx; then<br>  echo &quot;qayta ishga tushdi&quot;<br>else<br>  echo &quot;xato&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>fi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>a &amp;&amp; b || c</code> ni if-else deb ishlatish: <code>b</code> xato bersa <code>c</code> ham ishlaydi. Muhim mantiqda <code>if/else</code>.</li><li><code>cmd || echo &quot;xato&quot;</code> — xabar chiqadi, lekin skript davom etadi va oxirida 0 qaytarishi mumkin; kerak bo'lsa <code>exit 1</code> qo'shing.</li><li><code>set -e</code> bilan: <code>&amp;&amp;</code> zanjirining chap qismidagi xato skriptni to'xtatmaydi — bu yashirin holat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>cd dir || exit</code> — har bir <code>cd</code> dan keyin yozilishi kerak bo'lgan qoida (<code>shellcheck</code> SC2164 shuni eslatadi). Zanjirlar 2-3 qismdan uzun bo'lsa — <code>if</code> bilan yozing, o'qish oson.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34352	<p><code>case</code> operatori misoli?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>case</code> — bitta qiymatni bir nechta shablon (pattern) bilan solishtirib, mos kelgan tarmoqni bajaradi. Har tarmoq <code>)</code> bilan boshlanib <code>;;</code> bilan tugaydi, <code>*)</code> — default (hech biri mos kelmasa). Uzun <code>if/elif</code> zanjiridan toza.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Servis boshqarish skripti <code>start|stop|restart|status</code> buyruqlarini qabul qiladi. <code>if [[ $1 == start ]]; elif ...</code> zanjiri uzun va o'qish qiyin; glob: .log bilan tugasa<br>  [0-9]*)       -&gt; raqam bilan boshlansa<br>  *)            -&gt; qolgan hamma holat (default)<br>esac<br>Birinchi mos kelgan tarmoq bajariladi, keyingilari tekshirilmaydi.</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>case &quot;${1:-}&quot; in<br>  start)   systemctl start app ;;<br>  stop)    systemctl stop app ;;<br>  restart) systemctl restart app ;;<br>  status)  systemctl status app --no-pager ;;<br>  -h|--help|&quot;&quot;)<br>           echo &quot;Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}&quot;; exit 0 ;;<br>  *)       echo &quot;Noma'lum buyruq: $1&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>           echo &quot;Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>           exit 1 ;;<br>esac<br><br># Muhitni tekshirish<br>env=&quot;$2&quot;<br>case &quot;$env&quot; in<br>  dev|staging) replicas=1 ;;<br>  prod)        replicas=3 ;;<br>  *)           echo &quot;noto'g'ri env&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 2 ;;<br>esac<br><br># Fayl turi bo'yicha<br>case &quot;$file&quot; in<br>  *.tar.gz|*.tgz) tar xzf &quot;$file&quot; ;;<br>  *.zip)          unzip &quot;$file&quot; ;;<br>esac</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>;;</code> unutilsa — sintaksis xato.</li><li><code>*)</code> default tarmog'ini qo'ymaslik — noto'g'ri input jim o'tib ketadi.</li><li>Shablonlar glob, regex emas: <code>[0-9]+</code> &quot;bitta raqam va plus belgisi&quot; degani.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>case</code> — input'ni allowlist bo'yicha tekshirishning eng toza usuli: faqat ruxsat etilgan qiymatlar tarmoqqa tushadi, qolgani <code>*)</code> da rad etiladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34353	<p>Bash massivlar bilan ishlash?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bash massivi <code>arr=(a b c)</code> bilan yaratiladi; hamma elementlar <code>&quot;${arr[@]}&quot;</code>, bittasi <code>${arr[0]}</code>, soni <code>${#arr[@]}</code>, qo'shish <code>arr+=(d)</code>. Bash 4+ da kalit-qiymat (assotsiativ) massiv ham bor: <code>declare -A</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Server ro'yxatini bitta stringda saqlash (<code>servers=&quot;web1 web2&quot;</code>) — nomida bo'shliq bo'lsa buziladi va element qo'shish/sanash noqulay. Massiv har elementni alohida saqlaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>servers=(web1 web2 db1)<br> indeks:  [0]   [1]  [2]<br>&quot;${servers[@]}&quot;   -&gt; &quot;web1&quot; &quot;web2&quot; &quot;db1&quot;   (har biri alohida)<br>${#servers[@]}    -&gt; 3<br>servers+=(cache1) -&gt; [3]=cache1</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>servers=(web1 web2 db1)<br><br>for s in &quot;${servers[@]}&quot;; do<br>  echo &quot;server: $s&quot;<br>done<br><br>echo &quot;Soni: ${#servers[@]}&quot;<br>echo &quot;Birinchi: ${servers[0]}&quot;<br>echo &quot;Oxirgi: ${servers[-1]}&quot;          # bash 4.3+<br>servers+=(cache1)<br>echo &quot;${servers[@]:1:2}&quot;               # bo'lak: web2 db1<br><br># Buyruq natijasini massivga (qator bo'yicha)<br>mapfile -t pods &lt; &lt;(kubectl get pods -o name)<br>echo &quot;Pod soni: ${#pods[@]}&quot;<br><br># Assotsiativ massiv<br>declare -A port=([web]=80 [api]=8080 [db]=5432)<br>echo &quot;${port[api]}&quot;<br>for k in &quot;${!port[@]}&quot;; do echo &quot;$k -&gt; ${port[$k]}&quot;; done<br><br># Buyruq flag'larini xavfsiz yig'ish<br>args=(--namespace prod --timeout 5m)<br>[[ &quot;${DRY:-0}&quot; == 1 ]] &amp;&amp; args+=(--dry-run=client)<br>kubectl apply -f app.yaml &quot;${args[@]}&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>${servers}</code> (indekssiz) — faqat birinchi element.</li><li><code>${servers[@]}</code> tirnoqsiz — bo'shliqli elementlar bo'linib ketadi; doim <code>&quot;${arr[@]}&quot;</code>.</li><li><code>arr=$(cmd)</code> — massiv emas, bitta string; <code>mapfile -t</code> ishlating.</li><li>macOS'dagi default bash 3.2 da <code>declare -A</code> va <code>mapfile</code> yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Buyruq argumentlarini string'da emas, massivda yig'ing — bu tirnoqlash muammolarini butunlay yo'q qiladi. Massivlar POSIX <code>sh</code> da yo'q.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34354	<p><code>trap</code> nima uchun ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>trap 'buyruq' SIGNAL</code> — skript tugaganda (<code>EXIT</code>) yoki signal kelganda (<code>INT</code> — Ctrl+C, <code>TERM</code> — kill) bajariladigan kodni ro'yxatdan o'tkazadi. Asosiy vazifasi — skript qanday tugashidan qat'iy nazar tozalash: vaqtinchalik fayllar, lock, fon jarayonlar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript <code>/tmp</code> ga katta fayl yaratdi va oxirida o'chirishi kerak edi, lekin o'rtada xato bo'ldi (yoki siz Ctrl+C bosdingiz) — fayl qoldi. Har ishga tushishda yangi &quot;axlat&quot; yig'iladi va disk to'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>trap cleanup EXIT<br>skript:  normal tugadi     -&gt; cleanup<br>         xato (set -e)     -&gt; cleanup<br>         Ctrl+C (INT)      -&gt; cleanup<br>         kill (TERM)       -&gt; cleanup<br>         kill -9 (KILL)    -&gt; HECH NARSA (ushlab bo'lmaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>tmp=$(mktemp)<br>cleanup() {<br>  rm -f &quot;$tmp&quot;<br>  echo &quot;tozalandi&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>}<br>trap cleanup EXIT<br>trap 'echo &quot;To'&quot;'&quot;'xtatildi&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 130' INT TERM<br><br>curl -fsSL https://example.com/big.tar.gz -o &quot;$tmp&quot;<br>tar xzf &quot;$tmp&quot; -C /opt/app<br>echo &quot;tayyor&quot;</pre><p><code>trap -p</code> — o'rnatilgan trap'larni ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Qo'sh tirnoq: <code>trap &quot;rm -f $tmp&quot; EXIT</code> — <code>$tmp</code> trap yozilgan paytda ochiladi. Ko'pincha ishlaydi, lekin bitta tirnoq yoki funksiya xavfsizroq.</li><li>Single quote ichida apostrof (<code>To'xtatildi</code>) — tirnoq yopilib qoladi; funksiyaga oling yoki <code>'&quot;'&quot;'</code> hiylasi.</li><li><code>kill -9</code> va OOM'da trap ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Har vaqtinchalik resurs yaratilgan zahoti <code>trap ... EXIT</code> qo'ying. Docker/Kubernetes'da konteyner <code>SIGTERM</code> oladi — entrypoint skriptda uni ushlab ilovani to'g'ri to'xtatish graceful shutdown uchun shart.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34355	<p>Bash'da string bilan ishlash: uzunlik, almashtirish, kesish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bash parameter expansion bilan tashqi buyruqsiz string ishlash mumkin: <code>${#s}</code> — uzunlik, <code>${s/a/b}</code> — almashtirish, <code>${s:0:5}</code> — kesish, <code>${s#pat}</code>/<code>${s##pat}</code> — boshidan olib tashlash, <code>${s%pat}</code>/<code>${s%%pat}</code> — oxiridan olib tashlash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Fayl yo'lidan nomini, nomdan kengaytmani ajratish yoki string'ni almashtirish uchun har safar <code>basename</code>, <code>sed</code>, <code>cut</code> chaqirish — sekin (har biri yangi jarayon) va uzun.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>f=&quot;/var/log/app.log&quot;<br>${f##*/}   -&gt; app.log        (boshidan eng UZUN &quot;*/&quot; ni olib tashla)<br>${f#*/}    -&gt; var/log/app.log (eng QISQA)<br>${f%.*}    -&gt; /var/log/app   (oxiridan eng qisqa &quot;.*&quot;)<br>${f%/*}    -&gt; /var/log       (papka)<br>${f##*.}   -&gt; log            (kengaytma)<br>eslab qolish: # klaviaturada $ dan chapda (bosh), % o'ngda (oxir)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>f=&quot;/var/log/app.log&quot;<br>echo &quot;${#f}&quot;            # 16  — uzunlik<br>echo &quot;${f##*/}&quot;         # app.log  — basename<br>echo &quot;${f%/*}&quot;          # /var/log — dirname<br>echo &quot;${f%.*}&quot;          # /var/log/app — kengaytmasiz<br>echo &quot;${f##*.}&quot;         # log — kengaytma<br>echo &quot;${f/log/LOG}&quot;     # /var/LOG/app.log — birinchisini almashtirish<br>echo &quot;${f//log/LOG}&quot;    # /var/LOG/app.LOG — hammasini<br>echo &quot;${f:0:8}&quot;         # /var/log — kesish<br><br># Amaliy: barcha .log fayllarni .bak ga nusxalash<br>for file in /var/log/app/*.log; do<br>  cp &quot;$file&quot; &quot;${file%.log}.bak&quot;<br>done<br><br># Katta/kichik harf (bash 4+)<br>env=&quot;Prod&quot;; echo &quot;${env,,}&quot;   # prod<br>echo &quot;${env^^}&quot;               # PROD</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Shablonlar regex emas, glob (<code>*</code>, <code>?</code>, <code>[...]</code>).</li><li><code>#</code> va <code>##</code> farqi: bir belgi — eng qisqa moslik, ikki belgi — eng uzun.</li><li><code>${f%.*}</code> nomida nuqta bo'lmasa o'zgarmaydi; <code>archive.tar.gz</code> da <code>${f%.*}</code> -&gt; <code>archive.tar</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sikl ichida minglab fayl bilan ishlaganda parameter expansion <code>basename</code>/<code>sed</code> dan o'nlab marta tez, chunki jarayon yaratilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34356	<p><code>grep</code>, <code>awk</code>, <code>sed</code> ni skriptda qachon ishlatasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>grep</code> — qatorlarni qidirish/filtrlash (&quot;qaysi qatorlarda ERROR bor?&quot;). <code>awk</code> — ustunlar bilan ishlash va hisoblash (&quot;3-ustunni chiqar&quot;, &quot;jami nechta?&quot;). <code>sed</code> — matnni almashtirish yoki tahrirlash (&quot;eski host'ni yangisiga almashtir&quot;).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Log'dan xatolarni topish, <code>df</code> chiqishidan to'lgan disklarni ajratish, konfig fayldagi qiymatni o'zgartirish — har kungi DevOps vazifalari. To'g'ri vositani tanlash skriptni bir qatorga qisqartiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>grep : qator  -&gt; mos keldimi? -&gt; ha: chiqar<br>awk  : qator  -&gt; $1 $2 $3 ... ustunlarga bo'l -&gt; shart { amal }<br>sed  : qator  -&gt; s/eski/yangi/ -&gt; o'zgargan qatorni chiqar (-i: faylga yoz)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># grep — qidirish<br>grep -E 'ERROR|FATAL' app.log            # ikki so'zdan biri<br>grep -i 'timeout' app.log                # katta-kichik harf farqsiz<br>grep -c ERROR app.log                    # nechta qator<br>grep -rn 'password' /etc/app/            # rekursiv, qator raqami bilan<br><br># awk — ustunlar<br>awk -F: '{print $1}' /etc/passwd         # &quot;:&quot; bilan ajratilgan 1-ustun<br>df -h | awk 'NR&gt;1 &amp;&amp; $5+0 &gt; 80 {print $6, $5}'   # 80% dan to'lgan disklar<br>awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5   # top IP<br><br># sed — almashtirish<br>sed 's/old_host/new_host/g' config.ini           # ekranga, fayl o'zgarmaydi<br>sed -i.bak 's/old_host/new_host/g' config.ini    # faylda, .bak zaxira bilan<br>sed -n '10,20p' app.log                          # 10-20 qatorlar</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>sed -i</code> zaxirasiz — xato almashtirish faylni buzadi; avval <code>-i</code> siz tekshiring.</li><li><code>grep pattern</code> da <code>.</code> &quot;har qanday belgi&quot; — IP qidirganda <code>grep -F '10.0.0.1'</code> (literal).</li><li>awk dasturini doim bitta tirnoqqa oling: <code>awk '{print $1}'</code> — qo'sh tirnoqda <code>$1</code> ni Bash ochib yuboradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Strukturali ma'lumot (JSON, YAML) uchun <code>grep/sed</code> emas — <code>jq</code>/<code>yq</code>. Pipeline juda uzun bo'lsa Python'ga o'tish vaqti keldi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34357	<p>Skriptni debug qilish usullari?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Asosiy usullar: <code>bash -x script.sh</code> (har buyruqni bajarilish paytida ko'rsatadi), skript ichida <code>set -x</code> / <code>set +x</code> (faqat bir qismni), <code>bash -n</code> (faqat sintaksisni tekshiradi) va <code>shellcheck</code> (ishga tushirmasdan xatolarni topadi).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript &quot;ishlamayapti&quot;, lekin qaysi qatorda va nega — noma'lum. Har joyga <code>echo</code> qo'shish sekin. Secret bilan blokda <code>set +x</code>.</li><li>Trace stderr'ga yoziladi — <code>2&gt;/dev/null</code> qilingan bo'lsa ko'rinmaydi.</li><li><code>bash -x script.sh</code> shebang'ni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi — skript <code>sh</code> uchun yozilgan bo'lsa boshqacha ishlashi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>shellcheck</code> ni pre-commit va CI'ga qo'shing — xatolarning ko'pi prod'ga yetmasdan topiladi.
