Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34358	<p>Disk 80% dan oshsa xabar beradigan oddiy skript?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>df -P</code> chiqishini <code>awk</code> bilan o'qib, foiz ustunini limit bilan solishtiring; oshganlarini xabar qiling (stderr, log, Slack webhook) va natijaga qarab exit code qaytaring. Skript cron yoki systemd timer bilan muntazam ishga tushiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Disk 100% bo'lganda DB yozishni to'xtatadi, log'lar yo'qoladi, servis yiqiladi. 80% da ogohlantirish olish — tozalash yoki kengaytirish uchun vaqt beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>df -P  -&gt;  Filesystem 1024-blocks Used Available Capacity Mounted<br>           /dev/sda1  50000000  42000000  8000000  84%  /<br>awk    -&gt;  $5 dan &quot;%&quot; ni olib tashla -&gt; 84 &gt; 80 ? -&gt; chiqar &quot;/ 84%&quot;<br>while  -&gt;  har qator uchun xabar<br>exit   -&gt;  muammo bo'lsa 1 (monitoring/cron ko'radi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>LIMIT=&quot;${1:-80}&quot;<br>alerts=0<br><br># -P: bitta qatorli POSIX format; tmpfs/overlay kabi virtual FS'larni chiqarib tashlash<br>while read -r mnt use; do<br>  echo &quot;OGOHLANTIRISH: $mnt ${use}% (limit ${LIMIT}%)&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>  alerts=$((alerts + 1))<br>  # Slack'ga yuborish (ixtiyoriy):<br>  # curl -fsS -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \<br>  #   --data &quot;{\&quot;text\&quot;:\&quot;$(hostname): $mnt ${use}%\&quot;}&quot; &quot;$SLACK_WEBHOOK&quot;<br>done &lt; &lt;(df -P -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x overlay | awk -v l=&quot;$LIMIT&quot; \<br>          'NR&gt;1 { gsub(&quot;%&quot;,&quot;&quot;,$5); if ($5+0 &gt; l) print $6, $5 }')<br><br>if (( alerts &gt; 0 )); then exit 1; fi<br>echo &quot;Hammasi joyida&quot;</pre><pre># cron: har 10 daqiqada<br>*/10 * * * * /opt/bin/disk-check.sh 85 &gt;&gt; /var/log/disk-check.log 2&gt;&amp;1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>df</code> (P siz) uzun device nomlarini ikki qatorga bo'ladi — ustunlar siljiydi. <code>-P</code> ishlating.</li><li>Inode'lar ham tugashi mumkin (joy bor, lekin fayl yaratib bo'lmaydi) — <code>df -i</code> ni ham tekshiring.</li><li><code>$5 &gt; l</code> string solishtirish bo'lib qolmasligi uchun <code>$5+0</code> (son).</li><li>Pipe ichidagi <code>while</code> subshell'da — <code>alerts</code> tashqarida 0 qoladi; shuning uchun <code>&lt; &lt;(...)</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bunday skript — kichik muhit yoki zaxira uchun. Production'da node_exporter + Prometheus alert (<code>predict_linear</code> bilan &quot;4 soatda to'ladi&quot;) foiz chegarasidan ancha aqlli.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34359	<p>Bir nechta serverda buyruq bajaradigan skript?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Host'lar ro'yxati bo'yicha sikl ichida <code>ssh host 'buyruq'</code> ishlatiladi, <code>ConnectTimeout</code> va <code>BatchMode</code> bilan; har host natijasi va xatosi alohida ko'rsatiladi. Ko'p server uchun parallel (<code>&amp;</code> + <code>wait</code> yoki <code>xargs -P</code>), undan ham ko'p uchun — Ansible.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 10 ta serverda disk va uptime'ni tekshirish kerak. Qo'lda har biriga kirish — 10 daqiqa va xatolarga moyil. Skript buni bir buyruq bilan qiladi; bitta server javob bermasa, qolganlari to'xtamasligi kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>hosts: web1 web2 web3<br>  web1 -&gt; ssh -&gt; uptime; df -h /  -&gt; natija<br>  web2 -&gt; ssh -&gt; ulanmadi (timeout 5s) -&gt; &quot;web2: xato&quot;, davom<br>  web3 -&gt; ssh -&gt; natija</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -uo pipefail                       # -e yo'q: bitta host xatosi to'xtatmasin<br><br>SSH_OPTS=(-o ConnectTimeout=5 -o BatchMode=yes -n)<br>failed=()<br><br>for h in web1 web2 web3; do<br>  echo &quot;== $h&quot;<br>  if ! ssh &quot;${SSH_OPTS[@]}&quot; &quot;$h&quot; 'uptime; df -h / | tail -1'; then<br>    echo &quot;$h: xato&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>    failed+=(&quot;$h&quot;)<br>  fi<br>done<br><br>if (( ${#failed[@]} &gt; 0 )); then<br>  echo &quot;Muvaffaqiyatsiz: ${failed[*]}&quot; &gt;&amp;2<br>  exit 1<br>fi<br><br># Parallel variant (har host o'z faylida)<br>for h in web1 web2 web3; do<br>  ssh &quot;${SSH_OPTS[@]}&quot; &quot;$h&quot; uptime &gt; &quot;out-$h.txt&quot; 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;<br>done<br>wait</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>BatchMode=yes</code> siz — parol so'rab skript qotib qoladi.</li><li><code>-n</code> siz ssh <code>while read</code> siklida stdin'ni yutib yuboradi.</li><li><code>set -e</code> bilan bitta server xatosi butun siklni to'xtatadi.</li><li>Birinchi ulanishda host key so'rovi — <code>known_hosts</code> ni oldindan to'ldiring (<code>ssh-keyscan</code>), <code>StrictHostKeyChecking=no</code> emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 5-10 dan ortiq server yoki takroriy ish bo'lsa — Ansible (<code>ansible all -m shell -a uptime</code>), idempotentlik, inventory va parallel ishlash tayyor keladi. Cloud'da SSH'siz variant — AWS SSM Run Command.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34360	<p>Here document (<code>&lt;&lt;EOF</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Here document (<code>&lt;&lt;EOF ... EOF</code>) — buyruqqa bir nechta qatorli matnni stdin orqali beradi. Fayl yaratish, konfig yozish yoki masofaviy serverga skript yuborish uchun qulay. <code>&lt;&lt;EOF</code> da o'zgaruvchilar ochiladi, <code>&lt;&lt;'EOF'</code> da ochilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript konfig faylni yaratishi kerak. <code>echo &quot;...&quot; &gt;&gt; fayl</code> ni 20 marta yozish — o'qish qiyin va xatoga moyil. Heredoc matnni xuddi faylda ko'rinadigandek yozish imkonini beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>cat &gt; fayl &lt;&lt;EOF       &lt;- &quot;EOF&quot; so'zigacha bo'lgan hamma narsa cat'ning stdin'i<br>host=$DB_HOST          &lt;- $DB_HOST qiymati qo'yiladi<br>EOF                    &lt;- tugash belgisi (qator boshida, yolg'iz)<br><br>&lt;&lt;'EOF'                &lt;- tirnoqli: $ va $( ) literal qoladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>DB_HOST=db.local<br><br># O'zgaruvchilar bilan konfig<br>cat &gt; /etc/app.conf &lt;&lt;EOF<br>host=$DB_HOST<br>port=5432<br>created=$(date +%F)<br>EOF<br><br># Literal (o'zgaruvchilar ochilmaydi) — boshqa skript yaratish<br>cat &gt; /usr/local/bin/hello.sh &lt;&lt;'EOF'<br>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>echo &quot;Salom, $USER&quot;<br>EOF<br>chmod +x /usr/local/bin/hello.sh<br><br># sudo bilan faylga yozish<br>sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-app.conf &gt; /dev/null &lt;&lt;EOF<br>vm.swappiness=10<br>EOF<br><br># Masofaviy serverda bir nechta buyruq<br>ssh web1 bash -s &lt;&lt;'EOF'<br>set -e<br>df -h /<br>systemctl is-active nginx<br>EOF</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Yopuvchi <code>EOF</code> oldida yoki keyin bo'shliq bo'lsa — topilmaydi va heredoc fayl oxirigacha davom etadi.</li><li><code>sudo cat &gt; /etc/x &lt;&lt;EOF</code> — redirect sudo'siz bajariladi: &quot;Permission denied&quot;. <code>sudo tee</code> ishlating.</li><li>Tirnoqsiz heredoc ichidagi <code>$</code> belgilarini (masalan Nginx <code>$host</code>) Bash bo'sh qiymatga almashtiradi — <code>\$host</code> yoki <code>&lt;&lt;'EOF'</code>.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Katta yoki ko'p muhitli konfiglar uchun heredoc emas, shablon (<code>envsubst</code>, Ansible template, Helm) ishlating — o'zgarishlarni review qilish va test qilish oson.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34361	<p><code>xargs</code> nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>xargs</code> — stdin'dan kelgan ro'yxatni (fayl nomlari, host'lar) olib, ularni boshqa buyruqqa <b>argument</b> sifatida beradi. Ko'p ishlatiladigan flag'lar: <code>-0</code> (null bilan ajratilgan, bo'shliqli nomlar uchun), <code>-I{}</code> (argumentni aniq joyga qo'yish), <code>-P N</code> (N ta parallel), <code>-n 1</code> (har chaqiruvga bitta).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ko'p buyruqlar ro'yxatni stdin'dan emas, argumentdan kutadi (<code>rm</code>, <code>gzip</code>, <code>ssh</code>). <code>find ... | rm</code> ishlamaydi. <code>xargs</code> bu &quot;ko'prik&quot;ni yasaydi va parallel ishlatishni ham beradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>find ... -print0  -&gt;  a.log\0b.log\0c.log<br>xargs -0 rm -f    -&gt;  rm -f a.log b.log c.log   (bitta yoki bir necha chaqiruvda)<br>xargs -I{} -P4 ssh {} uptime<br>                  -&gt;  ssh web1 uptime  ssh web2 uptime ... (4 tadan parallel)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># 7 kundan eski log'larni o'chirish (bo'shliqli nomlar bilan xavfsiz)<br>find /tmp -name '*.log' -mtime +7 -print0 | xargs -0 rm -f<br><br># Har host'da uptime, 4 tadan parallel<br>xargs -I{} -P4 ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5 {} uptime &lt; hosts.txt<br><br># Fayllarni parallel siqish (yadrolar soni bo'yicha)<br>find /data -name '*.csv' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -P&quot;$(nproc)&quot; gzip<br><br># Bo'sh input'da buyruq ishlamasin<br>grep -l TODO *.py | xargs -r sed -i 's/TODO/FIXME/'<br><br># Nima bajarilishini oldindan ko'rish<br>find . -name '*.tmp' | xargs -t echo rm</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>-print0</code>/<code>-0</code> siz bo'shliq yoki newline'li fayl nomlari bo'linib ketadi — noto'g'ri fayllar o'chishi mumkin.</li><li>GNU xargs bo'sh input'da ham buyruqni bir marta ishga tushiradi (<code>rm</code> argumentsiz) — <code>-r</code> qo'shing.</li><li>Parallel jarayonlar chiqishi aralashadi — har biri alohida faylga yozsin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>find -exec cmd {} +</code> ham argumentlarni guruhlab beradi va oddiy hollarda <code>xargs</code> o'rnini bosadi. Parallel, retry va tartibli chiqish kerak bo'lsa — GNU <code>parallel</code>.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34362	<p>Bash skriptda input so'rash (<code>read</code>)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>read</code> buyrug'i foydalanuvchidan input oladi: <code>read -rp &quot;Savol: &quot; var</code> — savolni ko'rsatib javobni <code>var</code> ga yozadi; <code>-s</code> — kiritilganini ekranda ko'rsatmaydi (parol), <code>-t N</code> — N soniya kutadi. Lekin avtomatlashtirishda (CI, cron) interaktiv input yo'q — u yerda argument yoki env ishlatiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Prod'ga deploy qiladigan skript tasodifan ishga tushirilsa zarar keltiradi. Tasdiqlash so'rovi (&quot;Ishonchingiz komilmi?&quot;) inson xatosidan himoya qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>read -rp &quot;Muhit: &quot; env<br>  -p : savol matni<br>  -r : backslash'ni o'zgartirmaydi<br>  -s : jim (parol uchun)<br>  -t : timeout<br>  -n 1 : bitta belgi (Enter kutmaydi)<br>stdin terminal emas (CI) -&gt; read darhol EOF oladi -&gt; exit 1</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>read -rp &quot;Muhit (dev/prod): &quot; env<br>read -rsp &quot;Parol: &quot; pass; echo        # -s dan keyin yangi qator<br><br>if [[ &quot;$env&quot; == &quot;prod&quot; ]]; then<br>  read -rp &quot;PROD ga deploy. Ishonchingiz komilmi? (yes/no) &quot; ok<br>  [[ &quot;$ok&quot; == &quot;yes&quot; ]] || { echo &quot;Bekor qilindi&quot;; exit 1; }<br>fi<br><br># Timeout bilan, default qiymat<br>read -rt 10 -p &quot;Davom etilsinmi? [Y/n] &quot; ans || ans=&quot;y&quot;<br>[[ &quot;${ans,,}&quot; =~ ^(y|yes|)$ ]] || exit 0<br><br># Interaktiv emas bo'lsa (CI) — argument/env'dan<br>if [[ -t 0 ]]; then<br>  read -rp &quot;Versiya: &quot; version<br>else<br>  version=&quot;${VERSION:?VERSION env kerak}&quot;<br>fi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>CI'da <code>read</code> input olmaydi va <code>set -e</code> bilan skript to'xtaydi yoki bo'sh qiymat bilan davom etadi.</li><li><code>-s</code> siz parol ekranda ko'rinadi; <code>echo $pass</code> qilib log'ga chiqarish.</li><li><code>-r</code> siz <code>\</code> belgilari yo'qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avtomatlashtirish skriptlari non-interactive bo'lishi kerak: hamma narsa argument/env orqali, xavfli amallar uchun esa <code>--yes</code> yoki <code>--force</code> flag. Interaktiv so'rov faqat qo'lda ishlatiladigan yordamchi tool'larda.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34363	<p>Skriptda vaqtinchalik fayl qanday yaratiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>mktemp</code> — unikal nomli vaqtinchalik fayl (<code>mktemp</code>) yoki papka (<code>mktemp -d</code>) yaratadi va yo'lini qaytaradi. Faqat sizning foydalanuvchingiz o'qiy oladi (0600). Darhol <code>trap '...' EXIT</code> bilan o'chirishni ro'yxatdan o'tkazing.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>/tmp/myfile</code> kabi qattiq nom: bir vaqtda ikki nusxa ishlasa bir-birining faylini buzadi; boshqa foydalanuvchi oldindan shu nomda symlink yaratib (<code>/tmp/myfile -&gt; /etc/passwd</code>) skriptingizni muhim faylni ustidan yozishga majbur qilishi mumkin (symlink attack).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>mktemp          -&gt; /tmp/tmp.k3J9xQ2a     (fayl, rw-------)<br>mktemp -d       -&gt; /tmp/tmp.Zp81LmQe     (papka, rwx------)<br>mktemp /tmp/deploy.XXXXXX -&gt; X'lar tasodifiy belgilarga almashadi<br>Fayl atomik va &quot;faqat yo'q bo'lsa&quot; (O_EXCL) yaratiladi -&gt; race yo'q</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>tmp=$(mktemp)<br>dir=$(mktemp -d -t deploy.XXXXXX)<br>trap 'rm -rf &quot;$tmp&quot; &quot;$dir&quot;' EXIT        # skript qanday tugasa ham o'chadi<br><br>curl -fsSL https://example.com/app.tar.gz -o &quot;$tmp&quot;<br>tar xzf &quot;$tmp&quot; -C &quot;$dir&quot;<br>ls &quot;$dir&quot;<br><br># Atomik fayl yangilash: vaqtinchalikka yoz, keyin rename<br>new=$(mktemp /etc/app/.config.XXXXXX)   # bir xil FS'da bo'lishi kerak<br>generate_config &gt; &quot;$new&quot;<br>chmod 644 &quot;$new&quot;<br>mv &quot;$new&quot; /etc/app/config.yaml</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>trap</code> qo'yishni unutish — har ishga tushishda <code>/tmp</code> da axlat qoladi.</li><li><code>mktemp</code> <code>/tmp</code> da yaratadi; atomik <code>mv</code> uchun vaqtinchalik fayl maqsad bilan bir fayl tizimida bo'lishi kerak.</li><li><code>/tmp</code> ba'zan <code>noexec</code> yoki RAM (tmpfs) — katta fayllar yoki bajariladigan fayllar uchun <code>TMPDIR</code> ni boshqa joyga o'rnating.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> systemd servislarda <code>PrivateTmp=yes</code> har servisga alohida <code>/tmp</code> beradi — ma'lumot oqishi va nom to'qnashuvi yo'qoladi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34364	<p>Python skriptda shell buyrug'ini qanday ishga tushirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>subprocess.run([&quot;buyruq&quot;, &quot;arg&quot;], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)</code> — buyruqni ishga tushiradi, tugashini kutadi va natijani (<code>stdout</code>, <code>stderr</code>, <code>returncode</code>) qaytaradi. Argumentlarni list bilan bering (shell'siz), <code>check=True</code> xatoda exception chiqaradi, <code>timeout=</code> qotib qolishdan saqlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Python skripti <code>kubectl</code>, <code>git</code>, <code>df</code> kabi CLI tool'larni chaqirishi kerak. <code>os.system()</code> natijani olmaydi va shell injection'ga ochiq; kutadi<br>   -&gt; CompletedProcess(returncode=0, stdout=&quot;...&quot;, stderr=&quot;&quot;)<br>check=True va returncode != 0 -&gt; CalledProcessError</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import subprocess, sys<br><br>r = subprocess.run([&quot;df&quot;, &quot;-h&quot;, &quot;/&quot;], capture_output=True, text=True,<br>                   check=True, timeout=10)<br>print(r.stdout)<br><br># Xatolarni ushlash<br>try:<br>    out = subprocess.run([&quot;kubectl&quot;, &quot;get&quot;, &quot;pods&quot;, &quot;-n&quot;, &quot;prod&quot;, &quot;-o&quot;, &quot;name&quot;],<br>                         capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)<br>    pods = out.stdout.splitlines()<br>    print(f&quot;{len(pods)} ta pod&quot;)<br>except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:<br>    print(f&quot;kubectl xato (rc={e.returncode}): {e.stderr}&quot;, file=sys.stderr)<br>    sys.exit(1)<br>except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:<br>    print(&quot;kubectl javob bermadi&quot;, file=sys.stderr)<br>    sys.exit(1)<br><br># Foydalanuvchi input'i bilan — list xavfsiz<br>name = input(&quot;Namespace: &quot;)<br>subprocess.run([&quot;kubectl&quot;, &quot;get&quot;, &quot;ns&quot;, name], check=False)   # injection yo'q</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>shell=True</code> + foydalanuvchi input — <code>name=&quot;x; Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34365	<p>Python'da fayl o'qish va yozish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Faylni <code>with open(yo'l, rejim) as f:</code> bilan oching — blok tugaganda fayl avtomatik yopiladi. Rejimlar: <code>&quot;r&quot;</code> o'qish, <code>&quot;w&quot;</code> yozish (ustidan), <code>&quot;a&quot;</code> qo'shish, <code>&quot;rb&quot;/&quot;wb&quot;</code> binary. fayl ochiladi<br>    ...                -&gt; ishlaysiz<br>                       -&gt; blokdan chiqdi (xato bo'lsa ham) -&gt; f.close()<br>for line in f          -&gt; bittalab o'qiydi, xotira kam<br>f.read()               -&gt; hammasini bir yo'la (faqat kichik fayllar)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>from pathlib import Path<br><br># Qatorma-qator o'qish (katta fayl uchun ham)<br>with open(&quot;/etc/hosts&quot;, encoding=&quot;utf-8&quot;) as f:<br>    for line in f:<br>        line = line.strip()<br>        if line and not line.startswith(&quot;#&quot;):<br>            print(line)<br><br># Yozish (ustidan) va qo'shish<br>with open(&quot;out.txt&quot;, &quot;w&quot;, encoding=&quot;utf-8&quot;) as f:<br>    f.write(&quot;salom\n&quot;)<br>with open(&quot;out.txt&quot;, &quot;a&quot;, encoding=&quot;utf-8&quot;) as f:<br>    f.write(&quot;yana bir qator\n&quot;)<br><br># pathlib bilan qisqa<br>p = Path(&quot;/etc/app/config.ini&quot;)<br>if p.exists():<br>    text = p.read_text(encoding=&quot;utf-8&quot;)<br>Path(&quot;report.txt&quot;).write_text(&quot;OK\n&quot;, encoding=&quot;utf-8&quot;)<br><br># Xatolarni ushlash<br>try:<br>    data = Path(&quot;/etc/app/secret&quot;).read_text()<br>except FileNotFoundError:<br>    print(&quot;fayl yo'q&quot;)<br>except PermissionError:<br>    print(&quot;ruxsat yo'q&quot;)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>&quot;w&quot;</code> rejimi faylni darhol bo'shatadi — o'qish o'rniga tasodifan <code>&quot;w&quot;</code> bilan ochish ma'lumotni yo'qotadi.</li><li><code>encoding</code> bermaslik — tizim locale'iga bog'liq, boshqa serverda <code>UnicodeDecodeError</code>.</li><li>Muhim faylni to'g'ridan ustidan yozish — o'rtada xato bo'lsa yarim fayl qoladi; vaqtinchalik faylga yozib <code>replace()</code> qiling.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Config kabi muhim fayllarni atomik yozing: <code>tmp = p.with_suffix(&quot;.tmp&quot;); tmp.write_text(...); tmp.replace(p)</code> — o'quvchi hech qachon yarim yozilgan faylni ko'rmaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34366	<p>Python'da environment variable o'qish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>os.environ.get(&quot;NOM&quot;, &quot;default&quot;)</code> — ixtiyoriy o'zgaruvchi (yo'q bo'lsa default). <code>os.environ[&quot;NOM&quot;]</code> — majburiy: yo'q bo'lsa darhol <code>KeyError</code> bilan yiqiladi. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34367	<p>Python'da JSON va YAML bilan ishlash?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> JSON uchun standart <code>json</code> moduli: <code>json.load(f)</code>/<code>json.loads(s)</code> — o'qish, <code>json.dump(obj, f)</code>/<code>json.dumps(obj)</code> — yozish. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34368	<p>Python'da HTTP so'rov yuborish (<code>requests</code>)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>requests</code> kutubxonasi: <code>requests.get(url, timeout=5)</code> so'rov yuboradi, <code>r.raise_for_status()</code> 4xx/5xx bo'lsa exception chiqaradi, <code>r.json()</code> javobni dict'ga o'giradi. POST uchun <code>requests.post(url, json={...})</code>. <code>timeout</code> har doim berilishi shart.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Monitoring yoki deploy skripti API'ga murojaat qiladi. Timeout'siz so'rov server javob bermasa skriptni abadiy ushlab turadi; status kodni tekshirmaslik — 500 xato javobini &quot;muvaffaqiyat&quot; deb qabul qilish.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>requests.get(url, timeout=5)<br>   -&gt; ulanish (max 5s) -&gt; javob (max 5s)<br>   -&gt; Response: .status_code 200/404/500, .json(), .text, .headers<br>raise_for_status(): 400-599 -&gt; HTTPError<br>timeout tugadi              -&gt; requests.Timeout</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import requests, os, sys<br><br># GET<br>r = requests.get(&quot;https://api.github.com/repos/torvalds/linux&quot;, timeout=5)<br>r.raise_for_status()<br>print(r.json()[&quot;stargazers_count&quot;])<br><br># Auth va parametrlar bilan<br>headers = {&quot;Authorization&quot;: f&quot;Bearer {os.environ['API_TOKEN']}&quot;}<br>r = requests.get(&quot;https://api.example.com/deploys&quot;,<br>                 params={&quot;env&quot;: &quot;prod&quot;, &quot;limit&quot;: 10},<br>                 headers=headers, timeout=(3, 10))   # (ulanish, o'qish)<br><br># POST JSON<br>r = requests.post(&quot;https://hooks.slack.com/services/XXX&quot;,<br>                  json={&quot;text&quot;: &quot;Deploy tugadi&quot;}, timeout=5)<br><br># Xatolarni ushlash<br>try:<br>    r = requests.get(&quot;http://localhost:8080/health&quot;, timeout=3)<br>    r.raise_for_status()<br>    print(&quot;sog'lom&quot;)<br>except requests.Timeout:<br>    sys.exit(&quot;timeout&quot;)<br>except requests.RequestException as e:<br>    sys.exit(f&quot;xato: {e}&quot;)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>timeout</code> bermaslik — <code>requests</code> da default timeout <b>yo'q</b>.</li><li><code>verify=False</code> bilan SSL tekshiruvini o'chirish — MITM'ga ochiq; Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34369	<p>Python virtual environment (venv) nima uchun?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> venv — loyiha uchun alohida Python muhiti: o'z <code>python</code> va <code>pip</code>, o'z paketlar papkasi. Shunda loyihalar paket versiyalari bilan bir-biriga xalaqit bermaydi va tizim Python'i (OS uchun kerakli) buzilmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>sudo pip install</code> OS paketlarini ustidan yozadi va <code>apt</code> bilan ishlaydigan tool'larni buzadi. Yangi Ubuntu/Debian buni bloklaydi: <code>error: externally-managed-environment</code>. Ikki loyiha <code>requests</code> ning turli versiyalarini talab qilsa — global muhitda imkonsiz.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>tizim:   /usr/bin/python3  -&gt; /usr/lib/python3/...   (apt boshqaradi)<br>loyiha:  .venv/bin/python  -&gt; .venv/lib/.../site-packages  (pip boshqaradi)<br>source .venv/bin/activate -&gt; PATH boshiga .venv/bin qo'shiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>python3 -m venv .venv            # yaratish<br>source .venv/bin/activate        # yoqish (prompt'da (.venv) ko'rinadi)<br>which python                     # .../.venv/bin/python<br>pip install requests boto3<br>pip install -r requirements.txt  # loyiha paketlari<br>pip freeze &gt; requirements.txt    # aniq versiyalarni saqlash<br>deactivate                       # o'chirish<br><br># Cron/systemd'da activate'siz:<br>/opt/tools/.venv/bin/python /opt/tools/report.py<br><br># Tezroq zamonaviy alternativa<br>uv venv &amp;&amp; uv pip install -r requirements.txt</pre><p><code>.gitignore</code> ga <code>.venv/</code> qo'shing — u commit qilinmaydi, <code>requirements.txt</code> commit qilinadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>.venv</code> ni git'ga qo'shish yoki boshqa serverga nusxalash — yo'llar va OS'ga bog'liq, ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>activate</code> qilishni unutib global <code>pip</code> ga o'rnatish.</li><li>Versiyasiz <code>requirements.txt</code> (<code>requests</code>) — har o'rnatishda boshqa versiya, &quot;menda ishlardi&quot; muammosi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Server'dagi CLI tool'lar uchun <code>pipx</code> yoki <code>uv tool</code>, ilovalar uchun esa container image — dependency'lar image ichida muhrlanadi va hamma joyda bir xil.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34370	<p>Python'da xatolarni ushlash (try/except)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>try: ... except AniqXato: ...</code> — kutilgan xatoni ushlab, mazmunli xabar beradi yoki tiklanadi. <code>else</code> — xato bo'lmasa, <code>finally</code> — har doim bajariladi. Faqat bilgan va hal qila oladigan xatolaringizni ushlang; skript xato bilan tugasa non-zero exit code qaytarsin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ushlanmagan xato uzun traceback bilan chiqadi — operator nima qilishni tushunmaydi. Aksincha, <code>except: pass</code> hamma xatoni yutadi — skript &quot;muvaffaqiyatli&quot; tugaydi, lekin hech narsa qilmagan.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>try:           -&gt; kod<br>except X:      -&gt; X (yoki uning bolasi) chiqsa<br>except Y as e: -&gt; Y chiqsa, e - xato obyekt<br>else:          -&gt; hech qanday xato bo'lmasa<br>finally:       -&gt; har doim (tozalash)<br>Ushlanmagan xato -&gt; yuqoriga -&gt; dastur traceback bilan, exit code 1</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import sys, logging, yaml<br>log = logging.getLogger(__name__)<br><br>def load_config(path: str) -&gt; dict:<br>    try:<br>        with open(path) as f:<br>            return yaml.safe_load(f) or {}<br>    except FileNotFoundError:<br>        log.error(&quot;%s topilmadi&quot;, path)<br>        sys.exit(1)<br>    except yaml.YAMLError as e:<br>        log.error(&quot;%s noto'g'ri YAML: %s&quot;, path, e)<br>        sys.exit(2)<br><br>def main():<br>    cfg = load_config(&quot;config.yaml&quot;)<br>    try:<br>        deploy(cfg)<br>    except TimeoutError:<br>        log.warning(&quot;timeout, rollback qilinmoqda&quot;)<br>        rollback(cfg)<br>        raise                       # xatoni yashirmaslik — qayta chiqarish<br>    finally:<br>        release_lock()              # har qanday holatda<br><br>if __name__ == &quot;__main__&quot;:<br>    main()</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>except:</code> yoki <code>except Exception: pass</code> — xatolarni, hatto <code>KeyboardInterrupt</code> ni ham (bo'sh <code>except:</code>) yutadi.</li><li>Xatoni ushlab faqat <code>print</code> qilish va davom etish — skript 0 bilan tugaydi, CI &quot;yashil&quot;.</li><li><code>try</code> ichiga juda ko'p kod — qaysi qator xato berganini bilib bo'lmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qoida: past darajada ushlamang — yuqoriga uzating; eng yuqori (main) qatlamda log qilib to'g'ri exit code bilan chiqing. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34371	<p>Python skriptga CLI argument berish (<code>argparse</code>)?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>argparse</code> — Python'ning standart CLI kutubxonasi. <code>ArgumentParser</code> yaratib, <code>add_argument()</code> bilan argumentlarni (majburiy positional yoki <code>--flag</code>) e'lon qilasiz, <code>parse_args()</code> ularni o'qib tekshiradi. <code>--help</code> avtomatik yaratiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>sys.argv[1]</code> bilan ishlash: argument berilmasa <code>IndexError</code>, noto'g'ri qiymat tekshirilmaydi, yordam matni yo'q. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34373	<p>Python'da papkadagi fayllarni aylanib chiqish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>pathlib.Path(&quot;papka&quot;).rglob(&quot;*.log&quot;)</code> — papka va barcha ichki papkalardagi mos fayllarni aylanib chiqadi (<code>glob</code> — faqat shu papka). Har fayl <code>Path</code> obyekt: <code>.stat().st_size</code>, <code>.name</code>, <code>.suffix</code> kabi xususiyatlari bor. Muqobil — <code>os.walk()</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Disk to'ldi — qaysi katta fayllar joy egallayotganini topish yoki eski fayllarni tozalash kerak. Bash <code>find</code> ham bor, lekin murakkab mantiq (hisobot, filtr, API'ga yuborish) uchun Python qulayroq.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Path(&quot;/var/log&quot;).rglob(&quot;*.log&quot;)<br>  /var/log/syslog.log<br>  /var/log/nginx/access.log<br>  /var/log/app/2026/app.log   &lt;- ichki papkalar ham<br>p.stat() -&gt; st_size (bayt), st_mtime (o'zgartirilgan vaqt)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import time<br>from pathlib import Path<br><br>LIMIT = 100 * 1024 * 1024          # 100 MB<br>now = time.time()<br><br>big = []<br>for p in Path(&quot;/var/log&quot;).rglob(&quot;*.log&quot;):<br>    try:<br>        st = p.stat()<br>    except (PermissionError, FileNotFoundError):<br>        continue                    # ruxsat yo'q yoki o'chib ketgan<br>    if st.st_size &gt; LIMIT:<br>        big.append((st.st_size, p))<br><br>for size, p in sorted(big, reverse=True)[:10]:<br>    print(f&quot;{size / 1024**2:8.1f} MB  {p}&quot;)<br><br># 30 kundan eski .gz fayllarni o'chirish (avval dry-run)<br>DRY = True<br>for p in Path(&quot;/var/backups&quot;).glob(&quot;*.gz&quot;):<br>    if now - p.stat().st_mtime &gt; 30 * 86400:<br>        print(&quot;o'chiriladi:&quot;, p)<br>        if not DRY:<br>            p.unlink()</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Ruxsatsiz papka yoki o'chib ketgan fayl <code>PermissionError</code>/<code>FileNotFoundError</code> beradi — <code>try/except</code> bilan o'tkazib yuboring.</li><li><code>rglob</code> katta daraxtlarda (millionlab fayl) sekin; <code>os.scandir</code> tezroq.</li><li>O'chirish kodini dry-run'siz yozish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Tez bir martalik qidiruv uchun <code>find /var/log -name '*.log' -size +100M</code> yetarli. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34376	<p>Idempotent skript nima degani?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Idempotent skript — necha marta ishga tushirilsa ham natija bir xil bo'ladi: birinchi marta kerakli o'zgarishni qiladi, keyingi safar &quot;allaqachon tayyor&quot; deb hech narsani buzmaydi va xato bermaydi. Buning uchun har amaldan oldin holat tekshiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Skript yarmida xato bilan to'xtadi. Qayta ishga tushirsangiz <code>mkdir</code> &quot;File exists&quot;, <code>useradd</code> &quot;user already exists&quot; bilan yiqiladi, <code>echo &gt;&gt; fayl</code> esa qatorni ikkinchi marta qo'shadi. Avtomatlashtirish (cron, CI, cloud-init) qayta ishlashni talab qiladi — idempotentlik shart.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>idempotent emas:   echo &quot;x&quot; &gt;&gt; conf   -&gt; 1-marta: x   2-marta: x x<br>idempotent:        grep -q x conf || echo x &gt;&gt; conf  -&gt; doim: x<br>Naqsh: &quot;holat kerakli holatdami?&quot; -&gt; ha: o'tkazib yubor / yo'q: o'zgartir</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>mkdir -p /data/app                                   # bor bo'lsa xato bermaydi<br>id app &amp;&gt;/dev/null || useradd --system --home /data/app app<br>chown app:app /data/app                              # har safar bir xil natija<br><br># Konfig qatorini faqat yo'q bo'lsa qo'shish<br>grep -q '^vm.swappiness' /etc/sysctl.conf \<br>  || echo 'vm.swappiness=10' &gt;&gt; /etc/sysctl.conf<br><br># Yoki to'liq faylni yozish (har safar bir xil kontent)<br>cat &gt; /etc/sysctl.d/99-app.conf &lt;&lt;'EOF'<br>vm.swappiness=10<br>EOF<br><br>ln -sfn /opt/app/releases/v2 /opt/app/current       # symlink'ni almashtirish<br>systemctl enable --now nginx                        # yoqilgan bo'lsa ham OK</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>&gt;&gt;</code> bilan qo'shish — har ishga tushishda dublikat qatorlar.</li><li><code>mkdir</code> (<code>-p</code> siz), <code>ln -s</code> (<code>-f</code> siz), <code>useradd</code> (tekshiruvsiz) — ikkinchi marta xato.</li><li>&quot;Qo'shish&quot; o'rniga &quot;kerakli holatni to'liq yozish&quot; (butun faylni generatsiya qilish) ko'pincha soddaroq va ishonchliroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ansible, Terraform, Kubernetes — hammasi idempotentlik (desired state) g'oyasiga qurilgan. Bash skriptlar ko'payib, tekshiruvlar murakkablashsa, bu konfiguratsiya boshqaruv tool'iga o'tish vaqti.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34377	<p>Skriptda secret (parol, token) qanday ishlatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Secret'ni skriptga environment o'zgaruvchi yoki fayl orqali bering (CI secret store, Vault, K8s Secret), kodga yoki git'ga yozmang. Skript boshida mavjudligini tekshiring (<code>${VAR:?}</code>), <code>set -x</code> va log'larda ko'rinmasligiga, buyruq argumenti sifatida uzatilmasligiga e'tibor bering.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Token skriptga yozilib git'ga push qilindi — botlar GitHub'ni daqiqalarda skanerlab topadi. Yoki CI log'ida <code>set -x</code> tufayli parol ochiq ko'rindi. Yoki <code>curl -u admin:parol</code> — server'dagi har foydalanuvchi <code>ps aux</code> da ko'radi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Secret manbai (CI secrets / Vault / K8s Secret)<br>   -&gt; env o'zgaruvchi yoki fayl (/run/secrets/token, 0400)<br>   -&gt; skript o'qiydi -&gt; stdin yoki header orqali tool'ga<br>Ko'rinadigan joylar: argv (ps), set -x trace, log, shell history, core dump</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br><br>: &quot;${API_TOKEN:?API_TOKEN berilmagan}&quot;            # yo'q bo'lsa to'xtaydi<br><br># Header orqali (argv'da token yo'q — config stdin'dan)<br>curl -fsS -K - https://api.example.com/deploy &lt;&lt;EOF<br>header = &quot;Authorization: Bearer ${API_TOKEN}&quot;<br>EOF<br><br># Fayldan o'qish<br>DB_PASS=$(&lt; /run/secrets/db_password)<br><br># Parolni stdin orqali berish<br>printf '%s' &quot;$REGISTRY_PASS&quot; | docker login -u ci --password-stdin registry.example.com<br><br># set -x yoqilgan bo'lsa secret bloki atrofida o'chirish<br>{ set +x; } 2&gt;/dev/null<br>export PGPASSWORD=&quot;$DB_PASS&quot;<br>set -x</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>set -x</code> secret qiymatlarini log'ga chiqaradi.</li><li>Argument sifatida berilgan secret (<code>--password=...</code>) <code>ps</code> va <code>/proc/PID/cmdline</code> da ko'rinadi.</li><li><code>.env</code> faylni git'ga qo'shish — <code>.gitignore</code> va <code>gitleaks</code>/pre-commit tekshiruvi.</li><li><code>echo &quot;$TOKEN&quot;</code> bilan debug qilish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng yaxshi secret — umuman yo'q secret: CI'da OIDC federation (AWS/GCP role'ni token'siz olish), cloud'da IAM role. Qolgan secret'lar qisqa muddatli va rotatsiya qilinadigan bo'lsin; git tarixiga tushgan secret'ni darhol bekor qiling (o'chirish yetarli emas).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34378	<p><code>${VAR:-default}</code> va <code>${VAR:?xabar}</code> farqi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>${VAR:-default}</code> — o'zgaruvchi bo'sh yoki o'rnatilmagan bo'lsa <b>default qiymatni qaytaradi</b> (o'zgaruvchining o'zi o'zgarmaydi). <code>${VAR:?xabar}</code> — bo'sh/o'rnatilmagan bo'lsa <b>xabarni stderr'ga chiqarib, skriptni to'xtatadi</b>.</p><p><b>Nega kerak:</b> Skript konfiguratsiyani environment'dan oladi. Ba'zi qiymatlarning oqilona default'i bor (port 8080), ba'zilari esa majburiy (DB host) — ular yo'q bo'lsa skript &quot;jim&quot; noto'g'ri ishlashdan ko'ra darhol yiqilgani yaxshi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>${VAR:-x}   bo'sh/yo'q -&gt; &quot;x&quot; qaytaradi        VAR o'zgarmaydi<br>${VAR:=x}   bo'sh/yo'q -&gt; VAR=x qilib qaytaradi VAR o'rnatiladi<br>${VAR:?msg} bo'sh/yo'q -&gt; msg stderr'ga, exit 1 (interaktiv bo'lmagan shell)<br>${VAR:+x}   bo'sh EMAS -&gt; &quot;x&quot;, aks holda &quot;&quot;     (flag qo'shish uchun)</pre><p>Ikki nuqta (<code>:</code>) muhim: <code>${VAR-x}</code> faqat <b>o'rnatilmagan</b>ni tekshiradi, <code>VAR=&quot;&quot;</code> ni esa qiymat deb qabul qiladi. <code>${VAR:-x}</code> bo'sh string'ni ham &quot;yo'q&quot; deb biladi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br>port=${PORT:-8080}                     # default<br>: &quot;${DB_HOST:?DB_HOST kerak}&quot;          # majburiy; ':' — hech narsa qilmaydigan buyruq<br>: &quot;${LOG_LEVEL:=info}&quot;                 # default'ni o'zgaruvchiga yozib qo'yadi<br>extra=${DEBUG:+--verbose}              # DEBUG bor bo'lsa flag qo'shiladi<br>echo &quot;port=$port db=$DB_HOST level=$LOG_LEVEL $extra&quot;</pre><pre>$ ./run.sh<br>./run.sh: line 4: DB_HOST: DB_HOST kerak     # exit code 1</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>set -u</code> bilan <code>$VAR</code> ni to'g'ridan ishlatish &quot;unbound variable&quot; beradi — <code>${VAR:-}</code> bilan himoyalang.</li><li><code>:</code> siz <code>${DB_HOST:?...}</code> yozilsa, natija buyruq sifatida bajarilishga urinadi.</li><li><code>:=</code> positional parametr (<code>$1</code>) ga ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Majburiy konfiguratsiyani skript boshida bitta blokda <code>:?</code> bilan validatsiya qiling — &quot;fail fast&quot;. Xato xabarida nima va qayerdan berilishini yozing (<code>DB_HOST kerak (.env yoki CI secret)</code>).</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34379	<p>Skriptni cron yoki systemd timer'da ishga tushirishda nimalar muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cron/timer'da skript <b>interaktiv bo'lmagan, minimal muhitda</b> ishlaydi: <code>PATH</code> qisqa, <code>HOME</code>/locale boshqacha, terminal yo'q. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34380	<p>Bash'da <code>[[ ]]</code> da string va son solishtirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>[[ ]]</code> ichida <b>string</b> uchun <code>==</code>, <code>!=</code>, <code>&lt;</code>, <code>&gt;</code>, <code>-z</code> (bo'sh), <code>-n</code> (bo'sh emas) ishlatiladi; <b>son</b> uchun <code>-eq -ne -lt -le -gt -ge</code> yoki arifmetik <code>(( ))</code>. <code>==</code> o'ng tomoni glob shablon, <code>=~</code> esa regex.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>[[ 10 &gt; 9 ]]</code> — <b>false</b>! Chunki <code>&gt;</code> string (leksikografik) solishtirish: &quot;1&quot; &lt; &quot;9&quot;. Son uchun <code>-gt</code> yoki <code>(( 10 &gt; 9 ))</code> kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b> | Maqsad | String | Son | |---|---|---| | teng | <code>[[ $a == &quot;$b&quot; ]]</code> | <code>[[ $a -eq $b ]]</code>, <code>(( a == b ))</code> | | katta | <code>[[ $a &gt; &quot;$b&quot; ]]</code> (lug'at tartibi) | <code>[[ $a -gt $b ]]</code>, <code>(( a &gt; b ))</code> | | bo'sh | <code>[[ -z $a ]]</code> | - | | shablon | <code>[[ $f == *.log ]]</code> | - | | regex | <code>[[ $v =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]</code> | - |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>env=prod; n=15; file=app.log; v=42<br>[[ &quot;$env&quot; == &quot;prod&quot; ]] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;prod&quot;<br>[[ -z &quot;${var:-}&quot; ]] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;bo'sh&quot;<br>(( n &gt; 10 )) &amp;&amp; echo &quot;10 dan katta&quot;<br>[[ &quot;$file&quot; == *.log ]] &amp;&amp; echo &quot;log fayl&quot;      # o'ngda qo'shtirnoqsiz = glob<br>[[ &quot;$file&quot; == &quot;*.log&quot; ]] || echo &quot;literal emas&quot; # qo'shtirnoq = literal<br>if [[ &quot;$v&quot; =~ ^([0-9]+)$ ]]; then echo &quot;son: ${BASH_REMATCH[1]}&quot;; fi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Regex'ni qo'shtirnoqqa olsangiz (<code>=~ &quot;^[0-9]+$&quot;</code>) literal string bo'lib qoladi — regex'ni o'zgaruvchiga qo'yib <code>=~ $re</code> yozing.</li><li><code>[ ]</code> (eski <code>test</code>) da o'zgaruvchini qo'shtirnoqsiz qoldirish word splitting xatosini beradi; <code>[[ ]]</code> bunga chidamli, lekin bash-only (POSIX <code>sh</code> da yo'q).</li><li><code>-eq</code> ga son bo'lmagan qiymat berilsa xato yoki 0 deb hisoblanadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bash skriptlarda doim <code>[[ ]]</code> va sonlar uchun <code>(( ))</code> ishlating; <code>#!/bin/sh</code> bo'lsa <code>[ ]</code> va qo'shtirnoqlarga qayting. <code>shellcheck</code> bu xatolarning ko'pini CI'da ushlaydi.</p>	lvl::Junior dom::auto sec::h1 Bash_Python_scripting
Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34381	<p><code>curl</code> bilan API natijasini <code>jq</code> orqali parse qilish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>curl -fsS URL | jq -r '&lt;filter&gt;'</code> — <code>curl</code> JSON'ni oladi, <code>jq</code> undan kerakli maydonni ajratadi. <code>-r</code> — natijani qo'shtirnoqsiz &quot;raw&quot;  {&quot;name&quot;:&quot;app&quot;,&quot;stargazers_count&quot;:120,&quot;owner&quot;:{&quot;login&quot;:&quot;org&quot;}}<br>                    |<br>                    v<br>jq -r '.owner.login'  --&gt;  org</pre><p><code>curl</code> flaglari: <code>-f</code> HTTP 4xx/5xx da xato exit code, <code>-s</code> progress'siz, <code>-S</code> xatoni baribir ko'rsat.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -fsS https://api.github.com/repos/org/app | jq -r '.stargazers_count'<br># massiv bo'ylab<br>kubectl get pods -o json | jq -r '.items[].metadata.name'<br># filtrlash va bir nechta maydon<br>kubectl get pods -A -o json \<br>  | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.phase!=&quot;Running&quot;) | &quot;\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \(.status.phase)&quot;'<br># token bilan va xatoni tekshirib<br>resp=$(curl -fsS -H &quot;Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN&quot; Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34382	<p>Fon jarayonlar va <code>wait</code> bilan parallel ishga tushirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Buyruq oxiriga <code>&amp;</code> qo'yilsa u <b>fon jarayon</b> bo'lib ishga tushadi va skript keyingi qatorga o'tadi. <code>wait</code> — barcha (yoki ko'rsatilgan PID) fon jarayonlar tugashini kutadi. Shu bilan bir nechta serverga parallel ish yuboriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 50 ta serverga ketma-ket <code>ssh</code> 50 x 20s = 16 daqiqa. Parallel bo'lsa ~20s. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34383	<p><code>find</code> bilan eski fayllarni avtomatik o'chirish?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>find &lt;papka&gt; -name '&lt;shablon&gt;' -mtime +N -delete</code> — N kundan eski fayllarni topib o'chiradi. Avval <code>-delete</code> siz (<code>-print</code>) ishga tushirib ro'yxatni tekshiring.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Backup va log papkalari cheksiz o'sib diskni to'ldiradi. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34384	<p>Skriptga <code>--help</code> va usage qo'shish nega muhim?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>--help</code>/usage skript <b>nima qiladi, qanday argument kutadi va misol</b>ni ko'rsatadi. Bu skriptni o'zini o'qimasdan to'g'ri ishlatish va noto'g'ri argumentda xavfli harakatdan oldin to'xtash uchun kerak.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>./deploy.sh</code> argumentsiz ishga tushirildi va <code>$1</code> bo'sh bo'lgani uchun default &quot;prod&quot; ga deploy qildi. Usage tekshiruvi bo'lganida skript &quot;env kerak&quot; deb to'xtardi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>./deploy.sh [args]<br>     |<br>     v<br>argument parse --&gt; -h/--help? --&gt; usage, exit 0<br>     |<br>     v<br>validatsiya --&gt; noto'g'ri? --&gt; usage stderr'ga, exit 2<br>     |<br>     v<br>ish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash<br>set -euo pipefail<br>usage() {<br>  cat &lt;&lt;EOF<br>Usage: $(basename &quot;$0&quot;) &lt;env&gt; [--dry-run]<br>  env        staging | prod<br>  --dry-run  nima qilinishini ko'rsatadi, o'zgartirmaydi<br>Misol: $(basename &quot;$0&quot;) staging --dry-run<br>EOF<br>}<br>dry=0; env=&quot;&quot;<br>while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do<br>  case &quot;$1&quot; in<br>    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;<br>    --dry-run) dry=1 ;;<br>    -*) echo &quot;Noma'lum flag: $1&quot; &gt;&amp;2; usage &gt;&amp;2; exit 2 ;;<br>    *) env=$1 ;;<br>  esac; shift<br>done<br>[[ $env == staging || $env == prod ]] || { usage &gt;&amp;2; exit 2; }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>--help</code> uchun exit 1 qaytarish — bu xato emas, 0 bo'lishi kerak; noto'g'ri argument uchun esa 2 (konvensiya).</li><li>Usage'ni stdout'ga yozish xato holatida pipeline'ni chalkashtiradi — xato bo'lsa stderr.</li><li>Usage matni kod bilan sinxron bo'lmay qoladi — flag qo'shsangiz usage'ni ham yangilang.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Jamoa skriptlari &quot;hujjat&quot; vazifasini bajaradi. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H1 Bash & Python scripting	idrill-34385	<p>Dry-run rejimi nima va skriptda qanday qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dry-run — skript <b>nima qilishini ko'rsatadi, lekin hech narsani o'zgartirmaydi</b>. Bashda odatda barcha o'zgartiruvchi buyruqlar <code>run</code> wrapper orqali chaqiriladi; dry-run'da wrapper buyruqni faqat chiqaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Tozalash skripti glob xatosi bilan production ma'lumotni o'chirdi. To'g'ri retry: maksimal urinishlar soni, exponential backoff, jitter va oxirida aniq xato.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy'dan keyin health check darhol chaqirilsa servis hali tayyor emas va pipeline yiqiladi. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H2 Python, Go & automation tooling	idrill-40067	<p>Go'da goroutine va OS thread farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Goroutine — Go runtime boshqaradigan yengil &quot;green thread&quot;: ~2 KB stack bilan boshlanadi (kerak bo'lsa o'sadi), yaratish va almashtirish arzon. OS thread — kernel boshqaradi, 1-8 MB stack zaxiralaydi, context switch kernel orqali. Go scheduler M:N modelida minglab goroutine'ni bir necha OS thread'ga taqsimlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 10 000 ta host'ga health check yuborish kerak. 10 000 OS thread — gigabaytlab xotira va scheduler bosimi. 10 000 goroutine — ~20-40 MB va oddiy.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (G-M-P):</b></p><pre>G (goroutine)   G G G G G G G ...<br>                   v  local run queue<br>P (processor)   P0        P1     (soni = GOMAXPROCS)<br>                 |         |<br>M (OS thread)   M0        M1     (kernel thread)<br>                 v         v<br>               CPU0      CPU1</pre><ul><li>Goroutine bloklovchi syscall'ga kirsa, P boshqa M'ga o'tkaziladi — qolganlar ishlayveradi.</li><li>Network I/O netpoller (epoll/kqueue) orqali — thread bloklanmaydi.</li><li>Go 1.14+ dan asinxron preemption: uzun loop ham boshqalarni to'xtatmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>var wg sync.WaitGroup<br>for i := 0; i &lt; 10000; i++ {<br>    wg.Add(1)<br>    go func(id int) { defer wg.Done(); check(id) }(i)<br>}<br>wg.Wait()<br>fmt.Println(runtime.NumGoroutine(), runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0))</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Goroutine leak: channel'da abadiy kutib qolgan goroutine hech qachon yig'ilmaydi — <code>pprof goroutine</code> bilan toping.</li><li>&quot;Arzon&quot; — cheksiz degani emas: 10 000 goroutine bitta API'ga hujum qilsa rate limit/fd tugaydi; bounded concurrency kerak.</li><li>Container'da Go 1.25 gacha <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> CPU limitni ko'rmasdi (<code>automaxprocs</code> kerak edi); 1.25+ cgroup limitni hisobga oladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Goroutine — concurrency birligi, parallelism esa <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> bilan cheklangan. Production'da goroutine sonini metrika qilib kuzating; o'sib borayotgan son — deyarli har doim leak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::auto sec::h2 Python_Go_automation_tooling

Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H2 Python, Go & automation tooling	idrill-40108	<p>Python <code>marshmallow</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> marshmallow — framework'dan mustaqil serialization kutubxonasi: <code>Schema</code> klassida maydonlarni e'lon qilasiz, <code>load()</code> kiruvchi dict'ni validatsiya qilib Python obyektiga, <code>dump()</code> obyektni JSON'ga mos dict'ga aylantiradi. Type hint'larga emas, aniq schema klasslariga tayanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ichki DevOps API inventory obyektlarini JSON qilib qaytaradi va kiruvchi so'rovlarni tekshiradi. Qo'lda <code>dict</code> yig'ish va <code>if &quot;x&quot; not in data</code> tekshiruvlar — takroriy va xatoga moyil.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>from marshmallow import Schema, fields, validate, ValidationError, post_load<br>from dataclasses import dataclass<br><br>@dataclass<br>class Server:<br>    hostname: str<br>    ip: str<br>    env: str<br><br>class ServerSchema(Schema):<br>    hostname = fields.Str(required=True)<br>    ip = fields.IP(required=True)<br>    env = fields.Str(validate=validate.OneOf([&quot;dev&quot;, &quot;staging&quot;, &quot;prod&quot;]))<br><br>    @post_load<br>    def make(self, data, **kw):<br>        return Server(**{**data, &quot;ip&quot;: str(data[&quot;ip&quot;])})<br><br>schema = ServerSchema()<br>try:<br>    srv = schema.load({&quot;hostname&quot;: &quot;web1&quot;, &quot;ip&quot;: &quot;10.0.0.5&quot;, &quot;env&quot;: &quot;prod&quot;})<br>    print(schema.dump(srv))<br>    schema.load({&quot;hostname&quot;: &quot;x&quot;, &quot;ip&quot;: &quot;999.1.1.1&quot;, &quot;env&quot;: &quot;qa&quot;})<br>except ValidationError as e:<br>    print(e.messages)   # {'ip': ['Not a valid IP address.'], 'env': ['Must be one of: ...']}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>marshmallow 3 da noma'lum maydonlar default <code>RAISE</code>; <code>unknown=EXCLUDE</code> kerak bo'lishi mumkin.</li><li><code>dump()</code> validatsiya qilmaydi — faqat <code>load()</code>.</li><li>Schema va model ikki joyda takrorlanadi — sinxronlikni yo'qotish oson.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Yangi loyihada pydantic ko'pincha qulayroq (type hint = schema). marshmallow Flask/SQLAlchemy ekotizimidagi mavjud kodda va serialize formati modeldan keskin farq qilganda o'rinli.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::auto sec::h2 Python_Go_automation_tooling

Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H2 Python, Go & automation tooling	idrill-40114	<p>Bash'da <code>tr</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>tr</code> (translate) stdin'dagi belgilarni almashtiradi (<code>tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'</code>), o'chiradi (<code>-d</code>) yoki ketma-ket takrorlarni siqadi (<code>-s</code>). U faqat <b>belgi</b> darajasida ishlaydi, so'z yoki regex bilan emas; fayl argument olmaydi — faqat stdin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Windows'da tahrirlangan skript Linux'da <code>$'\r': command not found</code> beradi; yoki <code>ps</code> chiqishidagi ko'p bo'shliqlarni bittaga keltirib <code>cut</code> qilish kerak; yoki env nomini katta harfga o'tkazish.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' &lt;&lt;&lt; &quot;staging&quot;      # STAGING<br>tr -d '\r' &lt; script.sh &gt; script.unix.sh        # CRLF -&gt; LF<br>tr -s ' ' &lt;&lt;&lt; &quot;a    b     c&quot;                   # a b c<br>tr ',' '\n' &lt;&lt;&lt; &quot;web1,web2,web3&quot;               # har biri yangi qatorda<br>tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' &lt; /dev/urandom | head -c 16; echo   # tasodifiy string<br>tr -cd '[:print:]\n' &lt; dirty.log &gt; clean.log   # bosilmaydigan belgilarni olib tashlash</pre><p>Belgi sinflari: <code>[:alpha:]</code>, <code>[:digit:]</code>, <code>[:space:]</code>, <code>[:upper:]</code>, <code>[:lower:]</code>, <code>[:print:]</code>. <code>-c</code> — to'ldiruvchi (complement).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>tr 'abc' 'xyz'</code> — string almashtirish emas, a-&gt;x, b-&gt;y, c-&gt;z. Xato topsa — uni eng kichik qaytariladigan misolga qisqartiradi (shrinking).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Siz <code>parse_duration(&quot;5m&quot;) == 300</code> ni test qildingiz. Lekin <code>&quot;0s&quot;</code>, <code>&quot;999999h&quot;</code>, <code>&quot; 5m&quot;</code>, <code>&quot;5M&quot;</code>, <code>&quot;&quot;</code> ni o'ylamadingiz. Edge case'larni odam o'ylab topmaydi — generator topadi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>from hypothesis import given, strategies as st, example<br><br>def to_seconds(s: str) -&gt; int:<br>    n, unit = int(s[:-1]), s[-1]<br>    return n * {&quot;s&quot;: 1, &quot;m&quot;: 60, &quot;h&quot;: 3600}[unit]<br><br>def to_str(sec: int) -&gt; str:<br>    for u, k in ((&quot;h&quot;, 3600), (&quot;m&quot;, 60)):<br>        if sec % k == 0 and sec:<br>            return f&quot;{sec // k}{u}&quot;<br>    return f&quot;{sec}s&quot;<br><br>@given(st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=10**7))<br>@example(0)<br>def test_roundtrip(sec):<br>    assert to_seconds(to_str(sec)) == sec          # xossa: round-trip<br><br>@given(st.lists(st.integers()))<br>def test_sort_idempotent(xs):<br>    assert sorted(sorted(xs)) == sorted(xs)</pre><p>Xato topilsa chiqish: <code>Falsifying example: test_roundtrip(sec=...)</code> — eng kichik misol bilan.</p><p><b>Foydali xossalar:</b> round-trip (serialize/parse), idempotentlik (<code>apply</code> ikki marta = bir marta), invariant (natija soni kiritilgandan ko'p emas), oracle bilan solishtirish (sodda, sekin implementatsiya).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Xossa implementatsiyani takrorlasa (<code>assert f(x) == f(x)</code> ga o'xshash) — hech narsa tekshirmaydi.</li><li>Juda keng strategiya + qimmat test = sekin CI; <code>settings(max_examples=...)</code>.</li><li>Tashqi side effect'li (tarmoq, disk) funksiyalar uchun mos emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Config parser, retry/backoff hisob-kitobi, idempotent reconcile mantiqi — property-based test eng ko'p bug topadigan joylar. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H2 Python, Go & automation tooling	idrill-40167	<p>Python <code>asyncio.Semaphore</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>asyncio.Semaphore(n)</code> — bir vaqtda <b>ko'pi bilan n ta coroutine</b> ma'lum qismga kirishiga ruxsat beruvchi hisoblagich. Bounded concurrency uchun: masalan 10 000 URL'dan bir vaqtda faqat 20 tasini so'rash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>asyncio.gather(*[fetch(u) for u in urls])</code> 10 000 ta so'rovni bir zumda ochadi: fayl deskriptorlar tugaydi, server 429 qaytaradi yoki sizni bloklaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Semaphore(3):  [slot][slot][slot]<br>coroutine 1..3 -&gt; kiradi (counter 3-&gt;0)<br>coroutine 4    -&gt; await, kutadi<br>coroutine 1 chiqdi -&gt; counter 1 -&gt; coroutine 4 kiradi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import asyncio, httpx<br><br>async def fetch(client, sem, url):<br>    async with sem:                      # slot olinadi va avtomatik qaytariladi<br>        r = await client.get(url, timeout=10)<br>        return url, r.status_code<br><br>async def main(urls):<br>    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(20)<br>    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:<br>        results = await asyncio.gather(*(fetch(client, sem, u) for u in urls),<br>                                       return_exceptions=True)<br>    for r in results:<br>        print(r)<br><br>asyncio.run(main([f&quot;https://example.com/{i}&quot; for i in range(200)]))</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Semaphore'ni har chaqiruvda yangidan yaratish — cheklov ishlamaydi; bitta umumiy obyekt bo'lsin.</li><li><code>acquire()</code> qilib <code>release()</code> unutilsa slot'lar &quot;oqib ketadi&quot; — doim <code>async with</code>.</li><li>Semaphore baribir 10 000 coroutine obyektini xotirada yaratadi; juda katta ro'yxatda <code>Queue</code> + N worker yaxshiroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Semaphore concurrency'ni cheklaydi, <b>rate</b>ni (so'rov/soniya) emas. Interview Drill::Automation & scripting::H2 Python, Go & automation tooling	idrill-40168	<p>Python <code>asyncio.Queue</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>asyncio.Queue</code> — coroutine'lar orasida ma'lumot uzatish uchun FIFO navbat. Producer <code>await q.put()</code>, consumer <code>await q.get()</code> qiladi; <code>maxsize</code> berilsa navbat to'lganda producer kutadi — bu <b>backpressure</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Producer (masalan S3 ro'yxati) consumer'dan (har faylni qayta ishlash) tez. Navbatsiz yoki cheksiz navbatda xotira to'lib ketadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>producer --put--&gt; [ q (maxsize=100) ] --get--&gt; worker1<br>                                       --get--&gt; worker2<br>                                       --get--&gt; worker3<br>q to'la -&gt; put() kutadi    q bo'sh -&gt; get() kutadi<br>task_done() + join() -&gt; hammasi qayta ishlanganini bilish</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>import asyncio<br><br>async def producer(q):<br>    for i in range(1000):<br>        await q.put(i)              # to'lsa kutadi<br><br>async def worker(name, q):<br>    while True:<br>        item = await q.get()<br>        try:<br>            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)   # ish<br>        finally:<br>            q.task_done()<br><br>async def main():<br>    q = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=100)<br>    workers = [asyncio.create_task(worker(f&quot;w{i}&quot;, q)) for i in range(5)]<br>    await producer(q)<br>    await q.join()                  # barcha item task_done bo'lguncha<br>    for w in workers: w.cancel()<br>    await asyncio.gather(*workers, return_exceptions=True)<br><br>asyncio.run(main())</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>task_done()</code> chaqirilmasa <code>join()</code> abadiy osiladi — <code>try/finally</code> da chaqiring.</li><li><code>asyncio.Queue</code> thread-safe emas: boshqa thread'dan <code>loop.call_soon_threadsafe(q.put_nowait, x)</code> orqali yozing.</li><li>Worker'ni to'xtatish uchun <code>cancel()</code> yoki &quot;sentinel&quot; (<code>None</code>) qiymat kerak; Python 3.13+ da <code>q.shutdown()</code> ham bor.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Queue + N worker pattern semaphore'dan yaxshiroq: xotira cheklangan, worker soni aniq. Worker ichidagi exception'ni log qiling — aks holda worker jim o'ladi va navbat to'xtab qoladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::auto sec::h2 Python_Go_automation_tooling

Biri &quot;kimniki&quot;, ikkinchisi &quot;kim nima qila oladi&quot;.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy'dan keyin nginx <code>403 Forbidden</code>: fayllar <code>root:root 600</code>.
