Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40312	<p>FinOps va uning uch fazasi (core concepts) qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> FinOps — cloud xarajatini engineering, moliya va biznes birgalikda boshqarish amaliyoti (FinOps Foundation). Uch fazasi takrorlanuvchi sikl: <b>Inform</b> (ko'rinish va taqsimlash), <b>Optimize</b> (xarajatni kamaytirish), <b>Operate</b> (doimiy governance va jarayon).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Cloud hisobi oyiga $80k dan $200k ga chiqdi, hech kim qaysi jamoa sababchi ekanini bilmaydi. Moliya byudjet kesadi, engineering &quot;bizga kerak&quot; deydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>   +--&gt; INFORM: tag/label, cost allocation, showback/chargeback,<br>   |            forecast, unit cost<br>   |       |<br>   |       v<br>   |    OPTIMIZE: right-sizing, Savings Plans/RI, spot,<br>   |              idle resurs o'chirish, storage tier<br>   |       |<br>   |       v<br>   +--- OPERATE: budget alert, policy (Cloud Custodian),<br>                 KPI, FinOps review jarayoni</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># AWS: oxirgi oy servislar bo'yicha xarajat<br>aws ce get-cost-and-usage \<br>  --time-period Start=2026-09-01,End=2026-10-01 \<br>  --granularity MONTHLY --metrics UnblendedCost \<br>  --group-by Type=DIMENSION,Key=SERVICE<br># Tag bo'yicha: Type=TAG,Key=team</pre><p>Kubernetes uchun: OpenCost/Kubecost namespace va label bo'yicha xarajat. Standart format: FOCUS (FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tag strategiyasisiz Inform bo'lmaydi: 40% &quot;untagged&quot; xarajat — hech kimniki.</li><li>Optimize'dan boshlash (RI sotib olish) va keyin arxitektura o'zgarib, commitment bo'sh qolishi.</li><li>FinOps'ni faqat moliya jamoasiga topshirish — qaror engineering'da qabul qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Maqsad xarajatni minimallashtirish emas, har dollar qiymatini maksimallashtirish. Shuning uchun absolut summa emas, unit economics (cost per transaction) asosiy KPI bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40313	<p>Cloud unit economics (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cloud unit economics — cloud xarajatini biznes birligiga bo'lib o'lchash: &quot;1 aktiv foydalanuvchi uchun $&quot;, &quot;1000 tranzaksiya uchun $&quot;, &quot;1 GB stream uchun $&quot;. Absolut hisob o'sishi yaxshi yoki yomonligini faqat unit cost aytadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Hisob 2 baravar oshdi — panic. Lekin foydalanuvchilar 3 baravar oshgan bo'lsa, aslida samaradorlik yaxshilangan. Unit metrikasiz qaror noto'g'ri bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Cloud xarajat (team/servis bo'yicha taqsimlangan)<br>          /<br>Biznes metrika (orders, MAU, API calls)<br>          =<br>Unit cost  --&gt; trend, target, gross margin</pre><p>Misol: | Oy | Xarajat | Orders | $/1000 order | |---|---|---|---| | Iyul | $50k | 10M | $5.0 | | Sentabr | $80k | 20M | $4.0 |</p><p>Xarajat +60%, lekin unit cost -20% — yaxshi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>-- CUR (Athena) + biznes DB: kunlik unit cost<br>SELECT c.day, c.cost / NULLIF(o.orders,0) * 1000 AS usd_per_1k_orders<br>FROM daily_cost c JOIN daily_orders o USING (day)<br>WHERE c.service_tag = 'checkout'<br>ORDER BY c.day;</pre><p>Shared xarajatlar (network, observability, platforma) uchun taqsimlash kaliti kerak: proporsional CPU, request soni yoki teng bo'lish.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Noto'g'ri denominator: &quot;cost per user&quot; B2B'da ma'nosiz bo'lishi mumkin, &quot;cost per tenant&quot; kerak.</li><li>Shared xarajatni e'tiborsiz qoldirish — unit cost sun'iy past chiqadi.</li><li>Bir martalik xarajat (migratsiya) trendni buzadi — alohida belgilab qo'y.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Unit cost'ni pricing va gross margin bilan bog'la: agar foydalanuvchi oyiga $10 to'lasa va unga $4 cloud ketsa, bu arxitektura qaroriga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri input. Bu suhbatni moliya bilan umumiy tilga olib chiqadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40314	<p>Cloud Savings Plan nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Savings Plan — AWS narx modeli: 1 yoki 3 yilga <b>soatlik sarf</b> (masalan $10/soat) majburiyatini olasan, evaziga on-demand narxdan chegirma: Compute Savings Plan ~66% gacha (EC2, Fargate, Lambda, instance oilasi va region'dan mustaqil), EC2 Instance Savings Plan ~72% gacha (oila+region'ga bog'liq).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Doimiy 24/7 ishlaydigan baseline yuk on-demand narxda to'lanadi — bu ortiqcha 30-60%. Lekin RI qat'iy, arxitektura o'zgarsa bo'sh qoladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Soatlik sarf ($/soat)<br>  |<br>  |   ~~~~~ on-demand (o'zgaruvchan)<br>  |  ------------------  &lt;- Savings Plan commitment (baseline)<br>  |  ##################  SP qoplaydi (chegirmali narx)<br>  +--------------------------&gt; vaqt<br> commitment'dan yuqori qism = on-demand narx<br> commitment ishlatilmasa = baribir to'lanadi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ce get-savings-plans-purchase-recommendation \<br>  --savings-plans-type COMPUTE_SP --term-in-years ONE_YEAR \<br>  --payment-option NO_UPFRONT --lookback-period-in-days THIRTY_DAYS<br>aws ce get-savings-plans-utilization --time-period Start=2026-09-01,End=2026-10-01<br>aws ce get-savings-plans-coverage   --time-period Start=2026-09-01,End=2026-10-01</pre><p>Ikki KPI: <b>utilization</b> (~100% bo'lsin, aks holda pul yonadi) va <b>coverage</b> (baseline yukning qancha qismi qoplangan, odatda 70-85%).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Peak bo'yicha sotib olish — tunda commitment ishlatilmaydi. Minimum (p10) baseline bo'yicha ol.</li><li>Right-sizing'dan oldin sotib olish — keyin yuk kamayadi, majburiyat qoladi.</li><li>RDS, ElastiCache, OpenSearch SP bilan qoplanmaydi (ular uchun RI; 2025-da Database Savings Plans ham chiqqan — hujjatni tekshir).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bosqichma-bosqich (laddering) sotib ol: har oy kichik qism, 1 yillik — shunda muddatlar turli vaqtda tugaydi va moslashuvchanlik saqlanadi. Avval optimizatsiya, keyin commitment.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40315	<p>Reserved Instances (RI) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Reserved Instance (RI) — AWS'da aniq instance atributlariga (oila, region, OS, tenancy) 1 yoki 3 yilga bog'langan chegirma (~72% gacha). Standard RI arzonroq, lekin qat'iy; Convertible RI oila almashtirishga ruxsat beradi, chegirma kamroq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Prod DB 24/7 <code>db.r6g.xlarge</code> da ishlaydi va yillar davomida o'zgarmaydi — on-demand to'lash pul isrof.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>RI = billing chegirmasi (alohida server EMAS)<br>  Ishlab turgan instance atributlari RI'ga mos keldimi?<br>     ha  -&gt; soat chegirmali narxda<br>     yo'q -&gt; on-demand<br>  Size flexibility (Linux, regional RI): r6g.2xlarge RI<br>     = 2 x r6g.xlarge ni qoplaydi (normalization factor)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws ce get-reservation-purchase-recommendation --service &quot;Amazon RDS&quot;<br>aws ec2 describe-reserved-instances --filters Name=state,Values=active<br>aws ce get-reservation-utilization --time-period Start=2026-09-01,End=2026-10-01</pre><p>Hozir EC2 uchun ko'pincha Savings Plan afzal; RI hali ham <b>RDS, ElastiCache, Redshift, OpenSearch</b> uchun asosiy vosita.</p><p>| | Standard RI | Convertible RI | Compute SP | |---|---|---|---| | Chegirma | eng yuqori | o'rtacha | o'rtacha | | Oila almashtirish | yo'q | ha (exchange) | avtomatik | | Marketplace'da sotish | ha | yo'q | yo'q |</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>RI'ni bir region'da olib, instance'ni boshqasiga ko'chirish — chegirma yo'qoladi.</li><li>Graviton'ga migratsiya rejasi bor paytda x86 Standard RI sotib olish.</li><li>RI tugash sanasini kuzatmaslik — jim on-demand narxga qaytish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Barqaror, o'zgarmaydigan stateful yuk (DB) — RI; o'zgaruvchan compute — Savings Plan. Organization darajasida sotib ol (sharing yoqilgan) — utilization yuqori bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps

Uzilishga chidamli, stateless yuk uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> CI runner'lar, batch ETL, ML training, K8s stateless worker'lar on-demand'da qimmat. Xarajat va compliance governance uchun.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 500 ta akkaunt, dasturchilar test uchun instance ochib unutadi; kimdir S3'ni public qiladi. Qo'lda audit qilib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>policy.yml: resource + filters + actions<br>     |<br>  custodian run  (cron yoki event mode)<br>     |<br>  pull mode: API'dan resurslarni o'qi -&gt; filter -&gt; action<br>  event mode: CloudTrail -&gt; EventBridge -&gt; Lambda (real vaqt)<br>     |<br>  natija: actions, notify (Slack/email), S3 log</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>policies:<br>  - name: ec2-untagged-stop<br>    resource: aws.ec2<br>    filters:<br>      - &quot;tag:owner&quot;: absent<br>      - State.Name: running<br>    actions:<br>      - type: mark-for-op<br>        op: stop<br>        days: 3          # avval ogohlantirish, 3 kundan keyin stop<br>      - type: notify<br>        to: [platform@acme.io]<br>        transport: { type: sqs, queue: custodian-mailer }<br>  - name: ebs-unattached-delete<br>    resource: aws.ebs<br>    filters: [{ Attachments: [] }, { type: value, key: CreateTime, value_type: age, op: gt, value: 30 }]<br>    actions: [delete]</pre><pre>custodian validate policy.yml<br>custodian run --dryrun -s out policy.yml   # avval dry-run!<br>custodian run -s out policy.yml</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Dry-run'siz <code>delete</code> — prod resursni o'chirish xavfi. Avval <code>notify</code>, keyin <code>mark-for-op</code>, oxirida delete.</li><li>Lambda event mode'da IAM huquqlari keng bo'lib ketadi — least privilege.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Policy'larni kod sifatida saqla, PR orqali o'zgartir va bosqichma-bosqich kuchaytir (report -&gt; notify -&gt; enforce). Destructive action'lar uchun istisno tag'i (<code>custodian:skip</code>) bo'lsin, lekin u ham audit qilinsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40319	<p>Kubernetes right-sizing (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kubernetes right-sizing — container'larning CPU/xotira <code>requests</code> va <code>limits</code> ini real foydalanish (p95/p99 telemetriya) asosida moslash. Scheduler requests bo'yicha joy band qiladi, shuning uchun ortiqcha request = to'langan, lekin ishlatilmagan node sig'imi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dasturchi &quot;xavfsiz bo'lsin&quot; deb <code>cpu: 2, memory: 4Gi</code> yozadi, real ishlatish 200m va 600Mi. Klaster 70% &quot;band&quot;, lekin haqiqiy CPU 15% — node'lar ikki baravar ko'p.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Node 8 CPU:<br> requests: [##########----]  scheduler uchun &quot;to'la&quot;<br> real use: [##------------]  aslida bo'sh<br>   -&gt; right-size: request = p95 + bufer<br>   -&gt; bir node'ga ko'proq pod -&gt; kamroq node -&gt; arzon</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl top pod -n orders --containers</pre><pre># p95 CPU (7 kun) har container uchun<br>quantile_over_time(0.95, rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=&quot;orders&quot;,container!=&quot;&quot;}[5m])[7d:5m])<br># Xotira max<br>max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=&quot;orders&quot;,container!=&quot;&quot;}[7d])</pre><p>Tavsiya: VPA <code>updateMode: &quot;Off&quot;</code> (faqat recommendation), Goldilocks, Kubecost/OpenCost.</p><pre>resources:<br>  requests: { cpu: 250m, memory: 700Mi }<br>  limits:   { memory: 900Mi }   # CPU limit ko'pincha qo'yilmaydi (throttling)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Memory request'ni juda past qo'yish — node bosimida eviction va OOMKill.</li><li>CPU limit qattiq — CFS throttling latency'ni oshiradi; ko'p jamoa faqat CPU request qo'yadi.</li><li>JVM/Go runtime xotirasini hisobga olmaslik (<code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage</code>, <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code>).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Right-sizing bir martalik emas — CI/dashboard'da &quot;request vs usage&quot; farqini doimiy ko'rsat. Keyin Karpenter consolidation bo'shagan sig'imni haqiqatan node sonini kamaytirishga aylantiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40320	<p>Serverless va Kubernetes'da scale-to-zero nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Scale-to-zero — trafik yoki navbatda ish bo'lmaganda replikalarni 0 ga tushirish, keyin birinchi so'rov/xabar kelganda qayta ko'tarish. Bo'sh vaqtda compute xarajati yo'q; narxi — cold start kechikishi. K8s'da KEDA va Knative, serverless'da (Lambda, Cloud Run) default xulq.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 50 ta ichki servis, ko'pi kuniga bir necha marta ishlatiladi, lekin 24/7 pod'lar resurs band qiladi. Dev/preview muhitlar tunda bo'sh turadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Knative (HTTP):<br> so'rov -&gt; activator (buferlaydi) -&gt; pod 0-&gt;1 ko'tariladi -&gt; javob<br>            ^ idle N daqiqa -&gt; pod 0 ga tushadi<br><br>KEDA (event):<br> Kafka lag / SQS uzunligi = 0  --&gt; Deployment replicas=0<br> lag &gt; 0                       --&gt; 0-&gt;1 (KEDA), 1-&gt;N (HPA)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1<br>kind: ScaledObject<br>metadata: { name: invoice-worker }<br>spec:<br>  scaleTargetRef: { name: invoice-worker }<br>  minReplicaCount: 0<br>  maxReplicaCount: 30<br>  cooldownPeriod: 300<br>  triggers:<br>    - type: aws-sqs-queue<br>      metadata: { queueURL: https://sqs.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/123/invoices, queueLength: &quot;20&quot;, awsRegion: eu-central-1 }</pre><pre>kubectl get scaledobject,hpa -n billing</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cold start: image pull + app init 5-30 s — sinxron foydalanuvchi API'si uchun qabul qilinmasligi mumkin.</li><li>Node ham scale bo'lishi kerak (Karpenter), aks holda pod 0 bo'lsa ham node to'lanadi.</li><li>HTTP uchun KEDA o'zi so'rovni ushlab turmaydi — HTTP add-on yoki Knative kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Scale-to-zero'ni latency SLO bilan tanla: batch/async — ha; checkout API — <code>minReplicas: 2</code>. Kichik image, tez startup (Go, distroless) va pre-pulled image cold start'ni sezilarli kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40321	<p>Karpenter consolidation (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Karpenter consolidation — Karpenter kam yuklangan yoki bo'sh node'larni aniqlab, ularning pod'larini boshqa node'larga sig'dirish yoki bitta arzonroq node bilan almashtirish mumkinligini simulyatsiya qiladi, keyin pod'larni ko'chirib node'ni o'chiradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Deploy va scale'dan keyin klaster &quot;fragmentatsiya&quot; bo'ladi: 10 ta node har biri 30% yuklangan. Pul 10 node uchun ketadi, 4 tasi yetarli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Node A 30%  Node B 25%  Node C 20%<br>   |  simulyatsiya: pod'lar A va B ga sig'adimi? (requests, affinity, PDB)<br>   v<br> C ni cordon -&gt; drain (PDB hurmat qilinadi) -&gt; terminate<br> yoki: 2 ta m6i.xlarge -&gt; 1 ta m6i.2xlarge (replace, arzonroq)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Karpenter v1):</b></p><pre>apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1<br>kind: NodePool<br>metadata: { name: default }<br>spec:<br>  disruption:<br>    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized   # yoki WhenEmpty<br>    consolidateAfter: 1m<br>    budgets:<br>      - nodes: &quot;10%&quot;                 # bir vaqtda max 10% node<br>      - nodes: &quot;0&quot;<br>        schedule: &quot;0 9 * * mon-fri&quot;  # ish vaqtida disruption yo'q<br>        duration: 8h</pre><pre>kubectl get nodeclaims<br>kubectl logs -n kube-system deploy/karpenter | grep -i disrupt<br>kubectl get events --field-selector reason=DisruptionBlocked</pre><p>Pod darajasida himoya: annotatsiya <code>karpenter.sh/do-not-disrupt: &quot;true&quot;</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>PDB yo'q yoki bitta replika — consolidation servisni qisqa uzadi.</li><li>Juda qattiq PDB (<code>maxUnavailable: 0</code>) — consolidation hech qachon ishlamaydi, pul tejalmaydi.</li><li>Uzoq ishlaydigan job'lar uzilishi — <code>do-not-disrupt</code> yoki alohida NodePool.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Consolidation tejamkorligi right-sizing'ga bog'liq: request'lar shishgan bo'lsa Karpenter pod'larni zich joylay olmaydi. Disruption budget'ni biznes vaqtiga mosla — tejash va barqarorlik o'rtasidagi trade-off.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40322	<p>Multi-tenant Kubernetes klaster nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multi-tenant Kubernetes klaster — bitta fizik klasterni bir nechta jamoa yoki mijoz bo'lishadi. Izolyatsiya Namespace, RBAC, NetworkPolicy, ResourceQuota/LimitRange, Pod Security Admission bilan qilinadi — bu <b>soft multi-tenancy</b> (umumiy control plane va kernel).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har jamoaga alohida klaster — 40 ta klaster, har biri control plane, monitoring, upgrade xarajati. Bitta klaster arzon, lekin &quot;noisy neighbor&quot; va xavfsizlik chegarasi muammo.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Klaster<br>+-- ns team-a  [RBAC: team-a edit] [Quota: 20 CPU] [NetPol: default deny]<br>+-- ns team-b  [RBAC: team-b edit] [Quota: 10 CPU] [PSA: restricted]<br>+-- ns platform (ingress, monitoring)<br>   umumiy: API server, etcd, node kernel, CRD'lar</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: ResourceQuota<br>metadata: { name: quota, namespace: team-a }<br>spec:<br>  hard: { requests.cpu: &quot;20&quot;, requests.memory: 40Gi, pods: &quot;200&quot; }<br>---<br>apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: NetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: default-deny, namespace: team-a }<br>spec: { podSelector: {}, policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress] }</pre><pre>kubectl label ns team-a pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted<br>kubectl auth can-i delete pods -n team-b --as=dev@acme.io   # tekshiruv</pre><p>Tool'lar: Capsule, HNC (Hierarchical Namespaces), Kyverno generate (namespace yaratilganda default'larni avtomatik qo'shish).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cluster-scoped resurslar (CRD, ClusterRole, StorageClass) ajratilmaydi.</li><li>Kernel umumiy: container escape = boshqa tenant'ga kirish. Ko'p tashkilotlar gibrid: &quot;klaster per environment, namespace per team&quot;.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40323	<p><code>vcluster</code> (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> vcluster (Loft Labs) — host klasterdagi bitta namespace ichida ishlaydigan <b>virtual Kubernetes klaster</b>: o'z API server'i, controller'i va datastore'i bor, lekin pod'lar syncer orqali host klasterda ishlaydi. Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40324	<p>Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Zero Trust (NIST SP 800-207) — &quot;tarmoq ichidaligi ishonch bermaydi&quot; tamoyili: har so'rov identity (user, qurilma, workload), kontekst va policy asosida autentifikatsiya va avtorizatsiya qilinadi, aloqa shifrlanadi (mTLS). ZTNA — shu modelni ilovalarga kirishda VPN o'rniga qo'llash.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Perimetr modeli: VPN'ga kirding — butun ichki tarmoq ochiq. Bitta o'g'irlangan noutbuk yoki zaif pod = lateral movement, butun DB'gacha.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>User/qurilma --&gt; Identity-aware proxy (IdP: SSO+MFA, device posture)<br>                    | policy: kim? qaysi qurilma? qaysi ilova?<br>                    v<br>                 faqat shu ilova (tarmoq emas)<br><br>Servis A --mTLS (SPIFFE ID)--&gt; Servis B<br>             authz policy: A -&gt; B GET /orders ruxsat</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Istio: faqat orders SA'si payments'ga murojaat qila oladi<br>apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1<br>kind: AuthorizationPolicy<br>metadata: { name: payments-allow, namespace: payments }<br>spec:<br>  action: ALLOW<br>  rules:<br>    - from: [{ source: { principals: [&quot;cluster.local/ns/orders/sa/orders&quot;] } }]<br>      to:   [{ operation: { methods: [&quot;POST&quot;], paths: [&quot;/charge&quot;] } }]<br>---<br>apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1<br>kind: PeerAuthentication<br>metadata: { name: default, namespace: istio-system }<br>spec: { mtls: { mode: STRICT } }</pre><p>Inson kirishi uchun: Cloudflare Access, Google BeyondCorp/IAP, Tailscale, Teleport (SSH/K8s).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Zero Trust'ni bitta mahsulot deb o'ylash — bu arxitektura, bosqichma-bosqich joriy etiladi.</li><li>mTLS bor, lekin authz policy yo'q — shifrlangan, lekin hamma hammaga murojaat qila oladi.</li><li>Break-glass yo'li yo'q — IdP tushsa hech kim kira olmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Boshlash tartibi: identity (SSO+MFA) -&gt; eng qimmatli ilovalar uchun proxy -&gt; servis darajasida mTLS -&gt; default-deny authz. Har bosqich o'lchanadigan risk kamayishi beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40325	<p>SPIFFE/SPIRE nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SPIFFE — workload identity standarti (<code>spiffe://trust-domain/path</code> ko'rinishidagi ID va uni tashuvchi SVID: X.509 sertifikat yoki JWT). SPIRE — uning CNCF (Graduated) implementatsiyasi: workload'ni attestation (node + kernel/kubelet ma'lumotlari) orqali tanib, qisqa muddatli, avtomatik rotatsiya qilinadigan SVID beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Servislar bir-birini statik API key yoki uzoq muddatli sertifikat bilan tanidi: ular repo'ga tushadi, rotatsiya qilinmaydi, o'g'irlansa yillab ishlaydi. Turli platformalar (K8s, VM, Lambda) bir xil identity tiliga ega emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>SPIRE Server (CA, registration entries)<br>     ^  node attestation (AWS IID, k8s PSAT)<br>     |<br>SPIRE Agent (har node'da)<br>     ^  workload attestation: PID -&gt; cgroup -&gt; pod, SA, image<br>     |  Workload API (unix socket)<br>Workload &lt;-- SVID: spiffe://acme.io/ns/orders/sa/api (TTL ~1 soat)<br>     |<br>  mTLS boshqa workload bilan, ID tekshiriladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Registration entry: shu SA'li pod'lar shu ID'ni oladi<br>spire-server entry create \<br>  -spiffeID spiffe://acme.io/ns/orders/sa/api \<br>  -parentID spiffe://acme.io/k8s-node \<br>  -selector k8s:ns:orders -selector k8s:sa:api<br>spire-server entry show<br># Workload ichida<br>spire-agent api fetch x509 -socketPath /run/spire/sockets/agent.sock</pre><p>Istio, Linkerd, Cilium ham SPIFFE ID formatini ishlatadi; SPIRE AWS/Vault'ga OIDC federation orqali secret'siz kirish ham beradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Selector'lar juda keng (faqat namespace) — bir namespace'dagi har qanday pod ID oladi.</li><li>SPIRE Server — kritik komponent: HA va CA kalit himoyasi (KMS/HSM) kerak.</li><li>Ilova SVID rotatsiyasini qayta yuklamasa, sertifikat muddati tugaydi — SDK yoki Envoy SDS ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SPIFFE &quot;secret zero&quot; muammosini hal qiladi: workload hech qanday oldindan berilgan secret'siz, platforma attestation'i orqali identity oladi. Bu Zero Trust'ning servis-servis qatlamidagi poydevori.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps

Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40327	<p>Open Policy Agent (OPA) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Open Policy Agent (OPA) — CNCF (Graduated) umumiy maqsadli policy engine: JSON input'ni <b>Rego</b> tilidagi deklarativ qoidalarga nisbatan baholab qaror (allow/deny yoki istalgan JSON) qaytaradi. Policy qarorini ilova kodidan ajratadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Avtorizatsiya mantiqi har servisda <code>if user.role == ...</code> sifatida sochilgan, turli tillarda; o'zgartirish = har servisni qayta deploy; audit qilib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Servis / K8s / Envoy / Terraform<br>     | query: input JSON {user, action, resource}<br>     v<br>   OPA (policy + data, xotirada)<br>     | decision: {&quot;allow&quot;: true}<br>     v<br> Servis qarorni bajaradi<br>Policy bundle'lar -&gt; HTTP server'dan pull (versiyalangan)</pre><p>Ishlatilish: K8s admission (Gatekeeper), Envoy ext_authz, Terraform plan (Conftest), API authz, Kafka ACL.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>package httpapi.authz<br>import rego.v1<br><br>default allow := false<br><br>allow if {<br>  input.method == &quot;GET&quot;<br>  input.path == [&quot;orders&quot;, input.user.id]<br>}<br>allow if &quot;admin&quot; in input.user.roles</pre><pre>opa eval -d authz.rego -i input.json &quot;data.httpapi.authz.allow&quot;<br>opa run --server authz.rego &amp;<br>curl -s localhost:8181/v1/data/httpapi/authz/allow \<br>  -d '{&quot;input&quot;:{&quot;method&quot;:&quot;GET&quot;,&quot;path&quot;:[&quot;orders&quot;,&quot;u1&quot;],&quot;user&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;u1&quot;,&quot;roles&quot;:[]}}}'<br># {&quot;result&quot;:true}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Rego o'rganish egri chizig'i tik — jamoa uchun test va namuna kutubxona kerak.</li><li><code>default allow := false</code> unutilsa — undefined natija noto'g'ri talqin qilinishi mumkin.</li><li>Katta <code>data</code> (minglab user) OPA xotirasini to'ldiradi — kerakli ma'lumotni input'da yubor.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> OPA'ni sidecar yoki lokal library sifatida ishlat — har qarorda tarmoq hop'i latency qo'shadi. Decision log'larini yoqib qo'y: &quot;nega rad etildi&quot; savoliga javob va audit izi. K8s-only bo'lsa Kyverno soddaroq alternativa.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40328	<p>Kyverno (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Kyverno — CNCF (Graduated) Kubernetes-native policy engine: policy'lar oddiy YAML (CRD) da yoziladi, yangi til shart emas. To'rt imkoniyat: <b>validate</b> (rad etish), <b>mutate</b> (avtomatik o'zgartirish), <b>generate</b> (yangi resurs yaratish) va <b>verifyImages</b> (cosign imzosini tekshirish).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> OPA Gatekeeper kuchli, lekin Rego o'rganish kerak. HA (3 replika) va kube-system istisno.</li><li>Mutate policy'lar GitOps bilan drift yaratadi (Argo diff ko'rsatadi) — ignoreDifferences sozla.</li><li>Juda ko'p policy — admission latency oshadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Kyverno vs Gatekeeper: faqat K8s va YAML'ga o'rgangan jamoa — Kyverno; K8s'dan tashqarida ham (API, Terraform) bitta policy tili kerak — OPA. Oddiy validatsiyalar uchun K8s'ning o'zidagi ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL, webhook'siz) ham ko'rib chiq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps

LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}'; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO \&quot;{{name}}\&quot;;&quot;<br>vault read database/creds/orders-ro<br># username v-k8s-orders-ro-x7a..  password ...  lease_duration 1h</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Unseal kalitlari va root token'ni noto'g'ri saqlash — auto-unseal (KMS) ishlat, root token'ni revoke qil.</li><li>Vault tushsa ilovalar secret ololmaydi — HA (Raft), lease'larni oldindan yangilash, cache.</li><li>Dynamic secret, lekin ilova ulanishni qayta yaratmaydi — eski credential tugaganda xato.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Vault'ning eng katta qiymati — dynamic secret va qisqa TTL: o'g'irlangan credential bir soatda yaroqsiz. Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40330	<p>External Secrets Operator (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> External Secrets Operator (ESO) — K8s operatori: tashqi secret store'lardan (AWS Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, Vault, GCP/Azure) qiymatlarni o'qib, ularni oddiy K8s <code>Secret</code> ga sinxronlaydi va vaqti-vaqti bilan yangilaydi. Git'da faqat &quot;qaysi secret kerak&quot; degan havola saqlanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> GitOps'da hammasi Git'da, lekin secret'ni Git'ga qo'yib bo'lmaydi. Qo'lda <code>kubectl create secret</code> — reproducible emas, rotatsiya unutiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Git: ExternalSecret (key: prod/orders/db)<br>          |<br>      ESO controller (refreshInterval)<br>          |  SecretStore auth: IRSA / Pod Identity / Vault k8s auth<br>          v<br>   AWS Secrets Manager  --&gt; qiymat<br>          |<br>          v<br>   K8s Secret orders-db  --&gt; pod env / volume</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1<br>kind: SecretStore<br>metadata: { name: aws, namespace: orders }<br>spec:<br>  provider:<br>    aws:<br>      service: SecretsManager<br>      region: eu-central-1<br>      auth: { jwt: { serviceAccountRef: { name: eso-orders } } }<br>---<br>apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1<br>kind: ExternalSecret<br>metadata: { name: orders-db, namespace: orders }<br>spec:<br>  refreshInterval: 1h<br>  secretStoreRef: { name: aws, kind: SecretStore }<br>  target: { name: orders-db }<br>  data:<br>    - secretKey: password<br>      remoteRef: { key: prod/orders/db, property: password }</pre><pre>kubectl get externalsecret -n orders   # STATUS: SecretSynced<br>kubectl describe externalsecret orders-db -n orders</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Secret yangilandi, lekin pod env eski — env o'zgaruvchilari restart'siz yangilanmaydi (Reloader yoki volume mount ishlat).</li><li><code>ClusterSecretStore</code> keng huquqli — bir namespace boshqa jamoa secret'ini o'qishi mumkin.</li><li>K8s Secret baribir etcd'da — etcd encryption at rest va RBAC shart.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ESO vs Secrets Store CSI Driver: ESO K8s Secret yaratadi (moslik yuqori), CSI faqat volume'ga mount qiladi (etcd'ga tushmaydi). Xavfsizlik talabiga qarab tanla; manba haqiqati doim tashqi store'da qolsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40331	<p>Cosign keyless signing (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cosign keyless signing (Sigstore) — container image'ni uzoq muddatli private key'siz imzolash: CI'ning OIDC identity'si (masalan GitHub Actions workflow) bilan <b>Fulcio</b> CA'dan ~10 daqiqalik sertifikat olinadi, imzo <b>Rekor</b> transparency log'ga yoziladi. Tekshiruvchi &quot;bu image <code>acme/app</code> repo'sining <code>main</code> workflow'idan imzolangan&quot;ni isbotlaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> An'anaviy imzo — private key saqlash, rotatsiya, sizib chiqishi. Uni SBOM va SLSA provenance attestation'lari bilan birga (<code>cosign attest</code>) ishlat va admission'da majburla — aks holda imzo qog'ozda qoladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40332	<p>SBOM (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) — dastur yoki container ichidagi barcha komponentlar (paketlar, kutubxonalar, tranzitiv dependency'lar, versiyalar, litsenziyalar) ning mashina o'qiy oladigan ro'yxati. Standart formatlar: <b>CycloneDX</b> va <b>SPDX</b>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Log4Shell (2021) chiqqanda kompaniyalar haftalab &quot;qaysi servisimizda log4j bor?&quot; deb qidirgan. SBOM bo'lsa bu bitta so'rov. AQSh EO 14028, EU Cyber Resilience Act SBOM talab qiladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>build --&gt; image --&gt; syft/trivy --&gt; SBOM (CycloneDX JSON)<br>                                     |<br>                       +-------------+------------+<br>                       v                          v<br>              cosign attest (image'ga)   Dependency-Track / grype<br>                                         yangi CVE chiqsa -&gt; alert</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>syft ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0 -o cyclonedx-json &gt; sbom.json<br>trivy image --format spdx-json -o sbom.spdx.json ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0<br>grype sbom:sbom.json --fail-on high          # SBOM'dan CVE skan<br>cosign attest --yes --type cyclonedx --predicate sbom.json ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:...<br>docker buildx build --sbom=true --provenance=true -t ... .   # BuildKit</pre><pre>jq '.components[] | select(.name==&quot;log4j-core&quot;) | .version' sbom.json</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SBOM yaratib arxivga tashlash — undan foydalanadigan jarayon (CVE monitoring) bo'lmasa qiymati yo'q.</li><li>Statik bog'langan binary yoki vendored kod skanerlarga ko'rinmasligi mumkin.</li><li>SBOM'dagi CVE'lar ko'p false positive beradi — VEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) bilan &quot;not affected&quot; belgilash.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SBOM'ni build vaqtida yarat (deploy vaqtida emas) va image'ga imzolangan attestation sifatida bog'la. Shunda prod'dagi har digest uchun &quot;ichida nima bor&quot; savoliga isbotlangan javob bor.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40333	<p>SLSA framework (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, &quot;salsa&quot;) — OpenSSF framework'i: build jarayoni yaxlitligi uchun darajalar belgilaydi. v1.0 Build track: L1 — provenance mavjud; L2 — hosted build platformasi imzolagan provenance; L3 — build'lar izolyatsiyalangan, provenance'ni build kodi soxtalashtira olmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> SolarWinds (2020): hujumchi build serverga kirib, imzolangan rasmiy update ichiga backdoor qo'shgan. Kod review toza edi — buzilish build bosqichida.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>source (commit sha) --&gt; build platform (isolated runner)<br>                              |<br>                       artifact + provenance:<br>                       {builder id, source repo+sha,<br>                        build config, input digest'lar}  -- imzolangan<br>                              |<br>consumer: slsa-verifier --&gt; &quot;shu artifact shu repo'ning<br>                             shu commit'idan, shu builder'da yasalgan&quot;</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># GitHub Actions: SLSA L3 provenance generator<br>provenance:<br>  needs: [build]<br>  permissions: { actions: read, id-token: write, packages: write }<br>  uses: slsa-framework/slsa-github-generator/.github/workflows/generator_container_slsa3.yml@v2.1.0<br>  with:<br>    image: ghcr.io/acme/api<br>    digest: ${{ needs.build.outputs.digest }}</pre><pre>slsa-verifier verify-image ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:... \<br>  --source-uri github.com/acme/api --source-branch main</pre><p>GitHub'ning <code>actions/attest-build-provenance</code> ham SLSA provenance beradi (<code>gh attestation verify</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Provenance yaratib, uni deploy'da tekshirmaslik — himoya nol.</li><li>Self-hosted runner'lar build'lar orasida tozalanmasa L3 izolyatsiya buziladi.</li><li>SLSA build'ni himoyalaydi, lekin zararli dependency (typosquatting) yoki source'dagi backdoor'ni emas.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Amaliy yo'l: L2 ni tez ol (hosted CI + attest), keyin admission policy bilan &quot;faqat bizning builder'dan chiqqan image&quot; qoidasini majburla. Source track (branch protection, 2-kishi review) bilan birga to'liq zanjir bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40334	<p>eBPF nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> eBPF — Linux kernel ichida, kernel kodini o'zgartirmasdan va modul yuklamasdan, xavfsiz sandbox dasturlarni ishga tushirish texnologiyasi. Dastur verifier'dan o'tadi (cheksiz sikl yo'q, xotiraga xavfsiz kirish), JIT bilan native kodga aylanadi va hook'larga (syscall, tarmoq paketi, kprobe, tracepoint) ulanadi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kernel darajasidagi observability yoki tez tarmoq uchun avval kernel modul yozish kerak edi — bitta bug butun serverni yiqitadi. iptables minglab qoidada sekinlashadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>user space: C/Rust/Go dastur -&gt; bytecode -&gt; bpf() syscall<br>                                    |<br>kernel:   verifier (xavfsizmi?) -&gt; JIT -&gt; hook'ga ulash<br>             |                         (XDP, tc, kprobe, LSM)<br>          eBPF maps  &lt;-------------&gt;  user space (metrikalar, policy)</pre><p>Ishlatilishi: Cilium (CNI, kube-proxy o'rniga), Hubble/Pixie (observability), Falco/Tetragon (runtime security), Parca (continuous profiling), XDP DDoS himoyasi.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># bpftrace: qaysi process qaysi faylni ochyapti<br>sudo bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_openat { printf(&quot;%s %s\n&quot;, comm, str(args-&gt;filename)); }'<br># Yuklangan dasturlar<br>sudo bpftool prog list<br>sudo bpftool map list<br># BCC tool'lari<br>sudo execsnoop-bpfcc       # yangi process'lar<br>sudo tcplife-bpfcc         # TCP ulanishlar davomiyligi</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kernel versiyasiga bog'liq: eski kernel'larda (&lt; 5.x) BTF/CO-RE yo'q, ba'zi imkoniyatlar ishlamaydi.</li><li>eBPF yuklash <code>CAP_BPF</code>/<code>CAP_SYS_ADMIN</code> talab qiladi — bu kuchli huquq, container'ga berishdan ehtiyot bo'l.</li><li>Overhead nol emas: har syscall'ga hook qo'yish yuklangan tizimda sezilarli.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> eBPF ilovani o'zgartirmasdan (instrumentatsiyasiz) ko'rinish beradi — legacy tizimlarda bebaho. Lekin u L7 semantikasini (masalan, biznes kontekst) to'liq bermaydi; OTel bilan to'ldiruvchi, almashtiruvchi emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40335	<p>Falco (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Falco — CNCF (Graduated) runtime security tool: kernel syscall'larini (eBPF driver orqali) kuzatib, qoidalarga mos shubhali xulqni real vaqtda aniqlaydi — container ichida shell ochilishi, <code>/etc/shadow</code> o'qish, kutilmagan tarmoq ulanishi — va alert yuboradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Image skaneri faqat ma'lum CVE'larni deploy'dan oldin topadi. Hujumchi zero-day orqali kirsa yoki ruxsatli credential bilan harakat qilsa — buni faqat runtime xulqidan bilish mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>syscall'lar (execve, open, connect)<br>     | eBPF probe<br>     v<br>Falco engine + K8s metadata (pod, ns, image)<br>     | qoidalar (condition + output)<br>     v<br>alert --&gt; stdout / Falcosidekick --&gt; Slack, SIEM, Loki<br>                                  --&gt; Talon (avtomatik javob: pod'ni izolyatsiya)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>helm install falco falcosecurity/falco -n falco --create-namespace \<br>  --set driver.kind=modern_ebpf --set falcosidekick.enabled=true<br>kubectl logs -n falco -l app.kubernetes.io/name=falco -f</pre><pre>- rule: Shell in container<br>  desc: Container ichida interaktiv shell<br>  condition: spawned_process and container and proc.name in (bash, sh, zsh) and proc.tty != 0<br>  output: &quot;Shell ochildi (user=%user.name pod=%k8s.pod.name ns=%k8s.ns.name cmd=%proc.cmdline)&quot;<br>  priority: WARNING</pre><p>Test: <code>kubectl exec -it api-xyz -- sh</code> — logda <code>Notice/Warning Shell ochildi ...</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Default qoidalar ko'p shovqin beradi — avval tuning (macro'lar bilan istisno), aks holda alert fatigue.</li><li>Alert'ni hech kim kuzatmaydi — SIEM va on-call jarayoniga ulanmasa foydasiz.</li><li>Avtomatik &quot;pod'ni o'ldirish&quot; — false positive prod'ni yiqitishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Falco — detection, prevention emas. U PSA/seccomp (oldini olish) va image signing bilan birga qatlamli himoyaning oxirgi qatlami. Qoidalarni ilovaga xos qil: &quot;bu servis hech qachon tashqi IP'ga ulanmaydi&quot; — eng aniq signal.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40336	<p>Cilium (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cilium — CNCF (Graduated) eBPF asosidagi Kubernetes CNI: pod tarmog'i, kube-proxy o'rnini bosuvchi load balancing, L3-L7 NetworkPolicy (identity asosida, IP emas), WireGuard/IPsec shaffof shifrlash, Hubble observability va sidecar'siz service mesh beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Katta klasterda kube-proxy iptables qoidalari o'n minglab — servis yangilanishi sekin, latency oshadi. Oddiy NetworkPolicy L7 ni (masalan, faqat <code>GET /api</code>) bilmaydi; pod IP'lari doim o'zgaradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod A --&gt; eBPF (tc hook, veth) --&gt; policy: identity(A) -&gt; identity(B)?<br>            |  service LB (iptables'siz, hash map)<br>            v<br>          Pod B (boshqa node bo'lsa: VXLAN/Geneve yoki native routing,<br>                 WireGuard bilan shifrlangan)<br>L7 qoidalar -&gt; node'dagi Envoy</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>cilium install --set kubeProxyReplacement=true --set encryption.enabled=true --set encryption.type=wireguard<br>cilium status --wait<br>cilium connectivity test<br>hubble observe --namespace orders --verdict DROPPED</pre><pre>apiVersion: cilium.io/v2<br>kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy<br>metadata: { name: api-l7, namespace: orders }<br>spec:<br>  endpointSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  ingress:<br>    - fromEndpoints: [{ matchLabels: { app: frontend } }]<br>      toPorts:<br>        - ports: [{ port: &quot;8080&quot;, protocol: TCP }]<br>          rules: { http: [{ method: GET, path: &quot;/api/.*&quot; }] }</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kernel versiyasi talablari (5.10+ tavsiya) — eski OS'da imkoniyatlar cheklangan.</li><li>CNI almashtirish ishlab turgan klasterda — murakkab migratsiya, ko'pincha yangi klaster osonroq.</li><li>L7 policy Envoy proxy orqali o'tadi — qo'shimcha latency va resurs.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Cilium qiymati identity asosidagi policy va chuqur ko'rinish (Hubble) da. Managed K8s'lar ham uni default qilyapti (GKE Dataplane V2, AKS Azure CNI powered by Cilium) — bu ekotizim yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40337	<p>Gateway API (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Gateway API — Kubernetes'ning Ingress vorisi (GA 2023, v1): trafikni rollar bo'yicha ajratilgan resurslar bilan boshqaradi: <code>GatewayClass</code> (infra provayder), <code>Gateway</code> (listener, port, TLS — platform jamoasi), <code>HTTPRoute</code>/<code>GRPCRoute</code> (routing — ilova jamoasi). Header bo'yicha routing, weight bilan trafik bo'lish nativ.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ingress juda sodda: canary, header match, timeout kabi narsalar har controller'da turli annotatsiyalar (<code>nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/...</code>) — portativ emas. Bitta Ingress resursida platforma va ilova jamoasi mas'uliyati aralashgan. ingress-nginx 2026-da retire bo'lishi e'lon qilingan — migratsiya dolzarb.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>GatewayClass (infra: envoy-gateway / istio / cilium)<br>     |<br>Gateway (ns: infra, :443, TLS cert)  &lt;- platform jamoasi<br>     |  allowedRoutes: namespace'lar<br>     v<br>HTTPRoute (ns: orders)  &lt;- ilova jamoasi<br>   /api  --&gt; svc api-v1 (90%) + api-v2 (10%)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: HTTPRoute<br>metadata: { name: api, namespace: orders }<br>spec:<br>  parentRefs: [{ name: public-gw, namespace: infra }]<br>  hostnames: [&quot;api.acme.io&quot;]<br>  rules:<br>    - matches: [{ path: { type: PathPrefix, value: /api } }]<br>      backendRefs:<br>        - { name: api-v1, port: 8080, weight: 90 }<br>        - { name: api-v2, port: 8080, weight: 10 }</pre><pre>kubectl get gateway -A<br>kubectl describe httproute api -n orders   # status.parents: Accepted, ResolvedRefs</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Route boshqa namespace'dagi Service'ga murojaat qilsa <code>ReferenceGrant</code> kerak, aks holda <code>ResolvedRefs=False</code>.</li><li>Barcha controller'lar barcha imkoniyatni qo'llamaydi — conformance profilini tekshir.</li><li>CRD'lar klasterda o'rnatilmagan bo'lishi mumkin — standard channel'ni alohida o'rnat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Gateway API'ning asosiy yutug'i — rol ajratish: platform jamoasi TLS va listener'ni nazorat qiladi, ilova jamoasi faqat o'z route'larini. Yangi loyihalarda Ingress o'rniga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Gateway API tanla; u service mesh (GAMMA) uchun ham umumiy API.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40338	<p>KEDA (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> KEDA (Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling) — CNCF (Graduated) autoscaler: tashqi event manbalari (Kafka consumer lag, SQS/RabbitMQ navbat uzunligi, Prometheus so'rovi, cron) bo'yicha workload'ni 0 dan N gacha scale qiladi. Ichkarida HPA yaratadi va unga external metric beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> HPA CPU/xotira bo'yicha ishlaydi, lekin queue consumer'da CPU past bo'lishi mumkin, navbatda esa 1 million xabar yig'ilgan. Shuningdek HPA 0 replikaga tushmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>ScaledObject (trigger: kafka lag &gt; 100/replika)<br>     |<br>KEDA operator --&gt; scaler Kafka'dan lag o'qiydi<br>     | 0 &lt;-&gt; 1: KEDA o'zi (activation)<br>     | 1 &lt;-&gt; N: HPA (KEDA metrics server orqali)<br>     v<br>Deployment replicas</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1<br>kind: ScaledObject<br>metadata: { name: orders-consumer, namespace: orders }<br>spec:<br>  scaleTargetRef: { name: orders-consumer }<br>  minReplicaCount: 0<br>  maxReplicaCount: 24          # topic partition soni bilan cheklangan<br>  triggers:<br>    - type: kafka<br>      metadata:<br>        bootstrapServers: kafka:9092<br>        consumerGroup: orders<br>        topic: orders<br>        lagThreshold: &quot;100&quot;<br>        activationLagThreshold: &quot;5&quot;</pre><pre>kubectl get scaledobject -n orders     # READY, ACTIVE<br>kubectl get hpa -n orders              # keda-hpa-orders-consumer<br>kubectl describe scaledobject orders-consumer -n orders</pre><p>Batch uchun <code>ScaledJob</code> — har xabar guruhiga alohida Job.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kafka'da replika soni partition'dan oshsa, ortiqchalari bo'sh turadi.</li><li>Scaler auth (<code>TriggerAuthentication</code>) noto'g'ri — metrika olinmaydi, scale bo'lmaydi; KEDA operator log'ini tekshir.</li><li>Bir Deployment'ga ham HPA, ham ScaledObject — ziddiyat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Navbat asosidagi scaling — &quot;ish hajmi&quot; bo'yicha scaling, bu CPU proxy'sidan aniqroq. Downstream (DB) sig'imini ham hisobga ol: 100 replika consumer DB connection'larini tugatishi mumkin — <code>maxReplicaCount</code> shu chegaradan kelib chiqsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40339	<p>Istio Ambient Mesh (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Istio Ambient Mesh (GA 2024, Istio 1.24) — sidecar'siz service mesh rejimi: har node'da <b>ztunnel</b> DaemonSet L4 vazifalarini (mTLS, identity, L4 authz, telemetriya) bajaradi; L7 kerak bo'lgan joyda (HTTP routing, retry, L7 policy) namespace yoki servis uchun ixtiyoriy <b>waypoint proxy</b> (Envoy) qo'shiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Sidecar modelida har pod'ga Envoy: 1000 pod = 1000 proxy, xotira va CPU xarajati katta; mesh upgrade = hamma pod restart; sidecar inject qilish ilova lifecycle'iga aralashadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod A --&gt; ztunnel (node 1) ==HBONE mTLS==&gt; ztunnel (node 2) --&gt; Pod B<br>                                 |<br>          L7 kerak bo'lsa:  ztunnel -&gt; waypoint (Envoy) -&gt; ztunnel<br>Sidecar yo'q: pod spec o'zgarmaydi, restart kerak emas</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>istioctl install --set profile=ambient<br>kubectl label namespace orders istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient   # mesh'ga qo'shish<br>istioctl waypoint apply -n orders --enroll-namespace             # L7 kerak bo'lsa<br>istioctl ztunnel-config workloads | grep orders                 # PROTOCOL: HBONE<br>kubectl logs -n istio-system ds/ztunnel | grep orders</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Waypoint'siz L7 xususiyatlar (HTTP retry, header routing, L7 AuthorizationPolicy) ishlamaydi — policy jim e'tiborsiz qoladi.</li><li>CNI bilan moslik va kernel talablari — avval o'z muhitingda sinab ko'r.</li><li>ztunnel node darajasida — uning nosozligi node'dagi barcha pod'larning mesh trafigiga ta'sir qiladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ambient mesh'ni bosqichma-bosqich qabul qilish oson: avval faqat mTLS (L4) — arzon va keng; L7 faqat haqiqatan kerak bo'lgan servislarga. Sidecar vs ambient tanlovi — resurs xarajati va izolyatsiya (ztunnel umumiy) o'rtasidagi trade-off.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40340	<p>Distributed consensus (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Distributed consensus — bir nechta node bitta qiymat yoki operatsiyalar log'i tartibi bo'yicha kelishishi, hatto ba'zi node'lar yiqilsa yoki tarmoq bo'linsa ham. Asosiy algoritmlar: Paxos, <b>Raft</b> (tushunarliroq). Ishlatilishi: etcd (K8s), Consul, ZooKeeper (ZAB), CockroachDB, Kafka KRaft.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 3 ta node'da konfiguratsiya bor; tarmoq bo'linganda ikkala tomon &quot;men leader'man&quot; deb turli yozuvlarni qabul qilsa — split-brain, ma'lumot buziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (Raft):</b></p><pre>Leader --append entry--&gt; Follower 1<br>   |                \--&gt; Follower 2<br>   | majority (2/3) ack -&gt; commit -&gt; state machine'ga qo'llash<br>Leader heartbeat yo'qolsa -&gt; election timeout -&gt; yangi term,<br>   ovoz yig'ish -&gt; majority olgan leader bo'ladi<br>Quorum = floor(N/2)+1:  3 node -&gt; 1 nosozlikka chidaydi<br>                        5 node -&gt; 2 ta</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>etcdctl --endpoints=$EPS endpoint status -w table<br># ENDPOINT | ID | IS LEADER | RAFT TERM | RAFT INDEX<br>etcdctl --endpoints=$EPS endpoint health<br>etcdctl member list -w table</pre><p>Term tez-tez oshsa — leader beqaror (disk sekin, tarmoq jitter).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Juft son node (4) — 3 bilan bir xil chidamlilik, lekin ko'proq yozish latency'si.</li><li>Node'larni uzoq region'larga tarqatish — har yozuv WAN RTT kutadi.</li><li>Sekin disk (fsync) — heartbeat kechikadi, keraksiz election'lar. etcd uchun SSD shart.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Consensus qimmat — uni faqat kichik, kritik metadata uchun ishlat (leader election, konfiguratsiya, lock), katta ma'lumot oqimi uchun emas. CAP nuqtai nazaridan bu CP: partition paytida minority tomon yozishni rad etadi — bu bug emas, kafolat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40341	<p>WAL (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> WAL (Write-Ahead Log) — o'zgarish asosiy ma'lumot fayllariga yozilishidan <b>oldin</b> ketma-ket (append-only) log'ga yoziladi va <code>fsync</code> qilinadi. Crash bo'lsa, tizim log'ni qayta o'ynab (replay) commit qilingan ma'lumotni tiklaydi. Bu durability (ACID'dagi D) kafolati.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ma'lumot sahifalarini har commit'da diskka tasodifiy joylarga yozish sekin; xotirada ushlab tursak — elektr o'chsa yo'qoladi. WAL ikkalasini hal qiladi: ketma-ket yozish tez, sahifalar keyinroq (checkpoint) yoziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>UPDATE --&gt; WAL record (xotira bufer) --&gt; COMMIT: WAL fsync diskka<br>              |                              |  &quot;commit OK&quot; mijozga<br>              v<br>     shared buffers'dagi sahifa o'zgaradi (dirty)<br>              |<br>       checkpoint: dirty sahifalar data fayllarga<br>Crash -&gt; oxirgi checkpoint'dan WAL replay -&gt; izchil holat<br>WAL shuningdek: replication (stream), PITR (arxiv)</pre><p><b>Amalda (PostgreSQL):</b></p><pre>SELECT pg_current_wal_lsn();<br>SELECT pg_walfile_name(pg_current_wal_lsn());<br>SHOW wal_level;            -- replica / logical<br>SHOW synchronous_commit;   -- on: fsync kutadi</pre><pre>ls $PGDATA/pg_wal | head<br>pg_waldump $PGDATA/pg_wal/000000010000000000000003 | head</pre><p>Boshqa misollar: etcd WAL, Kafka log, MySQL redo log, RocksDB WAL.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>fsync=off</code> yoki yolg'on fsync qiladigan disk kesh — crash'da ma'lumot buziladi.</li><li>Replication slot yoki arxiv ishlamasa <code>pg_wal</code> to'lib, disk tugaydi va DB to'xtaydi.</li><li><code>synchronous_commit=off</code> — tezroq, lekin crash'da oxirgi ~soniya commit'lari yo'qolishi mumkin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> WAL — DB'ning haqiqiy manbasi: replication, CDC (Debezium logical decoding) va backup hammasi undan o'qiydi. WAL hajmi va arxiv kechikishini monitoring qil — bu ko'p prod incident'larning birinchi signali.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40342	<p>DB connection pooling (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Connection pooling — qat'iy sondagi tayyor DB ulanishlarini ko'p client o'rtasida qayta ishlatish. PostgreSQL'da har ulanish alohida process (~5-10 MB), shuning uchun minglab to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulanish DB'ni o'ldiradi. Tool'lar: ilova ichidagi pool (pgxpool, HikariCP), tashqi pooler — PgBouncer, RDS Proxy, Pgpool.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 200 pod x har birida 20 ulanish = 4000 ulanish. Postgres <code>max_connections=500</code>: yangi pod'lar <code>FATAL: too many connections</code> oladi; ulanish ochish (TLS + auth) har so'rovga 20-50 ms qo'shadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>200 pod (har biri pool 5) = 1000 client ulanish<br>        |<br>   PgBouncer (transaction mode)<br>        |  50 ta server ulanish (qayta ishlatiladi)<br>        v<br>   PostgreSQL (max_connections=200)</pre><p>| Rejim | Server ulanish qachon qaytadi | Cheklov | |---|---|---| | session | client uzilganda | tejash kam | | transaction | tranzaksiya tugaganda | session state (SET, advisory lock, LISTEN) ishlamaydi | | statement | har so'rovdan keyin | multi-statement tranzaksiya yo'q |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>; pgbouncer.ini<br>[databases]<br>orders = host=pg-primary port=5432 dbname=orders<br>[pgbouncer]<br>pool_mode = transaction<br>default_pool_size = 40<br>max_client_conn = 5000</pre><pre>psql -p 6432 -U admin pgbouncer -c &quot;SHOW POOLS;&quot;   # cl_waiting &gt; 0 = pool tor</pre><pre>cfg, _ := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)<br>cfg.MaxConns = 10<br>cfg.MaxConnLifetime = 30 * time.Minute</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Transaction mode'da prepared statement'lar — PgBouncer 1.21+ <code>max_prepared_statements</code> bilan qo'llaydi, eskilarida xato.</li><li>Pool juda katta — DB'da contention oshadi; optimal ~ CPU yadro x 2-4.</li><li>Uzun tranzaksiyalar ulanishni band qiladi — pool och qoladi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pool hajmini &quot;ko'proq = tezroq&quot; deb emas, DB sig'imidan teskari hisobla: DB nechta parallel so'rovni samarali bajaradi, shuni replikalar soniga bo'l. <code>cl_waiting</code> va so'rov kutish vaqti — asosiy metrikalar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40343	<p>DB sharding (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Sharding — ma'lumot qatorlarini shard key bo'yicha (masalan <code>tenant_id</code>) bir nechta mustaqil DB instance'ga gorizontal bo'lish. Har shard ma'lumotning faqat bir qismini saqlaydi — yozish va saqlash sig'imi gorizontal oshadi. Narxi: shard'lararo so'rov, tranzaksiya va resharding murakkab.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta Postgres 10 TB, yozish 50k/s — eng katta instance ham yetmaydi, vacuum va backup soatlab davom etadi. Read replica faqat o'qishni scale qiladi, yozishni emas.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>so'rov (tenant_id=42)<br>     |<br> routing qatlami: hash(42) mod N  yoki lookup jadval<br>     |<br> +---------+---------+---------+<br> shard 0   shard 1   shard 2   shard 3<br> tenant'lar tenant'lar ...<br>Strategiyalar: hash (teng taqsimot), range (vaqt/ID oraliq),<br>directory (tenant -&gt; shard jadvali, eng moslashuvchan)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>-- Citus (Postgres extension)<br>SELECT create_distributed_table('orders', 'tenant_id');<br>SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = 42;     -- bitta shard<br>SELECT count(*) FROM orders;                   -- hamma shard'ga fan-out</pre><p>Boshqa yechimlar: Vitess (MySQL), MongoDB sharding, CockroachDB/Spanner (avtomatik).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>user_id % N</code> — N o'zgarsa deyarli hamma ma'lumot ko'chadi. Consistent hashing yoki ko'p virtual shard (masalan 1024 logical -&gt; 8 fizik).</li><li>Noto'g'ri shard key — hot shard (bitta katta mijoz) yoki har so'rov fan-out.</li><li>Shard'lararo JOIN va unique constraint — ilova darajasida yoki ishlamaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sharding — oxirgi chora: avval indeks, query optimizatsiya, vertikal scale, read replica, partitioning, arxivlash. Kerak bo'lsa, shard key'ni asosiy access pattern'dan tanla (ko'pincha tenant) — tranzaksiyalar bitta shard ichida qolsin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40344	<p>Read-write splitting (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Read-write splitting — yozish so'rovlari (<code>INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE</code>, tranzaksiyalar) primary'ga, o'qish (<code>SELECT</code>) asinxron read replica'larga yo'naltiriladi. O'qish yukini gorizontal taqsimlaydi, lekin replica'dan eski ma'lumot o'qish xavfi bor.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova trafigining 90% o'qish (katalog, dashboard), primary CPU 85% — yozishlar ham sekinlashadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>App<br> | write / tx  ----------&gt; Primary --WAL stream--&gt; Replica 1<br> | read (stale OK) ------------------------------&gt; Replica 2<br> | read-your-writes kerak -&gt; Primary<br>Routing: ilova (2 ta DSN), proxy (ProxySQL, Pgpool), driver (target_session_attrs)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>type DB struct{ rw, ro *pgxpool.Pool }<br><br>func (d *DB) GetOrder(ctx context.Context, id int64, fresh bool) (Order, error) {<br>    pool := d.ro<br>    if fresh { pool = d.rw }   // foydalanuvchi hozirgina yozgan bo'lsa<br>    var o Order<br>    err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, status FROM orders WHERE id=$1`, id).Scan(&amp;o.ID, &amp;o.Status)<br>    return o, err<br>}</pre><pre># libpq: faqat standby'ga ulanish<br>psql &quot;host=db1,db2 dbname=orders target_session_attrs=prefer-standby&quot;</pre><p>AWS Aurora: alohida reader endpoint (<code>cluster-ro-...</code>).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Read-after-write: foydalanuvchi profilini yangiladi, sahifa replica'dan eski qiymatni ko'rsatadi. Yechim: yozgandan keyin N soniya primary, yoki LSN asosida kutish.</li><li>Tranzaksiya ichidagi <code>SELECT</code> replica'ga ketsa — izchillik buziladi.</li><li>Replica tushsa, barcha o'qish primary'ga ag'dariladi — primary sig'imini hisobga ol.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Avval tekshir: muammo haqiqatan o'qish yukidami? Ko'pincha cache yoki indeks arzonroq yechim. Splitting'ni har so'rov uchun &quot;stale qabul qilinadimi&quot; degan aniq qaror bilan qil — default primary, ruxsat berilganlari replica.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40345	<p>Replication lag nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Replication lag — primary'da commit qilingan o'zgarish asinxron replica'da qo'llanishigacha bo'lgan kechikish (vaqt yoki bayt/LSN). Bu davrda replica'dan o'qilgan ma'lumot eski bo'ladi; failover bo'lsa lag ichidagi commit'lar yo'qolishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Foydalanuvchi to'lov qildi, &quot;Mening buyurtmalarim&quot; sahifasi replica'dan o'qiydi va buyurtmani ko'rsatmaydi — u qayta to'laydi. Yoki primary yiqildi, replica 30 s orqada edi — 30 s ma'lumot yo'qoldi (RPO).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Primary: commit LSN 0/5000<br>   | WAL send (tarmoq)       -&gt; write_lag<br>Replica: diskka yozildi      -&gt; flush_lag<br>   | apply (bitta jarayon)   -&gt; replay_lag<br>Replica LSN 0/4A00 --&gt; lag<br>Sabablar: katta tranzaksiya, sekin disk, tarmoq, replica'dagi<br>uzun so'rov (hot_standby_feedback / conflict), replica CPU</pre><p><b>Amalda (PostgreSQL):</b></p><pre>-- Primary'da<br>SELECT application_name, state, write_lag, flush_lag, replay_lag,<br>       pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), replay_lsn) AS bytes_lag<br>FROM pg_stat_replication;<br>-- Replica'da<br>SELECT now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() AS lag;</pre><p>Prometheus (postgres_exporter): <code>pg_replication_lag_seconds &gt; 10</code> uchun alert.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()</code> primary'da yozuv bo'lmasa ham o'sadi — bo'sh tizimda yolg'on alert.</li><li>Katta <code>UPDATE</code> (millionlab qator) yoki <code>CREATE INDEX</code> — to'satdan katta lag.</li><li>Synchronous replication lag'ni yo'qotadi, lekin har commit'ga RTT qo'shadi va replica tushsa yozish to'xtaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Lag'ni nolga tushirib bo'lmaydi — dizaynni unga moslashtir: read-your-writes uchun primary, failover uchun RPO talabiga qarab sync/quorum replication (<code>synchronous_standby_names = 'ANY 1 (r1, r2)'</code>). Lag — SLI sifatida monitoring qilinishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40346	<p>Mikroservislarda dual-write muammosi nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Dual-write muammosi — servis bitta biznes amalda ikki xil tizimga (masalan DB va Kafka) alohida yozadi; ular orasida umumiy tranzaksiya yo'q, shuning uchun biri muvaffaqiyatli, ikkinchisi muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa tizimlar nomuvofiq qoladi. Yechim: Transactional Outbox yoki CDC.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b></p><pre>tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO orders ...`)   // 1. DB<br>tx.Commit()<br>producer.Send(&quot;order.created&quot;, ev)  // 2. Kafka  &lt;- shu yerda crash?</pre><ul><li>DB commit bo'ldi, Kafka'ga yuborilmadi -&gt; to'lov/ombor servisi buyurtmani hech qachon ko'rmaydi.</li><li>Teskari tartib: Kafka'ga yuborildi, DB commit yiqildi -&gt; boshqalar mavjud bo'lmagan buyurtmani qayta ishlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (xato holatlar):</b></p><pre>DB ok  + MQ ok   -&gt; to'g'ri<br>DB ok  + MQ fail -&gt; event yo'qoldi<br>DB fail + MQ ok  -&gt; &quot;arvoh&quot; event<br>retry              -&gt; dublikat event<br>2PC/XA - Kafka qo'llamaydi, sekin, koordinator SPOF</pre><p><b>Amalda — to'g'ri yondashuv:</b></p><pre>BEGIN;<br>INSERT INTO orders (id, ...) VALUES (...);<br>INSERT INTO outbox (id, aggregate_id, type, payload)<br>  VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 42, 'order.created', '{...}');<br>COMMIT;   -- ikkalasi atomik</pre><p>Keyin relay (Debezium yoki poller) outbox'dan Kafka'ga publish qiladi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Retry qo'shsak bo'ldi&quot; deb o'ylash — process crash'da retry ham yo'qoladi.</li><li>Outbox at-least-once beradi — consumer'lar idempotent bo'lishi shart.</li><li>Kodda yashirin dual-write: DB + Redis cache, DB + Elasticsearch ham xuddi shu muammo.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Code review'da &quot;bitta handler'da ikki tizimga yozish&quot;ni qizil bayroq deb qara. Asosiy prinsip: bitta manba haqiqati (DB), qolgan tizimlar unga asinxron, idempotent tarzda ergashadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40347	<p>Transactional Outbox (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Transactional Outbox — event biznes ma'lumot bilan <b>bitta lokal ACID tranzaksiyada</b> <code>outbox</code> jadvaliga yoziladi. Alohida relay jarayoni (Debezium CDC yoki poller) outbox'ni o'qib event'ni broker'ga (Kafka) publish qiladi. Natija: DB va event izchil, at-least-once yetkazib berish.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dual-write: DB va Kafka'ga alohida yozish crash paytida event yo'qolishi yoki arvoh event'ga olib keladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Servis --tx--&gt; [orders] + [outbox]   (bitta COMMIT)<br>                     |<br>      +--------------+--------------+<br>      | CDC: Debezium WAL o'qiydi   | Polling: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE<br>      v                             v   SKIP LOCKED, published_at<br>    Kafka topic (key = aggregate_id -&gt; tartib saqlanadi)<br>      |<br>   Consumer (idempotent: event_id bo'yicha dedup)</pre><p><b>Amalda (polling relay):</b></p><pre>CREATE TABLE outbox (<br>  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, aggregate_id text NOT NULL,<br>  type text NOT NULL, payload jsonb NOT NULL,<br>  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), published_at timestamptz);<br><br>-- relay har 200 ms<br>WITH batch AS (<br>  SELECT id FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL<br>  ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)<br>UPDATE outbox o SET published_at = now()<br>FROM batch WHERE o.id = batch.id<br>RETURNING o.*;   -- Kafka'ga yubor, keyin COMMIT</pre><p>Debezium'da <code>io.debezium.transforms.outbox.EventRouter</code> SMT outbox qatorlarini topic'larga yo'naltiradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Publish va <code>published_at</code> belgilash orasida crash -&gt; qayta yuboriladi (dublikat). Consumer <code>event_id</code> bo'yicha dedup qilishi shart.</li><li>Outbox jadvali cheksiz o'sadi — tozalash job'i yoki partition.</li><li>Bir nechta relay instance'i tartibni buzadi — <code>SKIP LOCKED</code> + aggregate bo'yicha key, yoki bitta leader.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CDC (Debezium) ilova kodiga polling yuk qo'shmaydi va latency past, lekin Kafka Connect infratuzilmasini talab qiladi; polling sodda va kichik hajmda yetarli. Ikkalasida ham kafolat &quot;kamida bir marta&quot; — exactly-once'ni consumer idempotency'si beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40348	<p>Saga pattern (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Saga — bir nechta servis bo'ylab biznes tranzaksiyani lokal tranzaksiyalar ketma-ketligi sifatida bajarish; biror qadam yiqilsa, oldingi qadamlar <b>compensating</b> amallar bilan bekor qilinadi (rollback emas, teskari biznes amal). Ikki usul: <b>choreography</b> (event'lar orqali) va <b>orchestration</b> (markaziy koordinator).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Buyurtma: to'lovni yech -&gt; omborda band qil -&gt; yetkazishni rejalash. Har biri alohida servis va DB; 2PC mikroservislarda amaliy emas (lock'lar, koordinator nosozligi).</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (orchestration):</b></p><pre>Orchestrator (state saqlaydi)<br> 1. Payment.charge      ok<br> 2. Inventory.reserve   ok<br> 3. Shipping.schedule   FAIL<br>    -&gt; kompensatsiya teskari tartibda:<br> 2'. Inventory.release<br> 1'. Payment.refund<br> holat: ORDER_CANCELLED</pre><p>Choreography: <code>OrderCreated</code> -&gt; Payment <code>PaymentCharged</code> chiqaradi -&gt; Inventory tinglaydi ... — markaz yo'q, lekin oqimni kuzatish qiyin.</p><p><b>Amalda:</b> Orchestration uchun Temporal, AWS Step Functions, Camunda:</p><pre>func OrderSaga(ctx workflow.Context, o Order) error {<br>    var comp []func()<br>    defer func() { /* xatoda comp'larni teskari tartibda chaqir */ }()<br>    if err := workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Charge, o).Get(ctx, nil); err != nil { return err }<br>    comp = append(comp, func() { workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Refund, o) })<br>    if err := workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Reserve, o).Get(ctx, nil); err != nil { return err }<br>    comp = append(comp, func() { workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Release, o) })<br>    return workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Schedule, o).Get(ctx, nil)<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Izolyatsiya yo'q: oraliq holatlar boshqalarga ko'rinadi (to'lov yechildi, lekin buyurtma hali bekor). Semantic lock (<code>PENDING</code> status) ishlat.</li><li>Kompensatsiya ham yiqilishi mumkin — retry va idempotency shart; ba'zi amallar qaytarilmaydi (email yuborildi).</li><li>Choreography'da sikl va &quot;kim nima qiladi&quot; yo'qolishi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 3+ qadam va murakkab xato yo'llari bo'lsa orchestration (Temporal) ni tanla — holat ko'rinadi va test qilinadi. Avval savol ber: bu servis chegaralari to'g'rimi? Ko'p saga — ko'pincha noto'g'ri bo'lingan domen belgisi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40349	<p>Event sourcing (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Event sourcing — entity'ning joriy holatini ustidan yozish o'rniga, uning barcha o'zgarishlarini o'zgarmas (immutable) event'lar ketma-ketligi sifatida append-only saqlash. Joriy holat event'larni qayta o'ynab (fold) hisoblanadi. To'liq tarix, audit va vaqtda orqaga qaytish imkoni beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> <code>UPDATE accounts SET balance = 70</code> — nega 70 bo'ldi, oldin nima edi, kim o'zgartirdi — ma'lumot yo'qolgan. Bank, ledger, compliance talab qiladigan domenlarda bu qabul qilinmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Event store (stream: account-42)<br> v1 AccountOpened   {owner: &quot;Ali&quot;}<br> v2 MoneyDeposited  {amount: 100}<br> v3 MoneyWithdrawn  {amount: 30}<br>      |<br>  fold -&gt; balance = 70 (joriy holat)<br>      |<br>  projection'lar -&gt; read model'lar (CQRS)<br>Snapshot: har 100 event'da holat saqlanadi -&gt; tez yuklash<br>Concurrency: append expectedVersion=3 (optimistic lock)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>func (a *Account) Apply(e Event) {<br>    switch ev := e.(type) {<br>    case MoneyDeposited: a.Balance += ev.Amount<br>    case MoneyWithdrawn: a.Balance -= ev.Amount<br>    }<br>    a.Version++<br>}<br>// store.Append(ctx, &quot;account-42&quot;, expectedVersion=3, MoneyWithdrawn{30})<br>// boshqa yozuvchi oldin yozgan bo'lsa -&gt; ErrConcurrency, qayta urin</pre><p>Tool'lar: EventStoreDB (KurrentDB), Axon, Marten (Postgres), yoki Postgres jadvali <code>(stream_id, version) UNIQUE</code>.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Event sxemasi evolyutsiyasi: eski event'lar abadiy — upcasting/versiyalash kerak.</li><li>GDPR &quot;o'chirish huquqi&quot; va immutable log — crypto-shredding (shaxsiy ma'lumotni alohida kalit bilan shifrlab, kalitni o'chirish).</li><li>Har CRUD tizimga qo'llash — murakkablik qiymatdan oshadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Event sourcing'ni butun tizimga emas, tarix biznes qiymatiga ega bo'lgan bounded context'ga (ledger, buyurtma lifecycle) qo'lla. Event'lar — domen faktlari (&quot;MoneyWithdrawn&quot;), CRUD o'zgarishlari (&quot;BalanceUpdated&quot;) emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40350	<p>CQRS (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) — yozish (command) va o'qish (query) uchun alohida modellar, ko'pincha alohida saqlash joylari. Write model biznes qoidalari va izchillikka optimallashadi, read model'lar esa aniq so'rovlarga (denormalizatsiya, qidiruv) — ular event'lar orqali asinxron yangilanadi, ya'ni eventual consistent.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bitta normalizatsiyalangan model: yozish uchun qulay, lekin dashboard so'rovi 8 ta JOIN va 3 soniya. Indeks qo'shsang yozish sekinlashadi. Bitta model ikki qarama-qarshi talabni bajara olmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Command (PlaceOrder) --&gt; Write model (Postgres, invariantlar)<br>                              | event / CDC<br>                              v<br>                    Projector(lar)<br>                     |         |           |<br>               Elasticsearch  Redis    ClickHouse<br>               (qidiruv)    (karta)   (analitika)<br>Query --&gt; read model (tez, denormalizatsiyalangan)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>// Command tomoni<br>func (s *Svc) PlaceOrder(ctx context.Context, c PlaceOrder) error {<br>    return s.tx(ctx, func(tx pgx.Tx) error {<br>        // invariantlarni tekshir, orders + outbox'ga yoz<br>    })<br>}<br>// Projector: order.placed event'ini o'qib read jadvalni yangilaydi<br>// UPSERT INTO order_summary (...) ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO UPDATE ... WHERE version &lt; EXCLUDED.version</pre><p>Read model'ni noldan qayta qurish mumkin bo'lishi kerak (event'larni qayta o'ynash).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Eventual consistency UX'ga ta'sir qiladi: foydalanuvchi buyurtma qildi, ro'yxatda hali yo'q. Optimistic UI yoki command javobida natijani qaytar.</li><li>Projector'lar idempotent bo'lmasa dublikat event read model'ni buzadi.</li><li>Oddiy CRUD'ga CQRS — keraksiz murakkablik.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CQRS event sourcing'ni talab qilmaydi — eng yengil shakli bitta DB'da alohida query modellar yoki materialized view. Murakkablikni o'qish va yozish yuklari yoki modellari haqiqatan ajralganda qo'sh; projection lag'ini metrika sifatida kuzat.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40351	<p>Anycast IP nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Anycast — bitta IP manzilni dunyoning turli joylaridagi ko'p server BGP orqali bir vaqtda e'lon qiladi; internet routing'i paketni topologik jihatdan eng yaqin (eng qisqa BGP yo'l) nuqtaga olib boradi. Ishlatilishi: DNS root serverlar, 1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8, CDN edge, AWS Global Accelerator, Cloudflare.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Unicast IP bitta joyda: Toshkentdagi foydalanuvchi AQShdagi serverga 200 ms. DNS asosida geo-yo'naltirish TTL va resolver joylashuviga bog'liq, sekin o'zgaradi. DDoS bitta nuqtaga yig'iladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>             203.0.113.10 (bir xil IP)<br>   PoP Frankfurt    PoP Singapur    PoP Virginia<br>        \                |               /<br>          BGP e'lon: &quot;203.0.113.0/24 men orqali&quot;<br>User (Toshkent) --&gt; ISP routing --&gt; eng yaqin: Frankfurt<br>PoP yiqilsa -&gt; e'lonni qaytarib oladi -&gt; trafik keyingisiga<br>DDoS -&gt; butun dunyo PoP'lariga tarqaladi (yutiladi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>traceroute 1.1.1.1          # turli shaharlardan turli yo'l<br>dig +short CHAOS TXT id.server @1.1.1.1    # qaysi PoP javob berdi<br>curl -s https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace | grep colo   # colo=FRA<br>aws globalaccelerator list-accelerators   # 2 ta statik anycast IP</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Eng yaqin&quot; = BGP bo'yicha, geografik emas: ISP peering sababli uzoq PoP'ga tushish mumkin.</li><li>TCP uchun: route o'zgarsa uzun ulanish boshqa PoP'ga tushib uziladi — shuning uchun anycast ko'pincha UDP (DNS) va qisqa HTTP uchun; stateful bo'lsa connection tracking kerak.</li><li>O'z anycast'ingni qilish uchun o'z ASN va /24 prefiks kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Anycast tarmoq darajasida failover va DDoS yutishni beradi — DNS failover'dan tezroq (TTL kutilmaydi). Global Accelerator yoki CDN orqali uni o'z IP blokisiz ham olish mumkin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40352	<p>CDN nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CDN (Content Delivery Network) — dunyo bo'ylab tarqalgan edge serverlar tarmog'i: kontentni (statik fayl, rasm, video, ba'zan API javoblari) foydalanuvchiga yaqin joyda cache'laydi. Natija: past latency, origin'ga yuk kamayadi, trafik sakrashlari va DDoS yutiladi. Misollar: CloudFront, Cloudflare, Fastly, Akamai.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Origin Frankfurtda, Osiyo foydalanuvchisi 2 MB JS'ni 300 ms RTT bilan yuklaydi; aksiya kuni trafik 50x — origin yiqiladi; egress xarajati katta.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>User --&gt; DNS/anycast --&gt; Edge PoP (yaqin)<br>                          | cache HIT -&gt; darhol javob<br>                          | MISS<br>                          v<br>                    (Origin Shield / regional cache)<br>                          |<br>                       Origin (S3 / ALB)<br>Cache kaliti: host + path (+ tanlangan query/header/cookie)<br>TTL: Cache-Control: max-age, s-maxage</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Origin javobi: hash'langan statik fayl<br>Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable<br># HTML: CDN qisqa, brauzer har safar tekshiradi<br>Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=60, max-age=0, stale-while-revalidate=30</pre><pre>curl -sI https://cdn.acme.io/app.3f9a.js | grep -iE 'x-cache|age|cache-control'<br># x-cache: Hit from cloudfront   age: 3540<br>aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E123 --paths &quot;/index.html&quot;</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Cache kaliti'ga keraksiz cookie/header kirsa hit ratio 0% ga tushadi.</li><li>Shaxsiy javobni (<code>Set-Cookie</code>, user ma'lumoti) cache'lash — boshqa foydalanuvchiga sizib chiqadi. <code>private</code> / <code>no-store</code>.</li><li>Invalidation'ga tayanish — sekin va pullik; fayl nomida versiya/hash ishlat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Asosiy metrika — cache hit ratio (bayt va so'rov bo'yicha) va origin'ga tushayotgan yuk. Origin Shield qo'shish ko'p PoP'dan bir vaqtdagi MISS'larni (thundering herd) bitta so'rovga yig'adi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40353	<p>HoL blocking (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Head-of-Line (HoL) blocking — navbatdagi birinchi element kechiksa, uning orqasidagilar tayyor bo'lsa ham kutib qoladi. HTTP/1.1'da bitta ulanishda javoblar ketma-ket; HTTP/2 buni ilova darajasida hal qildi, lekin TCP darajasida qoldi — bitta yo'qolgan paket barcha stream'larni to'xtatadi. HTTP/3 (QUIC, UDP ustida) stream'larni transport darajasida mustaqil qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Mobil tarmoqda 2% paket yo'qolishi: HTTP/2 da bitta TCP ulanish orqali 50 ta resurs — bitta paket yo'qolsa hammasi retransmit'ni kutadi, sahifa &quot;qotadi&quot;.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>HTTP/1.1: req1 -&gt; resp1 (sekin) | req2 kutadi  (ilova HoL)<br>           brauzer 6 ta ulanish ochib aylanib o'tadi<br><br>HTTP/2 (TCP):  stream A [1][2][X][4]   X yo'qoldi<br>               stream B [1][2][3]      &lt;- B ham kutadi (TCP tartib)<br><br>HTTP/3 (QUIC): stream A [1][2][X][4]   faqat A kutadi<br>               stream B [1][2][3] -&gt; darhol ilovaga</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -sI --http3 https://cloudflare.com | head -1     # HTTP/3 200<br>curl -sI https://example.com | grep -i alt-svc        # alt-svc: h3=&quot;:443&quot;</pre><pre># nginx 1.25+<br>listen 443 quic reuseport;<br>listen 443 ssl;<br>http2 on;<br>add_header Alt-Svc 'h3=&quot;:443&quot;; ma=86400';</pre><p>Navbat tizimlarida ham HoL bor: Kafka partition'da bitta &quot;zaharli&quot; xabar butun partition'ni to'xtatadi (DLQ yechimi).</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Korporativ firewall UDP/443 ni bloklaydi — HTTP/3 fallback ishlashi shart.</li><li>HTTP/2 da ham server tomonda sekin javob boshqalarni bloklamaydi, lekin TCP darajasidagi HoL qoladi — bularni chalkashtirma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HTTP/3 eng ko'p yutuqni yuqori yo'qotishli va yuqori RTT tarmoqlarda (mobil) beradi; data center ichida farq kichik. Umumiy saboq: mustaqil ish birliklarini bitta tartibli navbatga qo'yma.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40354	<p>AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute (GCP'da Cloud Interconnect) — on-prem data center bilan cloud provayder o'rtasidagi <b>maxsus xususiy fizik ulanish</b> (1/10/100 Gbps), public internetni chetlab o'tadi. Barqaror latency, yuqori o'tkazuvchanlik, arzonroq egress beradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Bank o'z data center'idan cloud'ga kuniga 20 TB ma'lumot replikatsiya qiladi.
