Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40355	<p>AWS Transit Gateway (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) — regional hub-and-spoke router: yuzlab VPC, Site-to-Site VPN va Direct Connect'ni bitta markaziy nuqta orqali ulaydi. Route table'lar orqali kim kim bilan gaplashishini (segmentatsiya) boshqaradi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> 30 ta VPC'ni VPC peering bilan to'liq ulash = 30*29/2 = 435 peering; peering tranzitiv emas, route'lar har joyda qo'lda. Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40356	<p>PrivateLink (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS PrivateLink — VPC ichida ENI (Interface VPC Endpoint) yaratib, AWS servislariga (SQS, KMS, ECR) yoki boshqa akkaunt/SaaS servislariga public internetsiz, AWS backbone orqali xususiy IP bilan ulanish. Multi-tenant SaaS va akkauntlar orasida minimal ekspozitsiya uchun PrivateLink to'g'ri tanlov; S3/DynamoDB uchun har doim bepul gateway endpoint qo'y — NAT xarajatini sezilarli kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40357	<p>Multi-region active-active (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Multi-region active-active — ilova bir vaqtda ikki yoki undan ko'p region'da to'liq ishlaydi va trafikni qabul qiladi; foydalanuvchi eng yaqin/sog'lom region'ga yo'naltiriladi, ma'lumot region'lar orasida replikatsiya qilinadi. Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40358	<p>DR failover routing nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> DR failover routing — primary endpoint'ning health check'i yiqilganda trafikni avtomatik zaxira region/endpoint'ga yo'naltirish. Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40363	<p>API Gateway nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> API Gateway — client'lar va backend servislar orasidagi application-layer (L7) reverse proxy: yagona kirish nuqtasi bo'lib, routing, autentifikatsiya (JWT/OAuth), rate limiting, request validatsiya, TLS, CORS, log/metrika va ba'zan javob transformatsiyasini markazlashtiradi. Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40364	<p>gRPC va REST farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> REST — resurslar va HTTP metodlari asosidagi arxitektura uslubi, odatda HTTP/1.1 yoki HTTP/2 ustida JSON. gRPC — Google'ning RPC framework'i: HTTP/2 ustida binary Protobuf, <code>.proto</code> fayldagi qat'iy contract'dan kod generatsiyasi, multiplexing va 4 xil streaming (unary, server, client, bidirectional). gRPC ichki servislararo aloqada tez; REST ommaviy API va brauzer uchun qulay.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ichki servislar sekundiga 50k so'rov almashadi: JSON parse CPU'ni yeydi, contract faqat hujjatda, versiyalar mos kelmay runtime xatolar chiqadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>REST:  GET /orders/42  Accept: application/json<br>       &lt;- 200 {&quot;id&quot;:42,&quot;status&quot;:&quot;paid&quot;}      (matn, o'qiladi)<br><br>gRPC:  orders.v1.OrderService/GetOrder  (HTTP/2 POST)<br>       &lt;- protobuf binary (kichik, tez parse)<br>       .proto -&gt; protoc -&gt; Go/Java/Python client+server stub</pre><p>| | REST | gRPC | |---|---|---| | Format | JSON (matn) | Protobuf (binary) | | Contract | OpenAPI (ixtiyoriy) | .proto (majburiy) | | Streaming | SSE/WebSocket alohida | nativ, ikki tomonlama | | Brauzer | to'liq | gRPC-Web/Connect proxy kerak | | Debug | curl | grpcurl | | Cache | HTTP cache | yo'q |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>syntax = &quot;proto3&quot;;<br>package orders.v1;<br>service OrderService { rpc GetOrder(GetOrderRequest) returns (Order); }<br>message GetOrderRequest { int64 id = 1; }<br>message Order { int64 id = 1; string status = 2; }</pre><pre>grpcurl -plaintext localhost:9090 list<br>grpcurl -plaintext -d '{&quot;id&quot;:42}' localhost:9090 orders.v1.OrderService/GetOrder</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>gRPC HTTP/2 uzun ulanishlari L4 load balancer'da bitta pod'ga yopishib qoladi — L7 LB (Envoy, mesh) yoki client-side balancing kerak.</li><li>Protobuf maydon raqamini qayta ishlatish yoki o'zgartirish — backward compatibility buziladi (<code>reserved</code> ishlat, <code>buf breaking</code> bilan CI'da tekshir).</li><li>Deadline qo'ymaslik — gRPC'da default timeout yo'q.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p tashkilotlar gibrid: tashqarida REST/JSON, ichkarida gRPC. Connect protokoli bir server'dan gRPC, gRPC-Web va JSON-over-HTTP berib, bu tanlovni yumshatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40365	<p>GraphQL va REST farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> REST'da server qat'iy endpoint'lar va javob shakllarini belgilaydi; GraphQL'da bitta endpoint va tiplangan schema bor, client aynan qaysi maydonlar kerakligini so'rovda o'zi tanlaydi — over-fetching (ortiqcha ma'lumot) va under-fetching (ko'p so'rov) yo'qoladi. Federation (Apollo) ko'p jamoali katta schema uchun.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40366	<p>Webhook payload'ini HMAC-SHA256 bilan tekshirish nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Webhook HMAC tekshiruvi — jo'natuvchi (masalan Stripe, GitHub) request body'dan umumiy secret bilan HMAC-SHA256 hisoblab header'ga qo'yadi; qabul qiluvchi xuddi shu xom body'dan qayta hisoblab, <b>constant-time</b> solishtiradi. Bu so'rov haqiqiy jo'natuvchidan va o'zgartirilmaganini isbotlaydi; timestamp esa replay hujumdan himoya qiladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Webhook endpoint ommaviy URL. Hujumchi <code>POST /webhooks/payment {&quot;status&quot;:&quot;paid&quot;}</code> yuborib, to'lanmagan buyurtmani &quot;to'langan&quot; qilishi mumkin.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Jo'natuvchi:<br>  sig = HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + &quot;.&quot; + raw_body)<br>  header: X-Signature: t=1696300000,v1=5f2b...<br>Qabul qiluvchi:<br>  1. timestamp |now - t| &lt; 5 min?   (replay)<br>  2. expected = HMAC(secret, t + &quot;.&quot; + raw_body)<br>  3. constant_time_equal(expected, v1)?<br>  4. event_id avval ko'rilganmi? (idempotency)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>func verify(r *http.Request, secret []byte) ([]byte, error) {<br>    body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 1&lt;&lt;20))  // XOM body<br>    if err != nil { return nil, err }<br>    t, sig := parseHeader(r.Header.Get(&quot;X-Signature&quot;))<br>    ts, _ := strconv.ParseInt(t, 10, 64)<br>    if d := time.Since(time.Unix(ts, 0)); d &gt; 5*time.Minute || d &lt; -5*time.Minute {<br>        return nil, errors.New(&quot;eskirgan timestamp&quot;)<br>    }<br>    mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, secret)<br>    mac.Write([]byte(t + &quot;.&quot;))<br>    mac.Write(body)<br>    want := mac.Sum(nil)<br>    got, err := hex.DecodeString(sig)<br>    if err != nil || !hmac.Equal(want, got) { return nil, errors.New(&quot;imzo noto'g'ri&quot;) }<br>    return body, nil<br>}</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>JSON'ni parse qilib qayta serialize qilgandan keyin HMAC hisoblash — bo'shliq/tartib o'zgaradi, imzo mos kelmaydi. Doim xom bayt.</li><li><code>==</code> yoki <code>bytes.Equal</code> bilan solishtirish — timing attack; <code>hmac.Equal</code> ishlat.</li><li>Secret rotatsiyasi: o'tish davrida ikki secret'ni ham qabul qil.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Imzo tekshiruvidan keyin ham webhook'ni &quot;trigger&quot; deb qabul qil: kritik amallarda provayder API'sidan holatni qayta so'ra va event_id bo'yicha idempotent qayta ishla — webhook'lar takrorlanadi va tartibsiz keladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40367	<p>JWT tuzilishi qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> JWT (JSON Web Token) — nuqta bilan ajratilgan uch base64url qism: <code>header.payload.signature</code>. <b>Header</b> — algoritm (<code>alg</code>, <code>kid</code>), <b>Payload</b> — claim'lar (<code>sub</code>, <code>iss</code>, <code>aud</code>, <code>exp</code>, <code>iat</code>, rollar), <b>Signature</b> — header+payload ustidan imzo (HS256 umumiy secret yoki RS256/ES256 asimmetrik kalit). Payload shifrlanmagan — har kim o'qiy oladi, faqat o'zgartira olmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Har so'rovda session'ni markaziy DB'dan tekshirish mikroservislarda bottleneck. JWT o'zida ma'lumot va imzo saqlaydi — servis uni lokal tekshiradi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImsxIn0 . eyJzdWIiOiI0MiIsImV4cCI6MTcwMH0 . SflKx...<br>   header {alg:RS256,kid:k1}            payload {sub:42,exp:1700...}     imzo<br>Tekshirish:<br> 1. kid -&gt; JWKS'dan public key (cache)<br> 2. alg kutilganmi (whitelist)?<br> 3. imzo to'g'rimi?<br> 4. exp/nbf, iss, aud tekshir</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>echo &quot;$TOKEN&quot; | cut -d. -f2 | tr '_-' '/+' | base64 -d 2&gt;/dev/null | jq<br># {&quot;sub&quot;:&quot;42&quot;,&quot;iss&quot;:&quot;https://auth.acme.io&quot;,&quot;aud&quot;:&quot;orders&quot;,&quot;exp&quot;:1700003600}</pre><pre>tok, err := jwt.Parse(raw, keyfunc.Keyfunc, // JWKS'dan<br>    jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{&quot;RS256&quot;}),<br>    jwt.WithIssuer(&quot;https://auth.acme.io&quot;),<br>    jwt.WithAudience(&quot;orders&quot;),<br>    jwt.WithExpirationRequired())</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>alg: none</code> yoki RS256 -&gt; HS256 almashtirish hujumi — algoritmni whitelist qil.</li><li>Payload'ga maxfiy ma'lumot (parol, PII) qo'yish — u ochiq.</li><li>Uzoq <code>exp</code> va revoke imkoni yo'q — o'g'irlangan token kunlab ishlaydi. Qisqa access token (5-15 min) + refresh token rotatsiyasi.</li><li><code>aud</code> tekshirilmasa, boshqa servis uchun berilgan token sening servisingda ham ishlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> JWT — stateless, shuning uchun revocation qiyin; bu trade-off'ni ongli tanla. Brauzerda token'ni <code>localStorage</code>ga emas, HttpOnly cookie'ga qo'yish XSS ta'sirini kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40368	<p>OAuth 2.0 va OpenID Connect farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> OAuth 2.0 — <b>avtorizatsiya</b> (delegatsiya) framework'i: foydalanuvchi parolini bermasdan, uchinchi tomon ilovasiga uning nomidan API'ga cheklangan kirish (access token, scope) beradi. OpenID Connect (OIDC) — OAuth 2.0 ustidagi <b>autentifikatsiya</b> qatlami: qo'shimcha ravishda <b>ID token</b> (JWT) beradi, unda &quot;foydalanuvchi kim&quot; (<code>sub</code>, <code>email</code>, <code>iss</code>, <code>aud</code>) aniq yozilgan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> OAuth access token'ni &quot;login&quot; uchun ishlatish xavfli: access token API uchun, kim uchun berilganini standart tarzda aytmaydi — token substitution hujumlari bo'lgan. OIDC bu bo'shliqni yopadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (Authorization Code + PKCE):</b></p><pre>App --&gt; /authorize?response_type=code&amp;scope=openid profile orders:read<br>          &amp;code_challenge=...   --&gt; IdP (login + MFA + consent)<br>App &lt;-- redirect ?code=abc<br>App --&gt; /token (code + code_verifier) --&gt;<br>App &lt;-- access_token (API uchun)<br>        id_token     (OIDC: kim kirdi - faqat app uchun)<br>        refresh_token<br>App --&gt; API: Authorization: Bearer access_token</pre><p>| | OAuth 2.0 | OIDC | |---|---|---| | Maqsad | ruxsat (nimaga kira oladi) | identity (kim) | | Token | access token | + ID token (JWT) | | Scope | ixtiyoriy | <code>openid</code> majburiy | | Qo'shimcha | - | <code>/userinfo</code>, discovery (<code>/.well-known/openid-configuration</code>) |</p><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>curl -s https://accounts.google.com/.well-known/openid-configuration | jq '.issuer,.jwks_uri'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Implicit flow va Resource Owner Password flow — deprecated (OAuth 2.1). SPA va mobil uchun ham Code + PKCE.</li><li>ID token'ni API'ga Bearer sifatida yuborish — uning <code>aud</code>i client, API emas.</li><li><code>state</code>/<code>nonce</code> tekshirmaslik — CSRF va replay.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> O'z OAuth server'ingni yozma — Keycloak, Auth0, Entra ID, Cognito kabi sinalgan IdP ishlat. Servislar uchun (user'siz) — Client Credentials flow yoki workload identity federation.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps

Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40370	<p>ABAC nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control) — kirish qarori subyekt (bo'lim, lavozim), resurs (tag, egasi, maxfiylik darajasi), amal va kontekst (vaqt, IP, qurilma) <b>atributlarini</b> policy bo'yicha real vaqtda baholab chiqariladi. Qo'lda skaner ishlatish va natijalarni yig'ish kunlar oladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Resurslar avtomatik topiladi<br>  EC2  --(SSM agent yoki EBS snapshot)--&gt; paketlar ro'yxati<br>  ECR  --(push paytida + uzluksiz)------&gt; image qatlamlari<br>  Lambda --(kod + layer)----------------&gt; dependency'lar<br>        |<br>  CVE bazasi bilan solishtirish (yangi CVE chiqsa qayta baholash)<br>        | + tarmoq yetib borish tahlili<br>  Finding: CVE-2024-xxxx, Inspector score 9.1, fix version<br>        |<br>  Security Hub / EventBridge</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws inspector2 enable --resource-types EC2 ECR LAMBDA<br>aws inspector2 list-findings --filter-criteria '{&quot;severity&quot;:[{&quot;comparison&quot;:&quot;EQUALS&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:&quot;CRITICAL&quot;}],&quot;findingStatus&quot;:[{&quot;comparison&quot;:&quot;EQUALS&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:&quot;ACTIVE&quot;}]}' \<br>  --query 'findings[].{t:title,r:resources[0].id}'<br>aws inspector2 list-coverage --query 'coveredResources[?scanStatus.statusCode!=`ACTIVE`]'</pre><p>CI uchun: <code>inspector-sbomgen</code> bilan SBOM yaratib <code>inspector-scan</code> API orqali deploy'dan oldin skanerlash.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>SSM agent ishlamayotgan instance'lar skanerlanmaydi — coverage'ni tekshir.</li><li>ECR'da faqat oxirgi push qilingan image'lar uzluksiz skanerlanadi (sozlama muddati) — prod'dagi eski image yo'qolib qolishi mumkin.</li><li>Topilma bor, lekin patch jarayoni yo'q — SSM Patch Manager yoki image'ni qayta build qilish pipeline'i kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Container dunyosida &quot;patch&quot; — instance'ni yangilash emas, image'ni qayta build qilib deploy qilish. Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40375	<p>AWS KMS (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> AWS KMS (Key Management Service) — shifrlash kalitlarini yaratish, saqlash, aylantirish (rotation) va ishlatishni boshqaradigan servis. Kalitlar FIPS 140-3 tasdiqlangan HSM'lardan hech qachon ochiq holda chiqmaydi; har ishlatilishi IAM/key policy bilan nazorat qilinadi va CloudTrail'ga yoziladi. S3, EBS, RDS, Secrets Manager kabi servislar KMS bilan integratsiyalashgan.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Ilova shifrlash kalitini config faylda yoki env'da saqlaydi — kalit kod bilan birga sizib chiqadi, kim ishlatganini bilib bo'lmaydi, rotatsiya qo'lda.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>KMS key (HSM ichida)<br>  | key policy + IAM: kim Encrypt/Decrypt qila oladi<br>  |<br>  +-- Encrypt/Decrypt (&lt;= 4 KB to'g'ridan-to'g'ri)<br>  +-- GenerateDataKey -&gt; {plaintext DEK, encrypted DEK}  (envelope)<br>  +-- Sign/Verify (asimmetrik), GenerateMac<br>Har chaqiruv -&gt; CloudTrail (kim, qaysi kalit, encryption context)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>aws kms create-key --description &quot;orders PII&quot; --key-usage ENCRYPT_DECRYPT<br>aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/orders-pii --target-key-id &lt;key-id&gt;<br>aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id &lt;key-id&gt;          # har yil avtomatik<br>aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/orders-pii --plaintext fileb://secret.txt \<br>  --encryption-context app=orders --query CiphertextBlob --output text<br>aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --encryption-context app=orders</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Key policy'da <code>&quot;Principal&quot;: {&quot;AWS&quot;: &quot;*&quot;}</code> yoki keng <code>kms:*</code> — kim xohlasa decrypt qiladi.</li><li>Kalitni o'chirish (schedule deletion, 7-30 kun) = u bilan shifrlangan barcha ma'lumot abadiy yo'qoladi. Avval disable qilib kuzat.</li><li>Har so'rovda KMS chaqirish — API kvotasi (throttling) va latency. AWS-managed key o'rniga customer-managed key — policy va cross-account nazorat sende bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40376	<p>Envelope encryption nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Envelope encryption — katta ma'lumot tasodifiy yaratilgan <b>Data Encryption Key (DEK)</b> bilan lokal shifrlanadi (masalan AES-256-GCM), DEK esa o'z navbatida KMS'dagi <b>Key Encryption Key (KEK/root key)</b> bilan shifrlanadi. Shifrlangan DEK ma'lumot yonida saqlanadi; ochiq DEK xotiradan darhol o'chiriladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> KMS to'g'ridan-to'g'ri faqat 4 KB gacha shifrlaydi va har chaqiruv tarmoq so'rovi. 10 GB faylni yoki millionlab qatorni KMS orqali shifrlab bo'lmaydi. Root key'ni KMS'dan chiqarish esa xavfli.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Shifrlash:<br> KMS.GenerateDataKey -&gt; plaintext DEK + encrypted DEK<br> AES-GCM(DEK, data)  -&gt; ciphertext<br> saqla: [encrypted DEK | nonce | ciphertext]; plaintext DEK ni o'chir<br>Ochish:<br> KMS.Decrypt(encrypted DEK) -&gt; DEK  (IAM tekshiruvi + audit)<br> AES-GCM-open(DEK, ciphertext) -&gt; data<br>Root key rotatsiyasi -&gt; ma'lumotni qayta shifrlash shart emas</pre><p><b>Amalda (Go):</b></p><pre>out, _ := kmsClient.GenerateDataKey(ctx, &amp;kms.GenerateDataKeyInput{<br>    KeyId: aws.String(&quot;alias/orders-pii&quot;), KeySpec: types.DataKeySpecAes256,<br>    EncryptionContext: map[string]string{&quot;tenant&quot;: &quot;42&quot;}})<br>block, _ := aes.NewCipher(out.Plaintext)<br>gcm, _ := cipher.NewGCM(block)<br>nonce := make([]byte, gcm.NonceSize()); rand.Read(nonce)<br>ct := gcm.Seal(nil, nonce, data, nil)<br>store(out.CiphertextBlob, nonce, ct)<br>clear(out.Plaintext)    // Go 1.21+</pre><p>S3 SSE-KMS, EBS, RDS aynan shu mexanizmni ishlatadi; AWS Encryption SDK uni tayyor beradi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Bitta DEK'ni millionlab obyekt uchun abadiy ishlatish — kompromat ta'siri katta; GCM'da bitta kalit bilan nonce takrorlanishi xavfi.</li><li>Plaintext DEK'ni log'ga yoki diskka yozish.</li><li>Har obyekt uchun yangi DEK va KMS chaqiruvi — kvota/narx; data key caching bilan muvozanatla.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Envelope encryption crypto-shredding'ni ham beradi: tenant DEK'ini (yoki KEK'ini) o'chirsang, uning ma'lumoti backup'larda ham o'qilmaydigan bo'ladi — GDPR &quot;o'chirish huquqi&quot; uchun amaliy yechim.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps

Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40382	<p>PromQL nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PromQL — Prometheus'ning read-only funksional so'rov tili: time series'larni label bo'yicha tanlash, <code>rate()</code>/<code>increase()</code> bilan counter'larni tezlikka aylantirish, <code>sum by</code>/<code>avg by</code> bilan agregatsiya, <code>histogram_quantile()</code> bilan percentil va matematik amallar. Dashboard (Grafana) va alert qoidalari shu tilda yoziladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Metrikalar bor, lekin &quot;oxirgi 5 daqiqada servis bo'yicha 5xx ulushi qancha?&quot; yoki &quot;p99 latency&quot; kabi savollarga javob olish uchun xom raqamlarni to'g'ri birlashtirish kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>http_requests_total{job=&quot;api&quot;, code=&quot;500&quot;, path=&quot;/orders&quot;}   &lt;- series (counter)<br>   |  selector -&gt; instant vector<br>   |  [5m]     -&gt; range vector<br>   |  rate()   -&gt; sekundiga tezlik (counter reset'larni hisobga oladi)<br>   |  sum by (job)<br>   v<br> natija: har job uchun bitta qiymat</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># RPS servis bo'yicha<br>sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br><br># Xato ulushi (%)<br>100 * sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total{code=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>    / sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br><br># p99 latency (histogram)<br>histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, job) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))<br><br># Disk 4 soatda to'ladimi?<br>predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint=&quot;/&quot;}[6h], 4*3600) &lt; 0</pre><pre>curl -s 'http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query' --data-urlencode 'query=up == 0' | jq '.data.result[].metric'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>rate()</code> ni gauge'ga qo'llash yoki counter'ni <code>rate</code>siz ishlatish — ma'nosiz grafik.</li><li>Avval <code>sum</code>, keyin <code>rate</code> (<code>rate(sum(...))</code>) — xato; doim <code>sum(rate(...))</code>.</li><li>Percentillarni o'rtachalash (<code>avg(histogram_quantile(...))</code>) — matematik noto'g'ri; avval bucket'larni yig'ib, keyin quantile.</li><li>High-cardinality label (user_id) — Prometheus xotirasi portlaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Og'ir so'rovlarni recording rule'larga chiqar (<code>job:http_errors:ratio_rate5m</code>) — dashboard tez, alert'lar izchil. SLO alert'larini multi-window burn rate bilan yoz, oddiy threshold bilan emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps

Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40390	<p>SCA (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> SCA (Software Composition Analysis) — ilova ishlatadigan uchinchi tomon ochiq kodli dependency'larni (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va tranzitiv) aniqlab, ularni ma'lum zaifliklar (CVE, GHSA, OSV bazalari) va litsenziya muammolariga tekshirish. Log4Shell kabi bitta kutubxonadagi zaiflik minglab ilovaga ta'sir qiladi; tranzitiv dependency'lar haqida jamoa bilmaydi ham.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>lock fayllar (go.sum, package-lock.json, poetry.lock) yoki image<br>      |<br> dependency grafi (tranzitivlar bilan) / SBOM<br>      |<br> CVE bazasi (NVD, GHSA, OSV) bilan solishtirish<br>      |<br> topilma: paket@versiya, CVE, severity, fix versiya<br>      + reachability (zaif funksiya chaqiriladimi?)<br>      |<br> PR: avtomatik yangilash (Dependabot/Renovate)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>govulncheck ./...            # Go: faqat chaqiriladigan zaif funksiyalarni ko'rsatadi<br>osv-scanner scan -r .<br>trivy fs --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 .<br>npm audit --omit=dev</pre><p>Chiqish (govulncheck):</p><pre>Vulnerability #1: GO-2024-2687<br>  HTTP/2 CONTINUATION flood in net/http<br>  Found in: golang.org/x/net@v0.20.0  Fixed in: v0.23.0<br>  Example traces found: main.go:30:22: server.ListenAndServe</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Minglab &quot;kritik&quot; topilma, ko'pi ilovada ishlatilmaydigan kod — reachability analysis (govulncheck) va VEX bilan prioritetla.</li><li>Avtomatik yangilash PR'lari testlarsiz merge qilinadi — regressiya xavfi; aksincha, hech kim merge qilmaydi va ular yig'iladi.</li><li>Zararli paketlar (typosquatting, kompromat maintainer) CVE bazasida yo'q — alohida himoya (pinning, ruxsat etilgan registry) kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> SCA — doimiy jarayon, bir martalik skan emas: yangi CVE eski koddagi zaiflikni ochadi. Renovate bilan kichik, tez-tez yangilanishlar (grouping, automerge patch) katta &quot;yillik upgrade&quot; og'riqlaridan ancha arzon.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40391	<p>Container escape nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container escape — container ichida kod ishga tushirgan hujumchi izolyatsiya chegarasini (namespace, cgroup, seccomp, capabilities) buzib, host OS ustidan nazorat olishi. Asosiy yo'llar: <code>privileged: true</code>, xavfli capability'lar (<code>CAP_SYS_ADMIN</code>), <code>hostPath</code> (<code>/</code>, <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code>), host namespace'lari (<code>hostPID</code>, <code>hostNetwork</code>), kernel zaifligi (Dirty Pipe), runtime zaifligi (runc CVE-2019-5736, CVE-2024-21626 &quot;Leaky Vessels&quot;).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Container — VM emas: barcha container'lar host bilan bitta kernel'ni bo'lishadi. Bitta escape = node'dagi boshqa pod'lar, ularning secret'lari va kubelet credential'lari.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi (misol yo'llar):</b></p><pre>1) docker.sock mount:<br>   container -&gt; /var/run/docker.sock -&gt; docker run -v /:/host --privileged -&gt; host root<br>2) privileged:<br>   barcha device'lar -&gt; mount /dev/sda1 /mnt -&gt; host fayl tizimi<br>3) hostPath /:<br>   chroot /host -&gt; host shell<br>4) kernel CVE:<br>   syscall -&gt; kernel exploit -&gt; namespace'dan chiqish</pre><p><b>Amalda (himoya):</b></p><pre>securityContext:<br>  runAsNonRoot: true<br>  runAsUser: 10001<br>  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false<br>  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true<br>  capabilities: { drop: [&quot;ALL&quot;] }<br>  seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }</pre><pre>kubectl label ns orders pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted<br># Xavfli pod'larni topish<br>kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.containers[]; .securityContext.privileged==true)) | .metadata.namespace+&quot;/&quot;+.metadata.name'</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Monitoring agent'lari va CI runner'lar (Docker-in-Docker) ko'pincha privileged — ularni alohida node pool'ga ajrat.</li><li>Root sifatida ishlash &quot;faqat container ichida&quot; deb o'ylash — escape'da host root'ga yaqin.</li><li>Kernel va runtime (containerd, runc) patch'larini kechiktirish.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Qatlamli himoya: PSA restricted + seccomp + non-root (oldini olish), Falco (aniqlash), user namespaces yoki gVisor/Kata (sandbox) ishonchsiz kod uchun. Hujumchi escape qilsa ham ta'sirni cheklash uchun node'da minimal credential va IMDSv2 hop limit 1.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40392	<p>Rootless Docker / Podman (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Rootless container'lar — container runtime daemon'i (Docker rootless) yoki butun stack (Podman, daemon'siz) oddiy imtiyozsiz foydalanuvchi sifatida ishlaydi; container ichidagi &quot;root&quot; (UID 0) user namespace orqali host'dagi imtiyozsiz UID'ga (masalan 100000) map qilinadi. Escape bo'lsa ham hujumchi host'da root emas, oddiy user bo'ladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Klassik Docker daemon root sifatida ishlaydi; <code>docker</code> guruhidagi har kim amalda host root (<code>docker run -v /:/host</code>). Container ichidagi root escape bo'lsa — host root.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Host: user ali (UID 1000)<br>  /etc/subuid: ali:100000:65536<br>  rootless runtime (ali sifatida)<br>     container ichida UID 0  --&gt;  host'da UID 100000 (imtiyozsiz)<br>     container ichida UID 1  --&gt;  host'da UID 100001<br>Tarmoq: slirp4netns / pasta (userspace)<br>Port &lt; 1024 bind qilib bo'lmaydi (default)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Podman (default rootless)<br>podman run --rm -it alpine id          # uid=0(root) container ichida<br>podman top -l huser user               # HUSER 100000 (host'da)<br>podman unshare cat /proc/self/uid_map<br># Docker rootless<br>dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install<br>export DOCKER_HOST=unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock<br>docker info | grep -i rootless</pre><p>Kubernetes'da: pod <code>hostUsers: false</code> (user namespaces, K8s 1.33+ da default yoqilgan beta) — xuddi shu mapping pod darajasida.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Tarmoq unumdorligi past bo'lishi (userspace networking), privileged port'lar va ba'zi storage driver'lar cheklangan.</li><li>Bind mount'larda fayl egaligi muammolari — host'da fayllar 100000+ UID bilan ko'rinadi.</li><li>Rootless kernel zaifliklaridan to'liq himoya qilmaydi — user namespace'ning o'zi ham hujum yuzasi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CI runner'lar va ko'p foydalanuvchili build serverlar uchun rootless (yoki Podman/Buildah, BuildKit rootless) — eng katta xavfsizlik yutug'i, chunki u yerda ishonchsiz kod ishlaydi. Prod K8s'da ekvivalenti — user namespaces + PSA restricted.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40393	<p>Pod Security Admission (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Pod Security Admission (PSA) — Kubernetes'ga o'rnatilgan admission controller (1.25 da GA, PodSecurityPolicy o'rnini bosgan): namespace label'lari orqali uch standartdan birini majburlaydi — <b>privileged</b> (cheklovsiz), <b>baseline</b> (ma'lum xavfli narsalarni taqiqlaydi: privileged, hostPath, hostNetwork), <b>restricted</b> (qattiq: non-root, drop ALL caps, seccomp). Uch rejim: <code>enforce</code>, <code>audit</code>, <code>warn</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dasturchi <code>privileged: true</code> yoki <code>hostPath: /</code> bilan pod deploy qila oladi — container escape eshigi. PSP murakkab edi va o'chirildi; boshqa himoya kerak.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>kubectl apply pod --&gt; API server --&gt; PodSecurity admission<br>                         | ns label'larini o'qi:<br>                         |  enforce=restricted -&gt; mos kelmasa RAD<br>                         |  warn=restricted    -&gt; kubectl'da ogohlantirish<br>                         |  audit=restricted   -&gt; audit log'ga<br>                         v<br>                     ruxsat / rad (sabab bilan)<br>Eslatma: Deployment yaratiladi, lekin uning Pod'lari rad etiladi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre># Avval ta'sirni ko'r (dry-run)<br>kubectl label --dry-run=server --overwrite ns orders pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted<br># Warning: existing pods in namespace &quot;orders&quot; violate the new PodSecurity enforce level &quot;restricted:latest&quot;<br># Warning: api-7d9: allowPrivilegeEscalation != false, runAsNonRoot != true ...<br><br>kubectl label ns orders \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=baseline \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn=restricted \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit=restricted \<br>  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version=v1.33</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Deployment rad etilmaydi, faqat pod'lar — <code>kubectl get rs</code> / event'larda <code>FailedCreate</code>ni ko'rmasdan &quot;deploy bo'ldi&quot; deb o'ylash.</li><li><code>kube-system</code> va monitoring agent'lari (privileged kerak) — ularning namespace'lari uchun ongli istisno.</li><li>PSA juda qo'pol: &quot;faqat ichki registry&quot;, &quot;label majburiy&quot; kabi qoidalarni bilmaydi — Kyverno/Gatekeeper yoki ValidatingAdmissionPolicy kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Migratsiya yo'li: hamma namespace'ga <code>warn</code>+<code>audit=restricted</code>, enforce=baseline; buzilishlarni tuzat; keyin enforce=restricted. Versiyani (<code>enforce-version</code>) qotirish K8s upgrade'da kutilmagan rad etishlardan saqlaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40394	<p>PDB (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PodDisruptionBudget (PDB) — <b>ixtiyoriy</b> (voluntary) uzilishlarda (node drain, cluster upgrade, Karpenter consolidation) bir vaqtning o'zida nechta pod o'chirilishi mumkinligini cheklaydi: <code>minAvailable</code> yoki <code>maxUnavailable</code>. Eviction API uni hurmat qiladi; majburiy uzilishlarni (node crash, OOM) to'xtatmaydi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Upgrade paytida <code>kubectl drain</code> bir vaqtda 2 node'ni bo'shatadi va 3 replikali servisning 3 tasi ham shu node'larda — servis to'liq uziladi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Deployment api: 4 replika, PDB maxUnavailable: 1<br>drain node-1 (pod a, b):<br>   evict a -&gt; ruxsat (3 ta sog'lom qoldi)<br>   evict b -&gt; 429 TooManyRequests (budget tugagan)<br>          ... a boshqa node'da Ready bo'lgach -&gt; b evict<br>Natija: har doim &gt;= 3 ta ishlaydi</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: policy/v1<br>kind: PodDisruptionBudget<br>metadata: { name: api, namespace: orders }<br>spec:<br>  maxUnavailable: 1<br>  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }<br>  unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow   # sog'lom bo'lmagan pod'lar drain'ni bloklamasin</pre><pre>kubectl get pdb -n orders<br># NAME  MIN AVAILABLE  MAX UNAVAILABLE  ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS<br># api   N/A            1                1<br>kubectl drain node-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=10m</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>1 replika + <code>minAvailable: 1</code> -&gt; <code>ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS 0</code> — drain abadiy osilib qoladi, upgrade bloklanadi.</li><li>PDB selector bir nechta Deployment'ga mos kelsa — kutilmagan hisob.</li><li><code>maxUnavailable: 0</code> — &quot;xavfsiz&quot; ko'rinadi, lekin barcha texnik xizmatni to'xtatadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> PDB yetarli replika (&gt;= 2-3), topologySpreadConstraints (AZ/node bo'ylab tarqatish) va readiness probe bilan birga ma'noga ega. Platforma darajasida policy: &quot;har prod Deployment'da PDB bo'lsin va u kamida 1 disruption'ga ruxsat bersin&quot;.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40395	<p>HPA (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> HorizontalPodAutoscaler (HPA) — Deployment/StatefulSet replikalar sonini metrikaga qarab avtomatik o'zgartiradi: CPU/xotira utilization (metrics-server), custom metrikalar (Prometheus Adapter: RPS) yoki external metrikalar (KEDA). Formula: <code>desired = ceil(current * currentMetric / targetMetric)</code>.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Kechqurun trafik 5x oshadi, tunda 10x kamayadi. Statik 20 replika — kunduzi yetmaydi yoki tunda pul isrof.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>har 15 s: HPA controller<br>  metrika: CPU o'rtacha 90%, target 60%, replika 4<br>  desired = ceil(4 * 90 / 60) = 6<br>  min/max chegara -&gt; behavior (stabilization, policy) -&gt; scale<br>CPU utilization = usage / REQUEST  (request yo'q bo'lsa HPA ishlamaydi)</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: autoscaling/v2<br>kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler<br>metadata: { name: api, namespace: orders }<br>spec:<br>  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }<br>  minReplicas: 3<br>  maxReplicas: 40<br>  metrics:<br>    - type: Resource<br>      resource: { name: cpu, target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 60 } }<br>  behavior:<br>    scaleDown:<br>      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300<br>      policies: [{ type: Percent, value: 20, periodSeconds: 60 }]</pre><pre>kubectl get hpa -n orders -w     # TARGETS 85%/60%  REPLICAS 6<br>kubectl describe hpa api -n orders   # Events, Conditions (ScalingLimited?)</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Container'da CPU request yo'q — <code>&lt;unknown&gt;/60%</code>, HPA ishlamaydi.</li><li>GitOps manifest'ida <code>replicas:</code> qotirilgan — Argo har sync'da HPA qiymatini qaytaradi; <code>replicas</code> ni manifest'dan olib tashla.</li><li>CPU latency'ning yomon proxy'si bo'lishi mumkin (I/O-bound servis) — RPS yoki queue metrikasi aniqroq.</li><li>Scale-up tezligi pod startup + node provisioning'dan sekin bo'lsa, sakrashda baribir yiqilasan.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> HPA target'ini headroom bilan tanla (60-70%), chunki yangi pod Ready bo'lguncha vaqt kerak. HPA va VPA'ni bir xil metrika (CPU) bo'yicha bitta workload'ga qo'yma — ular bir-biriga qarshi ishlaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40396	<p>VPA (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> VerticalPodAutoscaler (VPA) — container'larning CPU/xotira <b>requests</b> (va proporsional limits) ini tarixiy foydalanish asosida tavsiya qiladi yoki avtomatik o'rnatadi. Uch komponent: Recommender (tavsiya), Updater (pod'ni qayta yaratish), Admission Controller (yangi pod'ga qiymat yozish). Rejimlar: <code>Off</code>, <code>Initial</code>, <code>Recreate</code>, <code>InPlaceOrRecreate</code> (yangi, in-place resize asosida).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Dasturchilar request'larni taxmin bilan yozadi: biri 4 GB (ishlatadi 500 MB) — isrof; boshqasi 256 MB (kerak 1 GB) — OOMKill. Yuzlab servisni qo'lda tuning qilib bo'lmaydi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>metrics-server/Prometheus --&gt; Recommender (histogram, ~8 kun)<br>                                 | target, lowerBound, upperBound<br>                                 v<br>                           VPA status<br>     updateMode Off:      faqat tavsiya (xavfsiz boshlang'ich)<br>     Initial:             faqat yangi pod yaratilganda<br>     Recreate:            farq katta bo'lsa pod evict -&gt; yangi qiymat bilan<br>     InPlaceOrRecreate:   imkon bo'lsa restart'siz resize</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: autoscaling.k8s.io/v1<br>kind: VerticalPodAutoscaler<br>metadata: { name: api, namespace: orders }<br>spec:<br>  targetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }<br>  updatePolicy: { updateMode: &quot;Off&quot; }<br>  resourcePolicy:<br>    containerPolicies:<br>      - containerName: &quot;*&quot;<br>        minAllowed: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }<br>        maxAllowed: { cpu: &quot;2&quot;, memory: 4Gi }</pre><pre>kubectl describe vpa api -n orders<br># Recommendation: Target: cpu 250m, memory 610Mi  (Upper Bound: ...)</pre><p>Goldilocks har namespace'dagi VPA tavsiyalarini dashboard'da ko'rsatadi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li><code>Recreate</code> rejimi pod'larni evict qiladi — PDB bo'lmasa uzilish; kam replikali servislarda xavfli.</li><li>HPA (CPU bo'yicha) + VPA (CPU) bir workload'da — ziddiyat. VPA'ni faqat xotiraga yoki HPA'ni custom metrikaga qo'y.</li><li>JVM kabi runtime'lar heap'ni o'zi band qiladi — VPA &quot;ko'p ishlatyapti&quot; deb o'ylab request'ni oshiraveradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Eng xavfsiz va keng tarqalgan foydalanish — <code>updateMode: Off</code>: tavsiyalarni yig'ib, ularni GitOps orqali manifest'larga PR qilib kiritish. Avtomatik rejimni faqat stateless, ko'p replikali, PDB'li servislarga ber.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40397	<p>NodeLocal DNSCache (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> NodeLocal DNSCache — har node'da DaemonSet sifatida ishlaydigan DNS keshi (CoreDNS asosida, link-local IP <code>169.254.20.10</code>): pod'larning DNS so'rovlari avval lokal keshga boradi, faqat MISS bo'lsa markaziy CoreDNS'ga. Natija: DNS latency kamayadi, CoreDNS yuki va conntrack muammolari (UDP race, 5 s timeout'lar) yo'qoladi.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Katta klasterda tasodifiy 5 soniyalik kechikishlar: Linux conntrack'dagi UDP race (A va AAAA so'rovlari parallel) paketni tashlaydi, resolver 5 s kutib qayta yuboradi. Qo'shimcha: <code>ndots:5</code> sabab <code>api.stripe.com</code> uchun avval 4-5 ta noto'g'ri qidiruv domeni so'raladi — CoreDNS'ga 5x yuk.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Pod (resolv.conf: nameserver 169.254.20.10, ndots:5)<br>   |  api.stripe.com -&gt;<br>   |   api.stripe.com.orders.svc.cluster.local  NXDOMAIN (keshda)<br>   |   ... search domain'lar ...<br>   v<br>node-local-dns (har node, kesh, CoreDNS'ga TCP)<br>   | MISS<br>   v<br>CoreDNS (kube-dns Service) --&gt; upstream</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>kubectl get ds -n kube-system node-local-dns<br>kubectl exec -it api-7d9 -- cat /etc/resolv.conf<br># CoreDNS yuki va xatolar<br>kubectl -n kube-system logs -l k8s-app=kube-dns | grep -c NXDOMAIN</pre><p><code>ndots</code> ni kamaytirish (pod darajasida):</p><pre>spec:<br>  dnsConfig:<br>    options: [{ name: ndots, value: &quot;2&quot; }]</pre><p>Yoki tashqi domenlarni nuqta bilan yozish: <code>api.stripe.com.</code> (FQDN) — search domain'lar qo'llanmaydi.</p><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>kube-proxy rejimi (iptables/IPVS) va Cilium bilan o'rnatish farq qiladi — manifestdagi <code>__PILLAR__</code> qiymatlarini to'g'ri almashtir.</li><li>node-local-dns pod'i yiqilsa shu node'dagi barcha DNS — yuqori priority class va resurs ber.</li><li><code>ndots:2</code> qilsang qisqa ichki nomlar (<code>svc.ns</code>) ishlashini tekshir.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> DNS — eng ko'p &quot;tasodifiy&quot; latency sababi. Monitoring: CoreDNS so'rov tezligi, NXDOMAIN ulushi va p99 latency. NodeLocal DNSCache + ndots tuning birgalikda DNS yukini ko'pincha 5-10 baravar kamaytiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40398	<p>GitOps reconciliation loop nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> GitOps reconciliation loop — GitOps operatori (Argo CD, Flux) uzluksiz sikl: Git'dagi <b>desired state</b>ni o'qiydi, klasterdagi <b>live state</b> bilan solishtiradi, farq (drift) bo'lsa uni Git'ga moslab tuzatadi. Bu Kubernetes controller pattern'ining deploy darajasidagi qo'llanilishi; o'zgarish faqat Git orqali (pull model).</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Push CI (<code>kubectl apply</code> pipeline'dan): CI'ga klaster admin credential kerak, kimdir <code>kubectl edit</code> qilsa bilinmaydi, klaster holati Git'dan farq qilib ketadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Git (manifest, Helm, Kustomize)  -- desired<br>        |   (poll ~3 min yoki webhook)<br>        v<br> Argo CD / Flux (klaster ichida)<br>   diff(desired, live)<br>     teng   -&gt; Synced, Healthy<br>     farq   -&gt; OutOfSync -&gt; sync (avtomatik yoki qo'lda)<br>              selfHeal: qo'lda o'zgarish qaytariladi<br>              prune: Git'dan o'chirilgan resurs o'chiriladi<br>        ^<br>        |<br> Klaster live state</pre><p><b>Amalda:</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: Application<br>metadata: { name: orders, namespace: argocd }<br>spec:<br>  project: default<br>  source: { repoURL: https://github.com/acme/deploy, path: apps/orders/prod, targetRevision: main }<br>  destination: { server: https://kubernetes.default.svc, namespace: orders }<br>  syncPolicy:<br>    automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true }<br>    syncOptions: [ServerSideApply=true]</pre><pre>argocd app get orders          # Sync Status, Health<br>argocd app diff orders         # drift'ni ko'rish<br>flux get kustomizations        # Flux ekvivalenti<br>flux reconcile kustomization orders --with-source</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>HPA <code>replicas</code>, mutate webhook'lar o'zgartiradigan maydonlar — doimiy OutOfSync; <code>ignoreDifferences</code> bilan hal qil.</li><li><code>prune: true</code> + noto'g'ri path o'zgarishi — butun ilova o'chirilishi mumkin. Muhim resurslarga <code>Prune=false</code> annotatsiyasi.</li><li>Secret'lar Git'da ochiq — ESO yoki Sealed Secrets/SOPS kerak.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Reconciliation loop &quot;Git = yagona haqiqat manbasi&quot;ni amalda kafolatlaydi: rollback — <code>git revert</code>, audit — Git tarixi. Incident paytida qo'lda tuzatish kerak bo'lsa, avval auto-sync'ni ongli ravishda to'xtat, keyin o'zgarishni Git'ga qaytar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40399	<p>Progressive delivery (core concepts) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Progressive delivery — continuous delivery'ning rivoji: yangi versiyani hammaga birdan emas, bosqichma-bosqich (canary, blue-green, feature flag, foiz bo'yicha) chiqarish va har bosqichda metrikalarni (xato ulushi, latency, biznes KPI) avtomatik tahlil qilib, yaxshi bo'lsa davom ettirish, yomon bo'lsa avtomatik rollback. Tool'lar: Argo Rollouts, Flagger, LaunchDarkly/OpenFeature.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Rolling update yangi versiyani 10 daqiqada 100% ga chiqaradi; bug faqat real trafikda ko'rinadi — u paytga kelib barcha foydalanuvchilar ta'sirlangan. Blast radius maksimal.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>v2 deploy -&gt; 5% trafik --(5 min analiz: xato &lt; 1%, p99 &lt; 300ms)--&gt; 25%<br>          -&gt; analiz -&gt; 50% -&gt; analiz -&gt; 100% (promote)<br>              | metrika yomon<br>              v<br>          avtomatik abort -&gt; trafik 100% v1 ga<br>Feature flag: kod deploy qilingan, funksiya 1% user'ga yoqiladi<br>(deploy != release)</pre><p><b>Amalda (Argo Rollouts):</b></p><pre>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: Rollout<br>metadata: { name: api }<br>spec:<br>  strategy:<br>    canary:<br>      steps:<br>        - setWeight: 5<br>        - analysis: { templates: [{ templateName: error-rate }] }<br>        - setWeight: 25<br>        - pause: { duration: 10m }<br>        - setWeight: 50<br>        - analysis: { templates: [{ templateName: error-rate }] }<br>---<br>apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1<br>kind: AnalysisTemplate<br>metadata: { name: error-rate }<br>spec:<br>  metrics:<br>    - name: error-rate<br>      interval: 1m<br>      failureLimit: 2<br>      successCondition: result[0] &lt; 0.01<br>      provider:<br>        prometheus:<br>          address: http://prometheus:9090<br>          query: sum(rate(http_requests_total{app=&quot;api&quot;,code=~&quot;5..&quot;,rollouts_pod_template_hash=&quot;{{args.canary-hash}}&quot;}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{app=&quot;api&quot;,rollouts_pod_template_hash=&quot;{{args.canary-hash}}&quot;}[2m]))</pre><pre>kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api --watch<br>kubectl argo rollouts abort api</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>Kam trafikda 5% statistik ahamiyatsiz — analiz har doim &quot;o'tadi&quot;. Minimal so'rov sonini shart qil.</li><li>DB sxema o'zgarishi canary bilan mos emas (eski va yangi versiya bir vaqtda ishlaydi) — expand/contract migratsiya.</li><li>Faqat texnik metrikalar — biznes metrika (konversiya) tushishi ko'rinmaydi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Progressive delivery'ning asosi — kuzatuvchanlik: versiya bo'yicha ajratilgan metrikalar bo'lmasa avtomatik analiz imkonsiz. Deploy va release'ni ajratish (feature flag) rollback'ni sekundlarga tushiradi va jamoaga tez-tez deploy qilishga jasorat beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H5 Platform engineering & FinOps	idrill-40400	<p>SRE blameless post-mortem tamoyili nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Blameless post-mortem — incident'dan keyingi tahlil, unda maqsad aybdorni topish emas, <b>tizim</b> nega xatoga yo'l qo'yganini tushunish: inson xatosi — tergovning xulosasi emas, boshlanish nuqtasi (&quot;nega bu xato qilish oson edi va nega uni hech narsa ushlab qolmadi?&quot;). Natija — tizimli himoyalarni kuchaytiruvchi aniq action item'lar.</p><p><b>Muammo:</b> Agar incident uchun odam jazolansa, keyingi safar odamlar xatolarni yashiradi, ma'lumot bermaydi, near-miss'lar haqida gapirmaydi — tashkilot o'rganmaydi va xuddi shu incident takrorlanadi.</p><p><b>Qanday ishlaydi:</b></p><pre>Incident hal bo'ldi<br>  -&gt; 24-72 soat ichida draft (incident commander yoki owner)<br>  -&gt; Timeline (fakt, UTC vaqt, log/grafik dalillari)<br>  -&gt; Impact (foydalanuvchi, SLO budget, pul)<br>  -&gt; Contributing factors (bitta &quot;root cause&quot; emas, bir nechta omil)<br>  -&gt; Nima yaxshi ishladi / nima omadli bo'ldi<br>  -&gt; Action items: owner + muddat + prioritet<br>  -&gt; review uchrashuvi (blameless facilitator) -&gt; ommaviy ulashish<br>  -&gt; action item'lar bajarilishini kuzatish</pre><p><b>Amalda (shablon parchasi):</b></p><pre>## Xulosa<br>2026-09-14 10:02-10:41 UTC checkout 38% 5xx qaytardi (SLO budget'ning 22%).<br>## Timeline<br>10:00 config PR #812 merge (connection pool 50 -&gt; 5)<br>10:02 5xx alert ... 10:31 rollback ... 10:41 tiklandi<br>## Hissa qo'shgan omillar<br>- Config o'zgarishi canary'siz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri prod'ga<br>- Pool hajmi uchun validatsiya yo'q<br>- Alert runbook'i eskirgan<br>## Action items<br>| Amal | Owner | Muddat |<br>| Config o'zgarishlarini ham progressive rollout | @platform | 10-01 |<br>| Pool hajmiga CI validatsiyasi | @orders | 09-25 |</pre><p><b>Tuzoqlar:</b></p><ul><li>&quot;Root cause: inson xatosi&quot; yoki &quot;ehtiyot bo'lish kerak&quot; kabi action item — hech narsani o'zgartirmaydi.</li><li>Action item'lar backlog'da yo'qoladi — kuzatilmasa post-mortem teatr.</li><li>Blameless — accountability'siz degani emas: owner'lar va muddatlar aniq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> &quot;5 Whys&quot; o'rniga bir nechta contributing factor bilan fikrla — murakkab tizimlarda yagona root cause kamdan-kam. Post-mortem'larni tashkilot bo'ylab ulash va davriy tahlil qil (qaysi naqshlar takrorlanadi) — eng katta qiymat aynan shu kesishmalarda.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::sre sec::h5 Platform_engineering_FinOps
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H6 12-Factor & cloud-native patterns	idrill-40401	<p>12-Factor App metodologiyasini va har faktor zamonaviy Kubernetes'ga qanday mos kelishini tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> 12-Factor App — bulutda ishlaydigan, oson masshtablanadigan va deploy qilinadigan ilova yozish uchun 12 ta qoida (Heroku, 2011). Kubernetes ko'p qoidalarni <b>platforma darajasida</b> qo'llab-quvvatlaydi — ilova shu qoidalarga amal qilsa, K8s'da tabiiy ishlaydi; amal qilmasa, har deploy og'riqli.</p><h4>12 faktor va K8s'dagi ko'rinishi</h4><p>| # | Faktor | Ma'nosi | K8s'da | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | Codebase | bitta repo -&gt; ko'p deploy | bitta image, muhitlar GitOps overlay'lari | | 2 | Dependencies | aniq e'lon, izolyatsiya | lock fayl + container image | | 3 | Config | konfiguratsiya muhitda, kodda emas | ConfigMap, Secret, env | | 4 | Backing services | DB, kesh — URL orqali ulanadigan resurs | <code>DATABASE_URL</code>, Service DNS | | 5 | Build, release, run | bosqichlar ajratilgan | CI image -&gt; Helm release -&gt; pod | | 6 | Processes | <b>stateless</b> process'lar | pod istalgan payt o'ladi; holat DB/Redis'da | | 7 | Port binding | ilova o'zi port tinglaydi | <code>containerPort</code>, Service | | 8 | Concurrency | process'larni ko'paytirib masshtab | replikalar, HPA | | 9 | Disposability | tez start, graceful shutdown | readiness, <code>SIGTERM</code>, preStop | | 10 | Dev/prod parity | muhitlar o'xshash | bir xil image hamma joyda | | 11 | Logs | log — stdout'ga oqim | <code>kubectl logs</code>, Fluent Bit yig'adi | | 12 | Admin processes | bir martalik vazifalar alohida | Job, CronJob, init container |</p><h4>Eng muhimlari (amaliyotda ko'p buziladigan)</h4><p><b>3. Config</b> — bir xil image dev va prod'da ishlashi kerak; farq faqat muhit o'zgaruvchilarida. Image ichida <code>config.prod.yaml</code> — anti-pattern.</p><p><b>6. Stateless</b> — lokal diskka sessiya, yuklangan fayl yozish — pod qayta yaratilganda yo'qoladi va replikalar orasida bo'linmaydi.</p><p><b>9. Disposability</b> — ilova <code>SIGTERM</code>da joriy so'rovlarni tugatib chiqishi, tez ishga tushishi kerak. Aks holda har deploy va scale-down — 5xx.</p><p><b>11. Logs</b> — faylga emas, stdout'ga; formatlash (JSON) va yig'ish platformaning ishi.</p><h4>Zamonaviy to'ldirishlar (12 faktordan keyin)</h4><ul><li><b>Telemetry</b>: metrika va trace (OpenTelemetry).</li><li><b>Health</b>: liveness/readiness endpoint'lari.</li><li><b>Security</b>: secret'lar alohida (Vault), least privilege identity.</li><li><b>API-first</b>: aniq kontraktlar.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> 12-Factor — dogma emas, &quot;ilova va platforma o'rtasidagi kontrakt&quot;. Har buzilish operatsion narxga ega: masalan stateful pod'lar (6) masshtab va deploy'ni murakkablashtiradi. Agar holat kerak bo'lsa — bu ongli qaror (StatefulSet, operator) bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::sre sec::h6 12-Factor_cloud-native_patterns
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H6 12-Factor & cloud-native patterns	idrill-40402	<p>Immutable infrastructure nima va operatsion foydasi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Immutable infrastructure — server yoki container <b>ishlab turganida o'zgartirilmaydi</b> (patch, konfiguratsiya tahriri, qo'lda tuzatish yo'q). Har o'zgarish = <b>yangi image</b> yasash, test qilish, eskisining o'rniga deploy qilish va eskisini o'chirish. Natija: har muhit aniq ma'lum, takrorlanadigan holatda.</p><h4>Mutable va immutable</h4><pre>Mutable:   server-1 (2019) -&gt; apt upgrade -&gt; config tahrir -&gt; hotfix -&gt; ... <br>           -&gt; 5 yildan keyin hech kim uning aniq holatini bilmaydi (&quot;snowflake&quot;)<br><br>Immutable: image v41 -&gt; deploy<br>           o'zgarish kerak -&gt; image v42 (CI'da build + test) -&gt; deploy -&gt; v41 o'chiriladi</pre><h4>Foydalari</h4><ul><li><b>Drift yo'q</b>: prod'dagi narsa aynan Git va CI'dagi narsa.</li><li><b>Deterministik rollback</b>: oldingi image'ga qaytish — bitta buyruq (v42 -&gt; v41).</li><li><b>Takrorlanuvchanlik</b>: staging'da sinalgan image prod'ga bir xil boradi.</li><li><b>Xavfsizlik</b>: hujumchi o'zgartirgan server keyingi deploy'da yo'qoladi; read-only fayl tizimi qo'llash oson.</li><li><b>Masshtab va DR</b>: yangi server = image'dan ishga tushirish, qo'lda sozlash yo'q.</li></ul><h4>Qanday amalga oshiriladi</h4><ul><li><b>Container'lar</b>: Docker image + Kubernetes — tabiiy immutable.</li><li><b>VM'lar</b>: Packer bilan &quot;golden AMI&quot; + Auto Scaling Group instance refresh.</li><li><b>Konfiguratsiya</b>: image'ga yoki deploy vaqtida (ConfigMap) — server ichida tahrir emas.</li><li>Production'ga SSH olib tashlanadi yoki faqat o'qish/debug uchun.</li></ul><h4>Talablar va qiyinchiliklar</h4><ul><li><b>Holat tashqarida</b> bo'lishi kerak (DB, object storage) — server o'chsa yo'qolmasligi uchun.</li><li>Tez va ishonchli <b>CI/CD</b> — har o'zgarish image build talab qiladi.</li><li>Kichik tuzatish ham to'liq pipeline'dan o'tadi — bu yaxshi (tekshirilgan), lekin pipeline tez bo'lishi kerak.</li><li>Stateful tizimlar (DB) to'liq immutable emas — ular uchun boshqa yondashuv (operator, managed servis).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Immutable'ning eng katta foydasi — <b>ishonch</b>: &quot;prod'da nima bor?&quot; savoliga aniq javob (image digest). Favqulodda &quot;qo'lda tuzatish&quot; vasvasasi kuchli bo'ladi — shuning uchun tez pipeline va rollback incident paytida ham qo'lda tahrirdan tezroq bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::sre sec::h6 12-Factor_cloud-native_patterns
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H6 12-Factor & cloud-native patterns	idrill-40403	<p>DR'da RTO va RPO farqini aniq ssenariy bilan tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <b>RTO</b> — avariyadan keyin servis <b>qancha vaqtda</b> tiklanishi kerak (ruxsat etilgan downtime). <b>RPO</b> — <b>qancha ma'lumot</b> yo'qotishga ruxsat bor, vaqt bilan o'lchanadi (oxirgi tiklanadigan nuqta qanchalik orqada). RTO — &quot;qancha kutamiz&quot;, RPO — &quot;qancha yo'qotamiz&quot;.</p><h4>Vaqt chizig'ida</h4><pre>   oxirgi backup          avariya              servis tiklandi<br>       |                     |                       |<br>-------B---------------------X-----------------------R------&gt; vaqt<br>       |&lt;------ RPO --------&gt;|&lt;-------- RTO --------&gt;|<br>       yo'qolgan ma'lumot       downtime</pre><h4>Ssenariy</h4><p>Onlayn do'kon DB'si. Backup har kuni 00:00 da. Avariya 14:00 da (disk buzildi). Tiklash: yangi server + backup'ni yuklash 3 soat.</p><ul><li><b>RPO amalda</b> = 14 soat (00:00 dan 14:00 gacha barcha buyurtmalar yo'qoldi).</li><li><b>RTO amalda</b> = 3 soat.</li></ul><p>Agar biznes &quot;ko'pi bilan 5 daqiqa ma'lumot va 30 daqiqa downtime&quot; desa — kunlik backup ham, qo'lda tiklash ham yaramaydi.</p><h4>Talabga qarab yechim</h4><p>| Talab | Yechim | |---|---| | RPO soatlar | rejali backup | | RPO daqiqalar | WAL/binlog archiving + PITR (point-in-time recovery) | | RPO soniyalar | asinxron replika | | RPO ~0 | sinxron replikatsiya | | RTO soatlar | backup'dan tiklash | | RTO daqiqalar | warm standby, avtomatik failover | | RTO ~0 | active-active |</p><h4>Muhim nuqtalar</h4><ul><li>RTO va RPO <b>biznes</b> belgilaydi (narx va zarar asosida), muhandislar emas — muhandislar narxini aytadi.</li><li>Har tizim uchun alohida: to'lov DB'si va analitika hisobotlari bir xil talabga ega emas.</li><li>RTO faqat texnik tiklash emas: aniqlash, qaror qabul qilish, DNS tarqalishi, tekshirish ham ichida.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Sinalmagan backup — backup emas. RTO va RPO faqat <b>muntazam tiklash mashqlari</b> bilan tasdiqlanadi: haqiqiy backup'dan tiklab, vaqtini o'lchash. Ko'pincha &quot;30 daqiqa&quot; deb yozilgan RTO amalda 6 soat bo'lib chiqadi.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::sre sec::h6 12-Factor_cloud-native_patterns
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H6 12-Factor & cloud-native patterns	idrill-40404	<p>To'rtta asosiy cloud DR strategiyasini solishtiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> To'rt strategiya narx va tiklanish tezligi o'rtasidagi pog'onalar: <b>Backup &amp; Restore</b> (eng arzon, eng sekin), <b>Pilot Light</b> (ma'lumot tayyor, compute yo'q), <b>Warm Standby</b> (hamma narsa kichik hajmda ishlab turibdi), <b>Multi-site Active-Active</b> (ikkala joy to'liq ishlaydi, eng qimmat). Tanlov — biznesning RTO/RPO talabi va narxga tayyorligi.</p><h4>Taqqoslash</h4><p>| Strategiya | Ikkinchi regionda nima bor | RTO | RPO | Narx | |---|---|---|---|---| | Backup &amp; Restore | faqat backup'lar (S3) | soatlar–kun | soatlar | $ | | Pilot Light | ma'lumot replikatsiyasi, compute o'chiq/minimal | 10–60 daq | daqiqalar | $$ | | Warm Standby | to'liq stack, kichik hajmda ishlaydi | daqiqalar | soniyalar | $$$ | | Active-Active | to'liq stack, trafik oladi | ~0 | ~0–soniyalar | $$$$ |</p><h4>1. Backup &amp; Restore</h4><ul><li>Backup'lar boshqa regionga nusxalanadi (S3 CRR, AWS Backup cross-region copy).</li><li>Avariyada: infra IaC bilan noldan, ma'lumot backup'dan.</li><li>Talab: IaC to'liq bo'lishi (qo'lda sozlangan narsa tiklanmaydi).</li></ul><h4>2. Pilot Light</h4><ul><li>DB replikasi doim ishlaydi (&quot;uchqun&quot;).</li><li>Ilova serverlari o'chiq yoki 0 replika; AMI/image'lar tayyor.</li><li>Avariyada: compute ishga tushiriladi va masshtablanadi, DB promote.</li></ul><h4>3. Warm Standby</h4><ul><li>To'liq nusxa, lekin minimal quvvat (masalan 10%).</li><li>Avariyada: masshtablash va trafikni o'tkazish — tez.</li><li>Bonus: standby doim ishlaydi — sinash oson, &quot;ishlamay qolgan&quot; sozlamalar tez topiladi.</li></ul><h4>4. Active-Active</h4><ul><li>Ikki (yoki ko'p) region bir vaqtda foydalanuvchilarga xizmat qiladi.</li><li>Eng qiyin qism — <b>ma'lumot</b>: ikki joyda yozish (konfliktlar) yoki global konsistent DB.</li><li>Avariyada: trafik avtomatik qolgan regionlarga.</li></ul><h4>Tanlash</h4><ul><li>Har tizim uchun alohida: kritik to'lov — warm standby/active-active; ichki hisobot — backup &amp; restore.</li><li>Narxni avariya zarari bilan solishtirish: 1 soat downtime qancha turadi?</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Strategiyaning haqiqiy sifati — <b>mashqlar</b> bilan aniqlanadi. Backup &amp; Restore'da eng ko'p uchraydigan muvaffaqiyatsizlik: IaC to'liq emas, secret'lar va DNS unutilgan, tiklash hech qachon sinalmagan. Warm standby'ning yashirin foydasi — u doim ishlaydi, shuning uchun &quot;chirib ketmaydi&quot;.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::sre sec::h6 12-Factor_cloud-native_patterns
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H6 12-Factor & cloud-native patterns	idrill-40405	<p>Distributed tizimlarda Bulkhead pattern nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Bulkhead (kemaning suv o'tkazmaydigan bo'limlari) — resurslarni (thread pool, connection pool, navbat, xotira) <b>bog'liqliklar bo'yicha alohida bo'limlarga</b> ajratish. Bitta sekin yoki yiqilgan servis faqat <b>o'z bo'limini</b> to'ldiradi va butun ilovani &quot;cho'ktira&quot; olmaydi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><pre>API servis: umumiy pool 200 thread<br>  -&gt; recommendation servis sekinlashdi (10s javob)<br>  -&gt; 200 thread'ning hammasi recommendation'ni kutyapti<br>  -&gt; to'lov, login so'rovlari uchun thread qolmadi -&gt; butun API yiqildi</pre><p>Muhim bo'lmagan funksiya muhim funksiyalarni o'ldirdi.</p><h4>Bulkhead bilan</h4><pre>pool &quot;payments&quot;        50 thread<br>pool &quot;recommendations&quot; 20 thread   &lt;- to'ldi, so'rovlar tez rad etiladi<br>pool &quot;users&quot;           30 thread</pre><p>Recommendation sekinlashsa — faqat uning 20 thread'i band; to'lov va login ishlayveradi. Recommendation so'rovlari esa tez xato (yoki fallback) oladi.</p><h4>Qayerda qo'llanadi</h4><ul><li><b>Ilova ichida</b>: har downstream uchun alohida HTTP client pool, semaphore yoki thread pool (Resilience4j <code>Bulkhead</code>, Go'da buffered channel/semaphore).</li></ul><pre>var recSem = make(chan struct{}, 20)    // ko'pi bilan 20 parallel chaqiruv<br><br>func callRecommendations(ctx context.Context) ([]Item, error) {<br>    select {<br>    case recSem &lt;- struct{}{}:<br>        defer func() { &lt;-recSem }()<br>        return recClient.Get(ctx)<br>    default:<br>        return fallbackTopSellers(), nil   // bo'lim to'la — darhol fallback<br>    }<br>}</pre><ul><li><b>DB ulanishlari</b>: har servis/funksiya uchun alohida pool yoki kvota.</li><li><b>Infra darajasida</b>: kritik servislar alohida node pool'da, alohida klaster yoki akkaunt (blast radius).</li><li><b>Tenant'lar</b>: katta mijoz alohida resurslarda — bitta mijoz hammani sekinlashtirmaydi.</li><li><b>Kubernetes</b>: ResourceQuota, PriorityClass.</li></ul><h4>Bog'liq pattern'lar</h4><ul><li><b>Timeout</b> — kutish cheklangan (bulkhead'siz ham asosiy himoya).</li><li><b>Circuit breaker</b> — doimiy xatoli servisni umuman chaqirmaslik.</li><li><b>Graceful degradation</b> — bo'lim to'lganda fallback.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bulkhead o'lchamini o'lchovlar asosida tanlang (Little qonuni: parallel so'rovlar ≈ RPS x latency). Juda kichik — oddiy yukda rad etishlar; juda katta — himoya yo'q. Va har bo'lim uchun metrika: to'lishi va rad etishlar alert bo'lishi kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::sre sec::h6 12-Factor_cloud-native_patterns
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H6 12-Factor & cloud-native patterns	idrill-40406	<p>Circuit breaker nima va uning uchta holati?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Circuit breaker (elektr saqlagichi) — doimiy ishlamayotgan servisni <b>qayta-qayta chaqirishni to'xtatadi</b>. Xatolar ko'payganda &quot;uziladi&quot; (Open) va so'rovlar darhol xato yoki fallback qaytaradi — kutish, resurs isrofi va yiqilgan servisga qo'shimcha yuk yo'q. Bir muddatdan keyin ehtiyotkorlik bilan sinab ko'radi (Half-Open) va servis tiklangan bo'lsa yana ulanadi (Closed).</p><h4>Uch holat</h4><pre>         xatolar chegaradan oshdi<br> CLOSED ---------------------------&gt; OPEN<br>   ^                                  |<br>   | sinov so'rovlari muvaffaqiyatli  | kutish vaqti (masalan 30s) o'tdi<br>   |                                  v<br>   +-------------------------- HALF-OPEN<br>        sinov xato -&gt; yana OPEN</pre><ul><li><b>Closed</b> — normal: so'rovlar o'tadi, xatolar hisoblanadi (masalan oxirgi 100 so'rovdan 50% xato yoki sekin).</li><li><b>Open</b> — so'rovlar downstream'ga <b>yuborilmaydi</b>, darhol xato/fallback. Servisga tiklanish uchun &quot;nafas&quot; beriladi.</li><li><b>Half-Open</b> — oz sonli sinov so'rovi o'tkaziladi; muvaffaqiyatli — Closed, xato — yana Open.</li></ul><h4>Nega kerak</h4><ul><li>Yiqilgan servisni kutish (timeout 30s) — chaqiruvchining thread'lari band, u ham yiqiladi (kaskad).</li><li>Retry'lar yiqilgan servisni tiklanishiga qo'ymaydi.</li><li>Foydalanuvchiga tez javob (hatto xato yoki zaxira) — uzoq kutishdan yaxshi.</li></ul><h4>Misol (Go, sony/gobreaker)</h4><pre>cb := gobreaker.NewCircuitBreaker(gobreaker.Settings{<br>    Name:        &quot;payments&quot;,<br>    MaxRequests: 5,                       // half-open'da sinov so'rovlari<br>    Timeout:     30 * time.Second,        // open holati davomiyligi<br>    ReadyToTrip: func(c gobreaker.Counts) bool {<br>        return c.Requests &gt;= 20 &amp;&amp; float64(c.TotalFailures)/float64(c.Requests) &gt; 0.5<br>    },<br>})<br><br>res, err := cb.Execute(func() (any, error) { return paymentsClient.Charge(ctx, req) })<br>if errors.Is(err, gobreaker.ErrOpenState) {<br>    // fallback: navbatga qo'yish, &quot;keyinroq urinib ko'ring&quot;<br>}</pre><p>Service mesh'da (Istio <code>outlierDetection</code>) yoki gateway'da ham qo'llash mumkin.</p><h4>Sozlash nozikliklari</h4><ul><li>Qaysi xatolar hisoblanadi: 5xx va timeout — ha; 4xx (client xatosi) — yo'q.</li><li>Minimal so'rovlar soni — kam trafikda 1 xato &quot;50%&quot; bo'lmasin.</li><li>Har downstream uchun alohida breaker.</li><li>Holat o'zgarishlari — metrika va alert.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Circuit breaker o'zi muammoni hal qilmaydi — u <b>nima qilish</b>ni tanlashga majbur qiladi: Open holatda fallback nima? Kesh'dan eski ma'lumot, degradatsiya, navbatga qo'yish yoki aniq xato. Bu biznes qarori va uni oldindan loyihalash kerak.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::sre sec::h6 12-Factor_cloud-native_patterns
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H6 12-Factor & cloud-native patterns	idrill-40407	<p>Jitter bilan exponential backoff nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Retry'da har urinishdan keyin kutish vaqti <b>eksponensial</b> oshadi (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s...) — vaqtincha muammoga tiklanishga vaqt beriladi. <b>Jitter</b> — bu vaqtga <b>tasodifiylik</b> qo'shish: minglab client bir vaqtda xato olsa, ular bir vaqtda qayta urinmasligi uchun. Jitter'siz backoff &quot;to'lqinlar&quot; hosil qiladi va servisni qayta-qayta yiqitadi (thundering herd).</p><h4>Nega oddiy retry xavfli</h4><ul><li>Darhol retry — yiqilgan servisga yuk ko'payadi.</li><li>Qat'iy interval (har 1s) — hamma client sinxron, har soniyada &quot;zarb&quot;.</li><li>Eksponensial, lekin jitter'siz — client'lar 1s, 2s, 4s'da <b>birga</b> qaytadi.</li></ul><h4>Jitter turlari</h4><pre>base = 100ms, cap = 10s, attempt = n<br>exp = min(cap, base * 2^n)<br><br>No jitter:     sleep = exp<br>Full jitter:   sleep = random(0, exp)                  &lt;- odatda eng yaxshi<br>Equal jitter:  sleep = exp/2 + random(0, exp/2)<br>Decorrelated:  sleep = min(cap, random(base, prev_sleep * 3))</pre><p>AWS Architecture Blog tahliliga ko'ra <b>full jitter</b> umumiy ishni va tugash vaqtini eng ko'p kamaytiradi.</p><h4>Go misoli</h4><pre>func retry(ctx context.Context, op func() error) error {<br>    const base, maxDelay, attempts = 100 * time.Millisecond, 10 * time.Second, 5<br>    var err error<br>    for i := 0; i &lt; attempts; i++ {<br>        if err = op(); err == nil || !isRetryable(err) {<br>            return err<br>        }<br>        exp := min(maxDelay, base&lt;&lt;i)<br>        sleep := time.Duration(rand.Int64N(int64(exp)))      // full jitter<br>        select {<br>        case &lt;-time.After(sleep):<br>        case &lt;-ctx.Done():<br>            return ctx.Err()<br>        }<br>    }<br>    return err<br>}</pre><h4>Qoidalar</h4><ul><li>Faqat <b>vaqtinchalik</b> xatolarda (timeout, 503, 429, ulanish uzilishi) — 400/404 da emas.</li><li>Faqat <b>idempotent</b> operatsiyalarda, yoki idempotency key bilan (aks holda ikki marta to'lov).</li><li>Urinishlar soni va umumiy vaqt cheklangan (context deadline).</li><li>429/503'dagi <code>Retry-After</code> header'ini hurmat qilish.</li><li><b>Retry budget</b> — retry'lar umumiy so'rovlarning ~10%idan oshmasin.</li><li>Faqat bitta qatlamda retry (har qatlamda 3x = 27x yuk).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Retry — ishonchlilikni oshiradi, lekin noto'g'ri qo'llansa <b>avariya kuchaytirgichi</b>. Har retry siyosatini &quot;hamma client bir vaqtda shunday qilsa nima bo'ladi?&quot; savoli bilan tekshiring.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::sre sec::h6 12-Factor_cloud-native_patterns
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H6 12-Factor & cloud-native patterns	idrill-40408	<p>Zero-downtime DB migration uchun Expand and Contract pattern nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Expand and Contract (parallel change) — DB sxemasini <b>downtime'siz</b> o'zgartirish usuli: o'zgarishni bir nechta <b>orqaga mos</b> (backward-compatible) bosqichga bo'lish. Har bosqichda eski va yangi ilova versiyalari bir vaqtda ishlay oladi — chunki rolling deploy paytida ikkalasi ham ishlaydi. Avval <b>kengaytirish</b> (yangisini qo'shish), keyin ko'chish, oxirida <b>qisqartirish</b> (eskisini o'chirish).</p><h4>Nega oddiy migratsiya xavfli</h4><p><code>ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN name TO full_name;</code> — deploy paytida eski pod'lar hali <code>name</code>ni so'raydi -&gt; xato. Yoki migratsiya avval, kod keyin — orada hamma narsa buziladi.</p><h4>Misol: <code>name</code> -&gt; <code>full_name</code></h4><p><b>1. Expand</b> — yangi ustun qo'shish (eski kod buni sezmaydi):</p><pre>ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN full_name text;   -- nullable, tez (PG'da metadata o'zgarishi)</pre><p><b>2. Dual write</b> — ilova v2 ikkala ustunga yozadi, hali <b>eskidan</b> o'qiydi. Deploy.</p><p><b>3. Backfill</b> — eski yozuvlarni partiyalab ko'chirish (katta jadvalni lock qilmaslik uchun):</p><pre>UPDATE users SET full_name = name<br>WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND full_name IS NULL;   -- sikl bilan, partiyalab</pre><p><b>4. Read new</b> — ilova v3 <b>yangidan</b> o'qiydi, hali ikkalasiga yozadi. Tekshirish, kuzatish.</p><p><b>5. Stop old writes</b> — ilova v4 faqat yangi ustunga yozadi.</p><p><b>6. Contract</b> — keyingi relizda (orqaga qaytish kerak emasligiga ishonch hosil qilgach):</p><pre>ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN name;</pre><h4>Har bosqichda rollback mumkin</h4><p>Istalgan bosqichda oldingi ilova versiyasiga qaytish ma'lumotni buzmaydi — bu pattern'ning asosiy qiymati.</p><h4>Boshqa xavfli operatsiyalar va to'g'ri usullar (PostgreSQL)</h4><ul><li>Indeks: <code>CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY</code> (jadvalni lock qilmaydi).</li><li><code>NOT NULL</code> qo'shish: avval <code>CHECK (col IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID</code>, keyin <code>VALIDATE CONSTRAINT</code>.</li><li>Default bilan ustun: PG11+ tez; eski versiyalarda butun jadvalni qayta yozadi.</li><li><code>lock_timeout</code> o'rnatish — migratsiya uzoq lock kutib, butun jadvalni bloklamasin.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Expand/contract ko'p deploy talab qiladi — sekinroq, lekin xavfsiz. Asosiy intizom: <b>migratsiya va kod o'zgarishi bitta relizda orqaga mos kelmaydigan holda bo'lmasligi</b>. Bu qoidani CI'da tekshirish (masalan <code>squawk</code> linter PostgreSQL migratsiyalari uchun) foydali.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::sre sec::h6 12-Factor_cloud-native_patterns
Interview Drill::DevOps & SRE::H6 12-Factor & cloud-native patterns	idrill-40409	<p>Chaos engineering nima va GameDay qanday o'tkaziladi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Chaos engineering — tizimga <b>ataylab, nazorat ostida</b> nosozlik kiritib (pod o'ldirish, tarmoq kechikishi, DB uzilishi, AZ yo'qolishi), u haqiqatan kutilgandek chidamli ekanini <b>tajriba bilan</b> tekshirish. Maqsad — zaifliklarni avariya <b>sizni</b> topishidan oldin topish. GameDay — jamoalar bilan rejalashtirilgan, katta ssenariyli chaos mashqi.</p><h4>Ilmiy usul</h4><ol><li><b>Barqaror holat</b>ni belgilash (o'lchanadigan): &quot;checkout muvaffaqiyati &gt; 99.9%, p99 &lt; 300ms&quot;.</li><li><b>Gipoteza</b>: &quot;bitta AZ yo'qolsa, barqaror holat saqlanadi&quot;.</li><li><b>Nosozlik kiritish</b> — kichik blast radius bilan.</li><li><b>Kuzatish</b>: gipoteza tasdiqlandimi?</li><li><b>O'rganish va tuzatish</b>; keyin tajribani qayta o'tkazish.</li></ol><h4>Tajriba turlari</h4><ul><li>Infra: node/pod o'ldirish, AZ'ni o'chirish, disk to'ldirish, CPU yuklash.</li><li>Tarmoq: latency, paket yo'qolishi, DNS xatolari, bo'linish.</li><li>Bog'liqliklar: DB failover, kesh yo'qolishi, uchinchi tomon API sekinlashishi.</li><li>Ilova: xato javoblar inject qilish (fault injection, Istio).</li></ul><h4>Vositalar</h4><ul><li>Kubernetes: <b>Chaos Mesh</b>, <b>LitmusChaos</b>.</li><li>AWS <b>Fault Injection Service (FIS)</b> — EC2, EKS, RDS, AZ darajasidagi tajribalar, stop condition'lar bilan.</li><li>Gremlin (tijorat), Toxiproxy (tarmoq simulyatsiyasi testlarda).</li></ul><h4>Xavfsizlik qoidalari</h4><ul><li>Avval staging, keyin production'da kichik ulush.</li><li><b>Stop condition</b> (avtomatik to'xtatish): masalan error rate &gt; 1%.</li><li>Bir tugma bilan bekor qilish.</li><li>Observability tayyor — nima bo'layotganini ko'rmasangiz, tajriba foydasiz.</li><li>Stakeholder'lar xabardor, muhim savdo kunlari emas.</li></ul><h4>GameDay</h4><p>Bir necha soatlik rejalashtirilgan mashq: real ssenariy (masalan &quot;asosiy DB regioni ishdan chiqdi&quot;), on-call jamoa javob beradi, kuzatuvchilar timeline yozadi. Tekshiriladi: alert'lar keldimi, runbook ishladimi, failover avtomatik bo'ldimi, kommunikatsiya qanday. Natija — action item'lar.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Chaos engineering'ning eng katta qiymati ko'pincha texnik zaifliklar emas, balki <b>yashirin taxminlar</b>ni ochish: &quot;bu servis kritik emas deb o'ylagandik&quot;, &quot;retry'lar bor deb o'ylagandik&quot;. Uni muntazam (oylik/chorak) va avtomatlashtirilgan (CI'da) qilish — bir martalik ko'rgazmadan ancha qimmatli.</p>	lvl::Middle dom::sre sec::h6 12-Factor_cloud-native_patterns
